The drink came out almost as good as the original drink. I'll always keep coming back to this location. Service is everything, vote with your wallet, I will. 

Thank You Dtown Starbucks
Awesome customer service! Just passing through land needed a coffee fix! Beautiful scenic drive off the beaten path of Interstate 40.

Shoutout to the barista with the awesome dinosaur shirt. Just as a mark of authenticity, my three drink order came out to $10 even. I didn't get your name, but you were great!
To the rest of the staff- thanks!

I recently popped in here before my nail appointment to grab a quick pick me up. There was only one person ahead of me and it looked as though she was purchasing a gift card. 

The two baristas that were working were trying to figure out how to ring in her purchase but we're having a difficult time. 

The customer suggested taking my order and allowing me to go first while they figured out the gift card. The baristas said it was only going to be a second so I replied that I wasn't in a huge rush. 

10 mins later... (Yes, I was watching the clock) The TWO people working still hadn't figured it out! I sadly had to walk out... I really should have said something but I was furious! 

I don't think I will be back to this location. The lack of service, teamwork and disregard for the customers was a real turn off!

yeah dude. it's starbucks... i don't even remember which one this is. oh yeah, old city. let's see. this one is GREAT if you have to piss during first friday. no line, and you don't even have to buy anything...

A little small inside. If you're coming to get some studying done or work, it's not very comfortable. The staff is very kind though and the drinks are fantastic. I lost my gloves a week ago and it turned out that only one was missing. My boyfriend told me to call and ask, days later, if they found it in the parking lot... and they had it in their lost and found! I'm so grateful. It just goes to show they really take care of this location.

this starbucks sucks. i was in the drive threw line for what feels like forever when only like 4 cars are in front of me. i do not know what takes so long but i've never been in a slower starbucks line in my life

Niiiiiiiiice friendly staff. Love the lighted patio. On a balmy, non-humid night, this is a win-win situation. Surf the net, chat it up, go for the gusto... Buuuuuuuut don't go pee-pee, cuz tissue is non existent. 

I mean to be fair this was my 5th time there, 1st time using the "facilities", buuuuuut Starbucks is a large enough company (avg $5/cup of coffee) until I think they can afford a couple squares of toilet paper, #ijs.  When I informed barrista about thw toilet-paperless ladies bathroom, he was well aware & apologized for the lack. I appreciated the apology, not his fault. But the inside area was a Little unkept, definitely a rarity for Starbucks, but I guess there are always an exception to every rule.  All in all, Ill be back, with my own toilet paper no less... Lol, j/k.

Haaaaaa, this Starbucks get a 7.69 on a scale of 1-10.

Definitely one of the better SB's in the area.  It's tricky to get into the lot (you literally have to drive around the store) but the staff is solid and they are constantly updating.

They now have the Reserve coffee's (honestly, one of the few good beans starbucks has) as well as the beloved Clover Machine.

Having worked in this facility years ago, I know they are top notch on sanitation and policy so the coffee you are getting wasn't brewed an hour ago.

Dyson hand-dryers in the bathroom too?  Touche starbucks, lol.

I am a long time Starbucks customer and I usually go 5-7 times a week. I use the mobile app almost every time and they still manage to get it wrong. I rarely get an acknowledged when I come in and I always always say "thank you and have a good day." I would say 1 in 20 times someone looks up with a half interest and then goes back to what they are doing. I go anywhere from 6am to 3pm and it's always the same. There was one guy working the register Sunday who was very personable.... hire more of him! I would almost rather pay the 20% upcharge at the airport just because they are friendly and always get my drink right!

This Starbucks is minutes from my place and although that sounds nice..it's really a dangerous thing. Haha. Service here is consistently good and eventually the baristas will get to know your order. Only had one or two drinks here that weren't great but that is the barista making them and not a reflection of the location overall. Not a whole lot of parking here, but it is very convenient for those on the lrt.
Standard Starbucks. Has a drive thru that moves quickly, free wifi and outdoor patio. The drive thru line gets quite long in the morning rush.

I reaaaaally love this place!! I've been to dozens of Starbucks in my life and the service at this one is my all time favorite. They offer me new suggestions of drinks I never even though of on the regular, and they make my reg. lattes so yum yum yummy! The outside space is especially really nice in spring and summer to have a little date or just get some fresh air. Also, love the free wifi ;-)

I love the Starbucks in my neighbourhood. The are super friendly and the store is always clean. Coffee is great, you cam veganize your drink which is awesome. The only bad thing here is the lack on vegan food. They only offer a bagel with avocado spread (which is way too spicy) and a platter they never ever have. I hope they realize this and get
More savoury stuff for all the vegans in town.

Glad there is finally a Starbucks close to me! (My only reason to go to these outlets.) Typical Starbucks. Have been here once a week during the summer months. They have always had my order - iced mocha - and never had a long wait. I recommend the cake pops here. I think it's an unappreciated sweet here that I can never seem to pass up!
Picked up a to go carafe for a function here the other day. Staff were super efficient and provided enough sugar, cream and stir sticks. Thank you!

I normally go to Starbucks every morning before work, there is always a nice gentleman and an older lady with beautiful snowy hair there to make my beverage.. So normally I make an online order in advance simply because I'm normally in a rush.. This one day I decided I'd go in earlier simply because I was already out.. Well the two people who normally served me weren't there so there was this other heavier set girl with brunette hair there. She questioned me when I was just waiting 2 minutes earlier.. I told her that I had made an online order but there was No rush and she goes "well it's not even that time yet so why are you even here" with a nasty attitude which I didn't appreciate. I told her I go there every morning with the same order, she shouldn't have had an attitude for me Being two minutes early especially if I didn't rush anyone.

No wonder my Venti Mocha no whip tasted so weird. It was a Pike Place with Cream and Splenda- Yuck! Should have checked the label when kid first tried to hand me a water I didn't order. Then he hands me coffee saying here's your white mocha, which I didn't order. And driving away and drinking it I thought man I haven't had one of these in a long time my taste buds have changed! 

#starbucksfail

The customer service is on point and I was here at 7 am! I made the mistake ordering a super sweet drink whilst I'm an espresso or Summer frap drinker.  I called Gina and told her I made the mistake (the drink was still great to anyone else.) she told me to come in and get some thing new.  a Ashley the barista was concerned and cared.  100 percent and when it could be busy, they all took their time.  Thank you.

If certain people are working, this is a pleasant and quick experience. When other, certain people are working, the line gets lengthy and you will repeat your order more than once. Not the end of the world, but you may want to give yourself some room on time at this locale.

Worst customer service and cleanliness in a Starbucks even compared to busy ones in New York and San Francisco. No one acknowledges your existence, there is no friendly presence, and it seemed like there was no leader or manager in duty to give direction. A mess.

This is my favorite starbucks around. I work nearby and I go almost everyday. All of the staff is extremely friendly and my order is always perfect. The strawberry Açaí refresher is my go to and it's so delicious! Stacy is awesome, and great to talk to. I'll be back soon (probably tomorrow).

Drinks are decent, but expensive. Not many outlets to plug in phone/tablet/laptop chargers. Also, they ALWAYS have the air conditioning on full blast in there. It's way too cold. I can't stay there longer than a few minutes unless I have a jacket on.

It is 7pm on a Saturday night.  If you want a snack no pastry for u.   They are open two more hours and food case is completely empty and set for tomorrow. 

Just see two ladies working.  Pleasant service but nothing above and beyond.  

They proudly post their 100 on TN food visit. But store is not clean today. Pastry glass filthy and the front door windows look like cleaned with a dirty cloth. 

Oh well the one up the street across the highway was a better experience

I'm new to the area and I've been craving my starbucks! Little did I know it's literally 2 mini from me!!! 
I stopped by and got my usual caramel macchiato with an extra shot and it's like heaven in my mouth!!!!!
Super fast service and awesome employees!!!
I definitely will be back!

Excellent service!  I love when I don't have to wait more than 10 min. . It's an enjoyable experience when the staff is  working hard and engaging with the customer. .  This Starbucks is consistent and I  go out of me way to get to this location.
Starbucks is awesome. I love the food. And drink. They have all the new stuff. I wish there was a more local feel but I understand that's hard.

Starbucks Haiku:

Burnt beans yet none care
Restroom code is 12-60
Guy always hogs chair

Always enjoy a treat from Starbucks although the prices are getting out of hand- I actually had a reward on my card and it was only good for 3 days- so people watch your free rewards because I honestly think they put them out for so little time they hope you don't see it and it would be lost!

I like this Starbucks for a couple of reasons - they never get my drink wrong (and they always spell my name right), they have a drive through when I am too lazy to get out of the car, the staff is always super friendly.  The only negative about it is the parking sitch... which gets worse if there are a ton of cars in the drive through.  But they are pretty darn efficient at this location, so it is not that much of a negative for me.

Currently on minute 25 of waiting in line at this place. This has to be the worst Starbucks in the history of the world. 

We finally made it to the window and one of our drinks is wrong and they're out of lemon cake, blueberry scones and basically everything on the menu. Only come here if you want to make yourself late for something.

Updating my rating. Totally disgusted that it's not even mid October and Starbucks has sold out for the rest of the season of their pumpkin scones. One of the BEST sellers they have and they're not making anymore for the year! A major marketing miscalculation on your part Starbucks.

I came to the Wayne store on a Sunday afternoon. I ordered a chili mocha Frappuccino, it was wonderful! I came back the following Friday and ordered the same thing in a larger size. The first mistake was that they made it hot. So I had her remake my frozen cappuccino, hence the term Frappuccino!! She proceeded to dump the contents over ice and throw some whipped cream on top. I paid almost $6 for that fucking drink. I am extremely disappointed. If I wanted cold coffee over ice cubes I could have done that at home myself for a lot less. I know that is not how it is done in that store. Big thumbs down

I frequent this Starbucks for business and, out of the 3 in Doylestown, this one is the most 'work-friendly.' It's not too crowded and there's plenty of seats and outlets. Word of advise though: avoid like the plague on weekend nights due to teenie boppers getting dropped off for movie night.
Great Starbucks! Super fast baristas and my drink is always right! The only drawback is no drivethru and sometimes parking is a little crowded.

Service is top notch. Elizabeth, Teddy and Jimmy are the best baristas ever. The space is open and airy with a great patio. I like visiting this location more than any of the others in the Nashville area.

I don't prefer this location at all. It's near my dwelling, and this morning I thought of giving them another second chance.  I guess I was spoiled at my former Starbucks location on the NW side of town off 56th & Lafayette Rd.  I always received friendly greetings and smiles there.

This morning 0/5 of the Baristas greeted me when I walked in and waited...waited to order.  I did hear a Barista say "you have a customer" but not a "Hello! / Good Morning! / We'll be right with you!" Insert smile after any of the three options would have been great. Friendly customer service just doesn't seem to be their cup of tea or coffee.  How hard can "Good Morning" be?

Maybe next time...Good day!

This is my favorite Starbucks!!!! Sandy is awesome! She came up with the Birthday gift idea "gift card in a Starbucks cup" Looooove it! Bought it for my employees every year; plus she always takes good care of her customer. Sandy is the best!

I don't make reviews often but I had to today with the service I had. Was my second time going to this specific location and it was horrible service each time. They got my order wrong today and the girl acted like it was a hassle and my fault when it was clearly her fault. She gave me a hot coffee when I had ordered an iced coffee. I order this at least once daily and this did not taste right. It was so sloppy when she handed it to me, it had caramel all over the sides and it  wasn't even filled up all the way like she had poured the messed up hot coffee into some ice to "fix" the problem. On top of being rude and then getting a coffee tasting like shit I was very unhappy customer today and will never go to this location again! Usually customer service is great at Starbucks but not this one. I think they need some new employees. All my coffee junkies know how disappointing it is to get a crappy tasting coffee when you are craving your favorite Starbucks coffee. :( 

- very unhappy customer

Still running slow at drive thru...people are friendly and seem to be trying to give good service, but it just takes forever to get thru the drive up.
I also wish there were some big improvement in the breakfast sandwich offerings...it sounds great to offer a bacon, cheese, egg sandwich, but, when the roll is funky, semi stale tasting, the egg is a pre cooked, maybe frozen disc...yuk!  Bacon was ok on taste, terribly undercooked and not crisp at all.  Combination just totally bad and at the price, really, really bad.

This is the slowest Starbucks known to man. You can fly to Guatemala, pick the beans, roast them, grind them, and brew your own coffee faster than sitting in the drive thru. Seriously, 9 times out of 10, it's better to park and walk in. You'll be finished faster than the last car that was in line when you got there. All that said, I've not yet had an order messed up, which is a pro.

I've been to this location many times. They do not have a drive thru, parking is a little hectic bc it's in a busy plaza but the staff is so friendly here and literally have you in and out within 5 minutes.

Please make the "no smoking signs" bigger, and more visible during the night. Right now the signs are too small and not visible at all. At the streets, in the parking, please make those arrows more visible to indicate right traffic way.

One thing Starbucks does well is brand recognition. This was my first time to this location and it looks like all the others so I felt like I had been there a million times before. This can be seen as a positive and a negative - it is great because you are familiar with the layout and the menus etc but not so great because there is no individuality, uniqueness, or more personal feel to the place.

The drinks and treats are exactly what is expected from a Starbucks location (any Starbucks location). What separates the good from the bad is location and service. Unfortunately this particular Starbucks fails on both accounts.

I went at 4:30pm on a Saturday afternoon and the place was not busy however finding a parking spot and negotiating the parking lot was a feat all on its own. Unfortunately there is a T&T Supermarket directly across the parking lot and all of these customers were consuming the parking and walking haphazardly in the paved lot. This made it a unique challenge even to get in the door.

Once I had made it in I was able to walk right up to the counter and attempt to order. The baristas were all busy cleaning and so it took a while to get their attention but eventually I placed my order. The friend I was meeting had arrived before me so instead of waiting at the counter for my drink I sat with her and chatted for a while. Next thing I realize that ten minutes had gone by and my drink was still not prepared so back up to the counter I went. Again all of the baristas were cleaning machines and organizing items behind the counter - they all had forgotten about my drink. Luckily I was not in a rush because from the time I walked in until I received my beverage was over 15 minutes. 

There are two other Starbucks' at the intersection of 97th Street and 137th Ave and (without being to either) I would recommend trying both of them over this location.

Out of most of the Starbucks I go to in the Brandon/Tampa area this is one of my favorites. EVERYTIME I come here the staff is very friendly. And they always get my drink right, especially when I order DECAF. This is very important to me because I cannot handle caffeine. So why drink it then, you say? Because, I love the taste of coffee!  The store is hardly crowded when I come in and they are pretty quick to make your drinks.
Has always been my fave of the many I frequent to,study, work or just unwind. The staff there are so friendly and entertaining. :)

Starbucks!  Need I say more?  Well, maybe!

Pumpkin Spiced Latte, Iced Caramel Macchiato, Bacon & Gouda breakfast sandwich... Mmm... I'm already drooling.

But really, this is a great location with ample seating and inside Indigo Bookstore which gives it a great vibe for sitting back and relaxing with a cup 'o joe over a good book!

Be careful about the parking as another reviewer noted!  2 hour limit - keep your receipt to prove you were actually there!  And the North Town Parking Lot SUCKS - sorry, but no bones about it.  The worst parking lot in the city by a mile!

Downside to an Indigo Starbucks?  No drive-thru, but there is another one just down the road if you need the drive-thru.

Coffee on!

PS - Don't forget to download the SB app to your phone to earn free drinks and discounts!!!

This is a pretty nice Starbucks. The staff are friendly, the drinks are made well, and there is a seating area upstairs that's away from the noise of the espresso machine and endless small talk, so it's a great place to study.

Parking is MEH, but besides that it has a drive through that is normally very quick, workers are always chipper and fun to deal with and the coffee lives up to Starbucks standards.  Will be here often!

I don't go to Starbucks often because it's so ridiculously expensive. This location is nice, clean, and the staff were friendly. There was a wait both inside and even longer at the drive thru. To be honest the wait wasnt as bad as it usually is at Starbucks. I am sure i will be at starbucks again every once in a while since i do enjoy their iced mocha frappachino but not regularly since i cant spend $4 on a coffee all the time.

Came to this location for the first time today. Manger was awesome and super helpful getting my app and gift card balance to transfer. The staff were also very friendly and the coffee was perfectly made. The inside was awesome as well with a cozy fireplace to warm up next to. I will definitely make this a weekly spot.

Taste wise as far as im concerned most Starbucks are usually created equally....I have only sent a drink back once here and they were happy to remake it for me with zero attitude which I appreciated. What keeps me coming back to this particular location is the fact they are within walking distance from my house and it's not usually extremely busy in the cafe which makes it a great place for me to walk in and get a coffee before leaving for work. The staff is friendly and socializes with all of us from around the area and they really give off the sense that they enjoy their work. On a special note there is a group home five houses down from mine and the Starbucks staff always gives them discounts on their drinks. Much love to my local Starbucks for their positive attitudes and love for our community!

This is the most inefficient and just plain awful Starbucks I have ever been to. They've never gotten my order correct and all it is only an iced vanilla coffee with heavy cream. I went there once and I had to go back in the store THREE different times and I still left with a drink that didn't taste how it normally does from all other locations. I only go here when it is convenient as far as location. Don't even consider the drive thru...unless you're prepared to wait thirty minutes for your incorrect order.
A good place to hop to for a coffee fix when I'm at work. I also love their couch, perfect to do a little or a lot of work on the laptop.

It's interesting to see some rough reviews on here but I just went for the first time and enjoyed it! The woman working the register was very friendly in an auntie or mom kind of way, saying "you're welcome, baby" and stuff. That made me feel a bit more at home. I ordered the Sumatra but they ran out halfway through the the cup. She asked if I wanted to get topped off with something else and I said the Veranda, a bit sad since I couldn't get a full cup of what I wanted. Then she asked if I just wanted all Veranda, I said yes and she dumped out that Sumatra and told me that the next time I come she'll give me a free cup. So, yay!

Love his location. The staff is amazing. Love Trey and his staff!! They are amazing at remembering your order after just a few visits and are so happy to see you. The other locations around can at times feel like they are too busy to notice you. Not here. They may not always remember your name but your drink and size of cup... spot on!! Go team. You keep it up.

came into starbucks with my girlfriend. A bigger young women with purple lipstick and glasses was extremely rude to her coworkers. made our drink the wrong size and was disrespectful to us when we asked her to change it. 
wont ever be coming back again.
This Starbucks is very inconsistent between shifts! The early morning barista gets it right every time. Weekends and afternoons are always a chance to what the flavor profile will be
This Starbucks was ok. Small, cramped and people lounge everywhere so there was no where to sit. The staff seemed gossipy and distracted. Not my favorite one! I will stop here on an as needed basis.

I enjoy going to any Starbucks.  The atmosphere is casual and relaxing.  My only complaints are,  Starbucks doesn't serve any organic coffee, and when I come in I try to take a bistro box home for later but they never seem to have what I want.  I don't know if it's because they don't order enough or if they actually sell out before I get there.  I usually go around 3 in the afternoon.

No drive-thru available and limited parking.

Staff is friendly and location is well kept.

Great Starbucks! The staff when I was there were all young, and extremely welcoming. Not only welcoming, but also very knowledgeable of their products and Jenn especially was helpful in every aspect and even brewed me up a cup to try. I later bought the rest of the bag she brewed me a sample from (Italian roast). I will definitely be back and I think the whole staff deserves a pat on the back for their work.

Honestly the worst service ever. Does it make sense to take someone else's order when they're behind you? I dont care if they are a regular at that location, its first come first serve. Not first serve regulars then others.

My first time at this Starbucks.  No big complaints, but the staff seemed like they were more concerned with talking about what they did lat night then paying attention to the customers.  They were not ride, but certainly not paying attention.

Somehow it always seems as though no one who works at this Starbucks knows what day it is or what is happening. I always find that there are either not enough people taking orders or not enough people making drinks even though there are somehow like 6 people behind the counter. This typically causes super slow service which sucks considering this location is small and in a high traffic area.

I don't normally give a review to Starbucks but when I do, I give 5 stars. The people here were super friendly. I was here on vacation and the staff here gave us a bunch of recommendation on places to see. Great staff!

Joel thinks he is on a pedastool. He believes he is better than others, and can disrespect anyone. He is a piece of ugly shit that thinks he can kick people out upon sitting down, and force people to buy immediately. He is a donkey that believes he can rush people, and time their presence in the establishment before ordering. I pissed all on their entry door due to a lack of respect.

We all now how Starbucks are in terms of coffee, but I've had excellent, friendly, and quick service when I've come. It's not usually too busy so I can grab a comfortable chair. It's off the main East Lake road, but it's at a light so it's easy to get into an out of, and it's got plenty of parking. If you want some Starbucks, what more could you want? I just wanted to give a shout out to good service because I've been to some mediocre locations so I know quality when I see it.

great location for this starbucks, since it is close to a bunch of office buildings and a few bedroom communities. service here is just about average, although the line ups here are long making me wondering if they are just busy or in efficient. otherwise everything here is just like it is at any other starbucks: very consistent in terms of taste, décor, service, offerings etc. only downside is that they run out of coconut milk all the time.
If I could give this place 10, I would. I walk past 2 Starbucks just to go to this one. Great staff, great service, fast, reliable. Wish all Starbucks (especially NY) were like this one.

Best Starbucks I live in fishers and will always stop at this one on my way to work. Fast service, drinks are always right and everyone is always so friendly!!!! Probably my favorite Starbucks on the north side!!!
This is one of nicest locations of Starbucks in downtown Philadelphia - nice seating arrangement, two bathrooms, cool background music, free wifi -
20 minutes later we received half of our order. I had to ask for the rest because they were missed. The store wasn't even busy. Ridiculous.
This place definitely need more staff or improve work flow because the drive through is too slow. I waited 10 mins before even putting in my order
Very busy every time we go by this place.  We stopped in when we saw the drive through line was almost to the street.  The wait on the inside was just as long.  The staff was friendly and helpful.

The drive through line here can be ridiculous. Otherwise its a meh Starbucks. The one on Mallory by Drakes is vastly superior. They also are much faster. I just notice that location gives me better service all around than the Carothers location. Otherwise its just mediocre Starbucks full of corporate tools.

This is my preferred Starbucks to go to as the staff is always super friendly and polite. They have never made me feel like I needed to feel honoured to have them acknowledge me, which is a common trend I find at most of the chain locations. 

I do not drink coffee, I am not a Starbucks addict and I just am not a frequent customer by any means (with my lack of coffee drinking) but I have recently discovered a drink I love! A vanilla frappucino with raspberry syrup and whipped. I order it when my Starbucks junkie boyfriend drags me along to satisfy his withdrawals. 

I know very little of the lingo and I order small, medium or large, and the staff do not try to correct me or lecture me on the language of the coffee addict world... and I like that. Most other locations have refused to really help me when they find out I am not one of them. So a big thank you to the wonderful staff that has never shamed me as an outcast!

My post work "need a caffeinated beverage to make it through my drive home" Starbucks location, I have to say that as the 'Bucks goes, this is definitely not my favourite location but it is far from the worst one in the city. 

I find the baristas here tend to be rather unfriendly and lacking in that Starbucks perkiness that I have come to love and expect. On several occasions I have come in and the baristas will be chatting amongst themselves and seem almost bothered that I want to interrupt them to place an order. 

I do find this location to be very cozy in it's setup and unlike some other locations that have switched to long tables for en mass seating, this location has plentiful seating at tables at tables for 2 or 4. 

I also enjoy the tables tables that they put out in the summer, who doesn't love to people watch on Jasper Ave with a nice freshly brewed beverage in hand?

Location is great, staff could use some customer service skills.
Standard Starbucks experience! Plenty of seating area both indoors and outdoors. Service was quick and ample parking available.

This is my go-to, neighborhood Starbucks. I'm here a few times a week and love the coffee. 

The staff is friendly and they really get the job done.  This has to be one of the busier Starbucks, and it runs like a well oiled machine most days.

The lines are long at peak times, but I think that's to be expected. The employees never stop moving, so the wait times aren't bad.

I come here 3/7 days a week and have NEVER had a bad experience.  If they get my order wrong ( which they never do) they quickly correct it.  If they feel I have waited in the drive-thru too long, I get a free coffee.  Talk about being pro-active rather than re-active.  This is the way every business should be run.

On my way out of Target and wanted to try a new fall flavor brew. Selected a salted caramel mocha,hot. It was quiet so I was waited on promptly by two very personable and friendly barristas. The drink was great, mocha with a hint of salt and caramel. I think non chocolate lovers would even enjoy this.

Every time I go to this Starbucks it is absolutely packed! I've worked in the service industry before and it is not always easy to keep a positive attitude when you are busy and working under pressure. The staff here is amazing. The drive-thru is so long, so I often park and go in. Everyone I encounter is so happy and smiling and I really have never had to wait an obnoxious amount of time for my drink and breakfast sandwich, they are pretty quick considering the volume of people they are serving.
Been here twice, and both times, the wait was extremely long.  The employees are very friendly, but there is definitely not enough of them at this location.
All I have to say is nicest barista EVER at the drive-thru window! Excellent service and the drinks were great.
Close to home but they close too early, I think this location will not remain open much longer because of lack of business. I hope I'm wrong because it's one of my favorite locations!
Friendly staff. Great coffee. Recently renovated which gave this location a bit more seating. Still find  it hard to find a seat when it's busy.

Its Starbucks. This is the only Starbucks for miles around this area so they are often vert busy. Secondly, the service is slow. Never order a frappacino at the drive through...itll defiantly be melted by the time you get it. The service is nice however, slow slow slow. They need another Starbucks in the area to help with these issues.

I used to feel Starbucks kept up with the times. Everyone's feeling the pinch of the economy right now, so why raise prices. However, with the new year came new prices. I'm not happy that a house coffee is a 1.99 for a venti drip.  I was content with a  1.75, but come on that's still pricey compared to McDonald's for a hot cup of joe. I used to give that extra quarter as a tip, but now I'm keeping my penny. The personality of the barista's only go so far.
This place is easy to get to in center city. The staffs are friendly and drinks are well made. I was able to get in and out quickly, not bad!

This Starbucks is the closest to me, but I don't frequent it to often since it's in the opposite direction of my work. When I do visit, I always go through the drive through. It can get congested but goes quickly. I'm not a fan of Starbucks coffee. I do love the black tea here though, which I always get. I also get the butter croissant at times, which is delicious!

Worst Starbucks I have ever visited, waited  at counter to order, staff member busy filling a large to go order, four staff workers doing little or nothing, waited for a very long time with no acknowledge, turned around and walked out. Very poor customer service, this Starbucks will not get my business. Wake up CRESTWOOD MO STARBUCKS

Really bad customer service i asked for a cappuccino with 2 sugars on the bottom and was told to put it on my own. I told her it doesn't mix the same and was told again put it yourself. This is the worst experience i ever had in a Starbucks location. Good luck travelers ordering coffee from this place
I go to the Ridgemoor Starbucks quite often on the way to work and am always impressed with the fast service and friendly faces.
Super sweet employees that are helpful. I just started using the mobile order application and it's so fast and simple. Love this place

The best Starbucks I know. The batistas here are the best. I've asked them to just make something up for me several times and each time they've given me something that I thoroughly enjoyed. So I trust them enough to just pay and let them surprise me. Not to mention the energetic and friendly vibes they're always radiating. They'll also always make sure that they get your order right. If you don't like it, they're more than happy to redo it to your liking. And this isn't some corporately enforced attitude. They are genuinely willing to redo your order and make it right. 

The store itself is setup well. It's nice and cozy in the corner and also has good spots to just study or to do work. People are always here chillin. The store is always kept clean. Almost every time I come in, someone is cleaning some part of the store. Out of all the Starbucks that I've been too, this is definitely the most well run. It'll continue to be the one I'll always go to.

Not my favorite location, but not the worst that I have been in. Stopped in on a Friday afternoon before heading up to the Northside for an afternoon of shopping and doing pretty much whatever we wanted. They were busy when we arrived. Normally I would have stuck with the drive-thru, but for some reason decided to go in. The inside as busy just like the drive thru. When we got into line, we had about 4 people a head of us.

Surprisingly for as busy as they were, they got us through pretty quickly. They all seemed to work well together to get people through and on their way.

Some of the furniture looked a little beat up like perhaps it may need to be replaced soon. Other than that the overall location seemed to be clean with several places to sit. Perhaps this was because everyone was sitting outside, but still...lots of places to sit.

When I'm up north, this is my favorite Starbucks. It's a little neighborhood joint, so you don't have anything too loud, too obnoxious or too much in general. Great meeting place, great working place. It has somehow even missed that after school hang out from all the kids. 

The employees here always seem to remember me, even though I keep changing my drink order on them. It's just a nice, friendly, neighborhood coffee shop.

I love Stabucks but this is my least favorite location in South Tampa.  It is one of the dirtiest Stabucks I've ever been at.  I've been here a few times but just strictly for location.  I don't ever linger since it's so dirty.  If you want to sit for awhile go to the one on Westshore.  The last time I was here there were 2 employees behind the counter and neither knew how to make my tea latte.  One was new so I'll give him a break.  Then another employee was out sweeping (surprising!) and yelling to them how to make my drink when there was a line of people.  Why not get behind the counter while its slammed and then sweep?

This Starbucks is usually on point for most of the time. I normally get the same thing, sometimes switch it up. Well today I tried the get my usual London fog tea latte (well my boyfriend did)and they tried to say they don't have it anymore which I don't believe since all the others do. But anyways, so they told my bf they had something real similar. And anyone that's had the London fog knows it's lavender and vanilla with earl grey tea. So he brings me home the tea they said was similar and I tried it. Literally was straight peach tea. Nothing added, no sugars, flavors, nothing. Just straight peaches. I don't know who's taste buds got messed up this morning but looks like I have to start making my own tea and coffee since starbucks and Mcdonalds have left me hangin. Ridiculous. Gave them two stars because the people are always nice when I go. But get your drinks right, don't tell someone that peaches tastes like lavender and vanilla cause it doesn't.

Unlike Los Angeles, there aren't too many Starbucks here in New Orleans. I'm glad to say that this has been my go to coffee place in the mornings for this whole week while I was here in NOLA. 

Yes, I bypassed the other hipster coffee house inside the lobby of this high rise (sorry) as much as I wanted to try it.  I just didn't have the time every morning as I was in a rush. And convenience is the major contributor.

The coffee here is very consistent as it's not water compared to other Sbux's in California to not be mentioned geographically. My bagels were delicious, my cinnamon buns was fresh, my bananas were decent, however the egg muffin wasn't as good as I thought it would be. I'll stay with the golden arches for that item.

Anyhow, I'm still happy about this Sbux as it was convenient for my walk to the convention center every morning. It's never too crowded, and the employees are also very friendly.

People basically come and go at this location without really hanging around too long. Nobody smokes outside which is a major plus. 

I wish a Sbux similar to this location was around my neighborhood, that's never too crowded.

There are over 1200 cafés in Canada sporting the twin-tailed siren, but none are staffed with such friendly, authentic, and professional staff as this location. Most Starbucks do a decent job of hiring good employees, but someone did an exceptionally good job here. I visit this location a few times a week to read and write; after a couple weeks most of the staff took the time to learn my name!

This location is very busy during the day with office workers taking beverages to go and students studying at tables. Patrons come in waves, so if you can't find a spot, just wait five minutes. In the evenings the students are still there, but it seems to also be a popular place for "we haven't talked in a while, lets grab a coffee" meetings. Being so busy it's not quite as tidy as the Starbucks at The Matrix hotel (only several blocks away), but it is maintained quite well.

The space is quite large with many tables with power plug access. Unlike the internet at The Matrix location which can be spotty, the wifi here is quite reliable. There are also large east and north facing windows for natural light.

Other than that, the beverage and food quality is exactly what you would expect from a Starbucks. I leave it to your own preference to judge that!

The beverages are standard and many of the baristas do their job well and algae great customer service. however it's quite irritating to hear all the employees boisterous goofing around constantly. Also I thought store cleanup sweeping and mopping was to be done after hours, not at a quarter to nine when the shop is still full of customers. I understand the need for cleanliness often but it's not looking like it's helping the infestation of fruit flies.

Nice starbucks. It has a very large outside seating, but not so much inside. The drinks are made very consistently and tasted exactly the same every single time. However, one thing that bugs me the most is how freezing this place is. They turn the ac up too high and they will never adjust it for you if you ask. I even find myself bringing a sweater or jacket here on summer days. Trust me. It is freezing cold in there to point that I feel a little sick just trying to sit there and study for 15 minutes.

Great Starbucks!

Staff was super friendly. Helped us with our selection. This Starbucks is unique due to the fact it has a second floor. It is a nice place to have a business meeting or just hangout with friends.

This is a great location in the Boise Towne Square mall. I almost always order ahead via the app, and from the time it takes me to walk from my car to the store, my order is always ready and waiting for me. This is a busy location, the line gets long (like, outside the store long), so ORDER AHEAD and save some time! I've also had some great interactions with employees, who have filled me in on specials and just chatted me up. Overall, this is an excellent location with consistently good drinks and service.

My fiancé and I visit this location every time we visit my in-laws. Over the past 3 years the service has never changed. There are usually 5-6 employees working but there is no sense of urgency. It takes 3-4 times as log to get our drinks than the Starbucks standard. The employees are all over the place and do not seem to have any specific assigned station to keep the store running smoothly. If there was another Starbucks closer, I would be more than happy to avoid this one and drive a little further for better service.
I know people love this Starbucks, but everytime I have gone here, the wait is long and the drinks taste terrible.  I think when they are pressured, the quality of the drinks suffer.
Great place with amazing coffee! Great service and they always have a long line but get it moving fast. Plus, it's totally worth it to stand in line for 3 mins for great coffee and lattes.

Overall,  this is a pretty decent Starbucks location. They've gotten a lot faster with orders since a management change that happened about 6 months ago. Their atmosphere is quieter than most Starbucks and they very rarely run out of sandwiches and things, compared to other locations.

This location ia pretty large inside and has a number of tables and chairs that are rarely, if ever full. If you want to meet someone for coffee, this is a great place and better than a lot of the other Starbucks and coffee shops nearby. There are outlets at all the tables except one,  and it's relatively quiet,  which means it's great for studying or getting work done too.

The only big downside is that this is not the best place to get coffee if you want something quick on your way to work. This location has a large morning crowd (there are a lot of schools nearby and it's close to 465). This means that between 7 and 8 am it can take up to 15 minutes to go through the drive-through. I have noticed that if you go inside it's a little bit faster.

Barista crew is efficient and polite. If you come here during the day, expect tables to be taken up by McEwan students and business meetings. Not a lot of seating, but a nice space none-the-less. Large windows let in a lot of natural light, which makes this location welcoming.

i absolutely LOVE this Starbucks compared to others in the area. Its much newer, the crowd is good, WiFi is usually running on decent speed and the Barista make a pretty design on your Latte if you ask them LOL! I just LOVE the outside seating for nice sunny days.

Average to below average Starbucks. Two stars because the bar never has milk (skim or whole) and if you need some you have to ask the Baristas who subtly let you know they don't like you asking for milk in your coffee as it gives them extra work. For some reason, if you ask, you're given a really tiny amount of milk in a separate cup, not the usual carafe used by other Starbucks.
Cleaner tables & cleaner bathrooms then hwy 70 location. This one also has drive thru. Hwy 70 does not. The servers here seem to be on their game better. More attentive.

I visited my first Starbucks in 2006 in Kuwait. I have been a fan ever since. I live in South Tampa and will say the Dale Mabry and West Gandy locations are in typical fantastic Starbucks fashion. I started a new job in Apollo Beach a few weeks ago, so finding this store I thought would be another awesome SB experience. This evening, I visited for the third time this week and will say this is my last visit. I can do the slower service but today I waited for a pout over. As I waited, I noticed the creamer/sugar counter needed to be cleaned, then an employee came over to change out the trash cans and he laid the new trash bags on the counter. Once he was done he walked away leaving the mess, took a picture. When I received my coffee, I sipped it to find that it was just warm. I will send Starbucks corporate an email as this store is not representative of any SB experience I have ever had here or abroad.

Why does this place have such a low rating? This place treats me well on weekday mornings. I just mobile order and in less than 5 minutes my food or drink is ready to go! There are times my drink I order is a bit complicated but they make it well anyway. A few times in the past someone has said it was "too many things going on in the drink" which I didn't take as a good thing. You just don't say that. I like my drink the way it is. But otherwise, it is good.

Wow had great customer service here !! They helped me reload my card so I could get my points an reminded me to never feel rushed always take your time an get what you want an if someone behind you is pushy not to worry !!! 
Very good advice everyone should take it easy, say hello instead of being pushy!!

This Starbucks is great for mobile orders, but I tend to have to wait a while when ordering in the store. Seating is okay, but not the best for getting work done, as lots of people are constantly coming in and out right by you.
My favorite Starbucks in Philly! Caleb, Jason, Robert, Ryan, and Jenna are my favorite Barista's! They're all friendly, knowledgeable, and make my coffee to perfection!
I was passing through town.  They were very quick in getting my green tea latte. The staff, two guys were very friendly and easy to talk to which was nice.

Since I am toting around two small kids, I am a fan of the Starbucks drive-thru!  It is too much of a chore to get them both out of their carseats to make the (much needed!) caffeine runs.  The staff is always chipper and friendly.  Sometimes the line can snake around the building, but they do move it pretty fast.  I have had the barista make suggestions for me around my deisred beverages, and although I have always loved the suggestions, they state that they will re-make the drink if I don't care for it.  They will even cut the pastry in half and put it into two bags so my kids are happy too.

It's unbelievable. My wife came here 10 min ago and asked for a cup of warm water for baby formula. They said 54 cents. She said I left the wallet with my husband on the first floor and Starbucks is on the third. They said no.
I don't know what's wrong with this particular location when the refuse mother with a baby a warm cup of water. We will follow up with a complain.

This  Westshore & Kennedy location right next to Westshore Plaza has small outdoor seating, TWO long tables to study on, 1 desk-like table in the back, multiple small tables for two, multiple multi-plugs, comfy furniture and great music. I was a bit excited they had Motown and some chill classics on. The atmosphere here is inviting and the staff is friendly and servicial.  The Grande Vanilla Late and Venti Unsweetened Passion Tea we ordered were on point. They have many choices for snacks from croissants, cookies, pound cake to greek yogurt, fruit salad, biscotti, almonds, etc... i however went with the Fruit & Nut snack.  If i am ever in Westshore area, i would probably stop here to study.

The one thing I love about Starbucks is that I can know what to expect from their coffee. It was good as usual. I tried their new drink Carmel roasted something and it was really took sweet for me. I should have stuck with a cup of regular joe.

I have been a regular here for about two years now and have come to count on quick and friendly service.  Yes, as others have mentioned the parking lot is small and spaces are rather narrow.  If you drive a truck or large SUV, I imagine maneuvering during rush hour could be kind of a hassle. Typically, I enter the lot from Horatio so I can scout out the best parking.  Many of the baristas have been here for 2+ years but lately there have been a few new faces.  For such a great/busy location it's unfortunate that there is no drive through but that's a limitation of having a Starbucks in a strip mall. As for me, I'll keep coming back for a reliable and quick fix of caffeine as I head off to work.

(4.5) ~ Very Good Overall Food & Service!

** My wish finally came true...A Starbucks with a "Clover Brewing System" close to home!:-)  Read about the Clover Brewing System online and order your favorite Coffee Bean either Hot -or- Iced.  My Fav is their Aged Sumatra:-)

This coffee shop now deserves 5 stars. There service is absolutely amazing! 

Going in for my normal coffee run, I ended up in line behind a deaf person. The staff could not have been more patient or friendly with the customer. At the register, the cashier was very attentitive and signed thank you to him after he paid. The barista, who was making his drink, diligently came over to him and asked him if he wanted room for milk. At first he didn't understand and many people would have just given up. She, however, perservered until he understood her. Witnessing this Starbucks staff be kind and helpful to this man makes me want to give this place 10 stars - which I would if I could.

This is the closest Starbucks to me and it is on my way to work so I have been here multiple times.  I have never gone in as this is a drive-thru location and I am always on my way somewhere.  They are fast, very nice and efficient every time.  I have never had any issues with my service or what I have gotten.  The location can be tricky to get out of just due to the volume of cars at the intersection.  Parking is also a negative, but that has never been an issue for me.  I will continue to get my coffee here!

This Starbucks is conveniently located nearby and has a drive thru yet every time I go there the line is always way too long inside and out and the baristas constantly mess up my drink, and it's not even that complicated. I'm always disappointed and shocked they don't recognize me or my order for how often I go there.
This is the store that banned a customer for life for confronting dbags who were not handicapped but parking in the handicapped spots. Never reward this kind of stupidity.
I like this Starbucks because it has a drive-through which is usually run prety efficiently and quickly!

Best customer service I've ever had at a Starbucks! Doesn't matter what day or what time I go I've always had the best, most friendly employees help me. We go out of our way to come to this store because of that.

Hardly ever a wait here. I just moved to this area and was one day craving my peach green tea. I parked to walk inside which I hate. I was wishing it had a drive through and low and behold it did but the staff said it was hidden and it darn sure was. That's the only flaw of this place.

I am sorry to leave such a poor review, because I have been a regular here for years (6-7 visits a week). There are a number of great people who work here, but I just can't bring myself to go to this location anymore--I'd rather drive a little farther. 

First: drinks are rarely as ordered. I have frequently had to throw away my americanos as there is so much Splenda dumped in them, they are undrinkable. (I travel frequently and have not had this trouble at any other Starbucks location, and it is a consistent occurrence here.) The last time, I gave it back--an unusual step because I would always rather avoid a scene--and of course was met with attitude.

Second: don't try to order breakfast sandwiches here. Or anything on the menu, really. They are always out. Occasional outages I could understand, but...They. Are. Out. Every. Single. Time. Afternoon cake pop? Good luck. Bacon Gouda at 10a? Sorry, out. Ok, turkey bacon that no one probably orders because it is gross, so surely there must be one left? HAHAHAHAHAHAH

I would love to ask their manager what they are doing, because I actually think this would be an excellent case study in how not to manage your inventory par levels. Or maybe they are just trying to get rid of a surplus chicken sausage, because that is the only food item they ever have.

At any rate, I give up. Do yourself a favor and go to the one at Hwy 70 and Old Hickory. Or heck, even Nashville West. Pro tip: if you stubbornly go here anyway and intend to order food, check online ordering first to see that handy "Sold out at this store" notification and save yourself the aggravation.
The staff is friendly enough.  Waiting is kept to a minimum and they make a great iced cinnamon dolce latte.

Are there any adults that work here and can help these kids out? 20 minutes for a ice tea and panini... The drink wasn't even correct. 

Parking lot is a nightmare.

Update: this is literally the worst Starbucks ever with the absolute most awful staff to exist. I just waited in a 4 person line for 10 minutes watching an employee use his bare hands to maneuver pastries. Save yourself your time and money and go to united by Blue for better coffee and nicer people.
Great sbux, always fast service, although, no perfect rating because twice they haven't had my favorite sandwich feta and spinach wrap in stock, otherwise they're great.

I really enjoy going here, because it is less than a mile away from my house. The service is very good, they are pretty quick about getting orders out, and they have never made a mistake about my order.

Went to this location three days in a row, and the barista knew my order by the third day.  And almost everyone else's in the (very long) line.  Very busy location in the mornings, but understandably so.  Its prime location and delightful service make the delicious coffee served there seem even better.
By far the slowest Starbucks I've ever experienced. Just waited 20 minutes for two cappuccinos, amidst a crowd of other customers waiting. And it seemed to be business as usual.
Ridiculously slow. 1 cashier for 8 people in line and one clerk is doing NOTHING. At least two staff on break just sitting in area beyond shop. They need to respond to the line!

Great outdoor seating area but everything else sucks. Very few places to sit and spread out inside with a wifi that goes up and down all day long. The drinks are good but unless you like to sit in the heat. They don't even have the elevator music which I like to listen to from time to time. This location was very cheaply built and needs improvement.

The weekday morning crew at this store is absolutely the best. They are always friendly and quick, using a style that makes you feel invited and not rushed. They have offered excellent suggestions every time I have asked for ways to tweak any of my favorite drinks. 
I pass by 2 other Starbucks on my way into the office because the service at this location is truly the best.
Staff is friendly, but ALWAYS out of bagels and/or breakfast sandwiches. Get your logistical crap together!

This location is constantly running out of soy, and they are out of bacon gouda breakfast sandwiches half the time. When you ask for soy and they're all out, they insist on using coconut oil which is disgusting. They also screw up my drink a lot. And one of the register girls is borderline rude and very slow. The guys are really nice though. Weird
I enjoy this location because it is quieter than others further downtown. The staff was friendly, the lines were not too long and they made my drink right!!
Starbucks with a friendly staff and not that busy compared to the ones on state st

Love the coffee but the employees at this location are horrible. Every time I have the misfortune of needing to stop at this location they act like they're doing you a favor by waiting on you. Terrible customer service

This was the last location I will try. Whoever owns the Starbucks on dale mabry I'm sorry but y'all slacking. I've contacted corporate and managers. Nothing works. All I want is pike roast with cream and sugar stirred. Since they can't handle a simple order like that I'll take my business elsewhere. Gold member since 2009. I will never spend another dime at any location.

This Starbucks is typically pretty packed at most times of the day. There is usually nowhere to sit inside. The set-up is sort of L-shaped. You walk in and to the left are couches and tables. Along the path to the counter are more tables. The bathrooms are in front of you all the way in the back.

The staff has always been efficient and sufficiently friendly in my visits here. The parking lot can be a little tricky since it's two rows of parking spots, and you have to back up toward each other to maneuver out. This location is in Short Hills plaza, connected to Hollywood Tans, Classic Cake Company, a Vietnamese restaurant, and a dog toy store. 

They usually have bagels when I get there, which I enjoy. At the end of the night, the pastries like mallorka sweet bread are pretty stale, so I don't recommend getting anything like that late.

What I love about this location is the patio style seating to the side of it that they provide. This is great for warm weather when meeting up with a friend.

Unfortunately, the crowd that this location brings is ritzy, snobby Cherry Hill/Voorhees people. I sometimes wish I'd brought ear plugs when I come because overhearing their conversations is nearly painful. 

Overall, I'd say come here and get your drinks and snacks to go, unless it is a nice day - then enjoy the patio with a friend.

Nashville is unusual in the number of Starbucks it has WITHOUT a Drive Thru.  Fortunately this one has a Drive Thru, as well as being a nice new location.  We recently stopped in and the better half even ordered one of the recently and popularly discussed unofficial "Rainbow Drinks". The Barista was very kind and she and her manager helped to make "Orange Drink".

It isn't a large Starbucks, but the service is fast and friendly.

Nestled and small, I didn't expect much from this Starbucks. Granted I'm not a big fan but 1) It was raining and I was cold and 2) I had recently broken my large coffee cup and needed a replacement. So while waiting for a prescription at CVS next door I went in for a basic Cafe Mocha. They don't short you on whipped cream either. 

The atmosphere is calm,  baristas friendly. Today I'm filling a prescription and plan on grabbing a coffee simply to enjoy the quiet. I would never say that of the other Starbucks locations I've visited.

I kind of hate this Starbucks but also not really? 

Pros: 
- it is close to my home and also on the way to the highway (65). 

Cons:
- The interior layout is dreadful. In regards environment, it is just not a cozy space. The Windows face west and north, and let in harsh light that (if you are bringing a laptop) makes it impossible to sit it (but pull the blinds and it's too dark). When sitting with folks you're liable to have sunlight stab you in the eye if you don't face in a weird direction. There's one large long table where there should be multiple small tables pushed together - rarely do large parties sit there so instead a couple of folks on laptops or talking will take up a huge space. There's one good table by the coffee shelves that's ok. They have another corner table that is accessible to folks in a wheelchair. 
- omg the parking and drive-thru is terrible. NEVER PARK IN THE DRIVE THRU AREAS. Often the drive-thru gets backed up and then angry jerks in the drive-thru line are too rude to give space to folks backing out so they can leave. Multiple times I have gotten stuck there for a period of time. It's just the dumbest set up for a drive thru. They should have taken the lane that's between them and LA Fitness. 
- the people working here are ok. Sometimes I am just not impressed with service and other times they are fine. 

Overall, it is a Starbucks. It has stuff you probably want. I go here for convenience because the south side doesn't have a lot of coffee options. Sometimes it is actually nice. But usually I come here and am fairly unhappy, but glad to have coffee on my way to work.

I'm surprised that during a busy time there is only one cashier. The person before me had an item return and it took such a long time. No one said anything to me while I waited and waited. I come here a lot and just expected to be welcomed and not ignored. 

Today Austin made my day! He gave me lots of ideas on how to enhance my drink. Nice! I feel like an important customer and will be back soon. My cascara latte with an extra shot is perfect! Thanks Austin! 

David took my order and he was just wonderful! He was helpful, friendly and made my customer experience amazing. I'm now giving this location a top rating because of David's efforts! Keep it up David and I hope others follow suit!

I love this Starbucks. The baristas are so nice and it is usually pretty quiet. Though this location is small, there is always somewhere for me to sit. I go on my lunch break a few times a week and it seems like the staff genuinely care about the customers. This location is definitely a wonderful escape from my office!

This is your typical Starbucks. There's nothing special about it. 

The location is only a few blocks from where I work and they get me in and out of there quickly. Like every Starbucks, everything is expensive, so to order anything from here is a treat. The customer service could use some work but it isn't too bad. Some of the employees could at least smile when asking for your order. Also, when ordering a pastry, don't expect it to be fresh 100% of the time. I have received a few stale lemon cakes from here. 

Again, 3 stars.

I can't dislike a Starbucks with a drive-thru, and so I shan't. My visit consisted entirely of ordering at the drive-thru, and there were many cars and the line was long, but the queue went relatively fast. Good coffee, great iced tea, breakfast sandwiches all day ... yup, this Starbucks is good.

This location usually very busy. Seating is decent. The problem is for some reason the customers here all think they live in Beverly Hills and shouldn't have to wait or suffer the fools behind the counters. The employees here have always treated me well.

Same good Starbucks quality; however, the interior design (layout of tables and chairs) leaves much to be desired. It's hard to believe this was the best that could be done with a place built from scratch. I've been in Starbucks converted from gas stations that had a warmer feel inside.
Turn up the heat! It is winter. Doesn't have to be 80 degrees in here but cutting off the cool air coming from the vent would be a nice touch for patrons.

This location has a small parking lot that on a normal workday morning the drive thru is completely jam up! I prefer to recommend you the Starbucks on Anderson Rd.  - by AMC 24. Due to very narrow direction of car flow it sometime can be HARD to access this location.  Neither less to say it's always busy. Drive thru is quick so I do suggest it unless your lucky enough to find a parking space.
Incredibly rude and incompetent staff! We've been Starbucks members for a very long time and have never experienced such a terrible service. I would highly stay away from this location.

worst experience ever! i would give them zero stars if i could. please be aware (especially people with allergies)! these people at this particular location do not pay attention at all, i came to this location on friday may 20,2016 at 1:37 pm through the drive thru, i always order the same exact thing everytime which is a vanilla bean  frap, with soy milk, one shot, and extra whip. well they ended up giving me whole milk (which i am highly allergic too). this made me extremely sick, i was headed to work and happened to take a sip and soon after was extremely sick, i had to leave my job and go to an urgent care, the district manager has yet to call me. the 1800 starbucks number told me that she would give me a call by this morning.the 1800 starbucks number also tried to just compensate me with a starbucks gift card, how degrading?! i could have lost my life!!!!!! why would i go back?! please beware, i havent even recieved an apology! how tacky?!

Pros: it's a drive-thru
Their outside menu is pretty cool
Not to many cars were in line @ 10am on a weekday morning!!

Cons: rude employees who like to come into your car with your drinks

They are out of ice coffee((really)) and cookies and protein plates!!!

If your not watching you will miss the driveway to turn into and will have to drive down the street make a u- turn go back down the street make another u-turn then make a quick right!! :p

Lots of seats outside, and it is in a shaded area.  This Starbucks reminds me of the one at El Con except with a drive-thru so it is a bit more chaotic.  It is probably not a place you want to sit and read quietly.  There are a few couch chairs.  

The staff is excellent.  If you are thinking about getting a modification to your normal drink, they will make you a regular drink if you absolutely dislike the new drink.  I love this about the employees.

This Starbucks is inside Target, I had gotten a wrong order from another store and was in Target, I mentioned it and Andrew working was incredibly polite and corrected it for me. Would absolutely return to this location. Not to mention it was delicious when I did get what I wanted!

Love Starbucks! I go close to every day. Excellent service, but they are slower during certain times of the day. If they could find the groove like they have in the mornings, they'd have 5 stars from me. Unfortunately, I've experienced the slow service during dinner and later at night and that's when they seem to be the least busy.

Honestly? I try to stay away from here if I can. The store is just too small for the amount of customers who come through. My suggestion is to grab a drink and leave because the seats are way too cramped.

This Starbucks is inside Harrah's which made it convenient for us since we were staying there.  However, our lattes were weak even with extra espresso, so much do that my husband had to go back down to have them remake his as it tasted like cream only.  They did not offer the breakfast selections we are used to at our various local Starbucks.  A near fail for Starbucks.

What nice employees this Starbucks has! My usual location seemed to have double charged me on my last visit so I only had 50¢ left on my gift card. By the time I got my debit card out, it had already been taken care of. This location is pretty far out of my way, but I'll make the drive to return.

My wife ordered an egg nog latte. It tasted, and smelled, like burnt coffee with very little egg nog. Worst coffee she has ever had. 

My drink had very little flavor. Ordered from the mobile app. Drinks were actually ready when I arrived, but no one would acknowledge I was standing there to hand me the drinks, which were behind the counter. 

Slow staff. Poor attention to customers and tasteless drinks earn this location 2 stars. I've had better. Much better.

It is an small place but has the most friendly staff!!
Frapuccinos, lattes, coffees, and delicious sandwiches are on the menu.

Terrible. The only good thing about this place is its location. Even if there is no line it will take you at least 10 minutes to get a drink. My beverage of choice is a cafe misto, which is not a hard order, and they look at me like I am talking gibberish when I order it. Not a problem at ANY other Starbucks I have ever been to. They are too busy talking to each other to even acknowledge customers when they walk up to the counter. The last time I was there the cashier took my order with a wet mop in her hand. Lovely and very sanitary.

Busy place in the mornings better download the app to order ahead of time to get your coffee . Or you will be waiting and you will be waiting in rush hour traffic . But don't order it till your close to location bc when you order ahead  they make it faster
A typical starbucks, however less stars due to the lack of comfortable, cozy seating.
The the sugar free syrups taste jute as good in a latte as the regular.

Hey Starbucks! A big wag of the finger!! I bring my own personal cup to get my iced coffee and yet, your staff thinks that it is okay to use a plastic cup to simply write what my drink was and then that cup gets discarded. Chuck You #Starbucks. #wasteful

I need my Starbucks. I been to Reno before and always look for a Starbucks in Circus Circus, El Dorado and Silver Legacy and NOTHING. The closest one is in the Harrahs. It's very easy to find and spot... its on the 2nd floor in the West Tower.
The staff is very nice and friendly. The coffee is OK, especially its not the normal Starbucks prices either. Its actually more... I think its because its located inside Harrahs, but there always a line out the door. There only a few chairs and table, but usually people don't sit around. People get in line and purchase their coffee and leave. 
They don't give Internet access either... SUCKY!!! I thought they don't offer internet to everyone, but I have Starbucks Rewards, so with my rewards... I'm suppose to get free internet access, but I don't at this location.

Starbucks as usual but one of the biggest locations I've been to in awhile. I'm a sucker for local coffee shops but there's a serious lack of "local" in Haddonfield with Starbucks and Saxby's on King's Highway. 

Nice seating area. I've always had a big problem with cafes not having enough seating for customers. There's a nice line of high chairs and bar-like seating while also having your tables by a fireplace on the other side without the bustle of the people ordering. Wi-Fi is great - I've had issues at Saxby's down the street and other shops before. Plenty of outlets too (at least, at the bar-like seating). Also probably one of the very few places open past 8pm during the weekdays which is helpful when you're a working professional who also wants to study for grad school exams and future grad school! 

The weird? They are open until 10pm but were cleaning when I arrived at 8pm and mopping around 8:30 when there were still people walking in and out. I ordered a decaf coffee when I arrived and there wasn't any brewed but they gladly brewed a fresh batch for me and told me it was a short wait. 

Overall, one of the better Starbucks I've been to.

OK, OK it's Starbucks! But on that note, this location very efficient, clean & fast!! It was extremely Brick outside, so running into the city Sunday I stopped to get a skinny macchiatio-& it delivered. Yummmmm. The employees were quick, sits on corner, & like this one.

This used to be our favorite morning spot. That was before it turned into the Arctic. It's so cold you literally need a coat to sit inside in the middle of the Summer. After repeated attempts to change it, we just stopped going. Too bad, we've been hong here a few times a week for the last 6 years. The staff informed me that "it gets hot back here making coffee so we turn it all the way down".

Not enough seating for normal folks wanting to sit and enjoy a coffee with a date. Is taken over by students using Starbucks for a study hall. Funny cause some of them don't have a purchase that I have noticed? 
Sorry but I pay good money for Starbucks coffee .
love Starbucks but the Egyptian taking all over the place and the fight in it wallah... I come here everyday because I love seeing them fighting lol

Can't say I'm too impressed with today's visit. I received my latte and it was just a bit more than half full, we waited in the drive thru for almost 20 minutes, I was OVERCHARGED, and the barista who took our order didn't seem to know very much about the items Starbucks serves. I can't say I've ever had a bad experience at Starbucks; however, this visit was the worst on my list and I'm a gold member so I visit Starbucks a lot! I originally wasn't too worried about the service and the wait time - the thing that got me was my latte being more of a tall than the grande that I ordered. And mind you, I did not ask for it with room. The picture along with this review was taken before I took one sip of my latte that wasn't even prepared correctly. Really hate having to write these reviews, but just like for others to be informed. I called the store after getting down the road and realizing I was overcharged. I called and asked to speak to a manager and they don't even have a manager in today, how unprofessional!!  I had the nice girl confirm how much my order would be and I was right, I was overcharged a few dollars for two lattes and a sandwhich. Very very annoyed.

Starbucks is Starbucks, BUT the people who work here really make it. It feels familial when the employees get to know you. I'm a regular in the morning during the weekdays, and there are a lot of other regulars who make it feel warm and friendly.

This review has been a long time coming. I am a previous employee of Starbucks so I feel like I have a pretty good idea on policies, procedures and drink quality. The customer service and drink quality lacks consistently here. 

I want to like this store so bad as it is near my home and on my way to work. But they have messed up one too many times. The other day I ordered a venti iced americano in the drive thru and when I pulled around to receive and pay for my drink the employee let me know they just ran out of cold cups. That's fine. I'm not one of those Starbucks snobs who freaks out. However, I did want my normal amount of espresso shots, strength of the drink, etc. She asked if I would like a different size and I asked if she could just dump the drink in a Trenta size cup. I didn't expect anything extra or even for the cup to be filled up- and I let her know that. She shortly replied "no we're not allowed". If there's anything I know about working at Starbucks or any business- the customers come first. Especially when the business makes a mistake- like not ordering enough cups. She could have very easily given me a larger cup- I know from personal experience. Another time I was told I could not have my free refill on iced tea and coffee for the gold star membership and the manager stood right there and agreed with it. The employees here are very often short and rude in general. However, there is one guy- a younger, taller, thin guy with facial hair that I usually see in the drive thru and at times the register who has always been more than willing to provide excellent service well. As well there is a woman with short blonde hair who is usually making drinks and if I could find out her schedule and only come when she is making drinks- I would. She always provides me with excellent drinks just how I like it. Those two are the only reason I'm giving this place 2 stars instead of 1.

I wish I could like this place- messing up a drink a couple times or having a slow drive thru is one thing- but I just can't seem to get over the poor service. Sorry, Starbucks.
5 stars for their barista John Main. Best barista in the country. 10/10 doctors recommend you buy your coffee from him. 4 real.

Our friendly neighborhood Starbucks... good place to meet friends OK for business associates ... She's been there FOREVER and survived the downsizing from a few years ago (thank God)... but her age is showing, could use some new furniture or even a remodel, but we LOVE her

I'm a Starbucks fan, but I think I was at this location at a bad time.  I was there around lunchtime on a Sunday.  I was able to place my order pretty quickly, but I had a long wait time for pick up (and I had friends sitting in the car waiting for me).  I like the architecture of the building, but parking is problematic.  There are some spaces in the back and the side of the building, but it was cramped.  Also perhaps because it was the weekend, there were more teenagers in here than I usually see at Starbucks.  I think they could have used another staff member behind the counter making drinks to handle the volume of people.  I hope they do on busy weekday mornings.

Horribly slow service every time I come here no matter what time it is! Drinks are inconsistent but still better than any other coffee around big bend, and they have a drive thru, unlike most other sb in Riverview. Been waiting over 5 min in drive thru with one car in front of me for a grande coffee.
The code for the bathroom is 1989- save yourself buying a coffee to pee! ...............,:......:
This place gives excellent service. Employees are super nice and helpful. I will drive a great distance to visit the Starbucks versus others.

Today is the grand opening of this store - Ferguson, MO. They have a new concept at this location (2nd store to have, 1st was in Jamaica Queens) ....a community room that the Urban League will be able to help better the community. The room can also be booked by other organizations and it is free. They have a video screen, separate coffee/drink station, tables with outlets.  A lot of the workers live within a 5 mile radius. It is a very large store. I love it. Thanks Starbucks

If parking doesn't shy you away, this location is quite quaint.  It has enough little tables for seating outside and inside to allow for a great business meeting or a coffee with a friend.  Staff is pretty friendly and they  haven't got my order wrong yet so got to give it four stars for that!  Good selection of gift ideas too for that coffee or now available Tea connoisseurs!!
My order has been wrong many times, and the food is either cold or just not prepared fit to eat. Dunkin' Donuts is must better and less $$$
Had to wait 16 mins in line for 3 shots of espresso... Didnt get a "hello" "sorry for the wait" or acknowledgement for that matter at the window. Rude staff. Unnecessarily long wait.
I love Starbucks Coffee it brighten up my day and it help me stay up to read more books like always. :D and watch more anime.
