Our friendly neighborhood Starbucks... good place to meet friends OK for business associates ... She's been there FOREVER and survived the downsizing from a few years ago (thank God)... but her age is showing, could use some new furniture or even a remodel, but we LOVE her  

7/31/18 
She was FINALLY remodeled a few weeks ago, looks really great and much larger (took over the veterinarian office space that was next door and added to their own).  She needed the space to handle the crowds.  Unfortunately 90% of the chairs have no cushion and are uncomfortable to sit in after about 15 min or so ... maybe that is by design?  Probably won't be meeting friends here to chat... too bad, she used to be such a cozy place to gather for a visit.

I have been to many Starbucks Coffee places in many states and I loved the familiar smell when you first walk in. My drink was perfect. There was some nice out door seating. I was disappointed at the very few selection of coffee mugs and also that the table was pushed directly up to the shelve where you had to interrupt people sitting to browse. There is a refrigerated section that takes up the rest of the wall and gives this location a super market feel. Tucson is over 100 degrees out and most of the seating is outside. It's just not a relaxing atmosphere. I worked at a much nicer location several years ago and the retail selection was just as important as the drinks. I'm happy that they have the classics still!

While I was waiting for my drink a short red headed young woman dropped a squeeze bottle on the floor. She got on all fours and retrieved. She did not wash the bottle or her hands. This occurred just a few minutes ago. The new manager has lots of work to do.

This is the best Starbucks in Reno. The staff are friendly and speedy, the space is well laid out for staying and reading, and it has a drive-thru.

Our running group usually crashes the place on Saturday mornings, and we're always met with cheerfulness and welcome.

Maybe expecting customer service at a Starbucks is too much, but if there are half a dozen customers waiting for their drinks ans only one person preparing them while the rest of the staff goes about having personal conversations and standing about, you're certainly not getting it here. You'd think they would at least help each other with the iced coffees. If there are more than 2 people waiting ahead of you, be prepared to wait at least 15 mins for for your preprepared coffee to be poured over ice.

Date night, Apparently there are 2 locations in Oldsmar and I was at one while the beau was at another. While I waited for him to join me at this location, I ordered my hot chai Tea. Jonah was absolutely wonderful. He was personable and friendly and exceptionally warm. We chatted about how our names are different (my alternate Id) and how we don't often hear them, though mine is growing popular due to Anime. 

Once my order was placed, it took only a few minutes to have it in my hands so I could wait for Bruce to join me. I'd come back.

The location is not very big, and based on previous reviews - they're correct in saying it's slow. I ordered my drink from the mobil app while I was still at my hotel across the street. I made my way inside, only to find a large group of individuals that were clearly waiting for their drinks. Sixteen minutes after placing my mobile order - my drink was ready. I was in no rush that morning; however, this still fell outside of the estimate the app provided me for when the drink would be available. 
The wifi is decent, so if you're going to spend time there...your good from that standpoint.

Ok, it is a Starbucks. If you drink coffee, you've been to a Starbucks. I typically don't write reviews for chains, especially the really big ones. However, what makes this Starbucks great is the service.

I have never had bad service at this Starbucks. There have been one or two time that something has taken longer than it should have. (Usually it is my son's Java chip frappuchino) However, they go out of their way to make it right and correct the issue.

The staff is always very friendly and typically speedy, even when they are really busy. This Starbucks is a well-oiled machine.

This is my favorite place to go in the morning. I literally stop here every morning to get my Grande caramel macchiato extra hot. The wonderful thing is the workers know exactly what I want when I come in without me even having to tell them. I love Starbucks

Really limited seating with not a lot of charging ports. I had a lady flip out on me because she wanted a seat from my table, but I needed it to put stuff on it. My table was crowded with drinks, a large laptop and food....Can't really do much, lady! I wish the staff would have asked her to please keep it down when her children were throwing huge tantrums for a good hour.

Very generic Starbucks with a small parking lot.  The staff when I visited did not have the coffee roast I normally drink and wanted to charge me extra for a pour-over.  From my knowledge, pour-overs do not cost more than regular drip coffee.  I will not be returning to this location.

I love Starbucks inside of grocery stores - it's so convenient :)

The staff at this Starbucks have always been friendly and the coffee yummy.  This Genuardi super market also has wireless so you can get your coffee and sit down to use the free wireless.

I love starbucks. It's my go to coffee destination. I won't, however, be coming back to this location. I'm lactose intolerant and love the bux for the delicious soy milk. I ordered a soy latte. The barista confirmed that it was soy. I've not eaten anything else all day and have been violently ill. Clearly the barista put milk in my drink. I called the location to complain and they couldn't be bothered other than "let us know if you have to go to the emergency room"... really?? I'm so disappointed and still sick.

I am SO PISSED OFF @ this store!!!!!! I did a mobile order which I typically do and my app tells me my order is ready. Get to Starbucks and I wait for 20 mins with no coffee and the baristas making other drinks. Finally I get someone's attention and she informs me that they don't have my coffee and that was if. No apologize, no problem solving. Just flat out screw your mobile order. I will NEVER go to this Starbucks again. Lost a customer.

Finally, it opens!

The shell of this Starbucks had mocked the better half and I for at least a year. Driving past it twice going to visit her folks "Opening soon" it said for ever and ever.  Then, suddenly it was open and operating!

The staff seems more than excited about the new location. My barista, while making my Grande Double Blended Caramel Frappucino, was filled with so much zeal that he must have put almost the entire can of whipped cream on the top.  When he went to put the lid on, an almost obscene display of it ejected from the hole where the straw goes!

I'm looking forward to many future visits to this location, and I hope they keep putting on just the same amount of whipped cream!

I recently came to this Starbucks because it's close to my place. I wasn't that impressed with it. The store is understaffed. The people who work there were clearly overworked and they weren't really friendly. It's a pretty small Starbucks and became overcrowded really quickly. Just wasn't a fan of this one and probably won't be coming back to it.

Friendly staff and quick service. I appreciate that they still have breakfast sandwiches near noon. Today is Black Friday and they're keeping everything moving smooth. They have a unique selection of Starbucks coffee cups that I haven't noticed in others. Very clean as well.

I've been standing here for 15 minutes waiting for a latte. They make drinks in the order they want, 5 people ordered after me and already got their order and left. I come here every day and every day the service is consistently bad and disorganized.

Among Tampa area Starbucks, this has shown to be one of the least accessible.  The entrance and exit are difficult to access.  There are about 5 parking spots available.  (The other 5 belong to the Game Stop next door.)  When the drive thru is full, you might as well not try parking for either one of those businesses.

I am writing this as an individual who likes Starbucks and has been to just about all the Santa Barbara area locations. Starbucks is a great brand and is successful in achieving parity in its retail locations. That being said the De La Vina location gives me the most pause because it often comes up short on this promise.

The location is really great if you are on De La Vina headed south, it is very accessible and has a good sized parking lot. The early morning isn't busy but baristas often create a queue due to sluggish performance. There is one barista who is an absolute rockstar - another reason to come here. 

I have never seen food items out of stock as frequently as I do at this location.

This Starbucks has really gone down hill in the last year.  This recent incident was the tipping point for me as I am pretty tolerate of stressful situations and understand that food service is not the most happy environment in which to work.  I was in earlier this week and ordered 4 drinks for people from work.  The staff person who took my order quickly wrote my name on all four drinks.  Just catching it as this was 7:10 am I politely asked if we could go back on three of the drinks and write in the names of the people I was ordering for.  The staff person looked me straight in the face and sighed and did not break eye contact.  I was completely shocked.  I said to him, "Oh I'm sorry, I did not mean to be annoying."  There was no response, no thank you when I paid, nothing.  This was rather hostile behavior especially when you look someone right in the eye, sigh, and maintain eye contact without speaking.  The staff person also forgot to provide me the danish for which I paid for.  I was so taken back and embarrassed that I did not even go back in when I discovered the missing danish.  When I  shared this story, my colleagues said verbatim "We don't even go to that one anymore and will drive out of our way to go to the Starbucks on Main Street.  Interesting to note that of all the Starbucks in Indy this one has the lowest stars with the most complaints.  Will never be back.  Management needs to read this and do something about their staff.

I never write reviews for corporate chains but this Starbucks is the second worst Starbucks I have ever been to anywhere in the world.  (The worst: Starbucks right across the street from the British Museum in London) 

The service at this Starbucks is horrendous.  I work on Murfreesboro Pk so I stop in for a coffee at least twice a month...the service is ALWAYS bad.  The baristas seem unaware or uncaring about other people's time.  When your establishment is filled with people in business attire at 12:30 PM, you should assume that they're probably on their lunch break and they don't have 20 minutes to wait for you to make a latte.  Heed my warning: if you order anything other than a plain coffee, it will take between 15 and 20 minutes to get your drink.  There are 4 people working behind the bar.  It should never take 20 minutes to make a drink regardless of how many orders there are.  There are 4 of you.  I worked at a much busier Starbucks in college and if it took 4 of us 20 minutes to deliver a customer's drink we'd all be fired at the end of the day.

Not only is the staff lackadaisical in delivering orders, a handful of the baristas are extremely rude and inconsiderate.  I came in today after lunch to pick up a coffee for the afternoon and in the middle of my order (while I was still speaking) another barista offered the cashier an erroneous latte.  The cashier stopped taking my order, asked me to "hold on" and turned her attention to the barista.  "What is this?" "I used skim milk instead of whole.  Do you want it?" "Um, no let me ask this other barista chick if she wants it." "Just put it over there." "I don't want them to think it's a to-go order though."  The conversation continued while my boyfriend and I literally stood there and just stared at the guy making coffee and the cashier banter about what to do with this erroneous order.  The cashier interrupted me mid-sentence and then proceeded to have a 3 minute conversation about what to do with an erroneous order.  This is unacceptable.  THERE ARE CUSTOMERS IN FRONT OF YOU.  A customer is ordering.  Take the effing order and then figure out what to do with the mistake latte! 

The Starbucks brand is all about providing you a good cup of coffee with the (HUGE) added bonus of great convenience.  If I wanted to be treated like an afterthought and wait around for 20 minutes to get a cup of coffee, I'd head to one of the hundreds of independent coffee shops for a far superior brew.   NEVER AGAIN.
I love that this location always seems to have samples lately! Otherwise, a normal Starbucks experience.

I have been there several times, walk-in, ignored, drive thru, wrong order! I am a basic latte drinker, no funny order requests.  Burned coffee I will not abide! Being ignored, no more! Get a dedicated cashier with no headset these folks can't multi-task!
Can't really think of anything bad to say. The store is brand new so it looked super clean. Ambiance was very nice. Very relaxed atmosphere. Workers kept bringing me samples of drinks.
This is a really nice Starbucks.   The wifi is strong and there is ample comfortable seating.   I like to wait here while my car is in for service at the Firestone across the parking lot.

There's finally a new Starbucks drive thru open further down Hillsborough that's probably worth the drive. This location is frustrating. On the corner of extremely congested Memorial and Hillsborough, and paired with GameStop, in the smallest plaza ever. If you can squeeze past the drive thru line to enter the parking lot, you'll be lucky to find a spot. Going inside is typically faster but who wants to risk getting trapped? Exiting is tricky because if you park you basically have to exit right onto Memorial. If you drive thru, you can loop around the building again to turn right onto Memorial -or- turn right onto Hillsborough. Very rarely does either option go smoothly. On more than one occasion they were unexpectedly closed for unknown reasons. It's too bad because the staff is super friendly, and do a fine job prepping drinks and breakfast sammiches. I'd only recommend this Starbucks if you travel during times of little to no traffic.

This location is so hit or miss. More miss than hit. Their are a few baristas in there that need attitude adjustments. Being nice is not hard. I understand we all have our days but their drive thru skills are pathetic. Need to take a lesson from Chick fil A. I do enjoy Sandy (I think that's her name). She always is pleasant and there is a younger guy that works there that takes his job really serious and aims for excellent customer service. Great job to those two employees. The others just need to be a bit more friendlier.

I travel all over the world and often visit Starbucks. I've probably been to Starbucks in more than 20 countries. This is my absolute favorite location. They have really taken the time to get to know me, and they always treat me well.  In addition, the drink quality is always spot on. Sometimes, the taste can be off at a Starbucks where the baristas are in a rush or not trained properly, but I have never had a bad drink here.  Rock on, 19th and Chestnut!

This place is FREEZING. Yes, in Tucson even, this place is uncomfortably cold. The building benefits from shade so it shouldn't need too much AC, but they blast it as if they're on the sun. Much warmer and more comfortable outside somehow.

Asked the cashier if I could get a mocha started since she seemed like she was waiting on me. She blankly stares at me and says NOTHING. I ask her again, she still doesn't respond (and yes she understands English because I watched her take the subsequent 4 customers' orders) Another cashier took my order. It left a really bad taste to my morning. I can see why this Starbucks location has poor reviews overall, which is surprising for the busy street it's on. Go to any other Starbucks.

This is THE slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. If you are in a rush and need coffee and WANT to be late to wherever you're going, go to this Starbucks. They don't know how to work efficiently and there is always a line to order and a line waiting to get there coffee. I live one block away it takes me 2 minutes to get there. I wait in line for 10 minutes then wait for my drink for 20 minutes. Thumbs down.

A little nasty and testy when you ask for refill. The workers automatically take for granted that you walked off the premises when you've been sitting here for 45 minutes working on your computer. This is not good business practices by the employees of Starbucks.

It's 6:53 am supposed to be open at 6:00am no staff in site not the first time they have not been open on time. Heading across the street to the Diner for my go-go juice at least I know someone will be there to make it.
Very quick service. Customer service was great. I would recommend going back to this Starbucks.
This is the worst Starbucks out there! Second day in a row no vanilla in a vanilla latte! I waited five minutes as three employees watched coffee pour into a cup. Worst tasting coffee.

generic Starbucks.

In Tampa across from hotel & office location.

Coffee was excellent.

Very good selection of non-coffee goods and foods.  Wifi - noted a large number of persons having coffee & plugged in to their notebooks/laptops.

Comfortable seating although i, as is my want, ordered take out. 

The coffee here was very good.  I'm not usually a huge fan of Starbucks coffee but the coffee i got here was excellent.  

Service was professional, prompt, kind, good humored and most courteous.

Recommended.

This is an awesome location on Harrison Avenue at Memphis Street. The building is small and tan with the line on the depth of the Katrina water on the side. The staff and baristas are sweet and friendly. The coffee is hot and awesome! The WiFi is free and called Google Starbucks. To log in click the screen on a green box that says "accept & connect".  Open the same hours as Canal at St. Charles (05:30-21:00). This location has plenty of outdoor seating, as much or more than indoor! Some decent bicycle parking is also available. Nearby to the lake and City Park! You'll enjoy this location out of the main hustle and bustle of the CBD and French Quarter. :) Muchlove y'all!
I love how friendly the staff is. Went here multiple times already and the experience is always good. They serve fast and accurate. Though parking lot is quite small.

We stop at this Starbucks usually on the way to my husband's parents' home. Service is fine, although they don't put sprinkles on my skinny cinnamon dolce latte unless I ask (unless the stores on Binford and 96th St). The odd thing is that there is always something weird going on in the parking lot. This last time, a guy was driving in reverse across the lot; another time, a car was trying to exit while another car was trying to enter and neither car would move. I ended up having to get up out of the car to order while my husband waited to get into the lot!

In general, slow service, some unhappy workers, little teamwork. Store can be messy when busy. Parking lot too small that you may be blocked by people sitting in the drive thru. Falling short of expected Starbucks standards sadly and the reason why i brew more at home.  Too bad it's the only Starbucks on my way to work when i don't wake up in time to brew and ironically still cutting it close to clock-in time...

Everyone who works at this Starbucks seems to be having the worst day of their life every time I come here. I've had nothing but bad experiences every time, but I keep coming back because it's closest to my apartment. I've never had a drive thru experience where they didn't get something wrong and then get mad because I asked them to fix it. Seriously, it's happened like six times and I have a very common, uncomplicated drink order.
Super slow on the mobile order.  Also, I order the same Frappuccino every time I go to a Starbucks.  This is the sweetest one I've ever tasted and not in a good way.
The music is so stinkin loud in this place most days.  Really annoying for people who come here to work or have a nice quiet lunch break to get away from the office.

Greatest staff of any Starbucks in the area. 

I've been going to this Starbucks for about ten years and I'm not exaggerating when I say this place has seen me grow up. They have the best baristas in the game. If you're new: they'll make you feel welcome and if you're a regular: you can be sure they'll make you feel like family. In fact, when I left for college I told my mom they would be some of the people I missed most. 

Since the location change and addition of the drive thru, new hires were made and they're the same type of wonderful as the veteran baristas. 

Speaking of the move, the place now boasts a larger, shiny, new interior (although if you roll through at a busy time you may be hard-pressed to find a seat), wonderful outdoor seating area, and the benefit of being a test location for Starbucks Evenings- a development that offers wine, craft beer, and small plates in addition to the Starbucks coffee drinks and treats (the truffle popcorn is a must-have.)

The drive thru is a great addition although, if I'm being honest, I hardly ever use it because I don't want to miss out on the great experience of talking to my baristas. 

Basically, if you're in the area, make this your go-to Starbucks and you won't regret it.
As frequently as I stop here, it's just a stop. I get my grande bold and move on. This Starbucks is indicative of MOST locations, so there's not much to add to the conversation.

I stopped at this location for about an hour while passing through Santa Barbara on a road trip. The service was super friendly and it seemed like the baristas knew many of the customers who came in. They were out of several food items but my coffee was good and made quickly. There was amble seating and the air conditioner was blasting. A standard Starbucks experience.

All Starbucks are not the same. This one is top notch! The staff is very quick and efficient, and has never made a mistake in my app orders... not even once. And after a few days, they even greeted me by name when they realized which order matched me. Honestly, this is the best Starbucks I've visited in a long while. Very happy customer.
This location has a consistently friendly staff. Makes my Monday's a lot easier when I get to interact with people that are nice, quick, and knowledgeable of the product offerings!

I am very upset with the service at this Starbucks. When I ordered a pink drink through the drive through, they got my order wrong, so naturally I go back inside and ask that they remake my drink. The employees smirk at my request and proceed to make me a drink, and the drink they made me was basically just coconut milk. These employees were rude, incompetent and careless. If I could give this Starbucks a lower rating I would, but it isn't possible. This is the drink the Starbucks employees gave me versus what the drink is supposed to look like.

The man who called out the customer for parking illegally in a designated disabled parking space should be getting free Starbucks for a year, not banned from this location!!!!!!  Thanks to him, for doing the right thing!!!! I don't live locally, but would advise avoiding this place like the plague!!!  Shame on Starbucks!!!!

The one star rating is only because I have to rate this place - if it was an option, I'd rate it -100 stars.

Any place where I can sit for more than two hours with my cup of coffee and zero disturbance is my kind of coffee shop. This morning was very busy and as busy as it got I was still able to surf the web in peace. Free wifi, drive thru, and friendly service. This SB is popping so whether you're reading this review or not, chances are you'll stop by this one if you're around the area.

Thank you Starbucks! You saved the day!
 I went to this location twice this morning, in the odd snowy conditions on this 11th of March. I ordered the wrong drink my wife asked me to go get her. She was not happy at all. So I went back to order another drink (the right one this time) and I told them I screwed up the order and needed another drink. (Grande White Mocha Frapp no whip) When I got to the window the Head Barista ,(Mgr.) ,asked me if they made the mistake or did I. I told them ot was totally my mistake and he told me he appreciated my brutally honest admission and rewarded me with the drink for no charge. I am forever greatful and will continue being a loyal customer. Not because I was given a free drink but because that's damn good customer service showing appreciation for my business, and that is in short supply in todays world. Than you again! 
                 Sincerely Greatful Patron!,
                              Justin G.
By far the best Starbucks in Doylestown and the area. Staff is great and quick,  line doesn't stay long quick. Great for in and out.
I love the Vanilla bean Frappe which my friend Jeremiah introduced me to. Friendly staff and clean store. I love the smell of coffee but I don't drink it

They do a good job keeping the line moving.  Sometimes the staff gets obviously overwhelmed and passive-aggressive with one another which can be a bit uncomfortable.  The food selection isn't as stocked as some other locations I've been to.  But overall...It's a Starbucks.
Great hidden place to relax and enjoy a cup of coffee with friends. Great staff and a great little patio.

This place is horrible, I've gone maybe 3 times hoping it would get better since it's close to my house. The coffee is always watered down, I'll usually get an iced coffee, and for whatever reason it may be this location always seems to fill the entire cup to the brim with scoops of ice. They need to properly train their employees, they lack courteous customer service skills and are oblivious when it comes to making coffee, if I wanted this trash I'd go to some gas station on Milpas but yet again that would be much much better than this. Save your time and drive too montecito they never disappoint, best of all they know how to treat their customers and most importantly the coffee is the best of all the Starbucks (la cumbre is a close 2nd) in this city.

Seriously y'all, this Starbucks is gross. There's so much crap everywhere! 

Every single time I have visited, there is spilled coffee on the self serve counter. With the amount of coffee spilled, you can tell it had been sitting there for hours! 

The bathroom.. no toilet paper. Ever.
I love this Starbucks and location.  The staff are always super nice and the coffee's are on point.  This is a great chill place too. I am always ready for my latte with extra foam yummm

Our third attempy, as we are new to area....today 10 min to order and almost 25 min to get husband drink.  I had a coffee he a lattee, mine virtually gone by time we received his.  Asked and said sorry someone may have taken, didnt readily offer to make immediately...guy next to me had 40 min wait.  Unbelievable  need to find another coffee place.  Your brand wont withstand horrible service

2 stars. 6 stars less than the amount of people working. I come in, primed for joe, ready for bean juice. 8 humans, 16 eyes (lenses) focused on me. I greet each pair with my own. "Hello," I say behind my eyes. Accept me, I'm only here to pay. So I pray, I pray that someone will help me. A simple cup of joe on ice would suffice. I know I'm not elite yet, but I long for the day. Shorter hair glare comes forward, and I wait for confirmation. Affirmation. Acceptance. "Hi, i'd like a small iced joe please". I hear my words enter the void, and soon I see them wave back at me. I did not ask for tall, I asked for small. Forgive me father for I have sinned.

The Starbucks here in the mall is one of the best in boise. Every time I come here my coffee is fantastic and made in a timely manner. All the employees are friendly and talkative. I normally order a venti iced caramel macchiato. Best drink Starbucks has to offer. Next time you are in the mall stop in and grab a little something.

This is, as far as Starbucks go, a very good shop. The parking can be tough, but the back lot (shared) typically has one spot or three available. The seating inside is ample and spread out. It is often the scene for business meetings, dates, and folks often work privately on laptops along the back hallway. 

I would urge you to especially watch for a late afternoon coffee when school is in session - the kids fill the place, but at least are better behaved than when I was their age.
My favorite Starbucks!!! Stellar service and drinks made perfectly every time. The best staff of any Starbucks I have been to.Always pleasant, always friendly, always warm. :)

I frequent this Starbucks location often on my way to work. Can I just say, that besides the obviously good coffee, the food is pretty scrumptious as well! I recently tried a piping hot tomato & mozzarella panini that was incredible, along with a satisfying piece of banana bread. My absolute favorite drink is a chai tea latte -milky ,creamy, sweet, with some spice. Yum. Pumpkin spice lattes are up there too :)
This Starbucks is a pretty good place to hang out & get some work done.  Upstairs seating area is comfy.

This location sometimes runs out of soy milk and bacon gouda sandwiches, but the employees are very friendly. They used to mess up my drink sometimes but they've gotten much better. It sort of depends on when you go, I guess.

Excellent, fast and friendly service every single time. They get my mocha light frap right every time I go. I only go on my pay day, otherwise I would have gone bankrupt by now. BUT it is a nice treat, and the price tag is easier to swallow when my frap is delivered with a smile :)

If you are using the drive through be prepared to wait in line for long time since this seems to be a very popular drive-through location.
And unfortunately this location has really bad and sloooooow service. 
I have been inside many times and 90% of the time had to just wait for someone to actually take my order. There are always employees walking around but dis-interested in actually taking an order. They only know what they do walking around. Since I have to wait to get my drink for a long time as well.
This location really needs to improve on the service.

My favorite Starbucks location in Reno. The baristas are friendly and my order is always correct. Easy to get through the drive-thru or inside. Always clean inside too. Nice seating for sitting with friends.

This Starbucks location is really cool.  Since they've been open,  the tall gentleman barista (don't know his name but he reminds me of David from QVC)  has been so nice and helpful in my indecisive choices lol.... Though this spot has little and tight parking spots, it's best you park across in the median area, and it gets really crowded at different times of the busy day. 
 Also the location is easy without having to drive deep into Metairie or downtown if you are near the Lakefront, N.O.East, or Mid City areas.

Incredibly slow service at 6am after not opening the doors promptly at opening time. It took almost 15 minutes to get drinks, with only 2 people before me in line. Also did not have basic items like bagels and  blonde roast coffee.

I went in to pick up some coffee for the morning, coarse ground for my Chemex. I picked my coffee, asked for it to be coarse ground for my Chemex. I'm okay with her not knowing what a Chemex is, but to give me the finest grind, the opposite of coarse, is pretty bad. Working in a coffee house, you should know the difference of different grinds. To top it off, she was minimally apologetic for her error and made it seem more like I was bothering her than she was keen on pleasing me, the customer.

Starbucks at this location is great. The staff is awesome, the drinks are great (cider and vanilla chi tea are my favorite) and the place is relaxing with a great hangout area with free wifi. The downside is that the parking lot is very small and a pain to get into. With GameStop next door, the lot seems always full but I ride a bike there so this isn't an issue for myself. Also the interselection is quite brutal between memorial highway and hillsborough ave. Also remember that Starbucks isn't the cheapest but in the end, it's better than anything Dunkin can produce.
Large and crowded.  Not much in the way of "outstanding".  Starbucks is becoming just "ok" now.  Honestly, give some locals a try.  I be the WiFi is just as good.
It's a beautiful day in paradise but a hot one familia. I have to take time and thank good and the person who invented air conditioning better known as "a/c"!

The absolute slowest service I've EVER experienced at a SB. Often times there is only one barista on a register, even when the line is snaked around their display. Other baristas are lazily moving about the store, or exiting from the rear room, and appear to be doing much of nothing. Having worked in customer service myself in the past, common customer service sense says, if as a barista you are available and see a line forming, hop on the secondary cash register and help minimize the line and wait. There appears to be no pep in their step or desire to consider their customer's time. Maybe they need more caffeine themselves. :-/ Or maybe management needs to reconsider how their resources are allocated, especially during peak hours. 

In all my years and travels about the various SB's, this is hands down the least efficient and customer conscious. :-( I've frequented many SB's that have 3 registers open at once (1 for the drive-thru, if applicable.) Get it together Big Bend SB!

Update: A week or so after I wrote and posted the above review, someone claiming to be an employee of this establishment angrily inboxed me via Yelp using profanity and spouting off offensive jargon. So not only are they unprofessional, but also defensive, and incapable of handling constrictive criticism. With despicable outreach such as this, I'm thankful to no longer live in the vicinity! I'd love nothing more than to update this review to zero stars.

I have always raved about this store. Today was a very SLOW day with drive thru...waited at least 25 minutes. I would've left but I was boxed in.  Not sure why the wait was so long! But I am writing this review while I wait in line. Please help this store....Terribly SLOW
literally so slow, you would think they would be a little faster with orders. i should not be waiting 30 minutes for a drink.

Their drive thru is super slow, even when I was the only car. I ordered, she made my drink, I payed, a few other cars came behind me and I sat in my car and stared at my drink on the counter for 5 minutes listening to this lady take orders from the other cars. I guess she couldn't multitask and just hand me my drink while taking orders. Oh well, at least she apologized for the wait lol.

The staff in this Starbucks is very nice. They smile and are always polite. My coffee is always the way I like it. It does get quite crowed but the staff handles it well and gets me out quickly. I love having this Starbucks in my neighborhood. Hannah, Nikki and Justin are doing a great job.
Easily the best SBUX in downtown Philly. Friendly, quick & clean. What else can you ask for. Tasha & Jarrett are the best.

I'm surprised that during a busy time there is only one cashier. The person before me had an item return and it took such a long time. No one said anything to me while I waited and waited. I come here a lot and just expected to be welcomed and not ignored. 

Today Austin made my day! He gave me lots of ideas on how to enhance my drink. Nice! I feel like an important customer and will be back soon. My cascara latte with an extra shot is perfect! Thanks Austin!

Nice location, a little hard to find with the GPS (their signage is flat against the building in a sea of businesses) and parking is only street with meters. Service is great, enjoyed my Peach Green Tea. It's also quiet, a little reserved. Nice find on our way to Philly.

While I was a little put off that on occasion the lines go bit longer than I felt they should, then I had occasion to sit down and complete some work I Hadn't finished. That moment gave me a chance to appreciate truly relaxed atmosphere, as well as the friendly hard-working staff! It has become my favorite spot to just sit and collect myself and enjoy a nice atmosphere.

I really enjoy Starbucks.  I enjoy stopping off at them from time to time to relax and clear my mind. Although, trying to find a parking space at this location is almost impossible sometimes.  With that is added stress which I don't need.  What's sad is the location is very convenient for me. I'll be craving a cup of Jo as I pass, look at the lot and decide to keep going.
These directions led us to a cow field, no word on whether his name is Starbucks, but he didn't have any coffee.

This place is your average Starbucks.  They make all the drinks and microwave all the treats.  It's conveniently located across the street from a Dunkin Donuts.  So, if the line is crazy, then just jerk the wheel across four lanes of traffic and your problem is solved.  

There is a drive-through if you're lazy and it moves slowly.  It does speed up the indoor process though.  That's nice.  Don't go on Friday.  It will take you 20 minutes to get through the line.  However, the rest of the time it's pleasant and very much a Starbucks.  You have the super busy corporate types as well as the trend setters that sit in the leather chairs in the corner (and also probably arrived at opening that morning).  There will also be a random newspaper strewn all over one of the tables.

The Good: I like coffee and they are good at making it.  They also understand how to use the Starbucks app and that is very helpful for those that use it.  I'm generally in and out quickly.  You can park in front of that stupid bank to the left too.  Screw them.  Don't be intimidated by their signs.

The Bad:  They consistently have a cap problem with the drinks.  If I get an iced drink that isn't made in a blender, then I DON'T WANT THAT STUPID DOME CAP!  I want the flat cap.  I feel like a special needs kid with that other one.
Always consistently good service; however, exceptionally friendly service at the drive-thru this morning, without being phony.  Great job!  Oh, and great coffee :)

Normally I have good experiences at any Starbucks but not today. I did not appreciate the Barista making a drink for someone who walked up to her, not even having to wait in the line to put in his order. I waited in line to put in my order and waited for my drink to be made. How do u let someone jump ahead of everyone else who did wait their turn. Unbelievable!!!

Always a line, but the service is great.  I'm there every morning for a to-go coffee and bagel.  How come they never remember my name or order yet they remember all of the other regular customers?  Am I that forgettable?  Regardless, I still stop by hoping that they'll remember my name.  Oh well.
Very nice Starbucks - lots of outdoor seating & the baristas have always been pleasant.  Drinks & food are consistent with Starbucks quality.

These baristas are the greatest. They make the best drinks always. They remember the customers, are wonderfully silly and welcoming at the drive-thru, and are very personable. It's always fun at this location.

Came to this Starbucks and I will definitely be coming back. I frequent Starbucks in different cities vet often. I love that they have a larger patio to sit outside, a drive thru, and a very convenient location to easily get in and out. Ample parking as well. The service could of been quicker on a not too busy Saturday mid-afternoon. But I didn't mind waiting a little bit longer. But my dog thoroughly enjoyed the Puppychino from the barista and meeting new customers that walked by. I will be coming back soon! Great experience here at his location

Had a great time hanging out there with a friend last night.
The place was busy but we were able to find a table and sit for a few hours and chat.

Staff were super pleasant, offered us goodies that they were trying to get rid of that expired soon. Seemed like a nice gesture. Staff also very polite when they came by to let us know that they were closing soon. 

Not a coffee drinker, but appreciated the space to hang out with a friend while she had a coffee. Would go back.

Well as Comcast did not yet connect Internet to my new Apt. I became Internet-Less person, it is harsh, unbelievable sad reality ! I never thought I can live 2 days without Internet, after long angry calls with Comcast, I started to analysis my situation, looking around me for wifi places I saw this Starbucks, I know other branches in the city but this one open late on Saturday. I went there with my laptop looking for Internet shelter after Comcast turn us to Internet homeless! With my laptop in my arms I entered the shop and I liked the design, yes it is Starbucks should all look the same but this one look more special to me, more detailed with good finishing touches. the Register was friendly and smiley  asked me what I want, I said caramel macchiato for me  and Internet for my "dog" oops my laptop, to my surprise she told me they have sitting upstairs devoted for Internet hungry laptops, yay! here i go, here i come, finally getting my Internet dose and enjoying my caramel macchiato. The place is clean, very quiet and to my surprise empty! Good privacy and no snoopy eyes into your laptop. I do not usually review brand names but this place definitely deserve every word i wrote it!
