worst. starbucks. ever.
you know it's slow when the employees so can't bear to wait in their own line they become aggressive toward their customers in front of them.

Pretty average Starbucks as far as service and food goes. Staff was relatively friendly and the location is great. Only wish the tables were bigger because the tight space isn't ideal for studying which is usually the reason I come to Starbucks.

This location makes my drinks right most of the time. 

Unfortunately getting in and out of the parking lot when busy is not the easiest.
It seems every time I go to this Starbucks they short me on my drink :( just like this morning, I ordered a venti but when I opened the lid it was the amount of a grande...

Very disappointed in the service provided today.  I was the only person in line and had to wait at least 10 minutes while the cashier talked to a friend that was getting off work.  Okay, finally took my order and I waited another 15-20 minutes to get my drink.  Extremely disappointed started to walk out and never come back.

I have never been to this Starbucks where they get my o e drink correct. I drink a vanilla sweet cream cold brew. I ordered just off the menu, nothing special and thus group of idiots can't do it right, NOT EVER.

Hit Reverse & go to the Starbucks in Target! 
This is practically impossible for a wheelchair to get through, due to the close high top tables
I usually go the Wrong direction & turn into the line there.
I think I've seen one chair by the fireplace empty, why are people camping out there?? 
If you order anything slightly off the menu, they don't handle it well?
The most miserable staff I ever encountered at a Starbucks. If you can't take the pressure. Work somewhere else.

To be fair, I'm not really a Starbucks fan. This is conveniently located near my house, but otherwise, it's really not convenient at all. The line in the mornings for drive-thru service and counter service are both absurd. It's probably not as bad in the afternoon/evenings, but I only "need" a $5 coffee first thing in the morning.

I would much rather drive down the street to J'aime Le Cafe. The options as far as flavor syrups may not be as extensive, but the wait is often much shorter and, IMO, the drinks are better. Plus, it's local.

So, why do I even go to Starbucks? For the most part, I don't. They really got me with this whole 1/2 price Frappuccino happy hour promotion this past week, though. I'll pay $2.50 for a grande frappuccino in the afternoon, and enjoy every sip. Sorry, though, once the promotion is over, so are my days of visiting Starbucks on a regular basis. I can't justify the wait time in the mornings to pay full price for a coffee.

This Starbucks is on my way to work but I'd rather go anywhere else. Takes absolutely forever and the staff will literally ignore you in line or at the drive thru, no acknowledgement that they even know you're there.

I've been coming to this location for 2 weeks.  Each time I come here the employees spend more time talking to each other rather than to customers.  Not friendly.  I'm here early in the morning right as they open yet it always looks dirty.  Doesn't seem like they clean at closing time and that milk and sugar area is always dirty. This morning the employee used the same towel to clean that area and the rest of the bar areas without rinsing the towel. Yuk.  Time to move on to another coffee shop,  one that isn't so popular where they have pride in their shops.  Starbucks you need to check your shops.
Love the coffee don't go to this location if you are in any hurry you'll be waiting awhile.

I love Starbucks. I love this Starbucks. Best part...the drive thru!! 9 times out of 10 I have the boys with me. I love that I can get my Starbucks on the go. The baristas are great. They are always super friendly. I have also enjoyed coffee inside on a couple occasions. There is plenty of room for everyone. It was very comfortable. My drinks always taste perfect!
Its good service overall. Heather is a great barista. It depends when you come and whose working too.
It's a typical Starscmucks. Nothing really outstanding or disappointing about this place. The area where you pick up your beverages is a bit squishy though.

This place hasn't been reviewed in ages. I've come here quite a bit and they are fabulous. Some Starbucks lack quick service and pleasantries. Not this one. The staff are stupid fast and very nice. 

The location itself is well maintained and has tons of seating to accommodate people watching, eavesdropping, networking, coffee breaks and working. This is one of my fave stops on the north side of yeg. 

The only issue you may find is parking. The lot can get really busy with the mall patrons. So be on the look out for DB parkers and clueless drivers. It gets hairy in this location.

Super friendly service and made great suggestions for drinks for my wife (who cannot have caffeine due to her pregnancy).  I go to a lot of Starbucks, and this one is a great example of customer service.

This Starbucks is extremely busy so expect to wait at 8am during the week. 

Which is unfortunate because I really love my coffee but I am habitually late to class!!

The staff has always been busy but it seems like they need more help!!
Leonard, our barista, was awesome! Great service, big seating area and clean restrooms. This has plenty of parking off of De La Vina.

Best to use the drive-thru. I've frequented this Starbucks since it was built, and over the years the focus moved from in-store customers to the drive-thru. This focus has led many employees to forget f-2-f service. It's too bad. They are nice people. The fish stinks from the head down and I wouldn't be surprised if the tone is set by the top dogs.

Okay I go here all the time because it is my closest location, however this Starbucks needs like a complete re-haul. It's disgusting. I don't really enjoy sitting there because every surface is worn down and sticky- the chairs, the tables, the window ledges. Everything. It is just beat and I don't know why Starbucks won't update it. They need all new furniture too the couches and chairs are gross and beat and peeling. I also feel like there is a huge staff turnover. I used to come in here and would see the same people now I just keep seeing more and more new faces. Their coffee is good yes, pricey, but that's a Starbucks problem not a location specific one. But it's good. This location is hit or miss with items in the case as well as how fast they sell out of drinks. Also don't ever go here on a Friday night unless you want to be a part of a pre-teen group hang.

Comfortable Star$$$ in the Acme Shopping Center just south of Bordentown off Route 130.  

Not a fan of their burnt approach to java, but sometimes it is the only option in the vicinity.  The Flat White was fine, but the prices are designed to make the stockholders happier than the customers.  

This shop was well laid out with ample table and comfortable seating around.  No problem with the staff.  Everyone was in a good mood this mid-week late morning.  Several quiet conversations and solitary students around and about.

I'm not going to lie.  I've been a regular patron (whenever I'm around) of this Starbucks since I started high school.  Yes, it's a chain but I still love my frappacino (venti java chip) and soy latte.  They have plenty of seating and outlets, along with wifi, and the baristas are very friendly.  A lot of regulars come here, along with students from nearby Villanova, Bryn Mawr, Rosemont, Cabrini, an Eastern, so if you're looking for motivation to work, then nothing beats seeing students in hoodies with their buried in books and computers screens, a cup filled with some caffeinated drink clutched in hand.  In terms of food (because you need some fat and sugar to make the caffeine work properly, or at least I do), I also love the mini iced donuts but it's so easy to eat all three in one sitting, so I alternate between getting those and a pack of Annie's.  They also keep their bakery display well-stocked, which is a plus in my book, because I hate it when I walk into a Starbucks with a craving for a cinnamon chip scone and have t settle for a blueberry muffin.  Those are the dire times that call for extra whipped cream on my frappacino.  

Oh, and if you have a Gold Card, you get free wifi!  Minus 1 star for the parking, though.  If you're not adept at backing out (aka me), park in the less treacherous back lot.  You'll thank me later.

Went in around 10 and had the worst service . Waited 30 minutes for an iced green tea . Watched workers laugh and talk while slowly making drinks . They should have called in more people if they were  short handed .

This is a refreshing change from the Starbucks in Safeway at 97 St. and 137 Ave. Overall a pretty nice place to work, but there are only two tables conducive to setting up a laptop and doing some work.

While there aren't many tables inside, if you like working outside on a patio, this Starbucks has one of the best I've seen.  They have five tables on a large patio and a couple of big umbrellas. The road next to it isn't that noisy and the neighbourhood is relatively quiet. A nice setting to work or relax in. 

I've been to this Starbucks a few times now and it's one of my favourites. Doesn't hurt that it's not too far from home.

Busyness - Early afternoon here means the traffic is slow and the store is pretty well empty, leaving a good choice of seats. The drive-thru seems to be pretty busy though.

Noisiness - The music, as in many Starbucks, is ever-present, but it's not an especially noisy place. Today the choice is latin music. I don't know whether to work or take a siesta. I'm sure on a hot day the blenders would be humming and really make the place noisy.

Ambience - I like the layout and colour scheme of this store. It's relaxing and if you like cool, the air conditioning setting is low here. It's like a refrigerator. 

Power - Plenty of choices for seating and outlets available.

Free wifi - It's available and works well.

Staff - Lots of friendly staff at this location.

Seating - There are 17 seats inside, with four comfortable armchairs available. There are only two tables inside that are worth using a laptop on. There are seven bar seats that you can set up your laptop at, if you like working that way.

Security - It seems to be a pretty good neighbourhood.

Been to this Starbucks lots. The drive thru is suspect, be patient and even though there seems to be no other cars around you may need to wait. Typically the coffees are good and the servers are friendly.

I used to spend a lot of money here. Worst experience today at this Starbucks at Hillsborough & Memorial in Tampa. They ground my coffee incorrectly, argued with me, and refused to correct it unless I bought something else. Blew my mind. They were incompetent, rude, condescending, disrespectful and greedy.

The best customer service ever!!! Ms.Debra, Marty, Kelly, and Greg are awesome!!! Everyone knows what I drink and it's ready at checkout! They always greet everyone with a smile and a pleasant greeting!!
Always clean, very friendly service and conveniently located. Every time I stopped in , the staff is fast and helpful. They also love pets in the drive through.

As I write this review I'm starting to get concerned about the amount of these stores I patronize locally.  Maybe I should cut back a little (and perhaps the caffeine is why I am writing this at 11:45PM?).

FIrst off, these guys are quicker than many of the other SBUXs in town. I love it. Secondly, they have a drive through which is a big plus.  It's great if you work in that center because you can pop off to your office.  However, if you are trying to get back on S. McCarran you need to make a tight u-turn to pull it off (or drive up to Lakeside).

One thing I'd like to mention.  There are several businesses over here and people conduct a lot of business at this SBUX.  It's not a place i would go to talk about confidential matters but you'll hear it all the time.  The seating area in the back is somewhat 'detached' from the front of the store so any conversations you have back there are louder.  Just a note.

It's summertime, yet the temperature inside this Starbucks is so cold that even in a sweater, long pants and coat, it's still completely freezing and uncomfortable. I asked if the temperature could be turned up a little, and to be fair, instead of nuclear winter, it now feels more like Alaska. I had to move outside to prevent hypothermia.

Normally very good service and I have been impressed many times. The service is normally spot on but today the lady that took my order was very abrupt and short. Maybe I caught her on a bad day or maybe she was just in the weeds but it doesn't. Take too long to smile and be a bit more personable.

I'm new to the area, but I travel often around the country and have never had an issue with my normal Starbucks order. Always tastes the same across the board. Except here. 3 times in a row my drink was made and it was gross. They are always SUPER slow. So taste your drink before you leave or drive off. They will probably have to make it again.

Not a huge fan of Starbucks in general, overpriced and sometimes bitter coffee. With that said, I do drop by for a coffee fix and lemon loaf from time to time. This location is close to me and the people are always very nice. Parking is good and traffic getting in and out it smooth.

Great service! It was fast and has a drive though. We ordered multiple drinks and food items and it was all correct! Way better than waiting in lines out the door at other locations as it is off the beaten path.
Great drinks and food. Awesome/ cozy place to come and get work done and even meet up with friends!

they playing games cuz. they ain't got the Beast Mode coffee deal created by Marshawn Lynch. I was so mad. I seen it while I was having sex and I stopped to go get it now they don't got it??? I'm very disappointed.
Great customer service. The drinks are always good. I'm Usually in an out the drive thru pretty fast besides during the peek hours. Will definitely go here again.
They are always super nice and fast with taking care of every guest! I prefer this Starbucks over any other one, even in the city.

Been there twice. First Time was 9 AM on a weekday so it was a little busy from the morning crowd took quite a while to get a coffee as I went inside. But again given that there was quite a few people there I could understand it.

I went in this last Saturday there were two people inside one person pulled into the drive up as I was walking into the store at 6:40 AM.  I place my order and watched nine more cars come up and get their coffee +6 people that are done Internet orders come in and get a coffee in by 7:02 I still had nothing.  The two people that were on duty were so busy I couldn't even get their attention to ask them where my coffee was. I did notice that they have a Clock timing the drive-through's and then make sure that the drive-throughs get their coffee but they really don't care about anybody that walks into the lobby it appears.  I finally gave up at 7:04 AM and just have them refund my money because I figured I could drive somewhere else and get a coffee faster than what they were doing.

Love the atmosphere at this one especially the upstairs which is rarely so crowded that you can't find some space. You can sit and get work done--plus people watch out the window in one of the best spots in the city.
Baristas at this one are pretty nice and some of the quicker ones in the city .
My one compliant is that there is NEVER toilet paper in the bathroom, but I think this is just a Starbucks "thang"
Girl at counter super nice about it but don't understand why no one stocks this regularly even when they are not busy.
I've gotten stuck without several times so I always check now lol!
I come here regularly due to location and staff. I have to sit outside because this is one of the coldest Starbucks ever. I get the corporate controls the AC but it gets ridiculous!
Clean, spacious and quiet. I wish this is just around the block where i live.. Theres also a patio to hangout and breathe the clean air of santa barbara.

Nice new Starbucks in the new outlet center!

Store was nice and clean! It's also very spacious. I'm here on a Tuesday and it's not so busy.

All the staff members seem to like their jobs. They all have positive attitudes and very upbeat.

It's like any other Starbucks. I'm pleased with its service each time I'm there. My go-to drinks are green tea fraps and vanilla ice latte. 

The place however is a bit messy. The tables are not wiped down and chairs are all over the place.
Always love to visit this location.  They are always so helpful and accommodating.  They never seems to disappoint.  This is probably my favorite Starbuck locations in Tucson!!!

The new starbucks all seem to be very "open concept" which is a little weird to me...  I would think they'd want more of a cozy ambiance, but instead they build large blocks.  But that's not the end of the world.  I'm just starting to think that Starbucks DOESN'T want me hanging out all day using their free wifi... sheesh... the nerve!

The coffee is what it is... nothing different from any other starbucks.  you either like it or you don't.  The people here don't make it any better or worse.  The people behind the counter could be a little friendlier, but hey... we're outside of philly... I'm not expecting southern hospitality.  

I L-O-V-E the tables that have outlets in them.  I might get one for my house.  Or office.  Or both.  

The bathrooms are probably my biggest complaint.  First off... they chose to designate the bathrooms (the old broomall sb didn't do so) which I find mildly annoying.  And the bathrooms are just single-person usage... so I've had to wait for a while when someone's been in the restroom for an overly long period of time.  I suppose the caffeine does have that effect on people...  and really... shouldn't that just be common sense?!?  A place that sells caffeinated beverages should design their restrooms to INCREASE waiting times.  Just saying... could lead to a disaster!

I haven't used the drive through.  From what I've heard, it can be hit or miss.
Solid Starbucks, nice staff.  About the same as every other well run Starbucks.  They do tend to run out of bagels quickly.
I will just say if going to this Starbucks location use mobile order and pay. It will save you a lot of aggravation.

Not doing to well. Maybe Starbucks should have some barista training. There's no cleanliness, no pride, and no hurry what so ever. But at least the product was made to my liking and Starbucks standards. Maybe have 3 on duty at all times or train them to care more.

Starbucks is one of my favorite places to go. Usually I go to the Smyrna location which is rarely a bad experience. I have tried the Mt Juliet location at least 5 or 6 times now and it's a bad every time.. so today I ordered a "venti caramel cloud macchiato"... 
she never told me my total.. and when I look over to my fiancé handing me my coffee I got a "tall plain caramel macchiato".. didn't get a receipt or anything. Not happy. I would have been more understanding if they were busy..but we were literally the only people there.

Its the closest starbucks but also one of the worst. Never get my order right. I asked for a grande Frappuccino, was charged for one, but got a tall. And the Frappuccino was completely melted. Only starbucks to give me a Frappuccino that was melted ever. Shouldve saved 8 dollars and just bought some coffee at the gas station.

Friendliest service I've ever received at a Starbucks- I was on a long, tiring trip from Texas to Ohio and I stopped by this place to charge my phone.  The barista at the register made sure to put a smile on my face and force a laugh or two, and everyone else seemed to chime in.  I felt like the baristas here were more interested in my life than I was!  I'll definitely remember this stop for future travels.

Coffee is typical Starbucks so there isn't much to say there. The problem is with the seating. The outside tables are usually taken up with people waiting for the bus and the 4 inside tables are occupied by 20 somethings doing homework for hours.
A unique Starbucks. An upstairs and superb people watching. We were on vacation staying at a hotel a few doors down and came here a few times. Really friendly staff.

Just came here recently couple days ago. Wow I am amazed at how fast they serve your drinks! The staff are also nice here and a friend of mine actually works at this location as well.Great teamwork here! Always clean and staff are prompt and ready to take customer orders of all the times I've visited here. Never had a problem with my order or the taste of my coffee!!

I Love this new location! The layout is great, the staff us friendly, and brisk with your order! The chairs and furniture is super comfy as well!
I tried the new Passion Fruit Iced Tea Lemonade (shaken) and it was the best thing I have ever drank! I am hooked on them now! I also love the Strawberry Creme Frappuchino! 

I also love the patio! It was so nice and warm outside, and it was awesome to sit outside, in the shade with my Lemonade, and visit with my friends!

 Also, this location has speakers outside, which plays very nice music, and leaves a nice background noise for customers to enjoy if they are outside sitting at the patio by themselves. The only suggestion I have for them, is to turn down the music a bit, in the cafe, it seems to be a little loud, and makes you have to talk above normal levels for your friends to be able to hear you.

I also must add in that starbucks recently changed 90% of their recipes to take out all artificial flavorings, and preservatives!!! Now their muffins come made with real FRESH berries, and instead of syrup flavorings in their fruit drinks, they now come made with fresh fruit juice! Very nice for people like me who are *trying* to cut back on refined foods, and junk! 

Overall, this is my favorite location, and I definentaly plan on coming back!

It's Starbuck's so you know what to expect. The staff are friendly and fast. This seems like a popular location as there is often a line mid-morning. It's comfortable to sit outside as there are lots of spots in the shade and they have fans too. One neat thing about this Starbuck's location is the Katrina water line painted on the outside of the shop.

Pretty standard Starbucks in a sleepy town shopping center. They do have a drive through which is nice. I also like their newer interior design with LED lights. 

As for the drinks.  The Chai Latte was a bit watery, though the Soy Latte was good.  So mixed results on the drinks themselves.

This is a good location and the folks here do a great job. I've been here when it's busy and when it's not. (Of course, it's difficult to greet and chat with every customer when the line is 15 deep and there are 10 cars in the drive-thru. I say this because I've read other reviews for this location where people were kvetching that they didn't get a back-rub when they walked in...) This location was recently remodeled. It's more open, seems more spacious, with more natural light and has a simpler layout. The new  furniture is not comfortable. It looks like somebody went crazy shopping at IKEA. Gone are the comfy chairs and couches. Doesn't all-powerful Starbucks  want customers to "hang out at Starbucks?"

This location is hit or miss. The morning staff seems to be pretty good, quick and know their stuff. The evening staff are rude, slow and unapologetic. I also believe this location is understaffed. The drinks are also hit or miss, never know if it's going to be made correctly. I can tell when they leave the cup of fresh espresso sitting too long because they get so busy in the evening and can't keep up. I highly recommend ordering ahead on the mobile app if you want your coffee within a timely manner....
Dirty, slow service, rude, and after waiting 15 mins for a frap, they got the order wrong.

I have a good friend who works downtown and when we want to get together for a quick coffee over his lunch break this has been our spot for about a year now. Unlike alot of places downtown it boasts a good sized free parking lot making it easy to get in and out of. Naturally however when you have a good location it draws a crowd and this one can get quite hectic especially in the mornings and at lunch time.

Seating is limited at this location (probably one of the smallest stand alone stores I have seen) which I don't think makes alot of sense for the amount of business they do. It's still a good location though,no matter how busy they get I have always gotten my drink quickly. Drinks are pretty standard no matter which Starbucks you go to and I have no issues with quality here. I come back here due to the warm personal attachment I get from being able to meet with a good friend however there are so many coffee shops downtown you wont miss out if you never make your way down to this one but there is no need to go running and screaming in the other direction either. Just your everyday run of the mill three star experience.

Yes, I hate to admit it but these baristas here- Sure know my order by now. Living from 1600 Walnut to S. Philly, I still come back every night to order my Paleo Version'd Coffee Black with a Stick of Butter. They get it right every time. Why wouldn't they? Many people look at me like I'm nuts but this Starbucks makes me feel at home. My location at best! Great workers, in fact I'm friends with a few now! Drinks expensive? No way. Same price as DD. I'm such a fan of this Starbucks!!

I like the location of this Starbucks, and it holds a lot of memories. Bf and I used to play the game of life on my iPhone after work here before we were dating. The staff are friendly and while it's usually pretty busy I find there are lots of places to sit. The neighbourhood is safe so there are no complaints from me on this location, there is even a decent amount of street parking and parking around back!

A downtown Franklin staple.  Get your coffee and relax with friends or walk to the theater, Sweet CeCe's for some frozen yogurt, or down to the square for shopping, or drive to the Factory.  On the first Friday night of each month, get your coffee and head out to see the Art Scene displays in a variety of venues around the downtown area--great night treat.

We all love Starbucks but this one has real issues.  There is ALWAYS a wait.  I am not a frappe or latte drinker.  Two days ago I waited in the drive through 26 minutes for a black coffee.  Since I live in the neighborhood and this is the ONLY location I go but they must work on their customer service.  A smart business person would realize that another coffee competitor would do well in this location. Especially with the hospital about to open.  Do better Starbucks!

If I could put zero stars I would. Normally I go to the Starbucks on 42 (almost everyday) and they have always had outstanding service. On the other hand, today my boyfriend and I were closer to this location, even though I've been to this one and didn't care for the service before, i decided to give it another shot. We go to the drive thru and I order my usual, a warmed butter croissant and a venti iced coffee with cream and sugar..  The croissant was Luke warm and the iced coffee was filled with no sugar. So I decide to go inside and have them correct the mistake. The gentlemen who took care of us at the window quickly approached me along with another young man who I assumed must've been the manager. I let
them know there was no sugar in my coffee, also the label said with milk so I questioned that as well.. Instead of saying sorry about that, let's make you a new one, I got nothing but a cocky attitude and excuses; again I thought nothing of it.. Then the guy that's remaking my coffee is done quickly hands me the drink and walks away.. I immediately notice that not only is my cup is completely filled with ice and the coffee is an inch away from the top.. I was so frustrated that I just walked out, knowing that I just spent $4 on ice.. Very disappointing.. Will never come here again, Two thumbs down for sure

There's a consistent taste at this Starbucks. It would do better with a drive thru, especially when there are parking restrictions in Haddonfield. I do like stopping here when I'm not busy. They've never screwed up my drink and the baristas are always caffeinated, happy, and friendly.

No one behind the counter for more than 5 minutes.
So, I went next door to panera.
Has Starbucks gone humanless already?
Not ready for that yet Starbucks :/

Though I usually avoid Starbucks in loyalty to my other fave coffeehouses, the sheer convenience of its close proximity to my office and its early morning hours make it tempting for me to stop in when I'm running supremely late to work.  Without this branch, I'd be just another super java-deprived grump at the office, givin' my coworkers hell.

In all honesty, this place does stand out from the rest.  Every other location should be modeled on the awesomeness of this store -- great placement on the corner of a gorgeous building in Old City, staffed by some super friendly folks with remarkable coffee-to-person matching skills, and a clean and well-decorated environment with local florist offerings at the windows.

Difficult to find parking at times, being Old City parking, but don't try to park illegally for even five minutes since the PPA is always on the take here.
Love Starbucks coffee. Can spend hours reading and doing my work on laptop. Free wifi..! And yes nothing like a great cup of coffee along with it..!

I find myself more critical of Starbucks, or national coffee chains than local.  So I need to be thoroughly impressed to give Starbucks five stars and I just wasn't on this visit.  There was an uncommonly long line and the drinks seemed to take longer than I come to expect at other locations.  A major plus to this location is that there is plenty of seating, a lot more than other locations, which is great, because Starbucks are always packed.  The noise level was proper as I was able to converse with my business contact with ease.  Again they didn't wow me like I require of Starbucks for five stars, but they did not disappoint, so I will continue to meet here and at other locations throughout our wonderful city!
Worst Starbucks in the world.  Cold sandwiches, Slow, dirty, rude and always mess ups.

I live and work around several Starbucks and although it may be slightly out of my way at the time, I will ALWAYS come to the Starbucks on 5520 Calgary Trail. Bren, the barista, is an absolute treat. I feel working at a coffee shop you need to be in a positive mood dealing with grumpy bears before their morning coffee and Bren really sets the bar.  He takes the time to get to know you and always calls me 'friend' which I find makes it more personal! Haha... 
My coffee is always done proper and in a timely manner. Not an overly busy coffee shop either so to sit down and get work done isn't much of an issue.

Excelent service  good caffe I will go here all the time
Now this will my my library 
And caffe of course

Thank you

Just one visit here, but the staff is not friendly at all. Most Sbux have reasonably friendly Baristas who make eye contact and smile. Not this location. The attitude is just, 'give me your order, get it, get out!". We found another location the following day with people that enjoy life!

Every time I come to this Starbucks they always screw my order up and the funny thing is I'm there daily. 

My boyfriend goes in as well but they happen to always give it to him for free.

I always order no whip somehow they always put whip. This last time they put soy milk and whip.
There employees need to start repeating orders to there customers.

Drive through is always busy around 7am-10pm so that could be why. I see it's a great place for meetings due to the business area

Same great coffee as every other Starbucks. The location is great, right smack dab in the middle of suburbia. They recently expanded the dining area which made it nearly double the size it originally was, which is awesome; however, there is still a horrible parking lot situation and drive thru. I often place my order on the app and like to run in and grab my drink off the counter (usually much faster than the drive thru) but the problem is there's never anywhere to park to run inside. It's a shame because I really like this location. The drive thru doesn't help either, it often wraps around the building through the parking lot, only to block more of the parking spaces. I think the solution is building another location on Hazel Dell, north of 146th St. if anyone from Starbucks Corp. wants to chat about exactly where I'd like them to build, let me know!

I stopped here and got a refreshing cold teavanna iced tea (peach citrus white tea) based on the recommendation of the staff member who was working here when we visited (part of the reason for the visit was that my companion needed to use the restroom). The beverage was really quite good -- better than I had imagined. It was a good choice for a hot day. I'm thankful for the beverage recommendation.

If I can give a zero I would the employees here were horrible. I am here for a work trip and the cashier named "Frida" and the barista "Steve" were extremely rude and mocked me. Never have I had such horrible customer service at Starbucks. I simply asked for a cool lime refresher with extra limes she kept going back and forth with me. Then later I hear her and Steve mocking me and laughing. Disgusting service!

I come here because it's the closest thing I got to my work place at the moment. It does the job, you know what to expect because it's Starbucks.  However, I don't think this is one of the better locations.  I mean, I've been to busier locations with fewer staff that move the drinks faster, and I'm taking into account the drive thru line too. The staff are generally very nice and accommodating, but not so much when they are busy, that leads to grouchiness and sometimes rudeness. This location has very nice indoor seating and the perk is a drive thru, but I go inside more often.

Downside, slow in delivering drinks, even when it's a downtime, and they've also gotten my drink wrong on several occasions.
many peaple just come use the wifi end didn't buy any thats crazy stupid.they ocuped nice seat n buy nothing .

I love the Pumpkin Spice Latte and it always comes out a week before my birthday! It is the Epidemy of fall! As soon as Pumpkin spice latte comes out you know fall is coming and the flavor is rich sweet and pumpkin! The thing about Starbucks' Pumpkin Spice latte that makes it so special is that they use real pumpkin in their latte. I have to say it's as good as it gets and at this location they are quick and accurate in getting you your order the way you want with a smile and friendly face to greet you! What more could you want!?

The slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. Always 10 cars in line and it takes a good 20 mins to get to the window. And once at the window, my drink still isn't ready. I use to work at Starbucks and making these drinks isn't a difficult task.
Love my Skinny Vanilla Latte.  Always have quick, friendly and accurate service. I also love the outside seating.  One of the better Starbucks locations.  The new decor is nice.

I come to this Starbucks a lot because of it's convenient location. However, it seems as though the service gets slower and slower every time. The baristas here would never survive at the on campus Starbucks at university's like FSU that I go to most often. 
They were out of the food I wanted but it was late afternoon so that is understandable. They got my drink right once it finally came out. Overall a pretty average Starbucks experience.

Ah, the USF Tampa Library Starbucks...

You can't complain about the coffee - since they stand by the Starbucks promise of remaking your beverage if it's not up to standard. The food is standard: your danishes, bars, and prepackaged salads/sandwiches (which are a lifesaver, but not without a price: I cringe each time I recall the time I stumbled desperately into this Starbucks looking for something to eat after a 7 hour study session and wound up spending ten dollars on a tea and a cheese sandwich. True story). 

Study-wise? Well, you can't go wrong - and here's why:

- It's in the library. If you can't get your stuff done at Starbucks, please, move to one of the numerous other rooms/floors in the library. 

- That said, if you want to snag a seat in the Starbucks seating area - you better get there when it opens (don't know the hours? Just click the site link and it'll take you to the calendar of hours for the month) or during an off-peak hour (typically after lunch, when people tend to take most their classes). Sunday is always an option - it is a tomb in there on Sundays.

- I recommend this spot if you're doing some reading for a lit class. Starbucks is a social spot, and the air is always abuzz with conversation. I found it is far easier to ignore it when you're reading a book or a short story for class. It is not so easy when you're doing math, or reading an article for a political science class.

- Wifi is free, but only for USF students/faculty/staff.

Most Starbucks are fairly standard since it's a chain but this is the one I seem to frequent the most. There's nothing about this Starbucks that makes it stand out aside from its location (right on the corner of Jasper and 109ave). In the summers they set out patio sets, which makes it a great place to just hang out, have a coffee/drink and just people watch or read. 

The menu is the same as any other Starbucks and they have the same products. The barristas have always been super friendly and willing to fix a drink if there is something wrong. I think the only thing I would change about this Starbucks is that I wish it was bigger and had more spaces inside to sit. Since its so central, it's usually busy and at peak times it's quite difficult to find somewhere to sit.

This Starbucks need more employees . They are short staffed and take forever to get a drink out. Also they don't make the drinks and they are. They taste burnt and nasty ! This is the worst Starbucks ever !! I hate coming here but it's the closest to my house ! Not happy at all .

I've been going to Starbucks for a long long time. I even went to the original in Seattle just because I could. Tonight, I found my ideal treat!

The store was mostly empty near closing time I suspect so we had a relaxed time chatting with the barista. My wonderful wife ordered a chili mocha with whipped cream. As I watched her make it, my my mind was thinking "Mmmmm. Whipped cream. Good. Must have some now."

Never being one to resist an impulse, I asked "Could I have a small cup of whipped cream?" She said, "Sure, you can order it any time! It's called a puppaccino!" 

I was kinda stunned having never heard this ersatz-Italian-word before. She explained, people order this for their puppy! Not really being a dog-person, I said "I'm going to call it a Daveaccino instead!"

Mmmmm
Whipped cream
Good

Who doesn't love coffee??? We visited today because it was the first day of the "holiday" seasonal drinks and I LOvE the peppermint mocha & couldn't wait to get my hands on one! Then, to my surprise they had free reusable holiday cups today! This location has a drive through and is right off of Eastlake road making it the perfect pit stop to get your energy fix. The drive through had a long line but, the coffee was totally worth the wait! 
The seasonal offerings provided by the baristas at Starbucks help to keep things new and exciting. Just when you think, how sad no more pumpkin spice lattes.... bam peppermint mochas and toasted whites chocolate lattes!! They also have delicious seasonal cookies with this amazing icing that my kids just can't get enough of!

I've frequented this place very often since it's opened. It's conveniently on my walk to work. Mostly good experiences but one barista by the name of Isaiah is literally the worst. 

Instance one- get to work and my latte has NO espresso in it. Just foam and warm milk. 

Instance two-get to work and my venti is half full and half full of whip cream even though I didn't ask for whip cream. Should have just ordered a grande and saved money? 

Instance three-order a venti chiller through the app with other items. 4 different other drinks. Send my employee to pick up the order. She gets back and my chiller is not there. I send her back to claim my item and she comes back with a small drink and NOT the order I placed on the app. Apparently they were out of the item I ordered and the barista was just going to not tell us and expect us not to notice the item was missing and then proceeds to give us a completely different item in smaller size. 
 
Should I even bother with going back ? Not likely

Everytime i come to this location, Staff are extremely rude. There is no courtesy. Its like a  like a bar.  the only sound I hear in this coffee shop are the employees constantly talking to each other. So loud! Nonstop loud talking amongst each other! Very unprofessional. 

I go to starbucks everyday and this is by far the worst experience. Had to post after several bad experience at the same store.

The drive thru takes an eternity to get through.  When I got to the counter to pay, I noted how long I had been waiting (just for a tea!).  The girl who was there said "it's happy hour, so it going to take a long time."  Does the manager not know that it's happy hour?  Can they bring in extra staff?  I should note that it was last day of a month of every day happy hours, so they should be prepared by now.  I usually get this attitude from anyone working at this location.  I don't go on a good day, it will ruin my mood.

A great place to grab a coffee on the go or whether you need to take a moment to relax and sit down. They have comfy chairs for group conversation as well as tables both indoors and out to sit at. They have a nice selection of coffees by the bag that you can take home as well as cups, mugs and teas. Now they have packaged snacks for your indulgences too! The staff is always great and willing to help and make your drink the exact way you want it! 

I especially like the versatility in Starbucks which really puts them ahead of the competition when it comes to Wawa or Dunkin Donuts and most other coffee companies. They can make just about any drink (with the exception of teas of course) caffeine free by making them cream based instead of coffee based. And actually I believe they have caffeine free teas as well...so virtually any drink can be made without caffeine. They are also friendly towards those who want the drink they love but at a "lighter" approach. They have light frappucino's which have less calories and still taste great! They are always introducing new seasonal flavors as well and I can't wait for September 1 when the bring out the Pumpkin Spice flavor! 

Another great thing about this particular Starbucks in Bordentown, NJ is that (shhh) but they make drinks from the "secret menu." So if you knew about Starbucks' secret menu and have always wanted to try one of their special drinks - now is your chance! I know not all the Starbucks participate in making drinks off the secret menu, but this one surely does and I can't wait to try the cream based Pumpkin Cheesecake Frappucino (of course making me wait until September 1 is the only downside) but that is more of a corporate decision unfortunately. Anyway, this Starbucks is great and I highly recommend stopping in to grab a drink whether it's a hot coffee during the winter or a cold yummy frappucino in the summer...or vice versa! Like I said, Starbucks has amazing versatility with their drinks - so you can have whatever you want how you want it! :)
Always get my drink right. Always with a smile. It makes my day when I get my tea in the morning from this place! It is a fave! Do recommend it highly!
Love this store. We often in warm weather ride our horses there for coffee in the afternoon!  Fun!  Staff and guests love the surprise guests!

Extraordinary slow. I counted 7 people working and only one person was making drinks. They were having a great time laughing and talking to each other while ignoring the customers in line. It took 15 minutes from the time I ordered for them to make a latte.
Quick, friendly baristas make your drink right and get you on your way. If you're drinking your coffee here, parking can be a beast.
The most convenient Starbucks on campus. You'll have to try to avoid the crowds though.

This Starbucks is a bit different from the others I have been to. The staff is super friendly and put forth an effort to learn your name and what you like quickly.  They are not 100% perfect but they do everything they can to make it right when they do make a mistake. 
   It's usually a quick visit, even during the busy times. The team works expeditiously to get all orders out.

THE WORST STARBUCKS I HAVE EVER BEEN TO AND I WORK FOR THE COMPANY!! The baristas are beyond slow and they're sassy with customers when they ask a question about a beverage. It takes forever to make one thing that takes under 10 seconds

This is my favorite Starbucks location in all of SJ and Philadelphia. Outdoor seating is a very enjoyable feature, and the interior is spacious and inviting. Have never experienced a bad barista here. There are two bathrooms with average cleanliness. Speed of drive through seems on par with other Starbucks.

I was looking for a comfortable spot to have a coffee and do some work on my computer, which meant I was looking specifically for a place with a lot of plugins as I have low battery power on the laptop.

As I was close to the new Starbucks on Calgary Trail, I decided to pop in.

The first impression was great as they were pumping their music to the outside seats, making for a lively parking lot! 

The space is fairly small though with a community table, a handful of smaller tables and six seats up at the bar by the window. It looks like all of the community seats, along with the bar seats have great access to not only power plugs but also USB portals! I definitely feel like I got the best seat in the house as I pulled up to the bar and plugged in my computer and phone at the same time. 

The staff were super pleasant and I can see why a lot of people would pop in here. It was 3/4 full when I got there around 3pm on a Sunday but by the time I left two hours later, I think there were only three or four of us there, making for a quiet space. Drive thru was constantly busy as it's in a great location.

I am completely addicted to Starbucks- especially since they launched their mobile ordering. My weekly purchases must have increased 200% as a result of mobile ordering. However - I've had the throw out 3 breakfast sandwiches in the past 3 weeks from this location. Although I indicate NO CHEESE on my mobile order - they sometimes do not remove the cheese. I am highly ALLERGIC to daily due to a serious medical condition (not just lactose intolerant - a true allergy). Disappointed that this location does not consider serious food allergies in their preparation.

Came here for the first time today and went through the drive thru, the wait was about 10 minutes after ordering, but this is not uncommon for any Starbucks location. I ordered two drinks, one came out perfect and the other was incorrect, but I was already home before I noticed and I was too far to go back.

I would ordinarily give less stars for this, but the staff at this location are SO FRIENDLY! Both baristas I spoke with seemed really happy as did the person who spoke to me from the drive thru speaker. The owners must be doing something right to have such happy people working for them, it's really nice to see workers enjoying what they do.

Nice Starbucks location- convenient to a lot of things (City Park, Hynes school, etc.) and has everything you expect in a standard Starbucks (consistent coffee, efficient baristas, quick service, etc.)

Things that stand out about this particular Starbucks:

- lots of covered outdoor seating! On a nice day, this is a BIG plus- the fact that the outdoor area is covered makes a huge difference, too- you can go out there when it's pouring rain or hot direct sun and still stay comfortable. There's indoor seating too, including a counter along the windows if you're there on your own and just need a place to sit for a few minutes.

- Convenient parking- there are a few spots directly in front of the front door, and the neighborhood has lots of parking if the little lot is already full.

- Free Wi-fi....this is pretty common at coffee shops in town, but it's nice to know that yes, the wireless access is free here.

Obviously, Starbucks isn't a particularly local experience, but sometimes you just want a coffee drink that tastes the exact same as yesterday...so Starbucks it is. 

A slight bit of local interest is the "Katrina line" painted along the wall all around the outside of the coffee shop- this gives you an indication of how high the water was during the flood, just in case you were wondering about how much water this area of town got (hint- a lot!)
I go to this location when I am in the 109 Street area. I wish it was a bit larger as it is difficult to find a place to sit when it is busy.

I want to point out that I am a coffee lover first and a loyal Starbucks customer.This Starbucks is one of the best around. They have employees that have been working there for years and treat you like family. Sandy, whom you can almost always find at the cash register always greets you with a smile, she is one of the most pleasant persons you could ever meet. Don't forget about the manager Isa, he always goes the extra mile for his customers. If Howard Schultz, the Starbucks founder stopped by this Starbucks location, even he would be impressed with the quality and service.

This is one of my favourite Starbucks in the city. It is also my most frequented since it is on my way to and from work. I stop here usually 2-3 times a week for a snack or great coffee. I only usually go through the drive thru but the staff is really good at taking accurate and quick orders. The wait time is very minimal most of the time. 

The staff are really friendly and I have yet to have a bad drink here. The prices and selection is the standard Starbucks selection. On the inside they have a "Bar" seating area by the windows so you can look out at the Calgary Trail traffic. There is a large community table with power outlets for electronics and they have free wifi which is nice. The store isn't usually super busy but it depends on the time of day you go. 

In the summer time they have tables and chairs outside on their small patio area so customers can enjoy the weather. 

They also have a twitter account and usually tweet about specials or sales going on in the store which I think is a great way to reach out to their customers. 

I am a Starbucks addict and I will be back again. Probably after I finish this review.
They've always gotten my order right, but for a Starbucks they're a little slow. Their staff all seem to be nice though. No real complaints :)

Enjoying a sbux iced "reserve" blend - Dragon, I believe. Super dark, plenty robust.....apparently this new "line" is only available at certain locations (I work in Wayne, PA, and they informed me there was none in that area that carried the Reserve line. Tastes like REAL coffee!!!!

Seriously worst Starbucks experience so far. Ordered a pour over, the male cashier didn't have proper change, 3 other employees just standing there... I asked if someone else could start the pour over while he saw to the change. I was given just a regular coffee being told it was a blonde... this is ten minutes in. Then I have to wait for 1/2 and 1/2. 15 minutes in no change yet OLD COFFEE THAT turned grey when adding the cream. My son comes in to look for me because It has been so long. I tell them the coffee is old, I get told it's not, bologna, smelled old, looked old... none of them looked like they were going to do anything but let me leave with old coffee, I asked for the originals nail order of a pour over... but from how slow it had already been and how long it had already taken I asked for my money back. Girls leaning against the register... waiting for change for ten minutes! Manager aloof and childishly laughing about it with employees. 
Not good Starbucks! No wonder at all why this is rated a TWO!!!

Renovation is a positive , my only negative is that there is always a long line during peak times and there is no urgency of the team that people have things to do. Moving at a glacial pace. I've been to many SB in NYC and Phila and they run like a German train. Not sure what the issue is ?

Always friendly staff. A few of the baristas have been here as long as I have lived here which is now 5.5 years!
Love the drive-thru!

consistently the slowest service and lackadaisical staff of any starbucks. even when a line of 5-8 people are present they did not open a second register. strangely  there were at least 5 people behind the counter

They are always busy. Most of the time you don't wait but sometimes they can be VERY slow. The drive through is kinda behind the building. One time I left my purse at home but they insisted giving me the coffee without paying which was very nice of them.

My drink was made slightly different by my own mistake and the staff gladly remade it just by recognizing my facial expression when I received what I ordered. I offered to re pay for the new one and they said no let's make it what you want. Thank you for being kind.

Your typical Starbucks in regards to the quality of food, drinks, and decoration, though I would say above average in cleanliness.  However, the staff are generally rude and unfriendly when it comes to the overall service. The only reason I do go to this location is because it is the only really close one this far south, otherwise, I would avoid it.

Also, as per the other reviewer comments, the drive through is indeed ridiculously slow, even when there are few or even no cars in front of you.

Bottom line, if you aren't in any particular rush, or don't care about the quality of service, then a this is just that, a place to get your average Starbucks food and drink fix, but leave possibly worse off for the experience.

Very convenient location in Town & Country, so this place gets very busy since early morning. Nice interior remodeling, new look but not so comfortable furniture, who knows why..? Some staff members are lacking basic knowledge about standard gift card activation procedures, with an attitude against customer, as it happened in my case. The good part is that there are so many other stores to go to get the gift cards. No big deal.

The staff here is super chill. It gets a little snug in here when it's busy which can be overwhelming, but besides that I've never had a problem. 

I also like Starbucks because they carry a few GLUTEN FREE snacks like blueberry granola (yum!) and some other things. It's a little pricey, but worth it every once in awhile.

Terribly slow service. They had 2 people working. I got there around 9:20 am on a Saturday and didn't get to order my drink until 9:35. I have no clue why there was so little staff in a cafe in a heavily populated area on a Saturday morning.

I'm a Starbucks fan, I just am.

This one of all of them near the Franklin area, is the worst.
They always have not enough people working and the service is so slow.
Unfortunately this one is most convenient and the drive thru, who doesn't love the drive thru.

Only a couple times that I've been here have the staff been friendly or helpful, usually I have to check for a pulse.

Of all the locations nearby this one the iced coffee & espresso shots taste the most burnt, which is annoying.

It's also LOUD. I came once to get some work done, and the speakers were SO LOUD I had to leave. Maybe that's the goal?? Plus the internet is real choppy here.

Not my fave...

First impression was that it is has a unique layout, and it a pretty good size for a downtown location. There was plenty of seating, and we were able to get a table right away. Impacts on the experience were the spotty wifi; poor acoustics - the ambient noise was more overbearing than in most locations, conversation really travels here; and lastly, though it is a matter of opinion, it was pretty cold as well.

I like coming here at night, working on my computer and unwinding with a drink. Staff is always friendly and makes good drinks. 

It is small. There are never enough outlets at any Starbucks. 

Despite that, this is one of my favorite locations.

I've been here on a work trip. Walked over every morning. The staff are so slow. Jasmine was excellent. She was running bar and register while all her other co-workers stood around and ate a bagel. Now her 3 co-workers have gone to the back. Jasmine was very nice and remained calm throughout the rush. As a former shift supervisor for Starbucks, it's sad to see this kind of behavior. If it weren't for Jasmine I would give this Starbucks a 1 star.

I disagree whole heartedly with Leanna. The workers in this Starbucks are hired BY Starbucks. So they are Starbucks quality... Not mall quality. They are always fast and efficient, and if they make a mistake on my drink which has happened once or twice they always fix it with a smile. You guys rock!

Least favorite Sbux. The staff looks at me like I'm crazy/dirty/cheap when I ask for a refill on my iced coffee. I never know if they will be charging me for the cream in my americano. I no longer order bar drinks here because it totally depends who is making them. My order is right half the time I go thru the drive up window. I'm ignored for a few mins at the counter when I walk in b/c everyone is focused on the drive up. Yup. I think that's about it.

Before I asked for non fat frappuccino and no whip but they put whip cream on it and then they restarted it but ended up giving me light frappuccino which had the light syrup and tasted really bad I just threw it away. 
Today I asked for non fat latte with no whip the same barista added whip and when I told him I don't want whip he did not do the latte again just scooped some of the whip off the top. When I asked him are you sure this has no whip cream in it he said it is a drink that has a lot of chocolate in it and a lot of fat in it but I assure you it does not have whip cream in it. I know what I'm doing and I calculate the calories of chocolate and everything else. Wow lots of attitude for so much money put into a cup of coffee.

This is literally the worst Starbucks drive thru ever.  I travel all over the nation and this is the slowest.  I have been here at every time of the day and the wait is ridiculous. I'm not talking about 5 min wait...I am talking about 20 min waits.   For example I have been waiting for 10 min already still haven't ordered and its 6:45am.   It only gets worst from here.

I walked to an empty counter: no biggie as 2 employees were standing by, one sweeping, one just standing there. They then argued for over a minute whose job it was to take the order. One said that "Megan" told her to only do something. They talked on their headphones to someone in the back to ask for assistance. The one doing nothing finally walked over and took my order. Then a guy walked out from the back and they continued to discuss whose job it was. Then Megan walked out, and they started talking with her. In the meantime, noone is working on my order. During my wait, I bryshed an annoying fly away a few times and noticed how messy the counters - restaurant and kitchen side - looked. Very disappointing.

Every time I go in here, generally when I have errands in the area, I have consistently been treated rude by the barista. Also they have a bad tenancy to mess up my drink. Most recently I went in and asked for a passion tea lem...because thats all the girl let me get out before snapping that they were out of lemonade. I ordered a passion tea with raspberry sweetener instead. I watched one barista make it and she completely skipped the sweetener. When I asked if she could put some in she rolled her eyes, grabbed my cup and put a few pumps in then set on the counter rather hard without saying a word.I'll have to start making the drive to keystone to avoid the attitude and death stares.

I stopped here with the intention of getting in a little reading before I headed home. And although the people that worked there were friendly, and my drink was made correctly, the drink station was dirty, and trash was spilling out of it. The sugar packets seemed like they had been wadded up and shoved in the container. They were completely out of vanilla powder, and there were no chocolate powder or nutmeg bottles at all, just cinnamon. And for some reason, for a Tuesday afternoon, it was sooooo super crowded that the introvert in me didn't want to have to sit that close to strangers. Unfortunately, late December doesn't usually lend itself to sitting outside. So, I was mildly displeased with my experience.
Great service at this location and they always get my order correct despite the large surplus of customers this location seems to have.
Absolutely the worst starbucks. Service is ridiculously slow. Don't come here in a rush!!

Ordered a frap with coconut milk no whip! They put whip. When they re did it they took it around the corner and took the whip off. I trashed it. Unacceptable if you have a dairy allergy. I will go to another location for now on.

I really like the Starbucks. I am in there every single day seven days a week. They are always polite and the one time they got my drink wrong the manager gave me a free voucher for a drink next time I came in. The only thing I will say is there is not enough parking there's always a long line in the drive-through and sometimes you can't even find a place to park.

I'm writing this review while sitting in a line that hasn't moved in 8-10 minutes. I'll give them one thing, they're consistent..consistently slow. The workers are always very nice and drinks orders are correct. They are just not efficient which is resulting in many unhappy customers. Block off 30 mins if you plan to grab a drink from this Starbucks.
Ordered a smoothie and then waited 10 minutes for them to make it and then they informed me they ran out of materials to make it. Poor service

Hard to say bad things to starbucks (i mean all coffee should be same throughout all location) but they're just realllllly slow. VERY SLOW. Drive thru is always backed up and takes abt 20 min to get through even at slowest part of the day- i don't know why but they're really slow.

What can you say about another Starbucks? This one is a popular joint for the Lakeview crowd even though NOLA Beans is just a few doors down.  The locals seem to like this place for its coffee and outdoor seating. If it gets too crowded, just try NOLA Beans... or just go ahead and try NOLA Beans first.

This Starbucks brings me back to the old school days. Me and hubby used to come to this location all the time. Our all time favorite is the White Chocolate Mocha. We used to sip on that and chat upstairs at their lounge section very often. This is probably my favorite Starbucks since it brung me so much memories.

Since is my favorite, why 3 stars???? I've been checking in quite a bit lately. Their drinks are either hit or miss. For example, I've been getting the Matcha Green Tea Latte. Sometimes the drink is just right but other times, the barista probably didn't shake it enough...... resulting in "chunks" of powder at the bottom of the cup. Sometimes the whipped cream looks so nice while others "cheap/stingy" looking.
Very friendly staff and the drink quality is up to par as opposed to other locations. The wifi speed and range were better than other locations that I have been to.

This is seriously the Best STARBUCKS Ever!! I have frequented this location for over 10 years and have not one single time left unhappy. After a few months of being out of town visiting other locations, never so happy to be back to the best STARBUCKS on Earth! FAST, Super Friendly, Exceptional Drinks & Food .. Totally LEGIT.
They have google fiber - gotta love the internet speed here. Good table space too for those looking to study with a laptop & book(s).

This is the worst Starbucks I've ever been to.  The girl working there tonight at 8pm on 8/14/17 was so lazy and slow!!  She didn't feel like doing a pour over so she served me coffee out of a coffee urn that wasn't even turned on.  I tasted it and it was room temp.  I've never experienced that at a Starbucks.  I returned it and she did make a pour over.  It only took her 15 minutes to figure out how to make it.  Come on Starbucks.  Your customers expect better.  Your employee was way more interested in talking with her coworker than doing her job.

I'm a Starbucks fiend. I go at least once daily. I have my regular, and visit many others on my trips. 

This one was no different than any other, and I have no complaints. 

Five stars in my book!

Old City Starbucks is my go-to Starbucks.  This spot just got renovated so the design is new and much easier to maneuver around in.  There isn't much of a seating area here though, and finding a seat throughout the busy times usually doesn't happen.  
This place can get busy due to it's location, and sometimes the staff isn't the quickest.  Most of the time there is a line, but it doesn't take too long to make your way through.  Pick a different spot if you're in a rush and there is a line.  This Starbucks moves at tourist speed.
I've consistently received wonderful service at this Starbucks. The lines are crazy long, but they deliver quality drinks each time!

Cute location not far from WestShore Mall.  Parking lot is not the best and it is limited on decent parking and crazy when too many people trying to find a spot.  Location is medium sized and had a nice look to it.  Grab the comfortable chairs if you can.

This is typical of any starbucks where you are going to find the same drinks and delicacies.  The staff was really nice and fun to talk to.  Normally I do not get a horrid barista in a Starbucks.  I would suggest this being a good spot if you are in the WestShore area and need a little break and some coffee.  If you are a college student and need to come here to study or write a paper.  Get here as soon as possibly to get an outlet and a good space.

This place is dirty and needs to be cleaned more often. In addition, they say they didn't accept the "happy hour" promotion. As a frequent Starbucks customer this did not sit well pulling over on the highway to take advantage. Will never come back.

This is one of my favorite Starbucks in Reno. I like Starbucks because of the consistency. I work from home and head out for coffee at least once a day so I can have a break for about an hour. 

If I am going for a great coffee experience, this won't be the place. If I am going somewhere in order to check email, have a clean place to work, know that the internet connection is up and working, I'll come here. Starbucks is amazingly average but is always average. Sometimes, that's a good thing.

After waiting several minutes to even be acknowledged, Polly tried to charge me double for a tea without ice "because it's like getting two drinks." $7.50-something is what she tried to charge me, but in the app with mobile order it's $3.22. I might have laughed in surprise, explained that I know that's not how that works since I'm a partner at a corporate store, and told her there was no way I was paying for that and walked out. Extremely disappointed and will not be returning. I also will be telling anyone who asks not to go there and to go to a real corporate Starbucks, not this licensed store. This isn't the first time I've received as service here, but this is the first time it was so bad I walked out empty handed.

We love the staff here and they will take time to help you. They make the drinks perfectly. My son wanted a S'mores steamer and they had no issues making him his special drink. We drive 35 minutes to get there, but it's totally worth it than the one closer to our house.
One of my fave locations. Always available parking, the baristas are awesome, and this one is perfect to come to and get some work done or meet up with a friend.

I am coffee-hollic and honestly for sometime, I was unable to find the same quantity of coffee, which Starbucks provided years back.

Mostly the shot were not pulling right in most machines from one location to another and no one cared to calibrate the same.

And then I visited this cafe and the service and the quality of coffee took me years back to that same quality I was longing for.

Best baristas are found here - if you have had a hard time finding the same taste and quality of coffee that Starbucks once provide a few years back.

This is it. Look no further.

Located at the corner of 232 and 132.  Access from either street.  Convenient location.

Great service! Jeff attended to me and was quick and even offered his extensive knowledge

By far my favorite Starbucks location! The staff are always friendly, and my order is never wrong. I am a Starbucks addict and have a quad venti toffee nut soy latte every day at my local store in Ardmore. But when I am in center city on Saturdays to drop off my daughter at ballet, I get my fix at this Walnut Street location with my toddler before we head to the Barnes & Noble. I've probably been to this location thirty times, at least. 

It has never been a favorite location, given that it's often difficult to find parking (no fault of Starbucks, of course), but mostly because it's just kinda gross inside, and the seating is really awkward. Over the past year or so, they've played around with the seating arrangement (and lamentably got rid of two chaise lounges), but there doesn't seem to be a permanent way to arrange the tables so that people aren't blasted with cold air every time one of the two doors is opened. But, even the odd seating and grody interior aren't enough to turn me off from returning. My visit last week, however, may have been:

I ordered my drink and went to find a table with my toddler. A few minutes later I returned to the waiting area and saw what I thought might be my drink, but the woman who was in line after me had ordered several drinks, and she picked it up and added it to her collection. Then the barista called out some drink that wasn't mine, and the woman realized she had taken the wrong drink--mine--and apologized. Since she had already added sugar to the drink, she couldn't just give it me. Instead of the barista apologizing for the mix up, he mumbled "That's why you shouldn't walk away." Yes, he was talking to me, but he wasn't talking to me. He was bitching about me. If I hadn't had my toddler with me, I would have let him have it. But I held my tongue, and he he sighed as he started to remake my drink. As I watched him, I noticed that he made it with nonfat milk, not soy as I had ordered. But I didn't say anything because I didn't want to be presumptive; maybe he was making someone else's drink. But then he finished the drink and handed it to me, and I asked, "I'm sorry, does this have soy?" "No, I didn't think it had soy" he said. Yes, sorry, it does. Yup, he had to remake it AGAIN. And was he once remiss, apologetic or sorry? No, he was annoyed. I'm usually the first to give people credit when it's due, but this was probably the WORST barista I'd ever encountered. Not because he was incompetent, but because he was a jerk. Even if I had been a high-maintenance, hard-to-please, wrong customer, he should have put on a happy face, apologized for mixing up the drinks the first time, then apologized again for making my drink wrong the second time. And, he should have given me a free drink coupon. By the time I finally got my correct drink, it had been 20 minutes since I had ordered.  In most other Starbucks stores, the barista would have profusely apologized (and offered me a coupon). But nope, only in center city is Starbucks' customer service nonexistent.

Starbucks does a few things right. 

Where this location is concerned: 

The company identified the best location available on a busy thoroughfare (S. McCarran), then made a very well designed drive-thru that is pleasantly landscaped. In addition to all this, Starbucks has a pretty and pleasant outdoor seating area that you can see when approaching the drive-thru. From your car, it's the equivalent of looking at a nice painting of a picturesque Seaside landscape. You aren't exactly going there, but you can imagine yourself being there, and it takes you to a happy place in your head. 

Bearing these things in mind, more often than I care to admit, this Starbucks beckons and I respond by driving through and giving them my $3-$4. 

That's what I call good marketing. 

My nonfat Chai Tea latte was perfection. It was cinnamony, with a generous dollop of clove, nutmeg and the other pumpkin pie spices that make it such a good treat. I love that the barista adds the splendas for me so that I don't end up wearing it on myself. I also appreciate the relative speed with which this drive-thru moves customers along. 

Another plus for this Starbucks, they actually fill your drink right to the top of the cup (no cheating you out of that last 1/2 inch you paid through the nose for). Therefore, if you yank your drink towards yourself (as I did), you'll be wearing a nice splash of whatever jumps out at you through the little drinking-hole in the lid.

It's a Starbucks.

I'm a "local first" kind of guy. If possible, locally owned and operated businesses is where I go first, assuming they offer a good product, have good service, and aren't a haven for the nefarious or cockroaches. That isn't to say I totally avoid chain establishments, as the individuals that work there are local, and depend on some of us to patronize their business so they can earn a living.

This is my neighborhood Starbucks. Now that the Dry River Company doesn't open until 11 am, Coffee Xchange is a bit far away on most mornings, and that I'm not a big fan of Caffe Nation at Broadway and Pantano, this is the closest place to get a coffee drink to my apartment if I'm pressed for time. While they can be quite busy in the morning, the wait generally isn't very long, the staff is friendly, the pastry shelves are stocked, and there is ample seating. Parking can be a bit tight around the morning rush. They recently extended their hours to 11 pm on most nights, 11:30 pm on Fridays and Saturdays. They have a great outdoor seating area.

There's a reason why chains like Starbucks thrive, and why most of us "local first" patronize them from time to time. They offer convenience, consistency of product and service, and less risk when you don't know anything about other choices. I give them four stars when comparing them against other Starbucks, but this doesn't mean that they necessarily rate as good or better than local choices. Starbucks versus locals is kind of like apples and oranges. The locals don't have the R&D and product development, the funding to weather economic storms as well, or access to prime locations. They make up for that in uniqueness, innovation and charm. This is a good Starbucks, but I'd rather go local first.

Great Starbucks location. Very close to downtown Santa Barbara yet easy to get in and out of anytime of the day or night. I have always received great service and drinks here. The interior is spacious and there's usually plenty of parking.
Staff is slow, disengaged, and rude. Not a one time thing. I'll go a little farther to another store or another location for coffee.

This is probably the Starbucks location I've visited the most frequently. Service here is rather consistent, which I love. Although it's a very busy location, meaning that some food items are sold out if one visits late in the day, it consistently performs when it comes to beverage options and definitely provides a quick caffeine fix for those who need it. As a tea drinker, I've been reasonably happy with the chai offerings (though I prefer the Oprah Chai Tea Latte cold, and the regular one hot). The spinach and feta breakfast wrap is one of my favourite food options! 

The patio is rather small but great for people watching and certainly for watching the street. The indoor seating area is usually good and one can often find a seat. The wifi is occasionally difficult to access consistently but is available if one needs it.

While they focus on getting the cars through the drive-through in a timely manner, they lose focus on what a five dollar cup of coffee should be. I gave them two tries and I got quite possibly the two worst cups of coffee I've ever had. A call to the store with my frustration was met by a very young and sharpie voice telling me to come back and let them remake my cup of coffee. Doesn't that defeat the purpose? The bottom line isif you're looking for a good cup of Starbucks coffee and have a few extra moments make the drive to Winthrop.

As a true regular at this Starbucks location is amazes me the lack of consistency and service on the weekends.
During the week the service is impeccable.
The weekends are another story all together.
Long waits with one vehicle in front of you.....inconsistent service and product..... 
a Venti iced latte can be so white and milky one time and dark as the night the next.
Service is so inconsistent you can't believe it is the same location you frequent during the week..........

I think management needs to take a serious look at how this location operates over the weekends ......
Soooooo slow, over priced, undermanned, and chaotic environment inside.  Poor parking, minimal seating, and odd location.

This is my favourite SB location! There's not really too much to say here, it's a pretty consistent place. 

I recently spilled my entire drink (my own fault) and they immediately replace it at no cost! That really made me smile! 

They also always remind me to keep my receipt for my "treat receipt" in the afternoon. I'm here a lot... What can I say?

My love affair with Starbucks began in college, when a budgeted weekend-only soy latte remedied any hangover, amped me up, and helped forge my way to a 4.0. Now, 5 years later, my latte love-turned-lifeline has spiraled and my discretionary income takes a hit more mornings than not. There's something very special about a beverage that is a symbol for industriousness and also the reason why I hike out in two feet of snow, in freezing weather, sometimes with the flu, to get a beloved boisson. 

As an aside, this location is the best S-Bux ever! The team always manage to exceed my expectations.

Filthy! I would rarely leave a negative review , but this place looks like it hasn't been cleaned in months. The floors look absolutely disgusting, everywhere ! Dust and hair balls built up under tables. The scum and junk has built up on the the floor edges. I have never in my life seen a Starbucks in this state, I was shocked honestly. I asked for the manager. He said 'I've been gone a few days , yeah , I noticed it too.'. 

No way this got like this in days , you can tell it's just the way this store is run. Badly.
