Super nice people, always get my order right and they're fast as hell in the morning. Totally my preferred 'bucks!
can someone tell me why would you change trash cans while there is a line out the door?? and aren't refill suppose to get new cups?? infectious control!!!
This is my go to study place. Everyone here is very nice and the location is close to my house so its very convienent I cant live without my coffee!
This location is busy so be prepare to wait 10 minutes. I wished this cafe hired alittle more baristas. I always see the same 2 baristas covering all the tasks.
This place sucks. Go to Nono's or zen den or the other place up the street.

This location is always fast and efficient. Everyone's really nice and they rarely ever run out of ingredients. I come here almost every morning before work and love seeing familiar faces. They know my order now and take good care of me every time!

Every time I have gone to this Starbucks I have nothing but great service today DJ took my order he was charismatic funny and just straight up awesome. He even tried to upsell with an extra shot him since he was so nice I almost took it but I don't like my coffee too strong so I turned it down. A couple weeks ago I ordered a tall and got a venti I told them it was wrong and they gave it to me free of charge. Another time I wanted a plain bagel and they ran out and I was able to chose something else that cost most. I feel like these people put the customer first every time.

Rude and bad service. 
Left my drink on the table and never called out my name. Even when I stood in front of the girl she continued to ignore and failed to mention my drink was waiting. 
I hated spending a single cent at *$ but got a gift card to burn. 
Would not go back to this store.

GREAT GREAT GREAT !!!!

Im very picky about starbucks i used to be a starbucks barista 
and this location rocks always friendly always the correct drink ( or fixed right away ) they really show what most starbucks used to be and now this kind of quality is few and far between.

I still love coming to this Starbucks because it is near my job. It tends to get busy and slammed by tourist because it is located in Old City. The staff has gone through some new faces but they are all wonderful and friendly. 

I love the new color and style, very warm and welcoming. Great product placement to capture your attention reminding you to pick up another bag of beans or another cute/fun mug that you really don't have a place in your cupboard for but oh well you buy it anyway.
Recommend a salted caramel mocha andIt is always very very clean bathrooms the very nice and I recommend this place I love this I love Starbucks

Quiet little starbucks, which is usually not the case in most Starbucks. The two baristas here are very nice and attentive. Got my cafe americano, and it's pretty good. What more can I say? Good service here.

Employee friendliness was great and all but when I see THREE people get their drinks even though I ordered before them, then I ask where my drink is. Fourth person gets their drink and I don't have my drink. Not Cool Beans! Fifth person that ordered after me gets their drink.... oh now sixth. How unfortunate I had to be somewhere soon. Disappointing service today especially when I spend about $15.

There is nothing wrong with the coffee, but the attitude that was displayed today was not very friendly.  I stop here now and again and everyone tends to be pleasant.  I made a mistake on my order...it was my fault and I was apologetic for my mistake, and the order was caught before the drinks were made.  The girl who was making them gave me an eye roll and a snide remark.  When she paced over the drinks I said sorry again and I got an unpleasant "whatever" in return.  Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, like messing up while ordering and I am going to take it that she messed up with the attitude.

I ordered an iced green tea and told them that I didn't want that much ice. My order came out fast but when I took a sip, it was sweet with syrup. I didn't even know sweetened green tea was on the menu at Starbucks. I guess the barista thought "light ice" meant light on the syrup. I told them I wanted unsweetened with little ice and they were happy to make me a new one. My replacement iced tea came out frothy (which I didn't even think was possible for tea) and it was only 2/3 full due to the froth. I took two sips and I reached the bottom of my cup.

I placed my order online, paid, showed up to the store and the doors were locked with no one inside. I never recieved my coffee or a refund. It was almost an hour past the time they were supposed to open.  I always do mobile orders at this store because I'm constantly waiting past the wait time even when I place the order before I leave my house. I won't be going to this starbucks again. I wish there was another coffee shop in the area.

8:30 at night and you ask for a decaf coffee and they're not Brewing it and act like it's something foreign that you're asking for... Decaf coffee is what people drink at night so that they can sleep but still also have coffee not sure how many people are drinking decaf coffee in the morning to keep them sleeping when I go to work just a really weird way to operate. Off to Dunkin Donuts I guess...

If you put a mobile order in here I would just suggest checking in with the barista where you would normally place your order, which defeats the purpose of mobile ordering. Waited patiently for my mobile order for 15 minutes. I had placed the order while sitting in my car in the parking lot and went right in, never heard anyone call my name. Went to the pick up area stood there for 10 min to let them know I was there to pick up my mobile order, was not acknowledged by anyone. Checked my app to make sure purchase went through, sure enough it did. Checked with ordering barista it had been sitting behind the counter the whole time.
All other Starbucks locations that I have visited will just put the drink out so you can grab it, I understand that sometimes people take the wrong drink so that's why this location does not do that, however, not being acknowledged by anyone was very frustrating.

Tried to swing through the drive they for a quick refresher and once again it was not quick.   Only one other car in line 5 minutes later we get to the window and they did not have our order right.   Had to wait while they made it.    The other  employees were standing  around  talking.   Stay away from this Starbucks on the weekends.
I've been here a few times even though I forget to check in. The staff is extremely friendly and knows evrryone by drink and name. Very welcoming for a chain coffee shop :) my new second work spot!
Coffee is never right but staff is nice.the place is hit or miss most of the time. Go there only cause its the closest starbucks around

This place is a joke. The staff is completely unfriendly and unhelpful. It's taken me many small annoyances such as not getting what I ordered or waiting 15 minutes to finally write a review. I just placed an order on my mobile app and they claimed they never received an order and didn't offer to do anything to fix it like...I don't know...make the coffees I ordered and paid for? And I'm a neighbor and frequent  customer. Not anymore. Avoid.

One of the worst Starbucks I went too. They messed up, not one...but TWO of my hot coffee orders. It wasn't until later (since the drinks were hot) that the screw up was found. 

Ordered a grande pumpkin spice latte and a cinnamon dolce latte. Pumpkin spice had absolutely no flavor, and cinnamon dolce tasted like it had all of the flavor. In addition, they left about an inch of space from each coffee.

No wonder though, seven employees all standing around bullshitting....and only one customer in front of me. It still took 10 min. 

Avoid this Starbucks if you want any service, and if you  actually want your drink made properly the first time.

I usually come to this Starbucks because it's in my neighborhood. I must say the location is nice sice it's right on Harrison. However, the inside space is quite small, even though there is plenty of outdoor space (which is really unpleasant during the summer months).

I must say though that the staff is really friendly. I remember one time I went there, I wasn't sure what I wanted and the barista guided me in the right direction.

All in all, this is a good place to come to study, catch up with friends, or just get your daily caffeine fix.

I love the teas but it's confusing to order. Every Starbucks serves them differently. Some add sweetener and syrup; some don't.  If I order a shaken tea with passion fruit it's one price; with peach it's more money.  Lid I thought syrups were free with gold membership.

I stopped by for a cup of coffee, but all of the handicapped places were taken, so I had to park further. As I was entering the store, I noticed that all of the cars parked in the handicap space WEREN'T HANDICAPPED. No placard, nothing on the license plate. I talked to the manager about it. She was very rude. She said, "Tough s**t, I don't care who parks where as long as I get their money." I left immediately and took my order of ~$20 in frappuccinos elsewhere. Would not recommend.

Confession:  I'm one of "those" coffee drinkers.  When I find myself in Starbucks, I don't get regular brewed coffee.  I get something fancy schmancy like a Frapuccino with whip cream and caramel.  It always tastes and looks the same.  That's awesome.  I hate inconsistency.  

The service has gone from decent (in the 90s when they opened) to over-the-top spectacular (present day).  There are plenty of pastries to choose from if you want a snack plus a cooler with bottled beverages and refrigerated snacks like yogurt parfaits and fruit.  

Comfortable seating options, including a counter to sit at if you don't want to camp out.  Overall, the shop is clean, as are the bathrooms.

After 10 customers that arrived and ordered after we did, we asked about our drink orders, we were told that the 'stickers' didn't print. (How did we get our food order?)

No acknowledgement or apology.

Bad form store 21373

This is quiet place to unwind, great place to grab a cup of coffee before a hectic day. Only reason it didn't earn 5 stars is that they were out of soy milk at 8:15 in the morning. Staff here are extremely friendly and cheery and the barrister crafted my drink to perfection. Prices are the same among the Starbucks franchises. The seat at this location was very comfortable and nicely lit. Will definitely return to this location in the future.

This Starbucks is one of the worst I have ever been to. You never know what kind of service you are going to get from one visit to another. 
 The staff has a bad habit of ignoring you even after asking what you want,  as you are about to speak they turn around and talk to the others.  This happens more then once.  For the most part the Baristas do their jobs very well,  but the others seem more interested in what is on their phones. Good luck if you go there.

I am a starbucks coffee lover and im always going in any locations here in Edmonton. But this location at 109 st. jasper is very dissapointing!!!! There washrooms are locked!!! 2 hours before they close and the washrooms are locked! this is not acceptable! and they are not even close yet.. I ask one of the barista and she told me that the Ladies washroom are OUT of ORDER... even the Mens is locked too... and the two baristas are smiling while talking to each other....I don't understand why they locked it too early and when the customer are asking why its locked they are saying that is both OUT of ORDER.... and i dont think so that is both "out of order"...the way they answer us! this is not the starbucks experience that i always expected! I am not coming back on this location anymore!!!!!!!!!

Someone please explain to me the presence of so many disgustingly large flies here-- preferably one amongst the staff, as I am positive many other patrons know them more than plenty well, having swiped at most of them. Maybe they are attracted by one of the Insect Wonderlands that is almost any given table top.

Seriously, one day I killed at least nine of them in a two hour sitting. Why on earth was I at Starbucks, you ask? Well, we hadn't had internet installed yet, that's why!

One of my favorite Starbucks! Although I think Starbucks as a company should allow their employees to express themselves and not have to hide tattooes. Its a coffee shop its all about embracing the different in everyone.

As much as I try and support smaller coffee shops more often than not, I can't help but crave my standard Starbucks treat on busy days. 
Generally the lines aren't too bad and I really have to respect the fact they are offering healthier options in the showcase. Some newer additions would include a protein plate and paninis. I believe availability differs from store to store.
My top 2 drinks:
A simple skinny vanilla latte half sweet with a triple shot of espresso. Gets the job done. 
And more often lately- a skinny chai latte. I usually get it a bit on the stronger side. It has a good kick of spice and as one of the Baristas told me pretty healthy for you since it's mainly real tea with a small amount of sugar added to the mix. It's more of a subtle caffeine fix than the usual coffee fix and doesn't give u the typical coffee breath.
Their vivanno smoothies are really good as well. They are made with real banana and whey protein. And the instant flavored coffee packs available are really a good investment. Super convenient when on the go, and good paired with cold water or steamed hot milk.

This Starbucks has gone way down hill in the past year. Mobile orders are often not ready or wrong. Younger baristas often seem confused. Coworker got curdled milk in her coffee this week. Today I was given a cup that basically disintegrated in my hand burning me - BEFORE I even made it to the door.
Typical Starbucks although this one always seems to take a little bit longer than most.  Still, great service and same great coffee and snacks.

What an absolute pleasure going through this drive-thru this morning! The gentleman passing our coffee out the window and taking payment was such a sweetheart. You know it only takes a moment to be really nice, make a joke or two and completely make someone's morning. This guy knows it. 

Plus it's just a short jaunt from the ridiculously busy drive-thru at the Speedway/Wilmot store where I sometimes worry I might run out of gas waiting in line because the line is So. Freakin'. Long.  Not an issue at Broadway/Kolb plus they're super nice and speedy!

This is the BEST Starbucks in town and we have been to them all. The employees are very dedicated and although they are a training store the MANY steady employees have consistently offered excellent personable service. Also the cleanest bathrooms out of all the area Starbucks!

UPDATE: I've not been to this location in a while. Customer service has greatly declined. I waited at the menu/order intercom for a minute before anyone said anything to me. Long waits, friendly staff-most of them-I do not think are here anymore :(

GOD, these people are slow and incompetent. But since they are dealing with tourists and others with no choice, they can be as nasty as they wanna be.

My suggestion?  Do a little search on your phone and find an independent coffee house nearby. You will get much better quality coffee and drinks, and much better service.

Starbucks gravois bluffs is my place ! Every morn they keep me going w my flat white
I love Austin

I usually stick to local coffee shops to avoid chains like Starbucks because you can avoid the long lines and there are actually workspaces (kinda the whole point of coffee shops for me). But this Starbucks was a pleasant surprise.

Why this location stands out:
1) Parking lot. You wouldn't find this inside the city so I get to avoid street parking, limited parking, and time wasted looking for parking.
2) No lines. There's a good crowd, but I never feel like I have to wait. I'm usually the next person from the moment I enter.
3) Plentiful workspaces. There's a large community table, numerous bar and coffee tables, counter space, and couch/ottoman table pairs. Also, various outlets for those looking to keep their devices charged while working.
4) Drive thru?! Whoa, didn't even know that this was a thing at Starbucks.
5) Friendly service. The staff here is really chill and expedient. 

If you find coffee shops to be your second homes, you may find this a nice addition to your list.

Such a great experience! Very helpful and knowledgeable of the menu and answered all questions I had. Easy and fun people to interact with. They have it together! I wish more Starbucks interactions could be like this one. While here, try Natalie's caramel cake. Very good!

The drive-thru line wait is always so ridiculous. Also, make sure you're ready with a second option for your drink or meal , because it seems like they're always out of something. The staff is friendly. The inside is clean. But if you're running late to work and need a quick coffee, stop at the McDonald's next door.

I am not a fan of this Starbucks location due to their slow and snobby service.

They do have a drive through so that's convenient, but I find that it's a bit faster to just park and go in.

This time I came at 4 on a Saturday afternoon, was the only person in line, and service was SUPER SLOOOOOOOW.  UGHS.  Come ON.  OK, fine, there were a few people in line at the drive through but still. =P

Lastly, I had asked for extra caramel sauce on my caramel frapp but they didn't do it so I went back and asked for it.  The barista glared at me and as he added the sauce, went jabbering on about how he followed the recipe and didn't leave anything out.  Come ON, no need for attitude.  Just squeeze the bottle of caramel sauce and I'll be on my way!  I didn't blame him for doing anything wrong even though I had asked for it upon ordering.  He DID miss something but I wasn't upset.  SHEESH.
Love this location always friendly. If the line is long no worries they move fast. I will be going back to this location for sure.

Worst Starbucks drink I've EVER had. Ordered the Nitro Cold Brew with cold foam. First off the coffee was warm. Normally there's ice in my cold brew or it's extremely cold. This was unacceptable! It was warm and the "cold foam" was warm as well and very thin. Just terrible. My fiancé ordered it and when I realized the disaster we didn't feel like going back in traffic to get back to the location. Disappointed. Spent almost $6 on one drink and can't even finish it because it's not very good at all.

I couldn't give this place one star because I normally get decent service here. I am not sure if this is a holiday staff issue or what, but they were way off today. The line was not super long, but it definitely was not being managed well... By the time I finally got to the front of the line, I was looking at the cashier's back. There was no acknowledgement of me at all. I know the cashiers are generally charged with the task of preparing the baked goods, so I was prepared to let this slide. Either way, it would have been nice to get a smile, a "Hi, sorry can you give me just a second...?" or something along those lines. But I got her back. Then another employee comes to the cash register. I didn't assume she was taking over and she wasn't... she was just clocking in or out I believe. Either way, she also did not offer any type of acknowledgement to me, the customer, and when she was done with whatever she was doing at the register, she also turned her back to me a proceeded to do something other than provide customer service. Then the two of them started talking about topics that had nothing to do with their job, which would have been fine, had they offered some level of customer service. There were two other young ladies working on what looked like the drive thru orders since they were at the other end of the bar. Although they offered a few glances my way, they did not smile or speak to me or any of the other customers who were standing in a line that was really starting to build up at this point. I took a few minutes to take in what was happening, then I gathered my things and left. I am sure the two young ladies are completely oblivious to the fact that they just lost a customer because they didn't acknowledge me in the first place.

I really like this location. The baristas are so nice and bubbly even when I'm half asleep and have no energy to talk lol. The line is sometimes wrapped around the building but it goes pretty fast, which I love. My drink is always made correctly and it's always a great experience. Thank you.

This location is actually the location right across the street from West Edmonton Mall, right beside Boston Pizza.; It is not located inside the mall.

I've gone to this location a few times and to be honest, it lacks in customer service on the occasion.  There are a few barista's that not only provide a quick service, but also provide a friendly attitude while on other days the service is extremely slow coupled with a rude attitude.  Depends on the day.

There is a drive thru at this location as well, which is convenient.

I come to this Starbucks often because I'm frequently in the area.  I really want to be a fan of this Starbucks, after all they do have friendly baristas but here's what annoys me:

They almost never have decaf brewing so it's impossible to get a decaf unless it's a decaf Americano or on the clover press- I've asked for a pour over and they don't have a pour over system- what?!  

The seating is very limited here and one person, an older man sleeps at a table in the corner repeatedly day after day for hours on end while other people don't have a place to sit or have to share a table- I even complained about it to the baristas and they defend him- seriously?  No apologies or asking the man to please leave after a half hour or hour so other people have a chance to sit down.  I even called customer service who finally was apologetic and I hope the issue finally gets addressed!  

I really hope that things can improve because I want to be more of a fan of this Starbucks but these issues really get on my nerves...

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. The lady at the register was so rude right from the start of us beginning to order. The rest of staff was just standing around not doing anything while there were 10 people waiting in line to order.

I'm slightly confused - all the other reviews for this location seem to indicate that it's IN West Ed mall, when it's actually across the street.

In any case, it's close to my place of employment, which is highly convenient when I'm craving a mocha.  It's also nice to be able to grab a hot chocolate to sip on the drive home after a grueling night shift.

Other than that, it's Starbucks.  What else needs to be said?

I love the people that work here and their friendly demeanor, but it takes wayy too long to get things in the morning. It has been slowly improving over the past couple of months, but definitely not somewhere I can stop quick in the morning. Great drinks, great people, long waits.
One of my favorite Starbucks in the city. The staff are always friendly and coffe always fresh n hot.

Coffe is same as every other Starbucks which is good but. I have been to this one twice this week and both times the wait has been far too long for the number of people in front of me.  30 minutes in the drive through is too long for coffee. I won't be back for this reason.

This place is ridiculous. Seriously why pay 5 bucks for coffee when you can get it for a dollar at McDonald's. Not to mention snobby people. Some customers and some employees. I don't care if you are called a barista or not to me you are a coffee pourer. Don't make me feel like a low ball because you sell expensive coffee!! (End rant)
Does drinks perfectly most of the time and good customer service. This Starbucks is also in a nice neighborhood! I wish there was more parking space though.
Hit or miss depending on the barista that day if you're ordering a complicated drink like a frap. Always really busy in the mornings and on weekends. Can be slow.

We went to this Starbucks on a Tuesday around 9 am. While they were busy we waited a long time for sandwiches that were just reheated. My husband ordered coffee and sandwiches. The coffee was ready right away. He then ordered a couple of more sandwiches. The first order of sandwiches took 10 minutes. The second order took 30 minutes! Ridiculous!

Usually a long wait since it's the only location in the area. Service has always been polite and efficient but make sure they repeat your order back to you. I've received wrong orders a couple of times and unfortunately did not realize until I was down the street.
it just took them nearly 20 mins to make 2 iced tea drinks. that is just ridiculous, mcdonald's would have been faster
best costumer service ever! super quick and accurate with orders. everyone is so cheerful there. definitely my favorite starbucks

My get up and go was still in the bed. So, I popped in her to get a dirty-soy chai. Fixed me right up. Thanks perky & patient order taker. I always think I'm going to try something new and I rarely do.
Usually Starbucks is spot on, but this time my order got completely messed up. I'm finding Starbucks to be over priced, and a corporate bore. I'd rather go spend coffee money elsewhere.

Best baristas in town. They can make whatever you want however you want it. They also make wonderful suggestions if you're looking to try something new. Never had an issue with an order. When going through the drive thru the line always moves fast. The team is so pleasant and welcoming. It's definitely my favorite Starbucks by far, and I've visited MANY up and down the east coast!

Fast friendly and as always Starbucks.
I was told my review was alittle on the shortside so I added this. Good, friendly and as always Starbucks.

Prices in Reno Nevada are higher than they are in the Bay Area for a cup of starbucks. The line for this Starbucks was about a 20 minute wait. If your working in this city of at the hotels I don't think you would be able to get Starbucks on your 10 minute break without coming back late.

After ordering it took about 10 minutes to receive our breakfast sandwiches and 10 more minutes to receive our drinks. There were about 20 other customers in the store with only 2 employees. We came early January so it could still be high tourist season but the Farrah hotel should have a large enough staff capable or making coffee in a more efficient manner.

I ordered a caramel macchiato and it was cold, tasted like pre coffee and did not taste like what I am used to buying in San Jose CA. It could be a slow Starbucks and not during winter or high travel season do they ever have to make drinks, but it's Starbucks and Starbucks is always jam packed no matter where you go. Conclusion is try to find a bette estate bucks in Reno if you can.

Ever since I moved to bordentown this was one of my favorite things. The Starbucks is less than 5 minutes away from my apartment. (Can be a bad thing too haha) usually the service is always great; however, the only huge complaint I have is they don't check their mobile orders. On multiple occasions I've placed a mobile order and it won't be ready when I get there, nor did they start it. Today, I arrived 10 minutes after I placed the order and they hadn't checked. I can understand if it's busy, but it wasn't today. This won't make me stop coming here, but maybe they should have a different system to know to check mobile orders. A lot of times I'm in a rush and then have to wait another 5-10minutes.

Gosh darn lousy experience...dirty interior, xtremely slow drive-thru, no smile employees...nine of them behind the counter.  What a disaster of an operation and certainly not well managed.

Tried the drive-thru first and line wasn't moving, so we went inside.  Chaotic looking scene, with full garbage bin overflowing the counter top of the cream/sugar area, dirty floor, littered table tops.
Two employees at drive-thru window busy talking to each other, not doing anything?!  Employee at inside register must have been new.  Hesitant on questions, taking our order, etc.
Asked for no whip on cold drink, got about half normal amount on top anyway?  

All this at 11AM on a Sunday.  We were not impressed.  Too bad they've got a monopoly here...a little competition would do us all good.
Out of many ingredients. Frappuccino has texture of iced coffee. Out of whipped cream last minute. Took 10 minutes for a frappaccino

Starbucks always leaves a good impression on me. The service is as good as to be expected (sometimes there is a line). There are usually good sale items. Everyone is pleasant and the quality is always good.
Great place with super good customer service! Always friendly staff and always accommodating.

Wish it was inside the 3 connecting hotels, but it was a short (cold) walk away from El Dorado. Located inside Harrah's, on the 2nd floor in the West Tower. It was an easy find with signs everywhere. The staff was nice and the hot latte came out quickly!

There were a few chairs and tables but no couch, which would have made my little pit stop a bit more comfortable.

Glad to have a Starbucks nearby!

I am ashamed to admit how often I frequent Starbucks but let's just say I can confidently state that this was the worst Starbucks experience yet.

Any business is prone to mistakes/incorrect orders, miscommunication, mishaps and bad attitudes but boy did we hit the jackpot with this location!

Staff was standing around gossiping when we arrived (yes, I could hear that it was just gossip).  There was one person ordering and two cars in the drive thru when we arrived.  We were picking up after using the mobile app and our order was nowhere near ready when we arrived.  That's ok, been there and have done and have seen all of that.  What irked me more was not only how long we had to wait after our "estimated time" (yes, I know what estimates are) but instead how everything started coming out with lengthy waits between each item?  

People who were showing up well after we did were receiving their items also spaced out and staggered, within their order and ours.  

Our grande coffee came out second to last and only about 2/3 full even though we politely asked for "no room for cream".   When we finally got our last food item (4 of 4) we grabbed our stuff and rushed into the car, as we were now late to get where we needed to be. 

First bite into that last food item we were handed and it was luke-warm and not to mention thrown together like a burger at a fast food joint.  I thought these things were already constructed and just needed to be reheated?  At any rate, when pulling the thing apart to place it nicely together that's when we confirmed that it wasn't hot (so obviously it had just been sitting there).  Yes, we kindly/gently asked if they could check if our sandwich was in the drive through line, about half way into our stay.

Hope they can get their act together.  I could hear the conversations going on around me, all negative complaints about their experience there.

Worst Starbucks EVER and Iv been to many..They never greet you ..they always get your order wrong ..then when they have to remake it they're upset. I love Starbucks but this location needs real help!!

Very good service and friendly staff. I was happy to find a Starbucks with good service here in Tucson.Had several unpleasant experiences with the drive thru on Speedway so this was a welcome find.

At times the drive through seems to get priority leaving only one server for customers in the store.But all in all a good place to visit.
Stopped here on the way, transporting a car down to FL.  It was a great pick me up that energized me 3/4 down the east coast.  The coffee was fresh, tasty and well put together.

Nice Starbucks inside Harrah's Casino. Only problem, you've got to walk through a cigarette-smoke-filled casino to get to it. Harrah's is an old-school, dirty, smelly, old casino. To my surprise, the Starbucks was clean and relatively fresh.

Nothing really wrong with this Starbucks -- prices are a little higher than the norm (maybe 25 cents or so per item) but not nearly as bad as the Starbucks in Vegas casinos

The big problem is it's the only 'Bucks I've been to that doesn't have free WiFi. Probably under orders from Harrah's, who used to try to hit hotel guests up with a $11/day fee for WiFi ... but now that they roll that into a forced resort fee, it makes no sense for this location to still not have it. 

One area that tops the Silver Legs Starbucks (the only other option right near here) is that they have a little more seating, and you won't get as much smoke (though there's still some from the addicts that smoke right up until the West Tower elevator door opens before putting it out). They do have some power outlets here too.

Today this is my rating because the rude blonde with the weird makeup was once again rude.  She really makes me hate this Starbucks.  Asked for splash stick and that seemed like alot and she laid it on the dirty counter that's goin in my drink lady give me me a break!
Sitting for the outside is offered, but we can't smoke after making a purchase?  Very wrong and I won't be back.

Your friendly neighborhood Spiderman, I mean Starbucks. This place is constantly packed any time of the day which is not a bad thing. I've had no problems with any drinks i've ordered or the service. There is plenty of seating available inside and out, so you can bring your furry animals out for some coffee as well. If you're familiar with Harrison, there is plenty of parking everywhere if you're willing to make a few extra steps to get in.

Never see a manager in store. Customer service was fair. Forget drive-up window. Simple Drink orders occasionally wrong. Online orders are not ready because they are out of ingredients. Trash bins are overflowing and tables are dirty. Emailed Starbucks Headquarters Customer Service with no feedback.

I moved to STL from SoCal two years ago.  Started going to the Starbucks at Chippewa and Landsdowne because it is within walking distance of my home.  For 1 1/2 years, I put up with the poor customer experience because I figured that's just the way it is here in STL.  Then, I happened to drive by this Crestwood store and tried it out.  I couldn't believe how clean, friendly and professionally trained the staff is and the store is very comfortable.  So, now I get in my car, drive by the Chippewa store and head to the Crestwood store each morning.  Believe me, it's worth the drive to start my morning with a friendly store with exceptional service.
Slowest drive through service East of the Mississippi! Don't order a frozen drink because it will be a room temperature mess by the time you get to the service window!

By far the best Starbucks in the area without a drive though. Greetings are warm and friendly. Service is always great even where their extremely busy during school season. The baristas, cashiers and other employees are SUPER friendly. 

Today Joshua totally caught me by surprise by knowing my name! I was little shocked but definitely made me appreciate this place even more. 

I'm a sucker for Macchiatos and a cheese Danish.

My daughter was on a 10 minute break and decided to get a drink.  She waited over 30 minutes from the time she ordered.  Not enough people working only 3 employees on Labor Day weekend at the outlets?
It's fucking Starbucks, duh. They gave my dog a cool little pup cup for his Frappuccino.

This is one of the worst places I have ever been to . They are so slow always seems to be understaffed . One thing I would positively say that they fix my drink properly . Staff seems overwhelmed all the time . It does not matter what time of the day you go it's always slow . They have to fix their drive through path , It's narrow and can't accommodate enough cars.

I'm generally ambivalent about Starbucks, but this location is worth patronizing.  The staff here seems very close and they are always friendly with customers.  The only thing I don't like is the shop's temperature.  In the summer, the air conditioning is on full-blast all of the time.  I'm not sure what they have the temperature set at, but it can't be higher than 65 degrees.  It's not a problem if you're trying to stop for a quick drink and get out the heat, but if you're planning to do work here, you should bring a sweatshirt.

Over the years this Starbucks has been hit or miss, but for the most part it's been great. The customer service has gotten better over time and they are always really nice in the drive thru. Sometimes they are a bit slow and the frappuccinos are a little watery. Other times I can go through the drive thru pretty quickly and my drink is good (I usually get a frappuccino or pink drink). It's definitely worth it to go here to get a special drink that they don't have anywhere else.
Slowest ever!!!!!! AND they don't seem to care either. Ten minutes wait and they weren't busy!!'

Typical Starbucks but worse, focus on huge drive-in line and short change dine in customers on service. Forgot three sandwiches and a danish and brought our order out in 4 trips over ten minutes, ensuring we could not eat as a family or else have half hot / half cold food. Nothing but excuses. I don't care if you only have two ovens, get a third. 

It's a low bar to get 7 items together accurately...

This particular Starbucks should remove the "star" from their name because they just want your "bucks". Sat in line 30 on a Saturday afternoon then treated extremely rude by the staff.   They have a great location and awesome fireplace but there is no warmth in the customer service

I needed to buy breakfast treats for the office, so I went inside this new location one weekday morning at 6:30 am. There were 4 or 5 people working already, and the drive-thru area was very busy, although there were only a couple of us inside.

I was greeted promptly at the register, and in short order had my Pumpkin Spice Latte (venti, cold, with almond milk, no whip), and breakfast for the office.

I bought an assortment of breads: iced lemon pound cake, pumpkin bread, and banana bread, and I love that they were all individually packaged.  Each one was fresh, moist, and very delicious - I highly recommend treating yourself to the pound cake!

The interior is clean, large, and nicely decorated with plenty of seating. I would definitely come to this location again to hang out.

Always has my coffee and breakfast snacks made right. This Starbucks has more comfy seating than a lot of other Starbucks do. 
Staff is friendly also.

I called this location with a complaint and instead of listening to my concern, the manager simply placed the phone down and never came back. 

I heard her telling customers about how she "needed to take a shower" and "place money into her bank account". She also said something about how annoying customers were which I assume was her way of passive aggressively attacking me.

Poorly run, poorly managed. Starbucks needs to crack down on this location or close it.

The staff is super friendly! Cleanest store in the city BY FAR! People that complain about drinks taking time should just go to a gas station!! There a million different combinations of drinks and this store is always willing to make it right

Pretty disappointed in this Starbucks. I never go to Starbucks because they are always overly packed and I could easily go to DD. Well decided to treat myself and well the drink they gave me was disgusting mind you I order the same thing for probably 10 years now and know what it should taste like. They also didn't put the Carmel that I paid extra for in it which says on the side of the cup. So I turned around and decided to get it fixed I get it mess ups happen, they go ahead and tell me they are remaking it. I spent FIFTEEN minutes waiting for my new drink which at first I was like ok they are obviously going to get the couple before me...... No they got about 5 cars and 7 orders before I got mine which I have already waited patiently for my first one. Will now go eat my cold breakfast sandwich with my ok remake drink on my way to work. Will save my time and money next time I want to treat myself.

Standard Starbucks store. Nothing to stand above, beside great location. On the other side, as I pointed out earlier, more and more stores are lagging in cleanness. This store is one of them. Hope that Starbucks Managment will consider and make some changes in the near future.

I love this starbucks because there's no drive thru which means there's no backup in the parking lot! Yes, you do have to get out of your car and inside to get your coffee. But it's way faster than any drive thru and the service is always awesome! I will be back!
The staff was extra friendly, not much of a wait (which is a bonus) and my white mocha frapuccino was great as always!

my favorite of the local starbucks's! i love coming to sit and do work, or meet up with a friend. at this location there is such a great and friendly staff, you always feel welcomed when you walk in and there's such a strong sense of community, off the top of my head i can recall the workers Alexa, Mallory, Remegio, Clecy, Arianna, Mike, and Rebekah as people who have gone out of their way to make sure I have a pleasant experience, from remembering my regular order, to talking to me when i'm having a not so great day, they always go above and beyond for their customers!
The food was placed in the bag very messy the sandwich fell apart and the cashier was rude like she did not want to work there.

Typical Starbucks in the heart of Philadelphia's tourist area, however during this visit... the baristas were slow and unfriendly. There are still customers out there that are unfamiliar with ordering at Starbucks. A gentlemen in front of me seemed nervous with ordering and when the barista asked for what size he wanted, he waited a few seconds said he wasn't familiar with ordering, but wanted a medium. The barista seemed to be annoyed with the customer. The gentlemen had to go through the same ordeal with the cashier as well.

My drink order was correct though... I'll give them that.

Excellent Starbucks location.  I visit a couple times a week and everyone is always nice to me.  Some even know my name and know what I order each time.  It makes me feel like a celebrity.  From time to time, they have let me try new menu item samples, which is always a plus to me (I mean, come on...free food and drink!).  
The facility is normally pretty clean and the staff, although busy, seem to stay on top of it.  
My only very tiny con is that it seems they don't offer the free coffee grounds anymore.  Years ago, they would have packages of it by the door to take home for composting.  I guess it was too big of a pain in the butt to maintain.
Dirtiest Starbucks ever.  Got my drink wrong.  Barista not friendly.  No sense of urgency, I ng line at drive thru.  Manager appeared from back and seemed oblivious and uninterested.

Hot coffee served like warm. 
Could not take Starbucks card. 
Had to Apple Pay, then said I could go to website with receipt later to try to get the stars they owe me. 
Manager not very friendly.
Ultra caramel frappaccino was good. 
Vanilla sweet cream cold brew did not seem to have any sweetness or vanilla. Had to add sugar packets in order to drink it.
Great staff. They move quickly and keep the place cheerful and optimistic. The location is convenient and the facility is comfortable and light. Very relaxing and great vibes.

The only bad Starbucks experience I've ever had

1. The coffee was incredibly bitter and had a burnt after taste. I was only able to take a few sips before giving up. It's been an hour since I drank it and the after taste is still there

2. I asked to have room for cream but they filled it nearly to the brim so I ended up having to poor some out on my own which wasn't ideal.

3. They served the coffee without a sleeve, apparently they were all out by 11:30 AM on a Sunday morning. 

At this point I was pretty annoyed and asked if they could replace it with a fresh cup and I was told "they don't let us do that". I ended up just throwing out 95% of a large coffee, I just couldn't drink it.  

3. We also got a chocolate chip cookie but the center was basically uncooked, had to throw that away too.

I've never had a bad experience at Starbucks so I felt compelled to share my experience. Hopefully the location was just having an off day but if not, the franchise owners will need to make a couple of tweaks.

Just went to this Starbucks for the first time yesterday. It seems to be the only one in the area, which is surprising because usually there are 3 to a block! It's kind of hidden away from the street and is located next to an M&M Meat Shop. 
It's your average Starbucks - friendly staff, clean shop and fantastic coffee. They also have a nice outside patio for you to enjoy the summer weather!

I've been here many times and never had a bad experience. Service and product are always good. Today I placed my order through the app and it was waiting when I arrived about 5 mins later. The barista was super friendly too!

Is there anything different to say about this Starbucks?  Yes, three things.

1. It has the Old City vibe and is in a beautiful old corner building.
2. Parking can be a bit of a hassle but it's worth it.
3. The Baristas are significantly better than most.  Kudos to management!

5 star rating due to they are the earliest opening Starbucks within the Downtown casino corridor. Just in case if you need that extra shot of caffeine from a long night of drinking n partying. 

Easy walk from the big 3 ie; circus circus, Silver legacy and Eldorado Resorts.

This is my neighborhood Starbucks and I frequent it often. Very often. Of course they can make every drink to perfection except the Flat White. It's supposed to be with steamed milk. Not a cappuccino or a latte but steamed milk.  I hate complaining about things but .... Why can't they make a flat white?!  The ONLY person that can a proper Flat White is Hannah. She ROCKS!  She's awesome!!  ....but she works mornings. So if I go on a day she's off or go later in the day, I shouldn't order a drink for my husband. Check out the pic of the drink we got today.

Not sure what happened, but I was given the worst Very Berry Hibiscus I've had in a long time. The drink was ready when I got there but tasted nothing like berries, just hibiscus and watered down juice. I've had this drink maybe a dozen times in my life, and have only had this problem here. It's a relatively new store, so maybe they didn't quite finish teaching the ratios/recipes.

Management is horrible, drinks always delayed. Food came out and was told drinks were about 20 minutes behind. When asked, the Manager said reasoning was because of mobile orders and cafe orders???? Insert stupid look on my face.... people were canceling their orders left and right. Sounds like a management problem. This Starbucks location sucks and needs major help.

I spend plenty of time here but the service varies on the time of the day. Morning hustle is always extremely busy and sometimes slow. Afternoon is pretty fast but most people working not in the best moods. I can't complain about the coffee always deliciously made. The spicy chorizo is probably my favorite and my caramel macchiato I wouldn't change for the world.

Given that it is a drive thru ...I will say I spend way to much time in the in the morning and inside is no better.

Definitely debated between a 3 and a 4. I used to study here all the time, but recently, the place has been a bit off. 

The past few times I've been, the bathroom has been really unsanitary and dirty. There was toilet paper all over the place, the seat was dirty, and toilets were unflushed. They have a code for the bathroom, so I don't know how it always gets so disgusting.  And a few times I went, there have been characters upstairs who are either sleeping on the tables or one that was stumbling around switching between two tables mumbling loudly. 

Granted, I feel like I might have just had a couple of bad instances. Otherwise, the upstairs area is pretty good for a good couple of hours of studying. The baristas are all friendly and drinks come relatively quickly. There's a whole wall of windows upstairs so it's well lit, and you can take study breaks by people watching. There are a good amount of outlets on the walls upstairs, and it is usually pretty quiet. My favorite part about it is the rewards app so that eventually I can get free food/drinks if I study there for a while or a few days- but that's any starbucks really.

Great service and gray drinks. They always have my order written down before I even get to the register and I always get smiling very nice service. The food is great too!  Now they are very pricey, but well worth it if you are a coffee lover.

Extremely slow!!! 25 minutes in a drive-thru, come on! There is a reason why people want to stay in their cars, we need the time. Def need to improve here. Other than that, coffee was great as always and staff was friendly. Time management is an issue therefore 2 stars.

It's your typical Starbucks. My reason for the 5 star review is bc I witnessed a rich b#%tch just give the poor girl at the counter a hard time bc her drink was "taking too long". Um- I walked in saw it was packed, from there I used deductive reasoning to assume there'd be a wait. There is no shortage of lofty individuals in D-town who think that their time is more precious, she was one of them. The goth-looking counter girl handled herself very, very well. As a person in the food service industry, I frankly, have less and less patience for these people more and more each day. It's really enough to make you run in the back room, cry, even quit. People should just be effin nice. Kudos to the goth girl, I was scared you'd toss the hot coffee on her for a second.

Coffee date spot on Fridays!! Friendly staff and friendly locals! Don't confuse a line with bad service. This is a popular location because they do such a great job! It's one of the larger Starbucks around. It's not new and modern but if you need a place to sit and study or work with plenty of room you won't be bumping into each other.  Plenty of small tables, soft-set leather chairs and a large meeting table.  Special shout out to Manager, Ayla. She's great with the staff and the customers.

The worst Starbucks I have ever been to. Drive through takes way too long. Even when ordering an iced an iced coffee, they START when I pull up to the window. I understand that if it's busy, but when I pull up to the window see the staff AND managers looking at an Instagram post before completing orders, it's a bit unsettling. On top of that, their iced coffees are always watered down and the few times I've order through the app, I always have to ask them to top off my drink because they'll be about an extra inch of empty space in the cup. I'm not one to be petty about one more fluid ounce, but knowing this location it's because the workers just don't care. I have never had a good experience here and the ONLY reason why I return is because it is right next to my home and the only one on the way to work. I have NEVER had a good experience, NEVER received decent customer service, and never left satisfied happy. In fact, I've gotten yelled at by the employees, given attitude by the employees, and asked to wait to order while someone finished writing a txt message on their phone. The owner of this location needs to do a serious performance assessment.

I go to Starbucks at least once a week. I go out of my way to avoid this location though because they are just so slow. 15 minutes from the moment I place my order in drive thru until I receive it is unacceptable. And the staff seem to revel in the fact that they are so incompetently slow. Awful.

Was not impressed with this Starbucks. The space is rather large but the seating is limited. The overall space was kind of a mess and seemed like it needed a deep cleaning. Stuff was just out of place.

They also need better training on making drinks. The first time I went I ordered a brève hot chocolate. It was not made breve, and when I told the barista she started to argue with me that it was instead of just making me a new one. The second time I came I ordered an iced matcha, which is one of my usual orders. It was extremely bland tasting and lacked a sufficient amount of matcha.

Would avoid going to this location unless absolutely necessary.

I usually go drive through and it's usually pretty fast. 
I live nearby, so it's on my way home. 
I have nothing to complain about. I can't say that the service is slow.

The location is really nice and so is the coffee. However, do not come here from 10:45-12:00 p.m because they are always packed during this time and you will wait no less than 15 mins for your coffee. I usually go around 1:30 p.m and they always make my coffee right, but for the past week I've been coming in around 11:00-12:00 p.m and they have consistently gotten my coffee wrong and I usually wait around 20 mins for my coffee. I really do love this location and the workers but don't expect to be in and out of this coffee shop within 10 mins if you go between 10:45- 12:00 p.m.

Update: I stopped by ( against my better judgement ) and this time the restrooms were out of order and the guy behind the counter yelled at me to go to some market around the corner !

Let me try to describe you the ambiance ( I came here the last 3 days in a row) , I gave up on trying to work so might as well:

 1) A homeless guy changing clothes in front of me.
 2) Another homeless guy next to me going through his things, he's burping an talking on the phone, it is unclear if there is someone on the other end though.
 3) Another homeless guy watching a bootleg of the latest star wars movie (spoilers galore). 

Did I mention there are backpacks as far as the eye can see, smelly backpacks and mattresses.

And now a barista comes out behind the bar and gives one of the homeless guys a huge free cup of coffee, and here I am, trying to work to pay for coffee when I could have easily just brought a smelly backpack, not sure how this reward works.

Baristas behind the counter have been either rude or disinterested and the place is generally dirty.

Everytime I come here, it always seems like the employees change.  Maybe that's why there is never any consistency in my Venti White Mocha, Chai Tea Latte, or Caramel Frappe.  Sometimes it's good, sometimes not so good.  Sometimes there's a employee behind the counter, sometimes there's not.  Longer wait than other Starbuck's too.

Slowwwwww. For a Sunday morning, or anyone service should not be this slow. They either need more help or better help.

No real interaction from the person that took our order... 
It just took way too long to get an iced coffee, iced latte and two sandwiches.

Rough!

We went here with a big group of girls during a Volleyball Convention. It did not take long to get our order considering we were a big group. Our order was exactly what we wanted. It has  a great location too  if you are staying at Harrahs. If you just want coffee and pastries this a to go place but if you want your typical paninis and salads you won't get it in this Starbucks location.Nothing fancy about this place. This location is smaller than the other Starbucks I've been to. I would definitely come back again.

I've been to Harrah's in Vegas and Tahoe so my spider senses knew there would be a Starbucks here. 

My family and I ordered what we usually ordered at any Starbucks branch. The barista got our order fast and prepared them lightning fast. And yeah, our drinks were as expected. AND, THEY WERE AWESOME.

Sadly, the place NEEDS more chairs. We went there twice and the first time was crowded. Also, the barista needs to wear her smile. We went to Starbucks because we know we can get what we want there. I think she didn't know she would be more beautiful and definitely more welcoming with a smile. I felt like she didn't even like being there since she isn't even showing that she's kind of glad there are customers. She didn't even thank us or said bye when we got our order even though she was so near and not making other drinks. She was also avoiding eye contact.

Today's a 4. The product was excellent but the service definitely needs more tweaking. 

~came back the second day with a heck of a lot better service with good mornings and half smiles and their unbelievably fast service. 4.5

I love Starbucks especially the one on Harrison! I love the frappachinos...my favorites being the green tea and the pumkin spice, which is a seasonal flavor for fall. When I go with my friends, we usually would sit outside since it is usually packed inside and really cold. Even during the winter, we sit outside. A negative is there isn't much seating inside. There also isn't a drive-thru. I love how the workers are really helpful and will even give out free samples of coffee packets. One time they were about to close and gave me a bunch of cookies to take home. Regardless, Starbucks remains one of my favorite coffee shops.

Been here twice now. First time, they messed up my grande black iced coffee. Second time today, also destroyed my grande black iced coffee. Black coffee should not taste like it has 1000 packets of sugar in it. My bagel and cream cheese consisted of a black brick and two tiny packets of butter. I even asked the lady who handed me the bag "this is with cream cheese, right?". Sucks for me I didn't check before I got 10 minutes down the road. So now I'm out $10, with coffee I can't drink and a burnt frisbee. I'll be walking a few extra minutes to go to Dunkin Donuts from now on.

Service was fast and the place if business is spacious BUT the 3 times I've come by this place to sit inside I fiund plenty of seating but knats and small insects on my table and around the place. Just a bit cleaning up or regular inspection would make this place 4.5/5 stars. The staff is nice, service is fast, order has always been accurate but I could do without the critters....
Nice location (inside and out). Very friendly staff. They prepare the drinks quick and are always good quality.

Drive-through was slammed and early-morning took about 15 minutes to get coffee. The coffee was delicious I tried the new Punkin and a salted caramel. Got to the drive-through to pay and the employee was very friendly made the experience worthwhile will come back again soon!

Always cluttered, loud music, and loud people give no courtesy to anyone trying to get work done of any sort. Less clean than most starbucks ive been to.  

Ive since stopped going due to their mulitple anti police mentality but have given tbis location a fair review despite peraonal feelings of the company.

If it's one thing the employees of Starbucks can do right it's mess up an easy order. For the third time in a row, I've ordered EGG WHITE BITES. They have given me regular egg with bacon. Save your time and money and go to a local family owned establishment instead.

Stopped in at 9:45 pm when the hours run until 10 pm. The lady inside had locked all the doors and was on the phone not opening. Went out of my way to find an open store for a long drive, just to be sent away.

Service is SO SLOW. I've been there multiple times and end up being in line for longer than 15 minutes each time just for one drink. I use to go to the old one and have incredibly fast service with 6 cars ahead of me. I prefer the original Starbucks in Brownsburg because they are faster when you are in a hurry.

Starbucks is a place that serves it's customer with a smile and does what the customer asks.  If a drink is wrong they do not ask questions either they just replace it free of charge.  Starbucks provides many different coffee beverages, smoothies and specialty beverages without coffee along with all day breakfast items and lite lunch or dinner sandwiches.  Starbucks is a family friendly coffee shop.

This is one of my favourite Starbucks.  The location is close to the mall but away from the mayhem of trying to find parking close by.  There's natural light except a bit darker in the one area that is not by the window.  The service is always efficient and quick, and friendly.  The last visit, they did not have my usual tea that I like to order but I found a good substitute.

There are a few armchair types seats, wood chairs, and a few higher seats.  I've been lucky to always find a table and chairs available.

Right beside the door is a recycle bin labelled for paper, and cups and lids.  I haven't seen this at all Starbucks but they should have them! Some locations might not have room for it but it's better than trying to jam your cup into a full garbage.

I often go to this Starbucks because it is closest to my home.  The service is hit or miss probably because they seem to have new trainees here every time I am here.  The long time (e.g., more than a year) employees are usually very friendly and accurately make my order.  The problem is the trainees are often clueless especially when I redeem a reward and have to ask for advice from a more experienced employee. This tends to slow down the ordering process and results in overcharges.  I often have to repeat my order several times because many of the barista trainees  have short term memory issues which is sad because they are so young.  Given the high customer traffic at this location I think Starbucks should not staff this store with so many trainees. I gave this location two stars mainly because of the good service provided by the few, and ever diminishing, experienced employees; if I were to base this on the trainees, I would give no stars.

This Starbucks was the closest one to the hospital were my mom spent her last days. (sorry to be a downer but this review is a positive one!).  I stopped there almost every day to get a mental break and a strong cup of coffee. It's a beautiful shop, excellent staff, and they all (little do they know) made the two difficult weeks a little easier. Thank you!

Good things about this location
Staff is all very nice and friendly
Shop is well maintained
They've stepped up their game since my original review. 
I love the staff here and I'm like Norm from Cheers when I walk in. They all know my name and tray me like family ( actually better than my family )

Once again the staff is all great. 
Good job Claudio, Shay NayNay, Vee, Wren, Super Mario (Drew), MarkuMark, Shamir, Aaron, Jamie and to anyone I forgot. 
Namaste
The staff is great and it's nearby me. However it seems to be the only starbucks that closes at 8pm on most nights. Absolutely ridiculous.
Very nice clean Starbucks. Staff was courteous and made me feel welcomed. Drink was just right, perfect!! Highly recommend this location. A+

I moved here from California.  So it was Starbucks or Petes coffee,,, or perhaps 7-11.
Starbucks it was.

This particular store is busy every time I'm there.  Yea,, store security!  Never seem to see the same employee twice however.  Not sure it's because of high turnover or scattered hours.  Always had the same person in CA and my drink was ready for me by the time I got to the register. I miss that.  I also cannot have my favorite Starbucks drink, white chocolate mocha, because I'm diabetic now, but am happy they make so many sugar free syrups.  So it's a "Iced, Venti, Decaf, Skinny Vanilla Latte" for me now.
Don't think they've ever gotten my order wrong here,, but I did say ICED !!  That means I want ice in the drink.  I always have to ask for more.

A nice store, friendly employees, good drinks (although they ARE too expensive, but you know that on entry) and awesome blueberry scones!  I'll be back !!
Horrible service, rude, and takes forever for coffee. They do not know how ru run this place at all and it's clear they don't care about their jobs or service

Okay so I have been ordering the same coffee the same way for years!!! 


So here we go folks:

I go thru the drive thru, I place my order... And what do I get in return, a lecture on how I don't need to say this when I order it, and how I only have to order it this way...and on and on for 2 minutes to only confuse me...I was so irate and confused...I will NOT return here!!!. I think this guy working here either takes his job too serious or needs another job where he can tell people what to do. When I want my coffee, I want it with a total and a smile...no lecture on how to order a Starbucks coffee, when seriously dude, I come from Seattle where Starbucks was established!! Gezzzz...annoying!!!! 

FYI: a iced coffee means cold, not luke warm... That means you serve it cold, shall I lecture you on how to make a iced coffee???
My local Starbucks. Good space for some reading or studying or a small meeting. Lines are never too long. Drinks are made in fashionable time, overall great service. Definitely recommend.

Nice Starbucks! Neat location - I should say it's an unusual round building, and that makes it unique.

Seeing a lot of people having lunch meetings here [laptops galore] was reassuring that I had landed at a good Starbucks. 

Very quick - in and out in less than 5 minutes!

This Starbucks is the best! Kaitlyn Rocks it out and makes some mmmm mmmm good Coffee!

Hazel Dell crew, salute!
Cold coffee, not the friendliest morning staff. I could have used my index finger to stir in my half n half.

The Starbucks app is great, gives great discounts and rewards. The menu is still WAY Overpriced! Great food and drinks but some of the coffees that they serve is alright. Overall it's a great place to study and, grab a cup of coffee on the go. I definitely recommend it.

I love the staff. The problem is the system of getting mobile drinks out vs. the in house order. Twice I've waited between 15-20 min to get a drink and just walked out(without a drink in hand). I think for the prime hours they should have 2 people working on mobile orders, 2 people working on in house orders, 1 person on food, and 2 people on the register. This way no one gets behind and the flow of getting drinks out would be more efficient.

My local Starbucks is not too shabby. My drinks are always made correctly even when I give them some cray order. The people who work the window are always very nice! I'm giving this place 3 stars because the location really sucks. The parking sucks. The line sucks. The way the Starbucks drive through is positioned, the car line blocks other parking spots and the line comes out in traffic sometimes. When its busy its a PITA to get through.

Wow. I see why I'm not a huge Starbucks fan

Our office closed today due to a random electrical fluke. So one of the other girls and I went out for some coffee before heading home. 

This location has a nice small patio with umbrellas for shade. It seemed quite clean inside and the have done some remodeling since I was in last. More shelves for more products. But the gal taking the orders this morning lacked personality and any social skills- I never got a good morning or what can I get you?   She just stared at me until I ordered. Awkward. She did then ask for my name to write on the cup and that was it.  We picked up the drinks at the end of the counter and don't remember hearing a thank you then either.  I realize this could be quite the busy location but really, a smile, hi and thanks isn't too much to expect is it ?

They are consistent on the taste of their drinks, I will give them that.

The drinks are prepared well but the atmosphere is dismal.  I live nearby so I tried this location about 4 times so far.  I would like to stop by after working 8 hours retail on Fri, Sat and Sun but it is an unfriendly place.  I arrived at 7:15 pm but the floors were being mopped so I had to pray that I would not fall as the distance from the sitting area to the front is far.  No greeting; just there to take my order.  I had to clamber back over the wet floor to retrieve my drink and I do have arthritis...no thank you nor a good evening.  Why?  The Starbucks on S Virginia is really friendly but a bit funky at times.  This location is about as cool as a bank.

This is the closest place to my office you can get something to eat, so I eat lunch here once in a while.   My go to is a Cubano sandwich which is pretty good.  And it is small enough to allow a tasty square if you like.     The drinks are standard starbucks fare, all decent but you can taste the corporation in all of them.
They never have spinach wrap, been there countless times and they always run out at about 2pm. So annoying stopped going there

Absolutely the worst Starbucks I've ever been to! I give it two stars for the two good baristas it has. To give a glimpse of what I frequently go through:  I always ask for soy milk because I don't drink normal milk since It makes me sick but apparently someone thought it was ok (or didn't think at all about the drink they were making) and put whole milk in my drink
let me repeat that WHOLE MILK
DO YOU KNOW WHAT WHOLE MILK DOES TO SOMEONE WHO DOES NOT DRINK MILK!!
none the less that was not the first and last time they have messed up my order. My tummy, toilet and wallet still haven't forgiven them for their service and honestly the only reason I go is because it's inside the library but even then I rather walk a few minutes to get cheaper coffee at the student center.

The worst ever Starbuck you may ever experience. The staff are rude to the customers and one of the staff brought outside food and sat next to us and it was very uncomfortable because of the smell and he was very loud, it doesn't feel like i am in a cafe
Very disturbing and unprofessional! 
I know many people will agree on this, which is not to allow certain people to come in this Starbucks. Many complaints were made about this but something should be done about this. Woman are being harassed here and no one is doing anything about it.

I am visiting Philadelphia for the first time in my life. It was my good fortune to find this branch. This is the best Starbucks branch I have ever been to. The staff is delightful, friendly and hip.   

I walked in for the first time on a hot, humid Wednesday looking like something the cat dragged in. Upon seeing me for the first time, Bianca immediately asked if I would like a cup of ice water. This kindly act set the tone for my three visits here. 

I met Jenna that day, too. Super friendly, she made several suggestions and recommended a great cab driver who I patronized several times during my stay. During my last day in the city we discovered we had both attended the previous day's Phillies game, and we had a nice chat about that.   

On my second visit to the branch I was greeted by Jason, who is super gracious. He expressed great interest and willingness to assist when I had a bit of trouble, which was almost immediately rectified, with my Internet connection. He spreads good cheer along with the coffee and is a delightful individual who sight unseen sees the goodness in people. 

Every Starbucks has music, coffee, food, tables, chairs and etc. What separates this store from the rest of the pack is the staff and the service they provide. There's a store manager behind all this who deserves a note of gratitude. A store this good doesn't happen by accident. I wish I could take this branch with me.

My highest recommendation.

I've visited the store several times not checking in at the time. I've had service from both inside the store and at the drive through. The service I have received has been on oar with good, friendly, fast service. I only get coffee so don't know anything about their drink making capabilities. From previous reviews by others, seems their service has improved. I'm a fan if this location.

This location makes the drink correct every time, so I cannot complain there. But every single time I order light ice in my drink, they fill it to the brim with ice. Also, the drive-thru takes waaay longer than it needs to.

My local a fav store.  Now 5 stars since they began serving their Nitro Cold Brew and got it on the App.  This version of coffee is by far my favorite.  My orders are always ready when I get there, and totally correct.  This is Starbucks people, not WaWa or DD.  So expectations are different.  No drive thru  at this location, but there's our door seating and judging by all the customers I see on their laptops, the WIFI must be good.  Almost a daily customer.  Keep up the nice work
Great pick me up pit stop on a road trip!!! The drinks are on point and the staff is cool.   Gets the job done.

It's a small starbucks that gets very crowded but the staff have been nothing but friendly to me and the drinks were always perfect! I wanted to write though to mention that I was here once on a busy weekday morning and a woman in line in front of me was being absolutely mental. It was driving ME up the wall and i didn't have to serve her! The baristas handled it SO well, very patient and sweet and understanding of her many many many many nitpicky annoyances and explained everything so well to her. I worked in a pizza place myself so i know how it can be sometimes and i really admired their absolute patience with this difficult woman. I actually called back later that day to tell their manager about them!  Definitely a good staff, just definitely plan for things to take a big longer than normal due to its busy location!

If you plan to do a mobile order, this place takes upwards of 20 minutes to get it to you. The app is never correct, and the mobile order situation is a disaster. There's no way to know an accurate time, to cancel your order, or find out where you are in the queue.

My wife and I were treated with blatant prejudice by the manager Elle (who was working in the capacity of barista).

This included her not placing our drinks on the counter, not announcing them, not answering an inquiry about whether or not the products were ours, not greeting or saying thank you to us. Additionally, she treated the other customized, who all appeared to not been people of color, in a professional and kind manner. When I asked her why she was treating us disrespectfully, she literally turned her head and walked to the back. I asked another worker if I could speak with the manager and why the woman treated us so direspectfully and I communicated that she ignored me and gues who came out...yes, Elle the manager. She said, someone wants a manager. I said, Ma'am you just ignored me and treated my wife and I rudely. I was calm and composed and people sitting there watched attentively. I asked for her card and told her that I would be reporting her to Starbucks. 

I did so. The initial Starbucks customer service rep tried to credit money to my account as a form of an apology. That is unacceptable. However, video doesn't lie, so I will update this review as the matter is addressed. But the bathroom cleanliness was just as unacceptable as this manager's prejudicial  conduct.

It's all about location here. Located right next to the West Tower elevators and the Conference Center escalator.  It is literally a minute from your room. Much better than hotel room coffee. Service is always swift and friendly. Dropped a star for inflated prices.

Stopped in this new Starbucks for a coffee after visiting my niece. The starbucks is easy in, easy out, and the people that work there are just fine. I ordered a vanilla latte iced, it took about the time I placed the order until I got to the window to pay for my drink to be ready.

Really love this Starbucks the best in the area. Roomy circular building, clean and plenty of seating. Very friendly baristas too. And great coffee. Starbucks is always consistent in how they make their coffee, which I prefer.
This morning I saw a barista add cold water to my drink because she failed to steam enough milk to fill the cup. Appalling. They aren't about the coffee here. They're about moving people through.

This rating is purely based on a experience I had with the store manager.  Starbucks products are consistent across the board and are generally good. The manager at this store was so rude to me recently. The details don't matter, but it was an unfortunate event. There's no need for a manager to be anything other than polite to a customer, no matter the type of day or how busy the store is. A little self awareness goes a long way.

I'm a Starbucks fan. 

While I've never been a huge coffee drinker, when Starbucks arrived in town that all changed. Yes, I know they're a tad overpriced. Yes, I know the coffee can be a bit bigger at times (Though I always think this comment is typical of someone who hasn't really experienced the variety that Starbucks offers). 

I don't care. I'm a Starbucks fan. I'm a fan of the coffee. I'm a fan of the culture. I'm a fan of their devotion to customer service. I'm a fan of their recent decision to pay for college for employees. 

This particular location, however, is not my favorite Starbucks location in Indianapolis. While they can still be mighty friendly at times, especially in the morning, it seems like far too often I've either experienced indifference or employees that lack the knowledge I usually associate with well-trained Starbucks employees. As a member of their "gold club," which you can equate to a frequent flyer in their rewards program, I'm fairly knowledgeable about their offerings and I expect their employees to know more than me. At this location, that doesn't always happen as was the case during my visit this evening. 

I arrived to take advantage of a reward that I had received called a "Lucky Dozen." The Starbucks website encourages you to tell the barista you want to use your "Lucky Dozen bonus" so they'll know to look on your card and use it. When I announced this to the barista this evening, I got a puzzled look and a "What?" 

While eventually a supervisor did get things figured out and it did work out, this isn't the first time at this location that I've had difficulty receiving rewards. As an added bonus (sarcasm noted), I also received the wrong receipt. 

As a chain, I'm a Starbucks fan. In the case of the Starbucks at 56th & Emerson, it unfortunately drops down to a "like" with occasionally great service, occasionally indifferent service, and a lack of knowledge that puts a damper on the usual warm and friendly Starbucks customer service that keeps me coming back.

Very Disappointed of this Starbucks location! Always very slow and they always seem to hire NEW employees all the time. Oh, if you thought mobile ordering will be faster... think twice I waited a long time and decided to have my $ back.

Love my Starbucks, but it seems the drive through has become more of a priority that those who take the time to go in for take out. Love the atmosphere, enjoy my Starbucks coffee, but frustrated waiting for 3 lone staff members to finish serving several cars before pouring me (the only person in the cafe) my one simple regular coffee. Also wish they would change their sizes to small, medium and large I keep ordering a tall and getting a small. 

Other than that there is so much potential and I will keep going back.

I went back for a refill of my iced tea small size and the girl in the photo refuse to give it to me after being here close to two and a half hours.
