She said that my cup look like it went through a dishwasher which was more than rude and unprofessional. Starbucks needs to retrain many of their employees that are absolutely horrible to customers or fire them. Not to mention overflowing trash cans inside and out. Terrible management at this location. I think they forget who the customers are. We're the ones who walk in and pay money for service.

It is not the best coffee in town, but it sure is consistent. I love the fact that I can walk into any Starbucks in the country and get something that I enjoy.

My drink of choice is a tall vanilla bean frappuccino with a shot of espresso, or a grande with two shots if I want a boost.  Give it a shot, it is delicious!

This is my favorite location in town, that fireplace is awesome for late night conversing!

This Starbucks is right where I work so I stop by frequently.

Service is consistently friendly and nice. 

Obviously it depends on the hour how busy it is thus how wiped off tables could be, how prepared ya gotta be upon being the next customer helped, etc.

Nothing to complain about. Have always been served well!

Lately, consistently one of the worst Starbucks in the area. Never enough staff and when they are staffed, few baristas seem to have a clue as to what to do. You'll wait 10-12 min minimum for a drink and I've waited as much as 20 minutes.

I don't know if it's because I'm from the hustle and bustle of southern California, but this place is S-L-O-W!  I think we waited 15 minutes before ordering.  The barista had to read the different teas that were available, which I thought was weird, and didn't have the best demeanor. I ordered a Oprah Chai, and when I got it, it was super hot! He didn't ask how warm I'd like my water so I almost burned myself a few times trying to drink it.   Ryan P and I wanted to order bistro protein boxes and we found out that you can't get those in Louisiana!  I also wasn't able to find a "You Are Here" mug in the suburbs of New Orleans.

On a positive note, the drink was made rather fast once I ordered and the bathrooms were clean.
If you plan to eat/drink inside be prepared to fight/swat at bugs the entire time. Gnats and flies Everywhere ..it's gross
This is the nicest Starbucks Iv been to. They were so friendly and nice. Also catered to my ridiculous coffee request for less calories! Love!

I love the location of this new Starbucks, everyone is super nice.  The past two times I asked for my tea to be sweet and I usually don't drink it until I get home to realize they forgot to put sugar in my tea.  I called the number listed online to speak with a manager and the phone just rings, when I place my order with them I always confirm that they say sweet and the response I received was unless it's mark unsweet it's automatically sweet.  There is nothing marked on my cup telling me it isn't sweet, I'm really disappointed to say the least.

Kaylyn the manager is awesome she resolved my issues without hesitation Thank you!

Terrible customer service. I could feel the thickness of bad attitude immediately. It was cold out & I needed a warm place to wait for my Lyft sooooooo.....I waited in the non-existent line for one of the 3 non-busy employees to acknowledge me. I ordered a Pike because I didn't twist then to craft my usual espresso with care. The young man placed my coffee on the counter & walked away. 

I had to ask him, "Excuse me, are you ready for me to scan?" 

Nonverbal gesture of a head nod was given. 

I scanned and walked away disgusted. 

Counter, nasty. Floors, nasty, display case, nasty. Service, nastier. 

~Christy

Yes, this is a busy Starbucks, but even when the line is very long (peak hours) they move people through quickly.  They always prepare my drink exactly the way I ask and I have never had a problem with them getting my order wrong.  There is one male barista (I wish I could remember his name) who is super entertaining and nice to all of the customers and puts a smile on my face every time I come through the drive-thru.  I always hear him say, "THERE she/he is!" when someone comes up to the window.  Even though I am so tired when I roll through at 6 am on Fridays, this guy cracks me up.

I also had a great interaction with a female barista there one time.  She was a very nice young woman who accidentally dropped my credit card on the ground next to the drive-thru window when she was handing it back to me.  I had to get out of my car to get it because it had fallen underneath the car, which was no big deal to me at all.  I kept telling her it was no problem, but she insisted that my venti iced coffee was "on her" that day.  

Overall, a decent Starbucks that seems to amazing baristas!

For starters, I ordered my coffee  and pulled to the window, however- I wish I wouldn't have. While waiting for my coffee, I was informed by a disrespectful confrontational employee, claiming that I could not get continue to get marshmallow in my coffee. Knowing this is a lie- due to I get this flavor in other locations literally across the country weekly- got pissed off. She informed me, that they would not be giving me this coffee again. Due to I'm paying 7$ for a frickin coffee I will be getting the flavor I want and that I have no problems with at any other locations, so this chick needs to learn her facts before telling us we can't have a flavor that you offer.
What a difference! The employees actually smile and say hello' the space is smaller, however, everyone here is so nice! Someone really needs to manage the marlton location as it is day and night!

The baristas make drinks that are both tasty AND consistent.  The relatively recent remodel works a lot better for when it gets busy.  

They have two doors for entering so it is very convenient   If one door is being used, you just look at the other one.  If that one isn't being used, you can try to use it.  If the second door is also in use, look back to the first one and hopefully this time it will be available.  This is the best strategy I've found with the doors at this Starbucks.  As a bonus, this strategy works with a lot of other door situations you might find yourself in.

There are a lot of cranky people here when it gets busy.  The baristas are not the cranky ones.  They usually look pretty happy and they work really quickly.  I'm sure the customers have a reason to be cranky.  You see the mom clutching two kids and the one who can stand suddenly loses all motor control and forgets how legs work.  The one in her arms is crying and spitting up a little on her shoulder and you see it start to drip near the angry guy sitting at the counter scrolling through Excel reports.  Suddenly in walks a family of five, who need that extra burst of sugar to make it through the Liberty Bell line, and you take in the moment with all senses - your eyes meet the father just as his face sinks with a regret you sense is much deeper than choosing this busy Starbucks.  Little Johnny in his soccer uniform is pouring the half and half in his sisters hair and suddenly it hits you.  

You hear your name called, thank the barista, enjoy that first sip and step outside (using one of the two doors).  Life moves on, a taxi blasts a tiny bleet, the air enters your nostrils and in that moment, you know you've experienced it. 

Also, they offer free wifi.
They have really improved on their service since they first opened.  They are friendly and fast at the drive through !
Darren and Brianna are very good baristas and very helpful. They always deliver great service every time I go there.

This store is always closed! Or when they are open they are sold out of every item on the menu! It's a real shame living up here in Bordentown we don't have a lot of good stores  and Starbucks is my favorite. But this location is a real let down you never know if it's open or if they will have anything in stock!

If you have to go to a starbucks I would go to this one. It is my local sbux so I am a little bias. That being said, the staff is extremely friendly and never mess up an order which is what keeps me and my coming back to this location instead of any of the other locations that may be closer for them.

my friend wanted a pink drink. they they out. that's calm. the woman behind us ordered a pink drink. they said aight. no. 
2 stars for my lemonade. for sure had lemons in it.

Totally worth connecting with everyday
Hot Chocolate w/ a shot of espresso
Make it a purpose to enjoy the tasteful drinks, snack, and much, much more. I really miss the one on Fall Creak and College. I miss the walk. I  U Starbucks
Even though service was busy, Baristas communicated with me...regarding their service and kept apologizing.  Young people here provide excellent service!

This is my local Starbucks, and it's much like any other: smells delicious inside and seating is very limited. The baristas are very nice, but I usually find Starbucks help consistent across the board. I do prefer the stand-alone shops to the ones inside Safeways or bookstores or on the UofA campus. The location of this one is particularly ideal -- at the corner of Jasper and 109th, it's an easy-to-find meeting spot before heading off to explore the rest of downtown. Oh by the way, the new salted caramel mocha is delicious, I definitely recommend it!
Every time I've been to this Starbucks inside Target there's a line and it's understaffed. Every. Single. Time. not quite sure why. The Target Starbucks near my house is great. This one is not.

Trashiest group of employees I've encountered at Starbucks and I've been to some bad ones. Employees refused to give me names when I said I was calling corporate. Their aprons were dirty. One girl tried to shut the drive thru window when I was speaking. All this after waiting in the to go line got almost 30 minutes.

This is your average Starbucks. I went at around noon on a Sunday so of course it was busy as could be! The wait time wasn't too long, maybe about 5 minutes to get my drink. I ordered a Caramel Frappuccino. It wasn't the best one I had ever had from there, unfortunately. It was like it had no ice in it or had melted or something. It wasn't warm or anything, it just didn't have the consistency you'd expect from your typical frappe. My husband ordered his usual cappuccino and he said it was pretty good! I'll definitely be back to give this location another try.

This location was packed.  I have been here a few other times and I was pleased with today's v

 My Caramel Macchiato was the perfect temperature and tasted great.  My daughter liked her Iced Latte  and Bacon Gouda as well. They seemed to have a system in place to handle the Sunday rush in the bezt possible way. 

The barista who made my drink was friendly and stayed professional and polite in spite of an angry, slightly rude , customer who was being unrealistic. 

Thank you for a great start to my morning and my latte for our trip to the beach.

Half an hour in the drive thru for two cups of coffee! 3:00 in the middle of the afternoon,. I don't frequent Starbucks, I honestly don't know what the big draw is but now I have all the more reason to not go there. I have a friend who is homebound and was going to be near her home so I asked if I could get her anything, she asked for Starbucks. It took 32 minutes from the time I got in line until I left the drive thru to get 2 cups of coffee!!! When I pulled up to the window the coffee wasn't even ready! There were about 8 or 9 cars online ahead of me. How freaking long does it take to make and hand out coffee, you are a coffee shop!

This company is doing great considering social distancing. The tables were well spread out and the staff were friendly. My salted caramel cold foam cold brew was fantastic. Served with a smile (under their masks).

Thanks Starbucks for keeping the safety of your customers and staff in mind!

This is the worse Starbucks! I have been twice in the past week and ordered through the app, which stated it was a 1-4 minute ticket time. I live in New Orleans East and I order a latte while I was 20mins away and once I reached the store My coffee wasn't ready. They are extremely slow and should hire more staff for the morning rush! I had to cancel my order twice within the last week. I prefer to order from Starbucks on st Claude!

This is by far the worst Starbucks I've been too. This is the second time I waited about 10-15 minutes waiting for my drink. I had people behind me getting their drinks before I did. Only for them to forget about my drink. Really? Twice!

We live in the condos above this Starbucks and have been over 10 times. However, after this visit we will not be back. Previous reviewers stating that there are long wait times, inexperienced employees, poorly made drinks, and incorrect completions of orders are 100% correct. I asked for a latte with almond milk and it tasted like a hot cup of water. We ordered the everything bantam bagel bites and after two times of explaining our order to the male employee received an everything bagel. Lastly, our egg bites were given to us in an OATMEAL CONTAINER with no lid. Therefore, my egg bites spilled out and were found smushed on top of each other. Terrible service, knowledge of menu items, and overall food quality. 

If you are in Nashville from out of town, DO NOT GO TO THIS STARBUCKS and visit the Dunkin Donuts downtown, Downtown Sporting Club café, the diner, or any of the hotels such as Noelle for coffee.

I ordered my coffee and breakfast eggs this morning. Coffee came and then finally 15 minutes after I was able to get someone's attention about my food being skipped. Barista was unhelpful asked me to order again, I showed him my order then proceeded to fill other peoples orders after mine. After 30 minutes left after demanding refund and nothing happening. I go here 6 days a week very disappointed

Horrible experience coming here. I was told I "shouldn't order" my coffee choice because "it takes too long." My reply was then  "oh, is that way there were 6 cars ahead of me because you arnt fast enough?" I will not be coming back. Horrible staff and they are extremely rude!

I love this location. The staff is always friendly, especially Amy who works right before I head in for night shift. They always make the drinks correctly, and they really seem to enjoy making a customer's day. I went in to claim one of my rewards, and I had them surprise me. Not at all disappointed with my decision to do so! 

I've never had any issue, and they are also great at getting through the long lines pretty quickly.

WORST. STARBUCKS. EVER. 
1. Long lines with one person working the register, and a cast of thousands milling aimlessly around behind the counter? Check!
2. Having the lady 5 people behind you in line get her two Frappuccino monstrosities with sprinkles before you get your two black cold brews? Check!
3. Waiting FOREVER for your order? Check!
4. Leaving without your petite vanilla scones you ordered unwarmed because  you thought it would be quicker that way? Check! 

Just don't.
Friendly and kind staff. Mobile order was not available. Always has a bit of a line but it moves. Staff is conscientious

Customer service is horrible. I got a drink I get everyday and it didn't taste as it usually does. They weren't accommodating. I was going to have to pay more fir shots to make it taste stronger, even though 4 shots that I usually is strong enough. I had to complain in order to get it made again. Disappointing.

Unlike other reviewers, I found the friendliness of the staff to be the best part of this Starbucks. They were kind and helping a long line of people at an impressive pace. Was able to use Starbucks app. 

But the counter (where you pick up drinks) and floor were dirty and had lots of trash lying around, and overall the ambiance at the Clara Barton Service Area leaves lots to be desired. Stop here to grab a drink and then get back on the road.

Same great coffee as every other Starbucks. The location is great, right smack dab in the middle of suburbia. They recently expanded the dining area which made it nearly double the size it originally was, which is awesome; however, there is still a horrible parking lot situation and drive thru. I often place my order on the app and like to run in and grab my drink off the counter (usually much faster than the drive thru) but the problem is there's never anywhere to park to run inside. It's a shame because I really like this location. The drive thru doesn't help either, it often wraps around the building through the parking lot, only to block more of the parking spaces. I think the solution is building another location on Hazel Dell, north of 146th St. if anyone from Starbucks Corp. wants to chat about exactly where I'd like them to build, let me know.

Update: We need another location in the area, the staff here is always overwhelmed.

I go to this starbucks location sometimes multiple times a week. I even bring my dog for a pup cup and they're always excited to let him get one. The staff is nice it's is rare i leave there feeling like someone was rude to me. I've never gotten an incorrect order and i like to custom make my drinks a lot. They are on the slower side no matter if you walk in or go through the drive thru. But i'd rather have my drink made correctly so i don't mind the wait.

Not a fan of this Starbucks.   I would go as far as to say it is the worst in in Indy.    The staff is slow and unfriendly and the location always seems drab and dirty.   There are plenty of other locations just wish they would redo the staff and interior of this one because it is closest for me.
Great service, friendly staff, great coffee. Clean store and well organized shelving and displays.
The workers here are friendly and welcoming. They get your order write and make it exactly how you want it.

I'm not a daily regular, nor do I visit during peak hours, so I can't review the service at it's busiest. However, I have experienced consistent quality and service each and every time I've visited this location.  My coffee is always hot and my iced drinks are always cold.  My orders have been accurate on every visit, and my barista and drive thru attendants have been consistently friendly.  
I have yet to visit the interior of the shop, but the drive thru and parking facilities appear to be well maintained and clean.

Good furniture. I like this location because they feature the most comfy chairs and couches of any Starbucks in south Tampa. That makes hanging out here a pleasure. The menu is the same as anywhere else and the staff turns over, so what else can you say?
If you want to linger, then this one is your Starbucks location to choose. It's also next to a Panera Bread if you want a pastry or sandwich and don't like any of the Starbucks offerings.

I frequent this particular Starbucks location on a weekly basis - every Sunday after my long run with my running club.  Our (sometimes large) group comes in, hogs up the bathrooms as we each take a few minutes to freshen up after our runs, add wait time to the line, which can get long, take up usually at least 2 tables, a bunch of chairs, and the ledge by the fireplace, and stay for a good hour and a half.  The staff, I suppose recognizing our loyalty and business rather than our nuisance factor, is always very friendly and provides fast, efficient service.  I've never had to wait an excessive time for my drink, and I've never gotten an error with my order.  They  usually don't run out of things in the baked goods case either.

The store is kept fairly clean, considering we are there at the prime hours on a Sunday morning.  Someone is always emptying the trash and refilling the milk and Half and Half on the counters.  

It would be easy for the staff to look at our group, week after week, and roll their eyes saying, "oh, this group again, hogging up the whole store," but that has never been the case. We always feel welcomed.  I always receive friendly service, my questions are answered, and some of the staff members even go so far as to ask some of us how our runs went that day.  

5 stars for this location, for sure.

This store is dirty and gross. Employees are rude and I even saw water leaking from their ceiling onto their coffee machines for hours. Dirty!! Onto their drinks. 

AVOID. Go local!!! So many other cheaper and better local coffee places within the same block.

This Starbucks is a good size for being in the city! There are plenty of tables to sit at and study and I have come here to study on occasion! The coffee is good and what you expect at Starbucks and they're pretty fast at getting out orders! I recommend this spot to come and study or grab a quick cup to go! It's close by most shopping and restaurants so it's an a convenient location!

Terrible service. Just went through the drive-thru and they got my order wrong twice. What is complicated about a grande hot latte with skimmed milk and a grande iced coffee with regular milk and 3 Stevia?  First time round I got 2 iced coffees. Second time 'round I got a hot vanilla latte. Of course by the time I discovered this error I was long gone. I can forgive the first mistake but I struggle with the second one.  Definitely will not be going back.

I am convinced that every employee that works here, hates their job. I have visited this specific location on multiple occasions, and each time i have been greeted with the same subpar/dismissive customer service. There were 4 employees there today, and each of them acted as if I was a nuisance.  I don't normally write reviews but when every single staff member is rude, and consistently ignores the customer, a review seems warranted.

I like this location because of the setup - it's spacious and have sufficient workspace for folks who like to surf the Net, telework, or work in another place other than at home. This location is diagonal from the Westshore Mall. 

The parking lot is a little tight given the number of store fronts that are in that little plaza.

I frequent this location only because I get a 25%  locals discount. 

Their inventory is very minimal and their choices are limited, the customer service is very spotty.  Do not order the Chai Latte here, is hit or miss

A convenient Star$$$$ for this part of the world, with access from both Street Road and Second Street Pike.  Its proximity to some of my favorite restaurants - Aroi Thai, Blue Sage and House of Pho - make it a perfect quick après dinner stop for hot brew on the way to the movies or home.  

It is not the most attractive franchise unit in the area, but it serves a functional purpose. 

Unlike a box of chocolates, you always know what you are going to get.

Have been going here for many years and it seems that the service is going downhill.  Aside from closing early, no comfortable seating and the even less comfortable climate (I would suggest snow gear if you're brave enough to venture inside), this is enough to rank this in the well below average Category as far as Starbucks goes...

DO NOT GO HERE!!! This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. There was one person in front of me when I ordered, they got their drink within 2-3 minutes... there was no one else in there the entire time I was there. I waited THIRTY MINUTES, yes... 30 minutes for my frapp. They only cared about the drive though. The service was terrible, the workers were very rude, and the drink didn't even taste that great. I highly recommend NOT going here unless you have unlimited time to waste.

A little pick me up before a afternoon conference.
I love my coffee, and I got to give it to Starbucks, there coffee tastes consistent whether you are in Reno or Fort Lauderdale.
It is not the best coffee, but in a pinch it will do.

I love my Bordentown Starbucks baristas! Super friendly group and the store is always clean. I go out of my way just to go to this location because they always have my drinks on point. Keep up the good work!

Two perfect drinks after a night of zero sleep.

Soy misto for me, Mango smoothie for the BF.

Quick service too. Thanks Starbucks!

The slowest Starbucks I have ever been in. Ordered an iced coffee while on the go. Stood waiting for 7 minutes waiting for my simple drink while one barista fumbled around steaming milk and pouring it in the sink (what are you doing?????). Not sure why the other 3 workers are on the payroll because they are standing around doing absolutely nothing. 

Will not come back, plenty of local coffee shops in the area that are better, faster, and likely cheaper.
Hit or miss service. Very friendly or rude, tight parking. Has drive thru, wi-fi, inside and outside seating.
3 stars because they took away my neighborhood Starbucks, but 4 stars because it's spacious and they have nitro coffee on tap!

If I could give a zero I'd do that. The chick with the beanie on and nose ring serving drinks is very much a jerk and if she didn't want to come to work today. She should've chosen a stay at home job and let someone more pleasant take her shift. I can see why this location has a 3

Super rude baristas. 

This Starbucks is the closest coffee shop to my office, so I occasionally pop in for a cold brew. I regret it every single time. I'd rather drive across town to French Truck or Cherry where I won't be greeted with an eye roll and a snotty attitude.

This is a good Starbucks, but always SOOOO crowded.  The line is always RIDICULOUS, so I honestly avoid it unless I'm desperate for caffeine. 

And good luck finding a table, any time of day....

However, they are friendly staff, even though you're surrounded by annoying suburbanites...

I frequent this Starbucks location to study and do work. The layout is okay and the staff is friendly. 
Only complaint is the music selection is terrible. This is not a nightclub. 
Maybe some 'coffee house' music would be great! Especially in the late mornings.

This place is a bit small, and can be a little cramped with too many people in it. It's conveniently located amongst the historical sites, but this causes many people to come in. The bathroom was really dirty, which was really shocking because it was locked with a code and we expected it to be cleaner from Starbucks. The bathroom smelled and the ground was really wet as if someone had peed in there. The cashier was really nice, but the drinks could have been made better. There were grounds in the coffee for one of our orders as that was slightly disappointing. However, I don't think it's anything that the establishment can't improve on!

I normally rate all Starbucks average. Why? Because the coffee is always worth the price paid and the stores are generally clean and well maintained. Today though, we also received exceptional service. Our barista Daniel made a drink wrong. Now most would say that's a bad thing ... and it is. However, the way in which Daniel took responsibility for the mistake and quickly remade the drink was exceptional. If Starbucks could capture Daniel's approach to customer service they would have no competition. When you visit this Starbucks, we hope you'll get to experience Daniel. Ciao.
Worst service ever! So freaking slow I would fire all 3 girls that worked today if I were their boss

This Starbucks location is great. It's a lot less crowded than the St Charles x Canal Street location and most patrons are office employees looking to get in and out. The baristas are pretty friendly and know their stuff. I recommend ordering on your app if you're in a rush- I placed my order at the Poydras crosswalk and my iced coffee was ready on the counter by the time I walked into the store. The only reason I'm not giving them 5 out of 5 stars is because there seems to always be one or two fruit flies flying around the pickup counter every time I'm there.

Walked in before they closed at 6:00 pm, there at 5:55 pm and they said they were closed and wouldn't serve me. Stopped at this exit just to go to Starbucks. Need to have a talk with their employees about closing early!

This is my Cheers! The place where everybody knows my name and is happy that I came. The place where my caffeine fix is handled promptly and with a smile. I have been coming to this particular location for about four years now. Although I change up my drink order daily, the baristas are fast. Many times the line is long but they work through orders fast and with a smile. I do tend to avoid the Starbucks with drive thru, it always seems the cars take priority, so this location works for me! A big shout out to Danyelle, Tress, Jamie and Jeremy. Without you, my Good Mornings would just be plain ordinary mornings.
They forgot my cinnamon bun. I had to ask & didn't want to wait for it to be heated. So I couldn't enjoy as I wanted to. My coffee Flat White was good.
Wow, what a great store. There is one employee that is SO nice and good. Grace makes the best drinks EVER. Highly recommend.

I went to Starbucks this morning left my house 30 minutes early to give myself plenty of time to get to work on time there was 5 people in front of me in line and it took them 30 minutes for me to get to the front of the line never go here unless you wanna be late for work

Very friendly staff! The coffee is great(as always). 
The only thing I'm confused about is why they have a white marble countertop.  I feel like that would be easy to stain with coffee.  Oh well

My drink order was incorrect and I didn't realize until I pulled away. I immediately went back through the drive through and asked for the correct drink which the obliged. The staff was nice but the drink is not the best I've had. I wish they would have let me keep the other drink since they were just going to throw it away anyway and I had to wait in the drive through 2 times.

I used to come to this Starbucks more often with work colleagues but now I'm here occasionally for meetings.  The line ups can be long but they tend to move quickly and the staff are efficient to get my drink fast.  But the spacing is definitely lacking.  There are tables and chairs but the people at the next table are an arm's stretch away so it's not good for any personal or confidential conversation.  Last time I was there, there was a person in a wheelchair and there wasn't enough space for her to maneuver around the people, tables, and chairs.  People also sometimes stand by the area where you get napkins as they wait for their drinks so it gets crowded.

The staff need to buzz people in for the washroom and I have seen people come in just to use the facilities without making a purchase and staff don't seem to mind. 

Since most people take their drinks to go, I can usually find a seat but I still find it's not very comfortable compared to another coffee shop half a block away.

The Starbucks on the corner of 109 St. and Jasper Ave is a busy place, both in the restaurant and outside the window. Just a short hop from the Alberta legislature, I'm sure this Starbucks is popular with government types. It's also quite close by another government employee haunt, Ricky's Grill.

The ambience is not too bad. It's nice and bright, with windows going up 15 feet. No worries about a dark, dingy space here. 

All in all, it's a pretty solid location. If you're worried about noise, plug in your iPod and pretend the rest of the world doesn't exist. It's fairly laptop friendly here, but there are no large tables, so workspace is a bit limited. 

I took transit here, but the parking lot is free, but limited to 90 minutes. I pushed it when I parked the other day, but I don't want the hassle like I had at Northgate. Impark runs the lot.

There is some outdoor seating available in the summer months, but I'm not sure how many seats there are. There's a lot of traffic here, so it'll be noisy!

Busyness - For the early morning, it's not as busy as I'd figured it might be, but it's not far from Grant MacEwan University and the Alberta Legislature, so I'm sure it sees a lot of traffic from there and the other office towers close by

Noisiness - Combine a tile floor with hard surfaces, and you have a loud space. It's not too bad while I'm here, but I'm sure when all the tables are filled it can get quite noisy.

Ambience - It's a comfortable location and not a bad place for a quick meeting.

Power - I'm sitting tucked away in the back corner where there are power outlets directly under the bench seat. Another bench is also suitably equipped. If you're prone to wetting your pants, I wouldn't recommend these seats.

Free wifi - It is available and worked as advertised.

Staff - The staff here seem energetic and friendly, as is usually the case.

Seating - Ample seating is available here. The tables are all on the small side, so if you plan on gathering many people for an all-day, Starbucks fuelled programming session, find somewhere else, or occupy many tables. The tables are small. The seats aren't too bad. There are two benches with power outlets underneath. There are 31 seats, but the benches can squeeze in more (shower first please!).

Security - If you've read my other Starbucks reviews, you've probably gathered I'm a bit paranoid. You're right. Laptop thieves are everywhere! Take the appropriate precautions. I'm kind of a fan of going with an inexpensive laptop for public work. While I may like a Macbook, I'd have it chained to me in public. Could be a fashion statement.

This place was packed in the early morning, everyone getting their coffee and danish fix. I actually came by twice, once in the morning, once in the afternoon before our drive back home. Definitley a slower Starbucks compared to others, but they make my skinny vanilla latte perfectly! Only con is you can't reload your Starbucks card app or use a free bday drink at this location.

This Starbucks is really good.  They are consistently busy, and it's fun to watch the staff bustling around filling their orders.  Today I got my traditional Iced Chai Tea Latte, and my wife got a Skinny Mocha Frappuccino.  It was the perfect pick-me-up while browsing for shoes at the mall.
Great sbux, but they let homeless people sleep upstairs. They don't even buy anything. One took off his pants. Classy.
Food and coffee is standard Starbucks issue. Problem I have is ambiance. It's always cold and baristas can be loud. Not a good place to hang out.

This is my neighborhood Starbucks and I frequent it often. Very often. Of course they can make every drink to perfection except the Flat White. It's supposed to be with steamed milk. Not a cappuccino or a latte but steamed milk.  I hate complaining about things but .... Why can't they make a flat white?!  The ONLY person that can a proper Flat White is Hannah. She ROCKS!  She's awesome!!  ....but she works mornings. So if I go on a day she's off or go later in the day, I shouldn't order a drink for my husband. Check out the pic of the drink we got today. 

Update:  I absolutely love my neighborhood Starbucks. It's to the point where I don't like other locations which makes it very difficult when I go out of town .  My husband said the flat white is good and hasn't had a problem in a long time. I love that they have the dashes and I don't have to have the simple syrup added!  They always know my order and they make a point to know all their regulars.

This used to be my go-to Starbucks and I'm not sure what has happened as of late but the service is horrendous! The last 4 out of 5 orders have been incorrect. The last order resulting in swallowing a mouthful of coffee grinds only to discover 3 inches of grinds at the bottom of my cup. They are way understaffed and the staff they do have need significantly more training and support. The trash is often overflowing outside.

The staff here is very friendly and polite.  The inside of the store is clean and organized.  With that being said, they are extremely slow.  There's generally a long line in the drive thru and it doesn't move very quickly.  

All in all, it's Starbucks and if you're willing to wait a bit then swing by.

MUCH better experience this time - very friendly service and almost NO LINE - but it was 4 PM on a HOT (100 degree) Summer Saturday.

My 11 year old got a TRENTA aka "vat" of green iced tea.

We needed this!
This is a good Starbucks with friendly staff.   And they don't ever seem to get too busy, so no annoying lines.

This is my favorite Starbucks. Mikah is the best barista I have ever found. Kind, quick with the drink, and amazing customer service. The whole staff is wonderful. I come to this location specifically for the service and Mikahs great skills and customer focus. Thank you Starbucks  and thank you Mikah

There's nothing special about this Starbucks other than it is the only Starbucks location on the West Bank west of the Harvey Canal. All of the seats inside were taken by customers who appeared to be studying. I am glad my days of studying are long gone. We sat outside where there were plenty of seats.

Every time I go in the drive thru it's pretty slow, unfortunately. One time they were even closed for cleaning and didn't post any signs to indicate this in their drive thru area so there was a line of cars waiting. When I pulled up to the window to explain this to the employees, they gave me a curt response and apparently could care less. They don't seem to want to retain regulars. 

I suggest using pick up when you can to avoid the drive thru and possibly have better luck.
Always fast and delicious. Great window service everytime. Can never go wrong with a trip to Starbucks.

I wanted some coffee so badly I just pulled up to this Location and I asked the manger she's a girl the one has the scarf on her head . I asked her at 9:23 pm which is right now of the store still open she said no closed with the most bad attitude ever seen

My experience with Starbucks today's was awful. I did a mobile order today thinking I could walk in a pick up my drink cause I was late. Instead of that they made me wait in the long drive thur line to pick up my drink. Took me 30+ minutes get though the line and by the time I get there my drink warm and water down cause all the ice was melted. (never end up drinking it)So I ask the employees for a cup of water, during that process she sneezed and proceeded hand me the cup of water. I could never feel soo disgusting.

I usually have good experiences with Starbucks, but this particular location was very disappointing. I order my drink on the mobile app to pick up "in-store" before I was headed to work. I specifically did that so I did not have to wait in the drive-through and I could just go in the store, pick up, and go. I get there, and there is a sign on the door that says something to the extent of "sorry, nobody allowed in lobby at this time, must pick up orders in drive through." The line wrapped all the way around and would have taken me 30 mins to get through...that's the whole reason I ordered on the app to pick up. I was so frustrated, I ended up having to leave my drink and food there and call to get a refund. Please do not allow mobile order to say pick up in store on them if that is not the case, or allow the customer to access a "cancel and refund" button if something likes this happens. This may not be the employees fault, but still very frustrating.

My drink order is pretty simple (iced coffee, light ice), but it's been screwed up in pretty amazing ways.  It's had hazelnut, extra ice, regular sweetener, and various milks put into it.  If you count two drink errors in one trip, I've actually had my drink made wrong more times than I've even been there!

Also, the morning people have a habit of calling everyone "Steve."  I walked through the door, and was greeted with a "hi Steve!"  I figured they just thought I was someone else, until they greeted my friend who came in right behind me ("hi Steve!") and then the woman behind us ("hi Steve!").  I'm not asking for stern professionalism from every barista in the world, but that's just dumb.

What happened to this place?!? It's really gone down the tubes... I used to love coming here. It was home. And now... it's nothing more than a factory of poorly and slowly constructed beverages made by newbies who clearly are not receiving proper training (at no fault of their own). What happened here? It's clear the new hires don't even have a chance since they seem neglected through the training process. And now, there's nothing but employees who are failed by the system. 

And not to mention, the manager... She is not approachable at all, and I've never seen manager interacted with employees and customers in such a disrespectful way.

This was one of many coffee stops along my route. Found within a large travel center, this small SB location made some good cold brew. It was a quick stop, but an efficient one.
The staff here was friendly, but very busy. I was not the only one in need of a good cup of Joe. After getting my drink, so went on my merry way.
Good service, I'm giving it five stars.

This morning while visiting Reno I was surprised to find very few Starbucks offer a drive through.  I finally found this locationthe line was long, but  it moved quickly. The employees were professional and friendly. Thank you!

This Starbucks has always been consistent throughout the years. This weekend was nothing different. I found the staff to be very accommodating and hard working. 

I was there for a few drinks and a Father's Day gift card. It was pretty busy for a Saturday around noon but the three ladies on bar handled it well. They never seemed overwhelmed or understaffed. 

The dining area was clean and very specious. I saw a few college students studying and it's right in the center of Voorhees.

Free parking! Highly convenient location right in the centre of Edmonton's most busy area. Reasonable prices and FREE parking is provided right at the Starbucks. My family and I went here and enjoyed the service. The whole outdoor mall seems well managed. You can get groceries, supper, coffee, ice cream and everything else you need in one strip mall.
Even when using the mobile order app we still have to often wait for my drinks... And that is when we order it 15+ minutes ahead of when we arrive.

Excellent branch. Not too crowded, decent amount of seating and lots of parking. Thankfully they were not overrun by tens of inconsiderate people doing work all day and taking up every single seat, as often happens in Yardley and Newtown.

This Starbucks is located in Harrahs on the second floor.
It is a fairly small Starbucks, and there seems to be wait most of the time.
I ordered a medium latte, with nonfat milk at 140 degrees, and it came out so hot.
I could not drink it for about ten minutes.
I really think they burnt the milk.
The service was OK, more like cattle being herded in and out.
Will I be back, probably not.

I have went to this location more than enough times that I can say this place is ok. The drinks and food are great but the service is so slow. Workers are friendly but it seems they're short staffed all the time! I have went in and went to the drive thu. 
Just be prepared that you may have a long wait and I don't recommend when you are in a hurry

When I arrived I believe there were only 2 (maybe 3) baristas working and the store was pretty busy so it took me about 5 minutes just to order. When I ordered I asked for a pumpkin spice latte, no whip, no pumpkin spice topping. Even though the store was busy, (I believe the barista on register was Daniel), he took the time and rang in a PSL and then rang in a Latte and added pumpkin sauce. He saved me a little bit of money but ordering a latte and adding pumpkin sauce. 
I buy a lot of pumpkin spice lattes and usually I don't get whip or topping and I have never had a barista tell me that I can order a latte and add pumpkin sauce. 
I will definitely be returning to this Starbucks!

This isn't my favorite cafe as the selection in the immediate area is too good with the crown going to the -new- Capital One Cafe. This Starbucks is very busy and as a result very loud. It's certainly not a place I personally see myself getting a lot of work done in. Really, I just get my drink and head out. The staff are nice as is expected of Starbucks and they are a saving grace here.
You know what to expect when you walk into any Starbucks in a strip mall...a smallish store with decent seating and pleasant baristas. This one is exactly what you expect.

Smaller Starbucks. Service seemed a bit on the slower side, but I think one of the baristas was new and in training.

The thing that struck me was how stuffy and humid it was inside. I noticed the cooler was leaking, don't know if that was contributing or not, but I don't think I'd ever be able to sit inside and work there.

The store was overall pretty clean, but the milk station could have used a wipe down. I know those spots are hard to keep spotless, but it seemed slow enough that they could have ran a rag over it. 

This Starbucks is in a very convenient location on Street Road, and has a good sized parking lot. It's also right next door to a B of A.

This Starbucks is Great!  The employees are so friendly and attentive and very competent. You get your drink fast and perfect every time.  Maddie, Stephen, Drew, Stacy, and Brad are the best!!  This store is a neighborhood staple. We have been waiting for it forever. Yay!

Crappiest Starbucks I've been to, and I've been to A LOT because I'm self-employed and like to get out of my house. The first time I came here all three baristas ignored me for at least a minute as I stood at the register alone. I was hoping this was a fluke, but the next time I came here they "lost" my order. I was sitting by the counter, listening for them to call me, but they never said my name or the name of my drink. I had to go begging at the counter for it, and then I had to specifically ask them for a free drink card when they should have given me one without asking. The manager at this place should be replaced.

I just moved to Tennessee and this is my local Starbucks since moving...unfortunately. Every time I go I wait for  15- 20 minutes for my coffee while other people come and go after me. I just have a iced coffee so Its not complicated but they make it clear that it's not a priority. I asked if it had been forgotten today because I was in a time crunch but the barista said no and went on to make 4 more coffees leaving the cup on the counter with my name on it. I've never waited more than 5 minutes in the last 15 years of frequent visits to other Starbucks. It's horrible service with the grumpiest baristas I've ever encountered.. great location geographically but is probably the worst Starbucks I've been to when it comes to guest service. I really like Starbucks but this will be my last visit. I guess I'm giving up on Starbucks for 2020

I stopped by this Starbucks location during some errand-running yesterday. I ordered my coffee on the app. This location is pretty typical - drive thru, little sitting area outside, small inside seating area, etc. The parking area isn't huge, but I didn't have a hard time finding a spot.

Horrible customer service in the afternoon. I do not recommend this Starbucks. As the customer I except friendly kind service unfortunately the afternoon crew does not offer this. The tall blonde girl and girl with the nose ring are rude. I called the Starbucks manager and left two messages still no returned phone call. In the future I will go to a different location to get good customer service. Huge let down.

On the way back to home, me and my husband stopped here for coffee break. We ordered one almond milk latte,the service was quick and latte was great.
It looked clean and the staff was managing customers really well.

If you want to be perpetually late for work every single day, go to this Starbucks. While I have never had any issues with the attitude of the staff, this location just can't seem to operate like the well-oiled machine that other Philadelphia Starbucks pull off without barely breaking a sweat. Regardless of the time of day that I enter this Starbucks to satiate my craving for "fast food coffee," every visit seems like this location's rush hour. When I finally take my place in the long line that snakes through the front of the store... AFTER I walk through the gaggle of angry, caffeine-deprived patrons who seem to have been waiting for their drinks for longer than what it would take to go to South America and harvest the beans themselves, my order is taken by a 'bucks employee. That employee's sole purpose is to play a game of "telephone" with the cashier and the barista. By the time my order makes its way down to the barista, it is so jumbled that it is wrong at least half of the time. To make up for this, I have received more "one free drink, courtesy of us" cards from this location than I have from any other coffee establishment in the city. While I applaud their efforts to make up for their lack of communication, I just wish that I could go here and not only purchase a properly-made beverage, but also make it to work on time without having to practically spend my entire morning shift waiting on my iced soy vanilla latte.

I ordered online 1 grande mango dragonfruit lemonade from this location. When my bf came there to pick up, they said they do not have that, but they still charged my money and just gave me 1 green tea lemonade. Even they gave me that drink, I still feel so bad because why they did not told me when I ordered. I got mad at my bf too. They ruin my day.

Slowest service I have ever experienced. 6+ people waiting for their orders. Witnessed an employee swamped with 5+ drinks he had to make. He asked the manager who else was supposed to be helping him & she said there was no one else and proceeded to be not helpful and argue with the employee. Instead of being a manager & team player she watched him as he struggled. Arguing in front of customers is super unprofessional. I felt bad for the employee. Won't be returning !!

Although the people who staff this location are very friendly and welcoming, the accuracy of the orders is below acceptable. I once ordered a lemon loaf and the label on the bag said lemon loaf and when I checked, it was a banana bread in the bag. Another time, the lemon loaf had a large discolored spot where it looked like something spilled into the sealed bag. Today, I ordered a grande vanilla latte and later found out that the cup was completely just foamed vanilla milk with no coffee at all. Again, in all instances the label was clear as to what the order should have been. It's unfortunate because this is one of the closest Starbucks to me. Can NOT recommend this location sadly.

Stopped at this place when leaving main event. The kid wanted a pink drink so there we went. Ordered a y'all pink drink with no ice and then a venti with ice...simple right? Well, they got the pink drink size correct but gave us an extra large cup of ice! Luckily for the kid, that size sufficed when she poured the pink drink in there!

So I'm traveling from Florida to NY yesterday, left at 5:00am and got to the John Fenwick Service Area Starbucks rest stop and well over due for some caffeineafacation to continue my trek to NY and they were closed already at 9:15. 
Is it just me that thinks it's ridiculous at a rest stop to have such limited hours? And on Yelp just looking now it has their posted hours till 10:00 pm, wtf! I find Starbucks to be trending away from customer service, i.e. Products unavailable half way through their day of operations and such limited hours, like who would ever want coffee after 9 pm?
By far my favorite starbucks. Great staff, consistent drinks. Mobile ordering is pretty awesome too. It gets pretty packed, but what starbucks doesnt?
Chai latte tasted horrible, like the syrup was rancid. Asked for a replacement, same thing. Lots of flies on the ceiling. I give two stars because they were helpful in trying to remake the drink.
Great service! Considering the line is generally long (students need their coffee), the staff is still very friendly and extremely quick.

This was the first time I had visited this location since I was in the area. I ordered ahead but chose to go through the drive thru since I had my baby with me. There was a guy taking orders on a tablet when you drove up and I gave him my name for pickup. The line was long but moved through quick and efficiently. My order was ready when I got to the window and was prepared correctly. I will definitely return when I'm shopping in the area.

Claire is outstanding. Keep her. Make her your manager. Give her more money. I stop in a few times a week on my way home from work, usually after a long day and Claire is always so patient and friendly. She suggests things when I don't even know what I want. She is a gem. 

I have seen quite a few different drive thru attendants, and I usually come thru around the same time. Yesterday I came through and as I was at the window, I could see and hear the manager say she was taking over to get the line down before she sends someone on break. Nice to see management step in and help.

This is the second time I have ordered a protein box with fruit and cheese and had moldy/mushy fruit. I'd have gone back but the service took too long the first time and we had already hit the interstate. Double check your items

Beautiful new Starbucks with plenty of parking and a fabulous look inside. 
Great to have a 3rd Starbucks between Havertown and Broomall that has plenty of seating and the option of a drive through.

Just had the worst experience at this Starbucks i go to all the time since it is near my house. I would give this review 2 stars because the lady at the register was so nice, but not even her sympathy would make me want to even rate this Starbucks 1 star, luckily Yelp makes you pick that option. Anyway, i ordered a grande Javachip frap. The order came and i waited until i got into the car to try it. The coffee part was good, but then when the drink was close to my face, i started to notice a weird smell. It smelled like rotten dairy. So, i tried a bite of whip cream and instantly had to pull over to spit it out and started gagging. I'm usually not one to bring my food back at restaurants, but this was so disgusting i turned around and went back to the store. 

I waited in line and approached the nice woman who had just taken my order, and explained that the whip cream must be bad and that she could smell it to prove it. She took a whiff and agreed that it smelled rotten. She gave me a refund. I'm guessing that the lady appeared from the back was a manager and the cashier showed her and she claims she didn't smell anything. I told her she should try it because obviously their whip cream was rotten, she stated that it was made this morning and it was fine. I wasn't trying to argue, so i took my remade coffee, containing whip cream again. You know how there's extra whip cream coming out the opening in the top? Well, i licked it off the cap and had to go to the nearest trash can and spit it out in a napkin. I went back to the counter and said that this whip cream was also rotten. Now you can tell they were mad, they yelled "i just re-made that coffee." They tried the whip cream from the can and was said it was fine. Obviously its not! You think i was that terrible taste stuck in my mouth?? I'm not sure why it was "fine" out of the can, but i know what taste rotten or not. If i cant hold it in my mouth and gag its obviously not fine! The whip cream is always my favorite part about the fraps!

So, she suggested that i have one without whip cream, of course thats not what I wanted but i did not want to have rotten as an option. This same lady that had an attitude with me about the whip cream (white, shorter lady with brown hair and glasses), i noticed that she was also being unnecessarily mean to the cashier on my first visit. The cashier was a young black lady, and btw she was awesome. So anyway, i get my THIRD drink and what does it contain, WHIP CREAM. Not wanting to deal with these very rude workers for a 4th time, i took my coffee to the trash can and opened the lid. I tried a little bit of the whip cream and EW it was also rotten like the other two, i just scraped the whip cream off and walked out the door. I wish i had an ally, besides the cashier, that could try it and see that I'm not the only one that has taste buds. I'm now sitting at home typing this trying to enjoy this coffee with no whip, but i just cant. It's now in the trash, just like this Starbucks should be.

I love this Starbucks. Really close to Intercontinental Hotel and the mall. It is crowded in the mornings as people from the office buildings are coming to get their fuel, however the stuff is really friendly here, they have beautiful mugs and cups for sale, inside seating area and parking right in front.
My office for the morning. This Starbucks location is one of the larger ones in the Fishers area. Plenty of seating for both working and socializing.

On a cold rainy morning, there's nothing like a Starbucks right down the block at 6 a.m. to really pick you up.

This particular Starbucks was one of the best I've visited in a while.  Not only was the coffee dark roasted and black enough to kill, but the store was very easy to visit and order from, and the orders came out so fast! I went there with two of my friends who were attending an event on Sunday morning with me in the City Plaza, and the time it took us to arrive, order our drinks, and take off was probably less than 5 minutes.

 Additionally, the service was simply outstanding! The one-woman show barista- and cashier-in-one in this smaller franchised store, inside the Harrah's Reno, was so nice and pleasant, and had a beautiful smile on her face the whole time we were there. It was just the thing we needed to get our morning off to a great start.

Overall, a great early morning experience and one I would gladly opt for again.

Coffee is good. Ordered a bacon Gouda sandwich. First time it had no bacon. Bring it back in and this time the egg is ICE COLD a bite in but the bun is almost too hot to hold. Disappointed. Didn't even ask them to fix it, just refund me.

My Favorite Starbucks! The staff ROCKS!

Enjoy a couple lee brew or a hot brew. This is the best Starbucks in the city.  

Keep the yummy drinks flowing

The products are always on point. But since this is the only Starbucks within miles, the lines are always long. Never any available tables. You will definitely want to pre-order your stuff if you need it fast. 

WE NEED MORE LOCATIONS,CORPORATE!  GIDDY UP!

I go to this Starbucks only because I work right around the corner, so it's based on convenience. I never have an issue with the service or the wait times etc, I just can NEVER seem to get the exact same order twice. I, much like thousands of other coffee drinkers, usually have a regular go-to coffee order, so I basically order the same thing every time, but rarely do I ever get the same quality. 
Often times I'll order coffee at 7-7:30am and it's room temperature. I'll ask for cream and sugar and get either barely any sweetness or super sugary, this morning I asked for cream and sugar and it looked like they put no cream in it. 
Guys- I understand the struggles, I work in the service industry too, but you're making coffee not building spaceships. I'm sure you have a great training program but PLEASE do better.

I work next door to this Starbucks and come here all the time. I sent my friend in to grab a sandwich for me and she returned with the wrong one, becuase the woman working gave my friend the wrong one. She went back to return it and grab the correct panini and upon returning the woman working, Joy, was extremely rude to my friend. Talking in a disrespectful tone, and giving the worst customer service. This starbucks has ALWAYS messed up my orders anyhow.

MISTAKE STOPPING HERE! Never check reviews before stopping at a STARBUCKS...but I will now! Die hard Starbucks fans on vacation, stopped on a Sunday before noon. Should have realized that the flies and I mean a lot of flies inside (um can you say "dump") was a bad sign. One person in line who took forever to order her tall iced coffee. Ordering was easy - passion ice tea and a decaf iced with cream and pumpkin. Simple drinks.  Tea came out in decent time...coffee try 10 minutes (mind you there was a drive thru, but two baristas running drinks).  Didn't tell us they had no ice decaf and only because we were watching and overheard convo where they were like just make a latte...usually they sub decaf Americano in any other cafe...and they let you know. One person starts it after we correct them and then it sits while they go do other things...a second person picks it up and completes, not before squeezing caramel on top! We question what's on top and while she was nice, after we said we didn't order that way she said "do you want it with it?" - ah we just told you we didn't order it that way! Took another 5 minutes to get it right...meanwhile a father and daughter enter and loudly say "look no line for once!" Clearly there is an issue at this location.

Just got coffee and met the loveliest young woman. Cassie in the drive-thru was a breath of fresh air. She was friendly, mentioned that I had enough points for a free coffee and commented on how good my order looked as she handed it to me. She made eye contact and was very engaged. Mind you, she had already charged me (thru app) but offered to reverse it to let me use points instead. So nice!! This is my regular location, but Cassie is definitely a few steps above the norm. I called the store too and can only hope this review or my call reach the store manager at the least. I will actually look forward to seeing her again.

I often go right after they open, just minutes past 6am before work, and the staff are always so friendly. It starts my mornings off with nice people and fantastic coffee with my drinks always tasting delicious and hot. Thank you so much morning staff, you are really fantastic, keep up the good work!

Ridiculous. As a provider of paper, plastic and other items that eventually will need to be disposed of, there are NO TRASH CANS outside of the establishment. On my way into this location, I picked up a paper bag and a couple of cups (not from Starbucks), that some piglets had left in the parking lot. I asked the guy at the front counter if I could drop them in their waste can behind the counter and he said no, they only allow Starbucks trash. When I explained to him that this trash was in the Starbucks parking lot, and that there were no trash cans outside, he shrugged and said it was "company policy". W.t.H.??? So I asked him what he suggested I do with the trash, another shrug. Had no choice but to leave it where I found it outside. Did I say ridiculous?

When it comes to coffee I try my best to stay local but I often find myself craving Starbucks' unbeatable scones. When this happens I drive to this location and indulge. The coffee is good and the pastries are even better. It is always clean and totally friendly!

For those that don't feel like parking and walking 10 - 15 steps to get to the door of Starbucks, this one has a drive-thru. If you see a line don't drive off, the line moves quickly.

I just watched a horrific example of a guest berating a barista because the size of his drink was wrong. As an Operator, I was disgusted by this "guest" and his entitled behavior. This crew works hard. I see them a couple times a week, and they have never been anything less than professional and kind. They most certainly did not deserve to be treated that way. I commend them for not calling law enforcement as the "guest" verbally abused them several times. Great job!

When it comes to quality of products and customer service this Starbucks location is just normal. Most times when you walk in its clean, the bathrooms are decent and the drinks and food are average. 

What does really suck about this Starbucks is not the location but how is situated on the edge of Hillsborough and Memorial Highway. I am surprised that there has never been any major accidents during rush hour traffic with people trying to get their morning cup of joe. Even when it's not rush hour the parking lot is ridiculously small and the curve that you have to take to swing into the drive thru is bonkers! 

When I'm in a time crunch or just feel like taking the chance and not heading the other direction to another Starbucks I'll shoot to this location. If you're looking for a lot of seating... negative! If you're even looking for a space to park your car...head to another Starbucks! If you don't mind taking a chance on swinging through the drive thru and it's on your way to wherever you're going then this Starbucks is convenient.

usually this starbucks is very good! but my past experience changed my whole mindset. i ordered a grande hot chocolate at kids temperature. when i got to the window the lady gave me a kids sized hot chocolate. i told her i ordered a grande but at kids temperature, not the kids size. and she was so rude, she said she could remake it but i paid for a kids. that's not my fault because i know that i asked for a grande. she gave me the rudest attitude and remade it, she made me feel like i was being so difficult but she is the one who screwed up my order, not me.

Because of its location to my home, this has always been me and my husband's go-to Starbucks location. We go weekly. Sometimes daily. But lately, since their renovation, the service is terrible slow!!!! Even when I've gone and there are only a few folks in the drive thru, it's still a minimum of 15-20 wait. They used to be able to get through a crowd of folks in no time, but lately, we find ourselves either not going or leaving before we can even order. LOCAL MGMT: PLEASE fix this!!! We love you. We wanna come. But this must change!!!
Fine as usual. This location is less energized than many others, but still good for a quick stop.

Came in to try out the Mango Dragonfruit at Starbucks. Awsome refreshing drink. This exotic magenta color drink has a bursting sweet tropical flavor you can't resist. I've always heard about the benefits of Dragonfruit, but what I like from this drink is that it comes with real red fleshed dragon fruit (aka Pitaya) that makes it sweet without  needing to add sweetener  on it.

This drink is definitely for the summer! Sweet and Refreshing! Try one out.

Convenient location but service is not good. I've said I'm not going back and then I give them one more chance only to be disappointed - every time. Hence this review.

Problems include forgetting to add major ingredients in drinks, forgetting to make my drink even though they wrote it on a cup, cooking wrong food, low inventory of self service items, etc. Simple mistakes but pretty annoying when you're trying to get a quick break for a drink or bite and have to turn around to get mistakes corrected. Seems like staff is having a great time joking around but maybe trade some of that fun for customer satisfaction.

I'll return when reviews improve. Looks like I'm not alone.

Starbucks are hard to find in this area. I have to pick a direction and basically go out of my way 30minutes to get to a Starbucks. This is the 3rd time in a row now I've had horrible service plus my drink was wrong. I won't be back to this location. I'm not sure what's happened recently to your customer service but your employees seem very inconveniences with having to do their job. I say job bc my requests are basic uncomplicated drinks usually only one drink.

You know I love SBucks. I mean there are other good coffee bars but none so convenient. If you're on the go or in a hurry this is the choice. They try their hardest to get the drive thru and mobile orders out first but I usually go inside to pick mine up. It is one of the busiest SBucks in FL outside of Disney but give them credit. They do a great job.

I frequent Starbucks but the company should be worried about British, relative newcomer, Pret. Its small batch makes SB's coffee taste like motor oil and the simple, fresh salads unfortunately highlight the inadequacies of SB food. I say this because I'm rooting for SB as an American cafe - although Pret deserves to do well too....hoping SB pulls it together, especially especially with the food. I mean this in the most loving way, "it is awful" ...but you are American. Adjust accordingly.
This was the worst Starbucks I have been to. Drive thru was closed. Served cold coffee and said we would have to brew more. We left without coffee.

I go after work around 6:30.. even if I'm the only one in line it takes forever to get my drink.  The employees are holding conversations with each other or a friend who came in to say hello and they can't seem to talk and make coffee at the same time.  Very frustrating.  N

they had FIVE OR SIX workers standing in front of us yesterday. when my friend and i were waiting for ten minutes,, a male cashier came up to us and asked if we had been helped. when we said no, he walked away to talk to the others, as he did before. when we finally got our order in (twenty minutes later) , they gave us our drinks and two cake pops. one cake pop didn't even have a stick , and one of our drinks barely had any chocolate chips. it was ridiculous. never going to that starbucks location again.

I come here every morning.   The only time that I do not come is when I'm running late for work. The staff here is marvelous. They know what I want when I come in and they call me by name. Thank you all for being my morning pick up!
Good standard Starbuck's service as usual, with the standard menu.

Was OK until received rude treatment from an employee. Guess what Starbucks? There are other coffee shops around!

Bye.

AM I DREAMING? Starbucks opened less than 5 minutes from my house, and its a drive through!!! I'd been dreaming of this moment for all of my suburban mom life (which has been less than 10 months at this point, but still...). Dragging a baby out of the car to get coffee in the cold or rain is less than ideal, and Dunkin was the only close option. Now there's a starbucks drive through right on Rt 130! 

I still miss La Colombe (and being able to walk to get coffee) but this is the best option within 5 minutes of my house.

It's a Starbucks. If you've been to one, you've been to them all. If you want to get into specifics then I suppose you could harp on the service. I've never been blown away by anyone there. They kind of just do their job. It's done right, but nothing to write home about. However, there is barely ever a line. Even in the drive thru I know I rarely have to sit behind more then one car.

I love Starbucks and wasn't even a huge fan a couple years ago, but since coming to different locations, Ive had great experiences everywhere. 

The staff is always so welcoming and friendly. 

They have really great coffee and their muffins are so good. The cake pops are also a good choice to have with the coffee. Although their display case is a bit smaller than other locations, they still have about the same types of items. 

When I came in on this visit I got the cake pops and an iced coffee and it was really good. I would usually get an iced tea instead of an iced coffee and they are usually really good too.

I visited this place because I was given a gift card for Boss's day. My usual place to get coffee is not too far away from this location. I was surprised with my visit this time. 
When I usually come here, there has ALWAYS been a line. People a pleasant enough, but when you order ahead on the app, you expect you order to be ready when you get there. Therefore, I was anticipating a wait when I didn't order ahead this morning.
The line was not long and the young lady who took my order was cheerful. Within just a few minutes, my order was ready!
My go-to order is a Cinnamon Dolce Mocha. It was what I needed to begin my work day.
Always pleasant!  Always CLEAN! Always speedy in the drive thru!  I drive waaaaay out of my way to go to this particular Starbucks.

I rarely visit this specific Starbucks location, but whenever I do there seems to be an issue that reminds me of why I don't come here! They're always out of something and seem to barely be capable of putting together a drink correctly. Now yesterday was probably my third time experiencing a nasty attitude from one of the Baristas. When I ordered my frappe, I specified that I wanted NO whipped cream. Of course once I received it there was whipped cream on top, (figures). I told the Barista I wanted no whipped cream, as if to only remind her of something she clearly forgot, and she tells me, "ok well next time just let us know" (full blown attitude). I'm over this Starbucks Location!

This place changed my life. I've always thought that yelp was for older woman who leave petty 1 star reviews. I just downloaded the app so i could leave a review to this place. I was going through a messy long term relationship break up. The day after before school I came here, and Deb, the lady at the drive through window was the nicest person i think i have ever met. I was doing poorly financially at the time, so I went here because the water is very good and free. I also ordered a blueberry muffin because i felt bad. Deb noticed this and said that if I just wanted the water that's okay and i shouldn't feel obligated to order something else. This put me in the mood to change my life for the better. Immediately, i made a list of goals that i wanted to accomplish. And since then i have worked out every single day, read more books, became a better brother, friend, and person. The only thing that hasn't changed is that i come here every morning to say hi to Deb. To deb, thank you so much for making the world a better place.

I've never actually been inside this Starbucks. As often as I've gone it's always been the drive through.  So I cannot comment on the interior but I can say the drive-thru Baristas are always friendly and they get my order right 100% of the time. Can't ask for anything more than that.  Honestly the only reason they don't get 5 stars is because this location is so darned inconvenient, which isn't really there fault but it's still a thing so..

I went to the McCarran drive-through Starbucks on a Pumpkin Spice Latte mission the other day. Having recently moved to Reno I found it a bit hard to find. I had to double back and circle around a bit. I know that's my own problem tho. Hopefully I'll figure Reno out eventually.

This Starbucks is located in a business park and seems like a pretty business-y Starbucks. It's super-nice from the outside which is the only part I saw. A nice, new, modern building. Drive through a little confusing too, but hopefully I'll figure it out soon.

Once I got to the drive through the guy who helped me was super-nice. I got a Venti Pumpkin Spice Latte as it was a cold Fall day. 

I love Starbucks as a general rule. Knowing Reno had a bunch of Starbucks reassured me that I would be okay living in Reno. This was not my favorite location as it was sort of far away and hard to get into, but it was a good Starbucks experience overall.

When I got to the drive-through window the sweet tattoo-ed hipster handed me my drink. Nice hipsters instead of snotty ones are such a new concept after Los Angeles. This nice hipster neglected to give me a straw. That would have been nice, but wasn't that big of a deal.

My Pumpkin Spice Latte was delicious as usual. I loved it. I gave grandma a little drink of it when I got home and she liked it too.

I'll probably check out the other drive-through Starbucks in Reno before coming back to this one but it's nice to know it's there. Love that pumpkin spice!

I have been going to this Starbucks multiple times a week since it opened.  I have seen so many different staff there and all have been fine, but in the last couple of weeks at least two baristas have been immensely rude. My friends have noticed it too. Something is wrong.

Alright, so I know I should be all about the evil empire of Starbucks.  And for awhile I avoided it like the plague!  Until that fateful day that I entered my local store!  I love it here, the baristas see me crossing the street and have my drink ready for me in the morning - Grande Bold with Room!  It's great, I don't have to speak some mornings, which is probably for the best.  If I go outside of my 7:05-7:15am window the baristas ask "regular morning" and lately "regular afternoon" - I'm addicted to the Low-Fat Mocha Frap in the afternoon!  I enjoy Komodo Dragon, Verona, Sumatra in the morning!  A frap or seasonal late in the afternoon!  The staff at this store are exceptional!  I have gone to other Starbucks and been very annoyed and disappointed!  I wish the Pumpkin Spice and Gingerbread Lates were on the menu 24/7!  If you're in Old City, check this place out...  It's cheaper than Old City Coffee and the staff are a lot more fun!

Bright and cheerful with floor to ceiling windows.

Limited match here. 

Majority of seating remover for COVID.

A couple parking stalls but hard to come by. 

Not my fave location for a leisurely bev but delicious none the less.

This had been my neighborhood Starbucks until just recently. Great staff, well managed and friendly. The decor has an unfortunate "Stalag" feel about it though.

Kudos to Starbucks for it's new policy banning smoking outside it's stores. Nothing ruins a beautiful day visiting with friends at my favorite "Bucks" that some goof ball smoking. Smart, courageous and the right thing to do. Congrats SB

At first I was skeptical about the location of this new Starbucks. But it turned out to be perfect! Looks small from the outside but very spacious (and clean) on the inside with plenty of seating. Also has a very nice outdoor patio. Nicely designed, large drive-thru. Very friendly baristas. Great location & great coffee!
Starbucks is a "treat" coffee for me cuz I usually do DD but when I want my coffee sweet with a lil kick of extra I go here. Love it. And he threw in a cake pop for free
Not professional stuff. They didn't give any topping for my oatmeal. They were out of spoons, and thought I would eat oatmeal with a fork.

I went to this Starbucks on February 24, 2010.  They did not accept my Starbucks Card, and Internet Access was $10.95.  

I thought that with the Starbucks card, and access through Starbucks.com, Internet is free at any Starbucks.

I packed up my stuff, with three hours to kill for the late Amtrak Train 6 to San Francisco, and went to Java Jungle for FREE internet access.

I ordered Pizza, lunch, and delightful coffee.

This starbucks has the best customer service in the area.   It is true that they are always busy, but they move people through quickly and with a smile on their face.  The manager Jamie is always happy to greet you with a smile
I smellllll.... Cough-feeeee.... Say it with an New York accent, it's fun! =]

I never leave reviews but I needed to for these amazing baristas! 

Every single time I visit this location they are so unbelievably kind and helpful. As some one who also works in customer service it's extremely refreshing to visit this store and get treated like a friend. The sweet girl named Sarah Mai, I believe, today asked me my name and was so kind. I told her thank you for always being in such a great mood! She said there's too much darkness in the world so we try to bring some light into your day! 

This is how every establishment should be. They are so excellent!

The coffee was made with little to no care at all. I
