The attitude from the employees there is basic. You'll be lucky to get any eye contact whatsoever. The coffee was so hot that the cup it came in was becoming flimsy. It's just not a pleasant experience 
 And at the prices they charge...
Staff super friendly here! Good ol' starbucks.  No complaints.  No seating inside as of today. All staff wearing masks. Spacious and clean.

Geesh!  OK the girl was new but the guy working w/her was no help.  It was 8:30ish and there was one person in line in front of us.  We ordered 2 iced teas & 1 order of bacon egg bites.  When we turned around to go wait for our order there were 11 people in line behind us!  The guy told her she needed to multitask as he walked through the door to the back where it sounded like a party.  Turns out at 9:00 "the party" went on shift and the poor girl at the counter got some help.  Out of the then 4 baristas only 1 knew what hustle means.  I get that the new girl hadn't found her groove yet but other than the one who knew what customer service is, the other 2 were just there at their job!

I went to Starbucks this morning. I got an old fashioned donut and a white chocolate mocha. The white chocolate mocha is my absolute favorite drink from Starbucks, and I usually order it with an extra shot or two. The donut was delicious as well. As always, I think that Starbucks is expensive, but well worth the price. I will continue to buy coffee and pastries from Starbucks.

A decently sized Starbucks with an ample amount of seating (with outlets!) upstairs, though you have to come before noon to guarantee a seat on the weekend. Otherwise, pretty standard Starbucks in terms of their drinks, and the baristas were friendly and accommodating. 

There is only one bathroom that is not very clean, so I wouldn't recommend staying for too long. I've definitely been to nicer Starbucks in many other cities/locations so this was just an average one.

Well sometimes you have meeting and you want to step outside your office well today's that day. Couldn't pass up a Frappuccino. 
Always great times at Starbucks even the service here is great. I do enjoy this location because the outside patio is really cute nestled in cute corner and the inside is set up really nice and definitely like the choice of tables.

This is the worst drink I have ever gotten from Starbucks, and I frequent this place. I ordered a venti Starbucks double shot and I swear they gave me a tall in a venti cup and just added ice! I even waited for the guy to come back to the drive thru window and he just disappeared. If I wasn't crunched for time on my lunch break I would've went inside  to have them remake it. So now I'm pissed with a tall size coffee when I paid for a venti and the damn straw doesn't even go into the drink BECAUSE THERES NO DRINK. WTF DO BETTER
Workers were nice, but didn't really know what they were doing. Lots of little errors that make a big difference.
Anybody Starbucks starts at a very mediocre position, however this one consistently delivers better quality and customer service as opposed to some of the other Tampa Bay locations.

It's another Starbucks, but this location been to handful of times, when i am in the area, quite convenient, stop grab something,I use it as a Landmark as well to meet up with my buddies. .Quite nice inside,sitting area, wii-fii. The outside seating should be happening soon-warm weather is upon us to people watch!! Service has been consistently good, guess the ones I've been to are personable.
New, clean, friendly staff, easy to travel to, easy parking. Will return.  Happy to see this arrive in Goodlettsville.

This Starbucks is located very close to where I live, it's only a block or two off Rittenhouse Square.  The baristas are friendly and they know my coffee order which they give me exactly as I like, very nice!  They also have given me advice on how to brew coffee at home with the correct water/coffee ratio.  I'll definitely keep coming here, the convenience is great.

Let me preface this by saying that the manager was super kind and helpful.

None the less, I purchased two $25 gift cards and found out they were blanks.

Word to the wise: check your receipt before leaving the store

Stopped in for my morning earl gray latte.  The store was clean and service was fast.   They staff was taking care of the customers at a very good pace.   It looked like the drive thru was moving at a good pace.  My tea was made correctly and I was out the door in a few minutes.  I will visit this store again because of the customer service and speed.
My go to location! Always make my caramel macchiatos perfect. They also always have the reduced fat turkey bacon and cheddar sandwiches which start my day perfect.
Very good food, and drinks. They gave us "drip to hard water" and we will never forgot that. If you ever go to Starbucks rate 5 stars.

This place is hit and miss as far as customer service and product availability.  It doesn't seem to matter what time of day you're in they're always out of something or items are not stocked which causes customers to have to return to the counter for additional assistance.  I don't like this when I'm in a rush.  Getting someone to help you again is bothersome and most times you're completely ignored.
Very fast and efficient.  Only thing lacking is space to sit.

This starbucks was the closest one to my friends house so we stopped by in a hurry. The girl behind the counter was very nice, however, when I asked to use the buy one get one free happy hour deal it did not come through and I got charged for both drinks. Although that was bothersome I decided not to say anything after ordering our drinks. I got an iced caramel macchiato with almond milk as I usually do. The drink came out almost white looking like just milk and caramel mixed together. After leaving the store, I went back in and asked for it to be fixed and the barista rudely handed me a shot of espresso and told me to pour it in myself. It is safe to say that I will not be returning to this location and it was not worth the $6 I spent on one drink.
I normally love this Starbucks, but my last visit not so much. Not happy when I get my drink far from full. I will admit I ordered it without ice and using my star points, but a venti is a venti.

Very very long wait, they have to work on the schedule, so we don't wait 30 min for cup of coffe when we drive 7 hours straight.   They have to consider people driving between sates, usually tired and have no time to wait 30 min for a cup of coffe..

I go specifically to this Starbucks whenever I can because the staff makes the coffee taste even better. I happen to go in on a Friday morning and we all had a big laugh because I was the fourth Mike in a row. They hustle the orders out and do it with a smile... I'll be back for my next cuppa coffee soon.
- Mike #4

It's always busy which doesn't bother me, however service over the years as gone down. Yesterday I went in to pickup a mobile order and I saw the man put non fat milk in my drink that was supposed to have almond milk. I informed the barista who looked annoyed and said I was lying. Her co worker who put the milk in told her I was right and he did put the wrong milk in. The manager I assume was sitting on the bar side and went back over to help them and re make my drink. I am just frustrated by the lack of an I'm sorry we will remake it no problem. If I am paying $10 for a coffee it should be made correctly. This location is close to my night class and work or I'd honestly go elsewhere.

My experience at this Starbucks has been fantastic.  True, there are times when the line is very long but it's in downtown Nashville and if they are busy on a regular basis that tells me they must be doing something right.  My drink orders are always filled quickly and I've not had any problems with the quality of my drinks or food.  The baristas at this location are friendly and I always look forward to stopping in when I can.

Horrible Service unable to complete the simplest request without having to repeat it 2 if not 3 times. Apparently a Venti Vanilla Latte no foam and 120 degree causes great vexing on the person working the drive thru. The staff is incredibly slow inefficient and indifferent. The mgr has no more interest in customer service than the staff. It is quite unfortunate and at $5 a cup of coffee it should b an incredibly BIG DEAL .....

Always enjoy the Starbucks beverages and eatables, which I missed during the initial COVID-19 precautions.  Thank you Starbucks for offering mobile ordering.  Most mornings of late, it seemed the bulk of the customers have been using the drive through and running inside a mostly empty store, wearing my face mask for a quick pickup, has felt pretty low risk.  Staff are always wearing masks, and the app notice that "Your order is ready", helped avoid standing and waiting for my to go order.
Not so great today, while my order was ready and was prepared just as ordered, I was dismayed to see not one of the several customers in the store wearing a mask.  Especially the couple seated by the doorway and customers placing orders at the counter.  
I understand there isn't a "requirement" to wear a mask, so for now I suppose I'll either brew at home or use the drive through.
I am not sure they know what they are doing both in ringing the register or making the drinks. Worst latte macchiato ever.

This is a full-sized Starbucks, not a cart or hut. I love this location! The employees are all super friendly and have been from the get-go. The various batistas quickly learned my order and always make me feel welcome. They have typical Starbucks fare...cups, mugs, snacks. And a pretty good selection of breakfast and lunch foods. When new drinks come out, they are quick to offer samples. There's lots of coffee competition on this block, but if you're a diehard Starbuckser on Poydras...your coffee dreams have finally come true!

This is the slowest Starbucks in existence. During my last visit I ordered a Iced Caramel Macchiato and they forgot the espresso! 

This morning:  

- We were lined up to the door and I've been waiting in line about 15 minutes.

- Their truck unloaded everything in the front covering up some prime seating.

- There is a man sleeping in the front of the café. I guess they are too busy to eject him. 

If this weren't the only Starbucks in Downtown Nashville with any type of seating area (the other two are in hotels)  I would be choosing another location. 

Once Starbucks allows their franchise locations to order ahead via the app I think that will help with the speed issues.

Good food - fast service and accurate ordering. Space inside is regular/ clean & friendly. Free WIFI (awesome)! Overall 4 stars to my previous rating bc well deserved. I've been coming here early morning for ah cup of Joe. Enjoy the staff & environment.

Disappointed with the service of this location.

Ordered ahead through the app so I wouldn't have to stand in line. My coffee was ready but the food wasn't. I asked about the food; the response I got was "I just do drinks." Okay, but what about the rest of my order...she walked away.

Finally I see a food item put into the pickup section. It was mine...but where was the rest of it. Sat back down and continued to wait. Finally went back to ask and they said they're working on it. Once the guy came over with my oatmeal he had the wrong kind. Ordered blueberry but got the classic. Guess they figured I didn't want or need agave syrup and the nut medley. At least he tossed in the berries.

Needless to say, I won't be going back if I'm ordering food. Service was slow and my order was wrong.
How could you not love Starbucks! Exceptional staff also! I highly recommend an Iced Caramel macchiato!

Typically don't go to Starbucks, would prefer supporting local businesses. However, I received a gift card and needed some cold brew this last Sunday. Ordered 2 plain cold brew coffees, there were a ton of people waiting for drinks. The place was total chaos. Essentially only 1 person making drinks and multiple people standing around. I ended up waiting 20 minutes and when I asked about my order the cashier said I have 10 drinks ahead of mine. I walked out without my coffees and went to Nola beans. This Starbucks needs to add people or train employees to handle the busy times. No plans on coming back.

I'm from out of town and this was honestly the rudest and worst service ever. They could be less interested in doing anything for you. Try not to interrupt their convo by ordering your drink...ridiculous.

I come here because it's the closest Starbucks to my house, but they need to figure out a better system because I waited 25 minutes in line. That's a long wait for a coffee and pre-cooked breakfast sandwich! The line is always super long and awkward (people coming from two different directions), but I know it's probably just peak hours. I recommend ordering inside because it's a little quicker!

Aside from that the people are friendly!
Best Starbucks around. They always have a dog biscuit for Piper  super friendly staff
Great service! They are always very nice and accommodating. Despite the long lines I still really like the coffee here. They do a great job all the way around...

I love going into Starbucks and ordering a medium coffee. That look the barista gives you is always fit for framing. They scowl at you like you just walked into a McDonalds and ordered a Whopper.

Starbucks: "We don't have 'medium' here."

Me: "Yeah, you do. It's the size in the middle between the big one and little one."

I was once acquainted with someone who hated the word 'crotchless.' She'd wince and roll her eyes whenever she had to say it (which was surprisingly often). This Starbucks employee said 'medium' that same way my acquaintance said 'crotchless.' I made sure to ask for the medium roast too just for extra effect.

Anyway, after that awkward exchange things flowed smoothly. I can't bring myself to say 'Grande'. (It's my 'crotchless.')

This location on 109 St is always quick and orderly. There have been times I walked in here and it was crazybusy but the employees always managed to herd the coffee cattle in an efficient manner.

I don't think I have to go into detail about what they serve here. Just remember the Denis Leary routine about coffee-flavoured coffee, "They got mochaccino, they got chocaccino, frapaccino, capuccino, rapaccino, alpaccino, wtf?!" And as you already read, I got coffee-flavoured coffee. MEDIUM!

So remember: quick, clean, and (slightly) argumentative. I kind of instigated the latter though so I accept 26.3 % of responsibility.

I prefer to patronize independent businesses, but unfortunately the closest indy coffee spot is a 10-minute drive. On the other hand, this newer Starbucks is about the same distance from my parents' house, only I can walk. So in this case, environmental footprint is more important than independent operation.

Most of the hate in the reviews seems to be reserved for the drive-thru, to which I can't speak. However, the inside is cheery and bright, with plenty of plug-ins and fast wifi. My barista, who apparently normally worked at a different store (Drexel Hill?) and was helping out, was super nice. I wanted a mocha, but when I asked if it was very sweet, he said fairly and offered to cut down the sweetness (halving the pumps of chocolate they put in it). On top of that, he told me to let him know if it still was too sweet. It came out quickly, and while it's not as good as a mocha at Javista in LA, it's a solid mocha.

In any case, I will continue to do my best to seek out independent businesses to support whenever it's environmentally responsible to do so, but this Starbucks, at least from my limited experience, is a perfectly worthy substitute when necessary.

The baristas were nice and gave me prompt service.  I ordered a Iced Mocha. At approximately 12:30pm. There were three employees working which is why I'm giving them just three stars.  Every single counter was filthy.  Spilled coffee, sticky goo and what looked like scraps of lettuce were scattered on the counter.  Come on people, you sell food and beverages wipe the counters down.  I was the only customer in the Starbucks and two employees were just standing around chatting when I came in. The third came out of the back.  At least one of them could have cleaned this sticky gross mess when no customers were there.  I would have given 2 1/2 stars had it been possible.

Nice and convenient Starbucks in the same plaza with Panera Bread. This works out perfectly because I don't like the food at Starbucks and I don't like the coffee at Panera. So I get my coffee to go at Starbucks while I wait for me food at Panera.
Went to this location twice in one day and both times over 20 minutes in the drive thru!! This store sucks! Management needs to find out what the hell is going on! Won't be back!!

Drive Thru Organization:  Thank you for being open during COVID-19 but please (please, oh please!) put some cones up so cutting in line doesn't happen now that it's drive thru only.  Nothing worse than waiting through this line without caffeine to have folks cut in from the other entrance who weren't waiting nearly as long - we are living in a society here people.

Awful customer service. I walked in to grab a cup of faucet water just to take my medication with and the barista (Cameron S. ) was very rude and told me to get in line. That day the line was long and since
I did not need to pay for the water I did not see the need to wait in a huge line while they can just grab a cup and run it under the faucet. Instead I had to wait in line for no reason. Won't be back to this location again.

This location is literally next door to where I work so I visit often, haha.
Sometimes I work at 6:30am, sometimes I work at 7:45am. Either way, the baristas in the drive thru are helpful and friendly! I believe they recognize me too, haha.
Anytime I order a food item, they will ask if I would like it warmed up. I also know that my coworkers are treated well when they go too. Our drinks are made to order. 
Depending on what time you go, the drive thru can get pretty busy. I personally have not had a problem, but I have driven by and seen a long line before. It definitely depends on day and hour.
The Medicine Ball is a wonderful beverage! Made of hot tea, lemonade (steamed) and other healthy items, it helps when you are sick! Not a cure, of course, but it will ease your symptoms so you can temporarily function for work.
One last thing about this location, there is plenty of space to sit with friends or conduct a coffee meeting with peers! Nice little patio in good weather and large sitting room inside! One of Reno's best Starbucks locations.

a haiku for starbucks

seating is drafty
but bathrooms are toasty warm
guess it could be worse

(also, my soy hot cocoa was tasty)

I have to say of all my experiences as Starbucks, my travel through the south Starbucks have been horrible. The drinks just don't taste the same as up north. They aren't made with that same flavor and they get very frazzled with changes of drinks!

I am not a big Starbucks fan, but when a friend suggested a meeting at Starbucks, I agreed.
The location is perfect for all the business people in the area. It is located on the corner of lakeside and McCarran in a business park.
The store is fairly good size with a couple tables to sit at outside if you wish.
There is almost two separate sections to this store, the front where you order and a back room where there are several tables and chairs. Business meetings and computers were going on all over. I will have to say there free Wi-Fi is really good.
The coffee is OK, it did not taste burnt, I asked for my latte at 140 degrees, and it was served to me correctly.
If you are looking for a place to do business or have a meeting, this place will fit the bill.

I love my Starbucks, but I went to this location around 8:45 AM on a Saturday a few weeks ago and when I ordered the bacon egg and gouda with a grande caramel macchiato the cashier informed me that they don't have anymore bacon egg gouda sandwiches. On a quiet Saturday morning! I must have come on a off day and they clearly had sold out the day before, but that was really odd. 

My drink was great though as always so no hard feelings.
Super rude barista. She was not friendly and took 5 minutes before even starting our drinks. Definitely the worst Starbucks I've been to.

Starbucks is not really something a challenge in terms of food. You know what you're going to get. Customer service, however, is very important. 

I've been coming to the Egg Harbor & Greentree starbucks for years. As a regular, I can say that the staff here is extremely friendly and helpful. 

One issue you may have depends on the time of the day. At some points, high school lets out and this place can be as loud as a school cafeteria. Other times, several parents decided that this Starbucks is a good place to bring their children. Being in Washington Township, they have the "my kid does no wrong" attitude and often the parents will allow their infants to cry, or their younger children to run around as if this were a daycare. It does affect the experience of a nice place to relax with a tasty beverage. 

The service gets a 4-star rating. The crowd sometimes kills it though.

Coffee and food are good- what you would expect from any other Starbucks.  However I wanted to review because of the employees- every time I'm here they are nothing but sweet, polite and smiley.  Wish more places would act like that.  
Line moves fast.

On my way up to NH, we stopped at the Starbucks at James Cooper Service Area. This location doesn't have the mobile order but accepts Starbucks cards as a form of payment. There was a long line as usual. They offer a blonde roast coffee but it takes 5-7 minutes for a fresh cup. I ordered two beverages and it came out in a timely manner.

It great to have another Starbucks in Delaware County with a drive through.   Went through today and got a VERY hot barista made drink in a reasonable amount of time.  This Starbucks replaced the cute quiet one up the road nearer to Rte 320 that shared the lot with the pretzel company.

AJ has a fantastic persona! She is friendly, informative, and witty. She helped out with my London fog latte (in Proper English :D) and provided a thoroughly good Starbucks experience! 

The London Fog Latte is a bit less sweet then I imagined, but still tastes fantastic!

This Starbucks sets the standard for the many Starbucks in Tucson. The friendly Baristas, the quality drinks, and service never disappoint. The location is prime and convenient. The best coffee on the East side of Tucson!

Two words...Barista Baby!

So you think Starbucks coffee is bitter?  Wrong...it's better and you wanna know why?  The obvious of course is that you've gotta start with some pretty awesome coffee beans...after that it's all about the Barista. Doesn't matter which Starbucks I visit...whether it's a drive-thru, in a mall, airport or Target.  Those Baristas are highly trained professionals who know what they're doing.

I've been to many other coffee houses and time and time again, my #1 complaint is lack of consistency.  I mean it's not like they don't have great coffee, but please make me a non-fat latte that tastes the same all the time.

Until then, I remain a Starbucks devotee...peace out.

My friend and I stopped at this Starbucks because she felt her blood sugar dropping. She is a type 1 diabetic and needed something to spike her blood sugar. The line was long but she was willing to wait. We got out of line and were talking. She started to feel dizzy. She checked her pump (monitors her blood sugar levels) and noticed she was below 60. Not good! So we then paid attention to who was receiving their order. Everyone that received their drink was well after us!! I went back in line to get her an apple juice to help with her sugar, because at this point she was dropping lower. The two girls that were in front of me received their drinks BEFORE US!!!! At this point she went up to ask about her drink. They made it immediately. After we left she checked her receipt and when she got her drink and it was 26 minutes ! 
I get your lines are long but you need a system !

When you walk in you are greeted either by a line of people wanting who are moved through fairly quickly or you are lucky enough to be first in line.

The color tones are neutral with plenty of natural light offered through the plentiful windows.  Seating options are either tables (good if you are using the place to work) or comfy single seat cushy chairs (food for solo time or to hang with a friend or two).

For this trip I ordered a s'mores Frappuccino... to which I would say that even though it looked neuroticisms and had plentiful amount of whipped cream (yum!) ... the flavor was underwhelming compared to one that was prepared by another barista.  Even though I have gone through this experience, I would still be willing to go back again...because s'mores is life.

I witnessed one of the baristas wiping down a toilet(not using gloves) with a wash rag, she lifted the seat and really got it clean. Then, check this out, proceeded to wipe down all the mugs and cups for sale with said pee rag. That's foul.

The drive-thru line at this location is ALWAYS long, but because I expect it at this location and know to give myself the extra 10-12 minutes that part is irrelevant at this point.
After waiting a decent amount of time just to get to order a female in an annoyed tone says "what can I get you?" Now it may be petty of me, but at every other Starbucks they usually say "welcome to Starbucks what can I get you?" Or "how are you? What can I get you?".. I felt very rushed to give my order & I barely had time to finish ordering my last drink when a total was being given.. I apologized and asked her if I could change the size on the last one and she recited the total. I verified that she heard my size change and apologized again and once again a very annoyed "yes" thru the mic and that was it. I get up to the window and a girl with a matching voice and name tag that said "Cassie" is at the window.. once again no customer service, no nothing. Recites my total, scans my phone and closes the window without a word being said. I wanted to use a reward (which had she not just scanned and closed the window I would've had the chance to tell her the first time). She opens the window, hands me a drink to which I explain I wanted to use a reward and she says she needs to rescan my phone. Hands me the other 2 drinks and closes the window again.. still with no words exchanged. I didn't even get the chance to tell her one of our drinks was the wrong size and I was so disappointed and frustrated it never got fixed. I get that it can get busy and hectic, but this is the only location I chronically have customer service issues with, BUT this experience was worse than normal. If this location wasn't a block away and most convenient with having a newborn I wouldn't even go to this one. And as a matter of fact.. I feel that after this experience I'll be going back to other coffee shops that appreciate their loyal customers. Unfortunately, I know this review and experience won't be address, but maybe by reading it you can save yourself the long wait (inside and drive they) and the snobby experience.
Really great service every time we go to this location. It's nearly always busy but the employees are always friendly.
New "no straw lid"on my iced coffee doesn't fit!  Way too loose.  Of course drink spilled as the lid fell off.  BS.

I love Coffee and I love Starbucks in moderation, I typically tend to try and take my business to locally owned coffee shops, but when that isn't an option Starbucks is always great. 

The coffee is consistent, the drinks are always thoughtfully made and served exactly like you ask, that cannot go without notice. The service at this particular location is great, there is one guy who could stand a little "livening" up but aside from his unengaging demeanor, everyone is pleasant. 

This is near my work and when we have a craving I brave the crappy traffic to get here and always leave pleased. 

I wish this place were closer to my office, aside from that 4 stars!

This starbucks is just okay. There isn't really anything special about it. Sometimes they mess up my orders here when I do the online mobile ordering. They have added the wrong milk to my coffee and also gave me the wrong food once. Everytime I order in store my order doesn't come out wrong only when I order on the app. There is always a huge line here hence why I do the online ordering. Sometimes the staff here is in a good mood but other times they aren't. You can tell by the way they are talking to the customers if they are or not. 

Overall I will continue to come to this starbucks because its convent for me but I hope that their customer service improves and they stop messing up my order.
I love this Starbucks the girls and sometime guys are always friendly I'm a regular and they are very nice they remember what I get.  If I could I would give them 10  stars

I love Starbucks but this is not one that I would recommend if you can avoid it.

The one good thing is that there is a drive through, not many people like getting out to get coffee so it's nice that it has one. There is plenty of seating indoors and I think when it's nice outside there is also outdoor seating.

They don't really make my coffee that great, they never have. If you get frapps or lattes only then it's not that bad.. you can't mess those up. Like in my other reviews- caramel iced coffee with soy and it sucked almost every time. I stopped going here when the last 3 times they gave me the soy to put in myself, um, somethings wrong there. I was really unhappy with that. The people aren't that great or memorable so wouldn't stop by here again.

Good product, poor customer service.
The wife and I came to this particular location on St. Patrick's Day around 1:15pm to order our usual; while we're sitting in line we hear the window attendant taking the lady in front of us' order in what seemed to be a cheery mood. As we pull up to the speaker their tone is completely different, snappy, and pompous as they (oh and their name is Stephen) tell me I can't order a Frap because "they're brand name and call them Frappuccinos" which normally would t bother me because it's a common occurrence when I try to order via shorthand with the Starbucks franchise but Stephen in particular was just seemed to be in a bad mood all of a sudden; seeming like being petty toward his customers made him feel better. Then as we pull up to the window to pay he rips my debit card out of my hand then proceeds to hand me our order and say "here's your stuff" and closes the window. 
I've never had an issue with this location before but I hope proper actions are taken to make sure Stephen doesn't feel the need to treat his paying customers like a nuisance anymore.

This is actually the place I tried my first Starbucks coffee, so it holds a special place in my heart. It's not perfect, but really what place is? They do a great job for being constantly so busy, and I appreciate that.

This place is always busy!! I recommend getting the Starbucks app; you can rack up stars to get free drinks and you don't have to wait in line. I normally place my order on the mobile app 6-8 minutes prior to getting there. It's definitely one of the smaller Starbucks around. There are only three 4 top tables outside and a hand full of seats inside. My drinks are always made well and plus it's a minute from work.

Nothing worse than getting on the road and finding that the Iced Latte you ordered is mistakenly an Americano with splendid in it...even though the sticker on it says Iced Latte.

Got a plane to catch...hope the pilot didn't get his training at Starbucks.

I try to avoid this location as much as possible as I find them slow and they always seem to be out of ingredients. Yesterday was no exception. I was the ONLY person in line and I had to wait of 5 minutes for someone to take my order.  I wanted a Very Berry Refresher nope had to have Cool Lime. I asked for light ice and I got 3/4 of ice. I added a photo showing clearly on the sticker light ice so I clearly didn't stutter.
The line is ALWAYS so long and slow. The coffees are so expensive, if they r allowed on campus they should have to mark down their beverages it's crazy.
They have really turned around & they are so personable & know my emotional support animal's Name!!

Been going to this Starbucks for quite some time now. I order the same drink each time and I don't find the drink that I order to be that difficult to understand/make (green tea lemonade no classic syrup). Without a doubt each time I go my drink is ALWAYS made wrong whether it's not the right size cup I ordered or half the time they don't add the lemonade when I specify it 3-4 times prior to paying. I think Starbucks needs to hire more attentive people than what they currently have on staff at this location. Ridiculous.

If you're planning to study don't even think about it. I can't even hear myself think! The staff( mainly the guys) are so damn loud. Especially this one guy. I've seen him around for a while so I can tell he's comfortable to say and do whatever he wants. Extremely obnoxious! His shift was over 15 minutes ago and he's still lingering! 


I understand starbucks is not a library but I'm telling you ... it's impossible to be productive!

Every time we go here they forget our order they will serve the people before after and everyone in the drive through. I speak up and they say oh yeah what was your order? Every dang time! 8 people working and they can't manage a black tea?

This morning I picked up a nitro cold brew with cascara foam on my way to work. As I picked it up, I realized how flat the NCB was, and there was zero foam in it! There should be a half an inch of foam for this order. This did not bother me too much, but I should've tasted it before I walked away. I left the store in a hurry as I was in a rush, but as I drove away I realized how watered down my drink was. I wouldn't be as annoyed, but the fact that I just paid ~$5 for a sad and watered down cold brew left me still tired and with a bad taste in my mouth. I had to stop by a different Starbucks near my office to pick up a fresh new one. Pleaaaaaaase get it together.

Worst experience today 02/13/2021 around 01:00  pm . Ordered and waited 17 min inside the store. Few people came after me, ordered and took their order. When I asked the girl, she looked my order and couldn't find it. It charged to my account but I didn't get any coffee today. THANK YOU STARBUCKS.

This location is fine. It's not spectacular but also not the worst. We typically stop in here because its the last stop before we hit Delaware. They don't have any gluten free items and they are a little slow but it gets the job done and you get to have coffee that isn't Dunkin or whatever other brand.

Full Service Starbucks coffee & breakfast sandwiches INSIDE I95 Southbound rest-stop (to your far right.) Clara Barton is LAST I95 southbound rest area before Delaware Memorial al Bridge.   Pls note: Separate entrance into Starbucks from outside of Reston w/ regular & disables parking.  Staff were excellent! 4 Stars (not 5) due to bathrooms being part of rest-stop & not serviced I.e. not clean, hand-towels empty, clothing hooks inside stalls broken. 
Starbucks opened at 6:15am today - 9pm (not sure of posted hrs.

I've been coming to this Starbucks for about a month now, simply because I moved in down the street. My old favorite was the busiest in the district (and I've had an on-again off-again relationship as an employee in my past - NOT currently an employee and likely never will be again. My past experience was at a nightmare of a store... eek), so I must admit: I have high expectations when it comes to my 'Bucks.

Regardless of whether I choose the drive through or going into the cafe itself, I have always experienced smiles, cheery dispositions, and yummy beverages. 

The very first time I went through the drive through, I didn't have cash on me, and my phone wouldn't connect to the darn cell phone network. I couldn't connect to my Starbucks application, and thusly could not pay for my drink. He simply have me my drink and sent me on my way, and when I tried to pay the next time, he refused. I realize some might think this is common practice, but I've also had the experience where you just leave the drive through empty handed. 

Lastly, they have a good sense of humor. Sure, I've had a messed up drink once or twice, but it's their ability to handle it with grace and still be fun/funny during the recovery of a mess up that makes them stand out.
Service is always slow. I went there on a Sunday morning and they were out of everything including bottled water. Will never patronize this place again.
Coffee at not be great and quality questionable but customer service is amazing. The staff was very gracious a made sure they got our large order right and our names correct.

This store is dirty and gross. Employees are rude and I even saw water leaking from their ceiling onto their coffee machines for hours. Dirty!! Onto their drinkAVOID. Go local!!! So many other cheaper and better local coffee places within the same block.

Update: their management is horrible and they're inconsiderate to their neighborhood
My favorite Starbucks by far! Everyone here is always so nice and helpful, EXCEPTIONAL service every visit! I pass 2 other Starbucks store just to come this one.

I witnessed one of the baristas wiping down a toilet(not using gloves) with a wash rag, she lifted the seat and really got it clean. Then, check this out, proceeded to wipe down all the mugs and cups for sale with said pee rag. That's foul.

I was happily greeted at the door upon my arrival. The staff was very kind and attentive. The establishment was clean and offered a nice atmosphere for enjoying delicacies while using the free WiFi to get work done. There is adequate seating and the tables and lounge area are nicely kept.

My drink was delicious. My favorite beverage is the dragon drink. The staff made it exactly how I wanted it. My son got a birthday cake pop which he loved and didn't waste a single crumb. 

I will definitely be back to this location. There are Starbucks on almost every corner but this particular one is at the top of my list to visit while in the area.

To be fair, this location is incredibly busy... but the wait time for a mobile order is nuts. What's the point of ordering in advance when you have to wait another 10 minutes inside? Just disappointing.

It was a cold morning and all I wanted was a white chocolate peppermint mocha. I was on my way to school so I stopped at this location, no drive thru so I was forced to get out in the cold. It was a packed house.  I order my drink and they are out of white choc. Bummer. So I ordered a peppermint mocha=yuck. Tasted like dirt, not sweet and just when I thought they must have given me the wrong order, I tasted the peppermint on my last sip.  Never again will I waste my time getting out the car and paying $8 for a coffee and a danish when I can go to my local drive thru coffee shop and be way happier.    Lets remember why were NOT friends.

Small location inside a rest area but with a full menu. The milk and sweeteners are done by the baristas, not at a station, so make sure to ask for what you need. Service was slower than at dedicated locations but still fairly friendly. Not bad for a quick pick me up on the road.

Placed mobile order. Phone said would be ready at 4:06. When I pulled up, saw mobile line wrapped around the building. No problem, though. I parked in front and waited until 4:08. Imagine my aggravation when I tried to go in to pick up my order and there was a sign saying everyone had to go through the drive-thru. So, now it meant waiting until 4:25 for a coffee I ordered at 3:57 because I had to go sit in that long line. 
Had I known, at least I could have gotten in line when I arrived. 
If there is a problem at the store, the app should not accept orders!
What's the point of a mobile order if you have to wait in a long line? They owe me a free coffee at the VERY least.

One of the worst locations on the north side of Indy. Today there were TWO people working on drinks for over 13 people waiting....it took the cashier over 7 tries to put an iced coffee drink order in correctly. I get these are difficult times, but managers need to schedule enough employees to take care of customers.

Starbucks has not been my favorite for the past three years, they are ok in making sweet drinks, Frappuccino, those kind.  When it comes to making an espresso, a cappuccino, forget it, they don't even know how to pull great crema.  This goes for all Starbucks.

Really great service and employees are always super nice! The inside of this store is so clean and fresh and very welcoming! Would be nice to sit and have coffee once things are open again. Would definitely recommend this store.

My wife and I submitted a mobile order after eating next door at PDQ. It was my birthday and if you have the Starbucks app installed, they give you a free birthday drink. We submitted our order and I was pleased to see that the birthday offer chose the most expensive drink on the order (and didn't really seem to care that I added some extras like mocha drizzle). Anyway, the app said our order would be ready in about ten minutes, at right at ten minutes, we were sitting in the drive through. The person in front of us had a long complicated order (FOR ONE DRINK) and we sat there listening to her chat with the Starbucks employee for about five minutes before finally pulling forward. When I got to the speaker, you could hear the sense of relief in the order taker's voice when I said "Hi there, mobile order for James."

Anyway, we pulled around, and quickly picked up our drinks. They were made exactly as we had specified and were absolutely delicious. Lemmie tell you, Starbucks has a winner with their cold brew lines. I love mine with a bit of sweet cream and some mocha drizzle and this particular location nailed it. 

Note, it may be easier to walk inside and pick up your order as the line for the drive through tends to wrap around in weird places and block traffic.

Starbucks is literally out of every single thing I ever order. Today I ordered an oatmilk vanilla latte but of course they had no vanilla syrup, no toffee nut syrup, no caramel syrup and no oatmilk. Like what? I won't be back to Starbucks because they literally never have supplies.

I love Starbucks. I get coffee about every other day. Never have I had to wait 25 minutes for my coffee. 15-20 people behind me got theirs before me. This is after reminding them twice. This store needs to get it together.
Very nice people at this Starbucks and I felt the love with my latte and bagel. Everything was correct temperature and bagel was toasted to perfection. Thanks Again and Happy Valentines Day Y'all!!!

This place is hit or miss but today took the cake for me.. ordered my favorite skinny peppermint mocha and while I was waiting the girl at the window started sneezing and the she began blowing her nose....then proceeded to hand me my drink...so I asked her didn't you just blow your nose...she says to me I'm not sick... then I told her that I wanted my drink remade and someone else to give it to me...so I wait she leaves the window... then I'm watching this other person make my new drink... next thing I know she tried to hand me my new drink and informs me she washed her hands... (don't believe she did)I lost it by then and went off on her and the manager. I just asked the manager for my money back... I won't back to this Starbucks anymore..  that will save me money in the long run....

This is definitely one of my favorite Starbucks locations in the area!  The staff is really great and so quick at filling orders!

One thing to be aware of with this location, though, is the limited seating available.  There is one really large table and a few smaller ones, but there have been a few times when I have had to go to another Starbucks locations because of how packed this one was.  With that being said, I would always come with a back up plan in mind if you are planning to get work done while you enjoy your coffee.  

Nonetheless, I am a fan and dedicated customer!

It's frustrating when they say they are open at 5:30am and it's 5:40 and no one is at the drive through. Not the first time it's happen either. Why advertise that the opening is 5:30am if you aren't going to open til almost 6?!
I went to this location every morning before going to work. Sometimes 2 a day. It is super busy always better to order ahead of your there in morning rush.

So they have 3 people working.  Only one car in the drive through but I decided to go inside to use the restroom while I waited on my coffee. First their restrooms are closed. Second no one said hi or even acknowledged me when I walked in. Then the two guys stood there with their backs to me talking while girl was on the other side with her back to me. It literally took 6 minutes for them to even notice I was there. Worst Starbucks ever

Since I was in the area and nearby, I had not been here since the summer I wanted to see what I could get from here today. So, here's my review...

Positives
Love the location being in Cherry Hill, which is not too far from my house and township. As always, great atmosphere when you enter the place.  Two women conversating in their workout attire, working professionals drinking lattes and specially made drinks, people on their laptops making use of the store's Wi - Fi, barista's taking orders and fixing drinks for the patrons. Very busy this morning but not to where it slowed down customers or orders. Staff was courteous and professional and all had positive attitudes. Ended up getting a caramel coffee, but it took an unexpected turn...

Negative:
... my coffee order was black!!! I requested it with milk and caramel syrup. It was black coffee with only caramel syrup. Very very hot upon my first sip and was unable to drink until I got home and put my own creamer in it. The only thing that went wrong on this particular visit.
This is the slowest Starbucks and I've been to a lot of them. They spend too much time talking and joking amongst themselves.  They continually get orders wrong.  The need new staff in this store.
Sabrina the barista needs a grammy for her fricken awesome personality! Great location! Good service! Clean interior

Been here multiple times due to location. The last two times it has taken the barista over 15 minutes to make an iced coffee with one shot of espresso. The workers are all new and can't take the stress of making multiple drinks at once. Would recommend a different location.
Don't have decaf coffee?  What kind of Starbucks doesn't have decaf drip coffee...this one!!  Don't waste your time stopping. Kong wait line, poor service, poor selection

Stopped in for some go-go juice on my drive to Virginia. Staff was nice. And they were polite to everybody. There was a lot of people from all over the world here. And they treated everybody kind.
People left sticky notes for the staff to support them. Kind words go along way!

I have come to Tucson for a week's vacation and have been going to  this Starbucks every morning.  We always take for granted that the coffee and breakfast will be consistent (which it  was), but what I loved about THIS Starbucks was how cheerful and welcoming the staff were and how efficiently they filled orders.  A greaat way to staart the day, thanks!

This dude made me go back outside......... in the rain.......... with my 3 and 5 year old babies....... to grab 5 cent to finish paying for my drink. I am not joking. If this wasn't the closest starbucks in my hood, I would NOT come back. Like, you didn't have 5 cents to loan a playa on this $800.00 sbux drink???????????? damn homie.

Tests some soreness keeping it real quick to bouts of colorectal discomfort and urinary tract stingingly be there in the morning to imbibe my favorite venti caramel latte... Astra espresso LoL lol because I am not sure if I can stay woke up at this time of year! Happy Christmas and New Year
Sunflower mask takes joy saying no to people, in a condescending way. I watched her be hostile with the customer both in front of and behind me. Incredibly rude- woof.

I go to this location almost every morning. Staff is really sweet, especially Laty (I hope I have her name right). I am not sure if she is a manager or not but she always remembers me and is super friendly and welcoming. And the store is always clean.
Slowest Starbucks in town. Doesn't matter if it's 8am or 3pm.  If you go inside you'll see stressed out employees rolling their eyes at each other.

I love to come into this location especially because of one of the employees. Elia is always so kind and welcoming when I come in and prepares my drinks with such great care. This is the main reason I come in!

Conveniently located in the Central Business District.  Good place to get work done and get a drink while you are at it.  Barista wanted to be sure she got my order in correctly and definitely out in the extra effort to make sure it was accurate. Overall a clean location with plenty of seating for a downtown location.

I've been coming here for sometime now. This Starbucks is in a great neighborhood and parking usually isn't that difficult to locate. The employees at this location are very friendly and work efficiently. Theirs seating towards the rear of the store which seats a good amount of customers with  additional seating at the bar area looking out the window. The store always looks clean and well kept. They also have various mugs, instant coffee, coffee beans for sale. They had a 30% sale for Christmas time and ended up purchasing a mug. 

I liked the decorations they put up for Christmas and the music being played was great. I'm happy when I come in here it isn't too busy or I probably wouldn't stay. I feel a lot of people will take away from the overall environment. I feel some people talk too loud and I don't enjoy hearing other people's conversation. I would stop by here if your in the area and check it out.
It was ok... aside from the rat maze trying to find the entrance and them being 'out' of the one drink I wanted. Seems I've got popular tastes despite being different a lot...

Perfectly reasonable, perfectly normal Center City Starbucks. They're right across from a Target.

Normal amenities. Free Wi-Fi, they take credit cards, etc. Upstairs seating. Lots of natural light during the day.

Friendly service!

If you're staying, ask for a mug. And be sure to bus your own cups to the counter when you're done; there's no table service, naturally.

This location is always hit or miss. Sometimes my order is great and sometimes my order is wrong. I counted once and figured out they had messed up my order more than 12 times out of maybe 20. And when I say messed up my order I mean either forgetting something, completing giving me the wrong item, messing up a drink order, or something else. It became an ongoing joke anytime I went there. The staff was usually helpful when I reported the mistakes but it just shouldn't happen that often to begin with.

Walked in this past week to the new Starbucks out of morbid curiosity. I was not acknowledged at all while the store was basically empty minus one guy on his laptop. I waited a minute and a half to get service at the counter where I was rudely served.

My regular drip coffee was horrid and the service was even worse...no actually check that. The worst part about this whole thing is that there is another coffee shop in the same building! The guy over there was super nice, helpful and his coffee was outstanding! Apparently, he has been in the building for 4 years when $tarbuck$ moved in...what a bunch of greedy people. 

Not only am I never coming here again for my daily coffee, I'll just walk an extra 50 steps to get much better coffee and much better service!


p.s. If you don;t like the other little guy in the building, there are literally 3 other places within a 100 foot radius. This was a poor job in picking out locations...shame ::ding ding::
This Starbucks is awesome!!!! They accommodated my last minute request for coffee travelers and were super customer service oriented. The barista Ed even helped me carry out my travelers to my car.

This Starbucks is conveniently located in the Central Business District in Nola. With close proximity to most of the major hotels and business, banks and high rises in the area.  

 We were famished walking around looking for a breakfast spot.  It was Memorial Day and so many places were closed. We found ourselves lost in the area until we spotted a Starbucks and decided to go in and refuel with a coffee or snack.  My party of four all bought coffee, frappes and I got a new cold brew that just came out with a froth on top. It was so good and I wished I would have bought a Venti but then remembered this was just a quick stop.  

Besides the cool drinks what set this Starbucks apart was the service we received. As mentioned earlier, we were lost and wondering the area looking for a place to eat.  Before we left I asked the baristas behind the counter where would be a good homey place to eat.  They stopped what they were doing and literally threw a bunch of options and places to eat that I wasn't aware of and emphasizing on what would be my next stop and review, Mother's Place. 

Thanks for being so helpful and nice Starbucks team!
best sbux ever!!! clean, fast and only place that will remember my name and order!!!!!

This Starbucks is located in the 2nd floor west wing of Harrahs casino. Very convenient if you are staying in the casino and it's too cold to go outside. It is decent in size and the staff was very friendly!
Never get an order right. Hot not cold big not small not sweet too sweet. Never fail to get it wrong. Remind me not to come back.  Cute inside but coffee is a disaster.

[780]

The large Starbucks location is located at the Gloucester Premium Outlets.

No drive thru as it's part of the outlets.

It's a busy location but they were able to work the line quickly and prepare the order correctly.

Plenty of indoor and outdoor seating.

We actually spilled our coffee outside before taking a sip and the staff replaced it with a smile.

We will definitely be back.

This Starbucks sucks. When I pulled up to the window, I paid and he handed me my drink which was completely just black iced coffee (not what I ordered) and the worker was trying to argue with me that there was my almond milk, caramel, and vanilla cream in it. How are you gonna argue all that is in there when it was straight up black??? He told me he wouldn't do anything about it and told me to keep driving. I've never been treated so rudely

Went in to get an iced latte and piece of lemon pound cake. Asked the cashier if the cake was fresh she said it was, which was not true.   I then watched as 6 people who ordered after me got their beverages, some of which were quite more elaborate than mine, were given their beverages. As I was the only Caucasian in 
 In the place, including both employees and customers, one has to wonder if there was any racial overtones involved here. At any rate, I won't be returning to this store.

Great location.  Location is in a great area of town so they are always packed with customers, especially in the morning. They handle it well, I have never gotten a bad drink from them, it may sometimes take a few minutes because of crowds, but well worth it.

Small Starbucks open 24/7 on the rest area stop. Either first or last rest stop area on the turnpike depending on which direction tore traveling.  

I wanted one dark and one blonde roast but barista told me all they had was pike. Mind you it was 6.30am.  I was very disappointed.  

Bakery items looked good & fresh and the pike was ok.

If they don't want me to take the bakery item I ordered, that clearly had my name on it, then next time don't leave me standing near the mobil orders without acknowledging me. The reason people order on the mobil app is so that they don't have to wait when they get there. If the order isn't ready that's one thing, but if it's ready and sitting there but you have to wait to be acknowledged by employee(s), who are working right near there and just ignoring you, that's different. Get a better system for mobil app order pick up. Someone needs to monitor it. Also, rude female employee, don't tell me for future reference don't touch anything here. Instead, how about you say, "Sorry for the wait." Work on your attitude at work or get another job that you like so you're polite to customers.

Went in for a coffee and breakfast this morning and meeting a client for some paperwork exchange. After ordering I was the only customer in the store (with my mask on) and I was told that all the tables are closed......ok so I went outside. Odd I could eat my food or anything. A real bummer and I don't understand. Staff was nice but I think 4 behind the counter all staring at each other was weird too. So drive through but don't plan on sitting down.

What a beautiful, new Starbucks! Very cool design and easy access right off I-65 south. Very friendly staff and they made our coffees perfect! We will add this to 'must stop' list anytime we are trekking south!

It's kinda dark and dirty in this Starbucks. The girls working here were friendly but opted to gossip about the customers instead of cleaning the very dirty dining room. Also, a lot of homeless people hang out here.

I stayed up all night writing an essay. Next thing I know, it's a little past 5:00 in the morning and I'm ready for some coffee. I don't feel like getting dressed, so I get in my car in my pajamas and drive to the nearest Starbucks. I was the only customer in line and Marlena takes her time waddling up to the register and says "msdgsd." WTF..? like what in the fuck does that even mean? Whatever, I decided to brush it off and said "Hello, Good Morning. May I please get a double CHOCOLATE chip frappuccino with idk maybe like 4 shots of espresso?" What do I get? More fucking mumbling. She mumbles again and points to where I'm supposed to wait for my drink. 
As I'm waiting for my drink, I notice Marlena is engaging in an actual conversation.. an ACTUAL conversation with the person who was behind me. Why didn't she speak real words to me? Was it because I was in my pajamas? I really don't understand. I definitely wasn't being rude so I don't know why the fuck I was treated so disrespectfully. When I receive "my drink", it ends up being a Java Chip Frappuccino. That's not even close to what I fucking ordered. How incompetent can someone be? To avoid getting charged with battery, I decide to leave the store... with the wrong drink.. and I assure you I will not be returning. lmfao what a fucking joke

If you go in the morning, it's so much better.
I started coming here on my way to work and the morning crew is soooooo much better. I haven't had a problem with my coffee yet and it has been delicious every time. At least someone there follows the lines!!

They are building my confidence back into this place.
GO TEAM ICED COFFEE.

Starbucks is the BEST coffee place to go to! Starbucks has drinks from hot to cold. From sizes mini through venti. They have seasonal choices like a peppermint mocha (for Winter) and so much more! You can go and get your work/homework here while enjoying a delicious drink and snack! This place is also very convenient and close to home- no drive through though! Starbucks is 5 stars for me!

The staff are very friendly, though usually very busy.  The new building is very nice.  I like Starbucks coffee (if you don't, well then....).   I have very few complaints.  One is that sometimes (not usually) the music is too loud.  But overall, this is an excellent Starbucks!

This is my favorite location. The staff is great, store is clean, service is fast. Favorite part of the day is coming in for my mobile order(new addiction) and being greeted by name, so personal.

1 Star-   Total failure of an experience based on this experience would not return. Would not recommend.

2 Star-  Below average on several levels, not a total failure. Wouldn't seek out to return or recommend.

3 Star-  Average experience, minimum expectations met. Nothing that says wow or that stands out. Would return if someone else wanted to come, not a regular go to.

4 Star-  Above average experience, will come here again and recommend to friends and family.

5 Star-  This will be a regular go to and will be highly recommended to people I know. Exceeds expectations on a consistent basis.

How hard is it to follow a THREE ingredient recipe? They consistently use the wrong tea bag and this last visit was "the straw that broke the camels back". I brought my drink and told them it was wrong. Instead of them correcting the issue and sending me on my way, I had to wait for everyone (PLUS the people that came in after me) to get their order. I'm done with the Big Bend Starbucks and will drive those additional miles to get better customer service. (ie, TARGET)

I'm not a big fan of this location overall.  I've interacted with a couple female baristas who were very lovely, but the staff as a whole comes off as very aloof and unprofessional.

I've walked in there on multiple occasions, with no one in line, and had to wait as the baristas finished their personal conversations (clearly not work related) with each other with their backs turned to me before anyone acknowledged that I was there.  This just always feel so rude to me, especially considering that most Starbucks really seem to put a lot of emphasis on great customer service.

Also, not the most amiable bunch. Though I think I'm a bit spoiled by the location over on Coast Village Rd. where the staff are extremely friendly and consideration.  This crew - not so much.

This is your standard Starbucks. What's notable about this location is the cute building it's in - since it's in the historic district in Philly. The doors to enter are super cute and it's not too busy. 

The downside of this location is they moved really slowly preparing drinks and food. My typical Starbucks is in the heart of Manhattan and they move significantly faster than this location.

For some reason, this one is always disappointing. The male baristas/cashiers are usually unpleasant/mildly surly. I've repeatedly gotten the bottom of the barrel coffee, meaning the last bit with all the grounds in it and they have made a few busted drinks for my wife as well. The condiment counter is always dirty and the trash is always busting out of the top full.

Now I'm fairly easy to please, and if the coffee was $1, I would have no problem with lousy service and grinds in my coffee (multiple times), but for what is charged, I think things should be better. Honestly, this is the only Starbucks in the city I have a problem with. The rest are all awesome.

Don't waste your time and money. The worst service- slow and don't care. Will ask you to repeat what you ordered several times. And when you get your coffee, you might as well have drank from the 3 day old pot of coffee on your kitchen counter. Avoid!

If you have a password on your bathroom at least keep it clean. The unisex bathroom is disgusting which makes sense as to why the employees have a separate one. This Starbucks is spacious and allows for a lot of people to sit comfortably. The staff was chatty with themselves and there was a serious lack of "customer service." I will not be back to this location anytime soon.

Would not recommend this Starbucks location with all the other coffee shops in the area. The employees seem to lack listening skills. A simple iced coffee with cream and classic seems to be too complicated for them to get right the majority of the time. I've been patient over the past few months with them messing up my order but at some point, the store needs to be held accountable. Unless you don't mind being inconvenienced, spend your money elsewhere.

Noticed a decline in service from this Starbucks this passed quarter. Lots of trainees, which is cool I understand it takes some time, but where are the veteran baristas?! Y'all been jackin' up my orders. Get it together guys!

The friendliest Starbucks in the city. Always gets my order perfect and always making an effort to ask how customers day is! Super clean and definitely handling all COVID19 precautions as far as I can tell.
The service was amazing and the girl with the blue hair was so nice and make my drink perfectly

This is one of the better Starbucks around. It's busy and the area is nice also. It's conveniently located across the road from Grant MacEwan University which might make it a lot noisier and tough to find a seat once school is in session. 

It's a pleasant, spacious location with a good array of indoor and outdoor seating.

I've never noticed the parking sign, but you can bet after getting a parking ticket at North Town Mall last week I am looking at the signs more closely. Unfortunately the lot here is managed by Diamond Parking as well. I have only begun to deal with that. Watch for my review of Diamond Parking and North Town Mall.

It should be obvious that you should keep an eye on your car for the parking Nazis. If you're going to be longer than two hours, you might want to find a better parking spot. I think I saw some free street parking.

Busyness - This is a pretty busy location. It's fairly close to downtown and just across from Grant MacEwan University. I would imagine that it gets even busier once school's back in.

Noisiness - There's a nice high ceiling that seems to absorb the noise reasonably well. The music isn't too loud either.

Ambience - I've been coming to this Starbucks for a couple of years and I've always liked it.

Power - It is available, but the window seats and tables in the centre have an issue. I'd bring an extension cord if you want to use some of the tables in the centre. 

Free wifi - Available and works well. Being one of those people who keeps a number of tabs open, you might want to login with a browser which you don't use often, otherwise each page becomes a login page, oddly enough. (In Firefox Windows 7 at least.)

Staff - Always friendly and helpful. I've rarely had a complaint about a Starbucks employee.

Seating - There are 28 seats in this Starbucks, with four armchairs and two good sized tables for laying out a bit of work.  I like the square tables they have here. They're at a nice height and are quite roomy, compared to the dinky round cafe tables I normally see at Starbucks. There are four or five tables outside on the spacious patio. It's also bordered by some hedges to give it a bit of privacy. I don't know if they ever use the patio heaters.

Security - When I first started coming to this location, there was a homeless camp in the empty lot nearby. It's gone now, but the Starbucks is close to downtown. Not too bad of an area but 107 Ave is close by. Take the usual precautions.
Horrible. I ordered today a white mocha coffee and it was so so bland. I don't usually leave reviews .. but YUCK! Go to a different location.
This location is consistently pretty great.  As a witness, I can tell you that recent media portrayals do not tell the whole story of what happened there.

Really no problem with the product or service. I went through what was a long drive-thru, it moved well. My only real "complaint" the grounds were loaded with liter and just messy. Not the most appetizing view while waiting. I'm only posting this in hope that someone in a management position might see it and have the place cleaned up.

Consistently, the SLOWEST Starbucks I have ever been to. Prepare to spend anywhere from ten to twenty minutes waiting on your order if you go through the drive thru. I don't know who trained these employees but they have absolutely zero sense of urgency. Even when the line is literally wrapped around the building, they will be moving at such a glacial speed that it's quite frankly unnerving. As a former Starbucks employee, I gotta say, this location really needs to step it up a notch! Super disappointing!

Really annoyed that this Starbucks charged me for pupicinos, which is essentially just a small cup with a little bit of whip cream and I've NEVER paid for them before. Seeing as I buy enough Starbucks to pay my rent monthly and then the Asian man was beyond rude because he poured so much milk into my iced coffee that you could barely tell it was coffee anymore and when I asked him to remake it he told me I ordered wrong. Starbucks used to be nice because it was convenient not because of quality. Not it has neither convenience or quality.

This Starbucks location can be found on the corner, down the street from the Betsy Ross House. My husband and I came by here after visiting the Betsy Ross House last Thursday afternoon, around 4:25 pm. 

There were definitely plenty of people inside waiting for their orders and only one person ahead of us in line. We ended up ordering:

Teavana Shaken Iced Passion Fruit Green Tea Lemonade, $2.75 prior to tax- Although my husband asked for a grande size, the employee rang him up for a tall size. I didn't have any since I am not a big fan of passion fruit but he thought this drink was good. 

Mango Dragonfruit Starbucks Refreshers, $4.95 prior to tax- The girl at the register didn't ask for the size but automatically rang us up for a grande size. I thought this drink was refreshing, especially on the hot we were there. I liked the pieces of the dragonfruit, it was nice to eat it after I had finished drinking my beverage. 
------------------------
(Total= $8.32 after tax)

The employee taking our order didn't give us a receipt and when I had asked for one, she said she didn't know how to reprint one out. I am assuming she was a new employee since I saw another employee showing her around and training her. 

After my husband had initially ordered his iced peach green tea lemonade and paid for our order, the employee told him that they didn't have any more peach tea and to pick another flavor. The employee should have checked beforehand before charging us for the drink. My husband ended up ordering the passion fruit instead. He still thought this drink was good but he had wanted the peach flavor instead. 

Wait time for our drinks was over 15 minutes, which seemed like a pretty long time, compared to other Starbucks that we have been to before. 

A little later, I asked the barista making our drinks for water. He said okay but never gave it to me. I had to ask him again after 10 minutes and he never did. I was rather annoyed at the point. So my husband went up and asked another employee who got us 2 cups of water right away. No attitude and seemed to have a positive manner. 

If you have a choice, avoid this location. 

Please note that the unisex restroom was decently clean and adequately stocked with soap and toilet paper.

My drink is a ice soy latte. I've gotten many many times, but never like this at Bordentown location. Twice it's happened to me in a week. The bottom of my drink has a white chalky chunky substance. The first time I did not notice it will I was drinking it and it was off. The second time this morning (7-24-18) I looked before drinking and again the same white chalky substance. That's disgusting!

This was my second time visiting this location and clients were lined up inside waiting for meals to be warmed with only one oven working. The employee who was working the oven was eating a sandwich while cooking sandwiches for guests. If it wasn't Covid maybe it would be OK, if it wasn't a violation of a food prep area maybe it would be OK, unfortunately it's not OK. The owners of this location should frequent to see what occurs during the morning coffee frenzy. I will not return.

Nothing like a vanilla chai tea latte with oatmeal & brown sugar. Hearty and semi-heavy on the tummy. I needed a nap afterwards. Their breakfast cage free egg white chicken sausage or turkey bacon is rather tasty as well. Stole a few bites from my friends. The wraps are light with low calories so there is no guilt associated with eating 'em.

This location is very crowded most times so be prepared for the wait.

This place is busy in the morning, but they kept it moving like a machine. Bathroom was clean and they let me use it before buying something. 

Friendly staff and pretty patrons. My drink was made quickly and to my specifications. Good place to sit and get work done in the morning. I would go back again.

Stood in line for 20 minutes before I got to place my order. You would think with a line out the door there would be some sense of urgency to make these drinks, yet this girl thought it would be a good time to check her phone and drink her own coffee. An iced coffee and bagel took THIRTY MINUTES TO GET.

Just left this Starbucks... and it will be the last time. The staff here are unfriendly and unbelievably rude. As I politely asked the barista for no whipped cream, he rolled his eyes and snickered to the guy next to him. There was not one worker who was polite, friendly, or professional. This place needs that show undercover bosses to show up at their doorstep. Horrible experience Starbucks...

This Starbucks location is conveniently located off Route 130 right off a turn. I always seen it and thought it was busy. But this morning I had extra time before I started work so I gave it a try.

There were probably about 5 cars ahead of me but it moved pretty fast. Seemed like the staff knew what they were doing and moving orders right along.

I asked for a white mocha and the barista suggested a grande toasted white mocha. So it was my first time trying it. Pretty good I must say. But if you drink a white mocha you know it's hard to mess it up. Just a whole bunch of sugar :-) I love it tho. I paired it up with one of the breakfast sandwiches on the healthier side: the egg whites, cheese and turkey bacon one. Which was a great compliment to my drink. Now I know where to stop by for my Starbucks fix.

I am a very frequent flyer at Starbucks and I don't write reviews but I just had THE worst experience I have ever had at a Starbucks at this location. The barista was already remaking 2 others drinks when I arrived for my mobile order. My latte was WHITE and although I like cream in my coffee I draw the line at paying $7 for a glass of milk! The barista was rude when I asked for a straw and wanted to argue when my boyfriend went back in to have her remake my drink. Absolutely unacceptable. Never going back to this location!
I've been waiting in their  drive thru line for 20 minutes!!!  They really need a better crew working weekends.  This is ridiculous.  I have no idea what could take this long.

It's 5PM and they have their order ahead turned off - really irritating. It can't be that busy. Besides, we get a estimated time to pick up and we still have to go through the drive through line anyways. This location also took forever to open the inside compared to other locations. What's going on here?

Something as run of the mill and assembly line as Starbucks I will only review isn't he instance where something is great or terrible.  This time it is great.

This Ferguson store is symbolic because it is in the city of and mere miles from the area where a policeman killed an 18-year-old unarmed teen; that sparked a national conversation about the treatment of minorities by the Police and "policing only for profit".

Great and fast service. Their chocolate cake pop is to die for. I can eat at least 3 a day, I'm addicted. Nice and helpful staff

Both of these issues aren't normal so I wasn't impressed.

The crowd here seems less uptight than the group who frequent the older branch.

Because its new, there is an efficient and fresh-looking checkout area.
