This is always my Starbucks of choice between the two. Not only can I park easily, but the service is quick, bathrooms are clean, and the entire building just feels so "peaceful" with its plentiful natural light design. 

PROS: 
-Brand-new Starbucks. Something about brand-new buildings and all of their shininess is always appreciated. 
-Isn't nearly as busy as the Starbucks across the street. I can actually easily park here, and I can get service in seconds. 
-The interior seating is really cute. The entire Starbucks is covered in windows, so you get a ton of natural light, and the Starbucks feels open. It's lacking in those super-comfy, single-person reading chairs, though. Just lots of tables. It's a very "open concept" design. 
-Fast service, friendly service. I've never had an issue here; the drinks are delicious and served quickly. 

CONS:
-Turning left out of this Starbucks just isn't going to happen. You may need to plan ahead depending on which way you're going. 
-The parking lot is a little weird-feeling. You'll find a place to park, but it just feels like they maybe should have thought the parking lot design through a little better.
This Starbucks is a nightmare for mobile orders. It is normal to wait 20mins or more sometimes to receive your order. I've had to cancel it many times because I had no more time to wait.
I never review starbucks'. This one was fantastic. My cashier was perky as hell and friendly asf. She really made my day and I hope to spread her joy. My coffee tastes better because if it :)

I always have such a great time at this Starbucks.  The baristas are all super friendly and great to talk to. I usually place my order through the app and pick it up at the drive through.  Most of the time they know who it is as soon as I pull up and say "order for Ryan."  They have a personal touch which has been lost to most other Starbucks locations.

This Starbucks is located just right off 65 and on Southport road so it can be quite busy. The location is relatively easy to get in and out of. I don't stop by here often but when I do the staff are always friendly and helpful. They get through the line pretty quickly and with the drinks made correctly.

Awe Starbucks! I have only visited via the drive though recently to get my warm delightful steaming cup of goodness!  I appreciate the app and the new rewards system that gives you credit even if you don't pay through the app!

This Starbucks is located in a fantastic location. Located at the corner of Linebaugh and Sheldon, this is a great place to go if you are passing through the area. Compared to most Starbucks locations, this place is so much bigger and more spacious. This place has a ton of table seating as well as couch seating. But the centerpeace has to be the coffee bar that allows you to sit there and watch the baristas make your drink for you. The feel of the coffee bar and open coffee and food prep area really gives this Starbucks location a very modern feel. It makes you think of the open kitchen trend that is soaring in popularity at restaurants around the world. The service is also really good. The people working here are really friendly and take their time explaining drinks to you and are patient with you as you customize your order or have other requests. Keep up the good work here! :)

Worst Starbucks I've ever been to! Shouldn't even be called "Starbucks" because it feels like a knock-off! Pink drink didn't taste like strawberries, but more like Red Bull! Iced Chai with almond milk was NOTHING like Chai....no milk color to it at all, very watery looking and tasted like there was seltzer water in it!! Threw the whole thing away. I've been to other Starbucks in reststops and they still had the Starbucks feel and quality, so I know its possible!

Starbucks is my favorite holiday stop!  I always look forward to their new holiday flavors and it doesn't seem like the holidays without stopping at Starbucks to both get one of the holiday flavors as well as look for Christmas stocking stuffers.

Friendly staff, super fast service! Can't ask for a better Starbucks. All the employee to understand your order and look to learn your previous order. 

Ordering via the app is also super easy to pick it up, via the drive thru or inside store. 

Not writing a lot here since it's a fast food store and nothing special! 

Menu is the same all around the country.

Made a mobile order this morning to try their new Pistachio Latte.

My order was ready when I arrived. I was a bit confused so I waited around -- thinking my name would be called, but there is a sign clear as day that says something along the lines of "mention your name for uber eats and mobile orders." Whoops

During my short wait, I ordered Baloo a puppucino (free cup of human-dairy whip cream for dogs)  , because I couldn't come home empty handed.

The line was wrapped around the plaza, so I was so grateful to have a mobile order.

This location has been remodeled, so it's super open in the inside now which is perfect for COVID precautions.

There are no tables inside, you can order inside if you desire. There is one set of chairs outside. The decor is super modern and can't wait to see what the rest of furniture will look like when they decide it is safe to add it.

This newly built Starbucks is gorgeous on the inside, especially love kicking up my feet on the leather (love the smell) ottoman!

I really love the black and white paintings with a spotlight on them and how spacious it is on the inside with plenty of tables. If you want a warm setting, sit in the circle of chairs, which is my preference or if you want to be on your own/hang out with a friend, choose a table! There's a patio area at the entrance & feels welcoming. 

The service is great and like the knowledgeful baristas (Ex: Ask for Abel if you're indecisive on what drink to order). I'm THAT PERSON that may hold up the line for a couple minutes trying to figure out what I want, so apologizing in advance; this is what happens when I'm given too many drink choices!

I'm a sucker for any type of Iced Latte and prefer peppermint syrup, which is simple and so good; they mix in right amount of rich espresso & whole milk, but could always go lighter on the ice. This drink has been one of my latest cravings I can't get enough of.

I love the ambience and like to come here in the night after a long day at work and push caffeine in my system while listening to laid back music in the background as well as people watch.
Standing here waiting for my cold brew order and I've watched the 2 people behind me in line get their drinks already. The definitely are understaffed. The place could also use a good cleaning.

this is without a doubt the worst starbucks ever  i have yet to ever get a drink order correct. its so simple: venti vanilla latte almond milk no foam   today no vanilla i wa the first or second person thru the drive thru i had to repeat the order twice , we had a whole lol momnet about no vanilla creamer at home i mean seriously at $5.50 a cup get it together. i usually drive tot he 71st and bindford location because the location  by me on 56 st. is so slow and they always alway always mess up something in the order or you have to repeat it 3 times.  get it together

Literally the absolute slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. I am a barista of almost five years. I know when there is a lot of volume and when a set of baristas are just taking their time. Smaller Starbucks in the Olde City section of Philly. Can get cramped when busy. seating is at a premium. Typical food and drinks here. Service is the usual efficient folks/kids that work at these places. Never any issues. Parking of course is tough in this area. Does the job for Starbucks fans that live and work in the area and want a drink or bite to go,  but if you are looking for place to bring your laptop and sip your latte slowly there are better Starbucks to be found.
Simply put the barista doesn't  really care much about customer service.  Drinks are not made to Starbucks standards.

OMG, the worse espresso and the worse dark roast ever!!!! and I thought they follow a standard process!
how can you mess up espresso? just push the button on the machine....

Excellent location! The staff is always courteous and never miss any special instructions. The lines generally move very quick and always a great experience. Keep up the great work!

The staff this morning was extremely rude. When asked who was here for mobile orders a few people said their names and the girl shouted one at a time. Who the hell does she think she is, never going back to this elitist dump !!!

Honestly one of the worst starbucks I've ever been to. Staff isn't friendly the place isn't welcoming and chances are every time you go in here you'll be waiting for 10+ minutes in line and for your drink. Good luck.

I don't know how - but they consistently get my coffee orders correct. The very best Starbucks, with the greatest staff. Has a drive through, also. Nice interior.

The best Starbucks ever! We have one literally right next to our house but we go out of our way to go here. The service is fast and the workers are always super friendly. If they weren't so nice I'd say they might be robots because they make everything so fast and the drink always turns out perfectly. They don't have friendly robots yet right? Even if they are robots its still my favorite Starbucks.

This store is consistently among the worst Starbucks I've been to.

Their service has gone down since my last review, and if it weren't so dang close to home, we'd never come back.

They have trouble making drinks correctly, are ridiculously slow, and service is never delivered with a smile.

If I could give 0 stars, I would. This Starbucks really needs to up its game with service. Employees seemed abrupt and unfriendly at the least. It literally took 20 minutes just to make a grande chai latte. We then ordered a hot expresso that turned out to be a COLD double shot of coffee. Not very busy compared to most Starbucks. Kind of slow for the lack of business. Close to our hotel so that was nice
There has simply got to be a management problem at this place...I have never been to a place where the employees are consistently joyless seem to sort of care, but with not much enthusiasm.

The parking situation is horrible! The flow of traffic is really bad, in fact dangerous if you see how the patterns move. Having said that, it's a block away from my office and convenient as heck, so I roll the dice to get my tall cup of Pikes...every single day.

Let me first start by saying that I just had the oddest most unpleasant experience at this location. I love this Starbucks so much. It's almost my every day stop.  The baristas are very nice and really get to know you.  I accidentally put creamer instead of milk in my coffee. Pretty rude, unnecessarily condescending and dismissive. I suggest going to the one on Bell Road!

They served me cold coffee.  As soon as it was handed over I could feel the chill.  I ordered coffee with cream.  Come on Starbucks, keep fresh and hot coffee ready!  You are a coffee company and if you can't serve a good hot cup of coffee you should be ashamed.  I handed back to the barista and she replaced it and said the person must have gotten it from a pot that was turned off.  WHY would that coffee be available to be served.  I'm a Starbucks fan and this was downright disappointing.  Do better!

Did an online order, waited inside for our order for about 10-15 mins to realize that new people that were walking in to order received their drinks before us. writing first ever review because mean people suck.

just witnessed someone I assume to be the manager being unnecessarily loud and condescending to a new employee who made a mistake.

One of my favorite Starbucks in South Tampa! The staff is always extremely friendly. I usually order on the mobile app ahead of time even when I'm a minute down the road and they have my order ready to go when I walk in. The team they have right now is definitely able to keep up with the rush! The store is on the smaller side and they don't have as many prepared food/snack options as other places but the drinks are made with consistent quality!
"Pup cup" delight!   So cute!  Great customer relations!  It made his day. We will continue to go out of our way to visit this location!!
Staff is very friendly and super helpful. I ordered a carry out coffee service for 10. (I think it is called the traveler). My order was ready right on time and included everything I needed.

Good morning Yelpers.   So I am here to get my morning coffee. and the customer service I just have to help about.

The barista that works the drive thru is phenomenal. Her name is Mia.  Now when I say her customer service skills outweigh any others that I have encountered at this location I mean that sincerely.

Thank you Mia for your awesome service. it is because of people like you that I continue to come to this location.

I go here 4-5 times a week at night and theres this young man that makes me come back, super nice and always gets my order right! Go figure you would think the guys would be jerks but not at this Starbucks i say go ahead but be aware the drive-thru line does take some time during busy hours i would say between 5-10 minute wait the longest.

I have been in this location a few times and never had any bad things to say until now. My mom sister and I were shopping in the area and decided to get drinks. We ordered the iced caramel macchiato w/ almond milk, caramel frap, and a strawberries and cream frap. When I tried the macchiato it did NOT taste like almond milk. I do not even know what they put in my drink since it did not taste like the usual one I always order- not sure if maybe the milk was expired or they made it differently but it tasted awful. I couldn't even drink it and I'm not the person to complain and ask for a refund but I could not even swallow it. Staff is friendly, coffee is good, but the store is dirty.  Sweep the floors and wipe the tables once in a while Mr. Manager...

One of my favorites, mainly because it's near my job. The staff are wonderful, so friendly and they really try their best to fast. This place can often get slammed by tourist but it's still my favorite.
Not a real SB, no rewards so I don't understand how they have a storefront in a downtown metro area? No wifi and they screwed up my drink, nice work! Won't be back.

I really enjoy starbucks and appreciate it when I'm out of my area but after REPEATEDLY waiting extended times for my coffee I do not go here anymore.  Their drive-thru, and walk-up, are absolutely the slowest of any Starbucks I have ever been to.  EVER!  Speed it up please!

Been frequenting this amazing establishment for ten years. Over the years, there has been a lot of staffing  changes but I can honestly say the current AM crew is phenomenal! They are quick and attentive, always willing to correct any mistakes. Trista is a great leader and a lot of subpar service issued have been corrected under her supervision. The drive thru is often run by Ada and she is a bright spot in my day. Grey and Kenji are the best baristas we have ever had! Keep it up

Yesterday was first time ever going to Starbucks and today I've gone again , this company is really good and the staff is great too , this place is always busy and I know why , thanks Starbucks I'm committed now , will probably go every day now cause I'm fired up like an 8 day alarm clock , I'm going  try everything on the menu

I mean, I was in Reno. 
I was in a casino. 
There was a Starbucks. 

I mean, could it have been any better? I was already pretty lucky there was an actual Starbucks INSIDE my hotel, so I wasn't really complaining. 

The first day, I ordered my regular drink and it took the girl at the cashier about a good 10 minutes to take my order, and that didn't even include the wait time (which was about 10 mins). When I got my drink, it was scorching hot, like they decided to burn the milk when I asked for extra hot and through two cups and a sleeve it was terrible. 

Next time, different group of bartistas were working, and the wait was quick and a lot friendlier. But same thing with my coffee, the milk was burnt and I didn't even ask for it extra hot this time. But it tasted weird, different, not worth what I paid. 

So basically, it's a coffee shop inside a hotel that has the Starbucks logo slapped onto everything, but the service/ the drink/ the everything else isn't what you would expect. 
Because it is in a hotel and tourist area, the prices were a little steeper than usually almost by a dollar and they do charge tax, so if you're using your SB card- which they allow- you're probably going to have an odd number remaining balance, which I'm somewhat OCD about. 

They do accept your starbucks app and the giftcards, except they don't allow you to redeem your free drinks. 

There's another one brand new opened at El Dorado.. I wonder what that's like.

My mom and I go for coffee here all the time and they always do a great job! The drive through workers are almost always incredibly nice and bright people, and we've had our drinks paid for/paid for other people's orders multiple times. A fun little community Starbucks
Great experience this morning with the young gentleman at the counter.  The only person to ask how to spell my name. Thank you!! A great way to start my morning:)
I come here at least a couple times a week, it's close to the gym and has a great atmosphere.

This is the best Starbucks I have ever been to. The energy and atmosphere was amazing. The staff is super friendly and knows everyone by name. This store should be recognized by the higher ups, for sure. The employees really seemed to love their job, and I think that's what makes it special.
They really need to work on keeping items in stock and cleaning the place up.  This is the dirties Starbucks I have ever been in.
Great, friendly staff who laugh and take the time to talk to you and make sure you're happy with the service and coffee! Best Starbucks around!

Probably the worst Java Chip Frappe I've ever had, I am still currently sitting here and trying to sip it down, but like their coffee usually is, it tastes incredibly burnt, and it's over syruped.  But mostly, I can't get over this burnt coffee taste, and as I sit here writing this, the entire coffee shop has the "SOMETHING IS BURNING!" odor, and we are leaving soon.

Alas, we are still in search of a decent coffee place up in the Tampa Bay Area. 

Laura served us and she was helpful, no notorious Starbuck 'tude, friendly service on this late Tuesday morning.  We wished we could have just paid after we ordered but she didn't tell us the total & take our card until after everything was made, warmed up, and served, but we were holding a lot of items and even though it's a small detail... we wanted to just pay after we ordered and sit down to wait for our names to be hollared out like normal.  

We almost left due to lack of parking, there are barely a few people in here but the lot was completely full.

Still searching for a better place, but it's hard to come by in this area, so we settled for this Starbucks.

Meh, me thinks not for next time.

That's like the only Starbucks in the vicinity, that's why all the problems I guess. I stopped by twice so far. First time the line in the drive-thru was so long that I decided to go in. Inside line was even bigger. I got a cup of coffee with a shot of espresso and it literally took them about 10 min to get it to me. The second time I went through the drive-thru and the wait was no as long.

This place is the happiest place to be at 7:00. Friendly upbeat staff that welcome me by name every day. The coffee of courses great.  The place is clean and organized. All COVID-19 precautions are in place. I love starting my day at this Starbucks. It's hard to be a grumpy morning person after you visit this place.

This Starbucks has a very friendly staff and never mess up orders. Came here my whole time in NOLA and never had an issue. There is no parking Aaron all for this location and that is the only reason I it's getting  4 stars

So I went to the Starbucks today and I asked for a pink drink with zero strawberries Trenta they gave me a Trenta pink drink with extra strawberries in it then I went back to get a free remake they gave me a Venti pink drink with no strawberries Frick you Starbucks never go to this one go to Barclay Rt 70 DRIVE THRU!!!!!!!
I love this starbucks location'! The baristas are happy, friendly and work hard to get orders done efficiently and as fast as possible!

Typically great Starbucks. It was busy but moved along quickly. 

We had two tall Pikes Place coffees, two tall Americana coffees and a chai latte. We were in line and gone in less than ten minutes. 

Fast accurate friendly service. As Arnold said, 'I'll be back.'

Omg, my experience here made my day, I didn't catch anyone's names unfortunately but I'll share the experience... 

The experience: 
I'm not easily touched/moved but this day I was. A nice young gal greets me with a smile from ear to ear and says, "welcome to Starbucks, what can I get started for you?" She might have asked how I was doing but just the warmth in which she greeted me was enough. I order my go to, medicine ball, and ask if they have these bars they used to carry, I wasn't sure what they are called and try to describe them as best as possible but we cannot figure it out. Where we go the extra step is when the young lady asks someone else if they have an idea of what I'm talking about, the other person then askks the manager and she says, "yes the RXbars" she explains the situation. I was blown away at this point, not because of a free bar, I was going to buy it anyways but because not at one point was I ever told no in this transaction. Everyone was trying to find something that would be accomdating. 

Thank you Starbucks on the corner of lakeside and mccarren, you made my day :)

Today I'm enjoying a Tomato Mozzarella Panini, which is my absolute favorite! My drink of choice is a tall Coffee Frappuccino!  I have to say that during this pandemic Statbucks has adjusted and has been my sunshine on cloudy days often!  Simple pleasures in life matter so my pleasure is amazing coffee options What's also nice is the customer service I receive.  As I always say, #SparklingMatters
Horrible service. Felt bad for the front line associate that was poorly trained. Sad...train wreck.

This Starbucks location has "Starbucks Evenings"  which means after 4pm you can be served various small plates and "craft beer" as well as red, white, and sparkling wines in the afternoon. The sample Evenings menu features truffle mac and cheese, meat and cheese plates, spinach artichoke dip, and more. this location is also very clean, the staff friendly and helpful. Also features an outside seating area and free WiFi

Went today bc I worked at home - live at SoBro right next door.  Coffee and food was ok but the service is abominable.  Line almost out the door yet there was one guy taking orders and a young girl who looked like she just got out of bed standing around picking at her nails.  When I asked the cashier what she does you would've thought I committed the unpardonable.  Was reprimanded by the cashier, her and even another customer.  "She works very hard" - vehement defense of the indefensible.  Anyway I ordered 5 coffees and  5 sandwiches - what a deal, only $50!!!  I generally avoid Starbucks bc of mediocre quality and high prices - guarantee you I won't visit this one ever again.

Don't bother using the app to place your order, its faster staying in the drive-thru line. I've used the app multiple times and I am always waiting for my drinks. The app told me 2 to 6 minutes and I waited 15 minutes for my drinks. For the past three times I've ordered a bagel toasted with cream cheese the first two times they're out of bagels and the last time they had the bagel but no cream cheese or butter. What a waste of time! Completely frustrating and annoying.
A whole month after a storm and they're still opening and closing at ridiculous and inconvenient times. Very poor quality of service even when they are open.

When I first moved here, I wanted to try out my local Starbucks since I knew I'd be a regular patron.  My first impression did not go well.  I went very early (before sunrise) and I was the only car there.  I ordered quickly, but had to wait.  Not a big deal since I ordered something that required heating.  The problem is I got the wrong order.  I ordered bacon egg bites and received the ones with the peppers and spinach.  Of course I didn't realize until I got to my destination and pulled them out to eat them.  They were gross and I couldn't finish it.  By lunch time, I was sooooooo hungry.  Since this was going to be my neighborhood Starbucks, I wanted to make nice so I gave them another chance.  Since then, they've done okay.  My order hasn't been incorrect since.  They are inconsistent with drive through speed (some days it's quick and other days you sit there for a while) so if you're in a rush, I suggest doing the pre-order on the app and just walking in to pick it up.  They do consistently fill the coffee to the brim so that when you pick it up, it comes out through the straw hole and gets all over your hand and your clothes.  Luckily, I'm usually on my way home from work, but it's still a little bit obnoxious.  I spend most of my drive home wiping coffee off of my console.  Most of the employees seem nice and I'm glad that I gave it another chance.  I do wish there was another location in the area though.

I go to Starbucks every day (sad to admit) but I find myself trying to make my way to this particular location. There are so many work stations available and the guests are generally quiet. It's a perfect place to open up your laptop and get into the zone. The staff is really friendly and accommodate requests with grace.

DO NOT patron this location as they  HATE the disabled as seen by the actions of this store who banned a customer for LIFE at ALL Tampa locations because  he stood up for the disable because non-disabled people were parking in the handicapped slots.  Boycott and go to Coffee Bean instead.

Love this Starbucks, it's my neighborhood location. The manager Mya and all of the baristas ensure to learn the regulars by name and greet them very friendly. They also ensure every order is prepared properly and will always correct it if something is off.

This place is alright. It is just your standard Starbucks. It is a bit dirty but that is alright. Service is pretty quick and the seating is available enough. It is really nice to be here right now because it is warm while it is absolutely freezing outside. A homeless person just asked me for money while I was sitting here but I suppose that could happen at any Philly coffee shop. Happy to be here!
I don't like the borritos because mcdonalds  has better donuts

When the purchase is courtesy from others (gift card), then why not male your way to Starbucks. I really only purchase flavored iced coffees such as caramel and mocha and vanilla. Some times the iced coffees have been very flavorful and enjoyable to drink. Other times I have gotten iced coffees from here, it did not leave anything to be desired. Hoping for better flavored iced coffees.

"Cookie Monster," or the incredible drive through employee formally known as Ryan, made my Starbucks visit Sunday absolutely spectacular. He was funny, kind, quick and turned an otherwise average visit to Starbucks to above and beyond. I believe it's employees like him that make a difference in someone's day by spreading joy. THANK YOU RYAN - Coooooookies!
Really nice people.  Just wish they could get my order right.  I am a daily to double daily and my order is only right maybe half the time.  And it is the same order every time

Recently renovated.  The pros: more modern looking, there's more fridge space to offer more non-coffee items, the baristas are still the same ones pre-renovation.  There's outdoor seating now.

The cons: power outlets eliminated all except for 1-2, the new furniture seems to be intentionally less comfortable to keep people from hanging out for a long amount of time. 

They still make the beverages in a quality way, but sadly, it is no longer the coffee shop that's designed to be a place for casual conversation.

This is the worst Starbucks in this area! The drinks taste nothing like the other Starbucks. The lines a very slow. I know how a triple shot should taste but they charge for triple and only use 1 or two. The drinks taste watered down so we try ristretto but I don't think they know how so that is horrible too. This is by far the worst Starbucks I've ever been to and I have traveled around the world. I've given them many chances. I even called corporate. This store can't be helped and needs new management or should just shut down. If you really want to know how to make coffee go to the Tampa (Gandy) location. They are friendly and know how to make Starbucks coffee. This store is no different than going to a gas station. The only difference is the gas station coffee is cheaper and taste better.
Your normal starbucks in the outlet mall. It gets busy with all the shoppers. They have a "Leave a Note" wall at the counter, where customers can write notes and leave them on the wall. That is neat.

I always get the best service here. Today they even remembered my name with no prompting. Thank you Noel!  I have NEVER had this experience at either of the other two Starbucks I frequent on a regular basis. When I have a choice of Starbucks locations this is the one I choose!
Closes at 8 on the weekdays and 8:30 on weekends? Does not make sense. Staff is good otherwise.

Gal at the register didn't know how to reload a card. After two attempts she still caged my bank card for the total and the reload so I couldn't get points. Bummer! Sandwiches were still frozen in the middle and the coffee was the opposite and burned our throats. Worst was that we can eat inside restaurants locally and you can't drink coffee inside a coffee shop. Inconsistencies!

Horrible. Service is super slow. Went in on a Saturday morning and am still waiting on my drink currently after placing it 45 minutes ago. They need to pick it up! It'll be dinner before I get my coffee. If you want coffee for dinner, go to this Starbucks! Lost my service for sure.
Everyone who works in this starbucks is so amazing and friendly. They treat me like family!! Love coming here every morning.
Starbucks in Harrahs gets an A. Cozy little spot on the second floor. The coffee is hot and fresh. The lemon pound cake so yummy. The staff is friendly. The banana art made me smile. Good job!

Alright, I'll be that guy that reviews a Starbucks - but I'm justifying it to myself for a very simple reason. While Old City has a surfeit of attractions, it only has a few worthwhile coffee stops: Old City Coffee, Ole, and the cafe wing of Fork (down on Market Street). I want to be a champion of local businesses and in so much as I frequent local Philly favorites, there are occasions where a Pike Place fits the bill. If you have to support a corporate powerhouse, at least Starbucks - by most accounts - is a respectable company that takes care of their employees and customers. 

The main reason the Old City Starbucks is worth a review is because of its staff. I've visited my fair share of these corner coffee shops named in honor of Melville's masterpiece, and while I'm generally pleased with the service, this one surpasses even the Starbucks' standard. The seating is average, the drinks on par, but the service, amazing. As a side note, if you're looking for a good amount of seating, the Starbucks on 10th and Chestnut is a great location. 

Not to feed competitive urges, but if you're looking for a friendly, quick cup of joe, I think this Starbucks is a great option. However, if you have a little more time and a little more money, Ole is still my favorite spot in Old City.

I practically live at this Starbucks for all of my work meetings. Today really blew me away though. Not only did they have a station set up to write post cards to our veterans in honor of Veteran's Day but Savannah who took my order was just such a pleasure. She was warm, nice and really turned my day around :)

#218

Been here lots of times and they have never got my drink wrong...except for today. It wasn't exactly what I ordered but pretty close and actually was very drinkable. I used to drink Starbucks almost everyday but the cost is now prohibitive. This is a good location no major issues.
If you want your drink in a timely manner do NOT use the drive thru. It took 40 minutes and I should've left after 10.

Honestly the worst customer service I have ever had in a Starbucks. Can't even name names of i wanted to because nobody wears name tags. 

I walked in wanting to buy some coffee beans for my new ninja coffee machine. There was a guy putting some bags up. I asked him if he could recommend one of the dark or medium roasts for sweetness. He ignored me. I asked again louder. He walked away and went behind the counter. 

I picked one out myself and approached the counter to pay and get a drink. I smiled and asked him if the were any chocolate chip cookies left. He did not respond. 

Frustrated at this point I asked if he was ready for my order. He grimaced at me and still said nothing. I told him my coffee order and asked for a chocolate chip cookie, heated up. After ringing me out he threw a cookie in a bag. It was still cold. 

I made my way over to the barista making my order. I asked her how her day was going. She ignored me. She put my drink on the counter and I said thank you and she shrugged and started to walk away. I took a sip and said "hey there is no flavoring or cream in this like I ordered, could I please get some?" She put a bottle of milk on the counter and walked away. I put the milk in my coffee and gave up on the flavoring.

I don't feel like I was rude, and I was trying to be smiling and friendly so I don't know why everyone seemed disgruntled. They didn't seem very busy, and I don't expect a grand conversation or red carpet treatment or anything but a smile would be nice I guess. 

I don't know, it just really threw me off. I don't even care about the coffee being wrong so much as everyone glaring and ignoring customers. :(

When in Tucson this is my go to Starbucks even though there's one closer to where I stay. This one is clean, has a really friendly team, and a drive through! Can't say that for all of the locations, unfortunately so this one is worth the extra time and couple of miles. I use mobile order and I'm on my way in a jiffy! Serious shout out to the entire team here and an extra high-five to Austin, who is a delight.

This location is the friendliest out of the entire city. Maybe it's because I frequent daily. Everyone knows me by name so it's a nice start to my morning! I don't even need to tell them my order when I walk in because they know it by heart!

Loved this Starbucks, friendly, quick, efficient employees, and they asked me if it was ok to make a few adjustments to my acai berry tea when they ran out of a few ingredients.  Very very clean bathroom and store location in Philly, def stop in if you need some down time and are on your way to/from the Betsy Ross house.

Well they finally moved across the street to a little bit larger building. This one is a standalone building and it's nice, it's modern, but there still no comfy chairs inside. Same standard drinks and food. 

However, I will say before I left, I asked for a glass of water and it wasn't triple filtered which shocked me. I had to throw the water out and I could tell the ice was good. Not sure what happened there. But if you're coming to study and have a coffee, it's new and luxurious. There's a patio; but the area is limited and a bit crowded if your looking for privacy. If you wanna sit at the counter, it's roomy and there are lots of seats. But if you want a nice comfortable chair to sit on and talk to your other guest... Move on down the road as there are no comfy chairs in this place.

I really like this Starbucks. I'm more of a PJs girl but this is where I come for my basic white girl iced chai tea latte with soy. As previous reviewers have said, there's not much indoor seating but plenty of COVERED outdoor seating. What's cool about this is that you can bring your puppy BFF with you! While Starbucks policy is that they do not allow pets, you can bring your dog inside to order before heading outside. This is a must when there isn't a drive thru!

The staff here is friendly and service is quick. Drinks are your standard Starbucks quality. Stop on by, drop a tip in the jar, and treat your doggo to a puppuchino on the patio!

There are lots of beverage/food locations on the USF campus that you are better off ignoring and heading off-campus for. The Starbucks located in the library is not one of them. You've entered the library for a long stretch study session and Starbucks is right there to assist you in your academic quest. The line can usually get pretty long, but regardless the employees work quickly and you probably should get in line if you do not already know what you want because before you know it you'll be standing at the register with a ton of people behind you. Workers are friendly and very helpful with choosing the drink that you want or a snack to eat. There is not too many spots to sit in the actual Starbucks, but you can have your drink anywhere in the library so it really is not a big deal. Prices are not bad, and in the cold winter months you'll be glad you can warm up with a Starbucks coffee or hot chocolate.

Staff is always great and friendly; they seem genuinely interested in everything that I have to say. They also talked to me for almost 4 minutes explaining their tea selection - that was great! 
Their coffee quality is below par even for a Starbucks, but always make up for it with great demeanor and sometimes offering free upgrades, like a free extra shot! 
This is the best Starbucks I've been to on any college campus, not for their coffee but for their excellent service. 
Super convenient, super friendly - I'll definitely keep going back for my caffeine fix.

Everytime I go to Starbucks I always get a venti dragon drink with no ice because I have extremely sensitive teeth . I always get my drink filled to the top with no ice at any other location I go to. I went to this location and the employee told me he couldn't fill my drink up all the way because I got no ice. I will never return to this location I paid $5.38 for a half filled drink.

I was staying at Harrah's for an extended weekend and was thrilled to learn that there is a Starbucks in the hotel, in the west tower, on the 2nd floor (near the elevators & hash house a go go)! I ordered coffee for myself and family members every morning we were there. It was always moderately busy, just like any other starbucks, but the baristas were friendly, quick, and made everything ordered spot on.  If you want to get total rewards credits for your purchase provide your TR players card prior to paying (I had zero issues with this). This is a wonderful convenience for people staying and playing in Harrah's or around. This is not a standard starbucks with seating and I wouldn't expect that from this type of property, real estate is a commodity, there are a few tables, but this isn't intended for a hangout spot, grab your coffee and go! Overall a great experience!

Excellent service on Thanksgiving morning 2020. They had a great crew working and I was blown away how cheery everyone was. I'm thankful they were open being here from out of town With now coffee service at our B&B. The coffees were perfect and so were the impossible breakfast sammys and the Coup de grace chocolate croissants!

Busy location ~ the line moves quickly. Additional seating at the window, this location is often full.


Drive in available.

The staff handled a bathroom problem very well. A homeless person was in the bathroom for 15 minutes while a line kept growing. The barista politely knocked, asked if they were ok, then said please finish up as there's a line waiting. When she came back to check she nicely asked if everything was ok again. She treated him with dignity and humanness.
Great coffee! Great customer service!! I Highly recommend going here for your next cup of coffee!!!

First of all the staff is courteous.
The cleanliness wasn't great, the tables were a little dirty.
I was asking about a new drink and the lady at the front counter did a very good job in explaining to me what was in the drink etc.
When I ordered my drink it seem to take an awfully long time to get it I understand there's people in the drive-through in the drive-through takes priority but my drink took way too long considering there was nobody in there except maybe one other person. Don't get me wrong I know the drive-through takes priority but it took too long for me to get my drink.
Not a bad place or not all in all by cleanliness and quickness of service needs to be looked at just a little bit.

I'm always welcomed when I walk in, and have had mostly pleasant experiences. Isaiah is by far the best barista here and why I'm giving 5 stars! I'll even make a point to order when I walk by and see he's working. He goes above and beyond to craft every beverage and is always super friendly. I wish every Starbucks had a barista like that!
Love the new crew here! The managers are so kind a long with the baristas. They always remember what my hubby & I order!

I happily live less than 2 miles from 2 Starbucks but this one is the closest. I am thinking, walk up here on a nice sunny day type of close because it is only about 2.5 blocks away.

The staff: They're always friendly and accomodating. They don't rush you.  You can always expect greetings when you come in and smiles on their faces.  They always get my orders right and they do it in an efficient manner.

The storefront: Clean and well-maintained.  There are several tables and comfortable seating inside. Some outdoor seating as well and a drive-thru.

You can get the usual drinks available at any other Starbucks here as well as the pastry/food options.  You can hang out and enjoy your beverage inside where you will find a few tables and comfortable chairs or take it to go.

They charged me for lemonade in my iced tea when I asked 3 times that I did not want lemonade. I also said UNSWEETENED 3 times. Then when I got my drinks they were sweetened and with lemonade! Then when I asked her to remake the drinks, she made them the exact same way. Pay attention!!
This store is a disgrace. Employees are rude and have no regard for their neighbors in the nearby apartments. It's also dirty.

I, by no means, am a yelper. This will be my first review and if I'm being completely honest, as I intend to be, it took a lot out of me to even get on here and talk about my experience at this location. 
I work in the area, and have to be in for my shift well before any other coffee shops are open. So out of sheer convenience, I frequent this specific Starbucks. 
I have to say, as far as positive interactions with the staff go - they are few and far between. 
This store, in my opinion, is pretty high volume. I've only ever visited once in a blue moon when there hasn't been a line of people, or a line hasn't accumulated behind me while I'm ordering. 
It's rare that my drink is made correctly, even though I get the same drink from the same faces often enough. The consistency is never there. 
The staff - awful. Working in customer service and coming from a customer service based employment background for almost 10 years, I am disgusted. The staff here is always miserable and rushes to get you in and out of the store. I understand getting flustered when the place is bumpin', but there's no reason to take it out on the customer. 
I went in this morning to grab my coffee, the two men behind the counter seemed like they were having a hard time, one of whom I'm assuming is the manager. The manager in particular is downright terrible. He's always pissy, never greets me, comes over to the register saying "what can I get for you?" takes my order, and then shuffles me out of the way to get to the next person. I wait for my drink, say thank you, and he doesn't even make eye contact with me before he's back over at the register being just as cold to the next guest as he was to me. 
As a manager, I would expect more and would think that this person would set a better example for his team. This is the person that is held accountable for the way his staff handles customer interactions, and if they aren't providing quality customer service, he is to blame. 
If I could give less of a rating, I would. But there are some diamonds in the rough at this location that are always kind to me no matter how busy they are. 
This store could definitely use some retraining in how to provide the best customer service experience to their guests. 
If the horrible customer service wasn't paired with the inconsistencies in the drink orders, I would have never opened my trap. But I am so fed up with frequenting this location since I kind of have to, tipping every time I visit, and being met with such distain from about 90% of the employees here, including their manager who shouldn't be dropping the ball so much in front of his team. 
There are better Starbucks locations. And I'll probably just go to the one closer to my house on the way to work from now on instead of spending my money here to be treated so poorly. Sucks.

Wow. Quite possibly the worst Starbucks experience. Came in with a couple friends, one of which lives down the road and usually avoids this terrible Starbucks. I asked the cashier if the "salted cream cold foam cold brew" could be made as nondairy. He said of course and gave me my milk options. I went with coconut milk. My friend then said she wanted the same thing but with soy milk. He then asked if she wanted it hot or cold. Idk how cold brew can be hot  he then said he thought she wanted a salted caramel mocha. We clarified what we wanted. 

As we waited for our drinks, the barista sneezed in his hands and had a huge snot rocket. Gross. He then walked to the back, wiped his hands and came back out. Def wasn't back there long enough to wash them. He stood around behind the bar and a girl I assume was the shift lead motioned to him to wash his hands. So he rinsed them. Kept sniffling and touching his nose. Not who you want making your drinks, especially when you have a 7 week old, as my friend does. He should not have been working in food service. Point blank. If you are sick, do not work around food. 

My friend asked the supervisor if someone else could make our drinks because of what we witnessed. As she was asking this, I see him blending heavy cream for our drinks, which of course, does not fall into the nondairy category. He hands us one of them and we don't even want to touch it. The supervisor sends him on break and comes in to remake our drinks. She asks if our drinks are the "salted caramel mochas", which clearly homeboy rang in wrong so we let her know what we actually want. She then says it's made with heavy cream so I point out that the cashier told me it could be made nondairy. He says "oh I thought you wanted salted caramel mochas". I asked if I could get something else since i don't want dairy and they say they'll try to make it nondairy. Which btw, totally possible but might not be as foamy. 

After being in here 15-20 minutes for 3 drinks, to say i was frustrated was an understatement. There was no apology, no service recovery, nothing. Definitely need to retrain this staff, never seen such an incompetent bunch. The shift lead seemed to be the only one who knew what she was doing, understood food allergies, and cared about her job/customers.

Bf ordered a coffee frap and got an iced coffee instead---? It's quite a piss off when you go out of your way, and can't go back to complain because you're in a rush. So drove for nothing to get the wrong drink. Great.

I have probably visited 4 or 5 Starbucks' in the city, and this one is one of the better ones.  The staff has been extremely friendly and helpful every time I visit, and there is a nice upstairs seating area to relax and browse the internet while drinking your whatever.

On a side note, I picked up a box of their new instant iced coffee, and I think it is really good.  One box is probably enough for 10 or more small sized ice coffees, so the price isn't too bad either.

The staffs were very friendly. That's why I am giving them 2 stars rather than 1.
I ordered grande caramel mocchiato and paid $5.45 for it. ($1.00 more than a regular Starbucks)The barista did not make my drink right so I had to add an extra shot. Usually, Starbucks offers for free to make it right but I have to pay 92 cents.
So my coffee is almost $7.00. I have Starbucks gift card but cannot use it here.
They were too pricey and didn't make a go
I like that they are inside the hotel.
Anyway, I am not going back to this place.

This is my go to Starbucks! However I HIGHLY recommend using the app to place your order. I have had several occasions where I have not used the app and had to wait a very long time for my order. Now that I use the app I have had no issues with this location and stop in several times throughout the week

I used to come here all the time,love this location .The people are just so friendly and really fast with my order. Also,great interior space,always clean and great coffee.
The best Starbucks in Santa Barbara.

Always try a new food item.  Today was there version of a cinnamon roll. Ok I give it like 3.5 stars out of 5.  Interesting as it was with no icing but it was tasty. But I don't drink coffee so I am always up for a flavored hot chocolate.  Today's choice was salted Carmel ( mmmmm). I wish they had like French vanilla hot chocolate that would be so tasty.  Mmmmm thank you for setting my day to a good step.

The girl that's in the drive-through every morning is completely rude. Told me today after going there for years and  getting a Venti ice water With my $10-$20 orders, that they don't do that. Just went there yesterday different person they did that. She also told me they're no longer giving out straws but didn't give me a lid with a non straw friendly hole in it.  When I asked for a straw she basically threw it at me. Every other Starbucks in town will give you a Venti ice water and a straw if you ask if you need one. Unless they give you the right lid are you supposed to pull your lid off when you're driving a car and drink your coffee I don't think so! I'm writing to the corporate office as well.

Order a coffee and a bagel.  Coffee came out right away.  The bagel and food items not so much as fellow coffee drinkers were waiting around too. It's not a bad location.  I was annoyed to see another gal stocking shelves instead of helping her fellow worker at the counter who was in charge of taking orders and prepping the food. Oh she came, but only after she was done.  Yeah no, not in retail.  Get the crowds out.  Meh, Starbucks just isn't the same anymore.

I have been here six times now and all six times something is wrong. The top two issues are incredibly slow service and inconsistency with the way their drinks are made. I mean I've been to Starbucks all across the country. Big City Starbucks and small city Starbucks and this is the slowest one by far. I waited 27 minutes for an iced coffee! Safe to say...I will not be back.

Worst staff and horrible coffee.. they don't even have light fraps anymore- way to contribute to America obesity epidemic. Watch their stocks plummet - who wants to pay 8 bucks for a glass of fat and sugar - well maybe some but you lost me when u took away light versions.

Usually, this is my go-to Starbucks. They do always take a little bit to get your order ready, but USUALLY polite friendly people... Unlike most of the staff, there's ONE lady that's just PLAIN RUDE.. I stopped by at 8:07PM, drive thru.. (checked online and it said they were still open).. pulled up to the drive thru, "hello?" Nothing. "Hey are you guys open?" Nothing. "Helloooo?" NOTHING! Waited like a good 5min and no answer at all. I drive up to the window, (keep in mind they don't even open the window to answer my question), and ask the lady are you guys open? She literally looks at me never opens the window or comes over period. Just stood there and said, "Does it look like we're open??!" Making rude face expressions, never coming over, never opening the window, AND she kept acting like she couldn't hear me after that. IGNORING me... Plain nasty and RUDE.

This is one of my favorite locations in Tampa because of the convenience of having the Panera and FitLife Foods only a few steps away. The baristas here are very nice and already know me by name. Some I've noticrd have been there a few years already. One I know always has a cheerful attitude when I interact with. That's always a good sign for consistency and knowing that they must be happy there. I love how they are well stocked with a variety of sandwiches (sometimes depending on location they cam be hard to find). My order is also always correct when I come here (even though it helps that as a looooong time customer of Starbucks I know how to order). I love to come here for their delicious sandwiches for lunch and a drink on my way to work since its fast and convenient. Starbucks as a company has actually improved some with their food (its better than most fast food I should say).

I normally don't review large chains since people generally know what to expect - but this location seems super busy and it's worth warning people about the long delays - recently waited almost 30 mins from the time of my receipt to receive a plain old latte - which is 25 minutes too long.

Same Starbucks you'll find most of the time but if you're in a hurry you should probably keep going down the road.

I really gave this place a few shots before posting this review because Starbucks are busy, I get it. But I have had a few instances in the past week that I've never seen at another Starbucks in all of my years of buying their coffee. 
Earlier this week, I put in a mobile order and arrived about 10 minutes later when the estimated time was 4-7 minutes. I got there and there was one man in line, and two girls behind the counter. The one was working on someone else's drink (maybe another mobile order I assumed). Turned out, it was the man who had only just ordered. I always understood mobile orders to be your place in line, but I didn't say anything. I waited about 8 minutes for my whole order (I got multiple drinks but the longest thing I waited on was food because one of the girls behind the counter was stocking lids very slowly instead of making anything).
The next day, I put my mobile in earlier expecting the wait to be longer as it was a Monday. Put it through about 15 minutes early, still the whole order was not ready when I arrived! Took at least another 10 minutes for them to realize that they never finished one drink. 
Then this morning, I put in my mobile order in early. It was a Saturday at like 630 am, so in my mind, it would be more than enough time. I arrived and stood around because the drink wasn't ready yet. Found it odd because as I was standing there the workers didn't say anything. Finally, I asked if my drink was waiting behind the counter or something. This is when someone finally informed me that the espresso machine had not been cleaned, so she couldn't actually make my drink as the machine wasn't working. I was trying to catch a train, had stood there for several minutes before I even said anything, and at the very least the employee could've reimbursed me on a gift card and left that out to let me know something wasn't right.
I will not go back to this location. In all honesty, it's never busy, which I have to assume is because so many others before me have come to the same conclusion.

It's always amazing when I come here. Occasionally the baristas don't seem like they're taking their time so sometimes the drink doesn't taste right. I always get an iced caramel macchiato with 2 pumps of hazelnut. It's so yummy and they make it taste so sweet!! Drive through is quick and the workers are very nice and efficient. I recommend!

The new Iced Teas that they have here are deeeeeelish! Here I am sipping on a Venti Mango Black Tea Lemonade as I type this. The price is rather reasonable, and the tea is not too sweet. I am also a fan of the pretzel. Must get it warmed up for the added bonus. I have never been a fan of the pumpkin spice craze, but thumbs up to all that support it! Within walking distance, it's nice to have variety.

At first I wondered how a Starbucks could possibly have a two star review. After visiting, I completely understand!  The service at this place is awful!  I had to wait for the two employees working to finish their conversation before they even bothered to ask what I wanted. 
Once my drink was ready it was promptly plopped onto the counter without a word being said. The team working was then able to get back to their conversation without customers interrupting them. 
This is by far the worst Starbucks I've ever been to!
Hey. Coming from the Virginia area we needed a Starbucks fix.  None for miles it seems until we found this one on the way to the Betsy Ross house. Phew.  Needed a double shot of espresso. .

This is Starbucks at Poydras and St. Charles. It is an awesome and smaller location than the one a few blocks away at 700 Canal. A bit less crowded and touristy. The beverages are amazing. Got my red holiday reusable cup though I missed the launch so I am happy!!!! Baristas are kind and friendly. Location is great to work in or pass time enjoying a tasty beverage. You'll love this location too!!!

They ran out of Sugar in the Raw...they're located across from an Acme. Why not go buy some? Would you tell people who use other types of sweetener alternatives (Stevia, Equal, etc) "sorry, we're out"???

I frequent this Starbucks to study. It is a larger Starbucks than most in Tampa area (I've been to 6+ recently to study); it has over 6 'reading' chairs (no table), 6+ two-seater tables with one side of booth seating and your standard long table with 8-9 seats. There is outdoor seating as well.

The staff is friendly and competent. I've had a few experiences at other Starbucks locations where, in a slow period, they're joking / messing around to the extent that it's disruptive to people trying to read or study. I've been to this location over a dozen times total and I've never had that experience here.

Five star location for sure, I'd highly recommend coming in to either grab a quick drink or stay a while.
This Starbucks location is very slow compared to all other locations I've been to. They need to have a little more urgency because their drive thru lines get insanely backed up.

Best inside in the area because it's roomy and has plenty of seating. I've gone there a few times to do work. However, even though the staff is very friendly, they are incredibly loud amongst themselves. I know it's not a library but man, they're super chatty and because the music is loud they talk very loudly. That's the only draw back IMO.
Excellent and friendly staff, fun morning atmosphere, great coffee! Always clean. Very accessible location, spacious seating, and not overcrowded.

This is my favorite Starbuck's to frequent when in the French Quarter. There's not the uncharge that you get at the hotels and you can easily order online ahead of time for pickup. Definitely order ahead - it can be super busy.

I have been to this Starbucks everytime I come into town and I have to say, it is one of the most cleanest and nicely ran establishments I ever visit. I stay in harrahs frequently on business and always get my morning cup of coffee here . The people are absolutely wonderful and their lobby is always clean clean clean! I also appreciate that they have a wide selection of drinks and pastries for everyone to choose from, especially at odd ends of the day! Overall I am always pleased and highly recommend this place is anyone is ever in harrahs and is looking for their morning or mid afternoon coffee and pastry!

Did a mobile order. Got there a few minutes after they were supposed to be ready. The drinks were, but we waited 12 minutes for our breakfast sandwiches before checking on them. The worker was rude and said "it will be over there when it's ready'. We waited 5 more minutes, then had to cancel because we had to leave. So...15-20 minutes after we got our drinks I told the girl to cancel. She actually looked up the order and said she "didn't get it". Umm...it was a mobile order and our drinks were there. Had to leave, no apology from staff, no breakfast. Paid for two sandwiches but didn't get them. Do not go here!!! I have never had a bad experience like this at Starbucks!

Starbucks in my home town! The future is now!

As cozy good as caffeine gets on this casino floor!

Since this Starbucks is so close to Costco and ALDI, I expect that normally it is more packed, but I'll do some field research and come back a couple more times. For Yelp, of course.

No smile and very unwilling to make pleasant morning conversation.  Most Starbucks employees are very friendly which is part of what makes it easier to spend so much on very mediocre over-priced coffee.  If it weren't for the fact that this place is near where I keep my yacht at the Harbour, I would not go back.

This is my favorite neighborhood Starbucks and the first time I've dined in since the pandemic.

Take note,management, this employee (picture posted) definitely needs customer service training.  He asked what I needed and when I started to point at the coffee sleeves and stirrers, he yelled at me, Don't touch that!!  (This is after he tossed the Stevia packet at me vs handing to me.).  

I responded, you don't have to yell at me, I take directions very well."  He snarked back, We'll you wouldn't believe how many people don't." As if that makes his rude behavior and comments acceptable. 

I get  and appreciate it that you're trying to practice social distancing but this man needs to get off the caffeine and practice good manners.

I really wish this location would get it together. We live close by and go often which is dumb on our part because nothing is ever right and the baristas have some serious issues with customer service. Don't bother ordering ahead on the app because that takes even longer. 


Visit the one on Vets. They're super friendly and we've never had an issue there.

I love this Starbucks so much! I go every weekday morning and sometimes on my lunches as well. I always use the mobile ordering because it is so convenient. My drink/food is always perfectly prepared for me and ready as soon as I get there. The staff are all super friendly and they are super efficient. I used to wait in line before I got the app and they would just pump through the line. You don't have to wait 5+ minutes here just to put your order in and I love that. This is definitely my favourite one in the city!
Nice up to date location with plenty of shaded outdoor seating, long study table and comfy chairs. It was super packed but they kept the line moving and always friendly with a smile.

Let's face it we mostly do not visit Starbucks for the coffee but for the experience, the baristas are always with a smiling friendly face and super knowledgeable, they look me in the eyes and the customer service is  OUTSTANDING.

Speedy service, nice but not spacious on the inside - great outside seating area. 

For the size of this location the cleanliness is always great.

Keep it up Baristas! :)

Quite possibly the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. Not only is this location very dirty, but they also are not helpful or friendly. I ordered through their app and went in to pick-up my drink. I had to wait for at least 20 minutes for them to tell me they were out of Pink Drink ingredients. Do NOT come to this location. You might as well just go to Dunkin' Donuts. They will do a better job.

I frequent this Starbucks probably 100 times a year if not more. I know everyone is short-handed and randomly closing early because of this.

Could you PLEASE make the sign on the door large enough to see/read from the parking lot?

 I can't tell you how many times I've tried to stop by after work and think you are open because all the lights are on. I'm sure I am not the only one...or could you update the hours somewhere that is accessible like Google or the Starbucks app?

At this point the Starbucks off Emerson seems more reliable as per hours open. It's a little further for me, but I'm tired of driving to your location first...finding it closed ..then driving to the other location.

Service is short - ordered a Venti Iced Caramel Macchiato through the app. & the barista interrupted me multiple times - I had basic questions...shouldn't they learn how to help customers with online orders since I'm sure it's majority of there business?

This Starbucks is just okay - service brings it to 3/5 (should be better IMO). This is a big difference between the customer service I get at this location vs. the one on Sheldon Road, which always goes above & beyond; it's a 4/5 @Sheldon as a result.

Also, parking is really tight, so I recommend the drive through! My previous experiences wasn't really the best (nothing special here), so I don't stop here often at all despite it being on my drive home - maybe I come here only once every 4 months out of desperation.

I've been to this Starbucks somewhere in the realm of 100-200 times and I can truly say it's the best and most consistent coffee shop around.  Even if you want that "local" feeling, the employees get to know you and your drink orders.  I will go out of my way to go this this particular Starbucks due to the efficiency and friendliness of the employees.  I've seen the line 20 people deep and somehow I still have my coffee within 10 mins.

This was once my regular Starbucks to go to. Every time I have had an issue, or things went especially well, the management has always taken me seriously. Now, when I do go in, they remember me and my regular order and ask how I've been doing. The neat thing here is that there is a line marking where the water came to from Hurricane Katrina, and the line is higher than I am tall. They have had the occasional rude barista, but just tell the management, and they will take care of everything. Parking in front can be tight, but there is parking in the rear. There is no drive thru. There is some outdoor seating. The inside is a bit tight with the seating.

Recently, the exterior has undergone a facelift. The paint has gone from a brownish-yellow to a grey-white. The exterior seating still has nice strings of lights that come on at dusk. The parking lot in front has been cleaned up and the lines repainted. It is nice that despite the fact that this is an established store, it is still cared for.

The restrooms are not gender neutral, but single stall, and I have seen women coming out of the mens room when the line has gotten long, and no issue was made from it.

Too slow! I've been coming here for a few months now. This is my neighborhood Starbucks. From the long lines daily at the drive thru, to the full parking lots out front. Inside a sea of people. While fully staffed. I'll still manage to stay in the store for almost 15mins. Insane. Not to mention the high prices and mistakes on drink orders.

Can never go wrong with a mid day wake up call. Everything here tastes great and definitely hits my sweet tooth. Their baked goods are always fresh and you can get them warmed up if you ask them. Sometimes they have bogo grande or up, who can resist a steal like this.

This is the cafe that I usually go. employees are super nice and remember most of their regular's name. They also have strong customer connection! I always enjoy talking with every single employee who works here. It never feels like they're talking to you because they have to; you actually feel close to them. Also for mobile orders there haven't been a single time that I've ordered and they didn't have it ready when I got there. 
The cafe is always clean! and washrooms always have the needed supplies! I absolutely love this café!

I really like this Starbucks if I need some "me time". There is plenty of comfortable seats to just sit back and enjoy my coffee while reading my kindle. My coffee is made exactly like I ask. The staff seem to enjoy their job and are friendly without going overboard to where it seems fake . This is one of my favorites. They also have a drive thru
Worst Starbucks, worst staff. It's not clean, they're not nice, and they're not competent. Avoid at all costs. The reviews are awful for a reason!

Wow, I had to wait until the barista (if that's what you could even call her) finished her funny  story about being out of it, not sure if she was sick drunk or something else and falling down before arriving to work. After waiting I was informed they they had no decaf tea, in which it was so funny. I hate doing bad reviews but this one deserves it. Terrible service and a filthy store.

First Starbucks that didn't write Jade when I told them my name! I mean... they still spelled my name wrong, but at least it was some form of my name. They got my order right, and were very quick about it. I noticed they get a lot of mobile orders, and they are very good about dealing with those while simultaneously handling the orders in store. I got my coffee very quickly. There is plenty of seating, and the bathroom is clean. If you are looking for outlets, there are a few good spots to plug in. This particularly location is basically what I would expect from any Starbucks store.

I absolutely love this Starbucks .. so much so that I've become a bit of a regular. From the friendly staff to the fast service, I absolutely love coming in. Ashley and Pete are always there with my drink ready (often before I can even order!!) , a smile, and honestly get to know their customers. 

Whatever the staff is being paid is not enough!!

I used to work right on 4th & Market and parked around this Starbucks, so obviously on my walk to work, I would randomly stop in for a morning latte. I LOVE this staff. I have been to many-a-Starbucks and they are top notch and my absolute favorite. They were always so friendly and though I'd only stop in once a week, they remembered me and always had a warm welcome. I seriously miss this group and every time I am in Old City, I make sure I stop in because I love dealing with them. Just thought I would let Yelpers know how wonderful they are!

P.S. - Like another guy wrote, be VERY careful with parking. The PPA will nab your car within 3 seconds. Also, peak hours, it can be a little tight in there.

So as much as I appreciate them remaking my drink after they messed it up they still messed
Up the remake  I go to Starbucks all the time and never have issues with my drink being made correctly at other locations. Sucks you guys are always messing up my drink and the only close Starbucks to my job. I can't come here anymore it's a waste of money. Be better.

A Starbucks on an island, in a way. You have plenty of businesses on one side of Big Bend Road, yet not the other. The benefit- Starbucks gets the attention a Dunkin or small coffee shop normally would.

Good customer service on the inside, yet this location is so popular that you will easily see 20-25 cars backed all the way out onto the road due to the drive-thru being overwhelmed. The solution? Park your car at the adjacent bank, walk over into the inside of the store, and pick up your order with almost no wait. Seriously, this location may have 8 baristas behind the bar, yet 6 of them are dedicated to make drinks for the drive-thru patrons. 

Overall, not a bad location. Just be patient in getting your drink order if you like 20-25 minute drive-thru wait times.

Best Starbucks around. The lack of a drive-through keeps this place still feeling like an actual coffee shop. Baristas run like a well oiled machine, they make my order just a bit better than most Starbucks, and they even remember names and orders, despite being ALWAYS busy. An actual hospitality experience, something lost on many chains.

It is 3.9.17
I have visited this place a few times since my last review a month or so ago.
I will bot be back. There are too many other SB locations worthy of my business.
I have read the other recent reviews. They are spot on. The customer service here is completely lacking. The employees are slow (it was NOT busy when I went), unmotivated and unfriendly.

For the most part this location does a decent job in delivering good, temperature appropriate food/beverages. On many occasions they've forgotten to give napkins, condiments, and/or handed items out of the window one by one rather than putting everything into a bag. I know there's a pandemic going on and shortages on supply but let's think logically and give the customers what they need.

We love this Starbucks for a few reasons: 
It is close to the blue route so we can get to it easily en route to and from work. The staff is always kind and welcoming. They are also most knowledgeable about their products' ingredients, and the ambiance is bright and the place is always clean! Keep up the great work, Starbucks!

Stopped in here during a conference we had in Nashville. We were staying at the Omni so this location is on the opposite side of the entrance from the hotel. It was a quick walk and our service was friendly and fast. You cannot use Starbucks rewards here though. Nice little seating areas too.
The lobby is opened but the employees are focused on drive thru. Why not have someone designated to the lobby customers, so we're not waiting in the lobby for 10 mins.

Came to Starbucks to grab a quick drink but no one seemed to be manning the drive through. I was throughly disappointed and did not get coffee. Then unfortunately, I got so tired from lack of coffee that I crashed my car. Thanks Starbucks.
They were busy as can be and completely killed it with customer service and quality!  Great job Big Bend crew!

It's too hit or miss. I'm not a big coffee person, so I only ever get the caramel macchiato when I need a pick me up. Sometimes it's good, sometimes it's nasty. It almost tastes burnt the last few times I got it. Recently, I brought it back because it was nasty and burnt and I heard the lady say under her breath "she gone drink half the cup then bring it back." I had only taken like 3 sips! And even if I would have drank more of it so what? It's nasty and I want it remade. But I still come here every so often I just hate that I have to have my fingers crossed like I hope it will be good this time.

This Starbucks is located inside the Fry's. I'm not a coffee drinker but my regular order at Starbucks is Iced Green Tea Lemonade. I stopped by this location this morning and I honestly was in and out in under 2 minutes! Can't complain about that. The employees were very friendly and my drink was correct.
Love this location! The employees are friendly and the service is quick! My drink is always great and it's always a good experience.

I ran through the drive through on my lunch last week wanting something hot, and asked if they could mimic a drink for me. I asked the barista to make me a hot version of the new oat milk drink, and boy did she do a great job. I will be getting this from on now, and save the iced version for the summer! 

The line was pretty bare and had my drink in a timely manner! Be sure to tip your baristas!

Awful experience. I always order the same exact thing from Starbucks, for years now, a nitro cold brew iced coffee. The baristas here were so confused by my order and kept ensuring I wanted it iced. I've never even been asked that before, it's never been an issue. I ended up getting an entire cup of ice with literally a few sips of coffee. The girl who took my order was clueless and I didn't get a receipt but I was able to see on the coffee cup they put I wanted extra ice? I have no idea where that came from. No other Starbucks has ever done this, and what I was given looked nothing like what I always get. $5 for the most simple cup of coffee and it was all ice. It was unbelievable. I've never had such an awful Starbucks experience, and the baristas were so unhelpful and uncaring.

This Starbucks goes above and beyond to make every customer happy! I come in to study or to get a drink before going to church, a few times per month. My primary Starbucks is in Lebanon but I love this Brownsburg Starbucks just the same! They try to greet every customer when they come in and notice if you come in frequently! They are a busier Starbucks but they are quick and efficient! Today, one of the employees noticed I had been been studying for a while and brought over a free drink to me, which is the sweetest thing I have ever experienced in a Starbucks! I recommend this Starbucks to everyone!

Today, I witnessed horrible behavior from the manager. Starbucks corporate needs to investigate and fire the manager at this location for the absolute horrendous behavior and attitude she has for her employees and customers. Your employees are not slaves. Treat them with dignity.

look at the sign and the time on the picture and tell me the two dont add up. this happens every fucking day and they change their times for closing everyday. pretty fucking stupid. like its not my problem you dont want to work.

Ahh will never go to this Starbucks again. I go there most mornings, I order the same thing every time I go. Today I go for the same thing I get a med nitro brew with Carmel sweet cream. Every other time I order it, I comes out with the nitro brew with the sweet cream and caramel sauce on top. It's my favorite. But today the cashier tells me I can't get it that way. I asked her if I can have the caramel on top, she says no it going be in the coffee. I said I would not like it in the coffee I just want it on top. She says it comes in the coffee and didn't put any on top. Thank you will find another coffee house to go to even if it's in another state.

Terrible service. They are supposed to open for 5am, and for the 4th morning in a row we pulled in the drive thru between 5:05-5:15am, and the two-three women that are supposed to  working either didn't acknowledge us or told us they won't be serving until 5:30. Needless to say I won't be back and recommend the same anyone trying to go before 5:30am.

Last Monday I was having a crazy, rough day.. my phone was picked up by someone by accident and my whole life went blank.. You know how it is when you're cut off from the world, and you know no one's phone numbers by heart, LOL! But Brandyn, an exceptional human being at Starbucks, took my order and said, "It's on us."  I was so taken aback by this... it immediately calmed me and allowed me to sit down and get centered. Then another employee came over with a small brown bag with "I hope your day gets better" written on the outside, and a pink cake pop on the inside.  What an incredible personal touch! These guys ROCK!,  and they definitely made my day so much better.  Great job Starbucks.

This is such a reliable starbucks location. Tonight Byron was working at the starbucks window and he made our night!
