My sister and I were taking a break from caring for our Mom, and finally got to run out for some coffee. Byron was so kind and friendly that we were able to laugh and have a nice convo and just take break from the chaos! 
We hope Byron gets a raise he's amazing! And the coffees were perfect yay!!
Awesome Starbucks. Drinks always taste good, stores always clean, and the baristas are friendly. Really awesome atmosphere too. It's a circular shape which I found cool. I'll be back!
They went down became so rude even to use the bathroom you cannot so they will excuse you from stupidity excuse this is pandemic what is there to do the service where is the service!!

This Starbucks is okay. It smells overwhelmingly of mold though. One of the best parts about Starbucks is when you walk in and the coffee aroma punches you in the face. Imagine my disgust when I breathed deep and got no such warm welcome. Blegh.

Anyway, the service was very fast and friendly. My flat white is not the best I've ever had. I think the espresso is pulling too much water, or maybe it's not hot enough. It's not bad enough to return and have them remake though.

Hubs' triple chocolate mocha frappuccino is freakin' delicious, but I don't know how you could mess that up other than using spoiled milk. It is just a really good drink (or calorie bomb, whichever).

Overall, not impressed, but it fulfilled its purpose. I hope they get that mold/mildew smell situated soon.
I always go there. They always give me free water when other places make a big deal out of it. The customer service is always on point. I recommend you guys to try this location. Thank you!
Best Starbucks crew in the area. Always friendly with a smile even when busy. Too bad they are temporarily closed for a few days. Go to the rt. 70 Barclay Farm SBs. There are nice there too.

Its not that hard to get the simple orders in right. I didnt not ask for special order, just what they got in the menu. . Ugh I had to explain the drink for the person. 
Also, cant they find morning people to work in the morning who can be happy to work in the morning. ?!
This was not my first time of experience grumpy crew in the morning.  It is the worst thing to face the grumpy people in the morning as I walk in to grab a simple drink of latte..  
And yes, they are ALWAYS OUT OF SOMETHING !!!
Not impressed.

absolute worst and most pathetic starbucks i've ever experienced. for context, i am 18 years old and have lived in bordentown for 15 years, and have gone to this specific starbucks for after-school treats since i was a child. last year my friend and i went to this starbucks at nighttime and she ordered a vanilla bean frappuccino. she was given a literal glass of unflavored ice. it was the texture of a frappuccino but there was no flavor. we tried giving it back and asking for a new drink but the manager insisted that we were wrong somehow and had to be persuaded to take it back and make her a new drink. months later, i ordered an iced coffee, only to discover burnt pieces of black plastic floating in it. one of the machines had malfunctioned. recently for some reason they have refused to open the front of their store and have been "drive-through only", which i think is absolutely ridiculous. they also are terribly slow because they have a shortage of workers, which i know because i asked a drive-through employee if i could apply online, to which she responded "oh yes, we are very short on workers!". i have applied twice, and have heard back zero times. now i work at chick-fil-a, a franchise which actually provided me with a punctual response to my application and offered me a job. i went to this specific starbucks again last week for a drink and a lunch and i was in the drive-through for 39 minutes (i was looking at the time). it took 39 minutes to go through the drive through because they have a severe worker shortage, refuse to accept applications for some reason, and also do not open the front of their store.

This Starbucks is a mess. They are very disorganized and have no issues letting you stand at the counter for several minutes before acknowledging you. Really it's the staff at this location that are the problem. Although a few are very nice, several are very controlling about where you stand and even wait for your order, and outright rude and snobby when responding to simple questions. I recommend going to the Speedway across the street rather than dealing with this place.

This place has horrible customer service. I'm always in line about 30 minutes to even an hour every time I order. I went through today, waited 30 minutes for my order just for them to not accept the $100 I had. I asked if her manager could get change from the safe because it was all I had and I had already waited in line for 30 minutes. (every single store has a safe for this reason when they need change or to make a deposit) and the woman working the drive thru says  mockingly "No. I don't know what to tell you there's a bank right over there." I was mortified and drove off. I will never be going there again.

This location is a joke. A bunch of young kids working making up their own rules and causing such an inconvenience to customers. The drinks are never really consistent in taste and they give you a attitude when you ask them to remake it. I've been to other locations around my area including the ones in target and everyone has been pleasant and nice. This location needs a serious revamp in team members

Fell in love with a barista after having a conversation about this cross country road trip I'm taking. Raises the stakes knowing I won't be back too philly for a long time. Felt the vibe, missed the opportunity. Thinking about her hours later, resorted to leaving a yelp review....have never stooped so low

Great experience 10/10 would do again

-a crisis having young man

Came in today (Friday morning)- this location is so very cute and cozy, I wish I had had the time to lounge and enjoy it! The employees here are awesome! They were pretty busy but so polite, and do not make you feel rushed, and very friendly. All drinks came out perfectly! Thank you and great job y'all!
Employees turn people away before posted closing time. As a former Starbucks partner, this goes against company values.

This place used to be out standing, but now they have all new staff who seem to have never been taught how to do their job. Also very rude people. Everytime I order from here my drink is not even filled to the top and it is ALWAYS made wrong. There is ALWAYS about a quarter left empty in the coffee. Wtf. I paid for a venti and y'all cant FILL THE CUP?! It is now to the point where I do my best to avoid coming to this star bucks, or I will go to the dunkin close by. Seriously, wtf is going on. I hate to sound like a karen, and Im all for benefit of the doubt, but its happened at least five times now. Do better.

Cashier with the dark pink and blonde hair has NEVER been friendly. As the first person you interact with in the morning....this should be unacceptable coming from someone working at Starbucks. Disappointed.

I stood at the counter for 5 min and every single person behind the counter just looked at me and walked away or flat out ignored me. When I finally got someone to acknowledge me, instead of helping me herself, she asked another girl to help me, who only acted that I was annoying her by trying to purchase coffee and breakfast. I won't be back to this location.

This place has the rudest staff. Lady named Milo opened door on Sunday morning after 50 knocks. Could clearly see my 7 drinks on counter and she wouldn't hand them to us. I asked if I could grab them and she absolutely not, get in drive through line. The line had 20 people plus. Asked multiple times as only 5' from door. There was at least 5-6 staff members working so they were just being lazy. Never coming back here.

This Starbucks is in the worst location possible in traffic pattern. Despite placing my mobile order well in advance, typically it's not ready. Patience isn't an issue, I understand Covid has played hell on our workforce so I don't mind waiting. The issue is, when I place my order online, I pay for extras, an extra shot of expresso, etc. There are other custom selections to my drink order as that is how I enjoy it. However, when I arrive most days, they can't find my order, ask me if I just placed it or say it's just not in the system. Then when I get to the window and show my mobile receipt, the ask ok just a venti white mocha!? No, not just a venti white mocha because I already paid for these extras. It's near daily. My only other option is past my workplace and doesn't do mobile ordering.  The cost of your coffee is premium, the service should be too.
Do not go to this Harrison location. They give you drinks that are all ice and when you bring it to their attention  they just tell you...."everything is measured." I payed $5 for ice.

Horrible service. Walked in as the only customer with one order ahead of me. Stood there for 15 minutes while others got served first. Interaction from employees was less than friendly or understanding. Walked out with one drink instead of try two I ordered. At least I asked for a refund. Will NOT be back to this location.

I've never had this happen before but today I was not happy with my starbucks. I asked for a hot latte and received an iced latte, I bought a chicken wrap box......it was terrible!!! The wrap had barely any chicken it!! While the flavor was good, I had to eat a plain wrap with nothing in it BECAUSE I WAS STARVING and already back at my job. NOT HAPPY!!!! There has also been times when I have ordered my latte and got back to my job (which is in the same parking lot as my Starbucks!!) and when I sipped by drink I could feel how light it was, opened the lid and the cup was just over half full. Seriously!!!!!! So now I ask for light whip cream so they don't fill half of the cup with whip cream. Last time I checked....whipped cream was just a topping.
Drive thru is good, but frequently busy. The wait times are not long, staff in drive thru is nice. Coffee is good!

Yes, Starbucks are quite similar from one to the next but I wanted to drop a review for this one for two key reasons:
1.) The young gentleman operating the drive-thru orders during our visit and could have fooled me if he said he was an on-air radio talent. His positive energy and confidence poured through the speaker and brought an instant smile to our faces.
2.) The burnt butterscotch latte is delicious. Give it a shot while its on the menu.

I love that this location is so close to me.  I recently started delivering for Uber Eats as a side job.  This is one of my favorite spots to pick up deliveries from. They almost always have the order ready and if it's not ready, I never have to wait more than a few minutes. They package the items to perfection and write the customer's name on the bags, which helps me out if I'm picking up multiple orders. 
The employees who work here are fabulous and always very welcoming. 

I always look forward to stopping in!!!!

My only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is because the parking lot is way too small and crowded for how popular this location is! I came to get my Fall dose of PSL and just as usual... I was not disappointed  The indoor seating is gorgeous and spacious as well.

With the choice between this location and the one inside westshore mall, this is definitely the better choice.  Plenty of seating inside but only two tables outside.  The staff was great and very pleasant.  Coffee was perfect as was the food.  I enjoyed the comfy seating by the window to chill at.
My coffee was delicious, but unless you have A LOT of time on your hands, you might want to go to the one down the street.

The worst Starbucks we've been too. Very dirty. Very unorganized. Our sandwiches weren't even cooked. Our cold brew coffee didn't taste like coffee. It took an hour for us to get coffee and food when we were the first people in line.

This place is awful. I ordered a drink and they didn't even start it until i asked 30 minutes later. 4 girls  came in 20 minutes after me and they got their drinks and food before me. I asked for no whip and they still gave me whip. I checked 3 times before i asked them abt my drink so don't call me a Karen. I've been here before and the food is very overpriced. And whenever i sit at the tables they're always so dirty and the bathroom is worse than a gas station bathroom. I stopped going a couple months ago because all their machines were broken and they're always out of materials. Do they not restock?  I recently came back and luckily they did have some materials but never most, whenever you check the app, half the items are out. This place is so bad, overpriced, messy and unorganized.

My least favorite Westbank Starbucks, but the closest one to me. Usually timely with app/in-store orders... that is IF you can order what you want because they're usually out of nearly half of the menu items - especially seasonal flavors/drinks! Ive started orders on the app MANY times only to be disappointed that the drink I want or even the syrup add-in I'd like is not available, although you can still select it. Never use the drive through - always long and slow. Order ahead through the app!! In general, their coffee is not nearly as strong or flavorful as that of local shops.
Depends on what time of the day you go the service is good. Jason at the drive thru window is the best! Always so kind. Also I LOVE that they have  real dog treats for my pup!

Overall, I'm neutral about this location. They have great customer service and the drive thru moves with relative speed, even when busy (though I still recommend going in if you can due to the poor design of the parking lot).  My primary issue is the inconsistency with quality. Some days, I get a sweet cream cold brew and it tastes delicious. Other days, it's as if it has no cream at all and I have to throw it out.  The drinks are too expensive for that and I usually find myself just going to Dunkin' Donuts instead where it's cheaper and usually made as ordered. 

The other irritation with this location is their inability to affix the lid.  It's almost a 90-95% certainty that I will end up with coffee on me. This is another reason to go inside because you can press the lid down prior to picking up your drink. Not much you can do when it's being handed to you from the window. 

I have used this location for Uber eats delivery before and their packaging in that regard is great so I recommend that if you are a regular. I would definitely use it if I found the drink quality reliable.
Standing inside 40 min for one drink? Not worth it. They will always give your food cold and then give you attitude if you ask for it warmed up.

Retrain. Including manager!! Simple birthday redeem can't even process! And tried to blame me for it when I mentioned many times before I even ordered!! Didn't even bother being nice and didn't even get the correct beverage!!

This is the second time I have a wonderful interaction with the people in drive thru. The first time, I was whistling video game tunes and the barista liked it so much, I got an upgrade.  Today, I was repeating what my wife was ordering verbatim, including words like, "I guess, umm..". Then, a barista separate from the one taking my order came on the mic and said, "Bro, you guessing what your wife wants?  You gonna be in trouble."  That led to a wonderful yet playful conversation that made all of us chuckle, including my wife who was in the car with me. I do enjoy these kinds of interactions and they make my day in an otherwise gloomy year. To boot, the drinks were well made and the pastry I got was good.

A great afternoon stop, nice patio outside and beautiful inside seating.

The coffee is addictive !

((( Great service too )))

I typically place a mobile order, walk in, receive and go at any Starbucks but I encourage it here. The staff is always friendly and prompt. When I leave, the drive thru is usually in the same spot though so order ahead and you don't have to wait.

Lady at the drive thru was real sweet. Girl on the mic wanted to argue what a black eye is. Just run a quick google search. It's coffee with shots of espresso, not sweetened coffee. I'm done with this Starbucks. Y'all are terrible.

My favorite Hot Starbucks Espresso Beverage is the Venti Carmel Macchiato!!

I admit I'm very picky about my order. But it's not like it's a .99 cent cup of coffee.  

I was soo blown away tonight as the Barista made my Carmel Macchiato ABSOLUTELY PERFECTLY DELICIOUS and on point!!!

My hubby and I frequent this Starbucks Location drive thru whenever we can. 

Hubby just orders the Venti Pike w/cream & 4 Splenda, he's not hard to please at all. If I wasn't with him, he'd settle for a cheap regular coffee from the Donut Place. 

I, on the other hand, am not a fan of coffee. So, when we are out together, it's Starbucks only. Lol. 

I order the Hot Venti Sugar Free Carmel Macchiato with 9 Pumps of the Sugar Free Vanilla Syrup, Extra Carmel Drizzle In the cup, 3 Splenda, 2% Frothed Milk, Just 1 shot of Espresso (not the 2 that comes with this) and with a straw to sip from. 

Yes, I know it sounds like a lot but I am a diabetic and I also can't have a lot of caffeine so I have to be specific. 

5 STARS from the Barista tonight, my Macchiato was Perfection!!  Thank You so Much!

This Starbucks didn't cater to my needs, so needless to say, I won't be back:  

1.) I needed to put in three different BOGO drinks and they wouldn't allow me to do that. They said the offer is only one per customer, but the Westshore/Cypress location has always allowed me to do multiple orders in one transaction in comparison. I told the cashier I needed to ring up 3 transactions, but she must've not been listening...whatever - chalk it up to a misunderstanding & incompetence. As a result, I didn't order my Carmel Macchiato or get a BOGO Iced Black Tea. 

2.) I waited 10 min. for my friend's Ham & Cheese Croissant...they forgot and I even got there early before the 2pm BOGO rush. Whatever - this location feels scatter brained to me.

I appreciated that they filled the Venti Passion Tango Lemonade (no ice) to the brim (I paid my coworker to have her second tea as a result)!

Parking isn't too bad - it's shared between Panera, Petsmart & other businesses.

Arrived @ 5:20 PM. Happy the wifi works in the parking lot on this cold day. Seats outside are not very socially distanced. All inside closed down. Understandable. Very friendly ladies behind the counter. Not sure if one is in training because two don't need to be standing around just chatting it up with each other ignoring customers. These two behind the counter just laughing it up, talking about up north and "some other girl the other day" and I can hear all these personal conversations over the music that I assume was playing. I was greeted by them so I'm acknowledged but they don't trace where I've been or how long I was there. 

One speedy worker making ALL the drinks - no help and they may like it like that and then the 1 barista working drive thru. I stood in the store for almost 20minutes waiting on my order. I asked the ladies, who ignored me since the initial hello,  where my order was because I have been standing over there waiting. I was pacing after my order said ready but I watched the barista making ALL the drinks. I never received an apology just laughter- more like giggles and reply of "It got mixed up with drive thru, haha". I didn't find it funny that Over 10minutes after the app said my order was ready and no one asked me why I'm waiting around. Very disappointing. Most other Starbucks bend over backwards to make sure customers are happy. If one is in training then she is not learning the Starbucks way from her trainer. Luckily this is not my normal Starbucks because if so you just made we wanna walk into Sip85 instead of this because that experience was so stressful. 

I wish management good luck because those two employees earn the giggle and gossip award but not hard working. 

Most displeased

I'm not sure if I've seen a more well designed and aesthetically pleasing Starbucks than this one. 

They have a beautiful patio outside with a privacy screen and the inside has ample space between the seating. One big table, a couch area, private areas, and a wall of small and medium tables. If I lived over here, this would definitely be a choice for doing work. 

The staff were all in a great mood and very helpful with my sleepy self. I opted for the pumpkin crepe cold brew and it was ready within a couple minutes. 

The area to order is a little tiny if a line does begin, but I think they move pretty quickly to mediate that problem. 

Also my grande cold brew was $4.50 - what a steal for Starbucks since I usually pay between $5-7 at other locations.

We all have bad days, and it's then that great employees stand out. Josef couldn't fake it today. After my order, I let him know that yesterday I had a cappuccino from this location that was made with only milk (no coffee), and as I watched his blood drain from his face, I continued to explain that we used it at the office for other coffees, so all good, we got value and I didn't want any refund, just an FYI here. His response was an eye-roll and the standard reciting of what seemed to be the Starbucks policy manual's suggested response. It couldn't have been less sincere. His distain for me and all that I apparently represented in his agitated state of mind, was risible. Josef, I'd bet you're better than that. Next time you're triggered, handle it.

It's actually a Starbucks window in Harrahs casino no seating and always crowded with casino patrons. The prices are higher than a free standing store but if you need a coffee fix it's your only choice.

I just went through the drive-thru and it took forever.. No one inside either ordering I don't know why it took so long today and then she tried to tell me a mango dragon fruit was a creamy drink and she wanted to sit there and argue with me... To the little teenage whatever chick that was so rude and had an attitude... know your drinks honey because I sure do.

I don't frequent Starbucks much but I will be back to this location because of the awesome staff! Quick and friendly, and were so nice to recommend something to eat with my nitro brew since it can upset the stomach. Remember to tip your baristas! :)

Consistently a 20-30 minute wait for a mobile order AND the landscaping is unkept and outside dirty. Way to show pride in the neighborhood. I try to go to the Vets location even though it is far less convenient. They really need to get it together.

Pros:  Drive Thru

Cons:  Hurried service and over crowded.

Your typical Starbucks -not bad and not outstanding.

I came to this location today, first time and was disappointed. I am a patient person but it took a long time eventhough there were lots of employees, and granted busy. But some were just doing nothing and could have been wiping the counter that was not clean nor the floor areas. They got my order wrong since I ordered a cappuccino and got a frappucino which I could see happening since they sound alike thru thru the shield and masks, but after a long wait was disgusted. Although employee did offer to correct I walked away not wanting to wait a long time again. So ate it outside with my muffin. I did not see napkins and feel they should be offered for the price you pay. I was too aggravated to ask and couldn't wait to get out. I saw another customer with the same reaction shaking her head. Seems they are not as organized as they should/could be! I prefer the other location on Eagle Rd.
Friendly team. Quick service. Music is loud and a bit wild. Loud dubstep. Team seems pleasant behind the counter. Smiles all around. Great job.

Starbucks. The usual sort. A seriously crappy parking lot kinda sucks the awesome out of the joint, and I'm not a fan of the velvet chairs (the leather on S Howard is superior)

And the phalanx of loser smokers out front kinda ruins the entry... but thats everywhere these days, so I can't blame Starbucks for idiot addicts killing themselves...

Friendly and helpful staff make it all OK. :-)
I don't know why I came back.  Told myself never again and here I am 20 mins into my order and no drinks... terrible.

Horrible experience 

While I was ordering a drunk another female behind the counter interrupted my order and corrected me that Starbucks doesn't make skinny peppermint mochas anymore.   I found this intrusive and rude.  I thought I ordered a frappacibo peppermint mocha and actually received it over ice.  Yuk.  Additionally my child ordered a chocolate chip cookie not warmed.  She threw the cookie across the counter and said @dont forget the cookie".  I have never receive a cookie in a plastic wrap with the date on it. It has always been served in a paper bag.  Zero finesse or class at this place.  She was entirely unprofessional and diminished the experience one pays for and expects at a Starbucks. Get your cookie and coffee off the shelves because this was jus a bad experience.

It takes a lot for me to give a Starbucks a low score but this location is not my favorite. I ran into an issue where one of the drinks I ordered required "steamed lemonade" the barista was very rude when replying that "we don't steam lemonade" and when I asked why he simply asked the manager. The manager stated it was a "health code" violation and stated they couldn't make my drink. They didn't offer to sub the lemonade for anything or even to NOT steam the lemonade, they just moved on to the next customer. I contacted their customer service and they said there's no reason the lemonade couldn't be steam and apologized profusely for the situation. To this day I still avoid this location, it's worth it to drive further down the road.

Three trips back and forth for them to get our simple order and they still couldn't get it right.  Manager Steven could not follow thru with his promise to get us our order after three trips.  He told us he couldn't refund the order.  If I can't get my order right or my money back, what is the point.  Yesterday the same thing happened.  They refuse to put white mocha in any of our drinks but they say they have it.  At this point I just feel like they dislike us and are doing this purposefully.  I have been more than patient for the last several orders but this place can not get their act together and I am forced to leave a review.  I had to demand to get gift cards back which is the least they could do.  Starbucks corporate should do something about this behavior.

This is our go to place when my kids are in tow and the hubby wants to gamble.  There's a few chairs and tables to sit and relax at but otherwise nothing to really write home about.

The reasoning for the 4 stars is the service.  Some places don't like to split drinks for you.  Other places will split drinks but you have to split them yourself and they will provide you with the cup.  Honestly, I don't see the difference but whatever, I play by the rules. Anyway, the workers here are always nice to not only me but my three boys.  They are friendly and constantly trying to talk to them, and no, not in that creepy stalkerish way eitherway.  They treat them as human beings instead of kids that will wreck the place and they have to clean up the aftermath.

I almost always see them cleaning.  Most Starbucks in my area aren't doing this.  Either they are too busy or they just don't care but these workers are always cleaning.  They have their moments when they are busy but there's always time to clean.  I'm totally a fan of that, especially being a mom of three boys.

Keep up the good work and I'll keep frequenting this place while we are in town.

Mobile ordering constantly turned off/unavailable at this location recently and store closes early without updating hours on the app.

Great staff, but it's almost a daily frustration with the long drive-thru lane being the only option

Very rude staff. I ordered caramel macchiato medium size and gave them a smug to be filled. They kept my smug some where and forgot to brew my macchiato. I stood in the front desk for about 30 minutes until they finish serving all their customers quietly. Knowing that every body coming behind me was properly served I kept patient thinking they might consider it. Finally, I politely asked them if my order is up and they were a kind of confused and none of them have even remember what my order was. It took me about ten minutes to explain them about my order and I finally located that my smug was thrown some where in the corner. After this all no body has apologized but rudely asked me to pay again. What a strange behavior is going on around Starbucks?
drink is slushed flavored ice. nasty. i'm disappointed. i thought all starbucks places were supposed to be good.

This used to be a really good Starbucks, but their service has gone way downhill.  2 weeks in a row I've put in the same order and something has been messed up both times.  

All I ordered was 2 bacon breakfast sandwiches and a coffee with 3 cream.  1st trip last week, coffee comes to me black.  I can forgive this because the coffee is still edible when it's black.  

Today I go there and put in the exact same order - 2 bacon breakfast sandwiches and a coffee with 3 cream.  I get my sandwiches home and it turns out one of them is a sausage sandwich.  I hate breakfast sausage sandwiches, because they smell so nasty it's like anus wrapped in vomit, diarrhea, and period blood.  

I spend 20 mins on the phone with the Starbucks and they can't find my receipt.  Fortunately, they put an approximation of my order on one of the breakfast sandwich wrappers so I still had that.  They asked me if I could come back, I said not right now but later I could.  

I went to the gym to work out and then on my way home came back through the Starbucks.  I gave them the wrapper and this time they stepped up and paid for their mistake, gave me a free bacon egg and gouda breakfast sandwich - they were all out of the bacon egg and cheese ones by that time.  

Still though, very frustrating to go there twice and have the order screwed up both times.  There's a new Starbucks just down on the road in between Gateway Blvd and Calgary Trail and 51 Ave.  I'll be going there from now on, give a new location a shot.  

If I had put in an order for 20 customized coffees than I could forgive them for screwing up something in the order.  Even a 1 time screwup I could forgive.  Consecutive screwups on a simple order, though?  I cannot overlook that.

Literally the worst Starbucks I have ever been too. Besides the line always being a mile long and the staff being slow, they also cannot make a drink properly. $7 for a green tea latte with extra scoops of matcha and Natalie hands me a cup of milk with matcha at the bottom and said that they forgot to shake it. Even after stirring the drink there definitely is not 6 scoops of matcha in here.

It's Starbucks and this is NOLA which means there are lots of local coffee options but this location is great. Fast, friendly and drinks prepared properly, what more could a girl ask for...ohhh yeah she asks for establishments that are conscious of and follow COVID rules, which they do THANKS STARBUCKS

I ordered the green tea latte but with a cappuccino ratio of milk. Unfortunately, the cashier wrote, "latte, half foam" so I got a very heavy drink. I explained the miscommunication to the barista, she knew exactly what I wanted and remade it perfectly. 5 stars for the young lady!

I really only came here once. It was on our way to Cape May and I was having a serious crave. We really only popped in and out (definitely less than 10 minutes) which much to my surprise is a GOOD THING! Anyone knows its VERY rare to do that at a Starbucks when you're not using the mobile app. 

You know the saying, first impression and all that, well the atmosphere and cleanliness definitely made an impression... a good one. I can't comment too much on them as we didn't order anything other than beverages so there wasn't much interaction. But the customer service I received was nothing to complain about. I definitely see myself returning if ever on another road trip in that direction.

Until next time,
~~You may pay the bucks, but you're treated like a star.

This has got to be the worst location, but because it is the closest to my house... I will still go to this one.

Messed up orders a few times, which is fine. Not anyone's fault, but darn. Do not take your anger and place your rudeness on the customers!

Drinks seem to be inconsistent. Every time I order a frap from this location, it's watered down and not frozen. Lattes taste diluted. If I'm lucky enough I'll be able to go on a day a good barista is working..

A bunch of confused employees, over staffed yet slow and no one knows what's going on. Manager is rude and the food on display is moldy. Response to telling them said they're display doesn't reflect the provided food. Lmao come onnnn

Consistency and friendly service is the hallmark of any Starbucks. This location has lived up to this standard. My order is always ready at the time specified on the app and given to me with a smile (you can tell even when masked). Thanks Starbucks!

The food and drinks here gave me food poisoning. As I was waiting for my order, I was just looking around and I saw they had milk (which looked old) sitting on the counter. Also, they need more staff. I saw only 2 people at this location. I will NEVER come here again. And if this is the closest Starbucks to you, drive a little farther to a different one, it'd be worth the drive.
I was unaware that it is apparently bad manners to call and order a box of coffee the day you want it. The staff was unbelievably rude.

Just sipping on a Vanilla chai tea latte w/ soy, no H2O.... I know it's hot but my tastebuds were salivating for my favorite hot tea.

(Pause for a sip) 

Yep, still as good as always....

I went here the first time the other night because I was out and about and they were pretty much the only place open. The staff wasn't entirely nice. I don't expect staff to go out of their way to talk to me or get to know me but you can tell when someone doesn't want to be at their job and are very negative and yeah this girl just had attitude. The drinks weren't especially prepared all that great and I just got stuff off the menu, nothing fancy. I do like that they extended their drive through however it is still extremely tight and coming at night from the dark parking lot a hard to see. I definitely will not stop here if I'm in town again. I'd rather go to wawa.

Went on Wed 11/4/15.
Great service service as usual.
Cashier in drive thru was friendly,  helpful and a delight! He had great red hair!

This place was disgusting. I'd rather drive to Rockville Road then to get something from here ever again. If I could give zero stars I would! Between given me the wrong drinks and old food with a bad attitudes, It's not worth it! My advice travel elsewhere.

The promise of Starbucks drive through is that they get your order right every time. Out of my 5-6 visits here so far my order gets messed up twice. This location is logistically great for me to and from work but I think I will go back to Quik Trip if I have to break for coffee. 
Yesterday there was a mumbler at the drive through. I could barely hear him and he did not confirm anything I was saying to him. Of course the drink order is wrong, I asked for soy milk and got regular milk and when I asked him if it was soy milk, I was told I did not tell him that I wanted soy milk. Yes, he did offer to make me another drink and asked me to wait in front of the Starbucks instead of the drive through line. That's fair. And 10 minutes later I had to walk into the place to ask for my replacement drink. I give up on this place. There are so many other coffee shops in the area with better service. Sorry Ferguson Starbucks, you need to up your customer service game.

This is my favorite Starbucks in the New Orleans area. It is pleasantly located on Harrison Ave. in Lakeview, has a great outdoor seating area, and always has good service. 

BOTTOM LINE: #1 Starbucks in NOLA!

A busy, smaller Starbucks in the heart of Center City, this one doesn't have a whole lot in the way of seating (especially with so many people coming in and trying to grab a seat) along its slender interior.

The baristas are on their A-game here, though; they've always been super-friendly and I get a perfect drink every time.

This just isn't the place for you to expect to come and study & chill with a beverage.

One of the worst Starbucks in the area.... I tend to drive 12 miles away from this location because they don't have consistency. Besides of the nasty attitudes Starbucks needs to teach some of the people here how to make coffee.... it's hot or miss 

I have never seen another coffee place temporarily close so much either....

Came here this morning, because I got tired of wawa and Dunkin donuts and wanted something different. I was automatically attracted to this Starbucks even though I passed 4 others because they have a drive through and it was freezing cold outside. I didn't realize that it would take forever to get my items. With 5 cars in front of me it took several minutes. Once I ordered they were out of cream cheese which is kind of annoying. You would think the buyer would order enough cream cheese to equal the amount of bagels, but no. And by the time I got my bagel it wasn't even really warm. My white chocolate mocha didn't taste right. I probably will not comeback unless it's another cold morning because when you pay $7 for 2 items that didn't come out right and take forever to make that's not acceptable.

I'm surprised that during a busy time there is only one cashier. The person before me had an item return and it took such a long time. No one said anything to me while I waited and waited. I come here a lot and just expected to be welcomed and not ignored.
This is my usual Starbucks.  The driver through is pretty fast and everyone is for the most part is super nice.

I've been in this Starbucks twice, and they've been incredibly slow both times. The people working inside don't seem like they are in no rush to help. The drive thru is even slower. Honestly, it's the slowest Starbucks I've been to.

This is your typical Starbucks, however I'm giving them 2 stars because they are incredibly slow. Some mornings you may be waiting in the drive through for around 15 minutes. Also, it seems every time I go to this Starbucks they short me on my drink. Just like this morning, I ordered a venti but when I opened the lid it was the amount of a grande... So disappointing. Too bad this is the only Starbucks I pass on my way into work.

Extremely rude employees. I walked up to the register and the cashier/barista stood there on her phone for a few seconds before realizing there was even a customer there. Then, as she was running my card, continued to look at a Snapchat story. Baristas were slow and did not know what they were doing.

Thankfully not a drive-thru!  This 'bucks has a little cafe and huge outdoor seating.  Not to make excuses for not going to local coffee shops, but this is on the way to work, and I thoroughly share the wealth, sometimes I just need a double tall no-whip peppermint mocha.  

"Perfect" oatmeal too.

It's okay. I asked for a drink that was a promo that just ended and was quickly dismissed. Then I asked for a normal drink. I asked for skim milk and she repeated the name of my drink. I don't think she was very interested in listening. I don't think this is a Starbucks I will come back to.

Hands down, this is the worst Starbucks location I have ever been to. Sadly, it is the only within a reasonable distance from my home so I continue to go. Every (and I mean EVERY) time I go the wait time is ridiculous whether I'm ordering a more intricate craft beverage or a tall blonde. This location gets backed up at all hours because the employees just really don't give a shit about the customers. I've gone inside to order multiple times to find one lone employee taking orders and literally no one making drinks regardless of how many people are in line. The employees have no sense of prioritizing the customer and are usually stocking, half assed cleaning, or socializing amongst themselves. The only semi-positive thing I can say about the staff is they are typically not rude, just oblivious. I cannot stress enough how much I despise this location and wish I had the willpower to stop throwing my money at this place. Oh, and the selection of whole bean coffee sucks if you're into that. 

Tl;dr - Avoid if possible.

We went through the drive through. Service was super quick. I got my usual skinny caramel macchiato with almond milk. My friend got a skinny non fat vanilla latte. It was just the pick-me-up we needed!

I have been by this Starbucks a few times. It's a quick right turn off of West Chester Pike. Unlike some other Starbucks, this one has some of the nitro drinks, which I really like. An employee of another Starbucks told me that the equipment for nitro drinks is expensive, and that's why a lot of places don't sell the beverages. It's not much of wait even with a crowd if you walk in, and the drive through was efficient when I used it. The inside wasn't the cleanest when I've been there, but I guess with high traffic, you can't keep things constantly spotless.
There are a number of nice Starbucks in the area, but the entire staff at the newly-remodeled Ridgemoor Starbucks is the best-bar(ista) none!!

i ordered cold form ice coffee, but they told me that there is no lid for the grande. and told me take off the regular lid and drink it. and very bad attitude. i understand they are busy, but i don't understand the attitude.

Didn't think it would ever be necessary to write a review about an established and consistently good chain like Starbucks, but I have had 3 bad experiences here which is equal to 100% of my visits over the past year. I keep coming back because of the convenient location and me wanting to give them the benefit of the doubt, but this location needs to tighten up their operation. I have had wrong orders twice in a row and have been charged the wrong price for a drink when they were simple orders and in a non-busy time of day. I understand people make mistakes but the last time I went, the place was nearly empty and one worker swept in front of me while the other one was standing off aloof. It took a long time to even be acknowledged and for my order to be taken, and it was't even met with a smile or a greeting. Common sense and basic customer service go along way. Never thought these subsequent small issues would make a difference in my perception, but they really do. I will never return to this Starbucks again.

I think this is a great Starbucks location in Tampa. It's located on the corner of a busy intersection, at Kennedy and Westshore, making it equally accessible for you to leave and go take care of multiple things that you need to do in the area or, for you to come from various locations in the area to take a quick coffee break. Unlike Starbucks locations that are closer to downtown, this location is located in a plaza with ample parking, making it a more stress free option when you are on your coffee run. The inside of the store is spacious, with lots of table seating. I also really like the addition of high top table seating in the middle of the store. It makes for a more communal feel and it also allows slightly larger groups of people to congregate and meet up, always a plus for a coffee shop. The staff here are courteous and take care of your drink or food orders fast. And the bathrooms are quite clean, another plus considering the high volume of people that pass through the store. Will definitely drop by if I'm in the area again :)

It's a Starbucks. You know the menu. 

This store gets 3 stars for just being average with service. 5 people behind the counter, 1 person taking orders and one other trying to make coffees. 3 people just talking and not helping. 7 people waiting in line. They should have opened up a second register.

The service was great. Employees are always friendly. The coffee tastes like coffee and made just as I ordered. The only problem is the design of the parking lot. You could easily get blocked into your parking spot for a minute or three longer than you'd like when the drive thru gets backed up. It happens very often. It has happened several times to me. Drive thru is the way to go if you decide on stopping for coffee.

There is not much to say about Starbucks.  Listen, when you are a Colombian, and you drink Colombian coffee everyday, and you have been harvesting coffee while being a child, a plain coffee in Starbucks won't surprise you much.  The consistency of the coffee is the same every Starbucks you go. I even become a petulant woman if I have to talk about coffee in Starbucks.  However, Starbucks have two items I really love and for which I return to it.  The chai latte, and the espresso shot.  Moreover, the workers are usually really nice people, super attentive and smiley.  They have something in common, their looks, they have tattoos, and piercings, and crazy glasses; they are happy people.

Super excited there is some sort of Starbucks near me.  This would be the closest I have yet to find to JBMDL, that is corporate. 

This review only relates to the drive thru portion.  

The employees were fun and super nice.  The coffee from the barista was just okay.  I think the outside of the building looks nice (it appears newer and well kept).  The fact that there is a drive thru is fantastic.  Starbucks is harder to find in this area as Dunkin Donuts trumps it (I'm a huge disliker of dunkin donuts).

I will come here whenever i'm seeking my Starbucks its in a good location to 295.

(IMPORTANT NOTE: Evidently I spent more than 2 hours in this location this morning, as I discovered when I went to my car. I discovered a $45 ticket from Diamond Parking on my windshield. I had no idea there were even time limits here. I left a message with North Town Mall administration to have the ticket reversed. My family shops a lot at this mall. If this is not taken care of satisfactorily, I won't be shopping there again.)

(UPDATE - Aug 13: Just talked to Larry, the manager of Starbucks, and he's going to look into it and call me back. No luck with North Town Mall Admin yet, as they don't ever seem to be in their office or return messages.)

(UPDATE - Aug 23 - I called Diamond Parking last week & they reversed the ticket & trusted that I was in Starbucks. They said next time they'd need proof, so keep your receipts! I always do.)

On a dreary, rainy day like today, I really appreciate the abundance of natural and nice artificial lighting. Looking outside at the pouring rain makes me want to stay dry and comfortable here.

This Starbucks is a good option for an informal meeting up to eight people. I haven't seen any tables this large in any other Starbucks. 

The parking can be a pain at times because the newly remodelled Northtown Mall (well worth a visit) is quite busy, with a London Drugs, T&T asian supermarket, Bed Bath and Beyond and Indigo books as tenants.

Busyness - Mid-morning in this Starbucks is steady, but not overly busy. As one of the many Starbucks with a drive-thru, I'm sure that makes a difference.

Noisiness - It's on par with other Starbucks, if not a touch quieter. It's a bit bigger space than other Starbucks, so it seems to absorb more noise. The music isn't too bad either.

Ambience - This Starbucks is another one of my favourites. It's a bright space with lots of windows and pleasant artificial lighting. You don't have to worry about eyestrain here. It's a comfortable place and there are a couple of really nice paintings (prints?) too.

Power - Seems to be a good selection of outlets to plug into.

Free wifi - Available and works well. I think Starbucks made a good choice in offering free wifi.

Staff - What can I say? Starbucks does a pretty good job of hiring upbeat people. I don't know if I've ever had a complaint about their staff.

Seating - There's a good variety of seating here for groups, including a table that can seat eight (something I haven't seen at a Starbucks before). The majority of the seating is geared to groups of four actually. There are a couple of comfortable armchairs tucked away in the corner and there are three comfortable benches also.  In total there are 28 seats inside. There are also a couple of tables outside.

Security - I've found it to be pretty good here overall, but there are a few odd characters coming in every once in a while.

I love Starbucks who doesn't. Every time I go they never have the proper stock of ingredients. Not anything over the top but simple things like Cold Brew or Blonde Roast. When you are spending $6 on a coffee it's irritating that they don't have what you want.

July 28  time (12:05)I just had the worst experience coworkers scream to each other! Argue about taking the garbage people to be late my order is taking too long to be process because the argument! They are so rude!

The poorest run Starbucks I've come across. Under staffed during the morning rush in a huge office building. 30+ minuets in line just to order. Cashiers running food orders. I've seen numerous orders getting screwed up. Def need s better management.

Kudos to the baristas on my last visit. Still squinting against the cosmic rays of COVID-19's corona, they've opened the doors, but only to the extent of the long arm of the law: one giant step from the entryway to the interior's antisocial barrier. Waiting for service at a nearby car dealership whose coffee maker was removed against fear of the virus sent me over the hill through invisible woods to grab a cuppa. The Buck's brew is more to my liking, anyway.

The barista's voice smiled from beneath the facemask as she retrieved my mobile order. The drive-through lane was (surprisingly) empty and no one allowed inside, so service was immediate. The green to-go stopper (so often out-of-stock in busier pasts) had been pre-inserted by a magical, plasticized hand. Condiments are also banned to public fingers, so you'll need to ask specifically for anything you'd normally manage on your own at the walkup counter. Yet, a cheery and successful visit was had by all.

Your mileage will vary. Like its sibling locations, service varies with each crew and visit. It's still a Starbucks cookie-cutter, chain store experience. But we must all do our part to keep the beans brewing. Mischief managed.

Stopped at this Starbucks on my way to a doctor appointment. I went inside, did not go through drive-thru so I cannot comment on that. 

I was heartily welcomed as soon as I walked in. It's spacious, with lots of tables, a few couches, and comfy chairs. 

I got my order within five minutes, it was correct and hot. I worked on my laptop on the table.

Bathroom was clean. 

No complaints.

The dude working the register was rude and the service was terrible. They were slow and at least 3 people that ordered after me got their drinks first. When I finally did get my order it was the wrong drink, but at that point I just wanted to leave.
Would it kill this place to serve a better selection of soft drinks that are not coffee?

This Starbucks location is on my way to work, so this one is my go-to. I usually go through the drive-thru and I have yet to have a bad experience in the year and a half I've been ordering coffee here, which is either very lucky or rare for a coffee shop in my opinion! Although my order really doesn't vary much, I stick to lattes or flat whites and the occasional seasonal drink, so I guess I haven't really put them to the test.

Most of the baristas are friendly and fun, only one time have I ever had one that wasn't super friendly sounding but he seemed very new to working with customers. Almost like he hadn't tried working on the "sorta-fake but possibly actually friendly" voice that us customer service peeps perfect. Otherwise he was just very direct, which wasn't bad either.

Overall, this is a normal, good Starbucks experience at this location. It's usually a 25% chance that I'll also pay for the person behind me, hoping to start a chain reaction, so maybe you'll get lucky next time you visit this one.

I have ordered online multiple times form this Starbucks location. However, every other time when I arrive to pick up the order, they will tell me that the sandwich(es) that I've ordered are out of stock.  Any other Starbucks, when ordering online, will only let you order the sandwich if they have them in stock. This location needs to do better with updating their sandwich availability for online ordering - it is a consistent problem! A manager needs to figure this out and fix it.

This location is my primary store.  I'm not sure what's happened lately, but the quality has slipped. Compared to other locations, the foam beverages are practically foamless and I had to call and speak with a manager about it.  I had rewards expiring last week and specifically told the barista/cashier that I wanted to use them. She acknowledged my request and charged me anyway AND my star rewards expired the next day.  This is just a couple examples  of things that have not gone well lately.  Very disappointing!  Please don't let this location go the way of other Township businesses that didn't listen to their customers.

This is becoming my new favorite Starbucks around here and my go to when I need to be productive. It's located right off of Dunn Mills rd in Bordentown. The staff is very friendly and happy to serve you. The location is very clean and contains several lounging areas as well as tables and plugs for those of us who want to get work done. It's relatively quite on a Wednesday morning/early afternoon.

The SLOWEST drive thru EVER 15 minutes in line 
Not acceptable maybe more staff. 
Need to speed it up

I am elated with the staff at this location!! I stopped in as they were locking the door and the young male barista willingly accommodated me with a Venti coffee on the house!!!! Thank you!! I now will head to Sarasota in java style!! #Starbucksrocks

[664]

We only use the super cool drive thru at this location.   I need to stop inside and review the entire store.

There is plenty of parking at this location.  It's conveniently located near the 476 highway so it makes a great stop before a long trip.

The coffee was made perfectly but the line was really long and slow.    We waited for a while for our one cup of coffee even after we paid.

We will definitely try this location again and hopefully it will be a bit faster.
One of the bad apple in Starbucks family. Very dysfunctional store. Multiple mistakes taking orders and long wait time for not particularly many customers. A better training is necessary.

'We're out of everything! ' Seems to be the order of the day.  I was disappointed that they display the pepperoni  turnover in the display case but when I order it the product is discontinued!? Don't display product you don't sell.  Also all other fold over types are sold out.
Finally-  It doesn't take 24 hours for a gift card to transfer to the Starbucks app, it happens right away.  I put an extra $10 on my app thinking that's what happened but when I refreshed my app the gift card had applied.

Barista Quinton is the light in my life 

-1 star because they take  too long :'( waaaaaa

This is still my favorite location. Just recently the orders have been wrong alot, most recently in the last 2 days. Yesterday wasn't a big deal because it was just lemonade missing. Today is an issue because I've only had 1/4 of my drink and feel sick because the wrong milk was used. Mistakes happen but 2 days in a row and people have severe allergies, luckily I didn't drink it all and it will pass but please starbucks pay attention a little closer. (Plus we pay extra for these things)

1 Star-   Total failure of an experience based on this experience would not return. Would not recommend.

2 Star-  Below average on several levels, not a total failure. Wouldn't seek out to return or recommend.

3 Star-  Average experience, minimum expectations met. Nothing that says wow or that stands out. Would return if someone else wanted to come, not a regular go to.

4 Star-  Above average experience, will come here again and recommend to friends and family.

5 Star-  This will be a regular go to and will be highly recommended to people I know. Exceeds expectations on a consistent basis.
This was a typical Starbucks. Service was prompt. Staff was pleasant.

The slowest Starbucks i've ever been to.  Got trapped in the drive through line and it didn't move at all for 10 minute increments all up to the front.  Probably half an hour in that line for some latte that took 10 seconds to make.

Some days they are quick, most days they are slow as hell.  My advice is to just preorder.

The employees at this Starbucks are friendly, nice and consistent with their service. People should expect it to be busy considering its location in Haddonfield. There is a good amount of seating inside and a few tables outside as well. 

There is metered street parking and it's located on a corner of a four way intersection. 

5/5

Terrible. They took so long making my coffee, I had to ask for a refund. They probably forgot about me. I sat there for nearly 20 minutes. I definitely was not going to be late to work over coffee. But I won't be back here again.

Disappointed. 4 of 5 items in my order were incorrect. Two breakfast sandwiches had cheese when I specified no cheese. I ordered everything bagel bites but got plain. Usually Starbucks is great about these details but apparently not this one...

This Starbucks is a mile from our house. My wife will sometimes walk up when she wants to get in a bit of extra exercise. The store itself is pretty standard for a Starbucks. The service has been good and the store has been clean. It is in a relatively easy location, although the drive in is in a very awkward position. I would recommend ordering online, parking in the shopping center parking lot, and just walking in.

4 stars for the location, 2 stars for Starbucks coffee which sucks by the way. 

We stopped here on a snowy day and it was just perfect to catch up on a book over some coffee at this place. Got the small town charm.

Full disclosure: if there was a Yelp-variant solely for rating public restrooms, I'd be all over it. Alas, there isn't, so this review is mainly a shout out to the top notch men's restroom at this Starbucks.

S'bucks as a chain is typically pretty prime when it comes to restroom game, at least by my metrics. Always roomy single-stall lockables; none of that multi-stall nonsense. This downtown location takes that roominess to another level. The restroom is more comparable to a nightclub hallway -- strategically lit, sleek gray paneling lining the walls. The space between the door and the toilet is almost comically long... but there's a weird grandeur to it. You can sit on the porcelain throne at leisure, basking in the gratuitous space while the sounds of mainstream indie-folk filter through the air. Everything the (fluorescent) light touches is your kingdom. Jury's still out on the LED task-lit mirror -- at first glance, the bright light is mildly flattering but a lingering look really forces you to ask: "God, is my skin always this oily...?"

Overall, a quality location... for a Starbucks. Decent glimpses of downtown, especially if you take advantage of their street-side patio seating in warmer weather. For windy, snowy, or overcast days, there's plenty of space and seating indoors as well. Drive-thru available for those on the go. I'm not much of a coffee dude myself, but every time I've grabbed my usual (grande black tea, two pumps classic) from here, it's been up to par. Solid spot with bonus points for winning my lavatory love.

This Starbucks is excellent for evening study sessions it's usually pretty quiet and the baristas quickly learn your name and drink preferences. They are quite friendly even if you aren't a 'regular'. This starbucks has pleasant but not overwhelming volume level for their music. 
I cannot comment on the service at morning rush times as I'm strictly an evening Starbucks customer. The wifi has yet to give me any problems. Over all good place to grab a cup of caffeine and crack open a book. 
Parking can be a bit of a challenge as the lot has perhaps 10 spots in it and a drive thru lane between the parking spots and the store. Street parking is ample on North & South as well as Delmar.
7050 crew is best around. Never been disappointed. The wait may be a bit long at times so I turn to my smart phone. My 6 shot 3 pump order is tasty and perfect every time. The Ice teas rock too.

I frequent this location because it is so close to my work. Sometimes going more than once a day! 

My drinks are always hot/refreshing and made just the way I like them. Sometimes I'm even upgraded to a larger size at no charge. 

Since I've been going here I see the same faces on both sides of the counter! That's saying a lot for a coffee shop. I often wonder if some patrons ever leave! 

After their recent facelift it has helped with flow of the queue that forms in the morning and lunchtime rush. Less in shop seating now from the looks of it, but I've never actually sat and enjoyed my drink. 

The only thing negative I have to say is that they usually run out of sandwiches before lunch even starts! And there is one staff member who could benefit from smiling once in a while... But over all my experiences have been above average!

I stop here every time we drive to Orlando - and the staff are usually consistent and friendly. Every once in a while I've had a rough time trying to get what I want, and since 99% of the time we come here it is through the drive through and then onto the interstate - it is hard to turn back around and get it fixed.  They are open 24 hrs too - which I count as a big plus!

There r no ppl waiting in line. And the server totally forgot I have a latte. And he didn't eventually make it with whole milk and light ice which I told him when I was at the counter. Poor service. 
I like the chairs here better.
I've been here a couple times. Nothing good and nothing bad about this location. Just your typical Starbucks. Drive thru is a little hectic but never had a bad drink here.
This place is an embarrassment to Starbucks. Awful service and wait times for simple drinks, skipped orders and wrong orders. Go next door to the Wawa.

This is the slowest and least friendly starbucks I have went to in Indy. I work close to this location so I frequent it quite often. They are slow. Even when the lobby is close to empty and the drive thru is slow. I have waited and waited and waited on basic drinks with barely a smile when my order was finally ready, let alone an apology for the extended wait. I am usually very patient and have never said anything to them except thank you but this evening was it
 This has happened repeatedly to me at this location so I had to come to yelp. I have had great experiences at other locations and will make it a point to not come to this one anymore. I wanted to add that I work in the evening so I am coming close to 7p, not mid peak hrs.

I love this Starbucks because the staff is amazing! The other patrons are usually super awesome as well! I work close by at Grin Dentistry and our staff orders from here daily. Anywhere from 10-14 drinks per day. It didn't take long at all for Jamie (a manager I believe) to learn my name. Or anyone else's name who happens to be getting our drinks that morning. I hand them a list of about a dozen (half of them with titles 10 words long,) and they get right on it with a smile! Usually, they put our names on the cups which makes it super easy to pass out back at the office. One lady in particular (shame on me for forgetting her name!) always makes the doctor's drink last because she knows doctor likes it extra hot. They also let me know as each tray is ready so I can load my car up as they go. Sometimes I wait until they are all done (especially in winter months) and have become pretty good at stacking 2-3 trays to carry out at once. The other patrons are always quick to open the door or grab a tray and help me out, even if I don't ask, and I think that speaks volumes for the atmosphere, staff, and clientele. It takes someone who truly loves their job (like Jamie and her staff) to always smile and be so friendly when they see me coming with that long list every morning. Thank you all so much! You can get a fancy coffee drink at a lot of places, but great customer service is priceless!

Alright so yes, this is your typical Starbucks. But I'm mainly writing this review to compliment Alicia(I probably butchered that) but to the girl closing Friday night! She is a gem and the barista who took care of both my friend and I. Even when It was past closing time, she gladly took my order. Yas girl.

Bad Stuff :  PARKING IS A NIGHTMARE. Weekends the line is out the door. for real!

Good Stuff:  Coffee, sandwiches and pastries, WiFi and a fairly big dining area.
Very friendly baristas but they need to clean there coffee shop!!! Customers were having to clean the tables themselves and the glass doors and windows need a much needed bath!!!!

First, there was someone drinking a coffee inside with a dog (not a service dog)....my biggest pet peeve (pun intended) at restaurants. People, use the outdoor seating if you really have to bring your dog.
Also I asked the associate if they had a certain item. He told me no but in fact I did see it on the shelf after looking.
On the last two weekend visits. I have found the person at the register to be borderline rude and unfriendly. Guess I will be avoiding this location if I can.

This morning I decided to pick up an espresso at my favorite Starbucks on Speedway and Wilmot. Even though there were at least 6 cars ahead of mine, they managed to kindly take my order, get it right and with a smile. Thank you guys!

Starbucks is Starbucks... Unless it's this Starbucks. The friendliest, fastest Starbucks service around. If nothing else, go just to talk to Dan in the drive thru. His energy is so contagious, you may not even need any caffeine!
I go to Starbucks almost everyday this one has the best lattes I know all Starbucks recipes are the same but it's the way you brew the coffee i only come to this one in sb
For a chain store very frustrating when staff doesn't know what they have sugar free and makes a drink with sugar when you cannot have sugar

This is my quick stop for my iced passion tea, I forgo the liquid cane and have it made with monk fruit stevia.  I have some dietary limitations and I can still enjoy this refreshing tea made to order.  The drive thru is usually pretty efficient and all the employees are pleasant.

The McMullen Booth Starbucks is my primetime chill out spots. It's one of the most spacious and least crowded that I've been to, which is why it is close to heaven for readers.

The interior is decorated in the rich, warm colors that Starbucks is known for, but unlike most of the cafes this one has two long, wooden tables for multiple patrons to sit and enjoy their java. This is perfect for groups, and personally my husband & I love coming here as a date night for some drinks and board games.

If you're looking for comfort, they also have leather chairs that are soft enough to sink into and stay for a while. When I'm not bringing the hubby for date night, you can find me with a kindle in one hand and a tall caramel macchiato in the other(which I order with nonfat milk to make it less than 200 calories. Yum!).

The onnnnnly gripe I have, is that sometimes the sounds of their appliances can be quite noisy, but who's ever heard of a quiet blender?


All in all, this is a wonderful place to come sip a tasty drink and kick back. The environment is calm & cool, the baristas are quirky & perky, and of course the drinks are always delish.

This Starbucks is huge! Unfortunately, a lot of the tables don't have outlets (hence the 4 stars). I haven't been here in a while, but it's nice to see that there is now a community table. The baristas are all nice and the place is clean.

Starbucks is one of the businesses that I review quite regularly, because they are a part of my morning routine.  This was my first time at this location and  the bad customer service will make it my last

On the morning of 10/25 around 10 am, I am headed to the airport and stop here after getting gas.  I order a PSL.  About 15 mins after driving off, my drink has cooled down enough for me to enjoy it.  Unfortunately, it was coffee.   And not tasty at all.  I called the store back and asked to speak to a manager.  When the manager got on the phone and heard of the mix up, she asked me to bring the drink back.  I told her to put it back on my starbucks card,  She then said that she would document that they'd  made an error and i'd get a free drink.  Problem-I don't live in that area.  After a ton of back and fourth, I called corporate and they resolved it.  The manager didn't seem surprised, so I guess his happens often

This is the absolute worst Starbucks I have ever been to. The line is awful, the service is slow, and the employees are rude and inconsiderate. Many times in a row they've messed up my order and made me wait. I started ordering online and they still don't make it until I get there.

Not all Starbucks are created equal, so I learned today. My dog was with me (in a carrier), and recently had surgery, and literally all the people working there wanted to know how he was feeling and were wishing him to have a quick recovery. And get this, they gave me a chocolate chunk cookie! It was so good too, because they had just warmed it up. Hah, how cool is that?! (interrobang, where are you when I need you, bro?) Granted, I wasn't the one who had surgery, but it certainly made me feel better about my dog having it! The drink I ordered (iced vanilla latte) was as good as can be expected, but when I come back here it'll be for the service, for sure. :)

I would never typically write a review for Starbucks but I had to comment on the spaciousness of this one! Plenty of tables for working and a nice communal table. The cafe room itself is separate from the coffee bar which is nice. Good quiet atmosphere. Drinks are standard. Staff is super friendly too! This is easily one of the best Starbucks I've been to! Minus one star for parking disaster.
Had to repeat my order 3 times. The person at the window was rude. And then they got my order wrong!
Usually Starbucks is pretty good, but this one was awful. They messed up my order twice, and I never get anything complicated just a white mocha. I'm very disappointed

5 Star customer service. I walk in and everyone on the afternoon shift knows my tea. First time I have ever had this kind of service. This afternoon I walked in and Sally asked if I found kittens to adopt. As we talked she made my tea without asking what I wanted. That is great service. Paul, Mario, DeeDee and Margaret all provide fantastic service.I could make tea at home --- I would rather go to STARBUCKS several times a week.
Thanks - Michelle AKA Venti Vanilla Rooibos

LOVE this new store! The staff are all well trained and ready to improve it even more. There are lots of comfortable chairs, free wiFi, and good music playing. Once construction is complete it will be very busy - so sneak in before this great location becomes overwhelmingly popular.

This place makes way better fraps than Bryn mawr. There is usually a line and only one person making drinks.  There is less seating than most Starbucks. I really love the seasonal fruitcake frappucino. This time when I ordered it the barista said "oh you actually like that?"  I told her it's my favorite and she said "the chunks of fruit are nasty". I rose my eyebrows and again said, "well I like it". When my order came out, again she said it would be better without the chunks of fruit. I find it terribly rude to ridicule a customer's order and unprofessional to bash one of the products you sell. It really bugged me.

This rootin tootin new Starbucks is a great place to stop, particularly for Causeway Commuters. More on that later........

Uness you were born on a different planet or raised by wolves, you know what Starbucks is all about. They're the originators of the overpriced coffee drink and have hooked millions of Americans on the fru fru mocha late hold up the drive thru line frapa drinko. But despite all that stuff, they are also incredible convenient and make getting an influx of caffeine pretty darn simple.

This shop is brand new, and located on the outskirts of Lakeside Mall. Getting in to the drive thru is simple. There is a large computer screen at the ordering area so verifying your order is correct is simple. Be aware that they have a camera and can see you when you order. Don't be picking your nose or they'll know.

Each time I visited this location I've used their drive thru. It moved pretty quickly and the employees were very friendly and helpful. Now for the pro tip for commuters:

If you drive the Causeway daily you'll know that the right lane of Causeway Blvd. moves more quickly than the center lane. Stay in the right lane, turn right at 17th street and get in the Starbucks line. When you leave Starbucks exit on the side closest to 17th Street and you'll avoid all of the traffic and have a tasty beverage. You can thank me later.
Wait time is ridiculous! Plan to be late to work even after arriving there in a reasonable amount of time for coffee.

I love coming to this Starbucks- the drive thru is always fast even with a long line and the baristas are always so friendly! The parking lot can get a bit crazy with the long line for drive thru and make it tough to get in and out of the parking lot.

I was initially at the Bread and Company next door and couldn't figure out what's what. So, I came into this Starbucks, instead.

Nice, small Starbucks. Probably only enough to seat about 20 inside; 9 outside. Kind of dark inside, but there are seats near the front windows. The wooden (made from reclaimed wood!) seats at the window are uncomfortable (no backs) and wobbly.

Pastry offering was meager, but as long as they have my cheese danish, I'm fine. I'd probably still go to the bigger one up the street if I wanted to find a place to sit comfortably.

Nice Starbucks located next to the I-4. Good sized parking lot means it's easy to get in and out, even when packed. Staff is nice, makes great beverages and this Starbucks has a nice vibe to it. This location is open 24 Hrs! I always stop here every time I travel to the west coast.
Fantastic barristas that can make anything you like with a cheerful smile.

I've only ever used the drive-thru here, but have never been disappointed. Customer service is consistently great. There was a mixup with my order once and when I pulled around to the window they made my drink quickly and gave it to me free of charge.

Ok, not a whole lot to say about Starbucks other than it's Starbucks. I go here about three times a week for coffee and I do that because it's consistent.

No, I don't order the mocha skinny latte with a shot of anything. I order Pikes Peak because that's all I want. Coffee. And because I only order coffee I find that their price is consistent with other coffee shops.

If you do go to Starbucks on a regular basis I would highly recommend doing the star points system. After 12 stars (1 star for each purchase) you can choose a free anything. Sandwich, custom coffee, dessert. Anything. That's kinda neat and makes it a better value.

This is a subpar Starbucks with a poor layout. Sure, the staff is friendly, but something seemed off about the interior. It is walking distance to Vanderbilt University, which is nice, however. There is outdoor seating for when it's nice outside.

My favorite Starbucks. What I like the most about this place is that they stay open till 12:00am! great for night owls like us! Also, the baristas are friendly and always treat like family. Sure, it does get pretty crowded at times and I would love to see some improvements in their tables and chairs, but besides that its a good place with hard working staff.

I love this location, it's the old Del Taco so the structure is super cool.  The inside is nice and roomy plus the outdoor seating is covered with the space-like roof.  There is lots of cool location art on the wall along the (locked) restroom area.  I always appreciate a locked/coded restroom because it assures a certain level of cleanliness.  This S. Grand area can be a bit infested if you catch my drift.

The service is great.  They always make my coffee just the way I ask and don't give me attitude when I request a pour-over brew (which is a little inconvenient if you're a busy barista)  but hey....I like what I like, and I pay dearly for it $$$

Located right next door to Chipolte; who's chips I am addicted to is the only downfall, whenever I go to this location for my coffee I almost feel obligated to grab a bag of chips before heading to the car :-(

People here are very nice, but - Sanitary practices need to be greatly improved. The lady who handled my transaction on 10/18/2014 twice grabbed the INSIDE of my cup with her fingers while preparing my iced tea. The same hands she uses to handle money at the register. Kinda gross.  She also used her hand to plunge into the ice container, instead of using the scoop, which I'm pretty sure will get them dinged by the health inspectors. Aside from these things, she didn't follow the SB procedure to make the tea, which is not a big deal to me. She filled water directly over the ice, then she put in the tea concentrate, then put the cap on the cup and swirled it a little. There was no shaking, but again - I really don't think that makes a difference but it demonstrates the lack of training and management at this particular location.  The filthy practices ARE a big deal, and I griped to corporate on their website, but their reaction was ho-hum.  So, perhaps posting this publicly will get their attention and get some remediation.  There's a shortage of SB stores in this area, so it's important to me that I can get products that were handled in a sanitary way @ this store!
Zero. really. Perhaps Starbucks was good ten years ago. But now, dirty, unfriendly and just another Corporation that forgot how they got started, us the customer made you.

I went to this location with my 6yr old daughter she wasn't feeling well that day and accidentally dropped her smoothie on the ground. She felt so bad and started to cry. The staff was amazing they gave her a new one and told her it was ok. They even gave her an extra cute little cookie.

This is your typical college area coffee shop.  It's stuffed full of IUPUI students and a few locals.  During the day, the students tend to talk loudly and ruin the ambiance for those locals there to read the paper or perform work. In the evenings, it's quieter and more suitable for those looking for a quiet cup of joe.  The staff is friendly but the service slower than other coffee shops around.  I never could figure out why.
