For those looking for a coffee shop to do work, you may want to consider a different location.  For those just interested in the caffeine, it suits the purpose same as any other Starbucks out there.

eww.. Starbucks.  If you have any taste, you will not be caught dead in the green monster while in New Orleans.  This one is super tiny, and four blocks to Cafe Du Monde.  Go for it.  There's also coffee on the third floor of Virgin, two blocks away.

Classic Starbucks. Of course when I was there in the morning the cashier was pretty cranky but hey it's not the end of the world. Otherwise the service was pretty good and I enjoyed my stay here otherwise.
Nice guys here but very slow. Very slow. Can't even go here on a Friday morning because it usually takes so long.
My home Starbucks location. Always clean, efficient, and friendly. Great place to get my daily caffeine fix!

I have been to all over the country, and have never felt I needed to write a review for one unit now. 

When my friend and I walked into the place they had a large display right in the doorway [blocking everything, so clearly they would like you to see it.] with their new refreshers in a can. When I picked one up to look at it, the cashier from a distance shouted to us "Those are gross. The ones we make are ok, but those ones are gross." 

Ummmm...OK.

We approach the counter to place our orders and the girl walks away. We stand there for several minutes waiting for someone to ask us what we wanted to order.. but nothing. 

THERE WERE 7 PEOPLE WORKING BEHIND THE COUNTER.

Once we did put in the order we ended up waiting15 minutes for it. There were no drinks they needed to make in front of ours. They were all standing around talking. The funny thing there was what appeared to be a trainer behind the counter teaching a new employee to do something.

The man that ordered behind us didnt get eye contact, asked questions that were answered with short snotty answers and was treated even worse.

We overheard conversations about employees and their medications, weekend plans, hair products, etc. 

I am still shocked about the lack of proffesionalism and the dirtiness of the store, but what blows me away the most is that the drinks took 15 minutes to make. I live in Chicago and watch a team of 2 take care of a line of 30 people with no problems. These 7 people couldn't get an iced drink together. GET IT TOGETHER.

This is my favorite Starbucks in many ways. Top of the list is that there is a stop light at Oracle and Rudasill to get into and out of the Starbucks without issue and onto a busy road. They have great service with friendly employees. I like how easy it is to navigate and not get stuck trying to get out into traffic.

I love this Starbucks! I come here to do homework frequently and the staff is incredibly friendly. They are very visibly hard working and notable at their job and get the orders done in a timely manner. The night crew are always nice and welcoming despite the later shifts.

Probably the worst Starbucks I've very visited. Don't know why I keep thinking it'll get better. Drive thru is a nightmare. Line is always long and they seem to always get my drinks wrong. Always check your drink before you drive off or you'll be getting off or making that nasty line all over. I've never seen suck a clueless staff.

My favorite Starbucks! They don't have a drive-thru, which was originally a disappointment. However, the morning team moves faster than most drive-thrus! More importantly, for someone that stares at a computer screen all day, it's great to get some human contact! 

The staff is so friendly. I especially appreciate their understanding when my mind doesn't function well in the morning. I feel comfortable asking for crazy and unique combinations of yummy drinks!
Never been inside but the drive thru staff are always pleasant and apologetic if they are busy. Great customer service for sure!

What can I say..... it's a Starbucks.  The drive-thru is faster than other ones I have gone through.  Nice new building...friendly staff.  I enjoy going to this Starbucks.  Funny thing is there is also a Starbucks inside the Fry's in the same plaza.

I definitely like the layout of this Starbucks.  It has a drive-thru.  You walk in and it looks like a long, wide hallway without space to spread out and the table means to do so.  The music selection is comforting and there is artwork on the walls.  The employees are super energetic, and there are a lot of them, so maybe bring headphones if you are concentrating extra hard.  Drink was okay - I think the liquid came to the halfway point of the cup which is sad.

Drive thru, pleasant staff, conveniently located at the intersection of Delmar & North and South, directly across from Dewey's Pizza and Paper Dolls boutique. The interior is large enough to spread out with your laptop, homework, friends and business plans. Plenty of seating and obviously....coffee.

~Christy
As always, this store goes above and beyond. They brewed a batch of decaf for our group. Good for Starbucks, good for us.

I love each and every Starbucks, and this one I can remember pretty well. The inside isn't as big as preferred, it's actually to small I would say. This could easily be a problem for some study groups or students. They did get my order right and every drink received from them tasted amazing I should add. I will be going back because this location is very close to my house, but I wish the store was bigger.
I live pretty much across the street from this location and have been here at least 40 times and have never had an incorrect order.  These 1 star reviews seem to be gruntled ex employees.

Proably one of the best place to go and eat or drink in Edwardsville. I have only been here for 2 and a  half days and Ive been here twice already. Workers are friendly and my drinks have been delish!

We come to this Starbucks once or twice a month. It's a matter of convienence vs preference. The service is so hit or miss, mostly miss. Today, my drink was made the wrong size and the barista huffed at me and was snarly about remaking it. I've found most of the baristas are lackluster about customer service and much more interested in chatting with each other or friends.  This location is frequently crowded with students studying or working.  The drive through tends to move fast and is usually pretty busy. The drinks and food is up to the normal Starbucks quality

The staff is extremely nice, but the drive-thru is always a MESS (just for coffee?) and the drinks themselves are a little overdone for me. (All I can taste is sugar). I like the new teas they have though!
Your standard Starbucks location. Lots of college students and Indy natives. Their staff is usually really friendly and helpful and the location is pretty clean.

This is your typical Starbucks location.  As noted by other reviewers, the parking here is terrible.  If you park and go inside you need to be very careful when leaving, as when you are backing out the cars waiting for the drive-through will be right behind you.

I do like the seating inside, as some spots have a nice view of Delmar and North & South while being out of the direct view of the rest of the room.

My wife and I come to this Starbucks (our preferred) at least once a week.  They are friendly, fast, and a little wacky.  Very much up our alley.  I've seen people point out Jonah's name before and they are dead on.  He's great.  He calls us out by name every time without missing a beat.  Add on top of that, my wife has an often mispronounced name and he's made a specific effort to get it right.

Favorite Starbucks in Indy!
It's Christmas season...maybe get another barista at the bar.  No need to be waiting this long this time of year.

This is the highest grossing Starbuck's in Tucson, no joke.  

They're at a busy intersection, but VERY convenient when you're headed to the beloved healthy grocery store in the same parking lot.  

This establishment is also open on all major holidays (including Christmas).   

It's a bit cramped inside and sometimes I feel like I'm playing frogger if I walk in, but the drive through is very convenient.

This Starbucks is pretty typical in terms of layout.  However, I would recommend the Starbucks at either Delmar and North & South and Hanley and Wydown over this Starbucks for interior space.

Also, when you are enjoying your beverage the views are poor, both inside and outside seating offer only views of the parking lot.

One advantage this Starbucks has is extensive parking, as it is in a strip mall.

I generally go to Starbucks to by COFFEE beans. Normally I purchase other interesting items they have on display. Yesterday I went to Starbucks to get coffee as usual. They had none on the shelf. The person with whom I was speaking asked manager if they could make me a couple of bags. I don't know what was said but it amounted to. "We're to busy" well that's the last time I'll go there. Come to find out I can get it for the same price at Amazon. And, save time and gas. Plus I'm not tempted to buy something for which I did not go shopping.

It's all about the friendly baristas at this location. If given the choice, I always opt for my local coffee shop go-tos - Foundry, Henry's, Bee, Calvin, etc. but I have to hand it to these folks for serving up a healthy dose of smiles, efficiency and customer service. From time to time I find myself here for either a.) top notch people watching/Monument Circle views at the window counter or b.) meetings with individuals whose offices fall within the Wholesale District. 

I could go on and on about the food and drink components but it's a Starbucks. You've seen one, you've seen 'em all (not that it's a bad thing.)

My only complaint is the constant draft created by the door placement and continuous bustle of customers entering and leaving.

This location is poorly operated and the service is always slow! Yes, I understand it takes longer to make some of the specialty drinks but the service here is very slow! This morning there was a long line and a woman complaining that her mobile drink was not ready for pick up! Again, forget the sensitivity training and train your employees how to actually provide service at a reasonable pace!!!! 

The 3 star rating is for the decent size parking lot and decent size indoor/outdoor seating! Other than that not much else I can say!!

This Starbucks has one key feature that puts it on my regular itinerary. It's near where I sleep and therefore can provide an early morning double espresso when I'm too lazy to crank out some coffee on my own. 

Honestly, I've been to so many Starbucks that I can't really tell them apart anymore. Why is there not a Yelp badge for this amazing accomplishment Hello!? Yelp! I want a badge now. 

Ok. Maybe this is the caffeine talking.

This location has a drive-thru...but if you use a reuseable cup for a fancy drink, they still use a disposable cup until you get to the window. Go inside instead if you want to not waste.

The staff seemed a bit distant and not too customer friendly. In fact, the barista seemed a bit impatient with me while I was deciding how to make my however-you-want-it Frappuccino. 

Overall, nothing too noteworthy, but does the job.

Not sure what is going on lately, but since the new manager and new weekend staff it is a hot mess here!!!  SOOOO slow and uninterested ... Night and say difference from the excellence if Pat, Mel and the weekday staff....hate coming on on weekends :(

This starbucks has an exceptionally quick drive through. They're really friendly and nice and it doesn't take 15 minutes to get through even when it's busy. I love the layout inside and i wish i lived closer.

Quaint location. Outside Lakeside Mall; can be see while on Causeway heading to or away from the north shore. Drive thru is good for Causeway Drivers; stick and move. Drop down, go into the the drive thru & back up & on the road. 

Nice outdoor seating for us SUNSHINERS that like to bask in the sun while sippingl on some Starbucking-goodness. 

Friendly employees, as is the Starbucks culture. 

Decor is very modern & Starbucks-like. Indoors is just as nice as outdoors. I love this wooden table/desk area in the very front. Very student friendly environment. 5 metal stools on either side... Great for enjoying the outdoors, but from inside. #peoplewatcher #peoplewatchingisaSPORT

I think this location will be more for meeting & greeting as it's nearest to the mall & seems to be a great spot for such an event.

When I first started coming here coffee was always made right and consistent. So far my coffee order has been messed up twice. I asked for a grande iced hazelnut latte with an extra shot. I was charged for it but when I received the coffee there was no extra shot. The cashier never wrote it on the cup. When I asked if there was an extra shot in the drink the barista told me, "no its not written on the cup" with annoyance and I understand you're busy, but I just wanted what I paid for. She proceeded to fix it and instead of remaking it she took my cup and poured the extra shot in an already completely filled cup. So when I closed the lid most of that extra shot spilled out. The second time was today. I went through the drive through and ordered the same drink. When I received my drink it was definitely clear looking and when I tasted it I knew it was made with skim milk, which I did not ask for. I was in a rush and didn't have time to ask for a remake. The barista who made the drink obviously wasn't paying attention to how the coffee was made because no where on my cup does it state I asked for skim milk. It sucks because I pay for good coffee. Lately it's been hit or miss.

This is the Starbucks I go to most often.

It's usually very busy, and the space is L-shaped and narrow.  t's often hard to get a place to sit down inside, and there's plenty outside, if that works for you.  It usually doesn't for me.

Why am I giving this Starbucks four stars?  Good service and good location.  I often go to Trader Joe's to shop afterwards.  It's often on the way to or from home, and I came here for trenta-sized Passion iced teas to counteract dehydration during cancer treatment.

Like every other Starbucks around the area same seating inside and outside, drive thru ordering and same with inside. They offer food to order and same with drinks including free WIFI! The customer service from the staff could use some work but other than that it was a great experience.

My favorite Starbucks. Friendly baristas. My drinks are always well made and staff makes an attempt to know you're name and make friendly conversation. Have experienced the "pay it forward" drive thru train a couple of times here which leads me to believe we have some kind customers and neighbors in this area. I love that even when the line looks crazy it never takes long.
Pretty much the same Starbucks as all others.  Consistent coffee drinks.  Very nice that there is one right there in the hospital.

Location! Great location next to IUPUI Campus. Good baristas, excellent service. The only thing missing in cold winters is a fireplace.. Otherwise this store has everything. There is grocery store and other eating places in the same strip mall, so perfect one stop for most students

Chapters gets me here,
coffee is nasty and bland,
stick to the cold drinks.

-Yelpku #1

I like this Starbucks because its right in the middle of Landsdale town. The staff are friendly, and the only criticism i have is that the seating is a little tight and outkets are hard to find. Better opt to go to the North Wales location if you're looking for space and places to plug in a laptop! 

Heres a link to their nutrish info!!  http://www.starbucks.com/menu/nutrition
Poor service and bad attitudes. Whoever trained the staff here needs to train them on customer service.
Starbucks  - Please Lord Jesus train your employees some customer service!!!

Not a bad place to meet or even grab a hot drink. The staff are welcoming and place seems neat always. Other that I can't seem to think of anything else other than a pretty laid back atmosphere of young students.

The baristas at the drive thru are so nice and courteous.  Alexander is especially nice and interacts with the customers. We are not just a voice on the intercom. And the coffee always come out as requested.

I yelped the hours as me and my girls were looking for a late night snack and it said 10:00 pm. I got to the drive through at 9:53 and was told that they closed at 9:30 pm for the night! How disappointing that we were interested in driving a ways to get there by 10:00 pm and they HAPPILY said they were closed REPEATEDLY

Absolute worst service ever for a Starbucks.  Ordered drinks and cake pops and waited in the drive thru for 15 minutes before even paying. Lady working drive thru window was very short and rude with us.

Typical Starbucks here... busy time, and still friendly and efficient. 

I'm sure you all know the pricing... same as every Starbucks. 

Exactly as we wxpected... which is good... nothing at all to complain about. but nothing to really cheer about either.
I was really excited to see Starbucks come to Hermitage.  My only gripe is that it's just a bit small inside - just a few tables.  All in all, though, your average Starbucks - close & convenient.

Abysmal service. Will never go here again. They are inside the Sheraton Hotel and apparently feel that is all they need to get a steady stream of customers. There are a lot of other coffee shops in the area.

Small location located in a small Webster Groves shopping plaza. Surprisingly parking is a breeze and the café is easily accessible. There's minimum seating inside and outside on the sidewalk patio. Plenty to explore within walking distance in case you'd like to park & stroll. 

Staff is very pleasant.

~Christy
Loving the feel of this Starbucks!!!! Always clean and a great "group" table if you want to come with friends or study groups....
Quick 24hr caffeine stop if you need a break from the war on I4 between Tampa and Orlando.

What?? No chocolate covered espresso beans?? Imagine going on a hunt for a specific birthday gift and expecting them to be at Starbucks, only to be told "You would think so, right?"  

Boo!

The parking sucks, there were 5 baristas present but still couldn't get the line moving. Ordered a triple espresso with white mocha instead Gave me 6 espresso shots. Good thing I tasted it before leaving I would've died lol

Best breakfast sandwiches in the world! I know there are a million Starbucks in Indianapolis but I always go to this one just for one reason , Rowan. Rowan is the manager at this location . I had an issue and he immediately took care of it . Amazing customer service ! Also super fast drive thru!

A one star rating is too generous!   This should be a -5 to truly capture the negative experience. The quality of staff has gone down hill significantly over the past few years.   On a recent visit, I politely asked for a straw since there were no straws in the bin.  The staff person didn't make eye contact and didn't say a word.  He went to the back, got a bag of straws and literally threw it across the counter with an indifferent glance.   I don't need to pay $5 a drink to be treated this way.

Starbucks is overall a great spot because you can not only grab coffee but you can order Frapp, hot chocolates, lemonade, food items plus utilize Wifi!!!!
Plus if you have a Starbucks card you can obtain points for each of your purchased items.

I keep trying the drive-through but so far I have only ever received an incorrect drink order (it has been 5+ times now). I am not sure why this is I have never had a consistent problem at any starbucks and they don't' even offer to correct it either.  That being said, this is just one of those starbucks that don't know how to handle the rush and if its not too busy and you go inside they are friendly and nice and get your drink right...just stay away from the drive-through! I keep thinking it might get better and try every once in awhile but it has literally been a bad experience every time.

Let me first say that I have not yet been to a Starbucks that wasn't super busy but this one is ridiculous.   However,  it is to be expected because of it's close proximity to the Westgate Brandon Mall, the AMC movie theater and the I-75 exit.  When they first opened they were extremely slow getting orders out, especially for the drive thru.   I thought I might run out of gas while waiting.  They have gotten a little better with time but still too slow.   Keep in mind the location if you plan to go to this one.   You WILL wait.
This location is a convenient alternative to the more crowded one a little further down, sans drive-thru.

It is completely obvious how unhappy the staff here are.  They are not friendly, even when I visit regularly no one has bothered to learn my name and I'm lucky if I even get a "hello" or a 'thank you."  Their service is on par with the cost of a Dunkin Donuts beverage, not the $4-6 I'm spending per drink there.  The drinks themselves taste good--like all other Starbucks beverages I've ever tasted--but the service is severely lacking.

Pretty much your typical Starbucks. Usually stays busy since it is right next to IUPUI's campus, but today had a few table spots open inside. 

I tried one of their new Clover-brewed coffees. Went with the Malawi. Very good, easily rivals the quality of a local, craft coffee shop.
Although the drive through isn't as fast as I'd like, the staff are super friendly and the location is convenient.  I stop at this location almost daily and my order is always perfect!

Stopped in at 11:30a. Not busy. Quick service by pleasant staff. This is a small store with strictly table & chair seating (no sitting area) serving the reliably consistent high quality Starbucks products. As I'm watching my diet, I had The very good Cold Brew iced coffee and low fat turkey and egg white sandwich.  I was very happy with both.

The Century Park Starbucks is a nice stop if you take public transit and need to kill time in between trips however keep an eye on the time. This Starbucks is located near the Century Park Bus Depot and LRT Station. I would choose this Starbucks over the Snack Bar that is located inside the Bus depot. 

I have visited this location a lot and I have to say the staff are friendly The Baristas excel at their drink making. The staff are always polite and usually every employee will say hello.  If you ever need a drink suggestion they usually have good ideas however, I usually stick to my "Usual" choice of beverages. They have yet to get it made wrong. They usually have a good selection of their baked goods no matter what time of the day which is nice. 

The drive thru is always quick and easy. The inside is the typical Starbucks decor and merchandise but that's not a bad thing. The downside to this location is the parking. There are only a few spots to park, There are nearby lots but sometimes walking isn't ideal so that's why I tend to stick to the Drive thru. I shop at the nearby Sobeys so I'll end up stopping by as a treat.

This location is convenient and closer to the college in town as well as avoiding the busy shopping centers where the other Starbucks is located. So far every encounter with the staff has been a good one. The tables have charging stations on them, only wish they had more tables but a Starbucks can only be so spacious.
Love this location! I make sure to come here every morning when I'm in town. Lex is an awesome barista!!
What can I say I am a sucker for a good latte. Today it was on ice. This is a new Starbucks. Staff were friendly.

Gross. Every trashcan was overflowing both outside the restaurant and inside the restaurant. Bathrooms included. Saw several workers walk by and even walk by by with empty trash cans (returning them to the dumpster area). I guess they have just given up?

I came to this Starbucks this morning and was trying to find the cheapest coffee I could so I could go to work 30 minutes later. The lady behind the counter saw I was kinda off and asked if she could make me a drink of her own. I agreed, 2 shots of espresso 2 pumps of vanilla an 1 pump of hezelnut and I filled the rest of the cup with creme. I wish I remembered her name,, she made me the best coffee ever.
This is one Starbucks that completely fails to deliver on the brand experience Howard Schultz set out to bring to Americans years ago. On top of that, my beverage wasn't that great.

Gotta love Starbucks!! Unfortunately, this particular location is always so busy that every order takes an eternity to get!! And when you need your coffee fix the last thing you want to have to do is wait. When we came through the drive-thru with a fairly simple order of a couple of coffees and a protein pack, it took a good 15 minutes minimum from the time we got in the Drive-Thru line to the time that we got our coffees.

It won't make me stop using Starbucks considering they have the best coffee EVER, but it might deter me from stopping at this particular location again in the future.

I visit this Starbucks often. Too often. It's a problem, actually. But I digress. Nine times out of ten I'm happy with my drink but I do agree with what someone else said about getting a different result depending on who's working. Some don't understand that cream and sugar does not mean the coffee should be pure white. For this reason, I've started ordering "light cream" to be safe. The parking situation is horrendous and very poorly planned considering the location but it usually doesn't take more than a few minutes for a spot to open up (which, by the way, is always the fastest way to go as the drive thru is always backed up). The employees do a great job of getting people in and out which is very necessary given the terrible design of the place. I keep coming back again and again so no complaints here.

Clean Starbucks. Lots of space inside with a good amount of seating and has an outdoor patio too. The worst thing about this location is lack of parking. Difficulty in finding a spot almost every time. At the tome of review (6pm) they are not busy at all. Plenty seating and just one person was ahead in line. Drink came out in about 2 minutes. And of course it's a great location right off Kennedy Blvd, close to downtown and UT.

Steven the coffee maker is a complete ass and truly does not like his job.  He does not say hello.  He is not polite.  He also never asks if you like your receipt.  Steven just comes across like he just hates his life.

I been here a few times in the past ordering coffee and sandwiches when I am in the area. Always busy here during the mid lunch/afternoon drive times during the drive thru and at times inside as well. Keep in mind parking places are hide to find so people do tend to park over at Mcdonalds to walk over to Starbucks.  I like the Vinte Mochafrappachino and my mother likes the White Chocolate Mocha hot. I wish they still had the Turkey & Swiss sandwich but they quit carrying it awhile back don't know why it was delicious!

If you decide to come to this location try come early cause this location for Starbucks really does get busy in the parking lot/drive thru causing it and some what inside as well.

Why is there big variability in the reviews on this Starbucks in KOP? (Plus - no reviews in almost 2 and a half years?!)

Sure, I'll admit that the parking lot can be a bit tricky to get in and out of, but as far as the store itself, I've had ZERO problems.

My drinks have never made poorly, and the service has always been top notch. The inside is not super big, but then again, I don't really sit around in coffee shops working on school work and such. I'm a grab-and-go kind of guy, and that's what makes this place shine.

I know that I can count on this place to make a delicious iced nonfat vanilla chai latte.

Yum.

My happy place. Parking is terrible & it is hard to get a comfy chair, but every customer is treated like royalty. It is crowded often throughout the day, but you will always get a perfect drink. If you aren't 100% satisfied, they'll make you another. Justin is a fabulous barista! He's never too busy to greet you by name & to make suggestions when you want a change.

Please don't come to Yardley's Starbucks! Enough people already & if you do, don't you dare park in the handicapped spot of you don't have a tag. There are only 5 spots & many of us will call the police to move you!

I should mention the regulars all look out for each other. It's an office & second home!

Dropped in yesterday around lunch, ordered a multi-grain bagel with cream cheese plus a small decaf. In spite of others in line, my order was ready in less than five minutes. Came to just over three bucks.

Their small coffee is similar to medium just about everywhere else. Dark wood interior gives the place a cozy home feel, no wonder people work online here. Their outdoor tables usually occupied on this busy corner.  Always enjoy Starbucks.

If you find a need to be at Webster, the shop is within walking distance. It's clean and has a nice size store front. I was also amazed that they actually recognized me on only my second visit (albeit was two nights in a roll).

I am a fan of this Starbucks location. Friendly staff, quick service, and good merch options in the storefront. My order is always delivered correctly and with a smile. There are spots in the inside to sit and they also have a nice prop area with umbrellas. 

I don't think a Starbucks without a drive thru can really earn the 5 stars (sorry!), but that's my only negative about this location.
The line here is way too long and the way the line is lined up is not efficient at all. Just asking for grumpy customers..
Don't let the long line fool you in the morning. These cats are fast! Seriously, a line of cars that wraps around the building takes less than 5 minutes to clear. Very impressive.

This Starbucks is located inside of the Sheraton New Orleans. If your in town for a convention its a great spot to grab coffee and a snack. The downside is they are very slow at making drinks and the line usually has at least 15 people in it. I am not exaggerating.

If your not staying at the hotel I would suggest you go down the street to PJ's Coffee for a quick morning pickup. I've been going to this Starbucks for three years because I've attend a conference there all three years. This Starbucks is here strictly for convenience.

Silly, sassy and irish? Are you sure you're at starbucks? Yes, this place is interesting because of the staff. I get a giggle every time I'm in. There is a man who works the drive through who wears a kilt and asks "how can we caffeinate you today"?

I do enjoy the high tops to chill and almost always have to park in the back behind the building next door because it's always hopping. It's busy but you can usually find a place to sit. I've skyped here and had meetings as well as just relaxed. 

I even once overheard someone complain about their order and the wait staff took care of them immediately making sure they felt taken care of. 

This is my favorite starbucks in the area though I almost always miss it because it's blocked by trees and hard to see. Oops!

i know it's something small but the smallest things are what makes everyone's drinks their own. i also just think it's ridiculous the lack of effort this was. how hard is it to just give people the extra stuff they want???

The baristas here are awesome. Shout out to Danielle for remembering I splurge on Fridays and get a PSL, lol. Probably the nicest staff, the store is always clean and the drive thru moves so quickly! Love this location!!

This place is surreal in a good way. It was by far the most ruthlessly efficient & precise espresso slingin' starbucks I've ever been in -- while simultaneously having some of the nicest and most cheerful staff I've ever seen at a franchise location.  The line was out the door when I arrived and I still walked out with a great cup a few minutes later. 

I rarely review Starbucks locations especially when I'm on a work travel gig but had to leave some feedback about this spot, Zeb and the gang.  

Still not 100% convinced that this spot is not some sort of secret Starbucks robot barista skunkworks lab trial-testing a special 'midwestern warmth' firmware hack .. but  I guess it could just be great people and good training.

Great location. Staff very friendly. I wish I could remember the name of the young man who took my order. He had red hair and was outgoing and had a nice friendly smile. Lauren prepared my drink and it was yummy! I hate seeing the reviews complaining about the clientele, It was a beautiful day and I sat outside with a homeless man. Instead of complaining sit down and engage.
This is a super normal Starbucks. Nothing really pro or con except he outdoor seating is quite nice.
Super busy on Sunday morning, but with the usual efficient Starbucks quality of service, it wasn't a terrific problem. Getting in and out of the parking lot, however, leaves a lot to be desired.

Teams cans all overflowing ... Six workers... I was the only one in line. Told them about the trash and 10 minutes later, with no additional customers... Trash still overflowing. One trash can was directly in the view of the counter staff. Skip this place, find another coffee shop.

It's my 2nd time visiting this location, not crowded like the many other locations I've visited. Nice and pretty spacious. Compared to the other locations, this place is bigger. The staff is very nice and welcoming. I was even allowed to come back later to pay for my drink because all I had with me was a hundo, very considerate. The this I don't really like its that its located at the corner and not
Much parking space, but it's ok, the more u walk the healthier u are ^_^. I ordered a venti green tea frapp and it was great! I asked the manager, whom took my order, if she should make sure that the green tea powder was blended throughly. Two other places I went to, I requested that BUT it was not throughly blended. There were still green powder seen on the bottom of my drink. But this place, the manager was very nice, she even offered to blend my drink 2x  Thanks A lot! It's tastes way better!

The staff at this Starbucks is very unfriendly and unprofessional. They made my drink wrong and would not offer to remake it. They discuss difficult customers loudly in front of the store. Would not recommend.

I went through the drivethru and was service by Ross! So I can only speak on my drivethru experience. I was promptly greeted by the server on the other end. He was polite, well spoken and greeted me with energy and a genuine friendliness. He repeated my order back to me. Upon pulling up to the window he greeted me again with a smile in person. My food was ready and I was given napkins without asking. After my transaction was complete, he wished me well and hoped I had a pleasant day. You don't find great genuine customer service very often, so I want to give kudos where it's deserved! Especially since I'm a former Starbucks employee ...I'm a little more critical.
I ordered a coffee and a scone to go, after 20 minutes I still did not have my order. Needed to cancel. This is probably the worst Starbucks I've ever been in.

I work down the street from this Starbucks and come here somewhat often. It's always pleasant, fast enough, and they make the coffee exactly how I ask :) I'm actually writing this review though because I want to specifically sing the praises of Ali, who made my day last week!!! It had been a really rough and stressful week and sleep was lacking. I drove by here to get an afternoon coffee so I could make It through the rest of my to do list. After I ordered my coffee and was waiting in line, I looked into my purse only to discover that I had left my wallet at home! I thought I just might lose it considering the week I had had, this was just the cherry on top of things! I knew when I got up to the from they would probably roll their eyes and be frustrated that they had made my coffee and now I could not pay for it. When I got up to the window I told Ali that unfortunately I would have to come back because I had left my wallet behind. She was so sweet about the whole thing! She told me that I could go ahead and take the coffee, and I could just get them next time. I feel like this is so rare in big chain places these days, and there was no reason whatsoever that she had to do that, she just simply went out of her way to do something nice and she honestly made my day! Starbucks is lucky to have Ali :)

This store has been slipping for a long time but I feel like I need to write a review with my terrible experience today. I spent literally not exaggerating 20 minutes in the drive-through waiting to get to the window. She took my credit card but did not tell me the total and handed the card back to me with no receipt. I know this is the modern age and a lot of people pay with their phones but I don't and I expect to be told the total and be given a receipt which they did not do. I finally had to ask for the total. When I drove away I realized that the drink was made incorrectly. Am I going to go back and get another one? No, I don't want to wait in line again.  The store needs some serious up training and some help in the organization.

This location is near IUPUI campus, so it's a combo crowd of students, medical professionals, and business people in the area, which means it stays pretty busy.  It provides the means for a work or study place, but the traffic can be distracting.  The staff does a great job of being personal with people and still handling the crowd at a good pace; and they make quality products.

Been many times in way to work at 6:30 am. Full of fellow IU hospital employees. Service is fast, coffee hot and I noticed a security guard there this morning. 
Big place, lots of seating.

This is my local Starbucks. Across the street from my house. We had a falling out for awhile, but when I'm in a rush, I'd be lying if I didn't tell you I stop in here multiple times a week (I'm always running late). The staff is kind and quick to pour and get my drink going, so I appreciate them for that.

I definitely prefer Chapterhouse, but they only take cash (unless its over 20 bucks I believe) and they don't open until 7am, and sometimes they open late, so sometime Starbucks is the only option. Luckily this Starbucks really does their best to keep it a humanized establishment despite their corporate superpower backing. 

Currently I'm into the gingerbread latte, but usually I'm just a soy latte kind of person, or black iced tea unsweetened in the summer. I mean, judging their drinks is like judging the corporation, so I mean, they're just fine. It's really the people that work here that make it a nice place to stop. So I'm happy to call them my neighborhood 'bucks.
This is the first time I have ever posted a negative review, but this is the worst...Starbucks....ever. Extremely slow service, rude and incompetent employees.
Terrible service - SLOW!!!  Unless you're retired or on vacation, not a good idea.  Not up to Starbucks standards.

Now, I'm going to seem like a hypocrite in this review if you take a look at my Starbucks review for the location in Creve Couer. My issues with the Creve Couer location had to do with not having a larger food selection and not having a drive thru...this U City location has both and I'm still only giving it 3 stars. 

While you can get a wide variety of breakfast and lunch foods at this location, the convenience of the drive-thru is negated by the slowness of the service. This Starbucks location is super near to my apartment so I've visited a lot at all times of the day and different days of the week...and it's consistently slow. The staff is friendly (as usual) but I've happened upon what seem to be an inordinate number of "newbies" at this location. That is, a lot of the employees at this location seem to be unfamiliar with their products. 

If you wanted to go inside, the parking lot is very small and the location (at the intersection of North & South and Delmar) makes for some problematic driving. When the drive-thru line is packed, that entire intersection becomes a hazard...seriously. 

Still, when I need reliably consistent coffee and I want to get it without parking and going in somewhere, I usually go here.

It completely meets all my expectations for a Starbucks.
That Makes it A-OK

This is the shiny new location (OK it has been there for almost a year now) and is my go to spot when I have earned a free drink through the star rewards program. 

So, what I usually expect:
   + Pleasant service
   + Consistency of product
   + Free WiFi
   + Clean public area
   + Pleasant, relaxing atmosphere

This spot usually hits all the marks. It is not the most relaxing Starbucks, more geared to the laptop warrior crowd and the last time I was here the counters and tables needed cleaning. It wasn't gross, just needed wiping down. The space is open and light with lots of windows. The small patio is also nice during warmer weather. 

I prefer the local coffee shops, but this will do when I have a freebee.

I still have some Starbucks gift cards in my account from Christmas so chose to come work here for a few hours this morning. Tons of table and workspace. By very busy inside the store on a Saturday morning. Nice and clean and everything you'd expect on the menu at Starbucks.

Every time I travel, I make sure to make a pit stop here. They always have a smile on their face and thank God I've never had to wait long for my drink. This is of course your typical Starbucks so it has everything all the other ones do. This one is clean and their bathrooms are clean too. Get your joe here!

This location is hard to get to and when you are inside, it is small, packed and very loud.  I was half way finished with my heated sandwich when my coffee finally arrived.  If you can avoid this Starbucks and go to one of the others around here you will be better off.  Not to mention that when I sat at the dirty counter and asked for it to be cleaned, yes she wipped the counter but it was so wet that I had to ask for a towel to dry it which I had to do myself.  Go to the one on Roger Rd , better service and clean.

Waited over 10 minutes for a grande White Mocha! And then two people that came after me got their drinks first! The guy making the drinks saw me there and didn't even bother to ask what I was waiting for. The cashier that rang me up finally asked what I was waiting for. Worst experience with Starbucks!

My friend and I were ordering drinks from the drive thru, we had the reusable venti starbucks cups that you can request for your drink to be in. Along with that, you can get a discount if you have the cups so we let them know we had them in advanced. when we came to the front window, the woman told us our total, gave us our HALF FULL VENTI CUPS, and closed the window before we even had the chance to pay.... we sat in confusion until she came back out and said our total was $10.64 which just didnt make sense especially because we SHOULD have had discounted orders. Very wierd service. wont be going back

They were out of so many things. We had to change our order and then we had to change it once more when we drove up to the next window because they discovered they were out of that as well.....but at least the woman was nice about the situation and apologized. I wouldn't hesitate to return here since this was my first time.

While the drive-thru can be slow (generally the people placing orders), the staff is awesome! Very friendly & helpful & generally quick with an order. Seating indoors & out is limited, but still enough most of the time. Can get a bit noisy because of limited space, but not too bad.
Always busy, and usually pretty quick service. The parking lot is too small, but that's not their fault. Thank goodness for drive-through!

Holy Macanoli!!  This is easily the busiest Starbucks I've ever seen. It's small and the line is backed up to the door.  The drive thru is 10 cars deep.  There are 8 baristas with well differentiated task priorities who fill orders remarkably efficiently.  Though there are easily 6-8 customers awaiting orders at the pick up counter for in store and on line orders, it is not a long wait.  I'm impressed. Quality is the standard I've come to expect from the Starbucks brand. Well done!
I love this location, the only downside is the parking lot. It can be difficult to get in and out when there's a long line in the drive-thru.
Great service and a great atmosphere to study. This is a busy location but they are quick and get you through the line fast!
One of the slowest running Starbucks I've ever been to. How long does it take to make a single drink? It also wasn't even busy.

The place is fantastic! I went here two days in a row while at a course. It is super busy and everyone packs into the Starbucks. But let me tell you... The staff are never phased by the big line and by the time you get to the front there as chipper and happy as ever. I couldn't think of a place more busy and so full with that pleasent of staff. If only Walmart was this good of an experience I might actually go to Walmart. 
As for my coffee, tea desert. It's the exact same as every Starbucks I go to. Nothing over the top special but the service is fantastic.

This is cool.  Great windows open on the world around.  This is a very down in the city sort of place to get your coffee.  And not only do they have all the standard Starbucks stuff.  But they have the clover here as well.  I've not seen it anywhere else in Reno.

There are five different coffees available on this special brew process.  Don't know much about it...but I guess it's like a french press and a vacuum put together.  My coffee was rich and dark.   Just like I like my..... ANYWAY...

The parking here seems a bit bothersome but there are still a decent number of spots.

And lastly...they have glass mugs!  I usually skip starbucks for the other places in town because I'm not a fan of coffee in plastic.  Cool they have the mugs!  I will be trying a cap the next time I'm in!

Had the best experience here minus one thing, the table I was sitting at was broken and tipped over spilling all of my drink I had just paid for. I was kinda bummed but got up to grab napkins to clean up my spill. The manager came out right away and asked if I wanted a replacement drink, mopped the mess up right away, and made my drink in front of the line! It was very sweet of her and great customer service! She offered us a new table as soon as she could. Coffee here, as always, is amazing. Definitely come here for good vibes, good coffee, and good service.

This USED to be my "regular" place. I loved the DT window.  Well I moved daycares and started going to the one on Hazel Dell.  Annnnnnyway, fast forward two years and I have missed this one so much and recently relocated daycares AGAIN so now I'm back in that area and so this is my regular stop again.  Like everyday - every.single.day.  Somehow, they "never" really recognize me (and I drive a car that is wrapped in the Caribbean Sea, sand and Sandals), order the same thing and somehow, they still often mess up my drink and are not what I consider to be "friendly" at all.

It's very disappointing.  I am actually almost OVER Starbucks because of THIS location and the OTHER location on 116th (at Keystone). They both suck.

Because I need a DT and because I love espresso, I'll continue to spend my $5, but it's annoying me more and more each day so I yelped it.  That's all folks.

By far the best Starbucks in the area.  Great staff, clean store, consistently accurate with orders.  Truly a team willing to go the extra mile for their customers.

My mom means the world to me and they treat her like royalty, so when someone asks which starbucks to go to (this or the other on Germantown Pike across from Shoprite) my answer is always this one.

I came here when I was waiting for my oil to get changed in hopes of getting some studying done. It was freezing inside, there was reggae music blasting, and the kid working the register didn't acknowledge me for a couple minutes. I got my drink and headed outside to find a table, but outside there is no lighting (fair enough). I am not a huge Starbucks fan, and usually only go there out of convenience but there is definitely a "Starbucks standard" which this location fails to meet.
Bacon, egg, and cheese, grande Carmel frapp, and a cake pop... No better way to start your morning. And since I'm a regular they always have more order down and ready to go!

This store is one of the best in Santa Barbara! I stopped in on the way to work, thinking that I'd be late anyway. I almost forgot about my terrible morning by the time I left. I got my mocha fast and the employees were very friendly and worked like a pit crew. Will definitely be back!

The baristas at this starbucks are so awesome!!! People complain about the wait time but really people do you think it's always their fault? It's our choice to go through a drive through when the line is down the street don't be surprised when you wait for 10 minutes.
应该是所有住delmar的Wash U的留学生必去的地方了，国际连锁，大多东西都是标准化，即使看不懂菜单也能猜到，早餐的鸡蛋火腿汉堡不错。
Best baristas around! They remember you and your usual. Seating is a bit crowded (especially if the Chapters isn't open) and if you sit by the windows in winter keep your sweater handy!

Has to be the best Starbucks I have been to!

I know, many of you are like, its just a Starbucks, they're all the same. And the reason for your reaction is that you haven't been to this one, the coffee actually tastes different for different flavours.

This is my local store, I don't go often but when I do, I'm glad its this one. To me it seems like all of the other Starbucks have given up on making the coffee different. I only drink the seasonal drinks from Starbucks, so when I drink it from other locations it taste like they use the same coffee for every flavour but change the toppings they put on the whip cream. At this location, I'm glad to say that the coffee actually taste different as per the flavour its supposed to be. I also find it to be the most consistent Starbucks I've been to. No matter what time of day, or year, If I order a caramel macchiato or a green tea lemonade it will taste as amazing as the last time I had it at this location. There's no shift in sweetness or bitterness. And to that I am amazed, since according to all the other Starbucks I've been to, it's a pretty hard thing to achieve.

I can hardly believe how empty this place is every time I go for coffee. I mean the Tim Horton's in this area is always so packed, It seems like this is a nice little secret area only a few of us know of its awesomeness. As for service, its decent, the people are always quick to serve you and get you out of the way. I've never really stayed and enjoyed my coffee there. I usually walk in and walk out, or do the drive through, so I wouldn't know how comfortable the chairs or the atmosphere are. But it's a small place so there aren't a lot of tables set up, but its nice that the tables are separated from the ordering area. This way when I enter I can immediately order my coffee and receive it without having to go through all the tables and private conversations. And it works both ways, when you're sitting down you don't have to deal with the traffic coming in and out of the store interrupting your conversation or work.

Overall I love this Starbucks, mainly for the fact that the coffee tastes so much better and is consistently great. The place is mostly empty creating for better service, and I love the separated area of tables

Bless there hearts! When I walked in I could already tell they were having a rough day. They were run low on ice due to some issue out of their control and because of it some customers had been waiting longer than you normally would to get a coffee. They apologized that they would be able to make the drink I wanted and even gave me a gift card for the amount of th drink I would have ordered for the next time and also gave me my slice of cake for free. That's good customer service and  I won't hesitate to stop in again. Thank you

I had the best experience during my week long stay during Mardi Gras.
The man in charge was so thoughtful, and patient while training a very new employee.  I found out on my last day that he was Krew Zulu.
Can't wait to return.

You think you've seen one Starbucks, you've seen 'em all, right?   Wrong.   This is absolutely the fastest coffee shop I have ever been to.   On a busy Wednesday morning, there were 2 cashiers and 2 (maybe 3) baristas moving at warp speed.   I ordered a coffee and a breakfast sandwich, and before I even put my wallet back in my pocket, the cashier was handing me my coffee.   Then I walked around to the sugar/cream station and as soon as I had put the lid back on top of my coffee, I heard "slow-roasted ham & swiss!" and was out the door.   Total time inside: less than 2 minutes.   Amazing.

This is my favorite of all the St. Louis and Chicago Starbs that I've ever been to! I work and live fairly close by so I come here several times a week - sometimes just to stop by for a quick drink and sometimes for hours-long major study sessions.

The staff here is AWESOME! Super fast and very friendly. Can't ask for anything more. Several times I've stayed there studying right up until they close at 9, and they're still totally friendly and not at all "please leave." Love it.
Amy was completely rude to me and the lady in front of me. If I didnt live so close I wouldnt come back. Other ladies were nice except Amy.
Good service. Terrible parking.
The drinks are good but 15 minutes in the drive through? No thanks. They are SLOW. REALLY SLOW.

Hi !! I absolutely love this Starbucks! I used to grab a latte from here when I was working in Regency square earlier.... The staff is prompt and cordial and I would give five stars to this place ..our favorite coffee house..
The people are GREAT! The drinks are terrific.  This is my favorite StarBucks.  But the name of the place should be Four Bucks 'cause it's always $4.00 bucks!!

This is the only Starbucks with a drive-thru that is legitimately on my way to work and in close proximity of Highway Farty. I have stopped here several times over the last few weeks to feed my new obsession with the fall Chile Mocha Latte. Let's not even talk about how good these things are. I used to boycott this Starbucks because it took over the Grand Del Taco, one of the most enjoyable memories of my misspent mind altered late night adolescence. The Chile Mocha Latte lured me here. It's not my fault!

I was blown away by how friendly the Team was. The store is super clean. Tommy. Adorable. And amazing customer service. 
The Barista Alexandra reminded me of the good ole days. Awesome.
From getting my order wrong, to not even apologizing for it, to giving me a green tea latte with so much matcha powder still on the bottom...I was not pleased with this location.

Vastly improved.  The staff has turned over and this is a much better Starbucks than it used to be.  I've been going regularly again and my order is always correct, the service is lightning fast and the employees are pleasant.

I love this Starbucks they have the best baristas ever at this location. I'm a regular here my mom works nights and am a college student so she'll get coffee for me in the morning and I'll do the same at night time we always go through the drivethru. 2 of our favorite baristas I want to give a shoutout/shine spotlight on
1) Carrie- she's there almost every morning nicest most cheerful person especially for being there so early
2) Andrea- fastest, perfectionist that always makes the drinks spot on and makes sure yur coffee is wiped off and lids on correctly which is always a plus
All the baristas are amazing these 2 are just constants that we see and talk to on a regular bases that know us by name

This Starbucks is the where it's at Starbucks. It is smack dab in the middle of downtown St. Pete and has competition from three pretty close ones, but that doesn't seem to be a problem, for business is always booming.
Redeemed my Starbucks rewards here, got a chicken wrap box & a large strawberry açaí refresher. Delicious!

I don't go to the Starbucks very often but stopped by a couple times this week when i was in the area. I was able to order and move through the line pretty quickly during the morning rush around 7:30am. I ordered my favorite drink an iced caramel brulee latte and was devastated that they were out of that flavor! They offered me a toasted white chocolate mocha which i don't like white chocolate but i appreciated the suggestion. They had pumpkin which i settled on which was made well. I would definitely come back to this location when I'm in the area and it's a plus that they share a building with Chipotle if you're around during lunch.

Kelly is the best barista at this location and I believe she's the best barista overall for Starbucks. But darcy the short hair small girl.... I can't even. One time I ordered a iced Carmel macchiato it was made totally wrong, I understand the drink is mostly milk but this particular time there was a lot more milk than usual. The drink should be brown but it looked like straight up milk and I told her there's too much milk but she went on to argue with me that it was made right. And another incident she gave me back my change and the coins fell out of her hand when I was trying to grab the bills with it but instead of putting it in my hand she just threw the rest of my change in the tip jar when I was picking up the ones that were on the counter. I don't have a problem with giving tip but don't just assume that's what I was doing. She definitely ruined my past couple experience going to my neighborhood coffee shop.

Business was slow (due to the time of night) so service was pretty fast. Tastes delicious. No complaints. It was pretty late so I feel the barista's quiet/short demeanor is due to her being tired or something. Either way, super excited to get my caffeine fix at like...2100-2130.

Was really impressed with the cleanliness of the restaurant. The staff was nice however the bread choices were limited.the staff said they come already made which means processed food.so the one I wanted they were out and the bread I wanted only came on that one sandwich.so I settled on the vegi.sandwich which was quite delious.the bread was hard.

This is the slowest Starbucks I've ever seen.  The line in the drive through is often backed up almost to the interstate and I can't tell you how many times they have messed up my order.  Unfortunately it's the only Starbucks in Plant City so I have no choice but to suck it up and wait wait wait! I used to visit 3-4 times a week but now I barely make it twice a month.  If it weren't for the gift cards I receive I probably would never go!!

This is my local Starbucks. I tend to hit this place up before heading to work. Since I've been here a 100 times, it's hard for me to really say much about getting in quick, as I'm used to driving around the Pavillion's Center/Walmart parking lot; meaning it's not easy to get in and out of.  The staff always say hello when I walk in. It's always clean and tidy. So far, they have always had the extra's I like to order; protein boxes and salads so I've enjoyed going here. It's not a higher end store, but they seem to get drivers like myself in and out of the drive thru fairly rapidly. It meets my expectations every time.
I ordered my drink and they didn't make it correctly. Instead of remaking my drink in the size I ordered they gave me a smaller size.

Consistently the slowest Starbucks around. A simple coffee order will take at least 15 minutes, even when there are only a few people in line. Don't come in unless you have 30 minutes to stand in line. Otherwise, service is average.

Worst morning staff around 630am the guy in the morning is awful I won't be going back this is. Never gets my drink correct - can  he even smile? I don't think so! I refuse to stop at this location!!!!

Worst morning service ever. Rude! My drink is never correct and I have to end up going inside to get the correct one I paid for. The drive through line takes foreverrr. Won't be back I'll drive to Carmel to get my fix now

Drive thru lines were slow both days we went. Customer service was lacking & needs major improvement. Asked us how to make a drink on their menu... then proceeded to make it incorrectly anyways. Not impressed. Worst Starbucks I've ever visited.

The furniture looks like it came out of an old college dorm.  Not uncomfortable, worn out, uninviting.  Environment is cold and warehouse like.  WiFi doesn't work.  I ask Starbucks person and they say it doesn't work for them either.  Have you tried fixing it?  I ended up going to one on 96th street.  Much better.
Great service and lots of places to work but it is always cold!
Nice big and beautiful!!! The drive thru is sometimes a little hard to get to but no worries!! I love the set up, inside and out

Went through the drive-through asked for a Trenta unsweetened very little ice green tea with two Splenda. And what do I receive... A Trenta with extra ice green tea sweetened with sweeten low! Really!!! So then I went inside and asked the lady if they have Splenda and she said they do and they had to remake my whole drink

I met with a potential business partner at this Starbucks. I do not drink coffee or caffeine, so I had whatever they call their cider. They were friendly, but a little slow.

It was pretty good, and the shop was a nice place for a meeting.  I probably won't return, since I'm not a coffee drinker, but I would recommend it to someone who is.

This has to be the slooooooowest experience ever. In the time I ordered and waited for my coffee my boyfriend manage to fill up his 35gallon tank of gas next door. I was able to take a trip to the ladies room and still I waited. And there was barely anyone in the store. Be advised to just go next door and get your coffee at Wawa's.

I like this Starbucks.  I actually prefer it to the one off of Ina when I am heading out of town and it is my last convenient Starbucks stop before I hit the long drive to Cali.  Always clean, friendly staff who write my name correctly on the cup, clean bathrooms and they never mess my drink up.  Way to go!

The location is outstanding and the staff is excellent. It is without question the best Starbucks location I have visited. Granted, I am not much of a coffee drinker and have only been to 4 or 5 locations in my entire life, but this store is at the top of the "World Class Customer Service" list.

I am known to have a plain bagel with cream cheese and a BTL (Arnold Palmer). The one time they made my drink wrong (because I was chatting up the young man and distracted him), they offered to remake my drink without hesitation. In fact, he caught his mistake as he was handing me the cup. I took the drink he offered and told him to not worry about it (I felt a little responsible, I think he was new and I was distracting him). They remembered the next time I came in and comped me my drink.

I know you have a lot of choices when buying coffee in Tucson, but I promise you will not be disappointed if you choose to visit this location. Not on product, customer service, or their commitment to our community.
Was told, "Can't do decaf through drive-thru." Out of pastries we asked for. Not the first time we've come here and they were out of stuff...both early morning and afternoon.

I love this Starbucks! Everyone is super friendly and I have never had any issues with my order. It can get a little congested first thing in the morning, but even then it isn't bad. I say 4 stars because I wish it had a drive through and because there are always multiple homeless in there taking up the first few seats, but this is a goodie!

I definitely like this particular Starbucks better than most, thanks to its spacious seating and available outlets. At other places, you have to sell your first born child to get a seat with some electrical juice, but this location has a very LARGE table in the center area with outlets built in to the underside of the table....allowing anyone sitting there to be plugged in! There are also a couple more around the perimeter, but I always look forward to spreading out my study materials at the table.

The staff has always been super friendly and they make great new drink suggestions!

Ordered my latte with no foam and it had about 2 inches of foam. I had to get to work so I couldn't ask for it to be redone and had to just use napkins to scoop it all out. Definitely wasted money :/ I was a barista for ten years and always made sure to customize drinks for people because that's why the go to places like Starbucks

I am finally sitting down to write a review for this starbucks.  Sadly, it is by far the worst run starbucks I have been too.  First, I would like to start off by saying that literally the ONLY reason I go to this starbucks/continue to go is because there is a drive-thru.  and to be honest, their wait time in drive-thru is horrendous (you can even watch the counter at the window when you do step inside.)  

Issues I have with this location are as follows:
wrong food given
undercooked food given
long wait times
overcooked food
wrong drink order (had this numerous times)
cold brew often off the menu (consistently for the last 4 sundays in a row I have gone.--someone is seriously messing up on saturday.)
lack of organization/awareness of employee to employee and employee to customer.

I am not sure how long this post should be, because I have been going here for months and every time I think, "ugh I can't believe I spent my money at that location, AGAIN."  I have kids so it's hard because I don't want to have to get out of the car all the time (I know, first world problem) but if the area had ANY other coffee place with a drive-thru I would be going there instead.

I have always been astonished at how friendly Starbucks employees are.  No matter what time of day, what I order, they are always chipper and energetic.  I thought that these traits were required to work at Starbucks (unless you are in NYC, of course).

I came here at about 5:30 am the other day.  This is not my usual Starbucks but I was in that area and needed coffee.  The employees that I encountered seemed to be angry that I would dare to stop by for coffee and a bagel.  In fact, only when the gentleman gave me my coffee and I didn't drive away did he remember that I had ordered a bagel.  He then shouted to someone in the main-area that he needed a bagel, thus making my wait way longer than if he had put in the order when I ordered it.  I got no napkins with my bagel.

Perhaps I just came in on the wrong morning.

I come here 5 days a week, they have my order down. Everyone is usually pretty friendly, Farro is by far my favorite one there though. He's always friendly and he makes my drinks the best. Going there makes my mornings.

It's your standard Starbucks so the drinks are well-made, the baristas are nice and everything is very clean. I give 3 stars because the location is horrible. It's right across the boulevard from the mall, so technically it's a prime location but it get's way too busy and the lines don't move fast enough. The drive-thru gets especially bad both in the mornings and afternoon. The layout of the parking lot doesn't help the situation at all. It's very easy to block someone's car in while waiting in line. I would advise going inside instead of the drive-thru, and don't park anywhere near the drive-thru or you might get stuck when you try to leave.

Home of the coffeebots.
Went here 30 days straight and ordered the same coffee each time (dopio for here).  Much of the time the cashier didn't realize there are porcelain cups for this order, so I ended up saying that each time.....over and over each day, or the barista would see the order tab, but put the coffee in a paper cup.  When I pointed it out, she simply poured the coffee into the porcelain cup leaving the crema behind.
I've been to other places where they recognize me after a week or so, but here the bots are tuned to their headsets and even though they appear to look right at you, they don't see you.

One thing great about this Starbucks is that it opens at 5a. The staff are very nice and fast. I just tried the new Horchata Almond Milk Frappuccino. It was pretty tasty! My fave is still the Mocha Frappuccino.

Writing a review on Starbucks in general seems a bit useless- we all know it and have our own opinions of it.  This location specifically stands out because it has transformed a landmark building from a useless eyesore into a gorgeous, functioning gem.  A gem which provides tasty caffeine!!!   I am sad to say that my first experience here was not a good one.  I got a ham, egg and cheese breakfast sandwich.  The sandwich was still frozen on the inside.  I realize they don't have a kitchen there, but it was an unwelcome reminder that its basically the same thing as a microwave breakfast sandwich from the grocery store.  Ew.  I'll still go there for my caffeine fix.  A lot.

Terrible baristas. This place was a dumpy little corner off the street with a weird area feel. I wouldn't go in here again if I were dying for caffeine. I just can't believe that Starbucks hires workers like this. Boy have their standards fallen.
Nice Starbucks in a nice little plaza. Great staff, and fast! As a Starbucks should be!

I always have the best experience when coming to this location. I usually use the drive thru and the girls who take your order are just the nicest ever. They are always so sweet and friendly and cheerful and unpretentious. Service is usually fast and quality of food and drink is always on point. I highly recommend this location.

I so badly want to give this location a good review but I have visited too many times and been disappointed-have to say that this Starbucks has such a high turnover and maybe this accounts for their inability to make a consistently good drink, specifically their lattes. I really think it's the lack of training. Almost every other location makes their drinks consistently, but at this one, they either let the espresso shots sit too long ( causing a burnt taste) or fill it overflowing with milk (which dilutes the taste) or serves it lukewarm. They are also 5x slower than any of the other locations in town. Whatever it is they are doing, more times than not, I walk away frustrated and vowing never to go there again.

While visiting Florida from the northern east coast, our hotel's internet was not working and i had to find wi-fi. Thank goodness Starbucks is the reliable standard. I could even link up from my car in the parking lot. I finished my work requiring internet and went in to enjoy my favorite  iced green tea. The interior and the entire restaurant are brand new. It has 2 separate seating areas: one lends itself to eating and drinking, the other with comfortable club chairs lends itself to long-term staying while surfing. This is a popular spot with lots of seating, so dont expect quiet while you work. Bring earphones if you need to concentrate and you'll be fine. Excellent venti green iced tea with Stevia sweetener- my comfort drink.
Ordered Cool Lime refresher, and got almost like water. It only has a hint of lime flavor and full of ice and water. Don't go this location.

Between 10th and 11th St, opposite Camp St. Indianapolis
If you are reading a Starbucks review you want to know if THIS one has good staff and service. In a word: Yes. They are pleasant and quick and keep a tidy store. They know their regulars and have a smile even early in the morning. The fare is standard but it is up to snuff and you can expect it to be right.
Terrible service. Rude baristas that laughed at my indecision. Overall just not a good customer experience.

I met up with a friend for coffee on about a week ago and hadn't been to Starbucks in a while, so we met here. It was busy, but not too loud inside. There was no line up, which was nice and we got our coffees in a timely fashion. There were a lot of tables and places to sit to enjoy your afternoon. The latte I had was delicious and very well made. I didn't add anything different or extra into it, and sometimes that can make it very strong tasting, but this one was different. I was very happy with it. After about an hour of sitting chatting, one of the baristas came around offering to try some of their banana bread. She was very polite and made sure she didn't really interrupt anyone if they were talking. The banana bread was very moist and very flavorful. I would definitely hit up this location again, especially in the summer/fall when it's nice out as the patio looks very nice as well.

First, the cashier took my order rudely while the guy in front of me was still signing his receipt blocking me. Then, the barista made the wrong order (would help if they marked the cups as most Starbucks do?!) and blamed me I picked up the wrong drink. I think there was nobody waiting for an order on front of me? Remade the right order but it was watered down and still didn't taste like what I ordered. Maybe I should have stuck with the wrong order as it tasted better. At any rate, such an "I don't care" entitlement attitude. I.e. I can do a terrible job and still get a paycheck. Amazing.

This is one if not one of the best Starbucks that I go to. They know you by name if you are a regular and just overall friendly staff. They take the time to make sure that your order is right and are overall satisfied. They are prompt and precise and can tell that they have fun and enjoy what they do!

Went there for a check of the view and coffee as we live 2.5 miles south.
Good service , not exemplary but exceptional scenery.
No problems so far and lacks some of the sometimes over the line wandering folks at rhe Kietze store.

Will be back.

We along with other customers had to wait about 20-30 minutes, us for a Frappuccino and a strawberry açaí, today at the location near the carousel and food court. The poor guy who was making the drinks was trying his best to get everything finished timely while his "manager" or "supervisor" was berating him telling him he needed to go faster. Mind you the two female employees, including the manager/supervisor, were just standing by the cash register talking about another person they could see in the mall and filling an already full coffee maker instead of helping the male employee during a rush who he said was his second day on the job. The male employee was the only one who apologized for the service while the two females were watching him struggle instead of helping him. That woman should not be in a supervisory position if she feels the need to berate her employee in front of customers during a rush on his second day while she stands there and allows the other employee to stand there watching as well instead of helping him.

Stupid me..   Why did I go to this location...  It's always given me problems...  Even the wife said, "I thought you were going to the other one..."  Our breakfast plans fell through, we needed coffee and we were headed home.  We decided to use up a starbucks gift card and we ordered coffee and sandwiches.  Impressively, the sandwiches were done in seconds and we had them before we even paid.  Then we waited for over seven minutes and the sandwiches were cold by the time we ate them...   We got our drinks and went home to eat.  While drinking our drinks in the car, we noticed both of our drinks were wrong.  The cashier wrote JCF, for Java Chip Frappe on our drinks, but the person making them thought the J was a V I think...  Both of our drinks lacked Java, but were completely vanilla beaned up...  

So why didn't we go back to fix the error?  Well, this location and parking lot is the absolute worst.  Once we were driving down Germantown, we would need to make an illegal u-turn, then go to the mall to turn around, just to get back here.  With the traffic already building, it would add twenty minutes to our trip.  Forget it...  

As a side note, I did complain online to Starbucks and they gave me $15 back.  We spent slightly over $20, but I'm satisfied with that resolution.  We won't spend that $15 at this location.  Karma once again for not listening to myself or you other yelpers...

If this were your first experience of the Starbucks franchise, you would walk away neither overly impressed nor depressed. 
For those of us who've easily been in dozens of them, the feeling is about the same.
In our particular case this week, it was a necessary evil -- we were trying to locate yet another tourist attraction (this sounds like complaining, but trust me, we were having a fabulous time) and the iPhone and its handy GPS were nearly dead, so we ducked into Starbucks for a drink and a good long battery charge. 

I'd never had a Starbucks smoothie before and I'll never have one again. It was just not like a 'real' smoothie -- no fruit chunks, no bold fruit flavors, nothin' interesting, and a strong preservative taste to seal the deal.
But chances are I'd have said the same thing if I'd gone to any other Starbucks nationwide, so don't take that the wrong way. 

The girls behind the counter were LOUD and goofy, but at least they were having fun at work. Plenty of parking out front.

A small Starbucks inside the Sheraton Hotel. It's the closest Starbucky near where we were staying on Bourbon St.  It has a limited amt of tables. The register person was very nice.  All I wanted was a Starbucks mug so can't comment on how they make their coffee.

Never had poor customer service from any other Starbucks. One of the employees who took the order was very impatient. And whoever made the drinks did not know how too. Went back to redo the order and they argued that they were right and that the person who made them was a manager. Horrible!

Very green apron! Nothing to complain about here.  Partners moved fast and were always friendly despite the sour faced rude customers who ordered in-between text messages and ongoing phone conversations.
 
For those who find their store too small and the their service too slow, trying getting off the phone and look the person behind the counter in the eye when ordering and stop treating them like a barely tolerable app on your phone.
All Starbucks have become over priced and service is sloppy and slow. Who says its not about the money?

Surprisingly when I walked in there was a couple in front of me ordering. There is normally a long line when I come in or go through the drive-thru. 

Today when I went to order the barista was not friendly at all. I usually have a great experience when I go to starbucks. This woman didn't say anything until I ordered a croissant and she asked warmed? Then she asked for my name.

This was the worse experience I have ever had. They are usually very friendly. Even the drive through talks to me more. 

I will continue coming to this starbucks due to the fact that there is a drive through and makes it convenient.

Overall, friendly people and of course my drink was great. I would have given them a 4 star rating, however the drink/dining area was dirty. The tables needed to be wiped off and the floor swept.

It wasn't as clean as some of the other Starbucks, but the friendly people made the visit worthwhile.
