Ugh. This Starbucks is a mess in a lot of ways. The parking lot was so poorly designed, it already creates a plethora of issues for this franchise. The workers work at their own pace. They don't care what the customers think, they just work on their own clock. They are accurate with the order, but how hard is it to take a coffee order? Not hard. If you're brand loyal it doesn't matter but if you just like a good cup go to the Buddy's Brew down the street. Always a zoo here.

This place provides the standard Starbucks high quality product served efficiently by pleasant barista staff.  I love the comfy outdoor couches (weatherproof plastic of course). That said, I find the inside small and cramped with only high top seating except for a single lower table. Not welcoming atmosphere since the remodel necessitated by the closing of the bank branch with whom they shared a large lobby with confer station areas and work/conference tables.  I go there on nice days and for drive through. Hate the interior.

When you have to work all day and then come here and visit sick family members, you sometimes need a pick me up. My mom was in the hospital for 5 weeks and this Starbucks was located inside. I was working 45-50 hour weeks, then needed to come here everyday and there were many days I needed something to wake me up some. This Starbuck is the average Starbucks, nothing different than any other one. Although they did not ever get my order wrong. It's just such a tight spot to order and pick up your order. There is something about tight facilities, and parking lots that Starbucks just seems to have to have.

Literally the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to in my entire life AND THEY WEREN'T EVEN BUSY!!! There were four freaking baristas working, two people ahead of me in line (one didn't order a drink, just a slice of lemon pound cake) and it still took 20 full minutes to get my tall iced coffee which literally requires no fancy mixing. You just pour the coffee from the pitcher and some cream and viola! I almost asked if I could make it may damn self at one point. So frustrating, every time I come here it's slow. I have to remind myself to not come to this one.

Just had another awesome visit. I used the new Mobile order and Pay app. My order was ready to pickup when I arrived. Awesome! It was delicious... And they have a new beef brisket sandwich that is yummy.i also purchased a small bag of Almond Rocca caramel popcorn. This store is immaculate and the baristas are so friendly.

I am always blown away when people I barely know remember me. Our cashier not only remembered me, but asked me if I still had partner numbers from the very short time she knew me as a barista. We chatted a little while as she rang up my order for a green tea lemonade and when the barista on bar handed me my drink, it was a green tea latte (the cup markings are super close). I actually would've rather had a green tea latte -- I just didn't want to pay for it. The tea lemonades are cheaper. Both baristas apologized over and over and offered to remake it, but insisted it was fine. More than fine, as I said earlier. They personified what it means to be a Starbucks partner. Sure, they messed up, but they took the appropriate steps to correct it and I left a very happy customer :)

This starbucks sucks butt I'll give it to them because they are very friendly. 

They are constantly messing up my drink order BUTT they offer to fix it with no problem.

They are also pretty slow... Don't ever go in when they have a long line.
Coffee is good as expected. One problem though the drive thru is atrocious! Every time I come I sit in this god forsaken line for 30 mins. I think I have a problem.

I always stop in this Starbucks when I'm in Tucson. The staff is always on top of things, they have the fast drive thru of any Starbucks I have been too, and they have never gotten my drink order wrong. My only complaint is that they are sometimes out of the spinach wrap I so love.
I had the worst Starbucks experience here. They jacked up 2 out of 3 drinks. Poor effort by the barista. Sorry - she's not a barista. Just a girl making coffee.

I love this Starbucks! The staff is always super-friendly and accomodating. They even re-made me a drink one day...but I think that's the SB promise. I like this SB as a place to meet up with friends because they have a nice outdoor patio and lots of comfy spots inside, too. I never feel rushed or bothered. My only complaint is that there isn't always enough parking.
Wait time is over 25 min for a coffee. Hmm. Not a good process here. Wrong orders. List orders. Need someone to help them out.
On line says it is open until 11p. All signs are lighted. Pull up at 10:08 and closed. . Disappointing at least turn odd Drive thru sign and menu board and update in-line hours.

Favorite location to go to personally. Although they're always busy (location is right by 69), they always seem to get you in and out quickly. 

Tip if you're in a hurry: if the drive-thru is long (it almost always is) it's worth running inside real fast. They're usually not as busy inside and get you out faster! Ordering ahead on the mobile app is awesome as well if your drink is available!

Drive thru line can get really long, but they move pretty fast. 

Surprisingly easy to pull in and out of the parking lot (if you're making a right on Grand, that is). 

Drinks are inconsistent - why isn't me venti latte filled up all the way? why do sometimes I get that little green spill locker and sometimes I don't? 

Haven't been inside (yet) but the pictures I've seen look pretty cool.
One of my favorite Starbucks locations conveniently located on 96th street easy access in and out the staff is always very friendly the only downside is there's no drive-through.  Near the Nail Bar

I absolutely lovee this Starbucks location because of the super friendly staff here. I love it even more now that its renovated and has more seats! This location is always quiet enough to start some work or just sit and chat with friends. 
    It's also in a great location since there's a froyo place, pizza restaurant and whole foods right across the street!

One week ago at 9 pm one of the employees was trying to let people leave by cleaning the floor with the soup next to their tables, and on the entrance, I was the only one inside when 2 others came, they were not able to enter because she left the soup on the floor, she saw them and did nothing, then I left and these two left as well..
Out of all starbaucks I've been to this is the worst.
Right downtown! Cute location: inside & outdoor seating. Again, it's Starbucks....quality & consistency of product were right on. Baristas were friendly & this was a clean location!

I'm the type of customer whose drink is unique (I know, I know) and memorized by a couple of the veteran baristas. "The usual?" they ask when I stroll in or roll up to the drive-thru speaker. I love my veteran baristas at this Starbucks. I even went on a date with one once! (Whaaaaat?)

And I've been coming to this particular location for the better part of two years, so I don't really feel bad about the rating I'm bestowing upon it today.

It seems that they've recently hired a slew of new employees who a) have no experience working with coffee and b) fail to listen to your drink order in the drive-thru line, resulting in having to repeat it 3-4 times. 

So what happens in this instance? Well, it seems this Starbucks is keen on training said employees during their rush: when people need to get the f%#@ to work. So the long (LONG) line that runs all the way into the traffic on Girls School Road (literally) remains at a standstill for a solid 20 minutes. 

A solid 20 minutes of waiting, followed by a new barista that either gets your order wrong repeatedly or just pauses, followed by ".... Um... What...?" in the most monotone I-don't-care voice I've ever heard. 

Look, I understand new employees need to be trained on making drinks and serving food as well as taking orders in the store and in the drive-thru line. But maybe rethink your plan of action and have the new guys MAKE the drinks during rush and TAKE the orders during the slower hours.

Until they get situated, I'll unfortunately be taking my business to the Starbucks further west in Avon. Sad face.

This is a 2nd rate Starbucks at best.
My husband and I have been to this Starbucks many times over the past year and I cannot think of one decent thing to say about our experiences.
More than once with 6 cars in line in front of us we have sat for OVER 30 minutes waiting in line.
Let me be clear for a good/great coffee I am totally willing to sit in that line but that's not what happens here.
When you eventually get to the speaker to order consider yourself lucky if you only have to give your order twice.
Only 1 time have I gotten to the window and the order was correct!!
For example, today what should have been a triple vente cappuccino was instead a grande latte.
When telling the woman this is not what I ordered and repeating to her what I had ordered she went thru the motions of fixing it. Try #2 I got a vente but after taking a sip I realized it was not a triple cappuccino but instead a standard vente latte.
We were already made late to my daughters graduation ceremony because of how long we waited so I took the latte and left. 
If they can't get it right after 40 minutes 2 tries and being given the order 4 times there's very little chance I would have gotten what I ordered in try 3

Did I mention they never even told me the cost or offer me a receipt?!$&

All in all I'm a coffee lover and willing to spend $5 on a great coffee but I'll drive the extra 25 minutes out of my way to the next closest Starbucks vs. going to this location again!!
This Mother's Day Sunday crew struggled to keep up. Our drinks came out 5 minutes apart from each other. Only one person making drinks with 7 people working!

This Starbucks is normally pretty quick about getting you in and out. The last time I went into the store I had my complimentary birthday drink. It was suppose to be loaded on my Starbucks app, but I am having difficulty with it. I showed my barista my email and the app and she had no problem giving me my free drink which can be anything on the menu. It is a great way to keep you going back, but who doesn't love spending $3 for a small cup of coffee. 

I must say Starbucks has it figured out when it comes to going back frequently. Sure I can make a regular cup of coffee at home, but I have to keep my gold status and I want to keep getting free drinks so I keep going back spending my hard earned money. 

Their customer service is great and they will make it right without questions if there is a mess up. This location is pretty quick and very friendly.

Have been here a number of times, and not overly impressed. The staff usually seems to not know much about their own products and my drinks get messed up often. I would rather go to a local place instead!
Typical Starbucks. They get my order wrong 20% of the time and they leave caramel on the cup 80% of the time. I don't understand why they don't give you a napkin.

Typical Starbucks, big and roomy, always a place to sit... plenty of parking too.

However, they rarely get my drink correct.  And it seems to be happening more and more often, and it's making me not want to go there anymore.
Just your basic Starbucks. Friendly baristas. Horrible, horrible parking. But pretty convenient being close to Vanderbilt.

This is not my normal Starbucks, but it could be.  The staff here is pretty awesome.  I felt like a regular even though I do not go to this location often.  I'm walking distance from Mass Ave 'Bucks and will visit the drive though with kids in tow.  The staff here made my visit special.  I don't know if it was my Starbuck Gold Card or my reputation as a well know Yelp elite is getting around.  Either way, keep it up.
They continue to give me someone else's drink probably 8/10 times I go and I never get back a receipt so I could go back and get my correct drink  fast service though

This is my favorite Starbucks in St. Louis.  I'm reviewing it as a Starbucks, since that is the sign on the side of the building.  I didn't expect to be blown away by some baristas creative take on a latte... but I also didn't expect to be underwhelmed by some hipster's weird interpretation of my favorite beverage. 

I go to Starbucks for consistency, friendly service and free refills.  I come here when I'm visiting my parents to get work done.  The staff has always been super friendly.  The decor in the Starbucks is nicer than some of the other stores I've been in.  This store is also a little less busy than their Kirkwood Rd. counterpart, so be sure to head here if you're going at a busy time of the day.  I think the drive thru helps manage the crowd.  

Overall, a great Starbucks.  You'll get the drink you want, and you'll get it with a smile from friendly staff.
I stop in here every morning to get my coffee. Fran and Alayzgia are the NICEST and most polite ladies. They know my drink, they're always smiling and it's just a pleasure each morning.

I really like this Starbucks, it might just be my favorite Starbucks!  I say that because all of the employees are very friendly and sweet.  I came in dripping wet from the rain and one of the baristas offered me a trash bag so I wouldn't get more wet, how sweet!   This Starbucks is conveniently located to my gym and work so I'll plan to come here again.  They definitely give service with a smile, which goes a long ways these days!  I think I'll choose to come here more often!

This is my usual Starbucks and have been coming here for almost 4 years. I'm not a coffee drinker so I appreciate the baristas keeping me updated with non - coffee drinks. I LOVE these three in particular: vanilla chai latte, green tea frappucino & valencia orange cooler. When I occasionally try a coffee blend they make sure that it's not too strong for me. Based on how they take care of me I'm sure they treat other customers just as good.
Was not the service I'm used to getting. If all other stores had personalities like the one I encountered at this one Starbucks would go out of business
Great customer service on every visit.  Everything is always delicious.  Ive only used the drive thru at this location, but they are courteous and accurate.
Great Starbucks.  The staff is pretty friendly.  I enjoy stopping here and doing some reading and studying.

What could be better on a cool spring day. A triple white chocolate mocha. Needed the caffeine to get me home to Arkansas. Great customer service. Barista was quick and courteous. Exactly what I needed in a hurry.

Yet another Starbucks. However as similar as they all are, they are all different!  This one is busy!  Fast!  Friendly! And yes clean!  

The menu board is rather lean! Must be a lot of regulars here.

I was in there with a friend and he has frequented there several times.  When they call the customers name to pick up their order I could barely hear the name called and I have good ears. They only say it once and if your talking to someone you might miss it and your drink will either get hot or cold.  My friend ordered a cold coffee drink that he usually orders. This time they got the orders wrong 3  times. Almost making us late for church.
They don't know what customer service is.
I won't go back there again.

Dan is the Man at this drive thru.  Actually, most of the staff that service the window are friendly, personable, attentive, accurate and prompt, but Dan adds entertainment to the list.  Good coffee and other drinks.  Not liking the new items offered through la Boulange or however, you spell it.  Most of the pastries need to be heated to taste good, as they are refrigerated or stale tasting otherwise.  On the plus side, they seem to have more offerings than in the past as far as pastry variety.  Quality of food is no where near Panera, but tops on beverages.  
You will encounter long lines at windows on rush hour.  Parking lot is tough and not driver friendly.  Use caution.

My favorite Starbucks location!

I have been to this location numerous times and have always had a pleasant experience. This most recent visit I drove from a lunch meeting that was 3 doors down (I feel like I need to acknowledge the band reference I accidentally made), from another Starbucks but I drove another 15 minutes because I love this location.

There is always ample seating, I've never felt like my space was invaded by anyone nearby. 

Service is always great, no complaints!
Trash was overflowing and my frap took forever to get. My husband ordered a double espresso shot and they served it in a large cup that you'd get a large coffee in.

Every time I go to this Starbucks I am disappointed. There was probably about 5 baristas behind the bar and not one greeted me when I came in or acknowledged me when I got to the register. I basically had to wait until the girl on the front till saw me and acknowledged me. They leave far too much room in my iced coffee when I asked for no room at all. I've asked in the past to have it topped off and got an attitude in return, I wouldn't have to ask at all if it was made properly to begin with.

I feel like I should update this review because lately I have noticed the service seems to be better. The baristas seem happier and the overall cleanliness has improved as well. 

I still think this is a really busy location so not great for a meet up. And the seating here is awkward and uncomfortable... but the improved service makes me more comfortable for popping in and out when I need my caffeine fix.

The employees are friend and nice.
It seems like Starbucks train their staff for all the Santa Barbara stores here in this one. It seems like the new people train here and then movie to other stores, except for the ones who have been there for years.

The only problem with this Starbucks is that is small.

I live right around the corner, so unfortunately this is the most convenient location to go to. Every time there's a huge line with one person at the register and then it takes far too long to receive your order. Today I waited over 20mon after I ordered and paid for an iced coffee...

This location is ok..the staff has completely changed! The old crew was great, very nice and personable!! It's a very small location with a few tables and a bar with stools by the window. They do have two outside tables as well. We have been going here for years and have met some very nice people! If it wasn't for knowing other customers here it's possible I would stop going! One last note...two restrooms and no code or key needed...but buy something anyway-IT'S A BUSINESS!!!!!
Love that a Starbucks has come close to where I live. I would study here however the music is a bit too loud.. Please do a music check.

Only 2 stars for this one because 1) It was New Years Day and they only had three baristas working. For hungover people, a little quicker caffeination is never a bad thing. 2) The drive through customers were being served much quicker than the folks in store. 3) The woman in line ahead of me was ordering about 8 drinks and then decided to argue with the cashier because he didn't reload the proper balance on her Sbux card. That wouldn't have given them less stars in itself -- but I literally waited TO ORDER 14 mins. At least could have started my drink while resolving the issue?

All employees I gave the 4 star to r gone :( this Starbucks is left with incompetent staff. They made my drink hot when I asked for iced ... They slip in whole milk when u ask for skim ..no more friendly hellos or remembering your name :( 
Now it's just coffee .

I am giving four star primarily based on my PREVIOUS visits. Just went through drive through and the lady there was NOT pleasant at all. :( She seemed very unhappy with being there and when asked if everything was okay (because the wait was longer than normal) quote for quote she replied "well there's 85 of you and only one of me so..." sorry but I didn't say it rudely nor did I need attitude back. Very unhappy with this experience, but on a NORMAL basis the people are VERY pleasant and happy! Hence I gave four stars! :)

Service was quick. No hand soap in the bathroom! Tables were dirty.
Lots of staff, but no one was attending to the minor details.

As far as I'm concerned this is the best Starbucks on my commute. I pass three and a fourth is a touch past my office. I used to go with my mood and chose whatever one looked the least busy but at 6:30 am none of them were terribly busy. This particular one has made one mistake in approximately 200 visits. That's a darn fine record. This one has a drive through and some comfy chairs and a sofa as well as tons of tables of varying size so there's ample seating. Service is very good as is the quality. I spend $4.61 five days a week and almost everyone knows what I'm ordering, my name and no room. So why not 5 stars? The parking lot is a nightmare. If you end up parking just as it gets busy good luck getting out. It's set up in a way that the drive thru when busy can literally prevent every single parked car from getting out. I guess this used to be a drive thru restaurant so they were dealt a bad hand to begin with. Oh I just wanted to address the speed issue that seems to ne a recurrence in reviews. Generally I think they do fine at this location. I do see one particular "crew" that when they work are significantly slower than other "crews" but it looks to me to be due to not working their strengths not because they are doing anything wrong. Btw love Ana and Sue. They are always cheerful.
I love this location. Rachel and Pioquinto are my favorite baristas. They are terrific!

Nice people work here, always a smile . They run a busy shop fast and efficient .
Coffee tastes same as in all other star bucks so I guess it's the employees that make this one special .

This starbucks is great, the people here are very friendly and the location is a nice place to just sit back and watch the traffic. My friends and I love coming here for our bike meet ups and catch up while watching nice cars drive by.

We come to this Starbucks at least once every two weeks if not every week.  It is conveniently located in between our house in Orlando and my parent's house in Tampa.  This is by far the slowest Starbucks we have ever been to... Consistently.  Service is poor, you would be lucky if you get much more conversation than 'what can we get for you'.  We thought that this time we would go inside to speed things up and get a better experience but that didn't change anything.
Could not fulfill online order for a cup of coffee in 15 minutes. App indicated 3 to 6 minutes. Tried calling store to contact manager later, no one would answer and no voice mail.

This Starbucks is terrible. Mobile order took thirty minutes!  And they were not apologetic at all - actually very rude when I queried about my drink. The three workers clearly were not trained well because they had to re-do several drinks while I waited for mine. What's crazy is this Starbucks was packed! This location could use a complete overhaul with its workers.

I like the location and the layout of this store. Right in the heart of Downtown, a block off the main strip of the bar scene, opposite from Jannus Live (RIP Jannus Landing). The decor inside is very modern with some soft leather chairs along the far wall. The staff is very friendly despite the fact that you know they have to deal with a lot of drunks and the downtown crazies. You'll have to pay to park most days (all days?) but you have to do that anywhere downtown. I'd go here more often if not for the parking problem. But it's still a great Starbucks.
The location is convenient and in the morning the outside area is nicely shaded. Service is okay.

I much prefer this Starbucks then the one on Canal Place! Had to wait for someone here and the worse thing I can say about the place is that it would have been nice if someone had wiped the tables down at some time in the 90 minutes I was there.

So from the last time i reviewed this location years ago they have improved and are a million times better now.
My drink of choice is a Venti Americano with heavy creamer and vanilla. If this is done right its one of the smoothest drinks you could imagine, drinks like water practically but you still get 4 shots of espresso. If done wrong it taste like instead of using espresso they used coal from an old fire. Its very hard to get right.
That all being said, my past few years coming here they've done a flawless job of perfecting that drink for me, most of the people working started to remember me and my order also which is huge for me. Now granted were all just human, occasionally during extremely busy times it may not be totally up to par, but everyone working has always been more than happy and willing to fix the order.
This is one of my favorite locations in the city without a doubt.

Don't normally do reviews on Starbucks due to the monopoly they have on the coffee market , I try to support the little guys. I did the drive through and my barista Dan was so sweet he saved me .. Wait for it ! A 20 cents .. Eyes rolling I am sure .. It is not the 20 cents that is the point.. It's the fact that he had exceptional customer service and he took it upon himself to be proactive and offer ways to save a few cents .. I like that brain cells were being used and not just another drone like barista at your service .. Way to go Starbucks on Kennedy .. You have a star

Probably the worst Starbucks I've ever been to and I've been to a lot. Drinks never quite right and staff who seem to not understand that when you pay almost $4 for a drink - you want it to taste in the ballpark of what you get at other local Starbucks. Avoid..

I like this branch. The staff is so welcoming and friendly. And the people that visits are usuallu students or workers from near by companies.

The only drawback about this place, it's really small. Even though when the weather is nice they do provide outdoor seating with tables and meat seats.
9am on a Sunday morning & its busy AF here!!! 15 cars in line for the drive-thru & 17 people in line at the register. Cuz-ray-zee!

Needed a quick pick me up for an event, and was thrilled to come across this Bux location. 

Quite a bit of a parking lot to navigate (I'm an out of towner, so maybe I just turned in the wrong entrance) but the drive thru was quick, order was correct, and the customer service was great. 

Within 5 minutes, I had drinks in hand, and was on my way. 

Can't beat that.

My hubby picked up our morning coffee here the entire vacation and they never got the order right! There really is no where else to go, and I was not impressed with the  Chicory in  Nola I had to have real coffee.  
The employees here do not try too hard probably because it is in  a hotel so they know most customers won't be back.  I basically drink rocket fuel but they watered it down quite a bit.
Our own hotel serves Starbucks with  breakfast but they stop serving breakfast too early for us to get up. So this was the only other option.

This place was crazy busy. Steady flow of people coming through. Thankfully they kept up pretty well & we received our drinks  without waiting too long. This particular Starbucks is the smallest one I have ever been into. It is also set up strangely, but maybe that's because of its location & tininess. Ha! As soon as you enter you are standing at the order counter. Then you move around the counter in a line, finally to end up on the other side. There you will find some seating if you choose to stay. There are also a few tables outside. We left & enjoyed our drinks at the monument.

Great Starbucks, always very friendly and great customer service. 5 stars for the new Starbucks! A little small inside and it's always packed, but that's a sign that it's a great Starbucks! Will be back for more!
What is with all of the flies? On multiple occasions there have been swarms of them throughout the cafe. Need to address the issue ASAP.

This Starbucks is by far my favorite. I can only write a review about their drive thru.... Always speedy, they never make mistakes, and the location is ideal if you're on your way to the mall or work. It's my hidden coffee drive thru!!!!! 

Also some of the most talented baristas around. They only Starbucks location I can say "make me something amazing" and they DO!!! Thank you for helping me make it through so many 12 hr shifts!!!

This Starbucks does the trick. Fast, friendly service, ample seating available. I've never been here during "rush hour" but I can imagine it gets to be pretty bananas as per the great location. 

One drawback... The bathroom. Yuck. Needs some attention.
My favorite Starbucks In the area now. They are super friendly and quick. I also like the setup and ambiance of the store. I will have to go more often.

Come here to study all the time! Best layout of a Starbucks - lots of space, and utilized well. The service is fast and they've never once gotten my order wrong. Other places' baristas will give you a bit if attitude about refills or remaking drinks, but these guys are great. (Not that they need to remake much). 

Big cautionary piece of advice though - there are ALWAYS a bunch of flies and fruit flies all around. Make sure you look closely into the food before ordering - I've seen fruit flies in there several times.

It's a Starbucks in a really neat building! I love how Starbucks has re-claimed this space and made it usable again. The major downsides are that it's very busy and the drive through is incredibly slow. Major upside is that this building is a two-fer and you can get Chipotle next door.

Just as clean and friendly as any Starbucks I've ever been to. Apparently they are having issues with their suppliers and therefore are not making sandwiches or wraps (aside from breakfast ones) for the foreseeable future...hmmm??
Great experience. New Starbucks opened late in 2013. Nice Tables and chairs. Great baristas. I've not had any issue. At times especially mornings can be crowded as expected 5-10mins wait.

Always great coffee. If you like chi this is the Starbucks to go to, I have to drive past the one closer to me bc there chi is mixed wrong, to go to this one!
Always great service! They are one of the quickest around

Mmm... I love Starbucks.

Yes, it's overpriced.  Yes, it's a sweet treat.  Yes, it's an indulgence...

That I L-O-V-E!

Mmm... Try the iced carmel machhiato with added vanilla and cinnamon dolce syrup to taste like a snicker doodle cookie!

Did you know they have kid sized drinks for the wee ones for $1.25 and you still get a star on  your Starbucks reward card for purcahsing?!?

Register a gift card or download the app for your phone, collect stars, and earn free treats, discounts, and a free drink on your birthday every year!

This location is never crowded when I go in the morning (before 7am).  They have parking spots right outside the entrance on meridian.  They have messed up my coffee a few times.  I would say I hate to have foam in my coffee.  For some reason I ask for no foam and I still get it.  A lot of it.  I will not stop at this location again.  I've given them enough chances.  Not worth my time when other locations can get it right.

The plastic smiles and "third place experience" facade quickly crumbles on a 97 degree day when someone asks for water. Waiting in line I watched a man attempt to get a glass of ice water for a homeless woman outside. The employees were demeaning and patronizing, one telling the man they had no ice as another scooped ice into a coffee. I realize it is a business, but you are also part of a community, refusing to provide a cup of ice water to a good samaritan to give to a  homeless person (who did not come inside) on a dangerously hot day is nothing short of mean.

It was your "normal" Starbucks location. Coffee was made to my liking. 
The shopping center around the store is great. Ample parking and great eats at the Coal Fire Pizza place nearby. 
This Starbucks could have been kept up or maintained a bit better compared to what I have seen at other locations. The bathroom was untidy and the product displays on the floor were looking picked-over.  Limited selection on baked goods and food/snacks. But hey, at the end of the day, the coffee was good.

this Starbucks has great employees especially trevor, Jonathan, and patti but I'm not sure if she still works there. these people are great, they are easy to talk to and they are super friendly and they get your order right! I defiantly recommend going to this Starbucks for there great service and hard working employees. they deserve a raise!

There are a few reviews that negatively characterize the staff here, but in my experience the staff here is one of the most charismatic and energetic units in Tucson. However, this location is insanely busy and the staff seems to be under constant pressure to move as quickly as possible, which causes mistakes. This is more of a location issue - I think that if there were another location maybe a half mile down the road the service may improve greatly.
I have been here many times over the past year - on one occasion the staff forgot my order and I had to ask them again to bring it out. The thing is- the line was so long that it extended out of the door, so it is tough to be too angry about it.
If you're craving Starbucks, just go here. And if the line is ridiculous, the nice thing to do is tip the staff for having to deal with it, instead of getting angry at the inevitable mistakes.
I go to this Starbucks a lot because it opens really early, has great tea, has friendly, competent staff, and a lively clientele. Food is ok.

Slowest Starbucks I've ever been to--- drive thru is never a speedy process but this location is always packed. 

Enjoy their happy hour deals!
I love the new design of the place with a couple of more outlets which is desperately needed at other locations. Great atmosphere as well and the baristas are customer friendly.

This is a franchise store so don't expect the usual VERYGOOD experience. I guess mobile  scanners are only available in Company stores.. Folks in franchise stores are just simply not trained as well as co stores

Starbucks sucks. It's so awkward and the quality of beans they use are poor. I know it a coffee shop but everyone is so quiet and observing you can feel the snobbery in the air. It's like pigs at the trough. Id rather go to some family owned place.
Slowest. Drive-thru. Ever. The manager needs to get with the program and train the employees better. No reason there should be a ten minute wait with three cars in line each only getting one drink.

Standing in a Starbucks right now. Barista had one person with a two drink order in front of 
me. Turns out to me time consuming drinks. I'm waiting for an iced coffee. No other customers are in line. Three employees are standing around talking, not realizing the one of them could make the simple iced coffee for me so I could be on my way. Instead they continue to yap away, totally unaware of anything around them. Waited 5 minutes for simple unsweetened iced coffee. Congrats on the 1 star ladies. U earned it

Solid coffee. Normal Starbucks menu. Cute atmosphere. 

2 Stars off for the parking situation. Terrible parking. They should not have been allowed to build here given the parking chaos. Bad design.

I usually come here on a coffee run for my family while they are at work, so I usually have a large order. I have never had any trouble with my order. It has always been right. I've only had 'burnt' coffee once and that wasn't even with the big orders. Everyone is super friendly. I love this Starbucks over the others in the area. They're nice, they get my order right, and they get it to me quickly.

All I have to say is yum!! Starbucks is delicious. Their coffee is warm,tasty, and how coffee should be. Their passion tea lemonade is sweet and very good. I also enjoy their pumpkin and banana walnut slices of bread. The location is great.  I'm fond of Starbucks.

Coming in here just now reminded me why I stopped coming to this location ...... lack of customer service that in some cases as today almost borders on rudeness .....

I should have taken my card back and driven 2 miles down the road to another location ......

Hopefully I will not give in to "I hope it's better this time" when shopping up here.

What separates one Starbucks from another is the customer service ..... not the drinks .......

This is my favourite Starbucks in town. It's located on Whyte inside Chapters book store which makes it more interesting. I can sit there and spend hours working or reading a book or browse the Internet without being disturbed. There are a good number of tables and staff are usually friendly. My complaint would be about not being served in mugs and plates, and small choice of baked goodies.

Starbucks food and drinks are pretty much the same wherever you go... We like that.

What sets this location apart and gives it that extra special Midwest flair is the insane drive-thru line. Consistent 18-23 minutes waiting.  Fine for those who have plenty of time on their hands to sit and do nothing while spitting out car exhaust and burning gas.

Just for fun, no one seems to know what to do when the line extends into the Best Buy parking lot and entrance.

If I could, I would open my own coffee/food location right across the street and show live video of the Starbucks line on an app.

I rarely write reviews.  However, this is the worst service ever.    Very disappointed
They had 8 people behind the counter and could not manage a simple order.
Seriously waited 15 minutes for an iced coffee as folks behind me in line got fancy iced drinks first.

I've always been a home brew coffee kinda girl, so it's a rarity when I venture into a Starbucks. However, my boyfriend is a huge fan so we decided to go on Saturday. 

After staring at the menu completely overwhelmed for what seemed like an eternity, I decided to try the Mocha Light Frappuccino. It was the most delicious thing I've ever drank. It was a cold, silky combination of mocha and chocolate. A Grande only has 130 calories too. 

In my eyes, that's worth raving over!
Nice remodel. Staff was friendly. Even delivered our food to the table. That is, when they're not real busy! And it's always pretty busy.
Stopped in and waited 10 minutes for the drink to be made, a single person making drinks, really?!

Ah Starbucks. Well once again brand recognition is in full force, looking at the outside I could have been anywhere (Madrid? Penang? Sydney? - nope I was in St. Albert) and the inside has the same cozy, casual feel to it. The store front faces west which is great for our area because that means they get the afternoon/evening sun.

The service is good - not great as sometimes you have to repeat your order or the staff feel the drive-thru takes priority. The food and beverages are exactly what is expected from a Starbucks (that's what you get from a standardized chain) but I find this fact comforting because I know what I order will taste the same no matter where I am in the world. 

I like that there are multiple plug-in locations - on the walls and underneath the bench seat. This is great if you do need to work for a long period of time because then you don't have to fight other people for the limited power.

There are 5 Starbucks locations in St. Albert and this is by far my favorite - for some reason, even for how "out of the box" the store is I really like the feel of this one - it is less busy then others, the staff are always welcoming, and the parking lot is very user friendly. I love to meet up after dinner for coffee with friends throughout the year here.

The location is key to the success of this coffee shop. Not far from Washington's Crossing, Bristol, Morrisville and such. The layout is nice with lounge chairs and a high top bar in the front. Tables around the side in the back along with an small outdoor deck. The staff is knowledgeable and are efficient with their sense of urgency to the customer. Free wifi (as with most Starbucks). I visit a lot of coffeehouses in the greater Philadelphia area and this is one of my staples. So yeah I like it because it's solid not necessarily because it's a Starbucks.

The other Starbucks in Hermitage. I was there Saturday morning while my car was being worked on. This one doesn't seem to be as busy as the other Starbucks in Hermitage. I do wish they had a larger patio

This Starbucks is pretty nice, and the service is pretty good. There is a fair amount of inside seating as well as some limited outside patio tables available, a drive-thru is also available for those times that you just want to grab a drink and go. The rest is pretty much what you would expect from Starbucks.

This drive thru is just ridiculous. Takes forever to get through. Unless you are have 20 minutes to spare and are desperate for a Starbucks, avoid this one. Seriously always busy, and they just can't get cars through in a timely manner. Two stars just because they have gotten my order right both times, but major fail on wait times

Came to this location 15 minutes before close (so sorry!) and they were still extremely friendly. I got their new promotion - double shot on ice, and it's not bad! I was looking for a new favorite and I might have found it. Their outside seating also looked very nice.

I go super early in am (0540) for my tall white choc mocha & they make it perfect & on schedule! Plus the girl makes sure not to over fill so there's no spillage or leaking which is a must when making these beverages, we don't want to wear em-I've been to others that are slower then molasses & half my drink spills out from how crapy the lid is put on or over filling! I'm satisfied so far!
I am not a fan of the coffee.i usually get latte ir capaccino..i am a fan of the bakery items..just personal preference.they also have a small gift area.

I really like this location. I usually meet up here on Wednesday mornings before work for some discipleship time. The employees are always friendly even when it's 6:30am, and I like that there are a couple of tables outside to sit out and get some fresh air.

This is a great Starbucks location right off of I-4.  It is open 24 hours and has a quick drive thru.  You can't miss the location as there is a giant Starbucks sign viewable as you approach the exit.

I have had no problems here with the quality of the coffee or speed of service as both have been great.  My only complaint would be with the friendliness of the staff serving the drinks.  Some cheerfulness and politeness goes a long way.  The last time I came in, it seemed more like they didn't really even want to be there.
Not enough electrical outlets.  They need to install places to plug in for those who need power for devices.  It's 2015 SB peeps---one or two outlets right next to each other just don't cut it.

I'm not a Starbucks fan, but sometimes it just can't be avoided. Had to be on this side of town and was meeting an ex-coworker for coffee to catch up, so Starbucks was convenient. Its not a very comfortable Starbucks as the seating is kind of on top of one another, but the shop was clean.

The service was polite and quick.

The coffee was just meh. I've become addicted to the Cafe con leches in Miami. Ask one of the "baristas" (said in my most sarcastic tone) at Starbucks for a cafe con leche and you'll get a blank stare. I ordered a Caffe Latte as that is the closest they have, but still just meh.

I wish I could say I had a good experience here today but I did not. The only reason I'm giving this place three stars is because the past experiences I've had were not bad. The manager on shift this morning was not all the friendliest. When she greeted me she did ask how I was doing, I responded with " I'm doing okay how are you?" She didn't answer my question just asked me what I was getting. I ordered a medium coffee, she collected my money handed me my coffee and said here ya go. No thanks you have a good day. I would expect this from a McDonald's employee not a manager at star bucks. I then went over to the creamers and milk and had notice they did not have there time stickers on them. I use to be a shift manager at Einstein Bagels so I know all the food safety rules. I walked over to her and told her how there were no stickers. She then tells me they have "timers" on them. If this is star bucks policy to not put time stickers and have some "timer" on them then hopefully someone high up will see this and change that, because how am I suppose to know if the milk has been out for 1 hour or 7? I ended up not liking the coffee all too much took my business to Einsteins across the street. Much friendlier staff they were more interested interacting with me versus each other.
The baristas are really helpful with making beverage suggestions. Great options to make drinks healthier.
The drive thru is ridiculously slow here. 4 cars in line and over 20 minutes on an afternoon-not the busiest of times. They also don't have the nitro cold brews at this location.
Love the whole staff there.They greet you with your name  after couple of your orders.They learn your customized drinks and get them ready when they see you walk into the door.They are just amazing.

Found out the GM is making this location an Allergy Friendly Store!!!  For those of us allergic to nuts (some drink flavorings contain nuts), cross-contamination can be deadly.  This Allergy Friendly news is wonderful to hear!  I wish all Starbucks did this!

We got a drink for my Mother, who is allergic to coffee (I know, so sad).  They made her a wonderful Raspberry & Carmel Hot Chocolate!  No cross-contamination at all! Very happy!

Also got a few other drinks also.  They forgot one ingredient in one drink.  They remade it correctly!

Did have a small problem with an employee who tried to tell us we didn't know what we were talking about regarding ristretto.  We gave up and decided to contact the company so they can be retrained them in that area.

25 minute wait for drive through service!  For a mobile order I placed through the app.  Ridiculous.  When she gave me my drink she asked if it was mine.  I said I hope so.  It wasn't even filled to the top.  About an inch of empty cup.  Avoid this Starbucks.

A great experience here yesterday, and almost every previous visit. This is not my main go-to Starbucks (I live in Edwardsville even though I work in Collinsville) but they don't disappoint. A little bit bigger dining room than E'ville (they should switch since E'ville is usually busier!) but usually clean. The staff is very friendly. Barista yesterday was super patient and very helpful with a non-coffee drinking member of our group. Michah (manager or asst. manager?) is very friendly, too.

I really like this Starbucks, it might just be my favorite Starbucks!  I say that because all of the employees are very friendly and sweet.  I came in dripping wet from the rain and one of the baristas offered me a trash bag so I wouldn't get more wet, how sweet!   This Starbucks is conveniently located to my gym and work so I'll plan to come here again.  They definitely give service with a smile, which goes a long ways these days!  I think I'll choose to come here more often!

Love this Starbucks.  It is very spacious and the baristas are very nice.  They get through a long line fast!! Love the comfy chairs at this location.  And of course the outdoor seating is a plus!  This location has more college students than most due to its close proximity to Webster university.

Let's start with the good! The staff are really friendly, their bakery items (I had a browny) were really good, I didn't have to wait too long considering how busy it was, and got the correct order (although with way too much cinnamon). On the down side I have a few issues that will result in me never returning to this location. I get the logic of being busy and cutting little corners to get customers through the door, but throwing dirty used steamed milk jugs and whatever else that needs cleaning across your clean work space into the sink is gross. Re-steaming milk can get people sick. Not cleaning down the steamed milk spout and pushing through your lines can cause some bad cross contamination and get people sick. When pouring milk into a steamer jug and managing to pour it through your hands somehow you need to learn how to properly pour milk. If your work station is more milk then stainless steel, take the second and wipe it down. When lifting your steamer jug all the different milks are dropping into whatever is sitting there. If for whatever reason I couldn't have lactose I would be one sick person. All this being said, I didn't mention anything to the staff because the barista looked a bit overwhelmed. So I won't go back knowing that if the visible corners are cut who knows what else there is that I didn't notice.  But again, the staff were super nice. :)

I dig this Starbucks. They have huge tables and some are communal tables that you share with others so if you are anti social, don't sit. Baristas are quick and super friendly. I think I saw on the door that they are open until midnight each wk--unheard of!

Stopped in today for a fix before a work meeting nearby.  Service was efficient. Staff couldn't have been nicer.  I was told to have a nice day three times by three different associates in the 5 minutes I was there.  Keep up the great work!

Free standing Starbucks. The parking lot you pull out of is like on a hill, so be careful not to scrape the bottom of your car when you pull out. Basically like any other Starbucks. No problems, and I think they now have free wi-fi. You can also sit outside if you'd like.

Extremely disappointed every time I go to this Starbucks. Because of its prime location it always busy, but the drive thru is terrible. Monotone, unfriendly service and my coffee rarely is enjoyable. I have a simple request, yet depending on who's working... It's always different.

1 Star for this location only because I love Starbucks! I have been to this store several times...after yesterday I will park my car and buy from the Starbucks in nearby Frys, or drive to another location! I'm puzzled as to how a Starbucks store can get their service so WRONG!! 

A few times, I have had excellent service via the drive through usually around 6am. Up until yesterday, I thought the worst store was in the Las Vegas airport. That being said, in the past 3 weeks I have experienced terrible service here on 4 separate visits. Isn't anyone training these people??? 

Yesterday I ordered my coffee from the mobile app (at 2:36pm), when I drove up to the store (a good 15-20minutes later) the drive through was packed but the parking lot was nearly empty, so I parked and walked in. Two or three people were sitting at tables, and I was followed in by an older couple. I walked up to the counter with the sign, 'pick up mobile orders here'. I saw the guy was completing a drink, and I saw my little red cup ready on the counter behind him. I asked him if he could grab my mobile order, not looking up he replied, 'yes'. Even though he walked past my drink several times in the next several minutes to take drinks to the drive-up window, my coffee sat there. Over and over he walked past it to take an order to the guy at the window, then back past it again (this time with two empty hands) to start filling another order. 

I continued to look in the direction of the other guy behind the counter (by the till) who seemed to look my way a few times. The couple, who came in after me, had already ordered and paid, but were now standing at the counter chatting with the guy.

Finally another woman came in, I thought this was a good sign, assuming he would acknowledge her and the other couple would see someone else was waiting behind them. Nope, he just continued to chat with the first couple while the other woman was now waiting. At this point, the guy filling the drinks was done with the order for the older couple. He motioned that he had their drinks, grabbed a cup and began to fill another order!!

Let me say again, I did not stand there 'quietly', I asked a second time for my mobile order, I knew the guy had heard me and he still would not make eye contact. I paced, stood on my tippy toes, looked at my watch several times (it was now 3:25pm). I considered walking out, the whole thing was bizarre, but I had paid for the stupid drink and I wasn't going to leave without it. 

Finally, after the 2nd woman paid, I walked over to the other guy.  He didn't look at me or acknowledge me in any way. I asked him loudly if he could grab my mobile order for me??? He said, 'oh you have a mobile order, you need to go to that counter (pointing to where I had been standing, pacing, etc!! Really buddy...you can't tell me you did not see me there!! ). I explained I had and refrained from commenting on his snarky remark. So he FINALLY handed me my coffee. 

One of the other bad experiences here was about 2 wks earlier. On that day there were literally 5 employees behind the counter. I walked up to the girl filling drinks and asked for my mobile order. She said, 'yes, just a minute', she was not only filling orders but also attending to the cars. She glanced repeatedly at the 4 other employees huddled behind the counter, as if hoping they would help (she was the only one working). I felt sorry for her so I waited assuming she would grab my coffee on one of her trips, nope. 

She continued to fill other mobile orders, (no other customers were at the counter) while glancing several times at the other employees. They were deep in some kind of conversation never looking at her or me. 

Finally, one broke free from the pack, so I walked over to him, he did not acknowledge me, I asked him if he could grab my mobile order. He was rather rude and then I realized he was the SAME Snarky GUY who gave me my order two weeks prior!!! 

I just feel stupid for waiting so long especially after several other bad experiences at this store.
I'm usually happy with this locations service. I particularly enjoy the pike place roast.

Great atmosphere, and great on a rainy day. Employees were friendly. Tables were clean. The employees didn't ask for my name for the order. When it was ready it was just sitting there and I was oblivious to it. But not a big deal since it wasn't busy. I would hope on a busy day they would pay more attention to this important detail. They had free samples of their pastries so that was welcoming.

Slowest most rudest Starbucks in the brandon area. I ordered some tea and it took 15 minutes for them to make it and there were only 4 people in front of me and no only that but when it was my turn to order the lady just stood there and stared at me for a good 15 seconds and then i said hi and then I proceed with my order. Is it hard to greet your customers? I also bought a Valentines day cup and i asked how much it was and she was like "theres a sign. Right. There." Ive applied here 7 times and still winder how this place hires slow rude people. Never coming here again.

I am not that active on this site, however I decided to write a review after the terrible service we had this Starbucks location.   I have to add that I am a gold card member of Starbucks and  I have 2 pounds of their  Thanksgiving blend bought up for the holidays.  

Tonight in route to a meeting in Lakeland, FL, we decided to stop at this location for coffee, water and a snack.    We initially requested a brewed coffee and preferably Thanksgiving blend if they had it.   The lady in the drive thru was very  very short with us and  blurted out  they were no longer serving the Thanksgiving Blend for the season.   We then started to change our  order and before we could finish, the lady cut us off and told us our order total.  We asked for several items  such as muffins,  cookies, snowman cookies etc and  each item we requested they were out of them.  She never made suggestions as to what was available.   She acted as if she was doing us a favor  just by taking our order.     I rarely get too angry with a sales person however tonight I wanted to  to drive off without our order.  However we  followed thru and endured their slow service.   There will be no more stops at this location!

I am so sad right now writing this review. As an old Starbucks employee and now a very true patron it feel like this particular Starbucks has started slacking.  I am hoping it is just a phase they are going through.  Anyways I work nights and I am usually at Starbucks by 10 and they close 11 to get my two ginormous wonderful Trenta iced coffees only for the past week or two they have come out looking like lattes (toooo much milk and not enough coffee!!!) and another night they were out of iced coffee and subbed it out for iced Americano (which is good but so much caffeine it made me sick bc I sucked it down like I do iced coffee).  So two days ago when I was here I asked if they had enough iced coffee because I know it was close to closing time and by close I mean an hour till... I was going to get tea instead to avoid paying for milk instead of coffee (I don't like milk). Needless to say one of the baristas was nice and one was very rude and tried to make me feel like I don't know what I am talking about but I get the same drink multiple times a day.  Phew that is a lot, but I hope their night service gets back to what it use to be!! Pleasant!
The Starbucks is about to lose my daily sometimes twice daily business. Mobile order placed at 11:15 not completed until 1127 too much chatter between employees. They are having a great time!

Eh, it's Starbucks.  They're all pretty much the same.  

The good:  The set-up is nice.  You can sit at the coffee bar.  There are a ton of windows for prime people watching.  Their coffee is consistently so strong you're guaranteed to wake up.

The bad:  It takes an eternity to get a cup of coffee here.  The staff is hit or miss with friendliness.  They've been known to mess up your order pretty miserably.

Not a bad option for coffee but with so many other options in a half block radius I'd recommend checking out some of the more local shops.
First time at this location. Drink was just as it should have been and the staff was pleasant.

I have going to this store for almost two yeas now. They are favorite store in STL. I will go out of way to go to this store. The staff is always so nice even before 6:30AM! They know my name and my order (unless I change it up.) I wish I knew all their names. But each one of those staff members needs an A++ for their smiling faces.

Here you get the expected high quality caffeine fix provided efficiently and with a smile.  Access and parking are a bit cumbersome.  Drive through is busy and therefore clogs up with the short access.  Inside is small. I find cafe style seating inside and outside to be uncomfortably rigid and designed for very brief interludes. Definitely not welcoming to read the paper or leisurely work.  Competition to improve is lacking. No nearby coffee shops except S'bucks at 116th/I-69 which is only slightly better (better outdoor seating & easier access).

I really don't understand it. Of every time I have been to this Starbucks location the staff is so rude, so inconsiderate, so disengaged from their customers it really begs the question that this must be the fault of the management. You ask a simple question and get a reply that might as well come with a snarl and growl. I would avoid this location at all costs (I will be driving out of my way) and go to the location on Oracle and Rudasill just down the road. Hopefully something will change there, because the entire staff should be ashamed of the culture and history that they are letting down. Maybe call this a re-do (part 2) Starbucks and move on!
Don't stop in this drivethru if you're in a hurry! They take forever and mess up orders.
Average Starbucks on south street. Staff was friendly and it has a decent amount of room to sit! I got the smores frap. Deadly but delicious!!

So this is the second time that I have come to this Starbucks and both times they were like snails. I waited in the drive threw for 30 minutes and then when I came inside and waited 30 minutes for a cup of coffee while there was a total of 4 people working. They were talking more then  do anything anything. Will not be coming back!

I met a friend here once a week and the service is always quick but not very personal.  there are so many people here is hard to find a place to sit. Not a good place to work but a great location and fast service.

Dumb butch gave me the limp wrist when I handed him my change cause my broke ass did not have bills. 
I specifically counted and divided my change and verbally told him so it would be a time saver but no of course I'm trying to steal smh

I asked for no ice and these bitches in the back ground laughed.

This place is busy even on a Sunday afternoon.  The staff is amazing at cranking out drinks like a vending machine.  Props to you.  I've never seen a starbucks cranking out drinks like that fast.   The only thing I wasn't very happy with is that the barista made drinks for their friends ahead of the line as a favor.  I think that's cool and all on a normal day.   Well not when the store is super busy and I was in a hurry to get out of that place.    I got a drink only because I was driving by and needed to stop by for bathroom break.   As a courtesy to the store, I bought a drink that I didn't need.   That extra few minutes wait was not cool.

So disappointed. Midnight stop after a TB Rays game. After requesting bold drip, I was told they had no bold. I then asked for a pour over and a second girl told the cashier they were too busy for that (really???? It's midnight! It's not rush hour!!!). Cashier says I'll be happy to brew you a bold coffee, we keep waiting and after some time realize she forgot us, we reminded her we were still waiting. Suddenly we are served a coffee, I ask "Is this bold?" And was told "yes". After getting back on the road I realize I was served old, COLD, coffee that was most likely pike place. Thanks for taking my money and I'm really sorry I gave you a good tip in advance!

Terrible, worst Starbucks experience I have had. 

So I waited in line for 10 minutes, there was one person in front of me and it wasn't busy. There were literally three barista's working on this one persons complicated order. The "customer" was disrespectful and obnoxious and obviously had no self-awareness or regard for anyone else. After I finally was able to place my order, and iced coffee, I was very irritated but knew I would get my drink immediately, because it's an iced coffee. If you don't know, and iced coffee takes no preparation, it's from the pitcher into the cup. 

NOTE: The customer in front of me had the three baristas make *three* of her drinks over. smh

Now commence level two of terrible Starbucks experience. Now I am waiting for my drink for the next 15 minutes. It's a drink that takes ZERO preparation and NO TIME to make. As I receive my drink, the "customer" in front of me gathers her drinks and walks out the door. I ask how in the world this debacle happened, and if the store manager is around. The barista snidely informed me that "customer" in front of me WAS the store manager and that she is now gone. 

At this point there are 16 people in line and now about 12 people waiting for drinks. At NO point did the manager see/perceive this is a problem. Now there are multiple customers, "real customers", complaining about the terrible service. I can understand if the store was busy, I can understand if new baristas are being trained, but I can't understand the store manager allowing this kind of bottleneck and they way she carried herself. 

This is a case of terrible leadership, speaks a lot to the general performance of the store I am sure. I really hope that some regional manager is paying attention. There is health, money, and local reputation on the line. 

One extra note, the store manager spoke very harshly and lacked any respect or professional presence. Even if she wasn't "on the clock", this is tragic to the health and culture of this local cafe.

Has a pleasant ambience, a great place to come talk with a friend or do homework. The variety of drinks offered is impressive, there is always something to get for everyone. Drinks are made quick and always taste delicious. Definitely worth your time to stop in and grab a coffee.

I have a love/ hate relationship with this Starbucks. However, I keep coming back because it is really the only coffee place by my job on the way. They are efficient and fifty percent of the time I can appreciate that. However, if they mess up my order and push me through the drive-thru before I can notice, I have issues. It's not like anyone on the way to work would have time to wait in line and have time to get the drink fixed. I have been over charged for larger drink sizes than I had received (I'm not a regular Starbucks person so I don't have my order price memorized). By the time I pull myself out of my half-awake stupor to try my drink and look at the receipt I am long past the drive thru and in the dreaded abyss of work. However, they usually do not run out of things and they don't try to obsessively upsell you on mediocre pastries. So there's that I guess.

This location is probably the least attractive Starbucks in Indy area. It is small and crowded, unclean restroom, and the interior needs updates or complete renovation. Mostly friendly service but the taste of the drinks is not always consistent. Three stars.

Due to its location in the busy intersection and commercial area, morning coffee pick up can be tough. Parking is abundant but drive thru line is the big issue. The sign is obvious, but most morning customers mindlessly follow the cars in front of them and form the wrong long line that blocks access to parking spots and driveways. Find another location for your Starbucks fix for a better experience.
Prime location and pretty fast service.

Thankful for this starbucks inside the hospital where i work! Very convenient and service is fast considering that they cater to every medical professionals, hospital staff, visitors, patients and students who are in need of starbucks. The baristas are also very warm and welcoming. The only thing I'm disappointed about is that they don't have the tomato and mozarella panini that i love and usualy order at any starbucks. Otherwise, starbucks saves my coffee craving! After all, at the start of every work shift I'd so want to skip, the smell of good coffee is all I need to get through it!

I wish there was a way to give a negative star. How is it possible to be stuck in a drive thru for 40
Minutes and still haven't received your coffee? DO NOT COME HERE !
Drive thru is busy but understandably so as its off the highway.  Had to wait a bit for them to take my order but it moved fairly good after that.  People were friendly.

I am not sure if it is due to the fact that there are so few coffee shops in the area (next closest one to my knowledge is the small Tim Horton's in the Esso station) but this Starbucks location always seems to be busy regardless of what time of day that I go.

The food and drink quality is pretty consistent with other locations that I have visited. The overall quality solely at this location also seems quite consistent regardless of the time of day I go at. They are always well staffed behind the counter and the only real issue I sometimes notice is that the cashiers will ring in quite a few drinks but rarely come over and help the person working that end of the bar once they have dispensed with the lineup.

This is a relatively new location in the area. Getting in and out can be tricky due to construction in the area. There is nice outdoor seating. The interior still smells new. The baristas seem nice, but the last time I came, one lady was instructing a new person on how to make a drink, evidently he has been making them incorrectly and she was getting frustrated. I can understand, and it was probably a good thing that it was a slow Sunday afternoon, and not in the middle of a rush.

My order has never been made wrong, and I like the nice sleek lines of the counters, tables and chairs here. The drive thru line is clearly marked and separated, so there is no confusion about if you are in the line or not, and no way to cut in, which is nice.

I am sure the kinks are still being worked out, it just doesn't seem like they are 100% yet. I am sure they will improve with time. I am so sure that being a barista is not the easiest job in the world, and pretty thankless.

Dear Starbucks, 

Thank you for living on the corner of 9th and South street. You are dependable and comfortable and you boost morale around this part of town. Most importantly you make up for all of the god-awful small coffee houses in the area that I always get suckered into trying. I salute you for being consistently decent. Never change. But seriously, stop changing your menu and make pumpkin flavor a year round thing. Alright, peppermint can join the year round bandwagon too. 

Love always, 
-a devote non-coffee drink drinker.

The employees here treated us so well. We ordered our drinks and the staff noticed my five year old had a birthday shirt on. She asked her how old she was. Then when we were waiting for our drinks one of the baristas gave our whole family free cake pops. They even upgraded our kids drinks to Venti's. Super sweet staff! Other Starbucks could learn from them.

While my experience was good in general, my drink was well made friendly banter with staff was acceptable.  I told the girl @ the counter  1 of my purchases was for a gift, she proceeds to open the package.  I was speechless. Is that STARBUCKS policy?

Writing this review leisurely as I sit in drive thru going on 15 min now. Way too long to wait for a 5$ coffee.

Ok. Update. 25 min. Order was wrong.
Yikes. At least they gave me a free drink coupon.

I like this location. The staff was friendly. They had a fair amount of seating and the place wasn't crowded so it was easy to find a seat- that being said I went mid day during the week. They don't have any fancier seating like some starbucks but I don't mind that. The bathrooms weren't great but they weren't bad either- better than quite a few Starbucks I've been to.

This is hands down my favorite Starbucks in town. I work in the mall and come here at least 3-4 times a week. The staff is all super friendly , they remember my name and my drink order . While they can sometimes get super busy, the staff is great at moving quickly and keeping the line going. Wish there was a little more space inside, but the awesome staff makes up for any size issues.

Not impressed with this location.   3pm on a weekday, busy city corner, drive thru line out of the parking lot,  so I walked inside.   Big mistake.  The cars that arrived after I ordered, received their orders before I did.  Next time, I'll drive the additional distance to get proper service elsewhere.

When has Starbucks ever done me wrong?  Well, today.  

This isn't "my" Starbucks.  I frequent others but was on the West side of town dropping my daughter for a night with her grandma and she requested a vanilla bean frapp. 

We drove thru and I must admit the server/speaker was very helpful, upbeat, and funny.  And thank the sweet lord they had the horizon chocolate milk for the little one or we might have had an issue.

SO, we get our chocolate milk box in a timely fashion but sat waiting for the vanilla frapp for an eternity!  When passed to us I hand it to said daughter and like any smart person she eats the whipped cream off the top first as we're pulling out of the lot.  As we're driving she says..ewww this tastes awful.  She said it tasted like drinking just iced milk.  

So, my issue is just with this locale.  Long wait, and a drink an eight year  old turned her nose up at.
Slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. Read the rest of the reviews this is not only once it's all the time.

Service always good, meets almost all Starbuck's standards - except about NO smoking.  Every time I come here there are smokers outside.  The cigar smokers are the worst.  I've asked store employees but they too don't want to be the smoke police.

The people are great and the coffee is even better. Very friendly people. My favorite is the iced chai tea latte with soy and vanilla and how these guys make it never seems to fail me. Pretty awesome.
Loved how there's a drive thru, but my tall white chocolate mocha with non fat milk, no whip cream was not good.  Does EVERYTHING taste different in FL?  Sigh.
Consistent Starbucks food and great staff. A great place to have coffee and watch the neighborhood regulars. Come here every morning when I am in Philadelphia.
Literally the slowest Service I have ever experienced. 20 mins in the drive thru behind 3 other cars is absurd!
Drive thru is the slowest in the land. Drink is usually right.  The location is really great, with great access to the highway. Don't forget to join Starbucks Rewards for your free drink!
Quick drive through always a great coffee or lattes! Only thing I see is that they need to keep their outside seating clean!!!

The staff at this location is loud and annoying. They are always so busy talking to each other instead of paying attention to what the customer orders. The staff at Ina and Oracle is the exact opposite. They are polite, quiet, and always get the orders right.
This location is great. Parking can be tough but it's well run with friendly staff. Very efficient and cordial.

Beautiful setting, Wonderful coffee, and most importantly beautiful people. This Starbucks has been my go to place for almost a year now, and I absolutely love it. The staff is wonderful and loves to start small conversations with you and the coffee is well prepared. The atmosphere could be better and they could use a few more chairs but overall it's a wonderful place.
It is Starbucks. Coffee is just okay but we don't have many other options in town for a cup of caffeine. Five stars for this location because the workers are always super friendly.

This is my favorite Sbux in town.  They are always friendly, and the drinks are well-made.  The parking lot can be a little treacherous when they're busy...today I parked in front of Snarf's (they weren't open yet) and walked across the drive through line.  Saved myself 20 minutes by getting out of the car and walking my happy a$$ into the building instead - just sit in your cars, people, it makes it that much faster for me.

Also, I love that the building reminds me of a spaceship and has easy access to the highway.

Just horrible. Longest drive through I have EVER been through. Ordered two drinks, pulled up to the window and was handed one drink, then sat at the window for 12 minutes waiting on the second drink which was just a hot chocolate. No apology for the wait either. Absolutely unacceptable. And I saw three or four baristas inside so there's really no excuse. Pure incompetence. Will not be back.

It has only been a few months, but I have noticed a drastic improvement on the speed of service here.  I have continued to use the drive thru and noticed that the wait times have decreased and I haven't had an order messed up in a while.  I don't go inside so I can't rate on that.  I can say the service has improved.

I'm a very frequent Starbucks customer (gold card member:) and I'm on a road trip across America and have stopped in at least 15 Starbucks and this location wins the award for the #1 most grumpy employee. The guy working at the counter was very nice (the only reason I gave a second star was because he was so nice) we bought food, drinks and a mug ($30+ bill) and everything was great until we realized we forgot to ask for an ice water. Daniella could not be bothered. We asked nicely but we were obviously a huge burden on her. First my boyfriend asked and she didn't even look up, so he was going to give up but then I went back to ask and she had a huge frown on her face and I was obviously a huge inconvenience to her. If there had been a crowd of guests and a line I wouldn't have even asked, but there were literally three customers in the store. I waited while she made a few drinks, and then she angrily hands me a tall cup (usually they give a give a grande or even Venti) with no lid, no straw, nothing, with a big frown on her face. I've never once been made to feel like that at a Starbucks until today so I felt the need to share.
Gross. A simple cup of coffee was watered down and burnt. Hands down the worst cup of coffee I've ever had! They had a nice staff but they lacked any knowledge of coffee. Won't be back anytime soon
Very busy.  Good food and coffee as usual.   If you don't mind fighting your way through the drunk homeless sitting out front begging for your change, then it might be worth it.
The worst Starbucks ever! I have no choice but to come to this one, but how have these people not gotten it together! Awful!
This coffee shop was our favorite, however quality of beverage preparation continues to decline. Even with the batista promise.
Using up a gift card for an afternoon caffeine treat. I haven't been to this location in forever. Remodeled and very nice. Tons of space with lots of workspace tables and comfy seats for visiting.

I love this Starbucks. Staff are always really happy and friendly. I have never had an order wrong, never had any issues with service. Overall an amazing store. But... Please put a garbage can in the drive thru!! I always forget to throw out my old Starbucks cups and end up having to put them on the floor in my car :(

We decided to stop in after an afternoon of shopping at the Westfield Brandon Mall. It was a good decision. We wanted to try their new blonde espresso. I think it's a great idea to have two different types of espresso. Most people who complain about the burnt bean taste should really like this smoother version. There is definitely no bitterness. It's actually quite smooth. I had the blonde latte. I thought it was very milky & creamy. I love milk, so I was happy with it. I noticed that you don't need to add as much sugar to the drink. My mother liked her shot of blonde espresso, but she felt that she needed more than one shot. It was gone in one gulp. 

The location is very busy. I give them a pass when it comes to cleanliness. I do think that they may need more staff because the floors and tables needed attention. The garbage bins were overflowing as well. If anything, they just need an extra person to maintain that part of the business. Other than that, the service was great. We were quite happy overall.
Great store. Very clean. Staff wonderful and knows how to make the drinks well! My go to Starbucks when I am in the area!

I come here once in a while because it's close to home. Service is usually friendly. I've been in a couple times since the Holiday Drinks have been out and they have been out if the skinny mocha syrup each time. This is not something that is random.  I have found that they do not always have their products in stock. This can be frustrating when you are expecting a certain specialty coffee. 
Parking is usually limited because of the other businesses around. Drive through is usually pretty easy to get through.  It is always warm and friendly when we go in.
