Love this spot. Staff is friendly and quick. They remember your face if your a frequent flyer to this spot. Great sites if your a "lookie Lou". Clean bathrooms. Huge plus.

This is the 2nd of 4 stores that I am regular customer of since the day they opened their doors. When Ryan transferred from Willow Lake to here I came to this spot too. That is because I know what excellent customer service is and with Ryan there was no second guessing that the rest of the partners at this location would also be hands down awesome; and they are. Over the years some have come & gone but the majority have stayed at this location for years. They all work hard at this store. It is a high volume location with businesses & the interstate being right there. I have been here numerous times watching them as they handle a packed drive through and inside with superior team work. Even if having a rough day they still do the best they can. The ONLY thing that has disappointed me, and other regulars, was when this location was up for a "remodeling" & instead someone at the district office decided to give these amazing partners a shooty "redecoration" of old chairs & cheap table chairs; not to mention the pathetic wiring job for additional outlets.  They deserved way better than they got, in my opinion. But, they, regardless, still maintain consistent positive attitudes and take pride in what they get to have, the customers who they serve, and the opportunities that the company itself provides for them - and that makes them and the store amazing.

I am not sure who did the hiring or training for this Starbucks but for a full new location they have the least professional and trained staff of anyone I have ever been to in America by far. Rude, eating, making rude jokes among the staff, while messing drinks up, then rude again, then even slower than you can imagine at breakfast rush. I go to the other one because it has a way better staff. All this has is parking, that's all.

Starbucks is Starbucks. I prefer the locally owned brews, however in a rush you can't beat the perfect same consistent coffee from Starbucks. Their 2am--2pm treat receipt is a great deal right now. (make a purchase before 2pm then show your receipt after 2pm same day to get any cold grande drink for $2)... And besides the coffee, I am really liking that Berry Hibiscus tea. I can't get enough of that this summer!

The staff is usually friendly & helpful - I had the unfortunate situation to have to deal with a woman named Yonnie - extremely rude & unprofessional!  Stay clear of her unless you want your day ruined.
Friendly staff, fast service and love the layout! All the greatest things you want from a coffee house. Especially if it's Starbucks!

Being located the the Brandon mall doesn't detract from this location at all.  It's your average, run-of-the-mill Starbucks.

During any of my visits, I haven't experienced the slow service others mention.  I guess I've just gotten lucky, or maybe I've just been bumped to the front of the line due to my dashing good looks & charming personality.  I like to think it's the latter of the two. 

This location can get busy, due to the location, but as I mentioned earlier, they do good with herding people through.  Drinks are made with precision, just like I'd expect from any other Starbucks location.  

Overall, the prices are high, but it's a pain to make a Java Chip at home, so I'll keep paying them.

This Starbucks has gone downhill in the past few months.  I order the same items every Sunday morning and for the last 2 months it has been wrong or not ready.  Last Sunday after  writing the corporate office it was finally correct.  It should not take an email to corporate to get an order correct.   I wish there was a different location on my way to church.  This used to be my regular hangout, but not any more.  I do hope later I can write a different review when they improve.
Nothing super special about this place. Had some good tunes going. But typical starbucks. Great location with outdoor seating.

Friendly, helpful staff, fast and efficient, clean and orderly, sugary-coffee-drinks are fresh and tasty--a really pleasant experience. The baristas make you feel like you're a regular, not just passing through a hotel.

This location isn't bad.
Usually the specialty drinks are made well. I've never had a bad drink from this location. 
The drive thru gets ridiculous. Usually long and slow. I would avoid it unless you happen to get there when there's no line.
Everyone seems friendly here, I've honestly never dealt with a rude barista at this store.
The location is convenient as much as it is a pain. Getting out of Regency, unless making a right onto 60 from the side road next to the plaza, is so frustrating. 
Parking is ample, no issues there.
All in all, this is a good Starbucks.
I'm a Starbucks addict with a Gold card since 2007 and a daily trio or 2 everyday of the week so my Starbucks review credibility is good lol
Enjoy!

Serves it purpose when I don't have a Peet's to go to.

Service was fairly friendly. I just needed a pick me up to take on my drive back to SLO after hanging out in Santa Barbara all day. Starbucks coffee is just too weak to ever earn more than an average rating.

Invariably the spottiest Starbucks I have ever been too.  I have had good experiences and bad here but in general with the volume of people, crush of vehicles in an already congested area and mostly disinterested crew this place is officially off the list for me.

Last visit was just plain awful...cashier neglected to give barista the ticket for my beverage so it was never made (and it wasn't even that busy).  Took me about two patrons (my mistake) to realize something was amiss. Was in a hurry and just had them credit my card...no other recompense offered.  But Saturday AM was fine so go figure.

During peak hours do yourself a favor and don't stop here.  As soon as burn thru my remaining gift cards I am moving on from Starbucks.  Another cost increase introduced today also...no thanks.  Plenty of other options available.
This Starbucks is way way slow..... I was disappointed in how long I had to wait. The service however was good - the person I came into contact with was pleasant.
I usually don't like Starbucks, but this one has fat, friendly service and a big outdoor patio with comfortable furniture.

The barista on register this weekend needs lots of training!!!!!! She didn't know how to redeem my birthday reward, which was so annoying.  I just received it at 12am and she just kept saying can't use it until your bday. The SBUX app on my phone, says it's available and it expires on the 28th. She got everyone's order wrong. Her manager came behind the counter eating with food in his hand. He was talking with a mouth full of food and started scolding her for taking food from the back because it was for the next business day. Overall customer service sucked so BAD. The manager on duty made it worse. I'll just wait till my weekday crew is back in effect:/

I used to live in walking distance of this Starbucks, and I truly miss it! Of course,
there are tons of Starbucks to go to, but this one was my favorite. The staff always got my drink right and even remembered my name and my usual order. That always surprises me at such a busy place. 

And that's really the only downside -- how busy they would get, which I know is great for them... But sometimes, I couldn't even find a table and I would have to leave. They did recently redesign their lobby area right before I moved, and I think they might have solved that problem! They are right by Webster U and Nerinx Hall, and when school lets out, it gets pretty crazy and loud, which does suck if you are trying to study. But overall, this is the best Starbucks I've ever been to because of their consistently great staff and service.

This is a small Starbucks located in a shopping center. The staff were friendly and welcoming, also very fast and professional. I decided to go to this Starbucks because it as the closest in my travels and I was in dire need lol! 

I ordered my favorite, the Carmel Macchiato. The barista had pre-made espresso. However, my drink was delicious, and not watered down as I expected since the espresso was pre-made. 

If you're in the area and in need of Starbucks this place is cool to go to! It's cute, small and near other stores/restaurants! It's right next door to Qdoba!!!

Tonight's theme: Social Sunday! I know this isn't a library, but this isn't a bar either. The crew was so loud and disruptive and not because they were calling out orders or anything work related. While they were well outnumbered by patrons, they managed to generate so much more noise than everyone else combined. My friend and I retreated to the old national side for a chat/work sesh which didn't help much. Prior to closing time, one of the workers walked in stating 'just so you know we close in ten minutes' laughed then turned around and walked out. Bizarre to say the least. My friend even commented she wanted to write a letter to mgmt. Think she was still ticked about how long it took to get her hot chocolate and the lack of pastry assortment tonight.

Quaint, quiet, good coffee but no cushy seating and some scattered trash on the floor..

My tall Red Eye is super good though! :)

I travel a lot, and am very happy to be a loyal Starbucks customer nation wide, but I have to RAVE about this location in particular.
 This is my daily Starbucks stop (when I'm in town, of course)
 Amanda is an amazing manager and everyone's smiling faces makes our morning! 
From Patrick, Emily, Chelsea, and Diane we are sure to have great service! These folks are well trained, and aim to make customers happy.
There is no wonder this location has so many regulars. 
You feel like apart of the family when you leave!

Exceptionally poor service. While waiting, 3 orders were made completely wrong, including mine. Staff is unfriendly and very disorganized. Great attention paid to drive-up, while in store customers wait exceptionally long times. Have never seen so many employees in any location so inefficient. Store is in need of major management overhaul. Will visit Panera right down the street next time.

If you like hanging out with people who seem to have no where to go, haven't had showers, hog up the tables all day, then this is an excellent Starbucks.   The staff is nice and friendly.   Wonder why they have pass codes on the restrooms.    Hmm.   Well that doesn't seem to help too much.

it's charbux.  I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. try a local coffee house. been here once only cuz a friend was into it and I wouldn't talk someone out of what they like despite my opinion.  gotta keep you happy
I love Starbucks Coffee!Romantic!Good for family!My wife and my son's say :want to go every evening!

What can you say - it is a Starbucks! The staff is what makes this place so good. They are the best. Always clean and coffee is fresh. Pastries aren't bad for frozen but I wish they had more "non-sweets" available to eat. Coffee is average but their specialty drinks are darn near perfect (try the white chocolate latte). Much better run than the one at SIUE.
PS - if you go in the summer, take a jacket if you plan on staying. Brrrrr!

Hey Yelpers, 

So today I was near this Starbucks and was like yesssssss NO ONE IN LINE for the drive-thru so I went around and just at that chance. Right! I ordered one grande size hot chocolate and one warm cheese danish. I received my total and proceeded to the payment window. We'll 10 minutes later I received my order with a fabulous greeting and my order. I was quite confused because with no one in line I just knew I would be in and out of the drive-thru but it seems as if I should have gone inside to place my order. I'm sure they were having a off moment. But the hot chocolate was warm and the cheese danish was perfect.
And there's only one other Starbucks like it in the Midwest, stop and get that coffee upside down. Yummy every time

I'm on Weight Watchers so I don't waste points on overly sweet espresso drinks too often. But thankfully, Starbucks has a pretty big skinny menu. I worked in a SB before and there is a formula for every drink. Skinny/Light drinks are made a particular way to lower fat and calories. That being said this location almost always has to remake my drink because they just don't HEAR me when I ask for a skinny/light drink. Which makes it take a lot longer. The staff usually seem distracted, frazzled or impatient. I only bother with this store now if I have a gift card, or I just order tea which is pretty hard to screw up

Can't stand Starbucks. The coffee, I mean the actual coffee taste burnt and is acidic. Yes great service but so crowded and dirty often I don't like going in. To be honest If I can't find a nice pour over at a local place or make it at home I'd rather and often do drink coffee at circle K. Kinda love it and for $2 it's a better deal.  Quit saying you like coffee and going to Starbuck. You shouldn't be able
Get diabetes from your coffee drink.  Nuff sed.

Possibly the worst experience I've had at a Starbucks drive thru. There was only one car in front of us, it still took 7 minutes to get to the window. The cashier instead of giving us our drink when we arrived at the window, decided to start taking an order for a car that had pulled up behind us instead, so my  drink just SAT there for a minute. You should take care of your customers whoses  drink has already been ready for almost 10 minutes before taking a new order.
The staff here are impatient and rude. Not really a welcoming Starbucks. I'll try another location next time or a different coffee shop.

I liked to stop by this Starbucks when I was doing some shopping. Some of my favorite Starbucks concoctions:

- nonfat extra foamy misto with sugar free vanilla
- americano with caramel drizzle (the caramel sauce that usually goes on frappuccinos... so rich and gooey!)
- coffee light frappuccino
- green tea frappuccino

A good place to meet up with friends too... yum! I would definitely hit up the local coffee shops as well but have nothing against the ever-reliable Starbucks!
The device is awesome and food impeccable definitely would go here for a quick snack or treat for the kids. Mocha frapp is the bomb

I really hope Yelp doesn't kick me off for reviewing Starbucks. But, to be fair, it's the LOCATION that I am reviewing, and not just Starbucks in general. Let's be clear.

I just love these guys. They are always super duper friendly and I've never had a bad experience. I usually rock the drive-thru (please don't kick me off, Yelp), but the few times I have been inside has always been pleasant. And not just the "Thanks for coming!' pleasant, I'm talking light banter pleasant. I love light banter. Especially when it's done right. And now that I'm pregnant and have a laundry list of a single coffee order, they never seem to judge me. It's ok, I'm judging myself for the grande iced decaf nonfat vanilla latte.

The only reason for the 4 instead of 5 stars is that sometimes their service is a tad on the slow side. But even this is ok with me. Once, when I thought I was having my first bad experience there because the dude was taking forever, it was actually him remaking my drink because he couldn't be sure he'd used decaf. And to top it off, he just gave me the "screwed up" drink in case I knew someone at work that would want it. 

Damn I love these guys at the COLLINSVILLE Starbucks.

Starbucks on South Street. They're a standard Starbucks and the people-watching is good. They've got a couple tables outside and Whole Foods is across the street. Never had any complaints about this place, but I don't get complicated drinks for the most part. Coffee or the salted caramel hot chocolate. Mmmm.

I think it is because we spend so much money for coffee these days (it's amusing to think about the times in the 1920's when you could buy a cuppa joe for 5 cents!) that places like Starbucks, Peets, Blue Bottle and Handlebar are judged on another level: a higher level than most places you can buy an espresso drink or a coffee. This makes sense and this rings true.
My experience with this La Cumbre 'bucks has only been positive.
From the manager to the Baristas and everyone in between the service and interaction between the employees and myself has been pleasant, fast, committed.
There are a number of bad reviews about this place yet i have never received bad service here and i have been here maybe 100 times over the last several years.
I have to be honest and say something that i have been wanting to say here on Yelp for a long time:  you must take control of the service you get in a place in which you are paying good money; particularly when the people behind the counter are young people who are in the work force for the first time.
I say all of this to counteract, even in a small way the bad reviews of this Starbucks in my adopted city of Santa Barbara.
If i have an issue with a 6 dollar cappuccino, i speak up and they will make it over. "They" can like it, they can not like it. Not my issue. I am the customer. I am the one paying. Typing this here it does sound a little harsh but in reality, is it really? I am polite yet firm. 
In any event this Starbucks unit is one of my faves along with that in La Canada, Studio City and the drive thru in south Glendale.
The people here are, once in a while mesmerized by the beauty of SB, the beachiness, the surfer-like paradise and the loveliness of the land  but a little firmness in how you order and how you react to bad service goes a long way. I mean paying $2-5 plus for coffee is a serious thing.

Best Starbucks customer service ! This is the first time I come to this location and the stuff members are awesome ! We went through the drive-through and the girl on the speaker understood my fiancé accent , he usually always struggle , also the lady at the window was very nice and caring! I really liked coming here !

This is my go-to Starbucks when I have a lot of work to get done and need a good environment to work in. 

Compared to a couple other Fishers Starbucks locations this one is a little smaller in square feet but seating is more ample in my opinion, I've yet to have problems finding a spot to set up shop. 

The staff is always super friendly and take the time to notice regulars. I have never had a negative service experience at this location personally nor have seen anything negative with other patrons, even considering I've spent multiple days working in front of the counter for 12+ hours. I'm impressed.

Coffee is coffee, Starbucks quality coffee across the board. 

Pro-Tip: Bring an extra layer if you get cold easily. During the day and especially as the night goes on, it can get pretty chilly inside (which is nice on hot days).

You have to walk here...there's no way to park, cars wrapped around building into the street, it's actually dangerous. If you sit in the car line, dodging and moving back and forth to let cars try to leave after getting their order, your patience is rewarded with standard fare. Park across the street and or at the cleaners, run through the crazed soccer moms and locals angry over the long vehicle line and you get a cozy, well staffed Starbucks with nice outdoor seating. Loses two stars for the risk I took to enter on foot.

Don't go to this Starbucks. It sucks. The decor is nice but it's always super packed and the baristas do a very crappy job with your drink. Not only that but they don't have some of their advertised drinks in stock -_- I ordered a grande caramel macchiato and I opened the lid because it felt lighter than usual and yes it was not a "grande" probably just a tall in a  grande cup...to top it off it looked really gross. Go across to the street to beyond bread or anywhere else

We received quick service inside, but there was no one else ordering at the time, so no surprise there.  My order was made correctly, as to be expected.  The place was pretty full of college students even though we were there on a weekend during summer break.  The drive-thru is always packed.  There is very limited close parking.  The outside patio and tables were clean.
Very friendly very fast.Great customer service,

This location is probably my favorite location so far.
For being in the heart of Downtown St. Pete, it is never overly-crowded, which I definitely appreciate, seeing as I'm usually needing to sit down and do some work.
I'm not sure if it's because of my purple hair (it probably is), but the staff seems to remember me, which just gives this place a home-y kind of feel. 
As for the menu, it's standard. Just like every other Starbucks. 
The reason I go to this Starbucks instead of any of the other locations in St. Pete is because it is clean and a friendly environment.

This Starbucks was quite clean and pretty. There's a gorgeous landscape painting by the restroom and plenty of Starbucks objects to buy on the shelves. Not a lot of sandwiches or wraps to buy though. There's other Starbucks with bigger displays featuring more foods on their menu and display cases. The waitresses attitudes were a bit rushed and they could have heated my family's coffee a bit more. My chai tea was hotter than their coffee. The chai tea was delicious though! I loved how I could add chocolate, cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla to my drink myself! The little bar had those powdered ingredients ready to add. The people in there seemed a bit older than the average clientele at Starbuckses. Overall it was pretty good!
This location deserves 5 stars, but it is always so busy that it takes 15 minutes to get your order. The baristas are always fantastic and on point so if you can spare the time, treat yo self!

I'm not a big Starbucks coffee fan but frequent this location for mommy coffee dates. They have a nice big center table that's wide enough the people across from you don't bother you at all. Their pastries are fresh and we enjoy them. Staff is friendly and can move a line very quickly. Also there's normally no trouble finding parking.
Great little place tucked away. If you are in the Trenton area don't bother going to any other Starbucks this is the one.
Convenient location and efficient service despite how busy they are. My most-visited Starbucks, by far.

This location is very hit or miss with their service and quality.   

I have had them not get my order correct a coupe of times and the person taking orders/at the window acting like they wanted to be anywhere else but there and the drive-thru line takes forever to get through!  

However, when you catch them on a good day, they are awesome! I was only in Tucson for 7 days (and literally went to this location every single day because my family members live off Cortaro Farms), but on the day that Rebekah (and a guy whose nametag I wasn't able to see) worked, not only did I get my sconed warmed up (like I asked), I got a correct order and total and smile at the window.  So this place can be a crapshoot, but it was the closest location to me during my stay and proximity to a caffeine fix takes priority! 

Footnote: They were just renovated!

Horrible, I was told what I said, which is not at all what I said, then get to the window to be belittled by Theodore. I've gone here everyday for the past 3 weeks and have ordered the same drink, and was never treated or talked down to like I was today. Never again. Goodbye Starbucks

The only reason I'm giving this Starbucks a 2 is because the drive thru people are amazing and they never make my drink wrong at drive thru. BUT I have went inside a total of 4 times and without fail EVERY TIME they have made my drink wrong and forgotten to put vanilla syrup in the Americano.

Thank heaven for mobile ordering and the fact that now I just get coffee from other locations instead of this one.

Poor layout. And how do you run out of your signature pumpkin spice syrup? Not one of their better locations. I hope they consider some improved operations.  I go to Starbucks for consistency. If they can't do that they have little to offer. We have awesome independent coffee shops in the city, I'll be spending more time there going for forward.

I'd like to add to the poor customer service reviews at this location.   Four people behind the counter - I couldn't get acknowledged as even existing let alone as someone who wanted to spend money and leave a tip.

Went two days this week, once inside, once through the drive through. Both times, equally slow. I'm trying to get my gold star before the new ridiculous policy takes place-this location is on my way to work but it looks like I need to search for a new one. I don't have 15 extra mins to waste in a line or a drive through.
Love my frappuccinos... Great fast service very friendly through the drive thru.. Love being a gold member... Get free stuff...

First my Venti Strawberry Acai refresher was way too sweet so I had to have a do over.  After consuming my beverage out side while Checking email, I walked back in to ask for the code for the restroom and the dumb clerk said " it was for customers only" !!! Really a dumb comment blondee!! I see microaggressions are alive and well in the Lou.
Top notch baristas. This store is great. It is really small and gets overwhelmed at time but the staff is friendly and well trained. They make a great cup of joe.

I am giving this Starbucks location 4 stars due to the fact that their parking lot is extremely small and congested. If you have a huge truck, good luck! However, the lack of parking has not deterred the employees here from doing their job and doing it well. The employees are quick, efficient and polite. On a rare occasion, they will confuse your lemon pound cake with a lemon drop but they are quick to fix the issue with a smile. Notice that I did say that occurrances like this are RARE. Even in the morning, the employees at this location are always willing to assist you. In all, these location is amazing.

This is one of the slowest sbuxs I have ever been to. They frequently mess my order and never repeat the drink order back to you. I go out of my way to go to the sbux at 71st and Binford because they are amazingly quick and so efficient.

We are out visiting family in Florida and maybe we are just used to speedy service being from Los Angeles but my goodness was the service sooo slow. We spent 35 minutes in the drive thru. Never have I seen a Starbucks drive thru so slow. No apologies for the wait. The staff inside were moving like they were on tranquilizers. So glad we don't have to go here again.

I come to this Starbucks pretty often only because it is 5 minutes from my house and I enjoy studying in Starbucks' environments but this one... yikes. My 2nd to last visit I was there for roughly 4 or 5 hours studying and I visited the restroom about 3 times. Nobody cleaned it once. There was black piss marks on the floor, no toilet paper and a safety pin sitting on the tp holder. For 5 hours!! My most recent visit, there is hardly nobody else in line besides me, and I order my coffee and a water cup. Water cup never comes... how hard is it? Another thing, me being quite a regular, they could at the least recognize me in some sort of way OR pronounce my name correctly, but no again. And lastly, I once forgot my wireless headphones which I had plugged into the outlet closest to the creamer station, where I was sitting, left the store about 15 minutes before close, forgot my headphones but it was too late by the time I remembered to go back as they were closed, then called first thing when they opened the next day and they "didn't have them". Now, yes in the 15 minutes between me leaving and then closing some stranger could have seen them and taken them but my money is on one of the employees who did it. Hire new people, the ones now suck.

I love coffee. And Starbucks is always a good choice. 
Something I really love is in the summer the occasionally have 
Dog treats for your companion. And it's what makes this location a high favorite.

Pros:
 - Baristas are super awesome and very helpful when it comes to drink choice!
 - Very quick service.
 - Clean.
 - Stable internet.

Cons:
 - Limited parking space.

Notes:
 - Be careful not go up the hill to fast so you do not damage your car.
 - Be careful parking, great deal of traffic in that small little area.

Friendly and pleasant employees. We are on a road trip so the mobile ordering has been our standard way to order. Sometimes the employees can be very rude about it or just flat not have even started on our order by the time we get there. That was not the case at this location.
So small inside. The staff are very indifferent,  we are in plant city people, no room for snobbery!

Love this Starbucks location!

I work and live near this one and they always do their best to keep it CLEAN (including tables, chairs, etc) and the decor is really relaxing.  Even when they closed for repairs/redecoration, they opened up a tent location right outside so that you could still order whatever you wanted from their typical menu!

The staff has been there for a while and knows me as a regular.  They don't burn the soy and I love getting my lattes from there.  The food is well-cooked/heated.

The place is usually packed but I can always find a seat either inside or outside.  There are always Starbucks-related products there and the shelves are straightened and products are stacked in a way that makes you want to approach them.  All price signs are visible.

Drove thru for some tasties.  I think they forgot to put syrup in my macchiatto.  :(  Still she managed to get our complicated order right and they were quite Efficent.  It is Starbucks what is not to love?

I am giving this Starbucks location one star for their lack of humanity. Here is what happened:

As I am waiting for my drink at Starbuck's on this cold Winter's night, in walks an old man who needs to use the restroom. I sense his need was urgent. And being that it was late virtually all of the downtown establishments were closed. So the counter gal tells this kindly looking old man that if he buys something that she can give him the key to the restroom.

I am aghast and speechless at this incredulous lack of humanity (obviously a store policy that the gal felt compelled to enforce). The man quickly says that his companion will buy something. His companion, a young man, possibly his grandson, begins thumbing through his wallet for money. Just then the counter gal tells me that my credit card did not go through. I come around the counter again to pay and I see the young man looking through his wallet still. I thought he did not have money so I told the gal that they are with me and to let the man use the bathroom.
Then the young man says, "No, it is ok. I would like to pay for your order." He hands me a gift card. My order was $10.10! He goes on to say, "it's worth it as long as he gets to use the bathroom." I was incredibly touched by this young man's compassion, so concerned for his companion that he would pay without hesitation $10 to Starbucks so that old man could use the facility. Then he wished me a Merry Christmas. This young man blessed two people that night with his compassion: His grandfather and me. 

As for Starbucks, you need to change your store policy. I will never shop at this location again.

This is a great Starbucks branch that I feel flies under the radar. Yep, it's in the Acme and there isn't any seating or Wi-Fi. However, the staff is really nice and there are never any lines so you get to have a coffee and be on your way in minutes. They also run occasional promos for free sandwiches and whatnot that regular branches don't offer. That's a nice bonus. 

Another reason that I occasionally like to pop in here is to go old school and get a paper and lotto tickets. That's something I used to do all the time when I lived in the city, but never do out here in the sticks. Man, I really miss bodegas. There's nowhere to get papers and lotto anywhere near me, but Acme hits the mark in that regard, plus you get an in house Starbucks to boot. Not too shabby. 

The only negatives I can think of are that you can't redeem free drinks from the Starbucks app and you can't order in advance. If you need that functionality youll have to stick with the main Newtown branch. Other than that though, there's alot to like about this Starbucks.

This is a great little coffee spot across the street from one of my favorite restaurants in Indy. There's plenty of parking, and huge windows to let the sunshine in and make the space feel a bit more open. It can get a bit crowded, but honestly what spot that has free wi-fi isn't? Super friendly baristas too! If I was still going to IUPUI, I'd probably be here weekly.

THIS IS THE S L O W E S T STARBUCKS EVER!!!!!!! I've never experienced anything like this ever. And what makes it worse is that the employees didn't seem to be concerned as if this was the norm for good customer service. I will never go back...but on a positive note my macchiato was great lol :)
Great service! Kinda my first time by myself and the lady was patient!! I was nervous but went well and my order was amazing! Will be going again soon

The staff here is very friendly and efficient.  Love the outdoor seating in the loop.  Sounds odd, but their decaf coffee is best tasting (pike).  I order a Pike half decaf and it is consistent tasting every time while other stores are not.

Smallish inside and no wifi available. 

The drive thru is PAINSTAKINGLY slow. I've been through it a handful of times, and am writing this review as I sit in the line. It's been ten minutes and I've moved forward three car lengths. This seems unacceptable, especially at 4:30pm on a Wednesday.
Used the mobile app for ordering and they forgot the Carmel syrup. Thought the app would save time but not when they can't get your order right

This is a good Starbucks, super clean and very bright. People are almost always friendly. The drive-through line tends to move along slowly, same as the internet. If there are more than 3 people inside using the internet, don't expect to get online. Otherwise, grab a comfy chair and read a book or meet a friend.

It's a Starbucks. It's in the loop. The door is in a weird place on Lealand - so that's kind of awkward - but whatever. Staff is nice. 

If you can't get street parking in front, there's a huge lot in the back.

This is the best coffee shop in Nashville. The crew here knows what they are doing; they'll take good care of you. They are fast, courteous, and service-oriented. They make good coffee, always fresh, always hot. 

It is worth your while to make your way over here for the best coffee in town. It shares parking with several shops, so just grab a spot in the garage behind the building, and come in the back door.

Out of cold brew at 930am, out of grande cups, and extremely slow service (almost ten minute wait) considering it was not very busy and all I got was an iced coffee. The fact that this establishment is part of the Starbucks franchise is beyond my understanding.

This is a very convenient location. 24 hours and right off the interstate should make for a great spot but this spot is plagued by long drive through lines and inefficient staff. Add to that the issue with backup onto the road and it makes for a bad experience. The coffee, once finally received is usually pretty tasty but they are lucky no competition has moved in here.

Worst Starbucks ever. I stood there for several minutes before I was even asked if I needed something. You can watch the employees and see they don't even talk between themselves.  The mood is very depressing. Take my advice and drive a few more miles to a Starbucks that cares about their customers.

This is my Starbucks home, and I've never had a bad experience. If there's ever an issue, they happily take care of it. (Like with anywhere, sometimes things happen.) For instance, they were out of my preferred pastry recently so I opted for another, and they not only refunded my money on the ones they ran out of, they gave me my second choice for free! I'm not sure where the barista went that automatically knew my order when I walked in, but I'm always treated well and with friendly service. I can always count on this location!
Longest wait time ever. Took almost 30 mins to get 2 iced coffees. Line doesn't move at all. VERY SLOW. Avoid drive-thru

This Starbucks always gets the simplest orders wrong. I order a venti iced caramel mocha with no whip cream. It came with whip cream and tasted like milk. This is not the first time they have messed up my order. There is another Starbucks on US 301 that is much better.

It's convenient to have a Starbucks drive-thru on my way to work, but the wait can be pretty bad in the busy morning hours. I can't comment much on the staff or the feel of the inside because I only stop by the drive-thru@this location.

I have to defend my neighborhood Starbucks. I frequent this location (as seen by my somewhat embarrassing 21 check ins here...) and I have yet to have a negative experience. For the first few weeks they were open, I would come upon no one in the drive thru and I would feel like a VIP, zipping through quickly. Even now, since the word has gotten out that there is a drive thru Starbucks in Midtown/Downtown, the wait in the drive thru is minimal. 
The baristas are friendly and knowledgable and they serve my coffee and food as expected. I especially like the friendly girl with the braces. She is rad. 
So, there, Starbucks Downtown, you have been rightfully defended (my work here is done).

This was the first time I've ever come to this Starbucks, but I will be sure not to come back. The poor barista working was left all by herself while her partner was in the back doing who knows what. While they weren't incredibly busy, the woman before me had placed a rather large order. The barista then called her partner out from the back for some help. He asked what drinks he could get started on for me and my friend. I placed my order for an iced green tea latte and he gave me the wrong size. There is quite a size difference between a grande and a venti but the price difference is small so I'd much rather have the venti and get the bang for my buck (considering more than half of it is full of ice anyway).  Then he hands me the cup which is basically milk that he threw the matcha powder on top. He did not mix it at all and handed it to me. The girl barista quickly pulled the drink back and said "Umm this needs to be mixed" but by the time she said that be had already run  to the back room.  He definitely was not a trainee, I would have had patience for that. He was just in a rush, depite the fact that there were no customers in line behind me. I honestly would have rather waited a few more minutes to have the woman barista serve me than to have this guy. He made me feel as if I was wasting his time and an inconvenience to him.  Overall I'm a bit disappointed because the store itself is nice and the woman barista was nice, but the other barista really set a bad first impression for me.

Understaffed and extremely slow. Don't come here if you're in a rush.. This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. The lines are always long and slow to get through and the baristas show no sympathy when you do eventually get to the front. I only go here when I'm in no rush and extremely desperate for a coffee

Now Downtown Reno, only has one Starbucks and off south Virgina street and when you exit you can only go one way, what a pain in the but!

That being said, I like hot coffee and they are best of all the Starbucks when it comes to hot coffee!

Doesn't matter what time of day the coffee is always hot and the people are on top of their jobs!

In March 2014 I rated This Location a 4 due to no food only Drinks today I go in sane thing as I Left I asked a blonde headed woman when was the best time to get a sandwich her response was we are very busy here, i asked the same question she said it's best to get here before 12 noon I said wouldn't it be better to order more sandwiches her response was No its supply and Demand..I said well I'm asking for a sandwich she said come before noon. I laughed and said if I'm ever here at that hour I'll stop back thru..

After getting only a few hours of sleep, I definitely needed coffee before my early morning shift at work. I ordered 3 drinks: a Venti passion tea lemonade for a coworker, and a Venti hot caramel macchiato and a quad shot with a splash of cream for myself. Having previously worked at a Starbucks, I understand the feeling of having to open and deal with grumpy people coming in to get coffee, so upon receiving my drinks, I left a $5 tip and thanked them greatly for working so early and being so cheerful. After only a 5 minute drive to work, I found my quad shots were almost ice cold, and my HOT caramel macchiato only seemed like slightly warm milk and there was no taste of espresso or caramel in it.

I am not sure who did the hiring or training for this Starbucks but for a full new location they have the least professional and trained staff of anyone I have ever been to in America by far. Rude, eating, making rude jokes among the staff, while messing drinks up, then rude again, then even slower than you can imagine at breakfast rush. I go to the other one because it has a way better staff. All this has is parking, that's all.

Has not gotten any better at all. Sigh worst Starbucks ever.

I don't make it to Starbucks often, but when I do it's usually this location.  Every time the staff is very friendly and helpful.  A few weeks ago my friend and I went in here in the evening.  I asked the cashier to recommend a drink that had little or no milk, and she quickly made a suggestion.  Trusting her, I ordered what she suggested, and it was very tasty!  Now....I just wish I remembered what it was called.  ;)

Worst Starbucks ever, staff ignored me when I had a problem with my order. In fact worse looked at me at the register and turned their back on me and continued to talk. All I wanted was to buy the banana nut bread I had asked for and they did not add to my order.

I stop here when I'm on the North side of town for work. What I noticed the last few times I've gone through the drive through is how fast it is. Yesterday I didn't even have my credit card ready. And the girl had my coffee in her hand! Usually at the Starbucks by my house I can sit in line forever.   I'll stop here whenever I have to be in Carmel

I don't hit up this location often, but I mobile ordered dinner. I needed to pick up something quick so I decided to try a chicken sandwich and get some tea since it was cooler outside. 

I know this is a busy location, so I mobile ordered. It was ready when I got there, which was great. The sandwich was hot and the tea was double cupped so it would not be too hot on my hands.

I had a chicken pesto sandwich and honestly, it wasn't that good. This is the second hot lunch/dinner sandwich that I have tried and I would not get either again. I usually just come to Starbucks to get coffee but occasionally I need to get something to eat. When it comes to food, I will be sticking to the breakfast sandwich that I like, and the bakery items.

The tea was perfectly brewed.

So slow. I have been here a few times over the years and every time I remember why I try to avoid the exit 19 Starbucks. They could care less about customer service. If you get in the drive through and there's only a couple of cars, don't be fooled. It will take 20 minutes. Today, I finally got to the window, I paid, and then she disappeared- almost forever. I could see my drink sitting on the counter. I just stared at it for an eternity. Pure torture.

I have a love/hate relationship with this Starbucks.... 

Hate: I get anixety in the drive thru... the line is crazy and unorganized and I hate getting so mad when people dont follow the proper "drive thru" etiquette. It makes me want to ram into people sometimes which I really dont think is a good way to start off the morning. 

Love: I mean... its Starbucks and its a drive thru... need I say more? Plus... the morning road rage really wakes me up and the long lines does give me a chance to check my email/groupon/yelp/facebook.. yes the line is that ridiculous. 

I do go here every morning so I guess it can't be that awful.. sometimes when the line is crazy they do give drinks for free.. which is nice. 

Need a new drink? Try .. iced coffee.. non fat milk.. sugar free carmel... its good, low fat and cheap (if you consider $3 every morning cheap for coffee).

the latte was the worst I've ever had in my life..  . I don't normally frequent starbucks but for a chain they make somewhat decent coffee... . 
I even got 2 shots and it still just tasted like milk

Everyone knows what Starbucks offers at this point, so I am comparing this location to others.  The parking lot parks four cars and is super cramped so you will most likely need to find parking on the street or one of the neighboring lots.  It was impossible to get a seat and the people that were there looked like they were camped out.  There was literally a knitting club there that had earmarked about 20% of the store's "real estate" to sit and chat and knit.  Very annoying since I just ordered a Chai tea and had no place to sit. The person who served me was polite enough but if you are looking for a place to sit head down the road to the Starbucks in the Kohl's shopping plaza - - better energy and lots of seating.
Turned in my empty smumatra bag for a free tall coffee.  no room for cream i said, i want every free drop. Thanks.

SERVICE Rocks!!

Stopped at this Starbucks location after checking into the Hampton Inn just a few blocks own 34th Street and my wife wanted an Iced Soy Latte. 

Despite being close to 4 pm the store was crowded but the line moved very quickly. The gentleman working the counter was super friendly and helpful, they did not have any dark roast brewed and I ordered a Pike but he virtually insisted he would make any pour over I wanted. I ordered a Sumatra and he had it ready for me very fast while keeping the rest of the line moving. 

Very clean, well organized and comfortable store and SUPER clean including the rest rooms. 

If every Starbucks was like this I would be a regular!

Ew. Inside was decent, but the outside area smelled like urine and there were multiple people walking around barefoot or sleeping in the chairs. I sat down without realizing that I was actually sitting in a chair that stank of  dried pee. Never going back there.

I'm a dyed in the wool Starbucks devotee and I love this one. Many seating options (I love the upholstered chairs). This is a deep store so not all seating is chilled whenever the door opens on a wintry day. Staff members are pleasant and efficient with a sense of humor (when I can't see what's right in front of my face).
This Starbucks is amazing. Is always friendly and kind I highly recommend coming to visit location they will take good care of you

It's not like everyone here is nice or everything they make tastes the same all the time, However I found that from going to a million different locations of starbucks as a big fan, They are the best one. some staffs are extremely friendly and some are just ok. and their coffee tends to taste different depend on how busy they are.
How do you review Starbucks? This one is the same as all the others, except that it shares space with a bank. The drive-thru is busy, but it moves pretty fast.

They refused to give me a cup of hot water today even though I have gotten hot water here many times before. They said it is company policy because they some customers get burned by it. I asked how that was different than giving someone hot tea and they had no answer for me. Very disappointed. Usually Starbucks employees are very reasonable but they wouldn't budge.

Good service...inside moves faster than the drive-thru in the AM. They make some of the better Chai Tea Lattes. But my reason for three stars is that they are consistently out of the Petit Vanilla Bean scones by 8 am! I can understand being out around late morning, but 8 am? Stock more, people!

I really don't like this Starbucks. They take forever, when the one just up the street on 82nd doesn't have a problem getting my coffee out in less than a minute. I just don't think it should take 15 minutes to get my coffee.
This place has the A/C on freezer cold. Bring a sweater. Everything else seems normal.

Dana is so awesome! This Starbucks has the best customer service! Made our drinks perfect! Cute little location in down town saint Pete, walking distance from the peir, defiantly stop in and get a cold drink while walking around!

With locations in Tucson being so diverse, I have descriptors for each Starbucks.  The swanky starbucks.  The shoebox starbucks.  The hallways starbucks.  The metallic starbucks.  The dark starbucks.  The light starbucks.

This Starbucks is fairly busy and you probably have to park in the adjacent bank's parking lot.  This Starbucks is mostly brown and warm-toned with mostly one big square table and a few awkward for more than one person tables.  Drinks are pretty good, but since there are drive-thru customers, the staff can get frazzled.  Once you wait for your drink and get it, it's tasty though.

normally I do not go to any Starbucks but I am meeting a friend here and I've checked the place out and it seems to be ran pretty smoothly the staff was friendly and courteous.

 I think the only thing that needs some help is the bathrooms and they should probably open the canopy covers outside because it's Florida and is about a hundred plus degrees outside other than that it's a great little spot to relax

A Starbucks with a drive-thru gets an automatic four stars from me, and then I start deducting from there. I can see that this Starbucks would get really busy because it's in a prime location, but my visit was quick and efficient, and I visited during a workday in the morning.  

Getting to the drive-thru can be a little confusing. For best results, enter from Girls School Road, not 10th Street!

Coffee is good, the service is great. This is my Starbucks ..
I'm not too impressed with their la boulange pastries. They are small, over priced, and not an improvement over their original pastries.

This is a great Starbucks location! Different seating options (sofa, tables, bar stools), Clover brewing for signature "Starbucks Reserve" coffee from around the world, free wifi and a drive-thru. On top of that, nearby eating options make this the perfect place to sit down and have a drink after your meal (if you don't want to eat at Starbucks, that is). Definitely recommended. Oh, and since they brew Starbucks Reserve, they also have reserve coffee bags for purchase.
Never have I been to this Starbucks and been served in an adequate amount of time. Either there is not enough Starbucks to service this area or this one in particular is severely understaffed.
Does it get any better great coffee and books? Standard Starbucks fare and good staff.
Consistently received drinks that don't taste right or that are not made the way I order them. Always disappointed in this place.
Nice location on a Sunday morning. Friendly helpful staff and spacious layout. A full range of pastries snd sandwiches are available. Ample parking too.

Nice little location by the Eller house. Staff seemed a bit new and explained my drink selection (French vanilla latte) is usually three shots of flavoring, and asked me how I wanted to split the hazelnut and vanilla shots. Which I thought was weird, but what do I know.  The latte was lacking, which is why I knocked the one star off. I found a table and used wifi for work and making work calls and it was easy.

Nice drive-thru which was great when staying in the area on vacation with our dog. Also, looks like this location has nice outdoor seating, but we didn't get to use it since we were on the run to see family each time we stopped in here.

Horrible experience. My friends and I came here as it is a new location. The place is infested with flies. The young workers there are extremely rude and offer NO customer service. The girl with long braids was on the phone the whole time, and waited to make our drinks. It probably took 10 mins for her to even just START making the drinks. Is she that mindless?  The boys were just chuckling to themselves having a good time. Very poor service, extremely poorly trained staff. Our lattes tasted awful too. No surprise there. No grown adult was around. These kids should not be working there. Where was the manager? The girl had no name tag, what is her name? She should NOT work anywhere. I refuse to come back to this location. If Starbucks keeps hiring these lazy people, I'll get coffee elsewhere. 
Read the other reviews, and change. 
Seems like management is lazy as well. What a shame!

Everytime I come in the baristas are having a fun time working. All are nice and polite, if they take too long to get your order out they are very apologetic and will sometimes even give you a free drink in them!

Starbucks is about at typical and predictable as it gets.  This location is nice, clean, pretty spacious, the drive thru is always speedy, the staff is always happy to serve you (even at 6:45 am- I don't know how they do it).  My drink almost always tastes the same- which is nice when a tall skinny vanilla latte is a staple in my diet during days when I have more tasks than time.  

If you're in the Brentwood/ Rock Hill area, this is the Starbucks I'd reccommend.  The one on Brentwood Blvd is kind of a logisitcal nightmare in terms of getting in/out and finding a place to park.  

Also, DO NOT order the new Vanilla Spice Latte.  It tastes like your grandmother's perfume.  It's bad... really bad.
Excellent baristas! A lot better service than usual. Very knowledgeable of their products and very helpful. Thanks guys!

This is my favorite Starbucks in Indy! 

The baristas are always so happy and pleasant, and typically produce stellar drinks.
Great Starbucks. Quick and friendly service. Clean bathrooms.

Usually pretty fast and I have never had any problems here. 4 stars for a Starbucks doesn't ever make much sense, but this is the most convenient drive through when I find myself driving a lot during the work day. That means I end up coming through this drive through pretty regularly. With that regularity, you would expect at least one issue. Never ever! 

McDonalds next door is constantly slow, but these workers must actually be drinking that coffee they are brewing, and even if the McDonald's workers are, that stuff just is not of the same quality, I don't are what the commercials say. The staff is fast and friendly. 

Whether it is a White Chocolate Mocha Frappe with extra shots of espresso or just a regular coffee with cream and some espresso shots, it will do the trick and it never takes long.
Despite the fact that this place is insanely busy the staff is cool and makes a good cup

Starbucks is always amazing! My only complaint is how busy this location is because it is the only drive thru in the area. Sometimes the line is all the way in the street in the mornings and I have waited as long as 20-25 minutes to go through a drive thru. However, that is not the workers fault! They go as fast as they can.

For a Starbucks, this location is one of the best. I've been frequenting this location for a couple years now, and they are quite consistent with making the drinks good. The baristas are all very friendly, there's a fair amount of seating, and the place is kept clean. It's really my favourite Starbucks on the south side!
This location saddens me, it's always gloomy and drab. They really need an update! And brighter colors on the wall. They are by the beach after all.

A busy Starbucks location with a small seating area. I like this location as it's large south facing windows make it warmer than many of the overly air conditioned stores. Sunny south facing patio often has nice flower pots. Standard Starbucks fare with efficient staff.
This is a wonderful Starbucks. Only one with a drive thru anywhere nearby. The employees are second to none. Especially Dan. He's the MAN! Only problem is it's slower than most.

One of the lady was wonderful! Seem like she says "you can make it anyway you want"...something like that phrase, customizing the drinks. I was having a disappointing day, but she brighten it back up. =D . One person can change a bumming day to a great day.

Not a very good location. The music was playing really loud which made it hard to talk. The tables were pretty dirty - I had to wipe mine down before using it. Also, when I placed my coffee order the staff wasn't friendly - they weren't rude but just kind of grave and serious. I'm getting coffee not ordering a coffin!! I'd go back cause it's conveniently located in one of my favorite malls but not cause of the service or cleanliness...

Although I find the adjoining space next to old national bank a bit peculiar, it definitely helps to open up the space and provides more seating options. Just seems like a security risk having a bank wide open and exposed like that but that's just the "what if" analyst in me. Nice spot to get some work done and it wasn't as noisy as other locations I've been to. 

But what gives about the limited hours the blonde roast is available? Is this a morning coffee only? Menu is a bit misleading I must say :/ Kinda like Jimmy Johns still listing sprouts on the Turkey Tom 'which. False advertising but I digress. Caffeine + wifi= productivity!
Love this Starbucks! I often stop by here on my way to work, they are always fast, friendly, and my drinks are always perfect and delicious!
Service today was horrible.  The weekend staff at this store have consistently been horrible.  My coffee order was correct but did not taste correct. .  They were very light on the mocha.

Five star for quick accurate service.  The cashier handed my croissant to another employee who heated it for me, so it was ready when I was done paying.
  A third employee made my tasty specialty coffee- yummy after 4 hours of traffic from SoCal.   Quick, accurate coffee making!

Terrible location!! I go yesterday after opening and order the Pike Place, their most popular coffee. I'm told they don't have any brewed. Okay, I get another coffee that's strong. I go today at 4:58 am, they open at 5:00 am. I expect to wait at the door for 2 minutes as SB usually opens the doors within seconds of the opening time. A woman comes to the door and tells me that they open at 5:00 but they don't have any coffee brewed, so it will be about 5 more minutes. She had no intention of letting me in. I commented that perhaps they should have started the coffee 3 minutes earlier, a time that will allow them to sell at the opening time. I leave and go to a SB 5 minutes away. The SB that I went to had the Pike Place ready, at 5:04 am!!! This SB is 1 block from my hotel. I will not be back. It's a new SB, so I suggest that someone in management tell them what "open at 5:00" truly means. It doesn't mean that the lights are on and the door is open, it means open and ready to do business. Obviously I'm cranky if I don't get my coffee first thing in the morning. BTW, I have never left a negative review for SB, as I love SB coffee.
This Starbucks is really slow. If you have an extra 20 minutes in your travel schedule then that won't bother you. But if you have somewhere to be, don't stop here!
Just a few minutes away and always quick (for Starbucks). If they do mess up they let me keep the mistake drink and make another right when I ask them.

If you can get a parking spot, this is a pretty decent Starbucks. The one at Kroger isn't that great and the Green Hills Starbucks is a zoo 24/7. The line moves relatively quickly and my drinks seem to come out great.

This place is the worst Starbucks I have ever been To. The manager Scott work behind the counter like a he knows what he is doing but for all the moving around. The coffee maker has no drinks on it and he is not getting anything done. I have waited several time for up to twenty to twenty five minutes for a single drink. At least once a week my ices coffee is hot. It just not a good place .
I love this Starbucks! I don't like Starbucks in general but the people at this one are always so nice! I don't mind coming back to this one every time cause everyone's so nice here.

This particular Starbucks is on the ball every day and I visit coffee shops on the regular. The lady in there by the name of Heather is a machine. She even remembered my order from my last visit. Now that's what I call customer service. All around I'm going to be making this my regular stop in the mornings.

This is a very good Starbucks. The parking is not the best in the world but it is located right next to the interstate and Walmart. The staff here is always extremely friendly and the drinks are consistent with all other Starbucks locations.

Worst customer experience was at this Starbucks. Cashier didn't key in the exact order of food I place. Instead she just said 'the price is the same' I guess it doesn't matter to your inventory? 

My colleague ordered a cup of cappuccino. No joke. It was entire cup of foam. Understood that cappuccino is supposed to have half cup of foam. The employee said 'cappuccino is all foam'. Seriously?

Employees here have bad attitude. Terrible experience at this Starbucks while on my first trip to New Orleans.

Terrible, terrible service. I waited 20 mins in line at the drive through to arrive at the window to realize they had not captured my order. Matthew, a Starbucks employee, was extremely rude and told me he could not take my order at the window and that i would need to go inside. I explained I had an infant in the back seat and that is the reason why I didn't go inside in the first place. He finally agreed to take my order at the window but did it in the snottiness way possible. Starbucks typically has a friendly staff so I was super disappointed to run into such an unpleasant person at the edwardsville location.

I really like this Starbucks location.  It's quite small compared to others, but I find that this makes it feel cozier.  It's not usually too busy, either, so there's always a seat to be found, and I've never experienced a long wait.  The employees are super friendly and helpful, and they've always made my drinks exactly how I've ordered them.  The condiment bar is always stocked up nicely and is very clean, which is a huge plus in my book.

This is an overall great Starbucks!
Couldn't even sit and drink my coffee because of all the people lounging around eating food out of Tupperware containers that they brought in with them. Great business model Starbucks smh!

Generally, always pleased with the service here. Always incredibly friendly. 

Careful, though, don't over salt my Salted Caramel Mocha frappucino. Too much makes it sink to the bottom and can get overwhelming. 

I wish this were a larger Starbuck's but they are clearly doing something right as this place is ALWAYS packed.

This Starbucks is located in Regency Center, and most of the time, entry and exit is smooth.  There is ample parking, but if you just wanted to hit the drive through, this location is pretty quick. 

Other than that, it is your average expensive high calorie coffee joint.  So far, it's kept pretty clean, and the service is friendly.  

My favorite is the Java Chip.  I get it every time I go to Starbucks, morning, noon, or night.  Yeah, it's a milkshake.  Don't judge me.

Wow, today service was at a new low. I walked in and no one looked at me. I literally stood by the cash register for several minutes and no acknowledgement. Finally when the female (I will be nice and not say her name) took my order, she repeated it back to me wrong as I could tell she wasn't listening. I corrected her and then she proceeded to order the wrong drink!  When I got it I looked at all 3 employees standing behind the counter and said this is the wrong drink AND then I told them that it is frustrating coming to this Starbucks because the service is always bad.  They just looked at me and one said, we will make new a new drink. That was it. No apology, no free drink, nothing. 

I gotta believe that the only reason this Starbucks is still open is the location; certainly not the service. I'm done with this Starbucks and will go to other locations that care about me.

The Starbucks on Broadway and Kolb is amazing!!

Very disorganized and incapable of getting basic brewed coffee served in under 10 minutes. Stay away if you actually want to get on the move in the morning. Other locations will take care of you better

I'm confused as to why this Starbucks doesn't have a complete 5 star rating!  For starters, there's actually a parking lot...in PHILLY! Mind you, it is shared with a few other stores and a TDBank, but dont worry, they wont tow your car for parking in their lot for 5 min. to run into the Bucks for a morning latte.  Secondly, this location received a complete reno, not so long ago.  The difference is great, and the flow of traffic to the register is much better.  The real reason I love this Starbucks however is the people.  The associates are so nice, know you by name, and can spell out what YOU want before you can tell them, simply because they remember.  Because of these reasons, I will go out of my way to stop there, even though there is a Starbucks 3 minutes from where I work. :)

As far as coffee goes it stands by its name and brand image. May be expensive but worth every penny. My favorite part is the extreme consistency they provide you. I can order a drink a 100 times from them and it will taste exactly the same 100 times straight. Whereas I can order same drink 100 times from Dunkin donuts and it will taste different 95 times with 15 of those times I need to force it down just so my 2.50$ doesn't go to waste. 

If you are looking for quality and consistency then pull out your wallet and head to Starbucks

I like Starbucks...I am not a die hard fanatic for coffee with a lot of calories, and tend to prefer what I make at home, however I do receive gift cards quite frequently and I love it because it's a treat for which I don't normally indulge.

This location is pretty typical of what you'd expect from a Starbucks. It's bright and clean and  there is ample seating inside and outside, and a drive through, and they all seem to be pretty busy throughout the day. On my particular visit, there was quite a long line but it also very well staffed, so we did not have to wait very long to place or receive our order. This is a really great place to wait if you happen to be visiting the Tesla station. It's literally right next to it, and for heaven's sake you don't want to try to leave this plaza and come back...in the time it takes to fully charge, you would spend the majority of your time trying to get out and get back in. Sit back, relax, and enjoy people watching.

The baristas are very nice, great environment and drinks are pretty good. However they don't seem to know how to make a lot of the drinks on the app. The other thing is they turn the AC wayyyy up and you end up freezing sitting in there longer than 5min.

This Starbucks located in Clayton is pretty, neat, and clean every time I come in. The parking isn't always great with just one block on Wydown and busy Hanley but I can usually find a spot. It seems to be very popular with bicyclists on the weekends there is usually a crowd outside. The door handles state that this is a Starbucks Reserve which it seems like they have the capability to do some specialty brews. I generally order ahead after the gym and always get my drink made on time and correctly. A Starbucks is a Starbucks but as far as locations go this is one of my favorites in town.

So I don't drink coffee, if I did, however, I probably wouldn't drink it at Starbucks due to their preference of burning their beans....

That aside, this is my favorite Starbucks location in the St. Louis area... considering the fact that I used to live in Illinois, work in Brentwood, have a doctor off of Manchester (and one on W. Lockwood), and live in the city... that says a lot. 

First: My two fave baristas there are Teresa and Erin, hands down. Friendly, they know my drink, know my name, and sometimes I even get smiley faces on my cup.

Second: It's a larger Starbucks, so it doesn't feel claustrophic like the one in the mall does AND the one on Manchester does. 

Third: There is definite consistency in my drink. Granted I always get a Caramel Apple Spice... but this is the only location that I have experienced my drink tasting the exact same every time.

Fourth: They're nice even when they're busy. I once had a barista at the Brentwood Blvd location get really mean regarding the order that I ordered my drink -- at the time I was drinking Mocha White Mochas with a shot of espresso... and apparently I said it in the wrong order and made her life more difficult as a consequence (or so she told me). That's when I started drinking Caramel Apple Spices. Never looked back (fall in a cup).

Had a flat white and unfortunately it fell flat on its face. Starbucks claim of microfoam is an outright lie. They don't train their baristas to do this, their machines are not built to do this and even the steaming pitchers are shaped incorrectly to perform this action. I feel sorry for the Baristas who are being hung out on a steaming wand and getting blamed for this corporate disaster.
If you are looking for a quick drive thru---keep driving. Slowest Starbucks drive thru in the area.

Wow, longest wait time I've ever had to go through. I expected to wait at least a little while but figured once I got my drink it'd be worth it. After being trapped in the line for more than a half hour I received my drink and realized it wasn't what I ordered. The order was typed in correctly but wasn't made properly. I understand that they may have been busy maybe? , but as patient as I was I really expected to have a little more accuracy to make up for the long wait time. Really disappointed.

This is the fastest drive thru in America! It blows my mind. There can be a line of cars wrapped around the building at 8am and I have never waited longer than 5 min in the line. It's magical and everyone is always friendly. Nothing better than a delicious, well-made coffee, breakfast to-go and a friendly face telling you to have a fantastic day when you are on your way to work. Great place!
My favorite Starbucks in town. Near my Casa and is well staffed.  Even with a line they are quick and friendly.

Any Starbucks is usually great, as it's my cafe of choice.  This is the one I usually go to, as it's closest to my house.  I've always had decent service, and the drinks and food are fresh and taste great.  This cafe is clean and enjoyable for meeting friends at.

We were in Yardley and went to this Starbucks numerous times. I had their very large decaf latte (with only two shots) and it was made perfectly as you would always expect from Starbucks. AND they had current New York Times and Wall Street Journals for purchase (not often available unless you are in a kind of "class" area/place. Great views and ok seats,

Never seen a 24hr. Starbucks before. Great stop on the way back home from a beach weekend in Clearwater. While our drinks were being made David was very friendly and chit chatted with us. We appreciated his humor.

Disrespectful employees. Yelled and threaten to call the cops on my fiancee because all she was asking if the drink that the barista has made was hers. She asked 3 times and everyone of the employees ignored her.
The barista gave her an attitude once he gave her his attention. My fiancee tried to speak with a manager but none of the employees wanted to cooperate to direct her to one. One of the employees claimed that he was the "manager" and refused to give her the District Manager information. A scene has already started in front of the many customers that have been or was being served. He ended up giving her the "manager" number which my fiancee called and when she asked who she was speaking to, they hung up on her. The managers number ended up being the store phone number. Nothing was resolved.

Never go here unless you're looking to fight with the disrespectful employees.

I have to agree with a previous review that this is, by far, the slowest Starbucks on the planet.  The staff is always friendly enough but when there is no line and there are only 2 people ahead of me, my Pumpkin Spice Latte should not take 10+ min from paying for it, to actually enjoying it.  Their slowness became a running joke between myself and my sister who used to be a barista.  I would text her as soon as placed my order, and then again when I had my drink in hand so she could witness (via text) how insanely slow they are.  Because it is close to work, I previously visited this location 2-3 times each week.  Not anymore!  My last visit was about 6 weeks ago.  The barista was having a conversation with another mall employee about how much she hated her job (inappropriate, perhaps?).  After 12 minutes, I asked about my coffee.  She had given it to the girl she was chatting with by mistake.  She apologized and said she would make me another drink.  But, I had to wait until she finished the drinks for the 3 customers who were waiting when we realized the mistake.  Don't even get me started about the huge difference between the quality of Starbucks in Nashville compared to Portland and Seattle (where I'm from).  Vastly different and an embarrassment to the company.  It's no wonder why my friends who are locals are not big Starbucks fans.

As a location, this Starbucks is difficult to say the least.  The line for the drive thru is frequently wrapped all the way around the store and maybe two or three cars waiting in line on 4th street as well. This is particularly the case in the morning when their can easily be 15  cars waiting.  The drive through line also makes it very difficult to park in the lot so you can't app order and pick up easily as well.  

There is overflow parking behind the gas station next to it.

Inside, this is an amazingly comfortable coffee shop.  It is clean, wide open, and very accessible. Despite the volume of customers, they never seem to run out of what I'm looking for.  Customer service has always been great here for me as well!  

Starbucks coffee will certainly scratch the itch but it's nothing to write home about.  It's good but it doesn't blow you away.

This place sucks! Not only could i not get a cappuccino because they didn't have enough espresso OR employees, but they didn't even have a building! It literally doesn't even exist!

You're better off going somewhere that is real, like the library or the DMV. At least THEY have coffe, sometimes it was even made that day.


Besides, Saxbys is a better cafe than Saxbys

This Starbucks drive thru is notoriously slow!  The only reason we ever go to this one is because it's close to our house.  Aren't they supposed to ask if you want your receipt?  We just stopped and she didn't ask if we wanted it and they got the order wrong.  We asked for a venti and got a grande.  Won't be going back to this one.  We'll drive out of our way to go to another one.

Our local Starbucks and a great location due to it's precise location, if that makes sense. This store is in the La Cumbre Plaza just off State Street. Not much seating inside, but do they need it? This is Santa Barbara. Weather is almost always perfect. The abundance of seating outside is what I like about this store. It's plentiful and peaceful. 

Staff is super friendly and they'll get your orders right. I recently saw a woman drop her entire venti latte over one of the tall tables and it spilled all over the stools around it. A staff member immediately stopped what they were doing to help her clean it up and even made her a fresh one. Good friendly service if you ask me.

It can get decently crowded early in the mornings on the weekends, but this is why Starbucks has their mobile ordering system. If you visit a Starbucks even once a month and don't have the app, you're missing out. I usually order 3-5 minutes before I arrive and my coffee is always waiting for me when I get there. No line waiting at all.
I visit here almost every week. Like all normal Starbucks. Always occupied. Good place to hangout.

This Starbucks is always busy and yet happens to be extremely understaffed each visit I've been. Wait times easily reach 15 minutes and that's on a good day.

The staff here has always been fairly unfriendly, which is unlike most of the stores I've been to. I do enjoy the Causeway store more, but this location's Drive-Thru is convenient.

This Starbucks is great because if the drivethru and convenient corner location. However, it is always crowded and the parking lot is a bit challenging to get out of. The baristas are friendly, but a bit slow at times. Today, the new guy left the syrup out of my latte.

I just drove through the new edwardsville location! They are always so friendly and attentive so i continue to go back. Today i ordered 14 cake pops for the staff at my job and they went above and beyond to hook me up. My coworkers were ecstatic about the surprise and I will continue to go to this location only. Thank you so much for the awesome service and positive Sunday vibes!

This Starbucks confuses me. The woman running the register is responsible for popping my sandwich in the oven and grabbing a food item from the case as well as ring me up while there are two people just standing around back there? Those two people were there along with the drink maker and the drive thru order person. Not sure of their role but I've never seen the register person have so many tasks especially while there appeared to be others capable of throwing my sandwich in the oven or grabbing my other item. That's how it seems to run at other Starbucks. U hit Starbucks often so that's why this odd division of labor stood out. Oh and there were 4 people behind me in line midday. I felt bad for taking so long to have my order covered. What was the purpose of those other two people?

While Starbucks isn't the greatest coffee in the world, I have coke to be really attached to this location. The mid-day crew has come to know my order when I come in. I spend hours in here reading my bible and doing sermon prep. 

I  the venti iced coffee, heavy cream and 3 stevia.

I agree with most the reviews that this location can be, once in a while, hit or miss. The location is convenient but the parking lot is small and the drive through can be just disastrous. On most occasions it is faster to go inside than it is to wait in line.

I have come here multiple times. I always order a milk alternative in my drink and pay the extra money (I am severely lactose intolerant) this is my 5th time at this Starbucks that I have received whole milk and ended up extremely sick. All day long. So if you have any dietary restrictions I'd keep a close eye on your barista here.

By far the worst Starbucks I've ever been to!! Ask for a Caramel Frappuccino & was given a black coffee. Never ever have I done a review so yeah it was absolutely horrible, by the time I realized my order was wrong it was too late. I understand there was a crowd but that is no excuse to totally screw up an order. Also my order was left out for someone else to grab because no one ever called my name!!
