They will never get my business again all customers should be treated with the same respect!
I've stopped at this Starbucks numerous times and I have to say it is the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. Thankfully they do get your drinks correctly.

I'm really disappointed at the turn Sbux has taken.  The formerly delicious chocolate chip cookies are on a rung equal to Chips Ahoy...
Also, the bad attitude from the young female barrista when I politely asked for my hot drink to be heated was such a turnoff, I'll never go back.  My drink has been wrong nearly every time, which is not such a big deal, but rudeness is.  You pay a premium and you expect premium service and premium products.  Bad move cutting back on both.

Love the location and the design of this place. But ... The service is the worst that I've ever experienced at a Starbucks.

One friend shares on Facebook the following: "The female morning manager is an idiot, and rude on top of it all. I'll drive to the CWE to avoid this place. Glad I'm not alone in thinking this place is a cluster."

The place is gaining a bad reputation with people who would be very loyal to the store because of the history of the locatin. Unfortunately, the treatment of customers by the staff is chasing people away.

Starbucks needs to seriously get a staff attitude adjustment in place or it will probably only get worse.
New location is open - avoid it. Inside is dirty.  The service is pissy.  And the drinks made taste awful.

My grande Carmel frappé dreams have been smashed. Sorry if you knew, but I just found out tonight that Starbucks doesn't use coffee in these drinks. They use coffee flavored syrup. Not sure why. Maybe I'm crazy. I will forever be confused as to why the largest coffee franchise in the world used flavored syrup when you have an endless supply of fresh coffee at your disposal.SHAME ON YOU STARBUCKS!

This Starbucks is right there in the middle of things downtown. It has a slightly different vibe, because of its location and layout. There doesn't seem to be as many comfy chairs, but it does have a cute high table section. 

The baristas were great that evening and I enjoyed a Caramel Brulée Frappuccino with Almond Milk. It was tasty and of expected Starbucks' quality.

The location of this Starbucks is everything. Walking in the heart of Downtown Indianapolis and enjoying a nice warm Starbucks cup of coffee is ideal. That's why this one is SO packed all of the time I'm convinced. 

Don't be turned away when it's busy. They move quickly but they are just limited on space. I just patiently wait my turn and get the heck out of there. Not a great place to sit and relax.

The 4th location that I frequent regularly. I have been coming into this store for 4 years. Working in a extremely high volume store the partners at this location are consistently on it as a team. I have seen them move a packed (and I truly mean packed) store full of customers in and out with top customer service skills and teamwork. I have also seen them in slow times when they work together to make sure that the store is in top shape for the next shift coming in. They get hundreds of regular customers in and they remember the very way each likes to have their coffee made - even if it is a month or two since that customer has been in they still remember. I could choose to go to the other location around the corner from them, but... No. I prefer to stick with the one that has the best bar none.

Friendly service... made my drink just like "home"...

I was in the area for a week a couple of years ago for school through Indiana U.  I needed my Starbucks fix and this was the closest one to my hotel.  

I've never been to Indiana before and the partners here were very welcoming... I asked them about snowboarding and apparently, that doesn't happen here... but they mentioned they had some rolling hills to the south... hehehe... oh wellz...

Anyways, yah, super friendly peeps and they made my drink just like they did back at my home starbucks...
Best customer service of any Starbucks I have ever been to! Smiley and friendly! Dana is such a fun employee, making us excellent drinks and loving life while doing so!

great location with very efficient baristas. i've only had one problem here with an order, but the situation was quickly and professionally handled by the manager.  very busy location so if you're distracted easily, i wouldn't necessarily choose this place to study or read.
I didn't have to wait very long which was great. When I ordered my coffee the cashier was very friendly. When I got my coffee it was very fast and the guy had a excellent customer service.
very efficient and speedy Starbucks. even when the line is long, you won't have to wait too long for your order. also, the staff is very friendly

So, I'm ranking this Starbucks as a 3 compared to others in Tampa.  Why so low?  The parking here is a nightmare as is getting in and out of the actual parking lot.  They are seriously out of two of my favorite things....vanilla roobois tea and rice krispy treats (or rice dream bars as I think Starbucks calls them) at least 75% of the time.  I've asked them multiple times why they are consistently out of these items and no one seems to have a great answer.  The bathroom is normally pretty dirty too.  

Giving them the benefit of the doubt though this is a very high volume Starbucks and their staff have always been warm, attentive and pleasant.  They are efficient as well for the volume of people they push through on a daily basis.

The staff here is really nice and the Starbucks is clean and overall convenient. However since Starbucks has come out with cold brew as the new product , I have been dying to try it. This is the third time I have gone to this location to order it and they do not have it. This is my neighborhood Starbucks so it's pretty disappointing that they are advertising a new drink that they don't carry. I had to leave to go to another one further away just so I could try the new product.

I'm not normally up in this area so it was probably my first and last time coming here. No complaints about this establishment. It was clean, had quick service, and my coffee and scone were delightful. Just about what you'd expect out of any Starbucks.

My investigation leads me to believe this is the store now known as 639 W Ina, not 7151 N Oracle.

I've hit them up several times through the drive-thru and service is average. Not the typical uber-nice Starbucks customer service experience but still pleasant.

I was mistaken in thinking this location opened at 4:30AM like the one at Ina/Thornydale. I had to be at work super early and came to the drive-thru at this location and stopped at the speaker box but could only hear what sounded like someone wiping down the mic or something. After a couple of  "Hello? Hello?"s without response I pulled up to the window. I was noticed within about 30 seconds and the woman went about unlocking the window and opening it. I asked if they were open and she told me no, they open at 5AM. I said, "Oh, OK, I thought you opened at 4:30 like Ina/Thornydale and Grant/Swan." She then said, no, 5AM and pulled the window shut. 

As I put my car in drive and glanced at the clock in my car I saw that it was 4:58am. Really? She couldn't have offered to serve me 2 minutes before opening? I realize she didn't have to but c'mon...this is Starbucks, and they're known for great customer service. 

I drove away disappointed and hit my regular store at Grant/Swan and headed in to work.

Tiffany is my favorite Barista. She has a smile on every Sunday Morning. She remembers my family and asks about them when they are not with me. 
The rest of the staff has a group dynamic that makes you want to see them as much as you want your morning coffee. 
They have created community in location that is frequented by people passing through on the highway.

Very disappointed with the service this morning around 7:30. They have at least 5 people working drive thru and 2 people serving everyone in side. The young lady making my coffee was extremely slow and did not seem like she wanted to be there. My coffee was bitter. I am not happy whatsoever.

Starbucks is just OK.   They never make anything sweet enough for me so I always have to get extra flavors but they are coming up on their food menu which is always helpful.  Just wish they weren't so pricey.  Good quick drive thru though.
Pretty much standard for Starbucks. Smaller format with about six 4-person tables and 2 small bar height counters. Nothing bad, but nothing fancy about this location.

I went to Starbucks to purchase 1 frappe and decided to just added the points to my reward card. Nothing too hard. The employee ended up loading money to my rewards card without my permission and charging me for 2 frappes. I can't believe they would do that. If I go inside to fix the problem I know that they'll give me the same "it'll be 4-5 business days till the money is back on your original card" and then have to deal with the fact that it's not there. I'm not going to deal with that.

I used to work about 30 feet from this Starbucks and it has been hard to be far from it now. I never had to wait in a long line and my food and drinks were always done right. To make things even better they have the best and nicest baristas, shoutouts to Christina and Jermey for always going the extra step to make customers feel appreciated and welcome. Miss this Starbucks location!!

Service is ok, but it's crowded with people who buy one coffee then decide to homestead taking up all the seats. Doesn't your college have study areas? Instead of sitting to enjoy my coffee for ten minutes, I'm in my car. Thanks Millennials!

I used to come to this Starbucks almost weekly on Friday nights after a dinner out.  It had been a while and stopped in here with a friend to get a coffee.   The parking lot appeared full but there were only two people ahead if us.  By the time we picked up our drinks, there were set least 10 people on line.   It took a while to get our drinks even though there were six people working the counter.   Everyone was polite and there was quite a buzz among baristas.  Coffee was as expected, good, but there is a reason they call Starbucks "four bucks."

There has been some redecorating with a modernistic feel.    The big, comfy couch is gone and the have put in a divider in the seating area to make the space seem less cavernous.  There is also outside seating and they pipe the music to the outside as well.  An OK experience.

First of all, I am not one to complain. I am a loyal Starbucks customer but would not recommend this site with current front of store staffing. In the 15 minutes I was in the store I observed that most food orders were either forgotten to be processed or resulted in lengthy delays. I witnessed multiple customers leave because of how slow the ordering process was and the lack of customer service.

In my little time at the store this morning I saw three drive-thru customers come back in to get their order corrected.As I heard one drive-thru customer say when they pulled away from the window-Huge Fail at Starbucks today.

This store is consistently slow and dirty. The employees DO NOT care about customers and seem either lost, disinterested or both. 

The ONLY reason I come here is that it is convenient. 
Maybe they know they have a captive audience and take customers for granted. 

How does management allow this to continue?

The worst Starbucks ever! After sitting in the drive-through for 30 minutes to finally get two drinks, my cappuccino was made incorrectly. I then handed it back to have it re-made and when it was made again, I was handed a drink that was only 3/4 of the way full and still not made correctly. I had to go inside, write my own drink cup, wait another 10 minutes and finally got my drink. Thankfully it was made right this time and the girl on bar was nice and knew how to make a drink. I am appalled at how bad of an experience I had today and will never return to this location.

Love Starbucks but this location is pretty slow...customer service is nice & pleasant & they still make ur Starbucks coffee favs delicious but could use some extra people to deliver beverages a little timelier!  this location is also open 24 hrs so great for anytime enjoyment plus it's right off I4 so it's pretty convenient for most peeps on the go...hopefully, if u get lucky u won't have to wait as long for ur drinkable delight!

The drive through at this location is AWFUL. There are two entrances to the drive through, which means that every morning an entire line of waiting cars gets skipped as someone pulls into the other entrance and gets in line ahead of them.

I am giving this Starbucks only one star purely for the drive through design. Everything else at this location (drinks, food, employees, etc) has been great.

Coffee is a lot harder to find than daqueries in this part of town, so Starbucks would have been fine for a fix, this is on the far side of the Marriot lobby, went in at 1:30 in the afternoon and they were already closed, WTF?
Though long overdue, the recent renovation makes this a great coffee shop with a variety of indoor seating options to satisfy all. Also excellent outdoor area.  As always, the coffee is the best.

Great starbucks. Awesome location right on broad street. So if you are in your way into Center City from South Philadelphia this is the perfect stopping place. Reletively short lines. And I really enjoy the local art work, along with some of the local acts that come in. Also a lot of space to sit down and do some work/ studying. I have visited a lot of starbucks and this one ranks in the top.

The local Starbucks where everybody knows your name. Well, at least they do when you come here almost everyday! 
My favourite Starbucks location, I've been coming here since the days of University and crazy exam schedules. The baristas are friendly, the drinks are consistent, there is lots of parking, and the bathrooms are always clean. 
A word to the wise, avoid the frappucino rush. What is the frapp rush you ask? The 3:15ish time on the weekdays when junior and senior high students alike congregate en mass from the transit station and all order frappucinos. If you are here during frapp rush, be prepared to wait and rediscover your inner 15 year old self!

Star bucks is a great place for cake coffee or a breakfast sandwich or lunch they as all
Restaurants except cash or credit tips and 
Work very hard to make sure your happy

I am surprised by the high ratings, I have come in a few times and have never had a good experience? But maybe I am just unlucky and havent come by at the right time?
I am a coffee lover, and I dont mind starbucks in general, but this specific location has just never gotten my order right. I only complained once when it was late and they werent busy, and the guy I complained to said it was fine and if I wanted them to do it over "just because I didnt like it" I was going to have to buy another and I SWEAR I wasnt being rude or anything I just said it was the wrong drink!! 
I quit going after that, because it sort of put me off :(

So I dont know... I guess I missed out, reading the other reviews!

Not sure why but I can't get this location to show up for mobile ordering ever, even though the website says it's available.  Employees are always friendly.  Would use this location more if mobile ordering started working.

Since this place is a chain, I think I'll spare the description of the food/drinks.  The location isn't necessarily the most convenient.  The door is placed in an awkward position on the side on a smaller street perpendicular to Delmar.  It's a little annoying to get into the establishment and find parking.  However, there is a huge lot behind the loop that's free.  So, if you don't mind the walk,  it is the easiest and most convenient place to park.  The reason I gave this place two stars is the service.  I've been here a couple of times on off hours. It seems that the staff is not that attentive.  (Maybe I've just been unlucky both times, because this never seems to happen to my friends that frequent this place).  Both times, I have had to wait several minutes before someone would take my order (even when there isn't a line) and there are other baristas that seem to be free.

Stopped in to add money to my card & place an order.  Staff seemed new & could not get my order correct.

When paying, was advised that my card was locked?!?!

Shift supervisor couldn't help, very frustrating.

Had to call Corporate the following day.  They could clearly see what the store had done.....they voided out my addition to my card.  Corporate fixed the issue, however, I was advised that this clearly should have been performed at the store.  Please TRAIN your staff correctly.

Came here when one of my high schools students did not want to go into Wet Seal... so we came here and talked about his college options etc.... The night crew was really nice and they chatted with their regulars while cleaning up for the night... no complaints here

Standard Starbucks experience. This one located inside the Marriott, so be prepared for long lines at peak times, especially during conventions. They do a pretty good job getting people through the line quickly with a small staff, though.
The coffee is your Starbucks selection and quality. There's a lot of seating at this location. It's clean.

Great location, clean, friendly staff, and a really nice outdoor seating area. This is one of my favorite Starbucks around. It's newer than most, so it has a modern feel with the wood fence outside, fresh coat of beige paint, and comfortable inside seats. They know how to personalize the drinks you order, so no need to walk inside to get your drink remade. Yay! Enjoy! Xo
Similar to most Starbucks, but fewer people inside, makes for a less noisy coffee. Floors could use a good scrub
Staff is friendly and quick to fill orders. Ambience is nice and there seems to be plenty of space to work in the main area, attached room, or outside. There's a drive thru, too.

Wanted a quick Starbucks stop for coffee and treats and this location was great!! Fresh coffee, yummy bakery items, and very prompt service!! Definitely recommend if you're driving through or in the area!

What can I say?  It's Starbucks.  They do have some of the more friendly Starbucks employees I've encountered at this location.  I think because of its proximity to 465 and Carmel, there is ALWAYS a line at the drive-thru.  You will get much faster service and be much less irritated just parking and going inside for your coffee.  Trust me, you don't want to be stuck behind the Carmel soccer mom ordering her Venti 1 pump caramel, 1 pump white mocha, 2 scoops vanilla bean powder, extra ice frappuchino with 2 shots poured over the top (apagotto style) with caramel drizzle under and on top of the whipped cream, double cupped.

I agree with Stacy L.  I've been staying at the Marriott for a conference since Sunday, and every day I go in, I feel like I get nothing but bad news.  They don't honor the Gold card free refills, soy, or syrups.  They're usually out of something every day...almonds when I want just a light snack - "oh sorry, we ran out."  Very small selection of sandwiches, and haven't seen a protein plate at all in this place.  Staff usually acts like they don't give a damned.  They close super early...what Starbucks in the US do you know that closes at 5pm? Do yourself a favor and bring your business to the Sheraton across the Street, or one of the smaller, independent coffee shops nearby like Rue de La Course (too many in NOLA to miss) who actually care about their customers and selling a good product, rather than passing the time doing as little as possible until they get off work to go party down the street.
Great service and always clean . Lots of outdoor seating . It can get pretty busy inside which leads to a line for the unisex bathroom.
Easily accessible and the standard fare of Starbucks that you'd normally expect.  No complaints! I parked on the street in the yellow zone while my cohort ran inside for the goods!
One of the best barristas I've ever met works there.  Red headed guy.
I don't always drink coffee, but when I do -- I drink Dunkin' Donuts. It's much better than Starbuck's, which tastes terrible.

Quick access, good drinks, a few indoor seats, and consistently good drinks!

I like this location for it's convenience because in the mornings it's a little slower than the location down the street. While it doesn't have a large indoor area to sit down it does have a few seats where there are a couple of regulars that offer a kind a greeting. If you feel like chatting, it is never a challenge to find someone to talk with. Usually, I need to get some grad school work done (or catch up on yelp reviews) and I hide out behind my computer. The seating outside the store is plentiful.

The baristas are always helpful and it seems that they could use a couple of extra hands, but they are good at what they do and always kind.
Pretty good Starbucks. Nice patio. 2 wishes: open till 11pm in summer & wipe off outdoor tables occasionally. I am a regular here. They just upgrade their furniture and havea lot mores seating.

What sets a Starbucks location apart from another?  The peeps behind the green apron...THATS WHAT!!  This location rocks !!  Quick and friendly exemplify this downtown Reno location. We enjoyed our daily jump start here during our recent ski trip. Visit this location to enjoy FIVE STAR service if you DARE!!

I've been to this Starbucks location couple of times and the experience of getting coffee here always been the same, HORRIBLE! Minus the dirty counters and grumpy baristas who visibly hate their job including the coffee they made you they also will make you wait for it. The tipping point for me was when I ordered a simple drink (Tall Pike) went to get Half & Half at the dirty counter but found it to be empty, skim milk - empty, whole milk - empty, I asked barista if I could get more Half & Half, she looked at me and said sure! then ignored me for good 10 minutes until I left, other baristas also ignored me while being busy hating on their job. I went to the near by gas station to get me Half & Half for the coffee I purchased at the Starbucks. (Anyone else see anything wrong with this?) 
So If you still decide to come here, get in line for slow crevice and free humiliation.  
Next time I'll come here, but who am I kidding I will never come here again.

Only negative is the often nightmare-ish parking / drive-thru layout. 

The staff are the friendliest of any coffee shop I've ever been to!

I've rarely had bad experiences at Starbucks, as I've been a barista and know how difficult it is to make people's drinks perfectly, and be accommodating. So I really don't expect much.. But today when I was with my mom I had a really strange experience. Let me start by also saying that my mom visits Starbucks EVERY DAY and spends a ridiculous amount of money there. I don't know how she does it. If there was an ultra golden gold membership, she would have it. Every other Starbucks in the area knows her order and is never short of super accommodating. But today we went to this one on the way to Philly instead. 

We proceed to order at the drive thru, and my mom orders her usual: 4 shots of iced espresso with half and half. 

Upon receiving our drinks my mom asked the barista if she could have another small splash of half & half in her drink, because the color was a little darker than she likes. This is not that strange of a request. She likes a lot of half and half and I have heard her ask for this a million times. Sometimes the baristas are generous enough to give her a full cup on the side. (You can even go inside and walk away with the whole pitcher of cream at the service bar, and they never bat an eye). But either way I have never seen her have a problem. Today, however, the barista working the morning shift looked at us like we had 5 heads. She said she would have to charge us for a latte if she added a splash more of half and half. A SPLASH!!!! Okay now, even though my mom likes her half and half, I can assure you there wasn't nearly enough of it in the drink to consider it a LATTE. She insisted that she had to charge us for a latte even after we mentioned that she only wanted a splash more, and that she'd never been charged for a latte before for asking the same. They even said that we should come inside and add more at the service bar ourselves, but they couldn't do it for us. UM. We went to the DRIVE THRU for a reason??? 

I don't really think these baristas know what they are doing. Super rude and unaccommodating. Also, what happened to the "Don't like your drink? Our Baristas would be happy to remake it for you" motto? More like "Don't like your drink? Too bad, fix it yourself or pay for a different drink" at this Starbucks. Won't be returning to this Starbucks unless they deal with their staff.

fancy new building can't atone for rude self entitled help. Quality is poor and drinks are not made to order. 
The staff here needs to either be retrained or purged.

Go to the Flourtown location better staff and much better quality.

HORRIBLE customer service & to boot $10+ they gave us 2 coffee and milk when we paid for specially lattes....Not impressed.  I've been a "Starbuckets" drinker for years and always looked forward to the Holiday flavors.  Was in a giving mood & decided to treat a co-worker after lunch.  OK so she has a complex coffee order (I zoned out somewhere in the cinnamon, triple, no foam, whip...)  The gal in drive-through had to ask a few times herself to get it right....no biggie.  Get to the window and waiting for order I could sense hostility....the gal makes a comment about "head-set not always working" co worker said it's OK you got it right, insert awkward pause, then "you seemed ungrateful"  HUH?!?   I was FLABBERGASTED thought WE were the customer and your goal is to get my order that I paid for.  I was floored. After a "manager" gets snarky with us and rolls her eyes we pull away at this point scared to drink coffees and realize they just gave us coffee and milk not the drinks ordered.   NOT coming again to this location and suggest unless you are into S&M don't go there yourself.

Thank goodness the folks at corporate are decent and understanding.

Irritated. Awful selection of pastries, I got the last of a chocolate donut, and then the wonderful barista dropped it on the ground. Instead of refunding me my donut, what does he do instead? Kindly give me a dried up old fashioned donut. It took them two tries to make my drink, because they didn't understand to make it with a milk alternative. Luckily they caught their mistake. They were slow and clumsy.

The good: Nice location. Outdoor seating is way cool.  Near the Clearview Mall. Friendly Baristas.  They have stock, when others don't.  Near a gang of eateries. Love the bar style window seating.  

The not so good: I find this location to be a little more stuffy than others, stuffy as the patron wise. I don't care for the drive thru, it's space deficient & a little hard to navigate. Parking is very limited.  Easily missed when driving, seems to be just stuck in a 'tiny, oh this will do' space.

But I'm glad they had my Eggnog Latte on tonight... tis the season.

Every time I visit this location I end up waiting anywhere from 10-15 minutes to get my coffee in the drive through. Given the fact that this is the only Starbucks near CWE that has a drive through I continue to visit it. The employees are nice but the service moves at snails pace.

Easy Walk From Hotel Indigo.
Open early. Very friendly staff.  Great coffee as always from Starbucks.  Nice local atmosphere.

Just a regular Starbucks. Pretty good service and a weird trendy atmosphere. You can watch them make your order which kind of sucks because I see them using Wal-Mart milk and generic ingredients which beats the purpose of getting expensive coffee!

Starbucks makes me happy all over wherever I go. This team here was always enthusiastic and made my visit joyful. They got me in and out of the store really quickly. 

Thanks Starbucks!!!!
This the best Starbucks in the area! The staff is kind and funny. They always make a great drink and a bad day better. The staff is beyond great!!!! This is my favorite by far!

This place is a disaster.  SLOW is the only way to describe the service.  Not staffed properly or with well trained individuals.  Then to add to problems the parking lot and drive thru are the size of a shoe box.

I'm reading some of these reviews and I guess I came here on a good day or something because I had nothing but good service. 

I came here a bit ago for my date, and I asked if I could wait a little while until he showed up, and they said it was fine. (Most places make you pay for something in order to just stand in their location.) After waiting, and he showed up, we immediately ordered our drinks and something to snack on. They lady at the register was nothing but nice, and sweet. Our drinks were not messed up and we only waited about 8 minutes, it was a but busy, so maybe about 10 minutes. 

And this is such a convenient location since it is right close to where I work.

Don't go here often, but stopped in recently two consecutive mornings. The staff's too laid back - seems to be a South Street culture of "easy does it". They don't know how to move a long line (or a short one for that matter) like most Starbucks. 

The 2nd visit one person in line (me) at 8:40am. There's three employees behind counter two working on drinks. The third, a manager standing 3 feet away, sees me waiting and then looks away - she's too busy and concerned with doing the inventory with a hand held electronic device. Apparently customers in line are less important than completing inventory. 

From now on it's Chapter House cafe just down the block.
Poor customer service, long wait, and not very clean.... Next time we'll make the extra drive to find another location.

I don't usually review big chains since everyone is familiar with it already, but I really liked the barista here so I needed to share.

I believe his name was Alex. My LivingSocial Starbucks eGiftcard was expiring, so I HAD to use it. I don't really know why I even bought it since I'm not a coffee drinker. I'm just a sucker for deals. Anyway, I was taking my time deciding, but he didn't mind. He offered his help, so I explained my thought process. "I don't want coffee, so I'm thinking a creamer, but I don't know what flavor. Which ones taste better as creamers?" He was ready with a list to rattle off, along with his own opinions on them. Made my choice easier.

My gift card only had $2 left on it. My boyfriend's gift card also only had $2 on it. So when we were about to throw his away, Alex gave us a tip to save it. If we register it online, add $5, Starbucks gives us another $5 for free. Sweet! (Again, I'm a sucker for deals.)
Service is always fast a efficient. And my items are always prepared to order with freshness!

Starbucks stores are slowly getting the attitude that they're invincible. Like "you need us." And no apologies. Yes, there are exceptions. But I can lo grade more stores than hi these days. 
It's pretty foolish, as corporate empires take decades to build, and weeks to crumble, it seems. 
I think of what some knowledgeable person told me in Seattle. "We like to think of SBUX as the McDonald's of coffee - mediocre product available everywhere."
So to me, SBUX boils down to ambience and friendly service. And while they can precisely engineer the ambience of each store, the customer service is always the wild card in every case. 
This store, like so many others, is sadly one of the majority. Inconsistent cashier service, long times to make drinks, and indifference toward the sale are hallmarks.
Yes you have a few nice people behind the bar. But for the majority back there, it's the tired and true SBUX mantra: You Need Us.

I understand that this location is in a high traffic area but this morning I waited almost 25 minutes for a MOBILE ORDER. The staff was visibly stressed out but failed to let customers, who for the most part were running late, that the water pressure either was low or just not working. 

A couple that ordered (via the app) grabbed their drink maybe 5 minutes before I did and a lady that had a drink being prepared at the same time as me just told them to give her her order and she'd add the water herself when she made it to work.
Great location but limited parking. Lots of drive-thru traffic. One block west of Hanley on Delmar.

The worst and slowest Starbucks on the planet.  I have gone to Starbucks all over the world and there isn't one more poorly set up or worse service.  They need to tear it down and rebuild it because you can't even get in or out!

Came here for my usual iced venti half-caf Americano with three pumps of sugarfree vanilla and room for cream. 

There was like -2 parking spaces so I had to put my hazards on and be "that person" to get my drink since I sure as hell wasn't driving to find a spot for a 5 minute coffee run.

Cute place, deck looks out on the river which is nice.

Huge shout out to Batista TOM left my wallet at home, & thru didn't have tap & pay here for me to pay with my phone. So his kindness and generous heart bought me lunch. There's still kindness in the world. I feel so grateful and inspired now.

Spent $4.91 on steamed milk with caramel sauce. Not a single shot of espresso anywhere, definitely not what I consider a caramel latte. I came in around mid-afternoon when it wasn't very busy either. Very amateur mistake from an expensive coffee franchise.
Decent service. What I don't like is the store is far too small and you have to park at mcdonalds alot. Coffee is great but not the best location or size.

I'm a big Starbucks fan who frequents a few different locations a week. I've been to this location once before for a to-go coffee retrieval, but last Sunday I stopped in to relax with my tea, read the newspaper, and enjoy the beautiful weather. My chai latte was perfect, but I was disgusted by the appearance of the store and its patio. We originally sat outside. There wasn't one table that wasn't smeared with milk or with crumbs and napkins lying on them. I went in the bathroom to get some wet paper towels to clean the table and was appalled by the strong urine smell, wet floors and trash lying around. We instead moved inside and found the same unkempt condition with the chairs and tables there. Worst kept Starbucks I've ever visited. I was quite surprised given its neighborhood location.

You would think that with this being a new location and with 5 people working there, and no drive thru line, and no one ahead of me .... that I'd have a great experience / wrong. I already wrote to Starbucks because not only did my order get made wrong once , but twice. The girl ringing me up had a problem ringing me up so she asked another coworker for help which I guess might have been the problem but when the first words that come out of your mouth for an order are "iced" you expect to see an iced drink , not a hot drink. Well they made me a hot drink. And then I told them that I ordered it iced they remade it - although looking at me like it was my fault , perplexed that there could have been such a huge mistake made on any of their parts - they remade it 
But it was still wrong. Since I had groceries in the car I just left and wrote to Starbucks. When you spend $6 on a coffee you want to get your order correct. And in case you're thinking I probably ordered something outrageous, I didn't. I ordered a premade drink off of their menu. 
This place is pretty- but it wasn't even clean and although it is large almost all the seating was full. It also was a tad dark. When I'm in the area I'll definitely skip out. That's what happens when you judge a book by its shiny new cover I guess!
Jake is easily the best barista Ive ever seen. It was so busy,  but Jake maintained a great attitude and worked very hard.  He deserves recognition by management

This Starbucks is fine.  It is, however, small, and it gets very busy at certain times of day, with a lot of people picking up coffee on their way onto the blue route or the turnpike.  During rushes, the employees crank through orders more quickly than at a lot of other Starbucks, but you can still have a long wait in cramped environs.  Also, the parking lot is small and getting out of it can get complicated.

The product is the Starbucks usual and the employees are good, but it's not the fastest or easiest place to stop at busy times and the seating is limited so it's not the best Starbucks if you're looking for a place to have a conversation or to sit back and sip your coffee.

Worst Starbucks I have ever been to. One worker on a Saturday morning, stuff all over the place, out of caramel and other items, nothing in the cases. Looks like the remnants of a hurricane hit this store. Will never come here again as I don't have time for this nonsense. Going on 15 minutes waiting for my drinks now.
Very convenient and open 24 hour. I believe that this is the only coffee closed to I 4 between orlando and tampa. Quick service and great outdoor settings. Many good memories.
Consistent with most other Starbucks locations everyone's friendly and it's super busy during peak hours in the morning.

Wow... I'm so disappointed in this particular Starbucks! They took my order only to forget about it, and the girl who took my order just kept staring at me while she was standing at the register doing nothing. Ugh... You took my order... Dont u think there was a problem if u stood there staring at me for a coo minute?! Anyway, 15 mins later I had to speak up because two people who ordered  after me got their drinks. Also after reminding them, I had to repeat my drinks 3 times for her to make it. One of my order was a carmel frap and usually when you order with whip they automatically add the Carmel drizzle on top and she forgot to add my carmel drizzle... That's like one of the best things about about the carmel frap. I had to ask her to put my Carmel drizzle on the top. I'm from Cali and a huge starbucks fan but this Starbucks needs to up their game, where I am from. Nope, its not going to fly.

They've stepped up their game I guess. Haven't had to get a drink remade in a long time. There are some less than friendly staff but overall it's been a more pleasant experience to grab a latte at this location.

This is definitely the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to.  There were 4 people behind the counter and it still took about 15 min to get a drink.  2 people were handling the drive-through, 1 was cleaning and the person that took my order at the counter disappeared for about ten minutes, then came back and went on a 10 min break.  I got to watch many drive-through drinks go out and finally after a solid 15 minutes I received mine. I wish 222 Artisan was closer I would never step foot in this place.

Horrible experience. Coffee grounds in a Pike and no syrup for a basic favorite. It was mid-afternoon, really?! The barista was in a league of her own. Blonde female with glasses, pony tail and headscarf who huffed, puffed & rolled her eyes when asked anything. Slid drinks to customers with the obligatory thank you. She was not only rude to customers, but to her colleagues. Never going back to this one. You shouldn't either. Walk a few blocks to 5th Street or across the street to Whole Foods.

I walked in and there were four people working behind the counter. I was the only one in line, but they do have a drive thru (which didn't seem super busy). No one helped me for a solid 60 seconds which was awkward and I felt like I needed to flag someone down. No one even acknowledged my presence or said "we'll be right with you!"

The initial customer experience left a bad taste in my mouth, but I'll admit it is a convenient location for meetings as it's right off of 116/Allisonville.

The employees at this Starbucks know their customers really well. The drinks are good and the service was friendly. This is Starbucks really small and narrow so don't plan on going there if you want work done because noise echoes a lot.

They have the Clover machine here! Baristas are very friendly. I had a nice conversation with Andy while he was brewing my Nicaragua Reserve coffee. Learned so much more about the Clover itself as well as the coffee I was drinking.

Clean interior, attractive design, GREAT Starbucks!

Least efficient Starbucks I've ever been in...  4 staffed behind counter.  Store slow, maybe 8 people being served/served.  Waited 10 minutes for order that was only produced after I asked for it...  meh, won't be back.

OK, we all know what you get at Bux, so it's really no different.  What makes a great Starbucks is the staff...it really is.  I used to work there, so I know what to look for in my "third place".  I moved to the Carmel area last year and recently switched daycares, which takes me past this wonderful drive thru location.

1st, score for the drive thru!  2nd, score for the fabulous staff!  I would say I do like their morning staff A LOT more than their night staff.  I come in OFTEN...I'd say - 4-5 days a week and in the a.m. I go through DT.  I have officially become a "regular" as today, the woman who works the window recognized my voice and immediately starting repeating my order.  She oftentimes will also give me a warm chocolate chip cookie if I ask really nicely.

I am a little disappointed in the night staff as they just that aren't into me.  That's OK...I guess.  Maybe it's b/c I am showing 24 weeks PG and they are judging my caffeine intake...I don't know.  This is my "go to" for nighttime meetings for Beach Bum as well.  There is typically a lot of tables available and everything is always clean! Score for the night shift.  

Atmosphere and staff, people....this Starbucks has it.  I consider this my new third place!  

While writing this, I am enjoying the perfect 1/2 decaf, grande, non-fat, no whip three pump white mocha stirred w/a straw. They nail it every time!

After Spin class, nine of us went to Starbuck's first ever Evening Hours Wine night. The weather was perfect; we enjoyed sitting outside . Everyone ordered wine. The service was a little slow, maybe because this was the first day to serve wine? The staff was friendly and helpful. A pleasant lady brought our drinks to us and asked if we needed anything else. Later she came back and cleared our dirty dishes. 
The wine is served in glasses. Nice. And much to our surprise, a snack of seasoned pumpkin seeds was included. Everyone seemed pleased about that. 
The wine was a good quality, mine was delicious. I heard several comments about how good it was. 
However, everyone seemed to agree that the pour was extremely small. And for the price-  seemed a little chintzy.  Starbuck's, please reconsider the pour size and make it comparable to the wine quality and the price. Do that and I will come back with a Five Star Rating! We were all excited to know you are now having wine night.

I absolutely love this location, the drive thru maybe be backed in the mornings, but they hustle fast. The baristas are very friendly and the recognize you if you are a regular. Always professional and polite.
Yowza! Knowledgeable and chicly cool. Best baristas we've found at this point.  They need to be with the constant coffee chuggers churning through the doors. Get your 'Bucks on here.

This Starbucks, like most, is uber busy between the hours of 7AM and 8AM. But the staff is cheery, the facility is clean and the chairs are comfy. Safe yourself sometime and go in, rather than waiting for the drive up; the line insides seems to be speedier than the line outside.

Starbucks is Starbucks. Pretty much all the same, except for the inventory and the employees.

Every morning they were "out" of something I wanted. And they were never particularly apologetic about that. And they all seemed super apathetic.

Three stars because caffeine when you're jetlagged and at a boring conference is ALWAYS a minimum of three stars. But certainly no more.
Not sure what's up with this location but it is extremely slow. 10 mins for an iced tea is way too long, especially when the guy behind me gets his coffee and food first

This Starbucks is clean inside and I have had decent experiences in the past. However, I recently used (day of this review)the drive-thru for the first time and was in line for probably 25-30 minutes. I was originally behind 2 cars and the car in front of me had ordered two drinks. I should also mention this was around 2:30pm which is not a peak time. I am not saying to avoid this Starbucks, but it is lacking that consistency factor which is their hallmark. I am giving them a 3-star review for now and will update as my experiences dictate, but I do not see it changing.
Always a table open.  Great Wi-Fi signal.  More cushy chair and sofa options than any other Starbucks in the area.

So, I'm driving on Sunday afternoon heading from Tampa to Orlando, looking forward to a good jolt of Starbucks coffee to keep me awake. After waiting about a half an hour looking for a Starbucks sign, I see one for this location.

I pulled into the lot, and it was pretty busy. I figured I could live with that, knowing that my local Starbucks moves pretty fast through the line. I was sorely mistaken. When I walked in, probably 15 people in line and virtually no one sitting down. After standing there for 10 minutes and not seeing any progress. Myself and a few others bailed. The person in front of me said they seemed more focused on serving the people in the window than people in the building.

I walked over to McDonald's and got a couple of apple pies, coffee and was on my way. The people in front to me still had not been served.

This is not typical of my experience with Starbucks.  Caveat emptor!

I do love the fact that it is in the lobby of my hotel, but I give it five stars for more than that.  The staff here was exceptionally friendly and when they made a mistake they went overboard to make good on it.  I went to the free standing location 1 block away and it was not the same customer service.  Great experience here!

A drive thru experience that I still can't figure out.  It's a typical Starbucks, and I've placed this order 100 times and never had this happen.  I ordered venti coffee.  The person on the other side of the sqwak box asked if I wanted cream and sugar.  I said yes, 4 sugars and cream on the side.  I get to the pickup window, and they give me the coffee and the cream in a cup like always, but she tells me they already put the sugar in the coffee and asks if that's ok?  Um, no that's not ok.  I don't get how one ingredient gets put in the coffee and the other comes on the side.
This location has gotten rid of the veggie breakfast sandwich. Why, SB?! Vegetarians want a breakfast sammy too! Also not the best SB service at this one.
An interestingly shaped Starbucks location in a strip mall. There is good amounts of seating here, but service is slow.

I've been using starbucks as a second office for years. I just moved my family to a nearby location and so I've begun frequenting this starbucks. Food and drinks are good. The place is clean. But the staff seem really stressed out or something. The lady at the front counter was just acting weird and saying strange things, and she needed me to repeat myself a few times.  The other staff didn't seem aware of the fact I stood at the counter for two minutes hoping to get a packet of honey. Again, it's 7:00 AM on a Saturday, I wouldn't blame them for being exhausted. I'm sure I'll add more stars once the staff gets friendlier and more present.

Love this location. It's our tradition to stop before church on Sunday's. I've seen this place super busy and the crew works quickly and efficiently. My drink has always been great. The staff is friendly. The decor is my favorite in Reno.

I have frequented this Starbucks for years and I must say, all other Starbucks are compared to this Starbucks, and they almost all fail in comparison.  (I realize this is not fair, and I try to make sure I remember this, but it isn't always easy.)

The crew at this Starbucks makes a good drink, is extremely quick and they have an uncanny knack for remember not only someone's name, but there drink.  I do enjoy my hole in the wall tiny coffee shops, I ally owned, but I do enjoy the yuck in and out service of my Starbucks neighbor.
Hands down the best Starbucks. Staff always goes beyond to satisfy customers. Great group and coffee!

Speedy and efficient. Sounds good right. Perhaps for some but not me. 
Not many in the store. Only me in line. Short line at drive thru. 
When I bid the person good morning and asked how she was her reply was what can I get for you. So much for pleasantries. 
I was trying to decide what to eat but she looked very impatient so I ordered my  drink to calm her down. 
That didn't work. Immediately she asks what else I would like. So I picked something quickly. 
I get it this is fast food. But it's not cheap fast food. And it's nice to feel appreciated when I'm dropping coin somewhere. I suppose it's being in the north instead of home in the south. 
Solid Starbucks but unfriendly.

In reviewing what it takes to get 5 stars I have decided to remove one star. My previous reviews stand and please read them. Four stars is still very good and I have enjoyed most of my visits here. It just doesn't live up to what I consider is 5 stars now, which is paying attention to the details of the business and getting almost all of them right.

I absolutely love this store!  I'm always greeted by a friendly barista, I get a consistently quality drink, and the store has a great atmosphere for work or studying.  I've worked for Starbucks for 4 years, so I am probably a harsher critic than most, but this one never fails to impress me.  This one's definitely a gem amongst the South Side.

I skipped my Brentwood Starbucks in favor of trying out this location. The Brentwood location is very slow and the parking lot is like playing chicken which is getting old everyday. This Rock Hill location seems to be pretty new and looks really clean. I was able to order and get through the line much faster than what I've been used to down the street. The employees were friendly and my order was made correctly. They even apologized for my wait which wasn't even half as long as I would have waited in Brentwood with no apology. This seems to be worth the extra couple minutes drive I will have to come back and check it out during the morning rush soon.

Love the feel of this Starbucks. Nice layout with ample room for reading, studying, meeting, etc. There is kind of a community area with comfy chairs as well as a big round table in the center conducive to larger groups.

The aesthetic is a little more industrial, which is kind of cool. And finally, a convenient Starbucks location in midtown/downtown/SLU! So nice.

And yes, there is a drive thru.

This is my Starbucks of choice, my Zen, my happy place. My best friend and I have been coming to this particular Starbucks for 5 years. Starbucks has seen us laugh and cry, it has heard our stories of heartache and butterflies. Starbucks has comforted us when we felt down, and listened to our gossip and seen the first's in our lives. When ever there is an emergency there is always "time for Starbucks". Maybe I'm giving this particular Starbucks a 5-star rating because it holds a little place in my heart. The drinks just always taste so much better here, but let's be honest coffee beverages just taste that must better with my best friend. I love Starbucks, I have always loved Starbucks, and I will always continue to love Starbucks. It just holds a place in my heart.

This Starbucks has some of the friendliest Baristas in town. I visited right before they were about to close with a group of friends and there was no rush whatsoever. In fact, they were very lively and were playing a game with their manager to see if they could get a customer to do the Zena Warrior call. Well, luckily they picked the right people because my friends and I are always up for a good challenge. In return for participating, they gave me and my friends all a free drink. It was the most fun I've personally experienced within a Starbucks. Definitely made my night!!

Stuff is awesome the service is fast and amazing. This Starbucks is always busy but you never wait to long.  Starbucks coffee is a little over priced but once in a while its good. Love the holiday flavors. Pumpkin spice one of the best of all times.

An average of 3 stars after 2 visits.  So convenient that they have a drive thru and the line moved rather quickly.  Great that there are two exits to either go east/west on route 38.  We sat inside second time around and it was empty on a Saturday morning.  It was clean except for spills on the sugar/milk table (didn't know what to call it, sorry).  Minus 2 stars because they did not have cold brew and i did not really care for the baristas being petty towards one another.  They were lacking professionalism.  I don't really care to hear them bicker about who get's to go on break first.  This chatter is unnecessary to hear 1st thing in the morning sans caffeine.  Please don't make your patrons feel uncomfortable.

Seriously strong Starbucks customer service! Today, while ordering my Chai Frap at the Chapel Hill store, I mentioned drink purchased Saturday night at Avon store location. It lacked NO Chai and I would have returned except I walked in 5 min before close and they locked the door behind me. I was asking if I needed to add extra Chai pumps to get the Chai punch I prefer.  

Woman taking my order works at Avon store, apologized to me, ask me a few questions and then comp'd my drink. Wow! Wasn't expecting that! I now take quick sip immediately if cold beverage before driving miles down the road. You know I'll be back at both stores with attention to service like this.

Competent people, clean store.  Not much seating and pretty rough in and out vehicle access holds it back, but this is the only one around.  They don't seem to take that for granted and deliver a good experience.

Waited over 15 minutes post ordering to get served the drink.  I waited with others who were experiencing same issue.  Never coming back, this location was severely understaffed and employees were not even hussling to meet the demand.

No two Starbucks are alike! Well... they're close but this location definitely stands out. There are two locations within walking distance of my work and I would choose this one anytime.

Why? For one, the staff are always upbeat and friendly. They're always joking around with each other and it seems like a fun work environment. Also, while the lines can get long, they always seem to go quickly. Sometimes I order ahead on my cell phone and my drink is always ready to go when I get there. The drinks here are always made well and the few times they've run out of something I wanted, the staff always have a similar back-up to suggest. 

The seating inside is cozy and comfortable and they have a nice outdoor seating area for those hot summer days. I think I'm going to head over there now for an afternoon pick-me-up!

Starbucks is Starbucks.

I always go there when I am out of the country.
I am addicted to their frappuccino with espresso shot.

This place has really nice staff!

Free wifi always at Starbucks!
Accepts AMEX.

Coffee is great but the barista named "Meg" gives off such bad energy. This is me 2nd bad experience with her. She is so rude. The first bad experience I asked her of her opinions on what flavor she liked best and she snapped back with a rude comment. Today she was just straight rude. She makes me not want to come here anymore. Awful customer service on her part.

I've been to many Starbucks and this location never disappoints. Employees are kind, patient and willing to recommend a good drink when you're to tired to decide. Today I ordered my drink and when I got to the window I discovered I lost my ATM card. Ericka looked at me with a smile and said "It looks like you you're having a stressful day don't worry about it." A small act of kindness but it meant so much. This is why this is my Starbucks!

Eh. The cashier was not friendly but the barista was friendly.

The order was correct...  plenty of strip mall parking... no drive thru... some seating..
The only time I buy Starbuck's coffee is when I need to use their wifi. But this locations wifi never works on any of my devices. This is 2013. Even McDonald's has working wifi.

This Starbucks is the closest to my house, but it's also close to many of the University of the Arts dorms, so if you want a place to sit and drink your latte amongst a lot of teens in legwarmers, you've got it.

It doesn't get the huge crowds of the Market or Walnut St. stores, but it also doesn't seem to be adequately staffed for the rushes they do get.

The drinks, as with most Starbucks, are barista dependent.  Some are great, some are good, and occasionally they're bad.  It does the trick most of the time though, and if the line is too long I just skip it, knowing I'll find another coffee place in a couple blocks.

Starbucks is Starbucks. The drinks, the food, the atmosphere is the same as every other Starbucks. The difference with this one is the staff. They are wonderful. They are always friendly and helpful and they always seem to go out of their way to help me. I really enjoy it here.

This Starbucks is usually top notch. I'm not sure if it was just a bad day or if they don't have the hang of drivethru service yet. We had to give our order three times to three separate people, and the order was still wrong. My chai was so sweet I couldn't drink it, it was only filled up part of the way, and it lacked the three shots of espresso that I asked for three times. If I go back here anytime soon I am not using the drivethru because it was chaos.

This is how my ultra caramel frappuccino looked like. Before ordered in Marana outlet Starbucks,it had layers ,like on photo of promotion ,and was good sweet .Here ,in speedway was just blended not sweet drink (sweet just on top , from middle to buttom was without taste cause it hadn't  this "ultra " caramel) .

They are now a ghost town as the shopping center is being renovated.  Parking is horrific, if the entrance is even open.  Combined with my experiences here I've pretty much decided even though it's convenient and I like the drinks I'm not going back.

I have been to over 100 different Starbucks all over the Midwest and South and this is the only one that consistently gets my order wrong.. I,get an iced white chocolate  mocha with caramel drizzle, not a hard drink to make, and yet they never get it right.. It is either way too sweet like they added extra sugar or it is soo bitter you can't drink it.. Just wish this store was as good as all the other ones I go to in my travels.

This is a great location. The baristas learn your name and your drink. Good conversation and great beverage! I had a s'mores frappucino made with espresso shots and it was delicious. The restrooms are very clean, as well as the entire location.
I always have to wait in line for at least ten minutes or more. The same goes for the drive thur Not very convenient when I'm in a rush!
Don't expect to get service if an off-duty employee comes in to order they spent 10 minutes just chatting at the register line wrapped out to the door

What makes this Starbucks standout is its speed. There is nothing like waiting out the door, this is a tiny Starbucks, and getting you drink in under 5 minute. This has to be hands down one of the most efficient Starbucks I've ever been to.

Another pro is that this place is open late throughout the week and is open an additional hour longer  on Friday and Saturday, which comes in handy if you are waiting for the garage to empty out due to a event at Hilbert Theater.

If you are looking to hangout, relax, and sip your latte, this probably isn't the most comfortable places to do it at. The inside is a tight squeeze and can get extremely noisy. They do offer bar seating along the wall, a few tables in the back, and some horribly placed seats at the counter where the drink pick up is. 

If the weather is nicer, they have a few tables outside that allow for prime people watching on the Circle, or better yet, just enjoy your drink while sitting on the Circle's steps.

We have been in Central Florida mostly south of Kissimmee for a week 
Checked out a few Starbucks 
Today we drove to Tampa 
First one we saw was this one 
Great location and nicest one yet 
Barristas are efficient but not as friendly as ours in Ottawa 
Coffee decent but there is a difference 
Will definitely try others 
Interesting setup with clean washrooms 
Drivethrough was too long 
Seating was good

Starbucks is Starbucks, right. The thing about this location is it didn't feel as laid back as others. It felt like You have your coffee, leave. 

Its so tiny, but great. A prime location. Bean and i decided to get cold drinks bc we were walking DT. The service was quick. The space tiny. The consumers were plenty, but therr was no place for them to sit.

Bran and I were cramped by the window. There was plenty of people watching to be done but it got so crowded we had to leave. The way my anxiety works caused me to feel too closed in. 

I'm sure this location ia setup like this on purpose. Fast service so they can get the line down. Bc there is always a line. Limited seating to keep the college student and bloggers out. And a key to the toilets to... I really don't in know why.

I'd come back in the future if we have a meeting in yhe Arts Garden & I need a quick cuppa.

I live closer to the Starbucks on Brentwood but I prefer this one. It is the best neighborhood Starbucks around! I love to study here. I also love that the baristas will let me study for hours, they never ask me to leave, and sometimes they even give me samples! How can I not like this place?!

On a side note, there is a drive through, it's clean, the bathrooms always clean, and there's plenty of parking.

I come here just about every morning before work and get my "grande pikes in a venti" cup. The staff and manager are very friendly. They refer to me by name. I love the atmosphere. Food is great. ( of course coffee is too).
I've been to a few Starbucks in the area and they seem to be dirty every time I'm there and just not friendly at all. But this location is always clean, including the bathrooms. If you want a place to  relax with your friends or to study then
I highly recommend this place. Its the best in St Louis in my opinion.
This is the best Starbucks I have been to yet! It was fast, friendly, and great customer service. My drink was made correctly, looked beautiful, and tasted amazing!!

This is my new favorite Starbucks in town (move over Wydown!).  It's relatively new so it's not overly crowded yet.  Perfect for intimate coversation or getting work done.  It's well decorate, service is great and everything you'd expect from a neighborhood Starbucks. PLUS--they have plenty of parking!

I stopped in at what was  the original Delaware County Starbucks.  It has been updated a few times since it first opened.  They stuck with only tables on the last two renovations.   I hadn't been here in a while but stopped in while waiting for a friend to finish their appointment a few doors down.   It was a Friday evening and I was a bit disappointed.    There were several people working the counter and I got good service and good coffee.   Why then was I unhappy, you are thinking?   As I am waiting, cruising the Internet, I am in the company of 6 or so pubescent tweeners who are talking drugs and private parts to the extent that in any other location, this would be sexual harassment.   Thank goodness it only lasted 15 minutes, but I was surprised that the staff just ignored it and let it go on.   After they left, I was inundated by two more sets of teenagers.  Not a place for adult drinkers like the Havertown location....

Don't go through the drive-through! We go through the drive-thru frequently as it's so close to the house, but it looks like it's time to find another location. The store has serious problems preparing hot food and keeping things in stock. We've had multiple occasions in which hot sandwiches were not cooked. I don't mean they weren't hot enough - I mean we've had more than one sandwich still frozen in the middle! Of course, we've been a few miles down the road when we found these issues and didn't have time to go back to the store.

They also have trouble keeping supplies stocked. Twice we've had them tell us they are out of Splenda. How does a coffee shop run out of sweetener? 

Finally, this week, the store did not have decaf coffee brewed. I've run into this at other locations and they served me a decaf Americano for the price of the decaf coffee. Not this location - I even asked them about it and I was told that isn't standard. Again, how does a coffee shop not have coffee AND, if you don't, why would you not substitute another item at the same price?
While they make a decent coffee like most others, I wouldn't recommend coming here unless you want to hear some of the rudest starbucks employees complain about their lives
If you have EXTRA time to wait in drive thru this is the place to go . Waited in line for OVER 20 MIN. OLIVIA WAS RUDE
Always have friendly and fast service! The drive thru is convenient during the cold months when you don't want to leave your car.
30 minute wait in drive thru (5 cars were originally ahead of us) ....ordered two white mocha s. ...both were terrible.  Worst Starbucks I've ever visited.

So apparently I've just haven't learned my lesson with these guys. By far the worst Starbucks I've been to! So tonight me and my husband went out for a late dinner and afterwards we wanted a drink from Starbucks so I looked on my app and saw that one was the only close by that was open. So we took the chance and went and sure enough failed us. I got a venti pink drink and my pink drink was light pink that was it! It looked so plain!!!! Why?!? Because they didn't add any strawberries! There was so evidence of any strawberries! I'm not complaining about the price because hey i know I pay a lot for a drink but hey I love Starbucks so whatever! It's yummy! But anyways if I'm paying that much I should be getting what I paid for! What it's suppose to be! My husband got a white chocolate mocha hot and he said it tasted bland. No flavor! And on top of it I placed the order on the app so we don't have to wait too long. My husband gets his drink and makes him wait another 10 minutes for the pink drink! If I want Starbucks I'll just go somewhere else and drive a little further out of my way to get some I guess! Ugh so annoying! The worst Starbucks ever!!!!!!

I've experienced better at this Starbucks! this is my go-to Starbucks until now.. I went in yesterday and they were out of decaf coffee. No big deal, they offered a decaf americano instead, which i declined because I was in a rush to work. I go in today, and luckily they had some brewed decaf coffee. BUT, they only had enough to give me half a cup! c'mon now people.....

Easily the worst Starbucks I have ever been to.  They consistently run out of items even when you get there by 6:00 AM, especially the bistro boxes.   Usually the excuse is that their truck delivery didn't get there when it was supposed to.  And they are extremely inconsistent when it comes to drink quality.  Just this morning they tried to give me a strawberry acai refresher WITHOUT any actual berries in it!  I've given this location numerous chances thinking that maybe there was a new manager or something, but after roughly 8 months, it's clear that this is simply a terrible Starbucks.  I'll be going elsewhere from now on.

The service at this Starbucks is below poor, waited 15 minutes for my latte and never got an apology for it taking so long. No customer service AT ALL! Very disappointed for a Starbucks! In addition everyone working behind the counter had major attitudes, not one staff member smiled, nor acknowledged any of the customers. I thought when you gave your name it was to be called so you know when your order is ready. It was more calling out the drinks instead. 3 people ordered the same thing and we were left wondering whose was who. Management need to retrain it's staff at this location.

I've been here to many times to count and have only had two bad experiences that were quickly corrected. The employees are very friendly and have even brought my order to my table before. I've been to almost every Starbucks around Brandon and Tampa and this is my favorite one!

This place never gets my drink right...and I mean NEVER.  Really sucks bc this is the closest starbucks to me.  I order at the drive through and it never fails...order is wrong. To top it off there's only one girl in there who is super nice.  Like, unusually kind. Everyone else is annoyed or checked out.  I have no idea what's going on with this location, this kind of service (or lack thereof) is new to me.

I have to admit the Google WiFi is a major attraction because it works perfectly with my Moto X WiFi phone -- so much better than the AT&T systems. BUT the service is excellent and consistent and friendly to boot. Currently my favorite one in town.

It's not that this is a bad Starbucks.  It's just that I believe the only reason it survives is because it tries to lure people away from Chapterhouse Coffee which is right down the street, is cheaper, has better food and  much better coffee, and is more spacious.

This Starbucks is like most Starbucks, except for Allen. Allen is the nicest barista I've ever come across. The entire staff is so nice and they all genuinely like their job. I'd go out of my way just to come to this particular Starbucks again.

I don't know why I subject myself to the rediculousness of this place.  #1, how is it legit that people waiting to go to the drive through can back up an entire road.  Even if there are parking spots, you can get in the lot bc all the people waiting for the dumb drive through have the only entrance completely blocked.  Once you do finally get in the place, they take your order immediately, and then you just wait.........and wait for them to get the drive through line down.  Today I watched 15 drinks come up before mine and there was nobody in the store waiting but me.  It was all for the drive through peeps.  HELLO, I'm standing right here in your store and you're going to put me behind the 50 people waiting in their cars, blocking traffic.  When I finally asked about my drink, the girl making drinks totally ignored me and some other person said, oh I think that drink is sitting over here in the drive through line.   I think it is crazy that they don't have a dedicated person making drinks for people that come into the store.  Ok my rant is over.  I'll probably end up in this crappy starbucks again tomorrow bc, let's be serious, it is on my way to work.

Hey Witch Barista, don't lecture me on the fact that refills "are only for the same visit" when you are too stupid to notice that I have been sitting in your store all along, thus, eligible for the reduced price refill.

By far one of the best Starbucks in town. Situated in La Cumbre mall, this location is just perfect. The interior is cozy with dim lightening and a few high top tables not ideal for those who like to work indoors. But only a few steps away you can soak up the Santa Barbara sun in one of many patio tables outdoors while enjoying their free wi-fi. Service is quick and efficient regardless if it's busy or not. 

New flavors are always on the board, but it's nice to stick to the basics.
Your basic Starbucks, nothing note worthy. It was an efficient experience and they managed to keep the line moving pretty quickly.

This Starbucks is not a great location if you come with someone else (or more).  There are only about 4 tables inside and they are all pretty small.  There are a couple tables outside, but in the summer, who wants to sit outside!  There are only a couple of big chairs that you can lounge at in the front.  However, even though there are not many tables, I have never had a problem getting one (although a couple times I snagged the last one).  There is even a bar that you can sit at and watch the baristas make the coffee (which I find a little creepy, but would be great if you're friends with the baristas and feel like sitting and chatting).  

The baristas are really friendly.  No matter who is working here, I always hear them chatting and laughing.  They are pretty quick too.  Since this is a small Starbucks there never seems to be a long line.  

What is kind of funny is that parking here is the easiest, since it shares a lot with Publix and a few other stores.  We need to switch this parking lot with some of the busier Starbucks locations!

There is no drive through at this Starbucks.

If asked, "How do I take my coffee"...
I reply "Seriously. Very Seriously!".

Clearly I have had enough coffee today because I am on fire with these reviews! This was my first time visiting this location (only came through the drive thru) but I am overall very pleased. The baristas were quick, and pleasant at the window. My drink order was also correct ... VICTORY! I was in chipper enough spirits, between their quick speed and my holiday tunes, that I even had to pay it forward in true Christmas spirit!
Seems like it's pretty new and has a huge lounge area and outside seating.  It's connected with the Hilton.

Service can be spotty. Barista's hustle, but cashiers can be slower. Fairly steady flow.  Might get a bit of an attitude if you oder items on separate transactions,  sorry peeps I have to hand in reimbursement receipts. It takes 5 extra seconds and doesn't hold up your line. Also quit the tude when I refill my card in the shop, you're still getting my money right? Decor is nice and decent retail selection.  Shop is a bit on the small side so space to sit and work is limited.

Drive-thru moves quickly and the staff is friendly.

I tried their sausage/egg/cheese/english muffin breakfast sandwich recently and it was delicious.  In fact, it was one of the best breakfast sandwiches I've ever had, period.  Very surprising.

Starbucks is the McDonald's of coffee shops, right? So, I should probably temper my expectations.

That said, the whole experience is corporate, lame and I can't wait for it to be over one I'm there.  

From the other customers who would push you out of the way to get their Joe 30 seconds sooner, to the barista that mumbles the drink orders as they come up, the need to go there is a useful reminder to never let yourself go to sleep without coffee in the house for the next morning.
The staff is their best asset. Their service is fast and when I had an unsatisfactory drink one time, they quickly resolved it, no problem and with a smile.
Staff and product are fine. But this is a tight cafe.  If you're going for a take out its fine. But this is a tough place to meet.

Great Starbucks location. They are always very fast and very friendly. The only thing is is that the parking lot is kind of small and at the busy times it can be hard to get into park. Iced hazelnut latte hits the spot every time!

It's a Starbucks... but O dear, they are slow!!!! Ahh seriously the one thing I hate about the south is how slow things are. A mobile order wasn't ready and this lady next to me had to wait. I had to wait forever for my drinks along with a guy with a tea. Cold tea does not take that long! Ahhhhhhhh! Stop waiting as in type this. O dear they are so slow!!!

Elizabeth is EXTRA rude ! Not the 1st time, not the 2nd time but always has a pissy attitude.  She has a smart and rude mouth ! Should not be working if she doesn't want to deal with customers, she should not be working .

My order is always hit and miss...it never tastes the same--so I always ask "more creamer" "more ice" "more sugar" lol not a big deal right? What IS a big deal to me is when the employees cop an attitude or roll their eyes because you just asked to have the taste of the coffee YOU paid for modified. Are they not getting paid by the hour? The most rude of them all is Brianna she used to be in the drive-thru a lot more before and boy was she rude and obnoxious!! I can always tell when it's her, she cuts me off when I'm talking at the speaker and ignores me when I'm at the window and if I dare ask for anything more WATCHOUT! So glad she's hardly at the drive-thru anymore. She's a bad representation of Starbucks.

Coffee was overrated and not very impressive. Barista added whipped cream even though I didn't ask for it. This location is very small and felt claustrophobic at times. I also do not like their selection of music for purchase. Nothing wrong with the selection itself, but why would I go to Starbucks to buy a cd?

The pastry offered was a bit dry as well. The panini bread was dry and they seemed to skimp on the meat. Again, I'm at Starbucks to drink their coffee, not get a sandwich. If I wanted a Sandwich, I would go over to Safeway or Quiznos nearby.

This location has a drive-thru window and wireless internet available if you choose to use it.

Super friendly baristas (which is becoming a rarity on the SBucks front)! The turkey bacon, egg white, cheddar sandwich was surprisingly delish! And the orange cranberry scones and dark roast were actually fresh here! All around solid SBucks on the Northside!

Today, 1/16/18, around 5:15pm, my friend and I arrived after placing a mobile order to find the Starbucks with a measly paper taped to the door saying they are closed due to staff shortage. Lights still on, mobile ordering still available, and 3 employees inside. What staff shortage? They refused to open the locked door as we were trying  explain that we already PAID $30+ for a mobile order. This left a bad taste in my mouth after many visits with poor service at this location. Go to another Starbucks

Standard Starbucks but in a great building  - the flying saucer building! 3 Stars is a stretch considering after 2+ months of nearly daily visits at the same time, they still can not remember my name or drink. Guess I am asking too much.

This is the friendliest Starbucks I've been too. My visits to other locations were good, but I feel like this location goes above and beyond. The staff is friendly and upbeat. Lines move fast. 

I drove through the other day and ordered a breakfast sandwich and coffee. The woman working the drive through read back my order at the window and realized she had made a mistake. I wasn't even bothered by it. I told her whatever you had rung up was fine, I'm not picky. She changed my order and gave me a 4 dollar credit to my next purchase! I thought that was so nice of her to do that. I didn't even care about it but she went out of her way to provide good customer service. 

One million stars!

I have a confession to make. I like Starbucks. I mean, I do prefer unique, independently owned cafés. Still, if I see the Starbucks logo on the horizon, I usually "need" coffee in a classically conditioned response. The thing I like about them: you can typically count on a consistent drink. It tastes the same from coast to coast.
