However, I stopped at this location for a quick caffeine boost before taking my kiddo to play. The service was just not friendly. The cashier's eyebrow was lifted because my sister took an extra minute to decide on a replacement drink when her initial request was not available. The cashier was very impolite. There were probably 6-8 other employees working. They were also unfriendly...and slow. Our drinks took longer than usual despite the lack of any other customers. Unfortunately, when they were completed, they were not made correctly. 

We debated whether or not to return to the counter, and decided that having paid for a "specialty drink," it was worth a replacement or refund. Long story a little less-long, they were extremely rude about that too. I'll avoid this location in the future.

who doesn't love starbucks??? this location is not the best but it gets the job done. don't complain about drive thru, the whole purpose of drive through is for convenience of not getting ur ass up out of the car and getting it yourself, so for a place that makes ur drink right on the spot why would you not expect to wait??? The baristas in here are totally nice. Not too big inside but that does not stop the laptop crews from coming inside, makes you think who does not have wifi at home...

Typical Starbucks. We had vanilla cream frappe, cold chai tea and sweet cream cold brew. Barista was nice not overly friendly busy talking with other barista. Tables were clean. May stop by if back by in the mall

I came here between yet two more doctor's appointments. It was a day full of appointments, and I  hadn't eaten much of anything. I had an hour to kill. There were no pre-made sandwiches available. When I asked for a breakfast sandwiches- nothing- they were hit hard at breakfast. There wasn't even a fruit plate.

This became my Starbucks simply due to geographic location since it's right near my apartment. It's a very nice Starbucks location always has all the drink menu options and a nice selection of products as well. All the baristas are very friendly and some even know your name, what I really like is if they will make suggestions based on your typical drink preferences. Clean and organized this will be my go to Starbucks for as long as I reside in Indianapolis
I like this Starbucks because it's generally less busy than the others in the area. I normally don't have a problem getting a table and the wi-fi usually works.
This may be the worlds slowest Starbucks.... 7 baristas on the floor and I've been waiting 15 minutes for an iced tea...
New location is now open - avoid it.  It's dirty inside.  Service is downright pissy.  And their drinks aren't made right.

I first tried this Starbucks because of how cool it looked. Bad idea. 

Every day, I order my Starbucks oatmeal without it being re-packaged in the wasteful paper bag. On my first trip to the Spaceship, I ordered as usual. When my order -- bagged -- was delivered to me by an irritated-looking woman, I pulled the oatmeal and fruit out and said "I don't need this bag. Will you reuse it?" She snatched the bag from my hand, scowled at me, held the bag up in front of my face and crumpled it into a ball. I said "Wait! I'll recycle that!", but she smirked and threw it into the trash as if to say "screw you, asshat." The overwrought drama and hatred in her reaction freaked me out -- what kind of employee acts like that to a customer??

That's when I saw the title "Manager" on her name badge. 

I've been back to the Spaceship when the lines at the awesome, friendly Starbucks (in the CWE or at 55 and Loughborough) are too long. But the Spaceship team is always sour and surly, disorganized (too many people behind the counter, but no one doing anything), and the orders nearly always fubar in some way.

This is certainly the coolest looking Starbucks in St. Louis. But it seems to be managed (during morning hours, at least) very, very poorly.

This new location at Delmar @ North & South is super convenient with the drive-thru.

I just love it, needing to re-caffeinate is a serious thing and getting to it as quickly as possible is something not to be messed with. They get it right here with their fast service at the window.

Unfortunately it seems like this place already gets a lot of traffic and it may actually be faster to go inside to order, but alas I like many other patrons are far too lazy to leave the car.
I always get the passion tea lemonade with raspberry. And it's always hit or miss on whether I'll get the right thing or not. But when it is right, it's fabulous!

One of the better run Starbucks in Edmonton. There are long time baristas working here so they  know how to make your drinks unlike some campus run Starbucks. The washrooms are clean and well maintained. Sometimes they even give out samples! Overall, this is top tier Starbucks.

Poorly managed. Always has a huge line and never has 2 people on register. If you don't mind waiting 10-15min for a cup of coffee enjoy. But a lot of the problem lies with the lack of options available at the Sheraton.

Stopped here at our usual spot for coffee. My wife and I got a couple seasonal lattes, pecan praline and Carmel brûlée , both coffees are standard and consistent as Starbucks usually is, however the drive thru guy was, saying less than friendly would be a step above his attitude.  I don't know how you can have such a stick up your a** that early in the morning, but I did my best to be friendly and got nothing in return.  Cheer up drive thru guy, your life ain't that bad, your still breathing another day

This Starbucks is one my favorites. It is really spacious with high ceilings and a nice aesthetic. I have always experienced great service and the snack selection is diverse. There are plenty of electrical outlets and I have yet to see it packed. There are a variety of places to sit, high tables, lower tables and lounge chairs. There is also a pleasant outside seating area. This starbucks has a drive through as well. The lighting is comfortable and balanced. Overall it is one of the better locations with a really nice environment.

This is the Starbucks I hit when I am visiting my parents.  I typically go  in the afternoon and I use the drivethrough.

It sucks.  There might be one car in front of me or 3 and I've had to wait as long as 20 minutes.  I tend to have a hangover and don't want to get out of my car, so I endure the torture.

I don't know what the hell they are doing at the window, but the coffee gets handed out quickly and I see payment going through and it's still a long time before they drive away.  Talking about where you went to high school is a big deal in St. Louis, maybe it's that.

I live in Chicagoland.  You order, pull up, get it, drive away.  I'm not into the Mayberry scene!

Extremely inefficient and slow service. Took 10 minutes to get my latte this morning with only one person waiting in front of me. I'll only come here if I have time to kill. Then again if I have time to kill then I would go somewhere with better coffee and a more relaxing environment.
Hate getting in and out of here in the morning! Drink correct about 80% of the time.

It isn't the Venti Skinny Cinnamon Dolce Latte that keeps me coming back. In fact, I actually find my typical Starbucks order annoying. Yes, I annoy myself just ordering coffee. The coffee is okay, but the staff is WONDERFUL.  The staff at this location keep me coming back. It's not just that they are always smiling; it's the fact that the friendly demeanor appears genuine.

Also, this is a high volume location, especially in the morning during the work week.  Don't be deterred by the long line at the drive-thru. You'll be amazed at how fast it moves.

This is the slowest drive thru Starbucks in Tucson avoid it if you can it's not just that there's a long line of cars whoever is running the drive-thru seems to not be in a big hurry to take care of the customers
The outdoor summer seating just boosted this rating up all the way! Great comfy spot to chill and enjoy their coffee! My go to Starbucks in the area!
Great staff all around in the evenings. Very patient with the toughest customers. Thank you for an enjoyable evening.

Best Starbucks location I've ever been to! The layout is amazing - so spacious and relaxing. It's also surprisingly quiet even when it's busy, probably because of the layout. I recommend this location to anyone in the area!

This used to be our favorite location. But lately it's just not being kept up. Trash is always full, tables dirty and the floor needs sweeping. 

Still one of the best staffed. Needs better management.

Great location, good staff

We ran the gauntlet in NO to get to this starbucks which was under a mile from our hotel near the airport.
Large location, friendly staff and they got our drinks right!

This is my normal Starbucks and it's usually pretty good. It isn't the best one in the world but far from the worst. They baristas are efficient and my order is almost always right. This one stays super busy but I'm usually a satisfied customer. Friendlier customer service would make this a 5 star for me.

I am not a huge proponent of Starbucks.

However, for those of you who are into McCoffees this is the place to go. The staff at my store is pleasant, efficient and very reliable.

These are all the reasons that Starbucks seems to thrive. I always get exactly what I knew I wanted. No room for variation. No room for outstanding coffee.

Oh and in this neighborhood, once you become a regular you may even get to know your baristas' families. I know I have.

The staff in this Starbucks is always nice and friendly, except one blond girl who seems angry with customers and colleagues. She doesn't smile, no eye contact and moves through the crowd to empty trash as an icebreaker :) There were several customers, waiting for her to finish and she looked at them so sternly that everyone froze on the spot. I hope it's not a usual attitude just a few bad days. 
I tried hot latte 2 times and it wasn't good, so they should work on that. Other than that I really like they open from 5/5:30 and that location is convenient.

Staff is typically helpful and friendly. Occasionally they are lacking at the condiment/creamer station. It's frequent that I have to request creamer or stir sticks. This morning no one could locate the stir sticks and it wasn't all that busy today either.  This is fairly typical, but it is an indicator that they're busy. 

It's my favorite/preferred convenient stop for Starbucks.  Regardless, I rarely see a familiar face. It may be the random times I go in or a high turnover; no big deal.  They serve me my coffee and it makes me happy. 

I don't buy anything other than fresh brewed.

As far as Starbuck's go, this one is definitely middle of the road.  They do have some outside seating which is nice but inside is nothing to write home about.  Standard run of the mill furniture with a lot of small tables.  Lots and lots of white.  Definitely could use a bit more color and decoration to liven it up a bit.

Staff are friendly and attentive but the lines drag a bit in the morning.  Not a place you can typically get a regular coffee at say 8 AM and be out the door in under 2-3 minutes.  Looking at least at a 5-10 minute wait.    

It greats crowded on the weekends too and finding a seat inside is pretty tough by Noon.  Lots of students studying and to a lesser degree people working.  What is nice is that you have a bit more space than other Starbucks which is good if you need to spread out a bit to work.     

It's convenient for me because it is right around the corner but parking can be a bit of a drag at this location too.  If you need a Starbuck's fix or want to get here early enough to grab a seat on the weekend, this location works but if I wanted to enjoy a coffee I would probably walk up to one of the places in downtown Clayton instead.

I have been coming here for over a decade.   Small with the usual expectations.  A couple of outside tables are available.  WiFi is free but you have to ask what network. Four bucks for a grande cappuccino..

So far, so good. It's now open as of September 1st. The configuration is kinda weird- seating areas are long and narrow, so plenty (or all?) seats near a view outside to Market or New Jersey Streets. Always amazes me how many of Gess they can pack into such a small geography! One more spot for the die-hands to get their PSL. No drive-thru. That would be what I'd like to see in a downtown location, though I guess traffic would be an immediate issue.

These baristas are always talking and ignoring customers. I can see once in awhile but it never fails to be ignored like we are not here and there isn't 20 people waiting to get to work on time. I really need to find a new coffee spot

This is the most inefficient operation on the planet.  Last Sunday around 9, I drove up to this location, and as usual, it was completely backed up.  I parked my car next door at the dry cleaners to avoid having to wait in that line, which experience told me would take forever.  I entered the facility and there was no line.  I placed my order for 2 croissants, 2 blueberry muffins, and 6 vanilla scones, and because I was in a hurry, I told them to skip heating anything up.  All of the items were in the bakery display.  I was then directed to wait to receive my order because there were 15 orders ahead of me in the DRIVE THRU.  Nothing in my order had to be prepared; just tossed in a bag.  There were at least 5 people behind the counter working, but I was told "she is working as fast as she can".  So not only is this food overpriced (and frankly, most of it available at your local market), but the service is terrible.  When I told them I was not going to wait for them to service the entire drive thru customers first, and to either give me the food or a refund, the manager refunded my money and thanked me!  So, I drove to McDonalds on Olive where I placed my order, paid my money, and was out in less time that I spent at this Starbucks with nothing to show for it.

I can't believe I like this place!  It's against everything I stand for in coffee. Its known roast is black to the point of being charred.  Its beans are a week old or more, it's overpriced, and it's so sterile.  This location is no different.

But the people here are so nice.  The barista said that they could make me a Pike's Place brew with a pour-over method, which means a fresher cup than the standard brew urns.  It cost no extra, and it's fun to watch them.  Pike's Place is far better than their standard roast, since it's not nearly as bitter.  After I got my drink, I saw that they offered a blond roast, promising a not as dark a bean.

I approached the manager, who was extremely friendly, and surprisingly honest with some of his views.  Once I had to leave, he gave me a sample package of the blond roast to brew on my own.  I left this Starbucks happier than I had ever before.

If you're on the West Side and you're one of those poor saps who LIKES Starbucks, this is undoubtedly the best one in the area. I am so pleased with my experience.

I stop here a few times a week and every time I always say I shoulda done dunkin'.

This has to be the slowest drive through Starbucks has.  I've waited over 20 minutes multiple times for my drink.  On the days I go, I have to build an extra 15-20 minutes into my commute to make up for their slowness.

Thanks Starbucks

This is a pretty nice Starbucks location in my humble opinion.  However, it is small, very busy, and does not have a lot of seating.  It is suited for people like me--who come in to grab some joe--and leave quickly.  The staff is friendly and always has drinks ready quickly.

They still have AT&T WiFi. There were three of us this morning on our laptops and we were fine... but by the time our # reached five, the network was so slow I could barely work anymore... 

Please upgrade to Google WiFi and I'll be back!

A couple years ago I had a barista create something for me at my request of hot sweet & no caffeine. A steamed lemonade with passion fruit tea, not sure what the actual name is, but soo good when I'm not feeling coffee. I've had some Starbucks locations have no idea what I'm talking about when I try to order this, and some who are like oh yeah, no worries. I was pleasantly surprised that this location knew exactly what I was talking about. It was exactly as I remember sweet, tart and nice and hot.

1st trip to tampa this year. Missing my navigator. Coffee is always exact and I found the perfect shot mix this year. 4 shots of espresso, 1 Splenda , 1 sugar in a raw, then equal amount of skim mile. I would love to show my fining to my navigator..
The morning drive thru service at this location use to be amazing. Now the customer service is weak. They don't care about providing a quality product.

Should of read all the review before going here. This place is the worse Sbux I've ever been too. Lady is lecturing the worker in the middle of a rush....about forgetting to ask first hot or cold drink. Wtf! None of the staff are smiling they all look miserable...probably because of that "manager" time to replace her.
Nothing better than a hot cup of joe from the 'Bucks. Any time of the day there smooth and bold flavorful coffee beans give me a great pick up. Always a destination for me while traveling for work.
Check your order , there is possibility that they will miss one or more items. You will be charged but you won't get all items. It's very unethical business. It happened to me twice.

The location of this Starbucks is not the greatest. You'd think with it being right off I-10 it would be but it's very difficult to get out, especially if you have to make a right hand turn onto Ina.  The staff is very friendly, though, and that makes up for the traffic problems.

We all know Starbucks sucks in general. The coffee is cheap but overpriced. 

Starbucks has 50¢ refills that eventually become free if you use a gift card that you keep reloading. Cafes with coffee that's actually good don't do this, so I like it here if you want to drink 4 coffees in one sitting. Especially cold brew ends up being the cheapest per ounce.

The restrooms have codes, but they give it to random hobos who don't even buy anything?

Around 3-4pm during the school year (September-May), a bunch of twelve year old kids come in for free water and disturb customers. One even dumped out the water and filled it with the milk (that's for your coffee). The workers won't do anything about it.

At least 5 times, hobos came in and asked customers who were sitting for change. The workers wouldn't do anything about this either (even though you're not supposed to do this inside a business...).

but this location has the best window seats in the city for people watching, especially when it's raining or snowing.
Love this Starbucks! It's close and convenient for me, there is never a line and the employees are always fast and nice, too!

I usually don't leave bad reviews but today was definitely the last straw. This place is such a hit or miss. Sometimes it's good and sometimes it's like they make drinks with their eyes closed. How is it that I get a caramel frapp and I get no coffee in it. Maybe a dash of coffee was put in it? Starbucks is a coffee joint right? It tasted like nothing but creamer and water. Like seriously? How can you mess that up? I didn't even complicate the order like some ppl tend to do. I just ordered something right off the menu and you mess it up. Maybe I just need to find another Starbucks to go to.

When you place your order online and people that have ordered after you IN LINE get their order first, something isn't working. I ordered online and 5 people, who ordered after me, got their drinks before I did. Apparently, the barista never checked for the online order. WTF?!
Hey Starbucks! Don't push online ordering unless your people are trained to check for the orders. Again!!! WTF?!
Dropped my bagel and was clearly having a bad day.  They made me a new bagel which made my day.  Great customer service.  Thank you!

I was able to get my vanilla-bull$@&t thing in an exceedingly expedited manner, so what more can a highly caffeinated woman ask for in a Starbucks? Considering this location sees lots of traffic (it's a drive-thru Starbucks at the busy 96th Street and Meridian Street intersection), I was impressed with the efficiency of the staff, and that they got my order correct.

Stopped by for coffee for the road.  The teenage cashier tried to convince us to buy a bag of the tribute coffee so he could get some free food.  Then he told us that if he sold a million bags of it, he would get a BMW.  Slightly entertaining, yet off putting.  And the bathroom didn't have any toilet paper, only toilet seat covers, which is certainly becoming a trend.  Just not one I'm a fan of.

Love, love, LOVE my Starbucks - it's not secret.

This location offers up all the standard Starbucks fare but it's a tad smaller than most and the parking is limited :-(  You can only get into it from the St. A Trail or Bellerose Drive on one side of each road because it's in a high traffic area.  Consequently, it can take a little extra time compared to some of the more readily accessible locations.

Be sure to download the Starbucks App to your smart phone in order to earn stars for every purchase (Buy 12 get 1 free) and offers and discounts that are offered exclusively to the App holders such as an extra hour on Frappy 50% off days, B1G1 free from time to time, or the more frequently offered $1 off an espresso beverage.  

You can also put money on your app, link it to a gift card, or register for auto load with a credit card so that you can conveniently pay on your phone!

One tip if you're trying to get to Gold member status or earn more stars, request to pay for your purchases separately so that you can earn a reward star for each transaction.

Another thing is remember you can customize the drinks anyway you like.  For example, you can get a Frappuccino made your way - it's doesn't have to be made with the sugary base.  You can ask for it to be made with decaf espresso or made with dark roast coffee, milk of your choice, ice and a sugar free syrup if you want to go sugar free.   You can google all kinds of Starbucks off shelf or secret menu ideas/recipes for your next visit!  And if you're doing a LCHF diet, remember that you can always ask for your lattes or fraps to be made with half and half, heavy cream or whipping cream!  If you order any of their drinks as a "Breve" they will make it with half and half rather than milk.  

The point is, customize the drinks to what YOU want!

This used to be my favorite Starbucks location. However recently I have been extremely disappointed. I use the mobile order to get in and get out and skip the line. Within the last week I have placed 2 orders and when I arrive not only is my order not ready( I have no problem waiting a minutes) but it hasn't even been started. Disappointed Customer

This Starbucks drink quality is mediocre at best. It is always wrong, or tastes horrible. If it is here or McDonalds I'm going across the street. Sorry, I've tried this one a few times but just not wasting my time anymore.
Quick efficient, it was far enough away from the convention center to get a latte fast!

I wish this location was cozier and more inviting. There are no soft chairs or areas to sit and visit. It is loud, cold and hard. This atmosphere just makes me want to get my coffee and leave, rather than catch up with a friend or do  some work. There used to be a areas with big leather chairs, but they've been replaced by a counter that has people with their backs to the room. Disappointing.

Went to this location in the mall and ordered a mint mocha frapp.  The waiting area, which is a decent size for a mall location, was full and the line was almost out of the door.  I decided to order from the mobile app since the line wasn't moving. It was a good choice, because I was able to get my drink while people who were in front of me in line hadn't even ordered yet.  The barista that made my drink was friendly. I didn't observe any of the rude behavior that I noticed in other reviews.  There was a slight adjustment that needed to be made to my drink and the young lady promptly fixed it with a smile.  Considering it was a Saturday, the visit wasn't bad at all.  For the volume of people that they had, I think they did a good job.  My frapp was great (first time trying this flavor).

I've only been to this location a couple times and both instances were quite pleasant. The staff seems friendly enough, however one of the ladies taking my order seemed like she was a bit frantic or something. Maybe she was just wanting to close up for the night. Other than that lady I find the parking is in a little complex that is tough to navigate when it's as packed as it was. It's more or less exactly what I expect from a Starbucks. I have nothing bad to say about the drinks though. They're delicious.

This is a relatively new Starbucks in my greater neighborhood area. So far the experiences here has met my expectations.
Mobile ordering is easy as well as placing an order in person. At times the drive-through line can be long, but they still seem to push out coffee in a fairly speedy manner.

It's hard to believe this building used to be a smelly fish fast food joint. The remodel/ rebuild is a huge improvement from this locales past life !

I rarely give bad reviews. I always wonder is it the day...was it a specific employee but no...it's not. 

I have been in drive through and sat outside a few times now and find myself going elsewhere for a few reasons.

The drive through lines here are terrible even with 4 cars. I have been through many many...lines and gone through faster with a better service attitude that this one. 

We went in and had slow mediocre experience inside as well. There was one time a girl said she was there working from another SBX helped us and she was wonderful. Truly. 

Again, 3 o clock...4 people ahead and I was in the line for 20 minutes plus. The service via intercom was less than expected...and slow on top of it. 

Consistently this has been my usual experience here. Sad. I prefer to drive further on 60 for better service and atmosphere. It is a busy location but I have yet to enjoy my experience here. 

Sad.

Starbucks, lets give this place the ultimate great review..lol...ok here we go... Coffee sucks, noisy, service is the worst, not to mention that I feel in paying for a full meal.. Only reason IM here odd because my 14 yr old niece wanted something.. Limited places at the king of Prussia mall..

Very nice people.   My espresso was a generous 3 shot beauty.    Just what the cardiologist ordered to jump start my afternoon "groggies."    Nice large common table to sit at and ponder all 

Will be marking this one as a Reg.

Love love love this newly  created  drive thru starbucks & it has amazing seating as well as the outside hanging  place is to die for. I'm sure to be back in the near future. Fast service even when in a rush always smiling and never rushing always patient and willing to assist you with your  needs.

Went to this Starbucks today, we got a grande Caramel Macchiatto and a tall Skinny Vanilla latte in the drive thru. When we got home we found out our coffees not full, they didnt fill it up to the rim, there was only about 3/4 of coffee with the foam in them. We were disappointed.

This morning I decided to pick up an espresso at my favorite Starbucks on Speedway and Wilmot. Even though there were at least 6 cars ahead of mine, they managed to kindly take my order, get it right and with a smile. Thank you 

Update, I just stopped by on the way home to grab an iced tea and return a wireless cup/speaker. I wanted to buy a cup on display, but they had run out. I tried to write a thank you note to their adopted soldier deployed in Afghanistan but there weren't any more cards and none to purchase. Then I waited over 20 minutes and watched people come in after me and get taken care of, so I walked up and they asked what I'd ordered, so i guess my order was forgotten. Kind of a fail today, I'm glad I wasn't on my way to work. At least my Pineapple Black Tea tasted good.

I work in the shopping center and I am glad to have this specific Starbucks in the area. The staff is always helpful. And wait time is minimal. I recently started using the mobile order and by the time I walk over there my drink is ready to go.
I love are local Starbucks and you can go and ask them anything and they will make it right. The people their are very nice. I like how their selling water bottles, and cute coffee accessories.

Slowest Starbucks ever. I downloaded the yelp app and left this review in the time it took to place my order and get it, 2 cars back from the box. This isn't the first time. Very nice staff, and great new location. Couches outside are a nice touch. Please...pick up the pace!

Typical Starbucks, great location downtown. On the small side indoors, but there is seating outside. You get a mixture of tourists and locals that work downtown. Very close to Sundial shopping and restaurant area. Prices are the same as with most Starbucks.

I swing through the drive through on my way into the office, and they have drive through service down pat! Even when there is a long line of cars the flows through the adjacent parking lot I am through the line and on my way in no time flat.  Everyone that has assisted me at this locations has been super friendly.

Just opened Thursday, feb 11, 2016. It's already constantly packed solid. Being next to Villanova university, I'm sure they knew business would be good for them. My biggest gripe is there is no drive thru but aside from that, I'm very happy how centrally located it is. It's close to my house and near lots of things but also there is ample parking. I've never seen so many parking spaces around a Starbucks before. Getting in to Starbucks is easy enough.  But this is a very fast-paced Starbucks and not relaxing. It's crammed tight with college students, local middle school and high school kids and people on their laptops.  The seating isn't comfortable.  Mostly tables and no comfy chairs. Also, there is no noise control. It's very loud inside. This Isn't the best Starbucks I've been to but I think it fits the area and it's good for what it is. I will be back for sure.

The baristas here are great and it's definitely a great spot for people-watching on South Street if you are able to grab a window table/seat.  It's always busy but the service is very friendly and I have yet to receive an incorrect order.  Plus, they also have the Evolution Sweet Greens juice, which I haven't been able to find elsewhere.

This location is wonderfully convenient and a great place to stop in for some coffee on the way into work, since it's right by the entrance to the PA Turnpike. It's a decent size for not being a store to stick around and hang out in. They don't have drive-thru, but that's not too bad.

I usually use mobile orders for this store, and whenever I do that, my order is usually ready when I arrive. Not much more to ask for!

One of my favorite Starbucks.  It's perfect for when you need a hit of joe before you wander the ave for shopping or whatever, and open late-ish if you want a coffee for the drive home from Whyte.  If location is important for a coffee shop, then this spot (and the one a block east) is set.

The staff is quite friendly and while turnover is not superfast, I do notice the regular staff changes over quite often.  Having said that, they do make an effort to get to know you once you are pegged as a regular. 

The coffee is starbucks - that is to say quite good.  I laugh whenever I read a yelp review of a starbucks that starts off "I don't like starbucks" then goes on the slam the location.  If you don't like it, there are so many other options and life is short, so 'cmon.  
As for me, I don't mind admitting that the monkey on my back comes from Seattle. 

Clean, fast and located in a giant bookstore - not sure what else you need.

Mmmmm... Venti, triple expresso, vanilla bean late... Skinny of course :-)
No one does a late like Starbucks.  But for what they charge, they should be good.

A tiny point of contention though... Their drivethrough may be great for a Prius... But not a truck.  Get out and walk in.  The bonus is the smell of a coffee house will greet you as you walk through the doors and everything will be fine from then on.

I have fond memories and a great long-standing relationship with this Starbucks. Every time I drive in from Phoenix, I stop here to get my caffeine kick before driving to the in-laws.

On this current visit I realized this location moved over just by a building. The drive-thru is even better! They added a parking lot across the street if there isn't any parking right up by the door. 

It's a popular location for a sure scrumptious beverage. By the way, no more Einstein's...sad.

6 people working took 15 min to make a blueberry oatmeal never going inside again. How is it that after waiting 10 min someone has to ask you what you order for them to start making it. Horrible customer service!
Fastest drive thru ever!!  Don't be afraid of the long line, it goes fast!  So thankful to have this quick Starbucks so close to home and work!

Starbucks can be notoriously slow, but this one takes the cake. I know you're right on Monument Circle and get tons of traffic, but shouldn't you have a bigger Starbucks and more baristas to meet the demand? Guess not. 

The workers didn't seem too cheery and it took 15 minutes to get a free venti ice water. And the bathroom ran out of toilet paper, but they did restock it after a few minutes. 

*Note: they can get snippy if you try to use the bathroom but don't purchase anything.
I ordered a drink that comes with ice. What I received was ice that came with a drink. I now know that ice here costs $4.62.

Drive thru always gives a starbucks that extra boost.  I've been here about a dozen times with no negative experiences.  Coffee tastes the same each time, as I would expect (and hope), and this location never seems to be crowded.

This location went from a 2 star to a 1 star.. If 0 were an option I would have chose that. Today I bought a coffee thru the drive thru. Americano, sugar free vanilla with cream. Tasted completely burnt and sour and normally it's smooth and sweet. The rest of the day I was physically ill and had to stop everything I was doing and go home.. I'm guessing the creamer was spoiled cause they leave everything out, and didn't feel like getting a fresh one for there customers. I'll drive a little farther next time to go to a better location.

Once again, I'm here to give this Starbucks a bad rating. I frequent this location as I live across the street, but today, i heard the manager come over to a customer and tell him he had to leave if he didn't buy anything. I get it, but also, having worked at Starbucks, I know Starbucks is supposed to be a "second place" and by kicking someone out.. that doesn't exactly fulfill that "second place" saying. I'll add that there were about 4 other customers in the store, so in no way was this man taking up space as there were plenty of open tables. Ridiculous.
Life saver! Absolutely love the staff here, and the coffee is always amazing. If you want a good laugh with great coffee, I strongly suggest coming here!

Bad service, staff have attitude and doesn't look like they wanna be there. Please fix this issue, I work in retail also and I do understand frustrations with customers, but don't give attitude to those who did nothing to you.

This location is a danger zone for drivers and pedestrians alike, thanks to their drive-thru that has cars lined up in connecting streets. Drivers who can only be considered narcissists or morons will block traffic moving south from the busy immediate intersection to wait to make a LEFT turn---effectively cutting the line of more 'correct' cars blocking northernly traffic to make a right. Employees report the drive thru is 'always crazy' with police being called to deal with accidents and fender benders--sometimes more than once a day.

On my visit today, I parked across the street and was nearly hit by an angry truck driver who weaved out of his lane to go around a car waiting to make a left turn---the blocking driver had only shrugged her shoulders at all the incessant honking: 'golly, what can I do?' 

Get in the proper line; go to another starbucks; lock your door cuz someone is going to kill you. On purpose. With their bare hands.

Inside, customers inside waiting for hectic employees to service the drive/thru, which remained relentless (ok) and dangerous (not ok). 

Anyone see that story on how often police visit Walmarts due to disturbances? Add this Starbucks location in this affluent neighborhood as a contender.

Bottom line: Instead of walking to Starbucks, I either get into my car and drive to one further away, or realize my fondness for their breakfast sandwich and pumpkin latte is neither not worth dying for or increasing my carbon footprint and just, you know, make coffee at home like a sane person.

Also, manager Allison? It's unacceptable for you to talk that way to an employee in front of a customer, then interrupt his service to the customer and demand his attention and mea culpas while the customer watches and waits. 

I know the drive thru is stressing you out but still...

I spilled my coffee, luckily next to the manager, and she was more than accommodating. And, even though it was completely my fault, she got me another cup on the house. It's the little things that make a place great and she seems to have a grasp on that. Thanks again!!
Super friendly service, some of the staff even knows my name by now.  :)  Also, they're great at offering suggestions for when I want to change up my usual order and try something new.

This is my favorite location! I love Adam, Ana Lee, Jasmine, and several others...I'm really bad with names and have a hard time remembering all. But pretty much all of them know me by name lol :)
They are all awesome!
Drinks are always on point, no matter how crazy mine get!!
They are real and are not fake. And handle rude people really well for what I've observed!
Great place open late (11pm) on a weeknight, I think even later on the weekend.  Needed a traveler late (family pack) and they were very gracious to get it ready for me right at closing time.

Okay I've been to a lot of Starbucks in my life but this one is my new favorite. I can easily get through the drive thru in 3 minutes even with a longer line. The staff is super friendly, and my drink is perfect every time! Keep up the good work guys!

What is different about this Starbucks is that it's situated next to a lake. There's outdoor seating, and it's got a nice view.

However, the parking is terrible. There are only four or five spaces on a tiny stretch of asphalt next to the shop, and the parking is terrible if you enter the lot from the "wrong" direction. Exiting is also a nightmare.

As stated before, I love Starbucks! This location is located in the French Quarter so it was very busy most times I went. I visited there about three times during my stay. The first time, I ordered my favorite caramel macchiato which was sweet like I like it; however they forgot to give me my cookie so after waiting in an extremely long line, I had to wait even longer. L On my second trip, I only ordered my favorite drink which was made to perfection again, but the barista was extremely slow so where as the line was not very long at all, I still waited FOREVER! On my third and final trip, the cashier forgot to give my drink order to the barista. I received my breakfast sandwich (sausage, egg and cheese, which was mediocre) in a timely manner, I had to bring my forgotten drink to the attention of the barista, who provided my drink (perfect againJ) very quickly. So there were a lot of pros and cons with my experiences here; however it was conveniently located and I would probably visit again if in the area.

Slowest. Service. Ever. 
Why order thru mobile app? It's to save time and be convenient. It doesn't save time and is not that convenient. There is no sense of urgency nor the feeling like they are interested in great service. This location used to be great.

Wow, this is not a great Starbucks!  It's location is what it is (forget it if you're heading west on Germantown Pike -- this is for the eastbounders only).  The bathroom seemed old and kind of dirty, which is  unusual for a Starbucks and the store seemed a little crummy as well.  It wasn't terrible -- they made my drink just fine, but it just wasn't as nice as their stores usually are.  I guess I go to Starbucks with a certain expectation of their standard and this store does not seem to meet it.

I absolutely love this Starbuck's location!  I work in this building and I have to say the crew here led by Zeb is amazing.  They are located right in the hustle and bustle of downtown Indy on the Circle so it is constantly busy yet the line is always flowing.

They are friendly, generous, attentive and fast.  They remember our orders and our names and they always have a great upbeat attitude.  When asked, the team enthusiastically gives spot on suggestions as well as clarifications when you don't quite know or understand how to ask for what you want.

I watched a biography of the history of Starbuck's this weekend on CNBC and feel that Howard Schultz would be proud of this location, they definitely embody the Starbuck's philosophy and culture.

I get a Grande Pike everyday and it really is just a better cup of coffee.  The outdoor seating is nice too in the summer, great people watching as there is always something going on on the Circle.

Good place, scenic view and nice coffee. You can sit out and enjoy the calm pace of the nature.
Parking could be a issue

It is unfortunate this Windermere Starbucks service is the one of the worst location by far since I'm a resident of this neighborhood. The drive through is slow, the barista is not always trained well. Oh did I mention they are generally unfriendly as well? My life experience with Starbucks has always been good as I was offered with courtesy and complimentary drink when mistake or inconvenience happened. But never been the same with Windermere location. This is the reason why I go to Ellerslie location when I have the time. Today, I had to walk-in to the store to pay my drink in the drive through line because the debit machine was broken. Obviously, no apology or courtesy was shown for this inconvenience. Sorry for this review... But this location need new management!

Great service, great atmosphere and great coffee! Parking is limited ans seating inside can get cramped, but it is still one of my favorite locations.  It's a little like Cheers, where everyone knows your name!  Why don't people who go often use the Starbucks cards, don't people realize that after so many drinks you get a free one!  If you are getting a drink anyway, put it on a card and register it and get the reward.  It just makes sense!
Never sat in there and had my coffee before,but, I must say this is one of the cleanest and quietest locations I've been to. Really nice and efficient staff, as well.

The workers at this starbucks are so friendly, whether its 5 am or 11am. I like coming here to change up my regular study spots. There are a lot of tables where you will see people doing work.
It gets quite crowded on weekends.

Note- they will be closed all next week for a renovation! They did not know what it would look like but they said they think there will be more room for standing in line !

It's Starbucks - it should be the same around the world. However, this is the most sluggishly slow staff I think I've ever seen! The lady at the till took my order wrong and after giving me my total had to correct it based on the wrong size. The lady in front of me is waiting for her drink to be remade as she ordered - decaf - and I still stand hoping  the four baristas will get their act together so that I can get on with my Saturday! I'll drive to another location next time.

My second time here to the Starbucks location not much to say about this location it has the same like other Starbuck locations such as  WIFI, Coffee, cups, indoor/outdoor seating with umbrellas.  The service is great when not busy and when in busy expect wait times in the drive thru in mid afternoon time due to being next to the shopping centers, mall and restaurants.  Never had any type of my order when ordering for myself or a family member.
The staff are highest quality.  If anything is not to your liking, they will make it over.  They care enough to do that!  They care who you are and what your orders are.  And they can converse!!!

I'm not going to waist everyone's time reviewing the coffee and food at Starbucks.  We all know what's what with this ginormous chain.  Let's talk about what might be a little different about this Starbucks.

1. Everyone complains about parking at Starbucks.  Many of their parking lots are very tight.  Bryn Mawr is legendary for being almost impossible.  The good news is the Havertown location is middle of the road.  It's really not bad.  Most of the time you can get a space without a ten point turn!

2. This location has had a recent remodel.  The new décor is contemporary.  I'm not a fan but it's new and clean and neat.  More importantly it's designed for staying a while especially if you have Wi-Fi.  There is a central table that seats nine.  Very nice for spreading out to study.

This is a decent Starbucks with a nice internal design.  It's worth visiting!

Parking is pretty bad here so unfortunately lose a star. And if you are on Germantown PK its really only accessible if you are heading EAST. And the place could use a good dusting and window cleaning.
Staff is professional and very nice. The coffee was hot and good and the cinnamon roll was light, airy and tasty.

I really dislike this Starbucks location. They never put whipped cream on my drinks when I always specifically say I want whipped. 

The drinks taste the same as every other location, besides the missing whip. 

Their drive thru is also terribly designed. If there are more that 3 cars in line you have to wait in the road or middle of the lot and hope no one cuts in front of you.
Starbucks + Drive thru = HEAVEN!!!! Staff is great, friendly and knowledgeable.

Nice sized Starbucks inside. Drive thru is never super packed and they've always gotten my order correct in the drive thru. Tonight I placed a mobile order and they almost forgot an item but they quickly corrected it and apologized. Baristas are friendly and helpful though.

I love this Starbucks! It's very close to my house which is an obvious plus. The staff is amazing they always take the time to say hi even when they are so busy!  I love that this Starbucks had a drive thru for those days I don't have time to go in, even then they know its me. Love this place!!
Slow service and unpleasant (maybe new) baristas to deal with- not all but most of them. They're lucky that it's off next to the corridor of i4.

I go here about 4-5 times a week and the staff is always very quick and friendly. They always get my order right!

The only problem I have is the drive through is hard to turn out of.

The location of this Starbucks is convenient as well as the drive thru.  However, each time I have been in the drive through, I have had to wait for almost 10 minutes to get my drink.  I began to go inside hoping the service would be faster...I was mistaken.  I agree with many of the other reviews that this is the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to.

This is the closest starbucks to my house. Not bad most of the time, standard. They drive me crazy cause I request light ice on cold drinks as they fill the cup and you end up with about a third of a cup of fluid. If I don't get light ice the 4 dollar drink is gone by the time I get home. Ordered light ice today and they filled the cup. I think I'll just skip this starbucks aND stop at one where I'm not paying for ice instead of a beverage.
Very slow, the drinks are always wrong and it looks like it's our fault when we say it's not what we ordered.

I was starving and needed coffee desperately when I stopped by this location. It was a cold day outside so needless to say all the indoor seating was taken. The barista was very friendly and was quick about getting my coffee started. My spinach wrap was a different story. It seemed to take awhile and when they said it was ready, it was a breakfast sandwich. Apparently another customer had taken my wrap. The barista apologized and started another wrap for me.
They served it as soon as it was ready, which meant it was super HOT.
The taste was good though.
Not my favorite Starbucks location, but not bad.
Maybe one day they will learn how to properly prepare the oatmeal. Or, maybe I should just stop coming to this one.

I had such a welcoming experience this morning at this Starbucks, which is so hard to come by. An older women was very accommodating and helpful during our order and even made us a free drink for me to try. A younger lady was talking to us about college and making sure she got our order right :). I love this location!! Truly made a great start to our day

If you enjoy breathing carbon monoxide while sitting in the drive-thru for 20 minutes, then this is the Starfux for you!  My aunt was in from St. Louis and friending for some of their Joe, so I had no choice but to stop.  20 minutes later, she got her used-to-be-hot latte and I got my used-to-be-frozen frap.
This location is always so kind & polite, even when it's extremely busy & there's a little bit of a wait they are so delightful.

If I could leave no stars I would ... The worst Starbucks ever! 

Passing through from Siesta Key going back home to Jersey, all you want is some good old Starbucks coffee to make your long road a tat bit easier ... Well not with this Starbucks!

Not only are they slow for over 5 people behind the counter, they also leave out your order so basically you just standing there waiting for nothing. Ordered two grande coffees, one decaf, the young lady behind the counter walked over to the coffee pot and poured me two medium cups FROM A VENTI CUP THAT WAS STANDING THERE ALREADY MADE! When asked which one is decaf, she hesitantly pointed at the one closest.  Puzzled I took a sip, not surprised, it was cold and tasted exactly the same. 

Luckily, or not so lucky, it wasn't just me that had their order jacked up. Several people turned their orders back. 

Just the worst service, I had gas station coffee better done!

I am a regular at this Starbucks because it happens to be on my way to and from work every day.

There are many reasons why I continue to come back other then the fact of convenience, those being;

The barista's are always so friendly and polite; every time I've gone, they're smiling and casually making polite chatter with the customers.

The service is generally very prompt even during the busy morning hours.  When they do fall behind, they always apologize and sometimes depending on how backed up they are and how long you have been waiting, they give you your drink on the house as an apology.

This Starbucks has either drop in or drive thru so it's fairly convenient during the winter season when you don't really feel like getting out into the cold to drop in.  They also serve a variety of different delectable treats and delicious foods.

I've only had one "bad service" with this location and that was that I ordered a venti, paid for a venti and was given a grande. I contacted them and advised the mistake and was apologized to profusely and mailed coupons.  I appreciated that they took notice of their mistake & promptly fixed it.

I had the weirdest experience here yesterday. I've been coming to this Starbucks for a few years now, it's convenient, the staff is friendly (I love Hunter!he's so sweet!) and my drink is always made right. I usually use the drive thru but yesterday I walked into the store to have a coffee date with my mom. So I order a frapp for myself and a pike place coffee with milk for my mom. The girl at the register served my mom's coffee with no milk and she served her espresso roast. So I take it back and request the coffee be changed to pike and with milk. She serves the pike and then tells me there's half n half at the bar. And I'm like "I would like milk please" and she again tells me there's half n half at the bar. So now I'm just staring at her with a confused face because I'm not asking for half n half lol I was asking for milk. Finally she rolls her eyes, puts milk in the coffee and rudely slides it to me. It was so weird! Is there some sort of "no milk in coffee" policy at Starbucks that I wasn't aware about? I don't understand why she gave me such a hard time about milk in coffee.
Great staff! Very helpful with questions and very friendly! The store could use some attention though as far as straightening and cleanliness goes. Wifi does not work on their patio.

I know Starbucks is known for their coffee, but I love love love thier Spinach Feta Wrap!!!  The coffee is pretty consistant from location to location, and I've noticed the staff is always super friendly.  

The Edwardsville location is no different.  Good coffee.  Good food.  Friendly staff.  = AWESOME.

Horrible!!! Waited over 10 minutes for a decaf coffee at 7:00 at night! Don't most people drink decaf at night? Got half a cup and I couldn't wait anymore. Never offered a free cup. Rip off!!! I'm so mad. Why can't Starbucks understand that some people can't have caffeine. Should have went to Wawa for the $1 coffee. Would have gotten it 10 minutes quicker and wouldn't have waited 10 minutes for half a venti THAT I PAID FOR!!
This Starbucks is very consistent. Food is on point, their chai tea latte is properly mixed, and staff was friendly. All you can ask from a place of business!

Does not accept Starbucks gift cards. Had my gift card in hand on the counter the entire time while ordering. Only came to Starbucks to use a gift card and ended up having to use cash. Manager was actually the one to take my order.

Can every Starbucks be like this one? The staff here is amazing! So kind and they always wants the customer experience to be great. And...guess what??? Even when other area Starbucks stores never seem to have things in stock that I want...basic things...this location is always well supplied.  It's spacious and clean.  Mainly I like it here the most as the people who work here really care.  This location should be the one all others strive to be like. The customer experience is stellar. Bravo! Best Starbucks on the planet!

Always fast, with friendly service! This little neighborhood Starbucks doesn't ever seem to have a time when they aren't busy, and that's a great thing! And they have a very extensive staff favorites list, which is always fun to try!

This is a good Starbucks for studying. It has multiple tables and plugs for studying with laptops. I also like the bar area, a little noisy but a good distraction at times for watching the barista make drinks.

Came on a late Saturday morning.  Not crowded, right before lunch time.  People behind the counter were much more interested in their very involved (and loud) conversations than actually serving the customers.  Very long wait time for my drink, and then, when I finally got it, it was wrong.  Baristas here are clearly not paying too much attention to what they're getting paid to do.  Several other customers before me had gone to sit down to wait for their drinks because it took SO long.  This poor service is unusual for a Starbucks, in my experience.

We will start with the good, this particular Starbucks is located just off of I-4 and is open 24 hours a day.  After that though, it kind of heads downhill.  When we stopped in, it was late afternoon, and nobody else was in there.  For whatever reason, it still took way too long to make a few simple drinks.  Another reason for the low rating, there is no place to really hang out here, as there is with just about every Starbucks.  No chairs or couches, the place is purely built for you to go in and out, and that is all.  Overall, just not the Starbucks experience I am used to getting.

The workers here were super nice and let us try samples and everything,
definitely recommend
Big fan. This place was busy. They were fast, so the wait went fast. The employees were friendly. And as busy as they were, the was very clean.

we've been walking here at least twice a week with our dog for the last several years and i'm happy to say their coffee has improved (it somehow tastes less scalded)--either that or my taste buds have fallen prey to their insidious corporate homogenization. the baristas are friendly, though they quite often have a  bunch of young gals that are pretty clueless and may have to retrain their listening skills--at least they always make sure you're happy with your order.
 this place gets crazy busy sometimes, which is half the fun if you're into people watching. we sit outside and watch the hectic parking lot and can help you with two simple TIPS: 1.) it's often faster to go inside 2.) don't park your car next to the drive through line when it's busy. lastly, you can ask for the misters to be turned on when it's hot out. 
 although this in not the coffee shop my PNW heart yearns for, and something inside me dies every time i come here, they're conveniently close to me and to other fun shopping spots, have a nice patio and their drinks are now more consistent. my detraction of stars stems mainly from some of their corporate practices (no recycle, still using #5 plastics and no effort to reduce waste, stupid lingo, price, froo-froo menu items that take forever to make and hold up the line), rather than their occasional sub-par barista.

I love this Starbucks.  The baristas are always incredibly friendly and helpful.  Case in point, on Sunday, the barista made my nonfat vanilla steamer and declared that he didn't like the way the milk foamed and would therefore be making me a new one!  Ah-mazing!
Make sure you always get your receipt back. They just tried to not give me 5 dollars back. Disappointed in Starbucks. Smh

I realize the Carmel Apple Spice is probably the least exotic drink on your menu...but if you can't be bothered to make it correctly...then stop selling it...today I paid $3.54 for a cup of warm Apple juice..No...whip cream No...carmel sauce....Come on guys...Really????

I really like the layout of this Starbucks.  There is a variety of seating choices (long wooden benched tables, small armchairs, and standard tables, with outdoor seating as well), with plenty of electric sockets for laptop use.  And being that this Starbucks isn't the biggest, I think they use the space nicely.  My drinks have always been made just fine here, and the baristas are friendly.  Parking is pretty easy, so what more could you ask for?  A great location to stop at after a morning workout at Spectrum!

What can you say about Starbucks. They have their quality down, their coffee down, and their pastries too down! ;-) So I hold the staff's feet to the fire. These people rocked it. They were friendly, polite, and extremely helpful! 
I was tongue tied in ordering my "Skinny Venti Vanilla Latte! After we all laughed, I was schooled on the right way to order it! Their restrooms are always clean. That's huge to Gigi, the Mega-Princess! :-P The local bulletin board was filled with resources. I have to say this is one Big Corp Cuppa I enjoy! And this particular store rocks!

I feel like I need to write this because this is a recurring problem at this location that is absolutely ridiculous and frustrating. 
This morning I placed a mobile order for a Venti iced tea at around 522. I got to the location at 5:30 that means there was eight minutes to make an iced tea. When I got there my order was not done. I continue to wait another eight minutes for my drink. Meanwhile there were three people working there. Two people inside and the one on drive-through. When I got there she asked me my name and I told her she told me she was working on it while she continue to do the drive-through and I continued to wait. The girl at the front did not do anything. She was talking to another employee instead of helping the girl on drive-through. My issue with this is that there's a sign that says if you wanna skip the line order on the mobile app. If I wanted to sit and wait another eight minutes for my drink then I would've simply gone to the drive-through or just order it when I got there. This is not the first time that this is happened at this location. Every time I order on the app I'm waiting for my beverage. This is absolutely insane. Why advertise skipping the line when you are constantly waiting for everyone else that is already there. This is simply poor customer service. And to top it all off my drink was not done properly. This is also an issue at this location because sometimes when I get my drink there is a ton of dragon fruit and sometimes there's about two pieces. Inconsistency is a major problem here. This location is most convenient on my way to work however I will be driving a different route just to avoid this happening again.
Great just like any Starbucks, just loses a star because if the amount of beggars out in the street in front of it and that come inside and harass the people

I'm a little hesitant to post this review, but recently I've been having a lot of meetings at Starbucks. I prefer Raging Sage, but Starbucks seems to be convenient for most people. So yeah, I give four stars for convenience. And they make my Americano right! I don't have to coach the barista on the fact that I don't want water in my iced American. Surprisingly, they don't even add water to an iced Americano, so they earn points again for convenience! There's really nothing on the Starbucks menu that I ever crave, so it's just nice to know that when I do have a meeting scheduled at Starbucks, that I don't have to make a pitstop at Raging Sage before or after.

This location is HORRIBLE!! You wait in line forever inside and at the drive through!  The drive through is set up so if there is more than 3 people in line you are blocking parked cars. The staff can be so obnoxious and rude! Forget about ordering a cold drink  by the time you get to the window the ice is melted! If you can, avoid this location!

ugh.  how many starbucks does one town need?

answer: zero.

avoid this corporate piss palace and support your local mom & pop coffee shop. 
try Reds or Muddy Waters

if i could give negative stars i would most definitely do it.

I just love starbucks and this one rocks!  There is one female manager who is always on top of things and very personable.  The staff are always very nice, they remember your orders and are good w/ my boys.

Hey it's a Starbucks. Hard to tell them apart except for the staff. They do a rotation between Newtown and Heacock road. Starbucks embodies the ultimate McDonaldlization of society. Regardless of your staff you can always for the most part get what you want and it taste fairly similar. I.e. friers on the right levers on the left. So what I'm saying for an organization that is not franchised, who really runs them. Typically it's going to be your students and possibly mid level managers. Customer service is paramount. I think the idea for many customers is they like to build relationships and see that familiar face at each location consistently of the staff.  I've noticed that both customers and employees seem to be discouraged when they are store hopping. It feels good when you walk in welcomed by your first name and they know what your order is. I think that a Starbucks cared they would stop the movement and allow those relationships to form. Their sales would increase their ability to upsell would increase as well. It's all about relationships folks. I give three stars not because of the staff because of the executive management that does not value this type of relationship. I believe training is the underlining cause. Which probably breeds inefficiencies if someone does not want to move as the incentive is to excel to run the store. But this is only for the short term as Starbucks has a high attrition rate as this is only a stepping stone.
I go here pretty regularly because location is convenient. But I find the quality of service here to be consistently poor compared to other Starbucks.

This store is the slowest. I have worked in the food industry for 4 years so I understand being backed up. But every single time I come here it is backed up. They are never consistent with drinks either. I've had to repeat my mobile order and wait over 20 minutes for my drink.

Update from the last review. The rating will be base on a category rating system.

Drive-thru:
If you are one to want some coffee first thing in a morning then give the drive thru a pass. You will end up waiting in line for around 10-15 minutes. Katherine is absolutely one of my favorite drive thru employees. As you pull up to the window, she tends to greet you and ask you about your morning. 
Rating: 7/10

Mobile Order:
The app is pretty easy to use. If you are curious on if they have your favorite bakery then the app will tell you if the item is sold out or not. If you do place a order before you arrive there then be sure to pick up your order quickly (less than 5 minutes). I have had my order stolen from me before I got to pick it up. 
Rating: 5/10

Inside:
The interior has a nice cozy and rustic feeling. If you are hoping to get some quiet reading done or work on some homework better bring some noise cancelling headphones. It can get a bit loud at times. 
Rating: 8/10

Total score: 20/30 (66%) 

Drive-thru: 7/10
Mobile: 5/10
Inside: 8/10
Very good drinks but the music they play is awful! And also too loud. I would probably pull my hair out if I worked here and had to listen to it all day.

To be clear this is the stand alone Starbucks on Rt 38.  It's new, has a drive thru and a decent little sitting area outside.  It's open early so I stopped twice after walking at Cooper River. Bad service.  Very unconcerned about a customer being in the store.  The first time I thought I just got the staff on a bad day.  Tried again and it was even worse.  Four staff, nobody even facing the customer area. Just standing around, two with their backs to me.  Nice big store with nice early hours but who needs to get that kind of attitude early in the morning?
Aleq has done an amazing job turning this location around.  The staff is very friendly and very professional. I'm here 2-3 times a day 5 days a week. Keep up the great work coffee friends!

I have stopped here on several occasions with each and every visit ending on a poor experience. Out of all the SB stores in Tampa this has to be on the bottom of the list. I have been given luke warm coffee on one occasion and coffee without sweetener on my last visit. I only complain due to the fact that as we all know first thing in the morning when your in that morning wake up funk all you crave is a great cup of SB wake me up. It's a total bubble buster to leave the drive thru with your expected cup of happiness and end up tasting some blah tasting cold java....I don't believe I will be giving this SB a third attempt..Sad to say I will be avoiding this location and opt for one I have had better luck at...
Large dining area, quick service, friendly staff at this location. If you like Starbucks, this is a good one.

This is one of my favourite places to meet friends or colleagues for a coffee/tea when the weather is nice.  The outdoor patio is great with lots of tables and chairs that aren't crammed close together that you can hear every conversation around you.  It's in a great are too.

If weather doesn't permit to sit outside, there isn't a lot of seating inside and it can get cramped.  Some of the table and chairs are close together and most are for tables of 2.  It also can get busy during coffee break time and I have been where the line up is to the door.  The waiting area for drinks can get crowded too.

Will keep coming back when the weather is nice to enjoy the patio!

This rating has nothing to do with the drink.
It is all about the service.  It was horrible. Since when does Starbucks give bad service?
I felt unwelcomed when I entered the store. I wasnt greeted. It felt like they wished people weren't there.

They were busy complianing about another guest while I was placing my order. That is not something I wanted to listen to at the counter.  When I was handed my drink, I was not handed a straw. I walked over to self-service counter to get one and there was not venti straws. So when I went back to counter to ask for one, she huffed about me interupting her rant.
Really??? If you focus on customer service and speed drink prep, customers would be happier.
Maybe this is why I go to the other store on 96th street. They are way more friendly.
A bunch of rude college kids rushing your orders. They often get our order wrong. We stopped going there.  I'm not supporting any business that won't respect paying customers .

I love Starbucks. I am a barista at Starbucks but this location is ALWAYS slow and they ALWAYS mess up my tall vanilla latte in a Grande cup with whip cream. It's really not a complicated order and I'm saying that from working at the busiest Starbucks in the world.

On my way to work just back from class I thought I'd stop at Starbucks and I am so glad I did. I had to reload my card with a credit card which I thought you know all of this going to take a little while it  was so quick so easy Sophia was amazing she was in the drive thru window. It's so refreshing to start your day off right. Thanks again Sophia

Great location and friendly baristas! Perfect reason to stop in for coffee and read. I'm always happy with my cup of joe here! 

 The pastries are usually limited, not sure if it's because people have a major sweet tooth in the area or they are under stocked. Seating is a bit sparse but they have a few tables outside for a sunny day.
Good morning! I hear this every time I come in. The staff knows my name and my order before I reach the counter. Nice. I prefer Starbucks over the others.  Good place for good coffee and good people.

Unbelievable.  I sent two of my kids in (12 and 15) to get drinks and when one of them asked to change the order for one drink they returned to the car telling me that they were not permitted to make the change.  I had to go in personally and show my face, at which point they acquiesced.  Really?? We spend $$$ at this place each month -- many people do.  What a blatant effort to bully young people .. why?  It was early evening and the place was deserted.  For the record, this was 6/8/19 around 6:30 at night.  The young woman who was working that evening should be fired.

The service at this Starbucks is always just okay. I frequently go between this store and the Starbucks on Pantano and Speedway as well as Kolb and Broadway. The customer service at the other stores is always far superior.  I come here because it is convenient and very close to Trader Joes!

I am a daily Starbucks junkie. Gotta have it. I usually only go to this location when I am too lazy to get out of my car. This location has messed up every latte I order. Never fails. Line is sometimes long-sometimes slow. When I came to this location on a regular, they never recognized my voice to my drink and name like the Big Bend location does. Not usually friendly-maybe because it's so close to UT?

Starbucks is as Starbucks does, and sometimes it does pretty good. What does that even mean? Well, I guess it means the seating is relatively ample (not a ton of spots, but spread out well) and the folks who work here are pleasant.  The food - well, it is still a Starbucks, so it's overpriced and under-filling(?!) but the pastries will do in a pinch, and the coffee is fresh and hot so overall, it's a decent place to read or study or chat.
Pretty big with outdoor tables. Convenient location at a mall complex with a drive thru window. Free wifi is nice. AC is blowing. Floors and tables are dirty and trash needs taking out.
i had to wait 20 minutes for my caramel macchiato. 20 minutes! no thank you. i really didn't enjoy coming to this location

Wah!  The local coffee house I used to visit when I was in this area went under!  Bah!

Well, a man has gots to have his mocha, if you know what I mean.  Hmm.  OK, that sounds dubious at best.

Anyway, I went to the local Starbucks instead after discovering the local independent was gone.  Service was actually friendlier than the last time I visited a Starbucks.  But the coffee was not up to even Starbucks normal standards.  Espresso in my mocha was off...did they change their espresso roast since my last visit to this chain?  Or was it just burnt or something?  Is Starbucks losing consistency?

Iced coffee was old/had a really weird taste. The manager tasted it after I brought mine back and agreed and made me an iced americano instead! So there was a mess up but they were so awesome about it!

I had to come here because my favorite cafe (little bean) is closed on Sunday's. I used the drive thru which is a nice feature and the drink was made to my specifications so I really can't complain. But recently I've been trying to stay away from any chain retailer. I know this is pretty much impossible but with Starbucks they also burn their coffee beans which ruins the espresso. Also the automation of the whole process takes something away from the quality. Just for example, I would NEVER order a Espresso Macchiatto from them.

I had a little time before an evening event began and didn't want to drive all the way home just to turn around and head back again, so I stopped in for an hour or so at Starbucks. Typical Sbux.. fast counter service and friendly baristas. The one thing that stuck out at me was the limited seating space inside. Lots of empty tables outside (like.. all of them because it's WINTER) but people were standing around waiting on tables inside. It was a nice enough day that had they had portable heaters outside, I think people would have been out there.. I know I would have been.

Hands down the worst Starbucks in the area. In this place last week.  Counters dirty.  One person working the counter and making the coffee.   Waited FOREVER.  They don't respect the customer's time.  I seriously wonder if they actually have a manager at this location.  Does he/she work from remote and not see what is going on? The baristas are SLOPPY.  Last two cups of coffee were dripping down the sides.NOT PRETTY.

Stopped in to get coffee for my long ride back home as I'm from out of state, and was very happy with the customer service from the staff! The young lady (wow that makes me sound old, lol) who took my order was very pleasant! The store is beautiful & if I had the time, I wud have loved to stay awhile & enjoy the atmosphere!! And of course my coffee was simply to die for! Thanks for giving me a really nice moment in my day!!
Love my hometown Starbucks! friendly staff, clean store, spacious door patio and excellent coffee.

Lovely to look at, but impossible to love. 

The setting alongside Lake Afton is as pretty as a postcard, but the 3 car parking lot is ridiculously inadequate. It makes a difficult traffic location that much worse, forcing people to focus on parking rather than driving.  Double and illegal parking happen every day, creating a dangerous condition. Amazing that the Yardley government permitted Star$$$ to do this.  

The coffee is the same as everywhere else, which to me is poor to average for the basics, but decent if you fall prey to the insidious upsell pressure to go latte or capp in order to be able to imbibe the burnt tasting brew. 

The facility is pleasant once inside, with windows facing Main Street or the lake. It is also a front row seat to the near miss accidents that routinely happen there.

I love this Starbucks because of their employees: they are always so friendly and professional! I have a great experience whether I use the drive-thru or go inside. Even though they can be very busy in the morning, I have never had a bad experience at this location. Thank you!!

This starbucks is at a busy intersection and the parking lot always seems to be full or almost full when I come here. Despite the limited parking, I really like this one. It's a starbucks so you're basically going to get a standard as far as food and beverages go, but I have to say I had a really great customer service experience there yesterday. The girl taking my order was incredibly friendly and very cheerful. The girl making my drink even started a brief conversation with me while she was making my drink. They always ask for your name when they're busy so they can keep track of drinks, but they weren't busy and asked for mine anyway and then called me by it through the experience. 

I hit this place on my way to baltimore sometimes, so although it's a mile and a half off of 95, I don't mind the extra time it takes to get here if I get friendly service

Worst Starbucks experience I've had. I was the only person in line and wasn't acknowledged for quite a while. Till person was sub par, and made me feel weird. Bar person had a headset on the entire time - which I would understand if she was talking to drive through customers - but I could tell quickly that she was talking to her coworker through it (the till girl). She made no contact with me. I've worked for SBux before and this was the worst experience I've had.

It really catches me off guard when I swing by this location with about 30 other people in line most of the time, yet somehow the staff here is ALWAYS as nice and courteous as they can be. This is probably my favorite Starbucks around.

Starbucks is, of course, something I love to indulge myself with and by indulge I mean purchase on a semi-regular basis, but who's counting? My go-to drink is always the same and, like McDonalds, Starbucks does what it does well and with uniform predictability. My grande non-fat iced dirty chai always tastes exactly the same. Same goes for muffins, breakfast sandwiches, and of course the occasional cake pop.

So, why three stars? Everyone else said it - parking lot and drive-thru are about as cramped as can be. It can get messy when you are parked in the lot and can't get out b/c the drive-thru is backed up - or when you want to leave the window and there's someone trying to turn onto Kennedy from Dakota... nightmare! My advice, backtrack to platt or cleveland. Anyway, other than that, the location is fine and the staff is friendly! I can't say i'd really want to sit out there at night, unfortunately, though, so that sort of takes away from the coffee house charm.

Quiet atmosphere inside, mostly people popping in for quick orders or set up with laptops. Frequent business meetings, which makes sense, since it's in a good central location.
Slowest starbucks I've ever been to. Waited in the drive thru line well over 10 minutes! Ridiculous!
Love the fact that they have a drive thru service. Saves me time and fills me caffeine addiction before going to work.

This is my all-time favorite Starbucks location! I have been a loyal Starbucks Gold Card member for some years.
