There have been a lot of Good, even some great locations... but this one by far is my favorite. It is very convenient for me because it is on my way to work, but there are times I have had to go to other locations for different reasons. Every time I do, I am disappointed because of the HIGH BAR this location has set. The manager is exceptionally helpful, friendly and professional. The staff is AMAZING. Friendly, upbeat, proficient. I have never had problems with my order. They're smiles make my day! KUDOS! I'm a fan! 
~Annie Kidd

We were staying at a nearby hotel, mobile ordered, and picked up our food at the hand off plane! Our order was not quite ready for us but almost! There was not much of a connection at the handoff but our food and beverages were great! We will return on our trip!

Went for lunch since I work 12 hour shifts, coffee is needed to get through the day. Only get a 30 minute window to run out. Traffic can be rough depending on when I go due to the mall and turnpike. Got there and ordered. Was very nice and energetic. Coffee was good and I was out in minutes. They were all attentive and the place was clean. Perfect place for a quick trip at lunch if you're in the area.
Literally the worse customer service. The only thing that is consistent here is the lack of good service.

It gets really busy here both inside and drive-thru.  The parking lot layout is designed poorly and can be a hazard for those using the drive-thru.  It's also hard to get out of the plaza during certain times if you are trying to get back on Brandon Blvd.

The place needs a little tidying up.  There are lots of crumbs, napkins, and spills on the tables and floors.  Trash cans are overfilled and lots of flies hovering inside.  Great location but the inside of the store needs a some attention.

One star was even difficult! Completely got my 1 drink wrong which is understandable but  major attitude and Mage you feel like it was your fault!!! not very welcoming at all. Should have gone to lacolumbe up the road!! Starbucks is definitely not like it use to be!!

My last review was made out of frustration with the staff that week. But now that my regular baristas are back, I'm back in my happy place. The service from the regular staff is incredible- very happy and they get to know the regulars

Took a little coffee break coming from Hearts Castle back to L.A. This place was busy but the staff was very friendly. Coffee  was delish as usual. Bathroom is clean. And it's easy access from the shopping center where it's located.

Since it's opening a few months ago, I have been to the Drive-Thru at this location twice. Both times, I was helped by Rebecca, who was simply a delight! She was so kind, upbeat, and had a great attitude! The first day I visited, I was in a crappy mood and her energy turned my whole day around. Wonderful customer service like hers doesn't happen every day, which is why I was so thankful to see her a second time. Nothing beats getting your coffee with a friendly smile!
Friendly staff.  Just remodeled the interior with a new beautiful wood interior.  They have a Clover machine to make the new high-end coffees the Starbucks franchise put out.

Muah !
Tall, Skinny-Iced Hazelnut Latte . . . . Please!
Thank you....... ( 8

As far as Starbucks goes, this one is pretty awesome. Service is comparable to other starbucks around the city (which does mean it's slower than tims) and everyone is friendly and welcoming. It's nothing that stands out, but it's cozy and it's probably one of my favourite Starbucks in the city. Their drive through always makes my day too if I ever go through early in the morning!
Normal Starbucks. Only down points are the street people that take over the inside in the morning and the terrible WiFi that keeps dropping.

We went in for a coffee yesterday (Sunday) and advised the staff that one of the wraps in the case with all of the food was moldy. They were aware but it wasn't time to replace that wrap yet so they left it in the case with the food to be served. I understand having a policy, but leaving moldy food in with food you are planning on serving is a bad one. Needless to say we did not order anything to eat and just prayed that the coffee and drinks were kept at a higher standard!

Great location off of Ina Road and Oracle! It's in a great shopping area with other delicious eateries. 

It's a typical Starbucks with drive-thru. This Starbucks shares space with Einstein's Bagels. They have a common seating area between the two; it makes for tight seating, but there are also tables outside. 

The staff are fast and friendly! See you the next time I'm in Tucson!

We literally just came from this Starbucks and I want to throw up! Not only did they run out of ingredients for my favorite holiday drink but they freakin gave me a cover with someone's lipstick on it! I'm soooo grossed out!!!!!

This Starbucks is always busy and packed, but mostly because it's the size of a large closet. There are only three tables in the whole joint, and I'm sure that's on purpose. With the number of people shuffling in and out, it's tough to be productive. Fortunately they have more tables outside. So if the weather is nice, you can enjoy some great sites of Indianapolis' downtown circle.
Low key Starbucks on Oracle. The usual friendly staff and plenty of comfy chairs.

This Starbucks is probably one of the best I've been to! The store itself is clean, the majority of the time. A couple times I've come in and some of the tables were dirty, but who knows, the people could have left a minute before I walked in. It's usually not too packed, but then again, I try to avoid it early mornings. When the drive thru is busy, more often then not they've either apologized immensely for the wait, or even put my drinks on the house. The employees are a generally happy group. I understand people have their bad days, so I usually blow off bad attitudes, since it happens so rarely. I tried applying here once, around November, and went in to talk to the manager about it. She seemed pretty rude, but I haven't seen much of her since that day, and the employees rarely act that way. Over all a good Starbucks. I'll continue being a regular there!
You will sit in the drive thru for at least half an hour between 12-5pm. If you don't, you got lucky. They are slow and still get a simple order wrong.

Literally just left this Starbucks drive thru. I drove through yesterday morning and was specifically looking for the raspberry loaf to have with my chai tea latte, unfortunately they were out. I was craving Starbucks again today so I went back to this same Starbucks cause they make all the drinks THE BEST. Anywho, drove through, asked for the raspberry loaf again and they didn't have any again which was no biggie but I was craving one so I got the next best thing which was their classic coffee cake. Drove up to pay and get my items and the lady who helped me at the window remembered me from yesterday and apologized for not having the raspberry loaf, shortly after our encounter the store manager came to the window to apologize and inform me they'll make sure to order more raspberry loafs to be safe and because of the inconvenience (which it wasn't at all) they comp'd my classic coffee cake. True class, professionalism, and customer service at its best. BEST STARBUCKS in town...on all levels!!

Very slow service inside. It seems that they pay more attention to the drive-through customers. Coffee was okay but they needed to restock the milk.  Spacious interior but I didn't care for the loud music playing.  Outdoor seating but noisy as next to busy road.   Too bad no one was smart enough to put the outdoor seating to the side or back Where it would be quieter.

Service is always speedy and accurate! I'm a creature of habit so I always get a soy white chocolate mocha latte. Lately I've been a fan of the pepperoni turnover. 

Grabs seat outdoors kraut in the cafe if you have some time.

I've had nothing but good experiences here. I visited the place just a few mornings and then stopped going (a time-management issue on *my* part.) But I came back a few weeks later and the barista STILL REMEMBERED my "usual." The coffee is always fresh. Occasionally their bold coffee is more like medium. But they change their bold selection every week which is groovy. I would give it a full 5 stars BUT - there's only one john. So if you hafta pee, you might have to wait in line.
Polite folks, but politeness doesn't stock the bathroom with toilet paper.  You have a job people!  Would you freakin' do it?
When I get a refresher it's always way under filled and the music inside was cranking. Sounded like a club in there. Very hard to study.

I'm conflicted on this review.  It is obvious by my 90+ check-in's here that I am a fan of Starbucks.  However, the customer service at this location seems to be lacking.  There was a time when they were a lot better but in the last few months it has been declining.  Let me start by the presentation of my drink.  My paper coffee cup shouldn't look like it was dipped in the coffee.  There shouldn't be coffee around the rim of the lid either.  Second, they have a hard time getting my order right lately.  I order the same damn thing every time; a tall with 4 splenda and light ice and a grande with 5 splenda.  My issue is they always forget the light ice.  Light ice doesn't mean one ice cube in my drink.  I order light ice because I want to immediately drink my coffee and not have to worry about 3rd degree burns.  If my coffee has light ice it shouldn't burn my mouth and make me use profanity.  Other than that, it's a Starbucks.
They just opened and the service is excellent! They are VERY pleasant, my order was perfect and I normally have a complicated order. This is deff one of my new favorite locations

Second time visiting was a vast improvement from the first.  The first time I waited FOREVER for my coffee...this location was extremely busy during both of my visits where I went inside to order.  The line moved quickly and the barista was very polite.  We had a bit of a longer than anticipated wait for our coffees but I think that is do to them focusing on the drive thru line.  I feel they could be a bit more organized and the place could be a bit tidier but my coffee was delicious and the patio outside relaxing.  I hope they keep up the improvements as I'd like to keep coming back.

Service here is fantastic no problems with customer service , but got a protein box today with a chicken wrap , apples and cucumbers and got so sick . Had it for my lunch break and was so sick at work with it

I kind of loathe reviews of chains, but I feel obligated to make a comment seeing as I "checked in" at this particular location. Darn you Yelp iPhone app!

I pretty much feel "a-ok" about all Starbucks regardless of location. Their beverages don't send me into a transcendent state, but they do warm me up and make me feel like I'm giving myself a little treat. It's especially nice when I remember that I have money on my little key fob thing and can rack up those little stars towards nifty rewards. Who doesn't like a freebie drink on their birthday?

The staff here was friendly. They made my drink correctly. That pretty much sums it up.

Recently I've seen an improvement in service. I also have noticed several new employees and so am happy that management must be listening to feedback. If the service levels continue to be positive I will update my rating. Keep up the customer focus......it matters!

Not a friendly staff. You have to ask for your receipt if you want it or they will never give it to you. When you do ask for it, they get frustrated with you. I like Starbucks but I have to avoid this one if I can.

A community a Starbucks as you'll probably get.  If you catch them at the right time you might even walk away with a free sample.  That said they do get busy and you can tell the staff gets a bit overloaded.  Try to come by at off hours and it will improve the experience.
waited in line at the drive-thru for 30 minutes at 2:30 PM. No option to leave because of the curb on both sides. Absolutely ridiculous. Will not return.

Part of the AWESOME crew at the Starbucks in Havertown, Pa (On West Chester Pike).... I say "part" because Greg and a few of the girls are missing from the photo.  I've probably been to 100 Starbucks (haha maybe more!) in various states/cities/towns, and this is by far one of the better ones. The best in every way - The service, management, consistency, atmosphere, seating, the space and the overall crew. My favorite Starbucks! Grazie guys for your wonderful service and personalities! You're the BEST and an asset to the Starbucks Company!!! @starbucks @jakeskalish...

Located on Whyte Avenue along what some have dubbed "Coffee Corner" this place is packed, overflowing, loud, and too busy. I generally head to the independent Block 1912 across the street rather than a chain place if I can help it.

I have had bad service with one of the employees, he has no customer service skills whatsoever. I was  the only one speaking, all he did was tell me the amount I owed. The only reason I'm giving it 2 stars is because it's Starbucks and the smoothie was ok.

This starbucks is pretty reliable in terms of service and drink quality. The wait in line can take a while but they make the drinks very quickly. I got a caramel macchiato and they made it perfectly - not too sweet, with the right amount of caramel, foam & coffee.
Typical Starbucks the staff is friendly and the bathroom code is easy to remember which is more than I can say for some of the other Starbucks I've been too.

I'm the only person here and they are taking care of drive thru. 

There are three people working and not one of them can handle the people that are walking through the door. 

When I asked if my drink was ready the answer was I'm sorry the drive-through is busy

Hi I'm not in the drive-through

The only person not making drinks is taking out the garbage

Worst Starbucks ever

I've been waiting 10 mins for one caramel marchiato and a frapachino not to mention the guest that c a me before me didn't even get their drinks I got mine first.  Horrible. The drive thru was wrapped around the store

I'm a diabetic and before I ran my daughter there I researched online my drink options. Satisfied with my choice, I ordered the drink I found online only to be told this location didn't have it. ( some sugar free vanilla spice option). However, the barista said she could make something very similar that would meet my sugar free requirements. Delicious! Thanks to her, I am a sugar free vanilla latte with 3 pumps chai addict. I've gone to other Starbucks and placed my order and have had comments made by the employees on how that must be yummy. Kudos to her!
The place looks nice for my first time there. But I had my coffee made by a very rude barista. I am discouraged from coming back to this well invested branch but poor choice of staff.

I love Starbucks but don't frequent them too often since the coffee prices have gone out of sight (and I am a cheap bast***).  I had a Cappuccino and it was good, but not that perfect Starbucks burnt Espresso taste I so dearly love.  But, in a pinch, it will do!

Best Starbucks in the city!!!  They are prompt, courteous and friendly.  Because Ive been going there for years, they know my order.  All the employees are great.  FRAN IS THE BEST!!!  She is a gem!!  Kelly, Adrian Aya'naziah and Seth are wonderful!!  Always upbeat and glad to see you!  This Starbucks is like the CHEERS of Philly..............where everybody knows your name and drink!! 

Cheers!!

this place is one of the newer Starbucks in the area so facility wise, it is big and clean. I love how they have the cold brew and nitro cold brew ready to go every day; other places I've been to runs out by the afternoon. the staff is ok; haven't had too much interaction with them but they seem nice enough. 
I like the big circular table in which is standing height (for an average human being height). is it great to get some work done while you are standing; put's a lot less stress on the back. 
the bathroom is pretty clean at all times; kinda surprised for a new facility like this they do not have an automatic flush.
parking is great; they have a huge lot where you can park.

I think one of the biggest pluses to this location is that it is going to be part of a strip mall. they'll have new things coming in so if you need to take a break and walk around, you're going to have that option. there is also a CVS down 0.1 miles down so you can walk and get some snacks and such if you like. 

overall, good spot, good facility

The customer service needs to be revivewed.  The cashier seemed very impatient or he just didnt want to be there.  Then when my friend mentioned about here Americana was not up to the top of the cup, I tried to laugh it off, but the three girls were laughing and rolling their eyes.  
I felt very disresepcted and it WAS not like the other Starbucks I enjoy.  Never will return.

WTF are you you looking to me for?  It's just a Starbucks FCS. WRONG!  This is NOT just ANY Starbucks. You've got the best staff in the chain right here.  You'll sometimes hear the service is slow.  That's  because every Sum 'B  in Pinellas County starts lining up at the window at 4:50 AM for coffee.  There's near accidents and angry exchanges every morning as caffeine addicts jostle in and out of Fourth Street cueing up for their first fix of the day.  Nearby there exists a half dozen other very good places to get a cup of coffee and even better donuts.  But those other places don't make you feel as good about being up that early and starting your day.  When these folks meet you at the window it's with a smile like my Daddy used to get on pay day when he brought Momma home his check. They're still giving the best service.

Starbucks is my pick up of the day and by far has the best dark roast when compared to most coffee shops. However, beware of going to this location around 5 pm. I placed an order at 532 for cold brew black venti, paid and revived my order at 550.

I've come into this location a couple of times and the service had been fine.  This morning was a bit unexpected.  
I'm a Gold Card carrying member and spent $10 on two drinks this morning.  While I finished my first one listening to music, I approached the counter to get another.  The nice kid attempted to get it as a refill, but when he asked the manager how to ring it up, I overheard her say "Absolutely not".  No biggie, I didn't mind paying full price (although $5 for cold foam seems a bit excessive)
What disturbed me was after I received my drink, I asked for additional cold foam as it was lacking a bit.  When I asked the girl at the bar, she snootily said "you could have asked for additional foam when you ordered it".   
What happened to them making it right if it's none done right the first time?  
I'm sadly disappointed in this location and will likely find another location to frequent. 

Poor customer service ladies.... just poor form!!
I like Starbucks so its nice to have one here in the Marriott.

I've given this Starbucks at least 10 different attempts and the majority of my visits have been horrendous. The few good baristas cannot make up for the too many poor ones with bad attitudes and bad work ethic. 

The only positive to this location is their drive thru. Be warned! They cater to the drive thru more so than their visiting customers. If you're in a rush, your best bet is their drive thru or else you'll be waiting twice as long inside the store

I'm not trying to be negative, but this Starbucks location continues to decline. Time and again, the drinks are not made to order, staff are slow to complete the orders and the beverage temperature, as a result, is tepid at best. Tonight, one barista made the drinks while another barista socialized with friends and the third barista was mopping the floors. It's really unfortunate that this location can't get it right. This Starbucks location needs an overhaul at management to improve.
Probably my favorite Starbucks in Indy. Consistently happy and attentive baristas, plenty of room, and the energy of the IUPUI, Attucks, and Indy Met customers who frequent this location!

Slowest Starbucks in the history of the planet. It's 2:20pm on a weekday, there's literally 9 people in the entire store, and I'm going on 12 minutes waiting for a latte I ordered for my fiancé. Sadly, this is a reoccurring problem here. I come here to grab her coffee a lot, and what should be a 5 minute stop turns into a 20 minute adventure, every single time. 

Other than that, the store is clean, and the employees are nice. Just your typical (slow) Starbucks.

I've always had a bad experience at this location. Last time there was some weird leak in my Frap cup and by the time I got to Sephora I noticed the trail of coffee behind me. The staff is always rude, and very busy too. 

It's also not a location that you can sit and chill at. It's a revolving door and reading isn't possible, too many distractions.
Poor service, terrible line control. 4 people behind the counter yet only one making drinks, with lines out the door. Last Carmel macchiato outta this one

This Starbucks sits deep inside the Marriott. So what you get is a plush Starbuck's experience. There is a separate room for the plush chairs.
 This is one of the best smelling Starbuck's. The same fragrance smell that fills the Marriott fills the air in this Starbuck's. The result is that you feel like your breathing in potpori.
  The prices are steeper than your usual Starbucks outside of downtown New Orleans. However, the atmosphere is so relaxing that I felt like getting in my daily coffee here was worth the steeper price.

I like this particular Starbucks because it is open longer then the Starbucks in the Loop is. I believe they are open till 10pm. The service is a little slow but spot on. The employees are also very friendly. 

There is ample seating inside with plenty of room to study, read, or chit chat. This Starbucks does not have that claustrophobic feeling when walking in unlike some locations. My only true complaint would be parking. Parking spots are very limited and you might have to park in the neighboring business's parking area.

I like this Starbucks because it stays open until 10:30 pm on weekend nights.  It's probably one of the few places in DelCo to get a late night cup of Joe and have it not be a diner or an all night Dunkin Donuts.  Staff is nice and pleasant.

I love new locations and I am extremely satisfied with this location.  Love the decor, service and all the amenities (drive thru, outdoor seating, can walk to whole foods which is a minute away).  One of the baristas welcomed me by name on my 3rd regular visit; it shows the baristas emotional intelligence.

This is one of the best Starbucks anywhere, great customer service, the baristas are awesome. I did my computer work in a little corner of the store, but couldn't help listening to them greet customers and engaging with everyone. If I'd live here this would be one of my favorite spots. Ah yes, my mint tea was great too!

I grew up down the street from this Starbucks and come into town to visit my parents often. Usually people are friendly at this location but the past 5 days we've been going in the people give us attitude and are nice to the regulars and sometimes get them their drinks before us, then don't call our orders when they're ready. I hope their lives get happier!
Most  ridiculously long drive-thru wait. Not even sure how it was possible for it to be that long. There was no escaping the line after 15 minutes lapsed, and they didn't care at the window.

Normal starbucks just located in roswell, new mexico.  Maybe area 51?

Not too far from Slu's campus it is under the UFO looking thing.  I keep my eyes peeled for Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones to stop a bug from taking off with the galaxy.

They have a drive thru.  I would have expected some kind of delivery system, but maybe it costs too much to fly that saucer?

Some people need their fix at starbucks every day.  I don't know if I'd trust little green men with my brain chemistry or risk prolonged contact with the unknown.

Proceed... with... caution!
Manager and staff are awesome. Same good stuff as every Starbucks. Best staff I've seen

I drove back from Fort Lauderdale to St Petersburg today, and stopped at Naples for coffee.  I wanted a Bullet Proof Coffee, and was told they don't make it. So Starbucks! It's time to get with the times and offer bullet proof coffee! It's the latest greatest coffee and as a coffee company you should offer it, or you will lose business! Or, let's put it the other way: Offer it and you'll gain a ton of business! 
Here's the recipe: 1 tbsp real salted butter, 1 tbsp good quality virgin coconut oil. Whisk up in a blender for one minute, and VIOLA! Boom! Bullet proof coffee! Let me know when you have it, and I will be back!

MY home Starbucks. The baristas know my name. And I can sit at the bar and not feel like a scourge. They accomodate my requests whenever I ask with nary an attitude to be tossed. I love them. As far as a corporate entity goes, this one has the feel of a neighborhood joint, and that's the story of how Starbucks finally won me over.

Pro - this Starbucks is a drive thru

Con - SO SLOW!

I'm a person who doesn't like change, so I always order the same thing at restaurants, and I always order a Venti coffee frappuccino. 

There are times I get it and it's lighter in color and obviously taste.

Why do I keep coming to THIS one if I have complaints? The drive thru obviously. 

When I meet with my friends, and we can sit down and relax at a Starbucks, this is NOT the one we come to. 

Convenience. 

But when the line is out to 4th St, I just keep driving.

Additional note - couldn't the sign be a little bit more visible from the street when you're driving north on 4th?
I live in this area, and always slam on my breaks because it sneaks up on me.

When I'm not going to Starbucks, I intentionally go into the far left lane as other Starbucks patrons seem to have the same issue. 

PS - I was in the drive thru long enough to complete 75% of this review

ONCE AGAIN - I ordered an UN sweetened green iced tea. Really stressing the UN. But no, it's sweetened.  Blah!  Why can't they get a simple order right??? Does no one pay attention? Or is it always a new batista that doesn't quite have if down yet? Very dusappointing.

Deck overlooking Lake Afton makes this a 4 star coffee shop, especially when tapping into the wifi, working remotely and enjoying a latte and a cake pop. Great friendly service and plenty of seating make this a staple for lazy days of coffee consumption and paper reading. Not a lot of parking...repeat: not a lot of parking!
This is one of my favorite Starbucks. They drive thru is always fast. They can handle large orders quickly. Make sure you use your Starbucks card to earn points towards FREE drinks.

This review is not for the quality of the product but for the customer service, or in their case- lack thereof. This Starbucks location continually has crappy customer service, and from the way it looks- it's all coming from one cranky bitch. 

I went in one morning to get a breakfast sandwich (Ham & Cheese Artisan sandwich with no egg)...and noticed that another type of sandwich had bacon on it. Mm, bacon...right? So I asked if bacon could be put onto my sandwich. The answer: No. Let me be clear, it wasn't the "no" that was the problem, per se. It was the snarky attitude of the woman behind the counter. It wasn't 'no sorry' or 'you'd have to purchase both sandwiches'..it was "No" with the implication and attitude that the answer is no because she'd rather go stick her chest out and flirt with that married man over there than dick around with something for me. 

I prodded as to WHY it couldn't be done, and got the *sigh* and even an *eyeroll* from the woman behind the counter. How STUPID of me for not knowing that the sandwiches comes pre-packaged, right? *slaps forehead* I totally forgot I worked for Starbucks last week! I pointed out that if egg could be taken OFF of a sandwich, then surely something could be put ON a sandwich. I also pointed out that I had no problem paying for the other sandwich so that the ingredients could be combined into one. Apparently a ham & bacon merger was imposssible for her. When, let's be clear - every other Starbucks is capable of doing what she is telling me she cannot do. 

I am the customer. I did not ask you for anything for free. If you have bacon in the building and I ask for bacon on something- then do your frickin' job and give me the damn bacon! If I ask for a Bacon Frappacino I expect you to start blending. I have no clue what this woman's issue was...maybe she needs to get laid because her bitchery was off the charts. So I grabbed my drink and told the manager at the time (who is now retired) that I would not be back.  And I meant it. Until I went back. UGH. 

I got in a situation where it was either stop there for something, or starve til morning. Blah Blah blah I go in at 6:20pm and order my sandwich. Miss Stick-Up-Her-Butt was there and couldn't make my food because she'd turned the oven off. Um, WHY? Why did you turn off the oven 40 minutes before you're supposed to close? Simple. She wanted to leave and instead of serving customers she just turns off everything and turns people away. Lame. 
. 
.

Apparently the make all their expresso drink iced unless you specify HOT. So this results in a further delay when u get your drink OR no drink at all if you figure it out when your husband gets home with it and assumed you ordered it that way. Tried to call and discuss this with a manager but their phone constantly rings busy which means they took it off the hook. Real professional!! I'm so over the Sub par coffee and awful customer service. LaColombe is only 20 mins away and so worth it!!

Every time I've gone to this Starbucks, my Frappuccinos have all been liquidy and not icey at all. It's been disappointing and a waste of money. We only have gone there more than once due to convenience in location, but it's not worth it anymore. Maybe Dunkin' will be a better option.

Love this store but Some times you have to wait in the road just to get into the start of the drive thru line. Guess thats any star bucks now days. Parking is usually terrible if you plan on going inside also. But customer service is usually pretty great and the drinks are good also. I've even got my order for free one time since he said I waited to long in the line. Will definitely continue to stop by.

I know that it's just a starbucks so my expectations are not crazy high or anything, but other reviewers are correct when they say it is slow service here. Although the coffee is fine, the baristas always seem to be in a bad mood to me, and they are ALWAYS out of food items like cake pops and sandwiches. The only reason I keep coming is how convenient the location is to my work. 

Today I ordered a Gouda sandwich and it was falling apart in the bag which irritated me, but I have no idea if that was the fault of the barista. However, I also got espresso con panna and the cup was 90% whipped cream so I couldn't even get to my coffee. I had to open the top and scrape half of the whipped cream out. I guess to be fair, was a generous portion for a small upcharge. 

Something else I would say about the location is it is especially uncomfortable for hanging out in. All there are are hard wooden tables, no soft couches, no space for more than 4 people. The lighting is really weird; it's hard to describe but basically one side of the place is blindingly bright and the other is dingy.

This Starbucks was alright compared to many others I've been to. Their wasn't much of a line, and my order was taken quickly. The service was a tad slow but I was in no rush. The specialty drink I got was good; however, I believe it comes with a chocolate drizzle on top and the barista did not put this on top of the whipped cream. I was a little disappointed, but the experience was good overall.
Best Starbucks around! Staff is very friendly. I've only ever done the drive thru so I can't comment about inside. Even if the line looks really long it moves super fast!

Very impressed.  I met a friend here and when we got up to the counter, I ordered just a blonde roast with soy.  Well, they were out of blonde and instead of me having to make a different choice, they made me a pour over blonde.  Delicious!  Since I had to wait, they even gave me a coupon to get my next drink at any Starbucks on them.  Great customer service!

Great store with awesome baristas!!
Had a hard time figuring out a drink for a co-worker and the lovely lady ( sorry, forgot her name ) took the time to help me and explain the difference drinks they had available that matched my description. Drinks came out very fast 5 min wait? And it was pretty heavy traffic ( around 8am). Will definitely return!!!
Yup.  Its a Starbucks alright.   Good cofee, always way too crowded with hipsters abusing the free wi-fi, and this one is in a book store.

I agree with almost all the comments about this Starbucks; drive thru time is prolonged, many of the time I have went there, because it's the closest to my home, my drink has been made wrong. Not impressed with the staff either. I love Starbucks but just not this one

It's a Starbucks, so it has great coffee.  But it is in a very high traffic area and I saw a homeless person in here sleeping and one person taking up a table for six.

Pretty much a walk-up place, you can find street parking.  Outdoor seating is nice when it's not really cold, of course.

I have a Starbucks gift card in my possession. I went to use the gift card this morning at this location in the drive thru. I ordered a cup of tea and an order of egg bites. When I reached the window I handed the woman my card. She said she couldn't scan it and do I have it on the phone app? No, I don't. I have it in my hand. She said she couldn't use it so I drove away without paying or getting my order because I was so infuriated she wouldn't enter the card manually. When I got to work annoyed and hangry without breakfast I pulled out my phone and entered the card into the app and the full balance was on the card. Clearly this isn't an issue of she couldn't do it. It's an issue of she wouldn't do it. Will never be back to this location. 7/25/18 - 9:45am.
Ordered online but the workers were super unhelpful and basically ignored me. Supremely rude staff. Looked at me like I was an alien for ordering an extra drink after passing past drive thru.
Another standard Starbucks. I think it's staffed with UIndy students, perhaps? Anyhow, nothing that I've experienced here is out of the ordinary. Just standard quality Starbucks service.

I feel like there are nine million Starbucks in Philadelphia but this one is my favorite. This is good because its really close to my place. 

The staff is really nice and pretty quick with the drink order. The best part is the big table they have in the corner and lots of power outlets! For a full time student like me, its nice to have a place in the hood to get out and study in. 

The hours are kind of a drag. They close up by 9 pm most nights so if you're planning on going or staying late, call ahead to find out their schedule.

15+ minutes for a drip coffee?!?

Visited today and ordered a drip coffee and a small americano.  It probably took 10 minutes for the americano to arrive... And in the meantime, folks who ordered AFTER me were being served frozen drinks, smoothies, and who knows what else. Meanwhile, I could see the lonely cup for my americano sitting there in the barista queue, with lots of more exotic, more complex drinks just rolling right past it - probably enough to lower its self esteem a few notches.  It must have felt really neglected - especially since it is the simplest drink minus an espresso that you can possibly order from a barista.  


Update:  Just stopped back in here ( same day) and ordered a decaf drip coffee. They didn't have any brewed and needed to do a "pour over" - essentially a custom one cup brew of coffee. This is pretty standard in the afternoon at Starbucks with decaf coffee. Usually this takes 5 minutes or so. However 15 minutes later I was still waiting for
my coffee. Basically I think they just forgot about it. Very light crowd so no real excuse. So, two visits, two extremely episodes of slow service. To me, that's a trend. One star.

If this is the location in the court- the service is consistently super slow and the employees are less than happy and this is typically on a weekday and no one is in line.  Everyone seems miserable! Don't go to this location! The one in the plaza is busier and 10x faster!

Unfortunately, every time I come here I leave with a different drink than what I ordered. It is usually read back to me wrong as I'm paying, and then after kindly straitening out what I originally ordered...inevitably they get it wrong. I usually drive off before I catch it which is frustrating. I should add that I ordered coffee at 7pm on a Friday evening...hardly rush hour.
This Starbucks is straight. Drive thru service sucks, but if you're coming in to study or chat with friends the baristas at the register are a lot nicer than the drive thru folks.

This is probably the worst service I've ever had at Starbucks.  No hello, thank you, or anything.  Just a blank look at me when I was waiting to order.  The baristas behind the scenes are busy making drinks for those in the store and also the drive through which was a steady stream on a weekday afternoon.  We waited for our drinks and there were other drinks but you could barely hear them say the name, if they even did at all.  My cup was sticky but not a big deal as I got a napkin to wipe it.  I paid $5 for a drink that was half filled with ice.  I'll have to remember that next time I want to cold drink to ask for little ice.  Only stopped in as we were in the complex to run errands!

I am not a coffee drinker, but go to this starbucks for business meetings when I am in Tampa or to catch some wifi in between meetings. 
The good: Its an easy central location where most people know and can meet. There is free wifi, and there is consistent items.
The Bad: The parking lot is always packed. Getting a spot is hit or miss and its very crowded. If you are looking for a quick in and out experience, this is not the starbucks for you.

One of my favorite Starbucks.  Very roomy inside with lost of space to meet.  The staff is super friendly and the drive through is my choice for fast in and out.  The parking here is tricky and in short supply

It's a Starbucks- No better or worse than any other, really. I liked that the staff had nametags identifying where they were from! Dominican Republic, Korea, Laos etc. And they were very friendly. The baked goods here are fresh, and hey, sometimes when you're in the hotel for a conference and you have 5 minutes between panels this is the only breakfast you can get! If you don't want Sbucks, the hotel has coffee in the lounge area, but it's even pricier (as in $4 for a cup).

I do think this location was more expensive than any other I've been in. Maybe it was my imagination.
friendly staff & clean store. Love the drive thru because it keeps the traffic moving when we want to hand around. They also have a nice outdoor patio area.

The usual as to coffee. Small selection of pastries, etc. And small sitting area.  Biggest issue I have at this location is the staff, which seems to change all the time.  The current employees do not seem to have much enthusiasm for what they do.
Excellent baristas! A lot better service than usual. Very knowledgeable of their products and very helpful. Thanks guys!

We are there most every day of the week. The attentive staff sees us walking in and brings our drinks to us.

This shop is also great for being great citizens of the community and support many causes.
This is by far the best Starbucks in the region. The staff is friendly, quick and accurate. The outdoor seating and dog friendly atmosphere makes it fun.

It's just another Starbucks folks.  This one is very tiny and it's in the Lawrence Park Shopping Center.  It recently received a remodel so it's nice inside.  It also has two or three tables outside if you like a view of the parking lot.  The usual mostly competent baristas.  I'm a Starbucks fan so I stop here when I have business in the in the shopping center or at the Home Depot just down the street.

I know it seems silly to write a review for a Starbucks, but my experience today was pretty terrible. Ordered a coffee frap, asked for half the usual amount of sweetener. Girl at the counter charges me for two pumps of classic. I ask why I am being charged extra for something that is already in the drink. She says the drink doesn't have any sweetener in it. I say yes it does, I know because they are always too sweet for me, which is why I ask for half the amount. She proceeds to argue with me, so I say forget I mentioned it, just get me the coffee frap. While I was waiting for my drink I looked up the ingredient list on the Starbucks website. Guess what? There's sweetener in it! I totally understand customers can be wrong, but in this case I was absolutely right. And even if I wasn't, there is not reason to be disrespectful to anyone. This chick has such a bad attitude it's insane. On top of that, the store is disgusting. Bottles all over the counter, overflowing trash, food on the ground. If you need a reminder of why you should go to your local coffee spot and not a chain, stop here.

I really like this Starbucks. It feels new and is very clean for an urban downtown location. Friendly staff fast service and clean restrooms are part of the 5 stars. Open til midnight! Lots of seating and at night you can sit outside with a latte and watch the club scene go by. One of my favorite Starbucks so far in the US. If the women's bathroom could have a hook that works going solo would be easier.
Cashier issued the wrong receipt. I went back through the line and asked for the correct one. On this 2nd time, she did not say a word. At least an apology! Coffee and everything else ok.

So, I've finally ventured into this South Street during the weekend. Nice staff.  Just wish I could figure out where the trash was and that there was a little more seating. It was a little cramped once it got to be later in the day as I did my work.

Awesome service Christina is amazing
Remembered my drink from last time I was in today, in fact remembered it so much that she reminded me I left something out!
Loooovvvveeee great service like that!
WHOA - stopped by on the way through. This place has a deck that looks over the water. Very cool!

Standard Starbucks. The people are pretty nice. Once, someone in front of me in the Drivethru line bought $5 of my purchase with the idea that you pass it along, which I did. They said it can go for a dozen or so customers in a row sometimes.

Poor service.  Went through drive through.  Allergic to dairy  and soy. Starbucks menu boasts of coconut so attempted to orde a drink with coconut milk. Girl on speaker acted like we were talking a cryptic when we asked for coconut milk.  Then when asking for sparkling berry drink was immediately told they were out of apple juice.  Wow... horrible prices and horrible service. I won't be coming back here at all!!
is one of the fast drive trhru starbucks so far
It's a great place to get coffee and work or visit depending on the company. But the coffee's good.

For the hustle and bustle of this Starbucks, the workers seem to work really well under pressure. One worker went out of their way to start a conversation with me, ask me about my day and inquire to make sure my drink was satisfactory. I simply wish there was more seating so I could spend more time there. In addition, it's a little distracting with all the Handlebar Indy and Pickled Peddler riders trailing through using the bathroom constantly! Overall, a pretty good experience.
Very quick service.   I walked inside.   I am having the chicken and artichoke sandwich warmed up.  I am drinking passionfruit lemonade tea.  Very clean.

After a wonderful bike ride on the MCT, I decided to reward myself with a beverage. I would normally go through the drive thru, but for some reason, I decided to go inside. It was a Sunday morning and there were maybe a handful of people inside with 4 (maybe 5) people working behind the counter. I stepped up, placed my order and took a seat at a table to wait. And wait. And wait. After noticing several customers come in behind and leave with their orders, I begin to get a little impatient. After 10 minutes, I decided to ask about the status of my order. The girl simply replied, "It's right here." Not once did anyone announce my order. I simply picked up my beverage, shook my head and walked out the door. That was my first and last visit to that store. Customer service = terrible!
I love this location, the chairs are so comfy and the baristas are funny.
Come here almost everyday on the way to work! I love the quick service and fresh coffee/food. The very best part of this trip is they call me by your name everytime you walk in the door!

First, it's a Starbucks.  They are pretty consistent in drinks and flavors across the board.  

The staff at this location is why I return.  When my mother died, I needed a sense of normalcy.  Something to help me get back into a routine.  

I went to this location every weekday for a year.  The majority of the morning staff know my name. I walk in and hear from at least two "good morning Nessa!" I never have more than a how are you? How's your morning conversation with them, but the simple effort of remembering my name and greeting me helped me keep going everyday.  

I've since moved and still try to hit this location a couple times a week.  They may just be doing their job, but when you're in a bad headspace, that kindness makes a huge difference.

Hey, it's a Starbucks.

However, I felt compelled to review this particular location mainly because of the staff.  I have never had a poor experience here--never a wrong order, never a long wait, never a Rudie McRudester at the register.  Plus they've got a pretty good selection of pastries and lunch-type items which are my go-to when I'm short on time at work.

Also, I love Starbucks in general for the fact that I can order something "skinny", and no one laughs in my face.

Love this location! Got off I-75 while
 traveling and went thru the drive thru. We ordered our favorite personized  frappachino and it was fantastic!

B4 work, this Starbucks does brisk drive-through business on the outside, with some customers stepping into the attractive-though-smallish dining area on the inside. As my friend Bill C. notes, customer service is exceptional for a coffee place. The staff person working the counter was visiting with a regular as I arrived (but quickly took care of me), and was introducing herself by name to a newcomer who followed. Bill C. didn't seem too thrilled with the baked goods, but my apple-raisin muffin was just fine. The standard Pike Place coffee was very good, too.  Perhaps it's not as hip as E'ville Main Street, but out here at the Crossing there's better parking.

I went inside this time and there was no line at 9am on a Saturday which was amazing! Imagibr my surprise when I order exactly the same coffee that I get in Chicagoland and it's 50 cents more here. Again I'm here to help with the hangover from staying at my parents house while visiting, so I can't argue. Just wondering what is more expensive here....

I went here on Thursday and I wanted to get the Oprah Cinnamon Chai Tea Latte but they said they didn't make those but they make Chai Tea Lattes and then she asked me if I wanted a tall one for free and she said if I like it I should come back in and buy another one. It was delicious and the worker was so sweet for doing that for me.

This starbucks is deceptively bland... Until you step inside. 
Its centerpiece is a large wood table (I couldn't tell if it was oak or particleboard), with strategically placed power strips underneath, so that each person at the table could potentially plug in his/her laptop.  
I actually got a decent amount of studying done there...that is, until the teenie boppers showed up at 8. (a busload showed up at once, got some frozen frapuccinos, and commenced  talking & giggling uncontrollably with each other) 
Shouldn't you be out at a party?
The whole point of using a personal cup is so that I'm not generating waste by getting a disposable cup.  You are Starbucks, figure out a better way to measure!!!!

Close friendly and convenient! They have a drive through and the staff is SUPER friendly and make the visit delightful each time. Coffee is consistently great and they have BREAKFAST!!!

Just wish it was a bit bigger due to the traffic when it gets busy, but it's a small complaint.

Nothing bland or regular about this Starbucks.  Starbucks drinks and treats are Starbucks, but the people that work there make it a pleasure to start your day or stop by to refuel.  
A great place to have a quick meeting for work or check in with friends.

it's a Starbucks. for me, great location. parking can be a problem. but the biggest problem by far are some of the loud pretentious women that come here. the type that talk loud to get attn, I guess they want it known that they live in Clayton? who knows. dont misunderstand, i'm not saying that everyone is, but there's enuff that are to make it annoying. it's so bad that I've stopped going to this location. i guess its their starbucks, not mine. A friend referred to them as geese and not swans. perfect description.

It's a STARBUCKS. I'm pretty sure everyone who reads these reviews already knows what to expect... but I'll write one anyways! :)

I always find this location to be extremely convenient and busy - right in the heart of touristy South Street. (If you do come here - make sure you walk one block up to see the Magic Gardens!) 

The coffee's hot, the sweets are scrumptious, and the baristas have always been super friendly in my experiences. I like to bring my own coffee mug for refills, too -- you usually wind up with a much larger cuppa'joe than ordering a disposable tall, grande, or vente.

I would stop by this location more often but the parking lot design makes it frustrating. The drive thru line blocks the parking lot. The entrances are poorly designed where cars block each other in both directions. If the flow was improved they would probably ove a lot more cars through. 

My other issue with this location is the consistancy of the drinks. I usually get a vanilla latte and I often wonder if I got the wrong drink.
Baristas have major attitudes and are super condescending. Slower than any Starbucks I've been too so far. Least favorite Starbucks, but the paintings outside by the drive through are awesome.
Great and convenient Starbucks, always fast and good coffee. On this most recent visit, I was lucky enough to be staying in the Marriott, so it was REALLY convenient!

Great location if you're looking to grab-and-go, but not to linger as seating is limited.

The drive-thru can sometimes be a pain, so I normally go inside to place my order.

Great downtown location.  The crew is always friendly and efficient, even when very busy.  I do wish there was more seating, but it works.  

The location has a drive thru and outdoor seating, so when it's not too hot or too cold you can sit outside.  

I've had coffee here a number of times and it's always hot, fresh and correct.  A nice break during the work day.
Great way to start the day! Smiling baristas and delicious coffee!! Such a nice place to meet up with friends and enjoy a good cup of coffee!

This Starbucks has a lot going for it. It's super-clean, and service is fast & friendly. There's plenty of seating, incl a few outside tables on the "deck" overlooking the pond. Very nice.
I know some have complained about the limited on-site parking here, but there's an easy solution, unless you are in a BIG hurry. If driving, as you pass the Starbucks and it's small parking lot on your right, go one more block, and make a left onto Penn Valley Drive. There is ample free parking on the street there and you're only a block away! If you can't walk a block to get your coffee, well hey, maybe you shouldn't be having that Vente Double Mocha Praline Snickers Bon Bon Double Whip Frappaccino, eh?
Still my favorite Starbucks. Best employees. Even though there are usually a lone they're on a school campus and always give the Best attitude and help. Foods always fresh, drinks always made right!!

Typical Starbucks I guess but I must have confused the cashier with my mind bending request to transform 15 pennies into a dime and a nickel so I could use the meter. She took this baffling question with much confusion as she made her way up the mental Everest. Dumped my changed in the drawer and said have a great day. Oh jeez.

Terrible! I've stopped here for the past 8+ years and the lattes are not prepared correctly and the wait is long! Tonight zero cars in drive thru, not many inside. I waited at least 6 mins and the latte average.

Nice Starbucks, good atmosphere and not as cramped up as a lot of Starbucks I've been to. The deal breaker here was the restrooms. They were FILTHY! Dust build up on everything in there was a dead giveaway that they are not cleaned regularly, thick brown urine buildup on back of toilet.  Nasty sink. The best way to judge how well employees keep a restaurant is by the bathroom. If they can't wipe down a toilet, how well do you think they are going to clean those machines they have to fully breakdown? Those bathrooms haven't had a thorough scrubbing in at LEAST a week. Buildup as thick as what was under the toilet seat takes a while to accumulate.
Terrible customer service. They weren't busy and couldn't keep people's orders straight.

This is a good Starbucks! They just opened a few months ago and I am so happy they have finally opened! 

This location is located inside of the Acme in the shopping center (where the Chick-fil-a is). Since it is inside a grocery store, it doesn' have everything that a stand alone Starbucks has (some of the food items and such) but they have most and what is there is done well.

The staff here is really friendly and personable! They make it a pleasant experience coming to get my coffee. And they are pretty quick as well

STILL the slowest Starbucks on the planet.  They got my drink order wrong and then told me it was because of a new person (which is what they told me last time too)  maybe hire a few more advanced baristas?

4*/5* not bec of staff (they're 5*).
The loss of star is for corporate's heavy hand in creating waste twice.
1) They don't recycle.
They don't even try. Big company like SB throwing cups away by the 100's daily, per store.
Do the math on that. Imagine a Costco dumping out a truckload of cups into the landfills.
2) Food is discarded per corporate BS.
The expiration date on a wrapped sandwich is today, the sandwich is unsold FOR FULL VALUE, then its trashed.
No 1/2 price last hour. No "buy $3+ coffee and get free sandwich".
No "receipt lottery" 1 hour before close (name on receipt, goes into hat, pull the winner)
No donation to shelter or company.
They can't even wrap it in a separate trash bag and leave it next to trash pile.

Compared to Coffee Bean in California that announced, 15 mins to close, that the following sandwiches have today's expiration date and anyone who wishes to take them may do so.
They were good sandwiches. Not $6 ones but $3.50 ones.

Starbucks is so corporate that they waste stuff left and right. The staff is usually as wooden as Pinocchio- this location was different (dude with full beard knows his stuff and is chiller than a morgue corpse)

Recycle.
Donate/raffle/secondarily discard the day old food.

SB is the Walmart of coffee.
Too big for their own good.

Seriously these Starbucks employees must be on speed, or they just have the best organization system ever. This location can be a pain to actually drive to seeing as how they have been doing construction on Meridian for about 3 years now, but once you are there the drive thru line moves like a breeze, especially in the early morning work rush. There has been a time or two in the afternoons where the line can back up, but on those times Starbucks recognized the delay and covered the cost of my drink! This is also a prime location to catch the "Pay it Forward" train where the car in front of you paid for your drink so you pay for the car behind you. The patio also has a good mix of tables and cushioned chairs so you will be sure to find whatever type of seat your behind is beckoning.

It's usually pretty good here, good service & coffee. This is my Sat. morning hang-out, and the last 3 Saturdays have been less than paar, I'm sorry to say. They have a new barista who needed reminding of what I ordered, didn't greet me, no "thank you," and barely said anything at all. I found her potentially rude.

I've given this place so many chances, but the times I leave unsatisfied outweigh the times I leave happy. Every time I get my drink it seems to be made incorrectly or stingy on the amount. I went a few days ago and ordered a grande Starbucks double shot on ice. Didn't pay attention when I left. Turns it out was less than half way full. The majority was foam. I realize this is the case with those drinks but it's hard when you pay for a grande and I got less than a tall. Thought I would try this place one more time this morning. Ordered a venti double shot on ice today. Same thing, too much foam and made incorrectly. The drink usually comes with classic syrup to sweeten it up. No classic syrup and barely any skim milk. I love the staff,very friendly, but drinks are awful quality. We all know Starbucks is pricey and when you pay that much for a drink and it's made wrong or has half the amount in it, it's frustrating. I did have a few sips of the drink below, but it did fit in to my grande Starbucks mug. First bad review I've given.
Nothing warms you on a cold dreary day like a vanilla latte. Love this Starbucks!  Always busy but always great!

I'm not a fan of this location, not only is the service not great, I've actually witnessed with my own eyes, 3 times where someone has had a phone or tablet stolen from them while at this location. This obviously isn't Starbucks fault, but I try to avoid this location for safety reasons also.

Located just inside the Tar'gét store. This Starbucks is just what you need when looking for a caffeine fix during a toiletry reload day. It has plenty of seating which overlooks apparel, trinkets, the front entrance doors and cart hub. My barista Alicia was super nice and crafted my drink to perfection. 

Starbucks Reward cards are accepted, pastries on deck, lots of ceramic mugs, travel tumblers, bags of coffee and more.

~Christy

While this is a national chain, one would think it would have better sense to  locate a store that enough parking and was easy to get in and out ( whether on foot or driving ) this location has neither. As others have said it has limited parking and the store is in the worst possible location because it's on a very busy corner and no one AND I MEAN NO ONE  will let you exit that lot safely, you literally have to take your life in your hands when exiting their lot in a car, if I was Starbucks corporate I would have never opened a store here, plus their over priced coffee stinks

Drive Thru window 2:30 pm Saturday 12/15.  Ordered Strawberry Açaí refresher, Venti, w/6 scoops of berries.  They gave me a grande with 3 total berries in it.  After spending $5.00 for this I asked him "is this 6 scoops of berries?  He took it back then it had more berries but he poured the existing drink in a venti cup so we ended up with a 2/3rd full glass for full price. It is clear he didn't give much of a care for what he was shoving out the window. Very disappointed.... step it up Starbucks!!

I have been to this Starbucks several times since it has opened and am really pleased by the friendly staff and the coffee. I wouldn't recommend always going into the drive-thru since it's packed often with cars. 

Therefore, I will share a small secret with you.... 

behind the Starbucks building is more parking (that's where I go). You can park your car, walk inside, order and be out faster than those waiting in the drive-thru. I have saved so much time doing this. I'm serious! I get my Iced White Chocolate Mocha (and a sugar treat) far faster than those waiting in line in their car. It saves me serious time.  I think the staff have a good multi-tasking system, but I have never had to wait at the counter in-store to have my order taken and it only took the barista less than two minutes to have my drink ready for me. Each Starbucks is different, I have been to other locations where it was ok waiting in the drive-thru. 

Plus, there is very comfy seating outdoors (like a super large couch). My bum doesn't always like sitting in hard metal chairs so the outdoor couch is a nice change.

I've been back to this location this summer, and see they now have water at the ready, even for non-customers. Well done, if only they would bring back the spinach and feta wrap. A solid 3 stars, which is probably about right for any Starbucks.

I agree the service is slow as the drive through seems really busy. But the staff are friendly and apologized both days I visited for the delay. 

It has a very large interior seating area, decent outside seating with umbrellas, and two club chair seating areas. 

Lots of parking and the noise level is average. 

The bathrooms were clean when I visited

Perhaps im spoiled coming from Seattle where Starbucks are almost always excellent, but this place was consistently awful.After about 2 months of orders being botched, and blank stares when it was pointed out to the staff, we found a good Starbucks on Broadway. My favorite here was being told "we ran out of bagels.thats why we didnt bring it out to you". Oh i see.I was just expected to pay for it:.No apology.

AVOID THIS PLACE .

Pretty nice Starbucks - but then again, just a Starbucks, so don't be looking for anything unique. 

They have plenty of tables, lighting, and outlets. The staff were very nice and my order was correct and tasted good. 

No complaints!

Thank you Starbucks for making my low carb Venti iced coffee PERFECTLY! I've been to a ton of Starbucks in the city of Chicago and not one has mastered my order. Shame I have to drive 5 hours for a good low carb coffee. This made the end of my weekend in Edwardsville. Thanks baristas at this location!

I always forget this starbucks is there.  There is always seating when you go at the right time of the day.  I get my hair done at circa 79 so it's a great location to grab something sweet before getting beautified!

I had a gift card and a free drink for my Bday and decided to grab a bag of coffee. The cashier was extremely helpful in suggesting a bag, gave me a dollar off, and hooked up the iced coffee. Both baristas were really friendly.
Typical 5bucks with nice outdoor seating (only if it didn't smell like crap and if it it weren't hella hot outside).
It's a Starbucks by name not quality, all the food prices in the case are covered so you don't know how much they are charging for the food

This place is a really great location for my work commute and I look to make appointments in this area. It is right off highway 69. It is a bit out of the way to get to the location, but not bad. Wifi is reliable. There was no line to order and my drink was made quick. One con that I think is directly tied to the location is that it was packed. Had to wait for a spot to sit and I was asked about my table when I was going to use restroom and again as I was leaving.

The service was fine it was the lack of smiles or eye  contact that causes me to give it only three stars.   My only order was a chai Tea latte and a slice of pound cake. The product itself was fine and tasty.

Not bad for a Starbucks, the inside is always clean and the baristas are friendly. The drive thru on the side of the building is a bit precarious to navigate, however, especially if you drive a larger vehicle. There are plenty of scrape marks on the high curb to remind you of all the cars before you who did not heed the severeness of the rather sharp turn (probably close to 90 degrees!).

I don't know why, but years of not liking Starbucks and now I'm hooked. Still not a coffee fan but I love their black shaken iced tea. There is something about it that is SO yummy! I get a venti and it lasts me til lunch at work. It's a little caffeine and hydration. This location's parking lot sucks because it gets congested by the drive thru line. You can park in the lot of the shopping center and walk without having to worry about the line. The line goes REALLY quickly so I usually use it. I am there early if I go, around 7am, so lines aren't as long as closer to 8. I don't get food there often, but their vanilla bean scones are really good and the only thing I've tried. 

Staff are friendly and quick. I go often! Just wish it was a little less $$.

Standing in a Starbucks right now. Barista had one person with a two drink order in front of 
me. Turns out to be time consuming drinks. I'm waiting for an iced coffee. No other customers are in line. Three employees are standing around talking, not realizing that one of them could make the simple iced coffee for me so I could be on my way. Instead they continue to yap away, totally unaware of anything around them. Waited 5 minutes for simple unsweetened iced coffee. Congrats on the 1 star ladies. U earned it

Having been here quite a few times, I suppose it's time for a review. 

I can't say enough good things about the staff. I witnessed the longest line known to man this morning and the staff handled it cheerfully. There were no signs of stress, just the notion that they work as a well-oiled machine. 

I never had an order come out wrong, but I did knock off a star for the parking lot. It's pretty rough, especially in the rush hour where everyone is trying to get their caffeine fix.

I go here all the time as it is right near my work. Christina, Seth, Dante. . . the entire staff is awesome and more than happily indulge my indecisiveness when I want to try something different. 

Yay!

I love Starbucks and one with a drive thru. There were 4 cars in front of me and they went by very quickly. Less than 5 minutes in the drive thru and the employee was super nice. I order the egg white bites and they were delicious. Whoever though to use the label to help hold down the spoon is a genius. I don't like having lots of loose things in my hands and that was innovative to me which I appreciate. Thank you!

Staff was very kind and respectful.
The only thing is, that the drink I got I barley got any liquid. Thats my fault I guess..
Either way this place is pretty good and I can tell they care for their costumers that come through to get something delicious.

Honestly I would come here again thank you!!

My sister and I are frequent Starbucks customers. This locations customer service was beyond mediocre. We walked in and none of the store associates greeted us or asked us if we needed assistance. We waited about 5 minutes then asked if someone could help. Starbucks should be a company that trains all associates on high caliber customer service.
Grumpy employees, poorly made coffee, got a cookie for my son and for some reason it was frozen so it was gross and not edible. Dunkin is cheaper and a better experience.

Came here to pick up a LARGE order for work. We were delivering to prospective clients and had lots of coffee/accoutrements that needed to be perfect. The baristas not only had my order ready for me when I walked in, they helped me carry everything to my car and were so accommodating. Their customer service was so lovely and we will be returning next time we make a large delivery.
Great location!!  very friendly!! Very well trained stuff!! I would come back again for sure!
Expensive pricing, mediocre attitude of staff. Not on par with Sheraton standards, yet it sits in the lobby.

I was a regular here... Maybe 150 venti non-fat latte's in the last year and frequent tips.  In recent weeks, service has been horrible.  This morning, I was the only person waiting for service and waited for ten minutes until I finally walked out.  There were 8 baristas, some doing nothing and some chatting with each other, near the check out and ovens.  I walked outside and only two cars were waiting for service.  Longer term baristas are great, but clearly something has changed as things back up when even a little busy.  Shame.  I will try Kahwa.

What's Joe Pesci's line from Lethal Weapon, "you get ****ed at the drive-thru?!" Needed a lift to make it home on my daily commute between St Pete and Orlando, so I stopped at the exit 19 Starbucks and ordered a chai tea latte.  Two exits west on I4 I went for my first sip and it was coffee!! I hate coffee! Joe Pesci was right, I wasn't turning around, so they got me.
This is one of my most favorite Starbucks as they work fast paced and don't forget about care and concern! They are right on top! A+
The staff are practically  very friendly. Sometimes they can be really really  busy so it will take a little while to get your order done.
Starbux as it was meant to be! Real neighborhood feel with smart staff friendly with locals--even know people by name.
This place is popular!  There is always a line for the drive-through.  it is a great location and easy to get to.  I suggest the sausage breakfast sandwich with a cafe latte!

Another pocket Starbucks, similar in size to Church street Starbucks downtown. But here they offer acres of free parking. The greatest mix of local yuppies and visitors this side of Cool Springs comes here for caffeine energy to drop loads of loot shopping here at the most upscale mall in the great state of Tennessee. If the limited seating is full consider getting your coffee at the big Panera Bread, also inside the Green Hills Mall.

I visited this Starbucks right off of I-4 this morning to relax with a good cup of coffee.  It just opened up after renovations/remodeling.  I actually liked it better before the renovations.  The location is very convenient off of I-4, parking is limited and quite tight, I was not welcomed upon entering the shop, the employee was mildly friendly, I had to wait a couple of minutes at the ordering counter before any employee noticed me waiting to be served, my coffee was served hot and quickly, there was no Truvia to add to my coffee, the dining room was clean & tidy, seating was rather cramped and there were no comfortable chairs anywhere inside or outside of the place (very disappointing), there were VERY few electrical outlets, Wifi worked well, no music was playing, workers were working on various things in the dining area and serving area, and the men's restroom was basically clean.

Worst Starbucks ever. I waited for almost 10 minutes after ordering on drive thru. Employee did not even apologize for the delay and then completely forgot about offering me napkins, sugar and a straw. I needed to ask her for it.

When we take the motorcycle out for an early Sunday morning tour of the Tucson Mountains, we love to end the trip here for breakfast so we can sit out by the bike and enjoy.  The staff, as at all Starbuck's, are friendly and the food is quick and good.  Thumbs up!

This Starbucks is in a cute little part of Webster Groves next to Gazebo Park, where events and farmers markets are held in summer. It's just like any other Starbucks but this is right next to my work so I go there all the time, usually around 2:30-3pm when I hit the afternoon slump. The staff are friendly and always prompt with my order, and they rarely mess it up.

My go-to drinks are the white chocolate mocha with non-fat milk and no whipped cream, as well as the java chip frappacino, skinny and without whipped cream.

The clientele at this location are a mixture of business people, hippies, young teens (Nerinx Hall, an all-girls high school is just around the corner), university students (Webster University is within walking distance), artists, entrepreneurs, and stay-at-home moms. You really get a mixed bag here.

I typically don't sit and stay to drink my lattes, but when I have in the past, the furniture is comfy, with a variety of seating choices for individuals or small groups, and the place is kept clean and orderly. It doesn't wow my pants off, but it maintains the high standard of Starbucks that I expect. A solid standby.

It's difficult to be fair when discussing Starbucks!

The name is so polorizing.  True coffee lovers, people who really know and love coffee, who believe, correctly or not that Italy is the only country in the world where you can't get a bad cup.  Who only buy their beans at LeColombe or have them Fed-Xed from David Schermer in Seattle, who have a definite ratio in their heads of what % robusto and what % arabica makes the best brew. These people hate Starbucks.  They vilify their "baristas", they rail against their penchant for over roasting, their fascination for stupid names, their insane list of combinations and their have-a-nice-day-robotic-Stepford staff.  

The rest of us are thankful that Starbucks, regardless of how they did it, raised the bar on coffee excellence in this country.  No one can deny that before them, 98% of the coffee served in America was swill.  Now, as a direct result of the marketing juggernaut they have become, even WaWa serves coffee that is better than good restaurants served less than 15 years ago.  OK, they still have to work on getting rid of the flavors, but it's a valid point.

For those of us in Philly, we don't have to go to a Starbucks so long as we can get to, Anthony's on Ninth Street, Le Colombe on Rittenhouse Square and Manayunk, Cafe Fulya on Second Street, The Last Drop on Pine, Ants Pants on South, Philadelphia Java Company on Fourth and on Second, Fitzwater Cafe on Seventh & Fitz, Saxby's in Haverford and a few others that I know when I drive by, and certainly Ray's on Ninth for if there is cleaner coffee making apparatus in the city, I'd like to see it,  But in a pinch, with my daily schedule sometime denying me access to these quality coffee houses, I get a short one at the local SB fully understanding that the good houses got pinched into action by that audacious company out of Seattle.

Love them or hate them, we, the coffee drinkers have benefited by them.

This Starbucks is located inside of a strip mall near Parsons and Ellerslie facing west.  

This Starbucks is sort of small but being in the South Ed Common area I had to head there from Leduc to get my You Are Here Collection mugs.  They had plenty.  I later learned the Safeway on 50 in Leduc had one mug while the store in Leduc on 46 just south of Safeway didn't carry them.

So yes I drove up to Ellerslie from Leduc just for the mug but I collect them and they had them.  I was having trouble with the box they came in (getting the lid from the back to the front but the barista helped me with it.  I can't believe how hard they are to take off.

Although I didn't spend long at this store I was greeted by another barista immediately upon entry and was kindly helped by the staff.  The place seemed rather full too, the seating that is.

After the unpleasant visit to the Starbucks on Whyte Ave, I felt the need to head to a spot that I know delivers.  Imagine my surprise when I discovered that this one wasn't listed on Yelp.

So, in addition to a coffee, I get to write a first review.  Yay me.

Location wise, nothing spectacular here.  It's in the middle of a retail park, so not a lot of foot traffic to watch and make fun of.  Yes, I'm one of those people.  It is, however, clean, the staff are friendly and competent, and they have pictures of some of the local police squads on the walls.  Any place that shows such obvious support for law enforcement gets my business.

It's also close to Best Buy, so once I get my techno-geek fix, I can also get my caffeine fix.  One stop shopping for addictions.  Can't go wrong there.
I love this Starbucks...efficient drive thru, great service, friendly people, delicious coffee what more can I say? fabulous!
They made my drink cold on accident and they remade my drink so it was hot and they even brought it out to my car for me! Amazing customer service!

Stopped here on my way back from a cruise. This location is conveniently located off of highway 10 and they have a drive-thru! The store was clean and offered all the touches Starbucks is known for. I redeemed my birthday drink today and got a venti iced chestnut praline. The cashier was helpful with answering my questions about the drink and made it easily customizable. When compared to other locations across the country, this one is pretty good.
I went into this Starbucks recently and was impressed by the friendly staff and quick service! Definitely my favorite Starbucks location in town!

Got to stop by every morning......I try all the new blends......summer time iced coffees are great.

Have my own starbucks cup !!!

Ever since there RO (reverse osmosis) went out its never been the sames. Its been over a year. They say its back but you can tell when you order an ice tea. It should look clean and refreshing as at other Starbucks. There ice tea looks dirty. Disappointing that home office isn't helping this location.

Ehh, this starbucks is ok. I came here mid afternoon on a Saturday and the place was packed. Waited in line for at least 5 minutes to order and then another 5 for my drink. Luckily, my drink was prepared well and correctly. The service was average, nothing to complain about but nothing spectacular. The barista making the drinks was disheveled in appearance and had liquid all over the front of his apron. Granted, I get that spills happen but his apron was gross, he should have changed to another one if he was going to continue making drinks.
Overall, average experience. This place seems to have pretty good reviews so perhaps I caught it at a bad time.

This Starbucks sucks. The customer service is horrible, they all act as if they don't want to be at work, and seem unhappy there. The first time I went, I ordered a small Carmel macchiato with an extra shot. When I received my drink it was a bit watery. I let that one slide and didn't think much of it. However, second time around I ordered the same exact thing but a medium instead. It tasted horrible. Again, it was so watery and had no flavor. I was so disappointed because I love Starbucks. I will not be returning here again. Save your money and go to a different Starbucks.

Sometimes you need a little bit of generic basic bitch things in your life. This place is one of those places for me. My favorite Starbucks in the city. Everyone is friendly ( usuallyI only go in the mornings, the late staff looks miserable at times but I understand).

This location does quite a good job. I have gone inside as well as through the drive thru. The drive through can take a bit of time when it's busy, but if there is a line up and you're short on time, park and go inside. 
Service is always fast inside, but parking can be an issue every now and again due to limited spots.
