I usually get myself a soy vanilla latte, sometimes I get an iced one. They are usually great but every now and again I get one with burned espresso- meaning the shot has been out over 30 seconds before being put into the syrup or dumped into steamed milk/soy/almond etc. If you go back and tell them, they will of course make you another. 
The interior is that of all Starbucks, modern, clean and has a good amount of seating. 
The staff is always friendly and helpful, they keep their goodies well stocked and aren't usually out of too much. 
This is a good location. 
Enjoy.

I'm just confused on if this was the standard way to make this drink? Every matcha latte I've gotten has always been mixed? This is seriously milk with powder setting on top. I understand if you're busy and I'm sure there is a drink set up that is company standard across the board but this was really disappointing seeing and having another customer complain about her drink not being right either. Maybe I've just been spoiled with other baristas who don't even know me and they mix my ingredients together??

The next time I think it'll be fun to watch a scary movie, I'll think back to last night when I stayed awake until 5am, anxiously waiting to either be dragged out of my bed by evil paranormal forces, or fall into a possessed state and kill my dog, my neighbors, and ultimately myself. Finally, when fatigue overwhelmed fear, I slept, but woke up only an hour later to the sound of my dog's muffled dream-barks. 

Thankfully, I knew holy humans with warm, reviving beverages were a mere 2 blocks away. I ventured out into the crisp morning air and despite the darkness at dawn, I thought it better to be mugged than remain captive to my racing imagination. 

One cup of coffee later, I returned to my doomsday domicile, curled up on the couch and thumbed through my roommate's coffee table literature: a photography book aptly titled, "Women Before 10am." Better dreams next time. Avoid "Paranormal Activity;" it will haunt you!

Old favorite spot to get coffee. Debey has been rude to me on 3 occasions, making me never want to go back. Once she ignored me as I waited for her to never look back at me after handing me a half full cup of coffee in the size I ordered. Another time I asked for a drink to be split, never was a problem in the last 2 years for this, but she acted suddenly angry I asked and gave me a small hot cup and no lid for an iced drink. I waited for a lid  but she ignored me then also. I am tired of feeling this rude person's passive aggression. I wonder how many other have fallen victim to this. She should not work with the public
Great atmosphere at this location. Unfortunately, my chocolate croissant was soggy. But I recommend the bacon Gouda breakfast sandwich! Mobile ordering is great.

Ever wait in cue at drive-thru for twelve minutes...and you're the only car?  Why would they need iced tea in 87° weather?  At RUSH HOUR??!?! 



You just never know!

This is my least favorite location in Tucson and I've been to them all! The staff here is unprofessional and slow... Currently I've been standing here for FIFTEEN minutes waiting on a breakfast sandwich. That's not counting the ten I waited for my six drinks. They keep asking if my order is complete and I keep telling them I need my food! Some of the employees are hustling and a few of the staff are clearly trying to hold this place together. 

I would strongly recommend going to the Grantand Swan location where everything runs smoothly, they are professional, and are able to get drink and food orders out in a timely manner.

Really love this Starbucks! The employees here are super nice and I have always had really quick service. I also love the fact that they have a drive thru (YAAAY laziness!!). All around a solid starbucks and a staple for my caffeine fix

Five stars for a great layout and views. Ample seating inside includes a long community table. The wrap around patio has a long couch-like seating along with a half dozen tables. While waiting in line you don't feel like you are bumping up against seated patrons due to the spacious interior.

The staff seems well trained and friendly. There is adequate parking and a drive thru ( don't try to get into the drive thru if you enter from Pantano - it is best approached from the Speedway entrance or from behind the adjoining Burger King).

Just the same as any starbucks. Local one in downtown.  Often hard to find seating as this place is packed...especially outside when it is good weather.  Nice, friendly service and often fairly fast.  A nice place to stop for coffee when downtown.
Still...this location is one of the most unfriendly around.  I also didn't receive what I ordered.  I will not be coming back until they get their $h*t together.
Ten minutes in drive thru.  Second car in line.  Eight minutes were AFTER I paid.  WTF!

I just waited 10 minutes for my mobile order to be completed. This is after placing my order 10 minutes prior to walking in the door. It took 20 minutes to make my drinks, from the time that I placed the order to the time that I walked out of the Starbucks.  Let me reiterate, it was a mobile order. When I arrived there was no one in line, the baristas were making two drinks. There were two baristas and a manager. The manager finally asked what I was waiting for and I told him that I was waiting for a mobile order. He took the mobile order from the printer and put the stickers on 2 cups and told the baristas that they needed to be made right away. The baristas were making drinks, the manager was wiping off the counter. The cups sat there and the manager continued to fiddle with other stuff behind the counter. Here's my question. Why wouldn't the manager just step in and make the mobile order. BTW the mobile order consisted of two iced teas. Not brain science. And the barista finally picked  up one of the ice tea cups, looked at the sticker and began to make the ice tea. Whatever he did, he did incorrectly, because he then threw that drink into the sink and began again. He finished that drink and then picked up the other cup. There was no immediacy in any of this. If this is the worst thing that happens to me today, I am happy, however the reason for placing a mobile order is to have the drinks ready when you arrive. If the Starbucks have been swamped with people, I would understand. If the manager had stepped in to help, I would be a little more forgiving. But all three of the employees seemed to be inept at accomplishing the goal of getting to teas onto the counter. And I am writing this review, because this is not the first time that this has happened. If any corporate Starbucks people are listening, it would be great if there were an alarm of some sort, a bell, a beep, buzz, that would allow the employees at the Starbucks to know that there is a mobile order waiting. Just a thought.

I have been to this Starbucks about five times. Each time I've been here it has been an extremely frustrating experience.

I tend to go through the drive-thru because I am a graduate student and I am always in a hurry to get to my next place. However, whenever I am in the drive-thru there is always an excessively long line and the drinks always take a long time to make. Obviously, the person who frequents the drive-thru tends to be in a hurry. But, instead of making my drink quickly and efficiently it has been made incorrectly about ninety percent of the time and takes about ten times longer than it should. The first time it happened, I thought it's just the drink, it's semi-complicated, I get it. The next time I chose something as basic as a Iced Caramel Macchiato. It looked like the correct item so I was thrilled, but it tasted awful and still took ten minutes to receive it.

I know how tough working in the service industry is, I work it in, but when I timidly asked them if they could remake my drink or brought attention to the fact it wasn't what I ordered they failed to take responsibility for the matter and made me feel horrible for bringing attention to it. Customer service should be high on the priority list for a well-known coffee place, but instead it was more than lacking.

I vowed this morning that I will no longer be frequenting to this location. Save your money and go to the Central West End location, they always have a good attitude and they are coffee connoisseurs.

First time I came here, I had just dropped my cat off for surgery. Went to get some coffee for the nerves. An older gentlemen who worked there could tell I was out of it and asked. Very friendly staff and great service. Love this Starbucks and I frequent it regularly. :)

Great convenience with the drive-thru. Even during the morning hours, the service is expedient. But if you need to spend time here, beware of the limited parking and quite loud music (you're a coffee shop, not a Chipotle!).

Im happy to find this Starbucks as an alternative to finding parking to go into a Clayton location. I went through the drive thru in the middle of the afternoon with only one car in front of me. It was a little slow but not terribly bad. I got a Venti iced matcha latte my go to afternoon drink. When I got it it wasn't filled to the top and had too much ice. This happens sometimes with the shaken teas but it's nice when the baristas are aware of it and make sure the drink is full for the $5+ you pay for it. Overall it wasn't bad I'd definitely use it instead of Clayton.

Your typical Starbucks! Neither bad nor great. Glad it's here though. I always need a coffee on the drive back to Nashville! Convenient location. And, even though people forget, just because they have a drive thru doesn't mean you have to use it! They still have an inside (which is a lot faster)! I'm feeling (and sounding) snarky today, so I'm going to end this one here.

Okay, so I get that I'm a Washingtonian, and I'm probably a coffee snob. Being that I live in the Starbucks capital of the US, I find it annoying when I go to a Starbucks and they do something extra stupid. Like allow some spoiled rotten teenager tell me they don't brew any "new" (wait for it) COFFEE after 5pm. Uh... really? To my confusion, he responds by standing there, like I'm the dodo head, and he's following corporate policy or something. Frustrating!

This is a cute location as it's right across from Monument Circle, very kind staff and quickly prepared my order as well. I love walking to this location in the morning, getting a cup of coffee in continuing to walk the rest of the city. I highly suggest stopping at this location if you are visiting in town!

Decent Starbucks. Very small parking lot, maybe 5-6 spots. Behind it is a huge Lake & in the winter when it's frozen, it turns into an ice rink. Kids and adults alike, play hockey and twirl around from morning till sunset. They all pile into Starbucks to warm up after, so it's always busy during the winter. There's about 10-12 tables/chairs down one side of the store. There are four leather club chairs by the front window which are a coveted spot. Across the front there's a counter top with some stools. Two big, clean bathrooms in the back, with baby changing stations. The place was clean. My particular barista couldn't have been nicer! There's also additional seating out back, overlooking the scenic lake for the warmer months. The only thing missing is a fireplace. The Newtown location has one, which makes it my favorite location. But, they closed today 1/7/18 for 3 weeks of renovations!! Ahh!! Now, I have to get my caffeine fix someplace else till they reopen. All in all, this location is nice, clean & mobile service is quick.

The barista at this @Starbucks location who's name is Steven was very nice and patient with me when I was attempting to use my 'Birthday Rewards' via the Starbucks app on my iPhone.  I wasn't really familiar with the app and Steven helped to familiarize me with it in addition to explaining to me the benefits of the rewards program.  Gold star for Steven!
This place seriously takes forever. I've been to Starbucks all over the USA and this one is the slowest! They take 15-20 mins in the drive thru when there's only two cars! Workers are nice
Made the trek because it said they were open for another hour online but they were already locked up and mopping when we got there

This Starbucks is one of the friendliest and down home coffee shop in Fishers. The manager, Andy, and his team try to constantly deliver good customer service. The majority of the baristas are friendly and helpful and even remember my name.

[465]

This busy corner Starbucks always prepares to order.  It's hard to get in /out due to the super busy parking lot.   No drive thru.   They really need double the size lot.  

We go when it's not busy ..

I'll definitely be back.

One of the most efficient Starbucks I have been to. Not to mention the baristas are amazing, and really seem to love making conversation with their customers, which makes us feel more important! If Ryann or Logan is working, they will 110% make your day.

I frequently visit this Starbucks location and the establishment is always clean, shelves orderly, and the staff is extremely nice. 

Today when I went into Starbucks with my husband, the staff went out of their way to make sure everything was great. My husband ordered his usual and I ordered a water and a white mocha. 

He received his coffee and my water  pretty quickly and we sat down waiting for my mocha. We waited for a few minutes and when he went to check on the status, an employee had already made it and placed it on the counter and someone picked it up. 

Realizing this, they apologized (totally wasn't their fault) and quickly made me another. I really appreciated the fact that they immediately made me another drink and apologized- even though the apology wasn't necessary.

I have been to this location several times over the last few years. I have had excellent service and poor unfriendly sevice. It depends on who is working as with all place. 

My most recent experience as usual there is a long line in the drive through, but it moves fairly quickly. Once I placed my simple order of a venti White Mocha, it was just a few mintues before I was at the window. My order was ready, hot, and handed to me. I loaded more money to my gold card, signed the receipt and was on my way. 

The window attendent was friendly and quick.
I normally go to the drive-thru location on 96th because it is less crowded, but it is usually more traffic issues to get their.
The place is dirty and small. Too bad for the most important plaza in Indianapolis. The cashier was ill-mannered. She didn't say a word to me at all.
This place has the best staff of ANY Starbucks anywhere in the world (and I've visited plenty!) Kudos to Janet and the rest of the AM crew - she might be the world's friendliest barista!

Has a good sized sitting area to sit and relax. Management could have thought about increasing the area in front of the counter when they last renovated the place. It can get really tight when a line starts to form. I noticed that the baristas are not that quick in preparing orders. So expect a longer wait compared to other Starbucks.

My opinion might be slightly biased because waaaaayyyyy back in the day I worked at this location. Although, the fact that I am now a customer should speak to the quality of this store. Overall this store is clean and fairly efficient. Sometimes they can be uber sloooww in the mornings, which is why I marked them down a star.  On more than one occasion I had to wait quite a bit of time. Fortunately, I went in today around 7a and everything was easy breezy. Most of the baristas are fairly friendly and are always ready with a drink recommendation. One thing I like about this store is that they value their customers and make an effort to learn something about you especially if you are a regular. If your in the area, you should definitely stop by!
New SB in Edwardsville! I am so excited. Tables and chairs are so nice and convenient. Close to campus. Loved it!

The coffee is always hot and the cold drinks are cold. Makes me happy! I hate mediocre temperatures in my drinks and do NOT get that here. The staff is helpful and friendly. 
Thank you for taking a leap of faith and giving me a coffee that one early morning 
that I forgot my Billfold -
while I rushed home to get my $money. 
I was flattered that you recognized I am a frequent customer!
The Barista Mark always has a smile on his face! Super friendly staff and awesome set up
Great location, but the lines are long and staff are less than friendly. My drink tasted different than normal.... Not entirely sure why. Otherwise, just a standard Starbucks experience.

This Starbucks blows.  2 stars because it has a drive-thru.  They mess up my order constantly and it isn't a complicated order.  It's 4 shots of espresso, ice and water.  The Starbucks on Westshore and Boy Scout is the gold standard of drive-thru Starbucks.  If you are crossing the bridge to Tampa anyway on the way to work or something, go to that one instead if you can.  

I also heard a bunch of homophobic slurs coming out of the drive-thru window one day during what I can only assume was a joke by the staff.  I thought that was pretty unprofessional and could have been very insulting to someone.

Typically drive thru and although the line may appear long at peak hours, the line actually goes pretty fast. 

The employees at this Starbucks have messed up my order multiple times, but they always attempt to adjust the drinks to make them right.

Consistently the same as the others....I was glad to find this in the small town of Collinsville.  I got my mocha and was ready to make my trip back to Chicago.  Clean and efficient.  That's Starbucks.

This location is always busy but the staff members are really nice! I've never had a bad experience here! They greet you by name and sometime remember your order. Clearly I am a regular here before work!

This once was my favorite Starbucks location, but recently they've fallen behind on keeping the place clean - there always seems to be overflowing trash, or wrappers/crumbs on all the tables and floors. On a more positive note - There is a lot of seating, including a long table.  And the baristas are usually very friendly. And the coffee - Let's be honest - Starbucks Coffee, is Starbucks Coffee - that's why we like it. It is standardized; no matter where you go, it's the same brand and pretty much the same product. I am your typical Grande Caramel Macchiato extra hot no-foam latte girl, and this place never fails to give me that inspiring jolt of caffeine infused inspiration.

Love this place! Great staff who will make anything I like and have no problem remaking something for me. The space is always clean or close to it and it's a great space to work in. Parking maybe a tad tricking but it is Clayton. Would recommend this Starbucks anytime!

This Starbucks got me through 6 months of being here shortly after their 530am opening to pick up my espresso drink on the way to work as my treat to myself for every 24+ hour shift I had to work in that 6 month period. I ordered on the app before heading out the door and had no trouble pulling up quickly and finding parking right out front that early in the morning, running in and grabbing my perfectly ready latte with my name on it, and getting on my way to work.

Standard Starbucks,  but quite a bit slower than others I've been to. Drive thru always has 5-8 cars in it and you will often sit in line for 15-20 min. The parking lot becomes a clustered mess when the drive thru line backs up. Inside is just as congested  and slow. This places is crazy busy all the time.
This place can be either a hit or a miss depending who makes the drink and whether or not the person is new. I do like the friendliness of the staff and I always leave good tips for their hard work.

A nice place to stop by in the round-robin missions to Home Depot and close to my partner's parent's home.  Despite its smallish size, it has everything.  Next door to Panera, in case someone in the party isn't enamored with the offerings at Starbucks and wants something more substantial to eat.  Outdoor seating so you can share the time with Fido.

I've been going to this Starbucks for years! I can say it did its share on helping me graduate college. The staff is always great and the service is normally pretty quick, depending on what time of day you go. There have been plenty of times I've had to wait a while because the line is very long. They are pretty busy in the mornings and then again at lunch/afternoon. If you don't want to wait too long id go at a random time in the day, like 3pm haha. 

They have a good amount of seats there and they have my favorite--outside seating!! Those go really quick, so if you see a free table outside make sure to grab it right away! 

Other than that it's a normal Starbucks-nothing too crazy about it. Good for college students, trust me--they can help you graduate. Grab that Venti coffee and keep.it.moving! 

If you are a college student now and reading this...life gets better!! Enjoy it while you can! ;)

I had an AWFUL experience. The bearded, white dude with pierced ears really killed my vibe. He was rude to my friend when she asked to use her Starbucks card. Afterwards, he saw me walk back and forth from my seat and the bathrooms to check if they were available, but failed to tell me that I had to use a key. Eventually, a customer was kind enough to share this information with me. I used the key to open the bathroom door and put it back on the counter. I figured that it wasn't very busy there and I was only going to wash my hands for a second, so I didn't need secured privacy. However, when I was about to walk into the bathroom, the guy yells, "SOMEONE WILL WALK IN BEHIND YOU IF YOU DON'T BRING THE KEY IN!" in the most rude, obnoxious, and condescending tone possible. Later, when he made my drink, it was overflowing all over the cap and it spilled everywhere. I could not even enjoy my blueberry scone or drink because I was SO INFURIATED BY THIS RUDE BARISTA. Ugh, he totally ruined the experience.

Poor coffee, wrong cake, half hour in line at drive in.  4pm Saturday afternoon.  On our way to the beach from Plant city we thought a simple coffee stop was just what would make the drive nicer.  When we pulled up to the window 25 minutes later our cup of regular coffee and tall cappuccino were not even ready.   They were making a frozen drink for the car behind us and left it on the drive in counter while we waiting over 5 more minutes for our simple order.  

Once you enter the drive in you cannot escape therefore if you have to wait 30 minutes you are stuck..no way out.   

Finally on the road and in the bag was pumpkin bread instead of banana.   We didn't want that.  

We will never ever go there again.  Word to the wise, grab a wawa cup of joe next door instead.

I am a fan of Starbucks due to the fact that I like to know what I'm getting and usually you get the same thing at each store. 
This store on the other hand is different than most, while the coffee is the same the staff leave something out.......like kindness! I could say maybe they are just having a bad day, but it seems that any day that ends in y is bad for them!! 
Go for the coffee not the relationships, b/c this isn't your local  friendly shop!
This is my favorite Starbucks in the area. They are usually pretty quick, friendly and haven't messed up and order yet!

I don't know why this happens but when it's only the male employees working they mess up
Orders, forget orders and don't call out name. 
I'm on a time limit. Last time I waited 10 minutes I walk up to employee area and said if you can't make my drink I have to leave I'll take refund. The guy said oh you didnt get your drink. He said to other guy where's his drink. He said I am didn't get order. What the Hell they are 3 feet away from each other and using ear pieces. 
I'm done with this location. 
I will say when the females employees work no issues. 
Management need to be updated on this and  changed if they can not train correctly. Maybe giving money back on this issue. How will the store ever learn.

Even when this place appears to be busy via drive thru, they still manage to get drinks out fast and accurately! I've gone a few times the past two weeks and haven't been disappointed yet. I have never been inside, so can't comment about that.

Inside of cafe is so messy, not clean at all,,
My coffee, americano,, tasted horrible. Which is hard to make it terrible ,, it is just black coffee after all. 
And my partner ordered caramel macchiato,, it was not any better. Horrible as well. 
Waste of money on coffee
Great Baristas, good coffee, large seating areas with laptop plug ins and plenty of cool people to chat with. Gotta love this Starbucks.
Nice location near me,  Free Wifi and good place to meet someone for a coffee or do some work.

This Starbucks always have fresh coffee.  The staff is very pleasant and I have made this location my go to place.  I love the convenience of the drive thru. And the cleanliness of the outside and inside.  It's located in a popular location which makes it easier to get to where your going.

Weelcome In 
James said
So Friendly & Upbeat
Clean
Love the Design of the store
I'll be coming here.often 
Summer Out door seating

I went inside to order for 5 different people at work and was so disappointed by my experience. The coffee was great and Lisa (the one who took my very lengthy order) was phenomenal but the rest of the staff left MUCH to be desired.  As Lisa was taking my orders,  occasionally she would have a question.  When she would turn to look to her peers for guidance,  they would blatantly walk past her or ignore her completely.  It's obvious that this group has no respect for team work or their customer's time. None of them were smiling or friendly other than Lisa. Very disappointed.  I'll be going to a different location from now on.  Great job to Lisa for providing excellent customer service despite the negative environment!!!

Best Starbucks in town. The store is always clean, and the team members are always polite, attentive, enthusiastic, and friendly. I stopped at this store several times over the past few months, and I was consistently impressed with the quality of services. The coffee's good, too : )
Consistently excellent service, and the espresso has bite. Best SBUX in Tucson.

I am in the area this week temping for work so normally I would not go to this location. Have to say it was the BEST service I have ever received at a Starbucks! Greg & Shane were very friendly & helped me with a question I had, service was also quick! Really helped with a good way to start my day, Great job to the staff & management! Wish I lived closer this would be my new Starbucks!
Caffeine...now that's some old school ADD drug...

The new text in your order Is the worst idea.

 when you're standing there waiting while people walk in and get their drinks. I stood there and watched 10 people walk in and pick up there drinks. what the hell. It just seems to be extra irritating when you don't have your coffee in the morning and then to receive your coffee and it tastes burnt. You need about two more barista's

Bonus points to this Starbucks for being located inside of my hotel (New Orleans Marriott).  I was able to visit each day to get my daily Iced Green Tea craving satisfied.  The cool thing about this location is that the barista told me I could bring my cup back for 60 cent refills!  Score!  I was ready to take complete advantage of this until housekeeping tossed my cup out while I was out of the room.  Grrrr!

Finally stopped at this location for the first time on Sunday. We went thru the drive-thru and surprisingly there was no line. I love that they serve breakfast sandwhiches all day and they have a really nice variety of filling sandwiches. On our next visit I will definately be getting out the car and going in to check out the inside.

The drive-thru experience went smoothly and the employee was very friendly. I want to bring the fur babies next visit so they can get the little cup of whipped cream. I ordered the caramel frappuccino grande and chocolate croissant which is served warm. Panera is usually my spot but I forgot how good Starbucks is. Yes, I will definately be returning.
It is close to the house and love the customer service here. The drinks are made consistently correct!

My only advice to you as a consumer is to double check your order each time before you get too far away. I order the same drink every time I go to Starbucks in person or from the mobile app. I just hit reorder on the app and my order always is made with almond milk. Over half of the time I get it from this location it is made with regular milk. The past three out of the four times I've been there,  my drink has been wrong; cold when I asked for hot, regular milk when I ask for almond. I know it's my own fault for not checking it for 5-10min after I get a hot drink and am no longer anywhere near the store because I let it cool down, but if the sticker says "almond drink" on it; I'm trusting the person who is making it to read the order whether I am in person ordering it or ordering on the mobile app. I don't get the almond milk because I like the flavor, I get it because I can't have cow's milk, and that is another $8.59 for the drink, literaly, down the drain. A 5 shot caramel macchiato with almond milk is all I want... That is the treat that I occasionally give myself, and now I had to throw it away and get sick at the same time...

I always appreciate good customer service, and this location does not disappoint! The staff knows its regulars well and knows how to take of them. There have been times in the drive thru where we'll here, "just pull up to the window - we know what you want!" which makes it super convenient when you're heading back to work! 

A staff is only as good as their management team, and management has done a great job training their teammates to do the best they can. Everyone is so friendly even during a rush! And we rarely have to wait very long for mobile order or in line order.

I would say that our drinks are made to our liking 95% of the time. Sometimes there are discrepancies but if we bring them to their attention, they're quick to fix. 

Of course, you've got inside-outside seating with a drive thru, with the entirety of the cafe always pretty clean. Definitely one of my favorite locations.
As far as Starbucks go, it was fast. Nothing else to report apart from sketchy characters.  Starbucks today is what McDonalds was 30 years ago, you know what you're getting. The wifi always works.

I love this Starbucks and I've stopped here many times on my drives across Florida on I-4, it's located off of Exit 19 driving east. The extremely tall sign is just one of the many things I like about this location and when I spot it no matter the time day or night I'm stopping yes they are open 24 hours. How great is that?

For me Starbucks is about the "product" so having to wait a little longer than normal is never an issue for me if my order is correct and if they correct any mistakes and stand by their customer service promise to make me a new one if there are issues. I look at this location like it's an oasis after driving for hours on I-4.

The staff has always been friendly and has provided excellent service and delivers awesome drinks. A few annoying reviews doesn't change my opinion .

On mobile order you can ask for other roasts besides Pike -- for instance, blonde. Blonde roast is available past the morning hours via a pour-over. This store often makes a blonde americano instead. I get that it's easier to make a blonde americano than a blonde pour-over, but that's not what I asked for. What I'm now drinking tastes like nothing. I was on my way on a trip, so I couldn't ask for a remake, as I have before. Don't do stupid substitutions -- an americano is not at all the same thing as a cup of roasted coffee!

This Starbucks is really good, I have to say it could be 5 stars. However, it will never be 5 stars because the parking lot has only 5 spaces and one of them is handicapped. Which is extremely odd because the inside seating area is massive? The staff of very friendly and the location is awesome! Small historic town vibe going on here. It is very relaxing with small outside seating next to the lake/dam that runs through town.

Great service at this location.   It's the usual fare but the menu is better detailed and the service polite, pleasant, and not perfunctory.   It has a drive through and on this Sunday afternoon, the line was six or seven deep.   There are plant of outside tables but you are on busy Route 38 so I'm not sure how relaxing that would be.

Located in a small brick house off of 116th Street, this Starbucks frequently has a long line of car going through the drive-through. The inside is surprisingly large and full of great work spaces. There's a big bar against the windows, but community table, and a few smaller tables. Service seems to go super fast inside (fewer people opt to actually go inside when there's a drive-through). $3.75 for a cup of water and egg, sausage breakfast sandwich is pretty dang good.

I am in Tampa quite a bit and I tend to stay away from Starbucks just because it can be insane, however, I was one of the designated coffee-getters for an event and Starbucks seemed the most classic. We came in with a 21-drink order and the baristas handled it like champs. They messed up on a few things but made up for it with amazing attitudes in the face of our Starbucks swimming pool challenge. The atmosphere is typical earthy tones and people sitting on their laptops. Comfy... if you have a Mac. (;
The drive thru service is so so so slow it's comical. Something needs to be done to make it more efficient

They mess up my coffee every single time. They don't know how to listen or follow directions! At least the coffee/espresso is not burnt tasting though. I go to it only because I work across the street, and it's convenient. Not anymore
Not a great example of how a starbucks operates. Ordered my coffee and had a burnt taste to it and threw it out. Tasted as though the grind needs to be adjusted.

This is my favorite location by far! There is almost never a wait or a line inside. The drive through is another story.. But come on people save the planet and get out of your car for 5 mins! 
The employees at this location are on top of it! One time I was here I had an issue with a rocky table and a lid that was not on very well and it ended in my toddler being covered in my coffee. Much to her dismay in her brand new outfit.. She freaked out I freaked out making sure she was ok (the coffee was hot) she was fine and much more concerned about her new mini mouse shirt than herself. I took her in the restroom as 3 different employees came and asked if she was ok.. By the time I got her washed off in the bathroom and back to the lobby they had cleaned up the mess, to include my cell phone. They had remade my drink and set it on the table with another cake pop for my daughter. They went above and beyond to make one hell of a morning as efficient and good as possible. I did not say anything to them about how anything happened just went in mom mode to fix the issue with out complaint as moms do. I was not going to complain, I was actually going to buy another coffee. But I didn't have to. I love that this location is so close to work. I make sure to visit this location over any other.

This is a nice big Starbucks with lots of seating as well as a few kiosks with Starbucks drinkware and gift idea items. The staff are very friendly. I was afraid there'd be a long wait in the morning, but it was fairly quick and I was off on my way.

It's a Starbucks, which is just like every other one on the planet, but this one has a drive-thru, which is nice....if you don't want to add stuff to your drink.  But, the place has parking, room to sit, it's clean, so it's what you'd expect.  Good enough.

This Starbucks is not for people who like a friendly staff. They were not rude but they were not like the type of staff I am used to having at my CA Starbucks. So if you don't mind that, then this is a good Starbucks.

I still remember the anxiety of my first time at a coffee shop, and no, it wasn't a Starbucks. But, it was a looooong time ago, and back when Starbucks was not a household name yet (don't ask don't tell). BUT, I was in highschool and was living in Seattle and learning that coffee drinking was more than, well, "coffee" :) and drinking; it was espresso, cappachee...what? and music and hanging out and books, and yada yada yada. Back to the purpose of my story, even the newbie trying to order a large (lol, large, haha) Mocha drink thingie (not that that would ever happen these days, I think babies come out drinking Starbucks and Redbull. I digress) will be treated with the utmost of patience and friendliness at this location. They've always been that way with me when, even I, (I used to work at one) forget how to speak Starbuxian (I made that up, catchy right?) or just plain have a brain fart and can't choose WHICH delicious diet no-no to indulge in. Although, they're sandwiches are a good choice for a meal and allow you  to stay in your diet plan should you choose, and the cake-pops are just enough of a sweet-fix (and look like one bite, but believe me it's just right) to tame your sweet tooth. And, if the end result is not perfect drink-wise, here's the word, PERFECT (there's your insider knowledge folks), they gotta make it again.  But, the Barista's here have always asked me without prompting if my drink was right, with smiles galore. And I've left happy and highly caffeinated.  So, although I'm still prone to favor those Seattle-type grunge artsy coffee houses of my youth I have sold-out and become a Starbucks fan, this location gets 5 stars (never a line and always friendly). Oh, another thing, if you order the delicious pastries they will heat them and make them uber delish. It truly does take them up a notch. You know, like you might want to eat it in private kind of good....teehee. Try the lemon cake, never had it before here and now it's my fav.
I ordered three drinks. They were all made wrong the first time. The second time two were made wrong. The third time, they were still made wrong and I gave up trying.

Only thing I don't like is the traffic and now there's no direct turning lane to go straight in anymore, have to make a u turn now. Other than that great service, nice staff and wonderful tall mocha Fraps and pastries ( that's what I always get there)

This is my favorite Starbucks in Brandon. The customer service is very conducive and welcoming. I also like the availability of a drive-thru. The one on Causeway is closest to my home, but their staff sucks! I always love grabbing my coffee and frappucinos on the go from here!

Sadly not all Starbucks are the same. I frequent this location because it's the closest to my house and 50% of the time I have a miserable experience. They tend to forget to make your order, I hear NO more often at this location then any other location. I don't think Starbucks would go bankrupt of you honoured the free reward coffee the day after it apparently expires. Customer service is their lowest priority here.

Rude baristas gave this place poor review. They messed up on my order and gave me a cold drink when I told them I never said cold. Therefore she gave me an attitude and said, "you told me cold. Can't believe this." She wont admit that its their fault. I asked to speak to the manager and shes also rude and just slid across free coffee pass without saying a word. That's not what I expected. I don't know where she heard that but all of them needs to get trained on customer service. I'm not paying high price coffee for rudeness.

I have one experience with this location- a drive-thru for a green tea latte. But it was all good! They got us through the line fast, and my green tea was hot, yummy, and perfect, and I got it all on a $5 gift card (with about 25 cents to spare!).

The line at this Starbucks is always horrendously long and today, after waiting in line for 15 min, they're out of cold brew and the strawberry refresher that I ordered is basically water. Not to mention the lid had drops of coffee on it. Anyone who has ever ordered the strawberry refresher can look at this and tell it's just watered down. It's disappointing when you wait forever, pay almost $5 for a drink, and this is what it looks like.

the FOURTH time i have tried a hot breakfast sandwich from here and the middle of it was cold and icy. honestly disgusting and i tried to give them a chance but literally going out of my way to post this. nothing irks me more than cold eggs. get it together!!!!!!!! tired of wasting my money.

This is a new location on speedway and pantano.  When I pulled up there were no cars in the parking lot or in the drive thru. Weird right?! I wasn't even sure if they were open. 

They were.

I ordered a dirty chai with two shots of espresso. I'm shaking as I text this review lol. Maybe I'll get one shot next time. 

Anyway, this place is super clean and has the best Starbucks bathroom I've ever been in. There are plenty of places to sit and outlets galore. The outside patio is HUGE and has very nice seating. 

I'll probably make this location my regular spot versus the one on broadway and kolb. 

I love Starbucks!

Customer service was very very good ! Jatoria helped me. What a wonderful person. One that will brighten up a day when a person's day isn't going so well. She is very contagious. Her wonderful spirit is catchy and she made my speciality drink for the first time and it was perfect (venti starbucks double shot on ice w/cold brew whip cream)
 Thank You Jactoria ( I hope I spelled your name correctly

We hadn't been here in over year b/c of terrible service. Went in tonight and it was GREAT, especially Jerre. Thanks for your help buddy, it was appreciated. We were very impressed and will once again return to this location.

Excellent service ! Such nice and friendly staff. This is the actual way my drink is supposed to come . If you take a look at my last Starbucks review my cup was half empty while this being the same order and it is completely full !

I try to avoid this Starbucks if I can, but decided to tempt fate today as the Five Points location parking lot is under major construction. Anyways, I usually avoid La Cumbre Starbucks due to its terribly slow service - 15 mins for an ICED COFFEE - and they didn't even need to make it, it was already brewed! There are constantly new employees - very high turnover - which contributes in my opinion to the lack of effort, continuity, and friendliness of almost every Starbucks I have been to. Plus it is the TINIEST Starbucks I have ever been in.

Definitely one of the better locations in downtown Indy. Great service, excellent baristas, and awesome coffee. Also, there is always parking! 

Sometimes it gets a little crowded (especially during school secessions) - might have to fight for a spot at times.
As far as Starbucks drive thrus go, this has got to be one of the slowest in Boise. Staff is nice... but being 10 minutes late to work because you get trapped in the coffee line is not worth it.

The customer service needs a little work and the place is not very clean, because when I sat on the table it was dirty and o should not have to say something in front of all the customers after having a cashier with little manners.
Friendly, clean, drinks as expected. Love love that they're open late. A bit more room on the inside and outside to sit and chat or to get work done.

If you are looking for a neighborly Starbucks this one is perfect! Employees have relationships with customers, they are quick to right any mistakes and the amount of natural sunlight in this store is amazing!! It's on the end of South Street that isn't too touristy but still has plenty of people watching opportunities. I'm moving and it will be very difficult to replace this Starbucks :(

Please please For the love of God get Faster I was stuck the Day before yesterday in the drive-thru line for 29 Minutes!!!! At 11 am!!! Then last night at 530 another 25 min wait in line again! If it wasn't for my Love of your coffee I would Never Return!!! I'm a regular 6 days a week come on get it Together!!!

Waited for 30 mins for our drinks inside, saw others bypass us when they were behind us in line. Note, if you want a drink in a reasonable amount of time, apparently you shouldn't come on a Saturday or go inside.

We came here to get another mug for my ever growing collection of Starbucks mugs! There weren't any mugs out but thankfully after we asked, the man behind the counter said they found a box in the back. Score!!

No drinks were bought this time around, but it smelled like any other Starbucks. :)

Baristas have major attitudes as are super condescending. Slower than any Starbucks I've been too so far. Least favorite Starbucks, but the paintings outside by the drive through are awesome. 

I've come back to this Starbucks on 3 different occasions since my last review because I'm always in the area and each time my drink order has been wrong. I do not take it back anymore if it's wrong because it seems like I'm an inconvenience. This store's convenient location is entirely what  keeps me coming back.
It's Starbucks, and I'm not a hater.  But this place was understaffed and kind of dirty.
We just stopped for a quick coffee and expected normal Starbucks, but it was great service and a short line. They even helped me pick out the perfect drink. All in all great service.
Pour over was good until I got a mouthful of grounds at the end and was driving, gross and couldn't spit it out

After waiting in the drive thru for a really long time, we finally got our coffees. Mine felt really light so I opened it and it wasn't even 3/4 full (and that's including the whipped cream). I had to park in their not so great lot and go in to get a replacement. The rep remade it and gave me a $4 courtesy card, but that drink never should have gone out the door. Also, the chalkboard sign outside said they would be closing early for Thanksgiving - it is early March.

BY FAR THE WORST STARBUCKS IN TOWN TO STUDY AT! ***

***That is obviously a false statement- I'm hoping people who don't really read these see it and it keeps them from studying here and taking up my tables :) 

This is actually my favorite study spot in all of Philadelphia... and I am NOT a starbucks person.  
Reasons:
1. Free wifi
2. WITH PLENTY OF OUTLETS
3. Nice staff
4. Only tables made for two people- so it prevents annoying crowds that talk a lot (yet somehow they still miss the handicap sign on the front table)
5. I don't get phone service here... which you may think is initially a problem... until you realize how productive you are! 
6. It's steps away from public transit, yet tucked away enough to keep it from being swarmed by the 9-5'ers
7.  I'm not sure if it's because it's located next to Fox and Hound or that it is close to the gay district... but it would be a lie if I said I didn't enjoy the man candy that walks by between 4-6pm every weekday :) 
8.  Also, it seems to be people who actually study... i'm sure the two person seats and unlimited triple white chocolate mocas don't hurt that any tho (not that I order those...)
9.  They don't care if you bring outside food in... as they realize no real person could sit there for 12 hours straight and eat the crap they have
No matter how many times I go here, Emily always has a smile on her face when she serves customers. I know the job is busy and tough at times, but it never seems to phase her.

I am definitely not the type of person that leaves reviews for places, but I wanted to for this Starbucks! I come in here to do homework every now and then and the employees are always super friendly and kind to everyone! They always try to keep the tables clean when they have downtime. They take the time to ask you how you actually spell your name, ask you how you're doing and have a legit conversation with you (which may not be important to some people but it is to others). I just appreciate their kindness!
Awesome location - the service was excellent, super friendly employees, everyone seemed genuinely happy. A ton of space to get work done, very clean. Strongly recommend!
Burnt coffee, only had dark roast.  Threw it away.  Nice staff, though.  Ran out of some pastries.

The only good thing about this particular Starbucks is that it's close to my house and I keep getting gift cards. Otherwise, I'd never bother and would certainly never waste money on their mediocre coffee. The baristas there are just not very good and quality is inconsistent. My recommendation is to save your hard earned dollars and get a real cup of coffee at HubBub or LaColombe, both of which are close by.
I love going to this Starbucks because once I go in Hillary already know what I want and she such a happy person makes me feel so welcome..! She should get a raise
Very Poor experience at this location. No Menu, staff unfamiliar with tea options. All items i requested were unavailable at 11am on Monday such as teas and croissants.

My favorite Starbucks that I've ever been to, mainly because of how awesome, friendly, and generous the baristas and managers are. This is a place for people of all ages, from students to elderly to businessmen to kids and everywhere in between. Drinks are always made with care and they'll always try to get your name right. Favorites are the vanilla sweet cream cold brew and chestnut praline (holiday special). Come here to study, socialize, or just to relax. It can get quite crowded during peak study season (end of spring, December, finals) so keep this in mind. Ive been a regular for 3 years now and still love my mornings or evenings spent here!

This is my favorite Starbucks the staff always puts a smile on face they know exactly what I want when I walk in the door. Keep in mind this is probably the most busy Starbucks in the STL their always hustling in bustling with joy. The entire staff deserves a big pat on the back. And a raise!

This Acme in the Village of Newtown Shopping Center recently underwent a makeover to bring it into the 21 Century.  The two main improvements were the new beer aisle and Starbucks, both very near the right side entrance to the supermarket, just beyond the bakery.  

These in house coffee shops are a version of the outlets found in airports around the world. A decent work area for the crew, with smaller units for pastries and light fare, and very limited displays for their branded coffee and accessories. 

The mermaid has been here about six months and they are efficient in their operation.  One early evening this week it was well staffed with a friendly crew ready to serve.  The barista kept her poise as she mixed my Chai Latte. Never missed a beat in our repartee. The others were cleaning up in anticipation of closing within the hour.  

Perhaps, because they see the same customers routinely, but this shop was far better in its customer service than the equivalent business in an airport.  They show that the opportunity to build relationships enhances the overall experience.  No doubt, for both parties. 

Even this Starbucks-phobe found this captive distribution point enjoyable.  It even made their drinks taste better somehow. 

Good job!

This location is heavily busy-given its location...the best advice I can give someone if you want to be in and out is to use the mobile order feature on the app. Depending on the crowd size, you might have to wait, but its better than waiting in line during a rush-happy hour promos. 

I know that they are supposed to be biased free since the incident that occurred in Philly with the two black men wanting to use the restroom while waiting for a friend, however, given the fact that this location attracts the homeless and the panhandlers, you still need to ask the barista for a code to allow entry to the restroom. There is only one restroom here and honestly my best advice is to not use this restroom-unless if you are in a dire need to go. Some of the baristas still act a certain way when someone wants to use the restroom and they haven't purchased anything. 

My favorite barista here is Zeb. He is very friendly and loves interacting with customers as he prepares their drinks. And don't be afraid to speak up if your drink doesn't taste right. They will be willing to remake that drink for you...although I recommend to take a sip before leaving.

They do have outdoor seating during the warmer months, but be prepared to be asked for money from the panhandlers that sit there or walk by you.

Your not reading this review because you've never been to a Starbucks before so I am not going to begin to tell you about the menu.

This Starbucks is not just a coffee shop-- it is a lifestyle shop. If your single and want to meet a runner-- check out Starbucks between 7 am -10 am on Saturdays.  If you want to meet moms of elementary aged kids--go between 1-3 during the week. A church-goes.... go on Sunday between 9-10:30 or again after 11:15 for the Central Pres crowd.  THIS STARBUCKS IS ALWAYS HOPPING!

Service is good, parking can be a bit of a pain (bring quarters!) and finding a quiet table can be a problem on the weekend mornings.

I have been coming to this Starbucks for years, for no reason than it is located in a shopping area I frequent. I have always enjoyed the free wifi and the atmopshere is generally good, although it can get very busy, even on weekdays.

Please build a bigger Starbucks this one obviously cannot accommodate all the people in the drive-through are in the line in the building it is not adequate place to get your coffee.  Very disappointed at this location, customer service, and accommodation for customer, will never be back
Never a long line, friendly and quick service! Comparing this to the location in Macy's makes it look like a 5 star spot.
Line was extremely long!!! They are consistently out of salt topping for salted caramel mocha lattes! 1st world problem! Polite workers and drinks are tasty!

Probably one of my least favorite Starbucks location mainly because of its constant chaotic state housed in the smallest of buildings. 

The drive thru lines are usually long and ridiculous and if you decide to go inside to save time you might run into yet another line with a not so quick return time for your drink order. 

Not much planning went into the parking lot or size of this Starbucks when it was placed in Edwardsville. They are in need of a new location. 

My suggestion download the app, pay ahead, park (good luck) and go inside and pick up your order. 

As far as parking goes: I would recommend not parking near the entrance, as the drive thru like may prohibit a quick and speedy entrance/exit. If the cars in the drive thru line are not blocking the pass lane, then you can drive around the building and find parking away from the constant flow of coffee lovers.

This is the Starbuck's I come to study at the most. I've been here so many times, this review is long overdue. 

I love his big it is, sometimes it's difficult to find a larger Starbucks. But this one is great! It has large tables and there is always one available. I especially love their couch seating, super comfortable to sit in for a while when I have hours of studying. 

Minor flaw is that the staff here can be hit or miss. I have my favorites, but there are a couple that could be rude. I say this because they are consistently rude. Other than that great location!

I am downgrading this store because for whatever reason the management cannot figure how to keep it clean during busy times. The response "we just got slammed" is no excuse. I like most of the staff, and they work hard and are friendly, but the store HAS TO BE KEPT CLEAN.

This starbucks is always busy with people ordering or enjoying their afternoon.  Recently came in and the cashier seemed overwhelmed by everything going on.  He was courtesous and nice but I felt anxious just placing my order which I normally dont (I always order the same thing no special order drink with substitutes, literally i order a tall iced coffee black). 

Im also a gold card holder and was bummed when I checked out it didnt go through. Instead had to pay cash when I knew I already had money in my card when I checked with my starbucks ap. I didnt want to be the one to hold up a busy line (as simple as my drink order) so moved out of the way. Checked out and didnt get a receipt that I was hoping to redeem at a later time. Bummed out experience. 

I think they need more than 2-3 people here doing everything on a weekend and especially since they're located in busy foot traffic area.
Barista Molly has a lot of attitude  for someone working in the hospitality industry.  While chummy with select customers, she is cold, impersonal and hostile to others.  GET RID OF MOLLY!

The best Starbucks around! They are miraculously quick in the mornings in drive-thru even though the lines can get very long. The staff is so nice, and they seem to really care about the customers. I go here at least two times a week, and I have never been disappointed.

I had a great experience at this location! They were super busy, but they still worked diligently and were friendly. Ashleigh allowed me to make 3 orders since I had a promo to get 100 extra stars ;) She patiently and thoroughly took all my orders. We waited only a few minutes to get all 3 drinks. 

The place is clean and there is plenty of seating and room for people to wait for their orders. I love the convenience of the location and hours!!

Busy location for driving through during weekday mornings. Not sure how it is during the weekends, but assume that it's just as busy if not more so. The interior is very big with lots of seating. They have yet to mess my coffee order up and the people at drive thru are always pleasant, smiling and friendly with me.

Love this new location. Various seating arrangements and the Baristas are always friendly.

My Tevana Chai tea in the bags is wonderful. Thanks Joel!

If you would stop talking over me then you could hear what I'm saying. The fact that I have to repeat the order 5 times (triple non fat caramel machiotto seems pretty simple but ok) and then you get an attitude with me bc I have to tell you not iced EACH TIME then possibly you shouldn't work the drive through bleach blonde with bad skin and a horrible attitude. This Starbucks is always the worst
Why is it that every Starbucks you go to the people that work there are so nice! Lucky for me and anyone else in traffic this one is right off I4.

Nice location with a flurry of activity due to the college, seminary, high school, and local business. The place is busy but I've always found a seat to park my java and laptop and the staff is nice and not boorish.  John, the store manager, is a cool dude and He'll converse with folks. 

This place draws some real characters like a resident "Bob Dylan" and the yoga trainer. There is a park across the way making for awesome people watching. 

This store gets a little cold at times due to the location of the doors but it's acceptable.

What can I say...again it's a pretty typical Starbuck's...great people and good coffee has made them what they are.  This place is on the NW corner and has a drive through...I've found that is faster to just park and go in.  It shares a lot with a Trader Joe's so depending on the time of day and which way you are leaving getting out can take some finesse.  (The Speedway exit to the west is usually hassle free, while East to Wilmot can be diceier).

Great staff, very efficient!!! 
Everyone has a great attitude and welding smile, no matter how early it is. I love this Starbucks. I go to this location and only this one. The manager and assistant managers are very active with there staff and get involved in the customers.
Pssssht STAH-BUCKS kid, don't get betta than this, wicked good coffee, wicked good people, especially on a crappy New England day in Nash.

We stopped by here quickly before a dinner reservation, he needed coffee for the ride home and I wanted to try the new Crystal Ball frappuccino.

It was Easter but the employees were very friendly. I asked for mine with soy milk and I noticed the employee making it with regular, so I asked for soy again and she asked me if I needed it in a new cup or not (ie, was I very lactose-intolerant or not). As for the drink, it was just okay ... the peach whipped cream was very good though.

Very tiny location with only one bathroom, otherwise this would get 5 stars from me because of the customer service.
Worst starbucks I've been to. Lost my drink order, then proceeded to blame me. Waited 25 minutes fir my drink. Never received an apology. And was late to class.

I came in with my friend for a drink and breakfast sandwich after we ordered I got my sandwich but had to wait almost 10 mins for my drink. To add icing on the cake my friend received all his items before me when he ordered after I did. Everyone who works at this location looks like they hate their job and could care less about the customer..
Yay!  Finally! The old Del Taco building put to good use!! Great space. Lots of seating and tables for reading, studying...  And there is a drive thru if you're in a hurry!
I have always enjoyed this spot. The staff are nice and the place is clean. Plenty of places to sit and the music is pleasent. I would recommend this place to anyone.
Very extremely rude staff! The female at the drive through acted like she hated her job and took it out on others! Won't go back to this one!

This location sucks! 
They couldn't break a $100 bill and refused my transaction because I didn't have have a debit card or credit card for my transaction. 
Who wants to charge a $7 transaction on a credit card! 

I've never been to an establishment that refused cash because "I don't have access to 
my twenties, so I can't provide change" 
I will not be revisiting, I'm sure if I offered a large tip  there wouldn't have been an issue with me using a big bill.

Each time I visit this Starbucks, I am disappointed. Most Starbucks locations are SUPER AWESOME, but this location consistently keeps a staff who are snarky, aloof, and disrespectful. Step it up kids!

Love Starbucks but this one would drive me to the local diner. Personnel are not trained properly. I waited for service this morning while 3 "baristas" were searching for something.   I ordered a tall Veranda and he asked what's that even though it was posted as one of the 3 coffees being served. Went to the food court instead. Other Starbucks at the mall is very good
This Starbucks is super cozy. All the employees are very friendly and it is a cute little spot for coffee

No bathroom use allowed! Customer beware.  After buying $25 of items, my 4 yr girl was told to go next door to a competing store by the Starbucks Supervisor.  The Supervisor randomly shutdown the bathroom for no reason other than high traffic.  The place was packed with 30+ patrons, but the staff shutoff a clean bathroom.  Don't have accessibility concerns, medical problems, or a parent of children and expect basic human support.
The service at this place is extremely rude and employees make nasty comments about customers in front of them.

We are regular customers this location. We usually come over twice a week. We came at 16:15, 45 minutes wait for drive through. Service was so bad. It could not accept. The girl who received my orders via her microphone, she was so rude. I was placing my orders but she was suddenly stopped my order while I was speaking to her. Then we received our order, our coffee had not sugar too. All staff are so lovely except that girl. Not recommend this location.
Awesome place. Cool Baristas. Very convenient located in a hospital when you don't want just regular coffee. Wi-Fi reaches in here. Clean and organized. What more can you ask for ?

I agree with the consensus that this Starbucks doesn't live up to the others in the city. The baristas there just seem so overwhelmed and confused, the poor things. I much prefer the one at 12th and Walnut, where you can find the best barista in the city, Denise!

I'm sure this is a decent place however the male that was closing 6-5-19 was extremely rude. I was strolling through the area and didn't know what time the business closed , I approached him to ask and was responded to In a snappy, rude , and unwelcoming way. No one wants to find tight parking just to deal with over priced mediocre coffee and crappy individuals like him.

I've been putting off this review in the hopes that they would get better with some staff turn over but they haven't. I will drive to five points and go to that Starbucks over this one any day. And I do. I only go here when I'm shopping or a friend is driving and I'm always disappointed. My drinks are consistently made wrong. And when I'm getting a coffee it's because I have a crap ton of stuff to do that day and don't have time to wait for 15 min for a drink that easily could have been ordered and made within 5 if made right the first time.

Bitter or overly sweetened coffee? Not here!

The line is always long but it's worth it because they never serve a bad cup of joe here. At $5+ per cup its important to have a good barista. I wouldn't advise studying here, the small over crowded space isn't ideal for those serious students.

I visit this location at least once a week (I work nearby) and have never had a problem with my drinks or food.  The baristas are pleasant and work fast.  As another reviewer mentioned, this place often gets slammed in the afternoons by dozens of students from nearby schools.  However, even at seemingly max capacity, I've never waited for more than 5-10 minutes for a drink.  Definitely wish they had a drive-thru but then I'd probably go even more, which my wallet certainly doesn't need.

This is a very nice and clean Starbucks. The staff is always very friendly and my drink is always made correctly. My favorite thing to get is the sweet cream nitro cold brew. I'm so glad this location offers this. The interior is nice however I wish it was a bit bigger and there were more tables to study at. Whenever I go there is almost never an open table. Overall it is a great Starbucks!

I've given the new (late summer) baristas time to adapt but they are just horrible.  Yes they can make the coffee but they always seemed completely overwhelmed.  They can't be bothered to look up or greet anyone that enters even when there is as little as one customer.  Getting their attention requires a song and dance show.  Mobile orders require shouting just to receive and can often take longer to get then just standing in the line because of this.  Its like they intentionally ignore any sound from the floor.  There are a few really great people still working but these new ones really outnumber them and with Kroger's store now open that may be the better option.

These baristas are always talking and ignoring customers. I can see once in awhile but it never fails to be ignored like we are not here and there isn't 20 people waiting to get to work on time. I really need to find a new coffee spot... Even on a slow Saturday they suck!

I mean, the drinks are fine, but I just got charged $10.95 for a tall latte ("$3.45") and a tall white mocha ("$3.95"). Didn't realize this until after the fact. The waiting area is also a shitshow with all the people waiting for their own drinks to be made, while also having to wait for all the mobile  order drinks to be made.

Guess I'd be cool with going here if someone else paid.

This Starbucks in my opinion is the busiest Starbucks in tampa.  There is always a line out to the street and even though they put a Dunkin doughnut right next door. It hasn't put a dent on the wait times people are willing to do for a Starbucks. The service is always quick when I run inside rather than wait in line. I'm in and out within a few minutes.  So if your in a rush run in rather than wait. There is plenty of side street parking

It's a typical Starbucks. You should know what to expect. I will say that this location is probably the best in downtown Indy, so when looking for your 'bucks fix when here, head to this location. Only downside is lack of seating in the winter. I love sitting outside during the summer though - people watching on the Circle is always interesting.

** Low Ratings?? They Are Reviews 1+ Yr Old. One is 4 Yrs Old. Why Did I Ck?? I'm Not Driving. Behind the Wheel? I would PEEK QUICKLY/SAFE @ THE HINTS. Sorry, Now their hiding behind "The Reviews:("

I have Zero complaints about this StarB location. Convenient next to I-4 W. Exit 19. It's spotless clean. Seems like it's had a nice Reno. Modern, lots of seating w/WiFi charging access. Configured into different sections. Even, for the non-techies. Wanting to relax for a bit. Or, come in w/a colleague or bestie. Seating for business meet/greets. 
Most important. "Bean Talk" from placing an order w/Armando at the Register. Great people skills. 
The Baristas are polite. Fast efficient service. I ordered the A Grande Mocha Soy Frappuccino. Needed a chocolate Jolt. 
I must say. ##WOW!! If Chocolate is an aphrodisiac or wake up your senses. 
I feel like dancing. 
Yes, I do miss the Hints On Yelp. Though :-( "Yelp. Pls, Bring your Hints back.*** NO OTHER W.SITE HAS THE HINTS.*** We're feeling lost out here. 
Lots Road Warriors.

Hit and miss here at times.  At once a knowledgeable server can help you.  At another, they can seem mystified.  Formulaic drinks and syrups are ok.  I do like the twists that can be added to each drink.
I am mystified that I can get a green tea chai latte at all other locations ever visited but here.  What's up with that?
Maybe I'll call ahead next time.  Great job in moving the bulky sales shelf from the middle of the seating area.  Feels more bright and inviting.

This is the Starbucks that turned me into a Starbucks fan many years ago. The staff is remarkably friendly, they always get my order right, and they're quick - inside or drive-thru. To anyone who worked there in its first years - thanks for being cool to my friends and me during the summers we were home from college.

The service here is consistent and friendly. The crew here really hustles, which is important to me. They care about you and they care about your order. The free wifi makes it a good place to get some work done if you need a break from the office.

These ladies and gentlemen drive for absolute customer service. They work hard And pay close attention to special drink orders. If you had trouble here in the past try again now. It will be worth your time.
Great location and always fast! Even if the line is long I'm still through quickly so the staff here is very efficient and friendly.

If you're in Midtown Nashville looking for a Starbucks, this is the place!  

I'm usually very disappointed by Starbucks service level, but I am extremely surprised by this store's management and staff.  Being an early riser, coffee isn't just part of my routine, it's a ritual and addiction.  Like every other SBUX, it's uniform: drip coffee, espresso, and bakery goods.  Where the difference lies is in the ability of the staff to recognize recurring visitors as well as to recognize new patrons and to make them feel at home.  This store has a really great staff!  I would swear that they actually enjoy being there.

The café is always clean, and it's not usually too difficult to find a chair.  There are several outdoor tables as well that overlook Centennial Park.  Parking right in front is usually available.  On-site security is nice to see.  Should you walk in to find a line to the door, don't fret!  They herd us through quickly.

I've visited all of the Starbucks in Nashville since arriving here several weeks ago, and this store is by far the best in this Yelper's opinion.

Today I experienced the worst customer service I've even had at a Starbucks.  It was morning rush hour, the drive thru was backed up so I went inside.   I was the only customer there. 

Three employees were busy working drive thru orders. The employee who appeared to be working the front counter ignored me and continue restock pastries.  A person who I believed to be a manager came out of the back, seemingly checked in supplies and also failed to greet me, ask whether I had been helped or redirect the front-counter employee to prioritize customers over restocking.  

I stood at the counter for a couple minutes and no one helped me.  I left.  Time to find another coffee shop.

This place is ALWAYS dirty! You would think being in the heart of DOWNTOWN Indianapolis it wouldn't be but IT IS!  I only stopped in this location because it was 1000 degrees outside and I love their cold Strawberry Green Tea. Well,  along with the nasty store the employees had NASTY attitudes. A woman asked for a cup of ice  after she finished her drink and you thought she asked for a million dollars!!! The barrister loudly proclaimed that "It's hot outside and we don't have ice to spare!" What,  they don't have a ice MAKER? Is the ice bought in from City Ice?  And as for my STRAWBERRY GREEN TEA, I may as well have paid  $4.00 for WATER!  The flavor and color of my drink neither  tasted or looked anything like green tea, let alone STRAWBERRY GREEN Tea!
Really nice place.  I like this one because you can always find a quiet corner for a meeting.  Everything else is pretty much a starbucks.
I love all of the drinks and usually go everyday! The employees are always very nice and friendly. They are also fast when it comes to completing orders
Nice Starbucks. Service was fast and friendly.nice dining area but small. Service was fast and friendly. Convenient parking in the strip mall.

Let's be honest - Starbucks Coffee, is Starbucks Coffee - that's why we like it. It is standardized; no matter where you go, it's the same brand and pretty much the same product. I am your typical Grande Caramel Macchiato extra hot no-foam latte girl, and this place never fails to give me that inspiring jolt of caffeine infused inspiration. What makes this place stand out to me in comparison to the other Starbucks in the area: The staff. I have spent a considerable amount of time studying here, during which I have witnessed the kindness of the staff on so many occasions. They truly are great, and manage to get their work done without being jerks...even when the place is so busy there is a line out the door... Brava. :) Keep smiling! :)

It was kind of a surprise to eye a Starbucks in a shopping complex just off one of the seedier strips in the city, but a very welcome one, as my need for a warm wake-up drink was high after hours of sifting through dusty thrift-shop merchandise. 
I ordered a cappuccino, which was the usual tasty treat, and a fruit and nut bar, something Starbucks has been carrying recently as a healthier option. They're basically a granola bar, lightly sweet, and what really makes these stand out is the addition of dried apricots and cherries. Yum! 
Maybe it was just the time of day, or the fact that coffee shops in this area are few and far between, but this Starbucks appears to get quite a bit of business.

Every Friday since thats my late day at work  I always stop at Starbucks and they have lots of selection for breakfast and for desserts, Most of the times you can get a breakfast sandwich ( like a bacon egg and chesse muffin) or their glazed doughnuts, or even their Iced Lemon Cake :) or their Marble Cake :) They even have fruit cups and salads as well. Since its winter time i would normally get the Signature Hot Chocolate or their Hot Green or Hot Passion Tea, very very good! The funny part is i never get coffee from Starbucks. I stick to my Tea's or Coco's. Spring and Summer time i would get the Passion Shaken Ice tea ( with 9 pumps of sweetner) or the Blended  Lemonnade. They have some seats to sit and where you can also bring your laptop and sit and enjoy your drink

I'm happily working my way through the gift cards my students' parents gave me at the end of the year. Part of me wants to dislike Starbucks and only frequent local places, but honestly I was excited for the excuse to have a frappaccino (sp?). I don't actually like coffee unless it's in dessert form, but I assume that most real coffee drinkers already have an opinion on Starbucks.   Starbucks all over have gone slightly down hill in the baked goods department, but you can still get something decent.   Although the place is fairly small I had no problem finding one of the comfy chairs for reading.  The staff is friendly and seems to know the regulars.

I never hopped on the Starbucks bus, I've always been a Dunkin Doughnuts or Wawa kind of girl. There are two in the KOP Mall but this review is for the one near Bloomingdale's. 

I received a gift card so I ventured over early in the morning. I know these Starbucks get pretty crowded.  The staff that I encountered were very friendly and adept. No complaints here on service.

My companion ordered a coffee I didn't understand and I guess this is why I've never fit in here. I need coffee every day of my life but I need it in the most simplistic terms possible. I need it to be large, not grande and I need it with cream and sugar not foams or God forbid my portrait drawn in it. I skipped the coffee altogether and decided to get one of their breakfast sandwiches. It was made with a very flaky, grainy kind of biscuit that I personally did not enjoy but the  inside ingredients were tasty in a previously frozen and reheated kind of way.

My girls love Starbucks Every time we pass a Starbucks they want to stop. Yesterday we were celebrating my daughter's birthday weekend, passed Starbucks and had to stop in the drive up to get their favorites. Well, to our surprise and disappointment. The cookie and cake pop was delicious as usual, but the 3 drinks were not good at all. They lacked flavor, half the drink was liquid, and the rest taste like slushy ice, with lumpy deflated whipped cream. There was only 1 car at the window, which left pretty quick. We were next, but waited at the window for a very long time. It appeared the barista was making several orders while we waited. Now there is a line around the building ‍‍So so disappointed. A total waste of my $22, then they kept my bank card and ruined my daughter's birthday shopping spree because we had to leave the mall to go back to get my bank card in order to shop. I don't recommend 2705 Veterans Blvd.

Really terrible. Came in with my mother and friend before the SATs for a little pick-me-up. 3/4 drinks were messed up. Mine in particular was a grande cool lime refresher. It didn't taste anything like the refresher I had been drinking for the past two years, it was extremely bitter. I asked a barista about it, and she responded by pouring 1/2 of the drink out and filling the remainder of the cup with water. Wow. I'm pretty sure Starbucks policy is to just make a new one for you if they mess up. Regardless, it still tasted horribly sour after this. It's a shame that the service is so bad, the interior itself it quite pleasant. Won't be coming back after the Wayne location re-opens. Save your time and go there instead.
