I don't like this location staff. They don't know how to make coffee. I ordered ice coffee more than 3 times. Always, coffee is overflowing. I dropped coffee in my shirts. And then, one of staff who is working drive thur very very UNKIND. Even though this Starbucks is very close to from my place, I'm Not going there. Never Ever !!

Came here with family. No criticism, but this is an ordinary Starbucks. The service is good and the product was of good quality. Nothing spectacular; again, not a criticism. Patrons were moved through the line at a respectable rate. 

I will mention that the clerk was patient with a customer who had trouble selecting tea. 

I would return.

As odd as the configuration of this Starbucks' drive-through is (nestled into a parking lot for a high rise building housing multiple businesses) it seems to always have a good sized line of people waiting. Probably because it's one of the only drivethru Starbucks in the downtown/midtown area currently. But no matter how long the line, the staff always seems to get through it quickly, efficiently, and professionally. They always seem happy to help and greet you with a smile no matter what. I think that's really what sets this Starbucks apart from the handful of others scattered around the Reno area. My order has always been correct too, which definitely makes it stand out to me. I definitely think for the circumstances this location is placed, it does a great job. I just feel bad for anyone trying to park in the surrounding lot during one of their morning rushes!

This is the Starbucks I frequent due to convenience. They have remodeled the inside providing a more modern aesthetic. I enjoy Starbucks because of the store hours which close late I like other local coffee shops. There is seating with outlets, and comfy chairs. The only negative is they don't have decaf coffee ready. You have to Ofer Americana or pour over. Overall great place to work and get a cup of coffee.

So glad to have this Starbucks right here in my neighborhood! Everyone that works here has always been friendly and eager to get your order right. Service is always fast and efficient, but if not completely accurate, they work hard to fix your order ASAP.  The best Starbucks I've ever been to! They're always busy but always friendly.

I can see why this Starbucks has a higher rating than some of the others. It's quieter and therefore you get a lot more customer service from the baristas. how are drinks were made perfectly. That's not always the case.
There's a nice little patio area and the inside is a little more cozy then some of the other locations. Also, it's a lot cleaner since they're not so hectic. If you're a drive-by girl guy, they have that too. It's pretty easy to access it off of Oracle, and be right back on the road. I like to hang out if I'm going to enjoy some coffee. Give it a try, you might just like it!

I wanted to stick with my great review I had given of the 4 points, but when I saw the two dead cockroaches in the bathroom I felt sad. However... The people who work here are so nice and friendly and I actually saw them cleaning! To me that makes this location even better. I just wish they would go in the bathroom to see if it needs cleaning and get rid of the two bugs. Maybe they haven't seen them quite yet LOL. I still like this location because it's quiet and more cozy and some others.

This location is close to my house so I tend to visit a few times a week. Staff is always nice and my drink is always amazing. But...they need a second register!! It seems when I visit that it is always busy and a line forms immediately. They need to keep the place a little cleaner as well. Dusty and sticky on the chairs and tables (I take mine to go but I see things while waiting in line).

I love this Starbucks!  I stop by at least five days a week on my way into work.  Yes the drive thru does get a little backed up from time to time, but the customer service is worth the wait!  This location has some of the best baristas in town!

I cannot function properly without my daily dose of coffee. This is my go-to spot every morning as the location is very convenient, immaculately clean, & qualitatively quick. The workers here are incredibly friendly and the baristas I've interacted with have all been just as courteous. They've even memorized my usual order, that's going above and beyond customer service. Great place with a nice working atmosphere.

This is my favourite Starbucks in the entire city. Clara is the most wonderful barista I've ever encountered. She always suggests things that might make my drink better. All the other girls have a big smile on their face even when it's 7 am. Even when I order with my phone while I'm basically pulling up to the door, my drink is ready by the time I walk in. It's always clean and they always have the feature reusable cup in stock.

I come here often to get work done and occasionally a strawberry frappuccino. It's always clean and inviting. I give this location 4 stars because of an employee who made my experience more frustrating than necessary. Starbucks recently changed the strawberry frappuccino recipe and name to "serious strawberry frappuccino" but I had been used to ordering it as a "strawberry frappuccino" for years. When I ordered it, the barista said "We don't have that anymore." and left it at that. I was very confused as I had just ordered it a week prior which I mentioned. She then replied, "we have the serious strawberry frappuccino..." How annoying is that...  I'm quite sure she knew what I meant.
Please rope off the back of your parking lot so that your patrons don't get their cars towed by Grand View Apartments.
Welcome to Starbucks.  Come for the coffee stay for the TB.  I get the third space concept...but, homeless dude sleeping in your business... No thanks

This is by far the best Starbucks in the Nashville area - Cordell is always upbeat, the staff really go out of their way to make you happy. Drinks are hot, and the only annoying thing is that someone needs to put cones up between the two handicapped spots in front so idiots stop parking there!!! 
Nice seating in the back, comfortable for laptops or reading. No pressure to move on. And yes, a really great mix of types.
Been waiting 20 minutes just to order in drive thru and I'm stuck between a million cars so I can't get out. Staff your drive thru more!!

The staff is usually quite friendly and they make their drinks well. However, it is always - without fail - super dirty. Every time I come in here, the tables have trash and crumbs or spilled drinks on them leaving them sticky. 

Today, two baristas let drink orders pile up while they were chatting with a friend about his boy troubles. Pretty unprofessional. :/

There are no plugs at this Starbucks. I came here while visiting Reno with the intent of spending 2 hours working before hopping in the car to work some more on the drive home (while my husband drove of course). 

While looking for somewhere to plug my laptop in so I'd have a full charge for the drive (and because my laptop doesn't hold a charge very long), one of the employees let me know they don't have plugs anymore because people would post up too long. There truly must be a better solution to this, like, a time limit on the plugs or something along those lines.

I work remotely so I spend a LOT of time and money (much more than I probably should) in their stores, and I really feel it should be safe to assume reliable WiFi and plugs will be present. 

Booooo!

I visit this store whenever I have an need to be in the area of Fairview and Cole.  While the intersection itself is (and always has been) a nightmare, Starbucks is always there to meet the needs of those seeking a java jolt, a tasty snack or some tea. I never feel rushed ordering and the baristas are always fun to talk to.  Now if only Starbucks would open more drive thru locations in Boise!

Still need much faster drive-thru service but they always make my Ice coffee taste Amazing.. I stop in 1 time a day and it's Always Delicious!!! They have 2 gentlemen that are always at the drive-thru both are Delightful and always Smiling

Now this is a fantastic Starbucks.  Fast, friendly service with employees who remember your name when you walk in!  Pretty impressive.  They are super fast with the line, which can get long in the morning.  

Lots of outdoor tables to talk about the local news of the day with the downtown loiter squad.  They also have the "Clover" system if you want a uniquely brewed coffee.  Try it out if you are curious - you can ask for any coffee to be made in the Clover.  These are common in big cities but DTSP has one!  

Even though it's "just Starbucks," the staff here goes above and beyond the call of duty to get you your much needed caffeine fix.  Also, they shut people down from using the bathroom if you don't buy something.  I personally like this philosophy because the general Starbucks public bathroom policy makes most of their bathrooms end up being where bums shave and do other various activities, some more hygienic than others.

I don't understand why they use online ordering for!!! I ordered 15 min before I arrived, 2-workers, no line! They haven't even started my one drink! 
I guess this what happens when u have poor management!
Grabbed a salted caramel frap. It tastes great and they actually still had the salt to make it. Fast and Great service.

clean but MOBILE APP ORDERED, ALTHOUGH CONFIRMED DID NOT GO THROUGH. At least on their end. So caution when using mobile order. They were good about it and it was nice there

Otherwise your typical Starbucks!!  !

Just a quick stop through the drive thru for a passion fruit ice tea before heading out. The drive-thru line is usually manageable and they are always quick and friendly with service. Great location right off 60 and across from the mall.

I have driven past the location numerous times and didn't even realize it was there.  I went in because I just didn't know what I wanted. I had a great experience staff rocked and the location was clean, lots of people inside working away on their computers :) It was great. Coffee delicious and a yummy breakfast bacon and egg sandwich .. happy tummy!
Long wait usually but the staff is super friendly and helpful everytime.  Worth the wait!

They charged me and then skipped my order and eventually somebody asked me why I was standing there and somebody else said oh sorry. And then it was too late and I gave up.

But it all worked out because I went to Denny's and I had my food in front of me in less time then I waited at the Starbucks for my espresso.

Agh. Meh. Mmmph. And other shoulder shrugging sounds. 

A.) it's your standard Starbucks as far as menu, decor, etc. go
B.) The free wifi is less than weak. Double "meh"
C.) I get that the suburbanites have few other coffee shop options, but holy shiza this place is jiggity jammed. 
D.) friendly service
E.) It gets "the job" done
Little congested but fantastic service!!!!  Sam and Erik were so awesome!!!!  Very friendly service.

Staff is erroneous. I have never waited so long for a drink at Starbucks, even when it has been packed. To top it off, I recieved my drink nearly 5 minutes before my friend, and he ordered before I did. Drink was shamefull and goes hand in hand with the ill-founded workforce. Everyone who works there looks like they want to be anywhere else, but starbucks.

Nice place to study. It gets noisy later on in the day and especially when kids get out of school so bring your headphones! 
The staff is very friendly and fast. They also have a water refill station near the bathrooms. 
Only downside is nearby parking is metered so definitely bring those quarters!

Pros:  barista was friendly and the place was very clean. Internet worked well and was fast.  My drink I ordered (I always get the chai tea latte) was delicious as always.

Cons: someone else accidentally took my drinks so I ended up having to wait extra while they made me a new one. Not necessarily Starbucks fault but still a little frustrating.  Also they did have a small wait in line to order (about 5 minutes) which wasn't horrible.

Excellent location for a relaxing Saturday morning trip to the coffee house. The ambiance is enjoyable, the barristas are knowledgable, and the location is just right for walking around Downtown St. Pete.

The absolute worst experience I have ever had at a Starbucks!!! I've never experienced such rude workers in my life. I'm still in disbelief at what was said to me at the drive-up window. Will never go back.

These people messed the up easiest drink and were rude about it. I ordered a tall iced green tea with no sweetener. I received a cup filled above the brim with ice and then filled in with tea. I pointed out that there was practically no tea in the cup, they said it's fine and moved on. I guess I just paid $3 for a cup of ice with a splash of green tea. I'f I lived in Tucson, I wouldn't come here again

Lovely drive-thru location with friendly service. Situated in the same plaza as Club Fitness which makes it super convenient for grabbing my PreWorkout morning Joe. 
There's plenty of seating both indoor & outside patio. Merchandise for purchase includes the typical overpriced Starbucks mugs, tumblers, coffee beans, brew systems and more. Cold case packed with grab & go lunch-a-bles, pastries, yogurt, fruit & so on. 

~Christy

Went there with my friend yesterday when they weren't really busy and got 2 drinks. I got a refresher and she got an Iced americano. After they took our order it started to get busy. I received my drink but she didn't. Then people who ordered after is for their drinks and we were still waiting for hers. When we finally got her drink the girl yelled out her order then risky put the drink down and just tossed a straw at it. She never smiled and never said anything to us. I'm just saying that Service comes with a Smile..... not a poor attitude.
Best ever Starbucks! The drive they is fast and easy!!! Great location and on my way to work...

It's my 2nd time visiting this location, not crowded like the many other locations I've visited. Nice and pretty spacious. Compared to the other locations, this place is bigger. The staff is very nice and welcoming. I was even allowed to come back later to pay for my drink because all I had with me was a hundo, very considerate. The this I don't really like its that its located at the corner and not
Much parking space, but it's ok, the more u walk the healthier u are ^_^. I ordered a venti green tea frappe and it was great! I even asked the manager, whom took my order, if she could make sure that the green tea powder was throughly blended. Two other locations I went to, I requested that, but it was not throughly blended. I can see there were still green tea powder at the bottom of my drink. But this place, the manger was very nice. She even offered to blend my drink twice to make sure there there were no green powder left. Thanks a lot for he bit of extra effort. My drink tastes great!!

This is the Starbucks right by IUPUI, IU Hospital, and Eskenazi - it is BUSY. 

And yet, the staff always are in top of it. It probably helps that this location doesn't have a drive-thru. 

Plenty of parking but you must share it with multiple businesses, so it can get scarce depending on the time/day. 

Lots of people study/work here, but it's still rather small and mostly has tiny two-person tables and two long high-top tables. This is not a space I'd want to read or write in, personally. But many folks like it.

Clean store, well-organized items, and friendly employees!  Just because I go to a chain coffeeshop, doesn't mean I tolerate mediocrity and this location does away with that.  

The parking is slightly easier and less crowded than Brentwood, however, the drive-thru line can be a lot more busy at times. This could be due to the fact that they can usually fit more cars in their line. That's also the bad thing about the parking situation. You could possibly get stuck waiting for the drive-thru cars to move. Fortunately for me, I have never been in that situation. If I find the drive-thru looking busy enough, I generally don't mind walking farther away from the store to park and leave when I please.

As far as the product quality goes, they are fairly consistent just like any other Starbucks I've gone into. There are several outdoor seating for you to use on a nice day and it's slightly more roomy inside compared to the Brentwood location. They are also fairly quick with the orders and are usually very polite. I have never had a bad experience here, service or otherwise. This will always be one of my go-to location and will continue to be as long as I live within 5-minutes of this place.

Quickest drive-thru ever! This Drive thru is always super speedy and they provide excellent service. Even if the lone is back to the gym, which shares a parking lot, you will be through the drive-thru in a jiffy!

Today, I went inside and met a business colleague. We had a table, and could hear ourselves wonderfully. I had a grande, pike place which was delicious and provided immediately upon order.

If you are planning meeting of the professional variety, arrive early. While today I did not have to wait for a table, I often have before because of the location in a professional area.

So...This review has nothing to do with my order, because that was correct, despite the lack of Ice in my Iced Americano.  This is to draw attention to the fact that your Sunday staff DOES NOT keep up with your weekly staff.  I have been to this location many times, and generally everything is good, fine, acceptable...once in a while even great...And don't get me wrong, I realize it is Sunday at 8:00 in the morning, but I too am going into work on what should be a day of rest.  

Pulled into Starbucks drive thru and there were a few cars, this process went quickly...I get to my turn, order my simple order, repeated back, tells me I can have my total at the window.  No problem, I have cash so I have it out and ready to go.  I get to the window and the girl at the window is either new or drunk...these are the only things I can think of to excuse the weirdness...She looks at my with my little bagged breakfast sandwich and repeats my order (perfectly) and I smile and say yes, and she just stares at me...slowly handing me my order.  I take my sandwich and wait for a total, because I like to pay for my stuff (and i need my coffee still) and she says, "Have I taken your cash, yet?"

What?  No, I just got here, you immediately hand me food and you have not told me any price, so...No.  I respond "No, I am waiting for you to tell me a total?"  After about 15 seconds, she tells me a total..."$7.60"  I give her $9 and tell her to put the change in the tip jar for them (because even for awkward moments, I like to tip people in the service industry.  She tries to hand me back $.40 and I tell her, No, that is for you and I gave you $9 and told you to put the change in your tips.  She looks at me confused, and says "oh, this change is for me?"  Uh?  Yes, it's for you.  Then she puts the change into the tip jar and takes out a dollar and tries to hand it back to me...Again, What??  I said to her again, "No, That is for you guys....ALL OF THE CHANGE is a tip..." I didn't yell, I am just emphasizing what my eyes were probably doing...She hands me my coffee and I leave, shaking my head and seriously confused as to how that became so difficult.

I just don't really understand the complexity of repeating an order, saying the amount, taking the money, accepting possible tip, giving the order to customer, saying goodbye...

I am sure that this was a pointless waste of time, but I never do this and I felt the need to bring to someone's attention the level of attention your cashiers have to money.  Not a great sign.  I get how hard it can be to staff on a Sunday...I really do, I deal with the same thing every week when I make my schedules, but the next time someone asks me if they took my money already, I should just say yes.  Why is it my job to ensure my items are paid for?  I'll take your hourly rate for my honesty...Thanks.

I was in the store earlier today & things were busier than usual. A couple customers were being extremely rude to the employees, but they still kept smiles on their faces. Ashley & Andy were especially helpful, despite the stressful situation. My coffee was good, as usual.

Went here this morning and i'm 99% sure the main girl was drunk. Also my salted Caramel mocha was not sweet at all. Will not be revisiting this Starbucks! Stickin to my main Albertsons starbucks, for the win!
Very straightforward and fine service, traditional mediocre Starbucks food. Kind of observationally dirty and unkempt.

1:00 pm Monday, January 21,2019

The manager here today is AWESOME! She went out of her way to correct a problem with a defective lid on a January cup. I cant express how much we appreciate her. This was a gift and the lid flap had been loose/leaky since purchase but finally came apart. The plan was to continue to use it after January (since it insulates well) so it was a sad thing that it was broken. She really made the day (and week, month, and even year). Thank you 

Excellent customer service!

Love this starbucks!!! Baristas are always friendly and always on top of getting my drinks just the way I like it! Using mobile order is super easy and I never have to wait in line! Always pack here with college kids studying. I love this starbucks because its convenient to home and work. 

I would like to however review the unicorn frap and how awful it was! It's not at all baristas fault that the company is offering such a horrible drink, so I cant ding the baristas for making it.  It was definitely unicorn poop and I cant believe I paid $6 bucks for a venti. Well note to future me to not fall for any of starbucks crazy stunts with crazy drinks call unicorn frap! There's still a few days left to get it but WARNING! Do not get it! Its sour and weird, and the more you drink the more it becomes tasteless. It tastes like water down vanilla bean!

This place is BUSY! Every time I drive by, no matter the time of day, it's busy. But, the staff is friendly and quick. The peach green tea lemonade is the perfect treat on a warm summer day. And you can never go wrong with any of their bakery items. I am quite partial to their scones! Yum!

There was no one in there when I came in, just walked in an ordered a simple grande iced black coffee. I waited 15 minutes. They were only filling mobile orders. I get that they may have precedence because they want you to use the app, but I was the only customer in the store. Why put me behind 6 mobile orders? This was the longest time I have ever waited at a Starbucks ever. Usually they all have great customer service, this was a surprise. Disappointed.

This is the best Starbucks in the area! They are so friendly and take effort to learn the names of regular customers.  They are also SO fast with mobile orders compared to other SB. The other day I went to pick up a coffee and saw a water on the mobile order cart. I asked about it because I've never seen water on the mobile order app, and the barista said you can't but she knows this customer always wants a water with her coffee so she puts one out with her mobile order coffee now. That's the kind of impressive customer service the employees have here! :) I've been going here for years and even though it's different employees over the years, the friendly customer service stays the same.

I love the baristas at this Starbucks - who will often remember you or offer their help to customize drinks - but be aware that parking is a nightmare. The traffic on Delmar and North & South makes it incredibly difficult to get out of the lot, and don't even try to park in the Starbucks lot if you see people in the drive-thru. As a result, this is a Starbucks that I prefer to walk to on a warm summer day.

This is my go to Starbucks and it's open at 5 AM.Great customer service, fast and accurate.Also they listen to your special request and actually get them right. Shelby is one of my favorite baristas, I'm always so happy to see her because she's excellent at her job and has such a contagious positive personality (awesome customer service)and that's exactly how you should be if you work in any business otherwise work in a funeral home where you don't have to be so upbeat.

I consider this my Starbucks, simply because it's so close to my apartment and I go there frequently. Located just off of 75th and shadeland in the strip mall with caplingars. 
Everyone is very friendly! You always feel welcome when you walk in. Even if it's crazy busy and coffee is being churned out at a high speed.
Drinks are always great! Never have an issue with those, and they will even make things that aren't on the menu, I love London fog tea lattes and the fact that I can still have them makes me very happy.
The selection of food products always impresses, they have all the snacks, and baked goods.
Plus if you want to get coffee swag on top of your coffee, this store is for you! The selection of cups is always abundant I think I have purchased 5 separate mugs as well as ground coffee to make at home! This is my forever Starbucks!

the guy working (trevor) was so incredibly nice and friendly. It's so refreshing to have great service beyond just a transaction. we joked around a bit how the computers were down because I know that can be a very stressful situation, especially for a crazy business like Starbucks. I just wanted to give Trevor a little spotlight for being a great employee (and an overall nice guy)

They will no longer offer the hidden menu. To the end they won't blend my biscotti into my drink.... Allergens are an issue I suppose but I feel that if you have mixers for nuts and one without you can avoid this issue. Just seems like the staff is trying to not work hard. Rare poor customer service for Starbucks.
The staff are very friendly here and they move people through the line quickly. Unfortunately the parking is awful in the evenings, but before 8am there's plenty of parking right outside the store.

Ms. Sarah was great at front taking my orders.
The guy that made the 3 coffee for me was horrible. He didn't borther about letting me know the coffee was ready.. He let ppl come ahead reaching over my coffee.. I thought that was very rude an unprofessional..

I know.  It's a Starbucks.  What is there to say?

There's little you can do to mess up an Americano, but these guys manage to do it.  Half the time when I ask for room?  There is no room.  The other half of the time? The room is created by only putting half the amount of ice, instead of a little less water.  So then I have a room-temperature, super watered down Americano.  Sad.

Sometimes they forget my order completely.  A couple of times I've been overcharged.

Please pull it together, South Street Starbucks.

I'm a regular at this location because of the Ina construction but now that you can cross the freeway I suggest going to the location in front of Target. By far the SLOWEST service ever. Every time I go it's 20-30 minute wait no matter if they're busy or not. The drive thru is the absolute worst.
Went inside to see if the wait was better and ended up standing there for 25 minutes. What a joke it is to have 5 people working the line but having 1-2 drinks leaving the counter every 7-10 minutes because employees are too busy talking amongst each other.

Seriously, drive to a different location. It's worth the extra drive.

We came here tonight for 1/2 price Frapps. The guy who took our order seemed nice & knowledgeable. However, the poor guy with Red hair looked like a deer caught in the head lights. Don't know if he was new, but nobody was helping him at all & it took him about 10 mins to make one frapp. 
If I were in a hurry & needed to get to work I would've been livid! But that was very unprofessional of his co-workers to leave him hangin!

its my local Starbucks :) Love it because its pretty close to the house. I go in for my passion iced tea, unsweetened :) 
Friendly staff, its clean :) Its a small one, but I think most of them are. Nice place. I like it. Its a typical Starbucks, but this staff is friendlier than most :)

This is the Starbucks that took over the well-known Flying Saucer building on Grand, near the SLU campus. It used to be a gas station, then a Del Taco. They were going to demolish it and then Starbucks came in. 

You'd think the Starbucks would be huge but it's only half of the building. There are 2 community tables, some counter space, some random chairs around the sides, and only 2 small private tables. 

Lots of light from the huge windows all around the building. Full of students.

I love this Starbucks!! The 24hrs is enough to make them better than all other bucks. I come here almost ever day. The drive through is always on bang though. They lose a star for the slow part but it's fine with me because I never just walk in. I have never had a problem. One employee even gave me her markout Try 3 pumps of pumpkin spice in a hit chocolate!!

Iwas In the restaurant business for many years, I love this location Britney and her amazing staff does such a great job I always feel like I'm at home when I go to this store I have to name a special thanks to Eli Brittany, Angelica, Gabi, Shana, Shannon ,Mitch and Shelby just to name a few of the awesome staff there...

Since this Starbucks is walking distance from my house,  I come here over 3 times a week.
It is super crowded in the morning, but I genuinely like the baristas.

Unfortunately, I've had my moments here. More than once they gave me real milk instead of soy. I was sick because I can't drink cow milk. Once I asked a young lady about my the type of milk used, she said rude. I asked because it tastes like real milk, and I get sick. Sure enough I was sick. The manager, Lee, was able to give me a comped latte the next day. 

So why them a four star instead of 2 or 3? I've been here over 20 times, and I've had less than 5 bad experiences. Plus, the baristas are SUPER sweet.

I can forgive bad svc once but same person with repeated bad attitude at GH Mall Starbucks. Does not want to work and not friendly. Walk up  w my two girls, say one drink. Her immediate  response "Is that all?" We say one more thing. "Is that all?" We do this four times. If you hate providing good customer service, then get another job. Management? You know who this is.

Very busy today! We had cold brew with salted Carmel cold foam and cold brew with sugar. Loved the salted Carmel foam drink! Cold brew with regular sugar is grainy, ask for syrup. The accidentally made ours twice so we ended up with two for ones. Good day.

Pretty much your typical Starbucks. Nice outdoor seating area. They get my order right and are quick.

It can get quite busy when the school kids all storm in the store at once.

If the weather is good, venture down to Wydown Park just a block east on Wydown. Its usually very quiet and has a lot of nice benches.
Amazing I love it.It is pretty pricey but it's worth it.early mornin cofee ohhhh yeaaaahhhhh

Don't know why the line is always SO long. Came in here yesterday and we got two teas. Very clearly ordered. BOTH came out wrong and when told about the orders being wrong, we were stared at. The tea was taken and placed in a "wrong" pile amongst a few others. One barista said to another "what's wrong with THESE ones?" This was at a slow time surprisingly, so I can't imagine what getting your order is like during peak hours, yet alone holiday shopping. Go to the Nordstrom cafe or coffee bar, you'll get much better service.

Occasionally you can get decent service here but not as a rule.

As a rule you can expect uppity staff who seem bothered your there and could careless about your business. I guess they figure they have the market cornered but I would rather go across the street to the Starbucks in the Target. 

They really need to take some customer service classes otherwise they need to take sometime off without pay!

The one other thing you can count on is 2 out of three visits to screw up your order. It is mind boggling how some of the servers keep their jobs, I guess it must be really hard to find people to work these days.

I've never had one Starbucks screw up so many drink orders multiple times! In the drive thru no less. People choose the drive thru in order to save time. Having to turn around and go back inside completely takes away from the experience. You've been warned.
I love it here. They have made a few mistakes on my drink but they do anything with in their means to make it up. The staffs awesome.
Amazing service!!!! Had exactly one dollar to buy a reusable cup and they used tip money to pay tax for me!! Very quick and very friendly!!

I'm usually not one to review Starbucks since they're all so similar, but this one stood out to me. The cashier taking my order was really knowledgeable and helpful with my questions. I ended up ordering the iced guava white tea lemonade, unsweet. The barista who made my drink, Parker, was super nice and personable. She struck up a conversation about the drink and enthusiastically gave me recommendations for other drinks I might like. The drink itself was really good- I'd definitely recommend getting it unsweet. I'd definitely come to this location again, for the staff alone!

The service was awesome and fast! Everyone was nice and greeted us.  My card wasn't working and they made sure I was still taken care. When you need coffee the last thing you need is delay. And they were awesome!!

This was the only time I have ever felt like walking out of a Starbucks in my life. The employee was a shorter woman of asian descent around 30 years old and had a horrible attitude. Nasty, no smile, and slamming things down as she put together orders. My advice to the manager is to assess your staff and get some pleasant baristas. To top it off while I was trying to get work done, she was walking around slamming things down as she cleaned as well. Horrible attitude. I will be sure never to return to this location.

I've been a hardcore Starbucks coffee drinker for years now. Wanted to take the time to acknowledge and thank the staff of this particular location because they are all super friendly and work as a team so great. I've been to many Starbucks where you may have a select few top employees but whoever the manager is of this location deserves a raise. He picks a diverse staff that all work great with each other and create a very enjoyable atmosphere for their guests. Thank you - keep it up :)

As far as corporate coffee houses go, this my be my favorite in the city. Its a great location to meet my clientele and it just has a nice vibe to it that doesn't exist at other city or county locations. You know you are getting a good coffee and this location is spread out enough....more than most places.

Not a bad Starbucks location. The inside is nice and clean, but the outside (mostly the drive thru area) aren't too great. There isn't enough room in the parking lot for the often long drive thru line. Overall though I must admit...I'm getting really sick of Starbucks over priced drinks....when most of them are sugar/milk/ice rather than actual coffee.

Was excited to get a coffee this morning after dropping off my kid at daycare. Wanted a cascara latte but no luck. They were out of cascara syrup. Then I decided on the blossoming tea latte but no black tea base. They only had green. C'mon now Starbucks I am not impressed

I also think this is one of the better Starbucks in the area. Agreed there is a good amount of space for those chilling or studying. I have waited longer than usual for a beverage, but I think that can be expected given that the place is pretty sparse and the traffic is not too extreme as to require additional staff. I also think the WIFI is better than most chill spots in the area.
Great service. Friendly service. Clean operation. Yes, you can feel the midwest oozing from this place and it is all good.

Based solely on mobile orders:
I used to frequent the 5th street location for my mobile orders but I started to get a super short pour on my drinks so I abandoned them and headed to Liberty.  So far so good! My order is usually waiting for me when I walk in and if it's not it's always just a moment before it's ready.
Drinks and food are up to the Starbucks standard I expect and the staff is friendly too.
Words of advice - if you park in the spots parallel to the drive-thru and it's rainy you will step down into a good couple inches of water! Good thing I was wearing my rain boots that day.  Generally, I avoid the lot and park in the spots on the street anyway, much less headache.

Alright, where to start....

I love Starbucks. I usually visit them in a daily basis to procure my morning coffee and on rare occasions food. However, their corporate model to prioritize mobile orders over in-store orders is atrocious. Why? Because putting mobile orders first, for individuals not physically in store create a bad customer perception. There is nothing worse than sitting around watching mobile orders stack for people who have not made it to the store yet, while people like me who are currently in the store are forced to wait. I hope that this model eventually changes.

After visiting the Starbucks at Ina near Oracle, I'm happy to say this is definitely our favorite. 

It's clean, my arms don't stick to the tables, I don't have to lay down a placemat of napkins and the garbage is never overflowing. Most of the staff are great!  Some of the newer baristas need to get a rhythm going when taking care of customers.
Our fav. weekly "hang out" place to wait for an hour when my daughters have piano lesson! Nice store, well kept & nice staff! We'll be back next week!:))
This new Starbucks location is very spacious and welcoming with plenty of indoor seating as well as a small outdoor seating area. The staff is friendly, as usual.

Gotta tell you I hated starbucks before coming to the US.. I loveeeeeee this coffee and their breakfast sandwiches I'm telling you their chef is brilliant.

Now go in here in the morning my hubby is here every day  - Jeff has learned so many customers names - the man is just a cutie - All the employees here seem to love to be here and I actually get in a good mood knowing I am grabbing a coffee here... 

The staff makes it!!!! Thank you for caring

Typical Starbucks except the need for a code to use the restrooms. Had a cafe americano with cream. Barista put in significantly insufficient cream. Think they put in a literal drop!. Cake poo was fresh and delicious. Busy place.

Great service and location easy to get to and get all oil changed at the Goodyear and come here and hang out and get a coffee get free Wi-Fi relax service is very good and I would go out of my way to come here.
I wish starbucks was a smoke free establishment! I love sitting outside on the patio in the evening to study but it gets ruined with cigarette smoke and i usually end up leaving at this point. :(

This Starbucks is on my way to work, and I frequent it a few times a month.  I just get coffee, "Venti Bold", and don't do the fancy drinks.

Unlike most locations, this one is an odd nexus of incompetence:
1. About half of the time I visit they are out of bold coffee.  You would think they would learn to always have enough on hand, but the incompetence prevents it.  They prefer to take my money, then tell me I'll have to wait for them to make some more. Lesson: when patronizing this store don't pay until your coffee is in-hand.  Wawa is three blocks away, and keeps their urns full.
2. Front counter service is the least of their worries. You know how most Starbucks locations are energetic and the counter person is eager to trade caffeine for money?  Not this one  They actually move slowly, respond slowly, and speak slowly.  It can take a while before someone notices a person waiting at the counter.
3. I've never seen the General Manager on-site.  I think that explains a lot about this location.

Standard Starbucks, but I like frequenting this one because there seems to be outside seating when I need it.

Drinks are good and I have no problems here.  
Drive thru can get out of control at times and make the parking lot more difficult to navigate.

This Starbucks is my absolute favorite in town. I love the layout and large windows, making this coffee shop always bright and open. They sport a drive-thru and were crazy quick with my online order (even though I live 5 minutes away), so really great if social interaction makes you cringe like me. The only thing for me is that one of their male employees is always a little TOO cranky for me; I'm sure he's already had his morning coffee unlike me. Oh! And they have doggie treats!

It's Starbucks ok? I frequent this one since it's close to where I'm staying until my apartment is open so I get my Cafe Americano here! Grande, to be clear. No frills and no extra anything any it! (I believe the fact that I don't order 95 things to go in it freaks out the blue dyed chick in the window every time) Makes me smile though! 

Restrooms are typically clean! I subtract one star here because with gender neutral you get the worst of both worlds, men smell worse and contrary to popular opinion, women trash the bathroom worse! So if they checked it once an hour instead of once a shift this would probably be one of the better Starbucks in Boise!

Lastly, service is pretty fast! I know, I know, my drink is plain of course it's fast! But no the people in front of me are getting theirs quickly and accurately so no complaints! Go get your java on folks!

Hey do you want the worst Starbucks experience ever?! Then definitely go into the Starbucks at the Doubletree hotel in downtown Nashville. There were 4 employees and about 6 people in line. Not only was it the slowest Starbucks but it was also the least friendly. Hey gals, you're in a customer service role, guess what that means you're basically an actor. So when I asked "Hey how are you this morning?", before ordering my drink...it's you're job to pretend like your day is going well-not roll your eyes and ask what I want. 

Also how many baristas does it take to make a grande toffee nut latte? It takes 3. One to make the drink, one to play therapist as she slowly makes the drink, and one to quietly say the order when it's done....so quietly the other customer and I had to make sure we were getting the correct drink. I completely understand talking to your co-workers but when there's a line of drinks waiting to be made and food being ordered, leave the personal woes on the back burning and do your j
Super friendly service with a smile. I cannot remember the gentlemen's name who took my order, but he was super nice and made my day.

Not the cleanest Starbucks by far! This is my second time here. First time it was very dirty and unattractive, this time wasn't much different! As for the coffee itself, that's what got these guys up to a three stars!

Please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please please clean your dirty bathrooms!!!!

I come to the Starbucks at least five times a week, I sit inside for about an hour and a half and get probably 2 to 3 refills on my iced tea. I have never had a problem with attitudes or my drink wrong at all, this is my go to Starbucks in Tucson.
I do have to say that lately the homeless situation at the Starbucks is not good but it's never really affected me. Also, you cannot hold it against them, it's not like they like to give out water or let them use their bathroom either. Maybe they could get locks on their bathrooms like some other locations in Tucson have??
Sarah Is one of the best employees and shift leads that they have. Always professional quick and extremely hard-working, I have seen her have to deal with countless problems and am always impressed. 
Thanks for always giving me the caffeine fix i need!

SUPER SLOW SERVICE regardless whether it's 6:15 am on a Tuesday morning or 10 am on a Saturday morning. 15 minutes in the drive thru is completely unacceptable! I come here because it's right by my house but it's SO inconvenient because they're always SO slow!

How much do I love coffee & tea? Let me counts the ways! I absolutely love this Starbucks location. The baristas are very personal and make sure to get your order correct the first time. This location is a great place to meet up for informal gatherings. However, if you're trying to study it might be best to go to another location. Due to its close proximity to the IUPUI campus, several housing residences, and a reduced amount of seating, this Starbucks location can get very crowded. Nonetheless, I enjoy getting a hot (or cold) beverage from here! It's definitely worth a visit!

I go here a lot because it is so close to my house and right next to Trader Joe's which I frequent but every time it is so crowded - with a line around the building for the drive thru and a line inside as well. The parking situation is terrible. You basically can't get to their parking because of the long drive thru lines so I park in the main parking lot but you have to walk across the drive thru line to get into the store (they've now put fencing up so you have to walk around). At least half the time I am in there they either completely forget to make my drink or make me a frappuchino instead of a latte (seriously why has this happened on more than one occasion?? Latte sounds nothing like frappuchino). *Sigh* but i'll still keep coming here because #imlazy and a #coffeeaddict. Positive notes? The coffee is good when I get it, sometimes I get a free drink out of them messing up my order because otherwise they just throw it away and they offer my pup a free puppuccino usually!
Great customer service on every visit.  The employees ate always so chipper.  They make my visit thru the drive-thru great.

The traffic at this location is very dangerous!!  customers are forcing their way in & out of traffic on North and South street almost causing accidents.  The parking lot is too small and confusing, this location should request that the County put a stop sign there or have an employee stand there with a hand sign !!!!

I came in to this Starbucks and their mobile ordering had gone down, so there were a handful of angry patrons. The staff here handled the rude crew with grace and patience, and kicked into high gear to get everyone taken care of. Not every patron was grateful for their hard work, but I hope the staff knows that it didn't go unnoticed. It's almost like people get crabby without their coffee! :)

I visited this shop a number of times during my hotel stay for a conference. I was very pleases with the fast service. On one visit I was given an extra syrup shot for free. Nice touch. There is a small but comfortable seating area with couches. The only thing I did not like was the design of the store positioned the pickup bar in a corner of the store which causes a bit of a traffic jam during busy times.

I go here all the time and there is literally NEVER the same employees... very confusing... not sure if it's a training store or what. Sadly my cloud macchiato was completely wrong today ...  Even more sad I expected it because my orders have been messed up in the past. Every employee I've come in contact with is super nice though.

Not the biggest or best decorated Starbucks I've been in, but the store is super clean, not too busy, and located in a very convenient lot off of Oracle. Fast and friendly service. The bathrooms are coed and immaculate. The bakery display is fully stocked on a Saturday afternoon, which is convenient considering some stores run out of croissants. They also have a drive through.

I am disappointed. I went through the drive-through yesterday and was super impressed because the line was quick, the employee in the window was wearing gloves and a mask. And she did not touch my credit card. I went back today and noticed that nobody was wearing gloves. And the associates that were making the coffee had masks on but half of them did not have their noses covered. The woman who brought me my drink again with no gloves touched another associate on the back and she passed and then handed me my drink and straw. I am disappointed because Starbucks had shown up the associates from Dunkin' Donuts with their performance yesterday. Not sure I will go back until everything is back to normal. Bummer

Always pleasant folks here.  Nice place to come and do some work if you don't work in a typical office environment. 

Next to shopping/eating area as well.

The staff are exceptional friendly and knowledgeable about the Starbucks menu. 

The coffee is always as you order it. 

Why then I am not giving this neighbour hood caffeine sanctuary a 5 start review ? 

Cleanliness. The floors, table tops are dirty and the garbages are overflowing. 

The bathrooms are a sticky hot mess as well. 

With four staff working on  The a Monday afternoon I find it hard to believe that there a labour shortage too clean.
Certain baristas consistently place my coffee on the counter edge nearest to them and furthest from me. I'm barely five feet tall; I'd like to not have to climb across to retrieve my caffeine.

Location:  Right next to Trader Joe's.  On a busy intersection.  Drive thru.
Service:  Been here a few times, it's standard.  I guess being from a big city, I don't perceive this Bucks as being as busy as some reviewers do.  I'm used to this kind of pace.  I am, however, impressed with the variety of drinks the patrons order.  In the great white north, it's hot drinks all winter and cool drinks all summer.  Here, the patrons really give the baristas a work-out.  Maybe that's what's so challenging??  It's iced coffee, hot latte, frapp, refreshers, oatmeal.  Sheesh.  
Drinks:  Consistent.  
Layout:  smaller inside, lots of outdoor seating, with shade.  Very popular outside in winter, but the sun still super-bright.  It's like I'm in Tucson.

Stopped at this Starbucks on our road trip to Jacksonsville. 

This is one of my favorite Starbucks. I used to stop here every week on my way towards Daytona for a work project. I like my coffee hot and they always make my grande,  non fat, caramel macchiato. no foam, extra hot latte perfectly.

This is one of the best Starbucks I've been to in a long time. The food comes out hot and fresh and the drinks are made by expert baristas. The speed is good for the area they're located in and it's amazing!!!!

Just across from the City Centre Airport (ECCA) and the Air Museum you'll find this comfortable Starbucks. It's not too far from downtown if you were looking for a meeting or workplace with loads of free parking. I would come back to this one.

Busyness - pretty steady traffic coming in. It's a busy road with a grocery store nearby.

Noisiness - about the usual for a Starbucks. The blenders are noisy. It's summer. I've noticed there aren't many soft surfaces to absorb noise in most of the Starbucks I've ever gone to.

Ambience - It's comfortable and bright, and the decor is typical Starbucks. It seems to be popular with other laptop users. The air conditioning is just right. Blondie is playing in the background today.

Power - Not too bad. There are outlets for laptop users, but some of the middle tables don't have outlets.

Free wifi - Yes, of course, and it works well.

Staff - Lots of staff here and they're friendly.

Seating - There are 16 seats inside with two comfortable armchairs. The tables are a little small for much more than a laptop and a coffee, but there's one large table that works really well for laying out a bit of work. It also has a small patio with a couple of tables and an umbrella next to the drive-thru.

Security - As there's a lot of traffic, it would be wise to watch your laptop and belongings. I know this area borders on an part of Edmonton that's not the safest.

Sloooooow!!!! Went in when the drive through line was 20 cars deep (yes I counted).....so I went inside. I was immediately helped and then waited over 30 minutes for a grande cappuccino!! Apparently the drive through gets priority and then online orders. Don't make the mistake of going inside. Won't be at this location again. The male worker at the steamer didn't make it any better with his death glares at all the customers waiting for their drink.

This Starbucks is suddenly the best part of my morning. Clean and friendly, too. 
Heard they went through changes, and whatever they did made this like a Seattle store.

I've been into this Starbucks once before, but only briefly. I'm impressed by the space as it has a high ceiling, lots of windows and decent sized tables. It's not a residential area, so it seems like most of the patrons drive here. It's a well laid out, comfortable place.

Busyness - For the middle of the afternoon it's fairly steady and a bit of an older crowd. I guess there must be no schools nearby.

Noisiness - Not bad. About average for a steady Starbucks. The drive thru keeps them busy evidently. The music is definitely set to background level. I like that.

Ambience - Typical for Starbucks with modern, coffee-shop decor. 

Power - Power is available to pretty much all the seats, except the center ones. Wouldn't have far to stretch your power cord though.

Free wifi - Available and works well. No connection problems. A touch slow though.

Staff - It's adequately staffed with the usual, friendly staff you expect at Starbucks.

Seating - There are 17 seats inside and a patio with about 10 seats. There are two comfortable armchairs at a table and the square cafe tables are big enough you could probably fit two laptops with mice. Five of the chairs are at a bar, and I've never been a fan of them. In all the Starbucks locations I've been to, I'm not sure I've ever seen anyone actually use them.

Security - Seems fine. Not a bad area of the city, but you know the drill.

The people that work here are nice. They are friendly and smile frequently. But 80% of the time they get my order wrong!!! I do not use the drive thru either. I always walk in. I think that some of them are stressed out from the volume of customers. Relax dudes, it's only coffee!! I don't mind a little wait! I won't return here. Been here a lot and It's not worth it anymore. Pantano/Speedway is a good one as well as Broadway/Craycroft.  Bummer.

What the hell, Starbucks? 

Lately, I've begun going to Second Cup more often. Not because I like their coffee, but because they're quieter. I used to like this Starbucks a lot. No more. 

I went in here yesterday. I just wanted to sit and relax and write. I usually have my earphones with me, but had forgotten to throw them in my bag. 

Lately, it seems like every Starbucks I go in has one barista who has to be SUPER SOCIAL, the loudest, most obnoxious person in the entire joint. Yelling to be heard over the coffee machine? They're not that loud. Everyone in the entire place DOES NOT NEED TO YOUR HEAR YOUR EVERY WORD. Customers do not need to appreciate all conversations between baristas! 

It's going to be a LONG time before I come back. And that's sad. I used to like this place a lot.

This is a great Starbucks location. The staff is always great and friendly. It's also a great workspace all day long with nice couches.
Just be careful as it's a popular location during rush hour: The drive through can backup onto 4th Street and the parking lot fills up fast. Luckily there is an overflow parking lot next door.

This is the slooooowest Starbucks I've ever seen anywhere. You could leave this one and go to the Mt Carmel location and get your order faster. There should be a contest for worst Starbucks in the country.

So I requested a dark roast Pour over. And the person to help me said she had some she was about to throw out That had already been made. I said no just make me a new pour over and she still was insisting that I take what she had. I said no please make me a pour over and then she said OK. After waiting 15 minutes I finally got my pour over dark roast and it was lukewarm. The cream containers were not marked and there were no stirrers  Not a good example of Starbucks

There was a single drink order ahead of my single drink order. They promptly cleared that and spent the following 15 minutes ignoring my order, and serving other, later customers. When I inquired about the status of my drink, I was thrown shade. 

I'd had enough, and decided to get a refund, and go. But wait! They *just* made the drink, and tried to shame me into taking it. Really. You made me late, and I have to go. 
On the way out the door--"HAVE A NICE NIGHT!" Real loud, very immature; you embarrassed yourselves.

Out of all of the Starbucks in the downtown Indianapolis area, this by far is my favorite place to come and meet up friends, get some work done and just to hang out. It is well kept, has friendly baristas and there's not too much of a hangout spot for panhandlers.

A little bit long on the coffee delivery I feel like a couple orders were taken care of out of order and made me wait a little bit. But otherwise you guys were very friendly thanks so much for feeding my caffeine addiction!

Starbucks is Starbucks. Any franchisee you go to is the same service and the same quality. The coffee is good and the environment is awesome. Whether you want to go hangout with your friends, meet new people or even study, Starbucks is always a good option.They also have nice outside seatings and it is right by other good restaurants. The reason why I give them 4 stars is because of the price. To be honest, it is just coffee and it shouldn't cost you 4 bucks for a cup of small coffee.

This is a really nice Starbucks. Get service, always good coffee. The only reason I gave it a four star is because of its location and drive through, it is slow moving and I've had to wait in the parking lot not the drive through lane until It starts moving. But over all it is a very good Starbucks.
This place rocks! Great friendly staff who are efficient and fluent in coffee drinks. A+

At first glance, and being an out-of-towner, I couldn't tell that this location had a drive-thru. It's situated behind the location in what looked like the Bank parking lot. It was very busy and the line slow, but the excellent service and my drink (recommendation of the cashier) being so good made up for that.

So I've come here on several occasions and they always seem to be "out" of something. I knew that was absolute BS the minute she said it bc how would she know that? Did you call all the stores to find that out? No. I didn't appreciate being lied to, especially since I went to the Starbucks in the mall minutes later and they made it for me. Sad.
Please redesign this location drive thur parking is awful.  Also order a cappuccino and it barely full, when I specified fat free milk & sugar free syrup.  So what happened to three quarters or so??

Computer isn't able to properly process payments through the app. Don't ever have problems using my Starbucks app but came here two days in a row and suddenly I'm having those issues. Don't have problems at Elmwood location or at a Covington location in which I frequent OFTEN. Won't be back.

This sleek modern architectural design of a Starbucks building, invites you to pull on in.  And if the Starbucks itself doesn't pull you in, then the connecting Chipotle may!   Yes, I'm a sucker for some Starbucks and Chipotle.  I don't think I've ever consumed the two in one sitting, but I'm open to the idea now.

Neighboring the Saint Louis University campus area, this Starbucks can become very busy at certain hours of the day.  Students flocking in for their caffeine fix and plopping down with their Mac Books.  That being said, I wouldn't count on every visit being a breeze.  You may end up waiting a little longer than had you choose a different location.  

There's not a vast amount of parking available for the Starbucks in particular.  In fact, there's barely any.  You may need to end up parking in one of the neighboring lots, and turn an eye to the signs informing you not to park there.  Hey, sometimes the rules need to be broken in the name of a latte.  Luckily, there is also the drive thru option available at this location, which nicely wraps around the building.

*Drink of the moment: Iced Soy 2 Pump Sugar Free Cinnamon Dolce Latte.  Is that a mouth full, or what?  Yeah, a mouth full of deliciousness!

It was my first time in this location and It has been a very long day 
The gentleman on the drive through was amazing he had great attitude great customer service he cheered me up and told me I was doing a great job 
Who ever you are keep it up ! You're making people's lives better

This Starbucks was busy. Did not wait long for my order. Super friendly baristas. A clean , pleasant environment. I havent been to an actual Starbucks in years.  I'm Mormon  don't drink coffee. I ordered snickerdoodle hot coco. My favorite I have had 3 times. All the Starbucks I have had has been at kiosks. Was in the mood for sweet treat this hit the spot

Love this particular Starbucks it is much bigger than the other stores in the valley and it is right next to axiom nice to come her in the morning after a workout. Service is always awesome and there are plenty of funny and interesting people! Saul is the nicest guy! He's the Mann!
Love Starbucks!  Must say that the some of the Baristas at the location near Loft need to learn their menu & pay attention!

It's Starbucks so I can't say much. I enjoy a latte now and again, but of course, it's pricey. This particular location can get really congested. Staff is okay; they don't quite have the friendliness of most Starbucks baristas I've encountered. I wouldn't recommend coming during peak times, or if you're in a hurry.

Love this Starbucks, love these baristas. Jacob is THE BEST - friendly, fun, remembers drinks and names - he brightens the day. Carrington remembered us from a previous Starbucks and is really good to us. It's our favorite Starbucks!

New Starbucks on the block. As it's pretty new it's still pretty clean and quick moving. Good amount of staff working today, quick service, clean counters etc. They have cold brew on tap if that's your thing.

There's a good amount of tables, but lots of people in and out so might not be the best place for you if you're looking for a quiet space to work. 

Overall, pretty good as far as Starbucks goes.

First visit to a Starbucks that was not in an airport in at least three years. I'm one of those people who has a friend that collects their coffee mugs but doesn't travel that much. Hey, it is a good deal for me: I buy and deliver the mug from Dallas, Las Vegas or Phoenix and she pays for an entire night of beer and scotch when I present the mug to her after I return from the trip.

This location was chosen for a brief meeting by someone who wanted to meet me just down the street from their office and it easily accomplished our goal of having a comfortable place to talk about some upcoming business.

While I don't drink iced coffee often because a good friend effectively has ruined that, KFC gravy and Cracker Barrel breakfast platters with his commentaries on these items, our drinks were prepared accurately and in a reasonable amount of time by helpful employees.

While no food was ordered, there were plenty of options and many of them looked quite enticing. (Ok, so what exactly is Starbucks Evenings anyway that is mentioned in other reviews for this store? Is that just marketing like say Baywatch Nights or Match Game PM?)

Absolutely no issues with finding a seat/table during the lunch hour, a parking space or the overall cleanliness of this store. Wi-Fi was easy to access and use as well.

Wow!  I'm so pleasantly surprised at this store! It's so open, with lots of room for seating and work. Very clean with friendly staff!! This will be my new go to since I'm only 1 mile away!  Awesome place. Check it out!
Friendly staff, drinks are made right. Very busy in the mornings

Worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Took 20 min to get an iced coffee and a cold brew in the store. Then, half and half was empty so I asked for a refill and it took another 20 minutes for that. In the mean time, I asked for some half and half and they wouldn't even give it to me from the counter; "we have someone on it"... uh ok so I have to wait a total of 40 min for an iced coffee with half and half? Yeah ok Starbucks, no thanks.

Look it's a good starbucks, but you know.. it's just Starbucks. Chapterhouse is 1/2 a block down 9th.. COME ON!

Tip: buy yourself a starbucks giftcard and register it online to get 2 hours of free continuous internet at starbucks (have to use your card once a month).

I'm not a frequent visitor to Starbucks but I don't mind this location when I'm in the mood for a drink.  I came with my coupon for a free drink to celebrate my birthday.  You can sign up online and they will mail you a card for a free drink with a 2 week window to use it.

It was a sunny day and I was craving a sweet drink.  I was glad to see no line up (this location seems to be a lot quieter than the one 2 blocks west) and I asked the barista what drink would be like a frozen hot chocolate.  I didn't catch the name of the drink but it sounded good so I ordered it with soy milk.  The only thing was, he should have asked what size I wanted instead of giving me the grande.  I probably wouldn't have been able to finish a venti though as it was a filling drink.

The barista who made my drink was friendly.  I enjoyed my drink as it wasn't too sweet but it had little pieces of what seems like chocolate bits.  I found it was very filling as well and I wasn't hungry for food after.  I wish I got the name of the drink, but I'm sure next time I can ask the same question and likely get the same drink.
Every time I go there and get serious strawberry they always have someone new and they always mess it up they need to just close down
Drinks were made really well, super convenient to stop for gas and grab a coffee. Mocha Frapp & Vanilla Latte on point!

Even though this Starbucks is closest to where I live, it's the worst. Staff is unfriendly, drinks are rarely good, food is generally okay, place is generally dirty. Definitely could use some training!!

Not my regular Starbucks but I stop by every couple of months, I've noticed within the last year it seems to have taken a downhill turn. The couple of staff I recognize are always friendly and polite, but they constantly seem short staffed and thus it really slows down service compared to other locations. There's ample seating but it isn't my choice location.
This Starbucks location makes my coffee right every time, which not a lot of locations can say! The staff is also very friendly and efficient :)

It's hit or miss for me at this location. On this evening I came with my partner and we ordered two drinks. It didn't seem too busy inside but I guess the drive-through was jammin. As a result, I waited and I waited and I waited some more; and finally somebody asked me: what did you order? I ended up getting my coffee and my partner's coffee almost 20 minutes out. 

While I waited I took a couple of snaps of the floor behind the service counter. It is always amazing to me how dirty the floor can get in a coffee shop. But what's even more amazing to me is how dirty the counters are and the items used for steaming milk and so on. 

Also, the coffee is the other or miss many times that flavor is not consistent at least for me and my partner. She describes the flavor at times like brewed roasted old pinto beans. I think it's nice that they guarantee your drink to be good or they'll replace it. Tonight however it was worth the trip just not worth the wait.

hanging out in a coffee house/cafe to do some work while sipping a drink and possibly a snack?  Having to feed a meter the entire time is not the best plan.  This place you have to find a metered spot and then feed it.  Meters are expensive here.

The store is not as warm and inviting as many other of these and it's not as nice looking inside either.

Worst one in Tucson, went once had horrible experience, tried again a year later, still went bad, asked for a no water extra ice green tea no sweetener in a venti cup.....instead I got a black tea in a grande that was overly sweet.... Don't hire kids, there stupid....

I've given this place so many chances, but the times I leave unsatisfied outweigh the times I leave happy. Every time I get my drink it seems to be made incorrectly or stingy on the amount. I love the staff,very friendly, but drinks are awful quality. We all know Starbucks is pricey and when you pay that much for a drink and it's made wrong or has half the amount in it, it's frustrating. I did have a few sips of the drink below, but it did fit in to my grande Starbucks mug. First bad review I've given. DRIVE THRU IS AWFUL. At 5:30 in the morning I shouldn't wait 18 minutes
For a drink. Do not go here if you think you'll be in and out quickly. I could have ordered a dinner at restaurant and got my food quicker than I got my drink at the drive thru. And I was the second car in line.

I have literally been coming to Starbucks my entire life and I have never had such amazing service as I have had today. Jessica is so sweet and attentive, she set my morning up for success. Everyone else was super nice as well!

We stopped in this Starbucks on New Years Day on our way thru Fishers.  This place was hoppin'!  The crew inside were extremely friendly and very warm and welcoming to us.  We ordered two Zebra Coffees, a cheese Danish and a coffee cake.  Both of the pastries were warmed without us having to ask (bonus). The coffee was prepared correctly and tasted delicious on this chilly morning.

The only thing we disliked about this location was the parking lot, it is quite small and not easy to navigate with the drive thru -as you can imagine - people in the drive thru line are afraid you are going to steal a spot from them, so they block you trying to park or turn left to find additional parking.

Overall nice experience!

Using the drive through is ALWAYS a delight. At this particular location they seem to "get it" and always get my order correct. In a world full of ups and downs this is a constant- yes. Great staff and excellent service.  Fast, organized and clean.  The staff remembers your name and greets you when you come in.  Thumbs up!

I'm not one to review things but this really just made my day and I know how hard those baristas were working. They were slammed with orders and my drinks both came out tasting amazing as usual!

I will say this, the staff here really does care about their customers. If they get something wrong.. the staff is more than happy for fix the problem for you. The bathrooms could be better attend to but I can understand they get busy and it's not always easy to get over there to clean them.

Starbucks is known for its outrageous lines but this location takes it to a completely different level. The lines are out the door, you can't move and you will for sure be waiting a good 20-30 mins for a drink that was made incorrectly. The tables are never cleaned because the high traffic volume. I mean I know it's the KOP mall but that's why you should maybe have a store that's not the size of a closet and a bigger staff.
Nitro cold brew. Enough said. Glad this Starbucks had it and let us try a sample of it. Friendly staff. Glad to have stopped by.

They mumble names here, and served my drink to someone else. Their solution was to have that person give me my drink... No organization inside; always seems like everyone is working around each other without any real accomplishment. Order is always incorrect. Do yourself a favor and go to literally anywhere else to get coffee, until they can fix this store.

Possibly one of the friendliest overall staffs of any Starbuck's I've visited! They make you feel like family if you are a regular and know many people by name. They are always smiling; no matter how busy. Manager is a friendly fellow named Aaron and is always ready to listen to any comments or questions. They've never gotten an order wrong. Lastly, I love the utilitarian vibe here!

Note: I didn't take off any stars for parking but like the other Edwardsville location, it can be tricky leaving. Remember that you can't get out by going around to the driver-thru entrance. You can get out by going back to entrance or through the hotel parking lot.

Corporate office needs to evaluate this store!
Slow service throw drive thru. Don't get orders rite the first time, I have been coming to this location nearly 6 years and the last year or so has been with soo many problems occur

This is the best Starbucks I've ever been to, and I've been to every one in pinellas county. I have been coming here almost daily since they've opened and I love every person that works here. They make the experience even more than just getting coffee. They call me by name, they know what I like, they all are so sweet and fun to be around... I've never had a bad experience here - ever! They are very efficient yet mindful and they always make my day!! Thank you, All!!!

When I heard about it I came back to see if the man was still there and he was not.
