I really liked this location: It had the speediness of downtown cafes but the friendliness of a neighbourhood coffee shop!

Only a one star because I like my drink. 
Otherwise it is one of the slowest (next to Horsham) stores ever. 15min for iced tea. I'm done.

18 minutes for an iced coffee? I was the only customer waiting for a long while?  And then they screwed that up too?  

Come on, folks.  Wake up!

The only thing I like about this place lately is the food. Can't drink coffee and I used to love their Chai tea until they changed it to Orpha!!! It's awful!!!

The staff really needs to be on top of cleaning tables and emptying the trash cans. They're consistently overflowing. So sad. This used to be a beautiful location.

With the Fall season in full effect, cheers to welcoming back the Caramel Apple Spice cider! This beverage with a warm pastry of any kind is so clutch. Basically a caramel apple in a cup! My first sip was like walking through an apple  orchard with warm caramel syrup in hand to drizzle on each Granny Smith Apple I bite lol. 

If you like apples, dont let this season pass by without trying one!

They recently updated this Starbucks location. It looks brighter, more open and modern. I don't feel like it added any more seating space, but now there are lounge chairs and some booth spaces as well as a longer table to accommodate individual people working. The two-person tables are round and a bit small if you're both wanting to work on laptops or have books to spread out so keep that in mind. I do like the look of the space and they did fix some of those nasty potholes so the parking lot's improved since my last review.
The coffee is always consistent. I love the pikes blend coffee. It's always clean inside and the staff is always pleasant. My only complaint is sometimes the wait is to long

Always a line, but that's a given for any Starbucks. However, this location is on the slower side when it comes to making drinks. I frequent a few locations around the city, depending on where I'm going, but I tend to skip this one if I don't have at least 10 minutes to devote to ordering/waiting for a drink. Stop in if you have some time, but skip if you're in a rush.

This is a great Starbucks location. It's right on West End, perfect for being checking out the Parthenon, heading downtown, or going to Vanderbilt. There's 3 other Starbucks location right down the road, so if you miss this one you aren't far away from another one. Their drive thru line is always fairly long, but they get through it pretty fast! It has a large indoor and outdoor space, great for studying, working and meeting with friends. The staff there are all very friendly, and helpful if you are unsure of what you'd like. 

See you soon Starbucks!

Unfortunately the worst customer service...drive thru closed, no breakfast sandwiches ready (all frozen) even though they were displayed in the case but no sign mentioning they weren't available till 9am.  Btw, I waited in the long line a second time for this breakfast which I couldn't get!  Keep in mind there were 6-7 employees walking around.  On top of all that, the hostess was unpleasant (like she hated being there) and the coffee was bitter (which is hard to do with a PSL).  The line was exceptionally long due to the drive thru being closed, which remained closed for at least an hour.  Errrrr not a nice way to start the day! not worthy of even 1 star today

Just so rude and inconsiderate. I'm trying to think the cashier had a rough morning or a rough night, but it has bothered me so much today to make me write this review. Don't waste you're time waiting in line here.
Every drink is perfection. I love the drive thru. It is quick. I have always had great servers at this location. They will even add extra toppers on the frapps if you ask. :)

Staff were nice and quick to facilitate orders. The reason for the 3 stars is related to the cleanliness of the indoor seating area. Have been here for a few hours and haven't once seen a staff member come from behind the counter to clean any of the tables or do any sweeping. Tables, chairs, and floor with visible crumbs and debris. I wiped my own table off with a napkin.

When to this Starbucks after having lunch at Pumpernick's restaurant.  There was no line. It was happy hour. My daughter and i were able to get a drink for the price of 1.  Great deal! My drink was made as a requested. I will continue to go to this Starbucks  when I have a craving for Starbucks

I sent my daughter in for a cold drink. She came to our vehicle 13 minutes later. Other adults went into the store and came back out with their drinks before her. I will not be going back to this location. Come on Starbucks you can do better than that! Very disappointed.

Came on Saturday at around 830AM waited in Drive-thru about 20 minutes, I was late for work my iced coffee was ALL Ice I'm very Disappointed!!!!!! Get Faster waiting that long and Still having drink made Wrong Is crap!!!
Customer service was great , regular coffee with 6 splenda , ice , half and half was perfect cup of JAVA for me !!!

I frequent Starbucks for studying purposes and generally find most of them pretty good studying environments. I came to this one at about 8pm on a Sunday and I was the only person in there. I realize that Starbucks does not mean silence, however when the employees have their friends come visit and are laughing obnoxiously and making a ton of unnecessary noise it's a little annoying. Employees should realize why many people choose to come here and sit. To get work done. It's not social hour. You're there to work, not to be loud and socialize with your friends. One was even annoying enough to start singing Blink-182 ALOUD over the gentle music playing overhead. Again, read the room. In addition to the employees complete disregard for customer service, the bathrooms were filthy. There was a dirt ring in the toilet, which I know takes quite a long time to form. If you clean the bathroom daily as I'm sure you're instructed to, the toilet and the floors should never be that dirty. If you're looking for a relaxing environment and a clean bathroom, choose another Starbucks.
I avoided this location for a solid 6 months then tried again.  It has certainly improved and is very much in-line with the Starbucks locations.

When a friend wants to meet the best choice for me is Starbucks The seating is very limited so I was happy to snag an open table!  My drink of choice is a Sugar-Free Vanilla Frappuccino During the pandemic I can appreciate the measures Starbucks has taken to ensure the environment is sterilized, safe, and efficient w/amazing customer service!  Coffee makes me happy

Alright, here's the deal. It doesn't take a brain surgeon to realize I prefer local coffee over corporate coffee. I think it tastes better, I like the look and feel of local shops, and the warm and fuzzy feeling you get when supporting a local biz owner trumps all the cake pops in the world (although damn, those cake pops are good, SBux.) That being said, sometimes I have to make a choice based on where I am and how much time I have. Occasionally (not often) those factors land me at the Wydown Starbucks.

It's not a bad place to be for a few different reasons, #1 being the space. This Starbucks is huge and there are many seating options, including couches, tall tables, big tables for groups, and also seats ideal for people working alone. There's also a cool little setup of tables outside which I can appreciate on a nice day. Secondly, the employees are so nice and efficient. When I throw my order at them of a doubletallicedsoysugarfree vanilla latte, they don't even flinch and it comes out quick and just how I like it. Obviously, also, the free & reliable wi-fi doesn't hurt. 

The trouble happens in the 3:00 hour. Whatever schools are nearby let out sometime around then, and it's as if someone opens the doors to the schools and says "release the hounds!" Students from middle school aged to high school aged come barging through the doors of Starbucks, likely looking to consume more sugar 'cause they probably haven't had enough already, and it's literally the loudest place on earth for about an hour. Girls crowding over each others phones yelling "OMG! I CANNOT BELIEVE HE SAID THAT!" Boys poking girls in the side causing the girls to shriek at scarily high levels. It's bad. It's funny to look around at everyone in there working because they literally can't believe their eyes (and ears.)

If you've gotta go corporate, this Starbucks is a fine choice. Just go in the morning or early afternoon, and if you choose to go around 3... well, don't say I didn't warn you.
This is my favorite Starbucks ever. I live across town, but every barista I've had here has been so nice!!

Look, we all know what Starbucks is like. This ain't no franchise, ladies and gentlemen, and there's nothing I can tell you about the selection that you don't already know.

What I CAN tell you is that this Starbucks is my absolute favorite nearby (half block away) establishment, with total credit due to the absurdly awesome manager and staff. Who else can I expect to harass me for being a bum freelancer, wearing the same baggy cutoff jorts every summer morning, and the same ripped jeggings every winter day? I mean BESIDES my mom. 

No one, that's who. 

I wouldn't have it any other way. These guys are friendly and fabulous, and make the morning drudge that much better.*

I happen to make an amazing cup o' joe -- beans purchased from a "source" who gets them  from Rulli of Marin County, California... fresh grinds every few days... single cup cone drip -- and on most mornings, I am happy to make my own. But at least once a week, when I've woken up on the wrong side of the bed and need a friendly face, or I've slept in and can't find the kettle (let alone those little cone filters) Wydown Starbucks comes through. 

-----

* To be fair, when you're a freelancer in cutoff jorts, there's not much "drudge" to the morning routine.

The staff here is hit and miss. Sometimes you get someone friendly and sometimes you dont. The manager here is the worst. The last time I went to the drive thru here I had to have her at the window. Even when you go out of your way to smile she is cold and bitchy back. Wont go here again

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. Although staffed with about 5 people, the wait times are consistently over 20 minutes for coffee. Wait times are shorter in Disney World in the middle of summer. AVOID. Go to the Whole Foods coffee bar across the street.

Update the damn app!  Hate it when I decide what I want and order it.  Then when we get there that item us out of stock!  So exasperating.  Started coming to this Starbucks because the other store didn't update their app either.  Would change if there was another store in the area.  Grrrr, just update your app when something is no longer available.  Please!  Otherwise what is the point of having a mobile app to order ahead?  Blah!!
Best Starbucks experience! Fabulous service start to finish. Delightful. Wish I could remember the gentleman's name but nay. Carry on!

I love the free wifi, lounge chairs and outside seating area! It feels like a real coffee house. The part that needs work is to have an electrical outlet by each table or in the table/on the floor - this is my mini-office and I can be here all day - java it all up - yet need better electricity outlets! Love the coffee, service but wish the price was more reasonable.
Dirty place, counters are filthy, baristas are not attentive, all tables needed to be clean

Awful experience here. I grabbed one of the pre-made sandwiches and realized it was past expiration, I told the cashier before I paid for it that I wanted to switch it for a fresher one and he made a big deal about walking 3 feet away to grab a new one. Then when I asked if he would heat it up for me he rolled his eyes at me. Meanwhile I ordered a green tea, and as it was less than 30 degrees out I didn't think to specify that I wanted a hot tea. I received an iced one and the girl who handed it to me kindly fixed the error. But as I sat and ate my lunch the guy working the register openly (and loudly) bitched to another coworker about me specifically. He complained that customers are so LAZY because it's OUR job to notice that the wrong style cup was being used for our drink order......I didn't acknowledge him, just left. And won't be returning.

Not too many Starbucks I don't care for. 
This one is special because it's like an oasis during tampa commutes.

A beacon of hope. 24 hours. . .

And it now shares a parking lot with Wawa.

Drinks are consistent.
Service is ok here.

Love the weekly picks for free iPhone music, apps.

When you have a broken machine customers who aren't having a drink made from that machine shouldn't be told it will be a wait. An iced drink should take a matter of seconds to make. Maybe having a plan to organize your workers for a situation like this would be more efficient.

I visit this Starbucks all the time because it's right across the street from my office. Because I visit here so often, the baristas know my name, why  I really like! :)

Other than that, it's your regular Starbucks store. There is no drive through. It is kept pretty clean too.

There several schools near by, so at 3pm, this place can get pretty crowded with students and that gets annoying.

The baristas have fun personalities too if you get to talking to them!

The new coed bathrooms are disgusting. I don't know why Starbucks did this but they're gonna lose what little business I am still giving them because of it. The bathrooms were never very clean but now they're truly disgusting.
This is the coldest Starbucks I've ever been to. Seriously its freezing, always. Service is and drinks are great but oh my god its so cold. Please fix the temp.

Now I know why Starbucks does not mix the Frappuccinos all the way! It's so the drinks can look pretty waiting for customers to pick up their orders! My favorites are the matcha green tea and Chai Fraps!
Great drinks but every seat was taken up by a homeless person so couldn't sit down... don't go if you're looking to sit down and enjoy your coffee.

Not the best Starbucks.  They seem rushed even when there is not many people.  As usual this time of year at all Starbucks they are out of the ingredients for the special holiday drinks, but they do not make a note on the board or on the drive thru, so you have to go through the order and "sorry out" a couple of times to get an order in.  And unlike other Starbucks they do not make an attempt to offer suggestions, cut the price, or substitute a similar ingredient, they just leave you hanging with minimal apologies.

There is indoor and outdoor seating that his facing a busy street.  The location is convenient to some shopping, ie Trader Joes and Bookmans, but not a great location to just take it easy.  If you come here it is only, obviously, to get your chain coffee drink and to move on.  If you have a minute or two drive a couple miles east to the Speedway and Pantano store or to Broadway and Kolb for the recently remodeled store.

I visited this Starbucks today and am super impressed with the staff. The sweet lady who took my order was not only on top of her game, she was friendly. I was greeted with a REAL smile, not an "I have to smile at you because it's my job" smile. 

She took my order for my Grande Strawberry Green Iced Tea Infusion and it was ready in about 45 seconds. Fastest order I've ever received at any Starbucks.  

This Starbucks is located just outside Lakeside Mall on Causeway.  It's in a little strip mall and has a drive thru.  Big plus.  The parking lot had several available spots, so parking wasn't an issue.

Male barista, glasses and a beard. Name's Dan. Really rude, sighed when we placed our order. Asked him if they still had a cinnamon roll frappuccino and he said "unfortunately." Started acting all pouty. Made two orders before he finished mine. Not the first bad experience I've had in here, could use some friendly new staff. On the plus side, the drink was good.

I am writing this five star review tonight because I came in at closing time and these employees had the right attitude and were happy to help me. I only wanted hot tea, but they didn't know it at the time. Their response to are you still open was "sure! What can we get for you" so awesome! It was cold out and the tea hit the spot! Thanks guys! And to the managers, you have a good team of people here!

Cheers!
Loved that they offered me a "Pup cup" for my dog when we went through the drive-up.  It made his day!

I've been to several Starbucks locations since recently moving to the area, & hands down, I'm giving this one an automatic 5 stars simply due to being the speediest, fastest, quickest - however you want to put it - Starbucks drive-thru that I've EVER been to. There was a long line to the road even, & I was in & out in 5 minutes from start to finish, including drive-thru time!!
This store just required my daughter in law to buy something in order for my three yr old grandson to use the restroom. WTH

Starbucks is normally known for consistent quality from various locations but this location is the sad exception. I have received inexcusably poor service here on several instances. Today, I placed a large mobile order on the app and was very disappointed to see a ripped piece of paper with a poorly handwritten note saying the store closed early taped to the door. This was especially disappointing since I had already paid for the mobile order and was really looking forward to having my beverage. I knocked on the door and honked several times but the workers would not open the door. Needless to say I will never mobile order from this location again. It is extremely inconsiderate and irresponsible for them to not shut down mobile ordering when they close early. Another time at this same location I ordered a trenta peach green tea lemonade and the barista accidentally made a venti so she just poured it into a trenta cup and it served it to me 3/4 of the way full. I asked her if she could simply top it off with green tea and she said it wasn't possible. I was appalled to receive such terrible service. After two of these horrific experiences I will absolutely NEVER give this location my patronage

This is hands down the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. The workers are miserable and were loudly complaining about my order because it "takes so long to make." It's an iced green tea! Usually Starbucks baristas are happy and excited to do their job so I am shocked every time I come here hoping it'll be different. I guess the manager hasn't learned to hire the right employees.

I love starbucks! This location not so much. Stopped in thinking it was going to be fast. Ordered my venti iced latte with coconut milk and paid.  While i was waiting i saw people cleaning because they were not busy. About 5 minutes pass and my order wasnt even started. I ask if they got my order and they were like no, the machine didnt print it out.  After that my order was made. I didnt get my good vibe in this starbucks. I will return cause it a good location. Its off the plant city exit. Easy in and out of the interstate.

I arrived and the drive thru was long, so I decided to go inside.  I waited for 45 minutes for one black grande coffee!!!!  As I got bored, I counted the cars in the drive thru.  50 + cars were served before your inside customers.  This is unacceptable.  I am highly disappointed in my experience.

My wife and I went through the drive through the drive through at this location at 5:39pm on March 30, 2018... the service was subpar to say the least. 

First off, the gentleman taking our order kept getting it wrong and I had to repeat myself a few times; not really a big deal in itself however, the service did not get better from there. I had ordered my latte and my wife venti Pike. When we arrived at the window, I notice that the lid on the venti pike was leaking substantially and asked for a new cup and lid (how he didn't notice is beyond me). This request seemed to displease the gentleman and he returned with a grande pike... I told him we ordered a venti and he contradicted me and said, "no, you ordered a grande" ... He relented and switched it back to a venti...and while doing this, he had obviously said something to his co-worker, because even she, shot me a 'look'. 

When he finally returned with the correct drink, the gentleman did not try to hide his displeasure in any way at all... and to add a little insult to injury, the Pike Place roast was definitely not fresh..

I think the staff of this store need to be reminded of a few things... 1) The customer is NOT an interruption of your work day, they are the reason for your work day
2) Starbucks provides a premium product at a premium price... and customers expect to be treated accordingly.
3) If YOU make an error, it's really no big deal... own up to it and move on. 
4) You are not the most valuable part of a business, the customers are.
5) You're easily replaced. 

Will not be back to this location
I like this this place even though they make you coffee burn your face off hot they have really cute cups to

I tried to get a match water and the lady attempted to charge me more for the matcha water than the actual tea. Usually, the baristas are nice about it and realize that there's no milk. I do not know why she wanted to charge more. Not going to this Starbucks again

Wouldn't recommend this place.  The cashiers are hit and miss.  It is more the overall cleanliness of the place.  The pastry case looked disgusting and there were flies on the register and around the store and it just didn't seem clean (715am visit).  I know sometimes a fly or two gets in in the summertime but there was 1 just sitting on each register and 2 flying around where the coffee is being prepared.  Gross.

So... I ordered a coffee and two pastries. No chocolate shakers by the mixing area. I tried to get the attention of a barista who was talking about her dental work to get a chocolate shaker, but she seemed too busy explaining her dental work to notice my tries to get her attention. Another barista saw me trying to get her attention and told me they've been out of chocolate for awhile. "Really? Then what do you use for the coffee drinks?", I thought to myself. It was around 7am on a Saturday, so not busy at all. The area where customers mix their coffee was pretty dirty with sugar and stuff. I don't know the coffee industry but shouldn't someone be on cleaning duty when it is slow? Oh, and the pastries were still wrapped in the plastic they came in. SMH...

In the middle and late 1980s, this particular location was a Café Paradiso. I was more of a tea drinker than a coffee drinker then, but every once in awhile, I went to Café Paradiso for their snacks, baked goods and an occasional cup or two of coffee. It was a nice place and I liked it a lot. Then, one day when I was working and going to classes at a nearby university, Café Paradiso was gone; it was converted to a Starbucks. And it's still a Starbucks. My Café Paradiso was gone! Quel horreur! 

So now, it has continued to be a Starbucks ever since then, and it's not too much different than all the other Starbucks locations. Some have outside seating, and others don't have outside seating, this one has outside seating. The interior must have been remodeled because it's dark like everything is mahogany wood or made to look like that and depressing inside. I'm not sure what they were trying to accomplish with that, but for me, it doesn't work. It doesn't feel inviting and I didn't want to stay there very long. 

They offer typical Starbucks stuff. They were limited on the Starbucks merchandise like cups and mugs. They had food offerings like made up sandwiches and what seemed like limited baked goods. 

Parking is a problem now because the formerly free spaces along Wydown are not free anymore. they have an electronic pay station where you have to pay for the parking now. I don't know why they changed it, but it is now really inconvenient to park there now. Those electronic pay stations are a major pain in the ass because they take coins or cards, and you have to put in your plate number in addition to paying with either the card or coins. I hate them. Around the corner are the old fashioned parking meters which I prefer over that damn pay station. So just beware of that and you will get a ticket if you don't pay.

I won't be back anytime soon.

This Starbucks isn't necessarily bad on the inside and I've always received consistently good service, but the parking lot and drive-thru is a clusterf*ck. Who thought it would be a good idea to put a drive-thru here? It's seriously dangerous to people walking and driving. This was not very well thought out. Yes, I know the previous business had one, but it wasn't nearly as busy as this Starbucks to matter, plus that shopping center was nearly all closed.
Plus, this straw ban is totally absurd. I asked the barista if they had any regular straws because these paper ones bake the drinks taste like cardboard. She tells me they are, "done with plastic," yet my cup and lid is all plastic. This virtue signaling BS needs to go!

SLOWEST STARBUCKS EVER!  I popped in for a gift card, decided on a coffee to go as well.  Time stamp on receipt was 2:17p; did not coffee in hand until 2:24p.  The inside service was completely in the weeds; drive-thru a priority for service (average time seemed to be 3+ minutes).

I recommend drive-thru if you're in a hurry.

Knew I should have gone to the one in Target...waiting sucks.

I ordered the egg sous vide and got a piece of black chunk at the bottom of the egg when I bit into the egg it crunched hard in my teeth . And tasted really bad I don't understand how you can get something like that with egg sous vide. And why do I always have to ask for a napkin? Is this Starbucks way of saving money?

I've been bad. I've been visiting this Starbucks more frequently that I should be, but it's all in the name of good health. Scout's honour.

One, it's exactly 4.0 km from my place, so husband and I have been taking more walks here in summertime. It's a sunny route and it's good exercise, and so this Starbucks has become our "halfway done our walk" treat.

I also go to Spa Lady in the same parking lot, so sometimes I grab a post-workout frap on my way home. Whaaat, I deserve it.

At the end of the day, a Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks. The same drinks, the same treats, the same amount of seating, etc. I just really like the location.

No drive thru here, but that's okay, what this location lacks for in size and convenience is surely made up for with the amazing staff. I came in on a Sunday morning to get my caffeine crave; and this location didn't miss a beat as it relates to service and the quality to come to expect from Starbuckies. This is truly your friendly neighborhood Starbucks.

Note: Parking is a bit of a a tight squeeze and there is plenty of customer seating outside. 

Cheers,

Hellooooo new, conveniently placed Starbucks. Fellow SLUdents and I have been waiting for you for quite some time. 

  First perk: they kept the Del Taco building, I just love it, it looks like a spaceship. 
 Second perk: There is a drive-thru and they made it accessible to the shoulder going on to 64 so you don't have to wait at the stoplights just to get back out. 
Third perk: The interior. So cool. The big "Saint Louis" light up logo, the all recycled wood surfaces and industrial metals with the Starbucks Reserve section is sharp. The seating is great: some high top tables, and  tables facing the all open window view. In a wrap up: it looks spiffy. 
And lastly the fourth perk: The service was stellar today. I know it is only the second day but every worker was smiling, working hard, and not complaining. Even when it was jam packed (and it definitely was) this morning at 9 AM they were bustling about but not snapping at each other while they navigated the Starbucks station. 
   I like the atmosphere, the staff, the accessibility and, oh yea, the pumpkin spiced latte. I'm a happy camper.

I've driven past this Starbucks many times and thought it looked like an interesting place. I've never stopped, but today I found myself downtown and thought I should stop in and have a look.

Overall I'd say it's a pretty nice Starbucks, but it suffers from one fatal flaw as a work location (unless you live nearby) and that is the pay parking. I didn't spend a lot of time driving around looking for free parking, because I don't think it exists in this area. $3.00 an hour. 

It's great if you live or work nearby and have the parking taken care of or are using transit to get here. Otherwise, if you're driving , forget it, unless have a meeting set up here. Work for a few hours and it's going to cost you, not to mention the inconvenience of having to go plug the meter. It's at the bottom of an apartment building, so I'm sure the residents know this location well.

Busyness - There are a lot of apartments around here so I expect this place is pretty busy in the morning. I wouldn't mind a Starbucks near my house. 

Noisiness - For being pretty steady, it hasn't been too bad for a Friday afternoon. It's winter now, so I don't know what kind of crazy person would order an iced drink to get those blenders going. But, it is Canada.

Ambience - This isn't your usual boxy Starbucks. It clips off the bottom corner of the building so it has an unusual layout. The windows seem to line about half of the walls, so it's quite bright inside, with high ceilings. 

Power - I didn't really see many outlets at the tables, so you may have a problem unless your laptop is miserly with the power.

Free wifi - Available and works well.

Staff - Friendly and efficient, as usual.

Seating - There are 21 seats here, with one large table to work at. If you're into relaxing in an easy chair, there are four of them tucked away in the corner and there's an electrical outlet there.  Perfect place for a power meeting or power nap. The rest of the tables are the square type with two chairs each. I like them much better than the useless round cafe style tables.

Security - It's a nice neighbourhood, but if you've read my other reviews you'll know I'm just paranoid about that kind of stuff.

This particular Starbucks is on the ball every day and I visit coffee shops on the regular. The lady in there by the name of Heather is a machine. She even remembered my order from my last visit. Now that's what I call customer service. All around I'm going to be making this my regular stop in the mornings. 

Still all of the ladies there are very chipper this early in the morning and my drink is mad perfect. Well done.

Great service at this location. I'm not particular with my orders, but all of the baristas are friendly and quick and offer great suggestions for someone who rarely drinks coffee. Parking can be a struggle during busy times, but there's a good amount of seating. One really long table (seats about 8-9 comfortably) and then a cozy little spot near the front of the store with couches. A few other smaller tables that seat about 4. Good spot for groups or one-on-one meetings.

Visited this location for the first time and really appreciated the assistance from the manager Abby. She was really helpful with providing information on their new one step coffee brewer. Will definitely recommend this location to others.

Clean store. My drinks are always correct and delicious. However, the service is very slow. When doing a mobile order it typically says 4-9 minutes but I end up waiting 5-10 minutes for my drink AFTER arriving. They need more staff but drinks are on point.

So I'm pretty irritated with this Starbucks and only this Starbucks when it comes to how they make there coffee I have been to Starbucks in many states since I travel a lot and this one is the worst I have never been this unhappy.  The service was good the drinks were terrible last time I was in I ordered what I always ordered and it tasted like water I had them remake it and instead of remaking it they took ice out and added cream or something sweet it was not the taste of a iced coffee like I normally get I didn't say anything cause I didn't want to come across  rude. I was really late for work today and ordered the same thing but a venti I usually order a tall but I work with patients all day and really needed the extra coffee I no joke took only a couple sips and the whole coffee was almost gone. They filled the cup almost to the top with ice leave maybe a quater of my venti actual coffee. I can't leave my post since I'm with patients who need my supervision at all times so I can't even go back and ask them," what the heck why is my coffee cup all ice and almost no coffee. I don't get off work for 11 hours so I'm writing this post to tell people if you want your coffee made right don't come here cause I am regretting coming to this place I'm exhausted cause I worked a double shift yesterday and really needed the coffee and now a tall is what I get coffee worth after paying for a venti.  Starbucks will lose lots of clients this way if the people at this location keep messing up on my drink as well as my friends have told me the same complaint so I'm finally leaving a review cause myself and other are tired of this location being the worst at making coffee the way it's suppose to be made not there estimate so they add extra ice when they come up short that is not good service that's lazy service
Workers are beyond amazing. Treat me so nicely every time. A simple " how's your day going" can make or break a customer experience. This location customer service is amazing. Thank you.

I love that it is connected with Einstein Brothers Bagels.  It is the nearest one to where I stay when I am in Tucson and having a drive thru is an awesome perk.  

The only down side to this Starbucks is also a plus...The Location.
It is great that is so close to where I stay but in the morning getting out of there can be crazy with the work traffic.  However that has never stopped me from stopping and getting my morning cuppa.

As usual we got our fast and very friendly service.   Loved the contactless service they are providing along with their reliable regular customer service.  They have no touch card scans and no touch on your cup.  Masks and gloves were used also.  Way to protect customers Starbucks!
This location has consistently performed below expectations. They not only are the slowest, but often do not produce the drink ordered.

Pretty good location, plenty of parkings around. 
Friendly fast service. 
I came in for a cake pop. First time eating cake pop. It looks super pretty and sweet, but taste not as good as it looks. The little kid next to me loves it though. 
The place is small, so during rush hour it can get crazy. 
They have nice outside seatings.

I come to the drive-through of this Starbucks several times a week, and it has to be the One of the busiest and one of the fastest Starbucks drive-throughs in the Tampa area, if not all of Florida. They are always busy in the morning, but the wait is never long and the service is always friendly!

Part of me doesn't want to write this review because I don't want is to get any busier here in the mornings.

super slow
there were 3 cars ahead of me and it took 20 minutes to get my order. that is super slow service for any drive thru. to top it off, the "all day menu" ran out of many many items. really really disappointed.

This customer service will turn any smile upside down!  The staff is very smug and unfriendly and I leave felling horrible about not only my experience but spending my hard earned money in exchange for an attitude, behind the bar!  Wow!  Unbelievable.  NEVER going back.  My time is valuable and I rather share it with people who are positive and friendly!  And Grateful!

This used to be my favorite Starbucks. It was relatively close to my house, I liked the town it is located in, I loved the staff and I loved sitting outside on Lake Afton. Alas, on my last visit, the life had been sucked out of the place. We couldn't use the loo. The staff was uninspired. And we couldn't even sit outside...
Thankfully, I have a better SB in my own town. Good bye Yardley.
Do not go here on Saturday morning!! Slow, slower, slowest. 25 minutes for a cup of coffee is abominable.

Friendly staff. Convenient location... Often there is a bit of a waitMy only real compliant is they run out of Cold Brew 60% of the time... Why not plan and make more cold brew? I feel so petty complaining when there are way bigger problems in the world today... this just seems like an easy fix. 

Update- unfortunately I spend a lot of time waiting for orders or drinks here. I usually get plain coffee, cold brew, or green tea but somehow there is usually at least a 10 minute wait... the staff is super nice and it's close to home so I keep coming back but after todays 12 minute wait with 1 person ahead of me ... I think it is probably faster to drive to a nearby Starbucks or coffee shop. Since it's been a consistent issue I'll go somewhere else and try again in a few months. Maybe something will change :-)

I went to this Starbucks, and one of the baristas there was really rude and passive aggressive. I was confused and she wasn't being very helpful and publicity humiliated me and my friend just because we were confused. Also, drink tastes watery. 
I

Everyyyyyy sinngggllleeeeee timmmeeeee I go they mess something up to the point where they mention it at the drive thru "I know this happens often" uh no every time update your mobile app so orders are current so you don't get pissed off people and have to refund the entire order then provide a courtesy " next ones on us" gift card

Slowest Starbucks I have ever been to.  It took them about 5-6 minutes to take my order, even though there was no line.  After I ordered, I waited for a while to get my drink (they said the drink sticker didn't print).  Not very friendly either.  Barely made conversation and didn't acknowledge my drink until I specifically asked for it (again which would be okay if it was crowded, but it was me and one other guy in there).  I don't know if my standards for Starbucks are too high, but I am used to having much better customer service than this place.  I will say my drink turned out okay so I gave them 2 stars for that!

If you're in a hurry, don't come.  They only do drive thru orders at an efficient pace and inside orders take at least 20 mins if you're lucky, even when they aren't that busy. I mean at least the occasionally communicate why it's taking so long, but you might as well go to circle k because honestly it's not worth it. Some other lady has been waiting for 30 minutes so unless you have all day, don't come.
this is so much different than all the other starbucks i've ever been to. oh my god, have you been here. you totally have to check it out. it's so great.

Great place for a rendezvous as a starter location to meet blind dates.  You can migrate from there if the "interview" goes well.  Nice location next to PF Changs.  Parking is a bitch.  There are not enough lounge chairs.  Those little wooden chairs and tables are not very friendly.  Service is good.

Ok, so I finally had to write a review for this location, because again today I sat in the drive-through for a solid 20+ minutes, YET AGAIN. This is the SLOWEST Starbucks I have ever been to....and I go to A LOT of Starbucks! Whether you go inside or go through the drive-through does not matter, either way is incredibly slow. Do not stop here if you are even slightly crunched for time. The employees are always very nice, so this appears to be more of a management/staffing issue, but they seriously need to get it together here.

Isn't the point of mobile order to get your order in line for preparation?  Twice this week I placed my order 10 min prior to arrival. The app said would be ready in 6-8 minutes both days.  As I entered I noted who was in the regular line.  Both days people who placed their orders after I arrived (about 10 min after I placed my mobile order) were getting their beverages and mine hadn't even been made.  Yesterday my order was ready 20 min after originally placed and today it was 17 minutes.  Very frustrated.  I get it is a busy location....but both days it looked like they were picking and choosing what drinks to make...not necessarily in order placed.  And to top it off today they were out of vanilla syrup at 7:30am...poor planning.

This Starbucks isn't necessarily bad on the inside and I've always received consistently good service, but the parking lot and drive-thru is a clusterf*ck. Who thought it would be a good idea to put a drive-thru here? It's seriously dangerous to people walking and driving. This was not very well thought out. Yes, I know the previous business had one, but it wasn't nearly as busy as this Starbucks to matter, plus that shopping center was nearly all closed.

As far as Starbucks goes, which isn't that far, this one is pretty much as good as you're gonna get. In fact, as a coffee shop it has pretty much everything I need: coffee, ample seating, friendly and fast waitstaff, proximity to delicious eating and drinking establishments (ahem Percy St.), free internet, and a lot of cute girls walking around outside (warning: can be distracting from homework). The bathrooms are clean and don't smell bad, as are the baristas. 

However, the place unfortunately gets docked two points. The first reason, some might say, is really strange and perhaps picky, but I couldn't imagine not mentioning it, as it is something that really bothers me every time I go there. Particularly when it's late out, I am often sitting there happily along with my fellow coffee-drinkers and girl-watchers drinking and watching in peace, enjoying the light music playing on the speakers overhead. The lights are dimmed and we are just enjoying the evening before closing time, when I will stumble into the nearest bar and get my drank on. All of a sudden, the peace is broken by an EXPLOSIVE sound coming from behind the coffee counter. What is this sound? I have no idea. It sounds like someone dropped a 1000lb bag of coffee grinds onto a bass drum. Or perhaps like a 400lb barista just suffered a cardiac arrest and fell into a pile of mousetraps. But let me tell you, my friends, this sound is rather upsetting. And it literally happens at least 2 or 3 times that I've gone there. What the hell are they doing back there???

It's also too cold at night.

Other than those reasons, this Starbucks is above and beyond most that I've been in.

I have been going to this location of Starbucks for years. in the beginning they would zip you in and out real quick so that you could get on to work in less than 5 minutes. Now it takes almost 20 minutes and the order is wrong. I have had this experience several times and finally this morning was the last straw so I am writing this review. I am very unhappy with the service at the drive-thru and it doesn't go any faster if you go inside to order. The baristas don't know how to hustle and evidently don't know how to read because my order is wrong a lot. And they question me like I'm the one that changed my mind mid order. They remake the drinks but then of course that adds more time to the wait. Ugh! So disappointed.

I ordered a Nitro Cold Brew with sweet cream. The first attempt came back as an iced coffee. I returned that and it was replaced with a poor facsimile of the advertised product. I have ordered this drink at least 10 times in the past from other Starbucks and it is always properly prepared and delicious. Please do some training to ensure product delivery that justifies charging $5+ for a coffee drink.

This has to be one of the nicest Starbucks I've been to in the area! In comparison to another store I went to in Tampa earlier last week, this one was a night and day difference! The first thing is this Starbucks is in a stand-alone building, meaning that it has a ton of interior room. The interior has a good mix of warm inviting materials and interesting wall art, which gives the store a nice hip feel. Compared to a lot of other Starbucks locations, this place also has a ton of seating. There's these 2 long high top tables that could seat 8 people located in the middle of the store. Towards the wall, there's  a round high top. Finally, located throughout the rest of the store, there's plenty of standard tables and sofas. This shop is perfect for getting work done as well as just a nice place to hangout with friends. Great experience here!

It's true this Starbucks is truly a night mare when it comes to parking and going thru the line. However good news as they are building a new one out by the high school and SIU WHICH SHOULD DRAMATICALLY REDUCE THE CONGESTION PROBLEM. on the other hand I am more than pleased with the baristas. In particular the lady who normally works the day shift. She's on the ball, in fact remembers my reg order. The best thing you can do is order ahead thru they app. It's always ready and I cut her run thru the drive thru or run in and pick it up. F

This Starbucks is so clean, friendly and has a very nice vibe to it. From the moment I walked in until the moment I left. I love that they have outdoor seating and different kinds of chairs inside to sit. I also love the big drive thru sign -u can't miss that! Love the high ceilings and the newspapers on the tables for you to read. It makes you feel as if you belong.

I regularly visit this starbucks when I am in Boise and every time it is the same thing, the employees are busy talking to each other that you feel like you are intruding instead of being a customer.  If they could change that atmosphere it would be 5 stars.

Worst Starbucks ever! Do not visit. I wouldn't of even given them a star if Yelp didn't make me. I'm here on a Sunday morning when they should be at their best and their baristas are nothing but rude. I ordered 2 drinks both of which have had to be remade at least twice. The barista at the bar thinks she can speak rudely to the customers as well. Make sure not to speak loudly, otherwise you will get yelled at. If you can skip and move onto the next Stabucks I would.

How many times do I have to order decaf before you already have it brewed?   I wish your coffee was awful so I wouldn't be compelled to drink it.  I could just go to Wawa and be happy with their so-so brew.   But no, your fabulous Java (not that house blend, it is awful, I refer to the good stuff, Verona, Sumatra) makes me try again and again.  Yet I am thwarted, every time.  When I order it's like I'm speaking in tongues.  A new word from this stranger, 'decaf'.  What could it mean?  Then the penalty for my individuality is meted out.  Pour over.  Just be a few minutes. Decaf espresso.  Even trying to buy some decaf Verona beans is no longer permitted in store.  Banished to make room for the house swill for the addicted masses.  I hate to love you.
It's bad enough that Starbucks has a one person only bathroom, but this one takes the cake for being the worst! They have ONE bathroom ONLY now! This is so inconvenient when you have to go!

Been here a few times, this is my local Starbucks! While I wish they had a drive through, I've gotten over it and found energy to walk inside! They keep it pretty clean inside and the staff is always nice. 

There is a back parking lot as well as street parking in front.

Went here tonight for coffee for myself and my boyfriend... horrible experience. We came through  the drive thru. The lid was not put on my boyfriend's late properly, he took a sip and it poured all over him and my car. Went back to inform the store/Batista's and was treated poorly. Was told it was not there responsibility for coffee spilled by the customer. I explained the lid was not put on probably and very upset about what happened. He said the were closed and I had to leave. I asked to have a replacement made which I did get plus a refund. I am just appalled by the way I was treated with disrespect by this employee. What's ironic is the person in front of me in the store when we returned was in there because his coffee was made wrong and had to come back also. Obviously there is some room for improvement here and need for customer service training. Will not be back

The app says you can place an order to pick up except that you can't and by the time I got my drink through the drive thru it was cold and so was the sandwich I order I typically like Starbucks but this was ridiculous

First of all, they take FOREVER here...this is the slowest starbucks I've ever been to. On top of that, for my oatmeal it barely had any water in it that top portion of my oatmeal was still dry and not even cooked. Then they didn't even give me a spoon to it eat with.  Im just very disappointed with this Starbucks. I've never had a bad experience with any starbucks until today.

I have just visited this Starbucks location once and have had the java chip frappe. 

The consistency was great. Will go back again

This has got to be the dirtiest Starbucks in Tucson. The floor was full of dirt and pieces of what seemed to be some white debris almost all over the floor. People were stepping on this and carrying it to other places. 

Every single available table needed cleaning and there were a lot of hangers-on concentrating in their laptop and doing maybe homework. Some of these had nothing on their tables that were sold by SB. 

What seemed to be homeless folks just walked in and out to just to walk around. Gladly the restrooms were locked, but any employee could have given them the numbers to get in. Restrooms needed some minor cleaning.

My grande coffee was really a short with foam taking 75% of the cup, the weight of the cup gave it away. Should have complained but I just wanted to get out of there. 

We enjoy SB from time to time and I must say that except for most tables always needing cleaning and folks just using their laptops, this on was a rarity. Thankfully!
There was pretty quick service. The staff was super friendly. The coffee was delicious as usual. I really enjoyed the experience.

I think this is honestly one of the best Starbucks in town and I don't say that because it's next to where I work. The service is always great even when they're in the middle of a rush. I have always had great tasting drinks and awesome recommendations by the baristas. Keep up the awesome work guys!

This isn't my first choice for Starbucks in the area, but it's up there on the list! They seem to stay pretty busy, but any time I've gone in to work for awhile, I've been able to find a seat somewhere - though it's been close once or twice. 

Sometimes the drive thru is slow. Sometimes my order's not quite right when I get it, though it's more a matter of how they make it rather than receiving the wrong item. The parking lot is currently hard to navigate between the pot holes and tight lot space. But despite these few "issues", I enjoy this Starbucks location and keep coming back again and again. The friendly baristas and chill work space make the occasional hiccups worth it.

Starbucks is by far my favorite place for coffee! We have lived in Boise for the past 3 months now and this location is the closest. I honestly have never been to a worse Starbucks. The staff isn't that friendly and the drinks are made terribly. The first time we went I just thought maybe it was an off day but no. We went twice after that and drinks still aren't made properly. I'm not sure why this location has 4 stars but it's definitely not worthy. If you are in this area and think, "Oh great a Starbucks!" keep driving until you find a different one.

Joel rang my boyfriend and I up. First she didn't understand what a venti was. Please educate your worker... We had said it a couple times. We don't have an accent at all. Just a couple of Californians. She was so rude. Please quit your job if you hate it that much. I don't expect her to be all happy to be there. But, talk to us like human beings. We're not aliens.

I'll be completely honest. I'm not a Starbucks fan or even a coffee drinker so my perspective may be slightly skewed towards the unfavorable but I will say that even if I was a huge coffee drinker and fan of Starbucks, this particular location seemed especially sad to me. And here's why.

Take out what you'd normally get at a Starbucks: coffee and your name spelled wrong on the coffee cup by the hipster working behind the register, and what you're left with is the atmosphere and just how the store feels when you're there.

Every time I go to this store to pick something up for my friends, it felt dead. I mean there were people there but it just didn't feel alive. The soft music playing in the background was more depressing than not, the tables and chairs weren't inviting and felt unwanted, even though it wasn't sunny outside, they'd have their curtains drawn halfway which made it even darker inside than it should be. Also every time I go there and there're people sitting at the tables, they'd be speaking softly to each other in a somber mood. I don't know. I just don't like the vibe at this particular spot. I used to work at Starbucks way back in my college days and it was an exciting spot with streams of people, loud music, bright lights, etc. It was inviting and upbeat. This place, I feel like every time I go here I'm intruding in on some funeral.

Alas, this is the closest Starbucks from my home and my friends leech off of me so because I'm so nice (maybe not in this review) I'll probably keep coming here for their drinks.

Parking: Shared lot
Price: What you'd normally pay at a Starbucks
Wait: None

Drive-thru here is really frustrating. First, as soon as you pull up before you can even begin to order they open with a hard-sell "what can we warm up for you to eat", or "can we get you some egg bites". I find this really obnoxious and overkill. Just ask me what I would like and let me take the lead please. Once you do order it's usually slow and half the time wrong. Today the till went down and when I got to the window the barista actually asked me to GIVE HER MY DEBIT CARD so that she could go and tap it in another location without me! When I refused, she then told me to go and park out front and come inside to pay. I handed back my drink and said no thanks, not what a drive-thru is for. Terrible customer service.

Always excellent service ! I stop here often before work nearby and it is one of my favorite locations. Drinks always taste good and even when there's a long drive thru line, it goes quickly. Baristas are always so friendly!
Super standard Starbucks but good staff and clean area. Clayton is super nice to walk around too!
The service is great. The amount of homeless inside and out is really a blight on an otherwise great monument circle experience.
I just spent 23 min in the drive thru here and no free drink coupon offered! Seriously Guys!!@

Popup Party  The four of us went to this location for their popup party. They offered free tall expresso drinks from 1-2. The store was pretty packed, however they were prepared. They had lots of staff and we really didn't wait too long for our drinks. They also offered samples of some of their bakery items. This location is located right off of 465. I will definitely stop here again.

This Starbucks opens until 10pm but when the employees are already annoyed with customers coming in at 9pm, it's hard to feel welcomed. It's a very busy Starbucks. With a lot of students and healthcare employees who live and work around this Starbucks, of course people are going to walk in late. I worked in customer service as well so I understand that it's not a great thing to have people walk in late but that's when it's few minutes before closing. If you hear one employee say 'how are they coming in at this time' and another employee working at the register with an annoyed face, makes you wonder if it was a bad choice to walk in an hour before closing. There were people who walked in right before and after me and I can see the employees' reactions each time and it makes question whether I should be spending money here. It's not the first time I experienced this and I can be sure that it will happen again. I never had problems at any other Starbucks. They need to step up the game here.

As Starbucks go, this place is solidly below par. This assessment is based on below average ease of entry and parking (although the latter has improved with a neighboring business moving out) and more importantly, the staff here is just less friendly than other stores.  

As an aside, it's definitely on the smaller side seating wise, and does not really have any quiet nooks for working, studying, etc if that is important to you.

Bottom line:  it's not horrible, but I try to hit other stores when possible

This Starbucks is much greater than the previous location. 

There are more windows that survey the area. While the seats are not as comfortable as the old location, there is more seating available, both indoors and outside. The inside is much more industrial than the homey feel of the previous location. 

I love that there is a drive through. It makes it super convenient, and not have to drive to the Keystone or Northtowne location to find a drive through. 

Each barista I've encountered has been kind and helpful. Only a couple seemed to be extra bubbly and attentive (I can't remember their names at this time).

I'm thankful for this new location :)

Place is overrun with aggressive homeless ppl. Management needs to run them off. Have compassion for homeless, but don't want to be aggressively panhandled while I'm trying to eat. I'm a gold card carrying Starbucks hard core customer whose Been to many locations across the country and the staff at this location Is really rude. Second visit here they were all talking in front of me, turned their backs to me when I approached the counter and kept taking, and then all walked away and did not take my order. Finally one of them who was taking came back and helped me. Guy who got my food and drink was rude. Won't come back here if in the area.
Pretty disappointed Starbucks. I ordered a Grande Chai Tea Latte this morning & when I opened it up, a quarter of it was empty. Well, that sucks. Next time can I pay a quarter less of the price?

By far the worse Starbucks I have visited, this says a lot as I travel for work, I assumed being just off the interstate that I would be in and out rather than waiting just over 20 mins for a cold brew with a minimum crowd. Needs organization or some management to keep things streamed lined. Hard to expect much from plan city though.

Brand new shop, wasn't too busy when I was here. It hasn't have the upbeat energy like some other more established one just yet. It will get there sooner or later. I do like the big table in the middle btw.

During my travel, this location has been the closest branch to my stay. They have been so accommodating as I am a healthcare worker and I have gone at least three times per week over the past few weeks.Their hours have been cut short 10-6:30pm due to the crisis, but I am grateful that they're still open so I at least come on my days off. Thank you for volunteers coming from other branches just to stay open for this community!

I don't come here often but I had a gift card from last Christmas and happy that I did because I was able to try a delicious drink that I think could become a favorite of mine. 

During a Sunday drive my husband and I decided to stop at this location for some coffee. Soo the drive through line was super long but to our surprise we got through it really quick. My husband had the Carmel frappe and I had the dragon drink. I honestly didn't know what to expect from the drink but being that I didn't have to actually pay for it I said what the heck !!!! LOL 

The Dragon drink it light, refreshing and not overwhelming at all. I expected the coconut milk to be a little stronger. The flavors combined really well and Yes, I would order this drink again. My only hesitation would be getting it from a different location because as we all know different locations make the drinks different and they never really taste the same. 

Our customer service experience gets 5 stars as well as the overall experience

Friendly staff. Convenient location... Often there is a bit of a wait.... My only real compliant is they run out of Cold Brew 60% of the time... Why not plan and make more cold brew? I feel so petty complaining when there are way bigger problems in the world today... this just seems like an easy fix.

Went early in the morning and ordered my drink online but ordered a breakfast sandwich in person. I got my drink in good time because they were not busy but I waited 30 minutes for my sandwich. I waited by the counter once I got my drink to mention that I didn't get my sandwich but nobody said anything to me. When I walked up to the girl to tell her I'm never got my sandwich she told me "Oh our mobile order printer is broken." I told her that I didn't order it online and that she took my order 30 minutes ago she just said "Oh. What's the name?" Usually get great service here but today it just wasn't good.

This Starbucks is normally on point but a couple of days ago I went to get a drink and waited in the line of the drive through for 25 minutes before I got up to the window to get my order. I was so frustrated that I didn't realize that my order was wrong before I pulled off. I tried to go back so that they could fix it but they had already closed 10 minutes early. Online it says they close at 1030pm but the door says that they close at 1000pm.

8/11/19 - My experience today was less than wonderful. A young lady took my order then got her food and drink and went on brake. I had to ask another barista for my cup of tea. Then I asked the first one (while holding HER food) where my sandwich was. She pointed to the barista at the register and said she'll take care of it. The other barista had no clue as to what I ordered. This has never happened here. I quite disappointed  

3/01/19 - Eddie's last day. He has been a plus plus for this location. He will be missed immensely. 

2/12/19 - So disappointed to hear that our wonderful asst manager Eddie The Arizona Pavilions location will be leaving us. 

1/11/19 - VERY disappointed that they didn't have my favorite sandwich today, chicken and artichoke 
11/20/18 - So disappointed today. Not one sandwich in the cooler at 11:15 am 

Once again we are here. Our favorite place. Love our Baristas. Jessica, Treigh, Caleigh, Alex and Taylor. If I've forgotten anyone please forgive me. So many great people work at this location. :) And of co

Wild I'm sitting in this Starbucks and the whole staff is so happy, polite and inviting. It's a breath of fresh air for big chain coffee shops this location makes you feel warm, welcomed and at home. Super sad I'm only in the area for an appointment and not close enough to make this  my local study spot!
I don't think I have to explain this one... my faith in my favorite coffee store is really going downhill recently.
As one who comes from the land of coffee, the home of Starbucks, this is an ok place for coffee.  We're here visiting on vacation and must have our coffee so Starbucks is a must stop.

This is a subpar Starbucks which likely only survives on the business of Marriott guests. I waited 15 minutes for my steamed milk which I had to request twice after the baristas forgot it. My pastry was stale. The bathrooms are a bit hidden. Go outside to the hall, turn left passing the guest gift shop, and continue down the hallway.

Attn. Corporate Starbucks: The employees seem nice but no one seems well trained. The bathroom is a disaster, trash cans in the dining area are overflowing, tables are dirty. Not that busy and took over 25 minutes to receive the wrong drink size, poured into larger cup and was handed a drink with coffee spilled and running down the sides of the cup that was intended to be put in my cars cup holders.

Speaking to someone in line that said she frequently comes to this location she said "this is no where near as bad as last Wednesday"

Unorganized chaos! Much potential but this place needs to be retrained!
Could never understand all the fuss over Starbucks.  Without all the stuff they add to their coffee it tastes like sheep dip.  If you want real coffee go somewhere else.

Wonderful Starbucks that uses the old gas station turned del taco space wisely.

They have a great selection of coffees here including the new rare/exquisite line.  I was able to buy a bag of Jamaica Blue Mountain ($30 for 1/2lb) and was thoroughly impressed by how bold and inviting the beans were.  

The layout of the location is unique as well.  Less outlets so there aren't too many stragglers.  There are a couple larger center tables that multiple students can sit at, but I believe they are meant for more of a social gathering type atmosphere than a study atmosphere. 

This Starbucks also features the Clover brewing system which is a technologically advanced system that seeks to brew coffee at the perfect temperature for the perfect amount of time.  I tried it (it costs about 50 cents more), but I did not taste an immediate difference.  Maybe I should have bought a normal coffee to do a taste test?

4.14.2020 There is a notice on the entrance that the drive thru is open BUT if you place a mobile order, it will be placed in the usual spot near the counter. Ensure you make eye contact with a barista letting them know you placed a mobile order and they will bring it to you. I caught them right as they were about to lock the door and the employee brought my egg bites to me.

One of the better Starbucks in my opinion. They actually keep their outdoor tables clean. (The Starbucks on Hazel Dell has disgusting tables). And the baristas are cool too.  For some reason they have begun locking one of their only two doors before dark. This is a main door and not on an alley so there is no security reason. From the patio to the open door is almost on the other side of the building.  I don't get it. It's 2018 folks, make it convenient for your customers!

Well, we thought we would try this location again. And, once again, tables looked dirty and were sticky, garbage was full and something spilled on the floor (which I pointed out). Took at least 15 minutes to take care of it!

However, it was nice to use a "real" knife to cut my sandwich. Don't think we'll be back here at this location.

I don't know why I continue to patronize the Starbucks... The service has been consistently terrible, the wait is ridiculous, And inevitably they get my order wrong every time. I have wanted to Like Starbucks and this one is a block from my home which I guess is why I continue this insanity. In this era of big business taking over the best that I can do is inform the public and inconvenience myself by refusing to patronize a business that does not seem to respect that the cost of their product is outrageous And requires good service.

I've been going to this Starbucks for years 1-2 times a day., last Friday October 11th 2019 my experience was not good my drink was made incorrectly 3 times! I came back Monday around 1:20 pm and spoke to the shift manager she was EXTREMELY friendly and made my drink exactly how I asked and even gave me a refund! It's great customer service like that that I will continue to come here! Thank you!
Haha, I am not a fan of Starbucks coffee. But if forced to go with out an option of a local toaster.... I would get a soy matcha latte and the bacon egg bites.

This is a new Starbucks in Nj on route 38. It's right. Txt door to PJs and across the street from the Morristown Mall. It's very clean and the staff are pretty awesome. I strolled in around 9:30 on a Saturday evening after going to a banquet. 
I wasn't sure what I needed but I ended up with my go to drink a big passion tea. They close at 10pm in Saturday evenings and has already began cleaning. The bathrooms were clean and I would recommend this location.

What a great way to start a day than a good cup of coffee and a friendly staff that greets you by name.  Just when the emails start rolling in I just twist my cup around and enjoy the hand written "Have an Amazing Day!" Thanks for starting my day with a smile.

I've never been to such a slow Starbucks. Corporate needs to come back in to retrain staff on how to churn through the customers without making each order a successful minute ordeal.  One star; because it's in the hotel there's not even the benefit of relatively clean bathrooms.

This Starbucks always, Always has the nicest staff! Even the store manager always greets me when I come inside. They're also so friendly. Most of the time the line goes by so quickly, especially compared to other Starbucks. I am normally not a fan of pumpkin spice, but I tried their pumpkin spice cold foam. Guys, this is amazing! Thank you so much!

Local new Starbucks opened in less than a week ago (located on Fairview & Steelwood) and is large, bright and ready for business. Lots of seating and space to spread around specially during this pandemic.

I love this spot 
The employees are wonderful 
Sweet professional 
They never mess up my complicated order
The manager is so friendly 
I think she is top notch
You can't go wrong going to this store

Most of the baristas are nice but there is one guy I've run into that is kinda sassy and I cannot tell if it's personality or if it's a displeasurement of being there. I was given a snarky comment when my ordered drink was made hot instead of iced. Which weirdly, the ice was given to me in less than two minutes but the hot took ten? My main issue is this location is really slowing down. Waiting in line for several minutes, 20 to 30? I might as well shut off my car to save gas and the planet. I'm going to start going to the other location on 135 or even the in store ones.
They never disappoint. I had a bad experience at the Algiers location, but this location made up for it.

As we've come to expected with Starbucks there are no issues with their coffee or other items. 

But this place was pretty dirty. The floors needed to be swept and scrubbed in a bad way, and the restrooms cleaned. When we went the men's room was broken, and only one restroom was open everyone had to share.

Never coming back to this location ever again. A mobile order for a white chocolate mocha was ordered at 8:37a and at 9:15a I had yet to see my drink appear. I asked the young man nicely about the status and I was told we are busy and we will get to you. I patiently waited HOWEVER I had to address the young man again after I noticed folks who walked in after me got their drinks before me. I thought the purpose of the mobile order was for my drink to be ready when I showed up maybe I am wrong. I didn't appreciate the lack of customer service experienced and the young man acted like I was being an unreasonable and impatient customer. After waiting over an hour for a mocha I knew it wasn't me. When mg drink was ready they still didn't bother to let me know my order was ready. In the words of Trillville "Neva Eva, Eva Eva" will I go to this location.

I am at this Starbucks ALL THE TIME. I work just north of downtown (between downtown and Germantown. This Starbucks is the nearest coffee shop I can walk to (or a coffee shop inside the farmer's market, but I prefer not to do that). It's in a hidden little area within the Doubletree Hotel. Walk down the diagonal sidewalk thing and you'll find it. The lines can get very long (a lot of state employees frequent this location in large groups), but they're pretty fast most of the time. They also do a happy hour (between 2 and 4, I think), when it's buy one get one free on drinks. It's just a Starbucks, but it's gotten me through many an exhausting day!

This Starbucks is my go-to since it is nearest to my house and they always seem to make my coffee right. My order is simple: a basic White Chocolate Mocha. Today I went through the drive-thru and ordered just that. When I received my cup of "coffee", upon taking a sip, I realized it was literally just hot water and milk. When I walked inside a explained to the barista that it tasted like hot water, she laughed and said that "they were just playing with me" and that "the pump was broken". So, they KNOWINGLY gave me a steaming cup of water out the drive-thru window, fully expecting me to drink it. I'm quite disappointed, this is not the Starbucks customer service I am used to.

Everyone that works here is very friendly. I love coming in in the morning to get my morning coffee and sometimes a nice pastry item. I spent a lot of time here at night to working on my homework and everyone, no matter what shift, is always so friendly and eager to be helpful. This Starbucks is always clean. It is a little small but there are plenty of places to plug in your laptop if you need to.

This morning I enter this Starbucks and the young lady wearing big frame glasses on duty was extremely rude and had poor customer service!!! Please train your employees to be more customer service friendly !!!

This is a super convenient location for downtown commuters who park at Market District garage. It's way to easy to do a mobile order in the Starbucks app and pop into this location on my way to my office on the Circle. 

The baristas are all friendly and make my winter mornings a little bit brighter with their cheerful greetings.

I don't know why I go here when in the area.  There is always something
wrong with my drink!  My double shot today was more milk than coffee,
and way too sweet.  The visit before that, my grande double shot 
was all ice with a third cup espresso.  I was so livid I took a photo
and sent it to corporate headquarters.  They responded with a credit
on my account.  The staff is marginal and always talking among themselves.
Today was my last visit to thus store.  Best store in area is Kirkwood on
Kirkwood Road....always amazing consistent drinks, and the staff is beyond friendly.
This particular location is the busiest yet this morning the service was swift, refreshing, and on point!  I'm picky about my cappuccino and it was made perfect

Stopped by the other day 'cuz I was craving a caramel frap..an old high school fave. I'm not a huge coffee person but I do love the fraps here!! As I'm pregnant snd don't typically drink coffee, I asked how much caffeine was in the drink. The first barista didn't know but was honest and friendly and kindly directed me to a second who was able to tell me. I appreciated the honesty of the first and the knowledge of the second. My frap was great and definitely satisfied my craving!

I adore this Starbucks. I don't live in the area but I come to Yardley every few weeks as my parents still live in the area. The location is great right on Lake Afton although parking can be tough. 

Staff is super friendly and seem to know their regulars quite well. They do a great job of creating that third atmosphere experience (not work or home but the local hangout).

When in lower Bucks County, I prefer this location and store to both Newtown and Big Oak Road.

First try at the blonde espresso and I can say I liked it.  It has a sweeter and smoother taste to it, caffeine wise I cant really tell if it has a stronger kick.  As for the rest it was normal but I like that starbucks is trying out new things with there coffee even when they have 800 different things you can get and then customize on top of that (not complaining). This is a bad location for customer service. I won't go here anymore. The staff acts like they are doing you a favour by pouring your coffee. Avoid this location if you can.

I know how busy this Starbucks can get, so the fact they really get to know and remember their customers is impressive!  Kudos to their customer service.
This place is a homeless shelter, just happy my local starbucks is not like this or I would never go again.
Long wait usually but the staff is super friendly and helpful everytime.  Worth the wait!  Love my starbucks!!!  Even the at home verdions.

My pumpkin loaf tasted like a trip back to the month of October. It was scrumptious!

I love this Starbucks...I always order my coffees with coconut milk and they do such a good job!
