There are two national chains that seem to garner their share of "haters" both for legit and not so legit reasons - Chick-fil-A and Starbucks. Chick-fil-A has obvious concerns politically, while Starbucks seems to garner hate mostly because it's the "big brother" type coffee house that has replaced local, indie-tinged coffeehouses nationwide. 

The truth is, as evidenced by sales, that most of us still go to both places. Chick-fil-A has, hands down, the best customer service in the fast food world while Starbucks is so woven into the fabric of our culture that many people don't say "I'm going to grab a coffee." They say "I'm going to grab a Starbucks." 

I generally try not to review a lot of "chain" businesses on Yelp, but there are times when it's warranted. This is one of those times. 

This Starbucks is located directly on Monument Circle in a building my father once helped renovate. It's on a busy corner and has two entrances.  Both entrances have older, wooden with glass-filled doors that can be a bit difficult to open. They also both have serious lips at the door that can be a bit difficult in wheelchairs. Unless you're downtown already, there's little chance you've come here as a destination because parking downtown is difficult and largely paid. Because this is Monument Circle, a wheelchair user has to also deal with the cinder block sidewalk with certain blocks that seem to always be loose. 

While I'd visited this location before, the truth is that even as someone who works downtown I seldom go as far as Monument Circle from my nearby Government Center office. 

Over the course of a fundraiser/awareness event that lasted around 4 days, I got to know this Starbucks very well as they became involved, almost last minute, in supporting my event. 

Over the course of four days, I was permitted to use their restroom without a purchase (I was staying on Monument Circle 24/7; so this was a big deal). I was also provided water periodically and, a couple times, alternative drinks. The regional director for Indiana also ended up supporting in other ways. 

This location, which is pending a needed renovation as the inside offers no seating but does have window counters, Is a frequently busy location that attempts to manage the chaos in a structured, occasionally stringent way. This area also is frequented by members of Indy's homeless community, most of whom have developed a sort of peaceful co-existence with Starbucks and its mostly compassionate employees who are still tasked with ensuring the business remains safe and responsible. 

Over the course of four days, I witnessed employees who were unified, enthusiastic, fun, efficient, and effective at their jobs. I witnessed a manager, Dawn, who remained aware of what was going on and worked to keep people on task while creating a fun, caring environment. As someone whose work they were supporting, I was greeted by name with enthusiasm, concern, and warmth every single time I entered the place. 

Every time. 

The drinks I ordered were always delivered as ordered, while the one time I special ordered a food item it was also delivered as ordered. The restroom, which is now operated by code rather than key, is a one-user restroom with appropriate hand-rails and a motion sensor hand-dryer. Even when I was really tired, it was easy to use. 

There's no question at its most crowded that it can be difficult to navigate in Starbucks, though for the most part I never had difficulty and found most of the customers cooperative with my mobility. 

While I don't know the details of the upcoming renovation, my understanding is it will make for a roomier, more hospitable experience. Starbucks also offers outdoor seating when it's weather appropriate. However, for a stellar experience over a period of 4 days and warm, enthusiastic support of one lonely activist's endeavor to make his community a safer place for children I'm giving Starbucks a well deserved 5-star review.

When to this Starbucks after having lunch at Pumpernick's restaurant.  There was no line. It was happy hour. My daughter and i were able to get a drink for the price of 1.  Great deal! My drink was made as a requested. I will continue to go to this Starbucks  when I have a craving.

This is my favorite Starbucks to go to in Santa Barbara!!! The staff is what makes this particular Starbucks so great. This location can definitely get pretty busy at times, but the staff are always so friendly and provide wonderful customer service regardless of how busy they are.

Originally, Starbucks offered only two sizes: short (8 ounces) and tall (12 ounces). When the company added grande, venti and trenta, they kept the old names for the original drinks. 

At most Starbucks around the world, the size options are: short (8 ounces), tall (12 ounces), grande (16 ounces), venti (24 ounces), and trenta (31 ounces). Grande is Italian for 'large,' venti means 'twenty,' and trenta is 'thirty'. After a trip to Italy in 1983, founder Howard Schultz became obsessed with its coffee bars and wanted to introduce Italian names. 

As customers demanded larger sizes, 'short' was taken off the menu board so the larger sizes of 'venti' and 'trenta' sizes could be added Tall ended up becoming the smallest sized drink on the printed menu.

There's a nice little patio area and the inside is a little more cozy then some of the other locations. Also, it's a lot cleaner since they're not so hectic. If you're a drive-by girl guy, they have that too. It's pretty easy to access it off of Oracle, and be right back on the road. I like to hang out if I'm going to enjoy some coffee. Give it a try, you might just like it!

I concur with most of the other reviews. This Starbucks is always so slow wether you go through the drive thru or not. This is one I frequent often yet also try to go out of my way to avoid. Again today they messed up my order and are out of regular lids. 
I'm giving it two stars instead of one because the employees were nice and fixed my order relatively quickly.

I've never been the one to review restaurants but Ive never been to such a disorganized Starbucks. 
My order was completely wrong, they forgot to give me my other items and when I spoke up about it they made it seem as though I did not pay for that item. I was just in complete astonishment. The cashier was rude and did not greet me as I approached the register. 
I am so disappointed. I will not return here.

This is my favorite Starbucks because the baristas are always excited to see me. They always make my drinks with love. The store is a very busy location and I've noticed popular times of day are early morning and after school so I avoid those times of day if I can. My go-to drink is a sweet cream cold foam cold brew.

The service here was great and the lady working the drive thru was very sweet and polite considering how busy they get, especially around the holidays.

The decor is very cute, cabin type feel, which is a bit different than the ones near downtown Tampa. I liked it. The drive-thru is a bit tight, so make sure to go slow. 

I ordered a light frapp with soy milk and it came out perfect and yes, this location does Puppucinos! Which is really just a small cup with whipped cream, but there are locations that won't do it. My dogs loved the whip and I loved my frapp. Will stop back to this location next time I'm in St. Pete, because not all Starbucks offer the same level of service.

The staff here are great! I've been coming to this location for over a year now, and I haven't had them ever get an order wrong. They always are very friendly, I've had the drive thru sing to me as I've approached the speaker multiple times. It is a very large location.

Unfortunately it is an extremely busy location. Drive thru lines going back to the street are not uncommon. Due to the volume of business they can be rather slow.

Overall, it's my favorite Starbucks in the area, and I find it worth the occasional delay due to how busy it is.

This review is of the Starbucks inside Green Hills Mall.

I agree it's stupid to review Starbucks but I'm lying awake in agony from the Starbucks tea I ordered at this location. I've never had a bad experience with any body working at Starbucks except this one. There was one young woman there who seemed a little hostile but now I feel she is some sort of cruel demon. I ordered a pineapple black tea and she said she was out of pineapple black tea mix and I should get the green tea mix instead. I said no thanks and just got a chai tea. The next day I stopped by again and asked for the same thing thinking maybe they have restocked. Well, she took my order for it but few hours later I realized it was green tea they gave me without telling me. As odd as it seems, I have a severely bad reaction to green tea and now I definitely friggin know she gave me green tea. I wasn't trying to be difficult when I said no thanks to the green tea suggestion. I must say, if you have ANY sort of dietary restrictions or allergies, do not go to this location. She has broken the food service code of trust and now I'm questioning everything...it will take time to rebuild the trust in the baristas and food service members I rely on to keep me alive everyday. All joking aside, this really sucks.

Drive thru is not slow which is a game changer! Lol The girl was so nice that when she saw my dog she offer us a puppuccino without even asking! Great service and nice location. Loving their Peppermint mocha latte!
This location is a gem. The baristas are always happy and nice and I love how they remember me when I come in. Between 9:00am -10:00am they get pretty busy but don't worry, they work fast!

ALWAYS SLAMMED. No matter the time of day you come here it is packed! The drive thru is the worst design and it is also the tiniest parking lot. It is the only Starbucks off of I4 from Tampa to Lakeland  so that's super annoyed. But like always the drinks are good, I've never had to complain about that. Would love to give this place 5 stars but I can't due to the fact that it's a pain to maneuver around and the layout is awful.

I visit this Starbucks a couple times a week--I only use this one because of convenience on my way to work. It is consistently the slowest Starbucks I have ever visited. It often takes 10 minutes or more in the drive through. They are in absolutely no rush. In addition, half the time I order they have run out of whatever I'm ordering. If you are crunched for time, you may want to drive out of your way to visit another--you'll probably save time in the long run.

Easily the slowest Starbucks in Brandon. Don't plan on less than 10 minutes before you have your coffee, even if it's an easy cup of black. Doesn't matter what time or day, it's always slow. I've waited 20 minutes on several occasions.

This Starbucks is great. They are fast and always polite but we have had some trouble with a few of their workers recently being mean to my mom and myself when we order. They have said things under their breath or laughing behind our backs. 

This does not happen every time we go though. It's a standard Starbucks and doesn't really stand out on any special. Just know that they may be a little slower due to the popular choice of drive-thru there.

First negative review for Starbucks. I will be contacting the store. To begin I am not an avid Starbucks drinker or coffee drinker. I go occasionally for their frappes or iced teas. I am currently pregnant and drinking a lot of caffeine is not recommended especially if your body is already not used to it. I went today craving an iced coffee and request a decaf iced coffee. They said they don't have that and instead recommended an Americano. Again, I am not an avid coffee drinker so I'm not familiar with this drink but it sounds like it has a lot of caffiene. So I clarified that I am pregnant and cannot have a lot of caffeine, is this drink low in caffeine. The girl said yes. So I pull up to the window and I clarified once more that here is minimal caffeine and she said yes our decaf is minimal caffeine. 

I get to work and take 3-4 sips over the course of 30 minutes. I begin to feel a head change and quickened heart rate. I have not had much caffeine at all these past few months so I begin to worry. I look up the details and turns out Americano is espresso & Starbucks no longer offers decaf drinks after 12pm and their "decaf" is watered down espresso. 

I am completely upset by this for being misled. Fortunately I barely drank any but caffeine can really harm your pregnancy is you have too much especially when you are not a regular coffee drinker. This was not ok.

I tried to do some work here today and I couldn't even with ear buds on.  Maybe I should have brought my larger surround sound headset instead.  

One of the reviewers who said that there a lot of ladies from nearby who like to talk really loud and obnoxiously to draw attention to themselves or talk loud on their phone inside was spot on.  I left this afternoon after about 30 minutes after this couple of bleached and Botoxed middle-aged women with their trendy yoga pants were way too loud at the table next to with a seemingly never-ending torrent of petty complaints, gossip about other women and their kids, and name-dropping.

I came here for some coffee and to get some work done.  Not a headache.

I will NEVER go to a Starbucks again!!! Constantly screwed with their erratic app. Starting to screw up a lot of orders. And their practically inaccessible to communicate with. NEVER follow through on committments......
I really loathe this company and have made it a personal mission to dissuade as many people as I can to ever support this company

My wife and i went here this morning. There was an obviously "disturbed" man sitting at a tall table near where we sat down at the large community table. I quickly noticed he was staring first at my wife and then at me. I looked away and when i looked back he was still staring. We moved to a far corner of the store. After awhile he stopped staring and began having a nice conversation with himself and making odd hand gestures. Yes he is probably harmless.

My main complaint is that when we brought this to the store's attention the response we received was "oh yeah.he is a regular here.Its his safe zone and he is harmless" Very nice and caring. However i think when you are a paying customer (and we have been going to Starbucks for over 15 years here and in Seattle) you are entitled to a peaceful environment.
I thought the store response was inappropriate and unprofessional. We told the store we will not return and they seemed unconcerned to say the least. I have seen similar situations in our Seattle Starbucks handled professionally and in a proper safe manner. 

This place needs some customer service training/upgrades for sure!

My first, and hopefully only, 1 star review. 

I have no idea why I keep coming back to this Starbucks. 80% of the time it's a frustrating experience.

Some of the people that work here need customer service training and the ones that are friendly always seen flustered or like they are ready to implode. 

Everytime I come here another customer waiting next to me comments on how disorganized this place is. So many people behind the counter and popping in and out from the back. Yet it takes forever to get a drink, or get one right, usually you have to  just take it and like because it's your Saturday.

One person on the register and yes they hsve a drive thru and in app ordering, however,  other Starbucks do it well, so it's not how it has to be. 

Today I tried a new drink,  not made correctly and when I stated it was incorrect they offered to remake it. Ok great, if that would have happened. 

I was about to leave when I thought the barista who poured milk into a cap that dripped down his fingers was for my drink, gross, then I realized mine wasnt even started. I should have told the guy who grabbed that drink to stop because it had finger cream in it. 

10 minutes later I had to ask if I was going to get my drink. First attitude and then "What are you waiting for". I got my iced drink and went outside,  it was slapped together like a last minute science project. 

I would suggest an alternate Starbucks,
Never answer the phone, also they are very rude and ugly every time I go there. I don't recommend going to this location.

Less than acceptable experience w/Jeremy C. this AM - Jan 1, 2021 at 10:03, as they were not busy and I was simply looking to get coffee and breakfast for two on vacation. No matter how polite I was, the guy was curt & condescending repeatedly. I'm from the South and I'm on vacation in the South. Is it too much to expect someone to be polite while I order - even during Covid times?? It was ridiculous and Jeremy should find a new job!
This Starbucks is close to my house and can get very busy if you just come to the store. The line takes forever so best bet is to perfect on the app and pick it up which I do and is more convenient.

It's the only Starbucks that's downtown and not inside a Casino but it's hard to get into because of the street configurations. The drive thru had a u inquest design too. It's not easier parking and going into one of the casino Starbucks so this is the best choice. I always order blonde coffee so I can't complain the service was fast.

Kindness!  One of my kids cut their knee on the monument and the staff was amazing!  Not only did they have a Band-aid, but they gave each one a cup of water!

Great staff and they found the time to care while serving customers!  Busy place~awesome location!

This stored used to be Great and have awesome employees who made great drinks. WHERE did they go? Every drink I've ordered since has been awful. I've ordered no ice and watched them fill to the brim with ice and give it to me when the sticker literally
Says no ice. They don't care. They make awful drinks. I don't pay 5,6,7 dollars for a mediocre at best drink.
Awful

This Starbucks is super convenient to me but parking is not ideal. This location is usually very busy so tables are prime real estate. This location is also highly frequented by the homeless which is not usually a problem unless they are soliciting money. The staff is usually friendly and courteous but this location is never very clean. The floor rarely looks swept or mopped. The bathrooms are not maintained very well throughout the day either.

My favorite coffee place, they stay busy but they are always FAST and get my order right! Great staff, The employees are so FRIENDLY and really care about doing a good job. If you ever can't decide what to get , just ask one of the employees, their faces just light up as they pair you with your perfect drink!

There was a customer inside Starbucks that had a dog the entire time I was there... when I was getting my drinks another customer walked in with a dog. While I was heading to my car there was someone else walking towards the Starbucks door from the parking lot with their dog. 

NOT a single employee asked if either customers dog was a service animal. Honestly it's gross... you are a retail food facility! Completely against Santa Barbara county health code regulations. In a matter of 10 minutes 3 dogs. Maybe I should put a call into The county health inspector.

Let me tell you about the tea!!
I quit drinking coffee and pretty much all caffeine in April of 2015.  I still love the aroma of a coffee shop, but I have to find an alternate beverage.
The barista was very helpful in assisting me with my choice of tea.  There is a menu card and the ones with 0-4 black dots beside them indicate the caffeine level. 
I ordered the Youth Berry.  She puts 2 teabags into a grande cup.  It was ruby red in colour and smelled heavenly.  I'm not a huge fan of açaí  berry, but it was surrounded by enough other stuff that it was merely enhanced, not overpowering.
Service was swift and friendly.  It was steady traffic, but not crowded.  Miss Laini and I had a lovely visit :)
One thing with the ladies washroom.  We are not sure that the locking mechanism works.  We did not actually test our theory.  Just a hunch.

Used to be my favorite SB to go to! Now the staff changed or management or something because getting a drink in the drive thru is about the most frustrating thing u can imagine. I have been in like for 25 minutes before! Don't let the number of cars in line fool you. That doesn't seem to determine your wait time. I hate that it has declined in efficiency and staff friendliness. There are other SB around and actually have had more success getting out of my car, walking into target getting the drink and leaving than sitting in the drive thru line at this one!
I had to run in and out but managed to grab a couple of cake pops on the go. Staff was friendly; took forever to get a simple cup of ice water and the cake pops were warm :-(

I love this Starbucks location! It's definitely roomier than most, with plenty of varied seating options in close proximity to outlets or with outlets built in to the furniture itself. There's also plenty of "group seating" that would enable larger groups the space to work, study or meet. 
Service is always fast and professional, and in the 10-12 times I've been here, I have only ever had positive experiences. 
The space is super clean and shelving is all well organized. I can tell that the management and employees take pride in keeping their location in beautiful condition. 
The walls are decorated with St. Louis themed memorabilia and the lighting fixtures are super fun. I really like the way they worked with the unique building space to create an open, welcoming vibe. This is also one of the few Starbucks locations in the area that stays open till 10pm, so if you are in need of a late night study spot, this is it!

Went to this Starbucks this morning.  Placed my drink order... My name was never called so I went up to check on my beverage... sure enough it was sitting there my hot drink was cold! The Barista didn't bother to ask if I wanted it remade. Terrible customer service.

Returned back for a meeting and was surprised that this Starbucks has done away with the tables and chairs. I asked a barista what's with the change, she said that this location was a type of special cafe that's been used in France. I'm pretty sure that management has done away with the tables and chairs so that they can deter the homeless guys to escape from the cold and irk customers. The standing thing is just too awkward and it really doesn't give you much room to have a meeting with coworkers. Your best bet for studying, meetups and meetings is to go to either the Mass Ave. location or the one near Whole Foods.

Contrary to what was written above I've just spent 30 minutes waiting in the drive-through line at Starbucks here. 
I never posted that one until my next visit where I have not moved for 8 minutes in line.  Now up to 12 minutes.  Can't move and I'm in a hurry. Have not progressed one inch. People have come and gone from inside.  There we go. 13 minutes to move one car length.  Two minutes for the second car length. Then improved pace.

RUDE!!!! The girl taking my order was plain rude. I explained to her how I want to order food and a coffee however my card is never accepted at this location. I go to other starbucks' almost everyday. She said "that's not my fault we can't give you anything then" and pretty much shooed me away. I was so upset never coming back here.

Date of visit 04-24-2019:

I stopped into this Starbucks for a drink after driving out to Tampa for dinner celebrating my birthday.  I usually try to skip & forget that one day of the year that references to my age and that time waits for no one.

I walked into this location and was immediately greeted by 2 or 3 employees with a friendly "Welcome to Starbucks", which I have never experienced at none of the other locations! It was around 11pm and coffee shop was moderately busy and most of the seats were taken by folks actually drinking their coffee and talking to each other and not distracted by some form of electronic device.

I walked to the counter and explained to the employee  (I think it was Amy) that it was my birthday and I wanted to place an order for a Java Chip Frap. She wished me a happy birthday with a smile, asked for my favorite Starbucks Gold card. Other employee's heard her and also made a point to stop what they were doing and say happy birthday! I think its the most happy birthdays that I have ever got in one day :) ! It only took the employee a few minutes to get right on my drink making it and in my hands with another "I hope you have a wonderful birthday", which I really appreciated!

The store was very neat and the floors looked like they were just mopped, hard to believe with the amount of traffic that was in the store. The counters were stocked and everything was in place. If I didnt live 30 minutes away I would make this my new favorite Starbuck (Store cleanliness 5 stars). The Ambiance was really nice and laid back, there wasn't any loud music and the other customers didnt have to yell to talk to each other. I got the vibe that I could sit and just chill which I will make a point to do next time I pass by! Thanks for the great experience.

Not my favorite Starbucks 

I ordered a iced venti decaf sugar free caramel latte.  When I got my drink it was definitely not decaf (believe me I can tell). But the barista insisted it was decaf.  We went back and forth with this until he offered to remake it.  I then got my new drink and I noticed this one had 2% milk while the original was fat free.  I tasted it, no flavor.  He finally added more caramel and it was then ok, not great.

I don't like what this store looks like either.  Felt crowded and cluttered. Staff was nice but I doubt I would be returning to this particular store.

Interesting location! And interesting how people here look very wealthy. This is a great addition because there is a Target, Petsmart, and bank here. I came here because I went to my nearby apartment to pick up some stuff and dropped off my dog at Petsmart to get groomed. Now it's the waiting game.... so I decided to shop and then cozy up to some coffee here at Starbucks. Everything is clean, spacious, and bright! The ceilings are so high up, it makes the place feel more roomy. It's busy here, but not too busy. Staff here make sure you are being helped as well. Bathroom is very clean and well-lit. They might need more seating, but that's all I can say for now.

I'm not usually a Starbucks guy.    I wanted a coffee and was on the way to visit friends; if I showed up with one coffee, I'd have to put up with sad puppy dog eyes, so I stopped at the local Starbucks.  There really aren't that many other options in the suburbs of West Edmonton. I actually think the coffee and the espresso are pretty average and certainly not worth what they charge for it.  But, this stuff is way popular and well branded.

I mean walk into a real Italian café and try that Tall, Grande, Vente thing and watch the retarded child look you're going to get.  Only Tall means something to a European barista and it ain't what you get a Starbucks.  A "tall" coffee is a single expresso made with twice the normal amount of milk as a "short".  It's not a "size"; it's more volume because you're asking for more milk versus the more common "short".  Similarly at a bar, you can ask for your highball in a "short" or "tall" glass; same drink, more mix.

If they get that much wrong, how good can the coffee really be?

The really annoying thing is that this location has a drive-thru window.  Who's brainwave was that?  They have customers both inside and outside and one barista.  So, guess what?  There is a long suffering line in front of the counter and one snaking around the building.  Additionally, you have no real sense of where you are in line or when you can reasonably expect your order to come up.  The staff look stressed out; the bartista definitely is and there isn't a customer with a smile on their face for a good thirty paces.

Oh, what a good time.

I stopped in for a coffee and this was the filthiest Starbucks I have ever visited. The shelves where normally to-go cups are sold were barren and full of dust. The food cabinet where pastries are kept had handprints all over it and there were maybe 5 pastries in the whole cabinet. The refrigerated section under the pastry cabinet was empty and overall the place was disgusting. I was itching for a coffee and the one woman making specialty coffees looked frazzled despite the fact that it was 2 in the afternoon. I grabbed a reg coffee vs getting a specialty coffee made. Even that was a mistake. The bar where you add milk and sugar looked like it had not been cleaned in a long time and there was only a small amount of half and half out. No milk, no skim. Its a shame. I will not be revisiting this location again.

This *newer* location is across the street from my parking garage. This location is much more spacious compared to the one on the circle and the staff is friendly and efficient. The store is also clean and well organized. 

I never wait too long, even when I order an espresso beverage.

They also seem to be very welcoming with the homeless community downtown.

This is one of my favorite Starbucks. It is a convenient location. Lots of businesses we use are close by it. The one down side about the location is that it's busy so it is sometimes hard to park. The drive thru is accessed between buildings and could be easily missed. 

The workers, however, are always friendly and helpful. They are quick. They are always efficient. The store is near and clean. I stopped on Christmas Eve while out running a last minute errand. I was nervous about stopping on a holiday like that. The drive thru moved quick and the workers were more than friendly and made my Christmas Eve great!

A busy morning at SB but everyone is still friendly and wearing smiles.  Place is clean. Just here writing for a few hours.  This really is a new space and bigger than other SB.  Thanks for adding this location.
Wow. The worst Starbucks ever. A 33- minute wait and two of the three drinks were wrong.

Across the street from Golds Gym. Don't blink or you'll miss it. Numerous wall outlets, a plus for us battery life challenged. Quite an impovement over many stores with only one or two outlets! Counted 4 on the west and south side for 3 tables.

Although there are several Starbucks locations around the country that are open 24 hours now, this location will always be the original "24 hour Starbucks" to me. Located conveniently right off of the I-4 at the Thonotosassa exit, this place is a must stop if you are making that typical trek from Orlando to Tampa or vice versa. Why, you ask? Well, because there is delicious coffee and tea, clean restrooms, and delectable pastries. Really, what more could you ask for? There is even a drive-thru for added convenience! 

The size of the Starbucks is ideal--room for casual seating and lounging, but not so huge that it's overcrowded and crazy. I think the drive-thru option helps prevent that. Also, the location right off of the I-4 (note the GIANT Starbucks sign over the highway), makes it easy to pull in and out of. I've never experienced any problems here, and also I associate it with roadtripping across Florida, so...5 stars!

I have been to this Starbucks on 4 separate occasions and they have managed to mess up every single order, every single time! Unfortunately, I never have the time to go back and get my correct order because I'm either on my way to work or something. 

One of the times, we ordered 5 drinks and used our gold card to get the 5th drink free.The cashier drained all of our points when they were only supposed to reveal the free drink. They also did not correct the mistake!! 

Terrible service, but I will go back again another time. Hopefully they're better the next time I go.

Rude, stupid teenage employees. I asked specifically for a pour-over, because their coffee was stale. Kept telling me it would take 10 minutes. I finally said, never mind. And walked away, and she says, whatever

Pros- They had good service and free samples ( I had a chili latte of some sort that was quite interesting)

Cons- The parking is difficult and limited. Also, it is basically located a few yards from a busy highway on ramp, so getting out of the lot into traffic is a little busy at times. I just went out the exit towards the local roads to avoid this problem.

My friend and I visit this location often while on our way to Orlando. My order (iced caramel macchiato w/ blonde espresso) always tastes bland and watered down compared to when I get it at other locations. A lot of times this location is out of stock of items. My friend once had to order three different drinks before they had it in stock. We always go through the drive thru and a lot of times the barista doesn't wipe my drink off or forgets straws. The line is usually really long as well.

This location never understands how to make drinks with any other milk other than dairy.. they get confused and just put dairy in it anyways... for the pumpkin cold cream all you need to do is add the cold brewed coffee, the vanilla sweetener and then foam almond milk.. you do not need to add dairy at all. The person getting the almond milk just wants the almond milk splash, we don't want a lot of milk and like the drink not as sweet. What is so hard?  just don't add dairy milk...

This is my local Starbucks. I am a frequent visitor. Only through the drive-through of course since I have kids. The drive-through is fast and efficient. Which I greatly appreciate with two screaming babies in the car. Several times I received less than adequate customer service from a rude barista. But overall in general this is a pretty good Starbucks.

This location is consistently unavailable for ordering ahead during a time (pandemic lockdown) when you can only order ahead. They got my drinks right the two times that I was able to order of the six or more times that I tried.

Wonderful! Our dogs eye got scratched by a cat, so we took him to a local animal hospital. It took a long time to get him (3 hours), so we got some Starbucks to get us through. We stopped by, and this one lady was SO nice! She sent us prayers for our sweet puppy, and was very polite! Our food and drinks were made in under a minute, and the service was amazing! Would recommend going here!

This Starbucks used to be a great Starbucks, but much has changed in recent years. It used to be wide open. It no longer is. There is too much clutter throughout the store. There is too much going on as you reach the counter. It is not really stroller friendly either. 

The only reason I come here anymore is because it is the default mobile ordering location for me. It is walking distance as well, but I would rather go to the Cheshire where the layout is much better.

I rarely go to this Starbucks location but it was on my way to Mass Ave and I was trying to complete a bonus points challenge. My New Years Resolution was to give up Starbucks. So far  - it's not going that well! I got in the long drive through line that moved Very Slowly. The car behind me bailed out. But of course eventually I got up to the window and got a cold brew drink ( to check off another bonus stars requirement) and used 50* to get a sweet treat (pumpkin bread - it's delicious). The barista was very friendly and both my drink & the pumpkin bread were good.

It's a ubiquitous Starbucks, but the staff is friendly and keeps the line moving when the place gets crowded. 

The place makes great use of space and there's plenty of seating both indoors and outdoors.  

They even have a space reserved for mobile orderers in the parking lot.

This starbucks is really good, the best part is some of the employees have gotten to know me over time and now they know what to order before I even get to the counter. So if thats not great service I don't know what is.

The Goods
Cannot function without a latte.
Leboulangerie is the new bakery and it is much better than before 

Ambiance
1. I like the faint lights in the ceiling kind of rustic chic

Service 
1. These people know me all the time!!!  Remember me by name!!

MoJo
1. Anything drink, I love them all but sugar free coffee is my fav

I've been hesitant to leave a review because I know every company has their bad days, but now it's been 5-6 times and I can't dismiss it anymore. I stop at this location's drive thru on my way to work most mornings and quite few times I'm greeted with, "What do you want" instead of the usual "Welcome to Starbucks.." greeting. I typically order multiple things, and many times I've been cut off after the first item in my order with, "Alright your total is ___, pull around" even if I wasn't finished. After getting my order at the window, I rarely get a "Have a good one" or anything, they don't say a word. No smiles or anything. I just feel like I'm bothering the employees by being there. They all look irritated. I'll probably start going to the one closer to my work from now on.

This is the best places for food ever I come here whenever I can someone to take me I'm 9 so I can't drive but if o could I would drive everyday even though it takes 30 minutes to 1 hour. Best place ever

Good morning Yelpers. So for those of you who follow me you know that coffee is a must for me every single morning. Typically I go to the Starbucks near my home but today I had an early errand so I stopped by the Starbucks near the Brandon mall. 
This is a very, very nice Starbucks. not only was the area inside clean but there was an area outside, a very big area, that was also well kept and clean. they have a lot of umbrellas outside to keep those who want to sit out in the Sun shaded.  I was very impressed that outside there was no trash in a sitting areas and all the tables we're wipe down and clean.
As with all Starbucks I was greeted when I first walked in and my coffee was served quickly and it was just the way that I like it. I will definitely be returning to the Starbucks.   :-)

I love Starbucks but this neighboorhood Starbucks is as good as it gets. The employees are friendly, the atmosphere is peaceful and the product is wonderful. Next time you make a visit to the Delmar Loop check it out and get a Vanilla Bean Frappicinio with Carmal sauce.

always super sweet and actually makes drinks in reusable cup and doesn't make it in plastic then dumps it into reusable one also never had a drink made incorrectly, but a great place to spend your time studying or working!!!

You have one of the rudest kids employed at this location. Slamming things like a child,  then places an empty cup and says NOTHING.. 10 min later I walk up to the register to see why my order is incomplete and all I get is oh we're probably out of that.. um ok then COMMUNICATE to the PAYING CUSTOMER.  Rude and unprofessional.
Worst Starbucks I have ever been too every time I've gone service is always good but the drinks are terrible tastes like burnt coffee every time
