Very slow, always busy and the drive through always seems to be lined up through the parking lot. I should stop coming here because the last two times I waited 15-20 minutes in the store for one drink.

Not my favorite location. Ordered my drink in the drive thru. Pulled up to the window, no hello, no how are you... I was pouring out a diet soda on the ground. He talked to me as if I were his small child in a rude voice saying "next time can you not do that. It attracts bees and I have to clean that". Luckily it was diet and bees don't care about aspartame. 
I would've been understanding and apologetic about that if he had been kind from the start. I believe his name was Andrew. Those are the only words he said to me the whole time at the window. Yikes.

I usually go to this Starbucks all the time and the line is always long and was today. A man pulled out of the line in front of me and when I got up there they almost gave me the wrong food but I said something and she still charged me for his order even after I said my bill should be lower. I didn't wanna even argue since I just simply asked why it was so high for a coffee and Pastry. But I paid $5 more even after trying to fix it. I was just aggravated and over it so I left. Probably just going to go to the other one from now on, this isn't the first time this has happened.

I have lived in the Feldmans neighborhood for 18 years. I have always believed this intersection needed a coffe house. Now we have one. I can sit out on the patio and watch the world go by. I don't care what anybody says about Starbucks. They have what I want...good strong coffee.
Quick and pleasant service! Conveniently located RIGHT by where I always park!

Worst customer service ever!! Not sure what was going on with the cashier but regardless customers deserve to be treated with respect. Something was going on with the phone order system and wasn't working properly so when I placed my order I wasn't aware that my order went to the store on mass ave instead of this store (I live in the 360 tower, so when I order it automatically goes to this store). I was standing by the door with my puppy for my order and the cashier rudely stated that dogs weren't allowed in the store and that the online system wasn't working. She asked what I ordered and asked that I show her my receipt- all this over a grade coffee.

I have been there multiple times and the managers have treated me horribly. I didn't want to write a review about it but recently I've tried my luck again and ran into an issue! The barista Moe really helped me out, how is it that a barista is way more professional and more for helpful to me than your management? I recommend you have kind people that are good with customer service in a management position rather than people that refuse to help you. Thank you for the help Moe I will be back because helpful barista's like you!

Super service since reopening after a small remodel at the end of May. Today I tried the Spinach and Feta Wrap. It has egg whites, diced tomatoes, feta and spinach. It would be better with sundried tomatoes. The wrap was a bit drippy from the diced tomato. Sundried you wouldn't have that issue plus you'd have a bit of sweet with savory. Get on that Starbucks chefs.

Anna! 5 Stars! Give this young lady a promotion! Wonderful customer service! Stopped in for a large iced coffee black unsweetened and I had my son in the back seat, he's ten months old! A little terror! But oh that coffee! Hot damn! So good! Allright!
The staff is rude and the location has no power outlets. How does a coffee shop not be equipped for tele commuters? Do not visit this location!

When you travel on the road, I don't know about you but I'm always looking for a little something familiar in the morning. Ok, I couldn't stand the coffee at the hotel, so swung on through for a cup of Sumatra!

This Starbucks was right on the way. I went in, it took 3-minutes for someone to get to me (not that anyone was in line ahead of me, just they were messing with a couple of baked items for the Drive Thru!), and I was out. -1 star for the prolonged wait time.

Ahhhh Starbucks... What did I do before you?

It's a little heartbreaking to see the parking lot in such disrepair after this winter... it was never bad before, but now you need to weave your way around potholes and piles of crumbled blacktop.

The service here has always been amazing. Their regular managers and baristas are friendly and very accommodating. Sara takes the drive thru orders with such pep that it brightens my day before the first sip of coffee.

I can't tell you how many days I have gone to this Starbucks and spent 3+ hours working on lesson plans or grading. I know every Starbucks seems the same, but there's just something about this store and the people that work there--I always get more done!

This is an awesome Starbucks, as far as Starbucks go. Super friendly and accommodating staff who will get to know you by name and make your drink while you are first spotted walking in the door, awesome little back porch sitting on beautiful Lake Afton, good crowd, lots of seating options. Can get busy at lunch, but you can usually find a seat.

This Starbucks is the worst Starbucks in the Tampa Bay Area! 
They close whenever they want... I've tried coming multiple times, and it's been closed during their "business hours". 

Also they are the SLOWEST ever. I waited in line 30 min for our order. When I got my order - they handed me my drinks in a drink carrier. In the carrier were to VERY HOT americanos... neither of them had stoppers in them. Sooo the HOT americanos were leaking naturally- and extremely hot water spilt all over my legs burning me. 

The girl in the window told me it was her third day. Makes sense. Because there was 0 customer service... and clearly she had no idea what she was doing 

Absolutely ridiculous.

Dropped by this Starbucks drive-thru to partake in their new Toasted Graham Latte, which by the way is pretty good.

I didn't get the opportunity to go in to the store, so this review is based solely on my experience in the drive-thru; I found the employee to be quite friendly as with efficient, barely had a wait for my drink to arrive.

One thing I did notice was how small the parking lot area for the Starbucks is due to the other surrounding businesses, so it can be a bit of a pain when you're trying to exit the drive-thru and there's a variety of people trying to park, find a spot or get out of one.

Nevertheless, I'd definitely come back!

Friendly one-man staff, and great outdoor seating with a nice view... what more could you ask for. Stopped in after finding out that my flight got delayed. Hard to find even with GPS. almost passed it. Ample indoor seating, clean, and quaint. The employee didn't seem racist... but then again we didn't sit down first, we ordered so I guess we'll never find out if they would have called the police.

Terrible place, go to the Starbucks in Fredmeyer.... Always a wait because they usually can't give the customer the right drink or food. Just go to the one inside Fredmeyer it's faster and more efficient than the one near McDonalds....

Coffee is coffee to me so maybe not fair to judge but this location of Starbucks just had too many people that seemed to be using this as their early morning place for hygiene.  A small line at the bathroom and the place was a little unkempt compared to the SB I went to about a mile away the previous morning.  This is a good location.  Very convenient and did not have time for the extra distance.

When I came in they were short staffed and incredibly busy, when I went to get my drink another person took it and ran off before I could stop them, but the barista saw and immediately remade it for me. A long wait should not negate human decency.

Best Starbucks EVER!! Staff is amazing - Ginger, Nick, Melissa, Jeff, Nelson, Molly (this is the usual group of peeps I see in the morning). I drive from TPA to St. Pete for work and refuse to get my drink on my side of the Bay because I have to go to this location. They know me - heck they even know when I'm in bad mood. Amazing customer service. A M A Z I N G

Nothing I can say about Starbucks that has not been said already.   The coffee is excellent and the service is wonderful.  On this particular day,  I purchased an ice tea because it was hot and was walking around downtown Indy.  The ice tea was refreshing.  I can always appreciate Starbucks whenever I have a craving for coffee.   It is terrific and makes me feel good.  A great pick-me-up in the morning!

Staff worked slowly and managed their workflow poorly. They took several orders from different customers and started making them all, but they waited to give the orders until they completed everyone's. The cashier took our order and my wife wanted to change the size of her drink. The cashier became irritated with us for changing. This would have been understandable if we had paid already but all she had to do was change the order, but she was clearly bothered by this extra work we demanded of her. 

Lots of untrained and inefficient staff with poor customer interactions.

First time here in a long while. The drive thru was packed but moved quickly. The woman working the drive thru was incredibly nice, funny, and cool. The imposible breakfast sandwich is my go to meal, and I came to this location because the one near me is closed due to Covid19 . This visit took my day from a 6/10 to a 9/10. 

Also, if you haven't already definitely try the impossible breakfast sandwich.

Always a fan of this Starbucks.  As a former employee of GreenHills (Cheesecake Factory) I have frequented this Starbucks on many occasion!  

I'm glad that the spirit of Starbucks shines through at this location, even though it's probably owned by GreenHills mall.  On my recent visit, I offered my coupon that I received via email from Starbucks for a free Frapp, and while it wasn't valid the guy still honored it and sent me on my way with a smile.

That my friends was worth smiling about!  Thanks!  I'll take another tall Americano, please!

One of my favorite Starbucks in town. My basic qualifications for a coffeehouse are met or exceeded here: 

1. Coffee- Good. 
I far prefer Starbucks to Second Cup, which tastes as if it's been strained through sweaty gym socks. 

2. Traffic- Busy, but not horrifically so. 
It can be loud sometimes, but that's what earphones are for. 

3. Writeable- Yes! 
I'm not one of those people who always grab the cushy chairs in front. I'm one of those people who grabs the outlet in back for my laptop, because I need the table space to spread out and work on my novel. 

The baristas are friendly and they work pretty fast. For the first year or so I was in Canada, I couldn't work yet, so got quite used to coming here in the morning for several hours and getting lots of writing done. It still has that special vibe for me, and I tend to get more (and better) work done here than anyplace else. I'm in trouble if it ever closes!

This location is the slowest ever to the point it is just ridiculous. Multiple visits prompted this review.  If you're in a hurry, better off going to the Target down the road that has Starbucks inside.  Consistency in the taste of the product (latte) is not there either.

This is my all time favorite Starbucks. Sometimes when you have a harder drink order, with substitutions and what not, the taste of the drink varies on a daily basis depending on who makes it. This Starbucks is the ONLY Starbucks to constantly make my drink correctly and tasty. The employees always have such a great attitude, even when they're busy and running around all over the place trying to get you your drink as fast as they can. This Starbucks always actually HEATS UP my food. So many times other stores will 'warm up' my sandwich, but it's done so half ass that my bread it still tough. If you've had a bad experience at a Starbucks I most definitely recommend trying out this location to make the experience right.

As much as I try to make coffee at home, some days you just need Starbucks. I knew I had a busy day at work today so I decided to stop for a pumpkin spice latte. It's a little earlier than I usually get one in the season but there are no rules anymore so why not.

Pre-Covid, I used the app a lot and would send in my order as I was leaving my house and it would be ready to go when I arrived. Starbucks was closed for for awhile and then finally opened back up, but I have just been using the drive-thru since then. Both ways are equally quick and I get in and out quickly. 

The staff are very friendly and genuinely seem like they want you to have a good day. I would say that is true for all Starbucks locations but this is the one I frequent the most.
Always have relatively quick service and their employees are very friendly and with great customer service.

My drinks never taste as good as at other locations. I don't know why this one keeps falling short. The staff isn't as friendly or courteous, either. I've never gotten a "hi" or even "have a nice day." Even if it's slow, my drink is never well blended. It's more like a Slurpee, with ice chunks and 50% whipped cream. Maybe they're short staffed and need more training? Go elsewhere in the meantime.

Terrible experience. I put in an order for Hannah and saw it come out and the barista insisted it was for Dana. I saw 5 people come up and spin the drink around looking at the name. Waited 30 mins, called it quits and asked for a refund

I come to this Starbucks a few times every summer and fall because of my job doing recruitment at Ben Davis high school and every time I go, they are a wee bit slow. I usually go to the Starbucks on 15th and Capitol and they be havin their ish together - so I guess all Starbucks are not created equal when it comes to speed. 

I ordered a grande iced Carmel-machitto for $5+ (I'm like did prices go up again?!?!?) - that's neither here nor there. I waited in line for a record-breaking 7 minutes and could not pull out of line due to the concrete median guarding the drive thru. Those things are the ultimate customers blockers and protect Starbucks from losing money.

Anyways, when I get to the window the girl was SO nice and the drink tasted as expected. So that made up for the long wait. I would give 4 stars but this is my consistent experience at this location. Sub-par.

2/12/19 - So disappointed to hear that our wonderful asst manager Eddie at The Arizona Pavilions location 

1/11/19 - VERY disappointed that they didn't have my favorite sandwich today, chicken and artichoke 
11/20/18 - So disappointed today. Not one sandwich in the cooler at 11:15 am on 

Once again we are here. Our favorite place. Love our Baristas. Jessica, Treigh, Caleigh, Alex and Taylor. If I've forgotten anyone please forgive me. So many great people work at this location. :) And of co

Edwardsville opened another Starbucks next to the high school. Smart choice for a location!!.  Went inside for an evening jolt of caffeine.  Hubby wanted dessert; real slim pickings on that. He opted for the banana bread ("It's good" he said).   No wait for service; lots of customers inside all on their laptops.   Possibly college crowd since SIU-E is nearby too.   Had to ask for creamer since there wasn't any but that was no biggie.  We sat outside and there was plenty of seating outside as well as in.   Think I prefer this location to the older one.

This place is wonderful the staff is quick. This is one of the smaller store but they had 3 people working or even a long line is gone in a few mins. They know their coffee and the store is clean. It's starbuck so the coffee is always good.

This Starbucks is the worst ever.  Although Starbucks policy is no smoking within 25 feet of building, the smokers are puffing daily at the tables outside.  I've asked the staff to get the smokers to stop.  On one occasion I heard the Starbucks worker come out and make fun of the person who complained about the smoking...me...to the smokers.  There are cigarette butts all over the place.  Even the inside smells of smoke and dirty clothes.  I've called corporate several times, but does no good.  I say close this location and open one on Beach drive or at the Sundial.  I thought Starbucks was about the experience...but not here in this rat hole.

This is the worst Starbucks ever! I've ordered twice from the app. Both times I had to wait at least ten minutes to drink my drink even though it was already made and sitting at the side. Each time at least three people made eye contact with me, but didn't offer to help and I had to be really assertive to eventually get my drink. This morning my order was wrong, but I didn't have time to ask them to make it again because I had waited so long to get and was on my way to work. What a bummer they hired such sucky people. Usually the people at Starbucks are great, but at this one their terrible.

I love this Starbucks store!  The drivethru always moves very well, always enough people inside to keep it moving..someone is making the drinks while another one is taking the money.  The baristas are always friendly and very efficient.  They always get my order right, and I go there a lot.  Starbucks is one of the few businesses left where the people waiting on you smile and are very friendly and helpful toward the customer.
I love this store so much! I bypass 3 other Starbucks just to come to this one! I absolutely love the staff! The products are always great! But it's the staff for me!!

Fast although unorthodox Starbucks service...the service was masterful. Yes strange but good. 

The rest you know.

This was the worst Starbucks service I've ever had. I waited for five minutes in line for someone to even acknowledge me and take my order. The barista on the cash register was unable to pay attention to my order, and thus put it in wrong. He argued with me over the contents of the drink, which I ended up being right about after confirming with a second barista. Then I requested to use my birthday reward, but again he wasn't listening and proceeded to tell me I didn't have enough money on my card. After I repeated myself 2 more times he understood. Then my drink was made wrong because he didn't put it in correct in the cash register. My drink was remade by the second barista and even then the drink was incorrect and tasted horrible. Will never return.

It gives me a bit of a relief to finally give a good rating to a Starbucks again. I came here to study and grab a cup of coffee and a bit of breakfast. The gentleman on register was super kind and welcoming. This is something many of the locations lack nowadays. 

I went to sit down and literally every table was taken except the corner comfy chairs...perfect. I will say that this Starbucks need to expand if they can or open another location nearby because this one seems to be so popular. And I was only there on a Wednesday! 

About an hour later I decided to be lazy and try out the mobile ordering on the Starbucks app to order a breakfast sandwich. (I didn't want to leave my purse in the corner with my MacBook out just to walk all the way around to the register especially when people were walking in and out so frequently and I also didn't want to lose my seat by packing up all my stuff.) Anyways, my sandwich is done and I walk up to where the orders come up (within eye view of my seat). My sammy ended up still being frozen in the middle which often happens if you don't leave them out to defrost in the early morning hours (I've worked at Starbucks before lol). They happily remade it. And my second one was also frozen in the middle but at that point I was tired of going up there and I really needed to study. Overall though, their customer service was great; they just need to expand a bit.
located on the Southeast corner of the Circle downtown, a great place to people watch & like us, as Falcon heads, watch the Falcons in the Key Bank building, Eric was very helpful & friendly

This is the most personable Starbucks crew I've ever met. Pretty much everyone is extremely great. The only reason I didn't give a full 5 stars is one employee I believe named Sally is extremely rude. I come in almost everyday and am always extremely pleasant to her saying thank you and all I get is a stank face and ignored. Aside from that these people are amazing. Would recommend highly.

I ordered a drink through the mobile and had someone pick it up for me. I ordered a Frappuccino with almond milk and whipped cream. When I got the drink, there was no whipped cream and it was made with whole milk instead. I called for a refund and they said I had to go in and they'll make me a new one, which defeats the purpose of having someone get it for me. I asked if they could go through the app and give me a refund and they were not willing to work with me. This isn't the first time this has happened to me with this Starbucks specifically

I love Starbucks and until I visited this location, had never received anything less than 5 star service. 

I visited this location several times using only the Drive- Thru. Each time I waited 5 minutes or more.  It seemed like a really long wait for a drive thru but I chalked it up to them being really busy inside. 

I decided i'd try going inside to see if the service was faster. It took twice as long and there were only two other people in the store and one had already received their order. 

My drink was as expected but it was definitely the nastiest Starbucks I have ever been in. The trash was over flowing and there were straw wrappers and sticky spots all over the floor and the tables had obviously not been wiped down recently. 

Also, there was a random woman gossiping on a cellphone walking around aimlessly and leaning all over the counters. I'm not positive she worked there but her clothing seemed to fit the uniform and she was behind the counter at one point.

There are so many Starbucks in the area that I just don't see myself visiting this one if I don't have to.

Hands down the best Barista Partners in Tucson! The most courteous, hospitable, reverential team.

Oh...yea...the other reason I come to Starbucks. The coffee is pretty remarkable. Always accurate and the Team always goes the extra mile to put a smile on their customers faces.

Nice service. They need a paper towel dispenser. I do not like hand dryers. They are noisy and I don't like touching bathroom fixtures after washing my hands. 
Overall, the service is good and the staff is friendly.

This is my favorite starbucks location BY FAR. The cafe is always clean, I always get my drink in a timely manner, and it's always correct. Even if they mess something up, they're always more than happy to remake the drink. The staff here is wonderful as well. Everyone is very friendly and always try to spark conversation. Emily and Savannah specifically are the nicest baristas I have come in contact with at ANY Starbucks. I live in Collinsville and always make the drive to this location because it's just THAT GOOD!

I drink Starbucks almost every single day and typically I have had the pleasure of interacting with only friendly staff members. However, after visiting this location over the weekend, I will never return. Two different employees were so extremely rude during my visit. The one taking my order had an attitude with me like no other and when i asked for something, instead of being polite and telling me they couldn't give me a cup of whipped cream for whatever reason, she stared at me and said "No" so rudely and then turned away like I wasn't still standing there waiting to pay. The woman handing me my drinks then glared at me and asked me "What are you still doing here?" And when I simply said I'm waiting for the rest of my drinks, she rolled her eyes and huffed. Keep in mind, it wasn't busy in the store and I had 2 out of my 3 drinks. Starbucks, the employees at this store need a refresher course on customer service because it was absolutely appalling.
Since when do employees use their phones while making my coffee? And why are they out of cold brew 5 days a week??

Unfortunately not a very good Starbucks for how convenient this location is for so many people. I always forgive the longer than normal wait time, but  most of the time they skimp on the matcha I pay $5 for and give me a cup of warm milk where I then pour my own packet of matcha in to make it worth drinking. 
And secondly when I end up waiting an extra 10 minutes stuck in the drive-thru bc of 1 car's order ahead of me, I don't get any "sorry for your wait" or "this is on us" which I've gotten at other Starbucks. When I hear at least some compassion for the ridiculous wait at other locations, I am absolutely still happy with my order and proud to revisit that location in the future. Never seen that customer service at this Starbucks location unfortunately. It's very disappointing because they get so much business, they should have a 5-star rating.

Recently I've seen an improvement in service. I also have noticed several new employees and so am happy that management must be listening to feedback. The service levels have continue to be positive and I am now Updating my rating. Keep up the customer focus......it matters!
25 minutes to get 2 coffee drinks!!! I get that they are busy but WTF?!! That is absolutely ridiculous!! At least that made our drinks correctly.

Hilarious coming on here and seeing all these people moan and groan about a cup of coffee and a Starbucks experience - lmao awww - did you expect a Michelin experience with your caramel frap for 5 dollars? Get a life. These kids work they're ass off - and deal with the insanity that can be South St - for way less than they deserve. For every cool person - there's 10,000 a**holes. I haven't - and if you haven't strapped up a smock - been belittled and done back hand springs for people who are tweaking over they're drug fix for 10 hrs then shut the **** up and be appreciative that South St even HAS a Starbucks (this st doesn't deserve it - sorry) like I am - stop being such an entitled pri*k - and treat people like humans. Mistakes are made. Get over it.

Apparently spending close to $200 a month isn't enough (yes it's an addiction) to get a refill on your ice coffee. Apparently, It's against company policy to get a refill unless you are finishing your coffee in the restaurant. Someone might want to tell the lippy manager that  we are in the middle of a pandemic and people don't like drinking their coffee in places where dozens of strangers come through every hour. Instead of being a corporate robot, maybe be a human instead. Or use your common sense, if you have any.

The Webster Groves Starbucks team is really great when it comes to making up for mobile ordering errors. 

For example, this morning I ordered a drink and bistro box, but when I came to pick up they were out of bistro boxes (the app hadn't updated yet). The team offered me to pick out a different bistro box and also a breakfast sandwich on the house since the bistro boxes that were left didn't have much protein. This is much appreciated! 

Other times when an order has had mishaps, the Starbucks team gave my husband and I $4 Next Drink's On Us cards. 

Webster Groves Starbucks is really accountable for mishaps, even when it's not their fault. They are always friendly and accommodating, and I appreciate their hard work and great service. Thank you!

Bottom line, the slowest drive thru with absolutely no excuse. All times of the day, no matter how many customers. Slow. They never apologize for it either. Even when it takes a solid 30 minutes. Idk why i keep trying this one, in fact I just left the drive thru after waiting for 15 minutes not even getting a chance to order, with the same car at the window since I arrived.
One of the better Starbucks in the area . There always friendly and talk with us when I come in with my daughter. Then even make suggestions because she likes to order off the secret menu .

This is one of my FAVORITE Starbucks. I go here almost weekly to do my homework and study. I am always so productive. I really enjoy getting my lattes in a "for here" mug. It makes my whole experience feel more cozy and more like a small coffeeshop and not a typical Starbucks.
They took away all of their indoor seating. That really too bad. Options were important and their window seating was a good thing.

The billboards say open 24/7 and they mean that, as I've stopped here on many an odd hour and holiday. Great drive through service and employees who are very friendly despite those odd hours and holidays, too. Only reason I'm holding back the fifth star is that the logistics when leaving the drive-thru are a bit annoying but if you are on that dead stretch of I-4 between Tampa and Orlando and need that caffeine fix, seeing their sign on the horizon over the interstate is a beautiful thing.
Mr. Paul was very unprofessional by telling "idk what does the sticker say". When I asked if the order pick-up drink was mine.

This is the worst Starbucks in Nashville. Drive thru or pick up you will be waiting at least 20-25min. Extremely SLOW service. They are also always out of supplies and food. So don't get your hopes up when you're craving something

THEY DONT LISTEN TO CUSTOMERS. This was my go to Starbucks for so long. I go here multiple times a week. They have been messing up my order for so long now but I keep giving them a  chance because i think they will get it right. I only get an iced coffee with 2 pumps of white mocha.... how hard can it be? Today the barista decided to add 4 pumps or maybe more. Usually when I  ask for 2 pumps of anything it says it on the sticker but not today. 

There is literally a mountain of white  mocha because they decided they wanted to add more. Can't even drink it now because it is way too sweet.. 

LISTEN TO YOUR DAMN CUSTOMERS!!!!

Of all the Starbucks in the New Orleans region with drive-thrus, this one has consistently held the longest wait time for years. Since 2014, I've endured the longest waits at this location. The baristas are typically friendly, but there is unquestionably some sort of efficiency problem with the drive thru. Lines are comparable to other locations such as the one further down Veterans towards Lakeview and the location off of Esplanade in Kenner, but this location doesn't manage the business nearly as well. On your average morning, expect an 18+ minute wait in the line , and upwards of 30 on some days.

2020, it's a New Year!  This is an amazing location, plenty of clean seating near windows. A large table in the center. I recommend they add another table in place of the coffee display. Very roomy and spread out. Compared to other Starbucks which can be cramped - this one is one of my favorites. My flat white coffee was made quickly and the staff is very friendly. I will definitely be returning!
Leiah (?) was so sweet! She definitely made my day. The drive through was fast, and my pumpkin spice latte was delicious!
Won't be coming back if Sarah is working.. I am sure she is very nice but can't multitask and is slow as molasses... every... damn . Time...

This Starbucks has the best vibes! The employees are caring and friendly. They remember their customers and that speaks volumes to me. It is clean and kept up well, and they are doing a great job during covid.
Extremely long wait but grateful for the drive thru. Staff are pleasant. Got my drinks right.

It took forever to receive my caremel ribbon crunch frap! By the time I got it, it was watered down and unsweet. I wanted either refund or them to remake it, but the line was too long. Totally unsatisfied and will never choose this Starbucks location again.
They do a good job for being how busy they are in the morning, and if the lineup is ever too big. They will give you your order for free if it takes to long.

Skip this location unless you enjoy being ignored, talked down to, and once again, ignored. Terrible service and they didn't even fill my expensive coffee to the top. Got two stars because the drink tasted fine after the ten mins it took to prepare it. I was the only customer there. Glad this app exists so I know where NOT to stop on the interstate. Think I'll go to a travel center next time. At least there, I expect bad service.

First off let me say that they are always busy, BUT they have good service and if you go before closing time, which I believe is 11pm, you could get the samples they didn't give out during the day!!! Love love LOVE Starbucks. It is pricey, but for their coffee I do not mind. If you can go, you need to bring your friends/ family cause it is AMAZING!

My favorite starbucks location! Every single employee is so kind and especially the tall kid named joe! He remembers my drink every time I come in and I really appreciate that since I come in four times a week. Super amazing and really appreciate this Starbucks location!
Depends on the day for the service but the weekend staff is quick and always nice ! My pup always gets treats too  !
Third time we've been given the wrong drink at the drive-in. Just Awful! They can't get it right.
Absolutely love this location and everything about it. The staff are awesome, truly a great warm welcoming environment.

Kids running store are moving in slow motion here. 7 am and I'm only one of two or three customers inside. Apparently, these mobile ahead orders nose you out! They still won't let you add your own condiments to your own drink! Even if you're vaccinated?! This worldwide pandemic has turned many into raging lunatics.

Parking here is murder. They only have 4 spots which are almost always occupied. This is easily remedied by parking at the CVS across the street or on Penn Valley Drive. Both are fairly reasonable options. 

Other than parking issues, this is a great branch. The lines are small, the staff is quick, they have a few tables out back overlooking Lake Afton, and there's also plenty of free seating available inside. 

It can get crowded from time to time, but overall, this is a nice, pleasant place to get your AM coffee.

This is not a very good Starbucks!  They don't update the app when they run out of bakery items.  So you order ahead and when you get here to pick up your order they say, I'm sorry we have run out of that.  What else do you want?  Nothing!!!  2 stars is all you will get out of me.  Blah!  Update your damn app!!!

Stopped in for breakfast before work. I got the impossible breakfast sandwich. It was nice and warm but the corners of the bun were hard as if it had been overheated. I didn't get a drink since I was headed to the office where coffee and tea were available. I'd like to see truly vegan options for sandwiches.

It's something about this Starbucks! I only drink one thing Grande Java Chip no whipped cream. It's gotta be something in the water. I am an avid Starbucks drinker and this location makes the Java Chip the ABSOLUTE best!!! I used to manager the red lobster next door and would treat the staff to drinks, as long as they brought back mine. Always great service always great coffee
This is one of the best Starbucks I've been to in a while! Friendly staff and the baristas were super helpful and had great recommendations. Whatever this location is doing - keep it up!

Every time I visit my orders are ready to go. They make sure the items are packaged correctly ie the labels are correct # of bags in order. They are friendly, verifying the order is correct so you're not grabbing the wrong items. They're always busy when I am there and it never seems to change their mood. Keep up the good work.

I love this place. You smell the coffee aroma the minute you get in. They have very efficient staff. They are very quick and very friendly. Very cozy place especially in winter time love to spend time there with my colleagues at work.

I recently moved a few blocks away, which means that my beloved CWE "home" Starbucks has been replaced. With that sorrow, however, comes some measure of joy. The layout of the Wydown Starbucks is open and accommodating, far more so than the locations found in the city. There is more than ample seating, and tables are spread far enough apart to avoid knocking into your neighbor. 
The small outdoor patio on the southern side of the store provides a view of the Botero while sipping your coffee.
As others mentioned, this store can get very loud during the weekdays after school lets out. Sunday afternoons, I've found, are calm.

It's 40 degrees in Philadelphia. Why do you have the air conditioning on now? Is that really what Starbucks corporate wants? What a waste of energy. Not very good as a corporate citizen. Besides the fact that you guys barely recycle (correct me if I'm wrong). 

I guess you want to freeze us out of your location. What's up with that?

Beautiful facility but this team suuucks. They just don't seem to know what's going on. Drinks are coming out slowly and out of order. Watched a Batista make a screw up order into an order for someone else. Waited ten minutes for a cold brew. Fail. Restaff!!
It was fine. Nothing special. Nice lobby.

PROBLEM
Music was so loud I would characterize it as rude. The store is not clean. Not a very good Starbucks. 

SOLUTION
Hire, Train, and Mentor good people. It doesn't take the clientele to point out filth and loud music. It takes common sense and client centric leadership.

I frequent quite a few Starbucks in St. Pete to buy my favorite bag of coffee beans; but as of yesterday, I will only be patronizing this location on U.S. 19 and 22nd, and here's why:  I had gone through the drive-thru to purchase a bag of my favorite Italian Roast beans and gave the girl at the window my credit card.  She came back with a bag and scanned my card; but when she handed it to me, it was a bag of Verona.  I told her I only wanted the Italian Roast and asked her to issue me a refund, which she did and gave me the receipt.  

When I checked my bank, I saw the initial charge but not the refund.  I waited a few days but still no refund.  So I called the store and asked to speak with a manager.  The manager was wonderful!  She listened to my story, looked up the transaction, saw the charge but no refund and said the employee apparently had forgotten to put the refund through.  I told her that every time I go to that location to purchase Italian Roast, they're out of it, which she said she was surprised to hear because she has 6 bags.  She asked if I wanted a refund or a bag of the coffee.  I told her I'll be in for a bag and thanked her for how she handled it.  She said she'd have a bag waiting for me with my name on it at the drive-thru.

Later that day, I went through the drive-thru and lo and behold, there was a bag waiting for me with a Starbucks gift card and note saying "Your next one's on us!"  Wow!  That is outstanding customer service!  I wish I got her name to give her credit because she exemplifies excellence in customer service, problem-solving, management and leadership.  Thank you, Starbucks manager!!  I'll be back!

This Starbucks is so incredibly slow. I have got out the drive thru line many times because of the wait. The worst was a 12 minute wait after I ordered with no movement at all.  There were still 3 cars ahead of me so I left.  I usually drive a little further to County Line and 135 for much faster service.  I gave this location another shot this morning because there were only 3 cars in line. The wait wasn't horrible but my drink was made wrong, which is pretty simple..latte with 1 pump of syrup. I'm not sure why this location struggles so much and the service level is so different from another right down the road, but I'll drive a little further for faster service and consistency.

New location? Was nice to begin with, now same experiences as old location, super slow, not very nice. Cater to drive thru so mobile orders not even worth it. I miss the Maple Glen location so badly!!!
Went there at 10pm and they close at 10:30. They saw me at the drive thru and they were talking to each other laughing waited 10mins and they never bother to tell me they where closing early!
Horribly slow. I would have left but I was let trapped on the drive thru line. Never going to this location again

Friendly and fast service, super helpful staff. Why aren't there organic options yet Starbucks??  For both coffee and creamer selections? I had a lot of stars built up otherwise i'd go to a neighborhood organic coffee shop.

In need of a little pick me up today, making a quick stop for coffee. Girl at register friendly, ad soon as I walked in she said hi! Was very informative when I asked about couple of drinks, cause I couldn't decide on a drink!  Barista then got started on my drink, and it was finished in couple of minutes, I think there was only one more person ahead of me.  By the way, they had a special for happy hour, so my drink ended up being half off!!  I do love my Starbucks and have never had an issue at all, I have cut down on coffee so I don't frequent this shop that often, but when I do, it is a pleasurable experience!!

MUST READ: Starbuck's CARES about YOU! I unfortunately was in accident out front of this store and after the reports were taken and the cars towed away, I entered to store to try and get warm and truthfully process all that had happened just a few minutes earlier while I waited for my wife to pick me up. A cup a coffee, I thought, would be really nice so I went to order my usual... As per normal, the employees asked how I was doing and I shared that I had just experienced an accident and was waiting for my wife to come get me. They were generous enough to listen and offer their support as I explained the situation. To top it off, they offered the coffee on the house. Yes, maybe just a free cup of coffee but man it meant more than a 20oz caffeine boost to me. Thank you to everyone in the store who were so generous and if you've lasted long enough to read this review, I hope you'll consider Starbucks for your next coffee craving..

All Starbucks are not created equal!  

Jonah and his staff go above and beyond to make dropping $5 on coffee as amazing as it can possibly be.  After a few visits, they will learn your name and probably your order.

Tables are less full when IUPUI is not in session -- but this is a good location to sit and chill -- with some outdoor tables as well.

Came by at 7:30 - close is at 8 PM. Everything was out of the food case. An employee was scrolling their phone the whole time. Completely disengaged and ready to leave. Not up to par with local Starbucks service.
This location is constantly closed due to staffing issues caused by COVID. You never know when it's going to be open.

Honestly they're my favorite Starbucks in town. They always know how I take my coffee and they do a decent job.  Seriously, what more can you ask for? 

Sure they're not anything fancy, rustic, or locally owned, but they're a cup of coffee when you need it.  Old reliable. Like an old pair of sneakers. They get the job done.

I've never had a problem with the staff or product but the service is SLOW. Drive thru line is always so long blocking traffic because you sit in line forever. Once you're stuck in line you see customers who orders inside and leave before you get to the intercom.
Employees arguing while waiting for food. Running back and forth past window never addressing me until it was time to throw me my food... wasn't feeling the customer  service at all

We had a terrible experience. I was with my friend to order drinks on our way to Orlando. First time at this Starbucks. We had Lucien as our cashier. She got our order wrong and forgot to put in one of our order. Our order seemed to overhwhelm her significantly despite asking for no modifications except oat milk instead of regular milk. She was either very soft spoken or irritated. Took 5 minutes to just get our order placed. She didn't even confirm our order. After the order, only two out of the three drinks came up. One of the drinks was wrong. So we had to ask to have redone. Then, we were waiting for a long time for a third drink watching other customers who came after us get theirs. When we asked if they were making our drink, they said they never got the order. We had to bring it up to another barista who was a bit older with white hair in a ponytail. He was sweet and helped refund us. On a side note, the bathroom was not very clean. Toilet paper all over the ground. We are never coming back.

You go to a Starbucks because you know exactly what you're getting in terms of the menu options, quality, and service. Of course, each Starbucks will vary slightly in these areas but overall it's usually a safe place for a decent coffee beverage no matter where you are in the country. This particular Starbucks is what many would consider my "neighborhood" Starbucks. It's the closest Starbucks to my house and the one I usually go to on my way to work, before running errands, or on my way out of town. 

I want to give some major kudos to the employees at this location. The service is always friendly and welcoming--even with the more colorful downtown Reno patrons. The team at this location definitely stands out in the sea of Starbucks as providing coffee with a consistently pleasant demeanor.

People are friendly, the place is always clean, and it's a Starbucks. So you know the menu.

Stop by if your thirsty, they have a drive through btw.

Unfriendly service. I also suffered a concerning drink quality issue yesterday. As Starbucks Corporate is trying to address these issues and has quickly refunded my purchase price, I won't elaborate. It was just... very unfortunate.

I'm a Starbucks devotee. This is the closest Starbucks to my home but not the only Starbucks nearby so I'll just avoid this one... forever.

This particular intersection I had low expectations but they were exceeded by far. This Starbucks is very clean, organized and spacious. The customer service / baristas are awesome and know what they are doing. Thank you!

I never have coffee at Starbucks, it's too strong for me. I'll usually opt for a chai tea or a latte. My boyfriend is a Starbucks fan. This one was fairly standard for the chain. No better, no worse than any of the others. We had a drink to wake up and wait out rush hour before heading on our way.

The drinks are usually decent. The customer service however is lacking considerably. There was a younger guy at the window today who seemed bothered to do his job. I was in the passenger seat so I wasn't paying much attention, other than to grab our drinks. We drove off and I mentioned his crappy customer service. My boyfriend started laughing because apparently he was playing on his phone. Seriously? At the drive thru window? Extremely unprofessional.

This place has completely impressed me! I used to always stop at the Starbucks in Lakeland off exit 33 on the way to Tampa, and this one is way faster!!!! I always stop at this location now, and yes, the drive through is a little slow...but the other location's drive through wait is 30+ minutes! They got my vote here!

The low review is primarily due to the service that has gone significantly downhill. I usually stop at this Starbucks pretty regularly before work. This Starbucks has the SLOWEST drive thru of any of them in town. Yesterday after the line not moving for 15 minutes, I just left. This morning, there weren't many cars, but enough that my drink should have been ready when I pulled up. Instead it was another 5 minutes after my card was processed before I was handed my drink. "Just go inside" you say? It isn't any faster, and I've had them put my order on the drive thru counter. It took me 5-10 minutes to get someone's attention to grab it for me.
And the point of a drive thru is for it to be quicker than getting out of your vehicle, walking inside, waiting in line, ordering, waiting for your drink, and then walking back to your car, getting in and driving away.

They need to take the service in the drive thru (and inside) up a notch.

Customer service is usually pretty good, however Starbucks says they care about their employees but then start them off at $9.25/hour when the company has the ability to pay a living wage. PAY YOUR WORKS MORE. ESPECIALLY DURING A PANDEMIC. YOU ARE NOT ESSENTIAL.

I've been here a handful of times. I've driven through, but they are usually backed up and so I ultimately decided it was nice inside and my daughter and I enjoy sitting and hanging out. It's clean and the staff are friendly, and they even seem to have more food items on stock then the surrounding Starbucks in the general Tucson area. I literally searched for the sugar plum pastry everywhere and couldn't find it and came here and got it two times here in a row! They are all out now though (limited special item). One day when I arrived, there was a mishap and they forgot all about my drink. I waited patiently, and finally went to remind them. They were apologetic. I was not in a hurry, if I had been I'd have been annoyed probably but it wasn't a big deal for me. It did however make me decide to come a couple more times before reviewing them to make sure I didn't rate them poorly if they didn't deserve it. I have since maintained an otherwise good experience with them, so I feel I can give them the 3/4 stars. This has been my new favorite location. I think that's for personal preference really. They are generally busy and a little slow though, so don't stop here if you're in a hurry and you'll be alright ;)

If you want lukewarm coffee, go here. I asked for a new cup of coffee and the barista suggested I get less creamer and it was still lukewarm. I also had to wait 5 minutes for pike roast (which is available 24/7 and never takes that long). Go to the Starbucks by center grove instead, more friendly too!

Great job keeping up during corona virus limited service. 

Had drive through yesterday. Fast and friendly. 

Order ahead was correct and on time. Pick up was easy. 

Good job guys!

It's a Starbucks.  New and shiny, but still a Starbucks.  They closed the other location, just a few blocks down next to Ceol, and they built this new location in the parking lot of the 1 Liberty Building.  I've heard that one of Starbucks' goals is to have every location have a drive thru, which makes sense since that's likely the most profitable transaction they can make.  

Parking is a bit strange in that they'd added spots specifically for Starbucks in the 1 Liberty lot, but no entrances for Starbucks on the east side of the building (which is where the lot is).  They've got a fake planter/barrier/divider thing to keep you from taking the shortest route to get to the entries on either the south or the west side of the building (which also happens to be right through the drive through lane).  Drive thru was doing solid business at 6:30 AM, probably 3 or 4 cars deep.

Tip: don't try to use the door on the north-east of the building - looks like it's stairs into the underground parking and is not connected to Starbucks.

The space is standard Starbucks - if you've been in any of the modern Starbucks you'd recognize it, and likely if you took someone in blindfolded, and had them identify the building, they'd know it was a Starbucks, so kudos to their branding and look and feel folks.  High ceilings set this place apart slightly, and there's more seating than the old location, with a mix of high tops, built-ins, etc.

I stopped in mainly since I wanted to try out the Reserve line of coffee, brewed on the Clover system.  The Reserve line is their new "premium" line, and the Clover is some fancy new brewing machine, single cup at a time that lets you program in exact water temperature and brew times, and uses a vacuum more than pressure.  It's a single cup system, and they grind and dose the beans after you order.  Interesting for a geek like me, but I think for most people it'll be seen as more of a novelty than worth the price premium.  The Reserve coffees ranged from I think 2.75 to 4.00 depending on the beans for a 12 oz.  Starbucks will probably have a bit more variety going through their doors with their Reserve line though, so that might make it worth while . . . 

Of course, the whole Reserve/Clover bit is Starbucks attempt to drive their bottom line up, trying to constantly grow as any publicly owned corporation must do to keep the stock market happy.  I think it is a better cup of joe than their Americano, albeit a bit expensive for what it is.  I think the cup I got this morning was good, but I also believe an Americano from the Hub or Bibo are excellent and comparable choices, for a buck or two less.

I won't be making any future attempts to stop in here explicitly, especially with the Hub on Cheney so close, but if I'm in the vicinity and in a hurry, the drive thru convenience could win out . . .

mmmm! this place was a godsend on my way north from St Louis airport....

Close to the highway, easy parking.

Staff was friendly albeit slightly overworked with the drive through traffic

The barista created my beverage and then realized i had asked for coconut milk, and made me a whole nother drink. What a trooper!
Not a good Starbucks. Staff doesn't know their own coffee and refused to do pour overs for anything but the three they already have brewed. Maybe they'll get better...

I get it, you get busy. That's normal. It's how you handle it that matters. 25 minutes for a coffee is unacceptable. What's worse, when people complained to the manager, they were dismissed. The young woman taking order would say she had no idea how long it would be! You better have an idea!  You know when the orders placed, you know when the name is called. Step it up a Cville!

Again, it's a Starbucks.  This one is located at 75th and Shadeland on the corner of a little strip that also houses the popular Caplinger's Fish Market.  Inside is VERY small as is the outside so seating is limited.  Great for a drive through -- you have to go around the other end of the strip mall by Donatos to access it.  The staff at this location is pretty friendly, too.  Especially John in the drive through and a gorgeous gal inside with a really unique name that I can't recall ...
I miss the "original crew"' Sara, Fiona, and crew, the new crew is great also. I'm still pining for some comfy chairs like some other stores but this is my home Starbucks while in Tucson.

I've been here 30+ times and have never been treated so rudely. Rolling eyes at me when I reminded them (after they handed me my drink) that I asked/paid for a shot of espresso in it. Then just pushed my coffee to me across the bar almost spilling it. 

2 cars in drive thru and nobody inside and they look like they have no idea what they're doing. 

I won't be back to this one.
The staff at this location is very unfriendly. The girl with the giant plugs and dirty hair is extremely rude. I did nothing to deserve being treated so poorly. My family will not be back.

I wait in the line 32 minutes to get my order and when I order they told me everything I order they told me they didn't have it and also all the time 
Different price they charge me and also they are fucking so mean and when they give me my Order all of it ice that is fucked up really fucked up and also the fucking drink it's just like a water taste

I used to buy Starbucks every morning on my way into work.  Thanks to covid I'm saving money on coffee.  However, this time of year brings my favorite blend, the Christmas blend. They have a blonde Christmas blend and a dark.  I made a special trip out just for the coffee.  In addition to the coffee they also have my favorite scone, the seasonal cranberry orange scone.  There is no better coffee & scone combo!

First off, I should admit: I don't drink coffee. (Whew, I feel better putting that right out there) But, I have a wonky schedule, which means at 6am, I'm looking for supper-or something supper'ish. Starbucks, as I'm finding out, has a great hot menu. Today I learned: the impossible is possible. The impossible sausage, egg and cheese sandwich is really good. Tasty-yes-great texture, not greasy-and the roll it's served on is divine. (Oh, the crunch!) I'd eat my shoe if it were served on this roll! I will definitely have the impossible again. And bonus: it's also filling. 

I'll be back to this location, too. At 6am on a Saturday, there was no wait at the drive-thru and the service was amazing. (She didn't balk at the Elmo pj pants I was wearing) Yes, it's across SR 60 from Brandon Mall and Target, in the busy Michael's/AMC theater parking lot-but early in the morning, it's a breeze. They have tons of parking and a little outside eating area. For $10, my Saturday is off to a good start.

I love this location (although every time I visit I immediately remember the day when it was an A/W root beer -long John silvers location).

That is a good thing in the fact that this location has TONS of indoor seating. They have high tops, couches, community tables and little 2 tops. 

The baristas are extra friendly and my favorite is Arthur-he's a true asset to Starbucks. 

If you visit regularly enough, Arthur is really good at remembering you drink. 
Another reasons why I like this location is they have a communal crossword puzzle at the countertop where you pick up your drink. While you're waiting, why not peruse the sheet and see if you can add to the challenge-nice!

Great location (meaning it's right downtown St. Pete) and really have to love almost any Starbucks! The employees are really nice and does a good job. However it can be hard to find a parking and this Starbucks is pretty crowded at most times (downtown, huh). There are only few nice tables and they are taken for hours by people who sip on a drink and study on their computers. So it's a no no for finding a nice table, but yes yes for getting my morning coffee... until I get my own Starbucks machine on Black Friday sale for $59. Yeeeey:)

Okay. I don't normally give 1* to establishments unless I'm really irritated. Just isn't worth my time or that of the place I'm reviewing. This is different. I have had many nitro cold brews at various Starbucks in the area.

I order a newer item on the menu which is the nitro cold brew. This is essentially a cold brewed coffee from a keg. I tried it and instantly knew something was wrong. It had was lighter in color and at first glance I thought it might have had creamer. I pulled around and voiced my concerns and was instantly belittled for my knowledge of nitro cold brew. It was my fault? 

In reality, the coffee wasn't as strong as I was used to for a nitrogen cold brewed coffee. 

Point is, if your product doesn't live up to a customer's standards. Don't make it their fault. Talk to them and make them feel like their opinion counts. 

Peace

First of all, we were not greeted by the person at the counter. We could not understand a thing they said because they mumbled. When my mother tried to reload 20 she went to use a 100 to pay and they couldnt take it because it was too big of a bill which is beyond my understanding. And there was no apology no trying to reconcile and no "sorry about that enjoy the rest of your day" terrible customer service.
They will never get your right !!!! Worst Starbucks in Tampa . I have a milk allergy and they always mess this up even when I tell them this ! No foam? You will get EXTRA !!!!

Manager Danielle was amazing ! She went above and beyond for every customer she came in contact with ! Definitely an example of how managers should be ! Customer service is not taken serious these days....she u
Gave me hope ! Lol

This message is for the management of this location. Please, please!! Retrain your baristas and take the time actually to try the coffees being served out at this location! You need to be in the customer's shoes, so you know what we are experiencing. I have been coming here since opening, giving chance after chance. 
I don't know what exactly has gone wrong with this newer Starbucks. But every single time I go, there is something wrong with my drink. May I add, I don't order anything complicated. My craziest drink was a simple soy latte, for example. 
I just went through this drive-through today, and my drink tastes like diluted, watered-down coffee and a splash of soy milk. Not worth $6. I've been ordering the same drink for years at multiple locations throughout the USA. But this location can't make the drinks right.

Full blown circus on regular occasion.  Longest possible lines- not because it's anything special but because workers are clowns.  Peak hours on Saturday, line around the block for both drive thru and inside, when finally get inside they have a new guy training in the register while the manager is just walking around apologizing.  What a moron.  Owner needs to pay a little more and get the A Team employees there on the weekend, can't have first day at the job type people.  Train them during the week during slower times.  Can't believe I have to even say this should be common sense
If I could select 0 stars, I WOULD. The service was absolutely freaking horrible. The servers/baristas SUPER RUDE!!!! Never will I EVER come to this sorry A-word establishment EVER AGAIN!!!

Starbucks must be doing well when they place two Starbucks across from each other.  This Starbucks is located inside the Marriott hotel and is located right across the street from the Sheraton Starbucks.  This Starbucks also closes early so make sure to get here before 5pm. I believe this Starbucks also has the collector Starbucks cups (has the city of New Orleans printed on the outside).  Lots of seating and relatively fast service.  No use having your Starbucks gold card here though. No free soy or syrup choices.

This Starbucks is conveniently located right before you hop onto the Pennsylvania Turnpike in Plymouth Meeting. Parking's easy. Their staff were friendly and fast, making it easy for us to pick up a caffeinated beverage before heading on a long long long drive. Like many regular Starbucks, there's seating and a restroom for customers.

If you HATE Starbucks, why are you reading this?
If you LIKE Starbucks, this one is just like the others except folks don't seem to hang out here - it's mostly drivers who need a fix for their commute.
I've never had any issues at this Starbucks. They are always friendly and I never wait long for my drinks. At the end of the day, it's Starbucks

First off, let me just say I am excited this Starbucks was finally able to open. 

Just so everyone is aware, last time I went, they informed me they only take mobile orders. I don't know if that was a limited thing or not, but make sure you have the Starbucks app anyways to place an order ahead of time.

As for the establishment itself, the workers are very friendly and efficient, despite seemingly being short-staffed. The lines can sometimes get crazy in the drive-thru, so I appreciate their efforts. On the down side,, it seems they are constantly out of something. Checking out their menu on the app, a lot of popular drinks are constantly sold out at their store, either from popularity or lack of supplies. 

Either way, I understand given that they are pretty new it will take awhile for everything to get situated. The staff also seems to just be getting accustomed to the environment. Nevertheless, I have high hopes for this establishment.

Welcome to Plant City.

Since I have been in town this week, I have visited this location a couple times using their drive thru. They run a fairly efficient operation. The lines have been at least six cars deep each visit and they process the customers relatively quickly. I was impressed both times with the friendly staff.
Every single time I visit this Starbucks I have to wait at least 15 minutes tops for a drink.

Just had a a wonderful experience at the Starbucks on Kennedy. The customer service has lacked lately because of Covid I'm sure. But everybody in the Starbucks was so friendly I just wanna give a shout out. It felt good to have people be nice again LOL

This Starbucks is kind of small, but nice and clean. The baristas were friendly and seemed to have a good rapport with their regular customers. If you have a dog, they let you bring them in while you're ordering. The location is really great and is near a lot of places to shop. I came here to study and then stopped in ACME to grocery shop before going home. It's also near the Magic Gardens if you're looking for something fun to do nearby!

Probably one of the busiest Starbucks I've ever been to, but it was well worth it.

About the only negative I can see at this store is their lack of two public restrooms.  Oh, they have two restrooms, but one is reserved for employees only.

The atmosphere inside is terrific and kitschy like most locations and as packed as it was, we were still able to find seating for my wife, myself, and our niece.

Waited for several minutes for our mobile order and never heard my name or saw anything like what we ordered.  I approached the counter and asked if the app had selected the correct location.  The barista was shocked and told me that it was in fact a location far on the other side of town (Kino and I-10).  Turns out on our recent trips to Shreveport, LA and San Antonio, TX we had made stops at that SBucks, so the phone app defaulted to that store rather than the one we were standing in a few minutes earlier.

The barista asked to see the receipt, quickly jotted down our order, and promptly made our 3 drinks.  So amazing.  We thanked her profusely and then called the other store to let them know so they could gift the other drinks to some of their patrons.

Impressed to say the least.  We'll be back and I'll check the app a little more closely before ordering next time.

Love Starbucks, but this one needs a lot of work.  Placed mobile order, came in, nothing.  Waited 5 minutes, still nothing.  When i go up, barista pulls my tag and puts it inline to make.  3 workers, 2 taking orders, one making them.  Long line both in the store and drive-thru.  Finally, my coffee is ready.  Total time, 20+ minutes, app said it would take 6-9 minutes.  Rude service, under staffed, ok drink.  Drove by two days later, drive thru was worse.  This Starbucks seems like it is a mess.  Not likely going back.

Ordered my drink at 12:39pm, did no receive it until 1:00pm; when asking about my drink, the lady rudely informed me that they were making them as fast as possible. However, the person that ordered after me got her drink first..... 

I get Starbucks every morning, but this location has to be the worst by far. Very disappointed.... Every time I come to this location it is never a pleasant experience. 

Almost told them just keep my money but not make the drink because I was beyond annoyed at how long I had to wait for a walk in drink.

I overheard the barista literally complaining about making my moms drink/making fun of it. So I said "well that's the way my mom likes to drink it." She immediately got defensive. 

They also put sweetener in it and claimed "they changed the recipe so there's no sweetener" and were incredibly rude after I called her out for complaining.

I never get angry toward people working in the service industry and that really got under my skin. I would not recommend this Starbucks.

Try not to complain about people's drinks in front of a family member next time. "Have a really great day!"

Usually the Starbucks is okay, not always the best. I have been doing the mobile order a lot recently because I am always in a rush in the morning. Every time I go to this Starbucks I submit my mobile order 20 minutes before leaving my house. However I get the Villanova Starbucks and my drink order is not ready AND everyone in the line gets their drinks before me. Also sometimes I go here and they do not even have a mobile order receipt printed out for me. Very slow here

I love my Starbucks on 10th! The employees are already friendly and fun. We've done business meetings here, come through the drive up, and just hung out with our kids between sports. 
The staff takes their time to get it right but also understand coffee drinkers need that caffeine stat ha! Great job!
So happy to have a drive through Starbucks so close to my home! Very convenient location and service has always been pleasant and quick.

The employees here seem to work extremely fast.

I'm a huge fan of Starbucks. I've always been greeted with a sincere hello and they always get my order correct.  My dogs LOVE the puppachinos!! I really like the S. Grand location with their speedy service.

There are no other words i can think to describe this Starbucks other than they are AWESOME! I feel extremely welcomed every time i go there! They know my name and the people are just super sweet and kind! I love it!!!
Best, most authentic Starbucks in STL. Great barristas and a very real and diverse clientele.
Kelsey was genuinely the nicest person I've met all day and it's 7pm. Thanks for making this place stay open an extra hour so I can get some work done. I'll def be back :)

This location has always had quick, accurate service. One time I was feeling sick and had a particularly bad day, so I thought I'd go to Starbucks for a drink and a small treat. That's a big deal to me too because I only go to Starbucks maybe 5 times a year. I reached in my purse to grab my wallet and realized I had left it in my gym bag. Seriously the nicest thing and exactly what I needed that day. Will definitely be returning to this location again and again.

Consistently great Starbucks location. Even though there's a good amount of turnover, the baristas are always top notch. Service is routinely fast and friendly.

The thing I like most about this branch is that they take the time to make my drink properly. I often order long shots, but many locations don't run the shots that way, despite my instructions. Good job for never cutting corners on my drink.

Five solid stars from me. I really hope we can move past the pandemic and get back to sitting and drinking our coffee in the shop. It's really a great place to do that.

Love this Starbucks. They always get the drive thru line done and finished very quickly! They are always nice but they have been under construction/closed a lot recently! I still stand by this Starbucks and the staff here!

Went on a bagel run to another establishment , but I had to have Starbucks.   Still no seating inside. This location is geared to keeping drive thru moving, so I think the drive thru is quicker than walking in and getting it at the counter.

I've tried the cold brew with vanilla sweet cream at a few Starbucks and this location makes it the best. The coffee was smooth and the sweet cream was sweet. This is by far the worst Starbucks to stop at. Avoid this location, rude rude people work here!

SLOW and still get order wrong lol gave second chance. Never again. 30 mins in line!!!!!

I have a somewhat different order than the usual fare. I do a Keto diet so I want a keto friendly coffee. My order is a Venti Iced Coffee with a regular splash of heavy cream, 6 pumps of sugar free cinnamon dolce, 6 pumps of sugar free vanilla, topped with cold foam and cinnamon powder. Not to crazy. I travel all over pinellas county and as far as Spring Hill and this particular Starbucks can't seem to get it right. They have now replaced my order twice and still can not get it right. I don't understand what is so difficult about it honestly. First time there was no cold foam or cinnamon powder topping and it was a cream bomb. Since you pay extra for foam I called and had it replaced. This Starbucks consistently misses. I frequent another location closer to work in an attempt to avoid this one next to my house because of how often they mess up drinks here. Truly, this store needs someone from corporate to come train the team as it's only been open a few months and is without a doubt the worst Starbucks in Nashville.

Worst Starbucks ever!! The staff is rude to the other employees and to customers. I couldn't believe the way they talk to a child. Jacob was rude to his coworkers and my child. I will never return to this location. Only gets a star since i have to

The employees are extremely kind and personable, but the service is extraordinarily slow. Also, they seem to be randomly closed at times for no particular reason.

I tried the Bacon, Sausage, Egg and Cheese Wrap today. What I did like...the wrap was hot, the bread/wrap itself was good and flaky, it was full and it did taste good. What I didn't like... the sausage was all down in one end, the bacon was one strip of half cooked bacon ( bacon crumbles would be so much better ). Still great service and my Trinta Black Tea gave me my caffeine boost for the day.
I go out of my way to come to this Starbucks. I have two others closer to my house and this one is the best.  Besides the drive through, the drinks are consistently perfect. And very friendly staff!

Sooo, let me preface this by saying I love me some Starbucks but this location is hit or miss and is probably one of the more difficult locations to maneuver in and out of. You are battling traffic from three different establishments and it's just dangerous. If you are ever in a hurry I definitely wouldn't take my chances because for some reason this location takes awhile to get your order done. Sometimes you appreciate the extra time and others it's like you leave wondering why it took so long for you to get something you didn't order. Ahh well, the employees have always been very nice and extremely pleasant but maybe they are just overworked? Not sure, but I can say I just got my pumpkin cream cold brew and it is extremely tasty so today I'm appreciating the wait. If you're going to stop in just plan accordingly!

4 out of 5 visits they're out of at least one thing my girlfriend and I order. Totally under-prepared store and almost a waste of a visit when you have a taste for that one thing you've had on your mind all day, but once again they're out.

I definitely wouldn't go to this particular starbucks to study, very limited parking. Starbucks is starbucks, but the baristas here have been kind of screwing with my orders! Iced macchiato and it tasted spoiled. Next time got the very berry refresher and it looked much lighter than usual and tasted almost like watered down fruit punch -- really watered down. Not too satisfied with the last few drinks but, its Starbucks. I'd just suggest going to another location instead.

It really shocks and saddens me that this Starbucks is rated so low! I have been going to this Starbucks almost everyday since it's opening. Back in the earlier days, my grandmother and I would go before I would go to school and the baristas knew both of our names as well our drinks. Ken Whan was the manager for years and just recently retired. He had numerous articles in the paper about his phenomenal customer service which would make customers always come back to this location. Even though he is retired, this Starbucks still has a great reputation and those customers still come back because the baristas are still great. 

This location has a really nice patio space in the back and comfortable and open seating due to the large windows. Seriously people, this Starbucks is awesome!

I came here for my Free Birthday Coffee, but this Starbucks is great! Of course it has free wi-fi and Spotify music playing, plus it is spacious and has big tables for laptops. I could definitely hang out here and get some writing and blogging done. The baristas were real friendly ladies, too.

I like this location. Despite the fact that it's a popular spot and sometimes the drive thru line is so long it's expanded into the parking lot, I'm never waiting for long and the workers are always moving quickly and keeping the line going. If I have questions about anything, they are usually friendly and more than willing to answer. 

I never have an issue with quality of food or drinks. If you're a Starbucks fan but don't want to wait forever for your order or get out of the car for it, I'd highly suggest this location.

Funny Monica was here recently!

I was killing major time today and it was chilly Latte kinda weather. My first Latte came from 8th and walnut. They were chitchatty and ignoring the customers. However, the barista made killer foam. I am all about the foam. 

This Latte was decent, but the cashier took forever to actually ring me/take my order. Then my Latte was served in the stickiest cup on the planet. When I got up to ask for another one it was like I was asking for the secret code to the lock for the twenties.

The best thing was the nice man I sat next to who shared the table between the chairs and was chatty in a nice not creepy way.
Unfriendly staff, bad customer service, and the beverages don't taste good. Unfortunately, most of the Starbucks in Clearwater are this way.

Put in a mobile order and the store was closed. If I had time to wait in a drive-thru line that wrapped around the building I wouldn't have put in a mobile order. If you aren't open, don't take mobile orders or put a cancel order option on the app

I hate writing bad reviews for places but I think it's time. This is the 5th time that I've been to the Starbucks because it's closest to my house and every time I go it's something different. This Starbucks is a new build, replacing the location previously at the nearby Clearwater Mall. Parking here seems to be a challenge, so I park at the end of the adjacent plaza & walk down the sidewalk on Gulf to Bay. Service has always been quick at this location, and the food options appear to be similar to other Starbucks. The interior is spacious, almost cavernous (read: loud) with high ceilings, but seating is quite plentiful including comfortable pit-style areas, a long bar accommodating many guests, as well as conventional tables for 2-4 people. An outdoor patio area also offers lots of seating. This new Starbucks also has a drive-thru though I haven't taken advantage of that ordering option yet.

After receiving terrible service at Dunkin Donuts with our food, we came to Starbucks to order drinks. The attendant who  Ibelieve was the manger George took our order and he was amazing ! Answered our questions , listened to us , and explained the difference so we made sure we made the right choice ! 

We always appreciate great service ! Thank you !

I'm usually a local coffee shop kinda gal but every now and again I go into a Starbucks because they are conveniently located. Always understaffed, sloth like and poorly stocked. What's going on with this shop that's different from the others? I love this Starbucks! We recently moved from the area, and I am very sad to no longer be able to frequent here. I came often to do work, and became pretty well acquainted with the staff. The layout of this Starbucks is great and allowed quite a few different options to set up shop and kill some time working on my freelance business, classwork, etc!

Usually the best service and kindest people, they were shut down for renovations and just reopened, went today with my 8 yr old daughter and ordered her a pink drink, the lady at the window working named Michele had an attitude and asked if the drink was for my daughter and I told her yes it was and she gave a dirty look and told me you know that has caffeine in it don't you?
I encountered the NICEST woman ever bless her heart. great energy and passion for her job and really made me feel special. Thank you to the barista with short pink hair, you are a godsend
