I am honestly grateful for the mobile app so I can order my drink before and the fact that I no longer work in the area so I don't need to order from this Starbucks

This Starbucks is always busy, but they know how to get customers on their way in the drive thru. Every employee I have talked to has been super nice and my drinks are always perfect!  I always pay using the Starbucks app so I don't have to mess with my debit card. I love this location!!!

There are better locations on the west side than this one (Avon, Brownsburg). This one is usually not busy in the morning, which probably should have been a tip-off.
Worlds best starbucks and even better people. My poodle is also a fan of her daily pup cup.
I've been to many Starbucks in my lifetime and this is by far the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to... inside and drive through.  I've been here multiple times and it's always the same.

Love this place I used to hate coming here because their customer service was terrible and my coffee tasted burnt idk what happened but I have been coming here for the past 3 months and it has been amazing every time! Amazing customer service every time I have came and the workers look happy to be there whatever changed makes me def wait even through the long wait lines and the best part of all is after my awesome experience my coffee is sooooo yummmmmy I can taste it! So yes def after giving it another chance it was absolutely worth it! I'm a loyal Starbucks customer again!

Good, FREE cup of coffee this visit (see my tip, via iPhone app), smiling server, and still $ left on my gift card. Entry and exit feel like my imaginary version of a loop on a Formula One race circuit, so be very careful.

Absolutely awful experience ever time we come here.

Burnt shots, messed up drinks, the list goes on and on. 

I would recommend avoiding this place.

Horrible Starbucks location.

However, this is definitely a NEW Starbucks. I got a tall black coffee (like I always do) and it was cold. I did not get a cold coffee. It was later in the day and they were not busy but part of being the largest premium coffee chain in the country is always having hot premium coffee. 

I don't know the area well enough to recommend a local alternative but it is definitely worth finding one. Considering how many young people live in this area now, I'm sure this place is swamped around rush hour. Do yourself a favor and find some cheaper, better, WARMER coffee somewhere else.

Convenient location near the hotel. It is quite busy so the lines inside and out will be long. Today we got lucky though, in and out in 10 mins. I love this store and wish they could train some folks at 22nd/Kolb.

Morning treat. Store is in a shopping center. But the actual store is not as clean. Alittle disappointed because of COVID store should be kept even clean due to the cdc guild lines.

Standard starbucks but with drive-thru, free wifi, and an amazing, well-spaced outdoor patio.  It's a great place to do work outside the house during COVID

Arnie said " I'll be back ".. but for me. I will not come back.

I used to go to this location all the time.. sometimes even twice a day ! 
The staff and managers there were always great and got to know their regular customers very well. 
Now, you dont see a manager  and the  few people behind the counter just kind of go through the motions. 
I am a regular coffee kind of person.. i dont care for the macha latte or any other sort of coffee concoction. .. just a plain old coffee please !

Sorry Starbucks.. but you have gone downhill . 
I used to love Starbucks.. but now.. I can definitely avoid it.

I took one out off 5 because the interior is not as modern and some other branch but good things are not too crowded, clean, buck of seat and outlet available. Lots of window.
And the staffs are very enthusiastic and friendly!

I spoke with a manager named Carol and she was very nice. She replaced my order and made it right. Like I said this is a great, beautiful and spacious Starbucks and I hate giving negative reviews when people work so hard to get everyone their morning coffees. Most unorganized and dysfunctional Starbucks I have ever been to. As a gold member, nothing makes my day more than my afternoon coffee. Workers are rude and appear as they don't want to be bothered, staff is overwhelmed with the massive drive through line and there have been several times they have told me they can't make my drink due to them being out of certain things such as cold brew and sweet cream. Not your typical Starbucks that's for sure... something is always off at this one! Very disappointing!!!

A fine Starbucks, conveniently located at the intersection of Delmar and Leland, on the loop.

Atmosphere is pretty cozy and offers a roomy workspace in case you want to have a meeting or get a paper done.  The place doesn't feel too large or roomy to be functional or comfortable, though, which is always nice.

Ordered a decaf here and am still drinking it; as I got near the bottom of the cup-- feh!-- grounds!  Oh well, maybe they were just a fluke.
Rude as hell the worst service didn't shake drink didn't even use manners I work in service I understand how hard it can be but the experience I had was ridiculous rude

Came to this facility this morning asked for a trenta pink drink no strawberries 4 pumps of vanilla . I got 4 scoops of strawberries and vanilla! So I came back this the facility this evening order same one even said please no strawberries explain what happen this morning I get my drink there was a strawberry in I said no strawberries she said oh it just fell in it like no bug deal !!! I will go else wheee ! They need help the line was so long there was 4 ahead of us took 47 minutes have a great day

The worst experience at a Starbucks I have ever had by far. Their order online system and online store hours said they were open, but they closed early due to a "glitch in the system". I knocked to try to say that we had a mobile online order and the employee practically yelled at me and said sorry we're closed. I said we had a mobile order and it was shrugged off and said we can contact mobile to get a refund. Absolutely ridiculous, get your hours and staff right. Shop local folks, Starbucks is going downhill.

Got the pink drink which is a must!
Friendly drive employee and no wait! Whoo hoo!
Right behind Tijuana Flats

Everything is always sold out on the app but when you go in person/drive thru they magically have it. Call it a conspiracy theory but I think they purposely sell out of everything online because they can't keep up with the demand of the app. This is super annoying because it is the closest Starbucks to my house but it takes 20+ minutes or more when you show up in the drive thru or in person (first world problems). 

The only reason I gave it an extra star is that the people in the store are always very sweet and nice. This is a management problem and they need to reflect accurately what is on their app.

My husband and I have been working from home together since the pandemic and decided after some appointments we'd grab breakfast to head straight home and eat while we started working. I ordered on my app which is super convenient and says ready ASAP. Their estimate was like 15 minutes or so for a croissant sandwich, egg bites, and two hot drinks. We pulled up with 5 minutes left of the time estimate but I went inside anyway so I would hear my name when it was ready. I walked in and it was being put on the counter at that same time which I was pleasantly surprised about. Everything was great but I can tell the food was pre-made and heated in some way. It was fine but I'd probably just get a drink next time.

Also, people need read the drive thru signage and not block the entire entrance as well as blocking the road to pass to other businesses nearby. It leaves an extremely unsafe setup for others. Be careful coming and going!

I'd give this particular Starbucks a pass, if I were you.  The wait is generally quite long.  I've waited up to 10 minutes at the drive through where, unfortunately, you can't get away once you're stuck there.  Today, with the drive through line of cars hitting about 8, I went inside.  There was no one in front of me in line so I thought this would be good.  However, I waited at the counter for about 2 minutes with no one coming to take my order.  After that I just left, thinking that if it is more than 2 minutes to take my order, how long would it be to actually get a cup of coffee.  I wish I could cash in the Starbucks gift card I got - so not worth it.  Also, I've gotten an inedible breakfast sandwich here with my coffee once in the drive through.  The muffin-and-ham sandwich was still ice cold in the middle.  So, give this place a pass and hit one of the non-chain coffee shops nearby.  I'm definitely pretty annoyed with this store and won't bother going back.

Lack of staff and busy morning commuters can make for a crazy and stressful day for baristas. The team members of Starbucks really step up and maintain such a lovely attitude when dealing with some less than pleasant uncaffinated humans waiting for their items in a long line.
I have been so impressed with the staff and they move fast and efficient and keep up the cheer- I will always back people who work hard when they are in a tough spot. I can't make the grumpy people nicer- but I can say that the people at Starbucks are amazing and I am thankful for all they do!

This facility is large, and spacious.  However, the staff is horrible.  For almost 2 minutes today April 2, 2017, three employees were playing "pat-a-cake" literally at the cash rap. (I have several videos of these employees doing this). I would be happy to provide these videos to management.  How in any way, shape, or form is this appropriate in a packed restaurant/coffee spot where people are studying, working, and conducting meetings?  There did not seem to be a manager around to make sure that the employees were doing their jobs, and not goofing off while customers became onlookers, and people were waiting in line.  I will be returning to study, but management really needs to get their act together, and make sure that their employees are doing their jobs, and not making this location in Lionville the laughing stock of the area.

A little facts on Starbucks...originally, Starbucks offered only two sizes: short (8 ounces) and tall (12 ounces). When the company added grande, venti and trenta, they kept the old names for the original drinks.

At most Starbucks around the world, the size options are: short (8 ounces), tall (12 ounces), grande (16 ounces), venti (24 ounces), and trenta (31 ounces).

Grande is Italian for 'large,' venti means 'twenty,' and trenta is 'thirty'. 

After a trip to Italy in 1983, founder Howard Schultz became obsessed with its coffee bars and wanted to introduce Italian names. As customers demanded larger sizes, 'short' was taken off the menu board so the larger sizes of 'venti' and 'trenta' sizes could be added Tall ended up becoming the smallest sized drink on the printed menu.
