There were NO open seats homeless "patrons" were taking all the seats. I looked down and saw a bag with bugs crawling all over it. No, not eating here and if Starbucks is into the homeless more than coffee and pastry customers maybe they should open shelters. Expensive coffee and not a seat to drink it in... great business model, I wont ever go back.
Great service. Staff was very helpful. Didn't have to wait too long for all our drink. Sat outside under the umbrella enjoying the great Arizona weather.
We are from Pittsburgh and we are visiting Nashville for the weekend. We had a huge order for our party and Allison gave us the best service that we've ever had at any Starbucks!

Rude Baristas used to be a fun place to go to a couple years ago now I 
don't even look forward to going there anymore

Let's face it: Starbucks are like Walgreen's - one on just about every corner in town. For the coffee lover, that's a good thing because you know you are never far from a hot cup of java. The thing that sets this particular Starbucks apart is the congenial, helpful staff. Often I stop in not for coffee but because I'm having a bit of a down day and need a lift in spirit. 

With very few exceptions, the baristas here always seem to enjoy helping their customers...and that's something you don't see every day! I know that no matter what the situation or time of day I can count on Sandy, Shelly, Emily, Heidy, Patrick and the rest of the staff to not only put a smile on my face and a tasty drink in my hand, but to make me feel valued as a customer and a friend.

A tip: For value and the best tasting cup of coffee you can get at Starbucks, treat yourself to a French Press. To me, that is the only way to discover the true flavor of the many coffees available. Be sure and ask your barista about food pairings to go with your coffee too. It is amazing the flavors you can experience when food and coffee are properly matched. 

Now for the drawbacks. My past couple of visits here I've noticed a disturbing trend: one of the managers (at least he acts like a manager...I can't be positive) has a bad habit of talking down to the rest of the staff and tends to be a bit of a tool. From some of the comments I've heard it seems like he may have some unresolved anger issues. (If he weren't of above-average stature, I'd say it was a Napoleon complex.) Not sure what his deal is but it makes me wonder about what kind of people skills Starbucks requires managerial candidates to have. While it hasn't been enough (yet) to make me not return, it's getting really close.

This is not the best Starbucks but they get four stars for having quick service and the standard Starbucks fare. If you get there early in the morning, there is typically no line at the drive-thru.

The parking lot for this Starbucks is horribly designed and the drive-thru is even worse. It is especially at the apex of a U-turn. If you have a larger car, it is impossible to get close to the callbox. I have seen lines here back up to ten cars. The wait can be long, so if you are in a hurry, this is not your spot.

On this particular visit, I went inside to avoid the drive-thru line and ended up leaving before placing an order. Starbucks could probably put another location in Ambler. This one just gets too much traffic..
Ordered a white chocolate mocha - was weak on all flavors, including the coffee flavor! Not sure how you can screw up coffee!

10/10!! They are truly looking out for you here :) 
This is my new favorite Starbucks AND the blonde espresso is my new favorite drink, thanks to a great recommendation :)

There's a big parking lot (no drive-thru) here, the restaurant itself is pretty large, and you can order ahead. What's not to like, besides the wait-time? *Shrug.* It's a Starbucks, man. It's exactly what you expect.
It was good. Really like the vibes I was getting! Was busy, but understandable because all the drinks were heavily modified, I like my drinks simple. Please support our baristas by ordering simple.

Very rude, dropped an espresso cup  on accident and was planning to pay for it. It was my fault, but Employee looked at me rudely and rolled his eyes... had an attitude and for no reason. I will not come back to this Starbucks EVER! If you do not enjoy your job then don't work for the company. You never know who's having a bad day & you treating someone worse ... does not make things better. I did not order anything from Starbucks.

I love starbucks! This location not so much. Stopped in thinking it was going to be fast. Ordered my venti iced latte with coconut milk and paid.  While i was waiting i saw people cleaning because they were not busy. About 5 minutes pass and my order wasnt even started. I ask if they got my order and they were like no, the machine didnt print it out.  After that my order was made. I didnt get my good vibe in this starbucks. I will return cause it a good location. Its off the plant city exit. Easy in and out of the interstate.
Starbucks corporate!!!!!!!! .  You really need to come help re-train the people in this store.   Short staff and lack of experience

I'm pretty disappointed in this place. I come here often and today I order an extra hot chocolate and they handed it to me and it felt pretty empty but I didn't think much of it. Once I drove off I lifted the lid and my cup was only half full?

Starbucks is a very popular coffee shop, whenever I go to the drive through there are always at least three cars in front of me, and there is a reason for that. Starbucks doesn't just have a wide variety of drinks and food, but their customer service is the best I've ever gotten from a restaurant. Every time I go there all the employees talk to me, they ask about my day, how I am, and small conversation you just don't see at other cafes. The other day one of the employees even gave me study tips on how to do better on finals! He told me about his experience and how I can do it. It really makes a popular chain restaurant so much more familiar, like I can go there and I know I will leave with a smile on my face. 

I love the customer service but don't get me wrong, the product is of course the most important factor. Starbucks has a ride variety of food and drinks, from Frappuccino's (which are a milkshake sometimes made with coffee), iced coffee, hot coffee, hot chocolate, sandwiches, muffins, bagels, oatmeal, yogurt, and so much more. Whatever you enjoy eating, I assure you, they will have it at Starbucks.

If I had to add a critique I would only say to add more locations. Then long waits and lines wouldn't be as much of a issue and they wouldn't run out of product as quickly. There is no wonder Starbucks is so popular, delicious food paired with amazing customer service. Overall going to Starbucks is such an amazing experience and if you haven't gone yet I would recommend it!

-KS

This location might be the worst Starbucks ever. 

Our orders are routinely incorrect. 
And our drinks are routinely under poured. 

The employees are usually rude and really seem like making orders is a pain for them. Maybe you should not be in a customer service roll.

This is one of the worst starbucks i have ever been to. who knew that you would have to mobile order an hour before you wanted your starbucks. I just waited 30 minutes to get my hot tea. They never printed out the mobile order receipts, people were coming and going who were in line. I believe starbucks noted that mobile ordering is for people who are in a rush, they just made me 15 minutes late for class. This starbucks needs to get it together or they are going to lose customers.

I'm sorry; I know it's still COVID and they're a new franchise who may be training more folks, but this Starbucks is the WORST I have ever experienced in town. The people are so nice, but there is a massive disconnect between ordering and receiving your coffee/drinks. Even the busiest shops in Franklin/Cool Springs turn around customers quicker with double the crowd. 

We've tried to order in-store, online pickup, drive thru - every option comes with a minimum of a 15-20 minute wait as they all run around and forget who's order is actually finished and who's needs making. Really want to like this spot, but with other coffee options nearby, can't see us keeping up with a place that holds no value on decent service. Hope it improves!

The Barista's here need to take another course in customer service. They aren't kind. As many times as I've been to this location (over 25), it is always the same experience. They seem as though they are frustrated that they have customers, and the wait is unbelievable! Drive thru or inside, be prepared to wait over 20 minutes. As I sit in the drive thru line now for the past 15 minutes, I anticipate another 10 minutes or more since there are 4 cars ahead of me. If this wasn't the only drive thru Starbucks close by, I would definitely not return to this location.

Caramel macchiato paired with the chicken sausage and bacon biscuit.   Pure yummy!

Mic drop!!

Walked in at 8:25 was told sorry we are closed. I asked what time do y'all close... the girl said 9 when I told her it was only 8:30 she said sorry we are closed as I said. She walked me out and locked the door behind me. 11/06. Rude as all hell! Closed over 30 minutes early and was nasty.

I placed an order through the app this morning for pick up in-store.  I arrived five minutes later and noticed that there was a large crowd waiting for orders, but the staff worked diligently to get those orders out in a timely manner.  They were focused and the barista that handled my order was very polite. I was concerned about ordering too far in advance, rendering my food and drink cold, but I think I'll place it 12-15 minutes prior to my arrival in the future.

I ordered a featured item, the Pistachio Latte with an almond biscotti and a bacon, egg and cheese croissant sandwich.  The pistachio latte was soooo warm and delicious on this slightly snowy day and it paired perfectly with the almond biscotti being dipped in it!  I was also very pleased with the sandwich.  The croissant was soft and buttery and brought all the sandwich components together in perfect harmony!  Will order all again!
Line takes forever in morning. The drive thru people are very rude sometimes when you ask about the products they offer.

Of course we all love starbucks!

But lately I have found that my caramel mochiato doesn't taste the same as sometimes they don't have all the ingredients. Also, the location that I go to is the one on Town Center. I would order food in advance, go pick it up to find out that they didn't have what I ordered and I had to find some kind of alternative; then wait for them to prepare it which is what I wanted to avoid in the first place.

I wish that they would have called me in advance to let me know what they don't have in my order to spare me the wait. 

I learned my lesson not to order in advance, but on site or drive-thru.

Just going to say that you guys need to get a bigger stock of food supplies. Every time I go to this location my usual drink doesn't taste how it should. I'm guessing their syrups aren't remixed everyday for good flavor. Today I even went back to get it fixed and it still came out bitter and like it's mixed w other things, but they insured me it was the right ingredients so I don't know. I'm just disappointed, this is my go to drink and I know exactly how it should be. And the past 3 times this location has made some funky drinks.

I have a love/hate relationship with this Starbucks.  It's always there for me, but it's always there for literally every IUPUI student and medical center employee too.  Fast, friendly baristas... but it's loud and crowded in here.  Parking is difficult in the winter when the snow builds up and during the lunch rush, but what can you expect when it's *everyone's* go to spot?

First time at this location in an area called The Loop. It's a half mile walking distance from Washington University Danforth Campus. 

A FREE birthday reward was redeemed for a chocolate chip Frappuccino. Staff was friendly and drink yum! It's a small dining room but I found a clean table. The area was overall tidy. However the bathroom hallway was full of boxes which was unattractive. 

I would return. 3.5 rounding up.

This Starbucks is trying it's best. 

It's drive-thru is probably the busiest drive-thru not connected to a McDonald's of Chik-fil-a in Greenwood. They work hard to get your order correct, fresh, and to you and if they are achieving that they are successful in my eyes. They've been of consistent quality as long as I can remember and the pandemic hasn't put changed that from experiences!

This isn't just your average Starbucks. Walk through their doors and feel like you're home. I will go out of my way to see my favorite barista's at this location, they have been known to put a smile on my face even during a rough day. It's more than just my coffee, it's a cup of sunshine. A little cheesy? Yes. But to top it all off, if you are not as into the feel good stuff as I am, they make a perfect drink here.

When you order a hot coffee drink (Hot Venti Americano - extra shot) at nearly 5 bucks, you kind of want it at the right "hot" temperature. At least I do. This clearly wasn't. Lukewarm at best. I brought it up nicely and I was met with an insistent recalcitrant attitude. The young girl offered to add steamed cream which I never asked for, nor did I want. I would avoid this Starbucks until they get the issue taken care of. Turn up the hot water temp! Easy fix.

Always a great Starbucks! Their team is super friendly and knows many regulars by name. They always seem to get drinks out quickly no matter how many people are in line and the store is always clean and well stocked. They even have Cold Brew and Nitro Cold Brew on tap!

Cancelled my order after waiting 40 minutes. No offer of refund or to even check on status of it. The employees are trying but store cannot handle volume. You are better off going to one of the many local coffee shops nearby.

Waited 40 minutes and paid 6 bucks to get a cup of iced milk instead of the shaken espresso I ordered. I typically wouldn't leave a review, but this has now happened to me multiple times. I will not be coming back.

Hats off to Jenny at the Rock Hill store.  I ordered through mobile app but after waiting 20 min I told Jenny I was leaving without my drink.  Around lunch I thought I would stop by to see if I could get the drink.  As I walked up, Jenny greeted me by name and asked if I wanted my Caramel Macchiato!  I had never been in the store so it's not like she recognized me as a "regular."  It was awesome to be treated like she genuinely cared!  Hope your supervisors appreciate you as much as I did!!
I absolutely love this Starbucks location, the baristas are always super happy and helpful! Thanks for being a positive experience always

I drove all the way to this location for my favorite drink the peach tea lemonade which was an available at the location closer to home.
It's a long way but I'd rather go there and know that they have exactly what, rather than to drive around locally trying to find a location with it.
I love the bacon Gouda sandwiches as well and they had them readily available which made me happy only drawback was it was extremely busy and even going inside and ordering was an extended wait in order to have my order fulfilled.But at least I got what I went therefore and I just hopped back on I 75 S and headed back home.
This location is absolutely bonkers. Waited a pretty long stretch for a tall black coffee. I think they were a barista short or something. Grab coffee BEFORE the mall!

The customer service needs to be improved, our order was missing food and when we called to ask them
They were very dry and rude. It sounded like they didn't care that THEY FORGOT TO PUT OUR FOOD IN THE BAG

Ok if they had bad employees they must be gone now. I had a wonderful girl serving us and she was very sweet to us early in the morning. We had ordered food and coffee all came out hot and good.  I'm on vacation so I'm in a pretty good mood myself and I guess that's kinda the general rule right. Treat people as how you want to be treated. Definitely returning for my drinks here in the future.

The absolute best Starbucks in Brandon. I have noticed they receive major slack for the time it takes to receive your order but what do you expect as it is in a central area of Branson. Other locations are tucked away or away from major traffic but this one is busy ALL the time. I've walked in tons of times and they welcome me by name. The managers are always available to speak to and the staff have no problem in correcting your order. I can tell you depending on the day I may request extra pumps of flavoring and they quickly respond. I have become very patient due to the personalities of the staff within the location. When I am super busy, I order pick up but the experience becomes different. The staff always ask me about my day or compliment something about me. They exude exemplary customer service that I can't help but to return over and over. My favorite person is Johnny. Sometimes I come order something just to see him not because the coffee is well as you know amazing. He simply makes my day. His smile brightens the room and he always checks to make sure my order is correct. I truly appreciate the time he as well as others take in making my coffee. I always look forward to my next purchase. Please go in and say hi to the staff especially Johnny and you may update any negative reviews.

I've been going to this Starbucks for at least 5 years. I'm not sure why I've never wrote a review before. ‍ This Starbucks is the friendliest on the Illinois St. Louis metro side. Since I'm a regular, they all know my name and greet me with it. The only other place I get that is Target in Edwardsville, but I worked there.  They are all super friendly and hold good conversations- when not busy. I think I've only had two issues in the years I've been coming here, and that is a lot when I'm a regular. They corrected the issue, without hesitation, and were apologetic about it. I've seen this with other customers too, not just regulars. Good food, good drinks, and good baristas.

went out of my way to come here. Sat in the drive-through for 8 minutes. When I get up to the window, I sit for another five or six minutes. Then they tell me The espresso machine is not working. Then asked if I wanted something else. I said no, I went out of my way to come here to get a latte. She said sorry about that and gave me my money back. I just sat there for 14 minutes and my time was not acknowledged. They didn't offer me a free drink, free food. A gift card. Nothing. Justa "sorry about that". Just left me super annoyed that I wasted so much time for nothing.  I know many other Starbucks would try to compensate for some thing so serious but not this one I suppose.

My drink was good, but the person at the window put out a weird vibe that's sticking with me. I'll shake it off, but get some social skills.  You might just be the only person someone gets to see or speak to today. Just be nice... maybe smile.

By far my favorite Starbucks location in the New Orleans area! The service is usually very fast and if there ever is a wait, I'm never in line for more than 20 minutes. Every staff member at this location is very accommodating, energetic and friendly! Caesar is always a pleasure to see in the mornings when picking up or placing my order. Also to mention that this location and their baristas are ALWAYS consistent! My coffee always tastes very good. Thanks N. Causeway staff for always making my mornings better!

I mean, it is Starbucks so you can't expect a whole lot. When I entered the store it was quite messy and nobody acknowledged me. I stood at the counter for a few minutes before I was asked for my order. I chose a peppermint mocha with whipped cream. The wait time was about 5 minutes, not too bad. The milk tasted burnt however. Bleh. I was going to ask if I could have ny drink redone but the barista at the bar seemed in a bad mood so i didn't wanna make things worse.

They did a renovation which is nice because it doesn't look very dirty like it used to. But the people working there especially the old guys are still very rude and not friendly. I am not against old people working but they need to be nicer! Anyway. They also started putting locks on the bathroom doors and refusing homeless people using the bathrooms. They are people too. They just need to use the bathroom. Just ask them to not stay in there forever. It's not like they are the only one who would mess up your toilets!!!!!! Not sure about other Starbucks but this one is very close to where I work so I come here a lot and I see too much I gotta say!

I understand all fast food is over worked but when you do a mobile order. Your drink should come out as you placed it. I say light ice every time and every time is like they purposely add extra ice. When a drink is 7 bucks every day. You want it to be made correctly.

I ordered a Venti Pike place online 15 mins prior to arriving at this Starbucks . Once I arrived, I waited for about another 15 mins before I was asked what I ordered. By that time, I was running late for work and had to leave. I rarely have issues ordering online at this location but I guess they were busier than normal. 

Oh well

This has been going on for a few weeks and I can't ignore it any longer...
There's a new assistant manager named Amy at this store and her presence is intolerable any longer. 
The energy she puts off is not pleasant, the staff vibe is ruined when she's on shift and I just can't stand being in her presence.
I used to be a District Manager for a Fortune 200 company in retail and she would not survive in one of my stores, no clue how she's a Starbucks member, much less in a management or leadership role. I hope Starbucks doesn't lose staff over her as this is one of the best crews in Tucson and where I go 4-7 times a week to study with my daughter.
Starbucks, listen to me, Amy needs to go, you're jeopardizing longtime customers and valuable staff because of one bad element...

We order two drinks plus food and go to use the restroom. It's locked with a keypad. No sign that "bathrooms are closed." We ask the barista and they said this is now a "pickup" store and bathrooms are closed even though they have two. The lobby is open and the drive thru is open and the bathrooms are open...unacceptable. I'd avoid this location....dc

Don't go to this Starbucks. Pregnant with my third kid and barely sleeping with bad pregnancy brain. I stopped by the Starbucks while walking my dogs because my daughter was hungry. I went inside to get her a snack. Being human and a tired, sleep deprived mom I accidentally walked off without my dogs. Realizing this shortly after, I called Starbucks in a panic & about in tears and told them I was not far away and was literally sprinting back to the store.  I asked if they could make sure no one steals them or anything. They said okay I see them and sure. WELL After this they called animal control and the sheriffs department on me. The sheriff told me after seeing my dogs she realized this wasn't really an appropriate call & that I was obviously a sleep deprived mom. She said she could tell I felt terrible and that my dogs were extremely well behaved and well cared for. She then told me to leave before animal control got there. Luckily, the sheriff was so understanding and kind. I will never return to this location. In the past they have done annoying things like mess up my drinks etc but I understand that mistakes happen and have never gotten upset. Now, I'm MAD. Support a local coffee shop instead. I am so easy to please this is my FIRST negative review. I usually only review things I love.

They are very, very busy here during peak times of the day. Unfortunately, I don't think the new staff at this location are prepared for the kind of rush they are receiving. 

The drive-thru is always insane, and the cars in the drive-thru end up blocking spaces for people that want to park. Someone should really look into that because in the morning you end up with a huge traffic jam in this parking lot which leads to issues on Speedway (which itself is already heavily congested in the mornings). There needs to be some sort of order in this chaos. 

Drinks, even if ordered 10 minutes ahead on the app, are slow to appear. I've had several times where I ordered 10+ minutes ahead, walked in, and still ended up having to wait for a drink. That would be acceptable, I guess, if every time I showed up my drink was correct. 

On two occasions I have come in and waited for a drink only to have them put whipped cream on it -- which I specifically have them take off. The little sticker will even say no whipped cream and it appears. The first time this happened, the barista immediately noticed and remade my drink from scratch. It was appreciated. She gave the one with whipped cream to me and I passed it along to a co-worker as I have dairy issues and can't even have whipped cream on my coffee without tummy upset. This barista, I unfortunately did not get her name, gets a STELLAR 5 STARS!  

The second time, I had to tell the barista that I didn't want whipped cream. She seemed annoyed, but saw this on the sticker, and took a spoon and scooped the cream out, then gave the drink back. A huge portion of the cup was whipped cream -- much larger than normal. I told her I wasn't trying to be a pain, but I'd like the drink remade since (1) I cannot have dairy and (2) almost 1/4 of the cup had been whipped cream. It was not my mistake and normally anywhere else they'd be happy to accommodate this request. The grumpily agreed, kind of snatched the cup back, and remade the drink. It was just poor service -- I understand them being busy, I get the frustration, but when I'm paying $7-8 for a latte I would prefer it to be made properly. This barista reduced my review to 3 stars and has made me question ever coming back. 

This location is one I won't visit anymore unless I've somehow made an error in judgement and forgot to stop at my regular location(s). There are a lot of Starbucks locations and I won't make an effort to patronize one that won't make an effort to get my drink order correct, and in the event there is an error correct it without sass.

This Starbucks is a mess. I've gone here many times as it's close to the interstate, the baseball fields, etc. If you have 45 minutes to waist in line, go for it. Their cafe is rarely open and now they even close early on the weekend. They try to be friendly, but it comes off as hollow when they are obviously not trying to work hard to get your order out as right and fast as possible. I don't ever expect a Starbucks to be super fast but this is absolutely ridiculous!
They fired three good employees never going back... who fired them and whyyy. so lame.

I normally have good experiences with this Starbucks but not today. I ordered 2 strawberry refreshers and for some reason there's a fizz in both of them and it tastes old which makes me more worried. I'm trying to call to let them know and NO ONE is answering the phone I called 5 times already no answer. I don't spend $5 on a drink for it to taste like shit Starbucks !!!!
Didn't have my card and only had $100 bill, young preppy dude was acting like a baby and would not take my $100. Maybe put a sign up Starbucks. Not coming here again.

Waited in the drive thru line for over 30 minutes at this location which is by far the LONGEST I have ever waited in a Starbucks line.  This was in the afternoon on a Monday... not even what I would consider to be "rush hour".  Extremely frustrating!!

I was about to start acting as a bouncer for this amazing crew this morning. This team was busting their buttons to manage a huge number of customers this morning and dealing qith rude customers that were angry about things that the employees had no literal control over! Sorry Karen they were out of vanilla flavor to make most of their drinks. Is that the batista fault? Nope! They did the best they could with the conditions they were forced to deal with. Also the doctor stalking the hard working barista talking about your stupid coffee with this much ice and water... I saw you and you are a self entitled turd. Props to the morning crew for handling everything thrown at you with a positive attitude and the patience of saints.

The worst Starbucks experience I've had in a while. NO parking at 3pm, lot of people working inside at tables. I had to tell the barista my drink order 3 times (unsweetened green tea, light ice...not that hard!) and requested that they use my sweetener packets and they said it wasn't a problem.

I went to the restroom and when I came out, my iced tea still was not ready (no one was in front of me in line and no drive through customers). There were 4 total baristas and they were all talking to each other on their headsets about someone they knew in high school. Social hour apparently. 

When I finally got my drink, my sweetener packets were floating my in drink. I was shocked and audibly said "seriously?!" And they looked at me like I was crazy. When I said my sweetener was floating in it, they offered to remake my drink but seeing as I still had a 2 hour drive, I wasn't interested in waiting to get it remade.

Needless to say, I will not be visiting this location again.

This place is usually really good at service but today it wasn't the best Sam was the person who did my drink but he messed it up and then when I asked for what I got he gave me sass which didn't feel good and made me feel bad then he forgot my friends drink so we waited for like 5 minutes and he still didn't make it then we finally asked and he was definitely annoyed and then he Aggressively graded the cup and she said that the drink didn't taste as well as it usually did and that it didn't look right

went with a group of friends during a monday around 4pm. one friend ordered an iced caramel macchiato and there was no extra caramel and the drink was already mixed (the milk wasn't separated like it usually is when served). the same thing happened with another girl who ordered a similar drink. another friend had no caramel drizzle on the top of her drink, even though it was on her receipt. when i ordered the girl informed me that they were out of grande cups. she basically led me to believe that they couldn't just make  grande drink in a venti cup, so i had to get a tall. when i got it the cup was only 3/4 of the way full and half of the drink was foam. i couldn't even get to the actual liquid. definitely do not go to this location. i give 2 stars

This location never lets me down. They always have my togo order ready within moments of arriving. I totally avoid the drive thru line as you probably already know, they are always long and I have no patience. Going inside almost feels like a life hack. Always friendly, consistent and efficient.

This is your typical Starbucks, overcrowded, standard menu and awfully long drive-thru line. The service is exponentially friendly and very patient. 

Tips: 
-Order inside. I was behind three people and still got my coffee within 5 minutes or ordering. Beats waiting in drive-thru line!
-Avoid around the 9am hour.
-Get your order to go. Seating is spotty.

Busy spot. 
Friendly, quick service.  One thing though, I frequent Starbucks all over the world and I have to say this one had one of the filthiest bathrooms I've seen. (I've seen gas stations with cleaner). The employees are so busy they can't keep on top of it. If Starbucks wants their facilities open to all, not just patrons, then they need to hire a service to keep this up.  It's gross!

I feel like I'll come back to this Starbucks whenever I've had a bad day just to have the barista cheer me up. I have never had such kind service - and not in an uncomfortable over-the-top way. It was just natural compliments and manners followed up with a coupon to use in the next few days. Wonderful. The kind of charming staff that remembers regulars.

Otherwise, it's a smaller Starbucks, definitely meant for the 9-5 crowd to stop in and turn around. If you're looking for a quiet, cozy place to get work done then this probably isn't it. But that's okay because it serves its purpose well: giving stressed, busy downtown employees a reason to smile real quick before getting back to work. It may get a little less busy when a Starbucks opens within the forthcoming downtown Whole Foods next month.
Amazing this store is so funny. The workers laugh over everything I say! Come here! Pleaseeeeeeeeeee come here rn the people will love to assist you :)

I will preface this review by saying I am biased about this location because I am a regular with it being in walking distance from my work. This is my favorite Starbucks by far due to the staff being so welcoming and helpful. They aren't ever afraid to admit when they make mistakes or to fix something when you are unsatisfied with your order. 

Everywhere I go I have to customize to my order and this place is probably where it gets the most complicated. I appreciate that although they can't remember every detail of my order they have committed the basic components of it to memory. These employees are not only very friendly but very efficient also. They are always busy but they manage the customers inside as well as the drive thru impressively fast. 

Don't hesitate to stop at this location for your chain coffee fix if you are ever in this part of the suburbs.
This is the filthiest Starbucks I have ever been in.  Hard to enjoy a cup of coffee when your surroundings are just gross!

After six weeks Tucktaway in quarantine, and not being able to find a Starbucks anywhere... It was like finding gold to realize the location had finally opened up! It's amazing how much you miss something when it's no longer there!

This Starbucks location is worth a stop just because it is one of only 3 (at the time of this writing) locations in the greater Indianapolis area able to serve a COLD FOAM CASCARA NITRO. It's a deliciously smooth, lightly sweet treat that is worth going a few miles out of your way.

This location is large, with plenty of seating and pleasant employees. It's a great stop to satisfy your coffee cravings.

Well the mobile order said 10-18 minute wait. 
25min in and no order yet. 

Not well maintained. Poo service and bad attitudes. 

Disorganized and unhelpful 
No cans of refresher drinks. Needed to be refunded. 

The Starbucks experience has really gone down hill with the over expansion of the last 2 years.  City locations still seem to be able to attract decent baristas but the suburbs are truly lacking. 

Maybe Starbucks school is needed

Nice location and helpful barrister.  Took my dad to The Clearwater location.  With this being his first Starbucks experience I didn't  know what to pick.  My server was nice enough to ask a few questions then suggested a latte.  Needless to say, my father enjoyed it and has been asking for coffee every since.  Great experience.  
Thank you!!! I wish I remembered the name of the person that helped me...

The last 2 times I have been to this location I have gotten a grande and both times they have put a venti cap on my drink. If I move to straw it comes off, and keeps falling off making my drink spill all over me.

Most staff was disinterested, boarder line rude. Coffee was ok. Not sure why Starbucks corp doesn't check reviews and fix problems. Luckily there are other alternatives now so it's easy to avoid visiting Starbucks again.

I live in southern Indianapolis, but work up here in Fishers. When I tell you that I haven't gone to any other Starbucks besides this one (with the exception of when I travel) in months, I am being entirely honest. The employees are so kind and welcoming. Everyone is very patient with me, as I am not much of a coffee drinker. Today I decided I needed a "pick me up" after spending yesterday put on the water and working all day today at work. I ordered myself a green tea, an impossible sandwich, and ordered my manager a peach tranquility tea. I picked up my mobile order in the drive thru and when I got to the window, Aaron was there to greet me. Aaron was a new face for me at this location, but he/they did a wonderful job. He/they (apologies if this is not your preferred pronoun!) double checked my name and items. He/they handed me each item as he/they told me what each one was and he/they was extremely kind. I left with a smile from ear to ear because of the kindness Aaron had showed me at the drive thru window. I know these reviews sound silly, but as someone who also works in a setting where I interact with customers daily, I truly value when I visit an establishment and the employees are kind. Honestly, the smallest bit of kindness can go such a long way and today is that much better because of the kindness Aaron showed me.

This is the starbucks you go to if you're trying to get someone to make you a super complicated drink- the absolute correct way and without an attitude, even in the drive through. I always order off menu extra complicated drinks that literally make these poor people have to do math in order to concoct these beverages and they still do it with a smile.

Out of all the Starbucks near this area, I think this is the best one. People are friendly for the most part and they're efficient at making the drinks. Only downfall is that they often close early due to staffing issue (same as million other stores during COVID) so sometimes I have to wait a day or two before I can go back and order my coffee. 

Fun fact: I only order my pumpkin spice latte from this location since I can actually taste the pumpkin when I order it from here. I think they're really good about following the recipe card :)

Upon picked up the cup, it's so light.  Opened the cap and only saw the cup was 1/4 full.  I asked is it a Grande, the barrister said yes and seemed like this is not the first time, I was immediately offered to make a new cup.  The next cup was way more. Other than that, the service is excellent.  However, I may get a new title as 'male Karen'.

If no stars was possible that's what they would get....this Starbucks has the most incompetent staff in town.  I consistently get the worst drinks from them as they can not follow directions.  Not once have they gotten my drink order correct.  I have even ordered simple drinks they should not mess up like a green tea latte and they do not add enough of the mixture and I end up with a milk drink essentially.  So incompetent!

The incredibly friendly and attentive staff here bring the rating up to three.  If it were not for them, I'd give it a one, because this is not a particularly enjoyable Starbucks location.  St Pete, doing its best to be a 'big city', has a decent number of homeless folks in the vicinity of this Starbucks, and they are constantly coming in, spreading their belongings out, coughing without covering, etc.  Pinellas already has a Hep A issue, so I'm sorry, but I don't really like homeless people in my chosen eating establishments.

The bathroom has a pointless combo lock on it, and I say pointless because as we all know Starbucks policy is to no longer ask if someone is a paying customer, so they just give the code out to anyone who asks anyway.  That of course has lead to a disgusting bathroom I won't use.

Next up, the non-homeless expensive condo population of St Pete, who are also in close vicinity.  That brings in a combo of either yoga pants and 'service animal' dog as an dress accessory, or male with AirPods talking about their next awe-inspiring business deal way too loudly.

Finally, the place is kept ice cold and music loud, probably to encourage people to not stay too long.
Online order so not much info for employee interaction. Was ready fast before the online time though. Dine in and restrooms closed of course, but seemed like a decent spot for the IUPUI campus etc.
The simple things in life matter! During this pandemic I have still enjoyed my Sugar-Free Vanilla Cappuccino!  Additionally the measures they have taken for safety are so welcomed!
I came In today and the gentlemen at the window was so kind to me . I have a migraine and he even asked me if I wanted a cup Of ice. So genuine and caring! Thank you.

I always drive by this location and forget it's a Starbucks. This location is in an older looking brick building, bit different from their usual look. Most of the time I don't see many people here, if any at all. Decided to swing by since the other location on 116th, closer to I-69, had horrible service. I went through the drive thru. The barista was super friendly and quickly made my drink exactly how I ordered it. Will definitely choose this location over the one closer to I-69.
Took 45 minutes to make a latte with no alterations.... constantly was told "your drink will be right up" pathetic attention to customer service
This starbucks sucks it never has anything in stock and is so dirty no caramel or strawberrys and ive visited this Starbucks 4 times in the same month not once did they have what i wanted

Most unprofessional business I've been at in years. I was overcharged and my coffee was made wrong. I'm 6months pregnant and had to walk back to the Starbucks in the snow, I get to Starbucks and tell the girl my coffee was made wrong and I ask her to please fix it - she tells me "No" and tells me she made the coffee right the 1st time. I have my receipt and my full coffee in my hand, and I tell her that if she isn't going to fix the coffee then I want a refund, and then she tells me she is going to refuse me service bc I am with a man who is a racist... I was like "I'm here alone" and then she says that she seen me with a racist man when I ordered my coffee the 1st time so she doesn't have to fix it or refund me my money... WTF? I'm so mad I am shaking. I paid $8.17 for a coffee that is undrinkable. I told her I was going to call corporate and asked for her name and she took her name tag off and called the casino security on me. (This Starbucks is inside the casino) The security guards thought she was in the wrong and they were only concerned about me and my baby bc I was crying tears of injustice at this point. So I walked back home with no coffee and no refund. I'm high risk pregnancy and I'm not supposed to have stress like this, bc my blood pressure goes up and I start spotting. I can't believe that an employee would go so far out of their way to bully a pregnant woman - if I end up back in the hospital over this then I'm calling an attorney. That worker had no right to bully a pregnant woman just to get out of having to remake a coffee! 
PS. My husband is black AND I have 2 kids who are black and I'm pregnant with a black baby! I'M NOT A RACIST

I LOVE this Starbucks---
LOVE...and i dont LOVE ANY Starbucks-- but this one-- is top notch..
Its get a little busy in the morning so I'm always going inside, which is no big deal.
The people in there are extremely nice, and pleasant...(I need that in the morning)
The food and drinks I've always ordered from here are fresh, hot, and tasty!!!!! 
No need to write some lengthy review, we've all been Starbucks, we all know the hoopla--- 
But if you're in the area, by THIS Starbucks-- stop on in...you'll experience the difference.

This has got to be one of the worse Starbucks ever. We had to report the order several times and she still got it wrong. The speed from ordering to getting the drink wasn't too slow but the order processing was painfully slow. Double check your order before you leave
Love this starbucks, know me by name and know my drink. Definitely feel like I am at a "barista". Thanks everyone for making me feel so welcome

I go to starbucks very often. I have one near my home on Gandy, but after one visit I always favor going to THIS starbucks. Mainly due to their fantastic costumer service. One star employee that I'd love to point out is Niki. She ALWAYS greets me with a smile when I come to the drive-through window and ALWAYS has the best snack recommendations. She is a pro. I highly recommend coming to this starbucks. Thank you again Niki.
Are we not open for business anymore? Multiple times I've went there during normal business hours and they are either completely closed or the lobby is closed.
Everyone is very nice and helpful, a good place to study as well!!!!! Good at making drinks too

I go into this Starbucks all the time, because one its close to home. Two its convenient. The employees have always been so nice and sweet. This morning they weren't either. I know at times you can get busy but that does NOT mean you have to be rude to customers. They had forgotten my piece of bread i ordered which was no problem at all, It was the fact that when i had my mom go in and get it they first ignored her didn't ask if she needed help, and then when she had asked for the piece of bread we ordered she got snippy with my mom. There was just no reason for that and I was completely shocked when she told me that because usually they are so nice. AND we had just gone in there yesterday morning.

I placed an order for a iced breakfast tea with 5 pumps of sugar via the mobile app. It took me a few minutes to get to the store and I walked up to see if my order was ready, however I did not see it. I have gotten this drink many times, so I know what cup to look for. I stood waiting for my drink for 10 minutes. I didn't say something immediately because I did see they were busy and perhaps they were brewing tea. I finally decided to ask if maybe I am at the wrong store. I was asked for my name, and I was advised it was there but maybe they made it wrong... and they did.  No one apologized, no one seemed to be worried why I was just standing there. I watched them make my drink sloppy and in a hurry and of course did not do the right amount of sugar pumps. When my drink was ready, it was just handed to me..no words, no apology. I left feeling extremely disappointed.

I have been to a lot of the Starbucks around Reno, Sparks, and Carson City area and I have to say that this location is one of the best. I went in yesterday looking for one of the drinkware cups that I had been wanting and finally found one at this location. The girl who was working the counter was so friendly and I really enjoyed being able to chat while waiting for my drink to be made. I noticed that all the staff seemed happy and had such positive energy. I came back again today to get another cup and the same girl was working and was training a new person too. She was just as helpful and friendly as yesterday and even though she was training she made a point of taking a couple minutes to chat and made me feel happy and welcomed in this store. The location has a lot of parking since it is located in a nice shopping center. The only downfall is this store closes at 6 pm which seems just a little early for a city like Reno but maybe at this location they do not get a lot of business in the evening. I do not mind driving a little out of my way to get such friendly service.

This location is inferior to the average Starbucks or other coffee shop. Location near Turnpike is great, although that corner is so busy it can take a while to do all the required maneuvering to get there and get out of there.

Workers there seem less happy than your typical Starbucks worker. And let me admit up front: I could never work at Starbucks with customers freaking out over thousands of different special order variations. But that's the premise of the store, and since the economy is booming, retail folks have choices about where to work.

My order is hilariously simple: venti 'royal english'/black tea. Today I received my tea with both tea bag cardboards still connected to the teabag, floating in the boiling water. Plus no cup sheath to protect my sensitive hands, which in this location are kept away from the customers (who might, what, hoard them?!). Is Plymouth Meeting a high-cup-sleeve-theft area?

I try to avoid this location, but again, the placement by the Turnpike can be attractive. The service problems here (also no honey to be found - though they leave the Stevia out because no one would steal that stuff!) are probably due to understaffing. This place gets super-busy at morning rush hour, but it looked like there was just one cashier, one drink-maker, one food maker, and one guy milling about (cleaning?). Today's monopoly is tomorrow's Radio Shack.

By far my favorite Starbucks location in Reno. Consistently fast and friendly service, with very easy access to parking. Many Starbucks parking lots are a nightmare, but not this one because they are in a large shopping center area. 

I almost exclusively use my mobile app to order and pay ahead of time. During COVID, the pick up experience between different Starbucks location has been frustratingly inconsistent. Some locations even make you stand in line to with people walking in to order because they keep prepared drinks behind the counter. This location has by are the BEST system! Right when you walk in the door they have an organization system. Your order ticket is placed in a bin with your name on it and when ready, they place the order there was well. Very impressive. Wish more locations would use this system. There are several Starbucks locations closer to my house but I will drive out of my way to visit this one because of the convenience and service.
Nice SB's. Clean with friendly baristas. Ample parking out front. Only drawback is it has no drive-thru. Conveniently located in shopping center with a grocery store.

I've got no complaints at the Starbucks. They always try to be as efficient getting the orders out in a timely manner. This space is tiny! Sometimes it's rather busy on peak times like the mornings. But as I said they work very hard to get it done.

Can't recommend this location. Six employees and only two were working. Line of several people moved so slow cause the cashier wasn't getting help. The drinks were made right and the place was clean, but the struggle was real for the poor cashier who was doing it all. 

There were about 5 people in line and 3 more waiting for their drinks. Most of the employees were chatting among themselves and ignoring the line / customers, while 2 were pulling all the weight. The cashier and barista making the drinks were hauling, but it still took time to get it all with the rush of people.

Overall: C-
Props to the two hard working employees, I felt for them!!

Standard S'Bucks product and service, with a friendly staff.

Lot (and different kinds!) of seating that will really look great once COVID stuff is over with. Definitely one of my favorite S'Bucks interiors to date.

this establishment remains very clean and orderly. But the attitude from some employees at this establishment ruined my experience.  I ordered a mocha frappachino and a ham and cheese croissant. And a couple other food items and drinks for my children.. A worker named chole gave me attitude the whole way through as I ordered. At the end of it, she rudely commented are you done yet?. She made unpleased expressions at my children and I overheard her telling her other coworkers about these Mormon moms and their children. I did not hear it very clearly but I know for fact it was not very nice. I just wanted to enjoy the afternoon with my children, but people like her should not work in the food industry.

Two days ago I was came in for an iced coffee, and while nothing was wrong with my drink, there was something terribly wrong with my service. The girl taking my order was not over friendly, and not outright rude, but less enthusiastic than I'd expect. After almost sliding my card before knowing it had a chip reader, she snapped "Hold On." at me, which kind of threw me off because as someone who works in retail, I would never treat a customer with that tone. But this is the real kicker- while my receipt is printing, I notice she begins looking down and what do you know, she pulls her phone out of her apron behind the cash register and STARTS TEXTING WHILE MY RECEIPT HAS ALREADY PRINTED AND I AM STANDING THERE WAITING FOR HER TO HAND IT TO ME. I will also mention that it was around 5pm and there were about 4 people in line behind me, so she stood there texting while we all waited for her service. I was appalled and actually couldn't believe how dumb someone could be to do that, right then, on the job.

I've been to this location 3 times.  Each time the service was slow.  My last trip I got a trenta ice coffee with 2 shots of espresso and it cost me $20. Why?  I paid with a 20 and asked the barista to put it on my starbucks card and then take the drink off of the card.  He spent a lot of time doing this and then said the register wasn't printing receipts.  I've never had a problem before so I told him that was fine and drove off.  The next time I tried to use my card I had a 0 balance.  Where was the $14+ that should have been there?  I called the store, the manager was too busy to speak with me and I left my name and number.  She never bothered to return my call.  That's fine, I won't return to your location, ever.  I emailed starbucks.com and got a portion of what should have been there.  I'm definitely exploring other coffee options now.

Always a pleasant experience at this location. Baristas are friendly and helpful. Since I'm not a coffee drinker, I enjoy the hot chocolate, especially on a chilly December day. Customer service is alive and well here. 

Just the right temperature and chocolate enough with whip on top. Nice to relax with after a busy day. 

Plenty of parking at this location too, but no drive up as it's located in a corner of a shopping center. Five stars today.

I don't typically review large chains like Starbucks but this one deserves it.

The staff here is beyond friendly. Highly recommend.

If you like to wait for coffee with an attitude, this might be the Starbucks for you. Too bad the usual happy SB attitude is not present here as the location is good. I'll definitely stick to the local establishments in the neighborhood from now on.

This is our second time here in two days. To best describe it layout wise, it's long and narrow. The whole layout of the prep and kitchen area is a lot different from any Starbucks I've been too. 

Yesterday, when we came at 10am, they were struggling to stay afloat with the massive drive thru lane and the line inside. We had ordered a bacon Gouda sandwich and were told after ordering that they didn't have any left. We had also ordered a warm plain croissant and when my niece bit into it, it was still frozen in the middle. So she was gifted a chocolate croissant to make up for it. 

Today, we ordered 2 bacon Gouda sandwiches, mocha, java chip Frappuccino, strawberry green tea & a passion fruit lemonade. They were quick and efficient and got everything right. They didn't have any passion fruit for the passion fruit lemonade so we opted for strawberry instead.

I remember the days when the people at Starbucks were fun, happy, and cheerful people. Now, they don't say hi, or thank you, or even smile. Not that I'm THAT old but, ah, the good ole' days. Just so I'm clear, the young girl who helped us didn't say hi, or thank you, or not even a smile. Really, really starting to hate the entitled employees found in more and more Starbucks...

And my lemon loaf is hard on one side!!! Ugh! Lol
Alia, Ty, Jared...love you guys fir the warm greetings on my Starbuck's missions.

Absolutely terrible service. It took them 25 minutes to make one drink. No apology. Whoever their manager is, he clearly doesn't understand that if he's going to bark at others for not wearing masks, he needs to learn how to wear one properly himself.
EVEN TIME I come to this Starbucks there's a 30 minute wait. How and why does it take 30 minutes to make a cup of coffee?

OMG. Slowest and most expensive Starbucks in town, maybe in America!
My $5.94 skinny vanilla latte is $6.47 here!
And they only have 1 barista no matter how busy they are- this morning there were 12 people waiting for their coffee and another 10 in line to order/ waiting 20".
Do yourself a favor - get your caffeine before you arrive here - the SB nearby on Kennedy is cheaper and very fast!

The employees here are so nice and go above and beyond the norm of customer service! Kudos to Jacob he definitely deserves a day off with double pay; never fails always greets us at the drive thru with kindness and energy; I wish I lived closer to this location for he is by far the nicest barista  (I visit Starbucks quite a few times per week) He should be considered a trainer. Tysm

Always a Awful negative attitude towards its ordering customers. 

I asked for a chestnut praline Latte . Which should come with whip cream and dah praline sprinkles on top of whip. You think I asked for a bag of gold and a Bitcoin. Only to be told in a snobby tone. IF WE HAD IT I WOULD HAVE ADDED IT. 

Get over your snobby tude, I don't read minds.

Not the usual friendly service here today. A grumpy barista this Monday morning. Ordered my usual grande peach infused iced tea on the app but it doesn't allow for the fact I usually have them pour it  over a Trenta cup of ice. Somehow the barista was not happy when I asked for Trenta cup of ice. Sorry to spoil your day, but on a hot summer day the ice melts fast and my tea gets  warm. Guess I'll continue to use their app but keep my own cup of ice in the car to pour my tea over.

I've read a lot of similar reviews here. I feel bad for the staff but it is true, this has to be the worst Starbucks I've ever been to .... I waited over 20 mins and when I finally got my coffee it was the wrong order. I literally just left without waiting any longer for my fixed coffee. Will never try coming here again. The drive thru is a nightmare

This is by far the worst Starbucks in Greenwood and I'm including Kroger and Target locations in this.  The girl they have making the coffee is incredibly slow and picks and chooses which drinks she wants to make.  That means your wait time could be 20 min!  Never mobile order.  They fill drive through and store orders first.  I've ordered from my house arrived at the store and watched multiple people come in and receive their drinks and I will still be waiting.  They claim they have issues with their printer yet my food item will be waiting while I have to still wait for the drink.  From now on whenever I see the girl with green hair I leave and go to another location.  This location has gone so far down hill since their last manager changed.  When green hair girl isn't there it's better but their lack of management and training always shows.

Today is my birthday...I have the Starbucks app and have entered my bday in before so I know they have it....I went in and asked how I get my free birthday drink and they said I have to get an email...i checked and I was like ok but I didn't get an email can I just show you my license I promise today is my birthday... no... no free drink for me. Even though many ppl have told me they have showed Starbucks their license and gotten a free drink on their bday....Also worse than that I ordered a drink I order all the time it's the dragon fruit refresher... paid $6 on my birthday and today it tasted like pink sink water.. had zero flavor rad... thanks guys

Every time I come here, this place always messes up my order. Also, I am continuously baffled how long it takes to just pour a black coffee out to make an iced americano. A tall house coffee shouldn't require a 10-minute wait.

I felt so uncomfortable at this Starbucks location. I went in to order with my mom and my black step dad. The three baristas kept looking at him like he was gonna steal something. At first they didn't register that he was with me. Then my step dad accidentally grabbed a drink with his name but it wasn't his. There was someone else with the same name as him who came in after us, and the baristas kept making (loud enough) comments that I heard. I asked for extra sugar and one of them gave me a face. I told them loudly "excuse me can you say that slowly so that I can translate in Spanish for my mom" and they went quiet. Needless to say they were glad to see us leave the place. I will definitely be emailing corporate. No need for that racist attitude.

Quick service for being so busy. I lose sleep over the fact that every starbs I've been to gives me a different VSC nitro cold brew. Sometimes it's sweet, sometimes its mellow and fantastic, and today it's so bitter my skin melted off my body and fell into a puddle on the floor. 

I did not clean it up I just went to my car and slammed my coffee. Choked it down. I'll try again another time.

This location is odd. There is a drive thru that starts in the rear of the building. It is in a small strip mall with a game place and a men's haircut place, in front of a Home Depot. There is limited parking in front of the restaurant. There is also some outdoor seating. The drive thru is quick, but a sharp exit must be made to exit at the traffic light. 

Indoors is neat and clean. Restrooms are well stocked. I used to work nearby so I frequently stopped by for a coffee. I have only had one major issue with them. I had stopped by in the middle of an afternoon, and paid for my coffee and a treat with my app. Well, the clerk left my tab open and charged me for coffee for her friends. She admitted this to me. I called the headquarters and was refunded the money. Other than that, service has always been awesome. Easy access to and from I-10.
Fast friendly service. Clean interior and exterior. Highly recommended. This store is easier to get to and more convenient than I4 store

Got the venti mocha cookie crumble frapp & the FREE nitro shot they are offering for today only! Frapp is quite tasty!! Love all the cookie crummiez all throughout the frapp. Nitro shot, well, eh it was just ok. Asked gal what it was & she couldn't really tell me other than what the description said on the board. But, it has a very strong coffee taste.

I just love this Starbucks location!  The staff is super personable; they know my drink and get it started on sight. Except when I switch it up from iced to hot depending on the weather (and my mood). 

There is no drive-thru like the one a few miles away at Delmar and North/South but this smaller location is well worth the venture inside.  They alos have a nice covered patio for seating and people watching; a Loop "must do"

I swear my drink is different here every single time. The staff seem young and they definitely cut corners when making drinks. My Frappuccino had a layer of chocolate sauce at the bottom of the cup. I asked why and the barista said they pour the ingredients into the cup first (which is fine) prior to blending and that the chocolate pumps must not have blended. This is not the first time this has happened. It's just gross - who wants to slurp up chocolate sauce at the bottom of their drink - I didn't order a sundae at an ice cream parlor!
Currently struggling with staff to the point they do not have decaf because they not brewed it yet. A staff of 10 is not enough to operate the demand

This is a small, high volume store. There's not room to hang out inside but they do a good job of directing traffic and getting out mobile orders quick. Staff is very friendly and will start welcoming you by name after a couple mobile orders. It feels clean and safe during the pandemic. Fellow patrons - we can ALL wait outside until we see our orders come up. My favorite beverage is the cold brew with cinnamon almond milk cold foam.
i ordered a green tea with no water and was intentionally given a green tea completely watered down. My whole day is ruined. Will never come here again

This is the third time I've been to this Starbucks in the last two weeks and this is by far the worst Starbucks I've been too. The customer service here is horrible and I will never come to this one again!

Love this Starbucks location. I stop here 3-4 times a week before class and my mobile ordered coffee is always ready and made exactly as I ordered. Friendly cashiers and super clean. It's nicely located within Villanova's shopping center. No problems with parking either.

Many people on the reviews complained about the service and how uninterested the employees were I didn't have this issue, I was greeted by a very nice lady. She took my order and off to the side I went  the only issue that I had was, I waited a very long time for my order. The lady preparing it had no sense of urgency at all. I'm not saying you should run around getting my order to me under 30 seconds. But being the only customer in line, my oatmilk shaken Vintti should not have taken 20mins.

Consistently disappoints on the mobile app. $5 Frappuccino melted waiting on a latte ordered together.  Made 8 drinks for others in between then gave excuses instead of apologies. Poorly ran location. Go to other Hermitage location instead of this one.

Nicest Starbuck's I've found, which hopefully speaks volumes about management. Wait-times are reasonable. Staff is super friendly, like they like working there. Drinks are perfect, and I will definitely drive 6 mis out of the way to go here vs. the Starbucks in Pinellas Park.

Well, I love me some Starbucks!  I love that they have my sugar free options available for my teas, just wish they had more available so that could try other items other than my typical brewed chai tea or unsweetened green tea.  I would love for them to make their Peach and Guava in a sugar free option for Keto friendly drinks.  Lately, all my nearby locations have been out of the Peach flavoring....not sure why.

Anywho....this location wasn't crowded at all when I arrived and staff was welcoming.  Masks are required and something was said to the individual ahead of me who was not wearing his -- he actually had to put it on in order to be served.  My drink was out fast and tasted great.
Great Starbucks! The baristas are very nice and the place is very modern and clean. Mickayla was so sweet and even brought us our drinks to where we were sitting.

Baristas at this location are great. Customers? Not so much. I felt as if I was amongst a group of zombies Mostly everyone was wearing earbuds and talking so loudly that I had to retreat to my car for some peace and quiet. And some even more thoughtless ones apparently felt no need to cover up while sneezing! There was not a quiet corner to be had inside and I found the lack of consideration to be appalling. My coffee was delish. Too bad I couldn't enjoy the ambiance which was spoiled by a bunch of bratty, inconsiderate millennials!

I don't frequent this location much, anymore, since we moved. But when I do, I rarely have any issues. They're nice and check on things before you order them, to make sure they're still available. 

They always roll out the new menu items so I'm able to try all of the yummy stuff Starbucks has to offer.

I gave them 4 stars because they get packed and backed up at times. During the super busy times (before and after work), expect a wait. They try their best to be efficient so be patient. There's always the drive thru but the way it is set up, it wraps around the back of the building and spills into the parking lot, in front, making it somewhat of a nuisance.

I'll be back if I'm in the area.

I am a lover of everything STARBUCKS!  However, the biggest downfall of this location is the fact that EVERYONE GOES THERE!  I used to attempt stopping at this Starbucks in the morning on the way to work and it was a terrible idea.  I would challenge myself to get up earlier so I didn't have to wait in such a long line.... still a fail!  The worst part is the setup of the parking lot.  Instead of having one clear cut line, people approach the line from different directions so it seems like you may be getting the short end of the stick (depending on which side you line up on).  I have also tried to hop out of my car and go inside.... Ironically, it took me longer inside than it would have taken me in the line.  

Nothing against the service but because this is at such a busy intersection, it is never a quick stop!

I absolutely adore Justin and Abby at this location. They are so sweet and kind to everyone every single day, and constantly portray an uplifting attitude. I look forward to seeing them each and every time I come to this store.

First let me say this is nothing against the store and Caughlin Ranch. The barista's here are courteous, helpful, and always merry in the spirit of the season. 

My one star goes to calling customer service and ending up in a loop that offers no live person to resolve my problem. I just spent $83.74 on a wonderful hot chocolate and gift card but my apps locked up and would not allow me to use my Starbucks app to pay for it. Therefore,  I miss out on all my reward stars. When I called the misnomer "customer service" all I get is recorded announcements for their credit card or referrals to the website. Nary a live person to be had.

Customer service at Starbucks has continued to decline and it's no wonder their stock prices are declining as well. When you put shareholders ahead of your hard-working, paying customers it's always a recipe for disaster.

One star is more than deserved corporate Starbucks.

Shannon's genuine smile and happiness turned my whole day around. Her hospitality is a hard find in the service industry during Mardi Gras when we all (myself included) are especially stressed, tired, and unappreciated. You go girl!

11/24/19 - just wanted to give Christina the thumbs up. Very sweet and hard worker. Made sure everyone was taken care of while cleaning up the atea 
My experience today was less than wonderful. A young lady took my order then got her food and drink and went on brake. I had to ask another barista for my drink. Then I asked the first one where my sandwich was. She pointed to the barista at the register and said she'll take care of it. The other barista had no clue as to what I ordered. This has never happened here. I quite disappointed. 

3/01/19 - Eddie's last day. He has been a plus plus for this location. He will be missed immensely. ;

2/12/19 - So disappointed to hear that our wonderful asst manager Eddie The Arizona Pavilions location will be leaving us. 

1/11/19 - VERY disappointed that they didn't have my favorite sandwich today, chicken and artichoke

Once again we are here. Our favorite place. Love our Baristas. Jessica, Treigh, Caleigh, Alex and Taylor. If I've forgotten anyone please forgive me. So many great people work at this location. :) And of co
This is the slowest Starbucks ever. There is only one person working and doing everything. I hate this place. Stay away

Best Starbucks I've had in a long time!
Service was excellent! Drink was soooo good!
Thanks for a great experience!

I was on my way home from work. I was singing 80s music-with gusto-and suddenly had to have a Starbucks spinach and feta wrap. Warm and cozy, savory and tangy, ooey and gooey-it had to be done. So I turned down my "totally awesome" throwback tunes long enough to hit the nearest drive-thru... right there in the 1600 block of West Kennedy. Ohhh, I was not disappointed. The wait was short, the service super friendly and the wrap, so tasty and satisfying. It really is a nice combination-perfect for morning. It's six hours later and I'm still getting energy from it (and still humming "Total Eclipse of the Heart.") 

Thanks Starbucks!
The nicest workers of any Starbucks I've ever been to! Always ask how you are at the drive thru and chat with you at the window if there's time. They always make my day!
Today I ordered lemonade. There were strange stains on the lid. And On my last two visits the staff was very rude

You will wait for a very long time. And you may even wait in the road 
I have been coming here consistently for months (really not sure why I keep coming back) 
By the time you get your mobile order, all the ice will be melted. 
Weird overflow lot 
Good luck at this location
Great location with outside seating. Staff is friendly and service was decent even though this location gets very busy in the mornings. Enjoy your next cup of coffee at this Starbucks location!

Tried a new breakfast sandwich today. Double Smoked Bacon Cheddar and Egg since they were out of the Spinach Feta flatbread wrap. 

It was pretty good. 500 calories vs 290 so it should have been good. The croissant roll was very flaky and soft. The bacon was not near cooked enough for my taste but I like crisp bacon not stretchy. 

I would probably get this again when out of the wrap.

Busy like other Starbucks locations this location also offers, WIFI, seating, coffee of all kinds and same with tea. Food as well of all kinds, cups, restrooms, handicapped parking, regular parking. The drive thru is busy at times during the evening time rush when coming home from work or headed to work for the grave yard shift.  Service from staff inside are great with no problems what's so ever.

It's a Starbucks, it makes and serves Starbucks drinks.  If you've ever been to a Starbucks then you have a really good idea as to what to expect.  And if you haven't been to a Starbucks, then welcome to Earth

It's in the heart of downtown Indy so parking is at a premium and there isn't a drive through.   I was able to order and pickup my drink in a very reasonable amount of time.  They got my order right so I really have nothing to complain about.  I'll totally swing back by here again the next time I'm downtown.

I recently moved to the area and this place has become the favorite part of my work week!

Nova, Shelli, and Derek are always there with a smile and checking in on the latest and greatest with me and the other "regulars". They're seriously the sweetest!

The only thing I'm not a fan of parking/entering. The drive-thru causes a mad house so it's been a challenge to get in and out without some fast and furious type maneuvering.

I absolutely love the baristas at this location (as of 12/26/2018) they have the greatest attitude I've ever experienced --- and on top of that they have your order ready within seconds. I feel like they all deserve a raise (I love their dragonfruit lemonade refresher)

I will fight anyone who gives them grief, a bad attitude, etc! These baristas must be protected from evil

I clearly come here too often- they know my name and order! It's a very small space and the staff is friendly! They really get people in and out of here- I like this location as it's not as crowded as the other stores in town!

Absolute horrible customer service it's like COVID it is not even a thing, there are so many customers without masks inside and outside. Never seen an employee clean a table. The employees are so rude. They give the wrong drink and then when you say "I'm sorry this is incorrect" they act like it's the biggest inconvenience and don't switch it even though I'm paying six dollars for a goddamn shitty cup of coffee. I LOVE Starbucks but this is NOT it. The only reason I went this week is because my at home coffee maker was broken but I'd rather have the horrible dish water Dunkin Donuts serves then waste my time and money on this specific store. My favorite Starbucks was at the university of Miami campus and it was SOOOOO much busier than this Starbucks will EVER be and they had nicer employees who actually cared about giving the CORRECT DRINK TO THE CORRECT PERSON. I have been a Gold Card member since I was 15 in 2013 - I have spent on average $10-15 on coffee a day, I have a severe caffeine addiction and I can't drink the crap they served me without gagging. I'm so appalled by this horrendous establishment. It ruins the name of Starbucks.

Since Howard left as CEO,  I have observed a distinct decline in service and product.  Today at McCarren and Caughlin Parkway, my Caramel-Mocha no swirl of caramel or chocolate! Very sad baristas service and frappucinno creating. Store remains fairly clean but the friendly, cheerful baristas are few and far between.  Disappointing. 

Updated review. Only three stars today as the pastry display case was pitiful, to say the least. The barista explained to me that they are having great difficulty getting their pastry orders, especially the pumpkin scone order. The Starbucks advertising for the season talks up pumpkin, pumpkin, pumpkin, and yet they have nothing in their stores. Someone has obviously dropped the ball major big-time on this one!


Nice SB's. Clean with friendly baristas. Ample parking out front. Only drawback is it has no drive-thru. Conveniently located in shopping center with a grocery store.

Came here for drinks today (2/23) and it was probably the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. The guy working the drive thru with the tattoos of naked body parts was so blah, rude and like he didn't want to be there.

We ordered an iced passion tango tea lemonade and the order came out wrong so upon telling him it wasn't what we ordered he genuinely seemed annoyed at us for his own mistake, no apologies and huffed and puffed away for the correct drink. After the correct drink comes it is literally watered down so much it tastes like water. Our other order was blonde espresso iced with sweet foam and no exaggeration the sweet foam took up 3/4 of the cup with only 1/4 of coffee. It was all gone within five sips.

Super disappointing experience from the service to the drinks. Would never return to this location and would definitely not recommend.

There's a lot of Starbucks near by, but I think this location is my favorite. The baristas are sweet and never mess up my order. When you walk inside the building, it's spotless and not too crowded around 7pm. It's a good spot to study for an exam.

Coffee is a hit and miss now at first it was pretty good and then a couple weeks couple weeks went by they hire some new guys there and it's just the coffee is cold now like they don't know how to make it in there horrible attitude it's too late these two new guys are horrible one of them was like a stupid mask that looks like a face

I'm not sure anymore about this Starbucks....  I stop by almost every morning before work, but here lately I've waited forever in the drive thru just to be told they just opened and two of their employees called in.  Then there have been times when the drive thru and front door is blocked with chairs on the outside...  I'm ‍ confused, what is going on at this location?  Ending on a good note, they always make my drink awesome!

I have to change my review. We waited in the drive through for 20 minutes. Definitely not coming back to this location anymore. Even the person taking the order was super slow. Who has time for that?! No thanks!

Pissed! I went in today to get a Caramel Apple Spice and a Double Bacon breakfast sandwich. They were out of the sandwich as it seems they always are, and I received the wrong drink!  I got a Apple Crisp Macchiato, and even that had zero Apple flavor! I didn't notice until I got home relaxed and ready to enjoy my breakfast.  It was a total disappointment.
The worst coffee place in all of Tennessee. Even when you place an order on the app for pick up it takes more than 40 minutes. Get your shit together!!

Drive thru-only extends line even after rush hour blocking entrance to park and pick up. Made the mistake in picking up my drink inside option on the app. Should have ordered from in Target instead next time.
