This must be a very busy story as it's on the main strip and across from the mall but they have yet to allow indoor seating or open the restrooms to the public.. how are we supposed to wash our hands without the restrooms?

The staff inside was very friendly, there was no wait for my drinks.

Hey do you want the worst Starbucks experience ever?! Then definitely go into the Starbucks at the Doubletree hotel in downtown Nashville. There were 4 employees and about 6 people in line. Not only was it the slowest Starbucks but it was also the least friendly. Hey gals, you're in a customer service role, guess what that means you're basically an actor. So when I asked "Hey how are you this morning?", before ordering my drink...it's you're job to pretend like your day is going well-not roll your eyes and ask what do you want. 

Also how many baristas does it take to make a grande toffee nut latte? It takes 3. One to make the drink, one to play therapist as the other slowly makes the drink, and one to quietly say the name on the order when it's done....so quietly the other customer and I had to make sure we were getting the correct drink. I completely understand talking to your co-workers but when there's a line of drinks waiting to be made and food being ordered, leave the personal woes on the back burning and do your job.

Well, I sure hope I'm not letting the secret out, but this Starbuck's is a hidden gem. The looks of it are deceiving as it appears to be a run-of-the-mill strip mall location without a drive-thru, but it does indeed have one--you just have to drive around the side of the building. Because it hides out, the crowds are virtually non-existent. Also, they get the orders right every single time.

Lightning fast service, my drink was perfect, and a drive thru!
What else could a coffee nut want?
Bravo!

Staff needs some improvement. The girl working the register didn't greet or say anything for that matter and the entire ordering process consisted of eye rolls, not to mention she ordered my drink wrong. 

When I got to the end they handed me a hot instead of cold drink which I nicely said was incorrect. So instead of remaking properly she dumped it over a scoop of ice and handed it to me. Now I have a Luke warm watery drink for $6.

This location needs some work.

This location is amazing. I went in there at 1:35 on Monday 10/5 and the staff is super friendly. Very clean and they really deserve raises. My drink was amazing and I was even treated very well. Thank you to the guys working at that time. You guys made a person who was having a very bad weekend, turn their luck around with the kindness in this location. Thanks again.

Very poor customer service every time we go there. Went once earlier this week & both of our drinks were wrong. Gave it another shot during a less busy time. Both drinks were still made wrong & the young girl at the window was quite rude.

This place is amazing. Always so friendly they're always busy but working hard, they know me and my drink by name even though I'm just one of many customers that come in there. It is definitely my favorite location in town
I don't know why we come here anymore. This location is always dirty.

I go to this Starbucks when I'm heading to the Eastside of Tucson and I don't know why I still go. The employees are so rude when you are nice to them and no one every wants to make your drink right and it's lazy. I order the one same drink with nothing special just want it the way it looks and made the way you where taught during training and not give out half assed drinks.  . .

I love Starbucks I really do. But this location has gotten my order wrong multiple times. This location is close to my house but now I probably will just go out of my way to another location because my order keeps getting messed up

There are 2 Starbucks less than 0.5 miles from this one skip this and visit another location. Coffee is never as ordered. Ordered coffee with 2 extra shots. Was given a grande cup of steamed milk. This type of screw up happens every visit. Spoke to manager numerous times. She should be fired. Staff is poorly trained and supervised and is far too busy socializing to do their jobs.
Would not recommend this location to anyone!! Very rude and unfriendly staff. The worst Carmel Frappuccino I have ever tasted.

Thank you, Starbucks employees, for continuing to let us get our Starbucks fix during this hard time! This location is now drive-thru only, allowing us all to stay safe and have minimal contact. The people working are friendly and driving here is my big event for the day during this quarantine! I have been coming here for a long time and they are always quick and efficient, even when the drive-thru line looks super long. I hope they can remain open as long as it is safe for them to do so! I love my Starbucks and I love this location!

Meh, way too busy. I go there when I don't want to get out of my car and go into a good coffee shop. I either get really nice baristas or the complete opposite. Good place when your craving a sugary coffee beverage.
My favorite Starbucks location :-) baristas are the best!!!! Service is awesome :-) This is my first time checking in (on Yelp) but my colleagues and I are here at least 2-3 times a week.

There's 2 Starbucks in this mall but I'm pretty sure based on these reviews that this is referring to the one near Macy's. 

To start, this Starbucks is just dirty and disorganized. There is barely enough room for the lines to go between the meager seating.  

Pros: 
Couldn't find a food court and the only nearby alternative was Legal Seafoods so I'm lucky this place served real food like sandwiches and oatmeal

Cons: 
The wait is quite a bit, probably half because people are not sure where to line up and what is going on in there. The line actually forms to the left side, which is funny because you enter from the right side of the store and there's already a clump of people there who are actually the people waiting for their drinks. 
Prepare to fight for a place to sit, along with a clean spot on the tables. 
Confused and slow employees, but to be fair it was the holiday season
This one's not really their fault, but probably by proxy, all the patrons there are pissy and grumpy and territorial about the line. Probably mostly because they were in the line for so goddamn long.

Still not sure why a 3 star rating overall. They are still a 5 from me. The drinks are always awesome and we get great service.

Got the Mocha Cookie Crumble Frap this time. So good

Driver-Thru Attendant Had The Nastiest Attitude And Made My Drink WRONG. Went Inside To Get A Remake And As The Associate Was Assisting Me Other Co Workers Were Rude To Her Especially With Their Tone And Approach. The Drink Was Remade And Was Extremely Distasteful. I Won't Visit This Location Again.

I visited this Starbucks location several times while in Indianapolis and I was very impressed! The atmosphere is always clean and organized. The employees are very friendly and made my coffee perfect every time. The service is quick. There are several seating areas with a good amount of space, including an outdoor seating area as well. I really love this Starbucks location and highly recommend it!

One of my favorite Starbucks because the staff are amazing. Coffee-deprived people seem to forget that these are human beings behind the counter who are also tired, but are working like crazy to make your 5 frappucinos and skinny latte. 

I have encountered a day here where we waited in line at the drive thru early morning and it took a bit longer than usual, no complaints from me. This place is always busy in the mornings and has two lanes merging into the drive thru. When I got to the window they comped our two drinks. Another time I asked for a non-dairy drink and they accidentally put a dairy topping on and they remade my drink and comped a new one for me. One last story! My boyfriend forgot his wallet and we realized too late and they said to just pay it forward next time and gave us our drinks for free (of course next time we stopped by we paid for those in back of us)!

Make sure and sign up for Starbucks rewards for a free drink on your birthday and other discounts!

Great starbucks with awesome partners. I have been going to this particular store for about 2 years since I moved to Tampa!

This sbux is my go to place all year around and recently it got a makeover and now it's one of the trendy starbucks on the monument circle.staff here is super friendly and I love getting my dose of caffeine from here. It's even better now as they have started nitro brew here sho even better.

This Starbucks location is the one I probably frequent the most.  I am here almost every Sunday morning in the drive thru.  The employees are friendly and my drinks are always delicious.   Even with my picky order that seems to always change they are patient.   I also keep the corner of the bar company several times a month while I read or crochet.  It is nice to see the frequent visitors and hear there order stated before the customer even says it.  I have seen drinks remade without complaint when it is not quite what the customer wants.  The employees are constantly cleaning during any down time and seem to really care about the store.  I will continue to be here often.

I spent a few hours here recently working on a school paper. This place is extremely comfortable. Outlets are easily accessible. It's better than other Starbucks in this area. 

And if you think parking is bad here, try Starbucks in Paoli or South Philly sometime. You'll appreciate what you do have here.

During the pandemic I have been going to the Starbucks at 5970 W. Arizona Pavilions Dr., Tucson, AZ 85743 most Sunday mornings. To avoid the long lines at the drive thru I have been getting up at 4 AM to be the first in line when this store opens a 4:30.
The baristas are always so friendly. I always ask for a pup-a-chino for my dog, and a Grande, non-fat, no-foam Latte for my wife. They always top the dog's treat with five calorie Milk Bones!
Thank you, Arizona Pavilions Starbucks, for making the pandemic tolerable!

One of the best locations in Indy! The staff is very friendly. I stop in almost every morning and I have a complicated order-- but it's made very consistently from day to day. 

The one drawback to this location is there is a large homeless problem in this area of downtown and so almost always there are people asking you for money as you walk in or out. But that's completely out of Starbucks' control. 

I pass 3-4 Starbucks on my morning commute but I choose this one because of the friendly staff.

Poor management! I waited 20 minutes for my order placed at 8:30 on a Saturday morning. To be fair, they were slammed with orders, so that wait was not terrible. What moved me to give one star is that apparently they were "all out of " a number of things posted on their menu on the wall. I ordered an Impossible breakfast sandwich, which they were all out of. I asked if I could have just egg and cheese and they said they would have to take the meat off a meat breakfast sandwich. I'm not an uptight vegetarian, so I said OK. They charged me the same and did not offer extra cheese or anything. During the 20 minutes I was waiting for my order, I overheard three people being told they were "all out of" what they wanted. When people ordered food, they were told they would have a long wait, and did they still want it. Most said "no" or ordered something else. I would say they should hire enough workers and have enough product so that customers are not discouraged from getting what they really want.

9 out of 10 times they always get my order wrong. Once or twice I can see, but it's almost everyday. If there were another Starbucks around I would switch over but nothings as close to my 10 step walk from the office.

I don't know if the employees feel this way, but this starbucks seems very organized! Orders come out fast, the drive thru line moves quickly, it's pretty easy to get in and out of parking if youre picking up a mobile order inside or if you just came out from dining in, and the employees have always been helpful and kind

This is the closest starbucks to my house and I'm quite the regular here. There is always a line, however they manage it well and I am able to get in and out rather quickly. ie) I can order my coffee and wait without my son freaking out because it takes too long! (very important these days!)

This is the only starbucks where I've seen dogs inside, which I am a huge fan of.  Despite the business of this place, it's pretty serene inside and I always see people working on their laptops so it can't be too much of a disturbance. I like that there is outdoor seating at this location which makes for great people watching on South Street!

It's a starbucks, but a very well run one and the baristas always have a smile on their face.

This Starbucks is SOOOOOO disorganized. The staff behind the counter talk to each other instead of making drinks and leave you waiting at the pick up counter with your foot tapping. I asked what teas I could choose from and the  girl just said we have green tea that's all I know. I asked for earl gray and I was the only one customer waiting for drink besides the drive thru line which had 2 cars.... needless to say, I waited for an uncomfortable amount of time to the point where other folks walked in, ordered and got their drink before me. I just asked for tea!! They definitely forgot my order. Not cool! I had to grab the girl's attention to ask where my tea was. I said, "do you know how much longer on the earl gray?" And she says, "no" and I wanted to say, "well then who should I ask to get my tea?" But I held my tongue. Then I see her drop a random tea bag into a cup and quickly fill with water and push towards me. I thought they typically sweeten with some kind of syrup but I guess not for me or not today. I seriously think they need to hire and train folks not to be so disorganized even when things are slow. Just tried the tea and wow it is bland and tastes all wrong. I looked at the tag and it says "English breakfast" so I'm definitely not happy with the service but I already drove away bc I was so ready to get out of there. Next time, get the order right and don't forget customers.

I'm a pharma rep and am always ordering a lot of drinks when I go in. Today this location was especially busy, but the baristas were still so kind and helpful despite the fact that I had to place a 17 drink order. They worked quickly to get me all my drinks and make sure everything was right. I appreciated their pleasant demeanor and helpfulness!

I'm visiting this area of Florida this week from Colorado and visited this Starbucks twice so far this trip!  Great location in Plant City, easy in/easy out, adequate parking, nice looking outside of the restaurant, inside is nicely decorated, spacious, was warmly greeted upon entering, friendly baristas, quick service, plenty of different kinds of comfortable seating, clean dining room & men's restroom, bright, many windows letting in the sunshine, delicious coffee!, pleasant music playing, good, free Wi-Fi, A/C.

Friendly staff, they get my drinks correct every time, the location is clean and spacious. Good place to work/study. Music at normal level. I've come here 10 continuous days and have nothing but praise for this place and the people working here. Thanks for helping me work remote while visiting family during the holidays

This has got to be one of the worse Starbucks ever. We had to repeat the order several times and she still got it wrong. The speed from ordering to getting the drink wasn't too slow but the order processing was painfully slow. Double check your order before you leave because chances are it is wrong. For the most part the workers are friendly but just slow moving. I also noticed that when making their drinks they like to keep all the milk on the counter instead of putting it away to keep cold

Absolutely terrible service. I purposely drive across town to avoid this Starbucks. Baristas are super rude and don't know how to make the drinks right. This place seriously needs a visit from management.

Decided to give this location a second chance. Starbucks products are pretty much all the same. I have been to Starbucks statewide and many locations in California. This is by far and away the slowest one I have ever been to. In store and drive through are both awful. Seem to have plenty of staff I don't know what the hold up is. 
I'm gonna look for one down the road.

I have to say that this Starbucks that was new in the Mount Juliet, was like the best than any other location of this area. The reason why I'm giving this a 5 star is because of how the staff and the employees have been doing a great job, how good their Frappe-chinos come out, and how clean this place is. 

Since they opened in 2016, I decided to go try them out and see if they do any better job than the one next to Home Depot. It turns out to be 4 times better than expected to be. I go to Starbucks a lot these days, but the one thing I've got to say is that whenever I come in to Starbucks, one of the employees will know my order if you come here a lot. I was impressed about one of them knowing what I wanted to order. 

This is like one of the best Starbucks's I've ever been to in a while!!
My absolute favorite starbucks. The baristas are always friendly and very personable. I love all of them and they always make the experience a great one.

Store is supposed to be open till 8 pm.  I came in for coffee at 7:25 pm only to find that they stop brewing coffee at 7.  I've never had a Starbucks tell me I couldn't get any coffee before.  They didn't even offer a pour over.  I've been to starbucks at 7:50 pm and was still able to get a coffee but not at this location.  I'm on my way to the one a couple of blocks away.

I generally try to stay away from coffee chains since there are so many local places in town, but Starbucks always has a good tea selection which I appreciate! (I don't drink coffee)

It's Starbucks - I'm sure you're familiar with the prices. Affordable if you get a house coffee or tea, a little pricey if you get something a little more frilly. 

For not drinking coffee, I spend a lot of time in coffee shops doing freelance graphic design work or looking for a quiet spot to read. I'm always trying to find the right mix of cozy and quiet, but with large windows for natural light. This Starbucks does the trick. It's small - but since it's off the beaten path a bit, generally not too full. However, it's never empty - if I wanted to be 100% alone, I'd stay home! 

The baristas are always friendly and it's clean. There's one long talk table in the middle if you want more of a community atmosphere (or room to spread out) and smaller tables next to the windows. There's also outdoor seating in the normal months. Located across the street from Walmart and Goodyear, it's a great place to work after running errands or while waiting for an oil change.
Never fails how amazing the team is. Thanks for flipping my day from stressful to happy. You guys are the best

What is special about this Starbuck's is that the service is amazing (yay Paul!) and the atmosphere outside on a nice day is very neighborly with folks talking to eachother and the dogs are all out. The drinks and food are standard. Just wanted to say it's a nice place but check out Chestnut Hill Coffee if quality coffee and espresso is what you are seeking.

My review is based solely on the morning crew, between 6:30am-7:30am M-F.
I make a pit stop at this Starbucks location several days a week on my way to work. My schedule is pretty routine and I arrive at approximately 6:40am each time, however the traffic flow of the drive thru is completely unpredictable. Sometimes I am in and out in approx 10 minutes. Other times I don't make it out of there until almost 7am and at that point cars are practically wrapped around the parking lot. The slow service is definitely a down side, however I can honestly say they've never gotten my order wrong nor has the flavor ever been compromised. The quality of their products is always consistent. 
It's encouraged that people try to order ahead on the Starbucks mobile app, however the items I order on a regular basis show as "sold out" on the app, so I must wait in line if I'm truly craving them enough.

I'm in here a few times a week during the morning rush. The manager is almost always working the floor rather than passively hanging around - and she's pregnant, too! The staff is always very, very friendly (even when the manager is not working). Keep in mind that this is an extremely popular location, so there is ALWAYS a line in the morning. But I've never had to wait an annoyingly long time for a beverage, and the quality is always great.
Under staffed, stopped for a quick cup of coffee 6:45am, lengthily Line, 2 people serving 15!

I honestly feel bad for the employees working.. it's 5am on a Sunday morning and you only have 2 employees behind the counter? That's ridiculous.. They need to give their baristas more support.. I'm writing this from a line that's 15 deep.. Might have to forget about getting my coffee or miss my flight. 

Horrible scheduling on the managers part but the employees that are working this morning are polite and courteous nonetheless so kudos to them.

Okay, the parking lot is just begging for an accident (wouldn't advise driving a Land Rover or Hummer here - you would really be asking for it, no lie), but I love the baristas here.  It's almost always crowded here no matter what time of day it is but I risk the crowds and parking situation to get my java fix.  They have these adorable mini double chocolate chip cookies that are super-rich and sold in packs of 3 (okay, you can get 1 but where's the fun in that?).  I was here last weekend and got a free cappuccino because the barista admitted that he had made it "too light" for another patron (before he even gave it to her - amazing!  a self-correcting barista!) and offered it to me.  At any other place, the customer would have gotten a "well, take it or leave it."  Nice!  Cookies, a NY Times, and 2 caffeinated drinks in 1 fell swoop.  That definitely made my Sunday morning.

Here all this time I thought I was cool . nudge,wink,...... My son told me to order the grande,carmel frappuccino one day, I was hooked. So, on the occasion I get there at 5:25 in the morning, and they are taking orders, I will order my manly drink, and sip with delight and slurp the whip cream with my straw, when I get to the bottom. mmmmm, :)

Since the addition on the space next door, this Starbucks is the largest I've been to outside of NYC. It's so spacious, bright and clean inside. I love the 2 long high communal tables and tons of electric outlets placed under them. The only complaint I have, which is the same for all Starbucks, is the temperature. It's FREEZING in there. It might actually be colder at this location than most. Recently I was there for 2 hrs, even with a cardigan on, I left a popsicle. I'm not kidding.

Why 4 stars and not 5? A couple of employees could be more cheerful and sociable. They actually look like they don't enjoy working, period. The whole time I was never, I never saw either of them smiled once. Maybe I shouldn't be too critical as long as my drinks are done right.

The parking lot is still small since this Starbucks is in a tiny plaza. There's no changing this since there's no room to expand around this plaza. I usually park in the back in case people scratch or hit my car when they try to squeeze into the small spaces.

Looking forward to hanging at this location more. And I'll be bringing a coat. Ha!

Oh how I love this Starbucks, mainly because of where it's located. Today was my first time to this location. It's been long overdue for Starbucks in the neighborhood. It's very clean, nice decor, plenty of seats (inside and out), overall a nice space to enjoy the Riverfront! 

The employees were welcoming and friendly. They seemed very knowledgeable of the drinks. However, they were very busy, lines were long and the service was slow. I ordered the usual, Grande Carmel Macchiato, it did not taste as if it was made properly. I told the barista it tasted funny and they gladly made it again. This time it tasted a bit better lol. 

Although I did not have the best service today I will go back to give them a second chance. If you live in the area definitely give them a try. Im sure they'll get better with time.

My fav coffee chain. Friendly staff. They are always super busy. The breakfast selection is great, my kids love the parfaits, I really like the cheese danish. It's clean and of course it has wifi. Very close to where we live so it's very convenient. My usual drink is always the mocha frapp with extra mocha and w/o whip. But my hubby said one of his co-worker, ordered a 'green' drink and she said it was green tea. He knew I like green tea so told me to try. I did try both the latte and the frapp. Surprisingly, I actually like the frapp over the latte. Oh, n it tastes great with the whip. Me, a no whip on my drink person actually likes the whip on the green tea frapp, lol! Now I have a 2nd favorite drink. I even got my hubby into the green tea frapp. :D Although, I do recommend that if u get the green tea latte, is to make sure n tell them to mix up the green tea powder throughly, if not it will be some on the bottom of ur cup, and it won't taste good.

This Starbucks, in the Camino Real Marketplace in Goleta, actually deserves 0 stars. All of the bad reviews this place gets but nothing changes. The place is dirty, overcrowded, and the little shits that work there just don't care. The half & half containers are always empty and the last time I was there my "hot" sandwich was still frozen in the middle. This place blows big time. I'm going somewhere else next time I'm in the area.

Typical Starbucks.  Packed, bubbly service with a smile, yummy drinks.  I always wonder if I will find a Starbucks that does not get the same review from me.  I swear they are all cloned and placed throughout the nation.
This Starbucks sucks. I feel bad because the whole staff is clueless. Only 3 people working and none of them know what the hell they are doing!! Bathrooms smell like shit. And slow slow slow service.

I love Starbucks!  I can drink something from Starbucks every day.  This is the first Starbucks I've ever seen with two bathrooms.  Usually, the men and women share.

Inside is clean, nice and neat.  The service is great, they really go above and beyond for the customer at this location.

CARAMEL MACCHIATO --SKINNY, please and thank you! 

Not only can I see this location from my office window on the ninth floor of the Commerce Bank building, but my gosh I can walk to it in less time it takes me to get from the 9th floor to ground level via the elevator. 

Today -- it's Sunday, not working but I am studying and clearly YELPING!!! I arrived around 2:15pm-ish and the place was jumping. In the last hour plus its calmed down a few small groups studying, knitting (yes yarn and needles) and another few here and there with laptops and books. 

I like this location b/c it's clean and the staff are always friendly even during the hectic weekday mornings I love coming here for a hot chocolate when I am not in the mood for coffee. 

This place rocks on the weekends b/c I think people forget it's here and so the flow of traffic is minimal and you can usually find a seat and a plug nearby if you're not a Apple user.

Starbucks is great.  The only issue with this one is the space allowed for people to wait for their drinks.  There is a ton of space in this location overall, but they have crowded tables too close to the waiting area and it makes getting around in that area difficult.  To exacerbate this issue, they have also placed a lot of their additional products (mugs, coffee, etc.) in this area.  This makes it difficult to look at these products when they are busy, but it also means that people have to go out of their way to look at them before making a purchase.

Would be a great place to get your stuff done but this place became the trendiest "study" spot.  Girls would come looking thier best dresse down.  Sort of how they would dress up and get their faces dolled up for the gym.  I loved hanging out there and spreading my books (that I borrowed from the place by the library) all over the tables until the store manager thought it would be a fun idea to blast the AC on so that we wouldn't park for more than 45 minutes.  We were smarter than that, we'd just come in sweats and Uggs.  Problem solved.

On my travels on Canal Street I'd pass the downtown Sheraton Starbuck's sign. Today, I gave it a try.
  It is located at the Canal Street entrance. I came at a busy time. They were fast and too busy to be friendly.
  I had a choice of plush chairs, tables, and bar chairs overlooking Canal Street with the Marriott. I chose the bar chairs. I got plenty of sunlight, which probably kept my coffee warmer, and did some great people watching.

I loved that the employee at the register greeted us when we came in. However, upon ordering the first of my drinks, she proceeded to close the order. When I explained I wanted to get another drink, she rolled her eyes, gave a big sigh and not-so-nicely asked me what else I wanted. She was extremely short for the rest of the transaction. Not what I've come to expect of Starbucks employees.

For the most part, this Starbucks location is like just about any other. You'll find the same coffee, the same snacks and the same retail gifts here. 

Pros:  It's a good location in that it's easy to get to from I-170 and Olive, and there's a traffic light with an arrow that gives you access into the stripmall from the busy street. It's a bit warmer here, which is a nice change from the chilly Starbucks I've encountered elsewhere. The restroom is large and clean. Wifi is decently speedy.

Cons:  I normally don't order food, but I saw the sandwich sign and ordered a veggie one with no egg. The barista didn't bat an eye at my no-egg request and the sandwich was tasty, but there were no veggies, just cheese. Also, this location is very, very small. There's room for maybe 20 seated people and few outlets.

It's, you know, a Starbucks. *shrug*

Busy with college crowd most nights, however coffee is excellent and the staff friendly. If you are a regular they remember your name and your usual drink most of the time. Would recommend for a coffee and some time with friends.

Very friendly staff and convenient location.  The only reason this is not 5 stars is because they have got my order wrong a few times.  I guess when you go through the drive thru these things can happen.  I will say they have been correct every time I go in to the shop......
Horrible service. Huge line and the workers showed no sense of speed or intensity. Very lackadaisical. Waited 10 minutes for a tea?

Typical Starbucks.  The staff is a friendly and they work quickly.  I know nothing of their coffee since I do not drink it, but their iced drinks are pretty tasty.

The restaurant is clean and the staff is always friendly.  If you are not sure of what you want they are willing to help you decide what might be a good fit for you.

I just left your drive thru. You gave me an iced coffee with curdled milk. How do you not realize this when you made the coffee. You have lost my business for good. I feel awful since I drink half the coffee before I noticed it. Thanks a lot !!!!

Worst Starbucks ever! Bathroom filthy, baristas idiots, waited 15 minutes for coffee with no line. Had gift card, asked cashier balance on card he said he couldn't tell me, but it was on receipt. What? Never going back.
This Starbucks is the slowest I've ever been to, six people behind the "bar" and almost twenty minutes for TEA go toa different Starbucks you'll save yourself headache

This place is in the Bellevue so it's a nice location right on broad street. It's the first store on the right once you enter the building so it's easy to get to when you are in a rush. The seating is off in the back of the store (this isn't an "open floor plan" setup) so there is sense of privacy as you eat. The staff is friendly. 

Downside: it can be packed during rush hour. VERY packed. This is the reason I avoid it in the mornings if I can't spare the extra time. Also, the selection is not large. This store has a limited menu and, despite being in a posh location near city hall, frequently runs out of items that are supposedly on the menu

Not a bad place by any stretch of the imagine. It's just that, in comparison to other Starbucks, it just doesn't compare.

Used to be my favorite Starbucks now I try to avoid it. While they used to be friendly and fast and never messed up my  order...
Now they're Rude! Always trash talking loudly near the counter, Slow! And over half the time make my drink wrong but since it took at least 5min to get it I don't have time to correct it.

Wish they were as good as they were a year ago it's gone downhill fast.
And a side note the new decor sucks!!

My oatmeal this morning wasn't hot, but it was hearty! And the two tall blonde roast coffees (I needed the caffeine, and blonde roast actually has MORE than a lot of their espresso beverages) made up for that!

Extremely friendly staff and they're efficient. When I arrived, the drive through line was considerably long but it moved quickly. The sugar free hot chocolate was better than expected being that it was sugar free.

I've been a loyal Starbucks patron but this location will not get my business again the older Asian lady who took my order complained to her co-worker about my drink and didn't realize I was stand ing there listening nor did she pay attention to my request on how I like my drink! It's not rocket science but anyone who has been working at Starbucks for more than a week should know that 1) you don't argue with the customer 2) don't explain why you didn't do as I asked!!! I am the customer who is paying $4 for a fucking coffee!!! Plus a blind man could see that white mocha added to ice is more difficult to mix(ice is cold + white mocha syrup = clumpy hard white mocha at the bottom of the cup!!! Then you tell me that's how it's made!! Well, as a employee I know how it should be made and that is what I requested so just do as a customer request! You get a big f n 0 from me!

I hate to say anything negative about Starbucks but....this location is so in incredibly slow. Always! Ordered a salted caramel mocha frap but they left off the mocha and the extra caramel that I paid for.  I hate coming to this location but it's right up the street.

Every Starbucks is the same bland, boring, sterile yuppie infested, "I'm in a rush, get my latte quick" type place.

Awful Coffee, lousy rude service, terrible sandwiches, overpriced everything.

I avoid it always unless I get a free gift card.

I have never been so disappointed in a Starbucks!  Every location other than this one will make the drink I like even though it is not on the menu.  I then try the place again only to be asked in auto pilot "how are you?" I reply then inquire of the cashier "how are you?". She then disengages and completely ignores me and pays attention to the guest behind me while she's still checking out my transaction.  If you want to be treated like your patronage matters go elsewhere this place blows!  Another thing to mention is that no one smiles that works there.  Do you want to start your day off with the :-( not me!!  And last but not least their parking lot is awful chances are you will get backed into!

Mobile ordered 5 minutes before I arrived.  Five minutes in store and my drinks aren't ready.  Nobody else is in the store waiting for drinks, only drive through.  Not what I would expect when mobile ordering!

Extremely rude staff at the drive through window. They were out of every dessert I asked for and when I asked what they did have the woman raised her voice and shouted at me. She purposefully took her time and made us sit at the window without acknowledging us while she spoke to other people.
Just like any other Sbux. No unique charm but my drink was up quickly.

I love Caramel Machiato Starbucks makes and buy it regularly. Today, however, my early visit to this Starbucks location after my favorite caramel machiato and received tasteless, artificially sweetened liquid without a taste of coffee. I came back to let them know that it was not well made and barista told me that they will replace it. They did. For some unfortunate reason whatever she made for me with her poker face on turned out to be even worse. I did not go back again. You cannot sell coffee for 5 dollars and make me some unknown liquid. Wawa has a better coffee compared to the ones I got today from this Starbucks location. Disappointed...
Their recipe for large peach green tea lemonade is apparently 1/4 liquid and 3/4 ice.  I finished my large tea in a few sips.  Not worth $4.19
I love this Starbucks! The employees are so quick and are always smiling.  My son and I frequent this location often and its always a pleasant visit.

I'll go upstairs to the hotel's coffee shop before i'll wait a half hour in line just to be met up with a barrister that OBVIOUSLY works at the DMV on their off days, again. Service is horribly slow and i can't believe how unfriendly the employees are. Different days yielded the same results. Disappointment. The only thing they did right was make the drink but even that was a fail when they forgot an ingredient.

We buy a house over here off central and are thrilled because Starbucks is 24 hours and I literally use you 24 hours and now you change that????? Done! Will no longer be a a patron of this Starbucks....
Star bucks is always good. you just cant beat them.

Since when does a Frappuccino come with ZERO shots of espresso, forcing you to pay almost $3 to ADD coffee to your coffee drink?! Two drinks took 10 minutes to make and one of them was just a drip coffee that I had to ASK FOR AFTER PAYING & GETTING MY BAR DRINK. Not only that, but the "service" is straight up SURLY. While I was there (all 20+ minutes with only 2 people in front of me) I saw 2 women trying to collect their pre-order have to go through the whole rigamarole of re-ordering because their orders were nowhere to be found.

*Edited for clarification; While I know that any Starbucks, at any time of the day, is fairly busy, this was at around noon to 1 in the afternoon, not a peak time. Very few cars in the drive thru & fewer customers inside the store. And I managed a rival coffee shop (also a drive thru store) for 5 years. If our service was ever this shoddy, or our service times were this long, EVERYONE got reprimanded. My visit was an extremely poor, but accurate (if my past visits are taken into account) representation of how Starbucks treats their guests.

Good place to study or hang out, with lots of tables. But even so, it can get very crowded and near impossible to find a seat during the school year, especially on the weekends. Dress in layers as the temperature can get quite cold if the A/C is on high.

Good location, close to my mechanic Buck's Automotive, Walmart plaza, Battery Plus, etc. Very friendly staff, almost always upbeat, and great customers -that's what really counts when looking for good conversations.
Rude and inefficient staff. Worst Starbucks I've ever been to.  Really exceptionally bad for a Starbucks.

Former SS and barista trainer here. I ordered an iced coffee w/milk and vanilla this morning. When I was handed my drink, it was an iced coffee with a splash of cream on top. I took it, but informed the woman working DT that it wasn't made to beverage standards. The only response I got was an eye roll and her turning her back to me while calling out that she needed a break. For a new drive thru, I would expect the team to be much more attentive to customer service than this.
This Starbucks was super slammed on a Thursday morning. I was probably there 15 minutes for my Chili Mocha. Always busy. Small Seating area. Congested parking lot.

Nice employees; quick service! My drink was delicious.

The only drawback is that this location does not accept rewards.

I went to Starbucks today and I didn't get a coffee drink of any variety.  Rather, I got some lime refresher type drink.  It had a faint taste of mint in it and reminded me of a mojito (sans alcohol, of course). 

Service was great.  Wifi, of course, is always awesome.  This location has a drive-thru, outdoor seating and ample indoor seating.

Rude rude rude. Not what Starbucks represents.  You must not step across The Line before they open, not even to look at the bakery case. Maybe it was just a bad day. Oh yeah, this was 10 min after their opening time according to the website and they still weren't set up.

What's going on with this Starbucks? I've been coming here every day for 2 years and the service just keeps getting worse and worse!! There used to be super nice baristas here, now they're slow and not very helpful at all.

I kept getting Skinny Ventis from the drive through Starbucks on Campbell and Broadway by mistake and these gals gave me a corrected one on the house. Great customer service everytime. Always attentive and patient when I go several times a week.

I love them. 
Their drive thru is fast no matter how crowded. They always remember the stopper/ stir stick (I hate having to ask. It's drive thru. Figure it out and put it on without my request). 
They remember me and my drink order. They are always smiling and friendly. They often have drink samples - even in the drive thru. 
One of the best in the area and def. the best drive thru.
Parking, outdoor seating, drive-thru, WiFi, great coffee-what more could you ask for?

The manager needs to learn how to manage. Employees seem to think playing around and yelling and laughing as loud as they can is acceptable, very childish and unprofessional. The manager needs to understand they are employees not friends. Customers have to yell to be heard over the music and employees. Takes forever to get your order. Very poor service. Like all Starbucks WAY WAY overpriced.

I have been here a few times and I don't know if I've just been unlucky the times that I have come, but the vibe at this Starbucks is definitely different from the other Starbucks in the area. The baristas always seem unhappy and don't greet you with a smile. The young man behind the counter is unfamiliar with how to input orders into the kiosk and when he attempted to ask the other barista about how to input a snickerdoodle hot chocolate into the system, the barista Catie just ignored him. Another time I've been here, the baristas were bantering back and forth with each other trying to pass off the task of who would make the frapuccino I ordered for my kids, another time I asked to have a grande drink split into two small cups and the cashier told me they don't do that - where at other Starbucks they have no issues doing so. Customer service is key and this Starbucks seems to lack it. Food and drinks taste the same as other Starbucks, I just wish they had better customer service and smiled more.

Pains me to give such a low rating, but customer service was poor, product average, and as a passionate coffee drinker, it was almost pathetic to even stay for any length of time. Wifi was spotty, and to top it off, an employee began dusting right over my head as I was drinking my coffee. I left. Baristas were loud and not very friendly. 

Starbucks: you can do much better. I know you can. 

Fail.

This is one of the bigger Starbucks in the SB area, and also the one I frequent the most due to its location in the Camino Real Marketplace. It's a convenient coffee stop if you're out shopping in the area (Costco, Home Depot, Ross, Sports Authority, Ulta, etc) or if you're waiting for the showing of a movie at the theater a couple doors down. This place is quite popular so be prepared for a longer wait (than other Starbucks I've visited) for your drink...it's almost always crowded (a ton of college students studying), there's usually a line, and most seating will be occupied. They renovated a couple years ago so the place has newer furnishings and a slight rearrangement of the layout, but overall it seems pretty much the same as when it first opened. Their super friendly staff and prime location keeps bringing me back, even if it's not the coziest of places and doesn't offer super fast service.

I walk to this location, which is great, because there really isn't much of a parking lot.  I tend to visit with a regular and he gets much better service than I get. The few times a year that I crave a frappuccino, this place could do the job, but I've been to much better locations.  Any mall I've been to or rest stop, blows this place away in service.

This is the second time I've come to the drive-thru and waited for a solid 20 minutes for my coffee. I almost pulled away, but the line finally started to move just as I decided to go. The barista was very sweet and apologized for the long wait, but this consistently happens (according to past reviews of this location and my past experience.) They need to hire more staff or tighten up on the ones they have working. It's ridiculous!
Seriously the SLOWEST Starbucks ever! There's always a ton of people working yet it takes 15 min to get an americano. Don't even get me started on the drive thru.
Starbucks needs to step up their game!! The lattes taste generic and premade! Not fresh and very bitter :(
This location randomly closed for renovations.  And then just as randomly, it opened without their Clover machine.  Which was the whole point.  Off to Chestnut Hill Coffee Co.

Tonight was the first time I visited this newer Starbucks. I went through the drive through and the barista was very friendly, however I didn't get napkins when I got my drink. Is it Starbucks' policy to NOT GIVE napkins? Anyways, the drink was delish but getting out of the drive through is tricky, this stop mall is built on like a mini-hill and my corolla didn't like the steep decline to the street. 

If anyone at Starbucks is reading this...please for your drive through people napkins!!
Not at all happy with the incorrect hours listed showing that this location closes at 11pm.  A Barista just came of and kicked 10 of us out at 10:00pm.

Affectionately known as Charbucks or Fourbucks - we have adopted the slogan of:

"Friends don't let friends drink starbucks."

Save money by brewing at home with Peregrine Coffee (the BEST) or go to La Colombe or Caffeination.
Great staff .. It's what  you expect from Starbucks.  I'm somewhat of a regular due to proximity to home but more often than not a positive experience.

It is a nice Starbucks. The inside has some small more intimate tables as well as a big table if you want to study with a group of people. The service is friendly and the location is nice and safe. It is also open til 8 so it's not 24 hours but at least it's open most of the night.

I live 2 minutes away from this Starbucks location, however I most often drive 10 minutes to get  coffee at another location.  In the 2 years that I've lived nearby, I've had far more bad experiences than good. On several occasions drinks have been forgotten and other times  I've received really slow or indifferent customer service.  What makes it annoying is that this location always seems to have plenty of people working.  It just seems like they often get in each other's way.

If I'm gonna drop $4-$5 on a corporate cup of coffee, I expect to get the drink I ordered and have the pleasant, cookie-cutter experience that should come along with it.

Meh.  At best it's disappointing. At worst, it will make you never want to visit a Starbucks again.

Sadly this is on the way from my gym to work.  If you are lucky, they will greet you with words.  Most days, expect to be a disturbance to the rude and apathetic staff.

I can't tell you how many emails I've written to starbucks about this location.

Most recently they threw a bag of trash from the front OVER the coffee counter because the associate was too lazy to carry it around.  

Poorly managed obviously, rude and apathetic staff.  Spare yourself the agony.

On Saturday March 3 I was traveling from Corona CA to Goleta after a long drive we decided to get off the freeway and get some coffee well I walk in the lady taking my order had the rudest look on her face I can't remember her name it started with a SH SHELY SHIRBY IM NOT SURE I CANT REMEMBER  any way I asked for a venti green tea but quickly changed my mind before she wrote my name on the cup I said you know what can we actually make that a trenta please she straight looked at me and ROLLED HER EYES  walked away while she grunted and threw the cup away  didn't say nothing but gave me my total I've never ever been to a Starbucks who had rude disrespectful employees I tried to brush it off like mabe it was a bad day but that's no excuse when your working in customer service that's just not okay ....

Conveniently located next to and inside (you walk right into) the bookstore. how awesome is that to have a book store and a large Starbucks with ample seating? Well, I think it is :) 
This Starbucks has its usual long lines but the wait time was short for us. Overall, it's a great Starbucks with friendly staff and great coffee. Enjoy
These guys are very busy. I always get an iced green tea. They made it perfectly. The wait was about 20 minutes on a Sunday evening.
Basic Starbucks experience. Nothing fancy. Had the regular items. Fairly small seating area. Had an outdoor seating but it was too cold to sit outside today. Friendly service.

Good place to pop in for a quick minute while you're at the mall. It's very clean and spacious. I only took one star off because it doesn't have the deeply comfy chairs that some places have. The service is really fast.
Girls were cold and the coffee was hot.  Sure would like it the other way but hey you can't be too picky these days when it comes to six dollar coffee.

Love the staff. The service is always great. Never had a bad drink from there. But for the busiest Starbucks in the city, they always have the least amount of staff working. 5 staff when there is 50 people in line. And this is how it always is. This store needs to hire more staff.

In terms of the drinks, food, etc., my experience has always been fine, The biggest issue with this place is the size. Parking is an absolute nightmare, the inside is small, and each time I have been in, the baristas seem to mess up (thankfully never on my order). They always seem a bit flustered (probably due to the crowd, but hey, you work at starbucks, its expected), and while they are always friendly, I generally try to avoid this location because it is more hectic and stressful than it is worth.

Horrible service- my husband was ignored by the employee standing at the register/ another employee finally came over to take his order. Waited over 5 minutes for an iced coffee/ no additions. I took a drink once we had started in our way - horrible - it looked like coffee/---tastes like spit -not sure what it is - tossed it
 .

As a definite regular at this location, I've voted with my feet as to their service quite a number of times by now. I'll admit that while there are many better choices in the city for quality coffee and even better service as well, but as all/most of those options have chosen to ignore/discount the purchasing power and markets of the mid-county area in preference to other more trendy/gentrified areas, I choose to spend my $5 with a company that sees everyone's money as green.

The baristas are friendly and produce a consistently quality product no-matter what I may be in the mood for having. The interior is small and intimate but can become a little cramped when larger crowds arrive. Give this location a try for a quick cup or a nice place to spend an afternoon catching up on emails/etc.

At least three times a week they screw up my simple order. A Venti iced coffee sweetened with light ice is what I ordered. What part of that said put cream in it? This is been repetitive enough that I will no longer go to the store.

I love this Starbucks!! Mackenzie, LeThu, Kate & Danica are wonderful baristas! They are so friendly as well. My drinks are always delish and they make great recommendations. 

I always look forward to stopping in. I definitely recommend!!
I frequent this Starbucks location in the early morning hours and they always have consistent flavor. The staff is friendly- and HELLO!! Drive thru!! Love it.

This review is about an exceptional barista--His name is Ivan. 

Not only is Ivan skilled, he is also very kind and full of sunshine. He's the sort of person we all want to work alongside in our jobs and he elevates customer service to a standard that often seems a thing of the past. His friendly manner creates an atmosphere which is relaxed and makes you smile.

Somehow, Ivan remembers my quirky, unique order even though I don't come in every day--or even every other day.

Thank you, Ivan for your cheerfulness and consistently delicious orders :)
Terrible service, went through to get my latte, cup less than half full! Went inside to get a full cup, and she literally poured in a shot of coffee!  Rude staff. Never again Starbucks! NEVER AGAIN

I have been a Starbucks customer for years and this Starbucks in centerton square is closest to my work so I go there 3 times a week at a minimum. I have been increasingly disgruntled with this location. The layout stinks, the staff are fast but they seemed to have lost their friendlier baristas, and I hate that I have to ask for milk for my coffee because they only put out half in half...I know that's corporate but when I go to the Starbucks on main street they are so much cooler about it. Going to avoid the centerton location as much as possible from now on.

Here I'm in this city again and their is some sort of festival in china town. All the surrounding roads are blocked and the traffic is very backed up. Then I see the happiest sight of the day, Starbucks! Even better a nice parking space right in the front! Unfortunately they were about to close so there was no sweets left. I was able to get my hot tea though. The lady at the counter who looked very tired apologized that there were none! I told her I should not be eating more sweets any way! 
It's a nice clean Starbucks with lots of seating and available wifi. Unlike most other Starbucks I've gone to, you didn't need a code or a key to use the bathrooms. It had two stales in the ladies room and was very clean. I just wish they didn't close so early!

totally where i did all my studying.  bring your headphones, and backpack, and you'll look like the rest of the hunched over college students.
ahhh memories.
oh, also, during winter quarter, they pass out lots of free samples of peppermint mocha and gingerbread lattes.  yum.
Been here twice and I am impressed that even with a long ass line the whole order a drink and pick it up process is fast and smooth.  Works for me.  Plus almond milk Cappuccino?  Holler!

We are actually Open 4:30 am - 10:30 pm Monday-Friday and 5:00 am - 10:00 pm Saturday and Sunday! 
I partially feel inappropriate for posting on this as I am a Barista here! But just a quick message!
We are a very, very busy store. Often with many "new" partners so it is sometimes tough for them to handle certain situation with speed! Our drive through is often packed! And although you may swing by for just a cup of coffee, other cars often order multiple drinks, thus making the wait times increase! We promise we feel bad! Inside the store is often a safer bet if the drive through is packed! Sometimes a drink can be misplaced, mis marked and sometimes the Starbucks goblin just eats them up! So if we are ever lagging on your drink, don't feel bad to check in with us and make sure we didn't misplace it! Also, we often run out of things since we are so very busy! Please understand that it is sometimes a district wide shortage on some products, and certain things get discontinued! So if we are out, we promise we are sorry and chances are we want some too!!! If any barista is ever short, or rude with you, don't feel bad to ask for a manager or report the situation as we should always be kind and caring and ready to help YOU! But please also understand that we are human and stress does get to us and forgive us if we slip up! I am passionate about this store and company and want our customers to enjoy the experience 100% but I, myself, can only do so much!!!! One last thing/suggestion! We understand that you are busy people! But if you are ALREADY late for work, don't go through the drive through when there is more then three cars! Also understand that each barista has a different set of skills, coffee knowledge and experience! This is often why some drinks may taste different/better on different days! Thank you for your understanding and we hope to see you for some caffeine soon! :)

Well I was just here around 11 on a week day watched 6 people go threw line before me some with multiple drink cashier took in well over 60$ right in front of me I came to the register and ordered my drink was 6.77 I had 6 or 100$ cashier says well I can give you change for that and but you can get a smaller drink ? Well no not what I want or ordered how can such a large business not have change mid day for 100 when I just watched them uptake almost the sum of my change ??
Love this Starbucks !! Lonnie is the best barista in town, you can't find a friendlier person that works for Starbucks.

On 07/22/15 around 5:00 pm I was there. Not busy, my latte took forever, the 2 baristas didn't bother making eye contact, vanilla shaker was empty, a fly and a fruit fly landed on my table and table was wobbly! Is this A Starbucks?

The drive-thru is my favorite thing about this Starbucks.  Is there anything better than a cup of Starbucks to get you through an early morning?  I think not!  The drive-thru makes it so easy to hop off 275 and grab my drink without losing too much time, which is huge since I'm always running late!

The parking lot is always packed, but there's a side street nearby for overflow parking.  There isn't a ton of seating inside, but there is a nice big patio area outside.  The staff is always friendly, and of course, the drinks are wonderful!
Parking sucks. Gave me a venti that was 1/3 empty. Coffee is expensive enough without  shorting people out of the product.

Okay location compared to Newtown and other locations. Baristas are rude, and that is my only complaint about this Starbucks. Drinks are good. If you don't care about service, you shouldn't have a problem going here.

Sparks, NV

Good and fast service. Always accurate on their orders. Cute baristas doesn't hurt either. Opens at 0500 really helps a lot.

S-L-O-W-W-W!  Drive up (while still at a turtle's pace) gets more attention than those who brave actually walking in. 
And while I'm here, and speaking of walking in,the front door is ridiculously hard to open. While they have a "handicap" parking space in front I doubt if anyone needing to park there could open the door without assistance. Seems like Starbucks could afford to install an auto door device.
The worst Starbucks experience of my life.  The employees were talking amongst each other as opposed to working.  Took 30 mins for me to get my Grande iced coffee.  That is unacceptable.
Too impersonal of a feeling for me. Good if you are cruising through shopping area I guess. Nothing special. Used to have later hours, but once that stopped, I don't go back.

Very upset to the point that I'm actually writing a review. The barista forgot my drink and started back talking to me on how to grab my drink off the counter. It was a Monday evening with barely any customers. 

Dear Miss Darla, I reloaded my card, asked for a tall green tea frap, the cashier even repeated my drink back  to me and gave me my reciept. Then I walked 2 feet over to the counter and guess what I saw. I saw you make the drinks for the ladies before me, watched you make drinks for FOUR customers after me and leave. Not one, not two, but FOUR customers. I saw every drink you make and nothing was in a tall cup with a green colored drink. Don't tell me "Once you see your drink, you grab and go" and think it is my fault that I didn't grab my 'so called drink'. 

Such bad customer service. Not even apologizing for making me wait 15 minutes for my drink, but talking back to a customer. Really now?

Walk in to get a drink. No hello or welcome. The workers talked to each other and ignored my existence.. after I asked where my drink was a worker rolled her eyes and said over there. Not coming here again..

Relocating to this new spot is the best thing they could have done. Not only are all the costumers happy, but I'm sure attracting more. The parking and drive-thru have improved drastically. I feel like the staff has also improved. They were always polite, but now they seem genuinely happy.  The drive-thru line moves quickly, and there is always room to study.
Most unprofessional Starbucks I've ever been too. The 5 girls in the back were listening to their own music and not helping people.

Parking was easy (street), and the place was large and airy. What you'd expect from a newer Starbucks. We entered and immediately felt the positive energy from the staff. Friendliest most welcoming Starbucks staff I've ever come across.  Thank you for making our Sunday morning brighter.
Been to quite a few starbucks and you get thru the line here faster than any of them. Also like the fact that the drinks are pretty consistent at all of them.

I love starbucks ice coffee but this place is SO PACKED and SO SLOW and so tiny. And parking is hard outside.  I just avoid this place. There are so many wonderful starbucks nearby and this place is super annoying and I have been here many many times before realizing that it's the same every single time!!

The only drink I've gotten from Starbucks the past year is the green tea lemonade with extra lemonade and literally every other time they hand me a PEACH TEA LEMONADE (gross) and when I try to correct them half the time they hand me just green tea. Green tea lemonade is on the menu so why is it so hard to get it right?

I love Starbucks and it's really nice to find a close by location that always makes your drinks right! I like to do mobile orders and my orders are always ready on time. The staff is very nice and welcoming and eager to help. Even if I'm closer to a different location, I'll drive the extra mile to this location!
These girls will make laugh. Very nice and friendly people here.
Hanging out with my friend drinking my pumpkin spice latte. So delicious!  Love this time of the year!

A colleague and I decided on this particular Starbucks to meet for morning coffee. Starbucks are generally pretty much the same, minus the amount of seating each one has.

This particular Starbucks has a pretty good setup. When you walk in there are several easy chairs a few tables and then a couple of high top type tables towards the back. Unfortunately this place is pretty popular, and based on the clientele, it seems like that is primarily due to this location being very close to high school.

We wanted to sit and chat and were lucky enough to find an open table. The staff seemed friendly enough, filled the orders with a smile, and the coffee we chose was made to order and tasty.  

I personally prefer local mom and pop type coffee shops. Unfortunately in Tampa there aren't enough of them around so Starbucks is a solid back up if you want to get a good cup of coffee, and have a place to sit and chat. This particular Starbucks is no exception.

Not a huge fan of chains but I give Starbucks credit for opening right in the heart of Seminole Heights before the ongoing growth sky rocketed. I will also say, that as chains go, this one has been a useful addition since we don't have many other options for late night and very early AM coffee (Jet City isn't open late and The Independent doesn't open until 9am). The drive through is nice and the hours are awesome. Parking is tough sometimes - this is a tight small area but there is a surprising amount of indoor seating available for such a small location.

I come to this Starbucks over and over because of location. Each time I come here the staff is unfriendly and not helpful. I always feel like I'm inconveniencing them. I noticed that staff had changed almost completely the last time I was in here, but the service is the same! Whenever I get the chance to go to another one I jump on it. I hope this changes.
One of the smallest Starbucks in the city. I've never had a problem with the staff. I just wish this location had better seating. Max is the greatest barista EVER!

This is my favorite Starbucks in Doylestown. The baristas are very chatty and friendly, and inside there are 2 rooms for seating, giving you a view of historic Doylestown. One of my favorite drinks at Starbucks is Iced Coffee, but this Starbucks always seems to not have it! They also run out on a lot of little supplies.
Fabulous service. The lines tend to be lengthy between classes but the staff is always friendly and drinks are made with care. A great addition to Washington University's campus!

It's not my favorite Starbucks, but it's my neighborhood location. The staff is friendly, the bathrooms and seating area is decently clean. It's got a great atmosphere, but its a little too cozy for comfort. They seem to be more focused on the drive-thru than the walk-in customers, but I can't blame them too much. Over all, for a quick stop or a in dire need of a Starbucks hit, I would recommend this location.
We were In the neighborhood & stopped by for coffee.  We ended up getting a mocha frappe & vanilla bean frappe they were both excellent!!Customer service was great also.
Friendly workers, always ready with a suggestion. I saw one worker spend 20 minutes showing customers cups on the shelves. The tea and coffee were delicious as was the cookie. Awesome!

Just like the previous reviewer, the staff is so friendly and that is the main reason I am writing this review.

I needed a late night pick me up and I had yet to have a pumpkin spiced latte so I thought i would drop by.  I literally walked in the door at 8:55pm, store closes at 9pm, and the lady behind the counter greeted me with a smile.  After I ordered, she continued to make small talk and ask me how my night was.  I told her I needed a caffeine boost since I fell asleep studying for the cpa exam.

While making my drink, she said it sounds like you need a little extra boost to get you through the night.  I was like, "that sounds amazing".  When she went to ring me up she said the extra shot was on the house since she hoped it would improve my mood for studying.... well it did and here I am writing this review!

Having worked in the service industry, I know how one eye's that clock come closing time.  I thought me entering the store so close to closing time would definitely upset the staff... that was clearly not the case. 

Job well done!

Worst Starbucks ever, tried complaining before but they are owned by Saint Joes. Smh If I want a coffee that bad, I wait until target opens on City Ave. at eight instead. Everyone that works there acts like your bothering them. Best way I can explain it. Gave them two stars because the coffee is made correctly.

Beautiful store. Horrific service. Just waited in line for 28 minutes to get a bento coffee only then to be told there was no half & half by a dread headed barista who was to busy singing and cracking wise to his coworkers to do it politely. Called the manager as I left. She told me cream was on the way and told me she "understood" when I mentioned the lack of customer service. 

Sorry. Was really glad to see this place open but will gladly wait in line at one of the 5 others Starbucks within a few blocks before I return to this one. Apparently, it's more of an open mic comedy store than a real Starbucks.
Slow and rude. Ordered my drink took forever I also ordered a beagle she threw it across the counter and it fell on the floor and my drink came out wrong. Lame.

They really need to figure out a better system for alerting the employees when a mobile order comes through. Every time I order on the app and I come in to pick up, the barista says "oh, a mobile order?" and goes over to the machine and there's like 3 tickets for pending mobile orders hanging out of the machine.

The people are always nice but I took away a star because they forget to stock up on cinnamon. They would go days without cinnamon. Note there's a grocery store within walking distance and a Sam's Warehouse less than 2 miles away on the same street.
We came in to get some fraps as it was a hot day in Indy. The place was clean. It appeared new location built. It's a pretty big size. I would come back again.
The staff are all efficient and friendly. They know my drink and always ask about me and my family. Jocelyn is an absolute sweetheart!!
Don't hang out here long if you need to use the bathroom.  Only 1 at a time for the men.  Awful.

I was unimpressed by this location; it suffers from the inner-city Starbucks syndrome patrons may be familiar with in other big cities like New York.  It had a resident homeless guy on the days I visited.  The staff is a bit defensive as a result.  The feng shui is lousy and there aren't a whole lot of good seats.  It's not a disaster, but it's also not a particularly good example of this otherwise reliable chain.

I watched someone maneuver their SUV in the most artful way to not hit someone in the parking lot. Their bumper seemed to be about an inch away from the side of another car that was parked in front of the store. Mind you, this Starbucks for some reason allows people to park in spaces that aren't actually spaces, making the already-tiny lot a complete and utter nightmare. We somehow got a spot in the 15-minute parking area and I was glad that the people in back of us finally moved. It was insane. That is my main complaint. I'm not sure what I would have done without an actual parking spot. Other than that... my frap was tasty and the staff seemed nice.

The new renovations make this place (intentionally?) uninviting to those who wish to do some work there and it is an overall change for the worse.  The new tables are tiny, so one could not use a laptop and book of notes at the same time (not even close).  I miss the old tables.  Maybe they wanted to get rid of the student crowd?

Pros: Good coffee.

Cons: Gets really crowded. Music is too loud for my tastes.

Otherwise, just like any other Starbucks.

The review only pertains to a custom coffee from the Clover machine. This was a weekday morning not crowded by Sunday morning standards. The barista was busy and doing much multi-tasking. The coffee came to me tepid - well below 140 degrees - and I presume it was waiting for the barista to pour it. The tall size is $4 vs. $1.90 for the regular Pike Place.coffee, so it deserves a bit more attention. Other than being busy I do not have a complaint about the service at this location. I just do not think that any regular coffee shop can handle custom coffee. The Clover machine was built to make it all automatic, and it is now unique to Starbucks, but whether it fulfills its function is something else.

As a University of the Art's student I am ALWAYS at this Starbucks. Let me say, I am absolutely in love with it and its staff. Everyone there is very knowledgeable, and oh so outgoing. Go there 2 times and by the 3rd they know you and your drink. 

Shout out to my favoritist barista in the world: Emilie!

The people who work and run this Starbuck's are nothing short of wonderful. The parking is not bad either because there are all the public lots in Chestnut Hill dotting Germantown Avenue labeled with PARKING signs which are free to customers. The cafe is clean and the staff really take pride in their work. The only drawback is the table size, but there have been a couple bigger tables introduced. I come to this place all the time and am never disappointed.

Dear Starbucks,

Recently heard a quote that I thought was worthy of the general feel of this and the greater part of your stores.  "Just because you're the best at something doesn't mean you're actually good"-Doug Stanhope.

Well, unfortunately, this is not a time I relish saying "I told you so", but this place.  Gets worse by the day.  I've included my review from November 2014 a  few lines below, and well... I told you so.  Don't rely on my impressions alone.  Just peruse the recent reviews of this spot!

This location, currently, like all in NOLA, is just so subpar by any measure.  When under the original store manager, this place hummed.  It virtually operated on a raised vibrational plane.  Anyone who frequented a couple of years ago knows what Ima saying.  Was the fastest, friendliest, freshest, quality, expertly crafted Siren's snug you could happen upon.  

Now?  A factory of lifeless, corporately churned sadness.  Nowadays NOLA's coffee-loving veins are coursing with the lifeblood of far too many superior 3rd waves to even consider this, this...ardently formulaic inferiority. 

The only decent Starbucks in the area is the Kenner location on Esplanade, curiously NOT in the NOLA market.  

MY ORIGINAL REVIEW FROM NOVEMBER 2014 FOLLOWS:

Although I travel a lot, I consider myself a regular at this location when I'm back home in Metry.  I experienced the old store down the street and all it's immense problems (parking, drive through, etc), and the move to this new location earlier this year.  Great improvements were made all across the board in the areas around: 1) quality of employees, 2) presentation of the store, 3) quality of the products, and most importantly, 4) quality of service and atmosphere.

Well, now.  I sensed something was amiss last week on my 1st visit since around the middle of October.  I went through the drive through and the service was uncharacteristically slow.  And I mean slow to the tune of 25 minutes in line with only 6-8 cars in line.  Had nearly the same experience a couple of days later, and the kicker?  The drinks were wrong, and nearly undrinkable, both times.  This from a location that I considered to be the best around for a proper drink.

So I go in the store a couple of days ago and ask a customer, with whom I've become acquainted, what was going on?  He replies that Jay is gone.  

I don't go around offering reviews on personalities, etc., but the loss of Jay as the manager of this store is gonna be crippling.  This man worked tirelessly to get to know every single customer, knew all of our drinks, always asked if everything was perfect, he was a walking coffee encyclopedia, was always sweeping the floors, making sure everything was just right.  I can go on, but you get the picture.  Any of the regulars who knew Jay will know exactly what I mean.

I ask a barista, "Where's Jay?"  Strangely, the reply goes something like, "Don't really know what happened.  I think the management culture makes the store manager's job impossible."  And I'm told several baristas have quit or asked to be reassigned as a result.

Starbucks, I don't know what is going on here, and I don't know the entire story, but if you can't hold on to an employee the quality of Jay, you have serious institutional issues.  I have never met a more caring, resourceful, hard working person as the man you have apparently now lost.  His dedication to Starbucks was obvious within a couple of minutes of talking to him.  It will take a lot to get this store up and running at the level it was under his guidance and leadership.

Apologies if this seems like a soapbox stance, but I decided I should use this forum to voice my displeasure with the noticeably quick demise of the area's only truly great Starbucks location.  Good luck getting your s**t together again.

Came in early morning before 7am on our way back to Portland, and the place was clean, staff were friendly, and although the drive through was slammed it really didn't take that long to get our order. When you consider just how few people are actually making the drinks I thought it was pretty amazing watching them work. Was a convenient location on our way back to the freeway, and appreciated the smiles from the staff.
I don't drink much Starbucks since they got bad quality beans, but the staff at this location is nice. The drinks are below average. What can i say its Starbucks...

I have been here on the mornings since it's by my home and will never come here again.. Reasons are because I'm always late for work in the mornings.. There's a worker in the drive through that's always chit chattering way too long with customers and there a fat line behind us .. I'm done with being late to work

There is this lovely lady named Lisa that works at this location. She was so sweet to me despite them being plummeted by the drive thru patrons. I tried their new iced coconut latte, I believe. She said hey, since its the first time trying this drink, bring it back if you don't like it and I'll replace it. How sweet. I like Starbucks, but I think people in FL must love it. There must be one or two on every street.

Not only do the staff at this Starbucks take the time getting to know the regular customers, they treat every individual with a sincere kindness incomparable to any other coffee shop around. 

With their competitor, Chestnut Hill Coffee Co, up the block, the staff manage to being that small town coffee shop feel into this Starbucks. I have not been in a nicer Starbucks than this nor do not know of any nicer one (besides that faraway land of Seattle). It is also equipped with a clover machine which brews special reserve coffees you may only find at 52 other Starbucks in the country.

Overall, this Starbucks creates a warm and relaxing environment and is good for waiting around for a bus, gathering with friends, studying for finals, and just reading a book with a cup of coffee. For a Starbucks, it's a 5-star experience.

This is by far my favorite location to goto. Just as every Starbucks serves the same menu, the baristas do a great job bringing me back to this location. Launie always makes the experience a great one for me. Keep up the great work because I will be back!

What is important to know about this Starbucks is it's just off I275 easy exit and easy return back on to the interstate. Important for travelers to know. Larger store size, lot's of outdoor seating, drive through and very busy most times. Other than that it's a Starbuck's nuf said.

I really liked this location up until today when they purposely gave me the wrong change back & lied about it! I was the ONLY car in the drive-thru (which neverrr happens here). My order cost $5.73 & I gave her a $10 bill + 73 cents...all she had to do was give me a $5 bill back as change! She gave me my drink as soon as I pulled up & handed her the money...all that was left to do was turn around & hand me the $5 change. Tell me why I had to sit at the window waiting for sooo long that eventually 3 cars had pulled in, ordered & were waiting for a while behind me before she gave me $3 + some coins. I tried to tell her the change was wrong & she kept ignoring me/pretending she didn't hear or see me, even though she was standing right at the open window doing nothing the entire time...so I waited.
