When she decided to acknowledge my presence again, I told her I got the wrong change back & it's supposed to be a $5 bill. She starts giving me some b.s. defensive speech & I got so fed up that I just drove off. If u want to steal an extra tip for yourself & are that desperate for $1-$2 then just take it & go buy yourself some nice chapstick at dollar general. Also let me just point out that I completely understand having to wait a while in lines because people are busy making orders or having a bad day, that's fine & when they apologize, I tell them it's no problem at all & not to worry about it. That being said, it was at least 5 minutes before the FIRST car behind me even pulled into the drive-thru and there were THREE cars who showed up & ordered before she even gave me any "change". She was 100% just being a petty lying thief on purpose!

Great experience and service. 

DEFINITELY try the nitro cold brew they serve here. It is so incredibly creamy and delicious. Its a bit more bitter than Id prefer, but I find most of Starbuck's coffees to be thay way. Even so, give it a try. It's quite good!

This place is always busy and packed but despite the busyness service is very fast and the employees are always nice and on point keeping things moving. 

The couch towards the back of the store is very comfy too. My only complaint is the small parking.
Don't expect service, speed or quality. Disappointment to all the Starbucks that do a great job.
Always a good place to adjust time after heading westbound.

One word: NASTY. 


I stopped in here for a hot chocolate and it was rancid. For realsies. I literally almost threw up. 

*Let me clarify, since there seems to be confusion: I am reviewing the Starbucks at the address listed on the review. Across from Target, near DSW on Sierra Pkwy- they made the nasty drink. 

I was the only person in line, and it took the lady several minutes to even acknowledge me. I ordered a tall hot chocolate and a slice of the lemon pound cake. 

I take a bite of the lemon cake, pretty good- the bread tasted a little stiff- like it was a little stale, but the frosting on the top was good. I wait a few mintues for the hot chocolate to cool while I drive to the mall- and then I take a swig....OH MY GOD. *GAG* There is some really funk nasty after taste. It was downright puke inducing. I can't even really describe it, it was VERY bitter and disgusting and it left a horrible after taste in my mouth. I was like, wtf is up with this drink? 

I tried to give it the benefit of the doubt, I told myself it must've tasted funny because I took a bite of the lemon cake before hand. So I take another swig- and it's still this NASTY bitter mouthful of BLECH. I decided that they must've made me the wrong thing. I think, Ok so maybe this is some funky holiday version of hot chocolate and I needed to specify regular hot chocolate.( "Is it impossible to get a cup of coffee-flavored coffee? You can get every other flavor except coffee-flavored coffee! They got mochachino, cappuchino, frappachino, Al Pacino, what the F***?")


I figured since I'm at the mall, and there is the starbucks kiosk there- I'd just double check and see if they wouldn't mind making me the right one. I explain the situation to the guys there and he's trying to figure out what is going on with my drink- he sniffs it and makes a face. Then, being the brave soul that he is, he takes a sip from my cup- and proceeds to gag and shake his head. He announces that the Mocha mix that they put into my drink was rancid. 

Neat. Nothings better than a hot chocolate made with rotten mocha milk mix. Mmm. Needless to say, I didn't touch the rest of that lemon cake either. 

I will never come to this starbucks again. My stomach curdles just thinking about this place. Ew! 



Note: Kudos to the folks at the Meadowood starbucks for making me a new one that was not made with expired ingredients. See my review for that location. :)

I have spent many days here working on my laptop.The staff are always friendly.  Over my 8 hour marathon sessions I would have 2 or 3 cups of coffee and 2 sandwiches. I would often get my water topped up even with out asking. This for me was a very nice touch.

Above all I like the ambiance of the cafe. They update the furniture at the end of the summer in 2013. I preferred the old computer desk but I am growing into the new furniture.

Believe it or not, this has nothing to do with the overpriced, cheap coffee. Everyone knows about that.

It depends. Sometimes there's no line. Sometimes there's a huge line. Sometimes the baristas are great, and sometimes they give me a ton of attitude for requesting they put half and half in my coffee because I'm late and don't have time to do it myself. Like, sorry you have to actually put effort into your job???

Great place to grab a coffee and study for a bit. Lighting is nice and a bunch of outlets along the window. They also have a community table and 2 small 2 people tables. The baristas were super sweet- probably one of the nicest Starbucks baristas I've encountered, and the food came out very quickly! Love it!

Horrible service! The baristas do not know what they are doing and have zero experience. They have no clue on how to make a latte or a simple coffee. I asked for an iced green tea latte and they gave me a HOT latte instead and had to make it a second time. Still they made it wrong and i had to get my money back. I gave them 3 chances the three times i went there and the service was HORRIFIC. Please do not go there. You will be wasting your time. How do you work at a starbucks and not know what an iced macchiato or green tea latte is? Nice decor, horrible service

This is my first time to this newer location, and I was so excited to see they have a drive thru(through?) even though it's not really set up for it. The drive thru actually goes around the back of all the restaurants in that strip. It's kind of a cluster back there because there is also construction going on. Staff super friendly but my iced Americano was room temperature and had no ice at all :/

This my staple.  However the place is getting run down.  The bathroom is not fresh and the floors are dirty.  Guys. ...close for a week or two deeeeeeep deeeeeeep clean.  Buy new furniture some good lighting and some happy crew and boom!

Brand new. Clean as can be. Updated and modern looking. Excellent service and coffee drinks. Probably the fastest I've ever seen my drinks made and drive thru line move. And one fancy drive thru order board to confirm your order. Not to mention a speaker that sounds like the person taking order is standing at your window, unlike the muffled and crackling experience you get at most drive thrus. This specific Starbucks just became my go to spot. And super convenient located on 301 and a short jump over to the I-75 on ramp means to can get any direction fast after your espresso fuel up!
I love this Starbucks!  It's got everything - nice barristas, beautiful atmosphere.  I come here almost every day and it's always a pleasant experience.

It's a Starbucks, you know what their coffee tastes like (meh) and what their prices are like (high). So I'll tell you why this became my Starbucks.

They recently renovated the seating and it's a GREAT study spot. Reliable wifi, big tables in the middle, a comfy couch in the corner, and seating all alongside the window (read: convenient outlets and people watching). Huge improvement to the awkward tiny circular tables they had before. It can get randomly crowded sometimes (why any family would decide to bring all their children here for an afternoon or why a mom would bring 8 teens to drink frappucinos is beyond me). The barristas are nice. One of them made fun of me for having been there every day for a week when writing the paper that wouldn't die, I appreciated that he noticed. 

I still prefer independent coffee shops like Citadelle or Toast, but when I'm too lazy to go that far, this will do. Plus I'm a sucker for that Passion Iced Tea in the summer (get it half sweetened, it's better) and for $1.62 (?) it's pretty good.

I am one of the regulars and This starbuck is my favorite of all Starbucks that I've been too! The barista always make my drink taste the way I Like it! The staff are friendly and helpful! Highly recommended!:)

I won't lie to you - I always prefer local shops over big chains, and daily lament the fact that there just aren't any around of the former variety (literally, daily - I wake up every day and lament this specific problem, brush my teeth, and then merrily go about my day :-p ). I hope one day this will change back to how it used to be (doubt it). However, this is the next best thing (yay ...). This Starbucks has a good atmosphere, friendly baristas, and I've been doing work there at least a few days a week for several weeks now. It's a good change of scenery for getting some work done and it's lively at times - there's an open mic night every Friday evening at 7:30 (though during some months, it seems to be on Thurs. - check first before deciding to check it out), featuring some nice local talent. Overall, it has a homey feel, and I like that it's well-lit - full window facades on two of its four sides. I definitely appreciate natural light; so this is much prefered to me over a lot of other coffee shops (most of them Starbuckses - see above) that are entirely closed in with no windows or with only a few small ones. I wish this location were a bit bigger, and I heard it used to be 24 hours, but no longer - that would've been nice too. Overall, a good Starbucks in the area.
This is a great space to come in to work alone or to have a meeting. There is a huge very long table that allows you to spread out and not get in the way of others. Such a great spot in Metairie!
It's Starbucks . . . nothing really bad to say.  Pumpkin bread is amazing!!

This is a really nice Starbucks. I love the modern look and feel of it since they renovated about a year ago. They also have the exclusive Reserve Roastery blends (only a fraction of Starbucks locations offer these) so if you really like specialty blends/ exotic beans, you can find them here. I give it three stars though, because they are so slow every time I come here. I'd say I wait on average one minute for my drink at most Starbucks locations, but every time I come here I'm consistently waiting 4 or more minutes. Doesn't seem like a lot, but it feels like an eternity when other locations (and other coffee joints) have a much quicker speed of delivery. It's puzzling that they're so slow because they always have 5 or 6 employees in there that appear to just be getting in the way of one another behind the counter.

I wouldn't normally go out of my way to review a Starbucks, but I'll make an exception here.

The service at this Starbucks is fantastic. We have been going here for the past year and a half since we moved to SoBro, and we always get great service here. All of the baristas are super friendly and have great senses of humor. I'm sure working as a barista at Starbucks, they encounter their fair share of unpleasant people on a daily basis, but they never let it show.

My partner pointed out that since we are moving downtown soon, we will probably never visit this Starbucks again and it made me a little sad cause the baristas are always so pleasant to interact with!

The service good but here is what I don't like, this is a franchise place meaning there are Starbucks all over the country. I should be able to go to one Starbucks in Phoenix and it taste the same in Missouri but that wasn't the case. The store was dirty and the restroom was dirty. I get it when it gets busy that it can cause a mess but when you walk in and people are just hanging around and the store is dirty that's a problem. The macchiato was not good and pretty much tasted like milk. For a 5 dollar coffee I expect for it to taste better. Was not happy with this Starbucks

nice décor but barristas have attitude they are superior to their clientele & didn't get right order; I requested 10 shots of expresso and given 4!  they did not allow me to pour the 1/2 & 1/2 & the manager takes out her emotions on her customers.  I was denied my birthday drink because I didn't have my card # with me; they don't answer phone!
temperature too cold & employees gossip about me.  Not fun.

I come to this starbucks AT LEAST once a day everyday.  I spend hundreds of dollars a month at this starbucks buying coffee, tea, etc.  Most of the time I come, my order is wrong, the staff is completely rude and disrespectful to the customers, or they take their time to make a drink because they are so lazy and even if I'm the only one in there, it takes forever to make an iced tea.  I really hope this starbucks gets better because its a great area for this.  The only employee that is really nice and is on top of things is Matt.  They also use a computer to put in the orders instead of using the sharpie and writing on the cup and writing your name, etc, i know it's lame but it just seems like a regular coffee store when they don't do the starbucks tradition of the sharpie and the customers name!

I went to this Starbucks location last night for just a cookie or any type of dessert/pastry.  I was craving something sweet, so pretty much anything would've done.  I walked inside at about 7:30 PM and step in front of the refrigerated case to find it empty.  I stared at it for the longest time wondering if this location closed at 8 PM maybe and I'd just missed them putting away all the food for the night or if maybe they'd had a whole tour bus stop by that wiped them out or something.  It was probably 5 minutes that I stood there.  Not one employee ever addressed me or my confused expression at the empty case, and I eventually ended up just leaving and getting a delicious, fresh chocolate chip cookie from the Puccino's down the street.  Out of curiosity I looked up their hours this morning to see when they closed, and, come to find out, they were open until 10 PM last night...  I'm hoping I caught them on a bad night maybe, but I won't be back to find out.

Overpriced, overhyped coffee. So tired of not being able to sit down inside because of inconsiderate people using this as an internet café.  I'm done. There are many other places to have excellent coffee.
Going to Starbucks today was the best! The barista made the greatest recommendation for a special frapuccino and it was just perfect.

Possibly the nicest and most knowledgeable Starbucks staff I've ever encountered!  They made my coffee perfect they made what started as a bad day a very good one! We are so lucky to have them right on the beach it's nice for the people who live here and visitors alike! I will be back and recommend to all! Thanks guys!

I'm a Starbucks regular (twice a day every day). I don't come to this location often because it's not my favorite. They are always understaffed and today when getting an iced Americano with white mocha, the barista didn't even stir it. When I asked to store it before he gave it to us he said they are understaffed and they don't have time to stir the drinks with dairy in them because he needs to wash it. Weird because I get it every day at the other locations and they make it perfect. Why can't all Starbucks be like the Keystone Reno location?!
This is your run of the mill Starbucks.. We went on a Saturday morning .. Slightly slow staff and not the most friendly but they got the job done.  Coffee was served and it was good!

If I could give this Starbucks zero stars I would. Barista Heather was very rude and off-putting and Macy was like a deer in headlights and very confused. The training here is clearly subpar when compared to how well trained the staff is at the other Starbucks I frequent. It is unfortunate that this location has such poor quality employees.

A very nice young lady serviced me on 06/08/17, we spoke of Natalie's cakes. Very informational about company who makes them. Thank you for a delightful experience. 

Thanks again,
Occasional long lines at peak times, but staff works hard to move customers thru. Staff always friendly despite being very busy.  I go here almost daily.

Drink was made fine, customer service was bad. The male cashier was nice, but when I went to grab my drink and say thank you the girl gave me a condescending look. When I asked where the straws were she told me the condiment bar not even looking up or pointing. I would probably come to this location more if you didn't have such rude female employees. Came here on 5/2/2017

This place is great. They have a friendly and knowledgeable staff and make great beverages. This is by far my favorite Starbucks in this area. When I mobile order I always know that my order will be ready when I get there. I have never been disappointed and am always happier walking out than I am walking in! :)

I don't go to Starbucks very often. I do love my Venti Iced Vanilla Latte,  but it's over $5 now! Their prices keep creeping up.
I got to this particular location as its right by my house and is perfectly located for me to zip through the drive thru and grab a beverage.
The employees here are always nice and they must drink alot of coffee because they are always SUPER chipper and happy! Lol
Most times the drive thru line isn't too bad, but any more then 3 cars in front of you and it can be quite the wait. Not sure why this is, but I know the other day when I went it was due some guy just having to pay with his cell phone. The girl at the window had to scan it 4 times.  Was it his phone or their scanner/register?  The world will never know.
Most Starbucks are pretty much the same overall, but I do like the ease of this location. No left turns.

Miserable People. They will take your money but not allow paying customers to use the restroom . They blame the size of the crowd 4 hours before parade time but somehow the size of the crowd is not keeping them from making thousands of dollars an hour. This store manager should be fired. You can put more people on your cash register but not to service your restroom ?
Coffee is good but a grande size is now what a tall used to be.   Not good--lower the price if that's case.   There are many other coffee places near here to visit
It's okay. I use to stop here daily. Just to pricey. 10$ for coffee and a muffin, if the prices went down a bit I would come back. :(

Great coffee and pastries. Gets very busy noon time. 

You got to try the espresso, they seemed to have changed the source of their beans, great woody flavor. Double shot gives you a much needed kick in the morning ::;

I want to give a shout-out to this location and the great people working today. I recently found out I am lactose intolerant and I am still learning to ask for milk alternatives. I forgot to ask for my drink with a milk alternative and they were super nice about it and helped me get one without milk. Extra points here!

It's a Starbucks, that means mediocre, overpriced coffee for brainwashed hipsters who wouldn't know good coffee from a hole in the ground. There are 5 other Starbucks locations within 2 miles of this one.
 I still find it hard to believe anyone would drink this swill, let alone enough people for them to actually be everywhere. I occasionally stop in one to remind myself why I go out of my way to get actual good coffee.
People, wake up and stop pumping your veins full of sugar and lacklustre coffee. There are actual good coffee houses in the bay area, you can identify them by the intoxicating aroma of coffee, and a lack of green mermaid.

It's nice to be the "Duke" of the Seminole Heights Starbucks!!!!! The only thing that gives me tears about this SB is the parking and traffic. I love the customers who always park right in front of the "No parking" signs and anywhere else they believe they can. It tends to make getting in and out of here a mess. Other than that this seems to be the best SB location in Tampa..

I was visiting Reno and stopped at this Starbucks to get a coffee before heading home. 

Very disappointing for a Starbucks! 

I ordered a grande Carmel Frapp layered with extra Carmel. I received a Carmel Frapp with a few extra drizzles in the cup. 

There was no toilet paper in the bathroom and the barista who took our order wasn't rude but she wasn't friendly either.

I LOVE Starbucks but this place sucked today!!! 20 freaking minutes to get a normal coffee. The staff have such unpleasant looks on their faces, and the coffee still was not great... I do NOT want a refund I'm just so fed up with this store and the poor attitudes of the staff. It seems as if almost most of them hate their jobs. I have NEVER said this before BUT don't go to that Starbucks. To give an idea of how much I love Starbucks I would be gold status for the next 4 years if I never bought another cup of coffee past today. Honestly from the looks they were understaffed today.

I come here like every day? Then your going to make me get back in line because I forgot to tell you I needed Caraamel Drizzle? Then pay for it. Your swipe fee is more then the purchase... not happy...
Worst service ever. Watched them run out of Dark Coffee and used Blond roast to film up the cup.  Then didn't bother to add new coffee grounds to start brew but grounds were already used.

Worst service ever!  I ordered four drinks, I was charged for five 2 of the drinks were wrong. I asked for a refund but the girl in the counter says have to wait for the manager and they don't issue receipt for refund. How would I know that I'm going to be refunded, check my online banking nothing is showing up. I was given a hot chocolate for cafe mocha and double chocolate chips frappuccino for caramel frappuccino. They acted that it was my fault, didn't even bother to offer an apology.

Pretty average Starbucks. However, I did not like that they wouldn't make my drink with a different type of coffee. I thought it was their policy to make you any type they had stocked in the store? They had a lot of bags around the store of the type I was asking for. Maybe I'm wrong but I was disappointed. 
I have had a couple negative experiences with workers, not direct interactions just observations. For example people complaining about having to work there etc. things like that. You want to have a friendly nice time ordering your drink not feel like you are bothering them by ordering something. Also, they water down the ice tea here, I don't know maybe you can ask for it with no extra water but I didn't realize they were going to do that, I haven't had that happen at the location in creve coeur. So if you are getting iced tea here you might want to double check.

Good new Starbucks, nice set up, BUT terrible staff. I was there when Shannon was running the crew. I was going to stay for a few hrs studying but left early. She kept yelling about the pretzels smelling like dog. Shouting instructions at other employees. Complaining about the floor. Talking really loud in general. Singing loudly. Really annoying. Made the shop and the rest of the staff look like a mcdonalds. And it wasn't that busy and she couldn't get orders right.
Congested parking lot and no drive thru. Staff is hit or miss. I sometimes will just drive out further to a better location with better baristas.

The staff is friendly here.... but they typically screw up our orders.
Today... I asked for a passion tea lemonade with classic. Not a hard order. Didn't get lemonade in my drink. Honestly... I don't pay $4-5 for a drink for it to be wrong.

So this Starbucks is right by my home and so I have been waiting to give it a review.  I will tell you, the major positive thing is the coffee is always hot and I love hot coffee!  The staff is really friendly no matter if you go through the drive thru or walk in, they are terrific!   I have had Ice teas and hot coffee and for both this place knocks it out of the park.  One of the better Starbucks in town!

I have been to this Starbucks at three different timeframes in the past year - all for about four days in length each visit. I've never had a bad experience, despite the very long line to make my order. The baristas are very quick in delivery and stay in control despite the stress of a long line. I have only been here during a time of a large audience conference, so I'm not sure how the service is on a less busier day. With the Starbucks being so close to the Dome, I can't imagine them not being busy nearly all the time. 

The gift card system has not been working each time I have been here. I feel certain that they have just gave up on the system at this location. While this isn't a problem for me, it definitely could be for others out there.

Doesn't matter whether you come through drive thru or inside, this team is fast and attentive! They have a few new people so sometimes the wait in line can be a little long but the speed in which you get your drink makes up for it! GREAT STORE, GREAT PEOPLE!
This place is ok for a fast coffee a little over priced but to be expected from a star bucks chain! Sometimes service isn't that great. But most of the time it is!

This Starbucks is ridiculously uncomfortable.

No cozy, peaceful places to sit and drink coffee.  With a million doors and this and that and traffic, it's noisy, busy, awkward.  

In other words not feng shuid right.  No idea what the interior designer was thinking.

I live right down the street from this location so it's my go to right before work. For the most part the drive thru rolls by pretty quick for how long the line can be. The drinks I get are spot on. The customer service lately is horrible. The last couple times I went, the employees at the drive thru work with no integrity. For example, I paid with a $10 bill total was about $7 and some cents. She only gave me back my cents. In my head I'm like this doesn't add up. So I asked for my receipt and she says absolutely. I'm like you knew you gave me this amount of change right, you owe me two dollars. And she doesn't hesitate at all to give me my two dollars. So she sighs and acting all mad because I caught her. Seriously? I was in disbelief. I know it's only two dollars but that's not right.

Next one is a guy, paid with a card this time because I wasn't trying to get jipped! I asked politely, can you do me a favor and heat this up (muffin). He rolled his eyes at me.. So here I am waiting while I hear this guy mock me with his other co workers.... Ugh. How upsetting. I was furious! Never stepping foot in here again.

This Starbucks is teeny-tiny and overwhelmed. Starbucks needs to find a larger space in Canal Place. The staff here is so sweet and are lovely to their regulars. They work really hard, so throw a dang dollar in the tip jar!

I don't drink a ton of Starbucks, as my employer provides gratis coffee, but they are in my building and I probably hop down once a week for a latte or an iced coffee. I've only had one experience with a not great tasting latte, but usally the drinks are well made.  There is a small retail wall, that seems to only be shopped from at the holidays and a small bar with a couple stools, but I can't imagine wanting to sit in there when the line snakes and winds in that tiny space.

The staff was obnoxious. Every time I come in here they are extremely loud and have no regard for any of their customers. I do not feel like listening to the staff sing. It seems as if they have no managers on duty. It's unprofessional. Very annoying to try to concentrate while the employees are yelling at the top of their lungs. If it were other customers being loud around me I would understand. But the staff.......

I start every morning at this location! The staff and management are professional, courteous, and friendly.  New hires quickly understand the atmosphere and all customers appear to be satisfied. I love this place!

Great location. Great customer service. Amazing tastes. Period!! Make sure you stop in when you can afford to break the bank.  As of now, cotton candy, double chocolate chip and strawberries and cream, are my families favorites! xoxoxoxo

Update - Turn on the heat and clean the Phuckin bathrooms! It's not enough just mopping the floors. Gauddam! Gloves mask rag or wipes and wipe the toilets down clean and flush. End of story!


Excellent study spot!!! Spacious and very comfortable. They also have reasonable hours. 10pm close.

Staff is very friendly. Only bummer is, there is no clover at this location.

They messed up my drink this morning, I called and they offered me a free one so I go back in just now ands it's even worse then before! I'm almost positive there's not any chai in here. It just tasted like milk. Very disappointed in my experience here today. Especially for spending $14 on 3 really poor drinks. Not sure I'll visit this location again.

This Starbucks is directly on my way to work, so when I don't make coffee at home I stop in here.  If you get a Starbucks gift card and register it and use that to make your purchases, they send you free drink stuff sometimes and you get some added stuff in your coffee for free, like the soy milk that I have put in any foofy coffee drinks that I consume.
Slowest service ever. Staff are too busy talking to each other to serve customers.  Bathroom is dark and filthy.  Starbucks corporate seriously needs to look into this location.

Starbucks is my go-to place to work for one reason, and one reason only: free refills on tea and coffee (for members). I end up at the Carrolwood Starbucks because...location, location, location. But in a prime spot, you have to compromise on amenities. They are always crowded and never feel like they have enough seats or tables (except that one time their AC broke). The outdoor area iOS really just tables on the sidewalk and is nearly sitting in the parking lot. Plus, there is often a pretty long wait--with no drive thru. This is a spot to meet my caffeine needs, but it isn't the most relaxing of locations or the best place to meet people--for that, the new one on Linebaugh isn't really all that much further south.

There is this one cashier that is terrible! She would constantly deny any promos or specials to make her job easier. I walked in to order a Cherry Blossom frappachino and she said they don't offer it. I called later in the day and the person who took my call said they did. I did not walk in on the first day of the promotion either. The store managers need to do a better job educating their staff and have them turn away customers.

Because I love making coffee and home and I have a certain few fave brands I seek when I am craving the joe, I don't stumble into Starbucks often.  

On days I am rushing., I am thankful for a drive thru, quick breakfast options & the reliability of a chain coffee joint. Good to know that every Starbucks from the Hudson to the Bay, you're gonna get what you get no matter where you are! Yay!

I just MUST mention this location. 75th & Keystone, I'm gonna betcha that this is one of the busiest in town. 

Now to speak of the baristas & drive thru emcees: The staff are young & exceptional.  Previously, the gentlemen were upbeat and friendly; second to last visit, our barista was gracious and polite. Every time, they are QUICK! 

Todaaaaay (sing that.), the young lady that took my order literally sang my order back to me and made sure I would have a great day! Thanks! =)

In judging my various Starbucks locations I'd rate this one good. It's not fantastic but definitely exactly what you would want for your coffee. It's fast, the barista's are very nice and the easy in/out parking is good in the morning. The only downside is that this location doesn't have drive- thru

I will have to say if you are in a hurry for a something this is not the place to go.  I ordered a Double Chocolate Frappuccino and waited my for my drink.  Four other people came in after me and they all got their drinks (6 drinks) were all made before I went over and asked when mine would be made.  I was told they were very busy and they would get to it.  Two others received their drinks before the gal asked what I had ordered because she could not find my cup.  She hastily made it and it did not taste as good as I had before.  I will pass on this location in the future.
20 minutes for an iced coffee and iced chai???? Come on Starbucks! Hire more people for your busier locations.

We frequent lots of Starbucks all over the country  and have our regular favorites. At this particular Starbucks the drinks are very subpar, they never taste quite right in comparison to the other Starbucks. We've tried to give the benefit of the doubt each time, but it's time to throw the towel in, we won't be wasting our money at this location anymore.

I'm always one that loves to sit at Starbucks and sip some coffee while studying. The wifi is good, the baristas are friendly, and plenty of outlets! Good seating however is difficult to get sometimes. Seating options are limited and I prefer the individual seats rather than larger shared tables. There is also window seating but the table is small and awkward to do work on. I like to spread out my materials and get to work so individual seating is important for me. Luckily I'm often able to get my preferred seats. 
Another thing, this Starbucks is freezing! Yes I know Starbucks everywhere are always on the cooler side but this one in particular is the worst. I've come in during winter and had to keep on all my winter layers in order to stay warm! 
Parking is limited! I fortunately live close enough to walk so this isn't an issue for me but during peak hours I know it's extremely difficult to find nearby parking.
This location is very understaffed.  Huge lines even before 7am.  Staffing issues getting worse

It's Starbucks, same here as anywhere else. This location is open 24 hours but the lobby closes at 12 midnight. I found that out the hard way unfortunately. The lobby is always clean but cold so bring a jacket. This has become a great place for me to come late night to get some work in before bed. Even late at night I feel safe at this establishment. The staff is friendly and committed to customer service. As a non-coffee drinker, I usually get a berry refresher (no water) or a pastry with water.

It's exactly like every other Starbucks everywhere, except it has the additional excitement of having about half of their electrical outlets in the store, distributed randomly, just not work at all. There's no indication of which outlets work and which ones don't, and the employees have no fucking clue, so if you don't happen to be paying attention to which power icon appears in your taskbar, your computer may just suddenly shut down, losing all the work you've done since you last saved.

If they're too cheap to get their outlets fixed, they COULD spend three buck on this [ http://amzn.to/1QcZEN2 ], and then cover the non-working outlets, so that there's a reminder for customers that some don't work, plus an indication of which is which, but that would, like, require that someone test all the outlets, which would, like, be work, so they don't do it.

How much do you value that forty-five minutes of work you just lost because they're too fucking lazy to get their outlets fixed? I figure that five bucks plus a loss of almost an hour of work on my dissertation bumps the price to $$$$, hence my survey question answer.

Oh, and don't think they'll pull one of the five or six people chatting with their coworkers and ignoring the customers behind the counter onto the second register just because the line's out the door.

My favorite Starbucks in the city! They always have my mobile order ready, and it is always hot! There is good room to study or have a small meetings, but sometimes it can get loud. The barista's are all very friendly and I always enjoy my daily midday trip to Starbucks!

Does this say ice anywhere? This is the 4th time! Jesus! Or if it's not this sometimes I ask for soy since I'm Lactose they end up putting regular milk and they act like they put soy but u can taste a different. So disappointed in this place now. They need the old barista back!

Again, extremely busy location with not enough people working. Today (4/24) it was really busy. 2 people taking orders, one heating up food and the other making drinks. You need more than one person making 20+ drinks. Literally. This location was definitely over capacity. I overheard many angry customers saying oh I was here first why did she get hers first and so on. It was never ending....

anyways I did a mobile order. It was suppose to be ready in 3-8 mins. Received it at 15 mins...not a big deal consider it as extremely busy but let me take that back...yes it was a big deal since I was late for work and my ice caramel macchiato tasted absolutely disgusting. It was so gross I had a couple sips and threw it out. The staff here was friendly but that doesn't defeat the purpose. Yes, I'm aware of if your drink doesn't taste right, they will remake it. But I didn't have the time...I was already running late.

This location really needs more employees working!!!
too much ice,I did not buy a Starbucks,I actually purchase a Icebucks,a bucks of ice.If I purchase a vanti,I get 3/4 ice,even I purchase a tall size,I get half of the ice.

CHAI!!!

I swear sometimes that's my battle cry.  This day it was. After all, I was meeting a friend to pick up some clothing I'd left with her at the Ren Faire. 

We met up at this starbucks and the ordering process was quick, efficient and quite friendly. The prices were absolutely like they were everywhere else.. and of course, the quality was just fine.  This location is easily accessable right off of Dale Mabry.
Located inside a neighborhood. Kinda out of the way. Better off hunting for a coffee fix off of east moana blvd or kietzke lane.

My local Starbucks. Great staff, very friendly. The store is a bit small if you plan to hang out and do some work / have a meeting, etc. But, they have made the best out of the space. It is also right next door to the best doughnuts in town (Nicola's), so grab a Starbucks and some Nicola's doughnuts and you are SET!

for as busy as these folks are they have great poise & attitude while they grind and serve away to tourists, locals, employees and outside panhandlers 

sure its sbux and the rep that comes with it but philz, sightglass or blue bottle is over 200 miles away.   if hub was closer for me there'd be one less review.   the weekends are a mess so come earlier or later

the inside of this smaller franchised space is gorgeous with a tip of the cap to the construction mgmt team.  i like the pictures of their humble beginnings storefront on pike place meets virginia street and the ceiling resembles the fox theater in oakland a bit

daily drip seems to have blonde, dragon and pike in the rotation as one is also able to get their la boulange fix
Hate to give a 1-star, but the response time at this Starbucks is the worst I've seen. I was staying at the Westin across the street and dreaded going each morning. Needs to be remedied.

I love this starbucks... I am pretty loyal customer along with two other people.. BUT there seems to always be an issue when quindale (however you spell it) as if this person might have something against the three off us...NEVER smiles or greets us like everyone else does that knows us in there and is always making our drinks crappy... its actually really funny to me as i'm writing this.. maybe he doesn't like his job I DON'T KNOW but this has been multiple times. When we called up to make a little complaint he wanted to get snippy in some way, not really manager material if you ask me but that's none of my business JUST MAKE OUR DRINKS RIGHT! we are paying customers... "gold members" and having to pay for a $6.00 drink that was made like complete a** just isn't going to satisfy me =[  BE MORE FRIENDLY. Thanks!

This location is very small but they are quick to get the drink orders done. Every now and again parking can be a pain in the butt because there are quite a few businesses in there. They've got a decent sized outside seating area for the size of the location.

Cold and needing some wifi, I stopped by to grab some hot chocolate and a break. First of all starbucks hot chocolate is awful. Wawa's is miles better, plus it's a third of the price. Employees at this starbucks were disinterested and unfriendly. They did not even offer whipped cream with my drink which may or may not have helped the powdered mix and hot water taste  I will stick with delicious Dunkin donuts hot chocolate!
Garret is so sweet and accommodating! Made my experiance here fantastic! Boy should be in management if hes not already!!! Thank you garret

Expensive coffee, not that great. But what can I say its starbucks, that's what you expect. Save your money go to McDonald's, coffee is just as good (if not better) and lower priced.  Try the hazelnut ice coffee at McD's its amazing.

It's Starbucks, so I won't go into the menu. This Starbucks is great. Great customer service, they do their best to call you by name and thank you personally. There's multiple tables for those looking for a place to get work/studying done. There's no drive through but with mobile ordering, that doesn't bother me one bit. Love this quaint little location!

Sidenote: The best cup of coffee I've had in CWE is at Pi Pizza. 

I think Starbucks excels at consistency of product. This location is no different in that the coffee is the same taste as any place else. That said, this is a great location to grab a quick cup and go. ...however, parking is tricky near Maryland and Euclid so this is easier said than done. 

I rate this as 2 out of 5 stars comparing it to other Starbucks shops in the area. It is small and cramped and has one unisex bathroom which creates waiting for the bathroom an expectation. On a positive note, the bathroom has always been clean. Maybe the guy in front of you feels obligated not to be a sloppy mess knowing a cute girl might be waiting for her turn. 

The business itself does really well given the traffic in CWE and their Apple -esque ability to make people feel special while holding the logo on their cup (myself included as I type away at my Macbook writing this review...). 

A coffee shop as a whole and I might give it 3 or 4 stars. The staff is great (as great as all Starbucks staff) and you know what you are getting when you walk in the door. But when it comes down to going to a Starbucks, I'd rather go to one elsewhere.

I thought I'd drop in for a coffee at the new location, under the impression it would go smooth seeing as they just moved across the street and already knew what they were doing.....  9 employees in the front end of this store and there was a line of people that wasn't even budging. Even an employee on break was in the line that couldn't move. Felt like 20 mins in line at a shop full of help but nobody wanted to jump in and get things moving. 
Also, fresh out of protein boxes at 10am? Nice!!! 
Store is nice, coffee is hot.

Updating/downgrading this review from a 4 to a 1 due to the horrible service at the location for the past month or so. I'm in this location at least 3 times a week and so the decline in service was easy to gauge and coincided perfectly with the arrival of a new employee working the opening shift which is of course their busiest time of day. 

Without variance after being badgered by the people who have had theirs orders neglected, the employees actually doing work in the store are forced to stop what they are doing to go back and compete the tasks that slender man has placed to the side and forgotten about. It is unthinkable to me that he is still employed here let alone continuing to work the Morningstar (busiest time of day). Not sure if this is nepotism or classic favoritism in action but he's definitely not able to stick around on the merits of his excellent barista skills or incredible work ethic. 

Please Starbucks Olivette management, move this guy somewhere he can't obstruct the expedient progress of my mornings! I'll definitely re-revise this update if/when the situation improves because the rest of the people here are unwaveringly friendly and accommodating. This 1-star update is a reflection of the bad service being dealt out by one person and it truly crazy for someone to allow that to occur within their business.

Typical Starbucks so you know what you're getting. The service is really great here and the atmosphere is relaxing. The store doesn't look big from the outside but it goes back a bit farther to accomodate more tables for studying etc... The front of the store has comfy chairs and low tables which makes it ideal to hang out with friends. Very friendly staff which makes me want to visit again and again.
Stopped here to get some coffee real quick. I was happy they had a drive through. The guy at the drive through made my day with his sense of humor.

The line at this Starbucks location was extremely long this morning, almost reaching the far end of the store, yet they still manage to make the customers' beverages really quick and efficient. I also forgot my wallet here, and when I realized that I did 20 mins later, I called this location and someone actually picked up the phone despite their being very busy and told me they have my wallet (after I described it). I drove back to retrieve it and the woman behind the counter handed it to me - all cards and $40 + cash still intact and untouched. Thank you for all that you do. Much appreciated

I'm not exactly sure what to say about Starbucks that has not been said or thought by their average customer.  I don't drink coffee, nor do I make a habit of going to cafés, particularly chains.  I was randomly given a gift card by my boss, as she had forgotten about it and wanted to get rid of it, so my partner and I went earlier during a walk. I got a bottle of water, and he got a cold tea - nothing exciting or worth commenting on.  The staff was very kind though, so that's something.  They also had a ton of chairs and places to plug in laptops (you know, because we go out now but still avoid face-to-face communication).  I was not too impressed with the layout. The only coffee shop I ever loved was a place called JJ's, back in my hometown.  The sitting area had a fire place, gigantic overstuffed leather couches, a few end-table sized fountains, and lots of boardgames.  They closed because their child was diagnosed with a terrible disease and, according to what I was told, passed away.  This place has none of JJ's spark, personality, or warmth, but I suppose one should not expect that from a chain.

This is the Starbucks at Canal Place. It's a lil' location with a few seats actually inside. There are 6 tables on the floor in the middle of the mall to sit at to drink your coffee and/or eat your food. This Starbucks closes for business at 2000 hours (8:00pm). Harrah's Casino is directly across Canal and there's another in there open until Midnight but it is a franchise. This one the staff is great and they do get you in and out quickly. The Starbucks at 700 Canal is much bigger and fortunate for THEM but not for me busier than the other ones. Anyway this is Starbucks. Not much to explain. I do love this location when going to: The Theatres At Canal Place. This is an excellent location.

Daniel took my order and he was absolutely amazing!
The customers in front of us were unsure of what kind of drink they previously had that they enjoyed. It was a lady and her daughter, the lady spoke Spanish only. However, Daniel did his best with the help of the customers' daughter translating for him to craft a drink he thought she would enjoy. Both customers left happy and smiling. Daniel then took my order and managed to balance making five drinks over three transactions, while helping as a cash out register for non-Starbucks items, AND he even had some delicious looking strawberry samples ready for people to try. Oh, and he did this entirely solo! He did all this without even breaking a sweat, and had the brightest smile I've seen on anybody. Many words can come to mind to describe Daniel (can you say, "Employee of the Month"?) but ROCKSTAR is what comes to my mind. Keep on spreading those smiles, Daniel, I appreciate you.

I sometimes sit in this Starbucks for hours on end. I've interviewed kids for college in the store, and the staff don't even seem to mind that I haven't ordered anything. (The kids usually order something, or if they don't I make sure to buy anything at the end of the interview. When you see an anxious kid in a suit, sometimes you don't want to take ten minutes to get a cup of coffee.) So, I must give them 5 stars for not getting annoyed. It has a far higher number of power outlets than many other locations, which is a reason that I really like it. Beyond that, it's just a Starbucks.

These gals make my morning!  They are always incredibly friendly, quick and consistent (even with the new faces from the Broadway location)!!
Thanks!
Amazing! I believe the girls name is Britney. I work next door at Ulta in the salon and she always hooks us up with free drinks so nice of her!
This was always my studying spot, the baristas are very nice and they get my drink right unlike other branches of starbucks.

There must be fresh blood in this store, I went back a few days ago and was promptly greeted with smiles. The barista at the register was pleasant and went the extra mile in locating additional cake pops for my two girls. It had to be the pink frosted ones, and she thankfully found two! 

My order was made quickly and most importantly correct. I will be back to this location.
Standard Starbucks. Tasty treats and Java but nothing special. Bathroom wasn't real clean and out of TP

Smaller store than most. But it serves its purpose. 

Great for hotel guests, nearby coffee drinkers and #stickandmove commuters like myself. 

Located in the rear corner of Canal Place, 1st floor, you'll find this delightful coffee shop. It's the perfect size. A person that wants to sit & sip, is able to do so in the adjacent sitting area, FYI, no worries. 

This is the PERFECT PLACE for me to pull a stick and move caper like I normally do. Place my order on the app and park, pick up & go #stickandmove #success. 

The baristas here are vibrant & full of life in this delightful little corner of Canal Place New Orleans. 

I think this'll be my NEW pick up place.

OUTSIDE: Stairs and a ramp that go up to the front entrance. Outside seats and tables to enjoy the nice weather. 

INSIDE: Typical Starbucks feel. This location has a lot of seating, and a big long table in the back with stool type seating. Quite a few people on this Saturday late morning sitting inside and outside. However, when I walked in there was no line with one guy who came in after me.

ORDERED: Yogurt blueberry muffin warmed. She used a tissue paper to grab it so I'm glad to see proper sanitary practices. When it was done heating up, they promptly took it out and placed it on the pick-up table. Tall iced white chocolate mocha at first she grabbed as hot and started writing until I asked for it iced. Whipped cream on top because I forgot to ask for it without. 

STAFF: The girl who rang me up seemed neutral, not friendly, and not mean. I apologized for not telling her it was iced, but she didn't say anything like "No worries that's ok." She just grabbed a different cup with a blank expression and re-wrote it. I thought she would ask for my name to write on the cup, but she didn't. I'm not sure what Starbucks policy is on that if they only take names when it's busy or what. Seems a bit more personal when they call your name instead of calling out what you ordered. 

OVERALL: A-OK in my book. My drink tasted good and there wasn't an excessive amount of ice like some places do. If the staff was a bit more up friendly then I'd probably add another star.

I love this Starbucks!! It was well overdue for the area. The atmosphere is welcoming, love the designing, and the decor. The employees are very friendly, professional and helpful. I was disappointed to find the fireplace not working. It has been a month and  the fireplace is still not WORKING!!! Disappointing especially the days I really would love to relax in the lounge. Hopefully the owners are working on this issue.

Pros: employees here, in my experience, are always extra friendly. Convenient drive-through location. Drive through line can be long, but moves fairly quickly. Has a little area with tables to sit outside when the weather's nice (though it's right by the drive through line, which doesn't seem very relaxing. They do always get our order correct. 

Cons: Sometimes they run out of my favorite bakery items by the time I order, but I think that happens at every Starbucks and isn't specific to this location. On one or two occasions I've had whip from here that sat out too long - leaving milk sitting on the counter is my pet peeve, and this location does it sometimes. However, it's my favorite Starbucks in the area. Would recommend! It's a good place to meet a friend for coffee.

The drive thru line is always extremely long here. 
So today I opted for walking in as I was in a hurry. Only person at the counter, waited 5 mins to be acknowledged. 4 employees behind the counter not one looked my way. I have never seen a crew with less sense of urgency and I have been to plenty of Starbucks. Giggles, chatting w each other and grabbing cups and making drinks SO SLOWLY. No wonder the lines on the drive thru are so long. Pretty disappointed today. Management here needs to keep the crew in check.

I love Starbucks but this location today just disappointed me completely. This location is always busy but they are usually fast. Today was horrible. It took me 25 minutes to get my drink via drive thru. After 25 minutes of waiting the danish they game me was not warmed up. I still had to wait another minute for them to warm it up. I get to work only to notice my coffee (size - grande) was only filled half way. Completely disappointed. I noticed the car I front of me also had to return a pastry. I am not sure what happened but judging from my experience they must have messed up their order as well.

My first move, especially in Reno with the whole midtown movement  is to support local first. But, out of location convience I frequent this Starbucks more than I typically would, and the biggest reason why is the staff. The staff here is pleasent, friendly and efficiant without being fake. Sometimes,  thats all I need to bring me back in the door. Otherwise, Starbucks is Starbucks. Great staff here.

This is your typical small Starbucks.  True, it's not "the thing to do" in the French Quarter. But, if you work at the Canal Place mall, at Westin, or in the office tower and frequent this Starbucks, like I do, the staff will remember your name and your regular order.  That's all I ask for in a coffee shop.

I love the stained glass ceiling at this Starbucks! It's located inside the Silver Legacy Casino and it looks out on the gaming floor. I wonder what used to be in its place before Starbucks.  There aren't many seats, but most people just grab their coffee to-go anyway. I went here with my mom for a quick pick-me-up in the afternoon. Nice to just sit and relax.
coffee is alright, but the service is always quick and very pleasant every time I go there.
Starbucks is fine, this Starbucks is terrible. Poorly run and operated. It's our local option, so it would be convenient to stop here regularly, but almost every time we do the order gets messed up.

I came here for the classic oatmeal (all 3 toppings please!) and the staff was super friendly. There are some bar stools inside the tiny Starbucks, or there are tables outside on the sidewalk or inside by the stores.
Slow service , not enough parking.  Need another register and to always attend both registers.  On average, it takes 12min for a small pike - should never take that long!

Usually I don't see a need to rate chain stores, but this Starbucks is better than others. This is rating based on the particular Starbucks location, not the overall company.

The baristas I've had are very cheerful and are GREAT at making drinks. I don't like watery fraps and the baristas make it very thick but not super icy. When there was a super long line from 1/2 off promotion, they made my drink quick and still delicious.

Very roomy and cool location (great in the summer, haven't gone here in winter yet). However there never seem to be enough seats inside. People sit here for hours. The outside seating usually has open tables though.
This is the best Starbucks around with friendly staff and great barista skills. They always make my coffee just how I like it!

Good service with a busy morning
Barista named Brigette was great.  Positive attitude and giving other employees positive comments during a rush.  Real team player.  Starbucks is made better by great employees like this

I caved. I'm ashamed, yes. I fell prey to the dark side... *tear*

As a general rule, I don't "do" Starbucks. I'm more happy to give my money to local mom 'n pop coffee shops (which tend to have better coffee anyway) than to a humongo multinational corporation that's focused on the bucks (which I think is a clever marketing ploy to get you thinking about "bucks" before you even enter the shop, making paying 5 dollars for bad coffee seem perfectly okay). 

However, Starbucks does have ONE thing going for it --- their iced and blended drinks; which are fine if you're foregoing the bean's flavor for sheer buzz-factor. 

I stopped into this establishment last week and was surprised to find a sort of "build your own frappaccino" menu. Which was frustrating in that it didn't give you anything to go off of. No "choose a base, a flavor, the number of shots, etc" to guide the f-ccino newbies, like myself. 

So, i asked the barista (o? is it baristo if he's a dude?) what he'd recommend. And he made this delicious concoction of Stevia sweetened base (low-calorie and no sugar...helloooo happy waistline) 3 shots of espresso and a low calorie caramel flavor with a few drizzles on top. 

Low calorie, flavorful, and cooled me off! Plus there's a cute little outdoor patio lined with rosebushes at this location as well as plenty of shade. The road noise is mildly irritating but becomes unnoticeable after a few minutes. 

 My skeptic's raised eyebrow may have lowered a few millimeters. Touche, sbux, touche.

I am a really big fan of this Starbucks location. The staff is friendly, efficient, a little quirky, and they are already starting to remember my order (despite my only becoming a semi-regular about a week ago). 

It's also one of the biggest, most wide-open Starbuck's I've ever been to, which makes me very happy. I'm used to going to Starbucks and struggling to get a spot at one of the four available tables. This location however, has something like 12 round tables (seating two to four people) , 10 large lounge chairs, a bar, a long table with lamps and several side tables. And there appears to always be available seating. 

If you're the kind of person who enjoys doing work or reading in a location outside of your office or home, this is a great place to go.

Love the look of this building inside.  HUGE exposed brick walls and ceiling.  Staff was friendly and funny.  I loved that they had the AC cranked!  What a wonderful place to escape away to to cool off from walking around down town!
Really fast service and super nice people. I spilled my tea right after I got it, and they replaced it immediately for free.

Horrible service.  The guy behind the counter tee making the drink is moving in slow motion and talking to all the employees at the same time.  Taking forever and no one is in here but me. Extremely rude employees.  Won't be back to this location.

I'm really disappointed with my experience with this Starbucks location. I ordered ahead of time using my app. Estimated time was 4-9 minutes. I arrived in the drive thru in that time frame and was told that they were working on my order. No problem. There were about 3-4 cars ahead of me. I assumed it would be done by the time i got to the window. I get there and she again says they are working on my order. Next thing I see is them START my order of 4 drinks. By now, it's about 20 minutes since I submitted. I tried to get their attention dice at that point I didn't have time to wait for 4 drinks to be made and just wanted my order cancelled but no one came. Then she just handed me 4 drinks with no cardboard holder. I didn't want to be late for my kids' bus stop, so I left as soon as she gave me the drinks instead of asking for a holder. At that point I just wanted to get out of there. Of course, the drinks spilled without the holder. I only have 55 cents left on my card, and I'm done with Starbuck ls. I'll stick with other coffee shops that can actually give me drinks in a timely manner, and have people working there who will actually tell me when there's a delay, and use their brains to think someone might need a holder to carry 4 drinks.
They are fast and my order is never wrong. Very nice clean place to sit and eat or have your coffee there employees are very friendly.

Not my preferred Starbucks but it's a quick in and out thing. Location sucks personally, high traffic area, small parking lot. Sweet staff, quick and on top of things. Everything ordered is always made perfect. They always have my daughters cake pops in stock unlike the Irvington location.

During the height of my caffeine addiction I LOVED this place, not just for the coffee but the staff as well. I'd get to the register and my drink would already be made bc they remembered me and my order. I don't go in as much any more but everyone is still so nice when I so. The only negative about this place is the atmosphere but its in the mall so that's understandable.

I am spending a few days at this Starbucks this week because of the free wifi.... great staff and super friendly... I am originally from Orange County, Ca and I have to say, I was not used to nice, and friendly staff at Starbucks. A big 2 thumbs up for all the staff here.

I have to downgrade them as a result of the past few years of service.

The drive thru has substantially slowed down. The past few visits, scattered across an assortment of times, have all resulted in extended wait times. When the lines are long outside i'm happy to get out of the car and go inside. Even inside seems to have taken quite awhile. The priority seems to go to the drive thru, though when you are in the drive thru it doesn't seem like that.

A recent order was requested with "no whip" and delivered to me with whipped cream on top. That easily doubled my wait time since I asked them to remake it.

I will give it an upgrade for last nights purchase. The wait time seemed far longer than the usual extended wait. When I drove up to the window to pay my drink was handed to me and the employee said "No charge since it took 17 minutes." Thank you for this freebie but I have sat for just as long before with no change in billing and usually an incorrectly made beverage. 

I am sure these are a result of the surge in people in the area as of late but they should be adapting for that staffing wise. I tend to chose another location or another chain as a result of these issues.

I have been to this particular location 3 times in the last 3 weeks.  The service is usually slow and not terribly friendly but today was the worst yet.  The girl at the window never even considered smiling, she never spoke even when my order was wrong, and we didn't get napkins

Even though this is now the most convenient location, I will not go back.  Have to find someplace new.  I am a Starbucks Gold level member.
I haven't been to this Starbucks in two years... And I recently moved here. They're the slowest Starbucks ever and continually screw up your orders! They haven't changed in two years!!

This is not a "come hunker down and study for hours" type of location. It's very tiny and seating is limited. In fact, it's not even a good location if you want to hang with friends and catch up. This is really more of a "thank god there's a Starbucks in the neighborhood" location. However, I am thankful as it's quite convenient to my STL life. 

Staff is incredibly friendly. More so than most locations - I have great conversations here. My orders are always perfect. And I love their tip jar, it's a poll of sorts, and always fun. Parking in the CWE is a pain, but there is street parking available, you might need to circle a bit.
this place is great however sometimes the line is ridiculous due to traffic. The parking lot is so small coming off the main road it's an accident waiting to happen

The staff here are very nice. They are always quick with my order and I am noticed right away once I walk into the door. I love coming in this location to satisfy my coffee crave. Black coffee is what I tend to crave and they always show me the selection of flavors.

I love Starbucks. This location is the worst however. Slowest service. Negates the point of a drivethru and call ahead orders if it takes (my average) 10 minutes to get your order. A location by the turnpike/295 needs to be quicker. Constantly disappointed but still addicted.
Nice staff.  However, the bathrooms are always horrifically dirty and/or closed.  The store could really use an update on their furniture.  It's pretty worn.

Slowest. Starbucks. Ever.  I have sat in the drive thru for twenty minutes.  The parking lot is not convenient.  You are basically trapped once in line.  If you go in its almost impossible to get out.

I guess it was ok, I am just use to the staff at my usual SB's remembering me. Spoiled yes. The staff was nice, and the coffee exceptional.  I paid with my iPhone app.  That's always fun. I will go back to my usual Starbucks from now on.

I do not recommend this Starbucks, unless you are visiting in the late morning or early afternoon. The drive thru only comfortably holds a queue of 2-3 cars, and then you are blocking the road around the shop. Service is slow, and the baristas are not as friendly. The attrition here seems high for baristas; maybe it is a rotational Starbucks for training baristas in the area? If you sit inside, it is quite small, but clean. I say here in the winter once, and because of the two entrances, and the small size, I froze my rear off with the cold wind blowing in every time the doors were opened.

3rd time ordering a venti NO foam latte at the drive through and I end up with 3 inches of foam. Frustrated this time I wanted to see how many ounces actually were in my 20 I mean "venti"...My guess is right? EXACTLY 16??? They should rename the size to " Sedici" and charge us less.

I was so excited when they decided to open a Starbucks in my area. However, even though they have been open for months, the service is terribly slow. It is a minimum 10 minute wait in the drive thru even with 2 cars ahead of you. I thought the order ahead would speed up the process but it makes no difference! Tonight they  really disappointed me when I pulled up to the drive thru at 0756 and they stated they were closed even when the holiday day hours on the drive thru door CLEARLY stated they closed at 0800! The drive thru employee even had the nerve to wave her hand at me like go away while shaking her head. She was unprofessional and a bad representative of your company.

A bit chilly, they definitely keep Starbucks well air-conditioned in this little spot close to 15th & Locust.

Service was prompt and efficient with the barista and the cashier relatively friendly.

Bathrooms were clean.

There were a couple nicer seats, but the seating in here leaves something to be desired with the little wooden tables & chairs; free AT&T wifi.

It is difficult not to love a Starbucks that is attached to a nice mall: it's two yuppie worlds colliding. I like to hit up this Starbucks and do the following -- Step one: Get an iced vanilla latte. Step two: Walk around mall cool, caffeinated and happy. 

I've never had a problem with a messed up order at this Starbucks, but I keep my orders pretty simple. The people who work here seem friendly, too. One time, a guy who worked here held the door open for me. That's classy.

If I could give more than five stars I would. Going to Starbucks is a morning ritual for our Suburban family. They make the best iced coffee in town! Hands down. It's perfect every time! They know us by name and always conversed with us as soon as we walk through the door. The manager joe is one of the most caring and friendliest managers I have ever met in my entire life! Really! Go there.

I really like the current staff at this Starbucks. They are super friendly and get my order right every single time(seemingly not a difficult feat but other Starbizzles have failed). The food keeps changing which is good because I like to try new breakfast offerings.
The only complaint I have is that this location is so popular that if you are in hurry this can be frustrating. Farmers  market and showings of popular movies next door seem to inflate the lines even more.

I have been in Starbucks stores in many, many states and this is by far my favorite location.  The store itself has always been clean and there is plenty of space to sit down and enjoy a little reading and coffee.  The staff has always been friendly and I've never had a problem in the perhaps hundreds of times I've been here.  Also, I appreciate the fact that the quality and taste has always been consistent.  While I might like the idea of the "locally owned" coffee shop, you don't often get that consistency.

I like this Starbucks sometimes and then others I don't. There are good days and bad, but there have been problems sometimes with orders and sometimes the customer service isn't up to par with the others that I have been to. A few times my girlfriend was given and attitude and one of the cashiers rolled their eyes at her with her snotty attitude. I haven't had many problems I stopped in today and the barista, who was a older gentleman, made my drink was very friendly and is always offering other items to go with my drink. My drinks were always made well and I never had a problem, I know some people have had problems with yeh cashiers and I can't say personally I have had a problem. Good place to stop and grab a coffee, certain people make drinks good and others have made them not so well, give them a shot, love to read reviews!

Nice place to scan my receipts, create hemp jewelry, read my tarot and meet new friends! The Barista let me know I can get points via the app. I cannot use the card to redeem rewards or make a purchase. Minus one star because the tea was not brewed for at least a 3 minutes before hot milk was added. Starbucks, PLEASE let your Baristas at all locations know Tea will not brew in milk! It just stays on top, nor does it dunk well. There is a variety of tables to meet your dining needs. I like the large tables and love it when people ask to sit with me. Tip: Download Receipt Hog and scan your Starbucks receipt to get rewarded a free sweepstakes entry!

Wonderful Starbucks location. The staff is great and always friendly. I mostly go through the drive through and the employees are always sweet and funny. My favorite was when I asked if they made a different type of drink and the response was "heck ya, and it's super yummie" this response made my son and I giggle. Nice job!

Sunday's afternoon study hall people reading books not consuming anything. Others taking up table for 4 with their text books. Tough if you wanted to have a hot chocolate and a slice of pumpkin spice cake. Luck to have found table for two.

Ethically I can't give them less than 5 stars! The place is spacious. The sun lightening the area in a very nice way. I came to them from spring hill and no one was at the coffee shop and I didn't ask I just stepped a side. The lady from the front disk of Marriott came to me and asked me if I need anything and I said yes. She prepared my order and gave it to me. I gave her my credit and she was like:  you don't have to pay cause we made you wait!! It was really nice of her! I had the time this is why it was totally OK with me

the employees were being nice but my smoothie tasted like i'm drinking strawberry shake but fluffy??? that's okay it seemed they were trying their best... i'm thinking about going to another starbucks that's closer to my job for the next visit lol

i was staying a local hotel and came here for a breakfast during one of days in stl. 

i got a hot turkey sandwich which was ok and a chai which was ok as well

i am dinging this place on cleanliness and on their counterservice both of which could use some help. the set up for the sandwiches was also a bit confusing and not like the other starbucks ive ever been to

parking is hard to come by in this part of town and i would imagine those that come here usually find it somewhere. i happened to walk to get here so it was a non issue for me

overall, it was not the best SB ive been to but it was ok

I love this location!! They were fast and they made my coffee just right!! John greeted me when I went in and he was super helpful and seemed happy to help me!! He is an asset to this location!! Will be coming back!

This Starbucks location has very poor customer service. I told the person who serviced me that I would like to use my rewards points to purchase my sandwich. She then asked me if I want anything else and I told her that I also wanted to purchase a coffee. End result, she rung me up for two items. When I saw the amount I told her I wanted to use my rewards points for my sandwich, so instead of correcting my order she argued back with me on what I said I ordered. What kind of customer service is that?? Never again!! Worse customer service at this Starbucks!! Beware!!
It isn't the best Starbucks shop but they make good coffee. I always get my order to go. They are fast most of the time. They get really busy in the morning especially the drive thru.

All Starbucks are the same. Lots of money for really strong coffee. I get the caramel frap light with soy and no caffeine and sugar free caramel while shelling over $6. What's the point?!  I would rather drink my shakeology and make it into my own at home frap!
Always so prompt with the mobile orders customer service is absolutely amazing so I just love this place I'm here everyday :-)

My Xmas Starbucks always pay it forward during Xmas and love the seasonal drinks! Never a long line and drinks are always made quickly and correct which means delicious.  Never had a bad experience here  :)

The pumpkin spice latte is back! woohoo!  The only reason I ever go to Starbucks.  

This bread called the Lemon Loaf is also one of the greatest things ever.

This Starbucks has been open for about two months now.

I really like the baristas in the mornings - they're great, and know me personally! And they move the line pretty darn fast. 

But a lot of the products are still really inconsistent in taste; I've had iced passion teas that were basically Kool-Aid, and others that were basically water. Also, this location will take the Starbucks app for payment, but won't let you claim free drinks earned on your app. In addition, free refills aren't offered.

Because of Starbucks' obvious popularity with college students, there's not a lot of places to sit nearby, and even fewer with plugs. The Starbucks management team seems to be taking up two or three tables every time I stop by, so I have to assume they're working to get this store a little more on track.
I come here to do some work sometimes, and always leave disappointed. Because the internet is split between so many customers, it is very slow.

Very small and cramped. 

Workers were slow and unfriendly. 

No scanner to pay with your phone...she attempted to type in the correct info like 5 times so I could pay...


Wasn't too impressed. 

My drink tastes good though hence the 3 stars.

I did see a really cool Starbucks just up the street though and it is in an awesome and authentic looking building. 

So skip this one and go there!

Starbucks is not my first choice in coffee places, but because they are everywhere they are convenient, especially drive throughs. 

Yesterday I placed my order, sat in line for 5 minutes, pulled up to the window and held my phone out for the girl to scan. I said "this is a free reward." She got mad because she could not get her scanner to work, snapped at me when I asked her if she wanted to take my phone (which I guess they are not allowed to do- this is fine but explain it, don't attack me for asking). It finally scanned and then she said that I owed her the $5.40. I repeated that this was a reward. She then got mad all over again, snapped at me and was just rude because she did not hear me and had to scan again.

Update 12/18/2017:
This place has gone from bad to worse. After waiting 10 minutes I get up to the window and my order is not ready. In fact, she tried to give me a frozen drink and I had ordered two hot drinks. After sitting for another 5 minutes watching everyone running around looking perplexed and still not getting my drinks I left. Drove down the street to Puccinos and got my drinks in less than 4 minutes. I just can't go here anymore. Staff are slow, frazzled, rude and pretty much clueless. DONE STARBUCKS!

This location is great! It is right up the street from my house so I tend to go in a lot. I try not to go during "peak hours" (8-10am and 4-6pm) so I don't have to wait in long lines. All of the baristas are extremely friendly and helpful. Next time you go in, ask what their favorite syrup is and have them add it to your mocha. My favorite is toffee nut - yum yum! 
Another great thing about this location is all the seating inside and outside. I go here for long afternoons and evenings during the year to work on my computer. Never have I ever been bugged about how long I am there and they always give me a deal on my refills. 
Just remember, always be nice to the people who handle your food - and drinks ;)

I like.that they have added some things to their menu .The slow roasted ham and Swiss has.become my new favorite. Catherine the manager is so sweet and always on top of things. I usually get the same thing but from time to time i switch it up and recently tried the BlackBerry Mojito iced tea , boy was it refreshing . I'd also like to give special nod to Avery he's always so friendly and goes out of his way to be helpful. Great job dude :-)

I don't ever plan on writing reviews for franchises because essentially, you get the same experience as far as food/drink quality and service goes, especially when the aforementioned franchise is Starbucks. It's kind of impressive and scary how all Starbucks employees (regardless of their make, model, size, shape, sex, skin tone, etc etc) are almost Stepford-ish in how nice, considerate and generally chipper they are. 

A secret (well not so secret anymore) way to test the general amiability of a Starbucks barista is to walk in, look stupefied, and then say the following words: "I... don't know what to get. Do you have any suggestions?" If they're good, they'll smile and give you some suggestions based on your tastes. If they're great, they'll do the same, but then offer to make you something else for free if you don't like what you bought. This is why I love Starbucks and am annoyed by people who hate it.
