Yes, they're a big faceless corporation, blah de blah, but they got so big because they make their customers feel like they're the only ones that matter for those brief two minutes. But I'm soapboxing now, so I'll cut it short. 

This location rocks because I love how it feels like a library with a Starbucks attached. It reminds me of my undergrad days, and even simple things like the bricks in the ceiling, or how there is never a shortage of desks to lay out my books/laptop, or how all of the patrons are considerate and quiet, or even how this location is kind of set a little bit below ground making it feel all... cave-like; all these things just make me love spending time in here. Say hi if you see me. I'm the brown guy with the iDevice headphones on. There aren't many Indians in that location, I mean it's not like there's a really nice private university nearby with Indians all running amok. Oh wait... Ok fine, I'm the Indian guy always wearing flip flops; I know most Indians have an aversion to flip flops.

I particularly love this location because some are very knowledgeable about how some things should taste. I like matcha green tea and some ask for extra sweet and extra stuff added, no need too, I was pleasantly surprised that one of the baristas knew and didn't add anything different or ask. I also left my debit card(wrong one) and the barista was sooooo sweet he left the cups and entrusted I'll back. I drove like a fire was at my house as I was soooo embarrassed that I left my debit card.(horrible mistake) but once I got there I was extremely grateful that they were nice and understanding.

This new drive in location is beautiful with marble countertops and a sleek modern vibe throughout.  
They do still seem to have some of the same issues as they did across the street where your order is not always correct and the employees are not friendly. 
I ordered almond milk in my decaf and got regular. The employee who waited on me didn't say thank you or even look at me during our transaction. Not your typical Starbucks.

It's 3pm in the afternoon and the young moron working the counter tells me, they have ran out of freshly brewed coffee.   There is seven people working and they are all dimwits!   Just think this must the only Starbucks in the world that doesn't have any freshly brewed coffee in the middle of the day!

Unbelievable !
Nice roomy starbucks. Plenty of seating. Friendly service. Consistent drinks. Clean and tidy.

The baristas here are friendly enough.  The drinks taste the same to me at every Starbucks, so I'll leave the coffee reviews to other Yelpers.  

There are two things that stand out to me about this location: 1) Because of the layout--with the counter in a separate room from most of the seating--you can camp out for hours and not leave reeking of coffee.  2) There are tons of electrical outlets.  I have yet to find another Starbucks in Philly that has both of these things going for it.

Location is a little difficult to get in and out of on Shadeland.  They seem to stay steady, and the staff seems hurried and not too congenial. They do get you in and out but just not that friendly,  and I'm pointing it out because it's supposed to be part of their mission or values. Our beverages have been good for the most part.  It's OK for a stop.

A pretty standard Starbucks experience drink wise, however, the thing that bothers me about this location is the speed of service and the lines that seem never ending here.  Be prepared to wait in a line of no less than 10 cars if you are here between the hours of 7am and 10am.  The drive through moves at a snails pace.  One thing to note, though, is that the staff is very friendly and engaging so that makes the abysmal wait somewhat more tolerable.
Not sure why but the coffee was expensive and didn't taste very strong. I don't think they take Starbucks rewards but you can pay with your Starbucks card

Great service, prompt drink ordering, quick drink pickup and wonderful staff. Glad you are sooooo close. Love you Starbucks. :) They had everything needed, very clean and great location!! See you tomorrow for another coffee.

Open 24 hours unlike to locations on Kennedy and Westshore, but the parking is extremely limited and you're usually parking on a side street. Staff have always been nice to me, and this location is the most convenient to my home in VM Ybor and it's relatively quick and easy access off I-275.

I'm a Seattle girl and sorry to say even for as bad and most Starbucks service is in Reno this one was horrible. Under staffed and rude! I don't have 15min to wait when I'm second to order. She took 5 more orders before even starting my coffee. And her co-worker went on break instead of helping!
Won't be returning here ever

I visit this Starbucks often, it being the closest drive-thru location near my home....sometimes, I don't feel like leaving the comfort of my car, especially when in sweatpants mode.  The location also is a plus, being a haven to me, after disgruntled visits to Walmart.  Knowing my plain nonfat latte is within quick reach deadens my Walmart-checkout-line-related She-Hulk rage.  This location's staff is always very friendly, and rare are the drink order mistakes.  My only "con" is that I wish it was open later on the weekends; it's nice to grab a latte on the way home from weekend dinner/plans.
Love the flavor of eveything they have it's so good and plus really nice people everything us clean and tou can relax

I really like this Starbucks because, when you take the fact that it is right two major highways and squeezed into the area that it is, the people working here are making it work impressively well. I come here often enough that my bad luck gives me a mismixed drink from time to time or a long wait, but it's never left uncorrected in a fair manner or apologized for in a genuine way. I've never sought out for perfection by a national chain, but even though this is probably one of the biggest of the national chains, I find myself impressed with how functional and efficient such a location is.
I come here often and all of the baristas are always super nice! They recognize their frequent customers and everyone is always so friendly :)

Two amazing things about this Starbucks. First, the location. I'm visiting town and cycled ten minutes from Goleta. The cafe is in the heart of a tastefully designed shopping plaza, and my luck just so had that a farmers maker was taking place full of exceptional musicians and ripe fruits aplenty. Pretty awesome neighbor for a Starbucks. The second thing I loved was the space itself. Some Starbucks can feel cramped, frenetic, or assembly-line. This Starbucks had just the right balance of space between chairs, high ceilings to lift the spirits, and plenty of floor space to negotiate the inevitable foot traffic. I felt very comfortable and inspired in this writing to take care of my writing goals and am excited to return tomorrow morning.

The people working here are extremely nice and always in a good mood! They are all fast workers and you never have to wait more then like 5 minutes to get your drinks. And most importantly they make very good drinks and the snacks are always really good!
No more 24hours???? This location is always the best bet when my gf craves for midnight coffee (weird habit but cute )

I have been going to this Starbucks for years and it used to be my favorite spot.  Over the past year I've witnessed the manager insult and degrade her employees on several occasions to the point where I've almost said something.  She isn't friendly to her customers nor was she at all helpful when I had my my computer cord stolen there a week ago.  The rest of the staff is fabulous but she's honestly made me change locations and take my money elsewhere.
The employees here are super helpful and friendly. I sat down to eat a PB&J box today and really enjoyed my down time before heading to my next appointment!

1st and foremost this is one of the most beautiful
Starbucks, the ceiling is out of this world! We had received $5 coupons when we had checked into silver legacy, so our drinks were basically complementary. The line is always long, but the baristas make it go as fast as they can with out messing up an order. I wish this was my everyday Starbucks !

I have been called many things in my life.

Asshole.
Dickhead.
Jerk.
Greasy Thighs.  (don't ask)

But my favorite is seeing what medieval name the cashier wrote on my cup after not quite hearing me so well.  It's almost as if the name "Archie" is as common as "Megatron."  Some names I have been called at Starbucks?

RJ.
Arcie.
Andy.
Arnie.

But it was at this Starbucks that I got the most laughs after being called Argee.  That one is my personal favorite.  

Don't anger the Argee!  

Maybe I should say my name is Mortikai or Nicodemus.

I'm a Peet's guy by nature but in a pinch, I'll grab a Starbucks.

Anonymous.

Very quick, friendly and prompt service.  Everyone greeted you by your name vs just calling out your drink.  Nice touch.  Disappointed I didn't get my gold card rewards and discounts though.  That will prevent me from visiting again
Always slow and today I saw one of the baristas bitch out a customer because she didn't like how he took his credit card back. The manager was standing two feet away, but ignored it.
Staff is super friendly and drinks are good however their drive thru time is horrific. I could easily be stuck for 10-15 at times. Crazy
One of the best Starbucks in Delaware. The only downside is like many others I'll say it could use a good cleaning.

Every time I go to this Starbucks I leave feeling so happy. The baristas are great, always so nice and patient with my modified drink requests. My drinks are always made so perfectly. I was a partner and I became very picky about how my drinks need to be, every time I've gone anywhere but the one I worked at I end up a little disappointed with my drink, but not at this one, here I get a drink that is always just right, and the baristas always have the greatest attitudes.

I have an apartment almost next door, so I thought I'd go down for my birthday to get my free birthday coffee. Well, they don't accept Starbucks rewards... meaning no birthday coffee for me here. Also, the employees were not very nice, definitely not your regular Starbucks employee. I turned right around and walked out. Go 3 blocks down to the next Starbucks, where they accept rewards and the employees are awesome.

My favorite Starbucks. They make a mean iced white chocolate mocha. Sweet lord. I could have one of these every day. The crowd that comes there is very business-like. If not business-like, they're cute girls. Just sayin'. If I had more time to burn, I'd hang out here more often.

The baristas were extremely friendly. They even recommended me certain drinks but didn't recommend the most expensive ones. The service was quick but I wasn't cut off or anything. Great coffee experience
This is my favorite Starbucks in the area to visit! I make the drive each time because of the amazing employees. Leeanna is always so kind and so is Quentin. I leave happy each time.

I stopped in to grab a dose of caffeine while waiting for table at First Watch.  It was my first time inside this location.  Immediately I loved the feel of it and thought to myself "oh I've gotta come back for a full experience."

The leather chairs were calling me; Christy, Christy, CHRISTY come here!!!!

Anywho, I was on the clock so I grabbed my coffee, took a 2 second seat (just so my tush could touchCentra the leather) and jetted so I didn't miss my name being called at the Watch.

Don't worry Central Ave. like Arnold said, "I'll be bach"
Extremely sweet baristas! This Starbucks is always so friendly and clean! Drinks are great too.

This is MY Starbucks as in I always come to this one. And for that reason they know me and remember what I like and call me by name.  It's always clean and the baristas are friendly and courteous.  I wish I would remember to check in every time I come, cuz I'd probably be some type of Grand Puba of Yelp by now!
Dirty, horrible service and horrible drink. Please look at picture and the worker refuse to remake.

I'm not sure how this Starbucks earned poor reviews, but in the week I've been staying at my parents' place in Riverview on vacation, I've gotten my coffee here every day. For a corporate coffee shop, this location does a great job. All five of the staff members who've helped me were friendly, timely, and filled my order accurately. I didn't even have to ask for a puppuccino for my sweet hound--the barista offered one. Another staff member went to look for a pastry and yogurt flavor I wanted that weren't displayed. The outdoor seating area is convenient and plentiful, and the interior is clean and inviting. It certainly beats the Starbucks near my office in Raleigh, NC.

A Starbucks, is a Starbucks, is a Starbucks.... and this one is a Starbucks.  That doesn't say much, but simultaneously says it all.  I'm a purist with my coffee and always just order coffee.... no frills.  There should be a separate line for people like me who order, they turn and fill a cup and we are gone.... I don't even need to go to the separate counter to pick-up.  But I digress... this was coffee and it was good.

The service is super slow. They have like 4 ppl on the floor and only 1 person is taking orders. Baristas keep talking to each other when there is a line of like at least 3 people waiting for their drinks. Terrible

It makes no sense that it is so cold in here.  It is colder inside than it is outside, and all the people in here are bundled up or trembling.   If they didn't want me to be comfortable inside, then why don't they just make it to go only!  I was not comfortable at this starbucks at all.
Great, Standard Starbucks.  Always consistent. Drive through line is a little tight but they keep it moving.

NEVER come here on a Monday Morning unless you want to be late for work.  I understand that yeah it's Monday morning and everybody still half-asleep but honestly it should not take over 20 minutes to make somebody an online order yet you want to go in there you're sitting there waiting still and then to the point where you have to ask the person where is my order and they just have no idea all rude saying what's up. Im never coming here again

First time at this location and they messed up my drink although it was clearly labeled on the cup, they offered to remake it, but I was in a hurry and declined.  They made no effort beyond that, in the past I have at least been offered a remake and/ a free one for next time.  The bathrooms were dirty, which totally grosses me out in a coffee shop.  There were five employees working behind the counter and another person who seemed to be the manager.  The manager type person didn't seem to be assisting the team, even though they were very busy.  I still love Starbucks, but I wouldn't say I will make this one a regular spot.

My girlfriend and I decided to come to this location to enjoy a strawberry refresher over the other locations because this location is usually so spot on.  However, we order two venti refresher just to be told that they are out of strawberry juice.  Ok that happens, I guess, so we change to passion tea when we are told that they are out of lemonade.  Seriously?!?!  We decide to do do the new cold brew iced coffee and what looks to be a chocolate scone.   I hand the heated pastry bag to my girlfriend sitting outside and ask the barista if milk comes in the coffee. She tells me know but that they could add half and half. I ask for a splash The barista hands me two drinks what look closer to white mochas than coffee with a splash. My girlfriend then notices that the barista gave us a chocolate croissant.  I went to point it out but the girl walked away as I was talking to her about the mistake. My girlfriend then noticed that the scone we wanted was no longer in the case.  We wouldn't have ordered food today, but the scone was something new for us to try.
The only thing I purchase is very berry hibiscus.  I don't eat the food or drink anything else.  Customer service is good and so was my very berry hibiscus.

The staff here is so rude. When the cashier rung up my order she just threw my card back on the counter. Then it took forever for my grande coffee when there was only one other customer in there who already had their coffee. Also when my order was ready they just put it on the counter didn't say that it was ready or didn't call my name. I took it and walked out and she didn't say a word.

I went in for a coffe fix before hitting the children's museum, and right when it was time to pay I discovered that my card was no where in sight! I was mortified and sad bc I could just taste the Java goodness and sandwich about to be mine... :-( however after asking them would they accept my business check, a hug or Apple Pay, they excused the purchase and I promised to come back and pay. I did just that the next day! Thank you so much Starbucks! What a great staff!

We like coming to Starbucks.  We buy our coffee here for at home, so when we feel lazy, drive thru here we come.  Good service, helpful and inside always has a nice vibe to it.  Always great in our opinion.  And we love the dark roast blends. Can't remember what we bought last time, but its been our morning coffee.

Great service but my Carmel macchiato was very watery (they did replace it with no questions asked) only other problem is they are infested with ANTS!! Couldn't even sit at the table and enjoy my bagel without ants crawling everywhere.
The drinks were fine but all 4 of my sandwiches are cold in the middle. Not room temperature. Cold.

Easily the worst Starbucks on the planet. Takes forever to get your order fulfilled, they treat you without respect a customer should get. No one takes corrective action to improve service, no one cares.

I come here and order drinks at least twice a week. Every time I ask for light ice, they fail to make my drinks correctly.
Today was the buy a drink and get a free pastry.  I bought two drinks and was only allowed to get one pastry.  There was nothing written anywhere stating that there was only a single pastry allowed per purchase of one or more drinks

I love this Starbucks! All of the staff are very friendly, and one girl always makes suggestions and at least attempts to have a conversation with her guests. Today while ordering a Peppermint Mocha and a Pumpkin muffin she joked about how I can't make up my mind on which season I wanted. She told me how they only get the chocolate shavings for the pepmoch certain times of year, and if I wanted she would put cookie crumbles instead to give it a little extra something. Always very clean here. I'm a happy customer!

So i finally had the perfect breakfast sandwich.  Bacon Gouda..YUM!  So i was just going to have a bagel and I mentioned I would like to have the bread from the bacon gouda sandwich and put pb on it (smaller bread than a bagel).  I told her other Starbucks would leave the bacon not crispy and she said i can get it crispy for you so i told her okay.  The sandwich was fabulous and i wish all the other stores would go out of their way to offer crispy bacon when requested.  The others i have been to have said the sandwich is premade and they couldn't get the bacon any crispier.   Kudos to this one!!

This Starbucks is consistently great.  I registered a gift card online, so I get free soy and free syrup.  If you get a tall misto, your total is somewhere around $2 and it tastes just as good as a latte.  There are definitely ways to save at Starbucks.  A few weeks ago, they had a buy one get one free holiday drink promotion.  Anyway, my drinks are always consistently the right temperature, and every drink tastes like it is made from an experienced barista.  If you ask for a triple-shot venti peppermint white mocha and a scone, your order is going to be around $8, so be careful!  But the staff has always been friendly to me, and most of the time I am in and out within five minutes.

The barista was very rude to me when I wanted to confirm that she was using coconut milk and not soy milk. Customer service is down the toilet these days, but I was surprised at her tone and attitude, never mind I could have been allergic to soy. Not a pleasant experience.

Drop your (friend, sibling, loved one etc) off at work at 7:30am, drive around awhile and end here.  

Order a chai latte (or your own poison), and a crazy good zucchini muffin.  Then, devour the muffin top and the rest, while picking out the walnut gems which is strangely like panning for gold.  Repeat when your budget allows.
Favorite starbucks and a new favorite drink.....green tea frappuccino with soy!!! Excellent!!

If you go on a cold day, prepare to drink your Latte 'iced'!  Everyone around me is trying to bundle up to keep from shaking.  The seating is also limited for such a busy location.  If you have anything more than a very brief meeting, find another cafe'.  Everything else is your typical Starbucks cookie cutter experience.

I love Starbucks but not enough to go to this particular shop again. First time I went the barista got annoyed  that I had three cards: an empty discount card, a gift card with some credit and my debit card to reload my gift card), then she asked me to step away and wait for my coffee. I went to the bathroom to wash my hands and thought I left my wedding band. When I inquired about my ring she said that they wouldn't keep a ring if it was left behind in the toilet!

Next week I came back for a latte and to reload my card. There was a woman behind me and when she placed the order the two baristas just kept chatting away for several minutes while I waited by the cash register. I turned around and headed towards the exit door then one of them says "did you need anything, sir.". I said "nope" and I heard her scoff at me. Like she was annoyed by my perceived rudeness. 

I now only go to the one by Castleton, the staff is always friendly and it has a drive-through.
Just another one of these cookie cutter venues.  You ever been to one?  It's like all the others, which is a good thing about chain places...their consistency.
WiFi at this location is slower than a dial up connection for those who know what that is.
Once again stopped in got the best customer service from Gio got a nice ice tea after I couldn't decide on coffee thanks for the wonderful staff you have at this location

Honestly, I have never been a fan of Starbucks coffee, it always tastes like the beans were way over roasted. The service was not only slow and unfriendly, they even opened up late on more than one occasion. The only reason I kept coming back was the fact that it was in the hotel we were staying in and I needed my coffee.

So I absolutely love Starbucks. But let me tell you, I had the worst experience here. I asked for a refresher shaken with ice, but no ice. Literally when I got my drink it was super warm. And the baristas are not that friendly. It's really disappointing seeing the fact that I always go to Starbucks.

I usually have a good experience here, but yesterday when I tried to call in a traveler for today the phone just kept ringing and ringing! I've called before with no problems so I know the number is right, and I even waited and tried again a few minutes later, but still nothing. At least answer the phone and put me on hold while you finish up with the other customers.

I dropped into this Starbucks the other day at the request of a friend I was driving with. I don't usually stop into Starbucks, as I make my coffee at home. I decided rather than loiter while my friend got coffee that I'd grab a bag of their coffee and a breakfast sandwich to boot.

When I handed the coffee to the cashier he was kind enough to ask me if I wanted it ground. Oops, good question, I didn't even notice it wasn't ground, and I sure don't have a grinder at home. That was a point right there, but then I ate the sandwich and it was surprisingly good!

The biggest surprise was the coffee once I brewed it! I got the medium "house" blend I believe, and I think I'll be buying it again.

This review is based on the quality of the food and the coffee, the cleanliness of the joint (OK, it just opened), and the friendly, helpful staff. You just found a new customer (at age 42 no less).
Very nice staff!! I had ordered a dark roast coffee while their grinder was being repaired. They gave a complimentary drink for free !! I frequent here and would strongly recommend this one

Very nice, very kind. Drinks are always way above standard and the employees are super nice. I will sometimes go in there with my girlfriends and the employees joke around with us a bit, which improves my experience by a lot. Over all the experience is great!
It's a regular Starbucks with a little-less-than-normal friendliness. The place had a number of people there, but seating was certainly limited. No drive thru either. It's attached to a plaza.

As far as any Starbucks location goes - this is probably my favorite. The staff here are incredibly friendly and boy, are they fast! The store is usually fairly busy and parking isn't usually available unless you get there early in the day, which is fine if you work 9-5. The space is somewhat cramped, but better than it was prior to their renovation. Again - it's a Starbucks, but it has the best staff of any others I've visited in the past and better than others I visit out of convenience.
Friendly staff, quick delivery. I was here for several days at different times, never got dissapointed.

Went in yesterday morning wasn't busy at all I was so happy to get in and out. I love the fact I have a starbucks close to my house, I love starbucks I have tried a variety of different drinks and all of the drinks I've tried were tasty. No complaints I love starbucks.

This is one of the absolute worst Starbucks! The employees are rude and condescending! They behave as if they are doing you a favor by taking your order! They pay absolutely no attention to your order and so therefore if I ever got an order correct on the first attempt, it may be a miracle! If they paid half as much attention to the customer as they do to each other's personal lives, then maybe they could get an order correct! I have unfortunately visited this store on more than a few occasions and am still waiting for them to fix the problems. Save yourself the aggravation and go to another location!

Every single time I've been here, I've received attitude from the employees, I honestly feel intimidated to attempt small talk. This starbuck's takes twice as long on register and to prepare orders. I come here only because it is my nearest one, but if I had a choice, I'd go to any other.
Prime Starbucks place. Just passing by but the coffee isn't less of what you expect at a Starbucks. Was kinda busy when we came but it was around traffic hour so it made sense.

I only have two stars because I love their coffee.   This location sucks!!!!!   They never, ever have enough people working.  I am a gold member and make online orders in which it tells you that the order will be ready in x amount of minutes.   I stand inside for an extra twenty minutes every time.  It is nuts and unacceptable.

If you've been to one Starbucks, you've pretty  much been to them all. That said this Starbucks has some of the friendliest staff, and plenty of room to sit and grab a drink, work on your computer, read a book or even people watch :)

Unhappy with this Starbucks as of late... They are under new management and they have for starters changed the hours. This use to be a 24/7 location and they are now only open til 2 . They often run out of different flavor syrups and pastries. The last 3 times I have gone they were out of at least one of the things I wanted. It is very frustrating.. 

I have 4 doggies and they luv puppacino time! The last time I went the attendant at the window was quite rude about fixing 2 for me. The babies always share and when I asked for 2 she just was very sharp with me, was not at all friendly. 

This used to be my favorite Starbucks so the changes lately have been increasingly frustrating.

Today was not a good day. I waited at the drive thru at least 30 minutes. Ordered  a venti peppermint mocha Frappuccino..didn't taste peppermint at all..a little too watery and didn't get the "venti" amount. And my tuxedo mocha Frappuccino tasted just likes a regular coffee but a little bittered...very disappointed. One of the drink came out all dripping on the side of the cup and the guy handed to me didn't bother to either clam it up or tell me about it till it got all on my hand then offer me some napkins....

I'm here fairly often since I work in the area. Usually I like to drink the blonde roast. They normally do not have any brewed ahead of time so there is a wait for the single pour. I'm fine with the wait in theory. However, the single pours are apparently the responsibility of the cashiers. They get very busy at this location and the last few times that I've been here its been forgotten about by them. They either need to set a timer of some kind or have the barista take care of it.

I stop in here every morning before work (and have been doing it for about two years now).  The staff has always been nothing but friendly to me.  I have no idea how they're so perky so early in the morning, but it's refreshing.  I always get greeted by name and my drink is started as soon as they see me.  Overall, I have a great interaction every morning!
Standard coffee. But this parking lot is like a free for all no holds bard idiots choice of parking.

Been to this location twice now and I have overpaid for the wrong drink. I usually make chai lattes at home but I was running too late to make it so I decided to stop here on my way to work.  I asked for a venti chai latte with an added shot and they charged me for three shots, making it very expensive. Unfortunately, I didn't realize this mess up until I got to work. A couple days before i ordered a Starbucks double shot, which I was given the impression was an iced beverage but instead I got four shots of espresso and some milk. The people are nice, but then Again, ignorance is bliss. Please re-train your new people or quiz them on their drinks because clearly they just don't get it.
The worse tea I ever gotten from Starbucks. California Starbucks Riverside, California makes the best tea latte.

One day I'll stop forgetting how ridiculous this place is and just stay away. My guess is there's an attitude problem with management that reflects in the attitude of the employees. The drive through takes forever. When I go inside, some baristas will actually look me in the eyes, the windows to my soul, saying nothing, before they scurry to do busywork or prep. It takes time for the right one to come back to the counter. Ridiculous. 

And once I vowed to stay away when, after waiting over 10 minutes, I saw a guy take out the garbage and try to bring the cans back through the back door and was told by a girl from the window he had to walk back around and go through the front. Glad to see where the manager's priorities are. Today I just got rained on for over a minute waiting for someone to take my order before I remembered how terrible this location is and went to another one.
This location is huge but it's maybe the most popular Starbucks study group locations for all of UCSB. We got our order quickly but seating was limited. Neat to see the college vibe again.

Again my favorite place for my carmel frappe. However I do not know why Starbucks builds one such small areas. This is on the corner of a busy intersections and again not nearly enough room for vehicles.
Why in the world they have three people taking orders and only one making coffee is beyond me. 20 people waiting for coffees and only one person trying to make them all Bad management.

Ok, I admit it, I'm a coffee snob.  What's worse is my favorite is Circle K coffee!  I'll drink Starbucks if I have to I just don't want to feel like a need a cigarette to take the edge off after.  Fortunately they have a nice selection of iced tea.  The staff at this one was on it and kept the place clean.  Free wifi also goes a long way for me.  Thanks Starbucks!

Yes, it's "just" a Starbucks, but when we stopped in for our morning coffee on our trek back to Boston, the staff were extremely friendly and even helped us make sure we had directions (although we had a GPS) to get back to the highway.  My beverage - a cinnamon dolce latte - was made perfectly and extra hot, just how I like it.

It's Starbucks so the coffee is what you would expect but,  seriously the agitation and craziness that ensues from the parking games played in that lot has made me leave several times. Then I park in the big lot and walk over to hothouse... 

The worst part is it's really the only Starbucks that serves Bryn Mawr, Haverford and Villanova.... tired college students + mainline clients = disaster

They serve coffee flavored water! Don't mess with me I am from NYC and need my caffeine! But they get 2 stars because their bathroom is the cleanest I have seen on the east coast! It seems the further you get away from NYC the cleaner the bathrooms!

This was my absolute favorite location. I used to live right around the corner, and although I ALWAYS change my order, people recognized my face and were always friendly. There really isn't a LOT to say in regards to anything exceptionally done in comparison to other locations, because hey, it's Starbucks - they want all locations to be as close to the same as possible. What makes a specific location of a chain better than others is the consistency, and the people.

Smiling faces, my drinks ALWAYS tasting the same, the store being clean, well stocked and taken care of... this location is on spot. They battle back and forth between one or two other stores for being the busiest in the district, so yeah, sometimes it can be packed (especially the drive through in the mornings). I'll keep stopping by whenever I'm on that side of town, though. They make me smile.
Amazing staff. Some of the baristas are still in high school, but you'd never know it based on their excellent customer service skills.

This Starbucks is close to my apartment and very convenient when heading to many places around the Keystone area. Generally, I use the drive thru and the line always moves quickly even if there are many cars in line. Recently, I've noticed a few baristas with really great personalities and they always brighten my day by asking how I'm doing or greeting me in an energetic way. The only downside is the limited seating inside the store and I usually hesitate when I consider stopping at this location to study because I'm not confident there will be an open spot for me.
Ask for Kip at the drive thru.  He makes a fabulous cup of coffee!!!  I would know.  I go way too often.

I paid for two cheese danishes and was handed two paper sacks. I drove away and realized that one of the sacks was empty. How do you not know that something is empty. WTF??? Why would you hand me an empty paper bag?!

I love Starbucks and this is definitely one of the nicer ones I have been to in my travels. But the one thing I can say is that no matter how busy they are it always takes longer for me to get my drink here than at any other Starbucks. I'm just not sure why. Maybe it's just the mood I'm in today. Haha. Staff is super nice though.

How many Starbucks offer a view over an ice rink?! I'm going to guess only a few, if any. 

I like this location in the West Edmonton Mall because of the view, and the seating that overlooks the rink as it's more exciting than being stuck in the mall hall traffic. 

Staff are nice, helpful and quick with service.
Been here a few times, and every time I do it's consistent excellent customer service. It's the only Starbucks I like going too.

I love Starbucks, but this particular store was not very nice. They continued to remind the people in the coffee shop that they were closing soon, and before they were officially closed, a worker announced to the store that they were closed and kicked everybody out. I've worked in this type of industry before, and in my experience, good customer service should never include kicking customers out of the store before closing. You can come for the drinks, but I wouldn't come for the service.
This place has the best staff ever.  For a Starbucks they are top notch.  I would highly recommend a visit as they certainly know what they are doing.

This review is for this location and my experience for the last 2-3 years. 
I probably went here 7-8 times throughout those years. 

And every other time that I come here and order the "Blueberry" oatmeal. I get no blueberries. I usually order this when I go through the drive-thru. 

My opinion on this: is that a supervisor or manager there told the employees that if they don't ask for blueberries again then not to give it to them. Because going through drive thru you don't check the bag. Going back to the store is now more of a hassle since you didn't want to go inside already. 

This is foxy at best. Not cool. Starbucks doesn't need to save anymore money when they are charging through the roof for drinks already. 

Come on guys. The oatmeal says "blueberry oatmeal" on the menu!

This is the best Starbucks ever! I love coming here, everyone always has a smile on their face. The employees always try to make sure everything is done efficiently and quickly. I was particularly impressed with the managers; any time something is messed up they do their best to fix it! I love this location!!!

I know this location is extremely busy in the mornings, but the barista today had no sense of urgency whatsoever. I waited inside for 12 minutes in addition to the 5 minute drive after mobile ordering my drink. This wouldn't be such a big deal except I witnessed NUMEROUS people who were standing in line receive their beverage before me (including a coworker). RIDICULOUS. The second I mobile order the drink should be equivalent to me standing in line and ordering it. Why are people who are ordering 10+minutes after me receiving their drinks first?

Also, the parking lot is a sh*tshow, but there is nothing they can really do about that....

Gave it three stars because I usually do not have any complaints.

Taken a serious dive in quality/consistency lately. Wait times have been longer, and have been more errors with drink orders. Today, went through the drive through, it was lunch time so I expected a bit of a wait. 

Got to the speaker, was asked to wait a moment before placing my order. Sure, no problem. 10 minutes later, line in front of me is almost empty, still haven't heard back from the barista. So I call out, they apologize, says they didn't hear their headset beep.

It gets busy, things slip, understandable, I guess. Place my order, they repeat it back correctly. Get up to the window, wait a bit more. 

I had 2 drinks. One hot, one iced. They made my iced one hot, and made the hot one a completely different drink. Waited more. At this point I've been in the drive through a good 25 minutes. Not even an apology, just an offer to keep the messed up drinks. Yeah no. 

Think I'm just gonna go to the one on Disc from now on.

I've been meaning to change up my study spot.. so I found this Starbucks located off of Rt 73 on Fellowship Rd. There's really no other Starbucks nearby except the one in the Moorestown Mall or about a 10 minute drive to Marlton or Cherry Hill. There's also a limited amount of coffee shops, cafes, and potential study places in the area that have tables/seating and free wifi. 

I came in on a weekday around 9am and the drive-thru line was through (and out of) the parking lot. Because of this I was scared there would be no spots left inside to study.. luckily, as I picked up my espresso, a small table with 2 seats opened. The study area was filled with people on laptops doing work. 

I had an espresso and all the staff were friendly and welcoming. They did mess up my order slightly, but I was able to get it easily fixed. Just seems like the workers are in a rush (I don't blame them, they had soooo many customers in the drive thru).

If you're looking for a quiet place to get work done, this is not your place. The room fills with sounds from the kitchen, beeping, espresso making fizzing, and individuals on phone calls. This was not a problem for me as I work fine with background sounds. Most likely I will be back to this location since it has great hours and a clean study area.

The baristas here are great with the exception of one. My drink is always on point I can walk here from home, which counts as my exercise  newly remodeled, looks nice but not warm, cozy, and inviting like it use to be. Seating is very limited there's no comfy chairs anymore. Outside seating is good place for people watching. Definitely stop in for a good cup of joe but don't plan to stay, lol.

Being the only Starbucks within walking distance of the Williams Center, these folks stink at getting customers through the line and out the door in a timely fashion!

I just spent 12 of my 15 minute break waiting in a line that didn't move an inch! This is not the first time, they need more staff.

Literally no parking. Like ever. That's 3 times out of 3 times on the no parking. Waited 10 mins and parked in a non-spot in front of someone else who was in a non-spot. Villanova and Haverford haven't even started classes yet. 

Literally sitting at this location right now. It feels like I'm in an igloo. It must be set to like 55 in here. I'm not joking.

Open til 11. What you'd expect for a Starbucks. Kind staff. Only place you can really do any work as most coffee shops in the area close around 8 or 9 (at the latest). So their closing time really is a big saving grace.

Points for: open late
No points: no parking, it's like walking into an igloo.
This Starbucks is a gem. Inside the Bellevue. Beautiful decorative arts carved into the high ceilings. At a great location. If you happen to be in the theater area, recommend to stop in.

If I could give it 0 stars I would, while I was getting my iced coffees the male barista said to the female that I,   was probably going to post pictures of my coffee's on Facebook. After I receive my coffee, I said, "no I don't plan on posting this on my facebook. thanks though." Then he said , "oh you have boundaries?" What a jerk.

Basic Starbucks experience. Nothing fancy. Had the regular items. Fairly small seating area. Had an outdoor seating but it was too cold to sit outside today. Friendly service.

This location is down the street from my house, and I always run into people I know there. My girlfriend and I go in there about twice a week. The staff is very friendly, and they really take their time while talking to each customer. They are a lot slower than most of the Starbucks' I have been to, but sometimes its refreshing. More about the experience, less about the rush and caffeine fix. I usually drink the Salty Caramel Mocha (off menu, but AMAZING).

They haven't been reviewed in a while, so I hope this helps!!

3rd update. Raising to 5-stars. Flawless customer service for several visits since last reviews!

@@@@@@@@@@
To be fair, raising stars back, since have been back several times, and have not encountered the same sour barista. Everyone else has earned respect for a job well done!

@@@@@@@@@@@
New employee (one specific person) is quite rude.  Not first day encountered same poor attitude.  Sinking rating.  :-(

This starbs is 2 mins away from my home & I go there almost everyday and order the same drink but it's sad because they never fill it to the top?! I'm sorry if I'm paying for the size I expect it to be full... like you could splash a little more milk or ice in it because I feel ripped off when I order and my drink is never full! This Starbucks is the only one that does this to me and it makes me want to go to any other Starbucks so this doesn't happen. I just wanted to point it out so maybe, next time it's full. I've also said something very nicely to the barista one time and she filled it up but rolled her eyes. Anyway I would love to keep coming here because of how convenient the location is for me, so I hope this changes.

This is Starbucks so it isn't any fancier better or worse than any of the other company owned and operated shops. The baristas and staff are all awesome and amazing. This is the location right next to Dorignac's on Veterans at Wilshire. It is also a drive-thu so you may drive around and order and get it at the pick-up window if you're in a hurry and don't want to leave your vehicle. This is well outside of the touristy areas so you can deal with a normal and regular crowd of people. You'll enjoy this location!!!!

Hey, 
Went in at night to get an espresso. I order. Three employees were behind the counter, 1 "customer" in front was standing talking to an employee, obviously his friend for about 7 minutes. No one else was waiting for a drink. I finally asked for a refund. The cashier gave me a refund for the amount of the drink but NOT the sales tax. When I asked why I was not given a FULL refund, she stated that they don't refund the sales tax. I've never had this occur before, I don't ask for a lot of refunds in life, hardly ever really, but when I do, they refund the sales tax. You might want to retrain your employees on simple cashier principles. The median age of your employees was about 18. No manager was in sight. I tried explaining that I was due my tax and they just raised their voices.
Every time I go to this location they never have my mobile order ready always slow and the Fraps always look like mess. I wish I could post a pic of this sloppy mess

The servers kept on giving me dirty looks and they gossip a lot, lots of laughing and screaming. It was pretty dirty in there. I waited 20 minutes for my coffee, and when I got it, it wasn't even hot. When I asked them to heat it up, they acted like it was such a burden. I got sighs and eye rolls. Super uncomfortable! I definitely didn't feel welcome in here. I'm glad I got out of there. There's lots of other Starbucks around the area that are cleaner, faster, and nicer than this one. I suggest going to those rather than this one. I'm not coming back here.

Today you disappointed me starbucks. The staff is normally great and quick about getting everyones order ready. And with mobile ordering, it saves you time by avoiding the line! However, I didn't recognize the staff today and I received my coffee with blood all over the cup. NOT ok! For today's service I would give you zero stars but I'm giving a three because normally it is my go to location.

I have never seen such ignorance in one location.  After entering this hell hole we were promptly pushed to a back portion of the restruant. Later after we were near empty on our beverages a sexualy open employee came angry yelling that the dinning room was not for "us" apparently paying customers only for this cooperate evil that thrives from treating patrons like second class citizens. Keep in mind I did not make a scene because I'm a good Christian women

Very nice Starbucks in heart of Doylestown. This Starbucks sits in a historic building which adds to the cozy inside atmosphere complete with a fireplace. There is also outside seating overlooking downtown. The service is very good and I have been pleased. Parking can be tricky with a small public metered lot behind the building. There is plenty of street parking if you can find a spot.

Last time I stayed in this area for work (October 2011) this Starbucks wasn't here, so I was pretty damn happy to see it when I arrived yesterday.  The drive-thru was full this morning at 9, but they moved the line quickly and the barista working the window was super friendly. I'm a big fan of friendly baristas.

Usually this place is great for an after work stop. Today, it was just not good. Ordered my usual plus a tall iced drink and I got the most minimal effort put into my order. The barista, a blonde I never seen before, kept looking at me with annoyance. Just tasting my regular drink, all the add ins are missing and the barista tried to overflow the cup with ice. When she slammed the drink on the counter it overflowed out of the lid. I had to ask twice for a new lid and ice removed. The tall iced drink was literally milk with coffee poured on top and again a bunch of ice. I expect better.

Over the years I have had challenges with this Starbucks ..... I had lost all hope that I would ever have a good experience and was about to give up when along came Sassy!! 
It is not an exaggeration when I say she single handedly restored my faith in this store and has created a life long patron and friend. 
She is awesome! I hope her boss knows what a treasure he/she has in Sassy!! 
And it's not just me.... I see how she interacts with people.....she is great!! 
Because of Sassy I can now give this Starbucks a five star review! 
I highly recommend you go thru this Starbucks and see for yourself. 
Go Sassy! You are the BEST! Thank you for your perfect customer service.  ~Christine

This is the slowest Starbucks drive thru. It's the closest to my home and it is always--literally always---a long wait. Even when I'm the second car, it's guaranteed a 10 minute wait at least. You can't get out of line either.
Your employees need to wash their aprons! Some are so disgusting. Otherwise service was okay.

Consistently I was getting a coffee cup that was filled up only three quarters of the way. Mind you, I never asked for any room for cream. Today I finally sucked it up and asked her to fill it up all the way. I was given the silent treatment. Baristas face said it all. Sorry, if I'm paying 2$ for a coffee I would like a full cup.
Fast and friendly Starbucks, better than some, on par with others.

Ben thank you for making our coffee experience so lovely .  I went for an iced caramel macchiato but sad no caramel but Ben suggested white mocha well we got that instead it was great thanks again for a perfect experience

I have not been to a crappy Starbucks in awhile, but this one in particular stinks. I ordered my drink, a simple espresso hot beverage straight off the menu, no bells and whistles. There were maybe 4 or 5 orders ahead of me. 20 minutes later (I am standing at the bar the entire time waiting) I finally ask where my drink is. They had made it 15 minutes prior and did not put it out on the counter or called out the drink or the name written on the cup. The employees at this store were all talking to an employee that had just gotten off work (the same one that took my order) and got him his drink immediately. The employees were too focused on each others' stories and laughing to actually do their job and announce orders. The coffee also was poorly made and tasted burnt. So that too. Save your time and go to a different store.

This Starbucks has a lot to offer- it's a Clover store, the seating is so plentiful that's it shocking and it's quite clean. 

However, the employees need a massive training overall. It's, quite frankly, sloppy. 

For example. At 9am this morning, one of their coffee pots was broken, so for whatever reason, they elected not to have blonde roast. That's fine...but it should be intuitive to the shift manager that they need to be prepared to offer customers a way to have their blonde roast, whether via a pour over or the Clover. 

After ordering a blonde, all I got was "We don't have a blonde today." That's it. No explanation. No options. So I asked why. That's how we got to the pot being broken. I then caveated that perhaps they could make it on the clover, but at the normal drink price. You would have thought that was the most novel idea of the day. No! That should have been the first thing said: "I'm sorry, but the blonde pot is broken, but I can definitely do one on the clover for you if you have a few minutes."

Bobby Barista, you think your funny but your comments are nothing short of being a douche. Customer asked a simple question "What year did this store open" it doesn't require 18 douche like responses. Thanks but no thanks  Philly Resident and Starbucks Client

Went in this morning to try the much anticipated Nitro cold brew coffee. This is the happiest place on earth . The crew there was. Genuinely happy and awesome to talk too. The drink was amazing too. Thanks guys for starting my morning in a great way !

Went in and they had no iced decaf and no apology. Okay. And they never have salt or pepper for their food items like the others do. Claim they order it but it just doesn't come in.Well, call corporate and solve the problem instead of just accepting it!

Any ol starbucks, but super busy with Jefferson students and doctors coming in and out all day long. Not really a place to study because people are always moving around, but a nice comfortable place to have coffee with a friend.

I tend not to frequent this Starbucks do to the horrendous parking, but I was in the mood for some Starbucks so I decided to stop off at this location. 

First, as I mentioned before the parking here is bad. There are maybe 5-10 spots at the most and it results in chaos. I ended up parking across the street due to joe filled up the lot was. 

While the parking here is horrendous, the staff and food are up to par. 

I got an everything croissant, bacon Gouda breakfast sandwich and a strawberry smoothie. They also had a large variety of other baked goods in their case. 

All my food came out fast and was very tasty. I loved the everything croissant. It was soft and had a variety of delicious toppings including sesame seeds, poppy seeds and some garlic. The smoothie was solid and on par with other Starbucks smoothies that I have had.

The staff here is very good as they are polite and professional. They also serve the food and drinks very fast. Mike was great! 

This Starbucks also has a small courtyard with some tables in the back. 

Altogether, this Starbucks has terrible parking, but the rest of the restaurant is fine.
Nice space in sub basement level. From outside, it looks tiny, but it's not.

Very clean, well-run Starbucks.  Parking lot around back.
No issues.

Quick service even though they were busy. A good amount of indoor seating. Got no problems with the drinks  They got a nice stained glass ceiling too and even though the Starbucks was in Silver Legacy casino, the cigarette smoke smell was not noticeable. 

The best of the experience was the friendly service.

I go to this Starbucks a lot , 4 or more time a week since I work right next door. I am a gold card member so I spend some money here. Every single time I walk into this Starbucks I am nothing but nice to all the staff and they're pretty nice except for 2 girls that have helped me recently. Every time I come in they act like I'm an inconvenience to them. Especially Miryam, I have asked for a drink with different milk then what it actually has and I get rolled eyes. As well as when they close at 1:00am I go in around 10 or 11 they tell me they only serve hot drink until closing. I understand if it's policy they have but as I walk away someone else is ordering a cold drink. . I will no longer be coming  to this location not very good customer service

In my quest to review something everywhere I travel, I had to include probably the coolest Starbucks location I've ever been to. It is in the lower level of what can only be described as one cool fucking historic building in the historic area of Philadelphia. The only downside is that the outlets are spread out and if you are in dire need of a charge things can be a bit difficult.

I love coffee.  Hold all the flavors, sugary additives, whip creams and foo foo stuff.  Just coffee.  I love all roasts, all boldness, and most any type of beans.  Starbucks coffee is ok.  Their dark roast is a bit too burnt flavored (just not well done... or too well done i guess).  Their medium roasts are decent.  If you are a real coffee lover, I'm not sure starbucks is for you.  If you like desert drinks, this is your place.

Like Daniel, I practically live at this Starbucks during the school year. But not just because it is across the street from school.

the pastry and sandwich cases are always well stocked, which is great for when I need a sugar rush with my caffeine fix. The staff are really wonderful--always fun, always friendly, and they always know what to make me. 

And don't forget Emilie--the best, most funny, most friendly, most awesome barista ever!

It's Starbucks. What can you say about any Starbucks that hasn't been said before.  So, let me remind you:

First, no matter how long you are there, you're going to smell like roasted coffee when you leave. Not the good kind either.  Second, why is it sooo expensive!?  Third, they do offer sandwiches, wraps, and some other foods, and they are also overpriced. Lastly, there is hardly enough seating for the size of the place-- it's not very convenient if you just want to sit and chat.  

The service was fine, and the tea & coffee my co-worker and I bought were fine, too.

I suggest supporting local coffee shops and businesses over Starbucks. But, I can't say anything terribly bad about this place. It's a Starbucks-- what else could you expect?
Our 'homebase' Starbucks, this is a great location.  The staff are all very friendly and just overall good people.  Definitely a fan all around.

This is the worst Starbucks in Reno. The " children" that work there have zero idea what customer service is. The drive thru is always a 20-25 min ordeal. If you have all day to waste, you should be ok going there. If you don't have the better part of your morning to spend waiting for your drink, go to a different Starbucks. I especially like when their attitude starts because the 12 year old taking orders can't hear you over the road noise in the drive thru. Should have thought about that one when you built it, oops! Probably just poor management. They have lost my business.

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to! Unfortunately, it is the only Starbucks close to my house, so I have to suffer through the pain of visiting the store. I have had many negative experiences here, ranging from the parking situation (which is beyond idiotic) to an under stocked food selection to incompetent workers. Today, I went in around 9:20 AM, I was at the first person to order at the register and place my order for a Venti white chocolate mocha add one pump peppermint and a ham and Swiss sandwich. To be expected, they were out of the ham and Swiss sandwich. Well fast forward 23, yes 23 minutes later, and they finally get my order correct after messing up my drink, adding only one pump of white mocha, no peppermint. My drinks never get messed up, only at the store. Something needs to be fixed.

I moved to this area recently and this is the Starbucks I've come to visit most frequently. This morning I was there, sitting inside enjoying my iced coffee, when a very VERY disgruntled woman began berating one of the baristas about her tea. Normally, I would have just kept my head down and ignored her but this woman was ruthless. She insulted the barista, said things to make her feel small and unintelligent. Pretty much did everything she could to hurt the poor woman's feelings. I've worked in customer service for 5 years and I know what it's like to be treated like a servant when you're merely a "server". So, in case this lovely, hard-working barista ever checks her Starbucks reviews - please know that you're doing a wonderful job, and people like the woman have no business even being out in public, let alone interact with mankind... or animals for that matter. Thanks for all that you do.
Great service and its always fast moving. A clean, friendly and professional environment. The staff is very polite and extremely personable!

Two to three times a day customer, I don't visit this location often.
Every time I have come here they are out of the product I want. From berries in a drink to yogurt. 
Staff is very professional and courteous,  management dropping the ball.

I give 3 stars to this Starbucks. (Weep) sadly, the few times I've been to this SB location I've been kind of bummed out by the inconsistent service. There was 3 people working this afternoon, but it appears only 1 barista preparing drinks. My latte tasted funny and not in a ha-ha way, more like, for $5.13 this latte sucks. 
I said to the only barista working that I think they used the wrong milk and perhaps that sugar-free syrup and she looked at me like I was crazy. Ummm, I spend probably about as much time in Starbucks as a barista does (hang head in shame here), so, uhh, I kinda know my latte stuff. 
O'well.

First mistake was obviously going to this Starbucks when there are plenty of awesome coffee shops within walking distance, but anyway....the service was the worst. No eye contact and made me act like I was a problem and a burden. Don't Easter your time 

Take a nice downtown walk over to Park Ave coffee or drive to Kaldis Coffee

I usually come to a Starbucks for Frappucinos and the killer cranberry orange scones.  Thought I'd stretch my comfort zone a bit and try one of their refreshers - one of the citrusy ones, which they described as a type of a green tea.  I couldn't finish it.  It was horrible, so sugary and sweet that I almost spit it out immediately.  Me no likey.  

Since this store is located right at the entrance of a busy street light, be VERY CAREFUL if you park immediately in front of the store.  People zoom in off Virginia Street and hang a quick right and may not see you if you are slowly backing out of your parking spot.

FIVE employees and took 15 min from the time we ordered one drink to receiving it and only 4 people/drinks ahead. Way too young without an adult supervising. They announced the drink wrong and laughed. While making it, heard the horrible saga of one of them not being invited to a boys party because he didn't like her. They were moving in slow gear while discussing such an important event. No tip for sure and not a supporter of Starbucks employees.

One person working @ 0730 in the morning?? The long line was not progressing so I had to walk out. 
It looks like a nice, clean shop with plenty clean tables, easy parking, and pleasant decor. But, customer service needs to be more prompt for morning rush.
Lines were long and it took a long time to get two ice teas.  One ice tea came and the other too another 5 mins.

I understand the need to train staff, but come on!!! There were two staff here at 5:30 in the evening with 3 people infront of me that took over 10 minutes. Orders took forever because beverages could not be made due to training on the register. I ordered a midnight mocha frap and asked for no whipped cream, yet got it with whipped cream. Simply from the unpleasant wait I left unhappy and didn't even have it remade. As I walked outside I sipped my frap to find out it did not even have any mint in it.

In addition.... there was NO PLACE TO SIT inside due to customers who had long been done there beverages hogging up 2  seat tables to surf the internet. 
 
I'd expect much better at Starbucks!

Up until this morning, this was my favorite Starbucks. This morning I decided to ask the barista just how much "room" in my cup she would give me if I said "yes" to her question about "room."   The short version is that instead of giving me a cup from the regular stack of cups, she got me a cup that was already next to the sink.  Maybe it was a perfectly clean cup that happened to be lying near the sink.  However, after she handed it to me without a word and did not reply when I thanked her, I was afraid to drink it.  I carried it to my office and dumped it.  I will not be back to this particular Starbucks.

And, next time I order a coffee at a Starbucks, I will say "Tall dark coffee please, no room."

This place is great, it gets busy at times, but there is usually still room for me to set me things down and do homework. It is conviniently close to the mall if you needed to do some shopping and the people here are friendly and humorous!
We love this Starbucks... they are quick, friendly, and do a great job.  Other than the hoodrats hanging out on the front step, it is great.  Also. I would clean more thoroughly the front porch!!

So I come here quite often and today I noticed on the menu that there was a new "Caramel Flan Latte" so I figured I'd try it. I ordered it and I overheard the barista telling the guy who rung me up that she doesn't know how to make it. The guy then asks another employee if she knew whether or not they had the recipe...Meanwhile I'm asking myself, "Am I at Starbucks or the local 7-11?!" To make a long story short, I settled for my usual order and they seemed rather relieved. I was tempted to give them the suggestion of taking it off of their menu since no one knew how to make it. I'm shocked that Starbucks would allow this amateur move for themselves and their reputation.
The sorriest drive through wait times!!  22 minutes folks with no way to get out, it was the Starbucks Coffee black hole preventing on-time arrival to work.
Google says they are open til 10:30pm... we go through the drive thru at 10:20... they say "Oh, sorry - we changed our hours an hour and a half ago and we actually closed at 10." Uuuhhh.....WT?!

I love this Starbucks. It's close to UCSB, and it has an abundant amount of outlets to plug my chargers into when I'm there for long study sessions. If you're at the large wooden table, look under the table for a long power strip, you can't miss it!
I prefer this location as opposed to the one in Isla Vista for their fast and friendly service, and their amenities like a lot of tables and power strips- that are perfect for students like me.
Be careful! I got robbed here! Don't leave anything when you go to restroom. Starbucks does not help you at all

I've been to Starbucks around the country and the world and have not experienced such horrible service as I did here. After I ordered my drink, I asked if I could get a copy of my receipt and waited there for two minutes. The person who took my order seemed to hear me but stayed in the back and ignored me and the people behind me who were still waiting to order. The barista who made my drink gave me a chile mocha instead of the salted caramel hot chocolate I ordered. When I told her she got my order wrong, she gave me attitude. She then handed me a "new" drink that tasted like a chile mocha with caramel syrup mixed in. To make things worse, the baristas were loudly discussing making drinks for themselves even though the line was backed up, and spoke negatively about the customers.

Super friendly crew, the baristas seem like they have fun being there. VERY busy store but communicate with each other well. Although they're always busy no matter what time you go they always makes my drink right, in and out quickly.
Hey this is a Starbucks. The counter girl was completely cute and very pleasant. Barrista likewise. I try and do local but sometimes Starbucks is the only option. Got my latte fix in rural PA.

I like this Starbucks because of its location inside Silver Legacy.  Being between El Dorado and Circus Circus, it's a nice break away from all the gaming machines and tables.  The baristas aren't that friendly. And the coffee drinks aren't as consistent as expected. To top it off, the prices are higher because it's inside a casino. Yet, I still frequent this Starbucks because I haven't found a great cup of coffee from any casino coffee place.

Starbucks on the WashU Danforth Campus (Bauer Hall-the business school). This means a few things:

1) Changing hours based on the school calendar. When school is not in session, it may be closed or open for a short amount of time.
2) Unpredictable hours. If the school has a special event, it may be closed.
3) lack of seating space during peak hours like lunch time. Though there are a lot of tables, it shares the space with the b-school cafe, which has a lot of undergraduate and graduate students there all the time
4) you can use the app to pay, but can't redeem rewards or order ahead of time for pickup
5) wonderful staff!

Living a convient block away, I don't even want to know how much money I spend here per week, but I am a happy customer :) The service is always on point. The manager (her name is slipping my mind) is always incredibly sweet and positive with high energy while the rest of the baristas follow suit. It's nice that they already know what I want and we can chat about our lives. The more personable the experience the better. 

The only reason I didn't give this location 5 stars is because they don't have a doggie leash holder which becomes clutch in nicer weather. And I do prefer to work from their 19th and Spruce location instead because the vibe there is more relaxed. Sorry guys! But I still keep coming back here.

Nice folks- small place- parking street.
Clean restrooms and in very nice area- across from The Chess Club

I once saw a hipster and a soccer mom go at it in the parking lot. Hipster won because 1. Better use of swears and 2. Soccer mom really was going the wrong [redacted] way. Over-caffeinated in a small parking lot - it was inevitable.

You probably wonder what could possibly make the difference between one Starbucks from the next? 

The difference is the employees. The manager, Dave, knows my name and remembers my order as do most of the employees there. The products are consistent with Starbucks, but these employees truly care about the product, which they all realize is not just coffee or espresso. These employees all recognize that the product is the service provided. 

Dave, as a manager, built a team of who are hardworking, happy to be there, and take the time to get things right. Usually, the worst moments at a Starbucks are the confrontations between employee and disgruntled customer whose drink was made wrong. I've seen and heard employees make sure the drink they made was exactly how the customer wanted it. If it was wrong, the drinks were remade with a smile. There have been times where I've felt secondhand frustration from the situations unfolding, but the baristas worked hard and with a smile. 

I've seen these employees cleaning constantly to ensure a positive atmosphere. I've also seen moments where the team as a whole worked so effectively and efficiently that they had a moment to converse and the topics were always lighthearted and filled with laughter, another sign of a cohesive team. The store engages the community as well, with things like a toy drive, clothing drive and other activities. 

This Starbucks is what a Starbucks should strive for; a welcoming environment that ensures your product is exactly how you want it.

This Starbucks is the best one around!  I have been to many but no other location (either in or out of the city/state/country) has better baristas!  Everyone who works here is friendly, helpful and thoughtful.  They remember your name, your order and then also recommend other things they think you might like.  You guys are the BEST!  Keep up the great work!
Not a good location. Kinda dirty the coffee kinda not too hot. friendly help.

I'll start by saying - Yes, I visit this particular Starbucks location almost everyday weekday morning.  However, it's only because of its location on my route to work. 4 out of 5 times my drink comes out the way I ask for it (despite asking for the same thing every morning at the same time, they still only half listen and get it wrong occasionally). But I have to say that I am really disappointed with the customer service here compared to other locations I have visited. When I walk up to order, I don't get a 'good morning' or a 'can I take your order?'.  I just get stared at until I start speaking.  And when I finish speaking, they just walk away without a word.

It's really hard for me to rate a Starbucks.  I feel like if you've seen one, you've seen them all.  They have a very uniform feel.  This location I must mention is one of the larger ones, with amble tables and chairs for those lazy days where you just want to hangout in a coffeehouse.  

What I am a fan of at this location is their staff.  I walked in this morning half in a daze with a million thoughts running through my head.  Just kind of going through the motions without any emotion.  I had a rough night, refer to my Animal Emergency Clinic review.  I just needed something special, like a Chai Latte to pick me up and a chance to get some fresh air outside of the office.  

The barista/cashier who took my order was very nice and despite my half-baked demeanor, she asked me how my day was going and if a sweet treat from their bakery case might help pick my day up.  Which took me by surprise and kinda snapped me out of it and into the actual moment.  I was glad to be brought back into the here and now.  I did take a gander at their selection.  While their pastries looked very good, especially their bite sized petites.  Their English muffin sandwiches did not.  They were just sitting there, fully made and probably cold.

Everyone working behind the counter was very friendly.  I heard many cheerful Hello's, Thank You's and Enjoy Your Day's from the staff in the short time I was there.  

I left with a smile on my face and a hot little Chai Latte in my hand that most definitely picked my day up.

What exactly makes a "great" Starbucks? They're all the same to me; shitty music, hipster and Mac laptops. 4 stars for a really good triple dirty chai, a fresh bagel, lightning fast service, and friendly staff.

It was chilly and I needed a warm beverage for the wifey and I. The baristas here are always polite and efficient. I appreciate that, I want to be in and out quickly. The barista chatted with me while making the drinks and was genuinely nice. I always appreciate that good human interaction that seems to happen quite infrequently now. The drinks were made correctly, tasted perfect, and were done quickly. 

Beware of the tiny lot, it is hard to get in and out of here if it is full.

Indie hangout and gathering place for hundreds of delinquent teens on a Friday or Saturday. The time I went there I was on a bike ride through Bucks county and was clad in bright blue spandex racing kit. I was in queue waiting and the guy in front of me was paying for a few coffees with several methods of payment: IE starbucks card, cash and credit card-just for a $20.00 tab. I was patient and when my turn was up next, the barrista (coffee waitress) looked at me and went to the person in back of me and said: "your usual Fran?" It was like I was invisible..I doubt that, as I was wearing a bright blue uniform. I complained to the manager and didn't even get a free cup of coffee.

The barristas are pretentious and only seem to want to wait on regulars. I intentionally ask for a "small" or a "large" instead of using their terminology of "vente" and "grande." With the cadre of teens on a weekend night, I avoid the place.

It was 7:38 am on a Friday, so of course there was a line. I expected as much. But the baristas were telling everyone that the only size they had was grande, yet when I got to the register, I had the option of getting a tall coffee. (??)

Then I was told the giftcard system was down, and the ONLY reason I went to Starbucks that morning (which is an extremely rare occurrence) was to earn a star bonus. I inquired about if I could still get a star for the transaction, and the cashier told me not to worry about it, just enter the receipt info online.

A bit of searching later that night and NOPE. Had to swipe the giftcard, which I was hiding at the time of the transaction. She could have just swiped the card, I could have still paid by some other means and gotten my stars. Instead I get to feel like this *$'s employee lied to my face.

To add insult to injury, my coffee cup had WAY too much room for cream. I ordered a 12 oz and barely got 9.

Never coming back. There's another location a few blocks away on Olive.
Speedy drive-thru, friendly service, ample seating.  Parking lot can be a bit of a challenge as it's located in a small strip mall with limited parking.
Starbucks is okay coffee. I much prefer going to local coffee shops over chains. I don't mind their white chocolate mocha but a good local coffee will beat Starbucks any day of the week.

I'm writing a review here based off of the people that work here at the Starbucks inside st. Clair square mall! First off there are some very friendly people that work here that actually know me by name because I use to be a regular. Things have changed within the past few years. For the better and for the bad. There use to be an older female manager that was very rude and she seemed very snarky. She then left and an old guy with white hair become the manager or a temp. or something. He's the most disrespectful and rude barista I've ever encountered in Starbucks history! He doesn't care about his employees and doesn't help them out at all. I was once there and there were about 10 people in line and only one girl making drinks. The manager just sitting in the back being mad at the world. I gave this place place a 2 star because there are still friendly, cheerful people working at this location. There's also a new guy that started...beware his attitude is very arrogant.

Starbucks is Starbucks.  We have a love-hate relationship.  They provide me with the coffee I need when I need it, yet their drinks are really streaky.  There are some days when the drinks are absolutely amazing, but there are other days when you can't even taste any vanilla in their vanilla lattes.  It's almost guaranteed that a Cafe Vanilla frappuccino will be made as a Caramel frappuccino, so make sure you check this before you leave!  Their specialty drinks are by far the best (i.e. Pumpkin Spice Lattes and the Eggnog Lattes), but nothing is necessarily bad on the menu.

While the patio here is nice, on busy mornings/afternoons, it can be quite loud as it's right on Sparks Blvd.

However, overall, there's nothing bad about this Starbucks, but there's nothing great either.
Best baristos and baristas out there. Amazing service !!!

Echoing Kaela V's review: fast and friendly service. Nothing special stood out from one Starbucks to another but it was a positive and prompt experience. 

This Starbucks is located in the lower level of the Marriott Downtown which is popularly used for conferences and attached to the convention center via Skywalk. You'll also find the Champions restaurant in the lower level of this Marriott. As noted by Phil, they offer a full menu of pastries, healthy breakfast/lunch options as well as non-coffee beverages like smoothies and tea. If you find yourself biking or walking along the Cultural Trail, this Starbucks is only one block away and also close to the White River State Park (Indiana State Museum, Eiteljorg Museum, NCAA Hall of Champions, etc.).
Basic Starbucks experience. Nothing fancy. Had the regular items. Fairly small seating area. Had an outdoor seating but it was too cold to sit outside today. Friendly service.

I've had better service at any DMV. Posted hours claimed that they open up at 430a but there were two very leisurely employees milling about 'preparing' to open until about 450a. Once they did open (to a crowd of 6 people anxiously awaiting their lattes) the expresso maker was broken.
