Instead of having an ounce of sympathy or customer service the two employees proceeded to shame anyone who inquired as to what the issue was. Horrendously poor exposure for Starbucks.

It's a little tough to find this Starbucks. The address is 333 Canal Street, but you really access the shop from Iberville Street. Save yourself the hassle of having to ask the office security guard for instructions and go in the Iberville entrance.

Baristas are friendly and quick. A much better Starbucks location than the Harrah's store just across the street.
What's not to love about Starbucks!  Love their frappé in the summer months! Great location, plenty is seating inside and out.  Great place to hang with friends and visit.
Nice Big tables to Study or Work. Staff is nice and very helpful. Outside seating area to sit in aswell.
Slowest starbucks drive through I've ever experienced. I will happily drive 3 miles out of my way to go to another Starbucks. I save time and sanity.

This location used to be one of the closest to my home. Now I live on the other side of town and only find myself using this Starbucks when I am headed to or from a haircut down the street.

The baristas are always on their game and the drinks come fast - even when they are busy. They are always quite nice. Never a bad experience.

The parking lot is a tad small and hard to maneuver in but the speed they deliver the drinks makes the short time in the parking lot of minimal consequence.

My home Starbucks. The parking isn't great and the dining area is small but the people are extra friendly. All of the starbucks staples and the bonus is the staff who know me by name and my drink when I walk in the door. One of my favorite spots for a small meet up for coffee.

Make sure you order your coffee drinks non-stop or to-go otherwise they'll send security to ask you to leave or order more from the workers who spend their time talking about their teenage personal lives out loud and cussing non-stop. Either that or they just judge people based off of their appearance. Either way, not the usual Starbucks customer service found elsewhere. Also, they charge for refills regardless of your rewards status. Just go elsewhere!!!!!

I love all the people here, they really make everyone feel like family. I drive out of my way to order from
this Starbucks because of their efficiency and hospitality. Great place to study, mingle and have your favorite cup! 8)
They have the best chicken salad sandwich, and there salted Caramel hot chocolate is great.... Also the mango green tea is delicious

This particular Starbucks is a bit hidden and hard to find if your not familiar with the area. 

Theres a lot of traffic that comes through this plaza, because of the Starbucks. 

This entire plaza is newly built and I'm glad they decided to put in a Starbucks. 

This Starbucks, might just have the friendliest staff I've ever encountered.

I came in yesterday and today and both visits were awesome! The cashiers were super friendly and warm. The baristas made drinks the way I asked and served them up quickly. 

What more can you ask for? I'm thrilled and excited to deal with people who seem to genuinely want to serve their customers. It's great and I'll be making my way back tomorrow! 

Keep up the good work guys!!!

Every time I go here they made my order with sugar and claim that they don't add any. I'm very very sensitive to sugar and ask every time. I've gotten it from other starbucks correctly. Here I always have trouble! The blonde woman is always rude to me also

This Starbucks is one of the best in the whole city. Its right down the street from my job so I may be bias. It's always clean and the line is never unbelievably long. Their staff is always bubbly every morning. I quickly became a regular.
Soooooo incredibly slooooowwwww!!!!! All the time, crowd or not.so so so so so slow. So so soooooooooo s[ooooooopo so so slow

No recognition by staff that a customer is waiting for service! 
Staff member that was still wearing his apron jumped in front of me to get his after shift drink! Rude!
I really wanted that pound of coffee and a smoothie too! Left without it! 
Hey Starbucks! You are in the "Overpriced Coffee Business"! 
Poor service drives customers away! Haven't we had this discussion before?
Ugh!

Love this Starbucks for the following reasons:
 (don't worry Chestnut Hill Coffee Co- I still love you too).
1. Super Cozy
2. Usually enough seating (but seriously girl on the laptop- it's time you hit the road and give me that awesome chair).
3. Clover Machine (for any of you coffee snobs- you must try this.  You will have another fabulous reason to be a coffee snob)
4. Always a dog chillin' outside with the peeps
5. Friendly service
6. Have always had what I wanted (ie what is on their menu- reference my center city Starbuck's review...)
7. Parking out back/on street
8. Great places to walk with your Starbuck's cup up & down Germantown
9. Cool artwork is pretty much always on display

Thing to Work on...

10. Fireplace- duh!  :)

This is a tiny hole in the wall on the casino floor, big downside is only two seats inside the place, there's a very small seating area outside with room for maybe eight or so more people, but you're subject to cigarette smoke while out there since it's near machines. 

Upside -- free WiFi here, unlike the Harrah's location, and they're open much later -- to 1am on Fri/Sat (making them the latest-open one in Reno I believe) and I think 10 or so on Su-Th. Prices are the same as at Harrah's, maybe a 25 cent or so upcharge on the non-casino locations. And the usual casino rules are in place -- no cashing in free drinks, no free refills for Goldmembers. But it's still good in a pinch.
Bought this To-Go coffee cup a few years ago. I have put home brewed Starbucks coffee in it 3 hours before and it's still piping hot. Thanks for saving my life on many a chilly morning.

Standard Starbucks. Good amount of parking. They have a decent amount of outdoor seating and smoking is no longer allowed outside. Seating inside is also good. The staff is very friendly and there is an open mic night every Thursday if you're into that.

This is the classic traditional Starbucks set-up; it's relaxed set up with comfortable chairs, a fireplace and of course, excellent coffee is exactly the business model that the founders had in mind and the on-going success of this coffee spot while the others in town have come and gone (Bucks County Coffee, Coffee and Cream, etc.) speaks to it's perfect location and accessibility.  I see people complaining about the kids who hang out there (there's really nowhere else in Doylestown for kids to go ... lighten up) and the "dimly lit" interior (it's supposed to be like someone's comfortable living space, not a KMART) but all in all this place is great.  I go there frequently.

Great new location only a block or two down from the old one. The parking situation has vastly improved (ie, there are more than two spots to park your car now) and the drive thru feels like an actual drive thru, and not some precarious forest alley gauntlet that may swallow your car whole. Lots of natural light inside and plenty of seating options, including a long table with at least six chairs if you're looking for an informal meeting place or a group study session. 

A star off because it's taken absolutely forever to get my drink whenever I've been here, and for apparently no reason. Even coming in at non-peak hours with no one in front of me in line. Not sure why I need to wait five minutes for a simple iced latte, unless they're milking the cow out back to order. And if they're doing that? Let me know and I'll bump my review up to 5 stars because not even the hipster coffee places in the city are doing that right now.

Last visit here.  This place needs an overhaul starting with the managers and going down the hill.  Cashier more interested in flirting with some guy than getting my pastry.  Asked for Blonde coffee and got something between Blonde and the usual burnt stuff.  Done!
I've had this Starbucks a coupleof times and its okay but my co-workers just got back from their daily trip and said this one raised their prices by a lot.
Good coffee. But customer service can be better. And fix your machines so I can scan my iPhone next time instead of making me read off the numbers... First world problems
Cool employees that work quickly and efficiently. Definitely one of the best Starbuck's I've been to.

I have been in this starbucks hundreds of times and not once have they made the slightest mistake. 

I cheat on them sometimes with other starbucks around town and eventually return back to them because no other starbucks has such a perfect record of service. Your drink and bill are always correct. The seating is comfortable with plenty of outlets for your laptop. 

There is an utlta, petstore, and total wine in the same complex  and a home depot and target across the stress so a trip is here always a productive one.
This is the slowest drive thru of my life .... I know Starbucks are slow but this is horrible.  I was going to give them a 1 but I am being generous

This Starbucks isn't great, but it's not bad at all. 

This location has a fairly large parking lot if you play in the back parking. This store has a few spots where you can eat outside. However, they are almost always taken during the summer. 

This store is not small, but it is laid out awkwardly. It pretty much goes vertically. Anyway this location is almost always packed, but the staff does a great job of avoiding long lines and holdups for drinks. 

The seating arrangements can be difficult as they are usually taken. However, with a little searching you can find some seating accommodations. They also have some very comfortable seats located by their Yuletide style fireplaces. I wonder if it is one of those Amish fireplaces. They also have newspapers for sale as well as the Starbuck's coffee machines. 
Finally, the store has a "Bala Cynwyd Happenings" board. There people post local events going on. 

The staff here is pretty good and keep everything moving. The drinks they make are the usual for Starbucks. However, one staff member seems to have an attitude problem. 

A nice inclusion is that they have Kosher options. 

I have being going to this location for years, I remember that nearly 10 years ago there was a large fire. The whole store burnt down. 
However, this place is back and I will return.

This is an above average Starbucks mostly for its location and its indoor and outdoor seating area. Parking can be tricky around here especially at night and weekends. This is a popular area.

This coffee shop can get crowded but I have never had to wait very long in a line here nor have I waited long for my drinks. 

Enjoying Starbucks outside at this location usually provides some great people watching.

It's 3pm in the afternoon and the young moron working the counter tells me, they have ran out of freshly brewed coffee.   There is seven people working and they are all dimwits!   Just think this must the only Starbucks in the world that doesn't have any freshly brewed coffee in the middle of the day!

Unbelievable !

Big change!  Ok so the place looks great, the new design looks amazing and more functional and the staff seems to be nicer and orders are correct and several times I have stoped for a coffee in the afternoon and they have hot fresh coffee.

Total improvement!

Never had an issue with this at any other Starbucks.

Triple. Grande. Soy. Latte. 2 pumps of chai.

Said this very slowly to the cashier at the register, each item showed up on the screen so I know she heard me and she's charging me for it. She casually leans over to the barista and says, you hear that? Barista nods, cashier just hands unmarked cup over to barista.

I take one taste of this drink, there's no soy, there's no chai, at least they got the triple part right.

But there was no-one else in line, there wasn't a rush. I have no sympathy for laziness, especially when it messes up my morning routine.

I like this Starbucks. It's really convenient and close by. Overall it's located in a strip of other convenient eateries and such. My drinks are always consistent, rarely have had my orders messed up, and my hot coffees are always hot! The drive thru is a nightmare in the morning until about 10, but so is the line inside. The customer service is always awesome. I'm not a morning person whatsoever so delicious coffee and a smile always start my day off great :)

The drinks are always made pretty well and the barristas are fun and friendly. However, the parking is horrendous and this particular Starbucks is ALWAYS busy. I don't think I've ever been in there (day or night) where I have not seen a full parking lot and all the seating inside taken. The line can also be pretty long too. Overall, not a place to sit and enjoy your coffee but rather a get-your-drink-and-leave type of Starbucks.

$5.30 for my small caramel frap.. I need coffee hoping to use my treat receipt Starbucks currently promoted after 2pm special price $2.50, they said nope can't use the receipt plus store own by casino they can make up whatever price they want.... Wat da heck....so expensive
This Starbucks has great customer service and the employees are very friendly and courteous! They are fast and efficient! I really like this location compared to others in the Reno area!

My green tea infusion was good.  But this is the dirtiest Starbucks I've ever been in.  All surfaces look like they hadn't been wiped down for a couple days.  The floor was nasty and had debris everywhere (napkin bits, straw wrappers,  cup stoppers).  I didn't even want to touch anything on the condiment stand.  Definitely NOT going back again.

This Starbucks, is just like any other, except-the staff.  The staff here is excellent.  That is why they get three stars.  The location is small, the seating is mostly for one or two people and there are just one or two places that will accommodate a small group.  The location is not easy to get in and out of.  People driving down Wetmore are evil and never let you out and you are in a parking lot filled with Walmart, Taco Bell and Best buy customers--so it is always busy.  At night this area is slightly sketchy, especially bc of the Wally world customers. It attracts an interesting breed, especially at this location.  Don't get me wrong, I frequent this Walmart, but the peeps are seriously, interesting to say the least.  So beware. Oh and it gets busy in the am, slightly less than River and Stone, but there is no drive through here to speed things up.
Purchased a iced coffee waited 25 minutes, and they didnt even had what i asked for try to give me something else, so i asked for my money back this is on a tuesday at 4pm , really?

I try to avoid coming here as much as possible because it always feels so frantic for no reason. The one in the cherry Hill Mall faces a lot more crazy circumstances in a much more confined space and they still manage to function without making the guests feel just as anxious. I've had my order forgotten, once had an employee ignore me as I waited in line and proceeded to ring up another employee who cut in front of me to purchase her lunch instead, and have experienced ridiculous wait times during slow hours. The upside is that it's all made well and there's two guys that work there who actually have an understanding of good customer service.

Very hard setting. Not comfy at all. Beverages are okay; food passes for refrigerated "food". 
Although I thought that all Starbucks are non-smoking, inside and out, they don't enforce the outside rule in the least. Might as well put ashtrays on the table. Maybe No Smoking signs would be a step in the right direction?

I've noticed I made an unpublished draft about same issue so I'll finish with this.I will say the line if it's at a minimum is sort of speedy. Unfortunately I think if it's just a basic coffee or anything without certain effort is the ideal. I know it is very trying when ordering the matcha green tea. I am very simple, coco milk, light ice.i literally mentioned 4 times Ice green tea latte, light ice and coconut milk. I saw hot cup, mentioned again, I didn't notice any writing but gtl. (Keep in mind my flight has been delayed 3 hrs. )I saw them ring up for gingerbread tea,mentioned what I had. Saw the lady at the register walk to prepare the drink(wash hands nooo). She turned into barista and asked "how you do this"?,"do you add water".my mouth opened to say I want a refund  because I'm not a mean or spiteful person but I've literally sat in the airport with a mechanical and the only thing I was waiting for was this drink. Low and behold one of the other baristas said she'll do it. She started to put milk,I said two more times because when the other mentioned water I said I never had water in it, iced green tea latter coconut milk and light ice. So I told the new barista, coconut milk and light ice please, thank you so much. So she got the coconut milk then I saw the scooper of alllll Ice in this tiny cup. I wish I could've took a photo of how much was left over because it was so much Ice. The drink was so dark you could literally make another with it.  Some can balance and some can't. I didn't say anything. They dropped the drink off and I just snapped a pic of my disgust. 
However I remembered this was an issue before. So my mental note of the Starbucks at c17 is to only ask for water, coffe, purchase a snack or gift. Do not repeat do not order anything that will require some do more. What's so surprising that it was 4 individuals there. Why did the individual at the register attempt to make a drink. Plus I did not see a wash of hands.
It's my neighborhood Starbucks- they know my name, they know my drinks, they have a fireplace and great music.  What else could I possibly want?

Yes, this Starbucks is really busy and parking can be annoying in Chestnut Hill but I love this place. Why, you ask do I love this location of a corporate coffee chain? The Clover Machine! For 50 cents more you can get your drink made on the most amazing coffee invention ever. It's this neat little machine that is like a reverse french press. The drinks are made one by one and the beans ground right before they make it. You also can pick your roast when you go with the Clover. I love it because it's personalized, the staff is really friendly, and Clover makes coffee how it should taste - lovingly handmade. Besides, it's also really fun to watch the little cake of espresso rise from the machine. 

All hail Chestnut Hill Starbucks for having a machine for true coffee nerds!
Favorite neighborhood Starbucks! Even with their rude hair salon neighbors it still keeps serving great coffee.

9people
Bad server
Dirty

So disappointing this location.  I was there a couple nights ago around 9:30pm.  Not too many customers but about 10 employees!  I was in a good mood when I arrived because a few were dancing in the customer area (I thought it was funny).  But, then I had to virtually yell to get someone's attention to take my order.  Plus, later we sat in the customer area & the place was a mess.  One person came by, said hi, barely wiped one table & left the rest of the place a mess.  So so disappointing because this is a great location.  And no it was NOT busy.  I will not be back.

Hey Yelp. When the owner of this business complains that I've left a review for the wrong location, don't email me - let me be very clear. This is the correct location. It's by the aloft hotel, which is 558 Fellowship Road. The OTHER Starbucks location is off of Rt 73.

That I start my review like this should tell you something. This location has attitude, and not in a good way. I spend a week a month in Mount Laurel, and this is the only drive thru Starbucks nearby. So I go here. I try to have patience; it's a busy location, it's a crappy location in the parking lot - like other reviewers have noted, the angle at which you enter the short drive thru line cuts into the exit for the very small parking lot (which forces us into the drive thru line in the first place) - and each morning, there's inevitably someone blaring their horn at some inconsiderate behaviour due to the Starbucks location. In any event. Let's get into the Starbucks location itself.

I come to Starbucks usually twice a day. That's 10 times in a week, one a month, for the last 6 months. I've probably had good service - not great, but good - twice. Seriously. And it's not like my bar for good service is high... You know, I'd LIKE to have a "hello" or even a "hello, how are you today? How many I help you?" or hell, even a "How may I help you today?" and then of course, as you're taking my hard earned dollars out of my hand, a "thank you", or a "thank you, that'll be $7.80". That's what I'd LIKE to hear. But customer service has no typical shred of manners in the US it seems, and mostly, I just expect a somewhat pleasant "what do you want", and "$7.80" when I reach the microphone box or window. This location though, has several times had me calm my inner child and put aside notions of parking my car and walking inside to slap the lady who was so incredibly rude to me, or worse, wait for her to get off of work. Of course, we would never SAY these things out loud or do them (I'd hope none of us would!) - but I've had such crappy service at this location that these thoughts crossed my mind. Seriously. As of December 2015, there are 2 younger girls working the line who are just incredibly out of line. "What do you want? Oh, you want it DOUBLE TOASTED? That'll be a 10 minute wait. Oh it's not right? You must not have told us you wanted it double toasted." WTF? It's at the point where I don't leave the drive thru line anymore until I check my food order or sample my beverage - because it's often just not right. I dunno about you all, but I don't want to pay $5.95 for a double smoked bacon breakfast sandwich that has what appears to be raw, but warm, but raw bacon on it. When I order a non fat latte, give me non fat. This location seems to go out of their way to use WHOLE milk in non fat orders. When I order a gingerbread latte, and Starbucks is running the sticker program through Dec 24, give me the damn sticker. I don't want to have to ask for it, but worse, when I ask, you give me attitude and grief because you have to stop and get it. Seriously? It always leaves me baffled when Starbucks employees are miffed that they didn't get a tip. I'm sorry. I ran a coffee shop. I WORKED for my tips. I gave good SERVICE for my tips. If I had a crappy day, I had crappy tips - and as with most things in life, you reap what you sow. I'm sorry, but I won't tip you for being rude and sometimes disrespectful to me. You don't know me. What makes you think you're entitled to my cash?

And so, my New Years Resolution is probably one you saw coming a mile away. Screw this location. I think the best way to let THIS business know there's a problem is to stop giving them my business, and stop taking their crap. Drive down to the other Starbucks. it's 5 minutes, which you'll gladly trade off in the wait in the parking lot or drive thru line anyhow - there'll be more locals, which is always nice (I love when you walk into a Starbucks and the staff say "Hi Bob! The usual?") and you'll go along your merry way.

Closest one to where I live. I need one closer. Worth the 10-15 minute drive. $5 is a bit steep for a venti frapp. The baristas got my name right, I wanted it wrong. In and out in 5 minutes. Next time I am ordering a doubleshot because I need caffeine.

I want this Starbucks to be great because of its convenient location, but it's only okay! Plenty of outlets, but bring a jacket because it will be chilly.

This is a rather large Starbucks, and definitely one that a lot of people frequent when they're in the Camino Real area shopping. There are several seats, including a long raw wood top table beside the windowed wall that faces Los Agaves. During peak times, there's probably only 2-3 tables open if you need to work. It's normally pretty cold in here, so bring a jacket if you plan on staying for a while.

The cleanliness of this store is always what gets me. It seems very unkempt and dirty, and that has stopped me from working here a time or two. The bathroom is always in bad shape. I'd recommend using the Camino Real public restrooms outside - they are MUCH better!

But Starbucks is still tempting. When I know I can order ahead from the app and skip a line, access an outlet and work all afternoon, have access to real food and not just pastries at a coffee shop, this is a great option. It's in a great spot, making grocery shopping before or after i work a lot easier. Even still, I much prefer other Starbucks locations compared to this one.

Most of my visits here have been positive however I wanted to mention that last time I got a refresher it was not completely filled to the top. I feel like if I am going to pay $4+ for a drink that it should be filled up all the way. I have had this issues at other locations as well. Hopefully this is something that can be fixed :)

The quickest draw in Coffee Land - even at peak hours when all the cowboys and cowgirls need their morning perk. And they do it with a smile and great attitude! This is my favorite Indy drive-thru Starbucks by far!

My favorite SB menu items - the cake pops (any flavor!), the protein box, chai lattes with soy, skinny vanilla latte with soy and the green ice tea with matcha powder sprinkled in it. SB is my refuge from terrible fast food on road trips, so I frequent them often and can guarantee that this is one of the best run shops in the Midwest!

I was in a hurry, I got in line, placed my order. Then waited. The girls served lattes and everything else to the people behind me before even making my drink! She said it was because they're drinks did not require espresso. If I'm not mistaken lattes most certainly do require espresso!! Other Starbucks won't even serve a premade tea before the next drink!! So basically I stood in line for my turn and got cut by five people!!!!
This is the best run starbucks I've ever seen. FAST employees who are also very friendly. Multitasking without seeming frantic. High quality products, clean environment.

This is seriously the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to in my life. I went twice, during a stay at a local hotel, and ended up waiting 20 minutes the first time (after ordering!) and then 32 minutes (timed it) the second time... when I got to the window, I looked around hoping to see someone milking a cow in the corner but was unfortunately disappointed each time :(

The pricing is what you would expect at the airport. Not ever coming to this crappy Starbucks again, because if you have to get hot water you have to purchase something. Never mind the fact that I purchased something from the stinking place this morning.

Avoid at all cost.
Like any other Starbucks, but usually packed with students studying so I can rarely find a seat. Quality is on par, baristas are friendly, and quick service.
Awful service. If i wanted to wait 12 minutes for a burnt beam drip coffee I would walk to the grocery store. Avoid this garbage hole.

I really like the ambiance in this Starbucks, and their drive-thru is quick and efficient. The staff is friendly and funny, which is even more important. 

What more can I say? It's a Starbucks. So far since it opened, It's been running super-well. (I order from here a few times a week.)

The downside: Now that new businesses are opening in the same strip, parking is limited, especially at peak hours.
Went through drive yesterday! Service was perfect! Thank you. Very upbeat and order was perfect.

Starbucks is Starbucks. Love them or hate them. Either way I'm only going to provide my view on the specific location rather than their menu selection because, well let's face it... it's Starbucks. 

The baristas do seen to have a high turnover here. Can't exactly speak to what that means here but, if you're lucky enough to get a senior one, they'll hook you up. One time I forgot to ask for my extra shot in my grande skinny and I told them to hold off on brewing so I could get back in line. He said that was blasphemy and dumped a free one in there for me. 

So the parking lot, yeah... Usually filled to the max (and then some) with SUVs of the luxury brands. One time, I literally saw two Bentleys parked next to two Tesslas in between a few brand new LandRovers.  It's funny that the rich ones always get the spots, eh? My Honda and I parked across the street and defaced Lancaster Ave-road kill-death to get in there.

I also literally saw a fist fight between a BMW business guy and an angry Irish Mercedes guy over that damn parking lot. Thankfully, buff Infinity guy acted like the bouncer and broke it up. NO JOKE. I can't make this stuff up. 

At the end of the day this is an in-and-out (of you ever get it) Starbucks. Not the kind for your laptop or leisure.
The slowest Starbucks. Ever. They're probably still making my coffee. And it was literally an iced coffee. You just add ice.

The worst Starbucks in town!!! Their drive-thru wait time is horrendous. The line didn't move an inch in 5 minutes. I was in the drive for a total of 13 minutes! On avg., the wait time is 10 minutes. The orders are never correct and inconsistent. I ask for lite-ice, I get an iceberg!!! I go at least 4x/week on my way to work, hoping things would change. I even tried going inside, it's even worse! People were waiting for their order, not realizing it was ready because their names were never called or written on the cups. The orders were only labeled with a printout. This location will not be getting another cent from me! This place should be embarassed!!!
Great service even when it's crowded! I use the app and order online and it's always ready within 5 minutes of ordering! Easy to order before I leave my house and ready when I get there.

Wow...definitely surprised this spot doesn't have a better rating.  I affectionately refer to this Starbucks as "MY Starbucks" (a la Braveheart with the crazy Irishman..."What do you mean, 'your island?" - "Yes...Ireland...IT'S MINE."
The one at the Bellevue is closer but the line is forever and my order is always wrong.  The one at 16th and Walnut has the rudest staff ever.  But this one...friendliest crew no matter what...my drink takes a little long?  I don't even say anything and the manager hands me a coupon for a free drink at my next visit.  Can't give it five stars purely for that reason...sometimes you're standing there in an empty store and your iced coffee takes a strangely long amount of time.  And I miss Cafe Hausbrandt :(.

I love Starbucks, and I am an avid customer, but they are soooo sloooww at this location.  The rating is so low, because it's hard to mess up Starbucks, but they do by driving my patience and making me late!  They get two stars instead of one because they are usually pretty nice.  But it drives me nuts because there's always only one person on the register and one person at the bar, even when there's a line.  And there's a third or fourth person wandering around.  I've been to many Starbucks, and others know how to be a lot more efficient than they are at this location.  grr.
Where should I begin? They get 3 stars because Drinks were ok. Service was lackluster and the sandwiches were not good at all. I should have gone to an independent coffee house.
Best Starbucks in Reno. Worst parking lot. Friendly, efficient baristas. Always clean lobby and restrooms. I'm a regular and  love Valerie, Ayla and Cody.
I'd take away a star for the terribly planned parking lot and drive-thru, but it's got plenty of seating and a very friendly staff. Definitely one of the more enjoyable locations around.

I've been coming to this starbucks almost religiously since the start of the year at the same time everyday, 10 o'clock. Everything has been going smoothly until recently. There is a barista with glasses, male, short, dark hair who makes the drinks. He's been filling my grande coffee only halfway for the past 4 times I've been there, today being the absolute lowest amount I have ever had. I do not pay $5 for a grande cup of coffee only to get it half way filled. Idk who he is trying to play but he is so lucky that I was rushing to get to school this morning or he would have had an ear full. 

I will make sure to check every single cup I get from this starbucks to make sure they are giving me my moneys worth in coffee. I will also be speaking to the manager to make sure that all the barista understand what a grande cup of coffee looks like.

Let me start off by saying I'm so bummed that my experience was bad here because I was really excited to have a Starbucks close to where I live. My fiancé and I went to get coffee this morning in the drive through. There was only 3 cars in front of us and we were waiting for 15 minutes! I've never experienced something like this at a Starbucks. We waited a couple minutes longer since there was only 1 car in front of us and decided to leave and get dunkin coffee. At least they were fast and we got our caffeine fix! I know you're a new Starbucks, but come on...step your game up baristas!

Disappointed when I got my vanilla bean frap, I asked for extra Carmel and I didn't get one drop of Carmel. The person in drive thru really needs to listen to the customers order. And they didn't have enough green tea!

April 20, 2013 Saturday - pre-breakfast 9:30 AM
2 adults

Atmosphere - 5 stars
Food - 5 stars
Service - 5 stars

Background - Planning a big breakfast but LabCorp was swamped and we had an appointment in 30 minutes so a quick fix is needed.

Atmosphere - A clean small location and very long. But this made moving around in the place easy.  Lots of tables outside and we sat and drank for a little bit before we had to go.

Food
  The wife and I went with just a cup of frou-frou with a slice of pumpkin bread.  I had a Caramel Macchiato as usual it was really good and what I except from a Starbucks.  The pumpkin bread was so moist.  The unique thing about theirs was the pumpkin seeds baked on the top crust to give it that nice crunch.

Service - Small line inside but gone almost as fast as I got it in.  They had two cashiers working this location and before I knew it I had my drink.
 
Future - I will as I got a lot of gift cards for Christmas still.

Most unpleasant experience at this Starbucks left me feeling upset. After buying a flourless chocolate cookie for my son the barista did not offer to warm it up. It was so hard it was inedible. I asked for a new warmed up Coke and she proceed to charge me for it. I thought it was a standard procedure to have these warned up, at least I always had it that way. 

Consistently I was getting a coffee cup that was filled up only three quarters of the way. Mind you, I never asked for any room for cream. Today I finally sucked it up and asked her to fill it up all the way. I was given the silent treatment. Baristas face said it all. Sorry, if I'm paying 2$ for a coffee I would like a full cup.

I am not a fan or regular at Starbucks.

I love the service at this store.

Walked in for the Spring Happy Hour, but I can't decide what Frappie to get.  I was the only one ordering so the cashier let me take my time to browse the menu.  Made a few suggestions, and informed me that I can order anything from the menu for the promotion.  

After I placed my order, I asked the person who made the drink whether the frappie had coffee (I don't drink coffee after 10 AM as it will keep me up all night).  He immediately saw my disappointment when he said yes.

No worries and no problem.  He stopped what he was doing and started from scratch to make me another drink to my like.  Thank you Thank you Thank you so much for making me afternoon (during this allergy season) so much more enjoyable!  An icy drink with dar chocolate flavor and a smile handing me the cup certainly lightens up my day.

See you tomorrow!
Parking is impossible. Not sure why i even pull into the lot when its backed up on the main road, which is a little dangerous.

I mostly drop by early so i miss out on all the lousy loud mouthed wild kids. :p lol.
It's just a starbucks.  There's nothing that sticks out.  Sometimes the baristas are too busy chatting but it's nothing annoying that holds me up.  They're friendly for the most part.
Love starbucks I have tried almost every drink there also love the cakepops the workers are always friendly and helpful
Love Starbucks! Venti passion tea lemonade with raspberry.....so so good! The baristas here are super nice & know what they're doing.
Great location! Close by to hotels and a huge plus for out of town visitors. Great service, friendly staff.

Great Service and awesome Coffees!!
Love to share our Christmas Spirit!
Nothing better than Creme Brulée Frappuccino!!

So I know I should support local brew over the corporate stuff but I just can't drink one more cup of CC's coffee-flavored water anymore. I work in the French Quarter and this Starbucks location is conveniently located a few blocks away in Canal Place. I don't know if it is because they are schooled in dealing with the hoity toity Saks folks all day but everyone that works here is so professional, swift, and friendly--they make ordering coffee a treat! I hate that they don't have a tip line on their credit/debit card receipts because I often forget to carry cash to tip and feel like an asshole. I definitely recommend this location for your afternoon pick-me-up!

I come here every time I'm in the area with my pups and take advantage of the drive-thru service, however unless you're coming at non-trafficked hours, expect to be waiting in a very awkward line for 15-20 minutes. The drive-thru set up here was not well thought out and causes a huge block to even enter the parking lot. The coffee is always made to perfection and employees always kind and courteous, but the parking lot is not worth the hassle.

Was dying from major lack of sleep and stomach was angry from all the alcohol the night before. So I stumbled upon this Starbucks, and it was really cute inside with photos of Reno in sepia all over the wall. Although the barista forgot my sugar free vanilla, after adding it, it was one of the best made iced coffees I've had in awhile from Starbucks. It was just what I needed to stay awake for more gambling!

I've been going to this particular location for years. The staff is great. They are very friendly. I once forgot my card and the barista let me take my drink and pay later. So nice of him. I haven't been disappointed going here yet!
This is one of the worst Starbucks in the area. They are consistently slow and regularly screw up your order. Avoid.

Update: Stopped in for a cup not too long ago during the evening. Of course staff does rotate so these were not the same chicks as before. The women working that night had children (or at least one of them did) doing a lot of running around the place. Honestly I did not know whose children were whose - between staff and the customers.

Still, this team was much nicer (even if they weren't paying any attention to us - I'd rather be ignored than have to deal with someone's PMS!)

Starbucks in the Cherry Hill mall is very hit or miss. They're either empty or the line is so long it extends out of the entrance to the Macy's it's located in. Due to the stand's small size, there are probably 3-4 employees working at the maximum. But even with 2 on the register and 2 behind the counter it's not enough to accommodate the business of this location. Also, the space where customers wait to order and wait to pick up their order is cramped. It's not uncommon for people to resort to standing outside of the Macy's and try to listen carefully if their name is called, rather than elbowing strangers in the ribcages just to wait for a frappuccino. The drink taste like any other Starbucks. The baked goods are usually fully stacked and the employees are very helpful and nice. I give them props for being able to serve their coffee with a smile given the factors that make this location inefficient. I believe the mall would benefit greatly if they simply opened up a large independent Starbucks store within the mall.

Dear Starbucks,

Damn you for making me shell out 4 bucks a pop for my stupid guilty pleasure. The dreaded Venti Skim Chai Latte. The manliest of the manly drinks.

Having consumed this beverage now for about 5 years at the rate of one a day I can say without a doubt that if I had saved the money I would  be driving a Kia Spectra that I had paid for in cash ( with Navigation too! ). Damn you Starbucks and your delicious liquidy inventions! ( shakes fist )

Seeing as I prefer the car I drive to a korean sub compact , lets move ahead to the actual location in question and give you the dear reader a little run down on the happenings.

Starbucks , 138 Montgomery Ave location. A delightful cast of characters runs this place. Its a Starbucks so everything available at any other Starbucks  is on offer here , no surprise there really. They do have a nice fireplace and comfy chairs around it. The place is always clean which is not always the case at other Starbucks. 5 stars

Side note, ever notice the "Music Download Of The Week" cards? I always laugh when I see these because the initial use for these was to promote unknown artists to people by offering a free download. Fair enough. When I saw Paul McCartney one day as a free download though , I laughed to myself "hey, I've heard of this McCartney guy, I think he is going places! "  Starbucks and the music thing sort of doest work. Evidenced by the copy of Katy Perry's latest magnum opus on sale at the counter there the other day. They could have stuck to their guns and sold some better music. I get angry when I see the CD's being sold sometimes, but thats my issue.

The location is nice , parking is easy and the staff is really pleasant as I stated earlier. I like my daily visit to Starbucks and I usually leave with a smile. So thanks Starbucks. You have a good product and nice employees. Bala Cynywd Location is now on the map at YELP.......yee to the hizz AH!!!!! 

Another side note......maybe a strange one. Have you noticed the water they sell there? Its called ETHOS and apparently when you buy it , some of the money they receive from the sale of the WATER goes towards providing water to people in Africa. Seems like a great idea but it leaves me with the thought. "I just bought water , why don't you just send this bottle of water to Africa instead? " Kind of makes sense! Try to argue with that logic. 

GO STARBUCKS!

This is a great Starbucks --always clean-always organized and a great staff--mainly Kristina who is speedy and makes my drinks perfectly always!  I like that they always have community newspapers available for everyone to read but I don't like the cop who comes in regularly and always take the whole freaking pile of COMMUNITY newspaper and takes them home !!! Hello! The papers are meant to be read there and recycled for others-- not taken with you!  This place is better than the coffee shop up the hill where the staff talks way too loud!
Simply my favourite branch in Chester County. I was a regular customer before the revamp in 2013, but the staff is ever-so friendly.
Barista's are very friendly and knowledgeable about deals and promotions. They also gave great suggestions for new things to try. Very quick service and plenty of room to sit/stand/wait.

After landing in RNO, I had mapped this location as my first stop before heading eastbound on I-80 to Winnemucca.  It's a friendly place.  This is one of those Starbucks that asks your name so they can call it out when your drink is up.  Never give your real name, always make one up like "Godzilla" or something.

No matter if there is 1 person in line or 10, always a long long wait. There are normally 6 employees working but nothing is ever getting done. Today I ordered a iced decaf americano and 6 people behind me got drinks before mine was ready, really? This Starbucks has become my least favorite and I won't be headed back to this location. Tired of the lazy workers.

Everytime I go to cherry hill mall , I always stopped by the Starbucks that's inside of Macy's . Today being the few times I went , I've always seem to have bad experience with the cashier . The cashier always seem to have an attitude problem and always giving me weird looks . They must be racist towards Asian people . I gave it a two stars because the person that were making the coffee is always nice and very polite . Don't ever want to go to this starbuck again .

New Starbucks in indy you say? But a very convent location on the second floor of the JW. Full service with the oven and all the sandwiches for breakfast/lunch. A great staff which handled the crowds every day. And plenty of seating and newspapers to relax and enjoy your morning brew, if you have time.

Lack of  basics including heating (it's cold through out even with several layers on and a down coat; even worse is the doors were swinging open or are left open so any one standing in line or sitting nearby really freezes).  Also several times I received the wrong order so staffing training needs are an issue. The customer counter (napkins, spices, etc) was often not refilled. Staff was very friendly though. We never plan to come here again. More locally owned coffee shops nearby are definitely a better use of time, value and money.

Smallish Starbucks located on a corner street in Old City. It's right down the way from the neighborhood UPS store. They take Starbucks cards here and have the full menu so come get your favorite coffee flavored treats! Quick in and out, but few seating areas here.
I enjoy the 24-hours (drive-thru) and late hours (indoor). Free WiFi... Outside and indoor seating is available.

Conveniently located right off / on the highway.  This Starbucks has drive thru!
Lots of seats inside and usually fast service.
The only downside its that its always packed. Usually parking its so hard to find that you have to wait until someone comes out.
Besides the parking issue I think this is an awesome Starbucks.

Yelp keeps suggesting that I review Starbucks, so here goes...

It's Starbucks...there's nothing that I can say that hasn't been said already.  Except for maybe this:  I despise coffee.   As my Mom used to say, it's an insult to the palate and an abomination to the stomach.    So, much to my surprise, they actually have a pretty decent tea selection.  Not that I'm an expert...I recently had to take up tea drinking after voluntarily giving up Mountain Dew after a 20 year bender.   

Every once in a while, I have a friend who wants to meet at Starbucks and I grit my teeth and acquiesce.  I usually order the plain black tea.  And, to my astonishment, it's pretty freakin' good!  Better than the Lipton that I get out of the Keurig, which isn't half bad either.  The other day, I decided to live on the edge and order the Chai tea, black.  Holy s***...what have I been missing? Luckily the Starbucks Chai tea K-cups are available on Amazon for a reasonable price. 

Back to Starbucks at the Park Place Mall...the employees are super friendly.  I'm literally the last person on the bandwagon, I know, but they really seem to go above and beyond.  So yeah, go there...like you don't already know.

Traveling to see my husband who started a new position locally, I found myself at this Starbucks.  I currently have a special mug that allows for free coffee for the month and upon presenting this mug, the barista at the register offered a new type of brewing called Clover.  I agreed to try it.  She was very informative and helpful.  A true asset.  Then while seated at the bar awaiting my new drink, another Barista, Royce, gave me some interesting insight into Starbucks,blends and home brew.  He was funny and very helpful.  Even during an obviously busy time, he made my visit quite enjoyable.  The icing on the cake, the coffee was amazing!  Well done!

It's a Starbucks so free wifi, friendly service, great location that is easy to find.

Parking is a breeze.

I usually go for the mocha frappucino and ask for whipped cream. And I stubbornly ask for a Medium instead of grande or whatever StarbuckSpeak is for a medium cup. I'M SO CRAZY REBELLIOUS.

My experiences with Starbucks are always short because I choose to order online and pick up. Out of the 3 regular stores I visit, this one could definitely use improvement. Being across from my office, a lot of coworkers prefer to mobile order and pick up before coming into work. However, we are greeted with not-so-friendly baristas and we've had our drinks slammed on the counter after our names are hollered out. This location is always very busy as well so if there is possibly another location near you (82nd/Clearwater or Ruth/Keystone), I would suggest that. The store is very clean and small and occasionally has outdoor seating which is nice but since it's so busy, I wouldn't say it's the best place for a meeting or getting work done.

Nothing like a nice hot Chai Tea on a cold morning when you have a cold !!!

This is a newer store in our area. The inside is nice, service is fine.  Guess what I'm trying to say is, it's a Starbucks... Overpriced drinks we just have to have !!!
Needs more staff but otherwise handles the customer flow very well. Very small store so it gets crowded. Would opt for Dunkin' Donuts if you don't want to deal with the line (I did)

Terrible experience at this location.  They gave away my sandwich to another customer and after informing them that I had not received my sandwich 10 minutes after getting my coffee, they showed no urgency and took another 15 minutes to put my sandwich into the heat....

Great place to take a break.  Not too fond of the outdoor seating since it's right on the corner of the parking lot where cars come and go.  I stop here on my weekly shopping trips because it's convenient for me.  Still can't get use to the coed bathrooms.  The servers are sweet and friendly here

There are some nice baristas here, but I must say overall my experiences have left a lot to be desired. A substantial number of my drive through drinks are made with regular milk, even though I always order nonfat. We're talking maybe 1 in 3 is wrong. And by the time I realize it, I'm out of the drive through window and don't have time to come back around for a remake. Sometimes I've even seen the drink has a different color, been assured it was nonfat, and then realized it wasn't after I left. Again, many baristas are pleasant, but I've switched locations because I hate to keep paying 5.00 for a drink made wrong. By contrast, the Harrison Starbucks has never messed up an order. Never.
Not the Starbucks quality I have become used to. My cup got pushed to the back of the line. At least 10 peoples drinks were made before mine that were behind me in line.

Rudest customer service ever. As a frequent customer of all starbucks, I have never been so insulted. A polite query into asking when they open is retorted with a snappy "we open when we open.". Real classy guy. 

Wow. Just the customer service I expected at 6am.

Super Crowded and busy. 

This location needs to hire more starbucks employees so that they can be more on top of the game. I feel as if the lines were too long and short staffed. 

Cleanliness was a-okay. Could be better. 

Everyone was cranky and employees were making mistakes since there was too many orders and i don't blame them. The lines were incredibly long and people are cranky for waiting.

Minus 1 star for not giving me a paper protector for my cup.
Seriously? You hand me a cup, in the drive thru, over my head, with no "thingy"?

Not sure if it's an Idaho thing to save the environment, but really...  

Drive thru wasn't bad, staff was friendly, drink was as expected and it is around the corner from the gym I go to in the morning. I'll be here more often!

My favorite Starbucks in the tri-state area, Don't know why it took me so long to write this review but here I am. All of the service and staff here are amazing including but not limited too; LJ, Kevin, Kyle & Zac. One of the few Starbucks that actually knows how to make my drink perfect every time (Berry hibiscus with lime instead of water & light ice), I go past other Starbucks and go out of my way just to go to this Starbucks everyday and will continue to keep coming back.

I know...high price.but it's worth it hehe..coffee at a top eatery is far more costly and rarely more savory...and really....what is money...when you get free friendly atmosphere, manager, workers, etc.  Yes it's nice espresso/whatever/or mocha and sometimes a nice healthy snack..or a serious brownie hehe lucious for me, and I go to the outside seating and do art work, and share with surrounding peeps and workers for free...its, cool and refreshing for me...

I love this Starbucks!

At my work, Friday morning starts off with a mandatory Starbucks run for front staff employees and I'm always the one willing to take on this task. Usually, I place 6-8 separate orders using each of my co-workers debit cards or cash. However, last Friday one of the doctors made a generous announcement that he would pay for everyone's Starbucks. A list of 30 something different drinks was made and I was off to Starbucks. I handed the gal at the register the list and told her she'd probably need backup. I'm honestly quite surprised that NONE of the drinks came out wrong, everything was perfect!

The employees are always on top of it with putting stars on each of the drinks I have ordered. That way I'm not standing at the counter forcing myself to memorize which coworker of mine ordered what specific drink. We all know at least one person who gets carried away with their upside down caramel macchiato, extra pump of syrup, nonfat milk with one add shot. Lets face it, it also decreases the odds of me stealing another person's drink.

The service is fast and friendly to say the least... I just wish they had a drive-thru!

Starbucks, across the board, remain a linear establishment. They all adhere to a predetermined set of rules, guidelines, and menu options. This location is no different. Like most of them, it has a young friendly staff who are consistently busy. The menu is the same. The only difference is the locations. This location is more of a large kiosk type setting center mall.

We love this Starbucks and come here every Saturday morning. However the recent renovation has replaced the comfy chairs we loved with tall rickety tables. The only way we'll be able to continue coming here is if we can get a shaded table outside. Too bad--we loved this place. I didn't see any other regulars there yesterday. Fortunately food and service is still good.
Place seems grimy for s Sunday afternoon. Not sure if it's the place or people. Lots of young girls using internet but not buying anything.

I travel for work and hit a bunch of Starbucks all around the Philly area. Sure I have my favorites, but most fall into a "pretty good" service bucket.
This one in Lionville is consistently worse than others in the chain.
They have a lot of regulars. While that in and of itself is not a bad thing, when it detracts from other customers it is.
The last 3 times I've been in this location I have been delayed while the cashier or barista have extended conversations with regular customers.

Would it be hyperbole to say this is the worst Starbucks in America? Dated, sterile interior? Check. Unfriendly employees? Check. Abbreviated operating hours? Check. They couldn't even take a mobile payment or give the points. Come on, Starbucks.

This is not the first time I've been to this Starbucks location. This visit unfortunately has been one of the worst with the employees attention to their customers.
Mobile order was placed via Starbucks app and since the counter was busy at the time I walked in, I didn't notify the employees that I am waiting. 25 minutes past and the counter was cleared of people waiting so I asked the employee if my order is ready.  He said initially that the didn't get the order. I had to point out to him that the mobile order sticker is still at the printer and not being taken care of.  After 32 minutes of waiting I got my order and a "sorry about that".  I asked the manager to be notified that a simple mobile order more than 30 minute and no corrective action was undertaken.  The employee said "sure" and continued washing his cup in sink as if nothing happened.

Every. Single. Time I come here, the people are friendly and don't rush you to order. Grant it, I'm not taking 5 min to order, but sometimes you may want something different. They are always willing to make something for me to see how I like it. I love coming to this location!!!! I do not drink coffee, so they still give me great options!

New Orleans is not the kind of place to go to Starbucks (at least not in the French Quarter).  This Starbucks (inside The Shops at Canal Place) is testament to why.  Three different visits over five days uncovered a disorganized order-handling/drink-distribution process and some spoiled chai.  Spoiled.  As in bad.  As in fermenting.

As a Gold card-carrying Starbucks evangelist, this store left me nonplussed.  The baristas were nice enough, but I suppose it's hard for them to deal with all the personalities that come along with the tourist crowd that I'm sure they almost exclusively see.  I just didn't feel the love.  Ever.

Here's to improvement!

Definitely one of my favorite Starbucks places because it is quite nicer than the others.  It's close by to a lot of other food places like  FroYo, Coffee Cartel, and others.

The staff/service is great, really friendly.  The bathrooms are always clean.  The place is busy at times so it is hard to find seating.  There is outside seating as well but I'm not about to sweat while drinking my drink outside.  But overall, no complaints!

Thank you, Starbucks!

The service at this location is sooo slow. The barista that took my drink order was friendly. Then I had to wait about 15 minutes for my drink.  There were 7 people working and only 1 person on bar. Whoever did deployment for that shift needs to have a rethink. One of the baristas was moving breakfast pastries from one tray to another. She could have assisted on bar, but instead the gal on bar gets a newbie to help her. She has to tell newbie everything from how to read the sticker to how to make a frappucino. Why would you put your newbie on bar during the busiest time of the day? Like every other drive thru location, the focus is on drive thru customers as opposed to walk-ins.

I live nearby so this Starbucks is very convenient to where I live.  Most of the baristas know me by name which is a nice personal touch.  I'm in every morning to get coffee, sometimes a paper, rarely something to eat other than a banana, petite scone or biscotti because I'm watching my diet, lol!  

The pour-overs here, which I often get, think half caff and decaf pour overs, they're great and far superior to 16/Walnut!

Having come here for a long time, I've gotten to know various baristas and I really do miss David, he along with other baristas are often very friendly, which is so nice.  I also miss Josh who left last year!  

John, the manager gave me lots of free boxes when I moved a few blocks and I really appreciated that!  

I bought a few Starbucks gift cards for Christmas gifts which were real hits!  

I'll be back tomorrow morning!  :-)

Bad food and unresponsive customer service. 
I love Starbucks Sous vide egg bites with bacon and grünere. Order them all the time. Usually, they are terrific. But not at this location. 

First time ordering from this Starbucks in Chestnut Hill through mobile app for takeout. Given the wrong item, the low cal egg bites. These Low cal egg bites were thrown  directly into a paper bag, rather than on the usual  paper tray. So the wrong egg bites were now stuck to the inside of the bag. No fork. 

Called and manager told me I can't get a refund to my Starbucks card unless I drive back there. Told to contact corporate. Well, now there are 14 people ahead of me in the queue to chat with customer service. So, I gave up. 
I get that orders can be mixed up. But this was the wrong order, improperly packaged, missing utensil, and lousy customer service. And now they have  my $5 and I still haven't had breakfast. 

Frustrating!

Great morning crew during the week . However they are lacking customer service during the afternoon and weekend.  Today for example I order my regular iced coffee with non fat milk and she hands it to me black. I say it's suppose to have milk in it. .... instead of saying ok let me add milk she argues with me that I never said anything about milk! Mam.... come on just add the dang milk why argue  over it!?
Friendly crew, very helpful and seemed like they were glad I came to see them today.  Place was packed, but hey it's Starbucks in a Sunny Saturday afternoon.
Great service! The iced frappuccino was excellent. 10/10 would recommend this place to a friend.

What is the learning curve lately at Starbucks? I stop by here early a few times a week and its normally a quick hi, order and out the door in under 5 minutes.  Lately there is a new staff that struggles on both taking orders and making them.  First off I ordered a Grande Vanilla Blonde Roast and was super excited....until I have my first sip of plain Pikes Place Roast...blech.  My girlfriend also ordered a fancy frappuchino....and received it without any espresso. Lastly, todays Grande Dark Roast w/ room ended up being a cup that was half empty....or half full depending on how you look at it.
The staff here at this Starbucks are extremely polite no matter how busy they get. I love my hot cafe mocha. I am very particular about it and they get it right every time!

Dude. Can you guys actually do your job. Please. I'd appreciate it. I've been sitting here for over half an hour and still no food. I even went up to the counter and one of the employees just stared at me. If only Jason was here. He does a great job.
Nicest Starbucks I've been to...and probably the only one I've seen a black guy working at. If I actually drank coffee regularly, I'd probably be here every Monday-Thursday I had class.

I went to this Starbucks because I visited YourPie restaurant down the way. I had a buy one get one free coupon from Starbucks for happy hour. It showed up on my payment on my phone and everything, yet they refused to accept it. One of the baristas looked on his phone and saw that there was a happy hour but proceeded to tell me that they couldn't do it. I just find it ridiculous that they checked and saw what I was talking about, but since "happy hours are on Thursday" they couldn't do it. They weren't even polite about it, the girl who rang me up had a slight attitude as soon as I walked in the door and didn't immediately order (I was preparing my offer). Coffee was fine, but I expect better from Starbucks employees

This Starbucks location is always buzzing and lively with a packed house and friendly staff. At no time have I ever gone to this Starbucks and was not satisfied with the atmosphere, staff, or product. So overall, this Starbucks is highly reliable, clean, and friendly.

I'll just start by saying I'm a total Starbucks junkie! I'm completely hooked on the chestnut praline latte and it makes me so sad that it's only a seasonal drink lol. This has to be my favorite Starbucks in town, though. The employees are wonderful! They are always friendly, fast, and definitely care about their customers. They will do anything to accommodate people that is within their means. Example: even when my beloved chestnut praline goes out of season, they'll still make it for me as long as they have the ingredients for it. They were still making it for me months after it ended! If you want great service, you'll definitely get it here. I should also note that their line moves faster than in any other Starbucks I've been to in town. And boy can they make a great drink! The blonde barista makes a mean caramel frappuccino. Always very nice and clean in here too.

Approached the half giggling cashier talking to her coworker and ordered a Iced Carmel Machiato with whipped cream. Recieved a hot Machiato instead. It's 85F outside and a hot drink is the last thing I want.

Spoke to the cashier again and was told Carmel Machiato doesn't come in cold iced form. Regardless of how many times I've ordered a cold version from other Starbucks before, they still denied it.

Didn't feel like arguing, so I accepted the drink. Looked around for a cup sleeve and they don't have any avaliable. Out of stock for the next seven hours until they close. I was offered another cup to double it, but denied it. If they knew that they're out of cup sleeves, they could jave doubled the cup before handing it to me.

I left the store to get into my car. Opened the cup to check out the drink. It was filled 75% of the way up the grande cup. No foam. No whipped cream.

I was the only person in line. The drink was not a mox up.

Staff is very friendly especially Jade... he's my favorite barista! He knows me by name and always prepares my order to perfection.  I've visited all the local SB and hands down this one is the best. Parking can be a challenge during peak times but well worth it. Thank you for the great service SB @ Bryn Mawr

Awesome place! Very spacious with plenty of parking and seating! 

Best part of being at this Starbucks is having a Clover coffee. If you have never tried coffee made by the Clover machine ...you are missing out! You can have it hot or ice.  It's a bit more pricy but completely worth it.  

Friendly staff on board! Clean store and clean bathrooms! I usually don't go through the drive-thru so I can't comment on that...I like to go see how the store is and the merchandises the store has....

If you haven't come inside...you are missing out how pretty it is....
New employee (one specific person) is quite rude.  Not first day encountered same poor attitude.  Sinking rating.  :-(
The crowd is a bit intense for my taste, and good luck finding a seat or outlet. It's best to stop in for coffee and then be on your way.

Fast, Friendly, Drive-thru, New & NITRO COFFEE!

  I was very ecstatic about this new Starbucks popping up close to home. I had high expectations & was not disappointed. This location has an easy in & out access drive-thru & they're one of the few stores in all of Tucson for that damn delicious nitro coffee-For now anyway, until other stores rebuild & make room for the machine. The inside of the store is nice & clean with friendly staff. I really love their patio because it has booth-type seating with electric outlets! Perfect coffee escape for a student & anyone who truly appreciates the Starbucks experience!

My favorite STARBUCKS! Stephen and John (sadly John is no longer here, hopefully corp will see this and bring him back) are my favorite...This is only one of two locations that make my drink perfectly...everyone here is always friendly, welcoming and provides great service..special thanks to Stephen for always remembering me and my order, it's ready before I even open my mouth..Thank you all

We've been on the road for hours. We pull over to get coffee from Starbucks. The sign on the door says they are closing at 5pm due to the weather. It's now 4:40 and they locked the doors and did not allow us entry to use the restroom and told us to go thru the drive thru for coffee. Great customers service Starbucks!!!

The staff here is nice and they're pretty efficient.  The only problem was that they don't have a scanner for my Starbucks iPhone app, so I'd have to read off the number every time.  The line gets pretty long in the mornings, but usually moves pretty quickly.

I don't know why, but I usually have trouble getting my drink made correctly at most Starbucks. I was out with a friend and we decided to stop for coffee here on a whim, and I was slightly worried. But, my drink actually came out perfectly here. The staff were all very friendly, and it wasn't too busy which was nice. If I was ever in the area again, I would definitely consider stopping in here again.

Coffee is usual Starbucks quality and wifi is ok. But I give it 2 stars because it is, by far, THE coldest Starbucks ( or for that matter, any coffee shop) I've ever been too. Don't know why senior management has dropped the ball here since its been like this for years.  Perhaps a marketing ploy...buy more coffee or leave because its too cold to stay! Note: Don't bring a sweater, bring a winter jacket!

This is by far the worst Starbucks in Pinellas. They are always backed up because their staff sucks. There is a notable difference between this Starbucks and every other one I've been to. I rarely get my order correctly, and it always takes forever. Get it fixed Starbucks.

My mobile order today. I ordered at 8:06 and didn't get my items until 8:18. Why? 
Well they ONLY received my cheese danish order and not my drink. So I had to wait they checked and nothing then I had to go back to my car to get the phone to show the receipt and finally I got my drink. 

Mobile orders are supposed to make it easier- we'll not in this case.

Went to this Starbucks location on Friday morning around 730. Both the inside and the drivethru were VERY crowded.  Even though it was very busy I still got my order in a reasonable amount of time. I ordered a London Fog tea latte and it was delicious, as always. The staff were very friendly and attentive, even with it being extremely busy. 

The bad part about this location is the parking lot. It is way too small. The drivethru line wrapped all the way around the building. And they probably only have about 12-14 parking spots, which you couldn't even park in them because the drivethru line was taking up the whole lot. If you're looking for a quick stop on your morning commute to work, this probably isn't the best place to stop during the busy hours.

THE WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE I HAVE EVER GOTTEN IN MY LIFE! The cashier Karla and the barista Rachell gave us so much attitude! Lied to us about only serving hot drinks when 5 minuets later we see people coming out with cold drinks. when we finally got to order they made faces kept complaining that we ordered too many cold drinks as if it isn't their job to make them. so rude the entire time!

Great place to sit or take-it-to-go coffee house in the area.  Staffed friendly and will go out of their way to remember your name and order.  Although it is small compared to some other Starbucks it is always clean and the service is fast and accurate.  Free wifi and they always have soy milk in stock which is important to my wife and me

Stopped on a drive down to LA from Central CA. It was crowded, which was fine. I ordered 2 Matcha tea lattes with no sugar, coconut milk and stevia only. My daughter has blood sugar issues and they took down the wrong name so we waited 20 minutes before they found it. They were both filled with sugary syrup. I had to wait online again to have them remake them. I understand mistakes happen but it seemed like there were only kids running this store. they were nice and polite but it could use some adult supervision. Also, the bathroom was disgustingly dirty. Please clean that up. It is a restaurant not sure how that passes health dept.

This has got to be the slowest moving Starbucks I have ever been to. Yes, it's 8am but the Starbucks I normally go to has me in and out. Don't stop unless you have at LEAST an extra 30 minutes. It took me longer than that to get through the drive through. Inside looked worse.

Each day star rating would change. The core staff is always friendly and quite excellent.   They take care of you. They understand the type of drink you want. 

Place usually clean. Lately a lot of staff change. 

There was for the last few months one to two walls of boxes lining the place. They are all gone. Looking good!  Yay!

Great place to sit or take-it-to-go coffee house in the area.  Staffed is friendly and will go out of their way to remember your name and order.  Although it is small compared to some other Starbucks it is always clean and the service is fast and accurate.  Free wifi and they always have soy milk in stock which is important to my wife and me

My barista JP put too much ice in my drink. 95% ice 5% pinkity drinkity. Was disappointed in the amount of drink and the lack of berries. He also called me Amy (which was not my name on the cup) but he was nice. The other girl gave me a straw when he didn't, thanks hun! Overall it was a good experience. Thanks JP and girl with glasses!

We stopped here tonight 10/29/17 a long drive and detoured our of our way off I-70 to get a hot cup of coffee to keep us awake on our way to St Louis. 

1) terribly slow service, used the drive thru, I was able to run into the restroom and return to our vehicle in the line and my husband had only advanced 1 car length, it wasn't a long line- we were 3rd in line when I left the car. 

2) 3 baristas, only one was making drinks while the other two filled up straws and managed the till.

3) my husband and I ordered hot americanos with half/half, his was cold, literally they topped off the espresso with tap water, mine was scalding hot and tasted like burnt drip coffee having sat all day, my daughter ordered a black iced tea and got sweet tea.

Totally my worst Starbucks experience ever... seemed to be the service managing the store tonight.
This Starbucks has the best ambience and layout of any I've ever been to. Plus they introduced me to the Clover machine that is Starbucks reborn. I wish I had this exact same store in Long Beach

The absolute best Starbucks I've ever been to! I think I enjoy the baristas and the setting even more than the delicious coffees they make. I have many fond memories of this place from studying, enjoying conversations with friends and co-workers. I enjoy their clover micro brew very much!
Starbucks South Meadows gets an A. The staff is friendly. They have a nice drive thru and are open late. Love the chai cream frappuccino. Liquid heaven.

Consistently the best Starbucks I visit...and I'm all over the area. They always remember my name and preferences and despite being busy, I never wait long. Whenever I can, I route myself to this Starbucks for my morning (and sometimes afternoon) jolt.
The dirtiest Starbucks I've seen. Restrooms worse than a gas station restrooms. Going to find another place to get coffee  and hand sanitizer.

The reviews are mediocre, why?

So this location isn't bad. It's convenient and the baristas have always been good, no rudeness, but yet not overly friendly.
Parking is usually available. 
Drive thru doesn't usually take too long.
I went to this location almost daily when I was studying for my Real Estate exam. I'd sit there for a couple of hours.
Oh, and Dennis, a barista who was at the Big Bend location is now at the 301 location. He's awesome, friendly.
My drinks have always been on point except once and they promptly made me a new one.
All in all, its not a bad location.

At times this location is or hit or miss.

The parking is terrible and the angle to pull in and out, especially to go through Drive-Thru is awful. Not well constructed at all. I had my drink made wrong a few times, but I ensure to taste before I leave. They live up to the Starbucks promise and remade my drinks, no questions asked.

This is the only Starbucks around this area so it is bound to get packed from the highways, corporate employees, hotels, etc.

We were in Reno for Hot August Nights. Staff is courteous and pleasant, even during a rush. However, my Ristretto Breve Cappuccino was heavy like a Latte. The barista, Ashley, apologized and made a second drink. She acknowledged that breve is hard to foam. (I know it can be done, it just depends on the experience and skill of the barista.) Unfortunately, it felt just as heavy the second time around. I took it rather than wait for another one to be made. :/

As I've been forced to travel more, Starbucks has become my in-city lay over after I check out of my hotel and before I head to the airport. 

This place is great. It's located in a(n) historic locale (on a cobblestone street(!!). I was all like is this Rosewood/Ravenswood?) The seating is ample and the bathrooms are clean. Not as cool as the concept Starbucks in Amsterdam, but up there with some of the more cozy and quaint Starbucks I have visited.

If you're in a rush don't go here. Yeah it's right by the greyhound station. It wasn't a busy afternoon and my 2 orders of white chocolate (which they made a mistake on) took 17 minutes to be exact, took forever, the two barista was actually having attitude towards each other where the girl was just throwing/dropping things around, I was watching and so tempted to take a video of that occurrence.. Never again will go here..

Cashier was very pleasant.  Smiley and very nice. The barista however was more interested in paying attention to the latest gossip from the three other baristas that were just standing around laughing it up. She set a drink on the counter where myself and 2 others were waiting for their drinks but didn't call a name or say the name of the drink, nor did the cup have any letters on it indicating what drink it was. So I asked if it was the peppermint mocha and she turned to me and quickly said "yeah I think so" (as if I'd interrupted her) and went back to laughing and gossiping. So, I asked another barista if this was the peppermint mocha and she said "I'm not sure, probably." I was completely dumb founded. Not sure I'll be returning to this particular Starbucks.

The folks behind the counter at this Starbucks do the company proud. They are friendly and efficient. If you're getting your order "to go" you'll likely be very happy with this location. 
On the other hand, the decor & layout of this Starbucks is disorganized and looks worn out. The furniture seems randomly strewn about the room and there is little here that would make you want to hang out very long. And isn't that what Starbucks wants us to do? Time for a makeover here.

Worst Starbucks I have ever been to. 
My daughter's coffee was so weak, it had zero coffee taste. 
My husband's decaf was made with instant coffee and hot water. He saw them make it.
This Starbucks is right next to Abercrombie and Old Navy; it is not inside the mall.  There are four couch chairs.  Good luck trying to u-turn out of the parking lot!

Free wifi. Nice seating. Pretty decent baristas. The two black girls had MAJOR attitude but I love my Starbucks so I'll be back. It's definitely wayyyyyy more expensive than my Starbucks at home. I can get a venti iced chai tea latte for 4.23 at home. I got a grande here for 5.81. Crazy!!!

If I could give zero stars I would. They need to go to either the CWE location or Loughborough to see how to run a Starbuck's in the AM rush. They are awful with Customer Service, 9 times out of 10 they glare at you with no greeting and for having sufficient staffing they all stand around an awful lot doing nothing. Not to mention if you order a pastry with your coffee they ALWAYS forget the pastry and you'll wait longer. I refuse to go to this location anymore because you can't help but leave pissed off. Nice way to start the day.
