Have no idea how multibillion dollar company can't keep their shelves stocked properly to service their clients. You sit in line for 10 minutes for them to tell you they don't have something. Not just on one occasion multiple occasions

5 star service. 3 star setting. 

This is my morning hangout for sure.  The staff is wonderful. Friendliest bunch in town. They just did a remodel!  While remodeling I visited more other locations than usual and this crew is fabulous.  Might be the friendliest in town. 

So the remodel....Looks marvelous.   Sleek clean.  However if you liked meeting here with others before or after shopping or just like to meet anyone, this is really not the place now.  It is not a place to meet, snack and chat. (Interesting business model). They now have one community table that sits around 6 people.  All the rest is designed for singles. This place will sit about 14 other people. Mostly singles. I suppose a small group could sit at the bar. 

The remodel does feature many plug ins and USB outlets.

I go here near daily so the fact that I haven't written a review shows I have, admittedly, been slacking.

Service is what I have come to expect from Starbucks located in malls. It's hit and miss and not always quality. Drinks taste different every time. 

For instance? I hated the toasted graham latte based on the version I had at this location. In reality? It wasn't half bad.

This location also has the unfortunate habit of leaving pastries in the plastic bags and just inserting that into the paper bag/sleeve. This wouldn't be a problem, except when they do that you get the unfortunate experience of seeing the production dates on those pastry items. Last time (for me) the production date was from over two months ago... And no I am not joking.

What else? Some baristas are super friendly at this location - such as the girls who wear glasses... They all seem kind. Dom, Chip, and Clark are stars!

Oh and they now carry Bantam bagels (which were featured on Shark Tank) which are bite size bagels that are sort of like filled donut holes, only with bagels and cream cheese.

The problem is now, the same as it's always been, the manager Natalie.  I worked for her for about 7 months back in 2010 and the same thing I hear from customers today is the same thing as it was back then.  Profits above Care.  As long as you could sell bulk coffee to teenagers for only came in at night to steal wi-fi (yes, let the logic wash over you) you were good.  
She's driven numerous good employees from the store, or cut down their hours to bare minimal (A barista frank went from 35 per week to 7)

The parking for this place will never get better because it can't get better, there is no way of expanding the lot, so you have to deal with the privileged parking mommy and daddy's BMW any way they see fit.

Brit is the only reason I'd ever walk back into that place.  One great employee though can't save the sinking ship.
It is great to have a Starbucks in the Silver Legacy.  It is the same as other Starbucks, the real advantage here is the location.
The staff is very sweet. They offered ice water while we sat and was very nice. Really welcoming aura and establishment.

No drive-thru, small location, mediocre staff! They seem less friendly than other stores not because they are snobby, they're just clueless! I guess Starbucks is becoming the job of this decade, as compared to McDonalds of the 80s lol. 
It's not exactly a happy store, not the Starbucks culture!
The staff is great here - fast, pleasant and always in a good mood considering the fast pace in the mornings of caffeine deprived customers

Went there this morning to meet a client - great location in heart of Central West End. Very attentive, quick service. yes its very cramped, but real estate is tight in that area.

#1 Reason I love them today is that I left my briefcase after my meeting. Major problem. I had to Doctor clients files in there with all of their financial information. Almost had a fucking heart attack. Raced back there after and they had it in a locked room waiting for me!!!!!!!!!!! End of business cannot come quicker today! Thank you Starbucks staff for saving me butt.

This is my favorite Starbucks in the Camden county/ Burlington county area. The staff is always friendly and fast, even at 5:30 am. They always get my order right and will even  throw in things like extra butter for my baked goods at no extra cost.

This store has a funny entrance, but it has plenty of room inside and provides quick friendly service.  Other than that - it's a Starbucks.  I've always gotten what I ordered and was greeted by a friendly face.  This was the closest Starbucks to work so I went here often.

Staff was friendly quick and knowledgeable, the place it self was very clean and well taken care of.  They had 5 people working so quick is actually an understatement and the my gf and her sister loved their complicated confusing Starbucks drinks so 5 stars will probably be forced to come here again but all and all great experience.
I work down the street.  In 4 trips, my order has either been incomplete or wrong twice.  Very disappointing service!

Beautiful drink: Green tea latte + espresso shot. 
Thank you for making this! It tastes really. If you like green tea and coffee at the same time. TRY THIS!

This Starbucks is in a good location. The problem is the SLOW service! When you walk in, whether there is 1 person ahead of you in line or 10 people, you can expect it will be 15-20 minutes to grab a simple drink. I don't know if it's poor staffing or something else, but it's insane. I used to go to this Starbucks every day before work, and each time I was late for work. I finally gave up. There always looks like there's 3-4 people working in the morning but it's still so slow, much slower than any other Starbucks. There seems to be a lack of concern for customer's time--no urgency. The staff seems friendly enough to the locals that they know and like...and they ignore the others. The staff usually talks amongst themselves which is frustrating when you're waiting for a drink and employees are babbling away together. It sends and unprofessional vibe. 

Also, they only have one station for cream/sugar and everything is usually empty and messy. And the setup is ridiculous--where people wait for their drinks is also where you try to fix up your drink. It's a madhouse. They need to seriously redesign that aspect. 

Bottom line: for overpriced coffee, try Chestnut Hill Coffeehouse a block further up Germantown. It's quicker and the coffee is better.

3.5 stars. This is my neighborhood Starbucks. I typically grab my coffee to go. It's always busy and staff are always friendly.  I've never had an order messed up at this location, so service is consistent. They have nice big tables, which makes it easy to have a laptop and spread out.
Two of my requirements in life, ULTRA HIGH OCTANE coffee and Free WiFi. Added bonus, very cute barista and close to home!
As of Friday November 18, 2016 they will be closed temporarily for renovations (pics enclosed), you will have to visit other nearby locations.

It's a Starbuck's... nothing good or bad to say.....

It had the usual overpriced and high caloric  drinks... however good they maybe.

Not much to say here.  It's a typical college type place.  Everyone there was young and on their phone .

As is the case with most Starbucks built on pre-existing city lots, it is as if the city officials were so coffee-crazed they tossed out the normal parking and vehicle queueing requirements.  If you park in the lot, your car WILL be dinged or you WILL be trapped due to the poorly designed drive through line.  And for what?  Go inside and there's no place to sit, loud and bad acoustics make conversation impossible, and the pastries they sell are reheated from frozen. On the upside, the baristas are friendly here.

Shift supervisor Hailey just denied me service and was terribly rude about it . After sitting at the drive thru speaker 3-4 minutes I pull around to the window to see why I have not been helped yet . I'm payed no mind again . I drive to the parking lot there's s deliver driver shouting who knows whet as I park and enters the buildings main entrance. I enter shortly after and Hailey shouts I need you to leave we are closed . Since when I respond. We are closed I need you to leave . That's not true you close at 11 . Hailey informs me the have been closing at 10 pm for 3 months now . That also is not true . Hailey over looked I'm a regular here and come through here sometimes twice a day . However Starbucks twice a day regardless . I pass this going to a from my destinations . Nothing much to say but it was rude of her and I have been lied to when I spend loads of revenue with this corporation. Everyone was responsible all 3 stores associates I seen .

I only do drive thru with this location.
Pros: Specialty drinks are usually on point. That is huge.
Cons: Convenient yet horrible location. Its right next to 2-75, next to the off ramp. When pulling in off of Hillsborough, you have to go all the way around the building, next to the car line. Some people do not realize this so they sit at the entrance to the store. Its typically always busy. The line can be long and slow moving. There's almost no parking, and that is why I just do drive thru. If you do park, face Hillsborough otherwise you'll be blocked in by the drive thru line (parking directly in front of the store). You have to make a right out of Starbucks from the drive thru side, u-turn, to get back up to the light on Hillsborough.
But hey, with all these cons, the fact that they can make a drink right makes it worth the stop-so that's why I won't rate this location lower than 4 stars :)

The worst Starbucks I've ever been too. The bathrooms were super dirty and had no toilet paper. Plus it looked like someone had peed all over the floor. The staff couldn't have been bothered by it. Ordered our coffee and had to guess when it was up because they don't call anyone's names. Super slow service and it's hardly busy. Never going back to this one.

The barristas at this location are very friendly and completely focused on making every customer feel welcomed and valued. They work hard to assure that whatever your chosen Starbucks beverage, it is served the way you like it. One of the barristas, I think his name is Allen, is especially charming and works hard to make your experience in this store delightful so that you will return often. There are countless Starbucks, but it is the staff at this one that makes it memorable.

I can always count on this Starbucks being pretty empty and having somewhere to sit, therefore I come here often. I don't feel like the product of Starbucks varies so it's a typical Starbucks! This location is great and right next to some food places to eat or Walmart if you need to do some shopping. The staff at this Starbucks is very friendly,  always cleaning and trying their best to stay on tasks, especially with their drive thru window! Definitely one of my first places to go to if I just need to camp out for awhile.

My friend and I met here for coffee. The cashier was extremely rude. She was cussing as she rung up my friend and snatched my card from me when I was paying. Needless to say, she is always rude. That can't be good for business. Lets also talk about the guy who took my drink order. It seemed to me like he was hard of hearing. I said "Skinny caramel latte" maybe 5 times and he still wrote it wrong on the cup and before I was even telling him additional things for my drink and he gave it to the barista as I was telling him that I wasn't finished. I went over to the barista and told him what I wanted and he was very nice and apologized because he saw what had happened. We couldn't see a manager on duty to tell this to, so I figured a review would do.

So I order an iced green tea latte. The guy making it is slow, and turns around with an iced green tea (clear iced tea drink). I tell him sorry man but I asked for an iced green tea latte. He pours milk, scoops matcha, throws it in and hands it to me unmixed. It would be like ordering a chocolate milk and getting tea. Then having them give attitude because they messed up and handing you milk with a clump of chocolate powder mix.

If you screw something up don't make it worse by throwing a drag and then giving an unfinished product to replace.

I've been coming here for a week now during the Interactions 2012 conference and despite he staff being slammed, they have been incredibly welcoming and courteous while serving up my Grande morning crack with a Reduced-Fat Turkey Bacon Muffin. Seriously, bravo to anyone who has to work in the service industry during any conference, I'm its never easy to keep a smile on your face yet these folks manage to do it.

Be prepared: tiny space which leads to long lines.

Friendly and efficient staff.

There are probably better sit-down coffee places in the French Quarter, but this was near my hotel and wanted coffee to go. Still Starbucks is way better than PJs.

Good industrial vibes and generally well made coffee. Wish they poured more and sometimes gets really backed up. More of a staffing issue. But normally empty so it's expected to be harder to handle rushes .
They need more employees in the morning. It takes me at least 10 minutes to get to a barista because the line is so long.

Whew! These girls have some serious attitude. The only reason I went to this Starbucks is that in order to get the Barista badge on Foursquare, you have to go to five different Starbucks, lol.

Chains have to work really hard on customer service since the product is pretty much exactly the same wherever you go. All of the baristas here are chicks with tudes.

Will definitely not be hanging around here much. I'll go out of my way NOT to go here, probably. Speedway and Country Club is much, much better.

Place had 3 customers in there and it still took 20 minutes to get my drink which was terrible. They had 5 people working but only 2 seemed to be doing anything. Very poorly managed location. This is not the first bad experience I've had at this location...but it will be the last as I will not be returning. There is a Dunkin donuts right down the street.
This is inside the hotel, so it's convenient if you are staying there. The place is mobbed in the morning, but like most Starbucks, they work quickly and always have a smile.

I did not realize that a Starbucks could be bad. The coffee I have had at this one tasted like it was diluted. I thought the first time was a fluke and gave the place a second chance. Bad idea!  Some people (my 93-year old mother, for instance) may like their coffee this way, but this is not what I expect from a Starbucks.

One star is even too much! Not a big Starbucks fan to start, but they do have a few types I like. One is Blonde Roast, which they do not make after 3pm, they will make for you put you have to wait. Service is horrible, not properly trained, supplies (stirrers) not stocked. Line is usually too long, need more staffing. Need better management I would assume

So the staff here are all pretty nice and know what they're doing. This store is just impossible to deal with unless you go early in the morning. I've never had a problem going before 9 am on weekends and earlier on the weekdays (before the crowds basically). The staff is also really friendly and familiar.

If you try to go late morning or afternoon, it can be a miserable wait. I just went and it took 30 actual minutes to prepare my mobile order. If you want quick coffee, I have better luck at the French press. The problem with this store is the quantity of staff rather than the quality considering how busy the store appears.

I've been at the location a few times before. It's a very extremely busy location! Super friendly people and always makes my drinks perfect! One thing I hate about this location is that the parking lot is super small! It's so difficult to find a parking spot and on the side of the building you have to be extra careful with incoming and outgoing cars. It can be a bit dangerous.

By nature most people have a problem with the ubiquity of Starbucks.  I came into this location for one reason.  To purchase a flat white.  I learned about a flat white reading reviews in Singapore, London, and finally St. Louis. This Starbucks is next to my barbershop.  So I walked in and found the place filled with the typical Starbuck crowd drinking coffee and using the INTERNET.  The place was super clean.  I stood in a line of 4 people in front of me.  The line moved fast enough.  I ordered my flat white then walked over and watched them make it.  A flat white is very similar to café au lait with one major difference they use espresso for 50% coffee and steamed and frothed milk for the next 50%.  It is a powerful drink to say the least.  I really like this new coffee.  Of course I did not like the price but it is Starbucks.
Although I am not a big fan of coffee, their hot chocolate & sandwiches are definitely worthwhile. The inside of the business is very well decorated, and a nice, quiet place to get work done.

It's a Starbucks so you pretty much know what you are getting regardless of the particular location.  This location itself is pretty nice if you ask me.  Plenty of room inside and outside for those of you who like to sit and enjoy your beverages.  Reliable Wi-fi like most Starbucks and overall a groovy kind of atmosphere.

By far my favorite Starbucks in the area. Love the vibe of the place and the seats are comfortable to wait in until my order is ready and while checking emails. Doesn't hurt that there's a super cute guy that works there too! Awesome staff all around. Fave!

I am giving this place a review, because I stopped by here to get some work done and had excellent service. Normally I dont rate Starbucks since I go quite often, but this time they deserve it. They were extremely busy and a woman in a camo hat began to berate and tell the barista behind the counter how to do her job. The barista apologized and seemed confused as to what she did wrong, since she did nothing. Instead the woman made a huge scene and said "well I am going to the other starbucks down the street" and complained to another barista about it loudly. So I am making sure to give 5 star reviews on both yelp and google as the lady promised to give them bad reviews, and both my original drink and refill were perfect with smiles and light conversation both times.

I don't normally review chains,  unless I  have an exceptional visit, either good or bad. I have been coming here everyday as it's on my way to work.  
The last couple weeks, it's been downhill.  They want to argue about validity of their own coupons.  Not all, but a few of them.  It's just not worth the hassle. I will just go to the one on Gregg. They are super nice.
Very slow service.  Over priced.  Out of product.  No compromise.  Poor Customer Service - primarily the Manager.  Won't be back.

Great drinks and coffees made to order. Breakfast sandwiches are good too and they are made fresh everyday. Salads and lunch sandwiches are also available anytime during the day. Recommend the lemonade with raspberry it's really good.
I used to love coming here.. Now..?  They are like snails. It takes me like an hour to get through the line and wait for my drink.. So sad

Came in around 4:30PM on a Sunday. Steven took my order and he did very well for a new employee. I ordered a Twix Frapp (since I have a free drink) which is a lot of syrups and stuff in it. 

My drink came in about 3 minutes and it's blended nicely. They forgot the java chips but I didn't mind it.

Just came in for a non-coffee beverage...kinda felt ignored by the 3 staff people here . Ended up with a Lime Refresher. My tip to Starbucks: the "freeze dried" lime wheel garnish looks horrible. 86 it!

Very busy store in the morning.   6 team members very busy serving orders.   Bathroom was out of order which was an inconvenience.  Lot of people waiting for orders.    Batista yelling people's names and orders.   Even using the preorder app..... Had to wait a long time for drink.

Seriously adorable little Starbucks with couches and tables in the back room.  Who would have thought it would be so big from the outside!  It's like...a TARDIS of a Starbucks!  Couches are comfy, staff is friendly, and the bathroom was clean.

It used to be nice to meet friends at a starbucks, sit down enjoy a coffee. Now you can't complain about the prices because all are overpriced however when the service sucks and the place smells like it has a dead body in the back that is a deal breaker.

Best starbucks ever!!! Love the partners and the drinks are of excellent quality! 

Thanks for a great experience!

Well well well... since living in Miami in 2015 and discovering the "Starbucks Homeless Shelter" in downtown Miami and moving back here to the City of "To many brothers in love"; I have found a new "Starbucks Homeless Shelter."  You got to see this one. I count 6 adult men all sleeping comfortably in corners throughout the seating area and one of them is a mumbling, rambling Asian Cross dresser, yes homeless as well. Remember when you use to walk into a Starbucks and say, "wow smell that fresh roast" well, you walk in here and it definitely smells like roast but not coffee. More like "rump roast" or the Men's locker room at the YMCA. CLEAN IT UP STARBUCKS!! stop trying to appease to the masses. Kick these folks out and clean it up!! Prices went up, you know why?? Me either!! 

Now it must be said, the staff are awesome here. Very attentive and helpful.
This Starbucks stands out to me because of the excellent service. The workers are always courteous and quick. I'm thankful I live near this location!

I work for Starbucks currently.. And my store usually always gets the drinks correct unless it's a simple mistake of it being unsweetened or missing a syrup ingredient but won't change the drink and we always fix the drinks on the spot if we made a mistake, even during peak hours we make it a priority. One day I bought a creme frap for my co worker who was pregnant and waiting for me at a restaurant, while I waiting on my order at Starbucks, I SPECIFICALLY ordered a venti creme frap, so NO frap roast that contain caffeine. My co worker is going into her 9th month of pregnancies, and when I received her creme frap which was suppose to be white in color but it was tan brown. I couldn't tell in the dark lighting whether it was a tinted white or a tan which shows there is frap roast in the drink. And I asked them, "are you sure this is a creme frap?" And the two baristas gave each other a look and said "yes" well turns out after 10 mins of walking back to my co worker there was frap roast in it and she asked me not to go back and make a deal out of it but it upsets me because the cup was WRITTEN correctly! But the Barista's F* up! And this is the fourth time they've done this with my orders!! I order about 3 drinks each time I go but one of the few are always wrong! I asked for caramelized honey frap! I get caramel frap! There is a huge taste difference! I understand it gets busy but I TOO am a barista for Starbucks and I work during PEAK hours and I make sure I MAKE the correct drink! They write the order correct but however makes the drink never makes it correctly! And it's not even the same person! Each time I go it's a someone different who makes it but they still screw up my order..... It's just annoying and since I understand they are in a rush I leave it be but when I asked for creme frap! I EXPECT A CREME FRAP! Anything else is okay, but when someone wants a decaf give them a decaf!!

Rude employees. This used to be a great location but now the employees treat customers as nuisances and are terrible. By far the worst customer service of any of the Starbucks in Tucson. Feels like this location belongs in an airport or LA. Sad and a disgrace to the Starbucks brand. Time to tear this location down. DOWN!
Delicious teas, coffees and hot chocolate.  Pastries and sandwiches are good.  I like the oatmeal.  Good location near the mall.

The staff at this location ALWAYS seem to be in a hurry and angry. I have my order ready. I approach the counter and as I am reciting my order, the cashier rolls his eyes at me! This has happened with more than one cashier. Honestly, is it terribly difficult to write down venti sugar free caramel macchiato, skim milk, upside down?! 

Another visit here I had just received a gift card for my birthday via Facebook and was unsure how to redeem it. I asked the cashier who again, looked irritated that I was doing anything but handing over cash. She mumbled something to a colleague about it and the other barista said it could be scanned directly from my iPhone. 

The only reason I come to this location is its proximity to my apartment. Otherwise, I'd prefer to travel the extra mile to the nicer, friendlier location. 

Get your act together Street Road Starbucks.

Oh, Starbucks. Tampa's embarrassing coffee culture means that Starbucks is usually the place that you have to go for coffee. I sincerely miss the quiet coffee shop atmosphere. Now you have to endure your overpriced, burnt coffee in a loud, obnoxious space. I have liked this particular, Sem Heights Starbucks, but it has become unbearable. The parking lot is poorly designed (as many drive-thru Starbucks parking lots are), and it is so loud inside. I like to read at coffee shops, but it's impossible to do here.

Seriously the best service I've ever had at Starbucks. They made my drink incorrectly by mistake, then corrected it (larger size) and gave me a free drink for the future. 

Thanks for a great morning! :)
Omg! This is the worst Starbucks ever. All of the employees at the rudest people ever! They give so much attitude and always the longest line never go here walk to the Eldorado. So much better.
Fast, friendly service. Decent number of tables and power outlets. No complaints here.
The AM crew here is friendly, efficient, and quick! They are able to move a full line of folks through in a short amount of time!
Standard Starbucks like everyone says. The wifi, however, is atrocious. Had to backtrack to Aloft where I was staying just to check email.

This Starbucks is located in the same building as the Hilton Clearwater Beach - but it is outside of the hotel. It has it's own entrance from Mandalay Avenue. There is also a back door which leads you to the hotel.

I was thrilled to find this Starbucks - when I visited Clearwater Beach a year ago and stayed at the Hilton Clearwater Beach - there was no dedicated coffee shop in Clearwater Beach - the hotel had a "coffee station" at the end of the lobby bar in the Hilton Clearwater Beach (called Coaster's Lounge).

I ordered an iced coffee several times while staying at the hotel (with room for cream). I really wanted a cold brew - but they were out and apparently, the equipment they used to make the cold brew was broken - and they were awaiting replacement equipment. I asked when this was going to occur - they could not state when this was going to occur.

There is a good bit of seating here - some inside, and quite a bit out front.

#Starbucks

Completely disgusted. This was a terrible experience. Yes, all paid to the extreme lack of customer service. Seriously, if you know me, that's all I need. He literally couldn't take an order as simple as a strawberries and cream frappuchino and 2 cake pops. Then, we get to the window, no speaking and a VERY DIRTY APRON. He was a black man working the drive thru. 

- That is all. ‍

So I'm slightly concerned about my health after my visit today. As I walked up to the register I noticed a display container of string cheese sticks sitting there by the register. Picked one up and it was completely room temperature. I asked the Starbucks partner if these needed to be refrigerated to which she blankly stared at me, then realized yes yes dairy does need to be refrigerated. She said her associate (the little redheaded man standing nearby) apparently had forgotten to put them in the cooler. She then proceeded to place the box of cheese sticks in the cooler even though they had clearly been sitting out for at least an hour. It's been a while since I've done SafeServe, but pretty sure that was a violation of food safety....who knows what else isn't being kept at the proper temperature. I'll know if I get food sick tonight who to blame it on.

Had a nice time here. Came here on a Saturday morning to do some work on my laptop. The staff were nice. They were busy so it was a little loud in there but they did get my order in a timely manner. 

I was not too thrilled about the seating arrangement. It felt like you didn't really have your own spot but was not a big deal. Typical Starbucks.

3.5 stars for opening at 5:30 AM.

I won't bore you with the mundane details that everyone already knows about Starbucks.  This very small store is located on the South side of Canal Place and can be accessed via Iberville Street as well as through the 1st floor of the mall.  Most people get their coffee and pastries to go at this location as there are only 4 stools and a counter if you want to sit inside.  However, there are 5 tables outside on Iberville street if you are a sidewalk cafe kind of person.

What I like about this location is that they open at 5:30 AM, which is perfect for me, as my job often has me downtown at this ridiculously early hour.  They also stay open until 7:30 PM which is also a plus for those of us stuck at work past normal business hours.

The staff is very friendly and there doesn't seem to be much employee turnover, as I recognize some familiar faces when I go there.  However, be prepared for a line that sometimes spills outside onto Iberville Street during the morning rush hour.

This is the closest Starbucks to my house, I go every morning almost. There is one girl there that has messed my drink up three times in a row now, whenever anyone else makes it its PERFECT. When I went in to get it changed the first time she was super rude about it, so another barista fixed it and gave me an on the house card for my next drink. Since then my drink has been wrong AGAIN 2 times, and anytime she sees me she gives me the dirtiest look. I am not sure how to handle this. But here is a review. Service is quick, friendly, other than this situation.

These five stars are for the excellent staff that has been brought into this new Starbuck's location.  

Starbucks, as a whole generally earns an average of 3 stars, since oftentimes the staff is not as "into" their jobs, as baristas of olden-days... LOL

Their brand quality is very good, and has remained consistent over the years, with the exception of:  blonde coffee (fail) and the flat white (what?, are you kidding? You call that coffee?)

Have I written enough words, yet, Yelp?

So, this review will be in the perspective of somebody else. There was this elderly man clearly with a vocal problem. So the customer pointed to the point that he wanted. But the barista insisted in him telling her what "the sign says". He was clearly pointing at the item he wanted. He did eventually get the lemon pastry he had asked for.  But this was extremely rude.

Just OK as starbucks go.
Decent service - but I have yet to make a connection with a specific barrista.

Bathrooms are locked (you need to ask for a key) and filthy nonetheless.

Good location.

My ice green tea was a bit watered down compared to my usual Starbucks (both in Voorhees). The baristas were friendly though. The space is smaller and had less places to sit and study/work than other Starbucks as well. Can't complain too much though.

Average Starbucks. I have been through the drive thru and inside many times.  Parking lot is always full and sometimes I have to park in the neighboring hotels lot. The employees are friendly, however there are always new people here.
Accuracy of the orders are sacrificed because they are always training new people. I am pretty leinient on my scoring because of that. 
I am not reviewing Starbucks products on this review because i have done so in others. Their products taste the same as every other one around.
Fast friendly service, great drinks and prices right. Good is alright since they changed suppliers. Blueberry scones need more blueberries.
Always cheery and fast. I've never had a wrong order, it's a great way to start the day!

I dread going to this Starbucks.  I wish I could say the reason was inconsistency but they are consistently terrible.   I am not sure about their brewed coffee but their Latte's are bad.  Don't waste your money going to this location.
When my order is actually correct, it's great. 3/5 times it is right. Staff is friendly just not very attentive to orders.

One of the noisiest, busiest, yet -- most fun and interesting Starbucks EVER created.  It's a biggie, too.

It's quite large inside, large outside with seating, and a large behind-the-counter area for the staff.  The Barista and staff have to yell orders and jokes back and forth to the cashiers (and it's constant!).  The busier it is, the louder it gets.  All of it adds to the noise-level, and it significantly increases in volume.  The savior to all of this?  The service is outstanding!

As a customer, all of the above is a two-edged sword: making it fun but a little difficult to concentrate.  On the other hand, if you like distractions...it's a good choice: student body left, and student body right.  UCSB is close-by.

My one beef?  The floor is huge, and it has some seating but could have more.
Slow. These people are very laid back and slow. Also I noticed the place needs a cleaning. All they do is make coffee. What's so hard about that. Slow. SNAP to it people.

First thing let me point out that the ones on the turnpike do not open till 6am. So when I have to go on set early. I take 5 minutes to drive out of my way to stop here first thing. They are open 24 hours a day. Nice to know they are there when I need my starbucks fix.

They have a few tables outside so it is a great place for me to hang out with one of my dogs or one that is in for boarding school. Busy place so great for training purposes.  

I go through the drive through at the SB in Delran a lot and they have outdoor seating too. Just not as good of set up as this one. So when it is nice out I drive a little farther to go to this one.
Nice Starbucks, but I got bit by mosquitoes when I was there, like 6 bites. I don't know if it was the weather or something, but the coffee was nice, they have comfy chairs too. Nice.

I like the atmosphere of this Starbucks better than the other locations in Bucks County, 

It is located in a historic building right at the corner of main street and it is open and spacious inside.  I like old buildings. 

The drinks and service is consistent with all the other Starbucks I have visited.
Staff was rude and I felt like i was bothering them for my coffee...my coffee was yummy...and it's super busy so i don't know if I'll b back
Stupid.... How come you ask for coffee and they forgot to put coffee.... And they just laugh in your face.... Never come back....

This is a review for the Charbucks next to the Wyndham Garden Inn on Route 100 in Exton,

This Starbucks is walk-able from there and literally saved me throughout the weekend of a conference where I was forced to stay at the Wymdham.  I came here for breakfast - got some decent coffee and a breakfast sandwich which beat the heck out of the pre-packaged "Grab & Go" garbage that the hotel was offering.

I alsostopped in around 3 PM during a break in the conference and got a much-needed Macchiatto (sp??).  Thank you, FOURBucks.
Starbucks are generally great, this one is no different. Consistent great service and good Chai Lattes!  Their bacon gouda is the bomb also.

They always do my drink at the perfection point! Thank You!!
Perfect Smores
Awesome Lattes
Delicious Frappuccinos 
It Cant be Casuality!

Dear Park Place Starbucks, you guys rock! This is my typical Starbucks when I'm going to work or lunch. They always are quick on mobile orders and I know are typically busy with the mall traffic. Today I was getting an error message on my app. I walked up and their power was out! Apparently this happened to a portion of the mall and they were effected. However even though it was probably not the most ideal for the store and the customers, they made it work for the customers that were there with me for the time being. I appreciate that they still pushed to deliver to what they could, and made me realized that this is truly my favorite location. You guys are great and I hope to see you guys again soon!

If slowness was a virtue these guys would be kings..... Show up on Monday but be thinking about what you'll want on Tuesday because that's how long it will take to get your order. And when you do get your tasteless incorrect beverage you will wish you had gone elsewhere. If you do find yourself trapped at this hellhole try the drive through.... Seems they process 6 car orders per one counter order.... And no that doesn't mean they as quick at the drive through, they just aren't terminal like the counter is..... Avoid avoid avoid!

I'm not usually a Starbucks fan at all but, after hoofing it around the Quarter for French Quarter Fest, I decided to stop in here for an iced coffee to get my energy up. It worked like a charm and I went from dozing to having a pep in my step in no time.

The set up of this store is nice enough and they woman who made my coffee for me was good at her job, in the sense that she didn't mess up my order. Other than that, yeah it's a Starbucks.

Starbucks needs to re think their strategy with license stores. This one is owned by the hotel. They do not half to keep the same standards as real starbucks. I work at one and they don't offer employee discounts and they don't have a scanner to use the card on your phone. What is a simple transaction on corporate owned pos systems becomes a line creating disaster
Did I mention the employees are rude? Stay away from any "starbucks" in hotels, hospitals, targets, ect
Starbucks is a chain sure but the coffee always tastes good. The barista spells my name right on my cup every time I come in.

Every single time I order a blond pour over these people look at like I'm retarded because I prefer it actually poured over instead of on tap. I don't want my coffee on tap, I want it freshly poured over. If your going to make faces every time I order it then don't offer it. I can easily go to another coffee shop that I'm sure would have no problems serving me what I want with a smile. Get it together and hire people that are happy to do there jobs!

This Starbucks is my 2nd least favorite (the least is on Hillsborough at I-275) because it's smaller than most and it's located in a small plaza at a very busy intersection. Most times I'm driving west on East Bay so I'd have to do a U-turn at the lights, then squeeze into one of the tight parking spaces, or drive through the small and narrow parking area to get to the back for the Drive Thru.

Inside is smaller than most, too. There are a few tables and seats, but I don't recall a community table. I believe there's just 1 restroom for male and female and the door is right across from the registers. I generally don't like to sit near the restrooms and would like to see it out of sight.

There's a small patio area in front that I rarely sit in because 1) it's next to the drive thru so there's always cars driving by, 2) the busy intersection of East Bay and Starkey isn't much to look at and 3) most times it's too hot and humid in Florida!

Most times the baristas were just okay, not super friendly or talkative. One time I asked for no ice with my iced drink but I was given ice, but most times my drinks were made perfectly.

I really only stop by this Starbucks because it's convenient; definitely not one where I'd want to hang out, simply because the parking is just too small. Sorry.
My local joint.  Great group and very happy to help and usually have my drink started before I actually order it.

We wanted an after dinner cup of Joe. Starbucks was the closest coffee shop around. We did not realize they were closing within 9 minutes! Did they have an attitude because they were cleaning up? No! They provided great customer service. They have a new fan. I'll be going there when I visit Clearwater next month. Give them a change, you'll be satisfied.
Great Starbucks location-Christine was very helpful and courteous..Great friendly staff and awesome drinks and food

Love this Starbucks! One of my fave locations... Partially cause I can walk there from my house.. Lol. 
Staff is super friendly and always happy to accomadate any request. Love sitting out on the patio in the cooler air and watch traffic or chill inside on the couch with friends. 
Cake pops are my new fave thing! 
Def worth you checking them out!

If you're looking to get work done, do NOT come to this Starbucks. For a solid half hour they were playing extremely loud rock music (complete with a lot of yelling) that was blaring throughout the store. The music was quiet at first, and at a bearable level, and then one of the employees it turned it to the highest possible volume. I looked around at the other patrons there and everyone seemed equally as annoyed. This is probably the 3rd time the high volume of the music has made me left this store. I will not be coming back.
What are you going to expect from Starbucks? Their coffee is overpriced shit. You may as well go to Wawa or Dunkin donuts to get better coffee

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. The service is horrific and they can't even  make a basic frap. The employees are rude and impatient and it's obvious they don't like their jobs. 
Marriott and Starbucks should be embarrassed to have their brands associated with this location. 
It would be worth your while to walk to the location on Olive. This store is a waste of lobby space in an otherwise decent hotel.

Though I'm not usually a fan of the corporate coffee, I will give this place props for being one of the more cozier places to study at with a group of uni classmates on a weeknight.  They've got a lot of table space that's prime for a few hours of nose-to-the-book cramming, plus they keep this place amazingly clean.  The vibe is down-to-earth enough that you won't have to worry about gossipy Main Line socialites complaining about their latest Brazilian blowout fiasco.

Parking in the lot can be a pain, but be sure to check behind the building and on the street if it looks too full.

This starbucks is very good. No real complaints but not outstanding service. The place always has people sitting in every chair. Dont plan on staying and enjoying your cup of Joe. They have no drive thru. Kind of spoiled with my home base starbucks in bordentown. The one guy that works here looks like the actor jason sudakis

The Starbucks at Camino is like a home to me. I worked at the theater next door during high school and it was always a go to spot. It's always packed during study hours because of UCSB students. However, the baristas were always quick to make your drink. The iced caramel macchiato is the perfect balance for a drink that's refreshing but also gives you energy for the day (shot of espresso). Starbucks may not have the highest quality coffee, but it's always consistent!

Each time I come in the staff is friendly and nice.
The store is very clean.
I like the new lay out of the store.

We stopped here this morning at the drive through and the woman behind the counter was rude, and made the drink wrong. A Tall drip coffee with coconut milk. She skipped the milk. First time I've had a bad experience at Starbucks.

It would be amazing if this location was actually operating at 4:30am like advertised. I don't know how many mornings I sit at the menu to end up driving through without coffee, and to see everyone inside not working.

I love coming to study here. The drawback is that a lot of the time it is packed with Wash U students so it's hard to find a spot to sit. The greenhouse is super quaint and I love sitting in there on a winter day right next to the heater. Drinks are good, bathrooms are clean. Parking is rough in this area but you just have to put your walking shoes on. Fun people watching place
9:30 am Monday. Both condiment counters and the floor were a mess. Floor doesn't look like it's been cleaned since yesterday.  Expect more from Starbucks. Mentioned to one employee

I don't usually write reviews but this is the second weekend in a row that I have had Crappy service by Erica. I was hoping she was having a bad day last week. Guess not!

I work in the restaurant industry and if my employees had the customer service this girl does then they wouldn't be working for me! I ordered two drinks, both grande. Mine was made as a tall and was one of the worst mochas I have ever had. I asked if they had any sandwiches left and she said "I don't think so!" Ok. I guess she couldn't be bothered to look. Awful service! What happened.
This is one of the busiest Starbucks in the area. Great people, great service. Ihope the staff is being compensated, because they earn their money!

Love this Starbucks and my gold card. The free birthday, syrups, soy and drink rewards save a lot of $ in my wallet :) This drive through is fast and easy to enter and exit at the light in the morning. Only one I stop at for drive thru from Carmel to downtown.
Standard Starbucks, like McDonalds, you can expect consistent food and drink at reasonable prices. Often jammed with commuters but that is to be expected with the chain.
The people that work here need to learn how to make drinks. I've been there 3 times in one week and 2 out of the 3 times my drink has been made wrong. I feel ripped off! And I'm not going back.

Hey yall I work here just a public notice; most of you know we have a difficult parking situation to say the least, but apparently a neighbor complained about the volume of cars on the backroad so Tampa PD has begun ticketing
This is what you expect from a cafe!  The most energetic staff I've seen at a Starbucks, and they're fast with an order.

Now OPEN inside Silver Legacy on the casino floor. This Starbucks takes payment through your app phone or Gift card. It doesn't take any internet offers. 

They offer the same drinks and pastries like the other Starbucks. The design is very nice with a stained glass dome.

Seating is available in front of the restaurant but still indoors. 

Plus side is they are open late since it's located inside the casino. Downside they get backed up and have limited baristas since the space is quite small. This is good for to-go orders and go back to your slot machines, rather then hang around and drink/chat.

Plenty places to sit inside and outside well depends on what time you visit this Starbucks it's in a prime location for traffic being next to Panera Bread company and some other places that has heavy traffic. When I am around this area frequently I always stop in and pick up a nice White Chocolate Mocha hot with whip creme which is delicious.  

Always make sure before you leave to taste your coffee just in case it doesn't taste right they will fix it for you if you just let them know if they don't they will never know it taste bad or nasty.  Trust me, I know what I am talking about I been around the states visiting different Starbucks and yes at times the Starbucks Bartistas make the drinks some what strong but they will fix it for you which is nice.
There is a reason this is one of the two locations in Philly with a CLOVER press. Nice atmosphere even when it is busy. Feels like a neighborhood hangout.

I think this is the best Starbucks in the Santa Barbara/Goleta area.

It certainly has the best atmosphere. Feels more like the Seattle area ones with some care put into the interior.  Warm and inviting. 
Interesting wall art and a good vibe. 
A lot of seating options. Large area outside. 
Consistently pleasant service. 
Very comfortable, handsome Starbucks.
Open late too, which is much more urban feeling.  Great!

A lot of students study here so it can really fill up.

The child making my drink is a smartass. He's lucky I didn't pop the top off my coffee and throw it in his face. Entitled little douche bag. I will not be coming back to this location. I'M GOING TO COFFEE BEAN!
Delicious drinks and friendly barristas! Love the new Creme Brulee Frappuccino. It is delicioso!!

One of the most dirty bathrooms anywhere. I will spare the picture of the toilet  as was way to dirty to use and the covers were of course empty 

Service was blah and the back area were the drinks were being served were also not very tidy.

I love and work for Starbucks. I ordered a Starbucks double-shot on ice with soy and White mocha and the barista was ok. She didn't have an apron on which should be standard but she also put way too much ice in my drink and then put the wrong milk in. She fixed it but still too much ice. Maybe it was just a bad day but I still love this location!

I've been visiting Starbucks recently because it's closest to my work. So when I need a quick fix, I know I can run to Starbucks and back. And I have to say: they've really improved their iced coffee blend. It's not nearly as bitter as it used to be, to where now I can drink it without adding milk. It used to taste much more like an iced Americano - dark and bitter - but now it's significantly lighter, with a smoother flavor to it. So I will continue to go back to Starbucks when need be.

Now, I do have one complaint - or more of a general warning. If you've never been to this location - or any of the other businesses in this strip - the parking can be horrendously competitive during peak hours. It can quickly devolve into chaos, where people park anywhere just to get a "spot." So if you are going to this location, keep that in mind. It's better to go during irregular times than face the battle that is that parking lot.

Yup, this is a Starbucks. Milk is heated with steam wand, but never actually steamed. Steamed milk has a whole extra demension of creaminess and airy-ness (is that a word?), that you just don't get (ever) at Starbucks. Yes, steaming milk makes horrible noises and requires your active attention (none of this put the wand in, place the pitcher on the drain and walk away bull), but the end result is worth it. I think most plebes put so much sugar in their drinks they wouldn't know good coffee from cigarette ash water, but if you just want some overly sugary caffeinated beverage with burnt tasting espresso and flat milk, you've come to the right place!

Love this place. It's clean, bright, and newly renovated. Baristas are friendly and experienced. If you don't know about SB rewards already, you should get it because free unlimited refills of coffee, iced coffee, hot tea, iced tea, or shaken iced tea lemonades with any drink purchase (can be anything, even a frapp). I literally tried every single tea flavor for free...oops.

My favorite drinks are their green tea frapp, peach green tea lemonade, and the loose leaf green tea (I'm kinda crazy for green tea)!
Service was great and my drink is delicious. I order a Java Chip. Probably the best one I've had. The man with the beard working the drive-thru was very friendly. Overall great experience.

I have never been to this location before. But with a toddler who really wanted a cake pop we had to stop in! I got a soy Carmel frap. It was amazing! We walked out with the last pink cake pop. The people were friendly, but did that over explaining thing, it's super annoying! 
I was really not happy that this is the only location I have found that doesn't have a phone scanner for the app. I loaded my app in the parking lot, I'm 28 out of 30 stars, I was really excited to see what was at the next level! But sadly I had to pay using my debit card and am left wondering. But hey I don't wonder why they don't have a scanner... It's because they have old Kmart computers... About that over explaining thing... I'm in an Albertson's at a Starbucks kiosk and your telling me about Kmart computers?!
1. I don't care 
2. This was never a Kmart, how is that remotely relevant?
3. Kmart went (mostly) under long before there was a Starbucks in that Albertson's.
4. No I don't have the physical gift card that's on my app... That would be redundant as to why I use the app...
Good inconvenient coffee.

This starbucks gets the job done bc its right here on the way to work...however...get here early or brave this stupid ass tight parking lot. The parking lot is what keeps me away from this starbucks. Otherwise the baristas are normal and don't mess up any of my drinks.
No complaints. Visited this location while on a trip and was pleased. Keep it up guys.

Great customer service attentive polite!!! 

Worst parking lot EVER!! Drive-thru blocks parking every second on he morning! 

Why does corporate choose these smaller locations not smart! 

They have tone thinking cash cow

Ordered a kids hot chocolate for my daughter and a coffee for myself - terrible idea!!! A kids hot chocolate is not supposed to be the same temperature as a coffee. Have a little consideration for the young ones, no matter how terrible your morning might be. Never again!!

I have only been to this Starbucks location once or twice when I happened to be in the shopping center.  It's your typical Starbucks, except I don't love the set up.  When you walk in the door there is a table right in front of you, and it seems that the entrance area could get very crowded and confusing during busy time.  While I didn't sit down with my drink, I noticed the few tables around, none appearing to be particularly comfortable or private.  Also, the area where the barista will hand you your finished drink is kind of in the middle of the store, leaving you to stand awkwardly in someone's way.

Regardless, it's Starbucks, and I won't hesitate to go to this location if I'm in the area.

Revision due to recent experiences!

This Starbucks has a lot to offer- it's a Clover store, the seating is so plentiful that's it shocking and it's quite clean. Loads of additional parking in the back!

Today my Starbucks app wasn't loading my reward properly. Instead of writing me off for not having a freebie (which seems to be common), my barista was so professional. She scanned it a few times until it finally worked! Even though the clover machine produces a rather consistent product, this one was top notch...a sign of a great brewer.

While cleaning the store, the associate was more than accommodating and didn't ask customers to move or get out of her way. In fact, she actually apologized for cleaning. I felt bad about that since she was so nice. 

A great experience.

I went here today and got an iced Americano.  It was delicious and the staff was friendly.  But I just don't think Starbucks is worth the high prices.  It really adds up.  I'm gonna figure out how to make espresso at home, save some money.

Worst customer service EVER in a Starbucks. Dark haired female employee working today around 4pm should not be dealing with customers, she was rude and disrespectful over us picking up the wrong drink. It's a freaking drink lady...
Gave me my coffee for free because the wait was long....FYI... Not long at all! I was in and out! woot! woot!

I love getting hot chocolate here then sitting down and doing some work I own my own business n I don't really have an office I'm also not the type of person that can workout at home so I find myself here a good amount  doing work. The hot chocolate is always good great start before I do my work
Very friendly staff and they don't mess up your order! I highly recommend this starbucks over the other ones!

An okay, typical Starbucks location, except for that its prime location is perfect for catching cranky anti-shoppers (like me) leaving the Fashion Mall.  I always find myself wanting to get the hell out of the mall as soon as possible, but get drawn into this Starbucks every time I leave...a subconscious reward or trap I guess. I've not had a drink order screwed up here, and they are mostly efficient at moving shoppers along quickly, especially as the line grows very long during the holiday season.  The only negative incident I've experienced at this location occurred once, about 45 minutes prior to closing time with a parent. The treat case had been cleared out and inventoried, but the pastries/etc. were still laying on the back counter for customers to see.  My very hungry parent asked to purchase a cookie, and the baristas refused. Okay then.

I am not going to say much about the coffee and the product at this store because unless you live under a rock you probably are well aware of Starbucks. If you do happen to live under the rock I will just say this, I like coffee and Starbucks is awesome.

This Store is great for that morning coffee just before heading into the office, this is also happens to be when I frequent it the most. Sometimes the line can get crazy when a rush of people looking for their morning fix rush through the door but don't panic, these people are professionals and will handle it with ease. Starbucks employees are typical friendly and professional and I can say that the same is true here. So if you happen to be reading a review of Starbucks go check it out!

Don't forget your treat receipt if you have a sweet tooth.

This location is terrible! It took me 20 min to get 3 drinks this morning. Earlier this week, I made a complaint through their website for a similar problem and nothing has changed, I think it even made it worse!! I would keep driving and find a different Starbucks!
I waited behind one customer for a long time before I gave up and left. The staff is slow and are also a little obnoxious with how loud they are. The interior was reasonably clean though.
This is not a Starbucks they told me they said it's owned by the Hilton and my Starbucks card will not work there this place sucks don't go there they are rude and customer service is poor.

Starbucks is always good. I love the oatmeal and passion tango ice tea. My boyfriend had a coffee frap he liked very much!  The only reason I'm giving 3 stars to this Starbucks is because I looked all over for a recycling bin to recycle my cups etc and it was no where to be found. There was a whole story on the wall about how Starbucks is trying to be green etc. but there was no recycling bin?!  They definitely need a recycling bin and a compost bin!  Then they will get five stars!!

Not sure what has happened at this location. Twice this week they have run out of cinnamon.  Kind of a first world problem, I suppose, but when paying Starbucks prices, strange that manager can't go over to Albertsons and get some cinnamon if they forgot how to otherwise order. That and morning service has slowed to a crawl. 

Went to Broadway as alternative and good latte but lid was covered in servers perfume. Grrr. Messing with a guys caffeine fix.

I don't even like coffee and i'm horrible at remembering names of drinks and sizes, but because i work at Old Navy early mornings (4/5am), sometimes i need an energy boost. The baristas are ALWAYS nice enough to take a minute to help me find a drink that i might like and give different suggestions. I highly recommend this starbucks location. :)
Quick service with a smile.  Staff is really good and products are also very good.  Nice seating for a quick bite.  Never had a bad experience at this Starbuck's.  Keep up the good work.
I come here quite often and the staff is always friendly and asks about my day. They always get my order right and have great customer service. The drive thru line moves pretty fast too

This place is super cute as it has a greenhouse like part of the building that sticks out. They do all of the promotions and the baristas know what they are doing since I am the queen of complicated orders. Bonus, they spell my name right.

They do all the classic drinks correctly so I don't think it would be beneficial to review drinks like Pike place or the refreshers. Instead I will write about my personal favorites and my personal secrete drinks that I order, if you want to be extra like me.

Matcha Green Tea latte- Almond Milk, low ice, 3 pumps of sugar free vanilla, and an extra scoop of matcha- 80 calories for a grande!

Grande Ice blonde coffee in a venti cup- fill it to the brim with your own choice of dairy.

Americano with a splash of almond milk and 3 pumps of sugar free hazelnut.

Green tea infused with Mango

Petite Scones- SO GOOD are 3 for $3!

I come to this Starbucks every single day. I have nothing but good things to say about the service as well as the staff. LJ, Mike, Kyle, Zac, Bethel and Sara never fail to serve me the perfect drink while also making genuine conversation with me. The store is always clean and usually pretty busy which I believe is due to the excellent service. I go out of my way to make time to go to this store everyday because of the staff. 

Not only does the staff know my usual drink but when I feel like switching it up they give me spot on honest recommendations. I will continue to come to Starbucks and this one in particular everyday for as long as I live in the area.

After walking for a while through a hot day, I found that my phone needed power. I was a ways away from home so I decided to stop in this Starbucks. 

All of the employees were busy doing one thing or another except for one named Shan. Shan decided she wanted to text with her headphones in despite my being within her vision, choosing to ignore me all the while.

It was at the time she snapped, snatched her headphones out and inquired as to what I want. I asked how much water is to which she replied free and proceeded to prepare it. I did not ask for this. A practice of mine is to buy a small item at a place I'll occupy for a while if I only intend to use the power or wifi. She slammed the water down and went about her business as the shift leader apologized for their behavior. I don't appreciate being treated like less than a human being concerning work you're supposed to doing. I won't be returning.

Drive thru! So convenient ;)

This location opened up just a couple months ago, and though it is STILL on the wrong side of the road for my morning commute, it has a drive thru and was definitely needed in this area.  I'm glad to see a Starbucks in this area and I'm sure the hotels right there are more than happy to have it as an amenity for their customers!

There is some outdoor seating here as well.

First off, the advertising in the store is horrible. There was a display of breakfast sandwiches that were labeled collectively as "breakfast sandwiches". No further descriptions for each sand which. So if you wanted a specific sandwich you saw, you had no idea what to tell the cashier. 

When I told the cashier I wanted a breakfast sandwich she frustratedly asked, "which one?". Well maybe if you labeled them I would know which one I wanted. She also failed to inform me of the options which in turn led to me canceling the whole order. 

Horrible customer service. 

The way the line formed was ridiculous. Find another Starbucks location. You won't regret it.
It's so dead the ice is killing the stores. And the guy David is very RUDE he must want to go home. Other then that I love Starbucks...

ok
Was there yesterday. Long line. The took orders and paid, but barrista  was too lazy to write names on drink cups.

Well sorry to say that the staff isn't as friendly or patient as other locations.  The refrigerated cases are dirty saw flies walking around it could be from the door being opened often but my suggestion would be get a closed case.  Coffee was good so hope to see it improve.

Easily the slowest Starbucks I have visited. Staff seems content with being slow and lines inside and in the drive through are long and slow.

Also quite disappointing that they never get orders correct.

This location is fine, but they seem to frequently be out of stuff.  No napkins today...no lids for 2 days...sorry you need to use an extra long straw for your tall iced latte today...   Friendly staff though.  Just order that shit before it runs out..mmkay?

It's a starbucks, but unlike some others the baristas here always have a frown. In the city that has housed amazing cafes since the really 19th century it's hard to jump on the Seattle-coffee train, we have our own style of cafe and it rocks. Anyone remember Kaldi's?
Always a fan of the very helpful staff at Starbucks :) They are always smiling and peppy, no matter how early / late it is.

This Starbucks had the slowest service and always seems to be out of something essential. This store is really making Starbucks look poor. Waited 10 minutes in drive through line with only 2 cars in front of me. Ordered coconut milk second time this week they were out again.
Finally 1st PSL of the season and I saw my favorite  barista Brian!! It's Starbucks  shall I say more

One of the better locations I visit.  Since the menu is the same at all locations, the service is what really sets one location apart from another.  The service is fast compared to another location within close proximity.The Baristas promptly greet you and always has a great attitude.  I even once ordered my coffee wrong (was in an awful mood and thought it was their fault).  They were so nice (even though I was not) and remade my drink the way I should have ordered it.  Whatever the management is doing it is working for them!

This Starbucks location is probably the worst I have been to customer service wise.  They continually over charge for their coffee.  It's run like a disorganized mom and pop shop rather than a company store with standards.  

Here are two examples with the first being from this morning:

My wife and I went into Starbucks to get a couple of wraps and some coffee.  I ordered a regular coffee and my wife ordered a macchiato.  She asked for it to be made decaf and wet (what she orders at all starbucks locations), which is a regular order at all the other starbucks.  The server asks if she would prefer a cappucino.  My wife said no very nicely.   We were provided our total and paid.  Upon reviewing the receipt the first line item was for a capuccino which was strange.  So my wife asked why there's capuccino and not macchiato.  She was told that a wet macchiato is a short capuccino.  Now remember, she was just asked if she wanted a cappucino and she said no.  Yet, the server took it upon herself to charge for a cappucino any way and didn't offer to say, 'next time mam I will have to charge you for a cap'.  Nope, just went ahead and did it without asking or informing.  TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE EXPERIENCE.  We're only talking an extra dollar, but the way it was done and handled was very bad.  We both did not enjoy our breakfast and left with a very disappointing experience.

So this is where the story gets better about this specific location.  I drink decaf coffee and love to have a cup after lunch.  So when I am having lunch I usually stop by a near Starbucks to get a cup of decaf.  For some strange reason this same starbucks location always tells me how they don't make decaf in the afternoon (as they all do) and that they will have to make me a cup on a drip machine or clover machine.  

What's different about this location is that they give me a song and dance every time because they have to make the cup separately, they have to charge more because they have to make decaf on demand in the afternoon since they don't brew big pots.  The staff taxes you for buying decaf in the afternoon.  So if I by a small cup they charge the price of a medium cup and if I buy a medium cup they charge for a large cup.  Huh?  No other starbucks in town does this and it baffles me how this ones does that.  The price displayed says one price and they decide to jack it up because they don't make it in the afternoon.  Their excuse, 'it requires more labor to make a cup of decaf'.  This is a company that specializes in making coffee!!  They're good at it and efficient at it.  This is a definite way to drive away customers.  You would not expect this from a company with company wide standards.

This is what I mean when I say that this location is run like a disorganized mom and pop shop.  I would prefer to give my money to a local family down the street running their own coffee shop.  Again not talking about a lot of money here, but when you go into a place and there's a price listed for something, you would feel weird when they over charge you for that thing.  In the case of the decaf, I am not asking for extras or something different, I am just asking for what is on the menu regularly.

Can you tell I'm not happy with this specific starbucks location?   I hope this post will get that store manager's attention and train the employees to provide better customer service and proper pricing.

They get two stars instead of one because at least the coffee is up to standards.

The rest of the Starbucks in Santa Barbara are very well run, have great teams, and I will continue to frequent them.
Thank you to all the ladies working here. They always greet you with a smile, and are just a friendly bunch. Great place to sit and enjoy a small amount of quiet time before you go about your day.

Trying the iced cinnamon almond milk macchiato! This drive thru is fast, and the staff are friendly sometimes they've even sang to us( depends on who's there of course).They seem to like their job and have fun. We're drive thru regulars at this locale.

this is the worst starbucks I've been to. the bathrooms were filthy, the floor in the dining area was a compete mess, they didn't get my order right, gave a very poor attempt at fixing it, I asked to have it redone, then waited for about every other customer that came in after me to get their order before they could remake mine. this location is pathetic, 5 employees can't handle a few customers.
This is one of my favorite starbucks locations. Nice patio with outdoor seating and plenty of seating inside. Great spot for getting a little work done or just people watching.

Hands down one of my favorite Starbucks locations. Staff is always friendly and work quickly to get your order. It's usually busy during the morning so if you're in a hurry, place a mobile order from the app!
Worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Parking is terrible, the service is slow and inaccurate, and the employees are rude. Don't bother asking for decaf because they make it regular despite the request.

Fast service, my drinks tasted pretty good.
Small location, few seats available inside.

In an update to my first review, I returned to this Starbucks during the holiday season and went through the drive-thru during the same time of day. The employees couldn't have been nicer. While waiting for my coffee, the man working the window asked how my day had been and laughed with me when I said how excited I was about my snowman cake pop. It's cute and delicious; of course I was excited! While I can't truly compare to my last visit as I went in the store that time, I do believe this location has upped its game when it comes to service. So I have no problem upping my rating as well. Nice improvement, Starbucks!

I'm not quite sure what it is about this place, but even when this bucks is slow it still takes an eternity to get your drink order. I have had to wait about 8-16 minutes at different times just for an iced coffee. Compared to my usual bucks in Boston that I just came from this seems unorganized.

I go to many starbucks, all over town and this one is a pretty good one as well. I mean good service, good coffee, good music, clean bathrooms and beautiful staff!  Pretty much cant complain about starbucks itself. The only complaint I would have is the location. It's not the best location but you always have people outside the area or near asking for change. But that can't be blamed on Starbucks. Overall it's a decent place.

Nice location, newly remodeled with a pretty chic feel.  Leather sofa, window seats and outdoor patio with umbrellas to shelter you from sun and rain.

surrounded by other awesome spots like  the Chest Club, FroYo, Gamblin Whiskey, Lester's and Brennan's cigar bar.

No drive thru but it really doesn't need one with all its glory.

While visiting from out of town an avid Starbucks fan & customer this experience was beyond disappointing. The store couldn't accept gift cards or apps. To start. On a super hot day with a national fencing week long competition across the street. They were out of Venti hot cups, Venti cold cups, cream base & drink carriers. All before noon. Good luck to the rest of the days customers. When trying to order the Venti coffee, settled for 2 grande. In total ordered 6 drinks only to be told after two were made that they don't have drink carriers. So I had to ask them for an empty box from the back. Carried 3 hit grande coffees, smoothie, 2 Trenta iced americanos because again no Venti cups & an ice water all through the convention center. The staff making drinks were rude. Not looking forward to the rest of the week.

Starbucks, is a Starbucks, is a Starbucks.  The only thing different from location to location is the location itself.

This one is particularly nice because it's a bit larger than some of the other locations.  I love that there are little booths in the back.  This is a great place to meet a friend and feel like you have some privacy.

As with other Starbucks, I feel like they are overpriced.  However, as long as people keep paying, drinks will keep flowing and increasing in price.

Great Starbucks. Plenty of seating, and DIVERSE seating (armchairs facing a real fireplace, handicap-accessible/designated larger tables, group tables, mini tables, couches with tables alongside the wall, outdoor, etc.) The employees are quick, efficient and professional. It can get pretty crowded depending on the time of day and on weekends, but if you pick your time wisely, it can be a pretty great study spot. Of course, there is the standard constant music playing, so if that's not within your study habit, bear that in mind. Also, there are two different single bathrooms, which I think is more than your average starbucks (= less waiting).

I love the atmosphere here.  I wish they had more seats.  Joe the manager is great, the employees are so happy there that they sing while they work.  Why don't people who go often use the Starbucks cards, don't people realize that after so many drinks you get a free one!  If you are getting a drink anyway, put it on a card and register it and get the reward.  It just makes sense!
Tiny location seated just at the opening of the plaza.  Not only is parking tight (shared with eateries like Jimmie Johns and Sugar Fire) but the inside made me claustrophobic.

I am pretty much a tea drinker but when I want coffee I prefer Starbucks.  This location is convenient for me and as typical has the little coffee house seating area with some outdoor seating.  The only downside (not Starbucks) to be concerned about is the parking lot is small.  

This place always greets you warmly whether you walk in or use their drive thru.  They offer free Wi-fi and is a great setting to get comfortable to check email, surf the internet, or do some work (or write a Yelp review).

Aside from liking the coffee my favorite is the Caramel Frappuccino and it comes in two sizes of calories (a whole bunch or almost a whole bunch).  I always find it humorous to order because I don't drink enough coffee drinks to know all the correct nuances of ordering especially the specialty drinks.  So the staff is always very helpful in understanding when I order it with no bad stuff but want to still taste good.  This particular drink is cold and is a blend of caramel, coffee, and milk topped with whip cream. If you think cold comfort drink then you have the picture.

This location is quaint and is more suitable for its drive thru and smaller groups.  The kind of place for a quiet conversation.

Definitely a "Yay I am fan" kind of place.
This Starbucks is usually quite busy, despite the inconsistent quality of their espresso drinks and tea, the slow service, and the nightmarish parking.

We are experienced starbuck patrons as we have traveled across the united states stopping when we find one. We love going to starbucks and love their coffee and pastries.  Today we were very disappointed because as we were sitting with our coffee looking at the glass box the pastries were in we saw lots of flying bugs in the case.  They were everywhere.  Landing on our computers and flying in our faces.  The floors and tables were grimy as well.

The boys working that day were helpful and attentive to their patrons.  The place just needs a thorough and regular cleaning by professional custodians.

Each day star rating would change. The core staff is always friendly and quite excellent.   They take care of you. They understand the type of drink you want. 

Place usually clean. Lately a lot of staff change. 

There typically is not much sitting room. Now with holiday season approaching there is less. There is always a wall with boxes. This has become a place to get coffee not a meeting place because there is absolutely no room. It may be one of the smallest Starbucks I have seen.
Good location and friendly staff.   Not too far from the I-80 freeway and close to the main shopping are

Yes a starbucks. (Natalie F. is sneering at Zumbar right now). 

But what can I say? I'm an addict with snobbish tendencies. And this Starbucks was good for me. 

I was at a conference in this hotel, and this starbucks serviced me extensively. There were giant lines that curled in the small space, but the staff were quick and worked through the line efficiently. 

my only problem was that the fruit that they had looked miserable and about to rot. Perhaps it's because i'm from california and it's the midwest... But man. it was kind of gross, and worse, it was still expensive :(.
With all the Starbuck's in the area, no need to go to a sucky one or, as I found here, one with a snotty staff. What gives? It's Starbucks.

This Starbucks is close to home and the customer service is great! Ordering online or in person is quick and easy here! I've never had a problem and am a repeat customer. The surrounding plaza also has several shops and restaurants to explore! Great location!

This is our neighborhood Starbucks and I have to give it 5-stars. We never have any issues with our drinks and of course going here for years now, you get to know the staff. We take our dogs here on the weekends, and sometimes during the week, in the drive-thru, and they are very dog friendly. They love to give treats to our dogs and even ask about them if we don't have them with us. It's a great location, I think it's easy to get to, and the drive-thru is a bonus.

I was so happy to go to this Starbucks! They filled up my drink all the way to the point where it was overfilling. Plus the barista said they ran out of strawberry acai but they actually had enough for just one more and I was so happy  this literally made my day

The manager does not do anything at all. They are always out for stock with everything . I have heard the manager on multiple occasions talk bad about her own employees to other employees. Wtf? Super unprofessional and that's why this location is a failure. NO MANAGEMENT. Ask any regulars if they have saw her(the manager)..is bet they haven't.
