Starbucks is not my first choice in coffee places, but because they are everywhere they are convenient, especially drive throughs. 

Yesterday I placed my order, sat in line for 5 minutes, pulled up to the window and held my phone out for the girl to scan. I said "this is a free reward." She got mad because she could not get her scanner to work, snapped at me when I asked her if she wanted to take my phone (which I guess they are not allowed to do- this is fine but explain it, don't attack me for asking). It finally scanned and then she said that I owed her the $5.40. I repeated that this was a reward. She then got mad all over again, snapped at me and was just rude because she did not hear me and had to scan again.

I will not be going back to this Starbucks. The coffee is just not worth the wait or the lousy employee attitude.

Solid Starbucks with courteous staff and a generally pleasant environment and great Wifi. What else did you expect? Only reason why I don't give this 5 stars is because they put the AC roughly between "really cold" to "Juneau, Alaska, on a good day" setting. 

If you plan on staying in here for an extended amount of time, either make sure to stock up on foods to keep yourself warm or bring along that GoreTex jacket you've been meaning to show off to all your friends but haven't found the chance during New Orleans summers.

I've had plenty bad experiences at this Starbucks. Not only terrible customer service but unsanitary. The last time I went I watched the baristas touch their phones then make the drinks without washing hands. (Note they had a line of drinks but proceeded to watch a video on their phone) and one of the girls has long hair, which she let her into drinks and the milk steaming cup. They need to take better care of this location.

I love being able to ride my bike to this location and just chill outside with my beverage.  The barista is always friendly and although they can be busy, I can always find a seat to relax and enjoy my drink.

Do NOT go to this store.
The service was rude.
The girl made my drink and left it on the counter without calling my name. I stood in front of the the girl and she didnt try to mention once my drink was ready. After seeing all the people behind me got their drinks I finally walked up to the counter and asked. That was rude, she had time chitchat but didnt even bother to mention anything.
I hate starbucks

This is my Go to Starbucks- as its right around the corner!!. Even though its busy..moves quick..added plus..my old Golds gym..bud there- Tracy!!!;)
Love my coffee

Return factor: Of course..

Meh. This location was pretty dirty, the windows were absolutely streaked with handprints, the floors looked like they hadn't been swept in two days, and why are there homeless people next to the front doors sleeping? Sketchy.

The baristas are friendly enough, the coffee is.. well, Starbucks coffee, but the internet connection is absolutely dreadful - comparable to a cell phone and what ultimately led me to look elsewhere.   There's usually copious amounts of outlets and seating though with about twelve 2-tops lining the giant wall of windows looking out upon Latimer St (read: dumpsters and a parking garage).  Occasionally bums will coddle up next to the window outside and attempt to entertain you with their histrionics.  You could add or subtract a star if you are or aren't into that.

This place is tiny inside and by tiny I mean claustrophobia-inducing. But the saving grace is the lovely sidewalk seating. And, of course, there's free wi-fi.

I enjoyed an iced latte here Sunday morning while reading the news on my phone and it was a nice setting. The egg white, turkey bacon and white cheddar breakfast sandwich was better than I expected it to be - it was just enough to fill me up without making me feel too full.

I give 5 Star's Batista's are absolutely awesome and extremely Fast! They make me smile every time! ya ya ya the parking lot is awful cares as long as your safe! put on your smiley faces and enjoy that coffee :)
By far my favorite coffee spot in the city. The staff is always friendly, always clean and fast service. I just love the atmosphere that the staff creates here.

This is my first time using the mobile app to order ahead, and pay in advance.... and I must say that I'm sold!  There was a long line inside and at drive thru... but my order was already ready and waiting!  Plus, it was made perfectly! Kudos!
Barista this morning doesn't know how to fill the cup. $4.00 for coffee, it should be full. In a hurry and no time to wait. Thanks guys! Happy Monday.
The atomosphere is nice and the music is good for studying. It can get loud sometimes when a large group of people come in to study.  However, the internet is terribly terribly slow.

i love this starbucks location. i bring my dog into the drive thru at least once a week and the baristas are so nice to her & to me. i would understand if i got a barista who wasn't as friendly, since everyone has different personalities and i would never expect them to always be kind - but i SWEAR this is the friendliest starbucks in the sparks locations. i've been about 10 times and i haven't had any problems with my drinks, either. which is great cause my drink is pretty specific! thanks guys, keep up the good work.

Well, I certainly check in here often enough. I suppose it is time for a review. Keep in mind that I am not reviewing the Starbucks corporate empire, the (largely pointless) debate over the impact on the social fabric by the homogenized "coffee shop culture" or any other such nonsense; no, I am simply speaking of 2 North Central Ave. - my touchstone to reality. 

My preferred Starbucks is so much more to me than merely a refueling stop on the caffeine highway; it is the cornerstone of a relaxing routine that allows me to completely shed the stressors and megrims of each work week. This is my Weekend place; a place for great coffee and a newspaper, a place for clearing my mind while gazing out the windows looking out onto central Clayton. The thought of sinking into one of the overstuffed chairs in the well-lighted corner with a muffin or some oatmeal is a sublime way to awaken on Saturday and Sunday mornings.

There are myriad Starbucks locations in the U.S. and I have been to dozens of them. I am definitely a fan of their rich, deep, strong brew but the true reason for continually frequenting them as I travel city to city and state to state is this: whenever I enter, regardless of where I am, I can always recapture a measure of the peace and tranquility of 2 North Central

I have recently moved and this is my new Starbucks location. I have gone repeatedly and it has been the slowest and worst service I've ever gotten at Starbucks. First, no one ever acknowledges you when you come in and go to the counter for mobile order. You have to say "excuse me, I'm here to pick up my mobile order." Today, I mobile ordered at 8:13am... but 8:30am it still was not ready. At other locations, my order can be ready in as quick as 4-5 minutes. There was one girl doing all of the drinks for in store orders and mobile orders. Her tickets for mobile orders were excessively long and when a guy asked to see where his drink was in line, I asked as well, she told him and did not acknowledge me. I left because I would be late for work. There was at one point, 12 people there waiting for mobile orders. My total was  $8.24 and I did not receive my order this morning. Quality of drinks and food are usually fine but it just takes WAY too long and they aren't very friendly or accommodating and there's definitely not enough workers for the demand of this location.

worked here for 3 years and absolutely loved it. Miss u guys.  The service here is great, don't get me wrong during peak times it can get a tad bit hectic. But everyone is so engaging that time seems to fly by. Kathryn, Dave and Grant are awesome sauce as well as rob, Marcus, and Paul. And the lovely regulars Jeanne, Joey, Lamar, Angela, Kathy, Ms. Mary.

This is the only Starbucks I go too! I'm in love with all the staff! There's one in particular his name is gizz and he's the sweetest person I've ever talked too! He's a tall boy with dirty blonde hair and he always perfects my drinks and when I don't know what I want he makes it perfectly!

Pros:  

-BJ.  He looks like a viking but is the best employee I've ever encountered at a fivebucks.

-Clover machine.  They need something to keep up with town hall (town hall still wins by a mile), but the clover machine is a great addition.

-Reserve Coffees.  The only one in the area (along with the clover machine) to feature these types.  They are expensive, but the taste far surpasses their usual beans.

Cons:Parking, but that is every starbucks

Staff is usually friendly, but the service/inventory of usual Starbucks drinks and sides can be inconsistent. But if you want a simple drink and an awesome view and atmosphere, you can find that here. The interior is awesome and the big windows allows customers to enjoy the Riverfront views.

I usually love coming here and they haven't messed up my drink. But whoever was working drive thru on New Year's Day around 11 am was definitely not even listening to my order. I ordered a venti iced vanilla green tea latte. She repeated it back without saying iced, so I reminded her again that I wanted iced. She told me my total then I proceed to pull up. She hands me a hot latte. I tell her it's supposed to be iced. She hands me an iced mocha -____- this point, I was just fed up and was going to be late if I had her fix my drink for the THIRD time.

I always mobile order for this location.  My drink is always ready when I arrive which is a huge plus.  Sometimes even when you order the same drink at Starbucks it will vary in taste slightly each time.  However this location has always been consistent and my drinks are always great.  Today my barista wrote "Have an amazing day!"  I have never had anyone write a message on my cup but I have had a rough week so it was very inspiring.  Great location for mobile orders!

This place now sucks because of this slow lazy worker; Leanthony. This guy made me wait for my drink for an extra 30 minutes, even after I told him I've been waiting already. I was waiting patiently at the drink pick-up area, and he promised to check and see if my order was made but he never did, even when I was waiting right in front of him. Such a liar. He tried to say he couldn't tell the future (which made no sense) then started ignoring me. How rude can a person be? It took awhile until another worker asked if I needed something and finally made my drink; on the spot. 
Why couldn't Leanthony make my drink, even when I told him I haven't received my drink after it seemed like 20 other people got theirs? As I was waiting, other people  were complaining about this guy or place too. Because he's a slow lazy worker and Starbucks (or at least this place) has gotten worse, need to fire these lazy rude workers, and get back to getting some decent customer service.

Bryn Mawr Starbucks #1 in nationwide survey!

What survey you ask?  I've traveled to over 30 states including AK and HI and visited over 200 Starbucks!  It's MY SURVEY and Bryn Mawr is #1 for the most abysmal, abominable, ridiculous parking I've ever seen!  There is a special place in hell for the guy or gal that designed or allowed this nightmare to exist.  Auto body shops dream of having this store near them.  A root canal is less painful than parking here.

When you finally get into the store and while you're freaking out about the safety of your car, the Baristas and the products are just fine but unfortunately the parking disaster overshadows everything else.
I stopped in for the 1st time in probably a year. Its slightly redesigned and it was not freezing cold. My drink was perfect, which was unfortunate because I drank it too fast.

This is my new preferred Starbucks location. The staff are friendly and helpful. I used to work for Starbucks, so I know how to craft a decent beverage while still focusing on the customer, and these folks do an excellent job. 

They really have the 'coffee culture' thing down at this store. Customers ask about beverages and receive accurate information. They never roll their eyes at my extensive/strange drink requests and they were great about customizing beverages before Starbucks went on the customization kick. 

If something's wrong, they go out of their way to make it right with a sincere apology. 

I would enjoy the store more if it had a drive-thru or later hours, but I do think that could change the culture of the store.

They're pretty fast here, too. Occasionally I meet my friend out here on her lunch hour as she works nearby and we make good use of her hour lunch because everything is quick.
I think the staff here is amazing!! I'm only in this particular Starbucks a couple of times every few weeks and they always know what I order.  I don't know how they do it, but it's impressive......

My only Starbucks on the way to work, staff is super friendly and only once in the last 2 years has my order been incorrect and was corrected with no problem when I called about it.   The only downfall to this location is that the parking and drive through can be a nightmare depending on the day.   There's no consistency of when or what time in the morning so I only know when i get close to driving by if I should stop or keep driving!

We frequent this Starbucks because the staff is always very polite, cheerful and seem to all be having a great time! and generally very quick with the service, too.

Thanks you for your cheer and smiles!!! 
and the coffee, too!! :)

Best Starbucks in the city, imho. Baristas are so nice- every single one of them! Sometimes, yes a drink gets messed up but they quickly fix it with no questions asked. Best people watching window on a Saturday morning and I love sitting outside at the round tables with an iced vanilla coffee in the summer!

This is a standard mall type Starbucks on the end of the mall near Wetmore.  indoor and outdoor seating facing parking lot. pleasant service and kind of slow on weekday evenings.  Currently the holiday items are very cut priced but they are OUT OF SALTED CARAMEL AND CARAMEL BRULEE!   Well maintained and close to decent shopping and the Tucson Mall.

Slowest starbucks Internet I've ever used, to the point where often its unusable. This isn't an issue that only happens during certain times of the day, I've been there various times from 10am to closing, and it's always incredibly slow. 
The drinks are fine, exactly what you'd expect from a Starbucks (which is a good thing!). The service is quick and friendly.
It is freezing inside. Not sure why that is, but it gets to the point where my hands get that slightly numb feeling that comes with cold weather.

I have been visiting this location about two times a week for about a month. The store is a good size with a drive-through. The costumer service is so-so. The purpose of my review is the absolutely disgusting restrooms. I've seem cleaner port-o-potty's. Every single time they are dirty, smelly, wet and unsanitary. There is no possible way they are cleaned regularly. I'll be going back to Cherry Hill where they clean the restrooms from now on.

I only give this a 3 star because of the decor and location. I live in Wilmington, and until this opened only had the one on marsh road and the one in the Nemours building on North Orange (which have excellent Barista's and service - Not open on sunday). I digress. 

When this place just opened they were severely understaffed with very untrained and unprofessional Baristas. Not only did you have a long time to wait, but then the attitude they gave you was unacceptable. Tonight I went there walked in and about 5 or 7 employee's where just standing laughing and talking conversing behind the counter. I actually felt like i was interrupting there conversation by placing a order. Same RUDE service. What is it with this location Starbucks why can't you hire QUALITY employees! I actually don't go to this Starbucks anymore despite how great it looks the service is just awful. I'd rather goto the one on orange or marsh road.

This Starbucks has the worst customer service I have ever experienced. We ordered a Tea in the drive thru and waited in line for over 1/2 hr with not even an apology for the wait. I would not come here if you are in a hurry.

Yesterday morning I ordered online a espresso drink, entered about 10 minutes later and saw my drink wasn't ready which was really surprising. A few minutes later, I never pressed confirm my order. The staff noticed I was very stressed and they worked hard to get my drink ready for me. This Starbucks always consistently shows the best customer service. Thanks again!
I really enjoy going to this Starbucks. The folks here remember your name and are always friendly. Never have to wait too long. Keep it up y'all!

8/10/13 6:45PM THEE WORST SERVICE EVER!  The sign at the door says this Starbucks is open until 8PM  
The chic "taking" my order yelled out "we ain't got no tea to make that drinK..." before I even finished ordering.  I asked for something else and she yelled out, "we close at 7".  I pointed out the posted schedule and she continued to yell something about depending on how business was that day they were closing early.  There were at least 6 people there and 5 others behind me.  She asks what I wanted and noticed I had my Starbucks app ready and yells (yes, she yelled the whole time), "we don't have a scanner for that!!!", walks to the other end of the counter and yells at the top of her lungs "WE ARE CLOSED, YOU GUYS NEED TO LEAVE!!!",  throws whatever she had in her hands into the sink, turns the lights off and walks away mumbling some profanity.  
Angry much?  Oh, she did say "have a nice day".  For that, she gets a star.
Staff not as attentive as in other Starbucks locations.   They always seem to be out of vanilla bean scones too..
This is a okay Starbucks located in the Silver Legacy Casino, however they ran out of breakfast items during my stay. The baristas had a bit of attitude also because they are not a corporate store.

When I used to commute to Phila. University from South Philly, I would stop at this Starbucks around 630am every morning. Very welcoming and friendly in the morning, would always shake me from a cranky mood. Even offered me a free venti vanilla latte after I fell asleep at the back tables and knocked everything over. And THEY apologized to me about the table going down! Too considerate, if you ask me! :)

On top of that, quick service, great location, nice study/work spot too!

The usual Starbucks food and drink favorites located in a not easy to find strip mall just east of Street Road and Bustleton Pike. Recently remodeled to a newer, cozier, cheerier, atmosphere with a little more room to move around. Went from small to average size. The Baristas in here have always been very nice, efficient, and willing to accommodate. Service is never an issue. Lines can get long, but never long waits. Could use a bigger food display case, and like most other Starbucks they need more cushioned lounging seats, but space is always an issue. 2 single bathrooms that are coed and are clean  Plenty of off street parking and a small area to sit outside if you like.  All in all, a slightly above average Starbucks, but still missing the ambiance of the stand alone building Starbucks down the road west, on 2nd Street Pike and Street Road.

I used to live in Seminole Heights and frequented this location often.

The service was great and the drinks were awesome as usual.  This is a 24/7 location, which is awesome.

My only complaints about this location is that it's too small, gets crowded and there is not enough parking.

I gave it 5 stars because the staff is always attentive and take customer satisfaction very seriously.  Although there are long waits at times, the people that you get to meet make up for it!  

B. Major Grade:  A

This Starbucks is in a very convenient location for me and it has a drive-thru but they cannot ever make my coffee right. I would say about 90% of the time I go here they give a drink that is not made correctly and I have to go to another location to have it remade because if I ask them to remake it they just cover it with whipped cream and try to kill me with caramel sauce. Not sure why this location can't get it together but when I am spending $5 or more on a coffee I would like it they way it is supposed to be made.

Reading some of the prior reviews and patronizing this Starbucks on an almost daily basis, I almost didn't recognize the place.  The reviews for the prior years were accurate, reflecting some of what was going on at the time they were written, but thankfully, none of that's the case now.

Corinne is the store's manager, and she has an awesome staff; I've seen them really working hard and getting food & drinks assembled at a breakneck pace, even when the line of customers is literally out the door.  They do all of this with a smile, and also remember the regular customers' customized drinks and names accurately.  They are so nice.

I only have one complaint/suggestion, and it's not under the control of the store's staff:  the store is too small!  The next-nearest Starbucks is located at the corner of Bloomingdale & Providence, and the square footage and furniture is much more conducive to hanging out, working on a laptop, sitting outside, or reading.  Hey Starbucks Corporate:  put some money into the Lithia-Pinecrest store and give them an upgrade!  Bigger, please.

I'm not sure how much of a difference a yelp review can make with a chain but I'm at this location almost everyday. This last Friday the computer never printed out my order that was made in store and I waited a long time for my things when I was asked what I ordered. They got right on making everything the machine had failed to print out and ever since they have since covered my coffee three times. They are the nicest staff who really cares about their customers. They care to keep their regulars happy and if something goes wrong they do what they can to make up for it. Nothing like this would deter me in general because ITS JUST COFFEE.
The employees seem to enjoy working here. The location is right of of route 73. Not crowded for a Saturday afternoon. I was in and out in no time!!!!

Just a great place in general. Baristas are awesome, they remember your name! Feels like a coffee shop but not so much like a national chain. They have a great selection of any type of iced or hot drink. Their not terribly cheap but worth the quality.

COMPLETELY RUDE.

I walk up and order a cafe vanilla frap. She gives me a coffee frap with vanilla syrup. After I wait for her to help 2 customers, and another employee to walk up to the register on her phone, ignore the customer standing there (and myself) and clocked in... Walks behind the pastry counter continuing her text convo. 

I've been in the service industry for over 12 years... This is NOT how to treat people. I have also worked for Starbucks, this is not acceptable!

After finally being acknowledged (with a rude "you need something?" Attitude) I informed them that my Cafe Vanilla was made incorrectly as there isn't vanilla bean powder in it. After a few minutes of going back and forth of what a cafe vanilla bean frap vs a vanilla bean frap is... They made it (though I did just say I could use a refund instead but they insisted on just remaking it).

During the remake process she messed it up again. When I got it the lady asked me to taste it to make sure it's right. It wasn't and she said she could remake it again but at this point I just walked out.

DO YOURSELF A FAVOR... Just don't come here. The service and lack of basic job knowledge isn't worth your frustration.
i didn't really care for this location. it wasn't all that clean, they were crowded and drinks came slow the day i went. the one in flourtown up the road on Bethlehem pike is my fave in this area.
Everyone is alway so friendly here. I love to come in and start my day with a compliment or a smile. No matter how crowded or rushed the place is, everyone always has a cheery disposition.
Standard Starbucks. Clean. Free wifi. Friendly staff.

Where to begin.... Parking is a cluster at most times and people have no qualms about double parking you in to add to the fun. The staff seems overwhelmed and lately they seem to take orders quickly and fill them slowly which creates huge back ups of people. Since it's easy to compare this place to what, a million other  of the SAME format, it's maybe time for management to improve here but something needs an overhaul.

Manager Tay runs a tight ship here with lots of love from employees. They always go the extra mile to help you get the exact drink that you want. The place is clean and spotless. Bring a jacket because it's always a bit nippy.

This is the Starbucks that made me stop going to Starbucks forever. The only reason it gets one star is because they serve up a drink that sort of tastes like what you would get at a regular Starbucks. This is not a company owned store, it is owned by the Renaissance Hotel. Because of that they don't have to follow all of the rules. They take your Starbucks card on the rare occasion when they are processing machine is working, but they do not take payments with the mobile app or redeem rewards offers.

For example, they don't keep the hours that they post on their door, sometimes closing early in the afternoon. You pay about a 20 percent premium on everything you buy in the store because it's not a company owned location and hotels can charge whatever they want. One other thing I've noticed over the last few months is that the same drink can be a different price depending on what day it is and who is running the cash register. I don't know if that's bad training or something more nefarious. 

Regardless, this is a poor example of a Starbucks and there are other places in the neighborhood to get coffee, including the company owned store on Olive Street. My advice, stay away from this location. Its an insult to the Starbucks brand.

This is the largest Starbucks I have patronized. Plenty of space to sit and work. Staff is friendly and I noticed they were very happy to help with drink recommendations. Temperature is a little on the colder side so I'd recommend bringing a sweater if you're going to stay a bit.  No music playing while I was there... my only recommendation for improvement.

This is a solid Starbucks, but not really one of my faves given it's location.  The three stars is based on location alone.  It sits outside the mall, no entrance from the interior.  The staff is consistently fantastic... and always makes a solid drink (AND they do the Flat White like it is supposed to be done.)

It has a lot of seating which is nice and a little outdoor seating area as well.

Mostly average Starbucks.  They are still a little slow, which could be due to being a new location.

Other than that, it is your average expensive high calorie coffee joint.  So far, it's kept pretty clean, and the service is friendly.  

Basically, it's an ice cream shop, loaded with caffeine, that no one looks down on me for having in the mornings.  Thankfully, it's located right next to a dentist.  So after I have my Java Chip and a bunch of pastries, I can go next door and have all of my cavities filled.

So upset on how rude this lady was I'm guessing a higher up or manager !!!!! By the way she strutted around and showing someone how to you use the k cup machine on one of the tables me and my daughter were sitting at while waiting for coffee ! Lady just came right over started reaching over my food and coffee instead of asking us to move or excuse me thee rudest lady I've seen to in a long time I will never go back to this Starbucks again !

Best Starbucks by far!!! I have been to just about every Starbucks in and around this area (south Jesery) and the customer service and drinks are always consistant. The staff are friendly and accommadating. In the morning when the lines are long they work together to get every ones drink order...unlike some Starbucks that will be cleaning and stocking the pastry display when the line is out the door (Are you kidding me!!!) So hand sdown this is the best!!

Today I went for my usual coffee and when I went up to the register to order, I found that I had left my debit card at home. The cashier was kind enough to say "don't worry about it we'll take care of it. " and gave me my drink for free... She totally made my day! And because of her I will always recommend this place. :) thank you

This review amends a previous review about this location.  Since they have added Google internet, this Starbucks has great internet.  Though the service here is not my favorite ... you can't blame the baristas because this is one of the flagship stores with so much foot traffic that it is probably hard to follow people. Nevertheless I have started to get to know a few of the Baristas and they are courteous, friendly, and helpful.  The place is relatively clean, with my only gripe being the seating because of the location near UCSB campus. During finals and midterms ... students crowd this area but I am okay with it....

I love going to Starbucks. The drinks are amazing, but this could be the worst Starbucks I have ever been too. Every person working her seemed unhappy and rude. There were empty boxes all around the area where you collect your drinks. When I paid, I was told I needed exact change. I spend around $10 and gave the women a $20 and she told me exact change or card only. Also a limited selection of whole coffee for sale.

It's cramped in here.  Space is limited to a couple tables and when it's busy - especially in the morning - it's a pain in the butt to navigate around everyone since there's no room for the line to form.  That's one star.

I won't bore you with the details, but another star taken off because one of the baristas was giving me issues with redeeming a reward.  He was also busy chatting with another person while the line continued to grow longer and longer...

Very convenient location but for that same reason very busy. Quick to churn out the orders and good quality. Wifi was easy to get onto even when I needed to have a secured connection. I make stops here frequently due to it proximity to the people that I frequently work with.

It's Starbucks, but anything in CWE has to carry its own swagger, and this little spot, despite being near Coffee Cartel, manages to squeeze together plenty of seating in a small spot and has some great service.

It's also conveniently across from the Chess Club and right next to the Chess Hall of Fame.

Ummmm, not sure what the complaining is about regarding this location. I find it to be one of the Best  locations. It's comfortable, spacious, and clean with a great staff. Friendly and genuine.

I travel a lot! I've ran into some questionable locations. This location I place in my top five.

It's pretty small so it's really geared to get you in and out. Seating not available. I ordered the mango dragon. Drink. It was good and refreshing, I personally didn't taste mango, tasted more like a blackberry. Either way the service was quick and the drink was good without it tasting too sweet.

I'm not quite sure what it is about this place, but even when this bucks is slow, it still takes an eternity to get your drink order. I have had to wait about 8-16 minutes at different times just for an iced coffee. Compared to my usual bucks in Boston that I just came from, this seems unorganized.

Update:
From coming here more often, I'm noticing this place is chronically understaffed during peak hours. I feel bad for the baristas because they can hardly keep up when the lines get so long. It leaves me wondering, where is management during all this?

I'm adding an extra star for the baristas that work as hard as they do.

Update:

Since my review they seem to have hired more staff and things move along at a faster pace. I come here often. It seems like management got it turned around!

The cashier working the register at the Starbucks by gate E-26 is the rudest and most ignorant woman I have come across!! She is rude and just downright nast! My suggestion, if you don't like your JOB, and have 0 people skills, don't work at a takeout place; especially at an airport. Starbucks, you can do a better job training your employees. She was working 3/1/18 @ 10am

Not being a coffee drinker shouldn't disqualify me from writing a review about Starbucks--but you rabid coffee drinkers may disagree...lol

Ok--about Starbucks--I honestly go here for my tea.  I enjoy the Black Tea; Oolong Tea & Green Tea.   

This location is usually crowded in the mornings & around lunch hour because of the close proximity to Jefferson--but my experience with Starbucks is that there is always a crowd.   

The staff are usually very friendly and do what they can to make your time at Starbucks a good one.

I love this Starbucks because they always make the drinks fast and efficient! Huge location perfect for college students to study and hang out. I just went the other day and they made my Pumpkin Spice Latte' fabulous!

It's Starbucks - pretty standard stuff. This particular location is extremely compact; I personally wouldn't bring my laptop, notebooks, etc. to work on here. There are only about 6-8 tables inside and they are all very small. There are about 4-5 tables outside that are larger but let's be real, who really wants to be sitting outside for long periods of time in Florida? Lol. The other downside (I may be spoiled for saying this, but bear with me) is that there is no drive-thru. I was surprised it wasn't more crowded than it was. The workers, although there were only 3, were EXTREMELY fast!! I am generally not impressed with the speed of Starbucks workers but these guys were great.
Horrible customer service. Rude. My drink is constantly not made right. They are always out of what you want but they don't tell you until after you paid.

This place has gotten a lot better, I guess what a difference a year makes.  The people that were dragging this place down, gone and the people they have in now are actually getting people in and out rather than just holding social hour.

The orders are taken promptly, handled with care, and served promptly.  No BS here.

I'm sorry, I must have missed the "Kara V was here" Yelp sticker when I walked in --LOL.  I have a $75 Starbucks gift card that I am slowly plugging away at, so I popped in here when I was in the neighborhood.  Small, friendly, clean, great service from the baristas.  Super generous with the whipped cream, too!  Woot woot!
My wife bought me a grande latte. When I opened it at home it was literally half full. Rip off!!  It even felt half full before I looked inside.

Never thought I would rate a Starbucks...but I had to because this one is the best Starbucks in the city! Located on Jefferson Hospital's campus. Great place to study and relax (separate room). Very busy starbucks but the service is quick and SUPER friendly. 

Love it here.

This Starbucks is quite the distance from my house, but I was driving by on my way home from work and decided to stop in and get my usual Iced Chai Tea Latte.

Between Jocelyn and Abby, it's hard to distinguish who was doing a better job. Jocelyn said she was new, and was still learning some drinks, but smoothly upsold me to a Dirty Iced Chai Tea Latte. As a bartender myself, I was rather impressed at how well she had convinced me to add the espresso to the drink, and I knew after the first sip that it was going to be my new favorite drink from Starbucks.

Super rude. Got a iced green tea, Saw what looked like tea from a busted teabag and white stuff at the bottom of my tea and asked them to make me a new one and they initially refused and said it was just the sweeten low that was in there. Then I went up there and showed the lady the black stuff and what looked like white food crumbs in my tea, and she then proceeded to snatch the drink from my hand and started to say under her breath "the black stuff is just tea." And then proceeded to be rude the rest of the time and when I went back for the remade tea, she was also rude about that. Not to mention the fact of how long they took!  Got in there 2:15ish didn't get my drink and leave till 2:40ish

I love this location. Regardless of how busy they are they always seem to get my order correct and serve it with a pleasant attitude.
I would have given a four, but today it appears that some management/corporate personal came in.   While there I observed one of them going behind the counter and introducing himself to everyone.   This same person had to tie his shoe and to do so, he put his shoe onto one of the bar stools in the restaurant.  His dirty shoe was placed into the stool while he tied it and when he finished he didn't take the time to wipe it down let alone clean it.  This is a poor reflection of the company when a representative doesn't care enough about the impressions made by customers when doing such a thing

This place is super inviting! The staff made it really easy for me to pick an order I like and even offered to remake it if I don't like it so I don't waste my money. My day was been super terrible and the staff had no clue, I have no idea how his day is going yet he put on a polite smile and helped walk me through the menu. Scott is such an amazing worker and just wanted to say your effort, although small, was very appreciated! I hope you get granted with happiness and well beings (:

This is a very small, basic coffee and baked goods Starbucks located in the Shoppes at Canal Place. I work close by so I frequent this location, even though it's not my favorite. 

They are usually speedy in fulfilling orders. However, the drinks are often too sweet for my taste, so I forgo extra flavors or any flavored lattes. I am very sensitive to sugary flavors, so that's just my personal choice. I've ordered thru the app multiple times here, only to find that they've run out of coconut milk or they've run out of my food item after waiting for 5 plus minutes with no acknowledgement until I wait in line to get to the cash register (I know people are in a rush in he AM; it would be rude to butt). Thus, it's best to order in person here!

This Starbucks location has an always parking situation, but the drive thru is nice. There are a couple of baristas on staff that are really talented, but most of the team seems to be new hires. They are still getting used to the process. 

There was once where my sandwich got forgotten and then I was given the wrong one. It was busy and I had already waited fifteen minutes, so I didn't stick around to correct it.

i am super impressed with this Starbucks! The staff is friendly and prompt. I came early for a meeting with a colleuge and they were offering a buy a holiday drink and get one free from 2-5. Well when 2:00 hit it was crazy packed! The staff happily served every customer with bright smiles and cheery voices! They made sure to keep the place clean and tidy! They were even kind enough to allow me to order one of my drinks then while I was meeting with my college and then order my free one when I was leaving to take home to my husband!

I will grab a quick drink multiple times daily from my favorite neighbor Starbucks.  The people who work here are great and even when it's busy I don't wait longer than a few minutes. It's also a great spot to meet for biz or catching up with a girlfriend.

Starbucks is a Starbucks. This one has the Clover brewed coffee which some might appreciate where others won't give a hoot. Lot parking can be a bit challenging as it shares the spots with a few businesses in this small strip mall type building. There's additional parking on the side of the building and the back as well as metered parking on the street. Tons of tables and space inside. Again, it's Starbucks.
Amazing Starbucks with amazing employees.

Fantastic Starbucks !!!

My Iced venti decaf skinny vanilla latte was made perfectly.  Best I've had in a long time. Wish this store was closer to home !!!

Manager always has attitude and rude comments in return. She mentioned, it was "buy one, get one free" for National Tea Day. Told her I came in earlier today and they didn't offer me that, and she shrugs shoulders with attitude. Always have the worst experience with her at cash register
Service was slow. I received a cup with a bent rim. A bent rim equals a spill on my suit, shoes and car cup holder.  Bad way to start out the day.  Thanks Starbucks.

My daily Starbucks. I'm here every morning getting my soy chai latte. The staff is great, they always make my drink to perfection. They all know my name and sometimes start making my drink when they see me walk through the door. This is my "Cheers!I

This is by far the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. The coffee is always watery and weak. This store never has what's on the menu. The employees seem as though they are confused as to what to make when you order it. I wish I could of have a better experience here, because it's so close to where I live.

This store is the worst Starbucks that I've been to. There is an employee named Dev. She's one of the most horrible people I've ever encountered in my life. Dev made my drink wrongly and when I politely asked her to remake my drink she flipped out on me and told me I was being rude and ganged up on me with one of her fellow employee. She at last snatched my drink from me, dumped it in the sink, gave me a refund, and told me to get out. I recommend that you avoid this place at all cost. Dev if you read this... Your mom's a two dollar prostitute.

I ordered my iced drink and the barista made it hot. I told him nicely, I'm sorry, but I ordered this iced and he was all pissy. After he remade my drink I thanked him and he turned and said, "yup". My drink was made correctly and tasted great. I just didn't think his attitude was great. Bummer because this location is pretty rad. May not be coming here again if he's working.  Of course I didn't catch his name. But it was the male worker on Monday March 20th, 2017 at 515pm.

Always friendly service, albeit a tad slow but it's usually very busy there. Parking lot is a tragedy, the worst I've experienced. Bottom line: due to the lack of parking and the entitled folks who park illegally all over that lot (making it really congested), I usually go elsewhere for coffee.

I love Starbucks, especially a drive thru but this is not my go to location. I find that the drive thru is usually several cars deep and they take FOREVER. If you're in a hurry, don't come to this location. The staff isn't super friendly either and seemed a little annoyed with my drink order. I always ask for no whipped cream on my drinks and they can never get that right. I know it seems crazy that I'm complaining over coffee, but when you're spending over $5 on one drink, they should get it right. I'd much rather drive a little more to go to the location on Damonte/Virginia or the one next to Smiths.

This place is awesome. The baristas here are super nice, engaging, and suggest new products well. I ordered a coffee here and one barista suggest I try it "on the clover." I had no idea what it meant, but apparently it's like a french press machine but better. And he was right! Not only did this suggestion work out but he bumped me up to a grande. 

I also love coming here to get some work done. Definitely will be a regular here.

June, the barista was clearly having a bad day today. My drink was delicious as always, and the guy who made it was very sweet. However June couldn't give me the time of day and gave me attitude when I didn't day what size I like right off the bat. I come here often but haven't seen her before, must be new. If I were running a business I would not want someone like that greeting every single guest coming in.

I have to say that I am a bit of a Starbucks but and typically don't have an issue with any of the service that I get.  The Bryn Mawr location is the exception.  First of all it seems as if all of the employees are on a major "slow down mode". It takes them forever to ring people up and forever to make the drinks.  I can not figure it out.  No other location is like this!  May be the management - who knows.  But I dread going in there but it I convenient from the train station.   Their parking sucks, but hey there is nothing they can really do about that in downtown Bryn Mawr. 
I just really wish they would start drinking the espresso so that we can be served in a consistent amount of time - and with a SMILE!

I'm usually not a Starbucks fan, except for the very occasional dessert drink where the lower quality beans are masked in a swirl of sugar, milk and flavorings! (salted caramel mocha, pumpkin spice latte, java chip frappe.. mm)  

But this location has got to be one of the best designed ones I've seen! A huge breath of fresh air compared to the small cookie cutter Starbucks stores littered all over NYC! The ambiance is warm and cozy, and has the feel of and eco-conscious cafe. (Unfortunately the temperature is not so warm, brrr... its freeeezzy up in here! It's not so bad early am, but dang wear your thickest sweater and fuzzy socks if you plan on staying) 

The girls that work here are super friendly and sweet as well. The last time they wrote my name down as Angel even though she clearly heard "Angela" and saw it on my card.. lol.

I really like all the wooden decor and large table in here. I could imagine that if I had gone to school in SB, this would've been one of my prime study spots. They have plenty of outlets scattered about the store, and hidden under the long table so you never have to claw and fight your way to one like at some other spots. 

They have some cushier chairs and sofas too that provide an ideal spot to gather with friends to catch up, read a book or the paper. 

If its a nice day outside and you don't want to be subjected to the frigid temps in here, there is plenty of seating and tables right outside. 

Lots of parking and even during peak hours in the morning the service is still quick and the space is large enough that it doesn't feel crowded or cramped.
For a new store they are always out of something!! Hate being stuck in a drive thru line waiting for nothing thus had happened 3 times now won't be back!

This is a pretty typical Starbucks shop located on the strip along with other stores and a shopping mall. The interior is pleasant and well-designed with high ceilings and sports the regular Starbucks motif. The staff were pleasant and attentive during my visit, the store was clean, and it was a good environment. I hung out there and worked on my laptop for a while and the wifi signal was decent and didn't drop out. All, in all, this store upholds what you expect to find and experience in any Starbucks store.

Oh, and the white chocolate mocha was delicious. They always are.....

I'm always disappointed when I go here. I got a chai tea latte and the bottom was unmixed or something. Chai tea lattes aren't supposed to have texture. And a couple weeks ago I went her and ordered an iced chai tea latte with soy at the drive thru. When I got home I looked at it and the soy milk had collected at the bottom of the cup. I tried to mix it but it just broke up a little. It was still chunky.
I like this location because it is always clean and the employees are very nice.  The internet is always fast as well.
This place is extremely busy but the staff does a great job keeping the lines moving!  Coffee is always good!

Very good and friendly customer service. The baristas are almost always cheerful and happy when I'm at this location. They keep the line moving so customers in a rush can grab their handcrafted drink and get on their way.

This Starbucks is located within the Olin Business School at Washington University in St. Louis. It has all the drinks and snacks that you can find at any other regular Starbucks. The hours tend to vary depending on the school schedule. During regular school time it opens at 7am and closes at 8pm on weekdays. 

I love this Starbucks because of the amazing baristas and the other people working there. They are all friendly and always have smile on their face even when they tend to get overwhelmed by long lines of students. 

The people in green brings smile to all the students who come to get their caffeine fix. 

I will miss you guys during the summer break :(

The coffee and specialty drinks were fine, and yes it's New Year's Day and any employee would want to be home today, BUT I'm still giving this Starbucks a 2-star rating because of the barista who served my group. She informed us that they would be closed in 20 minutes and we assured her that we wouldn't keep her past closing. She was very snippy with us as she rang us up and then "accidentally" forgot to give my friend her $20 gift card back after she used it to buy a drink. My friend saw the barista pocket the card and asked to see if it was her gift card, but the barista said, "i don't think this is yours." Needless to say, it was.

Yes, I am a junkie. Happy now? So what? Me and 128 million other people. This is a nice big corner location 2 blocks away from my office, very convenient. Does anyone actually read reviews of a specific Starbucks location? Aren't they all the same? Friendly staff, lots of seating. I'm in.
One of the best and nicest Starbucks I have ever been to.  Rarely mix up my order and are almost always friendly.  Really solid neighborhood Starbucks.

This starbucks is on the ground floor of the Bellevue and just an awesome place to stop for a cup of coffee.  The baristas are quick to remember your name and your drink (if you order the same thing regularly.) Life Saver!

It's a beautiful space to enjoy the Riverfront after a movie or ice skating.  The staff thus far have been friendly, helpful and knowledgeable about the products.  So glad we finally have an S'bux in the area!

This location is generally quite busy since there isn't really another Starbucks nearby that's easy to get to (there is one in the shops at the metropolis at Barnes and noble). For that reason, I usually go inside and order or do the mobile pickup-I like to think I wait less than in the drive thru but I'm not sure it's actually true. Staff is always very friendly. I wish they were able to be faster but I think it's just a volume issue as they always seem adequately staffed.

This is definitely the best Starbucks in the Goleta area. The baristas are fast and make the best drinks. Also, their iced coffee is much better and much stronger than the iced coffee at the Fairview location. This one is also huge and has great wifi. They have really stepped up their game in the past few years.

Teenage girl barista chatting with teenage girl customers for three minutes about nothing in particular while I thought their coffees were being made. Then she took their orders. Reminded me of the "erhmagerd" meme. And I was jetlagged. Just did a redeye. And desperately in need of coffee. 

I was seconds away from throwing tables.

FINALLY got to place my order and it was a standard interaction from that point forward. But seriously, talk to your friends in study hall, not when there's a line in a coffee shop on a REALLY slow morning.
Large Starbucks with plenty of areas to study. Quick service. Kind staff. Clean store, and in a shopping center with plenty of other shops.

Lots of seating, though it does get cramped before dinnertime.  FYI - Stay away after school hours if you don't want to be surrounded by middle/high schoolers.

I like the layout of this Starbucks better than most.  There's areas for group/hangout, and areas for individual work... and a fireplace.

Working in a coffee shop now for over 2 years, you learn that customer service is everything. It's frustrating to me that my coworkers and I are constantly being encouraged to be engaging with customers and be friendly and the same ideals aren't carried over to Starbucks, well, this Starbucks. I come nearly every morning on my way to class and the same morning crew is always there- the blonde lady and the 2 young men who look like they may be related. They are never friendly, never engaging, never worried about getting drinks out quickly, and never going to be receiving a tip from me. I won't be coming back to this Starbucks anymore. I'm extrememely fed up with these employees. If your job is so miserable, find another route of employement

This run-of-the-mill Starbucks has outdoor seating with misters, which has been a treat on several triple degree weather days here in Tucson.  I've only been here on the weekends, where it's usually been moderately busy.  But the employees seem to be as organized & efficient as any other Starbucks.

Did I mention the misters?

This is definitely my 2nd home in Philly. I live just one block away, so it's not unusual for me to spend 3 hours a day here doing work. Most of the staff are totally cool - one person definitely irks me though. She just isn't friendly and likes to make a ton of noise an hour before closing to make people leave. 

I love that there are lots of places to sit, lots of outlets, and most of the sitting area is away from the noisy counter. 

The only thing I wish was that they made better chai lattes. I'll have to say that if you want your drink done right, go to the 12th and walnut starbucks. That was my go to place until my wallet was stolen there 2 years ago. I have been there once or twice and savor the chai when I go there, but that whole experience turned me off to that location.

Thanks 10th and Chestnut for being my home away from home!

The quality of drinks is always on top of the game! Customer service depends on who takes your order. I just went through the drive thru and ordered a green tea frappe and it's delicious! The lady who took our order was extremely well spoken and very polite. Something that I have noticed about this location is the drinks are never filled to the top and a couple of ounces of room is always left which is irritating when you pay 6 dollars for a drink.
4 pumps do not rhyme with 1 pump. Starbucks in Nevada is no different than the ones in California. They mess up your order all the time.
Tiny place inside the casino with a beautiful interior and ceiling. Employees are so friendly.
Wait times a little long but the employees that work there are super chill and friendly. Thumbs up for them!

When I was a regular customer, the staff were always friendly and made every effort to make sure I felt welcomed in the store. They always went above and beyond for me, and they never failed to put a smile on my face. Some of my closest friends came from this store, and I couldn't imagine my life without them. :) Hands down the best Starbucks location ever!
Friendly fast service and a well-made drink = a happy stop on the way to the office
What can I say about Statbucks that we do not already know. This is a really nice location behind the Aloft Hotel. Service and the staff were great. Location looks fairly new. Great meet up spot.

I really, really don't like to complain given the over-the-top friendliness of the place. But in the span of an hour I notified two different baristas of the lack of toilet paper in one john and the shortage in the other. To make my experience worse the bottom of my coffee was maybe an eighth inch of grinds. Sorry to be a whiner but thought it might help keep this from happening in the future. I informed the manager and he stated that they were understaffed.
The fast food industry is tough. These baristas work hard to deliver food/beverages efficiently as well as provide a pleasant customer experience.
Great service. Always on top of orders and friendly. Clean facilities. They make the drinks right at this location.

Considering this is a new location the staff is pretty bad.  My most recent visit Kayleigh was rude to a customer and the problem was 100% her error.  This time they forgot my scones and when I asked got nasty with me..

A great place to unwind, relax, and enjoy a good cup of coffee, tea, or even a bite to eat. The staff is very friendly and helpful. It is clean and welcoming. Never had an issue. I never felt rushed to leave either. Sometimes I enjoy reading or book or studying for school, just for a change of scenery. It is a quiet, peaceful place to be for a break. Good beverages and snacks as well. I have always enjoyed my time here. Good location as well if one had time or the desire to check out other local places to eat or explore.

Usually the service they provide at this Starbucks location is great. However, the past 2 times that i used my Starbucks app and ordered my food and drink ahead of time so that i could just run in and pick it up, (because im running late for school) they didn't even check to see if they had any orders so it wasn't ready for me at all. Not cool guys! So be careful if you're using the app.

They never get my goddamn order right!!
How hard is it to make an iced coffee with no ice! Come on Starbucks wake up and make my order right, also this Starbucks usually has a long line of people waiting to order that reaches all the way to the door. This Starbucks is usually very crowded and 8 times out of 10 my drink order will be wrong. My girlfriend tells me she doesn't want to go to this one because they always make her drink wrong. Shame on you Starbucks staff please start putting more effort into your job and make what the customer is paying for.

Used to be my fav Starbucks location. Not no more after they forgot to fill my mobile order and made me stand and wait for 20 minutes then instead apologizing & admit that they f*cked up the Manager made up excuses. I really hate that! I was pissed to see the customers who ordered inside after I had arrived received their drinks first. They didn't make my drink until I inquired. Turns out my order was still in the receipt register and no one bothered to pick it up. One of the manager's excuses was that they don't always hear the machine print because it's so loud. Then figure out another system! 

Another thing about this location is the new unfriendly faces. I hope other locations are better as I am a gold member.
Not bad, plenty of seating allowing you to work as you enjoy a beverage and snack. Been here numerous time and they seem to have issues handle cold mobile order; they get lost and you wait forever.

I've got to update this review to five stars. This Starbucks, and the people working at it, are truly awesome. 

I can now legitimately call myself a regular (much to my wallet's chagrin), and I've had a chance to see the staff in action on a daily basis. They are extremely friendly, know their customers by name, remember drink orders and have them ready by the time you've made it to the register, etc. -- all the customer service stuff you expect from the best.
Solid, dependable, predictable coffee. Not the best, but certainly very good.

This is a nice Starbucks, but it's always very COLD in this location.  The staff doesn't seem to care that everyone who is sitting there is wearing their coats, scarfs, and gloves (me included) while sipping on their coffee.   I understand some coffee shops do that to shush people away when it's crowded, but this store is usually pretty empty.  So if you are one of those people who loves to sip your coffee in a 38 F degree place, this is for you.  But if you are like me and the majority of people who rather be in a 68-70F store, run away from this place.

Okay, lets start with the cleanliness of the store.   There is trash overflowing the trash receptacles, there is trash on the floor, the tables are dirty, the area where the employees are preparing the drinks and food looks like a bomb went off.

Now on to service where, I could allow the cleanliness of the store to slide a little if the service had been outstanding.  Sadly it was not.   For some unknown reason this Starbucks has decided that the person working the register should also be the person preparing the order.  Note to management,"THIS DOES NOT WORK!" Just like ALL the other Starbucks I have been to around the world, your register people take the orders and keep your line moving.   Having people stand in line waiting endlessly for someone to take their order pisses people off more than people having to wait for their orders.

Let's move on to the Special giveaway today - When asked about the Reusable Cup giveaway Dustin (WHO IS A STAND OUT AT CUSTOMER SERVICE) asked the harpy who appeared to be the manager about the promotion. Her snippy response to him was We're out. Now I could see if I cam into the store at 1-2 in the afternoon and asked about getting a promotional item but when you get to the store at 10am the expectation is that they should have had sufficient stock on hand to accommodate at least the folks who are in the store early.  Shame on you!

Get it together people, this is no way to run a Starbucks.   Wanna see how it's done?   Go to Justison Landing store.

Not a fan of this starbucks.  It was just "ok" LONG wait for a iced mocha....   and no drive thru

But it is close to UTLA
Very rude barista. I was quite surprised, never been treated rudely at a Starbucks before.  Stay away from this location.

Great coffee, great employees, and a great study atmosphere causes this starbucks to top my list of the best starbucks to study at. They always nail my drink order, and always do it with a smile on their faces and delightful conversation. Although sometimes a little crowded, I always find myself coming back for more.
This place is a disaster super slow, can't wait until the one in Villanova opens. Packing is a nightmare

I've worked for Starbucks for about 4 years, I understand the rush of people, etc..the person at the register and the barista on the main bar were great and had a positive attitude. The cold bar barista looked like she hated her life! I understand cold drinks take a little more work but man, she looked at my order and just sat there for a couple mins and said under her breath, "I don't wanna do this" it was an iced green tea latte. She didn't do it to standards and as a former barista, that's disappointing. Maybe she'll have a better attitude soon, probably not though.

Really disappointing!!!! 
Being a frequent Starbucks customer, I can appreciate that sometimes things might go wrong. But I came to this Starbucks at 3pm on a Wednesday, and it was depressingly bad! If I hadn't been trying to make a movie, i would have brought my drinks back and asked for a refund. I wouldn't even have trusted them to remake them. The barista taking my order was unfriendly, but at least accurate. The barista on bar was terrible! She kept stopping to talk to her co-workers, and had no ability to multitask. She just stood there talking while 4 drinks sat there, waiting to be made. When she got to my first drink, she stopped to comment on how weird it looked (I got an iced latte made with heavy cream bc of special eating restrictions I have). I really don't appreciate my drink being a topic of discussion. She then forgot to top it with whipped cream, even though it was clearly written on the cup. When I asked her to please add the whip, she huffed and acted like it was a huge request, and like it was my fault. She checked the cup, and when she saw that it was her error she huffed a bit more but closed her mouth and fixed it. She removed the flat lid and replaced it with a dome lid, and then stuck the whip cream container inside the cup and overfilled it. Isn't that a health code violation?? 
Then she started on my second drink, a cold brew with light ice. Seems simple, right? Well cold brew is supposed to be cut with water, and she didn't do that; she poured straight cold brew into my cup, added no water, and then a little bit of ice. It was like battery acid!!!!! It was disgusting!!!! 
The condiment bar was FILTHY. The trash was overflowing, the counter was covered in spilled coffee and milk, and trash, and instead of a sugar container, there was a half-empty bag of sugar sitting there.
The attitude and demeanor of the 3 employees working was horrible, negative, and lazy. They spent most of their time talking amongst themselves, and had almost no interactions with their customers. All of them looked irritated and miserable, and acted like every customer was an inconvenience. The drinks were made wrong and were disgusting. And everything was dirty. I will never go to this location again.

New Starbucks location in the lobby of the Marriott. More of an open air spot with a few tables and chairs on each side. Located in the lobby just outside the skywalk to the convention center. Full menu of pastries, breakfast/lunch sandwiches, free newspapers, and snacks. There is even a toaster set up for bagels that customers can use. Free wifi too. Staff is a bit slow here though - and it was in mid afternoon when empty. Speed it up - I'm an impatient New Yorker!
Very slow. Went to the front of the line about 20 minutes ago and still haven't gotten my drink. Baristas making 1 drink every 3 minutes.

Worst Starbucks ever
Slow service and wrong items and drinks after 40 minute wait 
Got to be better 
I'll be back at PJ or Cc
Rude, inexperienced staff and always out of White mocha.Had to make my drink three times and still did not get it right.

Great place to grab a cup of corporate coffee and read a book or work.  The seating is pretty good for the area, the interior is always clean, and the outside is great for people watching.  I prefer going in on the evenings when it's not too crowded, though the lines can pick up on weekend afternoons. The only annoyance I've had with this location is the WiFi's glitchiness.  It's bothersome when going to the shop soley to work over the internet and finding it not working for no reason.  Again, that's minor.  The staff have always been friendly to me and they get my drinks fairly fast.  It's Starbucks, so there's no surprises with their fares and no use discussing them.

I'm so glad that a Starbucks finally opened by my office! But unfortunately it doesn't make a difference if the drinks aren't made correctly. I've been to this Starbucks before and everything was fine. Customer service was great and my drink was made correctly. Today when I went, the girl asked me for my order three times then comes back and ask me if my order has been taken. I drive up to the window to pay and my drink hasn't even been made. The barista asked the girl taking the order what my drink order was to make it. I understand that they just recently opened but orders should already being made when I ordered and not asked when I get to the window. I get to my office and my Honey Citrus Mint tea taste like water. Not including the girl gave me my hot cup without a sleeve where I had to ask for one. I hope everything improves but I will not being going back.

A lot of students at this location but they have a great selection of outdoor seating. Even benches. We went in, it was really busy but our drinks were made quickly and we were in and out in less than 10 minutes.

I love Starbucks and I travel a lot for work. Usually finding a Starbucks is easy on my travels. Lucky for me this trip, there was a REAL (not those fake ones) in my hotel lobby. I was more than pleased and even got a coffee before checking into my room. However, it did not have the true Starbucks feel and the staff was not up to par. But nonetheless I got my coffee every morning hot and delicious.
Closes at 9pm in Saturday night on the beach, summer time. According to google the are open till 10pm.

Very disappointed in this Starbucks. Ive been going here for years and as of recent it's been such a terrible experience every single time. As a Starbucks partner I pride myself in the quality of the drinks made and the efficient time but clearly they don't understand that. They are too caught up in side conversations and are just terribly slow that they do everything so carelessly. I really tried to give this place the benefit of the doubt but it's just terrible.
To be fair, raising stars back, since have been back several times, and have not encountered the same sour barista. Everyone else has earned respect for a job well done!
First review! The place opened today and looks great. It's about time we had a coffee shop in the neighborhood.
Terrible service. Twice I've gone here and they didn't get my order right both times. I refuse to come back to this Starbucks again.
It's tight quarters, but it's a good Starbucks with fast service and a great location. There are always students studying here. Something about the design makes it feel more "urban." It's unique!

I have hit this Starbucks twice on my way to work during not so busy times and wow, the service is slow! The first time I came there were 4 baristas working and only one of them making drinks...taking his sweet time making them too. I came again for a second time about a week later and the service was still slow. I have always been impressed with every Starbucks I've been too & their timeliness but this one in particular was shockingly so sloooowww!
Love Starbucks & the wonderful coffees available. The staff is courteous & professional :)

I'm not quite sure what it is about this place, but even when this bucks is slow, it still takes an eternity to get your drink order. I have had to wait about 8-16 minutes at different times just for an iced coffee. Compared to my usual bucks in Boston that I just came from, this seems unorganized.

Update:
From coming here more often, I'm noticing this place is chronically understaffed during peak hours. I feel bad for the baristas because they can hardly keep up when the lines get so long. It leaves me wondering, where is management during all this?

I'm adding an extra star for the baristas that work as hard as they do.

Nice baristas, usual drink and food options for a starbucks. 
I enjoy this location because they have a really long, communal table where it's easy to plop down and study for hours while getting free refills with my gold card. I'm sure they're plenty used to this because the place is packed with UCSB students every time i'm there. I never get any attitude about it and I really appreciate the ambiance. 

I do agree about the temperature, but I usually just bring a jacket and slow down on my iced coffee.
Free wifi, lots of seats and a great location, what more can you say about Starbucks?
Annoying girl that answers the drive-through I need my coffee before I hear that kind of stuff. Needs to work on her comedy somewhere else

$9.80 for a ham egg and cheese on an English muffin??  HELL NO!!!  It's a FauxBucks that charges room service prices. Doesn't take the Starbucks app and the ladies behind the counter couldn't care less about  anything.   Go outside to the building directly in front of the Westin. The Starbucks there is 100x better!!!

This is my favorite Starbucks in Delaware. The inside is always clean. They are always stocked with my favorite brownies when I want one. They are always professional.

I like their adequate staff and this is the only drive-thru that I have seen in DE so far so that is a plus! However, the cleanliness around the perimeter of the store needs help. I saw the same iced grande half-filled latte sitting on the curb (between the 3rd & 4th parking spaces on the right) for about 3 weeks. This sounds strange but I have been coming here weekly with my daughter since the middle of November.

All in all I just picked it up yesterday and kept moving. I love this company and recommend this location.

We visited this Starbucks in the evening. It was pretty spacious but that could be because I'm used to NYC-sized Starbucks. The bathroom could've been cleaner and parking was a little hard to find. 

I don't necessarily blame them for this, but there were groups of rowdy kids just hanging around since there was a PokeStop nearby. It was annoying, so we took our order to go.

The employees were cool. Everything else was pretty standard for Starbucks.

this starbucks is one of my all time favorite locations in the Bay area.  The staff is always extremely friendly, they repeat my order back to me for correct construction, and most importantly, they remember my name.  (I'm not a daily customer, so I value this immensely)  
The parking is very limited at this location, but I'm usually a drive thru customer so it doesn't bother me too much.  
I've been inside for meetings and I've found the lobby to be smaller than some Starbucks, but it's always been clean and well maintained.  I cannot imagine much to improve on the already stellar setting, other than an expansion to the property.  
All around, this is a top notch Starbucks and I'll continue to call them my friendly neighborhood baristas.

Got my coffee through the drive thru and when I pulled and got to the red light I went to drink it and realize it was only 3/4 full.. couldn't turn back.. when I tried to contact Starbucks, I got no response.. No more venti's from there for me .. great CS STARBUCKS !!! NOT
This is my favorite Starbucks in town. The baristas always have a positive attitude and they are super fast. This is why I keep coming here everyday.

We went to this Starbucks about a month ago & a bit disappointed!
My latte was good, the baristas very nice, but what I didn't like was how dirty it was.
No one cleaned the tables which is disgusting,
Thought it might be better outside...nope!
Tables had not been cleaned either!
Come on, it doesn't take much to clean a table!
Lots of coffee places to choose from, prob won't go back!

This is a great location for a Starbucks, in the center of everything. This location has become such a staple for the community by participating in local events and supplying power to most of the town when the power goes out everywhere else. The only downside is the kids that hang out on the porch. I don't mind the loitering, but their behavior and language is what's off-putting.

Conveniently located inside the Marriott near the elevator for the parking garage. This Starbucks is like an open counter and you can just sit in the lobby of the hotel to enjoy your drink or food. 

I came down around 8:45 am the line for Starbucks was long! There were about 30 people waiting. Once the line died down I was greeted and got a nice strawberry acai drink. So good and the ladies there were so nice.

Why is it so hard for servers to get an order right?  I ask for coffee and a sandwich on a plate.  That is two items.  Time after time, my plate request is ignored no matter how much I emphasize when ordering.  There are only two possible explanations:  They don't care or they are incompetent.  I guess saving 75-100 bags a year is not an issue at the prices they charge.
Comments?
this Starbucks is utterly disgusting; truly gross. It was infested by gnats which meant that everywhere we went had bugs. My food had gnats in it, the bathroom had gnats in it.

Parking can be a chore but this is your typical Starbucks.  This place gets quite busy and seating is very limited.   Sometimes you have to sit on someone's lap, and vice versa.  So if there is nowhere to sit.. just pony on up...
"Excuse me miss...mind if I sit on ya?!"  (best to use a wee irish accent)

otherwise yeah.. it's nice and refreshing to go here and realize you got a proper coffee with espresso and the right flavor, whipped cream like you asked, etc etc.  and be happy you are not at Dunkin Donuts!

I'm giving 4 stars because its a franchise, chain, boring run of the mill deal. Nothing here more exciting than a Venti Caramel latte.

For fun I always order the "supersize" and they look at me wierd.  I tell them to supersize every frickin thing... they just look at me again, wierdly.    Meanwhile, many of their baked goods are actually mini's.  Small teeny tiny versions of their counterparts in the non-starbucks world, yet cost 2x as much! hooray!
Who doesn't love blowing their wad on a cup of coffee which is mostly ice, if you get the iced which I always do, and an assortment of mini bakery items.     

Someone once told me Starbucks was founded by a hobbit.  Suddenly all the mini baked goods make sense!  It's by little ppl for little ppl!

Service was not great, forgot part of the order, got upset when asked about it , then still got it wrong. Drink was not full to the point the server commented that that she didn't know why it kept shorting the glasses ??? No she did not rectify it. First bad service in Reno from Starbucks! Hopefully just a bad day or all new employees......

I can't stand Starbucks at all and I try to avoid Starbucks at all times

I needed to refresh my make up before going to a concert last night and I came in and got a protein plate and a passionfruit iced tea and the service was fast and friendly and the café was pretty large bathroom was clean and there was plenty of parking I would say that this is one of the better Starbucks that I have ever been to

This is a smallest location I've been in. Its kinda tight (including the parking) especially if it's crowded. Seating to the left as you walk in, with community table and lined up tables lined up on the windows. Fortunately, it hasn't been crowded during my visits. 

Ordered a pink purple ombré drink:

Bottom half
Strawberry acai refresher
Coconut milk
Strawberries 

Top Half
Passion ice tea
Soy Milk
Vanilla syrup 
Blackberries 

I really didn't want to explain how to make it and to my surprise, I didn't need too. The barista knew exactly what I wanted and wasn't annoyed with making it. Which is a plus because I usually get a rolled eye or two. A little worried it wouldn't be right but I was pleasantly surprised that it was. 

At the end of the day... Yes, I'll stop back in if/when I'm in the area.

Not my favorite place to come and enjoy a cup of coffee or study but it is still a good place. Generally clean and the wi-fi is average speed as well. As for their drinks, it really varies on what barista you get. I usually get the iced caramel macchiato with soy milk and most of the time it is good. Definitely not the best place to study during midterm season, gets crowded and loud. Excellent for sitting outside on a beautiful day and enjoying a cup of coffee.

Although I try to stick with locally owned coffee houses, this is probably my favorite Starbucks in Reno. It isn't in the best location. It is not surrounded by a good view; it's right on the side of Greg Street in a rather run down, little shopping area. But, for me, this location is in a good spot. I take the route along this area often and since this Starbucks has a drive-thru, I can just swing in and get a cup of coffee or one of their other infamous beverages. (My favorite is their Passionfruit Shaken Iced Tea Lemonade! Yum!) Every single time I have been here I have been satisfied with the customer service. The staff is polite, professional and they run the drive-thru well. (I have never actually stayed for coffee here. I think there are many other more pleasant Starbucks locations, in Reno, if you're wanting to kick back and sip on something tasty.) They are fairly quick, with getting you your order, much quicker than anytime I have actually been inside of a Starbucks. Even when there are a few cars, in front of me, I've never had to wait more than about ten minutes. The drinks have always been mixed-well and held up the taste you expect, from Starbucks.
