As far at the drive-thru goes, they are A-OK!
Ridiculously long lines. Good selection. Great food. Nice outdoor seating. Service not that efficient.

The best thing about this Starbucks on Main Street, Doylestown, is the front elevation from the street. It occupies a historic building that dominates a key intersection in the Borough.  Very attractive. 

Sadly, that is where the positives end.  Inside, the layout is dreary. Dark on the brightest days, it feels like a morose ghost inhabits it, making for a sense of weariness. The coffee at all Star$$$ is universally bad, and it is no different here. It forces you to upgrade to an expensive alternative to regular coffee, a perverse upsell that seems to work everywhere. The pleasantness of the staff is helpful, but cannot overcome the down energy that is ever present. 

Many better choices in town, perhaps why the shop was not overly busy while life on the streets around it was jumping.
Served me cold coffee! I was in a rush and mobile ordered and didn't have time to go back in but that's a disgrace!

Staff was very genuinely friendly and accommodating. I ordered a lime refresher and didn't like it so a staff member happily made me a very berry hibiscus one instead. This is also a pretty large Starbucks. The only thing I didn't like were the bench seating directly in front of the registers. They were awkward and uncomfortable and directly in front of you are people ordering their drinks. Other than that this place is great.

This review is for the Doylestown Starbucks in the historic Fountain House - that for years & years was a bank.

As you may know - if you read my reviews - I am not a big Fourbucks (aka Charbucks) fan, but this location - smack-dab in the middle of town - is a keeper.  The multiple room layout makes for a good spot to cozy up with a (burnt tasting overpirced)  coffee drink.

My little daughter likes the iced green tea lemonade.

A nice location with decent service for a Starbucks.  About as good as a Starbucks can get.  (Oh and boy, can it get crowded with yuppies!).

The coffee is always good here and they have one big couch and 6 comfy chairs, as well as two long tables for working on.  That's more furniture than most of the *$$ in the area.  Only complaint is that sometimes the homeless and halfway house folk sleep in the comfy chairs in the back.  Around the corner from the main counter, nobody really notices how long your there.

If you're driving here with no hands, then perhaps you should Steer-bucks.

I really like this mall but I do not really like this Starbucks. The employees were okay but I could not believe how much they were charging my girl for a frozen blended drink. Inevitably, she gave me some, and it really just tasted like ice with a little sugar and milk in it. I could have sworn these drinks were better a few years ago. Maybe it's just this location. One extra star for the friendly employees.

Best Place to grab a coffee in chestnut hill. Im not sure why butt hurt drama queen liberal from good old flint,mi is so upset about @Erica A. But she needs to go back to her home state. 
The staff is super friendly and show they do care about their customers. Would highly recomend stopping buy while you window shop in lovely little Chestnut Hill Area. #phillylove #starbucksrocks

The worst f*cking place ever.. How the drive thru around the corner no one inside. I go inside order 2 coffees and f*cking 10mins later I'm still waiting.. GET THE FUCK OUT OF HERE.. I'LL STICK TO DUNKIN DONUTS.. RIDICULOUS 10 MIN WAIT FOR COFFEE.. OH AT 620 IN THE MORNING..

Drive through is horrible every time I come even when there isn't a line. I usually avoid this location due to the long wait time but today I decided to come inside and received some of the worst customer service; the cashier didn't even acknowledge me until she was done with her conversation and just stared at me with vacant eyes. I will say the tall gentleman that gave me my drink had great customer service.

I live no where near this location , but was told that it's a great location. It's right near the mall and nordstrom rack, so while shopping one day I decided to go in to get my drink. Absolutely one of the nicer Starbucks. People were so friendly. I went in yesterday and the barista was one of the friendliest employees I think I've ever encountered at any location. He was upbeat, and made conversation while making drinks. Asked how our day was.  Really nice!

This place used to rock.  But now the drive they takes 5x as long as it used to and you end up with a horrible drink.  Why not go inside if the drive thru is so long you may think?  It's no different inside, except there you get to see the disgruntled staff making you crispy drink.

Time for me to head on down the road an extra mile.  Sigh.  I was here the first day this place opened up almost 10 years ago and sadly and it's time to move on. Hopefully the management team get the staffing and quality issues under control because I will miss my home Starbucks

The baristas here don't know what they are doing. My iced coffees are usually warm when I get them at this location. My last venti was not even full. I had to tell them to fill the extra inch. Slow down a little and focus on quality over speed.

Something I like about Starbucks is its consistency. You can go to any Starbucks and know exactly how your favorite beverage will taste. There are coffee shop chains in New Orleans with wildly different tastes across the city. This one is no different. It's good coffee with the usual not speedy but deal-able wait time. 

My complaint - and what has moved me to leave a review is the temperature. This is the COLDEST coffee shop ever! I've seen people bring blankets in here! It doesn't matter if it's winter or summer, it's always freezing. Maybe it's supposed to keep turnover high, I don't know. If so, it doesn't work. But I do wish they would make it more comfortable!!!!
I get that your busy, but please just poor the extra Caramel in my americano as requested without the passive aggressive lecture on how to properly order extra Caramel. Please and Thank You!
Seriously the SLOWEST Starbucks ever! There's always a ton of people working yet it takes 15 min to get an americano. Don't even get me started on the drive thru.
Nice new store, but good help is hard to find I guess... bad service, bunch of kids mulling about, but only two really "working"

Starbucks is a must in a community and a person should have the same welcome feeling while entering every location. I did not feel this continuity when visiting this location by the Park Place Mall. The Baristas did not make me feel very welcomed and when a mistake was made with my drink I received a look of dismay not a, "We are sorry, please enjoy your visit." Overall, the drink was made well (the second time) and the experience did not have any other hiccups.

Commercialization is everywhere in this area of South Jersey, but it's almost necessary to talk up the recent Centerton Square businesses and particularly Starbucks. Three words:

Twenty-four. hour. caffeine.

24-hour caffeine served in a comfortable setting (although all Starbucks could use more counches/comfy chairs) with the New York Times at your finger tips and muffins and cookies of all sorts. Granted it's pretty cold inside for whatever reason and it IS Starbucks (hence 4 stars instead of 5) but it's nice to have around. 

And, in attempts to mutate into something with a more personal appeal perhaps, this Starbucks hosted a night of local musical performances the evening before Thanksgiving. Doubtful that Corporate came up with the idea, but they agreed to it! Kudos for that at least, as perverse as it seems.

Standard hotel Starbucks - coffee and food is what you'd expect. Also expect to wait in line. Slow. Very slow service. There is another coffee shop in the hotel with reasonable coffee, wide variety of food options, and is super quick. Highly recommend walking 50 ft across the lobby to save yourself 15 minutes.
Angela makes the best coffee in the joint!!!  Ask for her or Jessica to get your lattes done right!

There are a few places I actually enjoy the drive through more than going inside. I live up the road and when I need an injection of caffeine quickly this is my spot. The baristas are friendly and when you come once a week they will remember your order which I appreciate a little above and beyond. I get a very basic iced coffee, but it is still served with a smile and they have always been very professional.

Like many Starbucks locations, this store utilizes the automatic printed ticket for marking drinks. While this is no doubt an effective way to correctly craft your desired beverage, it often times comes at a lack of convenience as technology often frustrates users.  On Saturday morning, I came in when there were two people waiting on drinks and no one in line. It was a very moderate morning in terms of customers. Nonetheless, it took 15 minutes to receive my drink because the ticket did not print. Three people received their drinks even though the had ordered after me. Of course, the real issue is that I had received one of my drinks very quickly, yet I was waiting on another. I eventually had to let the barista know why I was waiting. Overall, this was an unpleasant experience.

Why couldn't you be in downtown Tucson when I needed you to be?  It was awfully annoying to drive all the way outside of downtown when I could have used you right on a corner by the convention center.  As far as Starbucks go, you are like every other one in the world.  Consistent.  The same.  Caffeinated.  

Oh, and you were better than Ike's.  That coffee was awful.  

But not better than Cafe Passe.  That place was AMAZING.

Consistent. That's how I'd sum up all my experiences at Starbucks. No matter which location I visit, I can say with some pretty strong certainty that I know what my beverage will taste like, as well as what type of atmosphere and service I can expect. Considering all that has held true across the number of locations I've visited, some of which were outside of the US, I'm pretty impressive.

About the only thing I see changing from location to location is the variety of seating options available, and as this Sparks location is a bit smaller than most in the area, I was impressed with the mix of comfortable, lounge type furniture, tables and chairs, and outdoor patio seating they offered. I found myself a quiet corner near a window, complete with a cushioned chair and ottoman, and enjoyed the natural light while I took a call and completed some computer work.

At the counter, I tried to order the elusive Starbucks Cold Brew (limited availability at all locations) and failed, so I settled on iced coffee and a really big glass of water. From the time I ordered to the time I got my order it was mere minutes, if that, and my order was taken and delivered with a big smile. 

Watching the staff work with each other, it seemed this team was a bit more connected to each other than some other locations I've visited. They also appeared to genuinely love their jobs, which is something that makes the experience better for customers in the long run.  

Since I've gotten more into speciality coffee shops from the smaller, locally owned businesses, my visits to Starbucks have definitely decreased, but this stop was a reminder of how great they can be when you need a quick afternoon pick me up and a place to put down and get some work done.

I just sat in my car for 10 minutes in the drive-through with only two other cars in front of me!  I have to say I was surprised when I got to the window to get my drink and not only was I not offered my drink for free, I was not offered an apology or quick explanation for the wait. 

There clearly had been an issue with the minivan in front of the car in front of me, but when this type of thing happens at other restaurant drive-throughs, one of two things always happens, they have the car causing the holdup to pull forward so others in line can get their orders and move on, or they apologize for the delay and give you your order for free. Very disappointed that neither of these options was considered tonight.
This is a difficult Starbucks to park at...you will likely need to find street parking or park in the lot one block down across the street. Small space, good service.
These guys are perfect for a fashion mall! Trendy hip baristas that understand individualized attention! Thanks guys, you're rad!

I ordered two coffees with cream and sugar in the drive thru and waited for 15 minutes....upon receiving our coffees only to find out after we drove off that they were black. We went back and the gurl who was working the front Ariel...ws not helpful at all...needless to say we were late for our event and will not be you g to Starbucks anymore...i am a dunkin fan..
Great place to grab breakfast on the run. They provide a good fix for all caffeine junkies wether you like it hot or cold.
Employees are pleasant but I sure wish they would clean the place up. Always good coffee and in a really nice location.

I prefer Starbucks over PJ's but this location needs a lot of help. Too often I place a mobile order and they don't have what I ordered. In February,  I was able to mobile order Valentine's cookies and they were out. They were over $20 and I didn't have time to wait for them to refund me as I was on my way to a meeting. Today they are out of cold brew and nitro.  Had to wait in line for a refund. I'm a bit annoyed at this point. I know it's a new location but seriously get it together people! I usually plan my travels to stop at the one by lakeside so shame on me for giving this one another try. I'll update my review IF things improve. SMDH!

I have come to this location multiple times hoping my experience will be different than the last, but nope. I seem to have to bad experience each time I visit this location. The staff are not very friendly (I understand it can be a tough job, but a little kindness can go a long way). My order has either been messed up or the staff forgot to make it and this has happened nearly each time. This happened even when I've used the mobile app to place an order. The times I have ordered inside the store have been no different. The customer service is terrible and I have often been ignored by the cashier and other staff. I have finally learned my lesson and will avoid this location at all costs. The staff deserves to be treated with kindness, but so do customers.

As of today it appears that Philadelphia Licenses & Inspections has temporarily closed the location for a few days due to repeated health code violations. The details are at https://pa.healthinspections.us/_templates/551/RetailFood/_report_full.cfm?inspectionID=9EAB03DB-5056-A20F-9EDB7D73831AD68D&domainID=551&userID=0. Hopefully this can be rectified quickly.

The Starbucks is the best! Their singing barista is a sweetheart and they are one of the fastest Starbucks drive thrus around! On a busy work morning they brighten your day, quickly give you your coffee and you leave with a smile along with your caffeine fix!

I really think this location can use some improvements. First of all, I am sitting here in front of the baristas and instead of restocking the pastries (which is missing lots of items), they are talking and hanging out. The baristas are not the friendliest, they have very low energy and some have an attitude. The bathroom is very dirty. I was so grossed out by it that I decided against my latte and went with tea instead (less contact with my drink). This could be a really cool Starbucks and it honestly needs a lot of work with the crew. Too bad this is the only coffee place open late.

Walk inside there was no customer, the two girl that work there was talking and talking, customer service was bad , no one really approach to us. I order the Hot Mocha with little whip cream on top.. I got my order and walked out from there and as I was sipping it... it was cold cold like the water they use for it was never boil.. was very disappointed because Starbucks suppose to be good!!! What the hell happen to this location.. it's like the people they hire to work for them didn't wanna work but just to finish their 8 hour shift there. Don't EVER go to this Starbucks location! Be aware!!!! Nasty a$$ drinks!!! Cold and nasty, can't taste any favor! Had to add my own stuff to make it a lil better, but still tasted nasty!! didn't really drink much from it!!! Toss into the trash! Waste my money only!!!

Alright this time I had the pleasure of checking out the indoors. As usual, it was packed on this Sunday morning but the interior was deceptively larger than I expected - there was a good mix of seating indoors (large rectangular tables, small round cafe tables, and squishy sofas). The patio had 2-3 tables too and both have ADA options. 

The women's bathroom was OOS during my study session so I ended up using the men's which is identical to the women's and even has a changing table! Huzzah!

Two things I'm going to be nit picky about - there weren't that many accessible outlets, especially near the handicapped tables. The other was that the AC was on fulllll blast- so much that the window shades and their metal beady pulleys were flapping about (see video). I left before I got to finish by drink because despite sitting by a sunny window, wearing long pants and a puffer vest, I was still freezing my bum :( 

I'm sticking with a solid 3 here now that I've seen both the drive thru and inside cafe.

Of all the Starbucks in town, this is my go-to location. It helps that it's the closest location, but really it's about the staff. For the most part everyone that works here is very friendly. I've gotten to know a few of them over the years, and it's nice to go somewhere where you are recognized. 

I've gone to various coffee shops around town, and Starbucks is the most consistent in the way it makes its drinks. I just wish the atmosphere was more unique and had more character.
Great location and friendly staff but are usually out of the assorted sandwiches that every Starbucks should carry.
Brand new and very clean, nice decor/furniture. Service is very nice. Plenty of seats at the tables or couches. Can't ask for much more from a Starbucks!

I went inside to go study today around 4pm. I asked for a decaf coffee. Needless to say, I'm writing this review at 1:39am. I DID NOT get a decaf coffee. Also, I never had a problem at this location till the managers changed. I've had issues with baristas arguing with me when I ask for a knife for my bagel. Ive also had repetitive baristas that seem unhappy. Their interaction with customers translates as unhappy as well. Wish I could give this location less then 1 star.

I was really excited that they FINALLY built a Starbucks for the Jersey to Philly commuters down route 38. For years driving to high school and now medical school, there was only a gross Dunkin donuts. I stopped here this AM and was pleased with this Starbucks. It has a drive through for the days you feel really lazy. The interior is cozy, with a few high tables, couches, and a gorgeous long wood table, perfect for communal studying. The wait for my drink was longer than I had expected, but that was due to the flurry of drive through orders they were filling. Next time I will order ahead on my app! For the location and interior of the place, 4 starts is warranted!
Typical but clean friendly location. Location very near the Wilmington Riverfront is a plus. Not much else around.
Always friendly, mostly timely, coffee pretty consistent. I enjoy going here for a daily latte.
Slowest location ever! I always have to wait like 15 minutes for my drink and there's only ever 1 person making the drinks at a time!

Really new Starbucks - drinks were made well, order taken quickly and correctly. There is also a drive-through.

Big windows allow for lots of natural light to come in. Big tables to do work on, and several executive looking chairs that probably belong in a hotel lobby more than a Starbucks, but that's okay.

I wish they'd put a trash can next to where you pick your drinks up. I wanted to toss my receipt and straw paper, but had to wait to get to the trash can by the milks and sugars across the way. That was the only trash I saw.

Overall, very nice location. Also right next door to the Greyhound station which is very nice.

Starbucks coffee is always my go to for a pick me up in the morning. Givin this one three stars because they always seem to be out of what I'm lookin for whether it's a chocolate chip cookie, bacon and egg sandwich or chocolate brownie! Other than that coffee is good.

Wow the service here was ... AMAZING how they are. Pumping out the drinks taking the orders! I have been coming here for the last couple days, I'm on business and staying at the Hilton. Also there was one girl her name was Victoria I believe, she made my drink twice and from then on I no longer had to explain my overly complicated drink.
Absolutely the best staff around. I review not just on product but on staff. Highly recommend Mocha Latte. Definitely awesome.

Ok, just putting it out there because every time I go, at least one of the peeps in front of me passes by the microphone to order and drives up tot he menu board.  Mind you, MOST places have the microphone to order ON the menu board.  Not at this Starbuck's.  So...the employee inside is yelling..."I cannot hear you, please speak up, or please repeat that".  The person in the car is yelling, "sorry, I pulled too far forward" and is hanging their head out yelling to order.  Unless you are a regular here...happens all the time.  Put a big green sign on the black tower to order from that is before the menu board.  Have it say "ORDER HERE".  We seriously take bets every time we go on the chances of a newbie ordering and passing up  and going to the menu board.   If I had a dollar....I tell ya.    This place is always busy and seems like they just do not staff accordingly.  I mean, come on, in this area, you know a Starbuck's will be hoppin.  Anyhew.  It is what it is.

Slow, slow, slow.
I went last Friday and there were 10 people behind the counter (6 with headphones for the drive thru).
That left 4 but only 1 person working the register.
Long line almost out the door and long line at drivethru.
Management needs to put a fire under it's workers.
Slowest Starbucks I've ever been to with the most workers.
A definite problem here.
Today, on a Sunday, another long line at drivethru with plenty of people behind the counter.
Waited forever for a simple, plain, latte.

Fast service, always very friendly. The mall can be a busy place. If the mall is busy you can bet Starbucks will have about 15 people in line. I'm not a big fan of Starbucks but this location always makes their drinks well and I've never been unsatisfied by their service or product.

Pretty standard Starbucks. I work across the street, so I usually order pick-up on my way to or from work. It seems a little small inside compared to other Starbucks and the parking can get a bit tight, but overall, no complaints! My drinks are prepared right and taste good!

When I lived in the neighborhood, I enjoyed spending time here for multiple reasons.  It's a cool space for hanging out, and the people who work there are always friendly  It's actually not a bad Starbucks for studying either; there is always a solid presence of students from the nearby high schools, colleges, and medical schools.  I'd say this one has more than the average number of seats and tables, but do expect it to get packed like any Starbucks would be throughout the day.  Also, the fireplace is a game changer! :)

Standard Starbucks, but they provide a nice library-like table for reading and working on your computer. That's worth an extra star.
Look at the photo of the table. I have Yelp on my computer screen.

This is my favorite Starbucks store in the entire area! I work in the same plaza and am here multiple times a week. The people who work here are extremely helpful and take the time to get to know you. They make conversation with you, suggestions on new drinks when asked and give their honest opinion. They want you to be fully satisfied with your order. I never have to feel bad about letting them know if something isn't made correctly. They apologize and just make it again for you. They are always smiling! I've ordered breakfast items here often. The red pepper egg bites and spinach feta wrap are my favs. There are many healthy items to choose from, however my Friday afternoon cheat snack is always a cake pop! It's extremely rare with how busy this store is that they are ever out of anything. The drinks I order here are the most consistent than any other Starbucks I visit. What I order is what I get and it tastes the same each time. It speaks for itself. There's a reason why seating is limited and parking is a challenge!

This location has been my go-to everyday the past year.  No doubt about the wonderful quality of the coffee or other products they offer.  The customer service here is beyond professional and friendly.  Everyone is super nice and kind.  Ray is my favorite person.  He always goes above and beyond to take good care of your drink and wellbeing. Today in particular, my clumsy self managed to drop my car's key fob into the trash can and Ray came to rescue.  Not only he fished my key out of bin, he sanitized it and made sure it worked.  I am not sure what Ray 's position at the company. I hope someone from corporate office read this and give Ray an opportunity to move up to the management position. I own a small business in Wyomissing and I always appreciate an employee like Ray.

This is a BUSY Starbucks so plan ahead if you're in a rush. I use the mobile app to order ahead for pick up so never an issue but the people are friendly and always say hello and thank you to me even when I'm just running in to pick up my order. They seem to move pretty quick and efficiently. I will mention, it's not the most ideally located store since it's next to a school so hectic in the mornings. There also is little parking/space so if you're trying to work there all day, I would definitely recommend a different location.

This location stands out from other Starbucks nearby because the employees are super nice. Large and clean. Otherwise, the expected Starbucks experience. Tip- sign up for the Starbucks app and create an account for a free birthday drink!
It may be new but the service is  the same slow mentality from the old location.  Go ahead and factor in at least 10 minutes in your schedule.

Starbucks is my go to caffeine fix in the morning!  While I never really have complaints about any Starbucks, this is my favorite one to go to.  The staff is super friendly and everything is always very clean!  It can get a bit crowded during the rush hours, but nothing unbearable... and besides, that's what ordering from the app is for, right??

Well they may all seem the same, but Kayla went above and beyond for great service.

My Girlfriend tried a new drink and didn't like it at all. She asked and Kayla was happy to help and make her a new drink. Most place would say no, not here.

Thanks again for making her day.

I wish I got the name of the person that helped me. He was on it. Cashier, barista, helping drive thru and had a trainee with him.....he was sooo on it !!!! Multi tasking to the max and he made some cute remarks about the drinks when he handed them out.....And on top of that he was kickin' out the drinks and even hot items very quick ....he a tall thin younger guy.....awesome !!
It's that place to go where every staff member knows your drink! It's a cool comfortable place to just chill, relax or get some studying in. Great staff that puts you first!!!!

For the purposes of studying and doing work, Starbucks is great. They (finally) have free wi-fi, lots of electric plugs, etc. etc. However, as a coffeeshop, Starbucks fails miserably.  The drinks are overpriced, over sweetened, and the location in Bryn Mawr in particular has really bad atmosphere.  The baristas here have no idea what good espresso drinks are--drinks are way too hot, and there is no difference between lattes and cappuccinos.    Not only that, there's also a really sleazy male barista who flirts with any female customer under a certain age--you may note that some of the positive reviews here are from women who have received special treatment.  Parking is awful, and there's only one way in and out.  I actually think there's a lot of room for competition in this area, especially since Saxby's is just as bad, and Milkboy is way too expensive in my opinion.
Absolutely best Starbucks within a 15 mile radius! Sam wise is always great! Unfortunately I moved away from Hendersonville so I will no longer be seeing him! Disappointing!

I LOVE this location! After studying there for awhile, one of the baristas learned my drink order and knows me by name. The drinks are always good and the cashiers are always attentive. Not only do they greet you by name, but they don't let chatter get in the way of serving the customers which is what I see almost everywhere I go. Cannot love this place more!

This Starbucks gets 3 stars, which seems just about right. Its not the best Starbucks in the area (the one across the street in the Safeway is MUCH MUCH better) but its certainly not the worst. Getting in and out of the weird shaped lot can be a pain, so that's a minus, but otherwise this is really just your average Starbucks.

I like everything about this Starbucks except the parking. They share their lot with several other businesses and it's usually difficult to find a spot. 

I find myself using the drive thru, rather than going in, more often than not. The drive thru line is VERY long at peak times, but when you need your coffee, YOU NEED YOUR COFFEE.
The staff has always been nice & pretty quick.  The parking lot & drive through,  well that's a whole other ballgame.

This Starbucks is in a prime location--complete with a shared outdoor courtyard and some good, adjacent restaurants. The inside is also very spacious and welcoming. I always go here assuming it's a great place to study and have a delicious cup of coffee. On both counts it misses the mark. Not a good Starbucks but also not a bad Starbucks.

The cleanliness is my main issue. I thought all Starbucks tried to maintain a well-kept environment for their customers? I figured this was standard procedure. Somehow this place is just dirty and unkept every single time I visit. The bathroom was so disgusting I literally walked in and walked out. This is really unacceptable, in my opinion. There are much better-kept local coffee shops right across the street (The French Press) that are crowded but manage to keep their space spotless. 

As for the coffee, the blended and espresso drinks are all overly-sweet. I have sometimes not been able to finish them because of this. On the bright side, they have a Clover Machine (for the black coffee lovers out there)! You can get a personally-crafted cup of any of their standard or reserve beans. This is something I highly recommend! 

Lastly, the employees are all really friendly! They always ask about my day and make a point to be cordial, even when they are swamped with orders.
Because this site is open 24/7, it's a very popular place. Parking is NOT ideal, but the staff is attentive, very roomy seating areas both indoors and out, and safely lit.

This store is always busy. However the baristas are always sweet and apologize. The last 2 weeks I have witnessed some customers being extremely rude and abhorrent people and they have dealt with it with grace. Last week during frappuccino happy hour I was behind a car who was grossly rude and frankly out of line. They were yelling at the barista at the order box thing, and then verbally abusive at the window as well. They ordered a million drinks and then sent them all back, they threw money at her and called her a fat ass white bitch and demanded she crawl out the window to grab the money they just assaulted her with. This held up the drive thru line and made it a mess. They finally left after 20 minute with their million drinks. The girl at the window was so sweet and apologetic for the wait. She was near tears (rightfully so after the outlandish treatment she went threw by this woman and her passengers) she gave me my frappuccinos for free and gave me drink cards for the next time for my wait. She was the girl with blue hair and she is ALWAYS sweet and professional. I have never seen her be rude or nasty to a single person. Then today I witnessed even more horrible actions by a woman causing a scene from the start. She was attacking a barista calling her names, going after her appearance and faith. Even calling her racist because her drink was wrong. She was video tapping the whole time and just saying the worst things ever. The barista just kept smiling, apologizing and remaking her drinks over and over while dealing with her verbal abuse. 
Both these girls were professional and polite and never once gave into these entitled trashy people. They smiled threw it and never gave in. Their manager should be thankful to have good help.

It's a Starbucks in a mainly residential area. 

It seems this is the only time of year I stop in Starbucks, as for some reason I usually receive several gift cards at Christmas- hint - I love the local Hub and Dorinda's- they both offer gift cards.  

This location has some outside seating. And between 7 to 10a the line can be to the door. On most days this location can move that line in and out pretty quickly. I did notice the other day the now offer a spot to pick up preorders that are made online- very fast and efficient. Even though the parking lot is a bit of a pain to get in and out of. Depending on the direction you want to leave, depends on the exit you must use. Plumb is a one way out going east, so you might need to use Arlington go in the other directions.

Unbelievable.  There were 4 people in the store when I placed a simple cheese danish and coffee order at 2:02 today.  With 6 servers, I still hadn't received my coffee at 2:16, so naturally I asked if they had forgotten me. I was met with the most rudest and eye-rolling customer service I've experienced in quite awhile. No excuse for this kind of slow and horrible service.

Scott is one of the best, friendliest, most accommodating and considerate baristas I've ever encountered. Really deserves a shout-out for making customers feel welcomed and valued! Went out of his way to make me a specialty drink similar to one unusually order that's only available seasonally. Genuinely exhibits optimum customer service skills and grace. Usually a very busy location, opens earlier than all other Starbucks between Montecito and Goleta. Lots of sitting areas, sometimes hard to find seating so arrive early to get yourself a space.

This is your average Starbucks. Nothing too spectacular. The focus is on the drive-thru, which I guess is to be expected, I mean, that is where their butter is really at! If you walk in and notice that the line is long, or there is no one helping the front counter (despite the fact that they see you, you have been greeted, they have asked how you are doing, they just won't take your order), my suggestion is to order thru the app, you will actually get your order (and your name will be spelled correctly) quickly. I realize that them misspelling your name and mispronouncing your name is part of the gimmick, but it is kind of annoying. But the bathroom is clean, as is the inside area for seating, which is pretty darn great. They have five small round tables outside. No smoking outside, even if there is no one else seated at the tables.

Ok. I am going to give away my real secret, and the meaning behind all four stars of this review. Honestly, they are not worth the 4 stars with the exception of the manager. There are a couple of employees who are all stars, but that is kind of beside the point. One morning, I had just moved into my new apartment, I didn't have internet hooked up at my house, I just wanted to update my podcasts before going to work. So I sat outside with my laptop. The manager was coming in to start work, and greeted me, went inside. He came out as I was quickly packing my bag to make a run for it. He came out, asked my name, and what my order was inside. I didn't have an order placed inside. He went back in and came out with a drink for me. I felt horrible, but the next time I came in, I tipped extra well. Don't tell anyone else about my secret, and don't abuse these poor people!

During the holidays, the drive-thru line wraps around the building, the line inside is to the door, and the baristas are just as friendly as ever. Or they treat everyone with the same grumpiness. Whatever.

They are awesome. They may not remember my name, I may not remember their name, I may not remember my own name, after a long shift, they may not remember their own name, but oh well. What are you going to do? Am I outside again? Oh for goodness sake!

Great coffee and fast professional service! A little pricey but that is Starbucks for you. Whenever they take longer than expected I receive my coffee at no charge. Usually very fast but some days they are extremely busy. Will keep using this Starbucks as long as they continue to stay at there current location! Highly recommend

Online it says you all close at 10pm. We just tried going through the drive thru around 9:40pm and got completely ignored. When we pulled up we saw two or three people working and after we drove around everyone was in the back. Ruuuuuude. Guess I'll get some cheap ass coffee at circle k. At least they are reliable.

This is the closest Starbucks to my house and I typically stop in twice a week. I've found that the staff is much more friendly when you use the drive through vs going inside. It seems backwards, but I suppose the Starbucks system is optimized for drive through business. 

I typically get a coffee with syrup, so nothing too unique. However, the barista that works the morning shift always remembers me and is quite pleasant. Lately I've been going everyday thanks to the offer they had before Christmas which allowed for a coffee a day In a specific tumbler after purchase. 

I've definitely been to worst Starbucks, but rarely been to better. So I'm giving them the 5 stars they deserve. Stop in, but use the drive though for the best service.
This Starbucks is great! They always pour my coffee to perfection. Bake my breakfast sandwiches to delight. Always happy in the morning. Great customer service. This is my spot!

The new barista, a young African American woman, was very pleasant, great smile and very personable.

However, this place always looks like it could use a good cleaning. 

Before we could sit at the large bar height table I had to ask for a wet towel to clean off the spilled coffees and food crumbs.   I don't mind this but I have a problem with it when the baristas are standing around talking so VERY LOUDLY that their voices are overpowering ALL the other customers in the store.   

They could be attending cleaning opportunities.

As much as I try to avoid Starbucks because of how pricey it is, I always find myself coming back. One of my favorite locations is this one which is right across the street from where I work. They just recently moved into this shopping center from their old location that was next door to Peg's Glorified Ham and Eggs. I will say, having the drive through really is nice. I used to go to the old location but there was no drive through so this is definitely more convienent. I love the baristas, I always get a warm greeting every time I make a visit, especially from Tiffany and a few of the others that I cannot remember their names. The inside of the store is beautiful, it is much larger than the otger location and very open with lots of seating. I haven't had a bad coffee from here yet. I usually get a flat white with coconut milk and it always tastes great, I'll be back in the next week or two I'm sure.

Typical Starbucks. Good coffee lousy food. Staff was a little more friendly than most Starbucks but I couldn't help feeling I was in a corporate conglomerate. Place was clean overall. Will be back if I'm needing an afternoon jolt.
Gotta give Starbucks a good review since they emailed me a coupon for a FREE breakfast sandwich

I am not a big fan of Starbucks, but  I am a big fan of coffee. I prefer my coffee to be hot and this is something that this particular Starbucks seems unable to manage. If you are staying at the Bellvue go across the street to WAWA. They know how to make good coffee and it's hot. There is also a Dunkin down the street...worth the walk. This place is horrible.

Awful!!! My green tea matcha latte tastes like milk. The service was awful. The barista actually ignored me when I placed my order then preceded to cuss under her breath. I had a question and she ignored that as well. Another women asked what my order was and she slammed my drink down in front of me. Would not recommend!!

Always a long drive-thru  line, but I was all set to try the new iced Carmel cloud macchiato!

Decided to surprise the hubby and drop his off .

The line went fast and I love the plastic cups!
Love the cups so much to reuse, told the hubby to save his!

I also really liked the drink ! Hope it's a regular on the menu.

This is the Starbucks that I always go to. I have never had any issues with it. They are very quick and friendly. 

Drinks: All of the drinks have tried have been so good. My favorites are skinny Carmel macchiato and magon dragonfruit refresher. 

Pricing: They has decent pricing. Many people say it is overpriced but for the quality I think it is just right. 

Reward: If you are coffee lover and stop at Starbucks a lot, you should get their rewards program. It is very easy to earn points and there is always opportunities to earn more every week. 

This Starbucks is good with service and quality.
They always have the seasonal drinks. If you need a coffee fix then stop here.

This is my "local".  It's by the office, I'm here all the time, and what can i say - this place has the best staff of ANY starbucks I've been to in St. Louis (and by God, I've been to a lot).  I should have maybe 150 checks in here over the last 2 years, but i as always too lazy to log onto yelp.

Drinks are always right on, the food is always fresh and I usually get the biggest piece of lemon loaf there is.  There's plenty of space to work / read, outlets if you need it and they also have couches / comfy chairs if you're chilling for a few hours.

Hint: park in the far lot (the one closer to mcdonalds) if you want to get here after say 11am or you'll have to snail it around wesport for ten minutes before getting that sweet nectar.

Came here for a post lunch pre shopping iced coffee. At the end, I was asked if I wanted milk -  I asked for a little room for milk and instead of leaving room for me,they added my milk for me....

Unless I was at a drive thru, I always expect (and have always had) Starbucks to allow customers to customize their drink to their liking - add their own milk and sugar unless otherwise directed. The fact they didn't give me this option irked me a bit- they might have thought they were doing me a favor but they weren't, haha.

Didn't want to be that person who was picky/wasteful and ask for another cup but I will for sure next time be MORE SPECIFIC so they have a clear understanding of what the customer wants.
Very disorganized. No scanner. very rude when asking questions regarding drinks.

The coffee is what the coffee is. Always good. The only thing that I'm unhappy with is, they have nothing to stir your coffee with,instead they have you use straws. Now, for a company with enough money to have a business on every corner and in every grocery store. How can you not have stir sticks that don't mess up our environment
Slow, very slow, extremely slow!  This place is way understaffed.  Unless you have a lot of time, I wouldn't go here.

There has to be a way to give zero stars ! Seriously . Service was terrible and drinks were ass . I never had a bad Starbucks experience before . Honestly , they should just shut this location down . Put a Corner Bakery instead or something . Geez .

8:30am with a line in the drive through - but out in less than 5 minutes! WOO!

Tried the new Cold Brew w/Pumpkin Cream after the barista talked me through the ingredients  (Vanilla Syrup, Cold Brew, Cream Topping w/Pumpkin Flavor & Pumpkin Pie Seasonings). Great service + they write jokes on the drive through window for much needed morning laughs
Consistently the slowest and most unprofessional Starbucks of all time - it shouldn't take me 40 mins to get a coffee in the drive thru every time
Friendly staff, conveniently located (especially for Westin guests)..   small joint, slow service but hot coffee!

I love this small cute kiosk and the people there are very Nice had a great conversation with a young girl named Nicole the other day thank you for not being rude like many other places that have to put up with moody and needy customers wanting their morning cofee.

First a Starbucks is a Starbucks no matter where you go, so the drinks are 98% the same.  The big difference I have found, is the customer service and the cleanliness of the store and bathrooms.

The customer service here was very good, they treated us, a group of 6 very well and there was some odd things ordered.  The only issue that came up was sadly my drink either didn't get made or someone took it, not sure which.  But I walked up and they made me a new drink right then and there.  The customer service here made my day.

Highly recommend this location.
This is by far THE slowest Starbucks. It's not just once in awhile, they are consistent. It's as if the manager is never on duty and the workers give zero f@#ks.

I'm moving and I will miss this Starbucks.  They gave me old newspapers to pack with and most of the baristas are quite friendly.  I also like that I can refill my passion tea for less than a dollar!  I've become quite friendly with most of the baristas, I look forward to visiting them when I'm in town!

My husband and I have been here quite a few times since moving here a week ago.  The staff have always been friendly and efficient.  Our drinks taste perfect every time.  This location will definitely be my go to for our coffee needs!

1st time here and will not return. Simple order "fell thru the cracks". Waited 20 minutes for two coffees. Expensive time wasting experience. Also got no receipt for my order or I would have asked for a refund.

Wow. What can I say about this Starbucks? I work at Legends mall and come here every single morning. In the past 6 months, this location has changed so much, and not for the better. 
There are a couple good baristas here, but for the most part the girls here are the rudest I've ever encountered. If I come through the drive thru, it's always incredibly slow even when there's only one person ahead of me. By the time I get to the window, I'm already tired of waiting. But they look at me and turn away, continuing to gossip. On several occasions they have taken my money without listening to me at all (I had a free drink on my card but she was too busy laughing at something someone said through their headset to listen so she charged me anyway). I've paid for drinks and when they finally get to me they're cold, and wrong. Or if the barista turns back to me, she will ask me why I'm still there. When I say I'm still waiting she argues with me saying I already got my drink. Um hello? Do you see anything in my cup holder? 
A few days ago I came by and got a soy chai and they put regular milk. When I brought it back in the cashier looked at me and practically threw a free drink voucher at me, then passed off my drink to one of the baristas, whispering something about me clearly because I got glares from everyone there like I did something wrong (and yes I was VERY polite). 
Yesterday I used the free drink and asked for a trenta of my favorite drink (not knowing the rules of the trenta because I had never had one) and the girl yelled at me, yes yelled at me, snapping that they are reserved for iced coffee and tea ONLY. Ok my bad, no need to yell... 
I wish I could skip this place, but it's the only coffee shop on my way to work and I keep hoping they will pull their heads out of their asses. A couple of the guys here are great though, as well as any time they have some girls come from different locations. 
Someone talk to this staff, they're making you look bad!

Horrible latte - I ordered a tall latte and it was scorching hot; I actually burnt my tongue! And the overheated milk rendered it so bitter :( I asked them to remake it 'warm' and it was still super hot...I couldn't drink it. The girls seemed to take it personally and weren't very open to my feedback but I think the machine needs to be recalibrated or something.
Hot food takes forever. Every time!!! I just don't understand. So many people working. Is there just one oven?

I completely forgot to ask for my drink with coconut milk instead of dairy, and they gave me a new, bigger drink for free when I went and told them. Very kind! The tables are sticky when it's busy but you'd get that anywhere.

I have been to many Starbucks locations, and none are as good as this location!  NONE of them!  I really do not understand the negative reviews here.  Every time that I go (which is fairly often since I work across the street) the baristas are always friendly with, not only the regulars such as myself, but everyone in line.  The drinks made here are always better made than any other location I have been to.  For such a small location, they sure do get that line moving faster than larger locations with far more workers.  If you are reading reviews, listen to the girl who visits this location on a weekly basis.
I love the new location much bigger and nicer. Staff is nice, and the parking is much better.  Wait time for getting your drinks is normal no complaints there

I went this morning to get a birthday present for my boss and I also asked for a bag. If maybe they have one but the lady said they don't have any? Are you serious? Starbucks always have a bag for us. The owner was my Uncle's friend so I totally will tell my Uncle later what happened. New employee are not that good like people in the old place. They kinda like they didn't know how to make customer happy. Not that I expected. Better need a customer service training your loosing customer!

Very friendly baristas at this location.  It's in the Bellevue so the architecture is beautiful.  There's a seating area in the back corner separated by a wall. The first time I was here I didn't see the seating.  There's also outlets underneath the bench seating so it's a good place to charge your phone.  It's very clean too.

I pulled into the drive thru at about 6:30 pm and was told to wait a second by the person on the  microphone. One sec turned into about 7 minutes!!! There were only 3 cars in the drive thru. By the time I received my order and rolled out of the drive thru it was 6:50. I only ordered two drinks. Not sure how it takes this long to make two very simple beverages. Not impressed.
Small SB. Took a long time in drive through. Didn't seem all that busy but maybe orders were large. Very small.
Coffe is good but the black-haired girl behind the counter is a total troll. Seems friendly enough with her co-workers but rude to the customers. 01/01/2015 @ 1745

This is officially the slowest Starbucks ever. The staff just seems to wander around inefficiently with no time management or understanding that people actually have somewhere else to be. So frustrating!

This is the worst Starbucks in this area. This is the second time they were out of everything we wanted. No Cream cheese, No blonde roast, No Bantom bagels. Like really. And it was only 1150 AM. They had to go all day.

Starbucks is Starbucks. With this location I can only complain about the parking lot. It's not their fault though. Just poor planning on the developer's part. Don't be surprised if you end up on the grass by Dorignac's. Almost always at least 5 people in line when I visit but always quickly served. Ordering via mobile is always my answer for this location.

Starbucks is Starbucks, that much we know. So what sets each cafe apart is how well they make their drinks, and how good their service is.

For being a busy cafe in the heart of Clearwater Beach, the crew here sure do know how to pump out their orders quickly and accurately while being courteous simultaneously. And whenever I have issues with my orders, they're quick to fix - of course, I'm courteous to them which, really, is all they ask for. Because when you're on the beach, it seems like anyone who isn't a local are always rude.

This is my favorite Starbucks. The service is incredibly fast. Even when they are croweded with a long line, the staff never falters and drinks are always excellent and come out quickly. If there's something wrong with your drink, they will make you another one without giving you a problem about it. Lots of seating (inside), and a few tables outside. The baristas are excellent, and they often times remember my drink as soon as I walk in the door. 
My only gripe is that the music in the evening gets a too loud for a coffee shop, and the staff likes to play weird 80's music (perhaps because the staff likes it?). The staff also seems annoyed when you ask them to turn the music down....this shouldn't be 'club starbucks'!!

Maybe I came on a bad day, but this Starbucks was a bit of a train wreck. everyone seemed to be on their first day of work. Cashier messed up everyone's order. Simple things like water was overlooked. People with online orders were waiting behind people who waited in line.

It was general chaos.

Gross!! 
Toilet is fucking disgusting,one homeless woman taking over the condiment station eating and drinking her coffee and looking in the trash and another one talking to him 
Self in the seating area. No place to sit and it's freezing outside and I just paid $5 for coffee. FUCK this place

The worst service at any coffee shop, in my life. Untrained staff who could care less about anyone in line, 5 people behind the counter, 2 people actually working. When you finally get to order, it takes 3 minutes and several attempts to get it right, it's a latte with 4 shots, that's it, 8 minutes later it is handed to me, incorrectly done. Save yourself, go to Chestnut Hill Coffee just north 2 blocks away. Done being aggravated by this staff.
I splurged and went for a peppermint hot chocolate. It was a coldy morning and I was not in the mood for the coffee flavor. Either way it was tasty!

Traveling through Deleware looking for coffee, this location says they're open at 6 am today....not the case. This location opens at 7 am on Sunday. Would be nice to have an updated hours listing here to rely on. Thanks!

Customer service was horrible today! Left my phone there today. Realized what I did and came back for it 20 minutes later. Baristas were totally uninterested in helping me when I asked if anyone saw my phone. It wasn't even busy. I called back later to ask again and whoever answered said it could be in the safe if it was there but he didn't have access to it. I asked who did and he said he didn't know and that they were extremely busy. Didn't ask me to call back or try to help at all. My phone was stolen at their location and no one really cared to help a customer out.

Let me clarify one thing again...not all of the baristas have horrible customer service. I'm talking about the ones that were working there on 12/2/2012 from 1:00-3:30.

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been too, and trust me, I'm a gold star member who is obsessed, so I've been to quite a few. The cashiers either don't understand or just make A LOT of mistakes. It's not uncommon to ask for a cold drink only to find a hot one waiting for you at the end (happened 3 out of 5 times in 1 week once). The wait time is a ridiculous 10-15 minutes, and people after me in line are often served before I am. I always get an iced vanilla macchiato which consists of like 4 ingredients and it never tastes the same each time I get it. Unfortunately, this is the only Starbucks on my way to work so I either take a chance and go here or stop at Dunkin. I've been going to Dunkin more often then not because they never mess up my coffee and it tastes the same every time so I know what to expect. This place sucks!

If I could give this place 0 stars I would. First of all they can't redeem rewards. And second they don't like giving you promotions. The employees aren't educated on Starbucks happy hour promotions and they make up there own rules just so they don't have to abide by the promotions. Every time I get a breakfast sandwich they always have to check if they have it in stock. Go to any Starbucks other than this location. It's not worth the trouble.

This is a pitiful Starbucks. It is on an extremely busy street so there's no good parking. Their cashiers move slower than molasses. Then they run out of products but don't tell you until after you've paid and are waiting. Their cashiers are unfriendly. Save yourself the trouble and go to the Flourtown location.
Salem, bagel was still wrong!  Stop arguing with the customer... just do what is asked.  No wonder your reviews are terrible!

I'm not the type of person to ever leave a review of a place, but I just couldn't help leaving one today. This was a terrible experience for me. I got my correct order, but it wasn't at all the drink I asked for. It was made completely wrong and wasted my time and money.

Great morning crew during the week . However they are severely lacking on the afternoon and weekend crews. 5 cars in line at drive through. We did not move at all...for an official 7 minutes. 7 minutes per order on a Saturday? They just don't seem to care.

7 am Saturday, relatively quiet, I ordered. Triple shot grande cappuccino so it would taste like coffee. It tasted like 100% milk. I asked for a new one. She said sure and made me wait for 7 other people and when I spoke up she said, oh someone else must have taken it. I was standing there the whole time, so no, that's not it. This Starbucks is totally hit or miss on quality. I have had too many misses. I will not return.

the employees could be friendlier. The supervising manager was very unfriendly. I can see she does not care for the customers or her stores locations, but only for herself. With being located within a block from other starbucks and smaller coffee companies, this location is doing nothing to convince their customers to stay with them. I would walk an extra block to have a more positive atmosphere or even try  the smaller coffee shops down the street (less than a block) to give them the business.

Hooray for free bathrooms and free ac. Boo for no toilet paper  someone got left in a shitty situation here for sure. Unlike other sbux, their restrooms are NOT gender neutral. On the plus side, there is a changing table in the men's room if you have a little one.

Didn't order drinks so I cannot speak to that. Overall on a Saturday night this place was much calmer and had no bathroom line, while the sbux further down chestnut in midtown village was a zoo and had a toilet line.

Let's cut to the chase:  This is a very high-volume Starbucks.  On the good side, there were two main takeaways:  1) The guy who took our drink orders at the counter couldn't have been any more awesome - I wish I had caught his name.  If the manager is reading this, we were there at about 3pm on Saturday, November 4th.  This guy was fantastic - great communication skills and very friendly.  2) This Starbucks is at Keystone Mall, my favorite mall of all time.  On the not-so-good side, because this is such a high volume place, expect to wait a while for your drink to be ready.  That goes without saying I guess, but that's always been the issue with Starbucks.  At the larger stores with the heaviest traffic volume, there seems to be a mismatch between the staff that takes your order and the staff that makes the drinks.  They had about 4 people making the drinks, and they needed about double that number.  But, 8 people wouldn't have fit behind the counter without running into each other, so that's just the way it goes.
Looks like a great place to study or meet people. The staff was courteous and was a great place to have a little breakfast before getting to know St. Louis.
If you can find another Starbucks to go to, you should.  Service isn't great and it always seems dirty to me.  Giving it 3 stars is probably too generous.

I love Starbucks. Loyal customer since their first startups. However, I am consistently disappointed with this location. They are extremely understaffed. This morning, it took a total of 20 minutes, to order and receive my coffee. I am aware I can do mobile order for quicker turnaround. However, it baffles me they don't hire more staff to aide in expediting customers wait times. The staff behind the counter is doing the best they can, overwhelmed and swamped with orders, even snapping at customers. It's a fantastic location, which draws many customers, seemingly at all hours of the day. Hire more staff to accommodate the demand. Otherwise be prepared to wait in packed room with college kids on laptops, and irritated job goers patiently waiting for their morning buzz.

I try to avoid this location because the Coffee is much better at other local Starbucks. 

I have had to get my coffee remade at this location so many times and Never at any other Starbucks.

Sometimes the machine pulls wrong and the coffee is water. Sometimes the drinks are made incorrectly. Today's wasnt hot at all and was bitter, this happens a lot, so I threw it out.

Ellenton Outlets Starbucks -Awesome 

Bloomingdale Starbucks -Coffee great people not as friendly.

Big Bend Starbucks - Coffee great , takes awhile and its disorganized.

Brandon - Coffee great, it's like watching employee bumper cars most times. 

I think Starbucks needs to step up its game.

Cute, clean Starb in the CWE. Love the outdoor patio seating - great for people watching and catching up on Vogue. Only downside seems to be the limited indoor seating, which may prove to be a problem as the weather cools down. Even my pumpkin spice latte won't keep me warm enough!

Hands down the nicest, cleanest, friendliest Starbucks I've ever been to. That alone would give it at least 4 stars,  but the fact that my drink was properly made, with good espresso and streamed (rather than burned) milk means this place gets all of the stars. A+, Seminole Heights.

Everyday I drive past River and Campbell and drive the extra distance to both this location at Wetmore or the Sbux on Stone for quality service.

The morning crew here is probably the most cohesive team I've seen, completing beverages quickly and accurately, and it only took the team a few weeks to memorize my drink and my name. 

Impressive, especially considering that at a majority of the other locations the baristas still look at me blankly while holding their Sharpies, even after 6-7 years.

I really feel valued as a customer at this location, and that's what makes all the difference.

Any time I am in the Pottstown area, even if it's out of my way, I make the time to come here to get a drink. The​ staff is always so very friendly and my drink is always made perfectly so I don't have to complain about it on social media. I also love the fact that they have a drive-thru​ and that they have a very inclusive staff. In fact,​ on my recent trip back east, I do believe we stopped here 3 or 4 times. It's just not the same going to another Starbucks even with one in the Target that is in the same shopping center.

The staff here is amazing. I have went to other Starbucks and even repeated business there and they always struggle with my name, this Starbucks still remembers it even after they don't see me for a bit. It's nice to be known or at least feel that way. They also make amazing and flavorful drinks! I haven't ever had have them remake my drink! Thank you!

This Starbucks is super close to my home, although convenient, not worth the effort or time. I have tried to regularly attend this Boise Ave location for about 6 months. Within the 6 months I have notice the following: 
staff is usually rushed. 
Staff usually not in a good mood, no matter the time of day. (few are fine).
The product produced and services is usually sloppy. 
Never quite what you order, if you attend the drive through. 
Occasionally this location will be out of a product, such as cups or a particular blend, then charges you for "what you get, rather than what you ordered" and quote "we are out of small cups, pay for the medium or don't get the coffee". 
After today's visit, I will prolly never return. Too bad this location is a stone's throw away. 
Dutch Bros will now receive 100% of my business.

Along with my order, I asked for a separate water. While waiting, I noticed the barista clean her fingers in the water as it was pouring from the tap directly into the cup. Not sure what her motives were, but its quite disgusting as well as disrespectful. Especially because everything she is doing can be viewed by waiting customers.

This is consistently the slowest Starbucks I have visited. If you're looking to grab something quickly in the morning, do not visit this store. There always seems to be 10 people behind the counter but only one at the register and the line moves very slow. The store is aesthetically appealing inside and some of the employees are very friendly but I find it frustrating how consistently slow the service is.
Major shout out to Joe (Barista).  Always an inviting smile and welcoming attitude.  I pass up 2 other locations just to get my drink made here because I know it will be done carefully and correctly.

This Starbucks has awesome employees. They demonstrate the best customer service I've ever experienced at a Starbucks. Friendly, energetic, and very welcoming! I've become a regular and they know exactly what I want: a venti iced white mocha no whip light iced!

The Stars are great workers and very friendly. Because the area inside is so small, they should probably start asking patrons to leave larger strollers outside. At one point recently I was 22nd in line and it went fairly quickly.

as we speak i'm walking away from a starbucks who not only had the doors locked and closed ten minutes BEFORE closing time, but a starbucks whose employee straight up ignored my knocks on the door. unimpressed.
Friendly service, great attitudes. Excellent coffee per usual. The Bantam Bagels were great.
Not super fast but they know how to give extra caramel!!! Maybe too much but besides that, very friendly staff and they take both the physical card and mobile app

Worst Starbucks ever, never acknowledged my presence. Busy filling the display case must have been more important. There is a (Mobil on the run) just down the road, good coffee and friendlier employees.

This is the Starbucks at 730 Veterans next door to Dorignac's Food in Metairie at Wilshire. This is an amazing location and the baristas are friendly and awesome. This is also a drive up window location if you don't want to or don't have time to get out of your vehicle. It is a good quiet place to work or relax. I love this location. It is out of the city (New Orleans) tourist zone so only locals hang out here.

I visit this Starbucks often (if not everyday, then every Thursday). Not only are they very efficient but they are always very welcoming. 

I prefer to visit this Starbucks over the one local to me because of their service.
With the place being empty, it still takes 15 minutes to get a non warmed pastry.  Better off going to mcdonalds. I hate to wrote a review but i've regretted stopping in here a few times.

Service not great. Had to keep asking for my pastries long after getting my coffee. Mocha super sweet (?). Coffee prep station very messy. Very long lines to drive up extending onto busy Bay St. Large dining area but over air conditioned so we ate outside.
Currently waiting for a lemonade and it's been close to 20  minutes. This is absurd. I understand waiting for a complicated coffee beverage

This location has been out of Splenda since Saturday. They are always out of something. By far the worst Starbucks location that I have ever been to. I was excited to finally have a neighborhood Starbucks. How disappointing.

This Starbucks has a great location, right by Jefferson and near Rothman and in the Washington Square area.  I've often stopped by when I've been at a medical appointment in the area or at the Jefferson Station which is also close by.  

They move the line somewhat quickly here, usually are pretty well staffed with baristas, so they're pretty efficient here.  The baristas seem nice here and helpful, I don't go here as much as other Starbucks near me but I'm glad this Starbucks is in the area!  

Good Starbucks!  I think the seating area could be kept a little cleaner but again great location and friendly staff.

Fast, furious and busy describes this place. Staff are fun and friendly, they handle your order with precision and speed. It's got a lot of seating but that is usually taken up by the Jefferson staff or students studying. Great place for eye candy and to get your flirt on. Hello Doctor! Oh and the coffee is like every other Starbucks, so no complaints!
Every time I get a drink from here it's disgusting. Anytime I order online even if I order 10-15 min ahead of time it's still not ready. I guess I've been spoiled by the brownsburg Starbucks.
Quiet,  quick and friendly.   Line moved quickly and they had coffee ready.   Man taking mt order was friendly too.

The best set of employees I have ever met. All of them are super nice and very welcoming me. Not just towards me, but I watch them interact with all customers with the same positive energy. I come her maybe 4 days out of the week and stay til close and they are just the best about it. I've never enjoyed a place as much as this location!! 20/10 recommend!!

Shout out to my early morning Baristas!!!! This location goes out of their way for customers and really makes you feel welcome! They always welcome me by name in the morning and ask me
How my day is going. The service is fast and friendly, which is great when I only have a 15 minute break to grab my coffee.


When I say they go above and beyond I mean it. I was greeted by handwritten birthday wishes on my drink this morning, which brought a huge smile to my face!!

Okay, four and five star reviewers... Have you ever BEEN to a REAL Starbucks? Or are you just buying bottled water here?

This is a franchised 'bucks, not a corporate one and it shows. If service was a vacuum cleaner, this place would be a Dyson. Seriously. Rude people that can't get a venti tap water right. Heaven forbid you try to correct them. Can you say stink-eye?

The store is beautiful and comfortable, but I drive all the way up to Marsh Rd where they know how to make drinks properly, they remember you after one or two visits and they're some real friendly folks to boot.

Great neighborhood Starbucks,
The crew is very friendly and welcoming.
I usually come here for my morning tea and muffin. 
The line doesn't too big and the area is very quite and peaceful.
They store is clean and well set up. 
Love this place!

I know you're probably thinking "Why is someone even bothering to write a review, bc if you like Starbucks you're going to go 2 Starbucks?"  Well this locale not only has a cool/unique interior layout, but also has the well-versed + friendly Drink Artíste named Alan; he whipped up some delicious eye-candy, that was a refreshing exotic-fruit blended lemonade. PS: my son who is only 4, used the BR & it was spotless... a rare find for any place in New Orleans!
I love the new renovations made to this location! It's definitely more spacious and clean inside. The baristas were on point and my coffee was perfect!

This is the only Starbucks near me so I'm forced to go to it in the mornings. I am not exaggerating when I say I've tried probably over 100 different locations of Starbucks because I travel for work, and this is by far the worst. This morning, I'm surrounded by 12 people waiting for their mobile orders to come through, and there are only 3 people working the entire store. I have no idea why the management would choose to have such few people working with such high demand. Also, my coffee is burnt every single time. I really wouldn't come here unless you absolutely HAVE to!

I drove through this Starbucks chain.
My order was right.
Coffee was tasty like yum.

Did I just 'bad haiku' this review?
All I wanted was to birthday cake pops at 5 o'clock on a Sunday and they did not have that. They did not have any cake pops to make it worse.

Time is not of the essence at this Starbucks watching everybody lollygag behind the counter they are more concerned with filling  ice or working at other things rather than filling the  20 people who want to drink orders

Product  was as good as always (and over priced ) but the design and detail of the interior is amazing!  Gorgeous walnut wood. trim and baseboards, colors are very complementary and a very cool brass musical instrument  hanging sculpture in the adjacent sitting area captures  the true essence  of New Orleans.

Worst Starbucks experience.  They served FROZEN food and would't serve food that was in the display case because they would "save" it for friends coming later.  They ran out of drinks multiple times.  Further, there was chaos with too many people standing around in the back talking and not working.  Management should be aware.

I come to this Starbucks all the time because it's right by my house and I have no self-control. I've never actually been inside but I frequent the incredibly slow drive thru. Seriously, it's SO slow. I don't even mean just during peak hours- I went today with 3 cars ahead of me and it must have taken 10 minutes. Honestly, one time I waited in the drive thru for 20 minutes. On the plus side, my coffee is always made correctly and delicious! It's just such a pain waiting for it.

Also, the parking lot is awful. If you're planning on parking- good luck getting out. I cringe as I watch everyone trying to back out without hitting any of the cars in the drive thru line.

Hellooooo.... renovation!! I walked into this location last week after taking a break from my expensive Starbucks habit. When did the interior change? I love it! It feels more open and airy. Very woodsy feeling too.

I try to avoid this Starbucks before 8am and during the lunch hour, because it is always waaaaaayyy busy. If you use the order ahead function on your Starbucks app - that helps immensely. 

So why the three stars? They always, always run out of food items like the protein boxes. Just keep more in stock, m'kay?

I live in town so I frequent this Starbucks out of what has become an old habit.  A lot of the baristas are quite friendly and chatty, which can be nice most of the time.  I think it's great that they have a ramp for people who have trouble with steps.  Most of the beverages and food is pretty good, it's too bad that the pastries aren't made there.  I wish they could control the noise level, at times both indoors and outside the noise is unbearable even at the crack of dawn, they should be a bit more assertive to noisy patrons, some people don't want to hear people laughing hysterically or barking, whining dogs at 7 am.

At one of my favorite pastimes trying the Tie dye. Let's see how it tastes lol. It was awesome but for me I should not have much sugar  But I tried it. Always stopping by Starbucks staff is awesome always get what I like enjoy
Worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Absolutely ridiculous that there were 3 cars in front of me in the drive through and it took 20 minutes for them to even take my order. Not coming back here again.

Starbucks probably has 20,000,000 locations by now, but this is one of the nicer ones. It's quite large with lots of seating - a good mix of tables/chairs for working and lounge-y areas for relaxing. Everything was very clean including the restrooms (not always the case at the busier Starbucks).

Basically the product is the same as the 20,000,000 other locations but this one has especially pleasant and cheerful staff. They managed to move people through quickly while still patiently answering a litany of dumb questions: "what coffee drink can I get that doesn't taste that much like coffee?" WTF, people!

Also, I loved that they're sponsoring a Giving Tree from a local animal shelter. You could grab a tag and buy products or send in a monetary donation. There was already a good sized stack of puppy presents from customers, which is awesome.

I am a very frequent starbucks go-er and this is actually the location I go to the most, because I work nearby. When I first started going to this one, one of the workers were very rude to me. He was confused on the type of drink I wanted, perhaps because of my wording. Whether I was right or not, the way he treated me made me walk out the door and not continue ordering my drink. I am never a confrontational person and I'm probably the nicest gal you could meet, so when I walk out of a place, that says something. I called their contact number and the representative didn't seem to care and robotically apologized for the inconvenience. I didn't go back for several weeks, then finally I returned because I needed coffee for my work shift. The worker who was rude did apologize and then paid for my drink. That is why I'm giving it 3 stars. Atleast he owned up to how he treated me, but that never should have occurred in the first place. Other than that, they make my drink how I like it and the rest of the staff is wonderful.
Service is just too slow. We've all been to many of these places. I just picked the wrong one on the way out of town. Not much else to say except: OOPS!
Third visit, poor service every time. Employees finish their social conversations while you wait to order. Had to have my drink remade. Not your typical friendly staff at this location.

My previous review had stated that they are consistently out of what I'm trying to order. I had pretty much stopped coming to this location all together but my wife would still from time to time. She sent me there today to pick her up some breakfast and I literally had to go down the line of the menu asking "well so you have this ?" Only for them to reply no sorry we are out of that too. Honestly it went from being infuriating to hilarious with how poorly they stock their store. The employees were fine but it would be nice for them to actually have product to serve me.

Worst starbucks i have ever been too. Barista is very rude and always have your name wrong. They are those girls with attitude. Some might think it s cute but bad attitude (like i am too good to be here) is never cute. If you don't know how to spell it, ASK! Even when i spell it out, they still don't get it.  How hard can you spell Yvonne or Jamison. They are too busy chatting with each other .they don't have time to do their job right. The floor is dirty. The counter is not wiped probably. Don't use the bathroom. It 's disgusting!
