Came in 7:30 am with my daughter for a coffee before school. It was surprisingly not busy. We ordered the new coconut milk mocha macchiato and a iced chai latte. We had our drinks in minutes. There was only like 3 other people in the store. We enjoyed our drinks at the many available tables. There was comfy couch set too. Perfect place to do some work or have a quiet conversation. The drive through have a few cars in line but seemed to be moving fast. If you need to avoid the crowded Starbucks this one is a good choice!

This new location is very nice and the staff is very friendly. But this one is special...It has a drive thru! The first Starbucks location in this city with one. Maybe even first in the country, I'm not sure.

Right across from the Magnolia Marketplace and just walking distance from where I reside, I can come here and unwind with friends and have a good social time.

LOVE the regular staff here ... always pleasant and rarely have to wait for my morning coffee. I've been to some Starbucks that were not up to snuff, but this one always brews the coffee just right. The early morning crew is A+++++.

Great location, parking abounds and there's always the Philly paper or NYT to read on the big, comfy couch.
Whoa! Definitely my favorite Starbucks. I drive out of my way just to see Mckenzie. She always greets me with a smile and most of the time remembers my name and what I like to order.

It's nice to be able to sip and an enjoy a Starbuck coffee while my wife shops at Sephora at Keystone Xing.  This Starbucks is a little small and has an odd layout considering the two entrances and exits.

Horrible service...took forever.  Sat in the drive through forever and then went inside.  Couldn't back out of the parking lot because it's so congested.  We spent 30 minutes trying to get fast food breakfast

Until Costco starting offering something hot with caffeine, you might as well get your fix here.  Fairly plentiful power receptacles for customer use. 

Deduct 1 star since you have to recite the Starbucks approved language and can't just ask for a "medium."

Used to be a favorite spot, but recently the tea was watered down yhe the soy latte had an odd after taste. The workers I am accustomed to. It's a busy spot with limited seating, adaptability is key. Don't rely on seating and chatting during busy hours. Cleanliness is ok and the noise level is average. I guess you can say it's a hit or miss. The location is conveniently located and there is outdoor seating. A good place to wait while you car is getting work done!

Starbucks, Why are you here in business if you never have products for this community of patrons? This store is consistently out of products and it's very disappointing that management has no understanding of inventory.  

This store has improved some; the last three visits have been great and items made correctly but it's always a hit or miss with them.  The Terry Parkway store rarely ever runs out of products and I absolutely adore Sandy at that store as she's the most personable employee of the two stores combined.  

Since my last visit here, I've opted to take my business to the Terry Parkway for good and now they're running into some of the same problems like this location . Sheeeesh!!!

KYLIE HAS TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE SKILLS AND A VERY NASTY ATTITUDE. The ladies that work their are very rude. Insulted me on my vacation. And my coffee and food was very cold and nasty. If you hate your life because you work at Starbucks then quit, don't take it out on the customers. WORST Starbucks i have ever been too.
The service is slow,  the orders agree often wrong and they're always ot if something that's not on their site.
Newly renovated this is a really nice location. I have always had good service and excellent food and beverages.

We pulled up at 8:59pm having no idea what time they closed and walked in to see two guys cleaning up the counter area. When I asked if they closed at 9pm fully prepared to walk away, they invited us in to serve us and reassured us it was no problem at all that it was 9pm. Wow... this kind of service rarely exists and these two young men are true stars! Thanks Zachary and Carlos!!! Merry Christmas

This location is extremely slow and rude. I'm not actually sure how Starbucks still allows their staff to be blatantly rude and disrespectful. I've called to complain about 3 times now and nothing has been done. I live literally about this place, yet I get in my car and drive 4 miles to a different location. It's a shame.

This Starbucks is probably the worst location in South Reno.  Any drinks I order, they ALWAYS mess up and it's getting super frustrating.  Where it's located is superb, but the location itself doesn't make your drink though.....

So not only they mess up my order every single time, they get mad at me like I did something completely wrong whenever I ask them to remake the drink.  There is an older lady working there - she is a cashier for the most of the time I've gone in there and she is beyond RUDE.  If you want an expensive Starbucks drink that is not up to your standards, this is the right place for you. I am not going back to this location ever again.

I love how cute this Starbucks is. I also love how much parking they have. I must admit this review is biased because I'm ENAMORED with the new tea lemonades. The guava white tea and the peach green tea are my absolute favorites (with and WITHOUT alcohol). Anyway,  I had a meeting here and although there is a lot of seating it doesn't have as many private or separate spaces.  It gives you a college union feel (i.e. long tables, lots of windows,  etc). But I liked the vibe and the customer service was amazing! The manager was super friendly and the barista let me taste smaller before committing.
Terrible service, even worse management. They wont cuz any of their mistakes. Rude and annoying, just go to mcdonalds for coffee

Small SB but very inviting.  They have plenty of people working so the wait is short. Music is playing softly in the background so it's not overwhelming to have a good conversation with others. Nice place to get some writing done.

Do not go to this Starbucks. Ordered a Toasted White Chocolate Mocha Frapp and it came out as White Milk Frapp, basically had not expresso shots in it. Told the girl that this doesn't taste like what I had ordered. She had to remake my drink. Secondly the store was full of gnats flying everywhere. My son had to go to the bathroom. As we entered  the restroom literally a bunch of gnats flying everywhere and it smelled like someone died in there. Felt like a scene from a movie. My son even made a comment that it stinks. I literally picked up my son and exit the building as I found it to be unbearable. Will not return.

Worst Starbucks I have been to. They always get my drink wrong. I complaint several times and went back to give them another chance and my pink drink was red. I typically get the pink drink and if they are out of something. They still make it without saying anything. Why? They just want to make the sale and don't care about customers. Not going back there again.

The customer service is sucks its like there are racist why? They took our order at the cashier but they didnt ask my name and didnt put the cup to the barista so that they will do my order most starbucks doing it like that but them i was like no we have a lot of orders what happen to my order they forgot? Some customer had there order but us no.Good thing i asked the receipt i was really mad because we waited like almost an hour then they didnt say sorry and then there the one got mad, customer service should be improved they didnt know some customer are tourist and having fun then they will broke our mood for waiting so long that 3 ladies are not good,

Idk what's wrong with this location. Either the workers are too lazy to make the right order or they simply didn't have enough training to make a decent tasting coffee. Every time I get an iced coffee or frappuccino it tastes so watered down and bitter. I couldn't drink my iced coffee last time bc they forgot to put the caramel syrup that I asked for so it tasted so bitter. They just always seem to forget something in my order that I paid extra for and I always go back to see if it'd be different another time but no it NEVER tastes right.

Although our drinks were served quick and in a hurry the store was less than average. The counter had no straws available and no supplies available to customers. The bathroom was not quite filthy, but definitely needs tending to. When the baristas have time to visit with each other, they have time to tend to the cleanliness of the dining room and especially the restroom. No excuses for a dirty restroom

Not sure what's worse: Bad customer service or the cashier intentionally not comprehending a simple order just for the sake of of being obstinate. 

You know the order! An order that's placed at a Starbucks a hundred times a day! A Chai Latte! THAT should be easy!

This was my first and last time at this Starbucks. 

Here's how I order -every time-: "a Venti chai tea latte with soy and light whip". Easy, right? Done.

But then, when my companion orders HER chai latte BUT with a shot of caramel, cashier says, "We don't have soy, it's 1%, 2%, or coconut milk". Wait. Whaaaaa?

So let's confuse the issue, you're all of a sudden not offering soy milk? My companion questioned it, but cashier claims ignorance. My companion, seemingly not having the choice to order her drink as she likes it, is disgusted with the barista being obstinate, then forced to order the coconut milk. We were both shaking our heads by this time, and both pretty weirded out by the barista.

Of course, as anticipated, it tasted terrible. FYI, coconut milk, mixed with a caramel shot, does not go well with Chai Tea Lattes. 

We asked them to remake it.

The part that really blew me away was the attitude I got because we asked them to re-make my companion's drink. I had to humor them! I had to laugh along with them while they were being ridiculous about the one drink. Because if I didn't, bad things might have happened with that newly-made drink. And yet MY drink was perfect. Ugh!
The staff is always so incredibly polite!  Granted, most Starbucks employees at most locations are very pleasant, but the employees here are uber nice.

Nice Starbucks located as part of the Hilton Clearwater Beach.  Fast and efficient service, not much more I can ask for then that when visiting a bucks.  Really nice patio area on the boulevard with many tables with umbrellas. Spacious indoor cafe area with many places to sit.

I love this location.  It's bigger than their old location down the street.  The staff is very nice and respectful.  They are fairly fast at making your drink, depending upon how crowed it is.  I'll definitely be coming back.

This store has done a fantastic job so far. I attended the story time on 11/8 and had a great time! The baristas supplied free drinks for the kids as well as some treats. The atmosphere in here every time I arrive is super welcoming, I ALWAYS am greeted upon walking through the door. I come once a day and, while some days are better than others, I don't have one bad thing to say about the team! Disappointed in the limited selection of food, but the manager (Alicia?) explained to me that there are frequent "company outages" that is not within their immediate control and accommodated me by giving me a suggested sandwich they did have on the house. It's a shame most people would rather complain than talk to the employees to understand the why. I'll definitely be back!

This SBUX, on Montgomery Avenue, is infinitely better than the Ardmore location. Ardmore seems to draw a more "swanky" crowd while this one has more down-to-earth neighborhood folks. And, there's much more room here, and a nice fake fireplace. Sometimes drivers wrangle over the limited number of free parking spaces, but there's plenty of metered street parking.

Ok so i came to this location on 6/7/2016. I came into the store as it was a regular summers eve. I walked in and the first thing I noticed is that delicious coffee smell!!! I love it.Well anyway, I ordered my drink as usual but the lady at the counter was kinda weird but its cool she's asian I guess. I got my drink and it was delicious but then again its hard to fuck up a tea. I was on my way to sit down and I noticed a pale white young strapping lad entering the store. He was well dressed but some could say a little "Pasty". I would have to say, he was very good looking. Come to find out that he works here! I am now a regular customer for life as long as that young man works here! I believe his name is david. He was so nice to the customers and really HOT!! Thanks Starbucks, I think i found the love of my life! PS. I have noticed that the majority of the employees are white and female. If its not to much to ask, could you guys hire more men of the african-american race?

Starbucks is Starbucks but I have now had 3 bad experiences at this location. 
1. Nonfat milk in my latte was stale. Walked in (no way to get back in drive through/ explained there was really something off and after one more attempt all agreed that the milk needed to be tossed. Received a $4 gift card.
2. Drove up at 9:54 and heard recorded announcement that store is closed. Parked and walked in. Store was open and they knew nothing about the recorded announcement. This was especially annoying as I have a broken wrist and it was hard to handle the 2 drinks I ordered.
3. Ordered 2 drinks this evening. After several repetitions of my 3 drink order. I pulled out. Took a sip, and there was no Splenda in my latte.
Drive through is a great convenience but this location needs to improve customer service!!!

great location. but horrible service. i waited 45 min for a cake pop. i bet that the cake pop was made in less time that it was served. the sand which had too much tomato when i asked for just a little and i also asked for my pumpkin bread warmed up but it was freezing cold when i got it. my hands got hypothermia it was so cold. 
but, it's a very pretty store.

Stopped in because Starbucks is the only place in this area that has hot teas. My girlfriend has a cold and didn't know what to order. The Barista, Dustin, explained a bunch of different hot teas and their benefits, then made my girlfriend an amazing beverage. She was extremely happy and Dustin saved the day! This Starbucks definitely earned repeat customers based off this visit and Dustin's excellent level of customer service.

I've been here a few times and I keep forgetting to review them. I have never had an issue with this Starbucks. The staff are always nice and cheerful. I am somewhat particular about the drink I order and they never roll their eyes or make me feel like a "difficult customer". 

Today, service was fast and easy with virtually no wait. 

I wish I could review Starbucks as an whole company because my experience, no matter which store I go to, is always pretty great.
While all Starbucks has the same product, this particular location is worth missing. Parking situation is an issue given it's tiny size. Also, the service is quiet slow.
My favorite location, they are always "on it", super fast, and organized. On my way to get coffee now

Absolutely love this Starbucks! The baristas are always so nice! I feel like I've made genuine connections with the employees. Tori,
One of the baristas made my day by giving me a free coffee. She said "you have a big day tomorrow and I love that you always come in and tell us about you and your life!" So so sweet, and truly made my day! Thank you for being such a welcoming, kind, and compassionate Starbucks!

A Starbucks is a Starbucks, but this is my local one so I wanted to commend them. The standard delicious drinks: finally got that Pumpkin Spice Latte this basic bitch had been pining over. Comfy seating where my sister and I lounged for a very long time while no one seemed to care. Also "writer working on screenplay/Great American novel" desk seating. I can attest their Frappuccinos are also sugar-y fat-y delicious. Service is quick and gracious. All in all a good go to local coffee place.

As a lover of frozen cappuccino drinks, as location as super close to my home, this will always be my favorite place to go to when I crave coffee. The staff are pleasant and Jackie is one of the best baristas there. She always makes my drinks full of love, thanks Jackie!
Terrible service. Got skipped over many times. Took way too long just to make two cold brews.

It's like people at Mc Donald's left to work here. Seems like they can't get an order right . Ordered the simple Vietnamese style coffee - quad expresso with 5 pumps white mocha with splash of heavy cream.... got one shot expresso 5 pumps white mocha and 3/4 of a venti cup of heavy cream .

Ordered a venti iced caramel cloud macchiato and this is how empty my cup was when they gave it to me. I asked the girl why it was like that and she said it was normal but I've ordered this many times at other locations and haven't had any issues.

Thanks for fixing the outlets at the farm table!   

Congratulations Bryan on your promotion!  

Your engagement with customers and attention to customer service will surely shine through making this one of the best *$'s in the city.

I look forward to the introduction of Nitro to your location!

I feel a little weird reviewing a chain store as big as Starbucks, because I feel like they are all very similar, but here goes nothing! 

I like this Starbucks. It has the most reliable wifi of any Starbucks I've been to. The drinks are consistent to all other Starbucks drinks I've had. They play fun cafe music that isn't distracting. The store is always clean, and the location is convenient with plenty of parking. The outdoor seating is nice, but can be distracting as it is located overlooking a very busy street. The metal chairs aren't crazy comfortable, but they have plush seating if you want it. I always come here to do work stuff so I've never paid close attention to speed when it comes to getting my drink out, but there is almost always a line when I'm here that seems to go quickly. Staff are very friendly and always pleasant and conversational while not being overbearing.

I feel almost silly writing a review for a chain restaurant, but the service here is just beyond amazing. This Starbucks is located on a very busy corner, and it is not unusual to find a line from the front-door all the way to the ordering counter. Despite this, and despite the fact that is only ONE store-front out of a chain of thousands (millions?), the staff has made it so that you feel like you're in your neighborhood coffee shop. They know the customers by name, and their orders by heart. I barely even have to speak upon entry-- they ask me if I'm getting my usual, and moments later it's delivered into my hand. 
I love this place, and they set the bar extremely high for not only every other Starbucks location, but for every coffee shop in general.

I went through drive thru and the first two things I ordered they were out of. The women that was taking my order was rude and rushing me after I asked if I could please have a moment to look at the menu since the two things I ordered they did not have. She had an attitude and I wasn't very happy with the service from placing my order to paying at the window where she seemed annoyed to even be there. So I ordered a strawberry refresher and cold brew with pumpkin. I didn't notice until after I was about to drink the strawberry refresher it had rotten strawberries in the drink that looked moldy. I love Starbucks but this particular location is horrible I've had problems in the past but since this is the closest Starbucks to me I decided to give it another try. Definitely won't return to this location I rather go out of my way it's a shame because other reviews that I've seen now are just as bad.

I've come here a number of times in need of a coffee an me nearly every time come away disappointed. While the service is usually prompt, the drinks are way to sweet every single time. It is conveniently located but inconveniently unenjoyable.
Decent Starbucks with a better than average seating area.   Generally helpful staff but no drive-in here.
Staff was very helpful in suggestions on what to order. Order was out in no time. Very clean facility. Only down fall is the hours open.
Slowest Starbucks I have ever been too in my life. Sat in the drive thru line for 30 minutes. Do not recommend going here.

Horrible service. They no longer have or try to cater to allergies. Manager tried to refuse me service. Even when I tried to explain I'm ordering for my husband her attitude was horrible and her voice extremely condescending when she responded ' Well, it's probably not safe for you because we have almond milk on everything, it's everywhere. To which I repeated that it was for my husband. If you have almond milk like, every where as you say, maybe you need a health inspector come by and see why you aren't cleaning up your products.

I wish I would have gotten a receipt to have transaction numbers and other pertinent information.  I went through the drive thru today and ordered a Grande Latte.  I had AT LEAST 1/4 of the cup full of foam.  High prices and hardly any product.  I just wish there had been a CC's with a drive thru on my route.

With all of the better, local coffee places around there's no reason to go here. If you must, expect to wait in line for about 20 minutes unless you're not going on the weekends or before work. 

The parking is terrible and you can get better coffee, for less money, down the road. Try Spaddy's, Jet City,  or Blind Tiger instead.

Most Starbucks you can expect the same customer service same quality of drinks etc. This location always has new employees, long wait times and can never seem to have any of the food items available. Literally you can drive to another location and save time even with a longer commute. Their drive thru is the slowest ordering method possible and non of their employees have any hustle. It is too bad the Starbucks is so horrible because they have one of the best locations in all of South Reno.

We came here regularly since it is near Home Depot and kumon where my son takes his after school classes.. 
the place is quiet and very clean. If I don't have much to do, I can sit there for whole afternoon..:) just kidding! 
Their cake pop is very good. Not so sweet but tasty.. my kids love it!!
I like Starbucks.  Despite my hatred of chains.  They seem to always get it right, they are friendly, and well, that's really all I expect out of my coffee place.

I wish I got the names of the two lady's working here Saturday 4/27/19 @ noon.They were awesome!! 
I don't drink Star bucks my self but my wife is a huge fan. Alas they made it so easy for me and  my 5 beverages

There are actually 3 Starbucks on this boulevard, but I always like this location the most. Well, maybe 4 if including the one inside lakeside mall. One reason is because it looks more modern and the seatings arrangement aren't odd like the other two. Personally, this place has a friendly atmosphere that the other 2 locations lack. I have ordered through their drive way before and honestly it is very slow. So it is much faster that you park your car and order inside. Another thing to note, if you are planning to study for a few hours here, please bring a jacket or small blanket. This place is extremely cold and if you ask the employees to turn the AC down a little bit, they won't do it.

This Starbucks was closest to my gate at Lambert Field, seemed to have all the items I wanted and saw in a Starbucks further away, plus had a shorter line. The workers there were kinda meh but the food was decent: I got both flavors of sous vide eggs and a couple petite vanilla scones, nothing to drink. The worker didn't greet me as I stood there, and was slow to prepare my order despite there only being two people in front of me. Luckily, I had the time to wait, but so frustrating!!! The food was okay - the egg white sous vide was really bland, though. The scones are always tasty.

The customer service and quality of the drinks is usually great. But I'm appalled at how disgustingly dirty the seating area was! Pictures say a thousand words. Corporate needs to get on this! And it makes me wonder if this is what the seating area looks like, what's it look like where food and drinks are being prepped?

Super courteous people behind the counter and super fast service. This Starbucks is in the Castleton Square Mall, which gets really busy. We visited when it first opened for the day during the middle of the week, so there wasn't a line at all. We just walked right up to the counter and got our chocolate cake pop (yep, that was our only order). We also got a cup of ice water, which they didn't charge us for! Nice! I'm not a fan of Starbucks coffee, but it's nice to have one in the mall because I am a fan of their baked goods. 

There are several tables right next to the Starbucks, so you can get your drink or food and rest for a bit.
Hours posted say 9pm but we went in right at 8 and they said they were closing soon so all they had was brewed coffee... How can Starbucks not have espresso available an hour before closing?

Hmmm its Starbucks....that's about all I can say about that. The same disaster with drinks...the so called "baristas" not knowing a latte from a cappuccino and having to stand at the counter and micro-manage your drink being made. I go to this location simply for one reason only, its literally 2 min away from my home. The place is clean and there's an abundance of ready made food options if your in a hurry. Aside from the drinks I order being made incorrectly at least you get service with a smile.
Great Starbucks always friendly and willing to do.what ever they can to please.  Parking is a bit of a problem but worth the effort.  :)

Great service BUT the coffee was just terrible here. 

I got the ultra caramel frappucino and it tasted like water . Barely any coffee taste in it. I'm comparing this to other Starbuck stores I've been to. 

Luckily the staff didn't mind remaking it but even after, it just felt like they added more cream + sugar so it was definitely sweeter yet still lacking coffee taste. 

I hope this is not the quality of coffee Starbucks is now coming down to. 

Just disappointed at the coffee
I'm sure it will get better eventually, but for now I'll continue to go on Terry Parkway.
Rude girl was too lazy to serve us told us store was closed even though it was 4 minutes till closing

I came here today with a co worker to pick up coffees at happy hour for our colleagues. We waited 20 minutes in the drive thru. When it was our turn we were unaware that happy hour deal is only for people who have the app. A cashier with blue hair rudely and loudly announced "why don't they have the app out and ready at the window!?" "We're busy!" We ended up just driving off. Very rude and unprofessional. that's not how you treat costumers or people in general. Won't ever use this location again.

Will never go back. I received a gift card for Starbucks, so I decided to stop this morning. To start, I ordered a creme brûlée latte, not realizing it was actually a caramel brûlée latte, the cashier goes "do you mean caramel brûlée " in a rude tone. Then when the cashier told me my total I tried swiping my gift card in the machine, she proceeded to lean over the counter and rip the gift card out of my hand, swipe it on her computer and then hand it back. Terrible experience. Will only be going to Dunkin' from now on.

I visit this location on a weekly sometimes daily basis. the employees there are not very customer service friendly. I who work night shift who don't sometimes get up until the afternoon goes there ask for a bagel and a green tea the response is they're out of the bagel and maybe I should get up earlier. Today I arrive I ordered five drinks for my family the total is $30 all I had on me was $100 bill I didn't have anything smaller and the cashier acted as if I had committed a crime and she says to me it's a security issue I'm not really sure what the security issue was other than her making me feel wrong for using $100 bill in America. The bank gave me that it was real.  Very unprofessional in the way they handle things.

I keep hoping the next visit will be better than the last at this location, but sadly it seems to be going the other direction.

Today I rolled in at 9am for a meeting. The parking lot was nearly empty, and I thought to myself, finally an opportunity for the fast and friendly service I've come to love from Starbucks. I walk in, find there's no one in line, and order a Grande Blonde Roast. Cashier keys it in and turns to fill my cup only to turn back around to tell me they're out of Blonde Roast and asks if I'd like to sub Pike's. I said that's fine, only for her to be told they're out of that too and I'd have to wait for a fresh brew.

Now I understand you get busy and prep gets behind, but this is the third time in three visits where that has happened at this location. On top of that, there's always overflowing trash in the bathroom and toilet paper on the floor. 

They have so many staff members on at once it seems all of this should be impossible, yet this is the consistent experience I have at this location.

This Starbucks should have its license revoked. I think they have a work share program with the TSA. Hungover 'lady' wearing sunglasses at the register has all the personality of a tree fern and half the warmth.

This Starbucks stands out from the other six within a three-block radius largely for its friendly and attentive staff.  It sees a HUGE wave of Jefferson staff in scrubs and whitecoats wash over it every morning, and gets them all out the door with their caffeine in hand and a smile on their faces in time for morning rounds.  I have walked in when the line was literally up the stairs to the door and been out with my coffee within 5 minutes.

It's spacious inside and has comfortable furniture.  The staff keeps the space surprisingly clean for the large number of homeless folks that frequent the location.  They are also respectful and kind to those homeless folks as long as they are not causing trouble.  They have the full food and drinks menu that you would expect from a Starbucks.  Long live caffeine!

This is a new place, still working out the kinks, but all things considered it seems to be doing well.

Clean space, friendly staff, cold and hot drinks, cold and hot food. I can see myself coming back here more often.

I like that they are experimenting with having a separate community room for groups to use. I hope that works out well for them.

Great customer service and skills 
No problem here 
Been coming here for over 3 years never no problems

Brendan does a great job with this place, and whoever managed prior was also very good. I've never disliked the venue. The staff members have been enjoyable. At least the ones I land on myself. He explained to me today the nitro cold brew with a cascara cold foam. It being nitro and cold brew. Very glad I tried it: not too sweet, and you don't need a major carb to avoid sour stomach.

This newly remodeled Starbucks looks nice. Definitely one of the jazzier spots in St. Clair Square. Starbucks is very consistent from location to location, and this one is no different -- good coffee at an above average price. I want to give a special kudos to the workers here, though. I ordered a tall iced green tea latte, and was really excited to try it. But when I tasted it, it was chai tea -- yuck! Fortunately, they immediately owned the mistake, replaced the drink, and even upgraded the size to a venti. Well done, guys! And, yes, the green tea lived up to my expectations.

The people who work here are always rude.  I don't understand this.   You're providing a service to people who are traveling, why are you in this job if you can't be even minimally friendly.  Also the system to use the app is always down.   It seems they just simply don't want to use it.   This outlet is badly in need of better management.   Does Starbucks not even care because the customer base is captive and has no other choice.   It's shameful.

When in doubt, and need a WI-FI, starbucks is always there for the rescue. This is a nice location easy to spot right off the expressway and has a pretty decent outside area.
I love my starbucks drinks, but even better when I spotted this one, I knew I could kill a little time till my next meeting. glad I found it, and know it is around.

Thora was working and had made some delicious samples. She had an iced toffee nut coffee and an iced cold brew with white chocolate. She won me over to toffee nut for sure! Excellent customer service. What a friendly location! Thank you!

The place is dirty.   The staff are standing around doing nothing when they aren't waiting on customers, and they only have tall cups for cold drinks.   So in order to accommodate a grande they make me multiple talls...wtf?   How hard is it to order cups?

I can see why they have bad reviews, but honestly, they're still new and still going thru the hiring process. I come here about twice a week before work and I have seen a guy get flustered bc he's by himself. Which is understandable. So I don't get upset over that. However, this morning there were two new faces. I think the girls name was Haley and I didn't catch the guys name but he had that blonde curly Justin Timberlake hair going on. Well they awesome! They were polite, attentive and very quick. They were getting people in and out of there super fast. All the while being nice and courteous. 
I don't know why people are being so negative on here, they are still new. They are waaayyy better then the one on the icon. Which also doesn't accept rewards and stuff. Now they are super rude. I would rather skip Starbucks then go to them on Saturdays. The girls there don't look like they want to be working and they just have the worse attitude. I've given them several chances, hoping that maybe it was an off day, as we all have those days. But nope. That was just their attitude. 
The only downside to this location is that they're not open on Saturdays.  hopefully that changes soon. Bc I literally live 100 ft from them. 
Otherwise, keep up the good work!

Stopped here and found a lot places to sit!

That's about all that's good here.  The employees were way too loud.  I don't think I've ever been to a Starbucks where the employees annoy me more than the people sitting around me.  Singly loudly and yelling behind the counter.

But mind you, this was just my experience on one day of the week.  And like I said, there are a lot of places to sit and an area outside as well.
Good consistent service very friendly. There are some delays some days but that's just due to their volume. Very friendly Baristas who understand customer service.

No longer consistent. Average customer service, especially for regulars.  I used to love my neighborhood Starbucks. Visiting almost EVERY day, the staff seemed to be on top of it.  However, they have recently been letting me down. Drive thru has become very inconsistent. No soy (which I pay for) in my coffee twice in two weeks and longer wait times. I have been to other Starbucks who will offer a free drink card if the wait time is too long. Not once has this happened here, and I am a regular. Pretty disappointing and not a good way to keep your customers happy. A recent drink mixup in the drive thru had me waiting again to remake the drink which, after all of that, ended up way sweeter than the ONE pump of syrup I had ordered. Again, no "free drink on us for the trouble" card. And if you think they will treat you to a free drink on your birthday, well "only if you have a registered gold card". Guess it's time to switch to a locally run or independent coffee shop who might be more appreciative of its regular costumers.
OK! So i realized that once i broke down each step of how i wanted my drink (coconut milk mocha macchiato-iced), they actually executed it perfectly!

One of the worst customer service i have ever seen!!! This girl was so rude to me! she did not greet me at all just stood there staring at me and waiting for me to say something. Then took my order and didnt say a word just started dojng her thing and talking to her co workers!! just the worst!! and the drink i ordered was so disgusting!

5 star review for Daniel from Nebraska! His service won my husband and I over as we were driving through Tucson  to LA and made a pitstop for coffee. He was so appreciative of our business- top notch customer service!

Went to the Starbucks today to get a half off Frapuccino and to my delight, they had lids for their cold cup commuter cups. I explained to the barista that I have bought several cold, recycle commuter cups over two months ago and no one in town seem to be carrying the lids anymore.  he simply asked me how many cups I bought without lids and handed me three loads! Thank you thank you! I appreciate wonderful service and not being grilled about where I bought them, when I bought them, only to be told they didn't have any in stock! Thus actually happened to me at several other Starbucks locations. Again many thanks for Fabulous customer service and a refreshing Frapuccino at half price.

I came to Starbucks hoping for a quiet sit-down with my laptop and coffee to get work done, but what I walked into was a cafe that desperately wants to be an EDM party.

Instead of low key music, what they were playing had needless distortion. It sounded like the music was being played through bad speakers, but the speakers aren't bad -- they're just LOUD!

I don't like to leave 1 star reviews but this is the slowest starbucks ever.  Nothing like paying $200 for a tea and waiting longer than normal. I know this is a first world problem. We are paying for the service and speed. Not here.
Nice place to get a cup of coffee while recovering from hours shopping at Costco, Target, and Wegmans.

This is by far my favorite Starbucks of any of them!! All the staff is friendly and courteous. If you go couple of times, they even know your name and they're always glad you came (sorry: Cheers reference). All kidding aside, I tend to use my mobile app and order 4-5 min before I arrive. I've never had to wait much more than that, if I do wait. Most times, I walk in, collect my coffee and walk out. They throw up a hand, say hello, and greet you. It's phenomenal! Mel, Rob, Tristen, and Becca are my favorite baristas anywhere. All the others are fantastic too! Thanks guys for always making my coffee right and for never giving me regular when I drink decaf, unless I order it. :)

Went here to get a coffee and a breakfast sandwich ..They got the order completely wrong, The sandwich never was put in the oven, I ended up waiting and waiting. When I complained they refused to refund my card and restore the rewards to my card. Barrista said she was stressed and wasn't paying attention to my order.  The place is dark and very noisy.  They need to get some bright lights in there

Starbucks, Mandalay Avenue, Clearwater Florida
Nice Starbucks in a convenient location. Main drag it Clearwater Beach, just a few steps away from Pier 60.

We ordered about ten drinks and the service was excellent. Every drink was the right one and I'm very impressed. I got the white chocolate mocha and it was amazing. Something tells me I'll be in Indianapolis next weekend and I know where I'll be first thing in the mornong.
Every day I go for coffee before work. No complaints. Faster to walk in than use the drive thru

The worst Starbucks ever!!! For the life of me, I do not understand why this Starbucks which is connected to one if not the largest hotel in the city are out or tea, premier sandwiches, and oatmeal.  Being attached to the Marriott - I am positive that the calendar of events and conferences are shared.  To make matters worse, they are not sharing with the people standing in line that they are out of almost everything.  So patrons are waiting 10-20 min to get served only to be told that they are out of all the meals and even black tea.

Unacceptable.  Whenever I think about the worst service in Starbucks, this location will always come to mind.

I'm a real fan of this Starbucks because it's comfortable and cozy as I come here to do my school work alot.

However, there's a huge problem with this location taking in a lot of rowdy and homeless people who are there to lounge and charge their phones (they never buy anything).

Also, turn the music down a bit, will ya?

Ok--- I stop in several times to eat or drink coffee at Starbucks before my kiddos have a game at the nearby Police Athletic Fields. Today, I had the worst sandwich (not the employees fault). Starbucks has decided to make a breakfast wrap and instead of a tortilla shell, they utilize flatbread. Well, when you place eggs, steak, and vegetables on flatbread--- it makes the bread soggy. I would strongly urge anyone to stay away from this sandwich. So, the two stars is for the sandwich not the place.

This review is based solely on the drive through ... which I must say - don't make the same mistake I did and go during 11:30 AM on a Saturday. The drive thru window itself is right next to the shopping center exit ramp so if there is any sort of traffic on the cross road, the line gets held up. It look me a while to get my drink and I think it would have honestly been quicker if I parked at Dorgniac's and walked over. Parking is also limited as they share the spots with a couple other businesses (a jamba and a burrito place if I remember correctly)

Took the grandkids here the other day.  We've been to many Starbucks - G-d know there are enough of them - throughout the country.  This was is basically on par with others.  You can't always find a table, since this place is fairly small - this can be a pain. Otherwise, this place is pretty good, but nothing great.  Does the trick though. Plenty of parking for cars but not enough seating for humans.  Has outdoor seating, which is a nice extra - only when the weather is good, of course.  The grandkids really like coming here.

I live closest to this Starbucks and my gym is also in the vicinity.  I run miles and miles around South Reno and before I typically walk home, I usually stop in and ask for a large ice water.  They get it for me without a problem and they're always so nice.  It's free, tasty, clear, cold water.  Dunkin' Donuts once asked me for 50 cents, pshh.  Bucks is where it's at.

Horrible customer service. I order 2 cake pops, one birthday and strawberry. They gave me strawberry and chocolate. I asked the Chinese barista nicely that one of the cake pop was wrong and she just gave me the stinky face. And to top it off when I was watching her as soon as she put the cake pop in the bag she purposely drop it on the floor and my daughter was sad that it was broken and came off the stick.

This is my most loved Starbucks! The baristas are always upbeat and fun to talk to. The coffee is consistent in taste. The atmosphere is great. There is plenty of space inside and out to relax and meet with friends or clients. Oh, and the outdoor furniture is the best!

If you want to wait and wait and wait for your simple drink order (medium iced coffee) while the two employees in the nearly empty coffeeshop hang out and/or fill the drink orders for five or six cars that come through the drive-thru after you place your order in person at the counter, then by all means, come to this Starbucks. Not to mention the three mistakes that both the workers made on my drinks order.

The crew here are always very efficient! The music is too loud so its difficult to make or take calls. It's frequently too cold. I've brought people here and we have had to leave because the music is so loud.  This review is after more than 2 dozen visits so it is not random.

This is the slowest Starbucks I have ever visited.  There is always a line because it takes so long for them to take and make an order.  It is ridiculous.  Expect a 20-30 min wait for a line 8 people deep.  

It is usually faster to walk down Canal to the new Starbucks and order from there than to order from this place right next to your office.  Horrible.  When will the management  staff this location with enough competent employees?

Guys, we know your busy in the morning but slow it down and get it right.  Ordered a white chocolate mocha and it was very bitter and 2/3 full.  As a business owner I would never deliver food that is sub-par.  You have one shot to get it right.  You are the face of the corporation.  People don't pay for that.  It is part of the hospitality business.

Went the next morning to give them another chance... wife ordered a caramel macchiato and I ordered another white chocolate mocha (drive through). The orders came out tasting exactly the same and neither of the drinks tasted like what we ordered.  Took the  drinks in to let the cashier know... she was quick to point out that there was a label on the drinks that said what they were :-/.  I tried to be nice about it but I immediately found myself telling her I knew how to read.

They did remake the drinks and they were not too pleased about it.  Neither were up any standard that Starbucks should have and they did make sure that the drinks were not the same... but still, a customer spends $11 dollars for 2 drinks, you would think they would be of quality.  If you want coffee I would recommend the gas station across the street...

Reduced to one star.  Won't be coming back.

I am a Starbucks fanatic! This particular store really stood out to me. I was passing through as I began my drive from West Chester, PA down to Wilmington, NC. I was greeted with multiple smiles and and when I informed my barista of my long drive, she suggested making my drink "extra hot" so that delicious warmth lasted a bit longer! As I was leaving they were sure to wish me safe travels! While in the store I popped into the bathroom (take the breaks where I can) and it was very clean, which is very appreciated when you have to use public restrooms!! Over all great experience and will be returning anytime I pass through!

Lemme get the bad out of the way, this Starbucks is no longer 24-hours. With all the other economy cuts made by many corporations, it could have been worse... but it's still a loss.

The good? There's still live music nights on Friday and Saturday! Yes, at a Starbucks. The crew still rocks shop, although they have a new manager that you get the feeling is not as hip as the one who made this place what it was. Many of the regulars, from Germans, to Italians, to Asian to suburbanite Christians, make for some awesome coffee conversation.

The coffee, however, is still Starbucks. That means get an espresso, as the talent of the barista actually makes a difference with these drinks, whereas the drip may be as bad as a fast food chain these days.

Hands down, it is amazing to find this place in South Jersey. It's no longer the haven for those of us who work thru the nights, but it is an impressive step and an accomplishment for Starbucks.
Smaller store, I often have to come later to ensure I get a table. The staff is great and I've never had any issues with my drink. Very quiet and that makes up for it being small.

All 3 of my drinks were wrong. They waited over 5 mins to open the window. My sisters frapuccinos were completely melted, and when they brought them back in the male worker was very passive aggressive.

Well as usual this store has failed me again. They shouldn't be allowed to do mobile orders no matter how many people are there they never have my coffee ready NEVER. Again today I ordered within their 3-7 minute window sat there for at least 10 minutes when I got there and they hadn't even started my coffee when I asked them to cancel it and they still have not. Worst store in town have a couple nice people working there but it shows that no one else cares.
Okay boys, time to spend the money and get the electric outlets fixed at the big table.
Good lord is all I can say.......the place is empty and still 20 minute drive thru wait for 1 drink. I

Okay. So, it's Starbucks. I get that. However, this one is just high-key terrible. When I visited recently, they gave me the wrong food (twice) and messed up my drink, all while taking 20 minutes to get the stuff I ordered to me. The only had one overwhelmed person on cash register, and there were at least 7 employees in the store. I will likely not patron this Starbs again, even if I'm desperate. Their only saving grace was they had a Beatles' album on their radio.
Honestly not a great Starbucks. Every drink here feels half assed over the last couple years. I always feel like I wasted my money when I come to this location :( Robb drive Starbucks is better.

This has to be the most mismanaged Starbucks of all. Always long waits - asked to pull around for food items, drinks are thrown together without being mixed & always shorted. Check out the drink I was given. I can't believe the service given for the prices we have to pay. Whoever was at the window at 6pm on 2/16 has absolutely horrible customer service. Never again! Better coffee shops in Seminole Heights
I come to this Starbucks and study here all the time. Some of the workers are really nice. It's also a good and chill place to study too.
One of the uncivilized Starbucks ever . Their associates need to be trained more . Luck of energy and people are unfriendly.

I realize I've never actually been inside this Starbucks but my experiences with the Drive Thru have been good ones.  This location is always busy but the staff is friendly and efficient.  Never had a problem with my order.
The place has a marked improvement.   The baristas are engaging, friendly and always eager to help.   Bryan still spells his name wrong  but he's a character and an integral part of the business.

Love starbucks, but I was lied to when the manger told me I was not charged for a protein shot when I was indeed charged. Very quick to dismiss me as a tourist with lots of money inferring that $1 won't break my bank.

They are never out of what I want when I go in.  The store inside is very well stocked.  Employees are friendly and fast for the most part.  (Very quick inside, longer wait outside)

Knocking down to the 4 stars because parking is difficult in this tiny center and the drive through is often packed because of the location and lack of other Starbucks close by.  Staff is still pretty quick with the line.

This location delivers the best food and beverages in my opinion. Their customer service is always outstanding and they always make the drink exactly as you have ordered it. Now that it is hot outside you must try their cold brew with cold foam. It is absolutely amazing. Whom ever invented the new lid for this knew exactly what they were doing. Some how you get the perfect mix of coffee and foam in every sip. The trick is to NOT stir the drink, at all. Once you stir it you have just destroyed the delicate balance between the 2 and it becomes just another cup of iced coffee. You can add a shot of your favorite flavor and/or sweetener or sugar but I would suggest no extra anything as it is sweet all on its own.  If you are on the fence about trying this go ahead and give it a shot. You will wonder how you have lived without this for so long.
This location does not make drinks correctly and always gets my order wrong, even if I'm ordering 1 drink. Other Metairie locations are much better.

I ordered through the mobile app, and I accidentally ordered the wrong drink. I asked the barista about my ordered and he pointed out I ordered the wrong drink. He then began making the drink I intended to order without hesitation. Great customer service!

It's new and so are all the baristas. But they are super nice. And I can tell they actually hired some people from the neighborhood. That made me smile. Psalm, is my fav. The artwork by B Mike is also a plus. If I ever have a reason to sit in inside I'll grab a seat by the window and gawk at that.
Got the new triple caramel Frappuccino and it was amazing! So tasty and even had a caramel type whipped cream. Great service and tasted delicious! Must try!

Love it. Service and my Tazo tea was perfect. My only complaint is that they have little parking. If I get a ticket for parking in some reserved parking lot that no one is using, I'll stab someone in the eye with my straw (i.e., politely park other in another lot....but i'll be very disgruntled!)

We stayed at the Bellevue and this SB is right by the front revolving door. I went in there several times over a course of a week and the staff are very nice. One guy is very dapper with his fedora. 

They have a good selection of Philly and Pennsylvania SB mugs as I picked them up as gifts. Many of the SBs we passed during our trip didn't have both mugs only one of the other, mostly Philly mugs. A really cute but small SB. Very busy in the mornings
They have updated and now accept the app. Staff takes their time to get to know you. Drinks are always spot on. See you soon...

I frequent this shopping center but had never been to this Starbucks.  There is actually a small Starbucks inside the Target across the parking lot and this one is pretty newly opened. My friend and I had dinner a few doors down at one of the restaurants and decided we wanted to keep talking so we went to Starbucks. He got a Mint Majesty hot tea and I got the Iced  1/2 green tea  1/2 lemonade without the sweetening syrup. It was refreshing and delicious. We sat outside. I'll be back!

This is a very busy Starbucks, so running out of drinks is going to happen. My last visit at this Starbucks will probably be my last at any Starbucks. I ordered three different drinks options, after being told they were out of all three... I was finally told they had the forth option I ordered. I requested an iced drink two different time...after waiting 15 minutes (no big deal, they were busy) my drink came out hot. When I tried to tell one of the employees that it was supposed to be iced, she walked away. I'm hoping she just didn't hear me but nonetheless I left this Starbucks with no drink and a 6 dollar charge on my card.

This location is super small and you will have to wait a bit for your drink. Unfortunately I have gone several times already and each person that does my drink does it wrong or it doesn't taste right. Also their lemonade is super sour. Other locations use a premade carton so I don't know what crappy homemade lemonade they use but it taste pretty bad. I saw they pour it from a pitcher..that's how I know they are making it inhouse. Also most of the employees don't understand the concept of light ice. By the way watch out that they don't over charge you on refills. It happened to me. I won't be going back. I keep wasting money everytime I go and I always leave unhappy.
No parking, people are extremely rude. My drink was incorrect and I asked if I could get it iced and she said it was too late. Bad customer service, never left a Starbucks pissed of before.

Decent walk-up SBUX. Not to be confused with the store closest to TSA, this one is located in terminal 1 between gates C-17 & C-19. Its small so don't expect plush seating, tabletops or any of the sort.

Great for simply grabbing a cup of Joe & snack before retreating to your gate area. Customer service was decent...nothing to write home about. 

Merchandise, especially the piece of STL ceramic mugs are available for purchase before boarding. 

~Christy

As Starbucks go, I give this one a 3 because Carrollwood really should have a much nicer Starbucks. No real complaints but just not large enough for this location. So it gets too distracting also. 

The staff has always been very good here.

I've been coming to this Starbucks for quite some time, maybe a year if not a little more and it is the best one around! The staff is always friendly and full of conversation, most of the time I just have to walk in and they're already typing my order out without me having to say a word!

I was here last year and had a terrible experience. This location was convenient for me so I went back. It was busy, busy. From the time I walked in and the time I left with my beverage it was 15 minutes. During the time spent I looked around where the partners were making drinks. It was full of spills, stains and finger printed surfaces. I can not say that this is one of my favorite stores.
As for the nasty insult from "John B". Clearly this Starbucks has a major problem. I'm not the only person complaining about the service.
What's up??? I waited in line 10 minutes to order, then waited another10 for my drink. If you are understaffed, put more people on!

Stopped here while shopping at Canal Place while in town.   It's a very small location tucked away in the corner on the ground floor.  

The line builds up rather quickly and ,on the day I went, service was slower than molasses. There was one person taking orders and one barista on duty. I understand that locations can get slammed with orders but it was almost as if it was the barista's first day. He just moved very slowly.  I couldn't order a java chip frappachino because they were out of java chips. So they may want to evaluate their ordering of supplies.

I'm interested how service is when business is slow . Hopefully not the same and, if so, I would give him a break.

There is nothing to laugh about when you gave my order to someone way behind me. Get names for orders always. The older lady who was facilitating was laughing at what happened and hugging and giving bakery to other customers who were standing with her at the opposite side. And don't forget to apologize!!! It is just basic!
Love this location! I tend to mobile order and pick up, and they always have my order ready and correct when I arrive. And they're pretty friendly as well.

The area was so dirty. It took over 15 minutes to get a strawberry acai no berries and iced green tea. I watched as my drink was made incorrectly and the strawberries taken out and placed back in the container. The first time it was made with strawberries it was tossed away. One employee working two others milking the clock. 
I guess and a frequent guest I expected more. I will never return to the location. When in the mall   Gloria Jeans is it.

Thanks to our local coffee roasters, I've become a coffee snob. I'm not sure if it's a good or a bad thing at this point because now I tend to snub my nose at most of the coffee I find offered outside of their shops. 

That said, I can still enjoy Starbucks, though my preferences have changed quite a bit. 

My selections are still typically black coffee offerings, but they trend toward the light roast these days. By many standards though, Starbucks' light would be dark. I can taste that dark, bitter, and deeply roasted character absent from most specialty coffee. It still works, but it's not what I really enjoy.

So combine the coffee with the fact that this particular store is small and located in a pretty densely packed strip mall, and you've got a location with less than awesome parking and slim pickings on the seating. Not a great combo.

The most redeeming factor for this store though is the staff. I've always been greeted with a smile, my orders are delivered correctly, and all the appropriate questions are asked.

Starbucks nailsl the consistency game again, and keeps them squarely in my wheelhouse of coffee shops I'll visit on occasion.

This is actually the second time I've been to this Starbucks; I was here last night. I thought maybe last night was a fluke so I decided to try them again today. It was no fluke. Last night I tried to order And iced Trenta peach infused green tea. They were out of this too. So I tried to order another green tea. I was asked if I wanted black tea, green tea, etc. I restated green tea. This morning I went inside to order a grande iced chai tea latte and see if they perhaps had lids to their cold cup commuter cups. I placed my order for an iced grande chai tea latte. The barista asked me If I wanted my drink iced and what size. I hesitated but continued and asked her if perhaps they had any extra lids for their cold cup commuter cups as I had purchased 2 cups but that location was out of lids. She made half an attempt to look for lids and advise me they didn't have any.I'm beginning to think I must be a glutton for punishment for all the times I return to Starbucks and continuously receive poor service and not the beverage of my choice.

In search of a quiet place to work on a weekday morning I decided it was time to check this newer location out. Sadly, I only stayed a few minutes because I had serious trouble finding a seat and the line at the counter never seemed to move. 

I'm not sure if it's the shopping center, more people living in the area, or what, but the few experiences I've had with typically predictable national brands in this plaza have not been up to the standards for these businesses. 

This location is much bigger and nicer than the location that was previously across the street. The crowd inside was all business too, which is a great indicator of who's living in the area. All that said, the store doesn't seem set up to handle the increased volume they're experiencing. I stood in the line for what felt like 10 minutes and only saw it inch forward. I just wanted a cup of black coffee and a seat to do a little work, but it looked like that could take 15-20 minutes so I went up to the store on S. Virginia by Total Wine (notoriously bad for seating too)  and was seated (with power nearby) in 5 minutes. 

Giving three stars for benefit of the doubt that this was just an off day. It certainly isn't what I've come to expect from Starbucks.

Great place to study or have a meeting! I love the decor and the friendly baristas! They are always cleaning and taking care of the store. They take their time to know their customer's names and help when needed.

Went through the drive-thru today to get the chestnut praline latte that I just read they had on the Starbucks website. I ordered that and at the window I got a Frappuccino. I told the girl that no I ordered for it to be hot - in latte form. She just kept looking at me with the dumbest look saying "it's a Frappuccino, it's a Frappuccino." She refused to do anything to change the mistake she made bc she clearly did not hear me make my order and then acted like they couldn't make what I wanted when the Starbucks WEBSITE STATES THAT HOLIDAY DRINKS CAN BE SERVED ICED, AS A FRAP, OR L.A.T.T.E. 
I won't be here again. I'd rather drive to the newly renovated terry parkway location. Y'all suck.

This particular Starbucks has one of the slowest moving lines in town. I'd avoid. 

As someone who spends approximately $200 a month on coffee, a majority of which goes to Starbucks, I have to say I'm especially annoyed with this location. My personal go to drink in the morning is 3 shots of espresso in a treinta cup of ice so I can pour my protein shake in with it. It fits perfectly. For whatever this location only gives a venti cup and is a bit snotty about it. 

Didn't ruin my morning by any means but between that and the slllloooowwww line I'll visit other locations.

This Starbucks is in violation of Philadelphia's law regarding gender signage on single occupancy restrooms.

I visited today and noticed gender signs on the restrooms.

I spoke with a manager, a young woman, and said they needed to come down in compliance with the law.

I was told "We tried that, it didn't work." I was told that when they put up unisex signage, men went inside and then left the restroom doors unlocked to be perverts.

I pointed out that this was unfortunate but it did not change the laws.

I was then told that upper management had made the decision and nothing could be done.

I pointed out that my only recourse then would be to file a complaint with L&I.

The response I got was "Hey buddy, do what you gotta do."

I might also point out that the two restrooms have DIFFERENT external lock codes on them, which means that it is up to the employees to attempt to ascertain the gender of the customer and then give them a code pertaining to the gender they've assumed.

NOT acceptable.

It's a nice friendly Starbucks. 
The drinks were made in a timely manner and the people were kind. I don't really order anything fancy or customized so I can't speak to that regards. However, the mango dragon fruit I got was delicious as always. 

The interior has pretty good seating capacity and it offers some outdoor seating as well. The place wasn't that noisy but did provide some noise for a good background noise.

I like Starbucks. However the Algiers location is different from all the rest in the metro New Orleans area. 
50% of the time my order is wrong and it's got to be the easiest espresso drink to make. Triple espresso Macchiato , 3 shots of espresso and foam, not half a cup of milk and 3 shots. 
I also buy packaged espresso beans at Starbucks, last 2 times I went to purchase them at this location. NONE. How do you operate a Starbucks and not have Espresso beans. Hopefully things will get better at this location, but until that happens I will avoid it.

The only reason this location doesn't have 5/5 is because every night I come in, it's the same manager. My experience at Starbucks in the morning and afternoons are always pleasant but as soon as I see the short bearded manager, I instantly want to turn around. I came in this last Wednesday just to get some quick drinks and the entire time, he wasn't friendly at all and honestly looked like he hated being there. It wasn't good customer service at all. I could hear him actually cussing! With kids in the store and everything! It was VERY unprofessional of him but what do you expect anymore when he always seems to be in a poor mood. A managers job is to overlook and hold people accountable but if he can't even watch his own actions, then I'll steer clear of his nights. If he can't even watch his mouth, how do I know he can make my drinks in a safe way? I haven't seen much of the other shift. He was always super nice and smiling! He needs to work more nights so the angry gremlin can get his beauty rest or hit the bars. He seems like he needs it. lol guess I'm back to being a morning person at this location.

went there again to give them Another try.. outside in the customer seats sat a street person asking for patrons going in and out for money.  Inside I was second in line, barrista took the order from person in front of me, then as I approached register she turned around and made Herself a cup of tea and checked her smartphone for messages , really not caring I was in line. Never again at that or any Starbucks locations

Was shocked that the reviews weren't great for this spot as most Starbucks are pretty standard. But here I am with a 2 star review. Line was long and did not move fast which isn't the end of the world. But while I was waiting a young lady working there was coughing up a storm and I looked to find her handling the food without gloves on. There was no effort to cover her mouth or move her head away. The woman in front of me gave me a look and said I hope you weren't planning on ordering food. I had been but I had already decided to pass. Thought I was safe from interacting with this worker and then right before my turn at the register she jumps into take orders, including touching cups! She also noticeably did not look well. I fortunately got a different cashier but had she asked to take my order I would have said no. The person helping me was good and our drinks came out fine, but the whole experience made me cringe. Unlikely to go back to this spot again on our trip as I question how much in the store  she touched. I don't understand how a worker wouldn't have enough common sense to go home or at least take precautions (gloves/mask), and how her peers didn't intervene.

UPDATE: Still a tragedy... Been standing here waiting for my mobile order for over 20minutes...

UPDATE: Still terrible and my drink ALWAYS has too much cream smh... 
The manager that is there in the mornings (light skin African American) is to blame for how terrible things are in the mornings...
She looks miserable and pissed at all times and treats the staff miserably... Those girls are never smiling and it's cus she talks to them like they are 12... No constructive criticism or actual managing... Just barking out orders with soooo much attitude... I've literally traveled the world and have never been to a more depressing Starbucks in my life... 
Once you bring in a MANAGER that isn't miserable and retrain the staff they'll have a shot... I sure hope it's soon smh

I have made 5 trips here (all mobile orders) and 4 of my orders were wrong and the 1 that was right was only 2/3 full... I'm assuming the baristas don't know how to make the drinks smh

I was so excited we were getting a Starbucks in Algiers but this is a huge disappointment...

I am blown away with the customer service and great attitude of the staff. We came through the drive-through on a rainy day and had the best experience ever. Me and my friend like to joke around so we were cutting up with the girl at the drive-through. She was so friendly and fun and was laughing right with us. Sunny served us coffee and also brightened our day. You cannot put a price on good customer service. I frequent the Starbucks on  but from now on I will be going to this location. All because one employee took the time to laugh and have fun while doing her job. She was very professional and knowledgeable she answered all my questions.

This location is only a few blocks away and a straight shot on my way to work in the morning, and yet, I will be going out of my way to find an alternative from now on.

For the third visit in a row my drink has been made incorrectly. This time (see pic) the "venti" had 2 inches of empty space before you hit coffee. And no, it didn't have whip cream that melted.

Sure, complaining about complex, gourmet coffee being mixed incorrectly is probably going to come across a little.. high maintenance. But here's the truth: if I'm going to pay $5 every morning for something I could essentially make at home, it had better be consistent and well made. Starbucks ALWAYS used to hold to a very high standard, repeat your order, spot-on every time. Lately, none of those things are happening. And at this point, it simply doesn't make any sense to go there every morning, and drop cash to get... whatever the barista chooses to make me.
A good convenient place for coffee but workers there are not clean at all. Trash was strewn on the floor for the entire day, no one cared. I went there on the eve of Christmas.

Drive thru takes too long. The services is awful. It used to be good years ago this location but honestly something is wrong with the management of this place. I live close by but I will avoid this place.

*I ordered ahead of time by using the Starbucks app... my order wasn't even ready at the window.

* I had to come back because I realized they forgot to give me my coffee cake and I asked for it not to be warmed on the receipt

* on my receipt, it states "shopping bag... $0.00"
At first he made state out everything I had ordered and I looked at my phone for verification but then he took it (the bag) away from me. Super awkward because I needed to carry my shit.

Horrible.... This store started off great, but has drastically declined in both service and quality in the last week or so. I stopped by this store on Saturday, and today, and ordered a venti Marble Mocha Macchiato with whipped cream, which is made the following way: White mocha on the bottom, steamed milk, shots of espresso, then mocha drizzle on top. It is normally made without whipped cream, but I ask them to add it. Anyway, both Saturday and today I was given a caramel macchiato with no whipped cream. The first time it happened (Saturday), I gave them the benefit of the doubt because it was 5:45 in the morning, and maybe they weren't fully awake yet. But, now that it happened again today at 1:00pm, I thought I would call and complain because I have had to throw away two drinks now, costing me around $10.00. Yes, I threw both drinks away because first of all, they were not what I ordered, and secondly, caramel macchiato tastes like a dog took a crap in a cup, to me anyway. When the lady picked up the phone, I asked to speak with the manager. She told me the manager wasn't there. I asked her when the manager would be back, to which she replied, "well, the manager is here, she just can't come to the phone right now because she's busy." Since when did lying to a customer become good customer service? I asked her to have the manager call me, and she took down my information. Then she asked what the nature of the call was about. I explained the situation to her. She then proceeded to argue with me and say that "marble mocha macchiato" sounds like "caramel macchiato." What kind of drugs are you taking lady? Whatever they are, could I get some? You know the old saying "you can't fix stupid." I guess that applies in this situation. Anyway, now the Starbucks employee has lied to me, and argued with me over the phone. I seem to recall most companies having a policy "the customer is always right". Needless to say, I will not be going back to this location ever again. I think I will stick to PJs coffee, and hopefully everyone else will too, so we can run this establishment into the ground.

Price-gouging a la carte (or, actually, unlisted items)! Employees might be smiling, but what I care about is the quality of the beverage. Over six dollars for a cappuccino?? It is Champs-Elysees? When I asked about where the cappuccino was listed, I did not receive a straight answer at first. The reply was: what size do you want?  So I asked again.
