One of the best Starbucks around. The baristas are always super friendly, every drink I've ever gotten has tasted great, and most importantly of all, this store really sorta feels like a home. All of the regulars are nice for the most part, and the baristas genuinely try to get to know everyone and treat everybody like they're a regular. They consistently go above and beyond.

I came into this store to by some gift cards for some coworkers. When I got there and asked for them the barista was rude and snotty to me because I was not purchasing a drink.  Love the chain but will never visit this store again.

The area for this Starbucks is great- it's at the center of Germantown in Chestnut Hill.  There are plenty of chairs and lounge chairs to sit and do your work.  It's quite so you can be really productive.  Just like any Starbucks, the staff are friendly and attentive when you walk in the counter to order your drinks- other than that nothing special with the service.

The WORST Starbucks I've ever been to, every single visit. I refuse to come to this location anymore no matter how convenient it is. They are slow, rude, and work with zero sense of urgency. On my last visit I had to wait 25 mins for a simple order and STILL ask for it 3 times! Then Alyssa proceeds to say "here" and toss my food on the counter. Are you kidding me?! How is it that every other Starbucks can manage to be moderately friendly and get your order correct in a timely manner and these guys just CAN'T??

This is by far my favorite location. So close to home and the staff make it an effort to recognize and get to know you so on your next visit they know what you are getting. I love how clean, vibrant and relaxing the store is.

I've come here a number of times in need of a coffee an me nearly every time come away disappointed. While the service is usually prompt, the drink mare way to sweet every single time. It is conveniently located but inconveniently unenjoyable

Nice Starbucks with outside seating. Too bad they don't have a drive thru like the one at Linebaugh and Dale Mabry, but this is in a strip mall and not a free standing building. They currently have a deal until May 10th where from 3-6pm, Frappucinos are half off! There is a new frappuccino called the "S'mores". I sadly was underwhelmed. I LOVE s'more flavored things. This had a burnt marshmallow taste and it was way too sweet and not frozen enough. I'd be willing to give it another try with another barista though. It was busy and the girl seemed overwelmed and "in the weeds".

These hours are false. The store closes at 9 apparently
 
The girl in the drive through said it was just an iPhone issue but yelp and my google search shows the same store closing at 10


If I could get a clear answer that'd be great.

Horrific customer service today. I've been getting Frappuccino's for years and today mine tasted like water; I thought the barista might have forgotten the syrup so I asked to get something new. After taking my drink, the brunette barista, who I believe was actually the manager, gave me so much attitude about asking to replace the drink. She said that it's supposed to taste like that...oh and that I shouldn't drink Frappuccino's in the summer because the heat will melt it..but I was sitting inside the Starbucks. I got so much attitude that I said never mind and left. I'm not sure if Starbucks or it's employees realize that spending over $5 on a drink that tastes like water is unacceptable. I will not be returning.

Haven't been to a Starbucks in a long time, this is definitely the nicest one in our area. My drink was even a little complicated but they got it done fast and the servers were quite kind. The inside and exterior are both very nice and the drink tasted great!

I would give no stars if that was possible. This is the absolute worst Starbucks ever in the name of Customer Service/hospitality employees everywhere. We are in the age of customer service, get with the program. Worst wait times in the world. And I have traveled the world and gone to Starbucks in many many countries.

This place used to be amazing and I LOVED coming here, but lately it has gone down hill. And when I say down hill, I mean DOWN HILL. It absolutely SUCKS now. 

Curious as to why? Please read below: 

Wait Time:
The wait is always forever. I feel like I could knit myself a sweater in the time it takes to go through that drive through and that's if I'm the only car in the drive through. I completely understand that Starbucks is popular and very busy, especially during peak times, but why is it that management cannot staff to demand? Is it really to difficult to know that during peak hours, the establishment might need a few extra hands? Now, I know the reasonable thing many might be thinking: Mobile Ordering. An absolutely fantastic idea. And for a while, worked wonderfully. Unfortunately, it seems as though it is impossible for these orders to be made correctly. Not sure why mobile orders are any different from ordering at the drive through or in store, but there's something that just makes them impossible to be made correctly. Also, in case anyone is curious, I haven't ordered anything complicated, especially through mobile ordering. If I want non-fat milk or sugar free substitutes, I order at the Starbucks. 

Cups:
Most recently, my sister and I came in and ordered some frappes and we received very liquid and disgusting drinks in sticky cups. Now I know I shouldn't have high expectations, but I really do not think expecting a clean cup is too much to ask for. 
What really put this trip over the edge was that when I asked for new cups, the barista ignored the fact that they gave me sticky, dripping cups and just put my drink (in the same cup) into another cup. So I walked out with my drink in literally two cups. Now, I know it technically solved the problem, but this is not the first time this has happened. In fact, I cannot remember the last time I received a drink from this Starbucks and the cup was not dripping or sticky. The absolute worst is when you stop before work, in your work clothes, and you don't notice the liquid on the outside of the cup and it drips all over your clothes. Sorry Starbucks, didn't realize I needed to watch out for part of my drink on the outside of my cup. Is it too much to ask for my drink not to be on the outside its holder? 
Quality:
I would also like to mention the quality of the drinks at this Starbucks. Now, I'm not a connoisseur of coffee. I do not have high standards when it comes to the quality and taste. As long as it tastes like it's supposed to - I'm good. That being said, I cannot remember the last time my drink from this Starbucks was actually right. It's been close, it's been drinkable, but it has absolutely not been correct/perfect, or what it is supposed to taste like. One might then ask, "Well how do you know what it's supposed to taste like?" My response: "I've been drinking Starbs for years - it's what got me through college. There's no way they changed their recipes for all my favorite drinks in the past few months." It's honestly just sad. I'm not a barista nor do I pretend to know the trials and tribulations of what it might be to be one, I'm sure it's difficult and my respect to all the amazing baristas out there, BUT don't many of your barista instruments have measurement marks on them? Doesn't Starbs use specific measurements for many, if not all, their drinks? Again, I'm not a barista, but it just seems like it would be really difficult to use the incorrect ingredient measurements. I'm sure if someone was new, of course it would be difficult to remember all the measurements and what goes in what drink, but come on. Eventually, after making so many drinks, it would have to become second nature or at least somewhat of a habit. Also, the amount of Starbucks trips that have resulted in a cup of milk being handed to me has been one to many. At this point, we must have to realize that there's something wrong in the coffee making process. I would never go to Starbucks and pay $5 for a cup of steamed milk.
Overall:
I'm just really disappointed in this specific Starbucks location. When I say it got me through college, it literally got me through college. I loved coming to Starbucks. It was my treat for the day and it just made my day better. That being said, I know it's silly to base my entire day on how my cup of coffee was, but is it really too much to go to an establishment which specializes in a product and expect their product to meet a certain set of expectations? The purpose of this review is not to hurt anyone or be rude, it's to help someone in charge realize that there is a problem and there are many coffee drinkers who want this problem to be resolved. It just makes me sad how down hill this place has gone. 
I really hope this review makes it to someone who can do something to help this caterpillar of a store because I KNOW it has the potential to be a beautiful butterfly. Until then, I guess I'm reaping the benefits of saving $5/day.

They were friendly; however, when ordering from the menu items previously purchased. They told me they don't have it on the menu. This time I tried ordering a Carmel frap. We ordered the butter beer first. It was not a frap at all. It was black coffee with way too much dairy and a toffee syrup on top. Afterwards we ordered the strawberry frap that was actually pretty good.

Cameron is a fucking GEM! Always brightens my day when he is there !
Ps. Liz and Davis and everyone here are troopers

We were here shortly after opening day.  Service was super friendly and prompt, and our drinks were yummy and correct.  Plus, TWO CONDIMENT BARS!  This café is also really roomy, and the parking lot is much larger and more well-planned than most SBUX DT locations I have seen.

This sbux is attached next to the Marriott. It seems to have gone through some remodeling because a part that connects to the hotel had that weird pungent vingegary smell.

This sbux is not corporate, so a lot of the promotional events are not available here (e.g., frapp happy hour that happened may 5-14). Though the space is small, they could have had at least two more tables--but they don't, so their seating is limited. But you could also sit at the hotel lobby i suppose.

Their service was...bad. My friend got tea, and they were giving him such attitude when he asked to fill the cup all the way with water. It's just hot water! I didn't think it was an unreasonable request.
What is going on here? I've never been to such a bad starbucks's. Y'all need to get it together. The staff seems poorly trained. The drinks are meh.

This has probably been the worst experience I've ever had at a Bucks. I ordered my drinks and they apparently ran out of the seasoning but didn't tell the person taking the drinks. They then said they sent someone upstairs to get it. It then took an HOUR to get back. Then I still had to ask for my drink two more times before I got it. Ridiculous!!

Nice space, good coffee. But Military Veterans, do NOT expect to receive a complimentary cup of coffee from this location on Veteran's Day. When I inquired about the advertised promotion this morning, I was answered with, "Nope, this is just a normal day."

I just moved to the area and today was my 2nd day (Sat & Sun) going to this Starbucks. Both days the workers seemed frazzled, with very little direction. Some were just standing waiting for direction while the counters were covered with major spills and a mess. Others were running around nearly missing each other with beverages in their hands. Each day I had to wait for 10 min for my food and drink order. There are spills all over the place and today it just seemed like a bunch of teenagers running the place with no management. 

Good thing there is another Starbucks near work because I would not be able to come to this one during the work week.

Asked for a Pink drink and it came out white. Seems they forgot the Pink.  I've learned to ask for light ice with the pink drink and this time they gave me no ice, so it was warm.  I guess that was my fault. The positive part, Kathy Orr from FOX 29 was here!!!

I thought Starbucks had a strict non-smoking policy.  It does not.  When you arrive at this Starbucks on a typical Sunday morning, you will be met by 5-10 motorcycles impeding your entry to the cafe, first and foremost. Then, if you enjoy sitting outside and taking in a bit of fresh air with your latte, this is impossible. Starbucks allows smoking of cigars and cigarettes on their property. No need to patronize this location, as you will stink like smoked tobacco when you leave.

Hands down above and beyond with service! I am a frequent costumer at this starbucks, I work next door at the tanning salon (lash extensions) and i often grab my morning drink and a snack. Not just an average kind of hospitality at Starbucks, will continue to stop in for my fav drink ! Thank you so much!
I've been disappointed the last 6 times visiting this location , the coffee is flavorless and basically just taste like steamed milk.. retrain your employees

Very disappointed. Like most, I was also very excited to get a Starbucks in Algiers. The first time I went, they gave me the wrong drink so I drove back to get what I had actually ordered and the drink was terrible. Well, I decided to go back about a month later for two of the same drinks and neither one of them seemed to be sweetened and one of them was really dark while the other one was extremely light and tasted like steamed milk with a hint of coffee. This girl shut the window after I thanked her and wished her a good evening. Overall, terrible experience both times I've been here. Won't go back. I'll stick to PJ's and if I ever want Starbucks, I'll just drive to Terry Pkwy.
They need to hire more than three people to work.  I should not have to wait 10 minutes to have my order taken.  Only go to Starbucks because someone gave me a gift card - over priced slow service.

I took my Dad to Starbucks for a coffee however there was not a place to sit together because everyone in there had a computer and took up 4 seats per person with their backpacks books and crap all over the tables. WTF!!! This crap is out of control real customers do no have a place to sit and enjoy coffee that's crazy that they have to take over the entire seating sections.
This is the worst Starbucks to come to when in the airport. The customer service is nonexistent and that's a compliment.

Within walking distance, you'll find a Starbucks in this Marriott, the Westin, and the JW. This is easily the most preferable one. Excusing the construction currently going on, the area is generally the quietest and least crowded and the staff are friendly. 

I've always found specific brick and mortar Starbucks locations have better service and employees. In hotels, I guess they know they've got you already. That's the failure at the JW location for sure. But at the Marriott Downtown, they still seem to care. And that's all I want, really. I'm already paying a little bit too much for coffee and cake; a friendly smile and quick service goes a long way. 

To Spencer who helped me this morning, I applaud your tolerance of the literal jackhammering across the hallway and I appreciate that the gingerbread loaf has real candied ginger in it!

Horrible customer service. There was a non English speaker and they laughed at her when she didn't understand where to get a reusable cup. One barista was screaming out an order multiple times, for a customer who was waiting for his change. I had gone in the day before while it was less busy and a red head named Jocelyn was checking her social media instead of making the drinks. This is not the first complaint, a manager should be there. Obviously these ladies can't be trusted to give decent customer service themselves.

Of course Starbucks is known for its coffee and amazing blends! However, today was my first time trying the breakfast. I ordered the Sausage Chicken Biscuit and it was certainly a treat. I was shockingly surprised at how amazing this breakfast sandwich was. It was piping hot, sweetness from the biscuit and spicy, from the gravy. This's sandwich melted in my mouth. Better than Mcdonalds, Chic-file, and Burger Kings sausage biscuit. I would rate this sandwich 5 stars hands down

Sooo where do I start? I work right down the street and I swear everytime I go to this one I'm always disappointed. I keep fooling myself think this time it will be better no I'm always wrong. My coworker looove his Starbucks and he agrees that this the worst location. I order different teas quite often I never sip soon as I get it because duh it will be hot but soon as I make it back to work it taste like water. Harrison Avenue location is waaaaaaaaay better. At least I'm not drinking hot water.

Most disgusting display of customer service I've ever experienced. Went there last week. Placed an order for four drinks. Got all four drinks handed to me in a to go tray. I'm actually completely shocked that the bad reviews for this location date so far back - why hasn't Starbucks done something about this obvious problem store!!?

One word: AWFUL.  

I've been here multiple times, and the service is always awful.  Rude girls that are obviously annoyed with 99% of their customers.  I have witnessed yelling at customers, eye rolling at customers, a filthy store, etc.  

I grabbed a macchiato here a few weeks back and it was completely undrinkable.  Waste of $, waste of time.  

Come on, Starbucks management - this store needs new employees!

When did Starbucks become so slow? 

This has become my local Starbucks and I am
In here almost once a week lately for meetings. It's large, modern and spacious inside, with lots of work areas to choose from, but it's constantly busy, so chances of snagging one depends on when you arrive. 

With the volume they seem to have at all times of the day, they never seem to be adequately staffed to handle it. The line is 5-10 customers deep at the register inside and my experience is they only have one register running. The staff is always buzzing about behind the counter preparing drinks that are all seemingly for the drive through and keeping the operation going. If you're sticking around though, there's always a long wait for drinks. 

Today my drink was all sorts of wrong too, which hasn't happened before. I ordered a nitro cold brew and it arrived as an iced cold brew. You can't put ice in a nitro drink because it takes all the nitro goodness out. 

All in all this Starbucks just doesn't have it going on. I've become used to it though and accepted this as the standard at this location.

Extremely rude. Ordered on the app and when we got there tasked us "what took you so long, everything is bad" still proceeded to give it to us with an attitude. All our food was cold and ice was melted. Will never go back.

Quick Tip: if you're a Starbucks connoisseur or have any desire for consistency in drink quality drive to Marsh Rd Starbucks!  

I had a really disappointing service experience at this new Starbucks location on a Saturday around 11:30 . I was excited that Delaware had more options for Starbucks now! ( Marsh rd and 896 95 rest stop are only real alternatives) The store location looked great inside and out. I was informed later, however, that the money put into the appearance and not into hiring REAL baristas is because this is not a REAL Starbucks, privately owned and operated.


 As soon as I received my drink I asked the Barista if it was foam free (as originally requested) she said it was. When I asked the Barista to take out the foam I was shocked at her response! Wordless she grabbed the drink while I held the lid. I asked the foam please be scooped out and more soy milk steamed to be poured to the top. She smiled and started the drink.
