The friendliest staff always very happy... always very clean....always 
Makes great suggestions for drinks an breakfast sandwich's 
My favorite of all 5 I visit on a regular basis

Not the closest starbucks to my work but I still go here every morning. Lisa and Carol are AWESOME, remember my drink every time and even got me started on a starbucks card so I can get free stuff since I am in so much! My 5 stars goes to them. 
The other staff members are also very friendly and usually have a line out of there in no time, with no complaints.
The barista working at 8pm 9/12 was like the best Starbucks employee I've ever encountered. She was very accommodating to my requests. Love my Starbucks but this was great. Give her a raise!

Clean, large space, with enough outlets to study or conduct a meeting. However, I've been there 3 separate times and my drink was made wrong, the WiFi is slow, and bring a jacket because it's always freezing.

This one is closest to my work - but is one of the favorites I have been to. The staff is very kind and the guy in the drive thru is friendly, quick and rarely makes a mistake. A few have the drinks overflowing and messy. Overall - a great location.

Coffee is good. Location is convenient. The wait times are excruciating. Every. Single. Time.
I don't know why it takes so long. It doesn't matter whether you walk inside or go through the drive thru. However, I think the drive thru may be a little worse.
On top of that, the drive thru layout stinks. It's not long enough and you have cars from multiple angles trying to enter. Ugh. This pumpkin spice latte better be spectacular.

I usually don't leave comment to Starbucks but this location is so lovely I actually went there twice in an afternoon....the building itself looks interesting enough but the inside's even better! It's the coziest Starbucks I've even been to. It got a fireplace and soft leather sofa.
It's not overly crowded and the staffs were very friendly.
I didn't want to leave!
This used to be an extremely slow Starbucks, but they hired additional staff and now it operates quickly.

This is probably the worst Starbucks operation. They always seem to run out of essential supplies. One day no plugs for the cups... Another no protection cover so now I burn my hands when drinking.    I really think that no one even cares when asked about it!

On the door it says that you must have shoes and a shirt for service . Unfortunately we had neither . But thanks to the great employee for coming outside and letting us know that we may come inside to order and that people do it all the time . So just Incase you're like us , you can go inside .

For the third time in a row, a certain barista sneezed/coughed while handling my drink and did not clean his hands.  Grossed.  Out.   I can't help it.  Three times in a row is insane.  If you are sick, stay home.  And if that's not possible, invest in some tissues and cleanser and stop handling my drinks whilst sneezing and coughing.   I don't recall ordering a tall bold with sugar-free vanilla and phlegm.

During the week this is my go to store Gracie is amazing and Alyssa!!
This morning I asked if Alyssa could she put a message on my husbands cup to celebrate our 25th wedding anniversary and of course she did!!

This store is understaffed and needs to stop the online orders. While those of us present in the store waited an extremely long time on our drinks the one barista made 10 or 12 different orders for those ordering ahead. There was one person working the cash and one barista. Being located in a busy mall spot that also contains a huge hotel required more staff or stopping the online ordering. After asking if there was any bottled water the response was, "There is none out there?" No, there is none out here. Cash person asked the barista if there was any bottled water to which the barista said, "There's no bottled water?" Oh, we are out. Well, glad we have that settled! But why on earth were they out of water? This location need lots of improvement.

my drink was ready quickly and accurately. baristas were friendly and efficient. the starbucks area was tidy and organized and you didn't have to venture so far into the store to get your coffee. it was really busy at 7:30 am on saturday because of a huge kids' soccer tournament in town (parents were picking up coffee for themselves and their 10 closest friends). the baristas were able to keep up with the volume impressively well. for me, there's nothing wrong with this starbucks.

My wife and me have been going to this Starbucks for four years. The people that work there are kind, considerate, and fun. When I went through my cancer battle they sincerely wanted to know how I was doing. When my wife was in an accident they asked me how she was doing as I picked up her daily chai tea latte with no water and no foam! Lol! They are quick, accurate, and personable. If you are over in the Carrolwood area check them out. You won't be disappointed.

Always come here when I am home to
visit my parents in Merion. Grew up in this area. Usually I come with my siblings and a handful of nieces and nephews. We walk .7 miles and it's part of a weekend routine we look forward to every time we come home. The kids love their cake pops and hot cocoa. Though lines can be long on Sat mornings, baristas have been accommodating with the long orders.  Some baristas are definitely more friendly than others. On other occasions I hang out and sit by the fireplace in the winter. It is an inviting place to hang out inside or out.

Met some friends for coffee here and I was a bit disappointed. Our brews were quite good. Their nibble selection was nice, however,  I couldn't get past how dirty the cafe was. Dirty tables and counters and the floor was littered. Chairs were esque and dirty. The bathroom was an embarrassment. They really do need to rotate staff to tidy the place up. Last, there are no comfy seats to kick back and just relax. This cafe is more aligned with the image of McDonald's not Starbuck's. Im sure its within the parameters stipulated by the Corp but it must be the budget model.

We visited this Starbucks twice during our weekend in Philly and had completely opposite experiences each time. The girl who served us in the morning was bright and warm and made excellent coffee and the guy in the afternoon was transactional and bored and the coffee he made tasted like dirt. So disappointing! 

The restaurant itself is perfect - nesting cosily in the Bellvue hotel (lovely to wander around in with your coffee) and in a great part of town. The restaurant has everything you need and includes a cute separate dining area out of the way of the crowd getting coffee to go. Shame not all staff enjoy working there or aren't properly trained providing great service and product! I truly believe success lies in the staff you choose!

I wish this Starbucks would perform similarly to others. Customer service isn't great, orders are not super timely. The specific order I get is entered in wrong every time at this location - which means I pay more. My most recent experience I ordered a tea and they told me 5-10 minutes after that they would need to brew more tea stating it would take 5-10 minutes.

They closed earlier than the time posted with all the lights on and I was sitting there waiting in the drive thru. The workers couldn't even bother to say they were closed which would take less than 30 seconds.

Pretty sure this place is run by college students who don't actually need to work because that is the type of service you get. Often times they are "busy" talking amongst themselves and 3 out of 5 times they forget to make something that I ordered(no joke). They don't notice until I ask about it or realize I am still waiting. Often times no greeting even when the store is relatively empty and no "can I help you" even if you're standing in front of the register they will continue to talk to each other until they deign to help you. I try to avoid coming to this Starbucks. Do not believe the positive reviews. As you can tell they are written by other college students who are probably friends with the kids who work there.
My order was somehow misplaced and it took over 15 minutes to get a tall latte. I had to ask twice about my drink. Next time I'll drive to a different Starbucks.

I love this location. It's spacious, has a wide variety of seating, from comfy couches to various sized tables, but the best part is that the employees are so personable! Definitely a Starbucks that you can plan on spending awhile in with good company.

Definitely a step above the rest. This Starbucks will not disappoint. Definitely recommend, especially for a weekday visit. Every drink I have ordered here has always been perfect, and the staff is SUPER friendly. Excellent work. If you are looking for a Starbucks without the crowds, visit here for this hidden gem.

Terrible experience at this brand new Starbucks! Not only was the service extraordinarily slow, but the bathroom was maybe the dirtiest I've ever seen in a Starbucks store. It was the kind of dirty that only builds up after a few weeks! Management better figure this out quick.

Standard Starbucks. Overpriced in my opinion, but the coffee is good enough. Their staff is usually friendly, too. The recent renovations make it look nice, and if you need a place with Wi-Fi to get some work done, starbucks is a good bet.

The long was about 8 people deep but the staff were extremely efficient in processing orders and getting people's orders in. We ordered two drinks and the cashier thanks me for my ordered and complimented my guest on her lovely hair. Customer service goes a long way and the staff here are A plus!! The barista even assured us that she was making our drink when it took a while. I'll definitely be back

This is by far my favorite starbucks in town. The location is perfect and the atmosphere is awesome. I went in a few weeks back and I ordered a pretty complicated drink and all I could hear was "have bar star do it" in the back. I was a little confused until a kid came around and started working on it. I couldn't catch his real name but he lives up to his nick name for sure! Bar star is truly a star....

I am a big fan of Starbucks, always have been and always will be.  I love their coffee.  This location is friendly and the folks who work at this branch are helpful and cheerful.  I probably stop here at least once a day.
My big problem here is the parking.  This is a VERY popular Starbucks, but the lot is teeny-tiny and people are parked all over.  I always expect to see an accident here.  There is no street parking near-by and the almost empty lot next door has a guard to shoo off Starbuck's customers.  They really need to figure out something to do with this crazy parking situation.
I also love that they stay open late in the evenings.  I am a fan - but the parking drives me crazy!

I have made 5 trips here (all mobile orders) and 4 of my orders were wrong and the 1 that was right was only 2/3 full... I'm assuming the baristas don't know how to make the drinks smh
I was so excited we were getting a Starbucks in Algiers but this is a huge disappointment...

How do you forget one person's drink when you have only one person ordering? Starbucks needs to check with this staff. If these baristas keep this pattern they will be called out on it. I have visited so many Starbucks and never once I've heard someone forgot a (the only ordering) customer's drink. She bluntly asked me what I was waiting for, to which I should have answered  'your phone number'. The whole staff can not be that senile. 
Starbucks is Starbucks, but some location needs training. As customers travel everywhere, managers should be concerned with the brand's image. 
Now, I was trying the new drink and I can't tell if this is the normal taste or not because I can't trust this barista's skill. It tastes very plain (new drink, Cascara). What a shameful experience!
Those managers need to be more mindful and not just drag brands' names in their messy act.

Stopped by Clearwater beach location since we had family visiting. Coffee was bland and the Cinnamon dulce latte was lukewarm and flavorless. 

2 star rating is for the hot chocolate which the others enjoyed.

This place was not so busy the first time I went, but I went in on a Friday morning around 945 am and I was waiting 15 minutes for my drink. It was CRAZY BUSY. My drink was made correctly by the time I walked out with it, but I will not be going back to this location if I'm in a rush.
Always friendly staff. Park and go inside! It's ten times faster and there are always spots to park in.

Stopped in because Starbucks is the only place in this area that has hot teas. My girlfriend has a cold and didn't know what to order. The Barista, Dustin, explained a bunch of different hot teas and their benefits, then made my girlfriend an amazing beverage. She was extremely happy and Dustin saved the day! This Starbucks definitely earned repeat customers based off this visit and Dustin's excellent level of customer service.

When Coffee Cartel smells overwhelmingly like bleach and cleaning supplies you go to Starbucks down the street. Sorry, CC...not this time. 

This Starbucks is noticeably nicer than most. Probably because it's in the CWE but it was also noticeably cleaner. They have a small outdoor patio which is a great area to sit in if you have the time. 

Overall, Starbucks coffee to me is pretty "meh." There are many other local joints whose coffee I prefer but sometimes convenience is king...or not smelling bad in this case. Upon my visit I learned that Starbucks does sandwiches now that you can warm up. Yes, I'm behind but I seriously rarely go to visit this chain. They weren't bad for being pre-made! Anyways, I won't be back anytime soon but this location is A-OK in my books.

The perfect Starbucks location to go to if you want a complimentary offer to get punched in the face while simultaneously be offered a gift card by the assistant manager after they refuse to make your drink because they were too busy doing nothing. Keep it up Starbucks!

I love going to this Starbucks they are usually really nice but today an employee named Kyle was rude and very sarcastic to my brother when he went there to get one thing he told my brother they were closed and it was only 5 o'clock. Starbucks doesn't even close until ten according to google maps and yelp so I thought that was very rude to have been treated like that.

This is without a doubt the best local Starbucks in Lutz. The baristas are extremely friendly and thorough. They make sure to get your drink just the way you like it - which is nothing new for Starbucks, but each barista makes it a point to get to know you as a customer and as a member of the community.
    The management and the baristas are amazing at this location. They make it a point to get to know you and almost befriend you ( but not in a smarmy way). 
     The work is quality in any of their drinks and it is always served in a friendly manner.

A while ago, it was a very rare event when I went to a Starbucks drive-through. That changed when Starbucks moved into the old Burger King building near my house. While the service is always prompt and friendly despite the long lines, the quality of what they make can be spotty.

I'm a big lover of matcha green tea lattes, and all kinds of brewed drinks. a big part of what I love about brewed drinks is the distinct flavor of what is being brewed. So when I come here, and I order a matcha green tea latte, or any other selection, and I get a cup of warm milk with only a splash of what I actually ordered, it grinds my gears. I get that some of the only reasons people drink Starbucks is to show off to the world that they're hip and cultured, but some people actually like the flavor of what's being brewed. I could easily warm up some milk on the stove, put it in a paper coffee cup, and lug it around with me, but that isn't what I'm playing for.

If this location fails to quit serving warm milk, I'll have to start going to another location, or coffee place all together. These establishments are far too costly to only serve warm milk.

Ok, so its a Saturday evening at 7:15pm, after a Cardinals home game and this location is closed, WTF????  AND its located in the lobby of a Marriott hotel!! And there are NO signs with their hours posted on any doors, weird!!!  Was VERY disappointed!  Thankfully their competitor,  Kaldi's was open!!

I was in Sparks for thanksgiving and was glad that there was a Starbucks close by. I went in twice and the drive thru once and and had decent service all the time.  Drinks were made correctly, staff was friendly, and the place was clean.

Slooooooooooow super slow 

10 plus minutes everyday


So I started to order on the mobile app 

And Come on almost 20 min from order time to pick up. 

And I only order Tea on ice 

Starbucks figure it out
Our favorite Starbucks we ever regularly went to, they are always fast, super polite, and never mess up drinks. Shoutout to Alex, the best barista who always knew our drinks when we came

This is a very busy drive through location, but this Starbucks still has cozy seating inside, unlike the sterile Plant City store. The staff here are quick, attentive and friendly. I'll be back. I'd dock a half star for the small parking lot, but oh well.

Never have I been so angry , I'm usually the customer that sees something wrong with their order and I'll just settle and leave . But this time it was way too early in the morning , and they had the audacity to argue with me . I ordered a vanilla bean iced coffee & I ordered it with CARAMEL drizzle . My brother got off the car to get the order inside and came back , the moment I took a sip from the drink it was like sand I my mouth and I spit it out . It was just sugar . Literally sugar . I tried to mix it around , it the layer of sugar was sooo thick it wouldn't mix . There were even spots that were still white because the sugar was still dry . So I get off the car and I tried to be nice I said I ordered that drink and there was just a thick layer of sugar at the bottom . And the guy at the register was polite , until some rude girl interrupted , and said "Thats caramel drizzle, that's go you ordered it" um no tf i didn't ? I order CARAMEL , not sugar . And she continued to argue that it was caramel and had just settled at the bottom . I asked her 4 times to remake the drink . I said "okay well if that's how your store makes caramel , then I don't want it can you make me a drink without it ? And she said "Well it's caramel drizzle , for future reference that's how it is " . Okay ? Every other damn Starbucks I've gone to gives me actual caramel not a bunch of LITERAL CANE SUGAR AT THE BOTTOM OF MY DRINK . needless to say I will never return here and I hope soon they get new staff , that girl was ridiculous. Bad customer service .

Been here numerous times, live right next store so it's very convenient. My experience has never been great I ordered a small vanilla breve latte today, I am a barista so I know good or bad coffee and it tasted like straight vanilla creamer. No coffee at all. I asked if there was coffee in here. They said one shot. Most definitely didn't taste like it at all. Paid 5 $ for a coffee that I had to throw away because it tasted like vanilla creamer over ice. Yum.

Excuse me but this Starbucks has inquired the best worker in the tri-state area. His coffee skills are superb. NO one could out do his likeness. He is the MOST kind and hard working man at the store. He is a Super master with the whipping. He works for the costumer and it comes purely out of his heart. He eat sleeps and dreams about perfect costumer service.

This is the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. And I have been to many many Starbucks. I have come here twice and waited almost 20 minutes in the drive through. The first time was during the morning rush so I can understand being busy. The second time was a Sunday afternoon. Not sure what's going on here but something is off at this Starbucks.

First off, I will still unfortunately be going to this Starbucks out of convenience as it's right by my office. However. Since Tiffany left there is approximately one nice person that works there. Lazy, slow baristas. I get it, your busy. But when you have to move, move! There is a newer lady that is doing the drive thru for who knows what's reason. She can't get or make drinks right, overflows cups, and takes forever to get you order even when nobody is behind you. This Starbucks is great location wise and I know that it's bound to be better, but the people that work there all need a reality check.

I live 3 miles away and keep given them another chance 
But I can't no more there baristas need to work on there drinks they can't even get a simple Americano with heavy whip. I'm taking my money to the one on Disc Dr.

Just went through the drive through and the staff was over the top friendly. The girl who took my order offered suggestions and the guy at the window greeted me with a huge smile. Refreshing to see such a friendly staff!
The barista, McKenzie did such a wonderful job making my drink and it was done super fast! Super helpful and kind! Love seeing her there!

I ordered from the Starbucks after leaving my nearby gym. It is in the center of Clayton making it really hard to just park and run in for a mobile order. I had to circle a couple of times before I could find street parking. The inside of the store is really big and very clean with a lot of people hanging out on the weekend. I got a cold brew and pasty which were ready when I got inside. My drink and food tasted good but I would probably avoid this location just due to the parking. However, Im sure ill be back sometime since it's so close to the gym.

My favorite latte this time of the year is Pumpkin Spice Latte! It's really good! They usually put around 4 pumps of pumpkin spice syrup in the grande size . I opt to get 2 puffs to cut down on the sugar content. It still tastes pretty good!

Ordered a latte and they did everything perfect except they forgot the COFFEE!!!
Really!!!!!!!!!

I'm not super happy with this location. I've been here numerous times and somehow they always mess up my order and overcharge me. 

Most recently, I went online to double check the pricing when I got home - I had a macchiato with cold foam instead of milk. I was charge for cold foam as an add-on. $5.  What I got was actually espresso topped with cold foam. A weak beverage that only filled half of my grande cup. Ordering online, this would have been $2.75.
This is the dirtiest store I've ever seen. Someone needs to inspect this place before the board of health shuts them down.

Google says this location is open at 4AM. No indication of hours of operation on Yelp. Chili's was even opened at this airport.

Not a person to be seen behind the counter. It's unfortunate because I just wanted to purchase a New Orleans mug for a gf.

I've been a loyal customer of Starbucks since 2005 and have spent many a pleasant hour there, enjoying a latte. (That's all I drink, because I'm not a fan of their brewed coffees.) Several years ago, they started charging for milk alternatives. Today, my grande iced soy latte rang in at a whopping $5.37. INSANE. This location is a mess. The bathrooms are filthy, the trash is always spilling over, and it takes up to 15 minutes to receive your order. The baristas never remember my name, and screw up my order (which never changes) about every third time. Oro Valley is a bit of a wasteland coffee-wise--maybe that's how they stay in business.

I like STARBUCKS in general. But this location was supposed to be big because of all the high class people. AKA  RICH.  I come to this location about 4 times a month. Every time we come I cannot find a seat.  Yes it is big but not bid enough. I like to hag with the Rich folks but just to tight with the seats. But even doe  282 Los Altos is a bit smaller it is all so for the rich but comfortable and a coma dating to all. Thank you for your time to read this I hope this will help in the future.

These girls are always amazing! There is a few other people that come here on a regular basis and are extremely friendly and always make a point to say hello. I've been to literally 1 million other Starbucks and this one seems to have everything I need. My favorite drink here is an Americano. Simple and not complicated. I use my iPhone app to pay and to receive my rewards. The girls are always happy to see me and happy to use my phone to process my order.

I've been to a lot of Starbucks locations. But this one specifically always have problems with mobile orders. Either extremely late or if you get there "someone" must've taken the wrong mobile order. Happens way to often. I minds well just go order in person.

Super friendly staff and being from Philly I definitely love and appreciate that...but when you make my drink wrong and try to justify it, that just irritates me to no end. Vanessa clearly needs more training or to be pulled off the morning crew

Its a Starbucks - but this one was actually fought for by local residents. The Historic Review Board was not having it, but the populace rose up and told them to get stuffed - and, now its here.

The place is rarely anything close to empty. Lots of hipsters and oldsters on any given day or time - laptops plugged in, books being read, parking lot full.

You might have a problem getting in. Thats a great thing considering I have friends who live close that always walk over... imagine if everyone drove in. Yeah. Anyway - I like this joint, and usually run into someone I know when I make it up from S Tampa to pop in here.

Its the location and people that make this Starbucks stand out.

The Starbucks is closed to Greyhound Bus Station. We order some coffee when we wait the bus. The baristas made Caramel Macchiato taste good. I like it very much. The cheese and fruit protein boxes & bowls is also delicious. I sat by the window and have a good street view. Let me have a pleasant time before I left the Philadelphia. Thank you very much!

Clean and modern decor, very friendly and welcoming staff. Drink made right and served with a smile. The only negative is they do not take Starbucks reward stars although they do issue them- this is more disappointing because on the pastry case they had a sign saying redeem  rewards here.
After going to other starbucks, they were open on this very snowy day. Zach gave us great customer service and made us feel welcome regardless of the weather conditions. Best pink drink of my life.
This is a great drive-thru Starbucks. Great location and friendly servers. Met my friends here for coffee and we all loved it. Visiting in town from San Diego feels like home.
Good service but are consistently out of what I want. Gets old quick being told they are out of things even when I try and mix it up and get different stuff.

The manager ignored me when I asked her about my online order. She also ignored me when I told her the creamer was empty. Worst Starbucks in the city! Senior Management needs to get this store in order . It is truly the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. Very disappointing for such a great location.

My daughter and I had a great experience during our visit today. Alex greeted us with a warm smile and was very friendly and kind! He noticed I had 2 gift cards and offered to combine them for me which was really helpful. My daughter is lactose intolerant and he made sure to check about the whip cream in her drink. Customer service was superb!

This Starbucks is actually some of the worst customer service I have ever received at any place. The workers could not be more rude-they act like you wanting to buy a drink from their store does them a total disservice and is the biggest inconvienence to them. More often than not, your drink order will not be right, and it isn't even worth it to tell them because the workers will straight up argue with you. I once watched them make my drink incorrectly, asked them politely to add vanilla, and the woman refused because she said she already had. I only go there if there is absolutely no other option because I always leave in a bad mood. I understand having a bad day, but I have been going here for months and I have NEVER had a good experience, no matter how kind or accomodating you are.

Not sure what was happening today but, there was a total of 5 cars in the drive thru, including me. It took 32 minutes to get my order in my hand. I wanted to back up and leave but, someone had pulled in behind me.

This Starbucks is nestled at the corner of a plaza.  While they are not the largest nor do they have a drive-thru, I've always enjoyed this location.  They use their corner space to great advantage and have a number of tables and chairs set up outside but well under the cover in case of sudden rainstorms.  Nice place to chill out, read and sip!

The service here has always been outstanding!  There was an issue with my order on one occasion (they didn't ask and I didn't make sure to specify that I wanted a hot mocha not a frappe) and they fixed it promptly and with a smile.  They even shooed me out the door with both drinks (which I suppose what were they going to DO with the other, but still).

Sure you've been to Starbucks - you know what to expect and this location will deliver. But that's not why you're reading this - here's what surprised me on this visit:  

a) new breakfast sandwiches!  I'm used to the sausage cheddar and bacon Gouda but they had several new ones including a biscuit with sausage AND bacon (I suspect its called the "Whole Hog") and a turkey bacon egg Swiss cheese ciabatta.  I was tempted to go Hog Wild but thought I ought to moderate my breakfast sandwich intake with the turkey bacon instead.  The sandwich was prepared very quickly and was ok. Just not something I would have again.  

b) they opened at 6 o'clock.  Most Starbucks open earlier and I happened to be out at 5:15 so I waited...   and checked Yelp but didn't find any coffee places that open in the area before 6!  One opened at 7:30!  Sleepin' in!
Slowest Starbucks drive through. Don't go to this Starbucks. I was in drive through for over 10 min and there were only 5 cars ahead of me. I think they need to hire more people.
Great friendly staff! Located st the corner or inside the Marriott also across the street from the courtyard Marriott

I give this location 1 star because the cashier was friendly. But otherwise my experience was sub par. I requested a dirty chai - but forgot to request almond milk so I immediately notified the barista before the milk was added - should have been an easy notification that I needed to pay extra, which I would have gladly done. Instead the barista acknowledged my request but still added regular milk (I thought it must have been someone else's drink), so I was shocked when she called my name. I asked her if my request had been too late - she asked her manager (Ms Raquina) who, without even acknowledging me, stated that I would have to get in line and pay for an entirely new drink!  No way am I doing that!  I don't normally complain about such small matters but the service was already slow which is not good for airport patrons. The time was around 5:30am, not sure if that should matter, but my recommendation is that a bit more time be put into customer service at this location. If possible - go to a Starbucks at a different gate!

Honestly, I've never been to a Starbucks with such awful staff. I just moved to the state, 5 days ago. I've lived in NYC, Boston, Pittsburgh, Ann Arbor. Never, have I ever.. and I mean ever...had to deal with such disrespectful people in my life. I was extremely excited to have a Starbucks location  so close to my new home, not anymore. What a waste for the company. Such a prime location but they have filled their store with employees that should be no where near the public.

I've been here twice and both times I've come in the service has been horrible and extremely slow I'm literally standing at the register and no one acknowledged that I've been standing there as employees pass by me.

Very long line...
Service was friendly though.
Had to partake in a mocha Frappuccino. They're really good stuff!

If there were an option for 0 stars I would click it. The male worker with blonde highlights at the register charged me $13 more than he was supposed to. He didn't give me a receipt because he literally stole from me, and this store doesn't accept rewards.

We came in and ordered an Americano and the shots felt a little weak to us. Julia, the barista, actually was the one to first comment on it before we drank it. She asked us to sip it and see if we liked it. We both agreed it was a little off. She apologized and then she remade us a drink on the house and made our whole day. Thank you for the amazing customer service Julia. We will be back!!
They always make drinks wrong and sloppy. I go there and order frappes and 9/10 they are always made wrong. Too lose or too thick. Not recommended.

I just picked up two lattes and the sweetest barista told me to have the "best day of my life".  It seriously was so refreshing.  
On top of that my almond milk latte was steamed perfectly; it's super hard to find a place that can do that. 
Overall, the first impression was amazing!

This place is a hot mess ..... I just moved to the area and this is close to me on my way to work. Well #1 they messed up my mocha sooooo bad #2 time they gave my coffee away #3 time waited 13 minutes for a online order and they gave me a card to make up for it, I come back the NEXT DAY and the service was a joke and the person making the coffee and the one putting them out looked like they had no idea what they were doing so I was given my coffee by a customer. Won't be back to this store again. Gave them more then enough chances

Someone gave me a Starbucks' gift certificate for Christmas which is a funny gift to give me because I never go to Starbucks.  (The giver kinda doesn't know me very well).  In Vienna I go to the old Viennese coffeehouses or to the cool indie ones but not to Starbucks ... and I only go to non-chain cafes in Phillytown.  But I had this certificate and there is one near me in Chestnut Hill so I thought I'd better use it.  Well to me the Chestnut Hill Starbucks sorta looks like the couple of other Starbucks I've been in in my life.  And the food items I ordered were all okay but not outstanding at all.  They included a sausage and cheese sandwich, a cinnamon morning roll, and a banana nut bread.  All had been made elsewhere and wrapped up for sale here.  The sausage and cheese on an English muffin was particularly bland.  
But then there were some pleasant surprises.  The staff at the Chestnut Hill Starbucks was super friendly and trying to be helpful.  Very ingratiating.  And I noticed how it was functioning like a neighborhood café as there were several people just hanging out and working on their computer or reading a book.  Chestnut Hill doesn't have many cafes so this Starbucks has become a neighborhood gathering spot.  Anyway that's a big plus and even though I will prob not be hitting up Starbucks again anytime soon. I'm glad it is there at the top of Chestnut Hill for the many people who do enjoy its hot drinks, food items, and unhurried atmosphere.

I always stop at this Starbucks in the way home from work on Fridays- it's never crowded and always stocked full of Pastries in the case and other refrigerated goodies.
The baristas aren't as personable as my 'regular' Starbucks but at least I get in and out fast.
There's always a fair amount of people utilizing the common area with their laptops so I think it's a conducive environment to get work done!
Shout out to barista Josh who is always an absolute delight. Great Starbucks! Professional, always get my order right and tastes great.

Okay. So, it's Starbucks. I get that. However, this one is just high-key terrible. When I visited recently, they gave me the wrong food (twice) and messed up my drink, all while taking 20 minutes to get the stuff I ordered to me. They only had one overwhelmed person on cash register, and there were at least 7 employees in the store. I will likely not patron this Starbs again, even if I'm desperate. Their only saving grace was they had a Beatles' album on the

My two item order was served incorrectly and with attitude.  I always ask for my breakfast sandwich on a plate, and it is almost always served in a bag.  Besides being wasteful (and face it, Starbucks is pretty self-righteous about environmental friendliness), it is represents that getting a very simple order correct is unimportant.  I can't imitate in writing the attitude I received when I said the order was to be on a plate, but it was not friendly nor did she offer to make the order correct.
I visit Starbucks less and less, and this one often reminds me of how employee attitude affects workplace atmosphere and customer satisfaction.
I just ate my bacon, gouda, and egg sandwich and it was cold in the middle.

This Starbucks is seriously the worst. The people who work here are slow, lazy and rude. But all is moot as there's never anything to buy. 6 employees and nothing stocked though I see racks in the back of food. Not worth the attitude.

My car was at the shop down the street getting some work done so I decided to sit at Starbucks for a couple hours. 

When I came in, the only other person in line was an employee who took her sweet time trying to figure out what she wanted to order. The girl who took my order was pleasant and when I brought my order back because it was missing the sugar/sweetener (had been entered as unsweetened), it was immediately corrected. 

Around lunch, the outside seating area did fill up. Most people on their phones and laptops. (The lobby is not currently open for inside sitting but there is a small patio on the outside that you can sit and enjoy your drink.
Danny working at the register was really kind! wonderful customer service. keep it up!
Visited the store twice and they messed up drinks in those visits. Staff is rude and not willing to serve the costumer professionally. NOT RECCOMEND
Nothing wrong with the quality, it's a normal Starbucks however the staff is not very polite or efficient.

A Starbucks is a Starbucks. Usually the drinks are consistent and the service is friendly.  Here they were very polite and friendly. I was greeted right away.  My order was taken and my drink was ready quickly. It tastes just like I had hoped. 

Initially I thought the store had closed.  Starbucks has shut down many locations at home. Although the parking area is small we had no trouble parking.  

I saw a few of the more recent reviews and was surprised how bad they were.  My experience was the opposite. 

I would recommend stopping here if you need a coffee.

This location has a nice ambience and I love the interior. The long table has electric outlets so it seems like a great place to settle with your laptop for a few hours. I had a free reward and I usually try new drinks with my rewards. The baristas were friendly and nice when I asked them questions about the new menu. Sadly, there is one crazy, judgmental barista girl here. She never asked me if I wanted my drink hot or cold and started writing on a hot cup. When I said I wanted my drink cold she snapped at me and said, "Don't you care about the environment?!" I laughed at her face because she was too crazy for me to deal with on my post-finals recovery day. 

If you're reading this crazy barista girl, I really do care about the environment. When I plan on going out for coffee, I usually take one of my many Starbucks tumblers and get my awesome 10 cent cup discount. So listen to the whole order before your mouth gets you fired.

Nice store, wish they had a drive thru but the short walk will do me some good.  Once your order is placed they are quick.  Nice people. Our puppy  the pup-ccino.  

Easy parking with a travel trailer or a RV.  It's next to movie theater, Goleta PD substation and Ulta Beauty.  Large area out front to sip your tasty beverage and enjoy the day.

This is the only Starbucks that I can go to and consistently get my drink made perfectly how I want it . The drive thru seems to move a bit faster in the morning but slower during lunch time! They are patient when my app is taking forever to load and seem to practice good sanitation !

After several annoying visits at the Starbucks down the road from this one, I decided to go out of my way to visit this location. My drink was perfectly made and the environment is very welcoming. 
I sat with my toddler to have my drink while she had a snack and I managed to spill almost my entire latte everywhere. Embarrassed, I went to the front counter to ask if they had any towels or a mop and bucket so I could clean up my mess. Without hesitation, Ben and Samantha came out to get the mess cleaned up. Samantha made me a new drink, free of charge. What a pleasant surprise! I thought that was so incredibly generous and they were so helpful. I know I would have been annoyed if I had to clean up someone else's mess, but these two were so cheerful, it made me feel less uncomfortable about the situation.
This location gets two thumbs up! The drinks are exactly what you would expect and the staff is amazing!

I think this is the last time I'm coming to this location. Every day this week I ordered a Blonde Vanilla Latte and every time I receive a plain latte. Today I decided to call in and ask for a refund. The woman who answered the phone said to come back and they'll fix it. Unfortunately I'm well on my way to the office. So I ask how about tomorrow? She said that fine but when I asked who I should ask for she seemed bothered by the question and said "I don't know who is going to be here tomorrow" and then started to talk to another customer and hung up on me. 

Sorry I'm not going to participate in the lack of customer response. I've been going to that Starbucks every day , I mean every day, for the past 2 years. Every morning and I never complain but I can't take paying 6 dollars everyday for something I didn't order and didn't want on a consistent basis. I'll try the Clayton location for now on. 

Keisha
Tell me why I asked for light ice and they fill the cup up with more than half with ice. 3 sips and my drink is gone lol thanks!

New Starbucks that filled in the gap between the downtown Wilmington and the Chadds Ford location.   Be prepared to wait in line at the drive-through.   My wait was 10 minutes.   It would probably have been faster  to preorder and pick up.  The good news is that the brewed coffee was very fresh.

This is my neighborhood Starbucks and it's super consistent with:  unfriendly staff, giving me a poorly made $7 mocha, slow service, and negative vibes.  I go out of my way to stop at other Starbucks to avoid a miserable start to my morning.  


....... However I was short on time,  ordered my drink via the app,  walked in and was greeted by Anthony.    A ray of sunshine,  i heard a happy hello, my drink was perfect and left hearing have a great day.  

Thank you Anthony for delivering the Starbucks code of conduct to a much needed store!

I stopped by this Starbucks on my way to work today and I left very happy for the first time.

They must have fixed the machine to pull correctly because my coffee was great. 

The watered down flavor was gone and I enjoyed drinking it. The new Barista was very friendly and temped my coffee perfectly.

A couple more visits like this and I will give this Starbucks a 5.

Friendly quick service. All the staff was welcoming and professional. Good drink, will definitely return because this is one of the best Starbucks I've been to. Cute location across from riverfront with some nice benches across the street. Inside was comfortable and spacious- great place to relax, catch up with friends, or do work.

I came about 1:55 for the Starbucks customer appreciation event from 1-2. There was a line of about 10 people. One woman said the line at 1 pm was looong! 
So coming a little late paid off this time! The staff here had it under control! There were 3 cashiers and several people making drinks. Two other baristas were directing traffic making the process quick. In about 5 minutes I had my drink! 
You could choose any tall espresso drink. I had a peppermint mocha with skim milk. It was made perfectly with a whipped cream topping.
Thank you @starbucks

Horrible Bathroom.  I took my three year old son into the bathroom today and had a very difficult time helping him use the bathroom because Starbucks had a blue light fixture in the bathroom.  I could barely see anything. Starbucks may have a reason for the blue light (drug use detterance??) but it's not family friendly.  That issue aside, there is no arguable reason why the bathroom had no toilet tissue! That's right; there was not a shred of toilet tissue in the bathroom.  Fortunately, my son had to do #1 and not #2. But wait, there's more.  We went to wash our hands and couldn't find a soap dispenser.  Maybe it was there but we couldn't see much (remember the blue light?). There was, however, a gallon jug of soap nearby. Lot's of fun.  Not.

Ordered PBJ Box for my kid  ( which comes with small half PBJ, four slices of apple and two carrots n 3 cucumber slices and dip . Well my three and half year old child was refusing to eat apples and cucumbers so I was quite surprised since she loves apples. So tried bite of apple they were sour and cucumber were bitter asked Javier if there is anything can be done . His answer was too bad these come prepackaged so this Starbucks store has no control over it and I can call the corporate and ask them if they can do something about it. Was quite amazed by the service . Just spoke with the corporate office and according to them this whole situation could have been handled differently.Javier certainly needs some training.

I've gone to this location several times and haven't been impressed once. We were the only ones inside and still had to wait over 20 minutes for our drinks. It became evident that everyone in the drive through was getting their coffee before me even they hadn't drove up after I had arrived.

If you want to wait in line for 10+ mins & the line wasn't long. Then waited another 10 mins for coffee & egg bites. I tried to ask if my order was still coming (it took so long I thought they missed it), but she rudely told me it was coming. It was then, that I seen them starting to prepare my order. No one said hello, no one said thank you. I'm not local, but Starbucks is better than this.

I know there's some negative reviews but every single time we've come here the service, product, and speed of service have been exceptional. Came here News Year morning and expected half drunk hungover employees that didn't want to be there. I was pleasantly surprised. Great job folks!

WOW, place was clean and mobile order was ready when i stopped in (complex mocha, two sandwiches and partridge in a pear tree ;-)

it was 6:30ish AM and no one was there.
All the tables were moved to the side & social distancing marks on the floor.
Two Baristas were on duty, a friendly greeting, a pass of the merchandise through the bullet proof (joke) glass, and off i went,
I go to this location once a day with a mobile order before work and they always have my drink ready and made on point. The staff here are also very welcoming when I walk in to pick up my order.

Let it be known that I'm a Starbucks super fan.  We stopped in with our out of town relatives to see if they still had STL Christmas mug ornaments in stock (my SIL collects them).  We weren't even planning on grabbing a fancy shmancy hand crafted beverage.

We'd only been looking at the ornament selection for a moment or two when an employee informed us they were closing in 3 minutes and not in a friendly kind of way.  We quickly made our choice and headed toward the register.  We stood there for a few moments without being acknowledged and, obviously, not welcomed so we left without buying anything.

One star because the shop is nice and one star because it's Starbucks, but your employees could up their customer service game even if it is close to closing time.

Great experience. Music is at a moderate level and not too loud. The baristas were super friendly and very quick with service. Thanks for the lovely experience today! Oh and I'm in love with the Nitro Cold Brew; never get rid of it.

I don't normally leave negative reviews at places, but I have now had several negative experiences at this Starbucks. This location is on my daily commute, so I often put in a mobile order before I leave the house. Three times now, I have gotten to the store and been told they are out of what I ordered in the app. Twice, I have ordered a vanilla sweet cream cold brew at around 6:30am. When I got there, they offered me an iced coffee because they were out of cold brew. A venti VSC cold brew is $4.45  and a venti iced coffee is $3.25. Today I ordered a south west veggie wrap which costs $5.45 and was offered veggie egg white bites that cost $4.45. I have no problem getting a substitute when they are out of the item I ordered; however, it's frustrating that I have consistently ordered something and been given something that costs less.  They have never offered to refund me so I could pay for the cheaper item, nor have they offered a refund as a viable option in general.

I have never had trouble with any other Starbucks's mobile ordering. In fact, other Starbucks mark items as sold out or unavailable if they don't have them. I wouldn't be frustrated if this happened once or twice because a dollar here and there isn't a big deal, but three times in the last month is getting excessive. At this point, I'm about to just start going slightly out of my way to the Dunkin' down the road.

Some of the best customer service I've ever had. They're fast, helpful, and always super crazy nice. I've been her probably four or five times in the last 6 months and they remember my name. They've also never gotten my order wrong, which is a feat in itself. Always a great experience!
Shout out to the drive through crew. Always engaging and friendly. As a regular who needs my coffee to survive the day to day I appreciate the effort they put in. Quality customer service.

They forgot they were doing a pourover for me although I was standing right there. Finally got my coffee and after paying their ridiculous 60 cent surcharge for soymilk, I got literally one drop of soymilk in my cup (I watched her pour it). Even so, the cup was so overfull that I ended up spilling it all over my car just by trying to carefully place it in the cupholder. It wasn't even a fancy drink. They just needed to be able to pour a cup of coffee and add a decent amount of soymilk in such a way that it wouldn't end up all over me and my car. They couldn't. Also, the weakest cup of pourover coffee I've ever gotten at a Starbucks.

Rude customer service. Wish I could give 0 here.
Staff is pretty rude, not let me talk. Never be back again.

Do not play with your hair while making a customer's order
Ridiculous 
And the appropriate action of the supervisor is not, "baby girl you need to pull your hair back."...especially in front of customers
Good fast service. The staff wore facemasks and gloves.  The best part is that their Nitro machine worked.  That has been a problem at many of the stores.
Filthy.  Filthy floors filthy bathroom blasting music.  Haphazard lines.  Never been Ina starbucks like this.

Do not go to this Starbucks. I've been here several times and EVERY time I've went they ALWAYS Mess up my drink. I am very specific with my drink and i always get the same thing. Somehow they always seem to get it wrong. Once I received a drink that was a legit just warm milk. Not what u ordered! Then, another time the top oF my drink was caked with whipped cream and Carmel that I couldn't even drink the rest of my hot drink. The staff here always act like they know what they are doing, but they don't! They'll also ask u to repeat four order so many times and still get it wrong! I will no longer the returning.

Don't order a Cappuccino. They don't know how to make foam. I specifically requested an extra dry cap and got extra bubbly milk that resembled a milkshake. Customer service was good just need more training on how to make proper foam. It's not that hard.  Don't think I'll be coming back since it was $4.25 for a drink that wasn't authentic. That's conglomerates for you.

This is the only Starbucks I've been to since moving to Reno. The service is always wonderful with staff that goes above and beyond. The establishment is clean and distancing is enforced. The coffee is always made as ordered and delicious. They even have outdoor seating. Why bothering finding another spot if this one is always great? :)

Usually a pretty good Starbucks when I come here but, today they were short in the display case of just about everything from sandwiches to pastries. It looked rather picked over like a blight zone! Very unappetizing to say the least. There were enough Partners in the store that someone could've taken a moment to refill and restock. The staff was very friendly and my beverage came out perfect, so they only get three stars today.

I have to say, Starbucks as a whole, I thoroughly enjoy.  And even after trying multiple coffee shops, I always go back.  But I always find myself stuck stopping at this one on my way to visit family in Hernando County, and I hate it.  They are always out of almost half their menu items by 10:30am and the staff are incredibly unfriendly.  I cringe when I have to go in, and find myself usually annoyed when I leave.  To the staff, if you hate your job or can't be nice, maybe the hospitality business isn't for you, and quit. To the manager, please figure out your quotas and stock, running out of something three weeks in a row is pretty bad.  Sincerely, annoyed customer.

This Starbucks location on Hillsborough Avenue in Tampa is a well managed Starbucks location that is efficient at keeping everything moving and getting your order ready. The staff here is very friendly and accommodating to make sure that everything is prepared properly. Good experience every time I have been here.

What's up with the attitude?  Clearly states Do Not Come to counter if your name isn't called.  I asked as they put food dwn & employee IGNORED me. Waited another 5min a girl finally asked my name & my order was waiting ! LOSE the attitude if you don't like working with the public DON'T oh yeah & all our food was cold, COFFEE cold.

Terrible service from Ivan and Ivanna on 11/1 at 10:15am. There was a man sitting in the crowded establishment without a mask on. I notified the staff. They refused to even ask him to wear a mask or leave. When I asked them to do something their response -- we can't force anyone to wear a mask. Sure, but you can ask someone to leave your establishment for not abiding by your policies. Disgusting behavior by that man but especially by the ignorant employees. Not to mention their service was slow and rude.
The worst cup of coffee I ever had from today from this location.  No taste, no flavor and the banana nut bread was ice cold in the center.

Back to being a Starbucks gal. I was going to Dunkin' off Missouri & the evening service is terrible. The moral & energy here is consistent. My only thing is the amount of espresso they give in a single shot is extremely minute. Not even a full shot. But I'd rather come here where the service is great.
I came to get a coffee and to do some reading and studying. But the tables and chairs we're surrounded by some flies. Disgusting. The Starbucks workers were too busy to care, too.

Oh Starbucks...you keep telling me you're my "community shop"...but I really just want you to be my coffee stop. Don't get me wrong, I love having a Starbucks in my hood, and even though I haven't walked to you yet, I could. The thing is, you keep messing up my orders, are always out of nitro, and have flies in your dining room. I know you're trying, and keep at it! It's not me though...it's you. And my vanilla latte was $6...so make it right.
Literally waited over 20 mins for a Tall Pikes. Completely disorganized, not clean, has gone downhill - used to be my choice of Starbucks.
Of the Starbucks this one has some of the friendliest staff and the most helpful team in ensuring that your dink was made with love and taste perfectly. Thank you!

I tried this location a couple times before leaving this review in hopes that the service would improve, but unfortunately that's not the case. 

Pros: This is one of the larger, if not largest Starbucks in the area. It's pretty much brand new and has a drive thru. The inside is very modern with plenty available seating. It's a free standing building, which is very nice especially since most Starbucks are in strip malls, or located in other businesses. 

Cons: This location gets very busy, especially the drive thru. I've had it take over 20 mins to get my order, but unfortunately going inside isn't much quicker. This location suffers from poor customer service. I have been at the counter and waited almost 10 mins before being greeted, then another 10 mins after ordering to receive my order. The parking can be a little tough as well, since Starbucks shares a parking lot with Panda Express and many other retailers. 

Unfortunately, I do not recommend this location.

Honestly, I was very happy to have this Starbucks in the area since I live in Seffner but it's inconvenient that one day they'll be open and the next day they're closed completely. Make sure you call before you go! Also when they are open they're always out of something.

I don't really have anything negative to say or anything positive. This place is like most Starbucks- you've got your coffee, food and merchandise. The seating is limited, but they have a decent porch space. The employees weren't rude or mean, but they didn't go out of their way to be super welcoming either. This was truly just an "Ok" Starbucks visit.

I go to Starbucks nearly everyday, that being said, I actively avoid this Starbucks location. I have gone inside and through the drive thru a few times and I never make it through in less than 20 minutes... even if I'm the first in line and there is barely anyone there. There seems to be enough people working and they are not overly packed inside either. My mom, sisters and I call is the "slow Starbucks", the old location was my favorite and easily 4 times as efficient. I don't like to beat a dead horse, but if you don't have an extra 30 minutes then I'd drive the extra 5 minutes to the Longley location or go to Bibo up the street. 
Pros: the drinks are usually made correctly 
Cons: timeliness 
Overall: Nobody got time for that!
Service is okay can get very busy at time. Typical Starbucks coffee it's okay it's overpriced . hard to find a seat because so many people come in there and sit on the computer for hours
Just want to give a shout out to Daniel at this location! He was so friendly and patient and provided amazing service! He made my friend and I'd experience exceptionally amazing!
Whomever your blonde barista is needs to leave. She was so mean to my boyfriend taking his order and made the worst drink. She didn't even give him a whole cup. We'll never be back there again.

Great location! Clean, well lit and lots of tables and seats to work. The workers are friendly and professional. They had no problem making me a new drink when something was wrong. The parking lot is a little tight but not a huge issue.

WORST DRINK I HAVE EVER RECEIVED FROM A STARBUCKS!!! All I ordered was a hot chocolate (simple) it tasted horrible so I asked for another one and AGAIN... HORRIBLE!! Love wasting my money, thanks bad barista!

Was part of my morning routine because of how early it opened. Unfortunately it seems like Starbucks as a whole could care less about early risers. Came in one day and this location wasn't open. Very long line sitting and waiting. No signs or anything. I left and came back the next day to a sign that essentially says "we would be happy to serve you after 6AM". 

From all of us reliable customers that start work at or before 6AM that loved your 4:30 opening time..... thanks..

This has to be the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. Don't have much else to say other than that if there are any cars in the drive thru you can expect it to take at least 10-15 minutes to get through.  On this particular visit, there were 6 cars in the drive thru and it took 17 minutes from the time I pulled into the drive thru until
The time I got my coffee. It seems as though they don't start making the drink until you've arrived at the window.

I ordered a flavored coffee drink. I felt it was watered down because it really didn't taste right. They made me another one and it tasted exactly the same. to their credit they did try to make it right but by the third time it tasting the same, I thought maybe it was just me. I obviously didn't have my coffee that day because by the time I sat in my car and drove off, I realized that their espresso machine was probably not working right or was watering it down too much or something.

The Baristas are very friendly and welcoming every day.  It can get crowded but the line moves pretty well.  Yes the parking stinks, but lucky for me I can walk here from my house!  This is a go to study spot for a lot of local students ... including myself.  Get there early if you want a seat to study at for a long period of time!

I have found that this location in particular has horrible customer service.  I ordered on the mobile app.  I went into the store and the employee and manager (?) were standing around gabbing.  I asked about my order and the manager (?) barked the on-line app was not working.  I went to asked how long would it take to make my order since I already paid for it...she barked again the on-line app was not working and wouldn't let me ask my question.    I felt like I'm was bothering them when I went into the store.  That is $10.00 down the drain.
I waited a long time for tea, and asked when it would be ready, and they said "another twenty minutes."  I guess they're busy. They did not offer a refund and I just left.
Really quick service. Very good staff. Super friendly and helpful. Great location too. Love that it is right next door to Dorignacs, one of my favorite grocery stores!

A few weeks ago, I went into Starbucks on Main St, in Brighton to study for my college psychology class. I ordered a pumpkin cream cold brew after a friend recommended it. When I got my drink, it looked very professional with the different layers of coffee and pumpkin cream. I stirred the two layers satisfyingly together and then took the first drink and I fell in love with the drink. The texture and taste were so creamy. The atmosphere was perfect for studying. I would 100% recommend the pumpkin cream cold brew to anyone who enjoys coffee or if you are looking for something different than the Pumpkin Spice Latte.
Kim's energy this morning in the drive thru line was amazing. She was so cheerful and kind and it made my whole morning.
Today I ordered a grande iced tea port over a Trenta cup of ice. All the staff was friendly the product they delivered was lacking in ice as my picture shows. Two stars today.
I loved this starbucks until one guy tried to teach me there is no mocha in white chocolate mocha frappe after he gave me white creme frappe and then offered to drizzle mocha on top

I stopped in on my way to work, store was super clean, and hardly any customers waiting at all. I decided I needed to try the new Brown Sugar Oat milk Espresso Latte, but a skinny version. It was super yummy, and will definitely be ordering that again.

So, normally I would have returned a starbucks that was wrong but I had multiple drinks and I didnt notice this mistake. This has happened at this starbucks on more than one occasion now. It hard enough to order a drink at starbucks, but it's more frustrating to have to try and explain how it's made. For a few months now starbucks has had the pumpkin cream cold brew and the irish cream cold brew. They were very good. I liked the way they were made. Black coffee with cream on the top. I've tried to explain to this location that I understand that the irish cream and pumpkin cream is gone, I just want a sweet cream cole brew or add a pump of vanilla to the cream. They just dont get it and basically give me iced coffee with milk and flavor mixed in, which is not what I want. I dont know how to order this drink. If I wanted an iced vanilla latte I would have ordered it. I asked for an irish cream cold brew with different flavoring. Now I'm stuck with this drink, with probably a ton of sugar. Is it so much to ask for some cold brew with cream on top??

Okay so let me preface this with a positive. Mino is an amazing baristo and kind human and he is the reason I come back to this location! Something about his demeanor and personality brightens my day! Besides that, this location is constantly disappointing me! There's been two instances where I've gotten such poor treatment, granted, it's while they're super busy, but I too am in a service job where I get slammed and am super compassionate and professional with my guests. 
Today, I ordered ahead on the app. When I came to pick up, the woman that handed me drink was super dismissive and mean. I told her I was waiting for another drink as well and she said "I know" and walked away. While waiting, I realized my drink was made wrong and I asked if she could remake it, but the lid wasn't on all the way and the drink fell. She was furious and looked at me like I was an imbecile and I got really embarrassed and just walked out, my sister was in the car and knows I have really bad social anxiety and the drinks were already paid for. So she went in and got the drinks for me. This barista in particular really went out her way to make me uncomfortable and it really ruined my mood and stressed me out. 

Probably will visit during Minos shifts and on a slower day but really sad about the service and people they chose to have on their team. I wish a manager would talk to the employees about how they treat guests.

Supposed to be open until 8pm. Came by at 7:18 and door was locked. Lights were on, and two staff members were still behind the counter, but both refused to make eye contact or answer our phone call. Guy sitting outside noticed our frustration and said that this store randomly decides to close early quite frequently.

I ordered a grande blonde and a double smoke bacon cheddar. The first sandwich came out. I took a second bite and the center of the egg was cold. I returned it to the serving counter and waited almost 5 mins for someone to acknowledge me. They quickly made a second sandwich which they burnt. I wasn't going to try again. Rampant incompetence at this Starbucks and I drive 150,000 miles a year. So I frequent Starbucks nationally and have never had this problem.

Hate is a strong word. I hate this Starbucks. I feel like I waste my money when I come here. I always try to give them another chance but they absolutely suck. They literally don't care what you order or the details. They half ass everything. I say light ice for every drink and get half a cup of ice every time. I need to stop coming here altogether. I've called to let them know they mess up my drink and don't care to fix my drink and acted like it was inconvenient if I came back. I go to Dutch bros now. No matter how long their line is they still pay attention to detail.

I just left this place and the two baristas were so rude, I felt really embarrassed. Here is what happened, I'm on a road trip and I always order through the app then go pick up my coffee. Most of Starbucks have a section where they leave your coffee and you grab and go. Today I did the same but it turns out that's not how they do it but I didn't know. I grabbed a coffee and the barista was so rude and I understand we are in the middle of a pandemic and they must be mindful but there are better ways to treat people especially when I wasn't trying to be malicious. I am a faithful Starbucks customer but I'll never be back to this one, they should just close the little window and call names. They probably have a sign and I should have paid more attention but there is no need to make your customers feel bad. I felt super embarrassed because this happened in front of other customers so 1 star for the two baristas this Saturday morning.
PS: I'm just visiting St. Louis so I don't really know how things are being handled here, I even apologize to the baristas but then I was thinking that it is not the way to treat your customers.

If I could give this location zero stars I would. Every day for the last 9 months I come here to get cold brew. I wait in the 30min-1hr long drive through (not an exaggeration), and I get my cold brew. If you try to go inside and order you are still waiting for all the drive through food to be prepared so it takes a long time as well inside. As of a couple months ago they just "run out" of cold brew....so I now wait an hour sometimes in the drive through to not get a cold brew unless they decide to just give me an iced coffee without telling me. I don't understand how you run out of a cold brew every day for two months and don't start preparing several batches the night before. Worst Starbucks in all of Florida and possibly even the US

I get that this is Starbucks... you'll either love them or hate them probably .  What I like about this location is the cool ambiance.  It doesn't feel like an ultramodern space and there is an add on for seating that has a really cool vibe.  I love architecture that feels like part of the community and this one hit the mark.

Today's visit was disappointing. I put in a mobile order for a chocolate cookie and a chai latte with Almond milk and '5 pumps'. Tbey don't actually pump the Chai so it is a visual measurement. I ask for 5 pumps because i have had multiple experiences of getting a almond milk latte with hint that there might be something else added but whether it's chai syrup it up for debate. The drive up line was long so I knew they were busy. When I got to the window I was handed my drink. I asked about the cookie and it took at least three minutes to obtain the prepackaged cookie that was in a paper sack. I was at the gas station when I tasted the drink (I had kept my mask on expecting the person at the window would be right back with the cookie) and I discovered that the barista didn't even make an effort in adding the chai. I'm not sure it had chai in it. I would have returned to complain but it was too much bother. Check your drink before you leave the store.

Lines are often long, but they do an awesome job cranking them out without making you feel like a number. I've had awesome, personalized service every time and they've never made me feel rushed- despite the 7 people in line behind me. I appreciate the friendliness and calm vibe in the rushed environment with the majority of customers dashing in wearing scrubs or lab coats for a quick caffeine jolt. 

The rare time something isn't quite right with my order, they've offered to fix it without complaint and didn't act like I was throwing a kink into the next order they were already working on. I make a point of stopping in every time I have an appointment at Jefferson. Make sure you tip if you can. They deserve it.

They do not let you use your Starbucks card to pay, however you can get Cheesecake Factory. =)
They do still make good drinks and it's inside the Barnes and Noble. I wouldn't go out of my way to come here, but I'm a book nerd so I will always be a customer at least until someone messes up my coffee (Even if I don't get my stars for being a Gold Card Customer).

Nice Starbucks with outside seating. Too bad they don't have a drive thru like the one at Linebaugh and Dale Mabry, but this is in a strip mall and not a free standing building. They currently have a deal until May 10th where from 3-6pm, Frappucinos are half off! There is a new frappuccino called the "S'mores". I sadly was underwhelmed. I LOVE s'more flavored things. This had a burnt marshmallow taste and it was way too sweet and not frozen enough. I'd be willing to give it another try with another barista though. It was busy and the girl seemed overwelmed and "in the weeds".
The staff are generally kind and very professional. This location is also particularly clean... a perfect place to get some work done or talk with friends!
The people are so creepy there and when I got my drink I went into the sitting area and everyone starred at me.

Generally good service, but recently was shocked the last time I went in... It was cringe-worthy when an associate named Brianna was very rude to her teammates in full view and hearing of customers. Management should sit down with her and explain why that's not good for business. Not the standard of excellence I've come to know from the brand, at least.

I love Starbucks, but this location has the most inconsistent output in terms of taste.  I don't know if it's just because they are always so busy or what, but I have 3 standard drinks I rotate and they never taste the same, nor do they taste quite right. They do have very friendly staff, but be warned the lines are often long and service slow.

It was stocked up, it was clean and the staff were efficient. While my goal is support local, sometimes Starbucks is what you need mid-road trip or when you have to push out a work email and need some quick wifi with a side of one of their cute snack platters. Solid choice!

Only the coffee saved this from being one star. Had the most inept barista ever take my order. 

First she couldn't help me get points because I had a gift card that was different than my normal card. She was clueless and I ended up using the little bit of rewards I did have at the time. The fact that I explicitly told her that I DID NOT want to use them made no difference. I ended up not being any points for the purchase added to my rewards account.

Then she handed me back the card and told me told me the amount left on my gift card and asked me if I wanted it reloaded. When I said no, she took the card back AND THREW IT AWAY! When I told her that the car still had money on it and she realized what she did, she looked at me for a bit, then rolled her eyes because she didn't want to dig it out of the trash. She dug out out and rinsed it off and handed it to me with a paper towel for me to dry and turned and asked the next customer what he wanted. No explanation or apology given. To top it off, the manager had to remind her to wash her hands before she finished taking the next order.

Hopefully she was just having a bad morning. But I'll think twice before coming back to this location again. And I'm still out the rewards for the $8 spent.

No bananas, no bagels bites, out of over 50% of stuff at 8 a.m (and not because they're busy). Manager obviously needs to step it up. They have disco music on at this early hour. Not cozy feeling either.
How can you not have lids for your drinks. The person in charge of inventory should be fired

I am not a fan of this Starbucks. My friend and I go here almost daily and it's always a gamble. Some days the drinks come out perfect, other days they're bitter. But what can you really do when you're addicted? Also the employees have RBF about 90% of the time. Not friendly at all. Going to this Starbucks is like a bad relationship. You hate them but need them.

I stop by this Starbucks every morning before work. Nathan is always great. He has my order ready, remembers my name and makes me feel welcome every time I walk in the store. If you want personalized service, this location has got it!
Kemaria is my favorite Starbucks person! She had me try sriracha sauce on my egg bites and now I'm hooked on them. This Starbucks is clean and quit too. My vote for the best!!!

This is my favorite Starbucks in Reno!-I am greeted by the friendly employees every time I walk in, they promptly get my order in the car line or walk-in, I have been happy with my coffee, and they are always quick to right an order on the rare occasion there is a mix up.  My hubby and I go there 4 days a week-When we could sit inside I liked that they have a large seating area

You know, when all is said and done it's a Starbucks.  It checks all of the important boxes.  They have a drive-thru and a reasonable amount of parking.  They are currently open with limited seating capacity which is nice.  But most importantly they have always gotten my order correct.  I end up here from time to time and will be back for sure.

I will start with the parking lot. It fits about 8 cars max and you can squeeze like 6 more up the side and the front of this place. I have gotten off my  Starbucks addiction lately but stopped in today. "Wedges, edges, and ledges"

They typical Starbucks easily gets 3 stars.  It's rare to find one that earns 5 stars, at least from me.

For this Northwest Reno Starbucks, which I once upon a time visited regularly, their breaking of the template from vapid strip mall digs into varied looking clusters of retail pads with different geometric shapes makes for a more interesting store. I'm talking about a vaulted, open ceiling once inside.  And a floor plan that isn't squarish.  And all kinds of soffits and ledges that make it even niftier.

The product is standard Starbucks fare and, yes, I've noticed that their prices have gone up some.  That medium sized (grande, I believe) cup of hot tea now costs a little more ... at all Starbucks stores.  However, I came in to find the same enthusiastic and prompt service I was used to getting.

There is an area at its perimeter with floor to ceiling windows if you want more of that high desert light.  (There are also adjustable shades.)  And there's an area closer to the bathrooms that is tucked away and has some big upholstered chairs.  It's all good.  The bathrooms are typically in clean enough and usable shape.

There is also a small outside seating area and, on occasion, I've seen people bring their canine friends and, with the typically dry conditions, it's understandable why they would.  There is a parking lot that is fairly spacious and, behind the ridge that this shopping area is perched on, there is a steep ravine.  Who knows what the hell lives down here?  I'm thinking coyotes and snakes, at the very least.  But this Starbucks and adjacent stores feel very apart from that wild world below, allowing you to experience a suburban coffeehouse experience that doubles as suburban Californian.  This Starbucks is just different enough on various levels that, with my 4 word tag line to describe this set-up - wedges, edges, and ledges, it's a 4 star Starbucks.  And I'm glad I dropped by to see that things hadn't changed.
