So, have you been to a Starbucks before?  If so, then you have a really good idea of what to expect. If not, where have you been?  
There is a good amount of seating both in and outdoors (although it is at a reduced capacity currently due to COVID).  They have a drive-thru and parking isn't an issue. Most importantly, they got my drink right and it tasted great.  I'd come back.

Nice location inside of the Hilton hotel on Clearwater Beach. That is the only good. Women at the register did not know what was included in certain beverages, and when I received my brown sugar oat milk shaken espresso, it was made incorrect. After notifying an employee about my beverage having zero oat milk or brown sugar, an employee with a nose piercing that was rude with an attitude, insisted that it was made the correct way. So in the end I paid nearly 7$ for a drink that is normally 4$ (quad espresso on ice). Look elsewhere for coffee in Clearwater.

There is only one word that comes to mind when I think of this Starbucks, and that's FINALLY!!!!!!!  Oh my gosh I cannot explain how long I have been waiting for a Starbucks in Algiers and I am in loveeeee with this one since it has opened. My very first impression was how nice and big the building was. The interior is especially appealing with very nice architecture, decor, and plenty of seating. The staff are friendly and helpful and on my first visit one of the baristas offered me a free drink because she had accidentally made an extra one.  I have been here 3 times since it has opened and have gotten multiple drinks at each visit--all of which were made to my liking. So far I have zero complaints and I'm sure this place will live up to its name. I will definitely continue to heavily support this Starbucks!
Specifically asked about the buy 1 get 1 for happy hour today and got home only to find out that they didn't apply the promo.

So today I showed up with my younger sister in the drive thru because it is their birthday. They are twins, and you would think this would be a pretty simple concept for someone to understand and grasp, but right from the start the lady taking the order would not believe them. 

She told them they can't use two birthday code in one order, so my sister responds and told her that's fine then, we can do two orders. This is the point when I realize it is not even going to be worth trying to order a drink for myself, because she is already so grouchy about two birthday drinks. She very clearly thinks they are lying about their birthdays, which is just such an unhappy and weird thing for someone to do. 

So they finally try to order and my sister just gets a cold brew with a flavor shot, to which the barista tells her they don't have the BUTTONS to order that. (Like why is this lady even allowed to speak to customers at this point???) so she tells them she'll have to do something "weird" to order it. We were thinking that was super strange since that's literally never happened and she always gets the same drinks but okay... 

So then she is told to pull up and she will give a total... 
Well there shouldn't be a total since they are both using their birthday codes and I decided to just wait and go to another coffee shop. 

She scans twin #1's barcode and then tells her twin #2's barcode isn't working, that there is nothing on there. We were literally looking at it with the free birthday drink so I'm not sure how that could even be possible. 
Then she gives them twin #1 a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT DRINK! Not even close to what she ordered that apparently "didn't have a button." 

Then as we left we look again at the apps to see what she is talking about and all she did was redeem 200 points from the twin #1's phone and didn't even bother to check twin #2's phone because she didn't have points for her to take like that. 

So definitely get your coffee anywhere else. This location is a mess and the baristas are incredibly rude and will assume you're lying when it's your birthday. DEFINITELY don't go on your birthday though because this barista will go out of her way to make sure and try to ruin your day.
When u ask for light ice they give u a ton and then charge me 6 dollars for a drink. Every mf time. I hate this place . DONT COME HERE THEY SUCK AND DONT LISTEN.

Pls do not waste your time going to this location. They can not and will not make your drink correctly. This is by far the worst. I brought a venti iced green tea latte and more than half the the drink was just straight foam! That is ridiculous. I did not just spend over $5 for just foam. Definitely will not visit this location again. I'll take an extra 10/15 min drive to go somewhere better.

Drive thru service is supposed to be for people in a rush correct?... if you agree with that statement then this location is not for you.... I've tried giving this place a chance over and over again and they take FOREVER! There's always a bunch of people working too but it's like they're all in slow motion. It's taken me 20-25 minutes to get a cup of coffee ...I now drive miles out of the way to go to other locations just to get to work on time. I can't wait until the Dunkin' Donuts opens across the street.
Everything great here and it shows. Good crowd on an early Sunday afternoon, drive thru was easy, my wife's customized latte perfect and so were the crispy sandwiches. Very friendly crew!
Great service! Our drinks were made quickly and taste amazing. The barista was so friendly and made our experience great.

Gross the girl who was making the drinks kept putting her finger in her mouth- definitely made sure to buy bottled water. Girls were so confused on the drinks, overall a hot mess and not focused on the customers just gossiping.

So far, I really like this new Starbucks,  the location is perfect, there is a drive thru which is perfect for my drive to work.  The decor on the inside is very snazzy and makes me feel like I am in a coffee shopt in Europe.  The customer service is top notch and the indoor and outdoor seating is larger than must Starbucks.  THe only drawback is driving in and out of the plaza there are to many twist and turns and not enough stop signs so people are confused.  That architect and engineer could have done better with that because people were getting agiatated as they try to get on the drive through lane.
The service is friendly and its a great location! Only problem is there is not enough parking spaces to handle all the traffic and the drive through line can wrap around the building.

I'm giving this starbucks 5 stars based on the cool staff and the Clover machine.

No pour overs here, they use the clover machine which is pretty amazing!!

The clover is a reverse French press and it makes an amazing cup of coffee!!!

Perfect extraction every time, and now you can pick whatever single origin coffee you want instead of being limited to 3. This is what coffee culture is about!!!

I recommend grabbing a coffee and walking down the street to the bookstore!!

Just had my first coffee from Starbucks in years  I didn't buy! Was horrible still ! Coffee just had cream nothing fancy got home took taste it was so bitter  tasted like last cup that sat all day! Even had extra extra cream! Guess i wont order again!Wawa has better coffee and not near the cost!

I've visited this Starbucks several time, before and after the build out. It is twice the size now. Today the place was well organized and received my drink with no issues. In the past I would pass this one to hit a different one. Mainly due to unfriendly staff and always asking for half and half or for the sugar to be restocked. 

Today's visit was nice. Clean store and friendly people. Maybe they had a change of management but you can tell the difference. 

They have a quaint outdoor sitting area and plenty of areas to hang out and relax inside. Parking at this location can suck because the lot is small. The drive thru wraps around into the parking lot. 

All in all this Starbucks has improved and I hope they keep it up!

May possibly the worst Starbucks I've ever visited.  Incredibly slow service, typical New Orleans attitudes, and ALWAYS out of product.  Out of all of my weekly trips out of MSY, they had exactly what I order ONE time.  Do yourself a  favor and geT coffee before you fly out.
Regular Starbucks coffee at the airport. Entrance of terminal B. They actually have quite a few choices and get really busy.

Bad service . They're like fight when custumer asking ! Over 20 minute for Oder drink and super nasty taste . If Starbucks name not on the worlds good cofffe bealive me I will never come to you Oder drink and you're cheat custumer shit ! They put ice on my drink they counting come on

Obviously Starbucks is great, in my opinion. Frequent shopper here lol. HOWEVER, this location is so adequately staffed. The building & drive thru line is insufficient. Cars are constantly backed out into the street. It doesn't matter what time you come to this location the line is always asininely long. I've been to other Starbucks where the line can be long but it still moves pretty quickly, almost like a chick fil A. This is the only coffee shop in this immediate area with lots of traffic! It needs an upgrade on location, drive thru & efficiency.

Horrible experience. I just spent $18 on an order of iced oat milk (after being told that a hot one would cost $3 extra to "build"), the wrong flavor cake pop, a pretty good kiwi tea and a caramel crunch frap without crunch because they were out of it. Worst Starbucks experience ever.

Absolutely atrocious customer service. The individual working the drive through "Natalie" was the rudest person I've ever had the displeasure of ordering from. It was clear her miserable mentality either rubbed off on the entire store or that just the atmosphere they chose to operate in. Regardless "Natalie" should find new work, maybe something that doesn't involve human interaction. 
Our order was incorrect and and brutally dismembered. They refused to fix the order in the drive through and told us we had to come in to fix it. We had no mask with us and couldn't go inside at the time and were offered no consolation to their mistakes and miserable attitudes.

This location next to the Westin entrance and Lululemon is still really understaffed on multiple visits morning and afternoon. Often only one person making drinks and nobody there to prep the cups and orders to speed things along. Needs to have two baristas actually preparing orders at the same time. I left without getting anything this morning before my family left on a tour.
Friendly, attentive staff, great location and cozy atmosphere! Perfect for getting work done. Best drink is the cold brew!

Me: "how many pumps are in that usually? 5?"
Barista: "I don't know, I just be pumpin'." 

Probably the worst Starbucks experience I've ever had. Baristas have very little knowledge of product and what's going on, everyone was very confused. They seemed adequately staffed in bodies, but not skill. Latte was marginal.

I give this Starbucks team a big thumbs up!  They know my drinks, my food, my name.  What incredibly personalized service with a smile.  You make every morning a complete delight!  Thank you for being my Cheers!  Christy a.k.a. Tall nonfat no whip mocha!

I go to this Starbucks because it is the closest one to where I live. I will divide it into general Starbucks and the warnings of their specific location (lots of congestion/traffic- can't really be helped).

I do not have much to say about the drinks as they are what you find at every location. They are always very consistent here, which is fantastic.

I like that they have a long powered table and a plentiful amount of wall outlets. Thank you for this!

The service here has always been great. Sometimes it takes a little longer to get a simple drink out, but it is usually because they are very busy. The quality of the drinks has always been great for me, and I do not have complaints! If there has been a mistake or they have somehow forgotten my drink due to their busyness, they always correct it or get it to me right away (sometimes in a larger size). 

When they aren't as crowded, the baristas are always friendly and chatty! Although Starbucks is not my favorite coffee spot, I like coming here to do work due to their longer hours and friendliness once it's a little emptier.

The only meh I have about it is that it is always SO COLD. A barista explained that their thermostat is hard to control, and that it's either extremely warm or cold. But when I have to bring my winter coat and gloves to a Florida coffee shop in the summer and when the baristas have to war hoodies and beanies sometimes, it's a little extreme.

---

So here are my warnings primarily based on their prime location.
These are things that can not be helped, since it is purely because of where this Starbucks is situated. For this I would probably give 1 star, but I do not think I can rate something that can't really change unless a massive construction project was done. :P

The location of this Starbucks is very great for their business. During peak times it gets very crowded. The thing is that their parking and drive-thru situation are both awful during these times. The lot is way too small for the amount of traffic they have, and during busy times I usually have to park far down in the neighborhood by the Papa John's (to not risk towing) or on a strange faux-driveway next door.

If you are parked in the lot BUT the drive-thru is packed, it takes a VERY long time to get out. You will be stuck unless a kind stranger lets you out. 

If you are trying to go through the drive-thru, due to the location and circulation, on a packed day you will be waiting in actual street to go through the drive-thru. There is not enough space.

Sometimes if I don't want to deal all of this I drive to a different Starbucks location that is not too far down the road and is way easier to park at/drive-thru. Sorry!

If you are patient (which honestly depends on the day for me), this location is a good spot!
Easily and consistently the slowest drive-thru service of any Starbucks anywhere. If you're willing to wait 15-20 for a cup of coffee this is the place for you. If not, try just about anywhere else.
This Starbucks is excellent. They respond quickly and cheerfully no matter how busy they are. I prefer this over the others in the area

So we were staying the hotel. Even though the reviews were off we decided to try. 

We got tea. The tea was consistent with what we get at other Starbucks nation wide. 

The restaurant was clean and tidy. The staff was friendly and welcoming.

It's new, sporting a unique design with lots of glass and high ceilings.  It's got a drive-thru, new for this part of the Santa Barbara area.  Two pluses!  What it doesn't seem to have is baristas that hustle.  From our own experiences, plus those of other Yelpers, it seems as though the staff here is under-trained, or lacking experience, or else not possessing a customer-service focus.

Our observation is that they go through the motions, but at a laid-back pace that's not helpful to people trying to get in and out while traveling up / down 101.  

The first time we stopped in was on a Friday night, after a local football game.  The entire cheerleading squad was in the lobby, and they were slow to decide what to order.  That left the rest of the patrons at the mercy of customers that didn't have their act together, and team members of 'Bucks adjusting their pace to a crawl.  Took FOREVER to get our drinks.  This was pre-COVID-19.

When we stopped in about a month ago, we weren't able to use the restrooms, which was unfortunate.  The lobby was empty, and the drive-thru line was not over-run, but it still took a long time to receive our orders.

Hoping they can gel soon!

This Starbucks has improved a lot since it opened. It is a very busy location but they handle it very well. Very convenient for us but we still miss the crew at the Chadds Ford location by Whole Foods. It is consistent with every other Starbucks!! Very friendly staff!

The coffee is good here and the car line typically moves efficiently. If you're in the mood for a good, convenient coffee, this Starbucks works well.
I haven't been inside so I can't vouch for the interior service or setting.

This is my favorite Starbucks in the area! The staff is super nice and friendly. It surely feels nice when the staff memorizes your order! 

This location is perfect to study and do homework. They have a large table with plugs to charge your electronics while you are doing your work. 

Give this Starbucks a try, you won't regret it!

It's a Starbucks. I'm glad it's open for carryout during the pandemic, but the setup is very confusing with all the tape directions on the floor that seem to want people to stand in a windy line. If there are more than 2 or 3 people waiting for their order, you can anticipate a lot of confusing and no social distancing as a result.

Adding up all the experiences I've had at this location over the years, something in my order gets prepared incorrectly 1 in 3 or 1 in 4 times. I'm still debating whether I'm okay with these odds or not.

Sometimes the customer service is very friendly, sometimes it's distracted and cold (like today, when the barista who gave me my mobile order was busy playing on his phone and neglected to give me my breakfast sandwich, which I almost forgot to ask about). The experience probably depends heavily on who's working on any given day.
What a mess!!!  The drive through line blocks the entire parking lot. I couldn't back out of my spot and then couldn't exit because cars were blocking it.
I love this Starbucks! Also, read the other reviews and Jerry is awesome and so friendly. The whole team!

The drinks and food were great as usual but the customer service was nasty. I understand it's busy on the beach and some people can put you in a bad mood but there is no reason to reciprocate your anger on other customers. I did not catch the workers name but hopefully she can learn to better handle customers.
This is the best Starbucks in the world! My wife and I love going to this location. The staff is always great and treat us like family when we come in. And they make great suggestions for drinks.

Newly opened StarBucks. This location is not in the Target store, as this business location page was altered to show as. I submitted a change request (business edit), but it has been mixed up. 

This location has a drive-thru window...great on those cold winter days...especially great when you don't want SB but your wife does!! 

Their staff (Barista) were friendly and had quick service. It was exceptionally clean...rightfully so since this is a brand new location. 

They have a decent outside seating area, definitely useful when the weather is nice and you don't want to go inside to wait in those long summer lines...as folks order them ice coffees!! (Is it just me or coffee should always be served hot?? You don't see folks in line at 7-11 to get hot slurpees in the winter, right?? Off my soapbox now!!)

I'm sure business will pick up for them and this location will be busy since it's a prime location.

My favorite Starbucks location I've been to ever! And I've been to several in first my lifetime. What separates this Starbucks from the others I've been to is that they always make sure to treat each customer with respect and kindness no matter what and always greet me by name. I used to live by a Starbucks in California for 7 years and it was only in my last year living there did they start recognizing that I was a regular. While it didn't bother me, I felt the difference moving here and seeing that everyone was just kind and welcoming to each other and the customers, it's such a pleasant feel to come into.

We were in need of coffee numerous times while in Indianapolis and Starbucks is a fairly reliable place to get strong coffee.

The employees were friendly and helped guide us with ordering something that we would love since neither of us get to Starbucks very often. I'd say in about a year, we've only been to various locations about 3 times. I usually go for a chai tea latte but sometimes something with more caffeine. Our first full day, I didnt sleep the night before because of anxiety, so Starbucks saved me from being a zombie.

Overall, this Starbucks is pretty standard but I liked the employees and the store had a very zen atmosphere. This specific location will definitely help you get caffeinated.

I love this Starbucks so much! The baristas are super nice and they are great conversationalist. My coffee or chai latte is perfect every time. There is communal and regular seating and the natural lighting is so beautiful on the inside. 5/5

Terrible experience and cannot day I am surprised.  The lack of respect, cleanliness, and overall attitude of the staff was disturbing.  Drove a few extra minutes and avoid this location.  There are plenty of great starbucks around happy to serve their customers with the respect they deserve.
They never make the drink correct. That's all I ask. Just make the drink the way I ask. Everytime we go there it tastes different. Same drink, different flavor.
Best Starbucks in the area! Only a drive through would make this a 5 star. Friendly staff makes it a great place for coffee.
Finally: A Starbucks that does everything right. I'm so used to sub-par Starbucks places messing up my order. They were nice & everything was extra good.
With this pandemic I don't understand why the employees were not wearing gloves today! We have been to this location before but today I didn't see anyone wearing gloves

They always forget items when I go through the drive thru. Even though I paid for them. And through Grubhub they forget a lot of my order as well just the other day they forgot my bagel, spread, and banana and today they forgot my sandwich and a cake pop. I like the people they are friendly and nice, but better attention needs to be paid to why is and isn't going in people's bags.

I have been a loyal customer of this Starbucks, mainly because of it's proximity to where I live, and while I am near a few Starbucks in the area, it seems that the baristas here are friendly and helpful, which is definitely a nice feature of a smaller Starbucks.  One of them has had very good suggestions on things, for example, today I tried a shot of Blonde Espresso in my Blonde Roast.  I never would have thought to have tried that but I actually really enjoyed that!  I was worried that espresso would have been way too strong and made me feel jittery but this was really good, except that it was a little strong on my stomach, but it definitely gave me the perk that I needed versus the plain Blonde roast.  She also had good suggestions when picking out a gift card for someone and I finally found the perfect one, which was really cute and said "Hey Thanks" as a cool thank you gift!  I felt that she went out of her way on a couple of occasions to help.  Now that this coffee shop is under new management, I have seen a lot of improvements in that I feel that the manager and people here really care and want you to be a happy customer, which I didn't feel before.  They've let me sample multiple coffees which were delicious.  My only reason for giving 4 stars instead of 5 is that I think sometimes there is confusion about the transactions of reloading my Gold card and then taking my balance out of the reload and sometimes the line moves a bit slowly.  All in all, I am happy here and I will continue to return, very nice neighborhood coffee shop!

This Starbucks needs HELP!! I go because it's on my way to work and regret it every time. Slow service, unpleasant employees . There just seems to be a lack of anyone caring at all. Zero management present. This place just sucks all around.

There's a tall, blonde, dedicated, smart employee there on the staff named REESE.  She's working part time while seeking academic excellence and tolerating the unique public AND work associates with diplomacy and quality service.  What better location?  Check it out.

Tried to stop in for some iced coffee before my ride back home because according to the sign on the door it says closes at 9 but it actually closes at 8:30pm. This is why it pays to check yelp beforehand.

The drinks are good, however, my complaint is their mobile app for this location. I visit lots of locations using the mobile app. This is the one where I shouldn't waste my time even looking. They have almost everything listed as not available at this store, sold out. Yet, when you go inside they have it. After many complaints to the managers and staff for months, it is not resolved. Poor business, especially since they are across from the hospital.

i come here to study a lot. the workers are always so friendly and the drinks are consistently good. they make sure customers feel welcomed in the store. some of the workers even know my order, which is so kind and really just above and beyond
The cleanest Starbucks Ive ever seen. The cashier was extremely friendly. And the prices cant be beat! My regular coffee in NY cost about $8 plus and I got it here for $5!!!!

Coffee was great as usual, but the interaction at the window with our barista was exceptional. She asked about our week and gave amazing recommendations for things to do based on our interests after having a conversation with us. I didn't even get her name, but she was really great and made our experience an awesome one. Hope she finds this!

Out of Chai, out of venti cups, out of plain bagels, out of lids. 

Reading reviews and I saw that there were issues with inventory management over 2 years ago. How is that even possible? The store didn't even seem busy from what I can tell. This didn't even feel like a real Starbucks, they didn't even have up-to date technology. They swiped my card and made me sign a paper receipt. 

I'm not a local thankfully but hoping someone at the store sees this and can show it to management. This place sucked and needs major changes.
They're SUPER busy today but are easily cranking out the drink orders.  The product is good but this staff is great! Keep it up!
This is by far the slowest Starbucks in Tampa if not florida. Regret going here every time unless I have 30min to waste

It's not the best but it's the closest coffee shop to my desk. (I work in the same building) These 'punch cards' are decent ive gone through about 3, downside is that you can only use it at this location.
We are so happy to have this brand new Starbucks at the front of our neighborhood!! Fast and friendly service with a smile! What more could you ask for!!?

I went to E. Hillsborough ave location near my home, I ordered a small size pineapple matcha tea for 1st time. Usual preference is matcha frappe.
Lid was not properly put on and drink spilled out, when I checked, the  lid had a split. Paid 4.79 for two sips that was leftover with mostly ice. Cup seemed smaller than usual small size and wh8at I did tatse of this drink was just okay. Very disappointing! 
However 5* drive thru staff, He was very professional.
Just went to the drive thru for a cappuccino. I think the person at the windows name was Bryce. All I have to say is ---keep that energy booboo! So friendly.

S/O to Bill, Aden, and Myra (Store Manager). They treated me with full blown kindness. They were easy to talk to and reassured that I got my drink and food correctly. A value to not only this location but the company itself. Their hard work and dedication should not go unrecognized!

The staff here are absolutely amazing. The main issue with this Starbucks is the drive through line during Covid is a mess. It starts on a two way street which means people cut in line. This was probably not designed with the current number of drive-through customers in mind. But at this point there have been months and months and months of dealing with this with no solution. It's a real problem.

I have been goi g to this location at least 3 times a week before COVID started and also have been using the online app, lately the service has been less than par. I work in the service industry and understand the struggles. The service at this location has drastically declined in the last few months. I will be looking elsewhere for my coffee now. Sorry, sometimes the truth hurts!!!

This is the location in Canal Place. Line moved quickly and I ordered the peppermint hot cocoa. The cashier rang me up then a barista said, "we only have skinny mocha for hot chocolate." I'm not a regular visitor but how do you not have enough syrup to make the hot cocoa especially on a cold day?
What's up with all the private convos and your rolling eyes? Customer service means NOTHING here.

I go to this Starbucks everyday, and staffing has gotten so terrible that I won't be able to continue using this location. I just sat in line for my coffee for 47 mins. Almost an hour for a cup of coffee. I have been a daily Starbucks customer for nearly 20 years and this level of customer service is no longer to the standard I expect when spending almost 8 dollars on a cup of coffee. I have continuously tried to show a level of grace, because I am aware of the nationwide staffing shortage. HOWEVER, I believe Starbucks needs to step up and make some changes. For starters I believe after waiting 40 mins before even reaching the register, without them even beginning to make my drink it should of been comped. My complaint is less with the few employees working hard today trying to do there best. And more so to do with the management that approved this schedule, and the hire ups for not offering incentives to staff there locations. When choosing Starbucks, I pay more then the standard coffee shop because I expect not only consistency but a level of competence that puts you above your competition.  But, these days, Starbucks is really dropping the ball.
The NICEST staff! I walk out of my way from a closer Starbucks just for the friendly, welcoming experience.

I'm giving one star bcuz i love that there's a Starbucks in Algiers. But i have to pray whenever i pull up- that my drink will be made properly. This prayer is rarely answered lol. I had the coldbrew with cinnamon oatmilk foam and it was delicious! The oat milk foam sits at the top and you get a rich nutty and creamy bit of foam with every sip of the coldbrew. As someone who normally drinks black coffee, I was looking for subtle flavors instead of something super sweet, and I was not disappointed! The baristas were very friendly too! I also really liked the extra effort taken with the seasonal decorations. I look forward to coming again!

Only one in the mall and the staff was super nice. They made my serious strawberry Frappuccino fast and it was delicious. It was delicious! It is also centrally located to a lot of stores in the mall, but it is far enough away from the hectic food court. 

I wouldn't go out of my way to find it, but it works for me.

I go to Starbucks nearly everyday, that being said, I actively avoid this Starbucks location. I have gone inside and through the drive thru a few times and I never make it through in less than 20 minutes... even if I'm the first in line and there is barely anyone there. My mom, sisters and I call is the "slow Starbucks", the old location was my favorite and easily 4 times as efficient. I don't like to beat a dead horse, but if you don't have an extra 30 minutes then I'd drive the extra 5 minutes to the Longley location or go to Bibo up the street. 
Pros: the drinks are usually made correctly 
Cons: timeliness 
Overall: Nobody got time for the

Update: (why does this have to be the ONLY coffee shop on my way to work)... if you order a blueberry oatmeal every-morning, like I do, please check your accouterments and the expiration dates. They like to sub honey for the agave (without question or notice), they like to give expired blueberries... or forget them all together, and the additional mixers is a crap shoot. I think it's supposed to be the nut/berry one? But sometimes I get just nuts, sometimes just berries and sometimes I get them all 3 with the brown sugar to boot.

Before you go judging me for continuing to order this overpriced item every morning, I understand that I'm being tedious... but I just figure that if you're running a chain with a limited standard menu... the least I could ask for is consistency. I should not feel that I have to triple check expiration dates and stop to check each item in my bag (slowing down everyone else) because the terror rate is so high! 1/4 visits I'd say. It's just not good form.

This location fucks up my order more times then not. I will politely repeat my order back to them to double check. And they will always just say OK and blow it off. And then continue to make my order wrong and when I ask them to remake it they will just re-pour it into another cup and hand me back a sloppy half fixed order. It wouldn't be that big of a deal if I wasn't paying seven dollars for a coffee and tipping them in hopes that they will make my order correctly.

I have a Starbucks problem (at least according to my bank account) so I was surprised and excited when one with a drive thru opened across the street from my job. This is a perfect location with a well planning drive thru and friendly staff. Since I frequent Starbucks all the time I'm used to experiencing a certain type of service when getting my morning coffee. My biggest complaint is the speed of the morning drive thru. I realize this location is new and so are the employees but waiting 25mins each morning to get through the line for an iced coffee is crazy. In addition, I have paid for yogurt only to realize it was expired when I went to open it. I think once the kinks of the new location are worked out and they focus on fast service this will be my #1 Starbucks.

This Starbucks is the closest to my home and I typically use their drivethru! Love that! There are days that the line is super long  but the wait time is really shortage staff are nice and friendly! 
I've been inside a couple times and it's a pretty spacious location. The drinks are made well! Definitely a good franchise location!
Quick coffee stop In the new MSY terminal, concourse C.  The the waiting in spacious, with lots of seats nearby.

When my fiancee and I were in the area for Valentine's day, we came here to relax and to stay warm since it was freezing outside and we loved it. The interior design was unique in a good way and we definitely were comfortable sitting in the lounge section with the heat lingering throughout the cafe.

I can't believe how quickly this new Starbucks was built and opened! I went to the drive thru midday and there were like 3 cars ahead of me but they moved quickly. Quality was pretty standard Starbucks and service was super friendly. 

There's a ton of parking! I think as more of the businesses open up in this new area, it will get a little hectic, but it's perfectly fine for now. Exiting onto Keystone just before an entrance to 80 is definitely hectic and I was not a fan of that...but access is slightly easier than to the location at Keystone and 7th? I think. 

I forgot Homage is closed on Mondays or I would have gone there. But this is good in a pinch and I always love me some pumpkin loaf!

Don't arrive on a Sunday when it's not busy.  The only visible barista was lounging at the drive thru window chatting up some guy.  She seemed to think that her conversation was more important than a customer.  Asked me to wait. I left with a photo that will find its way to the manager. Giving it one star for looking like a Starbucks even if they don't sell coffee.
My wife and I really like this 'bucks. They are efficient and the store is always clean. I am curious why this location doesn't have great ratings.

This is my new go to Starbucks as it's the closest location to my house. I wish it had a drive thru but not every location is equipped for one. I usually only do mobile orders as this location is super packed most of the time with local students sucking up the free WiFi. 

I highly recommend doing mobile orders on saturdays as the weekend soccer mom crews hit up this location in droves. Give the mobile orders double the estimate time as the baristas are usually swamped with the order lines going up to the entrance. 

Must say the people working here are very friendly and cheerful. They have never fussed about some of the creative concoctions I try ordering with the free drinks I get from the Starbucks reward program (love trying out the secret menu items found on the internet)

This Starbucks runs backwards. Every single time I come the wait is so long. There will be a few cars in line at the drive through and it still takes so long. Add 15 minutes to your plans if you come to this Starbucks. I'm sure other stores can share some best practices with the employees at this location.

Timing is everything? Yup!

Of course had to stop today to get the free holiday cups!

Of course you need to get the grande specialty drinks.

As we were waiting, the line started to increase.. four cars behind me and three cars in front.

Hubby uses the app and says we needed to spend $20 to get 75 stars... 

Our purchase total was $10.25... but he always falls for those gimmicks.. like buy one get one free etc..

When I got to the window and showed her his phone, she said the car in front paid for ours!!!

Perfect timing!

Thank you to the car in front!

I go to this Starbucks at least 5 days a week to get a drink and study. I have always received the best service. I wish they had a thumbs dOwn or a 0... honestly the worst Starbucks I've been my whole life. Is ok if they are in the process of hiring  or new but not ok NOT BEEN POLITE. Never really go to starbucks but this visit was much needed since I had a long 6 hr drive. Big time credit to Haleyanne who had the best advice and the best customer service. Definitely going back to this location. Thank you!
Don't go here if you have any kind of time constraints. SLOWEST Starbucks ever!! Took 10 minutes to order and another 20 to get my order.

This is my favorite Starbucks in town! The staff are super friendly and every time I come and sit down and relax the people around me are always so friendly and the vibe is just awesome. Sometimes it can be slow, but what do you expect when there are so many people trying to get coffee in a drive thru at once? Love it here :)

I cannot begins to express how important customer service is, especially if you are in the Starbucks industry and are known worldwide for how quick and polite the service is. I'm a big fan of Starbucks, but this particular store m is the only Starbucks I go to that doesn't have my mobile waiting for me when I come to the door. Everything just takes longer here. Not sure why, since they have more baristas than other places.
Staff here are very friendly and helpful. They made me feel very welcome when I walked in the door and throughout the time I was at the store. I will definitely be back soon. Thank you so much.
For how busy they were they got our drinks out quickly! Very friendly! There's so many Starbucks in the area but this is definitely not a bad location!

Friendly service. Coffee was good. Online order to 20+ minutes. Watched people walk in, order and leave before me. Only one person working on online orders and several for the counter and drive thru. Lesson learned, online order is low priority at this location.

I stop into this Starbucks from time to time, usually doing a mobile order so I can pop in and out without having to wait in the line at the drive-thru. Every time I've been inside, I've been pleased with how friendly the baristas are, how clean the place has been, and how quick they are to get my order to the mobile bar. They always make it a point to say hello when I come in and thank me for my business. Certainly an A+ experience!

An amazing crew that is serving out great coffee and genuine connections! Terrance, Emily, Hannah, Torrance, Mo and Betina quickly made this store one of my favorites and a great way to start the day. Love nerding out on coffee with the Baristas!!! 5.5 outa 5.

This is the Starbucks that I frequent when in Tucson and I've never had a bad experience. I typically do mobile ordering and take advantage of the drive through, which is a wonderful and efficient combination! The employees here are friendly and  a few are over the top personable! I have gone inside a time or two and also received courteous service and the facility itself is clean and comfortable. It's not the largest Starbucks store, but it's nice.

I didnt even start my car when I noticed that they forgot my creamers.  I want to make it clear that I do not blame the barista's at all but feel that this is a manager training issue. I go to Starbucks a lot these days, but the one thing I've got to say is that whenever I come in to Starbucks, one of the employees will know my order if you come here a lot. This is like one of the best Starbucks's I've ever been to in a while!!

It's no mystery that Starbucks is by far my favorite stop for coffee and other selections that are spontaneous dictated by my cravings at any given moment. I have visited literally hundreds of Starbucks' location since they've come into existence and although they all seem to be pretty consistence with the quality of the products they offer; the service, quality of the product, wait-time, cleanliness and accessibility of the location are the five points I will rate all of them on going forward - so to make the point I've recently incorporated a rating system based on this short list to calculate the rating of the locations I visit. I feel all these criterions are controllable by the corporation, the franchise owner or store manager.

Service - 3 Stars

This is one of my favorite Starbucks to go to in Reno! It's right off the highway, and easy to find, the parking lot is a little cramped so just be careful when you're driving in. I love coming here to study because of the big windows - lots of natural lighting that makes it bright and sunny while you're there and the atmosphere is perfect, there are people milling in and out because it's so accessible, but it never gets too loud because of the customers or the music.

The service itself is also fantastic! The baristas are all super friendly, and very relaxed and welcoming. One time while I was there I was "that customer" because my mocha tasted more like a hot chocolate instead of a mocha and I went up and politely mentioned it and they gave me a new one for free without even hesitating - and with a smile on their face. 

I wish I knew the names of the especially nice baristas so I could give them a shoutout, but I guess I'll have to go there again and find out! The best part of the place - lots of tables, and OUTLETS!

Ordered 7 items from the drive through just now. Noticed that they gave me a bagel mislabeled in a bag that said it was my breakfast sandwich. I went in to switch it out which was easy. Didn't realize until we were much farther away that they also forgot to put in our two cake pops. Tried to call and at least change the amount we were charged on CC but no one would answer the phone. Are you guys just throwing random things in bags?

Bathroom was disgustingly dirty and it's only 3pm on a weekday. When I pulled my pants back up, they were wet from in front of the toilet.

I waited several minutes longer than I should have for my drink. I noticed later the light ice was not lite, in addition to missing my Carmel drizzle. 
Maybe the health department should check this place out. 
Maybe they need some customer service training.

Wow!! Savannah, what a joy it was to see the tag with your full face and magnificent smile!!  Grazie mille for an amaaaaaaaazing iced espresso made perfectly in response to my request, and even more so for your amazing smile and personality! Bravissima!!

The best Starbucks in bucks county. Been coming here since I first came to the area. They are friendly neat and make my day every morning and will stop by in the afternoon also that is how much I love this place.
The coffee I got was burnt coffee. I will never return. The quality has gone down greatly.
The slowest, and I mean  crazy slowest, Starbucks I have ever been into in my entire life. Fire everyone please and let's start from scratch?

The new freestanding building is architecturally pleasing. The location is very useful and was a smart and forward-looking move, but they are really struggling with the service. When I get to the window, they are almost always confused as to which order is mine. On three occasions I drove off after being given the wrong drink and on a couple of others they've forgotten entirely. Sometimes the drinks are great/normal sometimes they are very unbalanced. I know the store is new and they are likely working out the kinks, but it's taking way too long for such a large and organized company. 
Starbucks, this store needs your help.

I've been here a few times - in July 2016 and in July 2019 and food was fresh and service was friendly. I believe a waited a little long a time or two but nothing unusual.
Ordered a chestnut praline latte and didnt taste the chestnut praline but they were more than happy to remake it for me very nice staff

Slowest Starbucks ever!!! One cashier who had no idea what she was doing. Very long line. They had one person making coffee and four other people that the best I can tell were supervising the coffee maker and the cashier. What a joke! Took almost 50 minutes to get an iced tea with only 10 people in front of me. Avoid at all cost if you have a flight to catch

This is a Starbucks like many others.  The baristas change from time to time as most of them do not choose to serve coffee for their lifelong career.  I've never had an issue with the service here.  My issue is with the HORRIBLE PARKING.  The lot is TINY and cars are often backed up onto Rt 30 waiting for someone to make a 5 point turn.  Cars double park, hog the "15 minute" spots, and basically turn this corner into a nightmare.  
There is a Cosi across the street with a BIG lot, a Saxby's toward Ardmore with same, and this little gem in Bryn Mawr has enough room for about 8 cars.  Sometimes I drive by and laugh at what I see...that coffee MUST be good for people do deal with that parking situation.  Do yourself a favor and goto one of the Coffee shops with *real* parking. In any case, please be careful parking here!  Or even driving by on Route 30 as sometimes cars are backing out of the entrance or just cued up waiting to get in.  Having to drive past this regularly, I'd say that is a solid reason to complain about the parking here!
Convenient location, friendly service and all menu options are sold here. I like the iced teas and iced coffee.

Frappucinos are always kind of thin and when they have specials like the cinnamon shortbread they never look like the pictures or taste as good as other stores' versions. 
They do a pretty good job on keeping the drive thru moving and I do like being able to mobile order here. That's the only reason I go here rather than the target store in this shopping center.

My brother and I are retired and spend a lot of time in various coffee shops around town.  The South Meadows Starbucks is very large and convenient.  The problem we have is that this is easily the most filthy Starbucks in town. I go to Starbucks everyday. It is my treat for myself. The baristas are friendly and everyone knows my order. If I forget to say "do you want coconut milk". I am lactose intolerant intolerant. They help take care of me. When I had knee replacement surgery  and my husband got my drink if he forgotten something the barista could help him out. I alway go to this store.

Starbucks are the same for the most part - but this Starbucks is pretty rough. The parking is minimal, and you're likely to get trapped by the drive thru line if you do manage to get a parking spot. The line is usually 4-8 cars deep, so getting through the drive thru usually takes at LEAST 20 minutes. The employees are friendly and professional, and the coffee is fine, but the parking and drive thru time is abysmal, likely because it's the only one nearby.

I work right around the corner & keep giving them the benefit of the dout. They're nice and all but always out of everything I've learned my lesson with the drive through. I feel obligated I order because I'm in the drive through but they have anything I want. Also they're card reader is always down which is embarrassing

The Starbucks with unique character are the better ones for that reason alone.  But, when the service is good even on Thanksgiving morning - well, that just makes that location awesome.  We had coffees and a scone post-Thanksgiving parade and found this a great spot to warm up inside and out.  Looks like a great spot for the Doctors at Jeff to hangout as well as students to study at.  

Highly recommend stopping in for a cup-a-Joe soon.

Hot coffee. Quick service. And 2 desserts for $3 AFTER 4PM!!! Why am I just finding this out?

It's Starbucks? What do you expect?

This is going to be my preferred location in DE because the other 3 always having some kind of problem. In order from worst to least worst are:

-Marsh - unnecessary long waits

This Starbucks is not much different than the others. Follow the formula, get a great cup of coffee. That's one of the secrets to their success. How many times do you find a pizzeria that you really dig, then when they open a second location....it tastes nothing like the original? What a drag. 
It doesn't matter if your in New York or Nevada with 'Bucks. Consistency.

Here is the dissimilitude. Customer service and atmosphere. Here the staff was great but the cafe was in need of attention. Taking into account they have 1 hour to closing shouldn't matter. One of two bathrooms had no tp and the other was pretty disgusting. One word and they got right on it.

The atmosphere is really incredible. I especially love the outdoor seating (so much so that I stayed and wrote this review). Great wall art and plenty of seating inside. Comfortable cushioned chairs outside with an amazing amount of shade trees. This is nicer than my house!

We wanted to give a shout-out to all the people working at the Starbucks on Shadeland Ave, near 21st St, Indy!  A+  Keep up the great work!  We have been ordering breakfast sandwiches, coffee, and brownies, there, several times a week, since the re-opening of the drive-thru, and the service is friendly and efficient and the food, desserts, and coffee, fresh and awesome!  Peace, Hope, Comfort, Signed, a couple of seniors, East Indy

Not sure what's up with the low rating for this location. Every time I go my order is ready as scheduled (mobile user here) and if I don't feel like waiting in the drive thru,  a quick hop inside to the pick up area and I'm on my way. Saturday afternoon around noon, it's usually busy. Located in the Rouses/Planet Fitness parking lot.about ten minutes from where I work. Friendly, courteous staff.

Everyone that works here is super nice and cleanly. The manager really cares about the customers and the quality of service. To top things off, they always have my order prepared perfectly, I appreciate them so much!

Stopped by the store this afternoon. Asked for some water. Was charged for a cup of water. It was 102 degrees outside, yet they have the nerve to charge for freaking H2O. If it's not illegal, it should be.
Sent an email to their Customer Service department & received a pretty standard "we are sorry" response and $5 (or 150 stars) as hush money.
Pissed beyond measure and cutting all ties with Starbucks at this point. 
Not cool Starbucks...not cool at all.

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. It is near my house so I gave it quite a few chances, but they are horrible. They will take forever, mess up your order, and their mobile orders are never ready. The staff is very rude and does nothing to rectify mistakes.
I've been standing for several minutes and no one has got to us. There's multiple employees standing there doing nothing. Will not go here again. Don't support this location.

Seriously THE LINE alone makes me think this is the new in n out, but at least in n out gets your order right. I mean seriously, the worst part is ordering in the drive thru just to be told to wait in front to then receive a poorly made order. I didn't even want to wait again. I get that there's a pandemic going on, but this is the third time this week they gave poor service. So it is what it is.

My first Starbucks hot chocolate and pumpkin scone of the season. It is truly fall now by my calendar. This is the new Starbucks location in town so I thought I'd give it a try. The weight was longer than normal; not sure why but it seemed like forever until I got to the window.

My hot chocolate was wonderful as always, just enough chocolate and a very drinkable temperature. Slightly disappointed in my pumpkin scone, however, it was dry and almost gardened in some places.  It tasted as if it had been frozen and they microwaved it? Y'all know what I mean, when you microwave something frozen and the inside gets warm, but the outside edges are hard and crusty.

 At any rate, five stars for my hot chocolate and one star for my pumpkin scone. Averages to a three for Starbucks today. I'm thinking I can probably find a recipe for their pumpkin scones as I've got one for their cranberry bars.

I had a mobile order placed and it said it would be ready in 5 to 10. I arrive and the girl says "sorry we were busy talking in the back". I had to then wait another 10 minutes for my order. Awful service! You girls are not good employees. It was dead. I was the only person there.
Good service friendly staff. Props to Kevo Aaron and Anna Marie very nice people. Do wish they had a little more seating and single seats though.
Always slow inside ... so frustrating ... don't bother going in even if the line in the drive through is long.
You know what to expect and that's half the value.  Nothing exciting or cutting edge here but the service was helpful and the coffee accurate.

My go-to place every morning before i catch the train for work. The staff is nice an they make my drink the way i love it. They also know their frequent customers well. =)

Only downside is the parking. Its AWFUL no matter what time of the day you go there. you have to keep in mind the place is on the corner of Bryn Mawr Rd. and it's tiny.  There are only 6 parking spots, but people park their cars up against the building and 'create their own spots'.

New location and expect it to be nice. Horrifically dirty bathroom from the outside door and handle, to paper all over the floor, to water, messy mirror, and just stuff everywhere. Seat up, changing table down. Very disappointed.
The wait is longer than any Starbucks. Double the time the app tells you when you order ahead. They often get orders wrong too. I choose to go to Brandywine even though it's 10 minutes further away

This store sucks!! I pre-ordered off the app... Unfortunately the app sent me in a wrong direction. Starbucks has no clue! I mean, how do people identify stores when they walk in???... there are no clear markings to identify the store,  nor is there every an address, store number, or something that identifies the location. Starbucks needs to fix that!!! The worst part was though, is this Starbucks location inside of a Hilton Hotel! I showed them my order from the app, and they made me pay for another coffee. This location sucks! And Starbucks, you need to fix this shItty situation!!!

Missed Starbucks! All baristas we're wearing their face masks :) restrooms are closed and sitting not available but coffee still taste amazing and I know that the baristas have smiling face behind their masks :) oh oh and they have  cake pops!

I've been a fairly frequent customer of this particular Starbucks since it first opened.  I've watched it go through the speed bumps of a management change, staff turnover and COVID-19.  The staff, with few rare exceptions, is pleasant, professional, and seems to truly care about their customers' happiness.  All this while working in what can be a busy, demanding industry with a sometimes-difficult clientele.

Over the past month, I've noticed that my drink order seems to take longer-and-longer to be fulfilled with each passing visit; even when I have ordered ahead.  In some cases, it's taken as long as 30 minutes.  (My drink is one of the fastest, easiest ones to make, by the way).  I'm the type person who, if I know WHY something like this is happening, becomes less annoyed by it.  When I inquired about this trend, it was made known to me that this store has recently been experiencing a rash of call-outs.  So the shifts frequently wind-up being understaffed.  I also learned that this store was just made into a training hub so alot of the staff that are manning these shifts are inexperienced, newly-hired trainees.  

The 3 stars are just to call attention to the problem.  This store used to be very reliable in terms of knowing when the busy vs. slow times were but it could be a slow time of day now and I'd still risk a 30 minute wait for a drink.  Hopefully, the situation will be addressed and rectified soon.

Didn't do drive thru, but wished I had.  Anyone who went inside got the pleasure of waiting forever to get their orders, as they got to watch the staff cater to the drive thru customers.  

Finally got my order, got into the car to drive away to find that my order was not right.  

I think the employees needed a cup of coffee or two.

This place is slow. Like c'mon guys, one of the tenants of being a good Starbucks is speed. Turn and burn, you know the drill. This is not that place. I will say though the staff was friendly but didn't seem to have a sense of urgency

worst service ever. the old woman at the reg was very rude and was yelling next in line over and over when no one had been ready.  when the card reader didn't give me an option to tip and i had no cash she and her male coworker said, without knowing i had heard, "oh so millennials don't tip." thats a) extremely bad customer service and b) offensive as i do work in service and appreciate a good tip but when there is no option to tip, employees should not be disrespectful toward the people they're getting paid to provide a service for.

Completely rude!
I don't understand why the employees of multiple Starbucks locations in Florida seem to have forgotten about customer service. The staff didn't care to make my drink correctly, and there were no smiling faces. Just blank angry people working here. Avoid this store if you want your usual Starbucks experience.

I go there almost every day because I work in the area, and they've given me dairy instead of soy at least 10 times now, but usually I catch it while watching them make it. Today I drank one with dairy and it made me really sick, so I went back and told them, and the girl just said she'd try to remember next time. Don't go to this one- go a mile down the road to Charlotte and it's much quicker, more accurate, and less frazzled.

If I could put in to words how much I hate this Starbucks I would. How do you manage to fuck up my drink everytime. They don't even know what light ice is. They literally don't care or pay attention. I'm mad that this location is my closest one. I literally am disappointed every time. Never coming here again.

I care in because of the new article I read. Now what I don't understand is how there are suppose to be writing isis on cups. But it's two different Muslim people working there. That I don't get. I think is a set up. The baristas was nice and even while crowded they were still nice. High prices and med speed service

TRICK OR TREAT! Well I got the trick Today on Halloween.  I ordered a Pumpkin scone. A Caucasian Male came out from the back area of the store with the scone in the little brown bag closed. I waited a couple of minutes later and received my matcha tea.  When I got home10 minutes later  and opened the bag, I found the pumpkin cake to be steal. So steal that the pumpkin scone crumbled as soon as I touched it.. It's a shame they've got a dude in there who clearly knows nothing about customer service and seems to be intentionally undermining  good  customer service. If I opened the bag and saw and felt that it was steal, the guy clearly had to know he was giving out a steal cake.  Beware the hefty Caucasian male about 5'11 and check very carefully anything he is handing to you.

The young lady who took my order was rather rude. She was very cut off-like. As I am placing my order, she would not let me finish before giving me my total. Her attitude was terrible and service was beyond horrible. As for my money being spent there today, I will not be returning considering my coffee tastes bad and sour. Starbucks, please hire staff that actually want to be at work and have better attitudes.

I'm not sure who Starbucks promoted as the new General Manager, but things are not being run correctly. The same crewmembers are still there- and still hardworking. Every day the line is wrapped past the front door and mobile orders take 15-20 minutes for customers to receive. Before COVID, I went to this location 5 time a week to order coffee and study. I spent about 10-15 hours a week in the lobby studying. Now because of restrictions, I just mobile order. The problem seems to be management. The store is not being run correctly. I enjoy this location and have had some great memories here. Hoping Starbucks corporate can fix said problems. Thank you.

The service has become a lot better. I am no longer dreading going in to pick up my coffee. 

I will say this though... it's kind of like a roulette though. I order one thing and get something completely different. I mobile order, so I'm not sure how it gets messed up two days in a row.
Super slow service made sense when they made my drink wrong three times. Driving a little further to the suncoast starbucks probably would have taken less time.

So definitely lots of pros. They stayed open during the pandemic and was able to get the drive thru line moving quickly. Mobile ordering in the morning was a breeze. Always offered to give my pup a puppucchino when I go through the drive thru.
The major con about this place is the drinks are inconsistent. Its always a bit disappointing when you realize they added way too much cream into your cold brew and full pumps of vanilla (even when you ordered it with just 1) after you drive away. But alas, I will be back...especially since pumpkins back on the menu

I am thankful that I have a Starbucks close by my house for those mornings that I wake up and just don't want to make coffee. It's not often that you find a Starbucks where the employees aren't friendly and the coffee impeccable and this Starbucks is no different. I've walked in, mobile ordered and ask gone through the drive thru and each time the service has been amazing and quick. The only downside to this Starbucks has nothing to do with the service or the flavorful awakening coffee they serve but instead the layout. There are a couple of ways to enter this drive thru and neither flows nicely. If you are coming from the front of the store it's hard not to block traffic while waiting to enter the drive thru line and I've been cut in line a few times by drivers that just come around behind me apparently thinking I'm waiting on something else? Or they just cut you off coming from the backside. At this one, if there is a line I'll usually mobile order and it's literally ready within minutes. I've ordered from the line for the drive thru before and by the time I got around, parked and walked inside it was sitting waiting for me. Nothing negative to say about this place....Thank you for quenching my coffee cravings in a jiffy Starbucks....and doing it with a pretty amazing smile!

I love coming to the Starbucks. The staff is always so friendly, drinks are made quickly and never really a long line for mobile orders. With the pandemic and every thing going on in the world, the little things make a difference. "We Love You" written on a cup just brightened my day!
This store has not been open on time for two months. They either call off or show up super late to open the store. This store is located in the Marriott hotel!

This is the worst Starbucks. Staying at the hotel for a conference, it's closed Mondays & Tuesdays and closes at noon the rest of the week. I get that there's a personnel problem right now but come on. You break from meetings & want coffee and you can't get it.
I dont mind its drive through service only, Most of the Dutch Brothers I go to is that way! But the food here is bland, and the coffee taste like its burnt.

I've never written a review before but my experience at a drive through in this location was EXCELLENT! the representative YADISHA was super helpful and even explain throughly the details of how to order the drink my husband and I enjoy to ensure I don't have any question the next time. 
Thank you Yadisha!!
Slowest Starbucks ever. Workers don't care about the customers. 5 people working and only kept 1 on register, 1 making the drinks. Other ones just standing around talking and not working at all

Our employees in this airport just trying to be jerks? We're at the Starbucks at terminal C and the kid at the counter is just nasty. Did everybody work too hard last night, party too hard last night or just wake up on the wrong side of the bed?

Newly opened early 2018, located across parking lot from Target, near to FedEx and PNC bank.  Nice large patio and a drive-thru.  Great staff. I recommend the green tea grasshopper (mint and mocha chip) frappuccino.

Super friendly staff. Always nice. I even spilt a little coffee and had to go in to get napkins and I mentioned it, they came out a few min later with a fresh coffee! Very nice and considerate. Iv been here often, great clean place

By far the worst Starbucks I've been too. Ordered an iced green tea and it took over 10 minutes to make even tho they had four staff members working and two people ahead of me. 1 out of the 4 people staffed actually were working. The rest of the staff was standing behind the counter drinking samples.

I went to this Starbucks and had a very simple order. This was my second time trying this location, and the last time they gave me the wrong drinks. I decided to give them a second chance. When they handed me the hot chocolate I immediately felt that it was only half full. I asked if they wouldn't mind filling it up the rest of the way since this was for a friend and they said yes, I got it back and they had filled it up with whip cream. When I got to my friends all of the whip cream was melted and the drink was still half full. I also order a caramel machiotto and it was not good at all. Very disappointed, I've been a Starbucks drinker for 19 years don't know if I will ever go back to this location which is sad because it is right by my house.
The drive-thru line at this location is always extremely long. Be sure you have time to wait!

I want to like this location because it is so close to my house but my experience here so far has been underwhelming. For the first couple of weeks they were open mobile orders were basically not available anytime I tried to order. I chalked it up to it being a new location. Recently, I ordered an iced chai latte through mobile. When I got there, they told me that their distribution center wasn't sending them chai syrup and they couldn't turn it off in the app, which is strange because there are plenty of things I haven't been able to get at other locations because they were listed as being out on the app. I thought it must be a weird UI issue with the app but they offered to make me something else. I said I wanted a different type of iced tea latte. They attempted to make it but didn't steam the milk or do anything to step the tea bag so I basically paid $5 for sweetened milk with a couple tea bags in it. 
The final frustration for me that lead me to make a review was the fact that a few nights ago I tried to order mobile around 8ish. Their hours were listed at 9pm online. Mobile ordering said it wasn't available so I hopped in the car and when I got there the lights were out and employees were walking to their cars. I don't know if it's a communication issue and they're hours are incorrectly posted or what but I was thoroughly irritated. I will probably give them another go down the line I hopes that things have gotten sorted out but in the meantime, I'll drive a longer distance to avoid frustration. 
All that being said, the staff have always been super nice so I'm chalking it up to logistical and training issues rather than quality of staff or competency.

The worst Starbucks I've ever been to. I avoid it at all costs, chestnuthill coffee co is much better. I only go here when I've forgotten my wallet because chestnuthill coffee co doesn't take Apple Pay. 
This Starbucks is the worst for the following reasons:
- very long wait times even when the store is not busy 
-rude and unresponsive staff. Terrible customer service. One of them handed me a hot americano when I asked for iced. I said "I'm so sorry (because I'm nice), but I asked for iced, the barista said "yeah your bad" and proceeded to pour the hot americano into ice.
-poor drink quality, I've noticed a lot of my drinks have a funky taste at the end.
Overall : if you're in chestnuthill try chestnuthill coffee co instead of Starbucks. It's a little more expensive, but quality trumps price every time.

This is clearly going to be one of Starbucks' stand-out locations in the city of New Orleans once the kinks are worked out. The service is fast and very professional. As other reviewers have noted, the space is open and airy too with good lighting. There are just a few things they need to work on, including making sure items in the bakery case are labeled so that customers can order more quickly/easily and figuring out how to pull a proper shot of espresso. My decaf espresso was very watery with little substance. Maybe they aren't using enough grinds/reusing the same grinds for multiple shots? I get decaf espresso at many other locations and it tends to have more body and flavor.
Consistently Luke warm coffee.  They will brew a fresh pot for you but clearly they need new ones.   It's ridiculous that they can't serve a hot cup of coffee.
The friendliest staff around. They make an effort to get to know everyone that walks through their doors. And they always get my order right on the first try. They're the best!

They have people working within inches of each other.  They give out no gloves or masks.  Poor window person getting dirty money & cards within a foot of people in cars.  Really?  Is this an essential business.  Do not patronize these greedy corporate entities.

I just have to rave about the employees at this location! I go to MANY different Starbucks locations and this one is by far the busiest due to its location right off of 75 and 301. However, the staff here is just SO kind. Every employee I have encountered here has just been the sweetest & so hardworking even in the midst of fast-paced chaos. I intentionally do not go to the Dunkin across the street even if it has a shorter line because the employees here are SO nice and seem to really care about their job. Definitely some gems at this location!

Starbucks: Fast-food coffee :)

I like their artisan breakfast sandwiches. The chai is too peppery for me. If anything, I like the seasonal drinks, an iced caramel macchiato, white mocha, or an iced passion tea.

The staff are always pleasant, even though they've gotten my order wrong on a few occasions...
slowest Starbucks ever ! 17 minutes in the drive thru !! 2 drinks and a water ! I hope this is not how they operate daily ! Maybe a management issue

What can I say...I love me some teas from Starbucks!! My fav drink is the peach green tea, unsweetened. If I want to stick to strict keto I'll order the brewed chai (chai tea bags) with 4 pumps SF vanilla, steamed HWC and 1 stevia. YUM

If you're not familiar, join the star rewards program and you earn stars for your purchases. Earn enough like me and you can redeem for mugs or food or drinks. I like to save mine up for drink ware although my hubs says I have way too much. But I don't think you can ever have enough Starbucks mugs and cups. Lol
Great baristas! Welcoming and smiling :) got my coffee with almond milk and honey, and daughter got her cake pop, valentine version, and her watEr :)

I tried their Oreo cookie Frappuccino, and my husband tried their lemon pound cake.... delicious! The employee at the drive thru taking orders was extremely polite and bubbly, and let me know I could substitute dairy for coconut milk, etc. after I let it be known I'm taking a chance with dairy today.

Horrible Starbucks. I was with my family looking for a place to have a quick bite. They didn't have any of the displayed sandwiches when we asked for them. So, instead we asked for five caramel Frappuccino's. First of all, they tasted like water. The drinks had more ice than anything else. The employees did a horrible job making them. They charged me 30 dollars for drinks that we ended up throwing away. Very disappointing experience.

One of the nicer Starbucks I've been to. Every time I've been here, it's always been busy, no matter the time of day. The staff have always been friendly and happy to offer suggestions for beans for home or a new drink to try. Also a decent spot for a light meal and to down one of those Evolution cold pressed juices. Bathrooms: clean.

All the above add up to what you're looking for when you visit a Starbucks. Clean, comfortable, full of competent employees and polite customers.

Finally visited this location after passing it when it first opened. My sister always used it so I wanted to see it and plus the Dunkin fresh decaf tasted too strong. Pretty busy on a Sunday morning . Customer service good but was disappointed that my London Fog had no sweetener as it should .

Doesn't open until 6:30 most days, FYI. I've gotten good drinks here and bad drinks here. I've also gotten food warmed up fully and food that's still frozen in the middle. Seems like a hit or miss location regarding quality.

Gentleman who took my order was kind. No one greeted in or said goodbye to any customers. Barista on bar literally tossed straws at the customers in front of me. My drink (iced quad espresso with 4 pumps white mocha) was made without care, I was served dead shots. Not swirled (part of bar routine) in any way. The blonde woman on bar made this a very unpleasant experience and needs some serious coaching. I did not even want to ask for my drink to be remade or for a straw after seeing how the customers in front of me were treated.
Had a wonderful experience this morning at the drive thru. Emilee was cheerful and welcoming. Definitely a fresh of breathe air.

I like this Starbucks.
...because I like all Starbucks; they have coffee.
I won't b*tch about the dumb little parking lot at this store, because more than half of the Starbucks on earth have dumb little parking-lot issues. And I'm okay that there's no drive-thru at this store.

Yesterday (DECEMBER 3rd 10:00-ish AM) I stopped in to load some $ onto my gold card. There were four employees working, but the line moved painfully slow. One employee was mopping behind the counter instead of helping customers, and two more were in the back of the store on breaks or something. 

One employee emerged from the back and stepped into the behind-the-counter work area 
W I T H   N O   M A S K   O N - quickly wiped her nose with her right hand (I swear I'm not making this up) then put a blue disposable mask on, and put on latex gloves 
W I T H O U T   W A S H I N G    H E R   H A N D S then proceeded to start helping customers.

Then a second employee emerged from the back ALSO with no mask, then put on a mask and began helping customers. I did not see whether they washed their hands or not.

The employee who wiped her nose is small, petite, has shorter dark hair that was pulled back into a ponytail, round-framed glasses and was wearing (Dec 3) a Blackwatch plaid shirt. There was another employee who would fit the same description except she was the one mopping the floor.
