Yeah, no. Sorry Starbucks, that's a hard NOPE.

I'll continue to frequent my Starbucks on 7th & Keystone as everyone at that location is BEYOND incredibly nice and they all seem to take COVID-19 precautions very seriously.


p.s. earlier in the week I actually did order a coffee drink here - a triple shot latte. I get one of these nearly every day at other Starbucks locations so I know what the triple-shot tastes like. 
My latte had only two shots.
And that really sucks when you're poor and the extra shot is expensive.   booo

Today, my phone died unexpectedly 5 times while I was driving and I was trying to find a hotel. I saw Starbucks and decided to stop and charge my phone because it was an emergency, my family was worried and I couldn't contact them or figure out where I was. I came in to buy a drink, so that I could at least plug my phone in long enough to get a decent charge. It was literally an emergency. My car wouldn't charge my phone, so I paid for a drink and went outside to finish my coffee and wait. I left my phone inside to charge at a table since I couldn't technically sit down because of social distancing. When I went back in to get my phone and text my m that I was OKAY, the "manager", a kid who looked too young to know anything about...anything...said I couldn't be in the store anymore. I was about to order another drink but the store lost THAT sale. 

Well, I have just enough power to leave this review as I promised. I think some discretion should be used, especially if a person is willing to step outside when the device is charging and the customer has paid for a drink. Now I am stranded because some wimpy kid had a power trip.

I never write reviews but I was so absolutely impressed by my service today that I would be remiss to not to share my experience! The barista who checked me out--I unfortunately didn't ask for his name--was the nicest and most helpful person I've ever dealt with in a coffee shop! He even made me a special drink that he recommended (which was delicious by the way).

I will say I was very upset that this location didn't have the option to tip on my card. My barista went above and beyond and the staff as a whole seemed to be working hard to get people's drinks out and keep the store clean. I never carry cash with me and I wish I could have offered additional financial compensation for the exemplary work of the staff 

I will definitely be returning to this location (with cash on hand)!
Utterly ridiculous I order a Carmel frappe with extra caramel and it very much wasn't blended right and tasted straight like coffee didn't even put extra Carmel
I'm allergic to dairy. They didn't have my first non-dairy option, so I chose another. They still have me milk. This place is a lawsuit waiting to happen.

It was super busy, I'm here for a convention with my high school and it seemed like everyone in the hotel wanted something to drink. The people were very friendly. My drinks were out in no time, and they were delicious. I'm a barista and I know how difficult it is in a rush, would definitely go here again.

OPEN WEEKENDS in the city limits. 

Staff mostly friendly. 

Will often run out of food items sadly. 

Privately run so doesn't participate in many corporate promos sadly.

I place a mobile order at 11:51 am I walk in Starbucks at 12:10 and my sandwiches were ready yet there is no drinks
I told the barista and he said oh they're coming right up 
It's is 12:45 now and I'm still waiting for my coffee 
Let's see if I have to wait a full hour before my orders complete 
Definitely won't be coming back to this location

Grabbed a mocha before training this week. 

It's too easy to get a quick coffee here since it's only a stones throw from the hotel here. 

Coffees are always consistent at least.

I come to this Starbucks several times a week, mostly using the drive through but also coming inside often to work. 

The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. They seem to keep their staff--there's not a lot of turnover and constant training. The drive through is really quick. 

The amount of seating is pretty good for a smaller sized Starbucks. There's a public table in the middle where you can sit and plug in your laptop. It's pretty quiet most of the time. 

I would honesty give it five stars, but two things made me hesitate:
-This Starbucks has floor to ceiling windows on two sides, which makes it really bright and inviting. But it is SO COLD in the winter. It's difficult to work with your coat on. 
-There are a couple of regulars who come in, don't purchase anything, and sit and sleep in the chairs. They smell like they haven't showered in quite a while and the entire place starts to smell like that. I feel for them and I wouldn't want them to be put out in the cold, but sometimes it becomes really unbearable. I don't have an answer for it. It's really sad and unfortunate. Occasionally I'll buy them coffee. They're super sweet and kind. But it keeps me from holding business meetings here in the mornings. I'll choose another coffee shop nearby. 

Overall, great, fast, awesome Starbucks. One of my favorites.

Worst place ever. 

I normally go to the Starbucks on Chapel and Haddonfield Road. They have great service and exceptionally clean even while under some renovation.

The one at this location is dirty and inefficient every time I go. Today will be the last time. There are about 7 people working and yet the line seems to never go down. After waiting for 15-20 literal minutes, the girl finally takes my order and walks away half way through my order and comes back. Then I'm back to waiting another 10 minutes for my coffee to be made. When they are done I walk up after hearing my coffee order, they put it on a dirty wet countertop, no straw to be found. I go to pick it up and coffee is dripping from my cup. Unknowingly, its dripping all over my dress. 

I am absolutely displeased with the service. I understand that it can get busy but this is unacceptable and too many people behind the counter doing nothing. Training really is needed even especially if the location is new as this one is.

Ill continue to be a customer, just not at the Mt. Laurel location. Neither will I ever suggest it to anyone else.

In all of my life drinking Starbucks, I never had a more amazing drink than now. It took my mouth to a candyland with caramel fireworks! I love y'all! I ordered a caramel ribbon salt crunch frappe, but they made me something totally different that blew my mind with flavor! A burst of joy right now! It's a caramel frappe add caramel crunch and extra caramel drizzle. THANK YOU JADA FOR THE RECOMMENDATION!!

This was my first time at this location. First off, there was a long line in the drive thru, so I understand that the employees were busy. When I drove up to the speaker, I ordered my drink and a pastry. I was unsure about a specific type of pastry they carried, and asked about it. I received a very vague response from the employee about the variety. Anyways, as I drive up to the window, I am handed my pastry and my drink. I pull out my phone as my payment method and I ask about a reward on my card for a free birthday item. The male employee at the window told me I should have mentioned it beforehand. I have NEVER had an issue with this before. How would the employee have known if I actually had the reward on my card or not prior to scanning my card, right? Behind the location at the Cheshire Inn on western side of Forest Park, this is probably the most unique Starbucks in St. Louis. Service is quick, the staff are personable (even when slammed under the morning rush) and the atmosphere is a little less corporate in feel. There's little mistaking that you're in a Starbucks when you step in the door, but it's also distinctly the Central West End Starbucks.

Skim the reviews (or Google Maps) and you'll find just about all that you need to know for a great visit to this walkable store.

There's no dedicated parking lot or pickup spot, but there a few sturdier places to lock up a bike on the block. (Drivers do have options though. There's a public garage above the Schlafly Library on Euclid and metered parking along the street. Free street parking is often available to the east of the shop on Maryland Ave and there's a paid parking lot across the street too).

There's no drive-thru, but mobile orders are usually accepted. The location isn't that large, but does have a good mix of semi-communal seating, small tables, sidewalk seating and a couple of more comfortable chairs.

If there's really any complaint with the store, it's the minor irritation of its tendency to sell out of products, whether it's Blonde Roast, breakfast sandwiches or Nitro Cold Brew (each of which have been unavailable at least once during my random stops in over the past year). I've never had that affect an app order but, if you have your mind set on a particular item, it's probably best to order ahead.

Located in the historic Jefferson Building, this is a rather unique Philadelphia Starbucks located on the Thomas Jefferson University campus. It's quite spacious inside, with plenty of tables for folks to study and mingle.  Being halfway below ground level, its gorgeous brick-walled foundation keep it rather cool inside. For some reason I'm trying to recall if there was a somewhat musty smell in here or not, but my recollection may be wrong and I'll have to revisit to verify.

My first visit here went very well, about a year ago, when they made my Frappuccino with perfection. My second visit (today) did not go nearly as well, as I dock the score because I have experienced something similar to that of other reviewers here:

Today's barista (blond with long, braided, pony-tails) turned my Frappuccino from a frozen treat to that akin to cold soup: it was very liquidy - which signifies that she did not use enough ice. Further, she put a flat-top lid on it and mashed down the whipped cream; whereas the drink calls for a domed lid. Maybe she thought she could get away with a flat-top lid because she didn't use enough ice and the drink was notably lower than filled the brim of the cup.

A Frappuccino should be filled to the brim with frozen liquid, the whipped cream should spearhead the top of the drink, and a domed lid should be used as to not suffocate the head of whipped cream!

When I pointed that out, she merely turned around to acknowledge my call for her, while a nearby employee came in for the save by replacing my cup with a domed lid. Had this location been out of domed lids, I'd have better understood; but clearly this was not the case. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ 

So now I have a 50/50 positive/negative view of this place - which bears out in my score. I typically order my Frappuccino regularly from a place closer to where I work, and they rarely have ever messed up the expectations of a Frappuccino (as well they shouldn't, as they are NOT cheap drinks)! Perhaps in the future I can adjust this review, if I am able to stop by and have drinks made properly.8

The chestnut hill Starbucks is literally the most sad  Starbucks I have ever been in. It got two stars for its location which is amazing but that just makes it even worse the attitude of the employees and the atmosphere that creates. 
If Disney Land is the happiest place on earth, the Chestnut Hill Starbucks is the polar opposite of that place. 
Every time we come in here most of the employees are either having a really bad day ALL THE TIME or they are just in a constant state of annoyance at their career choice. This does not apply to all the employees, there are a couple that always have a smile on their face no matter what and they are cheerful which makes ur day and ur coffee even better. But the majority of the employees here roll their eyes at customers, ignore customers, talk under their breath (news flash WE CAN HEAR U!!), & treat customers and fellow employees with disrespect and outright rudeness. This isn't acceptable. I've worked at starbucks, it was a fun job and easy going so maybe they just chose the wrong place to work. 
Either way, I'll come here for the convenience but I swear it's getting harder to hold my tongue at this location.

This Starbucks is always low on stock. The service is always terrible and slow. There is always this employee that is taking my order but never lets me finish before she cuts me off. Have I mentioned that my coffee never tastes right? I usually have to end up walking back inside to have my drink order fixed.
This place is ridiculous. 5 people waiting for drinks. No one can sit down because they have these ridiculous Covid signs over all the tables. What a terrible customer experience.

New to Plainfield and one to normally write about bad customer service but the Plainfield location has been nothing but a disappointment!  Even after several visits.  I could just be spoiled from the Avon and Speedway locations, but the customer service by far has been the worst experience ever!  No issues with the food and just for the simple fact that it's Starbucks, I have no issue with the wait time. But the barista at the window does not acknowledge the wait time and is extremely rude and unprofessional.  Done with Starbucks in Plainfield!

You might want to rethink who manages this location and the team that works at this location. 
Worst Starbucks I've ever been to!!!!!!!!

I had to wait a long time for my drink while they stood around and talked to one another. There was only one young lady who was working to get hot drinks out and one working the cash register. The others were just walking around like they didn't have a care in the world. There were 6-7 workers behind the counter and 3 customers waiting on drinks. In an airport they need to pick up the pace! We have flights to catch and don't have time to wait on them to talk and then ask how to make the drinks. Train them so they know how to do the job. ThIs is a first for Starbucks....at least for me.....Buuttttt the drink was good! Lol

Definitely one of the bigger Starbucks locations in the area. There's a lot of open space and plenty of tables for meeting up with friends or getting work done. The back of the store does get a little dark though but there's tons of light towards the front.

The location is very well staffed and the staff is knowledgeable and friendly, even given how busy they are. The drive-thru seems especially busy at this location. Parking is also plentiful should you decide to stop inside.

Bathrooms are clean and the air is cool. I haven't had any problems with any of the drinks I've had here but then again I just drink black iced coffee or cold brew which is kind of hard to mess up. 

This is a very good Starbucks in my book.

I used to go to this Starbucks every morning for a couple of years. I have to say that their customer service is lacking in the extreme. When I walk in at 5:30 am to get my morning coffee, on the way to my job, I expect to grab the coffee and leave fairly quickly. Do not expect anything to be quick at this establishment. many times,...sometimes 3 or 4 times in a week....they have been out of coffee and I have had to wait for them to brew it.....AT 5:30 IN THE MORNING!!! I have to say that I am a coffee drinker....not a frappachino or a latte or whatever else people drink...just coffee. If that describes you as well, then don't come here. They make most of their money...at least it appears to me....from all the other items on the menu, other then coffee. It is obviously not their priority. I have since left this place for Southside Coffee Shop. They are open at 5:30 am. Their service is quick and their coffee is their coffee is good.
Employees are friendly and service great but this location runs out of many food items on a daily basis, often early in the day.  Ordering more seems to be an alien concept.

I have been visiting this Starbucks now for about
3 years due to my location of work. As you would figure I have become a familiar face and so have some of the workers. I have not had a bad experience and don't believe I will. Clark and Ali are two of the people who remember me all the time and remember my drink orders.  The customer service they provide goes well and above what they have to do.
Their store hours are incorrect. It is 4:48pm and they are closed on a Tuesday. Even though the website and store says 8:00pm.
If you're using a gift card, make sure you ask for it back!

Coffee and a drive-thru? Yes please! Need somewhere because baby fell asleep in the car and you need to kill time? I'm here! Haha.  What did I get this time? A cookie crumble frap! Doesn't need any explanation, right?  My go to is a chai tea latte, but hey this mama can live little, right? Come here and enjoy the perks of staying in your car!

Gotta love drive-thru coffee. 

Santa Barbara and Goleta aren't fond of drive-thru establishments and the majority of the existing configurations have been grandfathered in. This particular "Noleta" location is not considered to be within either of the cities' limits so I assume that the permitting was easier to obtain. Either way, I enjoy this. 

The building is new and modern and the drive-thru can accommodate a good number of vehicles. That said, you'll see lines out into the roadway on a busy morning. For those sorts of instances, it'd honestly be more efficient to walk indoors and order. 

I don't order Starbucks often but when I do, I make sure to utilize their app. Each purchase accrues points which may be redeemed for freebies like a pastry or an add-on to your beverage. 

My advice: come here during an off-time when the drive-thru queue isn't a chaotic scene. Either way, you're guaranteed good service and good coffee.

Seems like a nice place, never actually sat down to finish my coffee, but the guys were pleasant to deal with. On time, they were little late on my order (about 6-8 minutes), and they gave me a free cup of coffee card for the waiting even though I haven't even asked for it. So, my experience was more than satisfactory.

I must say I am pretty disappointed with this Starbucks. Now I know Starbucks pretty much despises tea drinkers, the simple fact is... they sell it. And when a business sells something, I typically expect that place to re-stock as need be. 

Unfortunately, for the past 3 weeks, this Starbucks has been out of English breakfast tea and earl grey tea. Today, I asked the barista when they were expecting to get more and she said said tomorrow... Funny thing is, I asked the same thing a week ago. I then turned around and looked on the shelves where they sell items, and what do you know, there was two boxes of English breakfast tea.  Strange. I just find it a bit ridiculous, because you know if they were out of a certain kind of coffee, it would be on order immediately and back in the shop the next day.... 

The baristas are hit or miss. Some are super and some just down right grumpy and rude...

Stopped by this place on the way home, and its so incredibly beautiful inside. In addition to all the furniture being brand new, the layout and spacing is perfect. It was cool to see the community room with a sink, although I'm not entirely sure how to reserve or use it.

The staff was super friendly and my drink came out fast. Definitely try the Nitro Cold Brew if you get a chance. Not sure if it will be a regular order of mine, but it was cool to try. There is also plenty of outdoor seating and a drive-thru, so I will definitely be back.

8/10. 

Totally fine Starbucks.

Not too busy when I went. Drinks were well made and egg bites were good. 

They were out of a few things like lemonades and cranberry bliss bar dessert for the season, but probably not this location's fault.

I wanted an salted Caramel Iced Coffee with almond milk. The  cashier said they could do an iced coffee with salted caramel syrup on top because the syrup had mocha toffee all combined for this season. Instead they made it with the syrup inside. It was a chocolatey mess and I don't like chocolate. She said she just made it according to the recipe which is 4 pumps. My order was made wrong. Which is my first time ever happening at a Starbucks. I don't know if he was knew but he definitely wasn't listening to my order when he put it in because he asked if i wanted cream, after I said almond milk to begin with

This is without a doubt the best local Starbucks in Lutz. The baristas are extremely friendly and thorough. They make sure to get your drink just the way you like it - which is nothing new for Starbucks, but each barista makes it a point to get to know you as a customer and as a member of the community.
    The management and the baristas are amazing at this location. They make it a point to get to know you and almost befriend you ( but not in a smarmy way). 
     The work is quality in any of their drinks and it is always served in a friendly manner. In short they are the best.

I saw the reviews AFTER I ordered and thought, oh it can't be that bad, can it? Yes, it can be. The cashier was super nice, but my iced americano was room temperature with a few pieces of ice floating in it and too much water. It reminded me of that time I tried to go to a Starbucks overseas and no one knew what an iced coffee was. Not to mention, when I asked for room, they basically left an entire quarter of the cup empty. I'm not going to drink a quarter cup of half and half, ya'll! I'm also pretty sure they are not cleaning the espresso machine properly because the espresso shots taste like old, rancid oils. Weirder still, they don't have a full menu up, and there are NO pastries in the case. They have no ads up for seasonal, specialty drinks.
PS: Wound up throwing my nasty coffee is the garbage.  Any place that makes coffee like that isn't gonna be able to fix it a second time around.

This location is often sold out of many food items even early in the day. When asked if they could order more food the response was " popular items sell out fast and there is nothing we can do about it". WTF?  Other locations don't seem to suffer from this poor management.  Avoid this location if you are hungry
This location was fast and friendly service, could not complain. The coffee was on point. My favorite is the (warmed) blueberry muffin that pairs perfectly with an iced caramel macchiato.

We walked over from Renown hospital yesterday. Upon our arrival there were a few people in their lobby area not too crowded which was nice. Plenty of places to sit available but they were all dirty I couldn't find one clean place to sit the tables and chairs looked like they hadn't been wiped down for days! Looked like there were 5 to 6 employees working behind the counter. Then I noticed the glass near the area to pick up your drinks it was filthy, spots all over just gross! I agree with other people this location has always taken forever in their drive thru. They need to clean better! Also there were plenty of flies all around! Worst Starbucks I have ever been to. If I could have chosen 0 stars I would have.

Sorry we don't sell muffins anymore. 

What about that one in the case? 

Well it's been there for awhile. 

Also is it ok if we can't heat things up? 

I mean WTF? Get your act together man. How hard can it be to meet the minimum standard of a Starbucks?

We are on vacation and have tried to get simple coffees here on several occasions at various times of the day, all to no avail.  There is absolutely ZERO customer service.  There is absolutely ZERO sense of urgency.  They simply don't care.....at all!! What did we do?  We walked across the street to the Dunkin' Donuts and were served immediately.  Don't waste your vacation patience here...get your coffee across the street.
When the free Monday Holiday Treat didn't come off my bill the barista went to fix it, He said my whole bill was on them. I love when they're so kind to their customers.

I know this place just opened but WHOA. ROUGH.

Usually I go to the one on the other side of the freeway on my way to the dog park and while they sadly run out of the sandwich I want pretty frequently, the coffee is consistent and the service is as well.

Here, the dude who took my order was friendly over the speaker but didn't say a word to me at the window. I ordered a dirty chai with oat milk.... There was certainly no chai, almost positive it was almond milk and quite possibly the worst latte I've ever consumed. I also ordered my friend a regular chai with soy milk, which was also almost flavorless and hardly hot. We met at the dog park and discussed our disappointment. She was cold so she drank hers anyway while I left mine in the car. 

After I left the dog park, because yes that came first, I brought back my full coffee to get a new one. The what I'm guessing was a supervisor seemed really overwhelmed and was out loud talking about how frustrated she was with being understaffed while trying to make drinks and train a newer staff. 

The coffee she made me was watered down and they clearly are not using the same amount of chai I get at any other Starbucks when ordering the exact same drink. 

All im saying is if you're having a rough time staffing your already open locations, maybe hold off on opening this new one? And certainly get in there and train more. We go to Starbucks to get the same coffee that we expect regardless of where we are. Super disappointing experience.

I don't go to Starbucks for the coffee. Whaaaat? Yep. Caffeine makes me jittery, but the Cheese & Fruit Bistro Box is the bomb! Their sandwiches are pretty tasty, too.

The Bistro Box is stocked with a nice portion of Brie, Gouda, two-year aged Cheddar cheeses, nine-grain crackers, apples, dried cranberries and roasted almonds. It's a nice blend of crunch and freshness and #cheese.

You can't go wrong with the Roasted Tomato & Mozzarella Panini either: roma tomato, mozzarella, spinach and basil pesto on a piccolo roll.

They also carry my fave boxed Horizon chocolate milk, though it comes with a steep $2.50 price tag.

While at Cherry Hill Mall I just had to have a pastry from Starbucks. I chose the lemon iced cake. It was a HUGE piece that ran about $3.50 & it was yummy!! The staff was very nice as well. Now this is in a small section by the entrance but it was easy to navigate. It was clean & tidy as well. No coffee this time but I'll be back for sure!!!

I am so impressed by this Starbucks. Not only is my drink delicious every time, unlike many Starbucks I've been to, the baristas really take the time to get to know you and treat you like a friend. I wish this Starbucks was a little closer to my house. If it was, I'd be there everyday.

What a great Starbucks! Usually I go through the drive thru, and they got that down to a science, always super quick!

The other day, my wifi was down at home, so I decided to come in here and get some work done until it was repaired. I ordered a pumpkin nitro cold brew with sugar free vanilla and it was fantastic. Also had some bacon and gruyere egg bites, they are drool worthy! The employees are just as friendly to everyone inside as they are to you in the drive thru. I sat there for hours and heard them greet almost everyone coming in, "Good morning how are you! Welcome!" The wifi was super fast there too. Its such a great location to focus on your work that they've convinced me to return and work from there some more. Definitely recommend!

This airport Starbucks although pretty to see have the most limited option for product selections. They have only a few drink container. For someone who been going around and don't have time to stop at a Starbucks to get a souvenir mug, this is awfully disappointing because I been to crappier airport Starbucks with wide range of selection. 

I want to write this review in hopes that they will read it and that they will increase in their selections.  

Other than that, there's not much difference in airport Starbucks. Just disappointing souvenir/product selections.

Awesome place for coffee! You'd think that such a massive corporation like Starbucks would generic, McDonalds-like service, but they treat you like you're their only customer which is one of those things that makes you wonder why most places don't act like that?

Idk where all this "terrible service" is coming from, it's literally the main reason I go there. I even got a free coffee because the barista thought my joke was really clever and told me to put my money away.

If you like coffee and a cavalier atmosphere this a great place. If you think they purposely put "Isis" instead of "Aziz" because they're "racist" or "intolerant" then you're ignorant it was CLEARLY an accident.

Someone was kind enough to spend their money buying me a Starbucks gift card so all I ask is that my drink be made correctly. Apparently, this location does not comprehend the value of a correctly made Starbucks drink. I ordered a tall blonde vanilla latte, hot. The first time, they made my latte iced. The second time, they made my latte with regular espresso instead of blonde espresso, and then had the audacity to get an attitude with me because I asked for my drink to be made correctly twice. 
I also wanted a reduced fat turkey bacon sandwich. I was told that they were out of breakfast sandwiches, but someone in line after me ordered a ham and cheese croissant. I politely brought it up to the barista that I thought they were out of breakfast sandwiches as per what I was told, to which she then replied that they were out of breakfast sandwiches so I asked if you're out of breakfast sandwiches why is the person behind me getting a ham and cheese croissant isn't it considered a breakfast sandwich? Then I asked, why is it that a reduced fat turkey bacon sandwich is considered a breakfast sandwich but the ham and cheese croissant is not, to which the barista reply that she doesn't know and that whether or not the turkey bacon sandwich is considered a breakfast sandwich depends on who you ask. Then she had the audacity to get an attitude with me yet again saying that regardless they were just out of the sandwich.
Hi definitely do not recommend this location of Starbucks because of the rude Barista's, and the horrible communication that takes place. Save your money and buy Starbucks coffee beans from your local grocers or go to one of the licensed locations like the one in the Hyatt regency on Perdido. They have great customer service, make great drinks, and have much better communication skills.

Not my favorite Starbucks. Small store but due to location in Carrollwood it's always crowded.  There are a bunch of outdoor tables making this location ideal for a relaxing sip with a friend on a nice day. This location is in shopping center so there is no drive through. The take along food selection at this location is smaller than most. They used to have the quinoa lunches which I loved but no longer carry those.

One of my favorite Starbucks for on-the-go coffee, certainly not for doing work. Not sure if there is any seating at all. However, because it's a little hidden in the Bellevue there's never a line and they've never messed up my order or anything. One of my free drink voucher thingies was expired and she was nice enough to still take it! 

Taking a star away though because coffee shops should have some area to meet up and chit chat or do work I think.

This is a great Spot for hanging out with friends or homework or to get some work done. Sometimes if it's too loud I just go outside. The WiFi will still work to our on the patio. Great atmosphere here too!

New location that recently opened. Convenient entrance and exit. Drive thru available. They have seating outside and inside and appeared to be available since I saw folks sitting on the patio. I went thru drive thru and was a breeze. Drink tasted great, friendly staff!

Do not go to this Starbucks. I've been here several times and EVERY time I've went they ALWAYS Mess up my drink. I am very specific with my drink and i always get the same thing. Somehow they always seem to get it wrong. Once I received a drink that was a legit just warm milk. Not what I ordered! Then, another time the top of my drink was caked with whipped cream and Carmel that I couldn't even drink the rest of my hot drink. The staff here always act like they know what they are doing, but they don't! They'll also ask u to repeat four order so many times and still get it wrong! I will no longer be  returning.

Excellent Starbucks with an excellent staff. This is an extremely busy 'Bucks that manages to maintain Starbucks quality at an incredible pace. Order on your Starbucks app, park on the far side,  and walk in to get your order. It will save you 10-20 minutes of waiting compared to sitting in the drive through line.

Too bad because this location is so close, but they continue to make mistakes on my order ... and it's not that hard, but they go too fast, even when there is no line behind in the drive thru, or parking lot not buzzin.   I heard they had a new manager, but still very bad with mistakes after she took over in recent months.  I drive 5 minutes away to Broadway to get an accurate order.  Not my neighborhood coffee place anymore.  Too bad.  Get with it Boise Avenue!
I was having a pretty terrible day got some awful news and SOMEHOW the workers here managed to have me leaving with a smile... Driving away I was a little speechless but in a good way! Thanks!

This location only provides drive thru service. The Starbucks app states drive thru and in store service for this location. You can imagine my frustration when I walked about 1.2 miles from my hotel, looking forward to a warm venti coffee and a chance to earn some stars, and the in store was closed. 

Granted, I was planning on getting in a nice walk today, but it would have been great to know ahead of time that this Starbucks was limited in service. So I guess the one star is for the local person who decided to close the Cafe and not coordinate that with corporate.

This Starbucks is always super busy but they always do a great job. Today we ordered two Frappuccino's they accidentally made one of the drinks hot but gave us the hot one and made us a cold one as well so we ended up getting three drinks and the one they remade actually was given to us as a venti. All around great job with kind people
The slowest Starbucks on the planet. I watched grass grow while in the drive thru line.

Great location and great service levels. Huge store with lots of seating and very large patio also. Wish more locations modeled their size similar to this one as there is never enough seating at most of the stores.

No real complaints but it isn't one of the 'best' with awesome baristas.
The baristas are pretty nice. There are always a ton of people in here, like another reviewer said- if you're looking to study good luck. It can be sporadic with the amount of people sitting and usually the counter is free to sit. There's always a line and it's awkward depending on what door you come through and where the line is. 

It is a little disorganized with seating arrangements and where things are. Service can be slow because it is so busy but I guess that's expected, but still annoying. They don't always call out your name for your drink so sometimes you have to really pay attention to what you got and who was in front/behind you to know when your drink is going to be ready.

Lots of parking is a plus.
Not a bad Starbucks, it's got good chai lattes so I'm a happy camper.

I don't drink coffee but occasionally visit Starbucks for other items.

I paid more than six bucks for a Strawberry Acai Lemonade Refresher at this location and after a few sips through the straw, I started getting air.  It turned out that the glass was about 80% ice (see photo).  What a rip-off!

I had a better experience when I ordered hot chocolate.

I came to the Starbucks one fine day and I treat myself once maybe every two weeks to Starbucks and I just like a pour over coffee dark roast cream and flavor.. The guy took my order and then turned around to make my coffee which had already been made no fucking way up or over could've been done in a short amount of time... and I don't know who the lady was but I was standing there watching the whole thing and she told him don't worry about it and give me the coffee... if you drink a pour over and dark roast coffee you like a specific taste and Coffee so for her to do that in front of me I would never go back to the Starbucks.. This Starbucks has issues with steaming the milk. my coffee is never taste good from this location

This is a very convenient location and close to the Selmon and I-75 on/off ramps. The staff has always been very friendly for all of my drive thru and inside orders. Yes, the wait time can be rather extensive, and understandably so. For the most part everyone is ordering a craft beverage of some sort, not to mention perhaps a suit item so the way is to be expected. If you're looking for a quick experience this is not the place and I would suggest getting your coffee elsewhere so you're not stuck in the drive thru lane filled with regret. 

This location does have one detrimental flaw and that is the drive-through lane. It wraps around the building and parking spaces making it difficult for people to reverse out and leave. It is not always crazy busy and we have had some good luck with short wait times on weekend mornings. Pro tip: Treat the employees with respect and kindness, do you never know what they are going through that day!

This is a fine Starbucks near the roundabout, north side.  It's not clear once inside if there is a pattern to getting to the order register, people approached from both sides, making it confusing.  Barista (male) was more attentive and social with his compadre employees than giving good service to the customers.  Glad he was wearing a mask but hard to understand him.  Drink was made relatively quickly but thrown to the window without announcing the name.  (Glad I was paying attention.)  Product (skinny vanilla iced latte) was consistently good as always.  Service attentiveness and confusing wait area kept this from 5 stars.  Drink was over $5 here and under $4 elsewhere.
This is a Great Starbucks, the barista answered a few questions about different items on the menu and my Wife and I we're very happy with our choices!

Slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. There was one person ahead of me and maybe 3 or 4 after me. All I ordered was a cold brew and somehow I was in there for 15 minutes. I understand that the drive thru might be busy but there were at least 5 of them behind the counter. Baristas were slow moving and not very efficient. It didn't seem like anyone had a certain station, they were all over the place. I also tried to do the "order ahead" option the following day and for some reason, the app said this location wasn't taking those orders.

I love this location! Every time I order my drink taste the same... I wish I could say all other locations were this consistent. All of the employees are are very nice and helpful especially Toni. She's the best! Looks like she could run this place with her eyes closed. If she's not a manager she should be. I'd say she's art if the reason I like this location so much.

I have been to this Starbucks on several occasions and have not had very good customer service. Maybe it is because I am going thru the drive thru? 

I always feels like I am annoying them or they are doing me some huge favor.  My drink was consistent with other Starbucks and service was done in a timely manner.
Yum! I tried the blended strawberry lemonade with a pump of raspberry. I got a medium which was a little over 6$ I would recommend a small

Its Starbucks- what do you expect? Consistency. 
Well it was serviceable for us- however the drinks were not consistent.
Hubby ordered a cappuccino that had NO foam- I insisted he say something.
My lattes were ok- I asked for extra foam and instead got extra hot.
Oh well, staff is super nice.
Start off your day with a coffee and a penny slot!

It's super nice having another Starbucks on the other side of the highway as it cuts down on time when I'm south of I-80. Love the location! 

Unfortunately, when it comes to the food & beverages it's a different story. I've gone in several days in a row since they have opened and have had nothing but problems. 

To start, I ordered a decaf drink, which was not made as decaf. I have a caffeine sensitivity that causes heart issues for me so after drinking my beverage, I experienced an extremely high heart rate for the better part of two hours.

I've also ordered white mocha hot chocolates a couple times and received the white mochas with coffee instead. Luckily I can taste the difference when coffee is in a drink, so I was able to avoid any caffeine effects on my heart, but nonetheless still disappointing. 

In regard to the taste and make of the beverages themselves, I've also been pretty disappointed. Any drink containing syrup and milk tends to only taste like milk, so I'm unsure if the proper proportions of each ingredient are being used or if the recipes are being followed correctly. I also believe there is something wrong with their nitrogen when it comes to the nitro cold brew. More than half of the cup ends up being foam, even after the drink settles. The amount of cold brew I receive in a grande is not even enough to fill up a tall cup.

Lastly, I've noticed that when I ask for extra caramel drizzle, they are only using as much as a normal order and not coating the cup/drink in the necessary places. There has been several times where I will ask for cinnamon to be steamed into milk and it is not being done, the taste difference is something you can't miss on that nonetheless watching the baristas, so customizations aren't always being followed. I've also ordered food several times only to receive the incorrect item. Just this morning, I ordered a double smoked bacon sandwich with no egg, only to receive an impossible sandwich. 

While the customer service is great and everyone is friendly, I question if the baristas have received enough/proper training. I'm in a bit of a rut because I desperately want to shop at this location frequently, as the location is convenient and the store itself is absolutely beautiful and very well kept and clean; however, it becomes stressful worrying about my health when it comes to receiving non-decaf when asking for decaf. It's also such a let down for the place to be as inconsistent as it is. I can understand that things happen, but the same issues occurring again and again every visit cannot be a coincidence. I don't feel comfortable spending $15 on breakfast or lunch, knowing that it will have some issue, and I will not always have the time to flag down an employee for a drink or food remake. 

This place has amazing potential, but there's definitely some kinks that need to be worked out. I will probably spend the extra time to drive to the Starbucks on the other side of the highway as I know the small amount of wait time will be worth knowing I'm receiving food and beverage to the Starbucks standard we all know and love.

You know how women always make jokes about how men are extremely sexually unsatisfying in the bedroom? Well, let's just say Starbucks is a man and I'm his woman.

It started out one morning as a beautiful and fantastical idea - maybe even kinky. Go to Starbucks, enjoy a nice hot cup of coffee and slob on some spectacular oatmeal. Sadly, this fantasy was never realized.

As I pulled into the drive thru, I glanced begrudgingly at the seemingly endless queue of cars lining the asphalt covered pavement. Although the thought of waiting in this line seemed almost as pressing as waiting for the universe to end, I decided that maybe the coffee would be worth it. Spoiler alert: Twasn't. 

My tires squeaked as they fought with the pavement leading to the drive thru speaker:

"I would like an Oat Milk Latte please, no foam - and make that unsweetened."

Like songs from a siren, these simple words floated effortlessly from my mouth. However, I had to repeat myself multiple times. I felt as though I was screaming at a brick wall. Eventually, my order was completed and I was able to get through to the worker: now to wait the rest of the way.

I graciously drove my vehicle to the drive thru window:

"Apple Pay?"

The worker asked, to which I replied:

"Yes."

I paid for my (or so I thought) delicious order. However, as soon as my iPhone 12 Plus grazed the very last atoms of the card reader, I was handed a drink - but not mine. Confused, shocked, concerned, and unsettled, I begged for the coffee I so struggled to order.

After another order confirmation (one of trillions), I finally received my latte. Delight! Cream! Delish! WRONG! WRONG! My hastiness got the better of me. As I pulled away from this establishment, I noticed a few things about my drink.

1) There seemed to be foam.
2) I was unsure if it was even oat milk.
3) It didn't bring me pure ecstasy and joy.

This was truly a devastating blow to my ego. Upset and belittled, I chose to move on and order my coffee elsewhere. At the end of the day, I learned a lesson. To never come back to this Starbucks. Have a wonderful evening.

Baristas here always have an awesome attitude. And obviously care about the drink quality. Never had a bad experience here. And drive thur is crazy fast. Love love love this location!!!

This Starbucks is inside of the Target in Town and Country. I was pleased with the service that I received, but I was disappointed that this location does not have breakfast sandwiches. That was the whole point of why I came here before work last week. I was devastated, but my mocha Frappuccino was still delightful.
Great drinks, great service, super over priced cup of hot coco. How does a cup of hot coco cost almost $5. Silly me, it's Starbucks.

I stopped in here for an afternoon caffeine refuel after my delicious dog at Frankly Gourmet.  The guy running the register was having some sort of problem - and needed a managers assistance. He appeared to be agitated about all of this. So he called over some help to a second register - the girl that came over seemed annoyed about being called to work the register - but I will note that she was polite, thorough, and professional in her interactions with me and the other customers.

It was my turn next in line, and then this little old lady comes waltzing right in - into the line right in front of me to place her order. The cashier made eye contact with me - I shrugged - indicating to go ahead. I guess that when some people get to a certain age - situational awareness goes right out the window. So I was willing to cut her some slack because of that.

When it was my turn, the cashier apologized for that - I smiled and told her not to worry about it - it's okay.

I ordered a Triple Grande iced latte.  Looking at the managers nametag - I noted that the manager's first name was the same as my last name - so we had a brief discussion about the shared uniqueness of her first name and my last name.

Drink was strong and good - just what my eyeballs and brain cells needed!
This place sucks. But no one else is open this early for study time. Loud music. Loud employees. Lousy coffee.

This Starbucks saved me a few times while I stayed in Isla Vista.  When I'm on a caffeine binge, Starbucks is normally my addiction of choice.  Now, add to it the fact I hate trying to park in this area and I loathe having to maneuver around people in the streets.  When you mix that with my caffeine addiction, you can imagine me waking up and cringing until I stumble into Starbucks to get my fix.  

In any regards, this is an alright Starbucks.  It has a very Isla Vista charm to it that is somehow magically blended with a Starbucks atmosphere.  The cafe is usually clean and the staff is very friendly.  Do be aware they don't have a oven to heat up pastries, which is sad, but it's still a good cafe at which to sit and relax.

*WiFi hotspot (TMobile)
Awful. The Starbucks across from C18 in the American Airlines concourse. If Pat is working alone she refuses to heat up sandwiches because "they get on her nerves"

I have to write a rebuttal to my previous post.  I have been there a few times since my last entry.  The service has been quite well and every drink that I have ordered has been very good and consistent.  My daughter has now found her favorite drink as well it is a bubblegum Frappuccino Just let them know it has the raspberry base if they ask.

Not up to the high standards of service that most Starbucks are know for. I ordered a triple grande caramel mach and when I got it, it felt like only two thirds full.  I was in a hurry so I didn't complain as I should have.   

As I was leaving I stopped to go to the restroom and a pregnant young woman coming out warned me there was no toilet paper.  I went into the other restroom and it was also out of paper and dirty.  Very disconcerting.

This Starbucks is always slow. Long drive through line that crawls and even in the store the staff is slow and unmotivated.  I have been at the drive thru window and heard them talking rudely about customers and staff. They seem super catty and not motivated by customer service at all.

Although the baristas at this location are slow, I go anyways because I enjoy a good Starbucks coffee. However, just recently I stopped in because I had a coupon for a free drink and didn't have my wallet. I showed her my coupon and of course I needed my rewards card to scan. I didn't think it would be a problem because I literally know the barista from going there every day. However, she discarded my already made beverage sitting in front of me and told me a monotoned 'sorry.' Not very courteous at all. I felt really dumb for thinking they would help a loyal customer out. I'll go to Dunkin next time. Their customer service has gone out of the window and their wait time stinks anyways.

Convenient place to get a drink, because I live nearby, but I wouldn't recommend sitting in and having your drink there. It's a place where sketchy people hangout at times. Because of its proximity to the highway, transients and drug addicts will use the bathroom to shoot up, I saw it first hand the other day as I was having a drink there while waiting for my laundry to finish at Modern Laundry. Just a place to get a drink, not to hang.

This SB is cramped but cool. They made this space standard and mainstream. I understand it, I just don't like it. 

The staff was cool and funny. They knew their customers by name.They also played into the names for our cups. Batman and Robin. Fabulous.

We'll be back soon.

Their ice machine was broken so I couldn't order an iced coffee. Service was quick, though, after I decided on a hot beverage. Condiments/extras were well-stocked, although counter space was limited. The hot coffee I settled on was very good. No consolation for the unavailable iced coffee.

Can't go wrong with Starbucks! I personally love being able to go in somewhere and get a consistent cup of coffee at any time. What I don't like about this place is that I go in to this Starbucks 3-4 times a week and order the same exact thing and no one ever seems to remember what I get. Most of the time I have the SAME person at the register and they can't remember my drink or my name, which is on my gold card. Sad lack of customer service considering I'm spending as much money as I am. Great cup of coffee, sad lack of customer service.
I do like however the sitting area both inside and outside. It makes it nice to relax and watch people or sit outside and enjoy some weather before it gets unbearably hot. Plus it has free WIFI which is always a nice plus.

I've only ever had one problem at this location, and it was quickly fixed once I brought it to the attention of the manager.    The way this store is situated makes it a bit inconvenient for a quick drive thru visit, but the staff are accommodating and the coffee is great!

Typically go here but today a terrible experience.  Ordered 3 drinks all wrong. Simple tea and kids coconut Milk. The girls working need to understand food allergies and ensure when someone orders a coconut milk to make sure it's not regular milk used- my daughter is intolerant- infuriated.

Great location and very spacious. Well functioning Wi-Fi and friendly staff, now dressed us as reindeer. You can get your typical Starbucks drink or spoil yourself with a bit overpriced lunch food. Conveniently located next to plaza Frontenac. Perfectly suitable for business meeting, working or spending time with friends or family.  Some needs for improvement are overflowing trashcans and speed of baristas or they may be understaffed at times.

Funky location at a fork in the road. Hard to get into this location if you're on Curlew coming from McMullen booth to Tampa rd. You would either need to make a U-turn on Tampa then make a left turn OR turn left into the Dollar Tree / Marshall's parking lot, drive down to the Tampa rd side then turn right onto Tampa rd and turn an immediate right into the Starbucks parking lot. If you're coming from Hillsborough to Tampa Rd or Curlew it's fine.

Now that I think of it...I don't know if I've ever been to a Starbucks drive thru that was "normal." 

When I have an early Dr. Appt in Clearwater I come here on my way home as I'm usually rushing to get to a scheduled conference call or I'm just too lazy to park and get out that early in the morning.

This location is not as much of a hassle as the one on Memorial & Hillsborough, but it shares a parking lot with a Panera Bread and has the potential of getting congested. 

The baristas at the window are nice enough and I've only had luke warm mochas from here once in a while. Today my Toffee Nut Mocha was nice and hot! I'm not sure who used to supply Starbucks pastries, but I've never been a huge fan of the pastries because they are usually to rich and they linger with the taste of preservatives. Recently Starbucks just started carrying this line of French pastries that they call 'La Boulange' which includes a chocolate croissant. I get it hot, so although it's good, it's deflated the way that microwaves deflate pastries.

I stood in line and the cashier told me he'd be right with me. Stood there for a good 5-7 minutes while he was making drinks and the other cashier just looked at me like I was none of her business. Just walked out of line and ended up getting nothing. Great service!

I love Starbucks but this location has horrible service! I walked in with my husband one day and went to the counter and 3 employees just walk by us and completely ignore us. There we're no customers except for us so they weren't doing anything but we literally stood there for a few minutes being ignored by the 3 young girls working behind the counter. I was very surprised to get that kind of service at a Starbucks. I will not come back to this location.

This is my favorite Starbucks! The baristas are always friendly, happy and quick with my order. My drink is always made right, no complaints here. Special thank you to these baristas: Kia, Brianna, David, KG (?) and Sarah. :) They do a fantastic job and have excellent skills.

I don't know where to start... I worked at a Starbucks years ago so I know first hand how difficult it is to keep up with a big crowd, especially if you're a new employee but something is just not working here. 

Although this is the closest Starbucks to my house, I try to avoid it. I can say with confidence I have never had a quick visit to this Starbucks, even if I'm the only one there. In fact, multiple times I have waited in the drive thru 20-45 minutes before receiving my drink. Again, I feel bad because I KNOW this job is not easy but the wait times and the amount of times my drink was made incorrectly or not filled to the top is a little ridiculous. If I'm paying over $5 for a small drink I would like it to be more than 3/4 full (I realize I get lattes but the foam is not even filled up to the top). I took away 3 stars for these three reasons. I'm sure the managers know their wait times are an issue so I just wish they could figure out a way to speed things up!

I do give the staff credit but they are always very nice and apologetic about the wait times or messed up drinks and typically if you go inside the wait is not as long, but I can't get over how many frustrating experiences I've had.
My go to coffee spot in isla vista. The employee were super nice and all had smiles on their faces. Great place to study also! 10/10 recommend

This Starbucks is the slowest in clearing airport lines. I've been flying through BNA and using this location since it opened years ago. Now, unless you have 20+ minutes to wait, do not stop here. Time to move on to other options.

Stayed at the nearby Sheraton for a couple of days - so I hit this Starbucks multiple times! Had several cups of dark roast coffee, plus a dopio espresso Machiatto. Everything was strong and tasty! Service was good!

This is one of the largest Starbucks I've ever seen. There is a plethora of seating!

Multiple tries. I have given this Starbucks multiple tries now, and each time I think to myself stuff happens and running such a popular business is difficult. I have given this place the benefit of the doubt multiple times now and today was the last straw. 

I showed up a couple minutes after 7 and ordered a sandwich and a coffee. Over twenty minutes later, I walked out with a half-finished coffee and no sandwich. I'm a patient person. I really am. When I am given bad customer service at a restaurant, I give them the benefit of the doubt. But this place has disappointed me so many times. Pouring an iced coffee and heating up a premade sandwich should not take 20+ minutes. I wouldn't be writing this if this were a one time incident, but the truth is that this is standard for this particular location. 

I've tried both drive-thru and walk-in and it doesn't seem to make a difference either way. 

Avoid the wait, go to the Starbucks up the road in the shopping center next to Raley's.

I am a regular - an every day kind of guy. I am always greeted by name and they know my drink and what I like. The staff have become friends and I know, even if they goof up, that they will gladly take care of it. Great people and a great product.
This is the best Starbucks in Reno! I'm in and out of there quickly and the drinks are amazing! Not to mention the baristas are some of the best. I won't go to any other store! :)

This location has good seating and I'm usually able to find a chair quite quickly. However, I don't go here anymore because the Internet has consistently been slow. I don't get it, but 3/3 times the connection was ridiculously snail-like and I ended up leaving to go to the other Starbucks across town, where I had no problems. I don't go here anymore because I don't want to risk waiting in their long lines, getting a chair, setting up, and then discovering I can't even make any progress because their internet is frozen solid. Now I'll either stay home to work or go to another location.

This seems to be a fairly good Starbucks. Shady parking if you can find it, handy so that your car doesn't sit in the sun all day. Plenty of power on the community table by the bar. Power is underneath the table along the entire adage. Again, very handy and well thought out. The Baristas here are pretty typical, however two stand out, one for his inappropriateness overall who I will not mention by name, and another, Suzie, who seems particularly smiling, and rather bright. She has made some good suggestions that have saved me a little bit of money by using a coupon code for something I didn't know I could use it for, which has brought me back to this location over other stores. There seem to be quite a few regulars here. Same people every time I come here. To me, that is always a good sign.
A pretty good airport Starbucks - bigger than most airport Starbucks for sure! Had my drink and walking to my gate within five minutes! Not bad!

Not happy. I have been a regular at this Starbucks for four years. I'm assuming the staff is new because I've never had a problem until now. Employees are loudly gossiping and when I got the iced coffee I ordered, there was so much ice I couldn't get my straw through. Cmon.
Just tried the vanilla spice latte.  Now I want another one.

This location is a disappointment. Used to be our go to spot for coffee on weekends and we'd sit outside. The last time we went I ordered the same thing I order EVERY TIME we go to Starbucks. Mocha cookie crumble frappuccino. The girl who made the drink made a mocha. I told her I ordered the mocha cookie one with the chocolate whipped cream. She told me no I didn't. Incredible. Considering I ordered it, I think I know what I order! The last thing I expect is someone to argue with me over what I ordered and paid for!!! But it didn't stop there. Then she went to her coworker and started talking about me. Umm I was still standing there waiting. I now cross the river. The customer service is better in Elmwood. I don't care if she was having a bad day you DO NOT argue with a customer over their order and you DEFINITELY don't talk crap about that customer to your coworker right in front of them. Have some sense and wait until they leave. She made herself look bad. But she made that business look worse. If she worked at my company I would have fired her on the spot. I work in retail/customer service and own a business. ZERO tolerance for this type of childish behavior. I will never be back here

This Starbucks is small but the staff are so friendly and the location is always clean. This Starbucks has a far busier drive through so if you are looking for a place to sit down and chat, this is a pretty good option. The location is convenient as it is along one of the main roads that enters and exits the shopping center and I'm definitely a fan of their drinks.

This review is for the location in the red baggage claim area at the Southwest belts. Ridiculously long wait! One person working left that line gave up and went upstairs to the third floor main concourse and was told by employees at that Starbucks that they don't care downstairs. It doesn't matter if there's a long line because as she said, we're closing that location soon anyway. I was horrified! I have never gotten anything less than excellence from Starbucks employees things have really gone badly here at the airport for them.

This is my favorite local Starbucks! I almost always submit mobile orders because my family and I have special dietary needs and I don't want any misinterpretation of my order. This location always gets it right. Also the staff are always friendly and I can see them hustling to get orders out quickly.

I stop in here a couple times a month for a cappuccino. Usually made perfect, I ask for "dry".  I liked the old interior better.  When they remodeled, they made it look like a warehouse.  Also they changed the direction of the line to order and receive beverages which seems to be awkward to be picking up your beverage while dodging others entering the store.   The baristas seem to be nice but have forgotten to give me my $.10 credit for bringing my own cup, and also messed up my rewards so that one expired.  I contacted customer service and they admitted she goofed up and gave me my reward back.  Anyway, as far as the venue, during the school year its hard to find a place to park after 3 pm and there are lots of teenage customers.  I just go in to get my drink and leave. Not a good place to hang out unless you go outside where there is daylight.
Complete confusion behind the counter, walked up to an open, empty register(not often here at 9:30am) and am still waiting for a mocha, 20 min later. Unreal. Not even great coffee wow
I come here often on my lunch breaks as it is close to work.  The staff here are always friendly  and are very accommodating. This is definitely one of my favorite Starbucks locations.

This location has the absolute worst customer service in which I have encountered at any Starbucks!  One early morning last week on my way to work, I decided to stop in going inside rather than drive through.  There was 1 person in front of me in line to be helped and no one else inside.  With 6 baristas assisting no one, I found it odd that after drive through cleared out and that they had helped the person in front of me that I was still waiting for my 2 item order, 1 of which being a croissant, almost 10 minutes later.  Upon asking if my order would be ready soon, the young girl replied, "I don't know, probably."  I shook my head in amazement and waited another 5 min.  As I received my order and proceeded to walk out, I turned to look behind me and found the rude young blond girl along with the cashier giving me dirty looks from hell!  GROW UP LITTLE GIRLS YOUR JOB IS ONLY AVAILABLE BECAUSE OF YOUR CUSTOMERS!

One of the coolest looking Starbucks yet. As always drinks are on point and delicious.

We kept it simple apple juice for the little guy and the new Ice coconut milk mocha macchiato for my self venti (yes please). The decor is awesone and seating is comfortable.

You know me a Starbucks fanatic so as always very pleased. Kudos Starbucks.

Terminal C airside Starbucks. Need a lesson in customer service and polite customer interaction.   I ordered raspberry cake.  And was handed a berry berry coffee cake.  I felt the cake when he handed it to me and immediately knew it was a wedge vice a rectangle.   I went back in line and waited. When I got to counter I stated I wanted a raspberry cake not the berry berry coffee cake.  His reply. You are not the only one that gets that wrong raspberry cake is the coffee cake and raspberry pound cake is the cake.   Okay   I still want a rectangle cake with raspberry and not the wedge coffee cake.  He takes it and tosses it like a slam dunk in basketball.   And gets the raspberry pound cake.  And then repeats. No worry a lot of people screw that up.   Very Loudly now.  Really dude.   I can read the labels and I have been ordering it in SB s around the US ... And the employees always get it right...... You are the only SB employee who calls it that way and is almost ecstatic to correct customers in a public belittling and berating way.   Thank You For correcting Me.   I'll let the 100 or so other employees know they are wrong,,,,,

This is one of the worst Starbucks. Drink orders are repeatedly wrong, the baristas spend more time socializing with each then paying attention to the customers, and you need to allot extra time because the staff is extremely slow!

Stop here quite frequently on my way to school or home from work.  

This location is nicely tucked away in the Mason Woods shopping center, you can do some shopping, banking and even hit up the 'bucks.  

There frapps are yum, but I love the holiday season because they have pumpkin spice, peppermint mocha and also their Christmas blend coffee, which now comes in via!

The staff are incredibly friendly, and depending on the time of day, you may have to wait a bit, but no big deal (unless you are those suit and tie types that have no patience and really need your double soy no foam asap)!

I ordered a decaf coffee with a little bit of anniversary blend and a girl with the brown hair said, "you difficult".  Is anybody else sick of poor customer service from the people you are paying their salary?  The TSA could run this place better than these losers.
You should avoid this place. I don't believe espresso was made for my order. Very lax, no attention to detail.

Not the cheapest cup of coffee you'll ever get, but that's not why you come here. This location can get pretty busy, but if you're looking for a place to decompress for a minute, or people watch, this is your location. Staff is on top of their game, and I can tell they work to get to know their regulars and their drinks. A convenient walk from the businesses on Mass Ave, indoor and outdoor seating (including walk up window), and free WiFi.

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to!!!!! The employees answer the drive thru saying "hey" or "sup". THIS IS A COFFEE SHOP FOR CRYING OUT LOUD, so be friendly!!! Don't make it seem like I am inconveniencing you. Brandon is the only employee here worth mentioning in a positive regard. He is always so friendly and seems happy to be at work. Thanks Brandon for not sucking. The rest of you SUCK!

I go to Starbucks all the time and never had a bad experience until I came to this one and noticed my drink was really light. I opened it up and my drink was more than a quarter of the way empty when I received it. I feel I should get a full cup of coffee if I'm paying for that so I went to Ariel and she was extremely rude to me and made me feel stupid for asking her to fill my cup all the way. she proceeded to roll her eyes and pour someone else's steamed milk into my cup, handed it back to me and never once apologized. I'll drive the extra couple miles next time to get better customer service

Starbucks is my go to for coffee but this location I will not be re visiting. They are not friendly, never smiled and on top of that made my drink incorrectly. It will be worth it to travel down the street for better service.

I try my best to love this Starbucks, but the drive-thru and the parking lot kind of kill it for me.  I do have to give the staff props because they are so friendly and consistent with their service.  This is my daily Starbucks because it's on my way to work and I don't have to go out of my way, which is awesome.  I have thought about changing to a different location, but since I moved to Tucson this has been my go-to place, and I can't seem to make a change.  If the drive through/parking lot is empty, give this place a chance.  The staff definitely make up for the crappy location.
Great location and staff. FYI-this location closes at 6pm every night during the summer.

Best Starbucks to go to! The staff is so friendly! Some sing to you, some tell you to smile, they just make my day! They always get my drinks right! Not like the other location in the Westbank, they always have to do something wrong.

Starbucks is the best coffee place to go to even though it is a commercialized multi million or billion dollar company, it doesn't mean it isn't good. Every day that I go in I either get a frappuccino, iced coffee, or a shaken tea lemonade. The employees there are always extremely nice though I know it's their job I used to work for them, they are always friendly and smiling and willing to talk to me being the customer about new products or new equipment. Always my drinks come out tasting amazing. I honestly just wish that I had the equipment, and the products because a big chunk of my pay checks goes to them all day every day. I just wish that I could get a little more coffee for my money. All in all I love Starbucks I don't know who wouldn't.

Coffee was OK. The wait to even order was over 20 minutes at 7 am this morning. I can't seem to understand why only 2 people were working for a busy time: 1 making beverages and one on the register. There was a third employee on the phone but she did not seem too concerned with the line almost out the door....
This place is good but super generic coffee . Other places are better like coffee collaborative . If you want a more unique vibe as well check out coffee collaborative in isla vista .

One of my absolute favourite Starbucks locations in Edmonton. Staff is well trained and always carry themselves professionally. Drive thru is fast, efficient and is great for me as I am usually grabbing and running. Starbucks has some amazing products and this locations provides fast, friendly and genuine service.

Normally the staff is somewhat accommodating or at least competent. Today of course, I get the told, after being a Gold member for 5 years, how to get my star at the same time as reloading my card. He tells me that I made a mistake by telling him after he takes my drink order that I want to reload my card. He tells me he reloaded my card after and that I should have told him first. Never, ever have I experienced a barista tell me I couldn't do that. Huh, first one in 5 years... Annoying but not surprising from the typical privileged white boy! But normally this place is normally alright.

Definitely not a good example of Starbucks =/ Even though there was no line to order my drink, it took forever for it to be prepared (a tall Americano!! simple drink!)...approx 10 minutes. I was quite turned off by the staff chatting amongst themselves when I was standing around waiting for my drink -- they did not seem very focused on their tasks at hand. Seating is extremely limited and overall not very clean. Pretty disappointed in this Starbucks location...perhaps it's due to being in IV?? I've been to other college town Starbucks and they were by far much better, both in service and amenities.

I work right next to a Starbucks kiosk in the mall, which is ALWAYS busy and ALWAYS friendly. How can a full sized location screw up so royally?

Lets first start with the driver through, which is placed in a very awkward location. When we ordered a lady repeated back my order twice. I got a small strawberries and cream and a larfue peach green tea with a little cream. At first she said whipped cream, then she said no cream, and apparently couldnt figure out what I meant by "no, cream. CREAM." I like cream in my.damned tea, dont judge me. Anyways, I guess she switched stations because a guy came to finish the order for her. He repeated "with cream" and we proceeded to order 2 cake pops. When we pulled up, a man working the register asked "whipped cream?" So again, I said "no, just regular cream". "Ah" he replied. Then above all the clamour of both the customers and the traffic below, I could hear a woman proclaim "WHAT?! THAT'S NOT WHAT SHE SAID AT ALL!" and then yelled out how to make the drink. Yeah lady, did you want me to come back and do your job for you or something? Look, Starbucks, it's commendable to hire handy capables, but make sure the ones you hire stay on their meds if they're the violent outbursty types.

This is my favorite Starbucks in Indianapolis.  It is a great place to people watch.  They just added their oven-warmed food, which is nice when you need to grab breakfast to go.  I honestly think their coffee is a little strong for my taste, but many swear by it.  This Starbucks is right on Mass Ave, so there is a lot to do before and after you grab your coffee. This store has T-Mobile HotSpot wireless broadband Internet service.

I was in town, visiting family when I came across this gem.  Centrally located downtown Clearwater, right across from the Church of Scientology.  

This starbucks is large, with ample room for sitting inside and outside.  The employees all seemed to be enjoying themselves, but were not too loud (I was studying).  

Also, I enjoy the fact that this store lends to good people watching.

While visiting a friend at his Pop Warner car wash fundrasier this past Saturday, I noticed this Starbucks from across the street.  Dying in the 90+ degree heat, I just knew a Venti Iced Americano would quench my thirst so, I headed the short distance to grab a coffee.

In the home stretch of the front door, I couldn't help but notice the 6 car line at the drive-thru waiting patiently to grab a cup.  I captured a picture of the line just prior to entering Starbucks.  The question I have goes out to all you "I gotta go though the drive-thru even though there's a line a mile long" types.  The question is WHY?? 

I understand the drive-thru if, it's after hours and the only thing open is the drive-thru but, that wasn't the case today.  I even read post of someone complaining about waiting in the drive-thru.  News flash folks - There's no line or waiting if your park your car and walk inside.

Breath Tony.......  Once I got inside, I pulled my phone out to do my part as a Yelp Elite and check into the business.  Just as my phone reached my palm, I noticed the WiFi bars come to life.  Letting me know I had a solid internet connection.  It was also just about this time that I noticed the line inside Starbucks.  Well, actually I noticed the lack of line to be more specific.  Did I mention to you all that there was a 6 car line at the drive-thru outside waiting for coffee?  Okay, I thought maybe I missed that.

After ordering my tasty beverage(s), I did some looking around of the place.  I don't think I've ever visited a Starbucks laid out quite like this one is.  It actually has two entrances.  One entrance delivers you into the lounge area (see picture) and the other, into the area where you can look at and purchase Starbucks item like their coffee cups.  Also inside this door are the his and her restrooms.

Overall a very nice Starbucks store with a friendly staff.  My only wish is that they had a play list for the music being played in house.  Some of the best and rarest R&B Old School I've heard in a long time.  So rare even my Sound Hound App couldn't capture all of it.

This is a great Starbucks to visit. Even if they are busy the people working there are super nice, and super fast. The speed and good attitude I don't find at every Starbucks. These guys are the A TEAM.
This drive through is fast and efficient, I love that they're right off the fork in the road! Sure they're next to a Panera's but it's STARBUCKS! Id' rather use the drive through than park anyway!

I'm not sure if this Starbucks goes rouge when following the standard of other Starbucks stores, but everything done here is extremely inconsistent. Every Starbucks I've ever visited will gladly give you ice waters when asked, however this store refuses to give them to you unless you purchase something. I even had asked to purchase a venti ice water since they would refuse to give me one for free, and I was refused to be sold a venti ice water (even though they clearly have venti cups- ice- and water) Saturday I bought a coffee and asked for a venti ice water, and was given one no problem. Today i purchased a coffee and asked for a venti ice water and was told they do not give out venti ice waters anymore, that's it's a new policy, which I find completely ridiculous. Being a mall employee, I contribute to the sales of this location almost daily along with my co workers, and I think after my experiences at this store, I'm going to have to stop supporting this company completely since this issue seems to be unresolved, and will continue to be unresolved.

Awesome!!! So fast. So efficient. And so friendly!!! The parking and drive through situation aren't ideal, but they more than make up for it. I would rather have a seamless operation and a crumby drive through than a great drive through setup and choppy slow service. 
I had a doppio and an iced coffee. I was set for the day!

This is my favorite Starbucks. The only thing I don't like is the parking lot is too small. It's larger than others so most times I have no problem finding a table. There is also a separate room that is away from the baristas. It makes it a little easier to study

This is the most inefficient Starbucks I've ever been in. I've never seen so many people walking around doing nothing while so many people were in line and the staff had a nerve to be chatty with each other while we stood in line. Terrible

It's a Starbucks, so there's a certain expectation when you go to one. This one failed my expectations. First, it was 9am, we ordered Ham & Cheese Croissants and they were out of them.
