Second, I got an egg sandwich, it wasn't very good and they don't have ketchup. No Ketchup?! You serve eggs, this is America, you should have ketchup. When I asked, the lady told me they don't have ketchup and never have, I've been to many Starbucks and have had it, so why this location doesn't is beyond me. For $16 for 2 small drinks, a coffee cake and an egg sandwich, I expect you to have the items you display in the case and I expect you to have condiments. I wouldn't return to this location.
(Starbucks inside target) Terrible. I order a caramel Ice machicato and I got no ice or caramel. Do not go here!
One of my favorite Starbucks. The baristas are friendly and efficient. The mobile part works great here. Almost glad they don't do drive through because it has a great small local cafe feel.

This Starbucks is okay, but I'm only writing this review because the music is always blasting and hard to even have a conversation.  If you have to take a call, need to go outside.  I've found myself going out in freezing temperatures just so I can here my phone call.

As a previous Starbucks barista, I was shocked at the uncleanliness, unprofessionalism, and poor customer service. One worker was (hopefully) on break; however, she stood next to the espresso machine licking her fingers of hot Cheetos. Additionally, there were five people in uniform; however, only one was doing anything (taking orders and money and then proceeding to make the drinks without washing hands). I realize people have lower expectations for airport Starbucks, but this one was remarkable.

This is a very convenient Starbucks location and a great store, though the quality of service is a hit-and-miss!! Depending on the baristas on duty and how busy the place is, you're likely to have either a 5-star or a 2-star experience. I'm not particularly happy because they've messed up something on my last four visits there... forgetting the extra shot of espresso, giving me a small drink instead of a medium, giving my drink to someone else, ...maybe they'll finally get it right on the fifth try! :-(

Not sure if I have the right location. Writing for Lambert airport, East terminal. Starbucks across from gate E-17. 

Worst Starbucks ever. Ordered my drink, it came overflowing, running over the lid. Server wiped the bottom of the glass and nothing else. I asked if she had any napkins. "No, but I can give you an extra glass".  What good is that going to do me? I asked if there were napkins on the kiosk. Yes..... Just what I want before I board a plane. A sticky drink spilling.  Good grief!

So this Starbucks is as good as any other SB as far as quality is concerned.My coffee was good, the environment was nice and the whole place was clean. The big problem with this place is parking. It was awful. I had to drive around a few times before there was a spot open and even then I felt like I got lucky to get it. Would have gotten 4 stars, but parking sucks.
Once again this location had no VIA Decaf in stock. Now I realize they may do many things right but if they don't keep all their products in stock, for me, obviously, they are worthless

I'm a gold card member...shamefully or not. I love Starbucks and I went almost everyday in my hometown. This Starbucks has botched my order a few times. The staff is friendly but often distracted with private conversations. I ordered a very specific drink which was lost somewhere behind the counter. I waited a good twenty minutes for one drink, and I had to remind two workers. I still visit this location because it's convenient and I need my Starbucks fix from time to time.
I had the best experience here out of any Starbucks I've been to. They are fast, nice, and always make sure your order is right.
Friendly staff and quick service. Extremely dirty bathrooms and dining area. Garbage overflowing, tables not wiped down, floors with debris all over, quite gross restrooms.

Perhaps one of the worse Starbucks I been to. I went through the drive thru and ordered a tall green tea latte. It took forever and when I got it, the green tea powder was in chunks. Clearly not a well made drink . By the time I turned around, the drink had already separated and the green tea powder was all settled at the bottom. So I go into the store and ask them to remake the drink. The cashier was friendly but the barista, all she did was pour my drink into a tumbler and shake it a few times. That is clearly not the definition of "remake." Definitely not returning to this location. They also seem to have charged me extra compared to Starbucks I usually go to.
The employees were so loud and careless for any of the customers studying or reading... Horrible ambiance. I suggest just grabbing ur beverage and leaving.

Let me tell ya... the morning was going ROUGH but then it took a turn for the better when we met the barista of our DREAMS! Whoever was working the drive through at 6:47 on 01/24/2018 was such a good man and to think poor Sarah was "busting his balls." This man gave me the lightest ice and the most phenomenal drink I've ever sipped. Amazing work, 10/10 quality, 100% made my day better. He was so enthusiastic and funny all in one.

Best Starbucks in Reno!! All the baristas are wonderful and recognize me when I pull up to the drive thru or go inside. They know my usual and I have NEVER been disappointed. I rarely go to any other Starbucks and I pass Human Bean to come here. Would give 10 stars if I could. Love love love this Starbucks!!!!

This has been my go-to 'Bucks for the past few years, mostly as my pre-work caffeine buzz. While it's your standard Starbucks in most ways, the staff is always working in sync and gets the orders out promptly and correctly. There's also a wide assortment of regulars that always make my brief visit a little brighter. 
Another nice feature is an actual outdoor seating area that is quite lovely. Indoors is a little cramped, but still nice. 
If you can find the parking, this is a good stop for your Starbucks fix.

Sparing readers a detailed description of what Starbucks is or what they serve is pointless: anyone who hasn't been under a rock since the late 1990s has probably been into one.  Maybe you like it; maybe you don't; your opinion is your opinion.  Personally, I prefer the local coffee house to a Starbucks - just as I prefer a local burger joint to Hardees. Despite my preference, Starbucks is tasty, ubiquitous, and convenient.  This Starbucks location, which has operated since I was in high school (hint: it isn't new), has always satisfied me.  It is a five-star location.

A five-star Starbucks?  Yes, especially as I'd only compare one Starbucks location with another Starbucks location.  I'll tell you why: It's the service.  I've experienced nothing by exceptionally friendly service at this location for more than 15 years.  

Story time.  Very recently, I found myself with a great urge to purchase a French press coffee maker.  Since I had ventured to Northside, I figured I'd try Starbucks, since I knew they sold them.  After visiting one location and striking out, I telephoned this location to see if they carried the item.  To my satisfaction, the friendly young barista not only said that she had them, but that they were on sale!  When I arrived at the shop five minutes later, I found the she had already neatly wrapped and bagged my brand new French press.  The barista, who herself is a fan of the simple coffee makers, gave me various tips on how to brew the best cup of coffee on earth.  I'm not sure I'm a master yet, but I'm a work in progress.

It's the small things that count.  86th and Ditch Starbucks: I'll be back.

If you want your coffee with an attitude then you've found the place. I get it baristas, you're college students, just like me, and you don't want to work a job. But you most likely have to, but seriously why do you guys have so much sass and attitude. You messed up my drink, don't argue with me. As an ex partner I am disappointed in this place. They don't care about service because they get a flux of customers.

By far the worst Starbucks visit. First of all the location was a disaster. Second after taking my order she flipped my cups rim down on her filth filled counter. Third I ordered a simple chi latte and it was not even something I could drink
The staff was amazing!! They took extra time with my nephew and made him feel so special!  Parker and I will definitely be back, cause Seth was wonderful with us!

Visited Starbucks today (May 13) with my roommate for happy hour. I would like to give five stars to a worker named Justin who was kind and patient towards my awkward self. I had a recipe that I found online and wanted to try, and he was patient and understanding when he took my order. I really appreciated his friendly customer service and I hope he continues to have nice days because he deserves it!

Happy to report a five star rating! I have been highly critical of this location for a very long time. So must be different management huge improvement. The drinks where perfect the chai tea latte with foam was extra and fluffy perfect taste. My macchiato was absolutely perfect and delicious. My bagel perfectly toasted and not only that my order was ready in five minutes. No confusion no waiting boom it was done. Hopefully they keep up the good work. And they eliminated the fly problem!

I really think Starbucks has gone down hill in general over the past few years.  I really wish there was a good, local coffee shop like the ones I see popping up all over other metro areas like in downtown Chicago, NY, LA.  Some whole foods are starting to have coffee bars and they serve a far superior product.

This location is OK to work at.  Lots of seating and AC, but service is very slow at times, especially in the AM.  Drinks are thrown together.  Shots are inconsistent.  Nobody takes time to add the shots to the water for an americano anymore which makes it bitter and destroys the crema.  And, last time I was in, 1/2 of our breakfast items were missed so 1/2 of us were done eating, the others were just getting food.  Anymore, bagles are warmed but not really toasted.   

I was there last week and I watched 7 people wait in line for some time, then leave.  A few more just turned around after looking at the line.

Looking for a better place.
It's starbucks, coffee's good and the staff at this location are nice and friendly. It's near work so I get coffee here often.

Really nice, big and relaxing location with a nice range of seating options. No drive thru but easy parking for in & out. Staff are friendly and efficient. I particularly like the wall decor - a great eclectic selection of photo and paint prints. I especially like the large lush garden scene and the labyrinth. Oh yeah - the coffee is dark and rich, just as I like it. There are the usual other options as well, of course.

All the baristas here are very friendly, quick, and accommodating. They always have a large selection of coffee beans to take home and a good selection of tumblers and coffee cups too! It's an average Starbucks, but they are very accurate with their orders and I've never had any issues with what I've ordered here.

This location is usually crowded and the parking is tough, but the staff has always been great and the place has always been clean.   It's not spotless because it's a busy location, but all in all it's a great place to meet.  Outside seating is available, but not the greatest for ambiance, but it's a seat in a busy location.  I visit occasionally and would recommend it to others.

I love this Starbucks! I'm also very happy that it's right down the street! 
It's conveniently located in the neighborhood of Big Lots, Wells Fargo, Grocery Outlet, Sally's, Smiths, BOA, Walgreens, CVS, etc.

CUSTOMER SERVICE/WAIT TIME: 5 star
-They are always kind, always friendly, and always quick with my orders!
-Yes, like every other Starbucks, they have very busy hours where lines are long (before 9AM, and between 2PM or 3PM to 6:00PM) 

AMBIANCE: 5 star
-I love the way that this Starbucks is set up! 
-There's a seating/lounge area that feels very homey and welcoming. If I had time, I'd love to sit there and read a book, or write a paper. 

PARKING: 5 star
-Shares a common parking area with shopping center
-Never had an issue finding parking

We almost always use the drive thru, it's just easier, when you are on the go. The people who take your order are always pleasant. However, after ordering and getting to the window something happens and it seems to take forever to get your order. We are always waiting at the window. Our orders aren't super complicated, sometimes it's just coffee, no speciality drinks, and we still have to wait. 

When I have the urge to splurge on a pastry, they are always fresh & delicious. Whether it's my favorite iced lemon cake or the birthday cake pops. If you never tried the lemon cake & your a fan of lemons, you don't know what you are missing out on!

I go to Starbucks all the time always ask my dad to go and I love to be able to do school  work and go to. I would choose this place out of any other place for coffee. Their lattes are the best and the new crystal ball Frappuccino
One of my favorite locations for casual client meetings.  Great service and very courteous staff.
Busiest Starbucks in town but they always have fast and courteous service. And the lines usually move quickly so it is worth it coming here.

I drink the same drink everywhere I go, I get iced or hot depending on whether it's summer or winter. I've came to this location 3 times this summer and every single time I ask for an iced Americano with milk, hazelnut and to use iced coffee instead of water. Every time they give me a hot Americano! I immediately turn around and they fix it but today my husband stopped by this location to get me my drink and he showed up with a hot Americano! Even though he said iced. We live in Broad Ripple so I wasn't going to have home drive all the way back. 

If you want your coffee made right the first time I suggest you venture elsewhere.

It started out with the line being extremely long which was fine considering it is early morning (not to mention I love Starbucks). But then after standing in line you get to the register and they then decide to tell you their systems have been down **since the day before** and are only accepting certain forms of payment. Many customers who rely on their Starbucks mobile app were turned away. With a line that long it would have been nice to have a sign up stating the systems were down prior to waiting in this long line. Very disappointed. Poor customer service.
Love this location! Every chance I get I run here for a coffee. Friendly and pretty quick!

They cater to what you want. I typically order a skinny vanilla latte But with only one pump of vanilla syrup... so it won't be too sweet. I really like the ham and cheese croissant square when I need breakfast on the go and their green tea is like No other! The only aspect I don't like are the long lines. It doesn't matter what time of day it is there is going to be a line. They're really not that bad though... I'm just spoiled from living in Tucson my whole life.

This morning, I walked in to pick up my drink, a caramel macchiato. The barista rudely corrected my friend, who ordered a caramel coffee. He told her that she needed to order the caramel sauce, which she actually did (said so on the receipt), and refused to correct her order. My caramel macchiato tasted disgusting, the barista apparently doesn't know that caramel macchiatos are made with vanilla bean and caramel. As a barista, it is your job to know the drinks, not the customers.
No better or worse than most other Tucson locations. I come here as it's convenient to my commute.
Have plenty of time this location has got to be slowest service I have ever seen!!!!!

Staff here are always friendly I ordered one of my drinks incorrectly and they gladly made me a new with a smile love to see a company that trains there staff in the customers always mentality( I paid for both drinks even when they said I didn't have to but I didn't mind because it was my mistake)

I really don't want to wait 5 minutes while 2 employees figure out how to clock in and 2 other employees chat waiting for nothing. Just rude!!  It's an airport and people are usually in a hurry. Get you customer service ON!!!  Just a big disappointment!!!

Worst airport Starbucks around. Can't administer simple order... "Americano with room".  I guess half the order was right? 

No 1/2 and 1/2. I gave them empty one. It sat on counter 20 minutes.  And other milk products were empty. 

Saw a SW airlines employee use the barista's cream.... It was curdled!

Friendly staff but poor service. Ordered a pourover, waited 10 minutes, asked if it was ready, and they said they were just about to start making it. Common problem for those of us who don't want Pike in the afternoon, but always disappointing when the frap machine never misses a beat. Is Starbucks a coffee roaster or a milkshake maker?

Horrible iced chai latte. Seems like the barista put hot coffee over ice causing the beverage to become watered down and luke warm. I've never had a quality problem with Starbucks until today. Perhaps the employee who made my drink wasn't properly trained. Won't be returning.

A chain - I know, I know. I can't help but be a fan of Starbucks - I would pick the local coffee shop (particularly Henry's and Clavin Fletcher) any day over Starbucks, but in the same breath I wouldn't bash Starbucks like I would other big chains like Walmart. 

Somehow this ginormous business (at least the ones I have visited and especially the Mass Ave location) has achieved a small town-feel with friendly employees despite its big world reality. Some may consider it a marketing stunt, but I can't help but smile every time I see their "Create Jobs for USA" program. 

This particular location was remodeled and expanded during the summer of 2012. From time to time, you might find me on their spacious patio people watching and working on one of my latest paint-by-number "masterpieces". My visits to Starbucks are few and far between, but the caramel apple chai never fails to do the trick!
Worst service ever! Every single time they get it wrong! Everrryyyy singgglleeee time!
It's Starbucks! Of course it's consistently good. Service here is friendly and their drive through is quick. They have a good selection of food and will do whatever you want with your drinks.

This is definitely the most pathetic sandwich I've had at an airport. I understand that airport prices are typically higher than a non-airport location, no worries because I saw the price before ordering. I wish I had taken a photo of the display in the case and the ad for this sandwich because what I received was neither. I also wish I had looked at the sandwich before proceeding through the security check point. Don't get me wrong, the seasoning and flavor was everything a roasted tomato and mozzarella sandwich should be, especially for quick airport food. The tragedy was definitely the fact that there was very little content or substance. I opened the sandwich because I wanted to add my own veggie slices for added protein, which I'm glad that I brought. No problems with cleanliness our corresponding when ordering or paying. I'll definitely look before leaving if I stop here again.

This location is usually pretty busy. I wouldn't recommend it if you are hoping to read or get any work done, but if you just need to pop in for a drink and leave they are fast and efficient. 

The line for the register starts to the right of the display in the middle of the store. It makes it more tempting to leave with a huge cookie or pastry but try to resist! The baristas at this location have always been kind and speedy. They do also have a walk up window but I honestly never use it. I think it is quicker to go inside. If you happen to have a pup with you though the walk up window is a nice option to have. 

If you order drip coffee they may ask if you want to have that made on the Clover, it takes a little longer but if you are a coffee lover it is worth giving it a try if you have the extra time.

I travel from the Philadelphia airport about weekly. Sadly, I like to get a Starbucks when I fly, and the Starbucks in the B/C connector is the worst Starbucks I have ever encountered. At least 3 times I have had AM flights and the employees arrive late and don't open on time. They yell at customers if anybody brings it up. The employees argue with each other and customers. There will be 10plus people waiting for drinks and only 1 employee is making them. The rest just stand there. It us an airport- you would think this Starbucks would be more efficient than normal, but it is a disaster.  I hope a regional manager reads this. Reach out to me- I can give you dates, times and examples of terrible customer service at this location
This location was fairly busy. Service was alright. Their drive thru was busy so it took a bit of time for my order to be made.

Quick Summary: Great interior space for a relaxing day of reading and sipping.

Again, not my usual thing to review a chain, but I was geninuely impressed with the layout of this specific store I had to toss in my two cents. 

It was a gloomy day and I was starting to go a little stir crazy; but I was in a reading mood.  I had driven by this store a few times but never went in, so I figured I'll give it a shot. I was very impressed with the layout, it has more of an independent (read hipster) coffee house feel than your typical starbucks. Lots of seats, some low, some high, and plenty of plug ins. 

I liked that there was a separate 'room' that gave the feeling of being tucked away in the corner. I was happy to plant myself down for a few hours and burn through a book. And it was pretty evident I wasn't the only one with that idea... there were several long term customers in the house... including one guy next to me who solved a rubiks cube no less than 3x while he was there... (I think he was trying to use it as a conversation starter... attract attention... but I dunno doesn't seem like a place I'd go to meet people since most of them are there to... you know... read... anyways I'm married so my pov is vastly different... and I digress)

All in all it was a cozy place, great to just chill for a while and get it done. Good music in the background to drown out the sounds of the business and enough space between seats so yo don't feel cramped, but not so much that it seems you're in a vast study hall...

I'll definitely be coming back to finish my next book. 

One draw back though, since it seems a lot of people liked this store for hanging out the parking lot does get filled up quickly... and there isn't much turnover.

This Starbucks is located in the Main Terminal of Tampa International Airport. Tampa has a nice area set aside for food and shopping and Starbuck's is right in the middle of it all.

This Sbux is designed for hunting bear, as they say. They have dueling cash registers, and dueling espresso machines - that is to say - batteries of them on each side. I assume this is to deal with large quantities of customers and keep the line moving.

I ordered a Tall Coffee with room for cream.

I had gotten to the airport about six hours before my scheduled departure time - United (and I guess most Airlines) won't let you check in a bag at the counter until 4 hours before the flight. So I hung out upstairs in the main terminal. There are lots of tables to sit, and lots of electrical outlets to plug your notebook computer into - so I plopped myself down, cranked up my MacBook Pro, and leisurely sipped my Sb ux coffee. It was the usual consistent quality - but I was grateful for the caffeine - as I was feeling the need to perk up my brain cells.

If you ever have the need to call this Sbux - it is apparently run by HMS Host - the number for the Starbucks - through them is: (813) 396-3977, ext. 280.

Horrible customer service every time I come here. They have the most unfriendly staff and could absolutely care less about their customers.  If I'm paying  $6 for my coffee I expect you to get it right and not be rude. I wish I could say that this was the first time but sadly every time I've had the pleasure of going here they've either messed up my peppermint mocha or been rude. Not coming here again!  Save yourself the trouble!

First off: it's a Starbucks. So you know what the coffee already tastes like and what the menu is. The drinks are okay at this Starbucks, sometimes they use too little flavored though, especially green tea and specialty/holiday flavors which is saddening. Most of the baristas are students so don't expect them to make the best coffee you've ever had. The lines can be atrociously long especially around finals and specialty deals (think frappachinos for 2 dollars). They will run out of flavors during those times as well. Good amount of seating inside and outside for all those papers to be written. 

Overall, it's a basic Starbucks. It has it's perks and it has it's downfalls, but it's the only one in IV and the closest other Starbucks is on Calle Real. So do you really want to drive that far?

Literally the only reason I gave it two stars instead of one is bc it's close by. Half the employees are clueless and can't do anything and the rest of the time they're out of something. Also pretty slow, idk why the employees take so long to understand my order....

This location is perfect. I wish there were more parking. I stop in for my fav drink. Green tea frap. Always lots of people. Tons of wifi user. The best part is the staff. They are very nice. If their is a new product or promo they always explain what it is and what it taste like. Mini cherry pie is really good.

I often stop here on my way to work when in town.  Not going to review the coffee her because Starbucks is a industry leader for obvious reason.   This is all about the staff here.

The people working here are wonderful.  Always smiling, always happy.  They are often my first interaction of the day with other people and it's always a pleasant one.

Thanks for that!
The girl in here had a real attitude problem. She is obviously miserable working and she is being slow. She throws stuff around without a care and is rude to the customers. Don't go

once I ordered a drink that came out hot when I specifically told her I wanted it cold and when I notified the barista, the lady that took my order said I didn't say anything. that was rude, almost as rude as the dude who thought I wouldn't notice the difference from a plain milked down tea latte and a gingerbread tea latte.

Faster service for walk in customers durning rush hours. The drive up needs better traffic management due to a small parking lot and a short over all length of the drive up lane. Drive thru vehicles often spills out into traffic while waiting. Consider adding signs to let your customers know they can enter Starbucks parking by continuing down to North Martin Ave and taking the first right into parking.
It's a Starbucks, so you know the offerings. The staff here are great, which sets them apart from other locations. Super friendly and helpful.

This Starbucks is pretty darn good. Not sure anyone really cares about which way the windows face, were not hanging out at Starbucks for the view! The drinks are all properly made, service is good--same as most Starbucks, and really consistency is a main reason we go to Starbucks. Friendly folks here too. Cleanliness has never been an issue when I've been in there. Its the same as any other Starbucks--well maintained.

Today, I had a horrible experience at this Starbucks. I'm going to call out the particular shift because I think Managers should know what their Barista's are doing. I was in around 11am on Sunday. The Barista started my drink, and another customers drink. During this time she decided to walk to the back..get a mop..proceed to mop the floor...and than put the mop back...Finally getting back to finish off our drinks...Really????? Horrible customer service Starbucks....While I will be back...I hope to get a Barista who actually cares about their Customers.

Friendly, courteous staff. They always do their best to offer quick service with a smile. I have never had a problem with my order being wrong. As a semi-regular, it's rare I have to give my name when placing my order. Small space, but that is beyond their control and certainly an upgrade from the kiosk they used to occupy in the mall.
Helpful on the drinks and decently fast in the drive thru. Drinks are consistent. Convenient location. Not sure why others rated low. Typical Starbucks ;). That's why it's so popular.

Pricey Airport Starbucks

SITREP

They have the basic level 2 Starbucks products & service available at this location.

THE SETUP

I am not a fan of a Starbucks - whether it be in an Airport or a Stadium, etc. - that uses the location as an excuse to charge up to 35%-50% more for their product.

Paid nearly $3 more for the Venti Blonde & Sausage Breakfast sandwich I could have gotten for less at my home Starbucks.

THE LOWDOWN

They got most of the goods you want at a Starbucks, but they will make you pay for the "privilege" of being in an airport.

As Starbucks go, this has all the usual offerings. However, it is best appreciated for its drive-thru and outdoor seating rather than as a relaxing place to sit and work. On a recent visit the staff behaved like a group of teenagers at a party and did not cultivate a friendly or calm atmosphere. For a more relaxing atmosphere with warm and friendly staff, the Berwyn/Devon or Paoli locations are recommended.

I agree with others. This is the location closest to my work, which is why I have stopped here on multiple occasions regardless of the poor service but today was definitely the last straw.

I have started to give myself a lot of extra time whenever I go to this Starbucks because they are SO SLOW! Today, however they took 30 minutes. 30 minutes in a drive thru. There were only four cars ahead of me, I don't understand why it takes SO long.

Additionally after waiting 30 minutes I got the wrong drink. I could not believe it! I was already late to work so I just left and tossed the drink. Money wasted, I will NEVER go back to this Starbucks again, they are lacking good employees!

The only difference between this Starbucks and any other one is the staff and the atmosphere, which mostly consists of college students. The staff does a decent job of making coffee. I have not had a bad order at this place so far. Cheers.

Store is generally dirty. Bathrooms are poorly maintained. Drinks are good or I would have given them one star. 

One evening the entire place reeked of body odor. When I ordered I realized it got worse. I couldn't believe the person helping me was the offending person.
This is my favorite Starbucks in the area. I find that this Starbucks is less busy than the one of Los Altos and in wing field. Their employees are friendly and prompt with customers needs.
Love this Starbucks. I usually come here after school with some friends and all of the baristas are very friendly. They enjoy having conversations with you while they make your drink.

The quality is the same as every other Starbucks and staff are friendly but the wait time was way more than typical!   It was a good 10 to 15 minutes waiting in the drive-through lane... only a few cars in front of me
Friendly workers & quiet relaxing environment. Your local go-to study place. Coconut Mocha Frap is made the best here. I don't know why but they make it JUST RIGHT!

Slow. Slow. Slow. Slow. Slow. Slow. Slow. Slow. Slow. Slow. Slow. Writing this on my 10th minute waiting for an iced coffee. Same experience every time.

Updating my review. It's slower than a year ago. Seriously, where is the manager on this? Get a clue.
Thank you! Even in terrible weather, the service was great & efficient. The man clearing the snow off the lot was also courteous!
As others have said this Starbucks isn't great. Slow service, very unfriendly staff but my drink was good so for a airport stop I guess it'll do.

The staff here has always went above and beyond Service! Since I'm in a motorized wheelchair, I enjoy the Large Counter space! And huge fireplace! I rarely go to a Starbucks now unless it's Double Rewards STARS day or if someone has gifted me a Starbucks card, I try and find the local coffeeiers.
But I like this store!
I'm obsessed with their Emperor's green tea with a shot of maca

Service is quick and fast, got my cup of java within 5 minutes.

Can get busy during the morning and afternoon rush but as long as the barista team knows what they're doing, they punch out drinks like no one's business.

This Starbucks causes me stress. I go to it almost every weekend and every weekend I end up walking by a handful of local and, to my mind, better coffee shops on my way to Starbucks. 

So why do I keep going back? 

Simply stated: the walk-up window. I love the walk-up window because it allows me to secure my morning caffeine while out on a walk with Humphrey, my awesome, but somewhat skittish cocker spaniel. I hate having to tie Humphrey outside of a coffee shop while I am inside ordering coffee and the walk-up window is a great solution for us. This window is in no way an express window, nor does it function like a drive-through, with dedicated staff assigned to only managing window orders. In fact, if you are not tethered to the outdoors by a dog, a bike, or other whatever that prevents you from entering the store, you are better off entering the store. 

For me and Humphrey, this window has become part of our weekend routine and I wouldn't change anything about it.

I normally try to stay away from chain reviews, but there has been something irking at me for that past few months.  Before, during and post pumpkin-everything-craze-fest came the winter-holiday-spiced-everything-craze-fest of which a specialty drink was a salted-caramel mocha.

**It should be noted, that this really only affects the Mrs. but the agony over the following was just so mind boggling that I had to inscribe it to get it out of my head.

Perhaps one of the biggest, and a personal favorite, trend flavors around the Mrs. and I were equally excited by its birth.  Many a festive drink we did have until the last month-month and a half.

"Hi, welcome to Starbucks may I help you" or whatever the jingle greeting is for these stores. "Hi, yes, I'd like a salted-caramel mocha." "I'm sorry we're out of salt." 

OK.. so.. maybe the vendor didn't deliver salt, maybe the shipment was delayed, maybe the stocker thought it was something else and sent it back, whatever.  I'm willing to overlook a minor mishap one time.  We order something else and move on with our lives.

Take 2:  Same company, different location. "Hi, welcome to Starbucks may I help you" or whatever the jingle greeting is for these stores. "Hi, yes, I'd like a salted-caramel mocha." "I'm sorry we're out of salt."

--blood simmering--  same conclusion

Take 3: Same company, back to first location. "Hi, welcome to Starbucks may I help you" or whatever the jingle greeting is for these stores. "Hi, yes, I'd like a salted-caramel mocha." "I'm sorry we're out of salt." 

Internal WTF bomb.  Come on.  It's salt.  One of the most basic commodities found in even the most lowly of income housing/businesses/store fronts.  A natural occurring mineral found all over the world in different colors, flavors and sizes.  It's practically pennies/pound.  With grocery stores and Wawas aplenty, all of them fully in stock of the delicious, flavor enhancing crystals, there is no reason why this should not be an easily obtained item.  I'd be more understanding if their oatmeal goodie bag supply ran low, but salt?  It's like going to a hamburger place and being out of ketchup (or catsup for some).

Note to self:  Put box of salt in car.  Throw at franchise managers in future encounters.

Ok.  Done.  Get it together Starbucks.  Thanks for listening.

Smaller cozier store where Gigi and I have been known to put on a show by the way we act! Life's too short. 
Locals are known by the friendly staff. Greek culture has it to hang out at coffee shops and this Starbucks accommodates. 
The barristas have always been on their game.The food offerings are always kept full for selection. Ample branded coffee gifts are ample as well.  Patrons are friendly. Restrooms are clean. Gigi approves!
Alas it seems like the Starbucks of late unable to understand your order, if you don't want a company perscibed drink your screwed. Unable to process change

My review for this place is almost a year ago. Today, I thought it would be a good time to update it. Again, all of the good former employees are now being replaced with unprofessional kids. There were 4 employees behind the counter. One getting ready to end her shift, one making drinks, and the other 2 just gossiping when the customers and I just standing there staring at them. How in the world can you not see a line of customers standing there staring you down? There is a special going on this week that Starbucks advertises everywhere. It is the buy one macchiato, get one free (any size). I ordered a macchiato and was given only one. I came back to the counter to notify them about the problem. The 2 girls at the counter explained to me that I have to order the free one to get it while laughing at me. It makes zero sense for any customers to do that because obviously, there is a sign on top of the counter saying, buy one macchiato, get one free (2-5 pm). Why do I need to specify that? This is absolutely shady at its finest. The 2 girls did offered to give me the free drink, but I just find their service so unprofessional compare to the other previous employees.
SLOWEST DRIVE THRU. Definitely not showcasing their A team, tables are always dirty, trash is constantly overflowing.  Weekdays, Weekends...doesn't matter always the same, dirty & slow!
Closes early without warning.  Extremely dark outside.   Lights are never on outside.  Logo light is never on when open...very rude staff

This review is for the new (2017) Starbucks that opened in the Town & Country crossing shopping center. Featuring its signature tea and coffee drinks and sandwiches/pastry case fare, this location also includes a drive-thru. The baristas are friendly, albeit beleaguered when orders at the drive-thru pile up. They were out of the egg and turkey bacon sandwich when I came here, so went with a gluten free option that was still tasty. The interior is dark and a bit smallish in comparison to other Starbucks so probably more of a grab-and-go option.
I love this starbucks. quick, efficient, love the protein box to go with my tea or coffee. just giving in to the legalized addiction of coffee!!

Dirty Girl.  Unkept Starbucks recommend for top dirty list...   Bathrooms not clean.  But not thoroughly disgusting either.  No paper towels.  Trash overflowing. Where sugar and napkins are and five (employees) behind the counter, either in ignore mode,  or pasted on smile.  High chair a mess.  Outside tables and chairs need wipe off from prior patrons or the rain.  What do the five do?  Make coffee only?  Clean behind the line?  My recommend is drive through and hope that they are more tidy behind the line than in front.

This is my favorite Starbucks! Always fast service even if the line is long. The people working here are always nice to me, asking me how I'm doing, etc. A lot of students hang out here and do their work. When sitting outside no homeless people have ever approached me. Downtown location this ALWAYS happens when seated outside.

I walked in around 3 pm to get a coffee. The manager and an employee were leaning over the counter laughing while customers waited in line.

 I ordered a iced americano and waited patiently while 5 people that ordered after me got their drinks. I said "excuse me" to the barista and she told me that they were fixing the espresso machine and it would just be a few minutes. 

I told the barista that I needed to leave so I would be okay with an iced coffee. She told me I needed to get back in the long line for a refund because iced coffees were cheaper. I declined and waited longer.

Another employee came out and vacuumed the coffee beans out of the machine, then without wiping the inside just stuck the top back on and made my espresso!!! Gross!!!! Never going back there again. 

The customer service and obviously sanitation is deplorable.

Barista is too loud and talks rudely about drink orders.  My brother-in law ordered a coffee with extra sugar and the barista was loudly saying how he should brush his teeth right after drinking that coffee and how 'yes, I'm judging you!'

There was this one employee she just started working there. Was very rude and started yelling at me and arguing with me. I thought that Starbucks employees were suppose to be very nice and always give what the customer wants. Customers are always right when I worked there if I had an employee that did that we would've had to reprimand her and if it happened again we would fire her because of her actions so I hope she doesn't work there any longer because that was not something I would like to deal with every time I want a coffee.

Basic iced coffee with milk and sweetener. It had just the right amount of sweetener added.

Quick friendly service, clear communication while ordering in drive thru.

They had run out of the ham and cheese breakfast fold-overs, though. They are on order for resupply.

If this was not the most convenient location to the beach, I would never frequent it again. With the exception of Andy, the baristas are rude and unfriendly, especially Gina and Natasha. In fact, Gina always seems sick, hacking germs on everything behind the counter. And, Natasha could not be bothered to hand anyone their drink. Time and traffic permitting, I'll be driving out to the Belcher location where the experience is generally much more professional and pleasant!

In and out, just how I like it. Service was fast and while I placed my order, this Starbucks location was out of the caramel latte that I have recently become addicted to, but the barista offered to put together a suitable replacement for that selection. This was an excellent quality customer service decision as this also this was my first visit here at this Starbucks location.

I go into this location all the time when I'm picking my husband up at the airport. Recently, his plane was delayed and it was pouring rain so I knew I'd be waiting forever. I ran and the girl working was closing up. She literally had 90% of her stuff put away. With no question or hesitation she stopped and made my drink, to perfection. I offered to order the easiest drink and she insisted I get what I want. Amazing!

I go to this Starbucks regularly, and I'm giving it 3 stars because it closes extremely early, and there's never any where to sit. You would think being so close to campus they would have longer hours. They always run out of things so if you go late in the day you might not even get what you want to order. Other than that, if you go on a good day they make great drinks and they're fast (and I could guarantee you that they will almost always miss spell your name lol)
Good quality service, friendly employees and always an enjoyable experience.  I recommend this establishment everytime
I've probably been in this store 12 times half of the staff is great but my order has been messed up at least 4 times now and I am hesitant to go in depending on who is working.

First of all, where is the speaker box in the drive thru? I drove right passed it. Menu not big enough. Then they stopped selling the salted Carmel cake pops. When I ordered I sat in front of the window for 5 minutes before the lady opened the window. Then she took my gift card and gave it back without a receipt so I have no idea how much is left on it. Then she shuts the window and puts my drink on the counter next to it. I sit here looking at my drink and watch her make 3 more drinks for the  car behind me. She seems to get frazzled by the high volume intensity of her job and forgets that I ordered a plain 'ol iced coffee. So she has to look at the cup a few times and looks up my order on the computer to figure it out. Then she finally opens the window to give me the coffee I was staring at the entire time. Thanks. First AND LAST time I will ever visit this location.

I stop at this location a lot because it's convenient on my drive south on Dale Mabry. My drinks are always correct and the staff has always been helpful. I typically go through the drive thru and pay with the app (I'm still amazed by this:)). 
Today, I tried the new S'mores Frappuccino and it was delicious.  Like a coffee milkshake.  The chocolate, graham crackers and marshmallow were apparent and perfect.  I ordered it with skim milk and without whipped cream to feel a little healthier, but the fact is, it's a dessert... and a great one at that!

I gave it a 3 only because I usually don't have problems with this Starbucks. This morning, however, they were extremely busy and trying to get the line through as fast as possible. It came to be my turn when I gave her my coffee tumbler and got just a black coffee (it was the January edition cup). She yanked the cup out of my hand, filled it up, gave it to me. I put the lid on and started walking away. As I was walking away, the coffee spewed out of the lid, all over my arm. I quickly set my coffee down and took off the lid and noticed she had way overfilled my cup! Not only did coffee get all over my work clothes but I now have a blister on my arm from the coffee. I understand when it is busy that you want to get people in and out but she should have taken the time to make sure the coffee wouldn't spill out of the lid! This has been a few hours and my arm still hurts and is still red.

Rude service at counter. Unfriendly and just miserable greeting. Website says they have unicorn drink yet staff said they didn't ( probably didn't want to make it ). Took forever to get two drinks while 7 employees are standing around. Avoid at all costs.

This has to be the slowest Starbucks in all of Reno. Regardless if you go inside of the the store or go through the drive thru, expect at least a 15 to 20 minute wait. The staff moves so slow and it seems like they are just taking their sweet time even when they're is about 5-7 of them. They also always make your drink wrong 75% of the time.

The food was what you expect from Starbucks. The cleanliness and expediency was just so bad. Someone needs to empty out the garbage can!! Wipe down the counters. Pick up trash from the floor. Mop the floor. 

Where's the store manager? The District Manager needs to check out this store. There was a line of cups. 5 baristas behind the counter, chatting with each other. 2 of them could have helped expedite the drinks. 

Wow.

Very poor service. The lady named Barrisa was rude and fighting with the lady who was Asian (I didn't get her name) and trying to help keep her organized. Took 20 minutes for a simple coffee and I was passed by getting my drink by 4 people.
Both of us paid using credit card, he was asked for ID, and she looked at it like she was memorizing it.  I walked up right after, she didn't even glance at my Credit card.
The coffee here was so much better than other Starbucks. Their coffee is always fresh. The others?seem to have a bitter taste which made me stay away from Starbucks but this one was very good.

Do love my coffee, on weekends in particular. As My brunch buddy & I had to bring  it down couple notches, we came to this one, since some errands had to be around this area. The Store is busy, quite a bit people with tablets or laptops. , we ordered, and seemed little backed up, but started to move quick.I got my grande Caramel Macchiato, Yum..with breakfast sam-mich. Quite good, its nice one, Never feel rushed or the barristers are friendly, but sometimes in Philly , it can get like that, where the employees are having a bad day or something.

Return factor:
 Hell Yes-Hello Coffee Aficionado!!!
This Starbucks is fairly new and I've only ever gone through the drive thru, but the staff is pretty awesome and speedy.

All of the employees seem like they hate their jobs and don't care at all or want to make you a good drink. I saw a barista stand on the counter to clean a sign. That can't be sanitary. Carmel Brulee drink was bland and bitter compared to the Starbucks in Westwood. They don't give you whipped cream on a drink that is supposed to have it, and don't ask if you want whipped cream. There are better quality and more affordable places to get coffee in IV.

Has the training or bean quality dropped from this establishment or what?  Every Americano I have ordered in the past 3 months has tasted burnt.   Also when I order a small, short Americano (meaning not full with water) I get something different almost every time.   I give up Starbucks.  The convenience had me for a while but way too many disappointing visits.

I also have to agree with another post about the teenage party-behind the counter.

Super slow severs in a very busy location.  But, to make mattes worse, the staff is rude.  Maybe they are overworked, but this seems to be a theme here.  No reason to come here when there are better locations.

The workers at this Starbucks are always very kind and they make my drinks very quickly.  That's PERFECT for me since I'm usually running late (sorry I run on Asian time :x).  Overall, great service, great location, and great drinks.  They've never messed up any of my drinks.  My kinda place!
The inside of this starbucks and quality of product is fine, and on par with every other one. I did have a feisty barista serve me though. I can get behind fun employees!

This newly (July 2012) remodeled Starbucks is a great addition to the Mass Ave and Chatham Arch area. The staff is friendly and make good consistent drinks. The inside of the store has a decent amount of seating and the outdoor "patio space" has multiple tables as well. There is even a walk up window where you can order from the sidewalk. It is a great place to grab a quick cup of Joe.
Extremely slow drive-thru. I always check my drink before I pull away because this location tends to make mistakes.
The very best caramel Frappuccino I have ever had and I've had LOTS of them! Friendly, fast, and delicious!

I was pleasantly surprised when I was told they had coconut milk! A venti chai latte with coconut milk is ten times better than with soy milk. 
A little disappointed though because they were out of sandwiches... A chocolate croissant for lunch isn't the most filling (but it tasted as good as the Belgian ones).

Came here this morning by myself. I mobile ordered online so my coffee was ready for me when I got there -- but the staff was friendly and greeted me by name. Since I need coffee everyday, I'll be back tomorrow for sure... I'm here on vacation all week ;)

I was really surprised to see bad reviews for this starbucks! I come here because I like it more than the Starbucks that are closer to me. The employees are very nice and friendly. I also like the layout of the starbucks, I can always find a spot to do homework. Glenn is especially friendly. I have seen him deal with difficult customers and he always remains positive and kind!

Took a long time to get drink- I came for the clover machine and it did not disappoint! Large place with large table. It's in downtown area so not real convenient to "stop" for a coffee. I am definitely glad I tried the clover- it was excellent!

I don't have a favorite starbucks, they've all seemed the same, until i stopped at this one the other night. I could tell by the warm greeting the young lady taking my order had a smile on and seemed genuine. Marily was waiting at the drive thru, she made quick conversation and I felt went the extra mile to make sure my order was right and even offered a suggestion, I was pleased!! This location is out of the way (i have one walking distance from my house) but i will always go the extra mile to stop at this location, customer service was superb!!

Super friendly folks, always clean and they have the Clover system. 

Grab an iced coffee and have them use the Clover system, trust me.

This is a quaint little spot, great for foot traffic. They have a walk up window, which is neat as hell. One downside is you have to ask the counter for the key for the bathrooms... it feels like a shady gas station from an 80's horror movie. Overall, it's a cool spot, consistent coffee, and great people watching.
My drink is always made exactly the way I want it! I also like their selection of desserts as some locations do not offer such variety :-)
The coffee was good but the service ridiculous. Why must we beg and plead for some half and half. We waited over 5 mins for the barista to give us any which eventually made our drink cold.

A very nice Starbucks, and it displays works from local artists.

I've only been here twice, but that's only because I don't live anywhere near Indianapolis.  This place is a very cozy nice little Starbucks with a personable staff and it seems to have a very local and hip feel to it.  The art that hangs on the wall is typically (if not always -- I can't confirm) from local artists.

Starbucks has such high quality control that reviewing one is pretty much a silly exercise. However this Starbucks should be avoided unless you have lots of time to spend. Case in point today is a Sunday. Hit the drive through at 1pm. Spent 16 minutes waiting at the drive through window with no cars in front waiting for one normal drink.  In two trips here over the past month, both were the slowest Starbucks trips ever.
very busy on a sunday morning...hard for the staff to keep up, but they did their best.
Did a mobile order and it took 13 minutes to get the drink. Store was busy and not running both espresso machines simultaneously.

I'm not a coffee drinker.  Imagine my confusion when I was told to buy a traveler jug of coffee and snacks for 4 people at 7 AM!  The night before, I stopped by this location and mentioned that I needed a jug at 7 AM the next morning, but know absolutely nothing about coffee.  The barista breathed a sigh of relief and thanked me for ordering the night before and elaborates on the traveler contents.  The next morning, I arrived at 6:50 to pick up my goods and was out the door by 7.  One barista took care of my entire order.  She heated and individually packed and labelled each pastry.  The coffee was brewed beforehand, but they did not fill the jug until I arrived, which is fine because my jug is fresh!  They did a great job getting me out the door on time with a well organized jug.  You have my business next time I visit Tucson.

What can I say? It's a Starbucks and if you've been to one, you've been to them all.

My "go to's" for Starbucks are always the peppermint mocha frappucino or the pumpkin spice frapp, when it's in season. I stop in here when I am looking for a dessert type of drink and I don't think I have ever actually had real coffee here, now that I think about it.

This is a nice location that usually has people coming and going all day, since it's located on a busy part of Manhattan.

This team is so friendly and welcoming.  They know a lot about the surrounding area which made it possible for me to choose unregrettably, Cuernavaca for my lunch. It's a clean store, could use a good reminder once in awhile, but this is the way Starbucks should be. Thanks team!

The service is usually friendly and it is clean inside.  However, the customers here must not use the app to redeem star rewards.  I've visited here the last 6 times to use the almost 400 stars accumulated but each time the barrista would charge my account instead.  I just lost 130 stars that went expired.  Not the end of the world but really baffling why this is such a struggle at this location.
Only once out the seven or so times I have been here have the staff been friendly, they are usually not even cordial, just plain rude.

Was almost late for work because I didn't plan on the 15 minute wait. I loved the walk-up window, but not sure it was worth it to me. The guy behind me told me the wait is always this long and there are no more than three people working. There were two working that day during the morning rush.

I realized after I checked my app that I was not given a cup discount.

This location is frequently understaffed. However, I order through their mobile app. and I'm able to simply walk in and grab my drink. I love that they offer Coconut Milk for drinks so you can feel somewhat healthy. I always order the Caramel Macchiato and it's my favorite drink.
This is one of my favorite "local" Starbucks. The staff are very polite and pleasant and the atmosphere is great.
Service isn't as efficient at the Marsh Road location, but it works.

I like the location and the walk up window of the Starbucks; but, I've noticed that the service has deteriorated over the past couple of years. I thought that it was just my random visits that resulted in bad service until I've heard other people talking about it. Staff has been less than friendly at times, and the quality of the beverages has been poor. Capital and 16th St., Starbucks is far superior.

If you want to be treated as an important customer at the drive up, go to another Starbucks. This morning the person who gave me my order (2 coffees) didn't offer a carrier even though it was clear that I needed one. And when I gave her extra for a tip she didn't even acknowledge it, nor did she thank me. Then, she put both cups on the same side, and when I turned, the tray fell over and one cup spilled out completely, soaking the carpet in my new car. This doesn't even come close to service. I felt insulted, and won't be back. 

Someone should let these people know that there are many other choices--in fact the next time I'm in the neighborhood I'll go to Human Bean for my coffee. They seem to care how they treat customers. This store clearly doesn't.

This was a welcome experience, leaving my car dealer after my 3,500 mile check and hungry enough to eat a bear.  Well, I went by and of course, I had to stop inside.  Stand-alone store with friendly staff, good selection of edibles, WiFi and parking.

This location of Starbucks is particularly convenient location-wise and is the perfect place to stop after going food shopping (that's what I did). The entrance is a little awkward because the merchandise delineates the order area and it also clutters it up. However, this Starbucks carried a good assortment of the current menu foods and merchandise. Service was fast and friendly, and the coffee tasted just as it always does. Overall, a normal Starbucks location.

This Starbucks has tons of seating and is perfect for coffee with a friend or even meeting with a bigger group!  The drinks are always perfect and the staff is friendly, but bring a sweater - it's always FREEZING.  If you're in a rush, try the drive-thru!
Terrible service, they are generally confused regardless of whether it's busy or slow.  Expect to wait a while for your order and most likely not get what you ordered.

I'm a Starbucks addict and this location used to be my favorite.  Not any longer.   All of the previous awesome employees have been replaced by younger, immature and unprofessional employees that can't make a decent cappuccino.    Very sad.

Slow service.  I usually have a great experience here when i go into the store.  Just did drive thru and waited about 10 mins  for my drink and was offered no apology or any real expression of concern for the wait by the cashier.  Thankfully my drink is good!

Always a long line here. Only Starbucks walking distance on Harbour island so I do come often with my daughter. A few nice tables outside to sit at. Easily accessible on foot, if your driving you'll have to park at the hotel parking garage.

The 3rd of the 4 locations I frequent - this location holds that cozy "catch - up with friends" feel to it. And, literally, that is what many of the regulars do here - especially on Saturday mornings. It's the place where many take their "me" time after a monotonous day of work. The partners at this location just add to that ability. April had been at this location since she transferred from the Willow Lake store years ago. She and the other partners have truly given this location that feel of comfort and their attention to detail in customer service is outstanding!

Stopped here while waiting for my plane. No one in line when I got here. Ordered a talk coffee & bacon & egg sandwich. The gal at the counter haggled with me about giving her .09 cents so I didn't have to get .91 cents change back. Only had a small purse so didn't want all the change. Anyway I just put the .91 cents in the tip jar. I got my coffee but had to wait 10 min for the sandwich. They served 6 people that came after me before me. I asked for my sandwich , she said there working on it. Finally a gal put my sandwich in the toaster and gave it to me. I think the little gal at the register made me wait deliberately. So sad that there's not good customer service here. Btw my sandwich was cold.

This Starbucks forces you to buy something in order to use their bathroom.  That would be okay if they were a small business, but since they are a large corporation I find this policy aggravating.  Even in New York City the staff will give you a code irregardless.  I won't be buying Starbucks ever again--hopefully.  I think the bathroom code was 5832 of you need it.

Love that Starbucks has a drive-through! Makes it seriously convenient for anybody on the go, especially with young children Intel. Great service, friendly staff, always a pleasure to frequent a Starbucks.
ordered coffee from a nice fella who was surprisingly fun.   Drink came up fast and the store is clean and in a great location.  pay parking btw, but there's plenty of it.  go!

This place, for the life of them, cannot get a flat white correct.  I got them here for months, never a problem, then all of a sudden they just can't get it right.  I don't know if they're experimenting with the formula or trying to save money by leaving something out, but it's always watery and bland.  I called corporate the other day to tell them that whoever is in charge of this location needs help bad, they need some updated training or new machines or help ordering product or something.  Several times I would get my flat white, taste it, and then tell them it's not right, they just look confused, I usually end up telling them to just add another shot to it so I can stomach the rest, but this is ridiculous.  From now on I'll just go to a different Starbucks, maybe try this one again in six months or something.

Scone was dry and tasteless, and the mocha was not the best I have had even from a Starbucks. The establishment is always overpriced for what you're getting, but the staff was quick, got the order right and nice enough to not make me hate them while I know I am about to be sitting on a cramped airplane for the next couple hours. Hence, they're pretty damn good.
Staff here is really slow. I was in the Drive Thru for 25 minutes! I was almost late for work.
Typical starbucks except there is no drive thru and the parking is horrible.  There are minimal spots that are almost always full around lunchtime.

This Starbucks is located inside a hotel, the Embassy Suites. Though it looks like a Starbucks inside with the decor, the drinks do not taste the same. The value here is convenience if you are staying in the hotel or nearby on the Riverwalk.

IMPORTANT NOTE: NO FREE STARBUCKS WI-FI HERE!

The employees are very friendly, but I almost always have the same complaint about my drink, even though I order the same thing. It never tasted the same, almost like whoever made my drink forgot something.

I know, it's a Starbucks. I promise, though, that this one is better than most. The baristas are friendly, quick, and they make a mean cup of whatever you drink. It's not as busy as other Starbucks as well, given its weird location. This means that there are usually tables available with outlets. That's a huge plus for a freelance programmer like me. 

Plus, their Google Wi-fi is ridiculously fast. This is usually due to the low number of people in here, but man, it's faster than my cable internet at home most of the time. 

Needless to say, I come here very often and I stay for hours. I'm a fan.

I can't say that I ran into the same issue as the previous person that reviewed this Starbucks. In fact, I had a rather positive experience.

Driving down the road, I had a hankering for a Soy Chai Tea Latte right about the time I passed this Starbucks. I swung in and realized I had to go inside because there isn't a drive thru. I also realized after I parked by the door there was a big sign with an arrow that said "use other door" right where everyone else was parked. 

There were a couple of people in line ahead of me, but the cashier kept the pace moving and before I knew it, I was ordering and swiping my app to pay. There was only one barista crafting the drinks, so there was a little bit of a delay in getting my beverage, but it was perfectly prepared (I ordered it extra hot, and this was the perfect temp) and tasted wonderful. 

A solid 4 star review.. I just can't give a 5-star to a Starbucks without a drive thru. I debated on sitting out front and honking until someone came out and gave them my order, but that sounded rude.
I'd rather come here to study rather than the library. I enjoy a nice caffinated drink while listening to smooth jazzy music (most of the time) Infested with college kids, it never gets boring here.

Best triple mocha frap. However, service is bad, don't call your name when drinks ready, trash bins over flowing, and condiments bar was filthy. Second time here this week, and same great drink but bad service and dirty store.

This is one of my favourite Starbucks! Every time I go they have really pleasant people working, even when I awkwardly lurk around trying to decide what drink to get they are very friendly. 

One time I ordered a Red Velvet Frappe but had no idea what was even in it and they baristas were so friendly! They guessed at what would be in it, made it for me, then told me if it tasted gross they would make me something else. (It tasted pretty good to me.) It's really nice having the service being so friendly and helpful. 

The location is very convenient and they've got a huge parking space. Unfortunately there's no drive thru, so you'll have to go on a jaunt into the store to get your coffee on.

The pluses: Good sized dining room. Great, friendly staff. Great outdoor seating. Close to downtown. And it's frequented by many of my friends (I know you don't care)! 

The negatives: Parking is difficult (Small for several businesses). It's so busy that it frequently feels messy.  No drive-thru. 

Not my fav St. Pete Starbucks, but not a bad choice if you're on that side of town.

This Starbucks is near my office, so I've gone a bunch of times for lunch. I can tell you that both their pre-packaged lunches and their frappacinos and teas are up to par, and the service is prompt and efficient. I usually come mid to late afternoons, and even then it is busy but I can always find a spot. It seems to be a favorite for tutors and highpowered business people in particular. I can't vouch for early mornings waits, but from what I've seen this location is a good one.

Starbucks at the Airport doesn't compare to your local Starbucks. Just feels like the standards are totally different. 

On my latest experience my hot turkey bacon egg white sandwich came out extra cold, cappuccino was blah. Nothing new.

I agree that the view probably wasn't an issue when they leased the building.  The store is ALWAYS CLEAN, and the Staff is ALWAYS FRIENDLY.  As a regular at this store, they remember not only my name, but my favorites.

I think this is why I see a lot of "regulars" in this store.  The atmosphere is warm and comfortable, and a lot of young people hang out there to use their computers/internet.

This is one of the slowest Starbucks in the airport system.. been in line  over 5 minutes and 3 people have been helped so far... not enough employees working.. there are 4 and one is stocking items..

Super friendly staff! Don't really do Starbucks too often but I will be sure to come back to this one. Ordered a venti Passiontango iced tea with a Bacon Gouda Egg Sandwich. Everything was super yummy!!
Beans taste burnt and lower quality than Kaldis. Plus your money goes to Seattle and not locally.
Friendly cashier, not good coffee.  Definitely not a Starbucks filled with employees taking any pride in their work or their creations as baristas.  Not impressed.

The baristas here are super nice! Every time I've been here, it's usually not too busy with walk-ins. It seems like people use the drive-thru a lot more at this location. I really like to come here as a study spot! :)
This Starbucks is great! Quick drinks that taste amazing! The cashier complimented my nails which is always a good way to start your day.

I came here randomly and actually tried the online purchasing option. It worked very well and walked right in and was handed my drink. The place has a decent amount of seating options. The employees here very nice and overall place is clean. I'm not too sure about the bathrooms though. 

The drink was very good and the parking here is great unlike over crowded Philadelphia. I felt comfortable hanging out here and enjoyed relaxing and consuming my beverage. I will for sure stop by again when I'm in the area.
They know the drink by the fifth time you walk in, and your name by week 2. Laurie there introduced me to the Skinny Mocha WITH a shot of Toffee Nut. Im hooked.

The baristas have no sense of urgency. I need my coffee. This is very urgent. It does get busy from time to time, but even when there's nobody in line, it still takes a good ten minutes to get my drink...

but hey, starbucks is starbucks and green tea frappuccinos call  my name~

The coffee is pretty good..most of the staff are pretty nice. But the people going through the drive thru or pulling out of parking lots are psychotic. This however is not Starbucks fault. Overall pretty good services and staff.

Not a fan of Starbucks. Coffee is adequate in a pinch. Had a business meeting here. This review is limited to the iced caramel Machiato which was quickly served and prepared as you would imagine. Environment was clean and reasonably well kept, but honestly I really just don't like their coffee. Probably just me but I think Starbucks coffee taste like strained sock water. Not going to ding the rating as the taste of their product is obviously way out of any employee at the local level's control.

The staff is lovely and the drive thru is convenient. I once saw the drive thru line was super long so I decided to go in, thinking it would be faster. But they use the sticker system for orders, so it didn't seem to make a difference. 

Did find myself super annoyed that at 10am on a Monday they were out of the spinach feta wrap, along with other breakfast items. In my opinion there is no reason for that to ever happen. They should take a look at their ordering to ensure that doesn't continue to happen. It doesn't make sense from a business standpoint and they'll certainly lose customers to the other locations nearby

Jade is far the best Barista I have ever came across EVER!!!!!  
She is very patient with my order she actually listens to my needs and makes the BEST beverage....
 I would highly recommend her to make your drink. I guarantee you won't be disappointed. 

Thank you Jade!!!!

A Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks haha. I come here every morniny after I drop my son off to school before I head to school myself. I avoid the lines inside and hit the drive through. It's right next to game stop and within walkng distance of my gym. The baristas are always friendly like most Starbucks employees are. Not much to say, although I was a little disappointed they were out of their banana bread.

Interesting that the signs on the door say open at 530 am. Yelp has the open time as 6am. Waiting for 10 minutes this morning for doors to open. Just change the sign to 6am if that's when the store opens so people don't think the employees are just ignoring you while you try to open locked doors. That is all.

I am very impressed with the manager at this Starbucks. She is professional and nice. I had a problem with a drink and she was very courteous and helpful in replacing it.  It is a very busy business and they still manage to be happy nice employees.

Stop here on occasion for a little coffee-pick-me-up.  There is usually a bit of a line, but they work quickly so not too big of a deal.  They have plenty of seating but not very conducive to private conversation as the tables are inordinately close together.  The service is always friendly and fast.  Overall, your average Starbucks experience, which is a-ok in my book.  

One final note:  I saw a previous reviewer mention a drive-thru but there is no drive thru at this location--wondering if they were thinking of 36th and State Street as that Starbucks most certainly does have a drive-thru?

You are likely to register a new car at the DMV on a Friday in a shorter amount of time then it  will take you to get your order at this drive through.  The wait however is not the worst part.  When you get to the window the strong odor of diarrhea hits you in the face like a brick.  To add to the disappointment your iced coffees will come out hot and your hot coffees will come out cold.  They are also almost always out of cake pops and their other special kids treats.  I will not usually rate a place this bad unless I have been there 6 or more times and experienced the same disappointment each time.  This is the case with this Starbucks as it is consistently missing the mark with cleanliness, speed, and availability of menu items.

In my opinion, the only Starbucks in town. This location has the friendliest and most knowledgeable baristas around. I work at the Home Depot right across the street and have been extremely loyal to this location for many reasons for years.
Steph, the manager, and her staff actually take time to personalize your visit. If you are a regular, they will learn your name. If you have a regular drink, they will know it.
Thank you very much Northtowne Starbucks for keeping me awake in my dyer moments Of melatonin filled need!
You will see my business always and often!

As busy as any busy airport Starbucks gets. Service was not friendly in taking the order and pastries don't get toasted here (I'm assuming they're too busy to offer this).  

The drink order was prepared faster than expected despite the 15+ person line. I liked the spacious layout of this location as it flowed well.

My gripe besides service is that when I got my drink I almost wanted to return it since it didn't taste like much at all. However being short on flight connection time I let it go. Should've known that they didn't stir as all the pumpkin spice syrup was at the bottom and now I have an overly flavorful drink.. You win some you lose some.

The location is nice but the barista is mean and blunt. I never feel they are nice to the customer.even though location is convience,.... well..i am not going to the starbucks anymore...There are plenty  of starbucks in the world... barista makes me angry every time...Go to another starbucks....

Although it has Starbucks in the marquis, the experience ends there.  The two stars as follows 
1) clean 
2) it's a Starbucks.  
There is another option on the delta side.  Smaller but better.  This one has a sitting area and tables.  The delta side does not
Avoid the line. Avoid the disappointment. Avoid this Starbucks. Simply put, it just "isn't."

honestly, for better coffee and better customer service, go to caje or even the arbor. i've been here three times and every time i had to wait for the employees to finish their conversation before i got hit with a rude "are you ready to order or what." I would've given an extra star for making my order correctly but they can't even do that! ordered a chai latte and got watery mud. don't even bother coming here.

This is a great Starbucks.  Actually serves some great food with great java.  The atmosphere is very professional at this location and it is super clean.  Gotta say this location is my favorite.  They make Seattle proud.

Starbucks worldwide is such a hot spot for a great cup of coffee or just to meet up over some hot tea. This branch is like all others, with a happy bunch of servers and a cute setup. With the recent red cups out I had to be one of the first to try it out. Despite the big controversy about the design this year everyone still wants it lol. The first time I tried the chestnut praline, that had caramelized chestnuts and spices with roast coffee,milk and ice. It was a tad bit too sweet for my liking. The next time I tried the Gingerbread, I hated it. Ive eaten gingerbread biscuits and I thought it would have that flavour but oh no it was just too distasteful. My friend tried the Eggnog latte, as we had a buy one get one free on the festive flavours. Even this had this weird unpleasant taste, I think it's the grounded nutmeg that brings this flavour to it. So I don't think I'm a big fan of the festive lattes, however I love the double chocolate mocha frap and all the other fraps Starbucks serves. 
Also I was amazed when they gave away four free drinks randomly. That was very sweet of them to do so.

Unfortunately I ordered a simple latte and I'm assuming it wasn't so simple for the lady making this coffee. I ordered a Skinny Venti Latte, with Soy milk. I don't know what it was I received but it resembled mud in a cup. I know it's possible this older lady saws new then I blame management for putting her in the busiest place at an extremely busy time. It's not like I was getting a Seventy Five Cents Water, and I am sorry I expect my Latte to taste like good coffee. This was AWFUL!!! To management do not put an u trained person at the helm of the expresso machine when LITERALLY the clients had to tell her how to make their drinks, during a busy time. You should be ashamed of your business practices if this all you care about your customers! Someone needs to address this as this is a busy location. If it hadn't been so busy I would have gotten my money back but who has time to wait through a big line AGAIN!

Parking can be difficult at this location but thats the same song for most places in the village. Parking garage is available two blocks away on College ave plus taking a stroll is what broad ripple is all about. Even though its not the best location to grab coffee on the run, I do prefer this one if I want to chill and hang out with a friend especially in the winter because they have a wood burning fireplace.  Haven't seen another starbucks with a fireplace...very cozy and an average amount of seating is available. 
Staff is always helpful and friendly. Great spot to people watch as it is in the heart of broad ripple with window viewing galore.

WORST place ever! Turn around or order mediocre coffee on your flight, you'll be happier. Terrible customer service and they want to charge you for flavoring even when your drink comes with it!!
