As I'm getting out of the line I hear him yell his coworker I had attitude too, he couldn't wait and keep his comment to himself until I left...I go to Starbucks twice daily for the past 11years, sad to have to write a bad review...I would walk over to Berry Field and order fresh coffee or cold brew from there

Terrible service. I asked for a pastry twice and the barista still gave me the wrong item. She also "cooked" the pastry which should have been served cold. When I asked her about it she acted like it was my fault she gave me the wrong item.

Quick tip! If you bring your own mug, you get $0.10 off your coffee!  I had the breakfast sandwich, it was pretty good.  I think the better value breakfast sandwich is at Subway.  They have whole grain muffins and egg whites.
Don't expect them to have much product. Today they were out of caramel, plain bagels, stevia, just to name a few. They openly argue with each other and could use a lesson in professionalism.

I love Starbucks, so I've been to lots of different locations, and this one is by far the best! I must say, I only use the drive through, so I can't speak to service/atmosphere inside. I always get the same drink, and it is the most consistent I have ever had. Most places your drink always tastes different, a least a little bit. But here, always perfect! Fastest drive through I've ever seen--they will have a line around the corner and work everyone through and be back to no line in 5 minutes, no joke! Thanks for making my mornings easy and delicious :)

Drive Thru:  Doesn't matter what time of the day, there is ALWAYS a line.  

Customer Service:  This particular location has some of the unfriendliest, disinterested and unhelpful staff I've ever encountered.  

Location:  City Avenue is always busy so it's usually a hassle trying to get out of the plaza onto the street.

It's Starbucks.  The coffee is always consistent. The great thing about Starbucks is you always know what to expect.  

The staff was friendly, the store was clean.  A good visit.

Comfortable leather (looking) chairs.  It made a good stop for an after movie drink and snack.  

The croissant was not very good, especially after having a excellent one a couple days before.  The oatmeal raisin cookie was pretty good.  

I am not a Starbucks acolyte, and it always seems strange that everyone around me seems to be in this highly efficient and exact routine when I go to a Starbucks.  

They have Tazo tea, and the chai wasn't bad.

Absolutely love this Starbucks! In my opinion it's in the wrong spot. Should be more centered in the mall. The coffee is amazing! I recommend the passion fruit sweetened tea or the pumpkin spice latte. The workers are very fast compared to other Starbucks staff. The store itself is modern and very clean. It's a little small and lacks seating. But that's probably the biggest store they could get. Absolutely love this Starbucks! Doesn't get any better than this!

I really like this location it's easy to get in and out of. They have a lot of seating inside and outside. No drive-thru but the staff is so awesome it's worth going in. Logan is extremely nice he really helped me out this morning when my app on my phone wasn't cooperating.
Oh my god. Slowest place ever. Late for work because of them. Staff seems completely aloof and not even trying. This is simple to fix with some management help.

If I could give a negative stars on this starbucks location, I very much would. The kid behind the counter didn't get my name right, ok no big deal. I clearly and politely said no whip because it gets nasty on the bottom. The girl making I watched knowing out of their routine would put it on. Sure enough, she reaches for the whip dispenser and I spoke up nicely. She gave me a death stare and plastic smile that made me want to throw my beverage at her. I hope the manager sees my post and will give all of his staff a talking to on good customer service. I could see where I would be wrong if I was demanding and rude, but I was not all. A customer should feel good about their experience. I felt nothing but like an inconvenience. I will never go to this location again.

I have been going to this Starbucks for years and I have never been let down. From customer service to quality of product, this Starbucks always delivers!! Highly recommend this Starbucks, best barista in the area by far.

The line goes quickly but it takes forever for them to execute your order. I don't appreciate the fact that people that have ordered after us got their drinks before us. I come back every once in a while, and it is a great place to work or just take a load off.

Very small and cramped, but does the job when you need some good coffee quick while catching a flight.

Staff is pretty nice and tries to get your order fast.

Line would go out the door when it's busy and crowded, but that's pretty much expected when it's the only Starbucks for the airport terminal (there's a larger location within the terminal, but that at Gate A AFTER your go through the security checks).

I would not get coffee here or attempt to wait in line if its long and you have a flight to catch, because you would need to go through security after you getting this coffee, and they might ask you to toss it out when it comes to screening.
I just bought an ice coffee, it's the Slowest drive thru service with rude attitude!  You can see the ladies work there are joking and laughing doing nothing thru the glasses.

Decent, inside is usually a little dirty with ok seating, staff is hit or miss. The tall tan gentleman is very friendly he should be manager. Cause the female manager with red hair can often be very rude at times which shows with some of her female employees which can be even worse . Definitely poor management. Coffee is usually room temp cause it's old and they do the trick where you slightly lift the coffee container and trick the time to think its a new batch, doesn't work for me buddy. And they need to empty their trash more often usually it's all overflowing like the dump in Wilmington . Overall I wouldn't relate this store to the Starbucks image cause it is a disappointment. But with a little work and more friendly attitudes it could be alot better and even reach 4-5 stars.
Hands down the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. I got a frappuccino and it had no sweetener tasted like black coffee

The lady named Reba at the register was such a b-word for no reason. Rude to our entire group and it was for no reason. She continued her attitude with guests after us. I actually didn't order anything and she said something slick to me. Usually I tip Starbucks employees because I know they're running around at a high volume place but this was a definitely no from me. She ruined it for everyone. I don't get how she even has a job in customer service let alone a Starbucks.

Maybe it's bc I don't come here early in the morning, but this is the fastest Starbucks I have ever been too (which is great bc it is pretty small and cozy in here).  The parking lot is crazy small since there are a few other businesses in this plaza and it is at a busy intersection, so that sucks.  Other than that, they've never messed up my order so I can't complain.

This Starbucks just did a remodel on the inside.  I like the changes.  I like Starbucks coffee.  This location is just grand.  I have always been treated with courtesy and respect.  They also have free WiFi at this location.  I like it.

Quick Tip:
Register your Starbucks gift card and get free refills!

Randomly locked up at 8:09 with no sign on the door and employees still inside when the posted hours are open until 9:00.... and for some reason my drink always tastes like a kiosk Starbucks from Albertsons or something compared to other locations. Friendly service, though.

If you can get to it, its great.

The parking lot makes NO sense. It's teeeeny tiny and you can easily get trapped, especially if you are coming from the Linebaugh entrance. The gigantic parking lot immediately west (an office park) offers free towing for anyone foolish enough to park there. The drive thru line is frequently backed up so that getting to parking spaces (or out of them) is impossible. For some strange reason they decided to put an outdoor seating patio where a passthrough lane would have made MUCH more sense. UGh!!! That parking lot setup is dumb. 

Say you're lucky enough to park and go inside. Its really well-appointed. There are many workstations and comfy seating. It always feels like it needs a teeny bit of cleaning, but the staff is nice and banging out frappes and lattes pretty quickly. They don't get all pissy when you order a medium because you can't remember which quasi-fake Italian word they've chosen to represent medium. I like that, because, obviously I cannot retain the Starbucks sizing names in my brain.

If you choose the drive through, you may be in for a wait if the line is long. They do their best to keep it moving. Please be aware there is a pedestrian crossing through the drive through lane. After you give your order, screeching up to the window is not advised, as you could really hurt someone trying to cross.

I tried out this Starbucks last weekend on my way to an appointment at Saks. I ordered ahead since I had my baby with me and knew they didn't have a drive thru. This strip of businesses is always pretty busy so getting in and out of the parking lot can kind of be a pain especially lugging around a baby carrier. I waited at the pick up counter which they were a little slow making my mobile order. They don't greet you at all and didn't call out my drink they just put it out on the counter. I would probably only come back to this location if I'm in the area but without a drive thru and the hassle for not friendly service it's probably not really worth it.

I'm a huge Starbucks fan and have come to this starbucks 3-4 times a week on average for about 4 months now. They keep the place nice and clean but aren't as personable at this one as I've experienced in other starbucks stores. I'd usually be called by name by now and my drink would have been memorized.  My drinks are always great as usual though. 
My biggest thing is that it's not as cozy here. I'd like to see some couch chairs in the near future. 

Sincerely,
The girl that orders the raspberry white mocha every time.

Super disappointed that I just had to sit here and wait 15 minutes for my one drink. There was a lot of people in the Drive-Thru and apparently they got priority. There was only one person ahead of me inside the store. And they didn't even apologize or offer me anything for having to wait for so long for one drink
Really awesome location. Not real hard to find parking, and building has kind of an industrial chic flavor. Employees weren't real friendly but I'd def come here again.

I have never seen such "horrible " customer service.  Working in the customer service industry myself. I know that Starbucks, is a very, very well known brand that prides itself on quality and customer service. I don't know what happened with this location but, it needs to be shut down and everyone retrained. The coffee, food and customer service is horrible. Each time I say to myself maybe this time it will be better. And of course it's not. The one time that I did ask for them to remake a drink. I was looked at as if I was the problem. How hard is it to me a Carmel Macchiato? Now, I just go to the Dunkin Donuts. They have a good product and always have a smile.

I tried it this morning and will absolutely never go back.

I get better service from the kiosk at Target in West Clay. I was coming to work from a different direction this morning and not only did they not care when I told them their Thanksgiving blend tasted horrible, but the cashier completely drained my Starbucks card and screwed up my rewards when I was trying to buy my coffee with a card for my wife.

The barista was rude. Not my fault the place is so loud and you can't hear well. I've only recently gotten into the Starbucks experience, but I know it's not supposed to be this.

Been here a few times in the past. The store seems clean and organized. I feel like they are short staffed but the staff that is there put alot of effort into their job. Today, Rachel is fast and efficient at taking orders, always pleasant and Starbucks is lucky to have her as an employee.

This spacious and air conditioned (woohoo!) Starbucks works for me. There are quite a few poor reviews but, if you close your eyes and turn around three times, it's still a perfectly fine, clean, and well decorated Starbucks. 

OK. It is in Downtown Clearwater but I can't hold that against the Starbucks mothership. Instead, I'd like to thank them for opening one here in the center of Sci-Fi, pay-as-you-go, no-money-back-if-you-don't-get-to-heaven religion.

Best Starbucks ever! I really love coming in and starting my day off with my favorite baristas April and kirby! They are the sweetest girls and always make my drink perfectly! They are truly the heart of 86th and ditch!

If I could rate this a -5 I would. I understand they were busy, but all my mom wanted was a damn ice water and we waited for prob 5 minutes..so my mom says nicely "could I get my ice water?" And some worker that she wasn't even talking to said "ma'am, she'll get it okay?" (With attitude) and then my mom says "okay, I just wasn't sure if she heard me or not". Then the employee begins to say "okay just chill out she will get your water when she can" so my mom starts to walk away and the employee is yelling from across the room at my mom saying that my mom had attitude...which she didn't have attitude whatsoever. Sooooo long story short, there is a very unprofessional lady that works there and needs to be fired.
Nice location, I used to do the drive through almost every day before work, the cashiers are always pleasant.

They had my favorite breakfast sandwich here! The slow roasted ham and Swiss on a croissant! So many Starbucks are sold out of this delicious sandwich but this one always seems to have it! Thanks guys. They also have a drive thru

This is a really good location for a coffee shop.  The seating area is large and very comfortable with free wifi.  There is also a large table with 10 chairs around it and I often see people come in for informal meetings.  The staff is always very pleasant -  true rarity.  A great place to hang out!!!

I work close by, stopping at the drive thru once or twice a week before work. My order is correct maybe once or twice every couple weeks. Baristas are quick to ask me if my order is complete halfway through my sentence. Looking for somewhere else to go, kept trying to give this place chances but tired of spending my money on stuff on drinks made improperly, especially when I don't have the option to go back and have my order corrected.

Great service.  Environment is fun.  Coffee is good... of course.  However, the stools are the worst thing your rear-end has ever sat on.  Be one of the lucky ones who gets one of the two arm chairs by the fireplace or at the community table.  OR bring a pillow to sit on if you plan to actually stay awhile.  Ending on a good note:  STAFF IS SUPER NICE & they are constantly updating the food in the display case so it is fresh.
Worst Starbucks ever, customer service is bad they just want you to get out give you the order half way, won't come back to this Starbucks again that's for sure
Saturday morning and this Starbucks had as friendly a staff as I have seen at one of these quaint little stops. Thank you ladies for helping start my vacation off well.
Service here is so quick!! Always use the drive through and even when it's loaded with cars.... They still get you out of there fast! It's impressive.
Okay...20 minUtes to walk in and get iced coffee, as the drink wasn't made to order and all the milk containErs are empty.....and drive through is too busy to fill them ...drive up don't walk in.

Starbucks not something I would typically review since they're all about the same no matter where I go. But the staff was so nice that I felt compelled to say so on here. The cashier (Michelle) was super friendly to everyone in line and made a normal trip to Starbucks way better.

I have to say that I am generally a big fan of Starbucks for a) their customer service and b) their 'go green' mentality. However... The workers there seem more rude than I usually am when I wake up without caffinee. Also the lady who glared at me for my 'complicated order' decided to charge me extra. When I said she charged me for the wrong thing... she just said 'it's how much it normally costs'. On top of that... she made my order wrong. 
I'd rather go to Caje... that place tops all the other java and tea places here in IV.

Wheatards rejoice! Starbucks has finally added a little more to their skimpy gluten free repertoire.... it's a brand of cookies called "Lucy's". I've only tried the chocolate chip [there were several other flavors] but they were tasty.  More on the crisp side but hey, they were gf! Would have added a star had the barista knew what the heck I was talking about when I requested something gluten free. This is one of my fave locations... spacious, friendly baristas, close to work and sunny outdoor seating. Thanks Starbucks!

Recently, I have had a few issues with the service and this particular Starbucks, I never have a problem in the morning when I get my coffee, but towards the end of the day and on certain days, the service seems to go down hill. I really like this Starbucks because I usually always get what I want and my order is always on point, but recent trips through the drive-thru have not been the best. The past two trips I have ordered two drinks and my first one always comes out, then they always forget my second one. The other day I ordered two coffees, the girl gave me one and left mine sitting on the counter and walked away, I waited about five minutes before another worker realized I was still there. Just yesterday the same thing happened, and I had to remind her I had another one waiting behind her, I don't know what it is, but I go back because the morning staff always takes care of me right, I hope the customer service doesn't keep up this way because I don't want to find a new Starbucks.

Terrible cold brew. I ordered a Trente because I needed the boost to get stuff done this morning. I watched them fill the cup 1/3 of the way and they handed it back to me severely watered down with melted ice less than 30 seconds later, which leads me to believe they filled the rest with water... super upsetting considering I spent $5 on a COFFEE.
larger Starbucks w good outdoor seating that is shared w other businesses. Good indoor seating as well - perfect for studying.
Made my very "extra" drink perfectly when I did Mobil order, estimated to take 8-12 min and was done in 8
Friendly end unique staff which you don't get at a lot of other Starbucks. Really has the broadripple charm. My drinks have always been made just right and never had anything I didn't like

First time at this Starbucks in North Valleys.  The staff was very nice and service was prompt.  Their drive thru seems to be very busy.  I was there mid morning.  The dining area is quite small compared other Starbucks I have been too.  Chairs were comfortable, but tables were pretty small.  There are two larger tables for those with laptops.  You can function on the smaller tables, but are confined a bit against the wall.  

The dining area was well kept and there are outside seating options as well.  The music was a little loud for my liking.  Any conversation you would have would have to carry over the music, thus increasing the overall chatter level in the dining area a little louder then normal. The men's bathroom was well kept and clean and all personal hygiene supplies were stocked for use.  

Overall, I enjoyed my experience at this location.  If they toned down the music a little bit, then it would definitely be a 4.5 to 5 star rating.  Cheers!

I come here often and I'm satisfied with their customer service.  Starbucks, most of the time, have superior customer service and I love the ambiance of this one. It has more than adequate seating and table space to do work or lounge around.

Normally you get average service here and adequate drinks..nothing abovenor beyond at this location. But today... today I was a bbn ke ro chew my coffee for the first time..what a fun surprise. Barista said sorry we dont  have cold brew... then Oh wait yes we do ... okay awesome. Now we get them handed to us and immediately take a drink as the 630 am grind every morning requires been instant caffienation. Solid coffee grounds in both drinks. .. okay everyone has a whoops now  and then. So we drive back around and go to let the cashier know these drinks are nasty. She never offers an apology just looks at them, then makes us new ones. Husband brings them back out to the car, I check the botton..cool looks good. Were already running late now (going through the line twice) and first drink in??? Awful..it tastes like dishwater .. it's clearly not cold brew. This is our normal go to drink and we get it often... way to mess up a friday guys.

Typical Starbucks. 
This one seem to be having trouble processing orders. I had to wait almost 10 minutes for my drink and several other people had ordered after me had received theirs. I think they were training people, so I will give them a pass on this delay.

I think of this Starbucks as a "tourist Starbucks" located near the Convention Center at the Tampa Embassy Suites it's smaller than the average, less populated and lacking all the wifi lovers!!! Went in on a Saturday evening and there was just one other customer there, it has about 4 tables inside and a few more in the patio area with a convenient bike rack. Service was good but can't speak about their food selection since I didn't try anything but drinks. Love the location looking at the water will definitely be back. The hotel has a parking garage and near by parking is also available.

Had an amazing time this morning at Starbucks. Our cashier Eugene was just the sweetest as always and really helped me choose what tea I wanted. He's such a great employee and remembers me and my housemates every time!

I would just like to say a big thank you to every member on staff at the Starbucks. Thank you for letting me order drinks over the phone when I'm running late, thank you for caring for plus boxes out to my car, and thank you for not judging me when I show up in nothing but my PJs. You're an awesome team and you all rock.

I order 2 peppermint mocha frappuccino. They were perfect with the holiday season upon us. They were slow with the stickers for a free drink. The staff seemed unfriendly and wasn't all that nice.
The drinks were good but the staff needs to be more welcoming to their customers.

I am a fan of this Starbucks, they always get my order right and the are fast about.  Friendly and nice that's important to me!  I get the same thing every time a house brewed coffee room for cream and sweetener....    There is handful of Starbucks all over the valley, this is a good site!

I really enjoy Starbucks as my go to coffee stop and really hate to say anything negatively about it but this location is just not getting it right. First of all, the parking is horrendous and so small. Especially in the mornings when the drive thru line is long you can literally not get out of the parking lot. Parking aside I can't say I've had a great coffee from this specific Starbucks. Majority of the time I order the same drink so when it tastes different it's obvious. It is either not sweet enough or two sweet, sometimes not strong enough. When I go to a large chain I expect to get the same results each time and expect quality but I can't rely on this Starbucks location for that which is a shame because it is closest to my work. The one positive I do have is that the employees are always very friendly!

I just went in this Starbucks and got a delicious coffee. I ordered the hazelnut latte with an extra shot of espresso. It was made perfect! The staff was friendly, and also busy. I had to leave a compliment for all of them. The shop is clean and things seem to run smoothly. I also want to add that during my visit, a woman came in, and proceeded to blame Starbucks/Employees for spilling her coffee. The manager handled it gracefully. I have to say I'm not sure how a barista can make sure you don't spill your coffee, after you have pulled away and you are at a red light ( these are her words). I have been in the service industry, and I know these people are everywhere. It just feels a bit more obscene when they do it around the holidays. Shoutout to all Service Industry this holiday season!

The last time I came here, I got an iced matcha latte with a shot of espresso in it. I've gotten this many many times before at this Starbucks and other Starbucks. When I got my drink, the matcha clumped together and sat at the bottom of my drink... At first I was going to leave and just try to drink it as I was in a hurry, but I took a sip. It was really really damn bad. 

So I bring in my drink to ask them to remake it and this employee literally just told me that the espresso shot messed with the matcha and that the way she made it was correct. What...?

So I see her pour out my latte into another cup and then top that off with matcha and slightly shake it. And the drink is still clumpy and gross. Why Starbucks WHY

I fly out of Nashville, almost, weekly and decided I'd stop. I remember why I don't. The only reason this place is still open is it's inside this airport.
The service sucks, the coffee is made wrong and by the time you get it you can't get them to make it right or you'll miss your plane.
Avoid Avoid Avoid

Some of the baristas at this location are very rude. The men, I would say are the only friendly ones there. They are good at making drinks but several of the "teeny bopper" baristas in this location lack customer service skills. They need more training in the "friendly"department.

This is probably my favorite Starbucks.  I travel quite frequently and make it a habit to stop here on my way to baggage claim since I have time to kill; the St Louis airport takes 30-40 minutes for your bags to come out.  That's another story though.

Anyway, what I like about this Starbucks is how friendly the staff is.  There's always the same two girls working here and they are always happy and cheerful.  And, they provide great service.  Plus, they make an excellent quad tall cappuccino.  I go here so often that they now remember what I order.  

The girls always act like I'm crazy for ordering a quad.  I guess people rarely order 4 shots of espresso at a time!

BTW, this review is in reference to the Starbucks right outside of Baggage Claim.  The other Starbucks in the terminals are lame and the staff in those Starbucks acts like you've asked the world of them to simply take your order, much less do something like make your drink!
Literally the slowest Starbucks you stop ever go to. I have been to this location many times and don't be fooled by a couple people in line, you will still wait a longgggggg time :-(

Every time I have gone to this store whether it be drive through or walk in Ieave angry or feeling down on myself. The service is HORRIBLE, they always mess up my drink, and they make you feel less than. This Starbucks is on my way to work and I would stop every Thursday and Friday and EVERY TIME they were extremely rude and messed up my very simple drink. The management is as bad as the employees and makes me cringe. The trash can is always way to full and you have to try and JAM your cup inside. I wish I could say it was just one employee but sadly I've had an issue with nearly every one in the morning. If I'm going to be paying $5 for a coffee I expect it to be right and for the employees to not give me attitude. Too much to ask?? I did have one pleasant experience when I stopped late afternoon. Do yourself a favor and stop somewhere else.
Consistently good. Try the orange spiced iced coffee!

Cute, cozy Starbucks. I'm only giving it three stars because of the music.  No one comes to a cafe to listen to every song Taylor Swift ever wrote... People come to cafes to write, read, study, think, or talk. The lyrics to "You Belong With Me," "Breathe," "Red," "I Knew You Were Trouble," "Bad Blood," etc. are not conducive to these activities. Some cafes play song selections that are... I wish this location was one of them!

I have just recently moved to the area and have now been to this Starbucks twice. As a former Starbucks employee, I have to say that this store fell below the mark. Both times I ordered, the same woman was at the register and both times, she had little to no personality. I ordered a Venti iced coffee and when I got to my drink, it was sweetened. Now I know what you're thinking...as a former Starbucks employee, I should know that their iced coffee normally comes with the classic sweetener. But what I also know is that whoever takes the drink order should ask whether the customer wants the iced coffee sweetened or unsweetened. So when I waited patiently to catch the barista's attention to tell her that I was sorry, but I'd like it unsweetened. She proceeds to tell me it comes sweetened as she dumps out the coffee and huffs to make a new one. If I had never been to a Starbucks before, this would have been a complete turn-off. Starbucks employees are supposed to connect with the customer while making them feel at home in their café. This Starbucks has yet to do any of that. If it wasn't for the great location (walking distance from my place) and of course the coffee/food products, there would be even less stars above this lengthy paragraph.

This particular Starbucks received from myself a collection of succulent plants and agreed to have them planted for the Isla Vista slain students of the recent past. 
      The shop is small and crowded, true , but the coffee is up to standard. Fresher tasting than other Starbuck's I have visited.

Barista was rude & the worst white chocolate mocha I've ever had! Will not come back here! Don't expect any smiles from the barista, she obviously doesn't want to be here, I'm thinking she hates her job. I've been sitting in here for 30 minutes and have yet to see her smile. Ugh!

I visit this Starbucks often. During busy hours I do anticipate a longer wait time and unfortunately can be waiting for up to 15 minutes. However, I find the customer service here to be wonderful. I stopped in later in the evening recently and the drive through attendant asked me at the window what my plans were for the evening. I told him I was heading back to the hospital after a long day there already. He told me he was very sorry if I had anyone close to me in the hospital and gave me an extra shot of espresso to get me through the night. Very kind gesture and was nice to have conversation with him!
Supervisor was rude to me and other employees. Poor customer service! Find a different location.

I was completely appalled as I watched the girl in drive thru poke her fellow associate in the back of her head with a straw that she then stuck into my coffee.  
Disgusting lack of etiquette toward her fellow worker and my the customer.

Wow............how is this place still in business. I came in at 6:15 am to get a coffee and get some work done on my laptop. I order a coffee and ask for honey. The girl immediately says they're out of honey. OK. So I take some agave. I couldn't help but notice the tall guy with the beard wrestling with a coffee machine appearing quite frustrated saying F this and F that and "this job sucks I have to get up at 4:30 in the morning" etc. after sitting down for a few minutes it becomes clear that all of the four employees are disenchanted with their jobs and do nothing but complain and talk about working elsewhere. Of course I go to sit down and the wireless internet doesn't work. I almost think they might do this on purpose so they don't have to serve anyone. There wasn't on other person in the place. 
In my opinion, these are young immature kids of the entitlement age and someone needs to call corporate to come and clean this place up. 
Worst Starbucks experience ever.

I absolutely love this Starbucks. I have been going to this location for years and the customer service has always been great. The wait times can get long, but I always know that the staff is trying their best to get everyone their drinks. If I'm in a rush, I always do a mobile order and conveniently enough they just added parking by the front of the store for mobile orders only. The mobile ordering is super easy and I am in and out of the store so quickly. I highly recommend giving it a try!

Nice looking Starbucks, friendly employees who don't look down at you for not being a coffee expert and asking questions.  

Their hours are short compared to other local stores, they close at 9:30 but the food gets rolled up around 8.  Get there early if you want a muffin with your coffee!

They just finished renovating the entire place and it looks great! The coffee is mediocre just like any Starbucks, but the ambiance is great, and the people that work there are great. The only issue with the location it's self rather than the Starbucks builders, is that there is not a great flow for people to pay for coffee, then pick it up. It's MUCH better than it was before renovation, but people tend to bunch up after the cash register while waiting for their coffee.

This is my favorite Starbucks. Always perfect. Great staff, my drink always comes out as it should. It's busy, but they do their best to keep up. Most of the wait is due to the mobile orders they get. Not their fault.

As everyone knows, you can't swing a dead.....um, never mind feline fans....

Take two: Starbucks are everywhere, right, so why review one? Well, because in contrast to Schultz's ideal vision of the company and its products, not all Sbux are consistent in providing legendary service and the world's best coffee or whatever the mission statement is....yes, I am a former barista!

However, this is my neighborhood shop and I like it, so there. I don't really go there for the coffee - breves, my rare indulgence are still better at the Monon, Lulu's and MoJoe's. But, I love the Passion tea (with melon syrup, since Valencia was pulled...what was that all about?) and I like the staff here. They are friendly and efficient and more interested in waiting on you, usually, than regaling each other with dating nightmare stories, showing off new tattoos or re-capping the latest Project Runway episode - wait, that was me discussing PR with the barista....

Anyway, Starbucks also tends to be my "go to" place for grabbing something to eat in the car as a lunch substitute. And, with their new healthy goodies like the oatmeal and the whole-grain roll with peanut butter, I am leaning toward being a "Born Again Buxer" in the mornings! I just hope the corporate offices don't pull these items like they've done with so many other things from days gone by....seriously, was I the only one who loved that hot Muesli-Steamed Milk-Fruit concoction they had a while back?????
since my drink at Starbucks is the same everywhere I go this rating was purely based on the staff. The gentleman in there needed to drink their own product as they seemed either bored or tired.
Nice people but usually understaffed. Drive thru is agonizingly slow. Much slower than the Starbucks at 96th and Meridian.
There is a walk up window to order drinks if you want to beat the indoor line or if you're walking your dog in the summer time. Nice outdoor seating with a good view of mass ave.

How difficult is it to make a Frappuccino?  With only 1 other customer in line before me, took over 10 minutes.  And it was awful and watery.  Unfortunately I had already left the store and drove before I realized this.

Not my favorite Starbucks. I've been coming here since I was in high school and the baristas aren't very friendly or interesting to talk with. I don't think the remodel did much for the environment (I actually liked it before) and the wait is always long. The parking is really what keeps me from coming here unless I'm already going east on Clayton. Good luck turning left in or out of the lot. If you make it in, it's busy at all times of day, very cramped, and there's always some scary mom in an Escalade trying to run you over or steal your parking spot.
Standard Starbucks experience with lot more space! Plenty of parking and outdoor seating. Great place to hang out occasionally for studying or browsing!

Clean Starbucks with lots of comfy seating inside and a nice outdoor seating area too. 

Baristas were friendly and since it was slow they even rinsed our hydro flasks and kids before refilling our reusable travel tumblers with iced lattes. 

The double smoked bacon sandwich toasted open face was delicious. 

Conveniently located right off the freeway. 

Lots of parking!
Big open windows, great customer service and clean atmosphere! If I was to have a business meeting, this would be a nice location in which there are multiple tables for 8 occupants.

Need a caffeine fix before jumping on that flight? Well Starbucks has you covered at Terminal F (and all the other terminals, as well as the landside building). Staff is friendly and a limited selection of gift items are available for sale. 

FYI, hours vary by location. Here's the breakdown:

Landside: 24 hours
Terminal A: 4:15 AM to 9:00 PM
Terminal C: 5:00 AM to 9:00 PM
Terminal E: 4:30 AM to 8:00 PM
Terminal F: 4:30 AM to 8:00 PM

Being the  coffee fiend that I am (look I'm  caffeine's bitch and I'm okay with that, she's hot), everyday I am in a different coffee shop. Odds are, due to their ubiquity, its a Starbucks. 
This location out of all the locations I've frequented, is quickly be coming the worst one. 
First off, no one in this store can figure out how a LINE works. The store is set up where you have to walk back into the waiting line to get your drink. No easy customer flow is set up. 
Second, for some reason to be seen this location has 7-8 employees running around and still can't seem to make the line move at all. With four people in line me being the third, it still took 20 minutes to get my coffee 
Lastly, this store feels like the Abercrombie & Fitch store of the stores. A bunch of young good looking people standing around doing absolutely nothing.
It's somewhat hard to park during the morning rush, but there is plenty of comfortable seating on the inside.  Staff is prompt and friendly as one might expect in any Starbucks shop.

I'm going to qualify this review by saying we are not huge Starbucks people.  We are definitely casual customers, who might stop in once in a while for a drink.  Generally, I find the coffee to be a bit on the overpriced side.  But when you're out and about and need a caffeine fix, Starbucks will usually be a good bet.  

This one is located near home for us so sometimes my husband and I slip over here for a drink in the evenings before they close.  We've also used the drive thru for quick pick ups here and there.  And can I just say?  A Starbucks that has a drive thru is a wonderful thing indeed.  I wish all of them (or at least more of them) had them.  As a mother with several small children, drive thru's are always appreciated!

This location is easy to find, easy to score parking, the staff is pleasant and friendly, the selection is good, the store is clean and the seating options are plentiful and comfortable.  This is a fun place to hang out in, chat with someone and just enjoy a few moments.  I can't speak to bringing in laptops and working the day away as I'm not the sort to do that but I'm going to guess it's a good place to get that done too. 

If you're in the North Valleys and need a Starbucks fix, this is the place to go.
Funky cool hip sophisticated the remodel looks awesome! I will be spending even more dough the drinks are in top form. That flat white the other day was so good!!
My favorite Starbucks. They are so amazing. Fast and friendly! Everyone cares about you and your day. All around a perfect quality team. Going to this Starbucks puts a smile on my face.

This is a nice Starbucks location.  It is large and has plenty of comfortable places to sit.  The service was fast and very friendly.  They also have plenty of merchandise for sale, in case you need any of that.  It isn't your old style neighborhood coffee shop, but it gets the job done.

This is my first time in this location and I can't wait to come back again.
It has kind of a rustic atmosphere and I love it. The space is really well illuminated, enough tables for everyone. You can come in from the parking lot using two different doors. 

I ordered a soy green tea latte - smooth and creamy ground green tea, lightly sweetened and served with steamed soy milk and my friend a caramel macciato - Freshly steamed milk with vanilla-flavored syrup, marked with espresso and topped with caramel drizzle.

This Starbucks perfectly located, in the middle of two important streets but parking is not a problem.

Fool me once...Thrilled to see a drive thru Starbucks open on my way to work so I stopped in about 2 weeks ago and drove right up to order with 1 car in front of me. They didn't have what I ordered, and I proceeded to wait about 10 minutes for them to make it, but I chalked it up to new store. 

This morning I got in line with 3 cars in front of me to order. I then waited over 15 minutes to get my drink, at least 8 of which were from ordering to pick up. I said something to the barista and her response was a) to check to see if I was telling the truth about the wait and b) to say "yeah we have a really long line." Actually you have an expected line for Friday morning at 8:30. She then shut the window on me as I was saying that I can't be a customer if this is going to be the expected wait.

Not as good as the other starbucks. Not sure what they do different but my Frappuccino the other day tasted like it was mostly water and  soy milk. The color was almost white too. Not impressed for sure

Five stars for quick and friendly service. As with other Starbucks locations, this place has solid consistency in drink and food. Their coffee was the right temperature and they put the right amount of soy milk (my usual request). Conveniently located along US 19 in tarpon springs.

Second Starbucks in Reno that notices my doggie and gives her the whip that I leave off of my drink...

Very friendly people....

No matter what time of the day I swing by the Starbucks on Mass Ave, there is always a line of people. Thankfully it moves quickly, although with usually only barista working, it can take 5-10 minutes from the time you pay until you get your drink. Still, this is one of my favorite Starbucks locations for a few reasons:

1) No drive-thru window. Instead, there's a walk-up window during daylight hours. With all of the foot traffic on Mass Ave, this is genius.

2) To my knowledge, this is (at the time of writing this review) the only location in Indianapolis with a Clover machine. Sure.. some people can't tell the difference, but I think the coffee that comes off this machine has a richer, deeper flavor. I also avoid adding anything to my coffee when drinking something off the clover.. so perhaps my mind just thinks it's better when it really isn't. Either way, kudos to the Marketing folks at Sbux HQ for figuring out a way to get more money for a cup of joe.

3) The people here are just downright friendly. Even with a line almost to the door, they still manage to have a smile on their face. Even the Sunday before Christmas, when Mass Ave was packed with last minute shoppers needing a caffeine fix!
This starbucks was very very disappointing because I went at 6PM when they were supposed to be open, however they were closed. Why put hours on the door and not follow them???
Super slow service and the pike roast tasted like it was burned or old.  Sad since Starbucks is my go to safe coffee place.

Typical Starbucks, which fulfills my Sheldonesque need to have my coffee be consistently good no matter where I am. Service was great, plenty of comfie chairs around the fireplace.  Good place to knit while I wait on others. Only downside is paying to park.
Super slow service.. I waited more than 15 minutes for my frappicino.... I understand there's a line...but 15 minutes!?

This is the only Starbucks in the universe that only has 2 people working. One at the register and one making the drinks. There's 40 people in here waiting. I'm absolutely depressed being in this establishment.
Yesterday they ran out of ingredients to make a white mocha and no longer had snowman cookies, before the afternoon. Wanted to go to black crow but the fiancé had other plans. Been in here for 30 minutes and still no coffee. Never coming back to this location. 

-----------
35 minutes in, I receive the wrong drink because literally neither two of the employees care to pay attention to what I've ordered.

Best Starbucks location in Treasury Valley- consistent coffee & people (friendly & still efficient.). Location is tricky to get in & out of, but definitely the best true coffee peeps here per my experience-

Weird to review a Starbucks I know, however they are not all created equal.  Been to this location several times and everyone I've interacted with (especially today), has been helpful, polite and just plain friendly!   Happy this is my new "favorite" Starbucks.

Very frustrated with this Starbucks. I go thru the drive thru every morning and it's sooooooo slow. They need more people working the drive thru from 7 to 10.... They have never messed up my order so that's a huge plus. But knowing how famous Starbucks is they need to get their stuff together......

HORRIBLE SERVICE.  went to this location, ordered a white mocha frap with soy, and they gave me a white chocoloate frap with regular milk.... I even asked the "barista" is this soy 3 times, and he said yes every single time.  The Almond milk latte tasted like absolute garbage as well.  Shift supervisor was super rude when I called in to complain about this.  Avoid this location like the plague.  The regular milk white chocolate taste like crap, there was no coffee in it, and it gave me the skitters because I am Lactose and INTOLERANT.  I even asked 3 times and the fool lied to me.  what a joke, avoid

I love how convenient the Starbucks app is in regards to ordering and just picking it up. I've never had a problem with my past orders. So I went ahead and grabbed a few things on my way to work. It was my first time at this store. 

Also, I normally would tell them I'm picking up before heading to the drive thru window. Since staff would always tell me to just drive through without notice, I did so today. However, the lady with purple hair working the window somehow lectured me to give them notice. I understand that every store is different; however, I didn't appreciate that approach.  

My biggest issue is that I was extremely excited for my warmed chocolate croissant, but went home with a cheese danish! I don't like those, so it was kind of a bummer and waste of money. Wrong order is never fun.

So I've been coming here for a while. I've had average experiences. I usually come on the weekends and for some reason they can't get their stuff together at the drive thru. Today I ordered a tall nonfat mocha frap at the drive thru. I pull up and the guy who took my order notifies me that he forgot to put the cup on the station so they didn't make my drink and that he's sorry and I need to wait. 2 minutes later he is about to hand me a paper cup that clearly isn't a frappuccino. I tell him what I ordered, he pulls the sleeve on the cup down and shows me the sticker that says tall nonfat mocha frapp, and says "this is who I'm dealing with". At this point the manager comes over a minute later and says she very sorry and hands me a card that says $4 off my next drink. If I remember correctly those drink cards used to cover any drink now it's limited to $4. Anyway finally after sometime he brings me out a venti and says "they made a mistake twice and they made a venti, so we will just give it to you" 
Thanks to the smug guy and the slow service they get two stars. They would have gotten one but the manager seemed apologetic.

Sadly while this Starbucks is in a convenient location, it is THE most unreliable Starbucks I've been to. Numerous times no one had shown up in the morning so it was closed, or 1 employee shows up and is overwhelmed. They also sometimes struggle to make the drinks. Which is natural, but I don't think they've improved in the 3 months I've been coming here. There are other alternatives in the area that advise going to instead.

Drinks are always good here -- try the toffee mocha -- but the staff is a little on the raucous side. If you're trying to get any work done, I advise sitting in the comfortable couches toward the front of the store, the farthest point from where the drinks are being made. That is, unless you'd like to be entertained by a dissertation on why one manager is superior to another, and the other nuances of the interpersonal relationships of the staff -- a kind of soap opera, really. As The Coffee Bean Turns...OK, I'm a dork.

In fact, takeout might be a better option all around. I would give this location a 4 for takeout experiences.

Holy cow, this place is slow. I wondered why there was such a long line when I was coming in and out of this airport. Employees have no sense of urgency and take their sweet time. Avoid this location unless you've got at least 20 minutes - use the Starbucks right outside security instead.

I have gone to this location three days in a row and have yet to receive a single cup of coffee.  I waited in line in the drive-through for over 10 minutes each visit before leaving.  All I wanted was a simple cup of coffee with cream.  I guess I will going to the 7-Eleven across the street now on.
I always get great service here, and the staff is very friendly and helpful. Would be nice to have a drive-thru, but it would be a traffic/logistic problem. Keep up the good work.

Stopped in for a road tea and coffee. Drive thru was quick and staff was polite. Beverages were done well. We would return. The only odd thing is this place is coupled with a Panera Bread so it is usually pretty busy. The parking lot is a zoo and if people are there who can't drive it becomes a bit of an obstacle course.

This is the best Starbucks I have ever been to! The service is super friendly, and the atmosphere is perfect for studying or for hanging out. They have tons of seating! It is the best. Always go here.

Just asked for a refund, and was not offered anything in order to recover a customer..I told her that I wanted my money back, she asked why, I said because I hadn't received my beverage, and the people that came in after me were served before me, the guy that was making the beverages was too  busy talking to his friend who came in behind us, and was served, possibly my drink....who cares, anyways...hope they don't make this a habit...They need a better recovery system..I've been in customer service industry for 15 years, and this isn't how you retain and maintain your customers happy..by the way, it will take a couple days to get my money back onto my card...

I visited the Isla Vista, CA store which I understand serves primarily students in the surrounding community.  However, as a 53-year-old multi-year gold card holder, I could not have possibly been made to feel more unwelcome.  The manager was far too busy chatting with his friends and running around behind the counter doing part of everyone's job in a vain attempt to train, he took only half of my order, left me standing at the counter awaiting checkout while orders from the other register continued to jump in front of my poor cup, languishing unattended beside the register.  When the young lady at the other register finally rescued me, she helplessly explained she was "just in training" and promptly put my cup behind several others that had been ordered by customers coming in long after me.  More than ten minutes after my initial order, my grande nonfat latte was finally served, about 2/3's full.  Despite the lack of customers at the time, I had no interest in asking the hapless barista for a redo nor did the manager offer anything but a "your drink is coming" during the entire wait (though at least he pulled himself away from his buddies in the store long enough to dismiss me curtly).  Unless you're the manager's "bro," don't bother...

Never again will I go to Delran Starbucks. On Sunday November 22 2015 my mom and I went through the drive thru seeing how there was no one in line . We waited at least 10 minutes for the hippie dude to ring us up. Not once did he say I'll be right with you. He continued to take other customers orders who went through the drive thru. Finally he rings us up and hands us our grande egg nog lattes hot with no sleeves and no whip cream. Last I checked Starbucks advertises all their lattes with whip cream so why would the store decide not serve it that way?  We ask the hippie dude at the window to fix our drinks. Then he rings us up wrong so another person comes to the window(us thinking it was the manager) asking what the problem was and after we explain the boy asks us to pull around front and come inside to talk to our manager.  A girl who wasn't the manager but the shift leader refunded us our money and yes we got our drinks but the service at this Starbucks in horrible especially for not being the morning rush. Time for Starbucks to but up a coffee shop in Cinnaminson, NJ.

Go here frequently and the baristas are always very nice and friendly. Drinks are good also, one if the very few Starbucks I have found that add the chocolate shavings to the peppermint mocha (and I have been to numerous ones in other states) so that alone deserves 5 stars!!

Love this location. It is by far the best. I love how big the inside is allowing us customers to have a nice comfortable seat anywhere. Me, my boyfriend, and my sister went here and we all ordered off the secret menu and the cashier was very nice and took her time with us. I forgot her name but she is super nice and did not get anoyyed by us ordering from the secret menu. This is our go to location.

Staff is very nice. Wait time is usually not too bad unless, of course, you go during peak times. Drinks are always made to order. Never had issues at this location. Parking is sometimes limited; seems like this place really needs a parking garage for the amount of traffic flow!

I am not out in the Conshohocken area too often so I generally don't visit this Starbucks. However, this Starbucks is so subpar, I'm happy I don't have to visit. 

I came in and the line was very short. I then ordered a couple of items including a chocolate chip cookie, protein pack and a smoothie. My friend decided to get a coffee with hazelnut. 

After that, we got a seat and waited for the food to come out. However, it was a pretty uncomfortable seating arrangement as everything felt very cramped. I suppose that is because the Starbucks is so small. 

After a long wait of around 10 minutes the drinks finally came out. Unfortunately, my smoothie was pretty average especially compared to smoothies that I have had at other Starbucks locations. My friend's coffee with hazelnut was pretty bad according to them. 
 
The staff here was very nice, but it was not enough to make up for the other disappointing areas. 

Altogether, this Starbucks isn't great as the food and drinks are pretty ordinary and there is little seating. However, the staff is nice.
I only come to this branch when I absolutely have to- like crusty eyed at 7AM before an 8 AM lecture. Otherwise, it's too packed with students.

There were at least 20 people in line when I arrived. Five extremely efficient and friendly employees were working their tails off.  I had my frapp and breakfast sandwich in my hand in 21 minutes. I wish all Starbucks were run like this one was today.

I worked for Starbucks for two years, and I even picked up a shift at this location once, so I have tried to give them the benefit of the doubt when I have noticed things not being done according to standard. However, today my boyfriend bought me a grande Coffee Frappuccino from this location, and the drink was missing at least 3/4 of an inch in the cup. On another occasion, I waited for my drink for 8-10 mins and I was the only one standing at the counter when I heard the barista say "What does she want?" to another barista in a snarky tone. Overall, this isn't my favorite location, but there are nice baristas who work here as well.
Started going there recently on the way to work, baristas are fast and friendly. They had my order done before I finished paying. Thanks.

The staff is super friendly very knowledgable about making coffee

And they have the clover machine

This is the way to make a smooth flavourful coffee

It beats my Aerobie press in taste and flavour

The clover brew better be the best as its a $15000 machine

They also have the WSJ, NY Times and USA today newspapers for the media junkies

I lived in Seattle many years and the Starbucks service in the Northwest is out of this world. The staff here is unfriendly unless the regional manager is working ...which then changes everyone's attitude. i  am amazed at how nice they are if he's in the building.  order is often wrong. Lines are long and slow moving. And for some reason the coffee here tastes horrible. I used to stop a lot more and they just seem so pissed off and the coffee sucks so I started going to Brew Haha and it's a lot better. even Dunkin Donuts at least they have a drive thru. the most disappointing Starbucks in the nation...
Love this place. It's the old long John silver's but coffee smell has taken over. Good thing, coffee/fish probably not a good smell. Just need more parking like all the others

All Starbucks locations inside lambert airport terminal areas should be avoided. I don't think the baristas go to barista school! The Starbucks that's located directly outside the southwest terminal near security and the checkin counters is great! However that doesn't really help travelers who can't take their drinks inside. Perhaps chug some as you wait in te security line? Or grab a cup of joe as you head out of the airport if you can!

I don't recommend this Starbucks unless it's your only option. They frequently mess up my order even tho I don't get anything complicated. This time I was tired of it so I just took it and threw it out when I left. It doesn't help that the parking is really small.

I come every morning, I'm a regular. Trenta Passion Tea Lemonade with fizz. And a bacon Gouda breakfast sandwich! I love the staff they're all so helpful and friendly. 6:25 every morning and I can guarantee that I'll be back tomorrow :)
All the ladies here were so nice and helpful. We ordered a large order and they did a great job making it quickly for us. I would come here everyday if I lived here!

Always a solid choice for a Starbucks in the area. The staff is always helpful, the store is clean, and the drive through service is typically pretty quick. The one disadvantage is not because of the products, but the location IS on a corner (literally...right where Tampa Rd. and Curlew merge together), so it can be a bit tricky to get in/out sometimes depending on which direction you're coming from.

Always tend to stop here every tie I am on my way to work and I haven't had a bad experience I guess that why I am the Duke of this great SB location!!!!! Even at 5ish in the morning the staff is bright and cheery going that extra mile to make that first cup of Java in the morning just right. I look forward every morning to know that they get my morning off to a great start.

They leave the pastry cases open and flies walking all over the food. I tell the girl, she laughs like shes stoned or under the influence. Coffee was as usual just wandered how many flies made it inside of my cup before she put a lid on it!
This Starbucks is my " I feel crafty" stop. It's right near Home Depot and Pet Store. They have great staff. Jade rocks the house!. She goes out of her way for her customers. Well  stocked.

They play the music exceptionally loud in this Starbucks. I have come multiple times hoping they will have changed and have not. I have even asked for them to turn it down and they said no.Unfortunately I won't be coming back here to work again.

If you are in a hurry to catch your flight, get your coffee elsewhere. My wait was around 25 minutes for a cup of coffee. I had time, but others in front of me gave up. The employees just went about their business without any awareness that the line was out the door. This unit needs to review staffing and customer service from a perspective of this is an airport and people have limited time.

The service here is awful. I have been waiting at the drive thru right now for 11 minutes. I'm trapped in between cars with a screaming baby in the back seat. Everyone finally just pulled through and as it turns out, the cafe and drive thru is CLOSED. How about a sign?
I am by no means a fan of Starbucks, however the employees working this morning made my visit excellent, hence the 5 stars! They were all very friendly, smiled and seemed genuinely happy!
Great, friendly staff. Helped me with a special drink request without a second thought!

Omg, 3 employees for this kind of volume? Are you frigging  kidding me???!!!! Service sucks, no parking whatsoever, dirty, empty milks, no honey, blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah. Horrendous Starbucks, stay away if possible.
Huge Starbucks with a lot of tables. The employees are cheerful and happy even at unmentionable hours.

Just as good as any other Starbucks! Sometimes I stop by here before going to school, and I come here almost every day during Dead & Finals Week. Only flaw is that it is very small and crowded, so it is a bit hard to study here when I need to! I also wish that it would stay open a bit more late!

I had great service there. Everything came out right. It's just it would of gotten a 5 star but there was this crazy bitch that was trying to not let me through to park I was trying to park to go inside to order instead of sitting in line.  But she wouldn't let me through. But over all everything else was amazing.

This the worst Starbucks we have been to. After waiting a long wait time, I placed my order for just a chocolate croissant. The cashier didn't greet customers and wasn't friendly despite being early in the morning. She at least took my order quickly and handed the wrapped to someone else (usually the cashier takes it out and warms it up). 

Well after a while, I started seeing people that were behind getting their drinks and breakfast items. I then proceeded to ask where was my croissant because it was just a pastry. Then a woman said it was next and that she was busy making sandwiches and it would take 18 seconds. I guess she forgot or didn't get to drink her coffee this morning because she didn't get those sandwich order after I had placed mine. 

Then I asked to speak to a manager and she said she was one. I believe she said her name was KG when I asked. I then let her know it was poor management on her end not to know how to prioritize which orders should go out first. I let her know I was before those items that she choose to do first. Her poor judgement is poor reflection of her leadership role to her employees.

KG

This location is decent. The staff is friendly and the drinks are always perfect. Maybe it being in a grocery store makes it not as great. There isn't the seating that you normally have at regular Starbucks. However, it is very convenient to have it while you are doing your regular food shopping.
I wish they had a drive thru to add that extra convenience.
Starbucks needs to retrain employees.  Today again they couldn't even make an iced green tea correctly as I received an iced black tea. Listen up starbucks you have a problem in this store!

Today is supposed to be my day for returning phone calls and emails, and lots of paperwork. But horror of horrors, I've been on the road so much that I completely forgot to check the status of the pantry for green tea before I started boiling the water this morning. Fearing a bad case of "the shakes" from early morning tea withdrawal, I grabbed my car keys and headed down the road to Starbucks.

This particular Starbucks sits on the corner of Dale Mabry and Linebaugh Avenue within walking distance of my condo. When I first moved to Carrollwood the space was occupied by a skanky Long John Silvers which thankfully closed, was gutted by the developer, and re-opened as a really nice Starbucks. The interior looks less like an industrial-strength coffee house, and more like a very comfortable study / reading room with lots of places to sit and relax.

I'm not a big fan of coffee, and especially not the jumbo grande mocha frappacino double-shot espresso salted caramel latte crap that most people seem to like. Instead I just wanted a basic cup of freshly-brewed green tea -- oh, and one of those yummy-looking blueberry scones as well, please.

The barrista seemed to appreciate my needs -- perhaps it was the dark circles under my eyes, and the way I was chewing on my lower lip -- and she quickly rushed to pour me a large green tea and fork over the scone.  *sighs happily*

The tea was flavorful and calming, and the scone was fresh and delicious. I found a corner table and sat down to read the front section of the Tampa Bay Times while watching the other harried morning commuters lining up for their fresh Shot o'Joe before starting their work day.

This particular Starbucks opens at 5 in the morning, and stays open till 11 or so at night. They have a drive-through window which seems popular with the vapid "latte crowd" who are too busy blabbing away on their cellphones to come into the store -- fine by me, like......ya know?

Well done Starbucks, and thanks for saving my day!

I've only ever used the drive-thru at this location, but it's always been a pleasurable experience. The location is a bit inconvenient, especially because it's on the opposite side of the road as my commute, but it's not so that I hate making the trip in.

The nice thing about chain coffee shops is that everything is usually the same. I've never had an issue with a drink or a food order. 

The staff is always very friendly and converse with me when time allows.
Best Starbucks in the city. Employees are friendly and efficient. Long lines move fast and my order is always accurate. Best of all, no apathetic hipster baristas.

Love, love, love, LOVE this location.  99% of the time I use the drive through, and am greeted with a perky voice in the box and a smile in the window. Obviously we all know Starbucks prices sort of suck, but when that grande iced skinny vanilla late touches my lips, I know it was all worth it (lol).

Anyway when I did go inside I was surprised by the nice decor and comfy seating! Also has some of the fastest wifi around! No joke!

I will say the layout of the parking lot kind of sucks, so if you park and go inside you better not be in a hurry because chances are your car will be blocked in by everyone in the drive through lane.

Emlie was extremely rude! I don't understand how their prices can fluctuate within days when your literally an everyday customer.  I may need to re-evaluate where I'm spending my money because I sure shouldn't be spending it in places where it's not wanted.

I have to say that I have been through the airport many times , and I have not stopped in here till I noticed the prices were all the same for a sandwich. 

I do not normally buy sandwiches from Starbucks but decided to see what was there and had the chicken chipotle with the passion tea lemonade which is my favorite.

The service was on par and was treated very well. I have always loved going to Starbucks because of the friendliness and the bathroom. This one did not disappoint

The barista could barely speak English, and just mumbled out the drink names. She was the slowest barista I've ever witnessed, I ordered two of the EXACT same drink and she legitimately made ONE AT A TIME. Like made one drink, called it out, and then proceeded to look at the next cup and remake the whole thing again. My caramel macchiato had way too much milk, and not enough ice (my drink was pure liquid within 5 minutes) or caramel. Hands down the worse cup of Starbucks I've ever had, save yourself $5.
Very nice Starbucks. Plenty of room. Quick service. Plenty of bakery items and packaged type items to choose from. This is where I go for breakfast.

Hello strange Starbucks attached to the Hilton! You were the closest one in proximity to me to pick up some drinks to go this morning. There wasn't much of a rush, and I was able to get in and out fairly quickly. The staff was nice enough, but not as peppy as some of the folks I've dealt with. Also, it was a clean store. Not sure if that's because it was early or if this location sees less traffic. If you're looking for a sbux on this side of downtown, make sure you get in early because they have more limited hours. There's free street parking nearby so you're good for up to 2 hours. Nothing sucks more than having to feed a meter just to have some coffee.

This is a relatively  new store located by a get go and chiacagos pizza...we have been there a couple times and they have always gotten something wrong but its been minor ..yesterday after a stressful last week my sister and I decided to treat ourselves I ordered a peach green tea lemonade sweetened Something I had gotten before many times...the cashier hands me a strawberry lemonade I told her that's not what I asked for she then apologized took the drink and was gone  3 sec. I watched her take the container add peach to the leftover strawberry as well as what looked like tea pour out what was in my cup in the sink and shake it pour it in the rinsed cup...I was so pissed I told her it was still wrong and she acted as id she didn't have a clue. ..I just went home .its a shame for the amount of money I was charged and after a crap of a week she couldn't get 1 tea right..we will never go back to this location...

My secret starbucks place! This is the best bux I've been to in St Louis. Lots of seating, different types of seats (high tables, couches, normal seats), big tables, very fast google internet, friendly wait staff, very clean, lots of parking.

Only downside is it closes at 9pm but so does everything else in St. Louis.

This is the go-to place to get work done, or just chill and talk with your buddies and enjoy some starboox coffee



***Oh! The Internet is mad fast here!!!!***
Stopped by for a pick me up during the Mass Ave Crit.  Tasty, refereshing, and strong iced americano!

I have to say I was ignored never looked at or even made eye contact with. Made an order, and listened to a man barista talk about his makeup and outfit for the weekend to his coworker on their little headsets while he completely messed up my order of iced coffee...enough said, wasn't a difficult order if you get my drift. I don't mind that he ignored me but I do mind thats the reason he messed up my order.
Serves a basic purpose and line moves fast but doesn't give refills so minus 2 stars.

Was my first day in my new job as the assistant to COO of an important lawfirm in Wilmington DE. My first responsibility was to pickup coffee and biscottis for an important meeting this morning. 3 Caramel Mocciottos with light cream no sugar and 2 black dark roast extra sugar. And instead I got to work with 5 hot tea's. And got fired too so to say I'm never going to return to any Starbucks is an under statement. They we're all very nice when I got there but there incompetence to correctly get my order right makes me wanna give up on drinking coffee all together.  I'm soooooooo depressed.....

This is the best Starbucks I have ever been to and I have gone to many in other states. Max, Joe,Sarah, Christine, Michael,Rhonda, Jessica, heather, and a few other names I have forgotten are the nicest people you could meet! The place is clean and wonderful whether you are inside or going through the drive thru. I live closer to another starbucks but am happy to go a bit out of my way to get my morning fix here!

I'm a gold member and love everything about this location!! They always make my cool lime refresher just how I like it. They are the nicest people I greet in the morning. My dog always gets the puppuchino from Starbucks as well.

This Starbucks is honestly the worst. I've been here like 5 times and they never make my god damn drink right. They also have horrible customer service all around. I would give them 0 stars if that was a thing. The guy working the register was also definitely still drunk from last night.

This Starbucks certainly has the best coffee in the North End. I have wasted enough $$ trying to shop with the Mom 'n Pop coffee shops, but always default back to Starbucks. The baristas seem always friendly and on top of their game. The place does get crowded and backed up, but I would rather wait in line rather than regret the $5 I spent on sub-standard coffee and service.

Give me a cup of java and you proceed to spill caramel all over the sleeve and then not wipe it?

Even worse, you get an attitude when I ask you to give me a new sleeve?

Fail.

A perfectly adequate Starbucks in an ideal Broad Ripple location, which can get crowded during prime hours.   The core baristas are always very friendly and quickly pick up on the regulars and their orders; I've never had my order messed up here, no matter how picky it gets.  I've brought in bagels from next door, and have never been hassled over it.  My only criticism is that this location always smells like scorched soy milk, which I guess more reflects on the clientele's preferences than anything else.
Most interesting that both the staff this morning are sitting in plain view eating but will not assist customers. Hum... Really poor service in my opinion.
friendly but slooowwww service.  The normal Starbucks menu - over priced as always.  Still enjoy the coffees in spite of the cost.

Never really loved Starbucks as a franchise because 1.) I don't like coffee, 2.) I don't prefer to pay for over-priced other drinks & 3.) the food is never very fresh. 

BUT I had a gift card and this one is very close to home. Also I needed to get some blogging done so I ordered a hot chocolate and grabbed a high top. Drink was fine and service was fast. I did stay for about 3 hours and it was fairly 'busy' since there were a lot of people studying, having meetings or just reading. Most of the seating was filled so the community definitely appreciates a quiet spot. 

As far as the review for this particular Starbucks, the establishment is convenient, clean, and quick.

Starbucks is popping up all over the area.  Wherever you turn, there is one.

I happened to be around the Gravois Bluffs area and voila there was one to satisfy my caffeine needs.

Really can't go wrong.  Got prompt and friendly service.
Andrea is amazing! She will brighten up anyone's day... this girl rocks, she's always friendly and smiling :)

I'm a huge fan of Starbucks, but this one is bad. Messed up my order, told me that it was my fault and tried to charge me for it. They would only take cash for the fix. Sure they were just going to pocket the money.

March 2, 2013 Sunday - a drink 9:15 AM
2 adults

Atmosphere - 5 stars
Food - 5 stars
Service - 5 stars

Background - Have some gift cards burning a hole in the pocket.

Atmosphere - A clean small location and divided in a weird manner so it feels even smaller.

Food
  The wife and I went with just a cup of frou-frou.  I had a Caramel Macchiato.  It was really good, a nice treat.

Service - No line inside, while they had 8 cars in the drive thru.  Very fast service, I watched my Caramel Macchiato get drizzled with a ton of caramel, mmmmm so good. When we left there was a line, and there were still 8 cars in the drive thru.
 
Future - I will as I got a lot of gift cards for Christmas.

Feels very "Alberta" here - long, communal wood tables, plush, overstuffed club chairs...rustic is used in the other reviews often and it's an apt description. 

Staff are friendly and my coffee was good. Can't complain!
The wifi is terrible. 4 people here using their laptops and the wifi can't support it? Really? It's 2015.  This alone is worth one star.

This is the WORST. Starbucks I have ever been to! I go starbucks daily an to this multiple times an they seem to screw something up everytime! I got 2 different half cups of lattes when I paid for a full cup! An that's just the beginning of it!
Starbucks is great, we know and expect that. This one is super friendly. Downside - new seating arrangements are crappy cafe tables. Not cozy at all anymore.

My FAVORITE Starbucks!!! ...sometimes.

I've been coming to this Starbucks since it opened, dealing with it's overly-small, pain in the neck parking lot, because it was the closest one to my house. The staff is what keeps me coming back, and no matter how much time passes between my visits, the veteran employees always remember my drink, and genuinely ask how I have been, and what I've been up to. 

I usually order a grande or venti iced Americano, with hazelnut syrup, soy milk, and extra, extra, extra, extra caramel drizzle, and they NEVER disappoint me here, especially with the extra caramel drizzle, so long as it is one of the veteran employees making my drink. 

They have had a lot of new people come and go, who are typically just... mediocre. They seem unenthused, and never, ever make my drink right. Like, really.. How hard is it?! Extra caramel drizzle doesn't mean one small drop of it in my drink, especially when you charged me for the EXTRA caramel drizzle... Twice!! But, I know my drink is safe when I see one of the regular, veteran employees. I love going in and catching up with them, and they're all awesome. A few of them go to my gym, and we always talk about working out there. It's nice, and adds some personality behind the baristas who previously just made my coffee. 

Now that I have the option of the drive-thru Starbucks on the other side of the expressway, it truly says something when I continue to come to this one, with it's horrendous parking. The veteran employees make me excited to return, and pick this Starbucks over the new one. The latter CONSISTENTLY does not make my drink correctly, and the cups are always sloppy there, but I'll leave that for the review I'm going to write for them. 

All in all, this is my favorite Starbucks. Great employees, good coffee (as long as the right person is making it), with horrendous parking (hence the docked 5th star).
Very polite and rarely crowded. Usually two people on duty, but the job gets done!
Ordered a large beverage, this looks more like a small. Girl working the window needs some training.  When someone asks for a large, give em what they asked for.

It's Starbucks, home of overpriced coffee in Tarpon Springs.

The staff is genial enough, the service is good and the inside is clean and tidy. 

Outside, you can expect the Greek men to be congregated around the tables, chattering. Young couples outside sipping on their frappes and watching the traffic go by.
