It's Starbucks, people, not rocket science.

I really like this location of Starbucks...the baristas are very friendly and happy to modify your order to your liking. Also, they have this awesome bar area that I've never seen...so being here alone working away at my laptop, I can sit without taking up a table all by myself. And I don't feel alone because I am practically behind the counter hanging out with the team. Also, I've never come here where it was so packed that I couldn't get a seat...which is always a plus!

This Starbucks location is and a continent location just off the freeway. There are two reason of giving this Starbucks a three star. One because I have not been in the facility. And two there was trash all over the ground outside of the buildings.

I ordered three drinks, when I pulled up to the drive-through and the lady at the window was nice. They seemed to get the drinks out pretty fast so there was minimum waiting time. Overall, the drink I had the Vanilla bean frap,non fat no whip. 

It's nice to have a coffee place that sells other drinks besides coffee for those non coffee drinkers.

Mmm... Love my Starbucks.

This location can be a little trickier to get to because it's on the North side of the road in the not most convenient parking lot set up but basically it's in between major roads in a residential area.

What's not to love?  Download the app and earn free drinks and rewards.

I'll be seeing you soon for my fave Match Green Tea Latte!

Just learned this is a training location, now the trainer taught the barista how to make the matcha green tea ice latte. I'm glad they didn't dump the matcha powder at the bottom, I just wish it wasn't a sweetener that was added which maybe it's normal but I always mention no sugar just coconut milk. Maybe it's my fault for this one but thank goodness I got a grande and I didn't take it back but noooooo shots of sweetener.

The girl with blue hair was very friendly. I asked for a strawberries and cream frap with soy milk, and they put whip on it which wasn't a big deal until a dumpy girl with a bad attitude walked up and said "they specifically said soy with whip" when I (specifically) said no whip with soy.  Which is why my cup said "soy, ask me"

Great Starbucks location, friendly staff (most of the time)...nice place to get coffee and relax or chat. Can be crazy busy at times, making service less than ideal. Still my goto place for my morning caffeine fix.

3 stars for a very nice Starbucks! It's very roomy inside, super clean and very well organized. One star off because my ice caramel macchiato taste horrible! I think the guy pulled my shots wrong, which can happen. Another star off for no drive thru. As busy as this location can get. I'm surprised there's no drive thru.

They don't have enough seating at this location in the mall and the WiFi is unreliable.  My other complaint is with Starbucks in general - I WANT ORGANIC COFFEE!  Pretty please with no whip on top.  I don't think I'm alone on this one.  Coffee and tea tend to be VERY high in pesticides and molds.  It would be nice to see this national brand elevate their offerings to include "cleaner" options.  The coconut milk is a step in the right direction but it needs to have the added sugars removed.

This is the Starbucks inside of Target. They were rude and forgot to put the caramel in my caramel iced coffee, when I asked if they wouldn't mind putting it in (hence, it's what I ordered) the girl making the drinks got an attitude. It's not been the first time.. So here I go... *Posts review*

Even though I am not a big fan of this corporate giant, I have to give the one in TIA praise. Staff was fast and knowledgeable to keep that constant line moving.
Prices not much higher than their storefront location, which are too high, but for an airport, not bad.
And as much as I dislike the company, their products are usually pretty good. I do love their whole wheat scones, they had cinnamon,  it was terrific. 
What's a girl to do? I just have a general dislike for companies that are corporate giants and prefer local business owners and supporting local economy.

Has everything you want. Great location, drive thru, friendly staff, & lots of room. I refer to it as the best Starbucks in STL that no one knows.

Good place to meet up with some one since it is easy to get to 270 or 170. Recently, I have noticed a number of organizations using this location for job interviews so don't be surprised to see a couple going on at any given time during the day.

I don't like the new layout indoors, too tight for someone in a wheelchair,  the flow is just wrong. Like spawning salmon at the end of the line.  Where are  the soft seating outdoors?  Where's the previous much friendlier staff? It's ok, i do enjoy the new bakery they went with for desserts!

I mean . . . it seems silly to even rate a Starbucks because there are a billion of them and I am sure my single location yelp review will be worthless.  Regardless, the wait times and half and half situation are SO BAD that I have to comment. 

Really - what's the point of having a drive thru when it is faster to go inside?  Seriously, you will probably pass 37 different coffee shops on your way to work, I highly recommend stopping at any other besides this.

WIth regard to the half and half.  When I ask for "a little cream" in my iced coffee and it is WHITE, that is not cool.  Also, what's with the 'tude when I request (nicely, mind you) that you poor some out and add more coffee??  

Okay sorry for the grump review . . . maybe I just need more caffeine?! ;)

Rudest staff ever!!!! Horrible customer service and slowest service do not waste your money or time at this joke of a Starbucks. I went in to the Starbucks and ordered a coffee, there were literally two other people in the entire place and I stood there for 20 minutes waiting. The person who walked in after me got their coffee before me so I asked the person working where my order was. They glared at me and were rude saying oh we forgot to put in your order ?? Then this morning I gave them one more try. I went thru the drive thru and it took forever to order. I placed my order and the girl said they were out of croissants.  I said how can you be out of them you just opened?? She rudely said oh we didn't order enough. Not even apologizing. When I went to pay she was even more rude didn't even say good morning or hello just blurted out the total. Still didn't say a word when handing back my credit card. I finally got my coffee and the girl working just shoved the coffee in my hand and stared at me when I sat there dumb founded. She goes what did you forget something? I said aren't you suppose to say thank you???? She literally started laughing in my face and so did all the other workers. They were all laughing at me. I should have thrown the coffee in her face . Rudest experience of my life will never go back there . Management didn't care when told about this
The baristas are always friendly and it's the speediest drive-thru of all the Starbucks drive-thru's I've been to.

Starbucks is usually my go-to. But not when I'm in Exton. The staff is nice but the drive-thru is always at least a 10-15 minute process and inside is sometimes a bit quicker but not much. Plus the parking lot is very difficult to navigate through with the long drive-thru lines. Save yourself the trouble.

Downtown Clearwater makes me slightly uncomfortable ... secret service vibe you know what I mean ... so when in the area and craving coffee, I often visit this particular Starbucks. 

First off, the staff is so nice. My app/card for some reason never reloaded and the young man at the register eased my embarrassment. 

They got my annoying order correct (gingerbread latte, skim milk, one pump syrup, no whip latte) and offered to heat up our slice of gingerbread. 

The thing I've always liked about this particular Starbucks, is it appears clean and there are lots of places to sit. 

Some may find it inconvenient, however I actually like that they require a code to access the restrooms - Great safety feature for such a small downtown area.

The worst starbucks I have been to. Obviously the drinks are going to be the same which ever starbucks you go to, but the attitude you get -as mentioned by another peer- from some workers is horrendous. Never going to go here again.

Poor service. I ordered 4 lemonade iced tea and got 4 reg iced teas. I gave it back for them to correct it and they poured out half and poured in lemonade in the other half. The cashier that rung me up have a bad attitude. One if the worst Starbucks I've been to. Would never come here again!

Yay! There's still love for Starbucks! Because once it's joined the pantheon of freeway corporate watering holes along with McDonald's, it's just not American to hate Starbucks. Boom. And the enemies I've earned with that one..

As Artemis H points out, the atmosphere really works for light convo as well as work on ye olde laptop. So, yeah, it's one of my Chosen places for "real" work, especially in the evenings. The 'community table' is interesting--I like it because it keeps me from getting too comfortable, but the direct sunlight through the facing window during the day is overwhelming.

A barista could tell when I shifted from "writing" to "blogging' at my laptop, just from noticing the change in my facial expression. We chatted blog and writing, and swapped websites. This place is great!
Very happy with the service at this location.  Greeted with a smile by Angela, who was helpful and polite. Coffee was correctly made and sandwich was fresh.
I can't help myself. I love this place. Great employess! Clean bathrooms are always appreciated. Drinks are sopt on.

Standard Starbucks location but with Pride! 

This location almost always has a line and on nice days it has two (they have an outside walk-up counter as well as their indoor space). Despite the busy-ness the staff will answer questions and are quite polite...maybe it's hard to feel rushed when there's always a rush. Drinks flow out pretty quickly so don't be discouraged or rude, just know you'll have to wait your turn.
Long lines. This is a kiosk Starbucks so they have very limited space.  Still better than anything else in airside F.

I love Starbucks - my pocket book not so much.  I ended an earlier morning caffeine shot and stopped by the Bloomingdale location.  Typical of many Starbucks but not a big fan of the industrial interior look - I prefer the more homey feel Starbucks used to offer.

Recently given a nip/tuck.. This Starbucks brings the new single-serving Clover brewing system and Starbuck's new Reserve beans. Not to mention the great new Starbucks decor and look!

Back to to Clover system. It's so great! Especially for an iced coffee lover. I now have so many more options for iced coffee instead of just the one typical pre-made "iced coffee blend". They can now make any bean they have in store into an iced coffee. It's fantastic! Try them all!

My favorite right now is an iced Indivisible blend coffee!

And the people are nice too. Very friendly. 

Something else that makes this unique is the outdoor walk-up window. Very cool.

My go-to Starbucks!

Been to this Starbucks thousands of times probably in the past 6 years that I've lived in Clearwater. It always has friendly staff, they are fast, never mess up orders, mostly clean...what more can you ask for?

There are very few times where I think, "Man, this airport Starbucks is awesome!!!!" And this definitely wasn't one of those times. So cramped, so loud, so slow. It took the cashier like five minutes to take my order of two drinks and two sandwiches...... I was pleasantly surprised to see everything came out correct, honestly. After waiting ten minutes in this dirty location though, I can see why this place only has like 2 stars.

I've lived in Oldsmar for 8 years. I've gone to this Starbucks many many times, it used to be a regular routine for me.  The last 4 times I've gone they have gotten the order wrong. One simple  grande mocha latte, no whip. I get cold ones not hot (latte) or hot ones when I wanted a Frappe. Two times the lemon loaf icing has been all melted and weird. 
Besides that however,  the staff is so nice and friendly. They are always so sweet to my pup and give him a dog biscuit. Who does that? So as far as service with a smile they get 5 stars. Fixing the mess ups they get 5 stars. Making it right the first time 3 stars. Being good to my pup 5 stars. Just make sure it's right before you drive off.

Parking can be problematic, but the staff is really nice. They are also really creative--I love the displays they make out of cups and other found things. Lots of space here, and nice people. The service is usually pretty quick. Busy corner.

Friendly staff. I never know what to order and feel pressured usually bc there's a line behind me of caffeine deprived, impatient people. But today was diff and the cashier helped me pick something to have. The toffee nut iced coffee and it was really good. Glad I listened.

Oh my I truly cannot go to this location ever again! I order a simple Iced coffee sweetened with cream and it sucks here every single time! How can you mess up an ice coffee! The coffee always tastes burnt. I have wasted a lot of money at this location not once has my iced coffee been good. So sad:(

Oh boy, my visit here was really bad. There was no parking available and an exhausting line at the drive through. I really needed a coffee and was about an hour away from home, so after a very long wait at the drive through I decided I'll step out from that hough line and look for parking, it was worse.. I've placed a Mobile order and waited for about 15 more minutes until someone pulled out. Until I finally parked my car and stepped in, my mobile order wasn't even ready!! I gave them 2 stars only because the place inside looked very nice, clean and organized. They need to do something about the parking and drive through lines.

I go to this starbucks all the time, Most of the staff are very helpful and useful and even offer discounts when they are available, everytime they make a drink it always comes out just about to perfection, they make it better than some of the stand alone starbucks locations. 

This Starbucks is a smaller one from being inside a Target, but the staff is always courteous, working and won't keep you waiting.

The baristas have messed up my orders a lot of times. From using cow milk instead of a non-dairy milk and not following the instructions when asking for only 1 pump of something. I end up just throwing my drink away because I cannot have too much sugar due to medical reasons. Same goes for cow milk. I've complained a few times but I feel like they're not doing anything.

I love this Starbucks. The seating is big and there are plenty of outlets for homework and bloggers like myself. The staff is friendly and happy to serve. It's 15 mins from my place but it's worth the drive!

Out running errands in the Gravois Bluffs area because there's currently a Pottery Barn Outlet in one of the empty stores. After a successful shopping trip to the Pottery Barn Outlet I needed to feed my craving for the Chile Mocha Latte. In, out, and done. I'm addicted to them.

This location gets 2 stars only because the iced coffee tasted good and I'm feeling generous. (Amended to 1 star!)

The vibe when I walked in was that they couldn't care less about their customers. One girl at the register who took an order and proceeded to unwrap a breakfast sandwich and heat it for a customer while the line waited. During this time, two separate employees come up to the next register, mess around in it, then walk away. ANOTHER LADY EMPLOYEE is standing off to the side hugging a man and chatting. Not sure if she's on break or what, but obviously nobody has been trained on customer service. Not one person even greeted me through any of this!

At the end of it all, the lady calls out my drink and slides it onto the counter. Most sbux employees at other places make eye contact, smile--you know, act like human beings. I guess I'll go elsewhere in the future. 

And I've reconsidered. Only 1 star.
They make the best dirty pumpkin spice soy chais  they get busy and the wait is sometimes longer than I would hope. But it's a college town and if I want the chai, I'm gonna wait for it.

I was literally in and out of this location with in 5 minutes. The lady at the counter was very friendly. Parking was a little rough but this is the fastest location on westshore... located on westshore and cleveland.

Maybe Starbucks is too mundane to review, but I was having trouble finding a coffee shop to study at past 9pm downtown. The library closes at 9, while the other shops nearby closes at 7 or 8. Funny how no one's reviewed this place yet, and I had to search the store website to find this prime location. There were plenty of ppl hanging around outside on the patio seating and a few indoors too.
Usually service is crazy slow but it was better today. However my bagel was stale and the server who toasted it had a major attitude.  Maybe she knew she was serving me a 2-day old bagel?

Been here twice recently. First time was fine and went off without a hitch - I did a mobile order, walked in and picked it up.

Second time was not as great, although the staff were very friendly. We were heading out to dinner with friends but decided to stop by to pick up a few drinks. My wife ordered her drinks on the app slightly ahead of time, but I ordered it on the app while already in the store (to avoid waiting in line).

My wife's drinks took a little while to get ready, maybe about 10 minutes or so. I only ordered one drink, though, and it took almost half an hour to get ready! The staff were very friendly throughout the exchange, but it was strange that it took so long for them to get to my order. I did notice that one of the staff members behind the counter was in training, so that may have contributed. It was also fairly busy.

I'm sure I'll be back again, but in the future I'll be sure to order well ahead of time if I'm pressed for time.
Brought a cold back from my trip to Mississippi (thanks airplanes) so stopped in for a hot chocolate while my daughter was at Kung Fu. It hit the spot - rich, smooth and soothing. A nice treat!!

By far and away the best Starbucks that I go to in the STL area.  I work right next door and frequent this location and it always delivers. Unlike some other Starbucks that I've gone to over the years, this location really goes out of their way to connect and get to know their customers.  That speaks volumes to me and is something that doesn't go unnoticed. Even on their extremely busy mornings you'll see the staff with a smile on their faces, still making great drinks. Great place to grab some espresso and great people working behind the scenes.

Why 4 Stars?

This place is always packed and has a line around the building and out the door.

Usually that can be a bad thing for speed and quality but not for this spot!

Lobby was not very clean and they were out of some breakfast goodies..if that is the only hit against them, they did good in my opinion.
The guys at the drive thru are fabulous!!!!  Best experience!!!

Worst customer service ever! Good luck getting a consistent drink or even a smile, the manager with the long blonde braids is the worst offender and talked smack about me while I was still standing In Front of her. Take your money else where!!!

I ordered a caramel macchiato around 6:30PM on a Wednesday so there wasn't a line at all. 

They didn't put as much of the caramel drizzle as I would have liked but Josh helped me right away and i was out in 3 minutes.

This had to be my worst experience at a Starbucks's. I just went to a few min ago and the woman at the window was extremely rude. How dare I want a tall chocolate milk and not a boxed chocolate milk. From that point on she was so rude that my 4 year old child in the back commented! Never again!!

I have been to many Starbucks in Canada and by far this is the most friendliest one. Every customer was greeted as the entire and left by multiple barista. The gentleman at the register even check to see if I got my order. This is how a Starbucks should be.

I'm not going to write a review based on the Starbucks products, because I don't know anyone who hasn't tried them for themselves. So I will just review this location.

If it were just Starbucks coffee: Fast, Fresh, In my mouth immediately I would give it 5 stars because I love that stuff.

So these guys get 5 stars. I only go through the drive thru, but that's all I need. They are fast. I once waited ten minutes, and they gave my sister and me our coffee for free because of the wait. Even with 5+ cars in front of me I have never waited that long again. 

They are convenient if you live in the North Valleys because you don't have a lot of other options. This is why I think these guys are always packed when I go there. But honestly, I feel their speed is appropriate to the amount of people they are serving and they can't really do anything about that. In fact, having less customers tends to be worse for your business so I guess I can't push for that!

Also they serve Starbucks coffee... go here if that's what you want :)

Was super excited to have this location here since I could hit the drive by before work to grab coffee. I did go inside and it's very small. The entrance is shared with the bank. However the first time going the service was super slow and there were only 3 customers in line. The one barista messed up my friends drink (it was remade and she loved it... so she didn't complain) but my friend had to remind the women to give her a cookie she ordered. My 2nd time going was very pleasant and I used the drive-thru... very convenient and look forward to coming back.

Typical Starbucks fare, slow service because I don't know, everyone had their backs turned away from the door....doing??? Dirty-ish.....tables and chairs need updating but the biggest issue was the LOUD obnoxious music that was blaring. Ok I don't like intense jazz, but it was so loud you could not have a nice conversation. Would not have mattered if it had been my favorite music it was TOO LOUD. Two moms with babies left to sit outside because the music was so loud. I was only there to meet someone and go on to an appointment, this location not in my usual route...next time we will meet at Home Depot!

Most inconsistent Starbucks on the planet. One day it's great and the next day service is awful, they're out of half of your mobile order, and they ran out of venti drink lids. The staff are constantly miserable, and not a soul makes eye contact when you enter their store- forget a greeting. Clearly an under managed location, sad for how new it is.

Thoroughly impressed how the three workers busted through a continuous line of 30+ customers this morning. There line of people is intimidating but actually moved very quickly. Only waited a couple minutes for my coffee to be made.

It is not the best coffee in town, but it sure is consistent. I love the fact that I can walk into any Starbucks in the country and get something that I enjoy.

My drink of choice is a tall vanilla bean frappuccino with a shot of espresso, or a grande with two shots; if I want a boost.  Give it a try, it is delicious!

Anyway, I like this location, check it out!

Love all the Employee's here. I always do drive-thru because my Dog gets a Puppachino! They started this little delight for Finn. A few of the girls have taken pic's of him, are always happy to see him, & know his name. Service & Coffee are always great :)

This Starbucks can get BUSY especially during the 7-8 am work rush and on Saturdays! Although the line is usually out the door and it somehow always resembles some sort of organized chaos, I keep coming back. The staff is incredibly chipper despite the mad rush and works to get drinks out quickly.

The walk up window at this location is perfect if you have furry friends and want to stop by on your morning strolls. My pup has come to love the notorious "pup cup" whipped cream goodness he gets when we stop by!

This has got to be the world's slowest and least friendly Starbucks. Not only is part of my order typically forgotten they make you feel bad for asking for what you order. Not a great way to start your day and definitely not a place I will return to again...too many bad experiences.

I live a bit more than 5 minutes away, and this has been my favorite spot in the neighborhood for like a year and a half. 

Food: cream cheese brownie is pretty good. I didn't really try any other food though. 
Drink: one of a few Starbucks stores that serve green tea frappuchino. I don't really drink anything, but frappuchino and smoothies. Personally, I think they're all good. 

Atmosphere: nice leather chairs, tables and counter. If you want to read some book, there are comfy leather chair far away from the blender noises. Personally, I like to hope on one of the three seats near the bar-counter. I love to see them very professionally preparing drinks of all kinds, and look at the line of patron. 

Staffs: professional and friendly, especially the blond, young guy. Not sure what's his name. Brandon, I guess? Anyway, he's extremely professional, friendly, cheerful, and polite.
Got a coffee with a shot of espresso. Then got the bacon, egg, and Gouda breakfast sandwich. It was delicious. Good start to the morning and very helpful and friendly staff.
Fast service but it's Saturday morning and there is no one here. Parfait was tart but hit the spot.

Coffee usually made well. No problems with the drinks. The line can get lengthy due to inattentive staff. Besides that, shop is clean, parking can be scarce due to it's location (tight strip with Verizon & Monroe Muffler) . It's a usual driveby for us on the way to Sam's Club. Worth the run in.

Between landing in Saint Louis International Airport and motoring Interstate 70 into downtown Saint Louis for a week long vacation, this Starbucks came in very handy. If it weren't for this Starbucks, it would of been a very very boring two hours of waiting for my dad's flight to come in. This Starbuck's which is co-listed with the Concourse E Starbuck's downstairs is the ONLY business at presecurity. In other words, once the airline passenger such as yours truly enters baggage claim then gets their luggage, this Starbucks is the only place to hang out in the airport.

 When I hung out here with my brother, I was about to start off a week long adventure in the Lou. So, there was a real positive vibe to the Terminal 2 pre-security Starbuck's. The fact that the drinks cost identical to local locations did not hurt that vibe.

 My brother and I managed to get a couple of the few chairs by a long table in what appeared to be the one seating area. If we carried our cups of coffee outside we'd take in an oversized airplane model hanging from the sun lit ceiling near security. If we were drinking it during a tornado, we'd only have to walk a few feet to the restroom which doubles up as a tornado shelter.

 Due to the fact that this is the first Saint Louis business that I have patronized in over twenty years, this Starbucks Barista gave me my first impression of Saint Louisans. Fortunately, she was a pleasant hard working woman that passed over charging me for a refill.

  In our case, this Starbucks served a very good purpose. During the gap that my brother and my flight and my dad's arrived, perking up with Starbucks in our cups made two hours of time fly by faster than our Southwest flight from Las Vegas to Saint Louis.

This non drive-thru location is by far one of my favorite Starbucks....this visit has made up for some recently unpleasant one.
After trying Ripple Bagel and Deli next door, I wanted my familar drink. This location is very much a local feel. 
I placed my drink order which was nothing special. But as I wanted for my order to be made the barista was very nice.  I wish I had gotten his name, because I would have given him a shout out. Normally they seem to be engrossed in churning out orders even when not very busy. He was super friendly...he asked me about my weekend and how was my Memorial Day going. When he finished the order ahead of me, he asked if I had the iceed white chocolate mocha. Which was mine, when it was ready he handed it to me and my straw vs throwing it on the counter like at others locations.

When I go for my bagel, I stop in at this Starbuck for my drink!

I've pretty much reviewed Starbucks at several locations. THIS one provides me with the healthy alternative while I'm obviously at TIA! This is where I discovered the "Skinny Latte!" If I'm at TIA, you can find me here!

Super friendly staff. They make you feel like your business is welcome, and never make a sloppy $6 drink. Definitely worth the inconvenient parking.  Last time I was there they even offered a puppy whip for my pooch. I only wish every Starbucks was as friendly as this one.
convenient location, but slowest service i've received at a starbucks.

The girls here and couple of male baristas are wonderful! Always super sweet about refills with my gold card while I shop and they are always patient with me when I forget to recharge my card before ordering! The girls are also so great about explaining new drinks and or replacing drinks if you're not 100% happy! Thanks for my delicious pink drink and tea today! Hopefully one day you will carry the deli sandwiches and other cold items they carry at the Starbucks stores!
Some of the best baristas I know. Friendly, fast, and drinks are made perfectly. Excellent atmosphere in which to study too!

Slow, even with no lines. Gave my order, went to use the restroom, and they had *just* started on my drink...

Hint, people... Any time after 5 pm, get at least 2 hipsters working instead of standing around  looking clueless.
Service was excellent. The place was super clean. I was upset they don't have WIFI. The coffee was obviously as good as all the other locations. No complaints other than the WIFI.

Is considered the worst Starbucks in Reno. The employees should spend more time paying attention to what they are doing and less time talking. Starbucks drinks are not cheap so to pay for them and not have it right... Is ridiculous. Compared to the other Starbucks like the one at our hospital this one needs more time training. This store manager needs to get things in line.
Poorly organized. I waited too long then they has screwed up my order. They have two water faucets running full blast all the time wasting tons of water.

Sometimes it's crazy busy here, but the people working are always so pleasant! Of course they are pretty good at making our drinks...just takes a few minutes longer some days. 
We always come inside because the drive thru always has a line...they are pretty well staffed so they keep both lines moving!

Incredibly slow service.  Under staffed or staff doesn't pay attention to the customers unless it is a mobile order.  Allow about 20 to 30 minutes if you stop for a coffee and even longer if you are having a drink made or getting something to eat.

I would recommend going to one of the Starbucks in a store at the Chemical road shopping center.
Fast, friendly staff, good coffee and snacks. Finding parking can be an issue at certain hours as the lot is very small.
This place is just horrible I can't think of a reason why it's so big coffee is disgusting horrible service never again
I go to Starbucks everyday. And this one is my fav place. Ppl work there are pretty friendly!
I love the Iced nonfat Mocha and the blueberry scones are pretty tasty too!!!

This Starbucks is at the perfect distance away from school and home. Great place to go during the non-rush hours. I've had my fair share of not so great experiences here with customer service being a little inaccurate with orders and rude when I bring it up--but I get it--it gets busy and nobody ever wants to do it again and have the job lose some money. Overall, I'd say to order ahead through the mobile app if you don't want to wait in line. If you're there to study, don't hog the outlets during your entire visit. Can't complain. It's Starbucks. 

I WILL SAY THIS THOUGH: because they're almost always going through rushes not all people will prepare the green matcha lattes/frappes correctly and it'll look gross because you end up having to shake it up yourself. Be wise when ordering.

This is your average Starbucks. Drinks are good, staff is warm and welcoming. 

But it's full all the time and there is nowhere to sit. And it's difficult to find a place to plug in your laptop  if you want to use the restroom, you need a code to get in. (Maybe the homeless people use it?)

So busy it's annoying. And you have to pay to park. 

No drive thru but it does have a walk up window. 

If you want to get your coffee and go while perusing Mass Ave, it's perfect. If you want a coffee house experience to hang with friends and talk, or somewhere to get a little work done, this probably isn't your place.

Some say that Starbux is Starbux no matter where you go but I have to disagree. Out of the three or so locations in the "greater Northeast," this is definitely one I prefer. They seem to have the least waiting time (if you're getting something inside), they have enough of the outside seating (3 tables for them and 3 tables for the mexican place next door which are shared), wifi always works gret (I go there a lot when I am working from home) the staff is always smiling and they actually don't burn their coffee as much as some of the other locations. 

Now, some things could be a little better:
1. The wait at the drive-thru is often much longer than I anticipate and, for that matter, prefer... I am not sure what the cause is but once, I waited for 18 minutes while there were only 2 cars in front of me)
2. They could do a better job cleaning outside after those very nice people who neglect to throw out their trash

I enjoyed my visit to this location. The staff was friendly, quick, and my caramel macchiato was made just right.
I was looking for a Starbucks that had a large, comfortable seating area where I could work and hang out for a while. This is the place.
My go-to place when I'm at work in West Philly. The newest Starbucks in the area with friendly partners, fast service and fun seasonal drinks; Back-to-school Frappucino
Morning weekday employees are pleasant, attentive and quick. I appreciate that they remember you too. Parking is difficult during peak hours (morning and lunch). Place is clean.

First off, I LOVE Starbucks. I have a gold card and have been frequenting stores several times a week for a few years now. However, this location definitely is lacking in a few areas.

I think the biggest area has already been mentioned by many reviewers below me, which is the parking situation. When I decide to go to this Starbucks I always have to have an internal debate with myself about whether it's more worth it to wait in the (always ridiculously long) drive thru line or to park and go in (usually quicker) and then attempt to get back out of the parking lot onto Campbell going south. The way the parking lot is set up is not ideal... There really needs to be a way to get back onto Campbell on the east side of the Starbucks so that those of us who are attempting to go south or east from here after getting coffee can do so. There's a private lane running behind the Starbucks if you go around the next building over but I'm not really sure that the general population is supposed to be using that road. Therefore, if you park and go inside of this location your only choice is to get on Broadway going west, which is probably not the way most people are trying to go. Remodeling of some kind needs to be done - I'd be willing to bet accidents have been caused by people trying to dart out of this parking lot back onto Broadway going east.

However, the service itself has always been alright. The drive thru doesn't typically take quite as long as you'd think it would take just by looking at it, and my order has almost always been correctly made by the baristas. They're a bit abrupt at times, but I think that comes from having so many customers at one time literally all the time.

Not attentive to customer needs...ordered coffee, kept me waiting and never asked me what am waiting on. They just kept looking at me until I said where's my coffee?....they forgot my order but never bothered to ask me what am waiting for

I'm not sure if the District Manager is putting pressure on the Manager or if the Manager is playing games to make her profitability look good, but it's obvious that this is not the store to patronize.  One example of the tricks used at this store is to be out of the holiday drinks during promotions.  The store has been out of Carmel Brulee drinks for three days, which means they aren't giving out stickers for the Starbucks for those drinks. In addition, Starbucks is doing a bonus star for Carmel Brulee drinks sold after 2 pm today. So when will they have Carmel Brulee drinks?...tomorrow. The syrups used for Carmel Brulee drinks are not perishable and this store can borrow supplies from other stores, so this is a deliberate act to not have the holiday drink available. This is the second year this store has done this and there are more examples; but if this store is improving their profitability by playing games with the holiday drinks, what are they doing the rest of the year to make the store look more profitable at the customer's expense?

Wow... this Starbucks inside of the Target Store has great service! Love the free wifi to share content  while having a pumpkin spice latte! It  is back! 
Ms. Alexus is always happy to serve you with a smile! Great experience!
The service is always friendly and sincere here. Plus, it's not super crowded on week nights. I usually stop here after my usual runs to Sam's Club and Walmart before heading back over the bridge.

I visited this location last week while in town for a business trip. The location is in the heart of the town near several business which worried me at first because I thought to myself it could get very busy or noisy. It appeared I was fortunate and came in when the coffee shop wasn't busy at all. The staff was friendly and my triple iced latte with non-fat milk was on point! The cafe inside was larger than most locations and was very spacious with several tables, sofa chairs and 1 large table that seats maybe 15 people or more. There was also outside seating in a smaller part of the cafe in the front.  No problems here...

Great "neighbourhood" Starbucks. Some of the SB shops have become kind of cold and sterile. This one located in North St. Pete is warm and welcoming, cozy with a neighbourhood coffee shop "feeling" as the original owners intended.

The environment is pretty relaxed and I like that it's big enough for a decent amount of people. But the drive-thru can be extremely busy and the intersection at Bloomingdale can be a mess. Friendly staff though and it's typical of all Starbucks. I return fairly often.

I stop by here about once a week in the morning for breakfast and/or coffee on my way to work and always have a positive experience. The baristas make excellent iced and hot lattes! I usually get the same thing but during the holidays I tried some of their seasonal flavors that they were just as good. 

Their bakery case is always fully stocked with tempting pastries, breads and cakes but I have successfully always skipped them for a breakfast sandwich. 

The service is always friendly and fast. The main issue with this Starbucks location is the parking lot. On more than one occasion I pulled in, didn't find a spot and had to leave because there were no parking spots left!
I'm kind of sad. When I went on the Sunday morning of Iceamageddon 2017 they made me very upset. No more Chile Mocha lattes. What am I going to do? :-( Sad Face.

This is the second time I've ordered a chia tea for Starbucks and they completely destroyed the drink, it was horrible. Taste like hot coco powder no sugar. And to add insult to injury they butcher my name after I spelled it out for them smh, I will never return.

I'm not from Boise but I was in need of coffee and this Starbucks was great! The barista was incredibly friendly and even joked with me about me being from Oregon. As far as most Starbucks go, I think this one was extremely clean and prompt with my order.

I though I had already written a review of this location. the drive through is quite slow and the line can extend into broadway, if that happens go to the next street, make 2 rights and you are in the parking lot. if you go inside it is just as fast, if not faster then the drive through. 

they also messed up my order once, wanted an iced americano, got a hot... not too pleasant on a hot day but I had a test to get to so I couldn't even get a new one. To be fair it was busy, and I dont think the barista was fully listening.

although I like within walking distance and have been here many times so im still commin' back

This Starbucks has a fun location since it's on Mass Ave, but other than that it's just mediocre for me. The staff was not super friendly to me, like another reviewer had mentioned, however I was there on a Saturday morning and they were SO busy. 

The layout of this Starbucks  is a little strange. There isn't really much space for patrons to wait while their drinks or food are being prepared, so everyone just kind of stands around all awkward-like. 

Do yourself a favor and go a few blocks down the road to Henry's if you want equally as tasty coffee, a larger menu, and like supporting local businesses!
I was very happy with my experience here! My drink was served promptly and the costumer service was excellent.  This Starbucks was very clean and not over crowded.

Came here on the way to work had a reward for a free drink. The young lady who took my order had no idea what she was doing and it took nearly five minutes just to take my order. When I asked the manager of they had at least started making it she said no. After close to ten minutes I left. Not fast and not considerate of peoples time.

Aw, the joy of the captive airport audience.  Maybe I got them on a bad day, but they were pretty disorganized, weren't writing people's names on the cups so we were all a little confused on whose order was whose.  I got a hazelnut latte and it was the worst cup of coffee Starbucks had ever made for me.

One of my favorite Starbucks coffee shops in St. Louis. Lots of good seating (both indoor and outdoor), friendly staff, quick service, fresh selection of pastries, fast Google WiFi. The location is also pretty central and is a good place for meeting with clients. They now have a nice selection of Teavana ice teas, perfect for the summer.

In the heart of downtown IV, this Starbucks is always buzzing with students. You have to come relatively early if you want to snag indoor seating; this is a popular study spot among many, so you won't find too many available spots. On the bright side, there is additional seating on the patio outside. In addition, the baristas are usually quick to crank out drink orders. Anther thing I really appreciate about this location is that it stays open until later on finals weeks, so there is no shortage of caffeine for those trying to pull all-nighters. I only wish they'd serve drinks on tap, like the nitro cold brew!

Not my favorite venue, but was in a hurry and needed a caffeine fix. 1 Starbucks, 2 Starbucks, I never see any differences except, location & service, even the staff seems the same. Expensive, but good coffee.
What's a girl to do? Caffeine fixes can reach critical levels!

This is my favorite location on the Westbank. It's super convenient and my iced coffee is always made just right. A few of the workers even know my order as soon as I walk in. The staff is super friendly and willing to help you with anything. Clean, cool atmosphere that's worth the overpriced merch. The only thing that kind of upsets me is that the decor changed from like a retro New Orleans style to a weird corporate like Starbucks with bean fields and whatnot.

Sure it's an airport location with no extravagant leather sofas, industrial working tables are super cool baristas but it's an airport location...what more do you want but your daily dose served up just in time to board your flight outta this joint.

Located inside Terminal 1 just past the security checkout and next door to Dunkin Donuts.

Prepare for long lines but it moves pretty quickly if you know what you want and don't hold the line up ordering a tall cappuccino with a splash of soy milk, slightly shaken not stirred over a few cubes of ice in a grande up, half pump of hazelnut with a fan of whipped cream on top!!!!! STOP IT PEOPLE

This is my favorite place to get my coffee. It's super convenient and my iced coffee is always made just right. A few of the workers even know my order as soon as I walk in. The staff is super friendly and willing to help you with anything. Clean, cool atmosphere. My number 1 place to get coffee!

I regret it every time I come to this Starbucks. The employees seem to move very slow and appear poorly managed. I also see different people every time, which makes me think people don't want to work here. Today I had a mobile order that took 18 minutes to come out. Their napkins were completely empty, the trash was overflowing, and the bar was filthy. They also altered multiple customer's orders because they were out of iced coffee. I don't understand how I have such terrible experiences at this location when there are so many employees behind the counter. I love Starbucks and will continue going, but it will not be at this location.

I have a big secret.  This is my favorite Starbucks location and I go here 2 to 3 times a week.  

Okay, that's not a big secret... My secret is that I have been going here for a few years now and frequently of late and I have never been inside.  I'm usually in a hurry when I go to this location; I am either headed to work in the morning or getting a quick caffeine jolt in the afternoon or evening and I always use the drive thru.

The baristas here are incredibly friendly. Come to think of it, I can't remember a time when I encountered an employee that was rude. We all have bad days and I would totally forgive one or two bad experiences, but I can't think of any.  

My regular order of a triple venti white mocha (and shhh sometimes 3 petite vanilla bean scones) always comes out quickly and consistently.  

I guess I need to rethink this Starbucks.  I need to remember to think about it not just when I am in a hurry, but also when I am looking for a coffee shop to sit, relax, and read a book.

This is a decent Starbucks; and it's got a drive-thru available, in case you don't want to get out of your car. But if you do, be warned. It seems to be a popular location and was hard to find a place to sit. That is good for business! But not the best, if you want guaranteed seating lol. I found a spot though, and my coffee was good too, so I have no complaints. I like the drive-thru most of the time anyways :)

This Starbucks has great location since it is close to my office and I am a coffee person. Love the outside sitting area, mostly in the evening because it is too hot during the day. Normally, I do not want to write a review for Starbucks because of their popularity, however, I just want to bring to the manager of this location's attention about one of the barista there, Sam is probably the WORST barista that I have ever had at any Starbucks location, she lacks of personality and customer service skills. I am working in hospitality industry, too and that is not how customer should be treated. She made my order wrong and refused to make it right, claiming it was my fault. When I asked her nicely to redo it, she rolled her eyes and walked away. I had to ask another barista to get it done. Never have this kind of experience at any other location. Hopefully, the manager there will address this issue because this location is very convenient for me. If not, I guess I have to give Steep Station across the street a try.

What a joke of a Starbucks!  This store obviously needs a new GM.  First of all, they are out of wooden stirrers.  How can a coffee shop run out of coffee stirrers??  I order a decaf coffee and the cashier tells me that they do not have that.  I later find out from the mgr that they can make a decaf coffee anytime but doesn't seem concerned at all they one of her employees told me they "didn't have decaf".  They forget to make my turkey bacon breakfast sandwich... they have no record of it.  And then it comes out cold.  As I am leaving this guy is going off on the mgr on how they messed up his order and he is very angry!!  Skip this spot please...

Remodel looks okay but this place is always backed up, even when it's slow.  They have 2 cash registers but one is obviously just for looks.  Now, please do not be confused; there will be an employee standing in front of both cash registers, but they cannot, under any circumstances, ring you up using the register on the left.  Meanwhile the general vibe I get is that I am lucky just be served there.  As if asking for a coffee in this starbucks is some obscure out of line request.  These are my thoughts after 4 visits, which were all eerily similar in experience.

Went on a Monday night, had a freebie to use. Never been to this Starbucks before, but the staff seemed very friendly and thorough.
Nice inviting interior, with a covered outside area as well.
Inexplicably closed at 7:35pm, despite an open entrance and  posted hours saying 9pm, with a dismissive and impolite person behind the counter.

The slowest humans making sub-par coffee. You want to be late for work? Stop here. 2 people in line? Doesn't matter. It will  take at least 10 minutes just to make your coffee. Making your wait at Starbucks a waste of time and money.

Horrible customer service. Girl at the register talked to her friend as they made his order so they couldn't get anything started for anyone else. When they were done making my sandwich the girl literally threw it on the counter and walked off without saying a word. I had to walk up there and see if it was mine. Guess that's Starbucks for you, though.

Poor customer service.  Ordered four drinks, most venti sized, so tab was about $20 or so. Went and asked for refill of plain coffee and barista wants fifty cents.  No big deal, but I know free for gold card.  Didn't have phone on me, so I tell her gold card and ask her if she can confirm by my phone number.  She is super annoyed and tells me no.  Insists on fifty cents. Come on!  I order $20 and know the gold card exception, so you might think they would just refill with a smile, but barista is laser focused on that 50 cents.  Turns out my daughter, who paid for all, actually had his card so back to counter again where rude barista begrudgingly refills the coffee.  Not good customer service!  I'd give zero stars if possible due to very poor attitude.

Oh my gosh!  We are from Bend, OR passing through after backpacking MT Whitney.. ANDREA was drive through Barista taking our order.  My husband is the craziest Starbucks customer!  He is always ordering these foo foo drinks and he is a Marine!  He cracks me up! Anyway he was indecisive as usual.. ANDREA was so kind to help him solve his issues on exactly what he needed today!  She was also hilarious!! Bottom line .. Great employee with a HUGE personality!  She made our day!  5 Stars and great job Starbucks.. She is a huge asset!

This is by far the best Starbucks I have ever been to! I  recently started a new job and have only been to this Starbucks a few times. With the stress of starting a new job I realized after ordering my drink and waiting in line that I didn't have my wallet. Very embarrassed, I apologized and was prepared to drive away. The associate informed me that my drink was "On them today." It absolutly made my day!!! It is so refreshing to see a staff that cares for their guests so much. The staff is not only cheerful and efficient they are true day makers.

The baristas are kind, my favorites are Chase and David. The staff are interesting characters, and the crowd is varied and fun. Sometimes the line forms oddly because it's not yet redesigned the way I am used to from living on the other coast, and since it gets quite a lot of traffic sometimes, that means odd lines and disorganization sometimes. 

My iced chai lattés arrive almost instantly, though. 

Ask David for a "Grandré" if you like iced espresso.

This place is 3 Yelp Stars (A-OK). This isn't a bad thing. It's just a normal starbucks. It's what you'd expect. Its nothing special. This is what people expect from starbucks. Coffee, seating, and free bathroom. There is another starbucks in the supermarket so not quite sure why this one exists. but it does. and here we are. 

The staff is nice. The drinks are starbucks. This review is over.

This is a standard Starbucks in terms of menu and decor, but there is always a long line that moves slowly, and they close early. It's super small and inside the Hyatt Regency, but that shouldn't matter. It doesn't quite fit the Starbucks brand.

Not all Starbucks are equal...This is one of the best.  The staff is friendly.  And plenty of space to get some work done.  Special mention to Megan (?) for the excellent customer service.  Love the lipstick!

This Starbucks consistently under-performs in customer service.  The wait times both in the drive thru and inside can be very long, no matter the time of day.  They need to hire more baristas to handle the long rush hour lines.  I waited at the drive thru window for 2 minutes on a black iced coffee, after waiting in the line a total of 10 mins.  

I have seen extremely rude service in the store, to both myself and other customers, which makes me hesitate to go back in. 
 
Sadly, this store is underwhelming as it is so convenient for many.

My personal opinion is that espresso during travel adventures is an absolute necessity of life. While everyone else orders caramel macchiato frappuccino half-caf whipped extra hot concoctions from the Starbucks corporate lab in Seattle Washington... I'm more than happy with a double espresso aka doppio. 

Amazingly, doppio is the actual authentic Italian word to order a double shot! It works at Starbucks and anywhere in Italy! However, the coffee quality in Italy is quite a bit different and to-go is definitely NOT an option. 

At this particular location, you cannot use the app to pay for reasons totally unclear to me. But, cash still works. 

Finally, Death Before Decaf!
I love this place:) the staff rocks and it is quick! By far my favorite Starbucks in the chain!!!!
Love to come and have a cup o joe and tune out for a few. Staff are always friendly and quick. Drinks are good and consistent. Love that Stbx has free wifi now and great people watching at this one.
My favorite Starbucks! The baristas are always friendly and they always make great drinks. Be aware, no drive thru at this location and the parking lot is always packed.
When the right staff is working the best Starbucks!

I'm not going to write a review based on the Starbucks products, because I don't know anyone who hasn't tried them for themselves. So I will just review this location. 

If it were just Starbucks coffee: Fast, Fresh, In my mouth immediately I would give it 5 stars because I love that stuff. 

The mark down of 1 star is due to the speed: I go through the drive thru on a regular basis. When I go I see maybe a car or two ahead of me and have never waited less than ten minutes. I even got to the front a couple of times and saw through the window they had one person taking orders from both the drive thru and the in store guests.... seriously? 

The other star is for the weird experiences I have had inside. I have been inside only three times and every time I have heard the manager/supervisor whatever she is, yelling at the employees. She could just be a loud person, but it's a small place so really no excuses for this. I feel like I saw all of the patrons kind of pause in their coffee sipping and just look around when she started yelling. 

I live in the North Valleys and prefer to go to the Lemmon Valley Starbucks any time I can.

This is one of my favorite Starbucks I have ever been to!  Max and the other staff are friendly, attentive, and just plain know there stuff!  The Clover Coffee is fabulous!  Well worth the price and wait!!

I'm in Houston now and unfortunately I have not found a Starbucks run as well as this one and none have the Clover Coffee maker either!

This may be the busiest Starbucks in the United States. It is insanely busy and the staff are working their butts off to keep up. If you are impatient or inclined to complain you should go elsewhere. The team at this place demonstrates remarkable work ethic.  

Thanks for the hard work. My drink was perfect.

This starbucks location has a very relaxed lounge type atmosphere.  Plenty of sofa chairs, couches and they play background music.

This location is very busy with their drive thru and they still manage to give decent service inside.  It can be very tough to get to because its right smack on the corner of dale mabry and linebaugh, a very busy intersection no doubt.


I always order a venti latte with 6 raw sugars and cinnamon sprinkled on top.  They are always consistent and I cant say that i have ever had an issue so far.

The only complaint i would have is their steep pricing, I paid $4.23 for a cup of coffee, ouch!  For that reason I take away a star.
The slowest drive-thru ever! Definitely need to work on efficiency here. It is easier to drive to Paoli than wait in this line.
Free Wifi, Free Power for devices, over priced drinks. Exactly what you would expect.

I think this place is the best of all location there is. the staff is so super freindly and seems to know everyone by name. Jane is the boss and  Ms ASHLEY is the most super bristia in the world. Very clean, My coffee is the same for 3 years no matter whom makes it is is always fresh and perfect.

Great place to get work done! My new obsession is the mango tea lemonade!! 

Love the feature to order ahead and have it waiting for you!!!

When the NYC Starbucks said peppermint syrup is seasonal and this airport Starbucks had it.  Well that earns a star.  Properly placing 5-6 pumps into a venti earns them a star.  Then respectful employees and cleanliness earns them 3 more.  As a gold card member I frequent enough Starbucks to say they earned this rating today.

A Starbucks with a drive thru window. Get your buzz on the run, how convenient! 

I actually haven't used the drive thru yet though, haha. You see, the windows of my truck are small so I have this horrifying image of me clipping the top of the cup on my window frame and then watching in slow motion as the cup drops square onto my lap with the lid popping off on impact! What a nightmare... so yeah, I use the parking lot (which is in the back of the store by the way) and I walk my butt inside. (there's an entrance facing the back parking lot too, so no, you don't have to walk all the way around to the front to get inside, jeeze don't be so negative!). 
Be careful walking in though!  Those speedy, "buzz on the run" types with their big car windows could easily run you down as you cross their path toward the door. 

There is some outdoor seating out front which is nice, I think there are umbrellas at the tables too, but I'm not certain because I never stick around long enough to notice. 

Yes of course there is free wifi and tables to hang out inside, they have baked goods and a retail section full of strangely shaped mugs, coffee and other coffee related stuffs. (what Starbucks doesn't have this stuff? None? Oh ok, then why did I bother mentioning it? Who knows.) 

I'm not going to comment on the quality of the coffee vs other non-Starbucks shops, etc, etc, etc because I'm only reviewing the location and frankly you probably don't care because it's a Starbucks, and you already have your own opinion on that so why should I waste my breath? err... fingers?

Their service is fast, I never have any trouble there.

That is all.

(This my 50th review, so it only makes sense that I'd choose to write about a place I really love!)

Starbucks is awesome. That being said, some locations are more awesome than others. The Tampa Road location is one of those, no doubt about it.

It didn't used to be.

It used to have a very cramped feel. Mind you, the place is pretty small already, but the colors and furniture always made it feel even smaller. Then a few months ago the store got a face lift, and it looks a heck of a lot better now.

They have a communal table with electrical outlets lining the sides, a nice couch for two, and a few other individual chairs. The arrangement is much more suited for the shape of the space and, though I liked it before, now I love it.

Something that has never changed is the customer service. The baristas here are quick, quirky, and the down to earth; the kind of people I'm glad to see running a coffee shop. My drinks come out right every time, and whenever I'm feeling adventurous these guys are great at suggesting new drinks for me to try. 

I also love this location because of its close proximity to Panera. More than once I've been able to grab a bite for lunch there, then come right next door to Starbucks for a Frappuchino. It's a really great set up.

The only thing I don't love is the parking. They really could use more spots around here, and a lot of the drivers come flying through the parking lot. I've had the daylights scared out of me a few times.

If you can get a parking spot then the rest is cake or, in the case of Starbucks, Birthday Cake Pop. Speaking of which, I may just need to make a stop on the way home...

I don't go to this Starbucks often because I hate this shopping center.  However, it is a decent Starbucks, with decent seating, and a friendly staff.  

Today I had a free drink on my gold card.  I ordered a chocolate banana smoothie with a shot.  After I "paid" with my freebie, they realized they were out of bananas. I said, no worries, just make it without a banana.  Without my asking or even complaining, they handed me a coupon for my next drink to be free.  I love this policy at Starbucks - I have received freebies a couple of times becuase something went a little wrong, but nothing too terrible.  I am now looking forward to another free drink tomorrow.

This is just like any other Starbucks you've ever been to, minus comfortable seating. The place is always busy and the staff is pretty efficient, but very business oriented. Even rethink is focused on  speed and less on hospitality. 

The coffee is Starbucks, so nothing fancy. It's the same fare you can get at any location anywhere. 

The work areas are clean but the merchandise is covered in a layer of dust. Just goes to show that I'm not the only one who thinks a 12oz tumbler should cost less than $25.

But it's a moot point because I wanted a better cup of coffee but I had to very much settle for Starbucks.
The worst 2 cups of coffee ever brewed at Starbucks. Plain dark roast tasted like brown water. I asked for a repour this time a medium roast , same result , weak brown water. Disappointed.

I just ordered a tall soy white chocolate mocha from this location. The beverage was more than an inch away from the rim when I received it and the whipped cream appeared mangled and sunken into the beverage. I did not wait long but I am unsatisfied with the proportion given, I should have just ordered a short since my cup was not full. 

Ive had the exact same order at North Town Mall Starbucks location and it did not appear like that at all and it even taste better.

The staffs are super friendly, i've been coming here for 4 yrs now, they make the coffee right, and quick. Just one small problem that it is very hard to find parking in the morning around 8-9:30 am. Overall, it is a good place to work, study, meet with friends. They have plenty tables.

Been here two times and this is the second time they have forgotten my order. I waited over 10 minutes while others (6 people) behind me got their orders ahead of mine. I had to go over to the barista and tell them that I hadn't received my order after waiting another 5 minutes. They need to re-think their service order priority.

Love this place and the staff. No I'm not going to write a review about Starbucks, but something unique I saw this morning. They have grounds for your garden. Free!! Come and get them of you have a garden

Always clean and friendly.  The staff is always more than willing to go out of there way to do anything.

The only reason I am giving it a 4 star out of 5 is because the entrance -- it is the most strange entrance and the parking is limited.  

Overall, one of the better Starbucks in town.

I have decided that this is the last time that I will give this Starbucks location my money.  Time and time again I have received sub par service from this location and due to convenient proximity to my house I have returned with the hope that they will get it right this time.  I've looked past the fact that the staff hasn't been as friendly as other locations, I've compromised when they gave me still half frozen breakfast sandwiches by heating them up at home and I even overlooked the time that they surprised me by saying they had no coffee but could make something espresso based.  I don't know how a coffee shop runs out of coffee but it was 6 a.m. and I guess I wasn't in the mood to ask such mind blowing questions.  Today after having not visited this location for over a year, I decided to give it one more shot how hard could it be to order an ice coffee and move on with my day.  Well after waiting for 10 minutes to get my iced coffee and watching 7 other people with specialty drinks who ordered after me be served before me, I went up to the cashier to inquire as to what was taking so long with my simple iced coffee.  Her reply "oh we spilled all the iced coffee and now have to make some more."  10 minutes later I got my coffee, no apology, no offer to comp for the inconvenient 20 minute wait. Apparently communicating with the customer who is waiting for their coffee is completely off their radar.  So I'm done, over it.  This location has the worst customer service and in the age of social media reviews and unlimited choices I won't be giving this place my business and I hope others will consider offering their money to locations that are friendly and aware of what it means to at least meet if not exceed your customer's expectations.

This location needs some serious retraining. Five baristas behind the counter, one making drinks.
The other 4 yammering amoung themselves, quite loudly, how they didn't want to work the counter, another one complaining they didn't want to be there at all.  Never had that bad an experience in a Starbucks. Waited 15 minutes for a coffee while the line of people just grew longer. Plus this one doesn't even have a drive in window. The last thing a customer wants to hear
is employees complaining. My drink was wrong and no, I didn't go get it fixed.
Shout out to the team this morning...one machine down, 25 people waiting for coffee and they kept cranking the drinks out.  Great group of people at this location.

Loooooooooong liiiiiiiiiiiiiines in the morning.  Avoid at all costs!

Aside from mornings, I've given this location a couple of other tries.  For whatever reason, they have a problem making a proper misto.  

I'd rather deal with the traffic to stop at the location off of Greyhound Pass, or travel south to the store near 96th street and Meridian.

This location would earn a 2nd star if slow wait was occasional.

Ok, as far as Starbucks go. Would love a little more friendly vibe but haven't seen that from here.....ever. Not saying it's unfriendly...just blah. Varied crowd if you want to people watch... I mean it is downtown Clearwater after all.
The service and location is good. I've been coming here for over a decade, but the biggest problem with this location is SPACE. Never a place to sit. It's packed every time I come in.

Been to this location several times and the drive thru is the slowest I've ever been in.  My son had to work Christmas so I promised him a Starbucks coffee.  Wife called to verify the hours and was in the drive thru 21 minutes before there closing time.  Drive thru was so slow we never got to order before an employee came out and told us they were closed and we had to back out if the drive thru.  To many places with good coffee, never going back.  Horrible customer service!

This is the second time I have been in this city at this location and had to walk out. 
The staff is more concerned with sweeping floors, stocking shelves and everything else but servicing the client. 
I waited 10mins with only one person in front of me and no one ever took either persons order. 
I will never stop at this location again.

I have ordered a couple of times here and sometimes their coffee is good, but on occasion you get a cup of milk with watered down coffee. On one occasion I asked for a caramel macchiato and it tasted like milk with caramel. No coffee whatsoever, and I was disappointed because I love Starbucks! But overall it's a good way to grab a quick coffee if your on the go or if you're late. And the next time, I might ask for an extra shot in my macchiato :). "Happy Eating!"
I am a regular customer. It always seems like they're understaffed, but they make good drinks! Expect to wait a few minutes.

You know what to you get at Starbucks, let me tell you what makes this one special.

I really like this Starbucks. Of all of the stores in the area, this one has the best seating, parking, and staff.

The store has 4 leather chairs with side tables. A bunch of two and four top tables with both standard chairs and barstools. There is a booth that runs 100' along the wall opposite the counter. It makes working or meeting there an absolute pleasure. It's the biggest store I have seen in the Indy metro area.

The parking lot is big, although it's harder to get into with the US31 reconfiguration.
I stop by this location on the way to work almost every day. I order my favorite drink, iced caramel macchiato, and it's always made right! This particular location has extremely nice staff.

Very disappointing service from this store. Granted, any airport based service is going to be of a lower calibre than their real-world counterparts, but this experience was really sub-par. I asked for a tall coffee in a classic stanley thermos, and was poured a 3/4s full Tall Paper cup which was then emptied into my thermos. This was done in a clearly disdainful manner, and I immediately felt accused of having attempted to steal coffee from their store. Of course she then threw away the paper cup (easily equal in value to the coffee she had just sold me). Both unprofessional, unfriendly, and un-green.

Completely rude. Was told I couldn't order anything that is heated up because they "turned the oven off" with over two hours till closing. Have never had this bad of customer service at a Starbucks. Would compare this to a McDonald's that is in the rough part of towns customer service.

I despise this Starbucks! It shouldn't even be called Starbucks but rather "StarCLUCKS" for all the chicken head bitches that work there. The area is always dirty and unkempt. The chickens are always pecking about and have no customer service skills whatsoever! If there is one thing I cannot stand is people in customer facing positions who obviously hate customers! 

I say "Hi, how are you?" 
No reply. 
"Okay, I will take a ...." 
 Reply... "Oh we don't got none of that!" 

No bitch, what you really meant to say or what my cynical mind believes more or less 'it's 10am we ran out and I don't feel like making any more! Plus, my shift over in a hour, ain't nobody got time for all that!' 

Way to pass the 'BUCK'. Pun, truly intended! 

My request was simple... I asked for a piping hot blonde in large cup to which I could add all my sweetness and cream!  

Pleasant Patty, aka me, "Ok, then I guess I will have XYZ" and the chicken just clucks on... . Never gives me a total, asks for my name, never asks if I need room for all the other stuff I like to add, just minimal words to be exchanged.

Although Target failed miserably to afford a convenience to its shoppers, I am just as happy to    my way to the promenade adjacent to the Target and go to the REAL Starbucks!  

You know, the one with the eclectic vibe, funky music playing in the background, clean seating areas inside and out, free wifi, with an overall inviting atmosphere that says 'Hey guy , you ... Yeah you ! Come, have a seat... I got your fix. Stay awhile!' 

After all isn't that what Starbucks is known for? 

If I wanted shitty service from 'Shenika and dem' then I'd go get my coffee from the gas station for 99 cents! 

Alright, I'm done my tirade! I just needed to put that out there! 

Oh and one last thing, YELP! Where the hell is the negative star button⁉

If you are from anywhere in the Pacific Northwest, do NOT go to this Starbucks! You are NOT that desperate for caffeine! Trust me! I don't think their barista has been properly trained on the machines. Coffee tastes watered down. Seattle would be ashamed of this barista. Go five miles out of your way to the Starbucks on Gulf to Bay BLVD instead. Ten minute trip from the beach, totally worth it.

This is Sherwood Park's newest Starbucks and only the second one in town with a drive-thru - that alone should give it a couple extra stars!

The decor of this Starbucks is laid back and comfortable feeling, with lots of diverse seating options. There is one large, long table that would be perfect for a study group or business get together, as well as single, low chairs. With the distressed tin walls covering part of the coffee shop, you get a definite "kick back and relax feel".

The service is great and of course the coffee is... well, Starbucks - so how can you go wrong? A nice selection of bakery items and clean, comfortable washrooms make this spot high on my coffee spots list.

Omg people weren't lying when they said this is the "slowest" Starbucks. We waited easily 20+ minutes in the drive thru when there were maybe about 5 cars in front of us. It reminded me of the sloths in zootopia! And on top of that, I ordered a skinny peppermint mocha frap which I'm not sure why, but they topped with salted caramel syrup. The guy working the drive thru window was nice though. I just don't recommend going here if you are in a rush. You'll definitely be late.

Short line on a Friday evening and they have my favorite in stock! Trento sized strawberry acai with coconut milk. Lots of places have been running out with the new trend so I'm glad they have it it cool me off on a hot day in St. Louis! This store also has snacks and cups and gifts to pick up. I collect the you are here mugs and they have the St. Louis one in stock for under $12.

Starbucks is Starbucks. The coffee is always good. I only wished they would keep the half and half out in the afternoon. I hate to have to keep asking for it. If they're so worried about it growing warm, put it in ice! Jeeeez.

There's not much to complain about - it's coffee. I've never experienced any lines or mess ups w/ my drinks here (and I've come at all times of the day), so that's good. The baristas working are quick and friendly, too.

I do have to gripe about the 6pm closing time though. Really?

The ladies behind the counter were on it today.  I walked up to a 10 deep line and they cranked through it like pros.  Not the most friendly bunch, but efficient, and sometimes that is just good enough.  

Star off for the sitting area being a bit messy.

Great drinks, good light food and excellent service.  Everyone who works here is always nice and friendly.  They keep it very clean. Drinks get messed up once in a while, not often but they are always willing to remake it and are great with the feedback.  Only real downside is the parking lot is small and the drive thru line backs up to route 30 frequently.  I think the staff does a great job to try and get people through as quickly as possible.  Highly recommend!
Sarah at this Starbucks was the nicest barista I've ever come across! Keep it up, Sarah!
It's as good as any Starbucks..mediocre at best
This Starbucks always has good ring and good customer service my latte was very yummy and had great taste as well as it was heated perfectly  thanks Starbucks team !

This location has super fast service.  Drive through service is a plus for me as I was in a hurry.  As usual Customer service was great and my order was spot on. I will def. visit this location more often.

This used to be an amazing starbucks where the employees knew your name and drink so by the time you got up to the register, they had your drink almost done. Now it's SUPER SLOOOOOOWWWWW! And they don't seem to care even though the lines are almost to the door! Piss poor service as well as slow. Avoid and go to the eight others within a few miles.

This is the SLOWEST, least efficient Starbucks in the WORLD. Do not come here if you're in a hurry, I can guarantee you you will leave pissed off and not enjoy your coffee.
If there is no line, or cars in the drive thru you'll be OK.

Very nice location which will be celebrating its 1st anniversary shortly. Baristas are all friendly, location is nice and clean and so is their restroom.  I learned that they were trained by my pastor's elder daughter who works @ the one on 611 in Jenkintown - haven't gone there yet since it's out of my way and whenever I'd go by commuting to my former work location there was never any parking in their lot and am unfamiliar with Jenkintown's twisty, turney streets.  Like another reviewer said sometimes they can be a bit on the slow side.  One day I was very lucky and my friend who works @ the Jenkintown location filled in that day - I must say that my Frappucino that great day was extra tasty.  The only food item I tasted (since they tend to be pricey) was their Bantom Bites (little balls made out of bagel dough) which were OK in taste but not worth the value.  I like to come here when am looking for a special treat @ the end of the week since I don't live around the corner.  It's in the Huntingdon Valley Shopping Center which is just a few feet away from the building where my primary care doctor and my gyn are located - also a Pet Valu is a few doors down - also turning 1 year old soon.  At the other end of the shopping center is the Giant that I do my grocery shopping in, get stamps and prescriptions filled.  The reason this is a 4 instead of a 5 is that they have a $5 minimum limit when reloading your card (whereas the Starbucks located in said Giant has no such limit) and the service can be sometimes a tad slow.  However, you shouldn't go wrong if you give this location a shot - and there's plenty of parking to boot and the Route 24 bus stops at the shopping center.
I've gone to many a Starbucks in my day, but nothing beats my experience here. Jude was super nice and patient with my long and complicated order.

Lines can be a hit or miss but the Starbucks galliera is a very busy location!
