There's very limited seating inside but there's some outside and additional seating down stairs by panera and Nordstrom.  I usually do a mobile order if I decide to get a drink here. I have never had a problem with this location and the drinks I've order here are super delicious :)

I always go here for my tea or coffee. The people here are very kind, right type for this kind of business. The location is perfect, the parking is quite horrible though. The place is big, I always get a seat. It's a great place to study too.

This is the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. The people who work there should go to star bucks reeducation camp. They ignored me for their friends who were behind me. It took more than 15 minutes for me to get the three drinks I ordered. Were also rude to other customers in the store. They should close this store and start over.
Love that they will do a blonde pour over for you if they don't have any brewed currently.

This morning I went through the drive through and it seems that the order gal was having a worse day than I was. I had to repeat my order 3x and my drink was still wrong in the end. She didn't even greet me at the window; instead I was given a scowl. I don't think I will return to this location which is a bummer because they have a drive thru.

Service was insincere. When asked for more food choices due to the lack of selection, cashier had to make up a story. Not impressed at all. This is the only Starbucks in Downtown Tampa and it is disappointing!

This Starbucks and another have been my favorite during a recent "tour" of the ones in our area. There is spacious seating, and after a recent remodel the place is looking more modern. 

The employees here are among the best I've encountered at a Starbucks and the only negative about this location would be how it lacks a drive-thru, but that is something to take-up with the corporate Starbucks as opposed to this location.

Should you need a place to just sit-back and have some coffee this is a fine location!

Aaron, Kevin, and the staff of the Mass Ave Starbucks are by far the best in any Starbucks I've been around the country! The staff not only learns your face, but your name and your drink. They always greet you with a smile, the store is kept immaculate, and I look forward to my coffee every day. If you're in downtown Indy, be sure to stop in!

Best time for a cafe latte. The only problem with this location is where they are situated and parking. If you come during off time it's a snap but challenging when busy, doesn't matter to me though I love the stuff!

I wanted a large coffee, black.  My coffee machine was broken so I pulled into the drive through on the way to work.  The wait seemed like forever but may not have been that long.  Paid cash and got the coffee.  Drank most of it, got to work, sat it on the desk and noticed lip stick rings on the cup.  I am a man, and don't wear lipstick.  I poured the rest out, and there were some cookie crumble remnants in the bottom of the cup.  I don't know if they inventory cups and since the girl saw cash she just grabbed my cup from the trash, filled it and pocketed my money or what, but they are off my list now.

Very busy so they don't really have the time to be to friendly place has kinda gone down here my coffee always taste burnt. Cafe area is always dirty and they always have more than enough help but nothing is clean and poor customer service very poor!

This location was my #1 spot as it is convenient for me- until today.  This morning, I got there at 9am, after 5 minutes of being torn about what I wanted to drink, I placed my order (black tea lemonade- the cashier recommended it), a kid's hot chocolate and a glazed donut for my daughter. After 5 minutes, she received her drink and we sat at the table and waited, and waited, and waited. FINALLY, at 9:20 I nicely asked for my daughter's donut so she can at least eat (still no donut). I really couldn't take it anymore at 9:25, asked them for the donut again (which they finally gave me) and cancelled my tea (I was too pissed to get a refund or wait for them to make me one) WTH??! Please note: there were NO customers in the store!!!! 20 minutes wait time in an empty store is ridiculous! I will never go back to this place again.  If the baristas would stop running their mouths and goofing around with each other and start making coffee, maybe I'd return (actually I won't). This completely ruined my morning! If I could give them "zero" stars, I would!! 
You'll notice that I don't have that many reviews, 9 out of 10 times, if I get satisfactory to good service, I won't post. 
Here's to my 5th review via Yelp (raising my chai latte made from my keurig)
Tried a peach green tea and it was refreshing and they gave my puppy a puppichino! Staff was more on the friendly side as well. Cute spot to visit while I'm out here

I like this Starbucks. I'm not sure how crazy it is during the week, but on the weekends it's nice and slow. Meaning there is a constant line but it moves quick, and not waiting 20min for a drink order. This has become my go to Starbucks since it's opened. Fast and friendly service and always right on my order!

I ordered a small latte with soy and 1 pump of maple pecan sauce, the barista insisted that has to be just maple pecan latte and charged me $5.89, where my original order will be less than $5. I order the same way back in CA and there's no problem at all. Plus the staff are so unfriendly, I think that's what makes the experience so bad. You guys may be the first face someone visit Philly for the first time, be nice please!

Every time I go I have a good experience but tonight u did not. I ordered a medium Vanilla Bean Frapp and a Peppermint Mocha Frapp through the drive thru. I pull up to the window and pay her for what I bought. She brings out a regular HOT Peppermint mocha when I specifically ask for it as a Frappe. I politely correct her letting her know I asked for the Frapp in the drive thru and she replies with, " No you didn't say you wanted the frappe at all... But I can change it for you." And I'm just in shock because her attitude towards me was very impolite. The way she said it was horrid. And to add on to it she didn't apologize, isn't the costumer always right ?
Drinks are fine but service has been awful the last few times I've been in. Definitely needs to improve

This Starbucks is a little difficult to get into due to the small and busy parking lot. It also does not have a drive-thru. However, they are always very fast and efficient on the inside. We have never had service issues at this location. I typically order an Iced Vanilla Chai and it comes out perfectly mixed (it can be grainy if done incorrectly) and delicious every time.

As a coffee shop, this is a very good Starbucks.  Great coffee and nice foods.  Pleasant Baristas who know how to handle a large and rather particular morning crowd. Beware, however, it's a major gathering place and social scene for the Ladue Patch... especially on weekend mornings.  Private school logos and Lululemons galore. Better brush your teeth, wash your hair; and, make sure to do some sit-ups, run a few miles or play some hockey in the early am before you show up!  Not many heavy diners, smokers, beer drinkers or cola drinkers here...this ain't no freakin' Dunkin' Donuts!
Located inside an office complex, you'll need to park and walk in.. lots of seating inside and outside, got my drink and walked out.  Service was good, friendly staff.  Standard Starbucks.

Starbucks do you see the consistent one star reviews. Just now, teach the lady customer service. Wouldn't toast the bagel; told me they didn't have something, I then showed her the sign saying they do. She said, "ya that's wrong and never heard of the pound cake you're asking for."  Wouldn't make specialty coffee, just regular. So I go in for a toasted bagel and mocha and leave with regular coffee and stale donut from yesterday.

This Starbucks is bigger in area than most and has good wifi and access to power plugs on the "bench" seating close to where you pick up your drinks. There is a nice patio area with umbrella tables and a great view of the Sierras. The staff is on the ball, polite and efficient. In this Starbucks you can actually put some tables together and have meeting. The drinks are consistent with Starbucks standards so if you like Starbucks coffee you will like it, if not you won't.

Just about the only Starbucks out there that hardly ever messes up my custom coffee order. I've been here countless times. 

Don't let college student baristas fool you. I've consumed a majority of the Starbucks menu and the employees prep the drinks well, if not better, than some of the other locations I've been to. My only problems with this place are 1) the limited amount of table space and outlets (especially for a college town location) and 2) the fact that it closes super f*cking early in the summer and on weekends. 

Oh, I also hibernate in here. It's my second home in Isla Vista, and basically my bed during finals week. If you see a tiny Asian girl inside looking either cracked out or highly caffeinated and surrounded by a heap of study materials, it's probably me.

I am assuming this is the four-bucks inside the Target in Glen Mills.
Went there today for a large order for a group and they were pleasant, helpful & quick.

No issues and so glad they are there.

I am not really a fan of Starbucks.  Unfortunately at this mall all they have for coffee is Starbucks.  I ordered a venti Cold Brew which I can tolerate.  Most of the coffee at Starbucks just tastes burnt to me but as I said the cold brew is ok.

My wife ordered a Carmel frapucino light.  However they did not have the sugar free Carmel.  It is very sad to me that Starbucks would ever be missing any of the needed ingredients for their signature drinks.  The first drink they made did not have any coffee at all.  I did not even know they would make a Frapucino with no coffee.  The guy behind the counter said that kids get it that way.  My wife said it was "gross."

In any case she settled on a mocha frapucino light which ended up tasting ok.

The people behind the counter were nice which is why I am giving 2 stars instead of 1.  

It is also overly busy here which explains the slow service.

The bottom line is that I will continue to get coffee here when I am at the Mall because they seem to have a monopoly which explains the high prices.

Starbucks factory - always a line, but they keep it moving. I was not impressed with the bananas (they were old and brown...). Service was fast and friendly and the coffee was good. I really wish they didn't have all the standard airport fare though (water, fruit cups, etc are all the same everywhere).

Absolutely love this Starbucks! Not only do they make amazing coffee, the staff itself is worth the trip. I know you may think, of course they have to be polite. Well let me tell you, 70℅ of anywhere I go the people are not so polite. So when I say the staff is amazing you know it's worth a try!

The baristas here are the nicest  people ever! I've always gotten my order promptly even if it's super busy, and they never overdo it with the ice. Atmosphere can sometimes be a little bland, but that always is welcome when I stop here to study! I'm by no means a regular, and I regularly get coffee from whatever's open and nearby and I have yet to be disappointed. Just posting this because I see a ton of ..m,, negative review. See

So, first, this is an airport Starbucks...  The first of its kind at PHL.  Most hub airports have a Starbucks, so it's been a longtime coming here in Philly and I was excited to be able to get a Starbucks once in the airport.

The verdict:  Complete Disaster!  There are competing standards that determined this assessment.  First, it's Starbucks, which has its own, rather high standard and second, it's an airport establishment, which has to be quicker and more efficient than normal because people are actively in transit, a standard any eatery in an airport would and should be held to.  Unfortunately for this Starbucks it lives up to neither of these standards.  

The line moved agonizingly slow.  The guy taking the orders was taking his good old time.  I don't mean, "My plane's coming and I need to get this and go and you're taking forever" slow...  I mean, "Dude, you're literally moving like you got some methadone right before your shift" slow.  Forget airport speed, it wasn't even Starbucks speed.  Heck, it wasn't even DMV speed.  Just awful.

Next, all the employees behind the order-taker disappeared into "the back" at the same time and spent a good almost 10 minutes back there, meaning no orders were even being processed during that time.  Once they came back, one of the ladies said, "If you're waiting on a drink, you need to move into the gallery."  At this point there's a backup of 12-15 people waiting.  As we walk past that lady, she turns and whispers to another employee, "I ain't even playing with these people today."  Ordinarily I would have caused a huge stink about that, but I'm in an airport and regardless of wrong or right, I can't afford to get thrown out so I just keep moving, but man, that really ticked me off.

Once the drinks came, easily 20 minutes in, my wife's order, which was supposed to have whip, didn't have any whip.  Not the end of the world at all, and ordinarily Starbucks would be quick to make everything right, but it was such an unorganized madhouse that it wasn't even worth it.

The employees are slow, inefficient, unorganized, inaccurate, and worst of all perhaps, they were rude which, regardless of what you think of Starbucks as a company, you almost never encounter overt rudeness like you do here.

I could excuse a lot if there were some abnormal circumstance.  Somebody calls out, they're short staffed, a machine is broken, abnormal rush, etc.  But none of this was the case.  The Starbucks by E in Charlotte is always WAY busier and they get it done.  The employees staffing this Starbucks are just atrocious and it's clear they do not want to be working there.  Starbucks should be embarrassed.  There's lots of other places in PHL to get good coffee, Au Bon Pain, Le Bus, etc.  this Starbucks is NOT worth it!  Steer clear.
Sometimes it's the closest location, and you need your fix. This one'll do just fine, and has a large space and ample seating for relaxing with your warm beverage.
Love this new Starbucks. More spacious, modern and plenty of seating. Lots of parking.  And PLENTY of charging outlets now.
As always very friendly staff and quick service. Sometimes a bit over crowded but that's most Starbucks. Free wifi and lounging chairs are available.

Starbucks in the E Concourse on Mon. mid-afternoon 4/16/18- the best people working, cheerful, made a great shot- in- the- dark, and looked us in the eyes - nice to make a little human connection any day but especially while traveling.
I have gotten my usual vente americano here they did a fine job. makes me want to grab some every time before i shop.

I've never been a fan of Starbucks.  I don't understand why people insist on overpaying for an over-roasted cup of coffee?  It just doesn't make sense to me.  While the Very Berry Hibiscus refresher and most of the smoothies are okay, I can't justify spending the money there on a regular basis.

Inside it's your run of the mill Starbucks, with nothing negative or substantially positive added to the overall experience.  I've had friends who work at this location ... so I guess that's one redeeming quality.   It's fairly quiet and offers free Wi-Fi, so there's that.  

In a pinch you could do worse than Starbucks, but I'd recommend heading a block over to the Monon Coffee Company and getting a better cup of coffee or one of their incredible teas.  You'll save a little money on your coffee and get a way better experience.
The service at this Starbucks I would think that the owners would be embarrassed!  Incompetent and took half an hour to get a drink.... At an airport!? Unreal
First time stopping for breakfast and all they have left is the spicy breakfast sandwich??? I 10am not still breakfast?

I had a gift card to use and was in the mood for Starbucks so we came here. My husband said this was the most people he's seen in this line. It was moving really slow too. We get to the cashier and finally order. 

The cashier was either not interested in her job at all or just flaky. I had to repeat my order a couple times, she was arguing with another worker as I was giving my order and not listening. I said I wanted the bacon egg and cheese on the croissant and she seemed like she didn't know what I was talking about. I had to point to the display counter. She then turned away and started talking to the worker again. There must have been some kind of issue or people didn't know what they were doing. When she decided to give me her attention again I said I also wanted the bacon and gruyere sous vide egg bites. She seemed confused again then said "oh...ok. Which one?" Um, I just said the bacon and gruyere ones. 

I also ordered a java chip Frappuccino. The past couple times I got it it just hasn't tasted the same. The chocolate chips in it taste old. I didn't really taste much java or coffee in it either. 

The egg bites were good and the sandwich was ok, but for the price we can probably make our own at home and not have to deal with incompetent workers. Next time we decide to go to Starbucks I wanna try to go to a different location, even if we have to drive farther.
Favorite starbucks ! Turner is ALWAYS in a great mood amd gives great customer service
Just got served the worst Eggnog Latte I've ever had, worth about $0.10 but paid $4.75 plus $1 tip.  Putting Starbucks Isla Vista is under embargo again!

I never came to this location. I was in the area, it was snowing and it just seemed right. Smaller location not the smallest and it was very busy, like most Starbucks I go to. I got my White Chocolate Mocha and I was out.
Slowest service I have ever experienced.  Can't believe Starbucks allows their brand to be used by this Hyatt operation.  10 minutes for 5 people to get through.

Literally at any given time on a weekday morning there's 4-6 people working behind the counter and this is still one of the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. In addition I rarely get my orders made correctly the first time around. Half the time they forget when you ask for food and you have to remind them about it

Got "lightly sweetened" iced chai with no ice. Came with ice and tasted light straight syrup in a cup. Waste of $6 because their baristas don't know what they're doing.
Excellent service!!! They remember your drinks, your name, and give such a warm greeting every time I go in. Keep up the great job!! :-) :-)

This is one sad, sad Starbucks. Not only is it gross and unkept; the staff is absolutely useless. They look (and act) as if they have never made coffee before in their life, they are rude, tired, and basically just remind me of junkies without any trace of motivation. The place is a chaotic mess; if you don't want your day ruined, take the time and drive somewhere else for your daily dose of caffeine - this place is not worth your time, let alone money.

Good luck with wifi. Apparently the password changes. This one might work for you: wifi name hhonors and password emb06. Once you do finally get online, the connection is just awful.

Ordered the usual Java Chip. It came out tasting a bit strange, like it had cinnamon in it. Who am I kidding? It's gross, honestly. Tasted nothing like the usual that I get at other locations. Ended up just tossing most of it. 

Very small location with just a few tables inside. The employees don't really seem happy to be there.

One consistent quality this place had was the laxative effect of their coffee. Sent me straight to the bathroom. At least the bathrooms there look really nice. It's a shame it smells so bad.

Overall, I can't say I'm impressed with this place.
Located right after the security check point.  Convenient.
I suppose that this is okay if you need a quick cup of Joe before you fly out.  It serves a purpose and the you get served quickly.

It is a Starbucks, which means decent coffee always... fixed pretty much however you want it. I won't say the drinks are inspired, but they are good, and very consistent almost anywhere you go. That does have a value... especially if you are somewhere where finding a nice rich triple shot breve grande Cafe Mocha is difficult to do. 

The staff is almost always friendly, and sometimes even entertaining. This particular location is close to where I live, so I stop in occasionally, and they have always met my expectations!

Parking here is a pain... many people use the parking lot as a shortcut to get to Linebaugh off of Dale Mabry... to miss the short wait at the light.  But Wieners exist everywhere... can't let them get you down, right?  :)

Happy Caffeine!
Worst Starbucks in a 30 mile radius. Dirty, poor customer service, repulsive barristas and incorrect drinks. I'd like my $5 lattes to come with a nice experience.

This Starbucks location is one of two stores right on my way to work from Lemmon Valley to Sparks. The other Starbucks closer to my house is now closed for restorations. But even before construction began, that Starbucks always took forever and had the longest line. I started coming to this location recently and have never had a bad experience. Even though I give myself enough time to stop, I get paranoid something will happen in the drive thru that will make me late for work. But that has never happened, and in fact I have a few extra minutes to eat breakfast before clocking in. They are so fast!! I am always so impressed with the team, and how well they work together to get orders out quickly, even with a long line. When the Starbucks next to me reopens, I will still come here instead every time. Great service!

I love this location. The workers are so friendly. This makes up for a lackluster drink in my opinion. Nearly every Starbucks I go into makes an incompetent green tea latte. I've had good and bad here. The worst case is that I have to stir my own drink. Still my location of choice when in this area.

Baristas are super friendly but there is no consistency with their drinks. I used to go daily but now i purposely drive to sparks just to get mine. 
For some reason i can go anywhere else and my coffees are perfect but i come here and they taste more like sugar milk. 

Hoping this gets fixed soon since they are the closest one to me.

Usually really great and I will go out of my way to get my coffee here if I have time. Staff is really friendly and really put in the effort to make each order correctly. It doesn't take the staff long to know you and your personal preferences either.
My go to every time I need a pick me up or I don't want to fall asleep in class. Definitely find myself studying here a lot because I love the ambience.

Sloooooooooowwwwww.  Clean bathroom. But slooooooooowwwwwwww.  They don't greet you.  They're not friendly. Don't care.  Here's your coffee (eventually). You're welcome for my money.  Go out of your way to find a different.  Kaldi's coffee down the street.
I made a special request and the person (Isaiah) who was making my drink was extremely rude about it. I know the customer service at other starbucks location beats the service I received here.

We went through the drive thru and ordered a mocha frap, and when I tried it was so simple like just ice so i went inside to let them know and see if they can remake it, the cashier was so nice taking care of me but when she let the other lady know that she has to remake it this lady made a cranky face and rolled her eyes (this was an old lady) then when the frapp was ready she rudely gave me to, not even gave it to me, she shoved to me and rolled her eyes again, not even a " we apologize " NOTHING!!! Just for that reason i am giving you 1 star, cause costumer service is important for me!

The new "makeover" is HORRIBLE. Cold, dark, ugly,  and clearly they just want to hear people through. They even took away any comfortable seating, not even a single couch! No more local art, not even a community bulletin board.

Often the line is really backed up in the morning and there's no parking anywhere. Keep in mind if you're stopping on a weekday morning.

As of recently I've noticed if I order a extra shot of espresso it doesn't get added into my beverage and sometimes they don't put my requested soy milk. When I notify them I can tell I don't have the extra shot of espresso they give me attitude and say that the paper says it so the barista must have added it, when it's quite clear it doesn't have more than the usual. Getting pretty frustrated since it's the only Starbucks on my way to work and this is happening more and more lately.

My coffee and breakfast sandwich were fine but the line was agonizingly slow. About half the employees seemed lost. I saw several people get incorrect orders. When I finally left, the line was twice as long as when I first got there. It took me 20 min to get through it. In an airport, speed and accuracy is SO important. I hope they can up their game at this location!

Staff taking orders were friendly and service was fast. However, end product wasn't so great. I asked for light ice in my drink - after I watched the staffer dump ice into my drink, I tried to give a friendly reminder. She didn't want to remake the drink, so she got a bit unpleasant and said it was light ice. I'll have to make sure to specify the ice cube number next time.

Mmm..White Chocolate frappuccino here is the best I've ever had! maybe it's because  ordered it with 1 pump of frap and the rest was white chocolate LOL.

People here are friendly. Service was fast too!  
-1 star because they don't take phone orders.

Cheer up baristas!  This Starbuck's distinguishes itself in one very curious way:  the coffee squad that works at this 'Bucks is rather dour.  I have no idea why since most people in Boise are really friendly.  The coffee and all the other concoctions are the same as at any other Starbucks, and if you haven't been to one then you probably don't drink coffee, so I won't take this occasion to describe the familiar.  

Here's what you need to know: spacious layout, patio with umbrellas, suburban strip mall ambience, located in a former bank building, awkward drive-thru, and not quite enough parking spots immediately adjacent to the store so use the overflow lot which has plenty of space.

After moving to the area this week, I will NEVER go back to this Starbucks. An employee who had worked there for "8 years" rudely screamed at me this morning when I told her she was ringing in my order improperly and that's not what I asked for. She embarrassed me by yelling across the entire store about how improperly ordered. Sad thing is, I get the same drink almost daily from the Mitchell ranch store in trinity! Try that Starbucks instead bc the service there is amazing. I will go out of my way to work now to go to that store instead!

How many people standing around does it take to make a strawberry smoothie? There were at least 7 ppl standing behind the counter staring at you first off. I felt like a chicken dinner. End result this was the worst strawberry smoothie ever from starbucks.

Careful if you do a mobile order. They guys behind the counter seem to miss it until you tell them it's there. 

Glad it wasn't that busy so I didn't wait long for them to make it. Then again, maybe they should have caught it since it wasn't that busy?

Literally the worst Starbucks EVER!!! Totally avoid!! I ordered my usual - a venti London Fog and a turkey bacon sandwich. They handed my "tea" to me without the latte part. When I said it wasn't right they tried to fix it and handed it back to me with curdled milk floating on top. I handed it back and they couldn't figure out why I didn't want it!! My breakfast sandwich NEVER showed up and the employees didn't care or try to fix it by putting a new sandwich in the oven for me.....paid almost $10 , waited 30 minutes and walked away empty handed and hungry!!!

I typically enjoy going to Starbucks but this location is very small and not very comfortable. I will not be going back unless I absolutely have to. First, because of it's location, parking is not exactly easy. If you're lucky to find parking behind the building, that's great, just be careful not to park in a spot designated for one of the other shops, because you will get towed. If you can't park behind the building, your only other option is on the street and that can be difficult in Broad Ripple.

Once you get into the shop you realize that it is incredibly cramped. There are no tables for more than 4 people, and the 4-person tables are either in the very back (and always taken) or right near the door where you will constantly have to deal with people bumping into you. The area where you order is cramped and lined with way too many knick knacks and bags of coffee. I am a teacher and carry a pretty large bookbag with me. I had to set it on the ground while I was waiting in line because when it was on my back I was dangerously close to hitting things.

The one good thing I have to say about this place is its service. The baristas were helpful and courteous, and did not roll their eyes or seem to mind when I realized I had forgotten to say "no whip" while ordering. However, the two Starbucks that I typically frequent on the east side always ask whether I would like a receipt, and the barista checking me out did not ask this. He simply took my cash and expected me to walk off. When I asked for a receipt, he didn't know how to print one and had to get someone else to show him how.

I ended up sitting outside (there was literally not a single seat inside). Unfortunately it was a very sunny day and I had been planning on working on my laptop. Since the sun was so bright and I couldn't do that, I ended up abandoning my plans and writing things out on paper. Next time I'm just going to drive to a bigger Starbucks that's not as cramped.

Another consistent Starbucks. The girl at the register was very friendly which I don't see as much at airports so thank you. I love that no matter where I am I can count on the consistency of Starbucks.

The starbucks system is usually down, so you cant use gift cards or rewards here, and they never tell you that until they have already given you your food, and never tell you beforehand or put up a sign

Fine and well-staffed Starbucks. The only issue is not so much with Starbucks but actually getting in The entry driveway is a bit tight for two way and parking near the shop itself is very limited. Parking is readily available further back which is a smaller deal than getting in here.

A forewarning: I loved Starbucks when I was younger. When the chain first hit STL every place was a converting *something* and as a result each shop had a unique atmosphere. Now it has become so cookie cutter I cannot stand it. Also, they had changed the roast of their coffee and after that they officially lost me.

Today was a unique day though. I was on my way downtown to volunteer for Stray Rescue and I forgot to get coffee closer to my home. Frontenac was close and I was aware of a Starbucks, so I ate it and went it. I knew at 7:30 am it would be busy, so I expected to be late to my engagement... However, I was in that store in such a little amount of time, I don't remember the place very well. Yeah, the service was SO FAST despite the crowd. I was amazed. They had about 4-5 people working the counter, with 3 of them taking orders: 2 on the registers accepting payment while one was starting the orders while we were waiting. All employees I encountered were very friendly and I walked out with a smile and a decent cup of coffee.

The service I got at the Schneithorst strip mall (is that how I spell it?!) was so awesome, I might give Starbucks a try again. Or at least go to this location before I have a showing of some indie film and the Plaza Frontenac...

best barristas & service w/smiles &  unparalleled warmth, hospitality, congeniality; Rebecca IS symbol of Starbucks: mermaid who swam inland 2 serve up conversation & concoctions U will savor: always a JOY 2 B welcomed & appreciated, valued & honored as a guest who as good as any home....fireplace an asset to gather 'round & windows 2 the world!  encouraging sincere words & service by Jazz & crew, too!

Well, we were at the airport with a couple hour wait so we stop by for coffee. There were minimal line, but sadly those gnats were still crawling all over the sandwiches and baked goods. Needless to say, I was too grossed out to want anything. Hubby ordered his usual ice coffee and seemed happy enough about it. I highly recommend management do something about the food case. It's beyond gross. Its giving the business a bad rep.

I get Starbucks daily. This store is definitely more convenient for my commute to work but the few times I've been there have been horrible. They are SOOOOOO slow. Like sloths. Seriously. I'm not sure what they do differently than any other Starbucks but the drinks I always get taste different than what they should. If you're looking to waste 20minutes for your morning drink & having it taste gross this is your location!

I came in on the very first cold night of December 2015, to personnel dressed up for Christmas as Santa's helpers with the Grinch's attitude.  It was a most unpleasant experience.  You see I am not a regular participate of Starbucks.  I honestly went because it was cold outside and Starbucks gets such high reviews, so I was expecting a warm experience.  I will in future go to Wawa for coffee when I am out and about.  I experience the personnel at Wawa to be much more heartfelt, friendly and attentive.  Definitely the staff at this Starbucks are Naughty!!!  The Holiday presence is not alive at this location of the Starbuck family.

As always starbucks is great but expensive.  I tried the new maple pecan in a venti size, not impressed:( it has a very weird taste...taste like coffee mixed with peanut butter. Not a good combination. I personally won't order this drink again but it was a double star day! Next time I will stick with my peppermint mocha.

Cake pops. Enough said.

No, but really. I walked in last night after being stuck behind that darn Ben Franklin Bridge car fire traffic -- and the girl behind the counter could not have been nicer! We conversed about Philadelphia and traffic and city life until another customer came in. Plus, the cake pops. I so wish a former coworker hadn't enlightened me to them. They are just too good!

I like this location, as parking is ample and it's located near a bunch of other stores, including the ever-present Wegmans. Seating inside is usually plentiful as well, with some nice couches to sit on if you don't want to stake it out on a wooden chair.

But the cake pops. It all goes back to the cake pops.

Least favorite Starbucks unfortunately. Almost every time I put in an order something is wrong. They forget the little details. Venti water no ice- get a grande water with ice. Changa bagel extra toasted- barley toasted. Wet cappuccino- barely. Customer service was pretty good for the most part until the gal told us to move cause we were standing where the mobile orders go. Oh well.
The baristas always make my drinks to my liking. The honor their barista promise and always make suggestions. Clean restrooms. Short staffed though so the wait can be a little long.

Terrible. Only 2 people ahead of me but took forever because I order the spinach feta egg wrap which they forgot about until I reminded them after waiting for a bit. Ordered an iced coffee but got hot. I was frustrated and didn't want to wait for them to make me a new one so I took it. Nice people but slow and ditsy.
Waited over 15 minutes in the drive thru for a hot chocolate, nothing complicated! When I FINALLY received my order, I didn't even get a "your welcome" to my "thank you"!

Friendly staff, but this particular location always seems to be dirty. I rarely come to this one, because it isn't the easiest access/parking even though it is closest to my home.  No drive thru and it's a very small store, so you'd think they could swipe a broom through it before it gets to the level of filth.  The case where the pastry/cake pops are kept has been dirty and crummy, as well.  I posted a pic of how well they keep their outside.  It takes all of ten minutes to pick it up, c'mon guys, have some pride in your workplace.

Always friendly staff!
I go every day I'm in the office and bring my own coffee mug and they only charge $1 refills for any house blends. 
They don't redeem Free Drinks from the a rewards card, but they do earn you stars. 12 days of coffee for $12, earns 12 stars and a free drink at any Starbucks location!
Can't beat it!

Starbucks espresso is awful, in fact its not even real espresso.  BUT... this location has a Clover Machine (one of only 2 in the state of Florida) which is one of the more perfect methods for brewing coffee.  So if you like brewed coffee this SB actually has terrific offerings with their select beans, just be sure to ask for the Clover.  And its only a $.30 premium over their regular crap brewed sludge.  But if you want quality espresso you're still out of luck.

Do not go here if your in a rush. Mid morning and they still took an extremely long time to make my drink. 4 employees and only two working. One guy loafing around the shop trying to look busy. 

Brutal

Staff here is very friendly. Drinks here are very consistent. Parking on the other hand is very horrible . They only have like 8 spaces for how busy they are . Drive thru in the morning gets pretty packed and wraps around . Cake pops here the best ! They have all of their promotions on the walls . And have a big selection on cups they sell , even the clearance ones  . The interior is pretty spacious . More than enough room to study by yourself or in a group .
Ordered a $4+ medium hot chocolate with extra whip cream and I get home to find it maybe 2/3 full and with no whip cream!

Scholars Inn (a quaint, unique, neighborhood study-cafe) at the SE corner of College and Broad Ripple Ave. is now gone, replaced with a "pretty typical" Starbucks, no different from the one on Mass Ave, on University Ave, in Manhattan and in Berlin. 

Starbucks may occasionally serve a purpose in bringing a neighborhood back from blight. It was not needed here. Goodbye Scholars Inn. Rest in peace.

Alternatives: Hubbard & Craven's on Carrollton or, even better, Perk Up on 6536 Cornell Ave, just beside the Monon Trail. Both are an easy walk from the evil Starbucks.
Nice café, but you close way too soon! The soliel is still out! Thanx to Kayla, she saved the day. You are oKayla with me. Thank you for the sweets, sweety!

So I came in this morning through the drive thru and when I got to the window I was greeted by a huge smile and a great attitude by an employee named Matt. He was very energetic and pleasant. I only had a $100 bill and before he took it he said he had to check if he could break it. He came back to the window and in the nicest way possible said they couldn't break the $100 and asked if i had another way to pay. I said unfortunately I didn't but I could go to a store super fast and break it and come back and before I even had a chance to finish this amazing guy paid for my coffee. I just got out of the hospital this morning and this coffee was all I was looking forward to, and this guy took it upon himself to make sure I had it. I couldn't thank him enough. People like this make the world a better place and I will defiantly be back. With smaller bills of course ;) lol.

The service at this Starbucks is very poor. They care more about their hair than providing good service. They forgot my order after taking my money and after 10 min wait made it like it was my problem.

After a long day of traveling (that isn't over yet) i needed a cup of coffee.  While the coffee is good the friendly staff was what really made my day.  The nice girl behind the counter greeted me with a smile and made me feel appreciated!  Thank you so much for a little ray of sunshine today!

loved my drink. but the girl making it legit had no idea how to make it and was asking questions on what to do next and how much to use, etc. It really slowed down the time it took for me to receive my drink.

ample seating.

You will have to pay for street parking if you want to park and drink.
they also do not have a drive through

I've been sitting here doing work for 2 hours at the bar and really appreciate the service I'm seeing (and that I received earlier). The employees are very attentive and friendly and the manager is currently working with a customer to fix an issue from his mobile order. I watched them politely fix another issue with a customer as well, and have been impressed with their personalities and attention. I especially appreciate that they are not loud or shouting, which is very helpful when people are here doing work. I will definitely be back here in the future because of this atmosphere--some Starbucks can be loud and rude but this is one exception! (Today at least!) thank you guys!!
I like this place! They get orders done really quick, even during frappy hours when they had at least 30 customers at the same time.

When I'm in the area of this store I always try to stop in because the staff are always great. My order varries but today it was a vente peach infused white tea which was a humorous order since I never remember if I get white or green tea. The barista was sweet and offered a choice of either, but indicated the 'usual' is white tea.

Quick stop on the way back from lunch for a chocolate croissant. So warm. So buttery and so chocolate. Delicious!  Staff was super friendly and very quick. I'm not a huge Starbucks coffee fan or I would have gotten coffee while we were here. I am a coffee fanatic! Don't get me wrong. Just not a fan of Starbucks. But I do always love their pumpkin loaf bread, their protein packs and now their chocolate croissants. First time trying one and it really just melts in your mouth!  Yum!
The staff makes an effort to remember the drinks of regulars.  Sometimes its the little things like that which make the biggest difference.

Ordered one strawberry smoothie and it was ok. Ordered 2 venti green tea frappacino with whip cream.  Got our drinks and the strawberry smoothie was just ok. The green tea frappacino had no whip cream and had too much green tea powder making the drinks inedible. 

Staff was friendly but didn't take proper order and didn't make drinks correctly. I am an a Starbucks drinker and this one needs a lot of work.
Not bad, but understaffed. Why there is one person taking orders and making the drinks is beyond me, The lady was very nice, but I waited way too long for a simple iced tea.
Sloooowweww service and they missed multiple orders. Angry customers everywhere. AVOID IF CONNECTING FLIGHTS

I'm here just about every weekend to get a caffeine fix before adoption events across the street at Petco.  They get my order right almost every time but this parking lot stinks.  I love the convenience of a drive through but it's very easy to get stuck in a traffic jam when you're trying to leave.
Can't complain with Starbucks... Just watch the hrs at this location. It closes really early.

This location is okay. It is one of the few places on Cleveland street that are open late in the evening. The rest of the street even on the weekend is pretty dead.
We stopped in here for a potty break and for a drink and snack. Our drink was fine, but our sweet bread we ordered was pretty stale and cold, blah.  Maybe it was just bc it was in the evening, and it had been sitting for a while. Gross, I guess I learned my lesson from that one. If it is not too busy, and it is the evening, don't order anything that has been sitting out...eek. 
That's okay. I still like starbucks. I just know better what stuff to get, and when.
This is my favorite starbucks in the area. They make the drinks perfectly! I hate the parking lot. Every time I can't find a spot, I get really agitated because I need coffee!

Since this is the relocated Lithis Pinecrest Starbucks, the great staff moved with the store. Yeah!! Great lattes guaranteed!!

This is a beautiful new store, much bigger than the old one. Much more seating.  Nice to have a parking lot dedicated to this store and not shared with other businesses. However, having to take the road to get to the new Walmart to get here, can be a nightmare. Tons of traffic to get in and out of the new businesses cropping up there. This Starbucks has a new drive thru which should make many happy.

I would give it five stars if it weren't for the difficulty getting in and out because of traffic.  But, perhaps the most consistent Starbucks, so therefore my favorite!

One of the better locations in the area depending on the day. They stay crowded for the most part, so mobile orders are your best friend here. Quaint and cozy, very welcoming. Typically this location is well stocked and clean. Ample parking outside, however the drive thru is terrible- it's a narrow curve and no exit option. Bakery options always taste fresh. My top drink here- the caramel frap with frap chips

Love this location!  Usually stop in on my way to work.  I have always received prompt and friendly service from all staff members I've encountered.  Never had an issue with my order and it's always wonderfully executed.

Another McStarbucks here. 

They get you in and out quickly. The girl who makes coffee asks the customers about their orders while waiting in-line. I do like quick service like this. However, when I got my coffee, the girl was in such a hurry and slammed the cup too hard on the table that some of the coffee spilled (makes your hands sticky!)...no apology whatsoever. 

If you're craving coffee while waiting for your flight, this is the place for you. They have clean tables and free wi-fi, which is always a positive.

2013/#76

Came through today and had a million questions about coffee. Everybody was very helpful and knowledgeable. My order was taken care of fast and my teller even gave my dog a little treat for herself. Thank you for the good experience!

Me and my sister ordered separately, I got my drink right away, we ended up having to wait 20 minutes for my sisters, me having to go up to the counter and remind them more than once that she ordered right after me, and people that ordered a long time after her were getting their drinks and leaving. They said they didn't remember getting her order and then didn't jump into making gets right away. They didn't apologize and were snotty when we tried to explain she was right after me. Myself having worked at a starbucks kiosk, with only 1 or 2 on shift at a time, we handled lines well and never gave another a drink if they ordered after someone, this starbucks, with very inconvenient parking, and one of the largest staff I've seen, took so long for the drive thru and were running around inside forgetting multiple orders after ours and were not very friendly if it was brought up that they had forgotten. The only thing I liked was the design of the building.

This is a very nice Starbucks!  It's right in the mall and has a system set up for the line to avoid any confusion.  I found the staff to be very helpful and welcoming.

I visited here after the Christmas rush was over and they didn't seem frazzled or burnt out like many retail employees do at that time of year.

I was excited to see a Starbucks open in this location. However, the service is terrible. This is the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. Also, the workers, for the most part, are unfriendly and rude. Anything more complex than tea or coffee is not made well and tastes watered down. 

Management needs to step in and anonymously watch the service and taste the quality to see just how bad this place is performing.

This is the closest Starbucks to me and it's my go-to place if I need a pick-me-up (especially after I received a Starbucks card for Christmas!). The baristas are really friendly. I've only been in the morning, so I really can't vouch for the people on the swing shift, but then again, not many people are going to Starbucks for dinner, so they may be under-prepared when heating up a sandwich or if they've run out of baked goods at the end of the day.

Regardless, you can't go wrong with Starbucks, and this one is great.

I had a terrible experience at this location from the moment I walked in. Nobody greeted me upon arrival which, if you are busy is understandable, but there was only one person ahead of me and all other customers had been served. I waited patiently till the customer was finished, then was left there while the employees joked and spoke to each other. Again, I typically don't fuss about things. I myself have worked in customer service and understand that often, what a customer perceives runs deeper. Finally someone steps up to take my order with yet again no greeting. I receive my order and proceeded to add my fixings. The station was extremely low on almost every item. The cream was empty, the trash was filled to the top, there were zero napkins, and the sugar had lumps in it to a point where you could not get any sugar out at all. I had to open the sugar and remove hardened clogs for the next poor customer. This is unacceptable! Considering there were at minimum three employees standing around, you would think at least one would take pride in their work. It is safe to say I will not be returning to this location.

Quick and efficient starbucks with plenty of seating, with tables, sofas, and single person seats. Parking lot is a bit jammed up as this location is in a small strip mall. I had to U turn coming from 275 at the stop light, which was kind of annoying, as there is no dedicated turn lane into the plaza.

People are friendly! (As usual!) but this Starbucks is WAY too small and WAY too slow. The place gets overrun quickly because it is just quite simply too small... so the poor store size and location is what earns this place a "low" rating. 

If you see a line - don't go in - it will take a VERY long time to get your order and you will not have anywhere to sit in the meantime.
Low key think someone cut the wires. Didn't get my serious strawberry. Still entertaining. I'm about it.

The only reason it's getting 3 stars is due to the staff. Who are very sweet.  However they are slower than a sloth on a hot day! Place is large but always looks grimy.  I have never seen such slow service before.

Friendly staff.

Can't beat $1 drip coffee refills when you bring your mug.

I got the $30 tumbler in December that meant free brewed coffee all of January- the Target 'bucks if the closest to my house.

It's a little Starbucks and I've only ever seen one person working here so I'm not sure how they'll handle a crowd. 

Also, they don't keep the full line of coffee brewed and I get the dark roast so I get a fresh pour-over every time and I LOVE that. 

The same lady waited on me each time- she's nice, personable and seems to know enough about coffee to talk shop with me. I like that!

The biggest problem with this location is that it's in a Target...so I haven't been able to get out of the store without buying something at Target yet...but I guess that's my fault not, Starby's. ;-)
It's my local Starbucks. The staff here is a riot! They are always happy, cheerful, and at times goofy. Today's shenanigans was a HUGE fly swatter in back.

I'm not the biggest fan of Starbucks coffee, but it's fast, convenient, and there are locations everywhere, so I opt for Starbucks somewhat regularly. This particular location isn't my favorite, but it is closest to my house. The parking lot is tight and kind of a pain to navigate, and there's often a long line at the drive -thru that spills out into Broadway, which is a little bit terrifying. It means that you can't even get into the Broadway driveway from around 7 to 9 am.

The baristas are generally students and although there are some helpful ones, some of them seem like they can't be bothered. I ordered an iced coffee this morning (which literally involves pouring some pre-made iced coffee into a cup and topping it with a lid). The guy who rang me up put my cup on the counter and it just sat there while the three baristas on duty chatted in a circle for two minutes until I spoke up. I got a weak "oh, sorry" from one and the other two laughed. Not impressed.
I'm not going to say a word about the product as its all the same. That said, service and setting is very pleasant. Good place to get your fix.

Kind staff that will smile to a customer and the best Double Chocolaty Chip Crème Frappuccino I've ever had!
Definitely recommend this store.

Stopped by today, May 23rd at 2:30pm.

I know. I know. Everyone thinks it's cool to hate Starbucks because they're a big fat corporate target, but I'd rank this store way above any indy shop any day. I've tried most of them in town, and they've got nothing on Starbucks's quality or service.

I'm a frequent visitor of this store. Every time I go. An employee named Nora exceeds my expectations. She has a so much personality when she is interacting with me..I'm sure other patrons feel the same about her. My visit doesn't feel like just another transaction.

I upped my rating from three stars to four because I had the most stellar service today! I went in knowing I wanted a hot coffee but unsure of which syrup I wanted in it. I had never tried the cinnamon dolce, so I asked the barista if I could just have a lick of it alone. She insisted on making me a full on coffee with it and reassured me that she'd remake my drink if I didn't like it. After trying the coffee and confirming that the cinnamon dolce was too overwhelming (just as she had warned me!), I decided to stick with my go-to sugar-free vanilla syrup. Before remaking it, she asked if I minded waiting five minutes so she could make a FRESH batch of coffee for my order. Yes please! This was a great way to end the day.

So I have worked at Starbucks for 8 years. Never had an experience like this before. I ordered a triple grande iced caramel macchiato with light ice and stirred. She calls out my name and goes, "what do you mean stirred? It doesn't come like that." She was very rude.. I politely say yes, I want it stirred. As in when the shots are pouring from the machine you stir the caramel in with the shots, then milk then ice. She said she didn't understand. Then she says ok. Then gets a new cup, puts caramel at the bottom, then fills the cup with milk and then ice and puts the shot on top. 


I wasn't going to make her remake it, but clearly her and the other guy have no idea how to correctly make drinks. A stirred caramel macchiato is a normal thing. I'm so confused how both of them didn't know what to do.

DRIVE THRU! DRIVE THRU! I could end the review there. Despite the obvious fact that I love the drive thru my items are always accurate and that sweet drive thru is typically quick. Customer service is standard Starbucks, no additional frills and I'm ok with that!

My bacon Gouda sandwich was cold in the middle!  It is something I order often, at a variety of Starbucks location, but this is the first time I've ever gotten one that was cold.  I think I'll find a different coffee shop next time.  Two stars because latte was good though.  Of course I didn't figure it out till I'm out the door and in too much of a hurry to go back.
Wait times are horrendous. Mobile order 10-15 minutes ahead to save yourself the frustration.

This is a good Starbucks. It's always busy, the wi-fi is strong, and the baristas are generally moving at a very quick pace. It can get a little too busy to make sitting there too crowded but I'm rarely one to sit at a Starbucks.

This was my favorite go to Starbucks when Stephanie managed it. When she left to open her own business it went down hill. The garbage cans are ALWAYS full. My drink is usually wrong and the staff just isn't in sync. I hear the staff complaining about something most of the time, be it personal or about work. Doesn't make for a very positive experience. The drive thru is slower than molasses in November and most of the time, after that long wait, the drink is wrong. The store is not neat and tidy any longer and just lacks that warmth it had when Stephanie was manager. 
Sorry to give such a negative review but, unfortunately after having tried to stick it out through the transition of management, I just don't go there except for ground coffee and only if I'm I'm the area. Very sad to see this store go down hill.

I am glad this starbucks is on my way to work.  They are always friendly and helpful behind the counter at such an ungodly hour.  The coffee is always good of course and the place is nice and clean.  If I had the time there is lots of space to just hang out.

It's what I have come to expect from all starbucks.  Quality and reliability.  No bumps here at all.  And yes, the bathrooms are clean.

Located in Broad Ripple, it's always busy not to mention difficult to find parking for if it's peak time. I've always had good service here but the line deters me away most of the time. I love that I can mobile order to skip the crowd but since it's in the middle of the strip, there is no drive-thru available.
How does Starbucks run out of mint tea? If you can answer this question you'll receive the Nobel Prize.

I visit this Strbcks almost every morning, and for the most part the service is spot on....however, on occasion I will get a middle-aged barista that always seems to have an attitude with my simple "Pike" order.  When paying with my mobil app. (today)I didn't know if the transaction had gone through; never wanting to walk away not paying.  I asked her if it went through and she answered me as if I was a "child", repeating her thank-you and restating my name (as if a classroom teacher was disturbed w/a student).  I have witnessed the same type of service with other older customers before....treating them like children!!!  All Starbucks employees need to treat customers equally, with respect and dignity, no matter how upscale the location!!

This Starbucks has plenty of space and the staff is very friendly.

The décor is awesome and it's a great place to meet with other people.

The only challenging aspect of this coffee house is their parking lot. It is limited and getting in and out it's complicated. If you make it in, you will be in a great Starbucks!

Not impressed, but I'll stick with 2 stars instead of 1 since I'm not a regular. Staff was snooty (obviously friendly with each other, but I felt like I was intruding on the "cool" table at high school). My blackberry tea lemonade (not even an espresso drink) took forever to make, despite being the only one in line with 6 staff members. (Again, I'll give benefit of doubt...the drive thru was hopping.) Lots of outdoor seating, but who wants to be outside in southern Arizona? I missed the driveway 3 times trying to get to the dang place, too. All in all not a great place from what I experienced.

I was picking up an app order and found that someone had taken my drink accidentally. Angie remade it immediately and asked if I wanted an extra shot for the delay. Although I was not inconvenienced at all, the gesture was polite and professional. Thanks for the extra pick-me-up for my afternoon!

Starbucks is Starbucks here or in Seatle. Lots of seating, coffee wharehouse feel. The coffee is too strong for my taste, I always ask for half a shot to any latte. I do like their green tea lattes though. They are tealicious. ;-)

Being a former Starbucks employee, this location has the worst customer service ever. I don't use the drive thru, I mostly walk in and you are never acknowledged by the baristas working. No "Hello" or  "I will be right with you". I am not used to a Starbucks with no regard for customers and would have the nerve to have a tip jar out. I am not sure who the manager is but there needs to be training done to fix this issue. Maybe since I am not a regular customer there I get bad service.

Not pleased with most of the stand alone stores. Most of the employees are not paying attention getting your order wrong and then getting upset when you try to correct them with your order. I'm going to stick to the local Safeway or Bashes Locations as they work for that store not Starbucks. Starbucks has Failed in improving their customer service Once they started offering free college.

Definitely not my favorite Starbucks!!  The staff was fairly unfriendly and most definitely not speedy!  I was in line behind a couple who ordered 2 coffees then I ordered a black iced coffee and it took a good 10 minutes to get it!

This Strabucks is inside the Target on City Ave.

I am not a coffee drinker however every so often I get the hankering for a yummy chai tea latte.

As I meandered up to the counter I couldn't help but hear three employess in a heated conversation.  I suppose I wouldn't have minded so much if they were helping me at the same time but I was disregarded for several moments.

I finally placed my order for a tall, skinny (made with skim) chai te latte.

It is my habit to always ask if it is made with skim because the consequences of me having whole milk can be quite detrimental!
So once my order was made I asked  "Made with skim?" to which the barrista replied "did you ask for it with skim?"
I looked at him like he was crazy because he was rude and just assumed that I didn't!  In any event, I told him I had and he made it correctly.

When it was ready though he just placed it down and walked away.

So overall the service here leaves something to be desired.

On a plus note, there is ample seating as well as free WiFi.

Tried to order a frappucino 20 minutes before they closed and was told that "frappucino machine is shut down for the night". They also had thrown out all pastries/snacks. There were 5+ people still in line at that moment. I ended up spending my money elsewhere.

Whta's not to love about Starbucks! Good coffee, friendly staff, and very helpful, especially when I needed coaching to properly order my friend's drink. Venti 5-shot iced americana, 3 pumps of white mocha, extra ice.  Ta-daahh! (though I know I still probably messed it up)

Seems to be the slowest moving humans at a Starbucks EVER.  Also not the friendliest bunch either. One person running the register, two making coffee/food and another milling about with a snarky attitude.  How do you run out of hot brew with four people behind the counter?

Stopped in for a cup of coffee prior to a concert at the capital theatre. New to that area but found a Starbucks. Walked in to get my familiar feel. Was not busy. About five people in there on their computers. The barista not real friendly. My husband who is not a Starbucks regular was trying to choose a drink. The barista was annoyed. You need a pass number to get in the bathrooms. The sitting areas were dirty with crumbs and paper left behind. The air conditioning was broken and it was warm inside. Cooler outside on a July evening.  A disappointment to sit in a dirty hot Starbucks drinking a $6 coffee.  The garbage bins were full. I had to take my empty with me to dispose of outside. A big disappointment. There is another coffee shop across the street. I will try that next time .

This location is clean, the staff is friendly, and there is a variety of indoor seating from tables and chairs to a long table and stools and even comfy chairs. I ordered my usual peppermint mocha via the mobile Starbucks app and it was ready in no time. I like this location because it's central to other shopping areas and it's a cool brick building.
Awesome staff, always super friendly and as a Starbucks addict the drinks always taste fab. Only thing I could suggest would be the drive through line.

Love that they have a drive thru however their customer service is lacking. One employee named Reid (I think) has taken my order several times and had consistently been rude.  Have experienced this behavior with a couple other employees as well but not all of them. Don't mind paying Starbucks' high prices but not willing to pay for the bad attitudes.

This Starbucks I have altered my review a couple times now. They fluctuate in quality of service and services they offer. While they have expanded the rewards program to grocery Starbucks they still do not offer everything a normal Starbucks does, such as online ordering. Like many smalltime food businesses, it suffers from not having a large enough staff or inventory. So they are often slower than a large Starbucks with a large staff, and they frequently run out of basics like cups and ice coffee. Recommend going to a 'real' Starbucks when possible.

I've always had really friendly baristas here and my drinks have come out tasting great and fast! Maybe it's bc I know someone who works there but she's not always there when I go so I'd say it's just their service! However, things have gone downhill recently with a change in management, it seems she really doesn't know what she's doing or how to adapt her business model to the college environment. How can you expect full time college students to devote 6-8 hours of a day to a part time job? The constant understaffing and employee turnover reflects the poor management style. This Starbucks really needs to take into account student schedules and needs if they want to improve on customer connection. (No, I have never applied or worked here, just can recognize when a corporation is too busy looking at the big picture and doesn't know how to analyze and adapt to a specific community to maximize good/efficient service and revenue).

everyone here goes above and beyond my expectations.
my drinks always come out how they are supposed too.
thank you staff!

Everyone knows Starbucks, and either you like it or you don't, so there's not much sense in reviewing the menu.  Well, EXCEPT!  I am currently OBSESSED with their chicken sausage breakfast wrap.  This wrap (which the location closer to my job is often out of by the time I get there) the drive through (which aforementioned location is also lacking), and the friendly workers make this Starbucks my first choice for breakfast on my way to work or a caffeinated pick-me-up when I'm tooling around town on the weekends.

This Starbucks happens to make the exact same stuff as every other Starbucks....seriously.

By service is what separates one place from the next.  Service at this location is not quite as friendly as Trinity location.  Service is a bit slower too.  But it is a convenient location with ample parking.

I know that all Starbucks locations seem to be the same, but what sets this location apart is the Clover brewing system and the Starbucks Reserve coffees. The Clover system is designed to create the perfect temperature and brewing time for any coffee bean to give you the best cup you've ever tasted. If you are used to drinking coffee, this isn't just hype, you'll get a delicious cup. The selection varies, but you don't have to get a Reserve blend, they will brew any of their standard blends with the Clover. In addition, you can buy a bag of the reserve coffees to take home. They may not always have the blend you are looking for, but it gives one the opportunity to sample different varieties (albeit in a fairly pricy manner). There are usually little cards that describe each Reserve blend to help with the decision making process. I'd have to say that the Clover makes a great cup of coffee, and is the reason I choose this location over the myriad of other Starbucks in the area.
I was just raving about how awesome the Starbucks was and they gave us free #kindbars to try. Just because we have the best kids in the world! #HastyKids @starbucks

Rude & inconsiderate staff. After waiting 20 min in line, we ordered lunch. One of the drinks was super sweet and my son needed some water. I walked up to the barista to ask for a glass of water and she rudely told me to get in line. So I waited another 15 minutes to get a glass of a water. I'm glad we're just visiting, our Starbucks at home is very welcoming.
Stellar service during a power outage- felt like 100 degrees inside. Thanks for hanging in there!
The ones that make the drink suck.  Attitudes are horrible.  And on the register was nice.

The only other Starbucks in this area is kinda far, so I came here again to my dismay.

Still dirty, no improvement since the last time I was here. Sat for over an hour working online, and when I went to refill my tea, they did not want to do it for me, saying, "We cannot refill your tea since you've left the premises."  I pointed to my open laptop 15' away and said, "...but I'm right here."  I will never forget this Starbucks, because they will actually argue with you in front of customers.

Where's Schultzy when you need him?  Very sad to see this.

So my boyfriend and I just went through the drive thru when ordering we got one venti peppermint white mocha and a venti peppermint white mocha frap. When we go to the window Sammie was VERY rude when asking what the frap was. The total came out to $10.99, my boyfriend handed her a $5 bill and 6 ones. He recounted it twice before handing it to her. She went back inside the window and then came back out and said he only handed her $10. Rather than arguing with her he just handed her another dollar. This is unacceptable and her attitude was also not ANYTHING you normally get customer service wise from Starbucks. Very disappointed. Will not be returning to this location.

Let me Start off by saying I love Starbucks and I frequent them often. This location is near my job and I've been in there about three times so far only because my order never seems correctly made. I always order a grande Hot  caramel macchiato with extra drizzle. Every time I get them from this location it is as if I'm drinking a cup of milk. I ordered it today and it as if I'm drinking a cup of milk with caramel. I never taste the espresso. This is the only location that I have this problem with. I don't know if the measurements are not being made correctly or if the company is skimming off the top and giving out less espresso then what is supposed to be in that drink. Please go over with your barista's how to make this drink properly. Starbucks is not cheap so to have a drink go to waste because is not prepared correctly is unsettling and makes me not want to visit this location again. When you spin five and six dollars for a drink it should be made correctly. I don't think it the baristas fault, I think it's what they have been trained to do because again I have gotten this drink by several different people and each time I'm walking away feeling like I'm drinking a cup of milk. I want my EXPRESSO!!!

I've been going to this Starbucks to study for months and now I'm upset that I now have to give them this review. On December 4, around  6:30-7:30pm while I was studying  a woman across the table from me was complaining about her charger and about how much money she makes. I continued to work and then the women begun to through racial slurs at me. I was confused and uncomfortable so I ignored her. She claims it was a Mexican who took it, then she said it was my cousin? And since I was ignoring her she said "Ya puta I am talking to you".. I was shocked. I put my earphones in and continued working.. THEN she started screaming at me saying the following 
"Mexicans are dirty"
"Mexicans are poor"
"Mexicans steal" and more. 

SHE WAS YELLING this at me and there were about 20-30 people in the building and they all LET IT HAPPEN. Not one single customer or employee attempted to stop her from harassing me. I was EXTREMELY uncomfortable and she kept yelling racial slurs at me and it was not until I asked her to stop but she kept going for about another minute then she left and was staring at me from outside the window. After I was done with my work I was reflecting on what had just occurred and I am not upset about the things that she was saying I was WAY MORE upset that NOBODY said anything, NEITHER the staff or customers. By staying quiet about this matter it makes all these people accomplices. I did not feel safe to go outside and I had to call somebody to meet me outside. I was very shocked because like I mentioned above, I am a regular at this coffee shop and their customer service is great but this time they disappointed me. Anyway, I called back the next morning to speak to the GM but the lady over the phone sounded like she annoyed with me for asking for when I can reach him so I decided I am going to be writing a letter. It really sucks because this a place I constantly study at but now I never want to go back and now I have to find a new place. I do not feel safe in a place where I can be easily harassed.
I stop in here every morning on my way to work ! I think the staff is very social and they are always able to recommend me a good drink when I'm in the mood to switch it up !

A) It appears I am elite; my reviews are now proclamations. Woah.
B) I am somehow the very sole DUKE of this Starbucks.

So basically I, like, have to review this establishment. Which is not so bad because I can confidently say I do quite like it. Prior to discovering the good coffee test (it's akin to the good beer test: if the coffee, upon cooling, becomes flat mudwater, we have bad coffee. Hubbard & Cravens [& then, excitingly, Intelligentsia] demonstrated to me that palate-filing acidity, which Starbucks roasts totally lack*, completes the coffee experience by offering not a rapidly-cooling smack of caffeine but a fully-realized appreciable beverage, of which temperature is an accessory) I utilized this Starbucks' ambiance and dense black coffee to sit and concentrate and edit an entire novel back in April '11. It was a 5-star experience, then.

Now, post-Coffee Renaissance, I still find myself drawn to the ambiance. There are two rooms, one with the coffee bar and three small high tables - where I sat during above-mentioned editing - and another with a communal long table by the exterior window wall, a few half-booth-style tables nestled against an interior wall, and a semicircle of plush chairs around a not-real-but-good-enough fireplace. And my preferred chair, which I am not describing to you because it's MINE, dang it.

It is an excellent place to bury oneself into a laptop/book-based task among a similarly-minded crowd...though I've taken to ordering the sugarier drinks in order to avoid feeling like I am drinking an inferior product.

Not the coffee connoisseur's sanctuary. But a certain kind of sanctuary nonetheless. I dig!


*they've now introduced a Blonde Roast, which upon tasting is immediately recognizable as a step toward the Intelligentsia-style ideal - more acid, more secondary non-roast aromatics....but "Blonde Roast"? That marketing is weirdly selective: "Here is a coffee for yous who can't handle the 'bold' stuff!" The coffee strikes me as something uniformly more pleasing to aficionados, so why make its moniker so off-putting to seekers of intensity?

This Is your typical Starbucks, with a decent seating area and overpriced drinks, but this location has one very big problem - Flies. Yes, I said it, this place has a serious fly problem. During my last visit, there were several flies buzzing around our table and, trust me, this was not confined to our area. This was not the first time I have encountered this problem, so you would think that management would try to rectify this problem. Instead, it's getting worse.

It's not that great of a starbucks, but it's the best one of the one's around me.  I had to drive by the absolute worst Starbucks I know and I went out of my way.  The order was taken, but they made some of the drinks of the people behind us first...  

There was an incredibly long wait for drinks, even though there didn't appear to be a lot of people waiting before us.  The cashier wasn't "from our store" so she wasn't sure how they did things there.  Some people might consider Starbucks to be a fairly large franchise, so it's a little weird that they wouldn't have consistent practices when it comes to using the register.  I may be wrong though...

Just left here and the staff was so friendly and sweet. All had smiles on their faces and wished everyone happy holidays. So nice to see happy employees late at night. Girl at the register tonight exceptionally nice!
Very wonderful service was in and out in under three minutes (during a busy time) and my coffee is absolutely perfect. Totally made my day keep up the good work!!

OK, my comments are really not about this Starbucks in particular but about Starbucks in general.  I'll start off by saying the proprietor in a coffee store near me (they sell the actual product in the form of whole beans or ground and the variety at this place is considerable) calls Starbucks "Charbucks."  I have to say that's kind of a fitting name!  The coffee, regardless of the form you order it in (e.g., plain coffee, latte, espresso, cappucino) always tastes BURNT.  That's the best way I can describe it, just overdone!  Ok that's the coffee, what about the prices?  Absurdly steep!  OK, but whose fault is that?  Of course it the fault of the consumers who keep patronizing these stores and buying their awful tasting and over-priced swill.  Even at the airport you must drink Charbucks or pretty much go without coffee.  A word about the pastries and other "delights?"  Usually stale and also grossly over-priced.  Can you tell - I don't much care for Starbucks. Dunkin' Donuts has much better coffee.

This is my go to Starbucks - not only because it is close to my work, but because of their friendly and efficient staff. I have nothing but good things to say about this location. The staff works hard and always welcomes me with a smile. Kudos to manager Michael for running such smooth operation.
Cheers!

I see a lot of two and three star reviews for this Starbucks and for the two dozen or so times that I have been here, I just don't see it.  I know that you can't please everyone all of the time, but with as many customers as this Starbucks serves in a weekday morning rush alone, I suppose I can see how not everyone gets stellar service.  

With that preface, I always receive quick service at this location.  About the only "hiccups" I have to complain about are that they do not accept drink rewards here... and they do seem to have a higher turnover rate than at most Starbucks locations, so sometimes you have to repeat your order once or twice.

All in all, I'm a fan!

Thursday before a major holiday and they don't have the means to make their caramel ribbon crunch beverage?? Unacceptable & I should be given a disc for a future purchased since I had to get something else. I was stuck in drivethru otherwise I would of left!

This was a recently opened Starbucks location near me so I was excited to get there and see what this place had to offer in terms of coffee and vibes inside the place. So when I got there I decided to order their new Midnight Mint Mocha frappucino since I never had it before and something new at a new Starbucks would be fitting. A first I had to wait because the baristas were busy but that's okay. After I had placed my order it didn't take long to get my drink to me and while in there, at that moment, I suddenly realized I was in a coffee place for millennials.
