The drink itself was very good, minty, and tasty. In terms of coffee it's pretty good but I would recommend dunkin duouts for coffee but this Starbucks to just sit down, have some coffee, and get stuff done while sitting in a place more your time, especially if you're a millennial.

I swung into this Starbucks on the way to do mani's and pedi's with the little sister.  Its a Starbucks.  I wasn't expecting the world. 

There was no wait.  The place was clean.  And the reason I am reviewing this at all is because of the barista in particular working.  She got me my tea and while waiting for the espresso for my second drink she took the time to strike up a legitimate conversation with me.  It was such a refreshing change.  I didn't feel like I was being hustled in and out.  

It is amazing how one little thing can make a whole experience wonderful.  I wish I had gotten her name.  But her service was enough to make me want to write this review.  

I can imagine during very busy times things can get crazy, but if you go on an off time, I can only hope others have the same experience.
Starbucks!  At Tampa's airport!  Cue a Kermit the Frog-styled "YAAAAY!"  http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tv4KQbDaCfM

Ugh,, Starbucks app let me down and this store did nothing to help, rather added salt to the wound. While 2 stars is harsh, starbucks is usually perfect and I'm spoiled by their perfection so this slight mishap is so rare it stands out. 

I came in and not very busy. My starbucks app/card payment that I have been using flawlessly for over a year decides it didn't want to automatically reload my balance. I aksed the girl to reload my starbuckscard and then charge my drink to my card. She charges me full price for my drink by charging it  to my credit card instead of reloading my  starbcuks card .

Since there was no line, I was super annoyed that she ignored this 20 second request. to charge my starbucks card. It is less than a dollar but when I come here everyday, it adds up.  

It says something about starbucks as a whole that this location is considered sub par. Pretty impressive record. 1 annoyance out of the dozens of times I've been here. Then again, there are starbucks I've been to hundreds of times and they've never had a mishap even this slight.

Considering we continue to pay these crazy prices for what is pretty much coffee and milk. I'd hope they would have perfect service.

The store itself is fine, but the drive thru is atrocious. I've never waited less than 10 minutes and I come here frequently. Today they have a sign saying "pull around to the window to order." I've been waiting 15 minutes already. Get it together, Starbucks.

This location is super convenient and the staff in the morning have always been super friendly. It's a really busy store, so you should expect a wait. My go to is a caramel macchiato or the cold brew.

This location is not far from my house so I use it as a meeting place for clients. I like it because it is brand new and there are enough places to sit. The help there is pretty good. 

Of course the coffee is what they are known for and their little pastries.

I hit a crucial caffeine minimum on a layover in the Philly airport, and this location came to the rescue.

The line seemed long, but moved quickly. They seemed to alternate between making batches of iced/frozen drinks and batches of hot drinks, which was odd, but overall we waited under 5 minutes for our order.  The coffee was nothing spectacular, but my cappuccino was consistent with every one I've ever ordered at other locations, and predictability is what we're all looking for at Starbucks, anyway.

I am a self admitted Starbucks junkie:  I drink it at least once daily, my car automatically turns in to Starbucks' driveways without any assistance from me, and my children even ask for Starbucks if they want a snack (they dig the coffee cakes, cookies, and chocolate milk).  When my youngest child was 2 years old he would scoop up bath water in a cup, hand it to me, and say:  "Here's your nonfat, no whip mocha, Mom".

That being said, I've been to some Starbucks that are so so, others that are consistently good.  This one is one of my favorites for multiple reasons:

1)  They are so observant that when I order at the drive up window they recognize my car and already know what I want.

2)  They have been quick to give me coupons for free coffee if I have been waiting longer than just a few minutes for my drink.

3)  The mochas are consistent and always HOT (some locations will occasionally serve them lukewarm-not to my liking).

4)  Every employee I have had interaction with is friendly and efficient.

The only reason I give them 4 stars instead of 5 is because sometimes the service is somewhat slow in the drive through, even without much of a line.  A small price to pay for the other favorable attributes!

This is my favorite Starbucks in the world! I would stop in every morning before work to get my coffee or hot chocolate and an ice water. For some reason they have the best ice water and I was unable to order it on the mobile app. I went in one morning and talked to the kind baristas and we developed a special code so that I could order my ice water through the mobile app. For my new year resolution I decided I would only get Starbucks in Friday's and increase my water intake. When I went in today (it has been awhile) the guy who is always there in the morning (I need to learn his name) said good morning to me by name and asked if they got my ice water for me. I told them they had not this time and he made sure one was made for me immediately. Small gestures like remembering my name mean a lot to me and always put a smile on my face. I go out of my way on the weekends or over breaks when I am not working just to go to this Starbucks and you should too. The staff is amazing!!!

Today, the drive thru went pretty quick - when I got to work with my oatmeal I knew why - no quality control - didn't get the toppings that I ordered and were correct on the bag sticker. This isn't the first time they've messed up an order. Worst quality Starbucks ever!

I probably won't make it a habit of reviewing restaurant or coffee chains on Yelp, but I wanted to make an exception for this particular Starbucks because the employees here are really fantastic. Every time I visit, no matter how groggy, incoherent, or rushed I am--the baristas are always friendly and their pleasant demeanor is like an extra pick-me-up on top of the caffeinated deliciousness that I purchased that day. 

The new remodeling is great too! It seems to be a much better usage of space! Speaking of space, I've read a lot of reviews that knock down stars due to the parking situation that they can't really do anything about. They are on a busy street on the edge of a neighborhood, that's just the nature of the area I feel. If you want more of a parking challenge, try for the one downtown! Or if you want easier parking, try the one further north on the same street. Its Starbucks, if you've been driving in circles because the lot's full, you can drive 5 minutes to the next one. Just PLEASE don't be one of those people that sit in their car and decide to make a phone call, do their taxes, clip their nails, or whatever after picking up a coffee. Be courteous of other people trying to park and move out! /end rant. ;)

So, the explanation for not giving it full 5 stars, I really think they should put some sort a railing or one of those metal dividing "fences" along their patio area like you see at other Starbucks. Sometimes one can feel a bit insecure sitting so close to traffic, so for this reason I try to avoid sitting outside at this location. :/

Another family favorite. It used to be a Long John Silvers and in the 7 years we have lived near by we probably went there 3 times.

Since it was turned into a Starbucks I'd say we are there 3-5 times a month. Plenty of seating. Bigger than the typical Starbucks.

The kids and I are addicted to the cake pops!
I rather have a Starbucks in an airport than not. The service at this location is solid and Chai Tea Latte was good as usual.
A tough parking lot to enter and exit, but a quick trip through with friendly baristas after that!

This Starbucks is located inside a hotel and and a very large store. I come here because it's hardly busy and the employees are very quick at making beverages. There is only street parking and no drive thru because it is located inside a hotel. There is another Starbucks location less than a mile from this one but that location is always busy with hardly any parking. Never had a problem with any of my orders here and the place is also recently updated. Good spot to stop if you are in a rush and don't want to wait.

There is really nothing wrong with this Starbuck's except whenever I am in there I feel like I am with the cast of Juno!  These people are just to snappy and seem to talk really loudly so everyone can hear their snappy,quick and witty dialogue----and for some reason I find this really distractive!   It is probably just me---but that is my observation.

Consistently inconsistent. I get one of two things on a daily basis, and they can never manage to ring it up correctly. It's always a different price. Vaughn is the only person at this store who can make drinks properly.

The employees for the 5 PM shift today (12/5/12) are incredibly sweet! Haven't had better service at a Starbucks! :) Thanks for making the holiday spirit feel all the brighter!

A Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks. Thanks for keeping your quality of products consistent along the franchise. But mostly, thank you for the great service; keep it up!
Typical airport location. The coffee is fine but you wait and wait if you catch it wrong. Typically not staffed properly to meet demand.

I am a huge fan of Starbucks - usually purchasing 2-3 times per week. Unfortunately this location did not meet the standards of the other ones. I usually use this drive through, but one time went into the store. I went to the restroom to wash my hands, then went to order. I stuttered when ordering - and the young man taking my order looked at me, smirked, and said "should know what you want to order, you were in the bathroom long enough." I was so appalled and embarrassed I grabbed my order and left, not even thinking to speak to a manager.

(3.75) ~ Good Overall Food & Service 

MENU:
** Iced Cocoa Cloud Macchiato = (4.25) Very good, Especially with Cinnamon sprinkled on;)
* Watermelon Juice(evolution) = (3.5) good

The best Starbucks I've ever been to, hands down ! One specific employee (I can't remember her name) is always kind and positive. She gives me good suggestions for my drinks . This specific location makes my drink the best (I've tried many other Starbucks in pinellas county and they don't compare.. so weird) idk how they do it but I will drive out of my way just to go to this specific location for its service, it's efficiency in making the right drink and employees !

Starbucks is crappy and mediocre, but the location on Mass Ave takes it to a whole new level. Grungy tables and floor, confusing store layout, and a terrible Frappuccino all made this a lousy experience. I only came here out of desperation for a place to hang out for an hour or so, but I think I'd be better off on a random street corner.
I spend a good bit of time at this Starbucks and always walk out satisfied.  Staff is friendly and my breakfast sandwich and coffee is always great.
15 minutes to get a drink with no line. Manager on duty couldn't care less. Servers are very slow and don't look motivated

I'm also a barista at Starbucks, and there's nothing that warms my heart more than great customer service from other partners. I walked in and was immediately greeted by Dustin at the register. Instead of hastily just trying to get me through the line, we talked for a bit and made that "customer connection" that I love so much. 

I love my company and I love when other people really show how good people are. DUSTIN -- thanks for your great customer service! Keep it up!

Flew again today and two Fridays ago from Philly. Today seemed a little disorganized and line went too slowly. I admit they were trying but it was so slow, our orders were right and the staff was friendly, we finally have starbucks and an alternative to le bus or dunkin donuts now at Philly airport. Between concourse b and c. A nice addition to my morning flights. Now a little more organization and it would rock. Customers need to be ready to order when they get to counter. Large families wait and then look like a deer in the headlights. Seriously? I fly next Friday again so we shall see. It's only been open a few weeks.

Come here if you're a fly.  Or a person who likes flies.  This Starbucks is conveniently located and usually seems to have tables open.  The employees are friendly and efficient.  But both times I went there to do work, I was grossed out by the flies buzzing around.  It's good to take out the garbage sometimes.  Just a thought.
This store has a great staff and a good location near I-580.  It is in the same shopping area as Home Depot.  The staff works hard for quality in their product and it shows.

Starbucks is starbucks and we all decide for ourself if it's for you. This review is specifically for the drive thru. My first experience. I was impressed. It was fast, they go my order straight and I was still able to use my starbucks app with ease.

I ordered a venti cappuccino here via drive thru and more than half of my cup was foam. I actually thought my cup was empty. When I shook my cup, there was a measly amount of liquid swishing at the bottom of the cup. I actually put my finger down inside of it, and it was almost all foam! There was barely any liquid in the entire cup! And I paid almost $6 for a venti sized drink. I'm never going to this location again.

Love my soy vanilla lattes with 2 Splenda.  Yes, I could get it other places and have, but Starbucks always has me coming back for more.  This was trendy little spot with a nice, open layout.  Service was great:  quick, friendly and focused on the task at hand.
Very relaxing and laid back environment enjoy a good cup of coffee and catch up with friends.  Love the patio if possible....

This line get long--it's an airport!--but they sure move things along.  Drinks come out rapidly, food is constantly restocked, and they work pretty hard, all while being friendly.

What more can you ask for from an airport  Starbucks?

Fast, efficient, consistent.

My sister and I came to this Starbucks for some coffee. Go figure.
Neither of us were pleased with our orders.
I figured out that the problem with mine was that the baristas didn't know how to properly use soy milk in coffee.
(This is going to sound weird but I am so picky about it)
I don't even use soy milk in my own coffee at home, because I haven't mastered it.
I'm not sure how, but when you're using soy milk in coffee, you have use it differently, maybe in different ratios than milk. Otherwise the taste is disruptive to what you're looking for from your coffee. 
The Starbucks I usually go to in Target in Clearwater Mall has it down-pat.
Unfortunately, this crew wasn't up-to-par with their use of soy milk in my Frozen Salted Caramel Mocha Frappe, No whip, with soy.
I was disappointed.. it honestly didn't even taste good. The soy milk took all attention of my taste buds and also had a drying affect on my mouth which was obnoxious.
Coffeesnob101 lol

Good experience. Maybe it's me I just don't get the hype of Starbucks at ALL. I had a gift card for Starbucks I thought it had 6$ and change- turns out it was eight two cents. My husband ordered the white mocha drink and enjoyed it. I got the sweet cream cold brew. Very good. 

My daughter has educated me on many things Starbucks lol. So relieved to see gender neutral bathrooms (insert sarcasm here) apparently this is a big deal in the Yelp check in world. The Starbucks is comfy and relaxing and we sat in the cozy leather chairs. I don't know . . . I always feel so out of place in these kinds of coffee places. I'm usually super basic- black coffee no cream no sugar- can I be any more boring?!  I think back to an episode of Curb Your Enthusiasm when Larry David went to a place like this and has no idea about the menu. His order was "Just give me a vanilla bullshit drink". That's what I've always got in my mind when I go to these kind of snobby coffee bars. Lol.
Cleanest, fastest and most friendly Starbucks in town. You won't find any better, try for yourself.

This is my favorite Starbucks location! The employees are friendly and I've never had a long wait or my coffee made incorrectly as I've had with other locations. I have a fairly complicated order and I've never so much as gotten the dirty look I can occasionally get 

 There are also great booths to study and do homework in! There's always enough space to sit- this location is fairly large.

I love this Starbucks! I'm from the Bay Area and was in town craving a Starbucks drink. Customer service was phenomenal here. An employee by the name of Elizabeth gave great customer service. She was super sweet and friendly. Next time I come back in town, I will definitely stop by at this location.

Give five stars for effort and friendliness. Give five stars for a clean and nice place. Give five stars for well prepared food and drink.

Efficiency is rather bad right now but it will come. It takes a long time to get food, especially. But they are super sweet as you wait.

Had the worst coffee this morning! I order the same drink all the time and I knew it didn't look right... but I was running later than usual and didn't say anything... but my drink was terrible!!! Not the way I wanted to start my day! I ordered a grande, it was so light, I'm thinking I was shorted a shot. I used to love this location but I feel like it's been hit or miss lately... and it wasn't even really crowded.

I love this place.. before going home from work I need a coffee and something to chew on at probably 4:00 PM..( my time)
Always get their Peppermint Mocha or Ice cold Mocha.. 
Now they have also started sandwiches and wraps!! woohoo!
Not too crowded and not too lame..

One of the guys there has an attitude issue sometimes but the other guys are fun and great..

When I started my path to a healthy lifestyle, I stopped going to Starbucks. Then the started creating "Bistro Boxes," a healthier alternative, they posted calories on their menus, AND I discovered the "Skinny Latte!" I'm back and I can have a healthy bite and a custom coffee! This is just one of many I stop at as it's close to where my my Granddaughter lives. I can help her eat healthier here as well!

Fun Fact: The Oprah Chai (in it's Tall version) has only 150 calories. I can't account for the sugar content at moment and quite frankly, I'd rather not know but I will say this particular Chai offers a healthy dose of caffeine kick and spice. I giggled at first when I heard Oprah had her own bebida at Starbucks...but now, now, dear reader, I laugh no more. In true Oprah fashion, she means business.

As for this particular location: the barista was exceptionally friendly and the space was clean. The natural light would make for a great work/meeting space.
I went in here before my interview at Home Depot. I usually don't buy star bucks cause I can go to Dunkin' or even Wawa get coffee. The barestia was very friendly.

SUUUUUUUPER slow service. Ordered at the drive-thru speaker fairly quickly, but then waited at the window for almost 10 minutes before anyone acknowledged us, and when we finally got our drinks half of them weren't made correctly and tasted wrong. So disappointed.

I've been coming here virtually ever day since my stay in good ol' Conshy.  Why?  Because I need coffee to function and I like my fancy lattes.  I've only had one nice barista and she is uber nice.  Everyone else has been terribly rude.  If they make my drink wrong, they are rude about fixing it.  And frankly I've had two good lattes from here.  Why do I keep coming back?  It's the only latte place I've found.  Today I came in and the baristas were really nice to the locals and were one again mean to me when now it has been the seventh day I've come in.  (However, the one barista who has been consistently nice to me is still the sweetest, so THANK YOU!)  There is no excuse to be rude to a customer especially someone like me who is always friendly to people.  Terribly customer service.  I'm sticking with WaWa from now on.  

Only positive note is the tea lattes are back.  I did go in yesterday and the barista made a FABULOUS green tea latte.  That has been the highlight of my Starbucks experience.  Sad.

I mean, can you really have high expectations for an airport Starbucks? I would say no..

Service is nice enough, product is about he same as any other Starbucks, and prices and design are obviously identical as well.

I've never had an awful experience here, nor have I ever had a mind-blowing experience..but it's Starbucks soooo....yeah.

Happy happy staff here!
Perfect Carmel Mocha frappuccino! 
Family friendly and comfy couches.  Outside seating with umbrellas under the awnings.  
Nice merchandise selection and of course free wifi!
Top notch baristas. Delicious drinks. What more can you ask for. My iced skinny mocha was perfect on this super spring day.

I have to down rate this Starbucks because the only Starbucks product that I buy is the VIA Italian Roast Decaf. Despite the fact that it is the only VIA Decaf that Starbucks makes, at least one third of the time I try to buy it here, it is out of stock. I don't know if that's due to national not providing it or the store not ordering enough but it is very frustrating.

Experienced the most delightful customer service here! I was torn between the new drinks and Cristal was more than eager to assist me! Definitely will be coming back because of how pleasant Cristal was!

Super-fast drive-thru (even with the kind of wonky layout).
Staff was personable and friendly from the order taking to the pick-up window.  They made me a delicious Strawberry Frappuccino to go with my banana nut bread - which they offered to heat and did.

Waiting for a tire repair so we decided to grab a drink at Starbucks in Sparks. I chose a white chocolate mocha which is always good and got a free lemon pound cake with my points that I had earned. we also purchased a turkey Panini which was delicious. The place was pretty empty so service was immediate the wait was very short and as always it's an excellent delicious afternoon meal.

I love Starbucks, & I especially appreciate the consistency in their drinks no matter which location you're visiting.

What makes this particular location even better? The staff! 

I am a drive-thru kinda girl & always drive away smiling :) There is a very nice young man & a couple of darling women I have seen there, each of them very sincere and sweet. 

I'll be back again and again!

Absolutely horrible customer service. As I placed my order they loudly laughed at the way I pronounced "Caramel" and when I drove up to the drive through window they made me repeat it so the other women could laugh even more. I'm absolutely appalled at the way this location does their business and I will never shop here again.
One of my all time favorite Starbucks. The staff is always friendly and quick. I normally order ahead on the app and my order is always perfect and ready to go when I walk in.
Slowest Starbucks ever.  There is not a single person that works there from Cashier to the Barista.  Absolutely terrible.  Shouldn't take 20-30 minutes to get a coffee.

Slow service and the worst, and I mean the worst, mocha I've ever experienced. Instant hot chocolate made with water is better than this stuff. I would've returned it, no retry for this bunch, only I didn't taste my drink until already on the plane. I wish I'd known there was a Peet's.
Love this little starbucks.  Great drive through.  Super friendly staff.

Ok it's Starbucks. So don't expect some cafe in Florence. Nonetheless, this Starbucks location does "Starbucks" as well as it can be done. Drinks are always made an attention to detail, and the staff is super friendly.

It's hard for one location in a chain to distinguish itself, but they do an excellent job. Even when they're busy, customer service is never sacrificed.

It's enough of an effort that whenever I'm in Sherwood Park (or that side of the city) and craving some coffee, I always make the trip there. Even if it's not the closest place to go. I only wish all Starbucks locations were this good.

This place is nice, but there's always people who sit in here and take up seats pretending to do work on their laptops. Not the biggest fan of Starbucks, but this one is pretty nice. It's good to see a new and improved shopping center, and all of the new faces you'll see if you come here. Great atmosphere! 
Definitely coming back soon!

Staff are friendly and coffee is good but the only problem with this location are all the homeless people that sit here the whole day. I understand this is a national problem in most cities.  Some have mental issues and cannot help themselves but this is a business and people who actually pay money to come here should not have to deal with this.  There are places for them to seek help.  Maybe get a job.  When they sit here and order water all day well again this is a place of business. One man was rolling cigarettes he was taking apart from ones he found on the ground.  That smell of ash tray makes me not want to come here.

Not great. Service is pretty bad. 5 people working, I still waited 10 mins for my coffee in a nearly empty store. Probably best to drive thru on this one. I think the drive thru customers were getting priority.

This is a former Long John Silvers location but you'd never know it on the inside. It's absolutely beautiful!  It has a "lodge" feel to it with lots of wood, dark chocolate tile flooring and exposed beams. They truly did a great job with this location.

Friendly staff,comfy seats, ample parking and quick wifi!

Oh! And no screaming kids running around because their Lululemon clad moms are ignoring them.

Score!

Very nice Starbucks located on the second floor of the hospital. Good signs once you get inside to the Starbucks. Don't be intimidated by the hospital Ambience, once you get to the second floor and find the Starbucks you'll be very happy. Large, clean, bright, friendly with plenty of seating both inside and outside the store.

Came here thru the drive thru, the line was not too bad but the wait to order took Atleast 15 minutes. When I placed my order the GIRL on the intercom was sweet. When I got my order it was a GUY at the register and well he wasn't nice at all I was trying to add partial of the amount to my rewards since I had money already on there. He sounded very sarcastic when he said it's x amount and this is x amount. I had to tell him I know how much it is I have partial loaded already. Then when he handed the cup ( my bf was driving) it almost spilled. And when he handed the rest of my order he literally just stuck his hand out almost tossingly and didn't say anything..... 
good thing I rarely come to this location as his service was very unappreciated.

Convenient location, but easy to miss when driving. Parking is very inadequate and entrance driveway too narrow. Otherwise, the building is attractive, seating is adequate, quite clean, and service is good. Nice outdoor seating, more could be added.

For an airport Starbucks, this place was perfect! The staff was super friendly, service was fast and the coffee tasted great!  There is plenty of seating. They have a full selection of food and drinks! The only bummer was I wanted a Starbucks tall mug with the saint Louis logo and there are zero to be found  .... so if you ever get a restock! Please send me one! - a Saint Louis native

I always have bad experiences here. Either they get my drink wrong or it takes much longer than needed. Although I try to be understanding, I have had too many bad experiences to let it slide. I would not recommend this location.
By far the worst white chocolate mocha ....  employees here need some training. This is my daily drink and everywhere I go taste the same but here.

I been coming to see TJ to make my salted caramel cream cold brew for months. He is the ONLY one who can make it right. I have literally went to all the Starbucks locations and no one can make it right. Thanks TJ, you rock!
Hate to be that guy, but my experience wasn't very good. How do you mess up 2 drink orders?

Was there about noon today. Have no car, so their small eternally-packed parking lot does not affect me. Ideal bike-ride stop north of Downtown St Pete, at busy intersection of two bus routes. Immediate friendly service as soon as I walked in. Comfy window seating to quietly unwind with a cup while watching the world go by. Several outdoor tables with umbrellas right on the corner, a very pleasant place to read or do the laptop.
Maybe because of the size of this location I was not pleased with the food selection here. The staff was friendly and enjoyed the chai latte just was looking for more than baked items.

Slowest Starbucks known to man. I try to avoid this place but if I'm in the area and need coffee, I don't have much of a choice. Every single time I've come here they've been slow as all hell. I'm a barista too, so I get it can be busy.. but come on.

This is a very nice location with a great layout to sit, study, work, or converse with friends. I love the open payout and segregation for an additional semi-private area for sitting quietly. The parking lot leaves a bit to be desired as it is not conducive to parking or getting out of the parking lot. But, this is a busy intersection as well. 

My one criticism of their customer service is that when customers are present employees should pay attention and serve guests instead of continuing to talk with their co-workers. Even though the lady was very nice to me when she was taking my order she ignored me for about 30 s Vonda while she spoke to her co-worker about personal stuff. Other than this it was a great visit.
Best Starbucks ever! They are amazing and offer great customer service! My drink tasted so good and the atmosphere was so welcoming. I will forsure be coming back.

They close at 7 on Sunday, it is currently 6:10 and they have taken all their pasteurized out of the case, turned their ovens off, and were incapable of cooking any the food the have on display or on their menu.  I find that if your open that that means you should be capable of offering all items on the menu until close.  I am going to reach out to the manager of this Starbucks and hope that I can update my review based off of how the manager attempts to rectify the problem.  I now have an extremely disappointed three year old and it is difficult to properly explain the reason he can't have something I told him he could.  Needless to say I will be going back to my regular Starbucks and be avoiding this one at all costs.  Too eager to close down for the day and get out of work then to serve their patrons.

This Starbucks is pretty small compared to the other ones In the area but I will say that they are very quick with the drinks are are extremely friendly. They have a few 4 person tables that are great when you need the extra room to do work or
you are expecting to meet a few people. Both the dining area and the bathroom were very clean.

I love that this location is walking distance to the Clearwater Harbor Marina and Coachman Park. They accept mobile ordering. The cafe is a good size for a Starbucks and the patio has amble room for several guests. Patio is dog friendly!

This is one of the only Starbucks in Tucson that always gets my drink perfect! Having worked at a Bux before I order things i used to make and they rarely taste the same as i used to make them, but here they always do!

This Starbucks is connected to the Tampa Downtown Embassy Suites. If you are walking into the hotel the Starbucks is to the left. 
There is a row of tables and chairs on the outside and some basic seating inside. You are likely going to sit in the hotel lobbly to be honest which is connected on the inside.
It's a nice place. Seemed clean and I did not see a bathroom but the hotel has a public restrooms which I assume you would end up using anyway.
The food offering was not awesome as they seemed to be out of a few items but they had what I wanted so I was satisfied.
I ended up grabbing some waters and a protein box so I was an easy customer. Will try some actual coffee soon.

Extremely understaffed for a Wednesday morning at 7:45 AM.

At least 15 people waiting either a mobile order drive-through or counter order.

I love Starbucks especially this location. The people are just so friendly and very fast with my order. Now the only reason why I gave them 4 stars instead of 5 was when I ordered last. Okay awhile back I got a receipt with a free tea at the bottom. I was only like 1-2 days late after the expiration date. I am not one to complain about little things like that and I`m not asking for special treatment but the girl at the window was like tell her she can`t use it because it already expired with an attitude to add. Now when something like that is being approached I do find that kind of rude when address is with such a burden or attitude. Instead of saying it like that, she could of been "m'am I apologize but your coupon has expired", I would totally been fine with that. Other than that its a very convenient place for me to get coffee on my way to work.

Definitely an improvement from the previous Starbucks stand in the Galleria, though it can get slow and packed with customers. I do appreciate that they offer ice water for patrons as you wait though - a plus for hot St. Louis summers!
I stop at this Starbucks on a fairly regular basis.. the drive thru is quick, the staff friendly and the coffee.. well.. what can I say.. IT's STARBUCKS!

Don't expect the friendliest service here... and sitting outside is tortuous , it's decent inside . My main pet peeve is how they are so anal about refills, like if you walk out to best buy and walk back you don't qualify?? Just expect meteokre

As a traveler I frequent a lot of Starbucks. This is by far the worst. I waited in line for 30 minutes and watched everyone behind the counter move at a snail's pace. When it was my turn I ordered a coffee, oatmeal, and a water. I reminded the barista to charge me for the water, but she just waved it on. This happened to a few customers so I'm sure the company would want to know they're losing money (not that I mind). It then took another 15 minutes just to get the oatmeal, which didn't come with any type of sweetener (no honey, agave, brown sugar, etc). I didn't notice until I opened my oatmeal on the plane so I ended up with very a bland breakfast. Save your time and go to La Colombe a few steps away.

Kudos to Starbucks for creating a consistent brand.  This Starbucks as most others has consistently good drinks with a consistent taste.  No surprises.  The food is the same for consistency.  From a brand standpoint it is the "McDonald's" of coffee.  Unfortunately not local but so convenient and ubiquitous.

First time at this Starbucks location and it was an amazing experience - way better than the location closer to my house. 

1) it's fairly new! If you're going to try the drive-thru, there is a screen that shows your order. It's great to make sure that your order is accurate. 

2) they are fast! There were about 5 cars ahead of me in the drive-thru but I was still out of there in 5-10 minutes. I purposely don't go to the Starbucks near my house (Of 56th and Lafayette) because 5 cars in line there is an automatic 15 min wait. 

3) the staff seems so friendly! 

Keep up the good work representing the Starbucks brand appropriately.

This was the worst starbucks I've ever visited. Service was terrible and slow.   The staff working at the terminal c location were rude,  loud and unfriendly. When you pay $6 for a coffee you expect  happy polite service.  It took me longer to get a coffee than it did to check in my bag and get thru security. Visit another starbucks if you can. This one was BAD!
Slightly slow service but very friendly even when they had to redo my order. Bought the cutest STL mug! Good location. Clean

This location usually has an extremely long line but thanks to being early wait time was relatively short.  All the folks behind the counter were friendly and energetic but they don't have any breakfast sandwiches.

I don't like Starbucks at all. It's overpriced, mediocre-at-best stuff. 

Having said that, I respect a place that will happily screw up your order, no matter how important you try to convince them you are.

I stopped there for a Green Tea Latte. The place is very busy and doesn't have enough seating spots.
The service was friendly and the Latte was consistent with most other branches.
The staff looked very unprepared to help me and my colleague. Iced coffee was ok. Location was convenient.

I'm a regular Starbucks drinker or of convenience and consistency, but this particular location is horrendous. I think of myself as a pretty forgiving customer, especially if the staff and nice, but everything about this Starbucks has gone wrong.

The stand alone Starbucks in this center unfortunately closed so I stopped into the one inside the target. I had to wait an inappropriately long time in a short line and the baristas have an attitude with no sense of customer service. There were flies everywhere, even in the baked goods window (I should have just called the health inspectors at this point). The condiment bar was completely out of everything, sugar, straws, napkins-- everything! I'm honestly surprised at how bad my experience was. They didn't have any cold brew (figures) and offered me regular iced coffee instead. Thankfully my iced coffee was fine, but my boyfriends iced pumpkin spiced latte was disgusting and wasn't made right.

Save yourself the time and disappointment and go to a stand-alone Starbucks.
This is my neighborhood Starbucks.  They have a nice outdoor seating section that is perfect for people watching on Mass Ave.  The service is great.
I love this Starbucks.  They are always super friendly and helpful. And they make you laugh when ordering.  Great place to hang out with a good book, friends,  or to just "be".

The crew is awesome! Usually slammed (I mean, everyone needs coffee) but they get my coffee and name right every day that I go. Staff is by far the best part of this location. Nice and approachable, they get my daily fix of caffeine (which is worryingly high) right every time!

My excitement to see a drive thru Starbucks in the neighborhood quickly turned to disappointment after waiting in a line of 3 cars for 20 minutes. When looking in while I waited 10 minutes at the window for my drink it appeared that there were only 3 employees. They looked extremely disorganized, nothing was stocked and there were only 2 customers inside of the store so it's not like they were swamped. My peppermint mocha latte was delicious as expected but something has to be improved at this location.
Very large plenty of study space friendly attentive staff very very very cold staff said they have no control over the heat. Everyone had their winter coats on. I had to leave it was so cold.

Nice location in south Edmonton common. Ample seating but unfortunately most are hard wooden chairs. Lots or large windows that let the sun in even on a gloomy winters day. Solid tea latte and as always the spinach feta egg white wrap so hot and delicious.
The line stretches down the corridor. 20 minutes plus just to place your order. The coffee is not worth it.

The only reason for two stars is that they are the only Drive-Thru Starbucks in the area. The drive-thru is extremely dangerous. The parking lot is very tight and has two entrances from different roads into the drive-thru. The staff is extremely incompetent. People leave the drive-thru line constantly because it's nearly impossible to get around. My food wasn't ready so they asked me to "pull around and wait for them to bring it out" as if that was easy. I waited in the most inconvenient spot, which pissed off other drivers. I couldn't even get by the door and tried to call to no answer. Then I called and no answer, so I finally left without my food. I called again to ask for a refund, and she told me I would have to go in to get it. Absolutely absurd for how much money I spend at Starbucks. This also completely goes against the POINT of using a drive-thru. If I wanted to go in somewhere, I would have gone to the much BETTER Starbucks down the road. Also my coffee came out barely luke-warm this morning and I had to wait to drink it to microwave it. Terrible terrible customer service, and I will be reporting this location to Starbucks corporate.

My favorite Starbucks in the city for people watching, especially in the summer.  On a First Friday, there can be a bit of a wait but the staff is always friendly and the decor has more character than its suburban counterparts.
Coffee! Opens at 6am for the early birds..  Its usually busy, but the service is always fast and friendly!

Starbucks is A-OK Starbucks the only thing I do not like about Starbucks they need to keep their counters clean and keep your floors and bathrooms clean it gets mad when you make the drink wrong and asked to remake it just my point of you other than that I love it
Rude employee. Talked down to me and had a smug gave the entire time. Was not friendly to answer any of my questions. Couldn't see her name tag. :/

Hannah serviced me at the drive thru today and she was the most unpleasant person I've dealt with at a Starbucks. I was very polite and clear in my order and she couldn't understand what I was asking for and after repeating it back to her twice, she became very short with me. It's sad that this new location didn't exemplify the great Starbucks customer service that the company as a whole usually gives. I doubt I will return.
This is the slowest Starbucks I have even been to. On multiple occasions, I have waited 10mins for a basic order.

Saw that they had two stars so I had to put put in my TWO cents. I've never had them mess up my order, they're always friendly. Tastes like Starbucks. I'll ask for multiple specific drinks and they never bat an eye. Better than two star service, that's for sure.

Delicious sandwich but now i am left food poisoned, dizzy, breathless and breathing hard after eating it. The green tea is good too but it didnt help. I am angry!!!! I just want to be ableto eat regular food n not feel bad!!!

I was looking for a local owned coffee shop in Florissant and realized that they do not exist. The three I was able to find on Google maps had all closed up. But go figure there were two Starbuck's locations within close proximity so I picked one and there I headed.

This location was impressive. Not the physical building, but the staff and the people. It felt like a local owned coffee shop. After mentioning that I just moved here from Los Angeles, I was told that my first cup of coffee was on the house! We proceeded to chat about a few local places that I must visit. I met a local business owner, the local self-proclaimed "Crazy Dave" and a few other great people - and I felt very much at home.

The coffee was, well Starbucks. Other than the fact that they do not have any of the breakfast sandwiches, this was everything you'd expect from a Starbucks, and more.
Why go here when Henry's Coffee Bistro (with better, less expensive coffee and that irreplaceable, neighborhood feel) is around the corner?

Dang it - deleted my last review and this one is simply not going to have the panache that the last one did. Basically, I love sbux but I don't like it when the baristas are stuffy and flippant - these guys are so incredibly nice. I love them all. They are also completey on point in the morning, and travel at warp speed to deliver my iced coffee lt. cream with a smile and a wink.

I attached a map to show the best way to get in and out of this parking lot, without being interupted by the drive thru - basically you need to drive around the block (head north on Martin ave off of Broadway) and you won't get blocked by the drive thru traffic on the Broadway street-side, if you are trying to park... 

thank you smiley happy people I see each day, you guys are awesome.

While the window server is nice, the service is so incredibly slow that it ruins the convenience of a drive thru. I only use it when I have sleeping kids in the car because no matter what time you come you end up waiting 15 min in the drive thru line.

I love this Starbucks!  I have to deal with Route 70 and Wegman's to get to this one so only go when I'm up very early to make sure I don't homicide anyone.

They are so nice!

I ended up here, largely against my will, and regret it. It's worse than it was when I last reviewed it. Dark, dingy, dirty ... I guess the best you can say about it is that it's a nice hangout for the city's homeless population. But gads, even the homeless should have something better than this!

The iced coffee I had was awful. Cloyingly sweet, syrupy, sloppy, and artificial tasting. 

And as we left, the garbage can overflowing with its refuse was a nice touch.

I'm giving this Starbucks a two star only because the set up and slower staff make the line consistently long. They make decent Starbucks drinks, but if there's a line, it will take you a bit longer to get your drink. If you're rushing to get on a flight, do NOT go here unless there's no line.

Its Starbucks! When you catch a 550am flight out of new Orleans to Tampa and get a coffee ( double shot espresso) right outside the gate you just fell out of, yep! Better than sex.....!!!!!!   And in an airport, yep. you gotta wait in line since I'm not the only one who lives there... And yes, it's not cheap!!! Since when did you ever have something CHEAP at the airport? A pack of gum is $3, and bottled water is $4....suck it up. Your traveling, expect it!!!!!  Got another one in Atlanta 2 hrs later!!!!

Five star: highly recommend!! 

Best nap I've ever took & when I woke up. 
Bam! Coffee right there in front of me!

This review is for the Starbucks on the Southwest terminal at Lambert Airport. It always seems like an inconvenience for them to wait on you, horrible service. Last time I was there they only offered tall drinks because they were out of lids. AVOID THIS PLACE! I give it a 2 only because the coffee is still great!
The servers were a little stressed but otherwise efficient. They were advertising the Christmas snowman cookies but they were not available at lunch time

This place is kind of crap. First of all, the line moves incredibly slowly, in part because they make everyone sign for every transaction, even if it's just for $2. Second, they seemed to be out of a lot of things, including basics like light-roast filter coffee, whole milk, and unbleached sugar. It took me 10 minutes to get a cup of drip coffee, even though there were only four people in front of me. There were two people working behind the counter.

I've been to many Starbucks in my life and this one was the most disgusting. Don't go to this Starbucks! Not only are they slow but the area in which they make drinks was filthy. So was the restroom. It was disgusting! I also watched a barista make four fraps in one blender. I don't think they are supposed to do that.

Usually I don't post unless the service or food quality is bad however, I believe this deserves a review. I've been to this location two times and this is the second time they have forgotten my order. I waited over 10 minutes while others (6 people) behind me got their orders ahead of mine. I had to go over to the barista and tell them that I hadn't received my order after waiting another 5 minutes. They need to re-think their service order priority.

WALK TO A DIFFERENT STARBUCKS! This one is poorly run and very slow. My drink order was messed up and I had to ask several times about the status of my food before they realized they had never even started it. They acted like I was an annoying customer for asking, i was polite and I just wanted what I paid for. There's plenty of other Starbucks and hopefully this one is poorly run because it's new and still learning. For now tho, if you're in a hurry, you may want to skip this location.

I'm just not a starbucks fan, its really not their fault! I am yet to find a starbucks drink that isn't 100% tooooo sweet. Not to mention overpriced. The Starbucks in iv is very small as well so its not worth trying to study there. Overall I would just go to a different cafe or library any day.

Outside of the 15 minute wait for an iced vanilla latte and growing, the ambiance of this Starbucks provides serenity when patience is necessary.

The staff that is here has changed and in between them explaining how bad their schedules were made; found it possible to make a couple of drinks. 

However, aside from the collegial disgruntlement of a staff the patrons go about their work with absolute mindfulness. The cozy fireplace and modern decor invite you to sit down, plug into a book and forget about the bustle of the day.

Meanwhile....I'm still waiting on my latte.

Was very disappointed with the customer service. I came the buy a few mugs and coffee so I was spending quite a bit of money too. When I purchased the mugs and coffee, I told the barista that I would like to pay with seperate transactions using the app. Everyone knows you get stars per trans. The barista then informed me that you do not get stars per transaction. I then told her she was wrong and you actually do. After I said that she rolled her eyes and ignored me. I was trying to get her attention asking her when Starbucks changed their rewards policy. Mind you, I'm not a rude person at all and she still acted like she couldn't hear me, looking a completely different direction. She could defiantly hear me and decided to act childish instead. Couldn't be more disappointed with the customer service. Please vet your employees better or put some of them through a customer service training/refresher.
Morgan is incredibly rude and has an attitude problem. She needs a basic lesson on costumer service and manners. That is all.

Very frustrating waiting for my first cup of coffee in the morning and all 4 ladies behind the Starbucks counter in terminal A are more interested in talking to each other than doing their job. Once my coffee was finally made the barista didn't even make an attempt to give it to me. She set it on the counter as close to the edge closest to her as possible and then turned away to continue her conversation. I hope they don't actually get too busy this morning because folks could be waiting a while for their coffee and if you're one of those people that need your first cup pronto then you may want to pick it up somewhere else. Thankfully I am not!  The upside?  I am sitting here now in the airport enjoying my caramel machiatto  and cinnamon bagel. Yum!

I have been to a handful of airport Starbucks, and I understand why they overstaff some of them for when the rush hits, but this was a slower day and while a hive can work well with tons of bees buzzin' around these folks need to work on their system. 

It wasn't busy but the 7 or so folks working behind this tiny hub of a Starbucks were all younger and super chatty with each other where it made it difficult for folks to know if their orders were being placed or not, or correctly.

I don't speak Starbucks and asked for a Large, but got a medium and felt like the staff while efficient was being short with the clientele in favor of side conversations and jokes with other employees. 

I totally understand liking the people you work with but when it's at the expense of customer service, you should probably keep it to the break room.
Apparently, this Starbucks isn't open on Father's Day or really any other time I've stayed at this hotel.

Not the best in customer service. Silly me spilled my drink all over my table. Thankfully the kind gentleman beside me offered to assist me in cleaning the mess. He asked for a towel to help clean up and the response given was 'there's napkins'. Really?! Thank you for that! We aren't wanting the towel for our own personal gain, we are cleaning up a mess so you won't have too later. 5 minutes later and countless napkins, she finally offered a towel. Now, don't get me wrong. After hearing a customer accidentally spilled her drink, having been in customer service most of my life, I would have offered another. I realize it was my own fault but things happen and the darn thing was still full! Just not impressed with the attitudes given when asked for a towel.

(3.5) ~ good overall coffee & service.  Notes: The Main Entrance is the same for both the Bank(Right) & Starbucks(Left).  My Flat White was good, but not great;)  And my one wish would be that they add a Clover Brewing System;)

Does Starbucks hire these people, if so I know some people looking for work that can do much better than these degenerates.

+1 star for good espresso
Just what I needed after an early flight to Tampa. It's conveniently located inside the airport next to the escalators.
If there were 0 star option I would take that option. This place doesn't deserve my money, this place has the worst coffee and worst customer service that I have ever been.

I attempted to go in Starbucks to order a coffee.  I had my small Maltese in my arms, as it was 90 deg outside and didn't want to leave him in the car.   This location has no drive thru.   One of the employees started yelling at me the dog could 't stay.  I offered to place the order and go wait outside.  She refused.   I told her I would never come back to this location again.  SHe laughted and said, "Good".

I used to love this place because the employees are so welcoming, quick, and super organized. There was one employee who always remember my usual drink and always make it quick for me. Even when it gets busy, the line moves very very quickly. Now I don't see the old employees working there anymore. This place has changed. It is now very disorganized. During 3 visits, I was in line for 10 minutes. The drinks took awhile also.

This Starbucks seems like an older location.  There is no drive-through, and electrical outlets are in short supply.  Either the seating arrangement keeps you away from the outlets, or they're just not there.  There was only one outlet near the three tables I was sitting at.  But it's still Starbucks.  Quality drinks, friendly staff, and good service.  It's always a pleasant atmosphere, and great for a little mid-day break.
Best Starbucks I've been to in a long time! So cute and everyone is so nice and knows exactly what they're doing!

Avoid!! Save your money!
I asked for a tall coffee frappicino; I received something pale vanilla shade, warm and not tasting anything at all like a Starbucks coffee frap. 
When i reported to them I got attitude back.. I just left it on the counter and reported to the email on my receipt.

I usually love this Starbucks. Chris who works there is fabulous. All the kids are. Except today Heather who works there could not manage even a simple fake smile. Absolutely not personable in the least. Such a downer. She was knowledgable to ask whether I wanted my iced coffee sweet or unsweetened which I did appreciate.

Usually the only time I end up at a Starbucks is when trapped at an airport terminal for a morning flight. Luckily, I don't fly often so years can pass between Starbucks experiences.

$3.95 for the largest size cold-steeped coffee is ridiculous, being that at least half the volume is comprised of ice. Watered-down medium brew at 40% mark-up over the same stuff they serve hot. 

On this occasion I had been up for over 24 hours awaiting the arrival of my first grandchild. With any luck I won't have to avail myself of week-ass cold brew and harshly hot "fresh" brew until the next grandchild comes along.

While it gets expensive to make a daily stop here, we do find ourselves in the drive-thru at least one morning a week. 

Starbucks is Starbucks, pretty much across the map but this one has consistently impressed with quick service and shorter drive thru lines than the one further up Gateway Bvld.

This morning, the barista saw our car and  when we began to place our order, he remembered a drink order from a few weeks back.....we shook our heads and wondered if he can read our minds. No....the staff here is just that amazing!

This is probably going to sound ridiculous, but the coffee and latte I purchased here at the airport on 12/28 were the best I've had at any Starbucks in a long time. Fresh, not bitter at all. The employees were sweet as can be and did a fantastic job balancing quality and speed. Kudos, all.
This is one of my most favorite Starbucks, as these ladies work hard with care & fast! They are just lovely!
The baristas here are always cheerful and you can tell they're happy to be there. This is one of my most favorite places to sit on my laptop and get work done. It's a good environment. (:

This is a convenient location on your way in or out of town from the North. Although the parking lot is a little bit of a nightmare but that's not Starbucks fault. I almost always go inside rather than use the drive thru but on the rare occasion I've used the drive thru it's gone pretty quick.

The inside of the store is nice, the inside seating area is on the small side but they have outdoor seating as well.  The staff are always friendly, chatty and attentive. They seem to enjoy working here and make it pleasant for customers.  My drinks have always been made correctly and quickly.

We stopped in this Starbucks to kill some time waiting for dinner reservations. While the barista who took our order (she was brand new) was helpful and super sweet - what I found horribly off putting was there was an off duty staff member in line in front of us who was incredibly rude to the new barista behind the till - to the point she just let herself behind the counter to punch in the order herself. 

Also at the kid station the garbage had been pulled out like someone was changing it but never finished for nearly 20 minutes. 

Aside from that our drinks and food were prompt and very tasty. After the horrible attitude of the off duty barista though I don't know that I'll be in a huge rush to return to this location.
This location is always a friendly place! I stop in here whenever I'm walking along Mass Ave. It can be busy because of its location, but usually staff are quick and friendly despite busy crowds.
Sucks. Order a drink half an hour ago still haven't get it. The attitude of employees is horrible. Worst experience ever. Disappointed

Picture it: It's the middle of winter. The current temperature is dipping below zero. All you want is a steaming hot, caffeinated beverage. But, you're short on time and really? Who wants to get out of the car it took so long to warm up? The seat is finally toasty warm and your feet are finally beginning to thaw and besides all that, every surface of pavement everywhere is covered in ice (which, we all know, isn't the least bit fun to attempt to traverse on foot--unless, of course, those feet have ice skates on them).

Enter Starbucks drive-thru.

Yahtzee!

Not only does this location offer drive-thru service. But, the service is fast and friendly. The barista didn't seem the least inconvenienced to be leaning out into sub-arctic temperatures to hand me a steaming cuppa fabulous and even smiled while doing so.

Now, that's service.

Get to it!

So, just to get out there:
I have worked at a Starbucks and know the 'rules.' And every other Starbucks I have been to the baristas very accommodating to my orders and questions.

And I know I am in Isla Vista, so that care-free attitude must have some influence.

I have been in here multiple times and wish there was another Starbucks within a reasonable walking/biking distance. The baristas here are kinda rude and sometimes act like the world owes them.

I order two shots of espresso in my grande to-go iced cup with flavoring/syrup and soy. This is my way of getting a cheap latte. But it's not even a full iced latte because I don't want the full amount of soy. Two times I have been there they say "we're not allowed to do that." You're not allowed to make a drink? I even explained that it's not a full iced latte but both times they still charged me for a full latte. It's just two shots of espresso with some soy and ice because I don't like hot drinks.

To add to my frustration, when I checked my receipt and noticed the 'mistake,' I took it in about 5 days later and they said they couldn't do anything about it because every day the manager  "closes the register."

As a previous Starbucks barista, when a mistake was made, we always fixed it, even if it was days later. We would re-make the drink or give them a coupon for a free drink.

Another thing I have never heard of is not allowing someone to not have ice. I have served and ordered 'no ice' drinks I ordered a drink for a friend and they said they could only do half the ice. This establishment really puzzles me.

On one occasion (I understand that they were closing, but the hours listed were not the same), when I ordered my drink and noticed that he didn't give me my cup discount he said in a very hidden tone "I gave you plenty of discounts."
I made a confused face and just scanned my phone. 

I am almost out of money on my Starbucks card, and when I run out, I don't plan on returning there unless I'm desperate. There are plenty of other great cafes in IV with WiFi.

Hope others have better experiences.

After 18 visits, I figure it is time for a review. Why? I like this unique Starbucks...

It is tricky to get to. If you are coming in from Curlew, you can get here by cutting through a huge parking lot to get to Tampa road. Through much practice, I have found the optimal route that avoids every speed bump that causes my car to bottom out. Try left, right, left, right, left, and then right. 

Regarding this location, they have plenty of pleasant outdoor seating as well as indoor chairs and a beautiful solid wood communal table. Unfortunately, it is too close to the register so I can't edge it out the door and in to my house. 

As always, the espresso is consistently Starbucks and does what I need it to do. Wake me up!

I was really impressed by this Starbucks. So were my kids (hot chocolate people! I was NOT impressed with the nasty, cold St. Louis weather).
    When we walked in, the three of us were all kind of looking around  like "wow"...hehehe...because all the Starbucks I've ever been to have been teeny tiny with masses of people crammed in line. This place was spacious. And sleek. And totally spic and span.
    I had a different barista each time I visited, but both were very good. The staff was friendly (not pushy, not rude...but not funny like some of my local guys...just did their job swiftly and efficiently).
    Also, for the record, they had tons of tasty looking treats in the case...way more options, and much fresher looking, than here in Nashville. Not sure why that is...although Tennesseans are not shy about filling up the tank when on empty! I did, at least, let my kids indulge. ;-)
   All in all, very nice Starbucks, If this is what all the Starbucks in Missouri are like, y'all are *very* lucky indeed!

I like this location because it's spacious inside, but I also hate it because parking here is horrific! The lot is always full and there's always a long line for the drive thru so maneuvering around these cars isn't easy. I honestly have no idea where else I can park so if it looks full, I just keep driving.

Service is above average and the drinks are always consistent.

This been a regular stop on the way to work for me going on 5+ years now. Up front, the three stars are for the staff however, a couple drag the rest down, one with a regularly flippant attitude. 

Another common occurrence is at the point of sale when hot food items are ordered. The patron's name is not asked and when the order comes, a weak callout is made with only the name of the food and consequently not heard in restaurant over the often loud music and sometimes the sound level of the staff having a good time at work... I love seeing happy employees so perhaps this is a fair trade-off. However, a half warm breakfast sandwich tastes like hell. Often, they do not have in stock breakfast items like the heated sandwiches. Who does the ordering and for that matter, is there a manager even present seeing to these and the following glaring indiscretions?

As for the condition of the restaurant, I'd have to say it's a bit dirty and unattended. The window exteriors appear to not have been cleaned since the remodel, the window interiors are not far behind. The tables don't get wiped on a regular basis through the morning as well as the floor swept and debris remaining throughout the morning, it doesn't appear that it's mopped nightly either. The supply station is often out of items as I have observed often on my numerous visits at 6 am, the condition of the floors as described herein, unswept and still showing the signs of the previous business day. I did ask about this once and was told "Oh, we got hammered this morning". Again, 6 am and I look around seeing that I was one of three people in the place and but two cars in line outside, the staff kids partying it up... Really?

As said, there is good people working there that take a personal pride in the job they do but all that goes out the door given the aforementioned issues. A manager that isn't busy behind the counter preparing orders to oversee that the place is taken care of would be a start. A good hard cleaning of the entire restaurant, inside and out including the filthy paved areas outside, including the furniture is more than overdue. I suggest steam cleaning and sterilization. Can anyone say "Reset"?

I absolutely loathe this Starbucks. I'm so angry that it's the only one remotely near my college. The employees have absolutely no care in the world about making their customers experience the best it can be, and isn't that the name of the game for Starbucks? Isn't that why I pay $4 for a coffee? The drive thru is always backed up and after more than one horrible experience I've now learned to order inside. On any given day, they will have 4-5 people working and only one person making the drinks and the rest standing around talking and distracting the one person who's supposed to bang out all the indoor AND drive thru orders?! who manages this store?! It absolutely irritates me like no other to have to wait 15-20 minutes for my drink when I'm the only person inside who ordered one. The cashier will usually ignore you, and God forbid you order online, they won't make it until you get there and wait for 10 minutes since they're all ignoring you and then they'll make it. It's time for some new management to overhaul this location, they should really take a drive to the Southampton location because it's the most pleasant Starbucks ive ever encountered.

Friendly fast service! But this location is horrific. Dangerous line blocking Broadway traffic.  People still making illegal left turns from Broadway east. This location should never have been put here and should vacate. Starbucks is great but move to better location with safer ingress and egress

This is not my favorite spot, but it serves its purpose.  

The crew are fast, friendly, and efficient.  I do not hesitate stopping here.

Again, it can be hairy getting in and out at busier times of the day.
One of the greater Starbucks in the area for sure. Lots of seating and great view of Broad Ripple Ave. Love going to this place to sit and read a book on Sunday mornings.
Good coffee and a staff that makes me smile every time I stop in! A little busy in the AM, expected, but the 10 min waits bump off a star.  I STILL LOVE YOU GUYS!!! :-D

Staff is always very rude, I try to avoid this Starbucks whenever possible because they always deliver terrible customer service. I've yet to have a smiling staff member help me yet, at this location and they are so impersonal. I never even get a reply with a "you're welcome" when I say "thank you" or a "you too" when I mention "have a nice day." On top of the subpar customer service the drinks are below average compared to all other near by locations!

As far as Starbucks go, this is one of the locations I prefer. I tend to go through the drive thru at least a couple times a week and despite the high volume of business, the service is fast and very friendly. Not to mention- I don't think my order has ever been messed up here which is kind of amazing. They recently just got the nitro cold brew here too... which makes it even better. Overall, love driving through here on my way to work or school since it's so convenient.

I pulled up to the window and waited. Two minutes later the guy at the computer opens the window. Then asks "What did you have again????" You got to be kidding me. I just left. Horrible service, Will not come back. Starbuck goldcard holder.

This is by far one of the most friendly and attentive Starbucks teams, they make everyone feel valued  and in true Starbucks nature knows the regulars by name. Great management, great culture and in the rare occasion of a mistake they're super prompt to fix it with favorable outcomes.

Another Starbucks to add to the list... and this one was just run of the mill. I had the same lovely experience with the staff. WTF??? Do they have to be so darn friendly? It was like pulling teeth to get "how are you?" or a cup of coffee for that matter. That being said, I didn't allow it to ruin my visit. I was just happy to have a Starbucks again! They got my order right, which was a plus... and the location is a cute little converted bank. It added a bit of creativity and flair.

This starbucks is very nice they have a drive through and eat in area which is very convenient. The food you order is always hot and fresh and they always get your coffee order right. All the employees are very nice and will do anything (like remake your drink) to make you happy. Sometimes the drive through can take take but only if there's a lot of cars in front of you.

The same usual high priced coffee and food is offered at the airport. The food is decent and made rather quickly. The lady who took our order was polite and nice. The food was called out by name and what the order was but the drinks were sitting on the counter. Tough to hear sometimes with the crowd. It works for a quick coffee and snack if you want, though there are plenty of options that may be cheaper throughout the airport.

Rebekkah is the best barista. So personable and nice. I think she might be new but I hope she stays around for a while because this is my go-to studying location and it'd be great to have a friendly face around.

When I pay for two lattes I expect to get full cups, not here!  When I let the barista know she needs to fill the cups she shot me a death look.  Great customer service, NOT!  She did not even come over & look.  Just turned back to pouring milk.

The system went down this morning three customers in front of me. The woman who had to deal with it was frustrated, understandably so as the line was growing on a busy Saturday morning. She finally gave up and anyone who was paying with a credit card, the two people in front of me at that point, got their drinks for free. I told the truth and paid with my app instead of walking away with my already made drink for free. No thank you, no apology for the wait and inconvenience.

I came to this location only to receive poor service, lack of communication with the customer and rude ,after standing there for over 7 minutes I was finally acknowledged only to be treated as if I'm a bother employee family getting free drinks and hook ups other employees coming in not working only to make theirselves a drink and talk about why he couldn't wear his hat at work very unprofessional leaving the back door open which is a major safety hazard so he can take gallons of milk out. If you dont like your job simply quit

Every single time I go I this Starbucks I'm reminded of why I shouldn't get my coffee here. I don't know what goes on in this store but it is the slowest, most inept, unfriendly SB in the area. I try to always do mobile orders to avoid an even longer wait if I have to be in line, and even then, some of my orders take literally up to 20 minutes from the time of ordering to be ready (and no, it wasn't overly busy). I'm not alone in this, as the other day I waited with 2 other people, one of whom actually just walked out sans their order

The last straw was when I ordered a venti latte, got in my car, was driving away when I realized it was just a cup of hot milk. No espresso. Just. Milk. No room was even left for the espresso. How do you forget the coffee?!??! How?!?! When I drove back and returned it, first the barista didn't believe me, then they remade it and I didn't get an apology. 

What is going on in this store. Honestly. Also they've been closed a lot lately. Just randomly. The entire store needs new management and a staff kick in the a$$.

This location is my favorite one to go to. They are friendly and make my drink exactly the way it should be made. I have even gone to them on a few occasions to have my drink remade because another location butchered it. Thanks for being so awesome!

Pretty typical Starbucks.  Comfy sit down area, usually full of people studying, chatting, or on their computers.  The free wi-fi is nice and the location is great.  Nice place to hang out, check your email, or pick up a quick drink and a snack.

This is a great starbucks and the people who work here are very nice. I come here often and enjoy the outdoor seating. As a former starbucks employee myself I can say that they have a great crew . However, I must say though that as of this moment there is a young woman who is brand new and being trained on barista. She is extremely rude and incredibly difficult to interact with. I fully intend to take this up with the manager as her behavior is unacceptable. Multiple times she has insulted customers but pretends to be friendly when shift leaders are around. Her behavior is so bad I was compelled to write this review

Maybe they were low staff. I know Starbucks can get crazy inside but I feel like people should try their best when they can. I wanted to try the new mocha cookie drink and I asked for no whipped cream. There was a new girl working there who put the whipped cream on, when I asked someone about it they made me feel like it was my problem so o proposed a solution of scooping it off. The lady who took my order took my cup and sloppily scrapped the whip cream of. It did not look appealing at this time but I took it and went on my way. The drink wasn't ruined but I felt the rudeness.

Dear Mass Ave,

Why, oh why, do you not have a local coffee shop along your street? With so many wonderful local coffee roasters, I hope this problem is fixed in the near future. Until then, this Starbucks will have to do.

It's a tight squeeze with limited seating and seems like there is constant traffic flow throughout the day (surprise, surprise). Hands down the coolest part is the walk up window. You read that right: no drive thru, but a walk up window. Absolutely genius. Probably cuts down on traffic jams in the store during busy times of day.
Great service and the coffee and pastry hit the spot for an early wake up to fly home.   The line is long.   May be time for a larger Starbucks!

This is the Starbucks located near gate E16.  I have traveled to many a Starbucks from coast to coast and internationally.  The ladies that are at this location are not only the fastest I've come across, but also the friendliest.  All Starbucks should be trained by this team.  Howard Schultz take notice!

If you have a dairy allergy this location is one to avoid. For the past year this location has consistently ruined my latte. Every. Single. Time. Having almond or soy as a base is not that hard. It's actually common. I wonder how many times a day they actually ruin an order.

Own your mistakes. Correct them. Train your employees. I will be sick for the evening because of the milk. Thanks.

The employees of this Starbucks work for the supermarket in which Starbucks is located.  They have always made my drinks correctly.  When I came here with children, the employees were very nice and made the kids feel very welcome. Lots of free samples for the kids. Also, the employees took the time to talk to the kids and act interested.  That's what I want in a coffee shop. Good service and friendly employees. I noticed a comment from Felicia about an incorrect order. This is obviously a minor communication error. Was the mistake that bad that you needed to just award a single star?  Perhaps Felicia was not clear. Sorry, but I question the communication skills of someone who doesn't distinguish between "their" and "there."

I go to Starbucks all the time and never had a bad experience until I came to this one and noticed my drink was really light. I opened it up and my drink was more than a quarter of the way empty when I received it. I feel I should get a full cup of coffee if I'm paying for that so I went to Ariel and she was extremely rude to me and made me feel stupid for asking her to fill my cup all the way. she proceeded to roll her eyes and pour someone else's steamed milk into my cup, handed it back to me and never once apologized. I'll drive the extra couple miles next time to get better customer service

It's every single time I order here, they completely get my order wrong! But the thing is they repeat back what you want but makes the drink wrong! I ordered a caramel brûlée latte, it tastes like hot milk! No caramel flavor, no brûlée flavor no espresso etc.
This store is really nice, I'm actually surprised at the older reviews. Everyone here is friendly, I don't have any issues with store cleanliness. The staff here now is great.

I love this Starbucks and I am not alone. This coffee shop serves the community with a perfect location!   Starbucks employees are 
so capable, and service minded. They really know how to juggle the busy crazy times and still bring a sense of speed and calm. Try that combination!  Its always friendly I disagree with some of the mean comments from others. The staff does such a good job keeping it clean and ready to be used all day long. I got some personal help from Matt on the new Starbucks app. He was just so kind and went out of his way to patiently help me, a grandmother from out of town struggling with technology to get my reward!  If you haven't tried Guatemala yet its great too.

This location isn't the fanciest or well kept up and the chairs outside aren't very comfortable and there aren't enough of them. But most of the Batistas are very nice even though they aren't the fastest and on three separate visits this one girl dropped my drink when she turned around to hand it to me

This is one of my favorite locations. The baristas are super friendly and helpful. The inside is comfortable and useful with a huge table with plugs.
