There is outdoor seating available for when the weather allows. The drive thru is fast. The only issue like others have said is getting to this location from Curlew. My fix for that is to cut through the shopping center and turn right onto Tampa Rd.
Awesome! Went in to place my order, the entire staff was friendly. My drink was made exactly how I ordered it and the service was quick. Will be back!
This is my favorite Starbucks! All the employees are so sweet and they are very friendly and competent. Love!

These folks move through molasses with seemingly little sense that they work in an airport and have planes to catch.  I've been in line already for 10 minutes with little progress.  Staff need more help and need to step up their game.

Went through the drive-thru yesterday to pick up a drink for my lady. Cup was only 3/4ths full.  I did not order a "tall in a grande cup". Frustrating when you pay $6 for a drink.

Other than that, I heard no complaints about the drink.

This is a typical Starbucks. Nothing special. Can't figure out why all the neg reviews BUT my main gripe is the parking situation. 

This location is fantastic! On the way to work for A LOT of people off a main thoroughfare. And it's great that they put a drive-thru in to make it easier BUT there are definitely some logistical issues that weren't addressed in planning. 

The drive-thru isn't long enough to accommodate all the traffic so cars end up backed up onto  that main thoroughfare and it can cause a lot of honking and not so happy people. The line moves pretty quickly for the most part but it doesn't take long for it all to turn sour. If even two to three cars end up in the street, it's a commuting nightmare.

On the other hand, the parking lot is so small and hard to get in/out of that people inevitably end up parking at one of the nearby local businesses and, I'm sure, making those owners angry. 

The servers here are fast and friendly. I don't drink coffee so I couldn't tell you about that but they brew a pretty good Earl Grey.

I am not typically a Starbucks drinker but at the time I had no choice. 5 Stars for SUPERB friendly best customer service I have ever received from Starbucks. Visiting from the home state and city of Starbucks Seattle. Seattle Tacoma Starbucks locations very rude service. Thank you Meridian, Id Starbucks.

I went through the drive through this morning and girl who took my order and who was at the window, was extremely nice! It was 730am and she was so bubbly(idk how she does it) but it made my morning. Also a plus my coffee turned out great! Always have great experiences at this location!
Service for our drinks was really quick, but there were tons of little bugs crawling on everything in the bakery. I couldn't believe they hadn't thrown everything away

Work smarter not harder. The store was busy and received our drinks quickly. We also ordered two breakfast sandwiches and when we got the sandwiches both were cold. Even though it was busy, the baristas should always make sure everything is correct and up to company standards.

Very poor service. Saturday morning 10:45 AM I ordered a grande coffee and a breakfast sandwich but the condiment counter was out of sugar packets and the dispensers were empty. When I asked for 2 packets I was told I had to use the bulk sugar. When I handed 2 empty dispensers across the counter a surly manager type took them and disppeared across the lobby. I never saw him or the sugar

This was the worst Starbucks experience I've ever had. The drive thru was the slowest thing I waited in line for 20 minutes and when I finally got to the window they overcharged me and gave me the wrong drink and food items. They were unapologetic and slow on getting me the right items. Also the employees inside were gossiping about another coworker which I could clearly hear and I don't feel like it's professional at all. Don't go here unless you have a lot of time.

First off, let me say that the staff here is awesome. I have never had a complaint about a drink. It's like they all went to a Carnegie course because they remember my name and they are pretty fast considering the volume.

I'm not a fan of the atmosphere or clientele. People stand in the way of the logical pathway to the order station. The area to wait for your drink is overcrowded. I saw a Mercedes with a Trump sticker which should tell you that people inside have more money than brains.

Great staff and coffee with a poor shop design.

Had a bad experience at the Panera down the street...the people here TOTALLY made my day, not only by being so genuinely polite and helpful...but I overheard the way they were interacting with one another, and okay it's still early, but these folks are working very well together and being kind to one another...it's a rarity nowadays!! Thanx!

Good Coffee, Good Hot coco & good service. Love the location, know a bunch of former workers (who are all Cops).
Now for the bad news WAY TO SMALL.

It's always freezing, parking is a challenge (smaller than the store and one-way). You actually have to exit and come in another way to access the other half of the parking lot. Also, the bathrooms are always humid and dirty. The staff is okay.

Watched an employee named Alex pontificate loudly instead of start my drinks. Shuddup and do your job.
By the way I passed two local coffee shops that can make a better latte. I guess I'm not going to be so brand loyal anymore.
Closed during normal business hours. Sign said "drive Thur only" with the hours posted and they had the drive thru closed/blocked off during those hours of operation.

Extremely under staffed. Wait times very long for mobile orders and counter orders. Drive thru back up blocking parking lot. 

This place needs resources.
Hoooooly crap don't ever come to this Starbucks.  I have been inside for 30 minutes and counting waiting for my drink.  What a sad excuse for a Starbucks!  Corporate should be ashamed
This Starbucks has a good staff and great coffee. The only draw back is the numerous homeless that hang out and sometimes talk to themselves. No biggie.

If I could give this location zero stars, I would.  It's a cluster, 99% of the time.  Don't bother complaining, even for the benefit of those treated poorly--the management does NOT care and will make excuse after excuse about firing people, transitions, how hard the job is. Things we all know and are patient about, just not when it's the norm, which at thiis place it has become. People don't have time or motivation to complain after waiting a half hour for a cup of coffee, but please vote with your feet.

Like other reviewers, I'm not going to comment on the Starbucks brand itself, as most people have tried it and have their own opinions. I'm just going to focus on the location.

I'm not a huge fan of this location. More often than not, the place is dirty. The staff doesn't seem to make an effort to get to know me, or anyone else. If there are regulars they make the effort to continue to get to know them, but new people, forget it. They take their time with every drink I've ordered in store. While I know Starbucks places value on getting to know customers over speed of drink delivery, they seem to take longer than normal.

As far as the drive through is concerned, service seems a little more prioritized towards cars than inside, so I usually go through the drive through. Though, I still haven't gotten exceptional service.

The only reason I stop by and give money to this location is mostly for convenience for shopping in the area or hopping on 395.

I LOVE starbucks; unfortunately, this one is so, so, so, disappointing every time. I always say I'm never going back but I'm officially never going back. It's just not worth my time, would rather drive to a better one across town. Drinks are always nasty, it shouldn't take multiple re-makes to get it close enough to where it's just acceptable enough to drink. Customer service is awesome though and they are nice about remaking drinks.

Hands down the worst Starbucks location I have ever visited.  If I could describe this store with one word, it would be 'Consistent', for they are consistently terrible.  First of all, the cash handlers and baristas usually make me feel like I'm a huge inconvenience to serve.  When I come in they're usually having a conversation behind the counter, which is cool, I've been a barista and you chit-chat at work, but making me wait a minute and a half so you can finish your conversation about your friend puking all over the place at a party the night before instead of pausing to take my order really ticks me off.

Second, they consistently mess up my drink, which is a plain ICED COFFEE.  I don't know how they screw this up so regularly, seeing as it is just a cup of ice and coffee, but they do.  They always ask, "Would you like room for cream with that?", to which I answer, "No thanks".  I don't know why they even bother asking, because 75% of the time they make it with room for cream.

Today was the last straw though, when the barista called out my order, I told her that I had ordered it with no room for cream, and instead of topping it off with coffee like they usually do, she gave me a really snarky attitude and topped it off with more ice.

One of the best Starbucks I've been to. If you do not understand what to drink is they will explain it to you. Very patient employees

This location is getting three stars for simple gist of the service it's very random usually this location seems to be understaffed with even only one barista there last wensday during peak hours, not even a separate cashier , do to the under staffing the drinks end up so-so and you don't really want to ask them to remake them because it will anger the other three to four people waiting still for their little piece of joy   I couldn't wait any longer today at this location so after about six minutes I went to my car down the street to the other Starbucks see my other review and it was fast and sweet so sorry that the locations is put in that situation it defiantly gets customers and traffic to have at least three associates at all times.

This Starbucks is inside Target.

Staff here ranges from Happy and excited to serve you to unhappy to be alive.

Drinks made here do not have the same care and attention paid to them as other Starbucks have.  Sometimes they are spot on, other times they are a bit miss.

Another huge down side to this location is that you cannot redeem free drinks here. I give this place an extra star for being so convenient.  The lines can be long but if you need a pick me up while shopping... this is your spot.  No need to even go outside.
Are they trained to be rude and ignore you? Also, when you order online they are out of the item and you have to wait in line for a refund. They will destroy your day if you're in a hurry.
Not the best Starbucks. Usually get drinks right. Just off HWY 30, so quick on and off. I prefer the independent coffee shops but sometimes all that is around is Starbucks.
The guys here are fantastic. I don't think I could've survived college without them. Coffee sucks, but I keep coming back for the baristas and atmosphere.

I go to Starbucks twice a day everyday and this one's probably my favorite next to the Mt. Laurel-location. This one's just the easiest and most convenient because it has a drive-threw. The staffs always super nice and the drive-threw has a normal wait time but NEVER go inside because it will take foreverrr, FOREVER, like I've been late so many times to somewhere because I decided to go inside, never again, stay in your car, use the drive-threw, ALWAYS loll.

This location is not super busy, and seating is comfortable. However, no sofa style so perhaps designs for students or business folks that need desk space.  Also, there is no drive thru if you care for that.  The staff is very friendly and drinks are on par to Starbucks standard.

Overcharge me yet again, this time they refused to fix the issue and since the drive through had already taken 10min for 4 cars I left.

I'm sorry but kids cups of whipped cream are free at Every other store not $2.95 for a short cup of nothing but whipped cream.

Last time they told me I ordered two mochas not one and tried to make me pay for their whoops. Will be avoiding them from now on.. other Starbucks around town who don't treat customers so rudely.

, OK so every time i go to this Starbucks the black girl and yes I'm black to. with the one who ALWAYS WEAR THE HEAD WRAP! Always got a funky nasty ass attitude. If you don't wanna be there why work? And they give drinks spilling out all the fucking time. I'm spending $5 on a drink I don't need a drink spilling over plus a nasty attitude. 

Sincerely - Disappointed

This Starbucks location is always crazy busy.  I haven't seen a time where the line did not extend past the end of the Starbucks booth and almost to the nearby boarding gate.

If you are in a hurry, go around the corner to the Gulfcoast Mercantile and you can buy Starbucks frappuccino chilled drinks must quicker, if you can settle for that.

This location doesn't have hot breakfast sandwiches as well.  Just muffins, breads and cold items.

Only Starbucks I got to when I'm around my house. I stop here before work sometimes to get a skinny mocha latte and I'm always satisfied! There always friendly and cheery, and provide service with a smile and bubbly attitude! If there is ever something wrong with your drink or your unsatisfied, they won't hesitate to make to make you a new one; they are all about their customers 110%. Gotta love that coffee!

I've lived in Tarpon Springs since 2010. In the beginning, this is a very reliable Starbucks, for times like on the way to work. But in the last few years, while the service is friendly enough, speed has degraded to the point where I have stopped using this store.   Today I tried again, and and despite ultra light customer count, I waited 6 minutes to even move up one customer in line! Starbucks used to be the kind of place where you could reliably get something quality  to eat or drink quickly, but this store is clearly on island time. And not in a good way. And yes I have the app.  But when driving  (as I do for business) it's hard to use your phone safely for things like ordering a coffee.

Never seen a covered drive-thru quite like this at a Starbucks before- way cool! And that Boise sky tonight - Wow!!!

At first we went through the drive-thru. Later I visited inside to use their wifi. Shhh-  I'm a paying customer, no judging! Ha! Everything looks typical of most Starbucks stores. Clean and comfortable with easy listening music overhead and friendly baristas behind the counter. 

There was almost no line either inside or in the drive thru. But the little there was moved quickly. They made my drink correctly and fast - yay! 

Was a little disappointed to find this Starbucks apparently does not have Idaho designed products. No "I'm here" mugs or localized artsy gift cards. Darn. 

Kudos to the barista at the window for his extra patience when my cell phone decided to randomly reboot just as we were pulling up the Starbucks app to pay. Gotta collect those magic drink stars! Wheee!

This Starbucks is decent-sized and relatively fast: there's good seating inside (no outdoor seating unfortunately), the baristas are incredibly friendly, and the atmosphere is quite nice. 

It's definitely a little busy at most hours of the day. If you drop by the drive-thru, your order will be ready pretty fast; if you step inside though, you might have to wait a few minutes for your drink. Normally it doesn't take all that long.

The best part of this Starbucks is the staff -- they're so, so friendly! They are always smiling and willing to assist in any way. They're the reason I continue to come back to this Starbucks. Well done on behalf of the staff!!
Don't know why this location doesn't have reviews. It's a clean shop, pretty quiet but uber quick service! And the macchiato was up to my standard!!!
The location is very nice inside and the coffee is great a usual! The only downside is the awful parking lot and drive thru lane. Wish they could fix that part.

This place seems so understaffed recently. Whenever I go inside to order, the one employee is handling the register, food, 5 mobile order drinks for customers who aren't even there yet, and then eventually..my drink. I'm giving 5 stars for the poor overworked guy behind the counter who manages to maintain a good attitude.
Your standard Starbucks experience with one huge plus - a nice cozy fireplace. This location is typically packed with yuppies on their mac books, so sometimes seating is hard to come buy.

THis is for the location at the airport, located at Gate C, near Shulas.  Around 11, before my flight I stopped in to get a coffee. The service was mediocre, and I watched as a woman, unhappy with her morning sandwich - because As she said, it was half cold, but she ate half so she wanted a "certificiate for a free sandwich on her next visit" Clearly she's played the game before. Clearly she knew what she was doing, but the folks at Starbux weren't playing.  The did re-heat the sandwich for her, The 'Supervisor' did explain that they don't do the coupons there, that they aren't the same as a regular unit. But the lady wasn't taking that for an answer. She made the supervisor write out something on paper, not that this would be valid anywhere.. 

I bring this up because it slowed down all the service, It showed a lack of concern for the customers in general. Do I think companies should bend over backwards for customers who are running game? No. And it was clear that this lady knew the policy. She was taking advantage of things.

I wanted to get a quick drink and snack with a friend of mine today and I decided to go to the Starbucks right on City Line Avenue, but it was closed. However, close by was this Starbucks that was located in Target so we decided to stop off. 

We were pleasantly surprised to see that this Starbucks had been expanded and improved as part of this Target's renovations. However, we were very disappointed. 

On the overhead menu was an advertisement for their Mango Dragonfruit Starbucks Refresher. However, when I asked the cashier what that is she just describe it as a "refresher." That response just shows how little she cared about helping me or other customers. She later described it as a "juice", but upon researching it the drink is actually caffeinated. I think Starbucks should also train their staff better. 

My friend who I was with ordered a dark roast, but was actually given a pike roast. He was even more disappointed by how customer service handled the situation. The staff member did not apologize once for the issue and acted as if she was doing him a favor by remaking his coffee. 

I also got a chocolate chip cookie, which there were no problems with. 

Altogether, I would avoid going to this Starbucks at all costs.

I will only go here, if I really do not have choice since they have a drive thru. Don't come inside they have unfriendly baristas here. Go to the Starbucks in Virginia in the David Bridal shopping center instead, they have the best customer service in town!

I love going to this Starbucks, because no matter how busy it gets, you will always be able to find a place to sit. They have different sizes of table and it's easy to move the tables around for more seating.  This store is fully stocked  with supplies and it's all in the right places. I like that the seating area is spacious and has a wide look out. 
I also enjoy bringing my laptop here, because they have a lot of available outlets.
The staff is friendly and they always get my drink right. Sometime they take time to draw a picture on you cup. Some staff are super outgoing and sometime will take the time to chat with you.
I love sitting in there patio in the summer time. It's a great spot under the shade where you can relax and enjoy a Refresher under a BIG umbrella.
The staff are very attentive and it doesn't feel like I'm bothering them if I have a question. It's just too bad that they don't get paid more for such excellent customer service.

So glad to see Starbucks back at Five Mile and Overland again THIS time they are IN Fred Meyer's.  Being that it was upper 90's outside I was looking for a cold drink to cool me down, I also needed a few meats from the deli so how perfect the two were together.    
My experience here was as good as a coffee shop can get, I enjoyed the comfortable chairs, the design is pleasing to the eyes, and of course the star of the show my Caramel Frappuccino.  The staff was very quick in taking and executing the orders, nothing but smiles and professionalism.  I LOVE IT!!

I go to this location daily mostly because it's convenient. Service is always slow and drive thru is chaotic. Today hit the limit for me. Someone put a pump of some kind of sweetener, tastes like chocolate, in my black americano. Do better.

I am a big fan of Starbucks and will continue to go, but not to this location. I had a free reward and was unable to use as they "don't do rewards here". Shocked yes, only because I spend a lot of money with this company as we all do and to not be able to utilize rewards wherever is somewhat displeasing. Hope this will change in the future!

Hands down my favorite Starbucks in town! 

Why do I love it so much? 

- Ample parking day or night. 
- Literally 1,000ft from my most absolute favorite-est place in the universe (Weaving Dept at Myers House AKA epic yarn shop.)
- Right off the highway. 
- Less than 15 min from my house
- Near my workplace...s.
- VERY good service
- Rarely a line or wait. 
- Always gets my order right.
- Lots of space to knit and get work done too.
- Plenty of outlets to plug in.
- Bathrooms usually pretty clean.

If you love Starbucks, well here ya go.  Conveniently close to your gate so easy to grab something for your flight. 

Yup, you pay more because you're at an airport, but you need to expect that.  And if you are already a Starbucks fan, then you're already used to spending way to much for coffee.

But, I like knowing there is one close to my gate and that I will have a yummy drink and scone for my flight!!

If there was a no star for this location that is exactly what it deserves. My friend and I were in the drive thru placing an order while thee drive through attendant proceeded to joke and say that we could receive our drinks, and that he would think about making them. Clearly, a joke that went too far. He also proceeded to tell us where the road was because he told us "no" the first time. 

We tried to be kind and playfully go along, but it was beyond unprofessional. When we got to the drive thru, both of our drinks were incorrect. We were upset because if he had not been joking around, this probably would not have happened.

She told me that she heard the entire interaction because she has a second headset. Then she went on to tell me "how would I like it if someone told you how to do your job". 

I immediately realized that she had no regards for what I was saying, and I need to go further up the ladder. Horrible experience and representation of the Starbucks brand.

Love this location 
The employees make this place the best 
Customer service is superior to other locations 
Manager is top notch 
Always clean 
Drinks on target
A truly peaceful place to relax with friends
Or study

This Starbucks is absolutely the worst, Drive 5 miles 10 miles 20 miles out of your way because there will always be a line, they will only have One or maybe two people serving 20 customers and I have never been satisfied with my coffee.  So, if you really want a true review go to any other Starbucks ....anywhere!  Just not this one

I'm giving this three stars because of the location. The parking absolutely sucks! For such a busy area you would think that they would have planned for this.  

As for the staff, friendly starbucks staff. All of these folks are jacked on caffeine and make you want to be too.  I say that with the best intentions, I really do like starbucks. On off-times you can make it through the drive-through but its a squeeze. Most of the time the line backs up onto broadway...just poor planning but welcome to Tucson!

Very fast paced but the staff was very friendly and got my order right. This Starbucks is located inside a hotel and it's owned by the hotel, meaning that you can use your Starbucks card to pay, but you can't redeem the stars for a free drink or beverage. Only issue I have is that I wish this location could have mobile order. Sucks that I have to wait in a long line just for an oatmeal order. Loved how clean it is and inviting it is.
The baristas here are the nicest people! Whether at the counter or the drive thru! They are always pleasant but also they engage you in conversation they behave above and beyond what they need to!

Very cozy and cool with lots of wood.
Excellent workspace with separate room for even more workspace.

Drinks are as they should be.
Definitely one of my favorite SBUX in Tampa Bay area.

This is my favorite location. So yummy. They are always pleasant and work hard to make sure you like your drink. Also, no troubles using your app. They open at five except holidays. Also, they are doing this new thing now where if you are drinking there they have mugs to use so less trash.

By far the WORST Starbucks on the West Coast. This Starbucks is tricky to get to but as for service and cleanliness they up hold the Starbucks name!  Unfortunately nothing unique that stands out just your basic Starbucks but that's a good thing!
If you're going to go to a Starbucks in Indy, come to this one. Great staff, great execution, enjoy.
Love this location! Everyone is super friendly and drinks are always spot on! I actually avoid the starbucks closer to me and come to this one because it is so great!

Pretty disappointed with this Starbucks. I moved to the north valleys a couple of months ago so I started going to this Starbucks. This morning I went to this location to get coffee before work. I waited in the drive thru for quite some time without anyone taking my order. The time I spent sitting in the drive thru could have been spent getting coffee somewhere else. Starbucks is my go-to for coffee. It's usually convenient because it's a quick stop on my way to work. I go to Starbucks almost daily. As a result of the events that unfolded this morning, I didn't get my Starbucks, I am sipping on some crappy gas station coffee as I write this unfortunate review, and I was almost late for work :(    NOT COOL STARBUCKS...NOT COOL.

My other 97 visits to this location have been good but the fact that you were not there when I needed you this morning gives you 2 stars.

Andy goes above and beyond for his customers! He remembers my name and brought my order to my table. I notice that he always compliments every single customer on something when he's taking their order. Such stellar customer service! You're awesome, Andy!

Ordered in the drive through and got to the window. Tried to hand over money, but the Barista said, "I don't have change for this in my till, I'm so sorry."

Don't be sorry. Be a problem solver. Call your Shift over and have them use their Shift Keys to open your drop box and make some change for a customer. 0/10 for effort. Nobody on this planet will convince me that there weren't even two 20's in that entire store, hours after opening, to make change.

let me begin by saying ive never been a huge fan of starbucks. it just seems like a place to go if you want to be trendy and thats not my thing. in any case, i decided to stop there this morning for breakfast and i must say, their breakfast sandwiches are really tasty and they serve them piping hot. where things fell short was with my beverage. beverages are their specialty, right? so, i ordered an iced pumpkin spice latte and what a mistake that was. first, the drinks are way overpriced. second, they give you so much ice that theres very little of the actual beverage. i think i got a total of maybe 4 sips out of this thing before it was gone. i felt totally ripped off. the sandwiches are the only reason they earned the 3 stars im giving them. my advice, dont go there for iced beverages and if you do, tell them not to go crazy with the ice otherwise you will certainly NOT get your moneys worth. 

a huge plus at this location was the super friendly staff. they were polite and fast. big thumbs up there also.

Line painstakenly slow....being a loyal SB customer since Seattle shop first opened, you expect a standard level of service.  Like a hello, employees not shuffling around like they were out all night - a pep in your step people.   One barista was actually making my Americano and on her cell phone with her HEAD resting on the milk frother.   Bye PHL - get with the program.
Horrible. Slow and poor service. It seems like the baristas are not trained properly so they are very inefficient and don't make the drinks the same. Never will come here again.

Ordered online and got there and only my drink was ready. I asked if my other item was coming and the lady had the worst attitude about it when I just asked very nicely if it was coming. Will be returning but hopefully I have a better experience next time.
Not trying to hate.. But the black dude that works here is so rude! Good thing I was in a rush and a good mood or else I would've bitched him out. Ugh

I go to Starbucks every morning and get the same thing. There are 2 on my way to work and 2 on my way to class. I pass this one on both of those routes and have since had to force myself to NOT go to this Starbucks even though it is the closest. I spend at least 8-10 minutes in the drive thru WAITING each time and usually my coffee order isn't even right! I also always tip when there is a jar but why would I tip y'all if you can't ever get my order right and it becomes quicker for me to get out of line and go inside to get my stuff? I will not give this Starbucks another chance again and will drive to another or go to a better company of coffee shop.
Nasty. Don't know how this place has gotten good reviews. 5:00pm in STL airport. 3 people working, 2 customers ordering.  Everything from the barista to the sugar station was filthy.
This Starbucks is always quick and efficient. The baristas are so friendly here. They always make my drink perfect and if I'm looking for something new they always have the perfect suggestion.

I'm a Starbucks fanatic and I like to share the love around to all the different locations, meaning I need one around everywhere I go or I'm lost and sad, lol. Well, I happened to be heading to help out at a Stray Rescue adoption event in Fenton and swung by this Starbucks to grab a venti Pumpkin Cream Cold Brew (amazing thing!). First thing I noticed was that these weren't happy people. The staff was unsmiling and there were so many behind the counter that they were tripping over each other. Of course the lady in front of me in line was being a "not nice person" so I'm sure that didn't help. She wasn't nice when she came back in because her order was wrong, either. Karma (or was it? lol). The manager, I'm pretty certain she was the manager, made a comment about it loud enough for everyone to hear, which was very unprofessional, in my opinion. My drink, which took forever, was delicious. My experience, not so much.

My husband got two cake pops, one was Birthday Cake and the other one was Cookie Dough. If you buy two, you save $0.40. I got a small peach tea lemonade with a splash of apple juice and whipped cream! We received fast service, even though the cashier seemed to be new and in training. The drink was already prepared and the cashier was still figuring out how to apply the discount. We'll definitely come back! The only downside was the trash on a few tables that needed to be cleaned (swizzle sticks), but it wasn't too bad. The parking wasn't too bad for a Sat. and I imagine it gets crowded on weekdays.
Didn't quite listen to my order. Got my tea wrong. Drank it anyway because I was on my way to work.

I'm irate!! The manager/barista (brunette) refused to make my drink even though I've gotten it at this location before. She said "we don't do that here" I'm pretty sure it's because I'm black - starbucks is racist smh worst Starbucks location ever. AVOID!!

Do not come here if your in a rush! Slowest Starbucks ever. Ordered 2 iced mochas-nothing fancy- they had to come back to the window twice to reverify my drinks and then make them after waiting in the drivethru for 20 minutes.
I was very disappointed today. I went through the drive thru and had to wait forever~! They gave the car in front of me the wrong order not once but twice!!! I have never had to wait so long!

If this is the Starbucks at gate A, I have to say I'm sorely disappointed. Wow. Depending on who it is, the service is decent but they cannot choose slower staff to work here if they wanted to. There are plenty of green aprons around but I've never see folks move so slow. It nearly made me fall asleep watching them. 

Please pick up the pace folks. We need to catch a flight.....
You did it this time Starbucks employee!!! I made a few simple requests; LIGHT ICE and a heated crescent Nothing crazy. Well.....  too bad they're stingy. Disappointed with the service.
This is one of the best Starbucks in tampa!!! Lots of hs and college kids serving but their so nice!! Snicker doodle hot chocolate handouts??!!!! Yes please!!!

Order a venti  non fat latte and I got one with some type of sweetener in it which I tried to drink because I was on a tight schedule and had already left the area. My stomach couldn't handle the sweetener so I took it back and explained what happened they opened it said WELL you drank enough of it never apologized made me a tall and I took of sip of that it tastes strong and not like a latte 
For this price I expect the consistency I usually get and would it kill them to apologize for the inconvenience

EXTREMELY disappointed in the greediness of this (franchised?) location. 

I have been buying the Starbucks "You Are Here" and "Been There" Collection mugs, all over the world. They are priced at $12.99, as the sticker on the bottom of the mug clearly displays for all customers to see. I have over 230 of these mugs from my travels around the world and I have only ever paid this $12.95 (or international equivalent) sticker price no matter what country or state I have purchased in. The only exception to this is the Disney and Universal studio mugs are $16.95. I have purchased nearly all of my mugs at Starbucks locations inside airports.

My purchase today was for three of the mugs, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and Washington DC. When the cashier told me my total was over $60, I immediately thought she had rung one up twice, and I mentioned so. She said she only rang up three, so I asked how much they each were... She replied with "18.00 each". I told her I thought that was strange because I have been buying these for many years and I know that they are $12.95. I flipped over one of the mugs and looked at the sticker on the bottom. This Starbucks location has taken a black sharpie and scribbled out the price on every single one of their mugs!

Great service, etc. But when I sit outside I get this desolate feeling of lost-in-suburbia. I typically go on Sunday mornings and folks come in with the line occasionally creeping out the doorway. The paintings and photos inside are inspiring. The music is OK, usually. My guess is that it depends on what you're used to while sitting outside. My complaint is that it faces the parking lot so all you see are parked cars, as well as a major car intersection, i.e. Lindbergh & Clayton roads.

Great staff and service. This one is new as of 12/16, so they are still getting into the routine. Plenty of room to sit down and work or chat. The drive-thru is surprisingly convenient, but just remember to use the inside lane, since the outer is for the bank. Yes, the door is shared with the bank, not sure why others are shorting 2 stars for laziness. Oh, and there are a couple soft chairs and the nice high tables.

I love Starbucks and this location is very nice.  Ample parking and large interior.  I've never had an issue here! 

I also wanted to compliment Tiffany Mann.  Watching her interact with and manage the other employees and also the customers has been a joy.  She's so upbeat and happy, very personable.  She helped make someone's day today for a regular customer and seems to genuinely care about people.  She loves her regular customers and truly loves her job!  Tiffany is a great leader and asset to your company.  Props to her!

I want to give 1 star but I am not a jerk. We came here at 10 on a Saturday on the door it said they are open till 10:30. I get it everyone wants to get out of work on a Saturday. But the guy was talking to his friends and completely ignored us. The other guy just stood there and said he will help you in a minute. They had the entire display case cleaned out of their food. It was a horrible experience. I finally said do you have any cookies or items left. The guy that told me I would have to wait said no they sold everything. We just walked out.  The other guy was still talking to his friends.

This is the closest Starbucks to my work, and so I've come here many times. The service is always pretty good or great! There's plenty of parking, decent seating, and lots of big windows to let the sunlight in! One of the better Starbucks options in Edmonton. No outdoor seating though!

This is a pretty typical Starbucks.  I don't go here very often, but when I do, the drinks are always made exactly how I expect them to be made.  The employees are always nice and chat a little bit at the window while waiting for the drink to be done or payment to go through.  The patio is decent.  No complaints on these things at all.

Where there is a complaint, however, is that this location is very small, and the parking lot is a terrible joke.  It's on a very busy section of Broadway, where many different commuters pass all day long.  It gets super busy.  It's not set up for super busy.  The drive thru line is usually jammed packed and flowing out onto Broadway, causing a major nightmare for busy traffic.  It actually is dangerous at times.  People will flat out stay in a traffic lane just to stay in that damned drive thru line.  There's very little parking, so even if people weren't lazy as can be, there's still a hassle there.  

I wish they would redesign this location somehow to make the busy line flow better, or at least to get it off of Broadway for safety reasons.

This location is horrible! Wait time inside and in drive through is outrageous. Some of the people there are on top of their game but many of the employees are incompetent. I literally waited 10 minutes in the drive through with only one person in front of me and she only was handed one drink.
Let me say this there are definitely some employees there who are awesome but a few I've dealt with who are horrible and ruin it for the good ones.
"We do t carry non-dairy products".  Really??  35% of Americans are lactose intolerant and you can't carry non-dairy?  Airport kiosk often due harm to big brands.

Going inside is not bad, nice environment. The wait in the drive thru though, I've literally waited for 20 minutes before. Also, all of my other Starbucks have switched to no straws while they still use straws for their iced beverages.

This location is great! Very clean and move people out quickly. The staff is also very friendly! I ordered a sausage, cheddar, and egg, as well as a grande white chocolate mocha with 2 packets of sugar, 2 pumps of raspberry, whipped cream, and 1% milk and it was made PERFECTLY. My fiancé also got a grande white chocolate mocha with 1 pump of hazelnut and chocolate powder, as well as a bacon, Gouda, and egg sandwich, and he was happy with it as well. :)

Just what PHL needed. It's conveniently located between B and C terminal in the PHL marketplace, and close to the rocking chairs where you can watch the planes come and go. The baristas all seem happy, but being that this Starbucks has only been open for a week, there is plenty of time to be disgruntled like many other airport employees. One thing that surprised me though was that they didn't have their own wifi. I know the airport has free wifi, but it's incredibly slow, so I was looking forward to an alternative. Oh well, it won't keep me from coming back I suppose.

I rarely go to Starbucks- but once I a while I go to this one for an iced mocha. The wonderful thing is they're consistent. This particular location is small and gets packed. So I suggest skipping the drive thru and walking in. It's much faster.
This is one of the few Starbucks locations I am aware of with a Clover. If you enjoy good coffee it's worth the extra couple minutes.

I agree with the previous reviewers, you can definitely see a lack of motivation with the employees at this Starbucks. The cashier took his time talking to another employee and slowly ringing each person up even though we had a line of over 20 people. I was on line for 15 minutes and still didn't make it to the front of the line; I ultimately had to step off when I was at risk of missing my flight.
Line takes a long time depending on when you go. I love that they will refill any coffee cup for $1.25. It makes the coffee affordable on a daily basis
They have the best hot green tea I've ever had. Their spinach feta breakfast wrap is amazing

First time at this location and Jared made my day!  Received a Verizon free drink,  but was having difficulties pulling it up on the phone, Jared saw my troubles and said I will take care of you.   Because of Jared kindness, this will be   my Starbucks of choice, please visit this location.

The service was absolutely amazing! I went there with my girl and got 2 birthday cake pops that were absolutely delicious and I got a double chocolatey chip frapee that was amazing. Friendly atmosphere! Great place! Honestly I loved it!

Wow. Worst Starbucks ever? I had them remake a drink and they gave me an empty drink! I wanted to go back and get my money refunded but it's inconvenient for me as a customer and they are probably one of the only starbucks that does not have a drive thru store.

I love coming to my speedway Starbucks. It's a great feeling when you walk in and they know who you are and are so friendly (could also mean I go there to much  ) anyways they always look out, yesterday my drink wasn't correct and they remade it also had me keep the 1st drink (which I gifted to a co worker) and tried giving me a refund which I refused to take because they remade the drink so fast I was like no refund needed . It's always clean and nice when I go in I usually do mobile ordering but also order in drive they or inside.

Pay attention- as they can't be bothered to write your name on your cup and use it. This means no less than eight other patrons will touch your order before you realize it's sitting there. Also, my Valencia Orange Refresher was approximately 4 sips (grande) and all ice. There's a Dunkin' around the corner, do yourself a favor and go there. This place is a circus.

This has to be my all time favorite Starbucks I've ever been to. (and that includes worldwide too)

Large, spacious, and in an upscale suburb of St. Louis, Frontenac, MO.

Friendly staff, plentiful parking and lots of light and windows to have a coffee and visit with friends or do a little work.

Bravo Starbucks, make more of your stores like this one.

One of the better Starbucks I found. Newer above average size and spacious layout. A couple of extra cushioned seats. Bathrooms clean. Food case is well placed.  Plenty of parking. Easy access in and out. The usual friendly and efficient baristas. Lines can get long but never long waits.  Really not much to complain about.
A unique, one-of-a-kind coffee experience.  Nothing else like it.  Also a great meeting spot.

This is the 3rd time I've tried this location. 2 times too many. The drive through was around the building, so I decided to go in. 2 people had already ordered and were standing off to the side. I ordered, everything was good. I watched 4 people come in that had ordered on-line, they all had to wait. One order was incorrect. After about 10mins they finally call my name. I had ordered a grande and paid for a grande. I received a tall. I questioned it. The manager informed me I ordered a tall, she didn't take my order, she was reading the label. I informed her I paid for a grande. She again told me I was incorrect and I had paid for a tall, again reading off the label. She did offer to make me a tall but I wasn't willing to wait another 10mins. On top of it, I had ordered an iced drink that should have been shaken and all of the flavoring was on the bottom. If you're in a hurry, definitely not the location to pick.

Stopped by here with a co-worker after work the other day. Service was quick and very nice. I just had a cup of their iced coffee and a Caramel Frap. They had a nice selection of sweets that still tasted fresh for 4 in the afternoon. I'd recommend getting the Caramel Fraps! They are always delicious!!
Horrible!  They listened! And  STILL overcharged me!! I have a gold card and the response was "that's nice". I will NOT BE BACK!  my drink was short I got jipped!

This Starbucks is really big inside to have a more relaxing spot to do whatever you need. The staff is fast and friendly. I received a free breakfast sandwich from the manager due to a mixed up in my order. Very nice a professional. I wish the parking lot was a little consumer friendly. It's odd where front doors are from the drive thru. With small kids you must really be careful walking with them. Otherwise I still enjoy this Starbucks as it's close to my job.
Nice and cozy environment perfect for studying and just hanging out with friends and family. Food is amazing and the drinks are great. And the staff are very friendly too
Starbucks always has good customer service! The best variety menu! Comfortable and never disappoints#
I've been here several times, always had quick service. The seating area can get full at times.

This Starbucks location is so busy (especially in the mornings) as it is the only North Valleys location. It is conveniently located right next to a freeway exit and has a drive thru. Going through the drive thru is definitely quicker than going inside. I usually mobile order ahead, though. And this nearly always works for me. But when the sticker machine was broken or my drink was wrong, the employees at this location always made things right.
MorNing Crew at this Starbucks is absolutely awesome!!! Happy, attentive and great service. Plus the Baristas make my coffee to near perfection of how I like it.
Ordered a iced white chocolate moca just wanted to try something new.The Drivethrough was fast and the order taker was friendly.

Me: Hi can I have a rice crispy treat?
Barista: Do you mean a marshmallow dream bar?
Me: Bitch don't play games with me...

Typical, average, iiiight, just like every other starbucks in the world...

Sterile corporate experience 
The remodel is all about pushing as many coffee addicted lemmings through the rabbit hole. No light to read, no community bulletin board and no comfortable chairs. Get in and get out.
The staff is always pleasant whenever I come here. Which isn't very often. Unless it is during the winter season. Hazlenut lattes are unbeatable.

Very friendly staff - and apologetic.  Seems that in the mornings they are always out of the sandwich I want.  The biggest issue I have though is the lack of speed.  I can place a mobile order and 15 minutes later walk in and it's still not ready. Only once in the last month has it actually been waiting for me. I'm not sure why it's so slow all the time, there always seems to be plenty of staff working. Regardless, the staff is super friendly, I just wish things could be faster.
The worst. Rude and doesnt know how to ring up a refill. Go across the street to the other starbucks.
Even before COVID this was the slowest Starbucks in Edmonton. It is not uncommon to be in the drive through for 15-20 minutes.

This is the worst Starbucks I've been to. It's a disappointment coming here before work to have your order constantly messed up. On their iced beverages, they will fill up your cup with 75% of ice esp. if you get a venti. I usually get a venti cold brew coffee but with this location I always have to ask for no ice. 

They can't even make a simple iced Carmel macchiato right. I ask for 5 shots of espresso & my drink was a light Carmel color. I ask for almond milk and they put more milk than it should be & There was no Carmel! Im mad because I used my Starbucks reward on this drink. 

Always ask for your receipt at this location because they will over charge you. 

They don't care because it's a drive through. Welp, only the one star because it is a drive through Starbucks. 

I'm sad that I have to write a bad review on my favorite place but I'm fed up with this location.

Stopped in to get some breakfast and lunch for tomorrow. The girl at the counter was very friendly and pleasant. The service was quick, the atmosphere was quiet and people were just absorbed in their own activity. Just lounging around waiting for the rain to stop.  The restaurant was very clean and the case was well-stocked

I came to this Starbucks yesterday around 10am. I ordered a cocoa cloud macchiato in the drive thru. I had my phone out the window to pay but the girl standing at the window was talking to another girl about pay with the window open ignoring me. She finally turned to me and offered a non-genuine 'hi how are you'. When she handed me my drink she commented about how pretty the cloud macchiatos are not noticing it was obviously the wrong flavor there was caramel all over it and not chocolate. I took it anyway since I had an angry toddler in the car that needed to get home. Definitely need to be more professional at the window and pay attention to detail.

I saw on Facebook that there was a new 'secret' drink at Starbucks: the pink drink (lol not a secret anymore!). So I decided to try it...thru this particular Starbucks' drive thru. The service was really good, people attending me were nice and courteous. The line also moved fast, meaning that they were making specific orders at lightening speeds! 

Now about the pink drink..it's basically a strawberry Avis refresher with coconut milk instead of water and that makes it pink. This secret drink tastes pretty good at first, definitely reminding me of some candy from my childhood days, but after it just takes some time to finish it because of it's amazing overwhelming flavor. So it's a good bet to try it at least once before they stop making it and another secret drink takes its place
Nice and cozy environment perfect for studying and just hanging out with friends and family. Food is amazing and the drinks are great. And the staff are very friendly too.

just like a regular Starbucks, made a great iced white mocha latte :p only downside to Starbucks and all Starbucks is that the wait time for their coffee is crazy!! I waited 10 minutes to get my coffee when my food came in 1!

Hours on door and on Yelp state open at 5:30a - it's 5:49am and doors are locked. 2 employees inside that refuse to acknowledge knock or presence. Furious.  From out of town and have a 12hr work day and nothing else is open.

Made an app order and picked up. It was ready but it wasn't what I ordered. The label was correct with all the modifications but they just made the base drink and didn't do any of the add ons. For an expensive premium drink place with orders to go you have to be certain to include everything the customer paid extra for.

I love Starbucks! However I had a bad experience the last time I was there :,(. I always come in to do homework in the peaceful&quiet environment! Although the curly haired freak, the ugly makeup girl, and the budget Zoolander kept banging their pitchers, the Zoolander dude kept screaming "cheddar" was it necessary? No it was not

As previous posts have mentioned, this really is one of the best community Starbucks in Edmonton. The staff here are very friendly, plenty of seating, including eight comfy chairs and a large community table that can seat 12 people. And the new design of the parking lot makes it easier for parking.

One of my favorite Starbucks. Everyone that works there is unbelievably courteous. Everyone always has a smile and are quick to take your order.  I appreciate that they take the time to get to know me as a regular and make me feel welcome.  The place is fairly large for a Starbucks with several places to sit and be comfortable.

Wow.  4 people in line ahead of me.  Waited 10 minutes before realizing they skipped my drink.  After I reminded them no acknowledgement.  They did apologize when they delivered the drink, but the drink was terrible.  Tasted like pure milk with a bit of coffee instead of espresso.  Worst latte ever.  Wasted my money and time.

This store is in the Hilton Hotel which is very convenient for our visiting family and friends staying there. We were a bit surprised that it closes at 4pm since many millennials are night owls. Of course there are many food and beverage options in the vicinity to divert attention. The store was clean and the staff, friendly and efficient.

Place is always really busy but everyone there is really nice. One guy, I think his name is Grant(?), is super super fun to talk to. Store manager is super sweet! Overall everyone is really nice, just slow!

This is a really nice and spacious Starbucks, however I find their service to be a bit slow. I go during my lunch break and I there's usually never more than 2 people working behind the counter - 1 behind the register and 1 barista. Shouldn't there be more people working during lunch time? It would definitely help me get in and out and back to work sooner. Other than that, their quality is the same as any other Starbucks.

Does not uphold to Starbucks standards. Went in today and ordered a bagel and a coffee. My coffee came out fine but when I grabbed my bagel it was not toasted. This was kinda weird but no problem waiting for them to toast it. I asked the barista at the drink counter nicely if I could get my bagel toasted. She instructed me to cut the line where people were ordering and those employees to toast it because she was "too busy" to walk my bagel and ask her co worker to do it for her. She told me toasting her bagels "wasn't her job" so I needed to go to the line and ask for it to be toasted. Absolutely ridiculous and unprofessional. This place needs to hire some professional workers that actually care because this barista was not that. She was rude, unhelpful, and most importantly unprofessional. Disappointed.

The ladies at this starbucks in target are so disrespectful and spoke to me like I wasn't even a costumer. I asked if i could please have a java chip frappuccino and the cashier said "we actually aren't making fraps right now" and i said "why not?" and she said "Because we just aren't". In a very rude tone, and I was taken back by how she spoke to me. Then, they gave me a huge attitude about it and ended up making the frap for me.

Love the staff, love the location, and coffee is top notch!! So easy to get in and out of here if you are in a hurry, or if you're looking to study there's a lot of great seating areas and outlet plugs.

This is a busy location with a drive through. Parking can be an issue in the busy 7-9am window. Orders can take a while in the morning due to volume of orders, but you can order online and then pick up. Staff are friendly, and they do make tasty drinks!

Don't expect a Real Starbucks. 
They told me they weren't "real " but with Hilton, but I doubted it would taste different. 

The drinks are just not the same. Why?its like going to a Stbk at Target. Not the same! The ones at Disney too. 

Ordered my usual Mocha decaf with soy, do not get how it can taste so bad as if I made it at home with a cheap powder mix. 

Sad, I want to like it.... It looks the same, the prices are the same.... Great disappointment 

Not worth the long lines, very small space tho outside area seating too

I Love to come here before work, because as a teacher, caffeine is a necessity!

Every single time I have gone here, I have been satisfied.

On one occasion, the barista made a mistake in my favor and added too much espresso. Instead of throwing it out and starting over, she explained the situation, and made me a bigger drink! 

Parking lot and store have always seemed clean.
Staff seem friendly.

The service can be slow at times, but most of the time it is worth it because they are attempting to make your drink perfect....I think....if not they fooled me!!!

Will update after a few more visits.....Keep it up!

Clean and quiet Starbucks. Bathrooms are clean but you need a code to enter. 

Private parking lot. 

Drive through. 

They have an outside patio to bring your pooch with you.

Worst service I would avoid going to this Starbucks because the drive through line takes forever and even walk-ins make you wait. I usually get a black, unsweetened iced coffee and it amazes me how long they stall to pour those drinks when I see workers taking breaks and talking to each other or Even sipping on their own drinks!
One time I order through the app and walked in 15 mins later for the same ice black unsweetened coffee, it was still not ready! And I looked around there was 1 customer in line for the cashier! 
I would rather go to another Starbucks near my job in the morning, look for parking and walk in and out within 5 mins.
The city ave location really convinces me how bad management is because it's been at least a year I do not see improvement at all but it's literally on my way to work so I would rather make an extra effort to not just stand there and wait for my drink!

Sometimes the customer service is really good and then sometimes the only acknowledgment you get is your drink being handed to you through the window...depending on when you go. The drive thru line is often very long and slow but you may have the same experience going in.  This was true even before the pandemic. Maybe they just need more relief or more hands on deck.

Asked for a large coffee and they looked at me like what is that. I said oh sorry a venti coffee. Worse coffee I have had in a long time. No wonder I going there over 10 years ago. Sorry I had to try it again.

We've been here three times as of this moment in the last month and haven't been able to get the pbj boxes. I'm not sure why they are on the menu if they aren't something actually carried here. 
Makes no sense at all.

Could possibly b the slowest Starbucks in all the civilized world. No sense of urgency what so ever.. one young lady just standing in corner w a goofy grin on her face with a line to the door. Seriously 3 people on a Sunday morning on mass ave. And what's purpose of walk u p window if u don't utilize it?

I come here in bursts; sometimes every day in a week, sometimes once a week.  Each time the employees are friendly, kind, and accommodating. I can count on enjoying a relaxing environment while I complete work on my laptop.  Thank you guys and gals!

Unless you are a regular guest here the customer service is terrible. I have high expectations for Starbucks' customer service because I worked there for 9 years. What happened to me today would NEVER happen on my watch. 

I don't frequent Starbucks anymore because I know what is expected of them and they don't deliver. Today I was treating myself to an eggnog latte. I forgot to say no nutmeg. I told the barista after I got to the window and she said "I just made it" and "make sure you tell us no nutmeg next time". She didn't offer to remake it. She just handed it to me and rolled her eyes.

Yea, it was my mistake. Guess what though? I have remade countless food items and beverages because the customer forgot to mention something. It's called Legendary Customer Service for a reason. I did not receive this today. 

I will not be back

This place is a $hit Hole! There is literally no other way of describing it! Do not stop here for Any reason in life! Avoid at all cost besides the drinks not being right! The service is terrible! ThIs is probably the worst yelp review i have ever written about a place!

Called at 5:59 a.m. to order box of coffee to go along with pastries for a board meeting. (I actually was only going to order the coffee but the associate asked if I wanted to add pastries--YES!) My order was taken by a pleasant and helpful young woman named Emily. It took all of two minutes. Awesome!! The Dunkin Donuts across the road won't even answer its phone or return calls--so it's Starbucks from now on.
Came for Veteran's Day. We thought it was one of the nicest locations we have been into. Super friendly staff. Planning on coming in again soon :)

This location is the worst Starbuck's - not because of the location but because of the staff. I have given this one several chances and they either mess up the order or you wait forever. I will just go to me regular one who does a much better job

This store is nice store. I was be there many times. These girls were very nice and friendly. Only one thing that was letting me felt "do they really know the 'meaning of grande'". I was ordering the same orders by couple days which was fine. But, today (02-09-2020), they gave the funny orders which were green tea part. Am I wrong? Or we both were misunderstood each other by the meaning of "grande". So, that's the side by my understanding.

This location is great! 

It is a very clean location and the staff seem to work quickly and move the lines and people out quickly. 

It is a normal Starbucks like any other one. The staff were friendly when I went in and were happy to accept my military ID and give me a discount on my purchase. 

The coffee was tasty and I also had a muffin that was pretty good. 

I would come back to this location because of the staff being so helpful and friendly.

No drive-thru but the designated 15 minute parking on the front parking lot for your "grab & go" convenience is pretty noteworthy. The interior is a large open space with lots of seating & nooks for studying in solace. There is even patio seating available for nice weather days. Service is pleasant and the cafe is both well stocked and well kept. 

I particularly enjoyed the artwork.
~Christy

When you are from Seattle, it's hard to have patience for the baristas in other areas of the country... I was the only person in line and my drink still took forever. I asked for blonde espresso but received regular.  And there was barely any caramel in my caramel macchiato. Not impressed.

I can always count on this Starbucks location to be timely and to make what I'm feeling like that day, even though sometimes I don't know what that is myself. This morning, I was really wanting my go-to Hot bevie, but it's technically out of season. "Not here, my friend," said the barista today... though not in those exact words. :)

I have had nothing but satisfaction at this new location. Quick, efficient, never messed up an order. Today however, is a different story. The drinks were satisfactory, sure. But what came through the straw of one of our drinks was appalling. What I thought was maybe a remnant of blueberry was in fact a piece of rubber. It was the most unsanitary thing I have seen from a Starbucks. I sincerely hope this was a one off and nobody else at this store encountered such. We will not be coming back to this particular Starbucks that is just minutes from my home.

My chai tea just taste like steamed milk and it took 15 mins just to get it. Every time I come here it seems like it taste forever and now the drinks aren't even worth it. Next time I will try to go to the one in gate 17

I have been to this Starbucks twice, specifically to get my Starbucks whole coffee beans ground up and the staff is just amazing!  They are always friendly, courteous and happy to help.  Last night, however they really went above and beyond.  They were grinding up a 1 pound bag of Starbucks coffee that I received as a Christmas gift and the bag split down the side.  They alerted me of the issue right away, salvaged what they could of the spilled Christmas blend, and gave me another free pound of coffee which they ground up for me as well.  I realize that it's part of the Starbucks culture, but it is so nice to be treated as an important customer when you are spending your time and money at a business.  This location, just gets it!  Thank you for another great night.  I've been telling everyone how great the staff at the Dale Mabry and Linebaugh drive-thru Starbucks is.  :)

In order to function as a human being I require coffee. Strong coffee. Starbucks will jolt a horse. I like this. 
A coworker told me about the chestnut praline syrup that has limited availability from now until February. To say I'm in love with this is an understatement. 
If I'm wrong about the February timeline, please tell me since I am now obsessed. No other flavor will satisfy me. 
Drive thru here moves pretty quick. Staff has always been nice and the prices are a touch high. Welcome to Starbucks. Who cares, give me my grande chestnut praline iced coffee!

I used to love this Starbucks but lately they've been getting my order wrong every time I go. One time they gave me Splenda and 2% milk when I asked a soy vanilla latte. Today I placed a MOBILE order for an Iced Quad Vanilla Latte with soy milk. The soy milk is settled at the bottom and there's NO vanilla syrup in it. It just feels like no one at this store knows what they're doing. I understand they're busy but it is EVERY SINGLE visit, no matter the time of day. These drinks are not cheap and no other Starbucks I go to in the Tampa area does this. What I love about Starbucks is the consistency of what I'm going to get and this store is missing the mark.

Wouldn't let anyone other than Barista DeLayne make my drinks! She is the best! Quick & always accurate she does it with a great smile . She also makes great recommendations on the newest or holiday drinks for me to try. A perfect cup of Starbucks is the best way to start the day.

Slowest Starbucks ever. Was at Philly airport on Memorial Day and needed a caffeine boost. The baristas appeared to be in no hurry to get the drinks made. Thank goodness I had time in between flights. Otherwise I would have been very frustrated by how long it took for my order to be made.

I am not a Starbucks person but I do come in for tea sometimes. I have often noticed when in the Broad Ripple location that they have the absolutely nicest/best team. They are so happy, polite, professional and make you feel so warm and welcome. I like this location so so much. I come in when my daughter is at DJ class. Good stuff.

Wow.  Talk about nasty attitude from female named "Callie".  She seriously needs to get another job that doesn't involve dealing with people. 
She also got my order wrong... Can't take an order and has a nasty attitude.
Closed  at 9:45pm Thursday. They are not open the hours advertised. Beware don't waste the drive.

Staff was rude. They also charged me extra to have my iced coffee sweetened. When I questioned the extra .50 charge, she claimed it was a new Starbucks policy. Seems strange since having an iced coffee sweetened was part of ordering an iced coffee just yesterday at a different Starbucks. What's next? Charging extra for caramel for a caramel Frappuccino?

I'm happy that there is finally a drive thru Starbucks. Great location and close to where I live which is awesome. I love the open space inside. There is a mix of high top tables with low tables and sofa seats to sit on. I like how everything is spread out including the food items. Everything is not jammed packed together. 

This location does need to hire more people. They need a person who handles customers ordering inside and one designated 1-2 people handling just drive thru. When I go though the drive thru it's not much of a wait but when I came inside there was a very long wait because the barista was handling inside and drive thru customers. Drive thru order where being served a lot faster then the customers inside waiting for their drinks/food. They were out of a ton of stuff because no one has yet to go through the boxes and open them to restock items. 

I like this Starbucks but they really need to hire additional staff especially because they have a drive thru. Being that this is a drive thru location they can expect more customers because of the convenience of not having to get out of the car. You need the staff to make sure both customers inside and outside are getting their order efficiently and timely.

As a renown employee I would think that the girls working at Starbucks would be professional and NICE but they are so rude!! They will give you attitude for the most unnecessary things. Savannah is probably the rudest baristas there along with all the other young girls!! They gave attitude because my coworker and I got coffee today and white stuff started forming around our caramel drizzle, we weren't sure if it was expired milk or something was wrong with our caramel, so we asked if there was a way we can get it remade and she was so rude about it.

I used to work at a Starbucks. So I know what what a triple espresso looks like. The batista gave me a double and tried to pass it off as a triple, after I asked her to make it again she refused. She had long dirty blonde hair. And the man upfront tried to charge me to put milk in my espresso when I wanted to add a little myself at the sugar counter. Wtf is that, it's always been free, I felt like they were going go charge me for sugar too! I will not be back.

I'm basically a fan of all things coffee.  We stop in here when we are on our way to the farmers market or getting in an early workout in the area.  I've never been disappointed after visiting.  I enjoy the lounge space at this location.  It's very cozy.  The area where you order is very small and tight (it gets very busy), but they move you through pretty fast!

This Starbucks has decent space inside, but the drive thru is probably the slowest ever. I always hope it will be different but I just spent 25 minutes in a drive thru to get an iced coffee, and there is no exit once you're in the line (so I couldn't leave or change my mind to go inside or elsewhere).

I understand busy times, but almost half an hour is excessive.
I used mobile ordering my order was ready in a timely fashion the staff was friendly. The store's social distancing setup was efficient and easy to follow

This store closes whenever it feels like it and doesn't update its hours. Can't tell you how many times me or someone I know has come here during normal business hours 3pm on a Wednesday 7pm on a Tuesday and they just are closed out of the blue! Waste of time and gas . When they do decide to open they are insanely busy so be prepared to wait.

double blended with an extra dose of love. This was my second time at a starbucks today (shhhh) the wonderful Erynne assisted us via the drive-thru. She was super accurate with our orders and asked if i still wanted whipped cream since my base option was non dairy - so many assume i don't, don't give me any and i actually always want extra lol . We stan a lovely accurate barista. You know your employee is great when they impress during a short visit! :) .

I really really like the Starbucks but I think that they should make a kids meal because I am a child and I really like Starbucks and so does my brother and sister It's right around the corner from my house so it's very convenient on the way to school or summer camp but when I think they should add in the kids meal is a Z bar, a cheese stick, a cake pop, and whatever drink people order but I really do like this Starbucks every staff member is so friendly
This Marriott is overall nice and convenient in its location to the convention. My low rating is for their choice of this Starbucks management, who were rude and unprofessional in handling costumers.
It's Starbucks what can I say.  The service was quick and they gave me exactly what I asked for.  This location is small but inviting.

Typically, my experience with Starbucks is perfectly fine. However, I wasn't too happy with this particular location. Having Starbucks inside Target is convenient, but I was disappointed by the slow service. This was surprising because it's not really a busy location and there was only one customer ahead of me.

In addition to wait, my simple drink order was messed up. When I informed them that they gave me the wrong size, I had to wait even longer for a new drink and the barista did not express any apologies for the inconvenience. The next time around, I'll probably just go to another location and bring my drink into the store to enjoy as I shop. I hoped to give this place the benefit of the doubt, but it looks like other customers had negative experiences as well.

Busy. like Starbucks is generally busy - but this place is hopping on a Saturday. However, there are plenty of seats and tables. If you want an outlet (this might be tricker but doable). But friendly staff, quick, and I do like the atmosphere where you want to get some work done for a few hours.

This Starbucks is exactly what you're expecting: Sure, the coffee is overpriced. But you'll probably like it just the same. It's got a nice atmosphere. Clean and quiet. It's a nice place to kill an hour on a lazy day.
This location seems to NEVER have more than one cashier and one barrista so, the line is always out the door and down the concourse. I'm currently in line with over 30 people!!!!  GET IT TOGETHER!

This Starbucks is still just a solid 3 Stars. They get the job done, but without any extra pizzaz in customer service. 

I stopped in to pick up a Grande Cold Brew before my class over at the Apple store. The cashier was very dry, to be honest I do not remember her even thanking me or ordering. The wait for my beverage was minimal, considering two others were ahead of me in line. The young lady who presented me my drink, did thank me for coming in. So I figured, it was her job to say, "thanks". 

I wish Starbucks would go to paper straws or the new lids that are like a travel mug and do away with the plastic straws. 

Will I return? - Only if I am taking a class at the Apple store. 

When: February 27, 2020
Why: Liquid refreshment for class

Two stars goes to the awesome employees they have working . All are super friendly and nice , and hardworking . However they are always out of coffee , and basic foods they sell . This goes back to pre covid . 
I expected more from the coffee giant . Maybe promote one of hardworking employees to management so they can order properly and be fully stocked with coffee.
I've come here for a while with no issues. The only complaint i have is that the parking lot sucks. Besides that, I still come here a few times a week without complaint.

I can't believe the person who manages this store still has a job, for that matter I can't believe the district manager still has a job, this is by far the worst managed cafe I've ever been to.  This afternoon I stop in for a brewed cup of coffee and what's this?  Starbucks doesn't have any coffee?  What the hell is wrong with the world when Starbucks doesn't have any coffee?

I wish they would fire all of the upper management at this store and hire someone with actual experience in running a cafe successfully.  At least make sure coffee available for purchase.

Thanks for wasting my time as I waited in line only to walk away with no purchase since there was no coffee brewed.  At Starbucks.  The only thing you serve is coffee, can you stop messing that up please?

I ordered in advance for my wife to get her Venti Iced Apple Crisp Macchiato before work. When she arrived, the drive thru and lobby were packed (to be expected early in the morning). Her order was ready, but her drink was made wrong and they were too busy for her to ask for them to add the missing components. Plus, she was on her way to work. The drink only had the cold foam she asked for but no drizzle, they were out of blonde shots, almond milk, and oat milk. The drink also did not contain the pumps of apple spice flavoring they were supposed to have. Needless to say, I heard a mouth full about the drink. I know they can't always control the amount of orders, but they can be sure they are serving the drinks accurately, especially for the price many of us pay.

Why is it that no one here can make a simple cup of tea.   I always get a London Fog.   Ingredients:  Earl Grey tea, vanilla, foamed milk.   Simple.  You would think.   All I ever get is a cup of tea.   Difference, besides the vanilla, about $2.00. If I wanted cup of tea I would have asked for a cup of tea.   My last time here.  And I was a daily customer.   Sad

This is my favorite location on the Westbank, a zillion times better than the one on Terry Parkway.  The employees are super nice and friendly, and they remember my drinks and ask about my day.

The atmosphere is good, perfect for work, study, reading, or light conversation (inside voices and no screaming children... usually).  They were recently remodeled, and I'm going to be an old fart and say that I liked it better before.  They added a "community table" (that's what I call it), which is long and sits a few people at the one table.  As someone who cherishes personal space, I'm never going to sit there.

Now that I've finished whining, I do enjoy this location, and I appreciate the pride that the employees have in their store and work.  It's mega-obvious, especially when compared to the craphole that is the Terry Parkway location.

This afternoon after the Colts - Dolphins game, I went to this location to order two iced coffees. The two people working there told me there was a colts "daily double" special going on, where you paid double the normal price and it went to the colts. I argued with them for 5 minutes until they finally admitted they were kidding. There were customers waiting behind me and the two Starbucks employees refused to let go of their joke until a few minutes had gone by. I hope corporate Starbucks reads this and has a discussion with these employees. This really changed my opinion of Starbucks as an organization and I intend to share this experience with all of my friends.
My favorite Starbucks in the city.  Great chaise lounges in the back that are perfect for snuggling on with a good book on a cold day.

This is the only coffee shop at Renown (spoiler alert) and the management here does not staff appropriately. I am a huge fan of Starbucks and my  complaint for this location is how long the lines are and how much time you spend waiting for your drinks. Oh.... and the staff is definitely not your typical Starbucks people. They don't smile often... or at all. It must be a "Renown" thing. Not a fan of this location at all!

Got  Sweet Iced Coffee today for Lunch 
Finish drinking and find nice fat fly inside my cup .. Called store and they offer for me 
refund and 4 dollars off next Drink .. They should offer me something else 
I said thanks and suggest keep checking cups they serving before making some drinks 
Watch your cups People
