Gave me a regular medium roast coffee when I told them twice that I wanted a medium roast ICED coffee. Also, the cup was filled to the brim and leaked out underneath the lid. Just another reason why I'll pick Wawa or Dunkin over Starbucks 10 times out of 10.

I know you never expect good service in an airport, but this was terrible! The staff were unprofessional arguing with each other and then talking poorly about the customer in front of us while she was standing right there.

This summer I have been obsessed with Very Berry Hibiscus tea! If you like raspberries this tea is for you! I am not exactly sure what they do to the raspberries but they are pretty amazing! 

Covid precautions: masks are required, social distancing enforced - markers on the floor

I get coffee here almost every mornings. I can say that every morning I get a different experience. The place is very small so it can get very crowded in the morning or at "coffee" peak hours.

What I can definitely point out is that 9/10 times, they won't consider the customizations of your order you made (if mobile order), if it's anything else than the milk type. I've had order with no whip cream at all on my iced mochas when I requested extra, lots of ice if I ask for light etc...

Overall I can point out that often they get the order out fast though. People at the counter are friendly and will redo your drink without asking questions.

So I don't get it.  I order the same thing every time I go to Starbucks, no matter which Starbucks I go to.  I always get the Grande Soy Misto with 2 Splenda.  However, no matter where I go, it seems I am charged a different price each time.  This Starbucks consistently doesn't charge me extra for soy milk.  Yay!  I'm a fan :-)
The drive thru is clutch!  I find the staff friendly and professional.  Having this option in the area has been good.

I just had the single greatest drive-through experience of all time. I pulled up to the window with my Siberian husky, Major, in the passenger seat. As soon as the first employee saw him, he was showered with love. They made an announcement so that everyone else could come see him and say hi, and they even gave him a "Pup Cup" of whipped cream. He's a rescue and has always been wary of treats, but he loved his Pup Cup! Anyhow, Major got the superstar treatment at this Starbucks, and you can bet I'll be coming back here whenever I have the chance!

This is taking way too long. You would think the staff would be trained and able to handle a large weekend crowd as there is a "captive audience" at the hotel. Or that the management would be cognizant of special events and schedule enough people to maintain a reasonable throughput. We've been waiting a half hour and it looks like a half hour more to go. Would give up, but it's that point where you've waited "this long" and feel the need to stick it out.

Lousy service here and our barista had no clue what she was talking about. I asked if the Double Chocolatey Chip Frappucino had coffee as I don't like coffee and she said no. One taste and I knew it had coffee. Barista said "it only has mocha syrup," apparently unaware that mocha is coffee + chocolate.

Meanwhile my husband ordered his drink with light ice and was given one with extra ice. The (second) barista gave him attitude about making it as ordered, and even still it was really normal ice, not light. 

Management and/or ownership needs to work on customer service and product knowledge.

This location is large, well-lit and well-staffed. It has an automatic door, a drive through and ample parking. I was quite pleased with the speed of service when I visited and purchased a sandwich and beverage. I would certainly consider sitting and relaxing here with a beverage or food item for some time as the space seemed comfortable. The staff I interacted with seemed personable and kind. They were very polite and helpful.

So my wife and I were thirsty so we made a quick stop by the local Starbucks location at about 7:15-7:30pm So as we walked into the emptiness of this store which kinda shocked me but I was able to see why, as we approached the counter the employees were not really engaging with the customers as they were talking amongst each other for roughly a few mins of standing there, there was no recommendations made, no upselling or anything out of these three whom were all about themselves. Now I see why the store was empty, now after we got up to the front to order this happen.

My wife doesnt go to SB much but she loves a certain drink (Vanilla bean frappuccino with a fresh banana an caramel drizzle) but as shes ordering the guy behind the counter was kinda a prick or A-Hole towards her when she asked about the sizes because she doesnt come here much he replies with an asshole tone "Small,Medium,Large will work" wit a stupid look on his face. She then asked for a Vanilla bean frappuccino with a fresh banana and without waiting he then says "We dont carry bananas no more" without letting her finish or saying excuse me he just interrupts and goes off but instead of recommending something else or something he just goes back to his conversation with the girls there. 

Yeah with that type of customer service and this way to treat customers I'm not gonna waste my money nor time with this bull..sorry to be negative but when your treated like crap, you tend to be a lil sour.
Not the best starbucks in the area. I went to this one only twice, but I would not go back.  The service is bad and the drinks are just ok.

I absolutely hate to be this person. But as I was ordering drinks for my coworkers, I mixed iced/hot up until I got two drinks in my hand that were opposite! So I politely asked if they could remake them (knowing very well that I might be hated for it). But the baristas were SO nice and SO accommodating and did not make me feel bad at all. That is what I call 5 star service
What's not to like about Starbucks!!! Yummy!! The only thing I can think is that they are a bit expensive. Staff is usually friendly and it's clean.

Poor service and blah baristas today. Line was 7 people long with 3 uninterested baristas working the front counter. I ordered my usual grande iced tea poured over a Trenta cup full of ice and was advised they were out of all Trenta sized cups. No "I'm sorry we're all out."  Just a matter-of-fact statement, "We're all out."
 
Disappointing to say the least that there exists such a vast inconsistency in the local, individual Starbucks stores when it comes to staffing guidelines, product availability, and barista friendliness/customer focus.

Was really excited when this Starbucks opened because it was so much more convenient than the Glasgow location.  Was hoping as time went on, they would work out the kinks and get in a groove.  Couldn't have been more wrong.  I almost always have to repeat my drink order 3 times because the person taking my order is also making drinks.  They are constantly running out of something...brews, cups, etc.  Today my egg bites came in an oatmeal cup.   I thought it was oatmeal so I circle back and go in only to be told "we were out of the egg bite trays..we should have told you".  They never have enough staff and the drive thru takes forever.  Find another Starbucks on your route and skip this one.

Start off the morning.   They didn't have two of the breakfast things I order this morning!    This was the case yesterday morning.  I will not be back.   A big store like this can't keep up with orders I would be finding out what the problem is.

Came in today while shopping at Target.  Ordered my coffee and also needed to purchase a gift card for my brother in law. I was unaware that you could not use your Starbucks app with all of your money loaded onto it to purchase a gift card. The very young blonde haired barista was completely obnoxious and rude when she explained that "You can't do that!"  I was embarrassed and the specialty drink that I ordered was mildly warm. I'll continue going to the Starbucks in Exton from now on.

I used the Starbucks App for the first time to order ahead, and my coffee was waiting for me! The staff here are all super friendly and nice! Whenever you want to try something new, they are very helpful with finding your next favorite beverage!

It's a typical location, but the baristas need a bit of time management control.  That will come with time.  For the most part pleasant staff, but they really seems to have way to many personal conversations in a customer service setting.  This was a much needed addition to PHL.

There are a couple of nice workers but the manager is a bitchy slug of a human being who shouldn't work in any restaurant or any other customer service based industry. All I wanted was a water and she told me to get it myself and then proceeded to roll her eyes and grunt when I asked for a cup. You work at a Starbucks bitch, that's not my fault you're miserable I just wanted a drink ‍

The fat white girl wears looks, which is very racist, and she treated me with contempt because I am not an American. 

806 Manhattan Blvd
Harvey, LA  70058
United States

They were kind enough to let me use their restroom even before know if I was going to buy anything. It required a code to get in so I had to ask. 

That said , I did purchase a cold beverage and it was made quickly and it was delicious and served with a smile.

It's Starbucks.

Drive thru experience: This location seems to be incredibly quick. I did order a turkey pesto panini. The turkey tasted  bad. It made me wonder if they had checked the date. I had to toss the sandwich away.

The coffee's were good. The barista was quick, kind and very nice. I can't seem to remember her name.

The location is nice as it is before a freeway entrance. It makes for easy access. Plus it is far enough down that it is out of the construction zone.

i got  a sandwich here (if you could call it that) with like two tiny slices of mozzarella, some measly pieces of basil and tomato.... and mostly bread. i mean it was good bread but $6!!!???!!?!?  there was no protein or any oomph to the sandwich. i mean tomatoes and cheese arent that expensive.... 

also ordered a drink i hadnt ordered before and messed it up when ordering. upon rethinking it, the counter person adjusted it at my request but when i got to drink it i realized it was filled almost an inch below the top. i would rather have them put some foam on top to make it full at least. 
anyway.  pastries were good here, and i liked that it was a drive through.  very convenient that you dont have to stop to get your coffee, especially when you are in a hurry.

This is a great location--close to Marker District and Mathnasium. And it's one of the only Starbucks with a drive through in the area, so that's a plus. 

The inside is nice with a lot of seating. One of the nicer interiors of all the local Starbucks, and it's fairly good sized. 

The staff doesn't seem to be in much of a hurry, and it sometimes takes forever to get your drinks. And their food selection isn't great. 

But overall, descent Starbucks.
It was 7:52 when I want to this Starbucks on a Saturday and they fu** up my order twice

I frequent this location. All the baristas are great! They always get my complicated order right, and never have a problem grinding my coffee beans when I bring it in. I appreciate you all. Thanks for the great customer service, and thanks Indigo for making my morning today. If you're looking for a coffee shop that feels like home, this is it.

Today's service was absolutely terrible, I received so much attitude from the barista. It was absolutely unacceptable. First my mobile order wasn't ready when I arrived despite placing the order ahead of time. My drink was not made properly. I ordered a venti "shaken" berry sangria tea. The barista didn't shake the tea in the shaker and gave me attitude when I asked her to do so. Once given the tea a second time I realized it didn't have any berries in it. I said isn't this drink supposed to have berries and an orange slice in it. She took the tea from me poured it out all while giving attitude. When she began to make a second tea I said never mind I'll simply take a refund. I informed her it wasn't my job to teach her the proper way to make the drink as I didn't work there. Continuing to give me attitude I asked for a manager or their contact info. The barista mumbled under her breath and talked about me in the headset to her coworkers. The barista eventually gave me a contact number for a "manager" however no name was given. I asked for a name and the barista mumbled a name. I had to ask another barista to write the name on the paper. Absolutely the worst Starbucks experience ever and I go to Starbucks daily. This particular location was  first for me as I am new to the area. I will not return ever.

I've been to this location, inside the airport, many times while on trips to Philly. I love Starbucks because the experience and choices are always consistent. -This is my go-to when I'm trying to be as healthy as I can, essentially "on the go" while traveling. I can get an oatmeal, some fruit and a black coffee and I'm as happy as a clam.

First time coming to Nevada, and wanted some Starbucks. Stopped by the closest one and I ordered a caramel macchiato with extra drizzle. I also ordered some egg/bacon bites. Got to the window they didn't have them, and they gave me the option of getting egg white bites (never again). They were not good what's so ever. Do not recommend. And they didn't put extra caramel in my drink. Couldn't even eat the egg white bites, they were just not it.!!!!

First off, having a Starbucks in the hospital is a great idea. 

Second, it's a horrible idea to have badge pay in there! I think I've spent a little too much because I lack self control when it comes to starbucks and with a swipe of my badge it's paid for (yes, I know, its my own fault). 

I understand Starbucks isn't everyone's favorite, but I do enjoy a wonderfully made flat white. Unfortunately it's impossible to get a flat white here that tastes even half way decent. On the rare occasion that I work at the downtown Renown I always like to stop by and grab a coffee but the last 3 times I have gone in and ordered my beloved flat white it has been terrible!! Usually it's smooth and not bitter and although it has no syrup in it, it's strictly espresso and milk (I prefer the coconut milk, it gives a little different taste), it has a little hint of sweetness but it seems the espresso is always burnt when I order one here so the smoothness is taken away and it just tastes like a burnt cup of disgusting. But I do Choke it down because I need that caffiene. I have decided I will not be ordering this particular drink from them. 

Overall they have good service, the wait is longer here than in other starbucks I feel, but it is convenient to be able to stop and get coffee here rather than make an extra stop on the way to work. Now if they could just make the flat white correctly.

A perfectly fine Starbucks. Every time I've gone, the service has been quite slow considering how there are not many people when I'm around, but the baristas are polite and the store is clean, so I don't mind a wait for my caffeine kick or sugar rush!

There's always a long line wrapping around the building, because the baristas like to screw around instead of doing their job. I know this for a fact, because we go inside instead of waiting in the drivethru. It needs to be fixed.
I can't believe how long it took to get the coffee, it was literally ridiculous. They need more staff. The coffee was ok but no point if I have to wait more than 20min.
They need to figure out how to serve customers that only order a pastry.  It's not rocket science!

Absolutely terrible! Don't know how this location is still open. Waited 40 minutes for a simple iced coffee and ended up no being able to drink it due to how horrific it tasted between the inch of sugar and coffee grounds that were in it.
What can I say, it's a Starbucks. I needed a pick me up while I'm waiting on a layover. My latte helped me feel human again lol. Only regret after drinking my coffee, I'm feeling hot now lol.

4 stars for amazing employees but lost a star for literally never having oat milk. No matter how early you go, never there. Stop advertising it. Dunkin always has oat milk so I think this is where Starbucks falls behind. It's not that hard to find oat milk.

Yes, they were fresh out of Cold Brew at 1:29pm on a Tuesday. I went slightly postal in the drive thru (in a nicesty sort of way). I mean there's really no valid reason why a coffee establishment should run out of coffee EVER. It's non perishable for goodness sake. 

4/5 stars anyway simply because Caesar was an amazing sport about it; maintained a very patient, pleasant attitude. He made recommendations to satisfy my craving and greeted me with a big smile as I pulled around to the window. 

Moral of this review: GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE makes me weak. 

PSA: SBUX, prep according to popularity...everybody loves Cold Brew duh. 

~Christy
Grabbed a peppermint mocha and peppermint mocha Frappuccino while shopping on Mass Ave. As always it was delicious, the staff were very friendly, and we had a nice break from the cold.

I have been a "gold rewards" member for more than a decade, and I have been to virtually every single Starbucks locations in the area multiple times!  That said, I don't know what in the hell goes through my mind to make me return to this particular location!  IT IS AWFUL!!!  They almost never get the order correct (I get plain iced tea-- how difficult is that to screw up), and the wait times are horrific!  I don't know if there are staffing issues, if it's an incompetence problem at this particular location, or what it is, but somebody needs to address this problem.  Every other Starbucks in this area can handle crowds just fine-- I know there have been managerial and other personnel changes here, but this place is an utter DISASTER!!!

Ordered a traveler coffee box for corporate event. Staff was friendly but not very well trained. The coffee was ready for me on time which is amazing! But I had to wait a bit in order for them to call a manager on the phone because they (any of the 3 of them) didn't know the cost of the traveler. 
Once I got back to the conference room I attempted to pour a cup of coffee, however as soon as I started to unscrew the spout lid on the container, coffee poured all over my hand causing a burn. It was about a cup of coffee that spilled out from the screw spout. Making a huge mess obviously. Apparently they filled this thing to the brim while vertical which caused it to overflow and almost become pressurized once placed in its normal horizontal position. 
I've ordered these travelers dozens of times, from dozens of different Starbucks across the US and never had this happen. Between this and the lack of knowledge on the price, it might be safe to assume these were new employees. 
On an extremely busy convention weekend, leaving new hires to fend for themselves is pretty messed up for them AND for us. 
My hand is throbbing and swelling so I'd like to give negative stars and even sue for that. But I'll get over it once the pain stops! The girls, unprepared as they may have been, were completely sweet and tried their best. It's unfortunate for them that they were left alone, without any seasoned help to get them through this insanely busy weekend. They deserve a couple stars for their effort.....but OUCH!!
Every time I try and get a cold brew in the morning they never have the cold brew ready.  I guess the night shift should make it and they never do!  Someone needs to manage this store better.
food was good (mediocre) service was not good at all, should have been way better at best sub par
I grab my work coffee everyday here. The staff is super friendly and personable! If you're looking for a quick pick me up, this is a great spot!

I went to this Starbucks for the very last time today. This Starbucks has not been in the area that long, (maybe 2 years), and they have raised their prices 3 times already.  My usual order (tall hot chocolate and banana bread) went from $5.81 to $6.37. The cups have gotten much smaller, but the prices are getting MUCH HIGHER.  That's it for me.  I'll drive a couple lights down and go to the Starbucks in Target from now on. The same order is  still about $5.81 there. This kind of sucks for the employees now because they will probably not receive as many tips.

Fast, friendly service right next to the Convention Center and Aloft Philadelphia Downtown and across the street from PAFA. I tried the pumpkin cream cold brew and it was delish. Check it out the next time you're in the area.

A typical Starbucks. Fast friendly service. Coffee is great! Always consistently great!

Only glitch was they were out of Pikes Place coffee beans.

I was so happy to see a familiar friend open sonearly for my flight home. The baristas that were working at 5am were so friendly and worked quickly to get each of us waiting in line taken care of quickly and getting us caffinated for our trips. I ordered a venti blonde cinammon dolce latte and it was delicious.
My girlfriend and I ordered cups of coffee only a quarter of the cup was coffee the rest was foam and Air worst 15$ I've ever spend.

Can't ever seem get the to same thing twice every time I get my usual it's great but always different in some way from how much they use to what they use constantly hoping from milk to water very disappointed in them lately

I never thought to do a review for a chain like this, but I've come to really appreciate the quality this store offers. The employees are always pleasant, and orders are made swiftly and correctly. I had gotten used to the quality at the location on Valrico & 60 which is... subpar. I now drive the extra 15 minutes to go to this location instead because the experience is unparalleled!

They ALWAYS mess up my order at this Starbucks location. Sometimes they give me the wrong person's drink entirely, other times they just put the wrong syrup, milk, etc. The staff is relatively friendly but that doesn't count for a ton when the orders are always wrong. As a side note, the location is extremely awkward/inconvenient. You have to come in by making a right turn on dale mabry in order to get into the drive thru line. If you come through the other entrance, you have to add a 2-5 minute detour down the backstreets so that you can turn onto dale mabry going south and get into that one entrance.

I grabbed a coffee at this location 2 days in a row. During my experience, I was SO impressed with the customer service. I interacted with 4 different employees, and each one of them went out of their way to be friendly and accommodate me. One of the employees actually waited by the to-go bar and handed people their drinks as they came in. Another employee was sweet enough to keep and eye on my purse for me while I ran to grab something. Their friendliness is what makes this Starbucks feel like a community coffee shop, and is the reason why I keep coming back. To top it off, the coffee is always good! Go Starbucks on 4th! You guys rock!

This is the worse service I ever received it took twenty-five minutes for two drinks. The drive thru was busy so I decided to get off and order going inside thinking it would be faster, I should have just stayed in my car. There was only couple people inside. It seems that they were not organized. They had five people making drinks but it still took forever. They got my drink wrong and it was going take another ten minutes to make me a new one. I left very unhappy and won't be coming back to this location.

What can I say about a place that is nearly identical to ten thousand others? No drive through, that is a plus for me because I don't have to be second priority to those that stay in their cars. 
Comfy and separate relaxing room to watch the rain and Broad Ripple. 
Very nice, helpful, and professional staff.

Awful.  I got overcharged; I ordered one drink, but I ended up with two and paid for two.  She was frustrated that she would have to give me a refund, and swore that I ordered two drinks.  But I did order a sandwich that I never got.  I had to ask the barista for my sandwich.  I'm always at this airport and will not get Starbucks again; they are not representative of the Starbucks brand.
The lady who sold me the coffee grounds was super nice. The fact that she was so sweet makes it easier to chew my coffee this morning (see pics).
Absolutely hate this location. However the one by St. Joe's University was crowded and I needed to get some work done. It's not the cleanest Starbucks nor the coziest but it will suffice.
This is one of the finest Starbucks stores I've ever been in. Great location and the service was awesome!

Literally half a cup of coffee ! I always get this order and it is a inch maybe an inch and a half less then the cup . This is absolutely ridiculous the line takes forever and not to mention you have to repeat yourself numerous times in order to get what you want. Never coming here again !!
I love the people who work here - always friendly. Great location in the heart of downtown and this location will only get better when the new buildings are finished.

Ordered through the app and received my nicely made cappuccino as promised within 5 to 8 minutes even though there was quite a line inside.  This place shares a parking lot with a First Watch so parking is VERY challenging.

Nope they really gotta get it together !! How do you forget to make oatmeal not once but two times in two weeks ??? 3 weeks ago I went no muffins ?? I'm done going back down the street to meridian even tho it's out of my way !

Great friendly service. One of the better locations I have been to. Patio seating outside where you can sit with your doggie and soak up the Florida sun! This place has been our coffee spot as we transition into our new home here in Tampa, Florida!
They just renovated this location and it's beautiful! Speedy and friendly service left me smiling. :]

Love coming to this Starbucks due to its close proximity. I have a favorite seat because it has a big table and outlets readily accessible. If I don't sit here, it's pretty tough to find a seat with a lot of space and an outlet. My drinks have been made correct each time I go here. Great place to do work.
Didn't have my typical order of blonde roast, but employees were friendly and fast. Location was in the lobby of our hotel, but clean and bright.

I'm not a coffee drinker, but I love this location. 
The staff is very friendly and I love the inside of place is awesome. There a long bench with charging posts (USB) and lots of maneuvering room. It's in a great location that Speedway has done a fine job developing!

I've been to this airport more than once now and each time, I'm tired and groggy. This time was no different, I just got off a red eye flight, connecting here. Came here for some coffee, line is really long and really slow. Coffee wasn't correct, frappucino wasn't correct, ah well. Went to sit down, limited seats, charging station didn't work. 

Moving to another part of the airport...

Super quick and friendly service today, and my customized drink came out absolutely perfect. Better than it is at home sometimes. The baristas today were on their A-game. Exactly what I need before I embark on my flight!

You can also purchase Saint Louis "You Are Here" mugs at this location as a good last minute souvenir.

This Starbucks just broke my heart. I know that they were super busy and I can actually empathize because I used to work at Starbucks, but they totally botched my drink. I ordered the s'more frappucino. They used the wrong whipped cream, minimal chocolate, and used too much base which causes the drink to be too runny. The whipped cream was also lumpy. What a waste of almost 6 bucks.

This Starbucks has the best employees! Everyone is always so welcoming and nice! I drive a few extra miles just to come here! Thank you for your delicious coffee, impeccable customer service and great vibes!!

Extremely rude older lady with blonde hair running the drive thru. Argued with me over making my drink wrong after she made it wrong twice, and I WATCHED her fill my pink drink HALF with WATER. Won't be coming back here again. Management you need to take a look a your employee.

If it looks like a Starbucks, acts like a Starbucks and tastes like a Starbucks then it's probably a Starbucks.  And this my friends, is a Starbucks.  Not really a whole lot to say if you're familiar with the franchise.  They got my order right, it was clean and I enjoyed my experience.   Work a stop if you need some caffeine.

Not to crowded today but that varies. Employees were friendly. I ordered my pre flight caramel machiato and a pumpkin bread. Bread was rich with pumpkin flavor and heavy. I want something to last through two connections!  Napkins, straws, and extras are on a different table so you are not holding up the line getting your coffee.

I do not usually rate 5 stars unless everything is excellent. The service is 5 stars one of the best Americanos I have ever had. They treated me with respect and answered all of my crazy questions calmly and comfortably. The atmosphere is calm and inviting. I travel A LOT and have NEVEr been more satisfied. Thank you guys and gals for an amazing experience!

I always order the same thing at every starbucks I go to and the quality is always always the same...except for here not only was the wait stupid but the place is filthy which makes you think the sanitation of the blenders ect is the same. I could have gotten better service and better coffee from McDonald's. I ordered a vanilla bean creme for my boyfriend and it's just an expensive fast food milkshake. The last one he had was delicious from the Lemmon valley starbucks so idk what the deal is with this place in particular

Came to this Starbucks right by the cherry hill wegmen's on 10/30/17 to study. There are plenty of tables and chairs to study. About 5 comfy sofas. Staffs are very nice and drinks are consistent. Though I feel that sometimes it is understaffed. 

Importantly this location is not very crowded which I love. I almost don't want to write a good review because I don't want people to crowd this Starbucks.

Typical Starbucks.   Lots of people there on Sunday morning mostly getting takeout.  Large communal table, smaller tables and high counter seating at the window.   Service was ok.   No receipt offered.  This is in a huge shopping complex so parking during shopping season will be insane.  The fact that they are at the end of a row of stores helps with parking.
Good central west county location.  Would like them to remain open past 8:30pm. 'Outdoor seating' means 2 benches out front.

I end up so broke by the time exams start, so I really crave that Frapucino at Starbucks to help make it through the day. Sure the worker forgets that I asked for whipped cream or chocolate syrup around the side of my cup, but I learned to just ask for extra mocha powder. That cancels out the fact that I don't have whipped cream or syrup on my drink.

This place is pretty packed when exams start popping up, so I wouldn't go here to find a place to study with a friend. Chances are there are no seats left or there is just one for just one of you. I've gone a couple times looking for a place to drink coffee and study but I eventually gave up. I enjoy the iced drinks they have here.

Rudest Starbucks ever! You say how are you and their too much in a rush to reply! Drinks are always messed up. Employees never in uniforms or aprons. Always out of items and things. Employees are mean! Not sure why some still work here how they've treated customers.

The  barista did not know how to make a candy cane frappuccino, which is on their main menu.  For the past two times, my card has been declined there and only there,and it's kind of embarrassing, and inconvenient, because I have to charge a coffee to a credit card, when there are funds on my debit card, starbucks just can't read the magnetic strip. The employee was rude when I asked her to run my card again.  Called the bank, and they said there is no reason why my card should decline at starbucks, and this is the only place it does.  I love starbucks, but it's not worth the hassle and inconvenience, so I won't be back.

Tonight my Starbucks app wasn't working at all I wasn't able to change my password ah a mess. I already ordered my drinks and didn't have my credit card on me. I'm a regular here when I'm in town. They were super nice and gave me the drinks for free. I wish I had cash on me. Such a friendly staff and always excellent service. Definitely my favorite Starbucks in the area.
Smaller cups,yet they are more expensive than the Starbucks down the street. I paid 83 cents more here for my usual order.
The atmosphere is nice but the staff was not helpful and did not take my name. They appeared new or understaffed as they did not know what I asked for. Not what I expect out of Starbucks.

This is a nice Starbucks that you can get a coffee or tea at before you meeting or seminar at the Hyatt Regency. 

Great little place to get something to tie you over before you have a long day. It's also good to stop at to get some juice during a break as well. 

I like the decor and the ease at which I can get something to drink. 

I recommend stopping here when you need a quick drink or small snack.
Every time I go here, I receive my order very quickly and the staff is always exceptional! I've never had a problem here.
The service is pretty rough at this location. Especially the drive through. If you're in this neck of the woods and need a coffee, definitely make the stop... Just don't be in a hurry.

I love this Starbucks. It's very clean and close to UCSB (especially my office). They have a new mobile order window that makes it easy to pick up your order since the shop can get pretty crowded. 

Sometimes, I'll go into the shop to order if I don't k is what I want. I recently saw the dragon drink featured on the menu, so I tried and now I'm hooked!! I'm glad that I can now order it on the Starbucks app and have it waiting for me. 

This Starbucks team is so helpful too. They always make my drink right and they're always very nice. I don't know how they do it considering how crowded the shop tends to be.

You know,  not all Starbucks are created equal hence why they have 4 on each corner of the street.  You don't like one,  go to another,  right? Well, I would unless I was at a conference and not trying to walk in the rain. So, the only good thing about this Starbucks is that it's connected to the convention center via a skywalk.

So, I trudge over there each morning and order the same thing, soy latte no foam. No biggie, no major frills but I guess these baristas do not understand no foam nor filling it up to the top. 

I normally order a tall and have gotten used to the weight of my drink. So when I order a grande, due to the long conference,  it should weigh much more since it goes from 12 to 16 oz. It SHOULD but it doesn't. In fact, I think it almost weighed less if that's possible. I opened my cup to take a gander and the first thing I noticed was how low the foam came up my cup. I would say it was about an inch below the top.  Then, why is there sooo much foam? I understand that soy is different and it will foam later once it settles but seriously,  I do not think this barista did anything different from normal.

So, I went back up and asked her kindly to add some more soymilk since it was not full. Well, she did but she filled it with the cold soymilk. So I asked if she could steam it first. Hmm...so when she does pour it in, I swear she poured in about 4 oz more of soymilk.

So, if you must get to a Starbucks AND you're at the convention center and want convenience,  this'll do.

Just as a previous poster mentioned, the wait time is long. We waited in the drive through for approximately 14 minutes to get two coffees. 
When we got our drinks, both were done incorrectly and one drink had more mocha on the outside of the than the inside. You could see fingerprints on the cup from the mocha mess. I'm really blown away that we were given this cup with the mess all over it. We had to ask for napkins and then another cup to put over top so we wouldn't get the mess everywhere. Ultimately, we threw it away because it tasted terrible. I think the staff may be new or maybe they're not thoroughly trained. In any event, horrible experience. I don't recommend this Starbucks.
Great place, great workers,  friendly and quick service! I come here all the time! ;) The parking lot gets a little stupid at times, mostly because stupid people can't drive.

Starbucks is known for its flavorful blends and deep roasts- so the flavor and quality is always consistent. This store is set apart by the great staff and their amazing ability to work together! I picked up a quick latè on my way to the Dry Bar and from start of order to drink delivery I watched a seamless dance of the baristas who were very busy making magic behind the coffee bar! 
My drink was great (as always expected) but the staff was great!

Possibly the worst Starbucks experience I've had thus far. The barista had zero knowledge of the drinks she was trying to make. Got my drink wrong twice. When I asked for a cup of ice she said:

'I'm really busy right now ask someone else unless you want to wait 10 minutes" 

Everyone behind the counter heard this and simply rolled their eyes at the situation. Meaning it must happen on a daily basis.


Will not be returning to this location until there is a complete staff turn over.

Daisy, along with all of the other girls / boys working today around 2:15 are so sweet. Lisa, I believe the manager is a sweet heart and so accommodating and is quick to fix issues or assist with any questions / needs / concerns!! I love this location and will forever only spend my money at this Starbucks, it's so hard to find a Starbucks with customer service this good. Definitely worth my 5 star rating. These workers need raises, working this hard through covid-19 and and still giving great customer service through a mask!!!  keep it up guys, you're doing amazing!! Thank you for perfecting my drink!

Love this store. It's so clean and the staff is so nice to me! Lisa is a very sweet woman and she is very accommodating! I didn't like my drink cause I got something new and it ended up not being something I really fancy and she was very sweet about me changing my drink out even while they were busy. I know it might have been kind of inconvenient but she was so sweet about it and made my new drink an it was perfect. She has a bright energy and she's a hard worker.

Starbucks in Wynnewood is amazing. 



Rebekah, Andrew, Aliyah, Allyson, and the team is amazing. 

So friendly and welcoming. 

I applaud this team. 

I work in Public Relations and have been in service industry for years. 

By the grace of God I am sober and Starbucks will always be on of my favorite stops. 

Gail Walsh
AG Agency

I have been waiting several years for a Starbucks to open in this location. Right on the corner of Terrace Road and 101 Avenue.  So I waited a while after it finally did to post my review. 

 Now first off, I do love Starbucks, but I am not one of those customers who are in there every day, or necessarily even every week.  And I am not happy with every Starbucks I go to, especially drive thrus.  As I am one of those people who never get their coffee the way the recipe is made.  That is one of the reasons I like Starbucks, It is never a problem to ge my drink customized. I find that most of their coffee drinks are too sweet for my taste so usually get them half sweet, and often have to customize the milk due to dietary concerns. And due to chronic migraines & doctors orders have to have decalf now :(   I have never had a problem with any of these customizations when I have gone in to a Starbucks, however, drive thrus can be another story.

Speaking of customizations, their Grande Hot Chocolates have; 4 pumps mocha & 1 pump vanilla.  Try it with 2 pumps mocha and 2 pumps vanilla, it's good!  Everyone I have suggested try it agrees.

This Starbucks has been open for a few months now and I am very happy to say that each time I have been in, the service has been great.  I have been in at different times of day (but not early morning yet).  They have been not so busy to very busy when I have been there and the staff have always been pleasant.  This is something to say as many of them are new to Starbucks,

Every time I have gone in I was happy to see that they are getting busier and busier as this means (I hope) they will be around for a good while to come.

I was disappointed that they have extremely limited equipment for sale as I was looking for a burr grinder and they did not have any. But this was probably due to the fact that they are so new and have not established any retail sales yet.
A nice environment with pretty friendly staff. Too expensive to go to every day, but a nice occasional treat!

Worst customer service. They have a system where online orders and in person orders are mixed in at the same time so they end up prioritizing the online people instead of the ones right in front of them. I ordered two drinks at the same time and one came out in 3 minutes and the second came out 15 minutes later. Before the online system if someone had stood there for 15 minutes they would have asked what was wrong but now they just don't care.

I get coffee here once maybe twice a day sometimes and they started my order like 5 minutes later and no one was even in the lobby and it didn't taste good at all like my coffee usually has the last 10000 times not a happy customer

Honestly April has consistently given me the best customer service over the past couple years. Even when there's a drive through line going out of the establishment she still manages to keep a positive attitude and deliver outstanding customer service. I've really never gotten better service anywhere else.

Where have you BEAN all my life? With this being the closest Starbucks to work, this place is most definitely my savior in a cup. I'm a caffeine addict and am truly obsessed with Starbuck's green tea matcha. I'm in love with a plain black iced coffee just as much as I love a green tea frappacino with soy, caramel around the cup, extra matcha, and whip on top. Don't forget caramel on top of the whip too! Reeeefreshing, ladies and gents!

Messed up two drinks out of a two drink order. Brought drinks back to be remade, handed them over and told them what was wrong. They said they would remake them. 10 minutes later I come back to the window to see the same drinks sitting there not remade. Very disappointing service.
This cafe is always clean and the baristas are friendly. They are quick and efficient with orders. It's Starbucks, I got a caramel frappe and I loved it.

This Starbucks 
Is one of the slowest around. 
I'd know since I've been 
To most 'Bucks in this town. 

I hate to having to wait 
If there happens to be a line. 
So I always order through the app 
To try and save time. 

Usually when I arrive,
My drink is not ready. 
I need my coffee!
It keeps my nerves steady.

the night lady in the drive thru was rude as can be. 
I hand her my $$ and she proceeded to toss my change in my hand.... and i said thank you, no response.
I get handed my drink and i say thank you... no response to that either.
Drink is alright. I asked for extra java chips and received none.

During the day though, the staff is amazing. Drinks are always on point. Never had an issue with them so im giving it 3 stars.

This place gets really crowded at certain times (I.e. Early morning). The service is pretty quick even when there is a line of 10-15. Plenty of seating in and outside the store front. There are two Starbucks in BNA and this one is located just outside gate C-10. 

They make all your traditional favorite Starbucks beverages.

Hannah serviced me at the drive thru today and she was the most unpleasant person I've dealt with at a Starbucks. I was very polite and clear in my order and she couldn't understand what I was asking for and after repeating it back to her twice, she became very short with me. It's sad that this new location didn't exemplify the great Starbucks customer service that the company as a whole usually gives. I doubt I will return.
They are the best they didn't have what I ordered , they replaced it but not only that they send me a cookie with my order. Thanks keep it up.
Jessie made the best Irish Cream Cold Brew from any location i've had! Loved the service

This is easily one of the slowest Starbucks that I've ever been to. 

I place my order online every morning, as I'm usually pressed for time to get to work, and mobile order is supposed to be convenient. I learned early in they are slow so I started ordering even earlier, allowing them 10-15 minutes before I even arrive. And they STILL don't have it ready when I arrive. Even though the app usually says 4-8 minutes (should probably keep that updated better). 

And the people working are typically super rude if you have the audacity to ask about your drink/food. As if it's my fault that you're taking 20 minutes when it was supposed to be 4-8. 


Just too slow, with bad customer service. I'll be taking the extra five minutes to drive to a different one from now on.

Service is exceptional here.
The barista took great care with my order and asked before making changes to my iced peach tea to allow room for ice.

Clean location and really appreciate the drive thru.

This Starbucks location needs to be shut down. The service was poor before the current Covid-19 situation. Now it's even worse they take forever to make drinks, long lines in drive thru, ultimately only to get your order wrong. They Ignore you at the speaker until it's time to close. Avoid this location at all cost!

At 10:30 the drive thru was packed and slow. The employee working the drive thru was slow and I had to ask for stir sticks/stoppers for the 2 drinks. That was odd, but not too bad. 

What was bad you ask? Having to ask for my change. I handed her my cash and was expecting almost an entire dollar in change. She took my money and said "Thank you. Have a nice day." 
My response, after starting at her for a few seconds... "May I have my change?"
Confused look from her.... "Uhm... yeah. Uhm... how much was it again?" 

I don't know if you expected the change as a tip or just had a brain fart, but seriously... GIVE ME MY CHANGE. You didn't deserve a tip after making me wait as you screwed up my order, took your time on my order and then neglected to give me change.

I'll skip a return to this location... at any time of the day.

I have never been in such a loud and uncomfortable Starbucks. Not only were they blasting hip-hop/rap at full volume. They decided to ignore my request to turn it down and make rude smirks from behind the counter. it made me incredibly uncomfortable and unsatisfied I traveled across town only to spend 6$ on a shit experience and disrespectful customer service.

Very clean and mobile orders are held instead of being out in the open. The employees were all upbeat. 

Could use bit more light inside. Outside of that it's your standard Starbucks experience. One of the better ones in the area, in my opinion.
Here for another job, amazingly quiet on a Father's Day, the girls here were extremely nice and helpful but even though it was slow they were keeping busy. I love it when it's slow and not crazy.

I happened to arrive back in town for the friends and family opening.  It was SUPER crowded and the excitement was felt in the air!.  All of the employees were doing an awesome job to keep up with traffic.   The barista who took my order made sure it was correct and even spelled my name correctly.   I met Chris (manager at this location) through church.  I am very excited to say welcome to Speedway Starbucks!!!!  This is in a great area.  There is a ton of seating with a wide open wearhouse feel.  The bench along the wall across from the counter is very comfortable with charging stations built into the bench.  There is a spot for a USB plug as well as regular outlets.  Near the front of the store there is a large conference style table and cozy looking chairs.  I hope the town enjoys this new addition.

Wow spacious!

The new place looks cool, serves quickly, and has plenty of room for activities!  While other coffee shops aren't able to accommodate more than a couple people but I'll be inviting a whole crew here. 

They've still got the new-opening kinks to work out, like training their staff to be friendly and acknowledge people, but I'm sure they'll get the hang of it. I'll be back for sure.

Its a Starbucks what else can I say. It has a great location and is always busy. I usually only eat here if I am given a gift card to the place. It's just due to the fact a black coffee is 3 dollars there and I can make the same at home for 3 cents.

The products served here are not up to par or in line with the level of quality and taste that other locations provide. It seems the staff is new, there is confusion when you order a standard drink and there are many mishaps.  Examples would be failing to mix all of the ingredients in a drink so you have to be the one to mix the ingredients - without a tool or accessories.  Another example is that sometimes when you order a flavored drink, you will not get any syrup so there is no vanilla in your vanilla latte.  Sometimes it takes ten minutes at the cash register to simply order one standard beverage.  Not sure when this will improve, it's been that way since opening, very grateful to have a Starbucks here.  However, improvement is much needed and customers like me will be even more loyal.

Ordered Venti Cold Brew - can't do that
Ordered Frappuccino - can't do that

Employee - "as you can see, I'm the only one here"

Worst service I have every encountered!   If there is not enough staff to do it right, then close this shithole down!!

For an airport Starbucks this one is always super efficient, well staffed and friendly. You may see a long line but do not fret as during peak times they have 2 registers going and kept things moving. Due to customers are all flying don't make this your time to spend 10 minutes perusing the menu when you get to the counter. Do that while in line to keep things moving!

This morning I went through the drive thru at around 8:50ish. The girl who came over the speaker was very snooty... I didn't mind, but when I got to the window she was again super sassy. Like she was annoyed beyond annoyance.... in that, I accidentally drove off without my drink because the way she was acting really bothered me, that I just wanted to leave. So I go inside to get my drink... and super annoyed she hands it to me with so much attitude, like I ruined her life my by mistake. On top of that, I accidentally forgot my mask.. (because I was focused on my mistake & late for work) to which she scolded me for not having.... like I was a child who was caught red handed in a very bad act.  Whoever this girl is, she should be on mop or stock duty.. or find another job where she isn't interacting with customers. Usually the service is great here, but after today... I won't ever go back there. I didn't get her name, but she was either Asian/Hispanic with fake blonde hair... be aware of the negative Nancy! She's more bitter than the pikes brew!
These guys are awesome! Super friendly and super accommodating for unusual requests! The manager here rocks! Thank you!

This is my favorite Starbucks in the area! The employees are always so incredibly sweet and I've never had a bad drink from here. You can tell that the baristas make each drink with care. Thank you guys for everything!

This location is ALWAYS so busy....but we like coming here as it's the closest drive-thru for us when we get our Starbucks cravings.  The staff is always so pleasant at this location and makes an effort to strike up conversation when at the window waiting for drinks to be ready.  I am totally addicted to the Guava Green Tea Lemonade (no sweetener) and my daughter loves the Pink Drink (blended).  If you've not had the Guava, I highly recommend!!  I've gotten some of my friends addicted to this drink.  I think it's just the best and so refreshing and so pretty! :)

This is a nice location. I come to this Starbucks almost everyday because all my classes are online and it's nice to drink coffee while I work. It is always clean and for the most part quite. Out of the all the Starbucks in this area this is my favorite one to work at and study. I took off a star because I literally come here everyday around the same times and the baristas still don't know who I am and they usually seem caught up in talking to each other. But at least they always get my order right.

I used to be a huge coffee shop snob, but I keep coming back to this Starbucks location because the employees are so cool.  They're super nice, chatty, and remember your name after a few visits.

The new re-design is nice, too.

One star off for parking... but that's the price you pay for a conveniently-located shop.

What a nice friendly Starbucks.   Used my free coffee on my Starbucks account and my bf ordered coffee and a scone. This location is friendly, has lots  of comfortable seating and easy in and out parking lot. Great music which I find to really add too the ambiance. 

It would have been nice if they had a full menu with a description for those who don't know the difference between latte ans cappuccino.

This is usually my favorite Starbucks to go to but today I noticed there were two new faces and while I was ordering through the drive thru i started ordering and as soon as I would start ordering I heard one of the baristas mocking me and making a small a noxious noise and it was really annoying. I stoped talking and it would stop but as a started to talk again the noises continued. I hurried up and just ordered my drink. Annoyed at this point I was about to just drive off and not even pay for my drink cause of how rude they were. I pull up and decide to just pay for my drink and I see it's a light skinned black male and a white girl with super long hair in a ponytail and as I'm waiting I hear the guy taking someone's order and the white girl is the one MAKING THE ANNOYING SOUNDS I WAS HEARING WHILE ORDERING. These people are not professional whatsoever. And after I got my drink I looked in through the drive thru window and the white girl gave me the dirtiest look. For no reason! Maybe cause I'm cuter than her? Haha and also my strawberry refresher tasted like straight water...STARBUCKS PLEASE FIRE THESE KIDS
The coffee is ok. Not great. But the staffs are 10/10. Always make my day. Guess workers are reason I am coming back.

They are taking Covid-19 protocols seriously. They added plexiglass by the cashiers and they are enforcing everyone to wear their mask properly. They opened up about 3 tables recently. Their bathrooms are still closed. The staff here is really friendly and they're all hard workers. When they are busy, everyone seemed very focus and organized. For how busy they are, they are very efficient. For the amount of people they have, they get the drinks out quickly. If you come here during the weekdays and if it's around 7am to 8am, I suggest to do a mobile order. Order 15 minutes in advance before you arrive, to ensure your drink is done when you get there. Sometimes they get slammed and there's usually a really long line in the drive thru. If you weren't aware, you can also add a tip on the app, by viewing your receipt. Select the dollar amount and click done. I didn't know this until recently. I think Starbucks should ask if you'd like to leave a tip before checking out. This way, it's visible to everyone.

Allyson was so sweet! She was able to give me a drink that I absolutely LOVED!! Nice clean store with enough space for covid spacing! Barista who prepared this drink was great... they were all organized and working together
Great location, I've anly had good experiences here. Closest bux to my in-laws house. Typical pricing and drinks. Great employees.

This location is usually fine, the parking lot and drive thru is a logistics nightmare, but my experience today was beyond frustrating. I spent a literal hour in their parking lot. They ran out of grande and venti cups and were having to split all large drinks into smaller cups. I completely understand the challenge and backup, but when I got to the drivethru window after 30 min only 2 or my 3 drinks were ready. I was asked to pull around to the back door for them to get my latte. I waited there for an additional 30 min!! My sleeping toddler was in the car so I couldn't go in, I had to step out and flag down the drive thru attendant to remind her that I was waiting for this drink. When it came out some 5/10 min later it was not correct (I ordered and paid for a flavored latte and got a plain), and my husbands peppermint mocha that I was bringing home was a cold oily mess, but I didn't have any more time to straighten it out. The original delay I understand, but I sincerely think they forgot about me and I was not pleased to wait an additional 30 min and now have to rush to get ready for my event tonight. I understand the staff was frazzled, but would have appreciated a more substantial apology.
My first time to do a drive-thru for my coffee. It was a long wait but worth it just to get my caffeine fix. And I got a free car air freshener! Yay!!!
While I usually prefer the drive up locations, it's nice to stop in and chat with the Barista's.
Wow this place is huuuge! Very nice chill spot. Loved it and need to find a reason to go out of my way to go there. The drink i had was amazing. People were nice too

I live in Panther Valley, so this is my nearest Starbucks. I did frequent it to  work on music promotion before I had internet at home. Its a bigger location (on the inside), but I am not a fan of the parking lot. The Lemmon Valley shopping center it is occupied in, has a very congested parking lot. It is not Starbucks fault. The drive thru was placed in an odd direction.

Pretty clean atmosphere. The panhandlers are there quite often, though.

i just started coming here and for the second time in a row they took 15 mins to make my two coffees and i i usually stop by when i know i have time as my job is 3 mins away. they took my payment and left me there waiting for a while and ended up being late.... not reliable and most likely not going back.

Unhappy employees in the morning. Drinks in drive thru always made wrong. If I order a blonde coffee, I want coffee not a watered down americano Bc it's faster. 

Night employees so cheerful and nice! They definitely had their coffee haha!

Depends what time of the day you go
Before 10am (1 star)
After 5pm (5 stars)

On the good - this Starbucks is HUGE, having started its life as a fast food seafood place (the one named after a pirate).  On the bad - the parking is a mere suggestion and it can be hard to get in and out of this location.  I've used the drive thru many times with no issues, but recently met up with a group of friends to play board games.  We took over the long table near the registers and had a fantastic time.  A few other customers stopped to ask about the games we were playing and we invited a few to join (they declined - maybe they saw the "serious gamer" gleam in our eyes).  It was a lovely afternoon.  My only complaint was that the air conditioning was set to slightly arctic.  However, I never travel without a hoodie so I survived pretty well.  Of course, the freezing temps gave me a chance to add that their restrooms were sparkly clean - so very devious, Starbucks, but thanks for keeping the loos in great shape!

At 5:45pm, this Starbucks is dirty. The trash bins are overflowing and staff is checked out. One Male bearded barista was counting money as I came to the counter and after a minute never looked up, never acknowledged, so i went to the bathroom. After coming out there was a customer before me. I was next and I was still not acknowledged. I had to present myself to the barista, who only claimed he was waiting for me. It's the worst service I've ever received. I've never seen staff throwing away breakfast stuff already as customers are ordering. I will not be returning to this location.

This place is sooooo slow and works their drive thru before mobile orders. I've been waiting for 15 minutes for one drink. Now I'm late to work!!!! No to mention the girl working the counter looks pissed at the world. Get it together Starbucks.....: I need my coffee to get through my day!!!
New management has worked wonders for this Starbucks since my last review.... Some of my favorite baristas work here. :) it's a great place to study, if you can find a seat!
By far the worst Starbucks. Lines are always long and drinks are often wrong.  Often out of nitro and regular cold brew and even if they're not they always try to get you to order something else.

Starbucks literally never disappoints. If I want a guaranteed well made coffee drink and an awesome slice of iced lemon pound cake, I know to just spend the extra money and come here. Every time I try to cheap out and go somewhere else I end up throwing it out and making the extra stop. Thank you for always being consistently great which is so rare in the "fast food" industry now a days!

The gentleman who took my order was delightful and friendly.  Perfect.
No one in the store except foe a couple of people at tables near the back of the store.  I was waiting for my drink and sat down.  There were signs but there were signs on the tables where people were sitting.  I thought no biggie. So I sat down and then was lectured that I wasn't allowed to sir.  Rude.  When I asked why there were people at other tables I was told they worked there. How was I to know that. It was not necessary.  I'm tired of these kids being bossy and rude.  She could have been a lot nicer. Also, suggestion: Mark your tables EMPLOYEES ONLY.  In the midst of all that is going on and the tension in our world you can't let someone sit for 3 min!

The layout seemed odd to me when you look at other locations in the area. The store was clean and felt well stocked with lots of cozy places to sit. The staff didn't seem all that friendly and couldn't have cared less that we came in. Though the staff seemed anything but super friendly our drinks came out fairly quickly (one person made both) and they were correct.

Reading these reviews made me realize people only take the time to comment on things like this store when they've had a bad experience. ANY Starbucks you go to is going to have moments where you catch baristas at a bad time. 
Needless to say, every time I've come to this Starbucks I have been greeted by the baristas behind the bar with a "Welcome in". Anytime I am indecisive about a drink the baristas always work with me to help me find something that I'll love and then let me know that if I don't like it to bring it back and they'll make me a new one. They are so friendly and make an effort to get to know me. I highly recommend this Starbucks to anyone looking for a quick drink.
Clean store. Friendly workers. Not too busy on a Friday morning. Outside seating available.

My least favorite Starbucks of all time. Yes, I get that it's in IV and they're busy all the time, but they don't have to be so rude. The cashiers are ok.. The price tag for the food I got was wrong and she charged me more than the price tag, but today I ordered my regular drink which I get weekly and it came out wrong. They asked me if I know what the drink is supposed to taste like so I let them know that it's been my regular drink for years. My milky drink came out tasting fruity. So they remade it for me and they messed it up again so I suggested that the teas might be made wrong or mixed up and the girl was rather rude and impatient with me. She insisted that she didn't do anything wrong and would make it again. They made it 3 times and my milky drink came out tasting like strawberries. At that point I didn't want to have to deal with their hostility anymore so I just left.

This new, larger drive thru Starbucks is absolutely disappointing compared to the smaller one right next door that it replaced. I went to the previous smaller location for 10+ years. 

The staff at the new "improved" Starbucks are sweet, but highly inexperienced. It's a bit of an issue when you're paying $7 once or twice a day for a beverage and it is not hot enough or not cold enough. They do not understand how to use their $12,000 espresso machine properly. They don't time their shots. They have no sense of how humidity affects the grind/tamp.

I'm not going to harass the 18 year old barista to re-make a drink three times when they clearly haven't received adequate training. I have thrown my drinks away the last two times I went because they were not enjoyable at all. I plan not to go back even though I live and work within a three mile radius of this Starbucks.

I know to some, it may sound like I am being some kind of coffee elitist, but this is not Dunkin' Donuts. Starbucks have built their reputation on making coffee and espresso drinks and they rightfully charge more money for their product. But, if they do not know how to craft and serve their product, there is no point.  Clearly, they aspire to be the Arby's of the coffee world because they do not train their workers on the basic chemistry of building drinks. For this quality of beverage, I find the Dunkin' Donuts much better. The staff there is well trained in what they do. It's quite sad when the Dunkin' Donuts can get their act together, but a Starbuck's can't. Sad.

Drinks are typically ok but the service is extremely slow....especially in the drive thru. I hesitated before giving a review because I was hoping the speed of service would improve. It has not. I've tried coming here intermittently over the past 7 months. I always wait at least 15 minutes in the drive thru....every time. The staff is usually very friendly, but do not go here, unless you have plenty of time to spare
The friendliest staff work at this location! The drinks are always perfect! Walk in or at the drive-thru the service is excellent!
This is a third time this happened. I ordered a black, dark roast coffee and it tested like a watered down coffee from a gas station.

As far as a Starbucks goes, it's like any other. This location I've been to more times than the 2 check-ins I have. I've never had a problem here. My drinks have always been made correctly. The staff is friendly enough to make this a location able to be returned to, which is nice because it's the closest to where I live.

The drive through is usually more packed than if you park your car and walk inside, which I've done on several occasions. 

I do recommend this location if you're in the North Valleys area :)

I don't even know how to rate this place because I can't stand this location but I love starbucks. Every time I come here they never have what I want on the menu!! If you like tomato basil mozz paninis, dream bars, ham and cheese or spinach pastries, you better not come to this location. Every time  I've gone they are out of these items, got my drink order wrong, and they are slow af. I swear they hire the most incompetent people. Whoever is managing this location just doesn't know what they are doing or just does not care because it is the only starbucks in the area, that we are forced to come here.  They don't know how to hire competent workers and don't know a thing about taking inventory. Get it together Delran starbucks!!! Thank you that's all
Worst drive thru EVER. Takes atleast 20 minutes to get through it. Not very friendly staff. Terrible!

Ok, ok, they've done it!! They have improved so much it warrants a new review!!
New staff members, lots of people working, and the drinks are now the best of the 3 Starbucks I frequent!
I appreciate my coffees so much and its rough when they cant get basic right, but THIS STARBUCKS  has done it! 
they have a coffee master "Casper" who makes the best complicated drinks too!  I'm so happy with this location. For the last couple months it's been consistent and delicious!

The line in the newish store seems to move faster than at the coffee cart they used to operate nearby. Sorry, Starbucks haters, but Pike Place roast still is one of my favorites. Baked goods are okay, but wish they had a better gluten-free option than a packaged fruit-nut bar.
Morning coffee before my flight!! Great service - they got my husbands order wrong so they willingly gave us the drink they had already made (for free of course) and then made his drink.

I am not really a Starbucks fan due to the prices of coffee. But I have to stay awake when I am at the hospital waiting for my father. My sister never goes to Starbucks and doesn't do sugar. The girl up front was not helpful and very short. The girl making the coffee was way friendly and made up for the rude girl.

The Internet In This Starbucks Is Paid and Its The only Starbucks In Downtown tampa

The Nearest Starbucks that has Free Wifi is On Kennedy Blvd Across Walmart

I stop by this Starbucks nearly every day. The staff are super friendly, quick, and I have yet to have a bad experience here. I usually order ahead on the app, but even when I am in line the service is quick. Not to mention the fact that I have a custom order that I love and they always make it right. I have been to pretty much every Starbucks in our area, this one is my absolute favorite.

Congratulations to this mindless group of assholes that work at this location for losing a lifelong Starbucks customer for good! After ordering my drinks with my mask on, I went and sat down in a lobby full of maskless customers and removed my mask while I waited for my order. I was promptly told to put my mask back on or go wait outside in the cold. When I asked what the difference was between me waiting for my drink in the lobby with no mask on and the other paying customers sitting in the lobby with no mask on, she said "they already got their drinks". When I said "fine can I have some water?" She told me no, and told me to get out. This is not about keeping anyone safe anymore. Not that it really ever was. This is 100% about keeping people in line and making them follow absurd rules for no rational reason. There is absolutely no difference between not wearing a mask while you're waiting for a drink and not wearing a mask while you have a conversation with your friend and a drink on your table. I demanded a refund and told her that her customer service is garbage and that because if her the company is losing business. She then says "the company is doing just fine" and handed me my money. All while her cloth mask was hanging half off of her face. Screw Starbucks.

Over a two week span they got my order wrong 4 times (out of 10 orders via mobile). I come in fairly early every morning before work when it's not crowded nor busy so i don't understand why they can't or wont, make my drink right.

Extremely friendly and helpful staff. This is a great location being attached to the skywalk system too! You can easily get to the Hyatt/PNC building indoors if it's raining/snowing. Walk down the escalator and you're there!
The products were fine. Starbucks is Starbucks. The woman at the drive-thru was just very rude and short with us for no reason.

If you don't mind waiting 20-30 minutes for your drink this Starbucks is for you! Consistently slow service and always a line out the door. Take my advice and walk the extra few minutes to the Circle Tower location.

This location needs a complete staffing overhaul, especially during nights and weekends.  Not only do many of the baristas make beverages incorrectly, but there is this attitude about them that is just plain rude, like they can't be bothered.  So many of them also play on their cell phones while working.  There's no sense of customer service or building relationships, and often times the wait is ridiculously long for orders.  The restrooms also are almost always filthy.  They really need some help.

A great quiet Starbucks! Since it's hidden and connected to the Hilton, most people don't know it's there. They have different hours from regular Starbucks. Very quick, prompt service and the drink I ordered was made per how I usually enjoy it. They also have free WiFi, and can use the Starbucks app. I dislike paper straws personally, but they were able to offer me a straw-less lid as an alternative, which worked well.

I ordered a black iced coffee blended and the barista made a big stink about it. She tried to make me change my mind on my order twice. She insisted I have a frapuccino instead because otherwise the blended black coffee would be too slushy. I'm sorry but i know what i ordered. I love the texture of blended black coffee, it's not frozen but nice and foamy. I don't know why my order was so complicated. After I didn't change my mind and stuck with what I wanted she gave me attitude.  The coffee was great tho! I think Margo needs a little more training on customer service.

The staff here clearly enjoys working here. Always very lively here, which is appreciated. Although the lounge area is "average" when you consider tables to relax & converse at, there is outdoor seating that makes up for it.

As far as seasonal themes to market products, this location offers such as "Frappuchino Friday."The ladies dress up Hawaiian style, and the men wear a Don Ho Hawaii 5-0 shirt. It makes for good fun. The products are still very good, as well as certain new promotional ones such as Oprah's Chai Latte. 

Parking in this Starbuck's front lot can be challenging, particularly with the last two parking spaces on the front right (very tight). I would recommend parking in the adjacent shopping center lot and just walking over during the busy times of the day (early morning, late afternoon). Overall, a pretty good venue.

I understand as air travelers we are at the mercy of the vendors in the terminal, HOWEVER. Monique was more concerned with her playlist than getting her orders out. Never in my life have four people behind me received their hot fancy coffee orders before my UNSWEETENED black ice tea. Never have my bacon and gruyere bites been delivered a full seven minutes before my UNSWEETENED black ice tea. On top of that, please don't call me baby, Monique.

I was over on this side of town to shop at the local WinCo last Friday.

There was a queue going all the way around the building like no thanks I will pass!
I noticed this Starbucks across the street, so I thought what the heck why not treat yourself since you wasted a ton of gas coming over. I noticed they had a drive-up window, but the line was long. I went in and they were very nice to me. I got my usual order. I get a skinny vanilla latte. I found it interesting how different the order tastes depending on who is making it.
I found it super annoying that it's not the same every single time. Like it's a basic recipe for goodness sake.

When I go to a juice bar and make a order, it's almost always tastes the same. I know it's silly to be annoyed but I just don't get it. That's why I love my coffee at home! It tastes exactly the same every morning. I also think it gets pretty expensive to get it everyday...

The waitstaff guy was super friendly and accommodating to me. So I want too disappointed that the coffee was different tasting once again. Home is better :) Cute location and clean, well organized store.

I mean it's always crowded. The baristas are not friendly except one and I think she's the manager. I spend way too much money at Starbucks Is what my last visit reminded me of. I'm not sure what's up with some of these suburban centralized Starbucks. Everyone is either trying to keep the honey away from you or just just flat out rude. Lord but that y'all mocha and warm croissant be calling me.

I went to this starbucks because I wanted a drink since they just came out with the fall drinks, and I was waiting in line to order like everyone else. But when I got up to the cashier, I ordered a Pumpkin Spice Frappuccino, and a Pumpkin Cream cold brew. The total was $11.12 and I paid in with a 20. Now the change was $8.88 and when the cashier went to pay the change, he only paid me the .88 cents, and told the trainer that I left the $8 as the tip. This was a scam.

This is really embarrassing. Starbucks subjects it's customer to boring national standards for product while providing none of the large scale benefits of employee support and training. The "baristas" at both this and the Harbor Island store are painfully slow and lack understanding of the product. Combine this with one more stained shirt from the lid opening being put on the seam and I am going elsewhere. Starbucks said "it was all about the experience". 
If this is what they deliver they better improve the coffee!

This is an A-OK Starbucks for me, there's a lot of seating but no spot to really just hang out, relax and chill. This location seems to always be busy but so far the service that I have received here has been pretty outstanding, yes it can be slow but if it is based on the amount of customers coming through then it seems fast enough. Overall, it's a plain ole Starbucks, nothing much out of the ordinary. Although, it is worth mentioning that it's in a building connected to other businesses which equals to a battle in looking for a parking spot and no drive thru.

I decided I wanted a vanilla cream cold brew and a little 'chinno for my pup after taking her to the dog park. Took them over twenty minutes just to get me to the window (not that many cars ahead of me.) then they told me they were "too low on whipped cream" even though it was noon a Tuesday. So now I have a crushed dog staring into the store waiting for something that isn't coming, took them over 30 minutes to get me one damn coffee and they gave me regular cream in it. 

Already had bad experiences with this location now I am NEVER going to return. The girl even had an attitude when she said no to me like it was my fault for having a dog that wanted some whipped cream.
Always clean and friendly baristas. Experienced first Dirty Chai Latte and have been hooked since.

This Starbucks crew ain't the greatest. Very slow and inattentive compared to the hyperprofessionalism of most Starbucks employees. My standard drink was pretty lackluster, and my cinnamon twist was chewy. Meh. Weary bleary travelers appreciate a little kindness, and that touch of familiarity their favorite SB drink can provide. Though polite, this group could use some more training, some more pride in their work. An airport is a REALLY good place to keep people happy.

I'm a Starbucks fan. But it doesn't matter which one I go to, there's always a super long wait for what seems to be simple items to prepare. I was meeting a friend there for study group one Saturday morning around 11.

First let's talk parking. If you're driving southbound on the Boulevard, Starbucks looks like a drive thru only establishment. However if you make the right turn and another quick right, there's the parking lot. Super tight spaces and diagonal so when coming in, can be a little tricky. There's no walkway to the actual entrance so you're walking over shrubbery just to get in, annoying.
