I got there early, ordered my tall blonde roast and got it in about three minutes. Cool, but I walk.over to the sugar station to find no real sugar. ...AHHHHH. I WANT SUGAR. not sweet n low and not "raw" sugar. Just regular old sugar, please and thanks. Sooo I drank it black. Whatevs lol.

There were couches by the door, regular seating, hightops etc. Place was clean, bright and played nice music at a comfortable decibel level. Loud enough to bob your head to songs you know but not so loud as if you're in a bar. 

My friend arrived and ordered a smoothie. I looked back at least six times. Took 20 minutes for a smoothie! Sweet Lord. That's just ridiculous. Other than that,  l like Starbucks.

These baristas are so sweet and kind. This location gets PACKING in the morning and they always make drinks fast and they taste great. If your order is taking a while they are sure to inform you of the situation (or if there's a TON of mobile orders) and they are more than willing to fix things if there's a slight oops. (Even if it's mobile order self error) One of the management staff mates even knew my order for quite some time! It's kind of sweet to have someone know what you like and to care about it at all for that matter- I have to curb my coffee addiction for pregnancy but overall this place is great and the baristas are the best in town CANT wait to go back to my norm!

I rarely take time to leave reviews, but this Starbucks location deserves to be bragged on. They always get it right - my coffee is perfect every time (they even made my drink when I messed up my mobile order and didn't make me do a drive of shame to the other location). There are 4-5 other locations closer to me than this one, but I will go out of my way to come to this one every time because the staff is just a gosh dang delight. Many people don't realize how simple an emphatic 'hello!' (sometimes in song form) or 'how is your day' can really boost your mood. It feels like a verbal (socially distanced) hug. Kudos to everyone at this location!

Gotta love a Starbucks with a drive-thru! This one is located in the same shopping center as Market District, which has its OWN Starbucks inside the store, believe it or not. You can literally walk from one Starbucks to the other in about two minutes. (This is proof that we are living in a glorious, glorious time.) But that Starbucks doesn't have a DRIVE-THRU like this one, so this Starbucks wins. 

Because of the aforementioned drive-thru, I've never actually stepped inside the store itself. The drive-thru, though, was fine: when I was in line, it was a little slow, but I think it was because an order of someone ahead of me was messed up. But I got my pumpkin spice latte (hey, don't judge; it's almost fall) and was on my way relatively quickly.

We were attending a commencement ceremony at UCSB. We arrived a little early so we decided to stop by for breakfast. 

We were shocked to see how dirty the front area of the store was when we arrived. There was trash all over the place and looked disgusting. It looked like there was a party there the night before and nobody cleaned up. 

Luckily, the mess outside did not reflect the inside of the store. The store was clean and organized. Unfortunately, the restrooms were closed and from the other reviews I have read, this is a frequent occurrence at this location. 

Regardless of the inconvenience, we were able have breakfast before heading to the Commencement ceremony.

Dropping by at random, we discovered this is positively the nicest Starbucks location in the Tampa Bay area! The huge interior is classy and rustic at the same time, atypical for a Starbucks. 

We definitely enjoyed our caffeine fixes! When you come, I'd recommend hot beverages because I think the AC is set on frozen. We heard multiple people sneezing I think due to the Arctic conditions.

This Starbuck's single handedly feeds my Starbucks addiction. Why? Because they're always awesome! Rarely does the drive thru have a line and the staff is consistent and friendly. I have never gotten a bad drink or food item here and they are never out of items. They are open to making off the venue items and patient with me when I come in with 4 kids, order 7 drinks or try to pay with 3 different gift cards and redeem my points. I ordered several large catering sized coffee "boxes" here last year for a Christmas party and the staff was so helpful in deciding what I needed and what types of coffee to get. Avoid going between 2pm and 3pm or before 9am if you don't want any line at all as those times can get a little busy for this location. But this is, hands down, one of the best Starbucks locations in Reno right now. Believe me, I would know ;)

Filthy urine covered floor in the bathroom.  This is what happen when you don't have a men's room and a ladies room, no urinals for the men.  The tables where not wiped down, we had to sit at a dirty table.  This place needs to participate in a cleanliness training program.

Horrible customer service. The morning staff at this store is extremely rude. ALWAYS messes up my order. This Starbucks is the closest to my home and now I have to drive further out to a different Starbucks to get my drink right the first time and order taken by a decent human being. I refuse to ever give this store business again. Do your self a favor and drive those extra miles to a different store you won't regret it.

I go here and act like I'm intently working on a project on my notebook, when I'm actually jus jackin around!  No, actually, I do that at Paradise Cafe in Clay Terrace! 

This IS the nicest Starbucks in Carmel. I mean, all Sbucks have the same hyper-inflated drinks, however, they don't all have the "atmosphere." If I'm going to pay the price, I at least want a nice space to drink it in. The Clay Terrace one sucks. The one across the street from Clay Terrace sucks. The one in Meijer sucks. Hell, I've never been to the one on Carmel Dr. and Keystone, but it probably sucks.

I'm actually surprised Carmel hasn't provided me with a "local" coffee shop like that of Noble Coffee. Co. in Noblesville.  I mean, one would expect the affluence of Carmel to support such a place. Oh well....

In the end, I'll probably end up going to Panera or Panera's competitor that's not actually a competitor because it's owned by Panera, Paradise Cafe.

Almost made me late for work waiting on my coffee! I did a mobile order and it said 5-7 minutes and I thought perfect I'll just grab it and go. Well 25 minutes later I had my drink. I get it it's Saturday and you're busier but make the app reflect that! I wouldn't of even ordered if it said 25 minutes and I wouldn't of had to hurry to work! I had to ask the barista about my order and he wasn't of much help. I like Starbucks but this made me mad!
I tried the Roasted Coconut Cold Brew and taste like dirt water, horrible! Never again!!

I haven't been to this location before, but I always pass it. In the dear need of coffee I stopped and boy it is spacious. This place is perfect for students or big groups. Specially if they are looking for a cool place to study (plus caffeine).
Love this Starbucks! Always has fun, upbeat music and love meeting clients here. The employees are nice and super friendly!

The staff here is super sweet and helpful, I haven't had an issue with customer service at all. However, I recently have started doing my daily mobile order because my job moved locations, and 4/5 times my order is either wrong or late. It seems like this store is incredibly busy, which Is totally understandable, but they also seem to have some very serious staffing/management issues. It's definitely not the employees fault, they are just trying their best, but when I give them 20 minutes to get my drink done via the mobile app and then I show up and it's STILL not done, it's clear that this store is operational deficient.

Time to update my review. The line can still be long at the drive thru just like any Starbucks, but for me who goes here a couple times a week mid mornings, they definitely have improved their wait times. The staff is friendly and they are one of the few Starbucks that makes my Black Tea Lemonade consistently yummy and actually shakes it (mixes it) like they are suppose to. Wish they were closer to our home as the drive thru at the Starbucks at Buck and Lemmon is horrendous.

Literally the worst Starbucks I've ever been to and should get shut down before it ruins the Starbucks name. Never make my coffee right the customer service is absolute trash you can tell the workers are very depressed working there and it shows. I can get back there and make coffee way better. Absolute trash.
Probably my favorite Starbucks. They are super fast and don't mess up my drink. All the employees are also super nice and friendly.

I can't shop or go to the new Apple store without a Frappucino after-wards. It's just one of my unwritten rules. It's a refreshing treat to celebrate a new purchase or resisting the urge to make a new purchase. 

I like the new store location over the old kiosk version. However, I disagree with John H., I think the line moves slower. Perhaps my line was longer then his, because they were moving slow. I found it odd that two associates were taking orders and only one making all our drinks. I may be crazy, but wouldn't the line moved faster if two were making the drinks?

We all know the baked goods are shipped in to each Starbucks. There are no Kebbler elves in the back stockroom baking. Even though they are shipped in, I love the petite vanilla bean scones. 

Staff is always friendly and pleasant. They should be, Starkbucks treats their employees very well with benefits and $.

We have been back to this new Starbucks many times since it opened a few months ago. The quality and service has declined terribly.

The last visit (yesterday) was so bad I feel I'll never be back because of the ridiculously terrible service and quality of the drinks and snacks.

Let me elaborate:

First Strike: Out of at least 4 people working, not one acknowledged us for at LEAST 5 minutes. And they weren't doing anything! Not one person who worked there had a smile, or acted like they wanted to be there. They were all so decidedly unpleasant.

Second Strike: I was with fellow Yelperazzi Jessica T and she ordered a "Cafe au Lait", modified. Starbucks is known for modifications of any type, but the guy told her he'd TRY to do it but didn't know how it would turn out "because THIS location doesn't have sweetened condensed milk". What! Incidentally, they tried but the drink turned out awful. When we asked them to make something else, we were charged for it with no apology.

Third Strike: We both ended up with 2 very watered-down and unenjoyable pumped-up-priced Chai Tea Lattes.

Fourth Strike: I ordered a Sweet Treat -A S'Mores Bar. He at first placed it in a bag. He knew we were lounging in as he saw we had already taken a table. When I asked him if I could have it warmed, he acted like I was putting him out. After heating up the S'Mores Bar, he proceeded to grab an "oatmeal cup" and jammed the square-shaped bar into the round oatmeal cup, breaking the graham cracker apart. 

I feel I can no longer support Starbucks at all after this awful experience. 

If you compare Starbucks prices to most Mom & Pop coffee houses, Starbucks is always the pricier choice. 

I'd rather support the Mom & Pops coffee houses, as I've lost faith in Starbucks altogether.


39/100

When Starbucks first initiated its expansion it stressed service and quality for price. It was also known for providing good pay and benefits to its employees. 

Because I believed in those positive service traits of a good business I invested by purchasing a few shares of the company stock. 

Then Starbucks raised prices on all its drinks, ceased offering free internet connection at the stores, and declined in service to customers through longer wait time for orders, less attention to the cleanliness of the store, and workers not willing to listen to orders and requests of customers. 

Most coffee shops in my area offer free internet service-and are willing to make coffee at 1/2 the price of Starbucks-Its A Grind in particular and McDonald's are more competitive in their price and service structure. 

We sincerely hope Starbucks' management will work to deliver better service, value, and product once again to the clientèle it once served more professionally.

This has got to be the worst Starbucks ever! They are slow and don't make the coffee right, I asked for two pumps of vanilla syrup and they gave me one and charges me for three extra pumps! They have also "accidentally" charged me for two mocha lattes and a strawberry lemonade all on the same order either get yourself a new drive thru speaker or get some new employees because this Starbucks sucks. And before I get hate I do realize I was going through the drive thru and that it could be different if I were inside but wait I did go inside and I have never seen rider employees they gave me dirty looks when I was on a coffee run for my employer and just seemed ver annoyed with me because I ordered 3 coffees and 3 pastries. All in all I don't like this Starbucks and will never be going back.

New location moved right across the street where Boston Market closed. Much bigger location with a drive thru window. I believe they retained some of the staff but not sure. To start they had short hours. Now is it looks like they have extended their hours. The location on North Meridian is closed till the first of June. Looks like a remodel. Today was the first day my Trinta Black Tea tasted right at this location. Every time I've ordered it it has a slight fruit taste. Best guess they weren't properly cleaning out containers before shaking my tea. Or the tea comes out very light in color. I always ask for no water so it should be darker and stronger. So kudos to who ever made my tea today. It was perfect. 05/14/ 21 about 3pm.

Great starbucks, I go here everyday! This place always has my best interested and takes care of me. The employees are always so polite to me when I walk in and treat me well. They always get my drink since i get it custom.

I always love me some Starbucks.  I however prefer to walk into the Starbucks on Pyramid!  The customer service there is just so nice!  All the people that work there are so friendly and happy!  The energy really is contagious!

I usually end up here when I'm meeting friends or just need some stuff to-go. The baristas are all super sweet though, especially the tattooed one. 

I'd say 4 stars except that one time I waited a half hour past the time my online order was supposed to be ready and I was just having a bad week. You'd think that was bad, right? So why am I giving it 5 stars still?

While I was waiting I saw one of my neighbors come over with her new puppy in her basket, a cocker spaniel dressed up as a bumblebee. It was the cutest thing I have ever seen. We chatted and she let me hold her dog and give it plenty of pets, wagging its stubby little bumblebee tail. I kind of forgot about my drink until she left, and lucky for me it was just arriving as soon as I finished. 

(Plus I used Stars and got a $13 coffee for free because I made so many add-ons, so whoever the barista was who made my drink abomination during rush hour, props to you)

Since the staff has completely changed at this location my co workers and I won't even go in anymore. The manager is rude and doesn't want to be there, the rest of the staff are alright but don't know how to make any of the recipes.

The old staff (the two dudes with the beards and the tall blonde girl) were amazing. Sad to see the company let them leave. Surprised this store is still in business after losing the entire staff. This used to be my favorite location.

This location is fairly small -- not a lot of indoor seating and it can be crowded while waiting for your drink. But, they do have a fair amount of seating plus a "walk up" window for people who are out walking their doggies.

They have a Clover, which they use to brew their specialty coffees. I am CDL girl, so I don't have a well developed palate for coffee. But, I saw the machine in action and it looked pretty cool. 

Yeah, Starbucks is a chain, and there are a lot of great local businesses, but sometimes Starbucks is just so darn convenient. 

If you are riding your bike on the Cultural Trail, there's a bike rack nearby.

Horrific service. I get it, they were packed and the drive thru was loaded. HOWEVER, a busy day does not mean that you can ignore customer service completely. Greet people when they get to the register, nicely, you jerk. If it's taking 20 minutes to make one coffee, you should probably thank me for my patience. Because I was patient, and I didn't get upset that a group of six employees couldn't handle a few orders. In regards to my order, I had to repeat it three times, and it was still wrong. 

Won't be back. I can get overpriced coffee elsewhere.
coffee wasn't horrible but the employee working behind the counter with black hair & nice nails was very sweet & helpful. Will definitely be back if i'm in the area.
My local SB but its a good one. Big open spacing with high and low seating and some 2 person corners too.

This Starbucks boasts a great space with a decent amount of seating AND a stellar location in the heart of Mass Ave. And they have a Clover, which always excites me because while I don't get into coffee enough to order special coffee, the hubs loves it and it's fun to watch the baristas use it.

During all of my stops in at this particular location I have found the service to be efficient and friendly. Lots of friendly meetups of what I assume to be regulars were gathered throughout the shop, so it must be a welcoming place in general.

The bathrooms require a secret pin code that you can get when you order a drink. I don't know if a purchase is required but you at least need to ask for the code. At any rate, the bathroom I used was in good working order. 

Nothing out of the ordinary, but a great spot for the Starbucks faithful.

Stopped in here after leaving the one in Target at the Christiana Mall. 

It was okay. I'm giving five stars for the service. Very friendly talkative staff and my drink was awesome. I'll go back if in the area :)

Ahh yes, the "local" coffee shop.  I think as far as Starbucks go, this one is much more cramped and feels a little dirty everytime I go in it. I would definitely recommend going to the one of the two near monument circle--I tend to have a better experience there. 

Pro: You can have a place to sit and hang out while you are waiting to get a table at Bru!  Also, the service here is always great! 

Cons: It is just a low tier 'bucks.  Not a place I would go out of my way for--especially when there are places like Coat Check Coffee close by.
This Starbucks gets my order right one out of the five times I go. Literally needs a whole new staff.

This Starbucks is great. The guys who work here are so nice. I was lost but they didn't know that. Lol. I just stopped to check my GPS and get back on the right track. Plus, I had been lost for awhile, and it was partly due to the fact I was aimlessly driving around, looking for a Starbucks before I hit the beach. This is a pretty big town just before you hit the beach. I found it, but had to make a u-turn in traffic, and had to rely on someone letting me in, just to make my u-turn. Some cute guy in a convertible blew me a kiss and gave me the go-ahead. Since he was cute (and nice), I blew him a kiss right back.

I had the best hot Chai latte and Mini Vanilla Scone here. The scone literally melted on my tongue. So light and fluffy. 

It was pretty packed in there. One of the cleanest Starbucks I've seen, and looked very new. Outside was a seating area in front, covered by an arbor. Several ladies were just passing away the day, quietly sipping on their drinks.

One of the baristas asked me if he could make me a sample of their new item that's going to debut in a couple weeks. I forgot the name but it has hot chocolate and some fancy caramel whipped cream in that coffee. I'm not a big coffee drinker. I'm more of a tea-drinker, but this was good. It was a yummy enough delight that I'll be looking for its debut.

I'll definitely be making this a regular stop whenever I go to Indian Rocks Beach.

I just had one of my most memorable experiences at this Starbucks! Kyle was my cashier and he was so friendly and delivered the best customer service I've seen in a while. He was knowledgeable about the menu and you can tell he really cares about his job and the guests who visit. Kyle just made my day!  I'm definitely coming back to order another pumpkin spice special!

Definitely not the best Starbucks I have ever been to. The first time I ever went there, they got my order wrong. The last time I was there something was definitely off with my drink. When they get it right it's good though. The workers are generally nice but as someone who loves Starbucks, I'm pretty disappointed that this is the one closest to me.

Not your friendliest Starbucks employees. The wait for the drive thru was Long so I decided to go inside for faster service. Unfortunately they're so focused on fulfilling the drive thru orders they ignore the patrons who come inside. I was literally the only person in line and it took me 20+ minutes to get a coffee. While waiting for my coffee I decided to get a bottled beverage but no one even bothered to turn around to ring me out so after standing there like an idiot for 10 minutes I decided to eff it and just leave. 

3 our of 4 times I've been there my orders were incorrect so it's probably best you triple check it before you leave.
Drive through is nice but the service is always slow. I usually put my car in park because I'm sitting in the drive thru for so long

Received a postmates to order/ pick up from this location. Went 10 min out of my way to order from here, only to arrive & the door is locked with no explanation to why. I understand they are probably cleaning but i've seen over a dozen people walk up and try to open the door to just walk away confused. There is no note explaining why, and they won't answer the phone when i can literally see them in there. Result, i had to cancel my delivery & miss out on money. Next time inform customers as to why & how long you're closed. very unprofessional. -6 stars if i could!

"Pay it Backwards" - I pulled up to the drive thru window and after receiving the usual pleasant greeting I was told that the car in front of me paid for part of my drink order. I was the 74th drive through customer in a row that was done for. What a wonderful idea. So I "paid it backwards" and asked to pay for the car behind me. What joy it gives me when a stranger does such a nice little gesture!

Really love the location of this Starbucks. Decided to switch up my usual by trying the vanilla sweet cream Cold brew. I definitely would prefer the coconut cold brew over the vanilla! 

This Starbucks is pretty open and always has a moderate to smaller crowd. If the line is backed up here their is another Starbucks walking distance in the market district grocery store across the way!

I've now been here twice for afternoon work sessions. It's spacious, there's a decent-sized parking lot, and the wifi seems to work pretty well. Service was friendly, but at the same time, they got my drink wrong (I asked whether they only had white chocolate iced mocha, or whether they had regular iced mocha--and very definitely asked for the latter, but I think asking about the former confused them). Also, floors could use a bit of a sweep, and tables--at least in some cases--could use a wipe. I understand sometimes a place gets busy and this isn't always possible, but once the crowd dies down, that's something that should happen.

Still, it's a generally comfortable environment with lots of plugs; it could just use a bit more curation (and cleaning). All in all, though, this is a solid option in an area without any independent coffee shops open past last afternoon, and I'd certainly return as needed.

This was my first time to this location, and let me tell you how cute it is inside. Located near a college campus, this is the perfect pace to come study and enjoy some coffee. There are so many tables to sit at, and it's super spacious inside. 

I ordered a semi- complicated drink, the barista was wonderful, and my drink was delicious.
Been there a number of times and they didn't have what I wanted...... sandwiches, lattes, even coffee.
They close at 6pm on June 14 2021 because there is not enough employees or they choose not to work until 8pm. I wouldn't expect it from Starbucks. I should choose another coffee place.
Great location because they make the drinks and food correctly, consistently and generally are very friendly and prompt.

Simple order for a Venti drip coffee. They forgot about it. After a number of people who ordered after me got their labor intensive specialty drinks I enquired about my drip coffee and got serious attitude from the woman behind the counter. Furthermore she refused to give me what I ordered and shoved a different coffee in front of my face. I'd say get a coffee drink anyways but here.

This newly renovated location is the crown jewel of the 50+ Indianapolis Starbucks.  It has a mix of frequent locals and is a true representation of what a neighborhood coffee shop should be (chess matches, people strumming instruments, work meetings, and local minglers).  The staff is great, the get hit really hard at certain times but move fast.  The walk up window is great for dog walkers.  They also were one of the fist sites to get the Clover system which I find to be a dramatically better cup of coffee.  Even if I don't know you, I'll probably see you there soon!

Wow, I can't believe I'm actually going to write a review of Starbucks.  Oh well, please don't think any less of me as I'm more so reviewing this location than the company or its products.  
Being that all I ever get is coffee, I can't complain about their beverage.  Since all they need to do is pour the coffee into a cup, I can't complain about the service either--in fact, they seem like clones of almost every Starbucks I've ever been to.  So not much to write about there.
What I do want to say is that this one appears to open a little earlier than others in Tucson, at least earlier than the one on University Ave.  That's a plus for me when it is my early-commute-to-work-week.
One bit of advice, which seems even more appropriate after reading the other couple reviews of this location--DON'T USE THE DRIVE THROUGH!  Seriously.  I have never used the drive through, electing instead to go in and deal face-to-face with people.  But it appears everyone else doesn't want to get out of their vehicle.  This often makes it extremely difficult to even get into their driveway.  It's not ncommon to see the queue spilling onto Broadway.  Plus, even on days when there are only one or two cars in the queue (often there are 4 or 5), I still get my coffee and get out before they move at all.  Seriously, get out of the line, out of your car, take a second to go into the store, be greeted by a smile (usually), get your drink, and leave--likely you'll even save time (and gas) this way as well!

I park at the parking lot. I know this Starbucks is slower because there are not many Starbucks around Exton ( unlike downtown Philadelphia where has Starbucks all over the corner ). They make good and meets Starbucks coffees. Only thing that I wish to see is that a clean cup when I receive my order at the counter. Always I found some coffee spill on the lid or on the cup. Hospitality industry = hygiene

Usually a very long wait and they never have coconut milk, almond milk, oat milk, etc. They regularly are the only Starbucks in America for years that doesn't have basic drinks and ingredients on the menu. Nice workers though - not blaming the staff.

Best Starbucks! Everyone in the morning when I get my regular 5 am americano with white mocha and cream, the baristas are so welcoming! I enjoy the conversations they start with me it's like they "really" care! Love it!
This is one of the best starbucks I have been to in sparks Nevada.  They are efficient, friendly and a joy to be around!

Crappy coffee, terrible customer relations. Coffee made incorrect many many times over the years. Just sick and tired of giving this place a second third fourth fifth chance.  Mud cup is what I call this crap they served me today. Must have been bottom of barrel coffee grounds at bottom of cup just disgusting.
They were very friendly here. I appreciate that they remade my drink when I complained that I got too much ice. Loved their customer service.

My go to. My home. This Starbucks is small, but bursts with an awesome staff. Everyone that works here is incredibly helpful and friendly. By your third time you'll likely be greeted by name. If you can snag a table this is a great place to work for a morning before walking around the Village.
I am used to waiting at Starbucks, but this was an exceptional wait, to get the wrong order, from a rude staff. Next time will try the coffee place across the street.

I was running a little bit late today so I stopped in at Starbucks to grab a quick oatmeal for breakfast. I was the only one in the store. It took them about 15 minutes to make the oatmeal.... Running later than I would have liked I ran to work open up the packet of blueberries was hit with such an overwhelming stench of rotten fruit. Looking down on expiration date it's well over a month and a half old. I know it's really my fault I picked to go to Starbucks over literally any other place and I will not be making that mistakes again

I went through the drive thru and it went relatively fast but they gave me a caramel Frappuccino with no caramel so that was a big disappointment especially when I've been craving one for the past few days.

Very cute, trendy store.  Customer service was friendly and curious.  Drinks were fabulous. It was clean and tidy! Would definitely stop by again. I went into the store but they also have a drive through.

It's a starbux so its the usual - good quality coffee, consistent.  I'm here in the evening & it's not crowded, but steadily busy-no waiting.   Had a cranberry bliss bar that didn't seem to be quite as good I remembered, not sure if it's my memory or it just wasn't as good.   But hey I like starbux, & this one is as good as others- but no  special "hi, how are ya?" 's

The people who work here are evil. I've gone to this specific location for years bc I live close by. I thought at first maybe it was just one employee... nope! Every single visit I've been disappointed with the attitudes of these workers.. not to mention the clear irritation they show when you don't order "the right way"....  Always a bad experience.

This Starbucks has turned into a place of positivity over the last several months. The employees are happier and the new layout helps brighten the store. They have new interactive displays where you can read good news. I'm excited to return when normalcy return.

If for no other reason than they replaced the old Long John Silvers... I am a fan. Love the fact that there is a drive through. As I said in a previous review of another Sbux, I come for the hot chocolate, not the coffee. Great place to go as it is right on my way to work!

I love this Starbucks, my favorite by far in the area. In my opinion, they are always fast. That being said, if I saw the line was enormously long, I would not bother- that's just my policy on any place I go out to. I think the employees here are so courteous and friendly. They all deserve recognition for that. I go here once a week on average and my order has always been correct. I feel lucky that I live so close.

This is my go-to Starbucks! It's right around the corner from my work, so I'd say I run here at least twice a week for a grande Pike's Place (or a white chocolate mocha if I'm feelin' crazy).

I don't enjoy sitting in every Starbucks, but I really enjoy the atmosphere of this one! It's cozy, always filled with people, has a local coffee shop feel to it even though it's a chain establishment, and has the friendliest staff. In fact, I think the reason it has that local coffee shop feel is because of the staff--they always remember my name and are familiar with my order(s).

As far as coffee if concerned, they do a great job. I've yet to ask them to remake anything I've ordered, there has never been a need to! But since we're on the topic of coffee, I'd recommend the following: pike's with two raw sugars (less or more depending on your preference) and cream, an americano with honey and steamed cream, or a white chocolate mocha with an extra shot (a bit expensive, but if you're a Starbucks gold card member I'd recommend saving your freebies for orders like this).

Work Starbucks I have ever been to. Don't waste time or money coming here. We have several other coffee options on the West Bank and I recommend any over here. The wait is just plain ridiculous. There can be 4 people working and the line is a mile long. Even without a line, you'll wait 30 minutes. This is my last trip here. This is a disgrace to the Starbucks name.
I stopped by to get a cold drink on this hot day. The baristas were kind, friendly and efficient. They even filled my water bottle for me with triple filtered water for free. :)
From start to finish had the best experience here. Jeff helped me and was in an amazing mood which made me feel great! Loved this location!!!

This Starbucks might have the slowest service in Indy. Ive been here twice and each time was a bad experience. This time i came here at 11am on a Sunday and it wasn't crazy busy or anything but I was able to use the restroom and still had to wait over 20 minutes for my basic drink of strawberry açaí.... i think the walk up window is faster than inside service! Pretty sure several people were served before me. My drink takes 1 minute to make. I am very displeased with this Starbucks and will not be stopping here again.

I went today.  "Mr. Smith" did a great job taking my order right away, ringing it in correctly and the order came out quickly.  He was humorous and engaging... great personality.  He made a connection on what is normally a mundane transaction.

Well for a starbucks it's a letdown. You expect superior service and quality but don't see it here. Coffee is their main game obviously, but they seem to leave the brews out for a lonngggg time.  9 times out of 10 my bold coffee is Luke warm to cool once I put cream in it which means it's old as ****. Even when I go to wawa and get their crappy watered down coffee they atleast keep it hot and fresh! A little unbelievable.  Then , they are very bipolar about refills saying corporate won't let me refill if I leave the store and come back. Now granted the store is tiny , your lucky at the bizy times to get a seat for yourself without the usual strange people that come in daily and take entire tables to themselves. So if you walk outside to the best bug and back in your disqualified.... so they act like they follow corporate rules but the managers let themselves and employees have tattoos in your face everywhere with no attempt to cover them, unprofessional! !! At my job you would be fired!! If I was the owner I would fire people left and right!!! So again, it works for a quick fix but this place needs work to get to where the Starbucks name represents.

Ok, if any of you know me, you know I'm a HUGE Starbucks fan, 4 family members work for them... however...
I can't stand this location. I've been twice and they messed up twice.
First time I ordered the bacon Gouda breakfast sandwich and they gave me something different, no big deal, I let the barista know and she said "I gave you what you ordered" ok...ummmm...WHAT? I know this is not acceptable barista behavior and I said, no I'm not sure what this sandwich is, but I asked for the bacon Gouda. To which she responds, "no you didn't, I'll get you a different sandwich, but that's not what you ordered"
Shocked...
I mobile ordered today the spinach feta wrap and venti iced guava white tea w lemonade.
I went to pick up the order and I thought the drink didn't look it's normal pinky peach color, but, being in a hurry (why I mobile ordered)I grabbed and went. Well, of course it's wrong. It's lemonade and tea, no guava,and I'm thinking maybe it's not even the white tea...sigh...why make it at all if you're missing ingredients??
Then when I grabbed it the barista trying to have customer connection calls me Sasha, ok...not my name, but, who cares, she's trying?
This location while being in a super fancy area, super crappy service. 
Come on Starbucks, get it together here.

This location is a little out of the way for me otherwise I would make it "my" Starbucks.  The barista was friendly and patient while I bounced all over the holiday menu.  *there was no one behind us - I'm not that kind of ass*  I settled on the sweet creme spiced cold brew, or something like that.  It was EXTREMELY tasty. I chose wisely.  
The place was clean and organised, something that is lacking in quite a few locations around town lately.
Wow! Sarah just gave me EXCEPTIONAL service here. She was super quick to help me and went out of her way to get my drink right. Thank you for making me feel welcome. I'll be back!

This latte tastes as bad as it looks
 At 6 o'clock on a Sunday morning I think they have a little more time to make a LATTE the way it is supposed to be,  not this....
Drinks always made wrong... literally always. And there's always one employee with a shitty attitude lol.

Visited the location in Terminal 2, before the security gates, twice for the holidays while waiting for family members to arrive, on two different days.  Same two young ladies on both occasions. Both times it was obvious we were a bother and not customers that helped pay their salary.  I was told the drink I ordered, as I always do, was not made the way I ordered nor did they have the liquid cane syrup at their location.  Three drinks were ordered, two made.  After quite some time, and multiple customers served after us, I asked where the third drink was.  Oh my, the look I got was unbelievable, and she asked the second girl, who promptly told her don't worry about it just go about her business.  I asked a little louder where my last drink was, to which the rude one said don't worry about it, again.   I told her our three drinks should have been made before the other customers after us.  I did ask her what her name was, since I knew I wanted to call customer service (I couldn't make out her name on the name tag) and she told me don't worry about it, you'll forget it before it matters. Well, I did contact customer service, who didn't ask for any details of my experiences.  They did however ask for cross streets for the location.  I described the location, as I did at the beginning of this message, and was told they would forward my information to the MS Humphrey location and send me an $8 gift card for my trouble. Interesting how my 'complaint' was forwarded to a Minneapolis Minnesota location but they don't even know what my complaint was.  So, Starbucks customer service cares less than the employees that treated me like a bother instead of a paying customer.  Starbucks is a treat, not a necessity, and I will go out of my way to spend my money anywhere but there again.  I know one location doesn't make them all bad, but when the company's customer service shows no concern, well, that speaks volumes.

Their drive through staff are rude! There was no, "welcome to Starbucks ,what can I get started for you? " I called out 2 times ..hello, then was told just a minute.then silence for a minute. Then they  finally said just ...hello. I started to say what I was wanting & she cut me off & said she was with another customer! ...there's no car in front of me...so I waited & she said hello after another minute. Then as I started to say something she said, I'm with another customer. So I waited a 3rd time... then she said hello again & I asked for a pumpkin spice latte. She cuts me off rudely & says they're sold out. By this point I wasn't sure if they would make it right. I was second guessing if i was going to get a custom coffee. 
Ok! I was going to order a vanilla latte, I felt I was patient enough. Something told me I best move on because I wanted to say something but thought they'd mess it up on purpose.. I've ordered thousands of times through thousands of drive throughs across Canada & USA! This was the Worst rude experience I've come across! We deliver goods from NL TO Vancouver island. From Indiana through all northern states. I have the destination cups to prove it....Ya! For real! This was the rudest I've ever encountered. Will not stop here again.

Went there this morning for a get me up. They have the nitro on tap. Only problem is when I pulled off and looked to take a drink the nitro cold brew was half coffee and half foam so by the time the foam subsided it was half a coffee. If I'm paying $5 for a nitro it would be great to get a full cup
Probably one of my favorite experiences at Starbucks!! Super nice and made everything perfectly! Absolutely adore Beth!!

99% of the time I am happy to get my coffee here. However today I had to wait in the drive through window as the Starbucks  employee had a 10 minute conversation with what seemed to be her college friend knowing there was someone waiting. Would like to continue getting coffee here but would hope to not receive that kind if service again.

This place is sad. It's not okay when you have 4 employees up front and you have to ask one who happens to be the manager for someone to take your order after 5 minutes. The manager is terrible. When I asked if someone could take our order, instead of helping, she ordered one of the 3 other employees to do it and walked away to the back area. Absolutely TERRIBLE service. Starbucks should be ashamed to have this place open. It is not kept clean and the customer service sucks.
Used the walk-up window today - love this option for quick service with a smile! Staff is friendly, seating is ample with patio.

Used to frequent this place a lot in the past. But, recently the drink choices have been limited, to items being out. My favorite drink flavor is Cinnamon dolce, and it has been out. Hurry up Starbucks and get it in, or I can't buy your coffee.
Popular Starbucks in the morning. Busy line for drive thru but smooth efficient system for mobile order and pick up. They have nitro cold brew so that's a win for me.
This Starbucks is in a great location, but don't be surprised when you go here and wait upwards of 20-30 minutes in a (short) drive thru line. The wait times are always awful!

I am a fan of Starbucks, but not of this location. In the past I have had issues with drink quality, and didn't want to come back, but with the Los Altos store being closed (temporarily) I decided to give this location another try. 
On this day 12/13, I tried to do a mobile, order but the store was not listed. I went on the webpage, no mobile orders available (really?). I decided to head to the location, drive through only, so I go through drive through. Half a dozen cars ahead of me (not uncommon). I try to place my order (no peppermint syrup), ok so I try to get a tray of cranberry bliss (they were out), so I don't want anything, but have to sit in the drive through for awhile.
Side note: I went to the Los Altos location on Wednesday, mobile ordered the items I couldn't get at this location, went through the drive through and received them both as expected.

This was my go-to Starbucks.  This morning I got a rude barista who chastised me very publicly for trying to get my own drink carrier.  I assume it's a policy that when you order multiple drinks on a mobile order, you should be expected to wait in line and try to flag down a busy barista to get a drink carrier so that you can actually carry your drinks out of the store.  You know, waiting in line to get a drink carrier almost defeats the idea of putting in a mobile order, doesn't it?  I get the idea of not wasting drink carriers, but common sense and a little customer service would be appreciated.  

In any event, there are lots of Starbucks and other coffee shops around town where you can get better customer service and you don't get a side of attitude with the $5 cup of coffee.  I'll gladly go there instead.

Parking really stinks at this location that's why I only have them three stars. When it comes to my chai they always make it right so no complaints there. 

You are better off going through the drive they at this location when it and the Panera right next door are busy because parking will be impossible. 

I love the petite vanilla scones  :)

I missed happy hour, but I got my seasonal favorite.Erynne was the barista at the window tonight and was very nice.  She saw that I had my furry friend riding shotgun and made sure he had his pup cup.  The grande peppermint mocha frappe that I ordered was a the perfect choice the match this warm December evening.  They were also very generous with the whip cream .

No filter. Worst iced chai tea latte ever. It's just sit milk with a hint of chai & no vanilla. Save your money & find a different Starbucks to go to. 

Take a look at my picture you will see

Just fine for grabbing a drink and going. The staff was polite, drinks were made fairly efficiently, and there's a counter area off to the side to wait for your drinks that is out of the way of people trying to order and pay. If you're looking for a place to sit and work, this isn't it. It's really just a walk-up stand kind of set up. There are rocking chairs down the hall if you want to sit and watch the tarmac, but if you need a place to hunker down I'd suggest hitting up the bar next door.
Like this place. Parking works. Drive through is easy. Wait is not too long. Friendly staff. Good representation of Starbucks brand.  Order is right each time.

Well, this location is cramped and not very well laid out. The staff was what I have come to expect at most Starbucks. Not the friendliest, but they do the job. I went once, and I don't have any inclination on going back. I am also not the biggest fan of Starbucks coffee, it's a bit to acidic for my taste. Oh well, there are plenty of other places to snag a cup of "joe". I will be seeking them out instead. Do yourself a favor and visit the St. Louis Bread Co. one level below right under the Starbucks. It's a much better choice, and you can get a bowl of soup at the same time!!!

One of the best Starbucks locations I've ever been to. The staff is on point with the service and the atmosphere is quite homey. What I also like are the barista favorites board. Each staff member states their favorite Starbucks drink on the board, whether it's original or customized. I would recommend this location for study sessions; however if you're studying on your own, bring headphones. It may be a bit too loud for your concentration.
Best Starbucks EVER! The staff is so kind and they truly know how to make your day. They also know how to make your drink of choice absolutely perfectly!

There is only one bad review for this location, and that really does say a lot. I am a regular at this store and I want to assure everyone that this is one of the most professional and comfortable Starbucks I've ever been to! The baristas here are amazing and always make my drinks perfectly! This staff holds some of the best customer service I've ever encountered.

This is my favorite Starbucks in town! Staffs are very friendly and they will remember you if you come few times. They may not remember the name but they might remember your drinks or that you've been there often. 

Many seatings and good internet so you will see a lot of people studying or having a business meetings. It's right under the Westport plaza so plenty of parking spaces. 

Only thing is if you come between 12-1 it might be busy since it's lunch time.

Here on business, and I needed a caffeine fix this morning ... STAT!

Glad to see this Starbucks was open at 5:30am, and I was clearly the first person in the shop today.  I was nicely greeted by Gail, who proceeded to share some really cool new techniques with their Clover Coffee machine.  She suggested I get the 100% Kona Clover - she was absolutely right, it is delicious!  It's smooth, not bitter at all- and she was so enthusiastic and knowledgeable!

Thank you for my java fix Gail - you made my morning!

I am a very frequent Starbucks customer. It's a habit, an expensive habit that I've tried to break but inevitably fail. My most frequented Starbucks is the one off 116th & Keystone in Carmel. Parking is a bit difficult, but parking is a bit difficult at almost every location. Currently they have the indoor seating closed again due to Covid. You can order inside and also pick up online orders. I enjoy their awards program and try to maximize various stars promotions that they run. I've found the best use of star redemption is for the sweet treats. You can get a sweet treat for 50 stars which is a great deal compared to 150 for a drink that may be less expensive than a pastry.

I order an iced coffee with vanilla and a snowman cookie. The service was really quick. The iced coffee was very tasty. This Starbucks is always busy with people from the nearby gym. They always have enough baristas working here so the service should be quick.

These super sweet baristas just made me a delicious drink in a jiff! :) The pastry case was full of amazing (& very tempting) treats, and there was plenty of seating & good vibes. I highly recommend stopping by here for an espresso drink and snack!

Great service! The people working at this location are kind and helpful and nice. They try their best and put the customer first. I always get great service at this location and I frequent many Starbucks nationwide.

Just stopped in to my favorite Starbucks (86th & Ditch - indpls) and was greeted with the worst customer service ever. The 3 ladies working were grouchy, angry, and not at all happy that the 5 people in line were disturbing them! 
There are too many 'bucks around for baristas at this store to treat customers this way

I enjoy this Starbucks as I have yet to go to a really bad one.  I say the building is nice and clean, the customer service is pretty good.

The smell of the coffee in the air is always a good fragrance to me.  The dining area is clean and free Wi-Fi.

My coffee drink or espresso has always tasted so good.  The sandwiches and pastries are great to and very healthy and delicious.

I can find no fault in this Starbucks as it lives up to the reputation as a great coffee house in my opinion!

I really like this Starbucks. Located in a somewhat grimy college town, this store is a breath of fresh air as the staff really knows how to keep the store clean and welcoming. Nikolett, the general manager, is always really cheery and down to earth- she never forgets to ask how my day is going, and she always follows up on my recent life events- I really appreciate that. It's hard to work during these COVID times, especially in the food industry, so I greatly appreciate the effort this crew displays in their customer service and beverage crafting. I get a grande hot white mocha probably five days a week from this crew, and they're impressively consistent with making it beautifully. Great work everyone! Keep it up :).

I Usually drive through Starbucks but today I had to use the facilities so I went inside. I ordered my usual iced blueberry black tea no liquid cane sugar two pumps sugar-free vanilla. It was not very busy. I used the restroom, came back out and waited and waited and waited for my ice tea. While waiting, another  lady asked where her egg bites were. She already had drank 1/3 of her venti tea and still no food. It appeared that the 2 young men "working" were too busy talking to a young girl to fill orders. One girl was working and she was doing everything. I'm not sure they left out the cane syrup, as I watched her make my drink. By that point I just wanted my drink and to leave. Not a happy customer today. I'm hoping Sbux sends me a request for a survey, as they often do.
This Starbucks is by my house and recently opened!! The employees are amazing! Coffee is great! They're super sweet to my pups in the drive thru!
Nice small Starbucks in the mall.  Seating is only outside in the mall but then you get to people watch.  The staff was fine for the volume that they see (low)

It's the closest Starbucks to campus until another location opens in the UCen. Until then, this will have to do. 

The location is on a pretty busy intersection in Isla Vista. It's not too far from campus, but it's quite a walk if you're way east. There's not much parking, but not many cars usually stop for Starbucks. Bike racks are sufficient. The inside is pretty small and crowded, I've never seen an empty table. 

The service is pretty good, most of the workers are UCSB students. The wait is pretty average compared to other Starbucks. 

I started using mobile orders more often, so the interaction is now limited. However, my orders are usually done pretty quickly.

You would think that Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks and that since they are a chain, you could pretty much walk into any Starbucks and receive a relatively similar experience.  That said, I've been to hundreds of Starbucks in numerous states and this location is consistently the worst.  

I've had issues with this Starbucks going back to 2007.  For years I refused to frequent this particular location even though it was very close to my former office because for some reason their coffee tasted bitter and they frequently messed up my and/or my boss's order.  That said, I recently moved temporarily into a rental in the Mira Loma area as my husband and I go through the home buying process to move back to our neighborhood in Damonte and unfortunately this is the only Starbucks on my route from my home to the freeway in the morning.  I figured that since so many years have passed, certainly they have had ample time to correct any inconsistency issues, but I was oh so wrong.  

On at least 3 separate occasions in the last few months I either got the wrong coffee or they forgot to put any flavored syrup in the coffee at all, that's fine, I called they fixed it.  It didn't really fix my crappy morning without my caffeine fix, but at least they fixed the issue.  

Today I went through the drive through as I do most Friday's and lo and behold, once again one of the drinks had no flavored syrup.  It was bitter tasting coffee and milk.  I tried to call and the first time they answered the phone and then set it down so I could hear the cashier taking orders and the chatter of customers and staff etc.  I sat there for a while thinking someone would get on the line, nope, they just wanted to silence the phone, but heaven forbid they speak to the customer who just paid $5 for a cup of crap coffee I could have made better in my own kitchen.  I called back twice afterward and they just let the phone ring and ring.  

From this point on I will either wait until I get to Carson City or go out of my way to go to the Damonte Ranch Starbucks who are always consistent.  It's not about getting a replacement cup of coffee, I have the funds to pay for another cup of coffee, its the disappointment of waiting in line, paying $5 for a cup of coffee to brighten up my Friday mornings and then getting swill and being inconvenienced by having to call and go back.  

I don't want a replacement, I'd like for your baristas to pay attention to what they are doing and to be consistent.  If they have messed up that many times with just my orders, I wonder how many other customers are consistently disappointed by the lack of accuracy and/or poorly made drinks.  

Sorry for ranting, I just wanted to give the back story on why this is so frustrating, but for one location to have continually screwed up for years is just incredibly annoying and I feel that management should be aware that they have the worst location in South Reno or any Starbucks I've been through throughout the U.S.

I would rather brave South American drug cartels and forage for coffee in the equatorial jungle than go to this Starbucks when the crowd is out. The line is terrible. When you get the urge for coffee, wait an hour, and go. At certain times of day, the 5-Stars will align, and you'll get in and out quickly. Otherwise, you might as well hop on a burro and head south for the real thing.
This is a smaller Starbucks but the size lends to it being a cozier, more familial, atmosphere. The staff is fast and friendly.
Lately there has been a 15-20 min wait for order ahead.  The store is too small and Starbucks is missing an opportunity.

Awesome customer service. I left one Starbucks to go to this Starbucks and they may good with my Starbucks account. I was really upset with previous store but this store really showed how much they care about their customers. Thank you for thanking the time and explaining the Starbucks  reward program as busy as they were today.

The Slowest Starbucks in tri state area! Expect 15-20 min drive thru times. Doesn't matter time of day or night.  If you do order ahead 10 min out and go inside to pick up the drink still wont be ready.

The worse Starbucks in the area. You'll wait over 20 minutes just for your food to get heated up with 7 people working and basically no one in the store. And 9/10 times they won't make your drink correctly. The staff always seems lost and confused. Very unorganized and hectic. Spent money here for breakfast and walked out with nothing because I didn't have 30 minutes to spend inside a Starbucks.

I came in early this morning and order a vanilla latte, after waiting 15 minutes and watching other customers come after me and getting their drinks, I asked about my drink , the cashier ask the Hispanic girl if she made the latte and she said no, she finally made it herself, I had to wait over 20 minutes when the store was empty to get my drink

I went here to get a tea, and a croissant. I bit into my croissant to find 2 long black hairs. Disgusted. Will never return. Tea was also too sweet. I said 1 pump of sugar, I watched them give me 5. They also took 15 minutes to make a coffee. If you want FAST service and safe food, I recommend going to the kirkwood location.

This was the most chaotic and disorganized visit to Starbucks I've ever been a party too. Instead of dealing with orders in the order in which they were received, they were dealing with in-store orders first, and then every once in a while asking if anybody had mobile orders. We waited 30 minutes for our orders, they were all placed around the same time, but yet there were several in-store orders that were filled before and between ours that were placed by people who walked in long after we did. When one levelheaded person asked somebody named Allison if they could close down the dining room so that they could catch up, she asked why and refused. This would have made perfect sense, considering they were not able to catch up, and there was so much chaos. Because they couldn't catch up, there was a drive-through line that was making it so that people couldn't turn from Lemmon Drive onto buck. Though the dining room is still open for people to stand at tables, it made an unhealthy situation for those who can't stand for long periods of time, such as my daughter, who is pregnant and really needed to sit down. They took the chairs out, but left the tables. If it hadn't been for the fact that it was so chaotic, we wouldn't have needed somewhere to sit anyway. We just wanted to pick up our orders and leave. As far as our orders were concerned, we had to ask for our pastries, in our daughter's case, or they were just left on the counter, in my husband's and my cases, and for the ones that were left on the counter, our names were never called. For once, we had no issues with our drinks though.

This has become my fave as far as Starbucks locations are concerned. It's in our neighborhood and I didn't realize how convenient the drive-thru service is during the early morning commute until just recently. 

I've been coming here more for their tea lattes. Why? Because I make my own coffee at home, and I like it better. I'd rather get something that I don't make well. Besides that, I'm more into the aromatic tea lattes during the holiday season. It's so comforting and calming. I've actually had a nicer commute this week because of it. My recent finds are the hot Matcha Green tea and the London Fog tea lattes. You won't find the London Fog tea latte on the store menu, but you'll see it on their website. It's aromatherapy in a cup (or it is for me). They have other tea lattes, but this one is my favorite. The grande size has 2 Teavana Earl Grey tea bags steeped in warm milk. They put something else in there to sweeten it. Maybe some cinnamon syrup, but I'm not quite sure. All I know is that it's my new favorite hot beverage from Starbucks. I'm also a huge fan of their Matcha Green tea. I don't know what kind they use, but ground Matcha leaves are typically full of good antioxidants. It contains that as well as some sweeteners so maybe not as healthy as one you would make at home, but the taste is all there. You can make it as healthy as you want it to be with non-fat milk and no sweetener.

Anyway, I like the service at this location. I also come here for the mini vanilla bean scones. They are small enough, and easily satisfy my sugar craving when needed. I've never been a big fan of their espresso. It has always been hot or miss for me. I just don't like that burnt coffee bean taste. The espresso blends branded as Blonde have been less bitter. Other than that, this place is a winner for me.
Busy busy busy. New location is up and running and doing so smoothly.  Even with a buy 1 get 1 happy hour going on. My carmel Frappuccino was perfect and made quickly. Great job everyone!
I don't understand how a coffee shop runs out of sweet and low and equal. Go to Publix or Sams or just close. Or go to Dunkin.

From what I've been told, this is one of the highest grossing Starbucks outside of Philly. For as busy as they are they can have a lack of urgency and an attitude of boredom but typically have their act together and getting a drink is usually a smooth process. Attractive and comfortable inside. That being said, I have been going here twice a day since I moved here six months ago and not once has an employee ever used my name, which is a major faux pas in Starbucks culture.  Parking can be a challenge. By the time you get all of the employees parking their cars it leaves a few spaces for customers thus I end up going through the drive through more than I would like which itself can be "challenged" at times.

Hey guys! Thanks for wasting my time by not fulfilling my mobile order this morning. Waited 20 minutes before leaving empty handed and with $5+ less on my mobile account 

Hope you do better next time

This is one of my favorite Starbucks.  Not because the drinks are better (I'm actually pretty sure that Starbucks strives to have your drink taste the same at all locations) but because the people at this Starbucks are quite possibly the friendliest baristas I've ever met.  They are always cheerful, smiling and you can tell that they enjoy what they do.  Plus they all seem to like each other with the jokes that they're telling as they prepare your order.  Even in a large super-chain like Starbucks, they manage to make it feel like you're in your little neighborhood "everybody knows your name" kind of coffee shop.

Really nice baristas and cashiers. Chill music to work next to. Delicious drinks. Long community table, a few tall ones, seats at the bar, and a number of armchairs around. Board games and connect 4 for any time you want to channel your inner child (no one's judging). And finally, clean restrooms!

This is why I think this spot deserves     .

If we had a zero rating I would give it here. The way you treat all patrons is crucial. The disrespect for our local law enforcement 4 days ago was uncalled for. Why can't businesses stick to their specialty? Why must everything be political? From this day forward I will not visit a Starbucks. I will not buy gift cards etc as I often do for my staff. Instead I will go elsewhere. This community is in support of our local police. You might consider that the next time your staff behaves rudely to them. Oh, and maybe take a class in service recovery because your manager just failed!
Liam was especially nice to me at the drive thru today. These guys always give me a good vibe and yummy coffee! Thank you Delran!

It is an okay Starbucks. It has definitely become and chain store. I wished it was like back before it got so big that they would give you your coffee in an actual mug. Their were Starbucks store in the east coast that would do that. The ounces here don't. I don't mind their coffee it's still pretty good and the atmosphere is good. There is just a romantic memory that I had with that Starbucks in the east coast. It was raining out, you could smell the wet rain as it dripped from my clothes. I order some coffee and sit down. I start reading the news paper and as I was reading here came this lady politely interrupting me to serving me some coffee. "Here your coffee sir" the lady says with a smile on her face. I can just image all this happening in black and white hehe jk. Any how enough of letting my imagination take over. I just miss the days when Starbucks wasn't so commercialized. But I would come back here to grab a cup from time to time.

Bless this Starbucks location keeping their drive-thru open during the pandemic. But we waited in the line for 25 minutes. The coffees, supposed to be with 4 shots, were very milky and weak. The staff was perplexed over our online order and charged us for a breakfast sandwich that was out of stock. As a nurse who urgently needs to see my coronavirus patients, i was looking for a quick boost of energy, but wasted 25 minutes over poorly made coffee. I'd highly recommend the other Starbucks locations in the King of Prussia area

I went to this location due to the temporary closure of the location closer to my home.  
I used the drive-through to place my order and the person speaking on the other end was speaking very rapidly.  So...when he finished his spill, I proceeded to speak really rapidly as well. The guy burst out laughing as did I. I thought it was hilarious he was so funny! It was a pleasure to speak with someone with a sense of humor.
I approach the drive-through window and we both were laughing he was very pleasant and personable and I really appreciate it that on a subsequent visit I found out his name is Gabe and I just wanted to say that he's an awesome barista and it's a pleasure to speak with someone who appears to be so jovial each time I visit this location and see him thanks Gabe!
I also experienced a very awesome person and when I came through the drive-through on another visit I proceeded to go to the window to pay for my order and the barista said that the car before me had paid for my order.  I was astounded so I knew that I'd have to pay it forward during my next visit ...which I did and I told the lady at the window to please tell the car behind me that they would need to pay it forward as well  to keep it going! 
Woo hoo!
Spread a lil happiness during these difficult times!

Usually I go to this Starbucks often, and it's pretty good. But this time it was really bad, like REALLY BAD. The lady taking my order was nice and helpful, but the lady who made the drinks did an awful job. It tasted rancid almost. Same thing with my boyfriend's drink, they tasted the same type of gross. I couldn't even drink it, it was so bad. I'm sure the girl making it was new but still- if you're making drinks you should know what you're doing. I was extremely disappointed and am praying next time I come here my drink tastes better. The cake pop was really good though. Anyways, I called them to complain about the drinks being super bad, and no answer. So then I called again, still no answer. I called FIVE TIMES AND NO ANDWER!!! I was furious. So we drove back and complained and apparently they "don't take calls after business hours"! I'm sorry but if the same number calls you five times in a row YOU ANSWER!! Anyways, the lady who remade our drinks, Heather, did a fantastic job and I am pleased. Heather and her drink making skills are the only reason that I'm giving 2 stars, otherwise it would be 1 for sheer lack of customer respect and improper drink training on employees.

I've been here recently a handful of times and have had the full experience from walking in and ordering at the counter, to drive thru to mobile order pickups and every time I've been in, my order has been made with such exactness that I fear all other locations may never live up to my experience at this one.
Like most customers I place what I think are complex coffee beverage orders and they are made exceptionally well.
The location interior is clean, has plenty of seating, never feels crowded even when there are several customers inside, and the staff are always focused and friendly.
I placed a mobile order this morning and although I did wait a couple minutes longer than expected, my drink was made perfectly leaving me feeling as though it was exactly the way I had envisioned it should taste.
As long as I am in this area I will continue to patronize this location.

Usually this location is really awesome and they have been open much earlier and more often than some branches at this time. But I arrived this morning and was allowed to place a mobile order right at 6 o'clock this morning. I got to the front door and it was dark and no one was even there. I could only wait 10 minutes before I had to leave and go to work so I left empty-handed. Super disappointed with this location this was always my go to spot. I hope they figure out their stuff.

This Starbucks has one of the better airport layouts that I have seen with both an entrance and an exit area for customers.  Everyone was very helpful and the staff did not mind taking the time to provide me a pour-over decaf.

This Starbucks has the worst drive thru, doesn't matter what time of day the line is always wrapped around the parking lot. Seems no one inside cares. If you have the option go to another one until they change management or staff.

Yup a Starbucks - and i love me a good coffee.

Stopped in here on an afternoon on the way to take a walk on the greenbelt and i needed a little pick me up!

Staff was very nice, the coffee was good, and they were sweet even tho i was using a "freebie"

It is on the corner of state street, but to get back out of the parking lot and head left on state street can be a bit of a challenge! But everyone is friendly and lets you in and out of the street.

The location is pretty big and the patio outside is pretty good sized as well.

Went in really early morning I was waiting on my coffee and noticed a bug in the case wer they have all their baked goods...nobody was I. The store so I call the girl over doesn't even come so I say it out loud hey ther is a bug in ther still doesn't turn continues what she's doing and say ok with her back turn. Still waited for my coffee and she still didn't move mean while bug sitting all over that muffin  I honestly said it nice I have worked in the food industry before and sometimes it happens. But this chick did not move and did not care at all lol y'all got to do better

Possibly the friendliest Starbucks I've ever been in. I sat inside for a few hours quietly working on a project. The baristas made the initiative to make every "guest" feel welcome. Very upbeat and positive!

We had a quick breakfast prior to our flight from TIA to BWI.  The breakfast sandwich could be compared to McDonalds.  Of course the coffee was good as usual.  I wonder how average people can go here every day for breakfast and save money for a rainy day.  I guess it is about carrying a Starbucks cup to show your status.

worst starbucks in human history. i don't understand how someone can't clearly take a simple order here without screwing it up every single time. my girlfriend even got an uncooked sandwich from here.. i received a drink with 4 add shots in it... not sure if they're trying to kill people or not but i've been here over 10 times out of convenience and no bs, they've only got one of my orders right... 
today i go inside because my order was wrong once again and the girl making my wrong drink gets an attitude... it's the holidays for crying out loud... be jolly and please serve your food cooked and drinks to order... :)

great staff!!!
Sean, Lindsey, Zeb, Stacy, Sara, Aaron, Molly, Beth & Alicia, Daniel, Greg, & of course
The Ever Refreshing, Entertaining, FABULOUS, Friendly, Bubbly, Cheerful personality RODNEY
great place to hang out 
or stop by, while shopping on mass. ave
bring back ashtrays!!!

While sitting outside tonight with our Fishmonger, Mary & her daughter B , Daniel did an AMAZING JOB @ cleaning outside & Feng Shui ing the tables, while Lindsey & Greg worked equally as hard inside
This Starbucks was not the cleanest property I've been to and did have some cleanliness concerns. Otherwise, the drinks we got were good and the service was ok-kind of slow.

Lame. Open til 9 means open til 9. Not closed 10 minutes before 9. You should be able to go through the drive thru before 9 and get a drink - but we went at 10 til and it says - sorry we are closed. They are inside staring out. If you're open til 9, stay open til 9!

Horrible.  Out of food.  All display cases were nearly empty and looked bombed out.  Counter person unintelligible.  Lots of empty Cardboard boxes in the seating area.  Got drink wrong.  Got the last food item available and wasn't what they said.  Obviously no management attention here.

Ouch one star I know, but I do have my reasons.

Okay I do like the fact that it is in a little college town and is literally less than 5 minutes away from my apt. BUT that is not enough. I decided to drop by to use up the $10 gift card I got for Christmas. The first time I went here, I got a venti caramel frappuccino. It was too milky and too icy... barely tasting like coffee and the only caramel I tasted was the sauce on top of the whipped cream. I've never tasted anything so crappy tasting from any other Starbucks. The second time I went was 2 days later (which was today) to use the rest of my gift card. I got the strawberries and creme, which came out too milky and icy (bland.. just like before). I decided to actually say something since it wasn't right and asked for a new one (with a little more strawberry flavor). The second one tasted WAY too syrupy and unnatural. I had to complain AGAIN.. Finally the third and last one came out to be decent, but still wasn't the same as other Starbucks, but I was content. (I hate to complain anyway =/)

I guess the fact that this Starbucks is in IV is why it doesn't compare to other ones.

The friendliest staff of any Starbucks I've ever been to, no question. I've been a few different times of day and it's always the same experience. The baristas greet everyone by name and genuinely care about how your day is going. I will say, it can be a bit slow during very busy times. But, that's to be expected. I usually order ahead online to avoid waiting in line. What is frustrating, though, is that I've had drinks totally forgotten. One time I waited over ten minutes for my hot tea that I ordered, only to find out that the cashier was supposed to make it right after I ordered it. They quickly remedied the situation when a manager noticed how long I'd been standing there. Since moving to mobile ordering, I've had no problems. Their efficiency with mobile orders and the friendliness of the staff up my rating to 4 stars instead of 3.

If could give this Starbucks no stars I would.  I have been on various occasions and have not been pleased.  They have been out of items, felt like I was bothering them and take forever to fill an order once it is placed.  Tonight I pulled up behind a car that had just gotten to the drive thru.  About 3 minutes later they had still not gotten their order taken.  They weren't busy.  I finally went around and left.  They need to get trained by the Starbucks at 44 & 141, where they are quick, friendly and efficient.

I absolutely love this place. I have been here for almost 5 years and I have never had a bad experience. Everyone is friendly helpful and always on the move. They are very efficient and fast in their service of customers. I have never had a drink made incorrectly and they are always willing to honor my weird requests for drinks. I am there so often they only ask hot or cold which is a blessing because half the time I'm sleepwalking there. I give my whole hearted recommendation.

I have to say this is one of the worst places ever I live up the street and I've been here about five times and every single time I have to wait about 30 minutes for my order and most of the time they forget so I had to repeat my order twice sometimes three times they're stupid and all they do is giggle and talk talk talk the worse I won't be going there again!!

You know, I try to stick with local businesses, but I can't help my addiction to a consistently great tasting Americano...

This is the location I frequent most when I'm not traveling. The staff are friendly, and if you visit frequently will greet you by name. The space is roomy with plenty of tables, a couple of comfy chairs, and one table that is big enough to spread out your work. The WiFi is your standard AT&T pay-for-time-online.

The people watching is good almost always, but especially during the AM on weekdays when we're all migrating in to work...

I spent 30 minutes in the drive thru today (2/23/2020). This is the longest I've ever waited in a drive thru, probably will not come back to this location, just crazy. Received my drink and it was melting from the bottom up and the whipped cream was completely melting already. This tells me that the drink was just sitting there waiting and waiting. Extremely frustrated with my experience today

Waited 5 mins for the girl to even wait in us .. ordered venti creme Brûlée latte.. worst ever !!!!! Waited 10 mins yes 10 mins for the coffee.. ordered whipped cream and non!!! Went back and asked for the whipped cream she said oh it melted . I said NO she just handed it to me . There were NO crumbles on top and absolutely NO FLAVOR ! It tasted like warm milk !!!!!!!!!!!! Tired of paying the prices and NOTHING is ever right !!!!!!!

Honestly, one of the best Starbucks I've visited, in a while.  Professional staff.  Quiet place to work.  My coffee has been perfect and prepared quickly, every day.  I'm visiting for the holidays and this has been my go to for a little quiet time every morning.

It's Starbucks. 

Overall the experience here is exactly what you expect. The coffee is fine (not great), the customer service is generally friendly and fun, and the amenities are comfortable (but not too comfortable). Wait times are average too, unless there's a line at the register or in the drive through.

See when busy the staff here seem particularly discombobulated. It's odd.
