Instead of them acting as a tight team, predicting each others movements, and almost appearing to be dancing a careful ballet, this team seems to step on each others toes, miss beats, and leave guests hanging. It's not all that often, but I've observed this more than a few times.

My order is hard to mess up. Grande Blonde or Pikes, no room. I can't comment on their ability to make the more complex beverages.

As far as a neighborhood stop, I'm happy this is mine.

This isnt my usual Starbucks, but stopped here because of convenience. I ordered an Iced Caramel Macchiato with Soy milk, since i am lactose intolerant. When i received my drink I automatically new something was off due to the color of my drink. It looked very light, like almost just pure milk. And it tasted pretty much only milk, so i think they didn't add the right amount of expresso shots. However i needed to be on mu way so I didn't ask about it. Also later i started feeling off... kind of how i feel when i drink cows milk. Sure enough when i looked on the cup, it was not made with soy milk like i asked. So now im at work, sick, and tired. I know mistakes happen, but pretty much everything about the drink was incorrect.

Went in tonight RIGHT before they closed and the workers were sooooo awesome! Marley and James were so welcoming and fun to come in to I love when I can come into a store and feel like I'm friends with the workers. Lizzy also made sure that I was taken care of after my order was taken. The store looked very clean. Service was fast, coffee was good, overall a good experience.
I never leave reviews but this is the only Starbucks that makes my drink orders right, everywhere else is bland/watery. The line could be long sometimes for drive thru but thats expected

Absolutely love the drive thru here. I know it seems strange, but there is definitely something about this drive thru location that is special. It may be that the barista at the window takes a few minutes to get to know you while your drink it being prepared. It may be something more simple, like they've always gotten my order 100% accurate and this, sometimes, does not happen at the drive thru because of the garble coming through the machine. But here...here we have a winner.

Love this Starbucks. 

They have their mobile ordering system down. Every time I order on the app, I walk in and my order is ready. I can be in and out in 30 seconds. 

This is very helpful when you're running to a meeting and need to grab something quick. Definitely recommend. 

Also the baristas are usually full of smiles and welcomes.

This is the worse Starbucks I've ever had. I don't understand the amount of traffic because, the quality is horrible. I have giving them multiple tries from cold frappes, to hot  coffees. I've also tried them years later and still they're horrible. I don't recommend this Starbucks at all. Travel a little further to another location. Save yourself the expensive disappointment.
What a great staff!! I ALWAYS get greeted and most of the time they have my drink ready before I get to the counter.

I love this upscale Frontenac location (I'm being dramatic with the "upscale" statement) lol

Anyway this "Bucks" is awesome simply because the decor, set-up and overall feel I get when I walk in just does something magical for me.  It's next door to Froyo also; always a perk.

No drive-thru but lots of seating in a variety of styles: stools, sofa chairs, window seats, group bar arrangement. 

FYI, the four stars is because they lack a drive-thru and when I'm in a hurry or its raining cats & pitbulls....I need a drive up option people!

I wonder if I was having an off day in my personality, or if the store was having there own off day.  I am a huge Starbucks fan, but I really wasn't impressed with my one visit to this place.  I don't like to be negative to my Bucks, but this one and I didn't seem to mix well.

Didn't get the drink I ordered and staff just seemed to be distant.

Place was very busy, so they obviously do well by others.

This location has HORRIBLE service. I always thought maybe it was one or two grumpy employees but I've lived in the area for many years and have visited multiple times over the years and never once have I had a good experience. The food is lackluster, nothing ever taste fresh including the desserts. The drinks are okay but definitely not worth the price. I'm not a fan of businesses with crappy employee attitudes and this one doesn't seem to change ever. Skip this location!
It's decent enough, overpriced and sometimes the drinks are great and sometimes just subpar.
It is what it is, the staff suck and the coffee is good, you need to put up with all the BS from the staff.  Believe me they will frustrate you over a cup of coffee!
Worst Starbucks I've ever been to. They managed to screw up a 3 item order twice. We only went there out of convenience but big mistake.

This Starbucks is the slowest I've been to yet. They are out of nearly everything and won't get a new shipment in for weeks and then tell you that it's been discontinued. I've never gotten a sandwich fully heated here, it's always cold in the center so you have to ask for things double toasted. I give it 2 stars only because the people working there are always very, very nice!

Horrible service. My wife ordered a tea with coconut milk and after she saw the drink preparer begin to pour water in her drink, she reminded him she wanted coconut milk. They looked at her, continued to pour water in it. Then topped it off with a splash of coconut milk. If considering coffee/tea, you're better off waiting until you get on the plane to get a drink.

The line is always sooooo long and all i see is one person at the register. It's like this every time i come through. It's 3:44pm on a Monday. Please hire more employees. It's always always always an issue

The customer service is great and what can I say....Starbucks has the BEST COFFEE, cake pops aroumd! I LOVE Halloween time, my favorite Pumpkin Spice Frap is available. I wish they'd bring back the Unicorn Frap. I was unable to get the sour sauce in mine when I had it since everyone ran out of it but it was still delicious. The insides cozy and they have two lounge chairs by the door.

This Starbucks is one of my favorite "To Go" to places out here in Spanish Springs! They continually excel at high quality Customer Service every time I visit! They are always greeting you with cheer and a smiling face. They are familiar with my Favorites and normally know what I want even before I can place my order...always amazes me! If you're looking for great Customer Service along with your favorite brew,  this is the place to go!

I ordered a strawberry Acai lemonade  No scoops strawberry today but they gave me it with strawberry and took them out as if they thought I wouldn't notice in the picture you can see a seed I managed to pick up and last week I ordered the same thing and they gave me a strawberry Frappuccino
Great staff. They are super friendly. Great indoor and outdoor seating areas. They make the best lattes in town. Drive thru is convenient and fast, especially when its raining.

there are several starbucks in the airport but I am referring to the one located outside the US AIRWAYS gates.

I was treated to rude and disrespectful service.
I had a reward on my card and attempted to use it, when the cashier didn't know how to work my phone, she gave it to another worker, who took my phone and attempted to enter my card into the machine.
She turned me away immediately and told me there was no money on my card, umm lady I have 5 different cards you just happened to enter the wrong one.

She gave me this look at service as if I was not good enough and after a red eye I really wasn't having it especially since I did not get any coffee, because I refuse to buy coffee from such rude service, HMS HOST will be hearing from me.
The employees at this Starbucks location are always very kind, speedy, and give me helpful recommendations. This is definitely my favorite starbucks in the area!

The young lady at the drive thru Emma made my day she was so helpful and positive so friendly. 
To be honest the whole team is always great but 
this young lady EMMA  is so amazing.. thank you for making my day so much better and for the great customer service you gave .. 
With a lot of businesses short staff you don't get that kind of customer service .
The way they are  happy to be at work and we're happy to help the people that come in.
so I appreciate her I appreciate it great work and great customer service..

The ladies here were all friendly and attentive despite being swarmed by customer's orders. I mostly appreciated how the one who was making the drinks kept the waiting customers updated with the status of their beverage.

First time here

Quiet

Music playing in background

Friendly staff

Quick service

Highly recommend !!

I waited for my unfortunate coffee for 40 minutes

the barista told me that I should wait more and that I generally want from them. people who came later than me took their drinks a long time ago.

Stopped by next door at Three Dog and on my way around the corner decided I needed a Trinta Black Tea. I've never been in this location. This location could really use a face lift. It looks kinda tired and very dark. Service was fast and my order was right.

This is my most regular Starbucks stop! Being across the street from my office really helps! (Doesn't help my wallet though...) The staff is very friendly, and I've never had an issue with the many mobile orders I put through on a regular basis! It's a small location so it can fill up fast if it's busy, but most customers are coming and going so there's usually a spot to sit. There's also a walk-up window outside if you're sitting in the shaded area next to the building. I haven't tried that yet, but it looks like a good spot for a meeting or just to hang out and enjoy people watching (perfect area for it). This location is also a "reserve" location so you can find specialty coffees here, and they have cold brew and nitro cold brew on top! I'm a fan.

I go here almost everyday and today I found a hair in my coffee as I was drinking it I tried calling to bring it to someone's attention but no one answered the phone. This is extremely unsanitary there should be more precautions taken when employees work around food.
This Starbucks takes so long, there was 6 cars in the drive thru and I was sitting there for 30 minutes before I even got to order.

I used to luv having a coffee in here as I live in the neighborhood but lately it's occupied by homeless people, they literally sit there all day with all their shit around, looks like their base. The management doesn't do anything about it which is a pity because they are losing their regular customers..
Very good Starbucks, super close to Tampa bay, friendly staff and quick service. Starbucks drinks are super delicious as always.
The drive thru line here is horrible. Two people in front of me and I sat in my car for 10-15 min to get a cold brew. Should just go inside, but i am not sure if they would be any better.
Best Starbucks I ever been too. Very friendly and awesome staff members. They are very helpful. Don't be afraid to ask. Place is clean and coffee are fresh!! Great job! Keep up the good work!
Worst Starbucks experience ever staff could care less no clue as to product.. they didn't follow the Barista promise.
Hi. Best Starbucks Ever. Forever and Always. Simply because of one thing.... COFFEE. And ONWARD. And Max B. For the McRussell clan of the Clan McRussell
Painfully slow, The management staff seems not to care if you are waiting for 20 minutes before they open another register. This location has gone down hill, it use to be my favorite.

This is my go to Starbucks, mainly because of the baristas. I can only speak for the morning staff, not the night staff but the one girl(i believe her name is kate) always makes my drink perfect and is consistently upbeat. Their mobile orders are always ready when you get there (I live about five minutes away and typically order when I'm backing out of my driveway) and they can manage a line pretty quickly. Most of the staff knows me by name(not sure if that's a proud moment or a I spend too much money here moment...) but it's a super nice touch. They have adequate amount of items for sale (tumblers, etc) and are always stocked. The only reason they get four instead of five stars is because this location has stopped carrying the passion tea which is my favorite.

I am out of carrots. I am out of sticks. This location has time and again proven that they are utterly incapable of producing the most basic of coffee drinks. I order an "iced coffee with cream, sugar, and a shot of espresso" every time. They repeat the order back correctly to me. Yet somehow they manage to omit the sweetener on an infuriatingly regular basis. 

I do not like the taste of their coffee, which is the whole reason I get an iced coffee with sugar so that it shocks my taste buds and I am blessed to drink a tasteless, sugary caffeinated drink. The lack of sugar makes the drink absolutely horrid and I cannot understand why I keep thinking they'll get it right this time. I keep giving them the benefit of the doubt but not anymore. Not again. 

I am dumbfounded. Bewildered. Utterly aghast at the surgeon like precision in which they dupe me into thinking they did it right this time. It is unfathomable and inexcusable and I will never make the mistake again.
This is in an airport and this Starbucks closes at 2pm. The one star should be self explanatory.

I've been studying at this location for a couple years now while also occasionally checking out other cafes/coffee bars and I always end up coming back here. This Starbucks has an awesome layout when it comes to seating but more importantly, the staff here are amazing. Small gestures like remembering to get me a cup of water with my coffee even though I always forget to ask, or patiently talking me through what comes inside a Pmkin Spiced Latte without rushing me out the way, will definitely make you feel appreciated and welcomed. Thank you!

Typical airport Starbucks, except the ladies at the counter were exceptionally nice!
Air travel isn't as friendly as it used to be, big thanks to the staff this morning for making it a little friendlier!

I used to stop in this Starbucks in the Montgomery Mall every now and then when my friend worked here back in 2016/2017 or when I was hanging out with a group of friends and we stopped here. Since my friend left in August 2017, I haven't really been back since. This can be attributed to a few reasons. One is that I'm not a regular Starbucks goer, the second is I mainly visited this location to visit my friend and third is I'm not usually in the Montgomery Mall as much as I used to be. I don't mind Starbuck's products but since my friend left it seems the few times I did stop in this location has gone a bit downhill with service and employees. There's a Starbucks much closer to where I live (and even a bigger one across the street from the mall) and I'll stop in this one only if it is convenient.

I frequent this area of town so I end up at this Starbucks pretty often.

The staff has always been SUPER nice, and while I have never tried the food (except for the cake pops which are quite tasty) I have heard good things about it.

Also, my wait has never been more than 3min, which I might have just gotten lucky and missed the morning rush so far.

The coffee has always been tasty and hot too!
Slowest and worst Bucks around. Needs a Mgmt makeover. No matter what I've ordered in multiple trips always less than standard. Baristas don't know how to make drinks
The staff is always very friendly! Once saw me drop my drink and started making me a brand new one before I even asked.

Everything is fine, the sofa here is very comfortable and the environment is also good.  It is very suitable for work and writing. Many plugs under the seat can provide charging, which is very convenient.  Drinks are also normal, they are not particularly tasty or unpleasant~
They need help with their mobile service. Waiting for 10m for a mobile coffee is not what a customer expects when ordering mobile!

Good ol' Starbucks! I have been visiting this location a lot lately because i have been studying a lot and needed some quiet time and the aroma of coffee circulating through my nostrils. 

I never seem to run into an issue with anything here. They have WiFi and tons of seating. All the outlets work properly and are equally spaced amongst the tables. 

I'm giving Starbucks 3 stars because every Starbucks I have visited does not recycle or display any type of blue can or triangle saying we recycle. A multi billion dollar company such as Starbucks should consider recycling and it is crucial for the environment.

I visit Starbucks often and I get a regular hot mocha every time but at this location it always tasted gross. One time I opened the lid and it looked like grease at the top. I started feeling sick after I drank coffee from this location. Anyway, I don't visit this location anymore. The Starbucks on N McCarran is awesome though!

Just the best bunch of people at this location. The baristas are always quick to make sure our dogs (Moose & Ringo) get some extra loving. 

Special shout out to Jack who was more than willing to help me out with a technical difficulty I was having on the Starbucks app in the drive thru. Awesome environment and great service !
The barista won't let me order a soy latte with cinnamon powder... She insists it is for the cinnamon dulce latte only.

The perfect spot to sip and recoup from a long day of shopping. My favorite aspect of this particular Starbucks is how amazingly fast they are. Yeah, there's always a line. It's a mall...I expect this, but the time it takes to get my drink? It's next to nothing. This is probably one of the most efficient Starbucks I've ever been in. This is saying a lot, considering I am both unabashedly addicted and worked for Starbucks for three years.
Very sweet staff. They always get my order right and have the best fun-loving personalities :) 10/10 recommend going here and chilling in the café to work on art or read a book, etc.

DISCOURTEOUS: lacking courtesy. This Starbucks has mastered the ability to hire discourteous employees.

Unless you're a hipster with skinny jeans and sporting black rimmed glasses, your chances of getting good service are very slim to none!

I've been to this particular Starbucks a handful of times. It's in the old 'hood of Lockerbie, and I like to reminisce the fun times I had there before the neighborhood changed into hipster central. {frown face}

This Starbucks is conveniently located on my way outta town, and will admit that it is one of the nicer (non cookie cutter) stores. The food is nicely displayed, and the coffee has always been above average. Please note: I am not a huge fan of Starbucks coffee. I only buy coffee here because of the convenience factor.

This morning was the final straw. I hate foo foo coffee that has whipped cream, sprinkles, and all of the useless garbage on top of it. I ordered a seasonal coffee, and POLITELY requested that they withold the foo foo stuff. The disgruntled employee rolled her eyes, and shrugged when I asked for a copy of my credit card receipt. Shame on me for being detailed with my finances. 

When I was waiting for my coffee and banana bread, the mule of a woman, who on a dark night could be mistaken for a man, literally threw my straw on the counter, and slid my coffee, in which it almost fell off the counter, if I didn't react swiftly and catch it. She responded {deep voice} with not a thank you and have a nice day, but with "oops."

Won't return!

I stopped here June 24 while heading to my gate. The line was super long. When I finally got to the counter, there was only 1 register being used. Omg!!!! I figured, ok my caramel waffle cone frappuccino would be worth the wait. NOT!!! It took a while for them to make it because I believe they didn't know how. It was watery; Hardly any flavor. Surprised!!!! I never experienced that at a Starbucks. Very disappointed. I will not go back. If the line wasn't so long I would have returned it; that's how horrible it was.

They have done amazing things here! They have plenty of staff to make your orders hot and fast. There are  markers on the floor to help practice social distancing. There is someone who prepares and bunches orders for people to come pick up. We ordered inside and then picked our stuff up pretty quickly. I felt safe, comfortable and valued as a customer and would happily come here again!

Come on, what is there to say.  Its Starbucks.  If you have ever been then you know.  It is nice to go into a place where the staff seem to care about their job and the work they do.  This seems to be the attitude at this particular establishment from my perspective and as long as you have that everything else tends to fall into place.

The St. Louis Galleria Starbuck's is located by the atrium on level 2 at the intersection of the main and Nordstrom's Promenades. It is a fairly small location with limited seating.

  Between exploring the mall and dining in Weber Grill, my family and I spent time here. A couple of  things I appreciate about a cup of quality coffee with two Equals is that it is zero calories and unfilling. Essentially I savored a cup of Starbucks coffee and the precious time being with my dad and brother while building up an appetite for Weber Grill. 

  I sipped the first cup inside Starbucks at the large table while charging my phone up in the adjacent outlet. Starbucks is one of if not the only business I know of in the St. Louis Galleria where you can charge up your phone. With my phone charged up from the outlet and me from the caffeine, I'd carry the refill cup of coffee a few feet away in the mall and conclude the St. Louis Galleria Starbuck's experience by sitting near my dad and brother on a plush chair overlooking the Disney Store while savoring the taste of quality coffee.

My fiancé and I are both in school and we love coming to this Starbucks  because it has a lot of room and tables. I put one star because every-time we come we have to tell them to turn the music down. The workers are very loud and the music is very loud. This place is no longer our favorite spot because of how loud it is.

Seriously how hard is it to make an grande ice tea in a venti cup with extra ice.

Took four minutes to explain then they had the nerve to ask me why?????

The inside definitely does not match the outside.

When we first pulled up I was really worried.  For one thing, I thought it might only be a drive through, since it advertises that it is a drive through on the sign.  The second, was it looked a little run down.

Boy was I wrong.  When I walked it I immediately noticed the rustic feeling to the store.  I have never been in a Starbucks that is decorated like this one is.  There are plenty of comfy chairs and tables.  

It became obvious quickly that this is a neighborhood Starbucks.  When the guy in front of me got to the front of the line the cashier just asked "the regular" and started ringing him up.  I ended up seeing this multiple times!  They hired really friendly people to work here.

I order an iced coffee with cream and sweetener multiple times a week from different Starbucks and I didn't like this one.  It tasted weak and a little bitter.  I feel like this was probably a fluke, but it does stop me from giving it 5 stars.

Ahh, yes. The super-local coffee shop "Starbucks".  As far as your standard Starbucks is concerned, there are always friendly and great staff working here.  Always a great place to stop while you are walking the Monon Trail or exploring the Broad Ripple shops.  If you are a creature of comfort and want something familiar--this place is a safe bet. If you are looking for local coffee shops, check out Hubbard and Cravens or Monon Coffee right around the corner!

This Starbucks is amazing I'm not sure why other people feel differently. Google had the wrong hours posted for when they opened and I got there before they were even open and went thru the drive thru. They literally took my order anyways and made my drink and food to perfection. I wish I got those employees names, but either way hopefully they see this and know who they are. I tried the Starbucks down the street and the one I think in marrero and neither compare. The only thing that is a little bad is the lines are always long here, but that isn't the baristas faults! It's busy and they are doing their best. I'm sure they're short staffed as most customer service jobs are! Love you guys so much

This is a great starbucks to order from if you have a tall pile of books to read and you just haven't had the time. A couple Sunday mornings ago before heading to work, I placed an order on the app...i drove up to the store, and thus began The Wait. This was no ordinary wait, but a legendary wait that will go down in history as quite possibly the greatest wait of all time - it took 42 minutes from the time the order was time stamped on the app to when the drink was in my hand. Not 10 drinks with complicated instructions and special requests. One. Drink. Back to the book thing - I'm thinking if you spend your wait time knocking off some books, you can put a serious dent in your book pile in just a few short weeks. I personally don't read books, so have no reason to ever come to this Starbucks again.

I live nearby this location and have visited a few times in the hopes that the service level would improve. And basically because they open earlier than everyone else in Town Center.

As I write this review on Mon 3/15/21,  the store's posted hours on its website are 5:00AM -10:00PM 7 days a week.

This morning I walked up to the door at 4:50AM.  No sign of anyone, no big deal.  I look up to a handwritten sign posted on the door a day earlier (Sunday) saying the store unfortunately had to close at 3:00PM, but would re-open next day (today) at 5:00AM.

At 4:55AM, 2 employees stroll up to unlock the door and one says to me, "I'm sorry, we're opening late today."  When I ask how late, a half an hour?  And the girl says "Yes."  Needless to say, I left.

I don't know what's going on at this location but avoid it if you can.  Service sucks and they obviously have forgotten they are in a service industry.  They don't even abide by their posted hours.  The cleanliness in the store could use improvement also.

Hey manager and employees : get your act together!
Just notified corporate.

Too bad Wegmans doesn't open until 6AM.

This is my main Starbucks! I try to go here every morning. Sometimes I'll do order ahead and I've never had a problem! They are typically always busy . I will say I've had hit or miss days with my drink but I am also keto so I get over it if it's not perfect. But 4/5 mornings I go it's usually super good and just what I need to get through my day

This is my favorite Starbucks to go to even though it's quite far from work and home. It's always worth it to make the drive ! I can always count on them to make my iced espresso or anything that I order, correctly. Whoever is in charge of training does a really good job.

Went during quarantine period right before work. Fast and friendly service in the drive thru. Drive thru is a little difficult to find since it is a shopping complex. Make sure you drive around to the BACK of the store.

Masks and social distancing/limited capacity enforced!! The workers here are so friendly and I came twice in one day to get a hot chocolate then a cake pop (hot chocolate not pictured). I came here after walking to downtown sb and back so my legs were dead shot but the cake pop was honestly such a nice treat after such gruesome exercise. I was trying to get the snowman cake pop though but they only had birthday and cookies and cream left. 

Thanks for keeping me hydrated starbucks, I rly appreciate it.

Ok,so I caved and started going to this location again. The mobile app lured me back in. It has made getting my daily tea latte a breeze. That is, until today. Today they pissed me off!!!! I ordered my food on the app 25 minutes before I got to the store, and when I got there, my order wasn't ready. I stood there for about 6 minutes before I realized people who ordered after me were getting their food first. When I inquired about my order, I found out some guy named Emilio screwed up and did not make my tea after being asked to do it by one of the people doing the mobile orders. To add insult to injury, after he was called out on his error, Emilio moved at a snail's pace to get it made. I was livid. I ended up spending about 20 minutes in the store, which defeats the whole purpose of ordering ahead on the app. I watched countless people in the store And drive-thru order and leave before me. Thank you, Emilio, for making me late to work today.
Drive thru is super slow. Waited for more than 20 minutes. Would assume it would be quicker.
The staff here is incredibly rude. They are dismissive and unapologetic, even when they get your order wrong twice. Worst Starbucks experience to date.

Very slow . I can always count of being late for work despite placing a mobile order . I've given this location multiple chances and will no longer be going here . There are always 5-6 people working but for some reason they are all clueless and frazzled . Sad that this is the only " real " coffee option in my area.

Tried to order online to speed process up but cant do it. So go to the store lobby closed and 14 cars in line. You can never trust that lobby will be open and even if store will be open on time. Employees are rude most of the time. This store really gives Starbucks a bad name guess start going to human bean or DB because major disappointment.

Redesigned store...comfy and trendy seating and a buzzing staff that, although new to most regulars, they're trying to make everything awesome for you the first time. 

There use to be music playing by way of their Starbucks Spotify playlist, but not here. And the WiFi...don't even bother to connect to it. LTE with 2 bars is faster most times. Seriously need a reconfigure to ensure it can handle customer load regardless of how much content is being streamed. 

But today, my drink was good...I got a smile... and it was just a normal experience. Nothing more or less.

Had a very nice experience here this morning.

We were pleasantly surprised they were open at 5 am. Great coffee, nice breakfast sandwich of egg white and turkey bacon on an English muffin. Very sweet young lady answered my menu questions and was quite charming. 

You will find them by Gate E 16.

The drive thru location is HORRIBLE!!!!Everything else is great!
Just a suggestion.......switch the drive thru around so that the line starts on the other end of the window and have the outgoing vehicles come out where theyre currently going in. The way it is now. cars line up right at the entrance and block the on coming traffic. It causes a lot of angry people. This shopping center is already a mess with coming in and getting out.

This is a main stop for me before flying out of Philly. In the mornings it's extremely busy, so be prepared to wait in line. Last week I waited about 20 mins in line before ordering. The staff isn't extremely friendly, but they've gotten my order right every time! You can't order ahead from the app here, but they accept payment from the app.

Ladies and Gents, this Starbucks just recently relocated from their Lithia Pinecrest Road and Bloomingdale Avenue location. It's now directly ON Bloomingdale Avenue, with Chick Fil-A, Wal Mart Supercenter and Bloomingdale Regional Library being nearby.

This new Starbucks is large and has a drive-thru, which I sometimes really appreciate when in a hurry, like I was this morning. 

Service was friendly and quick. Definitely a plus was that my drink was correct! Looking forward to this new Starbucks!


9/100

There are two Starbucks within spitting distance of each other in this area. One is located next to a pizza place and has a drive thru. The other is located inside Giant Eagle. I believe this one is the one with the drive thru.

Quite a line at 3pm but it moved pretty fast. Very friendly at the drive thru and my order was correct. Also free with my Star Points. Pretty easy in and out if you use Springmill Rd.

Horrible! Ordered ahead on the app, then sat in the drive thru for 20 full minutes behind 4 cars at 2pm on a weekday. When we finally got to the window, we sat another *8 minutes* while the employee tried to figure out our order (very complex: an eggnog latte and a pastry). There were many employees inside, seemingly quite busy, but doing what? Finally got my latte, and it was tasteless and scorched--ended up having to throw it out. What is going on in this place??

Typical Wednesday morning, windy, cloudy, and trying to get over that hump. Figured I would stop by Starbucks to grab me a "pick me up." Got a grande white chocolate mocha, and a sausage biscuit. I must say the barista (insert name here) because I didn't catch it, was super friendly and made me feel like he actually cared how my morning was going. He served me with the best white mocha I had ever had - thanks friend...and my biscuit was piping hot. I always go to this Starbucks because they have the most amazing service in town! This mini breakfast just jumpstarted my morning.

All the people there are really nice, my main complaint would be the frappucinos always seem over-blended, which doesn't mean they taste bad, just that the consistency is basically that of an iced latte. Fortunately I like iced lattes, it's just not what I ordered :/

This review is based solely on the two hot chocolates I received. They were watered down and horrible. My girlfriend and I were extremely disappointed. It will be awhile before I return here. The two employees on duty were also not very welcoming. They took my order, however, they expressed body language which made it seem they did not want to be there.

Do you ever just feel like some people go up and beyond with their energy! Well that's how my day started at 5am- Some people just leave a lasting impression on you, that kinda makes you smile and say- today's a good day! Thank you Helena for your awesome energy, and outgoing personality! You Rock!

Quick and easy to order, especially with the mobile app. The staff has always been friendly and helpful. The menu is large with coffee being the primary option. There are a number of drinks for none coffee people and kids. Starbucks is my go to place for dark, rich, and delicious coffee!

Looking forward to a late breakfast treat, I ordered a grande vanilla blonde latte and a bacon gouda sandwich. My total was given as $9.74, so I grabbed $10.75 in cash, planning on giving them the extra dollar as well as another as a tip. When my change was handed to me though, I only received a penny. Ok, I guess there goes that tip. Then I get handed my sandwich, which I see was brought over with 4 other food baggies, I assume for other orders. I leave the drive through, as it's packed and I don't want to hold them up, and take a sip of my coffee. It's delicious and I'm excited again... until I reach in the bag and feel something spongy. It's a slice of bread with nuts all over it. And guess what? I have a nut allergy, so I don't dare try to eat it. Such a let down. I check the order stickers and see that it was meant for the car behind me. I hope they enjoy my breakfast sandwich.

Customer service is great! Usually when I get my drink and ask for light ice, I still get a bunch of ice even when i say very very light ice please. But on my drink, the worker wrote light ice and then light light ice underneath it and I really appreciate it. After the person making my drink asked if the ice amount was alright. Staff is friendly and makes the experience much better

This is fast becoming my favorite Starbucks. Not only is this location close to me. But they are so friendly and earnest. I am so glad they opened this location. 

I also believe they love animals. If I have one of our dogs with us they often ask if they would like a puppacino. It is nice to know that our animals are loved.

Store is clean, large and has ample parking. However, the drive-thru speaker was hard to find for me. The first time I ended up at the window and asked if I missed it. Sure enough, I had but it didn't upset them at all that I was at the window.

One of the worst Starbucks experiences of my life - I was unaware that mobile order were more important than customers physically in the store. I was one of many who were waiting for their single drink order for 30+ minutes. I had to repeat my order 3 times bc the barista could not understand "iced" and "venti" because she would repeat hot vanilla chai, grande, even after corrected. As I saw multiple people walk in and out (due to mobile orders) everyone who ordered before me in store stood annoyed as they waited for their order. I get that they're busy, so I didn't really care, but when my order came out, as a grande I now joined the rest of the customers ANNOYED. I told the barista I ordered a venti, she persisted to argue with me about my order. I told her to look up the "wrong" order sticker the barista threw out bc that was most likely my correct order, but she rudely turned her back, and huffed and puffed while making my correct order. I'm sorry if you're busy, I get it, and I remained Patient for  over 30 minutes, for a single drink (that consists of a mix and milk, which doesn't take 30 minutes to make btw ) while others showed their frustration. I brought my concern to an employee first and was met with attitude, so now I'm here to let everyone know your dollar and order is considered second rate unless you're mobile ordering at this location- so I personally will not be back, which is sad bc I know this location always has the slowest service since I live down the road, but slow service and rude attitude toward paying customers is where I draw the line. And yes, I did witness this rudeness to other in store customers before me, so I would be extremely surprised if I'm the only complaint that came from this mornings experience.
This place is a Starbucks, but they have the grumpiest staff. Don't expect the super warm interaction you get at other Starbucks. There is one guy, a Brit who is funny.

Worst drinks and service EVER!  Their Frappacino's are weak and watery.  Now if you  want a creamy, rich tasting Frap, go to Nordstrom's coffee bar and order an Ice Storm!  OMG they are like drinking  a shake!  There are a variety of flavors, but my husband always orders the Caramel Ice Storm.  Since I watch my calorie and carb intake, I'll have a sip or two of his - it is so delicious.  If you try one, you'll agree with me that Starbuck's is the worst.
Friendly, quick service, even when they were about to close! A refreshing drink for a late hot night!

Good service. 
The drive-through line moves along just fine. 
The drinks are exactly what you expect them to be. 
Convenient location. Good parking.

Waited in the drive through line for literally 35 minutes for one hot cocoa. with only 3 people ahead of me in line. Waited at the window for 5 minutes without being helped because the worker just left the window unattended; had to flag another staff member down. watched them in there with absolutely 0 urgency as I was at the window. I'm usually understanding of workers in the service industry because I know things can get hectic, but this was straight up infuriating. avoid this place if you can. ruined my whole mood.

Killing time while waiting for someone, I needed a shot of caffeine as a picker-upper. There's nothing too different from this place from any other of the 3,984 other Starbucks within a 50 mile radius.

I ordered a mocha frappucino, they made it, spelled my name wrong, it was delivered, I sipped it. I'm a rebel. I refuse to use the words "venti" or "grande" or whatever. I steadfastly ask for a SMALL.

In the meantime, I was provided with a nice clean bathroom and a comfortable place to sit and relax until it was time to head out.
Painfully slow, Management doesn't seem to care if you are waiting 20 minutes before you can place an order. This use to be a great location but it has turned for the worst.

I visit this Starbucks very regularly and I have not had issues with how my drinks are made. They are typically made correctly and are good. The food is always fine when I order it. I know this is a busy store so I usually use the mobile app, and my issue with the store is how long it takes for mobile orders. I live about 8+minutes away and often times my drinks and especially food (generally egg bites) are not ready when I arrive and I still have to wait. I often have to ask after my food orders. Today was the real kicker though, I am really truly trying to use my own cups more. I know I can't mobile order, but the small amount of time should be worth it to avoid making the paper and plastic garbage. Well, It took 20-TWENTY- minutes to get my drink in my own cup. I know because I had to re-up my meter and it ran out, twice! During that 20 minutes I watched them begin to make my drink in a paper cup, then dump it into my cup (so much for saving paper) and I also watched him heat up the milk, walk away for something, watch the other guy come over, ask what kind of milk, other guy can't answer so he dumps it out. I actually watched him dump it TWICE. What a terrible waste. So my attempt at being green and using my own cup cost me more on the meter and results in a cup being thrown away anyway plus 2 serving of milk being dumped out. I was very disappointed with my service today. Oh, and other mentioned bad attitudes, I don't get that so much as no attention at all. I couldn't get anyone to assist or pay attention when I was trying to say- hey, you've had my cup for TWENTY MINUTES.
Not good customer service at all in the morning. Got my order wrong three times. All the girls have BRF.
I have never waited as long in a drive thru as i did here. I waited more than 30 minutes

I would like to give much appreciation to this Starbuck's team for working so hard this morning. (11/18/21). They were so busy and seemed to have very little staffing, but they were so kind and calm. They gave me a heads up that my drink would take a while to come out and I was okay with that. I just really want to give appreciation to them and for all their hard work. You guys were great!

The employees are friendly and follow the recipes. The bathrooms are GROSS! There was urine on the floor and diarrhea all over the underneath of the seat. I know this because a male was kind enough to leave the seat up. I will find another place for coffee. If this is how clean they keep the restrooms, I'd hate to see where the public is not allowed.

This Starbucks in the Tampa International Airport is a great sanctuary after being poked, prodded, groped, and wanded by the friendly folks at Homeland Security. 

After putting my shoes back on and stuffing my pockets with everything I had in them, grabbing my carry-on bag and shaking off the feeling that a male security guard REALLY likes his job a little too much, this Starbucks sits at the end of the  line.

Most people who feel the wrath of a burly homeland security guard seem to head here first. I always get my black coffee and a slice of Key Lime pound cake ( they don't always have it) or a couple Key Lime Cookies.
It's annoying every time I go to this Starbucks they put coffee in my caramel ribbon crunch cream. I'm shy and don't like to say anything but it's still annoying
Good location. I come here once in a while after morning workouts. Exceptionally friendly staff, always a joy to visit.
Fast service, the staff was friendly and helpful! I recommend the cheese Danish or any of their passion tea lemonades.
Very quick on online order and very businsss themed area for the corporate little meetings. It does smell like body odor a bit. Hoping that gets resolved. Very convenient and plenty of parking.
Super fast service and friendly people. No line at 7:30 on a Saturday morning. Got three drinks and our food in less than 5 minutes

It's one of those stores that you either love or you hate, as witnessed by a lot of the reviews on this site.  Most of the employees are really awesome folks, and the two stars are for them.  The neighborhood is inherently self-entitled, and that sometimes makes for a difficult dynamic.  A tendency of management to listen to and accommodate the vocal minority is frustrating, and it leads to systemic changes that alienate regulars - as also witnessed in many other posts on this site.  The more this store tries to look and feel like any other Starbucks, the more it loses its charm.

I liked this location but for some reason it was more expensive then the Starbucks in my city. They also have the breakfast sandwiches which was cool because my city's Starbuck's doesn't have them yet.

I have been coming to this Starbs for 4+ years. I have been here in the early morning, midday and evening and the staff is always very friendly and efficient. For a few months I went in for my coffee around the same time, always using my app and found that the staff began to recognize me. Nonetheless, the staff is what makes this place work. Starbucks coffee is the same wherever you go, but it's the people that make me come back.

I find it hard to rate corporate / chains because they're very similar, no matter where you go, in terms of the food and products. 

With that being said, this review isn't based on the food/drinks, but rather the service, the quickness of the drinks and orders being made, and the location. 

This is located a couple of blocks from my work, so it's always nice to walk down here to bring my lunch and grab a drink and people watch. I love the walk-up window and the free pup cups they offer! It's always a pretty busy joint, so it's not the best place to come for a chilled and relaxing atmosphere. 

Other than that, a pretty good Starbucks experience.

The store was clean and employees were friendly.
Coffee from this location is as expected from a Starbucks chain, it tasted fresh and was made to order. They weren't real busy due to the recent snowstorm so we didn't have to wait in line and our coffee and food came out fast. The cranberry scone we had was tasty as was the caramel latte. My only complaint is the space is quite small and not good for groups, especially when the 2 larger spaces in the back were occupied by a single person in each while the tables for 2 were all empty. So the 5 of us had to take up 3 seating areas in the middle of the place. It is conveniently located right off the freeway and not too difficult to get back on in either direction. The lot was car friendly, meaning there weren't any steep ingress/egress conditions to deal with, nor any gargantuan speed bumps.
Would I go back? -Yes, as long as we have a smaller group.

I can't believe I'm the first to throw down a review on the Starbucks inside of Target. The team here is always busy, and always on top, never been slow and they keep the line moving.  They don't offer the complete Starbucks line of stuff ... But hey I don't have two make two stops to get the Chai' and stuff I love.  The service is awesome ... The products are good and I can drink my Starbucks in Target.  Fanatic Concept!
An impeccably clean Starbucks with a drive-through. Employees are friendly. Other than that, typical starbucks fare.

Well the curse of the wrong hours continues... third time in a week a place is not open the hours it says on maps or Yelp. 4pm on a Tuesday I needed a bottle of water... I walk up and the places was closed, at 4pm. Hours said til 8pm\/
Btw I think the reason for so many bad reviews on the service and lack of staff is probably because it seems to be a lot of rich spoiled kids around here that really don't need to work;

Nothing like sitting in the drive they for 30 minutes to find you missed the teeny tiny order screen and instead of them helping you at the window anyway- they tell you to drive back thru to the end of the line and order! Poor service. I will now become a Dunkin Donuts patron for life!
This location is in a weird location and gets very busy!! Service is pretty quick. I hate the parking lot abd drive thru layout!

I've been a Starbucks customer for a long time and this location is THE WORST!!! I pay way to much to get no whipped cream with my order and they NEVER make the coffees right! I order a frapp everyday and it's never right from this location, it's always watery and taste horrible!! I also order double shots and you can tell they don't put them in my frapp cause it doesn't even taste like it does when I get from other locations. I always get extra whipped cream and They always say They have no whipped cream. They need to hire new staff and not take orders if they don't have the proper ingredients to make the order!

I came to this Starbucks because it's near my house and I usually love Starbucks drinks. Yesterday, 11/4 I came into this Starbucks and ordered a Grande Chestnut Praline Frappuccino. The girl at first had my order down as a Chestnut Praline Cappichino, which I had to correct her. Then when my drink came out 10 minutes later, it was a Chestnut Praline Cream Frappuccino, which is not including caffeine, which is not what I ordered. I stood at the counter to tell them it was the wrong drink for several minutes while the staff kept looking at me and continued to ignore me. Eventually I had to get back into line to be acknowledged. They remade my drink finally after having to wait about 15 more minutes. Figured I would give them another try today with my family and we ordered 3 Chestnut Praline Frappuccino's. We received them and they all tasted light straight coffee. We asked them to remake them as they tasted horrible and the 3 new drinks we received tasted like ice water with absolutely no flavor. Very disappointed as we wait every year for Chestnut Praline to come back just to have repeatedly horrible drinks at a high cost. I expect good drinks for almost $6 a piece.
Always huge lines and coffee is served with a meh... rushed feel. Pass on it. Skip the stars. Just go to the best coffee in Philly down a ways. You won't be disappointed.
Went through drive thru to get me and hubby a treat.  Got to window chick opens up and says we are closed I'm like it is 6:55   Nope we are closed. Very disappointing.  Amateurs

Service is fine...but the quality of their drinks are mediocre at best. I would NOT recommend getting their iced coffee. I've tasted better iced coffee when I made it myself at a hotel. Their iced lattes are ok, but not worth the price. Only satisfying drink I've had there has been the pink drink. But..way too much ice, even when I asked for light ice. I never bought food from there, because I always saw flies buzzing around the food in the display case. Unsanitary much? And my final thought applies to Starbucks overall: their drinks should be cheaper. Or, at least make the size difference between a tall and a grande greater.

This new location is a nice newer Starbucks with plenty of seating and a Nitro tap. A small loveseat and a handful of comfy chairs add to the appeal of this place. The staff is friendly, and the service was quick when we were there. 

The tiny coffee bushes in Starbucks mugs on the tables were a nice touch. We ordered a LATTE and an AMERICANO, both of which were excellent and to Starbucks standards.

It's a nice big location and would be a perfect place to either sit and relax with coffee or get some work done, whatever you prefer.

I went in this AM unaware that the mask mandate was reinstated and the curly haired young lady behind the counter was unnecessarily rude about it. "Uhm excuse me you need a mask when you come in here" is not at all how I want to be greeted at 730 in the morning. Furthermore, I ordered a grande mocha Frappuccino with soy milk, I do not know what I received but it was not that.  I frequent this location most weekdays but will be finding somewhere new to get my morning coffee after this.

Located right down stairs from the American Airlines club lounge which made it very convenient for us to head down and grab us some of our fav drinks while waiting for our flight.  Walked right up w/no crowd to place our order -- friendly staff and drinks were wonderful.
By far the best Starbucks in Tampa. They're 24/7 and the staff is very helpful!

Decent space in this Starbucks for visiting friends or for working while you enjoy a coffee. Lots of smaller tables and raised bar height tables plus one super long family/community table. Due to the location, this particular Starbucks has more natural light than most I've been to in Edmonton. So I usually tend to enjoy sitting by the big windows. I also appreciate that there's decent amount of parking and handicap spots. As it is a bigger layout than most, there's two separate doors into the space. So if you're sitting at the larger table, you might notice more of a draft (especially in our chilly Alberta winters!) 

Lots of snacks and bites to eat plus drinks just like other locations. However, I find this one tends to give sample drinks where I rarely experience that anywhere else in Edmonton. Today was pink lemonade and strawberry frap made with coconut milk. Lemonade was lovely and not too tart. Definitely one to order if you were looking for a drink to replenish the electrolytes. We skipped the second sample as we loved our drinks so much already and didn't want to be disappointed without having any banana in it. 

Today I was with my aunt and we tried strawberry frap (gotta keep the valentine theme!) and believe me, say yes to having the banana added. Omg tastiness... the thickness... sweet but not over powering and the banana made it similar consistency to a milkshake, so choosing venti was the perfect size for that drink. I selected mine with full milk and my aunt wanted coconut milk. We were both very happy with our choices and definitely will order that again. We also split bacon egg bites (two per order). They're decent but I have to say I still prefer the sandwich over the egg bites. As I needed a bit more to eat, I grabbed an oatmeal raisin cookie. I was very pleased the cookie was chewy and soft (I've had cookies at other locations and cannot say the same thing).

As always, a decent experience at Starbucks. I just wished that some of their chairs had a bit more padding to them and should have remembered to bring my chair pillow with me.

Was really craving pumpkin spice latte and was very disappointed. Flavor was horrible almost tasted burnt and When you pay over $5 for a cup of coffee,  I want a full cup but once again almost a quarter of it was missing.

To be honest.. this place is beyond slow, and  the drive thru is horrendously long.
If you have a place to be go somewhere else. 
I waited twenty min for one small drink, a strawberry refresher for my daughter. 
I was really disappointed.

This store is always a mess. They are constantly out of things, even basics such as vanilla or milk varieties (not including the popular oat milk right now). Plan to mobile order at least 30 minutes prior to your wanted time and still expect to wait and then have cold food. The man that works the mornings is amazing, he doesn't seem to be supported by his very slow (and often rude) staff members. I still go to this location for the very friendly man who makes things so great, and for the fact that there isn't a close location as this seems to be the only one. If you know what you're getting into, drink quality is usually fine, it's just the horrible process of getting your drink.

Quite possibly the WORSE Starbucks I have ever been to. The 3 ladies serving on 9/26/19 at 11:14am were completely checked out. My order took forever to complete. Not because they were busy, but busy talking amongst themselves. I got my food and ate it before they even started with my coffee. AND it was the only one in line. No others to make. One of the workers used a long cutting knife to unplug the sink and then just set it aside to use again. The girl making my coffee wiped her nose before picking up my cup. This place is a sad reflection of what is typically a well run, clean establishment. I was at a conference and have no intentions of being back in that location even if it's the only one close by. VERY disappointing. These three girls could careless about their customers OR the cleanliness of their work environment.

Easily not only the worst Starbucks around, but the worst coffee house ever. Seriously, this is the place people go when they want their wet dreams ruined. Over half my orders are messed up, but I stop here because it's the only Sbux in this area. Pretty sure the only reason this place stays busy is because they have a captive audience. 
The staff is consistently surly and confused, undertrained and uninvested in anything they do. This place is so bad I'm almost ready to quit my coffee.

Almost.

I've never been to this location but the floor is filthy. It's 3pm and crumbs are all over the floor. Everywhere. Have no idea how long it's been like this or how often staff are supposed to sweep, but I haven't seen a Starbucks this poorly kept up in awhile.
Closed at 7pm in a very busy airport. Other people were also banging on doors. Starbucks should consider the business they are losing by closing so early.

What's up with Starbucks.  I stopped going for a while so I could support small family owned coffee bistro shops.  Recently stopped at several including this one for a protein box.  Almost all of the Starbucks I stopped at was OUT of protein boxes.  When I asked at the one on Disc Drive why? She told me we were having a nationwide food shortage????

Not aware of that.  Hopefully the hoarders  haven't started hitting the stores yet.

IMO I believe Starbucks is beginning the downward path of bring too corporate, failing on supply and customer service

This location is one of the best locations I've been to. The employees are very helpful and I never have any problems. I recently went during happy hour and the computer systems were down and the gentleman manually gave me the bogo offer whereas other locations don't try to help you. I will come again to this Starbucks. Wonderful service.
As everyone else says, long waits. I'm not exaggerating when I say it took 35 minutes for them to make my iced tea.

The line moved slowly but the staff was pleasant enough.  I didn't order coffee, buying a Philadelphia You are Here mug and bottled water.  The fellow dropped the mug onto the counter when he opened the box to scan the bar code. He did, however, show me that it wasn't damaged before putting it back in the box.  The mug cost $12.09, $1.14 over the blacked out price tag (I have purchased many of these mugs before) and the water was $1 more than the another airport vendor.  Although it was only a few dollars, I felt ripped off.

Had my 8-shot espresso, some vanilla bean frappacinno (plus a hair caught on the lid halfway inside the drink). I love Starbucks and this one had great service. However, the hair killed all the other upsides of this place. C'mon kids. You can have all the friendly and prompt service and a great product but putting a hair in the product you serve is poor service.

This is my local Star ucks and I'm happy to report that it is one of the better ones in Central Indiana.   It's located in a strip mall so there's no drive-thru which I think makes it better.   It's more intimate and you get your order much faster than at Starbucks that have drive-thru (I always order at the counter).

The seating area is very comfortable and not too bright.   I would say the vibe is more like the coffee shops of old where you sit and enjoy your cup o' Joe while reading a newspaper (rather than today's Starbucks where people are working on their laptops or having business meetings).

Wow. I've never had baristas make so much conversation with me I almost didn't know how to respond. It's sad we live in a world where we like being ignored or maybe it's just cause I'm from LA. The girls working the morning I went in were seriously the nicest people ever. Should've went to UCSB instead of UCLA I guess

I frequent this Starbucks location often for my favorite chai beverage. Located in the midst of a shopping plaza, this location can get busy any time of day. Often, I find myself waiting in long drive-thru lines to place my order. 

Unfortunately, this location is very hit or miss depending on who makes your beverage. I haven't gone enough to be a known customer, so every time i pull up I pray that they make my drink correctly. 

Tonight, I am happy to report that my drink was made correctly and there was only one person in the drive through line. 

I just wish for a little more consistency with this location. I've brought my drink back multiple times for significant order mess-ups and I'm typically not one to make a big stink about a slight mistake. But, messing up my chai often is a little unacceptable.

I just got a bagel with cream cheese and the cream Cheese was awfully sour. I'm Guessing it's spoiled.
 I was going to give it to my kids, but I'm glad I tasted it first. This is not ok.

This 1 star review is for Sam for her poor customer service. I usually come to this Starbucks because of convenience but I will go to the other one from now on. I would like the management to address this customer service problem and I am willing to give it a try again when it gets better.

I'm a super fan of iced coffee. Not hot coffee poured over ice. Ice cold strong coffee. 

Especially when the weather is hot and I want to watch my calories. I skip the frappachino/lattes and order up a iced coffee, no cream, no sugar, just iced coffee. Yum!

I made two orders. I asked for a starbucks double shoot on ice. I had to repeat to the guy 10 times that I want a starbucks doble shoot on ice. He gave me a venti cup that was filled half way with ice and 1/4 coffee. I told the guy I want a starbucks doble shoot on ice with little ice and two percent milk. He added more milk and told me that so I dont get confused next time Espressos dont get to much milk. I didn't ask for an espresso I asked for the drink that is called Starbucks doble shoot on ice. I get the gouda sandwich and leave. I taste my drink and it's not what I ordered, he still gave me an espresso and a half frozen sandwich
Nice place to read a book, TERRIBLE WIFI SPEED, if you plan to be online for more than 3 min, then don't even bother trying it here. It takes over 1 min for google home page page to load.

Horrible! Went thru the drive thru to Get a venti Carmel Frap with soy extra extra Carmel drizzle! Look at the pictures a drop of Carmel drizzle and a watery drink!! Don't go here if your really craving a yummy drink after the gym! Failure! Mind you I PAID!! For the extra drizzle I didn't get.

I don't really expect much customer service usually because I'm literally just grabbing coffee, but the customer service here is absolutely horrible. Like disgustingly bad. I hate writing reviews, especially bad ones but this is one of the worst service I've ever experienced. They aren't even nice. There is especially one specific guy (tall guy with a beanie) that's just the absolute worst and I just excuse him thinking he might have his own personal issues but how rude and just mean he is to his customers is so uncalled for. It's not just to me, but to so many others that come through here. I used to study at this location and I would be disturbed hearing him yell at customers. There was a lady who came in for whatever order and I suppose he was frustrated because he couldn't make out what she wanted and started raising his voice to the point she just agreed to what he thought her order was...she left with a cup of plain whipped cream. The other workers are at least cordial, which I feel like is fine because I know how it is sometimes with customers. However, I really hate how gross the service here is. I personally feel like the only reason why anyone still goes here is because the convenience of the location. Otherwise, terrible service. Ever since they changed locations it's just been downhill.
This location is really a hit or miss. You never know if the people working that day are feeling lazy or not with the quality of work they put out that day.

A few years back I used to live in Florissant and the only Starbucks was the one off McDonnell Blvd in Hazelwood. That Starbucks fits in the grab your coffee and get the heck out category.
At the time I couldn't complain (beggars can't be choosers right?) Man oh Man this one off Hanley is nice! Clean, friendly, convenient. All coffees I bought were spot on and made fast enough. This is definitely a valuable asset to Florissant.

Yeah, this is the worst Starbucks in Reno. I went in for an iced tea, waited around 30 minutes and got nothing. I finally just walked out. Enjoy your $4, guys. You definitely did not deserve it. I understand that there is sometimes a buffer with online orders but multiple people who ordered well after me got their drinks just fine. Do yourself a favor and save your time, money and effort. Disgusted.

I am not a coffee drinker but on a cold winter day I enjoy a grande vanilla chai tea latte with soy with no water. Also, to calm my sweet tooth I  get Madeleines Petite French Cakes. What a nice snack in the middle of the day.....

Waited for it to open. 8-23-2017. 3 workers came in late and stayed in the back room never addressing customers in line. The line slowly went away at 5:10 as no one had put coffee on or looked like they had any intention of doing so. New low for this location. Usually understaffed and long waits are normal. Needs management help.

One of the best in the Northeast area. It is well-staffed and the drinks are mixed to perfection. The Skinny Vanilla Latte is my favorite, but the Peppermint Mocha is also great during the winter holidays. The only problem is the parking lot-- it is always full!

In my personal experience this place has done right by me every time. It opens at 430 am which is totally clutch if you are flying out super early. They always have my impossible breakfast sandwich and my matcha is always made properly. The only downside is the line can get very long early in the morning.
I look forward to hitting this place again in the near future.

I normally wouldn't take the time to review a chain coffee shop that seems to have a location every ten feet, but my recent experience at this location left me with a smile on my face!

I stopped in on a Wednesday after dinner for a meeting and the barista (forgot to grab his name) was extra chipper and seemed to have a pep in his step. He provided great customer service and drink suggestions. I appreciated his sense of humor.

This Starbucks is more spacious than I thought, with a room separate from the barista counter to camp out on your laptop.

I can imagine this place gets busy during peak hours and it's Hunger Games style intensity to grab a table/outlet, though.

Parking isn't convenient, but it's Broad Ripple. If only it had a drive-thru...

If only there was an option for 0! This place is horrible. This is a picture of the SECOND order. The first set of drinks we got were both Carmel macchiato. My friend and I noticed our drinks were starting to form clumps so we called and asked if they could remake the drinks. They were so rude about it! I then spoke with Savannah who took the drinks back and she had the worst attitude along with another coworker. Got our second set of drinks and this is what it looked like again! Not only is there milk spoiled, but also their baristas.

This is one of my favorite Starbucks in Indy. I actually don't mind that they don't have a drive thru, because this is the Starbucks I go to when I want to sit and read a book or just hang out in Broad Ripple for a bit. 

The baristas are always warm, friendly,
and pleasant to interact with. I've never had a drink here that I didn't like, and they make consistently good drinks. 

I also love that it is right next to the Ripple Bagel and Deli, making it a perfect stop for a weekend breakfast or brunch. I like to grab a bagel sandwich from the Bagel Deli and then head over to Starbucks for an iced coffee to accompany my breakfast!

Well for the most part, you will get want you order and the staff are very friendly, just not the fastest in town, I will say they are faster then some of the Startbucks.  I have been to this store a number of times and they seemed to have a high turn over in staff, never see the same people working the drive thru.
Who knew it was company policy not to brew decaf in the afternoon?! Really?! Isn't that when most people want a decaf?
The Starbucks location is more than likely the best in town. I do frequent that store every day and my coffee has been amazing. Thank you so much Rachel for teaching everybody how to do my latte
The place is really dirty. Garbage all over the floors and bathroom needed cleaning. Would make sense if they were really busy, but it was slow and nobody was cleaning.

Worst Starbucks in terms of the quality and consistency of the drinks. Service is fine, just don't expect them to shake your iced beverages. Also someone in there needs to learn how to make Starbucks iced double shots...

I was pleasantly surprised by the great service at this Starbucks branch. Airport Starbucks' usually suck, but not so here! They did an excellent job with my great tasting Americano. The barristas all worked quickly and were very pleasant. Minus one star however for being out of almost all the food items we wanted as well as chai and some teas. How does a Starbucks run out of food and drinks in the middle of the week? Seems very odd.

When coming to this location there always consistent with each coffee that I receive- though I'm a creature of habit once I find a drink I love lol, I continue to get the same drink until can't drink it again lol- but if you haven't tried this location morning, afternoon or night with different crew making it's always the same drink no matter who makes- But the girl in the drive through today had an awesome upbeat personality which leaves you feeling better with your day!

I frequent this location since it is down the street from my office and home. The service is always sweet, professional, and on point. And of course, the drinks are always superb. I honestly wouldn't change anything about this location. Even the drive thru is extremely thorough and consistent with timing.

Celine made me the most amazing java chip frap! Huge fan of this location! Great atmosphere and even great people! 10/10 would come to this Starbucks again. Everyone is always so kind and Celine always knows my order. I feel like a regular every time I come in!

Waited for 15 minutes after ordering. Went up and asked if she had gotten a cup with Pat on it? Said some guy had picked it up. Said she would make me another. Made it and handed me the cup with Katie written on it. I told her I was not Katie. A girl standing close by said she was Katie, so she took it. So......she made me another. This place is screwed up. Wish I could get the tip back I put in the har by tge cash register! There is a reason I don't go to Starbucks often. Would give them no stars if possible.
Good location. Awesome, friendly and patient staff.  Love that golden sun art.

This is one of my favorite Starbucks locations. It's always clean and the service is always great. I enjoy the seating both indoors and out. I especially love the outdoor seating, even during winter when the heaters make it enjoyable still. I haven't had a bad experience at this location yet and always enjoy spending time there.
Awful service, the drive thru wait is 10 min each time with only 3 cars in front of me. Do better

Ok every other day it's a 5star rating. However today was less because of how the drive thru barista acted when she got my drink wrong. I go through the drive through and order as a creature of habit and say the same thing every time so I know it was not something I had left out. When I got my drink it did not have cream in it and she said "well it doesn't come with cream unless you ask". I said I did say I needed cream in my drink and did not hear her NOT say cream when repeating my order because she said it so fast. I am getting ready to provide customer service for 8 hours at my job and I really did not appreciate the attitude / arguing before 7am in the morning. Might be awhile before I go back to Starbucks and might need to head back to Dunkin'.

I would like to give a negarive one rating ，but this is the lowest I can submit，being an royal Starbuck fan for eight years is not easy and always ordering the same items repeatly，the worst location by far if anyone would like to stay as Starbuck fan ，it's a disgrace for this particular business to be in operation ，if the management team happens to follow this ，please fix this problems and make sure the employees are properly trained to serve.....food not heated up properly and the mixed drinks were not according to the right taste
OMG!  The service here is so S L. O.     W.  And the have the Starbucks market cornered at PHL.  They could do so much better.

Yay a local Starbucks!  They are super sweet very professional but they had to redo my coffee as they handed me a grande I ordered a vente.  Then I got my replacement and the whip cream was missing and tasted bad. The line behind me was super long. I just took my $6.35 coffee and left.  It's a new Starbucks and they need more training. I'll be back in six months....

I had a decent size order from here in the drive thru. However, when I received my chai tea latte...it was missing the "chai tea" part and I received a cup of milk...since then, their business has gone uphill and I do return.
Sandwiches are cold A Lot!  Still the best coffee ofcourse.....

This place is horrible. Not only do they fuck up your drink every single time they're slower than a sloth. Waited 30 minutes for my drink only for them to give me someone elses then give me attitude because they fucked up. And look at me like in stupid when I tell them what it was. Stop hiring idiots

Ok so it's not the best area of town, but it's not the worst!!! The staff is always friendly and they carry all the specials and featured drinks!!!! The drive thru seems to be a bit slow during the peak hours in the morning so I just park and go in and I get out sooner than the cars waiting at the drive thru. Their seating area inside is nice because they have two lounger chairs by the entrance where I can people watch or bring a friend and chat. Either way, this Starbucks makes my neighborhood a bit more appealing and I will support it based on that alone. If I'm on another part of town that has other coffee shops, I may try something else, but we need to help out the north valleys whenever we can. It would be nice to get some independent stores out there but I understand the economy wont support them at this time.

What a great new Starbucks location... It's so beautiful and everybody that works here is so sweet and accommodating ... Gabriel took my order and was super sweet and very friendly and I had special request that he happily did for me...Everyone come check out the new Starbucks it's super awesome

Employees are wonderful, but management needs to address this fly issue! Arrived at 5am last week and there were flies everywhere.  Severe cleanliness issues.  It's Summer and these things happen, but the floors are extremely dirty.  Attention to detail is needed every evening/morning.

OK, this is not a bad Starbucks. I visit occasionally. It is small. And occasionally the line moves slow and you wait a little bit for your drink. Most of the barista's are nice, quiet and polite. Then there is Omar. He is completely unnecessary. It seems he is always goofing off and just obnoxious.

Clean and friendly baristas. Drinks consistently have the same flavors. Seems there's some hate about he location and staff but My experience was positive and I'd return. Shoutout to staff and management! Feel like anger in some cases may be due to high expectations... when there is an obvious worker shortage and a tiny pandemic going on... lol
Anastasia needs to focus on her customer service and less on her speed. If you don't order in less than 5 seconds don't worry she'll pick for you!

This is my second favorite Starbucks in the area of South City and Mid county. 

First off, I believe all Starbucks are exceptionally decent. Never bad and never amazing. 

So what's left? 

I like this location because it's pretty large and has plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. Additionally, it's staff is consistently friendly and efficient. 

The watch out - in the morning there can be an absolutely rush of local middle and high school kids. It's actually amazing to see how fast they serve all of them. But beware, it may be a little hectic and longer wait than expected.
Good for relaxing.  Nice comfy couches.  Hard to study as they blast music over the speakers.

This place at 7pm TWO HOURS before closing time seems to be more in "let's get out of here on time" rather than "let's take care of customers "....limited availability on bakery items.....TWO HOURS before close...bakery display already dismantled......TWO HOURS  before close....10 min wait for my coffee...because they had to brew more...manager says "we've been busy ".....Monday night....early January....no one else inside except me....two cars in drive thru....you haven't been "busy" in my opinion....how about brewing more coffee when you're LOW?? Don't wait until you run out...you're a place known for coffee....you kinda wanna have it on hand....and you have sealed holding systems...so it's gonna stay fresh......oh but there was a lot of cleaning going on.....end of night cleaning....TWO HOURS before close.....but those pesky guests.....we'll get to them....

I go to this location 5 days a week. They never disappoint! The staff is "The" BEST!!! Very upbeat and cheerful, every morning!! It's nice to be greeted  with a smile and a kind word 5 days a week.. Erica at the drive thru, is such an impressive, wonderful young lady!! 5 ++++ Stars!!

Starbucks is usually my go-to. But not when I'm in Exton. The drive-thru is always at least a 10-15 minute process and inside is sometimes a bit quicker but not much. Plus the parking lot is very difficult to navigate through with the long drive-thru lines. Save yourself the trouble. 

Mobile orders aren't any quicker. You'll still be wit 15 minutes +. Basically, just don't go here.

Starbucks locations have this peculiar quality of all being different, but strangely familiar. This location feels like home. The baristas here have always been super friendly and I've never had any trouble with my orders.

If you're looking for a space to work, this place is also great. There are plenty of tables and it doesn't ever get too loud. Most people get their coffee and leave. There's plenty of natural light and the store itself is pretty well-lit too. The Wi-FI is speedy and there are a lot of other people working on something too, so you won't feel out of place with your MacBook out.

This is the worst Starbucks location I have ever been to and unfortunately this is the closest one to my house.
