I have been to Starbucks locations all around the country and even around the world, yet still nothing compares to the horrible service at this location. The staff is very friendly but you will be in there for 20 minutes waiting for your order only to be given the completely wrong order. It is consistently bad.

I am appalled at the way your staff is allowed to treat the police or anyone in u inform for that matter. There is nothing but complaints about the staff at this store. Are you proud to have a**holes working here? Apparently management doesn't care because when someone else called to complain, that person got the response "we don't care, it's fine if you never come back". I will also be sending a letter to corporate

Every time I visit this location the staff is really exceptional; they are patient, accurate, and friendly. This is a great place to enjoy a cup of coffee or study as it's larger than most other locations. My only con is that bc it's on such a busy street the entrances and exits can be a nightmare depending on which direction you need to go.

Sat in Starbucks drive thru line for over 20 minutes during mid day. It got to the point where people were beeping and very irritated. Once I got to the front of the line the long wait was not addressed nor apologized for. I understand things happen, however a little bit of customer service can go a long way. Will not return to this drive thru to say the least.

I have been doing mobile orders for the last 3 months, weekly orders - sometimes every few days. The customer service is horrendous here. The baristas and cashiers blatantly ignore every customer in the cafe. My mobile is almost never done when I arrive, even though I make sure to order at least 10 minutes before arriving, these days 15 min. Yet once again I stood in the cafe and waited for my incorrect coffee order. I inquired twice about my sandwich and I don't know why I was ignored and pushed to the side but I finally couldn't wait anymore because I was already going to be late to work because of this that I asked for a refund. Once I asked for a refund - suddenly my sandwich came out of nowhere, it was ice cold sitting behind the counter where I couldn't obtain it, and I now didn't have time to ask her to remake it. The service here is absolutely terrible. Put your order in anywhere else.

a decent Starbucks but with management/staff proplems.  5/17/16 the short, rotund, redheaded AM manager fielded a complaint from a customer.  I listened.  Before  long, she accused him of making a scene.  He did not.  His tone and demeanor were perfectly appropriate; she didn't like his having a contrary opinion.  Last I checked, its a free country  in which to have and opinion and express them. 2 weeks prior, I reported a woman taking a bottle of water from a display without paying.  The tall lanky male manager thanked me and DID NOTHING.  Now that may be company policy but...  The managers in this store need better training and the insight that loyal customers are the source of their paychecks.  90% of the staff are fine... a few are less than pleasant, slow on the smiles and warm greetings and clearly unhappy with their jobs.  The managers should be addressing this but I won't be holding my breath....

This Starbucks location is in the Fred Meyer on Overland Road.  At this visit I got a berry refresher.  It's was good.  I like other locations better.  The baristas aren't as peppy here as they are at others but I'm okay with that.  Overall it's a  Starbucks and I'm a fan of this franchise.

This Starbucks is fairly new and I've only ever gone through the drive thru, but the staff is pretty awesome and efficient. 

Had to ask for a sleeve...my only complaint

Me- "you have fruit flies all over the food in your display case."  Employee (blonde girl with left black eye) "That happens all the time, it's just the display food.  The food we serve customers is under the counter."   

So a store located inside (no outside entrance or windows) routinely has fruit flies in the display.  Suggests not only that you have some serious sanitation issues but you don't give a rats ass that the display you are using to advertise product has bugs all over.  Yum- makes me want to order food.  What's it look like under the counter where we can't see? Mold,  roaches, worse?  I've worked in food service- fruit flies are a sign your store is unsanitary and dirty. A health inspector seeing bugs on your food (display or not) will FAIL YOU. Stop making excuses and have 1 of the 7 employees standing behind the counter scrub everything and bleach the drains.

I came into this Starbucks today and got a drink, but I was having some troubles with my rewards card. The staff (Beza, I think was her name) was very polite and helpful! She helped me through my problem with a smile on her face, being very respectful towards me. My drink came out exactly how I ordered it, and I will be using this Starbucks as my go-to now! Thanks, Beza!!

This may sound mean but I can't figure out how this place has so many stars ! This is hands down the worst starbucks I have ever been too. Unfortunately for me this is the closest starbucks to where I live so I have tried it several times, I guess hoping for a better experience each time. 
 Most of the staff are extremely rude, not all but most. The first couple times I came here my drinks we're decent they just took awhile to get them. However the last few times my drinks have been bad to the point of not being able to drink them or completely wrong ! I am lactose intolerant and twice I got regular milk ! I spoke to the manager twice and both times she has apologized but that was it. 
 One morning in particular I ordered my drink and 3 petite vanilla scones for me and my kids. The guy who took the order walks off for quite awhile and comes back to tell me he dropped one but he still tries to hand me the bag. I look in the bag and of course there's only 2 scones. I reminded him I paid for 3 and would need my money back for the other one if that's all they had. He was confused by this request and he had to get someone to help him. Then he gives me attitude about it. To top it off I get in the car, now running late and it's the wrong drink ! Ugh ! I tried this place one more time yesterday and they we're so rude I literally drove thru the drive without getting anything. I will NEVER be back. Save your time and money, go to a different starbucks !
Shashana introduced me to my first pumpkin spice latte and was so nice! great customer service & i'll be coming back for all of my iv starbucks needs
I mean it is a Starbucks. It's expensive, the Ready to Eat & Drink products are ridiculously overpriced. Yeah it's good coffee but honestly I drink McDonald's these days. And I am a former partner.

Today I arrived in drive through and gave them my order at 1:55pm. I ordered  venti White mocha, and a grande caramel frap. THATS IT! I waited in the line along with 5 cars in front of me and about the same behind me. Until I finally revived my order in my hands at 2:13pm. Almost 20 minutes! HORRIBLE! Whoever the hell owns this dam Starbucks needs to fix this, because the other Starbucks on Los Altos and Disc to perfectly fine with large volumes of customers. 
    To the owner - ur employees are struggling or something is not right. If you happened to take 2 seconds of ur day and read my review but ALL OTHER REVIEWS AS WELL...you would be making more at the end of the day! #enoughsaid

This location has reopened for business, despite what Yelp says on their site/app. Just trying to get the word out, as they were closed for a month (starting 4/3/20) during the pandemic. 

I hope we can all return to a sense normalcy soon.

Granted this place is in a tough spot, in IV and packed with students but as a student myself it's frustrating how bad the service here can get. I usually stop by in a rush, like most others here I'm
sure.

The coffee bar (hand crafted) drinks are consistent.

The problem is the poor service and dirty environment. For example, once witnessed an employee clean the bathroom and come out with the dustpan with floor bathroom dirt and throw it away in the sink behind the counter, next to the coffee machines.

This Starbucks is so terrible. The service is beyond slow. Even when you mobile order. And 3 employees will literally walk past you and not take your order because they are doing other tasks like loading chips. And the drinks are always terrible. I try to order stuff that is little effort but they even mess that up. Most of the drinks have no taste, or or too sugary. I only go here when desperate or getting something that is already made.

This was the worst experience I have ever had at a Starbucks.  I ordered an ice tea and they neglected to tell me they ran out and had to brew more.  I was standing for 10 minuets watching everyone else that was in line around me come and go with their specialty drinks.  I asked the barista if she could check on my drink.  The barista said, "yea, it's coming we had to brew more."  She proceeds to make my tea but left about an inch of space between tea and lid.  I asked if she could just fill it to the top and she rudely threw my cup back at me spilling the tea.  I understand that they are busy but I also came into the building and paid over $3 for an iced tea.  I do expect to get a full cup of tea.  I would not go back!

I was staying with a Starbucks guy so each morning we had to stop so I took part and really thought this location was a good one.  Very clean, good service.  I also had the steak and cheese wrap which ended up being pretty darn good and fulfilling.  More so than most starbucks options in my opinion.  So good coffee and a good start to my day.

It is what it is: an average Starbucks recently renovated to look more like a spacious cafe, where it's still difficult to find a table and perhaps even more difficult to get the right mobile order.

I've had a few problems with baristas here. I'll ask for light ice and notice afterward that they wrote the initials for more ice on the cup (um, said no one ever.) A barista's called out my name before for a drink that looked like mine, just for me to walk away from the store and find out that this totally wasn't my drink, the name totally isn't mine, and that nothing on the mobile order shelf even resembled my iced caramel latte. Due to what appears to be a high turnover of staff coupled with high foot traffic, some baristas don't catch onto initials quickly or write sloppily, leading to drink mix-ups like a pumpkin spice hot chocolate instead of a peppermint hot chocolate.

The mobile order situation here is merciful to those of us who don't like to stand in line, and want to avoid awkward interactions. While the bike parking situation isn't bad at all, good luck ever finding parking around here if you want to grab coffee from IV and go somewhere else. However, it's not a bad place to go for mediocre coffee, especially if you'd rather your order be done fast than done well.

If you put mobile orders through here don't expect it to be done . I supposedly order because it's fast and efficient and i always end up waiting there 10-15 minutes waiting on something that never went through. There's always something missing in my order and the employees aren't very efficient when it comes to asking what I'm waiting on , even when they do see me standing there for long periods of time . I've never not come here and had a problem with the mobile orders.

Second shift for about a week straight I asked for Trent's Peach Green Tea Lemonade and they give me a Green Tea Lemonade. What is so hard to follow directions. I officially will not go during second shift because apparently following directions is so difficult when I know what I clearly asked for.
Horrible service. Make you wait and then tell you they cant make your drink.  Bunch of workers all loud and goofing off instead of helping their customers. I'd avoid this one

Food: 4 Stars
Service: 3 Stars

I love their chai tea lattes, vanilla fraps, all of their seasonal drinks, and let's not forget their scrumptious snacks and sandwiches. The one thing I really DON'T love... the wait time. 

This location is not far from my office, so it's a perfect spot to grab a drink and go. Except that it's never a "grab and go" situation. 90% of the time it takes nearly 10 minutes to get my drink. (In a DRIVE-THRU!) Walking in and ordering over the counter is a tad better. While I understand that each drink is made to order and depending on what you order, it may take awhile for it to be made (several steps), it shouldn't take 10 minutes to get a drink. (I think the longest I've ever waited was 17mins in the drive-tru.)

Hardly convenient... :[
Jeff is the best!!!!! Always happy and makes my day! Fast and friendly smiling and very upbeat. Good job 4th street

Everytime I have gone to this Starbucks the staff are really friendly. Additionally, the consistency of my drinks are always good!

I only use the drive thru at this location but the wait times are never more than 5 mins. I do however think the amount of calories in most of their drinks are ridiculous. 

If you're going I would highly recommend the cold brew!

Today I ordered on the app to this location. I ordered a GRANDE iced white chocolate mocha, but received a VENTI which is not bad... but it wasn't  what I ordered!!But then ordered the CLASSIC BANTAM BAGELS and received the everything bagels! I was very upset so I gave them to my friend and when she took a bite.... THERE WAS NO CREAM CHEESE ON THE INSIDE!!! 

In this past month my orders have been messed up and I do not know why that keeps happening! They are very disorganized with the mobile ordering and it takes YEARS for them to make the drinks! I ordered my drink 10 minutes before I arrived and still proceeded to wait 20 more minutes!

This drive thru is a nuisance to the entire shopping center. Sometimes they close the lobby for unknown reasons and the line will wind down two aisles and block people who are parked. One time the lobby was closed but they were still accepting mobile orders and made people wait in the drive thru for their order. Drinks are inconsistent and the availability of the items on the mobile app are incorrect so I can't order ahead.

While staying at UCSB for a conference, we would walk in to Isla Vista every morning for coffee.  I like Starbucks for the coffee and for the consistancy of product and service.  Our first morning, I ordered a grande coffee in a vente cup with an add shot.  The young lady took our order and sent the cups to the barrista (who didn't show up for several minutes).  Once our young gent (who will be forthwith referred to as Flock of Seagulls FoS) returned, he got my friend's latte to her.  Then he began working on mine, finished it up and topped it off with a different type of coffee.  When he brought it back to me, I stated that that wasn't what I ordered.  He stood there with the coffee in his hand as if I would change my mind and he wouldn't have to redo it.  After about 10 seconds of this stand-off, I kindly informed him that he would have to remake my drink.  All the while he was apologizing and creating excuses.  Dude, just shut it and make me my coffee!!!  I'm not sure what their system is there... verbal orders or written, but if it is verbal, then the barista needs to be in the same room when the order is made.  BTW, the lady behind me was not happy with her beverage either.  We left the premises to the whoosh of another drink being poured down the drain.

Day 2:  We come into Starbucks and FoS has his foot up on the counter.  Now, I'm not a germ-phobe, but I've worked in enough restaurants to know what is on the floor, and I don't want that on the counter..  We got the correct drink today, but only because the female worked both the cash register and drinks.  FoS was busy stocking sandwiches.

Day 3: Drinks were ordered by about 6 customers, and we were smack in the middle of the group.  The two before us got their drinks, and the two behind us got their drinks, and then we got our drinks.  There was quite a substantial wait between the first two orders and the last four because FoS felt a very urgent need to use the restroom even though customers were waiting.  Thankfully he did wash his hands!!

Day 4: Screw it!  I'm gonna use the Kuerig in the office!!

This is a study hall Starbucks. 
Always full and busy. 
Like all Starbucks, good coffee.  But like all Starbucks in Santa Barbara, the atmosphere is bare bones.

I don't feel like this Starbucks lives up to the standards of every other Starbucks I've been too. The employees seem to enjoy being there about as much as I enjoy the coffee stain on my shirt. They can't seem to figure out how to put a lid on without having coffee all over the top or they are just to lazy to wipe it down before they toss it out the window and into your car. I just paid more for an iced coffee than I did this shirt and now I'm wearing it too. Might as well drive the extra few miles and hit northtowne save yourself the headache.

Let's face it, it's Starbucks.  A little bit on the overrated side, compared to the  hip coffee shops that are now dotting the Reno area.  I don't hate their coffee, but it's not my favorite.  However, it always seems to be a good choice for meeting up.  Easy to get to, lots of parking, and plenty of tables and chairs to pass the time idly by.  No, I am not a regular, so they don't know me here.  And the cashier/barrista made that very clear by depriving me of any semblance of a smile that the others have written about here.  But I have to say, when I asked if I could have my cappuccino in one of the real cups, and not in one of their famous to go cups, he indulged me.  For that I was grateful.  My friend had one of their Italian sodas, and when I asked her how it was...her reply: eh.  But we had a good chat, so all in all, it was not a complete fail.

Order was placed at 3:06P via mobile suppose to be ready at 3:12P didn't get served until 3:25P after I arrived at 3:10P waited and watched 6 people get served in front of me!!!!
Called after I left talk to manger he apologized and let me know they were short staff.

I have no problems with this Starbucks, but I have problems accessing it! It's always busy and I can't find parking, so I usually give up after circling and end up going to a different Starbucks that is further away. There is no drive-through and it's in the middle of a busy strip in Broad Ripple, so I think it's really set up for pedestrians who are hitting up all the shops and not for people in cars who just want a drink on their way to something else.

Very rarely do I order from this Starbucks just because of how long they normally take. However, this is perfectly understandable since they're located on city ave and when you consider the amount of traffic they get into their store. But when I do order, I am always displeased with quality of the drinks they make. As a former barista at Starbucks, I understand the pressure to make drinks fast and correct. However this also means it's hard not to notice when they haven't been made right. I ordered a grande vanilla sweet cream cold brew, a pretty simple iced drink. The cold brew flavor wasn't bold enough, so you can assume they cut it with too much water or got lazy and used ice coffee. They also used regular cream most likely instead of vanilla sweet cream, or simply didn't put any pumps of vanilla. I'm always disappointed when I order from here. So if you're not eager to wait 10+ minutes to receive a sub par drink, don't order from here. 

On a slightly more positive note, when they're normally open, they're often very friendly, both in store and at the drive thru. They'd also be willing to remake your drink if you're not satisfied

Couldn't see breakfast sandwich signs until after I ordered. It was buried in pastry case tipped at an angle so hard to find. No napkins at coffee station even though 5 people were behind the counter. When I asked the only person hussing for a napkin, they shouted to someone else and it still took a while. Did everyone arrive late to work and not prep for morning rush?
Excellent location.  I visit Starbucks from Manhattan down to this location weekly.  Drinks are always ready for me when I arrive, made perfectly, and the staff is very friendly.

I frequent this Starbucks almost every morning and I can't believe it took this long for me to write a review! This location is hit or miss and it doesn't really help that their parking lot and drive thru are always a disaster.

This morning I ordered my usual (almond milk cappuccino w/cinnamon powder on top) and a marshmallow treat before leaving my house which is 2 miles away and will take me 5 - 7 minutes to get there depending on how much traffic is on Rt 100 already.

I was a little bummed this morning because my drink and food weren't waiting for me when I got there. The barista finished making my drink about three minutes after I arrived but didn't put my food order up. He gladly got it for me after I asked him about it and he said that their food tickets weren't printing this morning.

I gave four stars because the barista was very kind and my drink and food tasted great! And they even put the cinnamon powder on top of the foam just how I like it.

Not only do they have the clover (which is like the French press), but the baristas are super helpful and know their stuff! Only three Starbucks in the state of Indiana have the clover. This coffee bean press makes specialty coffee taste exactly like the notes the bean is known for. Like the notes of orange and caramel in the Costa Rican coffees. I am not a coffee expert so I am probably using the incorrect terminology, but these baristas are passionate, helpful, and courteous! The nicest Starbucks baristas in Indy by far!!!

Worst experience ever. Have never experienced so much attitude from a drive thru just for asking for an extra splash of half and half and then when it wasn't made correctly and I wanted it remade it was like I asked for the entire world. Thank you so much CAROLYN for ruining my afternoon! Starbucks should be a place of smiling and happiness.

A great place to study if you don't mind the stools. This place is generally empty and I only go here as it is close to Tino's and Ralph's . Although they have never given me the wrong order they are out of core ingredients like whole milk which has never happened to me at another Starbucks. Size wise its one of the smallest Starbucks I have seen which contain tables. 

The baristas are nice enough and do go out of their way for you, from always asking me if I need a receipt to giving me a cup of water during the hot summer for my service dog although I did not buy anything that day. They also don't push sell their bakery items which I have heard multiple people request only to be told they are out of the requested item as well. 

Tomorrow I think I will grab my coffee next door at Ralph's Starbucks and then walk a block to sit here to study at the Carrillo location.

On the road and truly need some caffeine, went out of the way to get to a Starbucks that was still open. Arrived at 9:45 and barista refused to serve us, even though the coffee shop is open until 10pm. Fine if I knew that, should change store hours to posting 9:30 then

Thank goodness for Starbucks drive-thru!  Sometimes a girl needs her pumpkin spice latte to get started in the morning.

I stop at this location a lot on my way to work.  It's a busy intersection, but they seem to move cars through at a very brisk pace, which I appreciate.  I have only be given someone else's coffee one time, and they were so apologetic when I called, then they gave me the right coffee free the next time I came through (with no hassle).

Tip - when Starbucks is featuring new coffees - ask for a sample, so you can taste it before you buy!
Love this place. I always get a ice mocha with no whip. But they give me the whip in another cup for my doggie.....
Very good! Customer service was very good. FRAP wasn't as thick as I like but still good. :-) Would stop in again if ever this way again.

SO RUDE! I made a mobile order mistake as I was in a completely different part of town, and noticed it LITERALLY seconds after pressing order. When I called to see if I could get the order cancelled, the person was very rude and said it was already made. I explained that I JUST ordered it and all she kept saying was it's already done, she was not helpful or anything. I realize I made the mistake, and admitted to it immediately, but CUSTOMER SERVICE! Don't be rude!!

Quick service even though the line was do the door. Love this location when perusing Mass Ave (they have a walk-up window, too)! 

IMO not great for morning commutes by car ~ unless you're a person who makes time to get out of the car, unlike me.
This is a good place to grab a cup of coffee as you're driving across the state.   Easy in and easy out.

This Starbucks just won over my heart. During the rush there was an autistic man that came in who the employees greeted by name and made feel so special regardless of how busy they were. I was so impressed by this establishment and the manager on duty!
Most starbucks would only get 1 star from me but I've got to give credit where credit is due.  The staff was super friendly which is always nice when you're heading for a flight at 6 am.

Went there on a Sunday at 7:10pm to order three drinks. There was no one else in the building or drive thru. We walked in and there were five employees. The lobby was dirty, tables dirty and the bathroom was gross. The lady that greeted us took our order and while the rest stood around one employee made the drinks. All the drinks were incorrect and the taste of them was not right. The reason I chose not to go back was because there was one of the girls continuously cussing in front of my daughter while we were waiting. Not one employee reminded her that their were customers in the building. I have been in customer service for years and this was not a pleasant experience. For a company that prides themselves in customer service it definitely didn't show on Sunday.

This Starbucks used to be so great and i used to enjoy going here. Since the new manager has taken over it has completely gone down hill. He has no idea how to communicate with the customers and is so aggressive when he speaks. His new assistant store manager is just as bad as he with with her customer service. I've talked to her about an issue i had with an employee and she seemed uninterested in what i had to say, the old
assistant manager was always making sure the customers were happy and satisfied if an issue occurred. Aside from that the employees are all new and have no idea what they are doing. I usually get the same drink and i had Grace, an employee, tell me the drink wasn't something they made when i regularly got the drink. She was rude and made it seem like i was getting a complicated drink. So i just ordered something else because there was a huge line of cars behind me. They also are constantly ignoring the customers and it seems like they purposely do it. I was surprised to see a few familiar faces recently, i thought the employees had all quit because of how terrible the service there has gotten.

Very disappointed by their service and attention to detail. I bought a venti and they filled it with so much foam that I barely got any coffee. When asked to fix it they gave my mother and I an attitude. Not what I expected from a Starbucks at all.

No parking ever!  Its in the Town Center, which isn't a walkable mall at all.  But I'm not a fan of the socialism that starbucks executives spend their billions of dollars advocating for anyway, so this place is no loss to me.

I pass this Starbucks on my way to work, I have been going there for 5 years if that tells you anything. Why did it take me so long to give them a review? I am not sure, what I can tell you is the service has always been good. Sure there have been mix ups but in 5 years I think there have been 2. 

      I am a nurse and "Coffee" is very important and when I order my drink I like it to taste how I think its going to taste. I downloaded the APP for SB and this has been very dangerous for me. I think I now own stock in SB. 

      If you want a really delicious cup of coffee made just the way you like it, or even if you want to indulge in an after dinner dessert this is the place to stop.

It's Starbucks so you know the consistency is always there.  There was no line and the gentlemen taking the orders was fast so I appreciated that.  The only thing that irked me is two people behind me got their blended drinks before my quad espresso with no milk. Really? Ok. Well, either way it's cheaper here than el colombe around the corner.

Well, i love starbucks but I'm done going there. I went inside to order & was waiting for my drink and sat down for a second at one of the tables & this male employee goes " you can't sit there so you need to get up" keep in mind im over due so I'm super pregnant, I get that the table was blocked off but damn way to make me feel like shit, when all I needed was a second to sit down and wait for my drink. This was my favorite Starbucks & I was a loyal customer to this specific location, just sucks I felt they had no care for my situation at all.

Worse Starbucks ever! Been here twice and each time my drink tasted nothing like it always does. The first and second time I had gotten a coffee there was very little coffee in the drink. So I tasted the second in the drive through because I had stated to the worker my drink looked white like hardly any coffee. Returned it for the real deal and when she gave me the second it was like straight espresso in a Frappuccino!  Gross! And horrible if you're correcting a drink in the first place get it right! Never going here again!

My daughter and I ordered 2 coffees and 2 muffins, they didn't ask if we wanted it warmed and I didn't think to ask until after it was handed to us. So we asked nicely if they could warm it for us. Oh boy, the person working there who should not be in a customer service position says to me with a glare " you should have asked"! Ok, well whatever. So Im standing there with my 12 yr old and she puts a bag down and my hand goes for it , Im still kinda shocked from her unnecessary meanness, and then she literally yells at me "is your name Nicole!?" Like 3 times. Her coworkers think it's hilarious that she is so disgusting to a customer and gets away with it. She clearly has no concept of customer service or just plain old treating other humans nice.

Starbucks.

Even the word will register an emotional reaction into the hearts of nearly everyone. Some regard Starbucks as a corporate behemoth and evil company, preying on the needs of the tired and overworked for their own profit. Others simply think of Starbucks as their local neighborhood coffee shop, populated by friendly baristas who remember their orders and local friends and neighbors.

For me, Starbucks has held neither an intensely positive nor negative place in my heart. I usually think about Starbucks in the same vein as I think about sweatshirts. They're useful, and sometimes we take them for granted, but if a fire burned down my house, the fact that my sweatshirt is now a pile of ash would be the last thing in my mind. I know, that rejection of a brand so omnipresent in modern society makes me a pretty unique and rare person to find nowadays, right!

I went to the Isla Vista Starbucks a couple days ago, simply because I was tired and in need of a Double Chocolate Chip frappuchino to inject my caffeine in my system and wake me up! It was a pleasant shopping experience, but in retrospect, I probably should not gone out of my way to choose the closest Starbucks to the University when there are probably 15 closer to my house in Santa Barbara. 

The workers at this Starbucks are kind and productive workers, even in peak business hours. I got exhausted watching them - the line extended halfway out the door! Despite this, I was able to wait in line to order, order, wait in line to receive my drink, and receive my drink in less than 10 minutes. That deserves what Carol calls a "high five!" Unfortunately, I did not give my barista a "high five" because they appeared to be busy. But if it was quiet hours I would give them a "high five!"

This location never messes up my order! It's right near where I work and I can always be assured that my mobile order is perfectly made. Other locations will occasionally mess up my cold brew with cold foam, but this one never disappoint! Thank you staff!

While I dislike reviewing big chain stores, all my experiences at this place warrant a review. Every time I have been to this location something has been messed up. Two particular instances are what finally got me to make this review. The first being the time I went to pick up a mobile order for a coworker. I arrived and told them what I was picking up, the girl behind the register let me know they had not received any mobile orders. I called my coworker and let her know. She in return sent me a screenshot of the confirmation. I showed it to the cashier and again they let me know they hadn't revived any orders. I asked if I would wait and see it if takes some some to show up on their system as the order was place about 20 minutes ago. The girl apparently in charge of the mobile orders snapped at me and she's been here all day and hadn't received anything and that I was a the wrong location. I read them the address on the screenshot and checked my phones gps but they insisted I was at the wrong location. When I arrived to work, my coworker double checked her order and her gps as well to prove I had gone to the correct location. My coworker headed over to this location to speak with the employees and of course once she arrived her order was ready in the mobile pick up station and no one said a word to her. 

The second instance was today when I order two iced lattes and instead was given a hot drink. When I brought it to their attention told them it was OK as long as the second drink was iced instead somehow ended up with a Frappuccino. I stood at the window in hopes of getting anyone's attention but was ignored. After about 20 minutes of waiting finally someone looked up and and condescendingly asked "what else are you waiting for" as if to acknowledge she had seen me standing there but didn't want to help. At this point I had had it and just left. I get this that it was very busy but honestly everyone working there has ridiculously bad customer service skills. As a 20 something year old who has worked many customer service jobs this is place honestly has the worst displays of blatant rudeness I have ever experienced or seen.

Catch me rolling through this drive thru most Mon-Fri. If you get there at the right time there's not much of a wait and it goes quickly. 

They always somehow seem to frick something up though. But by the time you realize what they fricked up you're long gone on your way to the office. 

Order a wrap and be sure to receive it still frozen in the middle. Yuck!! Stick to a basic order with low expectations and you'll be fine.

I like this location for the convenience of the drive thru and that's it.

If you want to be treated like your a burden, or get your order wrong or ask for an extra pump of strawberry puree in your drink and them fill over half the cup with the puree and think its funny, go here. They are rude, mess up drinks, don't want to fix their mistakes, treat customers very poorly oh and if you ask for a pupachino be aware that they act like you are asking them to run a 20 mile marathon because they act like it puts them out tremendously. I went to this Starbucks for almost 5 years because its so close to me but I just cant handle their rudeness anymore so I drive the extra distance to Dutch bros and let me tell you .. you have to try them they are super friendly they actually ask if my dog would like a pupachino, they have special pupachinos for the dogs there, the orders are perfect. They are all happy, friendly and well its just an amazing experience. Illnever go back to Starbucks. I encourage everyone to give dutch bros a shot, you'll love them, plus they remember you.

Stopped here for coffee as we wanted a quick refresher after our Museum visit. Clean and comfy environment with good seating. A great place to get some work done or meet up with friends. Quick service but parking is super difficult.
I don't come to this location very often because of their staff. Rarely a smile or a "hi". I feel like I'm a burden to them when I come in. Curious as to how this is the norm at a Starbucks.

WORST STARBUCKS EVER. Insanely slow and can't even make coffee correctly. All I got was a hot regular coffee with cream and extra sugar, you would think they could handle that since they're a coffee place. My coffee was FREEZING and basically milk! It's completely devoid of sugar, which I asked for EXTRA of. They can't even remember to put the little green things that prevent the coffee spilling in your car in my drink that I got in the DRIVE THRU. This location sucks!

Even in an Airport I will not concede to subpar coffee, I will find the closest Starbucks and even if it's out of the way I will make a trip to get my morning coffee.  

My flight was leaving at 7am and I was definitely needing my coffee once I made it through security.  I was flying out of terminal D and this Starbucks was a short walk and was between terminals B and C.  

My coffee was made to my liking, the baristas were friendly and I was able to use my gold card.  I hope they expand their locations within the Airport and eventually add a Starbucks to terminal D, until then it's a short walk for my coffee.

I really like this Starbucks because of its convenience and proximity to campus. I also enjoy the new window pick up because it makes it much easier than going inside the usually crowded and cramped space. This isn't my go to coffee spot, but a good option when I need it.

Been a regular here since their FIRST DAY of business.For the last two months there lack of READING orders is really pathetic! YOUR NOT THE ONLY PLACE TO GO FOR DRINKS.Soo keep shlufing and rolling your eyes when customers TELL you politely"It says Grande in a Venti cup w/light ice and extra whip-cream PLEASE

The staff here is great! They are in a busy location so it's always crazy busy every time I come, I'm talking a line outside the door. There is no drive thru at this location and parking is a nightmare. That's the only downfall. It's downtown so you have to find street parking and walk here.
Always slow.    But today they were rude and condescending.   High and mighty putting me in my place as an ignorant customer.    Worst Starbucks I've been to.

Too bad it's a chain, but it least it's in the Davlan (historic building) and has some outdoor seating. I'd rather patronize a non-chain, but no other coffee shop options in the immediate vicinity that fit the bill...
Plus, you always run into someone you know there.
Friendly and great service. Love that I can get my mobile order at the outdoor window if I have my dog.

Very disappointed this morning as a longtime customer when I was called by name and handed 'egg bites'. When I left I realized the order was incorrect. I returned to retrieve the correct order, the barista announces that ' you must have picked up the wrong order' There was a new employee training and it was interesting and disappointing that 'the customer' was wrong and shamed in front of the other customers. I was handed the order, and it was called out as my order. No apology to me for having to return to the restaurant. I have been a customer for a very long time. There are many choices in location and in coffee shops, I will no longer be a customer at this location.

I really liked coming to this location however lately going inside customer service has gone downhill. Load music unfriendly staff no connection with people. 
Drive thru is better and one of the fastest.
Hit miss on the drinks sometimes you get more foam than drink. The last one I got was not even full so I paid for a grande and got a tall in large cup. No good at all. 
Hopefully things will change
Maybe the night shift shouldn't tell people to come back during regular business hours when they don't close for another 45 minutes. How unprofessional.

I've stopped here a few times. The folks who work here in the morning are friendly and work HARD!  This place was slammed and they were pushing fast to get drinks out.  I could see the frustration on people's faces while they were waiting. The person making drinks let us know a few times that he was running  behind by 10-20 mins.

The place is consistent, clean and the quality of the food and drinks are good.  Lots of parking in the morning but when the  neighboring stores are open, pack your patience.
coffee is always right and staff is extremely kind! keep up the great work! everytime i get food it is delicious and even if it is busy u are not waiting long.
Rude/indifferent staff, sloppy service (e.g., hot coffee lid half off), parking lot is always tight. The Broomall Starbucks just a little farther east on Route 3 is much better on all counts.

This Starbucks has always been terrible. I hate to sound so mean, but it's the truth. There are never enough people working and there is always a line due to the fact that it's so understaffed. In fact, I avoided this Starbucks for a long time due to some serious maintenance issues. When I say issues, I mean tiny flies were everywhere and it smelled of sour milk. I've recently come back to this location since my friends live near this one. 

To be honest, it has gotten better. Maybe it's just because it isn't very busy anymore and people are avoiding this Starbucks, lol.
Bryce (I believe his name was) was such a sweet barista while I was running late for the day. Deff enjoy coming to this location!

I would give zero if I could. Worst service I have ever gotten. DIDNT get a sandwich I ordered and they wanted me to get back in a 10 deep line for her mistake. Then sneered at us.need to get friendlier staff .
Ella and Lee were awesome! Got a delicious Carmel Macchiato, along with a Carmel Cappuccino. Excellent customer service and made my morning a little better! Thank you guys

It's a Starbucks but on mass ave. 

I've been a couple of times for meetings and it's super convenient. Although it looks small from the outside, it's pretty spacious. 

On my last visit, the WiFi wasn't working which was a disappointment. Before that, there was one person working (making drinks and taking orders) so service was quite slow. Parking can also be tricky due to the location.
I love you Starbucks!  Always have & always will!  In any state, any town you are my fav!
Really rude to there customers. Take forever to make your drink and I asked for almond milk because I can't have diary and they gave me milk instead. Don't waste your time coming here.

This has got to be the most unorganized Starbucks I've ever been to in my life!!! They're not allowing anyone in the store for mobile pickup,  they make you go thru the drive thru and the line is ridiculously long ALL THE TIME!!!! The young woman at the door was extremely rude and CRAZY, yelling at us that she couldn't let us in to pickup our order, even though she had just let ppl in before us. We sat in the drive thru line for close to 25 minutes, my order was cold so I had them remake our food. Coffee was luke warm. Manager, Jeremy Bryant needs to manage his staff and the scheduling better. I recommend you go to any other location rather than this one.

I used to be a manager at Starbucks back in the day, and let me tell you this place is perfect! The professionalism and kindness of the workers made me so happy. Everyone is so welcoming and genuinely nice!! This will definitely be my go to Starbucks when I am in this area  such good vibes!

Standing there for a few minutes, wasn't greeted or even asked if I could be helped. Many of the employees looked at me knowing I was waiting to order, yet when I decided to sit down and do what I needed to do, they started to take up everyone orders. I had questions about the menu and was very disappointing in the careless response. Business was slow , about 6 people in the coffee shop. I am not sure what the deal was or maybe it was just today or even a racial issue, but I most likely will not come to this location again.
The service was fine... but there were too many homeless hanging outside the coffee shop. Go some place else.

What can I say, it's Starbucks!  It's consistent with other Starbucks.  The prices are higher, it that what you get at the airport.  There is no place to sit down here, the nearest is the food court across the way.  For the most part, the staff is friendly.  They can be busy from time to time so expect a little wait.  Overall they are decent!

This is one of the worst Starbucks I've been to in awhile.  Staff is super rude. The coffee that was brought home this morning from this location was so disgusting. There was about an inch and a half of vanilla syrup at the bottle of the cup(literally could see out the other side. Just like water) then the expired shots sat above the small pond of vanilla syrup then milk and ice and then 3 more inches of air into cup hit lid. So as one would who spent 11 + dollars on a fancy drink would u take it back. So I took them back. They couldn't have cared less didn't want them back didn't even open the window to speak to me until they finished my new drink to replace whatever it was they made the first time. I don't think I would be so upset about it if it was the first time but this happens often at this location. So I definitely won't be returning to this location at all.

Apparently this Starbucks is closed during the majority of the day. I attempted to go through the drive thru today around 3pm and there was a sign stating the new hours of the location were something like 5am-10am and 7pm-9pm. What?! Very very bizarre for a national chain to be closed for the majority of the day. Hours are also not updated on Yelp, Google or the Starbucks website so there was no way for me to know ahead of time. The only other time I was at this location i purchased 2 hot chocolates which essentially tasted like hot water, almost no chocolate flavor. We had waited over 20 minutes in line so didn't feel like going back through for new ones so we just tossed the drinks. Not sure what's going on there but I will absolutely not be returning. Dunkin Donuts down the road is much better.

This  Starbucks is struggling. The customer service is minimal and the drinks are made incorrectly way too often. Recently the drive through has been very slow. Today, it was over 30 minutes to get my incorrectly made drink.

This place is very slow. I placed an online app order @ 4:08pm and it wasn't ready until 4:41. I had to go to the cashier and she had to make itAnd they need all hands on deck on days like this. The line was to the door and it was at least 15 people waiting.  I will never go there again!

I very rarely go to Starbucks in general - super overpriced for what it's worth. However, occasionally I'll venture out to this particular Starbucks because of the atmosphere. It's a great place to catch up with a friend or pull out my work, except during rush hour. In this case, I came here on a Sunday afternoon before closing time. Overall, super chill and relaxed.

The baristas were all super friendly and a joy to talk to (we geeked out a bit about video games). And the general vibe in the building is airy and welcoming. The AC was blasting though, so make sure you order something hot or bring a jacket if you plan on staying a while.

I have been to almost all the Starbucks in St. Petersburg/Largo/Clearwater area.  This is not solely due to the fact that I love Starbucks, but because I travel throughout the county for my job and need a place to work in between meetings.  This is my favorite Starbucks in St. Petersburg.  Most Starbucks serve the same drinks/food, so my favor of this one is based on three main reasons.

1. It is in a great central location and easy to get to.  A little outside of downtown St. Petersburg, you can easily get to 275 or stay on 4th St. to travel to other parts of Pinellas County.

2. They have a bar with stools by a window, so there is almost always a guaranteed place to work if you are by yourself.  Each seat even has an electrical outlet.

3. There is free parking.  However, the lack of parking spaces is why I take away one star.  Sometimes the entire lot is filled.  Try to avoid those busy times (lunch time, right after work, etc.).

I have been to this location a handful of times, and am never disappointed.  This store is spacious and always seems clean, the baristas are consistently friendly, and all the drinks I've had have been made to standard.

Today I brought my daughter, and one of the nice gentlemen gave her an awesome sticker.  It was a nice little surprise that made her smile!

I'll be back, for sure.

Stopped in for a chai tea latte. haven't been to a Starbucks in months with all the Covid issues but a chai tea latte just sounded good this morning with a crisp fall in the air. I've never been to this location before and probably won't come again as it seems they have changed their recipe because I received the most watered down chai tea latte I have ever had the  misfortune of receiving in my entire life.
The baristas were friendly and helpful but, the product today was beyond Undrinkable. One star, for one lousy chai tea latte.

I love this Starbucks location! It's cozy and the staff is always very friendly. There isn't a drive thru, but that's fine with me--I like getting out of the car to walk a few steps before I drink my caffeinated, carb-filled drinks!

I've been to this Starbucks countless times and have not been disappointed with my beverage. The drive thru is convenient, but can get mobbed especially at peak times, due to the location. I have only experienced one tremendous wait time to pick up an order place in advance on the app, and that was at the very beginning of COVID restrictions when they were still figuring out the kinks. The staff are friendly enough, though the volume of customers certainly prevents them from trying to make a connection with people like a smaller Starbucks are able to do.

I give this location one star. Stopped in last evening with my husband and was disappointed. The woman at the window was beyond rude with 0 personality. The male barista was also rude and made both drinks incorrectly. I ordered a tall caramel brûlée iced latte for my husband and was handed a grande with whipped cream that I said I did not want. I ordered a grande iced caramel macchiato and was given a size venti without whipped cream, even though I did in fact ask for it. My drink was also 90% milk. I was so annoyed at this point I just left. I drank about two sips of my drink then dumped it out at home. It was not even remotely enjoyable. I was too angry to go back and complain even though I was very close. Please hire staff with personalities and that have proper training on how to actually make these drinks.  Thanks.

My first time at this location, and the service was excellent! The gentleman was friendly, and the barista made good drinks. When I am back on this side of town, I will definitely visit this location.

They were very dismissive, they got my order wrong and when my husband tried to confirm our order, they dismissed him at the drive thru window. When I tried calling the phone number listed for this store, they answered the phone and said it was a CVS drive thru. The second time I called it went to an automated voice message. They did not give me a receipt or ask if I wanted one so I couldn't go back to get my correct order. 

I've been to this store multiple times and each time they either mess my order up or are rude. There was even one time they messed my order up and when I told them about it, they acted like they didn't. 

I go to Starbucks regularly and I am new to the area. This is not what I expect from a Starbucks in terms of customer service and food. Not sure if my review will make a difference but it's just sad that we have to continue to deal with this every time.

Rolling in my big red truck, then kiddo and I were in the hunt for adventure. Starting my day at home to empty coffers when it came to coffee had me fiending for a fix, and the only remedy was to get my hands on some. 

After striking out all over town on our intended target, propane, we rolled in here. Seeing the drive thru was overflowing I figured it'd be fast to go inside the assumedly empty store and snag my drip coffee. Well, I was half right. The store was empty inside and we walked right up to the counter. Despite an associate being right there it took a few minutes to be acknowledged and a few more before we were served. 

We got our goods and went outside to the patio to find a seat. I was a bit upset seeing most of them were dirty. During COVID cleanliness is so important and seeing that they'd left them like this was upsetting. We wiped one down and had a seat, enjoyed our treats and hit the road.

Not a terrible experience but certainly not what I expect from a Starbucks.

My wife and I love our Starbucks. This location in Delran is our closest  store so we visit when we can. At home we buy and mix the Starbucks coffee and it's just right. When we come in we usually get something special like Frappuccino or a Teavana Tea in the summer. I like a bold coffee and Starbucks does not disappoint. Being a Starbucks member and having their app also gets you rewards from free food or beverages to free music and apps for my iPhone which I have found to be nice.

I was surprised to find poor reviews on a Starbucks location, but after a few experiences here, I completely agree. Management needs to get involved to stream line and smooth out their work flow. 
Twice, I placed mobile orders where after arriving and standing there for another 5-10mins and asking for help, did I then find out they were out of the particular sandwiches I ordered.  If they can't update the app to say they're out so I can't order in the first place, then they should at least place a note there with my name so I can speak with a barista rather than continue to wait.
I understand any food industry can get hectic and busy, but you'd think after a while, they would've worked on some process improvements.
Customer service is not always consistently up to Starbucks standards either.
Too bad.

When I worked briefly for Starbucks (albeit it was a decade ago) my manager made one worker a shift wear a timer that'd go off every 10 minutes to remind us to do a sweep of the seating area to keep it tidy. That should be instituted here. I have never been in such a filthy Starbucks and won't be spending any time here again soon.

Indigo and I went through the drive thru. I don't remember what I ordered, something like an almond milk iced latte and an iced water. 
I do remember paying. I handed the girl a Starbucks gift card, informed her that there was probably 5 cents on it, and then handed her 6 dollars (my
Total was around 5.57). She looked at me, definitely called me stupid in her head, and said "I don't understand what you want me to do. Your total is 5.58 and you handed me 6 dollars. Do you want me to put this on your card?" 
I said "No, there's 5 cents on the card and the 6 dollars is to pay for the difference. Use the card up please".  
She wasn't rude or anything, it was just a little funny. 
Indigo gives this place 10 stars for their excellent refreshing  ice water.

This location is very cozy and uncongested.  I always make a stop here before my long trip back to NYC. The service is quick and the drinks are quality.  I get a little confused on which way is the drive thru or the parking lot when I pull in but that's because I'm not a local.

I had a great experience in the drive through today! Normally not the one to place a review on a large chain but I was genuinely impressed by how sweet their staff was and fast.

Plus my pumpkin spice latte was made to perfection & the presentation was absolutely fantastic. 

Thank you for great service guys! Keep up the good work.

Es el peor Starbucks que haya estado,siempre les falta algo,crema,caramelo,el sabor,es pésimo que nunca tengan nada para darte la orden completa.
Recién me cambie ha esta área y es el único cerca con drive thru ...por mi no le daba ni 1 estrella

No one is here but us and yet they still got our order wrong
It's typed correctly on the label but not correct
Come on people

Just a Starbucks! I mean, I will say the staff is always very delightful and they work very quickly. Usually there is a bit of a line but nothing to grunt and grown over! 

Downfall I would say is it's more of a community seating store. Not much space for more private conversations. There also isn't a free thru.

I felt my coffee very light and opened it and it was almost halfway full. I don't know if it's because it was almost closing time and they didn't want to waste time doing my drink but this is not okay. The simplest and smallest drink and they couldn't fill it up

I visited this location Friday morning 2/28/20 at approximately 8:30 am. I ordered a sausage and egg biscuit i also had ordered a drink i heard everyone was trying. Which was a "Cookies and Cream frappe" so i got my items got to work. Then i realized i wasn't given the drink i ordered i was given a "Chocolate Chip frappe" which was not what i asked for. Not sure if my order wasn't entered properly because of the line. But that shouldn't matter i should've received what i ordered now. I'm upset because i can't enjoy a drink i was looking forward to trying!

So this one takes the cake. Out of hundreds of Starbucks I've gone to over the years, this one is by far the worst service I've ever had. From the "wach yo name?", to the "we don't got the ingredients for that drink (in such a rude way), to them messing up my order, denying it, and refusing to help make my order correct until I get back in line to wait another 15 minutes.  You should be ashamed at speaking to other human beings like that, and the higher ups at Starbucks should know not to hire people like this.
Unpleasant staff and rude ,  I don't surprise now why this location not always busy and they keep changing the employees...

This Starbucks is convenient, but their drive through has gotten really slow.  Yesterday, I waited 20 minutes before I even put in my order and stood in place without moving for about 10 minutes.  Otherwise, the service is friendly.  They just need a bigger prep area and more baristas and barista stations.

Thisbone star is partly for the curt infriendly workers, and partly to Starbucks corporate. I agree with comments below about tge ride staff. My issue is the red laser scanners. For the second day in a row after saying something the forst time, the scanners were pointed up right into your eyes. Instant eye damage. I asked tgem if they had any safety training in the proper use of lasers. No. In a hospital to boot. Great, moms dying, no coffee in rooms, have to get eye damage for a cup of Java. You'd think a hospital would be on top of a facility shooting lasers in eyes. They had no idea that was bad.

This Starbucks it one that is worthy of a review purely because the staff is amazing . Being in the customer service business I can tell you that they make my stop here 10x better. On multiple occasions that I stop here, the staff has been so nice especially Sharmaine and Erica ! You can feel that they are genuinely sweet .Although our encounters of me placing my order with them is small it really does change how I feel when I walk out .

It's no secret Starbucks is not my favorite coffee house. That being said, this location that was clean, employee taking my order was a little snippy when I ordered my drink but the rest of the staff was great. It gets three stars. Which is what I consider adequate for a chain. I won't hurry back to this location, but I also won't avoid it.

I work at Montgomery Mall and have been going to this Starbucks for 15+ years.  I'm not a fan of any coffee, but I get the chai tea latte and it's always delicious.  The few times here and there that I have thought it tasted a bit weak they promptly remade it for me.  There are usually only a few people in line and they keep the line moving quickly.  There is rarely a long line there except over the holidays which is to be expected.  
The prices have not changed since McDonald's left the mall.  Prices can vary from one Starbuck's to another, but being a steady customer I can attest to the fact that they don't base their prices on who else sells coffee in the mall.
The staff is super unfriendly but they do know how to make good drinks so whatever id go back. They're decent.

Clerk working the interior customer service counter - she was sick as a dog this morning. Is Starbucks not taking temperatures of employees and checking them? This girl (Caucasian girl with bright green hair) was so sick there was no way she should have been interacting with other people - she looked like a super-spreader.
I am staying away from this store - hope she didn't give me Covid.

Starbucks in general is bad enough, but they've turned the awfulness up to 11 at this location. The space is cramped, with hardly any seating and inadequate parking. 

The workers are the worst - the combination of phony excessive friendliness and disregard that is worse than just the typical Philly-area coldness. 

In spite of being so small, however, the store is completely filthy. There's a layer of grime on every surface, and it looks like it hasn't been swept in a couple of months. Your shoes stick to the floor as you walk through because of spilled beverages and food that has been left to dry out. Just, yuck. 

Did I really just spend 3 bucks on bleah coffee at this dump?

I needed something to help sustain my focus through the night but didn't know what to try. I prefer teas over coffee but these past few weeks have been brutal and I've needed something much stronger. I've had quite a few chai lattes over the past few weeks, I tried the expresso and it was a tad bit too strong not creamy or sweet enough. I asked the barista for a suggested caffeinated coffee - one that is "creamy & sweet" and strong enough to get me through the night....it was perfectly made. My drink was amazing! 

Sorry I didn't get your name- blue or green hair female- but want to Thank you for making me a creamy sweet coffee. I appreciate your positive attitude and excellent customer service!

***Fellow yelpers PLEASE please msg me your suggestions on creamy, sweet and strong Starbucks drinks- I need to get through the next couple of days!!! Thanks!!!

Near severely undermanned. Usually only have one cashier, and one rooster, and one person doing the sandwiches. Or Starbucks it gets this much traffic, horribly managed! People are in a hurry when they are at the airport. They can send in line for 30 minutes. Very inconsiderate! Best to go to the Starbucks over by terminals A & B.

My friend and I often meet at this location to study. The staff are always friendly, efficient, and the drinks are always ready promptly. The drinks are always tasty and made to order (though I usually don't deviate from the normal with my coffee). The store is clean. It is not the biggest location, but we never have trouble finding a place to sit. Definitely recommend this location.

Two stars are going to Katie and Tom. They both made my morning by being able to smile and being super pleasant. I ordered so called Impossible Sandwich, which fervently lacked the "impossible" in it. A simple sandwich of a mediocre flavor and a simple taste. Harshly overpriced ($6.95). The location requires cleaning, especially tables and chairs.

This is the Starbucks located in the Safeway grocery store. I have gotten coffee here twice thus far. 

Both times service was on the slower-then-typical side in my opinion. The first time there was employees being trained, which was explained when I ordered, so I knew to expect a longer-then-normal wait.

The second, most recent time, there were more employees working but service was still so slow from beginning to end. 

To top it all off, right after I got my drink another customer came back with her iced tea because there was some sort of small, flying bug in it. Gross. I won't bother with this location again, there is a stand alone Starbucks directly across the street (with a drive thru even!!)
Needed a quick bite and for the price less than Uber to the nearest cafe I was able to get a drink and gluten free marshmallow steak bar.

The manager of this business needs to step it up. Every time I place an online order the items have run out by the time I get there. The only reason I pre order is because I get a traveler of coffee or I'd just come in and order. Today's items were bought and paid for before 8:30am and they've run out when I went to pick up even though online I'd already paid for them. Going to have to start going to the store on Los Altos to get my orders correct I guess.

I regularly use the app the order from my house and the experience with picking up my order is great every time. Also really happy to know the store is strict with their mask policy and is keeping the place a safe environment for the employees
I went there twice in the past couple days the lady at the drive-through was extremely rude to me and they got both of my orders wrong both times would not recommend this store

I really like this Starbucks location. I have been here so many times and it's the closest location to home. Their staff are wonderful and friendly. I have to say the best Starbucks I have been to in terms of customer service. Will return soon!

Haven't  been to a Starbucks in a long time. Had the Grande Pike Place coffee. It was good and free from my VWS account. Was going to have a bagel but there were bugs flying around in the enclosed case that was a big turn-off.

Isla vista Starbucks is notoriously trash. Never in my life have I received so much confusion from a drunk consisting of two ingredients, milk and an espresso shot. Not crazy, right? That's what I thought, until I made the mistake of paying for it and then tasting it. I also got a chicken caprese, but given the general state of things here I honestly expect ecoli from it.

Friendly staff but budget extra time because you aren't going to get in and out in a quick manner at all. The worst time to go here is when there is a conference at the convention center. At that point don't even bother. Again nice people but not quick service.
Sooooooo slow!!! Go to another location for your own sanity! 15 minutes in the drive-thru for a meh drink.

I come here because it's close, not because of great service. Lobby is erratically open. Which causes bad backups at drive through. 
The people there are nice but they need to improve their staffing.
Very nice baristas extremely friendly and considerate .clean ,always has my special cake

Okay, so I may be a little biased because I was a Starbucks barista...but I love this location.

Park behind the location or in the corporate parking lot to the left. Don't even BOTHER trying to drive through. This location is ALWAYS busy and the drive through is insane...while the lobby is completely empty. Park, walk in, get your coffee before a car even gets through the line.

The baristas are super sweet no matter what time of day, and always put a smile on my face.
Nice and cozy Starbucks to work on school assignments. The staff was super nice, wifi fast and of course the coffee fantastic!

Nothing like standing there waiting to order for 5 minutes while the guys that work there talk crap about the customers in the drive thru and the things they ordered (dropping F bombs in front of me and my 3 year old). Make eye contact he still ignores me. Then they managed to make my daughter's chocolate milk wrong and my iced white mocha wrong. Won't be going back to this location.

Why review another Starbucks? Well, for 2 simple reasons: 

1. This store is unique for being a PLUSH one and for being located inside an ER Hospital building, which itself looks like a deluxe hotel!   :-)

2. Yelp urges me to do a review, possibly because I have posted a few pics and a tip.

- Go enjoy! It's a beautiful, full service store with one exception that it does NOT redeem your earned rewards, although you can still earn stars for your purchases. 

DETAILS you can skip:
 
While visiting a friend in Reno, he suggested that we should come to this Starbucks. I was totally surprised that he brought me to an ER Hospital building, though, which by any standard looks like a luxury hotel with large atriums, waiting lounges with artistic sculptures, flowers; patios overlooking beautiful gardens! I thought my friend was probably going there to visit a friend in the ER. But no, he promptly brought me to this very stylish Starbucks, which had a very plush interior decor and a comfy outside seating area in a lobby overlooking the charming garden! Now, I understood that my friend brought me here to show off their ER hospital and this Starbucks! 

So, we got in the long line for our brew and pastry. The baristas were friendly and helpful. They moved the line rather quickly with 2 cash registers open. We happily enjoyed the goodies in its charming "lounge" area.  :-)

I liked this place so much that I went back there the next 2 days for more. I liked its seating area in the lobby, too, at a table by the large picture window overlooking the small garden below. 

However, despite its appearance of a genuine, big Starbucks Store, it is only a LICENSED one by the Starbucks franchise. That means it CANNOT redeem your earned Starbucks rewards, nor give Gold Card members free refills, although you can still earn stars for your purchases.  :-(

Oh yes, they have FREE parking in a parking structure across the Tahoe Tower Wing. :-)

July 2015

I come to this Starbucks 
Cuz it's on my way to work. 
If I don't get my coffee fix
I can be a real jerk!

The baristas are always friendly 
Whether it's drive-thru or inside. 
My coffee is always perfect 
So I can continue on my ride. 

The parking can be iffy 
Since Panera shares the space. 
But if I'm in need of strong coffee,
Starbucks is my place!
Welcome to the world's slowest Starbucks.  Really.  Everyone moves in slow motion. You will be amazed!

This place is hopping early in the morning when most of the other places haven't even opened yet.  The employees do a good job at getting the orders taken and fulfilled quickly.  One of the downsides is there is not a lot of seating near buy.

I keep coming here over and over because my girlfriend really likes Starbucks and this is the closest one in the area to where she lives.  I have never been inside and have not dealt with the people on the inside face to face so this review is simply of the drive through area.   The staff is always friendly and the drinks are always made to order.  Which is the best thing about this place as well as their drive through.  However, the lack of speed is horrible there have been multiple times where there is one person a head of me in the drive through and I have had to wait 10 to 15 minutes for my drink.  The important thing about that is it seems like the person in front of me did not make a big order no they made a small order and that is what annoys me.  Had they made a big order it would be much more reasonable for the wait.  This had happened on multiple occasions and it is kind of annoying.  Now you wonder why I keep doing this then, well it is close and it is a drive through which means I can be lazy and not leave my car.  Also the drive through staff is very friendly and nice just as slow as hell sometimes.
Dont bother coming here if youre expecting your drink to get made correctly or even taste good at all. Oh and asking for a caramel drizzle = give me diabetes! And the wait is crazy...

Will never go to a Starbucks again in life. How dare this pathetic company deny the police service and treat them the way they did.  See ya Starbucks. Hope you get robbed and police come to help you one day. Wow. You are a horrible company

Dear Starbucks, please hire better people. 

Last time I visited this place, I remember telling myself to never come back. Well this morning, I was so tired and had to get some coffee. I wait in long line and order my coffee. The person who took my order was really friendly but I could tell that he hasn't work here for a long time. I was debating between cold or ice coffee but I thought I should get a cold one since it might be easier to walk around with my luggage. I ordered a cold ice americano. Something that I ordered numerous times. NUMEROUS. The guy who took my order couldn't find the button for Iced so he Input it manually. So this is where it gets interesting. I get my coffee and it's HOT. I tell the barista that I ordered ice and he goes "I put one cube of ice in there" then I looked at him and said "I asked for iced americano" then he just paused....and looked at me like I was crazy then he started talking about the situation to his coworker and I am 55% sure that she said this be she goes "how do you make an ice americano ugh" I finally get my drink and the barista apologize for the inconvenience which I appreciate but.....I think I am gonna go to la Colombe from now on when they open!

I love this Starbucks the people here are extremely nice. I come here at night mostly to do homework and there are plenty of places to sit. The staff will also go around and ask you if you want a free sample of a drink that's in season. LOVE IT!!! I've been thru drive thru as well same type of service A+
Very friendly staff, pretty good about fixing order if messed up.  Also my dog loves their pup cups

This is an appreciated location ha. Until recently, it was the only coffee place on Mass Ave. During summer months they have a walkup window. I've had to work here many times and it's pleasant. 

If you go to the bathroom you have to have a code which you get from the barista.

I discovered a fun board they have too! Check the pics.

Horrible staff. Closes before 8pm. Refuses to serve guests. Don't even bother!

Countless number of people walking up to order and their door is locked and it's not even 8pm. Staff is trying to ignore customers!

This specific Starbucks is located inside Renown Health Medical Center.
I love the location because it's where I work but it's not the only reason. Consistency. The baristas here have never got my order wrong which is a big deal because this spot has a never ending line of customers. 
They are always on top of their game here.

I go to Starbucks several times a week if not everyday and I travel a lot so I often frequent the airport Starbucks as well. I have had several issues at this Starbucks and have finally reached the point that I felt I needed to reach out to Starbucks directly and share this review. 

The Starbucks inside the Southwest terminal at St. Louis Lambert Airport has had terrible customer service and made awful quality drinks for me time and time again. Through travel I have probably been there over 20 times in the past year and maybe one or two times has my drink been correct. Today I went to Starbucks and ordered a grande iced vanilla coffee with half and half and whip cream. They were at the bottom of the vanilla bottle so the woman goes and gets a new bottle and removes the lid and proceeds to dump the remaining contents of the old bottle in my cup, no measurement at all and I could see from looking at it that it was way too much...it was right under the bottom line on the cup! She then dumps in some coffee and ice and then half and half and put whip on top and handed it to me. She didn't mix it...it was so separated because there was so much vanilla in it that I asked if she could mix it. She gave me a dirty look and took it without a word. She then takes my cup and dumps the entire thing (whip and all) into another cup several times to mix everything and then puts more whip on top and hands it back. I took a drink and it was way way too sweet, I said I'm sorry, but can you please remake this...it is way to sweet. The other worker (who was quiet, but very polite-working the register) said she would do it but the original girl said no she would do it. Again she says nothing to me and takes my cup and throws it away. She then pumps 3 quick pumps of vanilla in my cup (I know it's 4 that go in a grande) and then dumps in half & half (way too much and I know that goes in after coffee) and then coffee...she realizes it's way too full to add in ice and dumps some of the mixture out, adds ice, puts on whip and hands it to me. I know that Starbucks uses the lines on the iced cups to measure everything (I've watched my drinks be made and I've asked) and that after syrup they put in coffee to the mid line and milk to the top line and use the measuring cup for ice to the top and I appreciate that for consistency, but this Starbucks does not ever follow that in my experience. Anyway, I had to ask for an additional pump of vanilla and it was mostly milk anyway. It was awful, but after all this time I had to get to my gate. 

I know there are off days and sometimes team members are having a bad day or maybe they are not a fit...either way, this was by far the worst experience I've had at a Stabucks yet, but sadly not the first time I've had a really poor experience at this Starbucks.

This Starbucks is painfully slow. I am here at 3:30 on a Saturday... and the two people working here are possibly the slowest, most non-urgent people ever. Which is fine, but not what I would consider ideal if you're a STARBUCKS BARISTA.... I wouldn't be surprised if this location rarely meets their sales goals... within the 20 mins I've been waiting for my small Americano, 3 people have asked for refunds. SOS. Did I mention the slow barista CHECKED her phone while 10 people are staring at her while we all are waiting for our drinks...

Every time I go to this Starbucks, they get my order wrong. I only keep going because this is the only one near me. Today I ordered a sweetened hazelnut iced coffee with almond milk. It was not sweetened at all. Thankfully, I went home with it and was able to make my own syrup for it.

This Starbucks has such a convenient location in the heart of Broad Ripple. The decor and seating is very relaxing. I ordered a medium pumpkin creme cold brew. The service was fast and the drink was delicious.

Over 30 mins of waiting on a coffee. There were multiple people waiting longer than me but I was fed up and asked for my money back because I couldnt wait any longer. The cashier asked, "why what happened?" I told him I have been waiting over 30 mins for coffee and there has been multiple people come in after me who have already gotten their drinks already. His reply was, "well some drinks take longer to make than others." There seemed to be no sense of urgency or understanding.  Other people were getting the wrong orders... Went to the Starbucks on 22nd ave n and 34th st. Same drink was done by the time I arrived at drive thru window.
