Horrible service I was in drive thru line got out went inside and cars that was behind drove out before being served or even started so I asked for money back and walked out

I love this Starbucks. The baristas are friendly and efficient. The drive thru is packed always ! Doesn't matter when you go but the inside never has a line. The downside is the parking lot is shared by a grocery store and gym so it can get full quick. It's not enough for me to find another location though ! This one is the best!! My drink order is never wrong and the food selection is always fresh.

I have come here a few times and on 2 occasion now they have gotten my drink order wrong.
Both times they fixed it right away though.

One time they gave me regular when I asked for decaf and I could feel it right away - wow.  What a jolt!

The 'Bux in Paoli is way better.

I'll soon be moving to the Castleton area and I've been making a mental list of the things that I'll miss the most about the 86th/Ditch location. The Starbucks. I have been to a numerous amount of Starbucks and spent way too much money on their coffee. No regrets, though. This Starbucks in particular has honestly won my heart. And it just so happened to be conveniently located right down the street from me for the past two years.

Why is it so grand? The staff. Customer service is key and the group of people that work here are incredibly friendly. I have often gone in the mornings when I'm barely functional and they are more than happy to deal with my zombie self. I was even in there one day when a new guy was being trained on his barista position. Everyone was patient with him - workers and customers. I think Starbucks is a great establishment and they wouldn't have the success they do today if it weren't for workers like those at the 86th/Ditch spot. So, thank you! I'll miss being right down the street, but I'll for sure make my way over every now and then after I move.
What an experience!  My app was being goofy, but the fabulous Starbucks employees not only made it right, they made it better.  Thanks for starting my Thursday with a smile!

This morning I decided to treat myself and my daughter to some Starbeezes.  The drive through line was long but I was not worried about that as we had left early to allow plenty of time.  I do undertstand that it is morning and that wasn't the problem.  I am a avid coffee drink so When my order isn't right it doesn't start my day off on the right foot.  I had ordered a venti but received a grande.  I did notice that both our coffee's were on the light side so I removed the lid's and they very alittle over 3/4 the way full so that was a disappointment as well.  I wanted to go inside and get my larger coffee but was unable to as my daughter chimed in I don't want to be late for school.
I've gone here on multiple occasions. I order a hot drink and it's luke warm. I order a coldbrew and it's barely cold. This problem has been happening consistently. Staff is friendly though ..

This is one of my favorite Starbucks in town. Everyone is very sweet and on top of it. Once in a while they send someone from Lemmon valley that I don't go to that location because of her but it's fine I love the team up there! Kim is the best barista I've ever had the experience of ordering from and her customer service is top notch. If she were to leave this location I wouldn't be coming by. Lindsey is just as amazing and I'm stoked every time I see the two! I'll keep coming back way too often for their amazing drinks!

My mobile order is always wrong. It's the right label but always the wrong item inside. (As pictured) it has happened a handful of times. I'm a mom of 4 so I can't just hop back into the car and get the right item. I'll have to start checking my order before I leave.
Could not accommodate my wife and me at holiday time despite the long drive-thru line.

This Starbucks used to have a rough time on the customer service and speed, they were always so slow, and something was wrong with a drink or order. I know it's been rough with staffing during COVID so it never changed my perspective, just my patience some mornings! 
These days they're way better, and consistent! I can always tell when Stanley is working because the line moves faster and everything is always correct. He and the others have a great personality and I always feel welcomed.
very quick & attentive Dylan was very nice & helped me pick out what drink to order! 10/10 recommend

Wow, unhelpful baristas with seriously unsanitary habits. This location is always packed, and there must've been seven employees working, but watching them work was unsettling. The work space is a mess, and the cloths used to wipe the appliances are placed on dirty counters then used to wipe steam nozzles used to froth your milk.

A gentleman returned his sandwich, saying he requested it with just egg, no meat, and there was bacon grease all over it. Turns out they cooked the pre-prepared sandwich (which includes bacon), then pulled it open, removed the bacon, and gave him the sandwich. I waited 22 minutes for my order, and at no point did I see a single employee put on gloves. So I can imagine how they pulled the bacon off the sandwich. (Ew.)

On a pickier note, my standard order is a vanilla latte with honey, and this is the first location I've encountered that "wasn't able" to add the honey to my drink. So I asked where the honey packets are, and the barista pointed to the end of the counter. Of Course, when I checked, there were no packets. I asked two different employees if they had any more. One ignored me and the other said "maybe in the back" and just stood there. When I asked him if he could check, he disappeared and didn't return. 

So, yeah, I'll be taking a hard pass on this location on my next business trip.
One of the best SB's I've ever been to. I was staying in the area for a while, and I kept going back to this location due to the friendliness and kindness of the staff. Love it!
Literally the worst Starbucks I have been to. Drinks take forever to make and the staff has no clue. Just waited 15 minutes for 2 drinks to find out they made them hot not cold. Avoid at all costs.

We stopped at this location to get some coffee and were told we could not use the restroom. The sign on the door says for paying customers which I was, and what is more I witnessed their employee enter the restroom to relieve himself, but was then told by him once he walked out that the restroom was unavailable. I was not given any reason other than it's not available.

Great service.
Fast! Friendly. Solid Cappuccino.
Drive thru!

Worst customer service I've ever had at a Starbucks, not to mention that it was filthy.  Three women working, and one man who seemed to be the manager and didn't do a single thing in the 20+ minutes I was there.  One girl taking orders - fine, but didn't help the others out when she was slow.  One girl, obviously the new one, making ALL the orders, and very unsure what to do.  And the whole time I was there waiting, the third girl did nothing (and I'm not kidding), other than pour pitchers of ice into a sink, and then pour hot water onto it to melt it.  So while the newbie was lost and confused and making a mess, one of her co-workers did nothing but melt ice.  (Actually, to be fair, the ice melter and the order taker did giggle and look at their phones too.)  But don't think I'm sympathetic to the newbie, because when she got to my very complicated order of black iced tea, she didn't know how to make it, so just set my cup aside and went on to other orders.  She didn't know what went into different orders, didn't know what lids to put on what cups, and every time she spilled something (often), it just stayed there, along with cups on the floor, etc.  When I finally complained, the ice melter finished my tea.  Over 20 minutes, even though there were only two people in front of me in line when I got there.  Just awful.

This Starbucks is clean and new, although the tables could maybe be wiped down a little more frequently. The baristas are super nice and friendly! Unfortunately I think they forgot about my order and I ended up having to wait over 20 minutes for just a regular coffee. I was a little annoyed, but they sincerely apologized and then gave me a size upgrade which was definitely nice of them! The inside is small but most people tend to order to go. It's right next to the convention center, so most patrons tend to be people going there or from the hotel this Starbucks operates out of.

This location has the nicest Starbucks employees! They were all so welcoming and cheerful! My order was messed up and when I went in to fix it they went above and beyond! I wish I would have got their names to mention them because they are all so sweet!
Love this store! Staff is always kind and attentive. The drive through line is always a bit long, but I don't mind waiting. :) I come here almost every morning and I am grateful for it!

Ordered ahead, just like everyone else says, it took forever. When we ordered it said it would be ready in 10-12 minutes. No lie 30 minutes from the time we ordered we finally got our drinks. They seem to love at half speed here. It is a convenient location but not worth going to. We regularly use the Concord Pike location, which is just as busy as this one most days, and we never wait half the time this one takes!! It doesn't make sense to me that at two different locations you could have such a huge discrepancy in wait times.
Great, great service!!!!  Wow... Refreshing in our negative news cycle/popular culture!  We were served by Claire and Natalie... great spirit!!
Breakfast sandwich served cold in the middle!  Disappointing considering the price.  After a long line and a high price I expect a warm sandwich.

I have to say, I'm not a Starbucks regular, in fact, I think this is only the second time I've been to Starbucks. However, I like coffee, and after I had my eye lasered upstairs, the doctor suggested we have coffee while we had to wait 45 minutes after the procedure, and I thought that was a fantastic idea.

I got a mocha latte, and my hubby got a iced caramel Frappuccino. I have no idea why I got hot coffee on such a hot day, I don't know what I was thinking. I still think almost $11 for two cups of coffee is highly ridiculous, but what the heck, my eyesight was being restored, so damn the torpedoes, full speed ahead. 

The coffee was fine, really good, it's Starbucks, they really can't screw it up, can they? In fact, my husband's was delicious, and I wished I'd gotten that. I ordered a medium, and if that's a medium, I'd hate to see a "grande," holy crap, it was big! Hubby got a "vente," whatever that is, and it was massive, more than he, or we could drink. I don't get the "secret" language at Starbucks, how you have to be in the know to understand what the heck you're ordering unless you're a regular, and why people are happy to pay $11 for two cups of coffee day in and day out.

Here comes the part about service. Whey you pay $11 for two cups of coffee, one would expect a modicum of decent service with your Joe, wouldn't one? Well, I guess at Starbucks, that's not the case. The register person was relatively patient with us as it was obvious we weren't the regulars, and didn't know what the heck to order. She pointed vaguely to the other end of the counter, not looking at us, when we asked where to pick up. Aren't they supposed to write your name on the cup, in some kind of cutesy type of customer service? Not here. Instead, your cup is slammed down on the counter, with the contents screamed out, "something something, in a vente cup!!", with her arm outstretched while she moved as far away as she could in the other direction. Wow, I feel so special. My vente cup without even a warmer band on it, thank you very much, we had to put those on ourselves. 

So, our Starbucks experience was less than stellar, and certainly not worth $11, especially just for coffee. I just don't get it, but maybe I'm just old.

Despite my better judgement I went into this establishment. I absolutely do not usually go into a Starbucks. There have been many controversial stories about this place and they don't support our veterans. My daughter was hungry and thirsty and picked this place so I tried it. The coffee always tastes burnt from past experiences many years ago and today was no different. The sandwich was absolutely disgusting. I will NOT be going back to this place. To make matters worse a weird man came in and was constantly looking at my 4 year old daughter. He was absolutely creepy and made the hair on the back of my neck stand up. Something was off about him. I got my daughter and got out of there as quick as I could.

I recently started visiting this Starbucks more frequently. The employees are so friendly here! My drinks are always made correctly and always available when I arrive. (If you're not taking advantage of mobile ordering, you're doing it wrong.) just today, I ordered a drink that doesn't normally come with whipped cream. Today, it came with it. I'm not allergic, just didn't want the extra 100 calories, so I asked the barista if she wouldn't mind just scraping it off for me so I wouldn't be tempted to eat it anyway. She said of course, and then before doing it said, 'you know, I'm just gonna make you a new one!' Totally unnecessary, but I appreciated the sentiment. So thank you, nice Starbucks employees!

I'm seriously taking it personally that this Starbucks only has a 2.5 star rating. As it may be my favorite Starbucks. Here's the thing, upon perusing the below reviews, the folks that review it negatively are basing their review off one or two negative experiences. Take it from a girl who frequents this establishment multiple times per week - it doesn't get much better. 

I will say there isn't a lot of seating room. So if you are looking to post up and get some work done, maybe don't. This is the perfect location to come in grab and go or come in, grab, eat quickly then go. The staff is super nice and friendly. They remember me and my  order - what more can you ask for??? 

Negative - this shopping center parking lot STINKS.

Starbucks target- city line Wonder why this starbucks have 3 stars horrible I stopped for a  new frappe  that they currently sell with the sugar buttery topping that's way to sweet so instead I ask for the Carmel topping that goes in the frappe well what do you know my already 5.23 cent drink is now 6.03! Why  because I have to charge you for extra topping ! Why because you got extra are you serious! It's a frappe! I didn't ask for extra, I ask for carmel not sugar! I  hope they close this place down! I have brought this drink 5 times from. Delaware, Abington, Warrington Pa and in Montgomeryville  Pa., I come to this store to deal with this person that evidently have stock in Starbucks stay clear of this store! They cheating people charging when it's not extra. I tell you what they got the right person working behind that register as cashier! She Argued  me to the tee about that charge,  I won't be returning!
Slowest place on earth.  Grass grows faster.  Paint is like Andretti compared to this place.

I'm dropping my rating because lately it's becoming impossible to get my coffee without a half of a carton of soymilk in it.

Just had the WORST EXPERIENCE IN A STARBUCKS EVER!

We've been Gold card holders with Starbucks since 2010. Additionally we shop Starbucks daily. Multiple times Daily. 

This location for a new location is one you should skip. There is a DD down the road.

Most of the employees are rude and super brisk (which I understand being in a hurry; I've worked the exact same job before) and do not make orders correctly. Awful experience. The Starbucks at Circle Tower is super busy too but the employees are (or at least act like) decent people, and it's only 3-4 mins away so order there instead.

I realize that this Starbucks isn't perfect. It's right around the corner from my house and I go once in a while to honestly just get a break from my house.  I think the universe wanted me to go today. 

It took a bit longer but I didn't mind because I needed the break from my toddler who just hit the attached to mom, scream until I get picked up phase. Shout out to Anthal, the guy taking orders at the drive thru was AWESOME! He was friendly and funny and an absolute joy to interact with! Thank You!!!!!

Really liked the space inside this Starbucks. I often use Starbucks to study but some locations don't offer a good amount of table space. This Starbucks has a decent amount of tables/chairs. I've come to this Starbucks a few times in the drive through only. While they were not significantly busy at all and it still took over 10 minutes to get through the drive through each time. Absolutely ridiculous considering there were more than 4 people working each time

I place a mobile order 5-6x a week and the app usually tells me it's a 5-7 minute wait but it tends to be more like 10-15+ min sometimes which is understandable  but Lily's terrible attitude towards her coworkers and customers is not and is completely unacceptable. The two stars are for the rest of the staff who can handle a rush hour with a positive attitude despite having to work alongside a rude coworker

I'm not sure if it shortage of staff or not being able to handle a busy morning. Came in to order due to drive thru line being long. Was told lobby is just mobile order. Love the location on Mass Ave, but the service here is always spotty.  They had four people behind the counter so I couldn't figure out why it took over five minutes to give me a brewed coffee. The people here really seem nice, but 9/10 they get my drink wrong. I've gotten cold sandwiches, iced drinks with no ice, lattes with no milk...it's just bizarre

Stopped by here twice on a road trip. Shop was clean and well kept. Both times the staff was pleasant, welcoming and professional. This is definitely one of the better Starbucks we've been two (hence why we went twice!).

I'm updating my first review, because when I wrote it the store was new and I was allowing for that. 

THIS IS THE SLOWEST Starbucks I've ever seen. No one behind the counter is moving faster than a snail's pace. The same guy has forgotten to give me a spoon for my yogurt the last three times I've been here.

It's the only drive thru in the area, so sometimes I have to go there if I'm not wanting to get out of my car. But otherwise, you can drive a couple of mikes north or south and still get your drinks faster.

Every time we come to this specific Starbucks location we always get greeted right away, friendly staff & drinks come out perfect. Usually coffee places we have to ask for not so sweet, as in half the pumps & for the coffee to come out extra hot but not here.

I hate reviewing chains, because the heart of a franchise is consistency. What's the difference between one Starbucks and another? Nothing, if they're doing it right. I came here for a really quick visit, as I placed my order through the drive through. I started going back to Starbucks on Longley Ln.  Reno, Nv.  I think the store # is 13629.  I had been going to the one on Greg St. & McCarran, Sparks, Nv.  but it became REAL UNCOMFORTABLE. This place really went downhill. They are messing the Starbucks reputation up. Just expect to wait at least 10 minutes if there's at least two cars in your line drive thru. They have zero emphasis on speed.

To be honest, I searched the evening before my visit for a good local coffee shop I could make a quick run to from the Hyatt Regency before grabbing the car from vallet. It appeared to be a fully operating Starbucks franchise, not like the subpar locations tucked inside the grocery chains and Target. So, this rewards redemption news was disappointing. 

At the time of my visit, the Cinnamon Shortbread Latte was a featured drink so I ordered one hot for me and one iced for the wife; while earning 25 bonus star-dash flavor points for ordering two lattes. 

Ordering was easy. Speed was normal and it wasn't busy. The drinks were delicious.

There's a specific Employee that's extremely rude each time I come here, she's a larger Caucasian woman, it's not just me because I've heard other people say the same thing. She always has a nasty attitude, she should find a new job if she's so miserable.

Stopped at the Starbucks when I finished my doctors appt wanted something different to drink. Service was great decided to try the mango dragon fruit refresher it was great cold lightly sweetened price as usual wax a bit high in my opinion but it was great for a quick treat on the run home

This Starbucks is a real hit or miss. But 90% of the time it's a big fat miss. I will now avoid this place like the plague and drive out of my way for coffee.

Guess I need to make my coffee order easier so there's no way for them to mess it up.

On the smaller side, newly opened Starbucks location. Be careful using the drive through because one lane is for the attached bank, which is still under partial construction.

Afternoon, I stop by this Starbucks at least 6 days a week. It's only a good location if you don't mind waiting 30 plus minutes for a coffee. I am pretty sure that the wait time could be improved by having employees that actually care about serving customers. One person up front and the other 8 are standing there doing nothing. I felt bad for the barista.

When these folks were located in strip in front Wal-Mart they had excellent service.  Since moving they have lost it.  Some of the staff are the same so I am not sure exactly what the issue is. Piss Poor Attitude. Good morning, afternoon, or evening... most of all a very simple thank you is in their vocabulary. If you like a crapy stuck up attitude.. feel free to swallow their load. Cuz its  cumming all over your face.

What do you drink when you pick up a donut ?  

Yes, a drink from Starbucks, especially when it has a drive-thru!

Wanted to treat the hubby, (also this location is walking distance from his work), so I drove thru, and had to get the newest creation.

Line had three cars in front, a little slow moving, but worth the wait.

I ordered the Cold Brew Nitro... very cool and tasty!

Whew, this is a rough Starbucks to visit - that is, if you aren't utilizing the noteworthy drive-thru (which there aren't many area Starbucks with drive-thrus for when you don't wish to get out of your car!).

Always friendly service, never to long of a wait.

Friendly and fast during a rush. Everyone was hustling and they kept the line moving.

Very disappointing as was the customer service who I spent far too long getting a refund.  Starbucks call center is atrocious, the first person hung up on me and the second didn't know what she was doing

Worst online order experience and worst Starbucks experience.

I love this Starbucks! The baristas have always been super nice and the space itself is nice as well. It has a very clean, industrial look! Lots of table space as well!

A week later, I ordered coffee travelers from them And I specifically asked them to charge me for the extras (to avoid problems later) but I guess they forgot. Next thing I know the barista is lecturing me on how I have to pay for extras. They have a serious attitude problem. One of my employees called the district manager and nothing was done there either. 

I go to Starbucks every day and get the $6.20 frap. So that's $2,256.80 per year that I am going to have to stop spending due to shit service. Thanks for saving money in the future!

The staff at this particular Starbucks is pretty awesome. I stopped in this afternoon with a reward to redeem. I decided 4
shots would suffice for an afternoon pick me up but, as far as flavors, I was undecided. 
The barista asked me what flavors I liked and I replied "white chocolate" and "butterscotch." She suggested combining them, that although it sounds like a rather wack mashup, it was actually quite good. And she was right!

This Starbucks always does a great job but today I was watching an employee ask the manager a question where something was at, the manager Michelle responded "it's right there in front of your face" then again "IT WAS RIGHT IN FRONT OF YOUR FACE" the employees definitely didn't feel good about that response and it was very sad to watch and made me uncomfortable. Definitely makes learning difficult when you can't ask a simple question.

Slowest drive thru I've ever experienced. And it's every time I try coming here. I used to work at a Starbucks in Sacramento and I've absolutely never seen a drive through this slow. I tried to give it a few tries thinking it was just a couple bad days but no, it's insane. This time it took me 20 minutes

I can't believe my 3 year old knows what Starbucks is and knows what he loves to get when we visit. But he does, and it's incredibly cute when he asks to go get some "sones", and I can never say no. 

It's pretty convenient that they're in the same building as some pediatric offices. So when we visit the pediatrician we always need a special treat to coax the cooperation out, and a quick trip to Starbucks always does the trick.

We saw the brightly colored refreshers on a sign, so that's what we got. They were super refreshing and a perfect afternoon treat. The little dude needed a snack too, so we got a petite vanilla scone and a cake pop. 

Service was on point and very friendly. 

Great experience.

Ugh I'm so disappointed in the customer service I receive here, no matter how Busy you are you're a national branded company, this is unacceptable. Not only are the wait times very long; the baristas are unfriendly and unwilling to fix drinks they mess up which is a Starbucks policy! 

I ordered an iced drink, waited over 5 minutes for it to receive a hot drink. I said this was supposed to be iced, he responded drinks don't come iced I added ice to it.. so not only did I not get my iced drink, nor a hot drink, I got a crummy $6 luke warm drink. 

This location needs to improve customer service because it's really sad to come back every week to see the Same thing.

This has been a regular stop on the way to work for me going on 5+ years now. Up front, the three stars are for the staff however, a couple drag the rest down, one with a regularly flippant attitude. 

Another common occurrence is at the point of sale when hot food items are ordered. The patron's name is not asked and when the order comes, a weak callout is made with only the name of the food and consequently not heard in restaurant over the often loud music and sometimes the sound level of the staff having a good time at work... I love seeing happy employees so perhaps this is a fair trade-off. However, a half warm breakfast sandwich tastes like hell. Often, they do not have in stock breakfast items like the heated sandwiches. Who does the ordering and for that matter, is there a manager even present seeing to these and the following glaring indiscretions?

As for the condition of the restaurant, I'd have to say it's a bit dirty and unattended. The window exteriors appear to not have been cleaned since the remodel, the window interiors are not far behind. The tables don't get wiped on a regular basis through the morning as well as the floor swept and debris remaining throughout the morning, it doesn't appear that it's mopped nightly either. The supply station is often out of items as I have observed often on my numerous visits at 6 am, the condition of the floors as described herein, unswept and still showing the signs of the previous business day. I did ask about this once and was told "Oh, we got hammered this morning". Again, 6 am and I look around seeing that I was one of three people in the place and but two cars in line outside and the staff partying it up... Really?

As said, there are good people working there that take a personal pride in the job they do but all that goes out the door given the aforementioned issues. A manager that isn't busy behind the counter preparing orders to oversee that the place is taken care of would be a start. A good hard cleaning of the entire restaurant, inside and out including the filthy paved areas outside and the furniture is more than overdue. I suggest steam cleaning and sterilization. Can anyone say "Reset"?

This location ALWAYS makes my drink right. The staff is always friendly and people are awesome to deal with. Please remember, even if you placed a to-go order, try to tip! You got a $8 coffee, you can send them a few dollars. They don't make much. I always tip them whenever I can.

I come here almost every morning and usually leave with a smile on my face! The baristas are always so friendly and if you go often enough, they will start to remember you and possibly your drink order if you don't change up too often! I use the drive thru on my way to work which usually take around 10 minutes start to finish around 9:30am. 

There are a ton of cars they service at this time so all in all, the wait isn't all the bad. You could always park and go onside to order but that would take just as long in my opinion. 

My drink order is always right and is always consistent no matter what I order. I do change my order frequently so consistency is key and they do a really good job of this. My go to is pretty simple, iced latte. But, I love to try all of their seasonal beverages. I recommend the pumpkin spice cold brew which is new this year. Just a hint of pumpkin so more for everyday drinking where as the traditional pumpkin spice latte is so sweet (and delicious) but I couldn't drink it everyday. They also have seasonal food items which I still haven't tried yet but plan to! 

My favorite breakfast items are the egg bites (any flavor) and the bacon and Gouda breakfast sandwich. That is the bomb dot com. You can go wrong when trying one of these to kick start your day with flavor plus they are so filling and it last all the way until lunch! 

Who would have thought just stopping in for 10 minutes a day would bring so much happiness to my day and get it started on the right foot. I love my Starbucks and everyone who works there! I'll take some pics next time I'm in!
Longest wait I've ever had in a drive thru. Unbelievable. I go to a lot of busier Starbucks. Should be -1 star.

I love the drive through at this Starbucks. I realize that sentence makes me sound like the laziest person alive, but I'm typically on my way to a friend's house whenever I swing by this location and the drive through is just too convenient to pass up. Everyone who works there is super friendly from my experiences and the line moves quickly. They even plug your drinks with those little green plastic things so there's no spillage. I just wish there was a more convenient way to get out of the parking lot, instead of having to drive back through the strip mall lot.

The gentleman who took my order was very kind and definitely knows good drinks . i ordered a "Guava ice tea lemonade " asked for feedback and definitely glad i got it . very sweet and fast service here :)

Better vibe at Target's Starbucks.Uncomfortable here. I don't know if it was the odd way the tables were positioned that there's not enough room here or the particular clientele that day but, yeah, the order was correct.

The drive-through line is extremely long. However you never know that from the way the employees treat you. The employees treat you so nicely and with so much laughter and joy. I must say I don't know how they keep such a good attitude, but keep it going. You're the best!

This store used to be my favorite,  but since the change of staff members,  this store has gone down hill. So many times my drink has been made incorrectly.  Today topped it as they gave me a coffee, instead of tea, then when I went back to correct it(and  paid for it again) they made that drink incorrectly.  I would have gone back for a refund, but I was already at work and couldn't leave.  Waste of $11 .

You'll find this location attached to the Hilton Bayfront Hotel. They have an entrance off the street and one inside the hotel also. They have shorter hours due to the location as well so be sure they are open before coming this way. They do not have a drive thru.  

They have the standard food, mugs, snacks and beverages of all the locations. Staff was friendly and the store was clean. They do not have a scanner for the phone app so the cashier had to manual input the number, and I felt bad for him having to do that!

They has my drink finished before I was done at the register. They also had the Florida ornament mug, which I picked up here as well! 

No bathroom inside, odd location, off site parking and no drive thru being this place down a bit.

Overall: A
Great service. Short hours. Plenty of seating!

I stop in here at least twice a week because my husband likes their hot pour over coffee. It seems like recently the drinks taste watered down. Very disappointed the last 3 times I gone here I was unsatisfied.  I did call and complain the 1st time and was given a credit of the amount I spent so we went there to use it and the drink was fixed for my husband but I also ordered a drink and it was horrible I just dont know what's going on with this starbucks lately. I didnt want to complain again so I brushed it off. I returned yesterday and had the same issue it is watered down and there was nothing sweet about my drink. I think I am done with going back here and throwing my money away. I am going to have to find another starbucks or go to dunkin donuts. As of now I do not recommend

From the outside, this shop looks VERY shady. However, inside it's beautiful, cozy and larger than it looks. This shop even has like a Local feel and look to it. Baristas are helpful and welcoming and the service was awesome. Lots of electrical sockets too. They just need to get more parking space and give the place a new paint job.

I love this location of Starbucks.  It is small and quaint.  The staff is very happy and helpful.  I like to get an Iced Coffee or Cold Brew before hitting nearby stores.  The drinks are strong and flavorful.  Easy Parking in a Private Lot.

My absolute favorite Starbucks! Best in the country hands-down! Drinks are always made with love, consistency and perfection. The Iced Toasted White Chocolate Mocha is my absolute favorite drink. The environment is fun, welcoming and delightful. (If there are any improvements I would recommend..they would be: a fireplace, a bigger selection of cushioned chairs, outlets at the center high-tables, bistro-boxes, and mango syrup year-round lol! That's a lot to ask for, but you can always hope right?? ;)) My favorite Barista, Nick, a probable mid-20's gentlemen, that wears a black beanie..is absolutely phenomenal. This gentleman is hilarious, and a pleasure to speak with. Nick, himself, made my experience rewarding, making me want to come back. Kudos, to the management at this Starbucks for excellence.
They just renovated this location and it's beautiful! Speedy and friendly service left me smiling. :]
This Starbucks usually has a long line but every time I'm here they do a good job of managing drink orders and getting everyone moved in and out quickly. They even got my drink perfect!

This is one of my favorite Starbucks locations to get coffee from - the employees are always patient as I'm sometimes indecisive in what to get and ordering ahead with the Starbucks app makes things super easy; they always have the order ready within 5-10 minutes tops! Usually I only come to Starbucks to complete the star dashes and earn points...and check out the seasonal merchandise!

They've done a great job spacing out the tables at this Starbucks location and encouraging the use of masks. Pumpkin spice lattes, here I come! :)

Thank you, 17th Street Starbucks!

Conveniently located on the Galleria's second level, just outside Nordstrom's women's section and adjacent the Disney Store. If you can't find it with this navigation you're at the wrong mall lol..

It's a very inviting space; full of color, character and cool barista's. They have tons of merchandise for sale from tumblers to coffee beans. Tables inside and outside the store are in wifi range. There's an extraordinary feature at this SBUX, the exposed brick detail both inside and outside of the store. I'm a sucker for exposed brick.

Be advised its in a very busy mall so there is no peace to be had here...save your work for another location.

~Christy

Perhaps it's a strange connection I feel to this particular Starbucks that is compelling me to update my last review of them from 4 to 5 stars. But what can I say? I come here at least three times a week and I consistently experience kind and professional customer service as well as consistently delicious coffee--and that kind of service and product three times a week over a year says a lot about an establishment. 

Other things: 
- There is no drive-thru at this location, which is maybe why I love it so much! It allows your coffee to gently interrupt your day by forcing you to park your car, go into the shop, chat with a barista, and THEN enjoy your coffee. But I'm a sucker for the experience of something, even if it is a quick coffee run. ;)
- They have specials a lot, and I still haven't figured out how to track when this occurs (maybe the Starbucks app?). I've come here on several occasions and left having paid for only one of my two drinks because they were running a deal of some sort.
- If you're staying a little while to get work done, their wifi runs well and has never given me any problems!

Surprised that one would have so much to say about a Starbucks? Me too, but I can't help myself. This is hands down my favorite Starbucks. There's somethin' special about it!

This is by far the worst Starbucks in town primarily because they don't have a drive thru so you end up waiting far too long for your order or don't get what you ordered  . I also noticed that the staff here in particular is very inept , chaotic and disorganized . The few times Ive come here when I'm in the area I'll end up waiting 15 minutes for a single drink when it's not all that very busy or they get my order wrong and say that someone named Jim " accidentally took it .It happens ! "So I paid for a croissant Jim stole and I had to wait 20 minutes for it . That ish is crazy. It's also in an odd part of town so There's often ppl loafing around  vaping on the patio so as you're walking in you inhale their second hand cotton candy vape clouds ... not lovely. All in all it's just A straight up shit show if you will . Three thumbs down .
This Starbucks is the best location on the Westbank! Drinks are always consistent and perfected. The baristas here are super friendly and provide the best service.

This used to be my favorite location. Sadly some of the newer baristas are rude. I understand that people make mistakes, I used to work customer service. Offering no apology and being rude on top of it makes me rethink being a patron there.

"A Coffey A Day Keeps The Grumpy Away" Starbucks is a TREAT for me, at almost $6 bucks a pop for a Grande Coffee, its not everyday I can indulge in a tasty treat. I was so excited for my Pumpkin Spice Latte, I could hardly stand it.  I recently started counting how much protein I was consuming and friend told me that Starbucks offered protein for their drinks. So I drove up to the window and ordered my delicious beverage and asked for a scoop of protein in my drink...no problems, until I asked the question NO ONE WHO WAS WORKING SEEMED TO KNOW. How many grams of protein was in a scoop of your protein powder? 

Seemed like a pretty legitimate question. As a person on a high protein diet I want to know how many grams of protein is in the scoop you offer. Not one person who was working could answer. I then asked...is it possible to look at the package the protein powder is in? NOPE...we throw it away and transfer it, into another container. (Angry Face). 

Ok I'm over not knowing how many grams of protein is in my drink, I know I'm getting some protein in and I just want to sip on my deliciousness. I open my mouth for a big warm tasty treat, but what am I surprised with...CHUNKS of unstirred protein powder. SO NASTY...

THANKS STARBUCKS.

Idk why I keep trying because every time I come here it's really not good. I haven't had an issue with time or a wrong order, it just always tastes so bad. Like bad. Confused bc it's the only Starbucks I go to that continuously tastes different! I guess it's my fault that I keep going back but I just always think there's no way it can be bad AGAIN.

Ordered a strawberry açaí extra strawberries and light ice in the drive thru. Made sure to repeat light ice, I don't like paying for a cup of ice and 3 swings of refresher. So I get my order and there are no extra berries and the cup is FULL of ice. I'll stick to my normal Starbucks from now on.

Just waited 15 minutes for an iced tea with 3 people in line waiting. Paul the barista had immense attitude when I asked about the wait. It was clear that they were only interested in the take out orders done online. Really don't care for the snarky attitude, slow wait times with more people working then in the store and lack of customer service.

So... It's a hotel lobby Starbucks. Pretty typical. Small and limited seating. 
Today, however, the crew seemed to be somewhat flummoxed by the whole process. The two young men at the counter were trying very hard to provide good service but they seemed to be a little overwhelmed by the process - not providing bags, forgetting if they had rung things up, etc. They both were very friendly - welcoming each customer and saying "thank you." I appreciate that. 
The coffee is fine and better than the mass-produced brown stuff in the conference urns!

Changed rating from two stars to one due to harassment from possibly employees (though I can't be certain) with new Yelp accounts. Reporting the incident to Starbucks corporate.  The Starbucks was the worst I've been to in a very long time. It wasn't because any drink was made wrong as was messaged to me after I left a picture that was against yelps rules that I didn't know about. I removed the picture and I'm not even sure who the person was who reported it so I can't say it was a manager or employee. I have no idea. However it wasn't about drinks being made improperly as I don't drink coffee nor do I drink tea. My main complaint about this place is the arrogance of the barista who assisted my cousin and me. We asked for a chocolate croissant warmed up and you would've sworn we asked her to make one from scratch. I also had to protein boxes rung up for me by a very nice barista. However the rest of them were too busy discussing their personal business that they didn't pay a lot of attention to the customers. Yes they took orders! But zero customer service skills. When the girl who was heating up the chocolate croissant handed it to me I said thank you and she said you're welcome and turned on me so quickly. Shouldn't she be thanking me? She's the biggest scowl on her face the entire time. I'm not describing her:  that's up to management to decide who it was but she was arrogant from the word go. I no longer live in that area thank God because this is one of the reasons. But I told my cousin never go back that location again. She agreed as she was also surprised at the arrogance.

How does this location have no reviews? It ya da huge indoor seating area and the friendliest people! I wasn't even halfway through the door before someone poked their head up behind the counter to say hi with the biggest smile! I wish I would've taken her name . Short name starts with a maybe? 
She was so bubbly and friendly! Service was super fast too!
Location has tons of parking, a drive through, and was very clean when I saw it :)

It's Starbucks. Honestly I haven't been to Starbucks in a bit.. but it's Starbucks! What else can be said? Friendly staff. Quick service. I'm loving the Cloud Macchiato. I ordered with caramel. I'm sitting outside enjoying the morning. They have a wonderful front porch and sitting area .. it's sunny and a beautiful day in St Pete... what else can I just! I'm grateful for today's blessings!

Drink was good, but pretty sure I ate uncooked bacon with my Bacon and Gruyere egg bite :( the cashier told me to wait because he wasn't sure they even had it, then waited 10 minutes (while being on my lunch break) disappoinyin

Consistently the worst Starbucks in the area.    Have had the order messed up 5 times in a row now    I know they are busy but they need better guidance and help here.     Not using this location and taking the ride to Cinnaminson .    Going to cinnaminson store where they always get it right and are %100 more pleasant.  Would have been 1 star but grading on a curve for Covid

Drive through is pretty quick, but keep in mind that you are spending $12 on watered down coffee(and that's with 2 add shots) and freezing cold (supposed to be hot) breakfast sandwich. I am over trying to give them more chances to get better.

One of my favorite area Starbucks - it's got a great modern interior, plenty of seating, and it moves drinks quickly.

If coming to relax and chill with your drink is the name of your game, then this is the perfect place - there is an area of 6 super-comfy Restoration Hardware style chairs at the front of the store. I always seem to be able to grab one, but I typically come at off-peak times (mid-afternoon; but come to think of it, is there really ever any particular peak times at a coffee house outside of morning rush?).

This location always has some interesting tunes to play in the background, that aren't overwhelming to studying or conversing.

I haven't had any reason to complain about the drinks that the baristas have pumped out, thus far.

The ordering area has a food display case that is usually stocked with most every particular thing that the Starbucks company offers. It probably wouldn't take you long to request something in the case, after perusing it!

Also, there is more than plenty enough parking here; if that's something you're worried about.

#Starbucks continually pushes using the app, but there systems have been down at this location for a week now.  Not only am I losing points each time but it's inconvenient!  I don't know if it's a management issue or a cost issue. But nonetheless get your act together #Starbucks.
Hey went threw the drive through at 6 am and the girl was super nice and made our drinks perfect

I usually love Starbucks but this location was sooo slow!! I am not exaggerating when I say it took more than 20 minutes for me to get my drink. And there wasn't a lot of people when I got there. The employees were taking their sweet time, laughing and having conversations while the clients waited. Very upsetting because I know Starbucks stores and I never had this experience before.

I have to give this Starbucks 5 stars for the incredible customer service! 
15 minutes prior the staff had no idea I had just left a downtown location for lunch who refused to acknowledge us / serve us as we stood at the counter they kept their backs to us, due to our skin color, while carrying on a complete conversation with one another-hoping we would go away -it worked we walked out.
However, a little down trodden, I walked into this Starbucks and I was greeted like an old friend!!
Took an ugly experience in my day and made it better!
Inside very clean, lots of seating inside and outside. 
If you are still reading ..wondering what Resturant?? refused to acknowledge us 
Starts with the letters...ANNEX!

It never fails. Every Frap I order from this location is delicious! The presentation is always on point w/ the whipped cream. I mostly order from the mobile app and I never have to wait when I pick it up. Even when it's busy, my wait isn't long. Every worker I've encountered has always been polite and got my order right on the first try!

Right now, utterly low class.   Probably will stay that way.  A clearly mentally ill individual hangs out around the bathroom and knocks on door to harass people.  I was harassed and yelled back-I was in for maybe a total of five minutes.  Staff came to door at the mentally ill man's request, demanded I leave the bathroom.  I did, but they were already on the phone calling the police.
These young people have zero common sense and are abusive.  They work for an abusive company and allow crazy people to dominate the restaurant.  I'd seen this before in here and should have known better.  A very bad karma place, and you can tell by some of the denizens that regularly hang out there.  Enter if you like it low.

Definitely not my favorite Starbucks, but the location in Conshy, right next to the Giant, is fairly convenient. Don't expect to lounge around here - it's tight, and there's not much room for studying or doing work.  In the afternoon, tables may be empty but aren't always clean.  Still, service is generally friendly and fast.

Small Starbucks connected to embassy suits. Only a few homeless out front some seats but over all you can sit inside or out without difficulties.  Nothing special here.  They served my breakfast egg sandwich still frozen in the middle but there did offered to make me a new one.  It just needed 20 more seconds luckily.

I'm satisfied with this Starbucks and have seen SOOOO much worse at the ones near the USC campus that this one makes me relatively happy. I've been here on several occasions to get a caffeine fix, usually before a long drive and though I do come at odd times at like 9 in the morning or 3 in the afternoon, the line usually isn't too bad the baristas are friendly, and I get my order. I mean I asked for a chai tea latte  and a way to get less sugar and the barista suggested getting skim milk which doesn't make any sense but whatever at least he's giving suggestions even if they are totally nonsensical. 

I've seen a starbucks consistently with a line of 20 people at ALL hours of the friggin day so this one seriously guys, not that bad.

Honestly this Starbucks is ok. The employees are all very nice people. However, how do y'all manage to make a drink wrong 50% of the time...especially when you're given the screen shot of the actual recipe. Vt Black iced tea, 6 pumps raspberry, 6 pumps toffee nut, breve --- that's it. I used to think it was my fault but I show the same recipe to every Starbucks I've been to and this is the only Starbucks that messes it up. 

But they do keep the place organized and clean. Very convenient location as well. And I also like that they prepare drinks very quickly. I would order on my phone and by the time I get there it's already made in less than 8 minutes. That's amazing considering how busy it can get.

This Starbucks is a joke. Walked in without masks forgetting because staying in Sarasota there is no mask mandate . They supplied masks no problem. BUT what I do not understand is that they told me to put a mask on to tell me they aren't accepting card at this time and only CASH and Starbucks rewards are accepted. WHAT IN THE WORLD?! You waited for me to put a MASK on... to tell me your machines are down and accept CASH. Clearly you do not care about covid since cash is supposedly an issue yet mandate masks still. Makes no sense. As a business you should have signs to say CASH only or when you walk in mention it. The one employee was shaking her head like I couldn't see her side unprofessional commentary. I wasn't speaking to her I was speaking to the Manager (that I couldn't even understand because I couldn't hear her with her mask on) and Cashier. When I ask why wasn't I told before ordering that machines were down they couldn't answer me looked at me like a deer in head lights.

The service at the Huntingdon Valley Shopping Center, Abington,PA is the BEST!! They listen to their customers orders and concerns. They greet you when you walk in the door and all that with a big, sincere smile. Thank you Alex for making my visit a  pleasant one. This Starbucks is my new favorite and I will highly recommend this location. 
We need more pleasant people like the baristas here.

I wish I could say there's improvement, but there's not, it's close to work and the closest so I keep trying, the drinks are NEVER correct. Seriously Starbucks, how can the Missouri locations be so much crappier than California? 
I'm to the point i want to find a new coffee house to frequent, this makes me too mad to keep throwing this much money at this business.
My $6 drink today had no sweetener added and the wrong cold foam on top, got a girlfriend a dirty chai last week, and there was not the added shot, the girl asked me what that meant and then remade....

It took about 20 attempts for the barista to comprehend by order, which was a "Venti iced coffee, lightly sweetened with cream." While this is not a complex order I felt like I was living the "Who's On First?" sketch. Every time she'd repeat what I wanted she got it wrong - thinking I wanted whipped cream on my coffee, not understanding it was supposed to be iced, etc. I felt like I was on a bad practical joke show.

On top of the frustration of PLACING my order, it took over 15 minutes for my iced coffee to end up in my hand. Considering the numerous other Starbucks locations in close vicinity, I would suggest trying one of those instead of this location since it seems to be cursed.

The ability to get anything right in this location requires a genius. My cup filled with ice after my asked for no ice. My boyfriend got a coffee, it came without creamer. We had to go to the grocery store after sitting in SB line for 30mins. Food missing, drinks with no straw. The service here is just atrocious every single time

My go to Starbucks. Staff handles it all! Never met with anything but a friendly face (even with the masking policy in place). They pay attention to your order and have gotten it right every time! "Jello" along with a few others have gotten to recognize my order (venti apple macchiato hot) and it has been nice that they say hello to me by name. 
Love having a Starbucks closer to home.. it's clean, convenient, and as I mentioned, inviting. 
-Holly

Yes it's Starbucks. But this is one of my favorite ones. It is close to my gym too! 

This location has some of the kindest, friendliest baristas. They always answer my (what must sound silly to them) questions with kindness and joy in their voice. Today I was super exhausted and told the barista (in the drive thru). So I said I need a coffee Frappuccino with extra coffee. She said "Do you want an extra shot of espresso?" OMG YES!! Will you add  hazelnut. She replied "Anything for you." I thought that was a sweet response. I ordered my son's white chocolate mocha. She asked me if I wanted an extra shot of espresso in that. No thank you.

Love this location!! Plus I can pay with my Starbucks app

Starbucks is not my favorite coffee in the world, but I'm glad they opened a store *with a drive-through* near my house. So far, we've hit the window several times per month and it has been just fine.

I never thought I would say this but I really like Isla Vista. This Starbucks is alright, but nothing special. It seems like they run out of things a lot. This most recent time: Venti sized cups. So they gave me a trenta instead. Whatever, I'm good with getting more.

I made a joke at the point where I was offered a trenta cup instead, I said "oh only if you fill the cup". Bad joke, but super serious face from Starbucks girl. Have some fun people.

Self-serve water, I actually think that's a good thing.

I like this little cornerstone of Massachusetts Avenue. This is a fairly small shop as Starbucks goes and the recent updating of furniture has lost a few more seats which is confounding to say the least! In my experience, Aaron the manger, does an awesome job managing the staff and store. The store rarely runs out of products which is appreciated by me. There can be a wait at peak times, but ordering on the app is very beneficial and it seems like they have the pick up area well organized after some tweaking. This was a company wide adjustment to the application of new technologies in service. It has improved the pick up, wait times and customer flow.  I also really like the  Bacon, Gouda and Egg Breakfast Sandwich. Not the worst offender calorically and really fluffy and tasty.

This place is busy! We were lucky to find one table and service was great.  Our barista was friendly and there was no line up. Washrooms were also nice and clean.  I usually just order a tea and it was yummy! Went to meet up with a friend and catch up and we did so in a cozy and nice environment.  Also helped that on this cold winter day the sun was shinning through the windows.
I love Starbucks...PERIOD! Nothing more to say. Need suggestions, let me know. I GOT YOU
Always clean, good coffee, great service, a d easy to pay on the app. Starbucks really gets it. Bathrooms are usually clean and nice. Good parking and friendly service.

This is the newest in town (I guess). They just opened this branch last Thursday. I've been waiting for so long for them to start running this one. The place is huge! The table setting is perfect, not too close to each other. The staff is awesome. They are really happy working here.

This location was formerly a Long John Silver's seafood fast food joint, believe it, or not. The building should have been leveled----It's not too late---and a nice, modern, INVITING space take it's place. There's currently no inside dining, which is fine by me as it doesn't give me a warm, cozy, feeling of cleanliness. So, no stars for the building.

I ordered a Venti iced coffee with ONE splash of pumpkin syrup. The splash is extra.

The associate was friendly and the staff was efficiently handling the drive thru which was wrapped around the small building (typical for this busy corner location).

I don't typically drink Starbucks; I'm not one to pay over $4 for a custom cup of iced coffee. Having enjoyed iced coffee from another well-known competitor recently, I happened to notice their Medium-sized iced coffee is about the same size as a Starbucks Venti, at half the cost. But, Starbucks coffee IS robust and really packs that caffeine punch.

I'll admit this location is very "cozy", but we all know that is code word for small.  I arrived around 4pm on a Tuesday PM, looking for a 15-30 minute respite with a nice cup of Chai tea.  There wasn't a place to sit.  It had a very nice atmostphere with the usual holiday decorations and wifi.  A very nice large casual table that could seat 12 in the middle.  The Barista's were very nice but seemingly overworked.  
Unfortunately it did take me almost 10 minutes to get my drink.  I'm sure it is much less crowded before school is let out.   
My tea was good overall.  Will come back if I can get that corner leather seat!
Everything was correct for a large drink order for our party, baristas were nice and patient.  No complaints.

A pretty standard Starbucks - friendly customer service, fast drinks, and you know what you're going to get. This place is right on Mass Ave and does have a "walk-up window" if you don't feel like venturing all the way inside. It's convenient and you know what you're going to get every time!

This location often turns off their order ahead feature (sorry for wanting to SAVE YOU AND I BOTH SOME TIME), They've out of Splenda for over a week, the drive through line is usually quite long, they're quite adamant about Mark's even though there's no current mandate, and today they were out of cold brew, which translates to "nobody brewed new cold brew last night".  The two stars is a gift, should be less.  Pretty amateur for a place that wants $6 for a cold brew.

I'll continue to visit this location, because unfortunately it's the one closest to my house.  Wish that weren't the case.

I just want to say that all of the employees handle the busy-ness of this store very well. This morning, one of the employees (Paige) stayed very patient and friendly even when a customer was being rude and upset about the store being out of certain things. You all do great work.

In the past, I have really appreciated this Starbucks location, but in recent months the drive thru has been SO SLOW. Unfortunately, this has meant that I typically have to take my business elsewhere. I would advise the same if you're in a hurry.

This a great Starbucks location! I have been through the drive thru several times, and the service is always friendly and efficient. Today I had a rare opportunity to enjoy my drink in store, and the staff was just as friendly, including answering a few questions I had about my drink, and still very efficient. I also appreciated that there is a lot of seating in this location, which made it a great place to enjoy my drink. A nice location allLy

I love this Starbucks because fill my online orders in minuets. I can order from home and on my way long boarding to school my coffee will be ready. Employees are nice, especially if they make mistakes with orders. All-in-all, I recommend all to stop on by and give this place a try.
Had the worst service I've ever had with a Starbucks location. The staff was very rude and inhospitable. Never coming back to this location.

This particular Starbucks is horrible ! They are not friendly (only to certain people) they don't greet you when you walk up to the register or tell you to have a nice day ! JUST RUDE!! They are super slow when making your drink! They make you wait until they clear out the drive through before you can get your order(or maybe it was just me ) I've frequent this particular establishment on many occasions manly mornings but the few times I went in the evening it was the complete opposite. The same 3 People work in the early morning and they really need to find a new job ! I will not be visiting this location ever again. I like to be treated with respect the same respect that I give when I visit a establishment and spend my hard earned money ! SHAME ON YOU STARBUCKS 4600 City Ave !!!

Mobile ordered to the location on 161st and spring mill and my drink was so gross. Came to this area to go to Market District and decided to stop at this location  to see if they would be willing to remake my drink correctly and they did, no problem! Great customer service team at this location!!
Fast service during non-peak hours. No complaints (or extraordinary compliments either), just what you'd expect from a Starbucks!
The usual great Starbucks products but 2 times I have been there they were out of drink stoppers. This upsets me because I've had the lattè foam out the top due to vibrations from my vehicle.

This Starbucks location is my favorite in all of Tucson. 

After moving here, I've been testing out different ones to see where I like best for all day studying. All I needed was 3 things:

Opens late, check!
Open tables, check!
Outlets available, check!

There are usually always tables available and plenty of outlets for usage. It is also one of the later closing Starbucks around here, closing at 10pm Mon-Sat and 9:30pm on Sundays. The patrons who go here are also very pleasant. 

Dock one star because baristas fail to ignore me and other customers at the register when they are tied up on many occasions. It is somewhat understandable because they have to juggle in-store customers and drive-thru. However, employees should be trained to acknowledge the customer for waiting.
if you feel like waiting 45 minutes come to this drive thru ans bring your taxes or a novel.  #worststarbucks

I came with just 10 minutes to close, unknowingly, and they still treated me like they were going to be open for hours.I think my barista's name was Stephanie. She was so awesome answered all of my questions and then even accommodated my crazy whip cream request. I just thought everyone should know how awesome she is. I will be back

My favorite Starbucks in NE Philly area. Great selection comparing to those inside Target. This Starbucks have indoor and outdoor seating which I found nice on a comfortable sunny day. Be aware that their parking lot is very limited, I believe is less than 15 cars can be parked. That's when the drive thrus come in handy. There is plenty of times when my hubby can't find parking but settle for the drive thrus.

          The only complaint I have is drive thrus are supposed to be quick, but not this one. Drinks are usually ready by the time you drive to the window. I should wait no more than 5 minutes for one venti drink. Instead every time I've waited nearly 15 minutes for 1 drink. Other than that, everything else is good.

Although this location is very convenient, it's probably one of the worst one's on the westbank. For starters, the parking space is horrible! The drive-thru is way too tight and the inside itself is absolutely trashy.

The employees aren't as friendly as the usual employees at the other locations. They barely greet you, and they have this "I hate my job" type of look on their face.

It's a Starbucks like any other Starbucks.  Overpriced coffee drinks served by people who don't have any idea what they are doing (how hard is it to remember that I want SKIM milk in my iced coffee or no whip on my frap??).

This particular Starbucks is a former bank that has been converted (it's the Westbank way!).  The parking lot is a nightmare.  On one side you can't get out of the place without playing an odd game of "musical chairs" with whoever is in the drive through.  On the other side, they squeezed parking spots in by the drive through area.  Good luck getting out of your spot if the drive through has a line.  It's not happening.

I usually only go to this Starbucks when I'm in a hurry and would rather use the drive through than have to park, order and wait.

The lines can get LONG here so have patience when you fall in. Nothing worse than disgruntled customers making snickering remarks while waiting in line. If you decide to wait in line, please keep the rude comments to yourself. Rather than making comments, you can spend the time figuring out what you would like to drink lol.  That being said, they do a nice job of moving the line along. They really do pack the kiosk with employees to help with the efficiency but I've been here a few times where they were understaffed and the line didn't move as fast. That was ok, since I knew what I was getting into. Staff is courteous considering the fact there is a wait.  Seating is ample around the kiosk, so you can take a seat and chat with your friends. If you know you want Starbucks and will be passing the kiosk anyway, I HIGHLY recommend doing themobile pick-up option on the Starbucks app to avoid the wait.

A Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks, right? The coffee here is typical (that's a good thing) and the service is great. No problems here. 

Two things that make this a 3-star starbucks:

1) The parking situation is a nightmare!
2) There are very few electrical outlets on the inside. This makes working for a long period of time pretty tough.

All in all, it's worth the stop...just park at Le Peep and leave your laptop at home!

I love Starbucks and always get the same thing. I am glad to see a Starbucks so close to home so I don't have to drive all over to get to one. The only thing that has always been an issue of mine with Starbucks is they're prices since they are a little high. Other than that I love them.

I really like this Starbuck's location because all of the employees are so personable and make me feel welcome. Yon especially (I hope I spelt his name right). Whenever I come in he always asks how I am and initiates nice conversation. I come to this location frequently because it's right across the street from where I work so it is extremely convenient. The only reason it does not get five stars is because it is high volume and sometimes I do have to wait on my order for more than 5-10 minutes.

This is the Starbucks that used to be Village Coffee & Tea Company. They still have the upper deck in use for working, studying or enjoying a cup of coffee without the distraction of the business goings on upon the primary deck. The staff and baristas are all amazing and wonderful. The quiet floor is calm and peaceful. This is close to Tulane and Loyola Universities so students will often be studying during term. Please be respectful and use headphones on your devices that are at reasonable volume as not to be distracting. Also keep discussion low and to a minimum. There is an outdoor balcony to take phone calls and hold conversation but keep the door shut so you can't be heard. Use intimate (quiet) voice. Take any drama away from the students and people needing quiet. Thank you!

I want to give them a lower score but it's my own damn fault. An overly long line for an extraordinarily average cup of anything. Not only do they mark their products up 900% but they'll argue over the verbiage of small, medium, and large. It's my own fault that I need a coffee this hard.

This is my least favorite Starbucks location of the dozen or so Starbuckses within a half mile radius of it.

They don't deal well with crowds, the bathroom is dismal, and they are often out of things.  When you have the tantalizing signs advertising my seasonal favorite gingerbread latte, you cannot be out of gingerbread syrup.

I have heard a rumor that their new manager hails from the dynamite Starbucks located at 10th and Chestnut.  I am hopeful this may to lead to some improvement, so I will give this one more chances and update as warranted.

Horrible horrible service!! I walked in to order a decaf black. The cashier wanted to know if it was a "decaf this" or a "decaf that". I just want a decaf. "Well no one ever orders decafs. That's going to take a while. You'll just have to wait! Is that OK with you?" Well, I guess I have no choice. So I sat down and waited and waited. Finally the cashier ( same one who took my order for the black decaf) calls out,  "Do you want room for cream?" Ugh, no, black means no room for cream.  Then the barista called out several minutes later, "Vente decaf!" I walk up, no decaf. I stand there for five minutes. Still no decaf. I go back and sit down for five minutes then finally I walk back to the counter and ask about the decaf they called me up for. " Oh I haven't started it yet". I kid you not, 20 minutes from placing my order to getting my coffee. That's ridiculous. The barista apparently knew I was unhappy so she got me back. She put the lid on so the drinking hole was on the crack and it would drip on my dress. Thank you. That was thoughtful. Had to drive home to change before going to work.
Love to grab a cup of coffee here. The staff is great and friendly. Plus the coffee is always good. I only wish we had more drive thru options here in Reno. Great place to have some coffee.
This Starbucks has lots of fruit flies and flies and mediocre to lacking service.  If you live in the area you'll have to go here but it could be better

Sigh, yes, I go to Starbucks.  Given the dearth of places to enjoy a cup of coffee around the area, Starbucks is the place to go.  What I truly love are the baristas.  They are friendly, make an effort to learn your name and drink if you are a regular.  They are zippy and if they are incredibly busy sometimes they will comp your next drink.  

While Starbuck's coffee, in general,  tends to taste a little on the burnt side, they are consistent with the quality of their service.  This location seems to go the extra mile for its customers.
Quick and painless coffee fix ...came from hotel couldn't stomach the coffee there had to find a real star bucks now I can start my day
Great staff and Annie the manager is awesome, kinda miss the couch to lounge and chit chat..oh wait do people actually talk in coffeehouses or just use laptops??

Upside: Decent Starbucks in a great location with pleasant employees and nice interior decorating. 
Downside: Often quite crammed on weekends, wi-fi can be pretty slow. Bathrooms only function about 50% of the time.

I'm giving this Starbucks and the morning crew (Friday, September 14) -  5 stars for handling over 100 people in their store at one time in a calm and professional manner. When I first walked in and saw more than 30 + people in line and another 30 + people waiting for their orders, I almost walked out. But since I had time, I decided to stay for the show. The barista who appears to be the manager had all her staff working like a fine tuned clock. There was no yelling, no screaming, no complaining just smiles and apologies for the delays as they worked with a few flustered customers and the hundreds of coffee and food orders. Yes the wait was long, but they got the job done as best as possible with no drama. Starbucks should show all there stores how to operate under such stressful-demanding conditions. I've seen horrible service at other Starbucks with just a dozen people in the store. This morning crew deserves a bonus and it shows how important it is to have the right person as a manager.

I always have to order my drink extra hot here. When I do ask for that, my drink is as hot as it is normally at other Starbucks. They also feel the need to correct you on the sizes you order. I want a small. Other places do that as well, but when they do it at this one, its almost as if they are saying it like they are better than you. I order a mocha with soy milk because I am allergic to milk. At this location only, I can hardly taste anything but soy milk. This is a place where I will stop by, but only if in a hurry or not passing by another coffee shop.

Hey, maybe you should have two baristas instead of one. This is a busy location and watching many drinks being made and not in the order they were given is really annoying. I'm a patient person but inefficiency is inexcusable.

Without fail - and without exaggeration - this location is consistently bad and, after so long of being so bad, apparently still no plans for improvement. I'll sub-head my review with common themes and provide the latest example of each:

Slow
As usual, the drive-thru line was about 6 cars deep and only getting longer as the staff carried on lazily with no concern about the slow service. No apologies, no urgency.

Careless
Today, the employee at the window went about his routine without hearing my questions or acknowledging the obvious eye contact I attempted with him. I asked two questions that went unanswered and instead, got his back to me while he leaned on the register and waited for the next order to come through his headset.

No-good coffee
My iced coffee with cream and classic syrup was extremely watered down - again.

It's a Starbucks - the drinks are standard, the barristas are friendly.  The line is often crazy long.  But there are usually seats to be found (unless it's a weekend morning, then I'd go to the other Starbucks on Hwy 100).  Plenty of outlets for plugging in laptops and other devices.  There's always parking somewhere in the lot, but you might not be anywhere near Starbucks.  The outside tables are nice, but you're basically sitting in the Kroger parking lot, which, again, is less than ideal.

This Starbucks has really gone down hill over the last year, and now I've just given up. Ordered a 4-shot latte macchiato today that tasted like a cup of hot milk, and I had absolutely no time to wait on a replacement being made. At this store, they not only make you wait for your coffee, they also make you wait a while for the inevitable "fixed" version required to make up for their initial incompetence. There are plenty of other coffee houses around this area, including other Starbucks, so this one should be easy enough to avoid. How this location still has a 4 star Yelp rating is beyond me.

Affectionately known as Charbucks or Fourbucks - we have adopted the slogan of:

"Friends don't let friends drink starbucks."

Save money by brewing at home with Peregrine Coffee (the BEST) or go to La Colombe or Caffeination.

I really like the layout of this Starbucks. It has ample seating for the area and lots of different options. I have found myself here more frequently recently since I've had numerous business meetings in the area. It is always busy but not crazy. I also appreciate how tidy the bathrooms are!

I've been here several times. Ice cold air conditioning. Clean restrooms. Ample outdoor seating in the shade. Appears to be brisk and efficient with the drive-thru. Full compliment of indoor seating. Efficient and friendly baristas. They get my highest Bucks Rating for treating me well. I ordered a drink that they made correctly--changed my mind (WAY to sweet), asked them for a new one, and they made me a different drink with no fuss. Yes, yes, Bucks is supposed to do this. But the execution here was very professional.

I was not a Starbucks fan until recently! Now I can't get enough of it! Especially this location! Everyone u always super friendly and they love my little Yorkie through the window (she goes for the car ride). They always get it right from my difficult drink to my simple iced coffee. And you can connect to the wifi in the drive thru!

These places are like cockroaches - they be everywhere.  And, for the most part, they're all the same.  They have friendly staff, they serve decent coffee, and the ambiance is comforting.  This location certainly doesn't divert from the norm - they have friendly staff, they serve decent coffee, and I feel comfortable there.

Just came in this afternoon with my thirsty kids in the 90 degree weather to buy a bottled ice tea for myself and get three cups of ice for the kids and I. I went through the relatively short line at the cashier, paid for my bottled ice tea and had to wait more than 10 minutes just to get some ice. The manager/employee, who is the only person making the drinks at the store at the time, was super rude to me and deliberately made me to stand there and wait for my three cups of ice for a while. He won't simply give me the ice. I felt I was treated badly after having already been in line and paid for my drink. I did not expect to wait in line just for some ice. This operation is poorly run and I will not return to pay to get harassed again.

Horrible service. If you are not a regular they make you wait. The customers who received their drinks before me actually ordered their drinks after me BUT I saw the man hand the girl a tip... this is so wrong!!! Won't be coming back!!!

I went in to Safeway last Saturday to pick up some items to make breakfast. I decided to get a vanilla bean frappuccino. The guy who made it for me had dark hair was pretty tall and I want to thank him. I had never been so pleased with Starbucks before. He made it perfectly and he was very kind.

***Update*** This location still sucks. Going on three days of them not having vanilla syrup. Can the manager really not at least get their inventory orders right?!



I'm giving this location two stars only because I've never had my drink come out wrong. However, this is definitely the SLOWEST Starbucks I have ever been to. Going inside to get your drink takes at least 15-20 minutes and the drive-thru is literally a 30-40 minute ordeal. It's ridiculous. Not once has an employee apologized for the long wait. There's always plenty of people working. I'm completely baffled by how slow they are. It certainly should not take this long to make coffee beverages.

This is my least favorite Starbucks.  I can forgive the bad parking lot because they can't really help it.
