What I don't like is the atmosphere.  The music is always WAY too loud, and I rarely come here because I can't concentrate.  The employees are also pretty unprofessional, not what I imagine Starbucks wants its people to be.  They aren't particularly polite, and a few times I had to wait a bit for an employee to notice or decide to help me.  They also have loud personal conversations and don't smile.

I don't know who's in charge here (I've never seen anyone that looks the part, at least), and they must either not care or be completely delusional.
busy morning work line, be prepared to wait like 5 nd more if u getting anything w/ espresso, pray if someone is slow at ordering or getting multiple drinks

Another goat rope at this location. Staff looks like Keystone cops literally bumping into each other.  Mixed up orders, unfilled cream containers and  walk up customers are handled last even with few drive through customers. My order was messed up as were several others. Worst was that I called to complain (per request of a sign with business cards from manager) and supervisor could not have been less interested in my complaint. But too bad for me - I like the coffee.

What sets this Starbucks apart from the others is its excellent customer service.  The baristas are warm and friendly, and always aim to please their customers (especially their regulars, who they get to know very quickly).  Most of the baristas know me by name and drink, and also know when I want my drink hot verus when I want my drink cold.  Compared to other Starbucks in the area, they are also fast and efficient when creating drinks for their customers.

I try to avoid bux, but in an airport with slim pickings like bny it's nice to have a known quantity. I got a decent Arnold Palmer, made the way I wanted it, for about the same price as other airport places charge for a bottle of pepsi. The staff was friendly. It's tiny, which is nice because it's easy to get in and out. they had a full case of the typical tasty-looking baked goods. If you forgot your souvenirs, they've got you covered with Starbucks mugs specific to Nashville (and also Memphis, for that matter). It's to the right after security, on the way to the A gates, and across from noshville. The airport is so tiny it's only about a five-minute walk from the C gates, however, so it's a runnable stop for any gate even if you're running pretty late.

There is this MILF Lady that works here that is very wacky,  She's got pale skin, dark hair and a dippy hippy vibe about her.  She's so friendly, crazy and funny that I love going into this Starbucks on the rare occasion I do caffeine.

This is a great Starbucks! I have spent many hours studying here. 

The staff is friendly and not only ask your name, but really try to learn it! 

I always find it to be clean and organized, and the coffee is delicious!

This is the unhappiest appearing staff of any Starbucks that I've patronized. The baristas are rather unpleasant, in fact. The drinks are hastily placed on the busy counter, and the customer's names are inaudibly announced. After watching a series of unhappy customer interactions for 15 minutes without my drink appearing, I inquired about it's status. I was told "we made it twice, someone else must have grabbed it." As I was standing within 10 feet the whole time, I knew this not to be true. Also, why would they remake a drink if it had been picked up, and no complaint registered??? The drink was then promptly made, and was a Starbucks beverage, just as expected. My experience does not seem isolated, based on other reviews. I would seek out other options, if available.

I love Starbucks, but it shouldn't take 20 minutes to get a drink. Also, if there's a line out the door you probably should have more than one person making drinks. Someone fast, preferably. Head a block over to 19th for faster service.

Ladies and gentlemen, I implore you to find a better Starbucks than the Flourtown PA Starbucks.  YOU CAN'T DO IT, NOPE!  I've been coming here at least 3 times a week for the past year to do work and I have to say that the workers here are exceptional. What can I say, they run a tight ship.

Howard is in here every day making coffee and keeping everything clean like a barbarian! His work ethic shows and he seems to know everyone's name. 

Jon is also killing it. He's dedicated to his craft and is a helluva guy.  

All the other workers are true warriors as well but I forget their names.

Come here for coffee.

Stopped in for an iced tea. Went through the drive thru. It was fast and they got the order correct. Often times they put the syrup in automatically even though I order it plain/without. Staff was friendly. Will continue to frequent locations but I don't understand their prices. Out of this world!

After reading the other reviews, I am figuring out why people are always taking pictures of the inside of the store. I go often to study and I've noticed the picture-taking and always wondered why. Anyway! The store itself is super clean (which it should be, since it's brand new). 
The staff are all really friendly (particularly the blonde girl with a long ponytail, the guy with gauges in his ears, and the brunette with glasses). After being charged 3 different prices for the same drink, one of them finally told me how to order it so that I get a consistent price, which was nice of them. I like that the bathroom door has a key code on it so that random people can't wander in and use it.  My only complaint is that sometimes it can take a looong time to get a drink. I assume they're still working out the kinks, because sometimes the cashier will switch in the middle of an order and go over to make drinks. This would definitely be a 5 star Starbucks if the drinks came out more quickly. There are plenty of spots to settle in and study and of course, there's free wi-fi. What more could you want?

Pleasant Experience
Clean bathrooms, excellent service, friendly conversation

Bethany was lovely.
Just your usual Starbucks. Quick, expensive, and of course the obligatory people on there laptops seemingly deep in thought. No complaints here.

Service may be fast but not so friendly. And can someone please answer me why they charge $.60 for chocolate drizzle on top of my frappé? I WILL NOT be coming back to this location. 

The drive thru was packed but they get cars in and out. There are a lot of workers inside the restaurant but they aren't smiling. I went at 8am and no one seemed to be happy to be there. 

I give this location 1 star because I frequent Starbucks quite often, and I am a Gold reward member, but this charge is ridiculous and just made me question my loyalty to this franchise.

Drive through----waiting over 10 minutes JUST to get to the area to order. So, I tried going inside the next time---same ridiculous wait, with one person in front of me. The barista's and cashiers were soo crazy slow. If you're considering Starbucks in this area, you're better off going to the Target in the same parking lot and buying the ready-to-brews, your own coffee maker, and you'll get it quicker that way. 

PASS....

Um I love Starbucks, but I don't love getting confused & 'corrected' by the barista. I asked clearly for exactly what I wanted, and did not need a 5 minute lecture on the proper jargon in which to order. I used to work at a Starbucks. I provided excellent customer service by giving customers the product they ordered, not holding them up & schooling them like a child learning their ABCs.

I got my coffee and hoped to sit and relax in a quiet environment, but the staff decided to play loud moany-groany R&B music like it was their private nightclub.

-- update: months later, no change. Turn it down!!!!

BEWARE OF CUSTOMER SERVICE-----Oh my goodness, I hate to give a Starbucks a SINGLE star review but truly I feel it only fair to let others know about this particular Starbucks. Of course it delivers everything you want: ambience, the coffee choices, the convenient location and the great prices. That's kind of in-the-bag. What I look for in Starbucks is the customer service I expect too. As a visitor to the city of New Orleans and a devout Starbucks drinker (I travel all over the world), I came in with my husband and we were NOT greeted by a friendly employee. She did NOT smile (once) nor greet us with kindness but rather looked ticked off that we ordered the most expensive grilled cheese sandwich on the menu (probably because she had to heat it up...?). No smiles, no Thank you. We bought juices too. A total order of $20.
Then, I realized that I forgot to order some water with our order and I went up to the counter and after being very polite and not interrupting anyone, I softly asked a person behind the counter if it was possible to get a cup of water. The other employer said, "Don't ask me, I'm in training". This was not the same person who was at the register. I said "Well I'm sorry, but how could I have possibly know this? Don't you work here?" She shuffled off and ignored me! I then asked a THIRD employee behind the counter who was friendly with the Barrista only and not to other customers and she gave me dirty look and said "Just wait a minute". I stood there for over five minutes and she continued to make drinks, and help other customers. I went back to my table and my husband asked if I was able to get my water. I said no. He got up and then went to the Barrister and then he noticed that a water was on the counter. Apparently, she had made it and just left it on the counter not bothering to let us know. I'm sorry if this sounds stupid for me being upset over a few unfriendly employees and a water request, but I just expect so much MORE from a Starbucks. This just stood out in my mind as a total unusual store and such a bad experience. I won't go back to this store. I'll try others instead.

Absolutely the worst Starbucks in the city of Philadelphia. Sat in the drive-through for close to 17 minutes only because there was no place to park, I pull up to place my order and someone runs out with a piece of paper and says I'm sorry ma'am the drive-through was closed. I was not able to drive around the cars that were in front of me so I had to sit there. I asked him can't they just take my order since I'm right here and can't go anywhere. The cars behind me can at least back up and leave and he turns to me and said did you not understand when I said the drive-through is closed. Are you serious that you just spoke to me like that. Never have a problem at any other Starbucks except for this one and of course this one is a block away from my house. Managers are always stressed and treat employees like crap in front of customers. It's actually embarrassing as a customer to watch it happen.
Great service, nice workers, clean dining area, and quick response time! But let's be honest...it's a Starbucks, so that's to be expected!

Someone please open another Starbucks for the love of god. I would do it myself if they franchised. This place is WAY too overcrowded, missing drink ingredients (how do you run out of white mocha at 11am). Cleared out of bakery foods by noon. Wrong orders. I literally retold the girl my order about 4 times and she still gave me wrong drink. It was painful to try and explain anymore to her. I just took it and smiled. This is over multiple visits. It's never a decent experience.

We are going on over 40 minute wait in the drive thru for a drip coffee. This is the slowest store and the least busy I've been to. We are finally at the window and it took 8 minutes to get our drip coffee. We asked if we were still being charged after the exorbitant wait and the employee, Lea, as polite as could be said "absolutely". We then proceeded to ask for the district manager card only to have the manager come over and apologize. Really?!
I worked at Starbucks all though college and it was never an issue to keep our customers happy and issue a drink comp. apparently the policy has changed? My father that is terminally ill and at the near VA hospital asked that we bring him a Starbucks drip coffee. It took over an hour for his coffee to come to him with no sincere apology or try to remedy the situation.
Management, do you read the yelp reviews? This location has a problem and needs to be addressed. This is not a busy drive thru it should not have taken more than 5-10 minutes. We are utterly disappointed and upset that an outing away from my father's bedside turned into an ordeal.

Best Starbucks in the city, hands down! I don't know what's better the baristas, or the quality of the beverages. The employees there are awesome they always remember my name and my drink. Not to mention the guy with the beard is hilarious and always suggests new drinks for me to try. It's the cleanest starbucks i've ever been to, the lobby is spotless! There's always a place to sit and an open electrical outlet. This is definitely my go-to Starbucks whenever I need java!
The place is busy don't care about making drinks correct. I ordered latte no foam the adds a teaspoon if form. I just left the drink on the counter. Never go back. Awful !!!
I hate that I end up at Starbucks more than a local coffee shop.  But its just so good.  The never mess up, everything is always made the same: perfect.

I can't believe I'm reviewing Starbucks but here I am. 

This place is a panic attack waiting to happen. It's always so damn crowded with little seating. You literally have to steal seats sometimes. You're also rushed ordering because of this. The service is decent though and well, it's Starbucks.

Steven is such a great worker! He remembers my drinks before I even have to order!!  Everyone is friendly as well, and the whole store is always kept very clean! I've never had a bad drink from there before :)

Ok why is their no sense of urgency here.  Couldn't find the business listed ... So I had to create it.  Starbucks in the Safeway.  We waited for 10 minutes with one customer in front of us. Not sure why the line was moving so slow ... I've seen the team here before.  Really just a bad day perhaps for these guys ... Maybe they should have a cup or three.

How is this Starbucks not already on Yelp??? This is my favorite Starbucks, hands down, in the city. I know, I know, all Starbucks are theoretically the same, so what makes this one special? Well, for one, the location. Prime location for those of us who live in my neighborhood. Also, the staff really make this place shine. As nearly every tip on Foursquare will tell you, Denise is the friendliest, most helpful barista in the city. She knows me by name and always rings up my usual order without me having to say a word. It's little touches like that that make this place great.

Aside from that, and the recent remodel that seemingly doubled the seating capacity, this place is your typical Starbucks, with all the usual food and beverage offerings. It's just a lot better than the one on Broad (no seating) or Chestnut (always completely dead, meh baristas).

This Starbucks was modernized about a year ago, or so. I cannot recall to the exact. It's a huge improvement. 

The renovation ate up a substantial part of the patio, but there is still a patio nonetheless. No bike racks from what I could tell, but it seems the popular thing to do among the locals is to simply lock your bike to the barrier bars creating the patio space. 

Inside, this place is usually a madhouse. The line is speedy. Quicker than most other Starbucks in town, it seems. But be ready to wait for a place to sit. It seems this is the central meeting place for students and retirees looking to socialize. I have even seen people receiving math tutoring here, and you will sometimes see folks crafting. 

They keep heavily stocked, and even sell berries and bananas. 

WIFI is uber reliable. I have never had trouble on that front.

Do yourself a favor and download the app and place a mobile order! It seems like they will make everything that's ordered online before those who order in the store. This will save you 15+ min of waiting at all times throughout the day.
Crazy busy and seemed understaffed on a Sunday morning at 11:00. It is a beautiful space with free WiFi if you don't mind the 12 - 15 minute wait.

A Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks, right? Wrong!

Sure, you can get your beloved Venti non-fat latte (my drink of choice) and whatever seasonal flavored beverage your heart desires (peppermint mocha, anyone?), but you'll also get service from a group of darn nice folks who care about your coffee experience. Yeah, I could make coffee at home, but then I wouldn't have my favorite barristas smiling faces to get my morning off to a good start.

Parking can be tricky but I can deal with it - 5 Star(bucks) to the Flourtown location!

Cool starbucks in downtown NOLA. The inside is really old looking and unique (not old as in dirty, as in actually vintage) and there is a bunch of seating. The lines here can get SUPER long so service is sometimes slow but the drinks are right and it's in a great location. Typical Starbucks fare!

I like their spinach feta wraps! Im not a sugar person nor a coffee drinker sooooo i stay away from their 1000 calories drinks. And it's overpriced for horrible coffee (Ive taken a sip or two.) Starbucks have become a place for Tweens to hangout and feel like an adult drinking coffee. It's annoying. Lol. If you want good coffee/drinks minus the calories and get yourself some real Colombian coffee or go to a real cafe. I actually don't mind drinking good coffee, but caffeine just gets me even more hyper and I am already hyperactive as is, so that's another reason I stay away lol.

A 30 minute wait for a cold brew drink. I even ordered online!! I complained to the barista and he didn't apologize, just said, "Even the best have bad days." That's not an appropriate customer service response. There were 5-6 people working behind the counter, so it's not clear why things were moving so slowly.

Sure it's a global chain of cookie cutter coffee shops, but this one is clear proof that not all are created equal. My mochas are always a little off, the workers seem a little surlier than others, and the place is often packed thanks to it's awesome location leaving long lines. Totally skip this place!!

Surprisingly (hint the massive sarcasm) there's a starbucks a mere block away on Chestnut. Clean, friendlier, tastier drinks, nicer seating. This is the place to go..

I'm giving this Starbucks 1 star because the store hours that are listed are not real. If you look up the store hours you will see that it says they open at 5, which is not true.
I was there @ 5:20am and waited for 10min and saw no sign of anyone. It's not a huge deal but can be frustrating when your trying to plan out you morning.

I normally hate reviewing chains. But people should be warned about this location.

I'll start off by saying that there are some nice and competent employees that work here. Unfortunately there are some ever changing employees that seem to drop the ball. This happens quite frequently at peak times in the morning around 8-10am and in the afternoon around 2-4pm. I've gotten used to taking a paper and standing around while I wait for my drink, only to have it not be made. To be fair, they have always apologized. In some cases I've even gotten free drink tickets.  But this has happened more than one or two times. The most ironic was when I used my free drink ticket from a screwed up/not ordered drink experience the day before and then proceeded to get the wrong drink the next day.

I get this place gets ridiculously busy, and that some people that go here are really impatient. But it seems like there are communications and morale problems here. Perhaps a change in managers and some team building might be in order.

I'll stick to going to the Jazz and Java at the nursing school. They never screw up my order and it gets processed faster.
Terribly slow. Took over 15 mins for a flat white. Ordered it, but left to board flight. Keep moving.

The atmosphere was typical Starbucks, the store was clean and lighting was nice.

The problem?  Me and my husband went to the store last week for coffee before our shopping expedition.  I ordered my regular drink; venti awake tea latte, sugar free hazelnut and 2 Splenda (A big sissy drink, I know).  We also ordered some pastries heated up.  The cashier was very friendly, we got our danishes and then off to the other end of the counter to pick up our drinks.  

The barista was mixing up our drinks and flirting with a cute young boy standing by the counter.  I received my drink and tasted it to make sure that it was up to Parr.  It was missing all the delicious sugar free sugar.  I asked the barista if she added the sugar free hazelnut and Splenda.  She said she had and went back to flirting with the cute young stud.  I took another drink (I figured maybe my taste-buds were off).  Nope, definitely no sugary goodness. I asked her if she was sure, she said yes.  I asked her if she could add more sugar-free hazelnut.  With an exasperated sigh (as if I was interrupting her game), she did.  I opted to add my own Splenda so as not to disturb this budding relationship.  

I am typically pretty easy to please.  I am not above fixing any taste problems with my drink myself.  I do, however work hard for my money and have no desire to spend it on something that is not given the same care that I give my customers.  

This has got to be my least favorite Starbucks and I have gone to several all over northern NV and CA.  Also Southern CA.

I'm hesitant to write a review of this place as I'm afraid more people will come here to study lol. But in all seriousness, this is one of my favorite places to study. It's typically empty enough to get a decent seat and power outlet. The area is large and spacious so you don't feel claustrophobic. The inside is not as nice looking as Buddy Brew...it just feels/looks like a typical Starbucks. The other Starbucks on Westshore (next to Panera) has a cooler feel but it is way smaller. 

They have about 8 tables along a large couch which has outlets for each table. There are also some tables along the wall which have power outlets as well. The bathrooms (1 for women and 1 for men) have been clean the times I have been here. The staff is friendly and drinks (depending on how busy they are) are served relatively fast. I feel if you're inside the drinks come out slower compared to the drive thru. 

I can see parking may be an issue but the times I have come, parking was a breeze. Drive through can definitely be busy during peak times but which Starbucks isn't?

Stopped in for a quick coffee and just rest for a minute. 

This is a small location with no drive thru which is not uncommon for this big city.

There are few tables and a bunch of window seats which are great for people watching :) 

Will I be back?  yes if I'm in the area.
Great customer service these guys make the best frappes ever shit was bombbbb af On my way Home

I love that this Starbucks has a drive-thru!!! My latte is always great and my oatmeal or sandwich is also a winner.  However, the amount of time it takes to get through the drive-thru is ridiculous!! It takes them entirely too long to get through the line. They might be the slowest drive-thru in the history of drive-thrus!!! Once they get their speed together they will get 5 stars, until then I can only give a 4 star....

My favorite Starbucks of all! It is such a beautiful building inside and out. What they did to the inside of the place is amazing. It makes me want to hang out there and just people watch even though I have to get back to work. The staff there is super friends and they seem like they really take pride in preparing great beverages, even when the place has a line almost out of the door. I love the wall of coffee and coffee drinking accessories when you walk in. It's hard to resist buying some of that stuff when you are waiting in line. The case that the pastries is in is very pleasing to the eye. Thank god they have the Calories posted next to each type of goodie or I might put some weight on from my frequency of visitation. It's nice to look at, not nice to my waist line. Although I would like to suggest to the owner of that location that it would be awesome if they had some kind of deal with a nearby bakery that provided them with King Cake, but I don't know, Starbucks probably has a conglomerate code that would interfere with that kind of thing.
Walked in 10 minutes before they closed and the young lady taking my order was extremely polite and helpful, didn't rush me at all. Great customer service!

The partners out here are super great! my family is visiting from California! I just so happen to be a partner from California. The partners out here are amazing and I love the fact that this Starbucks happens to be around the corner from where I stay!!  Nelly Nel was the first to show that good old Louisiana southern hospitality, Mo and Sarah were awesome as well! Thank you guys for making my experince here an fantastic one!!! #tobeapartner!!!

My favorite Starbucks I've been to so far in Philly, everyone is always friendly and most importantly it's ALWAYS fast no matter how many people are crowded in here! They know how to be absolutely efficient and I appreciate it so much!

System was down, not much options, wanted Danish, said there was none.  Employes by target employees and manager that is very clumsy and doesn't care about anything.  Customers had to take up and order what was left, not in mood to confront anyone there.  Very lousy example to other Starbucks with no reputation.

First off, I LOVE starbucks and go almost every day. If this place had been my first starbucks experience, I wouldn't be such a fan.  We stopped here on a rainy day traveling across the state. Purchased a lunch and drink but after I paid with my starbucks card they realized they didn't have  soymilk.  Would have been nice to know before I paid but I get back in line for my refund. The barista does the refund wrong shorting me by $1.20. After I point this out she says she has to go to the back to get a manager to fix it. I've already wasted enough time at this point that I just give up on my money and leave.

Heads up. When your customers order a "Starbucks doubleshot on ice" this link below is what they are referring to.

Not just two shots of espresso in a grande cup filled with ice to the top. 

https://www.starbucks.com/menu/drinks/espresso/starbucks-doubleshot-on-ice

2 stars for being pleasant and doing a good job on my other drink.
I think the management has changed and so now everything is streamlined. I always get a smiley face on my drinks which are made right. So, great job to Starbucks for listening to their customers.

Slowest drive thru I've ever been in. I've been to this drive thru multiple times and I'm waiting 10-15 minutes every time. The more annoying part is by the time you get to the window they're just starting to get your order ready, and most of the time there are no customers inside. So how can't you keep up with just a drive thru. I could just go inside but it's not as convenient. 

Another problem with the drive thru is that the menu is so far away and on such an angle from the screen it's impossible to read. I don't go to Starbucks that often so I like to look at the menu and I can't see it at all.

Very busy and not the fastest location but still friendly and good drinks. It seems to be always busy so don't expect a quite place. Very central located on canal street. It's a Starbucks with a jazzy New Orleans feel.
The past two times I've coming here I've waited over 30 minutes for my food/drink. Very poorly run and understaffed

Normally a good Starbucks location. Was miffed when, after waiting in a long line, discovered they were out of my favorite, one and only item I order, Emperor's Cloud and Mist Tea. Not one barista offered to check if they had any more in the back. Poor order management and lazy workers. Wasn't any better at 16th & Walnut location.

This is the slowest f'n Starbucks on planet Earth and the baristas listen about as well as all of my friends kids. 

It's still Starbucks and still tastes good. Just wish I didn't wait for 15 minutes each time... Not including the wait to order.
As with all Starbucks, they have great coffee and munchables. My only problem is the wait time I experience every time I go there. It's the slowest location in town.

I usually go to the Starbucks at 15th and Market due to convenience, but I'm going to start coming here more often since its just a 10 minute walk away.This is my second time at this location and I'm writing this review as I'm sitting here. Compared to other Starbucks in the area, this one is much more capacious and has many more seats and outlets. At other coffee shops, I constantly find myself searching for a place to sit, and this usually results in me failing and having to migrate to another coffee shop. I haven't had such experiences here yet. 

The spaciousness also allows me to think better and feel less claustrophobic, even when there are a lot of people around. This is a great place for studying and getting work done. With that being said, the wifi is also fast, reliable, and free (yay!). 

Lastly, service both times have been friendly and accommodating; Drinks were made properly. The only complaint I have is that both times that I've been here, there were loud customers who were really distracting while I was trying to get work done.

I love going to this Starbucks. Every one of the baristas are very nice and accommodating. There are, however, some problems. The other evening was at Starbucks and used the bathroom. Now, I have to say that this is one of the most used Starbucks, just for bathroom use, whether one is a customer or not. When I went into the bathroom, it was obvious that the sink had not been scrubbed. There were layers on layers... That same night, while three people were on, only one was out on the floor serving customers. This particular barista had to do the drinks and the cash register. I image that the others had work in the back room, but it wasn't fun to wait while this poor person had to deal with the orders. 

It seems to me that in most stores, the staff is really pressured to get the cleanup done before the store closes. There is mopping (which can be dangerous to customers) and cleaning of restrooms, which, sometimes, are locked for the remainder of the night. The baristas (overall) say that they are treated well by the company, but it might be better to do the closing cleaning after the cafe closes.

I'm giving this location two stars only because I've never had my drink come out wrong. However, this is definitely the SLOWEST Starbucks I have ever been to. Going inside to get your drink takes at least 15-20 minutes and the drive-thru is literally a 30-40 minute ordeal. It's ridiculous. Not once has an employee apologized for the long wait. There's always plenty of people working. I'm completely baffled by how slow they are. It certainly should not take this long to make coffee beverages.
The heavy set lady with the dreads is very rude to customers and dirty. She gave me a attitude because I asked what the bathroom code was. I'll never go back here.

Where everyone knows your name and your drink is always done to perfection. Simply the best! Baristas are so friendly and proficient. It's clean, quick, and inevitably the best place to go for coffee.

I'm a fan of Starbucks, I'm a Gold member and I really like this cafe because it's usually not super busy but more spacious with seating like 18/Spruce and the quality of customer service is good too.  

Great that they have window seating overlooking Walnut St and are very close to 12th St. Gym and area businesses, think shopping, restaurants and hair salons. I'll be back!

In the land of Bada Bing there was a Starbucks that became South Philly's thriving cooperate coffee spot. Still great smiles and fast service but I've got the same bitch. Even with more seats and a polished appearance there is nowhere to sit. The new look has you on top of each other even more. Is this the old Melrose Diner back in the day? I don't want to share space with people I don't know or impose on their territory, since these natives feel they've got to claim 2 tables and 4 chairs just to surf the cyber wave of free internet porn. I am sadly disappointed with the feng shui here. For all that they spend in the glam appearance they could buy a bigger building  or just open an additional store down there other end of South Philly. However, I still like this java joint and give them snaps for their courageous beanery efforts of improvement. Much love to you Starbucks South Philly and your new stylized look!
Ordered tall coffee got just half a cup instead. Ordered muffin which felt like a couple of days old probably...

We had a terrible experience with 2 employees at this Starbucks (Molasses and Gabriel). They were extremely rude, slow and unprofessional. They made the wrong drink and reacted as of it was the customers fault. So unlike any Starbucks I've ever been in. Take my advice and walk another block to the Sheraton and use their Starbucks.

Yes, another in a long line of these industrial bean juice sellers. It is the same old, same old. It was clean, staff was cordial & slowly do their jobs.
The obsession with this chain is totally mind blowing. I literally get angry at myself Everytime I stop at one....I really do need to completely kick the Starbucks habbit. It's just so darn convient, since there is 1 on every other block. Ugh!
What's a girl to do? Really make up my mind & go out of my way to avoid these vultures....I am not a millennial.

One of the better Starbucks in Boise, has big parking lot, a drive through, and outdoor patio seating with umbrellas. The service is spectacular and of course the food and drinks a perfect as usual. I definitely recommend this one if you are in the area.
The happiest group of people work here, especially considering how constantly busy it is.

This is Starbucks is in a great location right next to Rittenhouse Park.  Its a pretty new store with lots of seating, including plenty of outdoor tables which are great in the summer.  Like most starbucks in the city, the coffee is generally good and the baristas friendly and helpful.

Quick and easy-- unless you are driving. This Starbucks is in the heart of tourist traps. There is no parking around. I walked here from my hotel. The line was a bit long so I was worried it would take forever. They were quick and got my order right. That's really all I can ask for.

I had to meet a client here yesterday and I have to say that I do believe some of the best ideas in our society are probably thought of while sitting in a Starbucks.  

The atmosphere of mostly all Starbucks' is very chill, relaxed and open to creativity.  This location in Brandon is no different.  The baristas were friendly, and cute I might add :)  My client and I met and discussed business while good Motwon oldies were playing in the background.  This is another thing I love about Starbucks, is their love for the arts and new music and artist promotions.  Working in the entertainment business, I aprreciate the support they give.  

This Starbucks is clean and well operated.  Spacious with plenty of seating...even a bar to sit at while the baristas concoct the next delicious caffinated beverage for posibly the next Springsteen or Einstein.  I love that!

The parking spots are right next to the drive-through lane so getting in and out of the parking lot is a nightmare if you're not going through the drive-through! Other than that, the staff is friendly and the coffee is good as always.

Extremely poor service. First made one of the drinks wrong that I had ordered. Then we stood and waited for the food to be ready for 15 minutes before I had to ask about it. They apparently forgot. Gave me a plain croissant instead of a chocolate croissant and a bagel with cream cheese, instead of toasted with butter. Starbucks in airports need to work much quicker since most people are trying to get to a flight. Unacceptable.

I don't venture to the Westbank often, but I was out running errands, had my laptop with me and figured I'd stop in to get some work done.

Not happening. 

The music is so unbearably loud that I feel like I've wandered into a night club that serves lattes. The staff is not really doing their job. I understand when you're young and it's slow at work, you want to chit chat and be social with your coworkers. But don't hang out in the back and ignore your customers or be louder than the music while you're playing around.

The difference between a national chain like Starbucks and a local place is that with a chain you know right off what to expect from every location because they're supposed to be run the same way. 

If you hate a relaxing atmosphere and just want to party it up while you eat your scone, this is the place for you.

This Starbucks has all the good Starbucks taste you would expect, but the workers are often chatting about who they are going to get fired next, making them take longer on your order. If you find it funny this might be a good thing, otherwise there are better Starbucks out there.

You can never go wrong at a Starbucks, they are always consistent. Since this place is on Canal it gets crowded, but the line goes fast. There is an assembly line attitude here and the employees are hustling.

Best starbucks around!! Even if Im at giant down the street that has starbucks inside, I make the effort to stop here instead because the staff is amazing and makes the best coffee! I come here all the time and they all know my name, my favorite drink, and even know if i want decaf/caf depending on what time i come in! They always have bright smiles on their faces, and ask about my day, I can say a few of them are practically my friends i talk to them so much when Im there. They will always make the drink exactly how you like and are happy to fix it if not to your liking. Best baristas around! That is for sure!

Service was quick during rush hours, I have to stop by everyday before I get to work so I will have a nice day at work lol 

I haven't tried order via iPhone app yet, next time I will update how that go. But I love to bring my own cup there so not sure how that thing will work

I love Starbucks coffee. I love the way it tastes and I love the way it smells. But, they are NOT all the same. Some are consistently good and some are flops. This one is one of the best. Take this morning, for instance. I had a nice conversation with the very personable lady at the counter regarding our kids. (She showed me a pic of one her sons - pulled it out of her apron pocket - love that!) Then I waited for my decaf frappucino. The girl making the drink put one down only it was slightly wrong (caramel instead of coffee) so she took it back and tried again. Evidently, she wasn't able to get it right so she had the guy working there do it. The guy made it (and it was perfection, btw - so many places don't know to blend the ice until smooth and you end up with ice chunks blocking your straw) and I thanked him and was just about on my way when the girl who had tried making it let me know she had comped my drink since it took a little long. Wait? What? I wasn't even upset about it nor did I complain and they took it upon themselves to comp my drink? In the words of DJ Lance Rock on Yo Gabba Gabba, "That was Awwwwesommmmme!" Seriously, most places don't do anything to correct wrongs unless you complain. This was sincerely most appreciated and it dawned on me that I have always gotten primo service at this particular Starbucks. Bravo!

For over 10 years I have gone to this Starbucks to get my 2pm dark roast pick me up. Sharon is an awesome barista, but today I must have got a new one. I asked for a dark roast with light cream and he said, "we are not brewing dark roast"!
What? Starbucks? No more have a coffee the way you like it? Really?
I told the guy, "you lost a customer". His response...."ok"!
Sad when crappy service tarnishes the brand! Mr. Schultz would not like to hear this story!

This location is one of the more busier Starbucks that you'll ever see. The drive-thru is always packed (even during the supposed slow hours of 3-5 pm), and the employees behind the bar are moving so quickly that you'll more than likely not have even the briefest conversation with them (not that it's a bad thing).

Exterior seating seems to be plentiful, while interior seating is of a reasonable amount. Don't be surprised to see half of the seats taken up by those on their laptops, a few locals, travelers, and salesmen pitching an MLM to an unsuspecting sap that just came in for a Frappuchino. Just your typical Starbucks crowd.

Altogether, this location is one of Hendersonville's best within a very busy shopping area.

Every corner, every hotel.....there are just too many, it boggles my mind. I can't think of a stretch of road I can drive 3-4 miles & not pass at least 2.

I love my specialty coffees & because they are so darn prevelent, I find my car heading to the drive thru. Really I have to physically argue with my car & tell it, it can't have high octane fuel, if we keep stopping. That seems to be language she can understand.

I love all of their coffee & tea concoctions. I love a light afternoon bite: muffin, scone....suprise me. My bottom line is, except for an occasional indulgence, it is way overpriced! That says it all. Food offerings are fair, but usually nothing to brag about & coffee drinks are usually quite tasty. Personally, I choose to spend my disposable  income on items I can't or won't make at home, just a personal choice.

What's a girl to do? Spend freely on items you really, really want & not overpriced anything.

The service was fine. Two issues:
Minor- the wifi did not work well. I was able to easily log on to the wifi from the yogurt store next to the Starbucks  
Major-a panhandler came in. We were sitting.  He approached us for money.  We refused.  He persisted for sometime. The employees did not ask him to leave.

What IS the deal with this location?!? While the baristas are always nice & polite and my order is usually correct, I am flabbergasted EVERY TIME I come here by how long it takes to get through it. Inside or drive through, it amazes me every time. 

It's the only one on my way to work however, soooooo.....

It seems like there is a Starbucks on every corner, but not all Starbucks nor their employees are created equal. This location is always polite, respectful, and timely. 

It's the little things. Today they made my day! In rare form, my eight month old puppy pulled on her leash and my brand new beverage went flying before I even made it home to put the straw in it. When I returned to this location, after cleaning up the mess and walking back, they replaced my beverage with no questions asked. It's the little things like this that make this location my favorite in Philly.

I'm a coffee snob and Tucson has plenty of places to scratch that itch. That said, for a Starbucks (huge qualifier there!) this location is my favorite in town. 

Easy parking, nice redesign on the interior, good crowd of regulars, and plenty of seating all make this location work. It's the closest walkable coffee spot to my house, so it gets a visit from time to time. And it's even saved me once or twice when I've run out of fancy third wave beans from EXO or Cafe Aqui.
Selena @Starbucks called me honey and I felt like I was getting my Soy Vanilla Latte at a Soul Food restaurant for a minute #ILoveIt #efficient #friendly

Friendly staff but can't seem to get my order right, I've been going there almost everyday for the past 2-3 months. They either forget my extra shot of expresso, the sweetened part or just my whole order.

Excellent, friendly service every time. Like a breath of fresh air! You're always treated like a guest and a friend. So much nicer than your average Starbucks! The employees here are doing a really great job.

Very crowded in the morning. They work hard to be fast and efficient though. The staff is very nice and friendly. Overall a solid starbucks. Also it helps that it is right by my work, so I frequent it often. Only thing that kind of sucks is that they run out sometimes of the breakfast wraps if I forgot breakfast that day.
It's Starbucks.  You know what you are going to get.  This location is fine.  Very convenient of you are in the mall here.  Family liked it.

Psych. Turns out this Starbucks isn't so great. If you go inside the service is SO SLOW because apparently their priority is the drive-thru line. I've waited forever multiple times for a drink when it actually would have been faster to go through the drive-thru that was ten cars long. I've also gotten the wrong drink 3 times in the past two weeks (including today), prompting this update. Those girls need to get their act together.

My last day in Philly and what better way to spend a beautiful, sunny morning at this cozy spot on the corner of 18th and Spruce. A clean, organized cafe with friendly baristas. Even the restroom was decently clean. I ordered a skinny mocha and egg muffin--enjoyed the moment savoring my meal. I'll be sure to return to this particular Starbucks when I visit Philly next time.

Absolutely the worst Starbucks I have ever visited.  The staff aspires to indifference, except when it comes to rambling on about themselves with their friends.  Waiting on customers is not a priority.  The entire team needs to be sent packing.
Great peppermint mocha! Friendly and quick service. Only down side is the extremely limited parking. Could use a decor update.

8 o'clock and both people working would rather have been anywhere else . English was not easily spoken . Out of almost everything . And really could care less if I was there or not ... Huge Starbucks guy but truly a horrible experience this time .
I call this the most plesant place in america.They play the most sweetest music you can hear with your coffee and after a while,it turns into Rockstar central.

Unfortunately this is my go to Starbucks, and that is strictly because of convenience reasons(right off the highway). The employees are always nice and friendly, my complaint is not with them but with the product itself. 
I get the same drink every time I come, a Tall Caramel Frappacino with no Whipped Cream. I don't understand how the same drink can taste so different. The taste is very inconsistent. Sometimes the drink tastes just how I like it, when other times it's so bad I don't even want to finish it. I thought they were supposed to follow recipes, it tastes as if sometimes they put too much of a product in and other times not enough. 
Also, on one occasion my husband and I went through the drive thru and ordered 2 frappacinos and 2 breakfast sandwiches. Now I understand that we probably ordered the two things on the menu that take the longest to make, but it was almost ridiculous how long it took to make our order. The sandwiches were also cold in the middle, but of course we had already driven off. We have learned our lesson, if we are in a hurry, go to McDonalds, they have much faster service in the early mornings.
Nice stop while shopping catch a feed minutes rest with a nice cold or hot tea but my fav is still a mocha.

Needed something to stave off the headache I felt coming on after visiting mom in the hospital. 

I pulled into the drive through, placed my order for one of the seasonal hot chocolates (Peppermint, thank you, very much) and then pulled around to pick up my order. 

The wait was not terrible, but it seemed a little slow. May not have been,I have no idea what the people before me ordered.  When I got to the window, I paid my $4.02 and was handed a wonderful, delicious hot chocolate. 

it was made perfectly, it was actually a drinkable temp, which is unusual, but oh so very welcome. Delicious to the last drop.

This is in the middle of everything so it is easy to make a pit stop after shopping and running errands. However, there is no drive thru... which leads to long lines. Patience is a virtue! Service is okay, similar to some other mediocre Starbucks. The retail section is a little small which leads to cramped wavy lines where you have to maneuver yourself around the merchandise. 

Seats are limited. Seats by outlets are even more limited. So grab a 2 seat-er while you can! Bathroom was not fantastic....  =-\

Service is fairly quick, and the coffee is made right. Its starbucks, if you been to one for the drinks/food, you've tried them all.

The atmosphere: They are usually busy continuously. been a couple times to study and drink coffee and was a little cramped. Noise level was moderate, definitely not a library (which is to be expected). Free wifi is a plus! 

Parking and navigating is interesting. Brandon traffic is never the best and this parking lot is a very busy lot!

I like this location. Wish it was a little closer to home. Good parking, friendly staff. Line when I have seen one moves quickly. My coffee was created pretty quickly and accurately. What more could you want. Oh right seating. That's good too. There are the typical tables and wood chairs but in the far corner is a pretty comfortable bench with 3 small tables. In the corner I'm sitting are 2 leather chars, leather sofa and assorted end tables and coffee table. All well worn but clean and comfortable. I've been here before and was able to log into the free wifi with no trouble. Today not at all. Would ask the staff but feeling too lazy to ask.

A Starbucks is a Starbucks.  They all usually have the same go-to drinks and favorite snacks, even at the tiny airport and grocery stores. 
I'm addicted to caffeine,  and honestly not too picky at all when it comes to food or drinks. I even let bad service slide with a benefit of a doubt. I do however, always notice and feel incredibly special when I do CONSTANTLY recieve great customer service, and good drinks.
All of the baristas started to acknowledge me BY NAME even if I only came in on payday. Then they began to notice my favorites. They top off "special order drinks" that I never usually really order, with extra hazelnut drizzle, or an extra shot when I seem sleepy, all just to make it a little nicer or more , exciting".
They're all so sweet and kind. They take time and pride in their jobs and would do anything to make your coffee a little extra; something special. They make it FEEL digferent from the run of the mill, cookie cutter Starbucks grind. 
I absolutely love them,  and how they make this particular corporate coffee house seem a little more local and enticing.

I believe his name is Sam, but he was an awesome barista! They didn't have  (or no longer carry) sugar free hazelnut syrup. I ordered a tall skinny mocha, and it was delicious! Love the flower drawn on my cup, too! Definitely come back to this location, they are always wonderful!
Cashiers and baristas are very friendly and helpful here. They keep the line moving quickly even during "rush" hour like weekday mornings. Very convenient spot close to my work.

This is the Starbucks at 700 Canal Street at St. Charles Avenue. It is a reserve store and pretty basic for a Starbucks. The coffee and other beverages are delicious and a decent size. The staff and baristas are amazing. The shop is pretty spacious. It is in the heart of the tourist district so there are times when it is very busy. Especially on the weekend and when events and conventions are in town. There is a code to use the facilities but once you make a purchase the baristas are happy to give it to you. The food is decent for a quick snack or grab and go. The menu isn't extensive but there's something to love. This is the Starbucks I regularly come to. It's the closest one to my home. I truly love this Starbucks!!!!

Great coffee inside the Safeway shopping center. Currently , having special for purchase of 16oz coffee beans you get a Grande cup of coffee for free :) 
4 stars due to manager -- other employees seem nice and helpful, but manager is a grump.
I got my coffee and hoped to sit and relax in a quiet environment, but the staff decided to play loud moany-groany R&B music like it was their private nightclub.

I been coming to this location for the pass 6-7 years since l moved near by and this location was never this bad in waiting to get your drink. Drive thru is the worst 20 to 30 minutes wait it's insane and common in this drive thru. From now on I'll be starting to take my business to the local coffee shops. They give you better customer service where you wont hear that they ran out of vanilla syrup two days in a row. It's pathetic for being a huge chain.

An amazing number of people were lined up at this Starbucks in Opry Mills, getting their caffeine injection. There's a great opportunity for someone to open a competing coffee stand here - assuming Starbucks doesn't have exclusivity - and make some bank.

They needed a bit of help today with not nearly enough workers for the crowd of shoppers! But the coffee was decent and gave me the energy to continue exploring Opry Mills!
Went through the drive thru; the staff is very friendly, service is quick & the frappucino is delicious! I'll be back if I'm in this neck of the woods! :)

Ah, Starbucks...consistent, convenient, plenty of parking.  Would I have preferred to support some local coffee shop?  Sure.  Did I have time to drive around unfamiliar blocks to discover said local shop?  Nope.  Starbucks for the win.

I'm guessing this is the Starbucks located in the KOP Court.

This place is a much chill location than its sister store on the plaza side.

We came here yesterday and noticed the hustle and bustle of the other side was not seen in the long, steadily moving order line .

The service was okay as were our orders. Cheers!

I have to say this store has to be one of my favorites in Nashville. 

The staff was friendly and the store and restroom was clean. 

I hope they keep up the good work. 
I will sure to be back. 

The only downfall is the actual location. It is on top of a hill and not at street level so it will take a little bit of extra time getting in and out but if they continue to keep the store clean and continue to be friendly then no complaints from me.

Rarely a place to sit. And when there is, it's a hard wooden bench or chair. This location just got remodeled and it has a large picnic table in the middle. And you have to share. Where is the cozy??? I want to relax and have a coffee in a comfy chair with a friend. Not a hard picnic table to share with neighbors in a paper cup. Coffee is so expensive, can they at least give us a bit of atmosphere to enjoy it in?

not one of the better starbucks. at the times when this place is busy, i understand turnover will be slow, and inaccuracies will be more likely to occur. (i've only had one incorrect drink order, and they were kind enough to give me a "free drink" coupon.)  however, there is no excuse for a snails pace when the place is empty. i used to work at starbucks when i was in college (which was, admittedly, a while ago), and they pushed for drinks to be made a lightening speed regardless of the lines (both in-store and at the drive-thru window.) so maybe they don't have that "rule" anymore.

because it's convenient to my job, i'll continue coming here, but i do wish they would attempt to pick up the pace.

I usually get happy wonderful service here. But for some reason the woman in the drive thru this morning was short. I was going to get a few more drinks, but got frustrated and kept quiet and only got my 1. Coming from a customer's point of view, customer service makes or breaks an experience. I am sorry to say, that I will be driving to AZ Pavillions from now on. Even though they are busy as well, and a bit out of my way, I have NEVER had a short barista. I do not appreciate "we'll have your total......." before asked if there is anything else. I'm sorry. Maybe it was a bad morning for her, but please leave it at the door.

I hate that terry parkway is the most convenient  one for me because they are sooooo slow. Why can't they just get it together like the rest of the awesome Starbucks drive thru! 

When I am leaving the West Bank at 4 heading to work from 6-2am I need my caffeine fix and this one just happens to be the closest drive through on my route before the GNO. Sometimes you just have to suffer a slow line for the greater good of caffeine in my veins. And by slow I mean a 15-20 minute wait in line and no whip on my venti after all that

The only reason I'm giving this 2 stars is because the service is EXTREMELY EXTREMELY SLOW! There were 3 cars in front of me and about a 30 minute wait. Then, when we finally got to the window, it was another 5 minute wait. Customer service needs to be worked on.

Fantastic Starbucks for getting work done! Outlets are a little spotty, but lots of spacious seating, and a nice atmosphere. Baristas are not bad (Starbucks quality here, if you know what I mean), and they usually play good music- a mix of all sorts of stuff.

Small, weird set up, but the coffee etc is on par. What was really gross was one of the staff eating and talking to the other staff who were making the drinks. He didn't seem to care that there was a line up of people watching him do this, but maybe they were too engrossed in their phone to notice. Anyway, yuck.
This Starbucks is racist.  If you support them There's probably a good chance you don't support the black community.

Jesus Christ, Starbucks!  Get your stuff together.  The past, well 6 or 7 times I have gone through your drive thru, I had a 15-20 minute wait, and for all of that waiting, my order was not correct most of the time.

If the franchise owners are reading this, your staffing at this location needs a serious overhaul.  Through the past six months, I have witnessed the lackluster attitude of the staff grow exponentially.  When customers are waiting over 15 minutes for an older, and get to the window, only to witness the staff horse playing and moving with no sense of urgency, it pisses people off.

I, for one, felt that I have this location enough chances.  I've been very happy with my experiences with your competitor (hint:  I wrote a review for them as well).  So, even though they are a little further away, they have earned my business, and you have lost it.
Busy location. Lots of parking. Good service. Drive through traffic can make it difficult to exit if you park in the spots on the Manchester side.

Ok I used to HATE this location. I continued to go only because it was right across the street from my office and I really need my Starbucks fix. Why did I hate it? The customer service SUCKED! When I go to a Starbucks I have a certain expectation of friendly baristas who Don't care about anything other than making you laugh while putting your drink together as soon as humanly possible. Well there were these two women that were working there -everyday. All they did was talk to each other! I'm not talking about talking to each other while making my drink... I mean talking me while there's a huge line waiting to order and another line waiting for their drinks. It's 7:45 in Center City! We are cranky and do not want to be late to work! Do not take your time making the only thing that will help me survive the next 8-9 hours. I don't see those girls much anymore not sure if their shift changed or they got rid of them. But if they're gone then you will get your coffee on time and with a smile :)

I have stopped in here several times, it's a good break point driving between Phoenix and El Paso. I have always found the service and the food and drinks (English breakfast tea - mmmm) to be great. It's usually busy so I can see why some might get frustrated but weather I'm here with all 4 of my kids getting lunch or just taking a break I enjoy my visit. Keep up the good work.

Honestly the whole Starbucks team in this Target needs to be fired or learn how to be decent people. I've never come across a team so rude. The most unfriendly people I've ever met and they don't really make drinks right. If y'all hate your jobs so much then quit instead of giving your customers a unfriendly and unpleasant experience. I frequent this Starbucks a lot and every single time except maybe once or twice, I've had a pleasant experience. Justin is the only one who is nice to customers.

Wasn't much of a line, but it took a long time for my drink.  One worker on her phone the whole time.

Otherwise it's a nice location.

Also stoked that this is so close to home. I don't use this place enough. It's not too busy during the day and when it is busy the noise level is still moderate. 

Great place to meet people or have a business meeting.

This is my favorite Starbucks in all of Tucson. I come here daily and even go out of my way so I know I will get my drink made perfectly. After 4 years of coming here I have had only one negative experience.   Sure, I could go to circle k for a cheap cup of coffee but the atmosphere here is what keeps me coming back for the classic green straw.
Quality place. If you have 10 minutes to get to work, maybe you shouldn't stop by Starbucks first. These baristas are overworked.

This has to be the coolest Sbucks I've ever visited. The use of brass horns for lighting to the works of art by local artisans is amazing. This store is a reserve store giving the chance to enjoy truly special blends either by the cup or bag. A must see for Starbucks fans. The staff is super friendly & always there to help. Take a moment to enjoy it all while visiting this wonderfully unique city.

A Starbucks is a Starbucks. This location is literally across the street from my work and the only reason why I go. They rarely mess up my order and I know I am going to wait in line. Give yourself 15 minutes to stand in line, place your order, and wait for your caffeine fix. I've never had a bad experience but  I've also never had a great one here either. All I know is it is a cup of overpriced coffee.

I love the university's Starbucks. The employees are always on top of orders, service is super quick, and everyone is super friendly. Shane is my favourite employee! Every time I have had him take my order he is always very clear. He looks customers in the eye and he is very happy towards everyone. 
The Starbucks at UNR is efficient yet it still provides a nice pace for those who want to just hang out and study.
Best most favorite coffee including coffee beans to purchase for home brewing  (unground of course!) We like their Pikes, Veranda (blonde) and Guatamala/Antigua.

So nice to see Emily at this location. Very friendly. The staff are all very nice here. 

Lots of seating and very clean. A nice change from some of the other locations.

Seriously rude lady working the window! You are supposed to be helpful not condescending. You seriously need some lessons in customer service. I wish they put names on receipts of who waited on us so everyone knew who the bad service came from.

Made a mobile order and came in after 3-4mins. My green tea was done but 3 of my vanillin bean was just sitting on the counter with milk in it. The girl that was making he drinks just constantly ignored my 3 drinks and worked on walk in orders. Been waiting over 5mins. Including the time I ordered my drink, total 10mins. She keeps making other ppl ordered that cake in after me. Didn't even bother to ask if I need anything else. Rude

*UPDATE*
My venti green tea frap has caramel taste in it and my kids tall vanillin bean frap has coffee taste in it. Fail! I'm in a time crunch so I didn't even bother to go back and get my drinks remade. Who knows, maybe I would have to wait 20 minutes. What's the point of mobile ordering when the barista ignores the order?!

Service is slow but that's because its always crowded, so I don't hold that against them. But every time I come in, there is only (the awful) Pikes Place blend on tap, never the bold or even decaf, and they will not brew the other 2 if you ask them too. I assume the manager only wants the cheapest blend offered there, and with the business they get there's probably no reason to change.

I usually love Starbucks.  This Starbucks was disappointing on several levels.  The coffee was weak and not as good as other Starbucks. It is ALWAYS busy,  which isn't a problem.  The ambience is cute and clean. This store has the worst service I have ever seen.  On two separate occasions, I had an issue with Sam, the barista.  The first time she made my drink wrong, argued with me about it, and then threw it in the sink (making a mess) and rolled her eyes.  The second time she was condescending and rude.  This is unacceptable behavior. As a previous Starbucks employee, I will be sure to contact corporate. I would recommend finding another place to go.  Addiction is right down the street with great coffee, service, and ambience.

This Starbucks location is just okay. I prefer the one on walnut and 34th much more. This Starbucks location definitely is one of the busiest in the area but I feel that they're always a bit under staffed. Baristas are always struggling to fulfill the online orders.

I always get a tall americano but I know that they almost always just pour dripped coffee which is not what I ordered. 

Though, I am impressed with their selection other than coffee which include variety of dessert items, sandwiches, mugs etc. Cake pops cures all.

I'll probably come back to this location just because it's convenient for me but doesn't mean that I'm happy about it. Meh
Slow slow slow.  They don't serve you in the order that you arrived.    Make sure you have plenty of time to wait

Internet works! Yippie!

I went to another Starbucks location nearby, bought my iced coffee, and took out my laptop to get a little work done. My Macbook displayed the little exclamation point on the wifi signal - no internet. BURN! So, I walked over to this Starbucks with my iced coffee. Yes, rather annoying, but I can't get work done at home! The internet worked and I was happy. I had a friend meeting me so we just met at this location instead.

The design of this Starbucks is nice. It's a new location so some of the features are different at this location. The bathrooms were clean and the staff seemed friendly. 

One star off for it being so busy all of the time!

Mobile ordered to here a few times. Usually very good and drinks are out there. One time I went in and the drink in the cup was completely wrong and told the barista who blamed it on the label being "wrong" when it wasn't because I read it out to her and it was exactly what i had wanted. Would've prefered if she just owned up to it. Anyways usually good and looks like good seating for those who enjoy sitting at Starbucks and working.

Kind of dirty. They get my drink wrong a lot. However I still continue to patronize here. The last time I was there I got diet vanilla syrup instead of regular, but didn't bother to tell me that until after I drove away and had to come back.

I always have a great experience when I go to this Starbucks. They know my name and the drink I normally get. The place stays clean and the staff are nice. Parking is terrible in the morning. The parking lot is shared with other businesses.

Good coffee overall. Great that you can do mobile ordering to pick up as this location stays busy. Seats and tables were all pretty dirty so I didn't stay to eat here. Coffee was decent but one of our lattes was burned.

I really hate this place. I really do. If you just want an ice coffee you must wait inline for everyone getting a fancy warm milkyatto.

They never have the Trenti lids in stock. Took me 20 mins to get a simple xtra large ice coffee. I think plain ice coffees should not have to wait with the fancy milk people.

Slowest starbucks I've ever been to. 20 min minimum for drive through. They need to get someone that knows what they're doing inside and that cares about making the drinks fast, the girls working in the AM really do have the " don't care attitude "

Starbucks is Starbucks.  Always pretty good.  I went through the drive-thru, and was not busy too busy unlike what someone said previously about always being busy.  I guess it just depends on the time and day you go.  I went on Sunday around 2:30.  I'm not sure what the one-way issue was from the previous review, but everything I saw was 2-ways (in parking lot, the streets) so this place was easy to find and I didn't have a problems going in and out.

One of the better Starbucks in the city... line always moves quickly and there is a good amount of space to read, study, etc. Also lots of seating, not just the standard wood tables and seats but lots of leather chairs and sofas, in addition to a long table in the back where 8-10 people can sit for studying. Compared to some of the other Starbucks in the area (16th and Walnut in particular, which basically has like 4 tables) this is a must better place for relaxing if you aren't planning as soon as you order. Other than that, all of the standard Starbucks goodness with coffee, etc.

This location is always thriving, but the service is always top notch 

Went to try the raved new Cinammon Roll Frap, and it came out more coffee-y than reviews I seen online.

My husband and I switched, and I got the Cocoa Caramel. Tasted like ice cream!

During my visit they were upgrading the drive thru so I can't wait for the update. 

The store was clean and organized and the service was great.

I went to this Starbucks a few times and some of the staff are, not very friendly not saying it's horrible place but they stand to be a little more polite.still i would go back,. Im confident they can do better.

They do many things well here though they are not a level 4 store (yet). I give Starbucks credit for trying to be like local cafes, but it is a passionless effort because a massive corporation can NEVER be a local cafe, for obvious reasons.

This is probably one of the worst Starbucks I've been to. Sat in the drive through line for at least 20 minutes (no exaggeration) on a SATURDAY afternoon when Starbucks generally isn't crowded. If you're looking for your Starbucks fix in any sort of a timely fashion, do yourself a favor and choose one of the other locations nearby.

Do I have to give stars at all? This has got to be the worst and slowest Starbucks. I used mobile order at 7:15 pm. 15mins later my order was ready. Had I known drive thru was gonna be faster I would have done that. It wasn't even that busy. Everyone in here was doing everything but making drinks. I'll stick to the Starbucks on Vets and Kingman.
Service is not too bad for a busy location. Staff is nice to deal with pretty attentive. It's not 5 star but who really is? Good job guys

While I love Starbucks, I left without my Pumpkin Spice Latte :( The supervisor/leader on shift insisted on showing someone how to make coffee for the first time instead of at least taking my order :( I was the only person in line. Two employees up front and two employees on drive-thru. Surely someone could've spared 3 minutes to take an order. After all, it's 8 AM on a Monday morning!!!! Serve your customers!!!

If you have tried one Starbucks it can definitely seem like you have tried them all but in reviewing this one I looked at the fact that of the three in the mall here in Sherwood Park (yes you are reading that right....there is infact three in this small mall) this location is the standout.

For one if you work in the mall or somewhere nearby it is very easy to get in and out of this one quickly. All three times that I went last week around 8:30 there was nobody ahead of me in line and the only thing I really had a wait for was for the barista to put out the containers of milk and cream as she had not finished setting up for the day yet.

Secondly if you need a pastry with your morning java fix they seem to have the best selection here. I had tried the Safeway Starbucks as well last week and by the time I got there at 8:30 about half of the pastry case had already been cleared out. I don't think alot of people associate Starbucks with Target yet in their mind like how many do with Safeway and Starbucks.

So to sum it all up while there was nothing stand out about this particular Starbucks location when it comes to the franchise as a whole when it comes to convenience and selection of product for those in the area it really can't be beat.

The woman working there was very nice! I got my sandwich fast! It wasn't busy at all so I recommend coming here in the morning! I got there a little after 8am. Though, there wasn't much of a selection to chose from.

Not patient with older clients. Man in the hat at the register was not a best foot forward.Condescending with a smile. Not only to me but o the man with limited English ahead of me. Food ok and the new butterscotch coffee way too sweet. Atmosphere nice. Lady making the coffees was professional and personable.

I've tried the drive in and walking in here..frankly park your car and walk in - it's faster.  

Other than that - its typical Stabucks far and typical friendly Starbucks staff.
Not a big Starbucks fan. Find a real neighborhood coffee shop or get your coffee from Mickey D's down the street. I do remember hanging there when I was teen. We thought we were so cool. Good times.

This Starbucks is by far THE BEST in customer service! The staff are super friendly and remember our drinks since we've been frequenting there often! Although Starbucks coffee can be a bit pricey what keeps us coming back is the service! They rock! Thank you Starbucks people for being so nice and giving something a little extra to your customers!

Well, it's Starbucks.  I like the coffee (if you don't fine, but don't be a hater) and the food too.  I just drink brewed so I'm an easy customer.  The staff is always pleasant and they do a good fast job.  
However, I'm in here like 3 days a week and they don't know my name (and never asked)-which is weird for a Starbucks.
UPDATE.  They do know my name now.

This location use to be my Go To place for studying. I stopped going there because the baristas conversate amongst each other so loudly about their personal matters (even when the background music is playing). They should remember that Starbucks is a place where a lot of their consumers come to do their work/study. I use to admire the quiet environment they once provided. Their customer service went down immensely. 
Now, my new spot is Kafe TR on Ashton Road for those who want that quiet environment! Please, also train the baristas to be friendly rather than  having rude attitudes and miserable faces. They look like they hate being there.
I really like this place. Caramel Latte tastes good. It is in a shopping complex and has plenty of parking. Over all a good place.

This location is pretty bad. I just went there this morning and tried to use a starbucks free reward. You know what the cashier said to me.."we don't redeem rewards for free drinks anymore" i'm like who/what/when/where/why and she just ignored me. Pathetic.
Always a problem at the drive through.  Lots of mistakes and long wait time.  Customer service not the greatest, very disappointing!

This is an awesome Starbucks. Huge and spacious. This is the one at 700 Canal where the St. Charles Streetcar turns from Canal onto St. Charles Avenue. It is lakeside of Rubenstein's Clothiers. Enter by the front corner doors. The St. Charles side is for exiting only. The line forms by the case where all the delicious pastries and such are. The staff and baristas are amazing and awesome. This is generally the location I visit most frequently. I love my Starbucks!!!
The service was great.  Very speedy and friendly.  Loved the opportunity to people watch out on the street.

This is my coffee shop to work at daily inside or on the patio. The employees are always so nice (in addition to the amazing drinks). Recently, I left my purse on the patio when I was moving inside with my computer bag. They were so kind and quick to take it and hold It in the back for when I realized by mistake I left it. Great employees at this place.

Normally, the service is decent.  Today, a person forgot to put in a cup for my order.  That's okay.  Maybe since I had to wait 15-20 minutes longer than everyone else, I could've had my size upgrade from medium to large or something like that for a higher rating.  I was hoping for more of a maple flavor in my maple latte.  The people here are nice.

I don't like whats happened at this location. Why not treat all customers the same. If no one was bothering anyone then what was the big deal. Everybody sit and mind their business and relax at coffee shops and when the entire group is there then people will order something together , nobody likes to order or start a meal when a member isn't present yet. That's kinda rude. I really just want all my money back that's loaded to my card because at this point I do not want to visit places like this. I Just can not support the disease called racism.

I know Starbucks in general takes a lot of criticism. One being their coffee. I am a Starbucks fan. I don't drink coffee. I don't drink sugar. I like Starbucks because I can get a sugar free, fat free, caffeine free drink any time. I wound up in this location because the Starbucks in the hotel is not real. Couldn't scan my phone. Didn't get a sugar free hot cocoa. 

I am so glad the hotel Starbucks failed. This Starbucks is the most beautiful Starbucks I have ever been in. Gorgeous light fixtures, gorgeous seating area, and plenty of room to spread out. The black and white photos represent the city well. 

When in New Orleans visit this Starbucks. 

Customer service is excellent.

I truly wanted to give a higher rating, because I love Starbucks, but this location definitely needs some extra care. When visiting the inside of the store, it's quaint size is comfortable, but the issue is, I don't think the employees are comfortable. I've never seen an establishment so unsanitary. There were miscellaneous liquids across their entire workspace, and not one person stopped to wipe anything down. I was pretty disgusted. Not to mention, I waited over 15 minutes for a single white chocolate mocha. I love Starbucks,  but if you like imagining your beverage being prepared in a clean workspace, please go through the drive thru only. Mind you, the only reason I went inside this time, was because my order is always incorrect when I order via the drive through. This will be my last visit here... I rather get a coffee from McDonald's, two storefronts down.
I love this new Starbucks. The seating is plentiful since it's in a large suite, and the decor is industrial chic. The baristas are all knowledgeable and able to make great recommendations.

This store has totally gone downhill.  Mornings are always crowded with lines going out the door, only because of its location being in the heart of University City.  Due to busy mornings, the staff is extremely rude because they can't keep up with the volume!  I guess they also don't care because they get the business either way. 

So, what happened to all the polite staff and great baristas that use to work there?  All new faces (at least during the day), which would be fine if they knew what they were doing and if they treated their customers with respect!  I do find that evening/night service is still a bit better though than the day.
