Nevertheless, customer service should be the number 1 priority of any business, even if they don't agree with the customer.  The cashiers here are really rude and the baristas either mess up the orders and/or don't fill the cups all the way. What is point of getting venti if you are going to get a grande beverage in a venti cup! And believe me, if you say something, they snap at you. Fine, then remove the sign above you that says "Love your beverage or let us know. We'll always make it right", and, teach your staff to actually do what the Starbucks 'Mission Statement' promises!  Also, each time I've used my own personal cup, they are supposed to discount my drink by $.10, but they always seem to conveniently forget to do that unless you specifically remind them ahead of time. You also don't get a receipt unless you ask. 

I was disappointed twice this week when I ordered egg sandwiches to go. I forgot to ask in advance to not have it toasted, but did ask shortly after placing the order. She gave me a dirty look, and rudely remarked that next time I should 'request' it before the order. Wow, it's just a sandwich, relax!  

The second time I remembered and asked in advance. However, after I walked out, about halfway down the block, I realized that the bag felt light, and noticed that the sandwich was gone!  Well, it fell out from the open bottom of the bag somewhere and I did not even notice it! 

So I went back and of-course the line was long and I did not care to wait another 15 minutes, so I stood and the front of the line and waited till the customer in front of me was done with their order, and then I politely asked the cashier for another sandwich explaining to her what had just happened. Meanwhile, another (not so happy) customer, who had also bought a sandwich had got the wrong item, so he rudely interrupted us to complain about his own sandwich. This confused the cashier and got her ticked off.  Eventually when I proceeded to reiterate and finish up my issue, the cashier angrily looked at me and said "you didn't aks me!".  I told her that I just did *ask* her, and she said, no you didn't, I did not hear you!  Seriously?  Then she said that too much was happening and she could not take it!  So another not-so-friendly cashier took over, and rudely gave me another sandwich in a new bag (I made it sure was sealed this time). I had wasted 10 more minutes just so that I could get another sandwich. It was not my fault that I had this problem, yet I was treated rudely, and got no apologies.

This is really bad. A store that doesn't care about or respect their customers, nor does it care about the quality of their service and the attitude of many of their staff members, doesn't care about the quality of their products, does not deserve my business.  And Starbucks is not cheap, we already pay enough for what we get, so I'd rather go somewhere else where I will at least be treated with respect along with a good cup of coffee.  

I hope that corporate Starbucks reads this because they need to know about the bad service and about all the wasted food that gets thrown out and the beverages that get poured down the drain due to mistakes of the not-so-well-trained employees!!

I fully admit I came here after the May 29 company-wide shut down to talk about new policies that said anyone can come in and hang out without having to purchase anything in the store.

To be honest, I was waiting for a friend who was running late for dinner down the street, and I had time to kill. So I tested the new policy. I sat down, used their free wifi, spent about 30 minutes, and left. No hassle by anyone.

Let's be honest, I spend enough money at Starbucks at a monthly basis that I don't feel much guilt about using their free wifi for a few minutes.

Now that i'm working 2 blocks from this location, I'm frequenting it more. The location is pretty cool right on the corner of St. Charles and Canal. It's probably the largest SBUX I've seen in LA so far. I love the vintage style of it and the lights hanging in the main room are cool. The trumpet artwork display hanging from the ceiling in the side room is cool too. They sell the usual SBUX fare and seem to keep everything pretty well stocked for being a busy location.

I've been here about 4 times so far and the staff have all been very friendly. They all have asked if I want to add an extra shot to my latte. I guess they really push the up-selling here. No prob. They work the line fast and I haven't had to wait long at all for my drinks. 

As others have noted, it's a great place to people watch. I generally don't stay here too long as I have to get back to work. There are plenty of tables and large windows to sit near and enjoy. There is also the separate side room that is kind of like a library study area with the long tables. The back wall has plenty of comfy seating, too.

I'm sure I'll be back soon.
Did online order said it was ready. Long story short now I'm late for work. Super slow and inconvenient. Also messed up my coffee, so I am now extra late. This place needs better management.

Extremely busy at 8 on a Saturday night. They only had three people working ... A cashier, a barista, and a girl pacing and cleaning and putting things away. The wait was ridiculous, especially when this third employee could possibly have been making drinks for customers instead of cleaning up... So she could go close up quicker I'm guessing. We ordered on the app and our drink was made well after the line behind us had all been served. When we do the same at the countryside mall  location, they are always consistent with the order in which they make drinks.
Staff are awesome and remember regulars orders. The are always courteous and have sufficient pastries in stock.

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever gone to. My order is consistently wrong. HOW?! Everything I asked for is literally printed on the cup. Not even by hand. This location is 3 minutes from my house, and at this point I'm going out of my way to another location so I don't have to waste my money. Do yourself a favor and go anywhere else.

Slowest starbucks ever. They only have one person making drinks during the morning rush! So this one person is flipping back and forth between the hot and cold drink setups and just can't keep up with the orders. Do yourself a favor and walk up two blocks and across to 20th where that Starbucks won't keep you waiting 15 minutes for an iced tea!

Love the people here but they always seem understaffed.
Never had an order coming out wrong and always the effort to serve me has been good.
Many times a bit of wait but... It is good coffee.

Service use to be "5" Stars...Been 4 times recently, they're always out of the Protein Boxes and chicken sausage breakfast wraps. I have yet to find they keep these items stocked.  The Summit Starbucks is "5 Stars"!
The most hostile, rude Starbucks experience I've ever had.  These people don't like their jobs and it shows.

Order employee are not friendly, just a little change right after my order, the girl gave me an attitude right away and finally I got the wrong drink from my order...! I Said nothing and just walked away.

By far the best Starbucks I've been to. The customer service is outstanding and I have never had an issue. I always come in with big orders for everyone back at work and they never even seen stressed with such orders no matter how busy it is. Simply outstanding.

Just went here and they gave me 3 black coffees instead of the 4 dollar chai teas I ordered. When trying to call them to explain they hung up each time. Absolutely ridiculous and we will be going to a different Starbucks or Dunkin from now on. So sad.

The only reserve coffee Starbucks in the area.  Short wait but I would say they aren't the quickest.  (Try the municipal towers in Seattle and you'll see what I mean).

Store itself is comfortably laid out with nice back to back benches, one side street facing and the other facing the counter.  Large room off to the side with a large rectangular table in the center.  Cell charging stations under the table and some on the side of the walls 

Only two bathrooms and code needed.  When I was there the code didn't work and they needed a key override.  

One eye opener during my second visit is seeing a gal sit on one of the tables against the window.  The Germophobe  part of me realized that table tops are now not off limits for street germs.  Ugh.  Maybe it's a generational thing but I never place my shoes where I eat!!

All in all, I will overlook these things on search of the Clover experience.  

Now if only Starbucks will offer mobile orders for all locations!

The baristas can be nice but I've seen some of them roll their eyes at my orders. I am not sorry that I'm paying their damn salaries and that leads to why I think they're terrible. They take forever, screw up the orders anyways, and look like they don't care for it all.  I have had good experiences as well but it's kind of hit and miss type thing. I would go one block over to the still busy but much better one.
I'm tired of wiping down my own table when I visit. The bathroom is always a mess. I even spoke with manager on the subject...,it's been a month...still a mess.
I consistently have to wait 15-20 minutes for a drink, even at off times. Service leaves a lot to be desired.

This location tends to have longer lines then others nearby but they seem to move effectively most of the time. They have never messed up my order and I constantly amazed at the memory of the expediter (must be all the coffee?)

For me there are more cons than pros to this Starbucks. I have visited this location about five times. Two of those times I have had borderline rude customer service - which I think is rare for Starbucks. I have usually had to wait in a long line. There are a lot of tables in the place, which is good if you need a table, but if you're waiting for your order you have to cram in around the tables - it's just awkward. Don't even get me started on the parking - it's in a strip mall so you have to compete for parking with Krogers customers. That all said - the drinks I've ordered have all been tasty. I'm a Bellevue resident and just glad we have a coffee shop in the area.

I just had the most disrespectful disgusting experience at this Starbucks. The cashier Patrick snatched my money from me and threw my change in my hand as if I were trash. It was awful. I just called to report him. The supervisor Sam, admitted that she'd notice him mistreating other customers and is now going to address this issue. Hopefully he will not be there next I visit

If I could give less than one star I would. The staff at this location are horrible. They frequently get orders wrong. They're incredibly slow. My last straw was today when after ordering several items I asked for a small bag. Apparently they didn't have one and no "I'm sorry for any inconvenience" is forthcoming. Really?  Because walking into my office with food in my arms is a good look, I suppose. So I asked them to cancel my order and speak to the manager. So here comes to the window a millennial doofus with a shit eating grin. As I'm telling him my concern he's just staring and smiling with a ridiculous smirk. At that point, I'm done. I spend over $10 at that store every day. Not anymore. I may consider another Starbucks, or better yet take my money someplace else. Do yourself a favor and avoid this place.

It's a little slow because Starbucks is the best... It's true! But, the baristas work their butts off making the drinks fast AND good. 

Also, CASSIDY the barista is a boss. She is the best!

Serious question.  You are right in the middle of Philadelphia's "Financial District" (so to speak).  Why aren't you open on Saturdays anymore?  You've got the five largest accounting firms across the street, working on saturdays.  This could be big money for you.  It doesn't need to be year-round  January to April 15th.

Nice new Starbucks but rather uninspiring and bland interior.

But it's a Starbucks and I must get my fix daily, so this one will have to do.

Not a fan of this location.  I don't really frequent any Starbucks because I love my Circle K coffee.  The coffee is good enough here, what I would expect from Starbucks.  The parking is difficult and somewhat crazy which makes this place a zoo.  The reason I stop here is because this place is right off the freeway and there is a great Wi-Fi connection.

By far the worst service I've seen at any Starbucks in the world!.. I travel the world for work and go to Europe, Latin America, even Asia, and get Starbucks at locations that are 5-6 times busier than this one. But don't ever recall waiting more than 3 minutes. At this location though... They make sure you spend a few minutes in line before you order your drink and approximately 15 minutes on a slow day! What do I usually order? Just a Trenta Very Berry Hibiscus refresher...
Awful! Just awful.
I can only imagine the lines here with this location between Penn and CHOP.  Luckily I've been going at off peak hours so I haven't had to wait.  Lots of seating here and friendly baristas.

Much better than your average Starbucks! 

First, it's much larger with a very pleasant upstairs seating area.

Second, it's open until midnight, unlike most other coffee shops here.

Third, the service here has been very good with friendly baristas who actually seem to enjoy working here.

Its definitely one of the best Starbucks I've been to!
Ok my main problem is not just the store but mainly the fact that they did not have the unicorn Frap and for that I am very upset

I can only speak of my first and only visit here, the service was fantastic, the drive through was smooth and fast. My order was accurate the girl at the window was super friendly and made sure everything was correct. That's all we really want right? I'd definitely come back to this location.

They get it right Every time! I never really noticed until they were closed for a remodel and I found myself at a different location trying to wrap my head around how difficult a hazelnut ice coffee was to make.

I love this Starbucks at UNR's Joe Crowley Student Union, aka "The Joe." Staffed by students, they hustle and make a damn good cup of coffee/frappucino/specialty drink of your choice. Friendly, fast, efficient and always a cheerful word. Yeah, sometimes you have to wait in line when it's a between-class rush, but I challenge you to find any other Starbucks in Reno that is more efficient and ALWAYS gives you a very hot cup o'joe.

If you like Starbucks coffee, you already know the menu, and you know the environment, so no need to tell you how great my Caramel Macchiato was. Being a coffee shop that has all the uniformity of restaurant chain, the only thing I found worthy to review is the quality of service and cleanliness. 

That said, I really like this Starbucks. The line moves quick because they know how to staff properly, and it's relatively clean given the amount of traffic that comes through. The baristas appear to actually enjoy their job(unlike the McDonalds workers down the street), which could be seen clearly from the smiles on their faces. They got my order right, but that could be due to the simplicity of my drink. My great experience here was mostly surprising to me because the neighborhood is usually crawling with homeless, littered with trash, and surrounded by neglected brownstones-not the civic pride I'm used to seeing. Spend some time in South Philly, and you'll see why this is pretty rare experience.

This Starbucks is immediately post security, and one of the only places to get "fancy" coffee, depending on the concourse you're departing from. By that I mean you can certainly get a cup of coffee closer to your gate, but probably not a latte or something like that.

AM lines seem to always be long, but it moves fairly quickly. I like that they clearly post calorie counts on both the beverages and the food items, so you know what you're getting yourself into. Otherwise, its pretty much the same as every other airport Starbucks in existence.
I really feel they have fallen off so much! Now you get average product for the same inflated prices.
I am not big on Starbucks but this location I like as a traveler - large space, cool decor like trampet celling light, big communal table, free wifi, bathrooms and outlets to charge your devises.

Granted this is a chain and  the whole point of having a chain enterprise is for the flavors to be the same no matter where you go, and that's one of the reasons I love Starbucks so much- consistency. But this Starbucks, and I have visited many Starbucks all over the world and consider myself somewhat of a Starbucks snob, is the best Starbucks I have ever visited (and now consistently visit though it is not the closest one to me at all). They are extremely knowledgeable and patient and friendly. In addition to that, the general ambiance and interior design is my favorite style of all the shops I've been to. Kudos Starbucks rittenhouse, you got 5 stars from me!

Horrible customer service - I keep giving them another chance, but it never improves. Waited 10+ minutes this morning for a small latte. And that was before the Monday morning rush. Ask if your drink is coming up? They'll purposely prep others before yours. A bit too much ego for my taste.

Prime location and pretty fast service.  I like what they did after renovating the place.  Seems a lot bigger and the line forms in a nice organized fashion instead of having ppl stand all up in a customers private space lol
Beautiful, spacious, and convenient. Doesn't get much better than this. Every barista I've encountered as been courteous and fast. Great wifi too ever since they switched from at&t to google wifi.

SLOW AF (backed-up mobile orders)

This Starbucks is beautiful and in a very good location.  However, I would not recommend going to this location if you're in a hurry or on your way to work.  I'm a huge fan of mobile orders, but my order wasn't ready until 30 minutes after I had placed it this morning (when you're on your way to work, this is a lifetime).  I was one of ~15 other people waiting for their orders when I got there.  Other people waiting were voicing that they were going to be late to meetings/appointments, mobile order tickets/printouts were going missing and people weren't in the queue, etc.  Not a good experience.  Wish I would have gone to 96th & Meridian, they are much quicker.
It was a nice little place I stopped in once. However, for me at least for now I rather go there to meet up with people as a ice breaker met.
I loove this Starbucks. It may take a while, but everyone is really nice and it's great for people watching!

I've been coming here week now so I thought I'd wait before I wrote this review 
I come in around noon every day sandwiches are always gone by noon so if you want one get here early----- also can't seem to understand the difference between and iced caramel Machitto and a hot caramel Machitto since I order iced and they give me hot

Update came back today and still sold out of sandwiches ugh absolutely unacceptable

Typical Starbucks. They seems to forget to make drinks when ordered on line and you need up waiting longer as you have to remind them that your drink is sitting there. I had this happen numerous times and it is really frustrating.

So friendly!!! I really enjoyed my visit to Starbucks on Walnut; everyone I spoke to was very kind. The lady that took my drink order told me I'm fabulous and the man I picked my drink up from made a fun joke with me :) I will be back next time I'm in Center City!
The Chile Mocha addiction is real my friends. I can't shake it. Glad this is on I-44 on the way out of town.

It really was just too slow. There was a line of drinks which takes time; however, the two other gals could have helped the girl on bar this evening as they were leaning against the counter and she was trying to keep up with all the drinks. My latte tasted fine, the store was tidy but I would not recommend if you are short on time.

The only reason why I go to this Starbucks is because it has a drive through. The staff are not always friendly and they keep on messing up my drink orders. They put ice in my hot coffee which was find, mistake happens. I asked her if she wouldn't mind making a different one without the ice and she gave me an attitude!

I feel compelled to updated my review because the staff had gotten incrementally better each time I have visited since my last review.  All orders have been correct and consistent.  Okay, now let's earn that one last star by working on your speed!

Everyone here is so incredibly nice. They're a little slow sometimes when its super busy but they more than make up for it with the service they give you. The coffee and the atmosphere is fantastic too.

Bethany was such a delightful young lady. As always the staff is kind and very quick getting my many coffee orders together. The other day I requested that my coffee be stirred well after ordering,. Without hesitation, Bethany gave a me a huge smile and offered to do so with no worries. Thankyou Starbucks for hiring lovely people.
This store is cool but the barista Fernando always hits on me and it makes me very uncomfortable.but Mariah to and Jordan are the best.

I've never had an issue with an location. It's naive to think that a company would embody the hatred and stereotypical nature of many insecure people we share the world with. The locations I visit are polite and want to know my name. Also, if you frequent a location, they already know who you are. Every company has room for improvement so, I will leave some space here. Happy workers create happy customers.

Nice and open Starbucks. $6 lyft ride from our hotel at the westshore grand. Ample seating available with tables for doing work.  A few of the chairs wobbled but since it wasn't full we were able to find chairs and tables that were stable for us to work at. Came around noon and wasn't that crowded. Friendly baristas and saw they have a drive through so I would think that is helpful. Appeared to have a good amount of parking available too in front and back. Down street from several restaurants too
This is THE BEST Starbucks on the planet. Every single employee is so nice, efficient, helpful, cheerful and awesome! Seriously the best ever.
Great service! Tim adds that personal touch that is so often lacking in today's coffee shops.  Wide variety of snacks at this location, too. Very pleased!!!

I hope they get a new intercom for the drive-thru because it is SUPER quiet. I can hear them alright but I know they can't hear me. I went through there today and had to repeat my order twice to the lady on the intercom and the order was still wrong when I got to the window, even after she repeated my order back to me.

Very friendly staff and the products, well its Starbucks so its good. However, this is got to be the slowest Starbucks ever!! The line reach the main seating area, very slow young man preparing coffee. They need to seriously hire more people or retrain the ones they have preparing the coffee. Way too slow.

This location has pretty much turned into the Ghetto Starbucks. 
Stopped by for a coffee while hitting Southgate and while it wasn't busy, there was a long lineup for drinks.  The guy working the register rang in my order and then chatted with the other dude who was furiously trying to make waiting drinks that had backed up.  He offered no assistance to his frazzled co-worker.
But the worse part is the shape and cleanliness of the place.  When I say "ghetto", I mean there were napkins all over the counter and floor, spilled cream/milk and those powdered toppings making a mess of every available surface.  I should have taken a picture to post - it was disgusting.  While the cashier wasn't helping his co-worker, he wasn't actually doing anything...it would have been a great idea to do even a superficial clean-up.
Friendly staff. Fast service. Outdoor seating which is a huge plus. Had a great date with my wife here. Will have to come back.

As Starbucks go, this one is on the lame side. Why? There is always a line, and it seems to move at a glacial pace. I guess when you are the center of attention in a super regional mall, and the line is always there, why bother moving at any speed other than 'this is what I feel like' doing.

Its not like those customers will go elsewhere, right?

Oh, wait. Yes they will.

Note: I do like the seating area. Lively, comfy and well located for people watching... if only the service could improve.

I must admit that I am not a huge fan of Starbucks coffee, but this is within walking distance of my house. The servers at this location are the absolute best! Very friendly and perky and they always show my hound dog affection and sometimes give him a mini-cup of whipped cream. They're the absolute best!
The worst service. Lady at the counter wanted to go home and let EVERYONE know it. As I waited she continued to talk about it. Sorry Starbucks

20 minutes after I placed my order, I brought to the cashier's attention that I had received nothing. He was very apologetic and gave me a full refund and an upsize on my drink, but that does not excuse this level of service at these prices. However, it does bump their rating from 1 star to 2.

Came here two days in a row. First day we went inside to order. Moe behind the counter was pleasant and helpful (since I didn't know how to work the Starbucks app). Food and drinks were normal Starbucks fare. The drive thru line cuts through the parking lot so good luck trying to get out of your parking space. (There is additional parking on the other side of the building that I didn't see until we were leaving.) Second day we decided to go through the drive thru to avoid parking and it's one of the slowest drive thru lines I've ever seen. But the girl taking the orders was friendly enough and the order was correct.

Baristas are nice for the most part. My iced coffees/lattes are a hit or miss. But the worst part are the long wait times in the drive thru. Omg I literally waited 30mins for a venti iced coffee with white mocha and 2 venti iced waters. 
When I finally reached the window I waited for a few mins more and she handed me my coffee and said my waters will be on it's way!!!! Then shut the Window and talkin to coworker. Couldn't she multitask talk and get the waters?!. I knocked on the window and said to forget them. 
I don't know why but I returned again this time for a venti java chip frapp.  Wait time was again ridiculous, furthermore, the frappucino tasted horrible!!! It wasn't blended enough , tasted bitter, and the coffee seperated from the ice and the whip looked like it was melting. 
I've also been given wrong change. This could be because the barista was more focus on chatting with her fellow workers than counting the money accurately. 

Your better off  just going to the starbucks in target or going inside. I've been to way more busier drive thru starbucks with much more longer lines and never waited more than 10-15min 

So they either need new baristas or learn to work more efficiently and get things done quicker while producing quality drinks.

The place isn't bad when u go later, but mornings suck! Three different times i go there granted my food and coffee doesn't take long but the ppl are so rude in they mornings. Get a cup of coffee. Or ever come in early and enjoy a cup of joe before u start working. And if that simply doesnt work find a job u will be happy with. Three different times and the same a$$ hole every morning.

Tucked away in a shopping center, an ok location. Parking lot is tight. Very nice outdoor seating, indoor seating is cramped. Cleaner than some Starbucks in the area. Creamers are often empty, as with most Starbucks, you would think Starbucks would make this a higher priority and also design a more efficient creamer station! Some staff are very friendly.

This Starbucks is my favorite of the 84647 that I have been to because of their staff. They have the friendliest staff and always perfect my order. Today, I spilled my drink EVERYWHERE and not only did they clean it up but they made a new drink without charging me. I have never encountered a more welcoming, happy, and fantastic staff than I have at this location. Thank you Hockessin Starbucks!!!!!

This location has recently been remodeled and is now a truly awesome location with a large community table and plenty of two-seater tables inside. The location has very nice staff too. Not quite a replacement for the defunct Ike's Coffee down the street, but a nice place to chill out after work with some reading or laptop time. Great WiFi connectivity and plenty of power along the walls and the community table.

Yeah I mean it is a Starbucks. Open floor plan with ample ceiling and the chandelier made of brass instruments gives the place a little twist.

Staff seems to work hard, but it was a tad slow from what I'm used to experiencing (although maybe New York Starbucks have spoiled me).

I love Starbucks! Especially their Café Lattes, they are to die for. Back when I was in University a year and some months ago, I would buy it every morning before class and it perks me right up. And I'm no longer grumpy. Without coffee I'm cranky. Now that I don't have any part time job for awhile, I had to cut down my Starbucks purchases of coffee.

Woohoo! I'm a Strabucks junkie what I can say! I love their coffee!

This shop is hit or miss when it comes ti being busy; sometimes its crazy inside and other times there is no line. They always make my drink to perfection!

The inside is like any other Starbucks but is always clean.

Like I said, I'm a Starbucks junkie so I know I'll be back!

I absolutely love this starbucks. Of the dozens + locations I have been, this one is tops by far.

The staff alone is worth coming- every single person is exceptionally friendly, and has called me by my name since my first visit.  I actually enjoy coming here just to say hi to everyone! They are like having a good bartender- they know what is going on in my life, and ask me how I am doing.

Of course, the drinks are perfect. They make them perfectly- and if for some reason they don't make it EXACT, they practically beg you to let them remake it. I really admire how important it is to them that you have your drink exactly the way you want it. 

The store is cozy, and always very clean and well stocked. The bathrooms are always spotless, and the patio seating is really nice too. 

Overall, if it is a one time visit, or your regular stop, this location is worth it. I love having them in my neighborhood setting the bar for quality and service.

I hate this Starbucks!!! If I could give it negative stars I would! This is a very very busy store and they use if for training! Why in the world would you make an extremely busy store a training store????? From the time it opens till it closes its crazy busy, the lines are super long! And they aren't very friendly. I work in the mall and I try to avoid Starbucks if I can. I have been going to the e bar at Nordstroms instead. They have delicious coffee!

I mobile order at this location pretty regularly and I usually ask for no foam because my $5 drink is often half full. Today when I picked up my order (in which I requested no foam) I open my drink to find it actually not even close to full.....just sucks when you're paying over $5 for a drink and it's not even a full cup.

It's awesome they have nitro cold brew but every time I've gone I've gotten subpar customer service. Their posted hours say they close at 10 but I went through the drive through at 9:40 and they were closed. And last time I got a cheese danish, it wasn't warmed all the way through, it was cold in the middle. I don't mean to be harsh but with them being such a huge corporation, I expect more

I'm only giving this Starbucks 3 stars because they have gotten very inconsistent. I almost always submit mobile orders because my family and I have special requests due to dietary needs and I don't want any misinterpretation when I order. Sometimes they get it exactly right, but this Sunday, it was an epic fail. 1. My Venti Americano with light heavy cream was on filled about 2/3 to the top and my husband had to ask the girl to remake it. 2. They didn't make my daughter's drink at all, so of course he asked for it. He told them it was a mobile order for a Carmel macchiato. They did not actually read the mobile or and made the drink the standard way and not to the specifics in the actual order, therefore it was loaded with sugar. 
I really need to stick with the Manhattan Blvd location because they are way more consistent.

Slowest Starbucks I've ever been to, and the baristas have terrible attitudes. They seem to hire based solely on the basis of whether or not they fit the hipster style of dress and opinion and not based upon actual work ethic. Would not recommend. If you actually work in international plaza i recommend you but a coffee machine for your stores back office.
Worst Starbucks in the country.  Sorry I have to be here. Always very disorganized. The drive through a chaos. Inside just as dysfunctional.
Usually Starbucks is always spot on, but today my boyfriend and I bit into a cold breakfast sandwich. You could imagine how happy we were.

Super friendly staff! I typically drink basic black coffee at other places but they have a lot of different roast so they are very knowledgeable when it comes to flavors and such! Love the Verona blonde roast now!

The best service, the best Starbucks. I wish I could take Donna with me to every coffee place I go to :) She remembers me and remembers my typical drinks! One time I forgot my wallet at home, and she said don't worry about it. I know starbucks is a monster chain, but this place feels like a great local place because of how it is run.

It's a Starbucks, like any other one, and it's just a few blocks over from the school I teach at. There's a drive thru and a confusing parking lot, but I understand why it's set up like that. It's a busy intersection; people are going to be coming in from Belle Chase and from Terry. It's fine, just park.

There's never a wait if you go inside, although the drive thru line can get a little long. I only order maybe 3 things ever and I'm in and out. The staff is nice and polite, recognize their regular customers, and the bathrooms are clean. No complaints here.

Service has been very slow the last few times.  Get it together, guys
      One of the busiest Starbucks in New Orleans, getting in and out here can be a pain.  That being said, service is always very fast, my order is usually spot-on, and I have met some very friendly, helpful barristas.  Stop by if you're cruising on the Wank.

Very busy

It was almost 15 minutes from getting into line before I had my iced caramel macchiato.  Not a problem, just killing time while others shopped.  

The order taker was upbeat and not at all judgmental when I didn't know how to pronounce my drink.  I don't do coffee places often.  The guy at the other end was all business trying to keep up and doing a good job of it.

There is seating and I scored a small table easily.  My coffee was good, easy to drink, and I was finished in less time than it took to get it.

A line of 8-10 customers and I watched 2 of the 4 employees doing nothing to help serve customers, one was actually yawning, flipping her ponytail tail around and drinking a beverage.  No one giving direction or trying to show a sense of urgency. Finally,  one of them started helping and the line started moving. Cashier was very nice once I got there, coffee was as expected. I admit that I use Starbucks for convenience, so it is frustrating when it is not as efficient as it could be.

Great location and size with New Orleans feel. Nice place to wake up in the morning and people watch and enjoy watching the street cars go by.  Long line, but when I order on my app, my food and coffee is ready in about 2 minutes!  I love technology!!
The staff here are always so friendly! I really enjoy my interactions with every person I deal with, regardless if it's super busy or I'm the only one there. Makes such a difference.

I LOVE this location. The staff is ALWAYS friendly and my mobile order is always ready to go when I get there - doesn't matter if there's one customer or 30. When I take my order they always acknowledge me with a "thank you, have a good day" and a smile (which pretty much no other location does). It's a pleasure to go to Starbucks Flourtown!

Now that UPenn is back in session the lines are to the door.  I am impressed with how quickly the baristas are able to complete orders.  I have always been greeted with a smile & my order has always been made correctly.  The second floor makes finding seating convenient; however, some people will hog the big tables with homework.

I try not to be a Starbucks snob, but this location is probably the best one I've been to in the city. 

Ample room, nice ambiance, very friendly staff.

This is by far the worst Starbucks in the city of Philadelphia. Long lines, one person making drinks, five other people that I think are "working"  are just hanging out behind the counter talking about scheduling and paper towels. This place is a poor excuse for a Starbucks. Do yourself a favor and don't go here unless you have 45 minutes to waste.

This is a lovely Starbucks in a cozy and homey neighborhood. They have indoor and outdoor seating and the outside decor is cute. The interior is large with ample seating that includes sleek, black leather armchairs. 

There are small tables as well as a long community one and I personally find this location to be a great place to get work and reading done.

This drive thru is beyond terrible. I was here on a Wednesday morning around 9:30 am and there were 6 cars ahead of me. After waiting for 15 minutes  and only getting up to the drive thru lanes at the bank next door, I decided to go get my coffee elsewhere. I won't be going to Starbucks anymore.

My first experience there was great and each time thereafter has been good. 

I had one flub up but by far this is the most consistent at doing things right. Pleasant attitudes. They now serve breakfast sandwiches and they have a drive thru!! 

I now like 17 miles away from this location, but I will still drive the distance when my time allows. 

Keep up the good work guys/gals!! :-)
Reliably good coffee with mediocre service. Pastries and sandwiches are made off-site, so quality would be the same as all other Starbucks concessions. Average cleanliness.

Worst Starbucks location ever, no syrups, no raw sugar. Staff was obviously learning and didn't know what they're doing. I had free drink with rewards but i still got charged for it on my SB card. This location is unbelievably dirty, cannot believe that managers are still employed here. If it wasn't only SB on this side of town I would NOT go here anymore.

I have a couple complaints about this Starbucks. My boyfriend and I live nearby, so this is the Starbucks we frequent, especially when we need a pick-me-up on our way to Phoenix. We usually get a coffee and a breakfast sandwich. My favorite is the spinach feta wrap, which is always perfection but twice now my boyfriend has gotten the sausage & egg sandwich and it's been cold in the middle. 

Another time, we frequented this place was to get an iced tea and a latte. I ordered an unsweetened passion fruit and the bf got a vanilla latte. His came out at least 5 minutes before mine and when I finally got mine and took a sip, I could tell it had sweetener in it. I checked the cup label to see if it said unsweetened, and it did. I stood there for another couple minutes before an employee approached me and made me a new drink. This all wouldn't have bothered me so much if I didn't have to wait so long in between Erik's drink and mine.

This starbucks is the one I happen to use most often because it's closest to my place of employment.  It's quite cramped offering very little communal sitting areas and service is most definitely hit or miss as some baristas there are superb and others not so much.  This place is also constantly packed on week days so I can understand why some baristas may be crabby.  Being that it's on UPenn campus and constantly busy, expect to wait roughly 10-15 minutes for your order unless you're ordering regular coffee black.

new starbucks. love the anterior. spacious and pretty! they also have a wide array of coffee beans you can buy (more than regular stores). they also have a big desk space for u to sit/read (unlike some other sbux around the city). i'm glad this place opened up near rittenhouse.

This location is dirty, the staff is consistently rude, and they put zero effort into preparing your order. I've tried this location several times, but I've given up hope. Many more attractive options in the area.

Stumbled upon this location because we were trying to get our coffee fix, but mostly to seek shelter from the rain.  lol  

The drinks are A-okay and the decor is awesome in here.  Lots of artsy things hung on the wall and from the ceiling, which is extremely different from the usual Starbucks decor.

Only thing really lacking is the customer service.  I asked for a water after ordering my coffee, and the worker just gave me a weird look.  Workers will do their job, but aren't the most friendly.  The world could use a little more smiling!

This Starbucks has a lot of tables and seats. There used to be a community table, which I love, but they took it away and put small tables in. I guess they have to find a way to fit more seats in. 

This Starbucks is VERY crowded during the day on weekdays because of all the offices nearby. When I do stop by, I often would have to wait 5-10 min for my drink because people tend to order a bunch to bring back to their coworkers. Despite the crowd, parking isn't too bad. There are spaces in front and back, and you can park on the grass on the street next to the building.

The noise level at this Starbucks is very high. The max # of people I've seen at one time at this place is 25-30, and with the espresso maker and blender going, it can get super noisy.

There is a Drive-thru at this location for your convenience.
Great location for Starbucks with all the offices in the are with that said , very, very busy in the mornings and a small parking lot for the location big plus Drive-thru!!

This Starbucks always has a long drive thru line. The first time I decided to brave the wait, I was in line for over 25 minutes. Really. In the last month I have decided to skip the need for a chai because of long lines a handful of times. 

This morning there was actually a line short enough that I wasn't sticking out into the parking lot. I got my chai in about 10 minutes, though it was quite watered down. Disappointed in this location.

I'll start by saying that, as a Seattle native and former Starbucks partner, I have high expectations for the Starbucks experience.  Starbucks does not just sell coffee.  It sells an experience to its customers. This is why Starbucks has dominated the market by creating the "third place."  This location, along with many in and around Center City Philadelphia, falls far short of providing this experience to its customers.  The baristas at this location are far from friendly and helpful.  The process seems rushed, the quality is lacking, and yet they fail to combat this by putting in the small amount of extra work necessary to provide a better experience (like adding a second partner to the register or taking drink orders at the pastry case during busy times).  Additionally, when someone questions them about a drink (quality or cost) they are very defensive and off-putting.  This doesn't quite jive with the sign by the machine stating "Love your drink or let us know."  Sadly, I have found my other Phila Starbucks experiences to be pretty much on par with this one so I don't have many options.  Just meh.

I give this Starbucks points for location. It is conveniently located right next to Cameron library. I am not a Tim Horton's girl, unlike the majority of U of A students (as evidenced by the two Tim Hortons located steps from each other in CAB), so I'm glad that this Starbucks exists to meet my growing caffeine needs. 

If you, like me, are one of those people who ridiculously customizes your drinks, then be prepared for the possibility that the staff will either not understand what you are asking for or make your drink incorrectly. It doesn't always happen, but it happens often enough that it should be noted. 

It would be nice if they had a better seating area so that you could meet up with friends for a coffee break. This is definitely a grab-and-go place. The use of the debit machine incurs a $0.35 fee and there is no mobile app scanner so they must enter your card number manually.
They never have bananas...clearly the manager here has no clue how to stick their store.
Friendly service, good coffee, but I would have chosen a local business like Black Crown Coffee instead had it been open on Easter Day.

The corner it sits on makes it difficult to approach in a car, unless you are traveling east bound on Grant. So I usually park across the street and try not to get hit while legally crossing the street. Yeah, the intersection is that busy. But once you make it, you can reward yourself with a six shot venti Americano. You'll need the jolt to make it back across the street.

I love this Starbucks and that's coming from a chick who said " F U Starbucks!" a few years ago because I thought they were such a rip.  I still feel like they are a rip but I will gladly pay for the spectacular service I receive every single time I come to this particular Starbucks (and I've been coming for well over a year).  I honestly receive better customer service here then I have at some of the best restaurants in the city.  Everyone is quick, FRIENDLY, POLITE, and the place is always clean.  I have also noticed that there isn't much turnover which I'm sure is a rarity in the coffee business.

Shout outs to:
The guy with the curly hair and glasses who works on the weekends- He is very fast and always asks people how they are and says it in a way that he actually cares.  Skillzzzz
The little chick with the glasses on the weekends - she is also quick and is very nice and knows what the regulars drink.  
The little chick with the short red hair who works during the week - she is always brings her A-game and is also very nice.  

Love this place!

I have acquired an intolerance to sugar and the only drink I have been able to tolerate is the matcha water lately. When I walked up to the register I was "greeted" by a woman with an attitude. She asked me what I wanted and I told her light ice matcha water. She looks at me tilts her head and instead of saying "I'm sorry I couldn't hear you," she says "what". I repeat my order and she asks me what size while looking at the venti traveling cup i am holding.  She then proceeds to charge me for an iced green tea latte and walks to the bar where she not only makes the wrong drink, which wouldn't have bothered me if she hadn't had a bad attitude, but makes the wrong drink incorrectly. I was so irritated I just left. With my sweetened(not supposed to be unless asked), matcha stuck on the bottom(supposed to be put in last so that doesn't happen) whole milk ( supposed to be 2%) matcha wa... I mean  iced green tea late..... wow... it's a good thing I'm not diabetic or lactose intolerant
These hours are not accurate. And not like other Simon mall Starbucks. Had an employee tell me today they were open till 9:30pm. They close at 9pm

I come here about once a week to work and get out of the house. Everyone here is always very pleasant and friendly. It can get crowded at times, but there's usually ample seating close to electric outlets if you've got a laptop.

Nice Starbucks located in the NEW OUTLET mall on the FAR Northside.  It was not crazy busy and there is no drive thru, but it is a larger store and very clean.  Indoor and outdoor seating.  The internet was not great for the number of people, so hopefully they get that worked on.  BUT is was a good stop for shopping in the middle of the mall.

As far as Starbucks goes this is a pretty decent location. I haven't been here in quite some time since I no longer work in the area but I decided to grab an iced latte on my way to my shopping outing in the Bluffs. The drive thru line went quickly and my drink was already ready to go when I got to the window. They had made my drink wrong originally and already corrected it before I got to the window. They offered me the incorrect drink for free in addition to my drink which I took for a friend. I will definitely come back to this location when I'm in the Fenton area which isn't too often but now that there is a Pottery Barn Outlet nearby I can see it happening more frequently.

I had to be at work particularly early so I couldn't visit my regular spot. I found this location via yelp and thankfully it was open at 6:15 a.m.

I asked for an off menu drink that I had tried in Texas, but they couldn't make it. I decided on a different drink and they made it quickly and efficiently.

Although I don't particularly love Starbucks, they are consistent. 

I wont go here regularly, but I will keep it in mind next time I have to be at work early.
decent latte..great quick drive thru....what else can you say...
This Starbucks is awful. The people behind the counter suck, there is no parking, and it is slow as hell. I'd drive past it and then another 100 miles before I got a cup of coffee here again.

I wouldn't go back to this location. I have always know Starbucks to be really diverse and friendly. Well not today I order a drink that was out of season per the drive thru cashier and the manager. I just order this drink less than 5 days ago she told me that's the price she is sticking to it. It was a matter of a few .60 I would have paid if she would have just informed me when the price went up but she couldn't I was never shown a receipt just a demeanor of this is what it is and pay or get out of line LBVS!!!!! Rude at it best

Starbucks has closed its bathrooms to paying customers at least 4 hours before parades pass today. Boo!!! I blame the store manager on duty. Why not see to it that the employees spend a little more time on actual service and less time trying to charm customers into feeding the tip jar with lame humor?

Headed to the Canal Place store from now on....smaller and more crowded but at least they get the job done. 

Shame on you Starbucks.

My favourite Starbucks. Just a 12 minute Canal Streetcar ride or short bicycle ride from my home in Mid-City. This is a huge and spacious Starbucks. The staff and baristas are all awesome and friendly. This is a "Reserve" location so they carry special blends of coffee. There's nothing outrageously fancy here. You get exactly what you'd expect of any Starbucks in any location in the world. But Starbucks is better with their app for Android and iPhone and by joining the rewards program. 125 stars gets one free drink or single serving food item. Stars are collected at the rate of 2 for every dollar spent and stored in your star bank. There are also many star dash opportunities for bonus stars. The details are in the challenges. For the record this is the Starbucks at 700 Canal Street where the St. Charles Streetcar turns onto St. Charles from Canal. Nearest Canal car stop is Canal at Royal. The St. Charles Line you are between two stops. Get off with everyone at Carondelet and Canal and walk one block towards the river (south) or if the operator doesn't kick you off with everyone else Common is the next closest and walk back. You can't miss it!!!! You'll love this Starbucks!!!
I am totally addicted to the Pike Place roast. It is my lifeblood in the morning. The best thing about Starbucks is that you get the same taste at any store, and really hot!

My 300th review and it's for a Starbucks?  Are you kidding me? No up and coming restaurant? No killer new NY Style pizzeria? A Starbucks? Seriously?

Yup.

It's been that kinda month.

My boss LOVES Starbucks so when we get together for early morning meetings, we have been getting together at this beautiful,brand new Starbucks in Brookhaven.

The location is perfect - right there in the new Giant Supermarket plaza, next to the AT&T store and the Smashburger,closest to Middletown Road.

This is one of the biggest Starbucks in the area. We love the large tables but there is plenty of seating all around the coffee shop. Wifi is free and it connects quickly to all my wifi eating devices: pad, phone,laptop.

The coffee is typical Starbucks. I am more of a Dunkin Donut's coffee guy but here there are three choices of regular to blend into the largest cup they have - that one cup lasts for the whole meeting. 

There are many more coffee choices as well as some food choices as is typical of a Starbucks.

4 stars for location and inside of store. Nicely decorated, spacious and inviting. Good corner location. Came here at least 3 times during our 10 day stay in NOLA. Good iced coffee/refills on a hot day (you do a lot of walking in the French Quarter!). Baristas are fast & efficient.

I love coffee and I love my neighborhood Starbucks.  Here are a few reasons why: Sarah, Jennifer, Robin, Mitch, Senija, and  Brooke.  I know  when I walk in they are happy to see me.  They are all "happy" people. They lift me up everyday.  I appreciate that!  They also know just how I want my coffee.  I always have to have more ice before I leave.  I save up my pennies to put on that Gold Card so I can not only enjoy good coffee but great people.

This Starbucks is BUSY!  Have some patience when you come here.  You see the long line, you know your order is not going to be ready in 2 seconds.  
Even with as packed as it is, the hard working employees have a smile on their face and are doing their best job.  
Seeing the negative reviews kinda surprises me.  
Look up from your phone and see the LOOOONG line, and understand that you are not the only customer! 
Take a seat and wait for your coffee to come.  If you dont want to wait, then dont order.

I was on vacation for one week in Seminole.  This Starbucks became my morning ritual.  Me, the dog and my friend would order our drinks and spend more than an hour in the sun at the outside tables. Well, I ordered the drink for the dog -- ice water -- which they happily provided. The only downside they didn't have my favorite breakfast item -- the Cherry Polenta Scone.  I guess these things vary region to region and I shouldn't eat it anyway.

The staff was super-friendly.  They remembered my drink after my second visit and I got my free refills for ice tea with no hassles.  A plus, a nice clean bathroom.  

Wish I could spend more time sipping tea everyday.  But, alas, it's back to reality.

Just went to my local starbucks. The service at this location is always fabulous.  They recently redesigned the interior as well.  The manager, Paul, is friendly and helpful and the staff is always courteous. And, of course, the drinks are always high-quality.
Cozy seating. Not much in the way of privacy, but peaceful and quiet, with folks keeping to themselves.

Although this location is slightly out of the way, this has become one of my favorite Starbucks spots (second only to the one on Maryland plaza). Ashley is such a gem and a breath of optimistic air when I visit the drive thru.

My usual location as of recently! Most of their employees are the epitome of Starbucks excellent customer service-specifically Derek & the new manager (whose name I don't know, I apologize)! I rate this 4 stars even though it's overpriced corporate bullshit. You should know that ahead of time going into a Starbucks. On a Starbucks standard, this group is the best of the best.
Great service and friendly staff ! Always busy but they seem to take care of orders really fast.

I've visited this starbucks a few times. I find the staff to be very friendly and very quick at what they do. my stuff was mixed properly and the drink was great. usually never an issue with starbucks. great experience! thanks!
One of the best in town with a clover machine and wine and beer service. Friendliest and knowledgable staff in town. We love our Baristas ..
The worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Worst customer service and just all around disrespectful

I'm not too sure of her name was Justine or Jessie she was the manager on duty but anyway she was absolutely rude and I'm sure she's a racist , not sure what's up with Starbucks hiring nazis but it's not cool . You just lost a long time Customer

This is a pretty typical Starbucks. Their service is always better than their coffee in my opinion. I come in because they have a consistently average coffee and I know I'll be able to get WiFi to get some work done. 

Lot of people here with the same idea as far as laptops and getting work done. My pour over took about 10+ min. Which they apologized for bringing out late.

Music is always a tad loud in my opinion at all Starbucks so don't plan on taking any phone calls here with any semblance of quiet in the background.

To make up for the long wait, I was provided $4 gift card. Many thanks for that. Like I said earlier, service (5 stars) is better than their coffee (3 Stars.)

Early-morning coffee . This Starbucks is great. Every time I come here it is very clean. The people that work here are always very quick and efficient. Always amazed at how they can make such complicated drinks so quickly. Love my grande nonfat no foam pumpkin spice latte with a dab of whip cream. Plenty of parking always friendly and helpful staff.

I came to this starbucks to study on a Saturday and was frightened to notice that this starbucks played almost exclusively Dave Matthews music for the 4 hours I was there. I decided that this had to have been an oversight on behalf of the individual given the task of choosing background music and dismissed this mistake. Then, against my better judgement, I returned here the following day, thinking "there is no way that someone will make the mistake of solely playing Dave Matthews for a consecutive day". Oh man was I wrong. Again, they gave Dave Matthews undivided airtime, except this time it appeared that the music was somehow louder, almost as if I was part of some practical joke played by the employees. To my disarray, however, not a single individual in this Starbucks seemed even remotely bothered by the monopoly of airtime Dave Matthews had attained at this establishment. I would often look up from my work in hopes of locking eye contact with a fellow patron to exchange a glance along the lines of "can you believe this is the 17th Dave Matthews song they have played in a row. This is crazy right?". But, sadly, that exchange never came. Honestly, I nothing but kind things to say about the staff, but I will not be mentally able to return to this Starbucks due to the tole I have taken from involuntary listening to Dave Matthews for 7 hours. I am writing this review in hopes of saving the minds of the employees and frequent customers. No one should be subjected to this kind of treatment. Consequently, if any scientists would like to conduct an experiment regarding the effects of being exposed to an endless loop of Dave Matthews on the human brain then this would be the perfect destination for you.
Long lines and clean bathrooms. Better than what one normally finds in some parts of of Canal street.

Typical Starbucks but parking is a pain and they are ALWAYS very busy. The drive thru is convenient but still busy. The building is kind of complicated to get to, there is a funny one way out of the parking lot.

The upside is it is a Starbucks so you know what to expect and the staff are nice.

The line moved fairly well and I got my drink pretty quick.  Service was fine.

This Starbucks seems pretty busy & full, so it's difficult to get seats.

This Starbucks is one of the better locations I've been too since moving to Philly. The employees are nice and do not give attitudes like other locations. The area is always clean and they always get the order right the first time. The location is a great spot because it is close to where I work and go to church. It has a good amount of space if you need to study. And a plus for all students is that there are a good amount of outlets if you need it. This Starbucks doesn't get too loud so it is another great reason to study here. There always doctors and other medical professionals who pass through here so it motivates me to study while here. There are new products every so often. The coffee roasts don't taste watered down like other coffee chains. Yes, it can be a little on the expensive side but it is better quality coffee to say the least. And they always ask if I want room for coffee even if I don't need it. This Starbucks is a great establishment 

NOTE: the bathrooms have a passcode for entry so you just have to ask them for it if you need it. I'm pretty sure the code changes frequently.
This is a great Starbucks location! All the people who work here are very friendly and helpful. Drinks are great too!

I've waited almost 20 minutes for one cup of French Vanilla Coffee and when i finely said something about it the manager said everybody is called in order. I've watched several people get coffee that was in line behind me. I do give props to the cashier she spoke up and said she forgot.
The evening shift employees are lost! And to make matters worse the lady who seems in charge is rude!

I feel like if you've been to one Starbucks, you've been to them all, at least as far as food and drinks go. But I have noticed the fruit in the protein boxes at this location seems to be generally fresher than at the Starbucks at Broadway and Campbell. I did order an iced tea one morning, and they were pretty quick considering the line.

My real reason for giving this Starbucks 4 stars? They spelled my name right without even asking. I know this might  not seem like a big deal to most people, but I don't think I've ever had anyone do that my whole life. Two of my best friends share my name, and even they spell it with a "y". It was a small vindication that I am the one who has been spelling my name right all these years.

it was so bad experience for me because i want to take my birthday gift drink on my birthday but they said that ''we can not give it, we are not Starbucks''. if you are not starbucks why your brand name is starbucks and you sell starbucks coffee and stuff.
The employees here are rude and don't fix their mistakes... it's a shame that it is the closest drive thru Starbucks around here
Excellent location, Clean and app orders are ready promptly. Only suggestion would be more consistency in their brewing.
We stopped here to meet our realtors and we had a great experience. Food, coffee, tea and customer service was great. We are definitely coming back.

The best in town. Love the Clover brewed coffee. I can get any coffee either hot or iced. They take time to get to know you when you come in often. If you are so inclined, you can have a beer or some wine.

By far my favorite Starbucks ever. 
Ed and the team are great. They get you in and out so fast, especially for how busy they are 24/7. I don't think I've waited longer than 2 minutes for my drink and I stop there more mornings than Id like to admit. 
Keep up the good work guys, and someone give these guys a raise for dealing with me every morning that I'm completely out of it!

First time at this location. Would not go back. Paid for a grande, got a tall and the staff did not seem to know how to make the iced tea/lemonade drink my son ordered. Service was extremely slow and we were the only car in the drive thru. Disappointing.

I love Starbucks and have been a devoted fan since the early 90's, however this particular Starbucks definitely does not live up to my expectations.  It's always crowded, you can never find seating (even though they have a nice upstairs area), and the music is a little louder than I'd prefer.  The baristas are friendly and I've never had a problem with them making the wrong drink, however they do consistently make the drinks at a lower volume than expected and very, very slowly.  Case in point: my grande caramel apple spice today was a good two inches below the rim of the cup.  Which makes it a tall.  And it took 10 minutes to make even though there wasn't anyone in front of me because the barista had to first look up the recipe in a menu book and then ask another barista where the apple juice was and then go digging in a supply closet to find it.  And it wasn't made nearly as well as the one I'd had a couple days ago at the other Starbucks a block away on Chestnut.  While it is convenient, I'd prefer to hit a different coffee shop, like the Nursing School's Jazz & Java or walk the extra block to the larger, quieter, and nicer Starbucks on Chestnut.
So happy to see a Starbucks open up in my area !! Prior to this one the closest one was 16 minutes away !! The staff is very nice and friendly !! It is perfect in the morning on my way to school

Thought I could give it another chance. 
This is what I said.."iced grande quad shot with 4 pumps white mocha"...then she asked of it was a latte or an espresso.....so I broke it down for her and said "grande with 4 shots of espresso and 4 pumps of white mocha and then fill the cup with ice, no milk"....my total 3.62...the wait time wasn't slow as molasses slow, I waited 7-10 min max....but when I got my drink, it was in a tall cup with light ice and I had about an inch of room. Maybe I'm too picky, I didn't even bother to change it. I wonder what I would've gotten had I ordered in a venti...anyways this Starbucks is going to be remodeled, I hope their customer service will be too
LOVE the staff. They have amazing energy and get my coffee perfect every time. The drive thru window is awesome as well. Perky but not obnoxiously so. Will continue to come to this location.

I tried to like this location but its the slowest SB's ever and they don't even have a drive thru.  I love iced coffee in the summer but half the time I get it here its weak as heck!!  I went today (my last time) and they couldn't get my order correct at all!  Even when they tried to fix it.  And I was there at a slow time.  And even when they do get it correct it takes for every to get your order .... I once waited 15 minutes for a plain coffee with soy and it was only slightly busy.

Am so excited about the new Starbucks at 3400 Civic Center Blvd.  It is truly like a coffee shoppe that is independently owned, not part of a major corporation.  The staff are incredibly service oriented.  It must be the test they pass to get hired!!!  One of the women asked me to call her ahead of time so she could save a pumpkin scone for me!!!!  And I plan to do that!  Friday after I see the doctor, my treat is to go to Starbucks, have the pumpkin she saved for me  along with a café ole!!  Could not be happier!!!!!

This is my "neighborhood" Starbucks as its the closest to my house. As i'm not a huge fan of Starbucks in general, i do seek them out sometimes because of the convenience. This location has a drive thru which can be nice.. avoid this place on saturday morning. SO BUSY!

Awesome location at 700 Canal, in the St. Charles Streetcar turn lakeside of Rubenstein's. A sweet family of baristas lovingly pour your Pike Place or Dark Roast. Reusable cups are available for purchase so the fun never ends, and it protects the environment. Also the rewards program is amazing. You get birthday coffee or pastry. After you get out of the welcome level refills on iced or hot coffee is discounted to free. Experts craft your frapps and other lattes, etc. I truly can say this is "MY Starbucks" because it's my favorite location. They're like family to me!!! :)

Starbucks! Where people are always sitting alone in public working on their laptops looking busy and you stand in line to order complicated coffee! Just like your average Starbucks. Nice staff and a brand new interior. Sadly new drive thru, so in the mornings be prepared to wait a little bit in line and for your drink. There are a lot of mobile orders that come in sometimes those take over the regular inhouse orders I've noticed. So skip on in for your Starbucks !

Pretty much your typical Starbucks. Ordered a couple of lattes and enjoyed our drinks before heading over to see a show at Walnut Street Theater. I like the fact that if you are drinking your coffee there, you can request a cup vs. drinking out of a to-go cup. Place was clean and service was friendly.
I usually love this star bucks, but this time the older women making my drinks was rude.

Damn long night can not sleep well ...I real need a cup of coffee , lucky my place near by starburst . I order ice coffee with cream milk and sugar . The waiter is the girl , she was very nice with beautiful smile ....I told her make sure not put milk in my coffee because I have allergic with milk ....she said ok 'I will make sure ' and she gave me black coffee ...oh my god , maybe I spoke not real good English so she was not understood ... I told her I want cream milk in my coffee ....then she was putted cream in my coffee but my coffee was not real good . And price $2.56 for regular cup ...
    I gave 3 stars because they are nice but coffee not make me happy.

Worst experience I ever had at any coffee shop ever. I waited in the drive thru for over an hour. It seemed like they forgot about the drive thru line because I kept watching people pull in the parking lot go in and order pay wait and get there order. When I finally got to the window the employees were rude and disinterested in helping me. When I finally got my coffee the order was wrong. I will never go to this Starbucks again. STAY AWAY UNLESS YOU WANT HORRIBLE SERVICE, RUDE EMPLOYEES, AND AN INCORRECT ORDER.

Parking is a challenge because it's so busy. Outlets to work off of are not easily accessible like at other locations. 

I don't think I'll be back here anytime soon. I don't like the layout here. Havertown is so much better in that regard.
Friendly service but the FLIES!  I see them coming through the drive-in window. They land on food, coffee, everywhere.  They have to do something. Not good.

I come to this 'bucks location because I happen to be on Racetrack a lot, but it's not my fave. If it didn't have a drive thru I wouldn't come at all.

For whatever reason this 'bucks doesn't make my coffee right. They always use more milk than espresso. I like my coffee to be robust, which normally I can get in a mocha or latte, but this location seems to skimp on how much coffee actually goes into those drinks...so I try to only get a tall when I come here. The bigger the drink the more milk they add. Yuck.

I prefer the one all the way on Anderson and drive out of the way at times just to go there.

I don't come often to avoid developing an addiction but when I do, the service is always very good! They're fast and friendly. One time I went in and they were out of my usual (very berry hibiscus tea) but offered another refresher and assured me if I didn't like it they could make me another drink. 
The only downside is that it's usually super busy during the week. The line always extends out of the door so expect a wait, otherwise I'd give it 5 stars.

I love this Starbucks for so many reasons, but mainly because the people there genuinely seem to enjoy working there.  The seating area is also larger than most other Starbucks in city limits and everything in here is well-maintained and very clean.  

Never had a problem with drink consistency or the time it takes to make them.  I've definitely been to a couple Starbucks along my travels where they have no communication between employees, leaving my marked cup sitting on the counter for those few extra minutes while I'm trying to rush out the door.  Luckily, this is my neighborhood Starbucks and I'm fortunate to have such friendly employees greeting me every time I walk in.

I gave this location a 2 ultimately because the people are great and friendly but the service is a clear 1. Today is a typical wait so I thought to start writing this after my first 10 mins waiting in line. Next stop is the waiting for my coffee which can be another 10-15 mins., seriously. Ask any frequent guest and they'll tell you the same. 

Since waiting I thought to look at the wait time on the drive thru which never exceeds 5 minutes. Kind of frustrating for a customer inside. BTW....still waiting. Overall, great people, great coffee but give yourself 20 minutes to get it.

Either it's too small or minimally staffed, some experiences are very unsatisfactory.  Myself and a coworker seem to have a difficult time during every visit. I wish they had more structure and consistency between customer service and product  satisfaction.

I normally love this place, however... the obviously new girl who doesn't seem to know what she's doing at all and is the slowest moving person I've ever seen should not be cashiering during the busy morning when the line is out the door.  

I've had her twice - the first time they were out of Pike's Place and she had to brew it, but she didn't know how.  She got someone else to brew it and then she went to help make drinks.  I waited.  And waited.  Meanwhile, she never checked back with me or bothered to pour the coffee I had already paid for.  Eventually I found another person to help me while the first girl was wandering around behind the counter, totally oblivious to the fact that she left me standing there for 15 minutes while the line grew longer.  Then today I get her again and it's like it is her first day all over again. She looked so lost and confused - it was a struggle for her to pull a cup out and pour the coffee. They were out of Pike's Place again (go figure) and she had to ask the other cashier what to do!  Didn't we just do this last week? How have you regressed in your knowledge of your job during that time?  For god sake, the line is out the door.  Learn your job or get out of the way.  

Besides that, the coffee is good and I love getting a free same-day refill when I bring back my cup and receipt. And the other employees are great - it's just this one girl who needs to go back to training.

One of the cutest locations I've been to, and a short walk from Samurai Blue. Sushi and coffee? Heaven.

The baristas were engaging, lively, and humorous. In the very brief time it took to order my drink, I had a conversation with comments from all of them. My barista even asked me if I was an "ey" or an "ay" Lindsey for my cup. Awesome customer service! And my frapp came flying out in no time flat. It was picture perfect. 

You guys rock!

Slowest Starbucks ever! This is the only Starbucks near me so I am forced to go to this location. It doesn't matter if there is a line or if I am the only person here, I always wait 5-10 min for a simple iced coffee. I wish I could say it is because the staff is new but it is the same people that have been working here for the past year months since I moved to the area.
Great friendly staff who remembers regular patrons and it's a nice walk from my place

I work at a local business that is not far from this Starbucks location. I often come to the Starbucks to buy a large number of gift cards for our client base. Typically I will drive through the drive-through tell them that I need upwards of 20 gift cards, pull forward, and pay in a matter of five minutes. I have done this probably 10 times over the past few months and there has never been an issue. I really think that on most days this Starbucks deserves four out of five stars. They are typically very fast and accommodating. 

However I just visited this Starbucks hoping to go through my typical routine of ordering gift cards. I was confronted with a flustered employee who told me to just pull forward and she would deal with me at the window. Not a problem. 

However when I got there, it was as though she had completely forgotten.  She tried to hand me the coffee for the car behind me. No biggie, I just reminded her that I was the one who wanted the gift cards. She said it was going to take a minute because she had to go get a few packets of gift cards from the other side of the store. Not a big deal, I can wait. 

It took her maybe 30 seconds to grab the cards before she proceeded to count them out in front of me to ensure it was the number I had asked for. I hand her my card through the window, and mind you this is a company card so it says the name of the company on it. She looks at the card, looks at the line of cars behind me, looks back at me and says She needs identification. I explained to her that I could give her my ID but that it wouldn't match the name on the card because the name on the card was the business I work for. She rolled her eyes at me and proceeded to run the card. 

I signed off on the receipt and was about to pull away when she said, "Next time you come to do this, come inside. It's very inconvenient for me to have to do this through the drive-through." and gestured to the line of cars behind me.  I explained to her that I had done this several times before to which she retorted, "Not through the drive-through." I drove off. 

Now, normally this Starbucks is actually a really nice establishment. That being said you should not argue with your customer when you have a growing line of cars in the drive-through. Don't treat your clients like an inconvenience when the only thing making the line grow longer is your stalling. And don't give your customers attitude when they're coming to you for continued business. I mean, we're referring our clients to YOU and you're going to give attitude like that? Whatever. 

2 stars for the lady working the drive-through today. Your costumer service needs some work!

I walked into this place and it smelled gross like spoiled milk, and I couldn't help but notice the flies flying around inside by the counter. I ordered my latte with soy and they said they did not have soy milk. I realize they probably have the market cornered, but I don't think that makes it okay to drop the ball. Customers have a certain level of expectation for the Starbucks brand.
Defiantly my favorite Starbucks in the bucks county area. They always make my coffee the way I like it!
Excellent customer service at this location & for fresh made coffee pretty fast  the pumpkin spice latte is mmmmm a yummy liquid dessert!  so delicious!

Clean and rather fast considering how busy they are. Thanks, Starbucks!  I love the added touch of the beautiful wrought iron chandeliers, and beam ceilings. Lovely.  What's that in the next room? A brass instruments sculpture? So festive! So New Orleans chic! Love it!

This is my local Starbucks. The Food Girl and I have frequented it for a few years. I must say, in the last few months, the quality, service and overall experience has plummeted off the deep end. 

Where do I even start? 

Is it too much to ask for a "Good morning" or "Thank you?" The snarky, snide service gets under my skin. A few new baristas have been nice lately but there are a number of morning-regular workers who are obviously jaded and bitter. It shows. The environment in this Starbucks in the morning can only be described as "dreadful."

Customers feel like cattle, moved from line to handoff station and finally out the door. And frankly, that is the best part of the visit.
