The store itself is a damn mess. The condiment bar is perpetually dirty. Sugar everywhere, spilled milk and empty containers. Look, I understand that this is a coffee shop and it goes with the territory, but it seems like the staff doesn't even give a damn.  I have never once seen someone cleaning up the condiment station, and I go to this location at least twice a week.  

As for strengths, the drinks are generally good. Still, the service is extremely slow and often gets my order wrongwrongwrong. I was even overcharged last week, not realizing until I got into the car. there was no way I was going back in there to get my $1.25 back. 

My advice? Go to Black n Brew. I should listen to myself more often.

Fast service. Love their Ice Chocolate Mochas!!
Always friendly and no nonsense with the way the business is operated. Their coffee products are very good and prepared just right.

System was down today which was beyond their control but they offered around 13 of us a free cup of coffee for our troubles. Some stores would have just shut down. I thought it was great customer service and you could tell that they had some meaner consumers beforehand. I give them major props. Love Starbucks,  as a company anyway but loved the coffee even more when it's free.

If I could give them no stars I would. Extremely long line and the staff was abrupt to say the least. I had to go back 2x because they forgot my coffee and then made it wrong. The barista said I ordered wrong (which is rude) sorry darlin' not even a possibility. I hate peppermint and get the same at 'bucks every time I go.

Your standard Starbucks. Good service for a busy location at peak hours. Seating availability and arrangement is decent. The line of customers can get in the way of things but I feel these are poorly engineered at most Starbucks locations. When I stay at the Sonesta across the street this is still one of the better morning options however.

The coffee is in a hotpot ( large thermos) so it is not as hot or as fresh as a stand alone Starbucks. The staff is nice but not as geared up as a stand alone sbux. They did take my reward, saw that was a previous complaint. The lattes, etc are typical Starbucks. My problem is related to the Coffee prep and delivery system. I see they are getting ready to construct a stand alone Starbucks on an area adjacent to Providence so until then this is as good as it gets on this side of I 40.

These guys are fantastic - extremely busy, but always friendly and willing to go the extra mile. Today they remade the hideous mistake of a latte I'd had the misfortune to receive at a different location. Wish I'd gotten the manager's name... but thank you, CP Mall Starbucks! You made (or re-made) my day!!

This is the most disgusting establishment.  Inside their food counter were gnats and flies; when I addressed the clerk, she simply said thank you and that she wasn't serving those to her customers.
The cream and napkin area was filthy.
Stay away.
This is probably the slowest Starbucks. I order using the app and it's not ready or wrong.  This location is so close but service is not good.

This is the slowest Starbucks ever!!! Second time trying and orders always slow waiting 5,6,10 minutes in line at the drive thru is absurd!! Don't bother going here just go across the street to the DD

Like Carrie, I really like this Starbucks and the staff is extremely fun & friendly. For me it's an easy stop on the way to work. I occasionally have trouble parking during peak hours in the morning, but around lunchtime it's always easy to find a spot right near the front.

Starbucks are all the same, sure. But this is the worst one. Takes forever, make drinks wrong, staff unhelpful and not cheerful. More worth it to go to the Target next door, go in, and use theirs. You would probably save time doing that too.
Coffee as always

After dark, Starbucks Corporate's new policies have
Turned this place into the Mos Eisley Catina ....

(Look it up)

My kinda place ...
The espresso shots weren't as strong as they usually are in other Starbucks  locations. I found this disappointing, since I really needed the shots to wake myself up for a long drive.
This is my local Starbucks! Staff is super nice and accommodating, despite the store being almost always busy especially on a Saturday noon!
Poor service and long wait times. They forgot to put flavoring syrup in my latte. Pretty basic mistake. I keep going back out of convenience, but this will be the last time.

I have to strongly disagree with the other negative reviews of this Starbucks.  We are frequent customers here and of the dozens upon dozens of drinks I've had here I've never once had one wrongly prepared. Unlike many Starbucks, this place never burns the milk and never fills up a significant portion of your cup with foam even if you order a latte with no foam. I've ordered numerous special requests and my drinks have always been prepared properly and quickly.  Service here has always been great as well, with the employees all quite friendly. Honestly, this Starbucks is much better than the standalone one across McCarran, so if you need coffee go here, not there!

This is the worst Starbucks I've ever encountered. The line was out the door, they weren't familiar with some of the most basic drinks and what really frustrated me was I was unable to use my Starbucks rewards from my App. The young lady at the register acted like I was speaking a foreign language when I told her my app had given me an offer for 50% off a drink. Then her manager, who was equally as incompetent, did nothing to help. She simply wrote me off and said "we don't do those here". Are you kidding me? This is YOUR company's app so these deals should apply to any location, and I would especially expect to be able to use it at an airport location. I use my Starbucks reward deals with no problem at any location I visit while home in Chicago. Starbucks, please do a better job educating your employees on benefits and programs you provide to your customers! My deal expired that same day so ultimately, I was unable to use it.

When ordering the cashier told me they only had small lids available, so best to order a small drink. Then it turned out they had run out of small cups (??) I ended up with a child size... Also, forget about powering up here, the entire seating area only has ONE working power outlet. I'm left quite baffled by the whole experience...

This Starbucks is small, but mighty. They know how to get customers in an out, especially when there are events happening at the Convention Center or at the Marriott. The staff is super friendly. Once, I lost my wallet and they knew me right when I walked in. Great place for a traveler on the go.

We're in the drive thru and it's a hot mess. The intercom is not working, the woman couldn't really hear us at all. We ordered four drinks and only one of them was correct. When we went to the window to get our drinks they had to remake 3/4. Making the other drinks behind us melt it seemed. Not a great Starbucks. Visiting from NY and I'm a gold member, so I kind of expected more. Two stars because the cashier apologized for the inconvenience.

This is more of a review for all Starbucks in general, and specifically, for its chai latte.  I've been on the hunt for great chai latte (since I've given up on coffee), and so far, Starbucks ranks number 1!  Taking away one star because consistency in quality is not always there - from Starbucks to Starbucks and even within the same Starbucks.

This Starbucks is located in the Opryland hotel in Nashville. I would go to this Starbucks every morning for hot tea. The staff was friendly and they had everything a regular Starbucks would have. All of your extremely long named coffee products that I still can't get right after five years. 

The coolest thing about the Starbucks is it was themed and it looked like something from Allison Wonderland there was a huge mushroom that was over top of the Starbucks and then there were all these vines and leaves hanging off of it I thought it was the coolest thing. The tables that were inside of the restaurant looked over one of the big open walkway lobbys in the hotel. 

Every morning I would come here and get about five different coffee orders for other people and of course I would get my hot tea.  Not one time where the order screwed up. I would also purchased about four or five water bottles per day here and the staff was nice enough to get a plastic bag which they did not have behind the counter she actually went to a store in the hotel got a plastic bag and put all the water bottles in there for me I thought that was very nice. 

Overall this is your typical Starbucks they did have a couple sandwiches available and other things but it's pretty much still a coffee place. Like any Starbucks you're paying for the name. 

PROS:
- looked like Alice in wonderland soo cool 
- friendly staff
Do not get coffee here. The employees are less than interested in producing a good or even correct product. Very poor quality service and coffee.

Will never stop by this location ever again. I usually go to the one that is on Loughborough and never has a single problem over there and they seem to always make my drink great and "full". What I meant full is the meaning of a full cup, not missing almost 3 inches in a venti cup. Today I stopped by this one and it was around 5pm. It literally like nobody was in there, its not even a rush hour so I dont know why this girl barista was so rudee. I stated that I wanted my ice green tea latte to be shaken up instead of leaving all the green matcha powder settling down at the botton like that, she poured the whole cup out to the sink and start making another one for me while giving me an attitude. When she gave the drink to me, it was missing like 3 inches, like wow & the drink doesnt seem to have any sweeter in it . I think she forgot to add in any syrup. Well my bad for wanted it shaken up I guess. On the other hand my sister wanted a venti black ice tea mix with some haft & haft, her drink wasnt even full. So she asked that barista if she can have some extra black ice tea to the full cup? She came and pour it into my sister's cup & my sister was being nice and said " sorry about that". She literally didnt even say anything back, turned her back and walked away. Like what was that?! It surely ruined a nice day for me.

My favorite Starbucks of all time. I grew up in Seattle so Starbucks are not all the same, I've came to notice. However this is my daily Starbucks. I come get my coffee EVERY day! The staff is AMAZING!!! This location also has the option to order ahead with the app! Best Starbucks in New Orleans! Coffee is great and the staff is out standing!!

This is a brand new store- just opened 5/7/16.  There are 2 parking spots in front, and 2 handicap parking spots in front.  There is a huge parking lot behind the building (and there is a rear entrance in the store).  There is a drive-thru.  I was immediately greeted upon entering.  My drink was prepared before I was even done paying.  The pastry case was well-stocked (even in early afternoon).  There are 2 huge communal tables in the center of the store, lots of tables around the perimeter, 3 comfy chairs near the front door, and a huge patio.

Fast friendly service. My sister works here so it's a treat to see her. She request a nice drink for me each time. 

Lots of students come here to grab a coffee. There isn't a lot of space here but there are a few table and chairs. There's always a line up here, so I like to get my drink and go. 

It's also too noisy and busy to sit down and have a conversation with friends.

Overall, I like the efficiency and the organized staff at this Starbucks.

Shitty service from whoever worked today at 1130..Everytime there's this specific pair of guys working, it's the worst service. Zero eye contact, wrong orders, no normal "thank you", etc. Everyone else that works here is great and it's a clean location. Fingers crossed they find a different location so I don't have to order from them.
Nothing like a white chocolate mocha with just a sprinkle of sea Salt to get your day going.... Yumm

Had to give it one star or else I'd give none. Absolutely ridiculous that it says this location is open 24/7 but I come in at 9:13pm and the employee is sitting in the back with beats on with the gate closed and refused to help us. Explain that? Terrible customer service.

I have to shake my head at this Starbucks. First of all I don't think it taste like Starbucks at all. The drinks are generally prepared wrong and the staff seem to always be confused with what you are asking for. The reason this Starbucks gets two stars and not one is because of its proximity to where I spend the majority of my time. I'll meet friends here for coffee sometimes, but I prefer CBG. I also think that the fee to use your debit card is ludicrous... no other Starbucks makes you pay that!

There are two Starbucks in Terminal 1. This one is for the one in the C Concourse/Southwest Airlines side. Not sure why this one always turns out so much more sweeter - in a bad way. I always get Starbucks when I fly and this one is consistently bad. The other one on the Delta side does a fairly good job. Unless you are short on time, I'd recommend going to the one on the Delta side (on the right once you get through security).

The best Starbucks in existence!  On Sept 11, 2015 I was car 6 of I think 77 that paid for each others drinks that day before the chain was broken!  The people are sooooooo friendly which is crazy when you realize its one of the busiest fastest paced places around, but they still treat you like family and will make anything that might go wrong - right with a smile.  I just love everyone there!

Great staff. Fast service. No place to sit due to the old men there that gather everyday combined with the suits that must work and steal wifi. Occasional hotties drift in and out along with a familiar face. Drinks are good but like any Starbucks expensive. All too often the bathroom is like a Hershey Highway massacre!

This is a typical Starbucks. There aren't any cushy chairs which is kind of sad and it's very crowded because it's right near a lot of classroom buildings for Penn and Drexel. However, the baristas are always very friendly and they try their best to move people through the lines. I would recommend going here during off-peak hours such as early in the morning or in the evening where you can usually get a seat.

The rest of the reviews pretty much nail it. The parking is terrible, I know the layout was already in place when they bought the property, but there had to be a better way to put in that drive thru so the line wouldn't block parked cars. Plus, the traffic for the drive thru spills right in to the street. 

The music is way too loud and the staff is not friendly. The last time I went inside it took about 5 minutes before anyone even spoke to us. The 2 people behind the counter were working on drive thru orders, but it doesn't take but a second to say "hello, I'll be with you in a moment". They do, however, have enough time to carry on personal conversations with each other while you're waiting. 

I don't like giving bad reviews, but I've been here 5 or 6 times already trying to find something positive (and it's the closest coffee shop to my house). It's just the same every time.

The Starbucks here in the KOP mall is actually a great place for a relaxing cup of coffee, particularly for those looking for some quiet time during the middle of the day. Unlike other Starbucks, this one can always be counted on for good coffee and pleasant music. 

I must also say that I love the nice decor here. They have great seating around the glass windows and doors, which is good for some laptop or wifi time. That was worthy of a nice picture. Check out the photo I quickly took here. 

The only real downer is the crowd that tends to aggregate around the mall, which spoils the quiet time that one might try to grab at sunset. If not for that, I'd say that it's a very pleasant place to be at after work or to catch up with some friends.

This is my local Starbucks. It's the usual haunt for meetings with business partners and friends.

Big patio outside but often the tables inside are full.  No leather chairs for relaxing - it's all wooden chairs.  There is a bar area overlooking the parking lot and a giant shared picnic style table.

Service here is quick and efficient.  Drinks are good.  The cream/sugar area can be a bit untidy but in general it's fairly clean.

Parking is generally easy but Friday and Saturday evenings can be challenging when the Hart's Kitchen starts to fill up.

I used to love getting my morning pick me up here...the baristas were great and always accurate. Now they have a lot of new people and suddenly my order with "no foam" has a lot of foam. Maybe it shouldn't be a big deal, but it does make a difference. You get a lot less when there's foam, and I just don't like drinking air. And I'm pretty sure I've been jipped on syrup recently too, so I just stopped requesting it. I order the same thing everyday on the app, so I know what it's supposed to be. I still need that triple shot to get me going, but I might have to start picking it up elsewhere. (Side note, Amanda is awesome!)

I love this Starbucks! After several years I still recognize many of the employees. Everyone is kind and conscientious. The place is usually quite clean and a nice place to study. The only reason I wouldn't give it 5 stars is because the drive thru can be very slow and the store is pretty small which means that it can sometimes be tough to find a seat.

The drinks and food are all the same in every Starbucks in the country. The difference between one Starbucks and the next is the staff, and this one has the best.

 It also has a drive through which is super convenient when making a quick run for you morning latte.

It's currently 5:15am and I have been in line since 4:50am. The location opened almost 5 minutes late with over 20+ people in line. They have one person making beverages and their computers are slow. In my opinion airport Starbucks should be the most efficient place seeing as how people are trying to catch flights. This could be a caffeine withdrawal review but seeing as how i still don't have my coffee yet perhaps it's accurate.

I am a coffee junkie and when I'm running low on fuel, I tend to spot a nearby SB where ever I am at. This was the chosen one and I will have to admit, they were friendly helpful and prompt for being busy. I changed up my normal order and they made my decision more confident. Thanks SB On Speedway, you guys rock and I'm super energized!

Small store but cosy. The seats are nice and it mostly seems to be a place where people come with their laptops to work. What I don't understands where are the electrical plugs? Not one seat seems to have access to one, unless that was intentional and they don't want people hanging out all day.

i usually come here every morning to have my spinach feta wraps, and have delicious tea with it as well ( i will drink coffee after this pregnancy) but the staff is very kind and takes time to make delicious drinks. They are also willing to hold a conversation with you and learn what you like and knows most of the locals. truly a wonderful place.
Great place to work! T he barista are always nice and provide excellent service. Makes you feel at home. Love this place!!

Randall who's working in the drive thru rocks my socks!  What a fantastic personality and gave a great suggestion for a new frappaccino flavor for me to try and it was delicious.  Much needed caffeine and a friendly smile and face to go with it.  Thanks Randall!

I always come to this Starbucks location because of the convenience since it's close by work. I wish you guys had the program so I can just scan my phone to get my points. Today Jen was working and it seemed as she wanted to get her other work done before actually helping me. I was the only customer in line.. my 3 drinks were throw together sloppily. My latte was free poured, like a cappuccino - basically foam. I think she needs a rerun on training.

Can I give them less than one star? I come to this location occasionally when I am in town because it is very close to one of my customers. I had some time to kill today and had a chance to observe how bad service is and how dirty this place really is. When I placed my order, the ladies behind the counter were more interested in seeing pictures on their phones than waiting on customers. Once waited on, the lady was nice. Walking to my chair, the floor seemed rather sticky, but I assumed they had just had a rush. Well, in the 90 minutes I had to kill, I never saw anyone attempt to clean the floor - at all, not even sweep. There is paper all over the floor in addition to it being sticky. It has been very slow, but no one attempts to clean anything. If the area the customers see is this bad, how bad are the areas we can't see - say behind the counter. How clean is the equipment? I almost want to call the health inspector. I will find another location the next time I am in town - they have lost my business.
Coolest Starbucks I've ever been in. $5 for a coffee is a small price to pay for the super laid back hipster Mac Book ambience going in this Java house.

Ever since this Starbucks opened next to The Children's Hospital of Philadelphia and the Perelman Center for Advanced Medicine, I have been utilizing it as equally as the other coffee options nearby (Dr. Coffee in CHOP, Gia, etc.). Overall, this Starbucks has been both a blessing and a curse for coffee lovers. Here's why:

The blessings:
-It's Starbucks! You can use your Starbucks card and get your favorite drinks (and get rewards) without walking all the way to 34th and Walnut (next nearest location). Great for people working in the hospital system.
-Great ambiance--a decently sized seating area in typical Starbucks-style decor (dark wood chairs/benches, artful coffee-referencing wall art) which I have never seen full, meaning that if you were not working in the hospitals, this would also be a decent place to get work done or meet up with people

The curses:
-It's Starbucks! Bad for your wallet and other coffee places with the good old fashioned punch cards probably have a better rewards system for loyal customers
-It is exceptionally busy, service is decent but mistakes are made on orders occasionally (mobile or in-person)
-Did I say that it is exceptionally busy? Service is slow because of the huge influx of mobile and in-person orders (the line can be out the door literally during peak hours)
-Even when it's not exceptionally busy, the service is occaisonally slow (barista dependent)
-From a coffee quality standpoint, it is pretty much on par with all other Starbucks'; you could probably find better coffee elsewhere, but there aren't that many other options in the area

Overall impressions:
-Avoid peak times (6-8 AM) and sometimes afternoon shift change
-Mobile order unless your drink is complicated (saves you the wait and you actually inadvertently "skip" people in line based on when your mobile order is put in)
-Be prepared for some drink mismatches and mishaps no matter how you order and either roll with it or be prepared to wait some more for a re-made drink

Haven't been to a Starbucks drive through in quite some time, decided to give this one a go. No.

Not only did it take roughly 15-17 minutes entry to exit, my drink was entirely wrong ( see photo). I used to work Starbucks a long time ago, and I totally understand how busy it gets . And of course if you choose a drive thru ( I wasn't in a rush) you understand that there may be a little bit of a wait, and that's fine! But I do think 17 minutes is pushing it. I noticed about after 5 full minutes we didn't budge a bit. Eventually I pulled up and ordered " Iced tall 2 pump SFV light ice coffee in a grande cup" which I did have to repeat back because the barista repeated back " Okay that's a venti iced americano??" 
So imagine waiting about 15 minutes rolling up -- driving away because I felt pressured with the line behind me.. and seeing that I had a an all iced coffee. As in, there was so much ice in the cup and i am NOT exaggerating, I had trouble putting my straw in!! I literally had to maneuver around the ice cubes so my straw would fit.. remember i said LIGHT ice right ? 4 sips and it was gone... glad I spent that money..

Wouldn't return on that poor experience. Enjoy that photo fail.

I was just killing some time before I went to work, so I decided to go have a seat in Starbucks in Southgate Mall. This staff when I went it were amazing. 

I was greeted instantly and everyone behind the counter made sure I was well taken care of. I felt like I was welcomed in the coffee shop. I have been in so many coffee places were I don't not get greeted and I don't feel welcomed. But the Southgate Starbucks location was hands down the greatest service I have gotten in such a long time. I visited the shop around 11:30 on Sept. 19 2018. 

I ordered an Iced Chai Tea Latte but they were out of Chai, and they let me know and asked if I was okay with them using Sweet Chai. I said yes. As soon as the drink was made, they asked me to tell them how it was, they made sure I liked my drink before walking away. The drink itself tasted exactly how my regular Iced Chai Tea Lattes. There were three of them, two woman and a male. They walked peoples order out to them. Replaced the tissue as soon as it was brought up. And they also said "Bless you" to everyone who sneezed. 10/10 would come back if I saw the same people working. 

Thank you for that experience Starbucks staff at that moment.

I generally like the service at this location. Though, the other day I got a breakfast sandwich. It was piping hot on the outside, but the egg on the inside was actually cold. Not a tasty surprise. BUT, for the most part I've been happy with this location's service and products.

Again and again, Starbucks on Country Club and Speedway continues to amaze.  My favorite store in Tucson, I will go through any lengths to go out of my way to this store.  Consitency, Friendliness, and promptness make this Starbucks a shining jewel.  I have been coming to this very location for 5 years and I'm stil a loyal customer.  Keep up the good work!


Tip:  Lots of students come here, it gets pretty packed and hard to find seating after around 2 PM.  

The outdoor patio is dog friendly!
Ugh. This one is always busy and staff is just not friendly. The place where you get your cream and sugar is always a mess and it's crowded and tight.

I have been patronizing this Starbucks for @ 10 years.  I will no longer do so.  There has been a change in store management.   Subsequently,  customer service has markedly deteriorated.   They do not seem interested at all in maintaining regular customers or attracting new ones.   So, I will vote with my feet and find stores that appreciate their customers.   I might even leave Starbucks alone all together.   There are many excellent coffee bars in Philly.

I've been here a few times now and I've never been impressed. They've gotten my drink wrong every single time. The first instance was a few months ago and I ordered a grande iced coffee. Plain. Nothing fancy. The coloring & taste was off which I mentioned to the barista. She was persistent by telling me that my drink was iced coffee so I left. I didn't believe her but she obviously wasn't going to change her opinion. I ran into a friend who is also a barista at another location and he too noticed my drink was too dark to be an iced coffee so he tasted it, and he deduced that they gave me an iced Americano with skim milk. The second time wasn't much better: I asked for an iced caramel macchiato and it was made horribly. It was very bitter, not proportioned properly, the ice was melting VERY quick, etc. I'm not asking for perfection but I've been to various Starbucks locations and my CM was never that bad. The most recent time I went there was today. I don't know why I did that. I should've simply went to the one at Westshore Plaza or beloved location in SoHo but I was being lazy. Guilty as charged. I used the drive-thru after hearing a lot about it. It was an hour after the morning craze so I figured it wouldn't be much of an issue. I had to repeat my order five times (iced toffee nut/vanilla latte) but it wasn't a life or death issue. The barista handed me my drink very, very quickly. It looked too light to be my drink so I assumed they put too much milk which has happened before. Oh well, right? I couldn't even check the printed label because two cars in back of me were vigorously honking. I didn't taste my beverage until I was halfway home. I noticed something wasn't right. The same designated Starbucks employee who took my order gave me an iced chai tea latte. I could've went back and returned it but it didn't seem worth it and I didn't have the time. Amazing. My advice? Avoid this place if you're able to. It has a nice scenery and the staff is generally very friendly but the drinks aren't made very well. You deserve better for your money. We both do.

Between this location and the one off of Cortaro I am at either one of these on a constant basis. This location in particular is about 2 minutes from my house so I do a lot of mobile orders through them, even if I order while walking to the store from my car my order is always ready and waiting for me. The staff is very quick and always friendly, they make a point to have a genuine conversation with you and not just take your order and move on to the next customer. They do a great job here!

Hanging out here for an hour and a half until a meeting starts. Staff is genuinely friendly and efficient workers. Starbucks always has long lines no matter which one you go to but these staffers are burning through the line fast. Work very well as a team together. Food is well stocked. Store looks clean and I keep seeing a staffer come and wipe tables off and straighten chairs, etc. Very nice atmosphere but the staff make this experience awesome.

I love this Starbucks. It's my favorite because they mix the toppings into the oatmeal for me, so I can eat it if I'm driving without having to prepare. The employees are all so nice and efficient. The only drawback of this one is that the drive-thru is terrible. They can't make up their minds how they want the drive in to work. Sometimes they block an entrance and want you to drive around the building, and sometimes it's okay if you come in through the entrance. It leads to confusion when there are a lot of cars. Additionally, the traffic in the drive-thru tends to block traffic during the 8:30-10 AM rush. That's okay, though. When things get too hectic I just park and run inside.

This Starbucks is conveniently located on a corner and with a drive-thru! The service and its drinks are amazing. Although every branch follows a recipe, not each makes it correctly. This branch, however, does the recipes justice. Green tea frappucino is a must try! Seating indoors and outdoors are plentiful. Lastly, staff are super friendly and knowledgeable.

Some cons are poor lighting for studying, max of 15 parking spaces with 1 handicap spot, tables and window sills are not the cleanest, and it's hard to miss this Starbucks as it doesn't stand out like most Starbucks do. 

Overall, typical Starbucks with delicious drinks and great service as expected.

Location- Convenient to Penn hospital
Service- Slow, do NOT go here if you are in a rush! 
The store is fairly clean, some of the staff is nice. 
Product- Not the best Starbucks I've ever been to but standard!

As a tourist from California I was appalled by the service at 10am at this midtown location.  The friendly staff is more focused on jollying up the customers than actually providing expedited, efficient, high quality service.. Took the barrista forever to mix coffee drinks as he was too busy looking around and chatting with the long (very long) line of customers waiting for their orders and the other staff. He got no help from the other staff after they took orders. My drink was an iced coffee. How hard was that to make? But two other employees stood around and chatted with him to distraction. I had a contractor waiting for me but what should have been an 8 minute trip became a 20 minute trip. People in Tucson generally are friendly and will chat you up and the wait staff everywhere never rushes but this was ridiculous. The tables inside were filled with laptop campers there for the duration but that's the same as California.

It was really slammed when we went, but we didn't wait long. Super fast and excellent service. I ordered 2 long involved frappachino recipes with no issue. My franken frappachino was perfect and my husband loved his banana split frappachino. With a long drive ahead it was the perfect time to use up some rewards. 
We don't come to this location often, but I would not hesitate to stop. This was thanksgiving weekend Saturday too!

I love to study here because there's lots of natural light. On days when I'm cooped up indoors to study for long hours, the light coming in makes it not so bad. The music can be a little loud (& the employees also) but my earplugs or headphones help. 

The parking sucks, especially at night if you have to walk to the dark, creepy lot with the dumpster next door. 

I'm not an avid coffee drinker, however, I am addicted to the soy caramel macchiato, which makes it so hard to try other coffee shops. And with this one being so convenient it's hard to say no!

Huge upgrade from the Starbucks experience we had at the location in Harrah's. Our drinks were correct, tasted delicious, and they were so very nice. They were busy, but that's to be expected because of their location. It was strange to have to enter a code on the bathroom door to be able to use the facilities. I thought that was strange given the public ridicule Starbucks recently received. A public apology from the CEO recently about how Starbucks was started with the idea of people being able to come and rest, visit with friends, etc. Here is a thought, don't lock bathrooms.
One of the worst Starbucks experiences to date.  No greeting, 30 minutes to complete a mobile order, no customer service.  Just a oops the order never printed, our bad.

They're not the fastest service in town. But I've had no trouble going thru the drive thru. Of course if you order something extra like a croissant or sandwich which needs to be heated, that's a different story. 
The coffee is the usual Starbucks quality. 
And they do try to keep it clean depending on who's working that day. Some of the crew like to play around and others actually do their jobs. This place is good when the crew isn't gossiping in the back.

I wish this location would get their service together. They're sooo slow. The drive thru is slow and going inside seems even slower. The baristas act like it's a chore to speak with you and if they can avoid making eye contact they do. It's not a friendly environment. The pastry I purchased today was stale. Even though there was only 1 person in front of me in line and only 1 person at the counter waiting for their drink it took almost 15 minutes to receive my drink after I paid for it today. The layout inside is awkward. I keep returning in hopes for some improvement but it's consistently poor.
The workers were rude, stuck up, unfriendly, and indifferent and the drinks they made weren't very good. Although the manager did give me a free drink. I won't be back.

I usually use the drive through at this location so my review can only speak to that... the items are not consistent, one day they make your order perfect the next day they tell you they ran out of ice once you get to the window to pay and after you have sat in the line up for 20 minutes, and another time you may get your drink completely wrong. Also, the staff here is not friendly or polite. So if you want to take a chance then go to this location. If you want to get a delicious drink from a friendly barista go to the many other great Starbucks  around town.

Ugh. From worse to worser...

Went in this morning for a few drinks. Condiment bar was gross; luckily, I didn't need it today. 

My order (I get this all the time, so I know I didnt mess up): Venti no-water Chai & a grande extra-caramel caramel macchiatto. 

First was the Chai. "Non-fat no-water chai" said the barista. (She's also the manager!) I politely told her I ordered a no-water chai, not non-fat, and she took it back, made a new one. Next drink was the extra caramel macchiatto. She called it a "Grande non-fat extra caramel macchiatto." I again informed her that it was not non-fat, to which she replied that it wasnt non-fat. And I said that isnt what you called. And she said, rudely, "Listen to what I'm saying. It isnt non-fat." Ok then...

Eff this place.

Between the person passed out on a table right outside the door to the employees who barely appear to have a pulse, this is not fully functioning Starbucks location. Save yourself the hassle and go to another nearby location.
People are nice but service is always slow.   Been here for 20 min waiting on iced coffee.  Have experienced line wait through the drive through also.  If you are running late to work DON'T stop!

I'm giving this Starbucks one star because of the ridiculous convoluted drive-thru. What a joke. If more than five cars are in the Drive-Thru, nobody can enter or exit the entire parking lot. I know, I know, first world problems. #nopumpkinspicelatteforme

I went to this place for the first time Wednesday morning, around 7am. I went through the drive-thru and ordered a tall peppermint mocha and sausage egg breakfast thing. First, the coffee was barely warm which on this cold day was a huge disappointment. Then I was disappointed in their menu options. On the Starbucks main website has all these healthy options but not at this location.
Pretty good for a Starbucks. Staff was freindly and the decor was about the best I have seen in this chain.

Friendly staff, awesome Barista, very helpful staff who I notice tries very hard to remember their customers and what they drink. I have never had an issue with them, and I have been going here several years. I sometimes come to study and it's always very comfortable. Will continue to go here, as long as they are here!!!

I stop by here quite often on the way to work.  They are fast and accurate most the time.  Whoever is working the window is super friendly.  They make suggestions for you to try.  The inside is quaint and has seating for you to work or just enjoy your tea or coffee.

I find it incredibly annoying for a drive thru attendant to ask what you'd like and then tell you to hold on and give her a minute once you're done. And her never had even heard your order when she's ACTUALLY ready.
Slow. Slow. Slooooooooow. The sbux in Frys across the street is 10x faster and they're not even trained baristas. Done here.

This is one of my least favorite Starbucks. The servers are very snippy and short tempered. No key was available for the restroom leaving patrons with no where to wash their hands. Very disappointing!

Convenient location & had coffee to dose up the mom for mother's day. They even wished her happy mother's day.
Prompt service, friendly & plenty of pop cakes (my fave!!)

What can I say about starbucks that hasnt already been said? Well, this place had a really cool and friendly vibe that made me want to stick around a while and enjoy my slightly burt tasting coffee:-)

IM HERE ABOUT once a week. The baristas are always pleasant and i have never had anything come out wrong. The service is fast and even if there is a line they get through it pretty quickly. Not too much seating inside and not as nice as some other starbucks but still ok. The only downside really is parking. It shares a plaza with a kroger and the building is under major renovation so big portions of the parking lot are closed. Also, there is no drive through but that can be a blessing in disguise as your drinks come out quicker.

I know a Starbucks located inside another retail operation isn't a new thing (see the Starbucks inside the East Sparks Target for example).  However, this is very much an option of last resort.  As a Starbucks, heck, as a coffee shop, it's nothing special.  The employees are even more truculent than your average Starbucks employee. 

However, all that said, it's nice to have the option to purchase some hot caffeine while doing the grocery shopping.  I try to do my shopping in the morning and having coffee to help me get through the ordeal is a major plus.  In fact, one of my large gripes about shopping at Walmart is there is no coffee joint.  Of course, I suppose I could hit up McDonald's for a cup but the thought sorta gives me the shudders.  

It's definitely not ideal.  If you're feeling particular, you may have more luck at the Starbucks down the street.  It's opposite direction from which I generally arrive so I don't stop in there as much, is the only problem.   So the Starbucks in Safeway it is.  It fills the need and the built in coffee cup holder on the shopping cart helps immensely.

They be slow. Even for regular coffee. They put their priorities on the drive through rather than the people who take the time to come inside, which I think is pretty fucked up. The place is clean tho, which is nice.

My chai latte was pretty on point and came out really fast; however, the barista rolled his eyes at me when I asked him to load the total onto my Starbucks card and then pay for it so I got the points for my gold card. :(

Most convenient Starbucks location around! I use their drive through at least three times a week.. I've never received a botched order since I've been going. 
I was an avid energy drink consumer and passed this place every morning during my hour long commute. I decided to make a stop one morning and this is my new addiction. I purposely go the first 15 minutes of my drive caffeine free so I can stop here in the morning. 
I think the longest wait time I've experienced at this location was maybe five minutes. 
They definitely get people in and out without losing quality of their drinks.
For a cheap, light, tasty breakfast sandwich, I recommend the turkey bacon sandwich.

Most of us reading reviews of Starbucks generally know what's the menu and layout of the cafe. My review is more aligned as a studier. This location in particular has an ok amount of seating to study and zone out from the talkative crowd that is rolling through.

For outlets, are scattered around the second floor and are mostly against the wall near the stairs but it is for a single and small table. If you have alot of stuff, I suggest you sit in the bigger rectangular table and find an outlet that your cord can reach. Bring good noisy cancelling headphones cause Starbucks usually has a constant flow of customers and noise as a result.

I came here during a slow time when the staff had all the time in the world to leave a lasting impression. The service was mediocre and the lobby area was a hot mess. Not very good representation of the company.

I waited 11 minutes (after ordering) for an iced tea this morning and almost missed my train. For about 6 of those minutes, my ice tea was already "shaken" and left to sit in the container they make it in. Why could they not just throw it into a cup for me? Instead they prioritized the blending of 4 frappachinos, while the ice melted in my tea and became watery. Thanks starf***s. Unacceptable! They cannot handle the morning rush. If you are wise, you will go elsewhere. Try 19th and Chestnut - great service.

Best Starbucks in the city! Always fast and almost all of them know my drink order and are so friendly. One time I came in and my phone died the second I got to the counter, and I didn't have my wallet with me. They gave me my drink for free, while I told them I'd pay double next time. Of course when next time came they refused. So nice!

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever visited.

For starters, they were short-staffed.  Only three employees for a large busy store.

Also, they were out of anything my wife wanted to order so she had to sit there while I drank my iced mocha and tried to get a little work done.

There are not enough outlets so I had to squeeze in at a little table against the wall while my wife sat at the long table across from a homeless drug addict who kept trying to help us find an outlet.  He looked everywhere, on the table, under the table, the floor, the ceiling.  He looked on the chairs, under the chairs and up and down the walls but could not find an outlet anywhere.  He confirmed that there were no outlets in the chandelier or behind or on any of the artwork.

Then he asked us for money,  After that he started waving his hands around looking at the beautiful colors.

Out of boredom (and to just get away from the guy) my wife decided to try to use the restroom.  You need a code,  she got the code from a barista and discovered that there was no toilet paper.  She informed the barista but, as of 45 minutes later there was still no TP in either restroom.

All of this put a serious damper on my ability to respond to a few work emails so I finally gave up and went somewhere cleaner and less full of drunks, crazies and drug addicts - the Krystal on Bourbon Street.  That place was the Ritz compared to this Starbucks.

I used to stop at this Starbucks daily. Recently the lines have taken longer and my order has been incorrect on multiple occasions. Today I ordered a strawberry refresher with coconut milk. There was one car in front of me. It took me 7 minutes to get my order, I spent 5 minutes at the window with 3 minutes watching the group of baristas stand and talk with one another. When I received my drink it had more ice in it than anything.... very disappointed

I'm not really sure what happened to this Starbucks in the three months since I have been here (I worked down the block and would frequent it a few times a week) but it went from being one of the better Starbucks I have visited to absolutely disgusting. I visited at about 7:30 on my way to work (they tend to get slammed right around 8:00 and you shouldn't even bother at that hour) and there were maybe three people in line. The first thing I noticed was the shelves were pretty bare and the sundries were barely stocked which has never been the case before. Ordered my food and the staff was friendly enough. Mostly just going through the motions. When I went to put milk in my coffee is when I realized just how dirty the store was. That are looked like it hadn't been cleaned nor the trash been taken out in at least two days. Most of the milk containers were empty. Nothing had been wiped down in a good minute. I proceeded to look around after that and I have never seen it this dirty before. To top it off the bathroom had no toilet paper and the back up roll was also empty. I don't know if it's bad management or lazy employees but it has suffered greatly in just a few short months. Had I written this review six months ago it would be nothing but praise.

Brand new great location and layout. We've been here several times per week since it opened and love the staff. The cafe is larger than typical Starbucks and is open late, which is great for us local residents!!

There is no way to give Starbucks under a five star review. The coffee (and other types of drinks) here are good, and if you ever order a drink you don't like it's because you don't like it, not because they made it wrong or the recipe should be adjusted. Everything here has just the amount of topping or what not and I love the fact they set the sugar and chocolate and hazelnut and such out for you to adjust your drink properly. On a side note, the people here are always extremely nice, never had gotten an attitude or anything like that, and I will defiantly be going here again and again!!

I go here almost every couple of days and I've never had an issue. This morning I ordered my usual Peach a Green Tea Lemonade. I got to work and realized that instead I was given a black tea mango. Not only do I dislike black tea but I'm also allergic to Mango. Ugh what a horrible start to my day!

While I regularly support the locally owned coffee shops during their open hours, I admit I am a frequent Starbucks consumer after work. They are very friendly in this location, some of the staff members know me when I walk in the door. There has been some turn over in the staff recently but the new people are also very nice. When the young lady made a mistake she caught, with my coffee yesterday, she offered to make it right then wanted to give me my next one for free.  I told her that was not necessary. It was good to see she cares about her customers.
Baddddd Attitude !  Customer service  really poor. Other then this ... Same old same old ... Coffee

I ordered an extremely simple Grande Iced Coffee with caramel syrup and 2% milk. When I drove up to the window, I received a hot coffee. I informed the server that I ordered an iced coffee. The very same hot coffee I was offered was mixed with ice and put into an iced cup. It was disgusting!! Then I returned and explained the situation and the woman who took my initial order was telling me what I ordered automatically comes hot..how does an iced coffee automatically come hot? So when I got up to the window for the second time, they gave me what I ordered but made it with the oldest, most disgusting tasting coffee imaginable! Not what I would expect from Starbucks. Extremely unacceptable for a $3 coffee. Very disappointed! Will not be returning. Beware!!!

A brand-new, super-clean, SORELY needed, Starbucks with a busy drive through in "Brookheaven".  Brookhaven had nothing like this shopping center - until now.  A new Giant, a wine/spirits (State) store, Smashburger, Hand & Stone - and finally - a real Starbucks.

My advice?  Skip the drive through - especially if there are more than 4-5 cars ahead of you and just go in and get your stuff.

Hallelujah,

Coffee is good, but don't buy any breakfast sandwhiches. Egg and sausage was ice cold, i couldn't finish it. Big sign, "we heat our croissants to bring out the flavor " nope chocolate croissant was not heated, it had chunks of chocolate in it.

This is my least favorite Starbucks! I've been here over 5 times (since I live close and it's easy to stop by), but I'm always disappointed! A few of the baristas I've experience via the drive thru are not professional, are rushing me as I order (ex. "Ok, is that all?... as I'm continuing to list my order). They do NOT handle special coffee or tea orders well! (Changing the milk or syrup type) they always mess it up and give me the wrong coffee. Other locations nearby handle special orders perfectly fine. Also, all of my friends in the area have mentioned how much they dislike this Starbucks location.

This is an ok Starbucks. The coffee is generally good and the service is decent and efficient, which is really all you need. The inside space isn't great, its actually a bit on the smallish side, and kind of awkwardly laid out. Its not all that inviting and I wouldn't want to work or hang there, but I can't imagine wanting to do that at most Starbucks. At the end of the day, its about the product, and this Starbucks is as good as any other. A solid three star establishment.

I went to this Starbucks two nights in a row to purchase hot chocolate for my roller derby league.  Bree & Hannah were very helpful and accommodating.  The first night I asked for two boxes of hot chocolate and one the second night.  They happily made the large batches of hot chocolate fresh & provided extra cups for free.  They also provided a large cup of whip cream and spoons.  The hot chocolate was delicious & stayed warm despite the cold temperatures until the practice was over.  Their small meals in a box were fresh & provided me with a healthy meal option.  The place is very clean & there were always a large group of folks using Wi-fi there.  Highly recommend this location.

Tall ceilings, well lit, lots of action. This Starbucks is a great respite at the corner of Canal Street and Saint Charles Avenue. Plenty of seating too. Being where it is and what it is, I like sitting here to put your finger on the pulse of what is going on downtown.
Eggnog Chai...only available during the holidays, but it is literally heaven on earth.

This Starbuck's is pretty much like any Starbuck's across the country. They have their standard items and the Starbuck's brand specialty items. It's a wide open space with a nice amount of sunshine lighting up the place naturally. Very clean.

What threw me off: They have those seasonal Vivanno smoothies. Yet when I asked to have an Orange Mango Banana Blend made with non-fat milk, the barista said it's not made with milk.

What? Not made with milk? This past summer, this Starbuck's drink was a favorite decadence. Across the country, I ordered them when the Starbuck's branch had them, always requesting non-fat milk.

Then I ordered a Java Chip Frappuccino® Blended Coffee, asking that it be made with non-fat milk. 

Again, the same response. There's no milk in this drink. O.K. Clearly something is different with this particular store or Starbuck's has changed recipes in the past few days.

Without checking out other Starbuck's since this experience, it could be this Starbuck's store has decided to use extra protein powder (perhaps, mixed with powered milk) or Starbuck's has changed the original recipe to save money. 

Personally, I like the option to select what type of milk is used or to pick soymik instead.

Here are recipes for these two drink found on Starbuck's website:

Vivanno Orange Mango Banana Blend
Made with a whole banana blended with all natural Naked® Juice made exclusively for Starbucks, our proprietary whey protein & fiber powder, 2% milk and ice.

Java Chip Frappuccino® Blended Coffee
A decadent combination of chocolate and java chips combined with Starbucks® coffees and milk, blended with ice, topped with whipped cream (optional) and chocolate drizzle, a chocolate lovers dream.

If I do more digging and discover whether this experience is localized vs. nationwide, I'll update this review.

(UPDATE: At Starbuck's in Phoenix and one in Scottsdale, both made their Vivanno Smoothies with 2-percent milk, which can be changed to non-fat milk or soy milk.)

This place is always crowded. Don't go there expecting to get a seat, or expecting to be able to hear the others at your table! 

I've had generally good experiences here, and the location is perfect. The caffeine, of course, is what I frequently need. My preferred standby favorite is the regular Pikes Place Roast!

At the best of times I am not a Starbucks fan but I go with benefit of the doubt and rate against other Starbucks. The location is ideal but the service, variety & attitude of staff is ridiculously bad. They really need to employ actual baristas with the wait time and queues that happen here.
I was queuing for over 20 mins to get my coffee (standing) and they didn't have half and half which was what I requested and tried to faux make it and it tasted terrible. The staff lied to me and said it was half and half even though I watched them pour something different (and incorrectly - I suspect none of them work for a creamery).
I know this seems picky but this is my 4th and last experience here as none have been positive and mediocre is the best it has achieved but generally disappointing.
One of the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. Whenever I have to go inside (because of the backed up drive through) there are unpacked boxes all over the store. Not your typical Starbucks....

Really Yelp...u want me to review a starbucks? No way. haha. Not many seats..always busy because it is the only South Philadelphia Starbucks. Try green tea frappacino, pumple spice latte (unfortunately this is seasonal here). This Starbucks use to be my pharmacy school quiet study spot before it got real busy. Feeling nostalgic.
Same as every other but south Philly stores are so much cheaper for some reason.

This place should be called Starsucks. Slowest service ever. 30 min for an iced tea and iced coffee. The employees response was that they have a lot of customers. Guess what, hire more help. Completely oblivious.

Love this starbucks, the staff is quick, friendly, and patient. This is one of the few starbucks that I've encountered that always give out free samples nearly every weekend. It's nice to go to a coffee shop with friendly baristas that always take your order with a smile on their face:-) My drinks are always good from here.
Went to the summit mall Starbucks and Nika has the BEST customer service! She had a bright smile and so accommodating! Thank you !

Eh merry xmas first off.. it sucks this is the only Starbucks in this area. We come to this one when we are in town visiting family. Every time they seem to mess up our order. It's really not that hard I have huge issues with stores that can't do and make something so damn simple.
So we did a mobile order ... and our drinks were wrong but they were right on our order on the phone(I took a picture of our order). My iced coffee had no classic no vanilla just cream and coffee when tho the little sticker had the right order.. along with my husbands drink he had a cinnamon dolce no whip and literally it was all milk.. 
I get this store is busy and the only one but still follow simple instructions . it's not that difficult to make a drink when it tells you how they want it made.
Sucks because we will still have to continue coming to the Starbucks every time we come to town. I just hope their staff gets better and knows how to read and listen when it comes to making a drink.

People who worked there were very nice and made the drinks in a timely manner and they were also right on the money with them as well, which made it , soooo much better. Also there is so seating area in there.

The staff as a whole isn't bad but there's one rotten apple. Maybe 2 at this Starbucks. I'm new to the Starbucks world so it's pretty inconvenient when I don't know the name of an item and I'm confronted with an attitude by the cashier. Another incident with the same girl happened when I told her I wanted my cookie warmed and she turns around and throws my cookie in a frisbee motion into the warmer. She then take the cookie out and puts it with the mobile orders. Meanwhile I'm sitting there for ten minutes waiting for my cookie, running late for work. I ask her is it done, again with attitude she tells me "I been out that cookie over there." So now it's no longer warm. Fast forward. I come in a week later. She loudly tells her co worker she thought I was gay. I call corporate at this point, they've done nothing. I message them weeks later to see what's going on, they wrote back saying they didn't forget about me. This girl still runs the register. Just two days ago I go to buy a green tea lemonade with a co worker who's new to our site. She gets into an argument with him. She then says she's gonna get her brother to come up to the location for us but sends her giant son out to our table 30m later who tried to fight me on the side walk! I call corporate again. Still waiting for a reply and I've gotten nothing yet. Today this same girl takes a picture of my coworker while he sits on a bench at work. I'm guessing to send to whoever she getting to come up to the location. I feel as though I have to carry my firearm to work now because of a bad seed at a Starbucks. Starbucks obviously doesn't care about complaints. I've tried to do the right thing. But who knows! She may have already taken my picture! I don't know what's in stored for me. But I have a family I have to see everyday and night and I'm going to do what I have to to make sure I make it home. Starbucks should be ashamed of themselves for allowing a mother and son to work together and for them to have this kind of character behind their registers.
I work at the airport and they always get my coffee with coconut milk and large ice water ready for me when they see me in line!
The most fancy and beautiful Starbucks we've ever been to! The employees are fantastic and super friendly!!
Great stuff

I have to be honest! I am always a fan of Starbucks. Excellent location, great drinks and cafe snacks, but a little price-y,as all Starbucks are. I do favor this Starbucks over others I've seen in Tucson because it is so close to campus and has a wonderful outdoor seating and nearby fountain.

The coffee was fine but there is only one bathroom for a large cafe. I waited for about 15 min in a long line right nxt to where u pick up your coffee :/ when i finally went in the bathroom was a nightmare. It was covered in layers of grime. A toilet plunger lay on its side on the floor. There was blood on the floor and hair, lots and lots of hair like someone had trimmed their hair all over the sink. It smelled awful and i left nauseated n wouldn't even touch the sink to wash my hands. 4$ for a drink= clean the bathroom!!!

I have been to this location to meet a friend for coffee and every time I go my caramel macchiato tastes so bland. I'm not sure what they are doing wrong but it's not right. My usual Starbucks is the location in the Target in Bridgeton ( they know how to make any drink amazing). I wish this location would do better, as it's more convenient to go through the drive through. Also they do not give receipts at the drive through. . Other than that customer service is good, it's literally how they are making every drink I have ever had from there.

I frequently go to this location and never have an issue. As a matter of fact today I went there twice. The first time was great and I was even offered to try coconut in my iced my coffee by the barista. However, upon returning later in the day for my refill, the barista named Aurea was fulfilling my order over the drive thru. She had a sarcastic and condescending tone over the drive thru and while I was asking my girlfriend how she wanted her coffee, Aurea rudely asked 'excuse me, what did you want in it?'  I understand people have long days and she may have even had a rough customer right before me for all I know, but that has nothing to do with me and my experience. I just wish she had 'reset' herself before taking my order. Because of her attitude and demeanor, I was coerced into this review and I think that says enough.
So, BNA is a great airport, this Starbucks was slow in service and a bit grumpy first thing the morning.

This is the only starbuck's I will go to in the area. I work in a coffee shop for I'm normally very snub about starbucks! It never about the drinks for me but about the service. Some starbuck's I have been to they treat me like I'm an idiot and I don't know what I'm talking about.
"I would like a medium coffee"
"Well which medium, we have two medium sizes Grande and Venti."
"The one in the middle".......=/ 
THIS starbucks on the other hand has great workers behind the counter. They are constantly running back and forth doing their job and helping customers. They are always very friendly and helpful.  The milk cart is always very clean when I go in =] which makes me very happy. If it is not it's normally because they are VERY busy, which is understandable. I never use the drive-threw because I feel like I will miss out of the customer-employee interaction which is the only reason why I go here!
I had knee surgery and my boyfriend went here to get me coffee and whoever was working asked where I was because normally it's either me or both of us that go in together, and he told them I was shacked up with a cast on. So when he arrived back home with my beverage they wrote "Get well soon!" with a smiley face on my cup and it was something so little, but it made me smile. 
I normally get two shots of espresso over ice in a GRANDE...cup...haha and add two splendas with milk or a vanilla latte and it always comes out great =]. My boyfriend loves their skim iced chais.

Slow service, not awful but could use some speeding up. And they need one person strictly dedicated to cleanup, restocking condiments/sweeping/ trashcans. The place was pretty dirty, even behind the counter. 
 On the bright side the coffee was good.
It serves its purpose: caffeine served without delay. space for people watching. space for working on your laptop. a bit fishbowl-like because of all the windows and it being located on a corner.

Love Starbucks and this location. Everyone is really nice and I love sitting here for hours studying. My only gripe is the drive thru. It's completely hidden so you can see the line before you pull in. Once you're in, even before you order, you're stuck, which is annoying when you're running late. It needs to be redesigned to allow people to get in and out in the event of an emergency or if you charge your mind, especially since there's usually a long wait.

This is a good place to stop by and get your FREE Wifi work done, the staff is always friendly as they are in every starbucks place I've ever been to,

I recommend the Iced Green Tea, with Vanilla syrup, but ask for it with no water, they put plenty of ice and it will be so good and refreshing!

Give it a try!

This is my favorite location to go to. It's a little crowded at times and pretty much always has a steady flow of customers. So if you are wanting solitude to accomplish some work this might not be the best place. I don't mind the noise though and the staff is gracious and quick with their work.

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever frequented. On average it takes 15mins to receive your order. The preparation of the drinks are inconsistent. You can order the same drink everyday & get a different drink. They do not respect people with allergies. The manager took my order and not properly ring it up or prepare it. They staff except for  two individuals have poor customer service skills and are rude.
Great mall and great coffee. However, my credit card number was stolen here. Buyers beware!!!

Coffee is coffee right?-so this location has that hands down. The employees seem disgruntle.. I understand this location is fast paced and you may not always want to smile, but you should!! Standing in front of one employee for at least two minutes only for her to not even look up at me but say "she can help you over there" is poor customer service. To have someone wait 10-15 minutes for a coffee and not even be greeted is the bare minimum this location should give. The lady who waited on me was stone faced and transactional ... didn't even offer me a receipt, only, "you can wait at the end for your coffee". Well thank you for putting my order in, and allowing me to pay 6$.... I guess good customer service just does not exist anymore.

I have to say WOW! Andres (rose gold hair) is ABSOLUTELY AMAZING. I visit here often. Probably twice or three times a week. I usually am lucky enough to have Andres at drive thru window and he just has the brightest personality and can turn a terrible day into the best day! Makes my drinks the best and has never messed up any order of mine. He's so friendly every time I stop by. He's truly one of the reasons I continue to come to this location.

I'm a Starbucks fan and if I see one I all of a sudden they thirsty. 

This store has got to be the best and fastest service I have ever received. I was in and out in less than 5 min. The employees were very genuinely nice and all smiles. Other Starbucks I've been to ESP inside Target or the mall, they will take my order then while I wait I sometimes over hear their inappropriate personal conversations. It's not the biggest Starbucks store and was occupied with many people with laptops, and I see why.  So professional here, there's plenty of Starbucks but I will def be returning to this location when I do my weekend shopping.

Not the greatest service at this location, particularly in the drive through.  I just went through the drive through, and the cashier not only got my order wrong, she then gave me change for a $20 instead of the $50 I had given her. When I pointed that out and in a nice way asked for the rest of my change, she had attitude with me.  She then gave me $5 too much change.  As I hesitated for a few moments before driving away so I could double check the amount and give her back the extra, she opened the window and quite rudely asked twice "what do you need now?"   I should have just said "nothing" and let her discover her mistake the hard way, but I didn't and still gave it back to her.  Unfortunately, this is not my first such experience at this location.
Good spot. I knock out my school work here on the weekends while downing espressos. Hard to beat it!

Best Starbucks in New Orleans! I come here frequently, and not only do the staff members remember my name, they remember my drink order. (I'm boring and get the same thing every time) They are also the only shop in New Orleans that doesn't burn their espresso either.

Today I went into the Starbucks on terry pkwy before going into work and I ordered something simple; tall coffee with milk and vanilla. The coffee sucked and I just don't understand how you can mess up such a simple order. I also felt like the woman at the register was kind of rude. I'm really disappointed because I hold such high standards for the Starbucks franchise in general and the fact that my neighborhood location can not live up to those standards is really disappointing. I feel like the headquarters would be really disappointed as well.

A Starbucks off the 3401 Walnut building. Lots of staff members, and a small upstairs with more seating where you can study in a slightly more comfortable space. The baristas here aren't the friendliest, but I've never gotten the wrong drink yet. Place is not particularly handicapped-friendly unless you use the main entry and sit at the bottom floor. No way to get upstairs.

Bathroom is a bit dirty, though.

This review starts out at an unlikely place - Panera. Popped in there for lunch. My girlfriend just moved in so we are without wifi until Friday and I figured I would eat and cruise the web.

Had lunch and a coffee that was fair. At least until they kicked me off the internet after only ONE HOUR!

Never in all the years I have gone to coffee shops/sandwich shops that offer free internet was I KICKED OFF because you only get one hour of surfing! Are you kidding me????? First of all, I purchased lunch AND coffee. Secondly, the place easily had 35-40% open tables. 

I decided to go one block away to the Starbucks. Yea, thats right. Starbucks is one block away on 1081 West Chester Pike in West Chester, PA 19382. Got a nice snack pack of fruit and cheese. Was greeted by the very awesome Kim who assured me they love my business and would NEVER kick me off the internet unless it wasn't working. Had a bottle of water. 

Never again Panera. Hello Starbucks! They won me over!

I was pretty disappointed to find out that this Starbucks is closed all summer after advertising that it would be open all summer online. You have to actually go down to the store to find out that it's closed over summer. They need to update the hours for the summer stating that it's closed as well as the signage around campus saying that it's closed..
Slow service. Inconvenient. Nowhere near the quality of a stand alone store.

People come to get coffee, and many come to work (largely online) while drinking coffee. Your internet cannot be that slow. You're a gigantic corporation, so you have the money to boost it and remove the router from the area where the bank vault used to be. It is impossible to work here.
Brand new building in my neck of the woods! Staff was super friendly and upbeat. Probably one of the most enjoyable experiences I've had at a Starbucks!

The parking lot is awful here... so that kinda makes things problematic to begin with. The drive-through line blocks half the parking and the rest is simply confusing as to how the heck you're supposed to get to it.

I've never had a major problem with the service or coffee- it's typical Starbucks stuff. The interior decor and layout is fine- they also have a little outdoor patio, but it faces the highway and drive-thru line, so it's not exceptionally pleasant. Free wi-fi, so that's a good thing, I guess.

Honestly, we do go here every once in a while simply because it is close to my parents' house and convenient when we're headed over there (sometimes you just have to leave the munchkin with the grandma for an hour and go get a cup of coffee and decompress- especially when you're around said munchkin 24/7). We typically go at odd times- like 1 pm or such- I would never try to go here during morning or afternoon rush hours- I'd make the extra trip down to Manhattan or just go elsewhere. 
It's fine if you need a Starbucks fix midday when the parking lot is near empty...
Product and employees are great but the drive thru has to be the slowest in the country.  You are lucky if you get through it in less then 10 min.

I do not live in Tucson but commute here once a week and this Statbucks is a great place to get work done. The staff are friendly, attentive, and quick! The latte's are not burned, plenty of outlets, and fast Wifi. Quite a bit of space and some secluded spots if you want to get out of the hustle and bustle of an active cafe. I highly recommend their new Blonde espresso, it adds to the flavor of my vanilla latte quite well. Also, lots of parking and it has a drive-thru.

This is by far the worst Starbucks ever.... and its not all the employees that make the experience awful, but the one girl they have working almost every Sunday is SO completely rude to the customers AND her employees she works with.... it is absolutely ridiculous. Her name is Cassidy and I made it a point to look at her name tag today when I ordered my drinks. She belittles the people she works with right in front of my boyfriend and I as we were ordered our usual drinks and this has not been the first time! It is everyyyyyy time!! I apologize to the person at the register for HER behavior because they are the ones who have to work with her..and they ALL just look at me with a sad but shitty look as if they feel sorry for themselves as well.. i cannot blame them for that. Every single employee there is very very nice EXCEPT for her... I would much rather bring my business elsewhere and boycott this Starbucks in International mall until they get rid of this bitter, unenthusiastic, rude employee because she is giving Starbucks an AWFUL look.. especially if you are a first time customer!

I was at the mall yesterday and asked for a simple drink an iced matcha latte with almond milk. After waiting 10 minutes to order I waited another 10 minutes for my drink I finally saw the barista prep my drink. She poured the almond milk, added ice, and then scoops of the matcha powder. I was expecting her to use the shaker as the power gets clumpy when wet but she simply put a dome lid on the cup, gave it a quick swirl without stirring it and recapped with a flat lid. I took a sip and couldn't even drink it until I returned home where I had to transfer to a cocktail shaker to properly mix the drink.

Its Starbucks! Need I say more. There is just something in their coffee- it's flavorful and addictive! 

They have so many delicious coffee drinks that you can customize in every which way, its no wonder there is always a line! For the many that need that caffeine fix, this place has it all- coffee, dark roast, light roast, espresso, tea, chocolate! Lattes, frappuccinos, macchiatos. And the flavors abound- caramel, mocha, vanilla, cinnamon, chai. Get it hot, iced, frozen, and with milk, soy milk, almond milk, or coconut milk! 

Of all the Starbucks in my area though, in my experience, this location has the best and worst drive-thru service. The best because they are fast and accurate- there is always a line, so that's pretty great that your order is always right. Its the worst at the same time because the drive-thru attendants seem unhappy and annoyed with taking your order... but again, there is ALWAYS a line, so....

Overall you cannot go wrong with their drinks. This Starbucks is a great go-to for that invigorating venti iced coffee, that comforting grande vanilla latte, or that refreshing Teavana iced tea!

This is one of the Starbucks that makes you sooooooo glad you can now order from the app! The people are normal customer service workers.. Over worked, short staffed and under paid in sure as it shows in their work. This is not one of the fun hang out happy people Starbucks. 

The building is nice, the lay out seems backward and causes a lot of congestion. And there for some unholy reason is always a line out the door! I have never walked out of a star bucks before getting coffee, the source of my life.. But I have here. It's just not worth the wait... They take forever!

Coffee is coffee.. But if you go here order from the app it's going to still take a while.. But it's less than waiting in that line!

Super busy location right next to CHOP and HUP. Often packed between shifts at both hospitals, so be prepared to wait 5-15 minutes. A few times, I have bypassed this location based on the snaking line inside and nearly outside. When I have ordered, the coffee-based drinks and offerings are pretty much on par with other Starbucks locations. With such high-traffic, the cleanliness of this store suffers as well. Not sure how the employees can really address this. They have seemed super busy when I have been there. I think most people who go here love Starbucks products and are willing to put up with the lines and lack of cleanliness around the store. As a plus, sells the Starbucks Reserve brand coffee.

Lots of seating, great upstairs area for studying and hanging out. Could be a little cleaner - there were some flies in the dining area. Smack in the middle of University City, this location is usually full of students.

Every morning I get a Venti Vanilla Latte and one out of  three times it doesn't have any Vanilla in it.  When they make it right I enjoy it and have a pleasant experience at this location.  But I'm done getting up early to spend $4.95 on an undrinkable beverage before work.

I am going to parrot the other reviews.  The staff was puzzled, busy and irritated about it all.  I got my order correct so I am happy for that.  I received my drinks very fast, as I should have because it was fairly slow for them.  Though I noticed the same car in the drive up screen for quite a long time, and was still in line after we left.  Maybe drive thru isn't their thing?   Compared to the other Starbucks locally its below par. 

The actual location was spacious and clean.  Behind the counter things look disheveled and lots of exposed wiring and knocked over wall equipment that exposed older paint jobs.  The parking lot is still a huge mess.  In its previous forms as a bank it was a horrible layout.

Come optimistic but come inside
Seriously slow!!!  By far the slowest Starbucks I've been too.  And it's 11am...not what I'd think of as peak hours.  And a "couldn't care less" attitude from the girl who gave me my drink.
I felt the latte was quite lighter than normal. After going home I opened the lift and found only TALL size latte in da GRANDE cup!!
