Don't get me wrong, I'm a huge Starbucks fan but this is the worst one in the area.  I will drive out of my way to go to any of the other ones. Why do I loathe this one?  Because the last thing I want to see anyone do while serving me is BULLPICK their nose!  AND my usual caramel iced coffee just did not taste like it normally does.

Absolutely the best Starbucks I have ever been to in my life. The friendliest and cleverest staff on the face of the earth. My drink (a very complicated misto with three flavors and velvety soy foam) has never been wrong. 
If you have a choice between here and wawa, it's worth the extra dollar and the slightly higher caffeine content. I run into someone I know from the neighborhood most times I come in, and even people I don't know are friendly company when waiting for my beverage. 
Great place to feel welcome. Some of the staff veterans remembered me years between visits.
Is a very small-busy coffee shop, but has a large seating-working area.  Very well located inside the mall.  Excellent service and always great selections!

For me, the perfect location on way into the University, with early-opening hours that fit my schedule well. Wifi is great; the place is bustling but still a good place to work. I like the large communal table. I find staff to be efficient, if not overly warm.  This location (sadly) benefited from the closing of the very-popular Ike's Coffee down the street, but staff do a great job keeping the line moving. They have a Clover machine; I tried the product once and the product was excellent. They're now applying for a liquor license.  Liquor doesn't seem what a Starbucks is all about, I'll be curious to see how it affects the character of the place.  I ding them a star only because interactions of the seemingly-ever-changing staff with customers is a bit stilted. The staff's friendliness seems disingenuous, as if derived more from a directive in the employee handbook than a genuine appreciation of their customers.
Just LOVED this Starbucks! This is a reserve store which completely made my day! Lots of great options to choose from! This is one of the most unique Starbucks I have been too- I loved the décor!
Avoid at all costs. Your drink will take 20 minutes to receive. Go to e-bar or a coffee spot outside the mall.
From opening day, the staff who work the drive thru at the Hockessin Starbucks have exceeded the typical standards of excellence and continue to provide fast and friendly service at every encounter.

This was my go-to Starbucks when I was in New Orleans recently for a business trip. The first thing I noticed was the cool, local theme that the place was decorated in. It looked a bit old timey, kind of like an old store and hanging from the ceiling were musical instruments. I really liked this. This is a pretty busy Starbucks due to its location on Canal St., close to the French Quarter. The line moves quick, though. On my last day, they were out of almond and soy milk so not sure if they didn't get a shipment or what. They did make it up to me by giving me a very, very large chai latte since my only choice was 2% milk.
Drive thru is always busy, so going inside makes it a bit easier. However, I must say for a busy drive thru each experience I've had on a weekend morning, the baristas were kind and personable.

One of my favorite Starbucks locations, especially since the fantastic remodel this past Fall. Very easy-going and useful layout, great options for mobile devices and laptops (Goggle WiFi), and very friendly staff. BTW, I rarely give 5 stars for reviews - this store does everything right!

Very comfortable atmosphere and great place .....  you know how Starbucks is 
You can't go wrong with them
If you get a drink you don't like they will remake you another one
They have patio tables and chairs too

I come here every morning. I would say 4/5 days a week I'm waiting around for my order which I place when I leave my apt. Which is ten minutes away giving them plenty of time. I don't mind waiting a couple minutes I know it's busy but waiting 15-20 for a breakfast sandwich they pop in an oven for two min and a coffee is redic. Recently, on two different occasions, they said someone took my order by mistake. Some of the girls are really good consistently make my drink well and are quick. The shorter one is so slow it's painful to watch. This morning I waited 20 min which is the reason for the review

I work within walking distance from this Starbucks and I am thankful for that because this is my favorite location in the area. This is the most consistent Starbucks I've ever encountered. I like to get different things but occasionally fall back on some of my favorites and it's always super fresh and made to perfection. They are also VERY fast here idk if that has anything to do with them having a drive-thru which pushes them? All I know is it's crazy how quick they are. And finally the employees are always very pleasant. I had one time where they were just kinda like "meh" employees lol. But in particularly there is one guy (not sure on a name) that is just exceptionally friendly and makes me love this location even more. Keep up the good work!

This is my favorite Starbucks in Center City.  Service is fast and friendly.  I don't go to Starbucks more than twice a month, and the cashier in the mornings still remembers my name and my order.  I'm always very impressed with her recollection.  

Occasionally, they run out of spinach and feta breakfast wraps, so get there early to make sure you get the food you want.

I heart EVERYTHING about this Starbucks. From the location (perfect for lookey-lous) to the friendly staff to the quick drink processing - to the busyness to the hustle & bustle of it all. 

They handle the load with finesse, grace & class. Due to the location of this Starbucks, I'm surprised it's not a 24-hr store, or is it??? I'm sure in NYC there's a 24-hr starbucks or even Cali. Anywho, I digress; but yeah back to this location...

My hope is that once you make it here to this location, that you're not dismayed by the parking situation. It can be a bit overwhelming, but the treats that await you inside promise not to disappoint. 

#WindowseatsaretheBEST

The drinks here are pretty typical of any Starbucks location and the staff here do a good job of working in cramped quarters and getting those drinks out in an expedient fashion....

So why only 3 stars you ask? The size and setup of the store is absolutely painful. It's kind of like a long aisle at a grocery store but not as wide making it incredibly difficult to move past other customers. There is also only two tables inside to sit at meaning if it's way too hot out or really cold you can not take advantage of their outdoor seating and are stuck walking around the mall with your drink or sitting on a bench somewhere.

I am pretty surprised that Starbucks would opt for such a small awkwardly shaped space in a premium mall like Southgate where they likely draw lots of revenue. Overall it's not bad but I like Bear Mountain way better when I shopping in Southgate and craving a beverage.
Huge. Convenient. Reliable. Friendly staff. No complaints.

I'm a gold card member and I absolutely love Starbucks. I live in California and was visiting family for Christmas when I went to get some coffee from this store. The service was fast which was the only good thing about the service today.. unfortunately today is the day after Christmas and it seems the employees are all in bad moods and it's coming across very rude.

Staff is unenthused to the point of appearing beat down. Maybe it's the night crew or maybe they shouldn't be open till midnight if they are already prepared for closing at 10:00. Who knows, maybe all those things, maybe not. One certainty is that the experience here is forgettable.  The conversations had by the staff, not so forgettable. Especially if you are sitting upstairs directly above the chatter.

Slow slow slow!!! Waited in my car for 10 min and I didn't get to make my order. Then I gave up. If it takes more than 10 min to make an order it will take another 10+ minutes just to get a cup of coffee. So pathetic !

Hands down the best looking Starbucks so far! The store totally exposes it's city's jazz scene with trumpets hanging on the ceiling, musical notes on the walls, music, etc. This location has a huge seating area as well so it's great for people!
It's in a mall but we never could find it!  Called and called and called yet THEY NEVET ANSWERED the phone!  Really poor!
New Starbucks on the block! Always packed with Penn students and their macbooks. Has a plenty of food options. Great service.

This Starbucks location is very hit or miss for me lately.  As mainly a drive-thru patron, I do get somewhat frustrated with the amount of time it takes to expedite orders.  However, the most frustrating aspect of my experience is not getting the orders correct and/or having a non-chalant "fast food" type of attitude from the order-taker through the exchange at the window.

Imo, things started going downhill around a 2 years after opening.  It appears that the great quality baristas left, and were replaced with typical fast food employees.  Let me make clear, however, not all of my experiences have been bad.  Like I stated in the beginning, it's very hit or miss.

I just hope that the franchisee has not gotten arrogant by having a cash cow location, because nothing lasts forever.  I'm sure that the new DD down the street is taking some market share.  As a gold frequent drinker member, I hope they improve their consistency and customer interaction before a CC's or PJ's gets built down the street, and they lose many loyal customers' business (including mine) forever.
Love Starbucks, wasn't impressed with my pumpkin spice latte today. I took one drink and got straight up grounds, won't be back to this location

I came here to pick up a order that I made online but when I got there there was nothing waiting for me. the absolutely amazing barista asked me what I ordered and instead of sending me away to the other location I actually ordered, she fulfilled the order and I'm very appreciative!! Thank you so much!! Now I am on time. Thank goodness because I accidentally ordered at a location 20 min out of my way.

I've quite honestly experienced better service at other Starbucks locations. That said, I really do appreciate the fact that I can use my Starbucks Gold card (or app) here just like at any other Starbucks location. This location isn't one where you would be likely to sit and enjoy your beverage: instead you are expected to buy one and go elsewhere to enjoy it. On my most recent visit, the staff member serving me didn't understand what I wanted until I rephrased it twice and even after I answered her questions she provided me a slightly different product than what I requested (which really wasn't a problem but it was rather odd). I do appreciate having access to Starbucks in this location but I wish the service were better, especially when it is summer and not very busy, and that there were more of a seating area available.

This is the best Starbucks in America. You will be hard pressed to find one that is more elaborate than this one. Its so good its hard to put into words, its an experience. If you come here to visit or you live here you must come see this place. In a city that known for neglecting chains, Starbucks has set the mold on what you need to do to compete in the New Orleans market if you are a change. This place is unbelievable.

I love it when I come to a Starbucks and everyone knows everyone! Makes the town seem so friendly and nice which it is but it just gives it that Homie environment. 

  Time to come here with a friend just to do coffee and talk and they're really sweet!  

They messed up my order one but were really Kind in fixing it with no issues!!!

I've recently become a pretty frequent Starbucks customer, and as far as locations near and convenient for me this one is my favorite!!! The staff is always happy, friendly, and incredibly nice!! I've not had a single bad customer service experience yet. My coffee is always ready within a minute or two and I'm never waiting long so even if I'm running a little behind I STILL have time to get my coffee, it's awesome! And everything is always delicious, especially compared to all other Starbucks locations in the area.

This was a wonderful Starbucks. First of all, it is very large. The service rivals any that I've been to around the country.

I was absolutely taken by the way they decorated it. As one would expect, the decor is very much New Orleans - lots music and jazz related items. Great fixtures and chandeliers, and a terrific mural that depicts the French Quarter.

Starbucks did a great job with this one. Our group spend some time sitting there, enjoying our coffee and the surroundings.
The staff here is so friendly and remembers my name and my order and allergies! They've only been open a short time but are striving to be the best!

Good coffee , bad coffee they have their day . Some days they make them good and some day they make them bad . It all depends on who's making them . But overall , I've never had a bad experience here . I've been a loyal customer so they know me well . They always greet me and my boyfriend and asking how we're doing. I come to this location often because it's the closest one to home .

I've given this Starbucks multiple opportunities to redeem itself, and it has yet to do so. While the location is impeccable, products are inconsistent. 

As someone who has been a barista, i can see drinks being made incorrectly. The staff as a whole is rude (a couple exceptions, but not enough to persuade me to go back). 

The nail in the coffin was asking for a skinny drink, receiving a full fat/full sugar drink, and the barista wanted to argue about what i had asked for. 

I get that this is a busy location, and i can overlook the occasional issue, but this location is consistently inconsistent.
I love the drive thru option

I'm not impressed. The coffee is acidic, and the baked goods are dry, bland, and often stale.
Just not worth the money at all.

I wanted to poke my eyes out after waiting so long here. What I thought would be an easy 10 minute in and out visit, took close to 25 minutes waiting in lines. The drink was fine, but the staff was so slow. I could tell they just gave up even trying to hustle and leisurely took their time making drinks. With a half hearted yell to the crowded drink pick up area, they didn't seem to care who they were servicing.

The customer service here surpasses any Starbucks I've ever been to. The baristas were friendly and addressed me by my name and my drink was out in record time. The facilities were super clean as well as the rest of the cafe area. Wonderful, I will be returning.

Beautiful location, friendly baristas, and quality coffee. What's not to love? Baristas handle the often large crowds pretty well and very professionally. I know I'm impressed! PS. I'm totally crushing on that cute blonde barista with tattoos.

I love Starbucks and have been drinking their coffee for years (gold member). However, this particular location constantly disappoints me. The employees do not look happy and do not serve with a smile. The beverages are diluted with milk and syrup. I will never go back. Please make some changes.

Just went through the drive thru, and it was awful.  I ordered an Iced Americano and a breakfast sandwich. The lady who took my order, Kim, screwed it up completely, which is tough to do with an Iced Americano.  I was halfway home when I took a sip and realized they messed it up, so I had to turn around.  I suppose that's on me, but again, an Iced Americano should be pretty easy (if you're not visibly hungover, that is).  So I go back, and the lady at the bar made it for me again.  Still not right, but at this point I'm pretty frustrated and my sandwich is cold, so I accept the drink and leave.  I'm pretty sure if I complained again that my drink would come with a side order of saliva and mucus.  Normally I go to the one at Franklin Mills, where the girl Brittany gets it right with a smile EVERY TIME.  Now, when it comes to coffee, perfection is not to be expected UNTIL you charge almost 5 dollars for a singular drink.  At those prices, you had better get it right.

Meh, indeed .. 

The starbucks on the UofA campus is a disappointing experience.  It's not meant to be a place where people sit and drink coffee, like a regular starbucks joint.  But that doesn't particularly bother me.  It's the quality of coffee served there, is what I'm complaining about.

Working in the neighboring building, I have probably stopped here for a coffee, maybe 50 times and have been disappointed, maybe 35-40 times.  For some reason, the staff (invariably students at the university) don't know how to operate an espresso machine!  The cafe lattés taste like latté (the italian word latte means milk).  The cappucinos are invariably cold and generally, the service is quite poor with a big mess in the collection area and people's drinks always mixed up and confused. 

It's really like a big production movie with poor acting.  Disappointing indeed.  I guess if you were getting just a regular cup of coffee (drip coffee, i mean) .. you shouldn't be too disappointed because it's easier to stay within the norms and specifications that starbucks insist on, when loading the drip (for those who don't know, for the entire height of the drip machine, a predefined packet of coffee is used to load the top).  But apart from the drip - it's just a desperate option to go to.
They had 3 reserves (1 from Cameroon, 2 from Ethiopia). Didn't see reserves at any other Starbucks in area. Also spacious and friendly employees (thanks Joseph).
Ordered a small and they gave my friend the venti. Don't they know small=tall? They rhyme. White chocolate mocha was too sweet.

This location in the Lowes parking lot on Ina Road, is my back up Starbucks. I don't know if there are grades of Starbucks stores, but this one is on the lighter side of merchandise and food goods. It reminds me of the Starbucks in the airport. Not a welcoming seating arrangement or interior atmosphere compared to the Starbucks on Arizona Pavilions,the Foothills Mall or the location off La Canada ( outside Foothills mall). Services is always fine but I don't think above average. It seems primarily geared towards drive through business, which is the majority of my patronage. Starbucks now offers coconut milk as an alternative option to soy or cow milk. I must say after two mochas with coconut milk, I'm in LOVE!

Look, I typically steer clear of Starbucks when there are local options available, but I spent about a month going to this one when my coffee grinder broke...and i LIKE it-- A LOT!
 the employees here are much more down to earth compared to the Starbucks by my house. they remembered me shortly after I started frequenting this location and their conversation is pretty genuine. I also felt like they burn their coffee less at this location...or is that my imagination? 
 but the *NUMBER ONE REASON* i feel compelled to write a 5 star review for this location at Speedway and Country Club is the fact that they RECYCLE! as explained to me by one of the baristas, recycling is not a corporate mandate at Starbucks, rather it is a choice made by each individual franchise. with all the plastic milk jugs and packaging that they receive supplies in, starbucks generates an insane amount of recyclable plastic waste that quite often goes into landfills. not here! if you are going to buy a triple-double soy mocha chocha blended whatsit (or just a good ol' 'cuppa), you should support this particular Starbucks, one of the few in town that recycles.

I know it's really busy at this particular location but the cashier was extremely rude and my drink was... half full....... what.

Even if it gets busy please don't show that to your customers.

I waited over 10 minutes in the drive thru today and had to leave because I was going to end up being late to work. It's always the longest wait.... If you can't operate a drive thru effectively, you shouldn't have one. So frustrating. There were still 2 cars in front of me too. The girl who took my order was very short and rude. Weird for 3oclock in the afternoon....

Is there any point in reviewing Starbucks?  It's all the same; which is not necessarily a bad thing.  It's just the same (unless you go to a real terribly maintained one).

They make a good latte.  There's nothing spectacular about it.

This is one of the best SBUX around, and it absolutely comes down to the management.  I spent several months, regularly going to the one over by the Mont Mall, but the place was consistently dirty and the staff was pretty ridiculous (read - immature, loud, and...just didn't allow for a great work environment).  I am not going to give my full opinion of that store (I know they have a new building - sadly, the people will be the same), but I have to mention that one in comparison because it is so close to this one.

As I sit here, working, the store manager is sitting at a nearby table LEADING a couple of new employees.  She knows how to do it.  She's professional and her employees exude that. She takes the time to really teach her employees how to be great at their jobs, and I absolutely think the success of this particular store is because she's awesome.  The store is clean. The bathrooms are usually clean - even smell decent.  The trash is rarely overflowing.  

I took one star off simply because I'm amazed that none of them seem to recognize me (let alone remember my name) even though I am in there most days, making at least two separate purchases each time.  That just seems odd to me.  But, hey, I guess I don't make much of an impression. It's also not the fastest service, but, again...faster than the other SBUX down the road.

Enjoying a nice pick me up.

Starbucks speaks for itself. Customer service is impeccable. My greentea frap is yummy. Great parking spot and super clean. 5 stars all the way. Just wish the prices go down.

Typical Starbucks. Fast and efficient employees. Good amount of seating and my drink (Trenta strawberry Açai refresher with light ice) came out perfect. Even though there were a lot of drinks before mine I don't think I waited more than two or three minutes. Overall I left satisfied :)

Love Starbucks coffee and their service. Even more so as this one is in our back yard just about! Their staff is very friendly and are willing to help out if you are not sure what you want at that time. 

    My only issue with this one is that they are a bit slow at getting your coffee and getting you on their merry way. If they stepped it up this would be an easy 4-5 star place. Just be cautious if you're on a short time limit!

The experience you have at this Starbucks really depends on what time of the day you go. There are typically teenagers working there later in the afternoon and at night, some who are great, but others who apathetically take over 10 minutes to make your coffee while talking. My coffee usually tastes better and is made quicker when I go here in the morning or early afternoon. 

Despite these few lesser quality experiences, it's hard to complain when you've got a cup of Starbucks in your hand. :)

Stop by this Starbucks to get the new zombie Frappuccino before we went costume shopping. I know that this is a novelty drink that only around for about 5 days what my son was expecting and what we received
was quite a disappointment. The beverage was double cupped because it was running over and the lid didn't quite fit was very messy got all over the car. It didn't taste very good I'm glad that it will only be around for a short time I know we won't be buying that again! The girl who was working the drive-thru did let me know that it was running over and to be careful not to spill it on myself. Would have been nice to have it put in another cup since it didn't look like the zombie drink to begin with. BIG DISAPPOINTMENT!!!-

For a new one in town it seems like a nice place to relax and have a moment.
I'm not a big bucks fan but I think I can become a regular here.
Nice location and easy access. From my first visit this seems like a customer oriented team which is nice.
Looking forward for some Ice coffees in the next few months.

I won't be going back, there's an older women w blonde hair and bangs who was not so very nice. I noticed her greet everyone nicely at the register, when it was my turn she wasn't friendly. Instead I got an up and down look as if I was wearing something she didn't like (Im in a tshirt and jeans) but I am tattooed. Then she had to correct me on the proper name of a drink even though she clearly understood me and repeated exactly what I called it anyway. My drink was over filled w ice, and my cream cheese was not cold, almost like it had been sitting out.

Great location! The employees are very nice and they work fast. This location gets pretty busy, but I've never had any problems. As some of the other reviewers pointed out, parking can be a challenge due to its location in the shopping center, and yes, there are insects outside (people, we live in the desert!), but that has nothing to do with this Starbucks in and of itself.
Slow "baristas" and for the price you pay for coffee, really disappointing to have burnt coffee taste , getting our morning coffee elsewhere from now on

your review helps others learn about great local businesses.

please don't review this business if you received a freebie for writing this review, or if you're connected in any way to the owner or employees.just



just had another unsatisfactory wait at irvington.......two unfriedly  barristas........the woman ahead of me waited forever for a knife to cut her sandwich in half! i am sure it was cold by the time it arrived!!!! why is it some starbucks will cut things in half and others won't?

The company through this location and have great customer service ! Coffee is always hot and made just right. They have a lot of space for doing work hosting small meetings in there too.

When you pull up the parking right out front says for loading only. If youre just running in and out put your flashers on and run inside.

I like this Starbucks because there's always great seating available and therefore perfect for getting work done. A plus is that there is also a lot of seating outside as well. 

Wifi works well, and food and drinks are standard per other Starbucks. 

Staff is kind and parking is always available and easy.

I was very excited when this new Starbucks (with a drive through!) opened up.  I still have high hopes for this place, but I've had a few issues with the service that I have not experienced at other locations, which makes me think it is a training issue.  I've been given the wrong amount of change, my order has been forgotten and I have been given the wrong order.

If you like Starbucks drinks then there is no issues since they almost always take the same no matter the location. 

This location is smaller but has excellent use of space. 
The staff is extremely helpful. 
I find the wifi to not be very good here but that is the only downside. 

Also usually very crowded

I was running late this morning and decided to use the mobile order feature on my Starbucks App (Great feature!). I use this app often but this morning I selected the wrong Starbucks (my fault). The barista's where great, without hesitation they made my order and had me out the door in a few minutes without charging me. I really appreciate there attention to customer service!

This Starbucks is conveniently located under my office. The elevators always smell like burnt coffee, but that's a small price to pay. The baristas are amazingly friendly, and they tend to keep the long lines flowing during busy times (unless they're training someone new, and that's not all that often). In about 3 years, there have been a few times when they messed up my order, which I only really care about when they don't use soy milk (lactarded=me). For the convenience and yummy soy chais, 4 stars.

Coffee culture used to be so much simpler. I like the phrase "redhotsteamin'cupOjoe'. I almost never use it, but I like it. Starbucks are fascinating. I'm not talking about the millions of variations of water run through the dried ground seeds of the ubiquitous Rubiaceae family of plants. I'm talking about the subtle variations how people move in and out of every Sarbucks in every city. The navigation of the que, where one stands or sits to wait for brew, how staff and regulars accommodate non-regular interlopers like I often am. Ok,,, maybe its not that fascinating. 

Anyway, I appreciated this smallish Starbucks in the center of Philly. They moved people in and out real well and still we found a place to camp for an hour or so in front of a momentous meeting - sort of reminded me of the hallway scene in Pulp Fiction. Go figure...

Not only is the service rude but the mobile orders only work every other day.  Never a hello, never a thank you, never a sorry for not making an order.
A couple of gentlemen in the afternoon shifts are friendly but not enough to support the rest of the team. Most of the staff just speak and laugh with each other but as soon as they interact with you, there is no eye contact and no smile. I work across the street so this is unfortunately my closest store. It feels as if we just interrupt them.
Waited a good five minutes just to get an iced coffee. Baristas seemed irritable and were rude to customers. Not a good Starbucks experience will not be going back
I normally don't write reviews but I've had a great experience at this Starbucks. The staff here are friendly as well as professional.

This is THE WORST Starbucks I've ever ordered from.  I was unable to choose zero stars. I ordered a tall cup with ice as I ALWAYS have for years and I was charged for the cup the ice and I was told if I added a certain amount of half and half or milk I had to pay for that before hand. 

The barista taking the order was rude while another barista stood in the corner talking to him and eating instead of helping to take orders from the 17 person line that suddenly formed.  The young woman filling the orders had such a bad attitude moved very slowly and looked as if she was going to commit suicide any day.  

I asked for a little milk and she asked me if I paid for it!!!!  This is a horrible Starbucks they need to fire everyone there and start over...  Maybe even tear down the kiosk and relocate it... this is my 3rd sad experience there and I will be making sure I get my coffee before I go to the mall...  THUMBS DOWN I was also over charged... I'll definitely be calling customer service on Monday. Here's a tip if you don't like working with people then don't work in customer service

Hands down best Starbucks in the US. Cozy, warm and the baristas are always on point. I admire them because I've sat in here for hours and this place is always hopping, and they can keep up with smiles on their faces!
Bathrooms could be a little bit more cleaner, but this Starbucks is gorgeous inside! Cute barista there too ;)
I never can understand why they can't make the drink right (that I pay more than $5 for) and when you ask them to fix it , they act like It's my fault they made it incorrect.

Pretty appalling. 
Apparently, although I've successful picked up mobile orders from probably 50 different Starbucks locations, THIS location wants you to go inside to get your order.
Bizarre.

My boyfriend is getting chemo at Penn so I ate some meals here. I was surprised the breakfast sandwich I ate (egg, gouda and bacon) was actually pretty yummy. The chicken artichoke flatbread on the other hand was awful. I took one bite and threw it out. It had a fridge off-taste. I also ordered a peach green with lemonade and this wasn't good. I don't like the mint taste in the peach green and what was I thinking adding lemonade when I really dislike Arnold Palmers. I spilled it all over myself and she was nice enough to make me a new one. She also let me sample a mango iced tea. I do think better customer service would mean that if I said I didn't like the tea, that she should have taken it back and given me a large size of something else instead of the sample. Because she didn't offer to replace it, I felt uncomfortable complaining about the sandwich. I spent good money here over the weekend and the service should have matched the money I spent. Plus if I'm going here on a weekend and not dressed like a medical personnel, most likely I've got a family member in the hospital and need some extra kindness.
Parking and driver thru here sucks especially on a rainy day. If you're looking for a place to plug in and web surf probably not the place.

Let me start by saying I love coffee and Starbucks (there's a local shop with better coffee but that's for another review). Some Starbucks are great with fab baristas and great relaxing atmosphere. Camby is not one of them. The seating is tight, often the bar is the only spot to sit. The crew behind the counter do a good job at making drinks and are usually friendly, but they are often rowdy and loud with lots of colorful language. In short, it's not my favorite location, but it's my closest so it'll do.

The employees here have great attitudes and work hard. The management leaves a lot to be desired, especially the female store manager. Many good, quality employees leave because of her. It has nothing to do with it being a training store and employees moving on to other stores. Treat your people well and they will take care of you.

I was never a fan of starbucks. If my friends car didn't break down half a block away in traffic, then I probably would have never come here. But, I am really glad I did. The people behind the counter were so helpful with listening to me and helping me find something I liked. It was new and different-- french press style coffee brewed over ice.  They even asked if I'd like a bigger cup so I could add soymilk.
Very thoughtful and pleasant employees put me in a good mood. The willow coffee was great, as well.

Excellent friendly staff.  I go there every day.  My only beef is with my fellow customers who think it's fine to take up two or three seats with their bags and coats  some don't even purchase anything and management doesn't seem to mind that regulars can't get a chair or outlet.

Excellent location, with plenty of sofas and tables to sit. This location doesn't serve a ton of selection when it comes to drinks. Seems to only have one type of tea, one type of smoothie and the plain coffee menu. It does have a good selection of cookies and brownies per usual Starbucks. No kitchen here so they won't be serving fancy hot dishes.

Great place to chill and wait for your friends while they shop.

This location is my favorite in Sumner Co or anywhere north of Nashville. They are great about having my order ready quickly and correctly. The regular employees are good about remembering you after a few visits and are very friendly. 

It tends to be a busy location and at peak times it can be difficult to get into the parking lot, so if I'm in a hurry I always order ahead on the mobile app and it's *usually* waiting for me when I walk in. Sometimes I'll have to wait a few minutes. But it allows me to enjoy the small talk with the employees rather than feel anxious about my time. 

No business is perfect all the time but this one is pretty close. 

PS...At the risk of sounding like an ad for Starbucks (I'm not), if you're a regular and not using the app, you should reconsider. Building your drinks tells you how much of what is in each drink, it allows you to customize everything and lets you see everything that's available to you that's not on the menu board. Including whether or not they're out of something before you get there. You'll see what the cost is before you order and you can earn free food or drinks that you've built up to $12 or whatever. Perks and rewards are nice when you go somewhere regularly.

My war with this Starbucks continues.
I asked for whipped cream. Gentleman said we're out of whipped cream. I said that's fine.
I look over and there's three baristas putting whipped cream on the top of three other orders.
..........?
When I get my hot chocolate it's called out as "hot chocolate no whip". 
Not even breaching the subject.
I can't hear my thoughts above the music and it's colder in here than it is outside.
1 star for free internet, which is the only reason I'm here...
My favorite coffeeshop in Rittenhouse. Aged Sumatra on the clover! The crew here is top notch, and a pleasant place to study or work on the laptop.
This starbucks is consistent, and ever present in the world from London to LA it's all the same experience. Some locations are slower than others!

Only go to this Starbucks if you have 45 minutes to spare. I feel bad for the people that work here and the constant flack they receive. A mall with the clientele like International should open up another Starbucks location (or they should not have closed the other one).
I love this Starbucks! The baristas are super friendly, especially Anye (spelling?), and they work fast too.

Can never go wrong with Starbucks Lattes! The location is in a pretty busy plaza and sad to find out there was no drive thru for the quick caffeine trips. They can get pretty busy in that location since they are in the center of busy shopping plazas. On a Sunday evening we actually got our drinks pretty quickly.
It's not as busy as store as you would think it would be for the location. 5 people behind the counter and the line moves slow slow slow. No recycle bins in sight unfortunately.
It officially takes longer to get a mobile order than to wait in the line. If you mobile order during busy times, your food comes 25 minutes before your drink.

My usual is the white chocolate mocha and it's a hit or miss with this Starbucks. With that said, when the drinks aren't made correctly or to your liking, they are happy to remake your drink. If you don't have the time to get your drink redone, then you have the option to call Starbucks or go to their site to file the complaint and they will send you a gift card for the inconvenience. Also, It's a licensed location which means that you can't use your free coffee reward here.

friendliest staff evah! (w/ 1 exception lol). 
outdoor seating in the sun and w/ street noise.
wifi weak outside.

I haven't reviewed my home Starbucks?  How dare I!  Sometimes the drive thru is crazy: I have parked by Samurai, walked in, ordered and picked up my coffee, and drove out a good 4 cars before I would have.  I'm not sure if it was who was working drive thru or just the crazy level of demand.  The baristas are all friendly.  On Halloween, there was a dude rocking a banana costume.  He was hilarious!  Sadly, I don't recognize him without the costume.  Oh well.

Why is there a sluggish line in the drive-thru lane at 1:40 p.m. on a Sunday? This location is on a continual downfall. My drink order was incorrect during three of my last four visits and the evening crew focuses more on chatter than quality service. I begrudgingly visit this location because it is near my home and en route to work, but I may have to throw in the towel and drive to another location or stop wasting time and money at Starbucks.

Aside from getting the normal high quality product from Starbucks as we all expect, this location always has made me feel like a member of their family when coming in. Quick excellent service and always greeted by a smile and a warm conversation. Even when the place is packed to the max they manage to get your order completed promptly with no sacrifice of Quality. A consistent 5 stars from this Starbucks location.
No tops for drinks, service sucks, drink order wrong.... Just horrible not going there again!!
Great coffee and tea. the staff is very friendly, orders come out quick. sometimes the drive thru is a bit slow. all in all worth the wait.

Starbucks is Starbucks- thus 2 stars.

I go in periodically to use free internet, during the later part of the day.
There's this one blonde-headed girl there who's a bitch. -minus 3 stars

I wouldn't review Starbucks normally- because it's Starbucks. But this girl's attitude is enough to make me go online and write a terrible review.

(I use gift card)
Her: There's $2.38 left. Do you want the gift card back?
Me: Yes.

What is your problem?

I'm with the first reviewer that this is not the best Starbucks to stop at. There is a nicer one down the street. I stopped to use the restroom and ordered two tall strawberry frappachino's. I'm not sure if they put any strawberries in here. The drink was not the usual pink color that it is at other Starbucks and it only tasted lightly of maybe strawberry syrup. Not worth the $7 I paid.

Normally they do a great job. They always are in a good mood,, I know several of the baristas but lately the wait has been quite a bit longer. it is getting better so I won't rate them down on it yet... The drink orders are always spot on and they are overall great at handling a big crowd. They treat each other very well and I was able even able to watch them train a team member. They did so with respect and lots of patience while still serving customers in a timely fashion. Kudos to the team for doing this in a fast paced environment.

This Starbucks is pretty clean with a couple of tables to the side. It located at a very convenient location next to HUP and CHOP. They are pretty fast with completing orders, with 3 people working on drinks. The ambiance is pretty nice. However it's pretty busy with people coming in and out. If you are looking for a place to complete some work, this is also a good location because the tables are off to the side away from the crowd of people flowing in and out.

I guess I visited on the worst day ever, because I couldn't wait for my experience at this Starbucks to end. I stopped by in the early evening for a sandwich and some quick blogging to pass an hour before I headed to my next adventure.

Everyone in the place was nice; I really want to emphasize that. The staff were very pleasant and eventually accommodating. But the overall service and atmosphere... ehhhh.

I ordered a tomato/cheese sandwich, an oatmeal cookie and a water to consume in-store. After I ordered, I put my bags down at a table and returned to the counter for my sandwich. I waited. And waited. And waited. One staff member was manning the drive-thru, while the other went... I don't know where. She returned eventually and fiddled around for a bit longer before noticing me, grabbing a sandwich and slipping it into a to-go sack. I looked down, confused, and asked if I could also have my water and cookie. She said that she didn't know I had wanted a cookie (even though I repeated it twice when ordering) and didn't charge me for it. I was silent, waiting for whatever would happen next, and she finally moved to the case, pulled out a cookie, put it in a to-go bag and rang it up. I thought that since it was her mistake and a minor expense, she should have simply given the cookie to me, but whatever, I paid. She then ran away before I could ask for my water again. I finally caught her and convinced her to hand over the glass of water she had apparently prepared for me before all of this rigamorole. I also requested a plate for my sandwich, which seemed a little puzzling to her, but she silently gave me one.

I finished off the sandwich, which wasn't the best, even by Starbucks standards, and got up to use the restroom. Unfortunately, there was no toilet paper. I headed back to the counter to ask for some, but the staff members had disappeared once again. I finally realized that the young man eating at one of the tables was a Starbucks employee, so I asked him for the paper. He told another staff member to get it. It took a while, but I eventually peed. Yay!

The cafe itself isn't the most conducive to working or the most comfortable. It's a small space, and the few tables were crammed so closely that you couldn't sit down without disturbing the chairs at the table behind you. There weren't many outlets, so if your laptop died, too bad, so sad.

Starbucks isn't my favorite place to eat or work, but generally, the chain is just fine. This location, though, doesn't do the brand any justice.

This location could be a gold mine. If the kids working behind the counter worried more about making the orders and serving the customers than the do bickering and telling each other how to "do their job". Lucky for them, caffeine is worth the aggravation of these bratty teenagers.
Well, at the end of the day it is just like any other Starbucks. Nothing more, nothing less except like Robin says it does have a drive through which is a little more convenient.
Literally the worst drive through ever, it takes almost an hour at times to get through and has to be the slowest Starbucks in all of Tucson

Better than average starbucks.. Great design great fast service, very friendly much faster than nj and what I'm used to waiting in long lines. I miss the homemade starbucks yogurt not sure why the only sell oikos.. I love my starbucks version

I really enjoy this Starbucks. The main reason? They always spell my name right on the cup!!! It may not sound like much but when you've got a weird name it's pretty exciting to have someone actually spell it right. My beverage always is more satisfying when it actually says my name.

The seating area is always kept clean. Since it is inside of a Chapters there isn't a whole lot of room but it's a cozy little area with a nice bit of natural light. If this location gets outrageously busy and you don't feel like waiting in line, you can hop on over to Target since there's a Starbucks in there too (although it doesn't have a seating area). 

The baristas here are always nice and reasonably quick. I've never had a bad experience here. (Unlike other Starbucks... Cafe Vanilla frappes are NOT the same as Vanilla Bean, but I swear 87% of the baristas don't know that).
Nice Starbucks with a lot of seating upstairs. It was a little crowded and loud when I was here since there's so much seating.

I have been a Starbucks fan for many years. I still enjoy their food and coffee, but I just can't figure out why a cup of coffee takes so damn long...I have been to this location 5 times now and every time I've had to wait an inordinate amount of time for my coffee....  and if you go in the drive-through, you're STUCK..and usually for 15mins..  The last time I went in with my kids we each ordered a drink and it rook 8.5 minutes (my son timed it) to get all of our drinks out.  I'd understand if it were busy, but there was no one in front of us...

Their sandwiches are decent, but typically a bit rubbery after their microwave/heat blaster machine, and there's no salt or pepper to put on them (?), but I'll still order some because it's convenient.
Have only been to drive-thru.  Great service and there is never a wait here!  Prices are high but that's to be expected given the company.  Very friendly and professional staff.. I will come back.

its your regular run of the mill starbucks. i prefer to visit local establishments, but its so close to my house it makes it hard to beat. i do wish they had flavored coffee though, rather than having to use pumps of syrup. gross!

I stopped into this Starbucks for a traveler early one morning, the girls working were very friendly and patience even with a hard thing like travelers. They also still had pumpkin spice which made me so happy!!!!! I love pumpkin spice! Very friendly, clean, and convenient !

I like the very well covered outdoor seating and the crowd at this location. But Laura D. is not alone in thinking wow, how are the bathrooms here so nasty? It's like what you'd expect at a remote state park.
If you want to have the worst possible experience at a coffee shop, this is the place.

Standard airport Starbucks. This one is near gate C10. I'm not sure about the hours, but it's definitely open past 8 pm, as I got off my plane around 8:15 and was dying for a coffee. There were three or four staff members on duty, even though there was no one getting coffee at that time, so at least it was well staffed. My coffee was ready almost instantly and was hot and as expected. The coffee shop had its own seating area and was a bit self-enclosed, so it had a real coffee shop feeling if you need to escape the airport seating by your gate.
Hot. Triple shot. Venti. Soy. Caramel macchiato. Drink was only ever wrong once. Big smiles. Great service. BUT it's a popular location so prepare for long lines inside and drive-through.

I've been working across the street since 2008.  This Starbucks has brought me nothing but aggravation for 4 years...until today. 

I have to preface, my dissapointment  was never assocaited with a lack of friendliness.  The employees always greet you with a smile and a "how are this morning?"  Also, it would be unfair to not expose the fact I do walk under a rain cloud most days and I am magnet for bad luck.

My gripe?  Complete inability to multitask or manage of line of more then 2 people.  When you work at a place infamous for crowds close in comparision to those lining up for the Broad Street Run, you woud think you'd have this down to a science.  Please go to the Dunkin Donuts underground at Suburban Station adjacent to Penn Center 6 (I know I know, theres gotta be a dozen at this location) for a lesson in efficiency.  

Why was today a success?  Now, it might have helped because it's a Sunday and there were only 2 people in line.  HOWEVER, the two ladies working spoke very clearly, took my order according to my actual spot in line (this is another thing that makes me wanna scream in the morning - if you are not ordering a drink - you will be skipped - and you will notice people who got there after you paying and walking out with their order before you. God forbid you just want to buy something already pre-made in the cold box display) rang me up correctly (incorrect change has happened twice in past two visits), and the best thing.....THEY ACTUALLY HAD THE CHICKEN SAUAGE WRAP (struck out on this order last 4 attempts - I also had to wait in line for 10 minutes before I could find this out. For Pete's sake, update or make a sign up-front when you are out of something. Now I am that rude person that walks straight up to front counter while a line of 20 start grunting so I can ask if they have something in stock before I get in line).

ANYWAY, thank you ladies for a wonderful experience. Quick, Correct Order, Correct Change, Hade Food in Stock, and No Line.  

PS. Happy Fathers Day.
I am a very angry girl right now! Online it says that the store closes at 10:30! I get to the drive thru and the girl states very rudely that they are closed and didn't say sorry.

I love that this starbucks is soo close to work! I get a grande hot chocolate and everything bagel with cream cheese almost every morning (I know super unhealthy, right?) Anyway the point is - This place gives me my breakfast and I like the baristas here.. they are super friendly and nice :)

I'm not really a Starbucks lover in general, but sometimes you just need a quick caffeine hit - and this place is on my way to work! When we first visited Tucson to find a place to live, we stayed at the nearby Holiday Inn. I had a really nice chat with a staff member here during that visit - Emma. When we moved here months later and I stopped back in, she remembered me! I was so impressed. All the employees here have been friendly and despite the busy-ness, upbeat. It can certainly get rushed, but that's to be expected in this location and during the morning traffic. I enjoy the outdoor patio here and it's easy in and out for the parking lot from 1st. I like this location and usually visit a few times a month. Drinks have always been consistent for me.

Rude service. We pay serious $$$ for school here and the service is horrible. The worst Starbucks in STL. What a shame. 

Went in a few times and every time it seems like it's an inconvenience for them to make a drink for me. 

I can't believe they have such poor attitudes. I can't believe that a company like Starbucks employs such trashy examples of society.

slow, always out of stuff, poor customer service, not clean, not typical starbucks workers. i've never seen a starbucks who always gets the drink wrong. its always too much of this or not enough of that. the location just sucks! 
Taylor is DELIGHTFUL and a pleasure to order from. Very well spoken and pays attention to detail!
The coffee is trash its fucking off it tastes like a fucking ashtray filled with sawdust the service is fucking horrible would not recommend

Overall friendly staff (except for that one snarky chick), fast service on slow days, slow service on busy days, and they get my drinks (if not my name) right. Not crazy about the location, but parking isn't too bad. I'm here a lot and am glad it's so close to uni.

I really enjoy working here when I need a change of scenery and love the easy access via car, bike, public transit, etc. Although I live close enough to walk, I am sometimes skeptical about walking with my laptop, phone, etc. so the option to drive and park for free keeps me coming back! 

It feels like a neighborhood coffee shop even though it's a chain store. The baristas are always super friendly and a few of them have made an effort to remember my name. My favorite is the Berry Hibiscus Refresher--unlike anything at any other coffee shop! Love it and will be back!

Reno, NV

Great service. Awesome baristas...............
...........
........
......
Skinny vanilla latte one shot two shot and no no no sugar!

I love this Starbucks location and staff! They are always happy to take my order and have genuine smiles for customers. No matter how I want my drink they listen and have great suggestions when I want to try something new. The store is clean with a nice atmosphere inside to sit and enjoy.

I really do love this Starbucks on campus. I actually come here quite a bit and could not believe that I had not written a review for them yet! What the heck!?! This is always a happening place, but every time I am there the staff are efficient and quick with how many students come through the place! The staff always have a smile and are so friendly! For awhile I was coming so often because of late nights for classes, the recognized me and knew my order...just like cheers! LOL  That always makes you feel really good! For how busy it is, it always looks clean and items are stocked each time I go in. If they happen to be out of something they are quick to respond when you ask for it. I have even seen on several instances staff go above and beyond in helping the customers to make sure they have everything they need while there. 
I also really like the set up of this Starbucks. They have comfy chairs on one side with side tables that really give a homey feeling and there are lots of typical Starbucks tables and chairs. I also like at this Starbucks that if you keep your receipt you can have a refill on the coffee! Not all do that unless you have the card! Which I recently obtained!  Way to go for keeping this Starbucks rocking on campus! Keep up the great work!

This was literally the best cappuccino I've ever had and I use to be a barista. I don't know the guy's name but he was amazing. He was on the drive thru headset but I wanted to make sure he knew how much I enjoyed the drink, so I whispered at him. His response was to whisper a thank you back. MADE. MY. DAY.  If the barista reads this message me!

This has got to be the saddest location I've ever been to. We sat in line (drive thru) for over 20 minutes total. They were extremely slow! 

I ordered the chestnut praline frappe nonfat with whip when we finally got to the menu. Waited another 5 minutes or so before getting to the window, and they handed me a hot drink. When I explained I had ordered a frozen drink, she said (very rudely might I add) "did you not order the nonfat chestnut praline?" I said "yes, it was supposed to be a frappe." 

She rolled her eyes and slammed the window shut, and started throwing cups around while trying to make it into a frappe. She then asked us to move forward and she'd bring it out. After waiting another 5 minutes or so, she finally brings it out, doesn't apologize.

I start drinking it, and it didn't even taste like it had espresso in it. It tasted like it was just syrup, ice, and milk. I'll never come back to this location as long as I live.

I had a meeting today at this location and it was a nice summer Sunday  @12:30.  The place was crowded when I arrived with no available parking. I waited for about 5 minutes, parked and went inside.  All of the tables were taken with electrical outlets which was fine because my PC was not totally dead. 

Typical Sunday morning crowd.  

In less than 15 minutes someone left and I was able to charge up. I ordered my drink and took the last 2 napkins. Bummer.  I wiped the table and in 5 minutes the napkins holders were full. I had to smile because this is great service.  

The place was clean and orderly. The only pet peeve was the free wifi was spotty and it took several attempts to login. Meeting was great and it was another successful Starbucks boardroom meeting.  :)
Starbucks on Manchester in the city of Manchester, the people that work here are friendly and helpful,  the atmosphere here is relaxing and the patrons cordial. Stop by and enjoy.

I was so excited when I saw the "coming soon" signs this summer for this Starbucks next to Gia and Jimmy Johns! I always wished for a closer coffee shop on my way into work, and now there is! This Starbucks is clean and bright, with plenty of outdoor seating and some indoor seating as well. It's great for anyone working in the hospital or research centers around the area because of its central location and quick service! As for the quality, it's what you would expect of any starbucks - reliable! Definitely going to be a new staple of mine :)
Trying to figure how service can be so slow when there are 8 people working behind the counter. Worst Starbucks I've ever been to.
Ordered a nonfat decaf latte as I am pregnant.  Line was long so it took about 15-20mins to get my drink only to realize once I was out of the mall that it was fully caffeinated!

Dear Brenna, 

Work on your customer service. Everyone saw your eyeroll when YOU messed up my order three times.

A DOUBLE-CUPPED hot tea is standard.

-SB Partner from a store 3 times busier than yours

Each item we ordered (4 total) came out wrong. The barista was new but if he was that inexperienced he shouldn't have been making the drinks yet. We did get a $4 gift card to make up for the bad experience and wrong items but we won't be back to this one.

It's a Starbucks and you probably know what the food tastes like so let's talk about cleanliness, service, and seating situation. On the cleanliness front, this place could do much better. It's a really high traffic store and I think that makes it difficult to keep clean, but I think they could do better. The service is definitely not not the friendliest either. Sometimes it may feel like you're asking for a favor rather than paying for a latte. And lastly seating. This place gets seriously packed!!! Like outrages lines so get ready to NEVER find seating and get bumped into about 20 times while you wait for your drink. But sometimes you just need coffee and this place will do the trick.

This is one of my favorite Starbucks in Tucson. The staff has always been super friendly and the baristas make great drinks. 

It's been busier than usual since the remodeling in July and since the new menu items have been added, and that's my only complaint. The staff level is the same, but there are more customers. 

Even though they seem short-staffed, the baristas who are there work hard to make wait times less. They're fast and efficient....and the management must be good because some staff has been there for years.

Kudos, too, on how polite the staff is even when faced with truly awful customers. There was one the other day who made everyone in line grit their teeth. Yeah, I'm talking to you, Mr. Blended White Mocha Caramel with six shots, four pumps, extra whip and caramel on the side. You were a complete dipwad who not only demanded that you didn't have to pay extra for anything, but then after you browbeat the cashier, made the barista make your dumb drink twice. We ALL wanted to throw you out the door....but the staff was more Zen than we were.
I'm a regular Starbucks fan. Just the regular brew.  This is a pretty small location but inside the mall and convenient.  The staff is consistently friendly and the wait time is typically manageable.

So far I like this place.  It's the first that I have seen in the area with a drive through.   It is bigger than most also.  Lots of space for those who want to hang out with their computers.   There is also covered seating out front as you enter.  This is an area that faces the parking lot and the traffic on Westshore Blvd.   So I'm not sure if this is a good setup.  Also,  it appears that the best time of day may be in the evening.   The mornings are just too busy.   However,  I am usually in search of a triple chocolate brownie when I go and this place is always well stocked.   Oh yeah,  the coffee is great too.

So it's Starbucks... You pretty much know what you are going to get (taste-wise anyway).
Because of their location, they are always very busy, so be prepared to wait a while to be able to place your order.. And then even longer to have it made.
Yes, the employees are friendly and helpful ... But at a cost (increased wait times for everyone)!
What happened? There were only three cars ahead of me. I think I waited 10 minutes to order and 10 minutes to get one drink. It was never this bad before.

The staff is incredibly friendly and even at the most hectic times keep things moving steadily and consistently. Sometimes I appreciate being able to just take a break from everything and sit there and relax with something to eat and drink.
Not that it is unlike every other starbucks, but this place is packed in the morning.  They get through the line pretty quickly.  Decent spot to sit at the window and watch the people go by.
Parking is a nightmare. Blender broken. No whipped cream. Why even bother? I'd rather drive all the way downtown to get a better experience.
It's a almost Starbucks in a Target store. It's loud dirty it definitely does not have the standards of a real Starbucks

This will probably be the last time I come to this Starbucks location. Today I got a notification from the Starbucks app that if you bought a drink, you would get a free one in the future. So I decided I would stop in, do some work and get a drink but unfortunately I picked the wrong location to do so. 

The barista had no idea what I was talking about and when I showed her the advertisement on the Starbucks app she basically told me that I wouldn't be able to participate in the deal while simultaneously preparing food in the microwave for the drive through customers. She was not the only person working and someone else should have been dealing with the drive through food or she should have finished with the food and then said she could help me, not try and do both at the same time... it made me feel really disrespected honestly. 

The drive through is EXTREMELY favored at this location. If you're going to go here, don't even bother coming inside. I'm pretty sure about 8 cars got served before my drink was made and I'm pretty sure they only started making it because I got up from my work and stood by the counter. 

Once the drink was actually made, it was practically thrown at me with drink coming out of the top of it. The barista said she would get me napkins but at that point I just wanted to leave. The drink wasn't even that great since the whole thing was rushed and the cafe itself was crawling with flies all by the cash register. 

I ended up just going home to finish my work there... free of flies and bad service. I highly recommend the other westshore location over this one.

If you're in University City and you want to go to Starbucks, this is the one to go to. The baristas work so hard to keep that long line moving along quickly and smoothly. And they are so cheerful while they are at it. It CAN be hard to find a seat, sometimes, because the place is small and it gets really crowded. But that makes it lively. Drinks are made right. Cream and sugar table is always well supplied. Despite the crowd, they manage to keep the place clean.

Located on the corner.  It's a huge storefront.  You'd never know this was a Starbucks except for the name.   Lots of dark wood, clusters of recycled brass horns used for lighting above throughout the store.  High ceilings.  Plenty of seating.  It's very Nawlins.

I'm not sure who the previous store occupant was, but this Starbucks is the most amazing one I've been to.   And the baristas are very friendly. 

Even if you don't drink Starbucks coffee it's worth taking a peek inside.

This is one of the coolest Starbucks I have seen! Love the interior! Very modern and clean! Fast and friendly workers. They still have salted Carmel mocha for now! They're out of pumpkin spice though :(

Drive thru service on the way to the doctor's office. I needed coffee. I NEEDED coffee like whoa! The drive through wasn't terribly backed up, and there was a young man being trained on the register. I saw the trainer being very patient with him. That made me happy. 

The coffee was made to the right temperature. Often you'll find that the coffee is made too hot, and the steamed milk is scorched, luckily this was just right.  I'm happy with what I got, but there is always room for improvement.

There are definitely reasons why this Starbucks has lower ratings than others in Reno.  I usually go a little out of my way to go to the Wedge Parkway location instead of this one.  
One of the baristas comes into my work and I always address him by name, however he never remembers me. 
Today a coworker of mine went over and ordered drinks for all of us, I also got a cherry oat bar... they forgot it.  I had to go back myself to get it, and they didn't even offer me one of the service cards afterward, so I asked for one.  They said "Oh, we don't have any." I said, "Well, this is an inconvenience for me so I would like something," Turns out they did have them. Why lie?
If you get early, like 7:30/8, sometimes it's not busy, which is the only perk.  The mall opens at 10, that's why.
There's one really tall skinny dark-haired barista who is always super nice. If you don't see him, head up Mt. Rose Hwy for 2 minutes and go to the Wedge location.
Always nice staff.. Plenty of seating and tables available. Sort of tough to get to if you're on the wrong side of 309 though.  It's one of my favorite Starbucks around. Oh, it also has a drive thru
Love Starbucks on broad and pine. Great staff awesome services. I will keep going back.

Excellent Starbucks location! Everyone is friendly and they always have a smile on their face. They have a pretty good selection of bakery items and sandwiches to go along with your coffee or tea. I recommend trying their Banana Nut Bread, it's quite tasty.

Where to being. A gentlemen and I walk in at the same time, he is slightly ahead of me so he orders first. I wait in THIER designated line by the sign for the line, so that I'm not in the other customers business (which they allow to happen at no end at this location... Wouldn't be surprised if debit card pins were getting stolen) 
A second gentlemen walks in and stands right next to the cashier in the their customers business. The barista finishes with first gentlemen and begins with the second gentlemen. I said excuse me several times and said that I had already been standing in line. 
The barista says oh ok, and seems confused. The other customer seems to have no idea what a line is. I place my order, the barista has clearly gotten short in her responses to me. The second gentlemen goes to place his order and she greets him with a big smile and apologizes... For what? Because I kindly respected your other customers and waited in line where YOUR sign says to? 
This location has been annoying me from day 1. I go about once a week, every time the staff is completely different, which would be fine if any of them were ever on the same page... Which they aren't. When I go they usually don't have too many people in line and I see orders getting screwed up almost every time. THERE IS SOMETHING WRONG WITH THE ICED COFFEE. It tastes watered down and down right crappy. I have had it more than 5+ times. It's not a particular barista or day of the week. It's always bad. I don't understand how your screw that up. Ice, coffee, skim milk. 
If I visit this location again, it's because I still have $8 left on a gift card I got as a gift and the location is convenient. Otherwise, I have no reason to continue with a business that doesn't care about their own lines, the privacy of their customers, the quality of their drinks, the attitude of (most but not all) of their staff, and If corporate Starbucks doesn't care about any of that, they'll care about all the wasted drinks I've seen poured down the drain due to mistakes because that's their money!!
Never in my life did I think I would be so annoyed with a freaking coffee shop.

I personally hate this location. The service is bad. We are paying $4-5 for a cup of coffee, wouldn't you hope for them to at least make it right?! If you don't like your job then quit. Don't mess up your customers' drink orders. The end.

A "forgotten" starbucks location that is placed on the way to lots of stuff but not actually near a destination.  Right off Veterans Highway in a suburbia part of town, this quaint s'bucks is small and has less study tables. There is some parking around the building but it's limited.  You can also park behind the store in the neighborhood if you are really in a pinch.  

It has great workers and is very clean.

This Starbucks is hit or miss.  Sometimes I get really good service here, and other times not so much.  I can say the same thing about the drinks too.  It's nice that this location has a drive thru, but the location is a bit inconvenient.  If your driving north on Academy, you have to make a u-turn (if you can because that intersection is crazy and has a camera).  There is a lot of nice seating, but they could do a better job in the cleaning department.

I mean I'm not against this Starbucks, it's the chain I dislike. Everything if full of sugar. I don't let my children have anything from here, because almost everything  is chock full of sugar. 

I have come here once and the service is good.

WORST STARBUCKS I'VE EVER BEEN TO! I just pulled out of the drive-thru here. There were only 2 girls working and it literally took 25min from the time we ordered our drink to actually get them. And then the girl working the drive-thru had an attitude with us because we were annoyed that they were going so slow. I wish I could rate as 0 stars. Horrible customer service.

I'm not sure if something has happened during the last 6 months since the last review was written, but I really don't understand why this particular Starbucks has such high reviews. The good: it is a block away from my apartment, it is always clean, and there is never a line of more than just a couple people. The bad: the employees who work there get under my skin every single time. The men seem to be fine but the women...It's not uncommon for me to have to stand there at the register and wait for them to finish their conversation before taking my order. The number of mess-ups that happen considering the low volume of people is pretty astounding. I kept going there because I figured that sometimes things aren't perfect, people sometimes make mistakes, etc. I'm a pretty understanding person. But after today, I will be walking the two blocks to 13th and Chestnut. There are always a lot more people waiting in line and it is always crowded but the baristas are amazing, they are super friendly, and I get the impression that they actually care. 13th and Chestnut is not always the cleanest (due to the high volume of people) but at this point I would rather put up with a little trash if it means I get excellent customer service.

There comes a time during the Red cup days that you just have to get a fix of your favorite cup of cheer even while you are away from home and this place did not dissappoint.  The Extra Hot Eggnog Latte was made to perfection mmmm, mmmm, good! 

Though this is a smaller than usual Starbucks I frequent, there's no shortage in service and friendliness from behind the counter as the Barista greets you with LIFE and makes your beverage right. Meanwhile, the drive-thru seems to be just moving along just fine.

This is probably the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. It looked like the 8 or so employees were just shuffling around trading places and only one of them was actually making drinks. I walked in and there was NO LINE and only 3 cars in the drive thru yet it still took 5 minutes of me standing directly in front of the register to have my order taken and 5 more minutes to get my drink. I ordered an iced chai! Literally scoop ice, pour milk in, pour chai concentrate, serve...and THAT took 10 minutes. 

Adding to the frustration is the fact that my nearly $5 "tall" (small) drink tasted like a glass of chai-flavored milk because there wasn't enough TEA in it. This will be my first and last trip to this Starbucks. I'll go to a gas station or drive to the Kahwa truck before I walk over to this place again.

Since every Starbs on my way out were super busy, I dropped by this location.  Consistency is Starbs way.  Which is good.  They were busy, but moved everything right along. Parking lot is small and there isn't a drive thru, but the insides pretty large.
This a beautiful Starbucks!!! Right in the heart of Rittenhouse Square! I love their frappuchinos. I also love their holiday / CHRISTMAS items and specialty drinks. Super friendly staff.
Slow service in the drive thru. I waited 10 minutes behind two cars just to get a coffee. Luckily for them, the coffee was delicious.

This is my go-to Starbucks. It's across from my work and the people who work here are normally pretty friendly. Not to mention, they are pretty damn good at what they do. I've been there at least a hundred times and they've never screwed up my drink.

So while efficiency is their main success point, they are for the most part pretty friendly and a pleasure to visit. Although there are many other coffee joints in the area that I may like to visit every once in a while, this is my primary place because it's so close and they usually make a good drink.

The space is a bit crowded, but the coffee is standard Starbucks. The pickup area is ineffective for the space, but it is something the atore has to work with. The service was efficient, and even though the lineup was off-putting, I was not dissatisfied with the time it took to get my drink.

I am not Starbucks-prone, preferring my coffee from either Espresso Art on University or Coffee Times on Speedway. But I cannot always get to the midtown area, so this is where I end up sometimes. 

I have had terrible experiences with Starbucks in the past. The coffee. Not the employees or the ambiance. But the folks at this particular location know how to make an iced latte! 

And the place is comfortable. And likely because of its close proximity to Pima Community College and being that it is one of very few cafes on this side of town (right off the interstate, too) it is often busy. But it has a decent amount of seating, even a few lounge chair/sofas. Also, nice floor to ceiling-windows that are south-facing make for a nice amount of natural light. 

Otherwise, it's your standard Starbucks. They do sell little sandwiches and salads here. The croissants are pretty good -- large and buttery, as they should be. The music is usually at a mellow volume and is Starbucks-typical: Jazz and neosoul lots of times. 

And free wi-fi! That's always a strong draw.

Starbucks in my home town reminds me of a place that the community can go to and meet up or do work there.  This Starbucks is similar - soft music, open space, enough room to spread out but not take up a lot of room, drinks that don't feel half empty, and the location is not crowded in a traffic-y strip mall or grocery store.  Bravo, favorite location.  Plus, it's right off I-10 (with a large drive-thru sign) so friends passing through can meet me here.  It is not chaotic even with a drive-thru.  Yay!

waited 30 minutes to get my simple drink and when I finally got it it was the wrong one.  Didn't offer anything (or even an apology) for their mistake besides offering me the wrong drink they made.   Slowest starbucks in the existence of ever!  Might as well drive to mall 2 minutes down the road and get your Starbucks there
It's OK...The staff here are always nice.  Sometimes the service is really slow though :/

This location will only do in a pinch. I haven't had my coffee today and needed something to take the edge off. Starbucks is conveniently located at the end of the food court. The customer service here is terrible. If I can help it I definitely hold out for a better location. I have the Starbucks gift card (so I can earn rewards) and asked the person behind the counter if she could check my balance. She did but it seemed like it was reluctantly. When my coffee was ready they set it on the table and walked away. No eye contact, no smile, no calling my name to let me know it was ready. I wish more people would put more pride in their work.

I know I know- you either luv em or you hate em. I fall into the love em category. I do not go for all those Froo Froo Fancy Smancy 1000+ calorie stuff thought. I am a Venti Bold with Sugar Free French Vanilla Syrup and a little half and half. Whether hot or iced, this go to drink for me is a daily fix- whether made at home with my grinder and syrup, or on the go and grabbed at the store.

This location is my "home" location- no drive in, but very friendly staff and lots of places to sit inside and out. If you are in the area, stop by- you just might see me there!
Nice patio, automated machines (not good), coffee ah, ok.
Great coffee expensive prices not such a great place to sit around not as inviting as a stand-alone Starbucks
This is a pretty decent place to come to and do homework. Free wi-fi. can't complain!

This Starbucks seriously lacks a sense of urgency. Too many baristas are working behind the counter to be efficient. I regularly go here since I am a hopeless coffee addict, but the experience is always awful. I order ahead using the app they encouraged me to use if I wanted my order done on time and they still deliver late. I only ever order a cup of pike place brew and they treat me like I ordered a frappe. I do not recommend this Starbucks.
This location is consistently so slow. A good 20 minute wait is NOT an exaggeration. In addition, 90% of the time the baristas aren't friendly. Worst Starbucks in Tampa.

Echoing many of the comments here, getting in may be the biggest downfall to this Starbucks location.  Service is friendly, the place is clean, and they even have a great drive thru.
