Coming from Academy road means a turn at a busy, ugly intersection.  Making said turn without your morning cup of coffee doesn't make it any easier...

Awesome people, great service. 
Myself and coworkers are here just about every day for our afternoon pick-me-up. 

They always take care of us and we shoot the breeze like we're old friends. 

Make sure you say hi to Yon for me!

This location is pretty nice. Narrow entrance so the line formation can be sloppy but the seating is pretty scattered. The window seats is a must; you get to enjoy people watching lol. There is an upstairs seating area but that's mainly for students anyway.
Would give it 5 stars if it weren't so daggone cold! I love how the barista asks customers to let him know if their drink isn't perfect!  All SBux should adopt this practice.

I come to this Starbucks just about everyday, it's the only one I know of that has a drive thru in the northeast area. There is usually never any long lines inside like the ones you find in town. Other then that it's pretty much the same as any other Starbucks. They do have some outdoor seating right out front which is pretty nice.
Great place with fabulous people behind the counter. Always cheerful and go the extra mile. Great coffee and awesome conversion;)
I love coming to this starbucks. Everyone here is very polite, and will answer any questions you have. There is plenty of seating both indoor and outdoor, as well.
This Starbucks has the friendliest drive thru workers. Always so happy and upbeat. It makes waiting in line for my coffee tolerable.

They have recently had a remodel and it looks great! Everything is so clean!! I ordered my usual complicated drink and it was perfect!! Target Starbucks was a great idea!! Coffee and shopping for the win!!

Out of the main CC locations, this one is more spacious, which I like a lot! 

However, here, the music is a too loud to get any work/studying done. When I've ordered hot drinks, I've been given iced. Matcha lattes won't be mixed too thoroughly. Milk containers will all be empty. I've wiped off my tables (there would be opened sugar packets, straw wrappers) both times I've sat down (5-6pm at night... it's not busy). It's all whatever in the end, just sharing my experience but I appreciate this location space!

We walked into the most beautiful Starbucks ever only to immediately be insulted by this Queen Ian, and yes, it's ok for me to say that, being that I'm queerer than a 3 dollar bill, instructing me to leave because of a zero tolerance policy to alcohol. I was actually coming in to buy my friend a coffee who generously used her time share points to make this trip happen. My partner handed me his drink and I quietly walked outside with it while he took her through the process and paid for her drink. I thought about it, but still felt extremely offended by this. I wasn't drunk by any means, but this is New Orleans! Really????? What I initially said was the nicest Starbucks ever, turned into my worst ever because of one guy. 
   After my partner and my friend came out, they did say that the rest of the people there were very nice and accommodating. So, Ian, you are the weakest link. STARBUCKS should say Buh Bye to you... You truly are their weakest link! Also, in New Orleans, it's more than appropriate for you to lift your zero alcohol tolerance policy since most people here over indulge and may be looking to you for some sobriety.

This is a pretty good Starbucks. Location is difficult, but if you are traveling anywhere other than east on grant ave, just turn into westbound grant, pass the star bucks, and almost immediately there will be a shoulder where you can make a u-turn. It can get pretty crowded in this one!

The only bad thing about this place is on how to get into the place to order your latte. It's hard to get in if your coming from 95. The staff is super friendly and my lattes are always on point. I usually order vanilla lattes and they put just the right amount in it.
Good service! Kinda slow but understandable because I went there early in the morning and only 1 barista during the rush hours

I typically only come in the mornings and have had amazing experiences coming to this Starbucks but recently not as much. Denise in the morning is great but the other barista making the drinks isn't, I typically order to go because I have to run to the train. On one occasion I came in 5-6 minutes after ordering only to find that my drink hadn't even been started and I was the only customer in the store. When the other barista noticed me she started to make my drink then another customer came in who she must have known but made a mistake ordering to go and ordered a duplicate. Rather than finish making my drink and let me run to the train station she made me wait to return the other customers duplicate order. Poor customer service. When I was finally given my drink the barista forgot what she had already made for my drink and left out the espresso shot, all I got was room temperature milk and syrup for over $5 and 10 minutes later. This is just one experience of many where I've had the the other barista have no sense of urgency. Guess I'll use the Starbucks on 13th and market from now on.

I came to this Starbucks while on a trip with my family. I normally don't write reviews unless the place goes beyond my expectations. This Starbucks is not only clean but has great baristas working hard to keep their costumers satisfied. I was really surprise to see a lady complaining to the manager about her drink not being remade. Her cup was nasty looking like it wasn't even from that day, obviously a scammer. The manager stood on her ground and didn't let this lady get her way. You guys are doing awesome! Don't let scammers like that lady make you feel bad

Staff was incredibly rude and impatient. Their interactions with themselves and each other were unprofessional and hostile. This is NOT the Starbucks experience I'm used to. Greg, the manager, was particularly inappropriate.

The staff here is always very nice. Yes they are very busy given they are the only starbucks on the south side that is not located in a store but they make great drinks and have gotten a lot faster. We need more starbucks on the south side!!!! not the stores fault.

The place is nice and clean. They need to turn the AC up a little. They keep the tables and stools clean as well as the floor. The music is good.  The lighting is cool. It's a bunch of trumpets with light bulbs in it.  I have to be honest and say I am not a Starbucks drinker the girlfriend is.  She swears by it.

This makes me sad to write, but there were five people behind the counter and it took 20 minutes for me to get a tall iced tea because only one of them was doing any work and she was making all the drinks -- the mobile orders, the drive-through orders, and the in-person orders. I was literally one of two people standing inside the store, and both of us waited unreasonably long times for very simple drinks. 

Positive: My iced tea was great!

One of my favorite breakfast places in the BNA!

Unfortunately, a boarding pass does not act as a coupon but this Starbucks takes giftcards! I had a great experience working with the airport 'bucks. Prices are high but that is expected with the word airport attached but the line moves quickly and there are plenty of workers to start barista orders! What more can you ask for from a chain?

I'll been to this Starbucks several times and there has always been a mess up. I'm not the type to make a big deal of it so I always let it slide. Today I went there and ordered a grande hot drink, when I went home I checked the inside and it was half empty.. I didn't even have one sip and the drink was already half way done. I was very disappointed.

There's nothing wrong with the staff. It's all about the set up. The location is great but the parking lot and drive through are horrible. It makes me never want to come here because of it. I can't imaginewhat morning rush is like. Again, the staff is quick and friendly, but this place NEEDS 1 star based on the set up alone.

Love the baristas here! Sometimes it gets a bit busy here..some more staff would be nice during the rushes, but other than that, they always find a way to make my drinks better, thanks for everything!

I'll be honest - I prefer local coffee shops to chain ones, but sometimes, Starbucks is just so darn convenient.

This particular location is pretty awesome.  They have ample seating for people who want to read and/or study, including a long farm table, which is cool if you don't mind bumping elbows with the person next to you.  They also cater to the soccer-mom type, strollers and all.  

The staff is friendly and I never have to wait super long for my order.  Probably one of the best Starbucks in the city.

Drove to this location hoping to get my coffee at the beginning of our trip, and they decided not to show up to work! Online it said they open at 5am, here it was close to 7 with no indication they'd be in anytime soon.

Wish I could give them a negative star. The worst service from Blake and Tarious a couple of two incompetent individuals, and if Starbucks have any business sense they would fire their asses. Sat at the counter waiting on Blake to take my order, after 3 mins he looked like he was flustered. I gave him two Starbucks mugs and he asked if I needed a bag. Well of course I'm in the airport about to take a flight. Then we ordered two ice coffees and then the drama began. He didn't write our names down and then we waited another 20 mins before I asked where our order was. No apologies so I asked that they chaged it from a small to a large for making us wait. They laughed and played it off, so after another 10 mins Tarious served the small and when I  asked where was the medium he said he could because we ordered a small. I said we didnt order this long wait time either. We asked for a manager but of course no manger, so we asked for our $33 refund to our cc and he snatched the receipt and continued to make drinks. After we saw that no one attempted to start the refund process my husband asked were they going to refund our money.  Tarious was rude and called my husband a "Bro" that we had to wait on the manager to come because they couldn't do it. Finally another worker stepped up and refunded our card. Long story short, I will be moving over to Team Pete's Coffee, bye bye Starbucks!

Only me second time in this location.  We had to wait a little bit before somebody asked for our order, but it was a little busy, so it was understandable.   The two grande mochas were made to perfection as was the strawberry refresher.

When it comes to Starbucks, the speed and quality of service and taste of drink may vary per store, so at this location...

Service: Speed (Average), Quality (Good)
Taste: Green Tea Frap (regular deliciousness), Pumpkin Spiced Latte (a bit watery)

We'll see what I try next!

This is right by my house and I go here ALL the time! :) It is in a convenient location and there is always ample parking. Their drinks are always made properly and they always have a great food selection! :) The people who work here are also very friendly. 

Their service can a hit or miss depending on who you get. Usually, things are delivered in a timely manner but there's been times they have just forgotten that they will forget my order all together. Two examples- 1) We ordered a bunch of bagels for work the other day and asked that one be heated and given to me to eat now. The barista made all the other bagels first and THEN decided to make the one for now. 2) A couple of weeks ago, we ordered 2 sandwiches to go and didn't get it. When we asked in about ten minutes they acknowledged forgetting. In the former case, we were the first people in the Starbucks that morning. In the latter case, it was extremely busy.

I agree with the reviews; avoid the drive through and plan to head inside to order. Once inside though I've never run into any concerns. Very friendly baristas, newly renovated and the baristas are always looking out for you and make you feel welcome and at ease. Yesterday I had a birthday reward that expired too quickly from last Thursday that they still honored; appreciated that immensely.
My favorite Starbucks in stl always friendly and kind. My order has always been fast and hot. They are awesome

Came her for a necessary caffeine fix and quick brekkie after dropping off my car at the dealership for service. I like the open space of the cafe. Ordered a grande caramel coffee (hot) and my only complaint is that the barista didn't ask me if I needed room for cream. I should have remembered to ask for it too . So when I got my coffee it was filled to the brim and it overflowed and I had to ask for another cup (Disclaimer: I haven't had my coffee yet so I'm super slow) so this was a tad annoying. I also got the sou vide bacon egg and a birthday cake pop of course which was yummy. I would definitely come back here again because it's convenient and I like the vibe.

I tried to avoid the extremely slow service at this location by doing a mobile order but that made it even worse. The beverage came out in the right order but the bistro box and hot breakfast sandwich were ignored no one had even pulled the items off of the mobile ordering printer and so I asked about it and then it took forever.
Twice I've done a mobile order with plenty of time and an extremely un-busy hour only to arrive to pick up and the order wasn't even taken off the machine/ never using this location again

The spinach feta wrap is always delicious.  I can't say I'm super excited about the flat white however.  It was, well, flat.  Tasted like hot milk with a wee bit of coffee.  Maybe that is what is is supposed to be, but I need more coffee impact!!  I say meh.

This Starbucks is thoroughly and consistently awful. The line is always long which I'm pretty sure is because everyone that works here is moving as slowly as possible. Once you've waited the approximately 20 minutes for your beverage, it will taste burnt and probably won't even be correct. Also if you order food there is a decent chance they will forget about it all together. 

It's hard to believe Starbucks is ok with this kiosk representing their brand as such. I guess when they're always busy and making money, who cares?

Do yourself a favor and walk down to the Nordstrom EBar. Their coffee is far superior and their customer service is exceptional.

First, I will start out saying that what I'm writing here reflects my views of most Starbucks locations that I visit however, in all fairness to the establishment I won't say they're all like this. 

Consistently inconsistent due to time of day, location, and barista I feel. 

I come here quite often as it's not outside my normal circle of travel. I decided to go with two stars on the rating because I'm not really happy with my drinks here. I feel like the only time my order is correct, is at night when it's slow. I've noticed that the barista's will intentionally make my order wrong if I've ordered something they don't agree with or they feel they are pressed for time. My drink usually isn't filled to the top either. So not only is my drink wrong but it's less than what I've paid for as well. 

On many occasions I've had to argue to get my drink remade. Strange considering "The barista promise" advertised on their cups. 

All in all the people are mostly friendly but their service and attention to detail lacks. I don't mind waiting for good quality service and a correct order but I get really frustrated with the opposite and an excuse attached. Sadly, I've come to expect my order to be wrong at this location. As we all know, it's easy to see our orders being made from the drive thru in any standard size vehicle or while standing inside, my accusations of my drink being incorrect don't come from me guessing. Let's not forget my taste buds know too.

I don't want this to be all bad so I will end with this- the location has great customer and is extremely clean. About three days ago they did give me two free drinks because I forgot my wallet and the Starbucks app wasn't working properly for me to pay using my phone. Thank you for that.

Out of all the Starbucks. This one is actually one of my faves... half because It's right next to the lab I work on my thesis in.  

But on a more real note - this place is PACKED.  8 am coffee in 10 minutes? Forget it.  Order ahead is a must!  

They do have a wider variety of snacks, mugs, and sandwiches but parking sucks since it's on campus and you have to really be *on campus* to get it.

I have to say I've developed quite the Starbucks addiction lately (I blame the baby-she loves soy chai lattes!) and this Starbucks has really been pulling through. The service at the drive thru and inside is always fast and super friendly. Top this all off with the perfect drink and food order each time and you've got yourself a great start to the morning!
Business as usual! The staff is friendly and cooperative, they kept up well on a busy Friday night. All the orders were made as requested!

All Starbucks are some variation of the same. The servers are all nice here, and like many places they are bad at spelling names. But they try.

The space is nice here. They have a fair amount of seating upstairs and a small amount outside for those nice days.

I had read about the Secret menu, which has so many items it's hard to believe all Starbucks can really accommodate the requests. On this day, I found that to be the case. I asked for an Oreo Cookie Frap. I was told, "Well, we don't really have Oreo Cookies." But, they did suggest the closest thing which was pretty tasty.

Anyway, the problem with Starbucks, all of them, this one included, is they are too pricey. I had a giftcard, so whatev, I went.

Nothing but good things to say. I am constantly here, and I have never had a bad experience with the staff or the food/drinks. Sometimes I come in after a very long day at work, and the simple kindness of one of the staff members asking me how I am doing is enough to make me feel better. Love the Clover...not sure what I'd do without my iced Willow!!!
Bottom line: This is the best Starbucks in the city!

Worst Starbucks ever!!!!!! 
 
It's not clean n  half of the staff are rude n guess what if u need the restroom they will ask for an ID even thou ur loyal customer  !!!!!!!!!!!!

Slowest starbucks. Went to drive thru today and it was bad service again.  One time I waited several minutes for someone to just come on speaker at the drive-thru but ended up driving away. Told myself never to go back after that and I absolutely will never go back now.

The absolute worst experience at a Starbucks I've ever had.  The manager was having a conversation while th an employee as 30 people wait for service. Another employee was loading croissants while the line and wait continue to grow. 2 people were making drinks while others stood around.  Then after my 30 min wait I get the wrong drink. I could not wait in line any longer. I hope this place gets shut down. Worst run store I have ever seen.

Starbucks is what it is. But this is the worst location. I would like some friendly service with my over priced coffee.  Still 2 (not 1) stars because the overpriced coffee is just as good as any other Starbucks.
Insanely slow for any Starbucks - let alone an airport one.  Lines have consistently gotten worse, but service speed as stayed stagnant over the past couple years.

I end up going here most mornings because it is the closest to my house. The parking lot at that end of the shopping center isn't fantastic, but you will always find a spot. Sometimes the line is out the door and sometimes it is fairly empty, but it's never so busy that it's not worth waiting. This Starbucks doesn't seem to handle volume as well as most of the other Starbucks I've been to and occasionally seem frazzled- granted, those are downtown and probably much more used to high volume. They have a normal selection of food, drinks, and items to buy. I also saw Starbucks' sugar-free vanilla syrup in their shop, which I don't see often in the stores and usually end up ordering online. They seem to run out of things more often than other Starbucks, like cup carriers or the lid stoppers sticks (not sure what the technical term is for those things).

I wouldn't come to this Starbucks to do work- they have a small number of tables and it always seems cramped and loud. Most times when I'm there, there are no tables open. I also notice that my normal order costs more at this Starbucks than other Starbucks by about a dollar- I think because they actually charge for the extras (soy milk, flavored syrup, etc.) while most other Starbucks I frequent don't charge me for them. But overall, it's a decent Starbucks and the main one in the area- the only other one that I know of nearby is the Starbucks in the Target near Brinton Lake.
The service is super slow! They need to work on that! It took me 11min to get my chocolate muffin warmed up! Meh

The gals here are always smiling & super friendly! Even though it's always crazy busy when I come in, service is pretty quick! There is patio seating if you want to enjoy the sun & fresh air, and free WiFi too! Make sure you sign up for their rewards program to get free drinks & stuff...
Always a great experience.  Service was quick and I'm liking the special Christmas blend coffee.

When I work full time, I like to come here during my lunch break; the friendly people always make my day better! When you come around lunch time, there may be a bit of a wait, but I think it's worth it for your afternoon pick-me-up and smiles!

Starbucks seems out of place in an academic library. And there is nowhere to sit, The drinks are on par with any other Starbucks - but with two Tim Hortons just outside the library on the same floor, this seems redundant.

Let me just start by saying that I love Starbucks!  I continue to frequent this location due to it's convenience on my drive to work.  With that said, I continue to be disappointed Starbucks - you rarely provide me napkins when I order food.  And yes, I am guaranteed to spill something in my car.  You have also stopped giving me my receipts - or even asking if I want it.

I honestly don't know why there are only bad reviews for this Starbucks when I've had nothing but positive experiences at this location. I mostly order my drinks through the app and it's always been ready by the time I get there and if I made a mistake ordering, they quickly fix my drink without hesitation. The customer service at this location is on point. I always make an effort to come to this location even if it's a tad bit further because the customer service is so awesome. Hopefully everyone else who had bad experiences will have better ones in the future.

I came here around the middle of May and had no problem using my Gold Card. I actually came here with a large group on Saturday, and they were quite efficient with our orders. 

We were only visiting the area, so I am not sure I'll come back just because of that. But if you're from around the area, I'd recommend. They have board games too.

Perfect location, just a 15 second walk to Rittenhouse Square.   The set up is good, with comfy chairs lined up along the windows and a communal table in the back.  

Taking down one star because there are too few plugs at the communal table - the seat to plug ratio is probably 3:1.  Like some of the other sbux in the city, this joint can sometimes be over air conditioned or under heated so it can get chilly.  Layer if in doubt!

I have a gripe or two with this location, mainly and lately, it's downright hot in there. I don't know what the problem is, but it seems like the air conditioning isn't even on. When I asked about it, the employee said it was because the door was open a lot. 

Oddly, I remember being cold at this same location during the winter, when the air conditioning ran continuously, seemingly unaware that it was 35 degrees outside. We once when outside on a cold day to get warm because it was so cold in the Starbucks! 

So, folks who have the key to the thermostat: Keep it cozy in the winter and refreshingly cool in the summer. Easy-peasy. That way, people who come to your establishment, buy things, stay awhile and want to come back.

I disagree with Kara.  This is not the worst Starbucks in the area and actually has one of the nicest coffee lounge spaces in town.  Tall lofted ceilings look out to Mt Rose and the surrounding Summit Sierra Mall.  It's actually a very scenic location.  The coffee is like every other Starbucks, good but not great.
Starbucks... they're all the same. I always get the same drink, made accurately. The only thing that ever changes in the service and this one is a shining star!

Hey, this review is my 600th!

I was exploring New Orleans by streetcar one day. I decided to get off the streetcar that ran along Canal Street.

I walked around for a while. A note to myself: I need to avoid walking around outside in September, when it is hot and muggy!

So, sweating buckets, I decided that it was time to hibernate in an air-conditioned place. I spotted this Starbucks and went inside.

I love this cafe. It's charming. There is lots of wood accents and brick. The lighting is perfect. I liked the music that was playing.

I ordered an iced green tea. Staff were courteous and nice. I sat down and did some people-watching.

The windows at this cafe are huge. I got a good view of the intersection of Canal Street and St. Charles Avenue.

It was good to relax and take cover in a cooler environment.

(16)

Nice new Starbucks just off US-31 in Carmel. This growing strip mall now boasts a Wild Eggs, Juice Bar, Fresh Indian Grill, dry cleaners and a massage place. This means the parking lot may be rather full, depending on the time of your visit.

This Starbucks has an interesting layout - it's long and narrow which is a semi-awkward layout. I like the high ceilings and modern decor. The seating seems more conducive for individuals or pairs than large groups, though. 

Limited merchandise area (coffee beans, mugs, etc) and the refrigerated case is a little sparse, too. 

Service was fast and friendly on my visit. I would return again given its convenient location.

*Note there is no drive thru here :(

I like to come here on my days off when I am not in a rush. Their staff is very pleasant and can spell my name right...haha.Their drive thru is very slow sometimes even when it is not a super long line, not sure why?!

I've been here three times. I've ordered iced Americanos each time. Every single time they have added sweetener to them without being asked to. I've never had this problem at any other Starbucks in the WORLD. Please just make the drinks according to Starbucks rules.

/whitewhine

The employees at this starbucks are awful. Simple requests made drinks worse. All i ask was for to shake the drink.. one dude said he did when clearly the green tea sat on the bottom of the cup. And the girl dumped out the drink out of anger, and remade a drink that was no bueno.
Great Starbucks in the area. They have a team of wonderful and friendly staff. The place is a bit on the smaller side, but it is rather cozy.

Been coming here quite frequently to study and the staff continues to impress me. They are all very helpful and now that they recognize...I've been treated to few baked goods that were extra. Can't beat that!

This place rocks the frappuccino.  They are fast, and no quality is spared.  It seems unnecessarily dark in here, but the baristas know what they are doing - and I think they know it too.  Try the mocha coconut frappuccino.  Delicious!

I'm used to quality service, came back from Europe where baristas are awesome. I drive about 15 minutes to get to this Starbucks and their service is getting worse every time I come here. Two days in a row I asked for a brownie and chocolate chip cookie at 845 pm and they are out of it. Those are two main things a coffee shop should have... Coffee was good tho.. So I will be taking my business else where, can't go to red lion and blvd or the one inside target which is the worst of them all.. Probably try Abington area next time.
Exceptional service and great food and coffee as always!  A very positive environment created by friendly, and service oriented staff.

I come from a Starbuck's family (ie we do not run on Dunkin).  I've always had excellent service at Starbucks, so I was shocked at this location.  

I was in need of a caffeine fix, so I run over to this Starbucks somewhere between 7 & 8pm.  I know that some Starbucks locations only make individual servings of brewed coffee after a certain time (I think 8pm), which is strange, but fine.  
I go to this Starbucks and ask the woman for a bold coffee, "We're out of that.  Would you like Pike's instead".  My response, "fine."  ...a few seconds pass and she's standing there with a cup, "We don't have enough for a full cup.  Would you like an Americano instead?"  

Here's what I wanted to say, "Are you kidding me?  That word after Starbucks, the last time I checked, was COFFEE!!!  I want you to get your lazy behind back there and brew another damn cup!!"

Here's what I said, "fine."  

ARG!!

What happened to the days when if Starbucks dropped the ball, you got a coupon for a free cup?

This Starbucks is slightly below average, I would say. The parking is very limited, and it can be tough getting on and off of 82nd St. The inside is nice, but on the smaller side. Most of the seating is for 2 people. The noise level here is not too bad, though - I think the higher ceiling helps. Service is average - baristas are friendly, but this is consistently slower service than at other Starbucks in the Indy area.
I really never had any bad experience with Starbucks in general.  This one is OK too. I enjoy coming here because it's inside the mall & very convenient.

You will never want for coffee in this area of Philly!!!! There are three Starbucks right here around me. This one just happens to be facing my hotel so its the easiest to access. When you walk in the people are friendly. They acknowledge you as you walk in. Yesterday the service was a little slow but this morning i had my coffee right away.

It is your typical Starbucks in appearance, so I won't go into that.  The employees were nice, occasionally there were some conversations behind the counter that I was taken aback by, which actually surprised me.  But my mocha was good and I was able to snag a nice comfy chair with a foot rest so I could kick back while writing on my tablet.  The only bad thing about this location is that it was my first time there and I passed by it on Manchester the first time.  I had to turn on my GPS to figure out I had already passed it and turn around.  So careful if you aren't paying attention (or to the wrong side of the road, look to the South) then you'll miss it.

I frequent this Starbucks a lot  because it's on a route I take daily in the mornings. I noticed the same as some other reviewers, that the baristas are not as friendly as other locations. Their personalities are just blah without that sunshiny smile you get at other locations. I have crossed paths with the manager in several occasions and she seems impatient and short -almost rude, then she tries to fix it with a smile. For instance, I was standing at the register and she went to the other register and took my order about 4 feet away without inviting me to the proper register first. Then I placed my order, she asked for my name and I was busy asking about the $8 cost for my drink. She had zero patience, did not respond to my inquiry and asked me again what my name was.  I even saw her hanging out at a table outside chatting as if she were a customer. Weird.

I'm a big Starbucks fan, and have frequently become a regular at 4 different ones between South Philly, Center City and Old City.

This one isn't one of the best, but when I've gone there during a busy hour or even a slower time, they've always been pretty quick about taking orders and getting them made well and fast.

I wish this location would get it together! 
Half the time items are unavailable, the workers have attitudes, or my order is incorrect. I only keep coming back here since it's the only one close to the neighborhood.

I've only been to this location a few times but it's going to be my new sanctuary. I had a corner to myself and it was very quiet. I don't think I've ever been to a starbucks that had two floors. It could use a few more outlets but it was great other than that. Maybe it was just uncrowded for me because all of the students are gone for the summer.
Perfect for eating your felafel from Felafel Truck right outside. You get the experience of a restaurant but the price of a food truck. I always buy a Starbucks to just so I don't feel awkward! Lol

Coming from New York my standards are high... Not only is the service slow as molasses but mid way though my iced coffee I almost choked on the Baristas turquoise HAIR!!! I literally had to pulled it out of my throat. The most horrifying experience ever! Just the thought of it sitting in my coffee the entire time gives me the chills.. On top of the fact I had to pry it out of my throat. 

The gentlemen before me had returned his cappuccino because he found a hair in his cup too. What are the Chances that the same thing happen to me. I've been coming to Starbucks for years and never ever has this happened. Being a female I understand that our hair falls out all the time but as an establishment that Handles food and beverages this should never happen. I'm so very disappointed!

The staff in this location are great always friendly welcoming. It is a very small location and sometimes very cramped so unless it's not a grande pike I am ordering I pre order through the app!! I love this!!! In the summer they have a patio that is nice to sit in no way would I chill inside and have a coffee way to cramped!

This has always been my go to Starbucks since it's on my way to work. Their service is getting worse and worse, don't put someone at the register to take order if they don't know what they are doing. I have a discount code for my sandwich which I provided it for her, and she used my starbucks reward instead. I can't eat cheese and they have always taken that off the sandwich for me, her first response is we don't do that. $10 for a cup of coffee and sandwich, Starbucks you really need to do better than that.

Not sure what Precious is talking about. I've always found the service and staff here to be above and beyond at this location. Baristas are always super friendly and get my drink out quickly even when they are slammed. 10/10 will continue to visit this store
Usually friendly-the ones who've been there the longest remember me when I was a daily customer at this location (now go to S. Howard location daily). Usually make the coffees right...usually busy.

Service is fast and friendly, they always have you in and out quickly so that you can start enjoying your drink. This is my closest and most favorite location in Tucson. This last year they had a remodel and it looks beautiful. I have never received a less than great drink from any of the staff even during a busy rush.

Staff was rude. Items not available & attitude was crappy. Staff was more concerned w their own beverages, their own personal calls & their cell phones than w the customer.

Guy that waited on me had an attitude-didnt want to explain anything & didnt make drink the way i asked. Snack i wanted was not available & his attitude was....attitude.

Female staff member was on a personal call when i arrived. 10min later she was sitting out frnt eating & drinking & on her cell phone. 

Outside tables filthy. Worst starbucks ive ever been in.

My orders are consistently wrong, and the drive thru time is annoying.The staff is always friendly and kind, but everything is done in a shaky disorganized way that makes me wonder what's going on behind the scenes. Maybe they're often shorthanded? I don't know. 

Last week I woke up early enough before work to visit this Starbucks. I ordered a grande iced coffee with cream. They gave me a venti, which I suppose was nice, but it had no cream. I decided not to mess with correcting them, then got a few blocks away and realized they hadn't given me a straw. This is a typical visit for me.

This is a cozy location with a lot of nice shops around it. The interior is plesant with room to move. It seems clean and bright. 
Staff here are kind and helpful and make a lot of good suggestions for those who don't come here often as I saw with a lady ahead of me. But for me they knew what I was saying and we're super helpful when I could not decide on a desert to eat. I ended up with a brownie warmed up and it was perfect for this cold day in YEG. 
I got a grande London fog half sweet and lactaid milk. It was made perfectly to my liking and nicely brewed.
My friend got a vente vanella latte and he really liked his too. 
Either way we sat here having good conversation and not a single issue. 
The only reason I'm not giving full stars is because the first lady who helped me seemed like she was misserable and not as kind.
19 minutes on drive thru... On a Saturday. There was only 2 cars in front of me. When we got the order the cups had hair on them. Yup... Never again. Beyond pissed off at this point.
Always messes mobile orders. Employees don't even look like they know what they're doing. Worst Starbucks ever
They don't make Cafe Misto here and only one person works at a time.

I usually don't partake in Starbucks, but during cram season, it's my saviour. I'll usually stop in for a cheese croissant or a double bagged awake tea (tastes terrible but does the job) when I'm studying. It's proximity to the library is really the best, especially when I can't spare the extra five minutes to go to Timmy's.
If you've been to Starbucks before, you know the drill. The staff is friendly, and there's a decent amount of room to sit with friends, or by yourself.
Nice coffee shop... Very friendly staff that helped me with my decision. I would defiantly recommend this coffee shop to anyone that loves coffee the way I do!!

Sometimes they have bags of dried coffee bean husks available (for free!) to use as compost/fertilizer in your garden, and that's really cool.  Otherwise, it's a Starbucks, so you probably know what to expect. It's worth noting that there's not a whole lot of parking available and the drive thru can be a bit precarious.

I think just about every business could take some lessons from Starbucks. They really know how to hire and train their employees to offer exceptional customer service.  

This location happens to be the closest to home so I frequent them often enough although typically through the drive-thru. Weekday mornings I'm often greeted with a very long drive-thru line but it moves super fast! 

I was disappointed this morning when I ordered my venti iced half-caff Americano and a slice of their fabulous low-fat cinnamon streusel coffee cake only to be told they no longer carry it as they've changed their bakery items. The guy on the mic told me the classic coffee cake was very similar and really good. Asked if I wanted to try it so I said sure. Turns out he really did mean TRY it, because it was free! Nice!! **unfortunately it doesn't compare to their much better cinnamon streusel cake. Oh well.

So I think I'll be on the hunt for a new favorite in their baked goods but in the mean time, thanks Starbucks!

This new location is small and does not have a large area inside of the strip mall, but a table is usually available. The store staff are always friendly and personable and consistently get my orders correct, and the inside of this store is kept extremely clean. 

This location is clearly run well.

i think i'm addicted to the sugar free cinnamon dulce syrup ...  what can i say - starbucks has taken over the world. whatever ! they have the same tasting coffee at all (well most) locations - it's affordable and you know what you're getting.
Would give zero stars. But can't. Closes at 9. Went at 7:30. Was told "no more coffee". Insane. Thought that was a Starbucks. Guess I was wrong.

This used to be my favorite place to go to for coffee since they opened.  I frequent this place every day that I'm working at the hospital.  However, in the last few months I've had many more negative experiences than I've had good.  Some of the staff is great. Some of the staff are like robots.  I've had to get my beverage corrected quite a few times.  For as much money as the beverages are, they shouldn't have to be corrected.  It isn't consistent.  I'm not basing my review on just one time.  But for example, today I ordered a vanilla chai and it was cooler than lukewarm.  Not how I want to drink my $5+ beverage.  So I went back to have it corrected.  Temperature was great.  However, the taste was off.  I had to go back to work and I didn't want to be those people to complain yet again about my beverage if the first two people couldn't do it right.  My egg bites that I ordered requested sriracha hot sauce.  I didn't realize it until I got to work that there were no sriracha hot sauce packets with my egg bites.  Talk about a bad morning!  I had a very bad morning today. This Starbucks is not what it used to be.


Editing to add that I did notice the barista noticing that he made a mistake the first time when he dumped the cold milk in my tea.  I didn't realize that was what happened until later.  He knowingly made the mistake and didn't care to make it over again until I complained.  These new Starbucks employees at this location don't care anymore.  They aren't like the old staff.  
And my second drink tasted a little better when I got more to the middle of the drink. I guess it wasn't really mixed well.   Bring back the old staff and management.

Newer location. Great efficient drive-thru with very friendly staff. Moves very quickly so you're never waiting long. 

Love this Starbucks but the entrance/exit stinks especially if you are heading south on  73. Since this isn't their fault i won't knock off any stars.

The staff at this Starbucks is always friendly and helpful. I had to give up caffeine and was not badgered in any form or fashion for ordering my decaf-non-fat-sugar-free latte. In fact, my barista gave me lots of ideas on other tasty decaf drinks I should try. 
I also want to take this opportunity to tell you to Pay It Forward- the last time I visited Starbucks the silver van in front of me paid for my order. I do this too every now and then, just never understood how good the receiving end could feel until this day. Give it a try and make somebody's day.

First of all, I like Starbucks. It is consistently decent coffee, no matter where you are in the world. I've had it in the bowels of southern Virginia, I've had it in the bizarre no-man's-lands of Austria, it's always the same, and it's always just fine. So you'll get no Starsucks hatery from me.

That said, I have never, ever, anywhere in the world, encountered a Starbucks as shitty as this.

They are incompetent and they are slow. You can stand there witha line out the door, and watch the 5 baristas behind the bar talking, looking confused, trying to get other people to do their stuff, and generally displaying zero ability to multitask. They never have two baristas on the machines, and I've rarely seen any barista make two drinks at a time. For perspective, my brother is a Starbucks barista, and he regularly has 4-5 drinks going at a time. Why? Because he's competent, and he knows how to get some speed on it.

Just today, at a slow point with only one person ahead of me and two behind me, I went to get an Americano. I stood in line waiting for the cashier to finish talking to the man in front of me about parking spots, while literally holding his change in her hand and just talking to him, for minutes. When she finished, she turned around and recounted some of it to the barista behind her, ignoring the line, for another full minute. Once she finally turned around and I got to order, pay, and stand at the bar waiting for my drink, I was treated to the stoned-looking barista strolling around working on the latte of the guy ahead of me, getting it just right, joking with him, and getting him some ice water, all while my cup sat empty. It's nice that she engaged him, but anyone with a clue and some hustle would have had the espresso brewing into that cup while they were doing all the rest.

I was a bartender and a barista, and the appalling slowness of all of these people would have gotten me fired from ANYwhere.

As a result, I now go to the Starbucks at 19th and Chestnut. They are speedy and competent there, and when I joke about the 18th and Market one, they laugh knowingly and tell me how often they hear that.

It's not just me. Avoid this branch, go another block to 19th and Chestnut and patronize good service.
This place is gangster. Light of my life. Best Starbucks ever. If you're a hater then go somewhere else. This place doesn't need you making the line longer anyway.

This Starbucks is in the former Village Coffee location. It is an amazing location right by Tulane and Loyola Universities in Uptown New Orleans. It's a Starbucks and not too unique from any other location. The staff is great just like at the other locations. This is a double decker so you have some seats on the main floor, but you also have the upper deck if you want quiet work or study away from the ingress and egress of customers and away from the equipment that makes coffee shop noises. This is likely to be a very busy location when classes are in session but you can hit it at slow times too. But you never know from August to May when universities are in session exactly who will be there and when. In the early morning it's usually people on their way to work so it shouldn't be too insanely busy. The mid-day once class begins and when students are on break you will find them studying on the upper deck so please respect their quiet time. Thank you!

Working for Starbucks, I've had different experiences when I go to different stores around the United States. So I came to this one, cuz this one is the closest one around. Luckily, I had Donna as my barista today. She was extremely nice and friendly and genuine, which is what I normally do not find out here in the east coast. We had a friendly conversation which people out here don't like to have haha it's nice to know Starbucks from the West Coast and Starbucks in the East, have the same core values. Thank you Donna and this store. P.s., my wife has been looking all over for a peppermint mocha that was good. And this store hit the spot. Thank you.

New Starbucks in Carmel near Meijer.  The inside was beautiful with lots of space. Exposed pipes, that kind of vibe.  Seating was facing the windows so that was a little awkward just to get to the seat. For all the space there really wasn't that much indoor seating.  No drive thru so they may find that they could use some extra seating. 

Service was great! The person who helped me was nice and efficient and got the order right. 
Our drinks and food came out quick. 
Everything was toooooooo hot though. Scalding hot coffee -much hotter than other Starbucks and the food was just too hot. I'm sure they will figure that piece out though. 
Great addition to the area. I'm glad to have it here

I'm a basic bitch that loves Starbucks so I will leave nothing positive reviews! Service is pretty good for the center city location! It sucks that it's pretty crowded but that's not their fault! Bigger location would help but that wouldn't keep me from coming back and getting my ice cold latte!

I went there for the first time in the new location. Well I tend to only go to Starbucks when I'm at the airport, I've always been impressed with customer service as well as the quality of the product. Today there was 5 people behind the counter I place my order for Cappuccino ended up with a half-filled cup of coffee that they put on the counter may have said my name if they did they didn't look at me and left me standing there as the only person in the store until someone finally realized that I was still waiting on my coffee and said this one must be yours. I stood there for at least 3 two four minutes walking around the store and looking at the people behind the counter who ignored me. Finally the grown up realized that I had not been served and I did appreciate that. Needless to say I won't be back.

This was the dirtiest Starbucks I think I have ever been to.  I'm typically a huge fan of Starbucks. I love knowing what I'm getting when I'm out traveling, so Starbucks offers that consistency.  This was the exception. The Barista who took my order had a filthy light blue hat on...I mean disgustingly filthy.  It looked like it had been fished out of a dumpster.  I don't think her Starbucks apron had EVER been cleaned.  There was a Starbucks employee ordering from her in front of me while on his break.  He smelled like he had not showered, his clothes were also dirty and his hair was a mess.  He then went behind the counter to help after his order.   This is a Starbucks Kiosk in the Tampa International Plaza mall, and although very small, it was in complete disarray. Line stanchions where not set up, the baskets and shelves of Starbucks items for sale where all clustered inside inside the stanchions so they could not be shopped.  It really seemed like the employees really didn't care.  I won't be back to this location.

Great location in the business district.  I was staying at the Ritz a couple blocks down for a work meeting so I'd walk over in the morning to get some coffee before the day started.  The staff was friendly every time I was there, and when I redeemed my birthday drink one morning the cashier gave me an extra smile and wished me a happy birthday, which was a nice little touch.

Beware, though the lines are long.  The first morning I went I think I waited almost 10 minutes to order my drink and then nearly another 10 to get my drink.  They were working fast, there was just a lot of people ordering drinks and food.  I cut down on some of that the next day by using mobile order and pay, so I'd order when I left the hotel, but even still I had to wait a few minutes once I got there for my drink.  It wasn't a huge deal, and once I knew I planned for it, but the lines were long every morning I went, so be prepared.

Right at the bottom of an office building and surrounded by other offices I am continuously amazed as to how quickly and efficiently the staff moves, and how friendly they are even remembering regular customers.  My seven-year-old occasionally comes with me and while on occasion she is hard to take they always treat her so very kind and graciously. When it seems like there's a Starbucks on just about every street corner you expect him personal robots only know you when they're collecting your money that is not the case at this location.

Charged my card twice /different amounts  when I went thru drive thru they had my card for longer when normal and I had to drive back latter to get refund no apology or anything like it was my fault they messed up. Definitely the worst Starbucks experience I've had. Also they didn't give my receipt or ask if I wanted one shoulda known as usually they ask
Clean, modern, friendly service. This is the best Starbucks location in Philadelphia.

Now that Ikes is gone there are not many places to hang out over coffee nearby, but I had to meet someone here once and I'm glad I did. There's a huge table that can be used for groups.

I was ready for a discussion on race but I was the only minority in here for the hour I stayed.

One in a million chance you will get a good coffee. Never consistent with their quality. The line is usually long, but even if it is short it still takes a very long time to get through it. Nice workers there, but like I said coffee is not their strong suit. Even though that's what Starbucks is known for.

Slow service. Waited 15 minutes in the drive thru for one drink. There were no cars in the parking lot, so there should've been no reason for that long of a wait in the drive-through for one drink. Not sure what was going on inside, but they need to step up their game if they're going to perform like every other Starbucks instead of performing like a Dunkin' Donuts
Its Starbucks.. what can I say. Parking can be tricky. It was one of the first ones in the NOLA area.
Staff is pretty good, but this Starbucks is always hot and humid! I can't stay here for more than 10 min which stinks bc it's the closest to my house.
This is the best Starbucks in Pniladelphia, hands down.  friendly staff, fast, beautiful interior -- pick this one when you come to Philly.

Gotta say... I've been in this Starbucks for no more than 15 min and I find it filled with very friendly staff. Leana gave me a free double shot of a white bean/white chocolate frap. Little barstool area at the barista counter makes it a very comfortable replacement of drinking with a bartender!

It's bittersweet having a Starbucks so close! I love their lattes! The staff are friendly, and some are still learning at this new location. I try to limit my visits to once a week, but it's so hard!!

I got to Starbucks at 6:20 and they were not open yet. I asked the worker who was smoking outside at what time they opened and he said around 6:30 or 7 implying that they did not have a set time for opening and closing. 

When I have gotten there and it is opened. The overweight white man with a scruff has been ridiculously rude. Rolling his eyes at customers including myself. So sad to feel uncomfortable at my local Starbucks!!! I think that he's the manager.

If you don't enjoy people giving you attitude, avoid this place!

I've been to Starbucks on 3 continents and never had a soy latte with mealy, whey-looking, black and white chunks floating in the drink. But apparently the NOLA canal crew is used to this, as they more than eagerly pointed out how all their soy milk has floating chunks. Obviously they think this is normal and not a refundable offense for a $6 drink.  If you're from anywhere else with a reasonable expectation of coffee service, I suggest getting the coffee in the hotel lobby.

Ok I disagree with all of these people who think the baristas are bad. They are the ONLY baristas west of the river that can steam milk properly. They know my name, and my drink, and they have only messed it up once. They are also friendly and make small talk - it makes my mornings happier. This is my Starbucks of choice.

Generally pretty good but today was off...
Ordered a Venti latte and received a grande chai tea. Ordered a venti pike one cream...hard to mess that one up right ?? WRONG, they forgot to add the cream ! 
Come on guys. I pay good money for a coffee. I expect you to get it right. !

Love Starbucks coffee and generally the service is pretty quick but this place is slooooow. The barista seemed like he knew how to make the drinks he just moved really really slow. There were only 5 not too special drinks in front of me and it took 17 mins to get mine. Every other Starbucks I've been to would have blown 5 or 6 out 10 mins faster. Based on the previous reviews this seems like a common complaint. Sounds like a new manager is needed. Do yourself a favor and walk the extra block the next Starbucks. You'll have your drink in your hand sooner even with the extra walk.
Horrible service. Was told by employee to not even bother ordering because it was too close to closing time and she didn't have anything left.

Second time here during no high traffic time (around 2:30pm) and this is the slowest Starbucks I ever been too.
I hope they improve because it is a convenient location with easy parking and easy to get to.

Your run of the mill Starbucks straddling Terrytown and Gretna.  Sometimes I feel the service could be a little quicker, but it's not terribly slow.  It's located at a busy intersection and navigating around the winding parking lot can be a hassle during rush hour.  Nothing terribly bad or amazing about the place, just your basic $5 froufrou coffee shop.

Great place to get a coffee fix and read the news of the day! The Lattes are to die for‼get the non fat Venti it is only 150 calories. That is just a 2 mile walk tonight to lose it‼‼‼but it is worth it

The service here fails more often than not. I've submitted a couple of online orders, 3/4 of the time, the pastry is missing, the coffee isn't ready within the estimated time or they haven't even started working on the order until I arrive at the counter.  I waited a total of 12 minutes after my 4-9 minute estimate for a coffee...because 'oops, I guess  I missed the online order'.  

The service at the window isn't any better.  "hey, what can I get you?"  

Brush up on some customer service skills here, Starbucks.

This was my first trip back to this Starbucks since moving to Maplewood. When I lived in South City this was my go to location on my way to work each night and on my days off. In the past I always ordered ahead and they were great about always remembering that when I ordered nonfat I still wanted whipped cream and they always greeted me by name. Today I went through the drive thru and ordered a nonfat drink with whipped cream. When I got to the window they had my drink and the girl questioned why it had whipped cream when my ticket said without. The manager John told her he was sure it was supposed to have whipped cream and greeted me by name. I was really taken back by this since I haven't visited here in over 6 months. There is something to be said about someone that remembers your name and order after all that time. I may have to go out of my way more often to go to this location again.

One of the better starbucks. This place is quick and friendly. It is a typical starbucks, but there is not the usual long line. Walk 2 blocks away to the other starbucks and there is always a long line!
Drinks are always made well and quickly. Lattees, Mochas, Frappachinos- all delicious.

I'm surprised the ratings for this Starbucks are so low.  The baristas have been nothing but friendly.  I'd give this place five stars if the first floor wasn't so cramped up, if going to the second floor didn't mean the temperature went up 10 degrees and I lose cell reception, and if the first floor had window shades so I don't go blind sitting there as the sun rises in the morning.

I am a Starbucks regular, but this was my first visit here, and probably my last.
My visit was on 12/16/15, around 5 p.m. .
Ordered with Starbucks card (so they had my name!), sat very close by, and waited, waited, waited. I walked to pickup a few times to check for my drink. Nada. The place was almost empty, so why the big delay?  Third time I checked, the drink was set back on the pickup counter, as if someone forgot and sneaked it there. This isn't a big place, I was sitting within earshot AND view...

I remarked "oh, I wasn't called" and barista was right there...no comment.
My caramel hazelnut latte was lukewarm , foamless, and truly bad. And I am not that fussy!

So much for Starbucks getting it right. They knew they had dropped the ball and were serving an Inferior product, but sneaked it out WAY back in the counter probably to make me the bad guy. I truly wasn't. I had checked 2 times before, and it had NOT been there. They were probably too busy chatting and OOPS left that drink on the BACK counter...sneak it out and pretend.

I often get more than one thing, and my tip app was still open. You can bet they got no tip...plus I am a very dissatisfied Starbucks customer.

Pros: I always hit this place at low traffic. Never waited more than 2-3 minutes for my tried and true Iced Coffee with cream, no sugar. Of course that -is- probably the quickest prep item there. The wifi is quick, regularly see downloads of 100-200K/sec from major sites. I do spend time here looking at my Serato Whitelabel releases and have no complaints. 

Cons: Store is anchored on east side of strip mall, which means the slim layout of the place + most of seating on the east can make for TOASTY morning visits during the summer even with the blinds down. The parking lot can feel be tricky at times, people drive way too fast through the narrow lanes so triple check before you back out of your spot when it is busy.

Baristas are all nice to me, so over time I've gotten to like this location even more. It's walking into a Cheers episode.
Nice place. always clean and staff is very friendly even when it gets hectic. Mornings are crazy .. its a lull between 9:30am and 11am

It makes sad to see such a busy store complained about but unfortunately the complaints are warranted. 
Most of the staff is extremely unfriendly and concerned more about getting their shift over with rather than providing an enjoyable experience. The trash is always overflowing. Trash and crumbs are all over the floor constantly. The bathrooms are always dirty and not taken care of. Although I spend time at this store, if I have the desire to sit and spend time, I travel further away to a cleaner and more friendly store. Also, it seems that whenever they get an order, they just leave the boxes in the lobby taking up one of the few tables they have. 75% of the time, it is hard to walk to the register because there is so much stuff filling small area. Customers do not want to see all the boxes taking up tables when they are looking for a place to sit.

The service at this Starbucks is relatively fast.  Baristas have always been friendly to me.  The two downsides to this location are that there is not a drive thru and the interior is small...it can get pretty crowded at times.

I have noticed a homeless man sitting in a booth in this Starbucks the past 5 or so times I have been in there.  I wish the staff would do something to help this man.  He has strong body odor and seems to be mentally ill.

This is a quaint location, hidden away in a tiny corner of the mall. The atmosphere is intimate and closed off from mall's open air environment. There's not a lot of seating, but there's plug outlets useful for electronics charging below the bench seating for those who linger in coffee shops with their devices. Mall entrance has a little more space, enough to fit in a stroller, but not to line up with it to allow for 2 way traffic flow. There's a larger selection of merchandise here than I've seen at other locations, and a decent amount of edibles available. It's nice they have 2 self service stations for cream & sugar on either side of lineup. The drink pick up end can get pretty crammed with people though. Because this location has a direct exit from the building & the other entrance is close to the mall's main entrance, it can get a little bit drafty in winter. Friendly service & quick moving lineup is a plus here too.

This is my favorite Starbucks and I go here as often as I can.  The baristas are always helpful and friendly and they fill my orders accurately.  The store is relatively new and spacious and very clean.  In addition, the customers are mostly nice and friendly.  I only wish I lived closer because the Starbucks nearest me is always crowded with slow service and less friendly customers and baristas.

Even though I like Coffee from other places more, preferably a non-franchise place, coffee is coffee. They have new items on the menu including choices of Vanilla Blonde. The barista made Vanilla Blonde Latte with soy milk and it was delish!

This is a busy startbucks. But I still love it! The coffee is great, and the staff is sweet. I came in during a not so busy weekday with my daughter ,ordered coffee and sat down to eat our panda express. The Barista came over a couple minutes later an offered an extra plate for my daughter (she was eating off a napkin because we were sharing food) and it just made me so happy that she was like looking out for us like that. It was a small random act of kindness that went a very long way. Something like that, says a lot about the business.I mean really, I didn't even know they had plates for customers to use! Anyways.  Its not just about the amaazziinngg coffee ;The staff is just as amazing!

This Starbucks isn't the usual Starbucks. They have very few selection. The smoothies was extremely great! My BF ordered an ice coffee something and it was too watered down. I wouldn't recommend this place unless you need something badly.
Contrary to other's rating. My experience here was decent. The only problem is that seats are often taken or too tight. Wish that there were more chairs and space.

This Starbucks literally has the nicest baristas ever! Came here on my usual trip down to Florida and was a little weary after my 14 drive because i had stopped at another location and wasn't happy. But these baristas really knew what they were doing! I couldn't decide on a drink and they were so patient and helpful! David really made my day! Top notch store, super clean! I will continue to come back every year!

The first ingredient in their "classic coffee cake" is sugar. Classic? Hmpf.

I wish they would post the ingredients to their other items. 

Their service and coffee are consistent and that has merit. 

While AT&T and Starbucks have partnered to bring wifi to their customers, it appears to be slower, consistently, than a dial up modem.

I am a firm believer in second chances.... Especially to businesses, because everyone can have an off day.... BUT time after time when I visit this location it's not up to the quality or service standards I get at other Starbucks.

Today when ordering something off their menu "vanilla blonde".... The barista/cashier had absolutely no idea what I was asking for... She made me feel dumb for ordering it, not a good way to start out my visit. ( hopefully she was just new and not 100% familiar with the menu yet )....

Then I wanted to make a second purchase.... ( trying to increase my stars on my rewards card ) and she says "you want more?".... Yes actually I do!!!! And it was a sandwich to accompany my coffee... So then I go and find a small little table to enjoy my coffee and sandwich and it was so loud.... I noticed I was near a speaker, so I got up and moved across the store... But still super loud... How was I supposed to get any studying done with music at that level... So outside I went, thank goodness I brought a scarf because it was chilly and very windy.

Then after I start to enjoy my sandwich.... It's cold.... Not cool... But cold! I brought it back up to the counter and the same cashier says "well we keep them in the fridge".. Ok that's great, but not the way you should talk to a customer... But I think it could have been the manager who brought me over a NEW and HOT sandwich and it was great... So giving credit when credit is due... Thank You.

I am will to give this location one more shot... But if they can't improve on their customer service, speed, and standards... I am willing to start driving to a farther location to give them my $5 a pop for coffee!!!!

Try teaching your employees to wait for a customer to leave before making fun of them. 3 kids working, I had to ask 3 times for milk before any of them heard(self service station had none). They were too busy chatting about people whining all day. As soon as I was given some creamer, I turned around and immediately heard one say "just like that".

I was SO happy when they opened this Starbucks! It's practically right downstairs from where I get monthly treatments! They are usually pretty busy since its surround by hospitals so all day long you'll see doctors and nurses standing in line, but I order through the mobile app and by the time I walk down to the Starbucks they almost always have my order ready and waiting! The staff is great; friendly, quick, efficient! This is by far my favorite Starbucks location!!!

It's Starbucks...need I say more!

No I'll be serious,  I visit this store three times a week.   I have said before I am a coffee junkie.  This place does it right every time.  I'm never let down by the staff or the products.  The goodies in the bakery case are awesome too.

The only thing negative I could say about this store would be the restroom. It's a male/female shared space.  I hate that!
I'm sure they did that for lack of space,  but if it's community shared, they need to keep it really clean and, one time I had no paper towels to dry my hands,  oh brother,  we have all been there!  

Otherwise,  I'll still be going back, but will use my "facilities" before leaving the house!

I am a permanent fixture in this Starbucks!  My morning commute would be absolutely horrific if I did not stop here!  There is no Drive Thru here, so I have no idea why there is a picture of one under this location.  

The baristas here are excellent!!  I come here so much that I don't even have to tell them what I want!  It's hilarious!! Depending on the time you get here, this location can have a line.  I came here on a Saturday morning at 10am and actually left because they were so busy.  I felt violated like I own the place.  hahaahaha!!  *I come here all the time, who are these strangers clogging up the place?* 

The service here is excellent!  But, some days there is a long line, most days I get in and out and there's no way to tell when.  You won't lose by coming here, that's for sure!

Decent S-Bucks. Compared to the 5 other Starbucks within a few blocks that I can think of off the top of my head, this one is far superior in its efficiency, which is probably because it's the most "off the beaten path." It's usually not stuffed with people, so you can actually sit if you feel like it, which I appreciate. 

One thing that baffles me is that even when it's not busy, the baristas ask your name and write it on the cup, but then call out the drinks being ready by the name of the drink, so I'm always awkwardly hovering, not knowing whether I should be listening for my name or for a shortened version of the name of the drink I just ordered (and might have forgotten?). But, spot on job otherwise, Starbucks on 18th and Spruce.

Disappointed with the drive thru service.  Very monotone, unfriendly and seemingly uninterested barista/cashier.   

The management should probably not have this guy as the "face" of the establishment at the drive thru.

Visit this location frequently. Always good service and my coffee comes just the way I order it. Would be 5 stars but I really wish it had a drive thru. Also, I'd like to note that Nick really goes above and beyond. Very friendly and efficient.

Unacceptably slow, shoddy service.  Seems like they don't like to fill mobile orders, for some reason -- the order-in-person line turned over multiple times this morning while i waited for a simple latte.  For 20 minutes.  The girl at the in-person line milled about sullenly when that line was empty and a cluster of people eating or waiting for orders bumped into each other like chickens bumbling around a stockyard.

I go to this Starbucks more than any other, and regret doing so every time.

I never met a Starbuck's that I didn't like.  Until this one.  They were shorted staffed the morning that we visiting.  Apparently, an employee had wandered off, leaving the other to fend for herself.

Service was decent considering.  Our beverages were good, but seriously, I was almost no longer in the mood.  That's how long it took to get them.
Easily the most expensive Starbucks in town. Yay! The employees are nice. So that gets an extra star. The iced tea I pay $3.50 for everywhere else in town is $4.55 here.

Some of the previous reviews on here or just plain silly no one at Starbucks ever asks for a tip. Yes it was a little on the slow side, but it's a small stand in a large mall food court . Its pretty much like every other Starbucks very busy and very efficient.

Love coming to this location. It's very convenient. Coffee is usually consistent, once last week it was very bitter but it's usually very good. I just wish they wouldn't forget my blueberries for my oatmeal. This morning was the 3rd time in a month.  I know I should have checked...which is my bad. I really wanted my blueberries this morning :-(

This particular location is great because it's right on my way to work but they are so so slow, and the staff isn't very friendly. Except for the older lady with grey hair. She's really nice, I think she's the manager. I always end up waiting at least 10-15 in the drive thru and at least 10 mins when going inside...

For being brand new, this Starbucks is terrible! I've been here 4 times... 3 times, there were problems! I wanted a cookie warmed, they claimed the oven wasn't working properly. I asked for an iced coffee, I opened it because they didn't give me what I asked for and it had a BUG in it so I throw it out. 3rd problem, asked for a sandwich, "we're out of that".... And it was a breakfast sandwich, in the morning... Come on people! Get it together! TERRIBLE Starbucks. Won't waste my time or money here again!

SLOWEST. DRIVE- THRU. EVER!! They have definitely lowered their standards with this business. And yes, as mentioned by other customers, after school hours are terrible! But hey....at least there is DD across the street!

This is a Starbucks franchise operated inside the Target store by Target employees.  This is the second time I've been there and experienced watered down coffee - they are definitely diluting the coffee and ought to lose their license.
Come on guys! Train your employees on how to redeem earned rewards. Other than that I love this location. Spacious. Great corner
Starbucks speaks for itself. Customer service is impeccable. My greentea frap is yummy. Great parking spot and super clean. 5 stars all the way.

The handful of times I have been here, everything was fine.  It's a Starbucks.  The experience is pretty consistent with most Starbucks.  They have wifi.  They have snacks.  They have coffee of a consistent quality.

This Starbucks is decent; clean and comfortable inside.  There's not lots of seating or table space available, so studying here is a hit or miss.

The drive-thru is often jammed, and service moves way too slowly.  Be sure to give yourself plenty of time if you plan to swing through before work or class.  Consider yourself lucky if you arrive and the drive-thru is clear!

Service is always friendly and cheerful, no complaints about the baristas.  

Also, on the major plus side, they're mostly dog-friendly.  They usually have a water bowl on the outside patio.

Person that took my order stood there for what felt like five minutes cause she didn't understand my order. Finally someone helps her and then my Trenta Matcha Lemonade comes with 80% ice and maybe 20oz of actual lemonade. Worst experience at a Starbucks so far.

I don't often drink Starbucks, but sometimes I am in a bind and I need caffeine quick.  This Starbucks happens to be convenient to my work, but that is where the convenience ends.  Much like everyone else, I am not a fan of this Starbucks for the wait.  There could be only 4 people in front of you, but you will still wait about 20 minutes.  It isn't just a one time occurence either.  It happens every time.
I went here several times on my stay. Everytime, the service was pretty fast though there were huge lines.
Was a great stop on our trip. Broke my rule of stopping somewhere that we have back home, but I needed my Starbucks fix and this was a great location.

This is the closest Starbucks to my home, but I travel to Riverview because I don't care for this one. I mostly do not like the staff, who are always nice but are very loud and "jokey" with another, which -in a small SBux- drastically diminishes professionalism and the "coffee-shop" atmosphere that many SBux customers enjoy (and the reason behind going to a coffee shop).

This is my favorite Starbucks in the Westshore area because it is a larger locations and away from the mall
crowds. There is outdoor seating, a drive-thru and parking in the back. There are plenty of outlets along the long bench seat and also outlets along the walls. Although Starbucks is always busy and a little noisy, it is my favorite Starbucks to work at because there are a lot of tables.

I have come here often, especially in the evenings to study.

What I like most about this location is that the staff is courtesy and there are many outlets to plug in my electronics while I am studying. The main table in the middle of the location has a lot of space to accommodate many people, or for a few people to sprawl their stuff. There are small alcoves inside, and they have outdoor patio seating.  

Another nice and interesting feature of this Starbucks location is that it was approved for its liquor license a couple months back and now serves beer and wine in the evening. They even offer free wine-tasting for an hour or so Thursday nights.

As I mentioned earlier, I usually come here to study. The ideal time to go when there aren't a lot of people is around 7/8 pm. Although the yelp website states they close at 9pm, they actually extended their closing time and this Starbucks location closes at 10pm.
Worse Starbucks in the St. Louis metro area. How can I wait in line for ten minutes and my drink still isn't ready?

First, I am a huge fan of Starbucks, and this is the closest to my son's place, so I go here when visiting him.  It wasn't busy when we arrived, so we got our drinks quickly.  Most of the tables were empty, but they were all dirty.  We sat outside for a while until the heat drove us inside, about 15 minutes later.  It was still not busy, but the tables were still dirty.  I cleaned one myself so we could sit and finish our drinks.

It is a Starbucks.

Friendly staff. Indoor and Outdoor seating. Average, speedy coffee, friendly overly trained staff. Plenty of selection. Nothing new. If you want a change nearby, by try
Buddy Brew.
Don't know what coffee this is at Nashville International Airport, but it isn't Starbucks!  If you want to be disappointed, come here!

Well, first off this place gets 5 stars because they stay open til 9p!
Friendly staff tonite which is always appreciated.
I love the open decor of this place and the tables!! So many tables and chairs! Perfect place to study alone or with a group. I will be back, this is my new SB spot in Carmel!
My favorite coffee shop. I love the refreshes and frappes. You should definitely try it out.

I have to agree that this appears to be a slow Starbucks.  Then again, maybe it was just that they served the wrong drink without a name and then moved on to the next last time I was here.  When this was corrected and the right drink served, it was accompanied by a "Next Drink is on the House" voucher.  That was classy, and saved the place from a two-star rating.  Free wifi as well for what it is worth.  That is unfortunately outweighed in my opinion by the store's location--the largest, crappiest parking lot sprawl in all of Tucson.

From the moment i moved down the street I've been going to this starbucks. It's had its issues as any new business would have. But i always get a big smile and the manager knows my name and greets me every time i go through the drive thru or into the lobby. She is by far the nicest one there.

My boyfriend and I stopped by this Starbucks location on Saturday evening. It was pretty busy, but we found a table near the door we could sit at.
