I ordered a chamomille tea, whie he ordered a Passion Tea Lemonade. We sat down and waited patiently for our drinks to arrive. After over 5 minutes of waiting, I decided to go up to the barista counter to see if our drinks were there. Nothing. So I walked back up to the girl who took our order and she said pointed at three paper bags with pastries in them and said my order was there. I was confused but she was busy with a customer. So I waited until she was done with the customer and asked her where our order was. She snapped back that they'd be waiting at the barista counter. SO I walked back to the counter again to make sure I didn't miss it and still nothing was there. I was getting annoyed by now. Meanwhile, both girls working the barista machine couldn't be bothered to even look up to see why I was walking back and forth looking frustrated. I walked back to the girl at the register and  told her our drinks were there nor were they called out. She asked me what we ordered again, rolled her eyes and yelled at another girl behind the counter to make the passion tea lemonade. So I walked back to the barista side and waited for the drinks. The passion tea lemonade wasn't even shaken like it was supposed to be. All she did was pour the pre-made mix from the carton over a glass of ice and roughly put it on the counter. So I took it, annoyed, and brought it over to my boyfriend. No sooner had I sat down that I heard the girl at the register call out that my chamomille tea was ready, so I walked back again, and shehad placed it on the higher ledge (vs. the lower one where the barista girls put them). As I brought it down, I ended up spilling the tea all over my hand since it was so high. I was sooooo mad. Why did she put it up there in the first place? I was able to finally put a lid on it and walk back to the table where my boyfriend immediately asked me what happened. He felt so bad he used his cold iced drink to relieve the pain and throbbing from my hand. This incidence was the second Starbucks in the city I've had horrible service from. I am beyond done with this chain. Their sister chain, Teavana is WAY better in terms of customer service and product quality.  I will never visit this store again,

well I'm certainly surprised today. usually there is this one barista that is super irritated and has the "I don't give a crap" attitude and for some reason always doesn't make my beverage right and is usually rude. today though, today.... mmph my latté was def good and he seemed less rude almost like he was actually trying to be nice.  However he still had the unhappy face he usually wears. I always hated coming here bc the the guy barista could be really rude at times and it's like I always leave feeling super pissed off. but because it's convenient I would come here when I'm in the area. I hope things continue to get better from here...
My favorite neighborhood Starbucks! They know my drinks and give my foster dog a puppachino, is there anything better? :)
Great staff, fast service and plenty of seating. Bathroom is filthy, smells like death and the customers are a mix of crazy, college students with a few hotties thrown in.
Meh... it's Starbucks. I think we all know what to expect by now. One of the nicest Starbucks I've been to was in Annapolis, MD.

I've been to this Starbucks a number of times and the baristas are always super friendly and cheerful, even at 6:30am.  I usually go through the drive thru, but the wait times have been crazy, so I used mobile ordering.

I am lactose-intolerant.  I always order soy in my drinks.  As soon as a took a sip of my latte this morning I knew it was made with dairy.  There is no mistaking that taste.  I was so disappointed because I was already half way to work, and with the wait times the way they have been, there was no way I was going back to wait in line and have it re-made.  

Luckily mine is not a dairy allergy, just an intolerance, and I noticed it right away.  I had to throw out a $6 latte.  Super sad. I understand baristas are in a hurry but PLEASE check the labels on the drinks before just making them with dairy on auto-pilot.  I would have spent all morning in the bathroom if I hadn't noticed the difference.

Just had a terrible experience here! As advertised in multiple locations in this store, today was happy hour from 3-6pm. This means half price fraps! When I asked the cashier about it, she very rudely said "We don't do that here!" The entire line of people, including University faculty, became upset and asked why. She simply replied, "Y'all can talk to the manager or leave." and "The manager is in the back." When we asked if she could get the manager, she told us no. The entire line left the store.

Absolutely terrible customer service, and shocking that she refused to honor prices as they were advertised. I understand some people have bad days, but this makes me not want to ever return.

I enjoyed going to Starbucks any chance i get. But at this location I try to avoid it as much as possible. The staff don't seem to be train in customer service and they do not clean. The Starbucks on Market Street in Center City is so much cleaner than this place.  
There was a coffee spill on the floor and it hasn't been clean. The counter was so wet that when they move the cups from the counter, water would spill over. Milk was left out so hopefully when i drink my frappe I don't have the runs from them leaving the milk out without a cap on it. Didn't seem to see a manger there and one of the worker almost fell cause the floor is slippery from the water and whatever's spill. So disgusted. Definitely will not be coming to this Starbucks.

This place is so slow I've had more than enough time to write multiple bad reviews and tell friends about it... the line wasn't even long I don't know what the deal is! If only there was a convenient Dunkin!! I'll never come back even if there is no one waiting...

It's Starbucks, one with somewhat nicer furnishings and an ample amount of space. I doubt there's is much variation between stores and customers come here knowing what to expect. Didn't get particularly bad or good service here. As usual, the coffee's just okay.

One of the better starbucks, but it is also newer. Fast service. Good consistency on the drinks. Always friendly.
The decor is newer and trendier as well. Good amount of seating.

Good morning Yelpers.  Nothing too long today.  Only that this location is super busy from about 7:45am to 8:30 so if you have somewhere to be at a certain time get there early or use the mobile application.  Otherwise the customer service is. Great.  Despite he busyness they still make your coffee with love and care.  Thank you Starbucks staff

When it's early morning (11am) and you are about to get into a full day of festing, you are gonna need a jump start. Enter Starbucks. We grabbed some coffee here on the way to French Quarter fest, and even though they were busy, the staff got our coffee to us quickly- and with a smile! The iced coffee is as good as any Starbucks. This spot is pretty small, and we were in and out so fast I didn't notice if there are places to sit, but if you are downtown for festing or shopping, this is a good place to get some brew.

Awesome service!  Friendly, polite and efficient!  They really go out of their way to get to know the regulars here and will have your name and order memorized in no time.    I have never had a problem with my drink order and the store is kept quite tidy.  The space/setup is a bit odd and small, so be prepared to feel a little cramped. This is a great Starbucks!

Person that took my order stood there for what felt like five minutes cause she didn't understand my order. Finally someone helps her and then my Trenta Matcha Lemonade comes with 80% ice and maybe 20oz of actual lemonade. Worst experience at a Starbucks so far

this starbucks rocked my world! the baristas were incredibly friendly and the coffee tasted great! i couldn't quite decide on a drink at first, but David helped me pick out an iced peppermint white mocha that i ended up loving! great atmosphere and wonderful people will keep me coming back! thanks guys!
My Saturday morning fix.  It's the same stuff they have at every Starbucks but they seem especially friendly at this one - Dilworthtown.

Went in to get a cookie on a Friday afternoon around 4 PM. Hours for this Starbucks are 6 AM - 7 PM! Went up to the counter and there was no one there! Went to customer service to ask to call for Starbucks assistance! Waited five minutes and no one showed up! Went back to customer service and reminded them and no one still showed up! Finally, 20 minutes later someone shows up!

I only like coming here because of the drive thru, however there are always so many mistakes with my drink order and today was the last draw. This pregnant african american lady that was taking my order, handle with every customers money. Decided to open a straw and put it in my drink. How disgusting is that. I never asked her to do that to my drink. This is the first time in years that ive been to starbucks that someone did this.

This Starbucks has an awful high turnover rate and training new people tends to slow down the delivery of orders.  There was once upon a time, when this location had a steady crew with the two "Kims" working here. They were very friendly, consistent in their barista skills and super accommodating when they failed us, (which was very rare). Now, it's a sure hit or miss and I have to pray to the sweet baby Jesus above that these baristas get it right. So far, it's been pretty good but unlike today, they had no product for my pink refresher and the new store in Algiers had no Splenda.  I opted for the violet refresher in lieu of pink (lol) and it doesn't taste bad at all.  Needless to say, this is my neighborhood Starbucks and we've forged a good friendship with Sandy who's been there a while and I look forward to her making our drinks.

This isn't my regular Starbucks but I do stop here a few times a month. I like that they have a drive thru and I find the employees here to be exceptionally friendly. I stopped for a coffee  last night and had the most pleasant man take my order, he was so nice and personable & it made going out of my way to drive there totally worth it. I also have an annoying drink order so a lot of times my drink is wrong. I've never had that happen at this location. One of my favorite Starbucks.

I typically will make the u turn to stop here since I prefer Starbucks coffee to DD. Recently the service has gone way downhill! The people who currently work here are indifferent and unprofessional. Last week I stopped for a BLACK coffee at the drive-thru. I received the wrong change and drink- upon informing the barista, I waited for over 5 minutes for a plain cup of coffee. To top it off, the barista told me I was wrong, rolled her eyes at me and did not apologize at all.  I will not be back to the drive-thru after many negative experiences.
These baristas know how to make an amazing drink EVERY time! Make sure you swing through the drive thru, it's much faster!

This Starbucks is by far the nastiest coffee place I have Ever been to! Went there today at around noon the Barista that was making everyone's drink kept spilling half his drink and mixes all over the counter then it was dripping all over the floor and into there ice storage! Disgusting! I got my drink that was all sticky and took 1 sip and threw it right into the trash! I love Starbucks but this one is Horrible!

5 people in line took me 30mins to get one cup of coffee. I ordered three different things off the menu and of course they were out of all three. This isn't the first time, nor the second time this has happened. Hence the review. I have been to Starbucks ALL OVER the country and have never had this poor of an experience. Do not recommend this Starbucks if you are hungry or thirsty.
Just burnt the roof of my mouth with a latte that I ordered with the modifier "Kids Temp", which should mean less hot than normal temperature...imagine if I had given it to a child...
Literally the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. The idiots working the drive thru are so slow that they're almost in reverse. Do not go here if you are in a time crunch.

I had a Salted Caramel Mocha here last night before going to work.  I didn't know if it was what I really wanted so I talked it over with the Barista and she modified it to what she thought I would like.  It was VERY good!  The facility is very nice as are the employees.

The baristas here have gotten bad in making drinks, I spent 20 minutes waiting for two drinks and they forgot to add one ingredient! Awful service! Train the baristas at this location better! Worst location in town by far.

Not really a coffee drinker but I had to meet someone and they picked Starbucks... Had tea which was pretty good but, I;m not ready to become a convert just yet. Always amazed at the shear amount of people waiting to get their caffeine fix... or simple occupy space... Place was clean and the staff was nice... it also smelled kinda nice

Since opening this was always consistent with the service and food/drinks up until a couple of months ago. It's now hit or miss with basic things which seems to mainly miss in the drive thru. On the way to work they have forgotten straws (then having to wait until they see you still at the window), sandwiches not being fully warmed and drinks being made wrong. As for inside the friendliness when ordering and when receiving your order used to be 1000% perfect but again it's pretty inconsistent with that so I don't expect a friendly employee...sad isn't it?

Ok well I've never been a huge fan of Starbucks, I'm a Wawa guy, but due to construction and a job location change Ive had use Starbucks for my coffee addiction. There are two Starbucks by my job, I've named them Good Bucks and Bad Bucks...if you didn't guess by he 1 star rating, this location is Bad Bucks.

Oh where do I start??? The 15 minute wait for coffee or the fact that while your waiting 15 minutes you are watching 4 employees do as followed: 1 cashier, 1 asks you what you want and writes your name on a cup, 1 makes the coffee, and 1 stands and watches and chats...I'm guessing that is the manager. 

Wow... What a waste. This place give Starbucks a horrible name and a general manager really needs to investigate why this location is so poorly run while a location a few blocks away on 16th and Market is run so well (that's the location of what we call Good Bucks).

If your in the area, walk the extra 2 blocks, you'll save more time and sanity than you know.

This location has a sad excuse for employees and management. I understand customer service however I'm standing there at the drink station waiting for somebody to look at me and notice I'm trying to tell somebody something and nobody pays me any mind. Mind you, I had already purchased my drink after watching the shift supervisor chat away and not make sure her employees were doing their job in helping customers that aren't in drive through. 

After expressing my disappointment to the shift supervisor she basically blew me off and walked outside to do whatever. Spending 16 bucks here tonight and getting piss poor service. Right.... Starbucks. This location needs some serious training.

Staff here is always friendly and efficient. Great location- very convenient and although they don't have a drive-thru here, it is sometimes faster here than other Starbucks in the area with a drive-thru. Pet-friendly outside and this store is always clean and well-stocked. Enjoy coming here.

this is a pretty large starbucks. they have couches and benches to hang out or to work on stuff. i just started working across the street so i will be visiting them frequently, i'm sure. staff is amazingly friendly and helpful. woo hoo!

Fast friendly service. I got my protein box, iced tea and was out the door quickly which is exactly what I wanted.

The only issue I had was with the amount of ice in the drink. By the time it was made there was just a little bit in the top. That's not how an iced tea is supposed to be. Plus, I was driving back to Phoenix which means the ice was going to melt quickly in the car.

I asked the barista to pour out some of the drink and add more ice which he did. Please just make it right the first time.

Haven't been to this location in a while, glad we went back. They are always so nice no matter what time you go. The day we were there the register froze and had to be restarted. It took a little longer to place my order, but they were so pleasant the entire time and for us, it was a do nothing kinda Saturday so we were in no hurry at all. We will continue going to this location.
Great service! There are some questionable people and smells there. But great place to grab some coffee or cocoa on your way to Bourbon St. or Jackson Square.

I have to admit I like this Starbucks.

For a couple reasons.  
- It's one of the more comfortable starbucks in town.  Lots of plush couches and chairs and plenty of seating
- Great views of Mt. Rose while you're sitting there.
- Clean bathrooms
- I've yet to have a screwed up order (there are some other sbux in town that seem to mess 'em up)

It's a Starbucks, so the beverages are standard fare.  It can drive me nuts the amount of people that bring their old clunky uncharged laptops in here (the sbux on Kietzkie next to Aaron brothers is like this) and take up an entire table to update their facebook status.    Get a tablet or an iPad, people!   Or bettter yet - secure your wireless so only people that purchase a drink can get  access.

Other than that, its a starbucks, in a great location.

They were out of a lot of things (product wise), but other than that they were friendly. I sometimeS always feel guilty when getting water with my drink. But, they were totally for it and even offered. One awesome thing I saw was, a business card in Braille!!!

I order a bagel and drink here just about every morning before work and have never been disappointed! The staff has always been extremely nice to me and in my opinion, they are some of the fastest baristas in the city. 

I always use the mobile app to order my food/drink in the morning during rush hour. Both are ready well before the estimated time limit that the app gives you. There have been a few occasions where their printer/or something went wrong with ordering via the app, but once you let the baristas know, they are quick to get your order ready ASAP. I cannot thank them enough for making my mornings so smooth. I say this because the Starbucks location on 18th and Market has always been negative for me.  While that location is technically closer to my office, i prefer to come to this location because i feel the baristas genuinely enjoy their job and are happy to help. 5 star customer service in my book!

TIP: If you don't already have the Starbucks mobile app, download it and order via the app. Not only will your order be ready by the time you walk in the door, but you collect stars that add up to free items!

Took 15 Min to get caramel iced coffee when there was hardly anyone in front of me and it tasted like nothing.  I think this is a drive thru first type place.  They get priority. Be prepared to wait forever.

I believe this location is very new, and it is FABULOUS - big, lots of seating indoors and out, ideally situated right off I-40 west of Nashville (at Charlotte Pike)....  as a frequent traveler through here I'm thrilled to find it here!  I'd rate it a 5-star but my drink wasn't quite right... ordered a decaf salted caramel mocha and I assume the barista who took the order was new because the ticket on the cup was for a decaf mocha.  Poor me, having to live without the extra syrup and caramel drizzle....  my waistline is secretly thanking them but my mouth is a little pouty.  Service was fast and friendly and I'll be back in the morning for breakfast!  (I'm a bit sad, too, that my Starbucks app doesn't recognize this location yet but I'm sure I'll survive that as well.  Lol.)

I love Starbucks. This one however is hit or miss. Sometimes the service is good and sometimes it takes forever. Either way my drinks is almost always amazing but sometimes the barista must be having an off day. But hey, it happens to us all.
Worst Starbucks ever. Beans are always burned, line is ridiculous, and the team is slow. Nordstroms e-bar and the new espresso joint are much better, faster, and nicer
Idiots works here, placed a mobile order and they didn't make it until I got there and they had no idea what I order. How am I suppose to know what your system printed out?

I love Starbucks. So much that I have the gold card and it has already automatically renewed two years ahead. But this location has terrible baristas - the worst I've ever experienced at a Starbucks. On top of that the service is much slower than anywhere else. Because of that to there are really long lines. Also beware: there is never anywhere to sit at this Starbucks location. It's more of a grab and go location.
My favorite Starbucks.  The people are always welcoming and the know I like my Iced Americano with extra ice. Good place to study and relax and chat with friends.

Slow drive through service. Sunday morning - wanted ti stop for a coffee before church. Drive through set up won't let you leave - we've been stuck here for 21 min. Please fix this!

Finally got to the window and the order was wrong. Drinks, food, everything was wrong. Had to pull up and wait for them to bring out.

Worst location ever. Long lines.  Tried to go study but there was bums sleeping in the back.  Another 2 guys talking and cursing so loud like it was a hole in the wall bar.  Grab your coffee to go because if you are looking for a relaxing place to study this is not it.

I go to Starbucks every day and was highly dissatisfied with this location as I was ignored by the guy behind the counter as he let another girl order a pastry and straight up cut me in line. I have never had an experience like this at a Starbucks before. I will just keep going to the other location inside of the Target down the road.

Service was horrible.  I walked in because the drive thru was backed up! Stood at the register waiting to order.  Two women on the end of counter were to busy to stop what they were doing 
to take my order.   Drive thru Is obviously more important then walk ins.  It's aggravating when they see you standing there and don't even acknowledge you! Then when they filled my cold brew it was filled with half MILK! Excuse me I didn't order milk! Last time I give Starbucks my business.  The lady who made my coffee was rude and snippy! Don't work there if you can't be nice!  $6.00 for a damn cup of milk and a drop of cold brew!

I come here almost everyday and they look at me at the register like they have never seen me before and ask what I want. So I order and every so often they get it wrong, not so often to make me upset but confusing since I come in a lot and order the same thing. Anyways, today I told myself if they get my order wrong, I'm writing a bad review on Yelp. So here we are! I'm never going to this Starbucks ever again because I feel uncomfortable trying to order my drink knowing they will never remember me and will probably mess it up. Thanks!

This Starbucks is hit or miss... I've had really terrible experiences here, as well as good experiences... but the bad always is what sticks out, right?  

Today, I ordered a soy, decaffeinated frappucino with whipped cream for my little girl as a Saturday morning treat. The barrista forgot the whip cream and then argued with me for a moment about whether or not I had actually ordered it before begrudgingly adding a couple noticeably small squirts... who goes out of their way to cause a little extra inconvenience and grief when fixing a treat for a 3 year old? Unnecessary... 

BOTTOM LINE: I am being generous with 3 stars... I rarely have a great experience here, but its the only Starbucks close to my house so it has to do.
Worst baristas in town. Not only did they not follow the simple instructions for a latte on the side of the cup but they short-changed me by a half a cup.

Very friendly people work here. The space is bright and looks comfortable.  Outdoor seating is undercover. There's also some good work spaces inside - like a table big enough for Thanksgiving dinner right inside the door.  And there's a drive thru to boot.

Front and back entrance, noted on the parking lot are good.  Make sure you come in the back entrance (second) to the lot.
In the recent months, service here has become exponentially better. Not sure what changes they've made, but it's working.

Since when does the drive thru not take your trash for you?  Since Starbucks removed the drive thru trash can, I've been able to give my Starbucks trash cups to the drive thru window to make space for the new cups. Today the woman wouldn't take it.  She looked at me like I was crazy.  That's new, because at every other store I've been to, they always can take it from me. Maybe this new location is too good for customer service.

I've been to Starbucks all around the US, few outside the states. This Starbucks has been THE best I've ever been to. Fast, friendly, quality, location and skill. Thank you! All our drinks were made right the first time. Sandwiches were warmed evenly and toasty. I'm not a review type person, but this place I just had to rave about. I've had a lot of bad experiences in many many Starbucks so I'm pretty sure that I know a great one when I see one.

You know the song from Wicked that goes something like, "Loathing, unadulterated loathing"

Yeah. That's how I feel about this Starbucks.

Usually, I'd think it pointless to review a chain, but after two years of trying to run in here for a quick caffeine fix, I've got to wonder how one place can be so consistently poorly run. 

Gah, I don't even know where to start.

If I were to try to defend it, I would say that it just can't handle all of the business it gets. It's tough to get a seat, and the lines are ridiculous. For a while, it seemed understaffed, but now they've got all kinds of people floating around. The line to order goes quickly with a cashier, a bakery server, and a cup writer all waiting to meet your needs. 

And then you wait for your drink.

And you will wait.

And you'll watch drinks appear with no one to claim them, because the drinks are consistently made wrong.

Last week, after waiting ten minutes for my soy chai and seeing people who came in after me leave with their lattes, I asked, "Is there a soy chai coming?"

"Oh, yeah," said the barista who had been singing and dancing behind the espresso machine. "I'm remaking it. I didn't realize it was soy the first time."

In the time I'd been waiting, I'd seen the two baristas throw out two other drinks that they'd made wrong. I'm not an expert on fancy coffee-making, but that seems a bit inefficient, like something's going wrong here. 

Honestly, they need another espresso machine, and they need to shift some of their staff members to operate it. I'm not sure where they'd fit it, though, but something's gotta give.

Like others have said, there's another Starbucks a block away on Chestnut with ample seating, friendly staff, and MUCH better service. It's quicker for me to walk a block out of my way than it is to wait through this hot mess.

New make over is the worst and not inviting at all & the service is well below par. Three times now I have gone in and my drinks were all wrong or luke warm & that's not counting times that I had to wait for a new batch of brew to be made because they ran out of coffee completely. Seems to be more drive through oriented now.

Lived in a few states been to a lot of coffee shops but there is just a good feeling about that spot. I contribute the good reviews due to two things: 
1) excellent decor and lighting 
2) sharp quick staff probably due to a good manager.
Great customer service and coffee. Fast and reliable. Enjoy their salads as well. Was surprised by how good they are .

This starbucks just completed a remodel.   One star because I do not like the remodel

Only big tables.   Too much sun shining in
good coffee, good hot coco & good service. now the bad side terrible drive thru and terrible entrance & exit.

Beware of the Brit in the drive through.  She is rude, snippy, and doesn't care about the customers. She's just there to get her paycheck. I'll go to a different store from now on. Not gonna take the chance of being verbally abused by Ms. Brit.

This Starbucks seems to be pretty efficient. I've been there a handful of times and can't say anything too negative about it. I tend to order via the Starbucks application and then come pick up what I ordered. I just left and it took about 11 minutes for my drink to be presented to me. It was busy so I fully understand.

The employees were working efficiently and doing the best they can. I think that's what a customer looks for along with a great product. The parking isn't too bad considering it's South Philadelphia. I think some of the employees have been there for sometime. The inside is not too big and it's hard to find seating the times I've been there. I think the Starbucks being right on S. Broad street makes it an easy location for people to come too.

I have been here twice over the last 3 years.
Got my latte and got out.

No issues - but not a HG (Holy Grail) either.

This Starbucks is everything you'd expect... coffee, food, nice attending staff, clean, and noise at a soft lull.

What is extra nice is the ambiance here. For some reason, this Starbucks has a more 'homey' feel with a bookshelf and decor that looks like it's straight out of a magazine.

Been to this Starbucks almost every day this past week.  Good Service and the drinks are made just the way they should be and within a reasonable amount of time.  Overall it was a very average Starbucks experience for me which isn't to say that it's bad, it's not.  I'm just satisfied with the service I received here.

Menu wise you know what you're going to get but with me, I order the same thing- hot peppermint mocha and a plain bagel, toasted WITH BUTTER. 80% of my orders are mobile orders and they still get the butter wrong and give me cream cheese. Some mornings, it is okay because I'm going back home but most morning I'm on the go and to have to return to their site for BUTTER is an inconvenience. I've ordered from other Starbucks throughout town and they never have an issue, not sure if this one is just understaffed and so busy they're unable to follow WRITTEN instructions.

After 7 months,  the above (original post), still stands true. Because of that I drive to the next closest Starbucks location at Marketplace where they're always pleasant & my order is accurate.

They wouldnt allow me to pay with a $50 bill. Couldnt get a good reason as to why. Doesn't make sense to me. I prefer to pay in cash for smaller purchases when in the US. Unfortunately not here. Nice setting though

Despite how chaotic this place can be in the mornings and lunch hours, the friendly staff keeps it clean, and drinks are made in a prompt yet correct manner.  Are you drowsy from lack of caffeine and have no idea what to order?  Ask the baristas to suggest something for you!

Terrible experience this morning. Cashier allowed customer standing behind me to interrupt my transaction and, of course, the cashier started to handle the other customer's issue and left me standing there. When I asked if she would finish with me, she told me to wait. She finished with the other customer and then came back to me. No tip from me!! Then when it came to getting my order, other issues arose.

This Opry Mall location is the only oasis in the area. Thankfully, it opens earlier than the rest of the mall at 8am. Sadly, it is a "large" kiosk and not a full service Starbucks store. 

Predictably, it is packed from 8-8:30 as everyone grabs coffee and/or a pastry on their way to work. 

Given the scarcity and popularity, an expansion is sorely needed.
Slooooooow service!   Inept management along with overwhelmed baristas.   Very little parking and a tangled mess of a drive thru

A special thank you to Janette for her help to set up a birthday surprise. She went above and beyond to place an order and make sure that everything was set up perfectly! She is a great example of a leader and provided excellent customer service.

I just wanted to say how much I absolutely love this Starbucks. We drive 15 minutes to come here all the time and study. Every barista is amazing! I wanted to give this review because of the service I got today. They accidentally made me a Hot Latte instead of Iced but one of the Baristas made me a second one and then gave me both!! He was super nice about it. Love this Starbucks

Rest stop on the way home from NYC.
Coffee was good but the wait was long at 10am.
Some of the orders ahead of mine got mixed up and the barista was kinda thrown off.
My order was delayed but it was correct.
I had a birthday reward to use and I realized the next day that I was charged FULL PRICE and my reward had expired! I am so pissed.
#birthday #starbucks #starbucksFail

I love Starbucks, yes I do!

What I don't love is that I cannot as of yet redeem my Starbucks rewards on my smart phone app inside a Starbucks Target :-(

Not enough staff. This Starbucks takes longer than any other store I've been too. Even longer then when I went to your New York location. I live across the street and i can't even get a cup of coffee. Inside and drive through line is so long. Never a full staff to meet the demands.

I come here once in awhile when I'm in that area but, when I do. I get greeted by my name and the only two are Patrick and Stephanie I believe her name is pretty tall red head. Both are very pleasant know my favorite drink and just very friendly. I love Starbucks and these people work hard making all the different flavors of coffee and tea. I normally come afternoon to late afternoon. I really never get a bad drink it just took some time to know me and what I oder. Thanks keep up the great work!
Drive thru is just terrible. Going inside is a little better but it seems there is an ongoing issue with the speed of drive thru when compared to other Starbucks in the area.  It's a real shame.

Great coffee and free WiFi. Depending on what time you go, their staff is either super nice (mid afternoons) or really rude (late at night). There's no in between. I've literally had a younger employee give me attitude when I asked about my iced coffee that took twenty minutes when I mobile ordered it. I get that customers can be annoying, but I was polite, in a rush because I had work, and ordered the simple drink ahead of time. I've also has the same teenager on a different day tell me the Honey Citrus mint tea "didn't exist" and "wasn't a real drink," when I've had it before then and since, versus telling me that those Teavanna teas were constrained. I'll continue to come here becuase it's convenient and because half of the staff doesn't suck.

This spot is conveniently located adjacent to the hospital and Perlman center, offering your standard Starbucks staples. Their cue is often short and if you're lucky, food may be disseminated minutes before closing time. The seating area is quaint, though not cozy like other neighboring Starbucks locations. Overall solid spot!

I don't usually gush about customer service, but I've not met a snarky or disaffected barista here. Period. Everyone is super-chill, efficient and friendly to boot.  They absolutely rock -  over ANY Starbucks I've visited (in at least 12 states AND Puerto Rico). Thanks for always being great.  Oh, and making a kick-ass cup of coffee too! Thank heavens for Clover!

Great service from Blake who helped me with a defunct starbucks' card that I got for my sister .  He gave us a free lemon bread slice since he couldn't help us with the card.  Outstanding customer relations from this gentleman .
Would love another location on Grant Avenue. This one has but one way in and out. Can't access it from acrossed the street and can't turn left when exiting. Very poor accessibility .

If you are coming to work on your computer, don't bother. There is very limited seating and it isn't very accommodating. Would only recommend this place for sipping on something while you shop at Safeway or to take back to your car.

There's a reason this location only has 2 stars. This is Quite possibly the worst Starbucks I've ever been to... I ordered my Traveller's for a big work meeting a day in advance, came to pick them up the next morning and they had no record of my order. No apology. Just looked at me like I was the crazy one. This the second time this has happened. I will not be returning.

Placed a mobile order at 5:00am and arrived at 5:07am to a completely closed store -- dark and locked. The store should open at 5am, and I would assume that staff would arrive prior to 5 to get things open and ready. I don't ask for much from a Starbucks, really, but there's nothing sadder than being up all early and hoping for a latte to save it and then striking out.

I called Starbucks Customer Care and got my money back and was pleased with their service. Nonetheless, a new store like this one should be looking to be on top of the game every day.

I used to meet dates here,was once to be a nice atmosphere,but sort of gone downhill
The exterior needs a major renovation as does the staff

Walking around this mall can sure make anyone a bit tired.  Enter Starbucks.  Located next to the food court there are plenty of seats to sit down and relax.  Add a cup of your favorite coffee or tea and you'll recharge your batteries in no time.  I went during holiday shopping and the gals behind the counter weren't phased even with the long line of people.  Drinks were made at the same rate orders were being placed.  Doesn't get any better than this!  Great folks!

They forgot my order again. Same as other reviewers gave me a $4 gift card the first time round after I waited for 15 mins. The woman making the drink kept forgetting to make it even after I said something. Today they forgot my croissant and I waited again for 15 minutes. I walked out and went to United by Blue coffee shop around the corner. I got a coffee and rose flavored donut immediately for basically the same price and less of the attitude and waiting around. It's too bad, they use to be on top of good service. It really depends on the team and who's leading it in the morning as a manager.
This sbux is always busy and loud, but they made a satisfying double espresso for me and the line didn't take long to get through.  I definitely prefer the sbux a half a block away on Chestnut.
Friendly service, this Starbucks is right next to the Kroger on Highway 70 S. You won't miss it! No drive through available at this location.

I use to go to this Starbucks quite a bit when I worked in the area. It is how it is, a Starbucks with my usual drink of a Mocha Coconut(after all I named my dog after it), or a passion ice tea lemonade. The people who work here are very helpful, cheerful, and speedy.  
The parking is not the best here at times, but now that I do not go to often, the times I go are off times, so it is fine. International Mall is right across the street as an FYI. Also, they use to have a starbucks there but it closed, so if you are looking for a starbucks fix in the area, this is the one.

Not much to say about Starbucks, its your typical corporate coffee shop. Sure they have some alright coffee and drinks but overall the value isn't really there. I mean its almost $5 for a medium frappuccino, not something I would get often however I do love the Vanilla Bean. Overall sure its great in a fix, however I prefer to find more local coffee shops they tend to offer a better overall experience and value.

This is probably one of the worst Starbucks I've been to but it's conveniently located across the street from my work so I always find myself back here. Can't tell you how many times I've ordered through the app and the drink has been made wrong like ordering a hot drink and they made it iced and takes forever if you want to get it remade. Seems like a lot of the staff here are rude and always dragging their feet I definitely would not recommend waiting in line here, order before you come in. I agree with one of the previous reviews that says they water down drinks.. I always order my iced tea without water and every single time at this Starbucks they add water, they just don't care. Given this Starbucks so many chances but today I couldn't believe it they were supposed to open at 530am and were still closed on my way in to work at 645... and they did not open til 9am!! Just a lot of lazy work here honestly definitely won't be coming back here I'll make the extra effort to walk to another Starbucks. I feel bad even writing this review because I'm not the type of person to bash a business on yelp but something really just needs to change at this location I've had so many terrible experiences here and I don't think I'm the only one. I also would just like to remind the employees here you are working across the street from two major hospitals, so most of your customers are either workers at the hospital or family of patients. We often work long, difficult shifts and I know it seems silly but sometimes that coffee really is the only thing getting us through the day, and these families that come in to get a break from being in the hospital rooms 24.7 are likely having one of the most stressful times of their lives so would it kill you to show them a little kindness?? Please, Maybe just think about this before the next time you are rude to a customer and remember where you are working.
Rude staff. People begging inside asking for your food while you're eating. Out of food that is displayed.

Awesome new space but terrible service. This place just does whatever they want with your drink and they don't care when your drink was messed up or with the wrong ingredients - it's like you're bothering them. Go here for the atmosphere but keep your drink order simple.

Typical Starbucks, but the workers are so much nicer than I expected!  They were so easy to talk to and even cheered me on as I studied for my actuarial exam. By now, we all know what to expect at a Starbucks, but that was one thing that stuck out to me while I was there -- and I was there for quite a while!

Starbucks is Starbucks. 

That being said, I thought this was a really nice and spacious location. There's a room adjacent to where you order with plenty of room to work, study, read, etc.

It just seems like a nice cafe setting to have coffee, chat with friends or get busy work done.

I am truly disappointed in this Starbucks location. I have only been here a few times, but today was my last. First off, they didn't have any of the sandwiches that I wanted to order, so I had to settle for something else. Then the cashier definitely got my order wrong... I asked for two of the sandwiches we settled on and two waters. I got one of each. I didn't have time to stand around and correct the issue after I realized what happened because we were on our way to church and they move pretty slow at this location. Overall, the customer service was mediocre at best. There are just too many other options to tolerate this level of disappointment.

I have been to this place a couple of times. It could be better. 

Pros: 
-there are alot of tables and couches
-it closes later than usual coffee places, closes at 10pm
-conveniently located close to Rittenhouse.
-friendly staff

Cons: 
-the quality of drinks produced by the varied baristas are inconsistent. Had to get my chai fixed twice and it still tasted mostly of water with a hint of Chai.

If you're looking for a place to chill and sip on a frappe, this is not the place! This Starbucks is cramped with very little seating. Like, I counted 4 tiny tables.  I came in one week and there was this long single line going out the door; it looked like everyone was getting off a school bus, that's how tight it is inside. Youre better off going to the Starbucks inside Safeway. Maybe. The service here is alright. It wasn't messy when I came but I wouldn't call this Starbucks ghetto.
Friendly service. The girl at the counter was the cutest person! She was so sweet to my kiddos!  They made our drinks perfect!

Wife and I go to Starbuck a couple time a week, more when we travel. Probably been to over a hundred locations throughout the world. The location is great in the middle of a major shopping district, though we do miss the one in the mall they closed when this one opened. Now that Cinnabon is open again in the mall, they really need to bring that one back. A Cinnabon and a Starbucks coffee..... yummmm.  As note by other reviewers, the customer service training is lacking here. This location is the only one where I feel a little ripped off sometimes. About 30% of the time we stop in they seem to short the drinks; order a Grande I expect a full cup. I'd order a tall if I wanted less. Most of the time, I complain and they top it off, but you have to wonder if the drive thur customers deal with the same thing and how many just never come back.

Your ordinary Starbucks location nestled within a rest stop, so there really isn't any fanfare that this Starbucks would be better than in any ordinary city (such as nearby Philadelphia), or even a local mall. No seating or stools, but then again, most likely you've arrived by car (or motorbike), or on a bus for a wait, so you certainly won't stay longer than you would at any other Starbucks enjoying a relaxing cup of coffee and a book/eBook/laptop. Most of their products are fairly consistent with other Starbucks offerings, so it might be a relief.

The line starts near the main entrance of the rest stop, not at the side entrance, to avoid confusion, and you receive your coffee/beverage at the left. The amenity station offers your standard fare of half and half milk, whole milk, sugars (natural, refined, alternative). 

My experience there wasn't out of the ordinary, but since the oven was inoperable during my visit, my double chocolate brownie was slightly warm, but still great to enjoy, and the employees seemed cheery, even in a place such as a rest stop.

Overall, if you enjoy coffee, and Starbucks, you would be in luck to come here on the way to your destination on a road trip / work commute.

Long wait times, even though there was no line. Got my usual Starbucks drink and it didn't taste like anything. I took it back and was told that is how it is supposed to taste. Poor service and poor quality.
Outstanding staff. Drink was made to order and I was allowed to work and relax for awhile before visiting friends at the nearby venue.

WORSE CUSTOMER SERVICE !!

This morning I went into the Langhorne, PA Starbucks and was treated very badly. As I stood there where for someone to ask for my order one of the workers walked pass me behind the counter to go wipe down the tables. I continued to stand there waiting for someone to take my order. While standing there another customer came in and we both stood there waiting. Then the girl wiping the tables walked back around the counter and asked for my order. I COULD NOT BELIEVE IT!!!! While I was standing there she was wiping down tables and when I said something she said"I had to wipe down the tables". She didn't say sorry or I apologize nothing. I think she should be fired.

I was so happy to see this Starbucks open but it is HORRIBLE!!!! Starbucks suppose to be more than a fast food coffee shop. I thought they card about customer service and their customers. I guess only the Starbucks in certain neighborhoods get the employees who care about their customers. I am so upset by this. I called the district manager so we will see what happens if he cares. 

If you just want cheap fast food service go to the Langhorne, PA Starbucks but if you want good service and coffee go to yardley or even the giant supermarket Starbucks in Langhorne, PA or Lawrenceville, NJ.

This is another good addition to a neighborhood making a comeback. Not much point reviewing the coffee here, it's Starbucks, you kind of know what you're getting there. The service here has been hit or miss for me since i've visited this location. This one young guy that works the window just is not clicking on all cylinders and has caused some annoyance with his slow speed and unprofessionalism. Otherwise it's a good location.
I have been here several times for coffee and breakfast. The service are always fast. But They have never made the coffee and food right. Was neither too watery or too sweet.

As a commuter student at WCU, I am often looking for a place to spend a few hours between classes where I can study.   As I've got my car in tow, it's nice to not have to worry too much about parking.  This Starbucks is in a shopping center, so there is always plenty of parking available.  Also, since it's a little off the beaten path, this Starbucks tends not to be packed with other students.  The Starbucks itself isn't very big, but I haven't ever had an issue finding a table.  The store is also generally neat and clean and the service is prompt.  The baristas are all particularly friendly and upbeat as well!

I wish yelp would let me write 0 star reviews because this Starbucks location should be one. 

The staff are idiotic they are short tempered, can't seem to understand anybody's orders and when we clarify our order, they still get it wrong. Are they all high schoolers? 

I am a Starbucks regular and I think corporate needs to really come down on these poor locations giving them a bad rep. I'm not from the area but it was I, I would never be a Starbucks customer. 

Absolutely, nasty attitude from all the baristas. 
Stop by here for a cup of ruin your day. Disgusted.
Get my order wrong three times because you're staring off into space, then get angry at the customer for ordering wrong? And then getting it wrong again? maybe you should take up consider taking up Starbuck's generous offer to take classes at ASU. 

The decor inside was nice and there were plenty of seating available, looked like a great study spot but I now can see why they're all open and empty. 
Go elsewhere. Dunkin down the block

This location was pretty good the line was long but it went by pretty quickly.
I actually forgot that this location existed but I'm glad I stopped by.

Fast, stick to business yet friendly service here. 

8 out of 10 on drink consistency.  My order is at least 2 allergy friendly drinks and maybe a croissant, 

This location is at a busy corner intersection so it's a little harder to get in and out of but you can use the strip mall parking lot entrances to your advantage (if you are heading north on Glennwood, use the entrance by Barrelhouse rather than by the Starbucks/Carl's)
Frappacino was fine, but I asked the barista to wipe off the counter where I was seated and was handed a wipe. Not cool!

Still a regular here and I must say the service has improved. Drive through lines go by in a jiffy and everything is made the right way. Pumpkin spice lattes are made perfect here. Everyone should try their pumpkin scones as well if you're into sweets. Yum.

Let me start off by saying im not from here. This is my second time down here in the last 4 months, first time at this SB. Normally goto the one in the Brandon mall. 
But glad I came in, apparently the guy i think his name was Cory now works here. I kno him from the other starbucks. Anyway, its been about 3 months since i last saw him & he remembered my drink. 
Not that is what I call customer service.

I had the best experience this morning! I wish I got the names, but there were about 2 guys helping me. I ordered a drink in a venti reusable cup and they enthusiastically suggested their new mermaid cup and even came over the screen to show me it before I decided. They were so positive and just made my entire day. I also ordered the RF Turkey bacon  sandwich and it was delicious.

The slowest, most under staffed Starbucks ever.   Seriously, it's almost funny.  But it's not.  Not sure why they closed the location in the mall to open this one but they should have just brought the same people over, they were always great.  Waited over 15 minutes in a near-empty Starbucks for one coffee while I watched car after car leave the drive thru.

It's 10:30 in the morning and the place looks like a tornado went through it...all the tables are dirty, myself and the person at the table next to me had to wipe them off, the bathroom floor is sticky with black footprints all over it, the floor inside the lobby has food and garbage every where. By no means is it so busy that someone could not come out and do some cleaning. Starbucks should be ashamed.
Giving it one star because I found a rat running around there in the morning. Really gross

I stopped at the drive through for a cappuccino.   Service was very polite and very friendly but a bit slow.  The cappuccino was the hottest I have gotten in a long, long time.  Definitely worth the slight detour I took to get there.

This is a reliable Starbucks. It has moderate seating, not as much as some locations, but at least 3 tables and several relaxing chairs. It has a drive through- which in St. Louis we know that not all do. It is always clean and I have never had any issues with orders.

I really don't like giving bad reviews however I am extremely disappointed in this place. After several times of being treated poorly and unsatisfied with my beverage (how hard is it to pour coffee/tea) I am DONE. I finally called management to complain and as a result they promised a better experience. I have it a couple months before going back hoping for a significant change in customer service and beverage quality, I'm pretty sure it got worse. Seriously guys how hard is it to be NICE? If you hate life that much just quit! I don't appreciate the staff treating me poorly. No eye contact, no smiles, no greetings, effortless and careless beverage making. I'll never come back to this location!

I'm giving them 2 stars since I actually got what I ordered which was a DRY cappuccino and not a latte which you will get everywhere else in Reno if you don't ask for SUPER dry.

I pulled up on a weekday morning around 8am and the place looked closed. Almost no customers and none that I could see from outside. Heavy steel garbage can blocking door from outside which I'm sure the fire department would not like. When I walked in and to the counter, there was someone at the register but they didn't look up at me for 30 uncomfortable seconds. I had to ask if they were open. The guy asked, "why did you think we were closed." He then half heartedly apologized by saying "sorry I didn't look up, I was still on my break." That's not a joke or a punchline although it could be. FYI - That's the worst thing you could possibly say.

Across the board, I am finding customer service in Reno to be outright horrible.
Must be new staff since I was here last. How friendly everyone was. Having my usual, Chai with vanilla and all soy over ice. Yum!

Too bad we cant give negative stars for reviews! I came in yesterday to pick up my minile order and after waiting @ the counter for 3-5mins ignored, I finally had to be strong voiced to get anyone's attention. While I was waiting (ignored) at the counter to be helped, other customer kept coming up next to me and they ALL were greeted with a smile and a "good morning." This Starbucks is located in a Publix. I believe it used to be a Safeway. The location is new and updated. The storefront inside the Publix is small but they offer everything from drinks to pastries to sandwiches. The prices seem pretty comparable to an actual Starbucks. Plenty of parking in the shopping center as well. 

The staff was friendly and nice. We just got Bacon Gouda Breakfast Sandwiches but they were great and nice and warm. I would come here again.

Every time I come here, I plan to wait. This is by far the slowest Starbucks in the area. Today I skipped drive through and went inside to order my coffee, and discovered the source of the slowness. Staff are moving at snail speed! They show no energy and perform every task in slow motion. So frustrating. I get it...food service isn't fun, but take some pride in your service. I have 2 stars because the drink tasted great...15 minutes after I ordered it.

No service.  I paid and waited for my drink and gave up and left.

People that ordered after me got their drinks. 
6 drinks that should have been after mine were made and served.

i asked where mine was after 4 drinks but they just said it is coming thru and kept making someone else's drink.

When i went into the store to order there were no-one in the line.
I ordered my drink and went to the waiting section.  
While i was waiting, A girl and father/daughter came in they ordered and got their drinks and left.

Then a mom/daughter came in and ordered their drink and when they got their 4th drink (6 in total)  and staff still told me to wait and kept making their drinks.
At that point, it was not worth it. $5 wasted. 

I have been here 10+ times using drive thru without any issues other than one time i ordered Pike Place and got huge coffee grounds (french press ground size).  Not sure where they came from since i don't think starbucks uses that ground size. (maybe cold brew?) 

This was first time i actually walked in the store.
I will not be coming back to this store.
Too bad because i live 2 blocks away and pretty much pass this location all the time.  Not to mention i also belong to the credit union next door.

I know most of the reviews are of the drive thru...

I always like to walk into a Starbucks, mostly for the fact that I put a lot of sugar in my coffee and you never get that with a drive thru. The inside is nice and clean, and I never have any problem making an order. It is served up nice and quickly and I go about my day. I enjoy it, no reason to hate.

I visited this Starbucks and accidentally left my son's backpack there. I realized a few minutes after I left, called Ailish and Bex, and they were so kind to check around the store, find it, and then tuck it away so no one could grab it before I could get back to pick it up. These 2 individuals are emblematic of the excellent team of individuals working at this location. Also one of the reasons that I go out of my way to visit this location over others. Thank you so much!

Kim is not a very nice barista, in my opinion, & seemingly they have a high turnover of employees, but everyone else I've dealt with at this location is okay. If you like dark coffee, don't stop here after 4pm, as they don't brew it in the afternoon & they apparently don't offer pour overs.

This Starbucks is extremely busy. Literally every time I've been here, different hours of the day. Expect a long wait whether you go in or go through the drive-thru. But in good news, they have never messed up an order that I've placed, and I'm very picky with my coffee. If you like Starbucks and are willing to wait, this place isn't that bad. I recommend the drive-thru because the inside is pretty tiny and everyone packs in there, so seating is very limited and it's pretty loud.

They have the sweetest staff EVER! I ordered a mobile on the go order and didn't realize it went to the Perlman location. I told them what happened and they were totally cool with making my order at this location. I had a meeting and wouldn't be able to make it to the Perlman location. 

The baristas are also so sweet! They make sure you're satisfied with your order and let you know your drink will be out soon while you're waiting, which is refreshing because the lines can be REALLY long. The upstairs area is usually packed, but when you find an open space, it's a great area to relax or study. This is def my go to starbucks around the area.

I went in with my friend Gabby. She was disgusted by her drink as she can taste a molecule of wrongness in her coffee. I however was delighted by the staff. She wanted to cry out against all that is unholy about this starbucks.  I calmed her down and bestowed upon her the wonders of this location's craftsmanship, friendliness, and sense of duty to their coffee. I apologize for any inconvenience this caused. Coffee good.
This is a nice open location where you don't have to knock down tables, chairs, or other patrons to place an order.  Otherwise, it's a Starbucks...nuff said.

This is one of my favorite Starbucks locations- The staff is always friendly and the facility is always very clean.  They always get my order correct.  I spend quite a bit of time here studying for classes and promotions.

So...I love this chain. The variety of quality coffee drinks, the app, the rewards. This store though... Need to prepare for busy weekends. I've been waiting for 30 minutes for online order. Unacceptable.

I stopped in St. Louis for an hour and a half layover and stood in line for almost 20 minutes waiting for three employees to try and fix the espresso machine while using a vacuum cleaner off the floor to vacuum coffee beans out of the espresso machine on the top and then the coffee tasted horrible.  Worst service then no apologies for the wait. No care factor at all.
Lexi was amazing!! You need to hire more people like her!!! Super friendly and efficient!

This is the only Starbucks around the busy mall area that is actually a free-standing Starbucks. it isn't a very convenient location including the mall, a lot of different shopping plazas, and grocery stores. I came in here to do some work, and I ordered a normal latte with one of the prepackaged protein boxes. It was overall a very nice experience the Barista was friendly and fast, but the only thing that I would knock off a star  for is the seating areas. All of the chairs are wooden and not really great for working however the atmosphere itself is pleasant because it's quiet inside.

The drunks and oatmeal were good. I like the area. There's plenty of room to sit, talk and enjoy your coffee. The baristas were friendly, but they ran out of cream cheese. 

My mocha was good, and my wife like her oatmeal. I'd go back again if I were in the mall.

I've always had great service. This is definitely a busy store! The drive thru is usually pretty quick and the employees are friendly. I love all the tea options that they have and the rewards that I get. It's always been clean and decent parking.

If I could give zero stars I would. This is by far the worst Starbucks. The drinks are never made correctly, and the counters are always dirty. The trash near where they make drinks was overfilled and instead of someone taking it out, they just moved it further down the counter. Compared to the Valrico Starbucks, the customer service at this location is below par.

I visit and spend a lot Starbucks stores and hold them to a higher standard than a other coffee places as they charge a premium price for coffee and food, it's hit and miss Like others have said and this is just a slower store which is why it is always claustrophobic in there.
Many of the baristas are very nice but This location is not very intuitive and the older manager lady here is sour. Sorry I'm not the only one who has commented on this.
It would be helpful to put the mobile orders where customers can get to them.

Convenient location but my order is always not made right. Espresso frappe looks just like milk blended with ice and looks so white. Chai latte that I ordered is not the same as other Starbucks. Taste like hot milk. They need to train their baristas coz their drinks are not pretty standard.

So I am currently here at Starbucks with my daughter. We ordered 2 tall fraps. The people in front of us got their drinks and food and almost finished their sandwhich before we got our drinks. I had to tell Bridgette, the employee there, that we've been waiting 18 minutes for our drinks and still haven't gotten them yet. She looked for our cups with our names and they were nowhere to be found. That's odd!!! I physically saw the guy write our names down on the cups. Did they disappear? Did they throw them away? Or did they intentionally not make my drinks! After I had explained my situation to Bridgette which I hope shes not he manager, she simply said ok I will make them for you! With an attitude! No apology or an attempt to figure out what happened with our drinks. Poor customer service! If your going to work for the brand you have to be fast paced and still be friendly at the same time! Isn't that part of working at Starbucks????multitask!!!!!!

Glory, glory I've finally found a Starbucks where the parking lot/drive thru area isn't a nightmare. My new job takes me way out to west county near this location so I'll be coming here a lot. It hasn't been overly busy in the mornings and the drive thru goes quickly. But even when it does get congested I'll still be able to park in the adjacent parking lot without worrying about getting my car stuck because of the drive thru line (hello Brentwood!). They have a nice little patio, too.

I don't know why folks go nuts about Starbucks. It's just a better version of a Dunkin Donuts. You go in the store and you're going to leave with a nasty smell in your hair and clothes. Most of the stores, including this one, are not clean and you can easily tell. 

I see a lot of people trying to have a meeting here or try to study - but I don't know how they do that because seats are so close to each other and the music is quite loud. Last night, I was meeting someone. Right next to us was a couple sitting and there were two other tables occupied. In total we might have been 8 people. One of the workers comes out yelling: WE CLOSE! WE CLOSE! WE CLOSE! WE CLOSE! She said that to each and one of the tables. Mind you that some of them people just sat down. I saw the person I was with in the eye and we're like what in the world just happened?! She goes in the back and puts the music volume even more up! I "apologize" (not) for not knowing the closing time of your cafe, but Jeez, what kind of way is that to announce it?! Moreover - when the other customers ordered - why didn't you notify them that you close in a little bit? Thankfully I'm not a coffee addict - and good for me that I won't return here anymore. No one has time to deal with rudeness.

The staff here waters down ALL drinks, even if you ask for no water (waters down coffee, hot drinks if they don't make enough to fill the cup, ALL teas so they don't have to keep making more, lemonade, etc.) If you catch them watering it down they give you so much attitude and end up wasting more product in the end since they're so often asked to remake the orders. Moreover, it's very rare that they're fully staffed or even friendly. This is honestly the worst Starbucks I've ever been to and would not continue to waste my time or money if I didn't work across the street.

Today, I had a very bad experience at Starbucks. My drink was made incorrectly so I went back to have this rectified only to be told how to order my drink next time. Thanks, but I'm aware on how to order a drink. No other Starbucks gives me issues but today I was basically told I don't know how to order my drink. So ok, moving along. I reorder my drink again as I was instructed to only to have it remade incorrectly again! I can't even believe it! To top it off, the girl, whose name I shall leave out but it's taking everything in me, gave me attitude and was short and cut me off as I was speaking. I will never, ever return to this Starbucks again!

Employees here do not listen when you tell them something. They continue to talk to their coworkers while taking or giving your order. You have to repeat things several times until they understand your order.

This review based on multiple visits. I DON T LEARN!
Be prepared for chaos and unacceptably long wait times. At one visit I ordered a sandwich which staff person forgot about! Today there's a super long line and one worker making coffees until another showed up. Why would anyone tolerate this AT STARBUCKS PRICES???
Unless you own its stock. This is my worst Starbucks experience AND MY LAST

Here's the tea. I usually go to local nola cafe's just because I prefer their authenticity, charm, and local brews and grub. BUT I occasionally frequent SB's.

And I need these in a cafe: good coffee, vibe, coziness, privacy, tables, plugs, and friendly betches.  Here you get some of that. Parking and layout remained the same.  I got the friendly baristas and good cafe au lait.  Loved the resurfaced modern, relaxed, clean feel.  It's spacious, and has restrooms and a coffee bar up&downstairs. Parking lot is tiny as it was before, but street parking isn't bad.  There are not that many tables inside, lots outside- love that, and upstairs balcony was one long buffet table. BUT no plugs whatsoever at any spot outside. Really?  The other personal issue was there were no tables alongside the windows (up or down) for privacy or a view, just two seaters. They had a few small tables inside upstairs along walkway=noisy and nosy. Then there was the f*&^#%$ music.  They were loudly playing emo punk music.  I'm talking Green Day,  Fall Out Boy, Paramore, etc.  Like that's great and all if you're a teenager from the 2000's and want to throw back.  It was obnoxious that I had to ask the barista to lower it down. Still loud and obnoxious.  Barista explained it's a preset IPOD at a preset volume. SB wants me to jam out to Paramore?! OH and when I couldn't punk rock anymore, I left around 3pm and the Paramore fan club arrived and crowded the upstairs like it was the after party with several kids who THOUGHT they were fly AF obnoxiously LOL'ing and singing out loud. Obv DJ Barista's friends. This coffee shop used to be frequented by professionals, and focused students when it was Village Coffee.  Now it just seems like a coffee bar.  Lastly, the WIFI. Literally had to connect to my mobile hotspot to finish what I was doing.  So what I thought would be a 4hr work day, was cut short to 1hr and I left in an emo mood. #rahhhhh
Worst Starbucks ever!  Please save ur money. This place need all new employees. I shoulda got Dunkin' Donuts

There is one and ONLY one reason to keep going to this location. Diane. I never met someone with a better ability to remember people and their personal preferences. This is a busy location and each day I am in there Diane speaks to each person like they are an old friend. She is a huge asset.
This isn't a real Starbucks. It's in a Target and lacks the ambiance and quality of a stand alone. Avoid. Table was too dirty to even put my sunglasses down on it!
Honestly, this location would be SO convenient if they weren't SO SLOW. I'm not even coming here anymore.

Pros: 
-Clean, spacious inside and out. 
-The baristas are friendly and make yummy drinks
-baristas are nice and brought me water for my dog once 

Cons:
-small parking lot, usually full of cars
The employees are always rude every time I'm getting coffee whether I'm inside or just going to the window. I wish lived closer to a different Starbucks.

First off, parking is a nightmare!!  When you pull into he plaza cars are coming at you from 3 different directions, scary.  This alone makes me avoid this store.

I got a  iced Caramel Macchiato (they dropped the sugar free caramel syrup for a caramel latte).  It was pretty tasteless. They were generous with the caramel, but I don't think they put enough vanilla syrup in it.  I've had much better at two other local Starbucks. 

Staff was meh. Not very friendly, but not rude either.  I will continue to use my faves, but this one will do in a pinch and I'm jonesing for my coffee.

PS:  as is true with ALL Starbucks, way overpriced for a cup of Joe!!  M

I continually leave this Starbucks location disappointed by the staff's interaction with customers. I ordered a Frappuccino, and the response from the cashier was "You can't order that." I replied, "Excuse me, but Frappuccinos are on your menu." Then, the barista interjected "If you want a Frappuccino, I suggest going to Wawa across the street." Appalled by these employees' rude statements and poor customer service, I am disgustingly surprised that this particular Starbucks location continues to thrive. After visiting both the original Starbucks store and the Starbucks Reserve Roastery in Seattle plus multiple East Coast Starbucks locations and having enjoyed the pleasant customer service at the aforementioned locations, why does this particular location continue to have such ill-mannered employees? Please address and correct their subpar customer service. Thank you!

Got to the airport early and stopped to get a coffee and two refresher drinks. Took them 10 minutes to get me one of the refreshers and took them 20 minutes to get me my other drinks and I had to remind them. Always get your receipt back from this location.

I've spent money here multiple times, they have given me the wrong drink Two times!!! I don't think they know the difference between a Frappuccino and hot coffee ‍maybe they have new workers or something, but in my eyes it's not right if I'm spending money with Starbucks almost every day,!!

Sucked. Coffee was awful. I told the barista she made me the wrong drink and she threw attitude at me and said "yo dat' be yo drink!"  After my brain translated what she said I asked her to remake it and she refused. I finally got the manager and she made the drink correct. No apology offered though.
Horrible service! They do NOT know how to make the espresso coffees at this location! Everything tastes the same, no point of ordering cappuccinos or flat whites. They all just taste like bad lattes.

I mean, it's a Starbucks, amirite? You know what you're getting yourself into when  walking into the arms of that ever familiar green mermaid.

I do want to comment on the efficiency of the staff in the mornings. I often drop by here before work when it is super busy. However, the line goes by super quick. I have often been the fifth to sixth person in line and I'm in and out in less than 5 minutes. Awesome.

This staff is doing a great job at getting me to work on time and caffeinated!

This place is the portal to hell. I work at the mall, and having this as our only Starbucks is the worst thing to ever happen to me. Seriously, worst place ever, worst people ever, slowest service ever. You are better off driving to the one down on westshore, or walking to the opposite end of the mall and enjoying nordstroms ebar than going to this miserable place, full of miserable people.

I ordered today a caramel macchiato. The worst in my life! No coffee,  no caramel just milk. They where lucky that i was with my husband and i didn't go back to make them taste what they sell. Take a taste before you left, just in case they gave you something else. This store have a problem. Every time the coffee is different. Especially caramel macchiato. Train your barista Starbucks!!!
Condescending flamboyant employees. Out of specials every time I ask. Hate this place.

I've been coming here week now so I thought I'd wait before I wrote this review 
I come in around noon every day sandwiches are always gone by noon so if you want one get here early----- also can't seem to understand the difference between and iced caramel Machitto and a hot caramel Machitto since I order iced and they give me hot
I love this Starbucks my boyfriend and I come here all the time and we pretty much always get a large chocolate mocha and a Large Dragon fruit refresher with lemonade and it's so good!!!

I usually don't go to this location because lack of drive thru, crowded,  parking issues and or poor service.  But this morning took the cake! As I walked in at 9 a.m. an outgoing customer mumbled something about nobody's working, which I thought was a peculiar statement.  So I  go to  order my iced tea and banana bread and find the two employees in deep conversation with a couple regarding donations. I hope this is the right location. The Starbucks outside security between A and C gates is great. Well, the woman working this morning is great. I arrived at the airport early and stopped in for a coffee and breakfast sandwich before I went through security. 

It's early, she's working by herself, and for the 45-ish minutes I was there she was the most positive and helpful Starbucks employee I've encountered in a long time. Multi tasked with the drinks and sandwiches, was kind with people who repeated their orders or checked in on things assuming she had forgot (she hadn't), & was super efficient. A great airport coffee experience

This Starbucks in Target has just been renovated and looks great. The girls have been there for a long time and always make my orders perfectly every time. This place is better than the "real" Starbucks in Brooksville on route 50. Don't pass up a chance for a great drink the next time you visit this Target store.

I visited this location on two occasions and was vastly disappointed. Not only was the store dirty and messy, but the baristas were rude and inattentive. I am understanding that food was not available, but I will not excuse the poor customer service. If I was able to rate zero stars, I would.
New location with a drive through. Comfy seating. Lots of power outlets if you plan to hang out.

Sorry...just venti-ing!!
Forgot my order and took 5 min, it's whatever 2 star from me because they did make up my drink right away when I said something.

Definitely my favorite Starbucks location in the Brandon area! The employees are sweet and helpful. Typically my go to spot to do some reading or just to hang out and have a drink. Definitely recommend the strawberry banana smoothie and the strawberry refresher!

This is by far the best Starbucks I have ever been in....hands down.  Staff is always friendly and accommodating and coffee is always fresh!  I drove past 2 other Starbucks to come to this one every day!  The Best!!

I tend to go to this Starbucks when visiting back home. They never disappoint. The staff is friendly and courteous. I never seem to have a line or long wait either which is nice. Plenty of room to park since it's attached to other businesses too.

Always get my order right. This kiosk store can be crazy busy but, the customer service is always great.
Brand spanking new with a very scary fruit fly problem in their display case, in their restrooms and seating area. Like whoa...

Food and drink the same as other locations.

If I could give No stars- I would! 
First day in NOLA - stopped in for a quick refresh...

Not fun.
Slowest Starbuck's I've ever been to. It takes 20 mins to get an iced coffee. I've taken to just getting a hot house coffee because I know they'll just grab it for me while I'm at the register. Ugh.

Nice SBUX to relax and catch up on work with USB and electric in front of a warm fire. Good service, hot tasty drink. Comfortable and convenient!

Located near sweetbay, this is your average Starbucks. Nothing phenomenal but consistent with the others in the area.

Located in the corner unit of a strip mall just off Causeway Blvd, this is a convenient place (for me) to get a quick caffeine fix.
