One thing I have noticed lately is that when I order hot drinks, they aren't filled up all the way. With how pricey it can get at Starbucks, I wish they would fill the cups all the way. The tables are never clean either from what I've noticed, but I never dine in. Just a heads up for other people. Other than that, I've had pretty good experiences.
Great staff. Quick and easy service. I love that it's inside the Safeway because it's actually a lot quicker since there's no line out the door. Even offered to fill up my water bottle.

Over the last several years I have frequented this location because I have family and friends in the area. I am boring, I just get a vanilla bean Frappuccino or a hot chocolate with whipped cream. I too am challenges with the beverage size names, and experienced one of the baristas, Melissa, who has waited on my many times before, said we also speak English you can use small, medium, large. I thought this was funny because as a non-coffee drinker I am not ordering and using the purpose behind the names and descriptions of the beverages. Because to me a grande should be larger than a venti. So, I stick to small, medium and large. Ha Ha! I have been in the store and in the drive thru, and have always had a very good experience and they have always been helpful. Melissa works hard. I have seen her be at the front and at the drive thru at the same time. And she remembers me when I come in to order and I am not there on a daily basis. It is more every few months. So kudos!

I visited this Starbucks in Carmel, IN today and got one of my usuals: a no water Chai latte. It was one of the best ones I've had. I went back a little later and was told they don't refill lattes. Ok cool. No problem. EXCEPT, this same day, a colleague of mine purchased an espresso. And was told, by the same staff, that they do not refill espressos but they would be willing to refill her cup with coffee. So I can only ask "What makes her order different from mine that you are willing to offer her an alternative to her refill and not give me the same courtesy?" This is the second time I've had customer service issues with this particular Starbucks. I've never had an issue at any other Starbucks I've visited. Correct me if I'm wrong, but didn't Starbucks shut down for training on racial bias? Oh did I mention my colleague is white. But the minute you draw a white person's attention to their own racial bias, they are taken aback and shocked that you would dare insinuate such an accusation. That is literally the only difference between myself and my colleague. We are both women. I'm polite when I order; I'm sure she is as well. She's taller than me though- maybe it's a height thing. She's white. I'm black. I'm tired and bored with white service workers who don't want to extend the level of courtesy and professionalism to customers of color the same way they do to their white customers.

I don't add cream to my coffee, so logically, I do not want my Starbucks barista to prepare my coffee for me with the top third of the cup empty to make room for cream.  I learned quickly that people are encouraged to tell the baristas "room for cream" if they want it, and "no room for cream" if they do not.  So that is what I continuously did.  And the baristas would nod and smile and it would seem that they were listening, so it was awfully surprising when I'd open my cup to put my Equal in and see that they have graciously made room for cream.

Gah.

The first few times this happened, I was willing to let it go; I'm not one to rock the boat, and at the times I'd be visiting this Starbucks it was always five minutes before I was starting work for the day, so I wasn't really interested in waiting some more.  Additionally, I don't think I have much drive in me prior to my first cup of coffee of the day to even formulate a good conversation, so it was all for naught, really.   

However, one day I finally had enough.  Ever the optimist, and coupled with a naivete that somehow didn't get squashed while growing up in New York, I ordered my coffee with no room for cream, and a ready-for-cream cup was returned to me.   I gave the cup back to the barista after my discovery and asked her to please fill it up.    She told me I had to wait in line again to order.   I got a little feisty and told her that was a page in the unfair book that I had highlighted and earmarked, and that it doesn't take a lot for her to please just take the large container of coffee located just to her left and use the next three seconds of her life to put it in my cup.   She then rolled her eyes and made some remark to a fellow employee that people like me are the reason she wants to 'quit the coffee business forever.'  I couldn't contain myself and proceeded to laugh at her.   

I mean, it's just a lot of headache to simply procure a coffee!  I gave the situation some thought for awhile afterwards and my conclusion is that there is absolutely nothing SO great about anything Starbucks has available that I would be so terribly lost without it and have to return.  I can get better tasting coffee *anywhere* in the city, even right next door.  And I can get better pastries elsewhere.   And so on.  Though I guess I am a little sad that I won't be able to buy those weird CD compilations Starbucks sells off of their record label or whatever the deal is with that.   Sarcasm meter on.

One of the nicest Starbucks in Tucson I've been to! I had a great shop back in Chandler so was antsy to find another personable location. This crew is great - friendly and work well under pressure. Remember, even if you have a simple order there is someone ahead or behind you with a ridiculous request...these baristas do their best to make your experience and drink top notch!

Always friendly here. They got busy while we were here and they handled it well. Lots of customers with multiple drinks in their orders. They made great recommendations depending on my taste. They will always steer you in the right direction. If you haven't tried a Clover brew, you've missed out.  You can get any of their beans ground fresh and made to order, hot or cold.
Huge Starbucks!!  Nice and cool inside. Clean and very pleasant workers! Fast service!!
This place gets the order wrong every time. Tea tastes watered down. I'll travel the extra distance and go to neshaminy or oxrord oaks.

We stopped in two times to grab tea/water and use the bathroom. The staff is very nice and the store is clean and well stocked. The women's restroom was down and had to use the men's which needed a bit of cleaning. Good location for a pop up wedding parade as well as we saw one each day.

Just went to the drive-through. It is 5 PM and I was informed they are closed for the day. There are no signs anywhere. No explanation as to why they are closed at 5 PM on Wednesday. Maybe they should get their shit together and put signs or something in the window so everybody who was in front of me and behind me didn't go out of their way to get to the drive-through for no reason.
But while I'm here- let's talk about the terrible inconsistent service. Always always always test or
Your drink before you leave because there's a good chance it will be wrong.
Wait times at the drive-through are also  the worst in the entire Tampa area. If you can, go to the Starbucks down in front of the golf view mall. Quick and easy
Worst customer service and wrong mobile order. For being so expensive, they should hire better staff. Rude and not personable like other locations I've been to. Will never order from here again.
The staff here is really friendly. I was shocked to see that considering the recent controversy.

The Starbucks in the Joe Crowley often messes up orders or takes forever to get out food. The blonde manager is really rude and doesn't seem to have a good control over her staff. My friend and I have ordered drinks there with curdled milk and when we went for new drinks they gave us the same old milk and glared as the drinks were announced. This is not the first time I've had bad milk so I will probably stop going to this location

The ladies that work here are rockstars! They whipped through a line almost 20 people deep like a well-oiled machine and did so with charm and a smile!

Seriously, one of the nicest SBux experiences I have had overall, let alone at an airport! It was an especially pleasant to get my caffeine as fast as I did since I was sleep-deprived and headed on a very early morning flight. 

Would gladly go through this specific TPA SBux again in a heartbeat!

Disappointing. 4 workers behind the counter. Dirty tables, empty napkin folder, not much of a selection of scone - blueberry or mini vanilla. No comfortable chairs to have my coffee. We were the only customers there. Thanks

Like another reviewer wrote "Starbucks is Starbucks". I second that assertion. Unlike many, I am not a Starbucks' devotee. With that said, I know there are many people who regularly stop by for beverages. I often laugh when I see the daily Starbucks' accoutrement, which makes me wonder if it just a status symbol for some or is it really that good? I have tried the hot coffee, frappucinos and some of the iced beverages from places all over the country and still cannot understand the fascination. 

Since I typically stay for about a week when I visit, I like to switch up my breakfast choices. This location inside of the hotel is always the spot for a quick breakfast that I can quickly purchase and take back to the room before really starting my day. As with most Starbucks' locations, this one is pretty busy in the mornings. However, that has never interrupted the service flow. 

The location is always clean and the staff are okay. Most of the time, I really get the impression that some of the staff just work there and are not truly committed to customer service, but it is convenient.

Nice run of the mill starbuck.

Cashier let me try the nitro coffee before I purchased it. I never had it before and wanted to try something new. Less bitter than any of the other coffee from Starbucks. I ordered it with sweet cream in it. Yum!!!

The employees were attentive and great and treated everyone equitable while I was there.

I am currently boycotting the Starbucks by my house on Royal Oaks for this one! This is without a doubt the FASTEST drive through around. They are friendly and always accurate with my order. This is what Starbucks should be!

What can I say? It's your average neighborhood Starbucks that fails to live up to the hype. I'm not sure what the obsession with this place is. I do come here occasionally because I am usually offered (by a friend for example) a free meal because this is what they enjoy, so I take it. If I had to pay the full price for this stuff, I'd never come here.

I'm sure most of what I'm going to say is going to apply to every Starbucks out there. This is given the fact that they hardly do any real work to make the food besides heat it up and for the drinks, follow a set recipe. The only thing that'll possibly differ from other Starbucks locations is that this one tends to burn any food that's heated up - consistently. You can see the burnt bottom of my ham and cheese croissant in the photo. Must just be a feature of the oven here.

Now, onto the stuff that applies to every Starbucks I've ever been to. If you want a popular item, you can't always expect it. There will be times that items have run out. I bought this food today at 10:00 am and this was the first time they've had a ham and cheese croissant in days. In fact, when I asked if they had ham and cheese croissants, the employee responded with "yes we have one ham and cheese croissant". I'm not sure if he was trying to ration the ever-popular ham and cheese croissants by only selling me one, or that he really only had one croissant left at 10:00 am after not having them for days. With other items, you will find that this applies to any Starbucks.

The second major thing to note is that you're paying for half filled cups of whatever drink you get. In my pictures below you can see how much of my green tea frappuccino was just ice that I threw down the sink - OVER HALF OF IT. This was despite the fact that I asked them to double blend the drink because I suspected that this would happen. It sucks that their frappuccino drinks are never actually blended well enough. I've had green tea milkshakes better than this frap from a mall booth, and I was actually able to finish drinking them because they weren't half ice. It's just another way that Starbucks tries to scam you out of your money, though.

A few other small things... the Bantam bagels are okay but are far more bread than cream cheese. Definitely dry and in need of more cream cheese flavor. However, this is the closest thing you'll come to a bagel and cream cheese at Starbucks in your morning rush, because Starbucks doesn't put the cream cheese on your bagels for you. Also, for all the money you're paying for their overpriced stuff, you still have to ask for napkins. They do not come standard no matter what you order. Weird... I thought my $20 drink, bagel, and croissant warranted a few napkins free of charge.

Also, at this location, I once ordered on the mobile app and the inventory wasn't updated, apparently. When I got there, they didn't actually have 3 of the items I ordered in stock. It was okay, though, because they made up for it with great customer service. They refunded me for those items that weren't in stock and still let me choose another item for free. I do have to admit that their customer service is usually on point.

This is the WORST Starbucks in the chain, hands down. To have not met one pleasant barista and yesterday when we ordered the BOGO frappe and said we were ordering the BOGO we were chewed out for "not telling me before I swiped". Sorry but your ineptitude is not my fault!

Order was accurate and quick, however the Star War's soundtrack that they had going was so loud I could hear it through my headphones. This is clearly not an isolated incident as there is a prior review that implied the music made it feel like a nightclub. I was one of four working on things (school, work, etc.), you know because it's a Starbucks and usually it's a quiet environment with wifi where people can get work done. However, it took me four hours to get 1.5 hours worth of work done. You're paid to be there, whereas we pay to be there, so it may behoove you to be respectful of your patrons. Thanks.

Unless you do a mobile order, plan to wait for 20 plus minutes to get your order even taken. They ignore the line completely in order to prioritize mobile orders. With 3 people in front of us it took 20 minutes to have our order taken because the employees ignored the line and did all the mobile orders.  There were 7 people behind us waiting for them to take orders. It was ridiculous

The wait was ridiculously long! On waiting to order and longer for drink pick up. There's so many people behind the counter yet the drinks still takes 20 minutes to make. Not recommended if you're in a rush.
If I say too many good things people will think I'm a plant or fake. This location is beyond amazing, accommodating and over the top friendly. I enjoy starting my mornings here.

I was placed order from here today, I gave them only one star. First of all, I was order the large hot coffee but the coffee is not hot, not even warm. The second one ( in my opinion, the one of the most important thing of a business) is service.  I didn't get any greeting when I place the order. To be honest, I don't really care about that.  After I get my "Hot Coffee", I was realized there is no more half and half cream there. And I went to counter and asked for some cream with the empty cream container. I said : excuse me, excuse me. No one answer me. Maybe they did not notice I was talking with them or whatever I don't know. For the third time I said excuse me, may I get some half and half from you，please! And the men just took it without saying anything.  Then he gave me the cream I said thank you to him. He didn't say anything either.  If you want your business getting better, don't you think customer service is one of most important thing?

I really like this location. The setup is pretty fantastic. I love the wood look throughout the store, and the space is very large. On my most recent trip, both outlets in the back of the store did not work. Another downside is that the music is always way too loud. 

I can definitely see how this place can get crowded during peak hours or high volume tourist travel times. 

Otherwise, this is a great option for coffee if you're in the CBD/French Quarter area.

Showed up at 7pm and the place closes at 9pm. ALL the food was pulled, had to wait about 5 minutes for someone to come up from the back, was told they are not making Frappuccinos any more tonight because they already cleaned everything. It's 95 degrees outside and that makes no sense. So my suggestion would be there at least 3-4 hours before they close or else you can't get anything.

Ashley is the stores best barista and I have to say when Sean is calling out the mobile orders he seems to be making the other barista's nervous and flustered. No I don't know if he's a manager or not but if he is his managing is not strong. Whenever Ashley makes my drink it's always perfect when anybody else makes it always wrong.

Recently waited over 10 minutes for a drink while walking in. Rather disappointing.  I drove through the next day for an order and the person working the register looked at my twice but didn't open the window until finally the third time. She asked what i ordered and said it wasn't on the screen. She then yelled to one of her coworkers "you didn't input his order!"  Honestly better off driving to a different Starbucks location because disappointing service seems to be the constant.

Never have I had an issue with this Starbucks the only reason they are getting 3 stars and not 5 is because I ordered on the app so it would be "quicker" I could have came in and ordered normally and gotten my food quicker, there are so many mobile orders sitting here as I type and mine is still not done very upset about this.

Customers are not as important as the conversations that the workers are having! Lines could be around the corner but until they are done talking about the night before you won't be getting any coffee! If you go to this location your gonna be 5-10 minutes late for work!

So I am an frequent Starbucks visitor. I recently moved jobs bring me closer to this Starbucks location. This is the third time I have placed a mobile order, prep time for every drink is 4-9 minutes. Without fail I have my drink 15 minutes after I place my order, very disappointing! Then today, I go in and have to change my mobile order because of a discontinued item and am greeted with eye rolls because I didn't know what I wanted the second after I was told I couldn't have what I ordered. When I decided, no one wanted to take charge of actually filling the order. Once filled I received this(see picture), what's the point of ordering a Trenta size if it's not filled up! Extremely disappointed!

So disappointed. I ordered a tall white chocolate mocha without whip cream, I got a tall warm cup of MILK :(
I immediately went back & asked the the person making the orders if she could redo mine as if tasted nothing like what I had ordered. I got no apologies, no comment....I was actually the one who apologized for not liking the taste of warm milk at 5am.
My 2nd attempt at it was exactly the same...warm milk!
Ugh, I tried to drink it down but it ended up in the trash.
Nothing like spending  $5 for something you couldn't even enjoy.
Starbucks should have EVERY employee follow Spec...I should be able to walk into any Starbucks & know that anything I order off their menu will be consistent.
Next time I'm in Nashville I'll take my coffee at the hotel :/
A friend of mine told me she waited 35 minutes for her drink earlier today. Didn't think that was possible, but I stood in line for 25 minutes at 1:45pm on a Sunday. STAFF YOUR STARBUCKS BETTER.

There isn't much to say about this place. It's located in the mall. I came on a busy Saturday night. The staff kept their cool and everything came out great! 

It was my first time trying the Mango Dragonfruit Drink. It is now my favorite! It has just the right amount of sweet and tangy flavor. The color on this drink is GORG! Its such a beauty you almost don't want to drink it! I loved it!

The girl who works the morning shift is the worst. She never smiles, never gets a basic coffee right. She doesn't wear a name tag. I get the same iced coffee a couple times a week and she always makes them hot. And here I am agin for the third time this morning she's remaking my coffee.
We're new to town and I like having a reliable Starbucks down the street.  The baristas are friendly and efficient. I love that there is outside space to relax and enjoy my coffee.

This location may be the busiest but has the rudest baristas. 

This Starbucks is located on Westshore, next to Ruth Chris's Steakhouse. Not to fret, there are plenty of parking spots available. If in a hurry, there's also a drive-thru feature at this location. Lots of seating available inside and outside the coffee shop. 

I usually indulge on a hazelnut macchiato whereas my date gets a tea. This particular visit, I had the chocolate croissant. It was mediocre, the layers weren't flaky. 

Overall, not a good visit.

The usual!  No complaints. Got the coffee. Although the person taking my order must have been new because she got it wrong. The barista had no problem taking care of it. 

A typical Starbucks and layout!

Come here on a regular basis and this is the worst run Starbucks I have ever experienced. I have been a regular Starbucks customer for over 15 years and have been to Starbucks all over the country. My mobile order is rarely ready when I arrive here and I usually just order a dark coffee with half and half. I get here and the employees are sitting around talking while my mobile order sits on the printer until I arrive. While I prefer Starbucks to other coffee providers, I am done with them. Some one needs to do something about this location!

Just opened up. Nice addition as it is directly on my way to work but there are a lot of cafes in the neighborhood. It is a nice size overall. I'm curious to see how busy it is going to get. I feel like I watched this place get built in a few weeks. I love a nice iced americano for the morning walk. The staff was friendly.

Horrible customer service through drive through. The guy who works the window is rude!!! He acts like he hates his job. Hopefully they do some moving around and can get someone else too the window who actually cares about customers and doesn't slam the window.

I have never been to a more disgusting dirty location. Took forever to get black tea lemonade. Every table was dirty, the counters and floors were just gross! And the employees were making a mess making drinks, spilling all over floor and counters. Ugh, won't be back.

I was HOPING that I would finally get my drink, ordered at "kids temp" (125 deg, warm)... actually at kids temp and NOT scalding hot. Wrong again. I don't know why it's so difficult for them to get this right, especially for a $5+ drink. I honestly wonder if they don't know everyone is in a hurry for work and in too much of a rush to go back and complain.
I regularly have this problem and end up with a burnt tongue. On one occasion, I made sure to stick my finger in it before driving off and realized how hot it was. I politely asked the drive through person to remake it at kids temp. While I was waiting, the girl at the window chatted with me and told me she is also sensitive to super hot drinks. By the time I got my newly made drink, I was in a bit of a hurry, so I quickly grabbed my drink around the sleeve, dropped it in the cup holder and drove off. A few minutes later I was on the freeway and reached for my drink. I grabbed around the upper portion of the cup, where the sleeve did not cover. It was so hot that I nearly dropped it on myself. I looked at the cup where the printed sticker usually is (that shows what was ordered). Because they remade it, there was no sticker. Handwritten with a sharpie (in HUGE print) it read "X-HOT". Hmm. Disgruntled employee upset that I called them out for making my drink wrong? Were they trying to punish me for asking them to do their JOB correctly? I know what I thought, but you decide.
I'd give anything for a half-priced-just-as-good mom and pop place nearby. I hate that this Starbucks is the only thing near me.

Never get my order right. Always takes at least 10 minutes for one drink regardless of the time of day. Asked them to save grinds for my garden (which they should do anyways) showed up later that day and had a bag of air waiting for me. Worst location I've ever experienced by far.

Been here quite a few times to study and meet up with friends. I would say typical Starbucks, always like to study here because of the overall atmosphere. Coffee is good, along with breakfast sandwiches, definitely recommend those if in a rush in the morning. Fast about the orders too, came out in no time.

I've been going to Starbucks for years now (this one included) and I have to say they provide the worst service out of all the locations that I frequent. The past couple visits they missed an item in my order and this morning they didn't even check their mobile orders. What's the point of having the ability to do this is they don't even check for them? I live 20 minutes away from the nearest Starbucks so I expected this order to be ready when I got there (especially since I have a cranky baby with me).

This location is nice like any other Starbucks.. but parking is a problem. You have to park in the garage and walk up the stairs to get to it... not ideal. I'm a drive through kinda guy on most days bc it's more convenient.
Fast and friendly service! Love paying with the app and so many choices to choose from!

It's Starbucks...mostly consistent factory product delivery with variation in the accessibility, architecture, staff and local management. This is a relatively new spot (so new that Google maps doesn't fully know about it as of this post.) Kudos to the team as staff are pleasant and on point. Your mileage is going to vary as "disappointing" is the best I can say overall, though you can still satisfy your buzz crave.

Accessibility gets low marks due to poor design of the strip center near the Ovation property that may or may not ever fully materialize. Parking is a challenge and will only become worse as the area expands to more fully suck. Lanes are narrow, few, and full even during off-peak hours.

Architecture and design earn fails for both the garage band harshness of what should feel like an invitation to someone's bonus room and lack of convenient access to amenities. Decor is comfy and open, but noise reduction is either missing altogether or substantially neglected by the designers. Forget conversation, but no one talks these days. Right?

Convenience also seems to have missed the design requirements. Customers must swim 10-15 yards upstream from the door through the line or circumnavigate the tables into the rear of the space to order. Add to that a lack of trash cans; none may be found in view if they actually exist in the general customer space at all. Two small (not much larger than a Grande cup) orifices exist built-in at the pickup counter. Wade through all waiting customers (as well as those grazing over condiments and napkins) and you'll arrive at the too-small trash holes whose bins are usually filled to the wood of the counter top. It scores two thumbs way, way down as they help your fingers cram refuse into a wet lack of space.

Today, on Christmas, I called this canal location and was told they closed at 3pm. I am an ER nurse and while at work we decided to make a group coffee run. We arrived at 2:40 and as we attempted to walk in the barista shut the door in our face and locked it. There were still patrons inside. She went so far as to not let the patrons leave while we were still standing outside in shock at the rudeness. We were clearly dressed in our scrubs and in desperate need of caffeine. I will
Never go to another starbucks after being treated so poorly. Zero Christmas spirit obviously.

Not my favourite Starbucks... it's much too busy for me. It isn't well lit and the size of it is kind of oddly shaped, very long, which makes everything squishy. Staff are nice and I would say that I go here primarily because of the convenience factor... why not have a latte to sip as you stroll around southgate? At least they make your drinks properly here.

Coming from New York my standards are high... Not only is the service slow as molasses but mid way though my iced coffee I almost choked on the Baristas turquoise HAIR!!! I literally had to pull it out of my throat. The most horrifying experience ever! Just the thought of it sitting in my coffee the entire time gives me the chills.. On top of the fact I had to pry it out of my throat. 

The gentlemen before me had returned his cappuccino because he found a hair in his cup as well.I've been coming to Starbucks for years and never ever has this happened. Being a female I understand that our hair falls out all the time but as an establishment that Handles food and beverages this should never happen. I'm so very disappointed!

This is the only Starbucks that always gets my order wrong. Was just there and ordered a Coffee Frap with Java chips. Instead I get a Java chip frap and I repeatedly ask if that was a coffee frap and they continued to say yes. It was so chocolaty I had to dump it. Well either the people need some more training on how to make drinks or they need to clean their ears out so they can listen better. Thanks for making me waste my $7.

Not only is the parking lot horrible- but the service hers is horrible! It takes 10 minutes or more for the drive through! And most of the time they get the order wrong! I ask for whole milk and 9 out of 10 times they get it wrong! So disappointing ! And I pay 5$ or more for a cup ! So disappointing
I was satisfied with my order and the staff was pleasant; my only gripe would be that the place could use sweeping and the lounge seating and tables could be spritzed ,swept off and wiped down.

Mobile order team dropped the ball today.  Placed order when I arrived.  Kid apologized saying he "didn't see it" (the order) This location has a nice team but some lack enthusiasm.  

No "real Starbucks vibe" here this eve..

Corporation is losing its touch on all fronts. Service. Orders.  Product line.  

Having a mobile order feature for customers involves more than an app and collecting g money.  You need to have the product prepared.

I can't stand going here when there is a line longer than 3 cars. They send a person to take your order outside. I was about 5 cars back from the ordering speaker, so clearly I can't see the menu.... how that makes sense, I dont know... I usually don't know what I want, so I like to view the menu and see what sounds good at the time,  but here, I cant. When I asked if he had a menu I could look at he said no. The least you could do is invest in a print out menu to have while taking orders away from the window. I expect this from a fast food restaurant, but come on starbucks, you're better than that. I won't come here anymore, because it's THAT annoying to me.

The drive thru line was extremely long, but sometimes that happens and that's ok no biggie. But DAMIEN on the other hand was extremely rude to us for no reason, rolling his eyes when asked to add vanilla that they forgot in our vanilla latte. And just had an overall poor attitude.....not what I expect from a Starbucks. Loose the tude DAMIEN life isn't that bad :)

Zack you were the best. Keep up the good work. My wife and I have been to Starbucks all over the world and u and the other employees were great. Coffee was Johnny on the spot. U can bet we will be back. 
Thanks Karl and Fran

What is painfully that I sit in line for 20 mins to text my job that I'm going to be late because one person takes the order, one person makes all the drinks, the one person taking order is preparing the food also but watching the other person stock straws, cups and things that don't help the flow of business. Guess I need to go somewhere else with a little more organization and direction on how to be more productive. #starbucks #killme

Came in with an order for four people. They ran out of ingredients for 1 drink that needed to be changed. Then the line of people behind us began getting their drinks first. When we asked about our drinks, they said they were not doing them in order. Are you kidding me.. Will not come back to this location.

Very happy to see a Starbucks open up in the graduate hospital area! Although there are other great coffee shops in the area, Starbucks is always reliable and open much later than the others.  Great place for caffeine fix later in the evening.

I stopped in here to plan my boogaloo I'm get a frappuccino like we do. The nice guy taking orders was fine and quick. The fella Zach was making drinks and repeatedly getting on his cell phone which took time from making drinks. His scattered his brain giving people orders that came and payed after I did. Just poor service compared to other Starbucks I would not use this position for planning a boogaloo.

I love this Starbucks.  The employees are very warm, nice and call me by name.  The only reason it is not a 5 star is because I am an app orderer and they sometimes turn the app off for no apparent reason.  When you tell them about it they sometimes forget they turned it off or were not told by one of the other shift it was turned it off.
Staff is clueless here. They don't seem to know what's happening. Nice but clueless. Can't recommend this location.

I spent more than 3 hours in this Starbucks drinking coffee and working. The staff were ultra-friendly and the pastry was fresh. The coffee was, well, Starbucks. Only issue, there was a mentally ill person roaming around the restaurant in a bit of a panic for more than 2 hours. She was drinking a Starbucks Venti cup of water. I returned to this store three more times and the same woman was wondering around in the dining area.

I love Starbucks but specifically THIS one. Why? Well aside from the fact that my drink is always perfect the only other reason I go out of my way to come here is because of the staff. I have never before met people who consistently greet with you smiles at 7:30am and always leave you with a happy faces on your cup or some seemingly genuine words to get your day going. Thanks Starbucks staff, you always make my day.

Nope. Just nope. Cost way too much for what you get. They're coffee is way too acidic, and far too pretentious. When I want a cup of coffee or an espresso I'd like to be able to state I'd like a small, medium or large. Venti pfft! Besides that, it gives me an upset tummy. So over s***bucks.
Their staff is super sweet and easy to talk to and make drinks within a reasonable time frame. I enjoy this starbucks atmosphere compared to others!

This is a nice big clean Starbucks on Canal around a lot of busy hotels. There was only one person in line in front of me. The girl started ringing me up, stopped in the middle and got someone else since she was going on break. That person started ringing me up then stopped halfway and said someone else needed to train on the register. During this time two people behind me were rang up on the other register which was frustrating since I had my toddler with me and needed to get in and get out. I finally got my drink and it wasn't very good. Tasted like their shots are burnt and there wasn't enough flavoring. Definitely didn't stop by any more on the rest of my trip.

This store seems somehow better now.  Maybe the flow is quicker during the morning rush?  Maybe its now that the lady cashier knows me by face I get better service?  I still cringe when I spend over $7.00 on coffee/espresso drinks and a breakfast sandwich - so I am not in here often.
Love starbucks drinks but I will never go to this location again. Waited 45 mins in the drive thru only to get the wrong size.

My last visit here was a double whammy of "what?" consisting of 1) getting a hot drink when I ordered iced (yes, it was quickly remade), and 2) discovering later that a free reward drink hadn't been processed as I requested, but instead I had just paid almost $7 for my drink.  I go to this location quite a bit, but this was just depressing.  The friendliness of the people behind the counter don't quite make up for the incompetence.
I sat the drive thru for about ten minutes until I said hello & the worker answered. Drink was good.

More than half of the people here were waiting for their coffee.  I put in a mobile order, and my breakfast sandwhiches were done by the time I arrived.  However, my brewed coffee and green tea took a total of 20 minutes (exactly).  They're down to one espresso machine today, but it seemed like there were plenty of staff... one person was being trained... maybe have someone pour drip coffee and make tea? 

Otherwise, place seems nice. Plenty of seating and not too loud.

Very poor customer service. Employee who made the coffee didn't say the name & put the coffee on the counter & another customer walked away with my coffee. He came back 2 mins later & returned it. She wanted me to take that coffee and I refused. Asked her to please remake it and she was extremely rude.

Absolutely the worst Starbucks in town ! I have never seen such rude baristas in the 18 plus years of going Starbucks ... which we visit on a daily basis! While waiting for our drinks, two customers complained about their drinks being wrong and the three idiots working there acted like it was the customers' fault and were EXTREMELY rude to them ! We waited for over 15 minutes for two lattes to be made while the three idiots talked. Do yourself a favor and drive 1/2 mile to the location on Damonte !!

Worst Starbucks I've ever been to. The staff hate their lives and they make sure to show you that. They don't know what they are doing, can't get the order right and not as well trained as regular Starbucks staff you would see elsewhere. They make fun of customer, they are slow, they are rude. Half of the people waited in line ended up leaving before getting close to the register. They tried to charge me extra while redeeming my free reward because "the add-in is not free". I had to correct them because everyone with common sense would know how rewards work. The responds I got were unforgettable: the cashier said "we have to charge you", the barista said "they should have charged you" with a chuckle, the manager turned around and told me "it doesn't come with the drink so you have to pay for it". Of course I refused to pay anything extra for my FREE drink. The drink tasted awful too.

I just left this Starbucks and immediately pulled my car over into some random parking lot because I HAD to write them a review. It's Tampa..on a Thursday morning..at 7:30 am. I got into the drive thru line behind 7+ cars thinking to myself, oh joy.. this is probably going to take a while. I kid you not, I was ordering within 3 or so minutes and they had my cheese danish and latte (which was made to absolute perfection) to me *in under a minute.* Don't know what kind of magic these barista wizards are using back there, but I have never been so impressed/mind-blown in my life. Keep up the awesome work you guys!

Kudos to this Starbucks for having a back bone. Some unpleasant woman named "Precious" came in with some stupid looking man, demanding that their drinks be remade. However, the drinks were not from that day. Starbucks apparently has a "same day same store" policy which the baristas rightly enforced. When the baristas informed them of the policy they got very rude and demanding. The guy that was with her dropped the f-bomb and demanded to speak with a manager. They almost became threatening. These two were clearly scammers. Precious J. and whoever that guy was, I hope you both get trespassed and never come back. Bye.
Thirty minutes and counting in the drive thru line on a Sunday at 6:30 pm. You guys need to get it together. Seriously.

The service here, like any Starbucks I've visited, is all smiles :)  When I have questions about new seasonal beverages, they are more than happy to help me with my selection and take their time.  Walking in, you're greeted with happiness, and when using the drive-through, they always manage to let their personality and friendly demeanor shine through!  The service is prompt and even long drive-through lines move quite quickly.

Went to this Starbucks location this morning to order my drink and got THE RUDEST barista I've ever met in all the states I've been to and all the Starbucks I have been to this one was just a total jerk!! I didn't even get to finish ordering my drink as he cut me off multiple times. I understand not hearing me clearly but after he ignored my request for light almond milk... I want extra frap roast but you wouldn't let me speak to even order it!!!!! I ended up leaving because I was so upset about it. I've never been treated that way before at a Starbucks. I spend a lot of $$$ there and to be spoken to like that was OUT OF LINE.

Worst customer service. Similar to McDonald's in the hood. Line of people and only three out of the 6 staff are actually servicing the customers. The cashier was even making drinks as the other three (including the manager) were standing around, joking being loud and doing fluff tasks that could wait. 

Completely unprofessional.
The BNA Gate C location always has just one cashier working while the line leads all the way out the door and onto the concourse. Get it together guys.

Wouldn't give me the code for bathroom until AFTER I had bought my espresso 

Otherwise nice space
Good seating area

But thumbs down for customer service

This starbucks at the corner of 20th & Market serves the local lawyers and stock exchange folks and they really manage the morning line well.  Staff is decent enough - and the bathroom is usually OK - kept locked.

Not bad!

The staff is nice. They make you think twice. Hold the sugar, none for me. I'm pretentious as can be. I tried to sit, but the crowd hit. I tried to lit, but they told me no weed. I have to succeed, I need a coffee fo free.

I frequent this location often because it's literally down the street from my house. I have never had a problem in there, but lately, it seems they got new staff or something because the baristas are extremely lazy!  The last two visits, two different baristas mixed two drinks in one blender when the ingredients have different measurements! I watched them do this with my own two eyes! Like are you kidding me, each drink is very specific for a reason, that's why we have the option to customize our drinks and for you to totally disregard that is flat out rude!!!!!  I need them to get it together, I shouldn't have to stand watch like a hawk to get a drink i am paying for made properly!

As an observant customer on a first visit I noticed this particular Starbucks was filled with exceptionally friendly and happy team members and customers. The people behind the counter are very engaging and seem genuinely happy to see their customers. Upon a second visit, I experienced even more of the good energy and made contact with a couple baristas who made me feel very welcome. This is my favorite Starbucks!  I will be back as often as possible while in Philadelphia.

I stop at this location at least 4 x a week for the most part I'm satisfied with the service I've received but there have been a few problems with this location opening on time and not because of bad weather. The store is not the cleanest especially early in the morning,and there has been 1 or 2 employees who were a bit unfriendly,. The guys seem genuinely friendly and are the reason I go back and give tips.

Let me start off by saying im not from here. This is my second time down here in the last 4 months, first time at this SB. Normally goto the one in the Brandon mall. 
But glad I came in, apparently the guy i think his name was Cory now works here. I kno him from the other starbucks. Anyway, its been about 3 months since i last saw him & he remembered my drink. 
Now that is what I call customer service

Not like Starbucks at all. I was the only person in line, and had to wait 3 minutes to place my order. Then they forgot part of my order. I was handed my blueberry scone in its plastic wrapper. Boo on you, Sbux!

Please update your hours! I've tried to come through between 5:30-6am multiple times when being called into work and either no one is there or, like this morning, one lady is there without a headset and not paying any attention to let customers in.

I come to this Starbucks enough to know when a bad experience moves from once in a while to consistent. It seems that some of the employees have changed so perhaps this has led to a change in efficiency level. Several times I have made a mobile order only to have to ask them to retrieve it from the printer five minutes after the order was made. I saw one woman waiting 10 minutes on one occasion. These are not during busy or backed up periods. Most recently, it took them 7 minutes to make tea though when I walked in there were only 1-2 drinks on the bar and no one in line....They just hadn't checked their mobile order que.

The WORSE SERVICE EVER if you drink Starbucks then you know the mixes and you know when the baristas do not have the mix right it so we're coming from LA long travels right soooo happy to see SB go in order a drink and it taste SOUR so I ask if we can just change the drink because it's not a mix the person doesn't know how to fix it and instead they try to argue me down so they turn around and make the first one over I give it to the other person in my party it's is still not right I told them thank but no I don't want that drink if it's not right end of story we walk out spending 12 no refund and drinks in trash HORRIBLE I WOULD HAVE JUST GAVE THEM THE MONEY IF THEY NEEDED IT just don't go there I should have seen the red flags the window was broken out enough said

Nice that we have a Starbucks in Fishhawk but the service is not so great! Drive through wait times 
are horrific and service is not so friendly

I am not a huge Starbucks person, but my husband is. The TPA location is actually well managed and quite clean. The employees are super sweet and have an extra dose of kindness/empathy which is wonderful and needed when at the airport. 

The line moved quickly and the beverages were quite good. I had a Chai and my husband an espresso.

If Starbucks advertises a new coffee or cold brew do yourself a favor and don't go to this one. They never have anything? Like honestly nothing? Every time I go there out of nitro. Every time I go they are out of cold brew. Every time I go I have to get out of the drive-through which is usually a 15 minute wait to walk in just just to be told they don't have what I need. And it's every single time. And no I don't go all the time and complain I've gone maybe three or four times to ask for something that comes out that's new because it's the closest Starbucks to me and they never have it. This is by far the worst Starbucks ever.

I am not a big fan of four-bucks, but - Chrissy - I know that lady of which you write.  She is such a nice lady that I have to give this four-bucks 3 whole stars.

I don't drink the coffee drinks but a light-ice 2 pump classic green tea lemonade is an occasional treat when my paycheck will allow it.

They know my order as soon as I walk in. I appreciate the barista's effort here...makes me feel special because this isn't even my "home location" lol.  It could be that we share the same first name, whatever the reason she pays attention to detail and makes sure my cup of Joe is made to perfection.  The inside is the size of a large walk-in closet but the fire place and friendly service is more than welcoming. 

Pull up a chair and stay a while.
~Christy

Of all of the Starbucks in the city, this is the best one. The staff here are so efficient and most of them now know me by name (says a lot about my coffee habits). Denise and Fernando especially are so awesome. Love this place.
Very poor customer service, they're always getting my order wrong. They even mocked the way I was dressed. They need some serious training.

Just had the absolute worst experience at a Starbucks I have ever had in my life. I went there - the place was empty. The "barista" didn't even say hello to me as I was waiting at the counter. I ordered 2 grande green tea lattes extra hot no foam. I had a gift card and didn't know how to use it as this was my first time having one. I asked her, "do I swipe it?"
