The lattes are the WORST I have ever had! I can't even drink them. They taste like water and are not "extra hot." The baristas name was "Bre". She really needs to find a different  job, as customer service and obviously drink making is not her forte.

Every time I go it's always something, yesterday my mom picked up her coffee to drink and it was half Empty. Almost as if we got someone's left over coffee. I also had to remind the lady to give me my food she seemed very disoriented.

Worst Starbucks I've ever been to.. I love Starbucks I get one everyday. They're always so nice and super friendly. I went through this one 5-10 min before they closed (drive through) and the guy working said to me "can you just wait one minute". Left me there waiting for 5 min until it got to 10:30. I then tried getting their attention and they wouldn't answer. I then proceeded to the window and they just said we are closed through the closed window. I said okay cool you could've just said that instead of making me wait 5-7 min by the drive through area like an idiot. I get that you're almost closing and that's fine but just say that next time not ask me if I could wait one second and leave me there wondering. I've never had this happen in any Starbucks's.

So how can a starbucks that advertises on yelp that it is open til 10:00 pm close at 9:13 ?  That is ridiculous. And silly us this is the second time we have tried this starbucks at night only to find it had closed before its advertised closing time. Do better. Poor customer service.
Maybe don't have a drive thru if it's slower than going inside. Everyone was very nice but I think they need to work on getting people through the line faster.

My favorite Starbucks in the area is Minden Starbucks- perhaps part of it is it's location- getting a nice coffee for a trip up Kingsbury Grade or a hot cup of coffee on the way home from a Heavenly Day. But none the less the baristas are always cheery and welcoming and engage me in conversation for the short wait for my steaming cup. The bathrooms are always clean and tidy. It's just a comfy experience each and every time.

Starbucks is what it is, and quite frankly, i like what it is. Having got my caffeine fix at Starbucks's all over the world, i can generally say that across the globe the service and quality has been reliable at best. And then there's this location. This is like the rebel Starbucks that must be led by a renegade manager who decided to just buck the system and deliver a poor experience across the board, for the sole purpose of delivering a poor experience. Getting any of the staff to actually smile or be pleasant is a certain impossibility.  I've found this location to be generally dirty and unkempt, and there are these odd little flies buzzing around all over the place.  I've literally stood there like an idiot while two barista's just chatted away, completely ignoring my simple order of just a venti Coffee.  Yes, i just drink black coffee. Venti. Nearly impossible to screw it up. And yes, they screw it up every time. If there wasn't a Bank of America in the same lot as this Starbucks i'd never step foot in there. I suspect the staff and management are just in a constant stupor because of the unbelievable volume they do with a drive thru.  But God forbid you step foot inside.  As my visiting niece said so eloquently "Wow, this Starbucks location blows"....Well said hipster niece.  Well said.

The workers are rude. I always have to sit in line so long that I wish I hadn't stopped. Last time, I was in line and had to get out of the car to grab something from my baby in the back seat. A worker screamed out the window "This is a drive through." Anyone could see I stepped out for a second to grab something. The line was at a standstill so I wasn't holding anything up. It was rude and hateful. Then, once I got to the window, the order wasn't even right. So, it all got left there. For the prices they charge, I expect to at least be treated like a human being and not like they are paying me to take the coffee. This place is incompetent, not sure how they always have a line....oh yeah I am....it's the only one in the area that is close for people to get to.

Nice that we have a Starbucks in Fishhawk but the service is not so great! Drive through wait times 
a horrific and service is not so friendly.

Most definitely the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Waited 15 minutes for an iced coffee. They have a few VERY nice employees and a few that look like they hate their lives. So rude, don't acknowledge you when standing at the register, act better than you, and never smile. They make it very unpleasant. The manager is a very nice lady though and you can tell when she is there, it is a much better environment
The barista was very patient and helpful. Even when i asked to have the whip cream taken off they still hd a smile. Totally recommend this starbucks out of many ive been to.

Saturday morning is CRAZY. Everything was good, but 30 minutes to get your drink?! Sheesh. 
Should have had 1 instead of 2 on cash register and 3 instead of 2 making the drinks.

Mornings are always insane at this location. I work in the area so this store is my go-to. This particular morning was chaos. I placed a mobile order thru the app and it said the 1 drink I ordered would be ready in 5-8mins. Incorrect. It should have been updated to reflect the circus show going on in the store and said your drink will be ready in approx 50mins-never!!!!!
That's how long I had to wait until I realized I was never going to get my drink. Everyone was looking at each other and stating how crazy this was! Others had been waiting just as long and the frustration in everyone's faces was brewing. The staff was calm and really tried to maintain some sense of order. There was a girl going thru the older mobile orders stacked up on what appeared to be a book shelf. She tried her best to pull orders for ppl waiting but at some point I wised up and asked for a credit because I couldn't wait any longer. They issued a refund on my mobile app and a credit towards my next order. The 2 stars   goes to the recovery effort.

So how can a starbucks that advertises on yelp that it is open til 10:00 pm close at 9:13 ?  That is ridiculous. And silly us this is the second time we have tried this starbucks at night only to find it had closed before its advertised closing time. Do better. Poor customer service

Tried a new drink and I give it two thumbs up! I asked for the hot apple cider type drink, and they knew what I was in search of. It's hot apple juice with a shot of caramel and so yummy on cold days. Got it in a real mug and saved a tree. Woo!

This rating is based solely upon service. I frequent this particular Starbucks often as it is close to work/school/home. I typically pick up beverages in the morning while placing an order using the Starbucks app which is super easy and convenient. I'm not sure of the gentlemen's name who works the drive thru but he is an absolute pleasure as he offers excellent service with a side of humor. I adore the service but if someone can make me smile BEFORE my coffee and while I tackle traffic on North Lindbergh then they're alright with me! Oh! The Unicorn Frap was delicious!

I went to this Starbucks and ordered a Passion tea and lemonade. The barista informed me they were out of sweetner, and I definitely like it sweet!  I was a bit deterred at first, but she offered an alternative to try it with vanilla. I was a little wary, but gave it a shot. She asked me to wait and try it before taking off to make sure that I was happy, and not stuck with an unpleasant drink. That meant a lot to me because it's such a small thing, but she cared. It must be hard dealing with coffee snobs all day, but she still showed outstanding customer service. I appreciate her, and I'll be back because the drink was also perfection. Their skills and service far surpassed my expectations. I thank her and them very much!

Stopped in for coffee and a light breakfast during my visit to the Philly area today. Like every Starbucks I've been to, the coffee was good, food was good, and staff was friendly. But also like most Starbucks, the noise was too high and the tables needed to be cleaned, even at 9 AM.

Regular Starbucks nothing different. However i will day someone else is using their lot because when i went today there was not one spot for me or my gf we had to park across the st which is a pretty busy street. They need to be more strict with their parking lot. They are for sure losing business with a full lot like that. Oh i forgot to say that there wasn't enough people there for there to not be any spots

It was freezing cold outside (felt like 9 degrees Fahrenheit plus it was SO windy) and an older man presumably homeless with mental health needs came in and the worker (I regret not getting his name!) let him just chill inside without buying anything. Not all places in business treat people with respect like this, so I really appreciated this gesture:)

This I why I love Starbucks: First, the coffee cake! The best! Good with coffee, but without it, it's great also. Second, the frappe chino and teas. They are so flavorful! It also goes well with the food there. Also, the service is good, because they get the order right and don't take a long time... (usually). Lastly, they are definitely kid friendly. A lot of drinks kids can have and they are delicious . All in all, Starbucks is amazing. Enjoy!

This was a very small Starbucks. I had just got off the plane and was headed to my hotel. I needed a coffee and decided to stop here to get a Cinnamon Shortbread latte. The latte was good but it took about 30-40 minutes for me to get it because the location was down an espresso machine. 

Besides the long wait for the coffee, the customer service was okay.
It's Starbucks.  It's on Tucson's Southside.  There is wifi.  The staff are friendlier than most other Starbucks.  There is rarely a long wait inside.

Wow, well climbing 3 stars. Literally the worlds worst Starbucks has slowly, and begrudgingly began to enter the world of acceptable business practices. If not for the BofA next door I swore I'd never step foot in this Starbucks again. Well, management must have been listening as they actually paid attention to their walk in customers. I was pleasantly surprised. 3 stars because of course they screwed up my simple venti coffee. Yep, just a venti black coffee. But that's ok, at least they forced out a smile.

Ever since they remodeled this location they service and the time I stay in the drive thru has been amazing . I don't stay in line for more that 10 minutes during rush hour. I definitely recommend this location is you need fast service

Cute little location near Terrytown & Gretna.  Looks like a log cabin somewhat.   I stopped here a few times during a recent business trip to pick up my fix.

Note the small parking lot, tight drive-thru, & you can only turn right leaving.

I love this Starbucks. It is great for studying and all of the baristas are really friendly and kind. I love coming here to work on homework and anything else I need to do. I would definitely recommend this Starbucks to anyone in the area

I've come here at least 4-5 times now, each time was a drive thru visit. So far, I must say that there hasn't been a long wait at all. My last experience, I pulled in and there was a very long line, but it managed to move very quickly. The service has been what you would expect from a corporate coffee shop that has standard operations. The coffee is up to the corporate quality as well. I would say that this is a great location if you're passing by and need your coffee fix. The inside, looking from the outside, doesn't appear to be that large. I don't know if I would hold any business meetings at this store. Again, I haven't been inside this store yet.

It's the closest location to work so I constantly find myself there and constantly find myself regretting that decision.
They have the slowest and most aloof baristas. It takes an average of 20 minutes to get through the drive thru with about 2 vehicles ahead. 11 times of of 10 they would have run out of an item and you'd be lucky to find that out before you get to the window. Now you're responsible for the poor people in line while you frantically scramble to decide on your items replacement. Avoid this place if you can.

The seating area with the benches is filthy. I leaned back and my shirt got stuck on something sticky. I guess they only clean the tables and the floor. This happened while I ordered a peach infused iced tea on the app. But, then I received a message that it's "not available" at THIS store. Ok, so I ordered a pina colada iced tea with apple juice added. After several minutes and seeing nobody in line at the counter, I wondered if my order was being made, despite my account on the app having been deducted. As I approach the counter, I see a man coming from the back with a bottle of apple juice and realize he must be making my order. We nod and I waited for my name to be called. I see him pour maybe a teaspoon of apple juice into the cup bc it's already full. I'm guessing he made the drink and then realized there was an "added item" which he hadn't prepared for. No big deal bc it was only 
$.50 extra. But, when taken into consideration with my overall experience, it certainly didn't help in making it a pleasant one. If that had been me, I'd have poured some of the tea into a water cup making room for the apple juice, but only bc the customer was standing there watching.

Sloooowww....

I had never been before to this fairly new location but stopped on my way to work. The drive thru was at least 12 cars deep so I went in. I ordered the Bacon Gruyère Egg Bites. That's it. I was in there 10 minutes waiting for them. You could have shot a cannon through the store. There was no one in there. Just 4 employees milling around like robots. I recently read an article about Starbucks sending out a "Barista Need-to-Know" update about how to handle questions and aggressive political opinions from customers because Howard Schultz might run for president in 2020. I guarantee you these 4 employees would do nothing but stare at you blankly. I'm not sure that anything would register in here....

Love it here.. work on site and frequent this location often.. either sweet cream cold brew or a Frappuccino or just a green tea.. and always top notch.. if you don't have the patience to wait a bit.. then.. simply.. ORDER AHEAD WITH THE APP!!

I purchased a grande vanilla bean frap and while driving halfway home back to my hotel pulled a hair out of my mouth  I then looked inside to cup to notice two more hairs in the drink!!! Called the manage and said said for me to come back that day or the next and would buy me a new drink and also make it up to me. I drove back the next day and the girl working offered me another drink, which I did not want. So they just have me a refund, nothing more! Really surprised they did nothing beyond that! #thumbsdownstarbucks #stillgrossedout

Living upstairs makes this place convenient... but more than that, this Starbucks is particularly friendly and inviting. The staff even donated gift cards to the local elementary school! Love this place....

Consistently good drinks and one of the best in the area with getting mobile orders out on time. If you're complaining about this location you haven't been to Blue Bell or Springhouse, clearly, not even close to these baristas!

Bad service and lazy employees, if you go at night you always have to wait at least 5 minutes till someone notice you....employees always on the kitchen spacially at night chatting and carless....if the drive thru person sees you, won't service you and u have to wait till the front desk employee show up.
Starbucks should be the same anywhere you go, except this branch use all bad beans or wierd flavors one...

I don't nno if the manager knows about the night shift but, it's pritty bad.

1 star is even to much for this location

This used to be a great location. The outdoor seating was my fave, but I think it's stopped? But I'm wondering if they hired a hospital designer (is that a thing?) to redecorate. It's blindingly bright. Are they making it less inviting on purpose? (No... really.) I'm also a little uncomfortable with a guy sitting in the corner, randomly yelling & cursing... the staff just ignores it, which I'm sure is not their fault. The staff is actually really great. 
The new sharps collection cans in the bathrooms are a nice touch.

The most important thing to know about this Starbucks is that it's super busy in the morning and the best thing to do is place a mobile order. They are friendly enough and I do love the outdoor seating. Parking can be a bit rough but I've never had to walk more than a block and a half.

One of the busiest Starbucks in New Orleans, getting in and out here can be a pain.  That being said, service is always very fast, my order is usually spot-on, and I have met some very friendly, helpful barristas.  Stop by if you're cruising on the Wank.

Friendly service. We stopped at an off time so nice to see a few tables not claimed by folks camping out for the day. 

Good location.

I get starbucks everyday.... friendly staff most of the time quick service 

Drink is Usually made to perfection just the way like it with mobile ordering a added bonus

I stopped at this Starbucks drive thru in Malvern Pa when I was in the area this morning. I'm not usually in Malvern too often (although I have been here many times in the past) I personally didn't have a problem with this Starbucks. There wasn't a line in the drive thru, the employee at the window was friendly enough and the products were decent too. All around, it's an average visit to Starbucks nothing mindblowing but nothing horrible either.

I came to this Starbucks to get some work done on my laptop. I got there around 7 PM on a Monday evening. There was almost no one sitting in the seating area, which is a good thing if you're coming to work. I like to grab an area to sit at a Starbucks that has one of the studio lights pointed directly at the table, and luckily I got a two-top table like that. I did notice that there were only one or two spots like this though.

I worked up until 9 PM at which point they closed. I was surprised a Starbucks was closing at 9 PM, but given the traffic on a Monday night I guess I am not surprised. People came in and out to order but there were certainly not that many people staying / sitting down at this location.

Overall my experience was what you would typically expect from a Starbucks. It was clean and the staff did not get your attention or anything while you were working. I would definitely recommend this Starbucks if you work in the area and need to get away to knock out a project.
Great service, especially by a friendly barista named Zah who was working fast to help a long with a smile on his face. Thank you!!

I travel thru BNA daily. This Starbucks location is historically bad. Service line times are always greater than 15minutes for a cup of coffee, on a busy travel day I have experience double this time. They have a revolving door for employees here, who are disinterested at best. Customer service is not a thing here. Of late, I have started going to the food court for coffee, certainly not 'bucks quality coffee, but sadly, if you're short of time this is not a location for you.
Seems like a new person works there every day that they have to train. I waited 15 min in line until I just left. Ridiculous.

One of my least favourite locations. It is a walk-in at Southgate mall. Always slow and always crowded.

Make sure you order online or in the app ahead of time. This review is at no fault of the employees as their effort is always there.

Cool Starbucks by Asana Climbing gym...walking distance. Friendly staff and clean inside. Everything seems organized and well managed. My order came out perfectly and no long wait. Their drive-thru is constantly busy.

5 people behind me got their drinks and I had to ask if the barista had my drink order- she non-chalantly says "yeah, it's over there"....hello?  If you know it's there why the hell aren't you preparing it?  I know it takes all kinds but you are in the service industry (SERVICE!).
Additionally, she prepares the worlds slowest Americano and proceeds to dump cream in it!  I tell her I wanted light room not cream and she looks at me confused not offering to make the drink correctly. I'm pretty sure this isn't the Starbucks standard.  Worst Starbucks experience to date.  Rude/ unprofessional staff.
This is to best place to get coffee and pastry and the employees are great especially erin she's the best goes above and beyond just a great experience

On a Saturday morning this was the only option for me to get a hot drink when I was in CAB as both Tim Hortons were closed. There was just one guy working so he would take the orders and make the drinks. Good thing it wasn't busy and just one customer in front of me and then another came after I ordered. 

There was just one sign board but I saw all the tea bags so I ordered my mint one. The guy working there asked if I wanted the one with caffeine or not. I haven't even been asked and I didn't even know they had mint in both options. He told me the jade citrus mint was decaf but after I checked and it's mint majesty that is decaf. I didn't mind either way and I always order the majesty so I'll continue ordering that one. I appreciated the offer and letting me know not all teas are decaf. 

After taking my order, he finished preparing the previous customer's drink and then got my tea before taking the next order. Along the outer perimeter there are upright benches to sit on to wait for your order but didn't look comfortable to sit for long periods. Also nice that there are 2 places to get lids and napkins.

I have been going to this location for several years. Quality definitely down over last few months. Frequent out of stocks. Inside order delivery is a drawn out disjointed process. Today store had a dozen fruit flies in the cooler. Lots of regular flies in the store. On a positive note employees seem courteous and friendly.

I visited this location today to do a little homework and I had a great experience. I ordered a breakfast Sammy and Latte (which was made perfectly) and sat down to do school work. (I wish I remembered the girls name who waited on me) The staff was efficient, working hard and at the same time having fun. I think have an establishment where your team members work hard but are also able to enjoy their time there is important. The work place morale seemed to be positive, which means that management is doing a great job. The positive energy really resonated with me, and it makes me want to come back and be a regular here. For my second round of coffee I was waited/served by I think Jordan and Larry. They both had smiles on their face and were truly the epitome of great customer service.
Walked all the way here for a much needed early morning cup of coffee. They don't open until 5:30am even though listed at 5am ever day. Really!?!?

Decent Stop Before Going Through TSA

SITREP

I got to Nashville Airport about three (3) hours before my take-off, and after I saw this spot, I really wasn't jone'sin to rush to the gate, not knowing what I'd find there.  So I decided to post here for about 90 minutes, and I'm glad I did.

THE SETUP

This is a large lounge area, and it's right next to the lavatories for men & women, so there's that.  It also had plenty of room to set-up my laptop and chill for pretty much as long as I wanted to.

NO WIFI

The first disappointment, though, was finding out there was no free WiFi at this Starbucks - nor in the airport for that matter.  So I popped out my WiFi Cellular card and made do with catching up on emails, uploading pictures, and surfing the internet.

EXPENSIVE COFFEE

The second disappointment was finding out that there is no normal pricing here at this Starbucks as you would find at a downtown Nashville location.  Just like the stops in Las Vegas and Phoenix, you will pay about 25%-33% more in coffee prices.  Ce la vie.

THE LOWDOWN

A decent stop for coffee & chill time when you are pretty much a "captured audience" on the airport grounds.
The drive thru is always slow expect to wait 15+ minutes and on top of it the employees are very rarely pleasant.

This is easily one of my favorite Starbucks. Whenever I order via phone, my drink is always ready with no mistakes. The staff is pleasant and they work quickly.
Also, I adore the location since it is near where I  work, and it is always on the cleaner side considering that some many students hang out there. Although the students are well behaved and quite pleasant, I don't think I'll be there working.

My anxiety hits the roof whenever I walk in this place.  I have been to a lot of Starbucks and this one is the worst.  Management here should really consider doing the mystery shopper thing to get feedback.  Very long waits when it is not busy and mistakes.  It's a shame this is the only one conveniently located near me.  I have switched to Dunkin'

This is by far the best Starbucks in the area. Lexi and Bex are sooo friendly and quick to strike up a conversation. I absolutely love stopping by here before work or after a long day. They are so sweet and always make my day! I love this location. 
Highly recommend!!
very nice, brand new Starbucks. Large spacious dining area. Very clean. Staff is ultra friendly. Coffee and pastries were fresh.

Sis I am going to be HONEST with you! This is a big Starbucks, it has a lower level and an upper level, so it is conducive for working. The staff has always been friendly. Since it opened the service has gotten better; it no longer takes more than 15 minutes to get food or any drink that takes time to make. The space is honestly kind of filthy-- as if the people who work there don't regularly check to see that there aren't pools of coffee and crumbs on surfaces and exposed milk and cream in the carafes. The biggest issue I have with this Starbucks is honestly one that most other chain coffee stores have: the coffee is bad. If you order an iced coffee or a hot coffee it is going to taste burnt, it will not be a fun drink. It makes sense that most people who go to Starbucks don't care because everyone is just ordering speciality drinks that are filled with other things. So like if you are into getting their candied drinks or literal boxed drinks that they pour into a cup for you GO OFF ur good to go. If you want good coffee that doesn't taste like charred earth, maybe go to a locally run coffee shop. Also, the same can be said about their espresso, how does it all taste burnt sis??? But like joke is on me for drinking coffee at Starbucks lol.

Great staff. I am there at least 4 days a week. 
Parking is not the staffs issue. It's the east side and or north shore parking is always issue. I would put this Starbucks against any in the city!!
Friendly service, great coffee and FAST !
The gals making the coffees were great but the gal heating up our banana bread was slower than molasses in January. Minnesota s January that is.
When you wait in line for 30 minutes and they still get your order wrong is fun. Even better when it makes you late for work. Big thank you to the staff here

Worst Starbucks ever. There would be times where I was the ONLY customer waiting to order and I'd still have to wait forever to order. Baristas will stand behind the counter and carry on conversation without even acknowledging you (I've never even gotten a "hi", like c'mon). 95% of the employees, including the store manager, are extremely rude. Drinks will take a good 20 mins to be made and still turn out pretty meh. Skip coming here because you'll just waste your time.
Cool Starbucks! Excellent staff! Seems like this Starbucks attracts beautiful people! Lots of hot women....handsome men....must be coffee LOL.

I'm not a coffee drinker but I do love the açaí refreshers on the menu! Starbucks never fails me with their customer service and the lines weren't overly ridiculous. The menu is never ending so there is something for everyone to try. The teas are pretty amazing and so are the food options although they are limited. Most locations are quiet enough to get a good study group going or small meeting

I have only had two drinks from here, and both of the drinks tasted horrible. I was so disappointed because I get the same drinks from every Starbucks. There is nothing like sipping bad coffee especially when the coffee was NEEDED.

This is an update review for the same location after 3 months , and it's  my last cup from starbucks.

I thought after store remodeling will be much better and smother service. It turn out that even worst.

Maybe store manager has a lack of experience or no training experience.

Employees.. i will say almost all of them except one are rude, not willing to welcome and serve.
As far as waiting time in store or drive thru, nothing change even worse now.
As far as cleanse, garbage always full..bar has nasty look and no one bother to wipe it off.
According to health code in the city, you can't put all powder continer exposed in the front counter on the reach of the costumers.

I decided to stop spending my $20 daily at Starbucks and buy a professional maker and do it my self.

I think the people who left 5 stars reviews are one time visitors.
God Bless America, this store will be reported to the HQ

This is a great place to go if you want to wait for 20 minutes for a breakfast sandwich in the morning while the baristas sing to the music on the radio, while another assures you "it's coming." Great for productivity.

This is my favorite Starbucks in town. The staff here is incredibly friendly. Been to many, many Starbucks all across Tucson yet I've never had anyone serve me like this staff. They're quick at what they do. Friendly no matter how busy or slow they are. They make you feel like you're the only person in the store by having eye contact, a smile and attentiveness. I have never seen any of them on a "bad day" because this staff keeps it professional. I've been coming to this location since the outlet mall opened and they never fail to make me happy. To the manager and the staff of this location you are AWESOME!!!! Keep up the AMAZING work!!!

As far as Starbucks go, I'm loving this location!! Particularly the AMPLE seating. As a person that does work in coffee shops a minimum of two days per week, I look for plenty of seats (bonus if there are a lot of small tables), reliable WiFi and most importantly plugs for my work computer! This location has all three! Add to that, quick service with friendly interactions, and there's nothing more I could ask from a Starbucks location! Keep it up guys and you've got yourselves a loyal customer!!
It's Starbucks, the coffee is always great and the teas and refreshers are always great. Staff is always friendly and try to get to know you. Love having this location closer to home

So stopped in for some coffee and the line was so long. But I had faith because they are usually fast. Well today they failed me  I must have waited 10-15 mins for my coffee!! It was chaos back there with the baristas

every time i come here they mess up my drink. i've seen several times that they add dairy milk to my drink which is concerning since i have a severe allergy plus they charge me extra for nondairy. i've had to ask them to remake it many times. additionally, the last time my drink looked as if it had been thrown on the ground. there was coffee all on the lid and i poured it on myself. i wish i could give this 0 stars. None of the employees have had the proper training and it shows.

Absolutely the worst Starbucks ever! No matter what they cannot get an order right. Every time I order a sandwich. They either don't have it and don't tell me until I've waited for 10 min or they give me egg bites instead.

IF I COULD LEAVE A ZERO I WOULD. NOT ONLY CANT YOU BE A BLACK MALE AND WAIT ON A FRIEND B4 U ORDER YOUR COFFEE U HAVE TO BE IN embarrass and be walked out in handcuffs while your friend meet you I've never in my life had to witness something so awful to the barista that throught her life was in danger I hope you never truly are in danger. As a franchise Starbucks should have procedures in order what to do when a customer didn't purchase anything and it shouldn't be calling the cops. I'm sad the situation is sad and you guys as a company old those men an apology and the Barista should be fired.

3 years later, and they're still understaffed. I've also found that their drinks are less consistent than other locations. Today I ordered a vanilla sweet cream cold brew (for which I had to wait at least 10 minutes), and it was both overly sweet and watery tasting. I've never had this problem at other locations. Overall, Kitchen Gia right next door or ABP is quicker and better.

Time to upgrade my opinion of this location. It's keeps getting better.  I've noticed a complete change in attitude and service levels for walk in customers. Friendly, attentive, and making a point greet customers. Not sure if it's been a change in local management that's made the difference, or if the newer Linebaugh location and lessened the pressure on this store. Either way, now deserving of 4 stars. Nice comeback!!

Writing a bad review of a Starbucks is like saying that Mother Teresa was a slut.  No one is going to believe you and no one will really care about your thoughts and you're really about to waste five minutes of your life by expressing your opinions. However...that isn't stopping me!

My hubby works at 19th and Market, I work at 15 and Walnut.  I decided to hitch a ride from him tonight after work rather than take the train so I walked from my business to his.  It's about nuts-in-my-stomach degrees outside so when I came to the Starbucks on Market, I popped in for what I thought would be two quick cups of coffee and then continue on my way to meet my partner another half a block down the street.  I was the only customer in line.

Two people were behind the counter.  An African American young lady with a terrible tumble-weave on her head and a goofy ogre-ish guy with a mop.  I placed my order for a tall Americano and a tall latte.  Nothing complicated about my order; you simply place the coffee cup under the grinder, push start and presto, you've got coffee!  

The back counter of the place was filthy.  Out of the eight pitchers used for steaming milk, none were clean.  Tumble-weave was too busy talking to a new customer who didn't seem to be placing an order but seemed to have stopped in for a social call, all the while my coffee was not being made.  Finally, Tumble-weave got around to making my coffee.  She steamed the milk first, then started the coffee.  I would have guessed that the coffee came first but then again, I believe that the chicken came first not the egg.  

I waited at the counter counting the seconds and then the minutes as they passed by.  I considered reaching over the counter and completing my own order but then I'd be banned from Starbucks forever.  Oh what a terrible shame that would be.  

Tumble-weave finally returned to making my latte.  She poured in the steamed milk from the dirty pitcher into my coffee and placed a lid on top.  The foam was too high in the cup so when she put the lid on it, foam went-a-sprayin'.  Solution?  Grab the dirty cloth towel that you've been wiping the counter with and wipe the rim of my coffee cup with it.  Sweet!  Are you seriously that much of a pig that you thought that was a healthy, reasonable, customer-service-oriented solution to the problem?  Why not just ask ogre-mop-guy to wipe off  the top of my lid with his mop?  No wonder you're a "barista" at Starbucks!  Try not to have any hope of a higher career goal than that, sweetie!  

One cup down, one to go.  

I stood (not so patiently) waiting for my Americano.  It was under the machine.  The machine had dispensed the coffee.  All it needed was the hot water added.  So, while Tumble-weave ignored my coffee and finished her conversation with new-customer, I asked ogre-mop-guy if he could get me a new lid for my latte.  He looked at me like I had grown three heads but after a few attempts to communicate my request to him, he finally got me a new lid.  Then I asked him if he could take over for Tumble-weave and finish making my Americano coffee.  It was sitting right there but he started to make a new one, which pissed Tumble-weave off.  Finally, she returned to finish my order.  Ogre-mop-guy headed off to get me a gift card to return at a later date for another go at getting a f*cking $4 cup of coffee.  No thanks.  I kindly handed him the gift card and walked out.

Like I said at the beginning...this review won't mean sh*t to anyone who reads it and it certainly will have no bearing on the profits or customer volume at Starbucks but I feel better getting this off my chest.  Thanks to anyone who took the time to read it.

Love this place!! Great service when I god and friendly. I get teas all the time with my Starbucks card or on my phone app. Easy to order on the phone and my drinks are always ready for me when I show up. 

*Black tea/lemonade with 9 pumps of cane
*Caramel frap with extra dulce powder
*Green tea trenta! 
*Smores frap with a Lil extra chocolate maybe on top 
*Cake pops for my 2yr son & Lil nephews  
*Apple juice for son 
*Banana nut bread is AWSOME!!!!!!! 
*Apple loaf when they have it, sad face have to wait 
*Great tea frap 
*Breakfast sandwich double smoked bacon, egg & cheese 

I always recommend this place

From reading other reviews I'm not surprised to write this one. 

I used the mobile order to get a beverage and my girlfriend did as well. I was in charge of pick up. When I arrived our drinks were ready, but hers was not correct. 

Now they fixed the problem, but the issue was the time it took. 

I stood at the mobile pickup area waiting for an employee to give me the time of day. 

There were two employees there, one on drive thru and the other making drinks. Both of them looked my way but neither of them acknowledged me. 

So I waited. 

I watched other customers being taken care of and new drinks being made, but no one talked to me. 

A third employee appeared and I continued to be ignored. 

After 5 minutes of determining the order was wrong  someone finally spoke to me. I simply turned the drink around and showed that the label said no ice and there was clearly ice in it. 

It took about 30 seconds to make the new drink, but it took way too long for someone to address the issue. It makes me feel like the only customer that matters is the next one to order.
New Starbucks, love what they did to the place. Very open and airing. The baristas are very sweet and bubbly. On Freret St but has a small parking area next to my it.

Hmfh. This was my first Starbucks. I LOVED the ambiance of the shop inside an old house, so I hung out here way too many times to count. Unfortunately, they bulldozed the house and replaced it with a smaller, cookie-cutter store that looks like the rest of them. Pity.
This is one of those Starbucks that just keeps bringing you back.  Clean, roomy, friendly, quick, well managed, well taken care of, and thats the way you will feel when you leave.

Pretty big Starbucks, with lots of nice seatings and nice, friendly staff. 

Like any Starbucks, they have all the drinks and foods you like to grab on the go, or to sit down and catch up with friends or paperwork. 

Overall, this Starbucks was not noisy at all when I visited. It was full in all of its seating, but the noise was under control and I was able to focus on my studying. It's a great location! I'm going to be back for more studying sessions.
Really slow service. Only 2 people working. Had to ask multiple times to get my order after 10 minutes, despite store not being busy. Will not come back to this location.

I travel for a living and have been to many Starbucks stores, but this one is my favorite!

The staff is great, there's TONS of seating both inside and out, it's super clean, the bathrooms are nice and out of the way.

If you're into Starbucks, you'll love this particular one!

I always park at the entrance closest to this Starbucks in the mall, but the language used here and the service I experienced today was disgusting. I walked up to the counter around 7:15pm and everyone was huddled in a group having a conversation - completely ignoring me. I took a second to look over the menu since I wasn't sure what I wanted anyway and then, I heard the white male named Kevin who was working at the time say several curse words and the n-word. After I heard that, I started walking away and it wasn't until then that one of the girls finally stopped chatting and asked if I needed help. I said never mind and walked away. I will NEVER come back to this location as long as these people work here. They use offensive language and act as if customers are bothering them.

I've given this Starbucks location two chances. The first time I came here I placed my reusable cup in front of the cashier and asked to have it in my own cup. She forgot to make note of my personal cup for the baristas so my cup continued to get passed over by the other cups lined up. After 16 minutes I finally asked the barista of mine was coming soon. He had made my cappuccino but not in my cup. So not only was my cappuccino cold from sitting there, I was forced to use a disposable cup. The second time I came here the shop was nearly empty yet it took 21 minutes for my cappiccino. The baristas were favoring the drive-thru customers which I understand but I shouldn't have to wait so long in an empty shop for just 1 cappuccino. Overall, this Starbucks location is one of the worst I've experienced.

This new location is great! Very roomy, friendly staff, and always smiling. 

It's not on the best intersection, but SO MUCH better than the speedway location up the street. 

Way too cluttered up there. This has a nice, new, modern vibe. Check it out!

I just went through the drive through after ordering a trenta iced coffee. The barista handed me a venti and I said I asked for a trenta not a venti (and was charged for it) . She told me it was a trenta, again I said I don't think it is. She took it examined it and said yes it is. Clearly it isn't a trenta when you see it next to the correct cup (I posted a comparison pic). I didn't have time to go in and argue about receiving the correct drink that I paid for but damn what terrible customer service. I drink multiple Starbucks a day and will definitely not come back to this location.

This use to be old village coffee. I love that Starbucks took this place over. It's always so busy! The staff here is extremely friendly and always working hard. I come here about 2-3 times a week. There's an upstairs area that I see students study all the time so this place is constantly full. I'm happy to see that it's doing well. 

You pretty much have to find street parking because their lot is always full (6-7 cars). There's plenty!
Amazing Place!!! I work next door at Chicken Salad Chick. The staff is unbelievably kind. The place is clean. They know how to serve customers well.

A few weeks ago they were out of whipped cream.  Is there a policy that they cannot go across the street to WinnDixie for additional supplies, especially when it is a common item like that?

Today, they were out of Grande cups. I was given the choice to purchase a smaller size (Tall) or pay more for a larger size (Venti).  The option to put the size I want in a larger cup was never given, nor was the offer to give me the Venti for the price of the Grande, since it was lack of planning on their part to begin with.

This is a pretty good Starbucks location.  The baristas are hard-working and they always have decaf available if you want it unlike most places. My issue with the place is that they don't seem to have a cleaning crew. I've been coming for the last 4 mornings and the floor is a mess and the same spilled coffee has been on the floor for 3 of the 4 days. Get someone to clean this place.

went in this morning before work to grab a violet drink. i got to work and finally took a sip and (i'm not trying to be mean at all) it tasted awful. it didn't even taste close to how the drink is supposed to taste. and they always fill my drink to the top with ice even though i ask for light ice.  i called safeway and let them know and  the lady i spoke to was pretty rude and didn't seem to care at all. ruined my morning ..

To me reviewing  is like baseball. Three strikes and you're out!!! First strike here is I could not get what I wanted. I wanted blonde roast and it was 6PM. The clerk said we stop making blonde roast this time of day. Okay medium roast I accepted. 2nd strike was after I asked for a large ice water. I got a small one from the clerk and had to ask a second time. Third strike was I didn't get a receipt. So no more strikes and they reached one out!! The next out is the place is full of flies!!! The third out is it is warmer inside that outside!!! For goodness sake, this is FL!!! Sorry Starbucks, but Dunkin Donuts beats you by a long shot!!! I am only here for your free wifi!!!!

Worst Starbucks ever! I come here from time to time because it is a convenient location. But it is EXTREMELY slow and orders are consistently lost. They will also ignore your order if you order through the Starbucks app.

Oh dear god ... if you go to a "regular" Starbucks (i.e. not on the U of A campus), you'll have an awesome visit and it'll be everything Starbucks is suppose to be.  If you go to a Starbucks on the U of A campus, you'll probably have a terrible experience, especially at this location, right outside the Cameron Library.

First off, the servers only speak spanish.  Why?  I have no idea.  They also never smile or strike up a normal, polite conversation with you.  The one server who must be a manager of sorts always looks like she's ready to kill someone.  I actually don't think she's capable of a smile or even standard conversation.

The drinks and food are the same as any other Starbucks, and you early points on your Starbucks membership at this location, but you can't use your points at this location.  This is stupid and I think has something to do with how this location is franchised compared to others.

I worked at the library and in the summer this location didn't open until 8am, the same time the library opened.  For students, this is fine, but for staff it sucked.  If they even opened 15 minutes earlier it would have made life so much easier.  And in the summer their sign says they close at 3:30pm.  Personally I think that's ridiculously early for a coffee shop.  And for awhile their sign said 4pm, but they still closed at 3:30pm!

They're also incredibly slow.  In fact, I think I could be faster moving backwards.  They always seem to have a line, but it's mainly because they serve so slowly!  They have two cash registers, but I've only ever seen the one open.

They also seem to have a hard time keeping the condiments refilled.  Most mornings the milk isn't out right away, and most afternoons there's no sweetener available.

They're definitely letting the Starbucks reputation down.

They have nitro cold brew!! That stuff is delicious. Was in the area and was glad to see that this Starbucks location has their new nitro cold brew. Plenty of indoor seating with outlets and WiFi. Very friendly staff - made the experience that much better.
Your coffee beans are ground using cancer causing chemicals yet you felt the real threat was a pair of black men waiting on a friend so you call the cops?  Disgusting!

This past Thursday my best friend and I stopped by for a late coffee.  I ordered a tall pike brew however when my friend ordered a decaf latte she was told they had no beans.   No apology just we do not have coffee beans.  There were no offers of alternative drinks.  My friend was greatly disappointed and hurt by the cold treatment from the server.

This is the most convenient Starbucks for me on my commute. 

My biggest complaint - and this is specific to the brand not this location - is that the cups leak from where the lid and the lip of the cup meet. My $2 coffee should not leak. I never have this issue with Wawa coffee, but ever other cup of Starbucks I get drips everywhere. Why?

As for this location - work on your employee morale. Everyone there seems miserable. Staff rarely smiles and service is not prompt. If there is a line, no matter how
Many people are working, you're going to wait.

I saw one of the girls at the dental office with a refreshing pink drink.. asked her what it was and she said it was "The pink drink"...

So I am easily influenced.. and since the hubby was in getting his check up, off I went.

We haven't been to this Starbucks, so I was impressed not having to wait on a long line. I love looking at all the Starbucks cups and mugs...

I walked back with 2 pink drinks and also a bottle of their vanilla syrup.. I could never get any stores to sell them to me, but this time I lucked out! I know I can make my own syrup, but this was a nice treat.

The drink was refreshing, but a tad too sweet , I'll get my iced Carmel macchiato next time.

I go to a lot of Starbucks, and this one is about the nicest I've ever been to in terms of the layout, seating and decor. 

It's huge place has a very open feel. There are two rooms and they have some long seating areas with bar stool type tables. 

One room has a table with 10 seats, good for a large group or communal coffee drinking. There's wood paneling and dark wood furniture and a great view of Canal Street through their large  windows. 

It's really a pleasant place to sit. If you're in the neighborhood and looking for a Starbucks, I suggest you try this one.

The drinks are consistent with what you'd expect at a normal Starbucks and the staff are particularly courteous and friendly.  One evening I was accosted by a harmless but somewhat off-putting patron that wanted to have a very extensive life/philosophical chat while I was trying to study and when he left, one of the staff members working that night came up to me and asked me if I was okay.  That's a really nice touch.

The reason why I gave this Starbucks a three instead of a four or five is how crowded it gets with teenagers in the afternoon.  If I'm going there to do some work, even with headphones on it's hard drown out their "likes", cackles, and "OMGs".  The store got rid of a couch teens used to seem to congregate about, and filled that space with two-person tables, so that seems to have helped somewhat.  I don't know, maybe I'm getting old, but it's a distracting place to be.

I've been here many times and haven't had too much of a problem with the employees here. Frappuccinos are usually really good and the environment is relaxing, but this one isn't really for people who are short on time as it usually takes a while to make their coffee.
All surface areas and floor were dirty.  Was a late Sunday afternoon and not crowded.

We go to this Starbucks every Saturday and do the mobile order, this is the 5th time our order has been wrong and we finally decided to tell them we are starting to get unhappy with the service and tried explaining we have paid for extra toppings and the girl working tried to argue with us EVEN THOUGH WHAT WE ORDERED WAS RIGHT ON THE RECEIPT so long story short they dont follow directions well at all.
Very friendly, assistant manager, Amanda, was especially nice.  Iced tea is wonderful, but even better is how relaxed I feel enjoying it in the nice environment.  They always make me feel so at home.

I went today and was greeted by Raven who I have seen there before.  She suggested a new  choice of beverage and started my with a smile on my face and in my heart.  Kudos to Raven, Starbucks is lucky to have you represent the organization.

Why Starbucks?!? I had high hopes for a productive work spot with a cup of coffee. The customer service was horrible. I ordered the veranda coffee, which they were out off, so I waited for a fresh roast. Well to my surprise they don't take your name for the orders. After 20-30 minutes of waiting I walked up to find my coffee sitting on the counter. I asked the staff and they were clueless. Thanks.@, that is helpful. After observing I saw they only call the name of the coffee (at a whisper), over blasting music. Helpful again. The positive is there is free parking, seating with outlets, free WiFi and late hours.

This starbucks is near my bus stop. The line gets pretty long, but they make your drink faster when there is a line! Honestly when they are slow god help you if you have to make a bus or get to work. They are almost too friendly!

I worked for starbucks years ago. If the drinks are made right they are great. My latte is always topped with a healthy dose of yummy foam and the people are as I said overly friendly! 

So if you happen to not have cash on you to run into la colombe ( which btw capogiro is open early and they have la colombe) stop here!

the new yogurt parfait is also addictive...i think there is cocaine mixed in the yogurt!

Okay the place is wheelchair accessible, but not through the front door, you have to go inside 1900 market and then through the side door. Might be tricky, but I'm sure someone will help you!

This is one of my favorite Starbucks. It is a new, modern layout with lots of tables tucked away so you can have a more quiet coffee time, or chairs in front of the cozy fire. It is always clean and not usually too crowded. All the baristas are incredibly friendly and quick, they have always had good recommendations when I wanted to try something new. Cheers to this location!
Avoid this location. They will mess up your order each and and every time. There's a Starbucks 3 minutes away in the target complex, go there instead.

Although this is not the nicest Starbucks I've ever been to I am happy it is so close to my apartment. Sometimes the wait at the drive thru is really long but most of the time I'm in and out of there. Whenever it snows they sell every food item for $1. Love it!!!! Always ask for an extra shot because they are skimpy on the espresso at this particular store..

Nice establishment but Starbucks is what happens when coffee goes corporate. Nameless, soulless, over-cooked, & bitter. Don't get me wrong--the folks here are indeed nice and it's a good location!--but I would buy my coffee off the back of a cube van from a guy named "hank" if it was done well.

This location at 19/20 & Market is my "old faithful" when I am on my way to the office or running errands in this area o Center City.  There is usually a longer line during peak hours but moves quickly (hello, mobile ordering!).  They have occasionally screwed up my order but always make it right if they do - thankfully they don't mess it up too often.

Between this 'Bux and the one at 18 & Market I am well-stocked with overpriced caffeine to get me through my stressful rat-race of a week.

Mad props to the barristas who are "workin' it".  Especially the nice young man who works 3 - 7 PM ish.

Gotta have my latte. #DiabetesInaCup

I am a fan, because the staff is wonderful.  But they have to turn down the music.  Omg!  Killing me....

Sometimes you're there, and you don't know if you're at a club or a coffee shop; hard to have a conversation or compose thoughts while enjoying your beverage with loud music.

Hint:  no one will complain if there is no music!  :-)
Awful and racist starbucks. This was the one where two black men were arrested for waiting for a friend and using the bathroom before they had bought anything... disgusting. Best to avoid this store

Literally the worst drive through Starbucks experience ever. It takes so long to get even a single drink, that I was able to put my car into park and slowly write up this particular review. They don't even acknowledge how bad it is or that you've been sitting and waiting for 11 minutes. 

Go literally anywhere else.

I understand that this location is really busy, but the customer service is just not up to par here. On my last trip in, I had a particularly bad experience and I can say I will not be stopping in here ever again.

Got a chance to actually sit down and enjoy the atmosphere.  Great music and free wifi.  Plenty if outlets to plug up to.  Nice coffee house in the neighborhood.  Cant wait for warm weather so I can sit outside.
The worst...slowest...drive thru I have experienced. Middle of the day. Not like it is busy times in the morning.

Dirtiest Starbucks ever! The female bathroom in this Starbucks was on par with some of the dirtiest gas stations I've ever stopped in. The guys bathroom was out of order so I'm assuming foot traffic in the female one was doubled. Sticky, dirty bathroom floor with a handwritten sign set on top of toilet that said 'hold lever to flush'. Ghetto. No papertowels, the whole bathroom looked like it hadn't been cleaned in two weeks. Won't be back.
service was quick, friendly, and super accommodating to drink modifications! i will definitely be returning to this location.

So this is what happens while waiting on friends at Starbucks. I hope you do the same to the white patrons. You may not have called but did not stop the police for arresting innocent people. No more Starbucks for me.

This would be my favorite Starbucks if it wasn't a gazillion miles from home. As I emerged from the wilds of Carson City, escaping my own scene from Deliverance, I entered this blissful oasis of civilization. Light, bright, clean, and comfortable, this is one of the nicest Starbucks around. I found a cozy niche, made some calls, enjoyed my latte and yogurt. As I rested, I reveled in the pleasant environment sans awful music and the feeling of being rushed which seems to characterize many Starbucks. They are doing it right here. And, the barista even lent me a pen and gave me blank receipt paper when I needed to take a number down during a phone call. That's what I call service!

Best Starbucks in west Chester area! I am here five times a week.   Donna and Jeff are awesome!  They know the names of all the regulars.  Many times my coffee is ready before I walk in as they see me coming from the parking lot.

Norman and the crew here are artists! You can tell that they are producing drinks with quality. They take their time and go the extra mile adding whipped cream and other what have you's. I ordered multiple items along with the large crowd also waiting for multiple drinks. The size of the crowd made me realize how much people like this particular Starbucks. I know its a chain and not a local spot but today....they were like a local spot!

It's a shame that I like Starbucks coffee so much because I continually have to be let down by the service here. The drive thru line moves slower than the DMV and inside may actually be worse. Can't count the number of times I ordered a food item to be told they're out of it only after I reached the window to pay. To put it shortly this is the the worst Starbucks location I've ever been too and they seem determined not to relinquish that title.

This is my stop before I head into work in the evenings. The large digital ordering screen is easy to see and confirm they have your order correct. The baristas in the drive thru are super friendly and I have had more than one cool conversation about music and movies here. The location is more convenient than the one they moved from is like 30 meters away so accessing the drive thru and pkg lot is much easier

This location gets crazy in the morning and around
lunch times, even in the summer. Because of the high volume, they are often out of some things, like sandwiches and baked goods, so you can only really rely on the drinks. Some baristas are sweet, others are there just to get the job done. There are two levels which is nice for meeting with a friend or getting some work done.

Very fast and friendly service.  This morning I tried the blueberry oatmeal for the first time.  The flavor packets mix together in such a way that can only described as 'perfectenshlague'.  If you watch the show 'The Office', when @dwightshrute becomes acting manager, he defines being in the state of perfectenshlague as the optimal happiness and fulfillment. Perfectenshlague is how I would describe my experience today.  

I give this 4 stars, because they accidentally charged us and fulfilled the order of an extra reduced fat turkey bacon sandwich.  Of course I ate it, but now I'm over my morning calorie count so it's going to force me to workout today.
Slowest Starbucks in town. Friendly people and drinks are made quite good . But if you are in a hurry or getting a coffee before work , I wouldn't come to this location.

I never really do reviews unless they're absolutely amazing or absolutely terrible, I walked in and there was one person in front of me while three people are waiting for their coffees, The girl working in the morning had a conversation for about three minutes before taking the next person's order and then didn't even greet me which is fine because she's busy however I waited 18 minutes just to be told that they couldn't even do my order even though it was on the menu, and being advertised. Definitely the worst experience I've ever had at Starbucks.

This Starbucks can't seem to decide on their hours of business.  If you make your way to this store it's 50/50 whether or not they're open.  Doesn't matter what time of day. 
The web site says they're open, Google says they're open...pull into the lot and there's nobody there.
The one further Westinghouse front of Lowe's is much better.
The service is beyond slow! Was thinking they were preparing my pastry... no they completely forgot about it after reminding them twice.

I'm a fan of Starbucks, and the service at this location is fantastic. However, they have one of the worst drive through set ups that I have ever seen. Also, parking is almost non-existent. They only have a few spaces in front of the store and the very small lot next door is a cramped mess. 

Starbucks corporate shouldn't even allow a store to open without considering these items.

If they would stop chit chatting with each other they would probably get my order correct.  I go once a week get w scone and a venti sweetened green tea and most of the time they do put the sweetener in but I'm done they were too busy chatting with each other they screwed my order up.  That's it for me with this place
I love heading into this location for the service and beverages. It's always so warm and inviting and something about the atmosphere makes it feel like Christmas time, if that makes sense!!

Extremely convenient drive thru is always a plus but while the quality of product lacks id rather walk into another starbucks to get my drinks made right.

The very berry hibiscus lacks its color integrity flavor and if your lucky they might drop 3 dry bereys in your drink.

I go to Starbucks, way more than I care to admit, on my way to work. I have to say that this Starbucks has some of the sweetest employees. Diamond is always with a smile in her voice and wave hello. Lauren is always so upbeat and positive. Always with a "how are you beautiful?" Definitely helps start the day in a great way!

Quick service. Very clean. I ordered a blonde Cappuccino, and after the foam, I had less then half a drink, that's was really disappointing. Flavor was good, just wish I could have had a full cup for the price of Starbucks drinks
I've been here for 30 min. and the staff have ignored me standing here. This is not the first time. There's really only one staff member here that has good customer service.

This particular Starbucks outlet is NOT handling COVID well.  Every transaction is consummated at the front door (the store is off limits to patrons), which contributes to very slow product delivery if you have not ordered in advance online.  On the day I visited the front door, coffee was not ready when the store opened nor was a simple order (a large coffee, half regular, half decaf, cream) filled correctly.  Where was management?
There staff was very nice and let me ask many questions I tried the Pumpkin Spice latte with 3 stevia. They had my drink done with forest time I went at about 12:30 on a Thursday.

Ugh!!! ((Eye roll)) Worst. Starbucks. Ever. Ok, I think I finally had my last straw with this location. I come here fairly often because of its location between the 95 exit ramp and where I usually head to in the NE, and for the sheer fact that it has a drive thru which for a mama of two littles, is sooooo nice! Especially coming from the city where drive thrus don't exist. 

 It is certainly a pain in the tush to get into, and then once you do make it in, there's a line. There's ALWAYS a line. Doesn't matter what time of day, there's a line. A slow moving one at that. I probably could've written this review while I waited in it. 

Besides the logistics, they're always out of at least one item someone in my crew wants! ALWAYS!! I don't know who does the ordering for this location, but they're terrible at their job. How are you ALWAYS sold out of something. And it's not just the same item every time either. Ugh!

Then today they serve me the most disgusting cup of cold brew! It wasn't drinkable! Glad I just ordered a tall when I usually get a venti. Someone up there was looking out for me! How do you mess up cold brew?!! And a black cold brew nonetheless!! Seriously? This tired mama needed a bit of something today. 

Service is very hit or miss and I've had one encounter where the cashier at the drive they window scolded me for not telling her I was ordering my free drink at the speaker. I mean, she was really nasty about it!
OVER. IT. 

Not one single redeeming quality about this location except for the drive thru which isn't enjoyable either! 

Unless you're desperate, save yourself the hassle!

I have good experiences here. Just happy it exists honesty, in this area.

Drive through is my preference most visits here, and energy one is friendly. I have had no issues with this location.
The BEST Starbucks I've ever been too!!! Everyone is so kind and they make my mornings better. They sometimes write cute little notes on my cup and it's the sweetest thing ever!!!
Waited 12 min for my latte while only one Barista and two other staff twiddling their thumbs...NOT ok!

please read this especially the manager !!!! this place has absolutely no organization at all!!!!! they do not have enough staff probably because the pwner doesn't want to pay anyone i ahev never taken the time to write a bad review in my life but this is just unacceptable. corporate needs to grt notified of this place asap its a drive thru it should not take 40 minutes to go through hire more employees or close

We came early morning on Mother's Day pouring Rain drive thru. They were top Notch no issues and we even asked for Drinks,Pumpkin Bread , and gift card. The staff was friendly and efficient even on the holiday! Cheers to your staff!

Very friendly staff, remembered my name on my 2nd time there. Been hanging out inside every once and a while, always a pleasant environment. Sometimes food/drink come out a little late but they always seem busy so I'm not too worried about it.

I go to this Starbucks about 3 times a week. Drive through is always slow because there are a lot of big trucks in the area and getting to the order window is difficult. They usually get my order right, and taste is consistent. I've found quicker service ordering on the app and parking to get my order.

THEY LEGIT FORGOT ME - How does this happen? I ordered inside and everyone got their drinks except for me so I had to go up and request it...this is bad service that they're so forgetful...I am disappointed! :( I just want my Starbs coffee after being traumatized at the idea of having to return to work onsite! lol

Love the location but Dominique is absolutely awful. A terrible representation of the company. She has a bad attitude every time I have been helped by her. Not only is she rude but she gets the order wrong 8/10 times. Almost seems like she's doing it out of spite.

I've been here a handful of times and I've had great service each time. I wanted to visit a couple times before rating. Today I ordered an iced americano with heavy cream and bacon egg bites. The young lady was very nice and the service was great. My order was out quickly.

Very seldom do I leave positive reviews. As bad as that sounds. However this Starbucks is my absolute favorite. It seems like I've always had issues with any other Starbucks. I've been getting coffee from them every day on my way to school and they're super awesome.  Their staff is really nice and go out of their way to make it feel like you're a valued customer. They've never gotten an order wrong. Not once. Bubbly smiling faces first thing in the morning before school definitely helps make my school day easier. Thank you !

As always, Starbucks always delivers with a good product. However, service wasn't up to what I've experienced at other locations. Order pickup wasn't clear and the cups were sloppy (spills and sticky) which wasn't a great way to walk into a customer meeting.
I ordered the matcha pink drink as well as the pink purple drink. They couldn't make neither of it. They can only blend all ingredient and a trained monkey can do it. Freaking clowns!

Perhaps the slowest experience ever.  4 people behind the counter and one making drinks.   I'm waiting on an Americano.   Seriously.  Been 5 minutes now?    Not sure what the hell the other 3 folks back there do but the girl on the Cafe Machine is moving and still falling behind.    6 minutes.    7 minutes.   8 minutes.  Finally eye contact.   Jumped me to the front of the que.   the Blonde is fabulous.   Her Co- workers are useless.   10 minutes.

Worst location ever every single time I come to this location there's bad attitudes I work in the area so its pretty often that I visit Please retrain your employee's on Customer Service. And to not a have an attitude with a paying customer on an item that is suppose to be in stock!!!!!! Get it together Please and Thank you!!!!

Been to many and this one has such cheerful employees who go above and beyond for their guests! Josh is a great asset to this company and deserves much praise! The other you lady we had that day happily made me a sample of a drink to try before I bought it! Great work ethic thanks for the A+ service
Still disappointed with this location. I had to literally go back to the cashier to ask if anyone was going to make my drink because most left and she was just standing there.

This is now one of the worst Starbucks in the area. I don't know what happened during the last year, but the service and the quality of drinks has gone downhill. I have been in Starbucks in other states and even other countries, and the consistency always amazes me. Unfortunately, this 82nd/Craig location has been consistently terrible lately. I gave it another try today, however, and I guess I shouldn't be surprised: in addition to not being able to get a simple drink order entered in correctly, once "fixed," the drink itself was so bad I poured it out before I got in my car. I'm done with this location.
Sitting in a near empty store for 30+ minutes to get a freaking latte. Why is this location so incapable?

This place is Starbucks Hades!  It gets slammed by the hospitals in the area and it is too small to handle the volume.  Not sure why anyone would want to work there because it is crazy.  Worse the staff is unhappy and passive aggressive to boot.  Took me 20 minutes to get my order and after asking three times for my muffin, they told me they were out.  Really disappointing spot.  They need to close it and rethink how they function.

Typically this Starbucks has friendly employees and pretty good service but last week I had an odd experience. I was driving to Orlando when I went through the drive through. My coffee tasted normal but when I got to the bottom I discovered it was full of coffee grinds. After that sip full of grounds I noticed the sleeve on my drink had a message that said "Be Kind" and the rest of the sleeve was shaded red. No idea why this message would have been to me since we didn't really interact with anyone for very long and went through the drive through. In any case I'm disappointed and we may be skipping this Starbucks in the future.

Disgusted!!!  Racism!! Can't sit in Starbucks while black and wait for the rest if your party.  Gold Rewards Status will not patronize another Starbucks until some firing take place and I don't mean relocating and a public apology from corporate.
