Terrible experience!  The customer service is awful. They hardly make eye contact while you are ordering and then take forever to make your drinks. They made all of the drinks when we were there in the wrong order. People that ordered before us got their drinks after us, and those who ordered after us got theirs before. Very poorly run store. We will not be returning to this location.

Not all Starbucks are created equal. This location is definitely not my favorite, but due to its proximity, it's one I frequent often. I don't get that neighborhood vibe. No "nice to see you again" or "good morning" even though I have frequented here fairly often lately, sometimes, day after day. I know, it's a chain, how could I possibly get that small town treatment in a big city? Well, I absolutely get that at the other Starbucks I go to in Jenkintown and I miss that warm welcome here.

I've had quite a few issues here... They leave chunks of matcha at the bottom of my green tea latte. They didn't know how to use the app sending me off without earning my points. I pay $5-$7 for my coffee, I should get something back, dammit! They have been out of blonde roast. They have been out of cold brew. Ugh!! Lately these haven't been issues, thankfully, but they most certainly have in the past. 

I've had the best luck ordering through the app and picking up at this location and highly recommend doing so. 

Parking can be rough, but hey, at least there's a parking lot! It is next to a bus stop which is nice for those who take public transportation. 

I usually combine trips here with quick stops at TD Bank which is in the same shopping complex so for that it's convenient.

Yes I understand they are doing their best. This is the only Starbucks that is having such modified hours. This is the second time I have tried after 2 which seems to me very early.  I'm not sure what is going on?? Can anyone let me know. This used to be my favorite one:(

Worst Starbucks experience EVER!! Hopefully it's just a bad day for Alyssa and the crew but judging from the other reviews I doubt it. As someone who goes to SB multiple times a day we have NEVER been treated so rudely and this may have been the first time I have ever had to ask to have my drink remade. That request was met by a look that told me exactly how she felt about that. Ugh... Not at all the SB service we've come to expect and love.
Used to be nicer.  The last few times I've been here the service has been slow and the bathrooms disgustingly dirty.  I'll go to a different location from now on.

Newly remodeled and friendly service. As part of the remodel, this location got a Clover machine (single brewed coffee) which is cool for Tucson. Given its prime location at Speedway and Country Club, its very busy, but the line moves fast. There is outdoor seating and free wifi for the non-summer days!

Personable staff. Very friendly. Always willing to go the extra mile to make sure you get the drink you want made correctly. It can get busy at times, especially on the weekend, but they work as efficiently to ensure quality every time.

I've visited this Starbucks 4 times now and each time something has gone wrong with my order. Two times were mobile orders that were not ready when I went to pick them up. The app gives an estimated time, usually of 3-7 minutes, and I pad that time with 3 additional minutes to ensure it will be ready when I'm there...and both times my orders were not ready more than 10 minutes after placing the order. The next time was a walk in order where I wasn't served for more than 5 minutes as I watched an employee put out new mats and two others making drinks for the busy drive through. When I did receive my drink, it was made incorrectly and it took another couple of minutes for the busy barista to have time to remake it. The fourth time was a drive through order and both of my drinks did not have sweetener in them despite my specifically ordering them sweetened. I'm sure a lot of this poor service has to do with adjusting to a new location with a drive through but I can't say that I'll be returning to this location with any regularity.

In the area for the weekend & needed the daily fix lol, & this location had a really long line for the drive thru so we almost didn't come, I'm happy we decided to go in! The shop was very clean & the staff was very cheerful despite how busy they were! They got my drink out in a timely manner & it came out perfect! I used to work at Starbucks not too long ago, so I understand the stress of a line that size in the drive! These guys crushed it!

Came to Starbucks right before 10am, was greeted nicely, ordered my drink.. my drink came out the wrong size which was easily fixed, due to covid i understand the half and half and powders are not out so i politely asked if the barista for the half/half and Cinnamon and Chocolate powder, i got a rude response with "you should've ordered it that way" because obviously we can't hand anything out or take the drink back.. i suggested maybe just giving me a little half and half in a smaller cup and i could just pour it in myself because i simply did not know.. Both baristas and cashier looked at me like i was stupid and gave me the half/half in a small cup with a "i guess" attitude.. made me feel totally uncomfortable and dumb.. i left and didn't ask for a straw because i didn't want to seem like even more of a bother.. at least my drink was good, but the attitudes sucked..

Of course Starbucks is one of the most basic B's coffee stop. BUT they're only alive and well because... WELL, THEIR CRAFT DRINKS ARE AMAZING! Everywhere, they have a set recipe, so generally the drinks can never go wrong! They were handing out free holiday cups for each holiday drink you buy. Yum! Pumpkin Cream Cold Brews!

Sooooo.... I'm a big believer in energy. I believe what you put out into the world you'll get in return, as a business owner I am careful not to bash any establishment. However this Starbucks...THIS STARBUCKS‍ is not it. 

Some helpful tips: perhaps adopt an idea similar to that of Chic-fila, have a server help to service the line on the outside so it keeps the drive-thru line from causing a major traffic back-up on Grant Ave.

Invest in professional development training (or maybe a better one) to train your staff on the basics of decent customer service, professionalism and efficiency.

Last, find a regimen that works! Each time I order from this location my order is very inconsistent. Unfortunately, this morning was my last visit..please see the video I posted take care!

I've been to this Starbucks several times. The people are usually pretty rude. It's always extremely busy and the baristas don't really seem to care at all about the customers. I had ordered a refresher and also a large water for my boyfriend. This is what I received when I got the water...ummm what?? What is that hard to fill the water all the way up to the top or break the ice cubes and actually put a proper lid on it?

For many years we suffered without a Starbucks drive-thru on the west side of town. All of the Starbucks were closer to work and had spectacularly long lines. 

Suddenly, like a mirage in the desert the Starbucks on a hill appears! Conveniently located next to the interstate, this Starbucks is PERFECTLY located for a Frappuccino or Latte on the way to work!

It hasn't been open long, but in all my visits so far, I've been greeted with friendly baristas who promptly delivered my coffee beverage.

I look forward to many more visits to this Starbucks in the years to come.

I ordered a coffee using rewards and couldn't order a bagel as it was out of stock, as so figured if order inside. I had issues with my app but Sarah  couldn't figure it out. Instead she made it right and let me have my bagel. Great way to correct the situation. Grateful some understand what customer service is about!

The barista who worked on July 4 was slightly rule. I was Starbuck customer for years. I was very shocked about  Starbuck staff who was bad behavior on that day. Amazing as always!! Kevin looked liked he just came off the runway in Paris.... as usual!! This Starbucks is fast, efficient, and friendly!! This is the most consistently amazing Starbucks that I have been a patron of. They rock!! Today I had Grande Iced Chocolate Almondmilk Shaken Espresso. It was delicious! I had a headache and this drink quickly went to work on relieving it. I also had a vanilla scone which was delectable as always. Thank you team!!

I hate to do this, because I'm actually a fan of Starbucks. I was a barista myself for several years, and I know things are often more complex than the customers see. That said - this is hands-down the most poorly managed and maintained Starbucks I have ever been to.

My drink (marshmallow latte) isn't a menu standard, but it's not complex and I've ordered it at at least six Starbucks in four states without a problem. The barista, when he walked the cashier through ringing it up, said to us "this isn't something we should be doing". Then instead of charging me for one syrup, charged me for vanilla syrup, mocha sauce, and marshmallow whipped cream. 

Then we waited. Ten mobile orders, one cafe order. Ten mobile orders, one cafe order - the mobile orders were mostly sitting there rather than being picked up immediately, so it's not like people were waiting for them. Then my friend's drink (she ordered after me) then another ten mobile orders. It took us twenty minutes easily to get two lattes. While we waited, I went to the bathroom. One had a hole where the lock should have been, with a ratty sign saying they were working on it. The other looked like the toilet hadn't been scrubbed in a month.

I like to give people the benefit of the doubt, but we went out of our way to avoid going here again.

Hiii Westshore Starbs, I have missed you so very much during the pandemic & happy to be back!

It was a 15 min. wait in the drive through lane despite seeing +3 employees working. I'm glad Starbs is continuing their afternoon Happy Hour (Download the app. to get alerts a day prior); I'd still happily pay $5.16 for a Pumpkin Cream Cold Brew like I did the previous week. This drink is undoubtedly my favorite and I didn't make any modifications at all, which is rare because I always prefer half the syrup. The 2 pumps of vanilla syrup combined with velvety cream on the top is heaven in every single sip! YUMMY! Thanks for helping me to continue my caffeine addiction...working onsite takes more energy than I remember & the caffeine makes me feel perky to tackle the rest of my busy day!

This location was the absolute worst location that I have EVER been to. I visited on December 4th. I entered the drive through line at 4:58pm. There were 8-10 cars in front of me. I finally said excuse me but can I get some help to because I was here first and I stood here and waited patiently. I also forgot to mention the time I preordered from this store and got here and they weren't open like the app said they were supposed to be. So I had to haul ass all the way down to chesterfield by my work just to get my order.

Came in at 4pm yesterday and they only had Pike Place brewing. When I asked with genuine astonishment if that was the only option the cashier said yes and did not offer a pour over option which every other Starbucks would offer if they choose to only brew one blend. Also imo Pike Place is the most generic blend you can offer cmon man. 

If that was not enough for the one star review they did not have any cream or milk out at the self help station?? I went by the location several hours later when I was in the area and stopped in just in bewilderment to see if they do not put any half and half out or accompaniments and to my shock they were still not out! Cost saving measure in a Starbucks or are you hiding the cream and mixing options somwhere I am not looking?

That will be the last of my money this location gets and luckily I used a giftcard.

I go to this location every day - they are less than 5 mins from my house - if I could give a ZERO I would. The last week every other day my drink is wrong, they had me a venti cup with the lid NOT secure and 1/2 this thing spilled on me and my car... when I explained what had happened and asked for some paper towels then guy threw his rag at me his coffee & milk soaked rag!!! I pay over 6 bucks for a drink that is never right.. I'm just super frustrated and will now drive the distance for my regular joint... I know  first world problem  but I'm done!

I'm writing to let you know that in February 27th I approached your location on Canal St and your cashier was extremely rude to me. She was at the register at 2:11 and I as I approached she told me to step back because I was wearing a mask. I'm wearing a mask because I'm pregnant and I'm not immune to measles. I'm a teacher and traveling from California and as a former Disney employee I would say this was humiliating and I just hope it doesn't happen to any other customers. When you work in the service industry, you should be aware that your job is to treat every customer with respect and everyone deserves to be greeted equally. I will go ahead and leave a review on yelp as well but it would be great if your staff was more educated in regards to what is happening at the moment.
I went to ruby slipper and Sydney's hospitality and Irish coffee was bomb asf! I want to thank you for hiring her and giving me an outstanding experience!

So drinks were made but the mix was not stirred on the Matcha Drink, neither is the mix in the White Chocolate Mocha. The White Chocolate Mocha was missing its whip cream (most Starbucks miss the Whip Cream). They should just not make it with whip cream and lower the price by $0.50. Not coming back to this Starbucks!

Nice Starbucks , right in the heart of downtown, right opposite CHOP. The inside was spotless clean, with plenty of seating . There was one person taking orders and another preparing the drinks - a good system as we got the drinks very quickly. The person taking orders was very patient with us as we took our time to decide. The drinks were very well made and tasted fresh!

For the second week in a row I've ordered my drink 10-15 ahead of time for pick up, I walk in no greeting, I had to wait an additional 10 minutes for my drink.  Today was the last day I come preorder my drink.  The manager comes out the back room wearing a head rag smh this used to be my favorite location.  So far 2 people  have returned their drinks while I'm waiting. #Not anymore

This is the worse Starbucks ever!! Take forever even when not that busy. So disorganized. Like cmon I've been to Starbucks that was faster with like 20 times more customers. 

Need to fire the people and start over. Brutal wait here every time!!!
Even in Europe coffee shops are generally not this large and beautiful.  Characteristically friendly staff working hard to serve you great coffee and pastries.
Asked for a venti and my cup was half full didn't notice until I was on my way home... wasn't busy for them to mess up my order...

Starbucks is definitely a place where you know what you are going to get and its process is in place to ensure that you receive exactly what you order and get great customer service. They also have processes in place if you don't get 5 star service. Visited this location through the drive-thru just as they were closing. Great service!
Trying out the new Apple pie Mach, the flavor was delicious!!! Tasted apple with a hint of cinnamon and espresso! I love this little starbies it's usually quiet and the service is always good

Deserves zero stars. By far the worst service and coffee I've gotten at any coffee establishment. I'm not even sure the girls who showed up after I waited almost 5 minutes were even the correct employees. No Starbucks nametag in sight. 

Arrived around 5:13pm i think on July 7th  for coffee and nobody was there. It was messy and one if the faucets was on running water. After about 4 minutes two girls finally walk into Starbucks. My friend orders her iced coffee with extra cream and the "barista" says what do you mean extra cream? What's the cream? There's no cream. Never have they not known what extra cream meant
I order a simple hot coffee with steamed almond milk. Again, she says steamed? You want it steamed so I just tell her to put almond milk in there regularly if you don't know how to do it. 
Worst place

3 stars is very generous considering multiple mistakes I've encountered & they've redeemed themselves somewhat.

Whelp! I was disappointed in the lack of service and turnaround time for drinks to be prepared.

A while ago, I went around 3pm for a late coffee break because they were advertising 50% off macchiatos (I miss these Happy Hour deals). I placed three different orders. The young man at the counter had difficulty finding a QR code through Starbucks app to be able to apply the discount. An older woman that looked like she'd been at this for a while (perhaps manager?) took over and tried same tactic for what felt like the millionth time where she kept scanning my Starbucks app, but nothing happened. She finally manually applied the discount after a total of 10-15 min. Of trying to fix the issue. Also, I specifically brought in my own bottle to help with reducing plastic waste and she didn't transfer over.10 discount when she redid the order from the gentleman that originally took the order. I had to wait another 15 min. For them to fix two drinks that were wrong. Both of those drinks were served hot and requested an iced coffee...for this transaction, it felt way too long and would've been nice if I got an apology. Plus, I was almost late returning to work for my afternoon meeting!

POSITIVE:
This morning I got here at 8:10am and there was nobody in line at all, so service was fast! I tried their caffe mocha that includes espresso, steamed milk and whipped cream served hot because I forgot to ask it to be served iced and delightful!

It's hard for me to resist making a stop because it's very convenient & on my route to work. While I enjoy certain chains, I've been disappointed on multiple occasions when they've made incorrect drinks. Usually, I "let it go, let it go" [Never too old for an animated movie reference lol)].

This is a popular stop, so I've even seen the drive through line curve around the corner of the road, not an unusual sight. The drive through can be efficient, but parking can be tight. I recommend giving yourself extra time just in case you need to hop back inside to get your drink corrected or make sure to take a quick sip before driving off to figure out if they made your drink correctly or not, which I forget to do 'cause I'm always on the go!

I regret wasting my money on this. I never get ventis but decided to treat myself today MISTAKE! This probably has NO COFFEE IN IT! It is basically white and SO sweet like it's only milk and syrup!!! Where's my coffee at? Oh they probably forgot it! Waste of my money and now I don't even want to drink it because of how bad it tastes
It's amazing how great your treated throughout  this covid-19 season. Although we had to make some minor adjustments the service we as customers receive are awesome throughout this pandemic

Inefficient Starbucks with what seems like new stream of employees, so they don't know how to do basics like ringing up Happy Hour (BOGO) drinks for myself + coworkers. Please at least open up a second register if this is the case everytime I order because I feel bad holding up the line and clogging it up! Sluggish service brings it down from a 3 to a 2!

So this is my regular Starbucks location and they have done a good job with my online orders. Everything is always ready and made just like I like it when I arrive for pick up. 
I've only had one snafu at this location, bad blueberries for my oatmeal. But they made it right on my next visit and have been very consistent since. I'll definitely keep visiting.
Who doesn't like Starbucks? Aliens, maybe? Yeti? People who don't like good coffee?

Very rude people there. It's a nice place to meet people. But the people were very rude. They refused to remake a drink after "losing" our drinks. Then refused to be helpful. Told us that they aren't remaking when they gave a refun that we didn't ask for.

The sewer gas smell in the drive through lane is so powerful that if there had been an escape lane, I would have taken it.  Chronic problem, never gonna get fixed.  I worked burn pits in the military and walked third world villages that smelled better.  You've seen my dime for the last time.

This Starbucks always gets me out in a hurry. They are very efficient here both in store and thru the Drive- Thru. Love this place when I am in the area!! Amazing as almost all Starbucks in this region!
Fantastic Starbucks. The furniture is much nicer than the vast majority of Starbucks cafes I've been to. The staff is fantastic, especially Mark and Ron. Great service, great ambience as well.
Piss poor service not coming back anytime soon would rather go to a different Starbucks and get better service with how much I buy starbucks

Ordered a iced latte like I always do at every startbucks I visit, asked for an iced latte, 2 pumps of vanilla and light cream. I get a iced latte with the whipped light cream topping on top my coffee also looked so light i may as well of ordered a cup of milk... it was so hard for the employees to understand what I was trying to order (which really was a simple order) and I was so confused bc this shouldn't have been a complicated order but they made it into one. Last time I order Starbucks at a mall. I was getting so annoyed they were making me feel like it was unheard of and I didn't know what I was talking about. I told her it's just like ordering an iced coffee but instead espresso with light cream or milk and 2 pumps of vanilla.

We come to this Starbucks every time we are in town it's always a great atmosphere but, today it was not.  I'm assuming it's the store manager not wearing her apron and has the nastiest attitude I've ever seen.  She's giving the most horrible customer service to every single customer apparently because the morning shift did not stock prior to them leaving.  She's letting out her frustrations at the customers.  I ordered my drink at 1.31p and just now got it at 1.54p and it was made wrong.  When I mentioned it to her all she said was "my bad" no I'm sorry no I'll remake for you, nothing she just turned around threw the drink away and had another associate make my drink.  This is not what you should expect when walking into any Starbucks.

I come in today with high hopes that a second chance could redeem them, and it did. Music was set to a reasonable level and my order was quick and accurate. However, the young girl who appeared to be running the show seemed to be short with her staff and was very condescending and rude to them. I obviously don't have enough context to know how the day had been or any personal issues this girl may have been going through, BUT if you're in a customer service business you know going in that means there will be times where business is VERY busy, and vice versa. Also, if you choose to enter into any kind of management role that means balancing that responsibility with the training and development of your staff. It was unsightly and very unprofessional to see her being condescending to the staff.

Love this closer location, drinks always made right. Only down fall is they say 6am open but the car line doesn't start til like 6:15/6:30 and a massive line is backed up forever was told no one has headsets when they are doing morning prep and forget to put it on in time to open drive thru

Always pleased with this location. My drinks are always delicious and the customer service is great! They are always inviting! My cashier today, I think his name was Brain really made my day with his happiness!

We were touring University City and needed a beverage before walking the Penn Campus and this Starbucks offered convenience and quick service.

The line was almost out the door upon entry.  We were impressed at how fast the barista's were able to expedite the line and provide drinks to the masses, including us.

No complaints here.  Drinks were fast and accurate and we were happy and on our way.

This location has always had decent service except for one time there were bees at the drive through and they weren't letting people order unless they went inside. I realize that's not their fault, but maybe go get some repellent. Anyway, this morning there was a black hair in my coffee.  i have blonde hair and the lid has been closed. I kind of want to throw it out now.

I've been there twice & travel a lot to many many locations. No bad vibes. I'm specific how I want my coffee made and they get it just right. No drive through which can it may be inconvenient to some though unfortunately & I can understand that. They deserve five stars overall

So I stopped in here for a drink and a rest stop.  The coffee was fine people were pleasant but NO restroom was available.   They MIGHT open them later this month.  Well that doesn't help when you are 40 miles from home and the hospital next door only lets the patient in, not their driver.

Baristas were kind of rude when they had to brew a new green tea even though I already paid for it and wasn't aware it was out before 
hand.. it took her all of 5 minutes while she was complaining to her coworkers in back about it and I could overhear.. I didn't realize brewing tea was so hard!! 
Asked for no sweetener and she repeated it back to me and confirmed and put "no classic" on the label BUT then she put sweetener in it - not sure if she was annoyed that she had to brew a new green tea batch? I wish the staff was happier
One of the better starbucks in Nashville. And they're quick getting drinks out so you're not waiting forever.

This is our favorite Starbucks. They always make the drinks consistently well and do their best to keep the long drive thru line moving as fast as possible (if more people would use the mobile app it would move faster, they should ask chick-fil-A for advice on drive thru logistics). Starbucks has had some supply chain issues lately but we are almost always able to find something we want. They are doing their best and it's not the employees fault.

When it comes to Starbucks I expect two things, a friendly barista and a tasty drink and this location has been very good to me on the occasions I have visited. I have visited inside and thru the drive thru and the baristas I have spoken to have been friendly and helpful when making my purchases. 

I love that they have a drive-thru because when it's cold you can stay in the warmth of your car while waiting for your delicious beverage or tasty treat.

Happy sipping!

No complaints about the service. I do have to complain about the fact they were more worries about mask protocol then handling problems. 

The good:
Got 8 shots over ice and 2 sandwiches. Came out with the wrong cup with is fine. Sandwiches were quick, nice.

As I turned to leave,  my cup scrunched upnand I lost a couple shots of espresso.  I cleaned it up and went to tell the barista just so they know that there's a lightly wet floor and they could handle it. 

As I was explaining what happened, my mask apparently got caught on my stubble and slowly lowered below my nose. So a completely different barista who saw me talking decided to chide me about my mask.  I'm not against wearing my mask as it is currently required. Nor am I against adjusting it if needed. But it is rude to interrupt someone attempting to communicate a situation because you wish them to adjust their  mask because it's below their nose.

The barista's there have managed to still deliver top notch drinks & service during the Covid pandemic. Especially Alyssa & Jordan, they do a super job making my drinks perfect every time. Wish Target would allow these employees to get tips, they deserve it!

This is about ECOLOGY and is likely not related to a specific Starbuck's location but  here's where I became aware that a refill of iced tea has to be made IN A NEW PLASTIC CUP!! They will no longer refill the cup you have. This is a business that touts its careful use of natural resources and ecology so I am really shocked.
I e-mailed the company and got a "standard reply to customer complaint" response from "Ellis"  not even addressing the nature of the complaint, the guy just blew me off. I plan to pursue it and hope to get someone from the company who will address this very legitimate issue.

The best Starbucks in the area!
A smaller store located at the end of a strip mall. No drive thru but fast and friendly service and of course you can order ahead via app. They always have my order correct and food/drink prepared exactly to my liking. I went here today and my mobile order was ready when I got there. Highly recommend, especially for mobile orders! 
Plenty of parking in front and on side of building.

Stopped in here with some friends to play catch up and kill time. I usually do not frequent Starbucks at all. While I was here, I loved that they no longer accept cash, happy that a business is implementing new procedures to help speed up the lines and the change counters. The staff was super friendly, courteous, and went above and beyond with my order.

I am disappointed in this Starbucks. I ordered a large coffee with cream and sugar, a very simple order. They handed me my coffee which was piping hot, I paid for it and walked  a few  blocks to my hotel giving the coffee some time to cool down so I could drink it without burning myself. The girl gave me a black coffee, no cream or sugar. I'm not sure if she messed up or if she just didn't care because she had a attitude like I was bothering her by ordering coffee.

This Starbucks is so slow the woman behind me left. She travels out of BNA regularly and she still didn't have enough time to place her order and get a drink. They only have one person at the register and one poor person making all of the drinks. I see another employee is in the drink area now but the line is still barely moving. I got my drink, a grande iced latte, but it tastes a little off.
Five employees and it was faster to do mobile order than order at cashier. I still had to wait forever for the sandwiches.  The only convenience is the location.

Had a great experience being helped by Brad at the counter. I'm not used to this heat (in town for a wedding) and was sweating like crazy and needed hydration. I asked for a surgery drink (back off coffee snobs .) 

He recommend two great options to spike my blood sugar and I was on my way! Fast and pleasant service.

They are always friendly.   I am not a coffee person but do like a good "spot of tea".  Their passion tea with lemonade is excellent.  Sometimes their black tea can be bitter.  I am a gold member and love the perks that come with that.

Great store to work and and where the partners are the best in town. They are always greeting people walking on the door. I come and get a grande cold brew and always am delighted to interact with all of the friendly staff that is there.
No bathrooms for customers only for employees. They have a really nice parking lot though. Excellent water drainage and very green grass. Looks like it gets water and fertilizer often.

I was so exited the other day to get my morningvcoffee, but was beside myself when i saw a hastily written note saying temporarily closed AND with no explanation as to why!!! It leads me to question if a certain virus was involved.

This was the filthiest Starbucks I've ever been in. Had I not known better I would have thought I wandered into a gas station bathroom after chili night. Needless to say I did not order so much as an ice cube after seeing what the bathrooms and seating area looked like. Try PJs instead. Much cleaner, less homeless folks loitering.

Horrible service ... !! 
After you ask for your order  , they tried to put you on the spot by screaming to the person who took the order (cashier ) ... it is so unprofessional and so upsetting !! Never coming back .. if you walk a few blocks up .. there is a better Starbucks with so much better service !

AVOID THE DRIVE-THRU ON SUNDAY MORNINGS.

I thought that maybe last week was an off-day but I was extremely annoyed this morning as well.

I would like to point out that it took 20 minutes to receive my order this morning with 4 cars in front of me. I ordered a hot green tea- and received it without the tea bag. I saw the gentleman take the tea bag out- which is unusual since I've never had that before. As a result, my tea was too mild for me. And my cup- it was not double cupped, and the cup sleeve was inadequate for the hot drink. The order for the gentleman in front of me was wrong as well.

Do I sound like a crazy lady on caffeine withdrawal? Maybe. I wish that this Starbucks would add another person to assist with the drive-thru during the busy times.
Worst service ever. Drinks are awful customer service is awful and people intimidate you and make you feel like you don't belong. Very very unprofessional.

I have been coming to this (relatively new) location for a few months and it it it is extremely hit or miss but I definitely want to say more of a miss. I wanted to write a review a while ago, but decided to wait until I had a little bit more of an experience here to share. The bottom line - this is not the typical Starbucks that functions like a well oiled machine, and maybe that could be attributed to it being a newer location. It is a rare occasion my order is given to me correctly (I always check before I leave) in the drive-through wait times are consistently extremely long. Prepare to wait here at least a good 8 to 12 minutes. It is the most convenient location to our house so I continue to suffer through; I am hoping things will change over time!

Dave and Danielle at this location are the best!!! I went for my free birthday drink.  Both told me Happy Birthday as soon as they saw it on my app. Of course I ordered the venti with no ice using one of the hacks I read.  Both were still super nice. Danielle gave me a cup of ice too. She told me lots of people do the same thing!  
The drink was really good. It was a little sweet for me but once some ice melted it was better. It was refreshing on a hot humid day. 
It was my first time at Starbucks since the pandemic started.  The store was clean. Staff wore gloves and masks. No seating is available. When I was done, the counter was sanitized.  
I would definitely go back to this location!!

This place is horrible! I will NEVER visit again. I went through the drive through and ordered a medium, caramel latte and a blueberry scone. When I got to the window to get my order the scone was cold. I shed the lady at the window, who seemed annoyed already, could she reheat the scone as it's now cold. She's stated, rudely, she had already warned it. I said to I knew this but I was in line for a while it isn't warm anymore. So she warned it and have it back. Below is the pictures of the scone she gave me back. Broken in pieces. Like I am a dog!!! I took it back at complained to the manager but she seemed scared of her employees as the woman and I hear words in front of her! If I wasn't hungry I would have returned the food and went elsewhere. 
This place is horrible

This Starbucks has been terribly designed.  The parking lots suck.  The drive thru lines block one lot and get so long they linger Terry Parkway.  Every time I get s Starbucks app reward or discount, this location never identifies it and that takes even longer.  The west bank needs more locations!

It is a joy to go to the Starbucks at the Tucson Premium Outlets, 6401 W. Marana Center Blvd., Suite 806 Marana, AZ.
Amy and her staff are always welcoming. The store, restrooms, and outside seating area are also welcoming offering a pleasant eating/drinking experience.
When shopping the Tucson Premium Outlets, I strongly recommend stopping at Amy's Starbucks for a warm greeting and excellent drinks, food, and service!
Starbucks is consistent they have great Iced Chai Latte this location is friendly in my past experience I've been 3 times and it's always great don't understand the bad reviews

Staff is friendly and helpful, and always get my drink right. There are at times long lines, this usually is at lunch and on weekends, it is a kiosk with about 5 people working at a time so they do a descent job moving the line, but as a frequent patron it is not uncommon to overhear one person order 5 frappachinos for themselves and their whole family. If you are not willing to wait in line there is a coffee shop in Nordstroms 1st floor entrance.

This location has been flaky for the past few months. For a number of weeks this past summer the opening hours shifted unpredictably, and for the past couple of weeks it's become the slowest Starbucks in the area. Whatever the reasons are, they're not prepared for morning rush times.

The only reason I rate this store 1 star is because I come in at 5 am, first person in the store, and sit at the handicap table as I have a lot of paperwork to spread out and the small tables are too small, then a worker comes up and tells me, "there is a handicapped customer that comes in and sits at that table" I think, no problem, probably someone in a wheelchair or something, I'll gladly move for them. But no. A tall, very capable man walks in and says I need to move (which I was in the process of) because that's his table. I get you're a regular but I'm still a paying customer who was there before you and you have no physical need for the wheelchair table more than I do, and I don't appreciate the employee telling me where I can and cannot sit. Ridiculous

The worst Starbucks that I've ever been to. Super slow and drinks came out terrible. I ordered a grande iced caramel cloud macchiato, and it came out 80% cloud foam, the remaining amount was probably 3 gulps of coffee at best. I didn't have time to return for them to correct the drink, so maybe management would have to learn about it via Yelp.

Hopefully our next visit will be better... there were only two people in line inside when we got here, and it took 15 minutes to make two lattes. To be fair, there were a lot of people at the drive through--but they took our order right away and I would assume that it would have been made as soon as the order was placed.
They don't seem to have much of a system in place for handling both drive through AND inside customers.

Mobile ordering was quick and efficient. They keep the fish mobile orders in the back, so you have to ask for your name. Lots of tables for working. They seem very busy even on an afternoon. Convenient location.

I have ordered from Starbucks for years and as usual, I ordered an iced americano with cream and I got a coffee that was not at all mixed. The coffee was still warm on the bottom and cream was floating up top. I told the barista at the window that it was not supposed to be like that and he said well you can mix it up yourself (!?). When I tried to shake it, it was still not mixed thoroughly to drink. I took it inside and ask them to mix it. The manager said he would remake the drink for me but also go irritated and shouted at me while I was trying to explain my drink was not at all mixed when I got it. Like he was irritated at the fact he had to teach his barista to make the drink but took it out on me. 

Then the sandwich that I ordered with the drink came out burnt and they packed it up to give to me anyway. I have ordered from here many times and never had a problem but this new set of crew ruined my experience.
CRAP SERVICE . They are Out of everything on the food menu and wouldn't let a handicap disabled woman sit down for 3 mins to wait for our order. Pathetic !

My favorite drink is the venti iced caramel macchiato. I always ask for extra caramel and rarely do I get messy drinks. This barista poured too much milk into the cup. So, after the espresso was poured and she went to add the lid, the drink poured over the lid and out of the straw hole. I asked for an extra lid to replace the messy lid after mixing my drink and the person who took my order made a smartass response about there being extra caramel, like it was my fault the barista made a mess. First of all, they barely gave me extra caramel. And second of all, don't blame me for your fuck up and carelessness. I was polite and nice when I asked for the lid. I visit Starbucks often and rarely do I get such treatment.

Terrible, for a University run Starbucks this place should be poppin. I got a hot green tea with steamed coconut milk and flavor. I got a green tea with a splash of milk and no flavor. Waste of my time and money. Never again. And it sucks because it was conveniently located

I have been hesitating on writing a review for a month now, but I officially will not go back to this location ever again, so here it is....

The location is great, as it is right around the corner from my new job. I have gone here at least 15 times in the last month and a half, and literally, no sarcasm, they MAY have gotten the drink correct once...ONCE! After the first five visits of leaving there with something i did not order, i started to realize i need to double check, and triple check with the baristas if they are making it correctly. I know this is annoying, as I worked for Starbucks myself for six years, but i got tired of spending money on something i don't want to drink and just "sucking it up" every time. 

This most recent visit, it was the same ole ordeal. I double checked with the guy taking the order, just to make sure he understood. Then i watched the guy on the bar making it incorrectly, but i thought to myself "give them the benefit of the doubt, maybe that is not your drink"....but...like always...it was. I had to say something this time, and the person i am, i felt bad about it....but I just reached a limit. Keep in mind this is not a crazy out the ordinary type of drink, like i know they get hit with often, or i would understand the amount of mistakes. I could understand once or twice or even five times not getting it right, i am a reasonable person, but 99% of the time?! Flabbergasting.

They are super nice people, so i do not want to bash them..but they just seem so clueless... The irony involved was how they were talking to each other about how they are "Coffee Masters"....in which i had to physically turn around to avoid laughing at. 

In conclusion, if you want what your paying for...do not go to this location. It is clear management does not take the time to make sure the Baristas are properly trained. Or maybe everyone that works there is stoned?

This is probably the WORST Starbucks in the area. I can in today for a mobile order and waited forever. There is a major fly problem (they were everywhere - on lights, counters, and espresso machines). The floors were so STICKY! It is just gross! Choose another location

Nice but not so efficient baristas. I waited 14 minutes this morning to get a cold brew. This place is never an optimal morning stop. Even the order-ahead coffee isn't generally ready in a timely manner.
Love this location! Went tonight to get a beg of ground beans for my press and the ladies working were so nice. Best West County Starbucks!!!!!

Waking my Yelp account up specifically for this review. Having spent perhaps too much time at too many starbucks, I can say that this Starbucks has the nicest staff and is the cleanest Starbucks in all of Delaware county, probably Philadelphia as well. I've never had an issue with my drink being wrong. Never hard to find parking, either in front, on the side. I've never had to park by smashburger but that would be another option. Gets pretty crowded closer to lunch. 

For anyone who has criticized this location, they can go to Glen Mills, Media, Springfield, Villanova, Bryn Mawr...Or really any other Starbucks with an angry disinterested staff that can't be bothered. The Brookhaven location feels like it's a totally different company.

So I preordered my cappuccino to pick up at the drive-through.  The line was very long and did not move for five minutes.   All of a sudden, that one car moved and the line really moved forward.   Coffee was excellent and hot.

Not the most amazing location, but it gets the job done. There is tons of parking, which is nicely separated from the drive-thru on one side. The partners are very friendly and seem to enjoy their work. This morning, they all humored this incredibly loquacious older gentleman, who engaged nearly all of the morning staff in loud conversations about baseball, stripper videos, and mutual acquaintances. There were smiles all around, even when the conversation got a little awkward.

My experience with the partners has always been positive, and my drinks have been spot on. I did get a bacon, egg, and gouda breakfast sandwich this morning that was still slightly cold in the middle. That's never what you want in the morning. I recommend a visit here as it is down the street from all the major shops and also a place to get some work done. The best of both worlds!

The quality of the coffee is just as you would expect at a Starbucks and the customer service was speedy and friendly!

So, I normally go to another Starbucks location...but I could see this location quickly becoming another fave!
