Cashier lady with lazy eye had an attitude and kept getting my order wrong and getting mad at me at it me for it everytime

Why are they almost always out of ice and whipped cream??? I don't understand it's a huge stable for the type of coffee they serve. Appearance and taste.... the staff is rude 4 out of 5 days a week and they only get our drinks right 3 of those 5 days but it happens.. it's just very disappointing when they don't have ice or whipped cream or toppings for the specialty drinks... I don't like paying $5 a coffee if it's made right

Quick breakfast before boarding our flight. 

Everyone had on gloves and masks to serve customers quickly. I don't drink coffee, but they have many favors to choose from. I had an egg sandwich with lemonade and my husband and son had eggs, cheese and bacon sandwich. 

We will return soon.

I come to this Starbucks pretty often and 3/5 times I get great service. But this most recent time I ordered a strawberry acai with lemonade and received ice with a little bit of my drink. I asked the barista if they could make it with light ice, and not only did I get a bit of an annoyed face, but the second drink I got had just as much ice. Was not very happy after that visit :/

please read this especially the manager !!!! this place has absolutely no organization at all!!!!! they do not have enough staff probably because the pwner doesn't want to pay anyone i ahev never taken the time to write a bad review in my life but this is just unacceptable. corporate needs to grt notified of this place asap its a drive thru it should not take 40 minutes to go through hire more employees or close down!!!

Just had a 25 minute waiting experience inside. We went inside because the drive-thru line was backed up onto Westshore. We waited so long and were going to be late for work that we decided to get a refund. We waited in line for that and then at the last minute thought our drinks were next to be made so we decided to wait for our drinks. Ended up being inside just over 25 minutes. What's wrong with you, Starbucks? Hire more people. Expand your facilities. Open up a second location across the street or down the block. Or have a sign that says "your anticipated wait time is 25 minutes."

I've lived in Center City for a few years and have been to my share of Starbucks, I tend to go to the ones where my business is most appreciated and where I feel the most welcome.  

When I first moved here, I came to this Starbucks all the time, and I really loved it.  Then, as national news revealed, there was the racial police incident here last year, interestingly enough, I went briefly in and out of this Starbucks on this day, while it happened, looking back on it, I can't believe that an ordinary day for myself turned out to be a huge news controversy.

I admit that after the incident here, I was very hesitant to come back, but I could tell that over time, the employees tried harder and the tension seemed to ease.  They've remodeled the interior of this Starbucks multiple times and now it actually looks the most well decorated Starbucks in the area!  The tables, seating and wall decor are all newly refurbished.  It's so busy and popular here that I often can't find a place to sit and eat!  I'm really glad that this Starbucks has bounced back from that incident.  I used to come here all the time with friends and I really enjoyed it.  The other day, I ran into my friend here and it felt like the warm, cozy old Starbucks again, which really makes me happy.  Sometimes life comes full circle.

I will probably be a Starbucks patron, well, Gold member for a long time.  I do enjoy many indie coffee shops and multiple Starbucks, you can pretty much always find me at a coffee shop throughout the city, and I enjoy coming here.

OK place to stop in when walking over to Harbour island.  Pet friendly patio with a large water bowl for you fur babies.  Staff was fine but they could not honor my Starbucks rewards.  Not sure if that is a one time thing or all the time.  There is another coffee place by the docks with bakery and gelato .  They give Starbucks a run for location and sweets.
Literally some of nicest people I've ever met. They go above and beyond every time. The drinks are great as well. The overall experience is awesome and I'm glad they are my neighborhood Starbucks!
This is the best cafe Starbucks has to offer.  Great baristas, lots of seating and they have and indoor / outdoor fireplace.

I've never had a good experience with this location for some reason it's by far the longest I've had to wait in line on multiple occasions which means they're for sure shorthanded for the amount of traffic they get, I've dealt with so many of the staff giving me attitude for that reason and not because of anything I did but because they're all stressed?! Starbucks needs to do better, hire more employees or pay your workers more so they could stop being so miserable while working!

I just left this location, the service was not friendly at all. We stood there for five minutes with staff right in front of us without so much as any acknowledgement. When the young lady came over, not so much as a smile or any form of pleasantry. The caramel grande latte had no flavor, none of the brûlée topping at all. Just will not be back.

This is a high volume tiny Starbucks.  

The staff is friendly and they do a good job of making sure the endless line keeps moving. It can take a bit of time to get your drink since it's so crowded but there is plenty of seating around the kiosk, so you can sit while you wait for your drink. You can also use the Starbucks app here. 

It would be better if they were able to expand and open a storefront to better accommodate the crowd.

All in all, it's a nice place for a shopping coffee-break.

Location is very convenient and my drinks always taste super yummy. Usually the baristas are friendly, but I wasn't totally crazy about my experience the last time I was in - however, it's only a minor complaint! Overall, I really love this location. AND! Their remodel is absolutely fantastic. The new driveway is so much better than it used to be and the inside of this location is gorgeous!

Anywho, I went in on the day the reusable holiday cups came out. They were supposedly giving one away for free to everyone who ordered a holiday drink. I ordered two and got no cup. They had them on the counters but weren't handing them to any customers that were inside... I tend to be very passive and I hate to complain, so I didn't say anything about it. It's my weakness... I know, working on it. 

I later heard from an employee that happens to live in my neighborhood that that should NOT have been the case and that everyone should've been given one. But, I'm not one of those people who go nuts over Starbucks cups. I was happy to get a yummy coffee out of my visit and will definitely be back!!

Nice upgrade on the remodel but I think the staff needs more training. I was charged double for an iced coffee. As I'm watching my drink be made he pours cold brew instead of coffee. Leaves the cold brew pouring since it's on tap and starts talking to other staff. It continued to over pour for about a minute before I started to say something to him. He makes the drink again with cold brew and calls my name. I informed him I wanted iced coffee not cold brew and he informed me they are out. Would have been nice to know when I ordered. And was still charged double for iced coffee and not cold brew. Will be saving my time and money and never returning.
Perfect and convenient for my long days at school. Towards the end of the night they give discounts on good and coffee.

Clean!  Fast! Friendly. Typical Starbucks. Crowded seating. 

One rude dude there making all kinds of racket and banging chairs around. 

Other than that...good.
Landon is a fantastic barista not to mention an AWESOME DANCER!! Great performance after a long, long flight!!!

This Starbucks gets my order correct 9 times out of 10 which is great, but, this is by far the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. I've gone to this one fairly regularly since they opened and my experience is always the same. When the drive through is busy you could wait as long as 30 minutes from ordering to actually getting to the window. Going inside does not make too much of a difference either. This is NOT to say that the staff is slow, they are always working and moving as fast as possible. The problem is that they do not have enough staff or kitchen space to keep up with the volume of patrons. My recommendation: put in a mobile order before you leave your house and it might be ready by the time you get there.

Very lazy employees! Arrived at quarter till closing my daughter walked in and they proceeded to make up their own hours and tell her they were closed although on the website and the other Starbucks was open. Very disappointed!!

It is nice that they adhere to COVID rules however they tend to be discriminatory at this location. On Sept 10th I stopped for a coffee and had mask on However because it slipped slightly to tip of nose the server made an issue of it and gave me a hard time about it. My face was covered as far as I was concerned. As I was waiting for my drink a young bearded man passed behind me NO mask on went outside and came back in Still no mask. As I picked up drink the same server told him to please put mask or he would have to leave. He continued to use his computer , Mind you No Food No drink. He ignored her and she did nothing As I was leave a young girl in the back corner also sported no mask. Sorry I didn't get to take a picture No more Starbucks for me

Seriously awful service - literally the worst experience I've ever had at a Starbucks, a company that (at least I thought) prided itelf on positive customer engagement and friendly service. I went to this location to pickup just a basic dark roast ordered in advance through the app, and after I tried to walk in at 11:50 am on a Saturday to make the pickup in store, I was abruptly and rudely confronted by a mind-numbingly unhelpful "worker" who greeted me with "We're closed!" When asked "what time do you close?" (for some reason this location closes at noon - random, but ok still doesn't explained why I can't go inside for 2 freaking seconds...what if I decided I just wanted to take a walk to Starbucks and didn't have a my car to make this pickup? Doesn't make sense why ONLY the drive-thru is only option) The worker didn't offer any assistance whatsoever and instead insisted I "get in the drive-thru" line, which was easily 10+ cars deep at this point. I asked if I could just step inside briefly and pick up my single item, since with 10 minutes to spare before they actually should be closed it would have taken me all of only 10 seconds to pickup my item off the counter (as usual) and then this would all be over, but allegedly this worker "can't get back inside" (she was confronting me in the parking like, repeating over and over again "sir, we're closed", when in fact as I pointed out they were NOT closed yet) I thought this was a totally ridiculous and obvious lie that she couldn't get back inside, so I decided to just wait for one of the other customers still inside waiting to just let me in as they left - yes other customers were still inside, so clearly I think it would have been no problem if I just stepped inside for literally maybe 7 seconds FLAT just to pick up my coffee sitting there on the counter right there which I could still see through the front door (the door was locked to outside at this point of course). Eventually, a customer came out but IMMEDIATELY a Starbucks employee from inside closed the door and locked it again before I could get to the door or ask for any assistance from him! I thought: this is the absolute worst customer service I think I've ever experienced, maybe ever! SO at this point I'm force to utterly waste my time and get at the back of the round-the-building drive-thru line while multiple cars ahead of me continued to place orders in front of mine well after my simple coffee was ready and getting cold by this point no doubt. By the time I FINALLY got my coffee, after it was cold of course, I didn't even want it anymore and didn't drink it - I ended up just throwing it away! What an utterly absurd waste time and money. Easily the worst Starbucks experience I've ever had in my life. I will not be back.
Poor to mediocre customer service, half filled cup delivered to me , trash over spilling trash at entrance .... would not recommend this Starbucks.

Love Starbucks and this location. Everyone is really nice and I love sitting here for hours studying. My only gripe is the drive thru. It's completely hidden so you can't see the line before you pull in. Once you're in, even before you order, you're stuck, which is annoying when you're running late. It needs to be redesigned to allow people to get in and out in the event of an emergency or if you charge your mind, especially since there's usually a long wait. But overall, LOVE LOVE LOVE my local Starbucks!

The baristas at this location are amazing! I have a very complicated order and every single time, they always make it perfectly. They are also very patient. Also, new store manager,  Rachel, is AMAZING! Stellar crew!

There were only two people in front of me in line, yet somebow I waited 30 minutes for a medicine ball tea. I watched the girl behind the counter plod along and leisurely make drinks. She was as slow and docile as a hindu calf, and it was kind of mesmerizing seeing how long just pouring a pre-made cold brew into a glass could take her. Eventually I had to speak up and ask for my food, because it was sitting on the counter getting cold while our peaceful friend was organizing the cups by size.

She must have noticed something wasn't quite up to par because she said very condescendingly to us plebeians that they were understaffed, sorry about the wait, we're all trying our best. We can't possibly know the stress the service industry is going through was the undertone there as she lifted her eyebrow at me.

I'm a former kitchen manager though - that line doesn't work when I can clearly watch you perform.  Maybe try some espresso before your next shift, I hear it's supposed to give you energy.

I love Starbucks and must have been to well over 150 locations all across the country and this is probably my least favorite location. I'm only giving it two stars just because of he name. 

First off this location is always packed.  A little too packed. I can never get a seat. Also I'm pretty sure there is a homeless shelter near by or something because I've been here 5 times and usually see people talking to themselves in the patio or hanging out around the location and have been asked for money on a few occasions.  Just makes the overall feel of this Starbucks just a little off. 

Also the bathrooms are always dirty and the super station is filthy. I don't know why I keep coming back here? Probably based on location only. I complain about this location on each visit!  I think I'm finally done though and will drive a little extra to avoid this location.

Amazing customer service. Went to the drive through and a spotted lanternfly flew into my car and one of the employees came out to kill it for me because I don't do well with killing bugs. He went above and beyond and I was so impressed with how kind they were. Good thing I can laugh about it now but so thankful for the dedicated employees here! My drink was amazing too!

I just picked up my mobile order from this Starbucks and I had an excellent experience so I wanted to make sure to leave this rating. 
I usually drink blonde espresso but, I ordered regular espresso in my drink by accident. The lady at the drive thru told me they were happy to remake it and told her don't worry, because it was my mistake. She was adamant that I get the drink I wanted so with a long line of cars behind me, she had my drink remade quickly. 
In my eyes they did not have to do that since I ordered incorrectly. But this truly was exceptional customer sevice in my book (and I used to work for Nordstrom if that tells you what level of customer service I'm used to getting/giving). 
Again, it was a small thing that really made difference. I will probably make this my new "regular" Starbucks just because of this one act. Thank you Starbucks

The barista was friendly and efficient.  My Americano was made properly.  I was able to use reward points to purchase my beverage.  My issue is when I went up for my refill I was told that they do not provide refills (not even with a $0.50 nuisance charge).

It seems like more and more Starbucks are not honoring refills. Certainly in my area.  This a loyalty program. It works two ways.  I purchase and Starbucks rewards...  You know; a quid pro quo!  Where is the quo?

Ok, a franchisee can do what they want.  Starbucks should at least make them post a sign and list this on the web app so we can decide not make the trip if we don't like the limitations.  Used to be if they redeem rewards, they provide all benefits.  No more.

There are some interesting coffee shops nearby.  I will try them out.  Starbucks is not a discount chain.  Without the rewards, I will give my business to independent shops.  It seems that is the only way to fight back.

I really hate this Starbucks.
My drink is always wrong.
Drive thru takes 40 minutes on average. 
Inside takes 20 minutes. 
Employees are always laughing, like excuse me, just make my drink, I don't care if you're happy. 
But it's the only one on the south side so I don't boycott like I should. 
(Angsty sigh)

Ordered a venti coffee and it was super burnt. I tried diluting it with half&half & even had to pour some out. Made no difference. Also asked for sweetened tea and it was barely sweetened. Staff was nice, but the side bar was messy & gross.

The folks at this store always do an awesome job with their drinks, and they've always been really nice and friendly with me. Couldn't recommend this Starbucks more--they even move through large lines fast.

Most recently, I went in for my birthday and they went above and beyond to be nice and make the day feel a little more special. Stellar job!

Love this location! Was my go-to when staying in Nashville a few weeks ago since it was walking distance. Always greeted when I walked in and felt welcomed. The barista Kourt (I think is her name) was really nice and awesome, and made my drink perfectly and promptly! Even had a small conversation with her about Nashville since I'm not from the area. Keep up the good work!

Went to this location for morning coffee, had a gift card that was purchased from the grocery store that I was going to use, turns out it wasn't activated by the grocery store! They graciously gave me my coffee anyway, was very thankful for the sweet morning boost!

From having a wonderful anniversary weekend with hubby to a coffee experience that felt shitty from the time they said "next in line". Ugh! Ordered the norm for us, white mocha and tea, Impossible Breakfast Sandwich, and croissant. After 10 min, they tell us they have no Impossible meat left. WE ALREADY GOT THE DRINKS!!!! Ugh! 

The barista was not inviting. I felt rushed. She took my husbands order before I could get out "croissant please?" Jeez! Poor customer service. People don't get we've been thru hell the past year. Kindness is always accepted and reciprocated. J/s

Another customer service fail today...I came thru on a Sunday morning around 11am to treat my auntie to a coffee and breakfast sandwhich as she was arriving from a long, overnight drive from Mexico. We walked into the establishment because the drive thru line was super long as usual. We walked up to the counter to order and weren't acknowledged for 3-5 minutes. Once we placed our order and stepped aside to wait, I observed a young man walk in with his young son. They stepped up to order and was immediately acknowledged by a barista that previously ignored me. I don't know why I continue to get shoddy service but of course, since Starbucks is my guilty pleasure, I will return.
One would think that this Starbucks would have someone working the counter on a Sunday morning at 8 am. Absolutely no one. Lost a sale and a customer.

If it ain't broke, don't fix it!! If it's broke fix it ASAP. Waited 18 min for a tall Americano, about 15min to long. Absolutely no efficiency to get their customers a cup of coffee. I finally walked out empty handed after 4 people came in after me and left with their orders. Worst customer service but then again it's Starbucks. If your time is valuable, Don't waste it going here.

Came here to study for final exam at 7. Found a table for the group that was coming to study with me. Then an employee comes to tell me that I need to move because a regular customer that is handicapped is here and this is their sit. I didn't have a problem until I seen this y'all women who was not not in a wheelchair or with a cane come sit at the table i got here early to find. I was made to outside because all the other tables the would fit my group where taken. I will not come to this one again but as a paying customer I shouldn't have been told go outside. Only rating it a 1 cause i have
This sounds silly, but I LOVE this Starbucks!  The people that work there are super nice and when I open the door to leave I always think to myself, "well, what a nice day."

I know this one is as good as it gets, because it's just about in my backyard! I was stoked when it finally opened and even happier to know that it had a great drive through.
 Although still in training the baristas  here know their stuff and are smiles all day long. they treat the customers like gold and that is huge in my books for any business!
 The interior of this place is a bit of an oddball with old wooden doors turned into a wall. Not what I would do with them but I do appreciate the attempt to recycle. Actually, it's a real conversation starter! 
 Stop by and enjoy, give me a ring so I can join you ;-)
The franchise owner of this location has decided to no longer to take cash. I wonder if he will realize that that's a terrible discriminatory act.....

My recent experiences here have been awful. This location used to be my favorite, but now I need to be VERY careful with what I order or else I'll get a cup of sweet milk. 

Today I ordered a triple white chocolate mocha (3 shots of espresso) and this is what they gave me. Guess they forgot to add the shots in because what I got was a cup of milk with mocha syrup. I paid $6 for something that I poured down the drain as soon as I got home. 

I ordered an iced green tea latte with EXTRA matcha a few weeks ago, and half of it was foam. Also, the line is always 20 minutes long too, so you need to schedule your day around your coffee run.

The worst experience ever. The music is extremely loud for a coffee shop. When asked to lower the music they said the speaker was "broken" and the music could not be lowered or turned off per the managers order. I feel like I'm at a nightclub at 11am.

Slow, rude, and unprofessional. I have never been to a Starbucks like this, and I have been to them all over the world.

I went to this one because the one further south messed up my order three days in a row...but this one was stunningly worse.

I watched the guy make a latte wrong and when I pointed it out he refused to fix it...gave me a threatening look. I can't even imagine what sort of bugs that live in his dreadlocks had fallen into my drink.

The poor wimpy manager was so threatened by the barista that he looked like he wanted help before he got beat up by his employee.

There must be something wrong with their regional management...given they are always out of things, have pervasive bad attitudes, and make so many mistakes at all the Nashville area Starbucks.

Certainly will be looking for alternatives when visiting Nashville.

We probably have like 10 other Starbucks that are closer to our house than this location, but now I will only go to this location. It takes about 15 minutes to get to here, we live in Plymouth meeting, but it's worth it. 

Every other Starbucks I've been to they either forget the whipped cream or some drizzle or toppings that's supposed to be on my drink, or get the drink messed up, or it tasted watered down. This location gets my orders right most of the time, I think there might have been one time they forgot a drizzle but it was only that once. We also always do the mobile ordering when we come here. It's always ready when we arrive. The drinks taste balanced and not watered down. 

They also have the food items stocked pretty good. Other locations either run out of items or items I want aren't available. This location always has the random items that I like to get there, like the sugar plum danish or the sous vide egg bites.

I seriously don't understand why this Starbucks has SUCH bad reviews. Obviously a bunch of rushed, cranky people.
If you want your coffee fast, go elsewhere. Starbucks Drive-Thrus ALWAYS take a long time, especially when you have people ordering frappuccinos. Those that a long time to make, as do lattes and machiattos. So if you're in a rush, it makes more sense to go inside. Otherwise, be patient with the baristas. 
This is still a newer Starbucks, so they're still learning. But I've yet to have a drink done wrong like I've had done at the Neshaminy Starbucks numerous times.

Lots of cross contamination occurring at the Tampa, FL Airport Gate C39 location. Ordered a non dairy drink and watched my drink be made  with the same container used to steam the milk without being rinsed beforehand. Once your drink is handed off they run away not giving you an opportunity to express any concern or any further requests. One employee had a nasty attitude and if you aren't willing to be pleasant & attentive don't work in an industry where you are expected to interact.

I've had good experiences at this Starbucks. Pretty hard to screw up an iced black coffee or an iced blonde americano. The service here has always been great and all of my online orders have been fulfilled on time. 

The following comment has no impact on rating -  They just did a complete remodel of the inside but I am not a huge fan of the two huge tables in the middle of the store.

Overall, I don't have any major issues with this place.

The worst Starbucks in America. They screw up, you tell them and they just say girl bye. I pay $14 a day here on a coffee and a coffee cake. Why is extra ice and a warm cake so fricken hard for these people!!!?!

Drive-thru generally has been a positive experience. However, the baristas inside can be be sassy, rude and unprofessional. I suggest finding others alternatives. As the customer, when I check up on a mobile order 25 minutes after it's been placed (and 15 minutes after the app says it ready), it never feels good when you're shunned at the register/publicly embarrassed when all you're trying to do is get a status check.
Racism is alive and well at Starbucks! Boycott Starbucks!

America's best coffee delivered at debilitating speed. If you're in any rush, skip this place. Starbucks has a set of standard operating procedures but the humans running this joint are extra hindered for no obvious reason. 

Lesson learned.

This is the third time I have done a mobile order and my order was not ready, which is no big deal but never does an employee greet you or ask if you are waiting for a mobile order. This again would be understandable if they were short staffed but today I counted 6 employees behind the counter. I often have to get one of their attention and wait 10-15mins for a mobile order. Just very disorganized and doesn't seem up to par to the systematic structure of other Starbucks locations. Go to the one in Burlington or Mt Laurel, it will be worth the drive.
I have gotten Starbucks every morning for the past couple years and after being served from the young man at the window today, I will not be returning to this location.

The location at 601 S Harbour Island in Tampa is awesome. Today especially so.  Always friendly and prompt, remembering repeat customer preferences after just a short time.  Most days I put in a sizable family order in person and after paying I wait maybe 1 minute, or 2 at most before it's all ready.  This allows me to handle 3 work emails before heading home.  Today I ordered, paid, and just barely had time to open email app and bam - order's ready!

And even when they recently had a system issue, they still figured out how to open and handle simple cash orders, when most other locations would have just kept the doors closed.

Great team here!!

If you know me at all then you know I could care less about going to a Starbucks. I'll pretty much go with ANY other local coffee shop in the area as long as the java doesn't blow. Unfortuantely there aren't really any choices in this area...and Starbucks is the king of convenience. 

When you're ending a 3 hour car drive from a long vacation a drive thru is pretty much the best thing you can ask for. Also, I need to point out in the most pretentious way as possible, I haven't had Starbucks in over a year. When your tired fiancè needs it, you get it. 

We stopped by cause she had a craving for a frappè. I thought I stopped playing cool and it was time to indulge my inner 13 year old girl and get a Mocha Java Chip Frappucino. A small was $5 and worth every sip. Those things are like crack. Seriously addictive. Probably from all the sugar they put in it. It wasn't anything super special but it hit the spot. The service was quick and efficient as usual. Convenience for the win!

I have to admit we were slightly scared on getting coffee. Since all of America is in the middle of a quarantine lock down, I decided I needed my coffee but took the extreme precautions to do so.

They handed me my coffee with gloves on and it made me so happy to know Starbucks is taking the time to make sure their employees are safe.
Great location always friendly and worked extra hard during all this mess going on. Always busy and they do their best to get it done. No ones perfect but they definitely try.

This is probably my favorite Starbucks to go to in Philly--and not just because they are directly across the street from my favorite fast food restaurant. The service and the drinks have always been on point and today was no different! I am not a fan of cold coffee but they offered me a sample of my favorite hot flavor cold. I tried it, but I didn't like it. Somehow, willingly drinking cold coffee seems sacrilegious. In any event, the barista had made a small one in case I liked it. Not wanting either of us to waste it, he suggested that I "bless someone who would appreciate it" and I managed to do just that. There tend to be homeless people hanging around across the street at my favorite place to eat. So, I  went across the street and approached a man with a sign and asked him if he likes iced coffee. Keep in mind, it's late July and the heat and humidity have been a bit much this year. I explained to him that they made it for me and that cold coffee just isn't my thing and offered it to him. He said he loved iced coffee and was more than willing to drink it. I gave it to him. I felt much better knowing that it wasn't going to waste, because, well, wasting Starbucks is just wrong. I also feel good knowing that we did something good for someone in need. This was a good trip!

I recently started going here vs the regular Starbucks where I was going.  

For the most part, I have been very pleased.  The baristas and managers have been very pleasant and friendly.  It's not as big of a store compared to where I was going before, which is more relaxed, the music is softer and the loud music was a real gripe of mine at another Starbucks.  The only downside about the smaller shop is it feels like sometimes the large amount of people waiting for their food and beverages feels like they're on top of the people who are in the limited seating.  It would be nice if they had more seating but they're a smaller shop.  

For the most part, I really like this Starbucks, friendly baristas.  

There was an issue recently with an angry customer but the manager and customer service addressed it.  There are a fair amount of homeless in the area too.  

Again, I like this Starbucks for the most part, these are my thoughts.

If you enjoy really horrible, condescending service, you'll  love this location! Got lectured on how to make a Starbucks Double Shot on Ice by some 19 year old pot head snob after he made it wrong. Little did he know, I was a supervisor at Starbucks for 2 years. Other than that, it's Starbucks. You already know the rest of the story.

I visit this Starbucks frequently over the past few months because it is near my work. The customer service is what stands out in this location. A friendly greeting, and a smile from the baristas each morning really helps the day start out right. They are a great team and they probably don't know how much I appreciate them! Five Stars and hugs too.
Terrible service and no sense of urgency for the employees. A coffee took almost 30 minutes to get with four workers at the time. A lot of frustrated customers.

I like going to this location even when the drive-through lines look long they seem to go pretty fast once I'm in it they usually have what I'm looking for I think I've only been there once where as they did not have the dark caramel for the caramel ribbon crunch drink I was looking to order other than that the staff is kind and very helpful whether I'm going inside or pulling up to the window.

Man, reading some of these reviews, I feel badly for the baristas. They must have to put up with a lot since the store's right next to Rittenhouse Square.

Anyway, this is a perfectly fine Starbucks with perfectly fine service for a Starbucks. If you're feeling on edge, maybe go somewhere else because, well, this is a Starbucks and you're not going to be waited on hand-and-foot, but I found the baristas here to be perfectly pleasant despite a rush, so it's a 5-star review from me.
I frequent this location often and Kingston is always there making sure my order is right with a smile!! Hope to see him promoted soon within the organization.

This is my daily stop. My singular complaint is this:  there is one barista who is most unfriendly. He never greets you, never says "thanks" or have a great day. He shoves your items through the window and immediately turns away as if he has better things to do. Didn't catch a name, but he's a tall man, close shaved (or possibly bald) head. Someone needs to teach him what good customer service looks like. Every other person at this location is upbeat and friendly...except for him.

I'm really glad this Starbucks opened up on Harbour Island, long overdue!
We can now have coffees and teas and custom beverages at standard Starbucks prices and right near American social and Jackson's! 

It's a pretty standard Starbucks with points available for collection (not redemption), same high quality beverages and usually carries the seasonal specials. One of the great things about this Starbucks over some of the others in South Tampa is this one isn't that busy and it has ample electrical outlets available. Almost every seat has charging. It is well kept, staff are friendly and seating is comfortable. 

There is however negatives too- you can park in the paid parking, and get your parking validated here (for free), but that makes parking a little inconvenient. It also closes a little early for a regular Starbucks (read 8pm). The biggest negative is they don't allow you to use Starbucks reward points. You can collect them but can not redeem them here. So it kind of eliminates the use of points if you only come here for your Starbucks.

This is my morning go-to! The staff is awesome and go out of their way to greet you and remember your name. It gets super busy in the morning, so I recommend mobile ordering. Give yourself 8-10 minutes and by the time you get there, your caffeinated deliciousness will be waiting for you. Only con? The parking lot is miserable in the morning. Super super busy!

Slowest airport starbucks.

I dont know if they're shorthanded.. but they are slow.  If your baristas cant keep up in a high volume location, get new people or more help.  Pathetic.

The numerous times I have been here the drinks have never been right. It's upsetting because it is such a convenient location. My cold brew didn't even have ice one time and the cold foam is never made correctly!

I'm just going to have to join everyone here. This place doesn't hold up to the rest. I like my drinks a certain way but every time I order here they always like to make their "suggestions" for my drink. And when I say no, I end up getting a drink with their suggestions. Does anyone listen here?
Best Starbucks in South Tampa. Staff are always cheerful and amazing. They always make my white mocha perfectly. Love this Starbucks.

5 Stars because I love their morning staff! Denise is absolutely fabulous. I am always amazed how she knows so many people's names AND their orders.

If you're looking for a Starbucks in Center City - definitely check out this one!

We've all been to Starbucks- 
So there's that, today with my reusable cup I got a Dragonfruit refresher. 

Cashier could of wanted to work a little bit more, however the young lady making the drink was very friendly and I was Pleasantly surprised how good it was.  Wish they didn't cost $6 bucks - 
But don't we all.  
I'll certainly get it again soon.

Drive thru review.  Fast line and girl at the window was very nice and smiled. I get the usual on ice since it has fewer calories.  Parking was packed so I had a bit of trouble parking to do this review! Happy coffee!

ok so when i go to this Starbucks, on occasion, bonus points because I use the stairs and not the escalator - i feel welcome right away.  The little cart/stand underground just has a certain positive energy for me. 
Anyway - my drinks always seem to be right, and delicious, and fairly quick for  a busy location.  Twice i was there and DeAsia heped me out - her warm smile and happy demeanor was enough to make my entire day!!   
FYI- its kinda small because its just a little coffee stop but it is in a great location and always well staffed.  The staff is always pleasant and accommodating.  

i will always come back here when i am around the area.

Long lines...not a shocker!  Organized and fast service...impressive! This store at the heart of the mall does a great job moving the line and the orders accurate and organized.  I was also impressed that the staff was on top of keeping the supplies stocked and area clean.  I ordered a Vanilla Skinny Latte...delicious :) and a Passion Tea with two splenda.  For those that have not tried this tea, it will not disappoint.  If you are looking for your caffeine fix and want fast service this Starbucks is a great choice!

This Starbucks is always busy and the employees have no sense or urgency. I imagine they are burned out and that is completely understandable. The coffee is always mediocre and more often than not my order was wrong anyway. Do yourself a favor and walk down to the Nordstrom eBar for a much better experience.

Despite this being in a terrible smelly location, I've actually had some of the best service here. Everyone who works there is SO super friendly and so informative. It feels like I've known them forever and I'm definitely not a regular. They are so helpful and so up to date with their products its almost mind blowing. Very friendly staff. Clean and quick as well.
Good customer service I went in yesterday Sunday the 26 and Tatiana made us feel very welcome !

This is the best by far coffee place I've been to .i love the taste of everything in there.their pink drink is one of the best refreshers they sell.all of the food is good and all of the staff are very nice and friendly.no matter what type of line they have then tend to get out drinks fast .liked Dunkin' donuts before but know I believe there is no other better place to go than Starbucks.

I'm not really a coffee drinker and I usually only come over here for the green tea frappe ; my last visit it seems like the flavor somewhat lacked like if they really don't get people who ordered my drink of choice. I guess if I were more of a coffee drinker and I would have more to say about this place but since I'm not I can give it three stars not too bad.

I had the chance to meet a lady by the name of Leilani and the team this afternoon at the Glenwood Store. "i visit this Starbucks frequently over the past few months because it is near my work. The customer service is what stands out in this location. A friendly greeting, and a smile from the baristas each morning really helps the day start out right. "

Location is incredibly busy. Drive thru was at least 10 cars long so I went in.

What wonderful and happy baristas. Not much more to say because well, it's Starbucks.

I'm not sure what the problem is with getting their drive-thru running efficiently but this is the last time I'll stop in the afternoon because after 3-4 times of spending 20+ min in a 4-5 car line should not take that long. I remember this Starbucks used to be one of the most aesthetically pleasing locations I've ever been to. It was always so cozy and cheery during the holidays. With the new remodeling it now feels more like a hospital cafeteria. It's like they purposely tried to make it unappealing. Whatever floats your boat I guess, but I try to avoid it the best I can...

I gotta give a shout-out to my favorite Starbucks location. Staff are very friendly and have been very accommodating during the pandemic. I always leave here feeling satisfied and well taken care of by your staff.
The staff here is always so sweet and positive! They deserve raises. I haven't had a long wait here either. Love this Starbucks.

The music was so loud, it was high energy pop/rap for the entire 1.5 hours I was there (and some of it was explicit). I'm in my early 30's, so that stuff isn't going to bother me very much. I'm giving 2 stars because the service was nice. But the typical coffee shop ambiance was was terrible, and I saw people start off sitting inside and then move outside so they could even have a conversation. The only reason I didn't leave sooner is because I was dropped off and didn't have a car. I love Starbucks, and I have frequented many all over the states, but this was the worst experience I've had thus far.

Many of the workers are extremely pleasant. I've seen other stores solve these problems by doing such simple things as relegate one pot for black tea, watch the timer so the coffee doesn't get burned, instead of using the squirt rinser every now and then actually wipe the mixing containers clean. So far this store does not live up to Starbucks reputation.

Now that I've vented I'm off to Dunkin' donuts where they brew the iced tea bags fresh. Also the coffee is fresh in the morning. Not to mention it's less expensive. 

YMMV.
Friendly staff, never a long wait, and always make my drinks correctly. If they mess up, they apologize profusely! Love this location.

Don't be in a hurry if you pull through this "new" drive thru location. I think it was faster when they were in the plaza. The service has been SLOW on my first 2 trips through the drive thru. Watching the male employee in the background dance didn't impress me while I waited at the window. Both trips I had to remind them that they shouldn't have charged me for Almond milk in iced coffee.

One of my favorite Starbucks around. Lots of parking, lots of places to sit (especially outside) and love the leather chairs and fireplace inside! The baristas are always friendly, shockingly unlike some other Starbucks. Always clean too!

A Starbucks with PLENTY of outlets and seating!

Ample bar seating with an outlet for each seat, larger tables towards the back with outlets as well.

Cheap, quick eateries all around if you need a break from your work: Maoz, Chipotle, Jake's, Rice & Mix, Marabella, etc..

There was a weird group of staff today, one that talked about philosophers and the other, who put lime in my drink with her bare hands. 

Other than that, a standard Starbucks catered soley to the student.

They're always really busy but handle it so well; service is amazing no matter how crazy it gets. The whole staff
Is doing a phenomenal job, I come here almost daily!!

I have always said I didn't like Starbucks; the coffee is too bitter and I never know what to order. This morning, I was rushed out of the house due to my alarm being set an hour later than it should've been. I told the barista I wanted a minute to think and then that I wanted advice on how to get the sweetest coffee. He was extremely patient with me and told me his opinion, which I took. When I got to the window he told me to try it before I left to make sure I liked it and it was sweet enough. To my surprise, it was perfect. This barista (His name was either Erin or Devin) was so kind and personable, he made my morning so much better. He even printed out a second receipt for me so I would know what to order in the future. Personally, good customer service is my "make it or break it" with most restaurants, being someone who worked in the food business for over 2 years. He is the reason I will now be returning to Starbucks frequently. Thank you!
They always run out of items! Line is super long! Wish they open up another star bucks around there so the amount of traffic at drive through can be split in two!

This location is inside the mall across from the food court. If you enter via the BJ's entrance, it's located basically right outside of BJ's. They currently don't have seating available, however you could get your drink and walk around the mall or go sit in the food court area.  Drinks are always good and staff is typically always very friendly and welcoming.

Literally the beast Starbucks on earth... the coffee is always on point as is the customer service. Big shoutout to Kelly who has the best smile, always happy. When I go through the drive through I feel at home. This is the place to be.

One of the nicer Starbucks in the West Chester area.  This place gets fairly busy and seating is limited, but the barista's all work very fast.  I find service to be great, and drinks to be consistently made.  A good choice for a local Starbucks!

This Starbucks is amazing. I accidentally submitted my mobile order to the eagle and chinden store and they didn't even hesitate to remake my drink at their store. Super nice and helpful. Friendly. Would recommend and will be the only store I go to!
Seemed to have gotten better. Friendly much more efficient staff. Go in there daily

How I felt about this Starbucks; divisive. 

The good: nice location in the mall area. Social Distancing of the customer lineup as well as the dining area, the drinks, customer service and cleanliness of the bathroom; right as rain.

The bad / Ugly: the flow of the orders. I mean, Groups of orders weren't given together but separate, patrons who were waiting longer than other patrons had to watch as patrons with shorter orders received theirs quicker. Busy yes, but I know Starbucks can do better than that...maybe it was just a bad day but still...! 

Just stating what I saw was obvious.

The products and customer service here is fantastic. However the location, drive-thru, and overall access is rough. The parking lot is really tight and the drive thru gives you almost no room for error with a really sharp turn. It's not my favorite to visit in the area. With one location on Trooper, another a Target, and another location opening on Ridge, this one is convenient for stopping by before you hop on 422. 

That all being said, the employees here are super nice, very community forward, and the food/beverage never disappoint.

Only open for mobile orders and take out in August 2021.  Masks are required, but this is the only place in New Orleans where I did not have to show proof of vaccine or a negative COVID-19 test within 72 hours.  It was not busy either time we went (both weekday afternoons) so no waiting.  Our orders were filled as expected and we received the same Starbucks taste and service given nationwide.

It was 9pm.
My 6 yrs old wants cookies.
The told us we are close and not taking any costumer. We where the last costumer and I explained  we onky want cookie for my daughter 
They still refuse to help.

Bad costumer service

This location is brand new, has a drive-thru, & the baristas are all super sweet! I've been here a few times already and my chai latte is always made perfectly by friendly and upbeat employees. Many have different options, my reason for not returning is that they don't make great Frappuccino. It may be my bad luck, but not going back. I rather drive 2 more miles. Great friendly attitude!

I'm really frustrated that they give you the option to order on the mobile app and pick up in store and then they post signs on the door saying you have to go through drive thru. This has happened multiple times. And anyone who goes here knows that the drive thru is crazy long. I always order 30 minutes ahead because I know it will take forever. I enjoyed the experience of visiting this Starbucks in New Orleans on canal street. It was spacious, surprisingly clean, well decorated with plenty of seating. The employees were professional and trained to do their one job. At the end of the day, I found myself unwinding while taking advantage of the scenery and sipping on a hot minty Medicine Ball.

I'm actually shocked that this Starbucks has a three star average. This is the Starbucks I go to very often since having two children and I think it's great. I would like to drink local more often, but again with two children I can't over emphasize the benefits of having a drive-through. So for the time being all my money is going to Starbucks. I find that it moves very fast. There have been times that I look at the line and think do I really need my coffee but I'm always reminded about how quickly it goes because the answer is yes, I always need my coffee.

My favorite is the salted caramel cold brew. I love salted caramel and it's the right amount of sweetness. The employees are always super friendly and I've never spoken with anyone who seems to be having a bad day. My son loves the cake pops. They don't always have all of them, one time they didn't have the cookie dough cake pop so we had to pivot to a chocolate one. Luckily he's too young to understand that it didn't have the one that he wanted.

It's quick the people are friendly and the drinks are always the same. What more do you want?

Your experience here might be different from mine. But here's what happened to me. Ordered a regular old pike place drip coffee though the app and the workers here never called my name. Stood there for 20 minutes while others got theirs. Workers never thought to ask me what o needed. My coffee had been sitting at the pickup counter the whole time I was there. Are the workers blind to that? The coffee was cold by the time I got it. I had to stand in line to get to the register to ask for my coffee. Then there was no cream a sweetener. The workers didn't ask if I wanted some. I would avoid this Starbucks if I was you, or be ready to make yourself noticed in here because none of the workers here apparently are trained to notice a drink just sitting there and a customer standing there. Seriously.
If you have a gold card, be prepared for them to give you a hard time about what you are authorized. This place is good at telling you what you can't have

If you find yourself buying several Starbucks drinks weekly and especially if you have the app you should know this is your typical starbucks (always busy both inside and drive thru). This location has been around for 10+ years. I've been buying coffee and fraps from this spot since I was a sophomore in high school. Fast forward 12 years later and there is a completely new crew. I hardly see the same barista after 3 months. 

Anywho, down to the drinks! My favorites are the hot and cold mochas, holidays drinks (all of them but especially the PSL and peppermint mocha), frappaccinos of course, and lastly their teas which are super tasty! Since there is always a new barista, your drink may taste a little different from time to time but 80% of the time, they get my order correct and if you are unhappy with it, they can remake it. A lot of times they will run out of the holiday syrups but that's to be expected because they are so dang popular. 

I will continue to be a loyal customer to this location.
I'm not amused. The people behind me are getting there orders first. How hard is it to get a vanilla sweet cream cold brew and a cookie? At least 6 employees and they are all clueless.

This is not my favorite Starbucks.  We go here because it's convenient and close by; however, my coffee always tastes bad.  Burn or just plain bitter.  It's super annoying that they don't have stir sticks, sweetener packets, or creamer around for over a year and half now.  I always feel like I'm annoying them when I have to ask for one of those items to complete my coffee.  This Starbucks feels cold and somewhat uninviting.  I've never been in the restroom but I can imagine how it looks considering I've seen the other Starbucks' bathrooms (terrible).

A fairly new Starbucks that's still working out the kinks but it's nice to finally have a Starbucks option in the Pennsport neighborhood of South Philadelphia. 

The service is friendly and the location is convenient but just be advised it's located within a Target store.

People, I've never seen a more professional cafe where you can effortlessly study with friends or other tutors or whoever the case may be. Where the seating is absolutely wonderful.
Now, Starbucks is slightly pricey but honestly the food and drinks are absolutely worth it. I'm not a tea person but I am in fact a coffee person and Starbucks has never failed to impress me. Honestly, I've never been disappointed once when I've gotten Starbucks.
Do I get it regularly? No, I don't have Starbucks that often but if I didn't have this tremor, I would be going every morning. :)
It's absolutely phenomenal. They have cake pops, they have sandwiches, they have Mac and cheese, they have coffee, they have pastries. They sell so much delightful foods and drinks and I have some stories regarding them. But I think I should go over a few negatives regarding Starbucks
Number 1: Again, it's a little pricey but not to bad
Number 2: The appearance of the inside hasn't changed. You start to want something fresh and something different
Number 3: It always makes me poop
Number 4: The sizing isn't necessarily clear for children, instead of large, small and medium- its Granda, I don't remember the other ones further proving my point. 
Now let's go over this story here: I recall after being tested for COVID (my result was negative by the way) We went by the driveway and got myself a coffee just to comfort me because those tests are uncomfortable.
Lastly I'd like to mention Starbucks has one of in my opinion, the greatest drink ever. It's a coffee drink titled the s'mores coffee. From my understanding, it isn't around always but when it is, I highly recommend it.
Overall Starbucks is definitely a great place to go to!

Worst Starbucks ever.   If you are going to take up valuable airline terminal space, you better be good.    Not even worth one star.    Worst service.   Lines for 30 minutes.   Horrible staff.   Avoid at all costs.

The guy messed up my order 4 times at 4 different day. First 2 time I asked for my drinks to be sweeten but never got it. The other 2 times I asked for a venti they gave me a grande.... can be some improvement.

This is my go-to Starbucks in the city. I come here A LOT and I wouldn't keep coming back if I didn't think the service and drinks were spot on.  Whether I'm just running in for a quick pick-me-up or I'm coming to hunker down for a few hours and study upstairs, it's always a great experience.  It's also nice when you're on a first name basis with one of the employees. :) Anyway, everything I order comes out relatively fast and tastes great and I love the decor/ambience (and the fact that there's an upstairs). I love this Starbucks!

Worst customer service ever. I made a mobile order for a drink , a bag of ground espresso and a sandwich . Something happened when I placed my order and the sandwich was removed . I stopped by while I was waiting for a flight arrival at tpa .My coffee was perfect.  The attendant fulfilled my request as asked . I would visit again

The people there are really nice! They do more often than not mess up my order. Crazy busy on this Saturday morning and out of quite a few things. Seemed short staffed and super stressed out. We used the app and still had a really long wait.
Great Starbucks experience here.  Staff was superb.  Line went quickly, paid with the app and even reloaded it.  Also, purchased gift cards for teachers.  Order was correct.

A manager rolled his eyes at me and said he didn't know what i wanted him to do when i was explaining why i was upset with something. And just to top all that off he never apologized and told me a fake name. I went in the next day and that manager on duty told me that no one by that name works there.

This Starbucks has always been there for me whenever I need a little pick-me-up in the morning before I start my shift. Its the fastest mobile ordering Starbucks around University City area. I can place a mobile order while I'm on the way to work, and bam 5'-10' later, my drink is ready for sippy sippy. Regular morning staffs are amazing and super efficient. They're giving out orders like boom boom boom, super fast UNLESS they have a new hire that requires training or something goes wrong with the mobile order system. Other than that, my coffee is always ready whenever I'm in the store to pick it up.

After morning rush hours slows down, the amount of staffs are also reduced, everything is going with a slower pace. The weekend also has fewer staffs compared to the weekdays.

The disadvantage here is that there's no parking on the street, so its very challenging for customers to stop by or even pick up with mobile order. It's only more convenient if you're visitors from the hospital or employees from the hospitals. 

Staffs are friendly. They remember your name if you're one of the frequent customers. They also make me happy whenever they greet me by name and ask how I am doing.
Horrible starbucks! The owners are assholes too. I recommend walking an extra block to the other Starbucks over the bridge.

The service was great ! It looked nice and clean. And the people working there were so nice. The drink I asked for was complicated and she by accident messed it up and had no problem at all when I asked if she can redo it. I was so satisfied with my drink so far she was the best one to make it! I WILL be going there again it was a little far from home but it was completely worth it.

Very nice Starbucks! I come here about once a week after the gym. Usually it's busy on Sundays and a lot of people go through the drive through so in store it can depend. But the shop is always staffed with a lot of people, they take the time to make the food/drinks right and fast. I appreciate that the employees care.
Today I noticed this box of kindness they have set up and I think it's such a great idea! I've never seen anything like it at any other shop before. Happy to support this initiative.

The baristas at this starbucks are so amazing! Got my coffee the other day and a barista named Matt made my grande white chocolate mocha with caramel PERFECTLY and was so kind!!! Made my day :) Loyal customer now!
Managed to mess up a vanilla sweet cream cold brew. Only place that's managed to do so.

This is a great location and lots of space to meet or work.   Today, their game was a little off. This Starbucks is the BEST one - hands down - that I have ever been in. They really care about you and customer satisfaction is a MUST for them. I've never had a bad experience there. Ariana, Cynthia, Melissa & Melissa and all the guys there are so sweet and amazing. They have my 2 drinks memorized & always remember my dairy allergy. I loveeee them. Keep up the awesome work!

I hate to be the one to criticize a Starbucks. I love Starbucks. I know its probably cooler now to NOT like Starbucks, but it made me the coffee drinker I am today so that would be unfair.

Maybe it's just something about the Starbucks tucked away inside a Target, but the fact that they don't take the Starbucks rewards (which is to say they will give you points for the drinks, but they won't redeem any of the rewards) was disappointing, and the fact that both my drink and my better halves drink were both so bland.

Still the staff was friendly, and I suppose if a fuss had been made they would have delivered on the drinks. I would say this is a Caveat Emptor Starbucks if ever there was.

This Starbucks really has gone downhill!  I try to avoid it but it's the closet one to me.  The last 3 times I've gone my order has been wrong and they've been so busy I didn't get it fixed. Your coffees aren't cheap, step up your game and give your customers what they expect!

okay-here it is- This is just about the busiest starbucks in center city on a typical weekday. why? It is located on the ground floor of a huge office building and directly across from a very large hotel and on the most highly 
trafficked street in the city. Step 1-find the tea shaker and fill w/iced tea to the first line, step  2-pump syrup, step 3-add water or lemonade, step 4-add ice, step 5-put the lid on, step 6-shake EXACTLY ten times, step 7-pour into a plastic cup and put a lid on it, step8- grab a straw and hand straw and drink off to the (angry?)customer while smiling/saying thank you and making eye contact btw, you must hand the drink off to the customer, you can't leave it on the counter and proceed to make the next drink. Most of the staff at this store do the best they can with what they have, but in times like these, would you really want to jeopardize your job to get someone a latte twenty seconds faster?

This is by far one of the best Starbucks in the northeast. But not really that many. Wish was as many as Dunkin Donuts. 

I stop in once in awile for a good strong hot cup of coffee. On pricy side. But if it's strong I'll pay it. I like there holiday frappicno in the holiday seasons. But that's about the only time I get them.

Alot of seating on the inside and out with free WiFi. I enjoy on a nice spring day sitting out side enjoying my coffee. 

It's a starbucks that can't be missed across from the airport and on the corner of grant and Academy roads. 

They can get kinda busy on weekdays early in the morning. So you are looking sometimes at about a 10 min wait. Not to bad I guess, depending on what you are ordering and how many people they have working.

They were so gracious and made my drink even though I ordered and paid for it at the other Ridge Pike store (I made the mistake on the app). I was so thankful I didn't have to drive over there or pay twice. This store makes great drinks and is always quick and clean! Thank you!!

4 baristas behind the counter and unbelievably long wait time. Only 5 people in front of me and took 10 minutes to order. What was supposed to be a quick stop at the rest stop for some coffee turned into a 30 minute ordeal.

And after going to the bathroom & writing this review, I AM STILL WAITING FOR MY COFFEE. NOT WORTH IT!!

I'm a regular at this location and the staff is always friendly and welcoming. My drinks are always made the way I like them and I'm never waiting long - even if there's a few cars ahead of me in the drive-thru. When I come in with my daughter (who's 4) they acknowledge her and treat her with the same respect they treat me, and as a parent that means the world to me.

Go here every time we visit the outdoor mall. It's busy due to its location yet I've never had any problem that the friendly staff didn't remedy. 

The outside seating is the bomb and you can let the kids play or relax in the large outdoor area and listen to live music. Lots of shopping to be had or better off, lots of chilling to do!!

If a snail or a child ran a business, this would be it. They should change the name to Starbucks the Experience, because it feels like a Disney ride. Ridiculously understaffed or just terrible group of workers. Rather go to the one in Medford, faster and cleaner too.
Shoutout to barista James!! He made me his favorite drink called "The Pink Drink" and it was amazing. I will definitely be back more often.

These 5 stars are for Juliet. She works at this store. Today she took my order with grace, made my order beautifully, and my day the best one i've ever had. She is almost as beautiful as the venti dragon drink w light ice she made me. God bless Juliet and her beautiful soul.

I hadn't been to this Starbucks location in quite some time and decided to go since it was the closest brick & mortar location. I generally stick with these locations (as opposed to one located in a Kroger, Market District or Meijer) to fully utilize my hard earned ( and in reality expensive) stars to spend 50 on a treat - specifically my favorite is the brownie. That's a tip to maximizing your stars since drinks are 150 per redemption - so dollar wise my brownie is a great deal at 50 stars for $2.75 of value. But it's hard enough to find the very delicious & popular  brownie so perhaps I shouldn't be sharing this tip? 

This location while beautiful inside is a bit challenging for parking in both amount of parking and narrowness of parking spots. There is no drive thru at this location - definitely a negative in my opinion and it's often extremely busy so there could be a long wait and no available seating. Does this sound familiar? That's really the norm at most locations but yet I am still a loyal customer. Starbucks has a lot of us hooked!

Despite chance after chance this continues to be the worst Starbucks I've been too. Incredibly slow and unorganized. Doesn't matter if you go drive-thru, mobile, or in person. Expect to be frustrated.

There is plenty of seating around the kiosk. The pastries in the case are arranged nicely every time. It looks clean. The location is ideal, as it's right in the main entryway to the mall and across from the food court.

It's an average SB store and will get the job done when you need a fix.

I've been a regular here since 2014. Like any other businesses, there are ups and down but overall this place is great! The staff are friendly and very professional. Happen to come across this location for the first time  and was beyond impressed! The baristas were awesome - so friendly and very fun. Who doesn't want a good laugh with a side of delicious drinks. :)

Starbucks is a much needed addition to this part of Delaware county.  It's hopping and with a drive thru too!  Today is bustling because it's a cheer party.  Workers are friendly and engaged with the customers.
Yes your typical Starbucks line moves fast coffee strong.  Lemon pound cake is banging as usual. I love the fact that I can prepare my own coffee to my liking. I'm a Starbucks girl.

This location has never messed up my basic order of iced coffee with cream but MAN it's slow now. It's not uncommon to wait 20 minutes in this line. I guess I'll blame it on the COVIDS‍.

This location always seem to have the least friendly and the drinks always taste very weak.  It is some what frustrating when I drive through the Starbucks to get my favorite drink to help me start the day.. and the ladies are not friendly and drinks are not just meeting the expectation. . .. not a ideal way to start the day .  I will be taking extra time and trip to avoid this location and go try other location.

Starbucks is good as always! But service is not the greatest. I have never waited in line at any other Starbucks longer than I've waited at this location. This past time my order was completely wrong, which isn't the first time I've waited 10 plus minutes to get the wrong order
