Probably the biggest Starbucks in the touristy area of New Orleans . Stop by at night to get their special New Orleans mug as a souvenir. Be prepared for a lot of homeless people, slow and Confused service, I paid for my mug and the guy forgot to give it to me and walked away. There's trash everywhere on the floor and on the condiment bar. For a upscale Starbucks they need to step this up.

I asked for a Tall Americano with half the water. If you love expresso, this is not an odd request. 
I was treated with disdain and disbelief. Questioned repeatedly, without smiles or concern that my drink was correct. 

I am a customer of this mall since 2006, and never been treated so badly at Starbucks. New Manager in place, and no one remembers the customers.

Truly the best Starbucks I have been to. They are always so sweet and understanding in there. You can tell they really care about the community with all of the programs they have going on in store. They give their grounds out for free for those who compost and have a sanitary product donation drive too. The store is always decorated for the season and has a pride flag year round. I love you market street Starbucks!

Though this is my neighborhood location, I've never ventured here until this past week. My favorite drink was made to perfection (green tea latte) and there wasn't an issue with anybody inside. Do wish they had more seating or atleast outlets. No other issues.
Maybe it was just a good day with good employees. The two girls made my Pumpkin Spice Cream Cold Brew quickly. Just wish they didn't stir the cream with the cold brew, but it is what it is.

This is really a top notch Starbucks! It's larger than most, with lots of little areas for you to hang out with friends, or just sit alone and get some work done. 

The baristas are knowledgeable, quick, and don't seem to get flustered if there's a bit of a line. There often IS, but they get through it quickly and you never have to wait long on your coffee. 

They truly care about the community as well. I work for a children's theater, and they've welcome us with open arms to bring our kids in to read scripts. 

There's a super cozy fireplace as well, and great outdoor space for the summer months. 

This Starbucks does a great job of serving you like a neighborhood coffee shop and doesn't feel like a big chain conglomerate store like some of the rest

Great service and coffee !

It's like they opened an Airport in my neighborhood coffee shop, Starbucks at the Airport, NICE !
This is a great Starbucks!  Kahlil is such a friendly barista, along with all the other employees.  There are not many other coffee shops in this area, but I'm always happy to come here.
If I could give negative stars I would, the girls that just waited on me are rude and shouldn't be in customer service. I'll never go to this location again!!!

They were efficient before students came back on campus, now it's a mess. It seems like they could use double their current number of staff. Some baristas are friendly, others are decidedly not. A better model would also help: like consistently calling the names out when orders are ready, and cycling back through names every so often of orders not picked up. My biggest gripe is that they are constantly out of almost everything. I'm talking basic things like cold brew and milk. I know Starbucks as a whole is experiencing supply chain issues, but this is way more than that. It has to be poor supply ordering, because surrounding Starbucks never have such extreme shortages. They also turn mobile order off more and more frequently. Over the past 10 days, there's been 1-2 days that mobile ordering was up and running. Some days I seriously wonder if they want to make money or not.
They have a huge line and props to the baristas here I would've lost it. Not enough staff for the amount of orders also very hot area and small.

This Starbucks is awesome!! It is the most beautiful Starbucks that I have ever been in. However, when I told them that, they humbly told me several locations worldwide that I need to visit  to really be blown away. 

They are incredibly efficient! They need to be. It is a VERY busy location. You should order ahead on your Starbucks app and walk in to pick up your order. Otherwise it could take you a considerable time to go through the drive through. You may have to park in the Freddy's parking lot because often their lot is full in addition to 10-15 cars waiting in the drive through line. This should tell you how amazing this  'Bucks rocks it. Julia is always amazing and my wife and I are looking forward to getting to know the rest of the all star cast as we are hopeless addicts to the best coffee house in the country. KEEP ROCKING WEST CHESTER!!

What can I say -- It's a Starbucks.  However, I can honestly say that they have THE NICEST drive through staff person we have ever encountered.  Hands down.  We even made a point to contact the manager to compliment her.  She's that nice.

Docked a star because getting in and outta here is really hard most days.  The parking lot is small and the drive thru can get crazy backed up making it even worse.  Check the app on your phone for hours as it appears theirs differ from surrounding stores sometimes.  However, they have yet to screw up my order here, so that's a plus.

So happy (my wallet disagrees) this Starbucks exists so close to my work! 

Yes, the line can be long during the busy morning hours and it maaay take awhile to get your order. BUT just download the Starbucks app, pre-order your complicated venti soy double shot extra foam extra hot sugar free cinnamon dolce caffe misto and it'll be ready for pick up in about 5 minutes (skipping the line!). The best part, aside from avoiding the dirty looks people behind you give when you start rattling off your drink order, is prancing from the door straight to the counter past the uninformed in line (VIP style) to pick up your perfectly made drink. 

You're welcome.

I gave myself a day to think carefully about writing this. I have been to this location several times. I can honestly say most of the staff there is pleasant to deal with. I may have a coffee addiction. That said the past few times have gone there drinks have been wrong. The manager is rude. I get anyone can have a bad day but it seems every time I go in is a bad day for her. I love location since right by my house. However I will not be returning there for coffee as long as she is there.

Everyone there is always so nice to me. They take your order with a happy tone, they smile and ask you about your day. Every time I go there, I leave smiling. The guy I just talked to asked me about my plans for the day and even talked about my future plans in life. I feel really appreciated and happy every time I go to this starbucks.
A nice spot to get coffee if you can manage the awful roads which are Brandon.  Parking is plentiful and staff are helpful.  Standard Starbucks experience.  Would stop by again.
Always unbelievably slow after remodel. Drive-thru wait is routinely 30 minutes. I've started going out of my way to go to other locations. Hope they can pick it up again for their customers.

Anyone who complains about this place is an absolute Karin with 0 patience or people skills. A lot of the time this building is understaffed (as are MANY service industry places right now), but the employees 100% always make it worth any kind of wait. I've ALWAYS been greeted with courtesy and kindness at the window. Brian the drive-thru guy deserves a raise for being SO gracious to the customers. I always get exactly what I ask for, and they even make wonderful recommendations when I like to try something new. 

Don't let the long lines scare you. It is worth it here! The only thing the manager needs to consider now is hiring more staff to keep up with the demand.

Just had the worst customer service at this Starbucks in Target. The girl behind the counter saw me in line and turned off the lights as if they were closed. They closed at 8 and it was not 8pm yet. I told her that and she said well we are closed. The guy hesitated but still took my order. They both were very rude about it and did not show any kind of manners. I will not recommend this Starbucks to anyone after that service. They need new employees.

This is my neighborhood Starbucks,which makes it the best!! (For me!!!) I love when I walk in and everyone says Hi! or Good morning!! 

They are (mostly) so friendly! I think when they aren't it's because they're either a he trainer or trainee and their mind is exploding. Seriously, not sure but I feel like this Starbucks is the training center of Tampa!! How grueling that must be and they STILL smile at me! 

 This is a typical Starbucks as far as offerings, no wine, appetizers or fancy desserts like other ones I've heard of, but I've had my share of Starbucks around the US and Europe and have had to return a cup or two for burnt taste, wrong order, etc. Not here. I come here 54-5 days a week when I'm in town and have never had a mistake! Ever. 

I'd say parking is the only issue because people don't want to park behind the store - but it's there, so my 5 stars stick!

Ordered a drip and when I got home, saw that the barrista short-changed me on the coffee. There is a good inch and a half of room which I never asked for, but I sure paid full price! Why does Starbucks charge so much for coffee and then rip us off on the pour?! This happens everywhere I go. I neglected to check this time, but I frequently ask them to fill my coffee up to the top becaus baristas everywhere are often stingy on the pour. I need to go back to making my own coffee. I wish there was a Peets coffee in this town.
Mixed feelings. My drink is usually good but they are sloooow. I saw a sign that they will be closed for training hopefully that includes putting a rush on making the drinks.
I like coming in here, sometimes its a little slow but thats ok. Drinks are still good

They have very friendly staff! I haven't had to wait too long when I go. The only downside is that there isn't a drive through. I wish that this location did because that would be way more convenient than getting out of the car!

I came here before my doctor appointment next door and it was a zoo.  I have been to busy franchise's downtown and in other cities, but this location is chaotic and does not handle crowds well. The person ringing my order up did not listen to me, and didnt understand what a  doppio macchiato was!! I ordered a decaffeinated one with extra foam. He wanted to know "what size?" I explained espresso drink, comes in one size....Took forever to get my drink and drank the regular doppio macchiato since time was running out for appointment.  I also got a cheese and fruit box. Perfect snack item for me. I drink starbucks coffee at home and like their food items, but only come when i have a doctor's appointment. I wil jot go out if my way to come back to this location.

My husband and I just drove into town from Tennessee, after 12hr - we decided to pick up a KETO FRIENDLY DRINK. The cashier at the register was extremely friendly, professional and even offered us a sample of one of the most popular drinks. She has been the best Starbucks server ever met, and we drink a lot Starbucks! Thanks to her, whenever we visit, we'll make to stop by!!!

You know what, it's hard to give an accurate rating because it's a toss up between the Starbucks location and Starbucks in general.

This location specifically is good. The drive-thru employees always seem to be nice and in a good mood. The order is correct MOST of the time. We order ahead through the app and pick up at the window.

There-in lies one of the problems. 

Often on the app it says either I can't order for this location (or some others) and, what gets me the most, is that they show items unavailable. 

It's always a toss-up between whether they actually have an ingredient, it's not just showing up on the app or it's on the app when you order but then when you go pick up you're told they didn't have a specific ingredient.

It's annoying as all fuck. 

There's a reason I use the app and it's because of convenience, THEY made the app for that specific reason and about 50% of the time something goes wrong. So this doesn't reflect this particular location but it reflects on Starbucks in general so one star taken off for that.

This location, though, seems to be alright in and of itself.
Place is cute, but there's a rude older woman that works here. Everyone else seemed nice though!

I'm not a morning person, so when I go to this location it's usually very early (between 4:30-5am) and I find so refreshing to have employees who genuinely like their job and greet you with such friendliness.

I have been coming to this Starbucks for over 10 years and used to frequent almost daily. At one point it was my favorite, however it has just been progressively getting worse and worse over the years. Now they close at 7? I walked in around that time not knowing, and they were very rude about our entry. Of course, we left instead when we realized they were closing, but  I can't get over how impolite these employees are getting, including the manager. Very disappointed in your service, I won't be returning to this location.

The store feels ill to me. I waited at the entrance for the customer in front of me to finish. Manager said to close the door because of bugs. Ate outside across the way and no bug activity at all (too cool out). Last time here never saw them wipe down tables.  They should get an ionizer air purifier.
I love this location, they're always on point with my order and they're so nice! Today they wrote Happy Thanksgiving Derek & Dexter (my dog) on my order and gave him a pup cup.

I am never one to complain, usually if I get an order wrong anywhere I would still take it and never say a word. Unfortunately, this location gives me reason to complain. They never make my drink right, and I order straight off the menu with no modifications. There is also one staff member that is NEVER nice to me...not sure what I would've done to receive treatment that she shoves the drink at me without even looking at me. Gives me reason to go to ANY other Starbucks in the area :(

Seems like the employees at the newest local Starbucks may be getting a bit jaded already. How about filling the drinks all the way to top guys? It isn't like they are inexpensive courtesy cups or something.
This Starbucks is in a great location-The Summit. They have a nice patio and ample seating inside. Service is always good here and they offer the usual Starbucks selections.

Fix the drive thru!

Quality of service - 5
Friendliness of employees - 5
Speed of drive thru service - 1

If someone gets a complicated order or one that takes a lot of time have them pull forward and keep the line moving. Easy fix.

The staff at this Starbucks location was very disorganized and inefficient today with all customer orders while I was there. They seemed adequately staffed (5) yet did not seem to know what they were doing. They didn't even have the added distraction of drive-thru services. Whoever the manager is needs to address this.

Worst service from any airport Starbucks that I have ever had.  This is the Starbucks by E29,and I will tell ypu that I am also tempted to never frequent a Starbucks again!!!

When I worked in Customer Service jobs, it was not the customer's privilege to order anthing, it was my prvilege to serve them.  Here, the utter disdain and disgust that the barrista had for my order was shocking.  I apparenlty bothered her by ordering a Cold Brew!!

To say the least, will never order from Starbucks in STL again.......

Maybe the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. I know my Starbucks, and I shouldn't have to educate you on your own company policy, snooty girl working behind the counter. A rewards card means I don't get charged for Soy and I don't have to use that card as my tender for the transaction. It's a rewards card.
I walked here from Whole Foods with two bags of groceries and I swear the woman looked at me like I had three heads. Not to mention the fact the place is swarming with odd sorts tied to their laptops, only looking up long enough to pass judgement. Way to make me feel welcome, Tucson.

I won't be returning here, there are plenty of better locations around town.

This is the one year birthday of this Starbucks in the FishHawk development. Indeed, free pizza and birthday cake was served to everyone for the celebration. A manager was on hand to thank everyone for being loyal customers. A nice touch!

The opening of the store a year ago seemed to have one problem after another, especially with getting the Wifi to work. Some of the baristas, early on, seemed to be inexperienced, putting out questionable fraps -- at least nothing like we ordered.

Anyway, today everything seems to be normal for a Starbucks that keeps the baristas overly busy with the drive-up window. This one, like most of the new ones, are built without sound-absorbing surfaces -- cement floors, lots of glass, and no acoustical ceiling sound absorbents. I get the feeling they do not want you to linger. Seems like someone could open a quieter, more comfortable coffee shop and prosper. Meanwhile, we're thankful it's here.

Driving through and not from the area. I ordered a flat white but these people gave me a cup of milk with a splash of coffee in it. Didn't notice it till I was already on the highway miles away (I was giving my drink time to cool down). Terrible drive with no caffeine just hot milk. I hope the "barista" steps on a lego barefoot.

Ordered a coffee online on Mother's Day, walked over with my family. Knew about the shortened hours since I walked over day before, but still could order online and still said open for grab and go. I checked. Long line of cars; truck in the Curbside space. Both doors locked, still sign for grab and go in window. Stood there, no one came to door. Called, no one answered. I even took pic because I couldn't believe employees were just ignoring people outside when sign clearly said open for grab and go. Truck gave up and got in car line. I walked home, got my car, went through drive thru. They NOW had written sign up for drive thru only. I cannot believe an employee could not have taken 30 seconds to walk out earlier, before sign was up to say "I'm sorry we're short staffed," hand me my drink and hand drink to people waiting in truck. We were all standing out there for approximately 8 minutes waiting since there was no sign for drive thru only. Super poor customer service. And they still gave me the drink that I ordered 30 minutes before, not a fresh one! I will be speaking to manager and contacting corporate. I have been going there since they opened in Bardmoor Promenade shopping center. They know me by name - about 18 years. For a long time I was there numerous times a week. This location is normally wonderful so I hope the manager will counsel these employees to take the extra 30 seconds to handle the situation properly, not just ignore people and put a sign up later. "Oh it's just a few people. They'll just have to figure out to go to drive thru on their own." Especially since many people walk over from huge neighborhood next door. I guess if you walked or biked over you're just gonna lose $5. (And this was noon, an hour after they opened. Sign was not up till after noontime)

So I've been to this Starbucks a bunch of times over the last 5 years. I got two iced drinks today and some food for my friend and I. We changed the milk option from 2% to Whole Milk. I took a few sips of my iced chai tea latte, and I was immediately sick to my stomach, and I stopped drinking it. My friend drank some of his iced coffee (way more than I did of mine), and his stomach is also hurting and is very sick right now, up and down to the bathroom non stop. The drink is still sitting in my fridge right now still because I've been in bed for the last 4 hours since we got Starbucks, throwing up a lot and having the worst stomach pains and bathroom problems. I did not eat any of the food and I'm absolutely 100% sure it was the Whole Milk in our drinks. It was the only similar thing we both had and now we're both very sick. I've never had a Starbucks drink bother me until now.

The guy taking our order made a mistake and had a mix up on what size drinks we wanted because at first he had assumed we wanted grandes and we had asked for ventis instead. Which this mistake is fine we are all human. However the younger mid 20 girl with glasses gave us attitude when we expressed that it was supposed to be a venti. And the thing is it was a cup of ice that was free! She stated well next time you should tell them what size you wanted, which we did. It is very unprofessional to accuse customers of a mistake when it clearly wasn't our fault. Also, she wasn't the one who took our order so she wouldn't know what we have said. It was a simple mistake that could be easily fixed with no issue or problem. But I do not appreciate being talked to rudely.

Every time I come to this Starbucks I'm in line for 10-15 minutes. I barely even get to the ordering speaker in a timely manner. They really don't have a good system here and It's really this Starbucks

Starbucks is known for reliability of their products and customer service. This location, however, has the rudest staff I have ever encountered at any Starbucks. Pushy, rushed, would not allow me to add to my order once it was completed (essentially denying a sale for the business). Very rude and unlike Starbucks.

This is the worst service I have ever received from a franchise drink shop. This whole experience was terrible. I order a Grande Caramel Macchiato with little ice. He gave me a caramel ice coffee with normal ice. When i politely ask him to take some ice out he said no. so i had to get the ice out myself. This drink is not even in the right cup and there's no macchiato. will not coming back. waste of money. Starbucks's service just gets worst every time i make a visit.

Not the best place to go. Staff isn't amicable and doesn't acknowledge you. They seem too focused on what they're doing as opposed to creating a memorable guest experience here. 

The Mango Dragonfruit refresher was really good, though. I'd come back for that and give the staff another shot. Maybe it was just an off day. 

A 3-star experience. Cheers!

This short and sweet review has been brought to you by me.
This Starbucks is located on the UNR (University of Nevada, Reno) campus within the confines of the CSU (Crowley Student Union).

The bad: It's crowded. Rarely can you find a time when it's not busy.
The good: I've never had bad service there and all their products are good and tasty. Not cheap, but you get what you pay for.

This is the only Starbucks on campus.
But, it's not the only coffee vendor on campus.

----------------
Bottom Line

Yes, I will be back.

I really enjoy this Starbucks. They always get my drink right. They always get friendly service. And it's a very convenient location for me personally too. It's right next to all my shopping locations if I need a quick delicious drink. I'll come through this location because I can get my drink before I start shopping and have something to walk around with and enjoy. Because honestly, who wouldn't want something delicious to drink while shopping.  Yes l will have to admit it's much longer to go through the drive through. So if you are in a time crunch probably not suggested. I'd always order through the app at that point. I like how they have both options. You can go inside and order or through DT. If you want order on the app walk inside and get the drink quick. I've personally tried a bunch of coffee shops and I always just come back to Starbucks. There's nothing that beats it. I am and have been a fan of Starbucks due to all the convenient locations and options they have to order.

This has been the best location in the area for a while now. The baristas are very nice and friendly and will go out of their way to fix anything. I usually come to this one after work but I went on my day off today. I mobile ordered and when I went to leave, my car started having issues and I had to call a friend for a ride so I could run my errands. By the time I got there, it had been 40 min since my order was placed and the barista immediately offered to remake my drink without me even asking. That was so incredibly sweet. I thanked her and told her I had car issues on my way here and she said it was no problem at all. I wish I had looked at her name but she is there all the time and is always so kind. Thank you for making my day and turning it around. I love this Starbucks.
This isn't my usual coffee spot in the city, but I do enjoy their Caramel Brûlée Latte! Their menu is extensive and their service is super friendly.

I have to update my review based on the experience I had on a double star Thursday. Obviously it was a busy morning which is why I placed my order with the mobile app. I arrived 5 minutes after the ETA I was provided. There were at least 7-8 baristas running around. I stood right in front of the mobile order plastic window protector for about 10 minutes without being acknowledged by anyone. Then another lady came around me and one barista finally came over to ask her first if she's been helped. I HIGHLY DOUBT you didn't see my broad shoulders in my large black hoodie sis. I just don't know what it is. Sometimes this location provides outstanding service and then other times you get barely mediocre service. At least my eggnogg latte and roasted ham and swiss sandwhich tasted good. I asked for 3 shots of espresso in my eggnogg latte but it didn't taste extra charged like I was hoping.

This location has been my go-to daily or whenever I'm craving for Starbucks ever since the 19th chestnut store closed.

 I haven't had any problems yet. But maybe is bc all of my orders are through mobile. So is pretty much walk in and walk out within minutes. 

The only thing I found it odd is their stock. So one day I saw their board outside of their shop. It advertised peach green tea and blue raspberry black tea. I have try to order both items for two weeks straight, I finally got it the 3rd week"sigh".

I ordered a mocha frappe; it really lacked the mocha & had no chocolate drizzle. The coffee portion was a bit overbearing. 
They were a bit slow especially since there was only one other drink ordered other than mine. 
Disappointed in this location

It seems no matter where I may travel to, Starbucks is always consistent in service and quality. This location is great. Nice outdoor patio. Plenty of seating and located conveniently to Westin Hotel and local Harbor Island retail and restaurants. Worth the visit.

Didn't get the name of the guy who helped me but he had an attitude right from the start. Their location was out of every drink I asked for. No Nitro cold brew with cream or even without cream. I even asked for this Valentines Day type of drink I saw on Facebook that had like strawberry and chocolate taste and before I could even explain he said "we didn't do anything for Valentine's Day here so not sure where you got that from" (as he slapped the register screen with his hand as if he was annoyed with my request). I could have taken out the recipe of what was in the drink from the article I read but I instead chose to go to a different Starbucks. Came for coffee, not attitude.

This location has closed for good. Today is 6.10.20 and they're out of business. 

I asked the cashier at the service area.
She said they closed when the covid-19 pandemic started. 
She said it was too difficult to maintain the social distancing. She said she's been here 8 years and never thought it would happen. But unfortunately it has.

By far the slowest Starbucks in the Tampa/Clearwater area. The young man who takes orders most mornings is painfully slow and finds himself a bit too amusing. He has told me several times he is "mid yawn" when taking my order. Definitely not a good option if you have any sense of urgency for the day.

I am a loyal and frequent client of Starbucks and have been for years, I travel often throughout PA, Northern NJ and NYC. Often I have business in the 422 corridor. Folks - this is by far the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. 

- Clueless staff and plain stupid 
- Incorrect orders constantly after explaining a basic black coffee
- Wrong lids placed on beverages 
- ALWAYS long lines when the place is dead, I have seen higher volume stores pump out so fast. 
- Once waited 30 minutes for a mobile order, basic stuff 
- Staff looks like they are on drugs and unmotivated - never make eye contact and nasty always, arrogant and miserable as well. Like you are doing them a favor 
- Worst designed drive-thru ever and parking lot configuration - bank set up and people have no clue how to drive in it. 

I once contacted the regional manager - Trina, she is as clueless as the staff, does not respond or care. 

Folks - stay away from this mess, the one in Limerick is just as bad - same regional manager, stay away! 

Called corporate several times and requested refunds and made complaints. 

Shut this dump down.

A perfectly made Iced Latte and a Smoothie for my friend with a clean restroom (need a code to use it) and friendly service.

No  issues.

They are closed during this tough time, not the issue, but left every light on.  Pulled in with a trailer this AM because every light is on(inside and out).  TURN YOUR LIGHTS OFF so people don't think you're open.

Yay! This Starbucks put new quiet feet on the chairs!! No more loud, excruciating, grating sound whenever someone moves their chair to get up! I've been coming to this location since they opened, and it has consistently gotten better and better. I'm happy!

WHERE'S THE FLATWARE?
The only "cutlery" this Starbucks has is plastic. And they don't have plates. When I asked for one they had to pull a demi from the display case.

I BROKE MY PLASTIC FORK ON THE MUFFIN
and then spotted my dress shirt when I had to eat the stale breakfast sandwich by hand.

IS THIS WHERE THE INDUSTRY LEADER IS TAKING US?
Not to be grumpy (I seem to be writing a lot of sub-3 ratings lately) but this Starbucks is located in a business hotel. We bleary eyed patrons in $1,000 worth of dress wear are dodging grease dribbles before meeting clients. 

(thankfully I remembered to blot not rub!)

Omg! Every single time I get coffee it's a 20-30 minute wait just to get through the line- I can't believe it. I thought it was just once or twice and gave them the benefit of the doubt- but no one has that much time to sit in line and wait for a coffee . Someone needs to get some sense of urgency
Ran out of peach juice so they didn't make my drink without telling me. I waited very long and was late. They also gave my friend whip and no caramel drizzle when she asked. Disappointed...

It's interesting to compare Starbucks locations across the country. I really like the design of this space. Lots of seats, lots of room to work or relax. The physical space is awesome. 

The staff seems disengaged. They'll get your order together but it's a very mechanical experience. There's little interaction with the customer. Maybe it's because they're burned out on tourists or something. 

And this is the first time I've ever seen a Starbucks employee texting on a personal phone while working the register. And I've been in a lot of Starbucks in a lot of states.

This is the worst Starbucks I've been to. Not only are they not nice, they make the drinks horribly. I go about 1-3 times a week to this location because I can walk- but at this point it's better worth my time and money to get in the car and drive to another location. I've put up with their rudeness and bad drinks for months now but after going to another location and having the best customer service and best drink ever I realized again how horrible this location is. I started to think I just didn't like my favorite drink anymore but nope it's just how they make it. The sad part is that it's not just one person that's not nice it's everyone there. I've had way too many situations where people have been rude which is really upsetting because Starbucks is supposed to be a brand that is well known for their customer service and similarity between stores.

Y'all that was some good service. Just rolled in from Houston and we used to go to one of the busiest Starbucks in the city where there was always a line and a wait. This Starbucks had people rolling through with almost no wait. I was so pleased at how efficient they were and our order was perfect from the food to the drinks. lol

One of the worst Starbucks I've been to. I've had to wait 25-35 minutes for one drink i ordered on the app. 
Slow service, rude staff.

I use the Glenwood location with caution. The shots are generally burnt, and the composition of their drinks is extremely "meh" at best - I have had to have them remake drinks on several occasions because they were undrinkable. I have gone to four locations in Boise, and this one is by far the least consistent. I typically order an iced Americano with cream, a caramel cream cold brew, or (as of recently) a shaken iced espresso concoction. They are always noticeably different in the way they are made at the Glenwood location. Very disappointing.

When we ordered there were 10 people ahead of us so it took 20 minutes to get our coffee.  we ordered iced coffee; I asked for Splenda but they only had stevia, then I had to ask to get some napkins.  The coffee was more bitter than usual, even with an extra stevia. 10 minutes after we got our coffee, the came around to say that they would be closing in ten minutes (3:00PM),  we sat outside at a table which was sticky. As we were leaving we noticed that there was a lot of small trash in the parking lot.  This place should be closed until they can stay open and 
Maintain their parking lot.

I hate this Starbucks with every fiber in my being.  They're so inconsistent.  Today, for no reason, no explanation whatsoever, they decide they are drive thru only.  Why?  Why?  Why?!?!  Now they're fights going on in the drive thru, parking lot, etc.  it's insanity.  They need to be held accountable

The absolute worst Starbucks I've ever visited. First, it's inside the publix; weird, that must kill any type of regular business they have. Secondly, it appears that it's not only INSIDE the publix, but also run by Publix employees. With a manager, 2 girls behind the counter, and only one other customer waiting for their drinks, we waited.. and waited.. and eventually walked without even being greeted. We were stared at as we walked, with no mention of "be right with you" NOTHING. The 2 girls behind the counter on Saturday around noon could use some incentive to display customer service. This location is a disservice to Starbucks and the franchisee should consider other options. I won't come back to this Starbucks and in the off chance I might run into those employees elsewhere in the store, I won't be returning to this Publix. Shameful service

The staff that work at this location are amazing!  I frequent this location and know several others that do as well.  If you get a usual drink, they'll learn it...making it so easy and a friendly experience.

Can't believe that I haven't taken the time to write a 5-star review about this location thus far; that is, it would have been a 5-star review up until my latest visit last weekend.

Let's first talk about the 2-ton elephant that I just plopped into the middle of the room: this used to have about 6 super-comfy chairs in which to come here to relax and drink in. The seating really set a wonderful tone as the awesome corner neighborhood coffee shop, in this quiet section of Rittenhouse. But the comfy seats are truly gone, and replaced with the typical wooden chairs and tables. Granted, there is a bit more seating for this busy location now; but this quaint neighborhood spot just became a bit more sterilized. So there's that.

Now on to the great things about this location: it's still a great neighborhood coffee shop for this quiet section of Rittenhouse, with ample (now more) seating, has a great open atmosphere, it's one of the very few area locations open through 10pm, and it may well have the coolest baristas in town - they've been the nicest, down-to-earth gals around (I'm sure there's guys too, but I haven't seen any thus far). 

So this is still my go-to location for when I want to get out into my neighborhood; but it's now less cozy than it used to be, is all.

I imagine this Starbucks as a ship. A marvelous ship that brings coffee and treats to all the hard working town folk. When I imagine the captain of this ship I see a fastidious young man with big dreams sparkling in his eye. That young man is none other than Julian, the handsome fellow with the great jokes and that signature ever-present smile. Julian will one day have a fleet of ships of his own but in the mean time he's doing a great job serving up beans to those in need.

This location is great!  The night we went I had ordered an Ice Carmel Frapo, I wanted a tall, but they accidentally made me a Venti!  I wasn't' going to deny it!

The staff is very friendly I noticed that they new their regular customers by name, and I Love place like that!

First, service is too slow. It takes forever to get a drink. 
Secondly, the "Trenta" size is basically a Grande with 2 extra scoops of ice. Rip off. 
Lastly, I don't think this place is hygienic. While waiting the additional 20 minutes for my drink after placing the order online; on more than one occasion, I saw a barista grab the cup from the inside after scratching behind her ear. Disgusting. Luckily a different barista made my drink.

If you aren't young don't bother going to this location as they treat anyone over 30 like they are idiots.  Two days in a row I have had issues where the men workers have made me feel like an idiot.  First I went in to buy gift cards for a birthday party and ordered my younger daughter a drink.  We go to wait at the end of the counter.  Five minutes later still no drink and the man was filling three drinks of people who had just walked in.  After I questioned him about forgetting my daughter's drink, he responded with I must not have ordered.  When I asked him whose cup was over by the drink mixers he looked at it and was like oh here it is.  Really??  How do you blame a customer without even looking around.  If I didn't ask who knows how long I would have waited.  Then tonight was my daughter's birthday so she asked to go.  I went through the drive through and asked for a small drink.  I always ask for a small drink with no problem.  This time the man, a different man from the day before, read it back to me as a tall.  I told him I ordered a small and he had the nerve to correct me saying they only come in a tall or grande.  I don't know about you but if you go out anywhere else and order a tall it's the largest drink they have.  I have never been corrected before and as a person like most who only goes to Starbucks for their kids I think anyone with a brain would know I just wanted the smallest drink as they already cost an arm and a leg for a drink.  Totally unnecessary.  Needless to say although this location is the closest to me, after this weekend, I will never be back.

When I arrived at Walt Whitman Plaza, I was thirsty for Starbucks. I was surprised that they didn't have any blonde roast coffee today. I got the 
Trenta Strawberry Acai with lemonade. My drink came out correctly and in a timely manner.

Only giving one because I can't give it zero. I have worked In Costumer service for over a year and have been able to manage at least one shift by myself and the guy working here obviously shouldn't be left alone. He was rude and was constantly asking me "is that it" when I would add something to my order, mind you all I got was a matcha drink and a ham and cheese croissant. They didn't have expresso? Or caramel? Are you even Starbucks? The guy was rude af such a jerk. Also there was no need to rush me because there was no line!

Worst Starbucks I have ever been to. My friends and I stopped here for coffee and we when we walked in, it looked like any other Starbucks Ive been too. As I finished ordering my drinking, I realized more and more the cashier was being kind of rude to us. I could see they were moving very slow and unorganized and they were sorta busy due to 5 cars at the drive through. My biggest mistake was when I asked a for little cup for my creamer. Out of no where, the cashier gets into our(me and the barista) conversation and rudely asked what kind of cup I need, almost like I offended her. As I am waiting for my drinks, I saw the cashier (maybe the head barista) get more flustered and at one point taking out her anger out on her coworkers as well. I never ever in my life been to a starbucks like this. I've worked in a service industry my whole life so I understand it is hard when it gets busy BUT you should never treat your customer that way. Unless you're desperate for coffee, do not come here. Everyone is miserable and the service is SUPER slow

Starbucks just opened this location and we'll so far it's pretty typical you have the prepackaged case and all the baristas making lattes, refreshers, and warming up paninis.  This store opened with tons of seating only to be marked off as closed for covid before any such orders from the state limiting them for seating indoors.  Was told it's a corporate decision, IMO these business should operate within the laws of the individual state they operate in.  


There is a outdoor patio w a few umbrellas and drive through for convenience but the parking is tight and can get as congested as a Chick-fil-A event.  So off hours are good and order ahead with your app.  Drive through traffic wraps around building and blocks neighboring business parking spaces from Saltys or access road into shopping plaza.

Believe it or not this is my second visit to this Starbucks that is within a quarter mile from where I have called home for a few years. Not a coincidence, I have only been in any Starbucks a handful of times, business meetings and a couple times meeting friends. Why... I flew at least 4 times each week during a long portion of my career with Waste Management, USAir, American and United were serving Starbucks coffee onboard every flight, flying first class I was never far from those brewers cranking out coffee pre flight and again during. I tried it a couple times. After all I have volunteered and worked at rescue squads and at trash companies where the pot and brewer were often dirty and the brew sat in the pot for many hours (the Wawa brewmasters just seized) so I have had some non gourmet cups. Maybe it was the fact that the lavatory drain pipe and the fresh water fill pipe are only inch's apart and the same gloved hand connects the clean and the dirty when the airplane is serviced between every flight.  All this considered I did actually like the blonde roast at Starbucks and always had good experiences. This visit is my first to review one and at 11 am no Blonde roast available while sitting at least 4 guests asked for it and were told we don't sell to much of that. My Pike Place cup was good and service was good. I did see it obvious that Drive Thru was a priority in service many customers waited minutes to be served as Drive thru flew thru.  It was a rainy day but the bathroom was dirtier then you would expect and a very detailed cleaning obviously hasn't been done in a while corners of the floors and such. It was well stocked and in general it is a nicely appointed store. The traffic flow around the store is weird the two store stop mall should be facing the side or toward the main strip of stores. The sidewalk is too narrow to even walk on outside the fence out front. Very small interior store but very large restrooms.
Very efficient and clean. They are particularly good with the mobile ordering. My order is always ready by the time I get there!
no white chocolate mocha and I still had to wait in the drive thru line for an unbelievable amount of time it wasn't even rush hour for y'all

Ever since the Lakeside Starbucks became a Sucre, this Starbucks has been busy every single time I've gone in, no matter what time.  There are 3 parking spaces in front of the building, and a parking lot with about seven spaces.  

Oftentimes, all these spaces are full.  The sidestreet next to the store (Nursey Ave.) is regularly patrolled by JPSO for ticketing and towing, there are no parking signs extending far down the block.  This makes this Starbucks the WORST Starbucks for parking in the entire metro area (no, the Canal Street Starbucks's don't count; they're in hotels and not actually operated by Starbucks).  AND IT'S IN FREAKING METAIRIE.  

That being said, they have a drive through, the staff is always friendly, they get the drinks right, and being able to pay for coffee just by flashing my iPhone is pretty awesome.
They need more training here. She had to remake my drink, I had to coach her how to make my drink and somehow it was still wrong.

Ok obvi normally I'd dgaf about writing a review for Starbucks.. but not this time my fellow Yelpers. 

I thought this was the swanky flagship Rittenhouse Starbucks so my Mayur C. and I went Sunday to try the new fraps. We got a venti and asked if he could split it in two. Literally nbd. First the cashier was like uh.... and then the barista came over and was like uhh.... I thought they were about to be like "LOL JK OF COURSE WE CAN" but nope. So awkward. 

Then I wanted to buy a mug they were featuring at the cashier but didn't have with all the other merch so I asked her if they had some in the back. *Que fiasco* She didn't know how much it is, neither did the barista, the manager was MIA. Meanwhile a line was forming behind me and she kicked me out of line at which point I was like yoo bye felicia, I'll get this at the other non swanky Starbucks. 

Finally after we got our TWO cups (barista was not having it..and FYI he refused to do the splitting of the cups for us so strange) she called me back over to buy the darn cup. 

Wow what an experience....and not in a good way.
Ahh much better (unlike the 39th street).  Swift, efficient, clean. The youthberry granita is delicious!

This is the best Starbucks I've ever been to! The one barista remembers my order, and even suggests new ones, that she thinks I'd like! She had me hooked on a white chocolate mocha, with 1 scoop of malt, and 1 scoop of vanilla bean powder for a few months! Then she suggested I tried the brown sugar oat milk shaken espresso. Since she knows I like mine a little sweeter, she suggested I add sweet cold foam on top! By far the best drink yet! Thanks Em!

Order shaken green tea w 4 Splenda, they shake the tea, meanwhile the Splenda is in the cup, pour the tea in and hand to me with the Splenda all on the bottom. I ask why it's not shaken together. Without a word just a dirty look the girl picks up the cup shakes it and walks away. I had to ask it be remade by the manager. VERY RUDE after I just spent $11. I travel the world usually this is the service you get in airport Starbucks.

Imagine my surprise when I, the jerk rolling up to a Starbucks that closes at 7:00 at 6:55, am greeted by the kindest, least frustrated barista i've ever had the pleasure of interacting with. I know that I would be peeved about someone coming in so late, but not her, she was fantastic. Ava, if you're reading this, I'm sorry I came around too late with another tip, I had to run to the Wawa to get the change broken. You rock and thank you providing some necessary caffeine to this sleep-deprived college student during finals week! Ava definitely deserves praise and a raise!

What was once the most inefficient Chase Bank I ever visited is now the most inefficient Starbucks I've ever visited. 

When businesses reuse an existing structure instead of new construction, it goes one of two ways. It either works perfectly (think Hong Kong Market), or goes horribly wrong. This Starbucks is a great example of the latter.

On a recent day I realized that I had not yet had by daily does of caffeine. Knowing that my addiction must be fueled, I noticed this location on my way to a nearby car wash. As I pulled up I noticed the spot I thought I should enter was marked "Do Not Enter". Slightly perplexed, I drove on till I found the actual entrance. I realize this is likely the best use of the space they had, but it was very confusing and somewhat dangerous. Pulling in to the drive thru meant passing several parking areas including one with cars parked immediately adjacent to the drive thru. If the drive thru was full, I doubt those cars could have exited their spots. Making matters worse was the height of the drive thru window. I guess it would be perfect for someone in a jacked up F-250, but I felt like a little child reaching towards the sky to receive my drink. Maybe the ground could have been built up to offset the difference in height, but it was very awkward. Design issues aside, there were also service issues.

At the drive thru there must not be a camera like most locations. After taking my order, the line didn't move. The cashier asked two more ties if I had been helped. This could be prevented if there was a camera showing the cashier the same car was still sitting there, but that was the least of my concern. Apparently the cashier taking orders was unsure of how to disable the microphone so I was able to hear her entire conversation. That conversation was primarily a tirade against someone in line who had ordered some very complex drink. While I agree that people who make ridiculously complex orders should be ridiculed, what if that had been a tirade against me? I would have surely sped away, tires squealing with my finger raised in salute, but it wasn't against me, so I just sat and listened. When I finally made it to the aforementioned jacked up truck height window, my drink was thrust into my hand with nary a word of thanks.

In summary, I am not a fan.
Worst Starbucks experience ever. The lady working there was extremely rude and had no knowledge of Starbucks drink or food.
Convenient location, however, there are always flies swarming in the pastry display case and around the store. Does not make for a very appetizing experience.

Hands-down, the best Sbux in NOLA, and one of the best anywhere.  

Pros:  
-Not a drive-thru, so the baristas can (and do) give you their undivided attention.  
-Very cool, hip coffee shop vibe with authentic art & lighting.
-Clover brewing system.
-Super friendly baristas.
-Cleanest restrooms on Canal.
-Great NOLA people watching!

Cons:
-Lines sometimes form.

I ordered drinks via the mobile app on my way to an event. I made sure to order with plenty of time before the "estimated pick-up time." However, when I arrived to the store I ended up waiting over 15 minutes in the cafe for a damn iced coffee. I watched the drive-through line cycle through at least 3-4 times while I was waiting, which is saying a LOT because those lines were *huge.*

What is the point of ordering ahead if you're not going to have drinks ready on-time? It was a frustrating experience.

With COVID-19, you can only drive through or mobile order. No standing inside. That said, there is always a line at this Starbucks in the morning. They always move the line along quickly; never making the whole process take more than a few minutes. I typically get my coffee customized and they have yet to get it wrong.

Located inside Target just outside downtown Philly, this is an easy stop with free parking.  Only to go ordering available and masks required as per city mandate.  They were out of some ingredients like sweet cream cold foam so two of our originally ordered drinks were unavailable.  Our final order was completed quickly and accurately.

Ordered hot coffee in the drive thru. Coffee came out cold! In a hot coffee cup. I'm really confused because it tastes like iced coffee it was ridiculous. I had to go through the drive they once again and return my 'hot'coffee for a hot coffee. It was a waste of time and we did not get anything from them for our wasted time or our inconvenience. I will be writing to Starbucks about this. Not good business.  The location was 5425 US Hwy 19 New Port Richey, FL.

They are unfriendly and slow even though they have about 4 people working the counter. Sometimes I've waited for 20 minutes and I'm still not at the front of the queue -- I have left more than once before because the wait is too long! Plus they messed up my order big time. I ordered a green tea latte and they gave me a coffee latte - I don't know what to do with it, cause I ordered VT, it's too much to drink (for a person who doesn't like coffee) and too much to throw away :'(
Loved this Starbucks!!!!! Not only did I have one of the best caramel macchiato there but the trumpet chandelier was beautiful. Definitely selfie worthy.
Clean and efficient Starbucks. Service was quick, friendly staff. Nice large area to sit and work or just to have some Coffee or tea and hang out with friends.

It's the same in NOLA I ant believe it. The only thing that Howard Shultz didn't do was buy the basketball team in NOLA and sell the team & fans out to some dude for them to move the team.

But the coffee & tea is good so I guess it's ok to drop $10 on a cup for you and your friend!

Located in the same parking lot as Blick Art. We finished shopping at Blick and needed our Starbucks fix. Walked right over and the inside was not busy. Walked right up to the counter and greeted by friendly staff. Placed our order with ease and waited. Drinks were yummy and we were in and out in no time.

It's so hard to find any Starbucks store when you're a Starbie girl in Dunkin Donuts dominant States lol anyways, I was blown away by how hospitality the staff was. They were very organized and drinks were given out by a snap of your fingers! Mobile orders ready in like 5secs! What's important is how the drinks taste, still amazingly done! My usual orders tasted real good. Just like how I expected maybe better! The only thing is I always order light ice, other locations give me full venti cup, this location only fill half, so... 
Anyways, 4/5 stars overall.

Starbucks Ratings: 3.8/5

Food: 3.75/5 - Decided to grab some coffee from Starbucks when we are waiting for brunch at Ruby's Slipper. I got the iced coffee with a pump of sugar free vanilla syrup and light ice. We were hungry, so I also got two bakery items to share with my siblings. Blueberry muffin is good and moist, a classic at Starbucks, but it was a bit too sweet for my liking; wished there weren't that much sugar crystals on top of it. The banana nut loaf was better, once again super moist with a strong banana flavor. We all love the crunch from the nuts on the loaf, and it was a solid size too. Pro tip, always ask them to warm up your bakery items. 

Ambiance: 4/5 - Located on Canal Street, probably one of the biggest Starbucks in the area. It is also a tourist area, so expect many people there. Interior is very spacious with lots of seats and room to work or chill, similar to most Starbucks locations but just larger. Inside is very festival, bright, and pretty clean. 

Price: 3.75/5 - Got two bakery items: blueberry muffin and banana nut muffin for $2.75 and $3.25 respectively, and a Grande iced coffee for $2.95. The total came up to be around $12. This Starbucks's bakery items and coffee are probably cheaper or around the same as other local coffee shops, but if you're visiting I'd recommend try out a local shop instead.  

Service: 3.5/5 - Staffs were okay, not greatest like most Starbucks locations. I ordered through the mobile app, and got called when my orders are ready, but there weren't as much acknowledgement from the staffs when we walked it, so not really amicable to the customers. 

BLUF: If you are staying on Canal Street in NOLA and want to grab a quick morning coffee, this is a very convenient location for you. Very spacious with seats against the windows and middle section. Essential pit stop for a dose of caffeine and small snack.

This is one of the many Starbucks locations that is located inside of a main grocery location. But getting our drinks from here was pleasant and pretty quick. I chose the pumpkin spice latte hot. With a little bit of extra pumpkin spice and it was made pretty good. I would definitely try it again.

A little bit show of a line with a weird entry / exit but a ok service and drinks. They are on the middle of the mall at a kiosk with merch cornered off with barriers. It's busy on weekends and had a line but the staff was friendly!

My drink was made to order and they have the collectible Florida mugs. 

Overall: B
A little awkward location but nice staff and good drinks.

This location is consistently on top of it. There is rarely a long line, the baristas are friendly and efficient, and they've always gotten my order right. There is no drive-thru and most of the seating is usually taken, but those are my only complaints. Still, this location is great for a quick stop.

I went into this location on Saturday, January 15th, at around 4pm to cash in on a free drink I had on my Starbucks card. The gal working the cash register was very nice, but couldn't figure out how to find my free drink, so called over, what I assume, was a shift manager. A gal with short dirty dishwater blonde hair. She told me a couple of times that I needed a barcode on my email I had received, to cash in on my free drink. I tried several times to explain to her that the email I received didn't have a barcode., to which she continued to interrupt over and over. She refused to let me speak. I couldn't believe someone in a customer service position was perfectly fine with being so rude to a customer. I will never go back to that location. I've probably been to a hundred different locations over the past 20 years, and have never  been treated as rudely as I have at this location.

This is a great Starbucks to hit if you are in the area. Not as crowded as other area Starbucks and baristas seem to be veterans. My drink has never been wrong here. Parking isn't the best, but I assure you it's better than the Green Hills location. They also seem to have a nice selection of pastries, snacks and sandwiches.
Classic starbucks. Very well decorated. It is definitely very spacious and has wifi. Service and coffee was perfect!

These "baristas" have perfected the fine art of eye contact avoidance. I ordered 2 lattes and received only one. I stood there, waiting for the 2nd one to no avail. The girls kept throwing out order after order, spilling them on the counter while calling out the names. No one asked me why I was still waiting, but of course, by not looking up they had no idea I was still there. Finally I asked where it was and the manager came over and apologized, something about a tape that only spit out one latte instead of two. He ended up making it for me. These girls are rude and obviously consider their job a major inconvenience. I will avoid this Starbucks going forward. You should too.

Great location next to the Westin on Harbor Island. Staff are always friendly and helpful. 
Since it is such a high demand location, inventory levels for case goods can be inconsistent.

Wondering if management confers with the hotel and city to better forecast supply levels?
Great experience yesterday at the Citrus Park mall Starbucks. Quick line at the register and my s'mores frappucino was correct the first time. Used the app to pay.

Love this Starbucks! 8 times out of 10 the customer service is exceptional. I have experienced some less than friendly baristas. However, the majority of the time, they are fantastic! The drinks are also always made to perfection. I find myself coming here just about everyday lately because I can't get enough of the drinks!

Newly remodeled beautiful store with ample parking. My only complaint was the employees seemed exhausted and didn't want to engage. I also needed a cup of water and waited at the pickup area for 5 minutes without being acknowledged so I just left. Hoping it was just a fluke!

Go to Starbucks, get a lot of work done here. Hard to see in the late afternoons, sun glaring. Nice staff; clean bathrooms; feel safe leaving my equipment out. It is very accessible for meetings; the other Starbucks near are too small. PS give the Cold Foam Blonde espresso Cappuccino a try; KILLER!
PS Read Robert S review below, pretty spectacular.

I worked at a Starbucks for 2 1/2 years and this is the worst Starbucks. I went when class was in session and when the line would be short. I was the four person in line and it took them 40 minutes to just make my drink wrong (because it wasn't written correctly.)  Looks like they don't have a manager?!

Very friendly staff however very slow...and 50% the order is wrong. The parking is horrible dude to squeezing this store beside the Salty Shamrock which people who go to Salty's park in the Starbucks parking the drive thru line is backed up which blocks you in. Will be a while before I go back.

Cashier and staff is very rude at this location. They don't greet you nor do they seem happy at all. Normally when I order an iced green tea latte, I'll ask them to add an extra scoop of matcha powder. NORMALLY, there are no issues and they do not charge for it. At this location, the cashier charged me 95 cents additional for one more scoop of matcha. This hasn't happened before so I'm wondering if it's because this Starbucks is  operated by the airport restaurant group. The cashier actually seemed like she was trying to find something to charge for that additional scoop of matcha so she put it as "add syrup" ...

If I ask for one additional pump of vanilla in my vanilla latte I wonder if they'll charge a dollar for that too. I'll avoid this Starbucks next time and try the green bean coffee shop in this terminal instead.

Oh, and my $6 grande iced green tea latte tasted like water. Avoid.

Typically, what I appreciate most about this Starbucks is the drive thru, but today I came in for a meeting. I've got to say...it's a Starbucks! 

There's nothing fancy about it, it's been around for a while now, so they must do well in this neighborhood. There's not really a local coffee shop on south Kingshighway, so this is probably a good option for many who need a place to meet. 

Today I got an almond milk latte. They don't have oat milk, but do have almond and soy for dairy alternatives. 

The parking lot is a little clunky, but there's plenty of space. It's a relatively quiet location, as it's a little off the beaten path of central St. Louis. That could be a good thing for folks looking to not run into anyone and be productive. 

If I come here, it will probably continue to be a place I come out of necessity and convenience.

This is one of the busiest Starbucks in town but luckily it has a drive-through. It's actually a great spot for meet and greets and job interviews during the day as it is located in the Westshore business district.  Peek times are very crowded though.

I understand there is a shortage of workers currently in America, but do not take it out on your consumer. Love my coffee from here and I usually love this store but this morning, I just was not happy with the response I recieved from the store manager. So off to Dunkin I went and was served in a timely fashion with a more welcoming atmosphere.

If you're a Starbucks Iced Chai fan this is not the place to go. For whatever reason they have taken it upon themselves to make the Iced Chai different than any other Starbucks nationwide...well I take that back, there is one other nearby Starbucks location (I forget which) that makes it the same way. And because 2 Starbucks so close in proximity make the Iced Chai wrong I can only assume it's a management decision, that someone who has management affiliations with both locations has told the baristas to make the iced drinks this horrible undrinkable way.

I have been drinking Starbucks Iced Chais for over 2 years. I drink 1 to 2 a day. I have had them in 10 different states and within those 10 states I've had the Iced Chais at more than several to numerous locations. They always taste the same...always.

The Hot Chai and Iced Chai are different not only in the obvious but in the concentration. The Iced Chai is not watery and is much thicker. What this Starbucks location serves tastes like they just take the Hot Chai and add ice cubes to it and milk. Maybe this is a money saving tactic or they simply don't know better. 

I will never return to this location again.
The coffee was good but I was waiting for 15 minutes for food i ordered a half hour before I came

This Starbucks is terrible! They are constantly out of everything. Even if you first come in the morning. They rarely have many of the seasonal flavors, and are out of the multi grain bagel every time. It also seems like all of their barista's have never worked in a coffee shop before. The reason you come to Starbucks is for a consistently good beverage. They do not make theirs well at all! Until they can get their act together I will drive 20 minutes to get a different Starbucks

I want to start with the fact that I'm so glad this Starbucks moved locations. They had been in a building two lots down from where this new location is, and it was so small and tight you could hardly get your car through the parking lot once you got your drink. It deterred me from going. So this new location has more parking and it's easier to get in and out of the lot, and makes it easier to get your drink. It's connected to a QDoba. The outside seating is nice. Inside I really like the big long seating stool area. Plus the drive through is always pretty fast efficient. 

The only reason I'm giving this new location a 2/5 is because of the service inside. I've been in here a handful of times and the baristas aren't very communicative. I had one who decided to clean the counter over greeting me to take my order. She made me wait for at least 3-5 minutes so she could complete her task. Another time while I was waiting on my drink to be done at the end of the counter, they weren't saying out loud who the drink was for, or what it is. So eventually I flagged a busy barista down and asked, and he just shrugged at me and walked off. The latest time I was in there getting coffee with a friend, and a worker loudly started cleaning the trash cans. I say loudly because she was practically throwing the lid around and as it slammed against the floor multiple times it made quite a ruckus. Plus she had everything so spread out, we could hardly walk. She had it spread out in front of the door. I thought that was a bit unnecessary. It didn't make for the best experience, honestly.  My suggestion is if you're in a hurry, hit the drive through. If you're wanting a nice place to sit and chat with a friend or to do work, go elsewhere.

Thank GOD for this Starbucks vs the Sheldon Linebaugh.  Yes its still Starbucks, yes it can be $$$, but the people here work hard and are ALWAYS friendly.  This team has it together vs Sheldon and Linebaugh

Every person that is a part of the staff at this Starbucks is really friendly and helpful. They always get my drinks right and strike up a conversation, I used to go in there a lot. It's usually clean. If you don't go in there during a rush, it's a nice place to sit down and relax. This is my favorite Starbucks location in Philadelphia. Every other location has been disappointing.

In the past two-plus weeks:  Order on mobile, get to the store, the cafe is closed.  I didn't have time to wait in the LONG drivethrough line, so I abandoned the order.  (Went online; Starbucks refunded me, thank you.) Stopped by the next day, cafe closed again.  Another day, cafe open, went to the counter, waited over a minute while being completely ignored by the staff, so I left.

Today I went back, mobile order for a Nitro Cold Brew.  7+ minutes after the "drink will be ready time" I asked.  The order had been placed to a side because they didn't have any cold brew.  And I'd have to wait at the counter if I wanted a refund.  (Went online to get the refund later.)

A poorly managed store.  I won't be going back.

The staff here was always been nothing but friendly and they go above and beyond to get your order correct. While there are times where the drive thru line gets a bit long, that really isn't their fault, and they are always as speedy as they can be. I recently moved and was afraid I wouldn't love this location as my last one but luckily the staff here have been amazing. 

Should out to all the baristas here, as they really do go above and beyond. I ordered a Salted Caramel Mocha Frap with soy, and of course I didn't want the whipped cream. I asked if I could instead have some extra salt on the top. Lordy, the barista working was the best at getting "extra" salt right. She went above and beyond! Not just a shake, but she really gave me the salty topping I was craving. This place is great.

They forgot our order, but barista was very nice and asked us what our order was again. As this is a Starbucks, the drinks are expectedly good. Good location: right inside the mall! Cons are that because it is in the mall, the lines are very long.

Thought I'd try it out again. 

Disappointed, again. 

How can there be four employees, in the only one in line, and no one says a thing to me for 5 minutes?

I came in the store because the drive thru was ridiculous and long, but still just as frustrating.

This has got to be one of my favorite starbucks in Tucson. The staff is super friendly. Our order is always correct. It's the same as any other good starbucks except they are super friendly. It looks like young college students are working here and there is nothing wrong with that. If you are ever in this area, swing on by. You will not be disappointed.

Came in for an Oatmilk Latte. No Oatmilk. Ordered a bacon Gouda egg sandwich. Got a sausage & egg biscuit. However, there were only two ladies working this counter. The Oatmilk is the fault of management, not these ladies. The masks make getting orders correct, so it's not the end of the world. These ladies deserve a raise. This is Dec 30th at 2:45pm. Please ensure these ladies are recognized. 
PS: as I write this, the ordering line is out the door.

This Starbucks has a pretty wonderful staff and I really appreciate their little pride flag! Very cute! I like to go here when I can afford to, as I am a college student with very little allowance haha

I like Starbucks, however, this location is one of my least favorite, due to the parking lot/drive thru situation.  However, I was in the area and too early to show up at a meeting, so I stopped in.  The drive thru took 13 minutes from when I pulled in until when I pulled out.  I would give that a 1 star.  
I am giving 4 starts to this location because of the employees.  Each one I saw/spoke to (I was in the drive thru line) was pleasant and friendly.  They all seemed happy to be there and like they truly liked what they're doing.

I made a google account just to review this place, more
