From other reviews, I gather this used to be a pop-up Starbucks. It is now a permanent location. Masks are required via Philadelphia city mandate except when eating or drinking.  It was a very busy location, the loudest Starbucks I had visited this year.  Service was a bit slower than I am used to but I only saw three baristas, whom were all working very hard to fulfill the large volume of orders.  My order was done as expected and I enjoyed it.  The store was very clean except right outside, which is likely difficult to maintain since it is downtown Philly.
When you have your fave stick to it I enjoy my Venti Sugar Free Vanilla Skinny Latte and the consistency keeps me coming back!  If anyone loves me they know to bless me with Starbucks gift cards
Corporate businesses running on laws made by headquarters closed their dining room again.  Such a huge footprint for drive thur business. Out of stock and poor service is what you find here.

Great food. Occasionally they do not have almond or oat milk. This becomes frustrating when my vegan friend wants a coffee and it is not very possible. I wish they would stock up more. I love Starbucks, but also enjoy sitting down to enjoy my meal, there Is not much seating at this location. Overall, I'll still always come back, but I would like more stock in popular items.

Terrible. If you like burnt coffee , traffic jams, rude employees, and HAIR in your sandwiches, then come here. I've put up with a lot because of the convenience of this location to my house. However, it's becoming more of a hassle than a convenience these days . 

Just getting to the store involves a line similar to chick fila , but without the traffic controllers. Just a long angry line of frustrated people that have to dangerously navigate coming in and out on top of a slope. I've seen people get into fights over coffee. 

Once you get to the drive through, the price increases every couple of months. I paid $7 for a plain soy latte and that will be only news but next month. 

If the cost were worth it that would be one thing , but the service is terrible. The employees are rude if you address a concern and they goof off and get your order wrong. I have had burnt coffee, and cold lifeless sandwiches, for years. 

But when I got a long course curly HAIR in my sandwich I about threw up. I addressed this to an employee and he gave me a gift card that was less than the value of the sandwich. He didn't care, in fact he thought it was funny. 

I can sum up Starbucks as entitled and crappy. It's terrible food and service. And they don't care how hard you work to make your money. The days of customer service are over.

Aside from the customers life-lined to wifi here camped all over the furniture and strewn about the floor...no really, that was my experience the other day when I walked in-they were like homeless people!-well maybe some were-drinks were great and customer service excellent.

Right on the heart of the busy Canal Street area, you'll find this large and inviting location. This section of Canal is known for its more chain type stores and offers a lot to do, so refueling is a must. 

You can tell that this store is popular because it's lathe in size, has room for a line and offers a variety of seating options. They also carry the "you are here" New Orleans mug from there collectible series, if you want one. The design of this mug is one of my favorites and is a great representation of the city's offerings. 

Staff here was friendly and efficient. Our orders were always correct and the place was kept very clean. Despite the constant flow of foot traffic it was very well maintained, including the bathrooms. You'll need to ask for the door code to use the facilities, as a side note. 

Overall: A
Great location, central to a popular area and well kept.

Spacious and open. With eight less than comfortable chairs Starbucks seems to be building new stores these days to be less cozy and less hip and more efficient. Tables are made of pale wood including one large community table that seats eight people. 

The drink I ordered - a grande red eye - was spot on and filled almost to the top of the cup. Service was friendly and efficient. Location can't be beat.

This is really a top notcb Starbucks! It's larger than most, with lots of little areas for you to hang out with friends, or just sit alone and get some work done. 

The baristas are knowledgeable, quick, and don't seem to get flustered if there's a bit of a line. There often IS, but they get through it quickly and you never have to wait long on your coffee. 

They truly care about the community as well. I work for a children's theater, and they've welcome us with open arms to bring our kids in to read scripts. 

There's a super cozy fireplace, and great outdoor space for the summer months. 

This Starbucks does a great job of serving you like a neighborhood coffee shop and doesn't feel like a big chain conglomerate store like some of the rest.

I am a longtime Starbucks custom and have visited multiple sites across the US over the years , I stopped in to this site this AM to get a hot brew and use the site connectivity.  Expecting the best I had become accustom to, I unfortunately experienced more of the worst in a possible shop visit.

Coming in to the shop, no warmth in any kind of a greeting, I had to wait for a barista to help me (was first in line at the counter).  I typically am a simple order guy, tall coffee with cream .. simple right ?  9 out of 10 times the barista says let me get that poured up for you .. and seconds later I have a hot cupper.  Not so here ..

It took nearly 5 minutes to get my simple order
I got a cool cup :(
No "thank you", no attempt to get to know me at all (very cold setting)
I was Just another face asking for business and interrupting a busy drive up
Customers who ordered had to wait .. too long
Saw a mobile order customer come in and get "no order" which in watching took on a trend, saw multiple orders done incorrectly and the waiting queue continued :(
What comes to my mind as I watch the workers here  "the old video of Who is on 1st?"

Watching the crew they seem to be disinterested in customers on the whole (there were a couple of team members who were there because they truly wanted to be),  on a 1-10 have to sadly offer up a 3 here .. needs attention and leadership with a passion and vision.  Will not revisit ..

I stopped by this Starbucks to order my grandson breakfast. His usual breakfast consists of egg bites, strawberry refresher and a cake pop. I tossed in a cold brew coffee for me. 

Our order was filled in lightning speed and the staff was very friendly. The eggs were hot and our drinks were perfect.

Moderate small size for a starbucks, currently no bathroom availability due to covid.

The baristas are friendly and do a great job with your coffee, doesn't taste watered down. There is a row of seats facing market street, I don't believe you can sit there just yet. Not much products.

Overall clean place and easily accessible to the people who frequently pass by the fashion district 

Great location!

For me, it's great to have a Starbucks in the Philadelphia's Gayborhood, er um - Midtown Village (!). With my newfound love of Starbucks, this is like the perfect location to be on the make to mix-and-mingle with the locals.

Even though it has ample seating, there are many times where it just feels as though there isn't enough of it. 12th & Walnut is a busy junction between Market Street and Midtown Village, evermore so since the bustling old Cosi closed - which used to be my favorite place to hang out.

And because this location is most always so busy, it easily falls victim to cleanliness issues for the floor, the tables, and certainly the restrooms.

But the baristas are always super-nice, and they can be some of the more interesting characters among Starbucks baristas; there tends to be a rather bohemian-centric atmosphere here, due to the large numbers of Jefferson & UArts students in the nearby blocks.

12th & Walnut is not the most perfect Starbucks in town, but it certainly is one of the coolest and best-located Starbucks around.

Very slow!.  Placed mobile order which said 3-7 minutes.  Waited 20 minutes for coffee.  One barista wprking and in no hurry for anything.  When finally got it, the cup was sticky. There are multiple other starbucks locations within a 3 mile radius.  Go there and avoid this location.

This little gem is often overlooked as it sits inside of Sheraton City Center. Over the years I've seen two makeovers, and I believe this last one may provide optimal space. 
The hotel itself has added a seating area outside of the coffee shop, just in the hall area. The shop had removed several couches and put tables where they use to be... This is helpful to the business travelers that mostly frequent the hotel. 

The Starbucks isn't as artsy or involved as a free standing Starbucks. The staff isn't as hipster or as talkative as some of the other shops. They are mostly younger, high school or college students, who are friendly and upbeat. The service could be a little better, some of the lines get too long and at times the baristas are unsure of certain drinks. Especially ones that aren't on the menu...

I don't mind the wait, considering it's not one of the busiest Starbucks. Go here if you have time to spare, and are in the mood to lounge around in the lobby.
This is a great little Starbucks that I enjoy coming to before or after work. It can get very very busy though, especially on a Saturday.

The local Starbucks in Montecito, located on the commercial street of Coast Village Road. My wife likes to have coffee first thing in the morning, so I'll get into my car and drive from the Four Seasons, where we are staying and just 5 minutes away. This is a fairly large location, serving the locals. Lot's of foot traffic, but the 6 baristas behind the counter are super efficient moving the line, with professionalism and a smile. There is a huge parking lot, so it's really easy to get in and out!

Review for starbucks located in Terminal E- Delta.
Visited this kiosk around 4.45am prior to a 5.20 flight so I was impressed the baristas were friendly and quick at that ungodly hour. However the Grande cold brew I received was the worst I ever received. For the past year I've always ordered a black cold brew and this was so bitter that I needed to add a splash of half and half to cut the taste. Had I had more time prior to getting to my flight that was already boarding, I would have returned it for another coffee
Great customer service, and willing to make sure your pups get water if needed! There's another Starbucks closer to me but I'd choose this one any day of the week.

They have cold brew. I've been having it daily for a week. One day I had it twice. 

Looking at the amount of caffeine on Starbucks site. It has about the same amount of caffeine as a hot coffee. But hot coffee has 1g of protein and 15mg less sodium than the cold brew.

I ll switch back to hot coffee, and cheaper too

We've come to this Starbucks early on every Saturday for years.  We've tolerated the inconsistent service, the cranky manager, the Bible group that takes over the entire patio every Saturday because we love the location. This morning was possibly our last visit - there are tons of other SBs to choose from.  No attempt whatsoever to maintain the patio area - see the picture. We always have to clean off our own table, but this is ridiculous - I'm not going to sweep for them!  When someone slips and falls on the piles of leaves they might pay attention. Sloppy.

I visit this Starbucks location 1-2 times a week as it is on my way to work and convenient. They have recently remodeled the interior, but now seating is awkwardly arranged and crowded. 90% of the time my drinks and food orders are correct. The staff seems friendly but there are 1-2 workers that can be attitudinal. They never bother to ask my name or get to know me; however, I see others come in and they are very friendly. Good coffee and fairly quick. I'll keep coming in, but if I am out and about I prefer another Starbucks.

7/29/15: agree that this is the worst Starbucks I've been too. Customer service is ABSENT! The blond 50 something manager is horrible. I caught her talking about drive-thru customers in front of inside customers. She gave me no greeting at all...I'm talking no "good morning", "welcome to Starbucks"...nothing. I'm done with this location.
AGAIN This is the worst STARBUCKS in Indy 22 min waiting on Drive -Thru   I can not believe that more and more this Sturbucks has the slowest service I've seen.

Great atmosphere unfortunately bad service this time, I have to agree with Martin J.'s review felt uncomfortable, people should be in the back if they don't want to be warm n friendly to whoever walks thru those doors. Next time I'll have to just order online :/

I've been to this Starbucks a few times in the past. Today I visited through the drive thru. They were pretty quick to take my order at the speaker and I was able to confirm that the order was correct on the large screen. I wanted to try their new espresso today and ordered a blonde flat white. I also ordered a spinach feta wrap, my go to breakfast sandwich...Only 290 calories made with egg white, feta cheese, roasted tomatoes and spinach in a crunchy wrap. Yummy! 

The drive thru line moved rather quickly. Once I got up to the drive-thru window it took a while before I was even acknowledged. When I received my coffee it was made incorrectly even though it clearly stated how I wanted it on the screen when I ordered. At this point the drive-thru line began to back up not only because I had to wait to be acknowledged and pay, but also because now they had to make the drink correctly. Starbucks is known for wanting you to be satisfied with your drink otherwise they will remake it, which they did and they did a fine job. I just felt bad for the growing line of cars behind me. 

While I typically like a strong coffee, the blonde flat white was surprisingly sweet and smooth. I would definitely order it again! The spinach feta wrap was piping hot which I prefer. I've gotten the same breakfast sandwich at other Starbucks and there have been many times it's still cold in the middle. Yuck!  Overall it was a good visit. I have yet to find a Starbucks that compares to the location in Carrollwood, but because I pass this location certain times during the week I would definitely return for convenience alone.

My go to Starbucks that is temporarily closed due to renovations where they bought the bank next door and are making a drivethru. They always got my order right and would often put any of the drizzled for the Frapps on the bottom and sides of the cup as well as the top, where many others only do the top.
I love Starbucks, but parking at this location is horrendous. I wanted to run in for an iced coffee this morning, but after circling the parking lot several times, I gave up and left.
I prefer panera much better. But when your in the need for caffeine. Had to stop

Love that they 20 minutes closed earlier than their advertised time and several people were in line trying to get coffee and were completely ignored by the girl inside with a headset.  
Utterly pissed.  I need to make a long drive tonight and need some coffee.

Imagine my surprise when I found you just around the corner. No longer will I have to drive the long route to get my sweet fix. Newly build location, lots of parking, great flow of traffic, and huge inside. Well bigger than the ones I have been to here in Tucson. I ordered my drink, which promptly came up with a smile. The crew reminded me of one of my favorite stores in Washington State. It is so relaxing in here. Maybe my drink taste better because it has a new feeling to it. Either way I am loving the style, the location, the feel.

Excellent Starbucks, they don't do mobile orders but they did take my phone order a couple of times and had it ready when I was there. In the back of the hotel by the Starbucks, there are three parking spots with 15 minute parking if you need to zip in and zip out.  Excellent customer experience.

Very RUDE! USE ANOTHER LOCATION!! I have never had more poor service in my life, women working were rolling their eyes as if my order was an issue. Customer service is your job!! As a former server for over 7 years this was unacceptable to me! I will be advising everyone I know to use other locations.

Worst salted caramel mocha frappacino ever. They forgot the blend it. So basically I had iced coffee with whip cream. 
not what I wanted or expected when they make these drinks every day. This is the reason I don't normally come to this Starbucks. Staff does not pay attention.

Encouraged by request a return. And also by remodeling. I ventured back.  I waited exactly 17 minutes for a Trenta iced tea.  It actually is faster yo drive to snogher star bucks  management comes up short. So it's faster to stop at Paneras.

I've been here plenty of times and had mixed service.  Frankly, I'm sick of it.  Yeah, it's a Starbucks but:

1) When you walk in and nobody is behind the counter, that's bullcrap

2) When you discover the person who is supposed to be behind the counter is talking to somebody in the little lounge area, that's a "it should be OK to shoplift something as reparations" scenario

3) When a second person magically appears to ring you up and asks "do you want something to nibble on?" that's falling into  "it should be legal for me to punch you in the face" territory

4) When you order an iced drink for your beautiful wife and it comes out hot, that's "eff them, I'm finally writing a review on Yelp."

And here we are.  Service (at least on weekdays) is on par for Starbucks found in hotels and airports -- OK product, crappy service.

And for the love of everything good, don't eat their food.  I've had bars of soap that offered better flavor and texture.

Great location. The shop is not too busy even on a weekend afternoon. There's a lot of comfortable seating and the inside has a spacious feel with many leather armchairs and several small tables scattered about, plus a larger table for students to spread out their books. Food selection is good. The staff are friendly and fast.

Ahhh Starbucks, my guilty pleasure. It never disappoints when I need the pick me up only a skinny Caramel vanilla can give me. There is usually alone at this one because it's so close to the hospital and other off its but service is usually quick and friendly. The everything bagel with cream cheese, the savory squares, or the veggie breakfast sandwich are all great additions to any drink (yes that bill will end up being $9/$10) 
If you haven't already- get the app and if you're not a fanatic, it will certainly make you into one.

Awful parking and one of the entrances is one way only. Really difficult access. A few years ago they changed all the seating and instead of comfy chairs and small tables they went to a large center table  with community seating (e.g. no privacy) and hard bench seating. Maybe that's purposeful to get people to not stay as long.

Local Starbucks coffee shop on Jefferson Hwy.  There's not a lot of seating; a few tables, a couple of recliners, and a sofa.  Standard Starbucks free wifi, no need for a pass code.  The coffee shop is clean. The service is fast.  Lots of Starbucks accessories for sale, as well as the coffee and pastries.  Basically what you would expect from the national chain.

The absolute best team in the entire Starbucks franchise organization.  No joke.

I've had the blessing to live in many towns and cities across the U.S. over the years. And been a Starbucks customer forever. Okay not really forever. As long as I can remember though. 

So I've been able to meet and get to know many baristas in those travels.  Since I work from home, for myself, I go to Starbucks a LOT.  No joke there either! 

I am moving back to California today, exactly one year since I moved here to Oro Valley.  And in this past year, I have been to this Starbucks almost every day, and many times, twice a day. So somewhere in the range of 600 times or more.  

Starbucks baristas are great everywhere I have been.  Here though? A different level of service. And the team - every last one of them, have become like family in some ways. Yeah, you may think that's crazy.  Except it's not. 

These people have come to truly care about me as an individual person, and I them.  We've gotten to talk about life, and goals, hopes and dreams, challenges and obstacles and so much more...  It happens when you spend as much time going to Starbucks as I do.  And when the staff all really are that good.  

So thank you to  the entire team, for making my year in Oro Valley that much more enjoyable!

Oh - and yeah, the Venti SKVL is perfect with 6 shots of Vanilla, or 7 depending on the mood of the day.  :-)

This Starbucks is aways crowded, which isn't neccessarily a bad thing-it IS the only Starbuck around.  

I suggest NOT going through the drive-thru because there is always a long line. Just step inside and you will be served much quicker and you can actually meet the people who are making your coffee.

The last several times I have visited this location, the staff is very different. This used to be one of my favorite locations, but not so much anymore. One of the baristas made my latte as a macchiato, then mis-made it again as a macchiato, and the third time got it right. No problem, but not one "sorry" or even a "your welcome" when I said thanks. Last weekend, she made a SF cinnamon dolce latte instead of a SF caramel latte...again no apology when I noted it wasn't the correct flavor. 

The staff used to be very friendly and on spot. Not so much now.

From 7am to 12:30pm this is the best Starbucks in all of Reno, the coffee is hot the service is fast and pleasent and the drinks are made correct.....   Any time after 12:30pm the service go hell in a hand bag!  I have stopped by for a cup of coffee and they have no fresh coffee, they have to brew it... Give me a break, what coffee place at 3pm doesn't have coffee..............

THIS PLACE!

I have stopped going to this particular location because of one thing: employee X. He is usually grumpy, always trying to sell people extra products, and has loud, awkward and inappropriate conversations with some customers. I've never seen him smile. Even though this location is close and convenient for me, I won't return if Mr X is working. If you go and he's working, you will know within a minute and you won't be pleased.
The only thing that could make Starbucks better would be if a coffee/green tea didn't cost almost five dollars.  They always have the best staff and great drinks

Starbucks in general is not my favorite coffee place. In my humble opinion, there are always better places to get coffee. That being said, it is a necessary evil because it is the most accessible place to go when I am in need of coffee and I don't have time to find something else. I have been to a couple other locations closer to my apartment, but this location is my favorite in Tampa so far. I like it because of its location--I'm a student at USF, and this location is easily accessible when I'm coming or going from campus. Sometimes I stop on the way to school, other time I stop here to drink coffee and do some extra studying after school. Starbucks is on campus, of course, but the line to get coffee is always out the door. I also like this location because it is consistent (so far). My current favorite thing to order is the salted sweet cream cold foam cold brew. This place makes it best. The sweet cream foam is the STAR of this drink. It should be light and fluffy and sit on top of the cold brew. Oftentimes when I order this at other locations, the foam goes flat and dissolves into the drink before it even gets in my hands. Finally, my service here has always been pleasant and the atmosphere is pleasant. If it's not busy, it's a great place to zone out to some study music and get some work done. However, the inside space is small, so I can see how it might not be the best place to go during busy hours. All in all, I enjoy this Starbucks.

Rating Starbucks is like rating McDonald's: what's the point?  Yep, it's a Starbucks on Market Street attached to the huge Marriott hotel.  About what you'd expect from a Starbucks.  No better, no worse.

This is the most horrible place ever you want to start your morning with . 
I had the most impatient cashier when I came in .she rushed to get my order even there was no one else in line - and of course - messed up my drink . Not just that - I handed her $20 , she took my money , turned around and came back ask me to pay again . Never again !
This is by far the worst Starbucks I have been too.  They our so rude and can't handle customized drinks at all.  Go ahead and drive the extra mile to kingshighway Starbucks.

I continue to order from this Starbucks because it's the most convenient location for me but this has got to be the most unprofessional Starbucks anywhere, everyone  behind the counter is totally rude and unpleasant every single day, they should all be trained in customer service
Why the hell has it taken 20+ minutes each time I've ordered today when it's not that busy? This is ridiculous and I will never come here again.

Before everyone jumps all over me for giving two stars, let me explain: I'm cold. 

Temperatures in St. Louis often reach 105 degrees, and it certainly did when I visited this Starbucks. That's why I chose to take my laptop inside, sip a smoothie, and complete an hour of freelance. That hour, unfortunately, turned into two simply because the air conditioning is jacked for an eskimo. My hands could barely type and I had to keep fixing my stiff-fingered typos, but I was determined to bang out this assignment, so I stayed until the glacial end. Seriously, I get that it's balls-hot outside, but that doesn't mean that you have to have the indoor temperature set to 55 degrees to compensate. It's ridiculous. I should not have to bring fingerless gloves to a coffeeshop.

Other than that, things were ok. Nothing was too exciting to write home about. Service was average, strawberry banana smoothie was average, music was average, wifi speed was average. Points for being open on Memorial Day. Had this location not been an ice cavern, I'd have been inclined to stay and sample a pastry. Alas, the Chippewa Starbucks is getting crossed off my list of un-home office places because I don't want to bring my parka everywhere I go.

This is my favorite Starbucks of all the local spots. As others have mentioned, the parking is a tough situation especially in the morning. The staff is really stellar however, the drinks are great and it's always super clean.

I always great and friendly service here. My order always taste great. The only downfall is the speed of service. This store is really slow, but due to it's convenient location it doesn't make sense to drive to another store. Just wish they would pick up the speed, I've never waited less then 20 minutes in the drivethru!

I really like this Starbucks. They have more seating then most of the local coffee shops around this area and the big table have plugs in the table so you don't have wires everywhere. The staffs are nice, plus this is the only Starbucks with a drive thru around downtown so whenever I'm lazy, this is my spot.
I love Starbucks, and maybe I'm biased from living in the Seattle area but this is consistently the slowest one I've ever been to.
has a lot of room to sit an relax. it is very clean and has a friendly staff.

I love the staff here.  Keep it up!  We need some happy faces to keep the vibes fresh and friendly here.  Especially in front of the kids play area.  Where the sleep deprived ultrasensitive parents require chemical compensation for their lack of sleep & depth of compassionate patience for their miniscule counterparts that want nothing other than to slide down the cow, balance on the log and ride the rubber canoe.
Excellent service. Clean and very fast. I enjoyed the workers at this location. Liked the late hours. We came in late on out flight kids were hungry and was the only placed open st that time.

I like this location, the staff and even the patrons are nice here.

I don't know that there is a ton to say about Starbuck's in particular.  I think it's important to point out bad service or a dirty store, but truly I have yet to see a Starbucks in those conditions.

Nice location. Decided to stop by after work before heading home. The staff here has always been friendly and pretty quick. The location has always seemed clean. Plenty of places to sit both inside and out. And if you're in a hurry there is a drive-thru. Its easy to access this location from Illinois, or Senate via 15th Street so there is no reason not to stop by and grab your favorite drink.
Relaxing place, I pass everyday. I enjoy the coffee and the people there are really nice.

I visit the Winthrop location several times a week because I work in the plaza. Even when I'm not in the area I travel to this specific location because the baristas here make it worth it! Most are very nice but my favorites are Parker and Josh. They always remember my order and always get it going without me having to say much. They make me feel like a valued customer.  They both deserve promotions!!

The last four years in Santa Barbara have been filled with late night papers and early morning exams.  This starbucks helped me through each one.  What a great environment and the partners working there are amazing!   Coffee is quality, environment is great, and staff is friendly -- what more could you ask?  

Unfortunately, because it relies on Westmont College for a lot of its customers and even employees, the turnover in employees can seem a bit high.  But it manages to stay high quality despite the constant adjustments.

Supposedly there is a huge revamp coming soon!  I'm excited to see it.

This is my favorite Starbucks in the Nashville area. I stop by most work days after work & then on the weekend in between breakfast and lunch. I've never had to wait a long period of time. 

They have plenty of outlets to charge devices, which is a great plus - this includes outside, which is super helpful. 

Their baristas are pretty great - and Ashley, the manager, is awesome. They are always pleasant and helpful - and willing to accommodate. The last time I placed a mobile order,they had run out of one of the things I ordered. I was greeted immediately & received a genuine apology & they gave me two of my second choice to make up for it. 

My only complaint about this location is sometimes they train baristas at really busy time - which I understand they have to get used to, but it definitely slows everyone down.

Do not waste your time here! And believe me, you will waste A LOT of time. This place is a disaster and an embarrassment to the Starbucks name. Aside from the terrible location that other reviews have mentioned, the low level of service and attitudes of staff who simply could care less, defy explanation. After a long break, I went back early on a Saturday. The drive thru circled around the building as usual so I went in. There were at least 20 people waiting for their orders, only one person at the register, and one person who may or may not have been a manager, who did not look up or get off her cell phone the entire time I was there (approx 30 minutes). The staff moved at a snail's pace. There was a steady line of customers asking about their orders or with incorrect orders that had to be remade which only slowed things down more. The young man at the register was more concerned about making sure his hair was in place. I did not appreciate watching him run his hands through his hair multiple times and then handle pastry orders for customers. I made sure he was not the who touched my food or I would have definitely said something. Apparently there are plenty of people who don't mind spending their money here but I will not be one of them.

I'm actually writing this review because the barista I encountered here tonight was very friendly but unfortunately that has not always been the case. There are a lot of people out there who refuse to go to Starbucks for so many reasons nowadays, but alas, here I am at Starbucks. When I have time to go to local coffee shops I will, but when I don't have time, this is the closest thing on my way to work that has a drive-thru. I was so excited to finally see a full Starbucks store on the south end of town. Unfortunately a few of the first times I went here I was greeted by many rude baristas and it was usually in the morning or afternoon. Rude meaning, never smiling, never greeting you (upon entrance or departure), and on a couple of occasions I've even heard them speaking poorly about their customers (myself included) and criticized what people order. If a barista from this store is looking at this review, really? How awful of a person are you if you are literally speaking badly about a customer as they're standing at the bar right in front of you? I'm sorry if the baristas here get bored of making the classics over and over again, but sometimes they are the first people a customer sees when their day starts, so the least they could do is show good customer service. The reason I bumped the stars up on this review is because recently others have started working here and the atmosphere has changed. The baristas that work here now are friendly and helpful. This location in particular has WiFi, outdoor seating, and a nice indoor area full of open space. Side note though, every time I have sat inside I've been greeted by a dirty table no matter what time of the day it is. It doesn't take that long to wipe down the tables for your customers.
This has to be the worst Starbucks in Edmonton. The staff of very rude, and the ambiance of this location is depressing.
Starbucks is always good. I always order the same thing, creature of habit, the mocha frappe light with coconut milk. It's easy and delicious!
Service is better during the day. Night shift doesn't care about anything but closing early. Stood by the counter for 10 minutes while I waited for my drink that was sitting on the counter.

This Starbucks location has always been problematic.   I go to numerous Starbucks..and this location comes up short in terms of customer service.  There are some excellent baristas..especially.  JC , Amy, John  and Ben.  However, this is counterbalanced by the vast majority of the baristas who show gross deficiencies in customer service skills.  
 
There is a homeless population who patronizes this store.  I am ok with that..and , in fact,  I am on friendly terms with most of them.  The problem comes.. once again..with the baristas who tend to see any person of color.. who is a regular ..as freeloaders and/or  homeless.  Everyone should be treated with respect regardless of their circumstances. ..and the staff needs to stop painting patrons with a broad brush. 

What differentiates each Starbucks is the level of customer service.   This store consistently ranks at the bottom in this regard.  I prefer other Starbucks where the customer service and training appears to be far superior.

Normally this Starbucks is very fast and professional. Today staff member wouldn't give me the half & half to pour myself. She would only do it herself from behind the counter. I'm sorry but this is not acceptable. Is cream so expensive the customer who pays premium prices for coffee cannot indulge in the cream?

Love this place, the staff and the atmosphere. Great place to study and bring your computer. The only thing is that they close at 10:30pm but oh well, there are other places that stay up later for night owls like us. Still its a great place and right next to several chain restaurants in case you are hungry.

I love Starbucks, who doesn't? I've even worked there three times in my career during college. So I know how to make drinks correctly, and I can say that my drinks here have never been made quite correctly.

Today especially, I left incredibly infuriated. I asked for a Passion Tea Lemonade with three pumps of Raspberry. The barista behind the bar made me a Passion Tea only with raspberry, and the minute I got it, I knew there was no lemonade in it. I watched her fill the shaker with water instead of lemonade right in front of me. 

When I confronted her about it, she told me I said only Passion Tea. The barista who rung me up backed me up, told her that I asked for lemonade with it, and instead of remaking me my drink, she poured out half of my watery passion tea that I had paid extra for with the raspberry and filled it half with lemonade. She didn't remake it, she just adlibbed. That's not how you make drinks, and it's an especially easy drink to make.

Next time, don't jip me on my money. I won't be coming back here.

So this is my "local" SBUX...meaning...it's super close walking distance to work.  I'm not a coffee drinker anymore but I do love me some tea! 

My order?  I've got a hot and a cold fave...

Hot:  Grande calm with steamed soy.
Cold:  Iced Venti 2 pumps classic with strawberry black tea lemonade.

This location is friendly and I've never encountered a line.  My only complaint?  My hot drink of choice usually has way too much foam...almost like a wet cappuccino.  4 stars.
Teeny tiny location. Quick, friendly service and oddly not busy during the mid afternoon. Loses a star for not really having anywhere to sit inside.
This morning crew is great.  I hadn't even paid yet and was second in line when the barista behind the counter asked what she could start for me.  This may be my new fav store.
Love this Starbucks location. They always remember who we are and what we like to order. And obviously they make great coffee!
The theme song from cheers comes to mind. They know me. This will be my Starbucks no matter where I move. If I ever really kick the habit...... Who are we kidding.

I give this place 2 stars for its service only, which is friendly.  However it gets only 2 stars because they don't know anything about coffee.  The customer behind me asked what the difference is between a regular drip coffee and an americano.  The barista looked at her for a long time with a confused look and then told her that it was a "darker coffee with more caffeine because it has espresso in it."  If you know ANYTHING about coffee, you know he's wrong on all counts...  Didn't expect much, but misinformation is worse than just saying "I don't know."

This location is definitely not my favorite. It's hard to get in and out of the parking lot, it's a fairly busy location and so it's extremely loud inside. I came here to have a date with my girlfriend and there was no where to sit so we had to sit in the car. Service has always been nice enough but nothing above and beyond. There is a drive thru at this location.

This place offers a very comfortable environment to meet with people.  The Starbucks regional office is next door to this location, so of course the staff are the best Starbucks have to offer.  They are on their toes and do a lot to help make your experience the best. 

This place is very LBTQ oriented and you will see many family members while on your visit, both working and enjoying the experience.

If you need coffee QUICKLY this is the Starbucks to go to! Even with a line around the building you can get through the drive thru in minuets. It is actually very impressive how fast and nice they are! So if you work downtown and need your coffee fix before, this Starbucks will save your life!

This is my favorite time of the year since all the holiday flavors come back. It makes it harder to decide what to order. The employees were super friendly and patient. I kept making edits to my order and the girl helping me was more than happy to fix it. Yes, I was that person today. Service was super fast even though the store was busy. To drink, I ordered a lite, half caff, salted caramel mocha with no whip. The drink was perfect. I ordered a premade bacon chicken sandwich with my drink. The sandwich tasted really good but was a little on the drier side, even though it stated there was a mustard sauce on it.
Too expensive, skimp on milk, don't fill cup.  And what's up with the cup?  Why red are they glorifying communism....  Go someplace else

On the road and needed lunch. I was hoping to find the elusive and delicious egg salad but no luck. I chose a Thai Chicken 20 g box. Tasted good and I would do it again. Friendly counter service. As stated in the checkin photo this place is huge.

Everyone was nice but as a former Starbucks employee and manager I was disappointed at the wait time. There was only one employee making drinks and he wasn't multi tasking or calling ahead. Maybe it was an off day

I love Starbucks coffee. Go there often. Just experienced the absolutely worse service ever. The cashier was rude. When my coffee came out it was not what I ordered. I politely told the barista and she argued with me and walked off and said something bad as she walked off. Her name was Chris. Little did she know there were other people who saw her. I will never return to this location again!

Hit or miss. I dont drink Starbucks a lot but when I do I come to this location. Majority of the time I get my drink right away and the people are nice but it seems lately that they don't care about their customers. Three times in a row that I have been here the people were rude and they forgot my drink!! The first time they forgot my drink it was about 20 minutes later from when I ordered so I went up and told them and they said there was no order for It even though it was on my receipt. They didn't apologise or say it was on the house, so 30 minutes later I got my drink. The second time, the girl was very nice and apologised and said the drink was on the house but the third time they were very rude and seemed put off that I was telling them I was missing my order.

Though the staff is very very nice, the actual shop itself leaves much to be desired.  I understand that this is a busy spot, the floor is often dirty and the layout should have been re-designed because it doesn't flow well.  Out of the starbucks' throughout Philly, this is definitely not the best.  I go there just about every monday night before my acting class but not because I specifically choose this exact location- it's out of practicality and the fact that my class is across the street.  If the interior matched the politeness of the staff, I would give it at least 3 or 4 stars but alas, they have a lot of work to do.

Cute place to grab a drink with a friend but be prepared to wait, because I waited 10 min for a passion tea and my buddy waited 10 for a smoothie. And this visit was not during peak hours. 2 stars because they got my drink right on the first try.

I've been here for 20min waiting for 4 drinks. I have watched 3 phone in orders come in and go out ahead of me.  I have also watched 4 customers who ordered behind me leave and there have been at least 10 cars go through the drive through as well.  I guess I should have stayed in my car..  Not sure what the hold up for my ice tea is, is but I've never been inside a Starbucks this long. Boo...
(The drinks were made well...so there's that)

Let me preface this review by stating that I go to Starbucks more that I probably should and 99% of the time I have an awesome experience.  The coffee is overpriced -yes- but I always enjoy what I get.  Today, July 25,2016 at 10:25am, was no exception and my drink was fabulous!  My Barista, Jen, not so much.

After my two companions and I received our drinks from barista JEN (her nametag is written in all caps) she proceeded to wash something on the other side of the partition where we had just picked up our drinks.  While plunging whatever it was she was washing into the water, the contents splashed on me, one I was with, the counter, and the floor (appeared to be whipped cream or possibly the remnance of a Frappuccino).  I kindly let her know there was now a sticky mess on the floor (twice) and received no acknowledgement.  Thinking maybe she didn't hear me I told her again and included the fact that the sticky mess was also on two of us.  Her curt reply was "OK, I know", while not even looking at me.

I have never received such rude customer service at this, or any other Starbucks, that I can remember.  Barista Jen displayed terrible customer service.  A thoughtful apology would have been nice but I, at the very least, would have liked to have been acknowledged.
Have to agree with most, the staff isn't as friendly & responsive as the other Starbucks in the area.

I have been to Starbuck's stores all over this lovely country of ours, and usually receive excellent service, and delicious coffee.  Unfortunately the same cannot be said for this particular location.  From the management down through the ranks, rudeness and condescending attitudes abound at this store.  It's as if they all could care less if you patronize the place or not. 
Nearby locations that meet the usually excellent Starbuck's experience are in St. Clair Square Mall, and one located in the Target Store; both located in Fairview Heights, IL. Just a short drive down the road from this terribly awful hell hole of a store.
Please understand that this review was written after many and repeated 2nd chances.  Oh, it is filthy too!

The baristas are always super nice. 
One of the few company owned Starbucks downtown.... Surprisingly there never a long wait time even with then being in the middle of downtown
One of the better Starbucks locations in the area. Free wifi by Google. Employees are courteous. Solid resource nearby.

I love Starbucks. Forget what people say about Dunkin' Donuts--that's bilge water! I don't even drink coffee anymore, but they offer an array of herbal teas iced and hot, and lately I've been treating myself to dark chocolate-covered graham crackers. Don't judge.

That being said, I must concur with many Yelp reviewers in noting that this branch is THE most inefficient location I've ever frequented. First, although the line is routinely interminably long, only ONE register is open. Employees appear to be milling about in the background doing who knows what. True, other baristas are busy filling ridiculously complicated drink orders ("Ummmm...I'll have a half-caf iced Americano with a splash of coconut milk, a smidge of soy, and the tears of the woman behind me in line who's screaming and pulling her hair out."), but still. 

The other day, two middle-aged women conferred with the cashier for 15 minutes as I waited (uncharacteristically) my turn patiently. Were they opening an offshore bank account, transferring money from their hedge fund to checking? No; for the life of me, I have no clue what the heck was happening, despite my earnest attempts at eavesdropping. Variations of this scenario are repeated daily, but this is the location closest to me.

The workers here are very friendly, and I usually tip, but I take serious umbrage with the extremely poor service. I kind of enjoy getting worked up about stuff, so I'll totally continue to patronize this Starbucks, but still...

1798044 was really rude, no personality at all. Yea coffee is coffee at any Starbucks but Baristas are what make you or break you! Your job may not define you but you never know what opportunities can come from one interaction with a customer.

as a motorized Wheelchair user I find the regular route is just too tight, so if they're not too busy or not I usually go the wrong way (not the first time) 
Those fireplace seats must get filled before the sun comes up, time limit??
Great comfortable patio out front! 
Staff usually friendly, some not! 
Drive Thru

It's a Starbucks. If you've been to one you've been to them all. While many people prefer Dunkin' Donuts coffee or other brands, Starbucks is my coffee choice. This is my normal Starbucks store. The service is fairly decent however the drive-through line is always long and it's kind of loud inside. But again I'm going for coffee not to sit in a quiet place and read a book.

The muffin that I got was a dried out disappointment and I couldn't even finish it. When I ordered I asked for a peppermint white mocha with no whip and when my drink came out it was half empty  because the top half was full of melting whipped cream. It was also not stirred well and while at first I thought there was no peppermint in it, after a couple of sips it was just all peppermint syrup and the sugar made me not want to finish the drink either. So all in all I paid $8 for half a muffin and half a drink. It was not worth it.

On the positive side, everything was well stocked (it was 8 a.m.) and the presentation was pleasant. The Starbucks was clean and they were quick. However, I believe there is another Starbucks after the security checkpoint and in the future that is the one I will go to.

It's a typical Starbucks and I always feel like I'm an idiot when I'm trying to order coffee here! I just don't get all the lingo that I suppose coffee aficionados use! Still, staff is friendly but I do find the service to be a bit slow at times. I find their coffee to be a bit on the pricey side and a bit stronger than I usually prefer. I do really like their hot chocolate! Still, this is a clean Starbucks with available indoor and outdoor seating along with a drive-thru. The parking lot is not overly big and during busy times, you just need to be extra careful.

Small place, very friendly staff, and always great Frappuccinos.
One large table and plenty of seats around.
Very small parking lot

You take time to write a review if is really good or the opposite:(( 
I like this location, nothing really that can be criticized other then long lines every time but I like the crowd:)) the outside patio is great!!!!
But... I only give 3 stars because every time I go they misunderstand my order. Now I learned to read what they write on my cup... Misspelling my name is fun! But me repeating a few time "coconut milk please" is embarrassing! If I see they put my drink in dairy blender I know they got wrong and I ask again.... Some are funny and chat with you, make a nice comment but yesterday both girls(the one that took order and one made my drink) forced me write the review this morning:(( she took a long time to make this mocha  frap with coconut!!!! milk... Chat with her coworker that was carrying buckets of ice, making jokes between the two, got distracted with so many other moves around, meantime started like few other drinks... literally I saw my drink waiting at every step to get to the next... It was in blender for like over 2!minutes because she served a few other drinks.. She even took time to rinse the blender cup and top before she got a top for my drink to serve it... My drink got to me very watery because it was melting already  and not much flavor... I don't think I had all ingredients in it... But I had to run... Otherwise I would have told them to remake it... Did not risk it for another long wait. 

What can I say... I will go there again because the nice location and very convenient to enjoy a sunny morning...

There are four basic things I expect from Starbucks: coffee, free WiFi, cozy atmosphere, and plenty of electrical outlets. This particular Starbucks has a grand total of one outlets, jammed in a corner that is anything but cozy. The positive here is that there is more parking than you could ever hope for. And this seems to be the trend in this area... If the Starbucks has great inside atmosphere with plenty of electrical outlets, you can rest assured the parking lot has been designed for miniature, toy cars. If there's plenty of parking, the inside is cold and unappealing. But so it goes.

This location has an entrance inside the Philadelphia Marriott Hotel. I visited the spot due to wanting an Iced Caramel Machiato after a wedding. This location was on point because it was just super conveniently located in the lobby of the hotel. The server gave me my drink but she made it hot. It wasn't her fault though. I assumed it would be cold. I'm not knowledgeable of what to ask for. It was real chill in there that night. Folks were enjoying themselves being by themselves doing the Starbucks thing. The only downer I have is that they didn't have any poundcake left. Other than that it was all good.

It can get crowded at times, and for some reason they will assign one of the less-experienced/slower baristas during those times. I feel bad for them because they're clearly struggling, and are flustered when people tell them their drink wasn't made correctly. I personally just let it go, but if I was in a rush, or really picky that day, I could see getting annoyed. After all, the drinks are pricey at $4+. I like it best here during a less busy afternoon.

Sometimes there can be a long time, especially around 4pm during the week . However, after this rush, the store quiets downs and the baristas are always friendly. The Starbucks is the closest one the the hospital and is great to pick up treats. The baristas are very nice and make excellent drinks. There is always a slew of food and fresh baked goods to chose from. The seating is spacious, although the store could use a little bit of updating. The bathrooms are sub-par, but there really isn't anywhere else to go to the bathroom In the area so they serve their purpose.

Mobile ordering sucks. My sandwich was cold by the time I received my drink 15 minutes later. Which by the way was wrong. Then I was handed 2 drinks without any indication of which was made correctly. Uggggggg

I love that this location has a drive thru! I wish all Starbucks did. That way I wouldn't have to go inside and see all the douchebags hanging out all day pretending to write novels and screenplays. This location always seems to be busy, probably because there aren't many Starbucks in the area. They still manage to keep the line moving pretty quickly.

Josh makes the best Bacon and Gouda sandwich I have ever had a Sbucks....and he is just a pleasant person to be in conversation with because of his warm smile and friendly tone. Glad to live near this great location. (Mark the corporate "who ever" needs to take some pointers from him, my sister and I had horrible service from him recently and an incorrect order, assuming from his lackadaisical order taking/ communication skills)
Love this location! Always great service, friendly,fast, always get my order right, and drive through is the biggest plus.

I always like to find a hidden gem, and I think I've found it in this Starbucks location. The store has opened up in the last month or so, and it's tucked away in a small new mall complex in northeast Edmonton just off Manning Drive.

I was happy with it mainly because it's very quiet here. I had been here once before when I had some business in the area and it was empty. I thought it would be the perfect location to get some work done out of the house. This morning several of the tables were full but quickly emptied.

It seems like the interior designers at Starbucks are mixing things up a little bit lately and I've been in a couple new locations that are a bit different in their look. This location is done in dark colours, but has lots of light, so it's a pleasant environment.

I'll definitely be back here. Overall it's a very comfortable location to work in. If anyone wanted to complain, and someone always does, you could criticize them for not having any armchairs to relax in. (I'm not complaining.)

Busyness - It's pretty new and I don't know that many people know about it yet. So, don't come here and make it busy! ;)

Noisiness - Not many people here yet, so it's not noisy. Lots of hard surfaces here though, so once the blenders get going this summer, it ought to be pretty noisy. If you don't like that, then sit out on the large patio. It's a quiet neighbourhood, so it's a great location to soak up some sun and not have to listen to a lot of traffic. They keep the music at just the right level too.

Ambience - It's a very pleasant environment; relaxing and at just the right temperature. 

Power - There are outlets for each table.

Free wifi - Present and works well. I appreciate the ease of logging on to the Starbucks wifi.

Staff - I don't think I've ever had a complaint about a Starbucks employee. They are all good here and all the coffee fixings were loaded up.

Seating -Inside there are 34 seats and 15 out on the patio. There are 10 seats on a comfortable bench, 16 on wooden chairs and 8 of the seats are at a bar. The bulk of the tables are round, so they're not that great, but there's space for the laptop. The tables outside are definitely not built to work on, but if you're outside, you shouldn't be working anyway. Relax!

Security - It's a nice neighbourhood, but that never stopped anyone, did it?

Nothing spectacular about this location. They don't "wow" you with their service, but don't give you a rude vibe either. The few times I have been here, my drinks were made accurately and they had all of their pastry items in stock. Also, the location is extremely convenient. With the high school down the street, a grocery store across the way and a nail salon next door, it is one of the most convenient Starbucks locations around.

Beautiful remodel! Nice new selection of sandwiches too!!! One of our fab spots.

Why don't they have someone to clean the tables at Starbucks all locations? It's not my job to clean a table before I sit down to enjoy my purchase!!!

Not friendly, verrrry slow, and not good at blending the coffee drinks - everything tastes exactly the same. Definitely not my favorite Starbucks!
Update: today=grumpiest barista on the planet! And the music is appalling. And when I nicely said something about the terrible music to the terrible barista, he just looked at me and shrugged his shoulders

Yay!! nice roomy location, plenty of seating and friendly staff and near enough for me to drop in once in a while. The seating is prefectly set for individuals or large groups without creating a jam in foot traffice around the tables.

The best Starbucks in the city! I go about 3 or 4 times a week and I love everyone here. Their service is exceptional every single time I visit ! I live on the north east side but I only go to this one that is by my work because they are so friendly and awesome ! And the drinks always taste better, but it could be my biased taste buds ;)
The absolute worse Starbucks I have ever been to. None of the AC outlets work so you can not charge your laptop. I will never come here again. Good Bye Starbucks and Hello Dunkin Donuts!!!!

I don't review chains.   I would always give them a three,   McDonalds; 3, Subway; 3, Taco Bell; 3, In ' Out; 3 (ok, 4).  Anyway, you get the picture.    But this Starbucks is different and while every other Starbucks in the world would probably get a three this one gets a four.  Let me explain:

It's not for the service, in fact the girl who gave me my coffee was kind of rude.  The coffee and the pastries look like any other Starbucks so no extra points there.   It is the people watching!   Wow!   The place is packed and it is full of a very diverse and amazingly entertaining group of people.  Think people who are staying at the Biltmore for a bachelorette party having their coffee before they jump on a fancy wine tasting bus.  A few Westmont students, some CEO of some company, an old guy who is always there, a few assorted crazy people and maybe a celebrity or two.  Some think that they are privileged and seem to be annoyed to be waiting for their coffee with all the common folks.

So if you are REALLY reading Yelp to find out if Starbucks is a good place to go for a cup of coffee, go there (or come here since I am sitting here now.)  You will certainly be amused.  

Wow, and as I sit here, some old guy just asked me if I would mind moving, he told me I am in his seat!!!!   Can you believe it?    I LOVE this place!

5 star based on total upgrade from the previous strip location. Brand new building,  so everything is new and clean. Convenient drive thru which the previous spot did not have. Larger outdoor seating area than the previous area. Larger inside seating area. In a much more visible spot positioned right of 71st Street. Overall a much needed upgrade for this business/hotel/Pike Township Starbucks. Applause!

The Starbucks was really quite disappointing. The coffee took forever to get in was, just lacking. It didn't appear to be fresh and the products I don't know just seemed off and flavor. The muffin that we got was stale and dry and very crumbly. It was not an inviting thing to eat so we passed and after tasting it left the rest in the trash.

The interior was not as clean as most Starbucks. And the staff was fairly slow and not efficient.

What's a girl to do? Well, you want a good cup of coffee sometimes you have to try a few places.

Love these guys.  Especially considering how swamped they can be, they're always very professional and pleasant.

I'm in there A LOT, and whenever they actually get a chance to breathe, they definitely recognize you and acknowledge you in one way or another.  Very friendly and personable.

They're also very on top of their customer service element.  I've been in there a couple times when I've asked for a food item that they were currently out of, and whoever was helping me was quick to suggest some similar items I might have an interest in and also offered to discount a more expensive replacement item to the price of the item I originally asked for.

The store is also very clean (as are the restrooms) and they have a very nice outdoor patio area.  Definitely my favorite local coffee stop!
The frap that I ordered from this branch  didn't taste the same as the one I get back at home in Michigan !
Very good fast friendly service convenient I have been going here for years and the service has been better every time especially since the renovation.

Woefully understaffed and can't handle the crush of students in line. Hot coffee can be had at the register, but inexplicably ICED coffee has to wait in the same queue as all the espresso drinks. Seems inefficient, when it is just pouring already made coffee on ice, but worse yet it contributes to the crazy wait times and massive crowd of people waiting to get their drinks.

While the food and drink is good, the service  is the  slowest. It doesnt matter if you go inside or the driveway...equally slow, especially in the morning, during their busiest time. The people who work there arent the friendliest either.

This is my favorite Starbucks in the area, by far.  The baristas are extremely nice, I usually do mobile orders and don't interact with cashiers too often, but they seem friendly from what I've seen.  One day my order didn't go through--they made me my drink right away even though I had to reorder it as I was standing there.  Very good service.  I only wish the Spring House Starbucks on my way to work was this good!  Drinks are always excellent as well!
Great place to study or relax! Seating area usually has available tables and a decent amount of outlets! Gave it four stars because there's never parking :/

It's Starbucks.  But this one has long-term employees that remember the names and preferences of dozens if not hundreds of regulars.

Seems to be "normal" in downtown Chicago, Manhattan, Seattle; but it's a treat here.

Great staff! Always polite and helpful. Rarely do they get a drink order wrong. 

However, space is almost always an issue at this particular location. It's not like the ambience is bad. It's just that a lot of people don't understand how to use proper 'line etiquitte', especially when the weather is cold. There are two entrances to the store, so I think the potential for awkward encounters is high. Personally, I've had some people think I was trying to cut them...when in fact, I was trying to manuever the line so the waiting line wouldn't trickle outside. 

Honestly, if you can swing it, I'd go for a different Starbucks...IF the wait is long. While the staff's attitudes are great, at the end of the day, the environment is way too claustophobic. Thus, more often then not, you'll probably get a whiff of some of the negative demeanors that mark certain downtown employees.

On the other hand, IF the wait is short...then I'd still recommend going here...just because you'll have a great experience with the staff and open window seating (if available).

Taylor is a grouch. Telling a Target employee how tired she is of making drinks as she is making drinks for customers. Sighed and rolled her eyes as another customer ordered a Frappuccino. If you hate your job, at least be discreet about it.

This Starbucks is located in a large strip mall area and has a drive thru.

I used the drive thru so my review is based only on that; the exterior appears well maintained & the employee I dealt with was friendly & efficient. I received my drink within minutes and had no issue.

I'd be back again, maybe even go inside for a further review.

This location ruined my image of Starbucks years ago. Hadn't been here in well over a year because the customer service sucks. Regardless, people in O'Fallon/Shiloh must not care about the bad experiences or reviews here cuz even still today, the drive-thru line was wrapped around the store as it always is, blocking the cars of the people who decided to brave the hot mess nightmare inside of the store. I'll go to the Fvh Target location if I have to have Starbucks or I'll goto Circle K gas station and use their espresso machine and get treated way better and much quicker.

Worst starbucks ever. Staff are mostly students and they are just chatting even if it's super busy time. Making mistakes so many times and their operation is extremely slow. I don't admit here is an official  Starbucks.

I went in to meet a friend, the hot chocolate was good but it took at least 10 minutes to make! My friend who lives in Belleville (I am from and live in Chicago) said that this location is always slow. If you want coffee but have some place to be afterwards this s not the place for you!

These guys are great. We come here all the time for work. The staff are friendly :-)

This is a great location to meet up with potential clients (if you're a business owner). It's also a nice place to just hang out. There's plenty of food places nearby, and the neighborhood is super nice!

I rarely leave poor reviews. In fact, I can't remember the last time I took the time for a bad review. But this Starbucks is woefully inefficient. We've waited 30min or more in the drive through and an hour inside on nearly every occasion we have visited. They lose drink tickets, get swamped with mobile orders, and just generally cannot seem to move customers through in the way of every other Starbucks store in every city we've ever been to. The drinks are made the same, but don't bother stopping unless you have a LOT of time to kill. They have far less customer traffic than several other locations we used to frequent (in bigger markets), but they just cannot seem to handle what they do have. Hopefully the new store opening in town will distribute the work load and help them out.
Service is bad!! Take forever to get your drink! And leta not talk about the carry-out, cause you can wait a good 20 minutes before you get ur drink!!!

went there to get some work done
Poor AT&T wireless connection
Should say "NO WIFI"
know problem, not fixed.
I love Starbucks but there is always an extremely long line in the Drive-thru and inside. The parking lot is too small to handle the amount of traffic that is always there.

Well judging the 2 reviews prior to mine, I had expected this place to be horrible.  As soon as I got to the counter I asked for a tall decaf, when the guy says "Sorry we are out of decaf"  WHAT!??!?!? how can a place that sells COFFEE be out of DECAF!!!!!  

Then he tells me but  "I can make an americano decaf"...How??? I say.
