Calm Down people it's just Starbucks.

Can't believes people are writing 2000 word reviews on Starbucks

It's your typically Starbucks, normally I don't review Starbucks but I was here and the experience was like any other Starbucks.






Starbucks.

I go to Starbucks nearly everyday..yep, addicted. This location has the worst staff of any Starbucks. The girls that I've encountered behind the counter are often rude and surly (I admit, not all of them, but many). I've come to this location maybe 10 times (usually go elsewhere thank goodness)and literally had bad experiences with varying young female staff about 8/10 times. They scoff at my drink order..and don't try to hide it, I might add (yes, it's a custom order, if I want coffee black I'd pay 1/3 the price at Tim's wouldn't I?). They just seem to have a bad attitude as they go about their tasks. Never mind they almost always get my drink wrong, and are so unwelcoming I wouldn't dare say anything for fear of the shade that would be thrown my way. If you dislike your job that much, do yourself and the customers a favour and move on.:(
Was looking forward to my venti iced coffee. It was watery and could hardly taste the splendas. Bottom of the barrel tasting coffee. Cmon Starbux yall usually do a great job.
Staff is great, very friendly. Service is quick. The only negative is the size of the location. Otherwise it's my Starbucks of choice.

First time I have EVER walked into a StarBucks location WITHOUT being greeted or asked if I desired to purchase what woulda coulda been a daily norm. Sadly, to all ALL my social media followers, listeners & viewers ... REROUT to another location where your greeted/acknowledged and where they will gladly take your order. TOTALLY ACCEPTABLE. NOT STARBUCK'S PROTOCOL.
Slowest Starbucks drive-thru in America. If you're in a hurry and need your coffee fix you should definitely go elsewhere.
Prices should be posted on items and readily available. When you have to ask a cashier who gets an attitude like it's beneath her it's very frustrating. Isn't that her job?

Service is terrible. It has gotten worse under the new manager. These people have no sense of hustle or urgency. They just amble along at their own pace. I would fire all of them and start over. The Starbucks at 96th and Meridian is a model of productivity. They move fast and efficiently. That is where I will go in the future.
Worst Starbucks I've been to! Takes forever and the employees seem like they don't have a clue of what they are doing. I wouldn't recommend this particular Starbucks.
Nice place to have coffee. Very friendly people. Very good environment. I like this place.
New workers... Useless!!! Slow slow slow... Lazy as crap. Shouldn't get a job making lattes if you're only cut out for pouring coffee.

I've fallen in love with the mobile ordering feature of the Starbucks app, and this is the store closest to my office, so when I'm driving in and I'm feeling the need for coffee and a pastry, this is the place that gets my order. 

Unlike the location a mile north on 86th street, this place is fairly quiet ad subdued. There's no drive through, so if you want to get something, you've got to park and walk in and get it yourself. I'm okay with this... it means it much quieter than the others. The staff sets my mobile order on the counter so I can walk in, say hello, grab my order and be on my way before the my headlights have a chance to shut themselves off. They've learned that I don't like my pastry warmed up, which isn't an option to request on the app, but they know when y order comes through how I like it, and they have it ready. Love this location!

I'm sure most would consider me somewhat of a coffee snob. I blame it on being from the Seattle area, which is obviously also Starbucks' home :)

But I am in no way too good for Starbucks. Especially because when it comes for convenience and ease of acquiring said coffee on my way to work, nothing is easier than this place. 

Usually hoppin' with all the people going to work in Intech Commons, etc (at least in the morning)... but the staff are nice and pleasant, and they do the best they can in a rush. 

Thank you, for helping me out when my bod desperately needs to be caffeinated sometimes in the morning. Also, my workplace thanks you for saving my productivity on those days.

PS. If you ever get the bug up your backside to make it a drive-thru, DO IT! People will love it, and it may ease the congestion inside the store in the AM. :)

Its only gotten worse..the line is out the door. Having hours to watch...the staff change and are very slow.. I can drive to the next closest and still save time...poor franchise drive on if you value your time

The parking situation is terrible.  You really need to park in the lot behind the Starbucks.  The drive thru line is really long so I parked and went inside.  I stood in line for 5 minutes then was barely greeted with a "what can I get for you?". I ordered a traveler and was told it would take 15-20 minutes...next time I will go to Monon Coffee.

I used to frequent this Starbucks because it was so close to work, but like the other yelpers wrote, the staff is awful. I walk to the south street starbucks or the one on 10th and chestnut now because of this. Dont even try to pay with your phone, it will take five minutes for the cashier to figure out how to charge you and scan it. If you order food, especially food that needs to be heated, be prepared to ask about your order ten minutes later and have the staff admit that they forgot to prepare it.

Alberto isnt the only sour grape... a couple of the staff members are starting to act like him. Bummer.

The baristas are nice, but the service is very slow. My drink was fairly uncomplicated (unsweetened iced coffee with nonfat milk), but the person who took my order wrote it down wrong. Unfortunately, I didn't realize it until I was halfway home.
The new Flat White drink is fab! A must try before it disappears...for you true coffee lovers you can appreciate this drink.  Worth the walk in the cold today.
Visited yesterday. Adjacent construction was ongoing .Starbucks was closed. Closure is temporary for renovation - as I was informed by a clerk in the 19006 store.
Very good store, people are very friendly and fast with order. I love to go to a store that people are friendly but they don't seem to be trying to please you.
Not a big fan of this location, service is not as awesome as other locations. At least during late afternoons.

I'm normally not a Starbucks fan, but I truly enjoy this location! There is great seating for those there for chatting as well as those there to do a little work! There is this great long table at this location where you and others can sit comfortable in a group and study or do a little work. It's truly great. There are ample outlets to plug up everything you need. So you shouldn't have any issues in that department as well.

The staff is soooo friendly. They let me try tea that I didn't hear of beforehand and even told me about other options. Also seems to have a lot of little buys in store that seem to be pretty cheap.

I really enjoy this location for some work and drink tea in Jefferson Parish.

Absolutely love this Starbucks! The staff is always friendly, the drinks are perfect, and the line moves so fast even at the busiest time of the day. I drive out of my way to go to this location and will be a repeat customer as long as I live in Carmel! Bravo!!
Excellent location. This location is very busy because of the location. I ordered from the app and walked down from my meeting room and it was ready!  Great service.
Wasn't the cleanest the day I was in there, the flies made it impossible to enjoy my latte

This is the best Starbucks I have ever been to! Super friendly staff and VERY quick in the drive thru. Even if there is a long line, it always tends to go really fast which surprises me. Never had a wrong order and I will continue to go back everyday before work in the mornings!
Very conveniently located downtown near corner of 5th and Church. Small and ambient atmosphere. Great service. Love this place.

Every Starbucks is similar but has a twist of its own. This one is in South Tampa, is very long and narrow, and after the remodeling is a lot more laptop friendly. They no longer have the handicapped tables that are great to work on. (Yes I am a terrible person!) They do have more outlets and small metal tables. They have the favorites and a decent selection of edibles.
The staff was very attentive and efficient even with a long line on a Saturday morning.  They all had smiles on their faces and were friendly and helpful.

Anyone who has read my reviews knows that I'm kind of a Starbucks junkie lol so it's only right that I visited the Starbucks located in this hotel that I was staying in for a few days. I went there twice and the service was slow both times. There were several people working behind the counter and I wouldn't quite figure out why things were moving in slow motion. But on the up side, being that it was located in the hotel, it was very convenient and each time my caramel macchiato was right on point so I guess it was worth the wait

They always get my order wrong!!  I usually order a hot espresso drink and substitute coconut milk for regular but add whip. Somehow the whip never makes it on the drink. Sometimes the drink comes out as a frappuccino!! I've ordered both through the app and in the store and it's always wrong. What I love about Starbucks is the ability to create your own drink. I hate visiting this location because I have to double check everything. And when you are spending almost  $6 for a drink you want it to be right
Jose, please quit talking to your friend who has been standing in front of the pick up counter for ten minutes. Your multitasking skills are poor and my coffee is awful.

I am so sorry to see so many bad reviews for this location.  I have been coming here ever since it opened and maybe I am just lucky but I have never had a problem.  Coming here before 7:30 can be a little slow but only because there are three high schools up the hill and if almost looks like every student stops at Starbucls first!!   Great and friendly staff, clean surroundings and fabulous service.

they had a nice sign about how they want to make sure your drink is right but there was no follow thru.  I immediately knew there was a problem but I couldn't catch the baristas eye and after waiting in line behind 15 people I didn't have any time left.  yuk. one of those places where staff knows better than patrons.  despite the nick-name I gave him to write on my cup, he wrote the formal name from my card.  despite I ordered a latte w/caramel they gave me a macchiato. don't they know there's a difference?  yuk.

I was elated when I first learned we were getting a Starbucks close to home. I was even happier when I discovered the Mobile ordering app and could affectively shave 20 minutes out of my morning. However, my recent experiences have been horrible. Between incorrect mobile orders, less than full cups, being lied to by employees in regards to preparation of my order and now lukewarm drinks... I just can't take it anymore. I've tried to call and speak to a manager but every time that I make an attempt,  I'm forwarded to a voicemail box that has not yet been set up. I order from this location 6 days a weeks. Last week, I had to make a second stop and a different location because the drink I received was completely incorrect. I later stopped in that afternoon and received a refund. I love the mobile app and wish that I could continue to use it at this location but the quality of service and product is not representative of my past experiences with Starbucks. Please address these training issues with your current staff.

We stopped by this Starbucks yesterday and had a great experience. We used the drive thru and placed our regular order. The barista taking our order was nice & friendly. Our order took longer than expected (an iced latte and a frappuccino). It was okay because the gal taking the order made some small talk with us and made us laugh. I know a new location goes through growing pains and some orders can take longer than expected, but she made it great. We will definitely be back when we are in the area.
Awful and unfriendly service.  Long line.  Disgusting condiment are.  Better give yourself an extra 20+ mins for a cup of coffee.   Nearest to gate 71. Yikes

Also first time in my life to see FLIES in a starbucks whether target or not.

Convienient location.   Store is large and clean.  The woman taking my order seemed to be on auto pilot.  I tried to engage her in conversation (I was the only one in line placing an order) and she seemed confused as to why I was talking to her. Hahahahaha.....Ooooooookay.....at least fake it for me lady...hahahaha.  Good thing I love me some Starbucks and could finally make up my own mind. My Skinny Salted Caramel Frappe was delicious and the hubs Americano was perfect....which is most important anyway...Great Job Barrista!!  I'll be back and I promise not to ask any questions next time.

Guess what? There's a good Starbucks at Rocky Point! Who knew? It's convenient to access from the Causeway, just a right turn and you're in. As typical with all Starbucks, it's kept clean. They have full service, so you can order a breakfast (I could live off the sausage egg and cheese) or have them heat up a lunch sandwich. The staff is friendly and the service is fast. 
I only wish they had a larger dinning area. There's only about 3-4 small tables. I know they don't want you to hang around but sometimes I just want to read in a nice comfy leather chair, read the news and sip my coffee. That's not happening here.
Stopped here when we passed by to grab some coffees. Went thru the drive thru. Service was quick and our drinks were made correctly.

I was visiting from out of town and looking for a place to cool down. I normally get a cold brew, but after talking to Taylor, she told me how it tasted and tried to match my taste to a thirst quenching drink I might like. 

Taylor also made sure right when I arrived that she was ready to help me and my family and if I needed any help before ordering. She seems like a sweet, kind, and down to earth individual that made my short visit one I could feel comfortable in and enjoy my stay. 

Give that woman a raise!!! By far my favorite barista I've ever met!!! She made this place her own by how she welcomeded each person, moved to the beat of the music in the cafe to set the mood in creating sweet drinks with a kick of music love, and did I mention my drink was DELICIOUS!!!! I've never tried the Mango Drangonfruit refresher, but sure glad I took Taylor's advice. Each Starbucks has a slightly different feel and decor, but Taylor brightens this place up and will go far in life in how she carries herself wherever she may go.

Thank you Taylor and Starbucks for being a part of my day and our St. Louis trip. Putting this Starbucks on the map!!!
This has to be one of the SLOWEST Starbucks in town. Don't come here if you are in a rush, you will be waiting for at least 15-20 minutes.

I ordered a venti Starbucks double shot and they handed me a tall. When I said something, the dude took it back, poured it into a venti cup, added ice & milk. Take a look at the pic... that's not a double shot... that's ice milk. Worst Starbucks I've ever been to.

By far the slowest Starbucks I have EVER been to. I have visited MANY Starbucks and even many that were located in targets and elsewhere and this is still the slowest bar none. They are often rude and impatient and also oftentimes they do not have what I request.  A few weeks ago I went there and was about to order a pastry when I came across the state of the pastry cabinet. It was ridden with fruit flies and other types of crawling insects. Fine I will give them that much but I still dread when I have no other choice but to go there. They need to retrain their employees and completely refresh that stand.
Bad attitudes here, the Barista didn't even greet, nothing. & she was rude, my order wasn't how I wanted it, & of course, bad attitude. I LOVE Starbucks, but won't be returning to this location.

I ordered a venti caramel macchiato with 5 shots. The girl who made mine put only four then proceeded to pour out some of the coffee on top because it was too full on top of that. Paid for two shots I didn't even get.

I have to agree (and respectfully disagree with Timothy's review below) that this Starbucks is a good place to go for a cup of primo coffee.  The baristas are friendly, helpful and don't keep you waiting any longer than necessary.  It's a small Starbucks and seating is limited, but most of the time, you will have no problem finding a seat.  Never had any drink that wasn't done to my satisfaction.  And, once again disagreeing with Timothy, I love their cinnamon swirl cake.  I get that when I want a treat.

This Starbucks, like other Starbucks, overprices their drinks which is why it's only a four star.
It's been twenty minutes and I have YET to receive a coffee with steamed milk.  One person ahead of me online. Are they growing the beans outside?

Slowest Starbucks!!! I waited 29 minutes for an oatmeal that should have taken one minute to pour.  Other mobile orders and drinks were more important apparently.  Even standing there, I was not acknowledged or apologized to for the long wait.

Whatever happened to customer service? A simple apology for giving me a regular coffee not the latte I ordered, would have been nice. Instead I got a rude comment and laughter from the gang inside.  Great way to start my day. Nice job there. Jeez, where do they get these folks.....
The employees set this Starbucks apart. They are always very friendly and keep the establishment in top notch condition, which says a lot given all the traffic that passes through here.
Wish they would stop giving me a Java Chip Frapp every time I ask for a Double Chocolate Chip Frapp! I don't drink coffee but I like their teas and non coffee drink options!
Go off-peak hours or plan to wait in line. If you're not in a rush, this is a great place to meet, read, work. Their staff is friendly.

This is one of my most frequented Starbucks, I usually like it because there is never anyone in there at the time I go.  It is a 'hit or miss" location.  What I mean by that is that while the service (in terms of friendliness) is always spot on... they can be slooooooow, as in slow motion.   Now that said, they have ALWAYS provided me with a kick ass drink - I always order a triple grande something and who ever is behind the machine has always taken great care in making my drink delicious and hot.

Avoid this Starbucks though during the week around 7 because ALL the high schoolers from next door are in there.

Simple Starbucks on the corner with friendly staff and convenient seating. The music can be quite loud so it's not the greatest spot for studying/reading quietly... but they offer cascara cold brue and for a Starbucks newbie like myself, it really hit the spot!

This Starbucks is downright unpleasant to be in. It has very little seating and has entrances that open both onto the street and into a hotel lobby. I felt like the doors were constantly opening in this place. The store is also far smaller than your average Starbucks. If you need to get a drink, it's okay, but it is not a place I would linger.

Consistently slow service. Very, very slow service. 
Drive through regularly takes about 18 minutes longer than it should.

Just stood at the cash register for six minutes while 7 employees walked back and forth without even greeting me. They would look, then look away. Needless to say we walked out. Not sure I want to go back to this one.

This is a nice little Starbucks!

Downsides: parking can be tough during peak hours, and the lineup has a terrible set up.

Positives: quick service, super friendly staff, lots of seating, and a very handy location!

I was literally drooling over the amazing selection of baking and other food in the display case, but just went with my standard flat white today. Can't wait to try some of those noms!

This location is consistently efficient.  They seem to be one of the busiest stores in the city in that they get a lot of downtown morning traffic and lunch time, too.  The drive thru can be backed up into the street, but they keep it moving fairly quickly.  The drawbacks are that they can run out of things fast such the pastry and food products.

The best place to read or study .
also the people who work there are the best of the best.

I pulled up to the window and he hands me two coffees one so full that it's dripping down the side of the cup, all over me, all over my car. I ask for napkins twice.  "$6.81" 
"Can I get a napkin?"
"$6.81." 
Hands the man the card, swipes it. Hands it back, closed the window. No napkins , no receipt, no have a good day. 

Rude. This experience has me not wanting to go back anytime soon. I yern for the feel of a nice cozy local coffee shop...

I've given them enough opportunities, to better their service.  Don't ever go inside, just because the drive-thru line is long.  Drive-thru has priority over everything else.  There is no rhyme or reason to this, even if your the only person inside and in-line, drive-thru comes first...ALWAYS!!  Coffe Starbucks Standard Coffee is always good.  I only go here when I have to, it's not my daily first choice anymore.  On weekends, it's a mad house!!

Ordered a trenta black iced tea, no sugar, extra ice.  Got a trenta black sweet tea, kinda has ice.  For $3.16, they should at least get the order right!  Called and they can't cancel the order, so I have to stop by to get my refund.  Will go get my money back and then won't go again!

A Starbucks is a Starbucks, right? Not really I have visited the good and the bad. What I appreciate the most about this Starbucks is the exceptionally friendly service. I have only had fantastic interactions at this location and the staff goes above & beyond to ensure you have a great visit. Plus it has a drive thru, what can be better than not having o get out of your car for your daily dose of caffeine.  My only complaint, they don't carry cinnamon chip scones. :(

Nice people, but the employees behind the counter talked so loud about their personal lives it was inappropriate for a business. Plus they had 1/2 the place closed off for about 20 minutes in the middle of the day because they were mopping it?!!? Made the place look like it was closed when I pulled up.

So good. The people that work there are always so friendly!! The drive thru can be a little slow, but that is only because they take the time to craft your drink/food with love! I will miss coming to this Starbucks when I move. O and the parking lot doesn't suck near as much as the rest!!

So, they have redeemed my faith in customer service by providing consistent friendly service. Maybe the person I dealt with was having a bad day or maybe she was a horrible person (don't see her working here anymore). Either way, here I sit with a Pumpkin Spice Latte in hand and a smile on my face!!!
I waited in line on Friday in the drive-thru for 15 minutes:(.  I have never waited that long at a Starbucks.  Was disappointed.

Probably my  favorite  Starbucks in  brandon. 
It's very  nice  and  cozy  and  a nice  crowd. 
They  keep  this  place  up to  date  and  clean.

Just skip this and give your business to small mom and pop shops like Poor Richards Coffee down the street which has organic grass fed dairy, is cheaper and is much more comfortable than this Starbucks which has about 3 high-tops, 4 comfy leather chairs (the only comfortable seating in the whole place) and one huge wood table. You could also go to Gryphon Cafe in downtown Wayne. Im so sick of over priced Starbucks with chemical ingredients and dairy from grain fed cows full of hormones and antibiotics.
They're very under staffed but the employees they do have are rock stars! Every drink is always perfect. They're not allowed to accept tips and that bothers me.
I tried the new spicy chorizo breakfast sandwich today.  I had to remove the spongy chorizo paddy in order to make the sandwich edible. Yuck! Stick with the bacon Gouda sandwich!

Super excited that Starbucks opened a store in South County that wasn't inside the mall.

Nice area, parking makes things a bit difficult.

Staff extremely nice, attentive and ready to serve your every coffee needs.

Horrible. And will not be back here. After the experience this morning I have to say I will never be back to this location. Every single person that I spoke to that worked there was the WORST ATTITUDE. If you do not like your job, find antoher one because that place will lose customers over their HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. I work in customer service everyday of my life and if I acted like they did, I would never have any customers. Everyone was rude and very short. I had no idea what the cost of my coffee and muffin was because the lady at the window never said anything to me, just took my card and handed my stuff to me. Sorry but it is 8 AM in the morning and starting people's day off like that is terrible. Needless to say I will be getting my morning coffee elsewhere from now on.

10 Yrs. Decaf every morning  . Yes and now its gone . A pour over . An americano. Not for me. If i wanted to wait i could. Today 10 min. for an over priced inconvenience.  
Snob? Not i. Just a consumer who will spend my $70 a month down the street helping African wells.

Corporate america has taken the flavor from this bean.

Despite what previous reviewers say, this is  NOT located in a strip mall (there's no mall), I would say village is more like it.
 The staff here at this starbucks are so cheerful, and friendly!!!! They seem to really love working there, or simply drink way too much coffee. Either way, I enjoy coming here to get a coffee before shopping at Vons
We went through the drive thru for a Sweet Italian Cold Brew. It took way to long to get through the line. The coffee was fair, will try a different Starbucks when in the area.
Omg worst Starbucks ever!!! Hire more staff!! It shouldn't take 30 minutes every day to get a coffee! Absolutely ridiculous.

It's nothing extraordinary but it did provide me with much needed caffeine and sugar, and for that, I will remain eternally grateful.  The baristas here definitely take their sweet old time but in the end, I did get my soy latte.

Great Starbucks in a location that badly needed a Starbucks for a while. The staff is very attentive and polite. The drinks are well made and samples of the food and drinks are offered to patrons to try. I found some sandwiches through the samples that I like to order. I also like they open late even on the weekends unlike most places in the area.

This location is definitely slow. I ordered upon first arriving for a shopping trip, and then patiently left my husband there to wait on my drink (took a good 20 minutes for a cool lime refresher) while I started to shop. 

I do understand that they were having some issues with the new bag of caramel sauce. I do understand it was busy. I do understand there were two people there and that perhaps they needed more help. 

However, I frequent the locations at the University of Arizona where they have 50 people deep in line and are still pumping out drinks within a brisk 4-5 minute wait. Once you've seen that skill, I feel like all of these stand alone locations can pick up the speed. 

PS: This location did *not* participate in a bonus star challenge or a menu challenge that was active. You do get regular stars here. But if you were ordering a Refresher to make the last item on a menu challenge, that doesn't register with Starbucks. Location doesn't participate--which sucks, and thus I won't be using the location anymore if they don't participate in any of the challenges (because I participate in all of the weekly/daily/monthly challenges going on and like my points).

I came for a strawberry acai with coconut milk ( the pink drink) in the morning and it was extremely busy. But when I got my drink, I realized I was charged wrong and my ticket didn't include the coconut milk, so they had to remake it. 
     It wasn't a huge problem for me, but I'm glad the staff was still nice and didn't get an attitude about it.

This is the only company owned Starbucks in downtown St Louis, and it is far superior to the others, especially the one on Washington. The baristas are friendly, incredibly efficient, and seem to care about the customers. It's actually kind of amazing how quickly they can prepare a drink. Unlike the nightmare on Washington Street, I've never had an incorrect order in this store. And, they stock had breakfast and lunch items as well.

The only thing that keeps it from being 5 stars is that the location is kind of small. It's not too small, there always seems to be a place to sit, but its far from the most luxurious Starbucks I've ever been to. One of the great things is that when the weather is warmer there are plenty of tables to sit at outside. That relieves any overcrowding, and is actually pleasant considering the giant empty department store you look at across the street.

Its out of my way to go to this Starbucks, but it's worth it because of the service, staff, and quality of drink and food.

Slow and inaccurate service. Always busy and always either understaffed or the staff just doesn't care. I'm afraid they may have a high turnover rate that bleeds into that
However there are a few baristas there that enjoy their job and work very hard. If you are lucky enough for them to make your drink or take your order, it's a 5/5 experience.
WiFi also doesn't normally and when it does it's very slow. However I think they'll be going to Google WiFi soon, so that complaint won't stand for long.

I frequent this Starbucks almost daily.  On the downside, it can be crowded and slow.  On the upside there are always a fun group of people to watch coming in and out.  I find the staff to be friendly and always willing to please.  In the mornings you most likely will see a celebrity or two if you watch closely.

Patio overlooks a parking lot.  However, the beautiful Pusch Ridge overlooks that stark parking lot.  The lines are typically short, since the OV is sparsely populated.  It's Starbucks-- you know what to expect
Hanging with friends at one of my favorite places. You can't beat Starbucks because they rock the house and they are always nice when you call about questions.
Love the Starbucks, the staff is super friendly they always know what I want. Green Tea Latte Soy no classic yum!!!!!!

Upon entering the establishment we found an enormous line of patrons waiting to collect their drinks. Red flag. We opted to chance ordering hoping for a quick turnaround. Starbucks is usually an expedited experience. We were wrong. No one could be mistaken for being in a hurry behind the counter. If waiting 45 minutes for a cup of coffee is your idea of time well spent this is the Starbucks for you. One drink was made incorrectly and the other was forgotten.  Upon mentioning this, our order was places at the beginning of the line to be remade. The erroneous drink was remade and the omitted drink crafted after a barista commented that we had been there a while. Avoid.

Out of all the locations I have been to, this one is by far my favorite. They are always fast and friendly. They are great at custom orders and are very accommodating. Location is good. My only regret is they are not a drive through, but it's not too big of deal for me.
Slightly difficult to get in and out. I believe the best part of this place is the Clover machine.  It is by far the best brewed coffee I have had yet.  A little expensive but it is worth a try.

I am a fan of this Starbucks, they always get my order right and the are fast about.  Friendly and nice that's important to me!  I get the same thing every time a house brewed coffee room for cream and sweetener....    There is handful of Starbucks all over the valley, this is a good site!

I've never been a Starbucks fan but had to settle for it this morning. I waited in line for 10 minutes to place my order, placed it paid for it then waited for another 15 minutes to be made. When I saw people who were in line behind me getting their order I asked about it and was told they're out of the skinny mocha.  
This is horrible customer service!

Today I used my Starbucks app to order ahead of time.  This location is always busy with a line out the door and the parking lot a mess, especially on a Monday morning.  

When I walked in, there was a good six people at the cash register and I thought "Hmmm, do I stand in line to pick up my order?"  Then I glanced to my left and sitting on the counter was my cold brewed coffee with a splash of soy milk and two pumps of sugar free mocha just waiting for me.  I had just confirmed my order a couple minutes prior to arriving.  I was so happy to see it was ready for pick up and I didn't even have to talk to anyone and it was all paid for!  

The four star rating is for the mistake that I ordered no ice and like always, there was way too much ice in my cup.  Other than that honest error I will definitely be ordering ahead from now on to beat the Starbucks rush.

This Starbucks is one of the nicest that I have seen. The baristas are very friendly and work really hard. Shouts-out to Karan and Jack who worked every hard and were pleasant to everyone in the coffee house.
Great staff and never mess up my order. It's the first place I go to when entering the mall.
VERY slow... 15 minutes to place and receive order. There were five cars ahead of me, need to have more efficient service.

I am a frequent visitor here.  I have never had a problem with the service at this starbucks.  Only one out of my gazillion times have i ever had a complaint about my drink, which they remade promptly.  

If you see the drive-thru line one car further past the menu just go inside, it would be quicker (as long as there isn't a huge line inside).  

As far as coffeehouses in the metro-east illinois area, they are lacking.  There have been a few that have tried but starbucks just puts them out of business.  I hate that for the local coffee shops, however, i love the hours of starbucks open from 5-11 most days so its a great place to get my homework done.  Great access to the highway as well.
Long line, well staffed, reasonably short wait. Pretty much what you would expect at an airport location. One concern was the cream/sugar table seemed rather unclean.

I went here on 10/20/15 at around 6:45 am. I ordered 2 pumpkin spice lattes and a butter croissant. When I got to the window, the a lady with short curly dirty blond hair was making it obvious she was angry that we wanted to reload our Starbucks card through the drive through and she began to basically tell us how to order in the drive thru. Then because our card didn't have enough to pay off the final bill, she slammed her hand down and asked for the remaining cash. Me and my wife felt very uncomfortable. I would not recommend this Starbucks to anybody. If you want good service, GO TO DUTCH BROS. I'll never come to this Starbucks again.

AMAZING!!!!!! I LOVE THIS STARBUCKS!!!! Everyone is always SO friendly and helpful! The workers make you feel at home, and make the greatest drinks! Also, the blueberry muffins are amazing. Meghan is the best manager. She has employed some amazing people as well -- Lauryn always has a smile on her face, Emily is the kindest ever, Sam is the most helpful worker, and Carlos is super sweet! If you are going to go to any Starbucks, go to this one. I don't care if you live in Connecticut, if you want the best coffee in the world, make the trip to Oro Valley, Arizona. This is our only real tourist attraction, thanks for giving us something, you guys. If this place was 24 hours, I would live on the comfy bench in the back. I love this Starbucks more than I love my own family.

I like Starbucks and drink their drip coffee often. And my review really isn't just about this store it's about all of them, it just so happens that this is most recent store where I have experienced this reoccurring problem that seems to happen nationwide.

I can drink coffee whenever and don't have problems sleeping so I often will get coffee in the evenings, and sometimes it's close to closing time. More times than not the coffee is either cold or lukewarm at best. I know Starbucks cares about it's service and I don't understand why they let this go on. It can't cost them hardly any money to brew a new pot when the last one is empty or a half pot but no you get coffee that has been sitting for hours and it's horrible. 

There have been times when I have been told that they can make some quickly and that is fine but to just give out cold coffee shouldn't be an option. In this particular instance it was just before 8 pm and they don't close until 9 pm so really no viable excuse for this happening.
Best staff, great space, lots of light, always clean.  Still have a couch and some leather chairs.  A nice group of friendly people hang out there. A good mix.  My favorite.
A typical Starbucks. Friendly service. A bit slower than others I have visited but my order was always made right.

Went to this location a few years ago and it was bad news all around. Coffee might as well have been dirt water. Then i came back last week and they have since gotten it together. All thanks to this man Porker. Made my drink super fast and it tasted great. Really knows how to operate a 'bucks. I will be coming back as long as that exceptional employee is on the roster, someone give the man a raise. Strange name though.

Parking is horrendous. People resort to parking illegally. Difficult to enter and exit the lot, depending on where you're going.
 Very slow service.

I live too close not to come to this Starbucks but I will not anymore. I know Starbucks has their own price but when I order a flat white and it's not even 3/4 full, I'm upset because I want what I paid for and I know how it should be made and the one on 91st and keystone can get it right and are so much more pleasant!

This is not how this drink should look. There is even matcha powder left on the lid. It seems to just be carelessness from the staff. Unfortunately this seems to happen with almost any drink I order from this location

I love reading down my tips here because it's a good log of the different drinks I have had here. I often come here and try something different, and I seem to like most of the drinks. I also come whenever there is a special, or also more often at Christmas time for holiday drinks or gift cards.

They are fast, efficient and friendly. I find the outside area more comfy than the inside. The inside is smaller than many other Starbucks, but it does serve it's purpose if getting refreshed and caffeinated. Wish I had one closer to me, but at least this is conveniently located next to other stores I like to shop at.

What can I say about Starbucks. Pretty standard, pricey coffee drinks, uppity staff and lots of hipsters sucking up free wifi.

All in all this location is pretty standard.

They are quick and friendly. My americano came out piping hot! I am kind of a wuss, I may have to ask for it a bit cooler. 

I did notice the flies others are talking about, but I also noticed they have a drive thru that is constantly busy so that window is always open. 

There is plenty of seating and the majority of people in there were studying so it's a considerate crowd, not very loud.

The Employees work really hard.
They are friendly.
Coffee always seems better than other locations.
I see them keeping the building clean.
When there isn't many Customers in the store.
I love the Caramel Apple Spice Cider 
Yummy

Coffees are great and perfectly made but low stars are for service.   If I place an order on line and it says ready 3-7 mins and 18 mins later it's not and walk in people are getting drinks before me than there is a breakdown in who should be serviced first 

This has happened everyday this week between hours of 6:50am -7:10 am.

Every time my husband comes out of this location he is angry and totally annoyed.  He today said an employee off the clock was goofing around holding up the line for about 7 irritated patrons and the other workers wouldn't tell the kid to shut up and move out of the way. The coffee is fine, the off duty employee balancing bags of coffee on his head while reaching over the bar to play with cups and markers has irritated my household greatly.
This is by far the best starbucks in the area. The atmosphere is good and the people making the drinks are even better.

I absolutely love this Starbucks location. The employees are friendly and have beautiful charismatic smiles and their customer service is just icing on top of the cake to go with the good coffee beverages !

The coffee was good and the staff were very friendly, but I found myself waiting 15 minutes for an iced coffee. There were 5 staff looking very busy. But between all 5 of them they only produced 1 coffee every 3 minutes. Other Starbucks locations I've been to are MUCH faster at making coffee. 
In addition to that, the place wasn't very busy either. I think they were fulfilling online orders maybe because nobody was claiming most of the coffees they were making. 
Meanwhile I stood there in front of them for FIFTEEN minutes waiting for them to pour my black iced coffee that should have taken 30 seconds. By the end I was borderline angry. And I ended up being significantly late to work.
My feeling is they should service the in person customers before the online customers. I was standing there waiting and even mentioned to the one employee actually making the coffees that I had really been waiting a very long time for just an iced coffee. He seemed confused and told me there were still 3 coffees in front of me. He was very polite but continued to make coffees for people who were not in the building. I was not happy with the experience at all.
Starbucks is my favourite coffee place in my entire life! I still be able to go there w/ my family

This Starbucks location is my absolute favorite!  Rob and his team provide exceptional service.  The thing I like most is even if you aren't one of their regulars they still treat you very well.  Unlike other Starbucks who only treat their regulars well.

The Baristas here are super friendly with an Asian male being my favorite person (I keep forgetting his name!).  The service is prompt and when it isn't prompt, I got my coffee for free.  My current complicated drink is always perfect (triple grande salted caramel mocha with soy no whip).   A couple of weeks ago, some nice person paid for my coffee 2 cars ahead of me in some "pay it forward movement".  It's always a nice experience at this place and I just have not one complaint.  See you guys tomorrow!

[this review is only for this location]
The staff here is super friendly and works quickly to get your drinks to you. I typically come here at night to do homework so I'm not sure how things go during the morning rush, but if the night crew is any indication, then I'm sure things run smoothly! 
I don't feel guilty for staying for a few hours because there is plenty of seating and I've never seen it get so crowded that I needed to move.

Pros: clean bathrooms and fresh assortment of treats/snacks
Great crew who know their regulars by name and what they want when they come through the door.  And there are plenty of regulars! The coffee is better than any other Sbux you'll find around.

Really helpful and nice service. John at the drive thru window was great. Very cheerful nice guy at 5:40am! Just ordered a coffee with steamed milk because I didn't want all the calories of a latte. John helped me figure out that it is called a Misto (AKA a Cafe Olay). Not on the drive thru menu but they were happy to make it for me. It's delicious. The coffee is the perfect balance and the milk nice and frothy. Great job guys! I'm going to try to finish waking up now...

I use the drive thru all the time and I have never had problems. I decided to go in today. There were 6 employees I could see behind the counter doing various things. I stood there for 5 mins without being acknowledged. This older couple walked in and stood near me (but not behind) and they got helped right away. I ended up leaving empty handed. This is ridiculous.

This location is the third busiest store in the entire Midwest. The baristas here are HUMANS. They all may have a bad day from time to time, due to angry customers constantly interrogating them on when their drink will come out. Them looking for your order will only delay yours and everybody else's. Please be understanding. There are only three machines to run and hundreds of drinks to be made. Please be patient with them. If you are running late, you should never stop for coffee. Do NOT blame baristas. You couldn't possibly expect to get your drinks in five minutes, when there were 15+ people in front of you (most likely with 2+ items each - this includes Mobile Order & Pay) in line, right? Remember golden rule, "Do unto others as you would have them do unto you". I love the O'Fallon team! You guys rock!

The people here are the sweetest! I come in a few times a week, usually in the afternoon, and they always make me smile. Perhaps it's because I've never stopped in during morning rush, but I never have an issue with parking or long lines. They're super friendly and super quick. :)

I have visited this store for years, but in the past few months have stopped around 7:30am for coffee. Each time i have waited over 20 minutes for my drinks.  As i watch the  staff stumble over fulfilling call ahead orders a big crowd is formed waiting for drinks.  I know its the morning rush but waiting 20 minutes for lattes is not acceptable. Plus my lattes smell burnt. Will not return to this starbucks in the morning.

Updated: 3/17
This location has really turned it around!
Generally awesome staff, who show skill and efficiency. Drinks much, much better!
Kudos!
Old: Not friendly, verrrry slow, and not good at blending the coffee drinks - everything tastes exactly the same. Definitely not my favorite Starbucks!
Update: today=grumpiest barista on the planet! And the music is appalling. And when I nicely said something about the terrible music to the terrible barista, he just looked at me and shrugged his shoulders

The baristas seem pleasant enough but are so slow that I usually find myself just giving up and taking a seat to do my work without buying anything.  I can't think of another place where I have to do this.
Had a really nasty latte today. I think they forgot to add the expresso. It was all milk with vanilla syrup. No coffee taste to it.

The people here are friendly and helpful.  They are always nice to my kids.  It's a Starbucks so you already know what it's going to taste like.

My only wish is that they had a drive through here.

Went in at 9:01 and was told sorry we closed one minute ago. For someone who goes to Starbucks all the time I can honey say I've never heard such a rude response. Luckily there are two other Starbucks within a .25 mile radius so I will be going to those in the future.
Stopped by the other day for mothers day and I must say that their Valencia orange refreshers are great

Filthy tables, a staff that is in no hurry whatsoever and no app reader for payment.  Yes, they have to manually punch in the code from your phone.  Did I mention no hurry?  The employee ducked low behind the counter texting thought she wasn't visible, like an ostrich or something, even though everyone could see her plain as day.  Add the ambiance of a dozen homeless people standing in front of the doors and milling around inside hitting you up for a cup of coffee and a Rickers has more appeal.

They only have one sandwich choice for sale each day. Most other Starbucks have more than one. Their fresh pastry and bread selection is more varied than other Starbucks I've been too though. They open really early, 5 am daily except Sun, then its 5:30 am.

Really happy to have discovered this Starbucks so close to me after I moved away from my old fave - its quick, efficient, and large with lots of seating! The baristas know what they're doing and don't hold you up, so I will absolutely be making this my new spot

This is the first time I have visited this location. 

When we entered at 12 noon, there were 3 'barristas'' talking loudly together. 

They took our order and delivered it OK but when we went to the condiments table, all of the carafes were empty. We brought them to the counter where they refiled them and handed them back to us for us to replenish the table with instead of making the effort to bring them out themselves.

It was extremely noisy in the shop even though there were never more than 2 or 3 other customers besides ourselves there at one time.  but the noise level rose even further when one of the barristas decided to rearrange the chairs and instead of picking them up and moving them, she dragged each one of the five chairs across the floor to it's proper place. We remarked that dragging was really noisy and asked her to please pick the chairs up  and offered to do it for her but she continued to drag them.

Whereupon, we took our coffee and moved to an outdoor table which was dirty with the remains of previous customers. When we took our trash back in before leaving, the three of them were still engrossed in lively conversation with each other.

Clearly there was no supervision going on and customer satisfaction was not their concern.

Always great service! They have a nice outdoor seating area. Although it could use a trash can out there. The inside has good seating options too. 
Biggest drawback is the way the drive thru lane is situated. It's really hard to get into the drive thru and if it's crowded, drive thru customers spill out onto the street causing traffic problems. 

But I've experienced good coffee and friendly workers every time I've been there!

I asked if there was anything weird in the hot cocoa. I was told there was not.
The waitress lied. Not only the worst cocoa I've ever had, I swear here was chai spices in it as well.

This is the worst Starbucks. Go a little out of your way to avoid it.  I used to be a regular at this location but it just became a hassle.  They either run out of something like the syrup or milk you like or they are super slow with making your drink.  On a few occasions I ordered a drink and waited over 15 minutes for it.  I tried the order ahead thing and when I got there it wasn't made because they ran out of syrup.  Waste of my time!  Do yourself a favor and Go to the one in the Giant or on West Chester Pike.
I visit this Starbucks every once in a while because it's the closest to my house . The employees are very nice but the service is slow.
It's Starbucks, you all know and love it. Great seasonal drinks, location is friendly and speedy, for your average cup of Joe this is the place.
Love this Starbucks. They're always busy but they are always very courteous and friendly. Oh! The coffee is delish

As always love Starbucks and their cross training btw stores are great! They tend to be consistent with their baristas.  Very informed and know what they are doing and putting together to provide great experience and coffee!
I like the staff and service but the music is too loud and i always end up having a headache. They need to understand that the place is not a club. Hope they address this issue.

I visited this store on 10/11/13.  The service was extremely slow and I had to remind the staff of my missing lattes. A training session on good customer service is needed by all employees who work at this location.

This is my favorite South Tampa Starbucks. Its always full, especially in the morning but the staff memorizes your drink if you become a regular and the outdoor seating here is covered which is unique to the South Tampa Starbucks options. There's a great Greek Restaurant next door and a Nail salon in the same shopping center so parking can be difficult but this is still my go to Starbucks in South Tampa because of the staff!

This is, by far, my favorite Starbucks location. It's conveniently located on my way to I-64, so I frequently visit on my way to work. The drive-thru staff is friendly and fast - even if the line is all the way out of the parking lot! The food is always hot and the drinks are made-to-order.

Here about everyday! Looove it! Dog friendly!!! Great staff! All super nice and friendly, always have been. They have organic Justins peanut butter cups! Ummm double yum! 
Best Starbucks ever! My Bff/dog approves!

Coming from a person who used to be a gold member yearly.

This place is awful, not only is it really packed All the time. The team members in here don't give a shit about the quality of your drink. I've given this store now 5 times since I've moved to Scott. 
Every single time I order fraps, they come out extremely watery, I mean like half of the drink is liquid.
Yesterday I decided on asking to get more ice to counteract this problem only to have the lady add three scoops of ice and then realizing that the blender got stuck only to pour it anyways. After that she ended up leaving about 8-9 oz of crushed ice left in the blender. Which meant my drink was extremely watered down by all that extra unneeded ice you carelessly blended . So much for me trying the cherry blossom drink, ONLY reason I wanted to try Starbucks again.

This girl handed off as well watered frappes to these group of 5 girls that were celebrating her birthday. How can you care so little and why does management not put her in check.

I know you definitely are wasting so much product I can tell, I don't understand how the manager does not educate you to properly measure drinks.
Pouring drinks are not hard, I have been in your same spot for three years! 

This is why I have avoided going to Starbucks at all these past three years I've been stationed at Scott.

It's Starbucks, what can I say?

I mean I can't say they're the best staff in the world but they're pretty okay for the most part. My order is always correct and my drink gets made on time and I don't end up standing there for half an hour waiting for a tall latte.

I'd say another plus would be the fact that they don't kick me out after 3+ hours of sitting at the same table, drinking the same beverage and abusing the crap out of their free wifi.

Ok so while in Reno I needed coffee of course. This SB was right up the street so I got to visit pretty much every day I was there. This was a well run SB. Clean with a very professional staff. They always got my orders right and each drink was made well. They had free samples to try also. Of course they had all the usual SB stuff like WiFI and chairs and tables. Overall this Starbucks was a notch above your typical SB and if I lived here I would visit every day.
If only this location had drive thru... Loving the new items on the menu. Cake pops are addictive.

This location is efficient & friendly.  Tons of outlets for laptops/charging your devices along the bench seating. 

There are a few spots to sit at outside and a stainless steel bowl for your pets!  

It can be a bit difficult to find as it's on the West side of the Manning Freeway - there is a cross intersection with lights to help make it easier to get back on North or South bound Manning.

See you soon, Starbucks!

its starbucks enough said. 

They would have 5 stars but the girl corrected me when I ordered. I am well aware of the Starbucks Lingo. I knew it before the little girl taking my order.  I choose not to conform to the lingo.

This Starbucks is perfectly located across from USF and my job so it's convenient to just stop by on my way to either places. Like most Starbucks, the service is quick and efficient. The parking lot of this Starbucks is very small with maybe 10 parking spots so it's hard if you want to park and stay for a while. However, I do like the setup inside because there are 2 long hightop tables with outlets as well at least 10 tables to sit at inside from 2-4 seaters and they also have leather chairs. They also have a big outdoor seating area. I'm not sure if there are outlets out there but I know inside there are. It's clean and neat and their music isn't too loud. It's a very busy Starbucks since it's right across from the university so if you're looking for a place to camp out and study... come early.
Very good location with great atmosphere. The staff are really friendly and helpful. I go there quite often. Free wifi. Good collection of breakfast and coffee. They have mobile payment facility.

This is a full Starbucks location, with food, the usual Starbucks drink menu, and a good selection of packaged coffee beans and Starbucks merch.

The baristas are nice and have always gotten my orders right.  During their peak times (when people are heading to or from work), the line can build up a little and you might have to wait a few minutes for your drink if it's not brewed coffee or tea.  They try to push the orders out quickly, though.

Setting it apart from some other Starbucks, this location is roomy.  It has large tables available, has a few comfy leather chairs, and has a number of pairs of electrical outlets (I believe five), making it a good choice for when you want to sit down and read or work on a laptop, or when you're looking to sit with friends.  The wifi network is pretty speedy, too.  The store can get a little crowded during peak times, but, in my many visits there, I've always found a seating arrangement that fit my needs.

Every time I go here the service is super super slow. They take forever to make drinks and it looks like the employees are just walking back and forth not doing much. Very frustrating since Starbucks mission is all about customer service and getting orders fulfilled as quickly as possible.

Horrible Service. Unorganized. Slow. No sense of urgency whatsoever. I counted 4 people behind the counter moving slower than molasses. I've been to A LOT of Starbucks coffee houses, and this one is definitely the worst I've ever experienced. I waited approximately 20 minutes after ordering my beverage and STILL they didn't have it ready. I had to ask for a refund because I had to leave. They seemed to be upset that I asked for a refund.. like I was the problem?? Anyway, I've been to this location a few times and always left unhappy either because of the service and/or poorly made drinks. The reason I had continued to go is because the location is convenient, but I can't sacrifice my time anymore for lousy service. Get it together people!

Quite possibly the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. It's amazing how CONSISTENTLY they are terrible. From not filling up your drink, being out of everything all the time, long long lines inside and out, and rude untrained employees.  Clearly nobody in Starbucks corporate is paying attention to this location or they would be revamping it completely as we speak. At this point we would all be better off if it's just closed down and they opened one in the target across the street.

I go to all of the locations, because I am all over the city some days. This is a great location.  The employees are friendly, fast, and the order is never wrong. I only use the drive-up, but it is always fast. There are Starbuck's in the area that could learn a lot from them-some are really bad.

I stop here a lot when I am heading to San Diego for my pre-road-trip caffiene.  The staff are always super, the joint is clean and they always get my quad venti drink right.

BUT, this is only get three stars for the sole reason it is in a terrible location.  Hard to get in and out of this one, period.  While I love the location in terms of being right off the freeway - if there is any traffic happening at any point in the day it is a pain to turn into, and get out of to put you back on the I-10 heading west.

If you are a patient person, then it will be okay and likely not bother you.
If your strolling through the mdallabd wanting a nice beverage while shopping,  then Starbucks is the perfect stop for s casual type of day.

Definitely not my favorite Starbucks. They have messed up my order numerous times. It's especially annoying when you initially order in the drive thru then you have to go in and get your drink fixed. They weren't very apologetic for messing up the order either.

Flies, Bad service, and bad coffee. Ofcourse there are a few nice employees, but the bad ones outweigh the good. I remember one time when an older gentlemen came up to get his drink and they had forgotten about it. They apologized to him and for compensation gave him the other drink that was waiting at the counter, which happened to be my drink! I could get over the bad service if there weren't an abundance of flies. I'm not talking one little fly, I'm talking about 6 flies EVERY TIME I GO THERE. Absolutely disgusting. Starbucks is supposed to feel classy and comfortable but this one feels gross

As many reviews I read about this place...they're all true!!!! There's always a newbie in training!!! I wonder if they're able to keep their employees? Anyways, I came here on a Saturday morning, no one was in there so I didn't care. But there was a new girl and a guy. I guess my drink orders can sometimes be complicated because she had to ring it up 3x. I noticed that I was overcharged too for no particular reason. I had a grande caramel macchiato and it's like $4.45. My total was $5.45 so my tax was literally a 1$? Wonder why....I didn't ask because I was running late. As usual lol but 3 stars for this location because my drink was super delicious!

Wish this place was better.  I have gone several times as it is the closest (for the moment) coffee shop.  Consistently slow service and rude employees.  Last night it was slow (only 2 cars ahead of me) so I gave it a shot and went through the drive thru.  Still took almost ten minutes.  It wasn't busy inside either, employee seemed more into talking to other employee than making coffee.  I have in the past had to pull out of line due to long wait time.  Once the manager was apparently training new employees.  They looked shocked...  Oh well, really hope a Dunkin donuts opens on green mount soon.

Morning crew on Saturday needs to up their game. Baristas didn't get tops solidly on the cups. This didn't start the morning off well. They had difficulty comprehending simple directions. In spite of having to clean up spilled coffee, I gave the place three stars because during the week this place usually gives good service.

All I needed was one large to go container of coffee. The first Starbucks I walk into does not have enough coffee on hand and it will be a 15 minute wait minimum. I called two other Starbucks that would be on my way to work and no one answers the phone. This Starbucks answers the phone and I tell him I will be there in 10 minutes. I arrive after driving over to their store and my order is not even started. I asked the location of the Starbucks specifically and the girl tells me "the new one quote. Less than impressed with the organization of this worldwide company right now.

Even after I convince myself to go here and I go here, I can't convince myself to stay.

It is almost always a disgusting line (15+ people) due to this being a University coffee shop. People are either there right after class, or they think that no one will be there between class- along with everyone else.

There are a lot of tables along  the side of the building, but they're awkward for being social and often overwhelmed by people. Impossible to be a relaxing, coffee atmosphere.

There are two other cafes on campus, and this one is of course the most expensive. And while the baristas are all nice, because they're students and it sucks just as much for them as you, the business itself is dick. Privately owned, they NEVER participate in promotions, not for any cause. They don't even comply with the Frequent Starbucks Card system.

I lie- they stock the AIDS coffee for sale. 

It's not worth the wait for things this expensive, this bad for you. Go to main building, ThirtyOne41, and get affordable coffee/tea/muffins. I'm not spending  $3.25 for the exact same Tazo tea (actually, they only give you one bag for  a large at starbucks, but two in the main) that costs $1.84 a block away, with a nicer atmosphere and no line. No, thank you.

The service was EXTREMELY SLOW as per usual and they got my order wrong. I waited almost 10 minutes in the drive thru for the 2 cars ahead of me to move and when I got to the window I was STILL waiting. I ordered a hot tea and they presented me with and iced tea. Best part is they charged me for an iced tea which is MORE than a hot tea and didn't even offer me a refund of the difference.

The longest lines and slowest service.  There have been times where it took me a full 30 minutes from the time I got in line to the time I leave with a drink.  I've found it to be faster to walk to the Starbucks on 34th street than it is to go here.  Also, this location doesn't accept Starbucks Rewards

I love going here for the convenience. I go to the Market and can get food or gas. Issues are, sometimes the drinks aren't that great. Only when this one employee works. He is amazing! Everything I order, he makes perfect. From simple ice teas to intricate mixed coffee drinks. My go to at this location is ice peach green tea lemonade. It's simple and you can't go wrong. Always refreshing! I usually just go in and out. The online order is convenient, but I am such an indecisive person. I end up ordering at the counter. The staffs outrageously helpful. They make decent drinks too, but that one guy is my favourite. I need to remember his name. Either way Theres no point of isolating him. They are a great team and are always inviting! Oh, they do not have a drive thru. So, be careful when you park. It's a tight area. If you're willing to walk park on the Smith's side and walk a little.
This is a very busy store, but always efficient and friendly staff.  Roomy both inside and outdoor patio.  It would be really great if there was a drive through, but not possible at this location

Fast drive-thru, had the St. Louis mug in stock, but not the Illinois one.   Hurray.
5 stars because this was the best tasting Starbucks I have had in the past 6 months.   (writing this while drinking one of the worst tasting...  )

Friendly staff, and again.   FAST drive-thru/well made coffee.
My all time favorite Starbucks now for over 10 years.  Well trained employees with great customer service every time.  The ambiance at this location is relaxing and inviting.  Love it!

A slightly below average Starbucks hence the below average star rating. They were out of things and it was early in the day, the coffee tasted like mud and the staff was particularly "out of it". Usually at a Starbucks there's some millennial zombies working who don't know anything and then one employee who knows everything. This location seemed to not have the "knows everything" employee no one could answer my simple questions about the varieties  of coffee and A question about the food that should've been easy dance.
  I asked if they could make me a pot of the blonde coffee and they said "no" because it was later in the day, I often ask them to do that at other Starbucks and they have no problem with that at all I realize they stop making the blonde earlier in the day. I was super friendly when I asked and they do it at a lot of other locations so it must be indicative of something else. I hate to be negative, I really do, but the place was also not really kept up. As far as cleanliness goes it was definitely a bit messy and no one was attending to it. There are definitely better choices for your money.

This Starbucks location is consistently friendly and the quality of the blended drinks are always top notch. The only complaint I have is the parking lot can be tough to navigate at the Royersford location
Great service always and long lines. Great for them. Another location on 54 is badly needed.

The staff is very friendly at this location, and the drink quality is excellent. I do agree, however, that the staff does not seem all that concerned with fast drink production. Not the place to go if you are in a hurry and there is any kind of line.

I've been making the drive from LA to SB enough to know for me, I'd rather take the 118 and drive a little further than sit in traffic for that same amount of time. And this Starbucks is my perfect reward when I make it halfway through my journey. 
I've stopped here a handful of times, and ice never been disappointed. The line is usually pretty short, but they are able to get through people quickly when a line does form. The place is always clean, and the baristas are friendly. And when I order my drink, I usually have a fair amount of special requests (less sweetener, coconut milk, etc etc) and they always make it easy.

Legendary Rudeness

Don't toss my straw at me Marissa. And I specifically told you to NOT cut my tea with water - full strength - I was very specific. 

I got to share the experience with other patrons. We were all being treated to the "I'm oooooh so busy" straw toss. An older gentleman in front of me look shocked. 


Just bad - period.

This place has been around for quite sometime now... I've been a regular customer for about 5 years now. 

Never had a bad cup a joe here!!!  And yes, it's a place where the baristas know your name : ) Sure as hell a good time!
The worst for so many reasons. Rude customer service. Have been belittled on more than one occasion. Lines are ridiculous.

We just stopped for coffee 3 minutes after opening time before we hit the road. Employee informs us they were still closed. Door sign and app said they were open for ordering.... guess McDonalds get our business.
Always busy at this location esp because of the drive through option. They all move fast here though so they've all been crisp every time I come here. Friendly cashiers

Love this place!

They are always so nice and meet you w/ a greeting no matter how crowded it is.  I am not a coffee drinker, but the caramel apple spice and crossaint are my weakness.  Also, during the holidays they have this creamy cranberry bar thing! Awesome.

This location is logistically in a ROTTEN spot.  A busy intersection.  The true bonus is that (unlike the Starbucks further up State Street) it has a drive thru.  They have outdoor seating, but who in their right mind wants to sit outside at a busy, often congested intersection inhaling fumes?  The really good thing is that since Starbucks is generally AWESOMELY the same for product, you can get your caffeine on the go and be satisfied with the product itself.

Passing through Indy en route to Chicago. Desperately in need of a caffeine fix to get us through the last stretch of our drive. So happy to see the Starbucks on the sign for this exit. Unfortunately, we pull off to discover the Bucks is a mile off the exit. Oh well, it's 7 pm and we need our coffee. Much to our dismay, the location was already closed. Please don't advertise yourself as a viable option for travelers if you're going to be closed before 8.

As a Starbucks partner myself I expect to be treated exactly how we are trained to treat our customers when I go to a store. This Starbucks has the worst customer service I've seen in any Starbucks. 
I went through the drive thru. 
My order was rushed, put in incorrectly and misunderstood. When I got to the window the barista didn't have his name tag on and he was uninterested. I was charged for a drink I didn't receive. The shots were dead. The sandwich's egg was still frozen as well. This store should be ashamed of themselves.
For you coffee lovers, try one of the flavored syrups and you won't have to add additional sugar. Quick getting through the line even though it was long.

This is my local Starbucks and I'm going to reconsider ever going back after dealing with one incredibly rude employee. One more than one occasion the older male employee has denied making decaf coffee. The first time it was in the evening and I was told they only make decaf in the morning. This morning I went in at 9:30am and was, once again, told they do not have decaf coffee and when I asked why I was yelled at by this man and told "we do not make decaf because no one drinks it" despite the fact that I was asking for it. I've always ordered decaf and this has never been a problem. Seeing other reviews, where people have been denied other types of coffee, it looks like this guy just refuses to do his job. Will never return here. Awful customer "service" especially during the holidays. Someone needs to get rid of Scrooge!

We are here every Saturday morning. Today we had the misfortune of coming when the manager Mark was manning the order counter - truly, one of the most unpleasant people I've ever encountered. He went off the rails when I asked him to warm up a cream cheese muffin just a tiny bit, something they have done at every other Starbucks the many times I have ordered this. It's one thing to nicely say "sorry, I can't do that" but he was loud, belligerent and incredible rude. Other guests were staring. We won't come again when he is here! (One of the other employees quietly apologized to me for Mark's behavior!)

Oh Starbucks.  How do I love you?  Let me count the ways.  

You have helped me numerous times during long shifts at work and more recently, during the post Thanksgiving sales in which I had to show up at the mall at 5 am for work and for that, I thank you.

I can not wait until we meet again for yet another 10 hour shift.  Yay for seasonal flavors!!!
The staff is quick, pleasant and seem to love what they're doing. It was a pleasant surprise to be greeted with such enthusiasm after a disappointing plane delay.

I visit here very often since it's the nearest Starbucks to my place. Parking is usually easy after 10am and it's free. The best part of this Starbucks is they have great customer service. Some staff members are super friendly, like Joseph and Curtis, it's always a pleasure and heart-warming to have their service. However, every once for a while, they will have few new faces who serve people with cold faces and rarely respond or reaffirm to customer's saying. That really make big differences comparing with my regular experience there. I wish those staff can pick up the basic etiquette to work with customers more since I wish to feel like coming home in my neighborhood. The ratio of chance for me having cold interaction is 1 out of 5, so I give them 4 stars.
I come here frequently. I love the drive-thru option with the huge screen. Fast and friendly service. Food and drinks have been made great! No complaints here.

Starbucks - what can I say. Morning, noon, or night this is the love to be! I have nothing negative to say about Starbucks at all! 

However, this particular location has its limitations. It is one of those smaller stores, meaning less seating and a more crowded environment. I wouldn't recommend coming to this one to get work done. On the other hand it does have a drive thru, which is always nice. 

Overall this Starbucks is just like the rest to me - one of my favorite places. :)

I've stopped in this Starbucks a few times and each time the staff haa always been extremely friendly and helpful. They had a lot of regulars come in, each were greeted by name and asked if they wanted the usual. Small things like that are nice to see.

This place has a couple key advantages: 

1) Places like Monon Coffee close fairly early, and I often rise late - hangover or not - but Starbucks is always open.

2) Drive Thru - When there isn't a line snaked around the building, the drive through is fast... and when it's cold or raining, that's the tops.

3) Coffee - Intelligentsia it's not, but Starbucks is always consistently fair to good.

I witnessed an appalling display of customer service. A male employee treated a customer terribly rudely even though the customer was in no way acting badly. The Starbucks jerk got the man's order wrong and the customer actually apologized to the employee. Rather than respond like all employees are taught, this moron actually insults the customer under his breath. The old man couldn't hear and asked the employee what he had said. The employee said, 'nothing', and then muttered another insult. I was too shocked to say anything. The old guy never knew anything was wrong and left just as happy as when he came in. Shameful.
They have no idea how to make a cappuccino.   I ordered one and it had very little foam.  I complained and they made a new one that was just as bad.  It's not a latte

JUST moved to Nashville. (Literally yesterday.) This was my first Starbucks stop, as its closest to my new house. The baristas were so friendly and welcoming! The service was fast and efficient. Looking forward to many more visits!

eh.  they got both our orders wrong, but we don't like wasting food like pretentious folk, so we didn't say anything and consumed it anyway.  

maybe they misunderstood my request for a frappuccino to mean iced-late, and maybe they misunderstood whatever it was my  husband ordered...i don't know, i wasn't paying attention--apparently neither was the person taking our order... 

it's starbucks, can't really vary the product, it'd be like going to mcdonald's and ordering chicken nuggets and getting a big mac instead, in the end, you know what everything on the menu is, no matter the location...this location just happened to make me a yuck drink i didn't ask for....
Super slow. Been here 5 times few customers and terrible baristas wake up and smell the coffee

This Starbucks is located inside the Target.   Therefore,  you won't have the ambience of a stand alone store.  However,  if you want convenience, you can order your coffee and drank it while you shop for household items and grocery.   Like everyone else,  I have a to do list a mile long,  so sometimes it's always good if I can kill two birds with one stone.

(4) ~ (For the one @ GATE F) very good overall, mainly because they have a Clover Brewing System!;). NOTE:. You rarely see Clovers at airport Starbucks.  Unfortunately I noticed it too late, so this review is a REMINDER to self;)LOL

MENU
** Clover Brewed Coffee = (5) Excellent!
* Dark French Roast = (3.75) Good
* Chile Mocha = (3.25) pretty good, but not great

These guys are spot on! I'm a light coffee drinker because I prefer tea but they always make sure to make me something that won't give me the jitters. The baristas are amazing, sweet and friendly. It's such a quaint little location in my neighborhood and during the warmer times of year it's always happening on the patio. I love this location.
Slow service no matter what time of day, typically can't get a drink right. Being generous with 2 stars because it's in a convenient location.

Today I went in and got the usual, venti mocha. Like always 3/4s full. I never like going to this starbucks I just drive to the one on Dalmonte Ranch. And I work ACROSS THE PARKING LOT from this starbucks. No other starbucks has done this to me. They always fill it up, and I pay for it. What is this! I only came here today because I had no car to drive to the other one. But I knew this would happen. I shouldn't of went! This will definitely be the last time I come to this location.
