Open up your drinks as they hand them to you and let them know. They only do it with hot drinks and not the cold. Cause you can see threw the cold coffee cups.

I stop by here two to three times a year on my way up north. They always do a great job and now they carry Laboulange. The line can be long depending what time of the day you are there, however, they do a great job getting you through quickly. This is usual a bathroom stop and it is pretty clean.
No general complaints...pretty friendly but some baristas are very slow. I hate that they turn their oven off 90 min before closing time.
Slowest Starbucks ever. No advantage to ordering with the mobile app, you will still wait a long time for your drink.
It's Starbucks, so you know what you get. This store seems to be overly attentive to their regular customers, while folks like me are just another face in the crowd.

This is the most convent Starbucks for me to go to, it's the closest to my house, so I can't describe my happiness when it opened. However, since Starbucks opened in 2017 I have yet to receive a correct order. I have on multiple occasions gotten into a back and fourth with an employee about not steaming the milk in my tea. I never knew getting regular tea with sugar was such a complex order. The reason I'm writing this post today is that I have had enough rude interactions and messed up order , today I ordered tea and a breakfast sandwich all of which we stark cold. I'm fed up with the lack of respect and incompetence the employees at this location has consistently given to myself and my family after almost a year of patronage.

Counterintuitive to logic, parking and going inside when there is a long drive thru will NOT save you time on getting a cup of coffee...at least the third or fourth time I have gone inside with only two people in front of me and they forgot to pour my coffee. I waited patiently and nothing.  Finally had to ask barista where my coffee was. Hey Corporate coffee take a clue from McDonalds and get your systems in check. This location hit or miss for service with a smile

Today was unclean with the tables not wiped or not wiped well enough, lots of crumbs and sticky syrup still on them. The sitting areas were circling with flies. Overall, it seems like the long drive through lines absorb the attention of the staff, and the inside gets neglected.

One of the things that I believe has made Starbucks so successful is the consistency. Whether I walk in to a Starbucks in Tampa, Mid of nowhere Missouri or the cpatial of the world, NYC every time I order my Grande Soy Vanilla Latte it tastes exactly how I expect it to. 

The look and feel of individual franchise stores is a little unique to the city of residence but the taste is the same. The baristas are always happy, do they get free coffee is that why? THe music is always light and positive and the assortment of breads, muffins and protein boxes are always abundant. 

At the South Tampa location where I frequent depending on the time of day the time it takes to get my coffee varies but is never ridiculously long. If I go in it's almost certain i will run into a neighbor or friend which I like unless I haven't taken my first sip off latte. Most know to wait.... Having the options to sit outside is something I like taking advantage of but need to get there early cause so do a lot of other customers. All in all I love it.

I love the convenience of the drive thru window. The employees are very friendly, always smiling and give me my coffee quickly. Today I tried the grande caramel flan latte with an extra shot of espresso and skim milk. I like my coffee strong! No need for any extra sweetener because the coffee already caramel flan goodness in it. It was delicious! This is my second day in a row getting this treat! Hopefully it will fuel me to ace my online nutrition test here in a min. All in all, you can't go wrong this Starbucks location. Even during the busy hours the staff is on their A game. Try a latte today!

Customer service is hit or miss. One morning in the drive thru I had ordered a tall coffee in a grande cup with extra milk, which is pretty much my standard order at every Starbucks I go to in the colder months and it has never ever been an issue. The barista gave me a really hard time about it and wanted me to pay for a grande even though I only wanted 12 oz of coffee. She told me the policy was to charge for more than 4 oz of milk. I worked at Starbucks for a few years and this was never something I had heard of. Regardless, I wasn't asking for 4 oz of milk, maybe 3 at the most if it was filled to the standard amount in a grande cup, which I can tell you is not actually 16 oz. I ended up just getting the tall black coffee since clearly she couldn't be bothered to talk to me about it anymore. 

When they do have nice people working, it's a great experience. They usually make my iced coffee perfectly.

Long time Starbucks customer. I easily spend $50 a week at various stores and I'm a coffee addict. As they rapidly expand their brand on to every corner in Florida though there's been a noticeable downgrade in customer service. This experience at the Fowler Starbucks was really the nail in the coffin for me and the brand. 
I showed up to the location at 4:45 AM on my way out of town traveling for business. all the lights were on including the drive light. After sitting in the drive thru area for over 5 minutes with no response I drive up. Inside I can see two employees who see me but don't acknowledge me at all. I'm clearly there assuming they're open and they just go about their business ignoring me entirely, not even offering a wave or hand motion that they're closed. 
And I certainly wasn't discreet lol. I honked, shouted, even tapped on the window. They probably didn't open till 5, but they could at least give me some indication of that. or make any effort at all to acknowledge me as a human standing there clearly wanting coffee and thinking they're open...
So it's Wawa from here on out for me. it's been real Starbucks

this starbucks does not support or care for any philidelphia police officers, fire fighters, and emt's.  boycott the business, any coffee establishment that will not alow a police officer to use its bathroom does not belong in business.  what happened to simple life respect for others?  go to dunkin donuts.... the coffee is better anyway!!

http://www.nj.com/news/index.ssf/2015/09/starbucks_employee_to_police_officer_you_cant_use.html#incart_river
BEWARE OF THE HALF FILLED CUPS!!! Beware of the male barista with scraggly long hair!!

Came to the same location at a different time and the experience was 100% better! Patrick, the barista, was super helpful and top notch customer service. I got a Vanilla Roobois, which is really good and even better with a little bit of milk.

This Starbucks is closest to my house, so I always come before I have classes at school. At night it does get a little crowded, but everyone is very nice, there is plenty of seating both indoors and outdoors, and there are a lot of parking spaces. Sam, Dylan, Michael, and this girl with pigtails (I forgot her name) are the best! They're very nice and actually TALK to you while they're making your drink. I appreciate that, because sometimes they tell you about new things you should try next time you come in, or make little suggestions that could help make your drink better.
Love this Starbucks! Always fast service even when the line is long. Plus they're always willing to correct the drink if it's wrong. Great customer service from an even better staff!!

This is one of the poorest run Starbucks I've ever been to. The staff are friendly but they are painfully slow are never effectively using their staff members. For example, there will be 20 people in line, 8 cups waiting to be made, 1 person trying to make all these orders and 2 people stocking sugar and coffee out in the floor and not making a single drink. This makes no sense. It is possible these people are not "trained baristas" but I'm not sure that makes my point any less relevant. This is a relatively busy location, they really need to be more efficient. I have been to far busier locations that run like well oiled machines- please help this location! 

Mobile orders? Good luck ! A lost cause at this locale.

5 stars for good customer service and a consistently good product, yet the downside to this location is its drive-thru. One of the absolutely worst that I've ever seen. It is (in my Donald Trump voice) AWFUUUUUUUL!!!! If you park next to the building, you are so screwed. Get ready to be blocked in for several minutes at a time while calling your boss to tell them that you are running late. The drive-thru has a very unique shape to it, in that it takes up nearly three quarters of the building upon entering from the main road. In addition, the drive-thru backs up so badly that you are better off walking in and making your order. It seems as if there are three baristas waiting to assist you within the drive-thru alone. 

The drive-thru obviously isn't the fault of the Starbucks employees, but it kind of sucks from a customer point of view. Its probably best to do what I did while on my second visit: park 15-20 parking rows away from the building so that you can walk inside of the store to purchase your yum yums.

Whoever designed this placed needs to be karate chopped in the neck. The customers + Starbucks employees deserve better than this type of dubious store layout.

Coffee (of many variations), Tea, Hot Chocolate, cakes, lunches, snacks & gifts... pretty much what is at all Starbucks.  Not a big coffee drinker myself, I frequently stop by with my daughter.  And if given an option at hotels, I'd stop by for Starbucks coffee for my "daily cup of Jo."  I do, however, love their lemon pound cake... not gooey, goes well with that breakfast coffee when you don't want yet another egg sandwich.  They also have a few interesting lunch options.

Will probably stop at Starbucks wherever, whenever... good coffee, even for a one cup a day person.

When they make your drink right, it's fantastic.. that is WHEN they make it correctly. I've had about an 85% accuracy rating on my drinks. The staff are always friendly, especially in the mornings. I will continue to make this my regular Starbucks, I have just made a habit of tasting my drink before driving off.

When this place first opened, it was fine. It was nice to have a coffee place closer to the store where I work. But, after several of my decaf orders being regular (and getting very sick because of it), the slow service, the stale baked goods and the rude staff, I've decided it's worth the extra walk to the Second Cup or even up to the new Tim Hortons. If I only have 15 minutes, I can't wait for someone to remake my drink. Twice.

I only stop here if I absolutely need to. The service is usually hit or miss. I've ordered via mobile and the service is only friendly when 1 younger girl is working. The rest act as if you are bothering them. I had ordered a grande frappucino and I never got the sticker for my card, so I just wanted the sticker. They just seemed annoyed I asked. 

Main line attitude served fresh with your Starbucks. No thanks.

Not sure if this location is understaffed or what... every time I have visited this location it takes forever to get my drink. I've been waiting over 30 minuets today, giving me time to leave this review. Good thing it's Sunday and I'm not in a hurry. 

Starbucks, you need to step up your game at this location.

Stopped in here today on my way to the library. I visit Starbucks about once a week, but this was my first visit to this location. I'd have to say this is the slowest Starbucks I've been to in philly. 4 people behind the counter, 1 making drinks...took about 15 minutes to get my drink. The drink was great, but watching 1 guy make drinks for the lunch rush hour was agonizing. The other staff members were piling up people's orders and it was clear from other customer's faces and conversations, they were not pleased with the service.

I like this specific location a lot. The people are quick and friendly. The coffee taste better here than other Starbucks I've ordered at. I just wish less people smoked outside. I would love to enjoy the outside but the cigarette smoke is too strong outside.

About a month ago I went I side to purchase a ice coffee. I asked for milk . The girl didn't give me my ice coffee with milk in it and when I saw it I reminded her how I wanted it and she said rudely " there's creamer in the corner " dumb girl. Thankfully there was a nicer girl there and I asked her to fix it and she did!

Love this Starbucks!! Ample amounted of seating, even though it is always busy it seems. Everyone is super friend, but I have to say Sean is my favorite barista at this location. I never thought you would build a relationship with your coffee people-- but Sean is so friendly and attentive that you can't help but look forward to seeing him when you get your coffee! If you are looking for a regular Starbucks this is the one!

under slightly new management, which has caused a perceivable hit in quality. it's still a better cuppa than any other SB i've been to in the area (save the delmar one which has much the same staff).  people are friendly, too.

So I went through the drive through and ordered but the lady just didn't get what I was saying. What I said was very clear and I don't understand how she had such a hard time understanding me. I had to say my order 3 or 4 times before she seemed to get it, and even then she kept changing it to things I hadn't said. When she went over my order she got two things wrong but I just stopped caring and said yes even though it was mostly wrong. Then I got to the window(after waiting for about 10 minutes) and took two of the wrong orders and asked her (very politely) if she could fix just one of the drinks that had been messed up. Immediately, she got incredibly defensive and kept saying "i read it over and you said it was ok". Finally she went to fix my drink and another lady handed it to me(with an apologetic smile on her face). I left only to realize that the drink she gave me was also not what I asked for. Also, I payed about 2$ more for the drink than I should have and ended up throwing it away. Honestly that experience ruined my day. Won't be going back there ever again and will try to avoid Starbucks as long as I can.

Worst parking lot set-up ever!! It's small and inconvenient. The drive thru cars have to wrap around the building and block parked cars in certain areas because lack of space. I only stop here because it's the only Starbucks around this area and close to highway 64. Service has always been mediocre and I've never been bedazzled by this place but it's really your only option around this location.

Will continue to go to this location rather than 56th location. This one always makes my drinks right and so far all the employees are friendly and actually act like they know what customer service is. They are also always fast when I come through the drive through or inside. Each time I go to visit the total waiting time for my drink is about 3-5 minutes or less.

I previously gave this Starbucks a great review a few months ago and I'm sad to say my view of this Starbucks has totally changed. I've really been back and forth about changing my review but today pushed me a bit over the edge. I've been coming here a few times a week for the past year so I know what times are usually good to avoid a crowd. I work up the street so I usually give myself an extra 25 - 30 minutes to make sure I'm able to stop here because the drinks are great. However, the last few months the staff has changed and has become very unfriendly and slow. Not to mention, a customer in front of me ordered a drink with apple juice or something in it and the barista couldn't get the pouch open and opened it with HIS TEETH. I'm happy the customer demanded a new drink and for him to get scissors because if she didn't I would have. So unsanitary. He huffed and puffed about it too which I thought was ridiculous. Anyway, today I walked into Starbucks at 7:40am. My work is 2 minutes up the road so in my mind I had plenty of time. I walked in and saw two customers ahead of me so I figured it'd be a 5 minute wait at best. That wasn't the case at all. Every person working I've never seen before. Someone had to be new because I didn't even get to order my drink until 7:50. I ordered a sandwich and a vanilla latte macchiato. The cashier double checked everything which I was happy about because at this point I'm already irritated by the wait. Not to mention the line behind me is now outrageous, at 7:50am on a Saturday. No events or anything we're going on nearby. As I'm waiting 15 minutes I notice that people who ordered after me start getting their drinks. The barista has a drink sitting at the bar which was a caramel macchiato. I pick it up and see it's my order because the correct order is written on the cup, I explained to her it was not my order and she said she'd make another. No apology but I wasn't about to wait while the line kept growing. I just took the drink and left. Horrible service. Sorry to say I won't be back because when they can make a drink it's delicious. I left at 8:10. 30 minute wait for a coffee is OUTRAGEOUS

Good, quick drive thru experience. Drive thru's are nice when it's really hot out.
Black tea was made perfectly to order and no complaints on the drink. 
If you have a gold card they can redeem the free drinks if you have any saved up!

This is the closest Starbucks to my house. Unfortunately I don't venture here too often because of the poorly designed parking and drive through. 

However when I do happen to be on the correct side of the road and have a craving for a venti Hazelnut Macchiato I'll swing in. It's a smaller Starbucks, but they seem to get the crowd moving fairly quickly. 

There are several tables, but I think they should take over the bank next door and make it a large Starbucks lounge. I would love to bring my laptop and books and study away from home. :)

I love the team that works here and truly believe they are doing their best, but almost 75% of the time I have attended this location, my order has been messed up in one way or another.  Whether it's incorrectly charging me for things or serving me dairy milk (which makes me sick) even though the cup said non-dairy milk, I never quite know how my drinks will turn out when i come here.

A Starbucks like any other Starbucks. This is the one I visit when I work in the mall, and there isn't anything special about it, but there's nothing I have found particularly awful, either. I mostly visit here as oppossed to Tim Hortons or Seond Cup because of the My Starbucks Rewards program.

The lineups can get pretty ridiculous, obviously, since it's in a mall. They also tend to have only one person on till, even when it does get crazy, which is a bit annoying, especially if you're going there on your break and don't exactly have 15 minutes to spend standing in line to order and again waiting for that order. But most of the servers I've had have been very friendly and good at their jobs. There are one or two there that I dread getting, but that's the same anywhere.

My coffee usually tastes just as I expect it to, and only once or twice have they gotten anything on my order wrong (and they are always happy to fix it). A good option if you're in the mall and want a drink or snack. (Though don't hold out hope of them having the new-ish bistro boxes in stock - they're sold out more often than not!)

No need to review the coffee, it's Starbucks.

Importantly though, the restrooms are clean. Barista's are friendly.

I'd like to see fewer wood chairs and more casual seating.
So slow......drive through and the inside. Clean, nice worker bees, but so slow. (Latte was good though!)
Fast service.  Friendly staff.  I wish there was more seating are for me to work at.

I started this review a few months ago and today I was prompted to finish it. Today, I got a bagel with mold on the inside. Whilst I was buttering my bagel, I saw something that looked like it was mold. Not full blown mold but it was fresh mold. Kinda green ya know? I thought it might have been some spinach residue from another sandwich. The. I looked at the other half and saw a whole mold sprout. Disgusting!! If I based my decision on whether to buy Starbucks, on this location..... I would never step foot in another Starbucks again. 

Guess I'll start giving my money to Pour Richard's down the street!
Friendly staff and nice place to hang out! Starbucks seems to be able the same everywhere so the atmosphere and environment really makes a difference. This one's a good one to stop by!

What has happened to one of the best and fastest 
Starbucks in town?? Well I need to find a new one that's not a train wreck. Poor service, dirt everywhere and now the help is mouthy!!!

I am not sure where the others that have written reviews for this place have gone, but this store has the friendliest staff of any Starbucks I have been too. They know most customers by name, greeting them as soon as they walk in the door, and normally have their drink started before they even order. Steve, the manager, has done a great job with this crew, especially Toya who makes my drink perfectly every morning.
Not sure which was most unpleasant: the employee whining loudly about how terrible his life is, the overflowing trash cans, or the dirty floor.  Not a highlight of the Starbucks empire.

Very good Starbucks location.  They are always on point with my fairly straight forward latte order.  I usually add a shot of espresso and you would not believe how often various locations forget that or even forget to add flavoring syrup.  Their employees are always fast and friendly which unfortunately for my wallet, influences me to keep stopping by for calorie dense goodness.  Coffee snobs and hipsters hate them, but I can't drink anything else.  The only downside is the fairly awkward drive through arrangement.  On a busy day it loops around the entire building.  I just returned from a business trip to New Jersey where there is a Dunkin Donuts on nearly every corner and to me, there is no comparison if you like premium coffee drinks:  Starbucks beats Dunkin.

I have never been to a slower Starbucks and a few of the employees were off-putting. While you wait for your drink, you get to watch how the staff works. One man making sandwiches throws them on the counter and a very tall worker with a plaid blue shirt tries to be funny by using ridiculous voiced and being condescending to people. They got all my drinks right, but took them forever and the employees did not make for an enjoyable experience. 

Update - still the SLOWEST Starbucks I have ever been to.

I don't do Starbucks usually. However, I have the pleasure of working in the mall, so this is where I end up for coffee before or during my shifts. I don't get anything special. I'm a regular red eye (coffee with a shot) drinker. That doesn't really run a hole in my pocket. Always comes out just fine from me at this location. Other Starbucks are notorious for handing me an almost room temperature coffee, and this one has yet to do that to me! So kudos!

My five stars goes to the service. They are always so polite despite some of those crazy lines, people, and orders they get. I'll be back because it's right upstairs from me.... and plus they'll refill my cup for a minimal price. 

They have a small seating area. I've taken my breaks in there and I'm always able to sit peacefully. It's a mall location, so don't expect ample seating. 

I do wish they gave mall employee discounts, but that's not the fault of the people that work there. 

Other than that, I don't visit any other Starbucks and probably never will unless it's my ONLY option.

Maybe I need to get out more, but can't say that I've ever been to a Starbucks that closes at 2pm. Granted, it was a Sunday, but still. I was hoping to get my coffee fix, but had to settle by making some hotel room coffee. Sad.

Almost always PACKED on a school day. Coffee quality is about the same as any other 'bucks. 

they have a posted sign that says they dont give out free water, im having trouble looking up the arizona statute but im 90% sure that is not legal.

This is one of my go to starbucks places but it's just an ok location. They're always constantly busy. The drive thru wraps around the building almost every time i'm there. 3 stars because they can actually make the drinks. so if you can wait for good drinks, deff. come here. if not, just go to the mall or down the street to target.
Seriously, Starbucks, an extra $0.75 or whatever for iced coffee vs. regular?  How does that even make sense?  I might as well spend the extra dollar and get an iced latte.  Lame.

This location is in a great area and is kept very clean compared to other Starbucks. As a past Starbucks employee from Canada, I would say it's actually the cleanest I've ever seen for how big the store actually is. It is quite busy, but never cramped, and it's not the store's fault for the traffic of customers it receives, so I'm not sure why there are so many bad ratings based on how "swamped" it is; also, every time I go in (mid-day) there is hardly anyone there and always a great selection of seating. On top of that, the staff and baristas and very friendly, efficient, and put in effort into their minimum wage jobs. You can tell that they're happy to be there and never give attitude. Good job to this location for meeting all the points.
Used to be the best (always consist) tasting & fastest on the North side.  Last couple months has turned into one of the slowest & has had to remake our drinks several times.
The people who work here are awesome. It just always seems to take an incredibly long time to get my coffee.
The best starbucks in the area, but the bakery items changed. Service is very friendly, but sometimes painfully slow

Starbucks are Starbucks, ya know? This one is my SB go to though because it's where I end my jogging rout so I literally go here every day when in SB but not because it's necessarily special other than that. Everyone 's always nice though so we're cooking with all our burners.

This Starbucks is an ordeal. The line for the "Drive Thru" snaked out of the parking lot and onto the street. I pulled up to the window, ordered my iced grande latte and waited. While the line moved quickly, I pulled up to the window, paid the cashier and was promptly given my iced tea. Huh? 

My response: "So, sorry, but I ordered an iced latte." Their response (from the girl in the headset): "He gettin' a venti!" I looked at my receipt to discover I had been charged for a venti. Awesome. 

I asked if I could have my grande latte, to which they added an extra shot of espresso to the venti. It's not even drinkable at this point. The cashier gave me a free drink coupon and my undrinkable non-order. The manager yelled/asked if I was happy, to which the cashier responded/yelled: "Oh yea, he's one happy S.O.B.!"

I guess I could most liken my experience this morning to this SNL skit: http://www.hulu.com/watch/447642

I pop into this Starbucks location 4-5 times a week to grab my beloved iced coffee after my workouts and these people are the best! I've seen them in a bad mood! They're always friendly and goofing around and having a great time! I go to a lot of Starbucks both local and when I travel and I have to say the employees at this location are the most consistent with their great attitude!

I asked for my white chocolate mocha at 130 degrees. It is boiling. My friend, whose name is Sue, was asked how to spell her name. "Ts...    they spelled it "Zue" . Really. They also did not leave her room for cream and sugar.

Not a bad Starbucks. Most of the staff have been friendly and attentive. Service is not the quickest, nor do you get the feeling that there is any need to hurry but then I am an impatient one. Parking lot can sometimes be a pain but this is south Tampa after all. Love the tables outside and the the comfy indoor chairs seem to be frequently occupied by nappers... can't say I've ever napped at  Starbucks....so them chairs MUST be super comfy!

I stopped by here before heading up to Phoenix to party for New Years Eve. I figured I'd get something to amp me up on the trip up. The service was friendly and humorous. They quickly took my order without questions. I ordered a "Mocha/Caramel Frappachino with an extra shot, Affigato style" The coffee came out great and was what I needed to start my New Years Eve fun. I definitely would stop by here again when I live for a trip and in need of some caffeine!

I ordered the strawberry refresher. Service was slow. When I finally received my order, my drink was so full of ice that there was hardly any liquid in the cup. Definitely the worst Starbucks experience I've had in a long time.

Just tried the new refreshers and that is just what they are refreshing.  The lime reminded me of a mojito and what's not refreshing about that.  Very berry hibiscus was also good.  The barista recommended trying the orange said it reminds her of tang.  And I can't forget to add... Who doesn't get excited about the pumpkin spice latte- it just screams FALL IS COMING!

This is my favorite Starbucks ever! The employees are always so nice & always make my drinks perfect unlike other locations I've been to! The service is always very quick & they are always very inviting! Thank you Starbucks on Chippewa & Landsdowne for being excellent!
The two guys who helped me were super nice and quick, stirred my coffee !! Which no other one has ever done!! So i definitely will be returning for sure. Clean, quiet environment. Enjoyed it.

Simple - my go to for iced coffee and the occasional chai latte. 

The germantown pike location is what keeps me going to starbucks simply due to their very nice young ladies that work there. 

Starbucks is starbucks, but the baristas at this location really try and give the costumer what they want.  That is why i am giving this chain a 4 star rating.

I go here because it's convenient but they lack consistency. Occasionally my order is wrong, doesn't taste right, or doesn't look right (e.g. missing whipped cream, drink not stirred). Other times the drive thru wait is much too long. I used to work at Starbucks so I know what their standards are. The staff has always been friendly and will correct any issues. Some seating outside. Seating area is for about 15-20 people inside and can get full. I have sadly left before to find another place to study when full. There's a handful of electric sockets along the wall and under the seat bench. Parking lot space can be limited during peak hours but sometimes if you wait just a bit, something will free up or  you can also drive around the back to park at Walgreens.
Literally the slowest wait I've had at a drive through. Rude service, 20+ minute wait. Coffee was good, inexcusable service

Longest wait of my life for coffee,  over half an hour and its impossible to escape the drive thru line due to the curb.  We received no explanation and were still charged for one cold coffee.   I would avoid this shop at all costs.

this is the closest coffeeshop to my house, I go there all the time when I need a stronger pick me up than plain coffee i can make in my house. 
The service is great. in the year I have been coming, they have only messed up my order twice, once they forgot my caramel and once the espresso tasted burned. Both times they made me a new one for free and were very friendly and not at all upset I had complained.

I LOVE the managerial staff, they are soooo friendly and have a great memory for faces. 

It does get EXTREMELY crowded though, I wouldnt suggest going for like, a date or meet up because it can get pretty noisy!
I like starbucks and this location specifically. They have a drive thru. Generally are quick. The drinks are made right. Cant complain.
This starbucks is sooooo fast. Don't let the drive thru line to the street mislead you. You won't be in it long!

I think I may have found my favorite Starbucks in the city. I had only been in here once before, and the guy named Jeremy remembered what I like in my coffee! I wasn't really thinking about what I was saying when I ordered, and instead of 3 raw sugar, I said 1. He asked if I was sure, because yesterday I has 3. I really appreciate the fact that they remember me, even though I had only been there once. Good customer service, the employees interacted with their customers.

This location as others mentioned IS very hot or miss.   It's the closest of the five in the area to me, but also the one I frequent the least.   It's a mall location so those of you who may hang out for business or for meetings may find space and noise louder than usual.   The staff is usually friendly but not as 'warm' as some of the others.   It feels less cozy and more about customer turnaround as a result.  The plus side, never had a problem with drink orders done well!

Beautiful remodel! The washrooms are beautiful.

Nice new selection of sandwiches too!!! One of our fav places to go after church.

Still like the old set up better though. Not crazy about sitting on a stool with no back on it :-(

Staff is always pleasant no matter how busy they are.

I have never been to a slower Starbucks and a few of the employees were off-putting. While you wait for your drink, you get to watch how the staff works. One man making sandwiches throws them on the counter and a very fall worker with a plaid blue shirt tries to be funny by using ridiculous voiced and being condescending to people. They got all my drinks right, but took them forever and the employees did not make for an enjoyable experience.

Here about everyday! Looove it! Dog friendly!!! Great staff! All super nice and friendly, always have been. They have organic Justins peanut butter cups! Ummm double yum! 
Best Starbucks ever! My Bff/dog approves!

This Starbucks is closest to where I live... And though the staff is very personable and friendly, they are so slow. They never work or move with a sense of urgency. I never knew how much time to budget prior to work or appointments because it never is consistent. My drink isn't complicated in the slightest. Green tea, that's it. I understand sometimes they get swamped with a bunch of orders, but even during their 'slow hours' I still wait a considerable amount of time. I ended up just switching locations and only stop here if I don't have somewhere else to be.

Starbucks may be a chain and all that, but it's the ONLY place I've found in which you can actually taste the espresso in their café mocha. So thank goodness for them, because I've ordered café mochas at all the cute little coffee shops around town and am always disappointed because it just tastes like hot chocolate. I need coffee! I want to taste coffee!!

Excuse me while I go enter myself into some sort of dependency program.

A Starbucks is a Starbucks, for the most part. 
The layout is almost always awkward, like the drive thru is an afterthought. The coffee is better than hotel coffee but not as good as craft.
As we were staying at a hotel close by, and the hotel coffee was not palatable, we stopped by for an afternoon boost. Service was friendly and drinks were accurate when served. I wouldn't make a special trip, but will certainly get the job done when you need caffeine.
If I had the time, I'd have looked for a small batch local shop.

The rebirth of Starbucks at Tampa's International Airport! Out in the open and brewing up a storm, the new location is hustling and bustling as per usual. Stocked with caffeine-addict approved beverages and fat kid approved bakery items. The line during a busy Saturday afternoon moved relatively quickly for a Starbucks. The seating was all filled up but there's plenty of room to spread out inside the airport. The up charge was killer but that is to be expected at TPA. I like this new location better because it's contemporary, easier to find, and much more spacious. The line can't be out the door if there isn't one. Welcome back Starbucks! I will speak for everyone when I say you were missed!

Full disclosure. This location is the closest to my house and I'm a regular. The staff is always nice and friendly. If something is wrong they will fix it.  And a few know my order by heart   

Tip: can get a little crowded if you're planning to come do work. There are plugs along the wall but window seats you'll want to have a full charge. This location isn't as big as others but definitely great for a meeting or a few hours of work

Getting in an out can be tricky during rush hour but they do have a drive through and the other nearby locations don't

The slowest Starbucks in the world. Mobile orders sometimes take 25 minutes here, drive thru is constantly wrapped around the building because of how long it takes these baristas to make the coffee's. Employee turnover seems to be high and I completely get it because whoever has been managing this has to be the one of the worst in the Company. Busy or not, get it together.

Best starbucks in Reno. The drinks are always made right (and the baristas there make great recommendations for new drinks to try also) and they are really really fast at making the drinks for you. They're pretty nice there too.
Unfriendly.  The other starbucks I frequent will accommodate when I ask a question prior to ordering.  I've never felt so put off by Starbucks before.  Shelley is rude and very unfriendly.
Enjoying my birthday reward a venti PSL. Good place to chill or work. Friendly and fast baristas. I'm tankful for this Starbucks it's within walking distance of my home.

I briefly eat/drink here every now and then at this Starbucks location if I happen to be in the South Tampa bay to bay area. This location is like your average size Starbucks with decent amount of seating indoors and outdoors. Always cozy and comfortable for your coffee/tea drinking pleasure. The tea/coffee/gourmet food selections are no different from any other Starbucks. There is plenty of window for daylighting. I like the way how this location is not too busy as it's location is surrounded by a residential neighborhood in South Tampa.

The morning staff at this Starbucks are phenomenal. Just great, happy attitudes start a happy day. I loved visiting and the staff already knowing that I was getting a "Soy Mocha no whip" everytime! The only thing is, I'm pretty sure everyone in Oro Valley knows how good this place is, so sometimes they are slammed but the wait even on a bad day is only maybe 10 minutes.
Go somewhere else for your beverages!!! I AM NEVER BUYING FROM STARBUCKS AGAIN!!  They need to fire their DISRESPECTFUL, Incompetent, Cop hating employees first!

Nice job staff! Though I had to wait a bit it was Christmas. Those kids were working their buts off and had a great attitude. They were greeting their customers by first name. These kids could teach customer service. This should be a corporate training center!

There's not a whole lot I can say about Starbucks that the general public doesn't already know. If you're getting a brewed coffee (hot or iced) make it at home. For all of you lazy or complicated people like me, Starbucks is well worth the money. ChipLand's baristas are very detail oriented when I order obnoxious drinks (especially the night crews, probably because there isn't the morning rushes), and they are always sure to ask me how I'm doing.
Extremely slow service!! It will take you at least 20 minutes in the drive-thru, not any quicker to go inside!

Sunday morning scenario:

Line snaked through Sbux into the Marriott lobby. One barista on register. Two baristas on coffee and food. One barista doing nothing. One barista at the espresso, etc. area.

I patiently waited my turn and ordered the same thing I have ordered every day since 8/28; a Venti non-fat, no whip  pumpkin spice latte and picked up a Mango Juice from the fridge. I did not have enough on my Gold Card so I also handed the cashier $10 and asked her to put it on my card first. She condescendingly "explained" she could do it all at the same time. She put it on my card and rang my order and gave me some coin change?? (still haven't figured that one out).

I patiently waited FOREVER and watched as several people who came after me got their drinks. I politely asked the barista if he had a Venti Pumpkin Spice Latte coming up. He did not. Meanwhile the register girl yells down that I had ordered a Grande. I pulled out my receipt to verify that I had indeed ordered a Venti.

He finally made my drink (with whip and most likely Vitamin D milk) and gave me a card for a free drink next time.

I get that people make mistakes, but register girl seriously needs to not be in the customer service position of ringing customers. (There were other snide remarks heard while waiting there that I won't even go into.)

I love Sbux and like I said, I visit my local spot at least once per day. Not even remotely impressed with the management of this local.

I frequent this Starbucks on average twice a week. It really is quite spacious and nice inside, and has tables outside as well. The normal staff is friendly, and the service is good. They quickly learn your name if you frequent the location. Every now and then they get an order off (e.g. adding whip cream after asking for none), but they always make it right. Having been to quite a few Starbucks locations, this one definitely ranks near the top.

The service has been consistently very polite and and prompt. The drive through is badly designed however, hence the four star rating. First world problem, I know, but that's how it is! 

The service window is way too far from the curb and high up, don't be coming through in your lowrider or muscle car!! I have a truck and it's still quite the reach. And on melty, drippy snow days like today, the overhang is perfectly positioned so as to drip slush in through the driver's side window. Lovely. The barista apologizes profusely every time! Other than that, I have nothing bad to say about this Starbucks, the staff seems like a great bunch, it's a convenient location off the highway, and it is rarely lacking in seating.

Every time I visit this location I either get the wrong drink, or he right drink gone wrong. Being a former barista I understand that mistakes happen and that nobody is perfect, but save your time and money and grab coffee at the office instead of here.

A good friendly Starbucks location. The people working there are attentive and have no problem with "side requests" like ice water and refills in addition to coffee orders. It is a small to mid-sized location with not many comfy chairs but hasn't been crowded the times I have been there.
I don't know what everyone else is talking about. I thought the service was great. He was a little slow getting the drinks out, but very friendly.

Took them 3 times to get my drink kind of right. After the 3rd time I just accepted the drink. It was close enough and I needed to go. While waiting for them to fix my drink, I realized 2 other people were waiting for the baristas to fix their drinks as well. I recommend to order something simple like regular coffee. It seems like that's all they can get right.
Excellent customer service and a lot of seating area including outside patio. They always get my order right...great place to grab coffee and do some work.

Usually one of my favorite Starbucks since they usually have great customer service till today. They got my order wrong and after I stood in line to let them know they where unapologetic, told me I was in the wrong line to tell them the order was wrong and made me wait on yet another line. Not at all the cust. service I have come see here. Got my hot chocolate and still not a single apology or even recognition of their mistake.

Love the staff here. They are always super friendly and fast! They make an effort to learn your name/face and your drink. This is one of my favorite locations because they get my drink right every time. The only issue I have are all the rude high schoolers that come in being loud an obnoxious demanding water after school. To which they still are given ice cold water with a smile. Love stopping here in the am between 9am -1pm or in the evening after 5 to avoid the kids. Nothing against them, I was in high school once...but I do like to enjoy the café when it's peaceful and quiet. (: Plus it's nice to stop in for a quick lunch or a pick me up when I have some grocery shopping to do at the Fry's next door as well as the Wells Fargo conveniently located inside the store. It makes my day easier to have everything in the same plaza.

My drink lids always smell like perfume. Maybe employees shouldn't spray fragrances on their wrists? The drive-thru is incredibly INCREDIBLY slow in the early morning. It shouldn't take 10 minutes for 3 cars at 7:30 a.m. on a Saturday morning.

Update: On Monday, June 22nd, we arrived at 5:38 a.m. Three employees working, one car in the drive-through and one customer--us--inside, and somehow it took us almost 10 minutes to get in and out of there. No decaf. They never have decaf brewed. You can go in the morning or the afternoon or the evening--no decaf. "We can do a pour-over..." It literally takes a minute to make the coffee. They use a giant scoop to measure out the coffee and the hot water comes straight out of the pipe into the machine. All they have to do is flip the switch! 

It also irks me that, in the drive-through, they always tell you to pull around to the window for your total, where you're then told that they don't have what you ordered. 

Also, why does that one guy wear plastic gloves all the time? Odd. 

To be continued...

Not a fan of this particular Starbucks. This isn't my usual Sbux but whenever I come here, I feel like the wait times are abnormally long and it has nothing to do with the amount of people there. The baristas move at a very slow pace and seem side tracked by side conversations. And it's always dirty. Coffee that hasn't been wiped off of the counter it straw wrappers and crumbs/debris on the floor. Today I ordered a Frappuccino and a Granita and I swear it look almost 10 mins from start to finish. And the one with the goofy eyes (sorry) made the frap wrong when all he needed was a little extra attention to read what it said on the cup. I'd rather wait through the line at the Starbucks that is actually in the mall before coming over to this one again.

My favorite Starbucks near USF - it's faster than the Bruce B Downs location and less croweded and it has a drive through unlike the 50th and Fowler location. Plenty of places to sit and work on homework and the store is usually on the quiet side since it's mostly other students. The coffee is to be expected and I've never been dissapointed at this location.
I've come in here off and on for a few years. Every time I come, there are always flies, everywhere. I left early a number of times because of them, today included.

This is ridiculous. A lot of people want coffee before work but it is bad that it takes 30 minutes. Why is there not another starbucks in this area? And on top of that, this one is out of half their items!! I want change!

This is my go-to Starbucks when I have a Starbucks craving due to it's location on my drive to work and because it has a drive-thru, yay! My review is primarily around their drive-thru. 

Almost every time, I have a wonderful, friendly quick experience. It probaby helps that I don't come at a super busy time due to an early work schedule but I appreciate their cheerfulness that early in the morning. Mitstakes or cranky employees is rare here for me. 

I highly recommend their bacon gouda breakfast sandwich! A breakfast here isn't cheap, but a nice occasional treat! Oh word of warning - during the school year, during nice weather, this is a popular place for nearby high school students to go to after work - it gets crowded and loud!

This Starbucks is attached to the Marriott across he street from Reading Terminal. I've been to this location many times for drinks on the go. The staff is usually very kind and pleasant. Due to the convenience in location, it is relatively busy and doesn't leave much room to seat groups. Not to mention this store is pretty small. It's not really too clean either but usually okay enough. Overall, I'll probably be coming back for their drinks!

This has been one of my best starbucks experiences, and I've been to many starbucks. The customer service was amazing. The barista took the time to explain every single tea to me, and other baristas, who were busy working, even happily told me their favorite teas. They spelled my name correctly, which is very rare. In addition, the barista gave me the extra tea that had been made for my brew. They made my day in Santa Barbara that much better! 

In addition, there are many large chairs, as well as tables, indoors and outside. Gorgeous location too.

Very tiny Starbucks in downtown. Only two 2-top tables inside and a counter for three more people. This is not the *$ you'll go to to do work. But it is consistently Starbucks and so there's that.

In my opinion, there's better coffee and better work space nearby. But some people love their green siren lady and for you all, here you go.
I don't understand why it took over 10 minutes for the lady ahead of me at the drive through to get her med coffee

The first time I tried to go to this Starbucks, as a graduate student who spends most of my time on the Center City campus... I couldn't find it. Eventually I realized it was tucked away in the business building. After finding it, I can say it's a great location- easy to grab a coffee between meetings or if you have some time to kill. They almost always produce drinks quickly, even when the line is scary long. I've been trying to figure out when the line is long or short, but honestly I haven't been able to figure it out yet- I think it depends when classes in the building are starting, or taking breaks mid-class. 

I go here about twice a week, and they haven't messed up my drink order yet (good job, Starbucks). Once they forgot to make my drink, but I complained after waiting about 10 minutes, and they made it quickly with no questions asked. The food options are more limited than other Starbucks, and not only do they not have a toaster to toast your bagel (FYI Starbucks- toasters cost about $20), but they are usually out of bagels by mid-afternoon. When that happens, no semi-healthy options are left, and I usually default to lemon cake or pumpkin bread. The space can be a bit hard to navigate, since the Starbucks is basically jammed into a corner- occasionally causing awkward moments. For example, if a student with a big backpack is standing at the right cash register and there is a line, it's impossible to get from the left cash register to the area where you wait for drinks. I don't care how skinny you are, it's not happening. 

I'm glad I eventually found this place- it has made my classes and meetings nearby more bearable. Minus one point for not having a toaster, and for occasionally being overridden by caffeine-addicted undergraduates.

Starbucks is a must every weekend for my wife and I. It nice walking in and the smell of that espresso hits your nose. Everyone at this location is always very friendly and knowledgeable about their drinks. If they do mess up (very rare) they always make it right and I appreciate that.

Another great Starbucks.  Although they are a chain I simply don't think you can go wrong.  This one has some outdoor seats as well as a fire place and some comfy seats inside!  I would return to this location.

My neighborhood Starbucks. Always a great place to get coffee. The place is clean, has both inside and outside seating and the baristas are friendly. I love how they always have a featured drink...in the summer I loved their smore's frappuccino and now in the fall, I'm loving their pumpkin spice and chili mocha. Starbucks  also has an app that allows you to pay via the app while earning stars towards free drinks, if you go here often, it's definitely worth downloading and using the app. The lines can get long here so be prepared to wait a bit sometimes if you happen to get here during their morning peak time. Otherwise a great place to get your coffee.
Very good... When I ordered they completely messed up the guy in front of me order... If you love chocolate, I suggest the Double chocolate chip frap

Super awesome baristas and also a super busy Starbucks in the AM. I probably come here at least 2-3x a week to grab a caffeine fix for myself and the office. They always get all the drinks right and are done on a timely manner. All the baristas here are friendly and usually always have someone on hand to hear food at the bar. 

I just wish parking wasn't such a pain in the butt but that's not really a Starbucks issue than the property management. They do have quite a few comfy chairs to lounge at and a few tables for chit chat. The lines do get long during peak hours but the baristas can only do so much with an espresso machine.
Not a bad place. Nice inside and friendly employees but my drink was very weak, usually it's nice and flavorful but it has next to no flavor. Very disappointing.
Just FYI for people who like to work and study in coffee shops-- this one only has one table with an outlet nearby.  Which sucks, it's a really nice clean environment otherwise.

We have lived in 6 different states in the last 10 years, and this is our 2nd time in O'Fallon. This drive thru by far is the slowest out of all the Starbucks we've been to. Hoping it would have improved since 2015 but it hasn't. 

Took over TWENTY minutes to receive our mobile ordered drink. WHY IS THIS LOCATION SO BAD?!?
This is a great coffee shop. Outstanding batista in the morning. He prepares a wonderful latte.  Even when they are extremely busy, service in fast and efficient.

I go to this starbucks whenever I work at the hospital up the street. Not only is my coffee made perfectly every single time, but the staff is always wonderful. Compared to other starbucks, this place is a ten! They're very quick and efficient!

Fantastic Starbucks. Several factors set this one apart.

+ Fireplace!
+ Well designed seating plan. This is a real differentiator. Lots of bar-type seating and lots of elecctrical outlets. Also good outdoor seating with umbrellas.
+ Music volume under control
+ Good service
+ Good vibe - positive energy :-)
+ Great posture ;-)

Did I say fireplace?

I go to this Starbucks twice a week, without fail, and sometimes more! It's fast (even though it's always packed) and the employees are nice! I typically do mobile orders in the morning and my drink is always perfect and ready when I arrive! The only downside to this Starbucks is that parking is limited, so when it's super packed the drive thru may be your only option. But that's not a huge deal to me because I'm always picking up, not staying! However there's lots of seating inside for studying or working. Love this Starbucks!
I tell everyone that this is the best Starbucks in Tampa and I will stick to that. They always make my order correctly and are always so nice.

This Starbucks is the closest and I think the only one near the base so I can just imagine how many people go here every single day. That being said, service can be pretty slow when they are super busy. One time the line was so long at drive thru that I just went inside for my order, there was only one person ahead of me but my drink still took about 15 minutes. That was probably the longest I've ever had to wait at a Starbucks. Also, the cafe itself is pretty small so there isn't a lot of seating and it just doesn't feel as cozy. As for quality of drinks, it's on and off for me, most drinks are just right but whenever I get a frappucino there's something off, either too watery or overly sweet. I'm gonna be back though...but only because the location is convenient to the area.

Bet you didn't know there was a Starbucks in the new Brewery District! I sure didn't, until I walked by it on my way home from the new Loblaws City Market. It's right on the north west corner of 119 St and 104 Ave, in a small building closest to the street (in the Brewery District but across from the Shoppers) - for now there's lots of parking in the lot but I bet space will become scarce once more shops open. 

I popped by the day after it opened (I happened to be at Loblaws two days in row- the first day it wasn't open, but the next it was) and treated myself to a caramel frappucino. The ladies who were working there were obviously newly-trained as they were careful and methodical about making it. They didn't have any decaf coffee but they were able to make it using decaf espresso (I didn't know that was a thing). They also asked me if I was ok with the coffee syrup since there would be trace amounts of caffeine in there - I don't know what is normal for this drink but I did appreciate them checking with me. My drink tasted great and they gave me an extra large dose of whipped cream so make sure you specify if you don't want that (I did... It was GREAT). 

It's not a super big space but it's better than that Safeway Starbucks since you can obviously sit down here. They do sell pastries and other goodies as other Starbucks stores do. I think once they get into their groove and get more comfortable with being baristas, this place will be great!

This is the friendliest staff of any Starbucks in town!  I go to this location to work every now and then, but it can feel cramped really quickly if you are inside.  The patio leaves a little to be desired, but what can you expect when it is adjacent to the front and side parking lots?

Many of us coffee connoisseurs like to adventure out in our local city, state, or even the entire country for new and delicious coffee. But good ol Starbucks brings it back around every time with our usual orders and convenience. 

This location is in prime location to Park 100 and the highway. It offers a full circular parking lot around the entire building for ease of entering and leaving. The drive thru is a bit busy during morning rush, but if you are a regular like me there are tricks to get in and out for those of us who Mobile Order. The drive thru line always leaves a gap to the road so others can go in and out of the parking lot. 

This location I've found to be always clean and tidy. The amount of tables is larger than other local locations for those with work meetings, brunch, and just those who want to use free wifi. :) It is not the biggest Starbucks I have ever been to but I guarantee the capacity is above average.
This place a literally my second home I couldn't ask for a better workplace environment than this!

I believe the sign outside says that the Starbucks closes at 9:00 PM. We arrived at 8:38 PM and the doors were closed and they were already cleaning up. This is unacceptable because this is over 20 minutes early. If I do this at my job I'd be fired tomorrow. I'm never coming back again.

It has a nice large seating area with different chairs to choose from, otherwise it is your average Starbucks. Good for studying. I wanted a chocolate smoothie but starbucks no longer carries the ingredients for it.. they got creative and made me something else instead.

This is my regular morning and sometimes afternoon stop.  Great atmosphere and a little larger than most other Starbuck locations.  The staff is pleasant.  Sometimes there is a wait, but typically not too bad.

This location is quite a mess. First, there were off duty baristas just hanging out and talking to the one barista working. The barista barely acknowledged me until he was done making the off duty baristas their drinks. That took a good 5 minutes. At least acknowledge the customer, not completely ignore them when they're right in front of you. Even just a "Hello" is good enough. Second, this location is such a mess. Sticky counters, trash on the floor. I get it - it's 9pm on a Sunday, but that shouldn't stop you from doing your job. It wasn't even busy, I was the only customer ordering. I'm a pretty patient and polite person, but when you intentionally ignore someone that's just plain rude. One positive: the barista working was somewhat polite.

Every single time I've been here the people were really friendly and made my drinks correctly! I cannot tell you how many times I've ordered my drink at other starbies and it's made wrong. If you go through the drive thru id go when i have extra time.
I like this Starbucks, although there's always a huge line and only 2 employees, one running the register and one making the drinks. I feel like they should really have some more help.

Definitely my favorite Starbucks! I order ahead on the app several times a week and my order is always ready within 5 minutes, but typically less than that. It may seem silly, but I really appreciate the fact that they put a straw on top the cup when I order iced coffee. The place is clean and the baristas are super friendly.
Love my Carmel Frappes.
They've gotten so much better over the years. Lauren was amazing and incredibly friendly. It's so nice to have the staff call out your name when the order is ready

By far the worst Starbucks in town. The only reason to come here is that it's conveniently located in the UA bookstore. Things I hate about this starbucks:

1. Incredibly long lines, especially between class times
2. They don't carry the full range of pastries--"La Boulange" is unheard of here
3. Cashiers consistently flub it: clueless about drinks, can't operate the cash register, can't navigate the gold card program, frequently mischarging and then not knowing how to fix the situation...all mixed in with an occasional snippy teenage attitude
4. Drink quality is inconsistent. Want too much ice? Check! not enough ice? Check! That's probably among the most minor of the drink faux pas i've experienced here.


Canyon cafe is a much smoother transaction, and the pastries are good! They just opened up a starbs in the library, so there's another option for the UA set. If you must have Starbucks, the one on University ave. is much better.

First of all, my iced tea wasn't filled to the top of the cup. Then, they refused to provide a refill because they "don't participate" in any Starbucks promotions. That's funny ... Before I ordered my drink, I asked the barista if they participated in the promotions and she told me that they did! Also, I just love being screamed at by the server when I go into a coffee shop. She definitely doesn't like being asked for a refill. Beware of this cafe. If you expect your server to be at least reasonably polite, go somewhere else!

Entrance is pretty inconvenient especially if you're not getting Starbucks and have to wait behind someone trying to figure out how to turn in. I usually stop there around 615am so there is no traffic and no line. 

The baristas are always friendly and have a smile. My order has always been correct but I do order black cold brew so it's not too hard to mess up. Fast, friendly, and a block away I'll take it!

Stopped in on Friday at about 5:00 pm ordered cold drink. Counter person Anton was very nice the person however whoever was making drinks was talking to someone obviously someone he knew who stopped in during a busy time they both talked loudly  the entire time while while the worker was trying to multi task. My order was wrong the drink was hot should have been cold. Had to remade drink was terrible second time, I just asked for refund. The manager needs to do a better job managing the staff. Two stars for Anton great counter person who offered me my next  free drink card.

Lots of flies everywhere, very unsanitery and annoying.  No longer offers milk or even half and half by self serve station.  Baristas doesn't accurately measure what goes in and often times give you a latte where most of the cup is foam.  Music is sometimes too loud. 

Good things: plenty of power outlets and chairs. Open 24 hrs.

I don't make a habit of reviewing chains but this Starbucks is officially my savior. 

Mistakenly I have decided to become a graduate student. Although the Webster University library is gorgeous, its too far. I needed a place that was close to my home and a place that I can go straight from work without giving myself time to think about how terrible it is to go straight from work to studying. 

The place has plenty of outlets and the service is great. The gals behind the counter will even watch your stuff so you an use the bathroom!

Just a pocket Starbucks.  This is Starbucks and less. No parking, limited seating.  It's about location, location, location.  If you work downtown and want the predictable known quantity of this international chain, come here to be quickly serviced. At least you can always get the New York Times at your neighborhood Starbucks.

I love this little starbucks! Its across from bond shopping center. Parking sucks here really bad. If you get a spot youre really lucky. The staff is so friendly and they make the perfect latte! Chris is the man and he feels like your best friend..very talkative and friendly!  I always order the venti lattes...gingerbread, cinnamon dolce latte, pumpkin! I also get the blueberry scones which are my favorite. I tried the cake pops there and they seemed raw in the middle. Me/mom were disappointed with them. I buy my 2 yr old son the cranberry/vanilla almonds and my 1 yr old son soft cookie pack they sell. There is something for the whole family here. cute little bar but hardly any tables because it is so small. Extremely clean and beautiful!

I usually don't comment aloud about poor service at restaurants, etc., but after the consistently bad service I've received at this Starbucks I couldn't hold it in any longer. 

Too often there is at least a 15-20 minute wait inside the store only to receive a mediocre drink. Earlier last week I went inside after seeing 7 or 8 cars in the drive thru. I stood in line behind one person for almost five minutes before one of the 7 people working came to take our orders. After ordering, I waited another 15 minutes to get my drink because the workers were busy socializing with each other. Even then, my drink was incorrectly made. 

Today, I wanted Starbucks again as I was on my way to work. This is the closest to my place of employment so I left with plenty of time to make sure I would get my drink. I waited in line after four people, and while that part went fast, I had to wait ten minutes to get my drink. I ordered an iced black tea lemonade and was served an iced black tea. I had no time or patience to tell them that once again my drink order was incorrect. 

In the future I will be avoiding this Starbucks at all costs when possible.
Ditto everyone else on the friendliness and convenient location.  The drive-thru can be a major pain during the morning rush hour though, so beware!

Full disclosure this is the closest Starbucks to my home. I am so grateful the sweet elixir of coffee is so close by! 

Every time I've visited, the baristas have been very pleasant. I've not had one botched order (but I do like pretty much black coffee). They are happy to give me a pup cup when I have my canine copilot. 

Being I life so close, I haven't spent much time loitering inside. However, on the times I've run inside it is very clean and modern.

I have been going to this Starbucks ever since we moved to New Tampa and within a short period of time the service began to deteriorate. Frequent incorrect orders, getting them wrong and today stood at the counter ass the only inside customer with a staff running back and forth, one was checking her messages on her cell phone and zero acknowledgment that I was there. Backed away and went to restroom, returned and still not even noticed as a customer. Will find another coffee shop.

The staff here is friendly, quick, & pleasant to be around. The closing staff people were accommodating in making my drink. They close later than most of the Starbucks near Santa Barbara. I would definitely come here again
Always consistent no matter the barista. Let's face it, its Starbucks and corporate coffee but it always does the trick!

Worse place ever, worst workers,  don't go here.. Think I grew like a hundred years here... I'm starting to think they dont believe in customer service. Who the hell manages this place anyways?

Updateeeeeeeee: the look on the girl from the drive thru 3 27 15 had the look of someone that was f ing bored and had no interest of being there plus she had a slow reaction to her face

This is my favorite Starbucks by far. I go out of my way to get my caffeine fix here. Staff is super friendly, patient and they make sure to "make the moment right" for all customers (don't be afraid to ask for recommendations/remake of a drink). If it gets really busy, they'll ask what you want & start making your order before you get to the register. Big parking lot, two bathrooms, large store and a good amount of outlets.

Very good customer service. I'm always greeted with a smile and hello. It's a bit crowded feeling on the inside. There's not much room to move around so I usually get what I need and go. I do wish this location had a drive-thru but it's on the corner of a shopping plaza. Their outdoor seating looks cozy. My only real complaint is they never have the spinach/feta wrap. Never. It's not just this location though! I'm starting to think that the wrap is an urban legend. I've been to several locations around Nashville, Clarksville, Milwaukee AND San Antonio and I'm always told they're out! No lie! Other than that, its close to home so I'll keep going back.

The cashiers usually charge me wrong and apparently they have no clue how the rewards cards work. If it weren't for hour breaks and their convenient location I would go somewhere else. Seriously canyon in better.

This Starbucks REALLY needs to work on their time management. No one should have to sit in the drive thru for 10 minutes let alone 20. At 20 minutes, I am now late for work. I used to be a barista, so I get it. But there is a definite disconnect here. They need to value their customer's time.

We went here today mostly for the coolness of having a Starbucks at the Zoo and having a chance to try out the paper straws. All was good! This Starbucks functions like any other Starbucks, including the breakfast sandwich options, but they serve iced coffee with a paper straw. I've never used a paper straw before today but I'm happy to report it worked just like a plastic one. Definitely recommend this Starbucks.

Though the line does go for days it seems before that first cup of coffee, the staff totally makes up for it!  They are super friendly and a great way to start the day - thanks for being amazing this morning!!

Bring back the blackberry mojito green tea lemonade!

Also stop running out of ingredients to make your seasonal drinks! I was told the caramel ribbon crunch frap is a "seasonal summer drink" - it's been summer for not even a month and this drink is hard to find already. It's just so much better than the regular caramel frap, so get it together and keep ingredients stocked and available!

I am so happy they opened this location in Devon. It's a daily stop for me. The people here are very articulate, quick, and friendly. They have a drive thru which to me is a MUST have! Biggest problem I have about this place is whoever thought this was a good location for this place was not thinking at all!  It's the tiniest place - the drive through is always a disaster because it blocks the very limited parking and there's not enough space for and the drive through lane is so tiny to get around. They need a much larger space for this Starbucks since it's so busy!

I come here everyday. Great and friendly staff. My only gripe is always long lines at the drive-thru and inside. But I guess like Disney World or Liv if your good your gonna have lines. I am still convinced they put crack in the coffee.
Usually pretty crowded and the the waiting time is a bit longer. The staffs are friendly though.

Friendly people and a nice place to work or spend sometime with friends. They have drive thru and also outdoor seating (which is good in summer). 

this place is usually crowded and takes time to get your order in the mornings. Since lot of people drive thru and evening during a week day you can find spots to sit and spend time. 

But on weekends it's little crowded I would say to spend time there and get a spot to sit as it is kong is busy with neighborhood people. 

This places it really good.
Super friendly , awesome consistency with making my coffee! Peaceful good vibe place!

It tends to be pretty crowded especial during class rushes you just need to know when yo come or be prepared to wait, but because of the rush sometimes they half ass making the drinks, kind of like quantity over quality

I don't understand why the employees are always so mad and act like it's an inconvenience for them to make your drink. They really need to get a new staff in there. They hardly ever smile and say anything to anyone. It's rediculous

Wanting Starbucks in this area is an inconvenience. Needing some coffee before or after your long day at work should be an easy task but here it's not. It's stressful. You have to decided if you have the time or energy to get starbucks. Because it takes 15 minutes in the drive thru to get some coffee. And it's no better in the store. Now, this is not the fault of the employees. They are doing great! It's the company's fault for neglecting the needs of the community. And we need another drive thru starbucks. I personally have written emails to all the right people and they simply thank me for my email. I'm originally from California so I am used to a Starbucks on every corner. But here in this area the closest Starbucks from this one is the one at the mall. (Which is also packed) It would benefit Stabucks to put in more Starbucks in our area. This is simple supply and demand people. I'm about to venture out and try other coffee places because I don't have the time and patience for this one anymore.
Great star bucks. Sometimes not enough parking and there is no drive thru but very comfortable inside.

So I brought a few drinks. Then went back and asked the lady if I can just have a ice water. She respond yes but it will cost you .25. I don't carry cash at all so I just hand her my credit card. She dosent charge it and end up saying it's fine. You can owe us. This place is really odd. I wanted to reload my gold card with 100 bucks but the lady says we don't partake in that.

The person who took my order was nice but i said twice id like my drink w  'whole milk' I specifically said it twice bc i didn't notice it pop on register when she entered order. Waited 5 min for someone named Theresa to start my order and saw it was skim milk. Politely asked if it was my drink she was making and immediately got intense attitude with a 'girl no u didn't just speak to me' glare. I said I requested whole milk and while keeping eye contact she proceeded to violently dump the skim milk into the sink and start over! Never once spoke a word to me. Bitch it ain't my fault your coworker doesn't listen and/or you hate your life working at starbucks at 60. GTFO. Only reason i gv 2 stars instead of 1 is because the person who took my order obviously just made a mistake, at least she was polite when she took my order. Theresa on the other hand shouldn't work with the public.

I had a very bad experience today at this location. First, they didn't call my name when the drink was ready, so my drink sat on the counter for a really long time. When I figured out the drink was mine, I realized they gave me the wrong order. 

When I told them the order was wrong, they tried to just scrape off the whipped cream and add coffee in the blender. 

I told them that I would like a new drink and they told me "it's the same thing". I asked again and recieved the same  response. 

I told them I didn't want it, and would just like a refund instead. They then told me they couldn't refund a gift card. I insisted they refund me, and then they finally completed the refund. 

Overall, this was the worst starbucks experience I have ever had. It was very dissapointing. Won't be going back to this location.

Barista was nice but I ordered a grande flat white and got 1/2 beverage and 1/2 foam...I know Starbucks isn't a legitimate coffee shop but a flat white is really as simple as it gets. It was a hot cup of coffee though so a dandy 3 sips for $5

I don't understand why it is so hard to get a cappuccino at Starbucks?  Ever since they started free pouring the milk on a cappuccino. ...you never get a cappuccino. ..you end up with a latte.   The art is GONE!

This Starbucks is worth finding. It is hiding just West on 144 Avenue by Manning Freeway (not far from the Rexall pharmacy). When I walked in, I was very impressed with the decor. C'est sublime!
I felt like I was back home (Montreal) even possibly in New York.
Bring a good book and enjoy your favorite drink or just chat with friends. I have been going on many occasions now and I will keep on going.
See you there.
Chantal
Ridiculously slow and then forgot half my order. 40 min it took to stand in line, place order and get my order. Will not be going back, this is the 3rd time with the exact same results.

Line at this Starbucks in Marriott Downtown lobby is always insane. There weren't any spices (I always have cinnamon in my coffee) and the milk containers were empty. Not what you'd expect on a busy Saturday morning. The staff was nice enough, but they could have used another hand it looked like.

I went to this location today and was pretty unhappy with my experience. My drink was decent, and the only reason I am giving a star. The staff member who helped me in the drive thru, first, appeared nicely and happy over the speaker. Once I approached the window and handed him my gift card, he did not say a "hello" or "how're you today" then, he comes back and says "2.82" I was slightly confused what he meant because my order was $5, I replied "im sorry what did you say?" And he said "2.82, you still owe me 2.82" I said "oh okay, no problem" and reached into my wallet and got him the money. He then grabbed the money from me without saying a single word and handed me my drink, and closed the window. I was slightly flustered because I typically reuse and reload my Starbucks coupon and religiously use and collect points on my app- so I needed my gift card back. (Starbucks has show to be pretty serious about their rewards program and making sure their members are happy, so I was a little annoyed that the staff member did not at least ask if I would like my gift card back.) I sat at the window waiting for the worker to come back to the window so I could ask for my gift card back. When he got back and I asked he appeared to be quite annoyed according to his facial expression and replied with an "oh ok." After finally getting my gift card back I was so extremely frustrated I drove off and didn't even bother the rude worker with that change he was supposed to have given me also! Absolutely terrible experience!!!!!
Always reliable Starbucks. This one in the airport is nice and convenient and the staff was very friendly. Might just be the Tampa airport but everyone seemed friendly there.
