I often wonder if the real Starbucks people know this little hole exists. Because surely none of these baristas have gone through any training whatsoever. If they had, they wouldn't have to reference their recipes five times while the line grows out the door.
The service here is painfully slow. I think they just grab people off the registers to work this location.  Also,it never makes for a good experience when the same person ringing you up also has to make your drink.  
Also, there are no comfy chairs here. Nary a cushion in sight. 
The drinks taste fine, once they come out, and the location is convenient, but that's all I got for the pro column here.
Go here every time I'm at the gym, because I can walk over from there. Super busy intersection, with a difficult shopping center to pull out of. Staff is super nice!

This Starbucks is small, but mighty. They know how to get customers in an out, especially when there are events happening at the Convention Center or at the Marriott. The staff is super friendly. Once, I lost my wallet and they knew me right when I walked in. Great place for a traveler on the go.

This Starbucks always has a long line because it's in a great location. The workers are fast, smiles on their faces, efficient and friendly. Great Starbucks I'm sure other locations to learn from them.

Been going here every morning for two weeks and can not comprehend what is going on. I usually get the same thing, latte and kind bar, every morning, and literally every morning get a different charge, ranging from below 5$ to almost 7$ for the exact same order. The barista had a lot of attitude when I mentioned it the first time last week, but it keeps happening. Maybe this will get their attention.
This place literally messes up my drink every time! I'm surprised the customer service here isn't better considering the upscale customers coming in there from Montecito.

Friendly staff and very efficient!! It's always nice to be greeted by a genuine smile and warm welcome...and I truly felt that when I walked through the door. Very clean and very well maintained store. The baristas were quick on the feet to get the orders out, which is always an accomplishment.
I came in yesterday in a rotted mood. But-- Steven was super friendly, kind, and took great care of me. It really made my day.
Register lady said they don't do French presses any more. At least the pour over was hot. Everyone knows the French press is tastier!

After recently moving, it is my local Starbucks. It's a typical Starbucks atmosphere. I have been in several times and have always been greeted with a smile. My classic white mocha has always been made correctly and even stirred so all the flavoring isn't hanging out at the bottom of the glass.  I pass three other Starbucks on my way to work but I will happily come back to this one.

Great Place for a morning breakfast and a nice cup of coffee. Love the location and the vintage ambience. It feels like an old coffee shop in a little town. Baristas are friendly and nice. The only sad thing about this place is that it now closes at 9:00pm. I hope they change that soon.
Surprising location for a Starbucks. Still very nice, big digital ordering screen through the drive through, and quick service on a Sunday morning.

HORRIBLE SERVICE!!! LACK OF COMMUNICATION!  I went to this location today (the day after Christmas) and was surprised that there was only one person in line as this location is usually always busy. I waited patiently as the woman in front of me was asking a bunch of questions about the syrups and sugar free items. I glanced at the board and noticed a huge sign advertising a FREE drink when you sign up on the Starbucks rewards app and register your card. I waited until the woman in front of me finished her order and when it was my turn I asked the cashier about the advertisement. I asked, "If I sign up right now, will I receive a free drink?" The cashier acted as if she didn't know what I was talking about so I pointed at the sign behind her and stated my question again. Again, she had a puzzled look on her face, then another worker chimed in and stated that I would receive an email of some sort with a coupon. I said, "Okay, I'll step aside and register now." As I sat in a chair right by the register I noticed a young woman and a homeless man. They were talking to one another, and to quickly sum up their conversation, she was in there to buy him (the homeless man) a drink and a sandwich; which I thought was a great gesture for someone in need while most people are celebrating the holidays. The young woman ordered the drink and food and I hear her tell the man that everything is paid for and that the worker would call him when it's done. She left the store after that. I'm pretty much done registering my card on the app and waiting for an email with my coupon. As I wait, one of the workers yells a woman's name and is holding a food bag. I just observe for the moment and say to myself "that was clearly the girl's who bought the sandwich for the homeless man." I began to feel a little antsy because it started getting crowded with people and I still had no email. I then hear the homeless man (he was speaking loudly every time he spoke) he's asking a cashier about his drink and food. Mind you, there are now two new cashiers at the register. I see the situation escalating because the cashier explains that he did not ring the man up and he would have to wait a second (as he was ringing another customer). The homeless man just says "what do you mean? It's already been paid for. The girl, the girl bought it for me! a hot chocolate and a sandwich." I no longer could just stand by. I got up from the chair and I asked the male cashier where the female cashier went who was just on the registers. I said "I saw everything, a young woman was in here and she bought him food and left!" and as I'm explaining this the female cashier peeks her head around the corner and I point stating "she rung her up" (As I did this, I see the food and sandwich sitting off to the side together, unclaimed). I was just fed up, I yelled "There's the food right there! What is the problem? Why are y'all not communicating? This is horrible service, I'm leaving". So I left, with no drink and no further explanation of this supposedly FREE drink they were advertising. I hope that man was able to get his drink and sandwich, he clearly needed it. It's really a shame that the young woman took the time to help him, trying to do a good deed for someone, and the workers there just totally ruined everything. I will never return to this location, it's not the first time I've had a bad experience.

Very friendly staff at the drive through! Drinks are made quickly but taste great. Love their white chocolates mochas for a treat but their regular iced coffees are also delicious. I wish all Starbucks had a drive through!
Always fast service and this is one of the only starbucks I've been to that hasn't messed up my order (yet) and I've been to this location about 100 times since it has opened
Friendly staff and great location. Variety of seating choices. My chai tea with vanilla and soy is always perfect!

I despise writing poor rated reviews...but this Starbucks really sent me home frustrated.

First, the gal at the bar couldn't put my lid on properly.  She ended up squishing my drink which spilled all over my cup.  Did she attempt to fix it?  Nope.  She just smeared her dirty hand all over the mouth part of my lid and served me a cup dripping with latte.  

So, I grabbed some napkins and wiped it down.  No apologies from the barista.  

Next, I left with my drink.  I looked at the cup and saw that it wasn't decaf or nonfat.  How can you miss both,  I don't know.  So...I had to turn around and return it...which I also hate doing.  I am now waiting forever for my drink.  Forever meaning...I am writing this review while waiting in Starbucks for my re-made drink.  

So now I have received my drink and I can finally get out of here.  

Wait...my drink is burnt.  Ugh.  Seriously?!?!?!  The issue with decaf espresso is that no one ever bothers to calibrate the shots.  

I gave up on Starbucks in California because there were way better options.  Nevada isn't any better.  This drink is going in the garbage and I plan to look for something else in the area.  Poor excuse of a location!

The Barista Kathleen was super helpful in helping me decide on a drink. I didn't know exactly what I wanted and she suggested the frozen strawberry lemonade becasue I said I wanted something without coffee. It was blended perfectly and definitely refreshing on a hot day. I don't think it is on their normal menu, but I will definitely be ordering that from now on. I will say their prices are a little outrageous, but people are willing to pay it. The clay terrace location is my favorite to go to because they have so much outdoor seating.

The line here is ridiculous. Drive-thru  is always long and wrapped around the building. The line inside is alright if it wasn't for the mobile orders which seem to take precedent, which is a fault on the company as a whole.
Not my favorite Starbucks location.. the drinks taste different depending on where you go I find. Very nice as always!
Coffee is tasty. The few times I've been here, it seems as though they are out of stock on many of the food items.  No card scanner.

Thanks guys! Always great to see a barista team that works so well together to get drinks out like rapid fire! Thanks so much!

Can't beat the Doppio con pana!

I love Starbucks and enjoy visiting different locations...but find myself repeatedly frustrated at this location. Today I arrived at 10:40am and there was no one in line ahead of me so I went right up to the attendant and ordered a café latte and a regular coffee. I got my coffee right away and then waited more than 12 minutes for my latte as only one barista fixed all the drinks and drive-thru got priority. Why is my order less important than someone in drive-thru? And then when I finally got my latte, I went to use the bathroom before leaving with my drinks, and the bathroom was an absolute mess...so I simply walked out. Not a good experience. Very disappointing.

This Starbucks is my favorite one in this area. No matter how long it's been they know my drink and always get it right.  Even early morning service was professional and friendly as well as quick.  The Carmel Latte was made just for me with whip cream on top and Carmel drizzle great to the last drop.  This drink was finished so quickly until I wanted another one.

RUDE!! Absolutely the worst customer service. I am a former barista and shift supervisor. I understand the rules and that you can never turn a customer away. Customer infront of me ordered her breakfast and drink and she only had a $50 bill...technically were not allowed to break it, however as a former shift manager I know for a fact it CAN be done instead he tells the lady sorry I can't help you then turns to the barista and yells stop making the drink she doesn't have the money to pay....Yes she did! How humiliating! I'm up next to order and they were so unorganized. I had multiple gift cards on my phone to use up one with .06 another with 2.34 and lastly a new one with 10.00. He was so impatient and asked me if I had enough to cover my drink...Yes sir I do like I stated I have a couple gift cards I'd like to use up first. Next, my drink was made wrong....and when I told the barista she grabbed my drink and slammed it into the trash. When she gave me my corrected drink she was not nice about it. Only Starbucks near my work...

How is it possible to have a watered down Double Chocolaty Chip Creme Frappuccino, when the ingredients include chocolate and milk? I stopped by to treat myself to my favorite Starbucks beverage today and should have left after seeing someone come in from the drive-thru to complain about their drink, and another customer walk back in after tasting his, yet I still took a chance. Never again. I DEFINITELY will not be back.
I frequent this location weekly. Extremely friendly staff, consistent drinks, and quick service.

Employees here are OK. They really seem to try, but this place is tiny, parking lot design is AWFUL (can hardly get in and then, once you are in, you can hardly get out!). There is always a line to place your order and the wait to get your beverage is even longer. And, what is with people who can't see everybody standing around waiting? You just placed your order.....why are you standing right in front of the counter, blocking pick-up? Do you think we are all standing around waiting because of the atmosphere here? Do you think your order is going to miraculously show up in just a few moments? Pay attention and use some common sense!

Very slow when going through the drive through at times. The service varies depending on who is managing that day and who is in the drive through. Sometimes you have a very nice barista at the drive through and other days no. Also there are always flies in the store during the summer and when I get a special shaken iced tea the barista never ever shakes them. I don't know if they're not being trained correctly or just don't care.
Absolutely my favorite coffee shop in the area. Amazing staff, great coffee and plenty of seating.

Typical Starbucks.  This place is close to my work, so I've hit it up on occasion for a hot chocolate on a cold day (not much of a coffee drinker).  Service is fine, and the drive through is fairly quick!

I work near here so I frequent this location. I usually come on the weekdays in the morning. The drive thru line is deceivingly long but it moves very quickly during the weekday. It's a well-piled machine. The weekend seems like it runs a little slower but I'm not as much of in a hurry. This is an urban location and I have been approached for money, cigarettes, etc. but the staff does well taking care of these situations in a professional manner.

Service here is soooo slow! It's probably bc I only ever really see one person working behind the counter. And the menu isn't as big as regular starbucks, but I really only go here when I'm in extreme need of some caffiene or if I'm in Target shopping around. It's nice to be able to sip on a drink while searching for items.

If you see like 2 people in front of you, skip it! You'd be waiting a lifetime just to get what you want.
This is the worst Starbucks ever. I get Starbucks every day and this is literally the WORST one I've been to. Every time they take forever and make my drink wrong.

Best Starbucks in Indianapolis.  They know how to get your drink done to perfection and it doesn't take all day like the one on Keystone & Ruth...NOR is it sloppy looking.  They are always courteous and speak to everyone when they come in the store.
Very friendly spot.  Packed with tables, outlets, students, and digital workers.  Great place to get some work done.

This particular starbucks is always hit or miss with me. I order the same drink at many different starbucks and for reason  it tastes so much different.  Very disappointing seeming I'm an addicted coffee lover and I tend to spend a good amount of money here. However,  Lauren the manner is very efficient, friendly and knows how to make a good drink and the establishment is always clean.

This place has always been wonderful. Great service and a great location with plenty of parking. I use to go once to twice a day but have limited myself lately. The baristas are really nice. This place has a drivethru with very quick service. Inside has a lot of seating but everyone is very close together. Only 2 spots by the fireplace and it is always full. In the summer months their outside seating is great with views of the indy skyline or methodist lifeline helicopter runs.

I've been here on multiple different occasions. It's a great location- right by the bank and potbellys and across the street from the Wynnewood shopping center. This is a great study spot too because it's a larger starbucks with large tables and chairs. It can really be a hit or miss though because it gets busy and filled pretty quickly in the evenings with students. The service and quality has always been really good so far. Stop by and give this place a try!

These guys are actually pretty good at taking orders and making drinks. I went in and asked for the crunchberry frappe. They not only knew what that was, but also made it without any fuss. I also got a half decent chai out of them... I'd still go someplace else for chai tho.... Otherwise the staff was very good, fast, and even the atmosphere was chill.

Drink quality is uniform to any other Starbucks I've been to. The people working, however, had zero communication, be it with me, or the other workers. I think the only words exchanged were my order and my total. 
They also were slow and disorganized - there was some Asian kid behind the counter with a coat and backpack on making drinks. He was talking to some friends on the other side of the counter, but where everyone else was wearing the black shirt, apron, and hat, it looked like he works there (he did know what he was doing) and he stopped by on an off day with his friends to make drinks for them and a few customers. Really weird.

Parking lot looks cramped, but to be perfectly honest, it isn't nearly as ridiculous as the Starbucks in Southington, CT, so I can't even hold that against them in comparison!

When I'm at our friends' in the area I'll stop by if I need my Starbucks fix, but if I was a local I'd probably try to find another.

The pumpkin spice coffee is back, and it is fabulous! But not better than the great service we got from Meghan at the Oracle Store. She is friendly, and helpful. We had a very nice Sunday Morning experience! Thank you!
Went again this last week and the service was again very slow:(.  I hope they can get it figured out.

The line in this store is in an interesting spot. No big deal, I just thought it was awkward. the first thing I noticed was the lobby, it was huge. I've never seen so many tables and seats in a Starbucks. I like it!
I ordered my drink as a barista stocked the cold case. I remember saying, "excuse me" when I was loading the case and needed to get by customers but that was lost here. The barista who took my order was friendly and nice, as was the one who made my drink.

I could write a 1-star review for every single time I choose to subject myself and go to this Starbucks. It's one building away from my office and located in the building where I take grad classes but it is HANDS DOWN the WORST Starbucks I have ever encountered. I'll bullet some things for now, and edit them as I continue to have terrible experiences:
-Baristas have absolutely no idea what they are doing. My order of "grande black dark roast" regularly throws them for a loop. This morning she handed my coffee to me and said "dark roast with room for milk!"... that's NOT what "black" means..
-They have no idea how to stock inventory. This morning I ordered a chorizo, egg and cheese sandwich; after paying and waiting 5 minutes, I was informed that they were "out of those" and then they listed off the ones they do have. When I said "all of those sandwiches are cheaper than the one I already paid for" they responded with "umm you want a pastry?" UGH
-One time I ordered a grande black coffee and a $5 gift card (a thank you gift for a coworker). The cashier proceeded to somehow load the gift card with the $5 and then USED IT to charge my grande coffee. So before I knew it, I was being handed a gift card with $3.90 on it. WHAT?? 

I should actually be working right now.. but I'll definitely be back to fill in more horror stories. Oh and if you ask why I go back? Working 10 hours in a desk job and then going to a 4-hour econ class warrants coffee and when you only get one 10 minute break during class?... yeah, you would go too.

I Mobile ordered but then change my mind and wanted to get an egg white spinach wrap, so I decided to go inside. Every time I come to this location parking is always a challenge. It's kind a pain to get in and out of the spots. But if you're lucky you'll get one of the 15 minute wait spots right in front of the store. This was one of those lucky times. 

There wasn't very many people inside so that was a bonus. They may have had a bit of a rush because the store was kind of in disarray. There was miscellaneous trash on the floor and it definitely wasn't my best experience there. 

The barista didn't put the right amount of sugar in my coffee, and didn't seem very excited about her job. That's one of the things that I really enjoy about Starbucks. The staff is always upbeat and excited to help customers.

This location actually has a really nice big table right as you walk into the left hand side. This would be a great spot if your meeting maybe four or five people! The wedding is really good and the musics not too loud, so I think this would be a really good place to have a few people get together there, unlike a lot of the Starbucks is that I've been to.

My experience wasn't good or bad this time necessarily, I would go back because of the consistency of the food and normally the drinks. It's in a convenient location for me since I live right down the street. There's a wing stop and A port of subs right next door... so how can you go wrong with that.... right??? Lol!!

Your typical Starbucks. 

It's always busy. I've never had a problem with service and the interior is really clean.

My local where the service is prompt, the baristas are friendly, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming and my usual is always perfectly prepared (a grande blonde misto with two pumps of either vanilla or cinnamon dolce).

I don't recommend the Veggie and Monterey Jack Artisan breakfast sandwich - warm and bland - but their pumpkin bread is delicious.

I have had better experiences with Starbucks, so I am pretty sure the problem here is with their staffing. I arrived to a busy store  and waited in line for my turn, I placed my order and moved over to the waiting area. While waiting I noticed two other customers, who had ordered after myself get the same drink I had ordered get their before me?  Overall the drinks are what you come to experience from Starbucks, my complaint is about the service.

Another problem with this store is the way that the its setup, the Drive Thru is a total mess and often blocks regular parking during peak hours. I have learned to never park in spots close to the building, always park in the spots away otherwise you risk getting blocked in by drive thru traffic!
I waited 35 minutes for a tea that they ended up getting wrong. When I came in, there was absolutely no one there and I don't understand how they still managed to get my order wrong. What a waste.

Usually go to this location with no problems whatsoever. Today, however, I will NOT be returning. 
I ordered my normal black iced tea, the employee even asked me if I wanted it sweetened or not and for some reason when I was done ordering I heard her laughing over the speaker. Whatever, brushed that off. Waited about 10 minutes to get to the window. When I pulled up she asked me if I had something completely other than what I ordered...told her no and repeated what I ordered 10 minutes prior. Then she says, "oh, we're out of black iced tea". WHY WOULDNT YOU TELL ME THAT IN THE FIRST PLACE?! The worst part was she brushed it off like no big deal and my time doesn't matter. I will be only going to Dutch Brothers where they respect their customers and their time.

First time I was at this Starbucks and I was blown away by their customer service! I went through their drive thru this morning and did not realize until I got to the window that I lost my wallet. The most wonderful, sympathetic person was working and insisted I still take my coffee. Unfortunately, I was a bit frantic and did not get his name! I look forward to continue patronizing this particular Starbucks many times in the future! Also, the blonde roast was delicious!

The service here is pretty slow but the staff is friendly, which makes up for the slow service a bit.  I definitely would not go to this Starbucks if I was in a rush. The staff seemed to be pretty knowledgable on the menu, which is also a plus. One of the baristas suggested that I add the white chocolate mocha to my drink and it was delicious. If the service was faster then I would bump up the stars.

Eh same old song and dance with a Starbucks. Obviously over priced but good coffee, tea and snacks. I suggest getting a bagel with a small iced tea. Then you don't have spend big money to get a decent coffee house experience. Pleasant staff and clean bathrooms.
This is my new go-to Starbucks and it is walking distance from my home!  Great service and awesome location.  I suggest the sausage breakfast sandwich with a cafe latte!

I accidentally did an online order to the wrong store and was running late to work. I didn't realize I had selected the wrong store until I got here but the staff were more then accommodating and quickly made me a knew drink free of charge since I had already paid on the app (not to this store though which is why it was so nice) they are always extremely quick and friendly

This is the worst Starbucks to ever come to. They are entirely too slow and there's always a long line. They barely ever have anything even early in the morning .. The only reason I gave it two stars is because it's close to my house. I try to avoid coming here and finding a different one on my travels if possible.

I officially LOVE this Starbucks location. I went there a few weeks ago, and I felt rather adventurous so I asked the barista for her opinion on what to get. (I think her name was Bree) The word charismatic does not fully describe this individual. She was incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful...and maybe a little cute too. Not only did I like her recommendation, but every time I go back the staff recognizes me and is really friendly.

I used to work in this retail area (for a year, in high school).  It is a pretty busy spot, and parking can be hairy.  Re:  The starbucks here churns out the yummy drinks & baked goods at a reasonable pace (not always super fast, but I think they do not always have enough staff on hand).  Such is life.  Good people watching and a nice large location, love the outdoor patio.

If you're lucky enough to have Torrie, Cait, or Debbie as your barista, you'll be greeted with a warm smile, friendly attitude, and great coffee. Such a great team. And a visit to this Starbucks always kicks the morning off right.

Again typical of this Starbucks location.  Sat morning with 1 person on counter and 5 working drive through.  Line out the door and saw 5 leave already.   Never a manager around to balance workload.  Lol... love watching the robot workers not making decisions.

*update*. 40 min to get a hot tea and microwave sandwich.  WOW
By far the best customer service at a local Starbucks. I can get in and out before work without waiting.. Best thing recently was Kim suggesting the Chestnut Praline Latte!!! It's amazing!

Nasty, messy, gross place. Icky icky icky. What a mess. 

Unfriendly explanation of the Starbucks app. Rude employees. How do you ever stay in business. Oh yeah. The name. 

Out of whip cream. How are you out of whip cream?

Will not be returning.
Sean, the manager, is very nice. They messed up my order is he was very nice and empathetic about it. Offered me a comp'd drink

First time going to this Starbucks, and probably won't be going back. I ordered an apple juice and a bagel for a quick breakfast, and I waited for probably ten or 15 minutes. It wasn't even that busy - they just forgot that I ordered. My sister told me the same thing happened to her, too. She ordered a drink and had to wait a while because they forgot and then made the wrong thing. Not going back.

It's a typical Starbucks except this location is severely undersized. The drive thru is good but always packed & parking is limited. 

I recommend going during non-peak hours. I'm hopeful they will either open another location nearby or expand this one soon.

This is the BEST Starbucks around. Warrington consistently messes up orders and Huntingdon Valley Shopping Center location runs a little slow.
I LOVEEE the baristas at this location. They're all incredibly friendly and make the BEST drinks. If you aren't 100% satisfied, they go out of their way to correct the order and make up for any errors.
Great Starbucks, indeed!

Horrible service.  The cashier obviously did not want to be there this morning and continuously rolled her eyes at every customer.  She also did not convey my order to the barista, which led to a 15 min lead time for my americano.  Not exactly a complicated drink, either.  No apologies from the cashier, either.  I actually felt bad for the barista who was stuck making all of the orders.  She actually apologized to me and it wasn't even her fault.  That and my toasted everything asiago bagel were the saving graces of the visit.

Starbucks coffee is a staple in my morning routine and this practice doesn't change just because I happen to be in an airport when the JOE bird calls.

I picked up my morning nectar with NO wait.  Yes, not a soul in front of me, which is usually unheard of.  I grabbed my joe and headed directly to my boarding gate.

Staff was friendly and efficient.

Prices were higher than the non-airport kiosks, but that's to be expected.

A great little place to just relax and enjoy some chit chat. 
SBUX coffee is the same everywhere but the locations are what make places more special.
I've been waiting for 15 minutes for two drinks, the store is literally packed with people waiting for their drinks and they are still taking orders... So confused.
I got a Venti Starbucks double shot with 6 shots of espresso here. Kept me up for 12 hours and counting. 10/10 would recommend.

The drive-thru lines can be long during the weekday mornings, but if you aren't in a hurry, you can just be patient and wait it out in your private, cushioned, climate-controlled chamber. Most times, the line moves faster than you'd think.  The staff are typically friendly, conversational during slow times, and I've received countless "'I'm sorry" free drink coupons when I didn't even feel inconvenienced.  Some Fridays, you may be behind the mysteriously generous local who pays for your drink, and then you hopefully decide to continue that chain of good will (or not).  I have had a few drink mix-ups, mostly them adding shots of flavor (ugh) to my plain nonfat lattes.  Overall ok Starbucks.

Starbucks coffee is self-explanatory. 

But the staff is super friendly, fast, and engaging while making your coffee. Bathrooms are clean and the parking is okay.

This has got to be the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. There was a group of three girls in front of me who ordered iced teas already made in the blender and it's took them 20 minutes to get there order. It took me 25 minutes to get my tall Caramell Machiatto. Ridiculous.  I won't be returning to this place again.

There are a few local places i frequent more often than Starbucks, but as a member I receive great rewards and discounts, so every once in awhile I'll pick up a venti nonfat double shot no foam this that or the other without breaking the bank.

Faster than the other Starbucks in the area.  The espresso is strong, like it should be.  Stronger than the Starbucks on 19 and Curlew.  The staff was very friendly and the Internet was great.  

I am a coffee girl and when I'm not feeling like I can't breathe in my jeans, I like a good caramel macchiato.  This place gets it right.  Otherwise I go for the regular drip.  This Starbucks is probably my favorite in the area.

This is a tiny Starbucks location with very limited seating. It's located in an office building. The service was quick and friendly. My guess is during the week it's super busy. We visited early on a Sunday morning. We were in and out in a flash! Even though it's a smaller spot, they still offer all the same drinks and food items in the case. Both baked goods and refrigerated items. We ordered s green tea, vanilla bean frappacino and  a skinny macchiato. Homeless people were outside and even Inside this location too. Parking is tough too!

One of the fastest most efficient Starbucks in Indy. I may my use the drive thru and at times the line extends out into Capitol. They are so quick though you move right on through. Fast and professional.  One of the top here.

The first time she forgot to add my mocha chips so she added them and double blended my drink which is a big no no for me. The second time tho it was spot on. Even tho I always order the same thing a tall they were gonna charge me for a venti at this location because "the extra ice was going to make it fill the venti cup" (I asked for a larger cup because of the ice. I didn't realize ice cost money? They let it slide.....THIS TIME! Whew ;-)

Love this location! The staff are always so friendly even during the busy rush hour times! This is my local Starbucks and I know I am going to get excellent service every time I go here. Also a great place to get some work done!

The environment was amazing! Never felt so welcomed in a chain coffee shop before, my kids and my self were greeted as soon as we came in. I was hesitant because there wasn't a drive thru and it was nap time lol. The cashier made me forget all about it. While we chatted and I redeemed my birthday reward they welcomed me to the neighborhood! Also giving me suggestions for things to do with my children in the area. This conversation was short but sweet! The barista was just as sweet! I will be going back! My smoked butterscotch frap was delicious.
Yay! They got it together, we got an iced skinny mocha latte and a frappachino and both were perfect. Anthony making the drinks was very organized, friendly and professional.

This is my home Starbucks at the moment. I love the employees, who are polite even when they are crazy busy. I've never gotten a bad product from this Starbucks. My order is a little complex, and they've never gotten it wrong OR looked at me like I'm insane for ordering. When they unveiled their new pastry menu, they were giving out warm samples, even to the drive-thru line! 

I wish I could find a way to thank them for making my morning better each time, but I haven't thought of a good one yet. I guess I'll just keep going back.

I found this Starbucks to be exceptional when my husband and I were in town. We were staying at the adjacent Marriott hotel so coming down the elevators to get a cup of coffee was a huge perk for the hotel. 

The staff here is awesome. Let me tell you why. I collect the Starbucks mugs from places I've visited and unfortunately, this store ran out. The two guys that were working the first day we were there was super apologetic that they didn't have any in stock but "thought" they might get a shipment overnight. They were nice enough to give me directions to other Starbucks around that they thought I should also try. Unfortunately, I struck out there as well.

When we went in later that night, I told the same guy that we were unsuccessful in finding the mug but he was still hoping that they'd get a shipment in that night but urged me to check the very next morning. 

The next morning rolled around and the two guys weren't working but a new staff came in and I told them the story of how we were anxiously awaiting the arrival of these mugs. The gal went into the back and sadly, they did not arrive in the shipment. I was bummed because we were leaving that morning and it was clear that I was going home empty handed.  I was disappointed and gave my husband the "sad face" look. 

We proceeded to place or our for a few pastries and our coffees and when the gal told us our total, we thought she had missed something. Turns out, she comp'd our coffee because they didn't have the mugs we wanted. How sweet! 

I thought that was a nice gesture and it sent us on the road to the New York with a smile on our face. When a store is super busy as this store was has the time to go out of their way to find a bunch of silly tourist a mug, I would say that's as good as it gets.

Fast and pleasant are the staff in this Starbucks location. I have come inside for my order,  and have driven through the drive thru many times and had positive experiences every single time I visited.
Its was so bad! The coffee was great, but the service was the worst I have ever seen. It took over 30 minutes to get our order and it was right, got love it

Of all the Starbucks I've been to around the city, this one definitely offers the best service.  Employees are very nice and orders are very prompt and accurate.  Loses a star for terrible parking lot design, location, and need for 24 hour service.   Not rating the coffee as this is Starbucks, people. If you're a "coffee snob" you know where great coffee is.

I'm not sure what happened, but this Starbucks used to suck majorly.  I used to wait sometimes 15 minutes in the drive thru with 3 cars in front of me!  And, if I went inside, I used to feel like I was intruding on the staff - the attitude was sort of like "oh crap, another damn customer".

Now, however, something has changed.  I went there today after lunch at Aroy Thai and the staff was friendly, fast, and great!  I actually felt welcomed to enter the store, rather than loathed, as before!

And, the service was quick. I felt compelled to hang out with the fun staff, rather than grab my drink and run the hell away, as before!

I am a renewed fan and can't wait to order my next quad tall cappuccino!

Yousa!

Welcome to the schoolyard, where first impressions are all that matter. You trip on your shoelaces running down the hill and forever you'll be known as the kid who rolled headfirst down the playground slope. To that end, I agree with Kristine d.'s recent review of her interaction at this Starbucks.

If this Starbucks isn't careful, they'll forever be known as the location with that one employee who finds the most basic tasks too complex to complete. His name, according to the several grumbling regulars behind me in the growing line, is Alberto. He will perpetually ask you to repeat your order, to scan your phone again. It's not a bashful, flustered "Sorry, I didn't hear you." It's an expectant, dismissive, "Again? Speak up." There is no apology in his tone, only entitlement, as if by ordering a tall coffee we are standing in the way of his efforts to do as little work as possible. 

It's always easy to tell when this particular employee is working register - which is all he ever seems to work - because the line will stretch twice as far as the average morning. Even his coworkers seem put-out by his enervated and apathetic pressing of buttons and mumbling of orders. 

"So that's a grande mocha, which comes to a total of..." 
"No," a customer says, "I ordered a tall latte." 
The manager in the background rolls her eyes and offers an apologetic smile.

My morning routine would not be the same without this Starbucks and their staff. I am greeted every morning by the same smiling faces who are always on their "A-Game". Quick, convenient and friendly. If I could give them more stars I would.

Was in the area all week and stopped in Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Same order to the same cashier everyday and all three days had mistakes. 2 Large / Venti black iced coffees with no added sweetner. Simple enough, right? Leave it the this Starbucks and their staff to take 15 minutes to produce a light brown liquid of all sugar and say orders up. Thank you for your service. Now someone with management experience come in and clean this up.

I am very pleased with this Starbucks location!!! They've made my drinks to my perfection many times! Not only that...the staff here are super over the top friendly! When I'm at west county...I definitely have to stop here!

Love this location for our weekend morning indulgence.  Wish there was more indoor seating but well, it's limited by space.  Great staff, wish I knew the lady with the dreads name, she's awesome. Nice when they know your usual order!  Busy location. Easy parking.

I've been through the drive through a couple times and every time it is slow.  The first time they gave me a free latte but I'm guessing this happens a lot.  Coffee is Starbucks so that's always good.

I really like this place for studying--they don't pressure you to leave and the atmosphere is nice and quiet. One issue is that it's a little small, with only 3 or 4 small 2-person tables and one larger table (indicated for handicapped, but I think usually used by business people or students who need to spread out. There's a small sofa area (very small, one loveseat and two small armchairs) in the corner. 

I have noticed that there are a few employees that seem to have no patience for the customers and act a little tiny bit condescendingly, but I also keep in mind that this is a drive through Starbucks and they are constantly busy ( a LOT of people use that drive thru.. haha) so with that in mind, it's not such a big deal. 

I can't say much for their coffee--it's always tasted a little too heavy/burnt-ish to me, but I do like their tea lattes.

I'm not a coffee drinker, so I can't speak to the quality of the coffee here, but stop here often with my husband who loves coffee any hour of the day or night!  Starbucks has an offer going on right now where if you take in an empty bag of their ground coffee (which we use at home), they give you a free cup of coffee.  Downside to this location is it can be difficult at times to pull in and out of the parking spaces as it is on the corner spot of a strip mall, and traffic can get very busy at times.

The furniture is very odd here, somebody wanted to make a fashion statement or something.  Nothing is comfortable.  The windows, looking out onto the street are nice but the service is lacking.  Very disorganized.

We stopped at this Starbucks whilst on our cross country road trip to Colorado for a quick caffeine fix. The baristas were super friendly and they really went out of their way to answer any questions we had about the area! Highly pleased with their service!
Their stuff is way overpriced in general, which is why I just buy their teas and make them at home. Staff-wise, I've always had wonderful experiences with them. They are very sweet and tip worthy!
These baristas are super knowledgeable and extremely friendly!! I love come to this Starbucks. They know how to make a awesome coffee and my Chai Tea Latte. You can't g wrong coming here!
Not one of the friendliest Starbucks in the area. And to clarify, this is East Norriton, not Norristown
The worst coffee in general at every store bitter and overpriced, it tastes like they never clean their urns and pots, I only went here BC it was my only choice for coffee

The staff here is awesome. Always treated well, whether in the drive-thru or in store. Fast service even if the parking lot looks full and there is a line of cars at the drive-thru. Glad this location is so close to my house!
The service is good. The coffee is great. And they donate to feed the hungry through Operation Food Search.  That deserves my loyalty.

This the absolute slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. I just waited in line for over 10 minutes and still had to leave as I was going to be late to my destination. Last time my drinks were made wrong. I'll never stop here again.
This Starbucks stands out from others. The employees are always joyful and the coffee is done to perfection. This location also has a very nice and large lounge to cozy up with a coffee.
This location is always super busy but service is quick and friendly! Even in the morning you're never waiting that long.

Brand new store. Very open and new. Love the fact there is a drive thru. It gets busy so parking may be an issue if you go inside. I have went there 2-3 times. Every time I have had excellent service. I wish the hours were earlier, it's close to my hotel and I like to grab a coffee before work but because of the hours I have to go to another Starbucks.

I'm a huge fan of Starbucks and have never had a bad experience at one before now. I didn't know there could be so many incompetent, rude people in one spot at one time. And the line for wrong orders was longer than the purchasing line... You're better off walking a block and a half to Academia Del Caffe at Penn Square.

So, it's about time I come back and write an overall review of this Starb. I still stand by my review below that the experience with Barista C was appalling, but as a regular here, most of the rest of the staff is awesome. They know my drink, my name, etc. They are a good group!

This location is really slow, and the baristas I've encountered have been pretty rude. The cashier was having a side conversation with another employee as I was paying and seemed annoyed when I didn't know If she was talking to me or her coworker. My motive for Starbucks runs is usually to get a quick drink at convenient locations (ie-everywhere). There were only about 4 people in the whole place and I had time to write this review after realizing I was frustrated with how long it was taking. I'll skip this location in the future.

Bright side: there is a good amount of seating and it's conveniently right on drexel's campus. Also not as many people as the 34th and walnut/ 34th and chestnut locations.

If I  could, I would give this location a  a big fat Zero for Customer Service.  I figured the last time I went was fluke maybe the representative was in a bad mood. Then last week two of my coworkers and I visited this location because it was close to Home-goods.  Upon entering this location I had my phone and order ready I walked to the counter where two representatives were helping the person in front of me. 
The representatives walked away one went to play on her cell phone and the other make the drink.  So I waited, another representative came from the back and took the person next to me order, whom had just walked in. Not once did the representative ask me if I had been helped .
Ok Tori, stay calm, the one that went to check her phone finally walked up and in her most annoyed tone asked me "How  can I help you"   I gave her my order and she advised me that what I wanted wasn't on the menu. Ok,  but can you make it .  She paused and said yes. She seemed annoyed that people were walking in. 
Starbucks are everywhere,  I will not be coming back to this one.

Great experience here. Easy walk from TPAC. Line moved fast. 
Inside and outside seating.

I do wish they had stand alone WiFi.

K so obviously one Starbucks is more or less equal to the next. But I've had service ranging from passable to outstanding, & this place is damn near the top, if not at it.

When I ordered my grande peppermint mocha with peppermint syrup & whipped cream & a drizzle of chocolate syrup on top, my fiance teased, "and sprinkles, too."

When I got my drink, it had red sprinkles on it.

Hell yes.

A Starbucks location within Target.  A combination of a few of my favorite things.  Convenient to be able to grab your favorite coffee drink before launching into an hour or so of shopping.

They have everything a full Starbucks would have except the relaxed ambiance.  After all you are still in Target.  Bright fluorescent lighting and cafeteria styled seating.  Those making drinks know all the usual drinks well and are friendly.

You can pay with your target card and get 5% back at the Target Starbucks.

Awful customer service. If you don't fit there mold they treat you like crap.  Avoid this location. And I now will avoid Starbucks all together. Go to Dutch bros or somewhere they treat there customers like people.  It's no wonder they are in the news all the time for judging and profiling people. It's not like there coffee is all that good either, just convenient. Don't bother.
Fly issue resolved. I'm there probably once a week now. And the blonde roast and Starbucks reserve  are going to take over the third wave trend. Small roasters beware!

So we have come to know and expect a standard level of service from Starbucks no matter where we are in the world... unfortunately this one does not meet the standard. As this is a good location to meet up with friends (somewhat in the middle between north side Edmonton and St. Albert), I frequent it about once a month. Every single time there has been some level of let down... either the baristas plain ignore me standing at the counter (for a full 6 min), or they don't listen close enough to my order and get it wrong (twice), to the bathrooms not clean on a regular basis, and the cramped feeling inside. Generally I find the employees disrespectful towards patrons and I have even had the manager make me feel uncomfortable in a situation.

Inside is small and there are not many tables, the decor is standard, and the lighting is dim. The one bright spot in this review is that I have never had issues with the drive thru. Overall I would not recommend this location for your Starbucks fix unless absolutely necessary. And definitely not a good place for studying or relaxing due to the cramped space and lack of lighting.

So today I had the peach green tea lemonade, it was awesome.    They forgot my drink for a little bit but I guess they just put the wrong name. Nothing but typical Starbucks service no disappointment.

Starbucks has never really been my favorite place to get any tea or coffee, though I am crazy about both. I went to try their new Refreshers drink in "very berry hibiscus". For nearly 4 dollars, they provided me what would have amounted to practically a thimble full of berry flavored water with 3 frozen-dried black-berries in a cup that had so much ice in it, the kid who prepared it had issues placing the lid on. Needless to say, I would avoid ordering that particular drink from there ever....

I'm not going to argue that this is the best Starbucks ever - because it's not. At the same time, however, I don't think it deserves the low rating it currently holds. First of all, whether because of the strange address entry or because of a Yelp database error, this particular Bucks location is hard to find. In fact the only way I could find it was by choosing "nearby" on my Yelp app and zoom in on 8th and Walnut. 

The management of this location is superb and for the most part, they handle the morning rush very well. That said, there are a few downsides to this location. I've had one or two Pike Places in which the coffee's clearly been burned. In addition, there is one employee, an older gentleman, who not only makes frequent mistakes with orders, but also has a knack for taking an absurd amount of time to process orders. When he is working register, long lines are guaranteed, as well as his typical curt attitude with customers.

When it comes to the quality of the drinks and the friendliness of its staff, otherwise, I think this is a strong Starbucks. On the average morning, you can be in and out of this location in 5 minutes, or less if you are only ordering a drip coffee like me. Given its proximity to Independence Mall, Washington Park, and the bustle of Jewelers Row, it is primed for a little line and busy tables. If you're looking for a place to sit and read, I'd recommend looking to the Starbucks at 10th and Chestnut. Here, there are very few tables, even less available, and because of the 2 sets of double doors, it can be a bit drafty.
Nice lobby, great vibe, great baristas. I'd definitely recommend; top Starbucks in Boise!
The angry older woman has a rotten attitude . She behaves as if she s doing you the customer a favor . Not spending my money on Starbucks again - much less at this place

The staff at the Clay Terrace Starbucks is superb!  Such friendly and thoughtful people.  Very clean facility.  Staff is very conscientious of good service, quality product, and good-looking store appearance.  I walked in today on my usual morning, and was quickly greeted with my "usual," and a sweet good morning greeting.  Thanks for going above and beyond, Clay Terrace Starbucks!

They have a ever rotating staff and usually the coffee isn't as good as other Starbucks. There are better places to go in the area. The junction  and the coffee place across the street from the movie theatre are better.

My favorite local Starbucks. Friendly baristas and Starbucks coffee, decent as you'd expect. Can get a little crowded but I come here often and always have a positive experience overall.


UPDATE: I've taken my rating down to four stars. The drinks are still great, but recently, this location has been plagued with very long wait times. In addition, some maintenance is needed. Many of the electric outlets don't hold in the plug when you charge your phone or laptop, the chairs along the windows are creaky and uncomfortable, and just the last time I went, my order was mistaken.

The Starbucks in trooper is now my preferred location in the area.

I love you... I have an addiction.. You feed that addiction.. When I try to stop and leave, you always keep me coming back..

This Starbucks is in the lobby of the hotel where I work, and I love it.

The majority of the employees are amazing. They are so amazing, they know what I'm ordering, before I know. I walk in, and they go "The usual?" 

Sigh... Can't get better than that.

This is an ok Starbucks, but the job got done. Depending when you come parking can get hectic because the lot is small. Sometimes it's hard to find a table on the weekends. However, my order came out good, despite them never calling my name to tell me my sandwich was ready so it was kind of cold by the time I ate it. Otherwise, the staff seemed pretty friendly. Despite it being late in the morning I felt like there was still a decent amount of food items left as some Starbucks run out quickly. I'll probably be back.
They are pretty good about making your coffee right.  I have had some issues with quality but the take care of it right away. Overall good experience

I consider this to be "my" Starbucks, although I do visit 3 others. I generally drive through on my way to or from somewhere else.

They're always friendly, never pushy, and when I order a caramel macchiatto (sp?) when it's 105º out, they considerately ask if I want it cold or hot. (The answer is hot. I'm not a fan of iced coffee.)

My only concern is the entrance/exit. It's very close to the intersection, and I've seen a couple of near misses when cars try to pull in/out of the lot. But I'm just a little extra careful.

Favorite sit down sbux on northside. Store is always clean, Baristas have never served a bad drink and are always friendly. Remember my name which is a bonus! Convenient in and out or place to chill with a book. Nice location off the monon on my bike.

Not the best at their service. Out of the cookies I wanted which is ok, but out of raw sugar too?? Went through the drive through and she even forgit to give us the stir sticks. She was however polite.

This starbucks sets the bar for teamwork, customer service and quality of product. Even when they are backed up they are still faster than most. They talk to each other, they finish each other's drinks. Jen is an amazing store ambassador, she is happy to see people and they are happy to see her. Fiona knows when you change your drink and checks to make sure that it wasn't an error. There's a woman with shorter and ofter colored hair that also seems to be an anchor on the team. Im forgetting some and there are so many on that team. I wish I knew her name because it's definitely worth mentioning. I don't know the store manager's name but to her credit she has an amazing staff. You should check this store out..... no wait....don't...I don't want the lines too long. :)

30 minute wait for a cup of brewed coffee? There were only 6 people in the line inside (drive-thru was wrapped around the building). Seemed like there were a lot of workers but the woman at the register was so slow. The coffee was fine if you have the time.

There is no seating in this Starbucks. And it's always cold in the winter and hot in the summer. 

The staff is helpful but a little on the slow side. Merchandise selection is super small. No drive through. Most of the parking is in the rear which makes it a little difficult to just run in and get your coffee. 

But--if you're shopping at Clay Terrace and just need a caffeine buzz, it's perfect.
This is my absolute favorite local Starbucks location! It's always clean and my order is usually correct. I really like the employees.

The staff here is actually not bad. This is a starbucks in a target so you have to have an open mind. You get what you get with no other Starbucks in the close vicinity. They do close earlier than their listed hours on the website. They staff shut the lights off 30 minutes before the listed closing time. Had to go get a smoothie from the cafe instead. Which was pretty mediocre.

This particular Starbucks is one of my go too Starbucks. They are extremely quick and efficient.  But make sure you go Monday through Friday from 630ish to 10ish.  This particular Starbucks is unique in that they seem to only get morning business, and staff accordingly the rest of the time.  

I have gone to this Starbucks on the weekend and walked back out because it was taking too long inside. But 3 employees with a drive thru doesn't seem like quite enough. (Granted, the people in front of me were taking forever.) (and I just ended up going through the drive thru).

One of the best things they have done though is the mobile order and pay. I find myself using it all the time.

The baristas are some the nicest Starbucks baristas I have ever witnessed and interacted with! I will be back the next time I'm in Nashville. There is no drive thru, but it was worth it to go in to speak with these friendly people. They were out of the two breakfast sandwiches that I wanted but didn't realize until I had already paid. They gave me another sandwich PLUS $4 gift card for my next visit! I'm super impressed! Thanks SB!

I've stopped in here a few times while shopping. It is hit or miss. The store always seems to need a cleaning or something to make it more inviting. The drink quality was fine but the last barista was awful. The group in front of me (2 girls) one had her drink the other one was waiting. One more person after them then me. 4 mins girl in front of me gets a drink, then the girl from the group. then 10 mins later my drink. Did I mention it was the 3 of us waiting. No apology, and I don't know if it was her hangover or what but she was the least pleasant person working with caffeine I've met. In their defense this was the worst experience. Most times it is fine. Never great but average. I'd say on a good day a 3 star.
Really nice staff and comfy location.   They were really friendly and had a good variety or food  and drinks for all.  We returned again.
This was located inside our hotel and only Starbucks in Tampa Bay.  It was our daily spot to visit for some delish Coffee.....
Not friendly, verrrry slow, and not good at blending the coffee drinks - everything tastes exactly the same. Definitely not my favorite Starbucks!

Stopped here with my family for a breakfast treat before we did our taxes.  The staff were super nice and made us feel welcome in their store.  The store is much larger than most and has very comfortable seating.  They made the wrong drink, but quickly made a new one and gave the the wrong one too!  Bonus!  Overall, I feel this place is a win.  We will be back.

The staff were some what friendly and there service was okay.

The place is clean except the men's bathroom seemed like someone took a bath near the sink. The floor was all wet around the sink.

If I could give ZERO stars I would. 
I just moved to this neighborhood 2 months ago. I've  ordered the same drink, DAILY, for years.  Never had a problem like I do with this location. 
Here is what has happened the last 4 days...

Day One, ordered a Quad Vente Carmel Macciato get to the window and I'm handed the wrong drink. I explain this to the girl at the drive thru window. Her response?? "sorry I must have heard you wrong. Have a good day"!
Had I not been in my way to work I would have gone in and the line is always slow and very long at the drive thru. 

Day Two, drink made wrong again. 

Day Three, I grab my drink and put it in my cup holder. At the stop light I pick it up to take a drink. The lid is cracked, clearly they didn't notice, when I pick it up to drink the lid comes off and I now have got coffee all over me. Have to go home to change and now I'm going to be late for work. 

Day Four (today),
I get to the window, ask if it's the correct drink. I'm assured that it is. Start to drive away and it's a drip coffee. I didn't pay $7.26 for a drip coffee. I go to the drive thru speaker and explain the situation. I'm told to pull back around where I have to wait behind 3 cars. I have one day off a week, today. Just wanted my coffee made correctly. Once I get to the window, I receive the correct coffee BUT it's 3/4 foam. Not ok. Did I mention that I used to be a Starbucks Manager 10 years ago??
Once home I called the manager.  Voiced my concerns to Katrina, I think that's what she said her name was. Of course she apologized and offered my next drink free. Her reasoning for the constant errors is that she is training 3 new people. That is false. Remember, I've been going there everyday for 2 months??  All faces are the same. That was a blatant lie. 
I will now buy my morning coffee elsewhere. $7.26 a day times 365 days a year???  You do the math, Starbucks!!
So disappointed and what a waste of money!!

For the most part Starbucks is Starbucks you know your order and the give you a pretty decent coffee. I recently had surgery and can no longer have any sugars in my diet. Needing a pick me up before work I stopped by Friday morning. My favorite drink of all time is the lime refresher. I asked if the lime refresher had sugar as I couldn't have any. Unfortunately I was told it does. The girls quickly steered me towards a black tea ice tea which they made for me in a separate container so not to fix with sugar. They even added sweet n low for me. I wasn't expecting such service. I was pretty impressed. I also ordered the egg white bites... those are very yummy. I will be back!

First the employees here try really hard and turn out a good product. The company severely let them down with a botched drive through design and a store that's about a third as big as it needs to be. It is always packed in here and your wait for ordering and drinks is north of 30 minutes.  You could literally build another Starbucks across the street and it'd be just as successful. Again however, the employees are quite good and manage as best they can.

I've gone to this Starbucks solely for convenience because its nearby and I don't drive. Baristas don't do a good job of making sure the trash is taken out, twice I came and it was overflowing. I walked in and one table was covered in trash. And I know they weren't that busy because one of the baristas was on her phone. I had to say excuse me loudly before she even knew I was standing in front of her. This location is also rampant with loud teenagers every night. I know its not a library, but people come to establishments like this to enjoy coffee and  get a little work done. Never have I been to a Starbucks where patrons are so loud. Not to mention the seating area is way too small.  You are better off getting your just okay drink to go. I probably won't be back anytime soon.
Definitely one of the best locations I've been to.  Great service, great drinks, great atmosphere.  Community vibe in a corporate coffee shop.

I used to the Starbucks app to order ahead, went inside after eight minutes. My order wasn't ready. I was given the drink after he finished now about 15 minutes after I'd ordered  I had to ask for the food I ordered, he told me to go talk to the cashier. And stand in line behind 6 people to ask for help to get the food that I had ordered ahead. So I had to be an asshole, and ask loudly if he could please help me out (I wasn't nasty just dumbfounded) so I could have the food I had ordered ahead. Never apologized for any delay and gave me a sarcastic have a nice day.
Happy and fast Starbucks, clean and tidy, with a friendly staff!
This is the worst starbucks i ever visited. People are rude and lazy. They were letting the person on register drown while others are just chatting. And to too it off, my drink is completely wrong.

I used to go to this Starbucks all the time when I was in grad school. Service was always fine. However, this last time, we stopped in the morning after Thanksgiving on our way out of town. We seriously waited 3-4 minutes in the store before anyone acknowledged us verbally. It was pretty ridiculous. There were 7 or 8 people waiting and finally, once the guy making drinks made a move to talk to us, the woman working the counter finally just stared at us at the register until we ordered. Really? Then she made a big show out of writing our names on our cups when we were the only people waiting for drinks. Pretty surreal. 

I do remember that people tend to camp out in this location and set up shop for quite a while. If you're meeting someone socially, it can be hard to find a table. In warmer months, there is ample outdoor seating, however. 

The drive-through can be tricky as there are two entrances and there always seem to be issues with the two lanes merging.

I only jumped on Yelp to write that this is the only Starbucks that has, two times in a row, given me a venti Java chip with a single shot of espresso, when I asked for a venti Java chip with an EXTRA shot.

Bruh, whaaaat the heck.

Had lunch next door, so afterwards I got a quick Caffe Americano to go. Baristas very nice and quick service. Thought my drink tasted good and strong the way I like it. I walked in (not driver thru). I was served ASAP. Thanks, I NEEDED AN AFTERNOON JOLT.

This teeny Starbucks does a decent job with the small space it has.  Although there always seems to be a line, they make sure that the drinks are made quickly (and accurately) while still doing it with a smile.

This is my husband's and my favourite Starbucks location. We've been to this one over 20 times and I am always impressed. The drinks are made exactly the way they should be here. Each barista seems cheerful and happy to be there- and one has even taken the time to learn our names!
Behind the counters everything is always clean and wiped and shiny. 
This is not the largest location however the seating is maximized in a good way. Lots of bar seats along the edges and individual two and four person tables. We've only experienced one time where we were not able to find a seat. 
The decor uses a gauge and some of the metal from the old brewery- so it's a very nice tie in to the whole district feel. 
Not all Starbucks are created equal- and this one feels like home to me. Go check it out!

I avoid this Starbucks even though it's the closest one to home. Always slow - it doesn't matter the day or time. Like most who visit this store, I've resorted to mobile order on my way, and here I sit 35+ min after the mobile order time stamp STILL waiting.   

Always seems understaffed - would be an easy solution to just hire a few more people!

I went to the ladies room looking for the changing table to change my 3 month olds diaper and guess what?! NO CHANGING TABLE OR COUNTER SPACE!!! I checked the men's room & NONE in there either! I asked the employees where the changing table was and was told there is none & when I asked where do I change her diaper the girl snipped and me and said I can change her when I leave!!! With all the money I spend at Starbucks and they can't even install a changing table?! OMG!! I've been to just about every Starbucks in Reno & seek out Starbucks when I travel too. I buy an over priced coffee (or two) just about every day!! If I have to choose between changing her on the bathroom floor or one of the table tops I'm choosing THE TABLE TOP! Maybe then they'll get a changing table! Why is this the only Starbucks without a changing table???!! This is Starbucks where talking about here. Not what I'd expect from them at all !!! I did call corporate to inform them of the lack of a changing table & how tacky it was.

Decent Starbucks. We got there 15 minutes before they were closing and it seemed like they were already closed. The food case was empty and the servers seemed bothered that we came in. 

My colleague had a Medicine Ball and they didn't have enough tea bags to make it correctly. My coffee was old and I wish they would have said something about getting something other than old coffee.
Great spot for some coffee and a meeting fast service no disturbance what so ever and hard workin employees

Had one of my worst Starbucks experiences today. While making my drink the lady goes to put whip cream on it then asks do you want whip? I replied no ma'am it's a coffee light frappucino. So she makes it then brings it over so I asked what drink it was she gave me a very rude look and goes what so I asked again then she replied caramel frapp. I then told her I ordered a coffee light she scorned replied well I can't read the writing on the cup then decided to slam the cup into the trash and finally re made my drink. She was a lady with glasses and long blonde hair in a braid
Staff is super nice and my drink is always made promptly and correctly!

Dropped in on our road trip for some needed venti cups of coffee. Very convenient and right off the I-10. They had friendly and efficient staff. This store has ample parking space but also has a drive-thru, if one is so inclined. Will come back if I ever find myself on this road trip again.

I really like my local starbucks. My drink is always made perfect and when there is a line, its pretty fast. The people who work there are also super friendly. I just really don't like the parking lot. When there is a crazy long line the line goes out in to traffic.. so that part really sucks. Make sure you don't park by the front door because you may be stuck in your parking spot if a line forms!

Very, very, v e r r r y   s l o o o w   s e r v i c e ... Z z z z z z z. Also, staff seems disinterested in very long lines. Always short handed. Doesn't accept Starbucks free coffee or food promotions.

I have been to this Starbucks before and had a bad experience with One of the employees attitude but I'm willing to ignore that and continue to visit this location because of the AMAZING service provided by Mario. I went in with a extremely large order today , I was extremely apologetic for hitting him with the order but he advised not to worry and that he would get it done. On top of taking care of my order he assisted all other customers with a big smile and eager to help as well. Mario is Great , I felt super bad for having such a big order but he made me feel much better when he took the task like it was an easy one. Thank You Mario !! You are Awesome !

This place is just okay with me.  I live three blocks away so I go here out of a matter of convenience when I'm in the mood for something that I can't make at home.  But the service here really does just suck.  The baristas always seem way more preoccupied with talking to each other rather than acknowledging the people waiting at the counter.  And I understand that everyone has a job to do (drive-thru, hot bar, cold bar, registers, etc) but when the person at the hot bar is getting smoked and there are four of you standing around watching them struggle to keep up with tickets, jump in there and help a brother (or sister) out!  I work near the Starbucks on the circle so the vast majority of the time I'll just stave off my coffee withdrawals until I can get downtown where I know they'll make my order correctly and in a timely fashion.

This Starbucks Location doesn't seem to be run very well; the employees were more concerned with taking pictures of each other and talking about customers who had placed orders on the phone than making drinks. Just got an iced coffee with nothing in it and was standing there in the crowded waiting area for like 10 min. It's worth it to walk to any of the nearby coffee shops

I can be lazy, so I love the drive through. It used to be very convenient for me to hit up this Starbucks on my way to work, but since I've moved, it's a bit rarer but I still like this spot.  A warning, though, although there are plenty of parking spots and the drive through is usually pretty quick, at certain times of day the parking lot will hold you hostage. The way it's designed, the drive through line snakes through the parking lot when it's busy and then you will be unable to exit your parking spot.  Let me tell you, this is frustrating. I usually park on the other side of the drive through area for this reason.  10 steps farther from the door, but no chance of getting trapped.
Everything was wonderful! But I do think they should have more people working. I sometimes come before work and it takes forever for me to get out of there!
Ordered puppacinos for two puppies, along with a Flat White for me. Dogs enjoyed theirs a whole lot. Thanks!!

Stayed in the hotel that this Starbucks was housed in for a conference. This place gets BUSY! However, they are pretty efficient and the line moved quickly. I didn't get a drink, but had a greek yogurt with berries and a separate multi grain bagel with cream cheese. The total came out to about $5 and it was very filling. 

Quality and selection of items are standard, but the location is really convenient! There's a nice bar seating area by the windows so it's a nice place to people watch.

This Starbucks has one of the longest lines with regularity that you will ever see. Plus it's a small Starbucks with a limited menu. I would only give a full-sized Starbucks 3 stars because their coffee tastes burnt and their prices are ludicrous. I know some people are obsessed with Starbucks but I've never understood paying more for worse. I far prefer Dunkin Donuts or Tim Horton's for quick and basic coffee, and if you want good coffee,you need to order online and have a good burr grinder and a Chemex or French Press.
Staff is always efficient AND friendly. Drinks are made with care and not rushed. I taste the difference!
Solid choice for those looking for their daily Starbucks fix.
Love this location! Everyone is very friendly here. Sometimes it gets a little crowded on Sunday's but we love it here anyway!

I like all the entertaining reviews for this place, though I can't say I have anything to add to them. 

We just came here for a grand latte and my usual "iced-venti-half-caf-Americano-with-three-pumps-sugar-free-Vanilla-with-light-ice-and-light-room" and left unscathed. This place was clean when we were there (a weekend) and our orders were quickly prepared and as-ordered.

I do wonder if Yelpers are being a little hard on this guy Alberto. Even though I have never met him, I feel bad for him. No one knows his story, what goes on in his life, or what he might be dealing with. 

Nonetheless, judging from the gross disapproval of his patrons, I hope he is able to improve his performance or find a role that is suited to his occupational strengths.
Great staff located on campus huge plus if you go to the school. If you are a partner they are a fake bucks so no deals. They have lots of treats. Baristas won't burn your shots they are legit.

Why does the worst Starbucks in the city also have to be the one closest to my job? 

In general I don't think the issues of this place are directly related to the staff. They are always friendly when I'm there. I think the problem is that this place is always busy because it's in the Marriott and there never seems to be ENOUGH staff. It doesn't matter if there's only 2 people in line or 30, I always seem to wait at least 15 minutes for my iced coffee. 

Yet, I keep coming back thanks to my relentless caffeine addiction.

I've come in two mornings in a row.  Different staff on the different days.  All wandering around behind the counter kind of clueless.  Don't come here unless you have a minimum of 15-20 minutes to stand in line and then wait for your coffee.  Two registers running, but one barista-- you do the math...

I had a friend go to the Starbucks location to get a Venti iced latte for me. They were out of the Venti iced cups and my friend asked if they could do 2 grande for the price of the Venti. They would not and did not accommodate for their ordering or supply issues. I usually do not get Starbucks but today called for one. They were also rude. 
Starbucks please understand that just a simple gesture will go along way.
Customer service I think not!

I should get something better than Starbucks reward points. I think my family pays the salary of one employee every year. Cool factor (yes), coffee clan behind the counter kicked butt. Drink was as good as mommas baked apple pie.

Very friendly and excellent staff, the inside of the Starbucks has an awesome Decour and it is awesome to work out for a long period of time. Dislocations drive-through is a bit slower than other Starbucks I've been to but overall a very good experience!

Drink was good but it took 22 minutes for me to get my drink upon entering the door. No apology for the delay and no manners by staff whatsoever. After the cashier yelled, "Next!", I walked up and said, "Good morning". No response. I said thank you for my drink. No response. RUDE!
Terrible customer service. Sub-par coffee. Of all the Starbucks I've visited, this is by far the worst.

My husband worked for Starbucks for 2 years as a black apron and a shift supervisor. When I experienced Starbucks then, they made sure that customer service was #1. EVERY time I go into this Starbucks there is someone who is incredibly rude. (Meaning someone working). One time a friend and I went in and I ordered a mug and as my friend started to order a mug, the girl had already grabbed a paper cup and when my friend stated she wanted a mug there was an eye roll and she crumpled the cup and threw it in the trash. When called on her actions she changed her attitude. They are never friendly and it never seems like customers are their priority, more like it is a hassle every time they order. Where the coffee is fine, the service lacks. If there were other places to go in this town, I WOULD NOT go back.
It's a Starbucks. Not better or worse than most!  Best thing about it? It has a lot of parking? That's good, I guess. Otherwise, it's a Starbucks.

These folks do a great job with order ahead through the Starbucks app.  

This location is next to the hospital and has no drive through. This creates long lines at times in the morning.  Luckily, the order ahead feature in the Starbucks app lets me place my order while I am driving to the store. I walk in and my drink order is ready and waiting for me.

I've tried the order ahead feature at other area Starbucks, but they have consistently let me down;  I end up waiting for my drink. The folks at Starbucks on Double R and South Meadows are on top of their game.  

Kudos for keeping my morning going
It's a Starbucks.  They make coffee.  It was adequate and caffeinated.  It's all good!

Very friendly staff and great location right in JW Marriott level 2. The barista a are very nice and good!
