I had a free birthday drink on my starbucks phone app and they do not accept the phone app but they decided to give me a free drink anyways and even wrote Happy birthday on my cup. Great and consistent

Since I don't drink coffee, I don't find myself in a Starbucks very often. But coffee shops are always a good spot for a casual business meeting, so I do visit them time to time and I'm always wanting something other than coffee to drink.

Not having been to Starbucks in probably a few years, I didn't really know what my options were, but since it was a nice sunny day, I wanted something cold and refreshing. I hesitated for a while before deciding on an iced tea, but the girl behind the counter actually recommended a lemonade that she really enjoyed, so I got that instead. It was just what I was looking for!

I was there mid-afternoon during the week and it was pretty quiet. There was a table of a few EPS officers but that was it. There was ample parking as it is located in a new strip mall and few other tenants have moved in so far. As more move in, parking might be a bit more limited.

I would have to agree with the recent posts about becoming 24 hours!  With the hospitals close by and this one being the closest one to my house, I would definitely support the 24 hour aspect!! Who do we take this to to get er done?  Also - if you have not signed up for a free Starbucks loyalty card, do it! you get free Starbucks on your birthday and after so many drink purchases. Make sure you have them ring up each coffee as a separate scan on your card though.  There is an awesome mobile app too that you can update and reload within seconds!

A classic example of a thriving Starbucks right beside a wonderful mom-n-pop. A keen-eyed fellow reviewer (NY T.) tells me that this particular Starbucks was actually there before the nearby coffeeshop (Bjava's) opened for business; but even so, my vote -- and my business -- go to the little guy (or "gal", as the case may be).

But we have the power, people! Starbucks can only continue wiping out local flavor if we let it. The power is yours!

My vote: Go to Bjava in the strip mall just to the south. 

Bjava not only has nice coffee and a friendly staff, but they roast their own beans right there on the premises. Stop in or pick some up to go. And shoot the bird at the Starbucks on the way out!
It's just about as Starbucks as Starbucks gets. Coffee, service, decor, everything is predictable (in a good way).

If you can stop at a different Starbucks, skip this location. Ignore the "prep time" when ordering through the mobile app and add 10-15 min to it. This is not the spot to grab a coffee on your way to work, unless you're willing to be late. Also double check your order especially with food- last week I ordered the bacon/gruyere egg bites and they gave me the roasted red pepper bites 
This location is completely disorganized and has ridiculous wait times with slow service...I've been to literally a dozen other locations across several states that are always on point with fast, friendly service. I won't be wasting my time and money at this branch any more, which is unfortunate since it is so close to me!
The music is always too loud to have a relaxing conversation while enjoying my drink. Always seem short staffed and uptight. Great location and patio.

When did Starbucks become smoker friendly? I love sitting outside - this location has the best outside seating - but no matter where I sit there is always someone smoking now. Very disappointed in how I can't even enjoy the experience I used to coming here. No one respects what "no smoking" means and the employees certainly don't care either..

Really disappointed in the drive through service I experienced tonight. I understand all their drinks are made to order but I waited in the drive through 22 minutes to get my drink and I got there at 5:20 pm. The workers didn't even acknowledge how long I had to wait. I would return but from now on I'll just walk into the store because I probably would had received faster service.

I've always been impressed with the service and quality of the coffee at this location. It's VERY small, but they move customers in and out with ease. The staff is always very friendly and even inspired me to send a note about them to Starbucks corporate at one point. So, it suffices to say that I like this location and recommend them. Sadly, my building has a Starbucks "cart" thing that can't really compare to a full store. So, when I have a desire to get Starbucks and I'm downtown - I head to this store and I'm never disappointed with the experience.

We have lived in 6 different states in the last 10 years, and this is our 2nd time in O'Fallon. This drive thru by far is the slowest out of all the Starbucks we've been to. Hoping it would have improved since 2015 but it hasn't.

This is my favorite Starbucks in Jefferson Parish. They seem to have a good crew working there and they always make my drinks the best. The big windows make the store bright and cheery.

Other than that, it is a typical Starbucks, offering the usual fare.

I often like to stop in on Saturdays as I'm out and about.

My wife goes here way more than i do, to do her homework and such, but so much i think she works there as a regular customer! ha.
I have got a couple drinks from this place and have never been disappointed yet.  i enjoy the strawberry's and creme frappe as well as white chocolate mocha and other frappes.   the atmosphere is just like any Starbucks, nothing special just a little coffee shop with some tables and free wi-fi.  i love that they have the free wi-fi here.  

the people are friendly workers and customers, the places is clean, and they have a little outside area to sit as well.

I work across the street. Ordered for some coworkers on the mobile app.thinking what a great idea. I can place an order then run over on my break. Went to pick up order. Told them my name. Was told my order was not ready yet. Ok? After waiting 20 minutes, it was Christmas time I didn't want to be a jerk, I asked to speak to a manager. Turns out someone changed receipts?  My coffee had been waiting on the counter since I walked in. OK I was a jerk but was already running late, and needed coffee, so whatever.  I just stopped in today to use my gift card and remembered the whole thing. Started a conversation with Dan the manager and casually mentioned the episode.  He gave me a coffee on the house. Great manager! Problem solved. I will be back again.

This Starbucks is rumored to be the highest grossing Starbucks in the Midwest.  If the drive-thru and in-house lines are any indication of the accuracy of that statement, then they truly are!

There's nothing I can say about Starbucks here, that hasn't been said, written about, etc.  But I've been to many a Starbucks, and this one is, well, just a great experience at any time of the day!  The staff is wonderful, and always greets the regulars by name.  Seldom do I even have to tell them what my order is.  They will usually ask if I'm having whatever my usual drink is for that period of time.  And promptly serve it up for me.  On the very rare occasion, that your drink isn't up to your taste standards, they want you to tell them!  They'll gladly remake any order to satisfy their customers. 

The store is clean and well maintained.  But the configuration could have been given a bit more consideration.  For example, the drive-thru lines up right in front of the entrance.  It creates a considerable amount of traffic, and presents a potential hazard for patrons going in/out of the building.  Similarly, there are a few parking spots right in front of the door.  Beware if parking in these spots due to the way the drive-thru wraps around the building and crosses behind these parking slots.  If you are parked there, and need to get out quickly, hope to God the drive-thru line isn't too long.  Or you're going to be stuck in your parking spot until the line passes by.  The good thing is, the baristas in this Starbucks are fast and accurate!  They generally keep the drive-thru line moving at a pretty goods pace.  That certainly is appreciated when you are short on time!

They have an outdoor seating area, but again, it bumps right up against the drive-thru line!  So consequently, your conversation is constantly interrupted by customers placing orders, or loud cars and stereos!  Enjoying a nice latte right next to a running car isn't the most pleasant experience.

The indoor seating area is less than adequate.  Sure there are tables and chairs, but on a Saturday/Sunday morning, they fill up quick, leaving you no other option but to sit outside, or take your order to go.

But as I stated, aside from these physical shortcomings, the exceptional staff more than makes up for it!  And the product quality speaks for itself!
Great starbucks. Not much more to say then that. Plenty of seating to get work done, very very friendly staff, and drinks are always made to perfection.
Stupid Starbucks, won't sell the food in the display because its the next day's inventory. What idiot would think up that one. A sale is a sale, but a sale denied is an annoyed ex-customer.

Forgot sweetening my iced tea, but she doesn't care. Just chatting with other customers and was not paying attention. Always forgets name, which is totally ok, and make rude nickname, which is not acceptable.

Worst starbucks in this area. I order the same thing every day from another starbucks, never have any problems. Went through the drive thru at this one and they handed out a cup full of ice and only half full of coffee. Went back in and asked "beth" for a new one. I was surprised by the sarcasm and attitude that she responded with as she stated, "what do you want me to do, put it in a smaller cup?"....... when i explained to her that i would like the size i ordered she began slamming things around and making other orders while i stood there for 10 minutes waiting for the drink to be corrected  that already took 15 minutes to get from the drive thru..... not to mention the fact that she still gave me back a cup that was not filled with anything but ice. Horrible customer service!!!!!!!

I wanted to get out of the rain while in Philly.  So I stopped by Starbucks.  What fantastic service, the staff was as accommodating as they come.  I stayed 2 hours to complete computer work. I was sitting near the register and over heard some of the interaction between customers and staff.  The staff was on point with every customer as they were with me.  

My hot beverage tasted that much better due to GREAT service.  Amazing work!
Reiterating my last review...the people are nice, but mobile ordering has essentially ruined this location. No point in going unless you can order and pay ahead.

I've read some of the reviews of this place and it says it's full of friendly people... but seriously who did I murder? Because I received one of the ugliest stares by a barista ever. Mind you, I arrived around 6:30 AM; after an hour of driving I stopped in to order something to wake me up. When I ordered my drink I ordered my usual (Iced coffee w/ 2 add shots) and the barista replied, but I didn't hear her well. When I replied with something else she corrected me and I apologized... But she didnt hear my apology because she gave me a mad stare and acted as though my mistake killed her favorite uncle. I was hoping I'd receive the friendly environment that reviewers have written about but I was unfortunate to have committed some sort of a heinous crime beforehand. Normally I'll let things like this roll but when someone makes you feel uncomfortable so early in the morning one has to say something. Even the cashier was unfriendly to me.

Next time I hope to receive the service everyone else writes about. I really dig places with awesome service.
It's in a target which is convenient.  It's usually crowded because there's only 1 person taking orders and making drinks.

Hands down the most inefficient Starbucks I've ever been to.  Let me summarize my experience:

6-8 customers in line, 8 employees working, 1 employee taking orders.
There is a lot of seating in this Starbucks, great place to meet friends.

Inattentive and unfriendly personnel. 

Got my order wrong and did not offer to remake it. 

This store is an outlier for Starbucks.

Good old Starbucks. Very busy location at times but they're able to somehow push everyone through in a reasonable amount of time. My drinks are almost always made to my satisfaction. Friendly crew here too.

This Starbucks is one of the worst!!! the baristas pick cups up put them back down and walk around. One barista on hot bar one on cold and move quicker when there's 100 drinks in line. horrible service

In my previous review I gave this place a low score. Yet they have completely revamped this place up. They actually are no longer the "Key West Pink Flamingo Club" meaning they only use to hire Dudes, finally they have a co-ed staff. The staff is pretty friendly and the vibe is good. Much better than before. I enjoy this location better than the one near the Muvico because it has a drive through and has less traffic. They make good drinks and when I get good service I always tip. Great Improvements!!!

As far as a Starbucks goes this is one of my favorite locations. The downside is no drive through. Parking is sometimes a challenge in this shopping center and I imagine will get even worse once the new Ross is open. Luckily the Starbucks is on the other side so there is usually a spot or two open nearby. 

The staff is always very friendly and more than willing to remake a drink if it is not to your liking. There seem to be a lot of regulars at this location and the baristas always remember their drinks.
I came to this Starbucks and they had expiration drinks and sandwich sitting there in there fright . Be careful people no one want to get STOMACH VIRUS for expiration food. Thank you Starbucks

I have gone to this Starbucks off and off.  I avoid it because of the uneven service that i receive.   Some , perhaps most, of the barista are excellent...many not as much.   Recently,  I dealt with an abrasive barista named Theresa.   What makes it worse is that I heard that she is a barista that had been there for many years.  She acts as though she is doing you a favor by taking your order.  She also seemed to feel that a partner that I was with was asking for free coffee..which was clearly not the case as he had a reward on his card that he earned from purchases.  This has been a consistent problem at this store.  Because they have a large homeless population at this store,  they tend to generalize ..especially towards people of color.   Theresa's sullen demeanor and her nasty treatment...and erroneous assumptions about my companion..confirms my decision to avoid this store like the plague.

This is a newer Starbucks and not my usual, but still close to my neighborhood so I stop in every once in a while. It's an average Starbucks, but it has a nice sized patio right at the corner of Chippewa and Lansdowne, my favorite part. Plenty of patio tables and chairs, plus comfy arm chairs, too.
Super friendly staff.  Well kept location.  The tables outside are great on a spring day.  It's a spacious location which makes it even better.

Hey. It's a Starbucks so WYSIWYG. However the staff here is always friendly and efficient. There is lots of room here and it never seems crowded although it is busy. Good place for a post Eagle Creek run.

The service is fast and staff are friendly, but the queues can be quite long. Nothing really special regarding the decor or range of products. Ample seating available and easily accessible to the JW Marriott lobby.

excellent amount of sitting room, right in the fancy neighborhood of Montecito, where you never know what celeb you might/will see. They have very friendly staff, and the line moves fairly quickly. I enjoyed their free wifi and ample seating. Perfect for a student/group of students studying for their next big test or for a group who just finished dinner to decompress on their comfy couches and enjoy a nice latte or chai tea. love it!

Slow service, frequent starbucks drinker...this store is super slow and seems to ignore mobile orders to last. Today saw 4 walkins after i arrived (order placed 5 mins earlier), all got theirs before my order. Spoke to shift lead, typical non-answer per the script with no genuine sign of caring
Gave 2nd try, same lousy service

Decaf takes 15 minutes they quit prebrewing it. 
Im changing to Panera. 
Icontacted mgmt.  corporate office.  Ive come here for 13 yrs.  no more.  Its all yours.

this location is kind of a pain to get in and out.  This corner of Lindberg and Lemay has always been an odd location to me. I was sad to see Gingham's close, but I am glad that SoCo has a stand alone Starbucks. The one in the mall is terrible, and sometimes I don't feel like driving all the way to Tesson. Plus this location has a drive thru. always an added bonus.

Every time I come to the play area with my son and my wife I go and buy some coffee while my son is playing but this time I didn't want coffee so I've asked the girl behind the counter if I can get change for 20 to use for the toy cars and she refused!! I will never buy a coffee again from any Starbucks location

Lots of rooms, plenty of outlets, lots of parking too.  They've got long tables for you all that roll deep.  Plenty of other places at the strip mall, Goodwill, O'Reilly's, Gym, Barber/Beauty Shop and C&G's pharmacy.

It is a Starbucks. 

Lines are relatively short. Parking is absolutely insane. There are too many businesses in the complex, and many have reserved their own parking for their stores. This makes it difficult since everyone is just trying to go to the Starbucks. 

Tables inside are usually all taken by locals. 

Oh yeah. Fill up your chocolate powder!!

Worst Starbucks. Barista said "I ain't know what no macchiato is" as she made our macchiatos. Shots went directly into the cup leading to a bitter awful taste (including plastic for a cold drink). No shot pitchers in sight. Love Starbucks but this was not drinkable. Hands all over the top of the cups. Yuck!
I enjoy coming to this Starbucks location because it doesn't get too busy.  However, if you are looking for a drive-thru this won't be the place for you.

What this location has working for them:

The fact that they have a drive-thru.  Sometimes, I just need a quick cuppa and I haven't the time or inclination to park and go in.  

They are speedy.  I have come during rush hour and even with the crazy volume of people, they get you in, out, and caffeinated in no time.  

The service is always friendly.  I haven't had a single experience where this has not been the case.

What I don't like:

The convenience of the entrance.  Which, I'm guessing is less their fault than the city's...but a word to the wise--the only way to get into this joint is if you are heading east on State Street.  If your heading west, you must go a bit up State, turn around, and head back east (and at that point, you might as well just hit the drive-thru at Cafe Capri and be done with it).  You also cannot access it from Veterans Memorial...though you can exit there.  Really, not the best set up.

So, if your heading east on State and need a quick caffeine pick-me-up...they'll take good care of you!!

I have always had excellent service at this location and a great experience. Sometimes I stop by with family when I am hanging out with them on this side of town. We have been going to this location for years and never had a single problem (there are other Starbucks locations that have issues). This location is always excellent. Same prices and items at any other Starbucks, so I imagine if people are concerned about prices this would affect everyone in town.

Did not try the drive-thru (there was a big line) but went inside.  Somehow our drinks took much longer than anticipated.  Too much worker chit chat.  There was no one in line in front of us and only one drink was in the process of being made before ours.  There were two people making drinks but it was not clear who was making them for the drive-thru or the store.  The drive-thru customer we saw at the window waited as long as we did for our drinks.  Either way, it looks like people just have to wait.  That is just the price you pay when you are buying $4.00 coffee.
There is a 25minute wait every time I go through the drive through and 9 times out of 10 they get my drink wrong. The only reason I go back is because it's close to my college.
Great location! Tends to be busier than most Starbucks I usually visit, though. Opt for the ordering option on the Sbux app. A decent spot for celeb sightings, as per my wife.

It took me a while to warm up to this particular Starbucks. The interior is often cramped and dim with long lines. I like the morning crowd, which is professional. Later in the day it's filled mostly with hoards of Westmont College students...

There are a few couches right outside on the patio. Parking is easily obtainable as well. 

This is easily the nicest Starbucks in Santa Barbara.

Sometimes you just need coffee. I'd much prefer to give my money to a mom and pop coffee joint, but honestly, $bux will have to do. The service was excellent, the product was perfect. and the company was great.

Kind of a hot mess. They made a s'mores frappucino without any coffee in it. Not sure why, we were only customers ordering so not like it was busy. They were friendly but didn't know how to Starbucks. Ordered coffee drink and got a lot of ice and milk but no coffee in it. Didn't satisfy my coffee urge. Attached to a Sheraton hotel and it's very stuffy, like they are trying to be high end but miss the mark. Dunno. Double "meh".

This Starbucks has a rep for being slow but it is conveniently located to my office and the baristas are usually pretty good so I do stop on occasion.  When I can get right up to the drive thru board it's like winning the lottery!  Today the drive thru line was long so I went inside. There were 2 people ahead of me and soon 3 behind me. The cashier handled the first person with such agonizing slowness I thought it much have been the customer's issue. The next guy was faster but then she wandered off and was making coffee.  Another cashier approached the second register and was doing something...as I stood there...not sure to what register to go.  No acknowledgment. No "we'll be right with you". Nothing. No joke. 5 minutes.  I walked out and will never go back.  I can go across the intersection to the Safeway

I stop at a Starbucks at least 3-4 days a week, I must say I have never had such a consistent positive experience as I have had at this location. Every single time I have gone through the drive thru the staff have been extremely friendly ( awesome customer service every single visit) and they always make my drink to perfection. I am not sure if the staff there are drinking a lot of espresso or they just hired a great team but they always provide a good/fast experience.
This place has ONE lady making all the drinks... And 7 people in line. Good times.
The staff is rude and nasty. And my drinks are never that great. I would rather drive a couple miles than waste my time and money here.

I love that we have this starbucks here on campus...I get a pretty complicated beverage ... And for the most part they always get it right...if they don't ....they know to re-make it...before I unleash my wrath...The manager at this location is super sweet he takes the time to really train his student employees...when you get a 5.50 venti cup almost daily you have certain expectations...

Pretty standard Starbucks-just beware of the drive through to make sure you're going the right direction since it backs into a separate business lot. Staff has been friendly. This location is sometimes out of things, like tea and specific cookies, but again, that seems pretty standard with such a large chain and customer base.

The staff was friendly but sooo slow. I came by to grab a quick iced coffee the other day and nearly 10 minutes later I was on my way. All he had to do was pour it for me. The parking lot also gets packed on the weekends and isn't fun to navigate. I think I'll try the QT next time!

I stop in this location every day. The employees have great customer service and are all very friendly. They remember my name and my few different drinks that I order. Professional service. 

Sometimes this location can get pretty busy in the morning, but they are still pretty quick. Just because the line is long doesn't mean that you'll be in it for long.

The drinks here are fine...your typical SBux experience. The set up is super awkward with a large display in the  middle of the small space. Its impossible to work in this location because it is always LOUD and the Oro Valley demographic just lends itself to people who are just not in a hurry, so they take their sweet time deciding at the register what they want to drink and then complaining about their choice after it is made. It can take awhile to get a coffee because of this.  The baristas are prompt and pay attention to requests, and do what they can in this awkward space.

Starbucks, you failed me. 

When I usually stop here on Saturdays, the parking lot is full, people are parking next door at Lion's Choice, and the drive-thru is snaked out to the street. Yet I still get in and out quickly, with a correct order.

Today, Memorial Day, the lot was half empty, no cars next door at Lion's Choice, and only 2 cars in front of me in the drive-thru.

I ordered my usual venti caramel macchiato and pulled around. I could see right away that there was a problem with the first car's order and they were remaking it. The car in front of me went without incident, but I waited a full ten minutes after paying to be served. They made the order for the car  behind me, then the one for the car behind that. The server verified that I had a venti caramel macch, and still I waited for them to make it. When it finally came I put it into the cupholder, tipped, and left. 

Um, yeah, Starbucks, do you REALLY think I can't tell the difference between a caramel macch and a vanilla soy latte? Yep, after all that they still got my order wrong.

I think it's time to head to the Kingshighway store for a while.

I kind of want to give this Starbucks three stars, but it's thanksgiving... I'll give an extra one, and here's why...

The location is great. I happen to live in the area, and there isn't much here at all - so they have the monopoly. The staff is very friendly, and they usually are pretty well staffed. It's inside the Westin hotel. For me, parking isn't an issue because I usually walk there, but there are only three or four parking spots. I have occasionally stopped there on my way to work and asked the valet guys if I could just pull up. They are very generous and allow for that.

The downside - at times they can be a little slow. Since they're in a hotel, they'll often get large orders, and I've been behind that large order. No fault of theirs, but beware! Also, at times they don't adhere to their hours, and they don't have the "typical" Starbucks hours. 

All things considered, this is a great Starbucks for people on rocky point!
This location is OK. Mostly just use the drive-up window on the way to work. The big downside, the parking lot is designed very badly!!!!

I just came out with a big smile on my face. The Starbucks crew was on their A-game today.

Here's how it went: I walked in and was immediately greeted by a girl who asked what she could start for me. I told her I'd received an email about half off drinks but that I'd pull up the email so I could verify. 

She didn't make me go through the hassle. She already knew exactly what I was talking about and even knew the code for the discount! Doesn't seem like a huge deal but to me it was. She's the first barista  that hasn't made me do the footwork for her as far as what Starbucks' deals are. It was such a relief. 

And it gets better... It only took the other barista three minutes to get my drink in my hand, even with people ahead of me! And my drink was quality, too; done quick and right. 

Congrats, guys! That's how I wish all of my Starbucks experiences could be. There must be something magical about this Sunday afternoon crew because they really wowed me! 

Keep up the good work, Countryside Starbucks. I'll see you again soon.

I was the only one in the drive thru.  Through the window I could see several employees just standing around which leads me to believe that they weren't busy inside. All I ordered was a kids hot cocoa and it still took well over 5 minutes for me to get my drink. When it came out it wasn't even warm it was cold. Don't think I'll be visiting this Starbucks again.

I love coffee. After eating a lunch at Dick's, we came to this Starbucks. It wasn't a long walk and we didn't have to worry about dodging out of the way of football traffic. This particular Starbucks is one I've never been to. 

I opened the door and the smell of coffee grounds was delightful. I ordered a latte. They fixed it in a matter of less than a minute -- usual. 

The place was crowded, so we decided to sit outside. Nice outdoor seating. 

I didn't ask for the latte to be iced, so it was hot.
However, after waiting a minute or two to let it cool, it was worth it. 

Coffee : Good. 5 stars. 
Staff : 5 Stars. Friendly, fast.

I love Starbucks. I have a gold card with my name on it. Frequent customer.  Unfortunately this one is the closest to home and has the worst service. The Baristas frequently chat with each other while slooowly making drinks. In the evening I've been completely ignored while the staff cleans and preps for closing more than once.
You might say that a Starbucks is a S Starbucks and in many ways you'd be right.  The difference here is the staff.  Super friendly and fun.

Honestly, reviewing a Starbucks is like reviewing a McDonalds. You know what you're getting, and the quality may vary depending on just how little the employees care at the precise moment you're there, but it will never be the best culinary experience of your life, nor will it be the worst. That said, the staff were friendly, seemed competent, and made their way through a fairly long line of customers in a reasonable amount of time.

Starbucks is so over priced it's ridiculous. That aside, the oral Valley Starbucks has now changed the bathrooms to be coed. It's disgusting to have to put the seat down every time you go to the bathroom. Starbucks bathrooms in general are filthy. I give most of my business to Quiktrip. Inexpensive fresh brewed teas and super clean bathrooms that are separate for men and women. Give it a try.
I love going to this Starbucks location. Wonderful and pleasant crew! They have a drive through also.
Very nice sbux in a brick/old town design winthrop town center has a trendy atmosphere with shops and other restaurants in the area! Greek restaurant, Green Iguana, and Publix in the area.
The staff here are amazing. Always happy and smiling and attentive towards the customer. Always get my order right and super friendly.

The staff is great. God bless them for putting up with all the homeless people that seem to linger all day long, hogging up all the seating and adding an unpleasant odor in the air.  One that actually overcomes the beautiful smell of coffee that you would Expect to smell in a Starbucks. Where is the manager? Why isn't this place in better shape considering its central location ?

Hate this Starbucks. Asked the all male Barista's several times if they can put the names on the cups. They refuse and say "we will take this under advisement" I had an issue on 6 occasions that someone ordered a similar drink to mine and took my drink then either tasted it or realized it was not there drink. This could be avoided if they put a name on the cups but they are too freakin lazy to do that. So then they have to remake the drink. I don't understand why they only hire men at this location. I feel like I am at a truck stop getting coffee from a vending machine and not a starbucks. Who wants a 6-6 big guy 280 lbs giving you a coffee? This is not Prison I am not your prison bitch. Why can't they hire females to work at this location?  Coming here makes me feel like in line for Prison food. They should relocate this Starbucks and move into the local prison. This place always has dirty tables; you have to clean it yourself, This is a disgusting Starbucks of truckers wanna be Barista's who is anti-hiring females. Boy-George Village People starbucks. Bitch here is your coffee you take it black now. Next!

A couple of the Baristas have such a poor attitude, and seem to not want to be there. As a fellow Starbucks employee I hate seeing this, makes me feel un-welcomed and un-appreciated. I went with a fellow partner and was given the wrong beverage, with a side of sass.  I feel like the Mid-shift partners should wear a smile and be more friendly to not only fellow partners but costumers as well.
The cashier was helpful, the order was fast, and the coffee was delicious. I would go back to this location!
There is good parking here!! Oh, and the coffee is Starbucks. Best part about this store is the staff. Several of them know my name even though I am not a regular.
Please do not give pikes to anyone that orders BOLD , we hate pikes with a passion? I love Starbucks with a deep passion. Other than that great place.

Incredibly slow. I always regret it as soon as I pull into the drive-through line or go inside, having forgotten how long this is going to take. When I finally get the coffee it's fine, but the service here leaves a lot to be desired.

This place is great! The customer service is awesome (the people who work here are friendly and actually smile at you), and the temperature is very comfortable. It's a good place to work and socialize.

I stop at the location at least 4 times a week.  It has a nice atmosphere and the staff is typically upbeat and friendly.  I'll continue to be a regular guest.  Nice place to unwind after a long day or get some good coffee on the way to to work.

I had a great experience this morning and had to share! I pulled into the parking lot and saw that there were 5 cars ahead of me in line. At the prime-time of 7:20 AM I immediately thought to myself, "Great... I will be here all morning." This was not the case at all! I waited no more than 5 minutes! This is AWESOME on a Friday, rush hour morning. On top of the fast service, my Cinnamon Dolce latte and bagel never tasted better :) Thank you Starbucks for a great start to my weekend.
I had the best customer service Leah was amazing! Stopped in for an afternoon pick me up and was greeted with a friendly smile!

Restrooms & Facilities are not cleaned throughout the day.  Lovely & engaged staff.  Bathrooms are filthy.  Store is well stocked with a variety of sandwiches, baked goods, drinks, etc.  great music selection.  I really expected Better from Starbucks today

This location is good ... But the employee turn over is fairly high ... Which causes my drink order to come out wrong.  I normally get green tea frap with skim milk ... One classic pump and no whip ...for some reason my last two had coffee bean grinds in it ... Not a happy camper sine they increased prices ... But I love studying here.

Close to my workplace, so I'm basically stuck going here for a caffeine fix in the morning. But it's not a bad Starbucks, and I like this location way better than the one on Wash Ave.

The employees have always been friendly, although I am routinely overcharged. Maybe I just keep showing up on days they're training new people.

It has also been a week and a half since I bought the last doubleshot espresso+cream can, and they have yet to restock. D;

But somehow I'm still okay with this place.

Friendly staff. Small place, but usually busy and not much seating. View of the mountains. Nice spot to stop on our cycling route. They have wifi, indoor seating, outdoor seating, board games to play, and friendly baristas. There's also a Starbucks in the Fry's across the road, but I'm never sure why people go there over the fun, friendly atmosphere of this Starbucks.

It's a Starbucks, so obviously the product is good. However I went in on a weekend in the middle of the afternoon and had one heck of a time. I wa the only person in there and it took 15 min to just get my order ...no joke. Two employees, one in plain clothes and the other working were chatting it up and running around. When they finally noticed me the one took my order and then proceeded to discuss a concert the other was going to..... Yeah... I could have made my own drink by the time they finished screwing around. I haven't been back Becaise the were so rude. I normally don't complain unless they really have me waiting 20 min for a latte ... And I was still the only person in there ... Hopefully they stepped up on their customer service .

This Starbucks always delivers. They are open late (midnight), with a great seating area inside and an even bigger one outside. A much needed staple in Wesley Chapel, you often see people socializing outside while studying or working a their computers and enjoying a coffee. They have a drive through with quick, friendly service. I've never had a long wait when running in or going through the drive through. Love it!

Flies, Bad service, and bad coffee. Ofcourse there are a few nice employees, but the bad ones outweigh the good. I remember one time when an older gentlemen came up to get his drink and they had forgotten about it. They apologized to him and for compensation gave him the other drink that was waiting at the counter, which happened to be my drink! I could get over the bad service if there weren't an abundance of flies. I'm not talking one little fly, I'm talking about 6 flies EVERY TIME I GO THERE. Absolutely disgusting. Starbucks is supposed to feel classy and comfortable but this one feels gross.

They have the usual stock of Starbucks drinks, the service is friendly and the line moves quickly enough.  I was disappointed that they did not have the usual lids for iced beverages, instead depending on the open-holed dome style lids.  These are cumbersome and difficult and not exactly the go-to lid for people about to board an airplane.  They need to do a better job of stocking in that area.

They also need to widen the queue area, as most clientele in this location are traveling with cumbersome baggage of some sort making things a little tight.  While they have two registers open, it can be difficult to get to the 2nd register due to to tight quarters.

Just knowing that you're among the rich n famous in Montecito is a thumbs up. Its a great feeling right?. Then you add in their awesome outdoor patio with wi-fi, tables & chairs.. Now I can relax , stress free, while I sip on my Coffee and surf the web.. Oh yeah!! Now we're talking! Great service, great location. I give this place 4 stars!!

Nice clean and fast...I enjoy this location. There will soon be a larger Starbucks replacing this strip mall location. It is being put where the old Wendy's use to be in Intech Park. This should allow for easier parking and more room for meeting and those working!
Turnover rate seems high, so had one bad experience. They might have to pay the employees more to keep them here. I could be wrong, but that is what happened to me.
The barista got my order exactly right & was so accommodating about allowing me to use 2 free star awards. Very quick!

I love Starbucks and I got to drink my first Pumpkin Spice Latte out of the red cups. Location is very convenient. The staff members were courteous to my friends and I, while we took a long time to decide what to order. We didn't have to wait long to get our coffees. Also something to consider is how there are empty seats on a Sunday, considering how everyone drinks coffee on Sunday Afternoons.

Slow service, frequent starbucks drinker...this store is super slow and seems to ignore mobile orders to last. Today saw 4 walkins after i arrived (order placed 5 mins earlier), all got theirs before my order. Spoke to shift lead, typical non-answer per the script with no genuine concern

this Starbucks is a hangout for years so when service shifts, I notice. Lately, I've had to wait a long time to get served-no problem when the line is long - but when there's 1 or 2 people waiting & barista's chit chat with customers, I get annoyed. This has happened twice in the last week. Lots of new faces behind the counter -maybe that explains it---
Took kinda long for them to realize I wanted Cheese Danish. They brought me a bagel. Luckily I noticed on the register before that
Great store. Super friendly employees. But... No outside seats. A Starbucks without al fresco seating is like a forest without trees. A farm without produce. A pool with no water.

Worst, slowest Starbucks ever, and they're rarely apologetic. Half the time my drink isn't even right. If you are actually in the store and not in the drive-thru, they don't even acknowledge you when you walk in, even if you're there for mobile pick-up. If you are in the drive-thru, be prepared to wait in a line that wraps around the building and overflows into the street, where you'll wait about five minutes per car. I'd give this zero stars if I could. I've never seen a Starbucks like this.
my fave Starbucks ! Long lines go quick they are fast and really nice.

While the staff here tend to be friendly, that doesn't make up for the excessively long waits and incorrect orders.  I've given them a chance at least a dozen times because it's the closest drive-thru to my home.  However, this place is the WORST when it comes to waiting.  And it doesn't seem to matter whether it's 2:30pm on a Saturday or 9am on a Monday - the wait is FOREVER.  And even after an order being completely inaccurate, I've never been offered a free beverage coupon like at most Starbucks locations.

We were in the drive-thru when there were only 2 cars in front of us.  It took 22 minutes for us to get ONE beverage! The car directly in front of us got so frustrated that she just pulled off when it was her turn to get her beverage -- and the staff didn't even notice!!! They tried to give us her order instead of ours!

On another trip there, I ordered a latte.  When I took a sip when I got home, I realized they had instead given me a black coffee! I drove all the way back to the store to get a latte and all I got was, "Sorry about that."  No coupon, nothing.

I've put in MULTIPLE complaints to Starbucks about this store but have seen little improvement.  I've been to a LOT of Starbucks stores with wonderful service - this is NOT one of them!  Unless you have 15-30 minutes to wait around for your drink, it would probably be faster to park and go into the Starbucks in the Target across the street.

Love that this location has an entrance from the Philadelphia Downtown Marriott, I can get my Starbucks fix in.

This location has ample seating.  Staff was friendly and my drink was perfect.  This will be my Starbucks for the week !

This location is no different menu-wise than any other Starbucks. I visit here frequently on my way to work, this location is rather large in comparison to others and offers nice outdoor seating as well as the indoor cafe. 

They do not have a drive - thru and mornings can get busy and parking a bit tight, thankfully there is ample parking in the adjacent Wal Mart parking area as well as the strip mall. 

You may encounter a long line any given morning, however the staff here are incredibly friendly and move fast. I always enjoy coming in and being greeted warmly.
Great light like lunch! Nice location and drive thru too. Wasn't very busy so made it fast and convenient.

This is your run of the mill Starbucks, in my opinion. Friendly staff, useful Wi-Fi, great drink selection, cheerful holiday decorations. It's a bit on the small side, but that's nothing major. I have always been happy with the quality of my service and beverage/food after visiting this location. Keep it up!

I've seen this come up on my list to review several times, and I've skipped it over because I didn't really know what to say. I mean, it's a Starbucks.

Here's what I can say for this particular location. I generally go through the drive through and there's always a line. It goes faster than other ones that I've been too. The service is always professional and friendly, and I've never had something not right here. In my book, that's a pretty good experience.

Horrible. Bad service, dirty, bugs--oh and need I mention they made my latte with spoiled milk?!?! Yeah, gross. I have been a DAILY customer of Starbucks for over 7 years and this location I refuse to go near.
Slowest service.  Small space.  Indifferent  staff.  Drink quality inconsistent....in other words I've had better.
Very slow service in drive-thru between 8:45 -9:00 am. I'm been waiting 15min already

I guess the problem with this Starbucks is its location.  It's great if you're cruising around the mall, but for a morning java it doesn't work. Why you might ask? Well, because it doesn't open until 9:30am. Unless you work at the mall or a bank, the business hours are limited. I personally like to have a fresh cup in the morning to get my day going, and I don't work at the mall.  Aside from the operating hours, it's a Starbucks we are all familiar with, clean and an escape to the java world.

The interior is cozy but only offers six small tables. Cool for relaxing during crazy shopping sprees. Staff was friendly, as on most Starbucks.  It's closest to Sears and Macy's entry.

For just sitting and having a coffee, this Starbucks isn't so bad, but if you want to get some work done, there are a couple of problems. The main problem is the lack of power outlets. I'm lucky to be sitting by one of two available. The rest of the tables would have to stretch an extension cord, if they've got one.

The environment is a little dreary, and I've been here on nice days too (still dreary). I guess I'm not particularly enamored with the character of the place. It's close to a lot of good shopping if you just need to take a break for coffee, or for a short business meeting.

Busyness - Mid-morning and it's fairly steady at this location. All the seats are taken. I am betting the drive-thru is popular.

Noisiness - Not too bad. The music is relatively quiet, so people don't have to yell above it.

Ambience - One thing I haven't ever liked about this location is that it's poorly lit. There's plenty of light coming in from the front windows, but the rest is under-lit, giving it a bit of a dreary feel.

Power - Luckily I'm sitting by one of the two power outlets available to any of the tables. The tables in the centre of the room are out of luck.

Free wifi - Available and works well.

Staff - Always friendly, of course. 

Seating - There are only 16 seats, but room for more at this Starbucks. There are a couple tables outside also. There aren't any larger tables to work on, though there is room for a couple more. There are two arm chairs and the rest are flat wooden chairs.

Security - Seems to be alright here. I think it's mainly wheeled traffic to this location.

Friendly and clean. A lady took my drink I'm sure by mistake and they gladly replaced it. There was a misunderstanding on the food item I ordered and again they gladly fixed it. 
They need outlets along the glass wall. There are limited outlets at the bar and back wall, disappointing due to the actually large store. That's the only reason they went from 5 to 4 stars because service this visit was awesome.
What a pleasure.

Freaking slow service AND the order is wrong anyway ?!?!

Nothing like getting to your hotel and settling in with your coffee only to find the NO FOAM latte is fully 1/4 FOAM 

WASTE OF MY MONEY AND MY TIME
Avoid at all costs!  We stopped in for a simple drink and it's now thirty minutes later and we still don't have it.  Plus the bathrooms are worse than any gas station I've seen recently.

I would give half a star if i could.. this starbucks should be named starSUCKS!! went in around 6pm- slow time of night.. waited 20 min for a drink b/c they never filled out a cup for me... then the barista said "settle down folks i'm working on one machine with 20 cups"... well where was my cup???? i expect better service from an institution such as u of a! 20 min for a cup of coffee!! could have brewed one myself.... disappointing.

I'm going to make this a solid 5 stars - why?

1. Location - easy access in the parking lot area.
2. Drive thru - a must on a cold or hot day.
3. Friendly and helpful staff - offering ideas of drinks I would like while waiting for drinks to be made.
4. Prompt service - I was a few cars deep when I ordered and the service was prompt.
5. Drinks - made correctly. Sometimes Starbucks are hit and run with their ability to execute a drink correctly. 

Also, I always order soy and the wife orders regular milk. This quite often leads to "soy whatever the wife ordered" and "regular whatever I ordered." This location always gets it right!
Eh,I still like the coffe at Dunkin better - and it's cheaper. Sbux remains overrated in my book.

This Starbucks has a very friendly staff! And to those who complain about the drive through line- I have no sympathy. People cram into the drive through line even though they KNOW it takes a long time and blocks traffic. Park and go in. It's simple.

Your typical Starbucks coffee, good, made fresh, various options. I stopped by on my way to work, (it was 7℉) and found out they do not have a drive-thru. Bbrrr! Still, I got off the car and ordered my caramel machiato. I called the coworkers and asked if they wanted something, one of them flat out said she didn't, as they do not carry lactose free milk. I was unaware of that and I asked the barista, no, they do not carry it! This is just a suggestion to Starbucks, perhaps they might want to cater to people who are lactose intolerant.

What can I really say? It's a Starbucks. I happen to like Starbucks and I may be biased because I used to work at a Starbucks when I was in high school and it was a very positive experience. I also like Dunkin Donuts coffee but there's something about the Starbucks atmosphere. They create the third space between home and work- a place we can go to read, work, socialize, or veg out. The music is chill and the products are cute and seasonal. I always feel very at home and comfortable spending large amounts of time here. I like the Starbucks on Bay to Bay because the staff is very friendly, it's a large location, it has a lot of parking, and it has a nice patio. They could clean the patio tables more diligently but they are pretty busy.
small. good for getting your coffee fix if you need it. not a place to study.
The employees are just so nice and I had the best vanilla I've ever had. It means a lot when employees are genuinely sweet and go out of their way to give you great service

Waited in the drive through for 14 minutes for 1 coffee. When I asked the drive through attendant why it took so long "Oh, the car a few minutes ago was having trouble with their order" so we were all inconvenienced because 1 car. What ever happened to pull forward and park so every one in line is not inconvenienced.... Thanks Kristin

The previous reviewer, Julie, is absolutely correct.  This is your basic everyday Starbucks and that's not a bad thing.  It's clean and neat and has generally competent baristas.  It is a small one so it has a tiny variety of travel mugs and other retail stuff.  There are also very few tables.  This is a three star kind of place for me.

I was informed that the girl that my complaint was about in my previous review no longer works there anymore. It's a good thing bc she will definitely drive customers away! If I'm in the area, I will stop by! Otherwise I will stick to my Starbucks inside target location!

The drinks are made just fine, but the customer service leaves A LOT to be desired. They are alway super busy and often understaffed. The staff that has been there when I go is always moving at a snail's pace and spending more time socializing (often inappropriate conversations) and less time working. It's just annoying and unnecessary. There are much better locations nearby.

I go to this Starbucks because it's the closest to work. Service has improved over the past 18 months. The one time my drink was horrible, I drove back and they remade it for me and gave me a drink voucher for next time.

This Starbucks is really great. I guess it's a pretty high volume store because of the intersection it sits on. I recently went in because I heard they had a renovation (within the past year according to other yelp photos) and man is it beautiful in here! I love all the tufted leather, wood paneling, wall paper, and gorgeous art! Not to mention the Edison bulbs in the bathroom. I'm not sure if they just redid it or expanded the size as well because it looks much larger than I remember it. This location was already nicer than other locations and the remodel just tipped the scales. 
As for coffee they have the same usual Starbucks menu. They did appear to have a large wall with other snacks and gifting items though. I got a venti PSL and it tasted delicious although they don't fill the cup nearly as high as you'd think because of all the whip they add.
My drink did take awhile to make. I feel like I was waiting much longer than other patrons. Maybe they cater to the drive thru first? There were a lot of people working here though. All of them running back and forth.
If you're not in a hurry this is a great Starbucks to sit and stay awhile.

Oh, how I LOVE me some Starbucks! There isn't one where I live so I always make sure I get my fix when I'm near one. Their service was super quick and staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. I had trouble understanding how to use my gold card and the barista walked me through everything which I really appreciated. She also introduced me to the green tea latte - yummy! You gotta try it out! 

Awesome service and great product!
I didn't have a good experience the barista was rude. And the attitude and the vibe in the store was way off. So wasn't to impressed or even liked my experience.

This is a rather large Starbucks compared to some in the area but only had two people working in the morning so the line was awful! I don't normally come to this location since there's no drive through and had I known how busy it got I would have ordered online ahead of time which I def recommend! My drink was good tho :)

This is probably the worst starbucks I have ever visited in this ride creatively dubbed "Life". As I crossed the proverbial picket lines to enter this humble establishment for which I had preordered a drink online, which worked like a charm unlike the mysterious object aunt bertha picked up in India. However when I began to wait for my beverage another story began to unfold. This was so dirty and disgusting place I have ever been, and I took my daughter to a rap concert! I decided to photograph this event to show the world. Thank you for time

I go to Starbucks to study all the time. Spend $40+ a week in this store and a few days ago someone stole my wallet and I think it was an employee. The worse part is their corporate office was not helpful one bit ! Told me to make a report and they would call back. Never did ! Then I called back and they say I need a warrant for footage. What ! I'm never giving Starbucks my money again.

Overall awful experience. Waited for my food for 45 minutes and in line for 15. Despite the fact that there were about 20 customers waiting for their drinks, the baristas still had time to chat and take their time.
Only use the drive-thru and have not had a bad experience. Staff is always friendly and drink always come out great

This is a new Starbucks store, just South of Methodist Hospital on Capitol Ave
The Staff here is so friendly & helpful
Mark was espically helpful last night!

This is easily the worst Starbucks location ever. Whenever I visit a Starbucks, I usually order a peppermint mocha. But whenever I've gotten one here, it's pretty much just steamed milk and a shot of espresso. Incidentally, I've stopped getting coffee here altogether unless it's just something plain and already brewed. Last week, I got a hot tea and the girl made it with water from the tap instead of the hot water. When I asked her to remake it, all I got was an attitude. Similarly, I tried to have coffee drinks made with the same result. Needless to say, I hike down to 34th-ish street now if I want something that actually tastes good. Also, the staff here is terrible managing the lines, which get incredibly long. I'm relatively certain the only pace here is turtle. To wait 15 minutes or more for crappy coffee isn't worth it. The Starbucks close to the UPenn campus is way nicer, has better coffee, the staff is friendlier, and even with the walk, you'll still get your drink faster.

I go to this Starbucks mainly because I work and live close. Carleon is amazing and always greets me with a positive and upbeat attitude! Another barista there always remembers my name and greets me with a smile! This location has some great employees, my business will stay here!

I would give this place a 0 if I could. The customer service here is horrible. The cashier, Krystal, rolled her eyes at me the entire time she took my order and was extremely rude. They were out of almost everything at 9am on a Sunday. Instead of the cashier communicating nicely other options to what I wanted she just snarked and rolled her eyes. I was very caught off guard by this because I rarely right bad reviews, but had to after this experience. Horrible service, long wait time, and they are unprepared.

Although I enjoyed the drink, the service was terrible. Starbucks lately claims that it is attempting to reduce the amount of plastic used and even gives a discount for bringing in your own glass. So when I brought in my own cup, the expectation was that they would blend the drink and put it in my reusable cup, not pour it in a plastic cup, put a plastic lid on, then take off the lid, dump it into my cup, and throw away the plastic. In addition, I ordered 2 drinks and after I got one, had to wait another 5 minutes and various drinks in between to get my second drink.

I try not to be that person. The super particular uppity snob about coffee. I try to keep my orders simple. I admire the baristas for remembering everything they have to remember while being fast and accurate. So for me to get angry at a Starbucks....it makes me sad.

Came twice. Long waits both times. The first wait was 15+ minutes. During this visit I watched the barista at the window try to hand a Frappuccino (which turned out to be mine) to a woman in a car in front of me three different times. By the time I pulled up I saw it sitting in the direct sun- whip cream melted. Frappuccino separating. She gave it to me anyway. If it wasn't because my son was already getting impatient in the back I would've asked for a new one. Who knows how long a replacement would've taken. 

The second time I went was only because it was on our way out of town. Given my first experience I ordered a very simple drink- venti cold brew, three stevia. The label on the cup was correct but there weren't 3 stevia. Bet you're thinking "pfft how would you even know!" and that's a fair question because I would think it too. I drink this all the time. An IV of it would probably be cheaper. I frequent various Starbucks an embarrassing amount of times. I have had this drink in other Starbucks in the country. All tastes similar. Not here. It was so simple and was still made wrong.

I am really disappointed in this location. Why on earth would you only have 3 employees working at 7am on a Friday morning? Do you want people to get annoyed while waiting in line for 20 minutes after ordering and being late to work? This is a busy location, staff it as such!

My breakfast sandwich also tasted like cardboard.

I normally stop at Dunkin Donuts on Friday, but decided to try Starbucks this week because I do like their coffee slightly better. I will never make that mistake again. Dunkin's food is way better, the coffee is almost that good, and I never wait more than 5 minutes.

For some reason this Starbucks hardly ever gets the order right. Always asking to repeat and when they read it back, it's always wrong.  If they do get the order right, half the time they'll make it wrong.  This is the only Starbucks I have this problem with.  I've never really had problems with any other locations.

I've patroned this sbux a number of times since my initial review.

This is actually my most frequented sbux despite there being a few other closer locations, mostly in part to the large amount of seating and friendly staff.

I will give them the highest rating I would give a starbucks.  Nothing against the franchise, but it's very difficult to compete with locally owned coffee and tea places in the USF area, that are surprisingly high in quality and offer more unique experiences both in drinks and setting

This Starbucks is nice. It can take time to get into the parking lot; there's a median, so you can only turn right into the parking lot, you cannot turn left. My suggestion is, if the Starbucks is on your left, make a left at the stoplight and turn around in the Kmart parking lot. This location has a drive thru. The music is not too loud, but the place is a little chilly during the summer, so I recommend wearing a jacket or cardigan if you stay a while. It's a smaller location but they have a lot of tables and chairs. They also have a seating area outside with umbrellas.

Convenient location with drive through for my work commute. I usually end up here around 6pm (night shift!) & 10am on Sundays before church. Drinks are good but the service is painfully slow with my average drive thru wait at 15 minutes. Inside service is not any faster. And I know rush times are challenging but maybe they need more staffing during these times?? I've been to Starbucks at the busiest areas in LA and sevice was very quick.... right now, I'm sitting in the drive through line, there are 2 people in line, 2 people waiting to pick up their drink, 3 people ahead of me in drive through, & I've been waiting 18 minutes and counting... sigh.

Love Starbucks but this location is always busy. 10:30am and I'm 10th in the carline to order. Sometimes they bring out a barista to take orders and speed up the process but that is inconsistent. In my experience the service is always friendly but the cashiers inside and at the drive through do not seem to have the urgency you'd expect for somewhere that gets this much traffic.
Here's an edit of a review I posted almost 4 years ago: Good coffee and food. This Starbucks is definitely my favorite in the area. I like the homely feel and the baristas are some of the best.

If you're around the Intech Park area, it's nice that there is a Starbucks.  This is a smaller strip location with no drive thru, but it's fairly quick to run in for your caffeine fix.  It can get full quickly during peak times, but they are usually good at handling the rush.
They didn't get my order correct and didn't stir my drink so all of the sweet was at the bottom.

Friendly and clean. A lady took my drink I'm sure by mistake and they gladly replaced it. There was a misunderstanding on the food item I ordered and again they gladly fixed it. 
I loved the atmosphere but try need more outlets along the glass wall
What a pleasure.
I love this Starbucks! I've noticed that this is one of the Starbucks location that actually gets my orders 100% right most of the time...and the drinks taste extra delicious! :)

Service could be better. The crew fails to communicate with each other. Product taste inconsistent. My latte was a cup of warm milk. I'll give this location one more try for coffee. The food is as you would expect.
This Starbucks is great.  The employees are all very friendly and the line moves faster than any Starbucks I've ever visited- and I've visited a LOT of them.

The baristas always know my order, this is my favorite Starbucks
It can be a lil messy on busy mornings but I have rarely come on in the afternoon to find it that way

This Starbucks is very slow. There were 4 people working behind the counter, yet my drink took 15 minutes to make and it wasn't even busy in there. Then, when my drink finally was made, it was the wrong drink. I ordered a hot drink and received and iced drink. I'll stick with other locations from now on. They're more efficient! (Maryland Farms location is always so busy, yet so quick!)

This Starbucks is nice & roomy. Hubby and I got to sit on a neat chaise lounge and still had enough room next to us for our little guys' stroller.

Our barista, Spencer, had a great sense of humor and had us smiling. He even convinced my husband to try a pumpkin spice cream frappuchino(he stays far away from anything that sounds like coffee!). 

The only reason I'm giving it 3 stars is because the pumpkin frappuchino came flying out, but I'm still waiting on my macchiato... And if I've had enough time to write this review without a drink in my hand, then there's definitely some room for improvement. 

Update: They accidentally made my drink hot instead of iced but, as an apology, they let me keep the hot one for free along with my iced drink. Nice save guys! You get 4 stars.

While the parking lot here is an absolute nightmare at certain times during the day (lunch especially), they actually have some of the best staff out of any of the Starbucks stores I frequent. They're not only friendly and attentive, but they make good drinks and manage to keep the store clean while doing so.

I was particularly struck one day when a very demanding woman came in looking for bagged coffee for a friend. They didn't have what she wanted in the retail selection, but the manager went in the back and was able to get what she wanted from what I assume to have been the store's supply. They just seem to go above and beyond there.

Recent turnover rate has been high. I miss all my favorite baristas. But the staff is friendly and tries hard. 
It would get 5 stars except for the fly problem. It has gotten better but the flies are still around.

They keep the air up high so bring a sweater if you plan to stay a while. Also, the music is a loud if you sit in the corner.
If you advertise that you open at 5 am then you should open at 5 am. The past few days I have been showing up at 6am and your not open. I guess I might have to find a new place for coffee

Incredible staff!!!! I absolutely love coming to this location because they make me feel so at home. Rob the manager is so personable and the staff always makes my visit wonderful. It's so nice to come to a Starbucks and see that every single worker enjoys what they do! I have been to other Starbucks before but this one is a cut above the rest! Do yourself a favor and frequent this location. You won't be sorry!

I kind of hate to give up this location only three stars, but there is one worker who is always very unpleasant, and always ask us though mobile orders or an inconvenience. Everyone else is always so pleasant, but the employee with the ginger hair tends to cause negative experiences with a bad attitude. I actually feel bad for the coworkers, because the attitude clearly affects their work, as well.
Blech.  Gross espresso. :(  Plenty of tables though.  My drink tasted better a few hours later in the microwave, so an extra star for that.

This entry is confusing a Starbucks Store (pictured) located at 639 West Ina that already has its own Yelp page,

AND

The Starbucks KIOSK located inside the Safeway store located at the given address of 7110 North Oracle Rd.

I personally think this entry should be deleted since none of the reviews apply to the KIOSK and the one picture is very misleading.

Amazing coffee, quick service, and friendly faces! I love this Starbucks location! All of the baristas are helpful and fun to be around. The coffee is always hot, and the place is kept clean too! I will be back again!

I love the extra caramel frap it seems some places makes it better than others but every time I get it I'm always happy and it never fails me.

get the caramel frap on a hot summer day and your going to want to live in Starbucks that drink I kid you not it like crack not that I've ever tried crack its just very addictive and would definitely have you going back for more and more and more  

and because I was going so often I decided to just join the Starbuck club to earn me rewards and point cant beat em' might as well just join em.

Conveniently located next to my place of work and full of the friendliest baristas?  Perfect.

I typically like any place where I frequent enough that people start to recognize either me or know what I usually order.  I wish Starbucks wasn't so expensive, but that is not any of the workers' faults - I'm sure they wish their paychecks were larger, too.  

I don't think I have to say anything about the coffee.  This location gets full of college students during school season who are faceboo, err... studying.  

While I would love for you to be open 24 hours, my pocketbook would not.

Placed an order on the app and it said about 9 mins wait. I got there and still waited another 15 mins while they had a new girl working the morning rush. She made my drink wrong, didn't even stir it and didn't know what it meant when I said I wanted almond milk. They could at least train the new people at a less busy time. She also only filled my cup about halfway. I will be contacting them.

Incredibly long line at 10:30 in the morning. I can deal with that. Incredibly slow service compared to other Starbucks. Employees trying their hardest. Management needs to staff appropriately and analyze efficiency for operation. I am now on 30 minute wait and no signs of my coffee coming out soon. Worse yet, a manager had an employee in the corner coaching her on this and that for 20 min. There is a time and place for coaching but not when u are this slammed. 

Update. Now on 45 minutes waiting. In-freaking-believable

Oof - this location is severely understaffed. You would think a 2,500+ attendee conference at the JW Marriott would call for more staff, but quite the opposite. 9:30 on a Monday morning with one person working the register and the other one doing drinks/sandwiches by herself. 

The line grew and grew and was easily 50+ people deep. It took me a solid 30 minutes to get a breakfast sandwich and water. When I walked by mid-afternoon, the line only had five people, so maybe it was just a timing issue. Still...

If you're at the JW for a early morning meeting/conference, I suggest finding your coffee source elsewhere unless you're willing to wait in line a long time. 

*Note that they charge for H20, even if your order in a Sbux cup.

This Starbucks is never as crowded as many others...

Don't worry, it still serves the same highly caffeinated beverages as the rest.

Driving home to South Bend after a day at Indy, I was parched. Seeing the friendly Starbucks logo at the off ramp I jumped off I65 with my mind set on a Grande VB Frapuccino.  All I can say is that I finally found the world's worst Starbucks. Surly barristas who clearly did not enjoy being there. I brought in my empty coffee cup from the morning run only to find there wasn't even a trash can in the place. I had to dispose of it at the gas station next store. What clinched it for me was after making my way back onto I65, I reached for my drink, took a sip and got nothing but ice and air!  They left out the liquid!  The drink was nothing but whipped cream and crushed ice!  I was frosted to say the least. How this place survived the downsizing is beyond me.  Never again.

My near work go to Starbucks.  I like this place, the morning staff is friendly and make my lattes right.  They have great memories, after stopping in a few times, they remembered my name and what I like to drink (grande latte) , and I appreciate that touch of humanity when I am patronizing a corporate coffee house.  

Yes, there is no drive thru.  Why this is a problem, I don't know, because it doesn't take any *less* time to get your coffee going through the drive through than it does to walk in the door.  If you are too lazy to walk 20 feet from your parking space to the door, maybe you need to reconsider the path your life took that makes that trek too inconvenient for you.  Yes, I am chastising people on the internet for being lazy.  Deal with it.
Slow service and usually backed up. They usually get my long order right so it's not that much of a bad thing. Try to come when you have an extra new minutes before your flight.
Love this Starbucks! Super close to my house and always awesome drinks. Really hard to drive in and out of but I know that's not their fault.
Simply the best way to get the morning going. Venti Soy Green Tea Sweetened.
930 on a Sunday, walked straight up to register to place my order, then waited 25' for a chai latte.

Just like any other Starbucks out there, friendly staff, enough room for everybody and most of all it's so close to my house! I normally have Vanilla Latte, Hot Choc or Mocha, but today I had Iced Shaken and sweetened passion tea lemonade and I love it. I guess I will sticking to it for some time till I'm ready for something new.

This is a great newer location. The staff has been friendly every time I've been. And, of course, the drinks are always good. 

If you like pumpkin spice lattes try it with half n half and vanilla. You'll be addicted.

This Starbucks is nothing special, but they've never messed up my drink or food orders before.  It's a small little set up right in the middle of kingsway mall and it can get pretty busy during the day. If you're in a hurry, there's another Starbucks in target that would probably be less of a wait/line. The good thing is this Starbucks usually opens at 7:30am, well before the mall does.
Coffee and staff are nice. But the lines here are abominable. Plan a minimum 10 mins during the week in the morning.

The customer service was really great. Fast and
 Friendly. Professional.

Only problem- didn't seem like the manager was paying attention to the needs of the store. 

Please see pic of barrel of over-ripe bananas. They were starting to smell.   If you don't want bananas- you're good.  But again, they were starting to decay.

The drive thru trash can is back after 3 years!! 

The drive thru moves a little slower these days but the consistency of the coffee has improved. I know this was a concerted effort on Starbucks part.

Why not have this group trained by the Paoli folks? They are friendly and efficient!!!

The drive thru was full, so I pulled in to park as the lot was empty. Thought I could just run in and run out...no drinks, just a spinach wrap.

Devon is friendly, too friendly. There were 2 people in front of me...one was ordering when I arrived...4" later, he left the register area! Then the woman in front of me ordered and there was more clever conversation. All this chatting and 2 more people behind me waiting. 

I was present to retrieve my wrap,thankfully.  The girl was so busy talking, she never got my name. Grrrrrrrr!


When I pulled out of the lot, the last car in the drive thru lane when I arrived, was in front of me leaving!

come on people, chat when it not busy....but if you have a line, let's move it alone. Its called Customer Service! Ask Paoli, they can do both!

Spent the entire day here recently.  I came in bright and early at 8 am and found some prime real estate against the wall next to where orders are picked up.  It was a great spot to do all my people watching as I worked, and I thoroughly enjoyed watching the good beautiful people of Tennessee make their way in and out.  Staff was very friendly and helpful and the cafe was clean and tidy.  Music was very good, provided a nice mix that enabled me to take my big headphones off and give my ears a rest  while still enjoying fine music as I basked in the ambiance.  Top notch locale, for reasons I can't say here, my favorite Starbucks ever!

The staff here doesn't have ANY sense of urgency. It's so frustrating to watch 7 people waiting for coffee, 10 still needing to order, and the employees talking amongst themselves distracted and uninterested in customer service. Can't stand this Starbucks.

Look for what it is, this Starbucks is great. Located on the first floor of the Marriott, this coffee house serves hotel guests, office workers, City Hall employees, SEPTA employees, and tourists down to see Reading Terminal market or City Hall. This all translates into foot traffic and high volume.
Short of adding a Wawa style self order kiosk, this place does all it can to maintain a high level of customer service. I've seen in 4 occasions free samples offered to entertain guests waiting for their orders to come up. That said, as mentioned by other yelpers, save yourself the time if you're in a rush and order on the app.
The drinks are usually served properly here. There is seating available however I wouldn't recommend planning on getting work done here. It's kind of cramped, and you're better served by visiting the Starbucks on Chestnut if you're planning on studying or working remotely. But if you just need a place to warm up or scratch your eyes open while catching up on emails on your phone, this venue can accommodate you.
For the volume of people, these guys do a great job of staying cheery and making customers feel at home. If you want in and out service use the app.

Note: I promise I'll come back and write an overall review of this Starb, because most of the employees here are great, but this particular barista was so rude, I feel compelled to highlight this experience:

As a Starb addict and daily patron, I know I'm bound to run into poor service from time to time. At lunchtime, as the only customer in the store awaiting a drink, the barista hands me my "no foam" tall latte with1/3 the cup full of foam. I ask her if she can remove the foam for me. She's already put off and wordlessly takes the cup back. She scrapes off the foam and returns the cup to me - without filling the cup up. So now, I just have 2/3 of a latte. 

Me: "Can you fill the cup with more soy?"
Barista C: "No, that's all the soy there is." 
Me: "There's no more soy in the store?"
Barista C: HEAVES A SIGH. "Well, it'll be a few minutes."
GIVES ME ANNOYED LOOK.
Me: "Sorry, it's just that I always order my drink with no foam."
Barista C: "Well, I am not here every day." 
Me: (Admittedly with a bit of sarcasm at this point) "I'm sorry this is so much trouble for you."
Barista C: EYEROLL. "It's fine." 

So, let's recap. First she makes my drink wrong. No big deal. But then she tries to lie and tell me there is no more soy. THEN, she proceeds to give me dirty looks and essentially tell me it's not her fault because she is not there every day. Never once did she so much as say she was sorry, or even just give me a pleasant smile. 

I'm just so floored by the entire exchange. Maybe I do have a very particular way I like my drink, but given that I spend nearly $1,500 annually at Starb (YIKES), I think it's ok that I have a preferred drink.
