Absolutely hate the remodel they did. I was excited when I saw it was closed for remodeling because this has been a regular stop for me during the week on the way to the office. But no more. The result of the remodel is rows of low small round tables with iron chairs elbow to elbow with everyone. Think middle seat on an airplane without the cushion. Just no longer feels like a place where I can relax over coffee a meal and the morning news on my I pad. Guess I will be looking for a new morning stop; Panera or Brugers perhaps.

Very slow drive in.  Classic Starbucks, great latte hot stuff.  Frappicino was also made to prefection if you can stand the drive in wait.  Barista also looks like the dude from breaking bad.http://www.chateauresort.com/default.aspx?pg=home#content

Game of chance that I'm no longer willing to play with due to their high prices .. sometimes your coffee will taste burnt , sometimes it will taste only like milk and then few times it's actually delicious. No longer will be coming to this location. Some of the staff their are actually really friendly though and remember me by name which is sweet .
Really slow service.  Luckily only 3 people in line but still took 10mins.  God only knows what happens when they get busy.

This location is quite hit and miss.  I don't recommend the drive thru here plus it's an inconvenient parking lot if you're trying to grab a quick cup of joe.

That being said, if you're meeting a friend for a leisurely coffee date, this location might be the right one for you!  Slower paced and not very busy.

Visited this Starbucks this morning, and I was beyond impressed. The gentleman at the drive thru window was very personable and polite. He definitely made my morning a little bit brighter. Drive thru workers are typically too busy to actually talk to the customer, but this gentleman took an extra minute out of his morning to make sure I had a good day. I really appreciate that as a customer. I will be back to this location for sure!!

Came in three straight days while staying at the nearby Residence Inn and was able to get my wife's favorite coffee(Peppermint White Mocha) right every morning and my daughter was equally happy with her Frap Mocha. Even with a line was able to get in and out less than ten minutes. I had the artisan bacon breakfast sandwich and exactly what I expected. Just wished they had a drive through.

Christmas is coming to the Greenwood Mall and as always this past Saturday was Hectic! (Especially during Starbucks Red Cup event with the buy one get one free!) This location is small, but does a good job keeping up with the rush. Bonus- it is located right next to the nicest mall restrooms so when the caffeine calls, you are good to go! They have a great spread of the Starbucks merchandise and are located right across from Teavana if you need a free sample to top it off with!
I love going to this location.  The staff are always friendly they're fast and they all seem to be happy when they are working.  Probably one of the friendliest in the city.

One of the newer Starbucks on Swan/Ft. Lowell. Very open and bright. Love the cool open blue ceilings. Staff is very nice and greets everyone. I had a tall mocha frap. Needed it today.  This location is so much nicer than the one up the street.
Service is very fast and friendly. Order is always correct and served with a smile. Only downside is that I wish they were open 24 hours. I do work nights across the street so that would be awesome.

This Starbucks is probably my favorite in the West Chester/Exton area.  Service is always quick, friendly, and consistent.  The seating area is small, but always clean and organized.  If there is a downside, it's that the parking lot is too small and always full.  Although that makes it tough, if you wait long enough you'll find a spot.
To the girl who worked the window today, you truly made my day significantly better! Top notch customer service!
located in a strip mall in Montecito it's a larger Sbx - the emplyees are genuinely nicew and the clients are kooky!
Great location and typically busy. The baristas are quick filling orders and friendly. They have plenty of space for studying or hanging out. The outdoor space is my favorite.
wonderful service and very quick!

Quite possibly the slowest Starbucks, at least of the ones I've been too. On average around 7-730am on weekday mornings there is a continuous line of 4-5 customers waiting. There are three employees working. It takes around 10 minutes to receive your drink. I wish the service was better. Often times I go out of my way to a different location or another coffee shop.

I ordered a drink with light ice.  I got a cup FULL of ice. The blonde manager looking lady tells me ice amount determined by ice scooper used. Uhh, then why is my cup full? There was no attempt to correct my complaint.

Close to home, but I usually visit my store in University City on the way to work. So, this store I visit on the weekend when we don't go to Regency Cafe in Landsdowne. Stopped today and was reminded how friendly the staff is! For how infrequently I visit this store, the barista remembered my drink. Well done!!

The Butler campus Starbucks is always hoppin'! It's THE place for students to congregate and meet up for group projects and study. The lines can get long sometimes, especially in a break between classes (usually near the top of the hour), but it ebbs and flows.

Lots of space inside at four tops, two seaters, and comfy chairs, plus an expansive patio area outside. But, even with all that seating, sometimes it's hard to find a spot. 

Also conveniently connected to the bookstore and a small "computer lab" area with a printer for your working needs. 

Free guest/open wifi as well!

I really like this location and the people are friendly at the window.  Today I went inside to get my coffee. The restroom was dirty. Trash over flowing and a diaper was stuffed in the tampon small box sticking out. The service was slow. They forgot my second item and had to wait longer.  Next time I will use the drive through.

The staff here is amazing. I frequently go in the morning on weekdays and it is chaotic! People are angry and impatient and the volume of orders the staff has to fill is outrageous. They are always kind and positive. I think they could benefit from a bigger store or more employees but I think they're doing great with what they have!

One of the best Starbucks in the area. 

Pros:
Consistently good drinks.
Friendly, helpful staff.
Clean store.
Drive thru is partially shaded most of the day.
Starbucks Coffee Master (black apron) on staff.

Only partial con:
Weird parking lot at this complex. Watch out for Wendy's drive-thru exiting by Starbucks' drive-thru entrance.
Despite this Starbucks always being busy, the baristas always do a great job. I also dig the comfy leather chairs.
The morning staff is fast friendly and consistent. Pretty much how your typical starbucks should be

They are wonderful! They know all the regulars by name and they remember your order every-time. There is sometimes a long line but they are so quick you very have to wait too long. Coffee is great for the bucks
I go to starbucks 2, sometimes 3 times a week and this location is probably my favorite around. The staff is always extremely nice and the wait is never that long. Thanks for being great!

I'm the former loyal Starbucks customer who you made late to work this morning. This Starbucks used to be good until this past year. I am never going here again. Despite now anticipating at least a 20 minute wait in the drive-thru, you have failed on numerous occasions to provide a cup of coffee in 20 minutes. Today it was more than 25 minutes. I could not even leave the line of cars because I was stuck. It was just a cup of brewed coffee, not even an espresso drink and I waited at the window... hostage after paying for my drink... for 7 minutes before I decided to just leave. This is the second time that this Starbucks has done this to me. Their current management is inconsistent and performance has definitely suffered. Their employees are disorganized but I blame management because they seem understaffed and confused. After 6 years of being a daily patron of this Starbucks, I am taking my loyalty elsewhere. They won't care but at least I won't pay to suffer their wait any longer.

I guess this pace was okay as far as a Starbucks goes, i mean I didn't have any issues with my order... but it was crowded. The real turn off was when I discovered that the crowd consisted mainly of students from Westmont...and the last place on earth I want to be in in a room full of students from a Private Christian College...seriously, what kind of education is that? I'll hit the another location next time.

So this is the Starbucks in Tampa's F terminal, which happens to be a Starbucks reserve! They have the reserve clover-brewed coffee. Ultimately it was a little disappointing because I mistakenly thought all reserve locations also had the nitro cold brew. I didn't snap a picture but it seems like they've also significantly downsized from their renovation a year ago? There wasn't any Starbucks-specific seating and I felt squished waiting in line for my drink. Other than that it was on-par with any other location.

Generally I go to the Starbucks close to work, not home. But I was in the mood for a tea on my day off. I am a generally happy person and get along with everyone in service, as I understand that it's not the best job. I, however, expect at least somewhat friendly service.
I went into this location yesterday and there was a familiar face mopping the floor. I apologized that I was interrupting her and that I could order from afar so I didn't mess anything up. She very rudely responded "Well you're going to have to pay, aren't you?". I don't think that was called for at all, so I walked to the counter where she made minimal eye contact and continued being sassy with her co worker. 
As for my drink, it was Starbucks. Nothing more or less.

Smaller than most Starbucks but was efficient in getting out drinks. Hubs got a green tea and it was normal :) I got a icedCarmel macchiato and it is probably the best I have ever had. Coconut milk I think enhanced the espresso and did not leave me with any after tastes or film. I don't think I have ever tasted the espresso in previous macchiatos I have had. Good job ;)
Service is always as soon as you walk in and the staff is professional and courteous. Store is always very clean, everyone working looks happy. Drinks could def be made quicker.
Pretty busy place with longer than average wait time... Happened a few times. Drive through is ok.

This is my favorite Starbucks when tooling around this area. The cashiers are friendly, the barista's can always make your drink exactly as you ordered it, and there is always an abundance of food items to choose from to go along with your drink. Plus, there is a wide variety in their selection of coffee beans and gift items.

It's a shame there aren't many unique coffee shops in this particular area. We are finding we do travel a lot more to find better shops (not Starbucks).

This particular Starbucks does a really good job. They get it right every time, and that caffeine always hits the right spot, especially when you have it with a scone. My favorites are the mini vanilla scone, the larger, blueberry scone, and the almond croissant, depending on my mood. In fact, I do like most of their pastries.

Always delicious, always hot, always satisfying. Mmmmmm.
Very friendly baristas. I never had any problems with my order. Clean store. Drive thru is a plus!
The staff looked like no one wanted to be there and the seating is not relaxing or very inviting.  They can make a decent drink no problem but the atmosphere is not what it could be

Always busy, always fresh.  First time I've noticed a board with pics of the variations on drinks.  Great idea.  It sold me on the Danica.  A blend of coffee, caramel.  Recommended for bold flavor.  Try it out!

I always try to avoid going here due to the ambience, smaller size(I feel claustrophobic in here) but end up going once in 2 weeks when I have craving for Starbucks coffee and this is the closest to where I stay.
Hard to find parking here although they do have a parking lot.
Staff is not very friendly and mix up orders couple of times( has happened twice for me).
Overall I would rather keep it  picking up online ordered coffee rather than sit here.

Zero would be the stars that I would give this location. They have always sucked and continue to suck. Staff don't care and clearly neither does the manager. I have never had a simple no foam latte done with no foam. Clearly there needs to be retraining, rehiring or a new manager. I go out of my way to avoid this location, It's not worth the frustration having to ask to get it redone or fixed. This location has had a problem for well over 15 years and sadly nothing has changed.

Don't waste your time ordering ahead on the app.. they don't have anything ready when you arrive. I ordered ahead and my order still wasn't ready 20 mins later.. I had a nail appt and had to just leave it. You're welcome for the 7$ tip.. for nothing.

You always expect it to be bad at an on-campus Starbucks but this one might just give others a run for their money. 

I have had extensive waits whether it be 30 mins for a cold brew that I have preordered through Tapingo (without cream, might I add) or for some hot tea which I don't get until the five people in line after me have already received their lattes and frappes. 

The staff is also very rude and have a lack of understanding. 


Do yourself a favor and skip this location.. order ahead to the Library location or take a walk to University instead. 
Anything. Is. Better. Than. This!!!
Not a lot of seating but they get my orders out in a timely manner.  Service is good and it is clean.

Very Rude person as a barista! Went up as others that came after had been served! And she just barked what are you looking for! Told her and she still proceeded to make as she wanted not requested. Very rude and very discriminated against! I didn't think that is the culture that Starbucks would like to be known for! Surprised For sure!

This is by far my favorite Starbucks to go to! Every time I come here, I'm met with friendly faces and quality drinks. This store can get a little busy, so occasionally the speed is a little slower, but I always Mobile Order and Pay if I'm in a hurry when I know they might be a little more busy. What really impresses me here is the quality of customer service. Everyone is always very welcoming and lovely to talk to. I also really appreciate how much seating this particular store has. I can go at almost any time of day and know I'll have somewhere to sit. There are even outlets outside by the doors, plus outlets all along the walls. I like coming here to do work on my computer for that very reason!

Drive thru not good. Everyday is the same. It's on my way to work so I stop here. If you have nothing to do but wait for a coffee, this is your place. By far the worst drive thru of any starbucks in Indy.  It's coffee not beef Wellington. Come on!
I have to update and add two other employees( man and woman) that I've been seeing in the drive thru during the morning because they are WONDERFUL!! It's a great start to my day because of these two!

Waited in line until it was my turn at the register only to be cut off by the attendant as she asked the guys behind me what they wanted. When I told her I had a drink order too she said "they work here". Really? So I ordered my drink and my pumpkin bread bit my tongue and moved on. The barista who made my drink was at least kind. She tried to help when I realized the register attendant had given me my bread refrigerator cold and still in the plastic wrapper. (I should have known when it was practically tossed at me.) The barista took it to be heated but the register lady repackaged it broken and in squashed pieces. At least it was warmed by that point? Seriously this is THE WORST Starbucks ever. The manager of this location needs to do a serious shakedown of the staff and their idea of service.
The best Starbucks!! The staff is always so warm and friendly!! Line gets long but it's a busy area so what can you do.

I like Debra who works the morning shift.  If she's not there, I turn around and leave.  Kroger cannot seem to keep staff to work the Starbucks in their store.  I also like Quincy but he's changed his hours to the afternoon.  So they have only two people that actually make the drinks they way they are supposed to be made and they remember what you order.

I don't what it is about this Starbucks - location, drive-thru or what, but it is always jumping! I went on a Wednesday at 7 pm, and a few days later on Saturday at 11:30 am, and both times the drive-thru line was long, the line in-store was long, and almost all of the seats were filled. On both trips the line moved quickly, and I was greeted with the wonderful trademark customer service that is expected from Starbucks. 

There's not much else to say, the service, drinks and food are consistent with other Starbucks across the city, but out of all the ones that I've visited, I'd have to say this is the best for people watching!
I frequent this location a lot when I am working at the mall.  I haven't had any bad experiences as of yet.  Staff is always friendly and my drink is always made to order.

I love this Starbucks. I come here almost everyday and order the same thing, it was a little sweet and they added whipped cream and regular caramel (which I don't like, just a little mistake, I like the dark caramel). Thankfully I was able to just walk in and request it a little less sweet and with no whipped cream or regular caramel !!! They made me a whole new one!!! This one is perfect like everyday. Thanks so much! Don't forget to tip!!! Sorry for bringing my drink back but it's so much better now !!! Love the staff here, always so nice ! I also love coming here because there is always a shady parking spot where I can smoke and drink my coffee while listening to music. Very clean restrooms also I might add.

I needed to use the bathroom at this location and for some reason I had to wait until an employee was free to escort me and open the door. This is not only embarrassing but dangerous for a 70y/o with limited control. The wait was 10 min. Needless to say I'll get my coffee elsewhere from now on!
Joshua was by and large the friendliest and most professional barista I've ever encountered.  Kudos! I don't live anywhere near this location but I'll certainly think about coming back again!
Good spot w drive thru and outdoor seating, but if you're coming here to do work, it seems to fill up fast in the morning, especially in winter months.
Pleasant Starbucks staff.  Really busy location once the high schools in the area let out for the day.  Staff is always really pleasant and accommodating.

We can never leave the mall without getting a few Starbucks for the kids and some hot tea for my husband.  I appreciate how they have some many different variety of drinks including caffeine free choices for kids.

This Starbucks location is very convenient to work & the University. However, it is ALWAYS packed, so it can be hard to find parking and/or seating depending upon what time you go. They have a nice outdoor patio area, and the inside is pretty large as well. My best experience,m has always been going through the drive-thru. I can't remember the one barista's name - she usually works drive-thru during the day - but she is always super friendly! I've also never received a messed-up order or drink from this Starbucks location before. Not that Starbucks messes up often, but it has happened a few times at different Starbucks before; not what you want when you are paying $6 for a coffee. I will continue to come back to this location, just because of how friendly the baristas are overall, as well as the speediness of the drive-thru, not matter how busy they are!
Slowest service with the most employees every. Single. Time. Most of the time they barely recognize the customers, smile, or more importantly address a long wait/line.
I haven't been here to verify but a fellow Elite member shared that this location now takes Starbucks cards now and gives stars. If true, that's progress.

Want to give this place a good review because of the friendly staff but in reality its not that good. My drinks never taste as good and the line always moves slow. I'll trek a block farther to the one on the Circle to get my Bucks fix while downtown.

Horrible horrible service!! I walked in to order a decaf black. The cashier wanted to know if it was a "decaf this" or a "decaf that". I just want a decaf. "Well no one ever orders decafs. That's going to take a while. You'll just have to wait! Is that OK with you?" Well, I guess I have no choice. So I sat down and waited and waited. Finally the cashier ( same one who took my order for the black decaf) calls out,  "Do you want room for cream?" Ugh, no, black means no room for cream.  Then the barista called out several minutes later, "Vente decaf!" I walk up, no decaf. I stand there for five minutes. Still no decaf. I go back and sit down for five minutes then finally I walk back to the counter and ask about the decaf they called me up for. " Oh I haven't started it yet". I kid you not, 20 minutes from placing my order to getting my coffee. That's ridiculous. The barista apparently knew I was unhappy so she got me back. She put the lid on so the drinking hole was on the crack and it would drip on my dress. Thank you. That was thoughtful. Had to drive home to change before going to work.

Sometimes I wish they'd add minus stars.  

I frequented this Starbucks while I stayed in Indianapolis big city with NOT such a small town feel.  Yes you see correctly, I changed the sentence there.  They are very rude here with all that covert racism.

Anyways.  Each visit to this location was during after peak hours.  In fact no one was in line.  Yet, they managed to be very rude and very slow every single time.

I love this place... it is my favorite Starbucks store!!!  I happen to love Starbucks... Terrible thing to admit, I know... But especially at this particular Starbucks, I always get great customer service and the employees always seem to actually ENJOY doing their job. Try finding that at other drive-thru's. The employees are are always very nice and quick to fix any problem I might have. They recognize me by face now--I usually go two or three times a week. I have to say that like most other people, I want to "fight the man" and give the local coffee shops a try. But I can tell you--I'm always disappointed with the other guy's coffee--I guess there's something to be said for big business because Starbucks just simply offers superior coffee. I hate to admit it, but I have yet to find a better cup of coffee anywhere... no matter how hard I try. I did give them only 4 out of 5 stars due to the expensive price. But I guess you get what you pay for.

"COFFEE COFFEE COFFEE COFFEE COFFEE" - I chant to myself while I drive down Damonte Ranch Parkway.  I am only three minutes away from my office but I'm not walking into work without my coffee.  

As I turn the corner coming out from the freeway underpass I pray that the line in the drive through isn't long.  

Sometimes the line looks like this:  "SON OF A B&%#CH"  
Sometimes the line looks like this:  "Whoo hoo!"

This Starbucks can be either incredibly busy or dead.  There is no rhyme or reason to it.  I have not been able to pin point a day of the week or a time of the day during which the peaks hit.  

That being said - the line always moves very quickly.  This morning I had 9 cars in front of me and I was out of the drive through in under 4 minutes.  The baristas are always smiling, they give you napkins without having to ask and the breakfast sandwiches are always cooked perfectly (other Starbucks location in the area like to burn them).

This is one of my favorite Reno locations for sure.

I give this location an A+.  Don't be afraid of the line.

Not very nice service. The young woman wanted to
close and not allow me to check out even though I was in line. I was just buying a prepacked food item. There were three people working. They couldn't help bc she had a tab open and was also making their drinks. It took approx 2 seconds to check me out with my sbux app after she closed her tab. She turned away other customers as well.

I get this Starbucks can be very busy and it is stressful for the people that work there, but when I went in it was not busy at all. Somehow the baristas still managed to take forever to make the drink, and they made the drink wrong. If you're going to take forever when it is slow at least make the drink right.

The rudest people I have met in a long time. When getting my order wrong asked if they would heat my muffin..Met with eye rolls and stomping off...asked for butter and oh my god you would have thought I asked her to go climb a mountain...be prepared to deal with this...and your expensive coffee will go down better

Went to this Starbucks on Friday afternoon. Only a handful of customers there. No one in line. I stood at the counter for two full minutes waiting to be served. Made eye contact with at least three of the employees none of which acknowledged me nor said they would be with me in a moment. Nothing.  Finally just sat down with my friend who apparently had fabulous service. 

I went back to the counter five minutes later and was finally served. 
Starbucks, you need to teach basic manners to your employees.
Computer issues, slowed drive thru to a stop.  This was at the Sheldon store...

In the mall on Saturday morning and needed a pick me up. Hit up this Starbucks for a tall chile mocha. The cashier was super friendly and asked if I had tried it before to which I  enthusiastically nodded yes and said I really like it. She said oh good because I'm not a fan and I wanted to let you know if you didn't like it we'd make you something else. I think that's great service especially at a tiny kiosk in a mall on a saturday morning when they are super busy!

Clean dining and bathroom areas.
Friendly staff.
They warmed our food up quickly.
Our drinks took a bit longer, strange since it was only iced coffee, but they came out perfect.

If they could schedule their staff a little better, this would definitely be a 5 star Starbucks for me.  The staff are super friendly and helpful.  And they have the nitro cold brew setup that most locations don't have.  They keep all their product well organized to be able to handle the rushes... if only they had enough staff.  This morning there was only one person on the till and one person making drinks - so the lineup grew very quickly.  there were also a bunch of mobile orders coming in that they had to try to keep up with.

Drinks are always made correctly... no complaints there.  But the wait is ridiculous when they get busy.

great customer service and they try really hard for the volume of customers they get.. would be 5 stars if i didnt have to listen to all the complaining entitled students that expect a drink in 5 seconds when they see a line out the door.. try the french pressed coffee, i didnt even know that was an option until some one at the other store on campus by the library told me about it when they didnt have to, worth the wait.

I have been going to this particular Starbucks in the morning for almost a year now and they are amazing. I use the mobile order app when I'm about 5 minutes out and 9/10 times it's ready for me to walk in and grab, I have never had to wait longer than the estimated wait time at this locatio. I may be jinxing myself but I have also NEVER had a bad coffee from this location. So to summarize, best coffee, best service and the fastest starbucks I have received since moving to Tennessee. Keep up the great work.
This Starbucks is soooo slow. They need a few more barista's to make drinks considering the amount of foot traffic they receive.
This new location is clean and pleasant, but the indoor chairs are unsuitable for larger guests, who have to hope for a comfy seat or go outside and hope for better.

Being a student at the U, and an employee at the bookstore, I pass by often, and sometimes go to get drinks myself. I used to go often during my freshman year. It'll be busy most days, most times. Go in the evening to avoid crowds or maybe early early morning. I went the other day and was told they don't take Apple Pay, though I heard from a few people before that they do take it. I scanned my card, but then they canceled the transaction - or so I thought. Turns out I was charged anyways! Staff are pretty friendly though, except for 1 or 2 I've seen. Not really clean because so many customers come in and out.

Edit: Apple Pay problem was finally fixed!

I love that they have a drive through! I work in the area and it's very quick and convenient to just pass through. My favorites are the pink drink, caramel macchiato (with an extra shot when I need one lol), and the almond milk cinnamon macchiato! So delicious I know it's new but I hope they keep it around. If you have the Starbucks app you can place your order ahead of time and that way it's ready when u get their to pick it up fast. And when I'm hungry my favorite treats are the birthday cake flavored cake pops or the rice Krispy squares. I come here at least twice a week and have never had an issue, the drive thru line moves pretty fast and it gets me caffeinated on time! Thanks Starbucks!
This location is quick and decent. However it's always busy inside. There's seating available outside too on a nice day.

Wow, first off, I would have to say that I will never ever return to this location ever again! The past few times my ice caramel macchiato have been terrible. I'm aware if your drink doesn't taste right, they will remake it for you. Sure, that's fine but it's not worth it when you're going through the drive thru and you've already driven off. Anyways, today (04/27/15) I decided to go inside and order. The girl didn't look to excited to be at work today, she was all attitude from the start. I told her what I wanted and asked if they could pull the expresso shots correctly. The barista (pale white skin with a black crochet scarf/hairband) had a very rude attitude said "what do you mean? Do you mean pour it in the cup correctly". I had mention that the past few times I've been here my coffee tasted burnt. And she rolled her eyes and apparently didn't understand the Starbucks lingo. She continue to argue with me but I told her to forget it and I walked out. You would think that Starbucks would train their staff well and make them knowledgable on their products, coffee, machines, etc...but this girl was all attitude. If you're not happy with your job, go find something else. If you're having a bad day, don't take it out on customers. A matter of fact tell your manager that you shouldn't be speaking to customers today.

This location is alway quick and accurate. Which is not always the case with other Starbucks in town. Love that they brought back the sous vide red pepper egg bites. I know it's supposed to be a healthier option, but I prefer to get it with a croissant to make a perfectly delightful indulgent breakfast sandwich. Paired with a warm cuppa tea, this is a heavenly treat.

Unfortunately this location has lost its MoJo expediting my much needed Jo! Super slow, the poor staff seems so stressed and overwhelmed, mobile orders are usually lost, drive through is more like a wait through. This location used to be really good, don't know what happened oh and they consistently run out of 'something' and it takes up to a week to get it in.

This Starbuck's at the northeast corner of 6th and Olive Streets is the only downtown St. Louis Starbuck's that is not in a hotel. It is one of the four Starbucks in downtown St. Louis.

  When I am on vacation, I like to explore and I like to relax. My dad and bro are the same way. It is in these Starbuck's that I got to enjoy quality time with my dad and bro. In all honesty, Starbuck's might not be the greatest coffee in the world. Personally I prefer Dunkin Donuts and Coffee Bean. Regardless their product is very good coffee. Along with their very good coffee, Starbuck's provides modern and comfortable hang out establishments that are known as the third-place. This was an ideal spot to sit with my dad and brother while sharing entertainment and sports news with our devices charging up in their outlets with complimentary Wi-Fi.

  We visited this Starbucks twice in the mid morning. One visit was after the Embassy Suites Breakfast reception. I am not a fan of hotel coffee, and decided to wake up with Starbuck's in my cup. The other visit was after Pharoah Donuts. What is neat about Starbuck's near a donut shop is that the consumer benefits from a delicious pastry that is far better than the one in Starbuck's with a quality cup of coffee. If the donut shop is a hole in the wall with limited seating such as Pharoah Donuts, Starbuck's provides the customer with an enjoyable spot to delight in the donut(s).  Me, the consumer benefitted from this.

 The tall (in Starbucks parlance small) coffee that was competively priced to other Starbucks at $2.33 tasted just as good as a Starbuck's coffee that I would sip in Las Vegas. The service was decent. And speaking of service, you need to ask the Barista the code for the restroom. 

  This Starbuck's has a downtown vibe. There were a sundry of downtown workers in and out of the building. It is a corner storefront at the base of a historic building. As I write this, construction cranes are very gradually transforming the immediate blocks around this downtown coffee shop from urban blight to a revitalizated neighborhood where historic buildings are being incorporated into homes. Along this stretch of Olive Street it seemed that the crane is more popular than the cardinal.

   The two times that we started off our days here were prerequisites to downtown adventures. Rejuvenated with very good coffee, conversation, and in my case during one visit two very good donuts; we'd walk the city streets and parks to the western preiphery of downtown at St. Louis Union Station.
A Starbucks in the Brewery District - what a surprise! Pretty good location - a spacious, bright area with lots of laptop-friendly tables.
Standard Starbucks. I think they are over priced in my opinion, but the coffee is good enough

Unlike some of the other reviews for this location, I'm not going to slam them for how busy they are. Actually that is one of their pros in my book. Yes they have long lines. Some days I'd even guess that there are 50 people in line and 20 people that have already ordered and are waiting for their drinks. Considering how many people are in line, I think they do a good job keeping things moving.

What I am going to slam them for is their drink consistency issues. Just because the place is slammed does not mean corners should be cut and quality should decrease. 

After a few incorrectly made drinks, I quickly learned to order drinks without any changes (I'm not talking about which kind of milk). By changes I means adding an extra shot of caramel, or substituting one ingredient for another. Also, god forbid  you ask for a sugar in your drink because they won't do it. You'll just have to put it in yourself (which isn't the worst thing in the world).

The one thing they did that really annoyed me was ruin my hot tea. I didn't think anyone could ruin tea. You get hot water and put a bag in it. It normally takes about 2 seconds to make it. Which is why I knew something was wrong when it was taking much longer than usual. It turns out the the barista read the cup incorrectly and gave me a tea latte. Now, I didn't have time to make a fuss, but from that point on I watch them like a hawk and really emphasize the point that I just want HOT TEA, not a HOT TEA LATTE.
WORST STARBUCKS STORE, EVER. If you want to wait for a cup of coffee for 15 minutes and not able to enjoy, please stop by.!!!!!

Staff here is super friendly the one women and one man that work mornings are so kind and have such a casual caring relationship with their customers and try to remember everyones name which is crazy how good these two are at remembering customers since it is a busy fast paced location and i have only ever had my order wrong but it was 5am on a friday and i got a pumpkin chia latte but was given a pumkin latte which is an easy mistake she probably miss heard me through the drive thru and i think she was new but was so sweet and apologetic and fixed it right away i never understood the Starbucks craze until going to this location i recommend the pumpkin chia latte and cinnamon dolce cream steamer they are my addiction this winter

Got the CHORIZO SANDY today and it was so disgusting! Took the chorizo off and ate it with just the egg because I was so hungry... and now my stomach feels like its being ripped apart. 
Other than that This is a good location, come here quite a bit to get my coffee and cake pop fix.

First time I've ever been in a Starbucks where I asked the "barista" if a particular coffee would be good over ice and she replied with a shrug, "I don't know, I've never tried it." I get that not every Starbucks employee has tried every coffee they sell, but I can't believe she didn't ask someone else or at least feign interest. It turned out, the coffee was good, and service was polite enough; but this is not consistent with the usual Starbucks experience. Disappointing.

Disappointing experience at this Starbucks location. I'm an airline pilot and I visit a different Starbucks location nearly everyday. I always order a decaf americano. The last two days at this location the shots of expresso were smaller and not as strong as I'm accustomed to. I mentioned my concern to the barista and I was told the expresso machine was working just fine even though the shot glasses were only partially full on a number of servings. The americano I was served was notably weaker and not as flavorful as I usually get. At Starbucks, consistency is the name of the game. Unfortunately, not all locations are achieving the high standards of excellence and customer service I've come to expect.

They ran out of ice. Not much more to say besides the rude customer service to go with it. I asked if they had anymore Double Smoked Bacon Sandwiches or if they were out too & was given the response, "Well does that have ice?"

Stopped by for a caramel latte which is my usual. Service was excellent, I mean extremely curteous. Coffee was good as always. It's spacious but lacking at the same time. There were no seats available because it's located around a busy shopping plaza. Therefore, you are competing with shoppers and frequent sitters who have unofficially adopted Starbucks as their hobby.

Anything Starbucks makes my heart skip a beat. Love the vibe, love the atmosphere love the drinks. Always good and always relaxing. Don't have time guess what there is a drive through. Also a free parking lot. Getting on the lot is a struggle but it's worth it.
All employees are very nice and helpful. I go there daily.  This is a busy store. They always seem ti get people in and it quickly. Don't have to wait in line long at all.

I think this is the nicest Starbucks I've ever been too! It looks like it was recently renovated ans shiny sparkling new. I was pretty surprised to find it done up in such a rustic style, comfy couches, different shape of chairs. It's very restoration hardware. 
Can't comment much on service and food quality. I was here at 7pm and it was dead. My order was taken quickly and served just as fast. 
As for the coffee, well, I try to avoid Starbucks at all costs and don't think it would be fair for me to review based on that. 
My review is strictly based on the "looks".

I love this location, everyone is always nice and has a smile on their face even when they're crazy busy. I go here all the time, I feel so comfortable and welcomed. Yesterday was my birthday and there was a problem with the app not coming up with my birthday treat, however two baristas looked it up for me and then gave me the drink for free and were very polite and professional. Every time I come in they always greet me and some of them even know me by name

This place is always busy. Half of the staff were standing around talking. Two of the girls were distracted by some guy talking to them. I saw my drink ready and the lady proceeded to stand right next to it for about 5 minutes. All she had to do was put the lid on. I wouldn't recommend if you're in a rush. My order was fine it just took so long to get something simple.

The Good: consistency

The Bad: not for people that want to "drink in" on location. In the morning you will wait in line forever as all their workers prioritize mobile orders over people in line. Even the "cashier" will work  five mobile orders in between every person in line while those in line just stand there and get angrier.  Two people in line behind me striking up a conversation and complaining about the same thing. They may as well just make it a drive trough or mobile pick up only place..

Anyone who has seen and/or read my posts on Coffee shops knows one of my biggest pet peeves is there is never any comfortable chairs to sit and chat and visit with your friends. This place actually has a comfortable seating area along with the typical hard tables and chairs. My challenge still is the way the sitting is placed. When you go to sit, your in a small area with 3 strangers and I feel I have to sit next to my friend in order to hear them, rather than across the room. There's a patio outside and the usual menu. 

Anyway, maybe Starbucks is finally hearing that some of the customers are already graduated (3X since H.S.) I just wanna sit and visit with my colleagues and enjoy my coffee!

Now, There's another new location that looks inviting out in Oro Valley, I cant wait to check that out one out next.

I love Starbucks...IT doesn't matter to me which location...Any and all are Great for me!!
Caramel Macchiato GRANDE is my favorite..but there are so many that I have tried and liked. 
I enjoy the comfortable feel of the locations. I enjoy just sitting there sipping on my drink enjoying my laptop or android tablet. 
Sometimes I just like to sit and read my kindle while I enjoy the peace...much like a library but you can drink here..lol!!

some say that they are going to start serving alcohol..I don't like that Idea personally. I don't want it to turn into a bar atmosphere..If they get into this business they need to branch off and name is something else ...
Anyway, I enjoy Starbucks!!

So happy that there was a great Starbucks drive-thru to hit when I was on my way to try the delicious Shapiro's Deli. The Circle Tour lady got a big Starbucks drink as part of her tip; I finally got a nice strong cup of java, as opposed to the muddy water that passes for coffee at some hotels.

This was an expansive Starbucks and not cramped at all. A decent parking lot and generous interior. I am so used to that terrible confining feeling that most California Starbucks suffer from. Not here.

Nice friendly employees also. However, 1 YELP STAR deducted for a very nasty bathroom experience. One thing you can generally count on, in addition to the fabulous coffee, is a decent potty. So surprised to see that this bathroom here was in a total state of disaster: over-flowing trash, paper towels scattered all over the floor, and NO toilet paper at all. But that's what seat covers are for in emergencies. I pointed this out nicely to the barista when I got a refill and he promptly mentioned it to the manager so I'm sure the bad bathroom was attended to.

But Starbucks needs to realize a good clean bathroom is a symbol of how the brand is perceived in addition to their high end coffee and convenient drive-thru's. It should not take some out-of-state tourist like me to point out the TP is gone and the trash cans are full in the Starbucks throne room.

NEVER HAVE ENOUGH FOOD OR WORKERS. Every time I come here the line is out there door solely due to the fact that there is nobody working the cash register sufficiently. They never have any hot food which is very frustrating considering majority of the students who use the Starbucks in the library need study break snacks. I strongly recommend the manager of this branch reevaluates their system of staff and product ordering. Very frustrating.

The service is lackluster, slow, and just not good.  In a prime place like this should be doing so much more.  It seems like this place is on the decline at least with the people running the place.  

The employees are more interested in serving their own coffee rather than serving customers.  I come in and they take my order, the guy hollers the order and the barista states "I got it", then she proceeds to make herself a drink and take a break.  I others are just standing around and having a conversation with each other.

My drink and others were just waiting to be made, so I had to ask them to make my drink.  Then they give me a look like I had the audacity to ask for the drink that I actually paid for.

This place is terrible.

They play great music at this Starbucks. 
Really good service. 
Comfy chairs inside and a nice outside seating  make it  a little nicer than all the  Starbucks in this area, but it is still just ok.

I'm not going to tell you anything about Starbucks you don't already know.  But I regularly stop into the Edmondson Pike location, and have never been let down.  It's not the sexiest SB I've ever seen, but in my experience the service is good, the coffee is hot (or iced, whatever), and the wi-fi is free.  There is plenty of outdoor seating, and the parking lot is huge.

This is an excellent Starbucks in terms of inventory.  Unfortunately, there is an African American woman with a deep voice who works there who insists on CONSTANTLY inflicting 120 decibels of her voice on all who decide to give their business to the franchise, disturbing those who come to experience some reasonably quiet co-presence with others.  Unfortunately, she belts out her voice constantly, and there is no relief from it whatsoever.  Management, at whatever level (regional or otherwise), should get her to stop (consistently) or get another job.  Unbelievably rude and inconsiderate.  Consequently, much better atmosphere at the Spring House Starbucks, which is nowhere close by.
They always get my order right but I wish they had more tables because this place is always poppin' and there's not enough room to study. The baristas are so kind and always welcoming!

Sat outside for 15 minutes waiting for my mobile order pick-up ($14) and I never saw anyone inside. This is 40 minutes after they opened. Tried calling. Nothing. Took videos if you want to see them. I want my money back right now.

This Starbucks is comparable to all of the others. I happen to really like Starbucks -- the quality, the consistency, etc. You get all of that at this store. The only reason I gave this Starbucks a four instead of a five is its location and the layout/size of the store. It's situated on a corner in Clay Terrace and as such, if you're just popping in, it's hard to get to.  You end up having to park somewhat far away and it gets crowded inside because of the weird angular shape of the store. But mostly that's just me being picky. It's up to par with all other Starbucks and I'll certainly visit again.

This location is so convenient for me because it is right near Center Square and it is on the way to many places that I go. The staff here is friendly and the service is quick. Their strawberry Frappuccino is so good especially with extra strawberry syrup. They have nice places to sit while you work too. I would definitely recommend this Starbucks and it's nice that they have a good place to get drinks in this center because my experience with Nektar juice bar was terrible.

Allow extra time if your headed to this Starbucks, gotta be one of the slowest in town.  I do drive through and order only already brewed coffee (Pike), but still wait long periods (10 min at the window earlier this week) for someone to even come to the window and take my money.    Not especially busy at 6:30 am but boy are they slow.  I think I'll purchase a coffee maker (I'm on extended work stay) and brew my morning coffee in my hotel room.  The coffee isn't that good to have to deal with this kind of frustration so early in the am

I can't go a day without having my Starbucks. I literally run on Starbucks amazing, yummy, delicious, coffee. Depending on my mood I like to switch up what I get, or I just order the same thing. My go to drink is probably green tea frap with raspberry syrup in it!! I love how this Starbucks is so big inside and outside!! The inside seating is so nice and peaceful, and the outside is just the same. You can't go wrong with sitting in or outside. The workers are really friendly, and accommodate whatever need it is to have.

It's rare to see a corporate environment like Starbucks to have a small business, friendly attitude. I went in with a friend and was met with the wonderful service of Jim.  If you can go when Jim is there please do yourself a favor and go in, you will not be disappointed.

I don't really know what to say about Starbucks.   The coffee is overpriced and okay I guess. The espresso has no crema and just tastes like dark coffee.  Stopped here on out way out for the drive back to Phoenix.   

I am really picky with coffee because I make the best at home.  Convenient only because they are on every corner.   Only go here when I absolutely have to.
This is a lovely, spacious and clean Starbucks. They have lots of space and a large variety of seating options.

Most of the time, the employees here are nice. Today, we weren't greeted by the person at the counter until she finally stood behind the register after a minute and stared at us. Yes, you will get some "dismissive" from the lady who hates her job. Majority of the staff is good, though, and quick.

I don't give many 1-star reviews, but this place is the slowest Starbucks...wait, let me rephrase...the slowest coffee shop I've ever been at in my life. Cashier/manager was pleasant, but it took fourteen minutes to get through the line as they had ONE inept barista working
After messing up everyone's orders I got my order caramel frappe but they forgot the caramel and sugar. My second time going to this one and second time they messed it up

If you must find a coffee shop near downtown, but not deep in the flustercluck of it all and appreciate not having to pay for parking, this is a good choice. The staff is friendly and keeps the place tidy. The place is frequently packed. In the summer, lots of outdoor seating. Peak times are a pain in the backside due to size and configuration of the parking lot.

This Starbucks is friendly and clean. Each drink and food item that I purchased was served with a smile and tasted great. I am not giving this Starbucks a 5/5 because it didn't have any qualities that stood out from other Starbucks or coffee shops. Over all experience was good!
Employees were nice enough to offer a homeless person sleeping here for several hours a drink of water or a cup of coffee.

This is my first time being here and most definitely my last!! The employee at the register didn't seem to know what he was doing. I ordered a venti hazelnut iced coffee with cream. PRETTY SIMPLE! I then received my drink which looked like it was just milk. When I tasted it it tasted like milk and hazelnut, no coffee? I asked the barista if there was  coffee in it and he said "yes didn't you get a latte?" I told him my actual order then he remade it but I still paid more money for a drink I didn't order.

This location is by the high way and supposedly getting the fast service, but it is not , nobody service in the front and I know they are open ! Sugar and cream station is dirty, seem no body clean the station for a while !

My second visit and the second time I have been delighted with my service!! I love the space in this Starbucks! Lots of tables and lots of space to have a private conversation. I'm grateful I live near by as this is quickly becoming my favorite location!
Everyone is so friendly here and Starbucks team is great and friendly free tall lattes cold or hot for the pop up 1-2 today at this location long lines but everyone seems friendly

This place is your average Starbucks.

It does not have a drive thru and does not carry Starbucks Reserve coffees.

The inside is pretty small with not a lot of seating. If you're planning on hanging out with friends inside, you should pick a different Starbucks.

This place is often crowded because it is attached to a Wal-Mart. It stays pretty busy, but their outdoor seating is nice and their baristas are consistently very friendly.

I use this Starbucks for occasional meetings, but most often I just stop in for a quick coffee to go.
I got a Frappuccino because it's super hot out today; not only is my drink delicious but the employees here were so kind and friendly!
Local kids, sweet attitudes. Very helpful and make you feel like family. Love this Starbucks!

Disclaimer - I ran the Honolulu airport Starbucks overnight shift for a few months several years ago.

Why do they train their employees to swirl the F'ing cold drinks!!?? When they do liquid gets in the rim of the F'ing lid and it will drop in you. Maybe that's why I got so many tips from the flight crews in HNL - I used to point out how clean their beverage lids were when I made them drinks.

My barista today slung my iced latte at me and closed the window. I waited u till she noticed I hadn't left and asked for a napkin to wipe the sloppy cup and she happily gave me (literally) a stack 4 inches thick. 

It's the little things that used to make Starbucks a great place - now it's just a McDonalds with a different name...

Conveniently located right across from City Hall, nestled in the middle of the expanse of the Courtyard by Marriott's lobby.   It's really just a counter with some high-top tables along the windows of Filbert Street.  Baristas make a decent cappuccino but add too much milk unless you ask for it extra dry.

I had one of the worst experiences that I have ever had at a Starbucks. 
They were not busy at all. When I ordered through the drive through they asked me to repeat my order multiple times (which is totally fine - I completely understand that this happens) but then I get up to the front...they take my card to pay...then not only give me the wrong order - but when I went to tell them what I actually ordered then they tried to charge me again and then STILL gave me the wrong order. Very disappointing.

I normally go to this Starbucks before I start my shift at a nearby hospital, so I stopped in last night and had a pretty terrible experience. When I walked in, there were three visible employees: one talking to customers, one making drinks, and one standing and doing seemingly nothing. The store was not busy at all so I was not at all prepared for a poor experience. I was eventually able to place my order and I ended up waiting 15 minutes for an iced coffee. The might not seem like a lot of time but this was close to 7pm on a Monday night and I really only had 10 minutes before my shift started I watched the one barista prepare someone else's drink very sluggishly while he complained about his commute to another barista. He was much more focused on his conversation than his professionalism. As my patience thinned, he started working on my drink. At this point I've waited 12 minutes for my coffee and my shift was about to start in a few minutes. So I told him that I had no choice but to leave because the service was just way too slow. Another barista came out of nowhere and instead of apologizing for her and her teams unprofessionalism, she told me to order my drink on their mobile app before coming into the store. While that may be a good suggestion for others, I don't believe that I should be concentrating on my phone while driving to Starbucks. The coffee itself was pretty terrible. I ordered a hazelnut iced coffee with almond milk and it was not mixed properly so there were little flecks of "almond milk" throughout the drink. I could've used an apology for the extremely slow service but I guess I'll just save myself some time and money and stop at DD next time!

It is not very often that an establishment earns a 1 star from me.  Being compared to other Starbucks and even other coffee houses this is by far the worst.  I go to Starbucks daily all around Florida.   The staff are not following uniform guidelines  (yes I go to Starbucks that much), but I found it unusual..... The tables were all dirty except 2 of them.  Counters all had trash on them.  We ordered a Latte and a frappuccino. One person was in front of us.  It took 9 minutes to get our drinks. I am pretty sure this does not meet Starbucks standards.  Hopefully someone from Starbucks will see this an make an unannounced visit.

I'm really over this SB. I go to this one out of convenience, but for some reason the concept of "no foam" eludes them. Today I ordered online, "Grande, Non Fat, No Foam Latte". When I walked in, I received my drink with an inch of foam. When I asked them to fix it, he took the foam off the top and handed my drink back to me. Don't get me wrong, I normally appreciate my over priced coffee, but when you are missing an inch of that pricy drink, it's just absurd. Worst. Starbucks. In. STL.

I had just finished lunch at Paradise Bakery in Clay Terrace.  In fact, I had ordered salad and soup so I could enjoy a lovely frozen coffee drink at Starbucks next door.  Now this isn't my normal location for my Starbucks consumption but considering it was Clay Terrace, nothing could go wrong, right?  I obviously live in a land of coffee dreams because the minute I walked in and looked around, I was pretty surprised.  The main booth in a much smaller Starbucks than I expected had ripped and faded cloth upholstery.  The floors were dirty and it was screaming, clean me!  When my daughter and I got to the register, the cashier was talking to a young man who already had his coffee in hand.  She saw us but turned back to the man apparently more engrossed in her conversation rather than wait on us.  We actually walked away from her after a few minutes of blatant disregard.  We actually stopped near the front entrance so I could yelp my location.  Did she call me back?  Say she was sorry? She had plenty of time to stop me from walking out but instead kept yammering and actually took a second to glare at us.   So we went back to our favorite Starbucks on the way home happy to see a clean store and friendly faces.
No WiFi and no outlets at more than half, if not, all of the tables? I stopped looking honestly. I paid $5 for a coffee and had planned on staying to work but left disappointed. What is the use?

I just love the Starbucks location they are so friendly and the manager Tiffany is very helpful. My favorite of all time has to be the green tea frappe on warmer days or the flat white on colder days. 
They always seem to have a good stock of pastries sandwiches and salads and are seldom out of any item except very late in the afternoon which is very understandable.

Went here with my fiance and I have regrets. I was trying to buy a gift card that came prepackaged with a greeting card and it wouldn't ring up. The packaging said the greeting card came with the gift card, yet the girl refused to sell it to me because she insisted it was extra. This guy behind me decided to shout his order because I guess he's just too important to wait in line AND THEY TOOK CARE OF HIM. I was still ordering stuff! Really?! 
I got my drink and left. I went to another Starbucks and was able to get that gift card no problem, the greeting card wasn't an extra charge.
I've got nothing but love for this Starbucks. Amazing customer service and fantastic coffee. I'm always greeted with a smile and the baristas know exactly what I want.

I've been just recently coming to this location cause I work at Walmart. I love love love the ladies that work here. Even at 4:30 AM they are happy and ready to help customers. I unfortunately forgot my card and the lady brushed it off and went ahead and gave me it for free. Absolutely generous and I'm thankful. I didn't get the ladies name but she was the opener for this morning! Thank you to you!

At this Starbucks the baristas are not only efficient but friendly! Also, props for starting neat initiatives--such as their "Grounds for your Garden." They allow you to take coffee grounds for your garden-for FREE! Way to go Starbucks!

I usually don't review chains, and honestly Starbucks isn't my favorite coffee.  Today though, they really made a difference in my day...so my dog got out this morning, I didn't have time for my coffee because I was looking for my dog for 40 minutes before I had to take the kids to school.  Starbucks has a great app, and because of their app, I was able to order ahead, and knew it would be ready when I arrived.  Unfortunately an errant driver ran a red light and I clipped his bumper on the way to take my kids to school and get my coffee.  Everyone was safe and uninjured, but the result was that it took close to an hour to pick up our Starbucks order.  I know...why did I still pick it up silly right??  Well sometimes you need a little extra pick up after a really rough start.  We got to Starbucks, they had already disposed of my order, but immediately made me a fresh delicious latte to replace it.  I felt uplifted and so much better about the day!!  Thank you!!
Great Starbucks. Staff fast and efficient. They made a kick-azz Carmel Macchiato and the sandwich wasn't too bad either. I'm not lying.  Keep on keepin' on Starbucks!!

This was such a good Starbucks but recently customer service is really hurting. I waited 25 minutes for a Frappuccino and the girls working the line laughed when I asked them about my drink. There seems to be a lot of new hires so maybe that's why they're taking so long but the attitudes are uncalled for.

I'm conflicted about the stars... I don't know if I should give three stars or four stars! I'm not a coffee drinker but the 1st time I was in here; it was great. Today... Not so much! 

I'm going to go off this trip for the stars but explain both trips. Now the 1st trip it was overly crowded and I was definitely confused on how to order. The guy explained the sizes to me and even helped me figure out the drink I wanted. Which was a strawberry refresher, no water, coconut milk, whipped cream and light ice. He was extremely patient, helpful and he is the reason why I came back. 

Now today, it's late in the evening, fairly empty. This should be a breeze. I forgot the sizes and didn't want to say small, medium or large. Nor did I see the sizes on the menu. So I ask, what are the sizes? She said "small, medium or large". I'm confused... I thought you all didn't say that!?! She gave me a look and ask what I needed. Uummm okay! Still very confused. This is Starbucks... Right?! I placed my small order for a strawberry refresher, no water, coconut milk, whipped cream and light ice. I did say light ice two times. Ima say they don't understand what LIGHT ICE is! The ice was filled to the top of the small cup. So I might've had 3 sips of nothing! Ugh! 

Ok. Besides this mishap of ice vs light ice. It's a really small location, pretty quite in the late evening, clean and plenty of seats inside and out. 

At the end of the day... Yea. I will go back but asking for no ice... Maybe I'll get light ice!

It may be conveniently located but they run out of items quickly. This is a large conference hotel. There are also people walking in off the street. They really should increase their supply. Got a spinach and feta wrap. Because it was overheated, it was a mess and falling apart.

Went here and a the barista with brown hair and not in uniform (which is kinda unprofessional) was loudly complaining about other employees and customers when there were many people in there. She also was very rude at taking my order.

I don't go to the outlets too much so I've been here twice? But, matcha lemonade is my favorite drink right now. Usually when I order it from the Starbucks on ridge pike it's very light and the matcha powder is settled at the bottom. Today at this location I can say it was by far the best matcha lemonade I've had! The color was so dark and they mixed it perfectly! 
Plus there really nice in there!

Your typical starbucks, and now they know my face and name because I go in there so much! They are friendly and super-accommodating to my small demands. The only problem is sometimes they charge me different prices for the same drink? Starbucks in general is over-priced, not sure how a venti-iced coffee can really be over $3, but at this point I'm addicted, c'est la vie. I preferred those few times when they charged me $2.40. I'm planning on registering a gift card and being one of those lucky gold card members so I can get free refills :) That might make the moola spent a little more worth it.

This location is convenient, but small with limited seating. However, that isn't the reason for the poor rating. This location is regularly out of food. 3/4 of the time I go, they don't have many or any breakfast sandwiches. They also don't offer the Nitro Cold brew. Unless they make changes, I'd rather walk 1 block to the location on the corner of 5th and Church.

I ordered a tall drink and I think they must serve smaller size cups than regular Starbucks, or did they all downsize the Tall drink? Um, it seemed like a micro mini cup size than the Tall you would get at Starbucks locations. Also my drink was barely warm at all! I don't know what happened here today. Disappointing.

Literally paid for a Venti just to get more bubbles than the actual drink. I order at 6:30 AM and didn't get my order until 7:10. And once I finally remind them I get this. I was already late otherwise I would've said something. But literally the worst location they take forever

This location is the closest Starbucks for me to get real coffee during work time. The store itself is beautiful due to the new building. Coffee taste consistent with other locations. But the service is NOT so good. The employee often in a cold mood. I often feel stupid to say Please or Thank you to them because the way they reacted. And today, I ordered a cheeses Danish, warm. After waited for over 10 (when there was less than 5 customers total in the store) still did not see my Danish ready, I went to the cashier and wanted to ask about my order,  I was ignored at first, then finally after I asked by any chance the Danish is ready, the answer was: It's in the oven. 10min warm a Danish the oven must be not working. No apology, not nice, not even polite or proper.

This is my favorite Starbucks in town. It's quiet and not too busy. Drinks are made to perfection. The baristas are nice and patient. 

Really enjoy being able to get work done here. There are plenty of tables and ample space to spread out. The outdoor area has music but it is on really loud. Pets are welcome on the outdoor patio area.

WOW. Best Starbucks ever. The staff is super friendly even when someone who isn't acquainted with Starbucks lingo orders. I haven't had a bad experience here yet. The manager is doing something right!

Starbuck's is like the Mc Donald's of coffee vendors. So Blah! My latest mistake was stopping for Matcha Latte. Matcha syrup is sent to the Mc Starbucks locations  to be added to steamed milk. Missing the heart and soul as well as the pungent rich taste of matcha made on the spot.
It's great! It's so close to where I live that I don't even have to drive there. The service is also good, I've never been disappointed from this location and I have been here many times.

The Asian food restaurant that used to be here had some really over-salted miso soup. It wasn't very good. If you think about it, coffee is a sort of bean broth. 

Anyway, the drive thru is convenient and pretty fast when the line isn't too long.

this place is a joke. i went there yesterday and today and both times they royally screwed up my order. today, after waiting in line for nearly ten minutes, i saw the girl making what i thought was my coffee and politely reminded her i wanted it iced and not hot. she gave me a blank stare and had no idea what i was talking about. they had totally lost my order. she got another girl to hurriedly make what i had ordered, which was a simple caramel frap with soy milk and a drop of whipped cream. i specified very little whipped cream because i am lactose intolerant. what i got was an iced coffee that tasted like sh!t with a crapton of whipped cream foaming over at the top. no caramel. then the woman had the audacity to say, is this what you ordered ? i don't know honeybeans, you tell me, you're the one who took my order. i was furious and wouldve asked them to re-make it but i wouldve been late for work if i had. so disappointed, ill go back to standing in line for 15 minutes at the suburban square starbucks  than deal with these incompetent people.

It depends on who is working the time you go. There are a few here that know what they are doing and make something that is tasty and other staff that need help making the simple drinks drinkable. If you go enough and are a bit of Star Bucks junkie you will figure out quickly who needs to be on shift to make what you want taste good.

Bathroom help with keeping sanitary and keeping stocked up. Also, what happened to that going out of your way-Starbucks  friendliness? Not so much here.  Outside of that, I love this Starbuck's setup and hope the one they're building in Trinity turns out this cool or better. The Cure was playing - pretty awesome tunes!!!

Worst Starbucks ever for many reasons. Staff had a very "I couldn't care less, I don't want to be here" attitude. They were out of what I wanted (passion tea), and when I asked what else they had that was similar, they didn't really have any recommendations. When they finally thought of something and I accepted, the lady who made it did a terrible job. It tasted like lightly flavored water. I refuse to pay 4$ for lightly flavored water. What a joke! I asked to have it remade (I have had the very berry hibiscus at other locations and it's delicious so I know what it SHOULD taste like) and got a pissed off look from the woman who made it. So much for any customer service. It was remade by the guy and it was a little better but still not what it should be. Don't worry Manager (whoever you are), I will not be stepping foot back through your doors ever again and I will make sure no one I know does either. Find another Starbucks that is worthy of your hard earned money and makes delicious drinks, this one does not.

Not sure why this place has mid to low reviews. Drinks are the same as any Starbucks, but the staff was so great! As soon as I walked in, Rick greeted me. Eman complimented my shirt and made friendly conversation during my order. He also asked a guy if he liked the new sink they just installed- it was so random, but so funny and a good conversation starter. 

I sat at the bar listening to an Audio book and 15 minutes later, Rick asked "How's your drink Eddie". So surprised he remembered my name. 

I very much liked the experience here!
This is my favorite Home base Starbucks. The drinks are consistent and the staff is always welcoming. Our coffee is very important to us;) Keep up the good work!

I've been bummed out ever since Hubbard & Cravens left Riley Hospital. While I prefer visiting a local chain, the newer Starbucks location in the Eskenazi Fifth Third building is the next closest place I can get my espresso fix alleviated.  They offer discounted days and coupons that you typically don't see at other Starbucks locations.  It also opens at 6 AM, which is a treat for us early-morning types.  Maybe the 4 stars comes out of desperation due to lack of nearby espresso; whatever the reason, this location offers one a nice, new location to take a quiet break from work on the northwest side of campus.

I'm not a frequent coffeehouse patronizer, but this Starbucks is one of my go-to locations because its close to work. Located on the ground floor of the Marriott, this Starbucks has a very corporate vibe to it. There is always a ton of people in here, with pretty significant lines. 

This is not a cozy-feeling Starbucks at all, being that interior space is very tight--like a thin, lengthy road. The amount of seating is sparse, and rather disjointed (a couple alcoves and a bar-type window seating area). This is not a place that you would wish to spend any length of time in.

However, you can be pretty sure of one thing - your food & drink will be fresh, being that there is a high volume of people that pass through here. In fact, I *highly* recommend that you get the Starbucks app to order/pay so that you can skip the crazy lines. 

Theresa may be the best barista in town - we're talking Best of Philly. She obviously works hard, she always has my drinks made perfectly, and she is one of the nicest ladies in town. I think she is only here in the late morning, though.

I tried ordering through the app just yesterday, and it all worked flawlessly for me. I ordered and paid with my mobile phone, it gave me an estimated time of 3-8 minutes that my order would be read, I walked over to the Starbucks, and by golly I had my drink in-hand on the 8th minute!

Why this location is not open 24 hours, is beyond me; apparently Philly cannot sustain a 24 hour Starbucks. If any location was going to be 24 hours, I'd think this would have been it.

Placed a mobile order and it was ready even earlier than my app said! I walked right into the starbucks and my drink was waiting for me. I ordered a caramel macchiato and it was great! No complaints, thanks for the quick and great service!

I waited for twenty minutes at this Starbucks for three drinks. The workers had no sense of urgency. I have never been more disappointed in a Starbucks. They spelled my name wrong, waited an incredibly long time, and they made my drink wrong. I was too angry to ask to make my drink correctly because frankly I was worried it would take another twenty minutes. I will for sure never come back to this location, unless you wanna wait twenty minutes for a drink that's made incorrectly.
Most horrible service ever at. Starbucks. Server said they were out of all breakfast sandwiches but as I was waiting for my coffee, barista pulled about a variety. Waited for 45 min on line.

I come here often in the evenings to hang out with friends. It's not my favorite Starbucks but I like the location. It's in Winthrop plaza which is very cute and cozy. I generally order a peach green tea lemonade. I'm not really into coffee and green tea is the only tea I drink. You can barely taste the tea and it's a really good drink.... Sometimes if you don't drink it fast enough, the ice waters it down. The evening manager gave us attitude one night when my friend pointed out that he didn't wash his hands between mopping and filling up a cup of coffee... Exact words were "Jesus Christ!" 
We got over it though... And I still visit. Lol... Pretty sure he washes his hands now.

Every time I go to this Starbucks they end up taking a very long time to make my drink even if there is not wait. They also manage to make my drinks wrong, either forgetting an ingredient or shorting me on the amount of coffee or espresso in the drink.  I don't expect a lot but I feel like at the very least I should get what I paid for and get it in a reasonable amount of time.  Unless there is no other Starbucks around you I would recommend to avoid this location as they are sub-par at best.
Not much to say. Just another Starbucks. Ate here for lunch, because it was convenient and healthy.
They forgot my drink and she rudely said I would have gotten that. Walked off. Asked again and then they finally made it.
Waited 15 minutes for drinks while staff went to the back leaving one person upfront. Got drink and it was nothing but foam worse Starbucks.

5pm:  I asked if they had decaf coffee.  Sure, they said, we can brew you a fresh pot.  

Here I am, wide awake at 10:30pm and have been working straight through for the past 5 1/2 hours.  I have no proof that they gave me caffeinated, but this is not normal for me.  I'm glad I'm getting work done now, but tomorrow is going to be miserable.

If you aren't going to give me decaf, just tell me so I can order something else!

This has to be my favorite Starbucks in the Indy area. I used to work inside the Greenwood Park Mall and would visit this location on average 3-4 times per week. The staff is excellent and they've never screwed up my drink order. They're pretty fast on turning those drink orders out too. They'll even make suggestions on additional drinks just to try and save their regulars some money. With their regular clientele they make an effort to remember your name, what you normally order, and how exactly you like it. This store is the reason I have a gold card, because they were the only location to tell me about it.

This really is a nice Starbucks and glad we do have one in Trenton. It lends an air of a professional place than the street life of Trenton. Nice to sit among a diversity of people primarily of the work life of Trenton. The baristas seem very nice and friendly. They have various entertainment events at times. This store really does try to create a community feel among customers. They let me sit as long as I want which sometimes I do stay a couple hours. Supposedly, you can actually sit without ordering, but I don't feel that's right. So, I get a coffee of different kinds while sitting with my phone. Interestingly, people painted rainbows a while ago outside in the intersection of S. Warren & Front streets in honor of LGBTQAI+. That's very progressive and of course, Starbucks is very open minded.

If you're driving down Capitol on a work morning, chances are you've seen this Starbucks' drive thru line spilling out onto the street. Don't let that stop you! There have been times I've been on the street in line at 7:45 and been through the line, placed my order, paid and gotten my drink within 6-7 minutes! It's seriously impressive. Imagine if all restaurants/drive thrus worked that efficiently! 

It's almost ironic that their morning drive thru is that great because their inside service is actually pretty slow any time of day. I typically only stop here if its early in the morning because I know I'll get that great service.

Have to give their drive thru/early morning workers props though! They're definitely the best in the business - and incredibly friendly while doing so.
Ordered a vanilla latte during study hours, and it was pretty good. This Starbucks location is the best one in the library hands down. Well done starbucks.

I mean, in terms of Starbucky-ness, it's fine. And since they take so long to make a latte, you can place your order, head over to the pharmacy to grab a few things you've been neglecting (or forgetting) to get the last 12 times you've been to Fry's, pay, then head back just in time to grab your drink and go. Maybe that's just me...
