One of our Santa Barbara-area stops for many years.  Especially when heading south on a Sunday, the 101 can be a virtual parking lot.  Being able to stop at this Starbucks allows for a view of what's happening with the freeway, which is useful for deciding when to brave the road again.

This location's been here for many years.  It's one of the smaller stores.  Not completely cramped, but not that large, either.  Since we normally stop on Sundays, the competition for parking spaces in the lot is not usually an issue.  I imagine it could be intense during the week when the other businesses are open.  It's a tight lot to begin with, so add some traffic and chaos could ensue.

Usually we both go in together.  This time, I was doing something in the car and didn't go inside.  Dear Hubby ordered us a beverage for the road.  He was back before too long, and the Frappucino he selected was made well.  Just the right dose of cool tastiness for the drive home.  I prefer this venue to one of the really busy, cramped ones on State Street where finding parking is near impossible.

This is by far my favorite Starbucks. The baristas get inundated with crowds from the dome, from the Met, from downtown generally, and they still take time to make sure everyone gets everything and they always get it right. The baristas know my name and I've only been in town for a few months. They're very kind, ask how things are going, and are very hard working. I especially like dealing with Cam, Sam, Desiree, Michale, Shelton, Lydia, Mac, and another fellow whose name I just blanked out on (sorry!) 

Love this store and this team.

This is my favorite Starbucks on this side of town! The Barristas are friendly. The place is always packed with friendly people who are ready to offer you a smile and a seat. The outlets are easily accessible. 
SOUTHSIDE ALL HEART!!!
Service here is always soooooo slow. A bunch of lazy kids standing around doing nothing.

I am not a fan of Starbucks except for a few favorites so I only go when there is nothing else around. That is the case with this location inside the Westin hotel. The staff is always friendly and makes a really nice breakfast sandwich. The coffee here seems less burnt than other Starbuck locations, so I give them some high marks for that. I also like the early hours that they open (6 am). 

When you have no real choice, this place is worth going to. 

As for the small location, there is nothing wrong with going outside underneath the umbrellas and taking in the fresh air at one of the many hotel provided tables, you just need to head left towards the beach and you will see them. 

They also accept American Express which many places in Tama do not.

This is by far my favorite location.  The staff there is wonderful. They get excited with me when a new coffee comes out. They pay attention to which bag I buy, and then ask me on my next visit for a review. They suggest new coffees to me, and so far haven't let me down with my home brew. They make my latte perfect every day.  When I say "thank you" they always respond. Many other locations don't pay attention when you talk to them, but not this one, they always engage and respond. The store is always clean too!  I come in pretty often so it feels like my neighborhood Cheers (I don't drink alcohol but I have a strong coffee habit). There is a group of older people who come in every day and sit at the same table. We chat now while I wait for my coffee. It's just a fantastic environment, with exceptional employees who always have time to talk about coffee with me. 

Update 03.26.19 grabbed my usual today and Laken made quite possibly the most perfect cup of coffee ever. I was greeted with my first name, and tons of smiles as usual. This weekend I was in a different area and had to stop at the Starbucks on Steamboat. What a different experience. Employees who don't look too in the eye, they don't reply to a thank you, and rush you out.  I was so happy to be back at my normal location today.
This Starbucks takes forever. I went there in the morning and waited 20+ minutes for my drink to be told they didn't even have it.
This Starbucks is usually clean and the line is never too long. The staff is friendly and the environment is mostly quite. For me this is the perfect place to relax and read a book.
So busy all of the time, but the staff knows how to handle it! The other day I thought the long line would take forever, but it was so so quick! Keep up the good work!

Excellent store, fantastic location.  This spot is one of the better Starbucks I've been to. The baristas are extremely friendly and if you are a regular they remember your drink and your name. They are quick and efficient and you are in-and-out. Hands down best store in the area.

The doors on this place are worth a 5 star rating all by themselves!!!

Got my fav Iced Caramel Macchiato.  Very yummy, one of the best I've had flavor wise. Could have used a bit more caramel on top, but couldn't we all want that?

Staff was great. Prices too high, which we already know when we go here, but we all deserve this treat now and then !!  Love it !!

The service at this locations has fallen off over the past few months. Today's visit included two employees goofing off while 5 customers waited in line.

The employees are no longer friendly and act as if they would rather be some place else. They skip around when it comes to making drinks which results in longer waits for some that ordered first.

So sad...this one used to be one of the best out there. Must have gone through a management change...for the worse.

I like how Starbucks is starting to do samples. It's nice to try their newer menu items without committing to a full serving and then not liking it. The only gripe I have is that they installed code locks on the bathrooms. I get that they have to clean them and sometimes the homeless will use them but come on.

Enjoy this place more than I should. Service is usually good. When it's not it's noticed without bringing it up and it's taken care of more often than not in my favor. Will continue to do business with them.

My second visit and the second time I have been delighted with my service!! I love the space in this Starbucks! Lots of tables and lots of space to have a private conversation. I'm grateful I live near by as this is quickly becoming my favorite location 

Wow I'm surprised at the service deterioration. I arrived at 5 and two people were behind the counter. No one said a word to me. One person was helping outside patrons and the other mopping the floor. I finally asked the person mopping if anyone was servicing inside patrons and she said yeah we'll be with you shortly and continued to mop. Finally a third person came from the back and helped me. I frequently go to this location and I'm sad to get lower priority than a mop.

Just like everyone else I enjoy Starbucks but the one thing I didn't enjoy was today I went to try their  cloud macchiato unless you like to pay for a cup thats 3/4ths foam and just strong coffee with a hint of sweetness I wouldn't recommend it
Not the best location but it's convenient. Sad that their equipment seems to have issues often. Not being able to use their blenders or expresso machine.

Horrible.  One cashier two people making drinks.  Supervisor walking around.  Two people in back.  The one cashier has to go make the sandwich.   3-5 minutes per customer.  Would have left but it fascinates me to see how poorly run this place is.  So bad it really is funny.

This is the most convenient Starbucks for me to stop for coffee and breakfast on my way to work in the mornings. I'm usually in a rush so mobile ordering is most convenient. There have been MULTIPLE occasions where I place my mobile order and get there 15 min later and STILL have to wait another 10+ minutes for my order. Which unfortunately makes me late for work. Today this exact thing happened and to top it off, the morning bun that I ordered was rock hard and my drink was made completely wrong. I would have asked them to remake it had I not already been 10 minutes late for work. All around terrible start to my morning. Needless to say I will not be returning to this Starbucks location

Speedy service, nice but not spacious on the inside - great outside seating area. 

Very nice location near the Countryside Mall and it also sits in a very nice shopping plaza with TJ Maxx, Ross, etc. 

For the size of this location the cleanliness is always great.  

Yes yes it's PSL season (you butta ask somebody) LOL (stop judging me) you know you like it also :)

Let's face it we mostly don't really visit Starbucks for the coffee but for the experience, the baristas are always with a smiling friendly face and super knowledgeable, they look me in the eyes and the customer service is OUTSTANDING. Keep it up Baristas! :)

Tiffany would be horrified if she witnessed the incompetence of her staff on the morning of 3/25.  I got so fed fed up watching every order before mine get screwed up and then re-made.  I finally walked out even though I paid.  Never coming back to this store.
This is the worst starbucks i've ever been to. For them to be on campus they move incredible slow and have no sense of urgency . It took them 20 minutes and they still hadn't even STARTED my drink

I don't understand why there's negative reviews about this Starbucks location when honestly, all I've had was amazing service with the very accommodating staff. It's located next to Penn Hospital and down the street from Jefferson, in a busy intersection where doctors and students come in for a cup of coffee -- you're going to have delays. If you're already late for classes/work, then why stop for coffee to add more to your lateness? It's YOUR job to prioritize your time, people. Not the staff. 

Stop being an entitled primadonna that huffs and puffs because they didn't make your very important coffee fast as possible. Anyway. 

I work around the area and got to know the staff fairly well! It's very busy there but the staff is always cheerful and make sure they've heard your order correctly, even apologizing when technology decides to backhand them out of the blue -- my coffee is always made perfectly and handed to me with a smile.

The store itself is clean -- I always see staff members either cleaning or keeping their bar area free of spills or answering any question a customer has, even when they don't get it line. They have impeccable customer service when I sit there and people watch from time to time, even striking up several conversations with a few. They care about their customers as well as providing them with a tasteful beverage.

2/5:00 PM is when there's heavy foot traffic so if you're in a rush, make sure to order on the app!

A small location with couch and fireplace. No Clover or interesting coffee. Basic cafe with drive thru. 

Music is too loud nearly every afternoon I come in. Can't enjoy a coffee and read with some crap music blaring in my ears.
Love the crew at this location! The only thing that makes me not go as often is the long drive thru line that's out into the street on some mornings.
Best Starbucks I've ever visited due to the Staff. Staff is very friendly and most know my order by memory.

With a great Downtown location, this is a great spot to step in and grab a coffee or tea. Their staff are very friendly, and great at giving recommendations if you aren't a good decision maker like myself. They have a small pastry section if you need a small bite of food, and are attached to the Courtyard which is great for hotel guests in the morning.

Keep in mind that this isn't the kind of Starbucks that you bring your laptop and backpack to. There's one tiny table, and it's not necessarily a comfortable place to just hang out in. There's one small table in the corner of the room, and that's it. The only downside to my visits here that I've encountered is that it's not necessarily sparkling clean. Often times the counter will be a bit messy or full of crumbs and spilt drinks (granted it's a food shop, and customers tend to drops things).

We have come to this location several times, more so during high school tennis season, for cold drinks.  In our experience, the employees are always friendly, efficient (inside and in the drive through,) and knowledgeable of the drinks and food that they offer.  For this trip we ended up ordering two grande drips with no room.

I have never been to a Starbucks that has been this rude and not put together. There were 5 workers helping the drive through but would not help up. We were told by one "I'll help you when I have time." Everyone clearly saw us standing there but just kept walking by. As we were about to walk out they finally came over to help us. 

Plus the bathrooms were bad and didn't even have toilet paper. I've never been to a Starbucks with bad service...I guess there's a first for everything!

What's not to love? Comfortable inside and out. Lots of places to sit and drink or eat or work. Outside tables are protected from the sun. The staff is friendly and efficient. Orders come up quickly and are correct. This is one of my favorite Starbucks.

I live nowhere near this Starbucks and I legit will drive all the way downtown just to go to this one some days. They always do my right! My drink has never been messed up and the drive thru line is typically quick even during the "pandemic." I appreciate y'all! Don't change or start messing up people's orders because this is my favorite Starbucks in Indiana. :)

Sad excuse for management. Mark needs extensive training in customer service. Perhaps some professional help. There with my 3 children after a doctors appt to get a special treat. Unfriendly from the start and very short. Was putting order in as he informs me my 3 year old is taking chairs. I realize now he's been staring her down angrily. I look over and see her putting empty chairs at a table for us. I said I could handle it. Goes on to say no, she's taking customers chairs. Informs me I should keep her right next to me. Yeah she's 3 and she doesn't listen. She wasn't disturbing anyone and I don't know how she was taking peoples chairs if they're sitting in them. Mark has children and informs me they always listen to him. I'm just a terrible mother I guess who can't control a 3 year old. Maybe I should get her on some meds. Mark goes on to ask me why I want to be rude to someone who makes their drinks. So now you're threatening me. I said I kind of have my hands full and I can't run over to her. Well you should keep her right next to you is his response. Believe me I wanted her to stay there but she has a lot of strong will and I didn't see the harm in her reserving our table while I'm about 15 ft away. It would have been more of a scene for me to try to get her to stay. I said to him you could have been a little nicer about it. He informs me he is very nice. Please don't go to this place unless you have children that act like robots and stay glued to your side. Children with any free will are not welcome here. My children were upset by this whole situation. My 9 year old was very aware and was upset with the way he was talking to me and realized this was not the right way to treat someone. She went over before we left and helped put the chairs back. We left without any thing we ordered because I was just so upset with the treatment we experienced. My children and I have been to all the Starbucks in the area and have never had an issue and always felt welcome. Been to this location twice. In and out first time for a drink and then this experience. The sad thing is this is located in a community with lots of families. You really need to try to be accommodating to all customers. This experience makes me feel really sad about humanity.

Well, as this is a Starbuck on campus for Drexel's student, doesn't matter how terrible it is, this is our only choice. Nobody is even bother to add this on Yelp. 
Try to order something simple, like dark roasted coffee or just tea, so there will be less chance the staff here mess up your drinks.

It's a Starbucks. What makes this one different from all the other Starbucks, is that they are slow as molasses that has been kept in the ice box. I don't even get complicated drinks. I order cold brew, black and it still takes forever. However, they do provide me with a laugh. They can't spell my name right. I could understand if they spelled it with a ph instead of the v, but here they spell it with a b. The last poor barista who tried to call my name out had no idea how to pronounce Steben.  I give him credit, he politely asked how to pronounce it. Since the v & b are next to each other on the keyboard, I just smiled and told him it was a typo. 

This Starbucks is in my hood, so I'll continue to support them. I'll just take a deep breath before walking in and make sure my patience switch is flipped to the on position.

Always consistent and had my 1st SB tip here that I believe is orth passing forward with gratitude:

1. Order the spinach wrap with a side of sriracha and cream cheese & a knife 
2.  Grab some napkins and Find a solid surface perform  the operation 
3. Gently open the spinach wrap until you have sufficient surface area to add you ingredients 
4. Squirt as much or little of the sriracha along the length of the opened wrap
5. Slather the cream cheese along the same path 
7. Close the wrap and wait a few minutes 

The cream cheese will start to melt and you end up with a new taste and texture plus the always delicious, delectable & desirous heat!

Interested to hear if anyone else doing same and all those who give it a try....what cha think?
The same as any Starbucks out there. Friendly baristas good coffee! The issue here is the wrap around the building busy hours at the drive through which is no fault of theirs.

Even with all the break and lunch rushes,All the staff are so friendly and will even remember your order (especially if you are there an unhealthy amount of times). I love stepping away from my desk and having a seat or stopping in during my lunch hour for an afternoon coffee boost. Have not used their conference area, but with so many businesses in the area it makes for a unique meeting space.
Just your friendly Starbucks.

Cute and small coffee shop. Quick and friendly service. Only reason I'm giving them 4 stars and not 5 is because of the condition of the restroom. Restrooms are shared with the entire Phoenix building (I think) so they were very dirty. I was afraid to touch the doorknob

I have been going to this Starbucks for 7 years EVERY weekday.  I was  such a loyal customer and now will NEVER go there again after this morning.  There has been a noticeable decline in their AM drive-thru performance over this last year.  Not only are wait times longer, the actual service has declined. This morning, I waited 8 minutes AT the window, after a 15 minute wait BEFORE the window, only to have the "barista" spill my coffee all over me and inside my car because he was "rushing."  I visualized him preparing drinks for cars behind me while I was AT the window, simply ignoring me.  Today reflects many days for me of late at this Starbucks.  Luckily, I was not wearing anything special but now my Tesla seats smell like coffee. Having it detailed this weekend.  This Starbucks no longer cares about their customers.  I am done with them.  They did not even compensate me for the damages or for the coffee that they spilled.  I was too done with the to care.

MY barista. Gabriel. Was THE simple most pleasant mf I have come across in the food/hospitality industry in ages. I am 32 years young. He was so knowledgable of what Starbucks had to offer. Gabriel even reccomended me the PERFECT Hellowakeup drink to lighten my day load! Great conversation! Thank you for being you, Gabriel!
This location has very slow service every time I go.   Luckily there are faster ones on the way to work.
So you have 15 people in line and instead of having any coffee brewed, you're just starting to brew pike.  Solid planing there team...

Super slow service on a Wednesday morning at 8:15 am. One lady just plain left, but I stuck it out and got my $4.50 iced half-caff latte.  

The good news? Close to my office.
The bad news?  Don't come here if you are in a hurry. 

Clean restrooms.

Loyal Starbucks customer and this is the friendliest Starbucks I have ever been to.  Hands down!  I'm a Yelp reader but not a Yelp reviewer.  So I'm giving a review for this Starbucks because that's how strongly I feel about this location.

My mobile order was even being made 5 min after it was placed. I had to wait in line and remind them I had a mobile order. The staff was playing and loud. Others had to inquire about their mobile orders, as well.

Located in busy downtown St. Louis but the mere fact that it closes at 6:30pm Monday-Saturday and isn't open at all on Sunday's makes this place a whopping 2-stars on the Christy Scale.

Downtown is filled with residents, business patrons and visitors looking for a cup of Joe well after bank hours. This location is super inconveniently located on the corner of 6th & Olive. 

Reporting live,
~Christy

Def glad this place is a block from my office but I've never really gotten great service. It's pretty disappointing because I'm a regular. Majority of the time I use the drive thru or I mobile order. Ironically the past 2 times I've gone in person, they've got my order wrong. For some reason they put lemonade in my iced green tea and I hate lemonade. Lol. 
Last week I went in for a large order as I was buying drinks for my staff. I was there for 25 minutes to get 7 drinks. I thought that was a bit much. 
The reason I'll keep coming here is twofold. 
1.) close to my office
2.) drive thru is faster than most

We consistently ask for NO FOAM on lattes and consistently get screwed with only 3/4 of a cup and the rest foam.  I'm not sure if people misjudge when slinging milk in cups but don't be lazy and make more rather than just lazily topping it off with foam.  I mean I'm paying $5 or more for my order.  If you can't give me what I ask and am paying for, then tell me and I'll make an informed decision to go somewhere else.  There are plenty of other options.  See photo posted of only one example...

I'm a former barista, though for a different Starbucks, so I tend to judge them a bit strictly. This one makes the drinks correctly and quickly. I'm not always thrilled with the customer service as sometimes they can be a bit rude. But most of them are friendly. I'll go back knowing that my very specific and complicated drink will be made right. For a busy Starbucks, they do very well and have their jobs down pat.

The absolute worst Starbucks! I went the other day, got my usual order of iced coffee and a bagel, and the worker told me the price was $8 which I knew seemed high, but when she read back my order she only mentioned my two items, so I paid and waited for my things. I then got to the pick up counter and got my bagel and iced coffee, the only two things I ordered, but found out later after I left that I was also charged for a croissant! The sticker on my cup even said items 1 and 2 of 3 items! I was basically cheated out of money by this Starbucks! There was no croissant there for me and I NEVER ordered one! The barista only even read my back my two items as she checked the order! This is completely unacceptable in my opinion. I've vowed to never return to this Starbucks and have also told my friends to never bother unless they plan on being over charged!
This is the nicest Starbucks. Wow! What a friendly staff. I absolutely enjoy having my first cup coffee at this place. It's a true definition of five starts customer service.

It's the same ol' Starbucks you will find in most airports. But the good part is that you know what to expect. Product, price and service are consistent, and sometimes the waiting time too. But it is worth it if you don't like surprises.

This is a review of the Starbucks kiosk located inside Giant Supermarket at the Wynnewood Shopping Center.

I can't tell you whether the coffee is any good or not. I stood at the counter for a full minute, waiting to place my order, as the woman at the register studiously ignored me and carried on a chat with her colleague. After that point, I left as the woman carried on her apparently riveting discussion. All I can say is that I hope such "service" is not par for the course.

This store may be one of the busiest stores in the area but the staff is extremely friendly. I know you have baristas that will be friendly because it's a job but this store has several employees that you know truly enjoy what they do and working with people. I'm glad that when I stop by theirs always someone who remembers me and asks how I've been or where I've been working when they don't see me on a regular. That says they care and it makes this corporate coffee shop feel like a local cafe. It's the people that make it not the store.

I go here everyday regardless but have to order a different drink because each time they mess up so I have up. I go here once a day sometimes up to three times and each time they have no clue how to make a cloud Carmel mac. Y'all really need to train these people. Before you lose business and I'll just go an extra mile beside work. Legit spend hundreds a months 7$ each pop. I expect to get the right drink. In the right cup. I'm not picky at all I just go on but 7 out of the past 8 times it's been the same issue

Great little Starbucks location!  It's inside the Westin, but they have their own entrance and parking spots.  It's right off Courtney Campbell Causeway, making it very easy to get there if you are headed West, but kind of a hassle if you're headed East.

Every time I go in, a staff member immediately greets me.  They're always friendly and quick.  I don't usually tip at Starbucks, but I usually end up deciding to tip them here since they're so nice.

Traveling through Monday 2/3 in the afternoon and wanted a tea before my flight. There were 6 Employees standing around. Super slow service !!!! Employees were not helpful and taking their sweet time !!! Not acceptable. Last but not least my drink order was incorrect. Simple Tea w classic syrup. No syrup was given. I would've went back to have my order corrected but I was already boarding my plane.

Very fancy, love the decor! I wish we got discounts here as employees. You can sit outside if you.like the sunny day outside. 
Like any other star bucks, I do feel sad buying expensive lattes that I can make at home, but this place is an.absolute delight in.the middle of a very busy day In the hospital. I can't tolerate the Seattle best coffee they have in the cafe so I'm very happy I have this option.

It's a Starbucks....which is like virtually every other Starbucks around the world.  However, a bonus here is that your iPhone app for Starbucks works with the in-store scanner!  Leave your wallet at home, but don't forget your Starbucks app!

OK I usually rate Starbucks a 3 star, but this one has a drive-through!  WOW!  So I'm pulling up and wondering how I'm going to put the half n half in my coffee because I don't want those silly little containers that you have to pull open, potentially spilling them all yourself or your car, so I ask the nice attendant person, can I have cream and will you put it in the coffee for me?

And she says yes!  And I got the coffee and it tasted better than I usually do it.  Hmmm, maybe all these years I've been putting too little cream in my Starbucks coffee?  Or too much.  I don't know, I didn't even open it, I just drank it.  It was pretty good.

I've been coming here for years. They have never messed up an order , Been rude , or done anything worth less then 5 stars. It's a Starbucks. It's good. It's overpriced but you know that pulling in. They do a great job!
Renovated to slow down service.  I understand long lines but 3 cars and still over 15 mins?  Will skip this one from now on!

Review based on ordering ahead with the app.  I've done the order ahead thing a few times for this location.  Anywhere from 10 minutes to 5 minutes prior to my arrival and my drink is always ready when i go in.  The barista even made a point of saying hello and using my name when they saw me grab my cup.  I appreciate the gesture as no other store has made that effort and I use the app at quite a few locations around town.
The staff is professional and courteous.  Even through the hectic morning rush these employees always greet you with a smile. Chris and Beth are the best!! Thank you for making my mornings brighter.

This Starbucks is located in Concourse A of Tampa International Airport.

Stopped in here for some caffeine while waiting for my flight back to Dulles.

The line was not that long, but for some reason each customer transaction turned into a long negotiation. Not sure what was going on with the staff...

Drink was good and strong though. Should not take 15 minutes from the time I got in line to get a cup of coffee - with only 5 people in front of me!

This Starbucks is in a hopping spot right in the middle of the Philadelphia Premium outlets.  So be prepared to wait in line for a while. They do a pretty good job of keeping things moving but it is crowded.  They do have some outside seating which is nice. All in all its your average Starbucks.

Really chill place. Not too busy, the line didn't take long at all, and my friend and I just went in and out to buy her a mug. Plenty of space to sit with tables and more comfortable couch-style seats. It is a part of a hotel, so it gave it a more "business" vibe, and the interiors looked nice and well-kept.

Having not had breakfast before my midday flight, I was happy to find a nice shiny Starbucks in the Southwest terminal. The line was short and the guy at the register was friendly. My breakfast sandwich was hot, though I really wish it was possible to get a crispy English muffin out of those ovens they use to heat them up. My blueberry muffin was very moist, which was a nice change from the scones that I usually get. 

However, I requested a hazelnut latte, and the drink I received didn't seem to be quite that. If I had to guess, I'd say it was a mocha latte -- definitely heavier and sweeter than the delicate hazelnut flavor I was expecting. My receipt just said flavor shot, with no specification, as did the cup. I thought about going back to ask, but honestly I had just gotten settled at my gate and didn't feel like it. So I'm sure I'd return to this Starbucks, but I might stick with drip coffee next time.

I live walking distance from this Starbucks so instead of driving to one I have the convience of just going here. I have not always been a fan of Starbucks because of their coffee but I started getting adventurous and started trying new things out. I fell in love with Starbucks Iced Green Tea unsweetened with honey and the Mocha Green Tea Frappuccino all because of the help of the workers! The staff are always friendly and since I am always there alone or with friends socializing or doing homework they basically know me. I am always welcomed with a friendly smile and whenever I ask for help about a drink I feel like they always go above and beyond even telling me if I don't like they can make me another one! The mornings and Sundays can get busy and super loud which might cause you to wait a bit for your drink but that isn't the workers fault. I prefer sitting outside around the evening since it is relaxing and more quiet compared to the inside sometimes. This is by far my favorite Starbucks in the area!

this place is still open, the lines suck but i talked to a manager and its one of the busiest sb in the nation, so that is expected and they do such a great job for the amount of people that are in there. if i didn't have to deal with all the entitled students that think they need a drink in 5 seconds after ordering when they see a line out the door i would give it 5 stars, but the crowd is what is a downfall. but the staff and product is great. i love getting drinks and going to read in the library.

Truly the worst service I've any Starbucks I've ever been to in my life! So slow and unlike any other fast and efficient Starbucks. Management needs to fix this at this location or new management is the answer.

I always rate my Starbucks experiences on the service, because that's the only thing that really sets them apart.  Here, they are nice enough, but just don't give that warm, welcoming Starbucks experience that I have received at others.
Staff is very pleasant and my green tea frapp is delicious. I also love their new bagel bites! Yum

Service was not good. Waited 30+ mins for a drink. When I asked about my order, the so called shift supervisor, brushed me off by saying it'll be soon and didn't even check for me. At the end which was more than a 40 min ordeal, they came to me, handed me money and said "We don't have the ingredients. Here's your money. There's nothing else we can do for you.". Very rude staff; not friendly.

Stopped on a very rainy Saturday for a nice hot tea and a coffee.  I was greeted right when I walked in the door and the barista who took my order was very friendly.  This location was very clean and seemed to be doing a brisk business.  The drinks were prepared quickly and tasted exactly right.  I had even asked at the counter what coffee they would recommend for the average coffee drinker, since I do not drink black coffee and he was glad to help and recommended the Pike Roast.  My mom approved when she tasted.  If I am near this location I would return.

It seems like, no matter what Starbucks I go to, the decaf machine is always being cleaned. I find this hard to believe. Are there just not enough people who  drink decaf? I have never once heard that the caffeinated machine was being cleaned. Maybe they don't clean that one. My friends who drink caffeinated beverages are never denied. Seems a bit fishy to me.
This is a good Starbucks location.  It's small, clean, and quiet.  The staff is friendly and the coffee is always good.  No complaints!

I place an online order. It was a lunch box, so there wasn't much to do but have it ready. I went there and one of the girls told me your order isn't ready yet, so I told her it's just a lunch box, so she said oooh ok go ahead and grab it. 

They didn't have the box I ordered, so I chose a different one, and the cashier charged me $3 for it. I was so upset because I used my rewards to pay for the previous box, so I felt deceived and also pay extra for a $6 box. I basically end up paying $9. 

I am upset not just for the poor customer service but for the extra fee. She acted like if I was trying to steal it. 

The first girl I understand she was busy making the drinks, so she didn't bother me at all. I mean I can grab a box. However, the cashier displayed such poor customer service. Just upsetting. Also, the bread is old, and the box has bacon which I don't eat, that is why I ordered the egg box. $9 to eat half of an apple. Great!
Great Starbucks. I got a chile mocha in the rain. The barista was friendly and said I had good taste for ordering the chile mocha. The drive thru was busy but moved quickly.

First off, this location has a friendly staff.  This was my first time working remotely from this location.  Wifi connection was good, I just had trouble getting a connection at 1st (but I think that's due to my tech savvy struggle self, lol).  After 2 trys, I was connected just fine. 
There is a decent amount of space if you want to stay in their lobby area to work or read, and there were plenty of people for a noon-ish crowd. The only downside was the cold breeze that comes through the building so often....if they had a fireplace it would be a definite bonus.  I enjoyed a Honey Citrus Mint Green Tea, so delicious and sweet. It kept me warm for the majority of the time there.  Also the cars always seemed to speed out of the drive-thru, which is no fault of the staff.  Everyone's in a hurry, just need to be mindful of the pedestrian customers coming in/out of the building, saw at least 2 close calls. Other than that, great remote space to work and not too noisy.

I don't usually do reviews but this particular location is rather frustrating for me. I want to start by saying the staff has always been friendly and nice but my compliant is with the drive thru. I live right across the street from this location so you would think this would be my good to spot. Unfortunately the drive thru takes forever! I'm regularly finding myself waiting in line for 10 plus mins. I decided against my better judgement to stop here before work today. Definitely made a mistake after waiting 15 mins in the drive thru and being late almost 10 mins for work I will probably never go to this location again when I have somewhere to be.
I bought a sandwich and they serve it to me cold. They didn't offer me a new one. The service sucks here

TRASH of a location. Terrible customer service, everyone there seems to be forced to be there. No willingness to help, no friendliness, nothing. Horrible coffees, i dont see how you can mess up an order when you're specific down to the pumps of sweetener. Also, their cold brews are disgusting, they are watering down like no other. And honestly with their poor service and disgusting attitude there's no asking them to remake it. It's a shame. I rather get off the car and go into the near safeway location Starbucks than here.

This is located inside the Target. I always seems there is no one behind the counter. The service is SLOW! The coffee is pretty good. The last time I was there I had to ask a target employee if the Starbucks was open. They said yes & they had to go find her

I am big fan of local coffee shops such as Bongo Java, Abba Java, Frothy Monkey, Ugly Mugs, etc. However, this joint is near my house so the convenience is great to grab good coffee. 

The best part of this spot is certainly the baristas! ALL of them are friendly and good at their craft.

Do yourself a favor and drive to this Starbucks.  Quick Drive-through, clean restrooms, fast internet and great side tables for meetings.  Can't wait for warmer weather.  Last year they had great outside seating.  Best of all is the staff.  They're happy to be there and always have a greeting.  They suggested a "London Fog" or Earl-Grey Tea Latte with sugar free Vanilla syrup.  I did mine with fat free milk and will try almond milk next time.  Great place in a busy day.

This is a nice spot to people watch or work between meetings at the hotel. It's located on the 2nd floor close to the parking garage and elevators. You're also close to the halls leading to meeting rooms and ballroom auditoriums. 

My drinks and food were accurate and quickly made; however, you're paying a higher amount because you're captured at the hotel. The clerk also wouldn't honor my birthday reward and it expired before I returned to my hometown.

This Starbucks is a disgrace. I understand that this is a high traffic area, as it is in the middle of the Outlets, but the cleanliness and customer service that I received was unacceptable. The cashier was very nice and understanding, even after I returned to her to change my grande order to a venti, but the brown haired barista was not having it. 

The first red flag was when she (the barista) jumped in front of the customers to grab a bag of chips, and proceeded to take them to the back where drinks were being made. As she was making the drinks, I noticed that she was not in uniform, and was making drinks very messily. Since there was so many people, I understood the rush, but her tone of voice when speaking to her co-workers also gave me a very unprofessional impression. I witnessed her mess up several other customers orders, and was honestly very worried. 

About 10 minutes later, I saw her begin to make the drink I ordered, and I asked her if it was mine since I noticed it was only in a grande cup. I told her my name, and she said that it was. Once I let her know I changed the order to a venti, her response was "Great *huff*, well I'm not changing it unless I can find that order." after hearing her rude tone, I responded saying "Well I actually have the receipts on my phone." then she proceeded to angrily dump my drink in the sink and kept a dirty look on her face, about 5 minutes later she finally made my drink. I asked her again to confirm if it was mine (since it had no label), and she barely looked up at me. After she finally looked up and said "yes" I took my drink, said my "thank you", and left with no further interaction. 

Honestly, I am very disappointed that this was my experience, as all the other workers appeared to be so kind and understanding.

The employees at this Starbucks are so pleasant and helpful. They made me sample a drink I had been wanting to try for free and chatted with me about various drinks on the menu and other ordering tips when the line was slow. They were all so friendly, knowledgeable about the menu, and helpful. I come to this location specifically because the employees are so awesome.
This is the start of my morning routine 6 days a week. The staff is welcoming and friendly. They are amazing and extremely hardworking.

Every time I go through the drive through at this location the  people working the drive through window are rude and miserable. Must really hate their jobs or their lives or people and in that case they should quit their job. 

And my latte tasted terrible and couldn't drink it.

This Starbucks does a great job of getting you out the door quickly with the resources they have. It's quite a bit faster than most Starbucks that I frequent, and I've come here when there was a line of 3 or 4 people waiting for their drinks. Don't plan to sit and work for 8 hours, the location is very tiny and there are 2 tables in the whole place. Also, the bathroom is locked, so don't plan on stopping in to use the bathroom, paying customers only!

Probably the most efficient Starbucks I've visited!

19th Nov at 2:43 pm. The crew attending drive thru left a bit to be desired? I ordered a doppio with a little cream and was handed a cold tall cup filled to the brim. When I complained there was the usual sort of  we can make it again for you this is so beside the point if you're working at a cafe get a clue what an espresso shot means it cannot be a tall cup filled to the brim it's not a question of making it again it's a question of making it right the first time!

I went in this morning to get coffee for me and my family. There was nobody in line, and the older woman with the frizzy hair and tattoos said she could help me. It sounded like she was in a rush to get to other customers, but there was nobody else in the store. I don't think that I've ever been so disrespected by a Starbucks employee - I usually have great experiences in Starbucks. My drinks came out fine, but my experience was far from pleasant. I hope this employee is better with future customers.

This is a really handy Starbucks location for us. Easy parking, good selection of pastries, and, of course, coffee! I love the iced coffees, the mocha in particular.
The service is prompt and friendly and the atmosphere is pretty laid back.
Just one request: please start selling the double shot Expresso cans of cold coffee! That's my wake up go-to in hotels when I travel on business.

Cashier seems nice enough, but the young black girl who fixes the drink has an attitude, and made a mess of my drink right in front of me. Considering the location, I would think they would have a much friendlier staff.

Very happy to have a Starbucks to stop at clise to work!  There have been a couple times they have been slow with service.  Today, I tried the Blonde Vanilla Latte and I was not happy with it.  I am wondering if they forgot the Vanilla.  Overall, I have had minimal issues and will return to try new flavors as well as enjoy my White Chocolate Mocha!
As one of the only coffee places in the area, I was excited to try it and I was not let down. The coffee was great, the little cafe itself was cute and well-equipped, and the staff was friendly.

I'm addicted to Starbucks! Actually I'm addicted to their contests! The one on 6th and Olive is comfortable and the Baristas are helpful. They will even offer a suggestion, when you have a hard time deciding on a beverage! What's interesting is I can order the same beverage at dif Starbucks locations and the beverage will taste and look different. I can also order the same beverage in the morning or afternoon at the same place and the beverage will look and taste different!!! My fave Green Tea Frapacino is on 6th and Olive. Horchata Frapacino is on Chippewa and Landsdowne!
Not enough parking! Orders come up very slow and are served by smart ass staff that make a chunky Frappuccino.
Really friendly employees, nice little spot, but do NOT come to this Starbucks if you're in any kind of a rush!
Love the atmosphere here. The staff is friendly and drinks are great. I wish there was more parking as the lot is almost always full.

Was never told my total, never offered a receipt, and when I asked about it I was rudely told about a hotel tax.  I already have a bad taste in my mouth about Starbucks, so this was the icing on the cake.  Thank you,JW Marriott Starbucks, for confirming the fact that $10 Starbucks coffee and wait time is not worth it.

Great location and quiet enough to have coffee with friends and hear one another. Love the leather seats!! There's a lot of people who come in to study or work and it's a really good place for that. 

The blonde espresso is awesome, if you don't like Starbucks coffee cause it tastes burnt to you give it a shot you won't be disappointed!!!

The Good: Every worker I encounter at this location is friendly. Stopping at this location multiple days a week, my order is 99% correct and in the 1% chance that it's not, it is fixed with a smile and apology. The location is clean. 

The Not-so-good: The app often lists that they are out of items when they actually aren't so always be sure to physically go in or go through the drive-thru to order if you encounter this issue at the Blue Bell location.

Barista seemed annoyed she was working and it wasn't even busy.   She would just place a drink down and not say what it was.   My wife got her order but it was a small instead of a grande.  I told her that my wife ordered a grande and she huffed and started to make it and my wife told her to forget it.

The service was fairly fast. It was festooned with the normal 'Bucks adornments.  The entrance and 'lane' to call out your drink is cramped.  Tables against the wall across from the counter make it difficult to maneuver.

This is your typical starbucks.  I always stop here on my way to court.  The quality of the food and drinks is good.  The employees are friendly and accommodating.  The drawbacks to this location are that it is difficult to get in and out of, the sign is not clearly visible, and it is often very busy.
This is an excellent starbucks location. Beth who works here is always inviting and an amazing person. I would highly recommend this starbucks location to all. Wonderful new building and very clean.

This location (22nd and Kolb) has hands down had the best service each and every time! They are consistent with their great team work, superb customer service and awesome quality/speed of the menu items. My Momma raves about this location and the few times I've been here, they have lived up to her praises!

Professionalism and customer service is dead. This place is exhibit A of this fact. I have come here multiple times and each time the attitudes and service are pure shit. Go elsewhere for coffee. Quills is a great place and not far from the Marriott if you have time to make it there.
Very impressed by the breakfast sandwiches. I got a red eye and a chai latte and proceeded to marry them. Then drank them together. I have discovered my new favorite.

I am glad they increased their hours till 5:30 PM This place has a really good working table for online and offline projects. The noise level is comfortable. The Starbucks partners here are friendly and attentive! The drinks and the food are delicious! Make sure you buy a Rewards card to earn points for free drinks!

I just moved to the area, and I've gone to this location twice. Both of the times I went there I waited for 25 minutes in the drive-through when there was only five cars in front of me both times. I don't understand why they are so slow here at this location, I've never experienced service like this at any other Starbucks location.

I'm not sure what happened to this location in the last 3 months.  The purpose of a mobile order is to order ahead to bypass the line or drive-thru to avoid the wait while being sure to allow enough time for the "Order Ready" estimate, run in, grab-and-go.  It's for people who want their coffee or breakfast, but know that they won't have time for point-of-service ordering.  If I had the time to wait the additional 10-15 minutes for my order to be ready after allowing for the estimated drive/prep time, then I wouldn't have used their app in the first place.  My experience the last 3 visits with ordering ahead 5 minutes before leaving and the approximate 8 minute drive from home averages a 10 minute wait.  Fifteen minutes one additional morning, but they were very busy on this particular Friday morning at 7am, so I was patient because I understood.  Today, I placed a breakfast order ahead of time in a time crunch (2 sandwiches, no java), arrived 5 minutes after it was placed (with a 6 minute order ready estimate, so I did expect a slight wait if they were busy), waited 10 minutes for them to finally tell me that one of the items I ordered was not available.  Game over, time wasted, running late because of this now.....again.  This time though, there were only 2 cars in the drive-thru, no one at the counter ordering, one person waiting for one coffee, and 5 employees working.  Again, I don't know what happened to this location but it's a shame because the location is perfect for where I live.  They used to be efficient.  I'll just go back to the Keurig and nuke something here that may not be as good, but at least I'll know the person preparing it has time as something that's considered.

Horrible service here!  I was literally the only person standing at the register, no cars in the drive thru and 3 employees walked around, past and f'ing through me without an acknowledgement.  I had to ask someone to help me twice...and then they didn't apologize!   This place need to replace their entire work force on Monday afternoons.  This was really bad!

Bond Shopping Center, 1891 S State Rd, Havertown, PA 19026

They don't believe in giving you your full drink. My favorite location ever. The staff is fast and friendly even on busy days. The drinks come quick, and correct everytime. If you're unsure on what you want they'll make recommendations based in your likes, not on something they may be pushing. Overall great location.

This is my home Starbucks snd I love hosting meetings here. Great atmosphere but usually packed.  The drinks are expertly crafted.  I had to laugh at the 1star review.  She said she asked Starbucks staff to put less pumps of the syrup in her drink and then complained that it tasted like milk! Thats what you get when you put less flavoring!  Lol! I highly recommend!

I am giving this Starbucks specifically a 5 because of their epic employee menu! I was stoked to see so many different creations from the employees. I truly trusted their knowledge and order one of the unique drinks. I usually go for the black coffee, no cream - the unique menu really made me want to step out of my box! Unbelievable customer service at this location, even with the rush of mall shoppers.

My favorite Starbucks in town! Hands down the best staff, with quick in and out orders. They make an extra effort to get to know their customers, and any order that is not sufficient - they fix (:

Prime location with the beauty of outside seating by a fireplace!!

I found wonderful service at this Starbucks. The workers were all wearing masks and I was greeted with a smile. Shout out to Greg who was putting out positive vibes and great customer service! Your attention to detail is respected. I love you, Starbucks.
The service was, also very quick and efficient, as well. It wasn't as busy as Starbucks usually are. Hard work, efficiency, and good customer service are three components I have found in this Starbucks.

Long wait times and staff is horrible and moody. Everyone that works there is slow and always seems to not pay attention to my order, which is usually a cup of hot tea and a petite vanilla scone. (Easy but they can't seem to get it right)

Omg I was having an awfully crazy day and the barista James made it so much better. He had amazing energy, was very sweet and had the patience of an angel. He was more than polite and very welcoming I will definitely come back

This is a great Starbucks! They are not all created equal and to me are set apart by their employees and the way the place is kept. I am always greeted with a smile! I always feel I'm treated with respect and appreciation and will continue to shop here.

This was go too.  I'm not someone who writes a lot of yelps.  The last few month when I come in I always order a ice coffee. Somehow it takes 15 min to make every single time. The customer service is always bad, this is the second location I've been to and the people at the drive thru or inside the store are just so snobby.

Is great place for read book .. and cofee the space is magic and g re at i love the university and love this special place
Luv the coffee and the atmosphere. Great place to meet a co-worker over coffee and a laptop.

this is a great store, i live a little far from here but work in the area and this is my favorite stop on my way in to work! always brightens up my day and the employees are always pleasant and kind!

This is pretty much the only star bucks I go to mainly because it's close to where I shop. The big plus is the line is never too long and they've never misspelled my name. Lol.

I hope management sees this and will really think about it: Would you wait 20 minutes for a black cold brew?

You say "Hi" to someone you expect a word in return. Not during my most recent visit. There was also attitude taking my order after that. I don't get it. Then they spilled stuff all over my lid and didn't give me a new lid just spent minutes cleaning it if

Highly efficient small footprint store seeking to meet your Starbucks needs/addiction.

Awful customer service. 

The brown haired woman that is working the closing PM shift (May 26, 2019) has terrible customer service.

Due to her lack of attention to customers, I inquired if the cafe was even open. It was 6:20pm and discovered they were open till 7:00pm. 

When she finally rudely asked what I "wanted," and I responded with my order, she crudely stated, "we aren't making those. I already washed the machine."

No kindness, smile, apology or anything. 

Firstly, when you are open for 40 more minutes, it's seems irrational to have already cleaned your
equipment. Secondly, even if you did already clean it, you could at least deliver the news in a kinder, more customer service centric way.  

I've traveled all over the world and have never been spoken to like this by a Starbucks employee. 

Avoid this store and entirely and go the the other Starbucks less than a block away. 

It is not worth dealing with a store that supports a culture of bad attitudes and impoliteness.

Looks like the store was closed closing up, everything was put away. Was told food items basically sold out (doubt it much likely) still has 45 minutes until closing. Won't come back to this location ever again smh!

So they got my size wrong and the drink wrong and no espresso shot when I paid for it and not double blended when that's what I asked for. Really annoying and no receipt...? Very rude and seemed unorganized. Won't be going back anytime soon, Dutch bros it is.

This one is just a really good one. Always service with a smile and warm genuine hospitality. Some places the baristas are so very much annoyed with people, tired, or just don't want to be there, but here, they're very kind and nice. Drinks are always on point, quick. The lady at the drive through just made my day the other day. I was exhausted but her smile really perked up my morning, coffee pun fully intended!
I like the staff they're quick they're friendly they're efficient and they're very helpful with the ordering menu I think all of them should get a bonus or a raise

I am here on my second visit to Starbucks 
I received a gift card for $25 dollars. 
Bought a Stanley brand thermos. It is defective. 
First use. Half hour with hot coffee it was hot on the outside. Coffee barely warm. 
Clerk put the wrong receipt in the bag. No other receipt but the cleared card transaction. Clerks and manager refuse to issue credit or exchange product EVEN THOUGH clerk remembers me. Won't go to this place again.  I'm not asking for cash. Just equal exchange. Starbucks name is on the product. Owner needs to hire thinkers. Expect a letter and social media discussion. Is this worth $25 to you?
This has to be one of the slowest Starbucks ever! Waited in the drive thru line for 25 minutes! How can it possibly take that long for 6 cars to get coffee?
The best coffee place ever and an awesome place to hang. My mom also loves it a lot. I recommend Starbucks to everyone

As a former barista at this location, I will say sometimes the customer service is lacking due to the constant business. When they are slow, however, they are quite friendly and efficient. Since becoming a regular, I must say this is my favorite Starbucks.

Relatively new Starbucks with a drive-thru. 

Friendly staff and VERY CLEAN bathrooms (hopefully they stay that way as the Starbucks matures!!)

There's outdoor seating as well and outlets toward the back if you want to study here. It doesn't ever seem to get super loud, which is a pretty nice plus. 

It's not a huge Starbucks, but they have probably around 8-10 tables of varying sizes. 

In the summer time, there are always flies in this Starbucks, which gets really annoying especially if you're sitting here for a while to study. Otherwise, they keep the place quite clean. 

Not much else to say about this place. Might be the specific baristas, but my drinks here taste more watered down than usual (I've experienced this with iced coffees, iced lattes, and hibiscus tea).
don't go here if you're in a rush to get to work in the morning. even if you order on the app, they'll take 20 minutes when it says "preparing soon".
Thanks to the kind gentleman at the drive-thru today!  He made my day and the best way to start my birthday count down off! 3 days away! The service was fast, friendly and great!!!

Supper loud music. 2 people standing around just asking if you want food with a line of 11. If they say your order half was and you finish it to confirm it is right they will get an attitude. Horrible customer services

First off, this location is not closed. Although maybe it should be. Came in when there was little to no line, which is rare. After i placed my order, there was a bit of a rush-- and everyone else got their drink before me, and I watched it happen, for 30 minutes. I could actually see the baristas picking and choosing drinks to make and continuously shoving my cup to the back of the line. So, finally, after 30 minutes of waiting, I went up to ask the progress of my drink. and oh, the cup was sitting empty at the end of the line yet again. The girl apologized, and to be honest I wasn't mad at her, and she told the other girls to make my drink next, and they seemed rather unresponsive but complied. Still took another 5 before it got to me and-- it was not the next drink made. 
If i didn't use a gift card on this drink I would have been beyond pissed. There's no excuse for making people wait that long for no reason. And after reading the other reviews, it seems this is the norm for this location.

No mango dragon fruit refresher and poor customer service. Ended up ordering green tea lemonade instead but what prompted the one star review is the lack of customer service. The Starbucks experience is not the same as when I worked for the company. I drove up to the window to pay I said Hi and the barista charged my card, handed me my drink, and that was it. She didn't say a word back but only conversation with her fellow baristas inside. Way to make me feel welcomed especially after not having in stock the beverage I really wanted. Let down.
Very friendly staff that always makes you feel welcome. I look forward to getting my coffee from them every morning. I've never had a problem here and recommend it highly!

Wow order drink today.  It was wrong and I thought they are supposed to make it right per there policy they did but WOW why the attitude??? Not happy as I visit SB daily may need to ban this location from my visits. I bet this location may not be open too long !!!

The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because of the wait. Their staff is wonderful and helpful. They're always very friendly when I come through and make great suggestions when I'm in need. The only downfall to this location is that they're always slammed. They almost always have a line around the building for drive through but they always seem to be moving it as quickly as possible. I wrote this while sitting in the aforementioned line and 19 minutes passed from the time i got in line until the time I got my drink.

Stopped by this Starbucks today in Center Square Commons. It's a neat smaller Starbucks, located on Route 202 which is pretty convenient. Drinks were great, decent service and an all around average experience.

I usually love their frappe's; however, this location is not up to par with the others. When I ask for my whipped cream to be blended in, for $7 a cup, please make certain it's blended in. My experience here was less than satisfactory. I don't believe I'll be visiting them again.

Me and my mother have been going here for over a half decade, and it's a great Starbucks! 
All of the employees are very helpful and hardworking, and if you have any issues they will be more than happy to assist you with anything.
It's a great place to do your homework, or just read a book! They have free WiFi, and if you stay in store, you can get .50 refills for certain drinks, also it isn't a loud environment, so that's a bonus.
Overall, I've had nothing but great experiences here, and I would recommend it to anyone!

The JW Starbucks is rude and unprofessional.  Ordered a cappuccino and venti water, it was $6, come to find out they charge for water in a cup. I said I don't want the water. After the third time of telling me they need to scan my phone app, I said why don't you train your people to warn about charging for water so I don't have to scan my phone three times. 

I went back to sit down and some SJW employee says In front of my seven year old that she's going to call security on me. Why is a low brain SJW scaring my kid?
