I spend $200 month in starSucks and they'll let homeless people use their toilet water for free but charge a good customer for a cup of water? 

I've had enough of this SJW company treating me worse than a homeless person. 

This JW Marriott has nearly convinced me that I'm done with starSucks

And their new bonus system sucks as well. 

I'm really starting to hate starSucks

I've recently started going here more before work to get breakfast. I'd place my order when I was leaving my house and it would be ready when I got there. It's been good but the past 2 times my oatmeal has been wrong. The first time I think it wasn't cooked long enough? The whole top layer of oatmeal was dry. And this time my oatmeal is literally soup. These have been the only things wrong with my order in the past 2 months. I plan on coming back and giving the oatmeal another chance.

i hate this target's starbucks! the baristas are  rude! and my beverage is still wwwwwrrrrong!
#ignorance

Nice, cool spot always. Never know what type  of entertainment  you might get in there with it being downtown on meridian. Only thing I ordered  what  I usually  order at other locations  and it tasted slightly  different(white  chocolate  mocha  latte) not sure what  was up with  that

My local starbucks and my favorite one. I will drive out of the way to go here. One of their manager's here has always been so helpful and helping me picking out Christmas gifts. But this place is well ran and always are timely and accurate. Only once have I had to go back inside after being in the drive through. I've been here alot! My favorite by far is Pumpkin Spice Latte skinny with whip. =) Nom Nom.

P.S. The parking lot sucks! People can't drive because of how it is shaped.
Great Starbucks, very typical. Really nice staff though. Very kind, very quick. Starbucks is always a great escape that's comfortable and familiar where ever you are.

**Let me jut say this address should read 31E. Wynnewood Rd.,NOT 50. This is also a newly constructed building with 2 other shops that is  connected  to the Starbucks with Potbelly being one of them. **

 Awesome friendly service is what you would expect coming from this location. I had the pleasure of dealing with Miss Torie who had greeted me with  a smile and even a high five! 

Yes I know this is a Starbucks. Yes I know this is a chain location that has swarmed the entire globe. Sometimes, just sometimes there is that one that exceeds above and beyond. I had came in when there were pretty much cleaning and prepping for the following day. For Torie to stop what she was doing in the wind down, or closing process means a lot. Torie gave me my caffeine fix I so desperately needed, plus it showed me they appreciate customers at this location.  

I will continue to be a customer at this NEW location just for that one simple reason.

I've had good luck at this Starbucks up til now. I won't be back until a couple of employees are gone. I hope that is soon. 

The challenge of being a writer is trying to find a place to write that has background noise, but not TOO much background noise. You get tired of always sitting at home in the quiet. I usually thrive on white noise (worked in a record store for years, so I can handle a LOT of it). But once in a while, you encounter a coffee place where the noise is just too much. Usually it's loud talkers-- those customers that sit right near you, and have no idea how much their voice carries. 

I've worked at this Starbucks A LOT in the past. I like the table right in the window, plenty of light, and I can get lots done. USUALLY.

However, my husband and I came in this morning (a Saturday, around 9-ish), and it was awful. 

Starbucks employees, I don't mean that you shouldn't talk AT ALL (I'm not an ogre, and I understand work can some times be boring or a drudge), but you have to understand something. People come to coffeehouses to relax, drink coffee, have conversations, and socialize. When YOU are louder than the coffee machine or anything else going on in that store, it's bad for business. 

There were two girls working here this morning that made it especially unpleasant. Gabbing about personal lives (at TOP VOLUME, let me add). And in addition, there were 4-letter words being dropped with surprising frequency considering there were a mother and daughter sitting not far from us. 

If it were just the loud conversation, that'd be one thing, but one of these chicks had a laugh that was loud, grating, and obnoxious enough to break glass. And she laughed a LOT. 

I'd barely gotten a good head of steam going on the writing when I finally had to call it quits. I'd had quite enough. If there is a manager working Saturday mornings here, you wouldn't know it. THIS is not how you run a Starbucks. 

I won't be back for quite a while. Way to go, Chatty Cathy.

Love this Starbucks. They have a great eating area outside-good for time by yourself to connect to wifi or meet with a group of friends. The staff here is always friendly and goes above and beyond to meet your needs. Even though this Starbucks gets packed it always seems to move fast. I would recommend this place for meetings!

I love Starbucks and spend way to much  money on it daily. If a drive thru customer comes into the store after an incorrect order there has to be more than  I will re-make it. Suggestions: can I make that one size larger for you? Or would you like a pastry? I don't know exactly but having went thru drive and having to return and walk into the store is an inconvenience. Your customer might say no thanks but offering is good business. Hopefully someone is reading these reviews. Have a wonderful day!

A-ok... Unless this is your first SBUX experience, you know what to expect. Today, 6/25/16, TIA is not too busy, and neither are the shops. Flying Spirit, so decided to BYOC. Tasty brew and friendly staff. I will be back... But then again, this is a favorite stop when coming to FLA.

PS. Free Wi-Fi via the airports network!

Usually pretty good. Today they forgot about my mobile order!  A cleaner Starbucks. 

Busy drive thru. 

Busy little place. A Starbucks.

I  love  Starbucks  in  Wesley  Chapel,  Florida  on  Bruce  B  Downs.  Stranded  for  a  place  to  go  and  everyone  is  closed ...the  bright  green  lights  shine  from  the  highway  and  soon  you  are  sitting  in  a  warm  cafe  with  lots  of  people  using  computers,  drinking  hot  beverages  and  eating  food.  Also....I  can  buy  newspapers  here  from  New  York!  A  great  place,  great  staff  and  great  Chai  tea!!!  See  you  there.
Typical Starbucks store in an atypical location--the St Louis Zoo located in Forest Park. Zoo entry is free. Full menu available.

I'm writing this because of how much I love this location simply for the baristas. They are always exceptionally friendly no matter how busy they are. I typically go on my lunch hour and almost always have Jim as my barista and he is awesome! Super personable and upbeat!

I know this area sorely needed this Starbucks.  It needed a place where people stayed instead of just dropping in and running out.  The layout of this Starbucks is conducive to that, there are enough chairs, tables countertops and a conference room to give the neighborhood a place to stay.  Not that Trenton is any different from other state capitals in that after 6pm, there is nary a soul to be found and especially when it's 30 degrees or less outside.

But I have to say it's problematic when I order ahead on my app and yet still come in and wait.  It's even worse when there is no queue, I peek in, see no one at the register, head straight to place an order and then have to wait 15 mins for a drink.  There is no urgency until someone voices a complaint, which is what I observe with basically every other visit and I can assure you that I'm not the one logging a complaint.  It appears to me that there isn't much of a difference when a complaint is logged to be honest.  So it's either the wait is terrible or the drink isn't made the right way, which is another story altogether.

So this pains me to say, I've got to be honest, but this indifference or lack of attention towards addressing a known problem is troubling for a business that really can/needs to kickstart a Trenton community that sorely needs it.

Not a huge fan of this location. Parking is always difficult due to their tiny parking lot. The store itself feels cramped and dirty, and it is almost always too crowded to find a comfortable seat. The staff seem to change all the time, which sometimes translates to slow service and sub-par drinks. I continue to go here due to its proximity to my house, but it's not my favorite.
LOVE this Starbucks! The staff is awesome, and they move the line very very fast! They always have my coffee ready with a smile!

Never coming back here again.  I've tried many times. I'm The only person ordering a drink., a ice coffer. Three people are working, talking. It took 10 min and there was no one In front of me. This wasn't  go too.  I'm not someone who writes a lot of yelps.  The last few month when I come in I always order a ice coffer.  All they do is scoop ice, walk over to where the ice coffee is in a big pitcher and pour.  Why must I wait 15 minutes for that when people in front of me who order warm coffee gets it made right away. This place what is my go to Starbucks but now I'd rather just make my own and save myself the trouble of waiting forever when it only takes 15 seconds to make.

I've been going here since the day they opened.  Mostly use the mobile app.  All the baristas that have been there awhile are always friendly and efficient.  Seems lately that there's a lot of new faces in there which apparently has slowed down service significantly.    I'm really ok with that mostly, but sometimes it seems reaaaallly slow.  Example: pull up to drive thru order spot and tell them I have a mobile order.  4 cars ahead of me at the window.  9 minutes later when the guy ahead of me reaches the window it takes another 3 (!) minutes for them to hand out one drink....one.....so from the time he ordered til he got his one single drink...12 minutes.  Doesn't sound like long, but it is for a drive-thru serving mostly single drinks.  Kinda takes away the biggest advantage of the mobile order.  Also bugs me a little when they hand me the drink at the window, and stare at me blankly when I remind them that there was a second item on the order.  They always ask what the second item was.  Really?  You have nothing to tell you that?  Again...it's mostly the newbies and rookies I'm whinin' about here.  The veterans get it.  I'll keep going there because I have faith that the service will improve.  Plus, the coffee is the best.

I usually use the drive thru here and the line moves quickly, which I appreciate! The main problem I have is there's not enough space for the drive thru line when it's busy in the mornings. Many times, cars are having to wait out in the road and block traffic before they can turn into the parking lot/drive thru lane. This Starbucks is very spacious on the inside though, so would be great for studying, working, etc. throughout the day.

I come here A LOT! I have had a range of experiences, most of which were excellent. 

Every now and then I encounter a lazy employee or one who seems to never even acknowledge me during the transaction besides to take my money. 
More often than not the employees are attentive and make sure my drink is made correctly along with being polite to everyone even though the place is slammed.
Do give yourself extra time during peak hours (morn, lunch, and dinner rush) as this is the only Starbucks for miles if going north.

It's a smaller Starbucks, that does not have a drive thru but they can really get things out quickly. I order ahead on the app when I am on my way to work (usually about 10mins ahead of time) and 9x's out of 10 they have it ready when I get there. The staff their goes out of there way to learn you name and make you feel like the care. I have noticed they have had the same staff for a while which is nice because they take the time to know you and your order. I once ordered at the wrong starbucks and they made it for me no questions asked, no fuss. This is probably one of my favorite stores. However be care if you go right before the high schools go to school, there is a large group of catholic school girls who go and if you get your in behind them you are going to have to wait a long time
Small place with limited seating inside but plenty outside. Staff was super friendly and my beverage came out fast and well made. Not much else to say.

I just love having a bit of heaven in a cup on my way to work in the morning.  Such a treat!
This location is brightly lit, clean and roomy.
Everyone we've met there has been friendly and helpful. 
The store is gearing up for Christmas and have added some pretty nice shiny bits.
Free wi-fi , nice location and great company while enjoying my hot beverage. What more can I ask?
Staff members were super friendly here. We were able to relax here after walking around the area. It was also a great place for people watching.

This is a great location to have a small business meeting and sip on some coffee or latte whichever floats your boat.  I usually don't drink Starbucks coffee because it is too strong for me but I love their Lattes and that I had today.

This location is a lot bigger than other locations in the area.  They have nice comfy sofas and lots more seating available than most Starbucks.  The noise level was not too divey.  We were able to conduct a small meeting at one of the tables and also take advantage of the free WiFi with little noise or distraction. This also have countertop seating with port connectors for your electronic devices. 

The service was fast and efficient.  Starbucks has already established a known reputation for quality so it is what it is.  But I would definitely go here again I like the layout and available space at this location.

Trenton, New Jersey, is the last of the state capitals to have a Starbucks.  After 400+ years of history, it has finally arrived.  And, from the look of the place, the Green Mermaid spared little expense in designing this java joint. It is large, bright and original.  Cut in a triangular shape at the corner of Front Street and South Warren Street, on the first floor of a State office building, the two outer walls are all glass, and both are lined with comfortable sitting areas for work and conversation.  The back walls are painted with colorful murals of famous cityscapes - including the famous Trenton Makes Bridge across the Mighty Delaware River to Pennsylvania. 

The coffee is standard Starbucks (not my favorite), but there is something to be said for consistency.  Their reliable snacks are present, and the service is friendly, knowledgeable and efficient. Everyone gets "TO GO" cups, even those hanging out, to save on losses. 

I enjoyed the fact that this beautiful facility was actually in this Sad Sack city, as much as I enjoyed my latte and slice of lemon pound cake.  I watched as people filtered in and out.  No one seemed to be taking the space for granted.  The gold balloons didn't let that happen. 

I allowed myself a moment of pride and gratification for this city that has been down so long that Starbucks is a very big win. Let's hope it is the beginning of a renaissance that has been awaited since Washington surprised the Hessians on a cold Christmas morn.

Another update:  this group consistency saves my collective consciousness with the always consistent London Fog.  I was first introduced to this Earl Grey Tea Latte in Denver-Colorado at the Cherry Creek SB.  This magic drink lifts me out of any morning NPR-Washington tweet review that the day is new, the nation under control and my ability to continue and affect change (if only my own) in-tact.  Thank you to all the DR staff and drive in for your smiles, wit and hard work.  Now, off to the races!

I should have left a review prior to this but after a good moment of thinking, this store has never done anything exceptional for my to even receive a star rating of high get them a 3 and this current rating is still generous to the wait for today. 
As a former Partner, I completely understand the rush, the intensity, the hustle, and the stress of Morning Coffee, especially if you haven't consumed your own coffee yet. This store definitely beats to its own drum though. I mobile order approximately the same time multiple times throughout the week, give or take a few minutes. When the app says it's gunna take 6mins to prep and my drive will be 6 minutes, one would kind of expect their order to be read and or near ready upon arrival. Well this store is never consistent. I can be half way their when I receive notification my order is ready or wait up to 20 minutes (like today 9/11/19) for my order. When I have to wait longer than 5 minutes for my order I'm slightly annoyed considering I put it in at least 6 mins prior to arrival. Not only am I waiting longer but also I'm now late for work. This is the most convenient store in my way to work and when on time it's perfect, but days like these are rough and I contemplating eating the cost of my coffee and leaving. 
Will the Partners of this store please develop a better routine to ensure efficiency of the workflow and timeless  of orders!!!!!

I really want to love this Starbucks. It's right by my house. However, I just can't love it like I'd like to. 

First of all, the service is extremely slow. I've waited in the drive thru line over 30 minutes just for a tea and a croissant. 

Secondly, good luck if you try to go inside. The location is filthy inside. I understand Starbucks get busy, but it's unacceptable for the floor to look like it hasn't been clean or moped in days. 

Lastly, pray that they get your order right. Luckily, a new Starbucks opened up off of 71st and 465. Go there instead.

The good: staff is very friendly and helpful. 

The bad:  inconsistent quality,  and inattention to the mobile app and to service items at the counter, to wit: oatmeal can be watery, dry or just right; there may, or may not, be cinnamon at the counter; there may, or may not, be those little green anti spill sticks at the counter.  Inconsistent quality of cups and lids, sometimes leading to spillage. 

The mobile app issue is an ongoing one and Starbucks seems to blow it off. The mobile app consistently shows items as "not available at this store" when in fact they are. Starbucks does s terrible job of keeping the database updated.

Okay, I have officially found my least favorite Starbucks. It was bound to happen sometimes and this location gets the crown as the worst location. Mind you, the service isn't all that bad but my main complaint is with the interior. The location is like a cheap imitation of a Starbucks. I am reliant on the chain to work. I usually go to the one on Franklin, however they are under construction right now and I needed to find one near my husband's work so I could get a few hours of writing in. The chairs here are like cheap Ikea chairs that remind me of throw backs from elementary school. The tables are tiny and cheap. It makes it difficult to work at. There are chairs, but the tables mostly face the window and on 100 degree days it gets hot quick. No thanks. 

I hate to give the place a low rating because the staff seems nice. When I have gone through the drive-thru I have gotten my orders right and they are friendly. So... it's a loss. I would give 2.5 stars if I could. There is just no reason for the poor set up of the inside and the parking lot is sort of a pain in it's design. It's not the staff's fault... so please keep that in mind when reading this review. Thanks!

This is a great Starbucks. 

Pros: Location is convenient. Staff is very friendly. Store and bathroom are kept clean. Orders are usually on point. 

Cons: Trying to get in and out of the parking lot can be puzzling. You have to hangout in the middle of the road to wait to turn left into the weird lane to get around the back of the Starbucks to the lot. Then turning left out of the parking lot is basically impossible so you have to get a little creative with your path to get back to Chippewa. 

I frequent this location often for meetings and to work, because the coffee is good and there are plenty of seats. I went 3 times last week.

It's a Starbucks. If you haven't been to one you're not living on planet earth. But this one sells wine. WINE!!

I was really excited until I got my $20+ charge for a 9 oz pour in a SUPER dirty glass. Yes, I probably should have said something, but I didn't think it would help.

If you want coffee after you land or before before you take off, come to Starbucks. But if you're seeking a glass of wine while at the Tampa airport, you might want to opt for the Hard Rock or P. F. Chang's instead. You're welcome.

Just like everyone else I enjoy Starbucks but the one thing I didn't enjoy was today I went to try their  cloud macchiato unless you like to pay for a cup thats 3/4ths foam and just strong coffee with a hint of sweetness I wouldn't recommend
When Steven and Rich @Starbucks on 22nd/Kolb found out I was working at the hospital on a Saturday they donated this to give us a little thank you!  It was a wonderful start to a long day.

Trenton has great local coffee houses, but it's also nice to have a good brand name coffee chain right downtown. 
This location is in a nice corner spot. The interior is warm and welcoming, as are the baristas (Tony is our favorite). There are lots of cozy seating areas as well as tables for larger groups and meetings. 
The display cases are well stocked with a variety of food choices, even at 3:15pm.
The wall murals reflect the historic and governmental significance of the city of Trenton.
They are also open until 7:00, well after the state workers have departed.

This morning around 9:30 am. I was going through the Starbucks drive through. I witness an altercation between two employees about the placement of credit card machine placement. One of the employee is on training I assumed. She gave me an attitude like, I didn't do anything to to lady. Just because your coe worker giving you a hard time you decided to take it out on the customer.

I frequent this Starbucks location. Generally quick & friendly service (even from the revolving door of baristas) as I always order through the mobile app before I arrive. Docking one star because the women's bathroom perpetually smells like the pachyderm exhibit at a zoo. Yuck.

Love this place because it's the only Starbucks that never gets my order wrong. BUT today was the day. First time I have ever encountered the most rude customer service. While ordering the cashier interrupts me with "can I get your name first, and repeat your order" after I pay I'm waiting for about 10 mins for my two fraps (on a non busy day) and a barista comes up to me and asks me if I was waiting for something. Um yea my order. Upon this time I had only received one frap and I was waiting for the other. Not only did she accuse me of not paying for two fraps she gives me a different order. I didn't even complain no need to argue with theses people.

I have yet to wait less than 15min for a single drink order. Often my order is incorrect when mobile ordering and takes forever, even though there always appears to be plentiful staff. Easily the slowest Starbucks location in all of the city.

Worst Starbucks I have ever been to. Used to live right around the corner so would stop by at least 3-4 times per week, but eventually stopped because they could NEVER get my order correct. A venti Americano with 15 sugar packets and cream - it's NOT that hard! At least half the time I went there and ordered that, it would be given to me without sugar or cream or both!

Love the convenience of this location for fueling up on my way to work, or just for a mid day pick me up. Worth every penny. Had the pleasure of being served by Mace (I think) in the drive thru today, and his energy alone made my trip worth while. Keep up the great work!

Typical unfriendly service. As a former employee of Starbucks it's depressing to see how customers are treated. As I came to the register there was no greeting whatsoever. The cashier just stood there leaning against the register. I asked if they had a dark roast and she just shook her head. I went ahead and ordered my drink without given any suggestion from the staff. When I went to pay with my mobile app it would not take the PayPal option. The staff member said "it didn't work". I asked why and she shrugged her shoulders. I ended up having to pay with my credit card. I did not get offered a receipt and the parting greeting was unenthusiastic and seemed like a bother. The coffee was made correctly and hot. It tasted good and had a good quality. There was no departing greeting upon receipt of my beverage.
Customer service was great, mobile order on point. Breakfast items perfectly warmed. Thanks for keeping me caffeinated.
african american girl very very rude!!! i will never visit this starbucks again. she has a nasty nasty attitude. she should not work up front bottom line!

Let me start off by saying while the drive through and parking can be extremely difficult to navigate during busy hours, this 5-Star review is for the Chippewa Starbucks staff and the food and drinks they put out.

Thanks so much for having such a fantastic staff, Chippewa Starbucks!

As far as environment, most of the product preparation area "pushes out" so that it is in the area of the store with a high roof. She left and came back an hour later lugging some possessions with her (a blanket, some plastic bag, etc.).

They probably were only able to throw the man out due to his lack of a shirt.

I ended up having to use the women's restroom.

The Starbucks on Bay to Bay has been my go-to study spot since I moved to South Tampa. True, my apt is just as close to about 3 other Starbucks locations, but I keep coming back to this one. They have all the necessities of a good study spot: plenty of tables, lots of easily accessible wall outlets, free wifi, a steady supply of caffeine and snacks, and clean bathroom. Most importantly, somehow the layout of this particular shop allows for pretty good seating compared to all the others I've been to. There has yet to be a time I came and there wasn't a table to study at. There's also a larger table in the back that offers lots of surface area for the laptops and books (and drinks!) for when I'm studying with a friend. Otherwise, I tend to pick to sit along the cushioned bench since my poor bottom can't handle extended periods on hard, wooden chairs.

Thanks to some serious study sessions, I'm a Starbucks gold member (yea baby ;D) and can get free refills on my drink. So, I can stay well caffeinated without breaking the bank (I am a poor student after all). The staff are super friendly... and when things are slow, they sometimes dish out free samples of some yummy pastries or drinks to everyone in the shop, which always makes my day. I'm a sucker for some freebies!

I was also able to take advantage of the Target Circle discount of 20% off all drinks on my order. Target has discount coupons frequently available through their app - a definite advantage of going to a Starbucks inside of a Target.
I come to this Starbucks Weekly and they never disappoint! The staff is always polite and never gets my order wrong.

Right around the corner from the popular donut store..

How can anyone resist a vanilla latte, extra hot to go with a devils food cake donut??..

Fast, and efficient!

Perfect location!

Employee was friendly, and energetic!

Asking for your first name, to make a more personalized  visit...

It works!

I was pretty happy (& my coworkers even happier) to see a Starbucks open up close to home,  somewhere I can swing by on my way to work, which isn't often but still a nice treat! This location has a good sized shared parking lot,  but I think the drive thru is the preferred choice for what I saw. 

Inside is spacious,  clean and bright. The staff seemed to work in sync. Ordering was easy as pie and quick. I did ask the barista making the drinks if they were labeled since 3 of the 4 drinks I was picking up had almond milk instead, and they were. Side note,  probably the best pumpkin spiced latte I've ever had.. I of course couldn't pass up trying an almond crossiant which was delicious warmed up. 

I saw a few customers had preordered and they were able to get their stuffs quick & easy too.

This was such a good Starbucks but recently customer service is really hurting. I waited 25 minutes for a Frappuccino and the girls working the line laughed when I asked them about my drink. There seems to be a lot of new hires so maybe that's why they're taking so long but the attitudes are uncalled for.

I just wanna give a shot out to the employees for continuing to show up and keep this store open during Covid. It can get busy and I watch these guys work fast and hard every time I come inside. So thanks guys!!! Happy new year!

Kimberly is the rudest employee ever. I walked up to order and she looked at me and said, what? I asked her a few questions about the drinks they had on posters above her and she said, it's up to u, order whatever u want but I can't decide for u. She's super rude and worthless for customer service. Don't go here.

Im not one to rave about Starbucks- in fact they're more of a roadtrip/in a pinch kind of place for me usually. But I live by this Starbucks at Nippers Corner, and have found myself going to it often. It feels more friendly and comfortable inside that the vibe I get from most Starbucks (more fast-paced in and out), and I actually really enjoy staying here to sit and work, or chat with a friend. The barista are really friendly and kind- which probably contributes to the comfortable vibe I get. I dig getting a black iced tea or a nonfat iced chai when Im in!

By far the worst customer service at a Starbucks in town! We've been at this location a few times and every time we go it's just a poor experience but this time I was just extra annoyed. We ordered a venti green tea latte and the guy hands us the drink in a grande size, I let him know we actually ordered/paid for a venti and he proceeds to give us a venti cup FILLED TO THE BRIM WITH ALL ICE and pours the grande size drink over it‍ not what I was asking for! Especially given the fact that these drinks aren't cheap so it's not an everyday splurge for us; so disappointed!

Anytime I come to relax and need space to study, this a comfortable location.  BUT do not count on Food here! The hours that might be spent here BRING OWN edibles. Unfortunately, even occasionally cake pops and pastries are the only options ... Too bad this location does not recognize the supply & demand, you can expect a mere " sorry we are all out " and nothing more. C'mon seize the opportunity to offer something to provide an overall positive experience ( or profitable Corp transaction ). Starbucks customers- whether these orders are by APP or in person for food or Drinks, be prepared for the consistent and easy "sorry we are out of..." with a smile.

Can we have a discussion about this Matcha Lemonade?!?! So delicious!!! I mean if I didn't have self control I'd probably order one every day. And this sausage sandwich was so good - you didn't need to add anything to it!!!! Flaky biscuit and juicy sausage made it the perfect breakfast meal!!!

Still slow service. If there was a different location the same distance away in a different direction I would go there.  They made my drink wrong again. Order a Venti Cool Lime Refresher with Black Tea Instead of Water. I get a Venti Cool Lime Refresher NO Water. HUH?  Then I get what I ordered but the cup has what looks like coffee grounds floating in it. Sigh. Been over 10 minutes since I ordered.

I'm a contrarian it seems with respect to my rating of this Starbucks. I was surprised to see a 2 star rating ... especially with my many experiences over the last few years. Yes, it gets busy with USF students camping at tables but generally easy to get a spot even at the communal table with power plugs. For those who complained about dirty tables, well if we all cleaned after we were done then ... just saying. 

Today, the order was prepared quickly and exactly as ordered. Greetings and order processing. Solid. Very Berry Hibiscus with light ice and 2 berry scoops. Check. I had a previous instance they made the wrong order after someone got distracted when someone else was asking about it, but they took care of it right away. 

Haven't tried the drive through but it always looks busy. But I'll take stepping in to enjoy my beverage of choice.

Your "third place." It's like your "fourth meal," but with comfort and class. Starbucks isn't just where your order your caffeine fix and leave, it's where the baristas know your name, drink and ask you how your kids are doing in school. They are constantly trained to perfection. They want your drink right every time at every location. Consistency is key. If it's not right, they will make it so and compensate you for your time and money spent. Starbucks isn't all about profit, it's about you. You're the one spending $5 on your daily latte -- it should be perfect and if it's not, you should let them know. I am a little biased, seeing as I used to work for this company, but every time I walk in here, I feel like family and the vast majority of the partners have no idea who I am. I have walked in here having a royally horrendous day and left feeling amazing.

So this Starbucks is just freaking amazing I can make a mobile order and by the time I make it to the store and is ready for pickup. Not just a regular pickup at that. But the employees are smiling working hard and dancing your coffee to you during this Christmas holiday season. if you woke up on the wrong side of the bed the employees will change that in an instant. This Starbucks gives you all the liquid courage you need to begin your day, get you through the day or to end your day on a positive note. I can definitely see this business hanging around for years to come. A+ for cleanliness, A + 4 speed, and definitely an A+ for service.
Once I got out of the Yuppie 500 off of racetrack route 3 and the app wasn't working so I had to go inside and search the menu there everything else was just peachy...

Help your Baristas OUT Starbucks! I literally just experienced a sweatshop this morning.  After waiting 40 minutes I left having paid but without my order.  Unbelievably understaffed.  Poor management, poor young people behind the counter.

They are always closed! No reason just hit or miss if they are closed. It's 1045 am and cones in front of the drive thru and they are locked. This is the 10th time I've been so irritated that they decide to close shop. Get new managers!

This is one of my fave Sbux in town. I also frequent the 6th Speedway location as well as the Kino Marketplace location. Parking at this one is less ideal but service is more consistent and drinks are served quickly. The newly locked bathrooms in all location are a pain but these ones are always clean. Also, there's usually ample space here to spread out and and work as well as a large shaded patio.

Every since I found out about this new location, I have been coming here rather than the location on Grant & Swan. This location is A LOT more spacious and has more setting, compared to the other location. It also doesn't get as much foot traffic nor are there people just taking up space in the cafe just to use the free wi-fi.

It seems to be a lot cleaner and more efficient flow, since the counter space for the drink orders is bigger. Overall, there's not too much to stay about a Starbucks cafe, since they are all kind of modeled to fit a certain mold, but I do like this location more than the other one that is close by.

In terms of tables, they have a large central table with outlets underneath, and some other outlets set up around the cafe in the back and on the side. There's also a small stylish seating area in the corner with sofa/couch-like seats, for a more relaxed look and feel.
During busy hours expect to order an hour in advance this place moves at a snails pace don't even bother unless you literally have nothing going on

As far as Starbucks go, this one is a good one! We always stop through here after having Mollie's for lunch on our way up to our family vacation. 

The service has always been very good and I don't recall having to wait too long.

It's even better now because it's the first Starbucks that I've been to that has La Boulange! Very tasty and excited to see it at more stores!!

My favorite starbucks! Almost wish they could have a drive thru:/ and need a little more staffing in the mornings! Otherwise super personal and friendly! They know the names of all their guests and are super friendly!t

Your standard run of the mill Starbucks. The staff are friendly and the baristas are good at what they're doing. I came during a pretty slow hour so I got my cold brew instantly. Everything else you needed at the side counter for sugar and cream were in stock and organized which is usually a rare case. Definitely a convenient location for people staying at the Marriott hotel.

I'm honored to say that for my 200th check in at this location, I had my favorite, final coffee prior to giving up coffee for lent 2021. I ordered a grande, hot flat white. It had the perfect amount of milk frothy goodness and it hit the spot on a cold evening. Yes, sometimes the baristas get overwhelmed and mess up an order but they are only human. We make mistakes and learn from them. If you respectfully ask your barista to remake your drink, they will happily do so. One reason why I keep coming back. Starbucks is my guilty pleasure.
This location has declined. The drive thru line is always 10+ minutes long, which is so ridiculous.

Do not buy a Starbucks glass or bring your own glass because they will get confused and slow your order. People who ordered after me got their ordered first. Very irresponsible and fucked up placed. The manager should feels ashamed.

If you have another Starbucks location you can go to, save yourself the time & go there. I've been going here for a few months and it's been the same routine consistently. I'll be going to another location..FINALLY. I'm not a review person, but I felt it was necessary. If you do mobile order, your drink gets put behind the counter, probably for COVID reasons..but when you walk in, none of the employees want to acknowledge you or even look up. You're basically just standing in there to watch how long an employee can act like you're not there before they accidentally look up. If you go here for a mobile order, you will watch your drink slowly melt on the shelf before it's handed to you. When you are acknowledged, you are just a burden for taking a quick 5 seconds out of their day. If anything, just risk going through the drive-thru, that way you can't be ignored.
Took forever and what we ordered didn't taste like normal, the barista did give us a free coffee to try which was very good.  So five stars for that.

Minus one star because, I ordered me the new Strawberry Funnel Cake Frappuccino with Coffee in Vente and got a small straw and NO Coffee. It's my birthday so I got it for free and shouldn't complain. 
But come on Man! 
The drive they folks were very friendly and wished me happy birthday but I wasn't gonna turn around

Lovely Starbucks in a great locations surrounded by other nice restaurants and shop.
I love the outdoor seating, and the design of the interior.

Especially appreciate Beethoven being played during my visit--not the usual coffeehouse playlist.

First time at this location, well it is brand new. Stopped in to take advantage of double star day and some pumpkin spice goodies! Got a Grande PSL and a Pumpkin Cream Cheese Muffin. I got the muffin warmed and it was perfect for dunking in my latte. Tasted SOOOOO good! My latte was hot and delicious with cold whipped cream on top. Very clean and spacious interior. I sat in a counter height chair down at the end of the prep area, very comfortable!

You can always expect a wait if you're planning to come through the drive-thru here. They almost always have a line in the drive-thru lane. So be forewarned.

That said, the staff here has always been friendly and chatty (as they can be while still working). The parking lot and interior fills up quickly most days if you're planning to camp out for a bit. 

Other than that, it's a pretty standard Starbucks. They just happen to have a drive-thru and a sizable parking lot.

2.5 stars to be fair.

Anyway, the staff here is fantastic. I think just about every barista/partner I have encountered has been friendly (not in the overbearing way) and courteous. There is adequate seating but could definitely use more as this is the only location in the Montecito/East Beach area. Frankly, my issue here is the fact that I think this place is terribly managed. They ALWAYS seem to be understaffed. Every single time I enter there is ALWAYS a line for both the register AND waiting for drinks to be made, if it be 8am, 1pm or 4pm. I don't understand why they don't meet the need of the customers and employ more people/have more people on the floor at all times. Also, the tables (both indoor and out) are always covered with crumbs and debris. This leads me to believe that they are always so slammed at the bar/register that no one can afford the time to tidy the rest of the shop.

Born and raised in Seattle, I am a coffee snob so I try to patronize independent coffee shops. That being said, there is something to be said about the familiar chain! (Free drip refills while I am sitting and doing work/reading doesn't hurt, either). 

Hire more people/staff up your register and bar! There is clearly the demand at this location to put an extra person or two on the floor.

Bottom line: I shouldn't have to wait for 5-9 minutes to order and have my drink ready. That's downright unacceptable. Shout out to the baristas who are friendly and keep cool under pressure.

This is the dirtiest place.  Tables not cleaned, floor full of trash and food bits.  Condiments- half and half, milk pitchers completely empty.  Watched as they slowed down with patrons, and they just stand around.  Finally one of the employees started to sweep the floor, but hardly finished the work.  Just a disgusting Starbucks- should be ashamed as this store has been renovated in the "new" airport.  They need new management.

I come to this one if I'm desperate. They always have an attitude and people are always behind the counter with one person working on the orders in the store, while roughly 3-4 people were at the drive thru. I'm tired of coming to this store and they're rude and inconsiderate.  I will say from now on, I just will wait and go to the one in the mall.

Tried the PSL. Full disclosure: I don't like pumpkins, pumpkin pies, pumpkin seeds, pumpkin strudel, or anything else you can could slap together to mask the nasty flavor of pumpkin. 

HOWEVER, PSL FTW. It's more spice than pumpkin, so it gets a thumbs-up and a slot on my weekly to-do list while it's still around. 

This location is small very fast. If there's a line, don't get discouraged.
I always get great service when I get here.  Very friendly people!  Starbucks always seems to be consistent;).

This Starbucks seems to have a negative energy to it compared to other Starbucks. Usually Starbucks baristas are pretty friendly and the drinks are at least good, but here the baristas appear cranky and produce meh drinks.

The baristas always seem so grouchy for some reason. I am beginning to wonder if this stems from management.

One instance that stands out was one time a month or so ago I ordered a Venti Very Berry refresher. Google that drink. See how dark pink it is? The one I got was very light pink, and had a ton of ice. I tasted it and it was tasted very watered down. I have rarely complained about a Starbucks drink, but when I have the baristas are always happy to redo the drink. When I asked about this drink and how I thought it was more diluted than usual, the one barista (that I think was the supervisor) said, "Well do you want it without water? Because it has water in it so it's going to be somewhat watered down." Why on Earth would I want a drink of pure flavored syrup? What kind of snide remark was that? The barista (who wasn't particularly pleasant either) who made it said it was because she ran out of berries so that's why it wasn't as dark as usual. She offered to remake it. She remade it, and guess what? This time it was remade properly. Interesting. 

I feel like the drinks I get from here are never that good. I'd rather drive a bit more and go to the one at 96th and Meridian or even the one inside the Target. Even if the drink turns out meh, at least the baristas are pleasant!
Nice cashier, but they forgot my sandwich. Manager said "it should be coming up," but I had to get back in line so they actually would take my request seriously.

Location, Location, Location

I LOLed big time when I saw this Starbucks being built.

United Airline Pilots used to have a saying ... "I love the smell of Starbucks and Jet Fuel in the morning" they even made T-Shirts with the slogan.

Well now the workers of the Ina Road Regional Wastewater Reclamation Facility which BORDERS this Starbucks on three sides, a plant that treats up to 35 Million Gallons of Sewage a day, have a slightly different saying .... 

Who doesn't love Starbucks though ... 

Five stars for this bold entrepreneur who erected this particular Starbucks!

I've gotten coffee there many times over the years. Today I got a strawberry cream frap with coconut milk. Today they didn't sub for coconut milk, and I can't even drink my drink. The bottoms of the cups were absolutely soaked in coffee, spilling all over the inside of my car. It's been bad the last several times I've gone, but today was the final straw with that. I tried chalking it up to the whole covid situation till now, but it's just bad.

When this Starbucks location opened, I was thrilled. It is beautifully appointed and the Baristas are always cheerful and friendly.

Unfortunately over the past month, I have grown disappointed. I would say 70% of my drink orders are woefully inconsistent, or incorrect. For some reason, I can never seem to get a drink that tastes the way I've come to expect from Starbucks. Often they are too sweet, or too weak, espresso shots forgotten, etc. I've grown weary of requesting a redo every time, so I've begun to take the drinks home and alter them so they taste the way they used to on the first try from Starbucks. This includes brewing more coffee and adding it to overly sweetened/milked beverages. 

I'm sorry to say today's drink order from this location will be my last. There are three other Starbucks within a five-block radius and although I enjoy the ambiance and Baristas here, nothing beats a properly made drink.

I visited the Starbuck's location at 55th Lafayette Rd at about 9:15am on a Tuesday morning. There were about 10 cars in front of me in the drive-thru and the inside was closed for walk-in customers. It took approximately 10 minutes to reach the mic where I could place my order and another 12 minutes or so to receive my Caramel Macchiato and Pumpkin Spice Latte. The drinks were delicious, of course.

I went through the drive thru today and apparently their "grease trap" has been leaking and it smells AWUL all around the building so awful that it left my car REEKING of this smell. I think I drove over the leak while in the drive thru because the smell is so pungent. This happened 8/9/21.

Omg! I'm usually not a Starbucks person, but came in today to try something cold. I wanted a nice fruity drink, but was indecisive on what I wanted. The barista, Laurin, came to the rescue! She told me "this drink will change your life!" SHE WAS NOT JOKING! after I sipped this frozen strawberry lemonade w/ strawberry purée  drizzled on the side... I stood up and twirled around!.

The atmosphere here is amazing! And it's cranberry bliss time.
In the middle of the day on a Sunday ordering and second car before window and waiting 10+ minutes and no car moving is poor for business.

My son and I went into  starbucks in ofallon illinois one friday evening before work and the guy that took our order didnt bother to get our food part of the order but the girls behind us he quickly got theirs. I had ordered the banana bread because the top piece of the last 2 pieces had a lot of nuts. Needless to say the girls behind us ordered it also and since he got theirs before me I got the piece that had 2 pieces of nuts in it. It took 10 minutes for us to get our drinks and 6 people got their orders  before my son was tired of waiting and asked if we could please get the rest of our order.  Needless to say we were late to work. This happened 2 fridays ago and I am just now getting to say something because I was so upset at the awful service inside.
It's Starbucks not much to say. You could got to a local place and get a better cup of coffee but if in a hurry this is your place.

i had to take place my order to pick up at this location because the one on citrus was out of most ingredients today. i ordered about 12 drinks. if i was at work and someone ordered 12 drinks... i'd probably hate my fucking life, too. told the girl im picking my mobile order up and they had my drinks in one corner and i stood there waiting for them to give me my drinks. some point, i asked her can i bring some drinks to my car and come back to get the rest. dont really know what happened but i ended up reaching over to get my drinks and put them in cup holders!! :-) i kindly asked her if the girl wouldnt mind pushing my drinks towards me because i couldnt reach that far. i didnt want to keep bothering her either. im just going to stick with the one on citrus.

This is definitely my favorite Starbucks location in all of Reno/Sparks. The baristas are so friendly, always smiling and make me not want to leave the drive thru (forget the line behind me because I'm having too much fun.) 

The only location I feel practices consistency and accuracy every time by making my drink perfect every time I arrive.

The employees were friendly and polite.  However, the trash can right outside the door was overflowing and made for an unpleasant first impression.  The mango dragonfruit lemonade was tasteless and watered down.  The chai tea latte was super sweet.

What are the hours of this Starbucks??? And who in the world owns this location?!? It feels like the employees just pick the day they want the store to be open and what times they want it to be open. Thank to a Sunday at 11 am and it's closed. I have driven here at least 5 times around 2pm in the middle of the week and the store is just closed. Is this location closing down? I'm just very confused. Don't waste your time driving here. It will probably be closed anyway. This picture is from a month ago. And it's still up.

My husband and I live in Montecito and come every morning to this Starbucks. 

Although most of the employees are wonderful, there is one Barista that is  consistently rude to my Family.. her name is NINA. 

Based on her behaviors, she always ignores us, delivers an angry stare and refuses to even acknowledge us..she's like the DEVIL working at Starbucks. 

We are fascinated Starbucks is grossly negligent
by supporting a hostile workplace by allowing  and supporting this behavior.

She/NINA Truly believes she is entitled to be rude and hostile  to her customers.... What's up with that Starbucks?

My Family Is  starting to Boycott this Starbucks for supporting hostile behavior in the workplace...as we are starting to try out other 
coffee venues in the Montecito area.

Get with it Starbucks, don't allow one hostile Barrista to destroy your business.

Truly,

I've been to this location twice while shopping in the area. It is not convenient due to no drive-thru and hard to find parking during busy times, but the location is clean, large and has a nice ambiance. However, both times I was here I had to wait long for my drink. The first time here, I placed my order and went to the pick up area. There was nobody in line behind me, and the order taker started cleaning up around the register area. The barista walked away and took some dirty items in the back. I waited and waited for the barista to come back and she didn't. Nor did she say anything when she walked away. The cashier came over a few minutes later and started making my drink. While making my drink the barista came back and started cleaning up but again looked down the entire time. The drink tasted good but some courtesy would have been nice. The second time was today and when I walked in a lady was standing at the register talking to the cashier. I stood at the register waiting to place my order and they both acted like they didn't see me. The customer continued talking about a child and dangerous fever temps and the cashier was sooo interested in what she had to say. I inched my way in between them so that the cashier would acknowledge me and take my order. Who has time to wait while they are talking about fevers? He was friendly while taking my order. His name was Parker. After my order I went to the waiting area and once again as soon as I got there, the barista walked in the back with some creamer containers. She didn't say a word. When Parker seen this he came over and started making my drink. When the barista came back out from the back, she continued filling cream containers and didn't even look up. Once again my drink tasted good, so that's a plus.

The baristas who are at the drink stations should learn some customer service skills. Also, if a customer is in line do not walk away until you've made their order.

Today I got my usual drink, it's the venti Caffe vanilla Frappuccino. Man oh man I have never had my coffee taste so good. I like my drinks sweet but I also like to taste of coffee and I could taste both this time. Service was wasn't really as friendly as other experiences but it was definitely efficient I didn't have to wait very long. I've been to this location a couple of times before and never had any complaints. I don't really live in south Reno so its not a Starbucks that I would frequent but if I'm in the area I will return.

They always make my drinks perfectly here! The barista Kay especially was so so nice! I was so frazzled getting my drink size wrong, but Kay was so sweet and understanding!  Thank you so much Kay!! You're awesome and made my day!!

It's insane how slow this location is. I had gone in to get a tea and there was only one barista on the bar. She told me it was going to take a while for her to take my order I waited over 30 minutes in line as I got up to the register she left the kiosk right away and didn't come back for a while so I just left. Very disappointed and the quality of the drinks aren't great.
SLOWEST Starbucks on the planet.  This time it took 15-20 minutes to get a drink.  It always takes much longer for a drink here than other Starbucks.

I asked one of the workers there if they had anything for a sore throat!  She made me a medicine ball!! I thought it was so nice of her, she could have just gave me some tea with honey!! Everton working there was extremely nice too!!

I haven't really had a problem with this location other than sometimes my drink will look different everytime they make it if I order the same one. But today I woke up late and I was planning on ordering and running over before they closed but on grubhub y'all cancelled my order twice and I didn't know why. I think you should fix the times you can order on there so I don't have to waste a 15 minute walk to get over there for them to finally tell me they were closed.
Drive thru was a bit on the slow side, and the employees seem a bit forgetful, but that could be because they are overwhelmed at this point in life. My order came out correctly.

Let me start by saying I am a Starbucks fan, I do enjoy the friendly customer service I receive at this location and this is why I continue to return time and time again.  However Id like to understand why it is you have signature drinks such as white chocolate mocha for example and I am certain each staff member is trained on how to make such drinks with the proper measurements of ingredients being added, thus making it a signature drink that if you order it, it should at least have that familiar taste to it each and every time.  For the life of me, I cant seem to figure out why that isn't the case at least not in my experience to this location.  I generally get the same drinks each time, however depending on the person working it can taste as unfamiliar to me as the person serving the drink.  All Id like to know is why? If everyone is making the same drinks nothing extra is being added or removed, how come I cant seem to get the same drink each time with the same expectant taste I came here for?
Bought a venti coffee and it was barely over half full. The coffee was also made wrong. I worked in a very busy Starbucks location for over 2 years . It's not hard to make things correctly

Horrible service. After 15 min waiting on a drink, when I asked the barista, she said she didn't have my order and ignored me. Like I didn't exist...  I had to return back in line to have the cashier help me. When he asked her about my drink, she said she already made it.... well, how about you make it again since I didn't get it? And not let me waste another 5 min?
Beware the crazy Russian lady who insists all hot lattes come with at least one pump of vanilla syrup whether you ask for it or not...

Some of the best service  I have had ever!  Ordered on the app, it was ready in less time than estimated!  Then as I'm going in my husband decides he would like something also...I ask if I can have another and they just whip it up!  Friendly, courteous, excellent service!

During the week, it's fine. On a Sunday morning, absolute mess. I get it, it's busy. But when I say light ice & they give extra ice or ask for a hot latte and they offer me a cold one, I get a little annoyed.  The line is long which is good for them, but the staff is clearly disheveled.
Love this place! I am a regular here and the staff always so pleasant and kind and really do their best! Thank you guys for going above and beyond!!

I am appalled by the service at this location. I arrived at the bookstore with more than 45 minutes to spare before my next class (at 2:42 pm). This should be enough time to grab a Starbucks and make it to class on time, right? WRONG. Although the location was busy, it was by far not as busy as I have seen it in the past or as busy as it usually gets during more popular times. So, I first stood in line for about 15 minutes and when i finally made it to the front of the line, the barista stepped away from the cash register to have a conversation with a coworker. After standing right in front of them for another few minutes, the barista decides that then would be an appropriate time to take my order. After I had my order taken, I proceeded to wait 27 MINUTES for my iced tea. When I was finally handed my iced tea, the cup was dripping tea down the sides and the lid was not properly put on. Then, thirsty as ever, I took a sip of my tea (note: i order the same beverage ever. single. day.) and was shocked by the taste (or lack thereof) of my drink. The water with a shot of peach bubbles they had made me was absolutely atrocious, not to mention that i had also completely run out of time and now had to sprint to my 3:30 class. I have now learnt my lesson and will from today on, only go to the Starbucks at the library. 0 stars. Will not return.

I ordered a chocolate croissant and a grande-size cookie crumble mocha frappuccino at the Starbucks Cafe inside the Safeway at Oracle and Ina. The croissant ($2.95) was nothing special, but the frapp was great. The regular price of the frapp is $5.35, but with a Safeway digital coupon and a Safeway Club card it was only $2.00. Great deal, and certainly kept me caffeinated while I shopped.

Usually they're very good; but last Time they got my order wrong (was supposed to be iced instead). Normally that would be okay, I don't mind waiting and people make mistakes, but then they used dairy milk instead of oat milk in the replacement. I am lactose intolerant, so now I will be in pain for a couple days. 
Just need to pay more attention to the label and what people say over the intercom.

Friday, February 5, 2021 at 5:52 PM:

It's very unorganized at this store. It's not that busy and they have multiple people working. I did a mobile order and I went in to pick it up. There's one person in front of me whose also waiting. The coffees are sitting right behind the counter. After taking her time, waiting on a customer and then moving around for another few minutes and totally ignoring us, the woman finally says "Are you waiting for orders?" No we're just standing here for the fun of it. 

She gave me my coffee and forget the bakery item. Then she put it in the microwave without asking me. I didn't want it heated up. Meanwhile, my coffee is getting cold and the whipped cream is melting. Being that the coffees were made and we were standing there, she should have gotten us out the door in less than five minutes. That's why you do mobile orders, so you don't have to wait. Very poor customer service.

Barista taking my order decided to dissect my coffee verbally and  drag out the ordering process. I've ordered the same coffee forever. It's not that complicated. It was as if she needed to prove she knew something about coffee in general, for no good reason, confuse me about my own order, and hold up the line in the process. Now I have a headache on top of needing coffee! Also, after all of that knowledge she attempted to drop (Yep! You guessed it!!) she fixed my coffee wrong!  I'm hoping to not need coffee in this area ever again. If so, I'll keep driving to the next Starbucks.

New Years Eve, the store front sign says they are open until 6pm - it was 5:20pm when I arrived and the drive through was coned off and the door locked. We were ignored at the door as the staff was closing up inside. I understand holidays, wanting to leave early - but as someone who works in customer service- that is poor practice.

Love this Starbucks. The crew working is so kind and fun (usually) and they want to get your day started right!  Thankful for Starbucks black coffee not breakfast and lattes or tea for lunch. 

Up for something different, try a matcha latte. 
Up for something new, try their Nitro brew. 
Up for the most delicious tea, try Peach Tranquility!  
And if you aren't feeling the best, ask for the Medicine Ball Drink -- it's delish! 

Love Starbucks for its typical consistency

Do not go to this Starbucks!  The lines are long, the service is slow and, after inquiring as to why my venti iced tea was nearly $4.50 vs. $3.00 at every other Starbucks, I was rudely told they were a licensed store and could make their own rules and, by they way, they would not refill my $4.50 tea.  The non-company owned stores in airports and hotels damage the brand of Starbucks and should be eliminated.  Horrible experience all the way around.

I usually don't review chains like this because well, it's a chain and I always think they are pretty similar. Starbucks is Starbucks, right? Wrong. I have been finding myself at more and more Starbucks in Nashville because my boyfriend needs to study and loves their rewards program. I don't drink coffee but I do love their non-coffee drinks. I sometimes tag along with him when he has free drink points or if I just need to get out of the house. After testing most of the Starbucks in the area, I will say this one is my least favorite. Pros: it has a parking lot and the staff is always friendly. Cons: the parking lot is always busy, drinks take awhile to make, and the store itself is tiny. This location always seems to be busy no matter what time of day we come. It's on the corner of a chain of stores which are mostly restaurants. It also shares a parking lot with Walmart. This makes parking tough at all times. I usually find the Starbucks to be decently spacious and comfortable. Here, I always feel like sardines packed into a can. The drinks take a long time to make and there isn't really room to wait. I always feel like I'm in the way. There are a limited amount of tables and chairs. The tables are really small. They have tables outside which can be kind of peaceful on a nice day, but the noise from the parking lot kind of ruins the mood of going to a coffee shop. Like I said, the service is always friendly and I don't blame them for the chaos that ensues at this location. They can only work so fast when people are ordering on the app and also in the store. So to make a long story short, if you need a quick coffee, maybe choose a different location. If you need a comfortable and quiet place to study, maybe choose another location.

Finished this grande iced matcha latte with almond milk in .7 seconds! What a ripoff! Fast service but I've been FOOLED. I would recommend asking for NO ICE or ONE (1) ICE! The few drops I was able to drink were delicious but that was $5 thrown right down the toilet!

They run out of small stuff often (lavender, honey, dehydrated fruit, etc) but the drive thru staff are always helpful and nice. I got my drink today because someone recommended it and it's goood. Line is typically long but it moves at a decent pace.

Service here was incredibly prompt and friendly. The cashier/barista did not have a name on his name tag, so I can't shout out his great personality - but he made an otherwise droll caffeine procurement ritual a little cheerier (something particularly scarce in an airport).

I ordered my usual flat white, extra hot, extra shot, 2% milk, and it somehow tastes different than usual. Not in a bad way. It tastes great, but I can't put my finger on why! If he accidentally used whole milk (which is the only reason I can think of for it tasting richer), I'm not mad about it. This drink is delicious!

Thank you, nameless Starbucks man. I definitely recommend hitting up this SB if you're in airside A waiting for your flight. There is one more café on the other side of the terminal, Bay Coffee and Tea, but sometimes you just need your SB fix (and double stars)!

Probably one of the best Starbucks I've been to! Most Starbucks are usually super loud/ crowded.. but to my surprise I've been able to get a good amount of work done here. Only issue I had in the beginning was the wifi not working. However, the problem's solved. There are a bunch of outlets around the store for your laptop, phone, etc

I've never had a problem with my orders here and always get it in a timely matter.  The employees are friendly and the customer service is good.
Great drive through!  The line is always backed up, however you get in and out pretty quick.  The customer service is wonderful.

the worker asked me what food I wanted and then another worker took my drink order and forgot to charge me for the food and then came up to me and told me I had to pay because it was my fault I didn't tell her about the food. bad customer service and didn't have anything in stock.

Its starbucks so it's awesome. But the last FIVE times I've been, they messed up my order. Its not a complicated order. White chocolate mocha Frappechinno. Theyve guven me an iced coffee three times... really disappointed,  never coming back and its disappointing because its a block away from my workplace. Always new people working too. They need to get it together.
Ordered a venti chai latte and was given a venti cup, but the amount was that of a tall, and it was a soy latte! Good knowing I paid $6 for 8 ounces for the wrong drink.
Extremely poor customer service. Its evident that customers patronize this location purely for the brand.

It's the quick service that keeps me coming back! I am a Starbucks gold member so I'm frequently spending my money here. In the mornings I use the drive-thru right before work around 8am. The drive-thru line is all the way to the street. Usually that would discourage me but not at this location. I know that I will have my order (done correctly) within the next 5 minutes. I am not sure how they do it but it's like magic! 

I break my neck to go to this Starbucks only! Even tho they are quick, the service is still quality! When I pull up to the window I feel like they care about me and my order. That's what keeps me coming back! Love this location!!!

After work I went to this location for a hot vanilla latte, instead I was given a cold vanilla latte. I wanted to change it but somehow there was nobody in the counter all of a sudden. I did not bother waiting as I needed to get home. Did not like the service and wouldn't be coming back anytime soon.

This Starbucks located in the Winthrop plaza has a very nice design to it. The workers inside are always friendly after I come and always quick to fill orders and make them just right. It's located close to Publix and some restaurants so it's a nice place to stop by after visiting these places. There are plenty of chairs outside for those winter months when you want to have some hot coffee and read a good book outside. Inside, the couches are extremely comfortable and people always seem to be on their laptops looking all cool and productive.

This place is always so packed with cars going to the drive-through. Since the Starbucks it's only drive-through right now. So that wait can be a little bit longer just because they are not doing anything inside. So if you plan to go to the Starbucks here just make sure you give yourself enough time. They always seem to get my order right which is super nice. The barista's are super friendly. And I know they are trying their best with how busy they probably get. I hope one day they can up inside again, it would make the wait less for me since I only order through the app for the most part. And it makes it pointless to do that if you have to wait in line with everybody else. But it is what it is.

I was visiting from out of town and this was the closest Starbucks. I usually get the same thing when I go to Starbucks but started to try different options. They made everything great every time. I went to starbucks maybe 10 out of the 20 days i was in town.
Visited here on 7/24/2014 at 3:10 PM. Jessica took our order.  I will cut this short and simply day that Jessica was not only curt and short with us, she was rude.

This is "my" Sbux. It's busy all of the time so the drive thru can take For.Ev.Er. 
I have never had a poor customer service experience besides the wait and I'm hear nearly every day.
jessica has been long gone and like many businesses, this starbucks is under staffed or regularly has longer wait times and just inefficient service.

The worst caramel macchiato I've ever had. I am a frequent Starbucks drinker and caramel macchiato is my go to drink before work almost every morning. I was on a road trip from Tennessee to Chicago stopped by this Starbucks location to pick up my regular order and I don't know how they messed up one of their most popular menu items but it taste disgusting! I'm not sure if the milk is bad or the coffee was watered down but it does not meet Starbucks standards. I have never felt the need to leave a bad review anywhere until now. So disappointed!

They need to work on some things. I know it's a new location but the drive thru should not take 30 minutes and I asked for the same drink I always get, Americano with cream and sugar. I got some milky watered down thing that doesn't taste like there is even an espresso in it.
i shop here for coffee one time and now my daughter is married to a caramel frappuccini!!!!  I regret bring my family to america!!!!!!

The staff was very friendly.  We stopped on our way to Busch Gardens for some snacks and drinks.  As expected, the drinks were quickly made, and there were plenty of snacks to choose from.

The bathrooms were also very clean, which can be hit or miss so this was a plus.


Overall, it's an easy in and out for a quick stop.

This starbucks is BY FAR the worst Starbucks. I always wait a while and come back to give them another try and it never goes well. 9 out of 10 drinks I've ordered have been wrong. Very rarely do I have an interaction with a friendly employee there. Most of them have attitudes. Every time I leave this location, it's never been a good experience.

This Starbucks is in my neighborhood.  A go-to place, in case of emergency, when I needed coffee pronto.  I came here somewhat early in the morning, on our way to a day trip to Sacramento, and there was a line.  But, I'm happy to say, the line moved fast, and my coffee was prepared quickly.  Now I can stay awake during the 2-hr drive.
Very nice location and layout with outdoor chairs and shade. Excellent service.
Great service!  I had a birthday treat that didn't show up on my card and the friendly barista gave it to me, no questions asked!  I appreciate such a friendly face and a nice welcoming attitude.

There is a barista who works here named Joseph and he is the sunniest happiest person ever. I couldn't keep such a huge energy output up all day and have no idea how he always manages to be so sunny. 
As a bonus he (and his team members) are really amazing at making coffee. I have a really particular order (I know I know I'm sorry for being one of those people!!!) and i haven't been disappointed once when I pick it up on my way into work!

I came here on my birthday and explained to them that my free drink didn't pop up on the app. They didn't bother to help besides scan my rewards. They still charged me for my drink and I still ended up paying $17 for the stuff I got. They also ran out of the sausage and cheddar sandwich like what is this? Popeyes? Thanks starbucks for helping me on my birthday! NOT!

Today i went to buy a  couple of  ice teas.  two of my ice teas came right a way but then they ran out of the ice tea i wanted.  Also there were a few other situations happening in the store but the gentleman came up to me and said the tea would take 5 mins to steep and asked if i mind waiting or would i like something else.  I said i would wait, understanding that sometimes things can get a Little frantic in the service industry.  In about five minutes i received my ice tea as well as two free coupons for the next time i visit.  I was very impress with the way the gentleman handled the situation and i guess it is true good things come to those who wait.  Definitely will be returning and not just because of the free coffee...haha
The workers here are all polite. The facility is clean. The coffee on the other hand is not the best. They mess up their ratios between coffee sugar and milk.

This place is always out of everything. No pumpkin, no white chocolate etc then you have to sit in line just to leave because of the drive thru! Terrible experience every time I try this location. Save yourself time and frustration, go to another location.
Rude and untimely baristas.   It is hard to get a basic coffee in a timely manner.   Bad service across the board.

This used to be my go to Starbucks. Any time I'm back in St. Louis for business or personal trips, I make sure to stop by and get some coffee. 

No real experiences with the store since summer of 2021, but my almost daily experiences with them consisted of fast, accurate service from when they opened this store (late 2013 I think?) to fall of 2019.

I will agree with one other reviewer who mentioned the uncleanliness of the bathrooms. The one I used smelled awful, with papers scattered around on the floor and an emergency light dangling precariously from its wires.

Typical S'Bucks. Staff is friendly and quick. Seating is decent, but no plugs at the big high-top table in the middle of the shop.

Classic Starbucks experience, ordered my typical iced vanilla latte, and drink was on point. Took them less than four minutes to have my order ready. 

The store is a bit small but there were plenty of two person tables and the staff made sure the keep the place clean while I was there. 

On a random note, I noticed that almost everyone around me was simply drinking water. Not sure if this is a trend but I can see how staff may be a bit displeased when people come in, order water, and stick around for their free wifi.

My coffee spot for almost four years now. Love the locals too, but this is close to my daily grind. The baristas here make it feel local for sure.

With so many people going in and out, parking lot confusion happens quickly - especially on weekdays. Not to mention the entire shopping center is a pain to get out of, regardless which direction you're headed.
Worst starbucks I seen in a while took me twenty minutes to get a strawberry acai so definitely avoid this one.
This location has officially CLOSED very sad day it was in a very convenient location quick off and on access

No starbucks cards accepted, but not only that the receipt is Marriott not starbucks so you get no star credit or anything on their app program. Also, here, Cappuccino and Latte are apparently the same thing here, and both are too hot to drink right away.

They are fast though and they are well, starbucks.

The stores hours do not match what is listed in the app. Over the past year I've wasted several trips because the app (and Apple Maps) says they are open when, in fact, they were not. Please make your ACTUAL store hours up to date on the app and elsewhere. Inform your customers.

I visit this Starbucks often about 3 times a week.  This location is usually pretty busy and the staff is often efficient. My blonde roast coffee w steamed cream is just right each time. I tried the caramel apple cookies this holiday season and I was not impressed but the stuffed stuffed mini bagels that I have been getting  are now a favorite to me.

Baristas work hard as this location is always SLAMMED with customers. I used to be able to put a mobile order in and count on it being ready when I got there. I don't know what happened in the last few weeks but every time I have put a mobile order in I've had to wait up to 20 minutes in the lobby for my order. So I'm taking a break from Starbucks for awhile. It's really disappointing.

Everytime I come to this Starbucks they always make my Frappuccino's the very best. The base is never too liquidy nor too icy. Big plus is they're very generous with the toppings. I ask for extra caramel drizzle and whipped cream and they always deliver.

I think this location does a great job, much better than Royersford with speed, card reloading is never an issue and I know how hard Starbucks employees work. My little cousin got treated awful at the Blue Bell location. Kudos to you guys! :) And to the guy who always remembers my name! Very nice people.

I had a terrible experience here and will not be returning. I ordered the new iced  brown sugar oatmilk shaken espresso and what I received was nothing like it. I've ordered the drink before at other Starbucks and it was always made perfectly , but this one was nothing compared to it. It was sooo watery and tasted like milk and water. I even went back in to let them know so it could be re made, still received the same exact drink.
