I posted a picture of what it's supposed to look like since I had it before and a picture of what I received. Two different drinks. Do not go here. They do not know how to make their drinks.
Dang waited like 15 mins for a caramel Frap and then wasn't even told it was ready so now I drink a non frozen frap, awesome service

Always nice. The store is kept clean you are served quickly even when it's busy. The regulars are treated well which is important. This is also the only location I've found that will sell you tea bags which some people may think is odd to mention but I like it and find it convenient. All others will give you a hard time about it. This is my favorite Starbucks to go

Really concerned this is rotten milk... I just spent $13 for this one drink to be delivered to me and it smells and tastes off. I think I'm going to have to dump it  Ive never seen chunky white stuff in my caramel macchiato before. Not to mention there's some black spots if you look closely

I'm so happy with this new Starbucks location. Not only is it super convenient but all of the workers show nothing, but kindness every single time I go. Even when I'm confused about something they go over the top and are patient. I've never been disappointed by them or their drink making skills! Not to mention I loved the vibe of their open mic when I went. If it wasn't for the pandemic I'd go every time! Thank you all

Little tip: order ahead on the app and walk in to pick up because the line can get long being that there aren't many Starbucks around here.

You can't go wrong with Star B's but then again you can because Star B's is not the cheapest or most consistent coffee shop you could go to. I have had some pretty boss coffee at other locations but I always come back to Star B's for the purest of the pure shit! Lol

I normally do a white mocha frap with xtra carmel. It's a violation if they give me coffee and I say xtra and there is just a few drizzles on the top! Day ruined cause I have to get out, come in, look you in the eye and tell you you didn't follow the damn sticker on the cup that clearly says xtra carmel! This happens quite often at this location and others I've gone to. I find it best to just have a person you prefer to make your coffee on request to get it exactly how you like it. 

Today I went with a simple carmel iced coffee that was Delish except it kind of tasted like grease but that could be the carmel. The plus side to today's stop was that the car in front of me was in the pay it forward mood and bought my drink! I love you whoever you are!
Racist employees. Wearing BLM espousing their views.  Not in uniform. Corporate policy is not to and yet he was allowed ?   Why?

My recommendation is to avoid this Starbucks. The staff while knowledgeable are not the most professional. 

After paying for my drink with my phone and being informed I was good, one of the employees informed me a few moments later,  that my Starbucks card didn't have any money on it, I informed him, I was redeeming my gold stars reward, and not paying with my Starbucks balance, at which point the employee pointed out, the Starbuck was acquired by the owners of Greenwood Park Mall, Simon and they didn't accept the Starbucks rewards.  What kind of cheap place is this? 

This place is a franchise ripoff WITH low QUALITY service and mediocre drinks, all under the great  Starbucks brand. What a sham.

Although the drinks aren't always made 100% correctly, this is a great location. Conveniently located in the Winthrop plaza, there are plenty of work spaces and a nice outdoor seating area. Service is always friendly.

Every time I go here I have to go when I know I don't have anywhere to be. I always know it's going to be at least a half hour wait in the drive thru. I see cars leaving all the time because it is taking way too long. I've left several times before as well. Hire some more baristas Starbucks. You shouldn't have an issue hiring right now, people think it's "cool" to make drinks.

I really like this location.  It's close to Indy Humane, where I actively foster and volunteer. I began stopping here when I pick up a dog from Indy Humane to take out for a walk and a treat, so I could get treats for both my pooch friend and I. The baristas here are use to seeing people and their furry friends from Indy Humane and are typically quite generous with the "Pup Cups." Service is always on point and my Starbucks go-to of hot Peppermint Mocha and warm banana bread, pure purrfection.

Happy vibe at this Starbucks! The baristas are so personable. Quite often I am greeted by name and my drink is already being prepared. I was particularly impressed with Elmer, who gave five star service every time- equivalent to somewhere like the Rosewood or Four Seasons.  Great place to chill and do work on the computer as well.

What a complete shit show! Since the old crew left, this Starbucks has gone down the shitter. The drive thru customers get served before the walk in customer's. If your lucky your mobile order will be ready when you get there. 
Drive thru is as disaster! It is filled with Main Line Mom's in their Black Range Rovers that order for their entire family. 
Parking sucks because the Main Line Mom's don't know how to drive their Black Range Rovers! Now that the Wayne Starbucks is closing this place is going to be a disaster. I will only you the Starbucks in Target from now on.

The Clay Terrace Starbucks is a good representation of the brand, although it is a little small. The service is good and the drinks well prepared. A great stop if you are already here shopping, but not worth a special trip.

Their patio is completely covered - no tables under umbrellas (although there are still umbrellas, I guess for double coverage).  This is awesome.  The bases of those umbrellas are deceptively heavy - and I've moved them probably hundreds of times - and they make me look foolish every time I try to shift them around to keep the sun off of the black metal tables that immediately hit a surface temperature of 900C when in the sun.  So a completely covered patio is awesome in my book.  

Clean, seemed well-stocked, and they didn't mess up my iced coffee (or take long to make it, which sends me into a blinding rage if there's no line and I don't get it in less than a minute).  So nice work Bay To Bay Bux.

I've been to this particular store multiple times.  They never get it right.  Wether in the drive through or inside.  They make my drink wrong, or they make my drink and put it to the side, while I stand directly in front of them for 10 minutes waiting for them to hand me the item.  At one  point I was trying to get an employees attention to get a straw.  After a while I reached over and got it myself.  Somehow that got the employees attention, to which they advised me to call for assistance. I end up at this particular store because it's right across the street from my home.  Usually when I remember the crap service I prefer to drive 10 min down the street to the other Starbucks.  I gave them two stars for the sole fact I like Starbucks coffee.

Fantastic Starbucks.  They not only have a drive through but also outdoor seating as well.   They are the quickest Starbucks I have ever been to.  Some things that I noticed a little differently at this one than the Starbucks I have been to in the past is that all four employees wore headsets, I am assuming to communicate with each other.  They also print out little stickers and place them on the cups of what you are ordering, verses writing it out with a sharpie marker.  This Starbucks is still clean...the chairs inside are comfy and there the armrest is big enough to place a coffee on the it.  The employees were much friendlier than my neighborhood Starbucks...

It's nice that there is a full service Starbucks in the C terminal now. However, the staff was a little short with several customers including myself. So if you know what you want, know how Starbucks ordering "works", and don't ask any questions you will be ok. Otherwise, you may want to get coffee elsewhere.
I'm not a big fan of Starbucks in general, but when I stop in here, the employees are so friendly! My drinks with special instructions are always made correctly.

Don't come here if you're in a hurry.  They cannot keep up with the volume.  I placed an online order and went through the drive thru to pick up.  I waited in the drive thru line for over 15 mins.  I would highly recommend they manage their staff and resources better, especially in such a high traffic location.

This Store overtime has consistently become the worst customer experience for four reasons.

1. Order Accuracy

I order the same simple coffee item every day, 
And they get it wrong 4/10. It doesn't sound like much, but if your time is money it's very frustrating.

2. Homeless

The sanitary conditions of the homeless, deliver pathogens into the enclosed conditions such as a store. They refuse to wear a mask and to add insult to injury they occupy the only outlets with electricity.

Come on Starbucks, your a private company and this is private property..when do non paying come before paying customers?

3. Battista To Cashier Communication

Today I asked the Barista after she got my order wrong again, where is the disconnect today, did the cashier transfer the correct order and you delivered incorrectly or what? 

She said "yes the order was correct but I didn't know what to do". 

Hmm with this reply  I'm thinking..she was not trained, she's not focused or she's the wrong person for this job...based on my opinion it's all three. 

are these baristas ever held accountable or supervised?

Unfortunately, I work in Montecito  and this is the only starbucks.

If you are in a time crunch & are used to quick service, this is NOT the Starbucks for you. This isn't my "regular" Starbucks, I don't think I have a regular one as I only do Starbucks a couple times a month. I visit different ones each time I go, as there are 3 Starbucks within 5 miles from where I live. This location however I did visit 2 nights in a row because I was in the area and craving a Venti Caramel Frappuccino (9 months pregnant!). Last night the drive-thru had maybe 4-5 cars in the line and it took us almost 30 minutes to get my 1 drink! When we pulled up to the window finally, they hadn't even made the drink yet! Luckily we didn't have anywhere we needed to be by a certain time. Tonight we do drive-thru again and this time it's us, plus 2 other cars in the line. We waited 10 minutes for the same 1 drink, and at least this time the drink was ready when we got up to the window. Otherwise I'd have to give this location 2 stars. It has to be the management because at any given time, when I come to this particular location the drive-thru is a long wait.

Brutal.  Wife called for two coffees and a sandwich. Stood there for 30 mins waiting. Finally asked and they said they'll make it.  I said I'm leaving take it off the tab.  Worst service ever and still haven't gotten my refund.

This Starbucks is part of my rotation of three that I patronize when I'm in South City. The staff is friendly and my drinks are generally made correctly. Typical for your local Starbucks. One thing I have to warn you about with this location is the drive thru. This gets busy and you can enter from both directions of the parking lot. When you come off the street you sometimes cannot initially pull in leaving you waiting in the street blocking traffic. Other times when you are pulling in from the opposite direction as someone else it becomes a game of chicken in which I have seen several patrons fight over who was actually next to pull forward. While this location is closer to my house I will pass it and go to Kingshighway if I see this occurring otherwise I prefer the drinks at this location.

Update: As much as I wanted to believe they had improved on their espresso drink making skills my trip yesterday was really disappointing. My husband had stopped ordering espresso macchiatos here due to them being made incorrectly more times than not. It should be espresso with just a dollop of foam. The last time I got one for him it was decent so we started ordering them again. But yesterday I got him one and it felt light so I thought it was made correctly but we got home and it was just espresso shots with no foam. I checked the cup sticker from the drive thru and it said the correct item. My husband drove back and talked to them about it and suggested some staff education for quality improvement as Starbucks is not cheap coffee. They didn't offer much of an apology and just offered to remake it for him or give him $4 towards his next visit. I will continue coming here for convenience since it's hard to mess up an iced latte but my husband will not be coming here any longer.
Always have friendly staff when I'm here. Nice environment in the Bywater. Nice lighting in the building by the way. Nice play for a little meeting.

Warm coffee and did not warm banana nut bread 
Need better service 
Cold snowy day and served chilled coffee
This is by far the worst Starbucks in Arizona. Staff is terrible and they are always out of things. If its not sugar, its stoppers, its straws. Terrible service

I'm usually not a huge fan of Starbucks, but this is a great space. It's huge, with plenty of places to hang out. There's a community room for group meetings, which I think is just awesome, and there's art on the walls that pay respect to being in Trenton. Definitely a place to get coffee and hang around if in the area.

This is a review for the Starbucks in the Southwest terminal.  We had a good experience here, as the line moved quickly and our food/drink orders were correct and tasty.  The bacon gouda was a hit, as was the turkey bacon egg sandwich.  Quick service before a morning flight.

CUSTOMER SERVICE HERE SUCKS!!!!  I stopped at this location for my usual coffee and I was not acknowledged by non of the employees. There was a guy making drinks who made eye contact with me and did not acknowledge my presence. There was a lady at the counter who also did not say anything to me but she sure was able to have a non work related conversation with another customer. I come from customer service background and I know acknowledging the customer is a big deal. There's plenty of other Starbucks in the area that I can go to and will go cause they will treat their customers the right way

the worst star bucks around.  everyone is inept and the drive thru on a good day is super slow. i just waited 30 min to be told at the window to pull my car up because my breakfast takes a while to cook. so in other words we just started your order now. it's consistently late and consistently slow.

Slow, backed up drive thru all the time.  Don't get the orders right.  You'll wait forever inside.  Not incredibly friendly staff.  This is the closest Starbucks to my house but I'll go to the Chippewa/landsdowne one instead- that store rocks.

This location gets worse every visit , you barely get greeted anymore. This morning I saw the employee with the most attitude training a newhire . I'm going to have to give myself more time in the morning to go to a different location.

(+) interior decor is amazing, they really optimized the space and there's plenty of space

(-) Kylie was our barista and made both my friend and my drinks hot instead of iced. I am not sure how that happens twice when she asked us for confirmation. As a customer it kind of made it look like I was being difficult but I wasn't, it's not what J ordered. Other Starbucks let you keep the wrong drink but she just took it back. We sat down and then someone came over to give the second iced drink but then didn't give a straw with it. Small things!

I love the employees here! They are so kind, especially Christine and Adam! I come here many times a week and they always greet me with smiles and make me feel welcome. It's a highlight in my day! The drinks are always delicious and even if they mess up, they assure me they will remake it! Terrific service! I love coming here and recommend it completely!
Slowest drive through I have ever been to. Avoid this place. Nobody took my order on the speaker, the wait was over 20 minutes for 2 coffees. And... why is the cafe closed? Drive through only?

HUGE shout-out to the morning shift working Friday October 9th! I came in the morning prior and the barista complimented me and I gave her a compliment back and that alone made my morning because who doesn't love a compliment? The next morning (this morning) I came in and was in the back of the line and she came over and asked what I was drinking and took my order even though there was like 5 people before me. After that she pulled me to the front and let me go ahead and pay. Its a simple act of kindness and it really impacted my morning!  If there is any managers reading this or Starbucks the company, her name is Tory and shes awesome! Everyone working this morning was extremely friendly and awesome but defiantly a big shout-out to Tory!

This place has that BARISTA ATTITUDE that gives good coffee a bad rap. Unlike most other STARBUCKS, this crew really thinks they are made of the RIGHT STUFF. I'm not saying all are Luke this, but it's a vibe. The place is new and has a rather cold modern style that takes itself a little too seriously.
I was denied service for not wearing a mask. This location discriminates against people with medical exemptions. Took my business to Tim Hortons who doesn't discriminate. Good job Starbucks.

This Starbucks is hit or miss... usually miss. 

They're understaffed and overcrowded the majority of the time. It's rare to walk in and out of here in under 15-20 Minutes. Hell, I blew through an entire lunch break waiting for an iced tea a couple weeks back... basically what i'm saying is, if your under a time crunch and/or really need your fix immediately. You might want to avoid stopping here. If time isn't a factor. Go for it.

The worse part of this Starbucks is the intersection you have to go through to get in there.  I swear that I spend more time sitting at red lights than I do inside the store. Obviously that is out of there control but if I'll be on time for work those lights will make me late.

The drinks are always hot and the employees are always happy, smiling and cheerful... Even at 6:30 in the morning!  They make a fine caramel macchiato! They always give my thermos a hot rinse! Extra props. 

Parking lot can get a little iffy at times. Go slow and keep your eyes peeled.

Stopped into this Starbucks for Octane Blast to get me through the morning. I've visited many of these coffee shops and this is the only one that seems to lack a certain level of organization for ordering. 

I walked in and was totally confused people standing everywhere...literally a line out the door for placing orders and receiving. I ordered a Solo Expresso Macchiato and a Blueberry Scone. They must have earned it in the microwave, because when I received it it was a blueberry brick. 

However, the overall experience was a pleasant one. The Staff was extremely accommodating...Scone was replaced and the coffee got me thru the day.

This is not my favorite Starbucks location. They often get my drink wrong and when I complained once, they were frustrated that I asked them to remake my drink. I usually don't complaint or have my drinks remake but it has happened 3 times.

One of my favorite Starbucks. Great indoor and outdoor seating, pet friendly, and fast and competent baristas.  Great location near the beach and at the top of coast village rd.  Downside: this is a high volume location and the staff doesn't seem to keep the trash cans from overflowing and the bathrooms clean.  On the last visit, the two bathrooms were almost unusable.

This Starbucks has always been the worst.  I don't know why I keep coming back.  I think they are going to change, but they don't.  Why don't I like it,  it's because it will easily take 20 mins to go through the drive thru.  I get they may be understaffed on occasion, but are they always understaffed?  If so, can these people get some help?!  Please?!  Some other locations kill it with their speed and maybe I've gotten spoiled.  But spending 20 mins + in line is ridiculous.  If they apologized at the window and said sorry for your wait, I'd still be mad, but less for sure.  I just want to drive off, but I feel like that's a crappy thing to do.   One time I ordered a breakfast wrap from here and I waited so long, my sandwich was cold by the time I got to the window.  I asked the guy if they heated it up and he laugh/smirked and was like "yah, want me to do it again".  Yes, actually I do, but I just waited in this shitshow of a line... I'll pass.

The team here handled the long line like champs! Would have been 5 stars but they forgot my hot water cup along with my order. Granted, I received my other drink and oatmeal without any issues. Also they offer some of the lowest prices in the airport for a quick snack. Plus, of course, they take Starbucks cards so you can earn your star rewards points too.

Since moving to O'Fallon from Springfield, I have visited here twice. Both times my Carmel Frap was extremely watery and no hint of Carmel flavor. There were ice chunks, and little to no whip cream or Carmel syrup (even though I asked for extra) My daughters ordered the S'mores frap, and those tasted like milk.. Very little toppings on those as well. 

I experienced other people trying to order decaf coffee and they were all out... This was at 9am!! Fruits for teas were out.... Mind you they didn't tell the customers until AFTER the order was placed and the tea was up.... 

On my second occasion I went through the drive-thru... Tried ordering a Venti, the girl on the speaker says "how about you get a Grande" I politely replied "no thank you, I would like a Venti" to which she then let's me know they are all out of Venti cups.... This was around 11a... Not sure how you run out of cups when the majority of your business is served in cups. 

They were extremely busy, so I don't know if this is a over demand kind of downfall. I believe O'Fallon itself could benefit from their own Starbucks as opposed to having one only in Shiloh and one in the mall in Fairview Heights. 

Clearly management needs to be watching quality control and be on top of order placement. I will likely not go to Starbucks as frequently due to how horrible my drinks were, the bottled fraps at the store taste better than the $5 product they gave me! 

I definitely miss my Starbucks on Freedom Drive in Springfield, IL, never had a bad experience in the 6 years we lived there. To only have bad experiences at this store in Shiloh, is disappointing. High traffic at both stores but you can definitely tell the difference in management and care to give a customer a good product.
I always enjoy coming the this Starbucks. They make drinks in a consistent way so it doesn't taste like something totally different each time. And there's a good amount of seating.

What the heck?! This Starbucks location has now entirely blocked off, with their Starbucks green cones, Campbell entrance AND exits!  They did have the Campbell exit open until now which made it convenient to leave from the drive thru window. Makes for one entrance/exit off Glenn which becomes quite the cluster you know what especially during busy times. Im contacting City of Tucson to see if that's kosher.
Starbucks I ONLY go to the one @Capital Ave. Service, appreciation, kindness, caring, & true making me happy with a smile

This a very friendly and clean Starbucks.  My favorite one close to me and have always had great service and always greeted every morning by name.  Parking is difficult in the small lot right in front of the entrance, but I park in the main parking lot on the side and have had no problems.   No drive through available otherwise one of the better Starbucks in town.

Of all the Starbucks I've been to this is THE slowest. Save yourself the trouble and just go to the one in the rest stop. The line might be intimidating in the rest stop but it actually moves faster some how.
i really like the coffee the service is great and they move fast you can walk in and out with no problem
This is absolutely not a Java chip coffee  you guys need to prepare the drinks correctly!

It's totally a Starbucks. It's Starbucks-y with accents of Starbucks, in a Starbucks theme and obvious Starbucks influences.

I wish they had more comfy chairs, not super tall tables, but that's nitpicking.

It exactly lives up to expectations. You didn't need a review to know what it was like. You're going anyway.

Why let me order a coffee on their site with option to pick up inside. When I get there the doors are locked and a sign says our drive thru is open. A drink that was ready 10 minutes ago is now 20 minutes later and I am still in the drive thru lane. If I hadn't already paid on the app I would have just cancelled.  Gave them 3 star instead of 2 star because Starbucks generally is too with customer service.

I have used their mobile order multiple times and come to the store 15 minutes later to find they aren't even open despite their hours telling me they should be open. So now they have taken my money and I have no recourse. Bad management if you aren't open when your hours say you are.

Friendly staff, but when we got our coffee, we both noticed that the cups were not nearly filled up. I asked for my latte with no foam and I got a latte with foam. I stirred at it for a while and when the foam cleared I had a cup of coffee filled to about 3/5ths of the way. My boyfriend's was the same. Here are pics of what I'm talking about. First one is mine, second is his.  Neither of us had taken a single sip of coffee yet when I took the pictures. I feel like I'm owed a dollar back on the coffee that did not fill this tall cup. :(

Everytime I go in there there's this girl named Stephanie I think (short, dark hair). She always acts super conceited and I hate the environment she puts out. Mobile Order is impossible in the morning unless someone is out there helping organise... Would only recommend this one when it's slow, don't go if you want to get out fast!!!

The people who work at this Starbucks are literally the nicest people I've encountered. I walked in a probably five employees said hello to me and two of them struck up a conversation. Also they made my drink quickly and without any errors. I really don't normally review Starbucks because they are all the same but I was struck by how friendly everyone here was!!

I work at the VA and frequently walk over to this location. Today I did the same and when I got there it said "drive through orders only" on the door and it was locked so I tried to order on the app but it said I couldn't order oat milk on the app. I ended up going to the drive through speaker and asking if I could order and she said "ma'am you can't come to the drive though" I said well I tried to order on the app and I can't go inside, and she said "due to unforeseen circumstances we can't serve you and we will reopen the main lobby again next week" ...... so I asked "if I was in a car you could serve me, but because I walked over in the middle of my shift at the hospital and your door is locked for me to go in and order you can't serve me" and she said "yes I cannot serve you" 
So that makes no sense to me I tried going in-they locked the doors due to "unforeseen circumstances" for this week only, tried ordering through the app which wouldn't let me and they wouldn't take my order. 
Had to walk back over to work without coffee and am pretty disappointed.
Best service ever? I've been to a few hundred Starbucks from work travels (worldwide) and this one stood out with it's great level of service, clean store and modern furniture. Very impressed.
Poorly run. Always a long than normal wait. Subpar drinks. Andrea is terrible. The workers seem overworked and are not friendly

I am happy to say my lid fits tightly on my cup. 
1 out of 4 visits isn't bad. I temp my coffee to 175,  so a loose fitting lid is problematic for me .

My Vanilla, non-fat, no foam  Latte was made quickly and tasted great. 

Thank you Starbucks .

I asked for very light ice and this is what I got. It's 3/4 full of ice. They don't follow directions. I know it's a first world problem but when you're paying this much for a drink, it's nice to get your money's worth, and also have your drink made how you asked for it.
Love this location.  The store itself is bright and airy and the Baristas truly care about their customers. They always go above and beyond their call of duty!

I love Starbucks in general, but the staff here really could use a little more training. Every time I order my drink it's different and every time a client orders it for me it comes out different as well. Also always very busy. Maybe a few more staff members or some free espresso for the staff. ;-)

If you've read through the other reviews, you know I'm not exaggerating when I tell you this is the SLOWEST Starbucks you'll ever go to. Seriously don't even try if you're slightly rushing. Is any management going to see these reviews and DO SOMETHING about this? I can see this place getting less and less popular for this reason, people are tired of it and not coming back.

Leaving 5 stars because the staff was amazing! A young gentleman in a pink shirt reassured me that I could use the WiFi which I desperately needed, and stay inside to work on a project despite the dining area being closed. I ordered a small drink just to buy something so I could work inside and the same guy put it on the house - so sweet! 

Really great experience here and they always get more order out quickly and accurately whenever I visit.

This place has the worst staff in the history of all starbucks!  Its only two of the employees there but they are the most rude and disrespectful of any I have ever seen.  I went in today like I do every day, I was not greeted, they did ask my name and I told them, and he kept doing what he was doing, about five or six people came in after I did and they all were greeted and were served before I was, and after that, I was finally asked again my name and the woman went right over to the station and picked it right up, it had been sitting there the entire time that I had been waiting, I said so its been there this whole time and the same one who handed it to me said you have to tell us your name and I said I did, and she shoed me and brushed me off with her hand, I called them as soon as I got into my car and asked for the managers name and the same woman told me to come and get a card my friend and HUNG UP ON ME! RUDE AND DISREPECTFUL! DO NOT GO TO THIS LOCATION IF YOU WANT A STRESS FREE DAY!

The people who work here are nice, the order is always correct and fresh. I took off a star because they are massively understaffed, which is no fault of the lovely people actually there doing the hard work. The problem with the understaffing and the drive thru is that on a Saturday morning you should expect to wait in the drive thru line for a minimum of ten full minutes. This is not an exaggeration, today I waited 13 minutes start to end. If you have somewhere to be this is super stressful, if you don't mind the wait it's fine. All employees are masked.
Love Starbucks lattes always made perfectly. Customer service is on point they are always helpful and friendly.

This is my favorite Starbucks location ever. I come every morning before work. It has a friendly, welcoming vibe, enthusiastic and kind staff, and most importantly the baristas are FAST. Even when the place is packed. Highly recommend.
I don't often frequent Starbucks, but I stop in here occasionally. This location is quiet, clean, and the people working there are always pleasant.

These guys made my day! They were all smiles and positivity. I made the mistake of sending my preorder to another location and they made it for me at Glenn and Campbell super fast on the spot. They always make me feel welcome here. It also felt very clean and safe. Plus they gave me a free Holiday cup! It doesn't get any better than that.

Really like this location. Great customer service and they have a very organized system, especially for how busy they are. They are very Covid compliant with masks and social distancing. We ordered inside and had all 4 of our drinks within 5 minutes of arrival which is pretty awesome. Love their refreshers and this time I got The Pink Drink which was delicious

Waited in line for 15 minutes to get to the window to pay to hear that they can't take my money because another person paid with a large bill. I tried to pay with a $50 so I would've been $30 change. You are telling me Starbucks don't have $30 cash in their drawers when there's always people in there?!? Girl at the window was pretty rude about it. We were in a road trip and all we wanted was some tea and coffee to keep going
Joseph did an amazing, friendly job on a large order during a very busy time. Thanks for a perfect order and even more for perfect service.

I wouldn't recommend this place for studying or having a meeting.
The tables are very very limited due to COVID but that's normal. My issue is that they are very very tiny for workspace. I barely got my computer and notebook on it and I was out of room. Thankfully my
Computer was charged bc just so happens that the tables that are available don't have outlets near them.
If you care about anything than care about this: THE CHAIRS ARE THE WORST EVER. They're half-backs so you
Can't lean back at all unless you want your spine sliced in half and they're SO WOODING AND UNCOMFORTABLE! Honestly, I think this is done on purpose...
I ordered an iced latte w mocha and Carmel and almond milk. Same thing I order at my other starbucks, same thing I order and dnd, same thing I order at buddy brew, same thing I order at cozy coffee cafe, and same thing I order at blind tiger....HERE IT WAS SOOO GROSS. After tasting it, I even had to go up and ask for extra mocha in hopes to get rid of the taste. I paid WAY MORE for it than I do at other coffee shops but threw 3/4 of it away!! Ewwww. Something must have been wrong w the milk or flavors?? 

It is also very loud. The workers weren't quiet at all and they're blending frapps every two minutes.

There's a very nice coffee shop LOCAL, that's like 1 minute from this place called Cozy Coffee Cafe. CCC has an easy to get to parking lot and will bring your drink curbside QUICKLY. Most importantly it's COMFORTABLE seating, relaxing atmosphere, and quiet!! AND LOCAL

I'm mean when Starbucks cravings call you answer!! And I can say that they never disappoint!! My go to drink is the iced green tea unsweetened. The only disappointment is that they never seem to have guava anymore. But you add guava syrup to your green tea and I've gotten people addicted!! Anyways plain iced green is also very enjoyable.
Big and spacious. Not small like typical locations. And plenty of seating outside for you to enjoy the weather and views.

Honestly this place is pretty bad. I love Starbucks & I'm a regular & literally get the same drink every single time. However this location, messes up my drink probably half the time. Today it happened again, today it was not putting the vanilla. Other days it's not using the soy milk & other days it's not using blonde roast. Idk what's up with the people that work here but it's honestly a MIRACLE when they get my drink right. Sigh, it sucks throwing away money because most of the time the drinks they give me aren't what I ordered & don't like them so i just toss them out. Im finally done with this location.

well i have an update to report and a complete turn around which is why my review went from a 1 star to 5 star! Jessica and her team are my favorite retail stop regardless if it's for coffee or anything else. She is great at making you feel like you are the only customer @ Starbucks. I now enjoy making this my first stop when i leave my house each day. Keep up the great work team Blue Bell!

the most fun you can have in a drive thru
Mark R had us LOL omg funny & helpful
everyone there is super friendly & helpful, we just get to meet them in drive thru

2 stars because on a very consistent basis I go into the restroom and it is a disaster: water everywhere, empty TP rolls next to garbage, no TP or seat covers, dirt and grime all over the floor, out of soap. I understand that this is a high-volume Starbucks and a lot of traffic comes from sandy beach-goers, but management should compensate for this by increasing frequency of bathroom checks/cleanings. It seems like a pretty simple problem with an even simpler solution, yet it remains an issue.

The worst Starbucks, not to mention the rudest one, in the city. I went there today to get my mobile order, which was suppose to be ready, and it wasn't. The staff was downright rude to the customers, plus I was rudely told to "put your mask on" when it slipped off my face for less than 5 seconds. I take COVID VERY seriously. I know people who are working on the front lines, not to mention who have caught this awful disease. I could've been politely told to fix my mask. Did I mention my order wasn't ready until 10 min AFTER I got the text that it was SUPPOSE to be ready? This Starbucks is awful. I will never go hear again.

I liked this Starbucks a lot when it opened a few years ago. It wasn't super busy because it wasn't as populated. 

But ho-leee crap has their service gone downhill. Slow slow slow. I don't know if I've ever heard anyone actually call a drink, so people cluster near the drink bar arguing over whose is whose. 

Now that everyone knows about it, they don't seem to be able to keep up with the demand.  

Send these people back to training, please. Including the cranky, antisocial managers.

I work at a Starbucks location in Indianapolis and this is by far the best location I've been to so far. We have twin babies and they were so caring, they even have a cart in the back full of books and coloring pages for kids. They were so patient with us and brought everything out to our table directly when they saw we were busy with the kids. I couldn't have asked for a better morning.

Can't go wrong with Starbucks! I got a coldbrew with almond milk and a shot of vanilla in a reusable cup. I did have to add a bit of creamer and vanilla to it but it was still tasty! The condiment bar could've used a bit of attention as far as filling up empty or almost empty containers but we made do with what was there.

this starbucks is shit. first off the line took way to long for 2 drinks. second the girl taking my order repeated it to me 7 times and still didnt get it right. then not only did my drink jist taste like water and no flavoring. the water tasted like swamp water. literal suer water. disgusting
This is my favorite starbucks but a little confused on why there's a sign in the drive thru that says "drive thru only" and absolutely no one inside.

I've been coming to this place for a while now and although the service is usually on par, it seems like the past few months their service and the quality of drinks have taken a nose dive into despair. How in the heck do you mess up an iced mocha? MOCHA not macchiato. 
Better find your A game Starbucks.

I try to be fair, but this was not a good experience.  wifi not working, store not clean and then they forgot to make my sandwich.  When I finally asked about it, they did make, microwave it.  Probably won't be back to this location.  only positive was employees were very friendly. 

 edit. was told by "Jenny" I would not be charged for refill but to ask for her because there are a lot of new employees who may not know about in house refills. She was not around and employee charged me .55.  the money is not the issue.  The lack of congruency is.

I STP in here just about every morning when I'm in town on business.  I've been coming here for about 3 years and the same great service is always given.  The lines are never to bad compared to some Starbucks.  I also like seeing the same faces year after year which means this location is a good one in my opinion to have little turnover of employees.  Great location,  will definitely return.

Should have stopped anywhere before here. Stopped for a smoothie. Thought I'd get one with protein and skip a full lunch. Ordered the Strawberry/Banana and a banana nut bread. Twenty mins later after I watch him pick up and put down my cup and make coffees for people that came in several minutes after I came, barista hands me some coffee drink. That's a smoothie? Oh I read it wrong. Then he goes to make to come back and tell me they don't have the right protein and asked if I want the new protein. Sure as long as there is no dairy. He proceeds to dump in 2 scoops then before mixing it turns to tell me that oh it does have milk in it. Uhm. Yeah. That's a problem. So now he's on his third remake of my drink. So no joke and less exaggeration it took nearly 20 min for one drink in w store with two people in front of me and one behind me (who walked out before me). $9. I could have gotten a full meal at Panera way faster. Next time.
Slowest service of any starbucks I've ever been to! If you are on a timeline DO NOT COME HERE. And they messed up my order after I waited in a SHORT drive thru line for 30 minutes! Ridiculous!

I've been to this Starbucks a bunch of times. There is no drive thru. It's in the nippers corner area of Nashville by Kroger, right in the corner. Outside seating and inside cafe seating. A little slower than most Starbucks but everything is made correct.

I started going to this Starbucks because in conveniently by my work. Every time I walk in I am greeted by all the workers. Every time there's a problem which there rarely is a barista is never hesitant to fix the problem. The Starbucks on my side of town isn't willing like this Starbucks and I wish I lived in this area because they make my day. I want to thank who I think is the manager in the morning (he carries himself like a manager) he wears glasses and is always willing. Thank you 22nd Starbucks for always giving me
A good experience.

This place had one single person working all alone taking orders and then making them. She was overwhelmed and being pestered by guests the whole time. I went to give her a tip for our drinks and she told me she isn't allowed to accept them. Why not? Hire more people or at least let them take tips they're basically doing 3 jobs for the price of one.

Yesterday for National Croissant Day there was a very nice option to donate a Croissant to the Landsdale food bank, myself and many of the customers in line, obliged the offer and donated a Croissant. After I left it dawned on me that this is not a good thing. 

We paid FULL price for the Croissant, which is around $2.60. I am sure Starbucks out-of-pocket cost per Croissant is likely much less than $2.60. Essentially customers donated more to Starbucks than the food bank. While I am glad that someone will enjoy the croissant that I donated, I truly do. I think Starbuck just increased their sales of croissants that day by ten-fold. This was a nice gesture but I think it would be better to give $3 directly to the food bank with out there being a profit for Starbucks. Or maybe Starbucks could donate the difference in price. It is a good thing just work the details out if you do this in the future. Thanks!

Wow... Went in to get a coffee for myself and a puppacino for my pooch. This is the very first Starbucks in the country that has ever wanted to charge me $.10 for a Dixie cup with whipped cream... for shame!

Especially considering you lost out on my $10 drink order to make $0.10 on a Dixie cup. Smart business move!

Service and coffee rate 5 stars but the parking lot-- both access and condition-- is horrible, so I'm docking them a star.
Most confusing entry and exit I've ever seen, but what is worse, I parked there for less than 5 minutes and came out to find my car covered in sap from a Pine tree. A storm was blowing through so perhaps the wind was unusually strong, but I'm sure this has happened to other customers who love their cars as well as coffee. I tried to call the location to report it but the phone rang unanswered. Yelpers, beware!
Editing review as I called a few days later and someone answered: She said they'd check on the tree but still no apology for the damage to my car. It may not be Starbucks' fault, but I'll still avoid this location in future.

I've given this location a few tries after initially being unimpressed. At 5:30 AM, I was one of two customers in the store, and there were four employees behind the counter. After five minutes I was finally acknowledged. I had placed a mobile order 10 minutes prior to walking in for a simple pour coffee, black (app said 3-7 minutes). Order was not ready, but worse was the less than friendly encounters with the employees. Also, this location has done away with straws for cold brewed coffees and you will be berated if you ask for a straw. Will go slightly out of my way to a different location in the future.
It's Starbucks not much to say. You could got to a local place and get a better cup of coffee but if in a hurry this is your place.

This is my favorite Starbucks in downtown Indy. The drinks come out quick and the staff are always very helpful. There is tons of parking and even outdoor patio seating. It's very spacious and the atmosphere is busy but you can always find a space for conversation or to get work done.

I'm a Starbucks loyalist. I really am. I'm also a Clay Terrace lover- I love the ambience, the selection of spots, the patio seating: all of it. With little tables outside, the Starbucks is welcoming and comforting: I used to go all thee time in high school.

This summer, I've been getting a Refresher almost every day- it's my one vice, I've decided. One double star day, I asked my friend to meet me there so we could catch up. 

We both ordered Starbucks Refreshers with lemonade- my go-to staple. Two minutes later, our names were called, orders placed on the table for pickup. My drink was notably missing both the fruit infusions and the topping of strawberries that the drink usually comes with. 

Last fall, I met someone at the same location and got myself a frappuccino. Not only was my frappuccino lukewarm, melting almost immediately, but it was missing the signature cacao nib topping and was decidedly low on flavor and whipped cream. 

I'll be sticking to the 116th and Illinois location from now on, thanks.
Great location and super fast service!  Ordered through the app and walked right in to pick it up.

When I come through your drive thru and order a $6 drink, being rude isn't the best customer service and when I ask for a straw eye rolling and lying about the straw size is also completely unnecessary!

Even in Boise, there's a Starbucks open on Christmas day! Who'dathunk?

For being a major holiday, the staff was super cool, and the drinks tasted just like any other Starbucks location (which is to be expected) and the line moved pretty quick despite a holiday rush. Ho ho ho!

This is my favorite place to grab a soy latte with my friends any day of the week. I love the vibe that I get when I go to Starbucks because it puts me in a nice mellow mood. I would definitely recommend this place!!!!!

At some point--I think after 5, maybe?--the building closes to the public and is accessible to students only. Nonetheless, this was my go-to Starbucks while at Butler and is still a gem to have on campus! Lots of happy caffeinated memories here!

Two Words: Study Spot

Out of all the Starbucks in Santa Barbara, this one is my favorite! 

I accidentally ordered a chai latte(I meant to order a brewed chai tea), and without any hesitation they changed my order. They did not give me any attitude (unlike at SOME Starbucks location). 

Sometimes, there is a long line, but I find that common at most of their locations. However, I must note that they try their best to get the line moving along.

This is a great study spot because there are plenty of tables. There are even comfortable chairs and tables outside.

I always find parking - there is a 2 hour limit. 

Best service, Best Starbucks.
Don't do drive-thru on a Saturday morning...25 mins waiting in line for one drink and two sandwiches!!  YIKES!!

i opened this review like oh this will be an easy UP as i thought of my quick trip but actually the layout of this location is (can i cuss??!?!) ..it's enough to not go back actually. i've been inside this location at least 3x and the service, cleanliness, speed, and atmosphere were fine. 

during peak hours you can't even get into the parking lot because it's a narrow angled one-way drive around. there's not enough room inside of their parking lot to accommodate the waiting cars so they sit in the street causing a traffic jam. there's other traffic from the other businesses in the suite. it's the most frustrating thing. you can't even get inside of the lot to park to order inside or grab your pickup items. 

i had actually mobile ordered and was almost involved in an accident trying to get inside. my order was sitting at the station waiting for me
I come here almost every weekend. They know my order by heart and treat me like family! My drinks always look picture perfect. Totally recommend.

The new Starbucks is so much bigger! They needed to move. I love this location! You cannot beat the views. 

The service has been great and is fast. The drive through line does get pretty long in the morning. 

The one thing I wish they would change is something over the drive through when you are getting your coffee or food. It was pouring one morning and everyone was getting soaked getting their coffee and food.

A cracked cup given to me in the drive thru filled my cup holder with coffee before I noticed it.  It's a  big crack, wished they would have been more aware of the drinks going out the window. Waited in line a long time for a mess and half of my $4 coffee  :(

What a sweet staff! I had an appointment further down North Meridian so I wanted to give this place a shot. What a sweet group working this morning!

My drink was made quick and correct and they even wished me a happy birthday as I redeemed my birthday drink! 

I hate I don't live closer but I'll stop by whenever I head downtown.

TIP: LOTS of parking out back.

I do like this Starbucks, its convenient, most of the staff are amazing, and friendly, and always in good spirits. However they all cover for one employee that drags the whole place down. Alberto. Below is a typical order with Alberto.

Me: Good morning. I would like a tall green tea, Zen, iced, plain with an everything bagel toasted with cream cheese, please.
Alberto: You want tea?
Me: Yes
Alberto: what size?
Me: Tall.
Alberto: What kind of tea?
Me: Zen.
Alberto: Hot?
Me: no, iced.
Alberto: Anything else?
Me: yes, an everything bagel, toasted with cream cheese.
Alberto: Bagel?
Me: yes.
Alberto: plain?
Me: no, everything.
Alberto: Toasted with butter.
Me: Toasted with cream cheese.
Alberto: Toasted?
Me: YES!
Alberto: (gives a price that's different every day)

I have never ordered anything else besides this combination. My friend who has been going 5 days a week for 7 years to this location, must repeat her order to him every time she goes. The rest of the staff will have her drink ready before Alberto even has a moment to pretend like he has never seen her before.

If you walk in, and the line is stretched out to the back by the side door, or the bathrooms, it will be because Alberto is on a register. There is a unity that forms in this line. Everyone know him by name. Alberto. You can hear the grumbles and mumbles in the line as everyone waits patiently for their turn to order 1 cup of morning coffee, and be charged incorrectly, by Alberto. If you order Breakfast, a bagel or a sandwich, make sure he calls it to the employee working the toaster. He forgets every time to call it back, resulting sometimes in a free drink next time you come in, but usually you just end up getting a blank stare from Alberto because by that point he has forgotten who you are, and has no idea what you want from him.

Always a pleasure to get a cool drink or some warm coffee related drink from Starbucks can't go wrong when they have what you're looking for lol...
I understand that all of the shortages are causing problems for their business as well as others so I can't complain.

I mobile ordered four drinks. They were not in a drink carrier. I was trying to ask where they were but no one acknowledged me or helped me. Pretty disappointed since there wasn't a rush or anyone waiting

Walked to this Starbucks a few days ago with the family while I was waiting for my oil to get changed. As we approached the building, I remembered that this was the Starbucks from a few years back when the guy taking my order in the drive thru was so nice, that it made my whole day better. So, walking into the store, I was ready for some friendly employees to jump at me and make that hot and humid walk we just took disappear from my memory. 

Man, did I feel silly. I walked up to the register and there was nobody behind us in line. We ended up ordering $26 worth of food/beverages, because I like extra shots of espresso, my boyfriend eats lunch sandwiches at breakfast time, and my son eats anything he can get his hands on. While I was ordering, since there was no one behind us, I was making little jokes, trying to get some personality out of the barista...I got nothing. If I'm going to sit there and order $26 worth of stuff, at least talk to me about something or give me a smile??

I move on to wait at the drink counter. The man on oven duty brings my sandwiches and banana bread over super quickly so that made me happy. Another female barista puts my first drink up and I say thank you. No response. Ok, maybe she didn't hear me. Second drink comes up, I say thank you even louder, and what do I get? A nod of the head. I get that the drive thru is packed. You have 4-5 employees focused on mainly that area. Normally if the drive through is your busiest area and main source of revenue, it of course makes sense to put your best people over there. But don't train your employees to treat your cafe customers like they are inconveniencing you. Once again, I will throw my Starbucks knowledge out there and tell you guys that I used to work at two different Starbucks locations. The second location I worked at had a drive thru and most of our sales were from that window. But even if we were slammed, I enjoyed taking orders from cafe customers because I could get to know them. It's a way more personal interaction and there is no sliding window slamming shut after each sentence you say. 

After we had been sitting outside for a while (on their really nice and comfy patio furniture), I went back up to the drink counter to ask a different barista for a grande ice water whenever he got a second. He said, "ya hold on a minute". A fellow employee passed by him and he passed the message along that I wanted an ice water. What???? It takes 20 seconds at the most to put ice in a cup, fill it with water, lid it, and pass me a straw. This blew my mind. About three minutes later when he realized that that employee either didn't hear his request or ignored it, he took the 20 seconds to make my water. Even though I was upset, I said thank you and he gives me back a 'mmmhmmm'. 

I honestly don't know what Starbucks is doing anymore when they train their employees. When I was trained, emphasis was on customer service. Now I go into a store, and all I can rely on is a decent drink and a few stars to go to my next drink reward. I think Starbucks is a great company that treats their employees so well but I really do wish they would put their effort back into customer service. This visit was so disappointing.
I've never seen such fast working Starbucks employees! They get the job done and move on to the next in lightening speed. Wish they were this fast at my local Starbucks.

Although I enjoy an almost daily latte from this Starbucks location (and overall have had good experiences with pleasant baristas and my latte made correctly and decent wait time to pick up my drink) my biggest complaint is parking. It's always packed inside and out. Instead of folks parking down the street (or perhaps across the street?) when the lot is full, people make their own parking spots where it is clearly marked no parking. Inevitably, this leads to a mess trying to back out of an actual parking space. I truly wish they would expand their parking lot due to the high demand. In addition, they would benefit from another mobile pick up order parking spot!

Hey boys behind the counter stop talking with each other and do your job!! 

They don't provide customer service as they are to busy talking band crap! I have to say WORST iced coffee I ever had!! I went back in and they did nothing to fix their screw up! It's times like this I miss home! Nothing like the Starbucks in Pikes Market!!! Seattle couldn't screw up coffee if they tried! Lol

I won't return, and this experience really left a bad taste in my mouth for Starbucks :(

The staff was really nice and helpful, but the coffee is not well made. The latte and macchiato I ordered tasted like iced milk with very little coffee. So I tried an Americano, but still no luck it was extremely watered down.

Yooooo WTF!!!! Yoooo how's that even possible! Yooooo! They have only one background music and yooooo it's so terrible! Yooooooo! I stayed here for 30 minutes! Yoooo that stupid song is driving me crazy yoooo! WTF

Not a great outing to this Starbucks yesterday evening. After an afternoon in Goleta / Isla Vista, we weren't ready to go home yet. Dear Hubby suggested getting a cold drink at a Starbucks, and hanging out for a bit. We thought about potential venues in Santa Barbara, and didn't have success, even driving down State Street from Upper State all the way to the beach.

We did note that State was full of tourists and locals as the afternoon waned, which was good to see.  We'll have to check out all the new businesses on the area south of the 101 soon.

We were considering heading to Ventura, but DH noted that there was a patio area on one whole side of the Montecito Starbucks.  He went inside to order, while I scoped out a table. Apparently, they were short-staffed on a busy day, because the trash can was overflowing, and every single table on the patio was dirty.  Not just dusty, but with rings of sticky gooey leftover memories of Frappucinos past.

I went inside in search of napkins and water to clean one myself.  They don't offer a water dispenser or pitcher of water.  I grabbed napkins and asked DH to add a water to whatever else he was ordering. He didn't realize that it was for the table.  I couldn't get water from the restrooms at that time, as both were occupied.

Once a cup of ice water became available, I doused the table and wiped up the previous goo.  That led to noticing how much debris was left on the ground in the patio area, as well.  The whole exterior needed some attention from the cleanliness patrol.

An outdoor stay at this location includes lots of ambient freeway noise, as the 101 runs beside Coast Village Road.  We were treated to a long Amtrak train heading south on the far side of the freeway. Busy travel corridor!  I would say that this is not the most restful Starbucks venue.  It was a shame to see it lacking for attention to cleaning on this last stop.

Be prepared to wait a looooooooong time for your order if you go to this Starbucks. I've never had to wait as long at any other Starbucks as I have at this one. Granted, there are always tons of cars in the drive-through, which obviously slows things down, but it's always been like that and management should have figured out by now that they need to schedule more workers to help speed things up. But when you finally get your oder, it always tastes great, and even with them being slammed my order is always correct. The workers manning the drive-through window are always friendly too.
This location is still fairly new, it's slowly getting better ... I find that the drinks aren't made the same consistently. The parking lot is awkward, however the staff is super friendly,
The staff is not the friendliest and even the customers that were there were not very nice.  But it is conveniently located off the freeway

I hate that this is the only Starbucks close to my work because it has the absolute worst customer service of any Starbucks I've ever been to.

 I always order ahead and do a mobile order so that I can come in and grab my drink and go but there have been multiple times where I have to wait 5 minutes for my drink because the dumb ass teenagers who work there are too busy standing at the register doing nothing.

Once I came in and there were a few people standing by the window where you receive your drinks, so I asked the girl at the register- with short blond hair (who was doing absolutely nothing at the time) if she could hand me my mobile order and she told me to wait at the window with the other people. There was a guy making multiple drinks, so I stood there and waited five minutes and he was too busy to hand me my drink, so I went back to the girl with short blond hair and asked her to hand me my drink. She handed it to me and then proceeded to chastise me about how busy they were.

Today I went in and asked for my order and the guy handed me my order then ran outside. It was the wrong order, it was for someone else with the same name. I told the girl who was wiping down counters that the guy handed me the wrong order and she said, "Oh no." Then proceeded to ignore me and continue wiping down the counter. I had to flag the cashier down who was busy taking orders at the register and ask her to hand me my drink.

These are only two examples. There are more but this review is already too long.
Don't like the environment. Get's too crowded and unorganized. Most workers just seem over it and not super willing to help. Never see the people I liked working there anymore :(
Base on that s order experience, barista that helped me was super friendly and quick with order.  Good and clean environment with other barista cleaning and sipping the huge sitting areas.

Update your hours!!!!! 
Made an intentional trip here and you're not open. 
Also, Kroger employee has no clue the hour of opening. We count on you guys to give accurate info and know what's going on! 
Geez.

This is supposed that be a peppermint mocha Frappuccino which normally contains coffee. It was so light. No coffee and definitely no mocha. The worst drink I've ever had at a starbucks, will not be coming back. Highly don't recommend.

Today is the third time in a row I have done a mobile order at this same location and all three times my order has taken extensively longer than the approximated time.  The last time I did a mobile order for travelers it took 45 minutes!  No apologizes, just excuses.  Terrible customer service.  Today I tried again to place a mobile order for the same Starbucks at 7am on a Sunday.  The expected time frame for drink and snack to be ready was 3-5 min.  After 15 minutes I politely asked if our orders were almost ready and discovered that they hadn't even looked at the mobile orders we placed and started the orders.  Total time was 25 minutes for a latte....disappointing to say the least.  At least this last time they did give us coupons for a free drink in the future which we appreciated.  Just hope they will improve their customer service and improve their time expectancy as provided on the app.
Happy staff. Running special during the time I was in St. Louis. Quick service. Will walk the extra blocks to visit this location.

Who doesn't love Starbucks!? This by far is my fave location. It's close to my parents house when I'm
Visiting and I can easily grab them a treat when visiting them!! The location is always kept clean, the customer service is always appropriate and especially since Covid they have made arrangements to remove some tables and spread out so individuals can come in and work! My normal go tos  are iced coffees and skinny vanilla lattes! They make them just right! The parking can be somewhat full at times and the lines can be really long but I'm patient so I understand I may not be able to drive up and be served immediately as others should understand lol. There was a time when I had to get my drink redone and the employees were so nice about it to fix whatever was wrong. 

Pros 
Customer service 
Covid friendly 
Drinks are perf 

Cons 
Parking at times 
Lines are long 

I'll be back. Probably today  love me some coffee!
This is the worst Starbucks for several reasons: 1. The patrons come from poor areas from SB to pretentious their no way rich and as a result they are very rude and uncivil

If you go when no one else is here, it is pretty on point. But below I will outline several issues that you should not have to face:

1) Terrible lines and poorly managed lines. I get it, this is on campus, so there are bound to be huge lines of students wanting coffee. During a lot of points one register is open but they will open up the second one to accommodate the line. But instead of making things better, this just means more people are standing in a crowded corner waiting for food. They also don't have a great system to get more people making drinks. I've been here several times when there are 40 people (not kidding) standing waiting for a drink, there is one person on a register, one making hot drinks, one making cold drinks, and there are then just two other baristas hanging around doing nothing. Just chatting. 

2) There is Tap-N-Go confusion. The UA campus uses this mobile ordering service so imagine a line out the door, which is enough to deal with. Well then there are 40 other people ordering from the service. So now you have 80 people waiting for drinks, and 2 people making drinks. 

3) Constant confusion on orders. This place is independently owned so they don't follow all of the normal rules/procedures/prices. Sometimes this leads to confusion. A drink I may order off-campus is sometimes up to 1$ cheaper. Half the time they want to charge you for ice. I once was charged TO TAKE ICE OUT OF A TEA! I said "no ice in the iced tea though" because I did not want it to be too cold, and the register actually charged me 50 cents. REALLY?! So there is some confusion in terms of pricing... but there is sometimes drink flavor issues too. Just depends on who is working. 

4) They rush. They rush a lot (there are 80 drinks to be made!) and end up making simple mistakes. Like a drink will say no whipped cream, they put it on. I usually just scrape it off (dairy aversion) and don't mind, but these are little mistakes they should not be making. 

5) Today I arrived at 8:58am and was in line. I was the 5th person in line and ordered at 9:02, which was pretty good. And then I did not get my latte until 9:33. Here are some of the reasons why: 

     (a) One of the baristas making drinks was working on two hot beverages when I was ordering and then, all of the sudden, she stops working and comes around the counter with the two drinks and gives them to two of her male friends that have just walked in. No mobile order info on the drinks. They did not pay. She proceeds to spend 8+ minutes talking to them while the line/drinks keep backing up. HUGE issue. When there are paying customers in line and a flood of people, employees should not be taking time to give free drinks to friends, and spending time chatting. She was an employee in a black shirt, so I think maybe one of the managerial employees. HUGE issue for me. I was rather annoyed. 
     
     (b) One of the guys making coffee messes up an order. A girl tells him it is the wrong drink, he realized the mistake, starts remaking it. Makes the SAME mistake again. We now have a hold up there. Another employee rushes over to save the day and tells the girl "How about you just take these two and we call it even?" HUGE issue for me. Poor customer service, poor attention to detail, ugh. 

     (c) Line is out the door. Mobile orders are stacking up and now people are waiting for them. Two people at the register. Two making drinks. THREE standing over by the oven that bakes things. They are making NOTHING and are doing NOTHING. Not even offering to attempt to help the two people swamped with orders. 

There are a lot of employees here that I love. They make me come in (as does the fact I work nearby and am always on campus) because I just like seeing them. But as a whole, this place lacks when it comes to employee training. 

If I ever see another employee make two free drinks for friends, then stop working to come chat with friends--mark my words, corporate will be hearing about it. So unprofessional it left a bad taste in my mouth all day.

This Starbucks is almost always busy... ESPECIALLY in the mornings.. it does have a drive- thru, but I wouldn't recommend stopping here before work or class unless you have an extra 15-20 minutes because the line both inside and at the drive thru gets ridiculous... placing a mobile order would probably cut the time down to 5-10 minutes to navigate your way through the super packed parking lot (there's not a lot of parking) and depending on which way your commuting trying to go southbound from this intersection is a nightmare! 

This location is always well kept, it's very clean and all the employees are exceptional, but I had to rate it 3 stars because of the lack of parking, the nightmare of a maze that shopping plaza is (especially in the mornings) and because I'm not a huge fan of the remodel. This is a small location, and there has always been a shortage on seating, there's a few chairs outside and a few tables inside but for some reason it feels a lot smaller since they rearranged everything and remodeled. It doesn't give me the "bring your laptop, grab a coffee and chill here" vibe I crave from a Starbucks.

We arrived at this Starbucks right as they were closing during a severe thunderstorm. We had our screaming baby, but the employees at this location welcomed us in, even as they were preparing to close, gave us free coffee, and waited out the worst part of the storm with us. When we were ready to leave one of the employees even walked us out to the car with our diaper bag and helped us get safely in to the car!

They went above and beyond and it made a big impact. We will definitely stop at this location the next time we are close by!

The service here is adequate.  The parking is so hard to use!  They have three spots by their dumpster and you may have to camp out waiting to get out of two of them if someone parks in front of the dumpster which is a legitimate parking spot.   They have signs everywhere stating you will be towed if you are not a Starbucks customer. I dare you to try and get a tow truck in the parking lot!

The barristas were all very nice. The food was good. I like the variety of breakfast selection. We got our food in a timely manner. We didn't get coffee so I can't comment on that but I will say the breakfast we ate was good and the people were so nice.

Perfect location co-located near the Mall near plenty of other shopping areas.
Service is always great, greeted at the door when walking in and always friendly smiles when taking your order. 
I ordered the triple (3) shot Americana for my morning boost! Can't go wrong with their bagels either. I routinely get them toasted, with butter and creamcheese.
When not on bagel kick, the banana bread it my Jam! :)
The parking can be crowded during peek hours, so keep that in mind.
As with most all SBUX stores, the inside is very clean and offers a great meeting place for business or just to catch up with friends and family.
Cheers!
Rob

Thank you, hard workers! I pulled up to this location today (thankful that they were open) and saw a sign to place a mobile order. I did so in my car, and got out immediately and went to the window to pick it up. it was already ready. it's the small things that make your day. they were polite and following all virus guidelines. the girl inside even waved at me. thank you guys for being so generous and hospitable in tough times! smiles go a long way.

The lady 'Sam' always screws up my orders. Ex: i specify soy milk and am are charged for it, but she forgets to write on the cup. And i get dairy after being charged for soy!
I say 'No whip cream', she adds whip cream even though it is written on the cup. It seems like she may be day-dreaming on the job!!

The guy with long-ish hair  gets it right and does not mess up the orders. Hence this place got its 3 stars, else it would've been 1 or less.

Good Location, nice layout inside.  I encountered the most unhelpful women at the register today.  Needed a little guidance ordering as I could not find something on the menu.  Just an unpleasant experience with an unpleasant person.  She seemed annoyed and irritated. Other staffers were pleasant enough and service was quick.  But will be going elsewhere from now on.  Too bad just got to the area and was looking for regular spot to frequent.

New location recently built within the last 6 or so months. I had a couple of issues when they first opened getting a couple of drinks, but they've always done right and corrected it for me. Staff is very friendly and a pleasure to interact with.
Went here to work on some things and loved the atmosphere, music, and of course my coffee. Anytime I need to work on my laptop, this the place to go.

FYI: Though this Starbucks sells Starbucks coffee, it does not accept the Starbucks rewards members card or coupons. There's another Starbucks in the Macy's across the street on (Market) or one at 15th and Market or one at 13th and Chestnut that you can check out so you can still get your points on your SB card :)

I have tried to write this review three different times this morning. This particular Starbucks has one particular employee that cannot put the lid on the coffee cups correctly. Last Friday as she handed it to me the lid came off and I ended up with hot coffee all over my hand all over the outside and inside of my car. Needless to say I said some very colorful words. I was not very happy. Today which is again Friday, and again the lid came off and once again my hand was burned I have a mess in my car. I give up I've never had a Starbucks cup lid come off. And to top it all off I asked her at the drive-thru speaker to repeat my order back to me and she informed me that she could not do that because she was getting food for another customer. Actually told me that she would remember my order to make it good enough. I don't want you to make it good enough I want her to make it the way I asked her to! I think this young lady needs some serious training. Not only on how to put a lid on a coffee cup. She also needs extensive customer service training. The attitude this morning was terrible. I go to the drive up because it's supposed to be quicker apparently not where she comes from. It's really disappointing that one employee can make the entire shop look bad. I may have to reconsider a different coffee shop in the future.

I'm a Starbucks lover but this location is one of my least favorites. I was very excited when they opened this location so close to the hospitals nearby, expecting some convenience. It has been more of a headache purchasing at this location than anything else. 

Two things to note for this specific location:

1. The parking situation is atrocious. Very limited parking. After the 7 or 8 spots are taken, you have to basically find grass or any concrete to squeeze your car into OR you can venture to Walmart, park there and walk back to Starbucks. Honestly, you are better off going to another Starbucks nearby. 

2. The service can be unusually slow with some inaccuracies in the drink recipes. I have ordered mobile before from the I275 Highway and my drink was still not ready. I recently ordered the Pink drink and there was no coconut milk in the drink when I received it. I didn't bother to tell them. 

Not my favorite location considering there are other coffee options and other Starbucks locations in the area.

spacious with decent amount of seating. large parking lot, with additional parking lot available.
not sure what it is about starbucks, but there are always massive amounts of flies no matter where you sit. Barista was friendly and patient with us while we were ordering.

Service was utterly and unapologetically awful. Wait time was long given the amount of people in store. What was an issue is after 23 minutes I was given the wrong order. I suggested the order was incorrect and I didn't want it. Server would not apologize for the fault. Said she'd make another but at that point almost 25 minutes later I asked for a refund. While there in the 25+ minutes this happened no less than 3 times. Getting orders wrong and either having to give away free drinks or throw away drinks. This is potentially the worst managed Starbucks I have ever been to. Unfortunately awful in every regard.

Just left this Starbucks after ordering a breakfast sandwich and a coffee. I watched the guy in the drive-through window consistently dig deeply into his ear several times and then commence to putting the lid on my coffee placing the same finger he used to dig in his ear over the mouthpiece opening in the lid! I kindly advised him that I had just watched him dig in his ear and told him I wanted a new, clean lid. He went and got a new lid, and did the same thing with those same dirty fingers! I could see crud under his nails!  I told him I would like for somebody to give me a clean lid using a napkin to ensure there was no contamination. He got mad and yelled "well I'll have someone else do it then!" to which I replied "please do, and also, wash your hands." 

By this time the manager scurried over with a new cup of coffee and handed it to me. I was still sitting there, so she said "did you need something else?" I said yes, creamer and sugar. She got mad and said "Well next time, tell us that when you place your order!"  I reminded her that I did ask for room to be left in the cup and cream and sugar when I placed my order! We are in the midst of a pandemic, you filthy beasts, is it too much to ask that you not contaminate my lid right in my face and then get mad at me for catching you? I trashed the breakfast sandwich - God only knows what went on with that! 

A word of advice to Starbucks, get mad at the nasty ass employee digging in his ear and touching customer's purchase instead of getting an attitude with the concerned customer who politely called it to your attention.  I will NEVER go back to this location!!
No restrooms is inhumane. There is a coffee shop in the next parking lot for you and Vons has restrooms if you need.
The happy crew at this Starbucks really started my Friday off great! They were super efficient and friendly! Loved the smiles!

I am passing through and stop at Starbucks across the country every day. This was awful service (I could have gone through the drive through 3x in the time I was taken care of with my order of only 2 simple drinks. I specifically ordered an Americano (paid more money) bc I was told the dark roast would take 10mins. Then I waited well over 25 mins and a guy comes in, orders, the girl who took his order had googly eyes for him and he literally walked out a minute later with his drink. Unacceptable!
