A guy waiting even longer than me walked up and demanded his money back and the manager (rather than listen to our concerns and the mans recommendation to handle the front end better), she told him she was the manager and "don't talk to my partners like that!" WHAT??? He didn't even say anything that was rude other than to show his dissatisfaction as a customer. I was in complete agreement with him! This store needs to improve and it may start with the manager making her "partners" accountable!
Not a place for studying. Too much noise :(

Probably the most jam packed Starbucks you will find. There is NO where to park. The drive thru is always a mile long and there's no way to drive back and forth to look for a spot... once you go in you can go back, you can only go out. It's really sad that this is the nearest Starbucks because the target nearby doesn't have Starbucks and the dunkin near by doesn't have a drive thru. Starbucks you need to re vamp your location.

This is one of the bigger Starbucks in town, so it is a great place to hunker up and do some work while enjoying your lattes or what have you. That is, provided that you don't come here during peak hours when it is filled with rich pretentious California girls and college students.

The baristas here are OK. Most of them seem a little too busy, or during slow times, preoccupied with themselves and their smartphones, to provide good customer service. But every now and then you will find a gem here. 

I'm not a huge fan of Starbucks in the first place. I find them to be cold and uncomfortable places, which is probably the point, because if it were, nobody would leave.

Still, it's OK. 

For a Starbucks, that is.

I love this little Starbucks. The baristas are very friendly and my order is always accurately made. The drive thru service is also very good. There is not a lot of room for a car line so a sign indicates that you can't be waiting in line past it. This is a for safety reasons so try not to get too bent out of shape :)

This is true big-city Starbucks. 

It's about the only location in Philadelphia that stays open till 11pm, probably because of being within the bustling Marriott hotel). It's lines can be rather long, so you'll want to acquaint yourself with the Starbucks app to order-ahead. And it's just not as cozy to relax and study in like other Starbucks locations, as the chairs are all metal and the environment is rather slender in width, as you wind your way through it.

The drink quality can be a little hit-or-miss, due to the apparent staff turnover this location has. But I can tell you one thing - the wonderful daytime barista Theresa will get your drink right, and serve it with such a charming smile!

One other thing - some reviews falsely report that the Starbucks app/cards/stars do not work here. That might have been the case a few years ago, but I can guarantee that this location certainly does honor everything Starbucks has (apps/cards/stars).

So everything appears as fresh as can be in this location; just be sure you skip the crazy lines and order ahead, and you'll be fine here.
I come here a lot. Always fast and courteous. I always think the tables could be a little bit cleaner, but there's a lot of space for seating and the bathroom is always clean.

A beautiful patio and outdoor seating to enjoy your favorite Starbuck purchase. Mature trees, shaded and quite location to appreciate my Chai tea. Indoor seating for studies or a nice spot to get some work done and the staff is friendly. Bring change for parking meters if not on your bike.

I absolutely LOVE Starbucks! I do think it is a tad pricey, but it's quality and I love it! I really am not a fan of coffee, necessarily, but I love their teas, pastries and sandwhiches! They also have juices, milks, fruit, and gift items sold at every location! 
I also love the feel when you walk in. It's really calm and welcoming with the couches, tables, chairs and free internet access. It's definately a perfect place to go have your favorite coffee while cramming for a big test!

Come here a lot with the gals from the office when we forget lunch or need a coffee break. Overall the service is consistently good, in the last year (with multiple visits a month) I've only had one or two drinks that taste off. Service is pretty good - the only negative that I have run into is when things are pretty bonkers with a conference in town - but it makes for great people watching!

Honestly shocked this location doesn't have higher ratings. I go through the drive thru when I come here during early mornings of the week and am always impressed by how upbeat and friendly the staff is. They are always so energized and kind, it makes it a great place to stop. 

I've also always found the drive thru to be quick and efficient and have never waited more than a few minutes. People have no patience nowadays, and I bet that's the case with those that have complained about the speed.

Great friendly staff and always good drinks and snacks. My wife and I had a mocha this morning and I had an egg and sausage sandwich and my wife a chocolate croissant. Always great.
Highly recommend.

I was at the Marriott while attending a trade show. I found the service to be fine and this location was extremely busy.  In fact, when I returned later in the day the barista remembered my particular drink and how I wanted it made. 
The staff was diverse regarding gender and ethnicity and I didn't notice any racist behavior overtly or covertly.

The decor is great. But man is the service slow. Compared to 96th and meridian, this is horribly slow. The staff is always nice so it's not a bad experience. But god help you if you hop on the drive thru during morning rush. It'll take you 10 minutes to make it through. And going inside is frequently no better on speed. Sometimes it's quicker inside but it also seems like they get a lot of trainees here because I frequently end up with people who have to ask questions about ringing up the order. It's fine but it adds to the overall time suck. 

Look, it's Starbucks so you either like it or you don't. But don't come here for quick service. Come for the experience because you'll be taking it in for a while.

Update 4/27/17: still terribly slow service. Waited well over 5 minutes with two people ahead of me. Most other places will blow through several people in the same time.
Allow an extra 15 minutes for the extremely slow service.  Very disorganized and store not very clean. Employees more worries about going home than the 8 customers in front of them.

I went to pick up a mobile order and one of the associates asked if I had a mobile order and I confirmed and started getting my coffee then another associate came out of nowhere and very rudely said don't touch without even knowing it was my order. I will not go back to that location.

Not a bad place to get your Sbux fix. Nothing else was open in this side of the airport so I also picked up some bacon and gouda sandwiches and the turkey and pesto panini. Both were served hot and the wait wasn't too long. They also have the new refreshers so I tried the mango dragonfruit and it was delish! Beware their Sbux app reader isn't working so you'll have to use cash or a different card.

The service was fast and friendly. The sandwich was hot and fresh, however a bit burnt which made the bread hard. The taste wasn't bad after getting through the texture of the bread. The bacon and egg was cooked really well. The drink was hot and tasted great. I loved the cake pops as well. There weren't any napkins in the bad which was a bit annoying. Overall I wanted to give a 3
because for $16.02, a burnt sandwich and no napkins is simply average. I gave a 4 because the service was nice. I would recommend for coffee and/or cake pops but not food.

Love starbucks. Just not this one. My wife went there last night through drive thru. She asked for sugar, they said they were out of white sugar. Brought it home to me, thank you sweetie, and it tasted like warm, milky water. I called, Deema said ok to get new one......Tomorrow. I went back today, still no white sugar. I parked, went inside, and there was PLENTY of baggies of white sugar. Is laziness or lying SOP for a. $5.00 cup of coffee? Cmon people, you can do better.

This is usually a great Starbucks worthy of 5 stars, but it is not OK to stop taking orders before 4.20 when you are closing at 4.30. This is a management issue.
It's hard enough to find an open Starbucks right now. :(

Great improvement in cleanliness lately. I would like to compliment Lauren-barista. She is a hard worker, and had fantastic customer service skills. This young lady has major social intelligence. She really needs to be in corporate!
This is home away from home for me as I wrote my dissertation at this location.
Thanks Lauren for making my night.
Dr. Michaels

Last time I am ever going here.  I called at about noon, and inquired about picking up some spent coffee grounds.  The fella was very helpful, took down my name, said he would tell his fellow workers, and to come by after 6pm so there would be a lot.   I stopped  by at 6:45pm, and was told a girl comes every day at 4pm to pick up grounds, and that's who got them.  Thanks a lot.

Every time I come here I'm disappointed. I've gotten a cool lime refresher that was only filled to 1" below the rim and even then it tasted watered down. I've gotten frappuccinos with too little frapp base so they didn't blend right. I've ordered extra extra extra bone dry cappuccinos and gotten a full on latte instead because they don't know how to make foam. Not even 1/2" of foam - pure milk all the way to the top. I've never had them remake anything because I never have the time afterwards because they take so long. I used to be a Starbucks barista so I know what the drinks should be like, and I know that it's not hard to make them, especially with the large number of baristas they have at all times. But of the 5 times or so I've gone to this location they've screwed up my order every time. Stay away.

Ive been coming to this Starbucks since I moved to Nashville. It was the first one I found closes to me.
It's always packed and has considerable lines in the AM.
I credit this Starbucks for teaching me to have patience in the South and learning that there's major differences between a NYC Starbucks and one in Nashville.
They for the most part have helpful cool employees.  I will say that they are a revolving door and that makes it difficult to "get to know" your local barista.
For the most part it's always very clean - and their bathrooms are always clean.
It has great ample seating both indoor & outdoor.

So far so good on day 3 of being open. Staff is friendly if a bit unsure. The inside is roomy with a wood and brick interior. Tones of gray, black and charcoal give the inside a sleek, modern look. My coffee didn't have its sometimes bitter, burnt taste to it. Which was great! Drive thru service is convenient. This is a welcome addition to my neighborhood!
They are all very nice here but really the only person who know what's she's doing is Allison.  The rest need more training.

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. I ordered a single tall hot chocolate and I received a cup of room temperature milk with barely any chocolate flavor. I also waited approximately 20 minutes for this cup of milk. How can anyone ruin hot chocolate this bad.

Quick friendly service! Our drinks were perfect. 
It's not a very big Starbucks, it's attached to another building, which I assume is some kind of offices of some sort. But for their location and size they weren't too terribly busy, and I was in and out pretty fast both times. 
Staff was cool too. Both times it was different people, and all of them were friendly and joked around/held conversations. 
Will be back to visit this one if given the chance.

I wasn't able to experience this location or drink a beverage from here because they closed earlier than most other Starbucks. They closed at 6 pm on a Monday night. Please check out their hours before driving here if you are in the area.

You know what, this is a place of respect. They are so nice whenever I come to get my coffee. I've gotten it twice now, they're so friendly and it's an experience with them. They greet me by name and they laughed with me and joked around with me! They're a vibe! I hope they get to know I said this.

Very clean store. You guys are awesome!

Dirty and slow. I have been a Gold Card member for more than three years. During a recent business trip I stopped in twice. Store was dirty and staff was super slow. Scanner for Starbucks wasn't working at the drive and they "can't " type in card numbers so after you wait in the drive through you have to come into the store. None of the staff talked to the customers beyond ordertaking and no one's name was on the cup...because there was such a line everyone was confused is that my drink? Is that your drink? Seems like the Starbucks management should spend a little time in the store getting it right.

I'm on my way to work a overnight and stopped here to get a caramel frappe. I get my drink looks really pretty until I take a drink and let me tell you it taste like a water frappe with whip cream and caramel. Horrible
This location has lots of outdoor seating (probably more than what you'll find inside), so come and take advantage it and enjoy the weather.

I ordered 2 coffees on Uber eats and selected a variety of sweeteners I might use for the coffees when they got to my house.  They were listed as packets on Uber eats.  I selected ...

4 raw sugars
4 stevias
4 honeys
4 sugars

Instead of delivering the packets on the side, they put the above into each coffee making them inedible.  I called the store to verify and they said they did this and that some people like their coffee very sweet.

They are inedible by anyone....

Manager said they would reimburse me when I came to store and get other coffee.  I can't get there now that is why I ordered ubereats delivery.  

I submitted complaint to Uber eats let's see what happens.

I will never visit this Starbucks again. I've been a regular Starbucks customer for the past 2 years. I get coffee between 4 and 6 times a week.  I recently moved into Fishtown and this location is the only one close to me without going into the city. There is a woman that works there that complains about her hours, her boss, the Starbucks company and Target every time I see her. It's unprofessional but I never say anything because I also work in the service industry and I understand the need to vent. However..... I went there two days ago and ordered my normal coffee drink, chatted with the employee and left. My friend came in not twenty minutes later, ordered her drink and told me the woman working behind the counter said she was tired of the customers that come everyday and order the same beverage and then she said that those people have no lives.  As someone that spends a great deal of money at Starbucks, I'm upset that this employee seems to think a) I'm some loser with no life because I'm a repeat customer and b) that it's acceptable to complain about customers to other customers. I no longer feel comfortable there and I will not visit this location again.

Rude staff. I waited in line patiently behind a group of people and when I finally made it to the front of the register, the barista proceeds to take the order of a man to the far left of the counter. The barista tells me that I'm not in the right side of the line and I would have to go to the end of the line (that had gotten long in the time I waited) towards the left to be served. I had already waited in line where it was clearly formed and there was no indication that I wasn't in a proper line already. It was clear that I had been waiting there longer then the customer he had chosen to serve before me, but clearly that didn't matter. I left this establishment after being treated like that. There are better coffee shops that do value their customers and have better customer service.

This service was absolutely disgusting. We stopped here on a 12 hour car drive and went in to order and the MANAGER was on the phone, watched me wait for 5 minutes while 2/4 other employees were doing INVENTORY while the other two were swamped with 20+ cars in the drive through. THEN the manager told me she had to go take care of a few things before taking my order...... first off. I work in the service industry so if they had been swamped and all employees were genuinely just trying to catch up I would understand but no, instead they have 2 of them doing INVENTORY.... Do not come here unless you wanna waste gas & not get any coffee!!

My boyfriend and I stopped by the Blue Bell Starbucks this morning before work-- just like we have been for the passed two weeks. We went through the drive-thru like we usually would and we started to get annoyed when we noticed a customer was taking forever to give their order. She was there for almost 10 minutes before pulling forward. The next car stopped, had their order taken, and pulled forward shortly. We we approached to have our order taken, we kept yelling, "hello?" into the speaker for over 5 minutes before we noticed the note on the board that told us to pull forward for assistance with our order. It took over 20 minutes before the person in front of us got the 1 drink that they ordered. When we got to the window, we informed the lady that no one answered to take our order & that the note told us to pull forward. She proceeded to tell us that they we closed when we tried to order & that we messed up their line... but how come the person in front of us got served and we did not? She told us to pull around again and then she would take our order. We had 15 minutes to get to our job, which usually takes us 25-30 minutes to get there on a normal day. We told the lady how we felt about their poor customer service and drove off with nothing. Will not go back to this Starbucks again, they're never consistent-- they suck.
this store is steady messing someone order up. Every single time. Whether it's forgetting putting cream in my coffee, never mix the iced tea lemonades. Sugar just sits at the bottom.

I purchased 2 hot peppermint hot chocolates without whip cream on 11/8.  When I got to work took the lids off one was barely a half full.  The other was missing 1/4 a cup from top.  I was so angry and disappointed specially after paying over $7. for both.  I've included the photo.

Always fast, friendly, and accurate. I work near here, so I come through the drive-thru before or after work, or on breaks, and they get you through quickly. The guy who usually takes drive-thru orders during weekdays is so enthusiastic and silly, you can't help but smile. Every time I order a drink with soy milk, he replies, "soytenly!" The inside is nice too - standard Starbucks with lots of seating.

This Starbucks store is amazing. Whether I come in the morning or after work, the staff is always super sweet and friendly. Not to mention the fact that my drink is always made perfectly. Also, the Mgr Dani is super sweet and sooo helpful. I had an issue with a product I bought and she was able to fix the issue promptly!! So glad I work near this location.
Very long wait and the worst frapuccino I ever tasted. Big chunk of ice with a little coffee. Never going back.

Went here yesterday for a pink drink. Very good service and no wait time or line. Parking was easy to find but the space is a bit tight but overall good experience and friendly and very helpful staff.

Absolutely hate the remodel they did. I was excited when I saw it was closed for remodeling because this has been a regular stop for me during the week on the way to the office. But no more. The result of the remodel is rows of low small round tables with iron chairs elbow to elbow with everyone. Think middle seat on an airplane without the cushion. Just no longer feels like a place where I can relax over coffee a meal and the morning news on my I pad. Guess I will be looking for a new morning stop; Panera or Brugers perhaps. 

Update: ok, so stopped in for take out and LOVE what they did. Either the remodel was not finished when I posted above or the made chargers based on feedback but they added padded benches with power outlets between the chairs and wall dividers. What a difference; warm and welcoming! Added a star and will further update review when I have more time.

Stopping in right before I headed to my daughters game to get an easy fav Carmel frap!
The staff is always so welcoming and friendly.
I'd definitely recommend this Starbucks!!
Thank you guys sooo much
Awesome service, great management, very friendly and efficient people. It would be nice if all Starbucks were this good.

honestly this starbucks is pretty good. for anyone complaining about waiting in line, keep in mind you're on a college campus with like almost 35,000 kids all trying to wake themselves up with coffee. if you're patient, it's fine! Also, try going at like 0:30-0:45 time period since most kids get off of class at like the 0:50 time period and that's when lines start to form. Also this starbucks is awesome be sure to ask for a receipt for most drinks because if you come back later in the day you can get a refill for ONLY 50 CENTS!

HORRIBLE STAFF & CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!!Yesterday I had the worse experience I've ever had in a Starbucks. It wasn't busy, it was in between rushes at 2:30 in the afternoon. There was no line so I figured my order wouldn't take long. The cashier was okay but seemed very uninformed. Patiently waited for my sandwich to be warmed up. Watched while other orders were filled. Still no sandwich. Watched while other sandwiches went out Drivethru. Asked about my order. Was told there was a process. That's was it. She didn't check on my order. She didn't communicate with any other of staff. Waited and watched while more orders got filled. Then the two people who came in after me received their orders. I asked again. She went to finally ask the sandwich guy and they had to look for it. Found it with drivethru orders. And she was like. Oops. Human error. I Walked out. I was frustrated and waited til I was out the door before yelling at the sky in frustration. I did yell but not at anyone or in the store. I have now left a message with Jonathan the district/regional manager. Maybe he will take accountability and try to make this right. I will NOT BE RETURNING TO THIS LOCATION. Don't be in a position of customer service or management if you are unable to complete the simple requirements of your job.

Made the mistake of going here again because I didn't have time to run to the real Starbucks on University Ave. Again I left disappointed. This place is a total rip-off. I ordered a cool lime refresher and watched them make it. Somehow a dozen other cold drink orders jumped ahead of mine... I used to work at Starbucks, so I know how to make these simple, simple drinks. It's really quite easy. You pour the cool lime refresher liquid up to a designated line depending on the size of the drink, add water to the next line, and then a certain amount of ice and some freeze-dried limes, and you shake it. What I got was cool lime refresher liquid only to HALF of where it should've gone (because the container ran out, and she didn't grab more). She loaded it up with water, and CRAMMED ICE SO FULL INTO IT that the ice was touching the bottom of the shaker. When she poured it into the cup and saw that it still didn't fill up the cup despite all the water she added, she dumped EVEN MORE WATER onto it. Just guestimating from watching her make it, she gave me about a grande's amount of CLR liquid in a TRENTA drink.

I was almost late for my meeting already, so I didn't stay to tell them to fix it. But if I'm ever unfortunate enough to find myself here again, I'm going to say "no water, light ice," and I"ll probably STILL get a diluted drink. Cool lime refreshers, lattes, cappucinos... I've never been satisfied with a single purchase at this Starbucks. Never.

This Starbucks is located in Warminster Pa in between York Road (Route 263), Street Road (Route 132) and Evergreen Avenue. The first time I came to this Starbucks was back on 11/13/20 with my sister as she lives down the road and loves Starbucks. The first time I didn't get anything but the second time on 11/17/20 I got the usual hot chocolate and it was pretty good. If ther4es anything I have to say is that the spot this Starbucks is in is very crowded due to the 3 busy roads mentioned above and both times it had long lines with no room to maneuver. Interestingly enough, this Starbucks is connected to a bank so that will bring in more traffic. Its still a good Starbucks but if you are not a fan of crazy traffic and long lines then I wouldn't recommend it.
Best Starbucks on the south side/near South County. If you are going for regular coffee, try requesting the Clover. Excellent.

This is the worst Starbucks in the area consistently, during flooding post Ida I figured it'd be most likely to be open. Somehow they were closed until 11am due to Ida without any flooding or lost power in the area and Lansdale was open and got me my order promptly even though the street adjacent to their store was closed from flooding. I will never ever go back.

I'm a regular of the morning shift. Where the team is always on point and friendly wether young or old. MY ORDER IS ALWAYS EXECUTED PERFECTLY! But tonight my gf wanted coffee so thinking my experience-would be grand NOT SO MUCH! Idk who was the head or the tail. I had to inform the barista she wasn't making the proper drink (it didn't look right). They were steady not really busy so idk why tickets weren't being read in full. The barista failed the task of making my drink then asked for help after 2 attempts. The next lady started making it WITHOUT KNOWING THE MODIFICATIONS. As I proceeded to tell her she'd gotten pissy at this point, slamming blinders and shit. But sorry big girl I wanted what my girl paid for. And after the 15min wait on a pick up order I get a venti espresso cloud NO SWEETNESS WHAT SO EVER! It was suppose to be a Venti Breve Iced Caramel Cloud macchiato. I adore the morning crew eddy made my first cloud and I made it my regularthing 2x a week. I know we are in the hood kind of but we don't need the hood on the night shift. HAVE SOME CLASS !!

Okay, Starbucks management in Montecito, it's time to eavesdrop on your employees ringing up customers. It's one thing to be social,It's quite another to be engaging customers in conversation when there are customers behind them. I don't really care where you took your girlfriend last night or what's a great place to dine cheaply. Seriously, if a customers asks, that's one thing-but keeping customers there while you-the employee-ask them more questions? Not good...less is more.

I stop in here all the time but I just had to leave a comment! The staff at this location is incredibly friendly, the service is fast and great! I appreciate the pride flags and friendly faces when I stop in! Also my order always turns out perfect at this location which is a huge plus for me! By far my favorite Starbucks to stop into!

This location is stupid slow, I've been waiting in the drive through for over 30 minutes and I still haven't made it to the window but I obviously can't get out because there is cars behind me. This is not the first time, they are usually really slow. Management needs to do something about it because this is unacceptable.

This place is hit or miss with service. I'm trying to give them grace because I bet it's because of being understaffed or hiring new people. Every time I go there and get a simple order (grande Iced coffee with oat milk, Carmel syrup and the classic syrup) they get it wrong. One time in the drive through the person said "did you say soy?" And I said "no" and then repeated my order. Drove away, and they had put soy in it. Every time I go it's made differently. NEEDLESS TO SAY, just check your order before you drive away and you'll be okay.
Big and spacious. Not small like typical locations. And plenty of seating outside for you to enjoy the weather and views. Friendly staff and in a shopping plaza for you to enjoy

The location is exactly opposite to the Holiday Inn Hotel and next to the highway, which makes it a great spot. It has a large indoor sitting area, outdoor sitting area and drive-thru. I stayed at the Holiday Inn hotel and wanted to have some warm tea and bread. So, after my morning walk, I decided to check this place out. 

The place has good vibes, comfortable seats. Got a croissant and ordered a hot green tea. The service was slow because there was a long line of cars in the drive-thru. Anyway, when my name was called out, I got a cold/iced tea. Disappointed with the delay and the wrong drink, I told the staff that I ordered a hot drink, not a cold one. I had to wait for few more minutes and they corrected their mistake and gave me the right beverage.

So, I guess the only problem was the delay. Other than that, it's a nice cozy place!

Big props to Joseph at the drive-thru window for really representing the Starbucks brand well and pushing for app downloads. He makes for a great brand ambassador! Expect long lines in the drive-through but friendly service. I was surprised and curious to see the sous vide egg and bacon option now on the menu. Located along capital Avenue on your way to downtown the spot seems to be quite popular for those grabbing a coffee before heading into the office.

Friendly staff and I often will stop here before work and get a coffee and it  is my go to location if I need to pick up a gift card. Staff has always been super friendly and nice to me. There is a decent amount of space if you want to stay in their lobby or on patio to work or read. The only downside can be the drive thru line - not the service - the customers, and maybe the person that designed the parking lot. The cars always end up blocking the road with a long line into the drive thru during peak times. No fault of the staff - these are the folks heading into the offices that are in the Intech Park area with morning rush and group coffee orders. During these peak morning rush times I avoid the drive thru and order inside.

I went through drive thru this morning and immediately dumped my coffee all over myself and my car. They gave me napkins and promptly remade my coffee free of charge, even though the fault was mine. Above and beyond, thanks for making Monday morning more bearable!!

I wish there was a Starbucks closer to my house because the employees at this one are always super rude and almost always mess up my order I come all the time because it's convenient but I always have to be so specific with my order and there always just so rude.

My experience here was awkward. I won't be back. I was only there for a total of about 30 minutes. I ordered my coffee and sat at a table by the window to work. I had my laptop, notebooks, binder etc spread out on the table. An elderly man approached me and said that I was sitting in his spot, and that he sits there everyday. I told him I wasn't going to move all my stuff, and that I'd only be there another 15 minutes. He pointed at another table, telling me it was empty. So I told him "Great then you can sit there." He was so appalled that he went and told a random guy at the table next to mine, and that guy offered to give him his table, but the man said no because he wanted HIS table. Lol. So then the man goes to order his coffee, and loudly complains to the staff about the girl that took his favorite spot. I was disappointed that the staff didn't kindly remind him that the seating is UNRESERVED. Instead they asked him, "Did you ask her to move?" ARE YOU KIDDING ME??? What is this, the 1940s?!  This quick trip to get some work done turned into me being harassed for my seat and the staff only making it more uncomfortable.

One of my hangout a while I was passing through this area a lot. The staff here is so polite, they remembered me every time I came in. 

Learned about the Caramel Brûlée with the extra double shot in it, straight game changer. 

Thanks guys ;)
Fen hands down makes the best espresso Frappuccino. Love this location and people like Fen make it worth the wait.

Why would someone do a review on a Starbucks ?? They are everywhere ... Unless you are near west shore of Tampa. This is the only one around and it is tricky to find 
This Starbucks is INSIDE OF THE WESTIN lobby. Pull into parking lot and around to the right side. It has the typical green Umbrellas outside to mark the treasure. 
They do have their own parking. 
This SB is one of those special locations that does not except your free drinks that you have earned. They do accept payment via the SB app though 
They do have a nice assortment of sandwiches, snacks, merch etc. 
My Venti iced upside caramel macchiato was made perfectly. 
I bought some low-cal jalapeño popcorn that is insane goody good good. 
Staff was very nice and the location is clean.

My favorite Starbucks.

I've been coming here for over 15 years and I always enjoy this place.

I guess I've been here so much, with so many friends, that it feels like home.

It's a great place to meet and chat.
Service is always pleasant and my drinks are always right.
Food is fine but I usually just have teas here.
My favorite is the chai tea latte.

When the weather is nice I always sit outside.

This location is conveniently  located  on Market Street near City Hall and Fashion District.  It's usually busy. Some seating is located in front and several high top tables are in back. It's inside a Marrriott. Sometimes I just sit in the lobby instead.  The baristas here were nice. 
The pop music playing was also gods. It made an afternoon break more relaxing. 
I love that Starbucks has Happy Hour once a week! It makes the high prices more reasonable. 
My chai tea latte was good. I would've like a little more foam because isn't that the reason for a latte?!  I like the flavor of a Starbucks latte. It has just the right amount of spices without being too sweet or overpowering.

I will never go to this Starbucks again. The last 2 times I've been there the same lady is so rude. And now this time she had to remake my drinks and didn't even do them right. I feel if you have an off day I get it but 2 times in a row.........

This location is in the middle of a Fry's grocery store. It's serviceable. It isn't a fully fledged Starbucks store, so I wouldn't expect all the frills that come with it. But if you are looking for some quick pick me up, then this is a good place to go. 

I almost never go to these locations. Just doesn't seem worth it to me. However my girlfriend wanted to stop here for a bit, because she was craving their iced coffee after finishing her shopping. I opted for an iced tea. It was a little overpriced, because they absolutely load those cups with ice, but it was a nice refreshing stop gap in our day.

This is one of the best Starbucks I have ever been to in my life. I recently went back to school for nursing - I come here almost everyday when not in school or clinical to get work done. The staff is amazing - and never irritated with me being there so much  the seating arrangements of this Starbucks create such a wonderful work environment- it's my favorite in the area. Plenty of individual and group space space. Large seating arrangements for one or a few. The rest could all take tips on their furniture layout! It's a key note  on this Starbucks .. I get ALL the coffee beverages, and they always come out amazing! Thank you all so much ! 

It's Andrew
Employees are pleasant, my order was completed quickly and correctly, and the store is very clean.

Anyone who knows me knows without a doubt how much I love my Starbucks coffee, "white chocolate mocha" to be exact.  I generally stick with one location because they know exactly what I like and exactly how I like it made. But seeing that I was in another area that happened to have a Starbucks, I thought with it being a signature drink and all,just how hard would it be to get it right . Well go figure, they managed to get it WRONG anyway. Now I believe sometimes people just get things wrong from time to time but a signature drink with specific instructions on what to add to make it exactly what I wanted? Not okay. To top it off,their customer service definately could use some help along with their coffee making and following direction skills. 

So dissapointed,and this my friends is why you stay with the same place so you never have to worry about being dissapointed about your coffee.

This Starbucks does not know how to make drinks. They are constantly making drinks wrong and try to argue about how a drink is made. They ask how it's suppose to be made. It's simply not worth the time or money to go to this location.

Review indicated the worst Starbucks. Totally agree. One person taking orders and making coffee on a busy Sunday morning.  Line to the door. Ordered a green tea cappuccino no whip. Got a grande with whip.
Tiramisu latte all the way . Great service . the line always moves quickly when it's backed up

The Saint Louis Zoo Starbucks.

   This is a one-year old Starbuck's in the heart of the Saint Louis Zoo. It is so new that when I visited it in the summer of 2018 it was nonexistent on Yelp and said "Coming Soon" on the Zoo Directory. Hence, why it took me so long to write this review. 

  In my opinion, Starbuck's is more than a caffeinated beverage. It is about a Starbuck's experience. A big part of that experience is  relaxing in an upbeat environment. The Saint Louis Zoo provides a unique Starbucks experience. It is located in the heart of the zoo fronting a lake where flamingos live and by the Lakeside Cafe. This is the only Starbuck's that I know of where I can walk a few feet then drink a beverage in the company of gorillas, sea lions, prarie dogs, alligators, and numerous members of the animal kingdom.

  It was on our second visit to the Saint Louis Zoo when I patronized the new Starbuck's. We had just walked a good part of Forest Park and through the Art Museum. I was up to sitting in the fresh air and enjoying a comfort beverage. Whether or not I wanted to enjoy the fresh air it wouldn't matter because this is a concession stand where customers order from a menu outside then pay and pick up the item at the window. There are a plentitude of tables on the lakeside patio by the Starbuck's. Of course there is a plentitude of seats throughout the zoo to enjoy a Starbucks item by one of the many animals. The closest animals to this Starbuck's stand are the sea lions and prarie dogs. It is so close to the sea lions that some people might find the loud barking chafing (the sea lions obviously do not need the caffeine).

  The prices are competitive to local locations. This isn't one of those rip off non-corporate Starbuck's (I assume it is affiliated with the zoo). The Frappuccino that I brought was a similar price to a corporate location.

  This Starbucks is a nice addition to the Saint Louis Zoo. I give it four stars on account of the fact that it provides a unique Starbucks experience in the heart of Saint Louis Zoo.
I always enjoy coming the this Starbucks. They make drinks in a consistent way so it doesn't taste like something totally different each time. And there's a good amount of seating.

I am a daily customer of Starbucks and really don't favor one over another I visit the one that I'm near. Overall, Starbucks are consistent with taste, quality and varying degrees of friendly service. However, today I had an exceptional service experience. It was not a enormous gesture but the fact that very few people in retail and or restaurants will go over and above to take care of you is rare. I bought a $35 Gift Card and Brittany the Barista that was helping me said she was out of the gift card envelopes. That usually is not a big deal but I was buying it for a client as a Thank You and it would have been awkward to hand her just a Starbucks card. I told Brittany this and she looked around to find a solution and showed me these small Starbucks Gift Card bags that they sell. I was ok with buying it but not excited to have to spend extra money on something to contain a Gift Card. When Brittany checked me out she zeroed out the bag  $2.95 and said I want to take care of you because we are out of envelopes. That is fabulous customer service although not a huge thing the fact that she took care of the me and made me happy while using her best judgment made an impact. Way to go Starbucks for empowering your people to take care of the customer!! I will be back to visit soon!

It's an airport Starbucks. I was happy that they have the Impossible breakfast sandwich here (nominally marked up at $5), which tastes reasonably close to their sausage breakfast sandwich. Also, they make a decent flat white (available as standard or with vegan milk and sweetener). 

They do a good job of marking off 6 feet in their line, and I felt that the employees uphold distancing rules.

I used to come to this Starbucks almost every morning but decided to drive a little further due to the incompetence of its baristas and staff especially Emely who justifies the employees when they over charge or give you a shaken expression when you ordered a chai latte. On top of that the lines are ridiculously long. This Starbucks needs to get it together.

Got a breakfast sandwich and it was halfway decent. I then had to go out to my car to take some conference calls and these idiots call the cops on me because "they thought I was taking pictures of the drive thru". F#%k this place

This Starbucks is crowded but that's not the problem!josh is rude and a asshole racist prick he just through my food on top of the counter but handed another lady her food in which she was white! Then when I asked him for toppings for my oatmeal he said it was at the end of the bar which is a lie because I've worked at Starbucks for 3 years as a shift manager and the toppings are by the oven station !! The experience was not memorable at all! I ain't say nothing but remember it's the customers that don't complain that will report you! Always be on point & friendly to all people !!
Nice to have a real Starbucks inside the hotel! Friendly staff and well made drinks, as expected. There is an outdoor patio or small beach area owned by the hotel so you can relax outside.

Did my usual Starbucks run at this location, which is always packed. Even though they are always busy they do a really good job of keeping the line moving, which is helpful when you're on a time crunch!! I ordered my usual iced coffee but I decided to try something new for breakfast and ordered a spinach wrap. Unfortunately,I was not impressed. I'm not sure if it was not fresh or just over done. The tomatoes had no flavor, the spinach was unappealing and the wrap itself was just tough. The egg was about the only edible thing. It may have just been an off day, but I'm sure the rest of the breakfast is great! I'll be back, I just won't be ordering the spinach wrap lol!

This is a great Starbucks.  The employees are good, and friendly, too.  The inside has the modern but comfortable look and feel of new Starbucks locations.  And they keep the place (including the bathrooms) clean. Most importantly (for the purposes of my Starbucks rankings), they have a number of electrical outlets, including a pair of outlets (plus a pair of USB charging ports) in each of the four legs of the communal table.

This location has a respectable food selection and the surprisingly good nitro brew.  They have consistently gotten my order right.  It's everything that I look for in a Starbucks.

FTR, they also have a drive-through.  I don't do drive-through anything, so I can't rate that, but they seem to manage it decently since it never spills over to cause problems for the customers inside.

If you want to drink a cup of coffee, and you are near it,  you gotta try this Starbucks place. Man, they have a LOT of coffee!  

I didn't see Maxwell House on the menu (totes my faves), but I bet they have it since they have so much coffee. 

Only complaint is they seemed to have a lot of coffee from 3rd world countries. Must be cheaper??  These places aren't usually known for quality products. I suggest they get their coffee from countries with better quality control and food safety standards....like America, Canada, or even plaves like Germany. Just a suggestion.

Please, someone open another Starbucks across the street to relieve the congestion at this place. Or hire more baristas. This location can't support the demand of this area. Drive thru and wait inside is just ridiculously long.

I have to comment on the drive-thru service folks...

I continue to have the unfortunate pleasure of being served by 3 ladies who seem to dislike working at Starbucks.

Never been to a Starbucks where customer service was just disappointing! And boring. I might as well been served at a DMV.

Many of us enjoy the idea of ordering from Starbucks and having us a fancy drink being served by a friendly upbeat employee. I continue to be robbed of such experience.

Please switch out the drive thru ladies!

I wish if I had another option, I wouldn't go there! in 09/24/2020 around 5:10 pm I placed an order of grande hot late with a cheese danish cake, but I received it @ 6:00 pm. Plus worst of all, the guy didn't even care about my order. He just gave me only the cold late without the cake. He messed up all my day, I couldn't study & be focused!

Unfortunately, this Starbucks has decided to remove all of their electrical outlets.  I've chosen Starbucks for years to be able to get some work done while having either breakfast or dinner. I've always chosen Starbucks for this very reason.

I won't be gIrving starbucks my business anymore. Sad, since this was the very premise of creating Starbucks

Worst Starbucks ever.

Was driving up to Pismo Beach for a wedding a few weekends ago. Decided to stop at this Starbucks since it was so convenient to the 101.

BIG mistake.

The ordering system and baristas were overwhelmed with a long line of customers waiting to be served, combined with a ton of to-go orders for people who used the mobile app. Our order got lost in the shuffle.

I asked again 5 minutes later -- same answer, but still no mochas.

After we waited a total of 20 minutes for our two mochas, I asked the barista (who was completely overwhelmed the whole time) what happened to our mochas. He said he didn't know, there was no order for them. He then went ahead and made our drinks for us even though he couldn't find our order.

Finally, 25 minutes after we placed our order, we got our mochas.
