Delicious and delightful atmosphere! I love my neighborhood Starbucks! There is plenty of workspace with a large table with outlets, a bar to sit at and a plethora of tables and couches! Plus friendly faces.

I give this location 5 stars because 9 times out of 10 they will get your order correct and I rarely encounter a snobby barista. 

Now, Jessica from the early morning shift is my favorite barista. Shes always charismatic on a Monday morning. It sets a good tone to my day so I appreciate her a lot. One more reason why I love this location. 

Granted, you are going to get those rude baristas every now and then but I like to think they are simply having a bad day and a smile wont hurt.
Everyone was so welcoming and cheerful here. I usually don't write reviews for Starbucks visits but this experience (and of course, the coffee) made my day.

Find this Starbucks nestled in the middle of the Philadelphia Premium Outlets. Naturally they're packed weekends.

Friendly, quick service. First time I've tried a flat white at a Starbucks, and it won't be my last.

Normal amenities for a Starbucks. Besides coffee, there's food and merchandise for sale. Need a bathroom? The outlet bathrooms are a short walk away.

They get one star for the great drinks and lose four for the terrible customer service. I don't know how one Starbucks managed to get this many rude people in one place, but they've managed. You couldn't pay me to go back there.
I wish the folks at this location would wear name tags because I would definitely give them a shout. They are a great team here!

Conveniently located but you never know what you're going to get with mobile orders, some are ready early, some take 20 minutes when the lot is half empty and there's no drive thru line.  If it wasn't 10 minutes from my home I would just go to East Norriton or Lansdale.

 I'll never forget I ordered a mocha no whip and showed up to a GREEN drink with whipped cream on it. Honestly I don't know what drink you could order there that would even look like that, but clearly no coffee-based drink could ever be green. I actually had to ask someone to remake my drink which was still labeled a mocha with my name on it...

I also showed up once to cop cars and being waved away as soon as they saw me pull up (to this day I have no idea what was going on), but I was charged anyway for my mobile order I couldn't pick up and doubt was made, and I had to call 1800 Starbucks to reverse. 

Seriously why do I come here, this is clearly the worst store. I've also never ever gotten even a hello from a staff member even if I say hello or thank you when I pick up my order. I'm to the point I'm driving further to Lansdale or East Norriton and that's the end of it, they aren't perfect but at least they are kind, always greet me even for mobile orders, and make an effort to be timely.
Great place to study or catch up with friends, it's located in the Winthrop plaza which is super cute and they have free wifi and coffee, what's not to love?!

They are very busy in the mornings, but they get everyone through quickly. Even at 7am, they are very friendly to everyone in the middle of rush. Drinks are made correctly - unlike some other Starbucks around town.
 
Even though I get off the interstate to get here, it is worth the extra minutes!

The people here work hard, I praise the hard work that goes into this location. but the organization of this place is lacking. I was standing in the restaurant for 10 minutes while it was packed with people he ignored me and asked everyone else their name. And finally when everyone cleared and he asked my name it has been sitting there the whole time. 

I get that it was busy, but I feel like the people who work should be slightly more concerned about safety and when there's more then 10 people in the store the first priority should be making sure the people who's drinks are prepared are called to them so they don't have to risk their safety any longer. 

Otherwise, love this location.

I've been here several times.   I've found the staff to be very friendly and I have never been disappointed  with what they've prepared for me.   The free Wi-Fi is very nice and handy.   If you are waiting in line, check out their community bulletin board.  

Just be careful as you pull in and out of the parking lot.  It can be alittle tight.

Damn!!! Can Starbucks be any busier?!

We stopped in for coffee, a smoothie and a pastry. I saw a strawberry smoothie on the menu, so thought it was ideal for a nice warm day.  Wrong choice... It was bland and tasted more like bananas. Disappointed, but at least it filled me up!

We ordered the chocolate croissant ($2) and requested it to be warmed. Unfortunately, I think it was only warmed for 3 seconds because it didn't even taste any different. BOO!

Friendly service and lots of seating inside and out were the only positives about this Starbucks. 

The line to purchase was long and the wait for our drinks was even longer. Be prepared to wait...

I somehow always end up at this location. They have their own parking lot and drive-thru, which is great for meb because if I'm in a need for PAID for coffee, more than likely I'm not in a mood to deal with people. The staff here is really friendly and helpful. I'm addicted to the peppermint mocha. I'd like to try the sandwiches. They look really tasty. I hope all of the locations are as good as this one .

This location has really stepped up its game. Running errands and decided to make a quick stop for a drink for me and a snack for the kids. Usually it takes sometime when there is a line at this location but this place was popping today. Seriously ! Almost never came to complete stop. Way to go! Staff was friendly when making order. When at the window,the staff member wearing a mask was smiling so big you could tell. He already had my order in his hands and ready to hand it to me before I stopped. Love the app for quick no contact with pay machine. Order was perfect and precise. Good work Zephyrhills Starbucks!

Amazing! One franchise that gives back to our local community! Thank you! Wouldn't find this in any other franchise! Would come here again and recommend anyone else to stop by, get a coffee, and donate what you can and spread the word!

Be ready to wait 45min, line wraps around on to Gravois. They closed the cafe so you can't walk in and order nor can you order ahead on the app for pick up. Way too busy of a location, they need to do something better.

I'm not too big on rating Starbucks because there is a decent reputation for the brand and it's locations. This Starbucks pushes the issue further because they provide a high-level of service. I'm never disappointed these employees are some of the best.

The location itself is beautiful as well, plenty of room to sit since the space is large. There's even nice outdoor seating. Easily the best Starbucks around.

This Starbucks is always super crowded, especially late in the evening. I like that it has lots of seating and now it just put in a community table, but, of course, always filled with students using their laptops. The staff is decent, but not extremely nice. And lastly, it's always freezing. Then again, ALL Starbucks are freezing.

A little too busy -- and the staff are a little too frazzled to really give the normal Starbucks experience. I don't want to be given a cup of coffee by someone who looks like they just want to clock out and go home :( That being said - the pours are good quality and the store itself is usually nice. Their food case is almost always empty of the really tasty things too.

Worse service ever received! Their register doesn't accept mobile payment for some reason, I told the cashier I would pay with my card if it was to much of an inconvenience and she flipped out! The if manager can't control those girls why are they still employed! All I ordered was a hot chocolate and the first one was thrown in the trash because she wasn't going to make it. I'm in complete disbelief. She continued to curse and stare me down if front of everyone in line.

So I'm going to throw 4 stars their way. I know there is quite a divided community on YELP about starbucks but here is my reasoning.

1) This location is quick, has decent hours, and the staff are extra-friendly. 
2) This place is a quick walk from my office and has a ton of outdoor sunny seating that is perfect for zoning out and catching up on the vitamin D.
3) There is a little more seating than the one up on Whyte ave, so I always find a place to sit and do work.
4) Top-notch people watching. I've seen some hilarious pick-up-artists, awkward first dates, super-keen "pyramid err umm... triangle scheme" sellers and gorgeous athletes of both genders looking for a pick-up after their run over at Strathcona field.

4 good points. 4 Stars.

This Starbucks is awesome! Danny is a real welcoming person. My daughter is the Starbucks lover and I only go when she is here and she loves this store!! Anytime when I do order they are quick, nice, and efficient! I will be honest with you though I really like Danny he just makes my daughters day and my day!! So nice!!!

I can't believe the service that I just received at this Starbucks the employees are unprofessional and ratchet the girl that wears the scarf around her head threw my friends drink away and refused to make it she starting yelling and said she wasn't doing anything for him I was in disbelief and to top it off the manager just stood there and watched I couldn't believe that a Starbucks is allowing their employees to treat their guest that way I love the brand but this location is horrible and I will never return

My favorite Starbucks! Everyone is very nice, they take the time to learn your name and orders. The baristas are very sociable and friendly but efficient. They love their regulars keeping the atmosphere fun!

This is by far the best place to go for coffee and tea in Santa Barbara! After years of drinking here I can honestly say they have the best staff, the tastiest drinks and the perfect location.

One of my favorite times of year is the Santa Barbara International Film Festival in January/February. Each year the "Festival Hub" is at the Hotel Santa Barbara which is located right next to this Starbucks so usually I check out the festival board then walk next store and grab a cup of coffee before the movies start.

Later on in the festival when I feel like writing some film reviews or just checking my email I always go to this Starbucks and sit for a few minutes. Plus, now they have free wifi!

C or T Tip: Sometimes I just don't feel like coffee. If you're the same way, I highly recommend the Passion Iced Tea. Add a few sweeteners and you're good to go!

I'm not a Starbucks regular, but sometimes, a girl's just gotta have a frappucino on that mountain drive up to Tahoe to keep her awake. I generally prefer to come in and order so I can order my drink, pay for it, then run to the loo or use the free wifi while It's being made. Multi-tasking Mode Complete!  The staff here are super friendly and nice, which is a bonus.
One of the fast line moving coffee stop ! They are 9 people working inside a small counter ! Unbelievable ! Good works !!

This is a busy Starbucks, and seating is very limited! While the layout is ok, given the long, narrow shape of the unit, there's just not much open space for seating here. Outside, they have lots of tables and chairs, but this is Florida... those are useless for at least 6 months of the year. This location is the most-mutually-convenient Starbucks for meeting a friend for coffee-time. I've actually searched for alternate coffee shops nearby but have found none... as we both work in the hospitality industry, we hate to take up space at a full-service restaurant for just coffee. So we meet here & stalk the one table not against the west-facing windows (again, this is Florida - a girl can go blind from that late afternoon sun). Also, they only have one bathroom, but its large & clean, and usually fully stocked. 

Beverages are always good and the service is decent. Sometimes I have a pastry or bread, and am never disappointed. They also carry a selection of other snacks, as well as sandwiches.

All the girls working this morning were completely rude not just to me but each person that came in. Oh, but while taking my order finally, they yelled "hey" to a girl cheerfully and went back to being unfriendly to everyone else. I think they purposely forgot the sweet stuff in my drink it's supper bitter.

The Starbucks on 56th and Illinois is the best Starbucks in the area, no question. My daughter's current favorite is the double chocolate chip creme frappuccino, which is apparently challenging for so many locations except this one. Mine is the salted caramel mocha, with my personal modifications, and I am never disappointed. I sure wish we lived closer to this store. I may have to make the drive, though, because these baristas and the drinks they make are awesome!

This location is medium-paced, which is perfect, as many Starbucks can get overwhelming with all the customers. Of the four visits I have paid them recently, three have resulted in an incorrect order. They were very small mistakes that shouldn't bother anyone, but 25% success rate should be noted. All of my visits have been inside and "for here" orders. No drive thru, no take-aways. The important factor is that the mistakes were always promptly corrected, and usually with some form of reimbursement. The staff is fantastic, friendly, and fast.
Great people, good food but seldom a place to sit.  People just using WiFi and taking up seats, many not eating or drinking Starbucks products.....    Sherry
It's a college crowd. Obviously you're not here because you're looking for psudo-intellectual chat. You're at the Starbucks on Gay & High.

Usually great, but the last few times I've been here the "closing manager" has been windex-ing things while 5+ people are waiting for drinks. One person is making them all, and the "closing manager" is causally walking around and talking at the one person making drinks. It took 16 minutes for me to get a hot tea. I get you want to get off work, but the poor person making drinks is slammed while the "closing" team member is trying to run off her checklist. I only know this because she was talking about it the whole time.

Recently opened (end of July/early August). Limited seating with most seating in the foyer of College Plaza. Seems as though they were trying to make the best of limited building space, but this seating only works for short conversation with a coworker-not studying, as the foyer has large amounts of noise and foot traffic. 

Quality and customer service is at Starbucks baseline or slightly below. They seem to have trouble nailing a simple "Blonde roast with no room" order and the baristas lack the Starbucks enthusiasm you might see at other locations. I imagine this will change with time, but I'd recommend studying or meeting with your friend at the Second Cup on the next block until that happens.

Okay.... so Starbucks is a Starbucks, is a Starbucks. This place isn't much different than any other location. Baristas are very friendly and are very helpful with any questions you might have. I love the standardization of Starbucks. Everything is the same no matter where you go. Starbucks has done a great job at that I'll say! 

They offer two bathrooms which is awesome, and are always clean whenever I've used them! 

The only downfall to this location is the lack of seating. For its central location I am surprised they didn't choose a larger store. Its often hard just to find a seat if you come alone, let alone if you come with a friend or two. Only time its not as difficult is if you visit in the warm seasons when you can take advantage of their outside seating. 

I do love the location of this store. Its close to home and is central, which makes meeting friends for coffee very easy.

This is a nice Starbucks to hang out at. It is smaller than most, but the view is great and the staff is always nice. There is no drive in, which keeps the noise down. I am an ice coffee and scones kind of person and the quality here is first rate. I would certainly recommend it. I often take my kids here and they are always friendly to them. They also still have the old style tables and chairs, which I prefer.

I saw some reviews saying this Starbucks was slow and over priced but I live nearby and come here often and that has not been my experience. This Starbucks is busy depending on when you come but no different than any other location. The staff has always been super friendly and move as quickly as possible. Also, prices are the same as other locations.
Starbucks has a delicious Green Tea Frappuccino! And their coffee is SUPER yum zone!!

One star because they're there. Sucks the big one. Across the street from my job, and was so excited because the one by USF is awesome. Seeing the drive thru had such a long line, I went inside-for quicker service, ya know. But, they had me wait for my order until everyone in the drive thru was served. Really?! Well, I did, i did.... I threw a hissy fit.  What's the use? I'll stop at Mambo's. Cheaper, faster, tastes better.   Hey Starbucks MLK! You suck!

I indecisively arrived at the counter to meet a  delightful young woman named Lily. She was incredibly helpful and recommended a speciality drink. When I told her of my dietary restrictions, she quickly and intuitively made the correct modifications. I ended with a drink that taste like Christmas in a cup! Thank you! I will be back!

My previous review had taken into consideration some growing pains at this location. Sadly nothing has changed. A simple order of "coffee-black", paying, and then hearing "I only have enough for a tall, can I too it off with something else?". Who would have thought a cup of their medium roast would end up impossible 80% of the time?

---
12.8.16 - Update
"Sorry we don't have any coffee", offers me an Americano instead and charges the full price difference. Talk about customer service! Still single star'ing it here.
Friendly staff but filthy. Orders often wrong. Few comfy chairs. The best part are the people who camp out in the ladies room.
I went on Friday. Was stuck in line for over 30 minutes with no care in the world. Service is bad, manager is bad. Please get yourself together.

This Starbucks is close to my house so it's convenient but the time it takes to get through the drive thru is ridiculous. It's usually pretty slow, so I go with patience but today, 8:30 am on a Sunday, 6 cars in line and it's taken me 30 minutes to get through the drive thru! Crazy!  However, the baristas are friendly and the drinks are perfect. This would be the perfect Starbucks if speed was improved. Honestly, I should have used pre order but I didn't realize I would be in the line this long.
5/5 stars! Great service and fast ordering! And in a decent area. And most of all, employees seem to really prioritize customers from the Starbucks mobile app. That's a plus+

A very busy Airport Starbucks location! Stopped in for an iced coffee to caffeinate the brain cells prior to boarding my flight back to Dulles.

Service was very fast, coffee was really good. They do need to spend a bit more time cleaning the seating area, quite a bit of trash and a number of tables needed to be cleaned.

A little slower than most, not sure if it's because of the location or being understaffed or something else. For such a high-traffic area you think they'd be a little quicker, I hope it picks up soon! At least 4 people working at all times would be ideal!

Worst Starbucks I have ever been to in my life. Incompetent staff that just try to run you out the door. The only reason that I have continued to go this one is because it is about a block away from my house.

I stopped by this Starbucks a couple days ago to get my free drink from my rewards. Upon entering I was greeted with a friendly hello and I was glad to see no line. The food selection was the same as any other Starbucks and I got my drink after a slightly longer wait that usual. 

I ordered a venti caramel frap with two shots of expresso and extra caramel drizzle. The taste was fine but as I was walking to my car the drink ended up turning into a latte. There wasn't a lot of ice and I'm sure it didn't melt in the cold Reno weather. 

Overall, this place is a solid choice if you want a Starbucks drink.

It's Starbucks. Like every other Starbucks. 

This one is big and has a very nice interior. 

Biggest downfall is the overwhelming amount of Vandy kids during the school year.

I'll preface this review with the fact that I'm a tad biased when it comes to this spot. I've been coming here since it opened, almost 7 years ago, and haven't found a reason to frequent another location, however, that could change. 

The location of this spot is PRIME as it's on my way to work, baseball games, and countless other functions. Since the doors have opened, the staff took a while to get settled, but once they did, things were seamless. Recently this store has lost 3 employees in the past 3 months to other chapters in their lives - Tyler, Erica, and Nicole. All three were integral at helping maintain the balance of how things ran. 

There have been other key ingredients here as well - Tia, Jason, Bethany, Tamara, Yumi, Eunice, Adam, and a couple others who share the duties, but in the end, the three mentioned at first, are the focus of why this store might take a hit. 

VERY long opinion short, this store's Barista's have ALWAYS maintained a sense of hard work, efficiency, and the will to reduce long lines and turn out quality drinks. I just hope that the absence of Tyler, Erica, and Nicole don't affect things long term. 

I wasn't lying when I said I am biased.
Friendly staff, even when they're swamped. Seating is comfortable, even though the store is on the smaller side. Nice patio space too, when the weather is right.

The staff is great and the quality of products are up to par as well. My only complaint about this location is the amount of flies and gnats buzzing around. Living in Florida it is expected to deal with these bugs but it just seems they can be doing better in terms of insect control.

Have to say it's the closer to the house I have stop a few time and it was  but last time I order the guy working inside making the drinking didn't call my name let the coffee on the counter and throw the sleeve on the side he was very rude and that was not nice because they weren't busy

Love Starbucks. 

Hate the location of this store. While I love that it is in walking distance from my work, the location is awful. Parking is horrible and there honestly isn't enough space. 
It is a smaller shop, but food and drinks hit the spot. 
I do feel it takes a little longer to get items ordered, but this location is always booming. 
I don't think I've ever seen it slow down, it's almost always packed inside. There is no drive thru at this location

Since I came twice this week I'll write about both experiences.

Earlier, I ordered via drive thru. The lines are usually long at this location. Today was lite in comparison. Even with a lite line their drive thru service can be a bit slow but that could be perspective since we expect things almost instantly in a drive thru line. I ordered my iced doppio as usual and it was made perfectly with all of my little additions. If you order banana nut loaf, ask them to warm it up. It will change your world.

Today I ordered an iced doppio and it didn't turn out as expected. So they actually have on the menu an iced doppio that comes grande and I think there are things added in it that I'm not too fond of. So if you want a double espresso just ask for a double espresso... I'll have to remember that next time  other than that my bacon Gouda egg sandwich was great. The only negative experience this trip was coming inside the store this time and with only 2 people in front of me, it still took while before I was able to order. Guess I'll have to use the app more to order from this store specifically.

Service has gone through the floor here, and to be fare most locations have as well. 20-30 min waits are not uncommon at busy times. Wrong orders happen more then they should. I've gone from going daily to maybe once a month. And may not bother anymore.

One star because I actually found one person at this Starbucks that is friendly. Frances thank you very much. Everyone else is very rude. The tall black guy, the pretty girl wth the hijab, all very rude. I've been here at least 5 times and never once have I had a positive experience. They just have quite possibly the worst customer service culture of any Starbucks I have ever been to. I always go out of my way to the one further down on city Ave across from the acme. I am honestly just writing this so someone will give Frances a raise or something. If she works with these people every day and still smiles like that. That's saying something.

The lady works in the counter for making drinks in the morning on Sunday seems to be very mean or racist. I said to the male employee that I wanted the drink to have no ice, and he wrote it on the cup. It was understandable that she mistook it for having ice. But after I asked her to take the ice out, she didn't even say a word with the mean face and took the ice out silently. I said thank you to her, and she still didn't want to say a word to me with the mean face. But she said "have a great day" with a large smiley face to the white customers before and after me. I'm wondering if this is the overall starbuck employees' attitudes to people with different color.
Always good service. With no attitude, unlike the Starbucks at Garden State Park on Rt 38.
Pricey, but overall the best place for a tasty Venti Vanilla Latte. Love the Lemon Pound cake w/white glaze frosting poured on top, soothes the sweet tooth and goes well with your java! : )

Boom Boom Boom,
Service is excellent, the same people frequent this place including myself and they remember your name, this is by far the fastest Starbucks in the city of Tucson, keep up the good work.
Despite the Bad service and Mean workers, the worst thing is that they over charge on drinks. Beware!

This Starbucks used to be fast, efficient, with perfectly made drinks. The last 2 weeks...not so much. There have been at least 1-2 trainees there in the morning between 8:30-9:00, which is not exactly conducive to providing fast and reliable service. Training should not be done on weekdays at peak business time, during rush hour. Also, for the last 2 weeks, my drink has not been made properly or is too weak, missing a part of the order, etc. Please, Starbucks - train your employees during a slower time...so your customers aren't late (or rushing) to work!
I went in here to order a beverage but the line was so long and the employee was moving at snail speed so I walked out. Will not be returning.

1600 Arch St, Phila PA

Update #2. Yawn. Couldn't get up that early on Sunday! Darn I  missed meeting the intellectuals here to discuss current events!! Next time. Nerd. 

Update #1
Hanging with the Greater Philadelphia Thinking Society here tomorrow. ;-) How exciting: current events- way better than the news.;-P will be reviewing this Starbucks tomorrow. Be there 10:30am.
Sweetest baristas! My favorite starbucks downtown... Sometimes when I'm not getting my regular, I ask the girls for a suggestion and they always come up with something great!

It took 20 minutes to get a simple glass of black, brewed, iced coffee. A terribly inefficient location. People traveling on the freeway don't have the time it takes to stop here. I thought the Starbucks I stopped at yesterday in Barstow was bad, this one was even worse.

I was in Smyrna on business and just needed to grab a bite before a meeting. I am not a huge coffee fan, but I find Starbucks to be consistent when I am on the road.  I went in because I was not in a hurry and wanted to chill before a day of meeting.  The barista was awesome very friendly and all the right questions.  In my plain coffee did i want him to leave enough room for me to add cream...yes!  Did I want my coffee cake warmed...yes! As all Starbucks seem to be...it was a warm atmosphere with a mix of business and casual folks sharing some joe and getting their day started.  If back in that part of the world I would stop in again.

I believe in giving positive reviews more than negative. Steven the British accented man working here made my evening stop at this Starbucks a pleasure. He was beyond courteous and was the most friendly person I had encountered all day!  I left the drive through with a huge goofy smile plastered on my face. I hope he's there next time i swing through because he's getting a nice tip from me.
Giving 1 star cause there isn't an option for none. Took 20 minutes to get through the drive thru and we only ordered 1 latte. Avoid if you can help it.

Pretty good Starbucks despite the sometimes questionable location. I never know with south st..you either find a gem or you come across crazies.

The staff here are very nice in the mornings, so I can't vouch for the later times.
They're friendly and professional and the wait is not bad compared to other Starbucks locations. They also make my drinks right.
Parking is a hit or miss but in the mornings it's no problem !

I've never waited 40 minutes for Starbucks before. 

Additionally, I saw a lady put literal green tea in my Iced Green Tea Latte. It's supposed to be matcha powder! The person at bar didn't even use the appropriate lines on the shaker container AND my entire cup was filled with ice! EXTREMELY poor training and highly unprofessional in the delivery. 

I hate giving baristas crap especially if it's a busy location but come one, I've been a barista at a high volume location and you can't mess up THIS much! 

Avoid.
The coffee here make me wonder if Starbucks really cares about the taste of their coffee.
They are always SO rude. None of the staff have any customer service skills. I try to avoid Starbucks on campus because they always somehow manage to put me in a bad mood.
Fast service and the Unicorn frap is fantastic!! The drink is extremely refreshing and not too sweet.

I decided to go through the drive thru here on my way to work last night, but I wish I had stuck to my Dutch Bros!! I ordered a Venti Vanilla Mocha Frappe, and for one, the price with tax was $6.10, when the largest size at Dutch is only $7, and much bigger. The bigger issue I had though was that the Frappe didn't even fill the cup, and then even with whipped cream on it, there was still a lot of "empty" room in the lid (Dutch overfills if anything, so I definitely get my money's worth). Also, when I have ordered the same drink just down the road at the Starbucks in Albertson's, it has only cost me $5 and change, so not sure if the prices went up or what. And, the gal working was nice enough, but she definitely struggled with the "small talk" while every employee at Dutch has this down! Guess I will just have to keep going there from now on!!
Stopped in for a Quick Tea. Love the Green Iced tea. Good location and fast service.

Music not too loud.  We pulled in to fuel beloved and I enjoyed the outdoor patio on a warm summer morning.  Plenty of seating with the ubiquitous green umbrellas.  If Starbucks sold those, we'd have them on our home patio! He loves the coffee and I always enjoy my large ice water.  The store is clean, comfortable, and convenient to the main road.
Great service. Try the amazing Peppermint Hot Chocolate.
Well I wouldn't know how this Starbucks is. The rude ignorant parking lot attendant who bullies patrons back into their cars is to blame. Stay in your little hut and leave the customers alone.

Trash days are Monday Wednesday and Friday. The first day I came I was not able to get into the drive-thru, I was determined to find another morning routine so I waited and found out their trash days. You want to come for their customer service and stay for their food!
A good little Starbucks inside of Target.  I have stopped here a couple of times and they have consistently done a good job at fulfilling my order to Starbucks quality.

Normally a five star place for me, but for the second time in a week my mobile order is not ready 15 minutes after order placed. I noticed that multiple mobile orders placed as recently as five minutes ago are all ready. Novel concept: make drinks in order they come in. And today I noticed barista just openly pouring my sweetener in instead of using the pump. Please get it together!

I've used both the drive through and the walk in. It's a little bit small but I think they've done a great job with the space that they have.

The drive through is blazingly fast. I was really impressed with how quickly they get their coffees done.

There's lots of parking as well. It does fill up during peak hours, but lots of cars move in and out, so it's not bad when you need to park.
This is true Starbucks - unique, lots of tables, music - making it a great place to hang out. Line can get long sometimes but it usually moves well. Parking is convenient but can be scarce when busy.

I enjoy frequenting this Starbucks...when I feel that I've given myself enough time before work to go. It gets super busy in the mornings, even at 6:30. The baristas are always kind, and friendly customers! Sure parking is sparse, but this is Green Hills! Lots of space in this Starbucks if you're needing me time or meeting a colleague.
A great place, good atmosphere, great area, excellent WiFi, electrical receptacles and everything you would expect from Starbucks. Prices MAY be a bit higher for we're in an affluent neighborhood.

I stop here occasionally when I'm parked in the lot across the street.  It is a small Starbucks, but the service is awesome here.  The only issue I've ever had is that sometimes when it gets really busy they tend to over sweeten their coffee.  Which doesn't affect me much since I usually order an iced coffee.  I can fix that by adding extra milk.  With other drinks though I think it can be overwhelming.
Still great lattes, but pricey!  I always have to ask for extra hot because they never froth the milk hot enough for my taste.

One of the better Starbucks in the area. The staff is always friendly and quick to get your drink the way you want it. The staff is always friendly and extra helpful when completing your order. Whether its five in the morning or during the rush they greet you with a smile and make you Starbucks experience a great one...
Not kidding.... Waited 20 minutes for a hot chocolate and only 4 customers were ahead of us!!!!

The usual Starbucks. Just a little slower at this particular moment. 

Fairly clean. Not spotless.

Like another reviewer said, it is very hard to review chain restaurants do to their corporate standards that each restaurant must follow. I will say that there was a mistake in the ordering process when I went. I ordered a peach green tea and waited for it. I never heard it being called but they gave it away to someone else who had been standing there. That made me a little upset because how could you possibly miss or forget the person who ordered something five or 10 minutes later? The woman who was working at the counter made up for it by giving me a large peach green tea instead of the small that I ordered. I guess it was her way of saying sorry about that. I really appreciated it! I also met some medical students while I was studying there and we had some interesting conversations. That's the nice thing about the Starbucks. It's right across the street from the medical school campus so there are a lot of other medical students studying there if that's what you're interested in or if that's the crowd that you like to hang out with. I also like to bounce between getting drinks there and going to the chipotle a couple doors down.  The parking is so convenient. There is a very nice and clean parking garage right across from it. Not sketchy at all

I came in here for a little post exercise treat. This store is a little smaller than other Starbucks, but I thought that made it feel cozier. There's a long snack bar counter facing the parking lot, and the traditional comfy area with tables. The employees were really friendly and everything was made fast and correctly. Even my boyfriend's blonde roast that had to be done specially had hardly any wait time.  This starbucks is definitely one of the better ones I've been to, so stop in if you're in the mood for some yummy caffeine.

I worked near this Starbucks  for 8 months last year so it was my go-to Starbucks when I was running late, having a rough morning or was running out of energy in the afternoon. I can say with great happiness that I was and still am very impressed with this Starbucks! 

This area is filled with business executives who are constantly on the go. At any one given time the line is around the corner but the staff handle it like champs! 

Not only are they really speedy when it comes to making your drink they remember your name and "regular" drink if you frequent here enough. With the sheer volume of people that come through the line each day I was in shock that the staff were able to keep up, I know I wouldn't be able to... but maybe that's why so many people love it! 

Hands down, a great Starbucks!!

This location is quite the people watcher spot. You get the blend of Vandy students, local movers and shakers, music row dial turners and business folk. The service here is spot on for accurate and friendly. 

I like the seating areas. There are tables inside and out and couches near the fireplace. There are also bar style seats. The place is clean and inviting. Parking is plentiful.

This is one of the better Starbucks locations in Nashville.
Worst Starbucks experience ever, paid for a full cup for 2/3, in Atlanta i get my coffee for less and with a full cup, good help is hard to find but not impossible:

I mean...this is your typical Starbucks.  The people are friendly, the drinks are consistent, and there's lots of room to plant yourself if you're meeting a friend or trying to get some work done.  What I don't like is the parking.  Obviously, this isn't something they can really help, but it does deter me from visiting.  There are SO many spaces, but with all the other businesses in the complex competing for spots, it's hard to find one during busy times.  But, hey, if you're looking for a solid Starbucks experience, this is your place.
I hate how much I love you Starbucks.  This Starbucks has excellent customer service.  I did not want to leave my dogs unattended so they brought my drink to the door when I placed a mobile order.

This Starbuck location is very friendly and accommodating to college students. There is a full menu and the hours usually last till midnight. Per usual, the design is very open and the number of outlets is quite plentiful. Just make sure you don't run your cord across the floor how I did as a safety hazards. Oops (TT).  The service at this location was very warm and open. One person greeted me and acknowledge my presence in the queue and try to prepare my order so I was not waiting too long. My experience was good and I would go back for a caffienated drink and/or to study.
The Starbucks at the Southwest terminal was speedy & friendly. They would be outstanding if the Gals would wear hair ties & the kiosk was a wee bit cleaner.

I spend many hours studying at Starbucks. I am a fan of their gold card because I get free refills on iced coffee and tea. This location is pretty busy especially in the evenings and seating is limited. This location is open until midnight Sunday-Thursday and 1am on Friday and Saturday, which makes it the latest closing Starbucks in the Pinellas area. So if you have a late night craving or you need to study late into the night they are open and have a drive thru. 

Come earlier in the day if you want a wider selection of food items. I love the new slow roasted ham and swiss croissant for breakfast. The cakepops are delicious for an afternoon snack too.  Since the addition of the LaBoulange pastries, the food items have gotten tastier but smaller.  The staff is friendly and the bathrooms are usually clean. There is outdoor seating which is nice on a warm day too.

This Starbucks location is very convenient!  My favorite hot drink here is the Peppermint white chocolate mocha and cold drink is Green tea frappuccino. I highly recommend signing up for their rewards program as the prices of these drinks a little high. Free drinks on your birthday and other free rewards thru out the year. This location always have a friendly staff. I made a mobile order and had accidentally put the wrong location and they gave me my drink anyways!

I always enjoy Starbucks coffee and whenever I'm in St. Charles, we usually stop by this particular location, though usually just the drive through. I think today was the first time we actually went inside.

Big fan of the drive through here. The employees are always extremely upbeat and never try and rush you. Sometimes they're a little too helpful when they ask if you want to add an extra shot of espresso and end up bouncing off the walls :). 

On this particular visit, we had some extra time so we went inside. We got our coffee quick but they were out of their breakfast sandwiches. Not a big deal since the barista explained that yesterday's snow storm affected their food situation. 

I'm particularly fond of the blonde roast and if I happen to catch it on sale, I'll buy some and have them grind it for me. Iced green teas are great too.
BEST Starbucks ever! Love this location & I have loved this location for years. Atmosphere is great, customer service is great, coffee is always great & right! It's the only location I go to anymore!

I appreciate that the iced coffee is consistently good, they provide sugar in the raw, and they move that long ass line fast, BUT they operate like soul-less robots; the lunatic fast screaming of people's names gives me anxiety every time.  Such a stressful environment.
Never disappointed in Starbucks, and I especially like the blended tea's that they have. Y-U-M!

Poor service. The ladies were to busy talking to each other and airport employees instead of getting an order correct... I ordered a very berry hibiscus tea and they gave it to another customer. Once I told them about the mistake, take gave me a tea with what I hope were unblended berries.
They're always quick with orders, friendly, and make drinks correctly. The Starbucks itself is always clean and well-kept. They also keep free water with cups out at all times

I've been here a few times and the drinks that I usually order don't come out tasting like how it should when I order from this particular location. Not sure if it's the bartista or if they do it differently here. Also, I've came here to read/study twice and both times the environment was terrible. The bartistas were very loud and talking about their social lives and cursing. Very inappropriate for work place.

Inside is nice and so are the employees. I've been in this one where the line is to the door and other times only a couple of people waiting to order. Lot's of people hanging out and studying which is fine with me. I usually never sit down at any Starbucks because I'm always on the go. This is a larger Starbucks with tons of seating so enjoy if that's your thing. 

Now for the reason they get 2 stars...the parking sucks. Crammed parking spots with at least 5 cars driving around vulturing for a spot during peak times. There is a parking lot right behind the Starbucks that charges to park. Don't think you can get away with parking for 5 minutes and getting something quick. There is a company who have their assholes sitting and watching for people who do not pay to park. The assholes then will put a boot on your car so you can not drive it. You have to pay the assholes $70 to have it removed.

Maybe it depends on the time you hit up this Starbucks, but my experiences have been pretty great. I tend to go to this Starbucks early in the morning, somewhere between 5 and 6:30am. The employees are always upbeat and friendly, especially considering the time. There's never any wait and my ice coffee with soy milk is always made perfectly. It's my once a week surviving summer camp treat.

Drinks are great!
Lovely staffs, really friendly.
Sometimes give me free treat. 
The music is also nice.

I hate paying so much for coffee... But I absolutely love this location! Not only is a just a few minutes from my house, but the staff is always pleasant- if not genuinely excited to serve you. I have lost many many hours in this Starbucks while studying, and while the music may sometimes be a bit loud, it's nothing a simple pair of headphones can't solve. The staff is readily and happily able to make awesome coffee, and if you are unsure they have a field day helping you pick a brew.

Parking is limited here and they are always short staffed. I have been here numerous times were I have been waiting in line forever and ended up leaving with out ordering anything.
Today I went to this location to give it another try and I have to say it was quick getting in and out.
I ordered a trenta passion tea lemonade and it was perfect.
Apparently they are building a bigger Starbucks next to the Bank of America in the parking lot so we shall see if the service changes but overall today was a good day to make a purchase at Starbucks.

My favorite Starbucks in Nashville. Great staff, fast wifi, adequate seating, the customers at this location are great, and the overall layout is perfect. No other Starbucks in Nashville has a fireplace, giving it a more "coffee house" feel. Perfect for winter nights with a friend(s) or late night studying. The only reason I will not give 5 stars, the parking can be a hassle. Overall, great Starbucks location.

The service here is good and they have a cute outdoor seating section. But as others have noted, the parking lot is awful and it is often 100% full in the morning and at lunch time (the only times I've ever stopped by).

The nicest Starbucks in the city. The staff are universally friendly and competent here despite the obvious pressure they are under to serve customers as quickly as possible (I've found myself waiting 10 minutes in line here during peak hours).  One of them, an American, speaks Japanese, and I have heard him exchanging a few words with customers. The barists almost always have something nice to say, in contrast to other locations in the city where, in my experience, they merely set your drink on the counter and disappear.

As many in the yelp community know, I am not a big fan of Charbucks (aka fourbucks) BUT- and this location deserved the big but... considering that this shopping area (near the Target on City Ave.) is the only walkable place near my new office, I come here for an occaisional Ice Green Tea Lemonade.

This Starbucks is clean and (aside from morning rush) not crowded.

A pleasant surprise.  My goodness - I may start (gasp) liking Starbucks again.

The baristas here are a little hit or miss, but they are more hit than miss. The bigger miss though is the average person at this specific Sbux. There's rarely open seating inside whenever I've stopped in. It never fails students commandeer almost all the spaces for laptops, books, studying... and there's one empty cup nearby that has been sitting there for three hours. Or it could be like the one time someone was rolling a doobie in the side corner and asked if I had any change while I was trying to get some work done. 

Back when this location used to be 24h (it's not anymore, which is why I'm knocking it down to 3 stars), the outside patio would be full at 1am, and you could overhear conversations in Russian, Vietnamese, etc. There's still a little of that now, but not like it used to be.

The parking lot is the only problem I have with this starbucks. A couple of months ago, I would have given this place one star because of its rude baristas and dirtiness. But it is redone and looks clean and nice. Also, they hired a new staff who takes care of its customers and are nice.

I like this Starbucks because it's fashioned to the feel and culture of Nashville. It's not uncommon to sit around here and hear musicians talking about an upcoming show or a recent recording session, which is pretty cool.

From a more practical viewpoint, this Starbucks has tons of seating of all sorts, so you'll never have to scramble for a seat. If you like a little chatter and buzz, it's a good place to camp out and get work done. Not the best choice if you're sensitive to distractions, though. And the wi-fi is consistently reliable - also a win.

Drinks ... It's a Starbucks. Drinks are $$, overpriced baked goods and sandwiches are $$$ ... But you knew that already.

I've been here a dozen or so times because it's convenient, as this one is located inside the Target Store in Burlington Township. Each of my experiences was perfectly fine/good. No problems whatsoever. The wait can be a bit long in the morning because it is on the small side. However, now that the stand-alone Starbucks across the parking lot (with a drive-thru window) is open, that problem is likely to go away.

This location is in a hotel so they don't accept Starbucks reward free drinks but you can pay with the app. Your typical Starbucks yet kind of hard to get to when walking on the opposite side of the street.

One of the best Starbucks in the area, and I should know since I go to them all. I never wait long at all and the service is excellent, Zac & Holland are really nice and always make my berry hibiscus drink on point, will definitely keep coming back.

Man, I stop in this Starbucks by necessity and lack of other options, but it's just never convenient. The parking sucks, and the baristas are slower than most Starbucks. I like the space once I'm inside and have my drink, but overall this is not my favorite Starbucks in any way.

Do you want to wait in line only to find out most of the drinks on the me u are out of stock and that being the case everyday then this Starbucks is the choice for you. There is only one person that works there hat is polite and has work in well run establishment before. Everyone else it's as if this was their first job at the age of 35. I'm sorry but this place needs new management. You've lost my business to Saxbys

Waited in a long drive up line.  Ordered iced black tea, got a cup bearing that label but it was coffee.  Parked, went in, waited some more, told the woman behind counter who grimaced, grabbed it out of my hand and came back 5 minutes later, here you go.  No we're sorry, no nothing.   Not the service I am used to from Starbucks.
I always get the same thing--grande caramel macchiato. This location skimped on the expresso. My drink tastes like hot milk.

As you would probably expect, this Starbucks is much like the other Starbucks scattered throughout the Nashville area. It does however, have a couple things that set it apart from some of the others. For instance, it seems to have the Starbucks Reserve coffees on a more regular basis than the other locations nearby; something that doesn't go unnoticed for someone with a bean addiction like mine. Second, while a much more common feature these days, it has support for mobile payments, which tends to make visits even faster and more convenient than they already were. All in all, pretty consistent, but with a few perks that make it a cut above the ordinary.
Efficient but busy. Parking is tough. It's full of college kids due to proximity with Vanderbilt.
Parking can be ridiculously tight...smaller,gets busy at times..standard...nice staff!

So, I have been coming to this Starbucks for a year or two and just noticed a discrepancy on the price listed on their signs in the baked goods vs what I was actually charged. I was told that was the corporate price... and I was paying extra since the location has a license agreement with Starbucks... pretty shady guys! Best to just charge your customers what's actually advertised on your signs.

Well, my request for no cheese on my sammich was ignored, I even double asked when she handed it to me and she reassured me there was no cheese. 

Sadly there is cheese present on my sammich guys! Otherwise, friendly, timely service.

Starbucks service varies and usually always up on standards, but this place is just so awful that I'm leaving a review on yelp for the first time.

I was polite in ordering a pastry, but the lady not only screamed at me because my debit card didn't went through (like, is that even my fault?), and I got yelled at again because apparently she called out to me "five times" (according to her) while I was on an important phone call I suddenly got from the bank and that I didn't respond her right away. I would feel sorry if I was in her way during a busy time, but there wasn't even a line. The lady screamed rudely at me and did not even get my order right.

Simply put, there are many Starbucks near the area that are hundred times better, so just don't come here if you don't want your good mood ruined.

When you need that fix, this is the spot.
I'm not a huge fan, mainly because it's insanely expensive and a chain....but I do enjoy the interesting coffee recipes and the gold card membership and free rewards here and there.  And the picks of the week are also great!

The baristas are mostly on top of it and friendly.  I do hate, however, that I am asked if I want my coffee hot or iced.  In my mind, it's HOT unless otherwise stated.  I mean, that's how coffee was meant to be consumed.  But, I digress.

This location is very convenient...the parking lot is a bit chaotic at times - because people can't drive.  The outdoor seating area is plentiful and nice to have an outdoor patio when the weather is beautiful.

Starbucks has done a fantastic job of being consistent no matter what store you are in anywhere in the world.  That makes a pretty impressive statement!
This location does not accept Starbucks card rewards (or at least this is what the barista told me after I waited in line and got cut in front of).
A very crowded Starbucks!  The staff was extremely nice, but unfortunately did not have my go to chai tea :(

Wow! This is my favorite Starbucks on the mainland. I was wasting copious amounts of time reading a local newspaper and playing on the computer over my morning coffee when some old lady started literally having a temper tantrum over her oatmeal! There was a cop in line and as her tantrum progressed and she was asked to leave and after refusing she was kicked out by the cop. That's some breakfast entertainment! Oh, and by the way, the oatmeal is tasty and they are quick and friendly.. as long as you aren't a p...ed off old lady that is.

If coarse the coffee, espresso, and lattes are great...it's Starbucks. But the traffic in the drive-thru is horrible. The lines are always long and wrap around the building. Going inside is just as insane.

Stopped in on a Sunday afternoon.  Asked for a caffeine free suggestion and received "anything could be decaf".  Ordered and iced coffee w/ cream.  Received sweetened iced coffee.  Asked them to re make.  Received cream and ice with a little coffee.  9 year old son ordered frappuccino.  Charged 4 and change for tall, even though their is a special for a grande frap for 3 dollars.  That was rude.  I blame management.
Worst starbucks in the city...maybe the world. Insanely long waits, no air conditioning. No bathroom (you have to go to the bar across the hall)
Super friendly! Despite how outrageously busy they can get given that they're in a prime location, I have always received great service and good drinks.

Friendly baristas, quick service, and no complaints. Very convenient to the hotel I am staying at, and for some reason they can't figure out why I want to walk across the parking lot to Starbucks because they have free coffee.

Found myself on South Street and needing coffee, so stopped into this Starbucks. It's pretty much like most Starbucks I go into. The line tends to move a little slowly but the latte was good and overpriced in typical Starbucks fashion. The condiment station was a little messy and could have used a little attending to.
I just discovered matcha green tea.my newest addiction.  Scoops(4-5) in Ice water less than a buck!   or as frappe.  Service was friendly but seemed slow.

The Starbucks card system was down for the day.  Instead of posting it somewhere, they let people stand in long lines just to find out when one went to pay that one could only use cash or credit.

At least the other store across the parking lot had the decency to tell me before I ordered.

Think the worker should have a shot of coffee ,waited for 15min for green tea lemonade, cause the maker ask the cashier what is that ,the cashier have no ideal what she write ,so I tell her green tea lemonade,the cashier said oh that is it , she dun know what she write how can she be the cashier. The maker feel like she dun want to make the right drink that I pay for,she say it good have it omg I dun believe it!!!!!!!

The service at this location is almost always poor. The employees hardly ever smile or say hello. The drinks are also bad quality unlike any other Starbucks location I go to. The iced caramel mochiatto always looks like it's been sitting out for a while and the caramel is just sprinkled on top of the drink

So you now have to wait in line to get the code to use the restroom and then wait in line to actually use the restroom. Oh and the barista who has the code miraculously does not have a pen to write it down so you can remember it. This is after the remodel where they though it was brilliant to serve you out of a trailer with no food and half the menu. Maybe go to Largo or something?

After the Chili Dog at Nathan's, it was time for my U.S. RDA of caffeine, and so over to the Starbucks I went - needed to keep the eyelids propped open for a few more hours - so an iced, triple shot, sugar free vanilla latte was desperately needed!

Delicious! I think I finished the drink before I even got back onto the Interstate! :-)

Multiple doors here confused me and the friend I was meeting! Unfortunately, I remember my visit to this location mainly because the Starbucks app insisted on an update.... I couldn't quickly connect to the WiFi, so my friend had to pay for me since we were short on time to catch a movie. Not this location's fault, of course, but just another of many reasons why I don't really care for Starbucks & their sugary, overpriced coffee. This is actually a very large Starbucks, with lots of seating including many outside tables.

They know my order before I order it depending on the time of day . Which is awesome my husband is steady and never changes I switch based on the temperature outside.  Generally they know that if it's cold I want a dirty Chai grande with soy.  If it's hot I want a peach tea lemonade sweetened.  The staff is friendly and always willing to help.  Best morning pick me up on 19.
Unimpressive staff and location. I've visited this location multiple times and now only visit if it's a last resort.

So most everyone has been to a Starbucks before, but the level of service and quality of the product is bar none at this location.  The staff is always friendly and pleasant.  I usually frequent the drive through, and they make it as effortless as possible and keep the line moving so that you are in and out in record time no matter how long the line is.  My usual order involves a few special requests and the many times I've been here, they've never messed it up.  There's something to be said about a place like that!
Super friendly baristas ...but...it's still just a Starbucks.  This area doesn't really have non-chain alternatives yet.  I'm still hoping!

I know, I know starbucks is the evil CHAIN!  But this is a great neighborhood find.  you walk in and they know not only your name but your order.  You see the same faces all the time so not a big turn over kind of place.  Consistent, good (over roasted) coffee ...

I'm not sure what my review of Starbucks will bring to anyone, since I feel like everyone knows everything that there is to know about Starbucks, but I would say that this location in particular is above most other Starbucks locations.

First, expect your usual Starbucks items at expensive Starbucks prices just like you would anywhere else. Service here is also usually fast and friendly and I never ran into any particular problem here.

What really sets this location apart is the fireplace in the middle around which you can sit during the cold winter months and the interior design. 

This location is usually full or almost full since a lot of students come here from universities nearby and particularly Vanderbilt University.

Overall, my experience with this location is rather positive and I would recommend it if you are a fan of the brand and are looking for a nice location. Feel free to message me for any additional details that you may need!

For anyone who drinks Starbucks more than a few times per week, we all know how precise and proficient they are. Unfortunately, this specific Starbucks is not. They have longer than usual wait times (6-10 mins online ordering), the drinks are never right or never taste the way they should. Yes, the staff is friendly, but not efficient. If you can avoid it, please save your money and go to one closer!

Slowest location ever. Staff is very friendly and seem to all be working hard so I am not sure what the problem is with this location. The parking lot is a nightmare. This time they had to brew more coffee as well.. not sure why we are out at 4 pm on a Saturday.

In Avon, the land of the chain stores, Starbucks is one of the best!! The baristas are extremely friendly and even know your name when traversing the drive-thru. They even have a customer of the week!

I am bumping them back up to 5 stars as they now are able to redeem rewards at this Starbucks. 

The layout of the store is great. There are plenty of tables, chairs and tables both inside and outside. The fireplace is a great feature during the cold months.  This all makes this Starbucks a good place to meet up with friends or to take work and study.  

The people who works always are friendly and the drink are made correctly.  Parking can sometimes get tight but the Cheshire has a large parking lot in case the Starbucks parking spot are all occupied.

I stop by here for my 10am coffee and it's okay. It use to be a Good Earth but unfortunately they don't have the same brand power Starbucks does. It's hard to say anything really good or bad about my experiences at Starbucks. They have their formula down pat and I know what to expect. So far they have not deviated from the formula through out all my visits in Canada and USA. 

So I can only give this a three star because I don't find anything exciting about predictability and overpriced coffee. I was happy to see a few Vegan options for food like a veggie quinoa salad with tahini dressing and apple chips but I'm not going to give them a star for throwing me a bone. No pun intended. 

The staff are wonderful and that is all I care to say about Starbucks.

I walk in they see me, I go pay and then pick my coffee up in two minutes. Can't ask for more. One of the guys who is been working there for a while, and is been making my coffee all the time almost, u will be missed buddy. Thanks for making my frap  always delicious
Very nice and freindy and and very quik,never in there longer then 5 minutes getting my coffee.

This has to be the absolute worst Starbucks ever! Every time I come here there is a huge line and the person working the register feels the need to chit chat with everyone for lengths of time. They need to work on moving the line along! 

I went one afternoon and ordered a tall dark roast and they were all out of coffee. It's a coffee place for Christ's sake! How could you not have any coffee brewed?? Also...it is a pretty filthy Starbucks.

Sunday at noon, and they were not organized or efficient. The drive- thru was packed so I thought going inside would be faster. Nope. I think they take care of drive-thru customers before in store customers. After waiting a good bit for my grand mocha, I had to ask for and wait longer for a warmed morning bun. Huh? Food and coffee are consistently good, but their service needs help with efficiency.
This is my local Starbucks and it's amazing! New staff is super nice!! Drinks are yummy!! Glad there has been a serious change!! This is what I expect when I visit Starbucks!
It is hard to screw up Sbux, as I call it. It's close by, and the drive thru is open late which I am happy about. SO far so good. Let's hope it stays that way!

I think the address on here is incorrect, but I managed to find it in the parking lot anyway ... pretty big parking lot and lots of shops.  

It was pretty empty in this Starbucks and they have a large covered outdoor seating area and a lot of seating indoors.  Drinks came out fast and the staff was nice.

Wow. Worst Starbucks experience I have ever had. Flew out on a Saturday morning and 3 people were ahead of me in line. We all waited 8-10 minutes for our drinks. When asked what was taking so long we were given extremely rude responses as it was clear all of the ladies here hated their jobs. Shame on Starbucks for not correcting this. Look at the all of the other reviews.

I love this Starbucks and the location.

The location is awesome.  Out of the way of heavy traffic like the Marlton Starbucks, yet close to a lot of local and family-owned businesses, such as a small bookstore (Bookswap Cafe) in the same plaza.  It's small and cozy, especially in the wintertime.  The floors and tables are always clean, and there's plenty of natural light.

The manager, Josh, is absolutely awesome.  He has helped me so much lately in expanding my coffee tastes as well as suggesting new things to try.  All of the employees are great and friendly, and I'm always greeted with a crescendo of hellos and how are you doings.

The coffee is excellent.  I've tried everything on the menu, and I've never had a bad cup of coffee here.  I've recently begun to drink the dark roasts, and today I tried the seasonal Three Region Blend.  All of them are delicious.

Thanks Medford Starbucks team for being awesome.  You have a loyal customer here that will keep coming back!
I was very clumsy and spilled all my kid's milk. They graciously accepted my apologies and insisted they would clean the mess for me. Thanks.
After paying nearly $6 each for two Pumpkin Spice Lattes at the drive thru, I opened on to stir it to find that they underserved both by an inch!  Won't be going to this Starbucks again.

This place sucks and I'm not even talking about the quality of the drinks. They have the rudest cashier I have ever encountered. A man-child with glasses gave me attitude and rudely correcting me at every coffee order I made. 

I'm an experienced barista so I know sometimes it gets tough but I would never snark at anyone. Thank goodness he wasn't the one making my drink or I wouldn't dare drink my coffee for who knows what he would do to my drink. My husband had to watch his every move just to make sure he didn't spit in my drink. 0/10 would not recommend! Just to the new one in St. Ann by the Rock Road, they're much friendlier peeps!

It's a Starbucks, so you know what you get.  The staff was nice and got us our overpriced coffees quickly.  Being located In the casino is nice, but the coffee didn't bring us any luck at the slots or the blackjack table!

While I was waiting for my order, I had to listen to a debacle amongst guests who didn't like that the bathroom had a passcode, and you had to ask the barista for it.  Was strange.  I don't care about a passcode if it keeps it clean enough, and it lessens the chance of someone ODing in there, but that's just me sayin'.

Upstairs is cozy.  Grab a seat by the windows and people watch while you sip your coffrapamochacinolattea.

I've been to several Starbucks all over the states as I'm sure many people have, but this specific location is the best. The crew they have working there is the most friendly group ever. I guess I can only speak for the early morning staff because that's when I go, but I always challenge them with made up drinks and complicated orders and they do a great job. Also, while they are trying to figure out my drinks they are good at small talk and don't just leave you sitting there in the drive through like a number. I can't speak anymore highly of this group. Keep it up!

All the employees here are friendly;  fast & knowledgeable.  Since I'm not a coffee drinker I often ask for suggestions & they are quick with a drink or two to try. 
Handy that they share space with a bank for quick wirhdrawals!
Oh yes and there is a drive through. Yay!

I can't say enough good stuff about this Starbucks. Staff is amazingly friendly and helpful. Large covered patio with outlets. Spacious area inside with sofa and nice chairs. Best ambiance in town. Come here regularly and you won't be a stranger long. Bring your friends and have fun.
Great Starbucks location. Friendly staff and fast service. Only downside is that the location is smaller on the inside, but they do have a drive thru.

This Starbucks has a fantastic view of the Catalina and run on mountains with outdoor seating. The perfect spot to grab a coffee after a hike or walk in saguaro national park! The staff is also very friendly which is a plus. FYI - They don't carry the Starbucks Arizona mugs. Staff recommended 22nd and Harrison or speedway and wilmot.
I have had absolutely no problems with this starbucks. My drinks always taste right and the customer service is always very good!

**UPDATE- There has been a dramatic improvement the last two visits! Good job!
Lately this Starbucks has been really disappointing. I have often come in and watched my mobile order get pushed to the back of the line for someone that ordered in the drive thru or in the cafe. This is not the way it's supposed to go. I used to work at Starbucks so I am very well aware of the procedures. I have also watched baristas get out of sequence on their drink making. I think some training needs to be done to get this very busy store up to the standard. It's frustrating to have to wait an extra ten minutes or more for a drink that you ordered on your way in the store. There is a reason for mobile ordering. The people here are great and I love the atmosphere but please work on your standards.

This is my local Starbucks and I often stop by here when out running errands since it's close to both my usual post office and my usual grocery store. Same old story as every other Starbucks, right? 

Right, except for some reason their wireless Internet hates me lately. Whenever I try to connect I get weird error messages, which is a total bummer when I've stopped in to work over a decaf Americano and order only to discover when I sit down that I actually cannot do any work. In fact, I'm there right now, siphoning radio waves from some other random signal. I may even fall off the Internet before I get a chance to hit 'post' on this review. Fingers crossed. 

PS: Lauren's review comments on the three plush chairs at this location; I'm happy to report that that number has been upped to FOUR.

This is the new Starbucks that just opened on Vista on the end of the vista village shopping center. I almost drove by it but saw that it was open today. I stopped in and got the white chocolate mocha for me and a caramel ribbon crunch frappacinno for the hubby. Great service and same great coffee that I expect from Starbucks! Great location! My mornings just got easier!

Slowest, untrained Starbucks staff I've ever experienced!
For sick a busy location during convention hours, this staff stand around laughing...asking how to make things, look st you with a blank stare when you order something off the menu (not even an odd request). The worst
Quite possibly the worst service at a Starbucks I've ever been to. Severely understaffed with folks who don't really care. Went 2 days in a row, simply horrible.

DO NOT EVERY GO TO THIS STARBUCKS if you intend to enjoy yourself and have a nice conversation or study or do anything else for that matter.  There are these obnoxious assholes that hang around there every single day.  They are Armenian?? Russian??.  I don't know what they are saying but they scream at the top of their lungs.  They are very disruptive and rude. They block the walk way where people are trying to get by.  I asked the lady there if she could tell them to quiet down so I could study.  No dice.  They literally shout when they talk and could care less how they affect the people around them.  It is worse than a biker bar.  

I've seen them chase dozens of people out of there with their rude, disruptive behavior and foul language, and the people that work there could care less.  They cuss in English for some reason??  Worst Starbucks I've ever been to, and I've been all over the country.  

If you are going to get your coffee in the morning to go, you'll probably be fine.  But, if you are intending to sit down and relax.  Forget about it!  Ain't gonna happen.

Not a bad little airport Starbucks - this one is convenient and fairly well stocked. Also the employees don't have the attitude you sometimes find at other airports. In all not a bad experience and I'm glad that there's decent coffee at the airport.

I love this location. The coffee is great, my orders are correct, and the baristas are quick and friendly.  The interior was just refurnished and looks great.  They have a long conference style table now with electric outlets.  It can be really busy between 7am and 8am; if you have trouble parking, there is an overflow lot around the back.
Horrible customer service from a girl with short bleach blonde hair and piercings in her face. It was hard to even to even wait for my drink.
THEY ARE NOT OPEN 24/7. I went in tonight at 11pm (a Thursday) and all the lights were off and they were closed. Never been here otherwise, but I'm sure the barista is great.
A big shout out to Rosslyn this morning! Today they went out of their way customer service wise. Such a great way to start the day :)

This is our stop every time we travel up north. Drive thru or store it's always a good experience. Restrooms are clean and store is too. Baristas are good. Thanks Millie!!  We will continue stop here every time.
Worst costumer service  I said "good morning" twice and no one answered... that all looked like bothered when I came to order.

This Starbucks' drive thru is extremely slow. The baristas are super nice and friendly, but they either need more staff, to work more efficiently, or just open another Starbucks down the street!! If there is one car ahead of you, expect to wait 10 mins. If there are 4 cars ahead of you, expect about 30 mins. It stinks to wait because most people are on their way to work or on the go; it shouldn't take longer than McDonalds. I would have given them 3 stars but today, I saw two cars leave the drive thru for them taking too long and the guy taking our order was not very attentative because he kept messing it up after repeating many times.

Its a good 'bucks, a little busy with people at laptops, but I can't complain because I often do work there too. Its the place to have your office.

They have a few more items than some of the local smaller locations. They also have a drive through.

I'm actually a regular here, but I just can't give any more stars because this place is just freezing inside. The staff is very friendly, though...and even with the drive-through backed up on weekend mornings, the service is pretty speedy.

Bring a sweater--the a/c is cranked in here no matter where you sit inside.

What's with the wifi? Worst connection out of all the South Tampa Starbucks locations. Don't even bother trying to connect.  Really. I will remove this comment when this gets better. :)

I've never been so disrespected by a barista. I got my usual grande non fat iced green tea latte. I usually get it shaken up and if they do not, I ask nicely and the Barista usually shake it for me. Not today, I asked nicely being the southerner that I am and instead of him kindly explaining to me that he cannot use the shake container because those are for non-dairy products he rudely stated that the containers you see there are for non-dairy products and I really don't feel like cleaning them after just your one drink. That was very unexpected and I've never been treated that way by anyone for no reason whatsoever. I didn't appreciate it. There was no need for attitude. Never going to this location again I'd rather go inside target which is a hop skip away.
Nope, dirty counter and slow unorganized, unpleasant barista. Find a different starbucks.

I love the convenience of this particular location but someone needs to explain to me why a full two hours before they close they had all of the pastries out of the case. I understand the need to start cleaning up before closing but two hours? Have they never heard of impulse purchases? Their manager needs to get the team on schedule because we had six people who all wanted pastries. It's ridiculous.
Best baristas around! All are super friendly and want to get to know you. They also make the best drinks!
My fav coffee. Won't go anywhere else for my cup of joe.

This is my go to for a Starbucks fix! They are pretty fast it's a small location and mostly cater to students and office staff in area including hospital staff. Too bad they don't seem to be open at 6am especially if you start the early shift.
Love the drive thru at this location. Coffee is alwasy what I'm expecting!
Super fast and friendly. Come here all the time and the line moves fast and serviced is exceptional.

Parking is a headache but the interior of this Starbucks is large, with an array of tables, workstations, bar seating, and couches. You'll find lots of college students studying here, so it's a good place to be productive. One of the better Starbucks locations I've been to!
Friendly staff. Very clean. The drive through is usually very fast unless you get someone in front of you ordering a bunch of food, in which case they should go inside in my opinion.

Upgrade. For a Starbucks, this place is a life bridge to sanity in suburbia. The outdoor seating is my pup's favorite place to spend part of the morning. The staff is great, just avoid the unfriendly skinny twink in the early mornings with a perpetually bad attitude. Everyone else is awesome. Eager to please, great coffee and they even know my boy Tango. Love coming here.

I recently read the not so good reviews on this Starbucks... Many of the complaints were true for the time. Chris has proven to be a good manager as far as speediness, efficiency, hiring, keeping the parking lot clean, and over all the best thing about any business, great customer service. I know a few people left do to rule change but on the customers end, change was needed. Parking can't be helped when the owner (corporate) is the one that chose the location to open. Not enough parking during busy times of day but like any place, we steal a spot from a nearby business. Frowned upon by them, however it is what it is. New store is under construction. Parking will be better.
