This is a very large Starbucks barest outside sitting. The location is almost too good though bc it's crazy busy ALL the time. Sucks to wait 20 mins for a cup of joe.
Nice, new open floor plan!  Would have been 5 stars but they don't have a single cushioned seat or couch available for relaxed seating.
Rude manager and way too much ice in my 'ice' tea. Better to go to the Wegmans across the parking lot. Less expensive and more seating.

Bathrooms were very dirty and they were completely out of coconut milk, which changes my order completely since I can't have lactose. Not my usual starbucks so I rolled with it and got something else....only 3 stars because it felt like they could've made some suggestions for substitutions or something since what I wanted wasn't available, but instead he kind of just said "we're out" and waited for me to give him an alternate order. Friendly enough, but a disappointment compared to my normal location.

The nasty rude people teenager working the drive thru needs a new job or none at all. She actually argued with me about what I ordered. I order the same drink every time for years. She thinks she knows what I want, more than I do.  She actually argued about what "I " REALLY wanted! Hahahaha, yes, Im serious, this really happened.

This Starbucks regularly runs out of coffee. I kid you not. Just visited awhile ago and ordered a grand Pike's Place, and they said, ok, we'll have to brew some. And then it took them 5 minutes to even start brewing it. This happens regularly. You would think a Starbucks would always have their flagship coffee freshly brewing. Instead, they practically discourage you from ordering coffee. Yes, at a coffee shop.

This is the Starbucks inside Target. I enjoy stopping by to grab a Frappuccino before I shop. If you get the Cartwheel app, there are occasionally coupons that can be used. The other day I had a coupon for 25% off a Frappuccino.

I have been to many Starbucks through the US and international locations, but honestly this location has some of the best baristas and top level service.  They are fast and accurate, remember your order, and have the best attitudes - a really great crew. Cannot recommend enough!

Not bad service, just weird. It's a pleasant place to relax and get some work done.  The staff is just very self-involved. I don't want to hear about your weekend construction and trips to the library.  Just a coffee.

This is literally the worst Starbucks I have ever been to in my entire life. I live in St Charles, and it takes less time for me to drive all the way to St Peters to go to Starbucks, than it does for me to drive down the street and get my coffee here. The service is awful and slow. The servers are rude and they yell at each other in front of customers. It's like watching the first week of Hell's kitchen when no one communicates and everything they cook is crap. You can tell that they're so used to messing up drink orders that it has become status quo, so they don't even bother apologizing anymore. Expect to sit in the drive thru for 20 minutes if there are more than 4 cars in front of you. If you brave the poorly planned parking lot to park and go inside, their hand made signage directs you to stand in line in the wrong place and they'll not hesitate to point out the error of your ways. Is there a leader or a manager of this store? It seems like every one that works here is on their first day on the job.

I used to love coming to this Starbucks but over the last year it has become downright awful. There are out of something they can make because they probably don't feel like making it. No one is friendly. The staff is incredibly slow when this is an extremely busy store. I much rather drive out of my way than come here. I get reminded when I go against my better judgement and come in because it's closer.

This location is good if you need to go somewhere on campus with work space and outlets, and that's about it. 

The good thing about Starbucks generally is that it is so standardized you know exactly what you're getting every time. Not so with this location- the bar is a mess, the milk area is often out of supplies, and the baristas are tired of dealing with students. This location is right next to a dorm so the ransacked supplies are likely due to that. It is clear the baristas don't enjoy dealing with the students but wind up delivering terrible customer service to everyone as a consequence. Having worked in a dorm when I was younger I completely understand how old serving spoiled kids their dry cappuccinos gets, but the complete lack of acknowledgement when you approach the register is unfortunate. 

Overall: decent place to work but bring your coffee.

Went here 3 days ago, just me and my boyfriend. The cashier was rushing us to order and they werent even busy then every time we talked to give her our order she would cut us off and start asking questions without letting us finish what we were saying. Got there at 4pm and it seriously took 30 minutes to make 1 peppermint mocha frappe and 1 green tea frappe with mint added to it!! 30 minutes!!! No lie!! The drinks were VERY watery and nasty. They were not blended well at all! They forgot to put the chocolate things on top of my whipped cream for the peppermint mocha frappe and also forgot to put the chocolate drizzle on my boyfriends drink that he asked for. I have NEVER had a bad experience at a starbucks and this was this first. We only stopped at this location because it was on the way to where we were going. We will NEVER go back to this location. Not to mention it was dirty inside, straw wrappers everywhere on floors and tables, crumbs on tables... people just stood around instead of cleaning in their down time. Carrollwood is 100% better, we will continue to go that one because the service is fantastic and always clean

The best thing this location has going for it is its location, as it's the only Starbucks in the greater Media area. However, parking is a big problem, as the parking lot is not nearly large enough to accommodate the heavy foot traffic it regularly gets. More often than not, I've had to wait longer in line at this location than others. 
On the plus side, this location has plenty of outdoor seating. 

In my humble opinion, they should close the Quiznos next door and just have Starbucks take over the whole building (no offense to Quiznos -- it just seems like Media would be better served to have more coffee and fewer sammies).

Cafe and drive thru experiences here differ a lot. Ordering from the cafe is always a great experience. Baristas call down the line to get your drink started and always get your order right. Every one is very friendly and personable. Drive thru staff - especially in the evening hours - are less than friendly, and my drink is usually made incorrectly. I also find it confusing when hot drinks are given without a sleeve.

Always very friendly people working and they heat the croissant better than any other location to where it's actually toasted and not just warm. The Lattes have a great foam, too! The interior and exterior of this Starbucks also get two thumbs up. I'll keep coming back to this location.

"Caters" may be too strong of a word - this 24 / 7 Starbucks "accommodates" procrastinators and time-wasters cramming last minute papers or idling away the witching hours at Temple's massive 24 / 7 Tech Center (i.e. computer lab). Lord knows how many papers I may never have churned out without the assistance of this Starbucks' Venti Bold induced caffeine comas.

The managers know their late-night owls may go here more out of necessity than voluntariness. The price is a few quarters more than other Starbucks. The coffee is always served lukewarm with lots of room for cream. At 4 AM with a 8 AM deadline looming and your eyelids sagging, you have little choice but to keep coming back for more and more.

It's a shame the otherwise charming joint feels like such a racket. I can imagine that hours could drift by watching the affable lot of space cadet, blipster, and crunk punk barristas attempt to man the bar. They fumble and spill everything, they talk about left field TMI personal issues, they always apologize for the always broken ice machine. You'd love to curl up in one of the nooks, crannies, and hiding spaces that fill the dimly lit cafe. But, yea, there's that paper, there's that GChat conversation, to attend to.

Love the coffee here, love the decor even more.

I've never seen a Starbucks decked out in such a coffee shop-esque manner. Sounds ironic, but it's true. This place gives me the feel of heart warming coffee shops sprawling up around Taiwan.

This location has a second story (balcony like set up) if you want more seating (or just more private seating) in case the tables on the first floor are full.

It works for moms to bring their kids to, but it isn't there for any man to do anything but be of service at. No self service coffee stations, and door codes at the bathrooms make this a rather exclusive to the mom-with-child kind of setup.

The worst customer service. Food somehow landed in my hand when a random bag was shoved my way without even being warmed. Never even asked me if I wanted it warm. Then my drink somehow landed on the counter with no label and no one told me it was (my drink). Then I had to ask for my receipt because I'm traveling for work and she basically ripped it off the register and handed it to me while looking on the other direction. I was the only customer at the register. 9:30a on a Thursday morning. Piss poor service.
What can I say about Starbucks that others have not? Very clean and friendly. Service is quick and the drive thru is even quicker! My daily stop on my way to work.

Very pleasant experience this morning. I wish they had more inside seating/table space for working. The majority of tables are outside and being a hot and humid climate I value indoor working space. But, all in all the staff are extremely likable and the place is clean. Starbucks is one of my favorite places and I enjoy varying my Starbucks experiences.
current staff here really sucks!! All the good employees are gone. There's one guy there that's super nice and. Ales great drinks. All the other need some customer service training.

This location has no regard for your time. In a hurry this morning so I did mobile order... ahead of time! I came down to not see my order and barista said they don't find it. I went back upstairs to get my phone came down and she told me they found the order in the trash! No apology for making me go back and forth..nothing!!..she was too busy complaining how she had to get up early to another customer.

This is the fastest Starbucks drive thru I've ever experienced. The stores in Clarksville need to take a page from the Smyrna store's manual! I've been about 8 or 9 times and this store is always fast and my drink accurate.

I come here once in a while to work and get out of the house. Everyone here is always very pleasant and friendly. This is probably the quietest Starbucks in the area. There is sometimes a crowd there, but more often than not it's fairly quiet. They've got a great patio to chill at if the weather is nice. This is always my first choice if it's a nice day and I can work outside.

It's rare, but I went inside as the drive thru was about 10 cars deep.   This store is the FIRST I have every experienced where they made my drink based of the line INSIDE!!   Normally, if there isn't a line inside (this is all Starbucks in general) and at least three cars waiting to order, you win the game by going inside since (it always seems) only one person is allowed to use the espresso machine at once.   At this location, register dude just walked over, made my drink, and bam!  3 min.  in and done.   Also, they had the new TN mug, so hurray for me.
Can't complain! Always friendly and helpful. Even when it is ridiculously busy in the drive thru and inside the store, they still do a great job.

Seriously lol the attitude of these servers is really something. They won't even address you when you're standing there waiting to make an order. I've had countless burnt lattes and coffee. Stick with the ice drinks. They're a bit harder to mess up.

The guy at the register was nice.  I waited a total of 12 minutes to get my drink.   Let me set the seen.... 3 people with empty drinks. 1 was a college student sleeping on his computer and laptop.  An elderly gentleman sitting in a comfy chair and another young college girl texting.  2 paramedics were waiting in for there drinks.  I was the only one in line. After waiting 9 minutes I got up and walked to the counter. The girl supposed to be working the bar was talking to drive thru. Then my drink was placed on the counter with not a word spoken.   I am very disappointed with this location.

Knowledgeable barristas who don't hesitate to give you good service; its what you really are paying for at Starbucks - not the coffee :) They are always busy, but being so close to the movies and off the highway has that effect.

So everything about my coffee and the majority of the service was fine, except that the cashier doesn't know how to do basic math. My bill came to $11 and change. I handed her $22. She turns around and throws two dollars into the tip jar and breaks my $20 for my coffees. 
Somebody better go back to math class.

Definitely the worst Starbucks experience any of the 4 of us in my group have ever had. It took nearly 30 mins to enter, use the restroom and get our drinks and there were only 4 people in front of us. There were 4 employees working behind the counter and only 1 register. They prioritize the drive thru, so be prepared to wait if you go inside. The bathrooms were disgusting and out of paper towels and toilet paper and the plastic holders were broken and laying on the floor. I will not be returning to this location ever again.

I was in a hurry this morning so I unfortunately I wasn't able to stop and sit.  I was just happy to find the closet Starbucks off highway 64 eastbound to grab my morning dose of crack.

This location is connected to the Cheshire Inn Hotel.  It has it's own entrance so no need to go all the way inside the hotel lobby to get here.  The parking lot was tight and spaces scarce but I was desperate so I parked illegally and made a mad dash for it, lol..

No drive-thru, bummer.  But the interior was super cool and chic.  I immediately noticed these awesome toffee colored leather ottoman style stools for seating.  The decor was almost like no other Starbucks I'd seen.  Then I found out this location is actually owned by the hotel itself, just FYI in case you care.

Staff was mediocre but whatever, I go for the coffee fix.  Can't wait to return so I can actually chillax and enjoy the ambiance a bit.

Being a non-coffee drinker I have no issues going to Starbucks with my friends.  They seem to like the coffees and teas.  I have been to several Starbucks in the past and the food has always been good, I was not impressed with the food here. 

The service was very good and the people were friendly.

I am shocked at how slow this place is moving when no one is waiting in the drive through and there are four people staffing it. One person made drinks while we waited for fifteen minutes for our drinks. Not a good experience for us.

I love Starbucks and I love this place but I have to give 3 stars to it . The service is really good here and the stuff is friendly. They make coffee on time and I don't have to wait for a long time to get my coffee. I can barely see the long lines in this Starbucks. When you are in rush morning time this is the best place to get a cup of coffee. But if you want tome come here and have a coffee outside on the patio the is not the best place for it. like coming to Starbucks and enjoy the coffee outside but here is impossible because its always so messy . The tables and chairs are always all over the place and the tables are always dirty and sticky . They should always keep it clean. Otherwise I love Starbucks.

Not one of my fave Starbucks locations. Service was slow and I saw a few people doing very little when the inside line up was packed. They need to learn to manage their time better by more useful. Long line up inside plus no lineup on drive thru equals GO HELP THE INSIDE LINEUP!!!
I mean if you went here for coffee, you blew it. But there are a lack of public restrooms in the area, so, you know.

This is the Starbucks inside Target. I enjoy stopping by to grab a Frappuccino before I shop. If you get the Cartwheel app, there are occasionally coupons that can be used. The other day I had a coupon for 25% off a Frappuccino.

Worst Starbucks. Never fills up drink all the way and gets it wrong half the time. It's close to home but will be driving 3 miles out of the way to avoid this crappy place - and it's a 20 minute way when you come in the mornings - on a good day

Way too slow!  The girl at the cashier was cheerful and friendly, but drinks were made way too slow!  This Starbucks is located on one of the biggest intersections in Clearwater. They should know to have enough staff to get drinks made for the general flow of customers that pass through here.

Trying one of the strawberry banana smoothies! 
Always great service at this location.

I am not a fan of starbucks but this place is very decent. Why?
* private parking lot
* spacious, plenty of seats and even a study room
* the barista actually cared about spelling my name correctly. Say what?!? She still didnt get it right but I appreciated the effort

This Starbucks has a good vibe and decent seating. The speed of the staff seems up to par. The nice thing about this location is that there is 30 minutes of free covered parking in The College Plaza lot, so if you want to park, grab a latte, then head to Sobey's and the pharmacy in the building, you have enough time to do it. I gave them 4 stars because one of the days I went in they had run out of soy milk and didn't plan to have any for another 3 days. To their defence, the store was new at the time, so they were probably figuring out ordering quantities. This will definitely become my regular spot for latte's!

I love this location. The baristas are always on their A-game and make a crazy good iced Caramel Macchiato made with milk and sugar + one shot of caramel. It does get slammed here with lines wrapping all the way around the building and out of the parking lot entirely depending on what times you try to grab a coffee though. Very good coffee here and I am not normally much of a Starbucks person, there's just really not much else in Smyrna that can compare unfortunately.
Slowest Starbucks I've ever encountered. I've traveled to numerous states and countries and this place is by far the slowest.

Employee named Riple was very disrespectful, worst Starbucks I ever been too. 
Slow service , employee Riple was arguing and was very disrespectful.
Terrible service and experience at this Starbucks location. Wont be back to this location.

The ladies were awesome today. They were calling our name to board and we had to leave without our drinks.  With our flight pushed back on a delay and terminal changes and then changed back to the original gate.  Big communication going on, we missed our flight.   Going back to Starbucks knowing they  tossed our drinks the manager remade them no charge for us.  Thanks for turning our day around. This was true customer service. Thanks ladies! I'll always remember this.

ALWAY BUSY, and no drive thru......

But it is right down town in "Midtown"

I would have given this place a 5 star but everytime I order the green tea frap it taste like a vanilla bean frap. But its still pretty good and can't complain. The service here is amazing. Its always busy and so hard to get parking if you have to drive around a couple of times. Wish they had drive thru... lol. The spinach wraps also very good. Love love it.

This is an excellent store with friendly employees and good service. I visit it almost every day.  Both inside and outside seating areas are excellent. They have a nice fireplace with comfortable arm chairs around it. The only caution is that it is directly across the street from Vanderbilt University, so when school is in session (most of the year) the store is very busy in the morning.

This SBUX is great!   Nice location (close to my office) and they have a drive through.  Inside is small but warm and inviting store.    

Mornings can be busy here since there is a school right up the street and teachers are in line getting their coffee (had one yell at me to get out of the drive through line because she was in a hurry but thats Galena High School not this sbux).

Highly recommended - they are one of the few SBUX I drink at frequently and they have NEVER gotten my drink wrong.

Venti = extra LARGE
Staff is awesome- friendly, speedy & helpful. Always a nice break in the day at Starbucks!

I don't drink coffee, never liked it. But, I love their Chai Tea Latte's. Like all their beverages, it is a little on the pricey side, but on par with other coffee shops. The restaurant is always clean and never crowded enough that you can't get a table.

This is a good location, the only problem is they don't have the scanner to read Starbucks applications from the phone. You either have to present the physical card or read the numbers off the phone to have cashier manually enter them in the register. The coffee is still what you'd expect of any location. The WiFi is free so that's a plus. The location is in the Harrah's Casino and there are some bicycle racks for bike parking on the casino premisses so ride dat! You're not SOL!!! It says 8 Canal as address but directly uptown of Canal Place. Enter casino from Canal entrance, go to the left and bada bing bada boom! Starbucks.

Starbucks at Target closes at 9pm today... So why are all the baristas telling me I can't have anything hot to drink and its 5:30pm?? They said the only hot drink is plain coffee. So thats what I got.  Im christmas shopping and I cant sip on a hot latte. They are already cleaning up and shutting things to go home. Im super annoyed.

My favorite Starbucks around town! The staff is always very friendly and helpful, and competent! They know what they are doing, and are very good at it. This location is always clean and has a warm, welcoming feeling to it. Sipping some peppermint mocha latte while enjoying the snowy mountain view in the winter is always a treat for me

I used to frequent this location and always found their beverages and staff to be above average. I miss the big, comfy chairs and parking has always been a pain unless it's right at closing time. I stopped in at this Starbucks twice last week and was given terrible service on both occasions. I'm know people aren't perfect and can mess up a drink order, but I actually watched the drink being made with the wrong type of milk BOTH times, asked about it, and was lied to by two separate staff members (or "partners", if you will). Please, have some pride and dignity. Customers aren't as stupid as you may believe them to be.

I live close by and was SO excited to see this open. Great atmosphere and love to sit outside. Some employees are super nice and some are snarky. Always out of decaf and servers have no clue what to do when that happens. How hard is it to brew decaf?

Located in the middle of the Delaware Plaza, it's usually incredibly crowded nonstop. Still, they're efficient at keeping the line of travelers moving.

I ordered my chai latte, it was was it was.
Great neighborhood coffee spot with an incredibly friendly staff.  If there is no street parking in the front, there's always space behind the building.

I really liked this place when it first opened. But the staff has become progressively more unprofessional. While placing an order the cashier was more interested in chatting with his coworkers. As a result I had to tell him my order (which was simple - a latte - that's it, nothing fancy) three times before he finally got it. They get 0 stars for service. One star for the decor.

Really bad/rude service at this location. If you're not happy doing what you do or working for Starbucks, then you shouldn't be there misrepresenting a good company. There's a Dunkin down the street that I'm gonna have to start going to or just drive to the Starbucks on 10th st... I'm not the only person that this has happened too at this location.

As a Temple student, I really wanted to at least like this place as it is the only Starbucks on campus. They used to hire students who were actually baristas before, but it looks like they've all been replaced by the typical Sodexo staff. The people who work there now are generally rude and slow. In fact, the last time I was there I saw a worker literally YELL at a Japanese exchange student because she had difficulty speaking English. The place was crowded (as usual) so I'm sure that poor girl was embarrassed. 

However, there is one person who works there that made me give this otherwise awful place an extra star. His name escapes me, but he's a tall youngish guy with awesome dreads. He is the only friendly person in there that's nice to everyone (even when they aren't fluent in English!) and he consistently has a smile on his face. His customer service almost singlehandedly makes up for the fact that everyone else he works with is miserable and rude. 

As far as the drinks go, meh. I usually just get an iced coffee, which is hard to mess up, and it's fine most of the time. I would be more willing to go there if the service was better.

Poop James was very disappointed in the quality of the toilet paper! It was literally see through. Poop James understands that it wont be the best toilet paper, but Poop James was not expecting it to be literally invisible. Poop James wanted to use a seat cover, but there was none. Im left to believe that the seat covers must have been rolled into the roll of transparent toilet paper. Which Poop James did not appropriate! Poop James did enjoy the coffee though.

Poop james signing off!

I've always had good experiences in this location. They are very friendly and I even scored a free drink the other day. I enjoy stopping in this particular Starbucks. I docked one point because the parking lot is annoying. It is hard to find a spot and easily get in and out of it. Once you get parked though, its worth it.

I stopped in on Wednesday and ordered a 12oz soy cappuccino, which cost about 4 bucks... Generally I'm not a start bucks person but needed a pick-me-up and they are the only coffee shop in Medford that has soy milk. Anyway, when I got my drink I thought, "wow, this feels really night." Turns out I got about 3oz of liquid and the rest of the cup was foam. Maybe that is a result of frothing soy milk, but either way, $4 for 3 oz of coffee is not worth it.
Worst Starbucks ever.  Horrible customer service.  No soap in bathroom when I was there.  Baristas not helpful and don't know their drinks.

As a loyal Starbucks customer for my whole life, I've got to say that this is one of the best I have been to. I am never disappointed. They frequently have a long line but get through the line in about 5 or so minutes. Great customer service from all the baristas. I get a drink that can get messed up easily but coming here I get it perfect each time.
Asked for a granda latte with 2 inch of room. Drink came with maybe a inch. The girl said here is the drink. Not sure what he did? Refused to correct the issue.

I have been coming to this location since I moved to Santa Barbara in February. I have been very impressed with the staff, specifically the speed and friendliness with which they do their jobs. I will continue to come back and would recommend this place to anyone looking for a quick cup of coffee on State Street.
Best Starbucks place in and around Nashville. The staff are really friendly and service is really fast.

Excellent service, very clean store. Lots of parking.
The beverages are always correct. By far the best Starbucks in Boise

In my book, this is one of the best Starbucks in Center City. The coffee is always good and the staff is friendly. It is always clean at this location as well. Can't say that for several other Starbucks locations in the city.

Worst service at a Starbucks I've ever had. If you can't remember to make a drink for your customers then you have failed at customer service. You have one job... oh and they were out of the one drink I ordered... how can you be "out of a product" especially when I see the customer in front of me get two of the same! Ha!

Nice staff, lots of outside seating on the sidewalk, and inside. I live close, but I am happy to have a neighborhood Sbux. Would be better if it had a drive thru, but it isn't set up that way, so I forgive them!

Love their Carmel Mocha's ... Ok so I have one every time I am in neighborhood:-) Which is at least once a week... 
  But I like this store over the rest. Though had to explain what skinny meant. But they were polite and friendly and place was clean.,,
Great service and lots of smiling friendly baristas! This is my favorite Starbucks in town!

I love this location!!!   Really convenient.   Melissa is my favorite.   She always fusses over my pugs when I bring them to the drive though.    She even draws puggy faces on the coffee lids sometimes.   All the employees are friendly and I can not recommend this Starbucks enough.
One of the slower Starbucks I've been to. This location is run by HMSHost which is not known for service, speed or efficiency. Prepare to spend about twenty minutes for basic beverages.

These guys have a captive audience.   

Last time the sandwich eggs were frozen inside.   
This time went with something no one could mess up...Toasted bagel.   Stale bread and not toasted.  

Line is so long you just deal with it.  

Common Starbucks.  Stop growing and fix your existing stores !!

I've had to leave this location three times without my drink; twice because they didn't make it correctly and once because they literally just forgot mine (I went inside). I work very early in the morning, and just don't have time to wait for them to make it again. Thankfully there's a Starbucks in the hospital where I work, so I just go there now, and avoid this one unless I have extra time.

My friend and i ordered the caramel Machiatto. Mine was a tall and hers a grande. Both of ours had a pouring amount in caramel. They didn't do this last time. I taste alot less of caramel at downtown st.pete. Stay consistent! St. pete dt taste much better. Part street put like 3 table spoons caramel in there. Sugar kill.

Cashier was friendly however barista made my drink incorrectly - salted caramel
Mocha frap and she put no salt or caramel in it- when I potent asked for the missing ingredients she grabbed my drink shook a tiny put of salt on it slapped the lidded I it making a large mess and it still had no caramel. Seriously, you had one job and being asked to do it correctly was too much. Maybe you should look into another job.

Great staff for the most part, though there is a heavier set female (manager?) who seems to be regularly less than approachable.  The service is fast and the quality of drinks is up to par with all the other Starbucks in town.  The shortcomings, I believe, are more about the commercial space than any one person's failing.  Long, thin layout with the milk, cream, etc. placed far away from the attendants and by the front door makes for a difficult time fixing up your coffee.  Plus when a container needs to be refilled, or a spill needs to be cleaned, the staff is sort of far away and harder to grab for attention.  Lastly, and unfortunately, is an element they have no control over.  There is a large homeless encampment in the nearby neighborhood, so there is a much more colorful and sometimes uncomfortable atmosphere in the cramped quarters there.  I still go there regularly, however.  No glaring reason not to, just not the great pearl of local Starbucks locations.

Pretty quick service on a Monday morning.  Even got some sausage/egg/cheese muffins to go which were pretty tasty and didn't take too long.

Nice and open and bright but very narrow and not much seating.

Thank you to all the friendly Batista's that have served me here at this location Dailey for 8 + years. I love you guys you always get it right my 4 shots espresso short shots sweeter this way thanks Courtney , Ralph LOL and all always asking how I am doing and showing interest in my life or just how my morning or evening is going xoxo

I always get fast service  (unless it's 7am) the people who work here are always very friendly.  I did once find a bug in the show case thing, they removed the bug but didn't dispose of the food that was in there.

Wow, pretty disappointed. I understand that when there are conferences, things might be busier. But waiting in line 20 minutes, only to wait another 20 minutes for a couple drinks is insane! All 3 people working today were new... bad scheduling.

As good as starbucks gets.

This was my first time at this location.  I didn't enjoy the long wait for my order, but it was tasty when I got it.  I ordered a caramel apple spice, Hubs got a hot choc and the boys got vanilla cremes.  All good.  The rasberry scone was just ok.

This Starbucks is in the Safeway shopping center south of the Golden Dragon and Einstein's bagels.  There is outside and inside seating.  I went to get the pumpkin spice skinny frappuccino which I have always liked and was glad it is back.  The baristas were friendly and very helpful.  It took a little bit to get the drink but a big order ahead of me.  I enjoyed the frappuccino.  It was extra spicy and I like it that way.  I appreciate that I can get a "skinny" version and it is just as tasty.

Awesome drive thru!  
Rolled in on pay it "forward friday" had our tab paid by the car in front of us...
Technically,  we paid our bill by paying for the car behind us... However,  it gives you a warm fuzzy feeling, all is good in the world! Hehe
Coffee is great!

This was a new location that opened up on MLK. Which is so close to my job. I am so excited. The only complaint I have (and this is with ALL the Starbucks) is that they have to find the locations with this smallest lot possible. There is no room for anything. However, I will continue to maneuver around these tiny lots to get my Starbucks fix.

Went in around 330pm on a Sunday, the place was pretty dirty and they had hardly any pastries left. Perhaps they were just rushed but I doubt it since there were only two other guests inside. However The baristas were very friendly and my coffee taste just like all the other Starbucks I have been too. If it would have had food then I would be rating it a 4
The barista that helped me craft my sugar free drink was amazing. I'm sorry I forgot his name, but thank you.
Lots of room to work. Not very busy at 8:54 am. Friendly staff. Loved my first dirty chai!
Grab a napkin, they didn't give me a wrapper around my hot hot breakfast sandwich :( that doesn't happen in L.A.

Let me just go ahead and say Terry is a giant jerk. He was downright hateful. He didn't greet us, just looked at us like we had 4 heads or something. He didn't thank us either, which is not a surprise after the experience we had.. Does he not realize he works with the public? His attitude would be more fit for a call center where he can roll his eyes without his customer seeing him. I asked him about the Starbucks app and he shrugged his shoulders. I had a free drink I had earned and he simply said "No, We don't do that." WHAT?! He threw my receipt at me and when I didn't catch it, he got irritated. I stood there with my hand out for my receipt so that he was forced to pick it back up and place it in my hand. My order was also WRONG, no surprise there. Maybe instead of huffing and puffing about having to be at work, you put on a smile and be thankful you even have a job. Homeless people are nicer!

It's not every Starbucks that has the corporate symbol made of guitar picks and a "Follow Us on Instagram" sign! This is a very Nashvillian Starbucks. But it also has a very big back room full of tables and comfortable cushy seats in the front by the bar. Definitely larger than most Starbucks nowadays! Not a ton of parking just in front, but you can park in the large lot next to or behind the Starbucks! Great location, great seating space! This might end up being my favorite Starbucks once I officially make the move to Nashville in a couple of months!

I received a starbucks card as a gift and decided to get breakfast and coffee drink after doctor appointment. I had my fave spinach egg white feta wrap and a half caff Americano. The Americano was too weak but maybe because decaf is not ad strong as their regular espresso. My wrap sandwich was delicious ad alwaus. Employees were nice and listened. This Starbucks\bathroom was clean and i was relaxed to stay awhile and hang out. Glad to know i have a decent franchise in my neighborhood.

The coffee taste really burnt. I think they need to make fresh coffee because u can taste that it was sitting. I have had it several times but it has not gotten better. I went to the other Starbucks and it was amazing.

There are actually two Starbucks at this Welcome Center now. One inside the Welcome Center and another in a new, stand-alone building (with a drive-thru) closer toward the northbound exit. Both locations have the same address, so consider this review to be for both of them. The one inside the Welcome Center gets 2 stars. The new one gets 4, so I'm averaging them out at 3.

I think the reason the new one was constructed is BECAUSE the location inside the Welcome Center sucks so bad. It's basically a kiosk that was constructed smack-dab in the middle of all the chaos so you never know where the line begins or ends. It has taken me up to 10 minutes just to place my order here and up to 15 minutes from the time I started waiting until the time my drink was prepared.

The new location, however, provided a much more pleasant experience. I was in and out in probably about 2 minutes, but all I ordered was black coffee, so take that as you will.

If all you need is coffee and a bathroom, avoid the madness inside the Welcome Center and go to the new stand-alone Starbucks, the goal of which seems to be to pull some of the foot traffic out of the Welcome Center.

Had a really good customer service experience here that prompted me to write a review, and I noticed a fair amount of negative ones.  First, it is definitely not dirty.  Like most Starbucks, they clean incessantly.  Maybe the reviewer caught them right before some customer trashed the place.  The barista's are overall very nice.  Obviously, there may be a bad egg here or there, but, recently, I thought I ordered an iced coffee, but I was given and iced tea.  I'm pretty sure I was wrong and ordered an iced tea, but when I inquired, they didn't even think twice they promptly gave me an iced coffee, offered me to keep the iced tea, and gave me a coupon for a free drink on my next visit because my experience wasn't "perfect."  Pretty solid customer service to me. 

As for the seating etc, I do wish the seating area was double the size and they had an entrance that was located on the side so the whole place doesn't get miserably cold in the winter with each opening.  

As for the drinks, it's Starbuck's, so this one is par for the course.

Who doesn't love Starbucks.. At this location it's a hit or a miss. They are always busy and you never know if the person at the window is gonna be nice or rude. They do have the most up beat nice man working the window sometimes but there are these two ladies who are just rude. Like here is your coffee now leave and basically doesn't care if your order is correct or not. But I still go anyway bc it's close to home.

Possibly the most unhappy Starbucks workers I've ever experienced. Service with a smile does not apply here. People, you have a job, you get free coffee all day, how bad could it be?? The girl at the register threw my panini on the counter and I couldn't hear what it was because, well, Starbucks. The barista was inconvenienced to say the least to have to ask her what it was. So sorry for asking! Please, strike a smile, we are the people giving you job security after all.

I've only had positive experiences here. But then again, I come during non-rush times so that could be why. Baristas are always friendly and my orders never take too long. Shout-out to the gentleman helping me with my tumbler purchase on Saturday December 5, around 2PM. He was the best! Even remembered our names to say bye as we were leaving.

Parking can suck. This location is usually busy when I drive by. And that drive thru line can wrap around the entire building at times. My drinks are usually correct. Sometimes not as strong as I order but eh, it's whatever. I take my order to go so can't comment on seating situations.
Have a cakepop.and a mocha frap, or the Chi tea! Yummiest ever!!!! Very clean and friendly!
Yep it's a Starbucks geez. Been here million times, who hasn't!?!? Lol I mean location is the big thing. Everything else is about what you would expect!!!!

The staff at this location are incredibly slow and easily distracted- they take much longer than necessary to prepare drinks, even when there are almost no customers. They also prioritize drinks based on the regulars, which will almost always be served before other visitors- I would definitely recommend the Starbucks on Gulf to Bay over this location!
Very friendly staff and our drinks were made efficiently. Skinny peppermint lattes.. Weren't hot enough, unfortunately! Perhaps it's just the milk aspect taking the heat down too much.

It's Starbucks.

I like Starbucks. Don't hate me! It's coffee and they have free wifi. I also earn lots of reward points because we buy it for brewing at home. 

This particular store is my usual stopping spot when I have to go south. The staff there is young, friendly and have been helpful in getting me started with going digital for cashing in my reward points. 

The coffee is the usual Starbucks coffee. I have come to depend on the consistency. The food items are OK. The breakfast sandwich is moderately healthy. All I can say is the Egg McMuffin has nothing to worry about. 

This particular store is very small, and can get crowded during busy commute times. I usually just get my treat to go, so the lack of indoor seating is not a huge minus. 

What bumps it up for me from an "OK just another Starbucks" 3 star rating is the staff. Over the last three years I have been stopping here, they have always been courteous, cheerful and friendly. I have also always gotten my order correct. That has to count for something.

I ordered a traveler the day before so I could pick it up and get to a meeting. They hadn't started it at all so I had to wait. Trying to plan ahead and be on top of things didn't work here. At least they were nice, but don't remember ever having to pay a separate cost for the cups before?
Thus Starbucks has had it's ups and downs with staffing in 2014, but right now they are rocking a team of true artists. If you see Jimmy working the bar - you're in for a treat. He spins coffee gold.

Changed their hours!!! DON'T go here now!!! This has been my favorite Starbucks (at least in Nashville) for a LONG time - and it's been especially cool since they remodeled their interior recently, so it's (in theory, I wouldn't really know) now an even better place to study and use your computer, etc. because it has a separate room just for that. And their service is definitely among the most efficient and friendly that you'll find at a Starbucks.

HOWEVER, just this past Saturday night after a show I arrived at 11:45 fully expecting the place to be open - as I've been there countless times RIGHT AT 11:59 and gotten a drink with no problem and plenty of politeness (it's not a tedious or complicated order). In fact they're often nice enough to let me in because they recognize me. This time though when I arrived they were completely dark and looked like they had been closed for hours (aside from the 4 or 5 people outside using their laptops). There was NO sign on the door - the hours sign that had been there was gone, though the suction cups were still in place. How helpful! I'll avoid making the obvious observation on the suction cups and how this situation su...is so incredibly frustrating.  I also had a treat receipt that went wasted because hey, I found out the same night that the West End location changed their hours too (although they're at least open half an hour later than this one on Friday and Saturday).

Anyway - come to find out (much later) this store has gone from being open until 11:30 through the week and midnight on Fri and Sat to 10:30 PM EVERY DAY!!! Unacceptable for such a prime location, especially one frequented by so many students and hospital employees. Even a MUCH LESS busy one in my city has better Fri & Sat hours than this. Ridiculous. Also, the shift manager who received the complaint about this really didn't seem to think it was a big deal in the least - not even the missing sign. Almost seemed happy about it. I only know about these hours because of the Starbucks website, by the way. To my knowledge they still aren't posted on site.  

****September 2013 update: open until 11 PM every night for now. Far as I know has been that way since at least June. Still seems to be very nice service, too. Still, not a fan of what happened with the hours/sign and still missing midnight!!

My neighborhood Starbucks. Staff is always friendly and accommodating. The beverages are always A+ quality served in a comfortable setting both inside and out.  Pet board is cool and they have the cutest picture of a red tabby kitten on the board along with other cute pet pics. This is Starbucks quality done right!
Close to the Free Library (which has its own little cafe inside -- great but tiny and fills up quickly)

Edit November 2017: I fly out of this terminal several times a month and I can confidently say things have improved at this location. I sometimes encounter employees who smile back to me when I smile to them. Service seems quicker on a reliable basis. Fair is fair, so thank you very much to the management for making early morning traveling coffees a more pleasant experience. This deserves a further star addition. I'm comfortable with rating this location as A-OK for now.

Edit summer 2016: I've noticed an improvement in the speed of service at this location in the past six months so I want to note that for the record. I appreciate getting my coffee without too much goofing off behind the counter. The wait staff still isn't very friendly but I added a star for the decreased wait time. I still prefer my neighborhood 'bucks and other local coffee shops where the employees at least pretend like they recognize my humanity when I'm standing in front of them. 

Original review:  Southwest terminal Starbucks is the absolute worst. Customer service is non existent. I have had my order screwed up, partially forgotten, etc more often than not at this location. Today the guy stopped halfway through my latte to chat with another worker. Then AFTER the cream stopped frothing he decided to "help" the cashier and chat with the customer. After finishing that convo he was starting up a chat with someone else when I reminded him about my unfinished latte sitting there cooling down. He finally managed to finish the drink after checking his phone a couple of times. 

A different time I contacted the franchise owner and he promised me free coupons to make up for that previous foul up. Then he forgot to send them until I called back 3 weeks later. His response  and the poor conduct of his employees tells me the franchise owner doesn't care -- the airport customers have few other options and he has little incentive to run a tight ship. Poor customer service comes from insufficient training and incompetent management so I suspect these employees are not receiving the same level of training and support that other Starbucks franchises provide to their employees. Too bad really, it makes flying Southwest that much more aggravating and does a disservice to the Starbucks brand.

Pretty much your standard Starbucks with kind baristas, clean interior, working WiFi, average seating and power outlet availability; however, if there is a line they are particularly slow most days. It seems to be a staffing issue where your order is taken quickly by two baristas but made slowly by only one.

Great location and easy to get into, go at least 3 times a week. Staff is very friendly and always remembers my favorite drink. Manager "Tiffany" is friendly and always engaging. Seems like there are already regulars there and a great place to check your emails.........keep up the great work.

Btw.....this is the stand alone store not the one in the Target..

First day, and it's already doing a booming business. I went to my normal location across the street, and the sign was gone from the building--first clue! They were hanging the "Now Open" banners as I walked in.

Be forewarned. The drive through is not functioning yet & they have it blocked off.

The service was great, and the place looked really clean. Hard to go wrong with Starbucks. My wife's drink was a little off, but we didn't notice it until we left and were on the road. I'm sure they would have fixed it if we asked. The staff was really friendly. There is not a ton of places to sit and work at this location, and parking is pretty limited due to the location. Just keep those in mind when wanting visit.

I'm the foursquare mayor of this joint. I never, EVER thought I'd be the forsquare mayor of a Starbucks. **pushing up oversized Internets nerd glasses that have slipped down the bridge of my nose **

From other reviews: agree: the parking is from Sucksville. agree: quirky and diverse staff. 

But really, I'm surprised reading these reviews! I like my coffee as black and robust as the day is long...and I'm never disappointed. The staff is friendly, they offer free samples, specials (free refills) and make suggestions (nice to meet you, red eye!) for the uneducated consumer. 

Because the parking is soooo bad on a busy corner, I just can't give the 5th star...but if they buy the Quiznos they share the lot with and try to expand, it's allllll yours, Starbys.
This one was really cute and the young staff was super friendly! I had to grab a protein box on my way out of town and added a soy latte for the ride. Thanks girls!
This location sucks because of the parking. However, the store inside is pretty big. It looks very small from the outside.

First and foremost, I love starbucks but this particular branch is terrible!  Surprising considering it's location and constant influx of customers... It's always a long wait while the barista's chat it up...  Special drinks are never consistent even when the same barista makes it.  Subpar starbucks....needs a revamp of mature and versed management or should  lose it's franchise

A good Starbucks. The inside has been cleaner than other Starbucks in the area. The staff are friendly and service is prompt. Drive thru can be pretty packed sometimes, but it moves pretty well. Drinks always meet the "Starbucks standard." A nice choice if you are in the area!
Good place to stop on the way to work as it is not very crowded and there is always a seat. Nice staff and good flat whites
Love Starbucks! Always quick when going through drive thru. Tried the mini fraps. A little pricey than I was expecting. Nice friendly staff.

I no longer can justify going to these places. The prices are through the roof. The drinks are bad. I have never been in establishment with so many employees that do so little. Sometimes there are more employees than customers and I still get a sub par drink and the privilege of waiting 10 minutes for it.

Horrible service! Rude! Make their own rules. They denied a Starbucks promotion, even though they are a participating store. Corporate should definitely come down and assess these employees and managers!

This Starbucks is a little more crowded and less aesthetically pleasing than the Starbucks around the corner in La Cumbre Plaza.  I've only been here once, but since I wanted to sit down and study, I ended up buying my drink here and scooting on over to La Cumbre's Starbucks.

I ordered my regular soy latte, and it was made just fine.  The barista was kind, and the service was efficient.  And that's what's most important at a Starbucks, isn't it?

My husband and I go there on a weekly basis and they know my husband...as soon as he walks in the door, they start making his coffee!  When he first went in, he told them his name was Jerk, and they didn't know what to make of him, but now they know him...they are the best!  Service is great, location is perfect, coffee is perfect!

Thanks Starbucks!

The Starbucks, on the surface, is pretty solid. Its big enough, always clean, has a nice outdoor seating area, and the staff is generally pretty friendly.  However, unfortunately, they are chronically understaffed. Maybe its because the coffee served at the offices across the street is horrific (it is, I worked there), but the lines here are just not acceptable. As I write this review, I am 14th in line, with several behind me, in the middle of the afternoon. I'm here several times a week; this isn't an isolated incident. 

Hire more people, Starbucks. There is obviously enough business here to support it.

This is a small Starbucks in a strip mall on the north side of Greenwood. They do have a drive-thru, but it's somewhat awkward to get to. No complaints. It is your run of the mill Starbucks. I believe they now have free wi-fi.

The line is ridiculously long and they left off a whole item on my order. When we brought it to the cashier's attention all she said was "oh sorry" and didn't even attempt to fix it. The line was way too long to have to wait through again.
I think this location is better off for not having a drive thru. The inside is very echoey, so if there are a decent number of people inside it's not a good place to have a conversation.

A friendly local Starbucks near the U of A hospital. The location is small, even for a Starbucks. However, they do have an extra seating area outside the store, both on the walkway outside and in the commons of the building area inside. This is essential since its freaking cold in Edmonton and outdoor seating is basically useful only 4 months a year. 

The staff was friendly and the drink order made accurately. I also love the fact my Starbucks card is usable here even though I am from the US.

Christmas Eve, 7:45 pm Its clear that they wanted to go home, but they were still very happy, very friendly and very efficient.  We both got latte's I got the Peppermint mocha and the husbeast got the eggnog latte, and they were perfectly done. The crew chit chatted and smiled the whole time. Perhaps the most efficient Starbucks I've ever been in.
..something bout their service every freaking time has been A++..i thinks its jn their java..lol..clean..fast..comfy atmosphere too..shud try do something bout smokers sitting at front door thou:)

Starbucks is my go-to place to work and kill some time for really one reason: free refills on tea and coffee (for members). This location is the only Starbucks in the area, but it is definitely not my favorite in Tampa. They are always crowded, never feel like they have enough seats or tables. The outdoor area feels like it is sitting in the parking lot, and about half the time in the afternoons they seem to be out of something...sometimes more than one. They are super nice here, and the problems aren't enough that I don't come when I'm in the area--but if I'm heading elsewhere, I would far rather be at the Kennedy Starbucks. This one meets my caffeine needs, but it isn't the most relaxing of locations!

This is literally the worst Starbucks I have ever been to in my entire life. I live in St Charles, and it takes less time for me to drive all the way to St Peters to go to Starbucks, than it does for me to drive down the street and get my coffee here. The service is awful and slow. The servers are rude and they yell at each other in front of customers. It's like watching the first week of Hell's kitchen when no one communicates and everything they cook is crap. You can tell that they're so used to messing up drink orders that it has become status quo, so they don't even bother apologizing anymore. Expect to sit in the drive thru for 20 minutes if there are more than 4 cars in front of you. If you brave the poorly planned parking lot to park and go inside, their hand made signage directs you to stand in line in the wrong place and they'll not hesitate to point out the error of your ways. Is there a leader or a manager of this store? It seems like every one that works here is on their first day on the job.

Update: I'm back here in line. I'm a glutton for punishment

Update: Back again on April 22 for a unicorn frapp. They stopped making then two days early and refuse to make one for my 12 year old.

I have visited this Starbucks for years and always give my name and drink when I visit.  No problem with the service, the baristas r polite and typically they are efficient when providing service.  Some personalization would be nice given I am a repeat customer.  

Good thing I like the product, if not the price.

Beware!  If you park behind this Starbucks you will get a boot put on your car if you are 10 minutes over your ticket. No kidding. My husband paid 70.00 to get the boot off. Another time a friend was towed away in the same lot for going over time on parking ticket. They were in the Starbucks drinking coffee. Avoid this Starbucks if parking. It will cost you $$$$.

While I love Starbucks today I'm in the middle of ordering and the girl who's taking my order stops and starts talking to the others casually as if I wasn't still standing in front of her ordering. So rude! If was important fine, say excuse me and then proceed. Manners people, especially in this industry.

I love the location of the store and the staff is always friendly.  Most Starbucks are always pretty much standard and the same, but the ambiance of this Starbucks is more inviting and customer service is also wonderful here!
A great place.  Very friendly staff that manages to remember my name.  I have been to many Starbucks all over the world, but this is my favorite.
This Starbucks is one of the best on state street. The baristas are super nice and very attentive to each customer even when it's really busy. Tyler and Maddie are always A+ whenever I'm in there!

Before deciding to go to Starbucks, I grabbed a cup of coffee from Dunkin' Donuts the day before. The coffee was very bland and the service was not spectacular...no comparison here with Starbucks.

Upon arriving at this Starbucks location, I was impressed by the cleanliness and the fast service this location displayed.  This location was very serene and relaxing. It provided an atmosphere where one can write a business letter or even draft a paper with little background noise.  Some locations allow you to use your laptop but they have background, non compromising noise that interferes with focusing and concentrating on a task.

I ordered a tall Peppermint Mocha that was topped with whipped cream and peppermint bits. This coffee was rich in flavor and very inexpensive. The customer service here was great! 

I will definitely return with my laptop and order another one of their flavorful coffee drinks in the future. I have been to other Starbucks locations, but this one was the best yet, by far.

This is the only Starbucks is on my route to work. Therefore, I stop for coffee about twice a week. 

The service is beyond slow. If you're stopping for coffee between 8:30-9:00am, you can expect to wait in line for about 20 minutes. Some people say it's quicker if you park and go inside, I personally have never found that to be true. 

The parking lot is tricky! I'm not sure why they designed the drive-thru the way they did. The entrance and exit are located in the same area, therefore, the people joining the drive-thru line block the people from exiting the drive-thru line, what a cluster! 

The inside is very cramped. There is not a lot of space for meeting or working, however, there is a nice patio outside with several tables for days when it's nice outside.

3 days in a row opening late with too few of employees to handle the crowd! Thousands in town for National Volleyball tournament with early starts! You would think they would be ready, properly staffed and open on time! This morning the Security Guard is helping behind the counter! Starbucks in the Marriott across the street from Convention Center, 2 employees, 6th in line 20 minutes later still not ordered!

I didn't expect much from an airport Starbucks but wow this one is terrible.  The workers were very mean to each other.  It took them forever to make drinks.  They didn't seem to have a good system going.  Their process consisted of one lady taking orders, one making them, and the other one telling the girl making them how badly she was doing.  I heard her say once "if you don't know how to make a drink don't make it."  But she didn't seem to be helping much.

It took an extremely long time to make anyone's order.  The floor was dirty as well.  They ignored customers after they gave them their drinks.  Two customers asked for spill stoppers when they received their drinks and were completely ignored by the girls working.

I was shorted $2 of my change, but told them right away and they gave it to me.

Starbucks is great and their coffee is always pretty good fine coffee. However, costumed service at this location was horrible!! The guy was extremely rude and I didn't feel welcome there at all. At first, he talked to his co-workers about how he got "his new tattoo in philly" while I was waiting for 5 mins for him to come up to me and get my order. He was extremely rude and disrespectful. He messed up my order 3 times and even on the 4th one, it was still wrong but I took it anyways because I didn't want to deal with him. I don't know if he was having a bad day or what was happening but it was 7am and seeing an incredibly rude person at 7am is way too early for bad vibes, in my opinion.
Great local Starbucks! Even with a line the baristas move it along quickly. Everyone is friendly and happy to be there. Only downside is parking can be a pain in peak hours.
I love this Starbucks! Staff is always friendly and I like the second floor seating. I think this is the only place in SB to get coffee at 6am

This Starbucks is by far the BEST location I've ever visited! The entire staff is always friendly and engaging. Today I went through their drive through on my way to work in the same shopping center. The manager always knows my "regular" drink and gets it right every time. Today after I left, he realized they made my drink wrong and called to tell me he would be bringing me a new drink. He personally brought this to me along with a free drink card for the mistake. This exceptional level of service is exactly why I don't go to the other two locations on my way to work and go to this one every time!! I just wanted to let Starbucks know that they have an amazing manager at this location!!

To some this review may seem like nitpicking but I stand by it. My go to drink is Americanos. I get them just about everywhere, typically iced. When you make an iced Americano it's important to put the ice in the cup first and then pour the piping hot expresso overtop. If you don't do this you have a hot liquid in a plastic cup made for cold liquids. When you put hot liquids into these types of plastics there is a high probability the plastic is going to release chemicals into the drink that will do God knows what to you. 


I've been to this starbucks twice, both times they made it adding ice after. Both times I didn't say anything because I don't want to sound like a D but to date I've wasted $6.50 because I'm not drinking that ish. Try to poison me once shame on you. Try to poison me twice, shame on me. I'm being over dramatic but for real doe, I'm not going back.

Came in today to order a drink off their "secret menu" having to pay double for that one drink (which is fine) not even the point.  the cashier still made a big deal about it. 2. Their wannabe barista adding in her smart ass comments. The rudest service at Starbucks thus far. "You can blame Pinterest for this drink" "that stupid drink" "I'm not shaking it up." Thing one: "it's not an ombré" thing 2 "oh well I tried" I forgot they get paid commission or something? Or by the hour? Cause they attitude for the PAID drink was absurd. Super disgusting anyway. Can't wait to pass this outrageous service to Starbucks Corp. plus there's fruit flies flying all over that shop. If they don't like their job they need to find a new job. Cause both those girls had the nastiest attitude and smart mouthing a paying customers order is so disgusting. Even if it was a bad day for them that's by far rude. If your employer offers these things what are you mad about if your getting paid for it??

This usually is my favorite starbucks,  but today got a Frappuccino with soy and it was not filled to the top of cup and was a bit thinner than normal
 Glad this wasn't my first visit cause I probably would not go back.  When you pay 6 dollars for a Frappuccino you expect it to be consistent. I felt this was about like McDonald's quality with Starbucks  price.

I am aware of what Starbucks is; what it represents and conveys, especially here in Philly. I always feel a hint of guilt when I go into this place and once I leave, that feeling stays for a little while longer. Anyway, the Starbucks on South Street is what it is; it's a chain coffee shop. There is nothing fancy or original about it and their products taste like every other one of their locations, so don't expect anything new on South Street either. However, the single, somewhat good and redeeming quality about this place is the lounge/sitting space on the top floor. I really enjoy reading a paper, or mostly, just looking out the window watching everything that is going on out at the corner of Third and South. It is relaxing, fun and allows for time to fly while you are staring through the glass. Aside from that it is basically your typical, generic Starbucks, nothing more and nothing less.

I used to go to the Palm Harbor location (because they had the long tables that i love to study on for hours) but it was a bit farther than i'd like. I stumbled on this Starbucks while checking if there was any other Starbucks closer to home that had the infamous long table. They hardly had photos or reviews but i decided to go for it anyways...and i am so glad i did. This location is conveniently located in Gulf to Bay next to Wawa and Walmart. Like i stated before it isn't big but it is clean and cozy, the background music and atmosphere is chill for nice long hours of studying. They also have a small outdoor seating area (some with umbrellas just in case it rains) for clients to socialize or relax and enjoy the fresh air. They conveniently have a drive-thru and have enough employees for both drive-thru and walk-ins. The Teavana Very Berry Hibiscus is very refreshing and even has few fresh raspberry and Blackberry inside. I love the fact that they have healthy options. Sure i still look longingly at the pastries but they have the option of greek yogurt with fruit, Protein pack, Spinach Feta egg Breakfast wrap (which i have tried before and is pretty good), etc. So i am very excited to have found a Starbucks where i can study and isn't too far from home.

I'm not the biggest Starbucks fan anyway, but between the absurdly long lines and mediocre service, I would choose to go to neighboring Panera for my coffee 8 times out of 10 (and they have free wifi).

The location is convenient.  There are tables, small and long & counter seating.  There are not comfy chairs anymore, I miss them, but it leaves more room for additional tables and seating.  Lots of coffee drinks, frappacianos, tea and hot chocolate.

I drink Starbucks almost daily (it's my favorite coffee) and I stop at this location a couple times a month. While the staff is always friendly, the wait time is consistently and often considerably much longer then it should be and much longer than the Starbucks locations I stop at in Wilmington or any DD I stop at. 

If there are two cars in the drive through, you can expect a 6-8 minute wait. This locations prices are probably 20% more expensive than other locations for what I presume to be its alleged convenience, but it's wait times are far from convenient. 

Stopped in yesterday around 7pm and they were out of dark roast. When asked about a pour over, I was told it'd be at least 5 mins. Ended up taking a pike place. 

Stopped by today and the line was out of the drive through lane. I just kept on driving...

Caramel macchiato was bitter and barely warm.. I got a ham and Swiss sandwich and there was a huge fatty piece in it, took up a large portion of the meat unfortunately.. cashier was very polite and I didn't have to wait very long but not worth the money.

This was the largest Starbucks I've seen in Nashville.  It has a barstool area, table area, small conference room and an outside porch.  Service was on par with other Starbucks, meaning it was efficient and friendly.  It was cool but not cold and felt great after being outside in the sweltering summer heat.  Go Starbucks!!

This is by far the best Starbucks ever. I used to think all Starbucks' were the same, but this one is special! 

What makes this place great is the incredibly friendly staff. I frequented this location a ton during my 3 years of law school, and the baristas always brightened my day. I have never encountered a nicer staff at a coffee shop. 

The inside of the Starbucks also makes it great. There's a fireplace and a ton of seating. The hours at this location are also a plus.

this is one of my go to places if I need to do any work on my laptop. it's quite a nice environment. you've got plenty of outlets to charge your computer or phone and it is usually pretty quiet in there.

the staff is completely cool with you ordering a drink or two and letting you stay for as long as the doors are open. I have never had a problem with any of the staff members there. for the most part, the items you purchase come out on time.

one major improvement that would nice would be to add some comfier chairs. this would be beneficial for those doing work and studying for long periods of time. after awhile, the seats can become a little uncomfortable. 

other than that, it's a high class environment and would certainly recommend it to others.

Just had the most friendly experience after a not so pleasant time at the location at El Con Mall yesterday. Thank you for a delicious beverage served with a smile... It really does make the coffee taster better!

My favorite Starbucks! They make the best coffee drinks! Especially my cinnamon dolce iced coffee. Today I went in there hoping the could resolve my horrible drink that I got at the Starbucks in the target across the parking lot. They so awesomely do fix it and I was very grateful for it. I promise I will stay faithful to my TRUE Starbucks . 
Thanks again for fixing my drink

Yes, I know, there is a Starbucks practically at every corner or major intersection.  This one; however, is my go-to Starbucks on the way to work.  Yes, it is packed every day.  Yes, parking is a nightmare and getting back onto Hillsboro (especially since I have to make a left) can be a challenge.  But it is a consistently decent cuppa joe and although it is busy, the line moves rather efficiently and quickly.  There are days I don't feel hip enough to be in there and there are also days I seem to be the customer not wearing pajamas - but that's really neither here nor there - just an observation.

Is Starbucks my favorite caffeine spot?  No.  But if certainly beats the office grind (pun most definitely intended).

Questo Starbucks è proprio carino e degno di nota!!!!
Innanzitutto perché si trova in un paesino che di per se è già molto pittoresco: Saint charles, punto di partenza di una delle esplorazioni più importanti degli Stati Uniti partite dal fiume Missouri.
Il locale è posizionato accanto alla strada principale ma in un'area abbastanza riservata e, oltre ad avere un sacco di spazio all'interno, ha anche tavolini all'esterno con adeguato spazio tra di loro.
E per di più ha anche il drive thru! Insomma: cosa chiedere di più????

Went in for a shake and they were short the banana because they ran out, so I just took some strawberries . It was still very good, but the awesome part was they gave me a card for my next visit! Super sweet! Thanks for making my Monday! ! They know how to run a business! Xoxox
Not a very good Starbucks. Sandwich was not up to normal quality.  Bathrooms had line with five people on it

The speed of this Starbucks, even though it's PACKED, is always pretty good. The staff is quite lovely, and I'm in often enough for them to know what usually get. I am actually in during Frappaccino Happy Hour, and it's pretty empty. My boyfriend and I like the free WiFi. It's small inside, but their porch is really lovely. The bathroom is pretty clean. I've only had  a couple of drinks that have missed the mark (the flat white must be difficult to make.)

I use to love coming to this Starbucks. Always had fast and friendly staff, who would go above and beyond most companies customer service satisfaction.  However for the past few months service here had gone down hill.  The last three times i was here my order was made wrong.  I than had to wait another 20 min for my correct order.  The drive thru is even worse.  Expect to be sitting in line for a min of 30-45 min, just to be given the wrong order.  
The only reason why I still come to this Starbucks is because of Danny!  He always greats every guest by name and memories your order for you.  
I'm sad to say if service doesn't get better soon I will be going else where.

Suburbia sucks.  Hades is a better place in my book.   Yet this place is one of the few things that make sterile suburban living bearable.  I like the lack of parking spaces. Sort of like telling all the fat people in their gas guzzlers...  Walk a free blocks, it will do you good...  What's better, they should convert one of their parking spaces to a bike rack.  That should send a message.

The baristas have always been a friendly bunch to me. And it's dog friendly outside so I can bring my pup . Can't go wrong.  And they were nice enough to save Galapagos coffee in beans while I went away.  

For a chain, they're really good.

I don't particularly like this location's parking situation, so we rarely come here.  I ordered two grande Gold Coast coffees and two blue berry scones.   After the first coffee was poured the barista informed me that they only had enough for one of the drinks and if I wanted to wait for another pot or choose a different flavor.  I opted for the veranda blend and the barista gives me an embarrassed look to indicate they were still brewing it.  I wound up getting pikes place, not my favorite, but it will do.
The poor barista then informs me that they only have one blue berry scone left, so I opted for a chocolate croissant.  
A short time later the manager calls my name to pick up the sweet treats and to my surprise she offered me a gift card for $4 off my next visit for the trouble I had with my order.  This was completely unexpected, it is nice to see a large business want to make things right to get their customer's to return and we will

This is the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Of course it's convenient because I work at the hospital. I've never had lattes be so under filled then at this place. You open the lid and the coffee starts a good 2-3 inches from the top, it's ridiculous. I started going to the one on Dale Mabry, where they don't under fill my drink.

Great location for a starbucks, used to come here after going for a drive up Campbell and then down Sunrise. Not usually crowded. They do close a little early. Great to go for a drive and catch up with friends. My second favorite starbucks in Tucson after the one on University.

They have some of the rudest people i have ever encountered working here!! They have total attitudes even though they are the ones that messed up my order!! It is not that hard to serve an iced tea and a toasted bagel people!! The Starbucks in Glen Mills has a much nicer and more competent staff.I will not go back here unless they hire almost all new people!!

It's a Starbucks, $5 coffee and a chill atmosphere. This is a relatively small one so there aren't a ton of tables. The people who work here are good and this isn't a super busy location so you can get in an out. I wish more Starbucks had drive thru so you didn't have to make a trip out of going to get a cup of coffee but it is what it is. My only knock is that the tables and floor here are consistently dirty. I know these are high turnover business but I have never been here and seen a clean table.

It's Starbucks, what can you say. Swanky place full of a mixture of college kids, business men and pompous women. Unfortunately the coffee is good enough to keep me coming back. Tip: everything tastes better with a shot or two of espresso. I'll deal with the terrible crowd every once and a while just to get my fix. Although, if the baristas get any more of a condescending tone, I might just have to make the drive to Crave every day.

One of the better Starbucks I've been to. It has an unfortunate lack of space after a while throughout the day because of students coming to study but I definitely think the drink quality is pretty good and the baristas have been pretty friendly. I wish there was another one of the counters with milk and napkins.

First experience and it's slower than usual, no where to park and just overall slow.  My mocha tasted like warm milk with a little sweetness. This is experience was almost as bad as my experience at the new city line ave location. After waiting to be rung up, waiting for my mocha I still ended up waiting for my croissant because they forgot to bag it and give it to me.

Happy New Year!

It's the fist day of 2018 and I'm very grateful for this Starbucks.

The staff Rob, Christopher, and Ashina were very friendly. They kicked off the new year with somewhat of a rude customer (I'm sure that person had their reasons for being a bit rude), but they handled it very gracefully!

It's tough starting off the first day of your new year having to listen to customer complaints, but thank you for being open on New Years and being patient and gracious to that customer. You guys are awesome!

Todays morning crew has it together.  I come in once a month and get a bunch of treats for my customers and they are so accommodating.  They make beautiful "gift bags" filled with random pastries that I get to bring in to the offices. They were super friendly and how they handled the morning crowd (and make you feel special) is appreciated.

This Starbucks it's probably the slowest one I have ever been to. It's located in a somewhat convenient place right off the road at a rest stop, but it is on the other side from the big building.
