There aren't enough bathrooms at all, especially considering this is a rest stop on a highway. 

The entire time, the workers were complaining about how hard their day was and how they don't want to be here. This was a loud conversation they were having in front of everyone. Awesome.

I sometimes work late into the evening on my computer with returning emails, doing research, shopping and etc. I live within 2 blocks from this starbucks so sometimes I like to stop in for a cup of coffee to give me an extra jolt.  I recently stopped in to get a cup of coffee and a croissant. I asked the attendant to please heat up my croissant for 10 seconds.  She informed me that she already shut off the toaster because they sold all of their sandwiches so there was no need to keep it on.  I asked her what time it was, she informed me it was not yet 9 pm.  They close at 10 pm. I asked her if she had a microwave and she said no.  There were still cakes in the display which means they may still sell them.  I am confused of why they would shut off the toaster if they still had items to sell that the buyer may want to be heated up even though it's not a sandwich. Every time I go there, I always get a slice of pumpkin or banana bread or coffee cake to go with my coffee and they always ask me if I want it heated up and of course, I say yes. I don't guess I will be stopping in there later in the evening anymore if I can't have my food heated.  I ended up eating my blueberry croissant cold which was not very good.

Other than the complaint above,  the staff is always pleasant and efficient.
This place is good for adults and kids to get the perfect meal. I will say it is a little expensive. But it's good

Worst Starbucks on the planet. I used to come 5 times per week. Their service is slow, they fill up the coffee half way up the cup and the rest with whip cream and though the manager or regional manager has gotten involved, he said "in sorry they don't spoon the steam back and I'm sure this won't be the last time." - either train your people to do the job you pay them to do for the customers who pay outrageous amounts of money for coffee or fire them and get a new staff who can get the job done.

My barista was adorable. She looked like a long haired Tinkerbell, really. The great thing was she was just as nice as she looked. 

I let her know about my half off coupon and she actually seemed happy for me. I wish more of the baristas acted that way! My coupon was for a chocolate chai tea latte, and I glad I decided to try it. It's a little odd at first, I'll admit. But after a few sips I was loving the flavor.

As for the location itself, it was squeaky clean with abundant seating and a comfortable ambiance. 

Curlew Starbucks is definitely a role model store for the brand.

This Starbucks is in a perfect location, with a beautiful building, in a great shopping centre. But unfortunately the coffee giant that I love was unable to capitalize on it's opportunity.

The biggest complaint about this store that I have is the lack of comfortable seating. All chairs except for 3 bench seats in the room are uncomfortable metal chairs that don't invite one to stay for more than 10 minutes. So if one is looking for a relaxing atmosphere to relax with a cup of coffee for an hour or two, I would avoid this store. 

This location has the normal Starbucks quality coffee, with some college students (most likely from st joes) running the store. Some days they are pleasant, other days they are rude and bitter.

I wish this Starbucks was better, because it could be so nice and perfect. But I don't have any desires to return to this location unless its just to pick up a cheap cup of joe after chipoltle.

The Starbucks is as good as any Starbucks in Southern California and South Florida! I've never been in a Starbucks that I didn't truly love, and this one is a "Class Act as well; so I'll continue going and/or stopping on the way when I'm going somewhere for more delicious Starbucks coffee!!! Thank you for the great service, too!

Great service and the drinks are very consistent. The #1 thing I love about this location is they have more than enough outlets for anyone who needs to charge their laptops. They also have plenty of inside and outside tables, which I think is a plus.


2013/#30
This Starbucks never opens on time. Posted it should open at 7:30 but it consistently doesn't open until 7:40 at the earliest.

This is what I would describe as a "no frills" Starbucks, and just a place to grab a coffee.  Not a place to stay awhile, or study, or read a book.  At first glance, a nice large Bucks.  Then you come to realize they have funky along the wall seating, no comfy leather chairs, and for the size of the place, this doesn't really make sense.  A 3.5 star location at best.

Service: nice, but minimal.

Come here every morning before work - the staff here are FANTASTIC! After my third time coming, the barista had my order memorized! Great service, very friendly and happy staff!
I grabbed  a skinny vanilla latte coffee before I got on my flight. Sat down on the plane to find that my coffee was hot water with foam on top. :(

I wish I could give this place 5 stars because I think it deserves it, but I can't because of a minor flaw that detracts from a perfect experience. Nearly all of the employees there are excellent! They consistently make high-quality drinks; the place is always clean and well-stocked. So, it's unfortunate that there is one employee who mans the cashier that seems incapable of taking an order correctly.

I always have to repeat myself a few times when this particular person is working, and then she will either relay my order incorrectly or forget to tell the person who is doing food that I ordered something in addition to my drink. Like I said, it's minor, but it never fails to happen.

If my experiences improve in the future, I will gladly change my rating.
Used to be the best Starbucks around here.  Only a few good employees left here.   Not so good anymore. 15 minutes to get a bagel right and not black.  Nebraska much better.

My feet hurt and I sit 90% of the day....

located inside the travel center...

Ugh! Same old same old over and over... What can you expect from a multi-national chain? Pretty much slow service and huge lines!

Lately this Starbucks has been really disappointing. I have often come in and watched my mobile order get pushed to the back of the line for someone that ordered in the drive thru or in the cafe. This is not the way it's supposed to go. I used to work at Starbucks so I am very well aware of the procedures. I have also watched baristas get out of sequence on their drink making. I think some training needs to be done to get this very busy store up to the standard. It's frustrating to have to wait an extra ten minutes or more for a drink that you ordered on your way in the store. There is a reason for mobile ordering. The people here are great and I love the atmosphere but please work on your standards.

Ok, so most everyone knows what to expect from Starbucks coffee as its a large chain. With this said, this location has a few things that set it apart. I will start with pros and go to cons:

Pros: 
- Interior design: chic and large. I often use coffee houses to do some reading, and this place has plenty of cozy seating and good decor.
- parking: I have almost always found parking in their lot

Cons:
- Service/Staff: not the top notch service I have come to expect from Starbucks. There are times I have to wait for them to notice me to get an order in. I have had a few hiccups with getting my drinks right


Overall, decent experience, but had so much potential as it is one of the most aesthetic Starbucks I've seen. Still good experience and great place to come and get some work done if you're a coffee shop person

This is literally one of the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Incredibly slow, and the last time I ordered a matcha green tea (powder with water that's .87 at every other Starbucks I've been to) they tried to charge me $4 for a "latte" even though there was no soy or milk in it. it takes 20 minutes I don't have every time to get a what's often a simple drink. I'd rather avoid this place or drive to a Starbucks that's out of my way then spend any more time trying to get anything.

One of the worst Starbucks I have been too!  Whether in the morning or afternoon there is always only one person making drinks and 6 other people doing nothing.  I seriously question the management at this location, and wonder if the staff just do what they want.  If you ever get upset about having to wait 20 mins for your drink they look at you as if they have the hardest job in the world and how dare you question them.  What a joke!!

This is my FAVORITE Starbucks. ALL the staff is super friendly and the Manager is wonderful! I have been going here for years and I drive out of my way to come here. It is also nice and spacious for when I want to sit and do homework.

Conveniently located across the street from the enormous New Orleans Convention Center (NOCC) this efficient and welcoming Starbucks was a godsend during my recent NOCC-based convention. I had forgotten to pack my reusable mug, so I was delighted to see that in addition to perfectly crafted drinks, I also was able to pick up a new travel mug that was in the style that I wanted. Thanks, Starbucks for making my Convention experience so much more enjoyable.
Slow and slower....Don't understand why it takes them 15 mins to make a green ice tea. Need better management.

The drive thru is either really fast or painfully slow. Tough to know what you're facing if you're pressed for time. No consistency with the beverages; sometimes they taste great and sometimes they taste way off, and again never know what you're facing. When you're paying $5 for a cup of coffee, you should t ever be disappointed. The guy with the bushy red beard is rude.

A cruise ship that I was on stopped at this town, so I decided to rest here for a little bit.

Service was a little slow, BUT, the drinks were good and the baristas were very cheerful. The location itself was very nice.

If I ever return to this town for another vacation, I will definitely be back!

Maybe it's because they are on a busy stretch of East Washington Street, but they seem to always be behind, be out, and be slow.  Behind in that they can't keep the store picked up/clean; be out of products; and slow to handle the flow of customers.  Apart from this, it's a typical Starbucks and certainly an option when in that area.

SLoWEST Starbucks ever! If you're in a rush DO NOT come here. There's a line to the door and there's one cashier, one barista, two other staff in the back when they should be taking care of their morning rush traffic! The barista told me that he  "can only take one drink order at a time" and walks away when I try to tell him my second drink order!

Easily the friendliest Starbucks I've ever been to! Everything is as you'd expect from a Starbucks, so no magical coffee - but I definitely appreciate the kind and friendly staff before my work commute!

This location one of the young lady was very rude I ordered a cup of Grande blondie coffee and she said they had to make it by hand. Everytime I come to this location which this is my second time because it's closer to my job I have a bad experience.
It's a Starbucks. Nothing special really. Same items as every other place. What you would expect. Staff is attentive for the most part and friendly.

This is a really good Starbucks. I love that it has a drive though and carries nitro cold brew (which I am addicted too). I see Danny almost every time I visit and he always remembers me which really makes my day! 

The only downside is that this place is usually packed so the wait can be a little longer.
I love this Starbucks. I usually use the drive-thru and they're always so fast and friendly, even when it's super crowded. :)

Very nice location! I'm in the middle of nowhere in Tennessee, and this was the closest Starbucks. The drive thru was PACKED, which makes sense because it's the only one within like 15 minutes. The baristas were super nice and made conversation with me about what I'm doing here and if I'm enjoying the state - I'm ecstatic that they DIDN'T tell me to "have a blessed day" (I hear that EVERYWHERE here). The only reason I gave it four stars instead of five was because the trash was like overflowing and the RTD case was kind of messy. Other than that, it was a nice little spot.

What can I say?  This is Starbucks!   Unfortunately it's next to my other favorite place to get a smooth and rich ice cold frozen coffee, so I have to choose. 
Cons: The parking is REALLY tight and is always busy with being in the middle of Vanderbilt University and Medical /Hospital. 
Even though the line is long, I get through very quick. Finding a seat isn't always easy, but this is the largest Starbucks I've ever been to. 
It does take more time to find where to park than it does to walk in and get my coffee, but it's worth it. 
Definitely keeps busy with its location, unfortunately its location that keeps it busy and crowded. 
I'll keep coming back for more coffee here.

This is one of the most inconsistent Starbucks there is. Actually, all the Starbucks in Santa Barbara are horrible! Get it together people. This is a huge chain and the one thing that should be counted on is consistency!

Worst starbucks location ever! The drive through takes forever.  The people working have no sense of urgency.  Twice they have been out of all coffee except dark and I've had to wait 5+ mins for a plain cup of coffee.  It's insane!  I can go through chick fil a and get food faster than a coffee here.

Nice Starbucs location! This spot has both indoor and outdoor seating areas, which is nice if you are stopping to meet up with someone! I usually stop in mid-day, so the lines usually are not long, but I do see more of a crowd in the morning. There isn't a drive through at this location, so you do have to park and walk inside...so if you're in a hurry you might want to keep that in mind!

"Now, this is your first lesson in coffee. Without anything in it, it's black coffee. Can you say black coffee? Then, there's coffee regular. That means two sugars and milk, which they have forgotten, so can I borrow some of yours? Ah, coffee regular." -- Look Who's Talking (1989)

What a great little Starbucks - and I mean little. We walked in after eating across the street and were in need of a cup of coffee and a sweet snack for dessert.  We ordered and then looked around and realized there was no place to sit - at all... then the young lady behind the counter said there was more seating upstairs... what?

Wow - we took our coffees and snacks upstairs and had a great space to sit and chat for an hour until it was time to close the upstairs for the night.

The service was good, the drinks were prepared properly and the overall atmosphere was nice.  Also, it was quiet, but it was also at night - so not a true test.

It's my local Starbucks. The staff is always very friendly and has more to say than what do you want :-) Has a drive through. 
If it wasnt out of my way I'd visit more often. Man I wish there was another one closer to my house. Can we get a Starbucks at the Beach?

How much is a cup of Grande coffee exactly?  I stopped here for a refill and after the long line of waiting, the waitress charged me 2.6 for a grande (refilled) coffee ? So even it is not a refill, why I am getting it 2.24 else where... god , if I'm not too tired to argue and the line is still too long....  don't know what's the feeling. Thought it should be a comfortable rest stop. Now I almost felt asleep waiting in line.. and btw, tried to order drink on app, the stupid map on the app only find UD Starbucks the closest.. ahhh ...
Poor customer service. The staff is way more interested in gossiping about their fellow employees than engaging the customer.

Came here on a Saturday evening to study and drink some coffee.  The staff is great; I have no complaints at all about them.  The store itself is a bit cramped though and the parking lot is extremely tiny.  I would imagine they get totally swamped during peak times.

I now it's not a "local" coffee shop and I feel bad for loving corporate coffee, but gosh dang it I just love Starbucks!!!  I'm so glad they FINALLY opened a store with a drive-thru on The Bench!  They are always friendly and I love my phone app. It's just all so convenient and good!

I've been to this Starbucks a few times...I'm definitely a Starbucks aficionado, lol!  David, the barista from Latimer is here!  There's another barista from Walnut St., a friendly bunch!  They have ample seating here too which is great, plenty of tables and chairs.  

I would give 5 stars but I think it's kinda lame that they want to hold onto your ID or keys while you borrow the bathroom key, I just think that's kinda dumb.  I don't understand why they can't just have a keypad on the door and give you the code like other Starbucks do.  I don't like having to leave my personal property with a barista.  If it weren't for that issue and the line getting backed up, I would have given 5 stars.  

I will keep coming here occasionally but it's not the closest one to me, so I'll visit the Bellevue and Latimer more often since they're closer.  Still, good Starbucks!

We hung out at this Starbucks in Harrahs at least once a day during our 10 day visit to NOLA. If not here, then we visited the one on Canal & St Charles at least twice during our stay. On a hot day, their iced coffee is a welcome relief. We usually cut thru Harrahs on our way to Riverwalk for Cafe du Mode beignets. It's a smoke free casino and AIR-CONDITIONED so we stop, have an iced coffee and watch people playing the slot machines. The employees are okay, typical of Starbucks, friendly, courteous, fast & efficient and the iced coffee usually pretty good though not consistent  (with refills). They have decent rewards program (star rewards).

It's a Starbucks. It's your pretty standard Starbucks. The employees were nice to me, my drink was fine (I only went here because the local Brewha I normally would frequent was too packed) and the line went quickly. That's about it. Don't think it deserves the 1 star from the other post.

Not open Saturday or Sunday unfortunately.

This is the worst Starbucks. They are always out of everything and they take forever whether you go inside or through the drive thru. Sometimes their employees are very rude too. Unfortunately this is the only one around so I if I want Starbucks I have to go to this one. It's been like this for years and they never improve.

This is downtown Wilmington where there is about 4 reserved spaces for customers of this Starbucks.  Employees of this Starbucks park in these spaces all day long.  Especially a Red Mazda 3 with Delaware Plates.
Good and happy crew! Love it! Clean environment clean bathrooms with toilet seat covers, seems to be not a standard in Florida. Wonderful idea to serve wine and beer! Down the street from our stay!

Although I am not a huge coffee drinker any longer, stopping by a Starbucks, any Starbucks is generally makes my wife very happy.  It's been freezing cold and today this stop was my idea. Absolutely love that I can jazz up my coffee and they act like I'm perfectly normal!  Today was a Cappuccino and a danish, as always fresh and delightful.  The staff at this location are always happy and engaged with the customers, they may only see me every once in a while- but they make you feel like they have known you forever.

The newly renovated Starbucks is super nice! There are lots of chairs and huge tables. I love it! Before there were never seats in this store, but now I'm
Sure we'd be able to find a seat at any time. It's really just very large! 
The parking lot is still very tiny and you have to go around the roundabout, which can be tricky. You must watch other drivers who have no clue or are in too big a hurry and will almost sideswipe you to hurry and park in a handicap spot. Well in the space between handicap spots. So rude. 
We live super close and pass by often so it's easy to come here, but usually safer to go to other locations. 
The new Strawberry Frappachino is excellent on a hot day!

Super slow and doesn't feel like customer service is a priority.
Even it was completely empty on a Wednesday late afternoon, and 2 employees were cleaning, the one employee responsible to make my product, took more than 15 minutes to prepare such.
Unacceptable.
This is a very unique Starbucks! Very fast and friendly service. Only downside was that there isn't a drive thru.

I visit this Starbucks frequently, even work from there on a regular basis.  The staff is very friendly.  There is the occasional 'bad day' person but that is very rare (we all have them).  The drinks are consistent and good.  The manager there, Annie, might just be the nicest person in the world.  It is a very busy store but worth it.  Highly recommended.

This is one of the best Starbucks I've been to.  The staff is always pleasant and my drink is always perfect.

For the record, I hate coffee.  Sorry Starbucks.  But they serve the best ice tea you can find.  I order black tea with no water (non-diluted) and no sweetener.  Then I can sweeten with sugar in the raw to my own liking.

Even better now that the patio is smoke free.

I love the location and they have plenty of work space, but they are so slow!

I stood at the counter for two minutes before being greeted, then waited another ten for my coffee. I came in at noon on a Monday, and there were only four customers inside. The drive through had a steady steam, and there were three online orders completed as well, but I still don't see how that means an inside customer should wait ten minutes for a coffee.

It's a great location with a wonderful set of staff. There's quite a bit of seating, tons of windows and even some patio chairs - all in all the perfect place to come and people watch or catch up with some friends. 

It can get really busy in there, so be prepared for a line up. With usually only two baristas working, it can be a bit of a wait for your drink. The drinks are always well made though, so the wait is worth it.

Came in one morning and ordered a venti blackberries and cream frappachino and a morning bun. Cashier rang me up and never gave me my morning bun. Got back in line to buy a bag of popcorn and get my pastry and I get an "oh you're back" I told her she charged me for my pastry but never gave it to me and all i got was a snarky look. 

After she all but through my pastry at me I waited at the end of the bar for my drink and started to notice that some of the people behind me in line were getting their drinks before me. While it's one thing if they were getting a regular cup of coffee it's another when they're getting frappuccinos and lattes. After 15-20 minutes of waiting one of the baristas came up to me and asked me what I ordered and if I was still waiting so I told her and apparently the cashier never marked my cup. The barista then made my drink and was very apologetic about it. 

I also try to help the cashier with the marking on one of the pastry bags because nor she or the manager could figure out what it was and being an employee at a real Starbucks I tried to help since I knew the marking and I all I got was a disgusted look from both the cashier and manager. 

Not to sound superior or anything buy If any of these things happened at my store it would not be tolerated at all. 

Since I'm on such a tight schedule in the morning I don't have enough time to go to the one in town or else I would.
Convenient to Riverwalk/ Convention Center Area. Your standard Starbucks environment with about ten tables and a window bar area.

Good drinks just wish the guy working the drive thru that has goatee/beard always wearing that rounded hat would stop asking me "are you okay...?" In a weird tone When I pull up. Then asking what I'm doing, what I did on the weekend, where I'm goin where do I work? I don't mind people being friendly but this guy makes me feel weird. Just chill out and hand me my drink please. Makes me not wanna come to this location honesty lol
Hours on Google say open 24 hours. Drove up at 4:30 am on an extremely early work Saturday, and drive thru and store were closed. Very disappointed that I couldnt get my pumpkin spice latte

Do you ever order an iced coffee and then an hour later you're wondering why you are bouncing off the walls?  Talking so fast?  Walking so fast? Can't concentrate?  Constantly OUTRAGED while reading the Reno Yelp talk threads?  The super friendly barista here confirmed our suspicion that a Starbucks iced coffee actually has  more caffeine than a normal coffee because it's so concentrated.

This is my favorite place that I love to hate. I only go here cause I am a starbucks phene, and I get a consistent flow of gift cards and the Barnes and Noble does not accept Starbucks gift cards. The staff for the most part is RUDE RUDE RUDE. I have to ask a zillion times for my cup to be filled more, they always roll their eyes at me when I hand them my refillable cup, sorry my dad bought me a refillable coup and a giftcard, I'm a broke college student who needs caffiene. It is in a pretty convenient location on campus so thats why I keep returning.

This is the Starbucks right near the Whole foods and it's fine.  Gets crowded during peak hours and the staff is pleasant enough.

Smaller floorplan.

It's starbucks, you don'y need to read a review on yelp to know what to expect. 

Clean place, nice staff and my pup loves the pup cups when he rides around being basic with me :)
One of my local Starbucks... This can be a very busy location but they are on top of things and keep the line moving. I only wish they had a drive-thru at this location.

Avoid this Starbucks at all costs. Unless you have 15 minutes to wait for an Americano with only 1 person in line ahead of you. It's rare to not have a line wrapped around the store. While the staff is friendly, they generally move at a glacial pace & only 1 register is staffed. Not sure why they bothered to place 2 registers in this location. It may be convenient but the service is practically nonexistent. Easily the worst store I've ever visited in the chain.

I don't spend a lot of time here, but when I do come in before work occasionally I'm always impressed with the service. Ive had a few mix ups with drinks during rushes, but they were always quick to fix it. As a barista myself, I can appreciate the time they take to do stuff like this without compromising speedy service!

My favorite Starbucks. I'm biased because it's down the street from me, but it's never done me wrong! I used to come every single day in high school, and they've only gotten my order wrong, maybe three times. Even for as busy as they get, the baristas are always in top of things. Although high school was quite a while ago, I still enjoy coming to this location. 

Now, when are they going to renovate like the other ones have in this area ??

Walked in and the barista was very nice and patient... Since I wasn't sure what I was craving that day. Not much food selection at around 830pm, but she did explain there was a pirate event going on and a cheerleading event and she said they cleaned the store out. The bathrooms were pretty nasty, and that is the reason why I am rating it a three. The drink my husband had was amazing (cannot recall the name right now) and he said that all starbucks should make it the same but they don't.

This store stops serving brewed coffee at 7:00! Why? 

Certainly not being done for the convenience of the customer. It has now been 10 minutes since I ordered a tall coffee. Nothing yet. Ridiculous. Starbucks should be ashamed of itself.
This is a great neighborhood Starbucks!  Great staff and the coffee is always good!  I'm amazed that no matter how early I get in and tired I look the staff looks wide awake and is in a cheery mood.

Worst service ever
My sandwich was cold and a so-called "caramel macchiato" didnt even taste to a macchiato. So sad we have to limit to this experience at an airport.
I dont recommend this one' They cater to regulars so slow it seems like a training store.

Great customer service, free WiFi, outdoor sitting and in park place mall. Ordered a specialty drink and took about 5 minutes but well worth the wait! They really know how to drizzle extra caramel when you ask! Love it! 

Secret menu item found online - caramel mocha chip 
Double chocolate chip frapp with 3 squirts mocha, line cup with caramel drizzle and topped with caramel and added double shot espresso

This Starbucks is a pretty good store. It is the only one in the area that has the Clover Brewing System - check it out.

Street parking only and at times it can be a pain to park. Make sure you plug the meters because you WILL get a ticket.

Not a very large store, but the flow does work for this location.

Great location in the 1920 Commons buildings on PENN's campus. Staff is quick and efficient. 

KEEP IN MIND: you CAN use your Starbucks card to make a purchase  however you CANNOT use your freebies or any coupons at this location.

Ok guys, I didn't think that you guys could get worse but somehow you did!
SEVEN BARISTAS "WORKING". SEVEN.
We ordered and then 20 minutes later we still had not received my coworkers drink 3 of the 7 baristas were standing around chatting, not even attempting to make a show of working. After 3 people had received their orders, my coworker went up to complain because: 20 minutes of our lunch break was now wasted, my sandwich which had been warmed was now cold, her salad originally chilled was now warm. And they tried to pass it off as a technical error. Are you kidding me? I'm so disappointed in y'all. CORPORATE IF YOU CAN SEE THIS SEND THEM SOMEONE TO GET MOVING!!!!!

It's...a Starbucks. And a petite one at that. Love that there's a drive-thru, but have to say, a few times they've been out of something I've wanted. Last time it was bottled water--at least they offer you a free cup of water in lieu of that, but sill... The downside at this one is the limited number of tables, so plan accordingly if you're thinking you're going to have a quick sit-down with someone. Staff is nice, bathrooms usually clean.
Zero internet connection. Waste of a trip! Came to do some studies with expectation they would have a decent internet. Wrong!
This is very small and tidy Starbucks but is in the heart of the downtown which is walking distance. Take a away .
Unfriendly. Second time visiting this Starbucks....different employees but same unwelcoming environment.

Parking here is a nightmare - and often there are no spaces - except for 2 resevred for the empty "We Buy Gold" store next door.

I often park in the shopping center (acme) next door) and walk across the busy street to get my four dollar latte fix.

Meanwhile - the service here once inside is actually good.  The afternoon female barista (3-5 ish PM) is terrific.  Can't remember her name.

Oh - and please clean the bathrooms more.  Blargh!
There are a lot of local coffee shops that will do a better coffee than these people. Don't get me wrong the coffee here is okay but its extremely overpriced compared to local coffee shops.
good location, but too many transient make the ambiance a bit sketchy. ha OK, but will not go to this location again.
Yes, it's just a Starbucks, but I love this location.  It's cozy and relaxed and a great place to work remotely in the middle of the day.  The people are friendly as can be, too.

Being located right across the street from the business school and law school is definitely a blessing and a curse for this Starbucks.  It is always always crowded.  Which is good for business, but not so good if you want to get in and out quickly.  Lots of seating, not a lot of parking.  The barristas are friendly, if a bit frazzled.

Came in here for a quick bite before I headed back on a road trip to Miami. I ordered the usual Iced White Chocolate Mocha latte. Service was friendly, quick and they spelled my name correctly on the cup (Yay!). However, the milk tasted like it was going bad. not completely expired, but halfway there. If I would've run back, they probably would've exchanged it for me, but I was in a little rush. Place in general was nice, clean and quaint. But, just check your expiration dates just in case!

OK i frequent this particular Starbucks, from work, Yeah-I know-its Starbucks!!!but sometimes you get shitty employees with 'Tude!! 

Here-you will NOT get that.OH contrare mon Freire, the people that work here are great, from the girl who takes my order, to one makes my coffee or whatever I get!! Eye contact, friendly, just genuinely nice. Sweet Little Asian lady takes my order, how cute is she!!! But my drink always comes like the Coke commercial" A Coke & a smile" , this Here, A COFFEE & A Smile" That's what I'm talking about.

Worst Starbucks I've ever been. The only reason they stay in business is because they are on campus. The staff is rude, obnoxious and otherwise inattentive. I tried to redeem a reward from my Starbucks app and they refused to honor it. However, they do accept it to pay. Hands-down the worst Starbucks ever in the history of mankind.

Its a nice Starbucks location. Plenty of inside seating in this small strip mall.   Order is always correct 
Parking is tough so we park in the next strip mall and walk over

Favorite place to get coffee from. But yesterday this place left a bad taste in my mouth. As I was downing my coffee there was a large piece of plastic in coffee that I almost choked on. Didn't go back or bring up to management because I do not like confrontation.

One of my favourite locations, they always say hello as I enter, and goodbye when I leave. 
They've learned my first name, and always remember I have an allergy to dairy! What more could I ask for?!

I've visited here several times with horrible experiences and after my visit today I've decided I'll be driving 20 minutes out of my way from now on to get coffee. I mobile ordered 10 minutes before I got there and stood waiting for my drink for 20 more minutes while they had 6 people working an unorganized mess. Not to mention the barista's friend coming in and ordering their drink while she took her time to chat with him and then put his order ahead of the other 10 people that had been waiting. Unacceptable.

On our way to Squaw Valley, this was the Starbucks that we had to stop at on our way to the powdery goodness. 

The parking lot is a mess, first off.  People taking two spots, tourists sideways into a spot, trucks making 10 point turns to get out.  Absolute madness on pavement. 

Inside the store is much more organized and customer friendly than most other Starbucks.  The staff was stuck in "frozen" which is one speed slower than a dead stop.  

I thought maybe it was the early hour we were there, but 3 other trips to this location confirmed that there is something in the water there that makes the staff super slow.  

The drinks were very good, so I have to give them credit for that and surprisingly still hot after how long we waited. 

Overall, a nice Starbucks experience, but well off the service I receive in the Bay Area.

This is my favorite Starbucks location in Indy! The baristas are so amazing, especially "cupcake" - the guy with the cupcake tattoo (next time I go I'll learn his name). He can literally turn my day around because he's just a sweet breath of fresh air. If I ever need my day or attitude turned around, a visit to see Cupcake just really helps! You can tell he loves his job and we should all model our attitudes from his! They move the line quickly and the customer service is the best. If you don't like friendly people then you should probably make your own coffee at home.
The a.m. staff is my favorite. Super friendly people and good to see them every morning
Great new space and they have a Clover brewer!  Always friendly here!  Try your next cup of coffee using the Clover machine!

I've been sitting here for over six hours.  Here are some awesome things that have happened:

- Two folks picked up a book off the community book shelf and read it for a bit, sitting next to each other.  There is a community book shelf at this Starbucks.
- Someone came by to ask if I wanted more hot water for my tea.
- A kid's parents are in a long meeting here, and the owner came past and gave him stickers and trading cards.  I haven't seen a little one beam that big in a long, long time.  He's been engrossed for the past fifteen minutes.
- The music's been GREAT.  Miles Davis, right now.

Nice to find one of these with a little bit of spirit...

The drive through at this location looked really long today so I decided to just go inside. That later proved to be a mistake when the woman taking my order took probably 5 whole minutes to take my order. 5 minutes in the grand scheme of things is not much but when the man next to her is serving 3-4 people before she was even done with my order, it starts to feel long. She was very nice and obviously just new but maybe start your newer employees at a less busy hour than 10am. 

With that being said, the barista making my iced vanilla coffee did a great job. The best one I have had in a while.

A good, stable, trusty, reliable Starbucks in a really small strip mall in Media's outskirts, stone's throw from the trolley and with a super nice seating area.  The folks are friendly, and the coffee always hot.  

Gets quite crowded sometimes, however, especially on weekends.  

One of my regular places when I'm at my BF's home.  I've spent enough money there to make a dent in the annual Starbuck's stock dividends...

The workers were welcoming and got my order right. However, I just have to say that this was by far the dirtiest Starbucks I have ever been to. Mind you, at 5:30am the place should look fresh and clean. It was not. The night shift definitely did not clean the bathrooms and there was a pile of stuff on the counter between my server and I. It just had a dirty feeling to the place.

This Starbucks is a dump. The tops of the armrests fall off the chairs - apparently they are too cheap (or lazy) to get them repaired (or even glue them back on!). The line was ridiculous and they don't have nearly enough people working (2 cashiers, 1 barista) for the dozens of people here (at noon on a Saturday). Not nearly enough seating available, though there is a nice outdoor courtyard for warmer months. My drink was tasty, but otherwise, BLAH!
This is the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. It's been open for long enough that you'd think the kinks would be worked out by now. Please do something to fix this issue.

Ok - If I have to review a Bucks you know I got something... 

For some reason, this location didn't come up on my Google Maps.  Maybe its a really new location?  (Before the natives call me ignorant, I am not from SB - just driving through) 

The girl was very friendly and took quick care of us.  

This particular Starbucks is very small.  Laptop/desk/work space is very limited - they have more like bar seating than table seating.  

Like any other downtown location, parking is weak, very weak.  And once you drive past it, you get suckered into a ton of one way streets.

TFR

This location is now Dunkin Donuts in City Center. 
This DD doesn't even have the decency of offering bathroom service to paying customers. After I placed an order I asked the employee if they had a bathroom and he replied they have one but the manager does not allow it for customers.

This Starbucks is located in Super Target on the grocery side.  My visit occurred on 1/13 in the late afternoon.   This is the first and only time I have been to a Starbucks that had only one person working.  The line stretched out of the Starbucks area and into the Target.  The barista was very friendly and was doing the best that she could to keep the line moving. Eventually, a lady in Target jacket came over to help.

The location gets two starts because of the lack of employees on a weekend and the fact that I was over charged.  I ordered a drink and was charged $1.20 over the listed price.  I questioned it and was told that the price difference was because corporate had gone up on the prices and the pricing signage had not been updated (but the register was).  I was quite annoyed to see that an extra charge had been added to my drink.  Watch your receipt and go when you are not in a rush.

So there really is only one person working here who is always on his game and gives phenomenal customer service. He's been there for years, so this excludes him. They mostly cater to mobile orders, and can't multitask. And if you don't get there before Felix orders his 8 shots of expresso, you'll be waiting for 25 minutes.

Update: they got everything basically correct. 


I ordered a venti captain crunch frap (fairly common secret menu buy) and none of them knew how to make it so I look it up then the lady behind the counter takes the phone out of my hand to look at the ingredients. It wasn't busy at all and took over five minutes to make my drink in the wrong size. I told them they looked annoyed but remade my drink.  Took 15 minutes to make one drink.

Used to be my go to Starbucks.   The smokers sitting by the door outside took care of that.  Disgusting. There is a 25' no smoking Starbucks policy being ignored. Told the manager and she said they just ignore her.  When I suggested not serving them she just stared at me.  My clothes smelled like smoke all day. Gizi is wonderful there, and the only only reason I plan to give it another shot.  But not for a while.  I'll go to the Target Starbucks in the same mall for a while.  Addendum:   January 17, 9AM. Still smoking.  Worse than ever.   Dang.

I have purchased cake pops frozen from numerous Starbucks preferring the cold texture to warm cake pops. I have done this for years. At this Starbucks I'm told by Taylor that it would be a "health code violation" to sell it to me unless it had been thawed for 3 hours. How does this make sense? It seems to me that my health is more at risk from food sitting out unrefrigerated.  Snotty, pedantic and nonsensical.  Skip this Starbucks and go to one that cares about pleasing their customers
Nice place with nice environment. I like my Starbucks once in a while. This is a good place to get mine since it's right by my church.

Multiple visits over the past few months.  Service has been polite but extraordinarily slow.  Beverage quality is consistent with other Starbucks locations but turn around on orders needs to be greatly improved.  Not the best place to stop when in a rush.

This is a great Starbucks to visit. They have a beautiful patio to enjoy the spring weather. It's typically busy but the wait is never bad. Watch out for annoying bicyclist that take over on Friday Saturday and Sunday mornings. Make sure to bring a photo of your dog to post on the community board.

This has been my staple place for Starbucks for the passed three years! They always get my order right and once I lost my debit card while in the drive through and the cashier still gave me my coffee! Talk about pay it forward. It's always clean and kept nice. The drive thru does get a little backed up in the morning! But it's worth it! I love this place!
The drinks are awesome and well done! Only complaint is that alot of college kids go there so theres never anywhere to sit!
This is the worst Starbucks. So slow, unmotivated and unfriendly and they don't make very good coffee either.
I am currently in the drive thru and there are super slow. And it's before 4:00 on a Monday. I will not be coming again!

I still like this location but it is a licensed Starbucks so I can earn points here but cant redeem my points or any offers at this location.  I was told a few weeks that was supposed to change but it still hasn't.  

I will update my review when it does.

Absolutely horrible experience, do yourself a favor and hit up the sunoco for your coffee. I get this is a road stop, but still as a chain you expect some sort of level of service, quality of product, consistency, appropriate level to fill a cup, etc. Don't hold your breath, not here. 

Had the pleasure of going through the drive thru. No one was in it so not high demand. Ordered a grande decaf, a grande darkest roast you have black, then a THIRD drink a Christmas roast with three pumps of pumpkin. Apparently there was some confusion as we were asked wait is that two or three drinks? Appreciated being asked as to clarify a correct order. We started THREE and went through all three again. 

Pulled up paid got the decaf and Christmas roast. Then the employee sat there. We let her know we were missing a drink, to which she proceeded to tell us we weren't which was interesting as not only did we order three drinks but we were ASKED how many and did the whole dance again. She then told us no you said two, well uh no we didn't, but are you going to argue with me. You didn't pay for it she said the amount and shut the door. We sat holding a 5 with coffee sitting there to pay. When the window opened explained we have to pay, great we have been waiting to do so. The cherry on top was the mystery third coffee was filled so high that there was no way to have it handed to build without it spilling and burning me. Which is perfect as I'll make sure to get some pictures as it blisters over and to contact corporate.
High turnover, poor training, bad management, SLOWEST Starbucks on the planet. I will be going elsewhere for my coffee.

Always a smiling crew awaiting you in your morning jaunt for caffeine. I usually grab a venti frappechino or chai tea and everyone is fast and friendly. Nice to just sit and reflect a bit before starting the grind. It seems in today's go faster faster faster mindset, you never really get a chance to slow the fair ride down and just absorb your surroundings in a bit, or Take a second to sigh, just slow down a second.

Piper says thanks for the puppucinno.
Always great service, and nice crew.
Only downside is the tight parking lot.

Another horrible corporate policy! What rocket surgeon thinks this stuff up.
I ordered and received 2 Americanos which were, you know, the same as always. Pretty good, not special. I paid with a gift card, no problem so far. 
Now I want to tip but only have 20's so when the girl brings my coffees I asked her to break my 20 so I can tip. Afraid not...you see they cannot open the register unless I buy something. So again short sighted corporate policy screws hard working hourly worker. Brilliant!

This is your typical Starbucks store. However the staff is very friendly. When the store is busy expect to wait a bit longer for your drink. This store is located within a shopping mall so it's busier than some normal stores.

Consistently receive terse and curt treatment, especially by Jenny. The sultry attitudes here are better suited for a dive bar. Most Starbucks around Nashville attract quality employees by it is impossible to relax at this one after receiving negative treatment on several occasions in a row.

Open at 5 during the weekdays and 5:30 on the weekends.  Closes at 8 pm.  There are plenty of couch seats for reading or chatting and not that many tables if you have work.  Their merchandise selection is large.  

Everything is very attentive here but very leisurely.  People order leisurely, people clear tables leisurely, etc.  The employees always adjust the blinds depending on the type of day and are always checking stock and cleaning.

I love driving up Hacienda del Sol, looking at the houses, and enjoying the 45 mph drive back down Swan.  Love looking at the Foothills too.

IT is your average Bucks. No drive thru so they will be moving a couple of blocks away to a larger, brand new (including a drive thru) store. This one is at max capacity and the line was practically out the door when we arrived. Private parking lot. Cleanish interior. Bathroom was broken so the men was transformed into men/women. (Another reason it is good they are moving to a new store.) Staff here are very friendly. They get people through as fast as they can. There is a wonderful patio to the side of this store. Shaded in the afternoon so it is a nice place to take an afternoon cat nap with your beverage of choice.

3 stars because the service here is dismal at best. I've been to this location more than 10 times because 8th very close to my apartment but if I have the time I head west 6 blocks to the next closest location.  
No matter what you order or how many people are in front of you you will wait at least 5 minutes for a very simple drink (ie black coffee) and if it's busy I've waited up to 15 minutes. Normally I'd walk out but when I'm craving iced coffee magic the more hip local establishments fail miserably every time. 
The only saving grace to this location is the upstairs area, which is bright, with a good view of South St for people wqtching, and has a lot of seating and tables to read relax or do work.
Staff is friendly. Even though the line is long, it always goes fast. These baristas are working hard!! Can't wait for the drive thru store to open up in this same plaza! :)

Very disappointed with this location. I get a large ice water with mactcha scoops. It's always been 87 cents. I've paid for green tea latte and frappe. Price is not the issue. Today it came up to almost 3 bucks. She said its tea and "labor" involved. Ice, water, powder seriously? I can see it it was hot brewed then poured over ice. It's still got chunks of powder in it. For that price it better be clump free. Difference was put back on my card but left a bad taste nonetheless.

I got a frappachino- which I always get. After about 10 minutes of the girl chatting with her coworker, she finally started to make my drink. (the place was empty) within 30 minutes I got sick after drinking it. I realized after being in bed for 5 days unable to even keep down water, that I was suffering from food poisoning. I'm assuming that since I have had the same drink from here a few other times, that it must be due to the lack of cleanliness of this place. Do not go here! Unless you want to risk getting poisoned.
Clean bathrooms, good location, free wi-fi, can't ask for more.
Starbucks are everywhere but the staff at this location makes you feel like you are in a locally owned coffee shop.  Tyler always remembers my name and makes sure my drink is perfect. Great staff!
Went for a Venti javachip on my lunch break, around 12:45pm on a Monday. There was a long line, slow service and they got my order wrong. Boo!

Pretty cool Starbucks, gets a little busy but I just always use the app and get my drinks fairly quickly. The baristas are cool and pretty productive so I'm always pleased with my service. Drinks are pretty high quality compared to some of the starbucks that I have been to in my day.

As a rule I don't participate in political discussions, being the subject of many of them. I'm not only a man of the sea (overfishing, whaling etc) but also a dreamer (standard flying dreams/night terrors). But when I heard about Starbucks' facial bias training I had to join in the discussion. I had always felt discriminated against because of my unique face shape and makeup. I am an avid hobbier (one who hobbies) and one of my favorite hobbies is dressing as a mime (one who mimes). And if it wasn't bad enough that there is this underlying assumption that I will put on a show for people (just because I'm dressed as a mime) I received very rude looks from a barista at Starbucks because I told her she looked like Oprah (the wrinkle in time version)! And I couldn't help but wonder if it was because of my homemade mime makeup. For those who live on a budget spur cream can be an economical alternative to face paint. In any case this facial bias was out of control. But after the training I could really tell a difference. I'm just glad this Starbucks got their act together! And the young man at the front counter was having a glorious time pouring Caramel sauce on his arms over and over again. It was a bit odd. But hey I'm down to clown.

This location reeks of poorly trained and new baristas. I came for an afternoon coffee and ordered my usual (blonde roast with soy). The barista said she had none and did not offer to do a pour over, instead, she asked if I wanted the dark or medium roasts. I asked her to do a pour over and another barista chimed in and asked if I wanted the clover made blonde roast. Of course --- they asked me that because it was easier and actually costs more on the machine. I have had other locations use the clover machine for the price of a pour over. 

Throughly not impressed with this crew.

As with every other shop in this Travel Center it was packed and very hard to get around when I finally got to the counter she tried her very best to get my order to as quick as possible , but it was still too much of a hassle.

Wanted to give them a chance to redeem themselves from my last experience and they failed yet again. I hold Starbucks to a higher standard they charge enough to at least hire individuals who are willing to do their job to the best of their ability

I love Starbucks coffee.  It's a chain, but it tastes good and it's available at the grocery store so I don't have to go buy it every morning.  Pike Place Roast is my favorite and the Anniversary Roast is good too!  I have never had a customer service issue, but I'm sure things happen.  I like the variety of pastries and cookies.  I try to avoid those, but there are days a girl needs a blueberry muffin or some pumpkin bread both of which are good here.  

You can get your coffee fresh ground and they ask what kind of filter you use.  I think that is cool!  Fresh coffee at home...it doesn't get better than that.  I like to start my mornings off right.

Absolutely the slowest service ever!
I was second in line and it took them 15 minutes to get me a grande nonfat latte.
The store was completely empty besides me and the person in front of me.The store manager just watched while her employees were doing nothing

This starbucks is great! Not only is it next to one of my friends Chinese Restaraunt, but it is a great place to do homework. I love the soft, sink in sofa that could have you instantly out cold! It is also a great place with a great scenery if you wanted to look over the city since it is high in elevations going up towards the mountain. 

The coffee here is also amazing, haven't had a bad order yet! I will continue to come here to knock out my homework and enjoy some fantastic coffee!

Coming from San Francisco, wasn't sure how the service and coffee will be in Tampa.  I was shocked of the professional, friendly, pleasant, FAST, accurate employees.  I am planning to move to Tampa after living in SF for 40 years and this place will be my primary coffee hang-out.  My hats off to the Manager and employees of this spot.

Noushi Barmaki
San Francisco, CA

This is an average Starbucks near the entrance to Terminal A and the baggage claim area. 

I have been a couple times while waiting on delayed luggage. My order has always been correct so no complaints there. There are a few nice chairs to lounge in while burning time.

Peter has the worst attitude- no sense of customer service. He's extremely slow and working the drive thru like wth?? He is condescending and our wait was in excess of 20 minutes! Do not go here if you're in a rush or like customer service.

Okay, so they renovated. Now they have The Most Uncomfortable Seating Ever. Plus, too many tables and chairs makes navigating the room impossible. Going to look for a new Starbucks. What a shame!  All the renovation accomplished was making it less comfortable for the regulars. What's the point?  Trying to attract the 20-somethings? Well, guess what? They're all at work. Want to keep (or get back) your regular customers? Bring back the lounge chairs and reduce the number of bar stools.

Nice, clean location.  Have been here 2 times and the service has always been great, and my coffee beverage made well.   Tried the new Casacara latte which was good!  This is not a large place, on the smaller size, but is nice inside and good service.

I've been spoiled by other Starbucks locations that I visit and was really hoping this one would redeem itself in time.  I've been to this location quite a few times since moving to the area a few months ago and every time it seems like they are out of items or unorganized despite what a high volume location it is.  It could be a busy morning or slow early afternoon and the drive through line is always backed up waiting for the order takers to do their things and get the orders out.  

The inside ordering process is no different.  Every time I go in something is always out of stock as well, which you would think wouldn't happen if they know they are such a high traffic location.  I've relegated myself to just go to the Publix in the same plaza to get my Starbucks order fulfilled as they are fast, efficient, and friendly inside that location.  They can also get you in and out quicker than the stand alone store.

It's a starbucks.
Not a lot to say.
Handy location.
Got a nice warm drink after a full meal.
Very contented.

Staff is friendly and drinks are on point. I go here daily. Don't hate cause it's not a "local" aka "snobby" coffee shop. Smyrna and La Vergne have very few options. So just go here and embrace some damn good coffee. They won't disappoint, I promise you. And if they do, just complain and you'll get your drink made right and a coupon for a free one. Tell me the last time Fido or Bongo did THAT.

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. Despite my daily SBUX habit, the fact that the Fifth Street location is nearest to both my home and my daily commute, and the fact that the tax rate in Saint Charles is less than any of the other locations I go near (thus decreasing my total beverage cost by at least a dime), I still refuse to go back.

This location goes through so much turnover and it shows. I drink the same beverage every day and ordered it over 60 times from this specific location in 2015 and have not received it right the first time around once (this is not an exaggeration; I just counted the number of purchases I made there this year and quit counting at 61). Frequently, I have not even been given the correct beverage the second time around. 

The worst part of their service, of which there are many bad parts, is not the long waits, the scary drive through/ parking situation, or the apathy of their employees. The worst thing about this Starbucks is that I have never been apologized to when they make a mistake.

The last and final time I will ever go there was when they gave me the wrong beverage THREE times in a row, didn't apologize, didn't acknowledge that they had done anything wrong, tried to make me feel bad about ordering a drink that had alterations to the standard (I wanted soy in my tea latte), and when I finally just asked for my money back, the manager had to think about it. 

My advice: find ANY other coffee/tea shop.

I am giving this Starbucks 5 stars, simply because of the employees.There are currently only 2 employees at this location. Not a problem if we were in the middle of Nebraska . This is the St. Louis airport location. I have been waiting for 13 minutes in a very long line and there are still people in front of me. All that said, these are the 2 MOST PATIENT and POLITE Starbucks employees that I have ever run across-anywhere. They have to take the order and make the drink. They are more efficient than most Starbucks employees who seem to like to wipe stuff down all the time , even when there is s long line. Their names are Alicia and Jamar. I finally made it to the counter and there are now 2 more employees.Jamar has to be the most polite kid on the planet.

This is a new drive-thru Starbucks. So far, while a "cozy" location, it does have a good amount of seating for its size. There's outdoor, patio seating as well as bar, table and chair, comfy chairs, and a long rectangular table with seating. The staff is friendly and they made my drink well. I'm always glad to see the opening of a new Starbucks and I bet it'll be a well-used location in no time.

Rude. Just rude. The lady at the counter on the inside was unnecessarily rude. I believe her name was Anna. It was dirty on the inside and any available tables were not wiped off at all. The drinks were fine, pretty standard for Starbucks, nothing phenomenal. I won't be going back due to the terrible service.

Horrible experience . I went in at 1030pm and there were not many people at this location but they had to have had 10 people working. They were not well trained and very unprofessional. The young lady who made my drink had an attitude and called out drinks in the wrong order.... Only go during the day.

I frequent this Starbucks for their drive thru window. Their service is average and the coffee is usually typical of other Starbucks locations. The drive thru does not move as quickly as others that is why they are getting 4 stars instead of 5.

Ashley was really rude to my family. We were trying to be polite and we asked for a reward and she immediately snapped back at us. We were given the wrong drinks- they were not even prepared well. They were chunky and not mixed at all. I usually love Starbucks and I love the service but this was mind blowing and totally ruined Starbucks for me. I am appalled by the service and the lack of any kindness that I found at any previous Starbucks. 
We also asked for no straws and they were thrown into our car. We felt unwelcome and felt like we had to leave immediately.

I work near this Starbucks and come often for coffee and drinks during lunch. I wish yelp allowed me to give three and a half stars because that is what I would award this Starbucks. Usually they're pretty good and pretty quick but they are a little pricier than other locations because (I believe) it is in a nicer area of town, Galena. I have never had a problem with customer service but today my drink was a little sloppy. I asked for whipped cream and maybe got half of it with some on the side. 

Like I said, usually they're really pretty good but I'm awarding three stars because of price and lack of attention to detail. Additionally the drive thru is a little hard to get in to. 

Also I have noticed a huge difference on prices of sandwiches and flatbreads. A pretty penny! The place is kept super clean and I love stopping in to sit down and get out of the office for a little while. Overall great service and quality was just a little hiccup today!
In my opinion... the best starbucks in The boise area!  Always friendly and welcoming!
A lot of seating...Cool upstairs spot for studying, internet-ing, or South Street people watching from the second floor. I can sit here for days...if I can find parking. haha

Yes. It's a Starbucks and as such, you have a certain degree of certainty in your experience, whether you like it or not. So, going to Starbucks is a lot less about the coffee than about the location of the store. Each store's location has it's own flavor and flair, and this Starbucks continues that tradition. I think the highlight of this location is the outdoor seating (obviously, when it's nice outside!). In the middle of a ton of traffic on Clayton Rd, this place somehow cultivates the sense of being set away. The interior is large and good for studying (lots of plugs).

To reply to Peter B's review, I was able to redeem offers at this location yesterday, so I guess it's changed from a licensed Starbucks to a regular Starbucks! Yay!

Horrible service staff does not know what is in the case and the sales. Worst store ever. It used to be a great experience please bring back your old staff. Who needs rude people serving 5 dollar  cups of coffee? Come on!!

Love that they added this new drive through Starbucks. Instead of having to park, unload tge kids and walk inside, we gas up our car, and pick up some coffee ^_^

We take road trips to to Jerz & NYC regularly, so definitely a good addition. Also a plus to be  able to see our server/cashier while ordering at the menu. That's something I haven't seen around. Ordered caramel frappe with whip cream & the new cinnamon almond macchiato~ Both were delish :D

Solid Starbucks.  

Staff is a bit rough but that's what you get taking 'only STL city residents' to work in a fancy coffee shop.

"Ok... This is a latte..."

Yeah.

I love this place! I love Starbucks in general. There really isn't much to say about it. My order is always right, the staff is very nice and quick. Even in the mornings, they are spot on and always smiling. The Store itself is very clean and well kept. It is a great spot to get a cup, and chill.

EDIT: one summer later... was always able to get my BECs (thanks for stocking), and with far fewer sweetened iced coffees this year. But the wait here is still hit or miss even when it's not busy.

Unfortunately this is the closest Starbucks to my office. But the service always seems to be slower when there's no line, last summer half of my unsweetened iced coffee were served to me with sweetener, I sometimes get grandes when I ordered ventis. And the most infuriating thing is that they hide the green plastic top stoppers away from the rest of the creamers and sweeteners and stirrers. (You know if people could see he green sticks and knew to use them as stirrers and stoppers you'd save money on stirrers, right?)

But the last straw was today, when once again they ran out of bacon, egg, and Gouda sandwiches before 11am. This happened often enough before they started this $5 special, but now that they can't seem to figure out how to order enough product to keep up with the demand they have encouraged, I can never get the one item I always used to go there to get.

This Starbucks never fails to disappoint me.
This location takes forever to make my uncomplicated drinks and also does not taste up to par with drinks I've had at other locations.
The unnecessary wait time at this Starbucks undermines the excellent service normally provided at other locations.

They were understaffed and overwhelmed.
They handled it as well as they could.
My drink was alright. A little water-down tasting. But I was just glad for a cold beverage on a hot day and some free wifi.

This review is sad to post because I love coffee and Starbucks. But this particular Starbucks is just not the same as it used to be. I've been going there since it was built in Smyrna. The baristas were always awesome, the drinks amazing, customer service great, and the seating and atmosphere perfect. 
BUT.
This is no longer true. Because I went to Starbucks so much, I basically knew each baristas schedule. And the awesome ones? Probably moved on to better things. I personally feel as if this Smyrna Starbucks just hired the first ten applicants or something and trained them in a half a day. It's a whole different experience now. I haven't had a good drink (and I've tried many items off the menu to see if maybe my tastebuds had changed or something) from them in months. They've also redecorated and now have a huge conference table and tables that are really close together. The atmosphere is just...off. 
I've been to lots of Starbucks around Middle Tennessee and Smyrna is just not in the top pack anymore. I'm not sure how others would feel if they've never been to this particular Starbucks, but because I'm a frequent, I can immediately tell the difference. It's disappointing and I probably won't go back anytime soon.

I've been to many a Starbucks in my time, so I have quite a bit to compare a visit to.

The service in here was great, a tad slow, but okay nonetheless. 

The issue I had with this trip was my visit to the bathroom. After I got my key from one of the baristas, I opened the door to see the nastiest bathroom. There was toliet paper all over the floor, the trash can was overflowing, and the whole place had an air of dirtiness.

I felt like I needed to sanitize my skin after using that bathroom. Gross!

I love Starbucks! I've been a fan since the chain started popping up in Indianapolis. This location is small and cozy. The staff is always friendly and fast. If you're new to Starbucks or want to try something new, I recommend the Green Tea Frappuccino, Mocha Frappuccino, or Pink Drink. For food I would recommend the Chicken Caprese or Chicken & Double Smoked Bacon for lunch. Then the Chicken Sausage & Bacon Biscuit, Sausage Cheddar & Egg Breakfast Sandwich, or Classic Oatmeal for breakfast.

I love this location! The staff are always so welcoming, they are always nice and they are all funny- I enjoy both the drive thru and coming in.
I have actually called the manager and compliment him on such great team at his location.
Thanks again! :)
Oh the barista working the drive thru today was super cute too !

The location is clean. The staff is friendly. My drink has never been made incorrectly. There's a drive thru--but the wait is usually much shorter inside. Speaking of the inside, that is my only problem with this place. It echoes tremendously. When the metal chairs grind against the concrete floor, it's awful!

I love all Starbucks stores. 
My visit was fast and friendly. My ice coffee was delightful.
Thank you for excellent customer experience ' I will return!
Gloria~
I never give reviews but can't pass this one. 35 mins for a frappachino.. cz apparently they r making whip cream!!
Love Starbucks, and I'm loving it extra lately so I was very disappointed to learn this location doesn't work with the mobile app order ahead service :(

I'm not a fan of Starbucks over all, except their Molasses cookies, which I can't find anywhere else. But, like Tart said, Nicole Kidman and Keith Urban, are. I've seen them both at this location as well as Bryan White and Ben Folds. And, if you're a studier, they do have a great back room with plenty of space that isn't really occupied.

Overall, good for celeb spotting and gaining some knowledge.

Great location for studying on campus. It has a relatively small "Starbucks" serving area but tons of space for studying, catching up with folks, and enjoying their fireplace (ok it's gas but whatever).
This is the fastest/friendliest Starbucks i have ever been to! The staff always has a smile on their face and they look like they love their job! My new favorite Starbucks!

My past 4 visits here have been awful. I usually get iced coffee or cold brew. They are usually out of cold brew but the one time they had it they didn't cut it. So I got a venti cup of cold brew concentrate (maybe that's why they are always out). Luckily I was on my way home so I was able to cut it in half at home. The iced coffee always tastes burned. The good thing is the baristas are friendly. The food has tasted good. 
I'm going to be visiting Panera for my coffee fix from now on!
I am in here everyday. I like relaxing. I am tired of swatting  gnats. The place is infested with them. Swarming around my face. Crazy!

Slowest drive thru ever. Try to park to go inside and it's chaos getting in and out of a parking space due to the drive thru line. Inside service is not any faster. I never found Starbucks coffee or food especially worth the wait.
If you can avoid this Starbucks I would do so. It's always on the dirtier side- spilled sugar packets, dirty barista counters, etc and it takes forever to get your drinks.. Pretty awful!!

UGH!!  Just ate (breakfast?) at this particular place. I asked to order the sausage sandwich with chicken sausage instead of pork and the clerk looked down her barista nose at me and said she could not possibly do that unless I purchased two sandwiches. WELL.   I discovered why, the sandwiches are pre-made and they just nuke them. I got a mocha ( which is what they are know for right?). Double UGH. She must have been pissed at me for asking for a substitution and stuck her bitter finger in it to stir it because I have never had such a bitter cup of coffee in my life. I've been to Starbucks before....I even went to Starbucks in Seattle, so I know what it's suppose to taste like and baby that ain't it!

The staff at this location are always sweet and quick. I've spent hours studying, chairing with friends, and grabbing a coffee to go and every time I'm pleasantly surprised by the customer service. On days they mess something up, they quickly and apologetically apologize for it. The milk and creamer at the front is a little odd, but works ok with the space. I recommend relaxing the patio and people watching in the afternoon.
Best Starbucks ever!! they treat us so good over there. Super fast and great service. i go past 2 other starbucks on the way to work and end up there instead of going to the others.

Hello. It's Starbucks. What else do you need to know?

This one does have more space than the average and a nice outdoor seating patio. 

Otherwise, order your normal caramel nowhip crapuccino and enjoy!
Arguably the worst Starbucks I have ever visited. Unfriendly baristas, very slow service, and dirty throughout. Do not recommend.

The same great Starbucks products as any location, but this one comes with a horrible experience. The seating area is usually in disarray, the condiment bar is almost always dirty and the trash is overflowing.

I keep giving this place a shot bc it is on the way to my work...I don't know why, but each time I get a caramel macchiato or a green tea latte here it tastes like I paid $5 for a grande iced milk. Super disappointing considering this would be so convenient for me. 

The staff is always great, but I would hate to be that customer to complain about my drink esp when I am in a rush in the morning with limited time and the store is busy. Would just like if my drinks were consistent each time I get them.

I came here to use their wifi to send important work emails. Their wifi doesn't work. Told the cashier, he basically said it wasn't his problem. My drink comes up to the bar (even though I don't even want it anymore since their wifi is down) and I'm on the phone and they keep telling me my drink is ready repeatedly non-stop, in my ear. This is an important phone call and I have rude and sarcastic Starbucks baristas yelling at me that my drink is ready. I will never come into a Starbucks ever again.

I stopped into this Starbucks quite by accident while traveling for the holidays. It appears to be quite new, very clean and quite busy, even on Thanksgiving day, as were the nearby Target and other businesses. The service was also quite good.

Stopped in later in the night. The service was fast and the people were very friendly. I didn't spend too much time in the place, and wouldn't typically write a review without more details; however, I got great service and wanted to boast about it.

My review (4 out of 5 stars) is based solely on the customer service I experienced.

The drinks were typical Starbucks fashion, nothing great or different.

Horrible service--was completely ignored when I tried to place my order while the cashier browsed her phone. Then was ignored a second time asking a question while the baristas were engaged in conversation. Generally, they gave the impression that they didn't want to be there.

This is one of the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. They are constantly out of multiple food and drink items at a time, and service is very slow and often poorly executed. I have received many specialty drinks from here that simply weren't made properly. The inside atmosphere is cramped and not good for sitting around, so definitely get your drinks to go.

Really big communal  table is great. 
A good selection of small tables, comfortable for studying and meetings. 
Seems to have a lot of regulars, shoppers, and students. 
Outside seating too. 
Employees have always been pleasant here. 

As all Starbucks go, really good coffee and treat selection. Love the organic soy milk hot chocolates. SO GOOD!

Prices are jacked up from Starbucks off campus. I stood in line this year and previous years for over 20 minutes only to be turned down when I finally reached the counter. They randomly would not accept my school ID's flex or RamBucks dollars when I happened to not have my Debit Card on me, and would fail to post this at the door before hand. When many people such as myself would also go through the same thing, then they would finally post a sign on the door. There's one lady that works there that seems to be the manager tends to be in a bad mood, and made me feel really uncomfortable as a customer through her negative mannerisms. She also over charged me because she guessed the price of something to get more money. One of the employees asked her a price and she looked up in the sky and said.. "ummm.. $6.95?" and priced it as such. Awful awful customer service from the manager. Everyone else is very friendly. I'm sick of her attitude toward customers. I hear it from other people too. She better shape up her attitude. We all hate it. (This rating would be significantly higher if it wasn't for her).

This is a Starbucks. The Starbucks chain is ubiquitous and by now this is probably my 4th Starbucks review. However, I want to review this one because the staff here was super nice and helpful. 

We dropped by this Starbucks to get the "we are here" mugs, which they sold out recently, but the barista went to the back to check if they had any mugs. Unfortunately, they ran out of the mugs, but had the new Delaware tumblers, which we got. During that time as she was checking the back and cutting open a sealed box for the tumbler, I noticed they had a limited zombie flavor - for Halloween. When I ordered it, the barista was cheery and while she was making it, she kept talking to us about where we were from and what we were doing in Delaware. She also wanted to make the drink as perfect as possible for photos. 

She was by far the most helpful and nicest barista working at Starbucks that I have ever met. Because of that, I wanted to recommend this location.
Coffee is typical Starbucks but the staff was terrible. Took forever to get my coffee because they were chatting and doing other things. I was the only one there.

This is my favorite Starbucks in the entire world. The staff at this location have been amazing and friendly every single time I've been there. Back when I was an every morning visitor, Ashley always knew who I was and what my order was just by hearing my voice in the drive through. A few of the other baristas knew it as well although I was never able to catch all of their names which is unfortunate because they all deserve a shout out too!! Thank you guys for being the best!!

Awesome staff. Always friendly. Rember names and drink pref. 
 As with most Starbucks consistent quality and if not right they will make it right. Atmosphere is great lost of parking and seating. My fav coffee house in Reno

City Line Ave, Phila border
Located near Target ;) & a few tempting eateries in this short strip. Okay Starbucks with a outdoorsy sitting area. Parking? don't know, I was at Crown Plaza for a conference when I found this place. Giant busy Target parking lot right behind. Be creative.  Server never even told me my DECAFF was ready. But the pro is the coffee was not too sweet. I like when I can drink it as is. I hear it is college student central, and I like that -being surrounded by a bunch of St. Josephs and PCOM smarty pants. ;-P
