This Starbucks was packed at 7 pm on a Saturday night. I didn't really think that folks drank coffee that late, but I'm pretty sure everyone else was there for the same reason I was - to get coffee to stay awake during a movie I was about to see just a quarter mile down the road.

Even though it was packed, the ladies that were working were in good spirits and our drinks were made to perfection.

Would return.

Save your time and money-go elsewhere. 

Bad parking, locked entry doors, untrained rude staff, more expensive than a regular Starbucks and does not accept app rewards. 

There were six employees stuffed into a tiny kiosk struggling to serve FOUR customers. My husband and I repeated our order a couple of times to a genuinely confused cashier. She had no idea how to put the order in the computer and didn't ask for help or offer a solution. And we don't order fancy drinks, it was two coffees in two different sizes. We actually had to leave without getting our coffee cuz they couldn't get it together. 

It's a coffee stand with a Starbucks sign but NOTHING like a normal Starbucks experience.

I love how cheerful the employees are, how they make their caramel macchiatos, and the fact that it's only 4 minutes walking distance from my work! But what I don't like is sitting 27 MINUTES in the drive through. They have plenty of employees but after the third time of making me late for work, I'm really done with this location. They need to send someone down from Corporate to straighten them out and get them moving! The parking lot is a mess and the drive through line is a nightmare. Inside is nicely designed, and I love the patio area. But if they only would step on it and get their act together!!!

At The Starbucks on 4th and South streets, the BARISTAS are a great group of people. They have to deal with so many different types of people(some of whom are very rowdy) and the baristas are always nice. The company has spent so much wasted money on putting locks on the doors that require combinations. The money would have been better spent  for  the baristas' pay. No one is refused entry to the bathroom. That's humane. So, why the locks? There is one thing that I do not like is that this is the busiest STARBUCKS for bathroom needs(especially people who are not customers). Each other starbucks has TWO bathrooms. This one, one of the busiest, opens only ONE of the two that exist in the café. Opening the upstairs bathroom would facilitate the use by the real customers who have made purchases.

It's hit or miss on everything. At times your drink is perfect, sometimes it is half full or they didn't mix it right or something (Hit or miss).
Sometimes they run out of straws or run out of cups or run out of sugar. (hit or miss)

Friendly staff, good group meeting spaces, limited parking.
The Starbucks landscape and design group did a fantastic job with this location. Not only do they offer a lovely outdoor patio which wraps around the front and side of the building with a few shade trees, they also designed in a drive through! 
A great spot for many different types of coffee drinkers!

Why is it always so cold in here? You honestly need a sweater or jacket if you plan to sit and work, from this location, for any period of time. I have not noticed this at other locations and I don't tend to be one of those perpetually cold people. The baristas are friendly and the coffee is usually pretty good, it's not as good as say Kahwa or Buddy Brew, but it is consistent and better than most options around here. This location is on the smaller side compared to the locations by USF and Wiregrass. An expansion of the store and upgrade of the heating and cooling system is in store? Currently 49 degrees outside and it may be 60 inside.

SLOWEST Starbucks I've ever been to! And I visit at least one daily, no matter where I am.
The wait was ridiculous every time we went, regardless of if there were only three other people in there. Went to this one more than I checked in, and never waited less than 20 minutes. With pretty much no other customers. 
This one was closest on the drive back to our condo after a days excursion, so we still went there, but I would have chosen another if it would have been an option. 
Probably won't be back for the wait alone.

This Starbucks smell like rotten milk it is unbearable. I don't know how people hang out in there. Not only does the store smell awful but the cups & lids smell as well. The customer service is terrible. Seems like everyone hates their job here. I will avoid stopping here.

I ordered a grande cold brew iced coffee black and waited almost 10min for it. There was no line so it wasn't that busy. That was the longest Ive ever waited for a drink at a Starbucks. Hope its not like that all the time.
25 min. For one cup of black coffee..... They did not know how to use the coffee maker?

Love this Starbucks. Excellent customer service. Lawson is the manager and has such an awesome staff. I come here on a daily basis because of the atmosphere and awesome customer service I get. They have plenty of seating both inside and out. I come here to drink my coffee and relax. Love this place.

The two times I have visited I have been pleased with the rapid service here at this SB location. The staff are always super efficient and friendly while completing your order, and I have not had any issues with the quality of the beverages we have ordered. This SB gets my approval!!!!!

I love Starbucks coffee, don't get me wrong. But this place has a terrible attitude. One night I was here, in the corner, so I guess they didn't realize I was still there, but, they were bad mouthing practically every customer who came in. Not to mention they aren't driven to provide fast service, seems like every time I came in it took a ridiculous amount of time to get my beverage. Very bizarre but I do not have a desire to support unprofessional businesses.
Very nice Starbucks with hassle-free wifi access. The outside decor is lovely, but the inside is pretty cookie-cutter. The baristas have personality and a sense of humor, which I always appreciate!
Typical Starbucks ... ya know, they have coffee and snacks. Expect to wait in line. This location is on a college campus and thus serves an audience with a very specific need and thirst for caffeine.

The service here is always wonderful and the baristas are very friendly. Great location, however sometimes the drive-through can be a bit slow. I really like their breakfast sandwiches, especially the egg-white, spinach and feta wrap.  The Cinnamon Dolci Latte is my fave drink.
This my favorite Starbucks on campus! The only Starbucks that closes at midnight which is great for coffee addicts like me.

Rude server. We are large group of people
And the server was rude. Didn't appreciate her service. Never coming back at this place.

This is my favorite Starbucks around Butler University's campus radius. The baristas are always so friendly and are great at making suggestions. The line typically isn't long and they accept online orders so your stuff is ready when you get there. Great neighborhood Starbucks.
If it's raining, don't bother. There's no awning to order, or one at the window that can cover the vehicle outside of it. I'm headed to work soaking wet and my car needs a wet vac.
Every time I'm here it's busy. It's a small kinda awkward layout. I wish the staff would be more prepared because it's ALWAYS BUSY!

Ordered $15 worth of coffee. Yes... Can you believe this place charges more than a Starbucks in Times Square New York City??? WHat the what??  A grande Cafe Latte normally is 3.85 in Times Square this place is 4.20???? Is this place really 35 cents better??? really???  To top it off, there was no half and half. Who the heck keeps watch on supplies?  I bring the 2 empty half and half canisters to the counter and tell the staff and the barista. This barista (dark skinny guy) just totally ignored me, like refilling half and half is beneath him. I'm standing there with these empty canisters for literally 10 minutes. I asked again only for him to act like he didn't hear me. I have a loud voice. People across the hall heard me. 

The good thing was, the cashier that took my order saw that I was waiting. She came over to ask me what's up and then got my a bottle of half and half FROM THE BARISTA'S STATION!!!!  

Anyways, she was cute too. 

But how dare that barista!!??!!??

So because of the long wait, my coffee got cold and the half and half made it colder. On top of that the coffee was not as good as a normal Starbucks. Boooo barista. Attitude sucked. And his coffee sucked. 

Very disappointing all around. Except for the cute cashier who was helpful.

I love this location big lots of great seating inside and out but it is so slow!!! I can always count on it being at least 15 minutes every time I walk in the door . In the morning drive this is never good . Quicker and more help would do the trick ..
We came in late Tuesday night and the place was empty. The workers were nice and our drinks came out like they're supposed to.

the worst starbucks i've been to.  it was great to have a location in the airport to stop in after a 6 am flight but i should have kept walking vs going in.  there wasn't a wait but i did have to wait for the baristas to finish their conversation before i could order.  there were 5 of them but no one took my order for a couple minutes!  again, should have kept walking vs going in.  i ordered a decaf cafe mocha but i didn't get it.  the baristas said it was decaf but of course it wasn't.  won't be back!
Is a good location, can get slow and some times they don't pay attention to details of orders!

I wasn't going to write a review but this has happened a couple of times already.  By and large, the baristas here are really nice.  They always have my order ready and they are just generally great people.  But there is one European dude who is not nice at all.  And when he is working, my online order doesn't get filled and he is really indignant about it. I mean, I don't expect technology to be 100%, but when I tell you I ordered online and you scream "NO!"  like I'm lying, that is offensive.  Especially since I order here damn near everyday.

I still give the place 4 stars because it's overall great.  I live down the street so I can't comment on the bathroom, that seems to be a major theme here.

Ummm can't really expect much from airport Starbucks but some will surprise you. I think Hawaii and cancun annnnd Seattle have done a number on me so I'm so picky now lol. Got ice green tea latte, no need for syrup or extras but I do ask for light ice and some that notice that will add extra matcha but.... Not here. It seemed like I was being a bother when I mentioned the little things I didn't want and want, coconut milk, light ice and no syrup. ( the look was priceless with light ice) I have a venti cup of iced green tea coconut milk flavored latte. I will definitely drink it and just note not to come to this location unless I want a basic all the bells and whistles drink young kids get. 
Something told me to get a grande just in case but I have a 3 hr flight.

Probably the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. Went 2 days in a row, walked inside because j thought It would be quicker.  Waited atleast 10 min at the counter for someone to come to take my order. I was the first in line. And then another 15 min for my Drink. Seems the drive thru was more important. I only ordered1 drink

Well it's pretty crappy to come here if you want to sit and enjoy your drink. There are people sitting everywhere using the wifi and they aren't even customers. They just plop down and go on their computers. Meanwhile paying customers can't sit anywhere. Starbucks needs to crack down on that.
The workers at this Starbucks are so rude . Never seen such a bunch of unhappy people. They mess up the order and then give you an attitude.

This is a great Starbucks! The staff is very friendly and the location is great for getting work done. My old high school was very close to this location and I would often times come over here to get work done. I've recently discovered the java chip frap with 4 pumps of peppermint syrup! So good! The crunchiness of the chocolate chips and ice with the cooling peppermint is awesome! My new favorite thing to order. I've given up coffee at Starbucks all together because I don't like the aftertaste from it, this is great alternative.
My favorite Starbucks in Tucson. I love the extended hours, location and layout with a choice of shaded or in the sun seating outdoors. They have always made my selected drinks correctly.

We stopped here at about noon one day before heading to the zoo for some coffee. There were only about 5 other people there. My boy friend and I both ordered iced vanilla lattes, which we get all the time at other Starbucks, and the drinks that gave us were so light they looked like straight milk. And they tasted worse. I kindly said that this does not taste right and the guy at the register said oh yeah that looks like they forgot the espresso. The girl in the back looked unhappy about it and said she would make another. She did, very quickly, which makes me think she didn't make a new drink because I got back the exact same thing. Maybe even worse. Very displeased. Will not go here again.

It is always such a pleasure to come to this Starbucks! Located right down the street from work, it's a great location for me to stop by on the way in, or just to go to as a mid-afternoon coffee run. Service is always great here and everyone is so friendly, making sure to engage you in conversation that isn't forced when you are half-asleep at 7am. 

Now with the Pumpkin Cream Cheese muffin available, they sell out fast, so stop by a Starbucks soon to try it!

Not sure what may have haopened at this location. Overall the counters, backline and floors were dirty. There were 6 people behind the counter having concersations, not waiting on customers. When they did take the order, the petson yelled at her colleague, "can i get a mocha? Can I get a mocha? CAN I GET A MOCHA?" 
Worst experience at a Starbucks ever!!

I really like this starbucks.  I like when the big front windows are open to people watch.  The exposed brick wall of the building also gives it a little less of "cookie cutter" starbucks feel and a little more of an "unique coffee shop" feel.  (whatever, it helps my sense of guilt when I choose The Man over local...)  There are always people meeting up or studying.  I'm usually there in the evenings and I'm taking away one star because my black coffee usually tastes a little old, but I get it - it's the evening, not a whole lot of coffee orders.
Great service in a small space.  The bar is set pretty high for the rest of the Starbucks, if not for every coffee house, once the customer comes into this place.
Mass confusion... no names on cups and with a long line hard to tell who is getting what and in which order. A few people working, no organization

My first and LAST experience at this Starbucks was HORRIBLE !!! I went to this one because it was the closest one (according to Siri) by my job. When I arrived it was crowed, which wasn't that much of a surprise. When I went through the drive through and waited I noticed that cars was starting to back up and leave. I thought it was a good thing for me so I can get ahead in line. I was wrong.

When after almost 10mins waiting to take my order, that's after the 15mins waiting to get to the order screen. I finally took my order (caramel frapp, no whip, extra caramel drizzle and two cookies for my daughter and I) 

When finally getting to the window to pay for my items the lady handed me the cookies first and they were BURNING HOT, yes I asked for the cookies to be warmed but not so hot my daughter couldn't take a bite out of it and when it finally cooled down it was hard as a rock. 

I was definitely pissed, oh and btw I'm still waiting at the window for them to give me  my drink. After 5 more mins passed I asked the lady making the drinks did they forget about me and where was mine ? She rudely told me that I had to wait and they only had 3 people on staff and they're really busy. 

So I'm still waiting for my drink and I look inside to see that someone wasted a drink, the line inside was super long, customers were complaining of wrong drinks given to them and so much more ... it was insane. 

FINALLY I get my drink and I instantly get pissed again because one they over filled it and it wasted on me soon as she gave it to me and on top of that they touched my straw and put it in there for me ! I HATE THAT !!! No one was wearing gloves for them to think it was okay to touch other people straws !!! I seen a girl scratch her hair and continue to make people's drink and thought it was okay! 

Then the cherry on top was when I finally got my drink it tasted horrible, NO extra caramel drizzle, which is what I LOVE, tasted watered down, my daughters complaining about her hard cookie and I'm all sticky because of the overflowing drink. 

I will NEVER go back! It was my first and last time there! 

Time spent there 3:35pm - 4:10pm 
TOTAL OF 35MINS !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

A good Starbucks. The couple times I've been here the staff has been nice and got the orders right. Ambiance is nice too- it has a fireplace, some cushy couches, a couple computer bars and a study room. The pasty case is well stocked and everything is pretty clean

Came into the 'bucks today, business as usual. My girlfriend and I were most politely introduced by a barista in training named Roshni. She gave us excellent service, and even expertly handled my complicated order with all the bells and whistles I add to my drink. She remained calm, cool, and friendly during the whole thing and she really has become my girlfriend's favorite barista ever and we will definitely be back again to grab coffee and say hi! :)

So far this is my favorite Starbucks. The girl who works the afternoon shift is nice enough to look up my account  info to get my reward number since my phone never downloads in there.  She always seems pleasant. That's what I look for in a coffee house. It's not just the coffee,  it's the whole environment
Tight quarters, very good wifi. Standard Starbucks fare. People ding on Starbucks but it definitely raised the quality of coffee throughout the U.S.

My visit to this location was Sunday 5/28/2017.  We had just checked out of our hotel and were preparing to make the nearly 700 mile drive back to New Orleans; and not having coffee was definitely not an option.  It was 6:40 AM and the parking lot had plenty of available spots. (no surprise there)  I was relieved (and glad) to see that this location was already open as they open at 5 AM Monday - Saturday and at 5:30 AM on Sundays.


The coffee shop was mostly empty except for 2 older gentlemen that seemed to look like "locals" to me.  The barista, although not overly friendly, was definitely polite and got me our 2 Venti dark roasts very quickly.  The restaurant was exceptionally clean, however, it was only 6:40 AM.  A lot of the reviews complained about slow service, but I did not experience this.


All in all, this was a pleasant visit.  The coffee was hot, as expected, and I was in and out in less than 3-4 minutes; and that includes me adding cream & sugar (Splenda) to both coffees.  I like this location of St. Charles, as it very quaint, and I could see myself coming here often if I was a local.

Very nice spot. Excellent surroundings. Nice service. Various kinds of baked goods. Fast and friendly service. Has Italian lemonade and cookie. A vanilla late with a Madeline cookie. Very Yummy!!  So relaxing and inviting to seat here and do some computer work.
It was a typical Starbucks. The staff was friendly and in a very convenient location in Downtown SB

If this place didn't sell Starbucks products and have the Starbucks logo all over the place, I'd confuse it for a local, neighborhood coffee shop.

The building itself is pretty small and there isn't much seating space, but it's cozy. It's my place for a coffee treat so I'm not sure what's like during the work rush, but I've never had to wait too long to place my order or receive my drink. The sugar area is always clean. 

Not sure how this place will hold up once all the new Granary residents are moved in and there's a whole new set of foot traffic, but for now it's a pleasant experience.

No reason not to give 5 stars but they didn't have grilled cheese.  Otherwise, nice people and apologetic.  And people, I always love when Starbucks has a drive-thru.  Especially if it's connected to a bank.

Don't do the mobile order they take care of everyone else before them. Much faster not doing it. They don't even acknowledge you when you're waiting ten minutes in the mobile pickup while people who walked in the regular line and drive through who came and ordered way after you are already done and gone.
Solid spot. Starbucks definitely picked a good location to open up shop.
I promise you they make thee best Chai Tea Lattes. SO yummy! Baristas are always so nice at this location!
I go to this starbucks inside of target on a daily basis! I love it when Adam is working! He always makes my drink perfect! The older lady makes it good to but she can be a little rude sometimes.

I mean, who doesn't like Starbucks?  I am a fan, but of this location, not so much.  This Starbucks is a very cramped and I often feel claustrophobic when I walk in.  There is hardly any seating anywhere due to the masses of college students who camp out there all day with their computers, books and oversized headphones drowning out the chatter and even the kind fellow patron simply asking "Is this seat taken?"  

I do not want to discourage kids from studying, they just need a larger facility to do it in.  The staff here is great and have always made my drinks to my liking.  I'm just a "space case" and I like to have options and room to maneuver in.  Thats all.
Best Starbucks I've ever been to. Workers are always polite, funny and knowledgable. My order is always correct and tasty. Parking lot can be a pain but that's the only negative.
Went through the drive-through and asked for a pumpkin spice latte with soy and no foam and as usual full of foam and 3/4 cup of coffee. Come on Starbucks you can do better than that.
Bad attitude workers. Flippant, self-entitled, self-absorbed. But probably due overwork. This place is always over filled. It's exceeded it local population quota. Time to expand.

I legit come here many times a week. It does get very busy dependent on the time you go. The staff there is so nice and welcoming. Any issue I've had with an order is always resolved. I like to come here sometimes just to say hi and see smiling faces. Tyler is my favorite (no shade to the others)! He's always smiles and spreading good vibes. It's nice to get that after being in an office all day! Thanks

After 25 minutes of waiting in line, the 3 staff members forgot to make our drinks. The head barista, Arumi was very rude while talking to her cousins that had just walked in. Instead of making our drinks, after I reminded her of our order, Arumi proceeded to introduce her family to the rest of the barista staff. There were 12 people in line to order and that did not affect any pace of the Starbucks 5 points staff. Several people waiting in line began to comment on the poor service. I will not come back to this location ever again. Horrible customer service.

Fortunately I work a very short walk from this place. I come here atleast 4 times a week and everyone is so friendly and service is quick. Sometimes it gets really busy, but I just end up leaving and coming back 10 mins later

I always use this Starbucks for my coffee needs and always got great and friendly service but today just made me love why I go here. I brought in a drink from another Starbucks location that completely made it wrong and they happily fixed it for no charge! I know now that this location is the only location for me. Props to being only 5 minutes away too!

Love this Starbucks! They have only messed up my drink once and quickly fixed the right one and gave me both without being charged.. The baristas there are so friendly as well. This is by far my favorite In the Rutherford County area!

Did a mobile order.   Was ready when I got there but the coffee tasted burnt.   Really a turn off when they burn the shots.        they need to clean their equipment between orders or train their baristas  better....

your regular starbucks- but not too busy and good seating area- outside too!

try the shaken strawberry lemonade- its not on the menu? but they have it and its a really good summer treat!

My coffee is always great! At times it does get very busy but the staff is fantastic and quick at getting drinks out. I've never had a problem with my orders. Love it here. Now if only they could get a drive thru :)

It's no mystery that Starbucks is by far my favorite stop for coffee and other selections that are spontaneous dictated by my cravings at any given moment. I have visited literally hundreds of Starbucks' location since they've come into existence and although they all seem to be pretty consistence with the quality of the products they offer; the service, quality of the product, wait-time, cleanliness and accessibility of the location are the five points I will rate all of them on going forward - so to make the point I've recently incorporated a rating system based on this short list to calculate the rating of the locations I visit. I feel all these criterions are controllable by the corporation, the franchise owner or store manager.

Service - 4 Stars
Quality - 4 Stars
Wait Time - 5 Stars
Cleanliness - 5 Stars
Accessibility - 4 Stars

Rating 4.4

Smallish location partnered with a bank on the interior.  Everyone was friendly.  Nothing spectacular here but the promo of extra stars for buying a baked good.  3 stars for a small coffee and brownie!

Well location isnt an issue. There everywhere. I dont drink coffee so my review is on everything but, Why is the venti still kinda small? I order tead and a few sips and shes empty??? The prices seem kind of steep but hell everywheres steep. Staff is always happy to serve you and there baked goods are rather delicious as well. I hate line ups and well theres always on here. ALWAYS. Seriously I dont think I've ever walked into a starbucks and never had to wait in line. Meh its A-ok

Brand new drive thru location, only third in the district with a Clover machine, Starbucks Reserve coffees. 

This intersection is really growing quickly business wise. It is great to finally have a quality coffee shop that fills the gap on Gulf to Bay in between Downtown and the Bridge.

Very spacious place to study. Customer service and parking sucks though. The barista with blue hair forgot my sandwich twice and went on lunch before even telling me that it was finished. Not the best Starbucks I've been to, but it's a great place to do homework.
Went there last night. Friendly service, and my coffee was made perfectly! At of all the Starbucks I've gone too they made the perfect balance with the milk and sugar in the latte.

Stopped in today, they were pretty busy, obviously.

I'm a HUGE fan of Starbucks, but the carmel Mocha, Venti was horrible: Burned milk, & not enough flavoring. I was super late or I would of gone in and returned it. Might have to rethink going back to this location again.
Always the best service during the week in the mornings. The staff is fantastic and friendly. I go mostly to see them and they make great drinks.

I usually come to this location since it's closer to home. Finding parking during the busiest morning hours can be a pain, but when you really need your cup of coffee in the morning it's worth it. Lol. Lines are usually long but it goes by pretty fast. The baristas here are always friendly and always have a smile. 

My favorite drinks:

Caramel Macchiato (Nonfat Hot or iced)
Hazelnut Macchiato (Nonfat Hot or iced)
Caramel Brûlée Latte (Nonfat light whip- My absolute favorite, but only available during holidays)
Pumpkin Spice Latte Nonfat light whip (Hot- only available during Fall)

Rude. And they screwed up my drink, then I went back for a croissant and it was stale. 

Greet fireplace, but it's underground so poor phone service and you have to be a Penn student to get on the WIFI.

Boooooo!

I've been a gold card carrying member ever since they started this program. I've been to Starbucks all over the place. Avon's Starbucks has the most problems with having the ingredients for my drinks on hand. These baristas are not the usual friendly staff I'm used to seeing at a Starbucks. There is a much better one at 10th street very close by.  They bend over backwards to make sure your order is right. Very friendly staff too. Bypass Avon and go to 10th street or the one in Target close by on Rockville.

This Starbucks features the reserve collection of coffee. I tried the Colombia reserve and was impressed. Most Starbucks locations do not sell reserve coffees. 

The food selection here is good compared to other Starbucks. Lastly the staff is professional and polite. For these reasons this location is one of my favorite Starbucks in the Tampa Bay Area.

Best Starbucks I've ever been to. Staff was laughing and smiling the whole time I was there. Barista knew their teas and took the time to make me the best Emperors Green I've had just by using the correct water temp. Thank u.

The best thing about Starbucks is you know exactly what to expect.

Since this Starbucks shares a parking lot with other businesses and a hotel, you never have to worry about parking. Score! I detest having to find a spot when I'm craving coffee. The placement of this Starbucks reminds me of gas stations. You put one on each side of the street, because people don't like crossing over traffic to get gas, or in this case, coffee. There's a Starbucks about half a mile down in the Feather Sound neighborhood on the opposite side of the street, which is the one I normally frequent. That one is definitely busier than this one. I think this one stays open based on convenience for people who just want to grab coffee and go. 

It is on the smaller side. There are four chairs in the back, but their proximity to one another means that if one person is sitting there, it is awkward to occupy another seat if you don't know the first person. The small side doesn't pose a problem, because as I said, it seems that this is a grab and go place. I came on a Saturday at around 4 p.m. and it was empty, except for a couple people.

I won't even comment on the coffee. If you've tried one Starbucks, you've tried them all. I have found that since I drink decaf every time I order it they have to brew it for me. This isn't an issue, because I go to Starbucks to read, not to leave immediately.

There are a couple tables outside, but there really isn't a view, unless you like traffic, construction, or hotels. 

This is your average, solid Starbucks.

This is a pretty standard Starbucks, which makes it pretty good in my opinion!  The staff is friendly and courteous, and they make the drinks pretty well.  We had one issue once where they rang us up wrong, and they gave us a voucher for a free drink (any size), which was super nice because it was a small error on their part.  They try to do the very best they can for the customers, and I appreciate that.

This location is super convenient for me.  It's on the side of the road that I'm always on when I'm going towards my house, so it's easy to pop in and out when I have to have my super sugary coffee craving quenched.  Say that three times fast, dare ya!

All in all, this is a good Starbucks, and I'll be returning a few times a week!

My previous review had taken into consideration some growing pains at this location. Sadly nothing has changed. A simple order of "coffee-black", paying, and then hearing "I only have enough for a tall, can I top it off with something else?". Who would have thought a cup of their medium roast would end up impossible 80% of the time?
Love this Starbucks!! Great staff with great personalities. They remember your name and drink. They make me feel like they are my friends!

The staff here is friendly and efficient. After a few visits they knew my order and made me feel like a regular. Now I am. And as always, the perfect latte. Love using the app, these guys are ALWAYS on time. Very much appreciated.
Yes, parking can be tight. Hint: there are more spaces in the back.
Employees here were extremely polite and when my drink took longer than expected they gave me a card for my next drink to be on them, if I lived closer I would defiantly be back!
Waited 15 minutes in the drive thru. Got a smores and a waffle cone. They tasted nothing like they were supposed too and by the point in time we got them we just wanted to throw them away.

HORRIBLE SERVICE!!! The baristas body language was horrible their was a customer in front of me and I think he pissed her off so she stormed out of the store. When it was my turn for my order to be taken...he was standing looking at me with a look like "what do want?! Are you gonna order or stand there like an idiot?!" And the WIFI is soooooo slow!!!! I'm here visiting a family member from NYC....and I thought us New Yorkers had a sick attitude.....this guy makes us look like angels....NEVER coming back to this location again!!!!
I like this location because the drive thru line is efficient and tricks you into thinking the line isn't as long as it is. Quick service& delicious coffee.

Here is your average starbucks that is tiny inside but has some seating with a long bar table. People study here but you should bring headphones. The workers are friendly and the have most of the pastries and usual coffee in stock. I can see it getting crowded at times because of the size of the place.

Overall, I'd return I'd I were a local here.

Food local Starbucks. Baristas are always friendly and service prompt as expected from the Starbucks chain. I have been here multiple times and they have not messed up an order yet. The same can't be said for all of the chains locations.

Whenever I would to Reno for the weekend, I stopped by this Starbucks at least daily. Parking lot is small and limited but plenty of street parking if need be. It never really seems too busy, so I don't see this being an issue. The folks behind the counter are extremely friendly, and my drinks have been perfect every time. I frequent Starbucks and have specific favorite locations because I'm so picky... and this is one.

This Starbucks has definitely lost its customer service skills over the years. I've been here 5-6 times over last year and without fail, there is no patience among the staff.

3 separate visits, I've witnessed:
1. A customer asks how much longer after waiting 8 min, staff responds "it's in the line to be made, be patient."
2. After waiting 15 min, a customer asks where is their drink to which the staff snarks "I remember making it so someone else must have grabbed it. Are you sure you didn't get it?"
3. Staff points to each other during a slow time like it's an inconvenience to take an order.

My first Yelp rating!  You pushed me to it.

I travel the U.S. And have Starbucks literally everyday. I visited this location 4 days while in town. Hands down the worst run location I have been too!!  Don't go unless you have at least 15 minutes. Painful to watch 6 people trip over each other while customers stand there irritated waiting on a simple cup of coffee!!  #starbucksfail

Pumpkin spice season! I love Starbucks and when I relocated to South Jersey I knew it was probable that one would not be as close as I had out in San Diego (a drive thru one 3 blocks away). Well the closest one is about 3 miles and so when I'm in the area and feel like treating myself I stop in. This location is usually busy but there is ample parking and the baristas are usually quick getting the orders out. I think that the service kind of depends with who you get and if theyre having a good day or not. I have had the friendliest service to at times indifference and even a little snobby. So, customer service is inconsistent, which is disheartening because like I said I am a fan of Starbucks. This location does have a decent offering of baked goods and food items as well and the usual Starbucks swag available for purchase.

They should've put more thought into this location the parking lot is the worst thing ever! They need open another one in St. Charles!  People can't get in people can't get out there's nowhere for line I'm stuck in here right now want to turn around but can't. Just the worst!
They open at 5:30, the service is great, the men's restroom has the best fragrance I think I've ever encoutered...I'd give it 5 stars but the fireplace lacked fire this chilly morning.
C'mon you know today is a busy travel day . Staff up. Sloooooow service!

This location stays busy. Never set foot in the place but the drive thru is as quick as can be considering the traffic in and out. The coffee is great just as you would expect from Starbucks. Price-wise I think you get what you pay for.

you know how Abercrombie only hires hot people? Well, I think this Starbucks is recruiting cougars. Nothing gets my Pike's Place up to 145' like a hot older chick in a christmas sweater & tight chinos. Rrrrr!
Staff very nice.   Smile, friendly, and very customer service driven.  Place is a little dirty most of the time...but beyond that...I will go again for sure!!
The cashier has no customer service and very slow service. How long does it take to make an Americano? A shot of espresso and water!!!

Very busy location with limited parking and the first one west of Philadelphia on Baltimore.  Thank goodness I can order ahead because today, I walked in, saw the line was 8 deep, and ordered on line through the app.   That put me to the front of the line in just a couple of minutes.    Coffee is always fresh here due to the volume.
This is one of the good Starbucks in the Nashville area. It is pretty big with lots of tables to sit and parking is very convenient. Other than that you get the standard stuff.

Your standard Starbucks, with very efficient employees, this location open from 6A - 6P 7 days. Enter from street or Marriot Convention Center lobby. Across the street  from convention center. Staying at hotel, I had at least one coffee daily, and their breakfast sandwich on two occasions, bacon, cheese and egg on a "croissant-like" roll. Higher quality ingredients than most similar offerings, but higher priced as well. Like most heat and eat products, texture kind of suffers.  New Orleans has a lot of local coffee shops which you should be sure to try as well.

Yeah, I know they're a corporate monster coffee machine BUT...when I want a boutique coffee or just wanted to "go off grid for a chill," I will scope out a Starbucks. I'm always able to find healthy options should I feel the need to nosh! For the most part, I've always found the Baristas to be upbeat, friendly, and patient. You have to admit , it can get crazy in line at times. They do a pretty good job keeping up with it all. AND, you have to admit, the atmosphere is so consistent in this chain. You can depend on it.
I came here when my car dealer, Crown, is my service dept for my ride. I will drop it off and come down to wait at this Starbucks. Convenience is good and that what Starbucks is.

Starbucks is my life. I am an eleven year old which should explain the first sentence. My favorite thing to get is a Carmel frappuccino. If you are a kid who has never been to Starbucks, you are a crazy person.

Come here on the weekends in the morning because it's most convenient location. Every time I come the staff are slow and confused. Lots of frustrated customers. It takes 20 minutes to get a regular ice coffee. I stay to read outside for awhile thinking that I can come back in to get a quick re-fill , but that also takes 20 minutes. Somehow the staff still find time to laugh and talk to each other as if they are doing their job. Terrible experience every time!

This store is a bit smaller than many but has a nice patio despite facing a very busy Gulf to Bay! The staff is quite efficient and reflects high energy.

This location can get very busy so don't be surprised at the lines or crowded parking lot.

My Skinny Vanilla Latte was spot on. I also always enjoy my Spinach, Feta Wrap which has that Greek flavor with low calories! 

Political Comment! This morning I noticed the diverse clientele, a snapshot sampling of a peaceful coexisting world. It seemed quite normal and reflected the way our Country was built! The tourists stick out like a sore thumb!  But they add jocularity to the mix and we appreciate what they add to our economy! Bottom line, we're already great in a good way.

I think my caffeine kicked in! One Love!

4 stars for the coffee and really low in the service. I've come here to buy just coffee and they fail to give me the discount for bringing in my own cup and they don't give me my receipt for the discounted price on a cold beverage later in the day

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been too.   If you choose to go through the drive thru, prepare to wait 20-25 minutes or battle cars coming from both directions trying to get in line.  If you do a mobile order, the wait is not much faster.  Perception is chaos from the employees.  Drinks are not great either.  I have now avoid that Starbucks and go to Dunkin Donuts across the street.

No coconut milk so did not get my drink
The line is huge
The order was set up correct and barista was nice

I love Starbucks and was so excited about this new location opening as it's so close and convenient. Frappacino is my go to drink and I was really impressed and happy with this location's presentation of the Frappacino specifically the whipped cream. It's like the first Starbucks that actually makes the whipped cream high and as it actually looks in photos!! I love the atmosphere and the modern and eclectic look of this location; it feels and looks like a big city coffeehouse. I like that they offer huge long community tables. Though I do love and prefer the Safety Harbor location because  they have a game table with tons of fun adult and family games customers can play while visiting. I think games would be a really fun and popular addition for this location; we would love that and probably come here more. It's  friendly service here. It does always seem a bit slow.

One of the best Starbucks I've been to! They were giving out samples of their ham and cheese squares when I walked in - it was so good I immediately bought one. 

The service was very good. The barista who made my drink was very nice and talkative. They had cooked my ham and cheese square too long, and offered me a coupon for a free drink (which I though was very nice, even though I wasn't bothered about it whatsoever). 

Overall, great customer service and friendly employees. If you're looking for a Starbucks in Clearwater to frequent, I'd choose this one.
Very spacious, friendly and helpful service, super convenient location! They also have great hot tea selections!

Okay very upset that I have to write a bad review.  The lady who was at the window 'preeti' is her name.  She was extremely unprofessional and damn right rude!! 1st seems pissed off by just seeing my face,doesn't give me a receipt, and as I'm waiting to ask her for it she rolls her eyes at me,so that pissed me off so I wait to tell her to be a little more respectful to customers and she closed the window on me while I was talking! !!!!!!!!!!! Corporate will hear from me if her boss doesn't do something about this.

Fast, friendly service! Always seems like everyone is in a good mood and is upbeat. Don't have any complaints! My order had always been correct! I'd say this is a good Starbucks to visit if you're in the area!

I watched them build this place.   Workers would smoke right on the sidewalk.  They were oblivious to everyone else.

So they have been open for about a month now.  They are not open on Saturday's or Sunday and I see folks pulling in going to the door looking in and then just walking away.  Folks even park across the street and walk all the way over for their disappointment.

Today I saw an employee of the new Starbucks standing outside smack dab in front of the Starbucks smoking a cigarette.  When he was done, he threw his lit cigarette into the parking lot and walked back into the store.  That's great advertisement isn't it?  

People are watching guys and they are making decisions.  Sugarfoot failed at that location you know.

I go to a Starbucks store every day, and this one about once a week. My experiences at this store have been mixed, but occasionally shockingly bad.  They have a couple of excellent employees, but most of the servers are indifferent at best and hostile at worst.  This is the only Starbucks store I've ever been in where a server refused to correct a drink problem, turned her back and walked away.  I recommend finding a different store.

Had the worst experience with this Starbucks. I ordered something and received it wrong 2 ways. I called to come back and receive a 3rd replacement and the lady was very rude to me and didn't believe that I called when I gave her my name and the managers name. She said so pretty much your just here to get something free. I was treated poorly and will not return! :(

Stopped by for an iced drink today and waited in the drive-thru for 15 minutes. When I finally got to the front they had two people working. The guy taking the drive thru orders grabbed my card and then went and started making drinks for others even though my drink was there waiting. Finally the second worker handed me my card. I had to tell her I had a drink there waiting for me. She barely said anything to me and handed me the cup. The least she could have done was apologize for the wait. I will not be going to this site again. With all of the other coffee competition you would think they would be getting their stuff together.
The "real" Starbucks in Reno is a great store.  The staff is friendly and engaging - and the drinks are just so much better than any licensed store.  Did someone say PSL?  What, What.  #stopby
Always get caramel macchiato with extra caramel and 1 extra shot of espresso. Very clean and nice environment

I go to this Sbux maybe 5 days out of 7.  The staff is reliable. It is a stop-gap for many employees so you see a lot of new faces. I'm guessing many are MTSU students. There is a group of regular baristas who've been there for a few years so I rarely have to tell them my order as I get ye basic tall dark roast...straight up. They're good people. The owner really should do more to limit the hard surfaces and noise..especially spending a few pennies for plastic caps for the chair legs...geez..simple fix . In late Winter / early Spring the sunlight can take some wicked angles at certain tables. The only other gripe is a very limited amount of outlets for your devices... again....that's an easy fix if the owner cared.


UPDATE:    since the remodel there are two large tables in the middle of the store with outlets underneath.  Brand new chairs of higher quality. The individual tables are now a bit smaller so it can be tight with your laptop , phone and coffee but overall the improvements work. I don't like the air-dryer in the bathroom over paper towels but that goes for every place that seems to be doing this. Paper towels are handing for opening doors in public restrooms. I'm not OCD about it but I prefer not to touch bathroom doorknobs during cold and flu season for obvious reasons.

This is where we always go on early Sunday morning work caffeine runs. There's usually not much of a line when I'm there, but I've seen it pretty bad on occasion while walking by. I'll be back many many times for sure!
I hate Starbucks, but I like this location!!  It's so cozy!!  Also love their pumpkin scones!!  DELICIOUS!!! Their vanilla chais suck, but I love their strawberry smoothies!
This is one of my favorite Starbucks in the Tampa area.  The barista's are top notch.  Perfect location on Gandy Blvd.

The workers here take away the friendly service Starbucks is known for! I've been here many times, never a greeting! They're usually talking amongst themselves. Today I had to lean over to get my drinks, I wasn't even handed a receipt.

Had an issue with my drink with the other star bucks a few blocks down.  Ordered a pink drink and they filled up the whole cup with ice.  After walking to the beach noticed this star bucks and asked them for water to mix up my pink drink.  They said not to worry and made me another one with limited ice.  

Great service and would recommend to go to this one if you are by the Santa Barbara area.
Worker ignored me for about 10 minutes and then was very condescending when I finally got her attention. No clue why she was ignoring me or why she was so condescending.

It was 5:15am, pouring down rain and freezing cold when I was trying to catch a cab on South Street. There were none and I was standing under the Starbucks awning for a few minutes when an employee opened the door and told me I could wait inside for my cab to arrive, even though they weren't open. It was so nice and thoughtful. I'll continue going there on my way to work :)

This Starbucks has the best baristas in the world. I've become close with quite a few of them as I work in the same building, and they are always so courteous to me. They've been with me through countless lunch breaks and I'm on a first name basis with most of them. Furthermore this Starbucks also has continually high quality drinks; I've never gotten any beverage here that's not been top notch.

"Do you wanna go to Starbucks? I need some caffeine in my veins...." This place is everything I want for my Starbucks caffeine fix--fast, clean, with a nice area inside and out. It's small on the interior, at least when the bank is closed, but it does mostly drive-thru business, so it never feels crowded to me. And let's be honest, there aren't a ton of options up here. They'll continue to be my go-to caffeine fix.
I love Starbucks.. you could say i'm a starbucks freak.. but this location tends to not satisfy my drink.. 5 out of 10 times they get it perfect..

This Starbucks is always a downer. If I'm having a great morning they guarantee to change that for you. The gal that took my order is terribly annoyed. Possibly a reflection of management? It's like she hates her life and wants to bring everyone down with her. I love the location because it's the midpoint of my long commute. The location is the only reason they get one star. Somebody help the staff, they are the most depressing bunch I've ever encountered. Sorry for interrupting you day with my coffee order.
My favorite Starbucks. They never forget my order. They make it with smiles on their faces
Love this location. I come everyday. The baristas are awesome. Lawson the manager is one of the best around. Very customer service friendly. This is why I keep coming back on a daily basis.
Honestly like yeah the lines are long but everyone is super nice. I mean it's a Starbucks on a college campus not sure what everyone is expecting.

This is my favorite USF area Starbucks! I've been sucked into becoming a bit of a regular by my carpool friend who requires it a few times a week. This one is always fast-moving, very friendly baristas who after maybe 3 visits remember exactly what I want and how I want it, and almost remember the names by now :) Wish there was a drive through option but it is a great location for a quick in and out drink. I can't speak to the 'sitting and hanging out' part of it but it is a little crowded being next to the university (and I'll admit I hung out frequently when I lived in the Malibu apartments that are about a 1 minute walk away). Thanks for always taking care of us!

This is my default Starbucks. Staff is always quick and super friendly. They messed up one order in the history of me going there, and were very quick to resolve. I am also a fan of their comfy chairs!

I have been going to this Starbucks for quite some time now. It is right down the road from my house and the location is convenient. However, the service is absolutely horrible and I wait 15 minutes minimum in the drive through every time I come to this location. No matter how few cars are in the drive through, speed and efficiency are not their strong suit. The quality of the employees has really gone down. They are rude and frequently don't get my order right. They are clueless and in need of some direction! I have now decided to make my own coffee at home! Also, whenever I try to go do school work and sit outside there are always kids running around and never any place to sit. Horrible all around! Never will I waste my time at this location again.

The customer service here was very poor.  There was a group of 4-5 women chatting behind the counter who ignored me when I walked up.  I stood there for a minute,  waiting to be asked if they could help me.  I finally asked if they were open and the cashier stared at me like she couldn't believe that I asked her that. Not impressed.  At least my latte was OK.  The employees definitely need some training in the customer service department or at least they should pretend like they care about their job and customers.

Smaller location at Five Points.  It's not fancy, and the front patio is utilitarian and not the least bit visually interesting.  

There is a large wall graphic inside that was intriguing.  It is notable for its size.

I was greeted by a smiling employee, and my PSL made quickly, which is where it's at when stopping at Starbucks.

Dear Hubby and I sat out on the patio, sipping our drinks and catching up in the day.  Noted that the interior was filled with patrons working or studying.  Clearly, this location fills a neighborhood niche.

Quick and clean Starbucks to stop at when needing a break from I-24. They have a drive thru which seems to be quite popular but i would go inside to check out the man candy working there (3 hot baristas in one location? Unheard of!) Oh yeah i also went in to get coffee also and it was delightful.

I want to like this Starbucks because it's so convenient for me, but there is never a place to sit to enjoy my coffee. There are 3 tables, which are always occupied, and a small bar where each person, because we are Americans, takes up 3 chairs. So disappointing that they could not find a way to make more room for tables and get creative on how they lay out the merchandise.

Be prepared to wait. There is always a line here and never more than 2 people working. I'm not mad at the employees for this. I'm sure its not easy for 2 employees to handle non-stop lines all day. I wish they had more staff. I've only  been here twice. The first time I waited almost a half hour (but was just trying to kill time before my train came). Aside from the wait, no complaints about my first visit. My second visit was not as great. I waited a bit as usual. The girl took my order for a venti iced green tea latte, light ice. And thats what she wrote on the cup and charged me for. Well the guy who made my drink some how confused "iced green tea latte" with "iced caramel macchiato". When he called my name I went over to get my drink and was surprised to see a macchiato. But by this point he was already making another drink and my train was about to arrive. Too bad I don't like macchiatos. Total waste of 30 minutes and $5.  One last thing that is a bit of an inconvenience is that they do not have a barcode scanner if you choose to use the app to rack up reward stars. You have to give the employee the gift card number and they have to manually type it in. This only holds up the line more.

Pretty good overall.  The pastry selection was on par with other locations, and the dining area was relatively clean for a slow Sunday afternoon.  Coffees are normally really good and all product is overpriced as usual, but we all know that going in.

The staff could use some re-training on customer service.  Not a lot of smiles or customer interaction going on at this location.

My favorite Starbucks in Indy!!! I used to come here to get work done in college and the baristas were all friendly, encouraging and remembered my order. It's kind of out of my way these days but I try to stop in from time to time and the great service is still the same.

Feels more like a local coffee shop than an international chain.
Some of the most foul mouthed, ghetto trash, racists you will find.  The way they talk about their job and customers (when they don't think anyone can hear), really makes you go somewhere else.
It's a Starbucks...not much to say.  it does have a nice, covered outdoor seating area though, which may come in handy for me one day.

So this is a "during the school year review" because the woman that works pretty much by herself during the summer is awesome and I get in and out everyday with the right order with no issues. I cant remember her name at the moment but i'll update when I do.

 So today I finally ventured back in because the line wasn't literally out of the door for once. You'd think i'd be in and out but no. I ordered a trenta  black unsweetened iced coffee no room and a cup of ice. I pay for both and patiently wait. Barista after barista asks people what they ordered while they're waiting (whats the point of ordering). Finally someone asks me what I ordered and I tell him an unsweetened iced coffee. A woman fills up a cup like 80% and hands it to me. I asked if she could top it off and she gave me the nastiest look so I said "you know what, never mind." I put it in the refrigerator at work to drink after lunch and I just took my first sip and there's a shitload of sweetener in it so now I have to throw it away. $4 bucks out the door for me. This service at this place during the year is disgusting.

A wonderful Starbucks!  The baristas are always friendly, and will give you amazing drink recommendations if you're stuck in a rut with your everyday espresso drink like I was.  They just remodeled too with a great new modern look and more space to work or study.  Woohoo!

Starbucks has the Worst Coffee Ever! Seriously, why would anyone want to waste their time and money on a place like Starbucks? Their coffee tastes nothing like coffee. Don't bother going there for a cup. Bob Evans has better coffee than this place.

It is not the best coffee in town, but it sure is consistent. I love the fact that I can walk into any Starbucks in town and get something that I enjoy. 

My drink of choice is a tall vanilla bean frappuccino with a shot of espresso, or a grande with two shots if I want a boost.  Give it a shot, it is delicious!

Anyway, I like this location, check it out!

A good local place to grab a coffee or their excellent iced green tea. It can get crowded abut 9:30 on weekdays when the local offices head over for their coffee break, but it is always clean and the staff pleasant. There is free Wi-Fi and a little patio that is usually filled with smokers.

I used to go to Downtown Clearwater Starbucks because it was the closest to me. Now there is one on Belcher and GtoB!! YAY! And you brought my favorite Barrista's to this location. Danielle and Jessica:)!!!! Be nice to them or I will find you!!!______(V) you below me (V)__
BUSY!  A little crowded, but still good with service and coffee.

This is a VERY small Starbucks location, but it's just as good - or better - than others!  Because of the small size, it feels more "coffeehouse" and quaint, and when it's not too busy, it's a very peaceful place to enjoy a cup of coffee and read or relax for a bit.  

The employees are always very nice and really helpful, and willing to make your food exactly how you like it.  The condiment bar has always been fully stocked, clean, and large enough for multiple people to use at the same time.  The tables are usually clean and tidy.

I'm glad there's a Starbucks location towards the outskirts of Tucson!

This little Starbucks apparently can get really crowded.There is outdoor seating nad  a large parking lot but the lot was full  ( its  a shared lot) . Service was quick, bathrooms were clean and frap was yummy.
I love the location. The staff is friendly! Service is good. No complaints at all. It's Starbucks quality.

Some of the friendliest baristas I've encountered. I've been to lots of Starbucks, but these gals was super nice and very people friendly. If I'm around here again I'll be sure to stop in for my drink and the smiling faces

This location is wonderful! Its located smack dab in the middle of the Vanderbilt Hospital area. This location is very nice/large inside, and has a large outdoor sitting area. The inside has a wonderful layout. There is a fireplace in the middle! This is a great location to be when the weather starts to get cold! 

This location has all kinds of people coming through it! While I was sipping my latte I saw the Vanderbilt surgeon on his lunch break, he had X-rays hanging out of his scrub pockets?!?! I saw the Vanderbilt law frat boy students wearing the stereotypical Polo Ralph Lauren Chino Shorts above the knee, with the plaid tucked in shirt to go with it, and don't forget the Sperry Top-Sider boat shoes with no socks!!! We cant forget the Vanderbilt Business Management women sipping her Triple Venti Soy Latte with no foam, eagerly working on her i pad while sitting comfy in her Vera Wang fitted suit! 

I am a avid fan of people watching, so this is a great location for me! If you enjoy watching people like I do, then check out this location!

I seriously love this Starbucks. I actually prefer it to the regular one in Shiloh. The staff is amazing and friendly. Always make me what I want, how I want it. Also they are rarely out of what I want.  A huge plus... It's inside a target.

Remarkable customer service!! The staff here are incredible. They took their time helping us find the right coffee for my girlfriend and I. They were a joy to deal with. Will definitely be going here anytime I need some Starbucks!

After voting, I stopped by here when I realized I had just missed the bus. 

For a mid morning, the place was filled with students and business folks and the general public.

Lots of table setups for laptop warriors in the back. A few couches and more comfortable seating up front.

The aisles of product for sale were sort of narrow, compared to the other locations I've been to. They were really cumbersome to pass between and next to people in line as I tried to get to the napkins/sugar/condiments in the middle.

Workers were quick. I didn't expect the woman doing inventory of the pastries to acknowledge me, since I don't care about that type of thing. She was too focused on her job to acknowledge me. The woman taking my order was quick, but I didn't get a friendly vibe from her, either.

Unfortunately, my pastry was stale. And I was too busy catching the next bus to do anything about it. I'm glad I don't drive, as the woman trying to get out of the parking lot took several long minutes before she found it safe to do so.
Nonemployees of Starbucks milling around in the food area. Creamers, etc empty at 0709. Come on. Still paid the full price for less than quality service.

This is a good location, the only problem is they don't have the scanner to read Starbucks applications from the phone. You either have to present the physical card pr read the numbers off the phone to have cashier manually enter them in the register. The coffee is still what you'd expect of any location. The WiFi is free so that's a plus. The location is in the Harrah's Casino and there are some bicycle racks for bike parking on the casino premisses so ride dat! You're not SOL!!! It says 8 Canal as address but directly uptown of Canal Place. Enter casino from Canal entrance, go to the left and bada bing bada boom! Starbucks.

I like this Starbucks location. It's very relaxing and they have a good amount of sitting space both inside and outside. My drinks are usually mixed very well here also. Sometimes they're under-staffed and get long lines. Today I had to ask for a refund because I was waiting over 15 minutes and the manager wasn't very friendly about it. However, overall I enjoy my experiences here and everyone is very friendly. They also give great recommendations for new coffee drinkers.

Ok so I hate that my first ever review is about a chain, but here we are.

Everything about this Starbucks is fantastic, except one important thing for me...the inter webs. I have come when it is busy and when it is slow and there internet connection always cuts in and out. This is important enough for me to give them 3 instead of 4 stars.

If you want to chat with a friend or read a book, this is your place. If you need to get some major computer work done...pick another spot.

First time at this Starbucks. They had pastries in the display that were actually sold out and the guy who made our drinks made no eye contact. Didn't say your welcome and acted like we weren't there.

This is my favorite Starbucks location. The staff are really friendly and always remember my name and order. Even though the line does get long sometimes, they get through it very quickly. My drink is always perfectly made, and I definitely prefer this location over the other ones in town.

I have really bad anxiety in public places and its extremely hard interacting with people and placing orders, the guy working that day was patient and nice and that doesn't happen often so shout out to that guy i wish i would have gotten his name to put on here.

They like to make a mockery of you behind the counter.  At least wait until I'm out of earshot before making fun of the fact I ordered room with my Americana.  Keep your counter stocked and bathroom clean.  I would have added two more stars.  Will be frequenting the 21st Ave location from now on.

I came here en route to Houston. I asked for a bacon Gouda sandwich. They made it, the egg was cold. I asked them to remake it the egg is still cold. At this point I am like wtf. They can keep the $4 how hard is it to reheat a damn sandwich? Never getting my money again at this airport. Only getting two stars because the coffee is somewhat decent. There was a racist review below in which the user Nash M. (Who is a negative yelped per his profile) who states the "wrong demographics" works here because the staff is African American. Don't pay attention to that, because that comes from a place of Godlessness and hate. Pay attention to the fact that products were not cooked or made correctly and service sucks. I have been to Starbucks in major cities with all demographics: African American, Hispanic, Caucasian, Asian you name it! It is the work culture of that particular location which fosters poor service not the race or ethnicity of the workers. Good news is there are multiple Starbucks in the airport I went to the one right at the beginning of the C terminal. There is one some ways down you may have better luck with.

Depending on your time this Starbucks is great, all of the Baristas are friendly and seem to genuinely appreciate you being there. The lounge is typically filled young adults playing around on their computers. They have an outside patio, which is great year round weather permitting. 

Their drink selection is self explanatory, I usually always or a grande soy latte and it does the trick every-time. They have a great passbook application so all I need is my iphone and it tracks my rewards. Once a month or so I'l l get a $1.00 off a tea or single shot. 

My only issue is the time, this morning I spent over 15 minute in line for my coffee. They are attempting to get orders before you get to the loud speaker but that much time is just too much everyday.

They are always super friendly and really good at completing your order properly. The Internet is usually really good. The patio has loads of seating and a handful of outlets. The inside is usually busy with some seating and a lot of outlets and aggressive CA (bring a sweater).
Great Starbucks with Exceptional Customer Service. Coffee and Beverages are always on point!!! Thank you

No one is looking to Yelp to figure out if they like Starbucks or not.  They already know. Starbucks does Starbucks well.  

Along those lines, this Starbucks seems to be about average.  It has all of your standard Starbucks products, decent service, large windows and a small area to socialize, work or just relax.  I am a fan of Starbucks corporate culture, I believe they treat their employees really well and through their efforts they are improving working culture around the USA.  But, because I've been in tens of dozens of Starbucks around the country and globe I don't tend to rate them 5 stars.  A Great Starbucks gets four, and an average Starbucks gets 3.  This one is pretty decent- but hasn't yet struck me as amazing. 

This was my second visit to this Starbucks- of which I anticipate there being many.  It is the closest to my Spring Internship.  If they impress me further I will update this review.
Awesome!!! Space is great, fireplace and all.  New Mobil office for me!  Great for the Dogtown neighborhood.
I am a Starbucks junkie. No doubt about it. This place is newly remodeled. It's the perfect place to stop before you shop in the nearby stores. They have a drive-thru to get your quick fix.

You can never go wrong with Starbucks no matter where you go or where you're from. My go to mock macchiato is an iced coffee with vanilla, milk, and caramel drizzle. Yum! I always try to order something new at least once a week to check pot the menu! Drive thru makes it easy when we got the kiddos in the car.

Good Starbucks - friendly service, fast-moving lines & clean interior.

Only giving 3 stars because my frappuccinos here have been below par. But for the more simple drinks this is a great option for Starbucks lovers.

This Starbucks may have a unique feel and location but I find it pretty inconvenient for anyone not staying at the Cheshire. I can rarely find parking in their small lot they share with the hotel. There is no drive thru so I have to haul my baby inside which wouldn't be a big deal if I can also order ahead but that isn't an option at this location. So having to haul my car seat in and wait in line becomes a huge hassle. I went here today since I had a workout in Forest Park and this is the closest location. I have to admit this was actually a better experience today than what I've had in the past. I was able to find parking and the girl working the register was prompt and friendly. Every other time I've gone they have been slow even with a huge line and weren't very nice on top of it. They made conversation today and got my order made promptly. For some reason my drinks never taste the same at this location. It was made correctly but my espresso tasted burnt/old. It wasn't horrible but it's definitely a location I wouldn't frequent unless I'm in the area it's just too much of a hassle for me.

Good. I had a strawberry shake with a almond croissant. Man was it expensive, but that's why I do not come here often nor pay for it (gift card used :P). I normally do not drink coffee, especially here at Starbucks. Once you tried coffee outside of US, especially at a coffee plantation, Starbucks is disgusting compared to real coffee. Service was great, ordered my food and drink and it was ready in about 5 min. It was not so crowded on a Sunday night, so, that's great. This is a chain, so price will never go down, just up, but I only stop if I have a gift card. Otherwise, I avoid Starbucks anywhere.

Overall: Great service, ok price, good food and junk

It's Starbucks.  They all look alike to some degree, all have the exact same menu. Ones such as this one always has a plethora of hipsters on their Macs doing some graphic design project or blog post.... 
Little coffee trivia I found out there : Cold brew takes 20 hours to prepare and is smoother than regular iced coffee.

I was thinking about where I could get a nice sandwich today and figured I would think about it over coffee. Stopped by my local Starbucks and, low and behold, they have updated their food as well as their snacks/cakes. Well, updated is a bit weak since I just ate a turkey sandwich that had the kind of turkey you get from the day after thanksgiving. It was amazing, simple and delicious. The havarti cheese just put it over the top. 

For those who enjoyed the snacks and cakes before, they have updated them but you can still find close matches to your favorites - except they are fresher and tastier. 

Bravo Starbucks for moving forward.

This Starbucks is HUGE but cozy. The staff are very friendly and quick. I really like the various types of seating, many places with outlets for charging laptops/etc, parking, and right near Vanderbilt.

Perfect.
Great service, awesome drive-thru and a friendly staff.
This Starbucks is a nice little shop close to my office.  Staff is friendly and beverages are always very good.
I really wish this Starbucks was bigger. It's such a nice place to study but it gets so crowded. However, it does have good (working) wifi!

Starbucks, it is what it is. I stopped in to get my sister her Pumpkin Spice Latte, and I got myself a Caramel Macchiato (or however you spell it). It was hot, and tasty. The barista who served us was patient and humorous. It was early on Sunday morning and it was pretty busy but we still got our stuff within a reasonable time.

This Starbucks has really good service, a drive-thru, and very personable staff. The people at the window always seem happy and like to chat with you at the window...  Just a Tip: order your coffee "skinny" for sugar free, fat free creamer,  and half the calories but same great taste.
Extremely slow service. It's really disappointing to order a basic drink and wait 15 minutes at Starbucks.
Everything inside is great. You really need to try to find a solution to the parking lot/drive thru situation though.
The nicest people! They said "hello" and commented on my shirt and told me my selection was great. They boosted my day! I'll definitely be back for that kind of customer service.

Aruna needs a lesson in customer service.  Snarky comments and a terrible attitude is no way to treat a gold star Starbucks customer.  If I ask for something double toasted I expect it double toasted not a complaint.  I will go to the drive through starbys across the parking lot next time around to avoid this one inside the rest stop center.
The baristas are extremely helpful and friendly! Drive thru is always efficient and the cafe is enormous! My favorite Starbucks in Indianapolis without question!

In the interest of full disclosure: I'm from Seattle, and Starbucks WAS my local place, so they really can do no wrong.

This is my "home base" Starbuck's.  It's like Cheers when I walk in, but without the bitter mailman.

The line moves quickly and the baristas are consistent and learn your drink (and your name, apparently).

One thing I love about this Starbucks is that they're always having charity drives- either for the Gospel Rescue Mission, the Syann Kindness Project, or a local animal shelter.  They are always giving back LOCALLY, even though they're now a worldwide chain.  Extra props for that.
I come to this location a lot and its usually great - friendly, fast, and clean. However, on this visit 'Jef' was very rude to my friend. Tell 'Jef' to get his attitude in check.

We stopped in @ 8:33 pm for coffee and desert and they would not sell out of the desert case because it was for tomorrow !! Some are frozen they say, well u have a microwave. Can't use it they say.  REALLY !!!

I gave this place only a 3-star rating because the two times i have been here i have been ignored or had my drink prepared after people who placed their order after me. Besides that it is a very clean place.

I really like this location! It's a convenient area on the way to work. Most of the baristas are very friendly. It does tend to get crowded though. It's very hit-or-miss with the wait time. During my most recent visit, however, my drink was ready quickly! Also, I highly recommend trying the midnight mint mocha frappuccino! Yum!! :)
This review is especially for Michele hope I spelled it correct and who ever found my clutch purse......thank you for all your help...best starbucks ever.

Very pleased with everything about my visit here. Denise was very friendly and informative. I asked about the Caramel Flan and she gave her honest opinion saying as a caramel fan, didn't enjoy it. I mentioned how I LOVED the salted caramel Frappuccino, she proceeded to tell me she could still make me one, just without the salt topping. I was so happy and tipped a couple dollars, I wish I had more cash to tip as I payed with a gift card. Anyhow, friendly service, and even made a drink not on the menu. Thank you Denise and thank you Starbucks for hiring great employees. :D
This Starbucks is probably one of the speedier ones on State Street, you can really get in and out of there really quick.

There is no worse Starbucks... The drones that work here have no clue of what customer service is. It is 8:00am and I've walked into this store when there was only one car in the drive-thru and I am the only person standing at the counter. Four drones are behind the counter talking to each other through the headsets they are wearing and appear to be ignorant of my presence at the counter. No smile, no acknowledgement, and no greeting... I'm the only person standing at the counter...

After what seemed like two minutes to me, I couldn't take it anymore, I left and flipped this Starbuck's the bird.

A place to be avoided.

Very quick service. Very reluctant to get dark roast at any Starbucks especially at end of day. Usually taste burnt. Not at this Starbucks. Nice clean and fresh I got the Gold Coast dark roast. Will for that reason  and heat service make this a frequent stop when in the area.  Would of given 5 stars but parking is too limited
Incredibly friendly staff on this brilliant Easter morning. Numerous outdoor tables that don't feel directly adjacent to road. Rambunctous guys playing backgammon. All around splendid experience.

Ghetto sketchy bathroom! Omg. A few nice guys on staff are really motivated about coffee, professionalism, & sb's CDR philosophy. But there's a few dim wits who won't counteroffer the unavailability of brewed decaf with a "pour-over." This place really could use longer hours & more seating. Perhaps a dueling store next store? They get so busy, partners start taking shortcuts, unsanitary ones too :( straight from cleaning floors to making my drink without washing! Putting tools directly into the sipping edge of my cup! Yuck. Don't forget some of your best, most discerning customers are your OCD ones. Think about it howie. But that bathroom tho! :/

Seriously this is the worst Starbucks I've been too. I dread it. I wouldn't go here but it's in my way to the kids school. 
The parking lot is MISERABLE. The drive through line is always long and if you try to park then you get blocked in by the drive through line! 
Other reviewers are right this one is out of things regularly! Last time it was bottled water?! I needed one to take with me for a field trip. The staff did not offer me a cup of water I was unamused. 
They are slow. Friday afternoon we were here for 26 Min after school for one drink.
