You have been warned.

The Avon store is one of my favorites with super friendly baristas. Whenever I'm looking for "something" different the baristas throw out suggestions. Several of my favorite drinks were recommendations and experiments. The cake pops are still one of my favorite snacks and perfect portion control. Rarely an empty table between folks working from home and business meetings. 10th Street in Chapel Hill Plaza is a better option if you need work space.

I love the Starbucks, here, its been my go to spot since I moved to the area. But John(you say), isn't all Starbucks the same? O no my uninitiated friend, not at all.

This Starbucks is a perfect location in the busy intersection of Baltimore and Providence, and has a beautiful outside terrace in which you can enjoy a nice coffee along with a good cigarette, but obscured in someways from the main street. But not obscured enough where you can't do people watching with the people pulling in and out of the parking lot, or ordering their coffee in the store.  

You can sit there under the beautiful little trees, and while I don't know the scientific names of the trees. I've decided to name them Larry, Bill, and Mindy. Larry because he's just a stern SOB, and doesn't bend no matter what. Bill because he hates Larry and likes Mindy, and he's such a nice guy but damn it he hates Larry. Then Mindy because she likes both guys and man when you sit there for a while let the mayhem and drama ensue!!! WOOOOAAAHHH!!!!

The people at the Starbucks are quick fast, and very nice. They will never bother you, even if you've sat there so long that you're going to spawn half men half chair babies.

Ok this is kinda a word location.  I've seen several Starbucks now that seem to be part of a bank drive through. This one is no different, hence the pics. Service and drink were good.  Just puzzled by the bank drive through feel.  Lol

I'm wondering why the service at so many Starbucks in Tucson is deteriorating. I haven't been to this location for 6 months. I met a friend on a Sunday afternoon which is not a busy time. Only two people working which isn't a problem as I got my drink timely. The reason for my rating is the young man who made my drink said nothing and didn't even look at me. He said nothing! The truth is it takes the same amount of time to say hello and thank you as it does to ignore your customer completely. I will choose other Starbucks locations.
This is a VERY SMALL location. The parking SUCKS! Only 1 handicapped spot. The staff is usually pleasant and the drinks are usually delish. It's just alright nothing great'

Always rude workers, i have giving this starbuck so many chances and also being nice to them everytime i come but they are just a bunch of uneducated people calling themselve eduacated.

This Starbucks gets me the jolt of energy I need before I head in to USF for meetings. There are always students studying useful stuff like the anatomy of sharks or differential equations. It brings back memories of cramming facts in to my brain in order to extract them an hour or two later. Too bad Starbucks didn't exist when I went to school but somehow, I survived without it. 

Considering this location is pretty busy and parking can be a challenge, the staff always seems to keep their smile on which is appreciated.

For goodness sake! When you have eight orders stacked up, and another eight customers waiting in line to order, please consider cutting out the chit chatting with your buddies, and focus on actually doing your job.

Employees who are off-duty and visiting... please stop the socializing when your friends are trying to complete orders while customers are standing there waiting, and watching you all banter around.

Socializing and friendly chatter are great, but, please know when to cut it out.

I enjoy coming here not really for the coffee, although that's what most people are there for, duh! haha.  Anyway, I come here for the atmosphere and for the people.  The baristas and cashiers are always friendly and they will actually talk to you instead of just taking your order.

However, the 3 stars is really for the customer service and not the coffee.  I always order a few drinks and I change up my drink orders depending on the day and what I'm feeling like having.  So, typically in Reno I order my grande decaf iced white mocha with 6 pumps of white mocha.  For some odd reason this place always puts way more than the 6 pumps or someone's got a really heavy hand.  My drinks are always WAY too sweet so of course I change my order and make it like 4 pumps to offset the extreme sweetness.  It's never the same.  I wish they would be consistent on their pumps so that I can order my drink more smoothly.

Well, all in all it wasn't a too bad experience.  I always have an iced water to help me with the tooth ache infused white mocha or I just let my ice melt before I indulge in my chocolate treat.

For a good conversation come here but don't say I didn't warn you if you order a drink with syrup in it.

Cockroaches!

Hello!

I tell the staff at the counter every other time I order coffee at this location.
After a Month, cockroaches!

Maybe it's the old building or maybe it's all the homeless people that hang out in there.

This is likely the last time I visit here until they advertise a remodel or put up a sign on the front doors reading, "No Homeless Welcome".

It's a business not a shelter.

Buy something or don't enter.

It's not a personal shower room either, it's called a rest room.
We were able to go while there was no rush. Drinks were properly made. Only thing I don't like about this location is the location. Too complicated to get out on to the main road.
Great as usual.... Normally after long day of work I stop by for the latte.  Lol talk about being wired.  Work is never done when you are a mom so kudos to Starbucks lol
The drinks were good; the baristas friendly.  This is the second time recently where a Starbucks employee addressed a customer by first name as they entered the business - that's impressive.

It's a Starbucks so that's two stars. One star for the big room, but I had a business convo here and it was LOUD. drinks are what they are, the parking situation($5 in the back lot means I had an $8 green tea--a steal!!!!) is a nightmare, the room is fantastic relative to other Starbucks, and it's SO LOUD I understand why I saw a lot of headphones while I was going out the door.

I use to work a block away from this starbucks. I went there at lest once a week sometimes 3 times a week. but after awhile i stopped going because I realized they were not living up to their standards. they continue to state that they guarantee consistency. but this is not true, i order the same thing every single time and it is never the same. I understand that each barista is different, but thats way they train them to do each drink the same. so way is my drink aways different? I have gone to other starbucks and end up feeling the same way.
This place had fast service and friendly employees. Everything tasted the way it should. The Hall to the bathroom is alittle hard though with those Edison bulbs

What a great way to start my day!  Elijah was welcoming and reached out to shake my hand and introduce himself. We engaged in some pleasant conversation while my beverage was being prepared. He's a Keeper!!

The big Green Hills Starbucks.  Nashvillian Nicole Kidman has occasionally enjoyed the coffee here, when she's not helping hubby Keith Urban with his rehab.  Other celebrities and regular folk  enjoy sitting down for a drink of brew and some of Starbucks expensive desserts.
Not to burst the Starbucks bubble, but their pastries are just old and mediocre. How come they are so second rate?

Unless you have a LOT of time on your hands, and don't need to bring a car, I don't recommend this Starbucks location. Parking and drive through are a complete cluster. Using the Starbucks app to order won't help either. 'Drinks ready in 4-8 minutes' actually means 15-30. I will not come back here. Ever.

I love this Starbucks! When I just moved down the street from this location and took a few weeks for me to go in and I'll admit my first time there didn't make a good impression on me. One of the barista's was pretty much having an off day and when it came to my drink and a couple simple modifications on it you could tell his expression wasn't very friendly and he was mumbling complaints under his breath. But the next day I did decide to give it another chance and he ended up apologizing and now especially since it's close to my house I come here daily as a part of my morning routine!  I prefer the morning staff over the afternoon staff In my opinion the morning staff has better customer service, they are quick,easy going, and they make a point to make small talk or even tell you to have a great day, I also think the morning staff makes the coffee drinks better too. Each staff member has made a point to make me feel a part of and learn my name and my order! 

There is a barista that is my favorite and one I unfortunately don't know her name :( (she has short dirty blonde hair and she's average height, and is usually working very early morning like at 4:30 AM. Not very specific I know) but she makes my drink PERFECT. I don't know what she does so different but when she makes it she puts the right amount of all the flavors and it blends together perfectly.  And I really wish I knew her name because she does a great job not only with coffee but with customers also.
Def one of the best places to study for sure. Great quiet seating areas with private rooms. When you want to lounge there's a nice fireplace area to sit down in large comfy chairs and sip.

It's a Starbucks in an off-the-highway rest stop.  Hard to win from a service or atmosphere perspective.  That said, the extraordinarily long line moved faster than I expected and the drink was as expected.  A solid choice in a pinch.

Continually amazed by how slow the service is here. This is one of the biggest Starbucks in Nashville and they constantly are understaffed. Routinely only have 1 barista working when line is 10 people long.

Maybe it's because this Starbucks feels right at home nestled neatly on the boutique corridor of Illinois and 56th, maybe's it's because there's no drive-through or busy highway to deal with, or maybe it has that certain coffee shop feel that you get from the depths of a city neighborhood, instead of a strip-mall.  Whatever it is, I like this version of Starbucks.

It's pretty straight-forward; we all know what we get - tall, grande, venti, grip - frap, whip, skinny, sip.  It's quality bean at a fair price, that's why we all go.  So what does this leave me to review?  Service, of course.  These baristas are some of the friendliest around; every time I stop in, they are very welcoming and put me at ease from my chronic condition of running late for work - at least if I'm generalizing about myself...

Parking can get a little crammed on this side of town.  There's not much room behind the boutiques and there's limited curb-side spots.  There is outdoor seating when the weather permits, which is great for people watching  This is a great little pedestrian/bike friendly coffee shop in Butler-Tarkington, one I can raise my cup to.

This is the Starbucks closest to my work and I'd come out here even if it wasn't.  It tends to be pretty busy and attracts all kinds of characters wandering the mall, but the staff is always friendly and I've never had a bad coffee fix here.  Some of the workers do make an effort to remember customer names which is a nice touch.  It can be a bit of a wait  sometimes, but it seems to be because of sheer customer volume, as the place has all the staff that can fit in the small location and it's run well.  5 shots of espresso out of 5.
always busy and always understaffed. only stop by here if you really need coffee. the wait is usually not worth it.
This particular starbucks is always clean. Staff is very friendly,  fast, and know how to make a great coffee! Always my go to location to hit up right before work.
This Starbucks (inside travel rest stop) is quite possibly the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to in the world. Painful.

I always go to another Starbucks close to my home and get a hot chocolate. I have gone to the Starbucks at the corner of Baltimore Ave and 252 today and about two months ago, and both times I have been extremely disappointed. It's as if they waved a cocoa bean over the cup and considered that enough. Never again. Disappointed.

They have friendly and happy staff here. I think her name is Taiesha? She's lovely! I had my non-sweet chai and this was so good! I have tried many flavors from Starbucks a while ago when this is the only brand I used to drink. It tastes great when having it once a while. You can't go wrong with Starbucks brand. This location is very good too.
The ladies behind the counter were very friendly. My coffee was perfect and it was pretty quiet :) only negative is the fact there's no drive through.

Starbucks is awesome, except for this one. They take forever, even when nobody is in there. I complained about it and the employee at the drive they was so rude she walked away when I was speaking. I wasn't being mean, I just told her my issue. Horrible customer service and I will never go to this one again.
Favorite location I've ever been to. I sit at this Starbucks everyday to do homework and the baristas are nothing but superb. Greatest environment and service!

I've been coming to this Starbucks for awhile now and for the most part, it has always been a pleasant experience. I decided to get a matcha latte today and to my disappointment, there were still huge clumps in it as pictured. I don't blame the barista entirely because perhaps, she was not trained to properly make sure the powder is all dissolved when making this drink...She was kind enough to shake the drink for me again when I asked but it did not help much. There were still clumps in every sip. If I wanted solids in my beverage, I would've gotten bubble tea. Maybe invest in matcha whisk? Or train employees to make powder-based drinks differently?
Always friendly! Never feel rushed to make my mind up! Very good about offering different ideas!
Stopped in for coffee the oter day.   Under renovation so times of operation are truncated.  Coffee is as expected.

I've been to many Starbucks locations, but this Starbucks is by far my favorite. The employees are friendly & they make the drinks perfectly every time! I drive 20 minutes to come to this location because it's worth the trip!

The Employees are friendly, but are not super fast with filling orders, which is okay. They have a lot of homeless hanging out on the public sidewalks around the store, but it's not something Starbucks can control. The layout of the store could be improved as there is a lot of wasted space.
No decaf, no sugar in the raw or syrup, trash cans over flowing at 11am.  Didnt call when order was ready.  Not impressed.

Usually fast paced, good service. Never had a. Issue. The parking and driving conjestion is annoying. Park closer to target/publix and just cross the street (not worth the headache of tight quarters).

Busy and central location makes this a coffee stop and social event.   This location is open longer than the close-by Peets' or the other Starbucks, in the La Cumbre mall across the street. The staff always keeps a good pace and sets a high standard for the slower Starbucks.

This is a great new Starbucks located in the old Market at the Cheshire. There is lots of space to sit on both sides of the counter with lots of chairs, tables, and a couple couches. They kept the fireplace from the old restaurant so I can see this being a Starbucks that feels welcoming to those wanting to do some work or read over a coffee. There is even outdoor seating available for when the weather is decent.

The hours are great as well. They open at 5:30 AM everyday and stay open til 9 PM and until 10 PM on Friday and Saturday. The staff was friendly and efficient. This is a great addition to the area.

I love this place. It's very conveniently located to home, work, and everywhere in between. The only thing I don't really like is the parking lot adjacent to this establishment...but hey, that's not Starbucks' fault! 

The Caramel Crunch Frappucino is indubitably delightful!

This is the best @Starbucks I've ever been to. If you are lucky enough to have CeCe make your coffee you can count on it being perfect and even more importantly she might be the kindest person I've ever met. Thank you CeCe.

How on earth does a place that is SO SLOW stay in business?  Average wait time in the drive through line is 21 minutes.  And not to mention that these slow pokes cause the lines to run out into the road and jam up traffic every morning!
Just wait.  All we need is one other coffee shop to open up, and no one will continue to come here.

This location used to be my daily Starbucks stop. The girls were always awesome and the food/drinks always amazing. So I decided to stop in while in town today. 

The line moved so quickly that I was at the front ready to order before I'd said hi. As I was paying the barista looked up and said hi, commenting that I'd changed my hair. It's been 8 months since my last visit do I was impressed that she remembered me but she also remembered my drink AND my name. 

Such awesome staff and their drinks are perfect. No having to explain 3 times how you like your drink.

This is one star for this location. Everybody knows Starbucks so I'm not going to rate the whole chain. This Starbucks is unacceptably slow. The lines are long and they crawl along. It's so slow you may even miss getting back on your bus. 

F minus. Slowest Starbucks I've ever been to.

I swear there is nothing like "Starbucks" to me. Yes there are other coffee shops with different styles. Bu when you look at the long haul Starbucks is still at the top. This is 1 of 3 that are near me and I love all 3 of them. The staff here are amazing, the coffee is never off (no matter who makes it for me) Great job training the staff Starbucks. Love it.

I was very disappointed with my two experiences at this location. I stopped at this location this morning on my way to work. It was not crowded or busy, which is what was the most frustrating part of my experience. I waited over 15 minutes to receive my order of an iced coffee and a breakfast sandwich. The iced coffee alone took almost 10 minutes. I was not apologized to for my wait. On a weekday morning, its unacceptable to have that slow of service. I will not be visiting this location again. I love Starbucks, but I will take my business to Dunkin' Donuts for my morning coffee.
Stopped at airport for a hot tea.  Service was good and taxi tea was good.  Hard to mess up hot tea.   Not a bad experience but also nothing special to push higher rating.

I thought this was a pretty decent, if small Starbucks.  The location at an oddly shaped intersection can be a little tricky, and the parking lot is of course too small.  I didn't have any trouble with the service, I was greeted when I came in and my coffee was ready in a minute.  Couldn't believe how crowded it was at 9pm on a Tuesday night!  I guess free wifi is a huge draw with a college nearby.

Loved the outdoor patio option.. perfect for a nice night!

This starbucks is insane - it takes about three minutes to take one person's order (even though the orders are rarely complicated), and there's usually one line open while the dude behind the counter moves nonchalantly and is also in charge of "microwaving" sandwiches and dealing with every kind of pastry. Right now, on Sunday at 10:20, there's a line out the door and one guy at the register and one person is making drinks. Kind of a general trend in Starkbucks, it seems: I almost wonder if there's some executive order to tell a) managers to understaff their stores and b) employees to take their time. I understand if they're overworked, but  there seems to be no interest in moving the line along. It's too bad, because it's a nice, big space, but this place needs new management.
I was trying to write a review at the shop but the wireless was so poor it wouldn't work. ..it's a Starbucks for crying out loud...generic food brand coffee

Of the many Starbucks I have been to across the US and Canada, this one most consistently gets the orders wrong and has the most uninterested and bla se employees I have encountered. There is so little to meet the expectation of an experience here that it is just another place to get coffee. I prefer to go to the Starbucks kiosk in Target though it is much less convenient.

There is nothing like setting with a nice hot cup and eating a scone.  Yummy!  I love that you can get a wide variety of flavors either "to go" or find a comfortable chair to lounge in.  Today I had a need to do some things on the computer and found this place to be the perfect spot.  I ordered a Caramel Macchiato (vente) and a Cranberry Orange Scone.  This macchiato is my favorite drink at Starbucks with its blend of vanilla and espresso topped with caramel.  There is something about this combination that really appeals to that relaxing moment while getting a jolt of espresso.  I find the experience wonderful and mellow with a zip of pizzazz to follow.  The scone was very tasty and added to a light breakfast treat.

Like any chain store, been there done that; however, the thing I enjoyed was the friendly greeting and the helpfulness.  There is always a dialogue that gives that unique specialness.  The staff members are also flexible meeting your needs and encouraging a change from your favorite.  

I found the spot to be exactly what I needed; serving exactly what I needed.
This Starbucks is great. Fast and very friendly service every time I have been.  Love it.  The employees really go the extra mile here. Thanks
Starbucks is a great service place and know how to make the special menu items even some understand the name of the item

The young woman at the counter was sweet, and the barista was hopping.  Our drinks came out very quickly. Those were the positives.

As other Yelpers have noted, though, there is limited seating. Also, if this location were a horse, I'd say it had been ridden hard and put away wet.  The place had a tired, overwhelmed air.  Like it needed a thorough Spring cleaning, with steam to sanitize the surfaces.

I realize that they must get a lot of traffic, despite having no close parking.  The need to bypass citizens living in the streets, and the last smokers in California also nearby,  polluting the air, did not make a great impression, coming or going.

Not an easy gig for the employees to keep up with the challenges of the neighborhood.  I recall being at this store some years ago with the family too get hot chocolate for the kids and it not being so grungy.  Not my favorite Starbucks.

The worst. I rarely come here.  I may have visited this location 4 times ever. My last visit a few days ago was horrible. I am a self proclaimed Starbucks junky.  My kids and i are visiting one almost every day.  The cashier he was soo rude and condescending. I ordered what I always order and he looked at me like i was stupid. I repeated again and he says oh you didn't say that the last time. I did not reply because I was got and tired I just wanted my ice coffee and my daughter's drink and get out of there. I go to walk away and right before asking the next customer what they wanted he  psssssssst and laughed. Thank God it was too hot or i woulda been on world star for real. Never ever going back there again ever.
Extremely slow service. I will be taking my business elsewhere. I'd love to be able to stop here on my way to work, but the wait is disappointingly long.

Taking time out of my ever so hectic and fast-paced life clearly involves getting a fabulously relaxing and motivating massage at Hand And Stone followed by a hot, soothing,  cinnamon dolche with layers of sugar, sweetness, cinnamon, espresso, and warmth. Nothing beats treating yourself to pure pressure.

Growing up in this area, Starbucks has always been my only consistent friend. I have been going here since highschool, college, got married and now raise 2 beautiful sons, bought my first house.And everytime I feel happy or down, of course I never forget to stop by this Starbucks. Every morning when I walk in, I feel like home away from home. Smell of brewing coffee and the staffs are extremely friendly. They always make you feel special by  remembering your name and the right cup of coffee. Little things like that definitely help especially when you feel shitty that day.

Always fast and courteous. Rarely mess up my order (and I am a pretty frequent customer) unlike a lot of Starbucks in the city. Line is never very long. Mobile orders are usually ready before I get inside. Pretty much all you want or need in a coffee shop!

I stop here occasionally on my way to work...have always had good service and never really wait in a big line.  If you are in a rush...give yourself time since the traffic light to exit onto Ulmerton takes forever to change...finished half of my drink before the light let me go!  

Service is normally good so I will continue to visit this location!
2nd best location and a busy location as well. Clean store located near the FedX store.friendly staff. They were out of grill cheese sandwich so I was a little disappointed but good craft sodas

This Starbucks has a good location for hitting up the drive thru on the way into town from the East. As others have said, it shares indoor space with an adjoining bank. This doesn't affect anything really, as the people in the bank are quiet. The interior is comfortable and has a good variety of seating, even though it is not overly spacious inside. The drive thru is one of the more efficient and accurate drive thrus at any Starbucks I have been to. The staff is experienced and high quality. Service is quick. Reasons I give 4 instead of 5 stars is the inside being on the smaller side, and the fact that there are too many "regulars" who will hang out here all day every day, consuming space. Also, homeless people have the tendency to wander in and ask for money. Sometimes a cop is there who will tell them to leave.
Very nice and cozy starbucks location. Everyone here is just so nice and friendly. Got my caramel frappacino fix today and now im happy.
A new stand-alone Starbucks at the Delaware Travel Plaza... a welcome addition to my usual mid-way stop to New York.  Easy in, easy out, drive-thru!

Great location! Very well run. Even with a slight line, it moved quickly! On a hot July morning, the iced passion fruit treat was so refreshing. Seating area was ample. Even at 8 am, several folks in suits were busily working on laptops.
Come here all the time.  Convenient location to meet clients.  Free internet.  Great service and products.

This is my go-to starbucks to get coffee and chill. Great location and interiors. The only downside is Their EMPLOYEE ATTITUDE toward customers. They are always rude, aloof and often give me mean look. There are only a few staffs ( most of them are males) that are truly nice. Im by no mean to offend girls cuz im myself is a girl as well, but  most of poor customer service experiences i have had were from female employees, which is sad.

I frequent many stores all over middle TN. This is the only one I have twice now received rude, "I felt like I was at a McDonald's" service - two different female baristas.  

The first time I was shocked. I've always felt that Starbucks has always done an excellent job of weeding out the unpleasants. Apparently not this location! She argued with me about getting whipped cream - let's face it folks, they have the best - added to a beverage that didn't normally come with it. Really?! Her manager explained she was having some personal problems. Wow. This was almost a year ago and she still works there and is short with almost everone. 

Today, I ordered by phone app for the second time. First was in Mboro at The Avenue and it was totally cool. They had it sitting on the counter and I just walked in, grabbed, exchanging thank yous, and went on my way.  Here, I patiently waited by the counter watching others come in and then get their order. I wasn't upset, just thought maybe my order didn't go through. Before I had a chance to say anything, the barista closest to me, who had glanced several times at me waiting there, said:
"Are you waiting for a phone order?" 
Me: "I am." 
Her, in that "I am better than you and you are an idiot" tone that just makes you want to punch someone: "You have to tell us or we don't know and you'll just wait."
Me: "Oh. I've only done this one other time and they had it on the counter waiting."
Her, still in that tone: "Yeah. We don't DO that anymore because here people kept stealing them."
Like I'm supposed to know this!
No apology, she just handed me my two $5.00 beverages and turned away.
Not my favorite Starbucks to go too, I'd rather go to the one across the street in La Cumbre because there barista's are way more friendly. But coffee is coffee

My family and I called this Starbucks to see if they had they Unicorn Frappe since we were by it. The man on the phone was very rude and said NO Starbucks has them in this area! BS. I found 3, but we were by that location. I'm glad they were out! Will never do business at that one. Never doing business with Starbucks period! It's pretty shitty they roll out a new product and most places ran out Wednesday
I stop here about 3 times per week to get my favorite Pink Drink. Always greeted with a smile and great service !
They could use better ingriedents but in general the food is not awful. The java chip frapp is the best
It's starbucks so the two star review is not for products - but for the 15 - 30 minutes if takes to get a coffee every single time!
Great staff and yum yum for my tummy coffee. fav is the White Chocolate Mocha all around

Coffee and pastries were fine. Issue was the wait due to inept staff. There were two customers in front of me and it took me 10 minutes to reach the register. Unacceptable at an airport. Girl at the counter was friendly but didn't know how to properly work the register. I asked for my coffee in a double cup - got a single, ordered a coffee cake - got a pound cake. This happened to everyone in front of me. All this while a good 2-3 employees were not doing much of anything(let alone helping the confused girl) and another 2 were making drinks slower than I've ever seen at a sbux. Manager was busy counting money instead of dealing with the situation. Nice seating area - maybe I would've used it if I did't have to run to my gate!

I've been to this Starbucks on a few occasions. The time of the day, determines how crowded the place will be. Today I went early, expecting a crowd. My expectations were met. The store is very small, so when it is crowded it can be a bit uncomfortable in there.

The wait in line wasn't very long this morning. I ordered a Venti Carmel Macchiato with an extra shot of espresso. When it came time to wait for my drink, the line was long. Someone before me ordered a bunch of drinks. By the time the barista had my drink ready I hurried out of the store. My macchiato was delicious, however I noticed on the cup my extra shot of espresso was missing. No big deal. As I mentioned, I've been to this location before and they just can't seem to get my order right. Overall it was a nice start to my day, minus the missing espresso shot. I will go back if in the area and in need of starbucks, ill just make sure to pay attention to the barista.
It's right by my work so I come here all the time. Staff here is great, good service. Lunch time extremely busy though with a school nearby!
We were staying nearby and needed to get up early the next morning. I called to ask what time they open and they gave me the wrong time so it was closed when we got there.

I wish they had the breakfast sandwiches since the airport selection is so limited.  Otherwise service is speedy and the coffee is your typical Starbucks...  Kinda bitter and super strong, but sometimes that's just what a girl needs for a am flight

The staff is so friendly at this Starbucks ! Although I don't live in the area anymore I really do miss this Starbucks and the staff. The one I go to now has the worst baristas and they are incredibly rude so I just wanted to say thank you for always being so friendly and nice to your customers.

The worst yet! What has happened to the Starbucks standard. This is 2 different locations, and the first one I posted about the manager reached out to me on Yelp and said. Who was rude to you? Rather than saying, wow sorry you had a bad experience how can I help resolve it. Yikes, bad management, no leadership. Sad. 

The people working there are very unprofessional, the young man behind the counter was so rude, he talked to me like it was an inconvenience when I asked him, do you have my drink back there? Because he wasn't doing anything. There was a line of people also waiting. It was not an unreasonable question. I was next and he was not doing his job. He looked at me like he was going to burn my soul! I was afraid... not really but it was inappropriate. 

Then an other young man came to work and proceeded to make out with his girl friend by the counter before he started his shift, sorry bro don't want to see your tongue down her throat while I'm eating. Or frankly any other time, neither would her dad I bet! 

Next one of their other visiting friends decided to throw his actual pokemon cards across the room like he was practicing a live pikachu capture, it was like being with my 9 year old, I was about to put him in time out when darth coffee boy saw my disapproval and ask his young friend to stop. What a cluster. 

Not a place to come for coffee or to work for an hour!

I have been to many Starbucks all over the country and Myra is the friendliest  barista I have ever seen.  She clearly enjoys her job and brings A positive energy that fills the store.  She also is very committed to making consistent drinks for the customer to.  The staff as a whole is excellent. This is my favorite Starbucks in Tucson.  Ample indoor outdoor seating.

Great staff and ultra lively atmosphere.  Always crowded with nice people on the weekends.  Plus, it's in the perfect spot so I  always have a reason to stop in for my favorite beverage.   My favorite coffee place in Tucson by far.

March 18, 2012 Sunday - a drink 14:15 PM
1 adult (aka just me)

Atmosphere - 4 stars
Food - 5 stars
Service - 5 stars

Background - I ended up here because the South Valley Library is closed on Sunday's.  I understand budget cuts buy close the place on a Sunday.  Okay that statement says I do not understand budget cuts.

Atmosphere - Very clean small location but the problem is hard to work on the laptop with the very loud herds of skiers coming in after a day on the slopes.  It is the very first Starbucks in Reno on the Mt. Rose highway.

I was promptly created by one of the employees who helped me look for the K-cups, after explained what they are.  I normally find them at Target/WalMarts and grocery stores.

Future - Sure if I am in the area and need a coffee or caffeine fix.

"And can I also get banana nut bread."

This is a smaller intimate location. Not a lot of space for large groups.Their is outdoor seating with more chairs. They still carry all the tasty snacks and the employees are really nice, especially Tim.He is so knowledgeable. Its really a shame they don't stay open 24rs.

Supervisors: Kathy, Stephanie, Josh, Chris, Ashlie
Staff: Iszel, Katrina, Blake, Bridget, Jesse, Kellie, Jordan, Monique, Austen, Dakota, Jeo and Mars. 

This Starbucks location has truly become a home away from home!!~! I have been a loyal customer on and off for the past 3 years, and each and every associate has completely welcomed my hubby and myself into their store with such a friendly attitude. They facilitate any and all questions while assisting every order with grace and patience. They certainly have  that "je ne sais quoi" that keeps you coming back for more! We feel like valued customers and handled with superior care.
 
Kathy, Stephanie, Josh, Chris, the current Supervisors, all sustain superior leadership. A staff is only as good as the leadership provided; they are exceptional leaders.

All staff members are so informative about food items and their prices based on our caffeine needs. They also offer their expertise and suggestions for new coffee items/seasonal products.

This store is utterly impeccable! Each associate provides a service containing a higher standard of excellence, "wowing and delighting" us with their professionalism and knowledge. They are TRUE ambassadors for the Starbucks Brand (which we take quite seriously since we used to live  in Seattle). Because of them, this location is my FAVORITE Starbucks in the Sparks, Spanish Springs, Reno, and Carson City areas. They have retained a loyal customer in us and we look forward to see them with every impending visit!

Thank you Sparks Starbucks on Pyramid/McCarren for providing such wonderful customer experiences each and every visit!

St. Louis, MO Airport

Good coffee as usual. Workers need to drink coffee to wake the HECK up!!! Customer service sucks. My "warmed bread" is cold. 

Bad attitude from the servers...

This is my favorite Starbucks... Starbucks is by far one of the best coffee places in town and this outlet has it's uniqueness for me...it's a place to go if you want to be treated as a friend, not just a customer. The Baristas are amazingly awesome and work hard to make everyone feel at home. The caramel frappe chino which was refreshing and above average, java chocolate chip which is tasty...the tomato basil mozzarella sandwich which is hearty, healthy and yum, chocolate with raspberry filling pastry which was exceptional.

Okay before everyone goes crazy and talk about the price...make it a treat to yourself you don't have to have Starbucks every day me I do it twice a week most of the time I would use my Keurig at home to save money because let's do the math if you brought Starbucks Coffee 5 days a week for 52 weeks that's  $1,300 a year 

Overall It's expensive but worth spending every penny for the betterment of your taste buds (Don't judge LOL )  and outstanding customer service.

Vesta and I went to meet a bride, whose wedding we were probably going to shoot at this Starbucks, which was my favorite Starbucks on Earth, only to find it closed. We walked here, on that one day this year where we had some real snow on Reno's streets.

And stupid us, we left our phones at home.

We had been wondering why the Starbucks people would build a new store only three blocks up the street, when they had a perfectly good one on Virginia and California which was always full.

Now we new, they'd planned all along on closing this one, but when I'd asked the people in there they never told me that, which makes me wonder if Starbucks even told them.

Anyway, we figured our bride and her groom would have seen this Starbucks was closed and that they'd go to the new one. Which they did and which we found out five minutes later after we trudged though the snow to get to the most sterile coffee shop on this planet.

There was no homey atmosphere like in the store they'd just closed. And no tables where four people could meet. Yes, there were some outside, but it was snowing and about a hundred degrees below zero.

So I asked the girl behind the counter why they closed a good Starbucks only to replace it with a worse than crummy one and she said because here they could have a drive thru.

And apparently they want to discourage people from hanging out. Get 'em in, sell 'em something, get 'em out appears to be the order of the day with the new store.

So, nice, friendly, homey Starbucks, I'm giving you only one star, because you closed and that is just so sad.

I waited from 5:10am till 5:35am at the drive thru, it appeared that they were very late to opening. They were busy running around but no one cared to tell us that were waiting why they were over 30 min late to opening. Even the lobby was closed. I ended up having to leave after 20 + min of waiting making me late to work with no food.

This is probably one of the worst Starbucks I've been to. The vibe there is just horrible. The baristas really seem to hate their job. They always look miserable and never smile. They speak in suck monotone voices. They make your drinks with NO urgency. There were so many times I went inside and stood there for about 5 minutes (being the only person in line) as several baristas looked at me and continued doing what they were doing as if I'm not even standing there...I would love to see the manager that allows this to happen. The only reason I didn't give 1 star is because they haven't messed up one of my drinks YET.
Starbucks will always be the best coffee establishment around. I love meeting up with my friends and the outside seating is awesome!
New Starbucks on the block at 39th and Walnut! Always packed with Penn students and their macbooks. Has a plenty of food options. Great service

The workers were very rude. They were ignoring me even though I was the only one waiting. They look at me and completely ignored. Afterwards I heard one of the workers saying thay she didnt feel like talking to people that day.
I was in shock. I will never go back tk thsi Starbuck ever again.

Your typical corner coffee shop Starbucks...literally on a corner. 

It's quaint but there's nice seating outdoors during warmer months. I like sitting on the bar stools looking out the window. 

Parking is difficult because the lot behind it is shared w/ many other businesses and is a tight squeeze. If you're looking to just pop in and grab a drink, you'll have to search for a parking spot first.
Not the friendliest bunch of people... the coffee is consistently the same.  The rating is purely on staff customer service.

it was a blistery evening and Starbucks saved us from the freezing cold.  the barista warned us that the hot berry chai will taste bad, so he saved me a few bucks and recommended the apple chai instead.

my recent discoveries at the 'bucks:

-green tea latte: delicious if you like green tea powder / green tea ice cream
-london fog latte: hot milk tea without boba (really a british/hong kong drink)
-hot apple chai: is really hot apple cider
-thanksgiving blend - serving it 2 months later, it still tastes good
-ethiopia something - sidamo maybe?:  yuck - tastes like burnt coffee
-salted caramel hot chocolate: uncanny yet delicious

they need more chairs. maybe the intent is to get people go get their coffee and go away, but i would still like the option to loiter

On March 1st, 2018 at around 5:40 am, my boyfriend and I went to this Starbucks drive thru. 

We proceeded to place our order as usual. Upon approaching the service window, the young lady, named Thy, handed us our drink. My boyfriend accidently started to pull forward without paying before he realized he forgot and immediately reversed back to the drive thru window.  Mind you, it was very early in the morning and he wasn't too awake yet, hence the need for our usual Starbucks coffee.  Back at the window, My bf was in the process of getting his money out to pay her. He felt really bad and kept apologizing. She became even more impatient and flustered and then proceeded to make some rude comments and slammed the service windows shut on us. Shocked, we waited for her at the window for a few minutes, trying to get someones attention to get the payment. Someone else finally came and collected the money and was very understandable about the situation and apologized on the other young ladys behalf. It was clearly an accident but the way the young lady handled the situation was very uncalled for as well as highly unprofessional. Needless to say, we will not be coming back to this location.

Also, to avoid future instances like this, maybe the employee should learn to collect money before hand.

Starbucks ahhh classic! Love a good frapp every once in a while. It doesnt happen very often because this location always has a wait.Early morning I have no time for slow pace between traffic and always running behind this location for me would have me in search of a new job. Parking is impossible at times I mean they are connected to the bank and also a very busy mall....Always a drive thru line unless some random hour of the day.Cake pops a guilty overpriced pleasure I adore. Do not care much for there breakfast only a fan of the coffee. I am a dunkin donut kind of gal so this is 3 stars for me.

I've come here a few times while traveling and just driven through the drive through. It's usually pretty quick and friendly. But today the line at the drive through was not moving. At all. For 7 minutes. So then I decided to go in. There was a long line, and I waited for about 15 mins. Then when I finally ordered, I asked for a large cup of ice water in addition to my coffee. I was told they "only serve water in tall cups." Despite the fact that I know they have venti considering I ordered a venti iced coffee. I get policies but considering the long wait they could have made an exception. Then when they called my order, it was wrong. And the counter is incredibly dirty with coffee and grounds everywhere. I'm sure it's just a rough day but there are a lot of pissed off customers in this place today. This has only happened to me one other time in my hundreds of visits to Starbucks around the country and usually they will give you a free drink as an apology.

This place is always packed with people playing (or working) on their macs.  Seriously, what is up with that. I'd feel completely left out if I bring my PC to this store. 

Besides that, the store is big and cozy. The barista ate nice and helpful.  It's always been a pleasant experience when I buy coffee from here.

Mind you, I do not like Starbucks at all. The only reason I came here a couple of times was for meetings plus I had a gift card. I will say, they're on top of things & know what they're doing. Nice staff & they seem like they have a lot of regulars that come in.

Stopped in for an iced tea and the new toasted coconut cold brew for the hubs. Drive thru was quick and friendly. They got my order right (we bring our own cups and often it is quite noticeable that staff do not like it when people do this) and did not balk. :) Drinks were made quickly and I was ordered and done in under 3 minutes. 

This location is much nicer than the other one in PH on the same road. It did not have a drive thru and it was small and cramped. It did have a nice shaded patio though. I do miss that. 

Well done new Starbucks. You deserve a raise (employees...) :)

YES i'm giving starbucks a review..

I am the typical caffeine junkie.  I drive to work grumpy, I open my store grumpy, I walk into Starbucks.  Instant smile!!  When it's warm out, there is nothing better then a ice coffee black eye in a larger cup with TONS of ice.  I have it unsweetened no cream if anyone decides they wanna drop off a cup of coffee for me.. =)  OR in the winter, Cap with extra double shot.  I told you I like my caffeine.  During those glum days I'll add a shot of peppermint.  Brightens me right up.  I love this starbucks in particular though.  The staff is GREAT, they remember everyone by name, and what you like.  The lines are quick and that extra buck in the tip jar is totally worth it.  Why I didn't give them 5 stars is because the prices now are RIDICULOUS.  I can't give up my daily starbucks, but that doesn't mean I'm not a little peeved that I'm paying $42 a WEEK for coffee.
Love Starbucks !  Friendly service and bought some Florida souvenir mugs.   My son loves the Cafe vanilla.  Service was quick and efficient.

Very ticked off.... drove around for 30+ minutes to find parking only to walk into Starbucks, only a few patrons. Ordered the Mango Dragonfruit drink only to be told it couldn't be made. When asking if the upstairs was crowded, was then told the upstairs was closed for "game night"??????

WHAT THE HECK IS GAME NIGHT?

Not even the courtesy of a sign posted on the door to share this information with the public. This is poor customer service for an establishment like Starbucks.

Did drive-thru early on a Saturday evening.  There was only one car ahead of us and none behind us.  Got to the speaker to order and a guy's voice came on and said, "Can you hold on."  There was silence for a good 5 minutes until a female's voice came on to take our order.  Pulled up to the window, no one in front of us and still no one behind us.  Waited for over 5 mins and no one came to the window - was about take off when the window finally opened.  Never greeted, never thanked.  Not what we are used to when spending money at a Starbuck's.  One star because the drinks were fine, but like a previous reviewer here indicated, it's the workers that make the Starbuck's since the menu is pretty much the same at all of them.
They're my second favorite Starbucks in the area. The baristas do a great job most of the time, however!
Great people, hard workers! Always gets drinks right, cares and positive attitudes! Pleasure coming here! 100 stars!!

I really like this Starbucks. Everyone is generally very friendly and the drinks are always good. 

My only real qualm is drive through speed can be a little slow. All in all, it's still my favorite SBux in the area.
Great location.  And they have a DRIVE THRU.  Starbuvks is consistent no matter where you go.  I like this location due to its proximity to Mount Rose Ski Area.  Enjoy.
Beautiful. Absolutely wonderfully remolded. If parking was better this would be my Starbucks of choice!

The system was down today and couldn't take money. That's okay. They gave me my coffee and did so with a smile. The lady ahead of me was a complete douche. She was all cranky about it. That's okay douche lady. I tipped them $10 and will continue to go to this Star Bucks. Minus one virtual star for not having a drive through in Safeway for my lazy moments. Plus one virtual star for the employees being fabulous! I love you to the moon and back coffee. I mean Starbucks.

This location has a drive thru, which is cool if you're in a hurry. My friend and I were not in a rush, so we enjoyed our beverages in the lobby. We were someone greeted by a barista who right off the bat told us they were slammed. There was one guest in front of us (who ordered one beverage) and drive had four cups on their bar. There were four people on the floor and her telling me they were "slammed" given all this information warranted very little sympathy. Anyway, I ordered my drinks and told her that I wanted to use some rewards. She acknowledged and ran my card. I'm waiting for my drinks and I get a push notification telling me my new balance on my card; she had both used a reward and charged my card. I don't know how you could do both, but she seemed "slammed" so I didn't want to inconvenience her to do a refund; I had to call customer service later. So I probably wouldn't return to this location again, since the one person I dealt with (she rang me in and made the beverage) was not very nice or welcoming. She didn't say thank you or smile once.
Not a happy camper sine they increased prices ... But I love studying here.

Employees Always friendly and professional and courteous
Great options . 
Highly recommended 
I love their fast google wifi that is free.

Great service at the drive through! Not only did she offer my dog a pup cup of whip cream but she was very pleasant with a nice smile! My husband was so entertained giving our two dogs the pup cup that he actually started to drive off with out my Americano! We all got a good laugh at that!
Come and socialize or just put your face to your laptop and enjoy the fine fine coffee !
It takes forever to get a brewed coffee! I can't believe they stop brewing coffee so early! This was such a poor idea! I thought Starbucks was a smart company.

Good coffee and great atmosphere. My pet peeve is when there are no "comfortable" chairs. This place has them! So nice for relaxing on this rainy day. And the staff here was very personable. I was pleasantly impressed by them. Whenever I am in this neighborhood again, I'll stop by for sure!

Mobile order not ready.  They said it wasn't received. They asked if I sent it to the correct location. I showed them my receipt with the correct location. Then they said maybe someone took it.  I mobile ordered because I was in a hurry.  Employees did not offer anything to make this inconvenience right.

They're okay. Customer service isn't spectacular compared to other Starbucks. Drinks are accurate most of the time and if they aren't right, the baristas will remake them. It's in a convenient location and the parking spots are close to the store, making this a good stop when the weather's nasty.

Don't even bother to order any sort of flavored drink, they don't put enough syrup in it to even notice. Save your money and go with something straight up. My caramel drink was the least flavorful Starbucks drink I have ever had.

The ladies working don't give a crap either and are not very attentive. It's a very disappointing, unfriendly Starbucks.

This place is a pit of misery and despair. Save yourself the indignity of paying money for their attempt at imitating a normal chain location. You'll also find yourself consistently bullied by the staff, especially by their miserable and outwardly rude manager. The placement in the library may seem to make sense, but it's just impossible to navigate because of the volume of students going in and out through the coffee shop. Recently they've renovated the inside to stop the line from reaching out the entrance door 24/7, and it lasted for a short while- but go figure within half a semester the whole store was in chaos and the line was flowing out the door again. This location is just awful. Zero stars.

The service is pretty fast 
My order is always correct and the 
Staff is great this is one of my favorite Starbucks to visit of course I'll be back again try the spinach fold it's really tasty
Although it's very convenient to come here as an employee, every time I come here, the same worker ALWAYS handles the money and the food. Gross.

I stop by this place pretty much everyday on my way to work. Staff is very friendly, and they pretty much know me by name and what I like to order. Try the reserve coffees on the clover. 4 stars because as others mentioned, parking can be an issue...

This is my neighborhood location and naturally out of convenience, tend to frequent it. It is typically a mixed bag in terms of service, and last night's visit was especially unpleasant. Not sure of the hiring criteria, though an absence of former customer service experience seems to prevail. To top it off, I stopped in yesterday and was greeted by wise remarks from one of the baristas for placing a simple mobile order. Seemed to play it off as a joke, but came across rather as an insult, especially when the other workers joined in on the fun. Mind you, this was in a store full of patrons within earshot.

Management needs to overhaul their entire service approach. A customer should never leave feeling berated by the staff. Regardless of proximity, I'll take my business to another location.

I used to come here often and today I realized why I stopped. I always get a grande iced hazelnut latte with an extra shot. This place does not follow standard Starbucks recipes. My hazelnut had an extra shot but they added wayyyyy too much hazelnut. The coffee was so sweet it gave me heartburn and I ended up throwing more than half of it out. I don't drink anything that is too sweet which is why I ask for an extra shot in my lattes. This one was overly sweet and undrinkable. Every time I go in my order is messed up. I'll be going to a different Starbucks from now

Starbucks have always been the same to me - the same drinks, the same ambience, the same food and what have you. But this Starbucks stood out especially to me - because it is an AMAZING place to study. I usually hate studying at Starbucks because of their small, tiny coffee tables and their cramped seating area but this one is large in size, airy and THEIR TABLES ARE HUGE. The lighting may be a little dim, but their large tables and abundance in outlets makes up for it. It's near Vanderbilt campus so its mostly students who come in, which is really nice 'cause that makes the noise level relatively low since we're all struggling with school together. I absolutely LOVE coming here. It's hands down my favorite Starbucks.

I love the taste of their coffee. It really can't be replicated BUT they need to diversify their pastry selection. They rarely add anything new. But my biggest beef with this location is that they are so slow!!!!!! There is no sense of urgency. I guess it doesn't matter if it takes 20 mins to make a coffee (even when it's not busy). It's crazy. Drive thru or walk in its all the same.

It's a Starbucks. They are all the same, that's a good thing. When you go there, you know what to expect, Starbucks coffees, friendly service etc. 
It has a big outdoor seating area.. inside is small and a little cramped. No drive thru.

This location is always busy, and I can see why! It's conveniently located, the staff is extremely friendly, it's clean, and there's usually enough seating to hang out and get some work done. The few times I've used the drive-thru have been quick, granted it wasn't when they were very busy. If you're in a rush, I would definitely recommend going inside rather than waiting in a line of cars that wrap around the building.

This Starbucks is exactly what you'd expect from a Starbucks. The drinks are how they always are, and they have mobile ordering.

The parking lot, entrance, and exit are all a nightmare. There aren't enough spots and it's difficult to get INTO and OUT OF.

I am writing this review only to remind people to BE NICE TO YOUR DAMN BARISTA!!! I watched some psycho get angry because the barista called out the name "Eva" instead of "Ella" (because the cashier "connected" the L's and made it look like Eva). The barista even had to offer her a new cup. Instead, the patron took the barista's Sharpie and re-wrote her own damn name on her own damn drink.

People are fucking stupid. It's coffee. Please be patient and kind.

A non profit organization I volunteer for uses this Starbucks location
for some of their meetings. During the meetings-of course-
people who attend the meeting buy Starbucks products. I contacted
Starbucks Corporate to ask for a donation for a large fund raiser event"
my organization is giving. Starbucks Corporate--which has a
Foundation" told me it is not their "policy" to donate to charitable
organizations. I wrote to them again to ask if our local Medford
Starbucks could at least donate a small gift card to be used in
our auction. Again-the answer was "no".
The Medford Starbucks is a highly popular (and I presume profitable) community destination.
Many non profit charity organizations in the Medford area use this
Starbuck facility for meetings.
Medford Starbucks-with their lack of cooperation with community
non profits--strikes me as avaricious and not willing to give
back to the community it services and profits by.
Please note-that the Medford Dunkin Donuts (Stokes Rd) was more than happy and willing
to contribute anything they could to our non-profit.
And that is where our business and your business should be from now on!
Best starbucks around. Awesome staff and fast drive thru as long as someone doesn't clog it up with an add on order at the window.

This Starbucks in Harrahs casino is the absolute worst ever. We went on December 31 at about 7 PM, and although there was nobody there, The server is an absolute nightmare. I had asked to use my Starbucks reward, and she rang it up with the deficit on my gift card. She is surly and unwilling to help. When I asked her why she took it off of my Starbucks card as opposed to using the reward, she said I would need to speak to the manager and she had no idea when the manager would be back or I would be able to help. She was atrocious. I would never ever recommend anybody to go to this Starbucks.
Nice friendly people. Clean and well stocked. Close to major stuff on City Ave, and near 76. Very large outdoor cafe area.

I'm always very happy with this Starbucks.  There are several tables that have excellent lighting which makes it a good place to park and study when I get too distracted by my television at my house.  My other favorite thing about this location is the fireplace in the wintertime.  It's right in the center of the store and surrounded by cozy chairs which makes it an excellent place to curl up with a book.  

Parking is pretty nice, no drive through, nice front patio, and very friendly employees.

Very disappointed. The frap wasn't made correctly as in it tasted funny, but that I could deal with...the one person working while the other lackadaisically talked to a "patron" was a little off-putting. What is more, a)the "patron" was not buying anything and b) she was taking up half the register area just talking about personal subjects with the second worker. I have worked several jobs where I have had personal conversations but you move to the side and move real patrons along. Not here. The "patron" stood there for at least 10 more minutes...who knows how long before I got there. This whole time customers SLOWLY moved through.  It was clear to see they were not pleased with the "patron" and we all knew she had either worked there or felt entitled. Now she moved to the side (where her boyfriend sat with their Wendy's bags) and loudly discussed personal matters with the workers while people waited. . Then she engaged the first worker in conversation while the store was busy. Needless to say, she was a complete nuisance (the "patron") and yet no one working seemed to mind setting the customers back in time and inconvenience them for the sake of this rude, inconsiderate person I hope does not work there (short, blond hair). I will go elsewhere and recommend the same to everyone. Kind of yucky experience. I think she put the baristas in a bad situation, but I also think she needed to be put aside for paying customers.
I normally love Starbucks but the staff at this one is lacking. It take 15 min to get my order and then they made it wrong two more times. :(

Those who frequent Starbucks have a home Starbucks. California Ave. is mine for two years now and more to come. Caughlin Ranch was for a decade before. I've have never had an unpleasant experience here. Not once! You get to know the employee's when you're a daily visitor, they know what you order every time until the moment you scale back to a regular coffee due to a coffee habit that will finance one employee's monthly paycheck! That is too much coffee!!! Whatever! Down the hatch!! 
  Venti nonfat triple hazelnut macchiato. One to three a day. Addicted in a bad way. I'm happy to hear this Starbucks is building a new store two blocks up S. Virginia with a DRIVE THRU!!! Woo hoo! And a reverse press! Excited for the new store!!

I frequent this Starbucks 3-4 times a week and never was all that impressed with the personalities of the baristas. They appeared disgruntled as I often overheard them talking poorly about their managers. Today, when I ordered a woman named Kendra helped me and was extremely friendly with excellent customer service. She appeared genuinely happy to do a good job and it makes a difference in my experience. I think this location has definitely stepped up its game over the past few months and it is showing in the attitude and cheeriness of its employees. Good job, Starbucks!

Looking for a place to sit down, do business, and have a cup of coffee? DON'T COME HERE!  This starbucks is always FILLED with people who don't have a home and USF students who don't want to do their schoolwork in their dorms. I've never been able to meet with a client at this starbucks because there is NEVER anywhere to sit, and being that starbucks doesn't tell anyone to leave, they never leave. Students stay here and complete their whole assignments, so coming here would be a waste unless your coming and going. I think this starbucks should be a caffeteria on campus

Drive thru is slow, but inside is even slower. Parking is dicey as the cars in drive thru wrap around the building. Never seen two registers open regardless of how busy they are n the coffee is good, once you get it. Wish it wasnt so convenient...
The baristas here are welcoming & friendly.  The lobby is large & clean. Love this Starbucks!

I had few bad experiences with this Starbucks.

First, the quality (or taste) of the drinks is not consistent, sometime, it is strong, too strong, (I had a green tea latte that taste BITTER), sometimes it is tasteless, (had a mocha that taste like water)...

Second is the service. The last time I came here, after I placed my order, I thought maybe I should reload my Starbucks card too. So I hand my money and card to the staff, she said "Next time you reload before you order". How in the world do I know which way is more convenient for you?!!! Not even a PLEASE? really?!!!

Now I rather walk few blocks away to the Barnes and NOble Starbucks on Broad St to get my drinks. Atleast their service and drinks are comparable to other Starbucks. I think since we are paying for our drinks, we deserve to get a good quality drinks, not just drinks with a brand without quality!!! Starbucks company should really look into this...

Stoped at 615 am for a breakfast sandwich; sausage, cheddar and egg. English muffin was toasted and warm, but eggs, cheese and meat were all cold!  Yuk!!  Didn't realize until I took a bite several miles down the road should have gotten my receipt so I could have called Starbucks and made a formal complaint!

I've been going to this Starbucks for the past 6 years & ive never had any problems. Clean store, friendly employees, fast service. It sucks that they had to get a new manager because she she can changed the mood in the room in 30 seconds... She comes off very mean and I feel like a burden when I go in to get coffee. And now that all my favorite employees left because of her I will not be returning to this location. Someone should really teach that manager about customer service or else I'm sure more & more people will not go back to this location.

Not much to say that hasn't been said already.  Park across the street to avoid the parking lot (it's easy to cross on foot due to the near perpetual traffic on 252).  I would love to see this Starbucks expand into the Quiznos to either add to the lot, add a drive through, or add additional luxury seating for long-term squatting. 

That said, this is my neighborhood Starbucks and while I've been to bigger, roomier, and more convenient locations, I'm still partial and a bit biased to it!  As Sarah said, buy out the whole building and you'll get my coveted and highly sought after fifth-Yelp star.

This location is very convenient to where I work, so I go in often. 

They're fast and accurate which is usually all I require for a 3-star starbucks review, but they also get bonus points for being friendly. 

I do wish there was more parking, but that's the downside of downtown.

The lovely lady at the register got this terrible location the lone star you see above. I wish I could remember her name but she was at the register on 8/13 at 10:30am. Back to the multiple reasons why this is a location I'll never patronize again:

1. While ordering, the person asked "will that be all for you?" after every. single. thing. I ordered and I only ordered 3 drinks: a venti iced vanilla latte, a venti matcha green tea latte, and a refresher (they were out of 2/3 we initially wanted). 
2. After leaving, all 3 were found to be incorrect. The vanilla latte wasn't flavored and it was tagged as a regular latte; the refresher had no flavor, and the matcha tasted like hot milk.
3. Upon returning and explaining the issues, the barista said from behind the woman at the register, "we're out of matcha." SO THEY MADE MY DRINK WITH THE TINY BIT LEFT INSTEAD OF TELLING ME THEY DID NOT HAVE ENOUGH FOR A VENTI. It was CLEAR there probably wasn't enough left for a tall. Did they think I wouldn't notice that it DID NOT taste like matcha and instead like a warm cup of milk?

The barista even nodded when I said, "so they made mine with whatever was left." He knew that was what occurred and didn't even apologize. The wonderful girl at the register was the ONLY one that was apologetic or kind. The barista was a jerk. 

They were also out of EVERYTHING. How can a Starbucks be out of so much on a Monday morning? I feel like the management here is dropping the ball on many facets of customer service. STOP ASKING IF SOMEONE IS DONE ORDERING AFTER EACH ITEM! The customer will tell YOU when their order is complete. Also? Teach your baristas not to make drinks if there isn't enough powder to make it. LOTS of people know their drinks and are well-aware when they've been shorted.

I won't be going here ever again. We have so many other coffee shops and Starbucks nearby in Tampa, do yourself a favor and drive 5 minutes to the one on Hillsborough.

This Starbucks is always busy. Same people out front with their pets ... A lot of people on laptops ... Ultra thin Starbucks very little standing room.  Not much of a place to go for the ambiance, the employees and location makes up for the lack of interior flare.  

I do like when I complained about some food they gave me another sandwich on the house.  Amazing customer service.

YEAH, another  Starbucks! NOT....I get so angry at myself Everytime I stop at one of theses $$$money sucking establishments. So many better ways to get an afternoon pick me up.
The menu, establishment  & vibe is the same, status quo. The caffinated beverages are good, but not worth the outrageous prices & in this case pompous attitude.
What's a girl to do? Get a grip & stop at a local venue for an afternoon jolt of caffine.

I almost granted starbucks five stars because I NEVER actually get coffee or any of the other sugar loaded shitty tasting drinks/baked goods. But the almost five star rating was due to the fact that every single day I bring my own tea packets and they give me a large cup of FREE piping hott water or when I'm thirsty they kindly give me grande free cups of ice water. Thanks for the free hot and ice water starbucks.

I really enjoy going to this Starbucks. The staff is a collection of some of the friendliest service workers around. There is plenty of seating so you can comfortably settle in and get some work done... in fact, it's for this reason that I drive by the more conveniently located (for me) Springfield store to go here. 

The major downside is the parking lot... it's a cluster-you-know-what during rush hours. Luckily I'm usually an off-hours visitor.

No long wait, great service and made just the way I like it.
Scones are amazing.

Certainly no major issues as its your stereotypical Starbucks. Naturally there's a HUGE parking/traffic - flow issue with such a small parking lot, but that's more of a semantic argument. Definitely some of the nicest bauristas I've encountered, with several of them providing personalized attention. Almost always my morning go-to spot!

They say that every hour of the workday you spend sitting down in front of a computer that you should take 10 minutes to walk and let your eyes rest. Well fortunately for me Starbucks on 21st is about a 10 minute walk.

Today I went to my local coffee mecca for a post-lunch caffeine injection. Little did I know that Starbucks is currently running a promotion on the new Blonde Roast. I tried it and it was delicious. Not only are they offering free tastings but you get a little VIA brew pack along with it! Free is always my favorite! I ended up getting a cup! And you wouldn't believe it if I told you but there were actually open tables and no line at 12:30 in the afternoon. I thought I was transported to the Twilight Zone. No thirteen year olds, not Twilight the vampire one. Sheesh! 

I have also become a huge advocate for reloading my registered gift card. Girl, you get free flavor shots ($0.50 savings!) as well as other little goodies emailed to ya. I know, I know. We as yelpers should be focusing more on local business but it is for my health. You know, the 10 minute walk!

There was nothing incredibly significant about this particular Starbucks except that I really had great service. I chose a new drink-I should know better-I didn't like it at all. The staff were happy to replace it, which really made my day. Thanks a million, definitely made me want to come back!
This location always feels like Cheers except with coffee.  Quiet cozy place one the corner in a great neighborhood.

The easiest way to get in is through the muvico parking lot, otherwise you have to go through the winding roads around all the shops where i'm always scared someone is gonna hit me. 
Can't say anything bad about this location. The line can be a little long and slow but nothing bad. The inside of this Starbucks is really nice. Great place to sit and chat. They have cute little tables inside and the same old table and chairs outside. 
Parking can be a little bit of a hassle because there are so many other places sharing the same parking lot. I always end up parking on the corner by the muvico or way down by the Jimmy johns.

This Starbucks is awesome.....

The staff here is just unbelievable and it the customers are so great... It a pleasure to sit and enjoy great company of a cup of joe in the morning

I work near this Starbucks location, so I am there quite often. What I enjoy most, is that there are a few employees that take the time to get to know their regulars, remember their orders, and really just put that extra effort. Even after not visiting for a few weeks, the first day I came back I was greeted by name and my preferred beverage was getting started before they finished ringing up my order. It is that extra effort that makes this Starbucks location stand out from all the others. 

As far as food and product go, this location is pretty standard to all Starbucks. The coffee is strong, and the espresso beverages very customizable. They offer the toasted breakfast sandwiches and lunch sandwiches here. The product selection is pretty small since the location itself is quite small. There are only two spots in the store that offer the "comfy seats" but there are many more seats just inside the office building for Starbucks patrons. 

The reason I'm not rating five stars, is there is pretty high employee turn over. This effects service, and when the new employees are behind the counter the service slows. But it is that small core of employees who have stuck around that make my trips for my daily caffeine fix very enjoyable.

I'm actually pretty upset about my experience I just had at this Starbucks. I ordered eight drinks most of them Venti I ordered a caramel frappe Pacino with an extra shot they forgot the extra shot. I ordered two Java chip with chocolate and caramel drizzle they forgot the chocolate drizzle. They forgot one of my drinks completely and when I went inside to get the drink there was no apologies they just blamed it on me saying that I didn't pay for it in a very rude tone I waited for the drink and when I was given with to me no apologies were made either. I'm extremely dissatisfied with this visit me and my entire office go here for drinks on a regular basis and if we dodecide to stop using it it will be a significant loss in business
Danny at the window is the man. Always makes me and the puppies smile on our way through!

Great service as the staff are friendly and will go out of their way to satisfy the customer. I enjoy coming here for my favourite cup of coffee while I catch up with friends. The snacks are always fresh and in stock. I recommend that you try the flat white. It's a like a latte only much creamy. It costs a little more then the other drinks but I think it's worth it. 
The only downside to this location is that they don't have a drive through. However they are in a convenient location right on baseline Rd. I have not tried the patio but then again I haven't been in sherwood park that long. Maybe when the weather warms up :-)
Worst Starbucks ever!!! My cheese danish is always burnt and cold in the middle and my ice coffee taste like vanilla right. Staff needs to be retrained!

If you would like to feel like Patrick Swayze from ghost and be overlooked (as a full grown man) when you are standing in plain sight in front of the register, and then watch someone walk up and get greeted and served in front of your eyes, then this is the place. It gets better. If you would like to order a hot cup of coffee, but receive it room temperature because they feel that's the way you should be drinking it, then this is the spot! Oh and if you want 3 brown sugars, but there is only 1 left, this is it! It gets better, would you like creamer? Tough luck, there isn't anything out at all! Not milk, creamer, or anything of the like. This location has a new theme, it's called hide and go seek while you play the character of Casper! What a unique experience!

This Starbucks is one of the most hit or miss establishments that I've ever patronized. Sometimes you get a nice person helping you who makes your drink well, and sometimes you get...uhh...something entirely different.

There have been countless times where I went in for a beverage and was told that they did not have the ingredients necessary to make it. There was a straight week where they were out of ice. Like, really? Ice? 

Usually the service is terrible, usually there are 1,000 people in line, usually the cups aren't filled to the top, and usually the employees spend more time talking to one another than they do talking to the customers...but sometimes everything goes off without a hitch.

So, this review isn't really helpful.

Just know that this isn't *really* a Starbucks. It's run by Sodexo, which is why they don't take Starbucks promotional materials (coupons, star redemption, etc.), and also why they get away with everything they do.

I'm not really one to typically review a Starbucks, but this place is a cut above they typical Starbucks. The drinks are the same of course, but being next to a university, the ambience here is really conducive to getting work done. There are ample tables, benches, and seats that invite you to stay to enjoy your drink or to get some work done. 

The people who longer tend to be students, and being around students always gives me a charge of energy, as if I were still of that age as well. 

I really like the layout of this place and wish more Starbucks made an effort to creat this type of environment.
Ordered a Venti cookie crumble frappuccino, got the order right and in a good time frame.

I'm a frequent visitor to many of the locations around my area. I usually order the same thing; skinny vanilla latte and a breakfast sandwich. I went through the the drive up and was greeted by a very friendly barista. While I waited she chatted me up and was peppy for the 6am hour. I was pretty tired and her contagious attitude helped pep me up. When I got my drink I gave it a sip and tasted awful like burnt coffee.
