I went in and out when I explained it didn't taste right the manager took it right away apologizing and had the other barista make a new one. His demeanor was very different and was disgruntled having to make a new one. When I got the new one it tasted the exact same. I was sorely disappointed that drink went to waste. They could have had 4-5 stars but when you can't make a standard staple drink on your menu that's a problem.

Very friendly baristas here, I'm usually greeted when I arrive. 
Plenty of free parking.
Plenty of indoor working area space and seating space. 

The drink quality on Saturday afternoons however is unpredictable. 
I've even had one barista who was reluctant to remake a drink. I order no foam lattes (I don't get how people like drinking a drink that contains 1/4 foam) and you always know when there's foam... Not only is the drink significantly lighter but you can see foam when you lift the lid! When I asked the barista to remake it she insisted on explaining why there was foam instead of saying "yes". Of course I understand why foam is produced but that has nothing to do with fulfilling a customer's "no foam" request. Steam more milk, use a spoon to remove any foam, fill with milk... 

Needless to say the drink was remade without foam but not without some coaxing :-/
I would not recommend stopping for coffee at this Starbucks unless you have an entire day to waste. Unacceptably slow staff. Stopping here tacked on at least 30 minutes to our journey.
This has to be one of the slowest Starbucks anywhere. Even worse, because it's in an airport. Wait of 15-20 minutes! Grrr!

This Starbucks has an awesome local and such a friendly staff. You can tell they really care about their customers and want you to have a good experience. All of the customers that attend this Starbucks seem very close knit as well, which is a nice feeling in such a big city. The only reason I am not giving it 5 stars is because of the seating arrangement / size. It's a great place, but everyone loves it so sometimes It's hard to get a table or even a chair to sit at. I have visited this location and a handful of times I've had to go somewhere else to study since there wasn't any tables open.

Decent Starbucks. I'm liking this one more than La Cumbre now because there is more indoor seating, including one large, long table.

I also appreciate that mobile orders are placed out in the open as soon as they are made, rather than placed in hiding, which makes me have to ask for my drink (Camino Real).

There's also a small patio directly in front of the shop. Occasional questionable folks may be around here. Think long term unemployed or retired and trying to sell you some ebook.

It's not New York speed, but everyone is very friendly, and attentive. The size is decent and outdoor seating is available as well. It also has drive trough option which is convenient in the way to the beach.

This is the worst Starbucks ever. There were 3 cars in front of me in the drive thru (a short line for this location), and it still took 15 minutes. And if you order on the app they never have it ready when you get there. I'm literally done with this location.

What a wonderful location tucked away off the street, next to The Hampton Inn and Suites!  Although there was a glitch with my Mobil app order, Tori the manager, handled the situation with grace and class. I enjoyed the service so much so, I purchased additional boxes of tea and coffee to demonstrate my appreciation of the wonderful customer service. 
There is a lovely patio location where you can enjoy the sunshine or finish your last chapter of your book!

This is the worst Starbucks ever!  No matter what time of day they are extremely slow.  I've visited this store st 6am and was only the 2nd customer and I still had to wait 10-15 minutes for a cup of coffee! 
When I visited 2 days ago I ordered a caramel Frappicino.  It took me about 25 minutes to get my drink.  And when I did it was watery! I told the girl it's not supposed to be like this and she grabbed the drink and said she will put more ice in it! I didn't get a chance to tell her no thank you please remake my drink.  When she did arrive my drink looked like flavored ice.  No coffee.  It was horrible! By the time I left over 30 minutes past and I was left with a $6 nasty drink.
Just a warning that parking is nonexistent.

We were here relaxing before they closed & I asked 3x what time they closed. We were completely ignored, the 2 guys were on their headsets talking to each other then my nephew asked again & before we finished he yelled back at us & says 9. And when we first arrived no one was here & one of the guys said I will be with you in a minute it took them 5 minutes to help us, definetly customer service issues needs to be addressed by this guy for sure!!!! We were here on evening of August 27th.

This is a pretty good located store.  The menu is consistent for other Starbucks.  The visit was not memorable.  There was no line and my order only took a few minutes.  I like how well staffed the location usually is, so even if there is a morning or afternoon rush time, they wait hardly varies.  They do have outdoor seating which was nice on such a nice and warm fall day when I was by.  I am a bit harder on stars with national chains, thus the average rating.  You will get the kind of product and experience you expect at Starbucks at this location.

Solid cup of coffee.  If I had some "big project" to work on, this would be a good place to hammer it out.  Always get the feeling I don't look "serious" enough, but, what are you going to do?  Nice place to hang...

I usually go to this Starbucks. I like the location even though the parking is sometimes a challenge. 
I would have given them a 4 1/2 star rating but since it's a four or a five, I gave them a four as I feel a five is without any problems.
Most of the people that work here are very nice and do a great job. However, last weekend I stopped to get a frappuccino and the lady that was working on the frappuccinos had a mess on the counter. It was mostly milk and water but when it come to food and drink, I want to see a place spotless. When she ran the cup through the mess, it turned my stomach. I took the drink, wipped off the bottom with napkins and left.
I was back the next day and the lady behind the counter was very clean. This made me want to keep returning since that is normally how things are at this location.
I will be returning there. If the service and cleanliness continues, I will change my rating to a five star.

one of my 2 favorite starbucks in Tucson!  I love taking my kids here on our starbucks "date".  The staff is super kid friendly and always happy and helpful.  I love that they blend the naked juice for my kids too...so nice!

Went inside this location and the drive thru would've been three times faster. Not sure if the guy inside running the register was having problems or because they had only one barista working. Ordered an ice coffee and two frappuccinos it took them over 20 minutes. Inside of the store is nice clean and has comfortable chairs to sit and its has free WiFi. However....stick to the drive thru... the barista is cranking out orders super fast.

Update: went through Drive Thru today thinking it might be faster this time. ....wrong.  Ordered two cake pops for my daughter. Sorry they are still frozen...wait no there not? Vanilla Bean Frappuccino did not have lid on securely. . .yep, it flipped over onto my cup holder and all over my daughters leg and carpet.....Napkins Ma'am? No....im going to need my the inside of my car detailed. Wait...I'm not done. The second Frappuccino came ....double chocolate chip. THE LID WAS NOT ON SECURELY. Chocolate drizzled down my arm & window panel.Handed it back. I'm all good. Won't be back.

What can I say? It's a Starbucks after all. Not my first choice for coffee but pleasant to do some work in a comfy oversized chair with soft music in the background. I was there for 2 hours and it was crazy busy the entire time. Coffee was.....Starbucks.

I went into Starbucks this morning (Sunday, 12/18/2016) at 9:50. The place is always busy when I occasionally go in, and I have no complaint about the service, the store in general, or the bathrooms. If it were just that it would be at least 4 stars for me. The problem is the black coffee, and this may be generic to many of the Starbucks. I had a tall size blond roast which was just terrible tasting. Blonde roast when freshly made should be smooth with no off taste and sometimes you can get it that way. It is just the inconsistency that is the problem. Maybe the coffee was made much earlier in the morning and it sits in the large canister too long or whatever. To be realistic Starbucks does not survive on the quality of its black coffee, so even if this is important to me, it is trivial to them as a business. Maybe I will have to bite the bullet and go where a fresh pour over is made for the customer and pay the cost of that in Santa Barbara until finally my bank account is empty.

We bought several cups of coffee here during our stay. I agree the service is not fast, and one of our orders was incorrect... But the baristas and the manager are super nice and personable! One of the baristas, Sandy, was especially awesome and came over to sing happy birthday with us to our friend in the group. Thank you!

What's not to love at a Starbucks! The variety of coffee, the holiday coffee, and even the holiday coffee cup the world melted down for.  That Venti holiday red simplistic cup always held the best beverage for me in the morning so I personally had not problem with it at all.  This location the staff is always super pleasant.  They have gone to a Skype type order system so you can see your barista taking the order.  This location also moves pretty quickly so don't let the long line fool you, you'll zip through pretty quickly and be on your way.

I've got to say at least they are consistent! Sooooo slow! Like painfully slow. It's unfortunate because it is the closest to my home. But it is actually faster to drive to a further location. If you don't have 15-25+ mins to wait on coffee DO NOT GO HERE. Two stars because the employees at least at the drive thru are really nice. 

Side note: wrote this review while waiting in line for my coffee

It is never a bad thing when a Starbucks has a drive thru.  

The service at this particular location is always fast and friendly and my order has never been messed up.  The location of the actual drive thru line seems to be in a bad location but it is functional none the less.

As far as Starbucks go, this one is occasionally my favorite because:

1. they make coffee
2. they are open 24 hours

repeat...

This Starbucks is located within the Providence Town Center shopping plaza, so you won't find any drive-thru here. You will find two entrances though, one on either side of the shop. The inside is fairly typical of most Starbucks I've been to. In addition to coffee's, tea's, and an assortment of food, you can also buy Starbuck's branded items like mugs, coffee, etc. Plenty of seating options offering both indoor and outdoor seating and my kids like to sit up by the bar and watch the barista's do their thing! It's also nice being able to stop in here, grab a coffee, and then walk around the shopping center.

I'd suggest getting coffee at one of your many other options. When our "kids temp" drink burned my daughter's mouth, I went to the bar, was ignored by the 4 partners standing there for a few minutes, and when I finally got the attention of the shift supervisor who was bar supporting the barista and asked POLITELY her to add some cold milk, her response was to say "I made it kids temp", and initially refused to take the cup from me. Momentarily taken aback, I said "excuse me?" At which point she repeated her statement, and snatched the cup from me. She splashed some milk in it and returned it to the bar with an eye roll and not another word. I get that it's not the end of the world, but I'm very aware of Starbucks policy toward customer service and for heaven's sake, the cup and the signage says love your drink or let us know!  So, I'll go elsewhere and find a store that believes its own PR.

Very disappointed go there almost weekly great crew but unicorn frappachino .daughter wanted one went by did not have it called later they answered the phone stating that they did not have it before I could even say anything.   Why have a new product and not have the ingredients to satisfy your regular customers?

Location of this Starbucks may just be my favorite given all the retail therapy I can do in the area (Pier 1, Target, Kirklands).  The staff is awesome, always super friendly and always spell my name right (bonus).

I meet girlfriends here for coffee dates because I love that they have plenty of outdoor seating.  

Look, it's a Starbucks... I love Starbucks... this is a great location with great staff.
Great Starbucks!  The Baristas are friendly and often have my drink ready before I get to the register.  Lots of comfortable seating and a terrific patio.

Not sure what kind of crowd surge they were expecting as they are located across the street from the convention center.  Thirty minutes in line and no coffee still.  Seems like an opportunity for work flow analysis and communication with the convention center.

This Starbucks has the best drive through of any Starbucks drive through I've ever been too.  The line is always long but they are usually really fast.  However, the other day they made me pull around to the front of the store to wait for my breakfast wrap. In the 3+ years I've been going to this Starbucks I've never been asked to pull around and wait, so it was disappointing that Starbucks is apparently implementing McDonald's crappy practice of asking customers to pull forward and wait.  But otherwise I think this is the fastest Starbucks in the St. Louis area, but maybe they're trying to be too fast...
Very small very busy but service was good ... I miss the big Starbucks the one I used go to where I can sit and read and have Carmel macchiato .
Love this place. Very cozy, though I never sit down. I always just grab coffee and go. The staff here is almost always great
Wow the staff tonight were pretty grumpy. Not a smile, not a thank you. NOTHING. YIKES.
Regular Sarbucks.  My latter came out good and the person who took my order was nice.  Just like most of Starbucks location, it lacks of tables and sofas.

I like the set up of this Starbucks and it's usually full of people reading, studying, or chatting.  It's location is convenient in that it's near the Green Hills Mall and shopping areas, but beware of the traffic to and from the place!  Use the light to get out if you need to turn LEFT.

Service: Speed (Good), Quality (Good)
Taste: Green Tea Frap (really tasty)

One of the worst customer service experiences I've had a Starbucks was at this location in Septmber. My boyfriend and I stopped by on a Saturday afternoon and ordered a drink each. The girl at the til did not even smile at us or seem enthused when we ordered our drinks. My boyfriend wanted a cup of blondo coffee (his favourite) and she immediately responded "we don't have that available right now - only the Pike roast. So I immedately asked her if they wouldn't mind making him his own cup (I know other Starbucks do this with no problem whatsoever). So she huffed about it and said "fine". Oh I was so mad at her rude disposition. We stood off to the side afterwards, awaiting my drink (chai latte) and in the meantime, there were a few more customers who were in line to order. About 5 minutes later there was no indication that his coffee was ready, so I walked back up to the til and the girl was not there. Instead, she was busy chatting with a male employee just inside the doorway as I could hear them. I stood there for a good minute until she decided to saunter back out to the til. She smugly asked me what she could do for me and I told her we were still waiting for his coffee. She turned around and realized she hadn't even started it so she said "oops, it will be a few minutes". She didn't even apologize. I was so mad at the whole situation, it was my boyfriend who had to steer me away from the counter and calm me down. So, bottom line, the staff working there that afternoon provided me with the worst customer service in recent memory. I will NEVER go back to this location again.

I love rating Starbucks against smaller, more local, more interesting coffee shops.  Once again, this particular Starbucks isn't as good.  Stopped in at 11am, ordered medium roast.  It tasted not so fresh.  Service was reasonable but not very friendly.  Some Starbucks employees are cheerful, not here.  

This particular Starbucks is long and narrow with nice decor and a decent selection of baked goods.  It is fairy new and looks that way.
It's the closest Starbuck's to my office, so I keep going back.  They don't have the quickest service at this location.  The staff is either very friendly or just kind of bla.

These folks have the wrong recipe or don't know how to make the new lime and berry refreshers. GROSS. Should be a tinge of lime green, instead was bile colored and sour rancid in taste. Yuck.

+2 stars for not rolling your eyes and happily making another beverage for exchange.
They're always out of breakfast wraps and Protein Plates.  Yack.  Service is great, though!

Not the quickets Starbucks around, and the barristas were a little less than friendly, which is the reason for the three Stars.  I have had my espresso burned a couple of times here, too, whcih means the barrista's aren't used to making it correctly or were not trained on the process well enough.  This location is also hard to get too.

This is the worst Starbucks. They're building a bigger store in the same parking lot, which is a good thing because I know how much business they lose because of their tiny store and lack of parking. Everyone I know knows not to visit here during peak time. I made that mistake today. I had about 15 minutes to kill so I figured I could avoid the waiting and confusion by placing an online order. I placed my order for 2 coffees and a bakery item and it said it would be complete it 4-9 minutes. I circled the parking lot for 15 minutes until I realized that if I didn't get in there soon my iced coffee would be water. Had I not already placed the order, I would have just said forget it. I had to park extremely far away from the building. I got inside and they had not started my order. I had to wait another 10 min for them to put it together. The straw that broke the camels back was when they handed me my order without a tray and said they didn't have any. This has actually happened a few times here. I had to walk pretty far to my car and somehow lost the straw to the second coffee I purchased. Needless to say by the time I got the second coffee home, the ice was melted and it didn't have a straw. There are bigger problems in life but this same situation has happened to me multiple  times at this location and I've never taken the time to complain because it's just coffee but its coffee I spend a lot of money on, which I don't mind as long as you're not taking my money and my time. I will not be visiting this location again until the new building is complete. Hopefully they can work out the issues. This was 30 minutes of my life I can't get back and the beverages weren't worth the aggravation. 

I'll just add that the staff is always very nice, but they look as overwhelmed as the customers waiting do. There is not enough space here and they can't provide good service when there are that many people waiting in such a tiny place. It doesn't help that people are already angry before they get in the door because of the parking situation.

This place could be better. The seats and tables outside always have bird poop on it and is always dirty. I understand these tables & seats are outside 24/7 but it is clearly unsanitary for you to put food and drinks on infested bird poop tables & chairs. This starbucks puts your name on the cups which is a good thing however once they make your drink they don't say your name they say the name of the drink which confuses customers because two customers could be ordering the same drink. The new hispanic employee making the drinks, clearly english is not his first or second language so when he says the name of the drink you can't understand what the hell he is saying. That becomes a problem. I asked him why he can't just say my name of (AJ) that would be 10x easier he said " I only do what I know to do Okay my friend" Fuckin Classy! This is not Miami hire people who speak Engish. When I was in Seattle the head quarters of Starbucks everyone spoke English and they called my name each time.

i have found that this particular starbucks location is one of the better ones compared to the other locations in santa barbara. david and the rest of the weekday morning crew are the best - awesome customer  service and mad skillz in making a perfect drink every time.  iced tall soy 4-pump toffee nut latte, please!

The staff here are very attentive and remember your order if you are a regular.  I get my drinks a lot quicker than at a lot of other ones in the area.  The staff is also friendly.  Great place to chill.  Lot of good stores in this mall.

This particular Starbucks deserves a great Yelp Review.  They are always over the top helpful and friendly. Always willing to answer my questions about certain drinks I'm not sure about and they just seem like they're having fun at work.  I love when an employee can joke with me like they're happy I'm there. This rarely happens anywhere these days! Definitely 5 stars for the Starbucks on 82nd as you're driving into Keystone.

I don't expect much from Starbucks. Just conveniently located coffee shops when I need that afternoon pick me up. This Starbucks falls short on so many levels...

First off, the staff were not very congenial. I felt as if I was imposing on them and "making work for them."

Second, the food in the display case did not look very appetizing. I think it was several days old. Maybe they should consider doing like the Japanese and use plastic models of their food if they don't sell enough product.

Third, the black tea I order was awful! It tasted like it had not been brewed since yesterday. I would not be surprised if it was day - old tea. It was so stale and so skanky- tasting, I ended up throwing it out. Waste of money for sure!

I will not be visiting the Starbucks again!

I would consider this a typical Starbucks, except for the size. It is TINY! If there are more than 2 people waiting, there is barely a place to stand to wait for your drink without stepping on someone else's toes! Despite the size issue, the employees have always been very friendly and my drinks have always been correct.

This location needs a couple improvements. The layout is poorly designed. It is very crowded. They could also use an extra barista. I only saw two working. Was everyone in the back room on break? The place was packed and Tyler was busting his tail making the drinks. He was very pleasant doing his job.

The restroom was pretty dirty, I thought I was in a Hollywood Starbucks. The floor could use some attention. Management needs to have enough workers to keep the place clean. The two that were working were busting butt and doing a good job.
I feel like without fail this location always has an overflowing trash can and debris everywhere, it's a real eyesore.

Nothing different or disassociative about this location other than it's in the airport.  Dropped in right before my flight to get a perk me up and was served quickly and politely.  This airport is pretty laid back so I doubt they get a crowd ever.

No seating in this location, it's just a walk up style setup.  Smaller in size overall than most any other I've seen but that's relative to the size of the airport I would think.
Always get great friendly service at this location whether it's a quick stop for my morning coffee or I'm heading over on an afternoon break for a pick me up.
Drive threw runs slow. And the sign can hardly be seen from the street. This is US19. Invest in a bigger sign!

This was the first time going to this Starbucks and I have never recieved a poorly drink until today. I ordered a chai latte and my husband got a white chocolate mocha. As we drove away I opened my cup and saw my drink was barely filled 3/4 of the cup not to mention most of it was foam. I decided to check my husband drink to see that his cup was only half filled and the remaining space was just whipped cream. I was seriously disappointed. If we weren't already on our way back home to Clarksville I would have seriously asked for a refund because messing up a drink that bad twice isn't worth trying to remake.

Fantastic Starbucks. The service was great and they made the drink perfectly the first time. It is also downtown Santa Barbara and it makes the walk downtown just that much better with a perfect coffee in your hand.

Very nice store. Outdoor seating away from traffic. Comfortable variety in seating/working areas.
Friendly baristas.

First off the mice gross me out at this place. It's not the cleanest Starbucks around. But really make sure you don't ask for a receipt at this place. I asked Steph for a receipt on my order today. She said okay in a few minutes. Then she asked me a second time what I want. I said a receipt. Then I wait for her in the back room for several minutes and she comes out and asks me a third time what I want. I said a receipt and I'm not sure how else to explain what I want. She was totally bothered by the requests and said it would take a while to get one. Fed up, I left. If they can't accommodate a simple request I'm guessing I know why they have a pest problem there. They really don't care. She and the staff can stay there and hang out with all the mice as I don't want to go back...

I have gone here almost every weekday for the last 8 months and they mess up my order at least twice a week.  I am sincerely thinking of changing my route to a longer one just so I'll pass by a different Starbucks. If it's not them completely not listening to the order, then it's them handing me a completely wrong drink. I don't know who's training these people, but maybe the whole store could use a refresher class. I've even tried slowing down how I order but it doesn't make a difference. I'm still getting the wrong drinks. The one in Oldsmar is way better, as well at the one in Dunedin on Main Street.

There was a memo going around today to women at businesses saying "If Yvett R. happens to walk into your establishment today, be extremely rude. Extra points for creativeness". Wasn't there? (see my Best Buy review for earlier today)
We'd been out practically all day and stopped by Starbucks before heading home. Now, I'm here all the time and I'd never seen this barista. I was in the mood for one of those Cap'n Crunch Crunchberry frappuccinos. Now, I know this has been around for years but I'm not daft and fully realize that not every barista will know what this is, since it's not a real menu item. So I don't order it that way. I just ask them for a Strawberries & Creme frappuccino with a shot of hazelnut and a shot of toffee (get two shots of each if you're ordering a Venti). I was ordering in that exact order when the barista looked like she'd been kicked in the gut and interrupted me. "YOU WANT HAZELNUT IN THE STRAWBERRY FRAP?", she asked. I said yes and also asked for a shot of toffee. Again, "MIXED IN WITH THE STRAWBERRIES & CREME?". I said yes and she stared at me for a while before shrugging and saying, "OKaaaayyyyy. . . ". 
What gives? I mean, it wasn't HER drink and isn't the customer always right? If I wanted the drink that way and I'm paying for it and I'm not asking her to taste it, what difference should it make to her? 
We were waiting for our drinks while my husband was making fun of how I'd been treated by ladies that day when the guy that makes the drinks called out for me. He read out my drink and asked, "Oh, you like the Cap'n Crunch drink?". A-ha! At least HE knew I wasn't crazy. Take THAT, judgmental drink lady. 
Yeah, I'm whining about today but I know and you know that I'll be back.

Great Service. Connected in building with Chase bank which I do go to. The barista was very helpful giving a great suggestion I would have never thought of - Iced Egg Nog Latte with Chestnut Praline. Oh my heaven.

Probably my favourite location in St. Albert... which sucks for me, because it's the furthest away from me hahaha.. just my luck.

The staff are friendly and they never seem to be out of stuff.  Well, at least not the things that I want.

Service is fast and efficient and orders are always correct.  What else can you want?

Very busy location were parking is challenging and getting a seat to have a chat with others is almost impossible.   This location has outside seating on busy Route 252.  Coffe us quite good and the baristas are attentive.
My drink was really good here. Barista was friendly and fast.   Bathroom was kinda gross and the dining area needed a clean up.

Fantastic upstairs area for people watching.  It's a chain so everything tastes the same as it does everywhere else in the country.  The Bathrooms were pretty dirty but thats to be expected when there is a 15 minute wait.
Stopped at drive through at 9:30pm and recording said they were closed. 9:30pm on a Wednesday? Seriously sign says 10pm. Somebody wanted to go home early.

This is the better Starbucks location on State Street!

Some reviewers have been confusing this location with the always-super-packed Starbucks across from the Paseo Nuevo mall that has the 2nd story loft (800 State Street): http://www.yelp.com/biz/starbucks-coffee-santa-barbara

Though this Starbucks is a bit smaller than the other location across from the Paseo Nuevo mall, it doesn't have such a horrendous line/wait or crowds. Orders are prepared within just a few minutes! How much nicer this is from the other Starbucks, where you have to regularly (I've never been to that location without a crowd packed to the door) stand in line for ~10 minutes to place your order and then wait another 10-15 minutes for your drink to be ready. It's terrible there!

I am willing to bet that the time it takes to walk the extra couple blocks down State Street to this location (from the other one), get your drink, and walk back up State, will still be less than it takes to get a drink from that other Starbucks.

Come here for serious drink relief!!

I guess good service depends on who the barista is at the time.  We went there for Lattes one evening after eating at Harrah's Buffet, and the place was deserted except for an employee rummaging around in a back room.  We waited and waited....there's no bell to ring, so finally my friend decided to poke her head inside the door to tell them we wanted to order and the rude employee says "hey you're not supposed to be back here".  

Well...you're supposed to be watching for customers, Ms. rude employee,  and not keep them waiting.  

The next morning we go back for lattes and the service is quite different....very friendly and quick service.  So, go in the morning.
Great Starbucks...cheerful employees no matter what time of day! Quick service in morning so I can get to work! One of my favorite Starbucks for service!

The service was quick and on point. I'm not sure of the other reviews but I got the drink I wanted quick and the service was super nice. Drinks was good and got me through my flights so it did what it was suppose to be done. I got the caramel frappuccino.
Pricey for a Starbucks...although I do have to say I very much appreciate the fact you were open on Christmas Day. My family thoroughly enjoyed it. Thank you.
The slowest Starbucks I've ever experienced, it takes 10 minutes to get a coffee every time
Slowest Starbucks ever. Seriously. 10 minutes to get a large black coffee. And it's like that every single time. Why do I keep coming back?!
Free Wi-Fi, Hot drinks, friendly staff.  Parking can be a hassle.

I nearly always have a great experience here! Friendly staff! And they really have a great layout for meeting with friends or working - I actually prefer to meet people at this location over Greenfield or Irvington because it's a better setup, imo. 

They have caffeine on tap, what more could you want??
Service seems to have improved, along with accuracy. Thank you for stepping it up, Starbucks! My faith is restored.

Andrea must be having a bad day.. Shouted at my daughter when she asked if her drink was correct and then tossed requested spoons her direction.. Hey shouting at my kids is my pastime no need for Starbucks to get in on the act :)

Cute shop. Friendly staff. Located at the corner of State and Cota.  The End.

What more can I say...it's a Starbucks.

Smaller size but great service! 

There is a bar right by the front window and maybe 1 table and two chairs.
The parking is not the most convenient, it should be open in the back to park but you just have the front and side options.

Not the best bucks to work from but an easy stop when hitting up spots up and down the pike!
Always fast and staffs a pleasure.  I literally haven't ever had my order messed up!).  I'm loving  that they all pay close attention to the order given by costumers
The drive thru tends to be rather slow at this location so I normally go inside.

Instead of posting a review, I will post the customer service complaint I filed with Starbucks following one particular visit which made me want to reach through the drive-thru window and punch someone (don't mess with me before I've had my coffee, kthx).  I still don't think I'll ever return to this particular location, but I do love Starbucks as a company and they did send me free drink coupons to repair this situation.  Just consider yourself warned if you do happen upon this location.  Otherwise, I know we all need a little moderately priced, legal stimulants every once in awhile (or every day, in my case) and Starbucks perfectly, convienently, and consistently fits the bill.



"To whom it may concern:
This morning I went through the drive-thru at this location.  When I came to the window, I paid using a debit card.  The woman working the drive-thru handed me my drink and pastry, said "Thank you" and closed the window.  I'm a frequent customer at this location and usually they ask if I want a copy of my receipt (and I always do want a copy of my receipt to track my purchases on my debit card).  This particular employee did not ask me if I would like a copy of my receipt and I had to flag her down and get her attention to open the window again.  I asked her if I could have a copy of the receipt at which point she began to LAUGH at me and stated "Well, it's going to take awhile."  Waiting "awhile" would have made me late to work and I was unable to wait.  I did not appreciate the way this woman laughed at me especially since she blatantly ignored what is probably policy/procedure to ask customer if they would like a receipt.  Though occurances like this are rare, this HAS happened at this location before (several months ago) when I was actually QUESTIONED when I said "Yes, I do want a receipt" and the drive thru person literally made fun of me for "keeping track" of my purchases.  I am a big fan of Starbucks (of course) and generally am pleased with the customer service, but today really was upsetting for me and I will likely not return to this particular location.  I do not appreciate being laughed at and I don't know why it is anyone's business why I want a receipt.  I realize the value of trying to to cut down on the use of paper and that is why customers are given the option of declining a receipt, but those of us who actually want a receipt should not have to deal with employees laughing at us, questioning us, or in the case of today, flat out refusing to give us a receipt.  Please contact me further with any questions or information as I would really like to return to this particular location (it's very convenient on my commute), but I refuse to do so until I know the customer service has very much improved.  Thank you."

A plug for their corporate offices - they responded to me in less than 3 days and sent me 2 coupons (for a free beverage of any size) within a week.  The only issue is that these coupons read like a scarlet letter and spell out the fact that you are/were a disgruntled customer.  I felt the need to say "Don't worry, it wasn't at this location" when I was using the coupon.  Oh well.  I'm too cheap to care at this point.

Unsanitary , do not eat here! I got a breakfast sandwich, I watched the clerk take my money,  prepare my food, push things into the garbage,  serve my food, then serve the next customer.  Never washed her hands a single time. I watched her do this over and over while I waited for my drink. The clerks preparing my drinks did an excellent job.  Call me crazy but I'm a health care professional and people die from handling food, garbage, and money improperly.  There are government standards in place for this very reason, I think a food inspector should visit so the required safety measures can be implemented. Perhaps employee retraining is needed. Now I must get brunch elsewhere. .....

I visited this Starbucks three times in two days and it was good. They have quick service and most of the people working there are nice. However, I asked for water with no ice and they gave me ice twice. When I brought it up, the barista was a little snotty with me.

I tweeted Starbucks about the ice issue and they replied. Perhaps they'll change their policy because giving customers ice without asking is weird. The body assimilates water best at room temperature and they could at least ask first.

I went into this starbucks because the one inside target was slammed & so glad I did. The baristas are super nice but still get their job done. From now on I will make the extra stop instead of going inside Target.

This used to be a nice starbucks. Just a few months ago there was a different manager and different staff. Now it's terrible. The customer service is awful and on Saturday the coffee was so bad I gave it back twice and then asked for a refund. No one likes burnt coffee that's been sitting in the carafe for hours and hours. If you brew new coffee into the old it's still going to taste bad!!!!!!!!!

I was there on Thursday, December 8 at 3:14 a.m.  The employee, Joy, was EXCEEDINGLY rude and incompetent.  She was apparently inconvenienced over my order of a pre-made breakfast sandwich and a latte.  Rather than making the latte, she handled the next customers.  (It was not busy at all).  Finally, it was discovered that the espresso machine was malfunctioning.  No apology.  Miserable.  I regret placing $2 in the tip jar when I paid for my transaction.

The service here is excellent.
The parking is still pretty awful - and now there is a "Super" Wawa next door.
Nonetheless, I still come in every month or so for a $5 latte.
I love it, it's expensive, I feel guilty when I do it - but I gotta have a starbucks fix every once in a while.
I always get a very tasty mocha from this shop.  I do however ocassionally experience a longer than anticipated wait do to large groups of people apearing from the mist...

As a gold card holder, I LOVE Starbucks coffee! I live near this location, so I've waited to write this review to make sure that nearly every experience I've had sucked. Well, it has. This is the WORST Starbucks I have EVER been to! Their service is absolutely terrible, unable to handle one customer, let alone a line with (oh my gosh) 2-4 people in it.  They only ever have pike place brewing, and the one time I opted to wait for a pour over, it took what felt like forever and my car was ticketed. Today, they ran out of pike place, and instead of giving me an immediate refund so I could be on my way, the girl behind the counter was flirting with her co-workers and diddly farting around behind the counter. I had to ask for her attention for my lousy refund! Anyone, Bueller? I can safely say that after countless bad experiences I will not be returning to this Starbucks.  If you're reading this, you know that Starbucks is on top of their game normally, this is not what you would expect.  Even if you're just walking by on South street, be prepared to wait and for them to be out of what you want. They were out of caramel macchiato's and coffee today, how does that even happen?? Shame on you, Starbucks! This location SUCKS!

Fabulous, consistent Starbucks as usual. Our use this one because it was the closest to my house in order through the app. My order was made accurately and quickly so I could pick it up and be on my way.
this location, though always busy, is always fast and delicious. i enjoy the upstairs loft area for relaxing and having conversations, checking work e-mail, or reading a book. Love this location!

I do like Starbucks but this one is just bad! The trash cans are full, the milk doesn't get refilled and the service isn't that great either! Someone from Starbucks should check this location and hire new people!

Stopped in here and was pleasantly surprised by the customer service. As I say in all of my coffee house reviews, I'm a former Starbucks barista and expect nothing but the best from Starbucks stores. More often than not, I'm sorely disappointed. This store was great. Upon reaching the register, I got a huge smile for the cute barista girl and immediate conversation. The barista making drinks looked up from his work, smiled, and said hi. Everyone was very personable. My drink came out quickly and when I asked for an extra cup of ice (I ruined myself from adding too much ice when I worked for Starbucks), I got a smile and a "sure" instead of the usual annoyed silence. You can bet that I'll be stopping here for a mid-trip north for a refill!!!

Slowest, most non-customer service oriented Starbucks I've ever visited.  Only 1 person was making drinks and the priority seemed to be the drive through lane.  This is the most inefficient process/approach I've ever seen in a Starbucks.  I visited this location on multiple days and different times during the day, always to find the same inefficient service.  During my afternoon visits, the personnel were definitely not focussed on getting folks served and out the door...unbelievably slow!

I thought the location on Mid Rivers drive was bad, but this one is actually worse. I have never been here when service was quick. Unbelievably slow. Do yourself a favor and head across the street to Dunkin Donuts or down to Crooked Tree coffee house.

This Starbucks is located inside or next to the lobby of the Marriott at the Convention Center.  When I stopped by on Friday afternoon, I was greeted by a friendly barista, and my coffee order came out quickly.  The only negative with this visit was that this location does not accept Starbucks reward free drinks but was still able to pay with my Starbucks app.
My favorite starbucks in SB. The staff is wonderful, always happy and smiling. drinks are made perfect.

Slowest location I've ever been too. 15+ mins in the drive though. Wrong drink made. My husband ordered a cold drink; they made it hot. We sent it back and was given a new one. We drove off THEN found out they dumped the hot drink over ice! Seriously!! Horrible! Don't go here if you need to be at work on time. They have no sense of urgency.

Fantastic new Starbucks that just opened. 
Nice service. Good space. Music not overbearing.
I like.
Great service fun atmosphere! Very busy yet the line kept moving quickly. I wish all Starbucks were as efficient as this one.

Started out my morning with a few minutes to spare so thought I'd grab a chai on way to work. With one Cashman truck in front of me ordering I thought "Great this will be quick." NOT!!! The guy took forever to order, then he and a blond flirtatious woman chatted for a good ten minutes while he was VERY SLOWLY handed just 2 drinks!!! With my extra time shot, plus the recognition the place must not know service I declined my order AND had to blow my horn to get the guy to even drive out of the lane! Needless to say I won't be back!

Holy crap! I walked into this location today to get a latte and I thought I was in the wrong place.  They have completely renovated their store and it is beau-ti-ful! They've installed lovely dark floors, moved the two sided fireplace to be accessible to more completely new leather club chairs, added a wall divider for a more private room and (probably most importantly) added a TON of countertop seating WITH PLUGS for studying.

I would live here if it was a bit bigger inside, maybe with some comfier chairs. But even the décor isn't enough to make this place a 4 star joint, because the staff is absolutely lovely. I always come by late into the night, about an hour or so before closing (which is when people usually rush customers and make mistakes) and the staff here is consistently positive and friendly, and super welcoming. They also are always willing to give drink recommendations (unusual among baristas, as far as I've seen), and are super speedy. These guys are the best!

The staff at this location are great, very quick and helpful! There is always seating available at this Starbucks and the Wi-Fi never seems to have issues. Store is very clean and is a great place to get some work done. The store can be a bit cold on the inside, I recommend bringing something a bit warm to wear for long stays or maybe order a warm drink!

Friend service and very knowledgable. Service is relatively quick most of the time. The crew is competitive here and like to challenge the others stores about things they do not know. 
Today a gentleman named Brandon was working the drive thru, he was a very upbeat individual. My drink was made perfect. Keep up the great work Starbucks.

Can the workers follow recipes? No.
Can they even make a regular coffee without screwing it up? No.
Are they even apologetic about their incompetence? They will chew you out if you even hint at it.

I have filed 20 complaints with corporate, but they give 0 shits

Today, the worker screamed at me and skipped me because I didn't know who was next in line and didn't order "in time." Since when is there a time limit to order. So rude and ridiculous.

Not my favorite Starbucks location, but not the worst either. The store appears small and can get crowded quickly, but this is only because of the way the store is set up. It's really not that small but when there's a crowd, the line can only go one way and that's out the door (as opposed to being able to wrap around within the store). There are very limited seating options here and not the most comfortable either. This isn't a very cozy Starbucks. This is more of a grab and go location.

What a dissapointment.... this place is not a starbucks, its a coffee shop that serves starbucks brand coffee. If you love starbucks like I do, then you will be quickly dossapointed. Ordered a bacon egg and cheese sandwhich and they wanted to charge $10, that is insane!  When I said I no longer wanted the sandwhich (before even paying) the lady at the counter quickly became rude  and condescending. I ordered a vanilla latte which tasted NOTHING like Starbuck's vanilla syrup. It is sad that they PRETEND to be a Starbucks with their menu, ads and name here but they are not.
i swear, i saw a homeless man on a laptop playing games here.

This Starbucks is located in Target. Excellent service and still get the pleasurable starbucks experience. I generally come here for some me time or to meet friends. I do enjoy coming to this Starbucks:

I visit Starbucks perhaps once a month, so each time I go it, it's really exciting and a treat. Not so much with this location. It's arguably one of the largest Starbucks I've ever been in, but the parking is atrocious. The staff was friendly but incompetent. None of our drinks tasted like they should have tasted. Quite a disappointment on a cold, dreary day.
I always get a frappachino here and It is so good! Its a nice little Starbucks in Indianapolis and real close to my house. It is a great spot if anybody needs to find a better Starbucks to go to.
I love that place I wish they can make it bigger its very small inside

Absolutely horrible service. I am pregnant and asked for a simple decaf coffee. The lady said decaf is out, so I asked for hand pour which is what other stores offer normally. The lady said she cannot do it because the line is long and couldn't fulfill my order. Not to mention she made me waited for 5 mins before taking my order while she was sorting out the coins. That was why the line built up!

Can you imagine a Starbucks with no brewed decaf option at all?

I'm finding that this location is growing on me more and more. Just on the fringes of UofA's campus, it's the perfect distance for a good lunch time walk and a "Venti Iced Green Tea with Raspberry Syrup"(That is of course, only when the weather is beatiful!) 

While there are plenty of other Starbucks kiosks on campus, this is "a legit" Starbucks and comes with a fair amount of space - both inside, outside, and in the lobby of the College Plaza building. The staff are much friendlier than those working the cafe within Sobey's next door, but the lines can get long and overall the service seems to be somewhat mediocre. 

Like I said though, with the warm weather, I've found myself here twice in the past week. Not my preferred location, but it does help my day to be a little bit sweeter :)
I like this location. So nice and clean and staff members are very pleasant!Not usually busy inside or drive thru which is nice when you're in a hurry!

Rude! The women who work there are extremely rude and inappropriate. I have been there to witness and experience them eye rolling and yelling at customers multiple times. 

It's a shame because the space is really nice with the fireplace, etc.

Love this Starbucks for their drinks always being consistent. I do hate a lot of the times that the upstairs becomes Hipster Freeloading Haven and then you can't even sit in there because of the shortage of tables downstairs,though. A friend and I once sat at a table and used the windowsill as chairs on a very frigid winter night. They could also be more considerate and clean up sometimes,too.

THIS IS ONLY A REVIEW OF THIS LOCATION, NOT STARBUCKS GENERALLY!!!
I recently became self-employed, so I've spent a lot of time at Starbucks, taking advantage of WIFI and addictive coffee. I've frequented many of the Starbucks in the area, but since I'm meeting somebody at CPK, I decided to try this one.  What a mistake. The staff here is utterly indifferent to customer service.  They bring new meaning to the word laconic. There's nothing wrong with the product (same as every other Starbucks), but the service left such a bad taste in my mouth, I'll never come back to this place ... ever.

Been here a few time and my experiences here have been the same...

-Long lines, slow, takes forever
-You finally get to the counter and they don't have what you want
-Coffee was lukewarm
Great coffee. Lots of seating. Also outdoor seating on a nice patio. Lots of outlets for charging. Occasional celebrity sightings...

Smack dab in the middle of State St in downtown Santa Barbara, this Starbucks is ideal for a quick cup of coffee and a nice walk to the pier. The baristas are super friendly and make you feel welcome as soon as you step in through the door. Expect to wait in line if you drop in during the morning rush.

A smile goes a long way, and so does a lack of one. Walking into this Starbucks, this past afternoon, I immediately felt like the baristas hated their jobs. A positive is that after they got my order wrong the first time due to the cashier accidentally writing the wrong order on the cup, a barista redid it without hesitation and said I was fine for asking. The drink was delicious. 
But still, the atmosphere just felt angry because of the lack of eye contact and the R.B.F. in the baristas. Probably won't be returning to this location, at least at lunch time, anymore.
Service is always great, Cody goes above and beyond expectations and creates a great aroma in Starbucks!

I generally like starbucks, but the employees are not the best here. They might be quick, but not friendly. I have ordered from here a few times, I ordered a caramel frappe last time and it was under-blended, there were chunks of ice and very thin, almost entirely milk sections  and everything in between in the same drink. The coffee is not the freshest  tasting when I order that. However the service is quick and the decor is nice, I just wish the drinks and employees were better.

Home away from home. The baristas are the best and really take the time to know their customers.  I love the way they make sure you get a nice fresh soft piece of lemon loaf that's not all dry on one side.  It's kind of like our local Cheers, a place to go where everybody knows your name.

Asian female  barista that made drink needs to be retrained. I asked for my drink extra hot. I get my drink and ask why wasn't it extra hot and she says that the pushed the button on the machine and that how hot she can make it. My drink wasn't x-hot as I ordered. I Know for a fact that she could have made my drink hotter  I have been at several Starbucks all over the US and that has never been said to me once.

This Starbucks is hit or miss. The drinks are not very consistent (taste/strength of coffee) and I have been charged extra for things at this location that I have not at others (ex. Replacing pumps for sugar free, etc) but it's close to home and convenient. I'd prefer to have the inconsistencies than no Starbucks close at all. The wait is typically longer than other locations here, and the parking is not awesome, but the location of this store itself is just a busy one and attached to a bank. Good thing, as with any Starbucks, is they will remake your drink if you are not completely satisfied. It's rare I ever leave here without a drink I like but don't really like to have to wait longer for the remake. Overall it's convenient and A-OK!

This really has to be the nicest Starbucks that I have ever been in. I usually like to support local coffee shops, but when your are in need of some caffeine, anywhere will do. 

The place is much bigger on the inside that it looks like from the outside. They layout is very open and welcoming. Tons of different places to sit inside and out. They even have a fireplace! 

The staff is friendly and fast. Exactly what you need in a coffee shop.

It just like any other Starbucks really so not much to comment there. However, I came here on a Saturday or Sunday (can't remember) and the line to order took 15 minutes. No joke, 15 minutes. By the time I got to the cash register to order, I ask her how long it would take to get a drink and she said about 20/30 minutes. I have no problem waiting for a good meal etc but waiting almost 40 minutes for coffee is absurd.

Not sure what they need to do to rectify this so it doesn't happen again (hire more people? expand the space?) I don't know, but waiting that long for a drink is quite ridiculous

I'm not a coffee person by any stretch of the imagination. In fact, I always order a green tea at Starbucks, but that's neither here nor there. The thing that I love about THIS particular Starbucks location is that it's a shoe's-throw away from the TLA, so you can kill some time here (upstairs, of course) just hanging out before or after hitting up a show. 

So, essentially, this review has nothing to do with the quality or the service of the Starbucks itself.. but just how it's convenient for my superficial killing-time needs. ;)

Need better customer service. 5 people behind counter and only one at register getting coffee and eatable items while others wait for a special coffee order. Also a smile wouldn't hurt once in a while. Just sayin!

As far as Starbucks go, this one is ok. After all, the coffee is the same as well as the food options.
The shortcomings is in the space. First, not enough work areas. After all many of the people passing through the airport are business travelers.  Next, too few outlets, which are prized by all. 
Finally, they do not have their own wi-fi, so you have to jump on the St. Louis airport wi-fi, which is really slow.

Was here on business so I popped in to the local Starbucks on the way to the office.  I enjoyed the friendliness of the baristas.  When they didn't have the sandwich I ordered they gave me an extra pastry.  My caramel macchiato was perfect!

This is an awkward Starbucks.  The parking really sucks.  And the layout is just kind of weird.  I'm not a fan of this location, but I would come here if I'm out shopping at the mall and need a refreshment afterwards.

One of the nicest, cleanest SBUX to which  I've ever been. Right next to an AT&T, Vitamin Shoppe and Talbots.  

The locale seems new, but it is not.  Just that the employees and management take care that it looks new.  Clean as a whistle.  And despite the smallish size of the place, it nonetheless attracts a nice crowd of nice people that tend to be nice because the staff is also very nice.  Which makes for a really good experience.

If it wasn't a chain, it would be rated much, much higher.

I created this account just to write this review, Becca is the unfriendliest person I've ever met. She should never have a job where she would have to interact with anyone. Talked down to staff and customers. Never will I go back if she is working here.

With a solid view of the parking lot, you too can enjoy a proper espresso or the frappuccino of your choice. For reasons I can't fathom, they are relatively friendly here which sets this location apart from many others. Finally, there is a decent amount of seating inside and a few nice tables outside too!

I have been meaning to leave a review for a long time now.  What makes this location are the employees. I come here almost everyday during my work week with my co-workers during morning hours. They know us all by name and always have a great attitude even though we all know work can get you down. They know how to make a great coffee and it's always a pleasure going back!

My partner and I are really sick, sore throat and all. We stopped at this Starbucks and were delighted to meet this amazing barista named Natasha. Five stars for her amazing personality, beautiful smile, and exceptional customer service skills!!!
This is a really good local starbucks with great staff.  I enjoy the neighborhood and its a great place to have a coffee and read a magazine.

Great location! I came to this location when I was seeing a show across at the TLA. It is right across the street and I enjoyed getting a drink to warm up. It is just your typical starbucks, assuming that you know about Starbucks. They have a variety of lattes, coffees, teas, and pastries. They sell cute cups and other small merchandise items which can come in hand if you have a last minute gift to grab. Best of all about this location is their public bathroom. Another perk of being right across from the TLA. After a few hours in that line a bathroom is essential! Plus, when I was waiting in line for the bathroom (just one stall) I was able to chat with a few of the members of one of the band I was seeing that night! Great experience and I have the selfies to prove it. Again, this is just a normal starbucks in a great location. The staff spelled my name correctly on my cup too!

A neccessary Evil - glad it's here.  "Makes life in suburbia bearable" (to coin a phrase from below.

Just wish there was a La Colombe out this way - at at least a hipster mom 'n pop coffee shop.

Go, Media!
Not really much to say... I mean, it's a Starbucks.  Thought I'd throw in a three-star because I love that they have the upstairs.  Pretty nice view of the shenanigans on South St.

So today during my lunch break around 12:40 I went and joined my friend to walk her to Starbucks and she was ordering her ice coffee and we went to the end and got the coffee, and she tasted it and it was very bitter and had no milk and wasn't sweet enough so she's getting sugar so the barista says do you want more sweetener " it already has 6 pumps" and she didn't hear him so he's tapping his fingers on the coffee machine and while he was doing that he was like "take the lid off " tap tap tap "take the lid off" tap tap tap very inpatient and mind you there was only one other person waiting for a drink and Starbucks is usually so friendly I was in shocked like if you don't like your job find another one

Fairly new Starbucks, being in an airport it was rather busy.  Line seemed to move quickly though.

I was greeted with a smile and the lady was joking with everyone making the wait more tolerable for the customers.  Coffee had a good flavor with no after taste.

Consistently the SLOWEST SB location in Reno, with rude, flighty workers. They have this random order of making drinks...it's clearly not which one was ordered first. I think they all hold off on doing blended drinks or drinks that require some real work (like stirring!) because they don't want to, and it sits there until someone is forced to make it after all other drinks and customers are gone. People should not have to wait close to 30 minutes for one drink when everyone behind them places the order, gets the drink, drinks it, and leaves. That's inexcusable. As is your crappy response when questioned about it. Here are a few tips for you: have an adult in the store once in a while. It's great that you hire young people, but some of them just aren't professional or concerned enough to work with customers. Don't stop what you are doing to flirt with visiting friends for ten minutes. Make the drinks. (I know that one is asking for a lot!) Send your workers to a real SB location to see how other employees do it. Or better yet, let them go across the street and see how McDonalds workers treat their customers. That's even better service.

Okay- I am not a Starbucks fan so much as I am a Jenna fan. Jenna has worked there for years and she is who I am giving the 5 stars to. Yay Jenna! She is an early bird and if you get up early enough and go through the drive thru she will make your day!

The usual. Coffee. Snacks. Tables. 

Expect to wait in line at almost any time of the day.

I don't like this location as much as others because it's smaller, or at least feels smaller. I like Starbucks with communal tables and lots of seating. This SB is almost always crowded and so I can never find a seat. This SB, however, has a nice patio area, but it's always crowded as well. Another negative about this SB is that there's no drive-thru.

As for the quality of the drinks and the service, they're as good as most other locations.

This has got to be the worst service I have ever received from Starbucks. I am a regular here and love the coffee, have the app, and spend more than I should weekly here. I would not recommend the Gandy location due to the inability to do their jobs. This is the second time they have gotten a pretty simple order wrong. I asked for a second shot of espresso, paid for it and never even received it in my coffee. This was also after hearing one of the girls say how weird it was to get an extra shot of espresso (something that's actually pretty common). This is something I normally get, so when I get halfway down the road and I realize it's not correct, I was upset. But since I was going to work I had no time to go back to fix it, now just wasting money on something I didn't even receive. They are more worried about talking with each other than doing their jobs. I will unfortunately have to drive out of my way to another Starbucks so I won't pay for items I don't actually receive.

This is about equidistant to the one on route 70 by Barclay towers for me. I like this location over route 70 because it's really easy to get in and out of and the parking isn't too bad for a Starbucks. There's no drive through but I never use those, this may be a drawback for others though. 

They fill mobile orders pretty quickly. Unfortunately, this time the order was NOT what I paid for. I ordered a TRIPLE espresso, which means there should be 3 times the amount of espresso relative to the amount found in a single shot. 

As you can see, I paid for a triple and still got a single shot anyway. 

On top of this, my boo's iced caramel macchiato got the opposite treatment, it was overfilled! After I put the straw in and out a few times and sopped up all the overflowing sticky "coffee" (I say that in jest as I don't believe these drinks count as coffee), it was dry enough to bring out to the car. 

I complained to Starbucks online team and they did credit my account $6, which is approximately what I paid for everything. When you come after 3 pm, they have a promo where you buy one espresso drink and you get a second free. That deal, along with the credit, took away the sting of what was not the most pleasant Starbucks experience this time around. 

They'll get another chance because after all, it's Starbucks and there is no locally owned cafe I know of in Cherry hill.
The A Concourse morning staff is so full of attitude, the music is not exactly customer friendly, nor is its volume.  Good thing Dunkin' Donuts is a few steps away.

They messed up the charges and one of the staff members (non-register) instead of apologizing were extremely rude after the mistake. Not getting coffee here again, I'll try Cafe Bakery next time or go to another rest stop.

My experience is that they have always been friendly.  
Usually crowded which makes it rough to get drinks in a timely fashion. 
I do find it crowded in the store, but again, that comes with the territory of being in a "coffee shop" setting.  It definitely is nice and comfy if that is the type of setting you want.  There is outdoor seating, but with FL you can only use that every so often - when it is not super hot, not raining, and not filled with some type of bug flying around!

Overall, this place is really good.  They make good coffee and other beverages and the staff is nice :)
How can you say no to coffee !! Love this place ! Great service and spectacular employees! Thanks guys .!
This Starbucks location has a super friendly and quick staff! Very nice views of the mountains and plenty of parking. My new favorite Starbucks!

More often than not, my drinks have been incorrect.  There's also rarely any seating because of the same large group of old loud foreign men there all night every night.  This is the closest to my home, but I gladly drive to two other locations a few miles away.
Mad props to Adam who listened to what I liked and made me several drinks until I found one I liked. Thanks for the excellent customer service!

Real disappointment. Not clean. No bathrooms operational.  Not enough seating.  Took way too long just to make one latte. Glass doors were full of fingerprints and I was here early in the AM so obviously not cleaned from day before. Advertised on I-75 but was 3 miles off the highway. Deceptive.

This location is terrible. No matter how many cars are in the drive through line, it will take at least 25 minutes. Most of the employees are unfriendly and seem put out to have to deal with customers. Going inside is just as slow. When I've been inside the employees don't let you know drinks are done. There's just drinks lined up and customers have to check the stickers to find their order. Often people take the wrong order, walk away, then come back over to get the correct one.

Ordered a salted caramel cold foam. My drink was forgotten about and someone that came in after me got their drink several minutes before me. After a friendly reminder they made my drink but it unfortunately is disgusting. The iced drink was warm, the "cold foam" was mixed in, and there wasn't a caramel taste- just salt. Sorely disappointed in my experience here.

Your typical Target Starbucks. I'm always on the search for table to take over with my study materials and there wasn't much here, but that's to be expected from a small location. The staff was friendly and professional. You can pay with your phone app and still get stars. Nothing out of the ordinary. 3 solid stars. Would give me more there's nothing to sing home about.

This Starbucks is underwhelming to say the least. 

Be prepared to wait at least 15-20 minutes for anything - even if it's a pre-baked good. Also, save your receipt because they are known for forgetting parts of your order.

Great service.. always a smile! ^^

I believe this Starbuck is the fastest!

This is hands down the best Starbucks in the Santa Barbara area, and there a lot of them!

I go in there many mornings and some nights and even when it's busy, they're cool. Gets a little nuts sometimes, though and they go through cream so fast! The bathroom passcode thing is annoying. 

What happened to the singing barista though?

I met two friends at Starbuck's for a quick coffee and chat on a Saturday afternoon. This location is a little small and doesn't have a ton of seating but it has that nice feel of being in the Cheshire. My tea was good and of course I would return.

A great little Starbucks to come check your email if you're hanging out in Reno. 

As someone who refuses to pay for internet when I'm already paying plenty for my hotel room, I like to seek out somewhere to catch up on my messages and make sure the world is not collapsing. Oh right, and have a nice pick-me-up cup of caffeine. This Starbucks fit my needs perfectly. Plenty of parking, really friendly staff, quick service, and a great inside atmosphere. Oh yes, and free internet!

I love the new remodeling!  It looks great, and is so open and big now! I love the back wall! The one thing I don't like is the parking, there are not a lot of spots, but the drinks are great! I love Starbucks, except their hot chocolate... I ordered it 2 days ago, and I was expecting a nice, warm, yummy cup of hot chocolate, but I realized it was made with water instead of milk. I mean, it wasn't that bad, but it would be better with milk

I have been going to this location for years because of the convenient location, it's on my way to everything. I usually have 3 different locations that I go to but this one has always been the worst. They never seem to get my drinks right even if I give them specific details (like "light ice") they end up doing whatever they want. The flavor is almost never accurate I just don't understand, this is something they do for a living! The crazy thing is that it's different employees so I'm assuming maybe their not getting trained correctly?? Idk but it's pretty frustrating that I pay $5+ on a drink that is never done right. Not to mention they are very slow on getting drinks out, there is no competition with some other locations. Like I said at the beginning, this place is in a convenient location, they need to step their game up!

Treated myself to a gingerbread latte with coconut milk.  

I didn't know Starbucks had so many dairy free options: soy, almond, and coconut!!  

Barista Chris suggested doing coconut milk in my latte and he wasn't wrong.  It was just as delicious as I remembered gingerbread lattes being.  He was so sweet and really brightened my day.

This was without a doubt the best Starbucks I've been to.

This Starbucks location was very crowded for a weekday early afternoon. 
Primarily outdoor seating available however high tables and a small area with cozy arm chairs was open.
I would not recommend this location for a business meeting or quiet place to work.

I stop at this location frequently before my commute to work. The servers are really nice and always have a smile on there face. On a particular morning I asked for a warm beverage that was typically served on ice. When I got to the window that they informed me they messed up the order and made it cold rather than hot. They asked me if I wanted to keep both drinks and I graciously accepted them. The inside of this location is a lot smaller than other Starbuck locations I have been to. They are always neat and organized and fully stocked on all the goods. Highly recommend this location :)

It's a Starbucks but it's my favorite Starbucks in the city to study, do work, and enjoy a coffee. Get a gold card, order a coffee, get free refills on coffee or iced coffee, sit and do work. Pretty great for all of that.

Went there twice in the last week! Saturday ordered hot breakfast was still cold on inside and yesterday ordered drinks using mobile app and showed up and was told can't make them. It's a shame this store was a good store until the last few months.

Would Gladly Give 5 stars!
Great Barista's Here,On my last several visits ALL my special orders have been ON-POIINT! I'm Always glad to wait for an order that's being made correctly. JUST DONT WANT TO JINX THEM lol! LOL!
Worst Starbucks I've ever been to. No menu up anywhere and then the staff were snotty with customers who were struggling to know what they wanted. Bizarre

Jammed packed every day & long lines. Thank goodness for the Starbucks app! If you are an avid Starbucks goer, why in the world would you not have the app!? A dislike per this store is they do not have decaf brewed eliminating a quick half caf for us sensitive to caffeine. One employee told me, "We don't make a profit from decaf, so we don't brew it." I think that's crap along with the decaf Americana they offer you...when you're just looking for a quick half caf. Anyway...this needs to change & I look forward to the new store.

I was ending my stay at the Cheshire and needed (yes...needed) some caffeine before an early morning flight. I asked the hotel clerk for the nearest coffee shop and he directed me here. 

It's Starbucks. Generally, for me, they're a 3 star, a-ok experience at best. But a few things made my visit to this Starbucks to be a cut above.

Firstly, the atmosphere is darling. Comfortable seating surrounding a cozy fireplace during cool weather, and a charming, umbrella donned patio for warmer days. 

Also? The workers. Friendly, efficient, and conscientious. Beyond their crafting of my beverage, I observed them interacting with other (somewhat particular) java seekers and they were patient and accommodating. 

Finally...Starbucks recently rolled out a new beverage. It's a cinnamon almond milk macchiato. And? It is delicious. Iced or hot, either way it's just plain good.

For the most part, I tend toward independent coffee houses. But, on a day when I needed a quick coffee before catching a cab to the airport, this Starbucks sure came through!

Get to it!

Starbucks is so good I love Starbucks directs I love Starbucks if you ever go to Starbucks in Tucson I recommend a giant Starbucks that's by the fries in the plaza but the target and Pier 1 and then if you get a Starbucks I recommend salty caramel mocha and strawberry açai and pink drink and I also brought recommend the mango dragon fruit tea

The only reason I ever come to this place at all is its proximity to my dorm and its prime spot as a late-night place to study, even as late as 2 am! These redeeming qualities are the only reason this Starbucks gets two stars instead of one.

The staff here are INCREDIBLY rude and hassle you in order to get your order and get the line moving as quickly as possible. This would normally be fine but the attitudes of almost every worker here are, simply put, awful. Over the times I've studied here, I've witnessed an employee here shout at a student and another employee roll their eyes at another customer who didn't know the difference between two kinds of coffee.

I guess this kind of behavior is acceptable when your customer base is a revolving door of students who come to you for caffeine out of necessity rather than free will.

Also, they charge $1 for a cup of water. Seriously? This is Starbucks, where their profit margins are wider than Hey Arnold's head; charging for a water is the epitome of cheap in my eyes - especially in this industry!

Save your time and go to another cafe if you can -- there are plenty of other options in the area. And if you insist on Starbucks go to the one at 34th and Walnut: the service is much, much better.

Store is filled with hipsters that are more worried about their social life than taking care of their customers. In five days straight of going there they have not gotten my order right yet. They spend more time chitchatting with each other and actually doing the work. They get two stars because after all it is still Starbucks!

This is MY Starbucks. Yes, I claim it. I'll pee on it if I have to in order to mark it, but that wouldn't be ServSafe (Google it). 

I love my baristas. All of them; Carlos, Phoebe, Caitlin, Jessica, Josh, Melissa and Fred and Val at the register. 

They usually have my grande-non-fat-in-a-venti-cup-for-extra-whip mocha ready for me as I am paying. I was even on a pretty tense personal call inadvertently pacing outside the front door one day and inside they were debating about bringing me my mocha. I was, at the same time, wondering if they'd bring it to me, but given my behavior and apparent look of tenseness, they stayed back. 

I make this a daily stop and sometimes twice daily. I spend entirely too much money here, but thanks to my bank's "save the change" type program, the $.88 dumped into my savings account per visit has padded it quite nicely. 

I am a Starbucks Mocha junkie. Even on the hottest of days here in FL, I always order a hot mocha. My definition of heaven is: steamed milk and espresso blended with chocolate filtered through whipped cream. 

The first sip is always my favorite especially if they jam pack my mocha with whipped cream and it takes a few seconds or so for the hot deliciousness to break through the delightful barrier. 

Ooo, Starbucks mochas.
Who would think that we would want a coffee at 5:00 AM before our flight??  Starbucks still hasn't opened.  This is a crap airport with crap concessions.

My morning at this Starbucks started out with a venti cup of coffee that had a choking quantity of coffee grounds in it. I then waited five minutes for them to brew a pot without grounds. Finally when my coffee was delivered I was informed that there was not one packet of Splenda in the store. On top of that, the area near their dumpster in the parking lot is littered with pumpkin sugar cookie boxes. I recommend Picassos, it's only two or three minutes further.

Yes, sometimes there's a long wait but at 9am, I get it. I expect to wait longer. No issues around lunch time. Everyone is friendly and courteous for the most part. They've never gotten my order wrong which is more than can be said about other locations. The food items are also pretty well-stocked which is a plus.

This is the closet Starbucks to my house so I am usually here every morning. The layout for the parking/drive thru creates congestion when it is busy and that is so frustrating at times. 

With that being said some of the workers have taken time to remember my order which is appreciated. However for the ones who haven't, they seem to be pretty inconsistent with getting my order right. 

I mostly come here for the rewards through the Starbucks app for free drinks/food items. However this particular Starbucks is pretty average at best.
