Great area upstairs to socialize with friends or relax with a drink.  Also, keep an eye out for events they have going on.  I've caught a couple musical acts and a touring author while I've been there.

Worst Starbucks in the country. The general manager has no clue as to what her employees are doing. It seems as though they are high as a kite every morning. Do not even respond to "good morning ". Hate this location. Do not go here go to a different one unless you want to feel like you're inconveniencing the employees. I've been to hundreds of locations of Starbucks as a traveling sales person and this one by far tops the cake as to the

UPDATE: Starbucks, I congratulate you on turning this location completely around to be a warm and inviting place to come. There's still room for improvement but your new manager has done a phenomenal job in the past 6-7 months. I stopped going here for a while for the reasons below but I actually go here a few times a day now. Great work.

OK. I really really wanted some coffee this morning. Since they don't have drive thru, I illegally parked (parking lot was PACKED) and bolted to the door from a good distance away only to find that the line was almost out the door. I don't care how fast they are, there was no way I was getting out of there in 10 minutes, it probably was going to be longer. 

Keep in mind, this is after 9am on a Tuesday. Not convenient and always a struggle for parking. Can they PLEASE figure out a better situation?! You let me uncaffeinated Starbucks!

I like the feel of this Starbucks a lot and the employees are very friendly and funny, but they are always out of stuff. I'm not sure if it's because they're a different type of Starbucks or what but they should really increase their supply. It seems weird to be out of things at 9am. Definitely not my favorite Starbucks to go to, but the parking is easy and it's nice to read in there some days.

This used to be my favorite Starbucks, however, over the past few months the staff has changed for the worse. The young man with the blonde hair is beyond rude, the staff is un knowledgeable about the drinks. They run out of necessary items to operate a coffee shop. It's just awful. Go at your own risk, if the gentleman with the blonde hair is there just turn around, he acts as if making your order is a chore.

Nice new facility, a few items needed to make it even better.  Need some shade on the patio, desperately, removable shade cloth during the summer months would suffice.  The interior warehouse design gets very noisy, some dampening to protect the employees & patrons would be great.  Need two registers open when the inside line wraps out to the door so patrons don't feel ignored & join the drive up line.  Still has great employees & great coffee!
Went in to get a cup of brewed coffee. Berista said, "it is 45 minutes old and did I still want a cup?" NO! Is this Starbucks? Won't ever return to that store. So disappointing!
I went to work on lessons there but they close at eight and not nine o'clock. Which was really annoying to me but hopefully they change the hours online to be right.

Visited this Starbucks on Veteran's Day. My best friend is a veteran and we thought we would go check their special for a free cup of coffee for veterans. My friend went to order and asked about the veteran's day coffee. A barista rudely said back to my friend "um excuse me what are you even talking about". There was a sign right in front of her about the special. The barista then looks at the sign and says "Oh is today even veteran's day?". Then asked for my friend's military ID three individual times. Not a very nice way for my friend to spend her day. Disgusted by the way this barista treated my friend. Her name was Tess. Refusing to come back to this location due to her behavior. Disgusted, and ruined my friend's day.

When I first started going to Starbucks, I would never come to this one. The drinks always just tasted funny. This sucked because this is the closest one to my house, and the next closest one was at least two miles away and I walk everywhere. But as of late I have started coming to this location again and it's been amazing. There's been a few hiccups where my drinks would be bitter, but I would talk to the barista about it and they would fix it without complaints. 

The barista's at this location are amazing. They are always in good moods and there's one in particular where every time I walk in, she always seems to be so excited to see everyone. And I actually gossip with her about barista's at other Starbucks locations and she always tells me to call them out for being lazy. She's the main reason I love going to this location at night.
The standard for which I judge all others. Yes, I'm a code snob.
Go-to place to grab a cup before a long drive.  And if Dan K would have bought stock around time of his review. he would have quadrupled his money in 5 years.
This isn't my everyday Starbucks, but I come here often that they now know me by name, since my work is down the street. The baristas are so welcoming.

I'm done with this Starbucks. It's the closest one to me with a drive-thru. But it's not worth it.  I really like the breakfast sandwiches, but they are always cold in the center. No matter how many times I stress this to them, and always ask for the sandwiches to be warmed open-faced, I get a cold center. This morning I go by there and figure it would do no good to order a sandwich, I only order a macchiato.  I get on the road and carefully take the first sip and damn it, the whole freaking drink is mildly warm.  That's it... No more.
Great Starbucks!!! Parking lot is a little confined but the staff is EPIC!!!!!!

My current 3 star review of this Starbucks location is based on a recent visit at the location and could change based on future visits. I really enjoy getting their Pike Place coffee and the spicy chorizo sandwich or the bacon and Gouda sandwich for breakfast. But one morning I wanted to switch it up and ordered the steak breakfast wrap and put my order in through the mobile app. When my wife and I arrived to pickup our order she had gone inside to get our food and drinks. When she got inside there was a note on a bag that said see the cashier. My wife was confused and asked the worker at the counter what the note Meant and they told my wife to go wait in the cashier line for help. After waiting in line the cashier informed her that they were out of the wrap and that they could make something else instead. My wife proceed to request a bacon and gouda sandwich and waited five minutes without anyone working on the sandwich. She went up to the worker who was making the food and asked when the sandwich would be done. The worker then threw down the tongs and said they would get to it right away in a somewhat attitude like voice.  After waiting a total of 15 minutes for a sandwich when we had put the mobile order in 15 minutes earlier this was a pretty big let down. If we decide to come back to this location I will update my review as it reflects on the most recent service which I hope will be better than the last time.

Always clean, but it's always crowded (comes with being right next to USF I guess). Difficult to find parking and a seat. Baristas are friendly but I've had a few drinks that haven't come out all that great.

Although I usually avoid Starbucks unless I am using their oh-so-convenient drive-thrus, I have stopped into this one a couple times lately for an early-morning pumpkin latte.  I agree with the reviewers below that the parking situation is just terrible, but that is true of most downtown businesses.  What I really like about this Starbucks is the service.  I am NOT a morning person, but teaching an 8am class this semester has forced me to be conscious much earlier than I would like.  When I drag my grumpy ass into this place at the God-awful hour of before-eight-o-clock, I am greeted by a staff of really, really friendly baristas.  They may not serve up the greatest coffee, but they serve it with great big smiles.  I like that.  Plus, I think the building is really cool, making this one of my favorite Starbucks in town.
Too slow. Need new management. Sorry this Starbucks needs to know it's the closest with a drive thru. Get that service in line!

I come here regularly and the baristas are super friendly, the coffee's good, and the bathrooms are always clean. The space itself isn't super big, so it can get a little crowded inside, but the patio is a decent size.

I love this Starbucks!  I agree with some other reviewers about the decor not being as fancy or modern as other Starbucks, but I don't really care about the decorations as much as the customer service.  We ALL know that Starbucks isn't cheap, but when you have great service it feels worth it. 

Consequently - I've had HORRIBLE service at the one across the street in La Cumbre Plaza....literally the barista called out "Venti iced coffee sweetened for Mary" and I stood up and apologetically gestured "Oh, I said nosweetener actually" and she glared at me while dumping out my iced coffee (continuously glaring at me) and then refilled it and pushed it towards me.  Her coworker was standing next to her and I smiled at her and said "Wow, what great customer service, huh?" She just smiled and looked away.  I mean, if you hate your job it definitely shows through to your customers.

I've never had a bad experience here at this Starbucks, but I avoid the other like the plague.  I come for the coffee but I come back for the excellent service.  In fact, at this one in particular I've had baristas tell me that if I'm not happy with my drink choice to please let them know so they can remake it.

I'm an avid Starbucks drinker. I've had a gold card since 2012. This is one of the worst Starbucks I've ever been to and I've been to A LOT. 

First off - there was a mouse running across the store, it was repulsive. 

Second - you wait entirely too long to receive your drink. 

Third - they will always get your order wrong. On my cup it said half and half in my iced coffee and they didn't put it in there, then rolled their eyes when I asked them to add some and told me there was half and half on the table...

Avoid this location at all costs.

Knowing how hard it is to find the the You Are Here City Edition mugs i was glad to stop by this starbucks store when we were passing TN and thus adding Nashville to my collection! The service was good!

I love this Starbucks so much. The baristas are always really friendly and there are tons of tables which make it easy for me to do work. It's the largest Starbucks I know of in Indy, so it's a great place to meet up with someone and know you'll be able to find a seat. They do crank up the air conditioning during the summer, so be sure to bring a sweater. I recently moved to the south side and the Starbucks down here really sucks in comparison. I miss this place!
My second favorite Starbucks location in Shpk. Good ample seating plenty of space to sprawl and good customer service. And there is enough parking here. Plus a good patio space.

My Vanilla Latte was great and the wait was minimal. The barista temped it to 175 just how I like it. 

I have noticed the lids not fitting tightly like they should at a few Starbucks lately  and this was also a loose lid / cup combo. I only got caught by this fun event 1 time. Now I double check the lid and I never tip my cup back, just to be safe.

There are some baristas here that are excellent, they remember my drink and always take the coffee bags. But it's hard if you are heresy frequently to return a drink if its wrong. All in all, well stocked and polite

Love coffee and service but the parking lot and drive through is horrible.they have a jagged metal gutter right on the corner bent so bad from cars getting scraped by it, it-needs to be rerouted. 
Parking is so difficult to maneuver for people. See so many cars hit. Very bad design

They are super slow in this location. They have 10 people behind the counter, but you walk in and the line is out the door. Very inefficient. 2 registers, 1 person taking the order and the other person takes the money. How about utilizing both registers so the line moves quicker. I waited 10 minutes for a croissant. That is absolutely ridiculous. Why are there so many people working inefficiently?!
Usually when I go to this Starbucks they never get my drink right, but yesterday when I went there they were so much better then normal!!

The only thing I wish was different about this Starbucks was its size. Let me tell you, the location is perfect. Just close enough to Butler's campus that you don't have to drive too far to study. But just far enough that you don't feel like you are on campus. However, I sometimes find it hard to be productive at this joint. It is usually pretty crowded- especially on Saturday morning. If you do find a table, this isn't the place where you can set out 5 books and all of your folders because table space is pretty limited. If they could expand this Starbs, it would be 5/5. As always, employees are friendly, coffee is hot, breakfast sandwiches are great. I'm a black coffee kinda gal, but if I'm looking for a treat I will tack on a warm chocolate chip cookie to my order.

1:30 Friday Feb 8
The worst service ever in any Starbucks I have EVER been in!    Staff very friendly, happy but ordered a sandwich and drink.   Finished sandwich before drink arrived.   The drink came after 7 folks after my order and the store does not have a drive up.  Needs to have trash emptied.      

I will say over several years I have been in and out of this store but they are a mess today !

This is by far the worst Starbucks I have ever been to.... waited FOREVER in a short line and then waited 15 minutes for egg bites that when I finally asked said it would be "just another minute"... do yourself a favor, head down the road a bit farther and go to another Starbucks!!
This place needs A lot of training and reorganizing to step up to the level of service most of us are accustomed to receiving at a Starbucks.
Service was slow with no one inside. Bathroom was gross I don't have to much to say about it. The two stars is because my coffee was done ok. Had to have them fix it once. Happy Drinking.

theres virtually no parking and the drive-thru is often so backed up that it trails out dangerously to Stokes Rd. it is perhaps the most poorly planned parking lot that i can think of. add in the fact that they frequently mess up drink orders and you've got yourself a real treat. do yourself a favor and check out Lakes Coffee in the log cabin shops behind pj whelihans, you wont be disappointed.

They're fast and friendly. 

They got all 7 orders correct! 

They don't water down anything. Generally, everything tastes the same.
Typical Starbucks you wait in line you pay it's mediocre.. Think I'm just going to get a cup at the gas station lol

Wish I could give 0 stars!!! Worst Starbucks in Pinellas county!!! First I order on mobile the same order I have ordered for almost a year at various Starbucks and this store is the only one who argues with me every time I go to this store. The first drive thru attendant handed us only one of our 2 drinks and slammed the glass door and we had to wave at him to get him to open door again to get our second drink. Then I asked for water to fill my venti coffee that they leave half empty and the 2nd employee came and told me to order it differently next time. 
Well I can tell you there will never be a next time at this location. I love Starbucks and luckily there are enough other locations close by that I can boycott this one!!

Whoever is in charge of scheduling at this Starbucks needs to do a MUCH better job. It's a Saturday morning of Black Friday weekend. They should expect a large volume of customers, correct? Somehow they only have two people working right now, one of which is CLEARLY new (as in the one girl is actively training the other on how to label cups, what goes in orders, etc.). Literally just waited 20 minutes for an Americano. How about scheduling three people, ESPECIALLY if one of them is new and clueless?? I am from out of town, and from where I come from if you get this horrible of service at a Starbucks they at least apologize and give you one of those free drink vouchers. I get that the girls behind the counter were slammed today, but it doesn't change the fact that I still waited 20 minutes for my coffee, and didn't even get an apology let alone a free coffee voucher. Disappointing Starbucks, to say the least. Looking forward to going back home where Starbucks is done right.

I stopped there today and was fully disgusted.  I needed breakfast.  Ordered the oatmeal for 'here' but the server assured me they were out of the dried fruit topping.  I didn't know what to say so I'm sure she translated my glare.  She found it when she made a little effort.

My bill was over $7 for oatmeal and a coffee.  She assured me the price was correct.

I could not believer there was not one clean table.  There was a high top which was totally gross and three two-tops, once of which I cleaned myself before sitting down.

Totally disgusting.

To boot, started getting a mouthful of coffee grinds when I was about 1/2 way through my coffee at work later.

I have never had such a bad experience at a Starbucks or any other coffee joint for that matter.

I will be taking back my coffee grinds tomorrow for a refund.
No decaf was ready and was told I would to wait for it to be brewed, isn't that the whole point of Starbucks.

This might be the worst Starbucks location I've yet to experience, not all franchises are created or operated equally I suppose..

Warning -- do not come here if you're trying to run to work on time or catch a train.. unless you have 20+ minutes to spare. Yes it takes about that long to get a drink (even an iced coffee) as that's all I ordered this morning. The line wasn't even that long -- there were about 5 people in front of me when I walked in. Somehow that equated to waiting roughly 5 minutes prior to ordering and then another 7-10 minutes in order to get the iced coffee order ( I said 20 minutes since you have to either run to work or your train..) 

None of the employees were incredibly friendly either -- just meeting expectations of saying the right things but with the most unenthusiastic demeanor and lacking a smile to say the least. 

I worked at a crazyyyy busy Starbucks back in the day -- and we were able to get those lines out the door in less than 5 minutes. Take the order while they're waiting in line -- they pay, then their drink is done. Pretty inefficient at this location.. I'm actually quite surprised corporate/ management hasn't said anything.. this never woulda flied at my location.

I'm actually an employee at this particular Starbucks and just wanted to shed some light on some of the reviews and comments and concerns of our fellow customers. 

MOBILE ORDERS:

I want to start off with our mobile ordering system. now typically with this of course it is meant to be quicker and your order is meant to be ready at your time of arrival. Im aware that the app gives you a time in which your order should be done, IGNORE this. It is not accurate and doesn't account for the large volume of mobile order drinks that we receive at one time. Majority of the time 10-15 mobile orders come though at ONE time. We are THE busiest in all of Tampa so sometimes there WILL be a wait. We (most days) receive enough at one time to stretch to our drive they window! YIKES! I know but trust your barista is busting their butt to assure we get your order our to you ASAP. 9/10 if your order is missing it is because you have not hit the very last button that finalizes your order and sends it to our location. If not it may be an error with our machine and simply letting your barista know at the bar that your order is missing we will be MORE than happy to make your drink on the fly. It's never a problem. Our baristas bust their butt daily to assure you all are taken care of the best way we can! 


BATHROOMS:
Secondly I noticed a review saying we lock our bathrooms. We do not lock the bathrooms. IF the bathroom IS locked, that simply means it is currently OCCUPIED. 

REUSABLE CUPS: 
While we do fill reusable cups, there IS a STANDARD in which drinks need to be made. If you have a sparkly reusable cup, it will not have the line measurements we NEED BY STANDARD to make sure we are giving you the proper proportions to build your beverage. While some are upset that we still use a cup other than your own to build the beverage, customers in drive thru expect there beverage to be ready upon arrival at the window. If our line is wrapped around the building and we have to wait for you to come to the window, take your cup and THEN make your drink, it not only will hold up the line but will make you getting your beverage a longer process. 

COFFEE:
During the morning we have all three coffees brewed. We have Pike which is our everyday blend, our dark roast which we switch every so often with a new flavor and our blonde roast. Obviously during the early morning hours demand for brewed coffee is much higher, therefore having all three coffees brewed is necessary. At ELEVEN is when we cut out the dark roast and the blonde because the demand for hot brewed coffee at that time isn't as high. Your barista will let you know (if it is after 11) that we no longer have blonde or dark, and then ask if you would like our house blend of Pike instead or wait about 3-4 minutes for a fresh POUROVER of dark or blonde roast coffee. We completely understand that we are a coffee shop therefore we should always have coffee, but we have found that we waste tons of coffee brewing all three that aren't as popular during later in the afternoon than our house blend coffee. Why brew something hardly anyone is ordering, which thus creates waste.

Hope this has helped some. If you have stopped coming to this location months ago I encourage you to give us another try as we are under new management.
