There are far better experiences at other locations (the other Starbucks in the same town) but this one is just a bad experience every single time.

I go to this Starbucks frequently as it's right down the street from my house. For the most part I just go through the drive thru but sometimes I decide to go in and sit down. The people who work there are very nice, but the service when ordering inside is beyond slow. The past two times I went in they just completely forgot to make my order.

Confrontational !!!!!!!!!!!
& can't make the same drink right EVER!!!
should be closed down for 3 hours to retrain to make drinks correctly & learn customer service!!! & learn how to ring up a discount rewards card!!

thank gawd for Indy stores that get it right

I mobile ordered. Never received a notification that my order was ready so after about 10 minutes I went inside to wait. They had placed my order where the regular drinks are instead of the mobile order pick-up location. Won't go back.

I don't even know where to start. I go to Starbucks all the time. My favorite store is in Clearwater Mall. Since I moved to different area I go to this store, on Gulf To Bay by Wawa gas station. Today, I went there with my mom. We had such a disappointing experience : as usual patio was dirty, napkins everywhere , chairs on one side, tables on another . I ordered drinks and walked up to sugar and creamer corner.  There was no creamer or half and half or milk. I asked the store employee to give me some creamer or milk, she just handed a gallon of half and half to me in a bottle . I added that to my coffee right infront of her and gave it right back. Another employee gave me a nasty look and whispered something to the person who gave me creamer . They both gave me nasty look and threw that bottle away . I felt so uncomfortable.  I went to them and asked what happened and they just ignored me. Me and mom went outside , in couple minutes Manager came outside and we thought she was gonna apologize and she instead pissed me off even  more. It was sunny and I moved table couple  inches to the side and she told us we couldn't do that . That patio is never taken care of and she is telling me I cannot move table for couple inches. I was humiliated and left. So disappointing that employees like that ruin Starbuck's name .
This Starbucks drivethru has a long wait of 7 cars and the staff were rude and unpleasant. We will not be back to this location.

Great coffee. Line super long! Baristas friendly but very slow at completing orders. Lots of standing around. When it was my turn for a simple plain coffee I was told I had to wait since they were brewing. Don't bother.

My first visit to this particular Starbucks was not the best. I normally stick to what I know especially with place that make my food or drinks to perfection. I was not in my normal area so I decided to give this location a try ( all Starbucks are not the same). I was there fairly early due to my commute to work. I ordered my normal Salted Caramel Mocha however I got what tasted like ONLY steamed milk. Imagine my disappointment considering I was on the road and away from the establishment when I discovered this. Although my drink was not correct my barista was very pleasant and nice for it to be 6:30am. I will give it another shot, I haven't totally canceled out this location yet. I still say it's worth a try

We just stopped here (7-15-17) at 7:00 AM for our fuel to get us going on a long 14 hour drive ahead of us. I wish I would have gotten the employee names, but hopefully leaving the date and time will help so they can be recognized! All 3 staff on hand were incredibly kind; each individually wished us both a great day and a good morning. The drinks were even better than normal, and the whole establishment including the restrooms were very clean. Thanks for the pep in our step, Starbucks!

Loved this little Starbucks up in Sparks, it was a beautiful little Starbucks. Clean, lovely staff and a beautiful murals that I must admit won me over this place. It is just so inviting and perfectly done.

Why don't more Starbucks decorate like this? My picture shows what I mean. I couldn't capture the entire picture as there were people sitting in front of it

Oh yes, and the drinks were made perfectly and served in a timely manner even with the staff tending to customers inside the store as well as the Drive-Thru.

This is by far THE WORST Starbucks I have ever visited. The staff has no sense of urgency. I have placed mobile orders and arrived to the store 10 minutes after ordering only to have to wait another 10 to 15 minutes because they didn't get my order started until I got there.  Most recently I placed a mobile order for a food item and found out upon arrival at the store that they were sold out. This happened twice this week! They don't update their mobile site with sold out items. This is the closest Starbucks to my home but I will never go back to that store. I will go out of my to another Starbucks.

Convenient location, but Starbucks need to install some sound absorbing tiles in here.  Can hear the counter staff laughing and talking clearly, not what I want for a rest stop.  Sorry for the bad rating.  I am usually an Easy 5 Star.  The rest room had TP scraps all over the floor, needs policing.

This Starbucks is usually okay, for the most part they get orders right. However lately they have messed up the same thing multiple times. I will order the mango dragonfruit refresher in the drive through, then I get to the window and they try to hand me some pale yellow drink with no dragon fruit. As with any food and drink experience presentation is everything. My issue is if you know you're out of mango dragonfruit ingredients, warn me. I am not paying $5 for a drink that isn't as advertised. This has happened 2 times in less than a month. My rating is 3/5 compared to any drive through food/drink place and 2/5 compared to other Starbucks locations. If this wasn't the most convenient location I'd never go to this one

This is by far one of my favorite Starbucks. It's a little smaller but quaint and friendly. I love coming here to do homework or get work done, whatever I need to do.

The baristas are always friendly and make awesome coffees. Plenty of "skinny" options. They have a little outdoor area as well which I love!

Went there to meet an out-of-town friend for coffee (it was in the middle of where we both were). 
Friday afternoon around 3:00...wasn't that busy so got served right away and got our drinks soon after. 
A nice store with about a dozen or so "high" seats, about 6 tables-for-two, but only a couple "sofa seats".
It's not close, so would rather go to the more convenient location up at Wingfield Springs, but I'd go back under the same circumstances.
I don't know why there is so many people paying large sums of money to buy coffee that tastes burnt and pasties stale. 75% of the Starbucks I have gone in are this way and this one is one of them!

I really enjoy a Starbucks coffee so I try to stop whenever I can. I do not like the shops located inside another store since many of them don't take the pre-filled cards. This was the only one i the area we were visiting so I had to stop and get my Latte. The service was OK.

OK, I know that I spend too much time and money at Starbucks...if they would follow the practices of this one, I could quit in one day!

We walked in and both employees were cleaning. One was dancing and singing to his music. He kept looking at me as if I should not be there. After 5 minutes we started to leave...another person came in, was greeted as a friend and immediately helped.

I guess that there is some sort of members only policy or similar norm here. Please, post your policies at the door.

Additionally, this place is filthy! Hense the cleaning, but why not help us?

I'm an avid coffee drinker and frequent flyer to Starbucks. This is my absolute favorite location. Debbie is such a breath of fresh air. She's always bubbly and kind. She somehow always gets my intricate and odd orders correct without hesitation. In a world of poor customer service and low quality options, this Starbucks goes above and beyond. This location is convenient for me on "school days" but I would drive out of my way to this location, even with one much closer to home, because of the amazing customer service I have received here each and every time I've visited. I always tell people about this location if they seem intimidated by the menu or the aura of Starbucks. (I guess it seems exclusive to some or that they don't "fit in") Try this location and you'll not only be hooked on the quality, but you'll feel at home with the service.

Slowest Starbucks ever! Every time I go (and today will be the last) the wait to pick up your drink after paying is horrendous. This morning there were 5 staff behind the counter and most of the time at least two of them were just chatting. I watched one of them make my drink of an iced coffee black. I saw him fill the cup less than half way with coffee and then the rest with ice, then instead of putting it on the counter for me to access he just set it aside. I then asked a girl behind the counter if she could "dump out some of the ice and add more coffee as it was mostly ice. " So naturally she scooped out all of the ice and filled it to the rim with coffee. When I saw there was one lone ice cube in it I said "now there's no ice." She responded with "you want more ice?" I just got her to give me a side cup of ice so I could leave as I could see this going on all day - all ice or all coffee. Apparently they can't do moderation in anything. Did I mention that they are horribly slow? Never going back!

I don't know if what I encountered at this Starbucks today was a new barrista, sheer incompetence, or lack of attention being paid because I ordered a hot chocolate and receive instead, a cup of hot milk. My order was slightly complicated, but not hard enough to confuse hot chocolate with simple milk. The mistake was even more disappointing because there was literally no one else ordering at the time so the barristas were not in any type of rush. Will most definitely not be returning to this Starbucks. 100% waste of money.

This location needs to stay open later. The stores around it are open later and the new theater brings much more traffic to the center. I have seen so many people walk up and pull on the handle, on different nights of the week, and find out it's closed. Take a look around and at least stay open as late as the other businesses. The hours sign is handwritten and not professional. Service is generally good.

This is easily the slowest service I have ever encountered at a Starbucks. It took 15 mins for our food order and they still forgot an item.  It took them another 5 mins. Best part...when checked, both orders were completely wrong. Only stop in if you are not in a rush and don't care what you get and want poor service.

My taste in coffee is usually real simple. Let it drip and add some sugar. No creamer. And none of that flavoring stuff. However, I do like to have an extravagant coffee every once in a while. So I go to Starbucks. (I know Collin is frowning as he reads this) Anyway, this location is quite convenient located on 19 in the Parkside plaza. Despite that, it's a little weird that the building is shared with a Chase bank. Literally, the drive-thru to the Starbucks is like driving up to the teller side of the bank with the ATM next to you. I hesitated continuing into the drive-thru fearing that I might be ordering a coffe at a bank. Awkward!

I come to this Starbucks all the time, as this location is right next to my office, since this location has no drive through I sometimes don't have time to stop in, so today I used the mobile app to order. I ordered my coffee and wrap at 8:09. I didn't get my order until 8:37!! I was LATE to work. The woman who put her order in at 8:10 (I checked her ticket) got her order, and an apology AND a gift card for her "trouble" I am beyond angry by the service here. I know they were really busy, but no one acknowledged me, I had to stop someone to tell them I had been waiting for 20 minutes. I am so tired of paying a premium for coffee, and not getting what I pay for. My advice: don't use the mobile app. It will take a half hour. LITERALLY! I am not even exaggerating.

It's the best Starbucks I have seen . Really good service . And it's  always clean . We got lucky we have this shop close  to us . Kim the manger she always doing the best . Really THANK YOU  Starbucks always first
Super awesome staff! They are very fast and welcoming. This is the only starbucks I will go to...the others don't even compare.

I absolutely love this Starbucks!!! I love to see the way they greet all the customers, even the ones they don't know. They all go the extra mile and we'll do what it takes to make your order right. They work well together -and they are all so friendly.
 My favorite for sure 
Yeah they're pretty awesome
Very nice people working. They went to the back to make sure they were out of something I wanted. Also, made my complicated order correctly!! Very pleasant.

Really frustrated with this Starbucks! Third time they got a simple drink wrong! Seems when they are busy with in house customers they don't bother about getting mobile order or drive through customers drinks right!

I can safely say this is the smallest Starbucks I have never been to. This store is so small that I spotted only four chairs for customers to sit on. I have seen drive-up coffee stands in Washington state that were bigger than this Starbucks. On top of that, when I visited this place, it was over-staffed and quite loud. For some reason, an old woman (who appeared unhappy) was loudly cleaning the floor and getting in the way of patrons.

This was the first Starbucks I have ever been to. I had no clue on how to order, so my friend helped me. Needless to say I've probably have had it 2 more times and never by myself because I still don't know how to order. I've never been big on coffee and I wanted to try it for the experience. I got a cold drink (can't remover what it was exactly). It taste good, more expensive than DD. The girl taking more order was helpful. I never knew there was so many different ways a coffee can come. It would be nice if they made a menu for occasional coffee drinkers. I feel like their seasonal drinks are easier to order.

I went to this Starbucks tonight, and the man who made my coffee was kinda rude. I never complain about these things, but I treat people the way I want to be treated. He seemed annoyed about me coming in to order, and no eye contact. The iced coffee was also super bitter and he just put it on the counter, then hurried away. I also didn't mind reaching behind the counter to get a straw, but it was just weird. Maybe he had a bad day, I don't know.

This Starbucks location is the best location I have ever been to. Being vegan, Starbucks is the only major coffee corporation that I have encountered that has options for someone like me. What makes this location stand out from all of the rest is their positive and caring staff. Amelia in particular, has always gone above and beyond, knowing my voice in the drive through line before I even order. She never fails to disappoint me, and if I'm having a bad day she can always lift my spirits by her kind words or by writing me a note on my coffee cup. I'm always leaving here with a perfectly brewed coffee and a smile.

This is the newly opened SB in Oro Valley. It was packed. One of the baristas, I think named Kaitlan, kept sticking her fingers in the glasses as she moved them around over and over again. That's disgusting. Then I got a refill of my unsweetened green ice tea and it has this gross sweet taste. I was watching them. They were barely washing out the mixing cups with those spray wash station. I think they need to tune up the training. I'm not going back for a while.
Line was long at 11 am. But moved quickly enough. Rude cashier. Guess you get what you get in the airport.

Such a great store! The store is brand new and beautiful, the ceiling has this recessed thing that helps keep the sound down, and the giant windows let in a ton of natural light. There's not a lot of seating room, but I think most of the crowd are business people grabbing a cup and moving on. I never have trouble finding space. The best part is the staff, who really make you feel welcome. After like my third time, the barista remembered my name! I've never been a regular before, it's so nice when the barista starts remembering you and suggesting new things you'll like.

This is my local Starbucks and I've seen it all. They've clearly gone through management changes in the past couple years, and I have to say they're always getting better!  Example: they just moved the milk/sugar station (what is that even called??) closer to the door, and for the first time in months it was fully clean and stocked! So they're definitely paying attention and trying to give the best experience possible. 

I typically mobile order from this location in the mornings, and they usually have a pretty short prep time. This is perfect since I can order on my way down from my apartment in the elevator, drive over, park in the 20-minute spots just up the street, grab my mobile order, and head to work. My orders are always accurate, and the only problem I've run into is when they're out of sous vide egg bites (low carb woot!) - this has happened several times, though not recently, and usually they're on top of checking so when I arrive they can substitute something else for me. It's unfortunate they can't respond via the app, but this is a corporate Starbucks issue that has nothing to do with this store.

Ordered a specialty drink, one of the featured items. Paid & was handed my drink missing a key ingredient- the specialty topping. When I asked they shrugged & said they ran out (sorry not sorry).  I wasnt informed ahead that the popular item couldnt be made. I wasnt offered a refund, discount or another item. 

Drink was so overly sweet it was inedible & i love sweets. 

In addition the store is dirty & smells like a toilet. Ripped chairs, dirty floor s. Self service area dirty.  Really smells bad.

Employee shld b cleaning not yapping on her cell phone.

I hearts the bucks but this one sucks.
I waited in line for almost 25 min before i was even waited on. REALLY ?!?! 
There were more than enough people behind the counter to have service run smoother and faster .
When i got to the counter i realized that they dont have the app scanner so the young lady who range me  up have to manually key in my # ! really WTF ???? 
Dont come here if your in a rush 
I cant with this place i just cant

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. I used the mobile app to place my order, and followed the instructions to go to the drink pickup area. I waited patiently for 10 minutes, watching as others who came in after me received their drinks. I asked the ONE barista who was making drinks if this was where you pick up mobile orders, and she responded, "I have a lot of drinks to make. It'll be up soon."  TWENTY minutes later and I still have no drink. Others who again came in 15 minutes after me have received their drinks and left. At this point another barista is now helping to make drinks, and I ask him about the mobile drinks again. He tells me they usually place he mobile drinks on the other side of the bar. So I walk to the area he pointed out and sure enough there's my drink....mixed incorrectly but also half melted. Thanks a lot guys!!!

I stopped going here because of the service. Snobby employees behind the counter, and always talking and joking amongst themselves. They don't even ask for my name anymore and when my drink is ready, they just put it on the counter. Don't call it out, don't say thanks, nothing. Last time I was there, there were probably five drinks sitting there because they didn't tell their customers they were even there. I'll gladly go to the Safeway starbucks. They at least acknowledge my existence.

Adam is so long gone many months ago!!! But there are two girls there that are always super friendly, always happy, never crabby and makes my drinks perfect! I will get their names next time because they are simply the best!

I've been to this location many, many times, but this is the last time EVER!!!  Went there this morning, (10 mile drive out of my way), waited over 25 minutes in the drive through (although there were only 4 cars ahead of me), the young lady could not get my simple order right (no biggie, it's Monday morning), went back home, took a bite of my panini sandwich to find out it was chicken.  Being a vegetarian, I of course, threw up.  There was not enough toothpaste and mouthwash to get rid of the taste.  So, got back into my car, drove back, went inside to tell them what happened (calm and collective), to my surprise after telling them I'm a vegetarian, the women behind the counter (seemed too lazy to even open her mouth) says, um, sorry.  OK, so this order took me 40 miles altogether travel, was sick to my stomach, to the sound of um, sorry!!??!!  Not even an offer of a coupon for a lousy cup of something.  This is not the first time I've had bad and unprofessional service from there.  NEVER AGAIN!!!
It was great to be greeted at 5am by a polite and friendly staff, but the line moved so slow. The line is consistently wrapped around the corner outside.

It is not the best coffee in town, but it sure is consistent. I love the fact that I can walk into any Starbucks in the country and get something that I enjoy.

My drink of choice is a tall vanilla bean frappuccino with a shot of espresso, or a grande with two shots if I want a boost.  Give it a shot, it is delicious!

Anyway, I like this location, check it out!

The drive-thru for this location is the WORST I've ever been to in my ENTIRE life and as a Starbucks addict I've been to plenty. I am currently sitting in the car waiting for 3 drinks. One of them a completely black coffee. I've been sitting in the car for 25 MINUTES. I am not joking or exaggerating. My girl ABIGAIL ( clearly employee of the month ) was just wondering around like she could give two F***s that there is a line of 20+ people waiting for drinks. I would like to mention that there were 4 other employees and a manager doing Jack sh** . Side not- still waiting for a BLACK COFFEE as I write this review. We then tell Abigail what we are waiting for and she then says with an annoyed voice that it's going to be one more minute. I can physically see the coffee in the pot. The girl moved on to the next order . If we didnt already pay I would have honestly told that girl to kick rocks and left. I will NEVER return here.

I mean, I don't know.... maybe it was because we didn't pay and they felt some type of way, or what; But my venti frappe was on the rather dull side. I ordered a strawberries and cream, it was a strawberries and cream (I seen't it.), but tasted more like a vanilla and cream. I'll put it like this... if you're going to be working in a barista, learn how  to whip things up. This place is too expensive to be not getting what you ordered.

This is the 1st starbucks that I have ever walked out off...  it was basically empty, around 4:00 pm, 1 car in the drive trough and one client asking for 2 bags of coffee to grind... 3 people on the drive through/ drinks 1 guy at cashier who has to leave to learn how to grind And  1 person around.  
10 min later nobody gets my order
I left

How hard is it to make an Iced Caramel coffee with coconut milk? Seems pretty hard to this Starbucks location, I've been coming here for the past two days to see if they'll get it right but nooo, and oh not to mention that I ordered and payed for a venti coffee and got a grande

It is Starbucks. Not much more to add to that. The space is familiar and the staff is quick here, which is nice. Since it is cookie cutter coffee, I say check out the mobile ap so you can order while parking (or sooner) and just roll in to grab your octane juice and leave. No reason to stick around here.

I'm still addicted to Starbucks coffee, but I don't go to their cafes for it. I make it at home. Gone are the days when speed and efficiency are enjoyed and 1600 customers are served in a 4 hour mad morning rush (that was when I was a barista in Chicago during my time there.). Now they waste time asking your name, asking it again, asking you how it's spelled sometimes, where before there was such a great way for them to work as a team and "remember" what your drink was. Something no one seems to be able to do anymore--remember something. 
This morning I was stuck needing to go get coffee though. So I went. When I pulled up I was excited there wasn't a line at the drive through being 6 o'clock in the morning. But I was wrong. There were two cars that pulled in ahead of me. I had to wait more than 15 minutes for 2 people to be served a beverage that should  be 90% prepped.  There's a number of things I disagree with in Starbuck's current business model, but the result is customers not going because, I don't care who you are, no one wants to wait in a line while those whom they're waiting for demonstrate inefficient, confused chaos! (Apologies for the redundancy!)
Love the group here!!!! When customer service is at an all time low they bring it!!   Thanks guys

Whatever Starbucks is doing during their employee training, it's the best business model to date. I've never had a bad customer service experience here in my life and I'm here weekly, for years.  Yes I can admit it, Don't judge. 
I really want to know Starbucks corporate secrets. They're killing the customer service game. It's one all businesses should implement. I always leave happy after my starbucks employee encounters. They are all so jovial all the time to the point where I've thought to myself, should I leave my career to become an employee there. I even one time asked a barista what their secret is and she told me it's all the Americana shots they're doing together in the back. 
Well it's working. See you guys tomorrow!

After Being trapped in the drive through for 20 minutes, I finally  arrived at the window where I was ignored for 4 more minutes until I I asked for my drink. The barista was rude and told me "everyone wants their drinks"  I will never go to this Starbucks again

Busy. Sooo busy. Inside AND drive through. Lots of students working, but some places to sit. Friendly, efficient baristas, who are as accommodating as they are friendly. The store is next door to Sonny's Barbecue, so when parking is unavailable, park in spaces available across the driveway into the shopping center. Look both ways when crossing over. Four stars for parking inside and out. But ... Drinks are made to perfection, and the smiles are limitless: I really like this Starbucks!!

Terribly Slow. 30 minutes for a coffee it's unacceptable. They treat you poorly and the drinks are watery down . Drive 5 extra minutes and go to the new one in highway 50 . 
Don't waist your time here.   By the way. Not once nor twice. Every single time it's the same . I'm done !

SLOWEST STARBUCKS EVER!!! I was late to an event on Saturday while stuck in the drive through for 20mins!! Sunday I thought I'd try again considering it's the only local Starbucks with a drive through. And the line was around the plaza. And not moving. Line inside was just about out the door after weaving in and out inside the store. And then the mobile ordering "wasn't available". It shouldn't be this hard to get a cup of coffee! I drove 5 mins down the road to the other Starbucks on G2Bay and 19 and I was in and out even with a few people in line. But again, LATE because of this location. The staff clearly needs more efficient training or better management. I've very rarely had quick, easy or polite service. Such a shame bc in a great location.

This is a busy location but people are so super hard on these poor Starbucks employees who work there butts off!! I mean I love my Starbucks also but geez give them a break. You can see there going as fast as possible. However I do feel Starbucks should have two people on mobile to go orders. Anyhoooo...I still come to this location regularly because I need my Starbucks fixed!

As a (recent) former Starbucks employee I am CONSTANTLY disappointed by this Starbucks. I now work at the children's hospital and stop by often to get a little pick me up before work. However every time I go, without fail, my drink is made wrong. Simple drinks like London fogs and americanos! Maybe they just went through a hiring period, however that's no excuse when Starbucks prices themselves on "standard". It would be one thing if it was one barista who made errors but the fact that I can order different drinks and go when different people are working and still have my drink poorly made is VERY frustrating. 

Maybe retrain on drinks or review with baristas because this is really annoying.

This Starbucks staff had to be one of the most unorganized and unprofessional staffs that I've ever seen. There was no type of communication amongst themselves or to customers walking in. It is unfortunate because the products we bought were actually well-made. That is not a saving factor for terrible customer service though. I will try to give this place another assessment a little later on to see if they fix this.


Update:

Since I've been back, they must have taken a note of the issue because the drinks/sandwiches have been marvelous and the service has been prompt! They've completely turned around my negative experience from previously and I was happy to see their staff has been improving their communication. Great job, guys.
Made it the way I like. Not the cleanest place I've ever scene. Also the lady next to me spilled her hot drink all over my one leg boo .

Traveling thru BNA (btw, is a very nice airport, ease of use, etc), early morning flight, went to Starbucks as I always do when traveling. Barista, Iris (short hispanic female) probably shouldn't work the morning shift; she was snippy while taking orders. I made it a point to see what her name was, as this is not typical of baristas I've ever experienced with Starbucks.
Typical Starbucks coffees and treats. What makes this store stand out is the terrible upkeep of the restrooms. Disgusting!
Leider sehr dreckig, Personal total überfordert. Es gibt viel schönere. Große Enttäuschung. Produkte schmecken wie immer.
Slow service.  Staff needs to move quickly to serve long line of customers.  Milk station may not have milk varieties.

I can't begin to express my gratitude to the young lady who held a bag of decaf Christmas Blend Coffee for me. I cannot have a lot of caffeine in my system so decaf is my usual go to when it comes to Coffee. She held this bag for me overnight and when I arrived the next morning at the store, she was not there but Alex and the gentleman who was also there were very sweet and accommodating. Alex told me of another location nearby that might have the Decaf Christmas blend and wouldn't you know they had it! So now I've got 2 bags of the Decaf Christmas blend to last me!

Ordered a nitro cold brew and a medium coffee and they didnt even ask me my name so I stood there waiting for it while they let me just stand there without telling me. The nitro cold brew they poured for me was 90% foam. I told the barista about it but she said she couldnt do anything for me and proceeded to keep pourinf customers foamy cold brew. Hey I dont know maybe its out and you need to replace it? Im no barista or bartender but im pretty sure all foam means its empty. Anyway the girl working didnt even offer me another product or refund she just sort of looked at me and kept pouring the foam. Maybe if a manager was there to assist them it looked like the two workers were overwhelmed couldn't keep up and weren't competent enough to ask for help or figure out how to pour a cold brew. Worst starbucks experience ever will never be going back.

I came here the other day and ordered a Mango Dragonfruit Refresher, which I frequently order and this time it was terrible. I asked them to remake it and it was just as bad. I went back today and did a mobile order for a Java Chip Frappe. The wait said 2-7 minutes. It took 20 minutes!! It caused me to be late and was very disappointing.

I went to this Starbucks tonight, and the man who made my coffee was kinda rude. I never complain about these things, but I treat people the way I want to be treated. He seemed annoyed about me coming in to order, and no eye contact. The iced coffee was also super bitter and he just put it on the counter, then hurried away. I also didn't mind reaching behind the counter to get a straw, but it was just weird. Maybe he had a bad day, I don't know.

I've always known about this location but didn't come here until a week or so ago. It's easily become one of my favorites.

I mainly go to Starbucks since it's a good place to study. But because of where I live it can be hard to find one with free parking and enough seating.

I love this one since there is always parking and it's FREE, which is huge. The dining room doesn't have a ton of seating but most people who come here get orders to go so you can pretty much always find a large table. The baristas are super friendly and I've never had a problem with my order.

Will definitely be a regular!

This is my wife's and my favorite Starbucks location.  Close to the house and covered outdoor seating makes a great spot to our pup. Lola loves her puppuccino (whipped cream in a Starbucks cup). It's always nice and clean here and the customer service is always top notch!  Although Starbucks is on the expensive side for coffee, or whatever you buy for that matter, it's the "Starbucks experience" that brings us back. Mellow music, other "like" customers, great free wifi, and of course great coffee. We've also met a lot of other dog lovers here who like to sit outside with their pup which keeps us coming back. So stop by and bring your pup and maybe we'll meet up someday!

Let's face it, we all kind what Starbucks is about.  You have so many choices and sizes at a premium price.  I am fine with that.   Their customer service is heralded as top notch.

I have found the cool refreshers to be a great option to coffee or tea.  The issue lately with the Starbucks locations I have visited is that they do not fill the cup.  It seems trivial, but when you pay top dollar, you want your beverage filled, not an inch or so from the top.  

Next time, I will complain but it was just too busy.  Bitching in front of others and backing up the line was not what I wanted.  Let's hope they browse yelp reviews and get it right!

Update- they still are awful
Im not sure what progress can ever be made!!! I keep hearing horror stories- its a shame because the district manager is so sweet!!!
Sadly this Store might just need a complete turn over

Place looked like it hasn't been cleaned in a week and the 2 people at the register had attitudes like I should know the whole menu inside and out. I go to Starbucks like 3 times a year. The people making the drinks were really nice

New location with more parking and bigger store. Seats are comfortable for lounging, or hard backed chairs are available for serious working. Power outlets are readily available. Baristas are friendly and capable. This is my first time placing an order in advance. App said to give them 5 minutes. It's been 10, and only the drive thru is busy. Only two others are waiting for orders that they placed inside. But it seems I ordered something (bananas) that they don't have. Ally refunded my money for my bananas and the new drink was made expertly and right!

While I don't have any problem reviewing "chain' establishments, with only an exception or two I don't tend to review places where you can pretty much expect the same thing from location to location.

This is, for the most part, the truth with Starbucks. Starbucks is Starbucks, ya' know? If you don't like their coffee in one location, there's a pretty good chance you won't like it in another location and, of course, vice versa. Now then, you do get some variations in service and I do think those are worth mentioning.

So, here I am. 

I was spending the evening at this corner of 56th & Illinois - dinner at Byrne's Grilled Pizza, a visit to Kids Ink, ice cream at Graeter's and, at the last minute, a stop at this Starbucks location for a shaken iced tea for the road. I mean, heck, even the fire station in this neighborhood is pretty good to look at.

As has been noted, this location is located on the corner and it's in an older, fairly upscale neighborhood. While not all the buildings in this area are wheelchair friendly, Starbucks built a decent ramp into their place and despite it being an incredibly small location it's also pretty well laid out for a wheelchair. 

I was actually wheeling by Starbucks when an employee appeared at the door. As I haven't known them to be incredibly hard-sell with their coffee, it quickly became apparent he believed I was on the way in and because it was raining and a bit chilly he was there to make sure I got in alright. 

Great move, Starbucks. 

There's actually an entrance right on Illinois and an entrance on the 56th Street side. The Illinois Street entrance, while appearing to be the main entrance, isn't adjacent to the ordering side. It's not a huge deal, but worth noting. As I entered, another friendly employee poked gentle fun of my Gold Club card and the fact that I corrected myself when I referred to my drink as merely an "iced tea" and not a "shaken iced tea." She was like "I'd have known what you meant." I almost said "Yeah, well, I've heard Starbucks can be kind of militant about the whole drink name thing," but I decided to appreciate her friendly demeanor. 

My drink was prepared quickly and correctly. The same employee who'd opened the door on my way in opened it on the way out. While this isn't particularly rare for someone in a wheelchair, it still was a notch above on a night when it was raining. It was appreciated. 

As others have noted, the interior is small and I could see where it would easily fill up. This location is fairly close to Butler University, though I'd imagine Butler has their own options and I can think of 1-2 other Starbucks locations also close to Butler along with a Hubbard & Cravens. 

This place fits the neighborhood feel of this corner. They were warm, friendly and inviting and their interior reflects their upscale area because you do have some coffee options you may not find in the more urban settings.

I love this Starbucks location! Mary at the drive thru is always super friendly and asks how my day is going. I always appreciate that! 

It gets fairly busy during the weekday with lots of people getting work done, so outlets are sometimes at a premium and finding a table mid-day is sometimes difficult.

Obviously Starbucks is a chain but this location is fantastic-- accurate on the order and a friendly staff that makes it seem like a neighborhood coffee shop. Keep up the good work!

By far my least favorite Starbucks experience. My husband and I waited nearly 40 minutes for two iced coffees. When our name was called, only one of the two drinks were handed over. I mentioned to the employee there is a second one and her response was simply no. It was printed quite clear on the cup that it was drink one of two and she didn't acknowledge.  After another five minutes of waiting, we were able to grab the the attention of another and he said he would make it for us. While he was quite polite, the other 8 employees were quite literally tripping over each other. We were not the o ly customers who took notice. It is quite evident they need some training in both customer service and their craft. The restrooms were filthy. No soap or paper towels and the stations were also lacking supplies and covered in trash. This might not be the best location to consider for a quick stop on your route.

On a business trip and decided to stop by and get a cup of coffee before my meeting. What can you say about a Starbucks? Same coffee and food. The service is another story. Four people ahead of me and it took 15 mins to take two orders. I know they want to up sell the scones and the other baked goods but when a customer say no move on. I looked at my watch and I left the store. The service is terrible.

I asked for VERY light ice, in fact I specified NO MORE THAN 3 CUBES...And this is what I got. Half the cup! Do Starbucks employees have issues counting or is this a forced policy? Shame on you Starbucks.

Want to be late to class or an appointment? Come to this Starbucks.

You know you're desperate for GOOD coffee when you're willing to wait in a 20 minute line, when there are other places that sell coffee around campus.  The coffee, was good, the staff moved as quickly as they could, but they had one person working the register and a line of 50 people at a time.  Starbucks should hire more staff for this location to please customers and ease the burden on their employees.

When you climb out of bed in the morning and you're all like "must... Have.... Coffee...." And then there's that beautiful white and green mermaid a block over, singing her over-roasted, sugar-laden siren song and you're all like "I'm gonna get the diabeetus but its sooooo good" so you go in there and you're like, "wait am I at Cheers? Because everyone knows my name. Oh and my drink is ready before I've even finished paying" and then you come home and all your friends and family are sitting in a circle in your living room and they're like "have a seat, we're worried about you" and you're like.... Okay, hold that thought I need some coffee people.... 

But yeah, this is a good SBUX. Go there. You need another addiction, right? (Who doesn't?)
They're eh. They never have enough pumpkin bread or chocolate croissants. They don't fill your coffee up all the way yet they put a half a cup of ice in to make it seem like they did.

Cockroaches!

Hello!

I tell the staff at the counter every other time I order coffee at this location.
After a Month, cockroaches!

Maybe it's the old building or maybe it's all the homeless people that hang out in there.

This is likely the last time I visit here until they advertise a remodel or put up a sign on the front doors reading, "No Homeless Welcome".

It's a business not a shelter.

Buy something or don't enter.

It's not a personal shower room either, it's called a rest room.
This place is ridiculous. You have to ask for a key to the restroom. Like a gas station. They might as well tear it down and build an Exxon. The coffee was the same quality.

It's very convenient to have a Starbuck drive-thru instead of going into Safeway store. We have been here multiple time. Order was quick and fast. We usually came here order for our family on Saturdays I and my girlfriend yes it does gets packed at drive thru and order didn't not came out what we expected it. Something it's miss understanding and yet there's room to improvement.

We have been coming to this Starbucks since they've been open. We've seen managers come and go, staff changes and remodels. Consistency has never failed. The Baristas learn our names, drinks and faces quickly. They are always friendly. Though at times it could be chaotic and an ocasional drink gets messed up overall we love our backyard Starbucks. Great job to our new manager "Brittany".

Who doesn't love some starbucks?! The baristas are quick and make your drinks at their best, all the time. A very cozy spot. It gets busy from time to time and sometimes there's nowhere to sit and relax but, not an issue because we all need Starbucks.
So we went to order a white iced chocolate mocha, and it was just plain milk with sugar. They re-made the drink but it tasted the same. The other drinks were good

As I continue my tour of Starbucks around Saint Louis I found myself immensely pleased with this one. The servers were very nice, there was a lot of seats--a good thing as the place was a bit busy--and other than an annoying parking lot it was a good experience. 

Yes though, that parking lot seems like a great way to get run over or in a car crash, as the strange setup has to be seen to be believed--with people whipping down a hill to sudden make a sharp left turn into the drive-thru; or, if they come from another street, darting straight in, placing themselves in a prime position to get T-boned by the aforementioned folk coming down the hill.

Were the parking lot not a deathtrap this place would be 5 out of 5 stars.
this Starbucks location does not serve quality. The smiles are nice, please the products are Not worth price. Too bad  the Starbucks sign will attract people, the poor quality is disappointing.

This was the fastest Starbucks I have ever been to. I ordered a pink drink and it was prepared in under 5 minutes. The consistency was great and it was mixed well. The people working were very nice and made sure that they got my order correct. My friends Frappuccino also took a very short time to make. They have lots of seating and it's a great place to study or get some work done.

Absolutely the slowest most unmotivated staff I have ever seen at a Starbucks.i can't tell you how many people I saw leave the line or bypass the store after looking at the shit show that was C concourse Starbucks. But hey, they are consistent with no intent to change.

The workers where very rude. I bit my tongue and still said thank you after being ignored for 5 minutes so the employees could talk about there personal lifes. The coffee is pretty much the same at all the Starbucks so the worker's make the experience and the suck at this one.
Waited 21 min for my mocha this morning. Ridiculous! Need new management. No wonder the stock has been dropping.

Nice to have good quality coffee like Starbucks at a rest stop but they seem to be pretty slow considering the amount of people working at this store. I guess beggars cannot be choosers here. Definitely a contrast from the NYC Starbucks stores. My drip coffee was good.

Stopped in just after 6:00 am for coffee and hot tea with my NYT.  I like the choice of music - but way too much volume.  Too distracting for my reading concentration. Asked for lower volume but I guess they got distracted by the music and forgot. Employees seem to choose their listening comfort over customers.  Let's ease into the day with a little more chill - please.

Sigh not too many Starbucks disappoiny with costumer service, but this one could use some help.  I wanted 20 minutes for a white defense tea!  The staff there said they had "forgot to place my order" after I paid for it.  Definitely annoyed. No offer for compensation either.  Skip this Starbucks when our

Starbucks Starbucks...oh how so many people love you and hate you. This girl is a regular at this Starbucks. Some are good and some are bad this one is just at home. 

You ask how can this be ? It is so close to the mall and it is hard to find parking in peak times. Let me tell you why . This Starbucks is a great place to unwind from your daily troubles and relax. 

Yes it is busy and yea it is hard to find parking at times but it's worth the wait because the staff is always friendly and remember you by name. They make you feel at home.

Nice music in the background, low enough to hear it but not too loud where you need to shout to talk to your table companion. The facility is clean, the workers were nice, and there were sufficient seating with nearby plugs for the laptop(s). They offer outdoor seating. Although my White Chocolate Mocha was extremely bitter, I took it as a sign that I really didn't need it anyway. :) Also, there's free WiFi. :)
Slowest Starbucks in the world. The guy in the drive through who calls you "buddy," "pal," "friend", and "mommy" before you've even had the chance to order is just awful.
Horrible service. The girls behind the counter were more concerned with talking about how "lit" their birthday parties are going to be rather than focusing on making drinks. Very unprofessional.

This location is horrible. Never fails. They always mess up my order somehow or forget to tell me that items are sold out and let me stand there waiting. I'd rather travel farther than this location not to mention the employees are never friendly. Whenever I say thank you,...no response back.

I came in with my own cup with my own cream and sweetener. I use stevia liquid sweetener. I told the barrister that I just wanted coffee, that I had my own creamer and sweetener in the cup. He starts putting sweetener in my cup, I told him to stop, because I had my own stuff in the cup. He then emptied my cup to put coffee in. They need to learn how to listen. Worst service ever!! Of course I left them without
 coffee.

I joke about this place being my office space, because it's my default study place on campus to get some work done. 

Why? Let me tell you why :P
- Outlets everywhere! Underneath tables, along the walls, in the ground - you name it
- High tables and low tables. Options are a wonderful thing, especially when you want to first sit and work for a while, and then stand and work for a while
- Open until midnight almost every night, even weekends! On Sundays they close at 10pm, but even that is later than most other coffeeshops in general
- Convenient location, being so close to frogro, the bank, the post service, CVS, food, etc. It's nice to get some of your errands out of the way/pick up a snack on your way to or from studying.
- The baristas are super friendly! They know the regulars, they aren't stingy about giving you water, and they frequently offer free drinks when they have a misplaced order
- Bathrooms are large and relatively clean. They're not particularly fancy but they have toilet seat covers (which I love) and it's generally very well maintained
- Lots of seating. So far, I've pretty much never had an incident where I couldn't find at least one seat, even though there are certain times of the day when it get a bit crowded. But compared to other coffeeshops on campus or in the city, this Starbucks is a safe bet on finding space

If you see me there (which is very likely), feel free to say hello :)

PS. I gave up checking in a long time ago, because my current count is not even an inkling of my actual number of visits (I say this both sadly and proudly)
Please don't assume I want that disgusting sweetener in my iced coffee. There's nothing worse than that awful surprise.
Great staff, large shop, plenty of seating. Even if the line is long, the wait is not.

I absolutely love this Starbucks location! I come here most Wednesday mornings at 6:30am and the staff is always super positive and welcoming! Not only is the staff friendly, but it's been a great space to meet other people in the area who have made this their neighborhood coffee shop! There is plenty of space and usually an open outlet for a charger! Long live the Caffeinated Siren Queen!

I waited in line for 15-20 minutes to be helped by Matthew at the register he was absolutely rude and has no customer service skills whatsoever.  He doesn't even know the difference between Trenta and Venti. I not happy with their service at all. This Starbucks needs some real training.

Asked for a particular drink, when made it was done wrong. Watched the whole process. Asked the supposed barista if the drink was made a certain way, they totally lied ro my face. Called them on it, and received total attitude. Unfortunately,  this isn't the first time. Worst Starbucks I've been too.

For a Starbucks very very disappointed. Walked in no acknowledges, stood at the counter for 5 mins finally asked to be assisted the was helped buy curt unfriendly service, the whole time the barista was yelling at the drive thru dude, one star! I will try another store for now on.

When one door closes another opens.  So goes the old saw.  And as the Starbucks in Eagle Plaza location closed this new one, called the Riverside location, opened.

The Plaza location was convenient to my house.  But it was narrow and awkward inside, the parking lot could be miserable and it had no drive through when that was the thing devoutly to be wished.  You know, those no makeup and bad hair days.  

So this new location is welcome for more space inside.  Although no better parking, more of it but in a really awkward lot. 

Inside you'll find a pletohora of high backless stools at high communal table that almost no one wants to use unless last resort and paucity of standard height tables with regular chairs that are almost always the first choice of everyone who enters.  What is with that in Starbuck's designs of late?  

End of rhetorical question musing.

It also has a drive through.

It also has more outdoor seating than the old location but the tables are packed like sardines in a can.

Some of the same, friendly Plaza staff found their way here.  There are some new people who are clearly in learning mode.  And the entire store is in "newbie facility" shake out.  So patience is in order while they get their footing.

THIS N THAT:

LOCATION NOTE:  Near the new Eagle tennis club and just down the road from Perks of Life.  If you'd rather frequent a locally owned coffee place, Perks is a good option to do that.

Headed for flight and stopped as I normally do.  Line was 40 people deep, wrapped around the store next door.  Stood for 15-20 minutes and did not move. No coffee is worth this aggravation.  They need a better system for folks who just want a cup of black coffee.

Needed something refreshing after playing disc golf at a park nearby.  I came in here to get a bottle of water, and then the add for a pumpkin spice Frappuccino caught my eye, so of course I got one, haha.  

Too bad there was only one size for bottled water, which was huge and way more (and more expensive) than I would have preferred paying for.  But I guess it was good to quench my thirst for the long drive home from Indiana to Illinois.  

I like how you can choose the Frappuccinos to be caffeinated or decaffeinated.  I opted for decaf, because I didn't want the caffeine in the afternoon.  

The pumpkin spice Frapp is sweet but delicious.  Yum!

Gabe and his friend (I think Kyle, who has been here for five years but didn't want Gabe to tell anyone that, sorry Kyle) were excellent. 

We were a particularly silly bunch and they handled our weird and delivered both a fantastic customer experience and delicious drinks & snacks. Especially considering the shortage of fresh bananas and only having smoothie bananas on hand. They were able to deliver an adequate smoothie experience with no issues.

This by far is the best Starbucks I've been to. 

The customer service is fabulous! They treat their customers the way customers should be treated. Additionally, I can't think of a time my drink was incorrect. When you spend $5 for a coffee some might think you're crazy. Fine...but I don't mind it if my drink is on point. My drinks are always on point because the workers actually care!

This is the nicest Starbucks I have been to in a while. It is spacious, clean, and a little modern. I was meeting a friend up here for coffee after work, and while the traffic was hectic and busy, upon walking in I immediately felt at ease. Something about a smiling barista and the thought that coffee is on its way just puts me into a good mood. It also helps that there was so many tables so we could find a quiet area to catch up. I would definitely recommend this location if you plan on sitting and enjoying your coffee there.

every time I go to this location there is always a problem. they somehow always manage to mess up any order I have even though they write it on the cup. the people who work here almost always are In a mad mood and very rude. I had one girl laugh at me over my order and say it was stupid.. I guess she thought I didn't have ears. I always come back thinking it will be different but it never is. I will not be coming back and will continue to drive 20 minutes out of my way to go to another location.

Where has the quality gone???
Here is $6 give me what you want because NO ONE LISTENS HERE!!

Every order has been wrong or slow for the past year!!

Absolutely awful store service!

I visited this place on 2017/8/11, around 3 o'clock. I ordered ice tall cafe mocha. The barista, who took my order, didn't ask my name and also forgot to prepare my drink. I had to stand right in front of the counter for like 20 mins waiting my drink. All the other customers got their drinks but me. She finally thought that something was weird and then asked me "what did you order?" God, she took my order 20 minutes ago and most of drinks were ordered via app so there were not much people she met during that 20 mins. Maybe she forgot my drink, because I was a foreigner and she thought it's okay to treat that way. But I wasted my 30 mins and was late for my appointment with my friend. She did not apologize me ever. Worse thing was her attitude. when she finally gave me the drink, she almost tossed it in to me. My friend, who came at the moment, saw her attitude and asked me what was wrong with her. The whole experience that I got from this Starbucks was very unpleasant because of one blunt and rude barista who worked at the moment. I will never order my drinks at the place!!!!!

Reason for one star slow service and I mean really slow. Took them 10 minutes to take my order plus another 15 to give my coffee! Waited way too long for a simple coffee! It happen to me before but I decided to give them another chance. Never coming back again!
Very competent Starbucks location. Not a lot to say as it was pretty standard. The employees were kind and prompt, not a lot more you can ask for in a downtown Starbucks location!

It seems like this Starbucks is short staffed all the time.
The staff is still friendly and nice.
The store could be more bright cause it seems a little dark.

If you're trying to choose a Starbucks in the area... CHOOSE THIS ONE!!!! 
The staff is amazing!!!
I'm from California, so this was a stop on my way and he made me feel right at home.
Graham helped me at the front register- and nothing but a smile on his face.

Not only that, but this is a drive thru and I've never seen a drive thru that has mastered both cafe and drive times. 
I usually see the drive thru prioritized and the cafe has to wait longer but my drink came out quickly, and correct!
Helps that him and another barista (wish i could remember his name ) helped me decide to get my Tennessee mug lol overall a fantastic experience

Probably the last time I go out of my way to this Starbucks. Worst parking lot of them all! Today I was served an iced caramel macchiato that had no caramel and tasted as if it was simply milk and expresso. I've had good experiences in the past however after today and the never ending 5-10 minute wait for a parking spot I think I'll go to Springfield.

I am not a coffee fan, but I love the Zen tea.  I usually purchase it in tea bags and prepare it at home.  I decided to stop in and order one directly from Starbucks since I had some time to kill before my next meeting.

Worst mistake ever!  They used BOILING water, which anyone that knows how to make tea knows that boiling water cooks the leaves and leaves them tasting disgusting and also burns the mouth of anyone who attempts to drink said tea.

I ended up throwing away my overpriced cup of bitter water and grabbing my ice water in my car.  I felt that there was no point of asking for a manager, they are all in their twenties.. like they care.

This Starbucks is decent, not the best or worst I've been too. It's mostly clean considering how much foot traffic there is. The baristas are nice. There's extra seating upstairs, only one bathroom, which considering how large the Starbucks is - it stinks. My coffee was okay, nothing spectacular. I asked for lite ice but they didn't really give me lite. Overall it's convenient if you're in the area.
Pretty empty for a Starbucks at 8am. But a larger sitting area than most and they have outdoor seating.

I work across the street from this location, so I visit here fairly often (when I don't decide to get Dunkin' lol). My friend and I met up in the city and decided to get White Chocolate Mochas (hers with almond milk, mine regular milk). The barista was very friendly and we got into casual conversation with him. (Good luck with moving your sister into her new place this weekend!) The barista also making the drinks knew not to put whipped cream on my friend's almond milk white chocolate mocha (as she has allergies to regular milk). We went back into the store just to double check that they didn't put any whipped cream on it, which was good. My White Chocolate Mocha was delicious and the PERFECT temperature. I recommend this location!

Filthy is an understatement. There are gnats and all kinds of bugs everywhere. Last time I went the display food had bugs all over and they informed me the manager didn't know what the doors were and threw them away....
Tables always dirty, floors never swept with crumbs everywhere, and too many staff members are rude and cussing while carrying on their private conversations loudly.

Staff needs to work on the way the speak to the customers and how they treat them. Pretty rude. Then to top it off the drinks they make aren't up to normal Starbucks standards. I've given this Starbucks multiple chances.  I'm done. They need some serious training.

Located under the radar within a Target department store, this hidden gem of Reno is must-see for anyone looking for a good coffee and even better service. This coffee shop bleeds the kind of atmosphere you thought only existed on television. You can sit back and relax with your coffee for a minute as the world moves around you. A melting pot of people bustle back and forth within the red walls of the store in a rush for the hottest deals as almost character-like employees interact and whip up drinks with a frenzied synergy that contradicts your expectations of what working for a soul crushing Seattle based corporation must be like. 

With dazzling smiles, the baristas address their customers by name. It is clear that the people warmly taking in their morning coffee are regulars. They could go anywhere. So why do they go here? To a chain located within a chain?  
  
It can only be because of the excellent customer service. The dynamic dark roast duo behind the counter are named Diana and Kelsey and between discussing the intricacies of French cinema and Canine-American rights, they are delivering the precise orders of their dazzled customers at a lightning pace. Curious to see how they would treat a newcomer, I approached the counter and struggled to figure out what to purchase. With a smile, "Kelsey" suggested I try a "crystal ball" drink that resembled the bad guy in the last Spider-man movie. "Diana" interjected and suggested a variation of the drink that was much better. This personal touch and recommendation had me instantly sold. Despite my eager enthusiasm, they even offered to let me sample it first, assuring me it was not a problem. It was like they'd known me for years and I instantly understood why so many people chose to visit this location.  
  
The drink was made to perfection and in that crystal ball drink I saw myself returning here in my future! The service didn't stop there though. After offering me an ice cold water (they managed to inject the frozen H2O croutons very adeptly), I watched as an errant child projectile vomited all over the wall, his mother nowhere to be found. The girls were on top of it instantly. Cleaning the mess and directing customers with practiced ease while calling for assistance with the child, I was stunned by their rapid response. To add to the situation, I watched as a Target employee stumbled over and attempted to rattle the girls with incessant questions about a show called "Duck Tales". With patient looks, the girls answered his questions to satisfaction and it became clear to me that they were truly prepared for anything this red walled hub might throw at them.  
  
Do yourself a favor and visit this Starbucks located within Target. If Diana and Kelsey are making drinks with confidence as cool as the Frappuccinos, I can guarantee you'll leave with a smile.
    
...Parking kinda sucks though.
Today is the day - #starbucksrecycledcup day - luckily they got a huge supply and I was able to get one.
I've only been here a few times.  The service is really great and it's never been crowded, which I think is really awesome.  The location is nice and it's extremely clean.

The place is clean, the service was awesome- some of the nicest baristas I've ever had, they were fast, the drinks were perfect and I was pleased. I feel like I'm betraying my normal baristas at the Frys location who are awesome-but these ladies need some recognition! Great job!

Got the salted caramel mocha with blonde espresso and skim milk. Delicious! I just wish they'd fill the cup a bit more, I feel kinda cheated when it's not up to the brim. I also wonder if maybe they dont make them hot enough?

Once again there is a massive line at an airport Starbucks. These should always have at least two registers open, plus baristas should be taking drink orders while people wait to pay. Why is this so hard?

Waist of time. One review said to budget 30 min, I think that's being generous. I budgeted an hr, still not enough time for my two drink order. 
I had to abandon my order, along with a few other customers, kissing our money good bye. 
Line was too long to try and get back in it, to talk to the one person on register to figure out refunds. 

Stop taking people's order, and help
the one painfully slow person making drinks! 

The WORST.

Great staff. Not unique to this airport Starbucks, but why do these particular Starbucks have no accessibility for the mobile app? This is an ENORMOUS INCONVENIENCE!!! Dunkin Donuts can do it, why can't Starbucks?!

Simply because the line is always long! Every time, no matter what time. The line is too long. You may not even have to step out of mine beside it's just too much. The staff is ok, but not as friendly as your neighborhood Starbucks. I get it, non-stop hand crafted drinks!
"Excellent service. They always know my exact order all the way from the speaker! Very friendly and professional staff!"
They're awesome. There's not much more I can say; they're just awesome. My order is always correct and tasty, they remember me as a regular customer and it's a comfortable place to do my work.
Rudest manager I have ever come across. The manager Oscar Minan-Raffo needs to be given a customer relations refresher course.
Not your best model of starbucks... tiny... teenwage driven and no drive thru... parking is a nightmare lol

Attention to detail is poor. Went drive thru for iced coffee.  Let's face it, when you pay 3$ and up for a drink, it better be right and good.  Starbucks quality is exceptional but that doesn't mean a thing when your drink is filled up an inch from the bottom.  Also, cream and sugar amounts way off.  Just a bad product for the cost.  Heck, Mickey D's would have been better for a buck each!  

If you do go to this location, just make double sure you get what you want.  Our problem was we went drive thru so no way to fix the problem after the fact.

Always a few homeless people hanging out and then maybe 3 places to sit aside from that so that's awesome. Oh and also, waited 30 minutes (while 7 months pregnant) to use the restroom when an old lady finally walked out apologized and told me she had had blood all over herself and "it took a while to get it all off" so um no thanks I just left and decided to patronize a place that has adequate facilities and table room available for paying customers.

The customer service is at it's finest at this Starbucks!  The manager, Paul, is one of the kindest people that I have met in Philadelphia.  His service goes above and beyond.  You definitely leave with a smile!

This Starbucks was relaxing. I've never been at this location. I had a meeting with someone & I felt like CRAP! My sinus was kicking my butt that night. Thankfully I immediately ordered a medicine ball. Oh my, I swear within 15 minutes, I could breathe out my nose. I see why it's called a "medicine ball." In reality, it should be changed to "miracle tea." Because it was a miracle that I felt almost 100% better after taking the tea within 30 minutes. The staff was friendly & welcoming.

Terrible customer service. They mess up my drink all the time they close 20-25 mins earlier than their time. I constantly wait in line for 10 minutes somtimes longer. The only reason why I keep going is Bc it is close to my house but I will drive further just to avoid this location.

This is my go to store.  They are friendly and fast.  I rarely wait for a mobile order and never more than a minute.  Since the Faith Rd location has gone downhill this is the go to Starbucks in Greenwood.

My personal experience was less than desirable. Rocío was the person who took my order and truly I expect more from Starbucks than what I experienced. She was too busy talking to her coworkers so I guess I disturbed her conversation; as I ordered the coffees she interrupted me twice saying she did not understand what I was ordering. I am used to people asking me to repeat myself since I have an accent, my point however is the way she asked. She was plain rude, her attitude was just not up to standard. Getting the order almost correctly now. They were not served over ice but still good. The Talls were short squat cups, not Tall at all. The total price was 962. I rounded up to 12 with my tip. You know these kids are making Lousy wages at the drivethru. We drove away and I said to my husband Starbucks Stock Holders are LAUGHING all the way to the Bank. This is a MULTI BILLION dollar company. They could lower their prices so that MORE people could AFFORD it and INCREASE the wages of their young employees. They WON'T!!!! Maybe in a Perfect World. I seriously doubt that their employees can afford to buy the coffee they are selling. Just a thought.

I just left this location after getting a full refund... the place is chaos ...people standing around 15-20 minutes waiting on their orders... orders done incorrectly...drive-through had 14 cars in it and online orders were pouring in people showing up to pick those up And being told to wait because the staff fell behind...poorly managed store.

I ordered an iced tea lemonade and and iced lemon loaf ...the cashier gave me the lemon loaf and while I waited the 20 minutes for my drink...I ate the loaf...I heard my name called so I thought it was my ice tea lemonade ...I walk over and it's a second iced lemon loaf so I carry it back to the girl who called my name and laid it on the counter ...I told her I already ate this I need my drink ...she replied "I don't do drinks. I won't go back!

This is a fair review if you go there you will see what I am describing above.
Good local Starbucks.....lots of outdoor/indoor seating.  Pleasant service and fairly expeditious.

I'm so excited that there's finally a drive thru Starbucks here! This location looked great, and had a very modern feel to it! I was quite pleased with how fast the drive thru was! They had forgotten to make one of the drinks, but were quick to fix it! I think this is one of the only drive thru Starbucks in Oro Valley, the others are all inside grocery stores.
great place to socialize and the staff is always friendly, sometimes a little busy so finding a chair could be hard.

BEST Starbucks experience ever!!! A girl named Katie was working the drive thru. The entire time we waited for our coffee she hung out at the window and made awesome conversation. Usually people just shut the window or don't talk to you. She was the kind of employee that brings people back to a location. Starbucks is winning with service like hers! (She was from Roseville, in case there's more than one katie!) :)
The slowest, the most unwelcoming, most confused, no sense of urgency group of people I've ever encountered at a Starbucks. They make you want to go to WaWa or Royal Farm!!

This starbucks features a great uniquely warm environment, friendly staff, and a nice work space for students or meetings--they have a lot of individual tables and a long table. The hours also allow you to work for a significant amount of time.

Plus points
1) dogs are welcome here. They sometimes have treats even. 
2) the fireplace during the winter. They keep it going, and it makes the place so warm and homey
3) the knowledgeable and professional staff
4) consistent free wifi
5) the starbucks reserve available
6) no silly bathroom codes

Minus point
1) no online app order available
Loud blaring music at 9am.  I feel like I'm in a nightclub.  None of the customers like it.   But the employees are having a good time.

What do I need to do to get my coffee made with no foam!!  this happens every time and these girls don't give two ish about how the customers want our coffee!!! I'm not ever coming back to this location and I didn't want to write a bad review but the lack of customer service at this location is ridiculous. 
   What does it take to pls read what the order is and correctly make it right. I open the cup and clearly she see my face and that there is an inch or foam. I order a double tall caramel macchiato with soy no foam. It didn't even have the caramel drizzle on top. Worst Starbucks ever.
By far the worst Starbucks around...service is horrible...wait time is unacceptable!! Then after you wait 15 mins YOUR ORDER IS WRONG!!!

This is a small Starbucks that receives heavy foot traffic due to the location. 

Not the cleanest either.

The bathroom gives me the heebie jeebies. 

Peep the pix.

This is the best Starbucks I have ever been to! Every single employee is so kind, personable and competent! I will come back to this one every time I'm grabbing coffee out! Lovely art inside tops it all off!
Even with the gold card, you can't get any free refill, you can't use the rewards, they don't tell you in advance anywhere, not good. :(

This is now my go-to 'Bux as I work at 18 & Market (I used to frequent the one at 20 & Market).  During the morning rush it gets absolutely mobbed - use the mobile ordering if you can and you can swoop in and out to get your over-priced #DiabetesInaCup.

Meanwhile, I treat myself to a latte about twice a week.  Trying to cut down but I love them.

I know people claim to not like Starbucks but the long lines here (quick moving) seem to indicate otherwise.

Gotta have my FiveBucks aka Charbucks!

My sister and I had a coupon for a buy one get one free holiday drink. I arrived and went inside to place my order. I was greeted and ready to place my order. I provided the cashier my coupon and Starbucks card. 

The only thing that was wrong was that I asked for an iced latte, but I ended up with a frozen one. No biggie-it was free and I still enjoyed it. 

This location is attached to a bank which is kind of cool, I bet the bankers love the smell of coffee all day (or they hate it?) and they do have a drive-thru as well.

This location was not accepting cash due to technical difficulties. 
A very busy airport and all they did was tape an easily missed 8 by 11 inch sheet of paper sign someone whipped up on a computer. 

There were over 40 people in line most of who were not aware of the cash only issue. 

Absolutely unacceptable to hear from the cashier when I finally got to place an order "we made a sign". 

Starbucks - thanks for wasting my time - it will never happen again. You lost my business for good.

The worst Starbucks seems like they can never get my order right and it's always same excuse new staff or short or staff saving my money and skipping this place! It's always such a disappointment when you decide to indulge from a diet and your splurge item isn't right and tastes funny 

Thanks for continuously disappointing me I'm gonna remember next time to skip this location.

This Starbucks is great to grab a cup of coffee. But last time I was here the power strips were not working, so I could not do any work while I was there on my laptop. I do wish this location was as big as the Starbucks on Montgomery Ave.

This location is filthy. I received my drink with coffee stains all over it. Not from my drink but from other drinks that splashed on it. The restroom is also filthy! The only cool thing about this location is all the gift card options they have. Over 50 to choose from!!! What?!?!

I visit this Starbucks whenever I am in the Smyrna area. I have not gone inside just through the drive thru. The drive thru can get pretty backed up but it goes by very quick, most of the time. They have always made my drinks right.

This is one of the few Starbucks locations in the Tampa area with a Starbucks Reserve coffee selection and a Clover brewing machine.  What does this mean for you?  It means that you have a wider variety of rarer coffee blends brewed fresh individually by hand at the time you order and not a second sooner.
I really like this Starbucks and Its employees. They were really helpful being as though I did not know what I wanted to order.

I go to this particular Starbucks almost everyday. Most of the employees are familiar with me and what I usually order whether it be through the drive-thru or if I go inside. Last December I was so sick with bronchitis when I came in that Tomy who was taking my order recommended the"Medicine Ball" which at the time was on the Secret Menu. Now it's been added to the everyday menu. That hot tea he made me was like a magic elixir. I came back the next day and ordered it again. Honestly I believe I ordered that almost everyday until Christmas. Of course it doesn't take the place of an antibiotic but it sure did feel good while I was drinking it. It's so nice to go to a place that recognizes you and sometimes even remembers my name.
Terrible quality control on the breakfast sandwiches. Got a turkey bacon sandwich and it had half a slice of turkey bacon. Pretty sad.

Lame to review Starbuck-es?  possibly, but here's my case for why this is the best among the starbucks in the city:

1. These folks learned my name after about a month of going there.  No other coffee shop that I've frequented (and in most cases for much longer periods of time) bothered.  it's a small, possibly inconsequential thing, but I liked it.  Also, it's impressive, given the volume they get.

2.  This shop more efficient.  I'm in and out at peak hours much faster than other starbucks or competitor coffee shops.  They've got a good system going, others should copy it.

3.  In the rare instances I hang around, this starbucks has the added benefit of seating in the store and seating in the lobby of the building of which it is a tenant.

I realize that to coffee snobs the accolade of "Best Starbucks" might be like "tallest kindergartener", (and for the more extreme anti-corporate crowd the equivalent of "nicest murderer") but my morning isn't the same without a stop into this particular starbucks

I worked at Starbucks for close to four years, and that was across 3 stores. This one, without a doubt, takes the pillars and core values that are giving to us at Starbucks into heart.
