The people work like a team, and solve problems like a team. They always have a welcoming smile and a warm hello waiting for you. Not once has our order been wrong, or our food cold. Even at peak time the service was fantastic, never having waited for more than 5 minutes. 

I wish my store was half as good as this one.

Amazing experience here with the staff! My lattes were made perfectly! The baristas made me feel a personal connection, almost like I've known them my entire life! 10/10 recommend. My favorite Starbucks in town!

Worst service and coffee I have had I have been ordering this same drink for the past 6 years almost daily and had to ask to make me a different drink and Michelle had a attitude and my sister had the same drink that I had to ask to make a different one and she didn't like it either so she asked for a java chip and again Michelle gave attitude  don't order the iced caramel macchiato here they suck

I'm not sure I have much to say that hasn't already been said by others - the staff here is the friendliest and cheer up your day when you come to get coffee/tea before work. The inside is one of the largest Starbucks I've been into - ample working space and they have a small patio too. It does get some traffic in the morning and I think the parking lot is a bit strange as the drive thru is a weird figure around parking spaces. I highly recommend this location!

As far as Starbucks go, this cafe is a pretty solid one. If you are a Starbucks connoisseur, it will meet your standards with proper, steamed foam and friendly, underemployed recent college grads. 

I recommend the caramel macchiato or
skinny vanilla latte.

This appears to be the Starbux inside the Target.
They are remodeling the store and closed it down for a bit but are reopening any minute now.  No real issues here - but I come at "off" times.

I had such a great experience when I came into this Starbucks. I am not usually one to order all the fancy espresso drinks so I didn't know what to order. The nice young lady named Kristina was such a help in making my decision and the drink came out great! Will definitely be a new fave order :)

Obviously, this has all the same offerings as a regular Starbucks. But, because it's in a Penn building, there are some pros/cons:

PROS:
- Lots of seats and study space
- Nice outdoor seating options
- Dining dollars from Penn meal plans can be used
- Convenient campus location

CONS:
- Not allowed to use mobile app for payment
- They don't accept any Starbucks deals or coupons (however, they do participate in some campaigns such as Frapp happy hour.)
- Few outlets for laptops despite large study space
- Gets busy/full during school year
- Staff can be rude/sassy, atypical of Starbucks (you can't even get a glass of water)

Amazing fast service at the drive thru

What else can you ask for 

Very friendly service at the window.  

The products where top notch.
It's the Starbucks you know and love, or know and hate.  It's perfectly cromulent, to quote Bart Simpson.

This Starbucks is one of the newest locations in the Reno/Sparks area. I love the way the building looks - it is fresh and modern. It was a great place to go for late night coffee. The one thing that sets this Starbucks above some of the others in town is the quality staff. The people were incredibly friendly and helpful.
Always kind staff here. Never have a problem with wrong drinks, but I am sure if I did they would gladly replace it. Big fan.

Super busy location with challenging parking.  Decor has been upgraded over the past year.   Still not enough seats for the demand.   A bit slow at times, but the usual fare at the usual inflated prices.  Not your traditional WIFI here.   Had issues logging on.

This is by far my favorite Starbucks in Reno/Sparks.  The building they are located in is absolutely beautiful and it's nice to sit outside on the patio during lunchtime in the summer.  They have yet to screw up my order (especially when I order a Cafe Vanilla Frappucino) which I applaud them for because I've had my order screwed up at least once at every other Starbucks I've ever been to.

I have decided that I hate this place. I am not a fan.

The only saving grace of this place is the interior décor; however, the coffee still is not good and the service is lackadaisical from employees who seem uninterested in what they are doing. 

I'm never going back.
There are several Starbucks in my area but this is one of my favorites.  The drive is usually very fast, my order is consistently accurate and the staff are always friendly!

This new location needs to step up there game significantly. I've been there a few times since they opened and I'm still hoping for improvement. 

The woman taking my order today did not listen and had I not been smart and watching the barista, I would have had a hot drink instead of an iced one. She also never asked anyone to heat up a sandwich so after getting my drink and waiting there for a few minutes, the barista went and heated it because it was never going to be done. 

I know the location is new and has only been open a few weeks but this is so far below the Starbucks standard I've grown to know and love!
Walked right up to counter and ordered an Americano.  It took at least 15 minutes, this is on a Saturday at 4:00.  I just don't get why people continue to put up with this
Went through the drive thru and ordered my usual. (Cafe vanilla frap) No complaints. The service was fast and my drink was good. What more is there?

I went to Starbucks today to get my wife a quick coffee. I saw there was a long line at the drive-thur  maybe 10 cars or more at 12:05pm  . So I went inside there was two guest in front of me and I had to wait 20 minutes for one Venti iced coffee with three pumps of syrup there is no reasonable excuse for that. This has not been the first time this is happened but it will be the last for me. If you want my money you will have to earn it.

I have never been so unhappy with the quality of Customer Service from this location. The cashier acted as if I was bothering her by ordering my drink. She didn't even crack a smile, whisper a hello, or mumble a thank you. She didn't even tell me my total and quickly turned her back to me before I could even put my card back. This is not acceptable, Starbucks. I work with people all day and I know how trying they can be. However, I have never treated a customer this way. Train your caahiers, please.

Staff is very efficient and know their stuff, the downstairs is a bit crowded but they have a very large upstairs that makes for a great place for a book club or poetry reading.  I used to live around the corner from this Starbucks and it was the only place I could go, very early in the morning to sit and read or write in peace.  The upstairs windows are a great people watching spot for the loony tunes that frequent South Street.

Okay, I confess - This is my neighborhood Starbucks and I love it! 

The staff at this location always make you feel like you are the #1 customer. Never been disappointed with this location.

So dirty all the time.  (notice the hair in the picture)
I asked for half and half since it was empty at the self serve bar and it took 5 min to refill. No joke. I also ordered a blueberry muffin and they forget it.

Standard Starbucks with regards to the interior, albeit slightly larger than most since they have a corner location.  Barristers have always been friendly towards me (perhaps because I am friendly to them?  How novel!).   Plenty of outdoor seating with ceiling water misters to beat the heat.  Convenient location too, with plenty of parking & just steps away from Pier 1, Payless and a Gamestop.

Thankyou for the recommendations to add 2 pumps of Raspberry to my Oprah Chai tea. Yum.
Also the green tea iced latte Venti is my favorite and Tomato mozzarella panini n cake pops and Iced black tea but make it sweeter, more sugar!
Good service, speedy and always busy! The product speaks for itself but this location has quickly become my favorite in SB.

Ordered my drink Extra Hot, as usual. Order repeated to me properly.

Drink v v cold. Obviously the barista too lazy to warm the milk up even though they weren't busy.

Come on guys, $4.50 a drink, you need to give me what I order

This is the friendliest Starbucks ever! They had free samples  of their peppermint mocha and they were delish. They carried on a conversation with you and didn't just write your name on a cup and forget but actually remembered my name.  If I lived on this side of Tucson I would be here daily!

If this will let me post the photo I will show you.
I've been through about 10 Starbucks this week obviously I'm a customer and when I return back to St Louis look what I see obviously someone was cleaning up and they lock the door so they just left the broom and dustpan out nice impression St Louis Lambert International Airport

I was excited that starbucks came to the neighborhood. The interior is cozy, unfortunately the customer service was lacking. It was a comedy of errors, not being able to accept my birthday drink coupon, making the wrong drink, telling me it was right, finally figuring out that it wasn't right. I settled on a regular cup of coffee as a replacement for my $5 beverage order and was offered no compensation for the difference. I won't be back.
Always a perfect drink.  Friendly and competent staff and the manager, Jacob, is beyond excellent!!  It's my favorite Starbucks in St. Louis!!

This location is my EVERYDAY stop.. everyone at this location is very friendly and they try to get to know you.. I feel very welcomed in here there is a couple of the employees that know my order n always greet me by my name I feel at home here :)
This Starbucks location has a super friendly and quick staff! Very nice views of the mountains and plenty of parking. My new favorite Starbucks!

This Starbucks is awesome. Great place to warm up in and grab a wonderful drink in the south Street strip. The bathroom was very clean just make sure you grab the bathroom code from the staff so that you can get in. There is a ton of seating upstairs so do not mistaken the downstairs as the only thing lace to sit or you will miss out on the birds eye view of south street. It is a great spot to sit down and work from a laptop or to read a book. It is not too loud and there is quite a few places where you can get some juice for your laptop or your phone. It really is affordable to grab a coffee or tea as with Gold membership you get free refills and if you are not a gold member you still get free refills on tea or coffee for only $.50. I have been impressed with all their holiday drink recipes and the food is always fresh and they have seasonal options.

I avoid Starbucks like the plague... not because I am trying to be indie hipster cool but because there are just too many other fantastic coffee shop options in our fair city. 
If I am going to buy an expensive cup of coffee, tea, or plug up for a couple of hours somewhere, why not give my dollars to an independent business instead? That $4 will be go a lot farther in our community than at Starbucks....

In the same breath, this location was quick and friendly and is oversized. Their oatmeal was quite tasty when I took a bite too.
I may visit Starbucks a handful times in any given year and I feel guilty every time.

I love my Starbucks!!  However, we have been sitting in the drive thru for 15 minutes, so I thought I would share this experience. As we approach the 20 minute mark, I am beginning to think they take our order and go pick it up at another location. As I peered in the door from my car, I can see an employee putting out inventory instead of helping the drive thru or counter...interesting. 

On a lighter note, the gentleman working the drive thru is hilarious a very nice. He would be the only reason we return to this location.
Very nice staff. Friendly and funny...  bad coffee :(

I absolutely love this StarBucks location! The workers are incredibly friendly- some of them even remember how I like my coffee. Is very clean, efficient and fresh. The main reason I keep returning here is for the amazing costumer service.
I post this as I am trapped in the drive thru line after spending 10 minutes without moving. So SLOW! Last time bad customer service too.

Pretty standard Starbucks. They have a lot more room than I thought and some nice furniture if you're looking for a place to work. The staff are generally nice and provide quick service. Keep in mind that the parking lot can get a bit crowded at times, but there's usually a space if you park farther away.
The coffee shop was messy. Furniture looked in need of replacing. Table tops were in need of wiping, trash cans were overflowing.
Multiple times I've been given the wrong order. On top of that the coffee never tastes very fresh.

I am a sucker for good coffee, and there are very few local options that I have found, so I end up defaulting to Starbuck, but that does not mean settling.  This particular location could benefit from some more seating, or maybe some different arrangement of seating, but all in all, it's adequate.  I didn't like that I ordered the Narino 70 cold brew on their menu, because it's on their menu, but "they don't sell that here" was the response I got.  That was frustrating as I don't like false or dated advertising, hence the three stars.
Cashier was unenthusiastic and dull. Slightly rude. But they had the Philadelphia mugs which was a huge plus considering we only came into that Starbucks for the mugs.

Really bad experience in this store. Never been treated so badly by a cashier, an old lady during checkout. Handed her a gift card, knowingly it still has $15 credit in it, and I think she should have entered as CC and not as gift card 2x , it didn't  go through . I told her there is money in there then the mgr let her do it again, apparently didnt go through so ok fine, we paid it cash. Then the old lady said, why is that they don't trust me? Upon hearing it, That totally irked me and I told her in front of her mgr , it is not that We don't trust you, we just know that there is money in that gc then the mgr just cut me off and said in full sarcasm tone " ok have a good day" What a biatchie!!!

I'm sure you know the drill....frappacinos, food and what not. What sets this Starbucks apart that it has several great spaces to work. There's a small off to the side room with a giant wooden table (my haunt), many overstuffed chairs, high tops and ample deck space. The parkinglot is cramped but I've never been hassled about moving my car even when I camp out for the morning doing work. There's the added perk of the dude in the wheelchair who considers himself to be the personal valet for the lot directing you where to park and doing his thing for tips.  As its right across the street from the business school, people here generally get that most folks are working on their computers so you won't have many cell phone screamers in the place.  Be sure you get yourself a rechargable Starbucks card so you can pile on those free refills.

There was a long line of customers and several staff on site but only 1 person making the drinks, the others were taking inventory and one just kept walking back and forth.  It would have made more sense for all to start making drinks until the line goes down and then go do inventory.

I have been in Starbucks all over the country.  Media Pennsylvania is a funky little fair trade town nestled into the county seat with its courthouse and lawyer class.  The Starbucks lacks an identity.  It is on the outskirts of the town center. It feels less like a coffee house than a strip mall fast food coffee shop. Plus the sour smell of old bitter coffee hanging in the air here is killing me. I get the feeling that this place is open only because it can, and no other reason.  Too bad. Starbucks is such a great brand.

I love coming here almost every day. The staff is amazing. They know me by name and my order. They are friendly and just obey all great! 
Hana is absolutely a real gem. The rest are of them are also wonderful. They take excellent care of me and get me in and out when I'm in a hurry.

This is a smaller Starbucks, but their service has been on point each time I come. They are fast and polite and since they are smaller, I dont have to worry about them forgetting about putting my Spinach Feta wrap in and then finding me for it (like has been true for larger Starbucks)  No issues with that for me. Parking can be a pain in the butt, since there is construction going on and it can be a busier area. There's a parking lot across the street for Whole Foods, but I've never been ballsy enough to park there and walk over.

Had the day off and needed to go over my emails. Stopped here and grabbed a cup of coffee. Service was wonderful and was able to find a table to plug by my laptop. Area was nice and clean. Bathrooms were clean too. I used the bathroom first and noticed the toilet paper was low. I stayed for a good hour and half- once I used the bathroom again- I noticed the toilet paper was replaced - which tells you a lot about the employees there.

I think it's hard to review chain restaurants like Starbucks because they have so many company-specific standards to meet that you really should have a similar experience there no matter what location you go to. My visit to this location was exactly like any other Starbucks I've been to, except for the wifi. 

I was greeted when I walked in, the baristas were friendly, I got my drink quickly, and I was very happy with my chai tea late. 

However, I planned on spending a couple hours at Starbucks--I had a lot of school work to do and I drove several miles from my house to come to this location. But it totally wasn't worth the trip because the wifi was incredibly slow. When I was watching my lectures, they kept stopping and needing to buffer every 5 minutes. I've never had this problem anywhere else. The slow wifi was so annoying that I left early and went down the street to Corner Bakery Cafe--where I was able to watch my lectures without a single problem. Definitely won't be coming back to this Starbucks to study again.

The service was alright; nothing to write home about, but this review mostly deals with the upkeep of the shop. I was here on a Saturday evening when it was not busy. There was one couple sitting on one of the tables and the three male employees in behind the counter. The shop looked like it had not been cleaned all day. The bathroom was dirty and there was no toilet paper available. The counter was sticky and dirty. I have never been in a Starbucks so unkept before.

Just a regular Starbucks. Nothing special. I came here for a Starbucks mug. Paid and then left. 

Ok service. Starbucks is Starbucks

This Starbucks has a lot of seating indoors, which is nice if you want to stay and enjoy your beverage. We got a cup of coffee to go, though. 

The restroom are clean, gender neutral and wheelchair accessible.

The parking lot is a joke might as well park somewhere else and walk over. The drive thru takes forever and block in all parked cars. Plus they're always out of stuff. Come on Starbucks add another location so this isn't my only choice

This Starbucks is closest to me.  I gave it one star already because of the cold food and even cold coffee.   I'm usually in a rush and I always go via the drive-thru.  My husband wanted a breakfast sandwich.   I regrettably gave it another try this morning. I didn't bother ordering a coffee, but two breakfast sandwiches.  As usual.  Sandwiches are warm to hot on the outside... COLD.. not cool, but COLD on the inside.  My son has worked at Starbucks for - 2-3 years.  Never at this location.  He told me they must be warming the sandwiches straight from the freezer.  He said that at the stores he has worked at they take out the sandwiches out of the freezer one day ahead and put them in the refrigerator.   That way they are not frozen when heated.  I have on a few occasions spoken to the folks at this store about the cold sandwiches.  I was advised to order them "open faced" to make sure they were heated thoroughly. But it just doesn't matter.  Either they really are hard frozen to start with or they are ignoring my request to warm them open-faced.  I have no idea.  Luckily this morning I was going back to my office and I heated the sandwiches in our microwave.  But I hate it when I'm on the road and I have to throw it out!  Well, I gave it another try... for sure, no more..  Too bad.  The staff is very friendly.

This is the WORST Starbucks I have EVER been to. Service? AWFUL! Quality of drink? TERRIBLE! Bathrooms? FILTHY!  I have been to many Starbucks in my life I love it BUT this is unacceptable. The bathrooms had pee all over the floor, when I ordered the cashier rolled his eyes when I asked for another cake pop when the one I had ordered rolled out of the bag and onto the open counter. Then when I received my drink it was so full of ice I couldn't even get my straw into it. When I asked the barista to take some out she was rude. I expected with a spoon or something that wouldn't take the drink half the drink out unlike she did by DUMPING IT OUT! I had about 5 sips of my drink and it was already empty! Will not be returning to this establishment anytime soon.

You might as well stop for some coffee since you're probably going to be stuck in traffic for a long time on this section of I-95. The new Delaware Welcome Center building is actually quite nice, and has a number of other restaurants to choose from.

I love Starbucks, but I absolutely hate this one. I have tried to give them a few different chances, thinking that maybe they were just having an off day. But, that's not the case. The employees seem to have their little clique of customers they like. The rest of us they don't care. They don't seem to make the drinks correctly either. The place is always dirty. The counters need cleaned. It's the closest one to us and I will still continue to drive 35 minutes to go to another one. I have lived in other cities and been to many different Starbucks. This one is horrible.

I'm sorry, but it shouldn't take 20 minutes to make a latte, considering there was about a 30 second wait at the counter to order. The coordination between the order takers and the barista (if you can still call someone who just pushes a button to make espresso that name) is seriously lacking here. At the time, I was one of two people whose drinks were totally overlooked while others who came in later received theirs. Avoid this location, it should be easy to do as there are about a dozen or so Starbucks in the vicinity. In particular, the Callowhill store has been doing an excellent job since the day they opened.

Terrible service by Barista too busy chatting.
Manager was rude!
The place was empty and I've been served quicker in extremely busy Starbucks. 
I overheard the barista say 'it's my last day' so hopefully things might improve but I'm hugely surprised by the managers attitude because they are usually so good in Starbucks! 
My drink was wrong but it wasn't even worth mentioning!!
Delicious every time...great service, clean store, fresh pastries....everything one expects from Starbucks.

I'm the ultimate NON-coffee drinker, but decided to stop in here today to get coffees for the rest of the office staff.  We've been working tons of hours and knew that they could all use it.  I bought myself a pastry (ok, but not the best I've ever had).

It's relatively a newer Starbucks, but it's definitely not a place that I ever frequent with the wife.  Everyone was very happy when I brought in the coffees and it was good for morale.
Polite but poor service. Not busy On a Sunday night but it took 13 minutes from receipt issued to getting my plain latte.

I always feel welcome here even though the new décor seems it dose not want you hanging out. Customers seem to treated on a personal family level. They are top Notch when they are on there game but sometimes it seems to get a bit frantic and confused. Most of the Baristas  personalities just bubble over

Ok, this place may just be the most pitiful excuse for a Starbucks that anyone could imagine. I live so close yet I routinely find myself walking five blocks out of my way to go to the 34th and Walnut location. The staff could care less about how your drinks taste here (which, btw, is terrible). I mean, I understand that Commons will always suck....but why does the Starbucks have to?

Its always crowded when you try to do work here also unless you go before noon. During the evening hours, the place turns into the loudest "library" you could imagine crawling with students drinking their gross coffee that they immediately regret as it makes its way to their lips. 

TL;DR - Just, no.
I agree with the reviewer that pointed that this Starbucks lacks in customer service skills. I kept coming back until I decided there was no reason to receive subpar customer service.

Don't bother.  I LOVE Starbucks, but not this one.  The staff is, well a little odd, and the place is small, tight, and usually crowded with people who basically stare at the menu board.  That's not the issue.

It's the worst parking EVER.  Hard to get into on a really busy corner, they have like 10 spots between Starbucks and Quizno's.  I have to end up parking at the sleazy motel next door and walking-seriously one day my wife will drive by and see my car at the motel and that'll be it.  I'm sure she'll believe I was walking to the Starbucks.

So basically I'm saying that this place will be the end of my marriage.  Overkill, maybe-but it could be accurate
Busy place, no luck with a semi dry cappuccino, just a hot coffee milk.  Keep training.
Twice now I've tried this location and they've messed up my order. Pretty disappointing. Just save yourself time and disappointment and use a different location.

This Starbucks is practically on the Vanderbilt campus (near the business and law schools). It's big and has lots of tables and seating. When I was there, several groups of students were studying, but it was a bit empty (7-something at night on a Sunday). However, this was just as students were getting to Vanderbilt for the semester. I can imagine this Starbucks getting PACKED as it gets further into the semester.

Although the store was not especially busy when I came by, it took me far too long to find a clean place to sit. After walking around the store once, I grabbed a napkin and wiped off an empty table myself. That's not exactly enough to keep me from ever coming back, but I'm more likely to choose another coffee shop over this one in the future, since a clean table is much more welcoming than a dirty one.

The second criticism is only relevant if you come to coffee shops to sit and work, as I often do. I haven't been here two hours, and I've heard the same CD three times. Tis rather annoying.

However, drinks here are usually fine. The location is convenient for the Broadway/Hillsboro/Vanderbilt area, and the fireplace is cozy.
The staff is so friendly. The coffee always fresh.  The staff are a little quirky, cute, and funny.
This is the Starbucks's in Harrah's. On my first visit their machinery was broken and I was unable to order what I wanted..

I am a regular at this Starbucks probably due to the wonderful baristas who usually already have my drink ready before i even ask!
Thank ypu Sha, Marshay, Matt and last but not least Allie! We miss her between holidays !

This is a standard Starbucks location. I got a beverage here and got the exact experience that I expected from my visit (especially as I ordered on the app). I don't really have much else to say about this location as I've only visited it once or twice ever.

Fast and friendly. I'm there almost every morning the pretty much know my order/name. They can get very busy which the parking lot and drive through isn't designed for. Yet the staff do a great job with keeping the line moving, the energy up and the orders correct.

This is my Starbucks I got to every morning as I live directly across from the Cheshire. The people who work here could not be more pleasant or more efficient, Jacob the manager is awesome and so are Lisa, Madison & Jeremiah. It's cozy inside and always plenty of people studying/working/hanging out. I LOVE this location!

I stopped by on a busy Summer weekend and the folks behind the counter were super fast and accurate.  The weekend was record breaking heat and everyone in line seemed to be ordering iced coffees or Frappuccinos but even with the slam of drink orders my order of 3 iced/blended beverages was super quick.
I haven't had many great Starbucks experiences but this one was really nice and definitely surprised me! Great service and I definitely recommend! I'll definitely be going back.

Very friendly and quick in store service, store is always very clean and has great connectivity options. Wi-if is fairly fast and there are power outlets for charging your technology just about everywhere you can think of.

Drive through can be a bit slow, but this is by far the nicest Starbucks in the area.
I went back today and it's much better. The staff is nicer and very welcoming. I'm glad they made changes because I will keep coming to this one. :)

Unfortunately, the reviews on this place are correct. Starbucks are usually time-sensitive. I know their average turn around for a single order of a latte and a sandwich with one other couple in the entire store is less than 13 minutes, which is what my wife and I had to wait before finally leaving because we had to be somewhere. Still didn't get our food because it wasn't done. It was a sandwich and a latte. That's it. Hopefully we'll find a way to get our money back. I leave 2 stars because it was still a nice facility and the employees may be new. I don't know what's going on in their lives. Still go here, just not on a crunch.

Meh. Came here with my l.o. after we dropped my other l.o. at school. I'm not going to lie. When it comes to "not a real coffee place" like Starbucks, I like to embrace the white girl part of me & get whatever seasonal drinks they have. I got the ultimate white girl drink (pumpkin spice decaf latte with almond milk). It was not sweet what so ever and was more spice than anything else. I could blame the almond milk, but since I drink it everyday and have made my own pumpkin drink with it, I know it wasn't it. It was the person making it. My I ordered my l.o. a hot chocolate he liked it very much. So something went right.

Also people reading this, if you are at a place by yourself. Do not sit at a table that is made for 2 or more people. Oh and do not "reserve a spot for yourself" by putting your bag on a stool then stand in line to order your drink. If it's not your butt or someone else's physically there saving the spot or your drink on the bar table, it's not your seat. You aren't above anyone or smarter. Everyone else is just considerate to others.
This location is very fast and friendly. The guy who runs the drive thru makes my day just a little bit brighter! I've never had a problem with this Starbucks!

Inept is the only word I could come up with. Signs all over the store that "due to the hurricane" their normal shipment of milk products wasn't delivered. So if you want cream for your coffee etc.. we apologize but we're out.  Heard one staff member tell a customer it would be tomorrow before they got any.

Now maybe I'm more simple minded, but there are 4 convenience stores within 100 yards of this Starbucks... and 2 grocery stores within about a mile.  You may think that someone would authorize some petty cash and just go by some half and half etc.

How people even get out of bed on their own amazes me sometimes.  How about we do whatever needs to be done to accommodate our customers?!
Great customer service! Your bathroom was a little dirty though.  The floor out in the lobby had drink spills all over it as well. But the customer service makes up for those spills

Overall the staff is great and efficient. The downside is PARKING! there is none! Please Starbucks build a stand alone store in green hills. I've resorted to the starbucks in the Krogers to avoid the parking situation at this one.

This review is about this location, not Starbucks in general. I was motivated to write this review because they are the definition of "efficient" in the morning! I ordered by phone about a mile away and when I arrived, my drink was just ready. I pulled into drive-thru one morning, running a bit late to work and not knowing if I really had time to stop by. There were 5-6 cars in the drive-thru section, so decided to check the time and leave if it took too long. I pulled into line and left with drink in 3 minutes! Fairly friendly, too.

New location for this Starbucks. Garbage overflowing inside and out. Coffee is lukewarm and when we went to get a hotter one, we were told they were out of the dark roast and couldn't heat it up. Seems like poor management.
This is the best Starbucks in Indy.  The staff is great and know how to make drinks.  Talk about getting right in customer service....always top notch and fun.

Please I'd give zero stars.
This is the Starbucks that is closest to me and has a drive thru that is ever so busy and jammed up 24/7. Parking lot is too small for the volume of the crowds.
I used to like this location until today, I went to the drive-thru as usual and got my drink and realized the cup was practically empty. I asked if they could remake the drink, I'm not paying for a half empty cup! Starbucks is not a cheap place. I would like to pay for a FULL drink. 
The barista immediately gave a smirk look to the girl standing next to her making the drinks, and she gave me a drink back, This second drink tasted like some watered down drink that tasted like dish water!! 
So the baristas were obviously irritated to remake a drink? so decided to give me a disgusting dish water drink? Hmm, okay.
So, I had already gotten out line, and decided to go inside, since I paid for this drink, I wanted it done right! Going inside there was a very long line as well, and I was hoping they would be understanding and apologize or something? 
Nope, it took me 15 minutes to get the attention of the smirking girl who gave me the disgusting drink. She then was laughing at me for asking to fix the gross drink! She walked away. I waited for another 10 minutes and after asking the girl again, if she remade my drink she set the drink out and didn't tell me it was waiting, like they normal call out the drinks. I was told I will get free coupons for this ordeal? but I wished I had stayed to talk to a manager, the girls who were at the drive-thru today were flat out bitches. If you can't handle being a barista and can't make a drink the right way, then find a different job and don't work with the public. 
probably won't be wasting my $ on going here to this location ever again.

Bad experience the morning staff are so rude specially the Choppy girl works on the day shift I went on the morning for coffee than I return back for refill so she didn't want to refill it and she charged me full price with a bad attitude I like start
bucks and I hope they put staff to present Starbucks not to ruin it thanks

Best Starbucks to go to in the New Port Richey/Trinity area! Everyone is extremely friendly & the drinks are made perfectly. Leah always remembers the drinks I like & is such a joy to see in the morning before I go to work!

Supposed to Open at 6am BUT THEY ARE NOT!  It's now 6:10Am and I can see them still stacking bagels but they aren't open.  WTF. This is a Hotel Starbucks and I'm on a strict schedule but this STARBUCKS DOESNT CARE!  WTF.  If your not gonna open at 6AM - DONT SAY YOU ARE!!
I have been in this starbucks so many times and each time it was a very great experience, the kindness of the staff is so appreciated!

I can say the Sunday afternoon staff was courteous and helpful! The area indoors and outside was clean. Keep in mind thoughtless customers will not think of others and leave their trash on the tables! NOT COOL! 
I am never feeling guilty when I have my Skinny Vanilla Latte! Vente and satisfying! I will also do a different Bistro Box which is always calorie frugal! I CAN do healthy at Starbucks!

Sloooooooooooowwwww.....slowslow snail slow!!!
I have been to this Starbucks drive through four times since it opened and every time I have gone I get excited because there is no line but I waite for my beverage 10-15 minutes!Sucks!  I will never go here again!

This is my favorite Starbucks in the foothills. It's a great place to come and people watch. The employees here are always cheerful and nice. The coffee is consistent, and I've never had a bad cup here. 

The Swan/Sunrise Starbucks is just an all around friendly spot. Here you'll find everyone from retirees to students. It has the flavor and ambiance of a true coffee house. In the afternoon, it's a popular study spot for the high school crowd- which I think is great! At least they are studying... 

The location at Skyline and Campbell is also nice, but in my opinion- the Swan and Sunrise Starbucks is the best Starbucks in the foothills.

Always love coming to this location. Everyone always is so friendly and they always make my drinks right. Not being rude but other locations don't compare to the quality of customer service I receive at this location. Thanks for always being so friendly and for always letting me rant about the long hot summers.

They are very slow here. 
I had a mobile order and when I showed up, ~ 10 minutes after my order, 1/2 of my order was ready. As I was waiting, I noticed people who ordered after I arrived we're getting their order. So, I asked the barista what was the status of my order. She looked at the other gentleman, said something to him and both kept making other drinks. So, I asked again and the barista, wouldn't look at me and told me there was no other mobile order. So, I politely asked her to double check because it didn't make any sense that only 1/2 my order went through. After another wait, the gentleman looked at the computer/register and realized there was another order. Instead of apologizing, she never looked at me, made my drink and placed it on the counter. It's just rude customer service. The least I could've gotten was an error admission, let alone an apology.
Terrible service at this place nobody cares about you they have only one person to take orders wherase a long line of people waiting for coffee.they really need to focus on quality service.
This by far my favorite Starbucks drive thru, even during busy hours the baristas are able to get you in and out without jeopardizing the quality of your order.
The directions option for the address to this location are terrible. It maps the location about 2 miles north of where it is physically located.

I think a little t depends on the time of the day for this location. I've been here several times and mostly good experiences. I've used the drive through and when I got home I had the wrong order and was upset but too far to drive back to fix the issue. I have my usual order at any Starbucks and it's an easy drink and 95% of the time it's on point but today my drink was a bit off, but not enough to ask them to remake it. I come here because it's a convenient location. 

This is basically a free standing location but there is a Chase bank connected. Plenty of parking and a large seat area albeit full most of the time. They also offer an outdoor patio which is nice when the Florida weather cooperates!

I'd recommend this location as much as any other. The baristas aren't overly friendly but they do what is expected - making a coffe drink or a tea beverage.

There is almost always a wait here. The staff here are hit or miss, but mostly nice. They always have at least three people working the bar, but they still run behind. My Venti iced latte was good, as it usually is. They also carry hot breakfast sandwiches, paninis, and salads, along with the usual bakery items.

This is the closest Starbucks to my house so I am here a few times a week. 

I like that they never mess my order up. I always get soy milk and my lattes so they ask me if I still want whipped cream and I say yes. The whipped cream is always there. (Many other Starbucks still don't put the whipped on) 

I was a bit disappointed when I had my dog in the car and asked for a puppychino. They gave me a little shot glass of whipped cream. They used to give them in the bigger cups. I was willing to pay for it so I was confused.

Inconsistent drink quality and you all too often get TERRIBLE service. Most of the staff are far more concerned with their conversations amongst each other and with chatting up their friends who come in to mooch free drinks to serve the paying customers. 

I can't adequately describe how consistently terrible the service is. Loosing orders, charging the wrong amount, having to repeat your order over and over and over again all while you are made to feel you are interrupting the staff's social hour is no way to run a business.

Until I hear rumors that there has been a massive change in the service, the TECH Center Starbucks is in indefinite time out with me. Starbucks HQ really needs to step in and deal with the poor quality seen at this Sodexo-run hell hole.

The customer service at this Starbucks is unacceptably rude. I stopped in before my early morning half marathon to get coffee, and from the moment I walked in, the baristas acted like they were annoyed that I was there. I know it sucks to work the opening shift on a Sunday-- I used to work at Starbucks and have done it many a time-- but it is your job in the service industry to act pleasant even if you don't feel like being there. 

Anyway.  I was drinking my coffee in the lobby and had to use the restroom. I asked a barista if I could use the restroom and rudely she replied there was no public restroom. She said I had to buy something first. This was the person who had made and handed me my drink. I was the only customer there. I said I already bought something and she grudgingly asked another barista to unlock the restroom, which he did, acting like it was the biggest hassle ever.

Seriously...this is not what I expect from Starbucks. I will be contacting the district manager of this store.

Terribly Slow. 30 minutes for a coffee it's unacceptable. They treat you poorly and the drinks are watery down . Drive 5 extra minutes and go to the new one in highway 50 . 
Don't waist your time here.   By the way. Not one nor twice. Every single time it's the same . I'm done !

I was there this past Saturday at 1030 in the morning.  The lady who waited on me was in a horrible mood. I spent over $50 on regional mugs and expected to be treated better than that. I don't care how long the line is.
Great place, friendly staff. Rarely get my order wrong. Definitely the preferred place to go instead of other coffee places.
I was having a bad night and the very friendly young man made my experience not only a great one but he was very sweet telling me he hopes my night gets better.. way to go Starbucks I will be back!

I frequent this Starbucks about 3x a week and I have to say the staff always greet me and take an active interest in conversation. The service is very fast and my drinks have been prepared correctly. I enjoy the South Street atmosphere. It's only downfall is at times, the seating can be limited and being physically disabled, stairs are not my friend. The other thing is the bathroom, there is a forever wait and it's disgusting. Aside from those two factors, I love it there!

I only frequent this place (2-3 times a week) because of the convenience of mobile ordering and the reward system.. the employees are generally nice but the place is dirty - making to my list of top 2 dirtiest starbucks I have been to. Wish the lighting is not too dark. Seems the business is booming because of the brand value, location advantage and a lack of other cafes available around the area.

Horrible service.

Just this morning I requested a Decaf Coffee to which I was told it would take 15 minutes? Barista did not offer to do a pour over or an Americano as a substitute.

Will NEVER go back here.
This was my first time in this location, and I loved the space and atmosphere.  I had a free birthday drink, and it was also my first time ever using my app, and barista was patient and very helpful!

They are generally very very slow - it takes forever to get your drink here. The baristas are below-average, and my drinks are always just so-so. If I'm going to pay $5 for a latte, I will go to another Starbucks!! A decent amount of seating, including outdoor seating in summertime.

Great product and brand but extremely slow. I go to the one on Gandy and by my work on Westshore. The speed of the drive through depends on the employee. Some are good but most are super slow. Very frustrating and making me start to avoid going. Super super slow.

Favorite Starbucks in Indiana.  Extended space. 
Pros:
4 seater tall tables w/ bar chairs: 5
Starbucks traditional small round tables along the wall: 8 
Lomg conference tables that can easily seat 6 to 8 people w/usb charging capabilities: 2
Coffee table seating area
Drive thru: excellent, fast
Outdoor tables w/umbrellas: 3
Excellent staff

Cons: not a lot of parking spaces

It is a new location and it has the standard Starbucks' layout. I was just disappointed with the staff. The cash register,  a girl named Jessica with long dark hair,  was rude and had an attitude the whole time. They should be more careful with who they choose to hire for front of the house staff.

Thank you Jill for arguing with me about a caramel macchiato upside down vs caramel macchiato v caramel late. Your professionalism is astonishing.  Instead of arguing with a customer, why don't you actually attempt to complete my order and LOOK UP THE RECIPE

Not the best starbucks because it always takes a long time. Also, there were times when they didn't make my drink altogether or forgot my food.  The first couple of times I have gone they weren't friendly but yesterday they actually smiled & were in a good mood, I wonder what changed ! I'll take it! 
They technically got my order wrong (I asked for cold brew, they gave me iced coffee) but at this point I don't even bother to have them fix it as long as I'm not paying more than what I asked for. It's not the end of the world but it's not right so what do you do ? Let's hope it doesn't continue.

I come here often because its right on my way to work, but some mornings it's a headache. About 1/2 the time they seem to get my order wrong or mixed up with someone else's and there's one woman who works here that I swear just hates her job!

I travel for work and spend a lot of time and money at Starbucks all over the Philadelphia area.  But I will never go back to this location, the employees here especially one who was a male in his 20's are extremely rude and were too busy to talk to me or even get my order right.  When I questioned him about my drink he got very arrogant and told me that's the way it is.

Even more surprising in the shadows of what happened in Philly a few weeks ago.

I've been going to Starbucks for over 20 years and will continue to, but recommend you stay clear of this one in Collegeville

Sara, is my go to girl!

I have many strange requirements and Sara was able to meet my every need for a tasty treat! 
Thanks Sara (a future interior design pro) !
-Dr. Sarah :)

This Starbucks location had only been open a few days. The parking lot was full and the drive through line (where I was) was slow and backed up. I chalk it up to new employees and a lot of customers. I'll try again in a week or so.

My only complaint was that someone had gone to this location and had the new nitro cold brew. I ordered that drink but was told a few seconds later that it was not available. Hopefully, I'll be able to try that next time too.
The employees at this particular location are incredibly pleasant; this is always my favorite Starbucks to visit. Everyone is always in such a great mood. Kudos to them.

Very unhappy with my last experience at this location. Came in to get a refill on my drink and was told it needed to be within 30 mins of getting original drink. I asked where it said that and she had said no where. Instead of being accommodating and making an exception for this one time she said she can get me a new cup or give me 10 cents off. I thought the purpose to bring in cups for refill was to be more mindful about the environment, clearly Starbucks does not care about their customers or the planet.

I wouldn't recommend going to this Starbucks location. They have consistently gotten my iced coffee wrong, which i think is a simple order, just milk and a flavor, probably 4 of the past 5 visits I had. They are also slightly more expensive and don't usually have as many food items as other Starbucks in the area. Although the location is convenient, it's worth it to drive a little farther out of my way to go to a different Starbucks that will have what I need & get my order correct.

This is just an unnecessary addition to the area. Literally there are three other coffee places within a mile that are more interesting and are local businesses. I would much rather support them and I also just like their coffee better. I could understand this place being here if there were no other options in the area, but that is not the case. 

There are other, better options for coffee. If you want something generic and burnt tasting, then this is your place. Otherwise, steer clear.

OK, so I come to this Starbucks often as it is somewhat close to home. I have visited numerous other Starbucks over time, and this particular location consistently does iced coffee right! There is no bitter taste, no "Americano over ice and "it is just a really great and consistent iced Coffee!  The people that work in this location are friendly, and always seem to know my name, even without the mobile order. It just seems easy to come here because I enjoy consistency in my order! Thank you to the store and all the staff for making the experience pleasant every single time!

I love Starbucks they serve so quick they have every drink you imagine one good thing about Starbucks is there water is free and Starbucks is the perfect place to study and to top it off they have amazing cafe music.

Not consistent.

Yesterday my drink wasn't melted and I actually had whipped cream protruding from the top of my lid LIKE ALWAYS. Today this is what I received. This is my favorite SB because they don't mess up my order like the other ones. So disappointing.

Really? In 2017, are we really denying pregnant women access to public restrooms? And at a Starbucks no less?

My wife is 30 weeks pregnant and was seeking relief after a fair amount of eating, drinking, and walking along South Street.

She walked into the Starbucks at around 8:00pm and asked for a venti cup of ice water and the restroom key. The barista (a white male) told her restrooms were for paying customers only. She showed her belly and explained that being pregnant she really needed to use the restroom and he told her there was nothing he could do because it was store policy.

My wife walked out visibly shaken and told me what happened. I walked in with her and asked for clarification about the store policy. I've never known any other Starbucks to do this. I was told by the same barista that there was nothing they could do and they reiterated the store policy, saying it was a "Philly Starbucks policy".

I told them that was ridiculous and asked if corporate was aware. Another employee (a white female) stepped up and told me that the reason they have this policy in place is because it is a "safety issue". My wife and I looked at her perplexed, so she continued explaining, saying that they let people use the bathroom and they end up shooting heroin and there's been an uptick in crime.

This made me livid... I asked if she really thinks my pregnant wife is coming in their bathroom to shoot heroin and she just kept repeating it's a safety issue.

Fed up, I said that I would be calling corporate to complain. She laughed and said I could go ahead and call corporate because they are the ones who made the policy and give them direction. I asked her for her name and she said she was not required to give it to me. I asked the other two employees and they also refused to give me their name saying they are not required to do so.

Frustrated, I said, that I would take a venti Cafe mocha and the restroom key. I figured policy aside, my wife needed to use the bathroom so I'll just buy something. The female employee said that she is choosing to refuse me service and that I need to leave the store or she would call the police.

Shocked by her brash reactions and the fact that the other two staff seemed to think this entire exchange was funny, I said this whole thing was crazy and headed out the door. As I was walking out, the female employee cursed at me saying, "have a great f'ing day". I walked back in and asked what she said and she kept threatening to call the police if I didn't leave. I took out my phone and snapped a picture of them (see attached).

I called corporate to complain about the situation and they indicated they would follow up with me. 

All in all, I am incredibly disappointed in this particular location and the workers here. They were rude, condescending, and took every opportunity to insult and demean us. And given that the three employees and the few customers in the store at the time were all white and we are black, l can't help but conclude that race played a factor here.

We spend entirely too much money on a daily basis at Starbucks to warrant this kind of treatment. And given their location on South Street (which gets busy at times), I can understand a customers-only policy, but they should consider expanding that to pregnant women and also people who are regular Starbucks customers. They should also evaluate individual circumstances and make informed, solutions-oriented decisions. 

Very disappointed. I look forward to a more detailed response from management/corporate.

What can I say?....this is the BEST store I've ever visited. I come here several times a week and the morning crew is unbeatable! Always friendly. Always smiling. Always something pleasant to say. Don't know who the hiring manager is but kudos to you as well. It's not easy hiring a team that is consistently fantastic.

The bald guy manager whoever he is, he has the absolute customer service I've ever experienced. I don't know how this man has a job. He needs to be trained again or something because he is awful. I feel so bad for anyone who has to deal with him. All the people that work there look so miserable and don't even try. This location is by far the worst in the area. You're better off going to another one. I can't stress this enough. How can one Starbucks be this bad??? !!!

Great shop. No issue there.

2 stars and can attest to the other reviews. 

If you would like to damage your car in the tiny parking lot or drive over a traffic sign that has been "laying down" in the middle of the only entrance or exit for weeks while braving the tight corners as traffic enters/exit, highly recommend. One $180 tire later...won't be back.
Extremely slow service.  Staff lacks product knowledge. They were also put off several products, and claimed that they could not brew a blonde roast coffee due to the time of day.
Never disappointed. The baristas know customer service and are always happy to make your day better with the excellent brews.

A really solid location. There are only a handful of Starbucks throughout Tucson that have consistently good service.

The manager here makes everyone's visit really nice..he'll come out to your table to drop food, make casual friendly conversation, and even help take large drink orders to the car.

I think the location is good and the staff is good, but honestly the manger on staff the day I came in made this visit a five star review type of visit. 

If I need to work on this side of town, I make it a point to use this location over the location inside the grocery store.

Keep up the great work.

Service was good but I ordered a tall latte and it tasted like a cup of warm milk.  There was only the slightest hint of coffee.  I know a latte has a lot of milk but I have ordered lattes at other Starbucks and have never had one this bad.

I updated my review from a 1 to a 3 because the staff fixed my drink without hesitation when I voiced my opinion of the drink.

This location by the El Con mall is always around the building in the morning, but i can see why we come back as the line moves quick and from my experience is always accurate o n my order! I am a tough customer always super customizing my order and They always get it right!
Fast and always good!!  Always get a hot sandwich and drink of choice with almond milk!!
I'm so excited that Starbucks with a drive-through opened up in our small town it's perfect. The staff is friendly and fast and I highly recommend it!

This is a nice and clean Starbucks. It is larger than many I have been in. The coffee and tea we got were made to perfection. The staff was friendly. Even though they were pretty busy, they got people through quickly. 

They only lost a star due to their prices. Not the fault of this store, but Starbucks hurts their own reviews by being outrageous.
It may be the biggest Starbucks in the area but SO SLOW - waited 25 minutes TWICE for one coffee. Won't come here very often

I'm not sure what the deal was here that day but it was definitely the filthiest Starbucks location is been too. 

Trash full, sugar packet paper, and straw wrappers,... all over the floors. Condiments counter was a hot mess too

I hope the manager reads this and gets the crew straightened out.

This refers to the Starbucks at the I-95 rest area (called The Biden Center). there are two Starbucks here. 

The outside stand alone drive through is just OK. Mostly they get the order correct, but not always.  Don't drive away without tasting your drink to make sure it is what you wanted.

The inside Starbucks is 
terrible.  The help are employees of HMS Host, a concession operator and appear to have little or no training.  Today I got two totally wrong and horrible tasting coffees and that was after a remake.  I also observed several other people complaining about missed ingredients etc.  Use the outside store please!
When i ordered coffee they told me the coffee machine was not work,when i ordered bagels, they told me the toaster was not work too! What amazing place!
Okay Starbucks. Easy parking Convenient in and out. Coffee and pastries were relatively good. Staff were friendly. Bathroom was clean. Okay spot to sit and work.

Waited in line while two employees cleaned and kept saying will be with you in a minute. When I asked if I could pay for my purchase I was told I needed to wait. Walked out and left my purchase. Customer's are the reason you have a job.

People think I'm crazy for reviewing Starbucks since they're a chain, but let's be real, there are some good ones and bad ones and you just never know what you're getting.
The store is bright and new and has a great outdoor patio for sitting. There is a mix of comfy chairs and tables so you can choose what you'd like and there are enough spaces that I haven't had a problem finding a place to sit.
The employees here are really friendly. I feel like they actually go above and beyond in customer service. If you ask a question, they genuinely talk to you. I've seen them make kiddos frappuccinos and hand them out with big smiles. They also have taken my drink to my table for me while I was in the restroom, and I see them bring people their pastries all the time. They take the time to make everyone feel like they're a real guest in the store.
The store is clean, they keep the floor tidy, and the music isn't overly loud. Bathrooms are well stocked, and they always have plenty of food available.
Definitely recommend you check out this location. It's also close enough to the Eagle greenbelt you can head over for a walk, which is a bonus.

This is a Starbucks so the coffee and food is good. The service at this store though is a different story. They're friendly and nice but how can you forget to ring up and give me my muffin when I'm IN PERSON at the counter talking to your face? This kid was busy on his phone when I finished adding my cream and sugar to my coffee to come back for my warm muffin. He had to ask again which one I wanted and I got it cold of course. Just frustrating.

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been too. They are insulting and rude. Messed up orders and copped attitudes toward me. I vary rarely complain but the terrible service I got here was amazing!!
And just to be clear.. I love Starbucks coffee and will happily go to the many many other locations they have. 
It is this one in particular that will NEVER go to again!!

If it weren't for the fact that this was one of the few late night places on campus that accepts dining dollars, I would have avoided this Starbucks like the plague. staff here are incredibly rude and condescending, & come up with bogus charges (like adding extra syrup when stores are not supposed to charge extra for iced drinks made without ice) when you place your order, it's almost like you owe the manager, 'miss pam' a favour, despite the fact that you are a paying customer. The fact that this store is affiliated with Penn Dining is the only reason why people still come here, as the attitude of all the baristas is absolutely appalling.

I wish I could give negative stars. The worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Rude staff. Drinks aren't made well. I couldn't even get a normal sized cup of water to go with my $7 crappy sandwich and $4 drink. Awful. Shameful. They should close and give up.

This is my favorite Starbucks locations, I come several times a week before work and order on the app. It's always sitting there waiting for me even when I order it 3 minutes before I arrive. The staff is amazingly kind, especially Elizabeth who makes my drinks most mornings and always speaks to each customer. Little kindnesses like that go a long way in starting your day!

Let me boast and brag. I've been coming to this Starbucks since it opened. I've seen manager after manager, barista after barista come and go but the level of service and quality has been consistent. I've had my share of favorite managers from Paige, Dan, to our current. The current barista staff of guys and girls are by far my favorite crew. 

I'll have my triple espresso with steam cream please!

Communication between ALL employees should be first and foremost. Today it clearly wasn't a priority for them. As I ordered a coffee and oatmeal and paid for it using my debit card, it took them over 15 minutes to tell me, we're sorry, but we are out of oatmeal. Seriously? Even though they refunded me the difference via same pay form, it's something they should have known they didn't have. Now more so since they prioritize the drive through and call in orders.
Unfortunately this location has really gone downhill. Used to be one of my faves, but now it's understaffed & slow and they're always out of baked goods/espresso/milk/stoppers, etc...

This Starbucks is the worst but unfortunately is the closest. I try to avoid going here when I can. They are ridiculously slow, I've even gone to the new Starbucks that opened further away from me and they were much faster and apologized for their delay, which wasn't even a delay. On top of being slow, they forget half the stuff you ask for and can't be bothered to give you a bag or napkins. When you go to the location in Mt. Laurel all the baristas are zipping around and it's like a production, they're shouting orders out, rechecking to make sure everything is there. I went inside to see if it may be faster at the Medford location and to see if maybe I'm just being ridiculous but nope saw them moving just as slow as I thought. They need better training!

This is my favorite Starbucks in Tucson. I am always greeted with a smile and if I see a new item on the
menu board the baristas will explain to me what it is. They are very busy here and these baristas will do anything to make your drink perfect. Please be kind when at this Starbucks. I am an older adult and have witnessed customers being nasty. There is a good group here and I appreciate each and every one.
Staff was super friendly great service! Order a ice vanilla coffee and the coffee was made just right! Couldn't be happier!

Closest coffee drive thru from my house.. must be a Starbucks thing to not give good service. Orders never right. Rude. Just give me my coffee please correctly. Not much to ask especially when I pay 5 6 bucks per cup.

Every time I order a frappucino in this location, I always get a snobby look and an "ugh". I mean, if you don't want to make it, why have it in your menu. The rudest baristas ever and not to mention slow service!!
Wow nice turnaround! Will see what next weekend brings. Speed is much better and the restrooms are definitely an improvement.

Really a no star rating.  Ordered an iced green tea latte and was made a green tea frap. When I asked to get the  drink I really ordered, the barista made sure to let me know how irritated she was with me. Seriously! It's not my fault the individual at the register is incompetent and I had to step away to the restroom while you blended my drink. I didn't even ask for a refund of the price difference, but was still treated like I personally attacked her. Next time the amazing Well Coffee Place is closed I will bypass getting coffee in Fishers.
This place isn't here anymore. Drove out of my way to get there so don't waste your time.

The best location for a Starbucks for me. I zoom down Spruce St swing a right on 39th and zoom up Walnut and I'm back at work in no time. Friendly staff and great service. Beautiful seating arrangement and easy flow to the store. Always clean. Always fresh.

Eight minutes to close, and in then drive up I get a recording that says they are closed.  I know they have to clean up, but I don't get to close up shop eight minutes before my customers expect my day to end.  First world problems, I know.

The staff is always friendly and my order is always right. I will stop here on my morning walks and feel so welcomed by the environment and staff.

Definitely a good location

As soon as I walked in every staff member that made eye contact with me gave me a warm hello. I was actually having a little trouble with my Starbucks app today and they were very patient and helpful with that. My bagel came out absolutely perfectly toasted and my frappaccino came out great as well. I would definitely recommend this Starbucks.

We stopped through this Starbucks drive-thru location on an afternoon.  We only wanted coffee, apparently in the afternoon the only thing they brew is Pike (must not be a heavily trafficked Starbucks to have such limited options.  They had just ran out of Pike and had to brew another pot.  The woman was very apologetic and gave us our order for free, we just had to pull up and wait about 4 minutes for the Pike. As we were not in a hurry to be anywhere this was not a problem, however if you're trying to get somewhere quickly I would not recommend stopping at the Drive-Thru as it did take awhile.

Fast, efficiently and friendly. I was in and out of this little location on a Tampa visit and my order was perfect. The only slight gripe was about the cafe that needed some tending to, but other than that it was great!

I will NEVER go to this location again. I love my coffee and used to stop here all the time because of how pleasant the service was even though the space was small and not conducive to leisurely chatting or homework. Today was the 3rd time that I've gone in and the baristas were rude and disrespectful. They act like taking your order is such an inconvenience and one of them rolled their eyes and said "unfortunately" at the fact we ordered bacon SV bites. My iced coffee tasted horrible too but they were so flippant I didn't want to waste their time having them fix it. Very disappointed.
Great local coffee store that gives you fast service, the right drink every time and the staff knows your name! I appreciate my Starbucks every day and love the store!
A simple espresso over ice took 10 minutes. I was the only one waiting for a drink. Strange. Not sure what was happening.
Worst Starbucks ever! No organization and they can't keep orders in the order they are received! Took me 20 min to get a latte! Go elsewhere!

Cute and cozy. Love the wood decor.
Drinks are fine, and the staff is friendly.

Would return for more hot beverages!

Not as nice as other Starbucks, but you do get the same experience. The location is actually pretty nice, on the corner of Cota and State Street. The inside is probably the worst layout I've seen so far. There's a few tables along the windows and walls, but not many. It just seems very narrow. 

The service here is identical to many locations. However, one worker did toss my baked good to another worker to place in the oven once. It's just a minor detail, but that never happened until I came here. Either it shows how far the bakery items are stored from the oven since the kitchen area is also narrow, or just a lack of care for my order.

this starbucks fucked up my order. I ordered a matcha latte w almond milk. They put WAY too much freaking powder. Like chill. It shouldnt be that hard to make a matcha latte. It's literally powder and liquid. How do you mess that up. I understand that these employees r new but why did you hire them if they cant make a simple drink. Fire them. I paid 7 dollars for the most horrendous piece of shit ever. U guys ruined my day, and my appetite.

Disappointing. Almost every single time I have gone to this particular location I order the same drink and they give me something different every time. It is really frustrating trying to explain to the barista what they made a mistake on. I have gotten the correct order maybe two times out of seven. Each time I order I said the same thing and they got the same information. Somehow it's something different. I enjoy Starbucks very much but, again this location was very disappointing.

I've always been a fan of Starbucks. This was my first trip to the location in New Tampa. The staff was friendly and fast. The products were in line with the usual Starbucks quality you've come to expect. 
The only issue I had was lack of seating. My visit was mid morning on a Thursday and there was only 1 table left and it was right outside the bathroom. Other than lack of seating, the visit was pleasant.

It is so awesome that we now have a Starbucks on the south side of the freeway in Meridian!  Yay!!!  If you know my tastes in Coffee, you know that the Starbucks on Meridian Road just north of the freeway has been my favorite for years, but since this new one is only about four blocks from my house....  ...well, I just had to check it out.
My wife and I got an afternoon coffee today and this brand new facility, and YESSSSSS, it was very good.  I'm so happy!

Finally an updated and upscale Bucks! This place has a lovely layout: large back area with seating of all kinds. AND they have comfy chairs. AND an awesome patio. AND lots of tables for those who need to do study groups. 

The coffee and tea is the usual fare; but at least Tucson is getting its name on the map for being a bit more deserving of a roomy place to enjoy their treats.
I love the Starbucks Moto...we prefer to serve the criminals then service members of police!  And this place is the same as all of the Starbucks.

I came here early and it was easy in and easy out. Just what you want. The service was nice which is the only way to differentiate most of the Starbucks these days. Please note that the roads around this place can be confusing so be safe!

*Sigh* I just want my coffee without attitude from the older lady. Everyone else is friendly and this location is really convenient as a Vandy student. I may have to try to figure out her schedule and avoid her. Otherwise, it'll be a trek to the 3005 West End location.

Clean and roomy dining room and friendly service and music was fun. However our drink was messed up twice. When asked for light cream, it was made heavy. Not a huge deal- but ended up tossing the drink in the trash after a few sips because it was over loaded with sweetness. Other than that, it was enjoyable.

Waited for my drink for about 20 minutes and it was at the cash register, but she did not say my name. Had a green tea frappe the other day and it was more milk than green tea. Service has gotten worse over the years.

The new location that they moved to across the street is sooooo dark. No windows. I love sitting next to Windows when enjoying coffee. It is also very loud (concrete floors and high ceilings). The only thing it is good for is that has a driveway. Otherwise not a fan.

I went into this Starbucks with my mom to grab a drink after lunch and the girl at the counter was nice, however we did not get all of her attention as we were trying to pay because she was talking with her other coworkers. So we paid and went down to the end where my drink was to wait.

The guy at the bar put whip cream on my drink, except it's not supposed to get whipped cream. So I said something about it and he argued with me and kept telling me it didn't say "no whip" on the cup, instead of just fixing the issue by scraping it off (which is all I wanted). 

Then the coworkers gathered in the middle of the store and started talking, except we were still waiting on my moms brewed coffee and her donut, which the no one had gotten yet. Plus my mom ordered a blonde coffee and the blonde roast was sitting on a holder labelled dark roast. So my mom just clarified that it was the right one and the girl was rude about it saying "well yeah, true north is our blonde roast." 

Will not be visiting this Starbucks again.

If you plan on getting a cup of coffee at Starbucks before your flight, you need to budget at least 30 minutes. The lines at this Starbucks are LONG. The good news is that 8th & Roast just opened another coffee shop in this part of the airport, so if the line is super long at Starbucks, you can go there. But there's nothing great about this Starbucks. I guess it's nice to have one, but I've flown out of this airport dozens of times and there's always a craaaaaazy line.

It's an alright Starbucks. 

There's a huge lobby! Lots of space inside, but not much outside. 

The lobby was kinda dirty when we came in. 

The service was quick, but the baristas were a little snippy and werent totally prepared with what pastries they had and what they didn't. Almost like the baristas weren't talking to each other until they needed to. It felt very disorganized. 

There is parking in the back, but not a lot.

I like Starbucks...I am not a die hard fanatic for coffee with a lot of calories, and tend to prefer what I make at home, however I do receive gift cards quite frequently and I love it because it's a treat for which I don't normally indulge.

This location is close to home, but it is located right in the middle of a busy triangle intersection that has three stop signs that are all pretty much ignored by 95% of those who happen to pass by. There is no drive through, parking can be a bit of a challenge, and it is almost always crowded. The inside is on the smaller side for the amount of traffic this place sees daily. None of this should be attributed to the fast and pleasant baristas and environment you typically expect at a Starbucks, but it all adds to the overall experience. I really want a Starbucks this close to home, but I wish even more that it were somewhere - anywhere - else than in this specific spot.
Over priced "high-end" quality. I submitted a mobile order because I was rushing this morning. I didn't check my order until I got to my office. Completely disappointed! My "warmed" banana bread.

Just left Starbucks here and am very disappointed with the customer service. As my mother ordered her food, a young female with blonde hair and light colored eyes rudely pointed at the sandwiches and said "which one, they all have names." She also kept agreeing to things we ordered and in the end they didn't come out as we ordered them. I asked for an ombré pink drink and got the regular. We asked for no bacon and she didn't even tell us that they couldn't take the bacon off. Towards the end of the transaction we didn't receive our receipt; in a rudely manner she handed the change back towards my mother. 

Fun part, when we were leaving we asked the same young lady for a spoon. She didn't say anything, and basically threw the spoon across the counter. But I observed as she was helping a white gentleman she was extremely nice towards him. This is not okay because it's shows racism. I will stick to the Starbucks back in Maryland because this was really the worst experience ever.

This is my favorite Starbucks ever thanks to the barista (her name starts with a C, I believe) who made my drink, a double shot on ice, perfectly and without a second thought or even an eye roll. She seemed happy to be there! The manager at the counter, however, named Jeff, was absolutely rude to me. He acted visibly annoyed with me while taking my order, and had a mocking tone to his voice. I could tell he didn't want to "deal" with me. I was polite as can be but he definitely woke up on the wrong side of the bed. Seems to me like the barista and manager should switch positions. She is much more customer friendly than he is and served me with sweet hospitality and a warm smile. She is the only reason I will return.

Starbucks is my JAM. I keep it simple with a non sweet almond milk latte or  I drink it black. This location is different. I don't know if they brew it differently or if they just don't know what they are doing but it never tastes as good. Baristas are grouchy most of the time. ( it may be due to dealing with stressed travelers all day).  The vibe is just off.

In the past week this location has been extremely poorly managed. 
Twenty people wait in line for mobile orders with one dedicated barista while those coming in front door are served by a dedicated barista immediately. 

DONT GO TO THIS LOCATION!!
Honestly greatest experience ever. Hannah and Sierra are a hoot! They made sure to make the perfect drink and they definitely did. I can't wait to come back
The staff here is always kind & the coffee is always good!!! My go-to is an iced caramel macchiato & they make it so well! Ily, starbucks

This place is soooo nice!The people are so nice and there is all the things you need!Theres books and toys and candy and some more candy and even more then that!Mostly if you like coffee then you should go to Starbucks or especially chapters.
Drinks are consistently good.  However,  the bathroom (yes just one bathroom) is filthy and so are the tables outside.  Staff always seems pretty friendly as well.
There is always a line at this Starbucks.   Not because it's popular,  but because they are so SLOW!  Corporate needs to send someone to fix this Starbucks!

This Starbucks location (5th Street in St. Charles) is right near where I work, so I frequent it at lest two or three times a week.
