It recently underwent a renovation of the lobby, and I'm really disappointed in the new seating; though it is a bit roomier and bright, it seems specifically designed to ensure that no one will sit for very long.  Perhaps that is the point; were too many people just hanging out in those comfy leather chairs and couches?  There is now a bench along the windows with no seatback to recline on, and the tables and chairs are hard and uncomfortable.  If they designed this specifically to spur people to move on quickly, then mission accomplished.  So now, if I need to relax and do some writing or work with my coffee, I'll be going to Picasso's or Crooked Tree.  Or, I hope that Starbucks will replce the seating with something a little more comfortable.

This is NOT a criticism of the baristas and staff, who have always been friendly and efficient!
Standard mini Starbucks but with the worst customer service imaginable. Lazy workers that don't want to wait on customers.

This Starbucks was a quick pit-stop on the way out of Philadelphia to head back to DC. Not only is this a gorgeous location if you're considering going for the wifi and to do work, but the employees here are quick and friendly. We were very happy with our experience here, and I'd absolutely go back the next time I'm in Philadelphia. 

Also, parking was easy. Let's be honest, in any major city parking has to factor into the rating of an establishment. Well, way to go this Starbucks! You're great with that. Street parking nearby, and we were leaving on a Monday morning at like 10. So there should have been lots of people trying to park, or so I'd expected. BUT the parking gods were on our side!

All in all, a beautiful and accessible Starbucks location in a fun, vibrant part of the city.
I ordered 4 simple drinks and none of them are right, Really slow and bad customer service specially the lady in the cashier inside the store.

Great drinks like any Starbucks and great customer service, but the bugs flying around are so annoying!!! I can't study/do work in the store, i have to sit outside, because the gnats/flies are so present.

The best part about this particular Starbuck's location is the interior décor. It's a nice place to sit and talk with whomever you brought to this location, but that's about it. If you want to sit and hang out at this location, unfortunately and I mean unfortunately, you will probably have to buy something from them.

I think that Starbuck's coffee isn't really all that good. I heard that there was this new location, so I wanted to try it out. I didn't think that I would get great coffee because I have never gotten great coffee from any Starbuck's location. Today was no different. I ordered a Vanilla Bean Crème Frappacino and got a cold drink that tasted like vanilla ice cream. If I wanted vanilla ice cream, I would have gotten the carton out of my freezer and eaten it. The bottled frappicinos that you can buy in the convenience stores and grocery stores are so much better tasting than what I bought.

The customer service was from somewhat lackadaisical employees, one of whom just acted like he didn't understand anything that was said to him. 

Some people may think that "it's cool to hate Starbuck's," but when they consistently have less than stellar customer service and their products don't taste good, that's not being cool to hate Starbuck's; those are valid reasons not to like Starbuck's and this location hasn't given me a reason to like their coffee very much either. Overall, I think that Starbuck's is overrated and overpriced for what they have.

I would much rather patronize the small independent coffee shops around town than to patronize a corporate establishment because the small independent coffee shops need the business more that the large corporate coffee chains need it. The small independent coffee shops always seem to have better coffee and infinitely better customer service, too.

I like that this SB is situated right beside Save On Foods. There's always an abundance of parking. It does get pretty busy in there but their staff seems to make it up with their pleasant greetings and smiles. I like doing my leisurely reading in the corner of where their couches are.
Coffee is fine servce sucked. And it stuiped tbat a review has to long. Yelp suuuuucccckkkks long enough

Long overdue full stand alone Starbucks on the northwest side!! Replaced small Starbucks that was across 1st.  New, clean, spacious, tables to work, seating to meet friends, staff friendly snd helpful and great drivethru. Take care in the parking lot however-while parking slots seem to accomodate, the traffic mapping is tight and intersecting with queue to drivethru, pedestrians, and entry/exit traffic.
Worst Starbucks I have ever visited. They're have a 7 people behind the counter that do not know what they're doing-the line just grows. I've never waited this long for a drink and food.

The worst Starbucks. Ive ever been to. No problem with the employees. But, my latte was really bad, spinach wrap was black - it was so burned, there were no newspapers of any kind, there were no coffee stirrers available, internet was beyond slow and spotty.

Every time I come to this starbucks I am disappointed. They never get my order right. I used to have one lady that I enjoyed seeing there and she was always a light & made no mistakes. She moved locations and now I never see any good service. The wait is always long. Grateful for the sweet person in front of me that paid for my order this evening but I wish I could repay them as my order was a total waste!! Officially never going to this starbucks again.

These people are the rudest starbux stAff ive ever encountered.  It was a sundAy morning at 10am and there was a line out the door.  THERE WAS ONLY ONE REGISTER OPEN.  When i called them on it, this nasty looking broad with a mustache started talking back.  So i told the manager who basically gave me the same attitude.   I called the district manager who said they would handle it after i told them how long they made everyone wAit.  Apparently this one girl Ashley (fat and obnoxious) is upset About and told me not to leave my water around.  Never have ive ever been told this at any starbux.

This is probably the worst service I've had at Starbucks so far. I traveled with family so we had a big order. They were in the middle of switching shifts, which i understand can get chaotic, but no matter what customers first. Even if you've clocked out, you are still representing the place you work at, and this is why they deserve the bad review. They got our orders wrong, and was very impatient. When I told her I was not done with my order, she rolled her eyes really hard. 


Overall was a terrible experience. If Starbucks at STL Lambert Airport decides to do something about this, this is the Starbucks across from gate A4. It was around 5:45pm on Tuesday.

I would give no stars. I never do this,write a remark. BUT this was bad service. Simple order two coffees and three breakfast sandwiches. Waited and waited. Got my wife's coffee waiting on mine. Customer behind me got his three coffees and breakfast sandwich. Still waiting and not a word from the employees. Second customer behind me got his two coffees and food. Still waiting, wife's coffee is now cold so I asked what's going on ?  They said they are just making the other coffees now. So I asked them to make my wife's coffee again. Third customer got their order. Still waiting. 
I figured it out at the end, they saw my badge when I paid  

Got to my car and the coffees they made weren't even hot. I love starbucks BUT I think I'm done. I'll find a mom and pop coffee shop.
This is the first time I have ever gone to a Starbucks and the person helping us was grouchy. She didn't say hello, thank you, or bye. Very disappointing.

This Starbucks has become one of the worst! The wait times are ridiculous, even for mobile orders. Shortly after I made a formal complaint about their handing of mobile orders, they just flat out stopped offering mobile orders. I no longer get coffee here because instead of fixing a staffing issue, they just turned off mobile ordering. I only do mobile ordering and I'm sure I'm not the only one. Poor management in my opinion.

I ordered ahead at 11:03 am and my drink wasn't ready until 11:37 am. On top of that, I asked for syrup and there is none there. The employees seemed to be fine, but the manager was not prioritizing orders. Walk in orders were done immediately and mobile orders were not. Poor management, not coming back here again.
Messy and slow service. People not interested in giving you a good experience at all.

The new location is amazing and great for studying. I love this Starbucks and the employees actually make an effort to get to know their customers. Spent all summer here working on online classes and never had a bad experience. I drive past 3 others to go to this particular one. You all are great.

Starbucks is kind of like the McDonalds of Coffee.  The advantage - you know what mediocre product you're going to get.  The product here is mediocre but the service can be so bad, I can't give it a two. The baristas often aren't paying attention to the customers.  I've waited up to 5 minutes for a nitro brew coffee even though I was the only customer AND nothing appeared to be changed out. I mean I'm sure the conversation the two employees had was really important!  The best part of that occasion - how angrily I was provided my coffee. I was a real jerk to interrupt their conversation with my business!!!  While that was the worst anecdote, I've never had good service!

This is one of the best Starbucks in Tucson. The employees are always cheerful, polite and very knowledgeable of the SB products. Andrew, Zarin and Ammie are always very friendly and cheerful, which is always nice to do business with them. If you are a regular or a first timer here, the employees treat you as if you are their only customer. It gets crazy at times, but everyone pulls together and this makes the flow of orders happen very smoothly. The Store Manager, Lawson, has a great attitude toward his customers and employees. Best Starbucks in Tucson. Thank you! Always enjoy going to this friendly store.

Zero sense of urgency in a place where you need it the most....at an airport gate.

Focus should be on expediting orders as quickly as possible.   Line of about 8 took me about 10 minutes to arrive at the cashier then another 10 minutes waiting for my food.  Totally unacceptable and happens way too often at Starbucks. 

If the coffee wasn't so good I would never come here.   You're hanging on by a thread Starbucks!  Improve your ordering system and now!!

Worst customer service I have ever received at a Star Bucks.  Very simply argot 90% of our order and patiently waited 15 min & realized they must have forgot to make the last drink we ordered.  No problem, it happens.  But when we brought the issue to the attention of the Barrista she rudely and sarcastically told me I just take them in the order I get them and were busy so you're ill get to your drink in a minute.  Took about 20 min to get a drink made. The entire time she was talking to a man (friend, boyfriend or the like) on the other side of the counter not paying any attention to what she was doing.  I then asked the girl taking the orders for the managers name and phone number., she then rudely stated I'm taking care of another customer right now, you're going to have to wait.  I told her actually we were also customers, who were there first and had not been taken care of appropriately. All I was looking for was a polite "I'm sorry but we'll get right on it).  It's not the fact the drinks were made out of order or that I had to wait, but how they handled it when I addressed the issue.  With family in town I had just spent about $40 there in the last two days.  For the premium you pay at Starbucks over indulgent positive customer service is expected.  Won't be visiting this Starbucks at all in the future, nor will my friends and family.

Slowest Starbucks I've encountered in the world. Passed through Nashville International 4 times in last 2 months. Twice I waited over 30 minutes in line for a coffee; once I wait for 15 mins but the long line didn't move. The 4th time I didn't try. The coffee, once you get it, is as expected. But they really need to hire more people.

The Starbucks chain in general is ridiculous with it's no readily available decaffeinated coffee policy. This is amazing since Starbucks is one of the largest coffee shop chains in America. To add insult to injury, they charge you more for an Americano or pour-over decaf. This morning at my local Starbucks in Horsham Pennsylvania I was told I have to wait 10 minutes for decaffeinated coffee...totally ridiculous. Do they realize how caffeine negatively affects the health of some people, especially people with heart medications?  To top it off, after I was stuck in the drive-in line waiting for my coffee after I was told I have to wait awhile for decaf., they did not put cream in my coffee and gave me the wrong yogurt which of course I did not realize until I drove off.  On a personal note I am doing this post so I remember not to go to Starbucks again because of their unfriendly treatment of decaf. coffee drinkers.

Terrible customer service. They mess up my drink all the time they close 20-25 mins earlier than their time. I constantly wait in line for 10 minutes somtimes longer. The only reason why I keep going is Bc it is close to my house but I will drive further just to avoid this location.

I love this location. I use the mobile ap to order my coffee right before I leave the house and by the time I get there it is ready. It is also always just the way I want it. It is perfect. 

They do have a drive through, but I think mobile ordering is faster than the drive through. I usually come during the week right around 7am and most days there is going to be a line in the drive through then.  

They have outside and inside seating. It is nice inside but I never just come here to sit and chill.

Workers are rude, no respect to clients, I normally come here when I'm shopping at nearby grocery stores. Taking advantage of COVID-19, they lock the bathrooms but they allow people they know. This will be the last time I will be getting my coffee at this location. What a customer service.

20 minutes in the drive through at 2:30 on Saturday is ridiculous. Ordered usual green tea and an extra blonde shot of espresso. Tea  was Excellent but shot was cold. There are more than enough Starbucks around to go to. Avoid the highway 19 next to Moe's unless you have a half hour to kill

My party bought several drinks at this Starbucks location. After watching multiple people use the restrooms here, one of my party members walked over to use the restrooms and was very rudely told that the restrooms were closed and were not able to enter. I'm pretty sure that's illegal.

This place is the absolute worst. They must think the beauty of the inside can make up for the terrible service you receive. Every single time I go there, they either a) don't have all the things to make my drink. b) make the drink too hot after I ask for a specific degree. c) always give me a the wrong milk when I ask for SOY. This place would have been better off not existing and the small one next to Sally's should have stayed open.

This place has always had my food and drink right, but man it needs helped. I've worked at Starbucks and been to hundreds of locations. I go to one almost everyday. This place....you need a solid 30 extra minutes if you plan on waiting to order, then waiting on a drink. I've even ordered in my mobile app while at home (over 10 minutes away) and still came to the store and waited. 

I'm not sure if it's the way the work flow is...there always seems to be a lot of workers. I hope they can get this resolved. I started just ordering a minimum of 15 minutes out which has worked out well the past few times.

**If you need an iced coffee refill, also plan on that taking at least 15 minutes - this is probably the worst part because I'm just wanting to leave at this point**

I love Starbucks, I love what they do, I love their mission, vision, and values, and this  Starbucks is no exception, super friendly, clean, efficient I'm outside here sitting in the lite rain in the morning enjoying the day, and a young lady from Starbucks comes out and wipes down all the tables to make it a more user-friendly experience......... way to think about the customer experience.

Janae (sorry if that's misspelled) in the drive through for this location is by far one of the most incredible people I have come in contact with. I've always had great service at this location but there is something special about how she brings a smile to my face every time I go there (which is a lot) I love seeing your face friend! You make my day start off just right! Happy holidays!

The absolute worst location! I wish this wasn't the location closest to me or I would never go again, but it is on my way to grab it, so that is the only reason I go back. First of all, the drive thru line constantly takes so long to the point where it gets me late. Like I'm talking I've waited for 30+ minutes and you get stuck in the line, so I can't get out at that point. It should not be taking that long ever with 5 or so cars in front of me. It has happened on many occasions. Also, my coffee order is almost never made right like I'm very clear with my order and they still manage to mess it up. The food is always burnt too, which is a big reason why I rarely get it anymore. I used to go daily and now I go maybe once a week because I'm sick of wasting money on something that is either burnt or not even made right and I'm also sick of being late for work because of how slow they are. It's ridiculous and this location needs to be managed much better because it makes Starbucks as a corporation look terrible.

This is by far the slowest Starbucks I have ever been in. For a cold brew coffee plain I waited 10 minutes with no one else in the store. More than once. Staff moves at a snails pace. If I had another option in this route I'd take it, even a **gasp** Dunkin Donuts.

Starbucks has my heart since my first cup of coffee! But for the first time, I was disappointed. I ordered my drink, paid, and waited like usual...and then waited...and waited...and waited. After 5-6 people got their drinks...who order after me. The barista asked what I was waiting for.  My drink. If the barista wasn't focused on providing complimentary drinks to his friend who walked in right before me who ...did not order at the cashier I think my drink wouldn't have been "taken" or forgotten.
Starbucks is always Starbucks anyway, but this was one of the friendliest ones I've ever been to! This is definitely going to be a regular spot for me, the vibe is awesome!
My boyfriend and I just got a coffee right before close and Jakob helped us at the window, he was so sweet, we wish you all the best with your future endeavors :)

This was a good Starbucks before it became a drive-through in a new location. 
They are  always be out of everything. During Smore's season I ordered Smore's and they gave it to me. With no whipped cream. And I was like where's the whipped cream? And they were like, "oh we are out of marshmallow."What?? Then it's not a smores! It's chocolate and some other things!
Was there a few days ago they are out of pumpkin sauce. Was there yesterday and they're out of cold brew. Was there today, they're out of cold brew. They also love to hand you cups that have coffee dripping down the sides of them. So, always double check before you take the cup to make sure it's clean.

Update! Today they are out of nitro and it's 6:00 PM ‍

Ok here we go again Isabella is one of the greatest Baristas I know very rare in this business. I appreciate your hospitality readiness to warn you up with a smile and a fire. You need more like her...
Shawn ain't bad either Lol!! Thank you both you make it fun to come in.

The baristas are sweet but wow, save time by going into the lobby if you can. This is THE SLOWEST Starbucks I've ever been to yet. Been sitting in the drive thru for going on 15 min now and still haven't reached the ordering station. I've moved 2 car lengths during this time. As a former barista partner, thus is extremely awful for drive thru times. Management really needs to work on their speed and times, especially after 4:30pm. This is ridiculous. Been here 4 times so far and regretted every time I chose the drive thru option.‍
Convenient in target store.  Got a cup of coffee. No seating due to Covid.  Limited when it's avl.

This shop is manned by the kindest baristas ever.  My daughter was having an awful day and she messes up her app order , was late to work , stuck i. Traffic. And was about to lose it.

The team here saved the day and showed such kindness. It was really appreciated .  Everything was delicious
Always a fun place. Fast service and interesting folks. Once again.. just the bathroom is NASTY! I really wish as in other cities they'd mandatory key use for the restrooms.
The drinks are well made, the staff is very friendly, but they are sooo slow in comparison to other locations.

This is a very basic Starbucks - not terrible but not over the top either. 

I usually get breakfast here and the service, while polite, is also a little gruff and unfriendly. But I don't go here for the conversation. 

A big critique is that their cups and lids for cold drinks smell like sweet bakery items (frosting in particular). Not anything that will cause you to dislike your drink but also not unnoticeable. 

Good place for a hot breakfast and coffee or tea. Also the location is great as it's by hotels and downtown St Charles.

I've been to this specific location a couple of times, and I've liked it just fine. The coffee is good, and the baristas are friendly. Today, I went in for a free drink with a coupon I earned. The girl behind the counter was super sweet! She helped me figure out what drink I wanted (I wasn't sure) and threw in all the extras since she knew it was free. When I picked it up, she said if I didn't love it they would make another one. The drink itself is delicious, obviously, but what stuck out was the phenomenal customer service!

Starbuckkkksss. What is up with the horrible wait in this drive-thru line? It's atrocious every single day, whether there's 40 cars in line or 2. It just doesn't move.

Pro tip- if you're in a rush, go inside.

Lol, great experience at this location. I was claiming my free coffee from playing a Starbucks game and had no clue how to order with the Starbucks lingo. The cashier, coffee man or whatever you wanna call him, lol was super helpful and helped me order a "large" coffee. Even though I'm you have to add you own sugar and cream it was still a pleasant visit. Polite folks here and I'll probably stop in here if I win another coffee!
Convenient location right off of the highway, but if you want great service & you want to grab your coffee and be on your merry way...don't stop here! Slow as hell!!!!!
The staff was the highlight of my visit to this Starbucks. Ordered food and coffee and was disappointed in the quality of food compared to others. 5 stars for the staff 1 for the food.

It's a nice Starbucks in a sense that orders are delivered quickly and efficiently. The staff is always friendly and wears masks. Food and drinks are about the same as in other Starbucks locations.

You can also seat outside, but I noticed that tables outside are rarely cleaned if cleaned throughout the day at all. Hence, minus one star. 

Lots of parking on the back of the building, so it's easy to find a spot.

Drive thru goes pretty swiftly. Always good service at this location. Only complaint is making a LEFT into you have to do u-turn and the condos by there do not want you to use their street as a turnaround... but I do anyways! 

Just tried the new honey almond milk cold brew.. I would like it a little sweeter so i'll get a shot of flavor next time!

Didn't even know this was here. But did my mobile order and went up to the screen and was greeted by a very pleasant worker this morning.  I was kinda surprised because there was a camera allowing me to see her as well. 
Overall, this is a new a location so it was very clean, workers were very pleasant.

Seriously.  Slowest Starbucks ever. 

It's 9am.  On a Sunday. 5 ladies working... all
Moving at a snails place like they haven't slept all evening or something.   Skipped the drive through, went inside.   I was the ONLY one waiting to be helped..  7 minutes later. Yes.  7.  I finally ordered my coffee.  What the hell??

Well my coffee tastes like it should taste. That's a plus. The three baristas are cursing and carrying on about working Thanksgiving. I understand that sucks. I've worked thanksgiving many years. They shouldn't say it in front of the customers. One man stood there trying to ask for half and half for at least 3 minutes (I mean holding the empty bottle in the air so it's blatantly obvious.) They finally seen the guy. Maybe work on customer service skills a little huh? I still tipped well even with the service. It's the holiday and I'm thankful they are working it.

What a unique experience. Ashley was less then friendly and welcoming but had a totally different demeanor with her male coworker and had no problem carrying on a conversation with him while taking drink orders. She charged me for a size larger than what I had ordered and when I mentioned it she didn't apologize but said, "I charged you for a venti because that's what I heard." I didn't even know what to say. I definitely ordered two drinks in two different sizes. While people's drinks were being prepared, her coworker tried to ask a question about one of the drinks but Ashley decided to finish a personal conversation with another coworker before helping the one with a question regarding a customer's drink.

The store was filthy on top of this. I'm talking trash all over the floor and the drink pickup counter was sticky and had old did spills all over it.

Teavana Shaken Iced Green Tea

Every time I come to this location, they fill your entire drink with ice. I take a few sips and the whole drink is gone. It's a total rip off.. I'm certain I could ask for a tall with no ice and it would be more than what I was served today.

I never get why people bash some of these locations. Where else are you going to get your coffee on I-95? I mean sure the Starbucks that is outside instead, but why bother? Go inside the welcome center, get in line, and go to this Starbucks. The staff was fast and friendly.

This is my favorite Starbucks location. Yes, there's a Starbucks on every corner it seems, but here the floors, tables, and bathrooms are always clean and the staff are very friendly in comparison with the indifference that feels so common to a Starbucks visit nowadays. Even when my app wasn't functioning one day, preventing me from paying, the barista gave me my drink for free and was so kind about it. It's my go to spot to get my favorite coffees and snacks on the go, or to sit and work peacefully.

This Starbucks is pretty spacious and has larger tables!

However, with the larger tables comes the probability that you will be sharing with someone you do not know.  Honestly, I think this is great, because it fosters a sense of community.  On the other hand, you better hope the person next to you does not smell.  

There is also a comfortable couch and a couple of chairs to lounge in (about 4).  There is a bar in the front overlooking U.S 19 (not the loveliest of views, but you get a ton of light being that it is an entirely glass wall in front of you).  This Starbucks is often full of college students studying.  I've actually been told this is the Asian starbucks (meaning there are more Asians here than you would find most places).  Surprisingly, this is true.  I can honestly say I have seen more Asians here then most places in the Tampa Bay area.

This Starbucks is in a pretty good location, next to a Target, movie theaters, other food places, etc.  However, the traffic on US 19 can get pretty backed up so choose your time to come wisely.

I'm not sure how I've managed to never review this location! But, here goes...

I've been to this location so many times over the years. Mostly drive thru. But when I lived in the area, I did occasionally come and do some work, away from my kids. The inside is a bit small and can sometimes be hard to find a spot. But it's a pretty busy location.

I've never had a bad experience here. Does one ever, really, at coffee places? We bean heads love our caffeine dealers. My Peppermint Mocha today had a bit to much flavoring in it, but, it was still an uplifting cup of Joe. Altho, I do think it's total crap that the price of my favorite flavor goes up, simply because Starbucks deems it a "holiday flavor" right now.

Reading the reviews, I came across many yelpers complaining about the layout and the size of the space. THE EMPLOYEES CAN NOT CHANGE EITHER ONE OF THESE SITUATIONS. If they could change this, I'm sure they would in a heartbeat. 

Anyway, service has always been great for me! In the morning, it could be absolutely dreadful, due to the line. However, the employees try their best to stay chipper and calm in these hectic situations. I could NEVER be that chipper in the morning, so it makes me appreciate the service even more.

I hate to see that this Starbucks has such a low ratings Yelp. This is one of my favorite Starbucks locations. I grew up in Greenville and I think that this place has well-integrated itself into the surrounding area.

Yes, there are better local places nearby (like Brew HaHa for example) but I must give this Starbucks credit for creating a great space right on the Kennett Pike. They have a wonderful seating area and the exterior in beautiful.

The DO NOT have a drive-through, which I kind of enjoy. This can mean that wait times can be longer but at least you have a nice space to wait. 

If you're craving Starbucks in Delaware, come to this Starbucks. There is ample parking and a beautiful space to wait for your brew!
These baristas/managers deserve a raise! They are on their sh*t!! Service and drinks are consistent every time!
Worse Starbucks in the area... they make every excuse to the customer no matter how reasonable the solution is, to do there actual job...

Worst Starbucks ever. Bunch of rude workers who messed up my order 2 times in a row, no apologies, and they were extremely rude about it. If you want to add more stress to your morning before you board your flight this is the place to stop.

Worst Starbucks I've ever been too! This place was filthy and the restrooms were disgusting with no toilet paper. When we let the baristas know, they said they were too busy to worry about the restrooms even though there was only 1 person in line. In addition, when I asked if they made a been there mug for Santa Barbara, they said that the been there series didn't do any cities just states which is obviously false. Avoid this location at all costs!!!

I opted to go inside this Starbucks  location today instead of going through the drive thru since the line was so long. It was during Happy Hour and BOGO handcrafted beverage. I purchased two Grande Irish Creme Nitro Cold Brews ------ DELICIOUS! Sometimes they are better than others and today they tasted superb! I also got a brownie for 50 points. This location has been remodeled (I believe) and it is very nice inside. There were many seats & tables available. Parking was sparse as is typical with most of the Starbucks I have been to. The baristas today were extremely friendly.

This is my favorite Starbucks. The baristas are very knowledgeable and kind. ESPECIALLY Cara. I visit this location on average about once a week and I always enjoy being able to chat with Cara. She's personable and always crafts my order perfectly.

As I was coming back from New Jersey, I stopped by here for some coffee before hitting the Baltimore metro area. This SB location is attached to the gas station along the way, sitting in the center between the northbound and southbound lanes.
As it was raining hard, most people were using the drive thru. I didn't want to wait, and I like the rain (especially since we rarely get it in Southern California nowadays), so I walked the 25 meters in the pouring rain to the front door. It was quite a refreshing walk.
I walked in and ordered my iced latte. The cashier had an upbeat personality. They processed my drink pretty fast as well. While they were making my drink, I made a pit stop. I can saw that this store is kept pretty clean.
A good experience, and a convenient one.

I mean it's Starbucks! Need I say more lol. Came here for a guava green tea lemonade. The line was so long and took what seemed like forever to get thru. When we finally got up to order, they didn't have lemonade! Ugh. Oh well I just ordered the drink without the lemonade and it was still good. Staff was friendly and got our order right.

Friendly service and clean location. I wish there was more indoor seating available though. The past few times that I have visited this location, there is one person taking up the bigger table with the most seating. Perhaps, adding smaller / two seater table arrangements would be better than the big bulky chairs that take up most of the space. That's just my two cents.

I go to this Starbucks frequently, usually always pleasant. However, this time around I go there to get lunch. Ate the pb&j sandwhich and cheese stick then I noticed the cucumbers. They were covered in mold. The best by date was 5/10 and it seems that they weren't checking their food case. The drive thru guy was in a rush and it was pretty busy. 

But, I do pay to have food that's fit for consumption, and this is just concerning. It worries me that they aren't cleaning the machines that brew the coffee properly either. I'd say, check you drinks and food before consumption here.
If you are in a time crunch avoid this Starbucks. We seriously waited 30 minutes in the drive through line which is designed so that you can not drive around the cars in front of you! What a trap.

They apparently have no process for handling mobile orders when they are even a little busy. Multiple orders left undone. The idea is convenience, not waiting 15 mins for an order that is just sitting in the queue undone.

Customer service is alive and well at this Starbucks location.  I had a problem with my Starbucks reward card and went to speak to the manager on site, Felicia. She took care of me very kindly and graciously. Apologized for the mistake.

Wow... This doesn't happen now a days.  Love their service and coffee. They will have a loyal customer here

Great customer service!!!!  This Starbucks was hopping!  We were the 6th car and it only took a total of 12 minutes!  We thought that to be very impressive with all the speciality drinks they make.  The gentleman that took our order and checked us out was very personable and in a good mood.  Very pleasant to see these days!!  Oh and our Strawberry Creme Frap was excellent!

Wrong order, burnt tasting espresso, very VERY rude barista. My expectations are not very high for a place with a drive thru but I went in having a nice day and I left completely irritable. Also this is one of the busiest Starbucks I have ever seen, and from waiting and seeing the people in line ahead of me it seems like I'm not the only person who didn't like their coffee...!

This Starbucks is super cute, as if there was a Starbucks on the way to Mordor.  Its quaint Hobbit Like setting is the perfect place to sip on a Keto Pink Drink and solve murders.  The staff is a laugh riot and sometimes distracting when I am trying to piece together a juicy whodunit.  They always have a smile on their faces and no carbs in the drinks.  I just love sipping my KPD and solving cold cases in this pub like underground coffee shop.   If you see me there don't say hello as I am probably minuets away from finding out who Jack the Ripper is.  

A must try for Starbucks lovers.

What a poorly run place and the workers have tons of very bad attitude... four people working and I waited 5 mins to place my order and when I asked if I could order I was snapped at and given a horrible look. Go anywhere else

My favorite Starbucks EVER! I come here at least once a week and the service is great. They recently remodeled the bar area and I love that there is more seating. The parking lot is shared by a publix so there is always plenty of parking. This location does have a drive thru and also a large outdoor patio area. This location is very Military friendly and will give you a discount if you are active duty!

Deceptive drive through! It looks like there is a drive through for moes you don't realize its Starbucks until its too late. Found out the car in front of us made the same mistake - how many times a day does this happen put a big sign there!

I stopped by one morning before work and was very impressed with the great and speedy service! There were 4 cars in front of me in the drive through and I was still in and out in under 5 minutes. The woman working the window was also extremely nice. I'm glad to know I have a Starbucks close by that I can go to during the morning rush and still make it on time to work!

I come to this Starbucks whenever I am visiting my daughter and we want to go for coffee.  As my review of the Starbuck's on Broad Ripple says...I always order the same thing:  A grande soy misto with 2 splenda.  This Starbuck's typically charges me 50 cents more for the soy milk, which is fine...I guess...but since the other Starbuck's doesn't...doesn't it make sense that I will go to the other one since it is closer to my house...EVEN if I am heading over to my daughter's house nearby??

Seriously Starbuck's...50 cents for 6 oz of soy milk?  At least they do remember to give me my cup discount since I always bring in my own mug.
So many good drinks in menu.. Yes a bit pricey but we all know this already..  This particular location was clean and staff was very friendly! Great coffee break!

Super cool interior! I am a big fan of the vibes of this Starbucks location. It is different than any other location I have been to. The outside and inside have a unique look. 

My drink was also delicious and was a recommendation from their "favorites" board. I can be indecisive at times so I liked that they had this board right when you get to the counter.

We all know what Starbucks has to offer.  These 5 stars are for the efficiency of the store and the friendly staff.

Ordered my favorite online, the drink was ready in 3 minutes even though there were quite a few people lining up.  You can see there were at least 10 drinks ready to be picked up.  I've never seen one this quick.

On the way out, I was approached by one of the staff who was holding coffee and cake samples.  I was offered the samples with a smile.

This store just won my heart (NOT because of the samples!)
El muchacho que atendió no fue amable en el servicio. Es muy inexperto y grosero, para trabajar con los clientes.

Grabbed my first Pumpkin Spice Frappacino of the season and it was as heavenly as I imagined! The drink was fantastic, but I'm giving 4 stars because the line was long and it took a while to even be able place my order and even longer before the drink was actually ready. Though it was busy the environment was still pleasant & there were plenty of seating options both indoor & outdoor. Really enjoyed my time there today.

One of the best staffed Starbucks in the area!!! 
Friendly and always feel welcomed 
Management is awesome 
Place is clean

The closest Starbucks to where we are staying for GJNC, there is one in our hotel but it doesn't take the app or gift cards. Friendliest staff here that I've encountered! Service with a smile from every employee here. Minus one star for NOT having mobile ordering enabled though. I live off of mobile order bc it's just easier to customize my drinks exactly how I like it. And sad they were already out of some of the breakfast sandwiches, but I'll let it slide bc there are many other people in town for the same thing and likely needed portable breakfast. Amazed that they have nitro brew here!
Waited 20 minutes even after ordering online previously...I am still in line with two cars in front of me.

This is my favorite Starbucks in all my travels.  As a former flight attendant and now a leisure traveler, I can always count on this location to provide the highest quality of customer service, reliable coffee flavor, and to remember my order every time I get here....less than half a dozen times per year. 
If there is a line, I know they will manage it proficiently.  The manager has been at this location for several years, as has a handful of other essential employees. New employees are trained and supported with care. They reflect this in their attitudes towards the customers. I appreciate this and it goes a long way with me.

First let me say I am a fan Starbucks. However, this particular Starbucks is one of the worse stores that I have ever visited. This place was dirty, I ask for paper towels for the men's room and I was looked at like an inconvenience (never got the towels), I ask for two packs of honey in my coffee, so what did she do? she slapped two sticky packs on the counter and said, here you go. I paid for my coffee with cash, instead of the clerk handing me back my change, she slapped 6 dollars and 86 cents in coins all over the counter and kind of shoveled it over to me. I understand that this is the electronic age but surely this young lady knows what cash is and that it will not bite you. Coffee shops are popping up everywhere now days, if Starbucks management isn't careful the stores are going to continue to decline. Competition is tough.

I stopped by Saturday afternoon around 3pm. Even though there were 3 employees working and the person just in front of me had been helped, no staff acknowledged my presence. Not even a "Welcome. We'll be with you in a moment." I patiently waited and when I was finally helped, I STILL wasn't greeted. I'm glad my order didn't take long so I could leave quickly myself.

Very very very poor service! We walked in just to buy a Starbucks Edmonton or Alberta mug and was made to line up for drive thru when we could have paid for it right then and there. 

Even one star is too high since we were waiting for the looooonnnnggg line. It took 25 minutes from the time we parked and was turned away to line up to get to the Order portion of the drive thru. And even while we were ordering, the lady behind the order speaker complained about not hearing us despite repeating ourselves already. I had to yell from the passenger seat " we were the ones buying the EDMONTON MUG" (but was told to line up for the drive thru.) !!! And it was the only time we were heard.

Adding further insult to the long line up, when we paid, she cleaned up the POS first thoroughly, WITHOUT GIVING US OUR PURCHASE AND RECEIPT that WE LITERALLY HAD TO ASK FOR BOTH.

At a time where business are dying for customers, this branch is OUT TO KILL BUSINESSES!!

Customer service is sadly lacking or maybe the lack of system or both.  

NEVER GO HERE!! THEY DONT KNOW WHAT SERVICE IS!!!!
Drive thru line was backed up so decided to run in real quick, that was a mistake. 30 minutes for just a hot chocolate ended up being late for work. Weren't understaffed just slow.

I love Starbucks and I know what I like. Even when someone is busy, you would think they could squirt flavor-but not this Starbucks. 
They forgot the vanilla in my vanilla latte. I went back to have them remake it, they got an attitude that they couldn't just add the syrup into the drink I already had (which was a good 45 minutes old by this point). The girl who was supposed to remake the drink went on break before doing so-the manager said that since she didn't write anything on the cup; he wasn't making anything. We waited for 20 minutes-the last 10 of which people who entered after is were served. 
Their parking lot isn't big enough to accommodate the amount of traffic, so getting in and out is a nightmare. Drive a little further to avoid this one.

This place is just below my office and I absolutely love sitting here. All the baristas are friendly and always greet you with a smile.
I always order one of these
1) Caramel Macchiato
2) Java Chip Frappacchino
3) Butter Crossaint

They replaced my butter Crossaint once when I was late to pick it up as it went cold. 
We sit here to work, have informal meetings and this place has a great vibe to it.
Do not go here if your in a hurry to catch a flight.  Service is veeeerrrrryyyyy slow.

Great new drink - IRISH CREAM NITRO COLD BREW - tried at this Starbucks location! I haven't looked into the calories yet so it may be the last time I order but boy oh boy is it yummy! The drive thru wasn't too busy when I drove through --- BONUS! and the friendly & helpful order taker suggested going with the Nitro Cold Brew over the Cold Brew version if I like Nitro. Um YES - I'm a NITRO huge fan! I highly recommend this cocktail for the taste - calorie wise TBD. Enjoy!!!

If I could give this place zero stars I would. It's the slowest and worst Starbucks I have ever been to. They're terribly inefficient, unorganized and walk around like lost children back there. The girl taking orders kept losing her badge for the register and she's making food at the same time. There was only one person making drinks. They were talking to each other and completely oblivious of how long their line is. We stood in line for almost an hour. They ran out of food. For being an airport Starbucks, it's horrible. Don't waste your time here

This location is awful. Every time I go through the drive-thru, the wait is at least 10 mins. I'm usually on my way to work so I place and pay for a mobile order that I can't even stay and wait to get. Ridiculous.

Why did corporate think it was ok to attach a Starbucks to a bank??? Small cramped crowded drive thru is always packed! No parking!

Friendly and spot on staff!!!

I kid you not, I waited in the sweltering heat in the drive through line for 35 minutes. The line was wrapped all the way around the building and moved at a snail's pace. At one point, a woman two cars ahead of me got out of the passenger seat and walked inside to order as the driver continued to wait. She went inside and came out with her drinks and the car line had only inches up up twice. That's how long it took them to serve the cars outside. I had the same experience the last time I came, so I will visit the location at 22nd Ave and 34th St every time now. They are extremely professional and fast no matter the day or time.

This location has a lot of space for seating which  I really enjoy. Starbucks ran this promotion in January with this silver tumbler that was refillable with free coffee for the entire month. I enjoyed stopping in each morning and getting my free coffee, always greeted with welcoming smiles and quick service! There are many Starbucks in town... but I prefer to be at this one!!

So, kudos to this Starbucks for recognizing demand and having two kiosks in this rest stop. Despite the extra booth, they are still incredibly busy.

I waited just over 10 minutes for an iced coffee. I felt like they were fairly efficient, although only two of the three registers were open. When you have a 10-minute line, seems like it's logical to open up that third register. Not sure that they really needed that guy adding cups to the already full cup stack when there was only one girl making drinks too. 

They have the cooler out front with prepackaged yogurt, sandwiches and such, and they have pastries, but it does not appear that they do the hot breakfast. 

All in all, there are some steps this Starbucks can take to improve the speed in which it serves its customers.

The first 2 visits I kinda thought the staff was rude. 2 more times prove it. Guy at window definitely rude. I said thanks and have a good day, and he said nothing!! He heard me! Name starts with an "I". Also name of a country!!  Also guy in ponytail is rude to us when we go inside. What's up with this place??

the cute barista, Ash is fantastic !! she's so sweet and will actually have a conversation with you instead of just standing there ignoring you. my morning hasn't been the best but her kindness has turned it around for a better day!!

This Starbucks needs so much improvement. They usually do not have the ingredients to make so many popular drinks or they do not have straws. I avoid coming here unless it's just a must. The management at this store should be re-evaluated. The Panini's are always out of stock. All of the refreshers are out of stock. Most of the syrups are out of stock.  The straws are usually out of stock. I won't mention how many times they just close the drive thru altogether. I prefer to go into the Starbucks inside the Fry's grocery store.

All too often I go to a Starbucks, and it's mayhem or worse, training day. 

This one was shockingly good. Had everything in stock, served quickly, accurately, and with a pleasant, not lugubriously-rehearsed smile. 

My hat's off to those that work there, and their manager, for being the best Starbucks in months and month. You are competent, well-managed, courteous, and quick. 

I cannot think of a better one, a very pleasant surprise.

This Starbucks is freezing!  I've gone here a couple times and I would definitely suggest bringing a jacket.  It also can get very busy and noisy so if you want to conduct a business meeting or a phone call, this is not the place.

That being said, there are quite a few tables inside and outside (compared to other Starbucks) and it is very popular at night.  It is a great location, since it has shopping all around it making it very convenient to go to.  I've never had an issue with parking either.
Does this look like light ice WTF      For the price of these drinks we don't need cups full of Ice

Barista got my food order wrong- ordered a cinnamon coffee cake (said it clearly, twice).  Ended up with a breakfast bun.  Very loud inside the facility and nearly impossible to exit the location to go north on Oracle Rd. Saw several potential customers struggling to figure out how to get in the store.  Perhaps it's a signal that you should try elsewhere.  My last time going here.

Just your average run of the mill Starbucks. There's only a few nice comfy chairs with the majority of seating located outside. It's tucked away in Clearwater mall and never gets terribly busy. There's limited parking right outside the store but you shouldn't have any trouble parking somewhere in the plaza. So far all the baristas here have been very genuinely nice which I appreciate. More of a Starbucks you'd stop in for something quick than a place you'd spend several hours at.

Time of order: 02July2019, 10:16:09AM, register 2.

On my way back to work, I decided to stop by to get a quick coffee. I didn't want to take long since my coworker I carpooled with had a meeting to go to, so I was in a bit of a hurry but had ample time to order coffee and a cookie and then head out. I ordered a caramel macchiato with a chocolate chip cookie and got my coffee, but was waiting an awful long time for my cookie. 
After waiting about 5 minutes, I asked one of the baristas (not the one who took my order) how long it will take to get my warmed up cookie and she said she was going to put the cookie in the oven now. She comes back 30 seconds later telling me that the store is out of chocolate chip cookies (you could've told me that when I ordered and during the whole 6 minutes I was waiting!) I was offered a chocolate croissant as a substitute, and waited 2 minutes for that croissant which I didn't want but was given no other alternative. 
Another barista comes to me and again tells me that the store is out of chocolate chip cookies (what the heck?! I thought I discussed this with another barista! No communication I guess!) She says if I want an alternative and I say NO and leave. My coworker was running late to her meeting so I had NO time to wait for a cookie or croissant I was NOT going to get anyways! Waste of my time and I never got my money returned! 
I am hoping a manager reads this and responds accordingly because I will NOT return to their store again.

I wish you were ten Stars so I could accurately review this Starbucks. This Starbucks is by far my favorite to go to everyone is so nice and work together very well. They have a worker there that even does special things for Mother's Day and other holidays. If you're on East Washington Street I highly recommend stopping in. Try the caramel ribbon crunch frappuccino and you will be hooked and in love.
Friendly service but the slowest Starbucks Drive thru I have experienced and it's slow every time I go.
I love Starbucks as much as the next person. I was surprised with how fast the items came out. It was clean inside and the energy was nice as well. Certainly a good place for a midday pick up!

The worst location I've ever been to! Out of the 5 people there, not a single person acknowledged my presence. Between that and the blaring music and dirty floors I thought maybe they were closed, and I was completely ignored until the cups were stacked (the customer is obviously not a priority here) After standing at the counter a few minutes I finally get to order. For some reason it took twice as long to make it than it usually does...and it tasted like crap. (I was the only customer besides one guy who was also waiting for his order.) I've gotten the same coffee for 10 years at Starbucks so I know when it's not right. I asked for another one and i waited another 10mins for it. They got it right the second time but I was floored that this was an actual Starbucks as I have never received such crappy service and have never seen one so dirty. I will never go back to that location..do better St. Albert.
Service could be much better. The barista Glenn was not very helpful and somewhat rude. It took over 15 mins for me to get my coffee and bagel and this was not at a busy hour. Disappointed.
I'm so exhausted of this place. It's the only one closest to me that's safe but their lattes are always so short.

I guess they were ready to go tonight. Idk what I even ended up with. I asked for a salted caramel mocha and ended up with what tastes like a hot chocolate. No whip, no caramel. Always disappointed when I comes to the hot drinks and sometimes with the frappes. Last visit I asked for a caramel frappachino with extra caramel and after I had already paid, they told me they ran out of caramel. Yea it was nasty.  If you want good hot and iced drinks, go down the street to Kávé Express. They never disappoint

The parking is abysmal and the drive thru is constantly busy. Still, the baristas are friendly, get the orders right, and get you in and out as quickly as possible. It's the customers who camp out here for the free WiFi that clog up close parking spaces. Maybe they should have two spaces just for pick up. Then when I order ahead I won't be parking a greater distance away - especially on a rainy day like today. Balbina and Shannon were wonderful, working together to get my offer right.
They've gotten my order wrong on multiple occasions. Wouldn't recommend going to this location.

For some reason when I order my coffee at this location, it tastes  too sweet and it's dark roasted. 
Our order has been messed up a few times, and it only has happened at this location. It seems like the app orders run behind, which should be the opposite. 
We pick up our orders at this location because it's on the way to take the freeway, but other than that, we avoid it. 
There's room for improvement and growth, and they should take advantage on this location.
Girl with the pink-ish hair and glasses was so polite! Not one to typically post about drive thru coffee, but had to post about how PLEASANT my experience was!!
Best barista ever award goes to.... BURK! This guy had my entire family laughing at the drive through. Great service.

What's not clear on Maps or the website is the stand alone Starbucks at this welcome center IS NOT 24/7 - only the Starbucks within the center is open all day. Makes no sense. The stand alone with the drive thru is the most obvious, and is o oh oprn 6am-7pm - but service seems only available well after 6am as I've stopped numerous times and though open the service is beyond slow (even to having to honk at the window). Being from the west coast, this is NOT up to the service of a standard west coast Starbucks - but certainly is up to the east coast standards. Easier to stick with WaWa....

This rating is more for the employees than Starbucks. I am probably the only person in the world that special orders a pink drink; I like more acai than coconut milk. Megan prepared my drink. She called me up to verify what I wanted. (I am sure there's not a button for what I want). She wasn't bothered at all, even though the store was packed with people in a hurry to catch a flight.  She double checked everything with me all the while smiling and a pleasant attitude. Starbucks might not be her career stop but I bet she carries that positive, friendly attitude wherever she goes. You might want to see what would keep her Starbucks! She's a great reflection of your company.

Manager was rude. I stood in line for minutes with a person in front of me and all employees walked passed us like we did not exist. I would expect a pleasant greeting and maybe an update like " good morning, we will be right with you " the place was not even busy it looked like they were doing other prep stuff . Basically was greeted rudely and rushed out
Everytime I come here they do not have the supplies to make the drink I get. Very rude staff!

Arrived on a Friday Morning at 10am & they were sold out of almost all there breakfast sandwiches. Really, so off to another Starbucks - hopefully- another one has it, or it's off to plan b.

The staff was nice & place was packed. Looked like a good work space, just not sure they will have their normal products.

Wish I could give it Zero stars 
Been there twice and they have been unable to get a simple black iced tea order right??!!!
Its a mess- GOT Training???
This is a no go - I"d be glad frys and safeway still have a Starbucks because this is a definite PASS!

This is a decent Starbucks. I've eaten here a few times recently. I'd give it 3 stars only because the wait can be a bit long, and because the restaurant itself isn't super clean. The baristas are always very friendly, but sometimes they make my drink wrong (always happy to re-make it) or forget about an item I've ordered. As a plus, they do have a parking lot, which makes it easy to dash in and pick up your order.

We mobile ordered here and they accepted it. Payment went through and everything. Turns out they closed at 3pm and it was 3:30. The people inside ignored us trying to communicate that with them. Never got our drink or money back.
I would say 9/10 times my drink is perfect!!!! The workers would be described as - Timely and always nice! Great Starbucks to visit. Still more than coffee should be but oh well
The cashier was so sweet. She offered me a trash bag to put my pillows in and it helped TREMENDOUSLY! Great service!

So I absolutely love this Starbucks location, but lately they have been off their game. This is the second time that I have ordered one of their cocoa cloud macchiatos and it's been given to me like this. I'm not sure what it is. It looks like bits of curdled milk? It actually got thinker by the minute. I'm usually willing to give anything a second chance but I've not keen on giving them a third. Probably will be taking a break from this location.

Ordered my drink Extra Hot, as usual. Order repeated to me properly.

Drink v v cold. Obviously the barista too lazy to warm the milk up even though they weren't busy.

Come on guys, $4.50 a drink, you need to give me what I order

I think this is by far the happiest Starbucks I've ever been to! I've stopped in here a few times in the last few months and Everytime I am greeted with a huge smile, some funny chit chat and the last time I even heard some singing! If you have the time to stop in for coffee... Do it! It'll make your day!

The coffee was good but the staff was downright horrible! They made fun of customers as soon as the customer had walked out of the store, they sat there on their cell phones while I was waiting to order, and while I was trying to give me order I was ignored and had to repeat my order twice because some person had to show another person a thing on their phone. 
To top it off my husband went to ask where the bathroom was but because the place was old English style he decided to ask in semi old English (old English but understandable) and those obnoxious children waited until he was gone in the rest room before literally making fun of him. The guy with the blond hair (sort of white black almost Mohawk sort of thing) was the rudest of the bunch though. 
We will not be going back ever!
No point in mobile ordering when you wait over  20 minutes anyway. This place has been a total mess for a few months in the morning. C'mon people.

Simply put, it's the kind of speed and service you'd expect from a suburban Starbucks. The product is exactly the same as at any other of their gazillion locations. But what sets them apart is friendly faces and a better execution than your average Big Bean experience. 

I popped in twice over the course of a couple days while visiting some relatives in the area. The place was clean, the wait during the day was short and the staff seemed to have a handle on what they were doing. Even with cars lined up outside, it felt like they were giving the walk-in customers priority. It's always annoying when you walk into an empty Starbucks only to wait forever for a drink because there are a couple cars idling in the drive-thru. 

 I especially liked the latte they made me. Way to get the most out of that foam!

As happy as I am to finally have a Starbucks drive thru after 3 days in a row of getting my drink made wrong I'll be going back to the Fry's Starbucks. Drinks are to expensive to have them wrong and the staff a little rude when you ask them to please get it right today. Too bad but it will save me money in the long run!

This location seems to be very popular. Every time I try to run through the drive-thru it's always very full. Glad I have the Starbuck's app and generally order ahead so my drink is waiting for me. I'm usually on my way home to Phoenix, need caffeine for the 2 1/2 hour drive and want to get in and out quickly. 

My orders have always been correct and when I've ordered ahead it's always been ready and waiting form. It's a spacious newer location with indoor and outdoor seating although as of this writing the indoor seating is closed due to COVID.

Can't ask for much more than that.

What do you get with this Starbucks on Vista? You may have guessed it: a typical Starbucks experience. Which is not to say it's a bad thing. It's just not as fresh, local or unique as other options for coffee houses in Boise. 

What I like is this: prompt, friendly staff, plenty of windows with great light, cleanliness and decent wi-fi connection for those squat and work folks out there. 

It's one of the newer Starbucks in the area, so you get fresher amenities. If your a PSL fanatic, this may be your best bet for Starbucks on the bench.

Tried to use my birthday reward here and was told the system was down and it was impossible to do. Then my iced lemon loaf was more like ice-cold lemon loaf. Otherwise, no problems!
Update: Starbucks customer service credited me for the full amount. Thanks! That said, I should add that the staff at this location  refused to warm up the lemon loaf, saying the melting icing would start a fire in the microwave.
I ordered a steamed milk for my child with vanilla. $3.56? Really?  Won't be back for a while. Don't appreciate being taken advantage of for the sake of a Starbucks cup.

This location is right by my house but I'll be driving to the next location from now on. I'm getting sick and went to order my favorite sicky drink, a medicine ball. I get the drink and tell the attendant that it's missing the correct tea and she very rudely explained that they changed the drink and this is how it is now. I asked why it wasn't mentioned that it changed and she was really rude, shrugged her shoulders and just asked if i wanted it or not. . . I didn't realize you could just change drink components and not tell anybody.

I went in tonight to get one of my favorite drinks to have after a long day.   I asked for a London Fog.  Easy drink.   Earl Grey tea, vanilla, foamed milk.   What I got wasn't even a good cup of tea.  I don't know what the hell it was other than a waste of money.   Will never go back there again.

I usually order through mobile order, but I never have any issues. Baristas are always quick and that makes my mornings great! I wish this Starbucks had a drive thru, but they make do without one. The inside is smaller than some other locations but they do have several outdoor tables.
Love Starbucks, love their coffee. But crystal was extremely rude at the cash register today. I hope I never come here again if she's working. Definitely needs to be trained on customer service.

Terrible service! The guy taking orders in the drive through is absolutely no help at all. I asked for help with ordering a specific drink and instead trying to help he said " I have no idea what you're talking about" so I ordered my usual and asked for extra light ice and he said "you mean light ice" but I order this drink almost every day and not one worker has said it was wrong. He must hate his job.

First time at the new Starbuck's on Hampton. I don't even remember what they tore down to build this at this point. It's been a long 18 months, hasn't it? About two years ago I was addicted to the Starbucks Bacon & Gruyère Egg Bites.  On my way to work this morning I remembered there was a brand new Starbucks on Hampton and I decided I needed a quick bite. The lot is plenty big and there is room for the cars in the drive-thru to stretch around the building. This is a key. A lot of the new locations are too small of the amount of cars the drive-thru attracts. Service was friendly and speedy and bonus, there was no one in the parking lot trying to wash my car for money or collect money for children in the name of Jesus like there is at the Grand Ave store. My Egg Bites were delicious! I'll be back!

I should start this off by saying that the barista who made my drink was very nice, efficient and my drink was just as expected. The state of the shop, however, was absolutely unacceptable. After I ordered my drink and paid I realized that the front counter had a thin layer of dust over it (and all the retail cups), the cream/sugar counter was disgusting; there was dried, spilled coffee everywhere (it looked like it hadn't been wiped all day), they were out of almost everything, and the garbage cans were completely full and trash was spilling over on the counters. There were also smashed pastries in multiple places on the floor. I feel bad for the barista because she clearly didn't have time to address any of it and there didn't appear to be anyone else working.
First of all, I only drink Starbucks coffee. Second, yes, service is a little slow, not still ok, I don't see many reasons for getting so upset as other reviewers.

This Starbucks has the biggest interior I've seen and it is always busy! I usually get the vanilla iced latte - multiple times they've accidentally used the vanilla syrup for frapuccinos as it's been too thick and grainy to mix into the drink.

The drive-thru is pretty quick and efficient and the employees are always friendly!
Covid should not stop the use of restrooms. You still have customers coming into the store regardless. If you are cleaning like your are supposed to it shouldn't be a problem.

The ladies working on 11/6 when it opened today were amazing, patient, and so friendly! I know they were hit with a lot of people when they opened but they still made our drinks delicious and hot, and handled customer questions and swaps so professionally. It's hard enough to work during this pandemic, and having red cup day only adds to the pressure. I wish I caught their names because they were great! Happy holidays, ladies!

My girls and I stopped here for a little birthday celebration for my daughter. We got cake pops and chia lattes. We stopped in just 15 minutes before they closed and the barista was great. I didn't get his name, but he was the 2020 ASU graduate. Probably the best customer service I've had at a Starbucks. Thank you for great service! The cake pops & lattes were great too!

I have stopped at this Starbucks quite a few times and every single time I can't believe how rude everyone is. The first few times I tried to give them some slack thinking maybe someone is having a bad day, but no, every single time every employee I encounter is just rude. No one smiles or greets you, they act like you're bothering them when you simply ask for a straw that they forgot to give you in the first place. I don't get it!
When is the Starbucks the other day in Tucson unhalton is unhalting they were very nthey were very nice they told me about the drinks for the summer time Pink Drink very different.

Kleine Starbucks Filiale. Nichts Besonderes, leider gibt es nur 2 bequeme Sessel, ansonsten nur harte Holzstühle.
Die Bedienung war nett (was bei Starbucks nicht immer der Fall ist). Die Getränke schmeckten wie überall, was die Sache sehr angenehm macht. Man weiß, was man bekommt.
Meine Gattin hatte Strawberry Smoothie, die Kids den "Very Berry Hibiscus" und ich, wie fast immer, den Venti Latte.
Ich habe bei allen probiert :-), alles war sehr lecker.

I frequently stop here and appreciate their social distancing and sanitation standards.  I never order anything extra fancy, in winter it is a hot caramel macchiato with only one shot of espresso and this summer it has been the iced peach green tea.  Their staff are nice but inconsistent about getting my orders correct.  Today I ordered a peach green iced tea on my way out of town, (I went thru the drive-they), and there was no peach flavoring.  I tried calling several times to the number on the website but no response. Frustrating!

Seriously sbux 15 mins to make a shaken ice tea with three baristas working come on!! Even at all the business sbuxs I go to they pump out drinks like machines this one here is just sad. As much as I love sbux this is one of them I definitely will not come back to!!
Thank goodness for Starbucks!!! This one is efficient and the folks were really nice.

A lovely place to kill some time and listen to high character folk music, perfect for our situation yesterday, waiting for a flight.  A nice little Starbucks, well equipped with power and wifi, a little slice o heaven.

Probably the slowest Starbucks ever . I've had to wait 10 mins for a iced americano with no one else in line .  Drinks never taste good anyways,  I'll just an extra 10 mins to the Starbucks on Westshore or Dale Mabry if I really want Starbucks .
My iced caramel macchiato has no caramel?  How is that possible?  Cafe seems to be doing well- lots of customers and friendly team. We just need caramel in the caramel drinks!

Convenient Starbucks on campus, they offer pretty much everything every other Starbucks offers.

The line gets super long in the mornings before students get their day going. There's a big lounge area with some booths, and many tables. 

It gets pretty loud some times, if you like to study at a quiet area, this is not the Starbucks you should come.

Worst. Coffee shop. EVER. 10 minute wait for a tall red-eye. Are you kidding me?! I eventually took the coffee and told the barista to forget the add shot because I had somewhere to be and couldn't wait any longer.

This location is inside the Super Target off of N. Dale Mabry in Lutz.  We were shopping around Target and wanted to end our visit with some Starbucks goodness however I was immediately let down when I tried to order my Guava Green Tea Lemonade and the barista told me that they were completely out of Green Tea!! How does this happen....ugh.  

Well, I just hung my head low and sulked by ordering a warm chocolate croissant....that immediately changed my mood :)  If you've not had their chocolate croissant, I do recommend it...but you have to get it warmed.  The chocolate just oozes out and is so delicious....making you crave one yet :)  You're welcome!!

Decent coffee and friendly staff compared to other Starbucks outlets.   The interior of this place is cleanest than other.    Parking here is plentiful but the spaces are very narrow.   The perimeter only has high top tables and the center tables are all low.  Enter at the traffic light if you are coming from Wilmington or else you'll have to make a u-turn further up the road.

This is the cutest Starbucks I've ever been in. Excellent service, nice restrooms, friendly, cozy--feels like you're in the mountains as it's part of the Cheshire grounds. I'm not a fan of Starbucks as I prefer to support local businesses, but if you need a coffee before the local shops open, this one is cute.

So so SO happy this location has reopened for drive thru during the pandemic. 

The staff here are fabulous and David is a social media whiz keeping everyone up to date with their hours and what was going on when they were closed. 

2 thumbs way up!

Having to work during the pandemic is stressful but being able to enjoy a treat like a matcha green tea latte makes the day a little easier.  

Mar props to David for keeping the community in the loop and for constantly doing updates like how we can do ride up on our bikes and do mobile orders for those of us trying to find ways to treat our kidlets who miss normal.  For now, Starbucks bicycle Frappuccino dates are a great way to celebrate special days like birthdays!!! 

Thank you Starbucks

My go to Starbucks! They've never let me down here. They are always so friendly and my drink is always right. They're also so nice to my dog when they give her pup cups (free little whipped cream dishes). The parking lot can be a little annoying getting in and out of, and sometimes it can be super busy which can cause somewhat slow service. Most of the time I'm in and out quickly but there have definitely been times I've had to wait longer than I like. However, it's my closest Starbucks and I'm always happy with my drink so I'll keep coming back!
Pulled up to buy and was told I had order online. "ain't got time for that!"  This store is off my list.

For a place that sells coffee which runs through most, they're so stingy about their bathrooms! It's on the news all the time and manifests localmly as well. We'd had coffee on the patio and someone was still inside though they'd locked the door. We had to use the restroom so badly, and everything had been closed. 

Now, I know they had closed, but I've worked at retail, restaurants, etc before and worked the late shift. And have been put in the same situation multiple times. Sometimes you get caught and have to go! There is nothing wrong with that. Yeah  it's late, yeah I want to go home or not deal with people, but to deny someone the basic urge to use the restroom has always been such a disgusting act to me. Especially two women at night. We ended up having to go to a dirty bathroom across the street, where we couldn't even stay long because the parking lot was littered with creeps saying disgusting things to us. 

Honestly, it's not hard to be a decent human being and the things you do reflects on the establishment you work for. I dont know who the guy inside was, but he ignored our knocks, and rolled his eyes at us when I finally knocked hard enough for him to have to acknowledge us. 

Starbucks really needs to get their restroom situation together I've never seen an establishment with employees that act this way about the bathroom.

Mary, was working the window and I was so surprised how much i enjoyed our small talk and her chipper personality. I left your store wanting to share her positivity and smile. Thank you Mary for the smile on my face. Drink was yummy too !!!!

Stopped in Harrah's Casino for quick a gamble and popped in Starbucks for a quick drink. Staff very nice and patient as my mom could not remember her order and kept switching it up on the guy. I got a sugar cookie which was pretty good for a packaged item. Mom and Cheryl got teas and a caramel Frappuccino which were to their liking. I got a vente Aqua Polar Freeze which is the best drinks they make :-) a.k.a. Iced water.

Nice on the surface
Dirty stinky one restroom only
Don't use it!!!!!!!!!
Starbucks is usually very nice and always clean but not this one

Filthy dirty. We were there at 9 am and it was disgustingly dirty! Then I had to go to the bathroom, BIG mistake!! As I walked in something green dropped from the ceiling and stained my shirt. At first I thought it was bird poop but then I realized it was the air freshener. Then I couldn't turn on the light. I told the lady at the counter that the lights didn't work and she rudely said, "I know"! You should surely take the time to do to the other Starbucks on state st.

the baristas are super sweet here, but i waited 35 minutes in the drive through line one day and was almost late to work. the line is almost always into the street and it's just a big mess. i would say that on most days it's at least a 15-20 minute wait for the drive through. i will mobile order from now on because i don't have time to sit and wait usually. they always do a great job on the drinks though and that is why i keep going back!

So they close at 5 pm on a Friday! There isn't another coffee location near by. I waited in line and apparently they had told the people before me they were closed but didn't tell me. They assumed I knew because of the people at the front.

This Starbucks makes a great soy hot chocolate. The staff was friendly and professional as well. The closed dining area could use some cleaning. Overall the brand could rethink hair control. It's an industry challenge though.

I had to stop at the Smyrna Starbucks near the hospital before a Saturday meeting I was hosting.  I tried to call ahead but the number on the internet was actually to a fax machine or something so I had to just stroll in.

First off, I was surprised at how many people were at Starbucks at 7AM on a Saturday.  Why are those people not in bed sleeping off a hangover like I wished I was doing?  Luckily it wasn't so packed that I had to wait to be waited on.  I asked the boys behind the counter if they had large containers for about 30 people and they recommended two of the to-go containers.  How long will it take?  They said 10-15 minutes and they would have it ready to go.

I would say it was even less time than that actually!  They brewed two big to-go jugs of coffee and filled up a bag with cups, sugar, fake sugar, stirrers, etc.  They then filled up a large cup with creamer and put a stopper in it so it wouldn't leak.  Then the cute boy behind the counter helped me carry it all out to my car.  Now that's service!!  Great job Starbucks!!
