AMAZING service... today my car broke down right before the window... i stopped the line for about 10 minutes and had to get pushed to the side.. THEY Paid for my drinks and BROUGHT them to me SUPER SWEEET STAFF. Thank you for making my day when it went south reaaaaal quick.

So tired of their uncooked bacon in their sandwiches! I ask them to cook it separately, they over cooked the entire sandwich and somehow the bacon is still uncooked and so rubbery it looks raw. Bread was so heard I chipped a tooth! And the bacon was still not cooked! Common sense! Take the top bread off the sandwich and put it through the cooker. It will not cook with the bread on top! Chipped a tooth because they thought if they over cooked the sandwich it would cook the bacon. I am pissed!

I went inside this store and wanted to look at the menu (it wasn't my first time at Starbucks but I wanted to get something new). The lady working with an attitude was like why are you standing there that is only for pick up orders. I was like I want to look at the menu. She was like you need to stand here. I was about to start walking and she was like you are walking the wrong way. Mind you there was literally no one else in the store and it was my first time in that location. I understand we are in a pandemic but we are supposed to work together not against each other. I walked out without getting anything. The same thing happened with other family members that walked into that store. Will no be going back nor recommending it
Not the nicest bunch of employees! Part of the reason we will not go back! Have been to many branches & each get a drink daily so we are very disappointed with their customer service!
If you love a perfect ice coffee, go see Brooke! She makes the best one that I have ever had..

Do not bother to come to this Starbucks (Elcon Mall) in the evenings! It says they are open till 10:30, so you come in, order your coffee at 9:45, then you get kicked out at 9:55 because the lobby closes at 10. So you transfer to the outside table, get comfortable only to be kicked out again at 10:05 because they have to lock the chairs! And if you do not like it, talk to a manager who is nowhere near!

I have been out of Tucson for a while and this used to be MY Starbucks. It used to be a customer friendly place where the crew did not have to defend their actions by shifting responsibility to some distant managers. 

It's OK if Starbuck's new preferred way of dealing with customers is through a faceless drive thru. But why not kindly spell that out on the Google search hours-of-operation page? So that those of us who prefer getting a personal touch with our $5-coffee-flavored-water would know it's an unfriendly place to stop by during an evening walk.

Very nice people :))))))))):):):):)
Super cool 
Very good 
Nice nice nice de niceeee
Better than dunkin in every eay

By far the worst Starbucks I've ever visited. There are 6 ppl working behind the counter. An hour wait. Line drop out. Time from ordering to getting my stuff 22 minutes. Everyone's orders messed up so they are just putting out fires constantly. The person taking orders cannot remember anything you just said and also can't make change. Hard to imagine how much money they are losing every minute.

I've been debating on how many stars I wanted to give this Starbucks but I settled with 3 stars, since you can't do halves. This Starbucks has its really good moments and also really bad. First, the bad, about 50% of the time they give us the incorrect order, or give us someone else's order. This happens often during the drive through, I'm not sure if they are such in a rush they are sloppy about their work. However the good, the staff is always super friendly and happy to replace the items, however it becomes super annoying if you have to keep going back to get a replacement.
Out of lemonade wtf. Not welcoming to customers. I definitely would recommend a different location

This starbucks is the worst ever.  I always order  from here yet almost every time I order food they say "we actually don't have that today"  they should always have food ready to go to a customer and not run out its just bad business. And to add their lines are always long I cant believe this location sometimes.
They are friendly and my drink is always how I want it. I'm here most days early in the morning and the wait is never too long.
Unfriendly staff. Asked a question when I ordered. No response. Said thank you, no response. No eye contact. The most hostile Starbucks I've ever visited.

The women working here were pretty catty. They were arguing about time off when I came in so I waited a few minutes and left without even being served. I get that it's a holiday coming up, and I truly felt sorry for the younger brunette woman who was visually upset about something to do with hours it seemed. However, this experience was really unprofessional and could have been handled by the woman who seemed to be the manager a lot better. Is there no place she could have taken people to talk to away from customers? I left just feeling sad for everyone working here.

This was a good Starbucks before it became a drive-through in a new location. 
They are  always be out of everything. During Smore's season I ordered Smore's and they gave it to me. With no whipped cream. And I was like where's the whipped cream? And they were like, "oh we are out of marshmallow." What?? Then it's not a s'mores Now is it??! It's chocolate and vanilla.
Was there a few days ago they are out of pumpkin sauce. Was there yesterday and they're out of cold brew. Was there today, they're out of cold brew. They also love to hand you cups that have coffee dripping down the sides of them. So,  always check before you take the cup to make sure it's clean.

What makes this Starbucks location the best are the employees! If you need people to start your day off great (ignore the old reviews) go here! Staff are really friendly and you can watch them bustle around and communicate to get the drinks together as fast as they can! Drinks turn out either exactly right or any wrong component, and automatically they'll offer to fix your drink on the spot / remake it / give you a refund and your drink for free. I'm really too young to be doing yelp reviews like this but I'll make a quick list of pros and cons! 

Pros
- Friendly staff (you can tell they love their jobs!) they'll hold conversation and tell jokes and things while you're waiting on an order
- Baristas are always more than happy to remake any drink mishaps! 
- Large variety of options for food, snacks, and merch
- Cafe area is kept really clean
- Big seating area (couch/tables/individual seats/bar)
- Bathrooms are always clean and stocked!
- Free wifi :)
- Outdoor patio / seating area
- Even though it's busy, wait times are usually really short
- (biased) the baristas are cute 
- If you're a regular, it's great seeing the newbie baristas quickly become well off on their own!
- Really, really, really biased but their recently new baristas are really cute

Cons
- I'd say it's the busiest Starbucks in the area, but they've got plenty of staff during rush hours to keep things quick!
- Sometimes the music can be loud and distracting, but the baristas are always happy to apologize, and go back and lower the volume for you!
- Lots of new trainee workers sometimes but they move quickly as well

I think Starbucks and I need to part company. This latest visit to this location is just one of many lackluster experiences that I've had with this chain.
Arrived here on a busy Saturday. Staff seemed in chaos. Cash register person wasn't sure how to input my gift card for my purchase. Bought coffee beans and asked that they be ground for a French press. This information was relayed to another worker who was multi-tasking at the window and counter.  Asked the cash register person if she told him "French press" and she nodded.  Took me a while to get my order. Got home and the coffee was ground to a fine powder. Tried using it in my French press and ended up with sludge in the bottom of my cup.
Called and spoke with Tristan and shared the situation. His response: "well, bring it back, I'm 99% sure we'll redo your order."  I said that if I'm making a return trip, I needed to be 100% sure that they would make a correction. He said, "I'm not sure who will be here so I can't say if they will agree to redo it."  Whaaaat?  You screw up my order, make me drive back to your store, and then you are "not sure" you can correct YOUR mistake?? This seems to be the way customer service is going and Starbucks is no different.  They are getting too big and too busy and service is suffering. At least train your staff to deal with customers properly. 
I've purchased all my coffee at Starbucks since you opened your doors but there are just too many places that offer quality coffee products....so I think that I'll toddle off and try one of your competitors.
Went here at 8:30 on a Friday night and the doors were locked with staff inside even though posted hours are until 9:00. Guess they don't want my business.

Couldn't get my order corrected.  The music was loud and the "barista" Amanda didn't seem to hear my order correct the first time and so I repeated it.

When I received my order I could see it was incorrect but the other "baristas" are so quick to drop off the order and turn around giving no attention to make sure customer orders are received (there was a pile of other food bags) and correct.  

My first time in this town for a meeting with little time beforehand.

 Also first time posting a review about Starbucks because usually service is stellar.

This is one place to go if you enjoy being treated like crap. They all act like you are bothering them and then expect to be tipped. The coffee is a hit or miss, no in between.  If you can, I would suggest you go to the coffee shop across the street.

Omfg this place is horrendous.  Dirty and disgusting. Forget about it, it'll take 30 mins to get the wrong drink.
Better to wait in the long line instead. 
Corporate - please come check this place out.

Basic Starbucks. I only came to get some quick work done while I was back in my hometown. It's a little bit on the small side and adjacent to a Chase Bank. There isn't too much seating for work and very few comfortable seating options. Because it's located in the parkside mall plaza you get less of an working environment and teenagers or pre-teens coming in throughout the day. Avoid if you're looking for a quieter location. Spent a few hours here and the bathroom, which was a bit dirty, was nevre cleaned. They could definitely check up on that more often. Otherwise baristas are nice and fixed my drink when they messed up my order.

Just left Starbucks and they had 0 food items. No boxes, no sandwiches. They need to improve the inventory management here, causing missed sales and upset customers.

Hopefully management reviews this and can make changes.

I decided to started my wonderful Happy birthday day 12/22/19 with hir cup of Chai Tea and choose Starbucks on Vista. Later on I will regret about that. The line was it's okay 4 cars in front of me, then barista trying to hard to understand my question, if birthday person able to have discount, maybe it's silly but it's always pleasant. After 4 unsuccessful attempts she still dont understand the question. The stupid misunderstanding can't be longer so I take my order,she decided to clarify that question face to face and told that it's not longer happy birthday free stuff there. Such unpleasant morning at Starbucks on Vista. I call my friend and she told me,let's go to Dutch Bros and u will understand how ppl really can treat you that day. Well Dutch Bros make my day with free delishous treat and more important with outstanding customer services on my Happy birthday day.

It's been a while since I've had coffee since I quit recently but I decided to stop in this Starbucks right before a final exam I had scheduled . I am used to going to Starbucks and being disappointed from the coffee tasting burnt or with the lack of coffee taste ,however, I was pleasantly delighted when I ordered my iced white chocolate mocha. It was just right , and you could taste the taste of fresh espresso, so I appreciate that . If I'm in the St.Pete area will definitely only come to this location. Also, the customer service was great and very friendly.

usually amazing coffee, but the oatmeal I ordered today wasn't made properly and they seemed to use cold milk instead of steamed milk (which is how it comes)- completely ruining the taste.  i didn't have time to go back so it kind of ruined my breakfast before work.. not sure what happened here- make sure you guys are steaming the milk!!

So disappointed in this Starbucks. I thought it would be so cool as it I a drive thru on a major
Highway but the bathroom was very dirty and the garbage cans were overflowing with garbage. The bathroom also was extremely dirty. I don't like it when these places are filthy

I'm adding a good review because it is a safe place to have a coffee to go during COVID-19. 
They had clear signs, floor paths and the you can open the door with your foot so you don't have to touch the handle. 
Otherwise it was a regular Starbucks experience

The black guy who makes my drinks every morning who writes the cute messages on the cups deserves a gold star and a raise. I don't usually write about specific employees but it being corporate he probably doesn't get enough recognition for the little kindness he puts in customers mornings
Best place ever! Everyone so friendly and sweet and the community is just amazing. Positive vibes all over from customers and baristas. Definitely a place you need to be at!

Although having the convenience of the drive thru is nice and most of the staff is friendly, drinks aren't made right. Modifications aren't given attention and get completely forgotten. I can completely understand missing something once in a while but it's happened a handful of times. Most of the staff is friendly and more than willing to help but I have had an issue with an older woman who I've seen working the drive thru window a few times, has had an attitude the last 3 times I've seen her there.

A Starbucks is a ........ what it is.
I have my fav which is quite limited and I get the same every time.
Service is fast and friendly.
Easy in and easy out.

New location same service. 

Why are there 5 people working and 3 people in line yet not one hello, please hang tight?   They all look busy but there is 1 person at the drive through?

I really hoped the service would get better, last time i visited in a Sunday around 3 pm they were out of Pike coffee! Out of coffee at Starbucks, so the girl filled my cup 1/2 way and handed it to me yet wanted to charge me full amount.  I was like.... mmmmm no, are you okay?  I asked if they could make more coffee she said no.  

I really am so frustrated with this place. 


I'll go to the local Panera and not aggravate myself.

It could not be any worse, a full store, and no masks on customers.  Starbucks has a responsibility to require masks on customers.  The company could easily lose in store pickup and outdoor seating if things continue "as is" in this country.  Shame on you Starbucks.

I still refer to this location as the new Starbucks. More room. Two long rectangular tables that seat at least eight each and plenty of smaller tables. Very good service and consistent high quality products. Drive thru as well.

I'm seeing others who have the same horrible service with the most rude employees ever in any place I've ever been to in my life. Deliberately overcharging too? No. not anymore. I guess its time to give up the urge to ever go to this place again. I won't do it. Enough of their horrible treatment toward a customer. They really don't care. A simple order like iced coffee gets so complicated because their "baristas" are impossible to deal with. This is not a real Starbucks and their employees show that its not.

There are a lot of Starbucks locations around me. I try to avoid this one because every time I have gone, my order isn't up to par. If I am paying $6 for a drink, I expect it to be perfect. I ordered my usual (strawberry lemonade refresher with no berries and 3 scoops of matcha) from this Starbucks yesterday and it was gross. They didn't shake it up so my matcha was just sitting at the bottom and they put berries in at first and i'm guessing pulled them out because there were random little chunks floating in it. Disappointed. Won't be going back to this location which is unfortunate.

Honestly this Starbucks is so awesome. Confused at the bad reviews because I've never had issues. Frankly, the drive thru service has been nothing but great. The person taking my order is always so sweet.  My cappuccinos are always perfect.

This place has to be the worst Starbucks ever. The bad thing is I lived near this one (and went here for over 2 years by lack of choice). I usually would try to drive out of the way to another Starbucks just to get a good, accurately made coffee. I enjoy many different coffees skinny mocha, pumpkin spice lattes, gingerbread lattes, iced skinny caramel macchiatos, etc. At least 1 out of every 4 coffees (and that is being generous) was messed up somehow. I absolutely love the ambience of this particular Starbucks too. Sad really.

Horrible service. Ordered on the app and came to find my order missing. No apologies whatsoever. In fact, the barista acted like it was my fault that my order wasn't there. Not sure what's up with your attitude. But if you were going to treat people this way, then maybe you don't belong here in the first place.

This location almost NEVER has nitro, does not matter what time of day, and they are often out of ingredients. I can never get what I want from this Starbucks location! I have stopped attempting to order from this location all together! Additionally the service is pretty terrible for Starbucks standards, especially since they moved locations from the northwest corner of First and Oracle. It seems that they did not prepare for more volume at the new location despite being a bigger store and adding a drive through. It usually takes at least 10 minutes if you order in person or through the drive through no matter the time of day, their printer always jams so even if you mobile order, your chances of actually getting your order are a crap shoot, and on the rare occasion they actually have nitro, my order is never right. Very disappointing seeing as I am paying almost $7 for a cup of coffee!

Love this SB location! I've always come here because all staffs are always friendly, my orders are 99% of the time correct. If they miss something, it's usually something as small as spelling my name incorrectly. Not a big deal! 


Drive-thru is usually a longer wait and the area is slightly tight when coming in so I recommend just getting down and making an order inside.

I get my daily coffee from here, and I'm glad that I do. The staff is very personable and welcoming, and their store is very decked out for holidays and special occasions. Like any other Starbucks, they're busy, but they handle rushes and large crowds very well (especially under the pressure of cranky middle aged men and women throwing a fuss over coffee beans). If you're in the area and interested, get some coffee here!
Best Frappuccino I've been served in a long time.  Not diluted, all toppings added.  The guy at the drive through window was also very nice as we waited a little for my drink to be made.

The 5th Street and Boonslick St. Charles location has incredible service with personable baristas! From the initial greet at the drive through (Brian) and the engaging conversation while at the window (Hope) this location is exceptional!

Although the coffee is terrific, the two stars is solely for parking options.  I feel Starbucks needs to place this store in a different location where parking easier accessible for their consumers. There is no reason in 2019 I need to wait over ten minutes to park my vehicle to purchase a regular coffee.  I will do my best not to visit here again.

Manager Lindi is a rockstar!  I left my purse in the store and Lindi went out of her way to secure it and found me on Facebook. She also realized we own a business and called to speak with my husband. Way to go on a job well done. Thank you!

This was one of the best drive thru Starbucks locations that I've been to in a long time.

It's perplexing that there were so many negative reviews that I read when I was in search of a local to me Starbucks. Not seeing any other locations to try, I put on a brave face and attempted to go through the drive-thru.  

Admittedly, it's a rather odd configuration due to space limitations, but truly if that's really the only issue, it should not be an issue. I found the customer service to be five star plus, and who could ask for more?!

I was greeted through the speaker box by Brittany, who by all accounts was not only super sweet, but very helpful when I asked a couple of questions about a new drink that I wanted to try.

When I arrived at the window and flashed my phone app, Brittany smiled, asked me how my day was going, and if there was anything else that I would like to add to my order. She did an excellent job of promoting products which I've never had happened to me at a window before. I really appreciated it. She even went out of her way to show me a couple of the new tumblers that they had just received. Then to top it off, she very politely reminded me that if I wanted to use any of my stars for my purchase I could do so.

Great customer service! My drink was totally on point! And when I'm back in the area, this absolutely will be my go to place.
Ridiculously slow. Bunch of employees standing around doing nothing. Should have their Starbucks card revoked.

I am done. Usually I don't complain because I understand that things happen and sometimes things dont work. But I have been to this location WAY too many times to forgive this any longer. The staff is terrible, never kind, always rude. But that not even the bad part because we get it, who would want to work there. The biggest complaint I have is them not KNOWING how to work here. They NEVER have cold brew, and if you order it on the app they tell you good fucking luck getting your money back. This has happened about 5 times. FIVE! After today I called corporate and told them how dumb this location is and I sincerely hope they shut it down. If you can't do a fucking coffee job...I'm sorry but you need help. And then they have the audacity to be rude about how they are out of fucking everything. I know how cold brew works boo, it takes almost 24 hours to make, so if you fuck up, you're out for the day. That shouldn't be happening EVERY FUCKING DAY.

I have always had a great experience ordering here. The employees are so kind and give me compliments every time I come in or drive by. There was one time that my card declined because someone hacked into my banking account and an employee paid for my drink. Great coffee and great service. :)

I have been going to this Starbucks for years on the weekends. I have always looked forward to getting a delicious, hot, brewed coffee with a shot of espresso. However for the last few months it has been terrible. The coffee is now often old, bitter and cold. The barista seems unskilled and unfamiliar with common coffee making techniques. It's very disappointing that I no longer look forward to my weekend cup of Starbucks coffee.
Really....not sure if it's one or two people working..6:15 am and must be 60 people waiting...ridiculous

If you want one of the umpteen different sugary drinks Starbucks sells you can order one here and get it as quick as you can at any Starbucks but if you want a black coffee pour over I suggest you drop your order off at breakfast and pick it up at lunch because it's gonna take a while; a long long while...By the time you pick it up it will be a cold brew

My go-to corner Starbucks. There's not much street parking but I use the Starbucks app to place my mobile order and get there early enough to park and run in for my order. 

This team almost always has my order ready on time with 90% accuracy. Good odds considering how often I go! 

Always fantastic customer service. I don't think I could be so chipper that early in the morning.

Clean, friendly, quaint, and fast service. I arrived at 6:30 pm and nobody was in line. Just as I was paying for my medium green tea lemonade with a dash of apple juice & whipped cream, my order was ready! As a kid at heart, I love whipped cream and always ask for it with any drink and they kindly accommodate me! I can't wait to go back, but wish the drinks weren't so expensive. :'( Excellent customer service!

Nice ambience and good music. Courteous staff!  However not kept clean:-( The pick up counter has spilled coffee and hasn't been cleaned in the 15 minutes I've been here. And it's not busy. In fact, my latte was placed on the spill for me to pick up. The floor is littered with discarded straw holders. Tables are not clean and cleared. 
Let's take a little pride in where we work.

I love good customer service!! I stood in line and watched as Rita patiently assisted the customer in front of me. As the transaction was concluding, Rita preemptively smiled at me in acknowledgement. 

Once it was my turn to place my order, she continued to smile and engage with me, making the experience pleasant and memorable. 

More importantly, as I stand here now, waiting for my order, I watch Rita provide the same, wonderful level of service to everyone in her line! 

THANK YOU RITA. JOB WELL DONE!

Genuinely the slowest Starbucks in the entire I-95 corridor. The cars idling in the drive-thru line are responsible for more emissions than the Popeye's fryers in the main rest stop plaza and the Teslas charging in the parking lot COMBINED. While waiting for my wife to get her iced coffee with soy milk, I was able to download the Yelp app, create an account, and write this entire review on my phone. But it's Starbucks, so when you do finally get your order it will be exactly the same as every other Starbucks everywhere. And if you're lucky, that traffic jam on 95 will have dissipated.
Picked me up a double shot, had great service, one of the finer Starbucks I've visited to date ;) #stardizzle

This is the most inefficient Starbucks I've been to. Employees are usually chatting with each other instead of making drinks.  I think they get away with it because there isn't a competitor close by (besides Dunkin Donuts! Which I endorse!)

Love this location! Super clean and the staff is always wonderful. You're always greeted with a smile and the service is very prompt! Conveniently located next to Target so I can shop and stop in for breakfast, lunch or a quick drink & treat! They keep everything well stocked. Though the Target has a kiosk for Starbucks inside, I always prefer to come here! It's also next to an urgent care and when you have an unexpected visit with one of the kids late in the day it's a nice place to stop and get a pick me up to get through the wait times.
Drinks have been consistently getting worse!  This time we paid $7 for a cup of ice. Not sure if this is all stores; but stay away from the one in Oro Valley on Oracle.

This starbucks is deceptive.
First of all, parking is horrendous - there's just not enough of it.
Secondly there is hardly any seating - a few bar stools and a few tiny tables for 2.
Thirdly, the retail area - used also to barricade off the drink line area - is too bulky and wide.

This location is deceptive in size - it looks like a big store from the outside but is cramped and crowded inside.

Meanwhile the usual Fourbucks menu items prevail.
Service was fine.

It's just too small.

Stopped in for some passion tango tea. This is a newer location and a rather larger Starbucks however the parking can be limited and challenging. Drive through today was lined out onto the side road. No inside seating is available due to covid however they do have some tables outdoors under their shaded area available for sitting and enjoying your beverage and food. Masks required and the inside of the store is opened for placing your order. 

They do have order online and pickup available and special parking available for you if you opt for this. Keep in mind that you have to either go in or drive through to pickup your online order. Staff is friendly and the drinks tasted great.

Great location in the 1920 Commons buildings on PENN's campus. Staff is quick and efficient. 

KEEP IN MIND: you CAN use your Starbucks card to make a purchase  however you CANNOT use your freebies or any coupons at this location.
Drive through Starbucks newly located on Hampton. Staff was friendly. First time I've ever been asked what my name was while ordering. Friendliest service I have received at any Starbucks!

What can be said about Starbucks that hasn't already been said, right?  Well, this particular location is super busy.  The music is incredibly loud... and the patrons talk even louder so they can hear each other.  Between the two, I don't think I could ever take any important calls here.

So why four stars, you ask?  This is a fairly large Starbucks location with a great open layout.  A cozy fireplace is located in the middle of the room and plenty of seating located throughout.  Outlets are located every few feet along the wall.  The baristas here make damn good drinks.  And despite all that noise, I have found that my productivity is at a very high level with all the energy around.

This Starbucks is conveniently located on my work to work. I prefer placing a mobile order and picking it up in the store, which save time during the morning rush. My drink is always ready on the counter. Great location and friendly service!

I really love this location but the coffee has been pretty terrible lately.  Just not mixed right. I order the same thing every single day and the coffee has just been so unbeliebly strong. Very disappointing.

I come here regularly before work. I enjoy the setting, even when it gets busy. But, the staff is inconsistent. There's one girl that works on Saturday mornings at 5, and every time, she makes me feel like I should leave. (REALLY short hair...) Doesn't say "good morning" or "hi" back... won't even look at me. 

I tried to engage in conversation once with her, "how are you?" and she scolded me for expecting her to put the honey in my coffee. No one ever told me, until that morning, that it was wrong and against health code. I certainly don't mind putting it in myself, but the honey packets aren't out for customers. She went off about how wrong it was to put the barista in that position... I just smiled and said that I would be happy to do it. However, all other baristas put the honey in. In fact, when I asked to put it in myself because of what she said, they laughed and said she's wrong. 

I would give this place 5 stars, except for the way she affects the environment.

This Starbucks staff had to be one of the most unorganized and unprofessional staffs that I've ever seen. There was no type of communication amongst themselves or to customers walking in. It is unfortunate because the products we bought were actually well-made. That is not a saving factor for terrible customer service though. I will try to give this place another assessment a little later on to see if they fix this issue.

My drink tasted great. The workers were nice and were working hard. My issues are not with this particular SBucks, but all of them. The evolution of their app orders has caused me to lose interest in visiting their stores. There must be a better system, and SBucks is a wise enough company to be able to figure out that it is not working. 

I walked in and right up to the counter to order. There was no one in line. I noticed 5 or 6 people standing around, waiting for their order to be made. I ordered my drink and walked over to near where they were all standing and began waiting. As we are waiting, workers are calling names. "Bob!" No one moves. "Karen!" Nothing. "Molly!" Still no one. There are now 9 or 10 drinks sitting on the counter that people have ordered but haven't picked up. Finally, names of people get called that were actually standing there the whole time. One guy ordered regular coffee and probably waited 15 minutes. Finally, I get my drink after waiting between 20-25 minutes. 

I don't get why people would order a hot coffee on the app and let it sit there for 15 minutes or more and let it get cold before you pick it up. I also don't understand why people would order an iced coffee, or a Frappuccino and let it sit there and melt before strolling in to pick it up. 

Starbucks, please fix this issue. Your workers are doing their best, following your broken system, but it's terrible.
Every time I go in here, the baristas are friendly & my drink is always correct. What more can you ask from a Starbucks?

Love this Starbucks!!  Yes, the parking situation sucks but there is ample seating inside and the staff is top notch.  We travel cross country regularly and have been to literally hundreds of stores.  This one is consistently clean and the baristas are consistently friendly.  Plus they make dang good drinks very quickly (even with a line out the door)!  The manager, Lindi has taken time to chat with us, while still moving faster than we've ever seen anyone move at a Starbucks.  Keep it up - 5 stars y'all!!

Tremendously slow service. 5-6 people behind the counter all more focused on tasks than customers. Served the wrong size drink, did not call any names when they put drinks up. Might work if they were proper size and you were checking. Dismissive attitude when mentioned to them.

The workers where very rude. I bit my tongue and still said thank you after being ignored for 5 minutes so the employees could talk about there personal lifes. The coffee is pretty much the same at all the Starbucks so the worker's make the experienced and they suck at this one.

This is one of my favorite locations to stop by! I ordered my drink and paid for it and drove away all within maybe 2 minutes today. No complaints with the fast and friendly service, and my cold brew with sweet cream tasted perfect. This location is a little further from me but worth the extra few minutes drive.

Not sure if there is room for a zero star... If so, Count me in on this location of Starbucks. The guy working here has the worst customer service skills I've ever seen. They have music blaring in the background and he was asking me questions which I couldn't even hear then gave me a crazy stink eye look. I asked if I could use the restroom and he said they didn't have any restrooms due to the virus. I guess they don't go to the bathroom all day either. If you have a choice, please choose another Starbucks or any other fast food restaurant choice for that matter.

You would think that the baristas would be a little less loud and obnoxious when the majority of customers are trying to work. They were all young men so boisterous that I could not concentrate and had to leave. The Christmas music playing during the first week of November didn't help either. Sorry, but this was a very annoying experience.

The drive thru at this location is the worst. If you don't have minimum of 10-20 mins to wait for your order go to another Starbucks. Today 2 cars ahead of me. No idea what first in line got but one in front of me only ordered 1 hot beverage.  Took 9 mins from order until I drove off with my 1 refresher. 1 beverage 9 mins. Ridiculous. Worst Starbucks drive thru in Sherwood Park. Maybe it needs more employees I donno. The staff is always pleasant & order is always accurate so I'd like to give more stars. But the drive thru is sooooo slow.

Awful experience here today. Employees are rude and inconsiderate, and lost their minds over my toddler not wearing a mask while sipping his drink as we waited over 20 minutes for my order (that they forgot). You guys, he isn't old enough for a mask PERIOD.
Don't waste your time here!

Yes, it's cool to hate Starbucks and I wish The Market was still here but these things happen. I came here for a meeting and was pretty nervous to see what happened to one of my favorite spots to get work done/have meetings and, of course, eat lunch. I have to say, I was pleasantly surprised. 

They changed a lot but it's still very cozy, has plenty of unique spots to sit, and even has a standing desk/table. This is by far the coolest Starbucks I've ever been to in St. Louis. It has a swanky/homey east-coast ambiance. You can even cozy up against the fireplace! 

While I'm going to miss The Market's food and tea, I'm glad to see the space is still a great spot to get some work done.
This is literally the slowest Starbucks I have ever been too. It's horrible. On top of it being slow, 50% of the time I get the wrong drink, the other 50% of the time they are out of something.
This Starbucks location is located within the Harrahs Casino. It's a normal Starbucks, so it's great!

Lazy workers 
4 people waiting on drinks, 2 workers just looking around doing nothing, one guy working hard. What about actually working guys ??

What is happening with this particular Starbucks? I have frequented this location for almost 25 years, yet I have found the service to have really declined over the last 6 months. The employees are friendly enough, but my goodness the service is slow. If you have a half hour or more to wait for a cup of coffee then I'm sure this review won't resonate to you, but for those that are pressed for time and on a schedule, I would suggest another Starbucks. Hopefully they will become a bit more efficient sooner than later.
Products generally extremely consistent. Staff is friendly and service is not too slow. Enjoy that they have places to sit as well.

Giving this place 5 stars. I can't believe people are really bitching about the "quality control of breakfast sandwiches."  "My sandwich didn't have enough turkey bacon." Get over yourself. It's Starbucks. This place isn't competing for a Michelin Star. The people are nice, the service is prompt, the goods are as expected, and the place is clean. Don't give it one star because your Pumpkin Spice Latte had too much foam on the top. Bitch please. Ya'll giving Starbucks bad reviews on Yelp like ya'll won't be back tomorrow ordering the same basic AF items. Smh.

If you need to be in and out quick don't go to this location. The drive through line situation is a cluster fuck. Today it took 30+ mins from the time I got in line to get my drink. I waited several minutes for them to take my order with only 2-3 people in front of me, and another 5 mins at the window just to get my drink. While at the window an employee mentioned they had several hot drinks waiting and if anyone needed help which they turned down. She seemed to me the only one who cared because the other employees seemed to be more focusing on chatting than doing their job. Once I got my drink the line- that when I pulled up to order my drink only had me still waiting to order- now had a line out to the main road. Very very very disappointing l.

This was my first time coming to this Starbucks. The staff was very friendly and greeted me upon opening the door. They were very efficient and knowledgeable. They help me make a decision on The Venti caramel Macchiato.  I almost forgot to ask for with cream but they were on top of things. Overall great service!

I stopped at Starbucks this morning at 5am before work and ordered a grande skinny caramel machiatto and a venti pumpkin cream cold brew. I started drinking the caramel machiatto and it was horrible. There was no caramel in the coffee at all. It basically tasted like watered down coffee with milk. Then when I got to work I tried the Pumpkin cream cold brew and it was just as bad, it was bitter and tasted watery. It's so disappointing when you spend $5 or more on a cup of coffee and it it so bad. I had to throw them out. It's so strange to me, if they follow recipes, why are coffees sometimes amazing and sometimes this bad.

Not a very good Starbucks.  The service is okay but they are alway out of the Dark Roast.  I went there one day and they were had just started brewing.  They started pouring the coffee while it was still brewing.  I'm not a barista but I don't think you should do that.  The next person in line will get a subpar brew.  If you have time, go a few miles up Eagle Road and you'll find a much better store.

Idk. Any joy I get from visiting this Starbucks diminishes at the annoying light that takes forever wish I could chose a different way out, but not so.  The store is nice and quick, an friendly, everything I enjoy about the brand, its just I don't want to visit because of the hassle to get out of there.

What this intersection needs is a pretty round about. That way everyone keeps moving and doesn't have to wait forever at that damn light.

Maybe I'll go again and try to get out another way. Ughhh. Im getting old !!!
This is a smaller intimate location. Not a lot of space for groups of people.  They still carry all the tasty snacks and the employees are really nice.  Its really a shame they don't stay open 24rs.

This review is ALL of the Starbucks from Santa Barbara to Canyon Country California! I called them all and not one of them has/had BROWN SUGAR SHAKEN ESPRESSO!!! It's really ridiculous how this drink is advertised yet I've been looking for it for over a week. I don't know who the buyers are for Starbucks but someone really screwed up here. Very very disappointing.

Hands down, the coziest, most uniquely styled Starbucks location in St. Louis? The ultimate opposite of the new, drive-thru focused locations that have been opening?

This is a corporate coffeehouse that encourages some lingering.

The interior is richly themed: an olde English pub, complete with wood-burning hearth, dark timbers and beautiful, stained glass windows. Old meets new when it comes to amenities though. Mobile ordering is available and quick, the menu and music are the same as at most other stores, and there's WiFi.

In addition to the two indoor spaces, with plenty of patio tables in front of the shop (there's not much of a view per se, but the option is nice), I really cannot think of a better Starbucks for a meet-up.

Went by here yesterday and they were completely out of everything caramel! How disappointing. Who does the ordering here??

Went there for a business meeting. Order both snacks and drinks, everything was going well at first, we stayed in the corner and minded our own business until we realized that the AC was lowered so low that it was unbearable to stay one more minute in. And given that there are not outside chairs, I couldn't help but think this was a tactic to make us leave given that we were there only black customers in the store at that time.

I beg of you, do not visit this Starbucks. 

This review is for the Starbucks INSIDE the Welcome Center. 

Where to begin...this was the worst Starbucks experience I have ever had. And based on the reactions of the other customers, it is safe to say it is one of the worst experiences most of them have ever had. 

1) The service was bad. The employees were uninterested in their job, and they either didn't speak to the customers or were rude when they did. 

2) The service was BAD. We ordered our beverage at exactly 2:26 PM (per the time stamp in the Starbucks app) and received two drinks (caramel lattes) 23 minutes later. There were about 5 people ahead of us. There appeared to be 4 employees working, but only ever two out front, working the bar and register. The person working the bar had absolutely no sense of urgency, working at an extremely slow pace. Occasionally, all four would be there, and they would just stop working altogether. 

3) The service was REALLY BAD. A person who got their drinks before us had to complain a lot to have what she wanted made. They appear to have made, without her having okayed it, one of the refreshers (it appeared to be a Pink Drink, or one of the others with coconut milk) with almond milk. She, understandably, did not enjoy that. More on this later. 

4) The drinks were absolutely DISGUSTING. We ordered two drinks:  a grande non-fat caramel latte and a grande coconut milk latte. The employee rang it up, we paid, and then we waited 23 minutes. I have never had such repulsive beverages from Starbucks. They made the coconut milk latte with almond milk, not having informed me they would be doing so, and based on the experience with the other customer mentioned above, it appears they just make all coconut milk beverages with almond milk WITHOUT informing the customers. Additionally, the coconut milk latte had no flavor. It tasted like sweet water, and had absolutely no flavor of coffee. Upon taking the lid off, the liquid was TRANSLUCENT, looking like slightly brown-tinted water. It was as if they had just put a pump of classic syrup in the cup then filled it with warm water. Furthermore, the non-fat caramel latte was also disgusting. It had also a vague sweetness, but seemingly no caramel flavor, and the coffee flavor was EXTREMELY strong, almost as if they had put all 4 shots of espresso (the 2 for each latte) into this one beverage. 

5) They weren't adhering to health standards. Everything was a mess. Trash was piling up out of the trashcans and onto the counter. There were milks out everywhere. The milks were so warm, the ice in iced beverages they were making would almost instantaneously melt. 

This location MUST BE shut down. It is an absolute disgrace to the Starbucks brand.

This is Starbucks. Chain. The only difference is that service is always on point, everything is fine right (if you ask for a non dairy milk, you get non dairy milk). My go to is Medicine Ball, kid gets pink drink, and wife gets coffee. Use Starbucks rewards to stretch your dollar.

This is our go to spot in New Tampa for coffee!  Always friendly baristas and the drinks come out how we like them. Some Starbucks have baristas who don't really care, but these guys do!  They've even re-made a drink for my son. He forgot to say no coffee in his frapp and they re-made for him even though it wasn't their error.

Good luck moving around in this clutter claustrophobia nightmare! If one wants to chillax at their local starbucks and do what one does while chillaxing at a Starbucks, this location is NOT THE LOCATION FOR YOU! If you wanna be crammed in a little space around a ton of rude people and hapless employees doing their best to serve said rude people, then this IS THE LOCATION FOR YOU! I choose to do neither, I'm out!
A great crew. Friendly and outgoing. And always moving fast to keep your wait time down.

Not all Starbucks are built the same, especially when they are located inside of an airport terminal.

Yeah, it's a Starbucks, and yes, everything you probably expect from a Starbucks is inside of here, but the service is not that. The service here is beyond slow and really just lackluster. That being said, the person at the register was friendly, but just had no concept of urgency.

I only ordered a travel mug, not even a drink so I can't imagine how long the people waited for their drinks, but I know one thing: the line kept growing and growing and the hovering around the counter waiting for their beverages and food got deeper and deeper and no one on the other side of the counter seemed to care.

I can't justify paying for an airport Starbucks at this location especially when it really isn't Starbucks quality. Just get a water from the Hudson News or CNN store and wait until you get home to grab a venti.

A big shout out to the crew at Houghton and Broadway! They are always so friendly and they make the most consistent drinks of any walk in or drive up I've been to anywhere. It means a lot to know I'm never going to have to return my drink because it doesn't taste right. Thanks everyone.

Imani's actions this morning really deserve a 5 star review. I ordered to the wrong store and she quickly corrected the issue! Had my drinks in less than 5 minutes. Thank you so much for making the customer experience so wonderful.
If you can't make my drink just say that so I can order something else. However, don't make it seem like I'm making your job harder
Honestly one of the worse Starbucks I visited with pretty bad attitude from employees.

I went in today for a pick me up in the afternoon. I got an I sweet tea no water added so very dark. After the ice melted and I was towards the bottom...I noticed the huge black dead fly. My cup had a lid and I was inside my home. I'll never visit Starbucks again.

En route to New York, the BoltBus driver gave us a 15-minute bathroom and food break so it behooved me to make use of this given how cramped and uncomfortable the bus was.

The Starbucks is a medium-size kiosk without any walls, much similar to those in the center of malls under escalators, elevators, and stairwells.

It must get busy because there was a dedicated line delineated with a rope like at an airport. There was no one in line around 1:30 pm on a Friday. The cashier was friendly, in a good mood, and took my order and spelled my name right! It's really the little things in life.

The barista was matter-of-fact and stoic and called out my name and handed me the drink, a venti white chocolate mocha. The flavors were consistently Starbucks-awesome and it was served hot.

Definitely pop in here for a coffee or one of their delectable pastries....

Huge Starbucks with lots of seating and more outlets than I have ever seen. They even have a separate room with a long table for studying. It's right next to Vanderbilt University, so I assume the student traffic here must be epic in season. The baristas are pleasant and pour a good cup. They've got a Clover machine too, if you're interested in the thicker, richer taste of that brewing method.
 
Overall, a great place to drink good coffee and work.

These guys love me and I love them too! :-) I come here every weekend. This place is always packed (because it's right across the street from a college). 

Feel free to chat with the staff when it's chill. They're all really cool!

I also recommend the lemon loaf... Holy cow... So good!

Ordered a latte with whip cream 2 times from here ... half the cup is whip cream the other liquid. When I addressed it the a-hole barista was very condescending. The managers aren't any better. This is one Starbucks location to NEVER VISIT!!!

The coffee was really good, the grande americano really hot the spot. The sausage egg and cheese breakfast sandwich was a little rubbery, not the best quality there. The crew behind the bar was on the job and earned their tip.

This is my favorite Starbucks by far. The staff are exceptional. they know customers by name and drink. They are happy to help you find a drink and make recommendations. They are very knowledgeable. They go above and beyond. They are always kind, upbeat and gracious. They care about their customers. The store itself is always clean and open. Never had a problem here, EVER. I can't explain enough just how amazing this location is.

This startbucks location was very understaffed, I mobile ordered 15 minutes ahead and still had to wait another 15 when I arrived. The staff was nice, but seemed very overwhelmed and stressed- seems like a management issue. They also have a drive through so I just don't think they can handle it all.
Great service and friendly staff! Always welcoming, and my order is always perfect! Cant wait till they reopen for in store seating.
Wish i could give a 0 star manager is a racist and rude to customers I definitely think this place should be re-managed

This location is in easy walking distance from my work. Its the perfect distance to go get myself a treat before/after work or on my lunch. Typically busy in the mornings, but depending on when I've gone during the day, service has been quick. 
I love sitting in front of the fireplace during the cold months (love that it even has a fireplace). Probably my preferred location out of the three or four i can easily get to. Again, i like to walk down (up?), especially because the parking lot, which it shares with other businesses, is always rather crowded and scares me.

I understand thing happen in life but you're at a job and you shouldn't let it affect you. Anyways I ended up leaving and not getting anything cause he made me feel like me ordering a drink would be a bother to him. Hope his day gets better. If he's there just walk away he clearly doesn't want to be there. This gives Starbucks a bad name since usually employees are super nice.

The staff is very friendly. The store is always clean and even though it may be in a horrible location due to parking, etc. that's not their fault. 
5 out of 5 for me.
Lots of tables to sit and work. Cool and airy. Great place to meet for informal interviews or coffee chats. Staff are friendly.

The baristas here are all really friendly and my drink always comes out just how I want it! The parking lot is a nightmare though. Forget about turning left into there, I sit through 4 lights sometimes and once you're in there, it's so tiny! But the Starbucks itself is a solid one.

Don't be fooled! It *looks* like there's bad parking, but there's a huge lot behind & Starbucks has a handy staircase right up to the lovely back patio! Plenty of seating, nice staff, clean washrooms. It seems like there're no bistro boxes, though. But there are breakfast sandwiches.

Also, if you're like me & always sad that Starbucks no longer has ATT Wifi (& therefore no Nintendo Zone), the FedEx next door has a Nintendo Zone! Perfection!

Wow! Horrible experience. Don't go here unless you want your morning ruined. I went inside bc the drive thru was so long. I waited over 10 minutes for one iced drink, while I watched everyone else inside and the drive thru slide by. And when I said something about it, the worker had the audacity to argue with me and claim it takes 10 minutes to make my drink. No way. I've ordered it plenty of times and it has never, ever taken longer than five at best.  Customer service sucks and they were rude. If every iced drink took 10 minutes, Starbucks would have gone out of business a long time ago!

Updated review.
I've ordered a lot of the past few months and they've really improved with times of orders and accuracy. I typically always mobile order, I've learned to give them at least 10 mins in the mornings and it works out just fine.

If you want to be disappointed every single time you come to a Starbucks, this is the location you'd be looking for. Not only have I gotten into arguments with the baristas here... this location is by far the slowest at making even an iced water. This location is so trash that I literally created a yelp account just so I can talk about how terrible this place is at anything. I'd rather drive 2 miles in a different direction just to avoid getting a headache. I also filed numerous complaints about this location and never received a resolution. A joke to put it all in simpler terms.
Friendly associates but crazy understaffed (maybe that's everywhere these days?) waited in line 20 minutes for tall coffee on a Sunday at 1 pm...

I was feeling light headed while waiting more than 5 mins for my drink. There was a chair next to a table. I sat down, the women working there told me  not to sit. I told her I already ordered I'm just waiting for my drink. She rolled her eyes and said NO SEATING! 

Never ever coming back again!

Wow. The drive thru was crazy long and there's very little parking. I parked and walked in can can't believe those people wait in the drive thru that long. I think it was a bank a long time ago. Shared with Jimmy John's.

Thks Starbucks location is keeping great safety measurements and protocol. The staff, generally, wear masks along with the customers who are suggested to wearing it. There is hand sanitizer around for use. I mainly order using their mobile app, which I've seen it to be pretty efficient. 

During peak times, orders might delayed a bit but I haven't waited for more then say 5-7 times for my order. I think it's fairly quick. Thank you to Starbucks and the staff at this location.
I'll agree with the previous reviewer that the morning staff are great. Hopefully this place will get all shifts up to speed. It is a great, cozy location.

I know what you're thinking ... "She's reviewing a Starbucks? Everybody knows what Starbucks is like!" Well, you don't know MY Starbucks, do ya? Yeah, that's right ... so shaddup! (please keep reading my reviews)

My Starbucks has more than just the slightly overpriced coffee, and the long counter at the window where you can sit and watch people go by, trying to creep them out with your staring. What, you don't do that?

My Starbucks has three (that's right, THREE) plushy seats in this little semi-private corner, and, get this -- a singing Starbucks girl. I call her that because I don't know her name. She's a very happy person, my singing Starbucks girl. And she doesn't care that everyone can hear her, she just sings whatever. Some ppl may find it annoying, but I like it ... it kind of just blends in with their music.

The coffee-shop also arranges their tables in a way so that not all the tables are smooshed together. I like that too, more privacy for each table. You can write or read whatever without feeling someone is peeking over your shoulder. Now if only they would lower their prices a bit, I could give them a full 5-star rating ... just kidding!

Power tip:  HUGE line out the door at the C terminal location at 5am. Toughed it out because I knew we had time. Took 30 minutes to get to the counter. Another 3 minutes to get the drinks. Another agonizing 3 minutes to get the food.  The turkey bacon sandwich was ok. The chocolate cookie crumble Frappuccino (without the crumble) was delicious but probably wasn't too healthy.  :)

After dropping off the food to the family, still saw the line out the door about 20 minutes later but definitely better than I was there.
Nice Starbucks. Locations within stores and airports are always noisier. Service was good. Friendly barista.  My chai was perfect. Plentiful table space to fit snd relax before or after shopping.

Overall I've had very good experiences with this Starbucks. My only complaint is that they only have small tables and a window bar with stools. I wish they had some comfy chairs, and bigger tables that barely fit 2 laptops. But I realize that it's a small Starbucks and I assume they're doing the best with what they have!

Can't go wrong! Some locations are better than others but that's simply based off of customer service along with the experience of each employee and making the drinks to your liking. For the most part, if it doesn't taste right they will make it right. I just wish most locations stayed open later.

Who hasn't been to Starbucks before? Well the coffee and food quality is just what I expected, so that's good. (I got a tall dark roast with a splash of cream and a spinach feta wrap.) This review is more so about the location, which is super cute and adjacent a local Inn. Check out the great exterior! Tons of seating both inside and outside. My only reason for 4/5 stars was mask wearing. Only 1 of the 3 employees was wearing one and I was the only customer wearing one. Missouri rates are still on the rise y'all! Masks preferred for this gal.

Literally out of everything I went through 8 different drink options I like before I found one they actually had the stuff to make. They have egg bites on the menu but the lady says "we don't sell those" very snarky. Extremely disappointing stop! Will never stop here again.

I always Love my coffee in the morning especially the dark roast. 
The store is always busy and seems the Crew needs some Team Building exercises or a better manager. Disarray. Out of cream, counter dirty and the outside of the store is not very inviting either.
