I ordered the 1/2 beignets from door dash. I received biscuits with no powdered sugar or marmalade with no flavor.

I have been to this Starbucks several time. But each time they just give me a so so impression. The reason behind is every time I am there the trash can is full, the table is dirty, the floor is not up to the standard. Seem like is a management problem. They need to tidy the store. I always seen a lot of them employees but did not see they actually care or clean the store. 

The shaken tea with pineapple black tea is refreshing. It is better and cheaper than their coffee. They do have other drink like infusion lemonade and chai tea latte. They also has strawberry acai. I thinks they are branch out from just coffee.

Looks like people have had mixed results here.  Unfortunately, there isn't a lot of parking, but there is another plaza parking nearby.  You aren't supposed to park there, but if it's not filled up, why not?  ;)

When I went in, they were quick and fastidious with my order.  One of the male employees was able to understand another female customer's order and why the white mocha wasn't coming out properly.  He had added it in, but the taste wasn't there.  One of their machine(s) was taking the flavor away.  So they made another one for the customer.  He had to add a lot more white mocha and it made the customer real happy.  I could even sense she was a regular at this particular Starbucks.  

Better to order online beforehand if you can due to covid.
The worst Starbucks I've ever been to. The employees are suck. One of the employees were sleeping I think and the drive through so slow they don't deserve a stare

I have never heard my wife complain about a Starbucks location until yesterday when we visited this one. They didn't do anything right. One of the coffees tasted burnt, and hers was not hot. Not to mention they were out of napkins and the place was generally dirty. We will not soon be going back to this location.

This is a large, cozy location with ample variety of seating. There is a fireplace with cozy armchairs, perfect for a casual coffee date or chat. There are long shared tables that are perfectly suitable for both groups or individuals. If you'd like some more privacy to focus on your work, single tables are available, as are booths. There is also a enclave-type space for maximum privacy, partially separated from the rest of the room by a frosted wall. 

In the several hours I was at my table completing a ridiculous amount of work, this location became very busy and rather noisy. If you don't mind the bustle, then you'll be fine (particularly if you choose a table by the window and away from the masses, as I did). I ordered a fine cup of Earl Grey tea, and a rather delicious almond croissant.
This is the slowest Starbucks on the planet. I went into the store not to the drive thru. Took close to 30 mins to get through small line and get my coffee. Unreal.
This is just you average Starbucks. When you go to a Starbucks always expect happy employees and AMAZING coffee.

While stopping by the Delaware Welcome Center for lunch, I saw that there wasn't much of a line so I decided to get my Strawberry Acai Refresher and Cranberry Bliss Bar. This kiosk sells the perfect tea maker, tins with loose leaf tea, and mugs. They don't have Christmas merchandise yet. I didn't like how their rewards system was down again.

Food and drink taste like any other Starbucks. The service is friendly and efficient. However, this place is filthy. Tables have crumbs and trash on them. The floor is the same. The condiment counter looked like it hadn't been touched some opening. (It was only 9am.) I'll be honest, I wasn't going to use the restroom with the store front looking as unkept as it did.

Not impressed with this Starbucks at all. The person at the register was rude and so was the person making my drink. They work in customer service and can't even be nice (which is part of your job description) won't be back to this Starbucks

This Starbucks is huge. Given that it's near a university, this makes sense. There are plenty of bar-height chairs & tables, as well as some big chairs to lounge. The entrance can be tricky though because there really is only one way in (hard to see). There's a parking lot behind the Starbucks, and as I was getting ready to leave, I wondered if I was supposed to pay for parking. Vanderbilt police made a run-through the parking lot, which is good if you're worried about security, as there was a wheelchaired homeless man greeting people.

My short, toffee nut mocha was made correctly. Add a butter croissant and a bottle of water, and my bill was a little less than $8 using the Starbucks gold card. I had to reload my card, so this took slightly longer, and my drink was given to me at the cash register during the transaction. The four stars are for speediness and a correctly-made custom drink. I would definitely return here.
Longest wait. I don't recommend at all. Been waiting in line for well over a half an hour. With no movement.

The supervisor was very rude I ordered a small butterscotch latte with almond milk and the past 30 times I've bought it they did not charge1 dollar to substitute almond milk for milk I asked nicely and explained and she was very sarcastic and rude
Always a great place to go. The Starbucks near Saint Joseph's hospital particularly was pleasant for a drink & a snack.

I like Starbucks for the most part. It just doesn't make sense to pay $6 for a drink and they can't even fill the cup up all the way... there's no way they look at it and know it looks right. Wish they had employees that knew what they were doing. I haven't even taken a sip and this is what it looks like! Hate to complain and I normally don't, but paying $6 for this is kind of frustrating.
This location rarely has decaf available as a selection. I have tried to order decaf espresso drinks on several occasions. They are either out or are "cleaning the machine".
I didn't realize that this was downtown Wilmington's only Starbucks.   Picked up two cappuccinos.   Great service although one was a bit drier than the other.

Earns a star for betting the only corporate owned Starbucks in City limits and thus earn and use rewards.
Earns a star for its cleanliness. 
Earns a star for staff being friendly.

Remove a star for closing at 5 PM weekdays.

Remove a star for BEING CLOSED ON WEEKENDS DESPITE BEING ONLY CORPORATE STARBUCKS OF THE CITY AND NEAR THREE HOTELS!!

Ever since the riots/looting of 2020 and pandemic closures, in Central downtown we have brew ha ha market st closed fully while the brew ha ha across from this sbux closes at 1 pm weekdays and all day weekends. The non corporate Starbucks is 7-2 weekdays only. IM coffee weekdays only (but HIGHLY recommend) 

But joke is on them because the former Loma Cafe REOPENED to now be Milk & Honey Coffee and food and art and oh yeah IS OPEN on WEEKENDS.

But still, Milk & Honey is on 4th which means those in the teens have a long walk.

Wilmington, the dying city.
(Also, never visit pine street unless you want to be shot)

Great company. Great product as well. This new location popped up out of nowhere like all others; and I'M LOVING IT. 

The Starbucks brand has definitely made a name for itself and I'm here for it. 

Tasty treats. Coffee concoctions. Caramel delights are all over the place. 

Recently, doppios have become a favorite of mine; straight IV coffee, 3 SHOTS please and it suits me JUST FINE. 

This location is in the heart of the CBD and is perfect, less one little detail, LITTLE TO NO STREET PARKING; be careful of the meter-maids/parking enforcement officers. Since parking is a thing for me, I simply order ahead and ba-da-bing, ba-da-bang; im in like Flynn.

Even despite the parking issue, the beauty of it is, it's great for those who live and work in the area because of the corner location of O'KEEFE & GIROD. 

See ya there!!!!
Hands down the best!!! Love walking in there!! Today they went above and beyond and even left this sweet message which made my day!!!

I like my coffee black,hot, and served with a smile.
I am never disappointed by this Starbucks.  It doesn't matter if it's morning, noon, or night.
They are always friendly and they always do their best to make you feel at home.  

I know Starbucks is big on customer service anyhow but I just wanted to give a bigger shout-out to this particular place.   You really know the true nature of a business, and its employees, when you go there often.  These guys are super.  Especially love the always upbeat Christian and Cristina show (I hope I'm spelling their names correctly) in the mornings.  They are a great happy start to any day--and of course a superb cup of coffee!

Usually Starbucks are pretty much the same in most ways. This one though is my favorite because they had "giving rocks" that were painted in different ways for mental health awareness ! I love love love the idea and it made me smile.  As someone who struggles with it myself it's nice to see little things of positivity , advocacy, and happiness. They also had well placed social distancing spots and cleanliness.
Thank you for my free breakfast. They saw I was a healthcare worker and gave me the coffee and my food.

Notttt greattttt. Snickerdoodle hot chocolate was maybe one of the worst drinks I have ever had. Very lukewarm and pretty much undrinkable.

Don't be led on by the display case. Their real deserts are hidden and they rarely have any in stock. Asked for a chocolate chip cookie, nope. Sugar, nope. Chocolate chip cookie dough cake pop... you guessed it: no. All of which looked available in the display case. 

Pretty upsetting experience and I ended up having to eat a cheese stick. 

2 star!
Horrible customer service. Super rude workers. Do not care for anyone but themselves.
Drinks are always excellent here... Just don't ever go inside if you're in a hurry. It takes ages to get a single drink if you walk in versus going through the drive thru.
Love their iced coffees! Their drinks are pretty consistent & quick despite very long lines. Keep it up Sam Ridley Starbucks!

I had a free drink clearly stated in the Starbucks app which they can see and acknowledged was there but their Internet at the store was so poor the app didn't work. At every other Starbucks they've simply given me the promotional drink. Here they refused my clearly available drink because the app wasn't functioning properly. Bad customer service. There's plenty of good Starbucks nearby, go to any other store

I came in the drive through and ordered a drink with almond milk, when I got it, it didn't have almond milk. So instead of holding up the drive through I came inside and tried to get a new one. The lady at the register charged me again! I came in with the drink in my hand & even asked her if she needed it back as proof that I actually got one. 15 total dollars for 1 drink put a damper on my very anticipated holiday drink.  Disappointed.
The Pupaccino is what keeps me coming back. The whip cream is a solid 10/10 for me -Sage

Not bad. One of the barista was talking to friends instead of making coffee at the right time. No biggie but maybe keep in mind that you're doing coffee and drinks for people not chit chatting. (I don't mind the chit chat but please do that when there are no customers or something). 

Price is good. Not bad. Good drinks though!

Ordered a venti matcha green tea with almond milk... i get this everyday. It came very dark so i Asked why so dark she said its made right... i dis not like she remade and it was same but definitely not made like i always get it... weird...

Terrible service inside
 They waited on everybody but me then they told me all we have to make more coffee were out I sat there for 10 minutes very frustrating

No matter what time of day I come into this location, the staff is always friendly and helpful. It's a small location, so the line gets long quickly in the morning, but the staff moves SO fast to get orders and people out the door. Always appreciate the kind, comprehensive service. Proud to call this my neighborhood shop! Easily the best Starbucks in the area, it's always clean and the baristas proudly make my complicated/annoying order.

It's a average Starbucks but Shanon is a god damn delight to be served by. Home girl was friendly, fast, and she even laughed at my stupid jokes. My wife says this location's apple macchiatos are always on point as well. 

10/10 would shamelessly drink liquid diabetes here again.

I always go to this Starbucks before work and love the drive through option and the sleek look. However; getting in and out of there is insane!! Gulf to bay is one of the busiest highways, & without having a light, it makes it far more difficult. I hope the move works out for them, but I will not be going to this one before work anymore.

Alex and jade were not just baristas for me. They were my friends too. We used to talk about hats, yoga and what not. 
I haven't found anyone that knows my coffee better than asked did. I loved the music too and very often would just work from the cafe itself.

Thanks guys.

Nearly every time I've gotten drinks here, they've been made wrong. I've had my drinks made with sugar free syrup instead of regular, 300 stars used instead of 150 (meaning, they took double the amount of stars they should've for a single redemption) and other drinks just generally poorly made--the newest brown sugar espresso drink which comes with 2 shakes of cinnamon was full of it to the point of a texture like chalk. I've never had to email customer support about anything, but I've made several complaints about this store in order to get my stars back and refunds for drinks that will literally make me sick because of errors they've made. Unfortunately, this is the only Starbucks within 5 miles--but at this point, I'll make my coffee at home or make the drive out for baristas who are better trained to standard.
Consistently the slowest Starbucks around. I watched 3 people back out of the drive through today because of no one moving.

Most Starbucks are the same however the folks at this location are VERY nice. 

Generally the store is clean and so are the bathrooms. 

This is for sure one of the better Starbucks locations in Nashville. 

I am always amazed by the number of people on their laptops at almost every Starbucks store go into. Every coffee shop for that matter. LOL

I rarely write reviews, but the customer service I received from Katherine today at the drive thru was the best I've received in a very long time. It took a little longer than usual to make a drink I had ordered, but she was so kind and friendly I didn't mind the wait.

This Starbucks location inside the Greenwood Target had some very friendly Baristas working yesterday. Through the Target app; Target has been offering 20% off drinks. I took advantage of that discount several times before the coupon expires. They were unfortunately out of my favorite breakfast sandwiches; however that is something I encounter frequently at many Starbucks locations. The Barista made a delicious iced Americano Cold Foam Irish Creme for me and I got one of my favorite treats - a brownie.

A rest stop Starbucks is not my favorite option, however, when you have been on the road awhile a hot cup of coffee sounds like heaven.

Because this Starbucks is at a rest stop the lines and crowds can be a bit much.  You will also encounter people that are not used to Starbucks which add to wait times and your frustration level as the barista explains the menu to each person in front of you.  

Barista's are friendly and try their best to be as efficient as possible.  Once ordered my coffee took longer than normal than normal to be made and was not the quality or consistency one expects from Starbucks.  

It meets the need but is far from what you would expect from a traditional Starbucks.  If you need a cup of coffee, this location will fit the bill, nothing more.

I go to this location literally almost everyday. I USUALLY have a good experience. But this morning was a little different. I get something for myself plus something for my kiddo, then sometimes i get something for my mom. Hers is a tall white mocha with soy no whip. When i got home i realized THIS is how full it was. I wouldn't complain if it was flavor or whatever because i used to be a barista so I know stuff happens. But to give out a cup with this much room is sad. Especially when the drink is$5

By far this location is the best on campus. You might think hmmmm arn't all Starbucks the same but I find the staff at this location provide much better customer service. They are friendly and make sure they understand your order when its not your typical on the board type order and they never overcharged me like the other location on Campus does. Thank you for understanding the difference between an "inch" of added almond milk and a misto, and for not scraping off the foam when I ask for extra...your the best :)

All three of these stars are for Nate who helped us at the window today. He was kind, charismatic, and kept great conversation. Great dude! Thanks for helping us start off our anniversary off right. 
Now, as for this location.. I rarely stop, and when i do the service is reliably slow and there is always a HUGE line. Seems like they're either not staffing correctly, managing inefficiently, or they just haven't trained their employees the right way... causing the staff always looks stressed as a mf.
I had high hopes for this location but they really missed the mark on friendliness and cleanliness.

I had to sit down and write this review because after a few times of having my order be wrong in the drive thru, I couldn't not say something.  I get THE easiest order you can get.  Trenta iced green tea, unsweet, no water.  Yes, I could go to the one downtown, but it's hard to park, and I have my little one in the car with me and it's just convenient to drive thru, I don't even mind the consistently long waits at the drive thru (20-25 min) because I don't have to get out of my car with a kid in pj's.  I do however get frustrated with my order being wrong and then still having to go inside to change it.  Today they got the teas right, but gave me Venti, a few days ago, I got one mango iced tea, and one green tea...a few days before that, I had to go inside because they gave me someone's tea from the mobile order, and she got my drive thru order.  I've been to so many super busy Starbucks, and they are hustling to get everyone through in a quick manner, and with the right order, this one seems to need more espresso or something to speed them up and also some drilling on getting the orders right in spite of being busy.  Nothings worse than going through the drive thru and then having to go inside to fix your order.  I am very polite, and don't usually make a big deal about it, but this needs to be handled.

All of the partners (employees) are so kind at this location! Caetlin made me the BEST dirty chai I have ever had! All the baristas are incredibly friendly and wonderful - I 100% recommended this Starbucks location!

I came to this Starbucks with high expectations I've been an oro valley native my whole life and I've not been pleased. I went with my girlfriend and they took 35 minutes to get her drink prepared even when we reminded them that they forgot and that hasn't been the first time they forgot a drink order, as my parents went a week ago and my mom ordered a regular coffee and didn't get it either until she complained that they forgot. The atmosphere lacks a coffee shop vibe as well as it feels like I'm in an auditorium in the open portion towards the left side. So far I prefer the old Starbucks that we had by papa johns and probably won't be coming to that Starbucks again.
This is the Most understaffed Starbucks I've seen compares to the amount of customers.

The drive-thru is more important than the customer right in front of them at this place. I realize it is like this with many restaurants these days, but I'm dropping $20 dollars here on bag of Ethiopian and a small Frappuccino you'd think I'd "mean something" to them. After all these years I still don't submit to their ridiculous and completely pretentious "size" names. You're selling coffee, not Italian sports cars.

If I can give them 0 star, I would do that. I go to starbucks almost everyday for my drinks. I usually go to a different location but I have been this location 4 times because it is close to a PetSmart I go to. My first experience with them was mobile order. My duaghter and I had to wait 45 minutes. Our first drink came out in about 10 minutes. Then we waited for about 35 minutes then finally asked for refund. Second time wasn't that bad. I waited "15" minutes. Third time, about 20 minutes. Fourth time, I waited about 20 minutes. The problem is the cafe wasn't busy. The barista was very slow. Middle of making a drink, he goes to the register and talk to a customer, come back and start a new drink, and talk to another person... Last when I was there, I went over to the bar area and watched him making drinks. I was so shocked. The counter top was so dirty with spilled milk and leftover drinks. Also there were opened milk and cream cartons everywhere. I won't go back to that location. I couldn't drink my order since I saw how they make drinks. Starbucks headquarter should do something for this location.

I tried a new location and will not be back. The cars were wrapped around the building which is not unusual. Then when I walked in it was packed like Black Friday. This too is not unusual for the time period. Still not worried. 

Well, angry customers fussing about missing orders, incomplete orders, and orders taking over 35 minutes to complete when the car line is moving fast and emptying. My order took forever and they made it incorrectly the first time which I was not the only one. The staff was just laughing and joking around. The ones making the drinks were answering the phone which made them stop working. This did not make sense as the cashier for in-house orders was standing their doing nothing as everyone waiting were app orders.
You guys are the best! And reallly held it together well during Covid with that drive thru madness... I come almost every day and rarely is my order ever messed up!! Thank you!

Having spent some time in Ann Arbor Michigan in the 90s, I felt like I had been transported back to the early days there of the "Cool Kids at the Coffee House"

This location is quite spacious with lots of seating. If you are looking for somewhere to hang out and drink coffee this is the place. It IS NOT however the place to pull through for a quit coffee fix, since it is lacking a drive-thru and shares parking with a nearby strip mall.

And where else can you go and find a free copy of the New York Times to read in Nashville?

Consistency. With large chains consistency is the key to success. With Starbucks you know you can walk into a store in Philadelphia and get the same, solid cup of coffee as a store in Ohio. This particular Starbucks is consistent. CONSISTENTLY DISAPPOINTING. Try the Barnes and Noble Starbucks coffee on broad instead.

A busy study place for college students. I ordered grande hot chocolate to go and had to wait a bit with one barista making drinks one taking orders one stocking food items and one on break. iThe stooge was fairly clean but not great. I will choose another place for my stop next time.
Super slow!  You will wait in  line a long to time!  I waited 25 minutes when there was about 8 people ahead of me.

I love starbucks and I come here all the time. I'm a good member for heavens sake. But come on baristas I don't understand how some locations shake up the iced green tea latte and some don't!!!! It sucks when yall don't take the time to shake it up good and I take a straw full of the matcha!! $6 for non shake drink that some locations do and some don't I just wish yall were more consistent with it. Shake it up!! Thank you!

Playing the Starbucks stars game today. Need to keep my gold card status for the little one in our life. The service today was excellent. When I went up to the counter to get a free refill I was asked how I liked the Pineapple Black Tea and I said I didn't. They happily switched my refill to strawberry green tea. Much better.

My wife and our three little ones have been stuck in the minivan since Michigan go visit my parents in Oregon.  We have stopped at many Starbucks and fast food establishments.  All have fallen flat in the hospitality and engagement realm.   Let's talk about the gem of hospitality in a 2 minute experience.  Her name is Kara and I'm sure her face is as lovely as her spirit l, however under a black mask to protect herself and our family.  She asked us how our weekend was and was very polite and understanding how amazing it is to drive 30 hours across the country with 3 little kids.  Sarcasm.  Haha. Who offers water to their patrons on top of the amazing service?!   Kara!   This establishment is more than lucky to have such a dedicated and lovely person working here.

Typically this is our go to Starbucks, but this time unfortunately, they had none of the items I wanted, and I ended leaving empty handed. My experience was made much worse when Courtney was very rude, and unfriendly. This is very disappointing, and I definitely hope changes are made.

This Starbucks is very roomy and has lots of outside seating. Our drinks have been made correctly each time we've visited, however their restrooms are  disgusting. I thought it was maybe an off day when we came the 1st time but they have been bad each time we have come. The floor looks like it never gets washed and there are used paper towels and toilet paper everywhere. It makes me wonder how clean their machines are and the hygiene of the staff.

I left my coffee at home, so I ran through Starbucks and I lead with, "I left my coffee at home and I just want regular coffee that isn't too sweet but still sweet. I just put creamer in my coffee, but Ik ur creamer isnt sweetened like store bought. I just need coffee, pls."

A small pause, barista was like, "I think I have just the thing. Do u like a lighter or darker toffee color?"

"Lighter."

"Ok, pull around. I'll give cream on the side, too! (I pull around). She says something but I don't know what she said. Then she repeats it. "No charge, I'm sorry u left your coffee at home!" 

Best barista ever!

I have always been an avid Starbucks fan and regular customer. This afternoon, I waited in line at the drive-thru for nearly 30 minutes. There were at least 5 cars behind me as well. So when I got to the speaker, the woman discourteously stated, "I'm sorry ma'am, we just took our last customer for the day." She refused to serve me. How easy would it have been for them to communicate to us SOMEHOW that they would not take a single customer upon closing. They could send out a representative to tell us, or put their chalk sign in the drive - ANYTHING besides making us wait and the refusing us service. I mean - I got to the line 30 minutes before closing. It's unjust and Starbucks lost a customer. I have no guarantee that the same thing won't happen again. Starbucks clearly doesn't need me as a customer.

The coffee is good coffee, you know, standard Starbucks coffee. The people there are so nice but they are always SO SHORT. There's no parking and the cars back up in the road to get in because the drive through goes so slow. You get blocked in the parking spots constantly and I have had to wait up to thirty minutes for a coffee I ordered in advance on the app. They REALLY need to move locations and hire more staff!!!

This is primarily the Starbucks that I go to when I drink Starbucks. I have been going to this location for over two years and every time I go I received excellent service. The staff is nice and welcoming and always offers you options if you don't know what you want. The drinks are cool and refreshing and I always get a double shot of espresso over ice or a latte on my way to work for a little pick me up. Look out online for specials during the pandemic I know they offered specials for nurses and Frontline workers. Will be back soon!

Although I don't normally like to review chains, this Starbucks near my work is always on point.

Their staff is very friendly and the drinks come out quickly.  More importantly, they really take the time to get your order right.  If you request customization on a drink, they've always got it right.

The drive through can get a bit backed up but it's worth stopping inside!

Walk in just expecting a good starbucks coffee and find out they are out of almost everything. keep in mind that it was only noon at the point like how are they out of everything?? they were out of grande and venti cups. how do you run out of cups? they didn't offer me any solutions because i wanted a grande and just said the tall is basically the same. i don't understand how they were out of so much and i think they need to work on that. starbucks has a high representation and they do not fulfill it. actually they probably are setting the customers up to buy the trenta because it is more money. ridiculous. coffee was actually really good tho!

Going through drive-through today. The girl on the microphone was very polite and friendly sounding. There was one car ahead of me. The wait was extremely long. I have no idea why. I sat behind the car at the window, and the car behind me stuck for over 10 minutes. When the person came to the window to give the guy in front of me his order, there were two drinks.

There were three girls inside talking, and I could only see one customer. I had to wait about seven minutes for my coffee. I decided to take a picture of the lobby to show there was no one in it, when the manager came up and told me I was not allowed to take pictures. I let her know that I did not take a picture of any people, as well as I would never put someone's picture on Yelp without their permission. She seemed quite distressed, maybe she had a feeling that the review was not going to go well... Who knows? It seems kind of ridiculous to wait in line for nearly 20 minutes for one coffee. So yeah, I'll give this place another shot sometime and see if it's consistent or not but as for now... Might want to avoid this place seeing that the workers prefer to talk over customer service...

We decided to stop and get some coffee on the way to the lake. It's Monday afternoon and we don't normally go to the lake, however the power company is working on the transformers and so we have no power. Kids are going to do their studying at the lake.

There was about 15 cars in line, now that we can't go inside, we have to compensate for long lines in the drive-through. The light went fairly fast. The girl who took our order was polite as usual as well as repeated my order back to me perfectly. That's one thing that's nice about Starbucks, they never make you feel bad for having long more specialized requirements for your coffee. But yes, you do pay for it. One thing that irritates me is the price has gone up since last time I was here. And this time of economic crisis, Starbucks it's not reducing the stress by providing a little discount on their overpriced drinks. They actually have increased. $5.90 for a Vente mocha with caramel. 

My usual order is a Vente mocha, extra hot, no whip cream or foam, add caramel syrup. Today the flavor was good, however it was not extra hot. The line was just too Long for me to go back and have this fixed. So, next time I am reminded to test it before I leave the drive up window.

Pretty quick service for it being very busy on a Friday morning! This location is very large as well, I assume a lot of people do work here!
The staff are very friendly! Especially my California friend in the drive thru. Thank you Starbucks for being so nice and friendly, especially healthcare workers!

DO NOT use mobile order.  Once you paid for the items you are NOT their priority anymore.  I waited nearly 25 min for my order (only 3 drinks) All the drive through and the inside people all got their orders before they worked on mine.  As I said, once they got your money, they don't give a sh*t.  This happened more than once.  Worst service ever!
We waited for over 55 min this morning at 10am and left without our order or our money back. This place sucks!!!!

I love this Starbucks and the staff is amazing. Most of the staff is young and yes they may make a mistake or two but always fix their mistake quickly. Also, all of my drinks and food are always delish!! Love the ice coffee on hot hot Idaho day!!

I was hoping i could change my 4 star rating to a 5 but i have to lower it to a 3. The staff is friendly and its a nice place, but we have seen a pattern of a lack of attention to detail over and over. Today my breakfast order was totally "forgotten" until i asked where it was. And for about the third visit in a row there were no stir sticks until i asked for one.

Every time we come here unless Lisa is our server we have no confidence our order will be correctly filled. We expect more from Starbucks.

Absolutely consistently the SLLOOWWEESSTT Starbucks I patronize. I don't understand why service is so slow here. I also don't understand why I continue to patronize this location other than convenience. After being stuck in drive thru for an unacceptable amount of time this morning, I will rethink this!
The worst customer service EVER. Employees in this store don't seem to take their job seriously at all. Too childish attitude and no work ethics. Never wanna go back there.
Nice location and service was fast specially barista Jinnee lee making sure my drinks are on point and always good. :)

This is the slowest drive through I have ever been through.  The manager obviously has no idea how to do his or her job.

I am a Lean expert who could help them, but I work too much as it is.  They would benefit from a consultant with similar skills.

Stay away unless you want to be trapped in line for half an hour.

Our 10 year old son got in line behind the only customer waiting.  Others lined up and were served before him - despite the fact that they arrived later.  We asked what was going on.  Apparently he should have queued in a different direction.  The "Barista" never said a word.   Terrible service

Pro's:
Great service
Clean
Plenty of outlets
Large table for studying
Familiar faces at Starbucks whenever I'm three 
Their generous with using rewards
Quick drive thru, one girl I had was very cheery - def liked that since she was the first person I saw that day 
No smoking in the outdoor area
Good volume of the music and selection of music, kinda helps drown out conversations

Con's:
Slow internet when it's busy, I've only had trouble a few times
Can get packed sometimes and there is no room to sit, but that's a good thing for Starbucks

This is my favorite Starbucks in town. Great place to congregate with friends and study partners. Never been disappointed with my orders.

I love Starbucks coffee and not all the stores are the same. This location is nice because it does have a drive thru window if you just want to get it on the run. Inside is pretty clean and kept up. Not very big but there are outdoor tables if you want to sit outside. I always ask for my drink extra hot and for some reason this location never has been able to do that for me. The parking lot is not very big and is usually crowded since they  do share it with other businesses. I usually park in the Raleys lot and walk over

This Starbucks seems a bit small compared to a few others I've been to recently, but I don't consider myself a coffee-house person, let alone a Starbucks person, so I may be off the bat here.

The drinks were just fine, prepared pretty quickly at a relatively busy time (most of the tables were filled at least, I used mobile ordering so I didn't wait in line), and the service was friendly. The tables and space seemed pretty clean.
This is a great Starbucks!  Friendly staff and even when they are slammed they get the product to the customer pretty fast.  No complaints here!

First of all, let me just put it out there that I love Starbucks!  I'm originally form Seattle, Washington & a Starbucks girl at heart!

I've been coming to this location for almost a year now and have probably come a good 20 times.

It's a convenient location in Village Landing in the same parking lot as Save On Foods and Shoppers Drug Mart.

Their drive through is efficient and friendly.  The inside of the store is smaller than most Starbucks and for that reason they only get 4 stars.  Sometimes it can be tough to get a seat and it doesn't feel as  cozy and inviting as some of my fave locations.

The staff are super friendly and cheerful even early in the morning!

My heart belongs to Starbucks...

I was running behind this morning and was very happy to see how quickly the drive-thru was moving. Immediately after pulling up, my order was taken by a very pleasant barista. Upon getting to the window I realized that I had forgotten my physical card, but had some money left on a starbucks card. This was not enough to cover the order however. I apologized and asked if the barista could take an item off my order so that I would be able to pay for the full amount. After about a minute she hands me my order and says don't even worry about it, have a good day. I believe her name was Leslie and I just wanted to say thank you Leslie, it made a bad morning into a really good one.

This place is in a shopping area, close to a Walmart and across the road from a Publix.

I don't drink coffee but came here for a hot chocolate on what was a cold morning by Clearwater standards. My hot chocolate was fine.

It is pretty much an average Starbucks, which means the prices are higher than they should be.

The handful of times I've stopped into this particular store, I've found the drinks made to standard and the staff to be very friendly.  They are also always very quick.  The store itself could be a bit cleaner, but overall I am a fan of this location!

This location is terribly understaffed. The line had at least 50 people in it wrapping all the way back to C9. The workers are rude and slow. The restaurant is absolutely filthy!  Starbucks should shut this location down. It's a disgrace! 

I'd give them -5 if possible.

This Starbucks had terrible service. We came today and the lady before us left upset about her order to then later find myself in the same situation. I asked for a  venti and got a grande and when I say down to wait for about 15 minutes and told another worker (the girl at the front who was very nice), she checked with the girl who messed up my drink and the girl hadn't even started on my drink... i expected my CORRECT order not the mess up. If you don't know how to handle a drive thru AND people inside the store then you shouldn't be working at a place that offers both services. In addition to this situation, my mom went to the bathroom and there was no soap. We are still in a PANDEMIC. Definitely a disappointing experience.

Its like there are two different stores here. The morning crew is friendly and efficient, although swamped with business. But the order is always right and they fly around like you expect. 

Go in the afternoon, the little "manager" walks around doing nothing. The staff moves like snails, and its 50/50 whether your coffee comes as ordered (25 minutes later). 

My last visit there were just 3 cars in line at the drive-thru. Great! A chance for a quick stop mid-afternoon. 14 minutes later I ducked out of the drive-thru and walked in. Ummm. No line here at all. 2 people waiting for their orders. Must have have been the driver trying to buy a franchise at the drive-thru. A breeze now right? 

I left 25 minutes later with a chalky, poorly made specialty coffee that the obviously new guy asked for help with on every step. The manager ignored his pleas, leaving the other "kids" to give him partial instructions and frustrate him nearly to tears. All while the the three customers inside watched the chaos behind the counter. 

Poor management to say the least. Kudos to the morning crew. Shame on whatever you call that circus that goes on in the afternoon.

i ordered via the drive-thru .. my drink was just blended ice.. the person assisting at the window stopped helping me to tell the other workers about an officer pulling over a car instead of making sure she correctly scanned my app to reload. this isn't my usual SB location but i def don't want to go back and i'm in the middle of moving so i'll be very disappointed if the service is typically this poor.

It's really bad when Starbucks runs out of ingredients for half of their menu! However I stood there waiting for nearly 10 minutes while the two employees working here we're busy talking and gossiping and catching up on what they did from the night before. I had no idea that to women could sit there and just gab so much when you have a customer standing in front of you. I'm not sure if these are actual Starbucks employees or just target people working the Starbucks counter.

So it was really tough finding an open Starbucks in NOLA in the afternoon as a lot of them were closed.  The only one one I saw open on their App was this casino location and the other one being another 10min walk, I chose to go to this one.  It is located at the far end of the casino (if you are coming from riverside).  

What blew my mind was their ridiculous pricing.  My usual drink costed nearly twice as much as the street pricing.  Every single item costs more and I understand this is at a casino but it is bit too much.  Especially for someone like me just trying to find a Starbucks, not there to gamble.  I did not have a problem with their service at all but thier pricing is ridiculous.
This place is a clustefuck. I would blame Poor  management making the baristas look like morons, but I honestly don't know what the root cause is.

I will start by saying that I love Starbucks. Mainly in the fall when I can get a good Pumpkin Spice Latte, Egg Nog Latte, etc. 

My husband and I went to Starbucks just to grab a coffee and ended up picking up a few things at Target while we were in the store. They were out of all the things to make Mocha so therefore no peppermint mocha, no white chocolate mocha, we were pretty much asking ok what DO you have? The barista made us a Pumpkin Spice Latte which is usually my favorite! ECK! I have no idea what the guy made but it was NASTY. I mean totally undrinkable. We didn't realize it until we were all the way to the back of Target (since I waited a few minutes for it to cool). When we went back up there the guy was talking on his cell phone sitting at one of the tables and no one was behind the bar. Hmm... Sorry but if I'm paying 5 bucks a piece for a coffee I don't expect it taste like coffee grinds. I won't be going here again, which sucks because I like this Target.

Very confusing experience right now. If you order using mobile, they still don't start your order until you check in (get out of your car and walk in to say you are here). But there is no sign to that effect. So we have been sitting in our car figuring the  6-7 people standing in line out front were going to get serviced first. "No sense getting out of car just yet..." kind of thing.
Then someone comes out and says everyone needs to check in and *then* the order is started!
How are we supposed to know that? It's not mentioned in the app when you order nor is any signage or anyone out front to mention it. 
In fact I'm expecting the order to have been started already if we used the app. That's the whole point of it.
So now we have to wait for all these people whose orders must all now be started at the same time.
I totally get that they are navigating this pandemic situation like all of us but it's been a few months now and all they need to fix this is some communication up front so people know what to expect.

We go to this location because it's close to school and it's really convenient. They have messed up orders in the past but have always gone above and beyond to ensure we leave happy. Today this was not the case -- we left not wanting to come back. The drive thru was busy so we went inside. My friend ordered her food. When I ordered, it took 10 minutes for the girl to put in my order: a breakfast sandwich and a refresher. By this time my friend had already received her drink. It took about another 5 minutes to get my drink which wasn't bad but frustrating because I had already waited 10 minutes to have my order put through. We stood at the counter waiting on our sandwiches for over 15 minutes. Not one person asked what we were waiting on or how they could help. The girl working the counter right in front of us kept looking at us but wouldn't say anything. The lady 2 orders behind us got her TWO sandwiches before we got ours. At this point they still didn't ask why we were still waiting. I asked how long our sandwiches we're going to take and their response was "who did you order with?" I don't understand how this answers my question. So I said "the lady 2 orders behind us just got her sandwiches. How long before we get ours?" She said "oh well there's been some issues with the oven". I said "if there's an issue with the oven, why did the lady 2 orders behind us get hers first?" She just looked at me. There were no issues with the oven. We watched them stand around and talk for the whole 15+ minutes. She handed us our sandwiches and we walked out. There was no attempt to ensure we were happy. There was no customer service at all! After today I am VERY disappointed and frustrated. We WILL NOT be back and we WILL be going to another location that has WAY better customer service. If you want to go here, I suggest not wasting your time and find another location. If I could give 0 stars, I would.

1 star for laziness. Before I order my coffee & 30 minutes before close, I needed to use the washroom. A mop & cleaning bucket was sitting in front of the washrooms, they were clearly not being used. I asked & the girl says "Well it's being cleaned." I asked about the other washroom and then she decides they're both being cleaned. No one was cleaning them. She obviously JUST cleaned them and didn't want us to use them.
They always tend to "forget" to do online orders! Make sure to order hours early but don't be surprised if your order isn't ready when you get there!
Great place, very friendly staff our drinks always come out fast. Drinks always taste so good , ordering on mobile makes the drinks come out faster.

The employees are really nice to me and they always apologize and fix their mistakes. Every time I order they make my drinks good. I feel bad because they are always understaffed and customers get irritated because the line goes out into the road and they get mad for no reason. You have to ask yourself, if this specific Starbucks wasn't good would there be a line waiting to get something? I love this location.

On top of being a big coffee guy in general, having worked at Starbucks for several years makes me able to see all the good and the bad when it comes to a visit to Starbucks. I know that on any given day you could have a different experience at Starbucks, but this location in particular is always consistent on being great in. I often mobile order as it's perfect on my way to work, and my drink has never not been ready when I got there. I am always greeted at the door, and have really great customer service. I've noticed a trend in recent years of barista's being less friendly and not often greeting you... And until I was on the other side of the counter, I never realized how much better of an experience it is when you're acknowledged right away. There is a younger guy that works mornings, wish I knew his name, but he always is super friendly and on top of it. This locations consistency and drinks is always spot on as well, don't feel like my drink has been cut corners like some other locations. With so many Starbucks choices, I will always go out of my way to visit this one!

Things I liked about this Starbucks:
1. Very short line to order.

Things I did not like about this Starbucks:
1. The long wait for my drink.
2. The trash all over the floor.
3. The creamer counter in complete disarray and with spills.
4. The staff sitting out front on a generator on her phone.. picking her nose. God I hope she didn't make my drink.

Came through the drive-thru a few nights ago for my "birthday drink." It was about half an hour before closing. I was once a Starbucks barista so I know that clean up and closing duties had already started. Nonetheless, both baristas that I talked to were super friendly, and both of them wished me a happy birthday. I was also very impressed with how quickly they made my chai tea latte! It was delicious and a great way to finish my birthday! ;) I love Starbucks!

I tried the new Guava Passion fruit drink.  I love guava and it was really good except that there was very little "drink".  The cup was filled to the top with ice so that it was gone in just a few sips.  I now know to order with light or no ice.  It was a rip off the way I got it.

It was so nice to walk into a starbucks where they are not treating the customer like an enemy. The bathrooms are open, the employees are smiling and friendly. My drink was waiting for me when I got there. I'm not from here. The one back home in Braselton, GA doesn't even have consistent business hours. The little bit of time they are open everyone seems scared to death to even look at you. Walk in with your mask just a little out of place and they yell at you to "fix" it. This starbucks was a breath of fresh air! Thank you!

One of the largest Starbucks I've ever seen.. and I've been to a lot of Starbucks. Sadly, I visited during that pandemic, so there was no indoor seating, but we enjoyed ourselves on the patio. Will definitely patronize them again.

I have nothing against the drinks or food, but the way they conduct business. The baristas are super sweet, but the lack of attention to all of the different ways of ordering is bewildering. If you are going to offer curbside then make sure you get it done. After waiting 30 min, finally I go in to be told that my order wasn't even noticed by anyone. Waited another however long and still didn't get my sandwich so I left. The physical location already makes this place trash.
This is the slowest Starbucks I've been to. There was no one inside but I waited 20 minutes in the Drive Through (even though it wasn't a long line).

This review is strictly for Diana , what breath of fresh air. 
Customer service was second to none. Will definitely be back when I'm in town.

The Staff is friendly and helpful, that is the 2 stars. The "social distancing" is ridiculous. People are scattered all over the store. No clue who is in line or waiting. They encoutage online ording, but do not fill the orders as they come out. If you change your mind, they cannot refund your money. The store and the app are separate according to one of the baristas. Either this location needs more staff, or better organizational skills. No interest on coming back to this location till the pandemic guidelines are no longer in effect.

I was just in here - before 6am on a Friday morning, by the way - and the young guy with glasses who helped me was wonderful! He was wide awake (more than I can say for myself at the time), super polite and personable. We had a nice conversation while he put together my order, and it just started my day off on such a positive note. Starbucks, I wish I got his name but please check the schedule and give this guy a raise - he deserves it! Good people are hard to come by, hang onto this one if you can :) and keep it up, nice young guy with glasses!

This is by far the worst Starbucks in Santa Barbara. I've been to this shop many, many times and each time I say it's the last. The last time I was there, I ordered two drinks. One of them was a simple drip coffee with cream and a sweetener. The coffee was bitter, as if it had been sitting on the burner all day. The person that prepared it didn't even bother mixing the drink. Every time I've come into this shop, they've either gotten the order wrong or the taste of the drinks were not consistent with other Starbucks stores. The tables are always dirty and the patio has a permanent urine odor, making the environment inhospitable and not the kind of place you'd want to meet a friend and chat. My friend and I were so disgusted that we took our drinks out to a bench near the parking lot, a ways up from the shop. It wasn't the type of experience we were going for, so we just gulped down our subpar drinks and vowed never to return to this location. This time I mean it. In fact, I think I'm done with Starbucks all together for a while.

Ordered a Venti and they made a Grande, instead of remaking the drink they added more milk and poured it into another cup. 

Overpriced coffee I can live with, but overpriced milk...

Screw this place.

This absolutely sucked my a$$ i ordered a venti and paid for a venti and got a hot damn grande! Then i was like at least i still got this burrito and i tasted it and just my luck it was just booty hole another cherry on top was the drive thru window lady.... let me tell you her breath was appalling that's it that's all i have to say.

It's a little congested in the parking lot and I had never been here before but what a CUTE little Starbucks, I love it.  I didn't buy anything here because I already had a coffee from another Starbucks down the road.  I was meeting someone here for a little business meeting and we sat outside because of the pandemic.  I was awaiting her arrival inside since it was our first cold day this fall/winter and I was observing the inside space and cleanliness.  I will definitely come back here once things chill out for a quaint, cozy hang out in a lovely space.

Ya, so this was the first place I went to get coffee today (if you read my other review about my coffee haul). I opted for a frappe, and it was nothing out of the usual for me as far as starbucks. The customer service was nice.

I like that their pastry bar was fully loaded with tasty looking treats. (no flies an urchins like ive seen at some locations). The restaurant is very clean, prompt professional service and a nice ambiance. I'd def go here again.

I agree with Rusty, this place could get 5 stars if it was a little less expensive.

Look, I know it's Starbucks but I admit that I love Starbucks. Don't hate. Plus it's conveniently located in the gulch and I'm really happy that it is. I came in when they were open for 2 days, and the morning line wasn't bad at all. I'm excited that this will be foot traffic primarily and hope that it won't have the same outrageous lines that West End, and other drive thru locations typically have. 
The layout is very conducive for quick service and catering to the coffee goers who are getting take out. This location has some tables but you can tell the intent is to serve people quickly and then move on. I'm glad! 
Only one issue I have is that they wouldn't redeem my free birthday coffee and it is about to expire!

Coffee is amazing cause, well, Starbucks! This location is a great quite little hangout and has a drive through. It's a standard little Starbucks and love having it in the neighborhood. The downside is that a huge part of the coffee experience is a friendly face and quick little conversation. Whether getting your coffee through drive through, the inside register, or mobile pickup, 95% of the employees do not give you eye contact, don't greet you, and are usually pre-occupied with coworker conversations. Someone needs to send these workers (March 2020) through some sort of customer service training. It's very uncommon to experience such a lack of courtesy in Idaho. I have faith though and hope that the management here catch on to this and get this location up to Starbucks and Treasure Valley standards.

This will be the last time I come here. The newly-remodeled restaurant is understaffed as usual. It should not take 20 minutes to get a coffee. I've also had issues with the quality of the food and drink here, the staff, and incorrect orders. This place needs better management.

This is my favorite Starbucks! They have perfected my drink! I hope thos place doesnt close since most drive through starbucks are closing.  I meet my fiends here twice a month! Great location and great staff!

Great location! Centrally located off of a Main Street and easy to get to.  Parking lot is small and shared with a few other businesses but be patient and you will find a spot.
Actual Starbucks is a smaller location but employees are so friendly and kind. My go to drink, strawberry açaí refresher , came out quickly. They had a large selection of bakery items and prepackaged foods like cheese and cracker plates and sandwiches. 
Bathrooms are clean too!

Everytime I have come here it has been terrible. The service is beyond slow and even though I give this place another chance time and time again, I am always disappointed. I waited 30 minutes for my drink last time and today I waited 15 minutes in the drive thru without moving an inch and just decided to leave. Others did the same. So just know this place loses business with their efficiency levels. Their drinks weren't even good compared to other locations. Their latte tasted like a gas station packets. Do not go here.

This is THE WORST Starbucks I have ever been to. They ALWAYS SUCK no matter the time of the day or the day of the week. They will 100% mess up your coffee. Do not trust them. They are always in a bad mood and will rush you. Absolutely terrible. Last resort.

I like this Starbucks so much it pains me to have to share it with any other customers.  Dogs love the pup cups and get excited every time we visit.  Working on a way to take this whole Starbucks to my house.  I think there is room in my back yard.
Ordered a Venti Pile Place and the coffee was cold... not even warm! There needs to be a temperature check system to ensure customers are getting a hot cup of coffee.

Saw this guy having a late night snack while walking the dog. Coupled with the dead rat that was outside this morning, it's safe to say we will never go to this Starbucks again. Have reached out to the location in the past after seeing mice, clearly didn't make any changes. Would not recommend, have seen over 5 mice on various occasions

All I wanted was an afternoon coffee and a place to do some work.  That was apparently too much to ask for.  I walk in, and the too-hipster-to-care barista is attempting to explain to the indecisive couple in front of me the differences between the latest brownie- or caramel-laden concoction that Starbucks is currently marketing.  After three minutes of me waiting patiently behind them and them debating, they decide on their order.  The conversation between the tattooed coffee merchant and the couple then shifts to the mysteries of paying for an order with a credit card.  Seriously - this guy gave them an outright seminar on how to swipe their MasterCard through the register.  At this point, I'm more than a little annoyed. Another two minutes go by while the handlebar mustache barista goes to check on a blender or something obviously important.  He comes back and informs the couple that their credit card didn't run and would need to swipe it again, and then walks away for another who knows how long.  I didn't stay to find out.  Needless to say, 5 or so minutes in a one person line is longer than I'm willing to wait for a coffee order to be taken.  I hate to think how long it actually takes to get it.  What I learned today:  If you're in need of a Starbucks, skip this place and walk 2 minutes to the one in the Safeway in the same shopping center; it will likely be faster.

3:00 on a Sunday afternoon. Walked in to order an iced coffee. Was told they're "too backed up" and aren't taking any more orders. What!? You're a coffee shop! I asked if that was even for iced coffee and was told yes. 

Mind. Blown. 

Never had that happen in my life at any Starbucks.

Let's you buy their products but doesn't let you use the bathroom because of covid. I get the concern but then why are you okay with letting people into the establishment to purchase items. It's the same amount of risk. If your comfortable taking my money in person you should let your patrons use the bathroom.

I love this location! Super friendly staff and awesome drinks. Order ahead via the Starbucks app, as it gets quite busy being in the midst of a couple major companies in Center City.

The best part of visiting this Starbucks is that the baristas always seem to be having fun in addition to being efficient and kind to all of the customers. Nothing beats going to a coffee shop where the workers are happy to serve you.
Not a perfect store, but the baristas are always upbeat and kind despite being constantly understaffed.

I've had good experiences at this Starbucks. They were out of some items I ordered online and the worker too time to walk me through what they had. I appreciated her friendly demeanor. I would definitely return to this Starbucks over the one on Market street. They're not very polite over there.

I am not a Starbucks aficionado but I've been to this location a couple of times.  The baristas are very friendly and the noise level isn't too bad -- probably my favorite thing compared to the typical Starbucks.

I have been going to Starbucks for over 40 years and this location is the poorest service I have ever received. Ask for a pour over coffee with milk & stevia. Got a coffee black. Reordered the drink and from start to delivery of remake drink 40 minutes. The manager in charge is the one that made the drink in first place. We I mentioned that the had provided such terrible service & wasted my time. She provided a $4 card for my next visit. I'll be back to speak to manager in charge tomorrow.

Christmas Eve, long line, no problem!

They have busy times down to a T!

The parking is abysmal and the drive thru is constantly busy. Still, the baristas are friendly, get the orders right, and get you in and out as quickly as possible. It's the customers who camp out here for the free WiFi that clog up close parking spaces. Maybe they should have two spaces just for pick up. Then when I order ahead I won't be parking a greater distance away - especially on a rainy day like today. Note on 8/26/20: During CoVid, they are doing a phenomenal job. They have 3 tables with 2 chairs at each table, set apart for social distancing. They have markings on the floor to help keep social distancing in effect. They are friendly and efficient. Parking is better since fewer people are inside.

5 min from me but ill drive 15 min further for better staff. Last week a male employee asked if I wanted my COLD EGGS REHEATED. I SAID SURE IF YOU LIKE TO. Normal reaponse being from the South. He walked away. I asked of he was going to heat it up. He shrug his shoulders & said. You said if I liked. So he walked away helping another customer. Dark big haird mini beard over weight. Sweating & passively rude. So yes Cold Eggs I threw away. Today not a busy Sunday. Having problems with my phone/starbucks App. 2 ppl Didnt bother to help me when i asked for them to help me real quick. On looked on the go said are you at the right store etc.. I had a scan thing pop up said head to the register. That Dark skin thin man walked away. They were working but 3 cars in drive thru & 3 ppl in store, I was one of those 3 inside. Asked a lady who wasnt able to walk away as fast as the other 6 employees who saw needing help but wouldn't make eye contact or answer me or acknowledged that I was at the order counter fumbling with my phone. I could have paid there but no one came to the counter. They were all avoiding the counter and a customer that was FACE TO FACE. After the one lady said something short and brief I had to yell out " can I plz get service!!" After being there for a hot minute (20 min) the girl told me I didnt order yet and had know clue about the scan bar that had prompted me to the check out counter. That same girl said. I Don t know what to tell you and walked away. A very light skinned thin long blonde hair girl. Just TAKE MY ORDER AND LET ME PAY WITH A CREDIT CARD! SHE TOLD ME I CANT HELP YOU. FIRE THESE STUPID-MEANING HOW DO YOU NOT HAVE CUSTER SERVICE SKILLS & WORK AT A STARBUCKS STORE? WALMART? DAIRY QUEEN? DR OFFICE? LAW FIRM? QUALITY PASSIONATE PPL NEEDED AT DR. MARTIN LUTHRT KING BLVD ACCROSS FROM ST JOSEPHES HOSPTIAL. BOSTON MARKET. HIMES & MLK. FIND REAL PPL THAT WILL SMILE. BE HELPFUL. THIS IS RIDICULOUS TO HATE A COFFEE SHOP SO MUCH. EVERYNODY AT MY OFFICE FEELS THE SAME WAY. ITS SUNDAY FUNDAY. NOBODY WAS SMILING. IT LOOKED LIKE A FUNERAL HOME BUT WITH ATTITUDE OF A**ES

GET THE STORE MORE HELP SO THEY CAN BE NICE TO CUSTOMER'S. This store is always busy. Staff are rude. Seems like they ALWAYS NEED HELP. Today hit the spot for a review. Been ordering from MLK for 1 year. 5 min from work too.

Worst Starbucks's I've been to in quite awhile.  Barista was rude.  She looked like she has been through the mill.  I asked if she could sanitise or wash her hands.  She was well ya but whatever.  She said if I was  that worried I should make coffee at home.   A real witch.  Won't be visiting this Starbucks anytime soon.  Everyone at the majority of Starbucks are so nice especially during this time.

Very rude and unpleasant staff. Took almost 20 minutes to get a single drink. When questioned about it they simply didn't care. Will not be spending any more money at this place. Maybe do some training on people skills..

What can I say... It's Starbucks... We are all drones of this establishment and are all proud to be. As far as coffee, if you have ever been to any Starbucks the consistency  is unreal. Whatever you order where ever will taste the exact same. I don't love the house coffee but speciality drinks are why I keep coming.

My only complaint about this location is seating. It is extremely small and not a ton of room. If you are meeting with more than 2 people, you may not find a seat and if you do things are pretty crammed. What I do love is they have 2 bathrooms and both are unisex. That is a huge asset. 

I only come to this location if I really have too... But overall this location is pretty good.

They have a valet parking area just no valet, thats okay I walked. Actually, it is a really nice location and there was probably some other business here that did have a valet service, I don't know. The barista would know, she was very knowledgeable and explained to me the cup sizes. A grande cappuccino would have been way too much but the short not enough. The still have short cups, and tall, the original sides according to the barista. I got a short water to give you a picture.
The drinks and food is good but the service is extremely slow. I ordered one drink and had to wait 30 minutes for it. It is not worth the wait.

The worst starbucks i've ever been too . Always get the drinks wrong and when they don't it will take twenty minutes to get a simple drink and when people walk in and order a frappe there's will come right out . they always forget about the first people in line . You guys need new workers ! If i could give the rate a 0 i would .

No, I know, right? 4 stars. Just hear me out.

There is a barista at this location of Starbucks that might just be the real life Santa Claus. He is the most jolly man I've ever encountered - with a belly full of jelly to match! Friendly, funny, and makes a decent foamy latte, too.

Docking a point because they replaced the big comfy couches with regular tables and chairs. Why make the place less welcoming?

It's close to my house and close to Tokyo Express and Mongoli Grill. Cheap fast food and coffee date? Yes, please.

**This review is for the stand-alone Starbucks in the Delaware Welcome Center parking lot, not the one inside the food court.**

I have visited here twice and both times the staff was friendly and helpful.  The place is clean and there is seating.  There are two independent bathrooms.  The one I used was in pretty good condition especially when you take into consideration the rest stop locality.

Both times getting an iced green tea frap was easy and the results were delicious.  Both times I asked for no whip cream and both times it was taken care of easily.  There is a drive through so if you get food in the main building you can visit this Starbucks drive through before hitting the road again.

The staff here made a real difference for me.  I don't imagine they have many regulars and I completely appreciate that being friendly and helpful to a two time visitor holds very limited value.  Lets be honest, I'm not hopping on the road and driving up to Delaware for my next frap.  What I can do is tell folks about this location and encourage them to visit this location as they embark on the I-95 east coast driving experience.  

This stand alone Starbucks and its friendly staff is its own caffeinated oasis alone the I-95 corridor.

I would give them 4 stars if the barista knew how to talk to strangers... I asked her a quick question, more like advice, on if a certain frappucino would be good... her reaction was as though I'd asked her to do a handstand and sing the Star Spangled Banner. Drink was great, though. Dirtier environment than desired, but since it's within a Target, I suppose that's forgivable to a degree.

Super poor service!! Staff is talking to each other but not working. 3 people behind the counter, 2 talking to each other ignoring customers while the line is getting longer and longer.
Don't go there! It's a waste of your time and you might not even get what you paid for.

I've never had a problem with starbucks and I tend to give retail/service workers the benefit of the doubt and rarely complain. He is making a joke about how I have to go home to change clothes! Then offers me more coffee. Well needless to say I left upset and humiliated as if that was not enough. Starbucks has lost my business for good. This is the worst customer service I have ever experienced.

Cozy Starbucks that took me back to my college days, as it's practically on the Vanderbilt campus ... :) Tried the chili latte. $4.50 is way too much for a short, Starbucks, lower your prices! Butttt I can't fault the branch for that, and I can't hate because the drink is pretty good. The staff was friendly and patient. There are lots of tables and couches. Bathrooms are clean. And the students working here are so friggin' adorable!
This location is a crowded local hangout but it has a great vibe. You might not get a seat, but your coffee will be good and you'll leave satisfied.

It's Starbucks, so if you've been before, you know what you're getting, right?  Service has always been great here, friendly and professional.  They know how to make Starbucks drinks, so, again, you know exactly what you're getting.

Nothing here pushes it into 5 star range for me, but I've always received fast, friendly service, and my order has always been correct.
I was the only person in line and they intentionally made my drink wrong (tall half calf vanilla latte)
Waited 20 min for an iced coffee.  People came and went and I still couldn't get my drink.  Terrible service.

I made an order online, I arrive and ask the cashier if my order is ready, he says that I should wait for them to call me, he does not verify the orders, I wait for 15 minutes watching the coffees that I asked to melt in my eyes, I ask another person again  check the orders and ... my order was waiting since it arrived, 15 minutes watching my coffee melt and my breads cool, badly done man

These people are miserable lol.  Like dang! Someone send them a smile and help. Short, impolite, sad. 

Send some help and hugs!

3.5 stars - mostly only for shock value.

Let me preface this by saying that I am not a fan of Starbucks. I think their coffee is over-caffeinated and often burnt, their espresso drinks lame at best, and everything over-priced. In fact, when I am trying to decide on a cafe to go to, Starbucks doesn't even make it to the list of options. However, I must admit that Starbucks is extremely convenient: they are everywhere and they are open late. So, when I needed to find a place to study late tonight, I decided to go to the Green Hills Starbucks for the first time in...maybe 2-1/2 years.

So, I walked in tonight with my friend and I couldn't stop my jaw from dropping over and over again and the exclamation, "Wow," from coming out of my mouth. Why? Because the place has gotten an extreme makeover. It's probably to do with the whole new Starbucks branding/marketing goals.  But, anyway, all of the furniture has been replaced with wooden counterparts and comfy couches.  It has an entirely different feel: less commercial and more local and authentic.  The gigantic study table with 20 electrical outlets has been replaced by benches on the wall, bar stools, and any other kind of seating you can imagine.  And the outlets are now impossible to find because they have been painted the same exact brown as the wall, which led me to create an extremely awkward situation as I walked around the entire border of the room looking for a plug for my dying laptop.  Despite an inspiring renovation of the entire atmosphere of the place, obviously, the quality of the drinks has not improved.

Astonished by the new look, I inquired the barista about when they redid the place. To which she replied last year in February. Embarrassed, I chuckled, took my drink, and slowly walked away. Clearly, I am behind the times.  Anyway, great new feel and atmosphere (this one is much more social) for Starbucks even though the drinks haven't changed.  So, if you must resort to going to Starbucks, this is the one I would recommend.

It's Starbucks so what are you really expecting? It's the customer service that makes the difference at each individual location. What I really like about this location being next to a Dutch Brothers it's typically pretty easy to get in-and-out of quickly. And you don't have to listen to the music blaring & a conversation about nothing when all you want is COFFEE.
Awful service, employees are disrespectful and unprofessional, they keep getting the orders wrong and seems they used to it and don't caRe.

It's Starbucks so you know the coffees going to be good. But the main issue with this one is the drive thru takes anywhere from a couple of mins to upwards of 30 plus. I've been going here for years now and it just seems that they can't find a happy medium with moving the drive thru along.

What a great crew! Lindi the manager was more than accommodating to me and my daughter who had s a cold wet day at WinterFest! Our drinks were delicious and made quickly with a smile. Great guest service!

Large lobby area and right across from Vanderbilt and Mellow Mushroom pizza. WiFi is pretty fast, line is sometimes pretty long, parking is typically not easy to find even in their lot (it's almost always full unless you're the first person there or it's nearing the end of the day!) Not the cleanest, but pretty clean! Ya know, for a Starbucks it's pretty solid!

Today I visited this Starbucks as I always do. I ordered a vanilla iced latte and sat outside with it. As soon as I got it I noticed it was just a little watery. I sat outside and took a sip and didn't care for it. I let 15 mins pass by contemplating if I wanted to get a new drink made or not. I finally went inside and asked for a new drink. An employee ran across the room and goes "WELL YOUVE BEEN SITTING OUTSIDE FOR A WHILE SO ICE MELTS AFTER A WHILE" ...... are you kidding me? I'm not stupid I realize that. I didn't care for it from the GET GO. she went behind the counter to re make my drink but didn't tell me. I got in line waiting to order another drink and she goes "IM MAKING YOUR DRINK" in a rude tone. Then yells at me to pull my mask up. Her name was NICOLE. extremely rude, unprofessional and out of place.

After hastily driving to work on morning, I realized I left my breakfast sitting on my counter. I quickly placed an online order for pickup for a bagel here. I luckily had rewards for use so it was free! (Cha Ching!) 

I pulled up to a huge line (obviously Starbucks is packed in the morning). But I parked and went inside. My bagel was ready shortly after. I realized I didn't have cream cheese (silly me, I didn't realize cream cheese was extra!) I asked the lady behind the counter and she said "don't worry about paying this time, everyone's just tryin to make it to work on time" and gave me some cream cheese. Simple gesture, but I just thought it was really nice of her. Great customer service Starbucks!

The manager there yesterday was so rude. Kept cutting me off while I was asking if they had some clear cups available. Then my 10 year old daughter went to drink her drink and he screamed to put her mask back up. He could have just said it calmly. No signs say you can't have a sip of your drink while you wait for your sandwich. Get a grip.

Asked my butter croissant to not be heated..and it wasn't but then I get home and it's still in the plastic packaging... which is good,I guess, because on the packaging it said it was produced on Nov 2...today's Dec. 4.

Friendly! This Starbucks stands out for consistency in great customer service. They are always upbeat and helpful, even when I have questions and we're communicating through the drive thru microphones. 

My order has always been filled correctly, and I like the comfy vibe I get here. 

A nice, hot beverage is sounding pretty good right now... :)

So we have been here 2 days in a row. This Starbucks is very clean. The staff taking orders is very pleasant. Bathrooms are a bit messy, but with the time it takes to get drinks, there must not be any time for anyone to clean the bathrooms. It honestly takes ages to get a drink.
It took less time to get a drink at the extremely crowded Starbucks Reserve on Christmas day in Palm Springs than it does to get simple orders at this location. 
Again, if you are going for a pleasant interaction with a staff member and a clean seating area this is your location. BUT if you need to go in and use a clean bathroom and get your drink quick, you may want to reconsider your choice and go to a different Starbucks location.

This is my most frequented Starbucks due to the fact that it is close to my office, but I also really like the staff! Everyone who has helped me has been extremely kind! I'm that girl who is known to have full on conversations with the staff members when the restaurant is not too busy! My only "complaint" is that they use stickers to mark your order on your cup rather than in hand writing with a Sharpie! The Sharpie makes me feel special for some reason. Haha!
This is such a nice little Target Starbucks. They had more syrup flavors than the Starbucks by my job, and the line moved quickly.

This is my favorite Starbucks. My drink is made the same way every time. The baristas are all friendly and fun. Even when they are super busy, I still get greeted with a smile. It is slightly embarrassing that several of them know my name, but I appreciate it. (I have a serious thing for the salted cream, cold foam cold brew.) Austin has done a great job at making this location the best!

So happy to have a local drive thru Starbucks!
