My first experience was perfect - there was a long line that they kept moving and I was quickly in and out with a delicious breakfast.

One of my favorite Starbucks because of the people who work here. They're always so upbeat and nice. it's a smaller sized Starbucks. I've never had a bad experience here. It's a nice place to do work at or have a coffee date because there is outside seating with umbrellas for shade.

Dear Starbucks ,
As usual you draw me in on a near daily basis! Never disappointed by my regular  cinnamon dolce latte. Always tempted to buy the newest folk rock indie cd , grabbing Ethos bottled water I don't need, chocolate Graham crackers , granola bars , protein platters ... Get me out of here!!!!!! The music piped in must have subliminal messages to influence you to Consume , buy, ....ok, drive through from now on. Oh Starbucks .... Till we meet again! Tomorrow you say? Ok.. See you then!

This starbucks is right by my place and while it lasts, it has been an essential establishment for me. Unfortunately this location is closing very soon due to Covid-19 impact I assume. I really enjoyed chitchatting with the employees there as they were the best seriously. I have never had a single bad experience at this location. Special thanks to Josh - he truly was the best. I am going to miss you all so much when you vacate.

WARNING...as a previous reviewer mentioned, the employees here are HORRIBLE. Much more concerned with typical teen angst issues than their jobs. 

IF YOU HAVE FOOD ALLERGIES, PLEASE NOTE THE FOLLOWING--

I ordered a coconut milk beverage, and specified no whipped cream. I have a very intense lactose intolerance issue. I *should* have watched her pour the drink and I should have asked her to use a clean pitcher for steaming. That's my bad...normally I'm all over that. 

I did not assume any untrustworthiness on her part, and I also didn't want to deal with her eye rolling. I am 100% sure she gave me cow's milk. I almost took myself to the emergency room, it was so bad. I never drink cow's milk because it sets off lactose intolerance issues worse than anything. The worst part is I had so many appointments for the rest of the day and so many things to do, and I had to cancel half of them, and struggle through the rest while thinking I was literally on the verge of a nasty lactose-induced death. 

I've never had such careless, thoughtless treatment at a Starbucks...! I will not return to this location, but I'd say it's a safe guess that the manager doesn't give a sh@#, given who works there. Bad managers hire bad employees. 

IF YOU HAVE ANY FOOD ALLERGIES, PLEASE BE VERY SAFE AND DO NOT PURCHASE ANYTHING FROM THIS STARBUCKS LOCATION. The same for anyone allergic to self-centered, emotionally stunted teens who hate their stupid jobs and can't wait to get out of here because oh my god Ainsley's having her big party tonight you guyssss! Hang on one sec, I have to help this stupid customer, *sighhhhh*

Probably the best customer service I have ever received at any Starbucks ever. I normally don't go to Starbucks for coffee as it's a little pricy but my wife and I really wanted to try the Irish Cream Americano which was very good. 

The person (wish I would have got her name) that was working drive thru gave us the best customer service I have ever received. It took awhile to make the coffees but because she was delightfully having a conversation with us it didn't feel like we waited long. 

For all Starbucks fans I would strongly recommend this location.

This is the best Starbucks that I have been to for doing school work. Other Starbucks have tables that are too small, at a bad height or not enough places to work. 
This Starbucks has lots of great work spaces (comfortable "lounging" chairs as well as tables with great access to power outlets.)
The air conditioning is always on and it can get cold so bring a jacket if necessary. 

TLDR: great atmosphere for having a productive afternoon. Cold-blooded folks beware.

This is THE worst Starbucks in south Tampa. They are always out of coffee..Really? This is a coffee shop. They should never be out of coffee. The service is terrible. Whoever manages this one should be fired. It's been terrible here for a very long time. Avoid.
Worst Starbucks ever. The workers are So slow. And they Never have anything. Save urself a 30 min wait just find something in the fridge

Worst Starbucks EVER. I went there today and there were about 3 employees all black females and the Cashier was the Rudest lady. I ordered she just stood there didnt tell me how much, then I gave her my Starbucks card and said I thought I had a free on. She swiped it and handed it to me. Saying nothing. Then a chick made my order way to sweet and in a Tall cup not Grande that I ordered. They need to fire all the people that work there that cant even give good customer service.
Customer service is always on point and they make good suggestions if you ask. If you want sweets/food you just gotta get there in the am. Love this target as well it's pretty spacious.
Big fan of Starbucks!  The Avon Starbucks employees need to step it up. There is always a line in the drive thru. The bathrooms are a mess. Tables are never clean when I go in.

Well, they tried.  The employees were nice.  They keep the location clean, which I'd imagine might be a challenge with a bunch of I-95 drivers passing through.

But, I waited a bit longer than I expected for my drink only to get a grande when I'd ordered a venti.  I noted the issue, they offered to fix it, I waited another five minutes or so before telling them that I'd rather take the grande for the venti price and get back on the road.  They apologized again and offered to make my drink immediately... Had I cared more, I believe they would have gotten me the right thing right away.  None of the shortcomings were willful, but I still opted to hit the road with my grande.   My memory is a bit hazy on the details, but I remember having a similar issue on a past trip.

The staff members seem to mean well, and the experience could be a lot worse, but "Meh. I've experienced better."

This Starbucks location is located inside of Target just walk inside in to Target look left you'll see Starbucks in plain sight. This location what all other Starbucks locations offer to the customer such as Coffee, Teas and etc. Some seating keep that in mind. The staff are nice and friendly.  Over all experience is great!

Not liking this location. The staff does not wear gloves when handeling food or drinks. My frappuccino was not up to the same standards of  other locations.  I was not happy.
   They took my name when I placed my order but they did not call my name when my order was ready lol. They need to work on a system.
  My  caramel ribbon frappuccino was not good. Not crunchy at all. It barely had caramel. I was sadly disappointed.

This is my new Starbucks! Ordered online and my order was already waiting for me. I ordered the egg whites, super yummy and fits my paleo diet. My iced green tea never disappoints and I ordered a passion tea for later so I asked for no ice. I was expecting it to be half full, but they filled that baby up! Baristas are super friendly. I over heard their conversation so whomever just had a baby congrats

This is the worst managed Starbucks in the country. It has to be. They never have products, even before the world's supply chain went to heck, they staff is routinely rude & condescending, and their practices of reusing equipment with out properly sanitizing should at least warrant a health inspection. Corporate's quality control needs to pay this place a visit, and have a new pen filled w/ink and 500 sheet notebook to list issues.

This Starbucks is at the end of State Street... just before the 101.  If you want to use the free internet, you must enter your email address.  A new feature of Starbuck shops I suppose.

Lots of glass for looking outside.  I had the generic "Starbucks Experience" here.  That's good.  No crazies, just regular people enjoying coffee.

My colleague and I were in need of a washroom and a great iced coffee so what better place to stop at than Starbucks to order 2 coffee Frappuccinos.  They make the best! It was refreshing and needed in a Friday afternoon.  I get mine made with coconut milk and it's got just the perfect balance of sweetness.  

I'm always pleased to stop at a Starbucks to use their facilities.  They are typically very clean.  Today was no exception the washrooms were very clean and our order took no time at all.  

This location is pretty nice great big windows and a nice patio.

I recommend this location as they r pretty consistent & most importantly always clean- inside & out- incl bathrooms. I really value that I can count on Starbucks standards at this store. Also- the staff is almost always super friendly! I do wish the bike rack was located closer-
Worst Starbucks experience I have ever had. The ladies working here had terrible attitudes. Don't go here.

My strawberry acai refresher tastes like coffee. I thought I could get past it but it was a waste of a venti drink. I'm guessing they made my drink in a not-fully-cleaned container. My husband (who normally gets our drinks) says his drink tastes like my daughter's mango dragonfruit drink. He says it's not the first time.

This is an alright Starbucks location. It's close to the parkway, so it can be pretty busy. The service here is nice, but I don't enjoy being cramped, pushing myself to the window so people can walking past while I wait for my drink to be made.

This is as good of a Starbucks as any. Am I crazy about their coffee? Not really. Any true coffee drinker would not be. Personally, I think the specialty drinks are too sweet and are designed that way to cover up the bitter burnt taste of the coffee. A truly Devine coffee is so smooth that you can drink it black. 

So, why do I get this place 4 stars? Well, the blonde coffee is an improvement, and you can request this in any drink. They will allow you to alter how many pumps of sweetener, whip or no whip, foam, light foam, or no foam, etc.  The customization and convenience is what makes Starbucks survive.

This location, the staff were friendly and the place was clean. So props to them!

I'm not sure which Starbucks this listing is for.  There is one in main terminal outside security which has a lot of seating and has always made my drinks very well (no complaints) and one inside main terminal on the left after the Admirals Club inside security.

The one I'm referring to now is the second one, inside security.  It does have some nice seating unlike what a previous reviewer said.  It has a couple couches and tables and chairs.  The coffee was good.

They did take my Starbucks loyalty gold card there like all of them in my experience.  Maybe the other reviewer got a new person, I'm not sure.

All in all good Starbucks in my opinion the several times I've frequented it.

make my 3 drinks all wrong......
pink drink's COLOR and salty cream taste are all different，feel so angry！！ I will not pick in this store again！not Professional，they don't know how to make them in right way.

The worst starbucks ive ever been to. They treat you like your bothering them and never speak to you just roll their eyes. I tried to ask the cashier how her day was and she stared at me like i asked her to fight. On top of that the cup was even full. Their attitudes are racist and unprofessional. I will bypass the next starbucks because of the trash they employ

Not a great Starbucks location - exceptionally slow. And "exceptionally slow" doesn't even capture just how slow it is. We waited in line for 10 min behind a single person ordering a coffee (drip) and breakfast sandwich - and 3 people were "working" at the time. All I wanted was a simple drip coffee. 

You'll find this Starbucks in the Harrah's Casino, next to the Canal Street entrance. Make sure you go in that side or you'll have to traverse the entire casino floor to find it. And if you do that, you'll see lots of pitiful fools gambling half-asleep at 6:30 am. 

Two stars because they are a real Starbucks and can scan your phone app

I LOVE this location - what makes it so special for me is that they have the "Songwriters Singing For Coffee" event every month (or every other month). It's a free event where you can sit back, relax and enjoy some good music while sipping your favorite coffee. I love going there for that. There are plenty of seats and staff are always friendly.

Line around the building so I went in. There was one person ahead of me. When I got to the front of the line, the manager turned her back where I stood for 18 mins. She was making food for the entire drive-thru. After my order I stood another 15 mins, watching the staff being redirected to serve the drive-thru. Terrible staffing issue and Elizabeth, the manager, only looked up when I asked for my money back. I know exactly what time I got there, so I'm accurate on time. Staff looked absolutely miserable and nervous. Unfortunate.

Fantastic drive thru experiences! Friendly staff make that early morning coffee run that much better. Parking lot area can be confusing the first time you navigate it so please be mindful of your surroundings so ya don't spill that latte!

I really just love this Starbucks for it's convenient location and it's spacious patio and the indoor is just as cozy, with plenty of seating for both. Of course I love to swing in and get their green tea or vanilla lattes. I just find this location best in the area. It's located next to boundary and the Cheshire for conviency. You can hop on 40 easily or just head down Clayton. But this place has about 15 outdoor tables!!

This is the Starbucks that I went to often when I lived in Dogtown as it was a nice stroll from my apartment. 
The coffee is always good, the staff friendly, and the shop large enough to accommodate lots of folks. In the winter time they usually have the fire going, though the seats near the fireplace fill up pretty quick. The outdoor seating is plentiful as well. If you're looking for a place to work, this is a good place. 
I understand they're pretty busy what with the typical Starbucks traffic plus the hotel, but the cleanliness was so-so.
The parking lot can be a bit chaotic though, as it shares space with the hotel and restaurants Basso and Boundary.

I placed a mobile order. It was not ready when I arrived after 15 minutes, although the app said it would be ready in 7-10. They were out of cup stoppers, and maybe that's why the drinks were not full. Definitely not worth the $3.57-$5.75 I paid for each drink.

I travel a lot for work.
I pride myself on trying all the Starbucks.
Today I was disappointed .
I made my way to this Location.
It is the Dirtiest Starbucks.
By far the worst one I have ever come across.

Some of those drinks aren't coffee - they are sundaes!

I kinda get the whole Starbucks appeal, I guess. My daughter and son-in-law both used to be baristas there and she has tried to explain and justify it to me. I mean, I understand the addiction to caffeine and all. It's just that, for me personally - with a limited budget or "disposable income" as it is now phrased - I cannot see spending $5.00 for a cup of coffee - or the hint of coffee after all those flavors, creams and toppings are added - that's a sundae, that's not coffee.

So, while you are at Starbucks ordering your Yeti Carnival Margarita with vanilla syrup and a lemon slice or whatever - I'm down the road at McDonalds drive-thru fork-lifting a Big Breakfast into the trunk of my car, for about the same money - "Could I have that with a double stack of hotcakes, four syrups and extra grease on the bacon, please?" Plus, the coffee is basically FREE! And - about 10:00am while the top button on my jeans is still open - you're already snacking on the carrot sticks and tuna salad you were suppose to have for lunch...

I have been going to this Starbucks for years and never had a problem until today. I ordered a tall caramel macchiato with whip cream and a warmed blueberry muffin. 

My drink was about half way full. So less if I took away the whip cream. I was in the drive through and didn't realize until I drove away. Plus my blueberry muffin wasn't warmed like I had asked. 

I really hope next time I go that it is much better. I have a ton of stars to still use up. I may start going to Dutch brothers.

This location is a little small so unless you come during off hours, I wouldn't come here to do work. Overall though, it seemed like an average Starbucks. I did ask for whipped cream on my drink, yet they handed me one without it. I would have liked to see more attention to detail, but the staff were all very pleasant and professional. I ordered a matcha green tea frappuccino, and it was refreshing without being too sweet.

This Starbucks left a lot to be desired on my visit this afternoon. There were only two employees working and one seemed to be training - and it was busy! We arrived when there wasn't much of a line but the queue got backed up several times while we were there. 

Secondly, there is not much seating available so you really have to pounce on a table the moment it becomes unoccupied. 

Third, the snack case was pretty barren and not super appealing. Perhaps this is a positive as it kept me from snacking!  

Finally, the music was turned way loud. I'm certain that Starbucks has some sort of corporate policy about their music volume and this particular location was definitely not abiding to that decibel. Totally distracting. 

My green tea latte was fine but the condiments station could have used a clean-up.

Being a working Mom, having a Starbucks within my neighborhood is a MUST!  I was happy to find that there was a new location for my caffeine fix.  Fishtown crossing is a great central shopping center off the very busy Aramingo Ave., which explains the long drive through lines that occur especially during rush hour.  While the lines can be long, they do flow pretty well.

The folks are friendly, delightful, and efficient.  No complaints there.  My only concern would be that it can be a hit or miss in regards to the items that they have available for my regular order (I'm addicted to the caramel ribbon crunch frap along with a coffee cake).  On different instances they didn't have the crunch, caramel drizzle, or coffee cake.  And for that reason alone they are 4 stars not 5 stars.  The location is pretty new so it's clean and inviting.  So all in all, this will still be my go to!

I go through this drive thru every morning on my way to the hospital before my 12 hour shifts. I order an ice coffee extra light on the cream (because other wise it just tastes like milk and I can't even taste the coffee). Starbucks is expensive. I could go across the street to Dunkin' and get a $2 coffee that's larger but I don't because I like Starbucks. Anyway, when they hand it to me and it's too light colored I know it's going to taste like milk so I just ask if they could please pour some out and add more coffee to it, that's all. Again it's expensive to not be able to enjoy it. This morning I asked her to do this and she had an attitude, turned around to her coworker and started laughing while mocking me loudly. I could hear her from the drive thru window. She brought it back to me, mocked me to my face while handing it back to me. And I left just thinking you know what... all I wanted was an ice coffee that doesn't taste like milk. I have to go to a hospital now where I have to keep patients alive for 12 hours which can be exceedingly difficult and exhausting. The most peaceful and easy part of my day from 5:45am until getting home exhausted at 8:30pm tonight is this coffee. My intentions are never to be difficult.

If you want consistently good service & drinks, you've found the right place. We go to Starbucks every morning, usually at this location because it's the closest, but also try other locations avidly depending on where we are for the day. I have to say, this location is always the most consistent and friendly. I like to customize my drink and they never fail to make it correctly. On the rare occasion something is incorrect, they are extremely nice about remaking it. For instance, this morning, I asked for no topping and the barista put sprinkles on it, so I brought it up to him and he very politely offered to remake it. I know this can sometimes cause a delay in their bar or be irritating for some employees (other locations have not been so friendly to correct any errors), but he acted in no such way. He remade the drink very quickly but with no sacrifice to the taste as it's one of the best that I've had thus far. I also think he might be newer to the store so I applaud him for his amazing work. 5 stars for service, efficiency, listening, empathy, and taste! I'm so glad to live close to this location as they truly offer a great Starbucks experience.

Probably one of the worst Starbucks experiences I've ever had. My family stopped during a road trip for a pick me up and realized it was located inside of a target, which was no big deal. There was only one person working and the line was relatively long, which happens. It wasn't frustrating until several target employees came behind the Starbucks counter and started talking to the one worker about coming over after work and asking about evening plans, which she stopped to answer. Thankfully an additional Starbucks employee appeared and took our order. This sped things up but once our drinks came out, they obviously weren't mixed. I asked nicely if they could mix it and the worker flatly stated that they didn't have spoons and don't mix the drinks but that the target food court area had spoons. This was odd to me but I simply mixed the drinks myself while waiting for the last drink. Right before she was going to put whip on my drink I told her I ordered a skinny version and would forgo the whip and she snapped back that some people want whip even if it's skinny. I guess I understand that too, but didn't need the sassy response. Overall, I was just disappointed by the fact that 1. If I'm paying premium prices for a coffee drink, I expect them to be fully made (aka mixed/stirred already) and 2. To be able to ask to have it a certain way without being snapped at or sassed to, especially if I'm being nice to begin with.

To top it off, I'm pretty sure my drink was made incorrectly as it was entirely too sweet compared to how it normally tastes, but decided it wasn't worth asking to be remade. 

If you've got the chance to get coffee elsewhere, I'd recommend it.
Clean, well organized, slightly cramped interior with quality service that makes a pretty solid hibiscus refresher.

Some people say a Starbucks is a Starbucks, but this one certainly stands above most other Starbucks I've visited! I go in a few times a week for iced coffee and not only is the drink perfect, but the service is outstanding! The staff is quick, great at their job, and SUPER friendly! Keep up the good work!
Always happy with the coffee and service here! The staff is friendly and my wait has always been really short.

This Starbucks is always busy! for a long time it was the only one in this area. I know they have added one inside the Publix which shares the same lot as this location, but I do not think a lot of people know this. Anyhow, when I stop by here it's typically an in and out situation as I will put in a mobile order. I will say these baristas work fast. I have never had to wait and also have never had any issues with getting the wrong drink. The taste of my drinks are consistent with my expectations. Personally I love the ice chai latte! The drive through is another option, but at this location this will not get you your order any sooner. I am not kidding when I say they are busy! 

I typically will see people sitting inside and outside on the patio. A lot of them look like they are studying or just catching up with an old friend, typical coffee house stuff.

I'm a Starbucks girl (sorry Dunkin') and this one surprised me. I'd been through the drive through several times but I can in to work today and it's way bigger than I expected. They have tons of seating (low tables, bar tops, comfy chairs, etc) & more importantly, tons of outlets if you're working. 

My drink was perfect, they were quick and friendly. All that you'd expect for a $5 drink. Starbucks always hits the mark with quality and customer service and this store is another example.

The staff at this location are amazing! I've seen 2 different people and they've both been so sweet and quick! The drinks never disappoint. Not to mention I get to shop while drinking my Starbucks. Love it!

Great location for casual business meetings. The staff here has been friendlier than I remember, so it looks like they got some great people to work here! Great customer service 

I love the inside how it's nice and spaced out, and although it seems crowded around the barista counter, there is enough standing room to avoid any awkwardness as far as social distancing is concerned. 

So convenient if you are meeting someone for a consultation or a quick interview. Or a great place to sit inside and work on your computer. I do have trouble with the WiFi connection on my mobile device but that is all Starbucks locations so it's not a secure connection but it's still a nice environment with a caffeinated watering hole.

Such a great location! First of all it's absolutely stunning. I love that each new or redone Starbucks has its own personality and character rather then the same thing store after store! The staff here were incredibly helpful and friendly. I wasn't able to pay by QR Code in App unfortunately for this location as they haven't not received updated equipment.

Remind be to buy the stock SBUX on Monday. This place was rockin on Sunday morning. Only two people working but they cranked it out with a smile. Had the egg white wrap which was yummy.Great location for on the way to LBI.

What can you say about a Starbucks? Nice place to stop, convenient and clean restrooms and generally ok coffee. 

This SB is a brand new one in a brand new building. Inside has an array of seating from cushioned arm chairs to high stools. They also have a long, communal table with stools, but the attraction is plugs for the computers if you need juice for them. 

The equipment is new in several ways. First the POS machines print out sticky tags to go on your cups. No more writing your names on the cups. Second, it seems the coffee drinks have the coffee grounds metered out. Why do I think that? Because the two times we have had Americanos, they seem weaker and less flavorful than when done by human hands packing the grounds. In fact, the ground coffee seems better than the Americanos. Probably won't have them again there. 

Help is attentive and cordial. 

Seating is barely adequate during inclement WX as loungers seem to be taking up seats for long periods of time.

Give Mary a raise!!!! What a sweetheart. I was apprehensive about ordering a drink I'd never had before. Mary reassured me that if I didn't like it she would make me something else. In fact she said, "I don't want you to spend $5 on a drink you don't like." One of the best Starbucks experiences of my life! Also, I love the drink.

I have always loved this location. I lived in St. Pete for a year and this one was my go to. Grande iced with 1 oz of heavy cream and two pumps of sugar free syrup---only 2 carbs! The staff here is are also a plus, very efficient and personable.

First Starbucks app order for my daughter today and all went wrong, then got worse. She ordered the Mango Dragonfruit Refresher with strawberry added (realized she ordered that extra once I returned home). I went to pick it up for her, because I'm a good Dad, and was handed a "clear-ish" looking drink with no explanation. So I asked, "isn't it supposed to be kinda pink?" Was told they're out of Dragonfruit but it wouldn't change the flavor at all. Here's from their website...

"This tropical-inspired pick-me-up is crafted with a refreshing combination of sweet mango and dragonfruit flavors, handshaken with ice and a scoop of real diced dragon fruit."

Turns out that dragonfruit must provide some dragonfruit flavor!! Called them once I got home about the missing strawberries and another worker told me again, after saying I wasn't charged for extra strawberries when my receipt clearly showed I was, that it didn't matter about the dragonfruit and if I drove back to the store she'd refund my 50 cents. That's not the way to correct this. The right answer would've been to refund it through the app or take my name for a future credit, not have me drive back to get a refund of 50 cents because you forgot the strawberry in my daughter's dragonfruit drink...minus the dragonfruit!!! 

We'll go elsewhere.

We absolutely love Starbucks but I think that after Saturday we will probably never go back to this location. Wife special needs daughter and I all tried to order online. Daughter got her order in but both wife and I couldn't get our orders to go in. Online said they were out of wife's frappuccino and my cold brew. Out of cold brew???? So we decided to go in the store. We were in the store 15 minutes and they only waited on 2 people. So we decided to leave. Daughter was just about to get her order so wife and I got out of line and we stepped out the door to wait for her. She got her order (which wasn't even close to what she ordered) and met us in the truck. When she got in I could smell coffee. Whatever they gave her was a hot coffee based drink but service was sooooo bad we decided to not go back in. $5.90 for something she would never drink. I feel they took advantage of a special needs child. Here is a picture of her order which was a cream based Frappuccino.

You have 5 people working. No one in line. 3 people waiting for drinks. Takes over 15min for them to make your drink. Terribly slow service. It's insane. Don't come here unless you have a lot of time. Drink is on par with Starbucks hence the 2 stars instead of just 1 star. But service is beyond slow and unacceptable especially at an airport when everyone is pushing time. Smh.

This is a very nice Starbucks. This is the biggest one I have been in on the East Coast of the USA. Baristas seem friendly and know what they are doing.

I would be a regular at this one if I lived in the area.

I hardly ever get starbucks but everytime i come here they always manage to mess up my order. I ordered a caramel macchiato and i got some other latte. 
I ordered a large green tea and the girl not only walked away without giving me my change ( it was only like 2.50 worth of change so i just gave it to her. After waiting for my change and not getting it i just walked to the side ) but she also gave me a peppermint tea.. Like. How do you mix those up...
They get 2 stars cause SOMETIMES theyre nice..

The staff here are the slowest people I have ever seen. Every time I come here I have to wait as long as 15 mins for a drink and barely anyone is in here! They have one speed at this location... VERY SLOW! The staff doesn't even know how to multi-task. They make one drink at a time! Plan to wait long periods to get your drink when you walk in. Hell a sloth is faster then them and that's embarrassing.

I would really recommend going to the Starbucks on 8801 4th St. N. They have the best staff and make drinks fast.

I love this location.
This is my first time here.
It's so spacious. Plenty of friendly staffs.
Lots of tables and outlet for work and study. 
Right now they decorate the store for fall vibe! 
Love it.

I've had no problems with this location. Service is fairly speedy. Sometimes the employees are a little short, but there's often a line/people trying to book it to their gate so chattiness doesn't serve anyone well. Whenever I've thanked the person handing me my drink I've gotten a genuine you're welcome/have a good day/etc.

On my most recent visit my Frappucino was a little more liquid-y than frozen, which I actually preferred. It kept the bottom from becoming a flavorless pile of snow. 

If you can snag a seat, the chairs in their lounge area across from the counter are considerably more comfortable than the airport seating by the gates. It gets a bit loud with the blenders, but it's not overwhelming. 

Long story short - it's a Starbucks in an airport; either you want it or you don't.
Terrible service, super rude customer service and they were out of everything! And they couldn't be bothered to tell me of this before I asked about each item

Absolutely the worst Starbucks with incompetent staff who asks you to repeat your order 5x and still gets it wrong. Didn't even order a fancy drinks Literally asked for a ice black coffee and they put milk in it...
Service is slow which I can't seem to comprehend since all of their customers are drive thru

This used to be one of my favorite Starbucks but since the construction of Pyramid and McCarren it is a BEAR to get in and out of.  Depending on the time of day it is possible to get in and out quickly even with construction.

The manager and the Barista's are super sweet and if there is ever an issue they will offer to go above and beyond to make sure you get what you ordered. I have been coming to this Starbucks for years. Are mistakes occasionally made? Yes, but that's true for any job. They have always corrected any error that I have found to my satisfaction. What more could you ask for .

I use to know the barista's names here but since the construction. I don't. 

I almost always use the drive thru.

Nothing against this specific location or baristas at this location but Starbucks is not allergy friendly, unfortunately. Starbucks is not Celiac friendly, which makes it difficult to find good coffee in areas where Starbucks is the only option... areas such as this one in TN do not have coffee stands/ drive thrus on every street corner, which is available in places like Seattle, making Starbucks the default coffee joint in smaller cities. Good coffee is good coffee, options are great too and having to rely on the baristas knowledge of ingredients when it comes to a food allergy instead of Starbucks just distributing that information freely to all customers is annoying and unreliable for those of us with Celiac. Seattle has good coffee and great options!

I love Starbucks and enjoy coffee every where I travel. This hands down is the worst location I've been too. Yesterday I asked for two Venti Bold coffees and they asked if that was the dark roast? Then they used water that was room temp for our oatmeal's & the slowest service ever. Today I went back to the location and asked for a "half caf" & I was told they don't have any decaffeinated coffee - when I asked if they could do a pour over... She insisted they had no decaf (even though I had decaf at that location the day before). They forgot my pastry and I didn't realize it until I was out in the car... this place is terrible!
I placed a mobile order on the app and still waited 20 minutes. The barista ended up telling me they were short staffed, but still....

I got here at like 8am. I ordered my drink at 8:13am and it wasn't even ready until 8:36! Lmao like that how packed it was in there and I was sick! Like I couldn't believe it took so long to make my drink. I told the lovely lady at the cashier register my name is Cyn and she wrote Sam. So when my drink was ready I didn't even know bc she wrote the wrong name. On the bright side the inside was very nice. Cute like your average coffee shop.

Good enough.  What I would expect on an early travel morning. No wrong done here.  Just decent lattes at early hours.  Did the trick.  Did its job.  No harm no foul.  Keep churning them out.  Keep the machine running.
The service was terrible here I waited 10 minutes for a coffee and.....it was wrong, such a disgusting disappointment. I know this isn't the best coffee, but it could at least be consistent

Ah, 666 - The Mark Of The Beast. A number so sinister that it has hellacious written all over it. When you reach this milestone on Yelp you clearly have to write about something that represents your idea of hell (or Johnny Brenda's if your Dave H. -1- but he's still the man). So it sounds like the perfect time to sum up exactly how I feel about Starbucks. And since I already spelled it out for you many moons over (http://www.yelp.com/list/i-hate-starbucks-philadelphia) you know exactly where this one is going.

My overall thoughts of Starbucks has nothing to do with service or product. I've had decent service in plenty, and in spots like the one that I'm dropping this review on (you'll go anywhere if certain people suggest it) I've had better than decent. And you can't go wrong with the diverse selections of beans that they bring in, assortment of Tazo teas, and delicious treats that they offer for the most part. Although a lot of the prices can be pretty damn horrendous (there's good reason why I affectionately call them Fourbucks). And they do provide a spacious decor that gives you plenty of room to get some work done if your in a bind (I like the upstairs that this one offers).

But in the land of lush and vibrant indie coffeehouses that is Philadelphia, Starbucks is pretty much the Soulless Empire. When you walk into a place like Chapterhouse that turns it's surroundings into an art gallery; a spot like Last Drop that's packed to the gills with good music, listings for local shows, and gratuitous people watching; or a spot like TBar that hooks up Scrabble and an amazing book exchange; the atmosphere brings you to life. But by comparison the atmosphere of Starbucks manages to suck the life right out of you. Every time I walk in and see the same typical looking art, the same cold plain decor, and total lack of vibrance, I can't help but feel like a corporate slave digging a hole towards a corporate grave no matter what I'm doing. If you ever hear the words "Grande soy latte two sugars" coming out of my mouth feel free to slay me.

But the main reason I hate Starbucks is because, just like rats in the city, they're freaking EVERYWHERE. If you walk down any major Philly street and see a Starbucks, and then it's more than likely that you'll come across another three blocks away, and then ANOTHER! It borders on the unnecessary, but rather than do something to lessen the amount (even when Starbucks announced the closing locations) it feels like their building more (http://www.yelp.com/biz/macys-philadelphia#hrid:6dm686CWJQrzhJAfGOcEwQ). Damn the Empire!

-1- Dave H. did review Johnny Brenda's as his 666. But it wasn't because he found it evil. It was because he didn't put the same significance into the number that I did. and after going to a good show he just felt that it was time to.

The drink and food were on point and came out quickly despite the line of customers in front of me.  It is a long store, so it's pretty skinny and doesn't have a lot of places to sit.  Luckily most people were getting their items to go so we snagged a seat at their bar area and ate there.  Outside customers were smoking (which is not allowed at the Starbucks in our hometown), so we had to stay inside to avoid the grossness.

The counter wasn't clean, but they were busy, so I get it.  You need a code for their single bathroom, so be sure to ask when you are in line so you don't have to go back up and ask!

It's a hit or miss...... this place is NOT consistent on making their drinks... only the morning staff can make your coffee right...  I order Chestnut praline... the 1st drink was order from drive through ... the 2nd drink I had to do a online pick FYI they end up giving me caramel frappe when I order CHESTNUT PRALINE.. smh

Diese befindet sich direkt hintern Eingang zum Casino, ohne Ausweis gibt es kein Zugang.

Recht klein der Laden, es war auch nicht viel los frühs. Ein Starbucks wie jeder anderer auch, Angebot identisch zu allen anderen. Was mir hier gut gefallen hat waren die beiden Damen die Dienst hatten, beide sehr nett und gut drauf.

Mein Chai Tea Latte war sehr gut, kann es immer sein.
The remodel of this location is AMAZING!! The staff is great but they still struggle with slow speeds and parking is a nightmare. Hoping they figure out a way to fix that soon!

Great place to stop before class or while studying for a quick pick me up and snack. Depending on what time and what is going on around campus you can be waiting on line for awhile. Convenient for students.

This location is always a disaster,  the drive thru line never moves. I sat in line for 20 minutes before deciding to just order online and go inside for pickup. When I got inside nobody acknowledged anyone coming or going, I walked up to the counter to get my drink and they had several cups labeled for anyone to take. There is no rhyme or reason, they don't offer assistance or ask if they can hell you locate your order. 7 different workers looked at me and walked away. I could literally have taken anybodys order and walked out,  or worse tampered with people's drinks. This place is filled with college kids that are simply there to hang out and gossip instead of work. 
I will not be coming back to this location,  honestly I am shocked that anybody comes here.
Perhaps the place would run smoother if there were actually adults keeping the chaos in line. If I could give 0 stars I would, This filthy establishment doesn't deserve any business.
My croissant sandwich was burnt I went there early and it still took a while to get my food.

It is always something at this Starbucks.  Yesterday and today it was a lecture about requesting a straw for my drink.  They have started putting sippy cup lids on the drinks.  The lecture has something to do with saving the planet.  The girl that told me this yesterday was so rude and awful that I shouldn't have gone back today.  I did. My mistake.  Got the same lecture in a gentler tone.  I find it hard to believe they are trying to save sea life when they are still using plastic cups and even bigger plastic lids.  Not to mention the straws come wrapped in paper and my mouth is only touching something I touched not 2-5 Starbucks employees.
Line for DT was CRAZY. Go inside only to find the employees standing around chatting with no urgency for their job. Do better. Have higher standards for your employees.

This Starbucks is located directly across from Jim's.  Jim's was pretty crowded so we decided to head over to Starbucks, grabbed a drink there, and sat down to eat our Jim's sandwiches here.  BIG MISTAKE.  This Starbucks is the motherland for flies. It was disgusting!!! Instead of enjoying my sandwich, I was fighting off more than a dozen flies. I don't know why this place has so many flies. Even Jim's did not have any flies and their doors are always open due to the long lines!

For coffee drink purposes, this Starbucks is great. Service was fast and my drink was good.  But if you want to sit and rest, think twice!!!

This is one of the ones I go to a lot. They always make my Soy Chai Latte just how I like it. 

The parking situation can get a little crazy sometime. Don't get confused if you go to the drive thru. One lane is for Starbucks the other one is for the bbq place next door.

They open at 5:30 AM. 5:35 AM "Order ahead not available."  

So I drive up to the location to order the coffee at the store, less than 2 miles away. THEY ARE CLOSED!!! Yet when I look on the mobile app, it gives the impression they are open.  

On a usual daily basis, after 9 AM, order ahead is usually not available. 

Of all my travels, this is likely the WORST Starbucks ever.

Worker Bridget P ( making special coffees)is not wearing a mask over her nose and mouth- it is around her neck- also her assistant( an older lady) this am revealed her family dirty laundry to all waiting and ordering coffee! Not a good image for Terminal C at Lambert today at 5 am.  We need professionalism in STL - we already have customer service problems at the Lambert Starbucks much less women showing their rudeness during business hours!!!

I'm not sure why Starbucks gets so much bad publicity and poor reviews!  Guessing it's the sheer size and magnitude of a corporation and haters gonna hate.

Well, if you weren't surprised I love Starbucks and I'm a huge fan of founder and CEO Howard Schultz and the work and ethics that go into his company.

Imo the coffee is very good, the service is usually very friendly and astute and the app is a game changer. 

Being able to order ahead at a million locations and have your tasty beverage awaiting your arrival and skip the long lines is amazing! 

Also, you earn rewards towards future tasty beverages yay.

Also, Starbucks offers heavy cream as an option for those of us on low carb diets and also all natural, low carb sweetener.

Stop the madness and rate fairly please.

Thanks for stopping by :)

This place gets pretty crowded but it's right next to my work so it's easy for me. Mobile orders seem to be a little longer than other locations but they move the line quickly  for the sound of people that come here! They really should have a larger space as people tend to have quick meetings here and the sitting area is quite limited!

Loved this location, it is such a neat building and in such a neat area.  Service was great and the atmosphere was fantastic.  Wish all Starbucks were modeled after this one in terms of the layout of the inside and the design of the building.  Super neat place

This has got to be the worst  display of a starbucks that I have ever seen... There are 5 people behind the counter, one person making drinks, when a drink is finished they just set it on the counter, no names called, no one had a clue if it was theirs or not!!! The place is filthy, and all the while the employees are laughing and being ridiculous in the middle of this chaos!! There was a 10-15 minute wait for our drinks... We pay alot of money for our coffee and we appreciate a little more professionalism at starbuck that what this starbucks displays!!! And this was gate C
Bike rack, great arrows & social distancing visual aids on floor- servuce is always sketchy here- but I'm impressed w/their adherence to CDC standards

This Starbucks is a perfect model for customers on the go, even for impatient customers who are always in a rush like myself. We all know when we don't have our coffee + we are rushing, grumpiness can ensue. The staff here though is on top of it, friendly and fast.. even when dealing with not-so-patient customers like myself! Will always come back here when it's convenient.
Great service. The baristas were so polite and patient with my little ones figuring out what they wanted to order. They loved how their drinks came out and wanted more.

After being disappointed by the breakfast offerings at my hotel, I wandered over to this location. This was a Sunday morning, so downtown Wilmington's pickings were going to be slim at best. 

But this joint was open. Just one customer inside, with two servers, with a homeless lady pacing back and forth outside. As I was ordering my White Chocolate Mocha, another disheveled-looking woman came in claiming to be waiting for somebody. Cashiers were cool with that, and to be sure, this lady wasn't crazy or anything, it just looked like she wasn't having a good hair day.

My drink stayed in my hand for about an hour as I wandered the streets before heading south for a baseball game. I can't say there was anything spectacular about the drink, but it did what it had to do.

Well i don't know where to start.  One thing this place is always packed!! This is my first time having Starbucks...yeah it's true why you ask well probably because i hate the smell of coffee so if it wasn't for a gift card i would have never tried them. Like i mentioned its always packed so we walked in the service was perfect i ordered a blueberry muffin and a Apple juice it came out nice and warm and was damn good. I can honestly see why folks are crazy about this place I'm just not into all the coffee and lattes it's just not my thing and for the record i almost died from the coffee smell while waiting for the order lol.

We came in to get two drinks, they made my flat white hot instead of cold, but the lady was really sweet and had no issues fixing the order, gave me the hot and cold flat white. While we were waiting she even offered another drink that they made by accident or extra. So we came in for two drinks and left w four. Awesome luck lol
Stand alone Starbucks located outside the travel plaza, much more convenient than going inside the plaza if coffee is the only reason for your stop.

If I could give zero stars for this store I would.  I had the unfortunate experience to witness a woman and her daughter being accosted by a staff member of Starbucks in Fishtown, Philadelphia.  I was in line waiting for a coffee when a women came in and asked her daughter what was taking so long to get her coffee.  It appeared the young lady was waiting well over 15 minutes for a large coffee.  The woman asked a staff member to check to see what the issue was since she was waiting so long.  The staff member immediately started verbally attacking the woman and shouting this is white privilege.  Another staff member came over who claimed to be a manager but did not or could not get the other staff member to stop verbally attacking the customer.  In very short order 4 staff members were all talking at the same time and getting louder and louder at the poor woman, who only wanted her daughter to get her paid for coffee and leave.

As to white privilege, I find it to be totally outrageous that a staff member would immediately start attacking a women with that claim, especially in Fishtown.  This area is not what you would call a white privilege area.  It is a medium to lower middle class neighborhood.  I find the entire encounter to be disgraceful and a very bad reflection on the Starbucks management team.  It is clear to me now that Starbucks willingly promotes this type of behaviour from their staff.

Suffice it to say, I will never visit this Starbucks again and have serious doubts as to whether or not I want to patronize any Starbucks again.  

Starbucks needs to wake up and smell the proviable coffee!  Who do they think is actually paying $7.00 for a cup of coffee!  It's certainly not the poor and downtrodden.

Today I came in for the oatmeal. Over all, it's pretty good. It's comes with multiple toppings that you have the choice to add to your oatmeal. They also provide you with agave syrup and brown sugar, so you have a choice of sweetener. I would get it again.

What a great experience! Haven't been to a Starbucks in quite a while. Ran out of vanilla creamer at home so went to this Starbucks Drive-thru. The drive-thru went quickly. The order screen was a live feed of the person taking the order. This man was so energetic and nice!  Came up to the window to another employee who really seemed to enjoy their job. She offered my two dogs a 'Pup'-pucino (whip cream in a shot cup). They loved it. (A little messy but...). My large Skinny Vanilla Latte was delicious. Great start to the day!

The service at this Starbucks was absolutely terrible. I ordered a pumpkin spice chai tea latte and instead of  the cashier asking me if I wanted a receipt, she crumpled it up and threw it away. I waited for a good 30-40 minutes. I then went up to the cashier to ask for my order and they didn't even have my order up! So I waited another 10 minutes for my drink. And then one of the cashiers accused me of stealing the drink and was trying to get me to pay for it again. I told him I already paid for it but I didn't have a receipt because the cashier crumpled it up. Then I left.

I work at the hospital across the street and this is my go to for morning coffee! The employees are all SUPER friendly and take the time to make each interaction personable! My coffee always hits the spot and gets me through my long days!

I would give this location five stars if they would figure out the drive-thru process. Making people circle back around the building to exit the drive thru is less than efficient (and safe). However, the folks who work there are generally pleasant, service is quick and we're always happy with our drinks!

Made a stop here before heading back from a weekend get-a-way. There's no drive-thru which I didn't like. There is a parking lot and the Starbucks​ is located at​ the end of the first little strip mall surrounded by other little shops. This location was nice and clean. The service was nothing less than very friendly. Also,​ this location is located up the street from USF which I'm sure can become pretty packed with college students meeting and studying. The bathroom was also nice and clean. If I'm ever in the area again I'd definitely make a stop for my favorite cup of brew.

This Starbucks has been recently remolded. Very sleek and urban.
Really cool wall art. 
I've always had pretty nice service here.

So just your regular Starbucks coffee shop with the usual stuff. I spent a whole afternoon here doing some paperwork after a weekend of working overtime in Tampa.  Baristas were polite and attentive. This shop was always crowded because it is near USF.  Store did look like it needed som TLC and floor was dusty.

This is my most frequented Starbucks due to the fact that it is close to my office, but I also really like the staff! Everyone who has helped me has been extremely kind! I'm that girl who is known to have full on conversations with the staff members when the restaurant is not too busy! My only "complaint" is that they use stickers to mark your order on your cup rather than in hand writing with a Sharpie! The Sharpie makes me feel special for some reason. Haha!

I needed a late afternoon fix and slipped into this store because it is the closest to friends with whom I hoped to connect for dinner. There was an unbelievable downpour and it seemed prudent to get off the road and "just chill!"

This Starbucks is like hundreds I've been to all over the country -- cozy, modern, busy and predictably, friendly.

I didn't experience anything above and beyond and I didn't observe anything Starbucks wouldn't be proud of... What I saw was exactly what Starbucks set out to create:  a comfortable refuge from the rest of the world where you can get a good cuppa Joe, maybe something to nosh, and either get stuff done or "just chill" with (or without) friends.

They literally have idiots working there spent a good 10mins in the driver tru window waiting on the young guy to give me my change. My total was 13.50 and so I gave him 15.50 and that confused him! It was a complete weird situation as the guy had the registe in his face to help he was lost disoriented and my frappe double shot was horrible!!

Stargetbucks...Lol, this is our nickname for this Starbucks which is located inside Target on Sierra Center Parkway. Great location and what better way to get a little pick me up when heading in to do a little shopping! Staff is usually very friendly and quick to get their orders out but can you please get rid of that large awkward order monitor that you have to look around to see me when I tell you my order? There has to be a better place to put that thing... 

On a more personal note, I've been to a lot of Starbucks locations but this is the first Starbucks I have been to that does not ask for your name... I asked "don't you need my name..." and the cashiers response was "nope, your good" When there a lot of people standing around waiting for their drinks it would be nice to know who owns that order. 

If the order is called out for a certain drink and someone else ordered the same size and drink as you... there is a moment of awkwardness when you both head up to get 'that' drink they called out...personal experience. Once you do get your order, there is plenty of seating which is also shared with Targets food area or you can just be on your way to complete your shopping!
Always always always out of something. Slower than slow. Dirty and not too good of customer service. It's what you expect from the area I guess.

Came in to get a mug for my mom and a cup o' joe along the way -- Got what I needed and more all thanks to a very special barista named Deniz!

Deniz took the time to find me a mug that was a part of the holiday sale. With his help, I finally decided on a cute festive little number.

He also made my day, complimenting my hair and providing the best customer service a girl could hope for. He went above and beyond, which I can't say about most Starbucks workers (and I don't blame them, they're overworked/underappreciated).

As Deniz so eloquently put it "keep it cute, girl"!!

I love Starbucks, obviously. But it just seems as if this particular location is always extremely slow. I have to leave my house 30 minutes early to be able to stop and get a coffee because it takes so long to get through the drive-through line. I then tried ordering inside the store and it took just as long. For whatever reason this location just has poor time management.

This is one of the better Starbucks at the airport. They are as slow as the others but my drink is always made correctly and I don't mind the wait if there is not going to be any surprises. 

They still have their seating closed off because of Covid and do not have the cream and sugar station available. Their merchandise is stocked and they have the full Starbucks menu of items to choose from. 

I added two Been There series mugs to my coffee order and love the design.

Staff is good, friendly. Coffee is what you'd expect at a starbucks. 

The biggest problems are:

The inside is really small. People will sit reading a book for hours at one of the two tables with electrical outlets. 

The parking lot is small and dangerous. Getting in and out of the lot is really dangerous. Better off parking in the lot behind the Starbucks an walking over.

Horrible! I ordered ahead from home. It takes 6 minutes to get to the store. I can see they are busy, do I wait 5 more minutes before going in. No croissant, no drink. At the 22 minute mark, I get my croissant. 5 minutes later, still no drink. I ask to make sure it didn't get lost - nope, "it'll take me a few more minutes to get to yours." I wait and wait and finally get "a" drink after waiting a total of 30 minutes. But not the drink I ordered. I got an iced drink when I clearly ordered a hot drink (and the tag on the drink does not say iced, so...? Aargh! Other people were getting their drink long minutes apart as well. My croissant was no longer warm by the time I got my drink. I KNOW that people who order at the drive-thru are not waiting 30 minutes once they've ordered to get their order, and their full orders are coming up all about the same time. This was the worst experience I've ever had at a Starbucks. Go to a different one if you can!

Went to Starbucks this morning because I wanted coffee, and just got paid. Something about paying for overpriced coffee just makes it taste so much better, am I right? I pull in the entrance and have to wait in line. Booo. I thought about parking and just walking in, but immediately turned down that dumb idea. If I'm tired enough that I'm willing to pay $5 for some caffeine, there ain't no way I'm leaving my car. I'd hate to overexert myself. Noo way. The line moved fast, I ordered my drinks. I watched a bug fly around the car in front of me. Everything is running smoothly at this point. I get to the window. The barista was super nice, I pay for my drinks - I'll regret the purchase later. I included a tip -because good karma and suches (probably). Drinks were great - well mine was. The other was for my mom, but I'll just assume hers was good too. 

Overall, great time. Coffee good. 5 trillion stars.

The only thing good about this location was that the two ladies working it were very friendly. Long lines and slow service. The prices were so much higher than any other Starbucks. They crossed out the prices with black sharpie in the display case and increased them when putting in the register. An egg wrap and a latte was $20.

Person is refusing to serve me because they are out of the cups needed to make my drink. But I can see her literally making other people's orders in similar cup? I asked why and am told it's against their policy?

They are constantly out of product. The staff is slow and don't seem to understand that running out of the same thing every day by 9 am means that you should make more of it. They can't complete simple tasks like putting mobile order labels on the correct order - then acting incensed when questioned about whose food is whose.

Super friendly. I usually go to the drive thru and it's always the same guy there. I forget his name. He's young, kinda tall and has dark hair. He's always very nice and doesn't laugh at me even though I'm usually putting on purple lipstick when I pull up. Lol. I know Kathryn is the manager there and she's awesome too. This location definitely has the best staff of any Starbucks I've ever been to.

I'm a HUGE fan of this Starbucks. It's the closest one to where I live, and the workers there are ALWAYS friendly. I always feel like I'm talking to an old friend, even though I typically only go a few times a year (I can't stay away from the Pumpkin spice frap...YUM!)

I've been through the drive thru a few times, and they have doggy treats in the window for your furry friends. How sweet! :)
So far I've had nothing but fast and accurate service no matter the time of day. Very happy with the service.

I like this Starbucks!!

For one, it's a decently sized Starbucks with plenty of places to sit down, and is usually not too busy (c'mon - this is Audubon, after all.) More importantly though, the people who work here are SO nice! They take a personal interest in their customers.

My friend asked for them to make an Oreo Frapp, which is kind of like a secret "off-menu" item, and they followed his instructions and made it right!

These baristas are the BEST!

I've been to probably over 100 different Starbucks.  This particular Starbucks is the most friendly and consistent I've been to.  The other day they gave me my order for free for a Christmas present.  That's great customer service.  It's located in the Hyatt so it's  quite busy during conventions,  but the speed of service is great.  They always have enough staff,  and they are all friendly.
The barista was the rudest Starbucks employee I have ever encountered. Take your money elsewhere. Costumer service here is truly lacking.
Clean shop.  Orders taken quickly and correctly.  Coffee arrived hot and fast and perfectly made.

Placed the order. Within in 60 seconds was at the front window. Scanned card. Left lot and realized that there was no mocha drizzle that was extra money. Their answer to this issue was waste your gas and come with your Starbucks card to get your change back. No apologies. No omg, let us replace this for you. Both Van and Holly were spoken to and asked if they could refund it without having to go all the way back there. their answer was there is nothing we can do. What kind of customer service is this. That the person taking your order in 60 seconds has forgotten what the order should be?

This Starbucks is close to my work and I probably should have learned my lesson by now. They are slow and it's loud. I came in today to grab a quick latte between meetings and waited well over 15 minutes when there were only 4 people in line in front of me. The service is only Ok. I will not be returning.
No toilet paper or paper towels in the bathroom on Christmas Day. Yuck.

Probably my least favorite Starbucks in the area.  I've been here probably a dozen times and no one is ever friendly.  Fortunately for SBX there are several other locations in the area.  Unfortunately for this store, I won't be back.

So yeah its just a starbucks. but its got a lot of interesting things going on.

  I walk inside and talk to the folks making the drinks, ya know friendly conversation , and I told them I'm new in town  and it all went fine until I told them where i moved from! and all i can see is a lot of eye rolling .. and yes I'm not going to mention where i moved from!    I sat down, and soon the place filled up with a bunch of girls who were loud and obnoxious , which is fine cause it was good entertainment to watch! Overall it was an interesting experience. I enjoyed the music, the coffee and the free entertainment! 
 just don't go there to study cause i tried doing that and i didn't get anywhere with it.

The first time I came here was during the morning rush and the line was REALLY long, but I needed my cup of coffee. Lol. Even though the line was out the door it went by pretty fast. The Barista that made my drink was so nice! She called my name as soon as my drinks were ready (I ordered my favorite holiday drink: Grande Nonfat Caramel Brûlée latte & Hubby's Venti Caramel Frap with extra caramel) and she even told me if I didn't like it or needed more caramel to just let her know. But it was perfect! For years I've been going to Starbucks and no one has ever told me that especially when they are super, super busy. I could tell right away the baristas working here love there job. They have the best customer service and value there customers.
Always friendly service with a smile. Talkative as well  I like when the employees suggest food items to pair with my drink. And most know me by name now lol

if I could give this place negative stars I would. Saturday, I went to get my morning iced coffee before a double shift at work. Having no time to go inside and wait forever for a simple drink ( @ 9:30 AM), I had my grandmother go through the drive through. BIGGEST MISTAKE. when i pulled up to the speaker, I was greeted by a very happy and peppy girl's voice...ordered a VENTI ICED CARAMEL MACCHIATO, girl read the order back as such and gave me the total. I pulled up to the window and was handed a GRANDE. I politely told her i ordered a VENTI. Her peppy tone quickly turned argumentative as she rudely said "no you didn't you ordered a grande". then the argument turned into "this is what you're going to do" as she tried to instruct me (at this point already late for work) to pull into a parking space and wait another 1/2 hour for my correct drink. I refused due to the attitude she had with me (after I paid for a VENTI).
Consistently the longest wait times I've ever experienced for a coffee shop. I would go somewhere else if not for the lack of any other competition at the mall. Please increase your staffing.

If you're looking to buy coffee beans skip this location.  The past three times I've stopped here, they didn't have what I was looking for.  Thet always say they have the kind I am looking for in the back but come back empty handed.

Very deserving of full stars. Service was prompt as people were in line, a staff took orders onto the sleeve to present to cashier. I received greeting when at cashier and the drink was piping hot and tasted excellent (compared to some barista). 

Even helped me fill up my thermos with hot water free of charge, for baby formula.

Saw a staff clean up some cereal on the floor. Thru are good to keep place clean and tidy!

Great and clean location inside new GSR hotel.

I came with a work colleague just to take a walk for some fresh air really.  I ended up getting a small Berry Hibiscus Refresher (low-cal, no caffeine, minimal sugar), and I really enjoyed it.  It was a good pick me up in the mid-afternoon.  And I didn't think it was majorly expensive like many items they have.  Baristas were friendly, and service was quick.

I am a huge fan of Starbucks and I usual come everyday. I've been stopping at this particular Starbucks since mid-October because my morning commute changed. Unfortunately, I've been disappointed with this Starbucks on many occasions, mainly due to inconsistency in the quality and taste of my drinks. I always order a latte or a cappuccino. Lately, I've been drinking more cappuccinos because the lattes I've been getting here taste so weak. Being that a cappuccino has less milk, I've been going with that. I don't think I should have to order an extra shot just to get a latte that doesn't taste like pure milk. The younger girls who work here make better drinks and deliver good customer service. There is an older lady who works here who lacks in both categories. I feel bad pointing this out, but I shouldn't have to feel like a burden when I come here. Maybe service would be better if we could tip? I'm not a difficult customer. In fact, I have great working relationships with all of the baristas in my hometown store in Wyomissing. I've never had a single complaint there. Honestly, I don't even care as much about the service as long as I'm getting excellent drinks. Maybe they're neglecting to tend to the espresso machine properly?

This Starbucks does not rock my world in any way but I have to stop here when I am in Tampa because I am always driving by it on my way back to Orlando and convenience matters more than quality.  Service is generally fine -- good but unremarkable.  The speed of service, however, costs the location its stars.  I find that the wait time here is often far too long, even when there is not a huge line.  Still, where there are no other real options and time is of the essence, you will find that you get what you need and sometimes that is enough.

I am a student currently living around the CBD and have walked to several coffee shops around the area. I cannot sing enough praises about this Starbucks. This is hands-down the best coffee shop in the city. Almost never too crowded and a good chance you have a table or couch to sit on and enjoy your coffee while having a meeting or getting some studying done. 

Some of the most pleasant baristas you will ever meet. Check it out!

I'm not familiar with this location, but I stopped in on break from a short road trip, and was greeted by three staff members, who were all very pleasant! They joked with me, and even shared some Starbucks knowledge with me. 

Shout out to these superstars: Andorra, Kristen, and Trina. Wonderful spirits. Great customer service.

I *will* be back the next time I'm in Philly!

(4) ~ Very good food & service...They have a Clover Brewing System, which makes a GREAT cup of coffee!;)  And a very good selection of cold beverages & Baked Good items.  My favorite is the Flourless Chewy Chocolate Cookie which I recommend heated up;)

We went during the happy hour promo-50% off! The line was almost out the door in an already high volume store- add happy hour and it's super insane. The line moved slow & it was hot as hell in the store, so we were standing in a long line awhile. . . but it took even longer to get the drinks. My daughter got her drink then 10 minutes later I got mine. The coffee bar area was total chaos in my opinion. I had to ask for my drink and the baristas are somewhat friendly but super busy and it was hard to get their attention. I ordered the decaf double chocolatey chip frap.  The drink was a treat with whipped cream aplenty. Mmmm!! 

Because the store is so busy, all the tables were dirty. Not a great impression. People pay tons of money for these drinks. I don't get the allure of Starbucks but my daughter enjoys it so I do go on occasion.

This is a full service (not a small satellite) Starbucks in the Hyatt. Good for a light breakfast if the more expensive hotel restaurant does not appeal to you. 

As for the quality of food and service, it is exactly what you would expect from a Starbucks, consistent.

You almost never see this location without a line in the drive-thru or a full cafe! This is THE place in the IRV where folks gather for business meetings, after-school study sessions, sewing circles and book clubs. You'll find a cornucopia of people here!

Wait times here are sometimes longer than other locations - sometimes suspiciously long when, after what seems like ten years, I only see one beverage handed over. And occasionally, a group of rowdy teenagers will interrupt gossip time with your best girlfriend. But outside of that, there's little here to frown upon. 

The place is cute and well-kept, and the baristas are friendly enough. Obviously the drinks and treats don't stand out from any other generic Starbucks. 

Certainly there are other locations I could travel to that would lessen my wait time, but it's really the convenience to my home that keeps me coming back time and time again.
This Starbucks starts sweeping and taking all the food away an hour before closing.  I don't like this.  Why come if they are closing at 10pm

Very slow, unfriendly workers with unimpressive barista skills. 

Plan to spend a good part of your morning in their drive thru and when you get to the window you will realize they can't queue drinks to save their lives. And good luck not getting your order messed up.

I live in Irvington so I may be a bit biased, but I am in-love with this Starbucks. They are always fast and friendly. They somehow make the drinks better. They always add extra syrup or whatever they can add. I love the location and the atmosphere. If I ever leave Irvington, I might just travel here to get some Starbucks because no other place compares. Haha.

Went in here for a quick pitstop Tuesday afternoon to re-energize my system with some go-go juice.

I ordered a Triple Grande soy latte.

This Starbucks has a Drive-Thru. While I was waiting, I noted to myself that it was weird to see Starbucks Barista's with headsets on. I pulled my pocket camera out and was about to snap off a shot of them with their headsets on and they yelled out "NO! You can't take pictures in here!" I inquired as to why? I sarcastically asked if my taking a picture of their Drive-Thru operation was going to reveal Top Secret Starbucks plans.

The manager came over and told me that they were more concerned with maintaining the privacy of their employees. I'll buy that argument - we all know what a bunch of stalker types all of you Yelpers are!

There was lots of inside seating here - and some outside seating as well. A number of folks were working away on laptops, presumably utilizing the T-mobile connection wireless internet connection.

I'll never come back here again since I was not allowed to take a picture! ;-)

Nice and has large open space , plenty of seating at bar , inside and out.

Staff friendly and very knowledgable.
The drinks are great. The women working the counters? Not so much. They're all really rude and mean for no reason.. If you hate your job so much, find a new one

I was at Starbuck in Edgemont, Pennsylvania today February 19, 2017 at 2:15pm to get a drink. The young gentleman at cashier whom took my order is very pleasant. He did a great job. I was very happy with his customer services. On the other hand, the barista who made the drink whom was a young girl, she's very judgmental based on customer looks and their race. She looked at the customers and shake her head with a despised manners for no reasons. It was DISGUSTING. Shamed on you little girl and Starbuck need to get their rules straight when training their staffs. It is sad to say that this is an ongoing problems at multiple starbuck locations. STARBUCK, please train your staff right. An upscale business needs professional customer services. I love starbuck but time after time of disappointments, I gotta rethink about walk in to one. Sorry.
It was great other than the fact that our online order didn't work. They are good at advice because we asked for recommendations

An incredible staff at all hours. They are to a man and woman friendly,personable,efficient ,and professional. They remember your name and favorite drink and deliver it quickly. If you miss a day they are genuinely concerned that everything is  ok. Coming to this store each day is a great experience. Highly recommended.

This Starbucks is always packed due to it's location in the mall. My mom and I decided to go during the Frapp Happy Hour. The line was insanely long and we waited over 25 minutes for the drinks. The bar where you pick up the drinks was very disorganized, people were picking drinks up that weren't theirs, some drinks were not labeled, etc. I'm pretty sure I picked up someone else's drink (they shared the same name as my mom's and it was the same drink I ordered), but my moms drink was missing. She had to go up and ask them where her drink was. I'm sure they ended up tossing a lot of drinks away and had drinks missing due to the volume the store was experiencing. I would try to avoid this place unless you don't mind waiting an inordinate amount of time for coffee. On the plus side, the cashier was pleasant and the frapps were bomb.
Visiting at least three times a week. It's not like that I really have a choice, but I don't hate it. Close to VanPelt. Convenient location.
Great drinks and many options. Very fast and friendly service. Really really good brownies. Clean and welcoming atmosphere. And FREE WIFI

Just visited drive thru for 2nd time in a week. They obviously don't understand what NO cheese means... Also my coffee cup had some kind of leak on the bottom and leaked all over me and my truck. Maybe it's bad luck. They never get the order correct.. Strange
Love this Starbucks! Very nice staff and they're pretty fast! It can get busy on weekends with all the bike riders and people out and about but this crew can get the job done.

The people at this starbucks are very friendly. When I walk in on a sunny morning, they are cheery and happy to help. Most of them rememeber my name, which is not an easy one for most. 

This location is always clean and never has a long line (at least at the time of day I end up going). Lots of parking, and a cute little patio to sit on outside. Some other locations feel smaller, but this location has plenty of room to sit and read, do homework, or visit with friends.

I have been to many Starbucks I have never had such rude service. We had just finished spending 45 dollars in drinks and they forgot to make one. While making the one they forgot a customer asked the barista how was it going and he replied would be better if I didn't have to put people sugar in their coffee. I have always had baristas put my sugars in for me never a problem. They had no manager at that location working talked to a supervisor she said sorry he must have been having a bad day and she said but we do have sugar available. She was no help at all.  That store number is 5621 don't go to that location if your used to great service. Keep driving to the one inside of Von's on linden.  Sorry to say this Starbucks was the worst one I have ever experienced.
My favorite Starbucks location by far! Baristas are super friendly and fast. Love using mobile order in the mornings! Great atmosphere inside and out!

I don't think there's a Starbucks in existence that has actually figured out how to have a layout that's good in terms of seating.  But there are definitely better ones in the immediate area better than this one.  Very limited seating.  If you like to hang out at a Starbucks and get work done or socialize, this is not the place for that.  Which is a shame, because the location is so good.

Staff is nice.  Fare is standard Starbucks quality.
