But there's a absolutely terrible woman who has been there every single time I've gone the past year or two who takes up the corner, never actually buys anything except a cup of water for her tea, talks loudly, and shoots dirty glances to every customer who sits down as if they're taking up her space.  She's either a homeless person who always goes there or the owner.  Either way, they really need to start locking that down.
There are many Starbucks choices in he area, but what makes the experience worth it is the staff. They treat you like family.

Not a review about their delicious coffee..  Staying at Starbucks makes me wonder about life... What are my hopes and dreams? Did Howard Schultz have the same dream in transforming this incredible brand into "america's third place"? Who are these people sitting around me and what are their hopes and dreams? This is one of the few
Places I can soak in my own presence and mindfulness; to slow down, embrace and appreciate life. I thank everyone who works here for their professional and prompt service; especially this cool Barista Chris, who has an incredible positive and bright personality. Sweeter than Frappucino.

I will miss this Starbucks very much. The staff at this location was there for me every step of the way throughout the last year of my degree while I lived in the area (at the lofts). They always remembered your face and your preferences. Very friendly and helpful. The store is always very clean and works like clockwork. I never had to wait for my drink unless I was chatting it up! I will miss it very much.

The worst customer service ever. Waited while people who were behind me, got their drinks. Saw 5 orders made that were wrong and had to be redone. One three times! 

Starbucks area manager - you had best get over here and do some training.

Unorganized.. unmotivated. Unhappy...
Enjoyed the quick cup of coffee!  Nice location right of of Main Street.
One of my favorite SBUX in the area. Friendly and knowledgeable. They know my order when I walk in. Always clean and bathrooms are spotless.

What happened to the staff from when it was the old Starbucks? Are they all gone now? I miss them! They used to be so much quicker, now it takes me at least 5+ min for a drink (and I get iced tea, which is already made--they just need to add ice!!!). Forget the drive thru, even when the line is short it takes a good ten minutes.  I have noticed a slight improvement over the past few weeks, but the staff still is usually too busy joking around with each other to actually be efficient. I understand enjoying yourself while you work but when the line is ten deep inside with 5-7 cars in the drive through it's time to move a little faster.  

I would like to give 2.5 stars but since it's not an option I rounded up, because even though it's slow, everyone there is nice.

I've visited this location on a few occasions and various times of the day. I've never visited and received prompt service, it's always an extraordinarily long wait for basic items. I visit the other Seminole location off of Bryan Dairy and receive outstanding service. I don't know what it is about this specific location but I hope they improve it soon or many people like meal just visit other Starbucks in the area

The service given might not always be the fastest, but as a customer and retail worker, when customers are not friendly it really doesn't help anything, in order for the customer experience to be improved people have to stop being such buttholes, you get what you give. As retail workers we always try hard to please the customers and make sure that they get the best service, but honestly, as a customer we also have a choice. I read a couple reviews on here, and to be honest if you go to a restaurant and the line is long or the wait time is too long, would you really want to sit there for more than 10 mins?! I know I wouldn't, I can't count how many times I've walked out of places because the line was too long or the wait time was too long. Let's be realistic if you are not patient enough to wait in line, we as customers have the choice to go else where, so don't take it out on the workers, that doesn't help at all. Now if you were not pleased with the product you got, speak up, I'm sure they would not have an issue giving you something else, and if the workers are doing a great job, give them feedback, don't just complaint when something's wrong, also let be known when people are doing are great job. With that said, let's all get a cup of coffee, and call it a day.

You can never go wrong with Starbucks for some caffeine... but this Starbucks is especially classy. That's probably because this location is right across the street from the Penn Law School. Of course, the menu is the same anywhere you go.

One of my new favorites is the Vivanno - which is a fruit-based smoothie, which a shot of espresso can be added to! A yummy meal in itself.

I know airport Starbucks locations will generally be a step down from standalone locations, but I really don't care for this one in particular. 

Located at the base of A concourse at the IND airport, it is in a very convenient location for anyone flying Delta or United and as such generally has very long lines.  Not their fault directly, but they tend to be very slow, which exacerbates the problem.

In addition, I find that they are often out of things, especially on the food side.  They often also get my order wrong or leave items out entirely.

The staff is also not up to Starbucks standards.  They are not friendly and generally don't engage the customers well at all.  Recently, when I stopped in here, their scanner for the mobile app Starbucks card wasn't working.  The lady seemed very put out that I was using one and demanded I read the numbers to her.  She then cut me off mid-sentence because I was "reading too fast."

I like Starbucks far better, but at this point, I think I'll go to Copper Moon when I need coffee at the airport.

Panic attack in a parking lot.  I feel like this review is long overdue.  Every single time I leave the Brentwood Starbucks I feel like I've been through a battle.  Not only is the parking lot a nightmare, making it difficult for the people going in as well as the drive thru, but the service is unbelievably slow, they get orders wrong all of the time, and the staff either doesn't want to wait on you, or wants to talk to you all day.  There are problems here.  Most people don't have 15+ minutes to dedicate to waiting for coffee!

I hate writing negative reviews but being that this is the Starbucks that is literally 1 minute from my house, I've been coming to this location for years and It's only getting worse, this review is justified.  Lately I've realized it actually takes less time for me to head to the Rock Hill or Webster Starbucks than to wait on Brentwood.  The other locations have me in and out within 5 minutes no matter how long the line (which is awesome!)  Brentwood needs to take a cue from their fellow stores and step it up a notch.

I come to this Starbucks a few times a week since I work next to the mall and everyone who works here is SUPER nice! The drinks are always right and delicious. Sometimes there's a longer line than most Starbucks but think about it people, coffee + the kop mall, of course it's going to be busy! Worth taking 5 minutes out of your day to get your caffeine fix here and deal with their friendly staff!
This location blows. Customer service was god awful. Everyone working there seemed like they hated their job. Maybe I just came at the wrong time of day (11 am) but I shant be returning ever again.
These people actually know how to make an extra dry cappuccino. I'll go to this location over the other Springfield Starbucks location any day.
This Starbucks has the slowest service. With a small line it took almost 30 minutes. Maybe they need more than 2 people working on a busy Saturday.

Iced coffee + almond milk = I'm awake and don't have the bubble guts! What a combo! 

This location has very high prices because it's inside of a hotel in the CBD. I had a $3 gift certificate and didn't have many options.
Got here just after it opened no issues here was greeted by several employees everyone seems to be in a great mood. My order was perfect easy access off the highway. Over-all a great experience :-)

Never have I been treated so rudely at a service establishment. ESPECIALLY since they  have signs saying "If your drink isn't perfect let us know"
Everyone that knows me knows I love Starbucks americanos. I by one veyday- sometimes two. I always have a starbucks cup in my hand. This time my americano was so hot I could hardly hold the cup even with the sleeve on. I waited 5 minutes to drink from it and even then, I burned my tongue. When I tried to let them know, this snooty asian girl says "The water comes out at almost 200 degrees"- 
LIKE I DONT KNOW HOW HOT AN AMERICANO USUALLY IS. I tried telling her I get one all the time. Her answer? She had the barista re-make it, this time with ice on the bottom of the cup. Needless to say, this time the drink was tepid at best. When I told the barista, this red headed guy, he walks over to the asian girl and says (which I could totally hear) "Now she says it's too cold" 
Im sorry Starbucks employees. I forgot I'm supposed to pay for this drink and just take it and drink it no matter how it comes out, and not bother you guys. They totally made me feel like an idiot. I asked to just get my money back, and I'd go to another starbucks. Michael, a skinny young kid who says he's the manager goes
"I"M SORRY THE TEMPERATURE OF THE DRINK DID NOT AGREE WITH YOUR TASTE BUDS" and boy, he didn't sound sorry at all, he sounded annoyed.
By this time I got angry and said: "You are making me feel bad for saying something when this sign clearly says "if not perfect let us know we'll  make it right", and that is not cool"
Michael says "I said I'm sorry I don't know what you want from us"
Hum...maybe a little sincerity? Maybe I'm sorry for the inconvenience, or that we couldn't get your drink right and you'll have to go somewhere else? Maybe actually trying to get the drink right and not just throwing ice cubes on the bottom of the cup. Maybe not treating me like I was a great big annoying inconvenience. I work in the service industry and I would NEVER tried my customers like this. Starbucks, I thought you trained your staff better then this.

I am coming to this location very often. I am surprised about some negative reviews. I find the service exceptional and always fast. I agree that there are a lot of new faces but there is always an experience Barista to guide them. In the last 3 years I go there I never had a single problem.  I agree only in one  thing with the previous reviews. The small counter area waiting for your order is very closed to path for the washrooms. So waiting 3-4 people for their drinks and on the same time high traffic for the washrooms can create issues. I give a lot of credit to all personnel for the continue friendly service and their efforts.
they make a great iced green tea... NOT THE LATTE!

If I could give them less than one star, you bet I would. I've never had anything but problems at this Starbucks. While I've only been there twice during travel, I believe it is the worst run Starbucks I've ever been to. 
The first time: no cars in the drive thru, almost no one in cafe, yet we still got sandwiches that were burnt and bitter shots in our espresso drinks. I mean, if they're that slow, they can probably check my Bacon Gouda sandwich to make sure it even has bacon...Why is quality so crappy when the wait is nonexistent? 

The second time: just stopped by and had a huge line for a wait. Now, I understand that, it was a busy time and that's out of their control... but we ordered with no difficulty (and no screen to double check our order) and assumed everything would turn out okay... I was wrong. We ordered a triple venti cappuccino and instead got a triple venti americano which is MUCH different. You guys can at least double check the order at the box or at the window to assure the quality of your product, it's like your job or something.

Sweet first to review! Having a Starbucks in the mall is  convenient and a very good business idea. I ordered a trenta peach green tea lemonade. Sooo delicious and refreshing. This particular visit I had the privilege of witnessing a rare, random act of kindness from an employee. I wish I had caught his name, but sadly didn't.  He went above and beyond the call of duty to take care of a severely habdicapped customer. I am truly in awe of this young man. God bless the few people that are left in the world and if you're reading this, God bless you.

Standard Starbucks. The baristas are great! 

Only problem with this location is they have never been willing to let me get a pour over or a French Press. So if you're looking to sit and enjoy something more than some Pike's Place, you may want to drive over to the Franklin Road location.

Slow service, mostly because the staff is inattentive. It's common to see three people working but only one has the time to help customers, the others engaged in chatting or side tasks. The result is often long, slow-moving lines. This location is also often too cold. They don't seem able to control the temperature. Coffee is good if it's made fresh, which it is some of the time. Seating area, restrooms, and condiment bar often not very clean. This used to be the best Starbucks location in the area, but it's now way past its prime.

I like this place. Have come here for years. They moved it a bit up tbe street and added a drive thru. Unfortunately, they haven't figured out how to manage the traffic from drivethru and walkin yet.  Always slow.
Excellent customer service! Long line but it went Fast! Loved the decor and the coffee chats with other visitors!

I am a bit conflicted about giving a Starbucks five stars. For one, I don't like Starbucks coffee all that much. There are a half dozen places in the greater Tampa area that I would rather get a coffee from. I only wind up at Starbucks when one of my parents, not knowing what else to get me, gives me a Starbucks gift card for the holidays. That being said, the Tampa Outlet Starbucks is as good as it gets (for a Starbucks). 

The employees here always seem to be in a good mood and are super helpful with ensuring that my wife gets the drink of her choice (seriously how do you always forget what you like to drink at a place you go pretty regularly?). In all my visits I have never had them once mess up my drink (although I did accidentally order it hot a couple times this summer, that was rough). 

Another bonus is the extended hours. When I am running through, early in the morning, the rest of the outlet mall is still awakening from its evening slumber. Sidewalks are being cleaned, fountains have yet to be turned on, Christmas decorations are being put up. Despite all that, Starbucks is open and ready to serve. They had no problems giving my daughter a cup of water when the summer mornings got way too hot too fast.

The seating at this Starbucks is pretty substantial. You have a few inside places to sit, an outdoor patio and a "grassy" space not too far away in the middle of the outlets. That's important because the amount of people that come here, especially around the holidays, is pretty insane. Take your normal Starbucks traffic, mesh it with an outlet mall full of shoppers on a holiday frenzy and you've got a madhouse. I hear there is an order ahead app? You definitely should use it at this location to ensure getting in and out in a timely manner. Or, do what I do, and show up before the outlets open.

This was my first time at this Starbucks(24 March) and it appeared to be a comfortable spot. I spent about two hours at the Starbucks and, in spite of everyone working so hard, the bar that has the sugar and half-n-half was disgusting and the trash was coming out of the receptacle on the same bar as the half n' half. In addition, all of the other trash receptacles had the same issue-trash coming out. This is not pleasant nor is it hygienic. I will say, however, that the bathrooms were very clean. I do not think that a Starbucks regional manager would want to walk in and see what I saw. if I have not already mentioned it, the Barista staff is wonderful and very friendly.

Starbucks can sometimes bring something to a community. When a neighborhood is struggling or staging a comeback, Starbucks can solidify things or help them along. It can be a harbinger for much needed gentrification, even when only a little gentrification is needed. 

That's why you get two stars instead of one. 

But really, why would anyone go to this Starbucks when Lazy Daze Coffee House (at 10 S. Johnson) is just around the corner??? 

Check it out: www.lazydazecoffeehouse.com 
Lazy Daze is the real deal: neighborhoody, local, laid back and cool. 

And just a short walk from Starbucks. To get there, walk out the Starbucks on Washington Street. Turn right. Walk exactly one block (past Jackamo's and Legend). At the light, turn left. You'll see Lazy Daze just as soon as you turn the corner.
Slowest Starbucks Ever.... three years I've been coming here and they never disappoint... guaranteed time to get a latte ... 8 minutes. I will say the people who work there are nice but come on

Not sure what all the bad reviews are about...this location is awesome! I stop here every morning on the way to work. They even know me by name now! (Not sure if it's a good thing) Ordering on the app ahead of time is always helpful and I'm not sure if the drive thru is a good idea- seems to be backed up often; however, quick "in and out" when you just walk inside and there's usually parking right up front. Highly recommend if it's on your way. Never too crowded, plenty of seating inside and out. Staff is always very friendly and helpful. Only complaint- they're  always out of blonde roast (my favorite), but they always offer to make a fresh pot, but I'm usually in a rush so settle for the medium roast.
Noice drinks; when I came inside it smelled like a toilet and air freshener clashing. I don't know, was it just me?
It is exactly what you expect from Starbucks and for a franchise that is about as good as it gets.  Sweet constancy.
Inside a lame mall. Great service, good drinks, only downside - the lines get kind of long but  I've met some really interesting people waiting in that line.

So finally a SBUX worth more then a 3 star... I loved this coffee shop the employees were totally on point they had several regulars they knew by name, face and drink.  They knew the menu and the location was clean.  I was really impressed with this little shop.

Joey the manager at Starbucks is a coffee ninja. He is always so nice. He always say Hi to me and asked me how my morning is going. My daughter likes him too. He gives her stickers and always says hello. Thank you Joey for making the morning visit to Starbucks so pleasurable! Keep up the great work!

The first thing that was immediately apparent to me upon my initial visit to this Starbucks location is that it has the worst interior seating layout of any Starbucks I have ever seen. Unless you are at a table touching the east wall, you will either have people in line to order, or people in line to receive their orders, brushing against you constantly. Consequently, the very few premium seats tend to get snapped up fast by people with laptops who occupy them for hours at a time. There are no nice seating areas tucked away from the line ups like at most other locations. Fortunately, they do have outdoor seating, however this being Edmonton, there aren't that many months in the year where it is viable to use them.

The other gripe I have with this particular location is mediocre service. I've pretty consistently found the staff to be friendly but disorganized. Today I walked up to the till, with no line up, and was asked by a staff member at the desk to wait a moment. She then leaned forward and started writing something, with a pen in her hand. After a minute or two, she grabbed a cup and wrote a name on it, then passed it over to the barista making the drinks, apologized, and said that she forgot to write down a drink order (why this took more than 10 seconds to rectify, I'm not sure). She was friendly, and I placed my order and paid.

I then waited near the barista who was making the drinks for several minutes, while he made five or six drinks, none of which were mine. Just as I was about to interject and ask if my order was coming up, the barista asked if I was waiting for my order. I stated that I was and restated my order, and he mumbled something apologetic and said that it would be right up. It was clear that he had no idea about my drink order, but at least he was polite, saw me standing there and thought to ask.

This was two hiccups for one order, and altogether it took probably three times as long for me to get my drink as it should have. I'd shrug this off if it happened once, but it was fairly typical of my experience there. The quality of the product is on par with other locations, but I'd recommend the location on 11410 104th Ave for better service and a better interior layout.

I was more of a fan when the gold card got you free soy, especially as I don't like too much of it. Now at 60 cents even a SBUX fan such as myself seeks alternatives. Shame but better for the wallet in the long run...

Visiting this city for the weekend. After a long day of wedding showers and shopping for wedding attire, we landed here before heading back to the hotel. Not only were our specially ordered drinks made to perfection, they were also HOT..unlike some places that deliver them lukewarm. We asked our Barista for directions to a nearby fast food joint. She patiently gave them to us in such a way that we found it with no problem. By the time she was confident that we knew where we were going, both of our drinks were standing ready. We left with an outpouring of well wishes to enjoy our stay. The coffee shop was clean and well laid out and offered a wide selection of coffee-themed items. Thank you ladies for taking such good care of us this evening.

I visit this Starbucks every morning before work. I order the same thing every day. I wish I received what I ordered every day. Lack of consistency. Today my coffee looks like milk with toffee syrup - forgot the coffee? One day my toffee nut syrup was replaced with gingerbread?!!  What if I was allergic ?!! I stopped going to Dunkin in part because of a lack of consistency.. This is just getting absurd.

I'm glad this is the Starbucks that is closest to my house, because it's the best one around! Everyone that works there is helpful and friendly, even at their busiest times. The place is always clean and has plenty of seating with the standard "Starbucks music" playing. And most importantly, my coffee is always delicious :)

Love the friendly people working here, and the fact that they always know what I want when they see me pull into the drive-thru.  Unfortunately, knowing what I want, and actually giving me the correct drink for 3 out of 5 days this week makes this lady not a happy camper.  Not the first time this has happened, not even the third time this has happened.  It's a weekly thing.  The manager is understanding when I call and complain, and yes, they always offer to make up for it.  And stupid me, I always go back to this one store, because it's close.  However, am going to try another store that's not quiet as convenient to see if they can actually prepare my drink correct for 5 days in a row.  That's $25.15 for the last 5 days, and I have only been able to enjoy $10 worth of it.  May never go back again, sorry.

Its early, I'm running late and need a coffee fix, so I usually go through the drive thru. Then they ask me what my plans are for the day, where I work, etc. A simple "how are you" is sufficient. I feel like I am verbally assaulted at times.  Not to be rude, but just take my money and give me my coffee.  I've resorted to acting like I'm on my cell to avoid this. 

I may have social issues, but can't be alone on this.

I'm not big on Starbucks or any chain coffee and, to be honest, no one needs to be in today's world.  However, the high street starbucks is just such a good location.  They've got a decent sized patio that looks inviting while driving/walking around that area.  The inside space is not so big, with Strarbucks going for a narrow design with a few 2-seater tables and a few couches at the back.

The staff at this location also seem to be quite friendly and since they're usually frequented by more relaxed people (given that it's in the high street), there's a very homely feel about it - almost like a neighborhoody feel.  However, I must add that I've been here on a couple of weekdays and it has been crowded.  So, it certainly looks like the cat's out of the bag!

Although I love the idea of a patio, I don't know how useful it is in Edmonton, given that we have 4-5 months of patio season, at best.  Perhaps they could have gone with a larger and more spacious shop without a patio?  It's a two-edged sword though, because patios are great.
Fast, clean, not over crowded, professional area, lots of outdoor seating and plush chairs inside. Great for business meetings.
I love this Starbucks. The people that work here are always nice and fast. It's a bit small on the inside but the drive through is usually quick.

I have never been inside of this Starbucks lol. I've only experienced drive through service which is why I'm giving 5/5 stars. I usually stop by this Starbucks on my way home from Holiday. It's just before the expressway on SR 54 and Sun Coast Pkwy, which is a very convenient location. The drive through moves fast and my order has never been incorrect. Kudos to the staff!

This is my go-to Starbucks, mostly because it's a mile from my house, but it's also better than the other ones around me.  Whether I'm going in to do work on my computer or just get a quick coffee on the run, the staff are nice, efficient and accommodating (I get a little antsy before I've had my coffee). Obviously the coffee is just like any other Starbucks, but this one has a nice staff, is super clean and has a lot of seating. They also always have good music playing. 

My favorite part about this specific one is the clientele. It's very unique, which is great for people watching. I've sat there from noon to 6 before to do work and I spent most of my time just observing the different characters that came in. It's definitely a great place to go.

I'm writing a review and a little tidbit from the review prior to mine. This location is wonderful. The crew here is always so nice and helpful and all the drinks are wonderful. Lots of parking and easy on and off access to the freeway. 

By the way, Carpinteria has TWO Starbucks... The other location is located in the Vons grocery store located on Linden Avenue.

Check them both out, you get excellent service at both locations

I was just there and ordered an iced coffee. I always use honey as a sweetener and asked that they add a little hot coffee to the honey while making my ice coffee so the honey mixes better with the cold coffee. Apparently this is a very difficult task because when I picked up my coffee there was a big clump of honey at the bottom. The girl at the window said they would remake it but was so rude, I was embarrassed for Starbucks. I received my coffee but it tastes rancid. I drink Starbucks 5-6x a week and order my coffee the same way every time so I know how it should taste. It's obvious they did something to my coffee, and they were all laughing while re-making it. What a shame. The people working at this place are a joke. Bad rep Starbucks.

I love this place! Great environment to hang out. Especially being from a church in the same parking lot, I spend a lot of time here through out the week meeting people, and on days to get away and study. All beverages are rad, and friendly staff. The manager is truly welcoming as well.

Speaking from a first hand POV, The coffee specialist LISA A. Is not to be trusted. She has stolen from multiple Starbucks locations here in Long Island, NY. She has spat in customers drinks if they appear "rude" or "cheap." Not to mention, she's a tad looney ..... You don't know EVERYTHING, lady. Please hire somebody who is not only trustworthy, but will keep the good name to the town of Zionsville.

Disappointed by the staff (twice). I wasn't given my receipt and they charged me for the wrong size. When I asked about it, the barista said, "oh you wanted tall?" and that was it. Didn't offer to correct my order at all.

This location is very clean, however, the coffee was not good. I typically visit Starbucks (other locations) at least once a day and I'm very familiar with the flavor of their Pike Place coffee. The coffee I purchased here was so weak I couldn't even drink it. It was just not good.

Been to this location over a dozen times. Nice size and feel. 

Unfortunately for at least the last 2 months, various outlets have been broken and not working. Went today and tried sitting 3 different spots. None of the outlets worked. 

After asking 2 different staff members and having them not even try to flip a breaker switch, I left, unable to plug my computer in.

Bad service, broken outlets but good coffee. 

This is a new location, let's get these things fixed!

Any place that makes my coffee and other drinks amazing. Will always get 5 stars from me.

Not to mention it is walking distance from where I live. So just a hop, skip and I'm there. Guilty of being a Starbucks lover. Although some of them aren't the best  this place here rocks. 

It can get a little busy since it is located within the outlet stores. So you get creative and download the app to order ahead so when you walk in your order is right there awaiting you. 

No complaints about this Starbucks, kudos and keep the coffee's coming.
I had two egg and cheddar English muffins with a cold-brew iced coffee. It was absolutely delicious. The staff was very funny, kind, and helpful!

Went to the Starbucks by the Fan Zone in Terminal B. Completely unimpressed. The two ladies who were working were very rude and huffy and complaining about management to each other. I get it, sometimes management sucks. But hospitality 101, leave it in the break room and slap on a smile.

Not bad, not superb. Just Starbucks. I love that there's a drive-thru but the location is off of the street so it's kind of hard to get here. Yesterday morning, the lid of my frappuccino was not properly applied to the cup, so it created a whole mess after I pulled off. Not cool baristas, not cool. But I've been here several times before then and had no problem.

This is a great location. I really like it here, and I would love it if they had more seating. I always order to go and my drinks are perfect. If anything isn't 100%, they correct it immediately.
The staff are friendly and efficient and the location is pretty clean.  Also, if there is a promotion going and the place is packed, I usually get my order in minutes.
Product shelves with their mugs etc are well stocked, plenty of treats and sandwiches, and I don't think I've ever seen them run out of the iTunes freebie cards
If you need a place to sit, you may be out of luck. The tables are usually filled with patrons from local businesses having a lunch meeting or students catching up on some projects and collaborations before catching a bus at the transit centre.
Always reliable and consistent, this location is a regular stop for me.

Pretty solid overall, came in and service was immediate.  Buddy was getting coffee and we were just waiting but I saw a slice of marble bread that I just had to have. Ended up buying it and just devouring it. It was absolutely delicious.
Always enjoy coffee and pastries. Great staff cleaned facility which is warm and inviting. Heck ya I'll be back

This will be brief, mostly because my visit was brief but my experience was consistent with previous times so I wanted to rate... 
Pros: fast service, drinks are fine.
Cons: poor service, careless manners.
This Starbucks gets 5 stars because I got like the very last Lilly Pulitzer x Starbucks Swell water bottle here in St. Louis. Yay me!

Compared to other Starbucks this one always has the same issue - really dirty, gross restrooms. I stop here on occasion to work before appointments downtown. Nothing makes me lose my appetite more for a delicious cup of joe than smelling urine while washing my hands.

Please fix!!! Begging you because you have good wifi. You are kind of my office Starbucks....

Most recent visit was yesterday 6/28.
Excellent service with an overwhelming number of people in line for a convention. Kudos. Clean, spacious, friendly.

Messed up on three of my drinks. and then I decided to give them another chance but then they messed up in my drink again! and they're pretty slow as well. but once you complain about your drink they make sure it's complete.

This message is to management, if you even care. For god's sake, please please please hire more staff! It is unacceptable to have three people working in the store at 7:30am when the drive through line is 15+ cars and the line in the store is 10+ people long. It is true that I used to live in the city and am used to a 2 minute visit. Spending 10+ minutes in this Starbucks just tops the list. I thought maybe it is just a one time thing, but it is consistent every single day and that is why I go out of my way to avoid you, Horizon Blvd Starbucks. I thought a mega giant like you would have some standards...

I'll have an order of the swift kick in the ass.

I rarely find myself at a Starbucks unless I'm traveling and without local options. This location offers a drive thru and your standard Starbucks menu. The only reason I would hold off on the fifth star is because I find it slightly pretentious when the staff corrects me for saying "small" rather than "tall" every time. I know, I know, it's all a part of their branding but please don't act like a dummy for saying "small". 

Oprah Chai all the way. Much lower on the calorie count than your average chai. Bonus: its spicier too.
Saturday morning.  4 customers. 3 employees. What am I standing in line behind 3 people for 5 min??

Customer service is horrible at this Starbucks rest stop. I think Starbucks should screen the rest stop
Employees better like they do for the actual stores.

I love Starbucks and  was excited to try a 50 % off macchiato on  Thursday night.  GSR Starbucks is not a corporate store so the offer on my Starbucks card could not be used. Disappointing.

On a better note the store is very nice inside a casino. Plenty of seating.  Great employees.
Starbucks is Starbucks lol good coffee good selection fast and friendly service the usual lol.

How can you let your coffee get cold?  I guess getting here late didn't help but at least a waring the coffee is going suck and your not in the mood for customers would have helped.  The good was you were right next to the REI.
Slowest.Starbucks.Ever. Not to mention inconsistent & sometimes even rude. I've already complained to corporate but nothing has changed.

One of the worst Starbucks in the area. We went through the drive through(which is a nice feature of this location), and he staff seemed friendly. I was impressed UNTIL we drove up to the pick-up window. I came to realize the baristas were extremely disorganized. The barista who took our order was also delivering us the drinks we delivered. She took frequent stops to deal with other customers orders while still processing ours. Upon paying the barista walked away for a good 2-3 minutes without saying a word. We started wondering where are tea was. After about a few minutes she handed us our drinks, and did not say anything again!!!! I was extremely disappointed with the deserved. I'll go to another Starbucks next time!!!

I came to this Starbucks while on a trip to the area for a wedding. It took us a while to navigate through the mall (since we'd never been there before we parked on the opposite side of the mall from it!) but when I got there my first reaction was, "Wow, this Starbucks looks so cool!"

I've never seen a Starbucks with this layout or decor before. Definitely a refreshing change from the traditional green and white.

My drink was made quickly and we were on our way. No complaints!

Starbucks products and service are fine, but I'm lucky to find a place to sit during the morning or afternoon coffee break times.  Even with a table, it lacks privacy and you can often hear other conversations around you.  The location is a popular one as it's close to many office buildings and the line up can be so long that it can be to the door or even outside! Best to get your drink and snack to go and enjoy it at the nearby Legislature grounds or back at the office.  There's another Starbucks a couple of blocks away that I find nicer and has more outdoor seating to enjoy on a warm summer day.

I am a big fan of the Starbucks chain in general.  When I worked on political campaigns these became my unofficial offices. They have comfy furniture, free internet,  and nice music playing in the background.  I have never felt pressured to buy anything or leave a Starbucks - no matter how long I have spent there.  It is a great place to have a one on one meeting, prepare yourself for a presentation, or just catch up on work between meetings. 

My fun Starbucks tip- join the rewards program.  It is free- cost you absolutely nothing- but it does provide you with at least one free drink a year, discounts through out the year, and every 13th food or beverage item is free. If you buy regular coffee, iced tea, or iced coffee- there are free refills with the card for your whole visit- which just contributes to my willingness to stay there for hours on end. Extra tip- they count the whole purchase as one purchase towards your free item- so split each purchase into individual items.  I think Starbucks is moving away from this and will start counting the items on one receipt individually, but they haven't yet. 

This particular Starbucks is very small, which is why I am only giving it 4 stars.  The parking lot is hard to maneuver  around in- and it only has a handful of tables. It only has one gender neutral bathroom. 

But the staff are fantastic, friendly people. They always get my drink order right. I have seen them handle some really difficult people and always keep their cool. if you like Starbucks this is one to check out- or if you are looking for a coffee shop in the area where you can get some work done, this is a good place for that too.

Nice location in an affluent shopping center that is always crowded on weekends.
Clean and comfortable,  Medium sized with seating and a retail area.  (Not a teeny one and not huge).

The absolute slowest Starbucks! I've been here about 5 times now and every time I've been here they have messed up on my order! I've asked for a manager and they said they don't have one. Do yourself a favor and go to another location!

I've been here 2 days back to back and yes there's always a wait. One day they managed the line really well having one of the baristas come out and take orders of ppl waiting and writing the orders on drink sleeve. I really appreciate this at any and all Starbucks they do this at! It REALLY helps! Good job ;) today the line was about 10 mins but no one took the orders in advance... 

All baristas are friendly and nice. 

Can't comment on the mixed drinks much I'm a dark roast drip all the way. Kids enjoyed their fraps though.
I love this Starbucks!  They are so friendly and prompt with their service.  Great place to meet friends and get work done.

Slowest Starbucks I have ever purchased from.  Staff did not announce orders and even failed to put some completed orders in the pick up area. Ordered from app for pick-up with an expected ready time of 5 to 9 minutes.  Waited over 21 minutes.  Starbucks "experience" definitely lacking.  I was in on a quiet Sunday afternoon, I can't even imagine how bad an early weekday morning must be.

As far as Starbucks go, this one is a gem. Especially for being located inside a mall, which usually spells doom for good service as well as good manners.

I come here so often, I'm pretty much a regular and have never had a bad experience. The staff is always friendly and the ones I see on a regular basis have a great sense of humor.

In fact, the last time I was here, the barista made my drink the wrong size. However, she remade it on her own, without me realizing that she had even messed up in the first place, let me take both drinks and gave me a "free drink coupon" for 'messing up" my order.

Doesn't get much better than that!
A Starbucks is a Starbucks, but this is definitely a much better alternative to the hellhole on 34th/Walnut.
Great staff and speedy service.

I have been to Starbucks all over the country Seattle included..This is the worst representation of the chain anywhere.Slow service, half empty case in front always.Dirty condiment station. Unbelievable disappointment.
Slooooooow service. Line out the door and they acted like no one was in line. One register for all the customers was not sufficient.

Gulch location with crappy service.   Staff move slowly and therefore line does.  How can four people be working but line moves about one person every three minutes.  Not even a nice good morning to compensate.  No one seems happy to be there

This is like any other Starbucks, over crowded and over priced..... But the staff is really nice, I would rather find a European style place where the drinks are more customized and cared for than any Starbucks any day!

The staff at this location is wonderful! Today, as I was rushing to eat my salad while working on my laptop at he same time, I spilled everything on the floor...after taking one bite.. While I was strugglin to clean up the mess (also embarrassed, frustrated, and hungry), one of the staff came up to me with a brand new salad and cleaned up everything on the floor for me. Best customer service ever! Made my day! 

Anyhow, besides this personal anecdote, I also want to comment that the location itself is really nice! They have plenty of small tables that you can study or work. Much better than the one on walnut if you are planning on sitting around for a while. Also, the music is the right volume and the couches are super comfy...

This is a starbucks inside of a Target. The locations Perfect! It's got great service and of course, they make ALL the drinks just like you like them. 

I always get a Medium hot chai latte, made with skim, with extra chai, which is always no cost. I LOVE it.

I have let Starbucks now at least two or three times that they do not get my order right. I have to have decaf because it adversely affects my leaky heart valves and today was the last time I will ever go there. Again, loaded with caffeine and I waited patiently for the high heart rate and shaky feeling to pass. Almost went to Urgent Care. Just ridiculous that when asked about whether or not my coffee is decaf, they always say yes it is when it is not. I also let them know that it is a medical problem and I need decaf yet it is never remedy. The next time Starbucks will get my urgent care bill
One of the most well-designed Starbucks I have been to anywhere.  Really cool decor and friendly staff make this my favorite Starbucks in the city (for however much that is worth).
Had to have my daily Starbucks! It's not for luxury it's a necessity!! Love this store since it's so close to my house. Clean store, yummy drinks & a nice crews! Until next time,...probably tomorrow!
Visiting from Atlanta the service I received from this location was by far the best! very kind and helpful! Will be back soon.

Starbucks in Terminal A extremely slow.  

I've flown out of this terminal for years and moved out of State 6 months ago. 

All new staff since my last visit and 
one thing has always been consistent; they are SLOW.

About a dozen people in line when we arrived.  Took 30 minutes.

Female cashier was too busy chatting with co-workers vs paying attention to her ever-growing line.

Four employees "working."

Line was half way down the center of the terminal by the time we got our order.
Super busy location.  Barista forgot about my drink and promptly made it when I asked about it and gave me a free drink coupon to make up for it.  Great customer service!

This is a busy Starbucks so sometimes the lines are long. But the baristas move fast and your drinks are prepared quickly. There are not many places to sit but if you do get a spot it is comfortable and fun to watch the Suburban Square shoppers scurrying about.

Oh man, where to start. Horrible service, employees on their cellphones not taking orders and there being a lot of customers. I ordered a chocolate milk with easy ice. I got a chocolate mocha with whip cream and the ice overflowing. I also ordered a ham and swiss- waited over 15 minutes for it and asked for it.. the response " oh I'm sorry i shut the oven off, do you really want it?" of course i want it. So he tells us it takes 16 minutes to warm up. I kindly said i would be waiting outside and he said he would bring it to me...well nearly 25 minutes later i realized he hasn't brought it out to me, so i interrupt my meeting and go inside. Its sitting there on the counter, a little burnt AND cold. the kid messes up ALL the time. has no manners and has horrible service. However, my usual encounters with a guy named Andrew? (i believe thats his name) is usually fairly nice and goes smooth. I still go there but I am tired of the sub parr service I get from this young gentlemen that looks like steve urkel.

First of all I love Starbucks. My husband and I were looking for coffee the day we left Reno. We figured any Starbucks is the same. I was disappointed with this location and had to wait over 25 minutes  for two coffees!   The way it was set up it was awkward to say the least. It seemed we had to push chairs out of the way to walk out....the one and only door we had to enter. The workers were friendly enough but it just seem to take forever and was awkward.

I stop here almost every time I take a flight. The reason? The service is the fastest I have ever seen for a Starbucks. The owner works along with the other baristas. She is taking drink orders 2-3 people back in line and has them ready sometimes even before you finish putting your credit card away. Their food is fresh. The staff is a bit quiet but friendly. 5 stars compared to other Starbucks I have visited. 

Other facts:
-No tables/chairs
-Your typical "compact" airport Starbucks
For me, nothing beats a fresh cup of coffee on the Clover. I was so happy there's finally one in King of Prussia (Clovers are embarrassingly common in Boston). My favorite stop on weekend mornings.

This location  is sure busy!  I'm here on a holiday Monday and for the last two hours all the seats indoors have been utilized as well as the patio.  

I LOVE the fact that this location has a huge patio with like 6 tables!

The staff are competent, the drinks taste like your typical Starbucks, so that's all good.  

Though, they lost a star as I cannot find plug ins for laptops.Thank goodness my laptop has a long battery life - I'll def come here again to work.

I've been to many Starbucks to say that the customer service here at this location is one of the worst so far! 
They made my friends drink wrong so when I went back up to correct it she said it says" well it says this on cup..." 
not a single "oh I'm sorry I can fix it " just a snobbish remark like it was my fault they made a mistake. 
I work in customer service and even though sometimes it gets hectic there's always time for a little empathy... maybe there  should be more customer service classes held for these workers cuz they sure need it! 
So there's no confusion this was the night crew. Day crew is much better!

I love this location!!! Even if this is not the closest location to me, I will go out of my way to go to this Starbucks over others. The partners here are SOOOO friendly! It is a level of service I have yet to encounter in this area. Thank you for always making my drinks efficiently and making my day better with your smiling faces!!!!

Regular manager is due back soon and new items will be added to the menu tomorrow.  Question:  which aroma do you prefer...coffee or BBQ?

I'm so glad a few favorite baristas are still here!

This Starbucks is right down the street from me. It is one of the larger locations I have been in and has a beautiful outdoor seating area that just begs for you to curl up with a coffee and a book to enjoy the day. It is well shaded with lots of couches so you can have some good convo while you enjoy the lovely Florida weather.

Not the fastest airport Starbucks but today the crew was friendly, got my order just the way I like it and at a decent speed. The lines here can get long as it's Southwest main boarding area so lots of kids ordering those complicated drinks. Unlike us geezers who just want a plain cup of coffee. Heh.

Rudest girl making drinks at night close to closing time 12/20/16. Tell her to shape up... I asked simply if I could have some chocolate syrup on my Java Chip (which it should have automatically), and she snatched it up from the counter with not a word and rudely placed it on the counter without any eye contact or a "here ya go" or anything. And she just quickly flipped around and walks away. Like dude really?...not the place to be grumpy. 

The girl who took our order was great though! But still 1-star...

All Starbucks are not created equal. The staff here is so rude. I like Starbucks but I will never go back to this one. It's done the road from my house and I will keep driving over to the local coffee shop next door. I ordered a drink. I was specific about what I wanted. The tall guy in the window handed me the wrong thing. It was very obviously not what I ordered. I said this isn't the drink I ordered and he snapped at me that I ordered my drink wrong. Then another lady walks over and hands me the right one, which was already sitting there. I tell her that the tall guy just snapped and me..She blows me off. I take a sip of my drink and it's still wrong. Park my car, walk inside to get sweetener, the tall guy and lady I tried to complain to are laughing. Thanks for taking rude service so seriously. As a business I support Starbucks but if you want more than a basic cup of coffee...don't bother with this location. They take zero pride in their product or their service.

it was nice at first the people there were nice and almost always got my drink right and then all of a sudden these new employees came around and were just rude. i asked for extra carmel in my drink and it ended up being a third carmel. i miss the way it used to be but i need to move on.
Best Starbucks ever. I always go to this one because it's close to my house but mainly the line is never bad. And if it is they are super fast. Great job sbux. My favorite one in Boise easily.

Most of the partners are insanely rude.
There's absolutely no sence of urgency, which is easy to forgive since this is a tourist hot. However when there's no one in line, 3 people waiting on drinks and 5+ partners on the floor it shouldn't take over 10 minuets to get drinks out. 
But before you go in and pay for a latte and get a cup of foam with dead shots, remember that you're in New Orleans and there are amazing local coffee shops on every corner and will actually give you the drink you asked for.
Love this Starbucks location!  The staff is always friendly and handles the long lines quickly!  Love my vanilla latte - gotta have it!!!!
This is by far the slowest Starbucks ever.   No matter what time of day. I only keep coming here for the convenience and the drive through.
It is a Starbucks, you know what you get from a Starbucks, but the service here is always 10/10. Even at 6 am the employees are smiling and always greet you! Great experiences at my local Starbucks.
I received such pleasant service and the interior of this Starbucks is spacious and clean. Definitely a spot I would return to.
Bad service, painfully slow, didn't listen to a really simple order, non peak hours. Had this experience several times.
This is my favorite Starbucks in Reno.  Not only are the baristas friendly & accommodating but so is their manager - the one w/glasses & short hair.

I don't know if the cashier was new, but I ordered a cascara latte and my mom asked for a cafe mocha with no whip. 10 minutes later we still hadn't gotten either order. When we asked, they said the cascara latte had been discontinued. I guess they weren't going to make either order?? When we eventually got the cafe mocha, there was whip and no chocolate....

If I didn't work so close to this Starbucks, I would not subject myself to being cramped in such a tiny franchise location. This located off the front of the massive Comcast center, but heaven forbid that any of that big lobby be used for more space to stand while waiting for your drink. This location makes you realize that in the city rather than in the suburbs, Starbucks only cares about quantity, not quality of locations. I wouldn't be surprised if they had similar locations in broom closets- at least there I wouldn't have to repeat my order 3 times because of the morning rush.

Overall nice Starbucks... Walking distance from universities and some food trucks. Parking is easy across the street but gotta pay the meter! 

Place is rooms with tables and high chairs to sit by the window. Baristas are on point at this spot!

Might be the slowest starbucks I have ever been to.  I didn't use mobile ordering because I has a reward.  I ended up walking out without my order so I could make an appointment.  They fill the drive thru orders first and only had one barista working with a huge inside line.
The barista didn't know much about coffee so she kept asking her co worker. I  order NO FOAM & repeated the special request yet and I still got foam! It even had the cup marked with "no foam"

Very impressed.  I placed a large mobile order via the iPhone app (9 specialty lattes), and the baristas at the Horsham location had it ready in exactly the time range the app gave (10 minutes), complete with carrying cases!

This is the Starbucks that I frequent most often as it's right by my office.  Everyone is really friendly (like most Starbucks) and service is fast.  The inside is not huge and there are only a few tables, but they do have outside seating for nice weather.  My one complaint is the tiny parking lot.  If there is a long drive-thru line, as is often the case, the poor saps who are parked in the lot aren't even able to back out because the drive-thru line blocks everything else.  Other than that, good stuff.

The worst. The counter covered in junk and trash.  Bought  a reusable cup and when I asked if the lid was clean was told "should be. If not u can rinse it." Waited 20 min. for 2 bagels only to have the harried clerk tell us he dropped the last everything bagel, did we want a plain?  Said yes then waited 5 min for him to start the bagel. Grabbed a juice instead and left.

There are two Starbucks in the valley that I would go out of my way to make sure I go to. The one that's on Milwaukee and Franklin, and then this one. The staff here so nice and friendly they always greet me with excitement and smiles, the fact that they can remember me even with all of their customers makes me feel great. Today "purely by accident" the barista managed to put a heart and my latte and it's going to make me smile all day I can tell. Thank you so much for making me feel at home.

Absolutely the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Time and time again, the one lady who always seems to be on shift is extremely dismissive and obnoxious. Don't waste your time here, any other Starbucks location is better than this one. Disgraceful.

Awful Starbucks location. My wife waited in line for close to 30 minutes.. only to find they had nothing vanilla and basically no food. They could only make caramel, peppermint, or cinnamon drinks. Ever heard of inventory management? It would have been nice to know they were literally out of pretty much everything prior to standing in line for half an hour. When my wife got to the counter and politely voiced her frustration, the cashier just had a blank stare and acted rude. Terrible service, and whatever drink she ended up with was inedible.

The Starbucks was small and the variety of items was even smaller. It was also very busy there. The staff did not seem to be fluent in English and wasn't the nicest. On top of that, they also got our simple order wrong.
STARBUCKS!!! caramel bruleé is delicious! Too bad its not on their regular menu.
This is a great Starbucks! Large inside area and large area of outdoor seating with an umbrella. There is also a convenient drive thru and lots of parking.  The staff is friendly too.

Great service this morning from the guy  taking your order (Chico) & the barista lady! I was asked how I was doing before my order was taken and the barista lady kindly informed me of the changes coming in 5 days to all Canadian Starbucks - the introduction of La Boulange pastries!! 

Apparently Starbucks bought out this famous bakery from San Fran and we are the last market to incorporate their pastries into the food selection! The barista lady raved about their croissants... Apparently to die for! 

Who doesn't love a delicious buttery melt-in-your mouth croissant?!? I guess I'll just have to try it out myself in 5 days time!

This 'bucks sits between me and work so I'm there a lot.  It's good, the people are friendly and they always get my order right.  As  the other reviewers mention the parking lot is small.  It's not difficult getting in and out if you're using the drive through but if you're parking during peak times it could get interesting. Even though it's not the biggest in the area the do have bistro boxes.  (not all of them do) So if you're looking for a little food with your coffee this is the place.

This Starbucks was so nice a clean the staff was friendly and fast. The location was so good in the mall and the it was near a nice siting area. The only bad thing which is kinda good is the place was packed so there was know where to sit.

Staff is friendly, bathrooms are clean. They put out FF milk, half and half and Whole Mike... For your beverages on the coffee bar. I'm finding most Starbucks don't do that any longer. A few groups meet here everyday. Its always a great place to start your day :)
I live In center city Philadelphia so my favorite is definitely the one on 18th&spruce or 17th&walnut but this one is good as long as you get the right person.

The drinks are always up to the Starbucks standard, but the wait is not. The drive thru is generally super slow... 12 minutes from order to drink is not acceptable at 3:30pm on a Wednesday. Overall, great product with slow service. I recommend going inside.

Came here to kill some time.  Good lighting, particularly since they have floor to ceiling windows.  Your typical Starbucks in that there were people there to get work done, others chatting etc.  Not too many outlets though hence the 4 stars.

Drinks are fine, but oh my gosh, the service was so in need of good management. I went in on Sunday morning, there were at least ten people in line, several people waiting for their drinks, and only three people working the entire place. When I got to the register, I said "hi"--just got a glare from the guy taking the order. And unfortunately, not even a thank you after placing my order. Waited for 15 minutes to get an Americano.

This is the second time I've been to this Starbucks location within the last 30 days.  The first time I visited, we were waiting for relatives and their incoming flight was delayed several hours so I had occasion to order several drinks.

They were friendly and quick to take my order though they seem more slow than other Starbucks in the making and delivery of drinks.  Quality is very good and I enjoy the open courtyard atmosphere of the airport.  You can almost always find a relaxing place to people watch and don't feel rushed to give up ytable!

Very well kept and organized. 
The staff was very friendly and welcoming, it was one of the best experiences at Starbucks. Usually they take your order and go to the next person, but they seemed genuinely interested in making sure the customer was comfortable and welcomed into the store.
What chain coffee shop runs out of cream, then, you have to wait an additional 20 minutes to get a new cup of swill?? Give me Dunkin Donuts any day! Definately NOT the way to keep customers!

Probably in the top ten Starbucks I've been to! And that's not just in canada either! I love the cozy corner that this Starbucks is tucked into and the cute patio that they open up when the weather is nice. 

The staff here have always been friendly and efficient even when they are swamped and the atmosphere is so inviting. As far as Starbucks goes, they're all pretty similar in taste and variety in their menus, so I can't really comment too much on anything except the wonderful staff and setting. 

If you're even remotely a Starbucks fan, definitely try out this location!
long wait lines and order was wrong.  i think i would prefer to go to the smaller coffee shop down the street that cares about my buissiness

For a Starbucks, it's as good as it gets. The location is obviously the best being on High Street, but what you wouldn't know is that the staff are always great! The manager/owner is always really friendly and funny. Generally, there's always a place to sit, which can be a problem at some locations. And the drinks are always made as ordered, again... can be a problem at other locations. Great location, great staff, and consistency.

Unfortunately this is the closest Starbucks to my office, or I would never come here. My (very simple) order is usually wrong, so if I do go to this location I try to go inside so I can get things fixed more easily. So, be sure to triple check your order! 

I'm actually not a coffee drinker, but I do love the whole leaf Teavana teas and hot chocolate which Starbucks offers. Except this location really has a hard time getting even the basics right. Several weeks ago the person working the register had to ask someone else how to make tea. Seriously?! It's a tea bag and hot water! I've also been given coffee instead of hot chocolate. 

The only thing keeping this location from getting a single star is the staff is friendly and it is clean.
So rude. Not a friendly bunch to start your day with. Additionally weird music playing. I would recommend a neighborhood coffee shop.

Slower than slow. 5 people behind counter. 1 in line- me. Drive thru faster. Seems that it would be wiser to serve the people (me) who have come in to order- iced tea. It's in a pitcher. Pour over ice. That's it.as I am standing here, the 5 employees have dwindled to 2.

Wow. I go to Starbucks at least once a day and I've never had a bad experience until tonight. The customer service was horrible and no big deal that he made the wrong sized drink, but when he went to remake it, he used the old drink to put into the new cup, added no new whip cream, it was runny and he left it all sticky and didn't wipe it off or offer napkins and when I asked for my receipt, he said he couldn't find it. I asked to speak to a manager and he said there wasn't one on duty. Unfortunate that every other Starbucks I've been to has cheerful, polite workers who seem to love their job but these employees seemed to hate life and customers. Coffee should make people happy. 

2/20/17 @ 825 pm
Probably the nicest workers I've ever met. I love them. A nice Starbucks location, love studying here and stuff!
I love this Starbucks!! The baristas are always so friendly. I love coming in in the morning and trying all the samples they have set up of the new lattes.

Your water filters needs to be replaced. I have had cold-brew black on two occasions. Out of a several month period. Both did not taste good. Then tried your water, from the filter. It tastes like typical Philadelphia tap water. Not very good. You know that taste. GET YOUR FILTER CLEANED/CHANGED, etc. Filtered water is essential for good tasting coffee. Coffee is 98% water.
I imagine other drinks may not be affected as much. But certainly your hot coffee that you guys brew in mass amounts behind the cashier probably would. Frappachinos,  caffe macchiatos, drinks like that probably would be to overpowered by the other flavors in there to notice. Or you may not notice if you add flavors or sugar to your drip coffee. I have had better cold-brew from other locations. It was black, nothing added. Their water tasted fine. I would recommend getting on this ASAP.

Friendly staff, little slow. Not too bad in regards to experience.
dis is rlly gr8 fam da ppl noce the air is noce and cold and dem drinks are too. you can ask if you want soy or coconut in your drink.  the tea is free refils if yu gawt dat green stateus

The worst customer service ever. Waited while people who were behind me, got their drinks. Saw 5 orders made that were wrong and had to be redone. One three times! 

Starbucks area manager - you had best get over here and do some training.

Unorganized.. unmotivated. Unhappy..

Went back the next day in case it was a one off.. this time they had no blonde espresso .. no internet.. no app pay.. no credit card pay.. and no bags for the mug we bought...

Seriously.. unbelievable.. the worst Starbucks ever..
The staff is friendly, the room has lots of natural light and the noise level has buzz but isn't booming, perfect for a coffeehouse.

Until about six months ago this was my favorite Starbucks, but my God the quality has gone downhill fast. I always order online 10-15 minuets before I need my drink and the last 6 times it's been messed up. Twice they forgot the caramel, three times it was the wrong drink, and the other times i was told they never got my order. The first couple times I didn't complain because hey mistakes happen however after the fourth time I got annoyed and was given a complimentary gift card, however the employee who gave it to me gave me attitude when I tried to explain that the gift card was worth less then the amount I paid for my drink and that in addition to this card I was my money back as I didn't have time to wait for another drink to be made. Seriously I only have so much patience
My go to starbucks! I really like it here, the workers are so kind and always do a great job with my drink!
I stop by early in the morning a few times a week -- Friendly staff that help me start my day off right!

Besides being closest to where I live, as well as almost exactly between my house and where I get on the Interstate to go to work, this location cemented me as a customer for life a few years ago. As I arrived at work during a particularly rough morning, I upended my Pumpkin Spice Latte, bought from another location, all over myself. I headed home to change and went into the Hickory Hollow location on my way back to work, lamenting bad mornings and wasted delicious coffee. The barista handed me my Grande with a smile and gave it to me for free. I've never had a drink made incorrectly, or had a bad service experience at this Starbucks. I see the Store Manager Malachi almost every time I'm in, working just as hard as his team. Five stars!

The staff here are just ticket takers, I think. You don't get ANY personal service like you would at an exterior Starbucks. It kinda smells like dirty sweat in the back lobby. They don't have much of a food selection like salads and other items. And for the amount of business folk that stay here, not impressed with the amount of places for people to "set up".  I would go out of my way to Not come here again. I wasn't impressed with any part of it. They do have lots and lots of seats.... Just not the right configuration.

Starbucks comes with all the standard setbacks: chain restaurant, average coffee, and questionable service.  This location adds difficult parking and supersaturated drive-thru as additional headaches.  With that said, it is close to home and the staff is comprised of interesting folks that are friendly and conversational.  You may not find this to be true on your first visit, but the place grows on you...
Always good but sometimes time consuming. Whoever that very upbeat man that sometimes works the drive through is needs a raise! he made my day he was so nice to me, love this location

This has got to be the worst Starbucks Iusually come here  every Friday after work and a few months ago they changed all of the Baristas and people that work here and the service has completely downhill the wait is long it's dirty in there and it doesn't seem like anyone really knows what they're doing I hate to say this because I've really enjoyed stopping here every Friday on my way home as my personal treat I think I have to find a new Starbucks because unfortunately this has just not gotten any better I waited a while to give it a chance but nothings changed I'm very disappointed and I think Starbucks as a corporation would be very disappointed with this particular Starbucks  café

No complaints! Employees are nice. Got the vanilla bean frapp -- tasty and flavorful. Bathrooms were clean. Jazz in the background.

Life is good.

I try to avoid Starbucks and try to go for local coffee instead but I couldn't find another coffee option around. I've never gotten outstanding coffee from here and that hasn't changed but this review is solely being written for the staff. Asia, the young lady working the counter was so sweet and gentle even with the line being stretched out. I know I wouldn't have been able to remain graceful with that stress. Siaka is the man who was HUSTLING with this line and getting everything out fast and with a smile. Again, something I couldn't do and deserves to be praised. With the snooty customers that come in and out of this place, I'm glad they remain kind. I hope corporate or someone in charge sees this review and does something for these stellar workers.

Rude employees. It's kinda a dirty looking Starbucks. I asked for almond milk and had to pay more for it. Then she literally used the skim milk in front of me and tried to lie to me about it. Never going to that one again.

Stopped in for a quick latte, and it was delicious as always. Highly recommend the smoked butterscotch flavor! Associate Abigail was very friendly and told us about the Clover machine, which I had never seen before. We are only in town for a couple days, but if I get the chance to come back tomorrow, I will gladly try one of those coffees! Only a handful of Starbucks carry them.

This location is in the Deptford Mall. It is located in the middle, lower level. It is a free standing setup, with bar seating on one side. It has everything a normal Starbucks has. It does not have a Clover machine.
I love this place is very nice the frapuchino is wonderful and there is variety in drinks I enjoy this place

Holy comfy seats batman! I've stopped by this Bucks a few times this past wk to mooch off of their free wifi and I want to rest in their comfy seats for the rest of my life! Staff is friendly and drive thru has been efficient when I've gone through as well however in the past three times I've gone in they haven't had milk or creamer out for anyone to use. Does this Starbucks not know that putting milk into coffee is common? Confused.
Drive through is small but great if you do not want to get out of the car but the staff is always friendly.

Small and cozy. Great for meeting your clients or work related meet ups. Not crowded which is great for me.
drinks are Starbucks drinks. nothing special there. just ah.
in summer bring a jacket if you get to stay longer. the staff cranks up the a/c to a freezing cold.

Worst Starbucks ever. Problems with their order system supposedly. Caused all the girls that ordered after me and some other guy to get their drinks before us. Like we didn't exist the barrista kept calling out what the newest people waiting wanted. Finally we went up to the counter and made a point to demand our drinks
Love it; fast, convenient and friendly service. What's not to like. The coffee is great, it's Starbucks right!!..the staff was very attentive and look like they were having fun. I'll be back!

I always come to this starbucks because I live on this side of town. The people there are super friendly. Compared to the other Starbucks I been to throughout Tucson, they are the only place that make my drinks how I want it. Everywhere else I have been don't make it quite right. Plus the people in the Safeway are friendly people. I would recommend grocery shopping and the Starbucks kiosk there anytime.

Severely understaffed on many occasions - I waited over 30 minutes for my frap and this is AFTER placing my order. Isn't the purpose for getting coffee, to get a daily boost not a daily depressant. Good place to go if you're waiting on your wife to shop and have hours and hours to kill. Otherwise please avoid. Goto the food court instead for a Java boost.

Avoid at all costs. This location has experienced management and staff shifts recently. It used to be a really great coffee shop now it's become a McDonalds with constant pestering to upsell. Not to mention its filthy.

My first time at a Starbucks reserve store. It doesn't seem any different than the regular starbucks except for the upgraded interiors and also, I think that they have more coffee/upscale coffee options which doesn't matter to me since I just drink cold brew.

The staff here is extremely efficient, the line up here moves quickly so don't be deterred by the line-up. The only downside to this starbucks was that the ladies' washroom smelled horrendous.
It is nice and clean, very friendly staff. It's my pit stop on the way to dropping off my little sister to UCSB. Very nice to stop and relax after a long drive.
I  like this location alot. Everyone is really friendly and good customer service.  I go there almost every day.  This is one of my favorite Starbucks Coffee location.

I frequent this location. And the Santa Barbara carrillo street location. The carrillo location gets it right everytime .And awesome workers that are happy your there.Im also near The Carpinteria location.Not because the nice workers or clean restrooms. But because of the convenience. Sorry,but this is the only thing going for this Starbucks. No one looks like they like their job and they turn their back when people walk in the door. Carol ,one of the workers ,is always rude and frankly gives out half empty cups of coffee. Also incorrectly done. Always acts as though you are a lot of trouble if you step foot in the store. And if you return the drink she only corrects the coffee half way. It's either cold,sugar syrup dripping down the side,or partially full. She will show you where the napkins are to clean it up yourself though. Some workers are slightly better.Its So sad because of the great location.

Literally the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. Great team but zero sense of urgency. I am in the area monthly for business and this is the closest store for me. Unfortunately it takes a minimum of 15-20 minutes to get my order. Once okay but every visit is not acceptable.

An open letter, redux;

     All of your great employees are gone or on a VERY limited amount of shifts. You are now, officially, a complete and utter epic fail across the board. Most of my co-workers have moved on to other locations and I'm trying to get some help from my GPS to do the same w/o compromising my AM commute time.

My hats off to your legendary ability to suck in such a well rounded way.

fin.

Great coffee shop in soho. There is ample parking in the back parking lot, and lots of differ net seating options inside include large tables and small tables with some leather arm chair seat and outdoor seating too. Not crazy about the Spotify playlist.

Ordered three grande chestnut praline drinks.   Two of the three came out ok, but one of them had about an inch and a half less fluid in it than the other two.   The service and the atmosphere were good, but I'm not happy about the drink.  That's what I get for not checking before I leave the store
It's always busy here, but the staff works really hard and they are always super friendly.  When I visit, I usually have four drink orders and they make them very quickly.

I am a huge Starbucks fan and was thrilled to see that this one was built right between my gym and my home! I went to get coffee the first day they were open and have been back several times since. I was disappointed on my first visit to discover that the employees were not as friendly as all the other Starbucks that I have been to. I decided to give them the benefit of the doubt since they had just opened and were possibly unfamiliar with the store. Unfortunately, this unfriendliness has not changed on any of my return visits. Until now, the quality was just as good as any Starbucks so I just overlooked the unfriendliness, but today something happened that forced me to write this review. 

Today I ordered a latte Macchiato with an extra shot. I told the cashier my name, she wrote it on the cup, and I went to wait for my drink. Christin the barista, called my name when it was ready and announced my drink but it was not what I ordered. I politely asked, "what did you say"? She did not reply, and my partner said he couldn't hear her either. I leaned in and asked again politely "excuse me Miss, what did you say?" She looked at me and impatiently and said the name of the drink again which I still did not understand. I smiled and said "well that's my name but that's not what I ordered". To which she replied petulantly "well then I guess it's not yours". She then condescendingly proceeded to explain to me the difference between what I had ordered and what she had made. So I replied again politely "well you can understand my confusion since that is my name and there's no one else here waiting". She snapped "yes of course". 

Nothing else was said, she went about her business, and then after about two minutes took the mistake drink and threw it away. In reality, she had made an error and was making me a new drink. Shortly after, she gave me the correct drink and said barked "here you go"

I'm not sure why, but for some reason the management of this Starbucks tolerates unfriendliness and bad service. This Starbucks is conveniently located for me so I will continue to go there, but I will recommend that you be ready to be treated poorly when you get your coffee. 

June 24, 2016
Since the above review, I have returned to this Starbucks locations two or three times and I am happy to report that things have really changed! It seems like they have really gotten their act together, and the attitude is friendly and welcoming amongst the employees. Maybe it just took a little time for the new store employees to settle in, but whatever the reason, things are much better there now. I recommend this location as I would any other Starbucks location.
The employees constantly change so the service is inconsistent. The location is great, but the parking lot is so tiny there's always a traffic jam.
