The staff is consistently quick, friendly, and funny at this Starbucks location, whether you are in the drive thru or dining inside.

They are great at making recommendations and accommodating you. This is my favorite local Starbucks to hit up.

My favorite drink to spam: Caramel Macchiato

Okay, so I bitch and complain when it's deserved - so I figure it's only fair to give kudos and warm fuzzies when it's earned. So here's a warm fuzzy for the folks at the Starbucks Kiosk in the Meadowood Mall. *throws warm fuzzies their way* 

This one goes out to the tall, skinny guy with glasses (who I'm pretty sure has a boyfriend rather than a girlfriend). You rock, dudeski. You're a hot chocolate Super Hero! I'm sure you thought I was crazy when I was explaining that something funky was going down inside my hot chocolate (that was made at a different Starbucks). 

But there was no fear in you, no sir! You yanked off that lid and you took a big ol' whiff and even though your face indicated a serious problem with my drink- you did what not many others would do- you bravely, and without hesitation, took a swig of a strangers drink. You risked your health for me! For all you knew I could've had some strand of Herpaghonasyphilaids -and you just ingested it without batting an eye. That's SO gangster.  

So Kudos to you, Mr. Funky Hot Cocoa Drinker Guy!  Starbucks should give you a gold star for great customer service! Your sensitive palate detected the rancid mocha mix in my drink and then you went even further to remake my drink at no charge to me- even though it was another Starbucks' mistake.

Despite how crazy and busy they get in the store, the staffs are always so nice and attentive ! You know how when there is a long line and you are the person that orders a drink with all kind of requests (aka me) and you feel bad and the cashier is probably giving you an attitude, well this never happens at  this place ! How lovely.
I ALWAYS get the best service here. There's a very sweet outgoing curly-haired blonde who just loves her job! She makes my drinks perfectly. She's a doll and a great barista too.

This Starbucks is small but very cozy. Staffed with a caring & generous crew, my experiences here have been wonderful! I usually find myself popping-in to grab an espresso drink, but occasionally I sit down and browse the internet, chat with friends or do some research for work. All together this Starbucks is one of those rare gems in a generally sparse coffee desert.
Its a starbucks,  they are all about the same but this one seem to have the world smallest parking lot and drive tho, people are always trying to get in and out and its just a mess out their.

1000am 7/16/14-

The staff- one girl in particular is soooooo loud and obnoxious - laughing loudly and yelling with her co-workers, I couldn't stand the noise level or the flippant approach when I ordered my coffee.

The store was also not very clean - I counted four dirty tables and dusty window sills.

It seems this Starbucks staff is more interested in being loud and goofing off than serving customers.... A total disappointment
Your coffee is way to strong OMG I rather get the latte but U guess it is kinda ok I lake Wawa coffee better though

Are you feeling lucky? This location is a total crap shoot. This morning, there was a friendly bearded guy at the window and they ROCKED it (someone promote that man). They had a line out to the street and I was out of there in under five minutes.  Other mornings, there's a REALLY chatty woman at the window who apparently has to milk the cow in the back before making my coffee and I feel like I'm going to die at the drive thru. 

The parking/lot situation is a total nightmare.  Whoever designed it should be fired.  You've got an extra entrance on the side that ruins everyone's day and the parking lot is only about five feet wide.  I would STRONGLY advise anyone to avoid parking during the morning rush. The space restriction ensures that you can only get out if there's no one at the drive thru, so you're pretty much stuck there until it either dies down or someone takes pity on your ass and lets you out.

So I'm giving them four stars because of my experience this morning. (Any other morning, I probably would have given them two.)

Being that I live around here, this is pretty much my go to Starbucks.  The inside is spacious with a lot of seats and this place is usually not busy so it is nice and quiet for you to do your work. The staff is always friendly.

if it's not 100 degrees outside and i'm not incredibly pressed for time, i prefer to walk the extra block to this starbucks (see my review for the nearby walnut location.) it seems like the baristas at this starbucks have a quicker turnover in preparing drinks, and the lines are never ridiculously long.

Well, Starbucks is Starbucks...for the most part.  I have never had a bad latte here or anything like that.  But I am more concerned about the parking lot situation at this particular location.  It constantly causes issues that make you think to yourself, "CAN'T THERE BE A BETTER WAY?"  And then you cry out in agony.  The situation of this Starbucks is that you can only pull into it if you are turning "right."  If you are turning left, then you have to turn at a stop light and then pull into the parking lot.  Well, this is quite the issue because you are creating a situation where you are pulling head into about everyone else...the entire drive through line...which is so tightly wound up in that tiny parking lot that you can't even swing into a parking spot half the time.  Which, for that matter, there aren't that many of.  Even writing this review stresses me out.  

This Starbucks location is also tricky because it is quite small inside, seating-wise.  And yet, every business man or woman without an office is determined to come here and take up an entire table to him or herself for a few hours at a time while drinking "H2O" as their cups are labeled.  

So here is my constructive advice for visiting this location:  make sure you are not someone who gets anxious in awkward parking lot situations and if you are planning on coming here to actually have a coffee in the store, beware, there may not be room for you.

But, I mean, my favorite White Chocolate Mocha is just as good here as any other Starbucks.

My morning, noon, and night stop for a great cup ò Joe! They are always usually spot on, and seeing that I am on the road a lot this Starbucks location is one of the best by far. I am here a lot, so of course there has been mistakes in my history of going, but I give the 5 star for the fact that they always fix my issue with a smile.

Keep your receipts if you purchase a gift card!

The evening of the Irv Halloween Festival, I stopped by to get a birthday gift card gift. My Starbucks Gold Card was charged for the gift card but the card was not activated. During the transaction, it seemed two different baristas were not quite certain how to process a gift card purchase.

I found out earlier today that the gift card was inactive. Upon review, they still charged my gold card and deducted the balance from the purchase.

Fortunately a very helpful Starbucks rep on their customer service line was able to refund the money back to my gold card.

Not so much of a review as it is a notice to keep an eye out and keep receipts when purchasing a gift card.
Not for the squeamish. A rat just ran the length of this busy Starbucks outpost. If you're part of the Muridae family, this is your place.

Love starbucks but definitely will not return to this location. There was a line when we went but over 6 people got their orders before we did and they ordered after we did. We only ordered a double shot espresso over ice, that's it. It shouldnt take 20 minutes for that, especially when people who ordered after, received their things.  I asked 2 different people about my order and was ignored. The third person I asked was the cashier that took our order. I tried to explain how I was dissatisfied with their service but she walked away.

This location is good in a pinch. On more than one occasion they've forgotten to make my or a friend's drink or food (even when it's not busy!) and I've had to ask the barista what's going on. They NEVER have blonde roast, which is kind of a first world problem, but come on, people. If you're in Brentwood and want Starbucks, go to the other one in Maryland Farms. Much nicer, more accommodating.

This Starbucks does not know how to make the drinks. I order a double chocolate chip frap and it was watered down and was barely chocolaty at all. Horrible plus bad service when no one was inside or in the drive thru.

Bobby didn't have a friendly, welcoming Starbucks attitude. In fact his attitude made me feel really uncomfortable like he was judging me and had no humor. Bobby didn't even smile and had a poopy face the entire time I was ordering. Besides the attitude, my tea was cloudy.

Love Starbucks.. this location however is a complete mess.. I've been waiting for 20 minutes for my tea meanwhile I've witnessed them mess up four drinks in front of me. I haven't seen a single smile from any of the employees.. or customers.
Clearly a management issue

I have gone running to this Starbucks for multiple events for my company. They have been nothing but HELPFUL to me. If I needed anything from hot sandwiches to a million pastries they have been on it with EXCELLENT service.  I wanted to give them the review that they deserve  :)

 Thank you for your help this morning!

This Starbucks is just as good as any of the other ones.  

My main issue with this location is the parking and drive thru situation.  Its horrible. You really just have to experience it rather than reading about it.  The drive thru line can partially block people in parking spaces from getting out.  Its also impossible to turn in to the store from Brentwood south. If you do turn in to the street before Starbucks, it will be almost impossible to turn in to the drive thru lane. 

All that said, my interactions with the employees has been positive.
Not that great. I had a latte and just didn't taste right. I asked another staff for extra shot of expresso to add but still wasn't the same taste. Maybe I'll just have a regular cup of coffee.

Great Starbucks, Great staff. Fast and friendly. Always seems busy but the staff quickly processes orders. It's a smaller size Starbucks, so if you are the kinda person who likes to actually sit and have a coffee or plan on doing a little work there, it can be a challenge to find a table. Seems to be a popular spot. I have been using this location for years, they have never messed up an order. Always seems clean. Bakery items always fresh and good. Also has selection of coffee items for sale (Mugs & Beans, etc)

Love this Starbucks location. The staff are fantastic, and even though I'm not here as often as I have been in the past, they still remember me and chat as though I'm there everyday. Love that they treat their patrons as though they are over for coffee at home. Service is great and the cafe is always clean and well organized.

Gentleman at the counter was friendly and correct order taken. Filthy and stinky bathroom. The gal making our drinks forgot the milk. She did add milk after we inquired. My decaf was bitter and not fresh at 5:00 in the evening.

Plenty of seating, great coffee and pastry, and strong wifi. Oh, and friendly and efficient staff here. Great way to start the day when you are exploring Reno and the surrounding areas. My wife and I were in town for four days exploring and looking at area real estate. This Starbucks inside our casino was very convenient. Yes, there were lines in the morning, but consistent morning kickstarts were what we were looking for (and needed) so this location was worth the wait. Kyle took great care of us today 8/14/16 and was very friendly and efficient when I ordered my venti non fat mocha WITH whipped cream. Ironic...I get it. Thanks for the morning food and beverage Kyle!

I'm not the biggest fan of Starbucks altogether, but this location is fine. 

The location is in Suburban Square so it is constantly crowded, but the lines move quick. They have plenty of seating room as well.

My friend used the Starbucks app and by the time we got there the food was ready. It was nice and warm as well. All the food had their sides as well. 

The only problem came when asking for a stopper for my drink as they forgot it. The man gave me sass and said "I don't have any, you have to go over to the counter and get it yourself." It seems like a usual trend at this place. Another barista here is pretty rude and is also upset when you think about your order. 

They usually have newspapers and k-cups available as well. 

The environment is nice and cozy with some nice padded seats. They also have complimentary wifi.

Iced coffee with sugar free vanilla syrup and a heathly dallop of heavy whippng cream.

win.

Only been here a handful of times. The oatmeal and breakfast items are good and the blonde roasts are never burnt. So by chain coffee store standards, this Starbucks deserves 4 stars. 

For me, I don't think there are many tables in open areas for studying especially because I don't like the claustrophobic tables in the back by the restrooms, but they have a cute little area with couches if you want to catch up with friends!
Nice service but this location is filthy. Dirty tables window sills floors. Great goin.

I like this Starbucks because it's on my way to work early on Saturdays and Sundays. The place is usually empty and I'm always pleasantly greeted. I come almost every week, so the baristas remember me and my order! That has never happened and I love it. 

I tried the other Starbucks nearby (the one with the drive thru) for a while, but I like this one more for early morning. 

I did come here once in the afternoon and it was beyond crowded... I think I'll stick to the early morning pleasant experiences.
Literally slowest Starbucks ever.  I waited for 30 minutes in a drive thru line for 2 fraps and a cake pop.

Although they've moved (they used to be next to the Apple Store), they've still kept their quality service intact. Pretty much every time I go here, I get fast and friendly service. I did have an issue once with an unfriendly worker, but I'm going to consider that a one-off.

Definitely gets busy quick, but they do their best to get you in and out with the right drink and a smile!

Pros: This Starbucks is clean, has lots of tables, huge outdoor area, fast and friendly service.
Cons: As with all Starbucks, it's freezing, and it could use more power outlets.

Very good place to have meetings or study all day.

This is a very busy Starbucks. I had opportunity to spend an hour or so here while waiting for my daughter and her entourage as they were shopping for a wedding dress. Though busy, it was never crowded. The only drawback was the counter staff. As with many of the other reviewers, I also experienced a rude/snippy tone. Customer service is key for Starbucks. At some point, if this isn't addressed, people will choose another option.
Always hit or miss, but usually when Tia (?) is working my drinks are perfect.
Came to this Starbucks when we were in Philly. It's pretty cozy feeling but I don't like that the line ends up right at the entrance. There isn't a lot of parking outside either.

SIGH.....for such a great location this Starbucks borders on mediocre.  The WIFI signal kept stopping and starting, by far the WORST WIFI I've encountered in any Starbucks.  Staff was somewhat friendly, could use some more classes on proper public service, other than that nothing outstanding at all.  If you're in this part of the city and want a drink, sure stop in.  If you're looking for a place to do some surfing or working online while you relax with a coffee, stay home.  WORST WIFI EVER.

Located inside Willow Grove Mall, this Starbucks is like any other free standing store except it doesn't open at 6am. It still opens a little earlier than the other stores here so if you are one of those "walkers" in the mañana then you have a place to get a caffeine fix to keep your energy up. There are plenty of pastries, cups, mugs, bags of coffee, and other Starbucks themed knick-knacks to purchase in addition to the standard beverages. There is plenty of seating and there are two single occupancy bathrooms in this store, so you don't need to use the general mall bathrooms to pee from the diuretic you just drank and paid $5 for, nice.

Anyway, staff is always friendly, drinks are generally made to Sarbucks standards, and the place is always clean. Check it out if you are at the mall.

no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no. no? no.
Great service and delicious frappes. Drinks were made quick. We were in and out. The drive-thru was pretty cool because you can actually see the cashier on a nice size screen.

I enjoy studying at this Starbucks since there are more seats here than at the Walnut/34th St. location just a couple of blocks away right across from the UPenn campus.  The baristas are generally pleasant, not any more or any less friendly than those at other coffee shops.  Immediately to the left of the main entrance is a section with couches, which are ideal for sitting in while reading a book or relaxing while savoring a cool beverage on a Friday evening.  The place is open until 11 P.M., which is nice.  I live about a 20-minute walk away, but I often come here with my laptop since it is less noisy than other places.  

This goes for any Starbucks, but I recommend getting the following:
1) Coffee Frappucino (this comes without whipped cream) since it is less saccharine than other Frappucinos and it probably has the highest caffeine content.
2) Passion tea lemonade (sweetened) - This cool beverage is perfect for the dog days of summer.  I get this either in the grande or venti size.  Don't take too long to sip it or the ice will melt and dilute the syrup.

The tall-sized house coffee is just okay and rather bitter in my opinion.  If you take your coffee with cream and sugar, it might be tastier since the coffee is so strong and bitter.  There is a difference between bitter and dark coffee, however, as can be noted when one compares the house coffee at Starbucks with Peet's Coffee blend.  The latter is dark and aromatic without giving a bitter after taste.  Unfortunately, it's difficult to get access to Peet's Coffee here.

Another perk: the place has restrooms which are clean (and open to the public).  The music is also enjoyable - it's usually a mix of bossa nova or indie (Wilco, emo music, etc.)

Best Starbucks in town ~ where everyone knows your name!
I meet friends and family hetr at least three times a week. It where my husband and I stop for coffee before church! It within walking distance from my house. I guess you could call me a "Starbucks Junkie"!

Every Starbucks is not the same. That's certain if you've been to a few of them, in different cities, different states, and stores of different sizes, offerings and, of course, with different people. This store, I say, is getting off to a good start. It's a new store, is quite spacious, clean, and the staff were very friendly during my visit. I had a white chocolate mocha, which was correctly made and tasted very good. There is also a very nice outdoor seating area that is relatively large, partially covered, and a very nice place to hang out. This store also seems to have the full complement of Starbucks food, snacks, and coffee offerings, too. Therefore, all is good at this Starbucks and I would recommend it for a visit for the coffee and Starbucks lovers out there.

Starbucks is my favorite coffee hang out anyway. But I was especially impressed with the great customer service at this location. Speedy service, the flavoring was done perfectly and all of the employees were professional polite and friendly.

I feel like this is a typical Starbucks. I've never had a rude encounter with anyone behind the counter, and they're fast and efficient getting me my post-work pick-me-up. The space is smaller than most Starbucks I've been to, but there is a small outdoor patio, and I usually get my drink to go, regardless.

I gets coffee here on the reg. Service is tight. Food is grrrd. Drive thru is sick. Other patrons are legit. I like this store. Just one mega ish that my wife got is their inability to keep cold brew flowin. What's up with that?! Besides that, I consider the Irvington Starbucks to be the best in Indiana and I've been to several other ones.

Just a Starbucks. And TIIIIIINY. Seriously. While waiting for my coffee, I was moving this way and that in order to get out of people's way! I saw a few people studying/working - I can't imagine how they do it! So small and crowded! I'd never get anything done.

I've visited this particular Starbucks location a number of times over the past several years. I've always had good experiences with my beverages here, or at least as good of experiences with these beverages as I've had at other Starbucks locations. This location is always rather clean and often has empty tables available for seating and such. I like how near it is to other places I occasionally visit -- hence why I do visit this location.

Everything from my previous review holds true (copy below), but the service here really is stellar so I had to bump them up another star. The issues I have with the location (small venue, horrible parking design, exorbitant profit margins built into upcharges) are all larger company issues...but on the small side, the staff here really does a fantastic job. 

I've been in this location enough to see what employees have to deal with. Yes, customer turnover is high, but think about the irritability level of some of those caffeine-addicted customers having to pause in their flurry to get their fix: they want their specific order EXACTLY the way they imagined. Perfectly. Instantly. Even if they didn't say the order correctly (because baristas should also be psychic, too).

I've posted up here with my laptop on occasion. I've never seen a barista lose their cool; they're unflappable. They're deft and efficient speeding orders through both the drive-thru and the counter. They know the menu inside & out (and I'm definitely one of those people who asks a bunch of questions so I can order exactly what I want). And they're smiling, calm, and share that soothing vocal timbre reminiscent of a shrink talking their client off a ledge...probably the best quality for a barista working the a.m. hours. I even trusted my last barista, Josiah, to "surprise me" and have me try something new - if you know me in person, you know I like to do exhaustive research and then make a educated, conclusive decision; unless you're one of my inner circle, surprising me is often a recipe for disaster - but Josiah got it right and I have a new favored drink!

I didn't expect to write this much about a simple chain coffee shop, but I really do think the staff here is undervalued. The service alone would rate this a 5-star location for detail, consistency, and speed. Unfortunately, the other problems at this location are such an issue that I can still only rate it as 3 stars. 

Since I referenced it and in case it's no longer available after I post my new review:

MY PAST/PREVIOUS REVIEW
I like that the baristas know their coffee culture and can answer any questions.  Whoever set up this drive-thru, however, is an idiot.  If you come from the cross street rather than entering off Brentwood, prepare for some tight finagling (and the blaring horns of irritated, coffee-deprived customers) to get to the lane.
And you're going to sneak in a sixty cent surcharge for adding soy milk (no upcharge for dairy) to my coffee?  St. Louis Bread Company is a block away with better coffee & no extra fees for those of us avoiding lactose.  I won't go out of my way for this one.
Tried the Cristal ball frappuccino. There were sugar on the cream. Fruit flavor? Quite familiar.

I love Starbucks.  Coffee is always reliably great.  Teas are really good too.  The location however is the biggest downfall.  I wish it was a self-standing store.  Not a huge fan of Target but will go for Starbucks.  Service has never been bad.  Store is often crowded with people just sitting or eating pizza from express pizza place next door.  I prefer a more quiet environment without all of the store traffic.

NOISE NOISE NOISE!!! I am a dedicated Starbucks patron and perhaps the biggest reason (besides the coffee) I go to Starbucks daily is the relaxing atmosphere. Gives me a place to quietly read a book or get a head start before heading in to work. Can't think straight in this location. It was like a bar at happy hour. Im not sure if it's the acoustics or what but don't go here if you need a place to chill.
We love Starbucks.  This one needs learn their menu. We ordered three drinks, all three were made wrong.  This seems to be a repeat problem when we go into this location.

Stopped at this Starbucks for a frappe and it was as to be expected. Starbucks is consistent that way, but what was unexpected was a sweet girl in the drive thru who saw we had our dogs with us and offered us a pup cup. After we had to ask what that was we graciousness excepted the cup of whip cream for our dogs. Our older dog liked it but our puppy LOVED it! When we said thank you and told her how much he liked it she gave us a second cup for just him! Such a great experience wish I would have caught her name so I could fully give her the praise she deserves! Great customer service!

Normal walk-in starbucks... Staff was very friendly... Drinks were made fast but with care... Had a great convo with the bristia about differnt coffee's we liked and she suggested some of her favorite that I might like...

Volwin, Sig, & Peter are the best baristas in the building! They are quick, and your drink will be amazing every time it is made bu ine of them! I order through the app which makes life sooo much easier...this store would not run the same without them.(or maybe I wouldn't )

This is perhaps the best Starbucks I've been to. Very energetic and friendly Baristas and the selection of food was great! Unlike other Starbucks I've been to recently, the drink was perfect. 

Now the not-so-good...parking is an issue and the Internet is rather slow. These two items would have likely generated a 3 or 4 star rating at the average Starbucks but the people who work here made up for the shortcomings of corporate. I highly recommend...if you can find a place to park and don't mind tethering to your cell phone. ;-)

I feel like this Starbucks should not have a drive thru. It's pretty awkward the way it is set up and people sometimes cannot back out of parking spaces. The line gets very long and out into central ave many mornings. Everyone who works here is very friendly, however service is at times inconsistent. This is my neighborhood Starbucks. I visit every other day. I think it would be much better if it were set up similar to the 4th street and 9th ave location.

Went today. It was busy since in the mall. I ordered the new cold brew. It seems to move slowly here and when I wanted to get a tea later I skipped it since it seemed busy and I couldn't stand the wait, the staff was friendly though and my drink today and many other times has been done right, it maybe deserves 3.5 stars. A better starbucks than some others.

I love this Starbucks! Before I moved, I used to run through drive thru before work. Now I just stop by during my lunch break. 

The staff is always friendly and the service is super speedy, which is much appreciated since I'm always running a little late!

The interior space is great for hanging out reading or working and is quiet enough for a quick meeting. They also have a few tables outside for when it's beautiful out.

They always are very welcoming and know me by name. They know what I order and notice when I try something different from time to time. Very quick service. It's smaller than a lot of other locations but I like that atmosphere and my order always tastes great.

This is my family's usual (and favorite) Starbucks in our neighborhood. They are quick, courteous, and usually remember you and/or your usual (even if you regularly just go once a week).  

I appreciate the fact that they all work together so well to get you your items quickly and accurately whether you are in the drive through or go inside. Another nearby Starbucks focuses on the drive through much more and it can take you quite awhile to get your items inside (even if you are taking it to go and the only ones waiting). It's like night and day with the service and friendliness of these two and this one most definitely wins! 

If you are parking to go in, I highly recommend that you park on the part of their parking lot that faces out and away from Starbucks and over on the half that is in front of Fed Ex. It is much safer pulling out of that area, because many times people come racing around that corner over by where the drive through comes out. I've heard of others who avoid this Starbucks because of this, but you only need to park in the correct spot.  This is the only negative, so when you choose to take my advice on where to park... there is no reason not to go here.  

I also highly recommend their rewards type program. Like I said, we usually just go once a week (and also often on road trips), but we still have earned free frappuccinos several times.

Quick service and pleasant staff. Coffee and food were good and served quickly!

Got a double chocolate chip frap and bacon & Gouda sandwich.

This is a place.   A dark place.  That somewhere.  Somehow.  Voldemort will use what fragments of his soul are still hiding out there...and you ALL know they are...will use this evil institution to FILL his minions with false hope and caffeine once again to try and take DOWN that kid with the scar on his forehead again...........Anyway.

Only thing I remember about this place as it looks like thousands of others JUST like it, except this one might have a barrista (can't we just call them employees, i mean seriously, like making coffee for a living should be a desired after career for ANYONE that has graduated any level of education) who has 7 different colors of dreadlocks or some other dirty hippie stench.   I always like to order the Large coffee and they always ask me if I'm talking about the Vente and I look at them with that look like...."I don't know what you just said little kid, but you special"....and I leave or if the coffee has kicked in too soon I torture other customers by using the restroom and turn off the air vent.
Starbucks is good, but I went last saturday and this parking lot is tough to manuever through. I hate crowded parking lots with small parking spots and no one can get anywhere! Anxiety!

Sad to give my old favorite only 3 stars but man it is just the slowest Starbucks. It's so small that they really have to move the drinks faster as there isn't a comfortable area to wait when it's crowded like today. There isn't a drive thru which has never been an issue for me in the past but it's been 2 years since I've visited and I could tell there was a major difference this time.

I think with as much business that this location does, they need more than 2 people working the counter. Our drinks were good and hot. I just hope they figure out how to speed up the process.

So dirty! After seeing the condition of their restroom, I wouldn't get water for my dog here. Their toilet hasn't been touched in weeks! The sight that I walked in to see is something you see in horror movies! They make the local gas station look like the Fess Parker.

I love this Starbucks. If nothing else, go here just to look at the decor. It's so cool! The look and feel is totally New Orleans.  The bathroom had such amazing light fixtures.

The staff was friendly and the line moved quickly. The location gets busy so be prepared for some sort of wait- it's in a high traffic area.

They had a good playlist kicking too which definitely helps. If I were local this would be the only location I shop at.

I have no problem for tipping for good service. However the big guy with the beard and knit hat always shakes or moves the tip cup once I am done paying. Now, I never tip at this starbucks simply out of spite. I mean come on bud, You are pulling a leaver on the coffee urn  filling up a cup and charging me 4 bucks, get the hell out of here with your tip cup.

Worst starbucks i ever been to. Service is dry and slow. And a few times my cup was half full. Like nothing but foam. Not the cleanness starbucks. Employees always look mad. The only reason i still go, is for free wifi. Hire friendlier employees and better trainers. No one ever smiles.

I can't live without my coffee and thanks to my dearest mum, I don't have to! I will use every bit of my $100 dollar gift card at this Starbucks. 

The baristas are so friendly and I'm always in and out in a snap. 

You guys rock!

The nicest Starbucks I've ever been to. Also the only Starbucks with wine and been. The cashier told me there are only 10 Starbucks with beer and wine license in Florida. Also the cashier Sarah was extremely nice and cheerful. And the barista got my name right

It's a pretty typical Starbucks.  Of course, I typically don't review major chains unless there is something worth highlighting.  This location has a few:

1) Yes, the Wi-Fi is free, but extremely slow.  It drops out on me quite a bit during my visits... still it is free.

2) The place is kept extremely clean.  Still, it is rather small and only has 3 outlets (2 by the bathrooms in the hallway and one in the other room).  Come with a full charge if you plan on staying a while.

Otherwise, think of every other Starbucks you've been too... yup, it is just like them.
I love this place! My cashier, Adam, was so nice and funny. Drink tasted perfectly. Rock on guys!

Whhhhaaaaaat?! My precious Starbucks is closed on a Sunday?! 
Anyway, I don't normally come to this location, but I should because it's closer to where I live. It's crazy that there are two flourishing Starbucks within 5 mins of each other and another one just down pyramid highway MAYBE 10 mins away! 
I ordered my usual: venti quad iced late 4 pumps vanilla 4 pumps hazelnut. 
It was pretty standard. The thing I like about Starbucks is its 8.5x out of 10 pretty consistent. That's typically why I choose the chain company over the smaller coffee shops. 
The price increase pretty much sucks. Big time. I went from a (dare I say) daily Sbucks drinker to a maybe once every 2 weeks. Sad, sad panda. 
I'm excited for the holiday drinks to come back around in the fall. The pumpkin spice is alright, but I love when the come up with new ones to try.
This Starbucks is the most poorly run in town. Drive thru averages at least a 10 minutes wait if there is even one car in front of you. You've been warned.
Super disappointed! Used to come here after church and hang out and talk and they used to close at 10 and now they close at 7:30 on Sundays. Don't like the new hours.

This small Starbucks is located in what is obviously a new strip mall (Yuck!)  in the Philadelphia's ex-urban communities.  As much as I rag on suburbia, I've never had the most positive experience of entering a store and being greeted by the distinct sounds of Lady Gaga blaring in the background.  Mmmm... Pretty cheerful!  Then the employees were in as good a mood as listening to Lady Gaga can get you, so besides sincerely friendly and eager to please, they were actually in a good mood.  Their coffee is, well... Starbucks, but what makes this place is the staff.  And their outside seating area has about twice the footprint of the store.  Nice place to sit and wait for my car maintenance at the Subaru dealership literally across the street.
Great location, fast service (even at their peak hours), and friendly employees :) This is usually my go to SB & I'm never disappointed.

I love Starbucks. But this location was either severely understaffed or horribly inept. It's 8pm on a Saturday at the drive thru for coffee. It should not be a 10 minute wait for a large coffee. They need to prioritize the orders.

Just keeps going downhill.   After this morning and the long wait for just a simple triple shot and rude barista,I will be taking my business to the Lemay location from now on.  I have been a loyal customer since the place opened.  But that does not seem to matter.  Mobile orders seem to take precedence over actual people standing in front of them. Other than amber who is wonderful, they need a better crew.  Nothing but sub par experiences.

They gave my drink to another customer, but once they realized the mistake, they replaced my drink. Place is always crowded and they are not too well organized at this location. The drink I ordered was not make correctly. Hit and miss at this location. Sometimes perfect and sometimes a complete mess.
Drive thru is super convenient, but can be slow, especially during the weekday mornings. Seems understaffed at times, but so far havent had an issue with an order
All staffs who were friendly and helpful with fast order to take out.  Nice services and very good.

I have been bitching about this for several months, but this is the only starbucks in the world that puts customers through a maze to get to the front counter. And be careful because the side door opens right into the middle of the line and you have to make your way to the back like you going the wrong way as on the airplane as everyone is leaving.

Go to Bala Cynwyd where they treat you like a human being.

Small...  Cozy... Laid back... Exuding the leisurely upscale nature of the shopping center.  Steps from Whole Foods. Friendly and efficient staff. And plenty of outside seating for those nice days when seating inside is a penury. Love it.

They work hard and are very nice here.  The ladies are lovely.  There are some "character" customers, but they aren't troublesome. I tried the "new" pastry...raspberry donut, and it was fine.    It's my "home" Starbuck's and I like it.

It's Starbucks...so you know what to expect. Some locations are great...some not so great...and this happens to be one of the better ones. I generally hit the drive thru and they are very efficient - it gets BUSY here probably due to the location literally steps from the parkway. Yet, the line moves along quickly at any time I have visited. The baristas are friendly and I've never had a mess up on a drink here. One thing that I can say is awesome - more than once I have been the lucky recipient of a drink that the person ahead of me paid for. Even happened on a Monday one time which made that Monday so much better than usual. Clearly they have some awesome customers who visit here regularly. So whoever has bought my coffee here a couple of times - thank you! I repaid the favor onto the person behind me. We need more kindness in the world. And coffee. Pretty sure those things are related somehow :)

I was super excited that there was a starbucks inside my hotel (Grand Sierra) upon booking however, every drink I ordered here the 3 days I was at the hotel...were just HORRIBLE. I had to tell the guy to add extra syrup to my white choc mocha latte because it tasted so bland the first time and then the second time it tasted like he added the whole damn bottle. Know your pumps, I feel like half of the employees got thrown in there and were not really fully trained on how to properly make a simple latte. After 2 days of spending $5.35 on my latte, I decided to just wait till I got back on the road to visit an outside location for coffee.

As a general rule, I try not to write reviews for chains, but i make exceptions on occasion.

This store seems to be investing in the community and is trying to find a balance of being a drive-thru and a destination.  It's definitely an anchor for Irvington.  Overall it's a pretty comfortable place to chill and enjoy free wi-fi.  The demands of being a drive-thru store makes it so the baristas are not as friendly as I've seen in other stores.

I wish Lazy Daze (or another indy coffee store) would get it's $#!+ together to be a real competitor to sbux in the area, but from what i've seen, that's not the case at this time.

Coffee: standard starbucks
Food: yes
Vibe: standard starbucks
WiFi: Yes.  free.
Plugs: Yes.

The baristas at this location are incredibly nice and always manage to get drinks out correctly and fast. They always make my day and give a genuine smile and quick conversation. Wish I could give more than 5 stars!!

The  barista   seemed bothered to take my order, didn't ask me my name, which was Olay, because they were not  busy. I was standing waiting for my drink and she put a drink up on a higher Stand, didn't make eye contact with me so I  didn't think it was my drink, and then went back to making another drink that I naturally thought was mine , she made that drink and then with a big smile called for "Justin "and said  your drink ready!  Then looked at me and with her eyes pointed at my drink like "there's yours".,but she never said a word.  I will say that she was  RUDE RUDE, RUDE!  Drink tasted fine.
Ok. Service. Not a corporate location, so they don't accept Starbucks coupons. Not cool. :-(

Worst Starbucks ever!  Went twice in a week on vacation to NOLA.  They were out of green tea on one occasion, another occasion out of vanilla creme fraps. I asked how do you run out of vanilla fraps, to which the cashier replied it happens all the time l, believe you and me!  So clearly poor management here.   Then the cashier rang up a grande drink even though I corrected her three times it was a venti that I had wanted.   When the drink was made up as a grande and I corrected the barista, the barista forced the cashier to chug the drink.  To which she did making other customers wait before placing their orders.

Lastly, to make Starbucks at this location worse, the bathrooms were out of order the four days we were there.

Starbucks should close this location till they find management that wants to provide a pleasant experience.

As a long time customer who adored this location I have unfortunately noticed a continued decline in customer service with a tendency to be border line rude. It is disappointing due to the frequency of my visits. My most recent trip was less than satisfactory in both service and quality of my standard over $6 drink which has now become the new norm. I hope this location can make a turn around soon as they will be losing my business.

This Starbucks is convenient and like most of the other establishments delivers a similar experience.  I find it kind of funny that it's right next door to a Dunkin Donuts, but maybe that's a benefit for those of us who don't want to pay $6 for a scone made from organic power berries harvested from the heart of the jungles of expensivecoffeebeanland.
Usually speedy with the drinks regardless of the line size. Watch the parking meters outside, the PPA is on point.

I don't typically go to Starbucks. Actually, I don't go to coffee shops in general. But this one is right down the street from my office and I stopped in one day because I was very early to work on a pretty day and wanted to sit outside in the sun for a few minutes before going to the office. There was a long line of cars waiting for the drive through but only a few people in line inside the store. The line moved significantly faster than I had expected based on previous experiences at Starbucks and after I paid for my drink, it was ready in just a minute or two. I've always thought people considered long waits at Starbucks to be a badge of honor. Not the case here. And the people were so friendly. They called me by name as they gave me my drink and as I was leaving. I decided to go back a few days later and they actually remembered me and anticipated my drink (I'd been in there once before!). Three different people working there called me by name. Each time I go in is like that, despite the fact that I stop in sporadically and occasionally. And the line of cars for the drive through is always moving, which I've also never seen at a Starbucks. I've been into Starbucks shops around the world and this is the best one I've been in. Love this place.

Check under your lid before leaving, as the drinks are consistently underfilled here. This is not a complaint based on just one poor experience. I work nearby, so I've been here tons of times. I am sick and tired of paying for a grossly underfilled drink. The only reason I'm giving 2 stars instead of 1 is that the staff are friendly, and they maintain reasonable wait times despite frequent long lines. However, at the end of the day it's the product that counts, and it's insulting to not get sufficient bang for your buck.

This is my favorite store in central Indianapolis. The warm and welcoming atmosphere is what keeps me coming back. Many other locations have lost their soul and I feel treated just like another transaction. That is not the case at this store. The Baristas go above and beyond with customer interaction. I truly feel as though they are my friends.

I'm really not sure what all of the complaints here are about. It might be because I purposefully try to avoid Suburban Square during high-traffic times (like the middle of the afternoon on Saturday) but I've never had a bad experience.

True, the line can be very long sometimes but that's to be expected for a coffee shop in a popular shopping hot spot. In my opinion, the service is very quick and efficient. It'd be nice to see more of the employees smile, but they've never messed up any order of mine.

I've come here to work on assignments for graduate school plenty of times. I have always been able to find a seat. Plus, there is free WiFi. What's not to like?

It's a chain store coffee shop, you know what you are getting.  This one closes waaaay too early for me to frequent it regularly.  The staff is nice even though one girl sounds exactly like Edie McClurg from Planes Trains and Automobiles...every time she asks me through the intercom how she can help me, I want to launch into Steve Martin's bit from the movie.  Gobble Gobble!!!
The usual starbucks experience. reasonably clean bathroom and our drink orders were correct.

Warning if you are used to consistency in a chain, this particular location does not provided it. 

After living in Seattle where you can go from store to store and everything is the same. You would think that they could do that here. They can't.

I head to this Starbucks every Saturday morning and for the most part, my coffee comes out quickly, and hot and tasting great! I always order a Skinny Vanilla Latte. The prices at Starbucks are steep, but I can't stand Tim Horton's or second cup so I am sort of forced to go here.


My order is usually right, but there was a time not long ago where every time I went here, there was some sort of mistake. It was really annoying. I would order a Skinny Vanilla Latte and I would get a Cinnamon Dolce Latte or just a regular latte. I guess they got rid of their barista because everything is back to normal now and I am enjoying my coffee again!

Starbucks is Starbucks.  And while I am not a huge fan of their coffee (in my opinion, it always tastes a little burnt) and I find it a bit disconcerting that their pastries, sandwiches, and drinks taste the same all over the world (no local flavours), as far as huge chains go, they aren't as evil as the rest (their labour practices are better than most other multinational corporations, for example).

However, I prefer to frequent locally owned cafes for my java fix, so I have only been to this location once.  I found the layout to be awkward, with massive columns taking up huge amounts of space and larges shelves of merchandise taking up even more precious real estate.  The result is a very crowded seating area with incredibly few seats available.  I found it claustrophobic and awkward not a pleasant place to sit and enjoy a cup of coffee.  Perhaps in the summer months with the patio open it might be nicer.  But this is Edmonton.  And our patio time is quite limited.

I found the baristas to be pleasant and helpful.  And the food and beverages tasted exactly as I expected them to, like Starbucks.
Love Starbucks!!! Great coffee!!! Even though they're pricey & sometimes the lines are soooo long.
Additional staff needs to be hired. Although there are always so many people working, but I have never waited LESS than 5 mins for a coffee. Typically more. Disappointed.

The staff here is hands-down one of the friendliest you'll find in Boise.  Unlike the places you get forced smiles and fakey greetings Starbucks sometimes generates, the staff here seems to honestly be happy to see you.
At least in the evenings, they're never overly busy and I've never had to wait more than a minute or two for my drink. I've never had a quality issue, and they seems to always properly follow recipes. The restroom is always super clean, which probably takes a fair amount of work on their part.
If you're on Eagle road, this is the best of the four Starbucks to drop by.
I really like this location. The place is super small but the staff is really friendly. Only got a black coffee so nothing to extravagant to post about that. Sorry.

I've only visited this location a few times when I visit a friend up this way, but service has been fast and friendly and my orders have been correct.  I've only done drive through so I can't comment on the feel or service inside.  So far, so good.

This Starbucks is staffed with lovely folks who provide quick service and a smile!  And they're open until 10 pm, which is a big plus as well.  And have you tried the Peppermint Brownie Cake Pop?!?  So yummy, and a nice *wee* treat in this season of overabundant treats!

The only bad thing?  The parking lot is teensy and difficult to maneuver when there's a line for the drive through.  It's too easy to get trapped.

I regularly stop in this location, sometimes for long periods of time. This is a small Starbucks with (what appears to be) a large volume of customers. I understand why.

I'm impressed with how efficiently and expediently the staff moves the traffic... AND still manages to remember everyone's name. Small neighborhood feel for this big chain store.

A dysmal Starbucks by all standards besides maybe speed. It's impressive they're able to move the line along and complete mobile orders as one of the busiest locations in the city. However, if it weren't for that, I would say it doesn't even deserve one star.

I've tried iced americanos and cold brew from here that never fails to taste burnt and today decided to order an iced green latte which ended up being weird tasting milk (didn't smell spoiled but definitely tasted off) with green powder at the bottom. My friend has ordered iced tea and a frapp here which have both been extremely watered down or 80% ice. I'm not sure if it's because it's the morning, but there hasn't been one order I've been happy with. Skip this location and go to any of the ones nearby.

While the service is pleasant, especially for the high volume of customers, there is a severe shortage of products, even in the crucial morning hours. If you have a specific drink you're craving, you may do better going down the road to a standalone Starbucks.
The young people that work the drive through are delightful and I get good coffee and fine service and a friendly smile!

Watch out!
10:15am after being on the road for over 7 hours, I was looking forward to a great cup of Starbucks coffee.... Not the case here. Ordered Gold Coast, one of my favorites, and the color after adding a small amount of cream was grey!! Super old coffee. 
Do your taste buds a favor, get a red eye or frap.

This Starbucks is amazing. Yes, I love my coffee! This Starbucks is in walking distance from my house, which in itself is wonderful. The baristas are extremely friendly whether it is 6:30am or 3pm. I have been craving their scones lately, so last week I went through the drive through  and unfortunately they were out of both scones. I was disappointed, but I still ordered myself a Strawberry Acai Starbucks Refresher. By the time I ordered at the Drive Thru and got to the window to pay, the awesome Barista had gone to the back and got me a Cranberry Orange Scone and a Blueberry Scone. He definitely went above and beyond and made this girl a customer of this Starbucks for life. Even though I was disappointed, I was already making plans in my head to return the next day to get the scone I wanted. He definitely surprised me in a great way! My husband and I visit this Starbucks at least once, maybe twice a week and for the most part we always order the same exact and it's always a drink on the menu. They have never made a mistake on oir orders. Everyone there is always so upbeat and super friendly even when you can ! on your face from the amazing barista's
Quick and easy! So nice to have a Starbucks inside the JWMarriott. Employees are very friendly and Juan is awesome! Keep up the good work!

I love Starbucks tea & get it often @ this location. I don't understand why this location is extremely slow. It doesn't matter the time or the day there is always a line. They r not very friendly @ this location either. Therefore, I had stopped buying Starbucks tea. I recently started back hoping things got better its been about a year. No luck. I went this morning around 10:25am there was a line wrapped around the building & flowed into the side road where traffic is pretty busy. I parked to go inside thinking it would b quicker. It was not. A large group was waiting inside. After waiting to place my order I asked the very young cashier who the  the manager was & he said he was. I said to him, I just want to let u know there is a line around the building & is even flowing in the side road of traffic.  He said, yes we are busy and asked what I would like to order. Very Disappointing. Ive never had this bad service at another location.
Great starbucks location. Very friendly service the few times I've been here. Love the drive thru bonus.

This is only Starbucks that I've written a review for despite the countless Starbucks locations I've been to in the past. I love this location! It's very close to my apartment in south tampa. 

The factors that makes his Starbucks so special are:
1. There are plenty of free parking! This is an amazing trait to have as a business in south tampa because limited parking or paid parking will keep me from going to certain locations. There's a giant parking lot behind Starbucks so it's not an issue.
2. Plenty of tables to do work! There is one big table which seats 6 ppl, 6 small tables, 4 couches, 6 seats on the bar facing outside, and 1 table that can seat 4 people. So plenty of seating.

On top of those 2 very important factors there is super friendly baristas, and perfect temperature.

I really couldn't ask for more. I think I found my second home. Lol

It's overpriced Starbucks in an airport. Service was fast/fine. Coffee was Starbucks. Prepackaged ham sandwich on marbled bread made my stomach stop rumbling. Got an OK caffeine boost before heading to Dallas. Nothing to write home about. Would not fly to IND just to try it, in case you were thinking of doing that. But if you're bored and have two hours to kill, trapped in Concourse B and need some java, it works fine.

I don't know what's Worse. The employee attitude or the crappy coffee. I had to ask the employee to remake my coffee and she was glaring at me so hard and asked what do you want me to do about it. I kindly asked for another coffee since my coffee was so milky. She made me a new coffee but purposely put lots of milk :/ so much for that!

Thanks to the chai latte I am now officially a Starbucks addict. I love the fact that this one is so close and a drive-thru. 

I'm taking a star off because the parking lot is a mess and frankly kind of dangerous maneuvering your car around there. Another star off because even if I'm the only car in the drive-thru lane it can be a little slow.

I tried the protein cocoa drink and it was caca , the taste is so unbelievably bad it made me laugh. It's  terrible, it taste like burnt turkey dinner with burnt hair and slimy egg whites. Try it if you dare.

I go here when I'm too lazy to get out of the car with the baby.  (Too bad Lazy Daze doesn't have a drive through.)  The baristas here are always friendly but sometimes TOO friendly.  I know they don't really care how my day is going or what I am up to that day.  I especially dislike one particular girl at this location that talks in this high pitched, totally fake voice.  Really annoying.  If you aren't sincere, than at least be real.
This place is fabulous. I am in love with the frappucinos. Java Chip is the best. Or I get the banana chocolate viviano if Im feeling healthy.

I had a conference at the Hyatt, and visited the Starbucks while I was there.

My Green Tea Frappucino was nice and creamy.  It didn't have chunks of ice, as it sometimes does at other Starbucks.

I also liked how they had jars of honey.  You are lucky to get a sack of honey at most of the Starbucks back home.

Great location right inside the GSR and the staff is always usually very friendly, but during times of the year especially holiday events the line service is way to slow. They need to figure out how to bring in some extra help, cashiers and overall people movers...the last thing you want to do is wait 15-20 mins to place your coffee order. You need coffee not to be grumpy and making people wait for coffee makes them grumpier.

Rahat is AWSOME!  Thanks for making my day with your smile and professionalism.  Starbucks has gotten so big that the customer experience often suffers. Rahat brought back memories of how baristas acted on a daily basis.  Thanks:)
sad this store was better a long time ago!now everytime i come here they're out of what i want! good location bad service didnt even make a counter offer!
It's a Starbucks just like all the others. Plenty of parking. Easy access to and from the highway. Good seating area both inside and outside. No complaints.

I've never had a bad experience coming here. This is the most convenient location to work that I can ever have. The baristas are attentive and have never messed up any order that I've gotten there. The place stays clean and the baristas are always helpful in answering any questions that you have. Definitely a location I will keep coming back to! :)

My tip though, try to avoid going during the times of around 8am or 4:30pm. This place is packed with everyone working in the nearby office parks. If you want to save yourself the stress and wait, just go a bit later.

This location is a good one for people watching. Lots of police were frequenting this spot when I visited most recently. But even on a brisk fall day the patio area was in use and the wifi was pretty helpful/convenient. Most Starbucks locations are pretty standard but this was a worthwhile visit.

They have absolutely no clue how to make a decent Vanilla Chai Latte. I went here once last week with a craving for my chai latte. I went to the drive-through because I was in a rush, pick up my iced latte and they forgot to put the vanilla in it I had to drive back around wait for the guy to come to the window. I let him know that I asked for a vanilla chai latte and he told me that chai lattes don't come with a vanilla and I said I understand that but I asked for vanilla. He takes it back pumps probably one pump of vanilla and gives it back it was still shitty but I had no time to go back around for the second time so I left. I'm driving by there today. Ask the guy for the same exact thing, get my iced vanilla chai latte and it still tastes like shit. Case in point, don't ask for a iced vanilla chai latte at this location.
Yum, chocolate chip frappuccino out of world. Service outstanding. My son really likes cake pops

Today is the first time I visited this Starbucks location. I stopped by in the morning to grab a tea on my way to the meeting in the Matrix Hotel. There was a decent line-up, but it went quickly. Service was really good and the baristas were very friendly. The tea was great as well, but it always is. I was very impressed with this location.
I've always had a great experience here. I like just a block away and they very friendly and quick with their service. There's one large table for bigger parties if that's a big deal for you.

This Starbucks is terrible! It never seems to have its act together. The staffing is always slow and both the drive thru and the line inside the store take forever to get through. No other Starbucks I've ever seen has had such terrible delays.
Great Starbucks , the most consistent in this area. Fast service and they have parking and a entrance on the front and back sides. Mocha Rocks!

This Starbucks gives Starbucks a VERY bad reputation. It is ridiculously slow. On all accounts. Whether you're going through the drive thru or inside ordering, its like they have NO idea what is going on or how to make a drink. It's so disappointing. The staff is hit or miss. Sometimes they are right on point with what's going on and sometimes they are completely aloof. 

Today it seemed like the person at the window wasn't paying attention to a word we were saying. 

They handed us one of our orders with hot chocolate spilled all over the lid. It was a complete mess. They also gave us one drink with a sip stopper and one without. No idea the reasoning behind that.

They need to get it together. It's a prime location, and a busy one at that. But with their lack of organization and ability to be a BIT more speedy is really going to hurt this spot.

This is my favorite Starbucks in town! Even though its the most crowded due to the location and tourists, my drinks are ALWAYS perfect and my breakfast sandwich is always warm throughout! Because of the crowds/line here, I prefer to submit a mobile order and they always complete it fully and quickly. I come before work around 7:30-8:00 am and park on St. Charles (its free before 8am). The music they play is always enjoyable, sometimes corny, but always makes you feel good! From Disney songs to Backstreet Boys to Elton John, you always want to sing along. Its a great way to start my day.

I usually go to this Starbucks every morning. For the most part it's like any other Starbucks, they have messed up my drinks a couple of times because I usually change it up everyday. And sometimes the barista will see me and make me what I ordered the day before. I guess that's not really a bad thing that they recognize me as a customer? Sometimes the staff is slow in the morning. And if you get there in the late morning, don't expect to get any to yogurt, sandwiches or bistro boxes. They will all be long gone.

Wonderful Starbucks. Staff is out of this world and they do remember you and your family by name and drink. 

Customer service is awesome and the drinks are spot on. 

Only reason it's not 5 stars is they tend to have the "B" team in there on the weekends. 

I go between 3 and 5 times per week.

I've only been through the drive-thru at this Starbucks location.. but that's the best part!  Anytime I've zipped through for a white chocolate mocha, I've received quick, friendly service and a great drink!

Come on, we've all had at least a cup of coffee or tea at Starbucks at one time or another.  I'm a one cup in the morning kind of person.  Usually stop here with my daughter who's addicted to Vente Green Ice Tea (no sugar, no shaking, no extra water) or 3 shots of expresso over ice.  

So yes, I stop by often,  Do like their lemon pound cake... usually have that when i"m in a hotel or other place other when I'm not home for breakfast.  I do like a hot Carmel Macchatio (drink it, can't spell it).

Let's face it, they make a good cup of coffee and their iconic everywhere..  Sure, I'll go when I need or want a good cup of coffee.  May stop by some of these days to check out their lunch.

Go Starbucks!
I just a iced Carmel coffee. Delicious refreshing , made perfect. Starbucks is the best.

I wish they had more seating. This place has a great warm & cozy vibe. I'm pretty certain if they had comfy seats it would be hard to get people (me!) to leave. I'm guessing it caters to the millions of people who work here in the Comcast Building (which totally makes sense) vs the occasional passerby who wants to sit & relax for a while. 

Otherwise, it's a Starbucks. Just like any of their other places as far as drinks & food goes.

I like Starbucks but their rewards are really painful to check. I have to push so many buttons to find out my balance every time.

Aside from that, this location is pretty great. I love going in and out but you'll never catch me sticking around. The baristas are good at making coffee and they are kind. It's definitely a place to check out.
Relatively fast service during the morning rush. Great location on corner of St Charles and Canal

I've been coming here recently to work "at home" and am enjoying it for the most part. Every time I arrive though, I'm *hoping* there's a seat near the front of the building. If you don't find one there, you're stuck in the back area that is quite dark. It's not bad to be in the back, it's just not as "cozy" to sit for extended periods of time.

Service is normal, and basically it's a convenient Starbucks for all the normal reasons (wifi, location, etc.)
I love this Starbucks, and the people are great! As long as the coffee is this good, what else can I say because it says it all for me in this convenient location!!!

Super slow drive-thru service. I know I need to give myself plenty of time to go to this location and the only reason I return is because I work nearby. They also seem to run out of things more than other locations I go to frequently. Staff is usually friendly, though they often seem flustered or stressed. Not sure what's going on at this Starbucks location...

I LOVE this location. This is possibly my favorite Starbucks in the Edmonton vicinity. There is just that something special about the Highstreet area that I can't quite describe. It is a feeling and until you visit on a sunny afternoon you may not know what I am referring to. 

Anyways the Starbucks itself is in the end unit of a strip mall giving it access to a great patio space. Well the patio isn't as large as it could be; they make the best of the space available. I like that the patio feels somewhat secluded and has a mix of trees (providing shade) and sunny spots.

Inside is tight on space too. Again they make the best of the space available but there are not too many tables and chairs. It is always clean and tidy and there are bathroom available for patrons. As this is a busy location I appreciate that the service is always stellar - the staff are friendly while remaining efficient.

The location is what makes this Starbucks special - you must try it out!

Fabulous location, amazing staff, and fun music. 
The store manager, Irene, is super friendly and makes coming here totally worth wading through tourists. I especially love the local artisan touches like their trombone chandelier and the filigree ironwork. My favorite part of the store is their Hurricane Katrina rebuilding photography. Starbucks is there when it matters!

I think the baristas need to be retrained. There is obvious unresolved issues within the employees but please don't complain in front of the customers, it's very unprofessional. Wished I asked for her name; but  the miss working Friday's around 3 something close to 4 just now seems really miserable. 

She didn't even mix my drinks. I ordered two sweetened green ice tea, a no brainier drink that cannot be wrong. She literally pour syrup, ice then then green tea. Didn't mix or anything. 

Basically, if you see a miserable young lady behind the counter, skip your drinks.

this is my go to spot for a caffeine fix...lol
everyone who works here puts forth an excellent level of customer service....
keep up the good work my friends
Small store, inconsistent service, food items "meh" and can get great donuts/pastry/coffee at Tyler's across the parking lot for less $$.

I placed a mobile order for a venti iced coconut milk macchiato and a berry trio yogurt. The employees ignored my order for 45 minutes. When I went to ask, they rudely said that I probably ordered it at a different location and demanded to see my receipt. After showing them, they made my drink and forgot about my yogurt. Worst starbucks experience ever and I'm a gold member. I go here all the time, but this was the worst service I've ever had.

This is something of historical significance because I finally got a drink from Starbucks that I liked. It was a major surprise to me when I got a peppermint mocha frappucino from them, and it turned out to be good. 

My SO and I are spending the holidays in St. Louis, and we went out for dinner, got haircuts and then went to this Starbucks for coffee and to sit and talk for awhile. My peppermint mocha tasted like a peppermint candy bar, so maybe, that's why I liked it. I got a small one because I was really suspect as to what it was going to taste like, but then I was happy with it. I liked that one enough that I will go back and get another one. It's seasonal so they won't have it after the holidays.

This Starbucks is rather small inside and has small tables, too, but is quite adequate for what it is. The counter and the pastry case is set up like all the other Starbucks around town. The two workers were very nice and friendly; they provided good service and were helpful.

Busy busy busy! This is a hopping Starbucks from my few experiences. Long lines, lots of students. Friendly, efficient drive-thru window and great coffee, no complaints! They even have the credit card reader rolled out so you can do it yourself.

This Starbucks rates a review because, for better or worse, it has character. During the day it's so packed with laptop users you'd swear you entered a tech start-up's unorthodox work commune were it not for the baristas' familiar outfits. As dusk fades, it attracts a fairly regular crowd of Tampa's finest minimum wage earners outside while the inside seems a bit like a study hall. This is one of those rare Starbucks that seems to approximate the Platonic coffee house, with regulars either spending all day exploiting the free wireless connection alongside a cuppa joe or just living the slightly overpriced Bohemian life as they dread the limbo between when this once 24hr Sbux closes and when they can return to what has clearly become their neighborhood haven.
Great Neighborhood Starbucks, Staff is very friendly and place is cleaned regularly.

This Starbucks is a real stinker! Overcharged! Refused to refund!

I was overcharged for a Vente sized decaf Americana. The cashier indicated that a Vente decaf brew was unavailable; however, he could offer an Americana instead at a higher cost.

I urged him to brew a decaf or offer me the Americana at the same price. The male cashier refused. 

After paying the cashier, I requested the female server to provide management's contact information. She refused. Moreover, she confirmed that I was indeed overcharged, but she declined to offer a refund for the difference.

We are guests at the Grand Sierra and will also pass down this over charge at checkout. Moreover, Starbucks senior staff will also be notified.

Below optimum staffing! Management is responsible. Caveat Emptor!

It is what it is, and what it is is a Starbucks in an airport. There is always a line, but it's not because the people who work there are slow -- quite the opposite. It's just because this is the first place you see after getting through security that offers coffee, so everyone congregates here. 

This Starbucks offers all of the things a normal Starbucks offers: sandwiches, oatmeal, muffins, etc. Like I mentioned earlier, they are also super fast here, so even though there is always a line, you won't be waiting too long (maybe 10 minutes).

I have never had a problem here! Hands down my favorite Starbucks. The staff is the absolute best! Great customer service, clean shop and always get your drinks right. Saturday mornings are always super busy but the staff always seems to zoom through the line and maintain their great job!

I frequent this Starbucks a few times a month and I'm always happy. The staff are friendly and the place is clean. So far my orders have been perfect, never messed up. One time they had a young girl singing and playing guitar, which was nice. The place is usually never dead, although never too crowded. I can always manage to find a seat.
Great service, enjoy going here! The frapps are awesome. They keep there establishment always clean and tidy. Fortunately I live only a couple of blocks away and get to enjoy this location.
This Starbucks is consistently poor. They do not accept the Starbucks Gold Card, which is annoying, and the coffee is almost always bad--very acidic and stale.
This is one of the starbucks I like to avoid.  Over the past decade, they consistently have had poor and slow service.  I'll occasionally still stop by, but it's not too much better.  I don't get it.

Nice enough coffee shop in quaint Irvington neighborhood.   A bit busy this afternoon, yet slow service seemed more attributable to poorly deployed workers. There appeared to be many, most doing little.  That said, a nice place to meet for conversation, business or chillin'.  Usual good quality quaffs.

This Starbucks is gorgeous, the renovations in the building are fantastic. I am so happy it is opened as it is only a block from my office. Starbucks is Starbucks is Starbucks. The only thing special about this one is that it is a Starbucks reserve location and the sell the special reserve star blends. The pastry and dessert case is spectacular and the display of the food in there is quite pleasing to the eye, luckily Starbucks likes to post the calorie count on their baked goods which usually causes me to pass up those types of treats, especially when I know my delicious salted caramel mocha has about 500 calories in it. Whatevs! I need it sometimes, peppermint mocha!! Where have you been all my life? Love the holidays at Starbucks!!

This is by far my most favorite Starbucks. Though the location is smaller in size, and your drinks come slower than usual, I feel their structural restrictions should not reflect poorly in their ratings. Those people complaining should definitely take advantage of the online ordering.

They're customer service is always consistently stellar here. Travis, the store manager, is the epitome of a leader. I had an issue with an order and Travis assured me that it would be taken care of!
great customer service by the lovely lady with glasses.

Nothing but terrible experiences at this location! I have never had a smooth and efficient experience while visiting this Starbucks, both in the drive thru and in the store. The drive thru is terribly slow with ridiculous wait times of upwards 15 minutes. I've pulled up to the window on several occasions where a barista has even opened the window to greet me or on other occasions they will open the window, process my payment, and then disappear for several minutes without communication what is going on. Let's talk about the inside and recap my episode from this morning. There must have been three baristas working drive through, two working the bar, one working the till, and a barista (who I later found out was the manager) was running around providing support where needed. It was absolute chaos. After waiting in line for 15-20 minutes I waited around for my sandwich and pastry. I communicated to the barista at the till that I was going to wait off to the left for my items. I don't think he understood what I meant, none the less I waited for an additional five minutes before asking the barista, who I later found out was the manager, about the status of my order. She stated that they were down at the end of the bar and that they had called my name several minutes ago. I was standing RIGHT THERE. No one ever called my name. I was already late for work and left. As I was pulling out of the plaza, my sandwich didn't smell right. I looked and it was the WRONG sandwich. They gave me sausage, which I cannot eat. I had to drive back and run in with the sandwich.The manager first verified the name on the bag before confirming that indeed I was given the wrong sandwich. She re-made the sandwich and asked for which form of payment I used and offered me a refund, not understanding that a refund would be more inconvenient for me as I would have to go back to my car and get my wallet. Let's be real, they have free drink cards. She could have provided better customer service. Unless this Starbucks issues an apology I will not be visiting it anytime soon. What should have been a convenience ended up in a 30 minute experience due to complete chaos behind the counter and poorly run service.

My favorite Starbucks place. Parking is convenient, the employees are friendly and professional and I enjoy the options of sitting outside or inside. Either way bright and open a great place to sit, relax and chat (or use your laptop of course).

The baristas in the mornings are rude and unfriendly.  I've come to this location a number of times sporadically over the past couple of years hoping to be treated cordially (nothing more required!).  Each time the gal or the guy take the card/cash and then plop the change/card on the table without so much as a thank you or a smile.  It's common courtesy to hand back the change or the credit card to the customer.  These rude idiots never do that.  And, I've watched them treat others similarly.  The management at this location leaves a lot to be desired.  Maybe I'll try in another 6 months and see if they've hired better employees....

My first time at this Starbucks was genuinely fantastic. Yes it can get a little crowded. Bought a little waiting is worth the good service. I asked then nice young lady behind the counterto give me a lighter and stronger blend in the same brew. I had the blonde with the medium and she made a single pour. And seem to be very glad to oblige. Definitely will make this a regular place to visit, the outdoor seating is a plus. The people that were visiting that they were very pleasant and patient. The coffee was fresh brewed well,perfect temperature. And I can be pretty fussy about temperature not a problem here. Very comfortable seating inside, I was waiting for someone else to meet me there. And would not mind waiting again and enjoying a good cup of coffee. I must add. Had a Delicious warm, Flourless(No Gluten). Double Chocolate Cookie. They are so addicting. Sometimes, I take half home and, 10 sec in the MWave  and treat myself again. Plenty of parking on the side of bldg.
Awesome service. I always am greeted with friendly individuals. Watch out for the parking lot which can be a cluster-f*** in the morning.

Overpriced coffee, very rude staff, and store is not clean.

I have been to this Starbucks more than a few times and sometimes you will get grinds in your coffee that's over-roasted and burnt.
