There are much better places to buy coffee than Starbucks in this shopping center.  One place sells bagels and has a variety of coffees at a reasonable price.

Tonight I tried to order my regular order of an Iced chai, nonfat. The customer service wasn't as it normally is during the morning. 

I repeated to the barista working three times, nonfat milk, and received an iced chai, with regular milk. 

I wasn't too happy with this after taking two sips I could tell it was wrong. The sticker receipt wasn't even on the cup like it normally is.

I had to go to the Tyrone Blvd location to get a frappucino for my bf because the barista said the blender was broken. At this other location, they had much better customer service, and replaced my messed up order for no charge.

This is by far the slowest most inefficient Starbucks I have ever been to. I waited 15 minutes for a mobile order on a drink that is not even complicated. I watched as the Barista constantly took drinks for the drive thru and put them in line before mine. After 15 minutes, I had to say something. I spend quite a bit at Starbucks but I won't be coming back to this store anytime soon.
High priced dish water. For what they charge you would think they could turn out a better product. Yuck.

Every time I visit this Starbucks, I'm disappointed.  Today, it was so loud I couldn't read the newspaper.  Staff was vacuuming the food case - so they turned up the music to hear it - then had to speak to one another so loud that it was impossible to think.  This store needs new management.  I generally avoid it, but it was  the location I needed today.

Deserves zero stars. Worst Starbucks experience I've ever had. I love Starbucks and I love going there everyday. The employees working on 9/23 got our order wrong, didn't care to fix it. They were confused about what we ordered (two venti iced double shots, one with whole milk, one with non fat milk) after they fixed our drinks, they were still not exactly what we ordered. Finally, the manager came out and was absolutely no help at all, she made our experience worse. She asked us if the drinks were close enough to what we ordered. Ummm..... NO! At that point we were too frustrated to keep arguing with an entire staff that was incompetent and rolling their eyes at us.  Next time we'll stick to the casino cafe. Not to mention we were staying at Grand Sierra (our favorite resort) celebrating a birthday
Worst Starbucks ever. Horrible customer service. Very unorganized and nobody can make a drink correctly. Stay away.

What a nice pre-flight visit!! I am so impressed by the four employees working here this morning!! A very long line at 6:45 this morning, and these ladies kept the line moving, kept the drinks and treats flowing, AND managed to stay pleasant!! My wrap got burned, but, with the line - these things happen. All in all, a stop I was very thankful for this morning!

Just went there this morning and the girl at the window was very rude to me because i didn't know how to use the app correctly. Then, when i received my venti iced coffee it was filled to the top with ice & had barely any coffee in it. I've never had either of these problems at any other location. Very disappointing.
Friendly staff. Fast service. They always greet you and have a big smile on their faces. Coffee was always made according to my order. Great location and store was clean. Overall great experience.

The guy taking my order in the drive thru messed up my drink. I don't know if he heard the right thing or not. When I told them that wasn't what I ordered, I heard the guy say "what does she want now?" in a bitchy tone. Umm, rude much!
I must say I've never liked coffee until my mentor got me to try a caramel frapp here. It's my all time favorite besides the pumpkin spice frapp they serve in the fall.

Worst Starbucks experience, ever.  Even worse then stopping at a rest stop Starbucks - gasp.

I met a friend here on a Saturday morning, and it was chaos. We were getting on the road and wanted a quick pick-me-up before our long drive, but it would have been faster if I drove another shop and got it.

First, the person who took my order did not hand me my baked good (which normally happens when it's not heated). I asked about it after I paid, and he confirmed I had ordered it but didn't get the coffee cake for me. I thought maybe they would hand it to me with the drink, but that did not happen. In the meantime, a woman who ordered after me was handed her pastry at checkout, so apparently that does happen, just not for me. I ended up having to ask one of the other store personnel to get the coffee cake for me, after waiting for some time for my drink.

Then I went to put half-an-half in my coffee, and the debacle continued. There was no half-and-half out on the service station, so I inquired about it. I told a barista there a no carafe at all to begin with, yet she brought out a carton expecting to refill the carafe; but she couldn't, obviously. Instead of letting us use the half-and-half, she disappeared with it to look for a carafe, which took more than 5 minutes before she found one and then filled it before we could finally use it.

There was no order in the store and it was just Mayhem. I don't think the staff is well trained and could definitely use more supervision or additional training. I don't think I'll stop by here again.
Good customer service. Decent coffee, messed up order twice but fixed it both times. Espresso sometimes tastes burnt but I think that's just the bean they use. Overall good

I usually go here to avoid the mall starbucks, which can take forever.

For the most part, I get what I order and thats that. No smile, no Hi, how are you. Just an exchange. I tip on occasion, and you would think since I am a regular, they would at least say, hey welcome back or thanks for the tip....no, nothing.

Meh

with so many awesome coffee places in Nashville, in comparison it's 3 stars.  Does 8th and roast or crema, or the well want to come out to Brentwood? Even Frothy monkey, goodness, perch is the only other coffee spot not named starbucks or panera.  
I'm ashamed that I go to starbucks.  There I said it, but for one second please see that this is to negate all the 2 star reviews against hipsters who complain about getting coffee, well why don't you just make your own at home, and fill up with your own mug.  
I'm sorry if I offended anyone, you can do something about it, and start your own coffee shop in the area, and solve my problem.  Look what you made me do, I have to give starbucks a 4 star rating.  

And that's how I feel about Occupy.

This is a new drive thru starbucks that opened up in the perfect location.  The coffee is now as I would expect a starbucks cup of Joe to be.  It was not as good when it first opened up but all is trained well now and no more burnt coffee.   Yessssss.   My life is now complete with this new location and with the drive thru!!!   Also ordering thru the app now..... Dangerously good..

I used to love her...but I had to kill her...   
I just tweeted: CRAP! GOT DRINK WRONG - AGAIN! Ordered 130degree...didn't take a sip for 15 minutes & STILL BURNED MY MOUTH!!! Now I'm YELPING!....

C'mon y'all! You guys know who I am! 
Grande decaf 2pump mocha, steamed at 130!!!!

Do you know you only steam it at the proper temperature 65% of the time now???

I used to go to Starbucks on Fowler but they only got it right 30% of time.
You guys used to be great! What happened? :(

Oh, and BTW, it's D-I-L-A-N! LOL ;)

P.S. Nichelle, miss you! :)

Staff is helpful and perky on weekday mornings.
The lines can be very long and at times slow moving.
Atmosphere is usually nice, with a cozy space and decent amount of tables.
Retail selection is excellent with a great variety of mugs, thermoses, etc.
Breakfast sandwiches always stocked and available, even if they're not in the case.
Usually better to go early as the line can get long later in the morning.
Clean restrooms.
K-cups and other take-out coffee readily available.
Simply a lovely place to spend an hour getting set for the day.

As others have mentiond,this Starbucks is located in a shopping center strip mall, so it's got a different clientele than say a mall Starbucks! In between the wedding and reception, we had a couple hours to kill so we came here. The line to order was quick but the line to receive moved at a glacial pace.

We were able to score tables here though; I guess most people grab their drinks and leave! It was very clean as well!
Slowest Starbucks in the universe!  Don't know why I'm surprised each time I go there and it takes 20min to get my online order that said would be ready in 5-7 minutes.

It's a Starbucks. It has all the Starbucks-y things they all have. The employees are friendly enough without being in-your-face, for the most part. The product has always been consistent. Being behind the bus stop, while you wait for our wildly unpredictable bus system, you can wait inside here and be warm/cool in severe weather. 

The Starbucks also brings something to the neighborhood. That something that says to my dopey suburban friends and in-laws "You're ok here...it's safe to walk around." and I like that. Because as much as I love my charming eastside neighborhood, this is still "in the ghetto" to a lot of people. That Starbucks says "It's ok to bring the stroller down, have lunch at Dufour's, and shop at Homespun. We aren't as shiny and new as Carmel or Fishers, but we're still cute & stylish."

Dying to get away from the crowd, my group decided we needed some beverages of the caffeinated kind. The spouse piped up, "Hey, there's a Starbucks down the street". The bestie and I jumped right on board with the idea and off we went, adventurers in SoHo. 

We walked in and I smiled. What a nice location! It's very open, with vaulted ceilings and plenty of seating.

Our barista was efficient and friendly, even when I whipped out an online coupon for a free kid's hot chocolate with espresso drink purchase. 

Tonight was my splurge night, so I opted for a tall Peppermint Mocha Latte and a Peppermint Brownie Cake Pop. Both were delicious. The barista that prepared our drinks had a dazzling smile and added a flourish to the way she prepared the beverages. Great customer service! 

I wish I was in this area more often. I'd certainly stop here to kick back with a coffee.

This is the Starbucks closest to my house, and I look forward to seeing the staff here. They are always so pleasant, and fast. I order from my app and by the time I get there it's all ready. Technology is so wonderful!
Average. Coffee was bitter. Great raspberry lemonade.

This is my go to coffee shop as it is near my house and I pass it every morning on the way to work.  The staff is friendly, and they generally keep a dark roast brewed throughout the whole day (one of my requirements!)

One thing to note is that if you are in a hurry and see 3 or more cars at the drive through, I recommend going inside to order instead.  You never know when you are going to get stuck behind someone ordering hot food and a few special venti double espresso, double non-fat, soy, mocha macchiatos.  You'll save quite a bit of time by ordering inside when stuff like this happens, especially if you have simple orders (ie standard coffee or espresso).

Drinks are tasty. Staff is hit and miss. Most of the time very friendly and helpful. One or two every so often that just make you cringe. Not as clean as it should be. Always seems busy.(but not a terribly long wait) I'll keep going here as the drinks are good and the experience is usually good!
This has become the slowest Starbucks ever. The drive through line is ridiculous and slow, inside is empty but just as slow? Now my car is blocked by the drive through line.
The employees do nothing but complain about working at Starbucks. At least they got my coffee right.
The service is ok, coffee and teas are standard. If service was better it would get a higher rating, they couldn't keep up with 6 people working and 8 people in line.

This Starbucks is a diamond-in-the-rough.

The interior decor is what I'd expect from a nice coffeeshop that is looking to add atmosphere.  Some old-world style furniture, etc.

The lineup moved quickly, though the barista was a bit behind (and forgot my order initially)... the atmosphere made up for it.

My absolute biggest issue with this store is their mobile ordering. What's the point of putting in my order if I still have to wait 10 min for you to acknowledge that I'm standing at the pickup area waiting for my coffee that's cold by the time I get it. Put the orders in the same place as the rest and not behind the counter!
Your typical Starbucks located within another organization - small and without a lot of the extras. For example, no breakfast sandwiches :( Or any hot food what-so-ever. But staff was friendly.
Waited over 45min to get 2 travel size coffees. They only have a limited amount of coffee machines and were out a bunch of other items...at 8am on week day!

I have only been to this location a few times, but I have consistently received shockingly wonderful customer service, and from different cashiers/baristas too. 
Employees here just seem happier. Now I'm not saying other Starbucks have poor customer service, quite the contrary. But this place stands out as the cashiers will go out of their way to make recommendations and often hand out samples too. While I've had samples at other locations, this one seems to be more on top of them. 
Luckily I live very close, and you can't beat the hours here either.

Need a reward after my 5k! I so earned the grande cold brew with sweet cream this morning. I received fast, friendly service with a smile. The environment was clean and extremely nice. The staff seemed like they enjoyed where they work. The car line was moving so fast, too. They cleared it out in no time and kept it small.

Worst. Ever. If there are more than two people in line, do yourself a favor and go someplace else. Anyplace else. Otherwise be prepared to wait 15-20+ minutes for anything more complicated than a coffee.

Sad location! Don't u dare drive your full size truck into that compact size parking lot! FAIL!  In a hurry? Drive on by! Does not matter that they have a drive thru, it is just an illusion that you think you can really drive thru ! Super tight, and super slow! No convenience at all! Don't ask for any food item to be hot, as it would serve better as an ice cube in your ice coffee! Summary? Act like it is not even there!

Line was very long, but they were appropriately staffed and the line went quickly. Waiting for drinks was very minimal. Had to dock a star because they don't accept the Starbucks rewards. However, our Americanos were 50cents less than they are at any other Starbucks in California. Drinks were accurate. Plenty of seating.

Avoid this location 
 
Rude employees. Terrible customer service. Got my order wrong. Super slow.

Okay....... so perhaps you are busy right now.... but with three employees at the front counter area and in five minutes NO ONE minimally says "good morning" or "we will be right with you"?!?!  Really?  I expect much better service from Starbucks.  Really sad....

I've been to this Starbucks a few times now, and it gets very busy (it was busy each time we went - morning and early afternoon). I give it 5 stars because customer service was good, and they were sweet to accommodate my boys when they asked for "secret menu" items. We had the secret menu app, and showed them the recipes of the drinks we wanted, and they were cool with it. Thanks, guys :)

*** Pit stop review (Carpinteria) ***
Time for the morning jolt of sugar and caffeine. I haven't had this stuff in a while. The caramel frapachino is served as I remembered it. It is a little less slushy and more on the watery side, but that's ok. The taste is consistent from one store to the next.

Food = good
Seating area = clean
Service = friendly 
Restroom = needs to be cleaned

I ordered a Tall Soy Flat White , but it looked more like a dry cappuccino . So much foam! Not the first time either. Unfortunately, it's a hit or miss location. Some days their coffee is textbook & delicious, other days, not so much.
Cute Starbucks location right in prime location. This location is very small but the customers were friendly to share the large community table. Staff was friendly and coffee was good as usual!
Baristas are always friendly and the coffee is consistently good. Indoor/outdoor seating adds bonus points. As some other users said, it's a Starbucks. And it does it's job well!

Small inside, one long walk has Windows which takes up predominantly the whole store and makes the interior a bit warm. Staff is very personable and polite the way customer service should be. Service was quick and there were no lines for 10am. Seems like a locals spot lots of old folks hanging outside with their dogs. I like this location
Overpriced wait in line for barely any caffeine.  Go to the Brentwood perk! It's way better than this chain corporation that supports child labor and UNFAIR trade!

No drive up window. :(
However, each time I'm greeted with a warm smile, I don't understand previous reviews. 
Coffee quality is the same as other Starbucks.

Great atmosphere but more importantly, incredible staff. The two baristas working when I went today helped me stay calm when my term paper randomly erased. They tried to help me recover it and gave me encouragement and writing tips. Truly awesome women who gave Starbucks a GREAT name. Will be a regular once I emerge from re-writing my term paper.
My friend and I came to this Starbucks for some work time. It was a very well taken care of establishment and had a super friendly staff. I would definitely come back to this one again.

Great Coffee as with any Starbucks. Drive-thru is pretty slow though.

Love the "pup-cups" they give to my dogs everytime we go there!

I really don't know where to start.  The service is bad and slow.  The last time i was there they completely forgot my order and I noticed after about 10 customers go by..  I understand mistakes happen so I go again today.  This time I looked to see who ordered before me and I thought  i will get my coffee after her, surely.  Nope, again about 7-10 customers get their coffee that came in after me. I  speak to a staff member and ask where my coffee is and he said it's coming.  He said they  make the brewed coffee first??????????? (I was having an iced Americano)  , so i point to a guy walking out with an iced drink and said , "what about him?  He just walked in and got a drink.. THE GUY SAID,  "WELL HE'S A REGULAR CUSTOMER!  ?????  REALLY?????    THIS IS THE WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE EVER!   It always has been.. Finally, another server, grabs my cup to make it,  stops , puts a pasty in the oven and walks in the back room and doesn't come out.  I had to ask again for my drink.  There are so many excellent Starbucks, that i can't understand why this one doesn't care about customer service.  I'll never go again..  too many excellent Starbucks.  The one on Edmondson Pike, the one on Nolensville Road and the one on Murfreesboro Road. .. all consistent in giving excellent service.

I'm so tired of spending almost 5$ and my drink tasting like blah. Starbucks has been so extremely disappointing lately. I drive for my job. So I've been to many. I got a skinny vanilla late tall. Tasted like sugar water. Great. Not. I am a black coffee drinker but hate their black coffee. The skinny vanilla is always a nice treat. Until it's made like this. I am not sure if the expresso was missing. Or what the issue. The service was fast and friendly but who even notices that or cares if your coffee tastes like crap?!?!!!!? Ughhhhhhh. Train your workers or get out of here.
Any place that the greatest shortstop of all time (Jeter of course) hangs out must be legit.

Awesome perk of staying in the Hyatt is being able to visit this Starbucks from 6am-5pm on the 2nd floor of the hotel.

Can get busy in the mornings and lunch time as business conferences are held throughout the day at this venue and many visit Starbucks before and after etc.

Other than that if you're a Starbucks fan and in the hotel/area..Great location to stop at and grab a drink. Can't avoid frappacinnos and passion fruit tea/lemonade on a daily basis here.

Warning to Starbucks Rewards card holders:  You will get star credits for purchases but the free add-ons for green & gold level members will not be honored in this location.
This is a Starbucks in name & beans only; deceiving & up-charged.  Beverage quality is sub-standard, inconsistent in order taking and drink preparation.  Shift workers seemed to change every 3 hours, managed by hotel staff.  
It is a shame this is the only Starbucks game around.  No stand-alone store that isn't 2+ miles away in triple digit heat.  
I'd rather bring my own coffeemaker next stay or cab it to the courthouse location, which has much better reviews than other nearby locations.
I love Starbucks but do not have a coffee on your menu if you do not have all the ingredients for. I don't think its right to pay full price for something that your not getting the full product.

Used to live here and was a regular. On a trip I stopped in for coffee and it was great but boy the service here on this day was awful! The barista was obviously having a bad day (older blond woman) and gave me bad attitude for asking for a drink carrier. She went so far as to make snide remarks to another patron regarding MY choice of sweetener: "so glad YOU don't use that stuff, it's so bad for you"! I'm surprised a scientist works part time as a barista,

Everyone at this Starbucks is nice and that is a plus. However, they are also incredibly slow. It takes them way to long to get my very simple order. I used to work for a Starbucks so I can appreciate how busy they can be. I suspect they put all their attention to their drive thru and neglect the cafe. I prefer to go to the Dunkin donuts next door. They are way faster and it is a much better experience.

Decent Starbucks. Lots of room if you need seating. The service is usually pretty quick. 

If you're looking for a quiet place this isn't the Starbucks for you. It's usually pretty steady in there and the baristas are incredibly loud.   I wish they would assign one of them to clean the dining area when there was down time. It's usually a mess.

So slow....people hold spots for groups of 5-8 and it makes it worse. I really hate coming here but when you stay here the only option is to leave the hotel to go to another place. The staff is friendly but sadly this is the slowest Starbucks on earth. The people who cut in front of us also took the last breakfast sandwich....then they didn't have the tea I wanted then someone else found it. Then they made my drink wrong which I drank anyways and I tipped them because I always do but this is also a tip...and the same people going to the pool are just here to use the pool for the day...so mind you...if you stay here you share the pool with every line cutting Tom, Dick and Harry and it's crowded, crowded, crowded.

Great Starbucks! Good location and plus there is a shared parking lot behind it so you don't have to worry about parking. The parking lot does get full if you go during the prime going out hours like Friday and Saturday nights. But that's the same for all the parking lots on Howard during those hours.

This Starbucks has the typical selection of food and drinks. There's plenty of seating inside if you don't mind sitting at the long table or the bar-like counter that faces the outside. There are several comfy leather seats and also several smaller tables. As with any Starbucks, there's always people in there working on their laptops. 

They do have lots of seating outside. They have tables that face Howard ave and also a couple of tables tucked on the side that faces 717 South (which is more quiet than the street noise).

Before getting on the Pa Turnpike early this morning, I made a short detour onto Horizon Boulevard to get some java and a small bite for breakfast.  When Chik-Fil-A was not yet open, I drove through the take out window at Starbucks next door.  

I liked the convenience and time savings of a drive thru, but it seemed like the order taker was also the barista as well as the short order cook.  So, she looked rather busy, and in need of assistance.  Still, she kept her composure and got everything right.  

As usual, the coffee had a burnt and bitter taste, but the extra milk requested helped to soften the harshness.  I asked for their Sausage, Egg and Cheese Sandwich on a croissant, but was told that all these meals are pre-packaged and microwaved just before sale.  I decided to go with the English Muffin as the only option.  I don't like what microwaves do to eggs and bread, so the meal was at best, average.  Nothing I would want a second time.  

Hopefully, CFA will be open next time I find myself in a similar predicament.
Fast and efficient. Happy Hour is also a plus. Got 2 venti green tea frappucino, 1 venti vanilla bean frappucino and 1 venti caramel coffee frap. All were delicious.
This has got to be the worst Starbucks in Canada. Always new people, the drinks are inconsistent and the service is horrible. Definitely needs new management!

Now I do not work in the food service industry so I might be wrong in this but....I went to this location while I was in the mall yesterday and there was an employee who was working wearing sandals. Open. Toe. Sandals. Again. Maybe I'm wrong in thinking wearing anything open toe while dealing with the health and safety of someone's food is wrong but I was extremely grossed out, and that was only one of my issues. The two employees working were more interested in the conversation they were having with each other than in helping the paying customers to the point of the gal who was the cashier/drink maker/sandal wearer was taking my order with her back turned to me and pushing a few buttons but still carrying on her conversation with the coworker. I may not work in food but I absolutely work in customer service and I can tell you that her lack of attention to detail in taking not only my order but someone else's could result in a potential mishap. What if she didn't hear I wanted soymilk vs regular? What if she put regular coffee in the decaf that was ordered? Some people have health issues/dietary restrictions that could have a negative physical reactions if she didn't focus on the customer she was assisting.  I will not be conducting my business with location ever again.

Early morning regular customer here. Baristas are friendly and knowledgeable. Once you're a regular, they have your coffee ready for you almost before you step up to the counter. Lines back up later in the day, and it can get noisy and a bit chaotic, but early morning is nice and quiet.

Does not honor Gold card member coupon codes nor do they allow you to redeem free drinks that you have earned on your card. Also, service was super slow when I visited around 8am and there was a noticible upcharge for some reason. Avoid at all cost!

I liked this Starbucks it was very clean and the baristas know how to make great coffee. Too bad the don't make my hazelnut macchiato. The parking is in the alley behind the Starbucks. They have parking on the street but you have to pay a meter fee.  A big fan of Starbucks. Love my coffee.

They make drinks. But there's always new staff so they are constantly learning how to take orders and make drinks. There's usually a line/wait and usually the drinks come out different everytime. Go up the street to Roxborough and get a better drink with better service.
Sorry. I know retail and service jobs are difficult, been there and done that, but this Starbucks is awe full. They are slower than hell.
Nothing goes better with a turnpike drive like Starbucks!

Their selection is great but I hate that this is my local Starbucks. They are slow as dirt and Alicia is nasty! I've witnessed arguments between staff at the register. I've been given incorrect drinks I've even been told that The way I know a certain drink is made is wrong (because we water down milk in an iced drink). I won't come here unless I have to. Last resort. Il drive out of my way to yardley or even Hamilton if the ones in target and the mall aren't open yet!

I love this Starbucks at Tampa Premium Outlets! They are so cheery and nice. They are open a lot longer than the usual outlet hours from 7:30AM to 10PM. 

This last visit I got their seasonal Caramel Brûlée latte which whip cream! It's so good, & it's just like a dessert to me.

They have a nice outside patio too for some perfect Fall time weather which we have right now.

This Starbucks wasn't bad at all. Though we've been trying to get in the habit of patronizing local eateries and nothing else, every so often, for convenience's sake, we have to pop in to the occasional chain. What made this experience memorable was the polite, genuinely happy, adorable barista that served us. She exuded positivity and ensured that our order was correct. And we don't often order food from Starbucks, but on this particular visit, we ordered the egg and chorizo patty sandwich... WHAT?! They had me at chorizo patty. It was piping hot and SOOOO yummy! I'm not sure that it was enough to pry us out of the hands of our local coffeehouses and eateries, but it was definitely something to scratch our itch at the moment. Great job :)

I can count the number of positive experiences I've had here on one hand. First thing I learned is not to go in the morning, you're almost guaranteed to get the wrong order. I thought going after work, when it's less busy would be better but it hasn't been. I've been charged for the size I ordered and given a smaller size. I'm a member of the rewards program and I've tried to use rewards here several times - as instructed I tell the barista I have a reward and would like to use it and they haven't. If this wasn't the closest one to me I would not return but unfortunately it is and I have a slight Starbucks addiction. Avoid this one if you can.

Looks renovated
Quick service
I wish I took a picture of my frappachino before I devoured it because it literally looked picture perfect. Not only that, but it was perfectly made. 
Nice job Starbucks. Its rare to find a good one that actually cares about the quality of drinks being served.

Friendly staff.  Restroom needed attention. When I told them they immediately took care of it. 
Everything else looks good.  I am not a coffee drinker so I cannot say how it is. My husband however said it is very good

This Starbucks is always hopping! Love stopping here for a drink or treat while walking around the outlet mall. Don't come here expecting to grab a quick drink and get out...there is always a long line. However, even with the long line I always seem to get my beverage in a timely manner. They have lots of seating outside and also so inside. I do think they need to rethink the layout of the store because when people are waiting for their drinks they are blocking the entrance. All in all good service and great drinks.

I'm not a frequent Starbucks customer, but I do enjoy their coffee and treats on special occasions.   I had an extremely positive experience just yesterday at the Starbucks drive thru in Zionsville.   The coffee was great (I ordered a frappuccino) and the barista was warm without being too over the top with it.   And patient as I navigated the menu.   I don't really like to feel rushed when I'm ordering and like to at least appear that I know what I'm doing.   
All in all, an excellent experience.   Others in this world are hopefully taking notes as to what Starbucks is doing right.

Poorly run Starbucks.  Ill-prepared to serve and have waited more than 10 minutes for a tea that they did not have brewed. Regret stopping in this Starbucks, as I could've driven 10 additional minutes and been finished by now. They need a new manager.

Arnold, MO has a new Starbucks! Yay! The service here is wonderful and they are fast!  This location is similar to the Fenton, MO location but the decor is upgraded and more spacious.

They also have a drive-thru.

Horrible service. I waited a good 3 minutes to have my order taken while the 'Mary Jane' talked on the phone. Of the other 4 employees all of around aimlessly nobody could help me and I wasn't even acknowledged by any. Mary Jane, the woman who was on the phone, was using her service gloves to talk on the phone and use the computer/ take cash. 
Not only did she touch food with these same gloves she couldn't understand why I would ask her to change her gloves to get me a new bagel. She argued that she had used something else to touch the bagel. If you think it's acceptable to talk on the phone and touch cash why would I trust your judgement on anything at this point. Disgusting.

I get my coffee here every morning.  They have been consistent with their service and quality of the drinks I have ordered.  Starbucks has figured out their drink, the taste is the best out of all the coffee places in town.

This Starbucks is amazing - fast service, friendly people, and they never get my order wrong.  I feel comfortable popping in on a Sunday afternoon or swinging by on my way to work.  Either way, this place is a major staple.

It would be great to have the hours posted!  I am frequently traveling through this area in the evening.  The Starbuck's is conveniently located just off the highway.  They used to be open until 11:00 pm, but the last few times I have tried to stop by at night, they have either been closed or in the process of closing.  It's a nice little shop and a great location. Please post your hours, so that travelers can determine whether or not to exit here!

Tends to get crowder but I need my daily fix. I like this location because of the. CLose proximity to the turnpike and route 1. Also has outdoor seating and better parking than the starbucks that's closer to my office.

I've lived and used this Starbucks since they opened (I live right behind in Tuscano). For the first few years, this place was the BEST. Fast, always correct orders, and the staff was awesome. Today - it's different. ALWAYS a line - even at the slowest times. Staff is not friendly, even seems to go out of their way to ignore and avoid customers, and the drinks usually tastes subpar. 

I don't know what happened. I used to be a daily customer, but not I stop in every few months (always a bad experience too). Sad. Wish they could get it back to how it used to be. :(

So glad this is my local Starbucks! The staff are always friendly, and the drinks are consistently good. The interior is a bit small for how much business it attracts on any given day, but it's a cozy spot, and it's also nice to sit & chat at the tables outside when the weather is nice.

Stayed the night here at Grand Sierra Sunday night.  Woke up early and needed a Starbucks pick me up and a little food.  I get a regular grande medium roast coffee and a sausage breakfast sandwich.  Girl rings me up and says $9.87 or something very close to ten dollars.  I said how much? I only ordered one sandwich.  She says, "the sandwich is $7.00" .  I thought was I was hearing things.  I asked her to repeat it and then  She says, " its casino pricing."  I cancelled that purchase in a hot second.  I understand paying more at locations like this but at a regular corporate owned SB a sausage breakfast sandwich runs about $3 so that is more than double! are you kidding me???  Heck even at the airport it is a little less than $5 and the movie theaters that have SB in them don't charge that much either.   I can go down the street and get a whole breakfast for that much or less in which I did. So suffice to say that my 1 star is based on the price gouging.  I couldn't believe the line or the nutty people who would pay that.  The lady ahead of me paid $37 for 3 coffees and 3 sandwiches.  I will probably remember this experience for the rest of my life.  Unbelievable.

This Starbucks serves a purpose larger than keeping me well caffeinated... And providing me exercise opportunities (it's within walking distance).

But I will discuss that after talking about the reasons people read reviews.

It's a Starbucks. If you don't like Starbucks you won't like this one. I am not going to ding stars for what is and will always be a personal preference (for taste reasons or otherwise). 

This Starbucks has a drive through. It is also a bit larger yet smaller feeling. By that I mean the baristas have a lot more ground to cover, I do NOT mean there is plenty of room for your massive stroller. Sorry but there just isn't. The pathway from ordering to seating corral (there is seating along the way) is just not that accommodating due to displays and that aforementioned seating along the way

The associates here will remember your name. I find that fifty fifty with Starbucks' employees. They also won't complain if you say the size before iced (one of the baristas at a St Louis Starbucks told me I was wasting her time by ordering in the incorrect order - yikes).

However, they are a bit slower. You can be standing at the register for awhile... There tends to be longer lines. They never have spoons ready (they then have to dig through boxes). But I will accept that and be cool with that as the people are pleasant... And I have learned that rarer amongst drive thru Starbucks places.

I have never used the drive thru, so can't comment on that.

Just the people and the service.

Oh and that thing Starbucks brings to an area that isn't caffeination? It brings some weird sense that an area is "okay." I don't prescribe to that, but rising home values after it being built show people do.

I think people say to themselves "it must be a nice(ish) area is Starbucks would build there" 

The sociologist in me says that's gentrification in its finest.

Great location. Service is always prompt and friendly.  Kyle is the best employee I ever met in any Starbucks.  He really knows every customer and knows how to connect with every single one.  All Starbucks needs a Kyle.

The outdoor seating at this location is what does it for me. The inside is often crowded and with a line has been my experience but once I get my drink and I can sit outside it's very nice and if I play my cards right I can get a spot with shade. Bonus! Standard starbucks other than the seating as far as I'm concerned.

Starbuck's definitely generates more crowd in G-Hall especially in the morning when students are half awake. Friendly baristas. Sometimes they get the orders wrong but everyone makes mistakes. 
Most students order drinks to go. Getting rid of that unnecessarily large dark wood rectangular table could really alleviate the traffic. Not many people would sit there anyways

A good pick me up morning and night within GSR. However, they don't make the best iced coffees the way I like it, and prices seemed to vary even though I would get the same thing. They do take the Starbucks app, but they have to do it manually.

Finally, a Starbucks in Arnold!  It's about time!  After having a semi-bad start of the week, I came here to get their delish pumpkin scones & their petite vanilla bean scones.  I'm not a coffee drinker, but I sure like my tea.  Their sweetened iced black tea hits the spot.  I have got to try the refreshers.  Like the previous review stated, the ambience is quite nice.  If you get more than 2 or 3 petite vanilla bean scones, you get a discount (I forget the percentage).  I'll definitely be back to study & work on my laptop here.

The line is always long.  On a recent visit I stood in line for about 15 min and when I got to the front, I asked for a breakfast tea and was told that they were out of that tea and they had an earl grey, I can't believe that starbucks only has one box of tea, I know that a lot of people drink coffee however there are a lot of people that do enjoy tea.  Staff not very friendly.

I have been to this location a few times..all I can say is when it is crowded u risk the chance of being cheated.. I ordered a Frapp.. large.. my mistake, I drove off should have gone back..was pressed for time.. ended up with nothing but chocolate syrup and ice!! .almost 6 dollars wasted!!! because they want to rush your drink!!

The drinks are always made correctly, even when substitutions are made. the staff is generally friendly, with the exception of a few discontent  personalities. I'm in here quite frequently, and have to say that the biggest downfall for this place is that the staff doesn't really seem to care that the line is out the door. The wait is generally obnoxious  and sometimes not even an option for me. I've been into MANY Starbucks over the years that are just as busy, if not much busier, and have not experienced such a wait...EVER. I don't know if perhaps the baristas get overwhelmed, or of the store is significantly understaffed, but this wait time is unreasonable. Many days I've taken the longer walk to the other end of the mall to get Dunkin Donuts, because the 15 min round trip walk is still faster than waiting for sometimes 30 mins or more.

This Starbucks is in the same strip mall that houses SuperFresh and Kohl's. If I'm here, it's usually in the morning when I'm on my way somewhere else. They are usually very fast, accurate, and friendly, although some of the staff definitely have that overly-hyped, sugar-high optimism that Starbucks has somewhat of a reputation for. 
They keep the food in stock; I've never had them be out of something that I wanted. The seating area is medium to large; I can usually find an armchair or a window stool if I want to hang around for a bit. 

No problems at all with this Starbucks location; they're doing it right.

If you like the clover brewed coffee,  this location has a clover machine.   Ask the barista for a coffee that is not already brewed and the barista will use the clover machine to brew it.  I ask for a decaf pike; the barista brews the coffee using the clover and I do not pay extra for getting a clover brewed coffee.  

The location was recently remodeled with new wall murals and furniture.  There are convenient electrical ports right below the seating.  

I like this location for their service, informed baristas and cleanliness.  Thank you Starbucks!

Very rude service. Dani our cashier was quite deaf and probably should think about getting some kind of personality. Not to mention, the barista I was kindly informing that their vanilla shaker was empty snapped at me for telling her so. Makes sense that she is better off not wearing a name tag.

Every time I visit this Starbucks, I'm disappointed.  Today, it was so loud I couldn't read the newspaper.  Staff was vacuuming the food case - so they turned up the music to hear it - then had to speak to one another so loud that it was impossible to think.  This store needs new management.  I generally avoid it, but it was  the location I needed today.

The cashier was so nice! We wanted a hot chocolate and the girl literally mentioned every single line they have and could do! It was nice and sincere, something you don't always get when ordering such a simple drink.

This store is too narrow and is poorly laid out, without any consideration given to what customers experience.

Specifically, when I visited during Winter, it got extremely cold in the front of the store because whenever anyone opened the door, gusts of cold air rushed in over the seated customers. The management made no attempt whatsoever to shield patrons from the cold wind.

Only the customers in the back were shielded from the cold, but back there you have to listen to the inane barista chatter.

I once witnessed an ugly scene at this store. One of the female employees sitting out front noticeably began crying. I was inside and I overheard a male employee backstabbing her, assaulting her character.
My favorite drink (white mocha) is always done right at this starbucks. Staff here is super friendly.
I enjoy going to this Starbucks!  My order is always received in a timely manner.  The staff is always friendly.  My faves are Doug, Ian, Nathan, Rachel, and Isaiah!

Great staff, nice facility, but the parking lot is small, and it fills up quickly. Add drive-thru traffic on top of that, and it can be difficult to navigate, especially before the first cup of coffee in the morning.

This morning I went into Starbucks excited because I have an interview and what better way to start my day than with Starbucks ...I was terribly mistaken.I ordered a vanilla iced chai latte with almond milk the milk was extra moldy so I nicely went over and said miss I think your almond milk is bad ...she says have you ever had it with almond milk before and it says it doesn't expire until 2017. In my head I'm thinking miss why does the expiration date matter when you can clearly see lumpy milk in my drink. She then proceeds to have this girl with crochet braids in her hair(her braids have nothing to do with this but if a manager happens to see this then you know who I have been dealing with all morning) make me a new drink and pretty much she just gave me a cup of milk.  I really could scream because this is not the way I wanted to start my day especially with an interview this morning...I almost never right a review but I had to get this off my chest especially when I spent $14 in there this morning.  Btw the girl I spoke of earlier also rolled her eyes at another customer...service was just terrible from this location this morning

Great place to stop by while going in or out of Whole Foods, which is just a few doors down!  They had Dark Roast still brewing when I showed up at 4pm today, which is great, since I abhor the Pike Place.  Of course they're always willing to do a pour-over of any coffee you want, but it's always nice to have good coffee already made for you :).
Terribly rude. To me and the customer behind me. Traveling through, thank goodness this isn't my normal go to Starbucks. Meh.

Although pleasant service, I've had too many mediocre experiences and drinks made here which is why my review is just OK. My most recent experience on a Tuesday during the mid-morning coffee break was another reason why this place is just ok. The line up was long to begin with, with plenty of people also waiting for their drink orders at the other end. By the time I got to the front, I ordered a Soy Chai Latte, Extra Hot, No Water, No Foam. The lady at the till who took my order wrote her lingo on the cup sleeve like normal and asked my name. I also ordered the egg & cheese breakfast sandwich. I waited patiently for my drink for approximately 5 minutes. Before my drink was up, one of the girls taking care of the food section informed me that they were out of the egg & cheese sandwich. I was uninterested in having it replaced with something else, so they offered up a refund. I was a bit alarmed as I didn't want to, nor did I have time to wait in the long line up again just to get a refund. However, they said they would scootch me in right away to take care of it. Fine. While I was going through my refund process, the barista lady was calling my name. So when I finished the refund, I went back to find that the drink she made was wrong because the lady who took my order scribbled the notes on the sleeve illegibly and therefore confused the barista girl. By this time, I was in a big rush as I had to drive to a meeting in another part of downtown. So I had to wait yet again, while my drink was made. And although I reiterated what my order was, I realized it was still not correct by the time I had my first taste 15 min later. *sigh* Anyways, it's those little details that can make or break your experience. For me, it was a deal breaker.

I was originally going to keep this short & sweet.  You know, an Espresso with 2 lumps of sugar and 2 stars.  Then I got to thinking about Starbucks. 

They were the originators of the chain specialty coffee shops.  They have grown by leaps and bounds and managed to make money. 

They are a Fortune 100 Company that has stayed independent, with out being franchised.  New opportunities are available for having a Starbucks, inside a Business, Hotel or Hospital. 

I think Starbucks is grossly overpriced.  Why do I say that?  If I order an Espresso in a fine dining restaurant, I pay that and more.  I am unusual in the fact that I LOVE coffee,  good Strong Colombian coffee, period.  I make that at home, so I do not see the sense in buying it out.  I also have an espresso machine.  I am not into Lattes or Cappuccino's.  They have a new line of Hot Chocolates, that are sure to be a hit.

I have had the opportunity to try many of their Sandwiches, which come into the Starbucks, already made.  The ones I have had are very good.  I also love their breads.  The multi grain berry bread with Egg Salad is exceptional. Their Muffins are wonderful.

But, they're still overpriced!

.

I don't know what it is about this particular Starbucks, but they never fail to mess something up. I keep going back because the location is convenient, but I regret it every time.  Half the time when I go in the place is empty, and it still takes them 10 minutes to serve me. The rest of the time my drink is made wrong.  The people are friendly but it doesn't make up for the lack of competency. :(

There's nothing like quiet time at Starbucks. Good coffee, great music (at this location at least), and decent artwork. The baristas worked quickly and were friendly. I like that there is a good selection of seating, from couches to individual booth seating. FREE WI-FI is always a plus as well. My coffee was made correctly and tasted pretty good. I didn't even use sugar like I usually do.
Slowest service of any Starbucks I have ever been in... Both times I came here it was excruciating .  Pleasant staff, but no apparent adult supervision.

Stopped by for a reading.  Noticed the music was a bit loud during the drink order.  When I sat down on one of the tables, OMG...they play music so loud.  They are the loudest starbucks ever.  It like they do it on purpose so the customers don't stay in the shop.

It's very hit or miss at this location, both with timeliness in being served as well as the employees making your morning beverage. For the most part, the better crew does tend to be there at least 3 out of 4 visits, so that's a plus.

I will second what Christopher said about the line though; it is super confusing for people not familiar with the area and I constantly see people asking "Is this the line? Or do I go back here?" What's the point in having a side door that opens half-way through the line that someone has to walk all the way back to the regular door to enter line. Why not just keep that door locked and cause less headaches? I've seen many a newcomer come in that way and look as dazed as a baby bird while they catch their barings and realize the actual line zips way back to the other door or catch them standing in the drink line when they have yet to place an order.

Signs or no, I've seen many people have issues with this; just saying, unless headache is one of many things you plan to pick up from starbucks during your morning routine, just enter through the regular door (across from Blue Mercury!)
It's Starbucks, what's not to love? Peppermint hot chocolate all year long! Free drinks because you come too often. Pumpkin bread for the little man. Ah the life!

Manayunk is such a cute little town, and every cute little town needs a Starbucks.  I ordered the new Hazelnut Macchiato, it was quite delicious.  The staff was friendly and the order came out fast and accurate.  I'm a fan!

Of all the Starbucks in the St. Pete area this is the best...! Great staff....good patrons & a lot mof fun..!  Parking is available across the street at the shopping cneter when the tiny lot fills up!

I've been patronizing this Starbucks every now and then ever since they opened.  Working on the "northwest" end of the CBD near the main post office, I am only a block from the Hyatt, and often find myself cutting through the buildings on my way to Poydras Street.

Every time I do, I often stop at this full service Starbucks located inside the Hyatt.  As far as food and coffee goes, this place isn't any different from any stand-alone locations.  However, it has a fairly large seating area and free wi-fi.  Couple that with an endless stream of tourists in the Hyatt, this place is the perfect spot to sit & people watch. (If you're into that sort of thing). 

Since I usually cruise through here on my limited lunch break, I never take advantage of the seating or wifi.  However, if I had the time or if I was a guest at the Hyatt, I know I'd be down here with my I-pad, just surfing, chatting and taking in the sights.  ANd drinking a refreshing beverage of course.
Starbucks at the JW Marriot.  Friendly and very talkative staff.  No line earlier in the morning, but by 7:30 you may have a line - especially if they are hosting a conference.

Its a hip location with plenty of singles who meet and set up dates. Oh God, I used hip in a review, I hate myself for doing it. 

There is always a great conversation and lots of chances to sit outside and watch SoHo go by the cafe. 

There are couple of down sides to this one specifically:

When you get here, if you plan to work, bring a power strip. There are never enough outlets and this place is busy. 

Its a better location to work where you can tolerate noise, because there is always, "That guy" who talks too loud about something not worth talking about, or a "so cute" kid who like to run around your chair while his mother looks on while he disturbs you. 

Nice outdoor area, but mind your stuff there are a few homeless folks who sometimes scope out unattended items.

Slow af. You will wait at least 15 minutes for no reason. It's too early for this type of frustration. Tf and they are fully staffed. One on register, one at window, 2 making drinks and one just walking around like he's trying to find his way.  Fucking ridiculous. First and last time here.
I don't recommend going to this store on weekends. been to this location on Sat & Sun

Thanks for being open at 515. Good to know as we were headed to the Airport. When asked about the protein packs they were eagerly making them in the back. Quick to help out. Clean place & good seating options available.
They offer food here that they don't have in California so I always enjoy coming here for the treats. The line always looks so intimidating but the staff knows how to keep the line moving.

Not a big Starbucks regular, but the folks working at this location are doing things well under the circumstances of their tiny, crowded kiosk [update: it's been enlarged and is now much nicer]. They make an (almost) consistently at-temp kid's drink (which is usually the only thing I get here when I'm with someone who drinks these). Unlike a stand-alone shop where Starbucks-addicts congregate, this stand in the mall gets a lot of riff-raff and I've seen the employees exercise great patience with some rude customers.

Other than a killer wait at peak times, this is my favorite location on Drexel's campus. My orders always come out perfect. The baristas are always super friendly and attentive at the register and when you pick up drinks. I haven't had a bad experience there even when the line is out the door. Somehow they are always patient and smiling. 

Not a ton of space with the place usually packed with students but term breaks are never an issue--you can grab a seat if you like or have a quick 10-minute turn-around on your coffee. 

My go-to drink: Chai Latte with an extra shot of espresso

Absolutely hate Starbucks policy of not serving brewed de-cafe after 12 noon.  Makes no sense to me... Coffee is their product, I am the customer and customer is always right. 

Otherwise, great products, good service

The fact alone that I'm taking time to review this Starbucks speaks volumes. As any seasoned Starbucks patron can attest to, each Starbucks has its own culture, if you will, and climate. this lively, upbeat location is staffed with awesome individuals who really go the extra distance to make your drinks and experience pleasant. This is not the standard at every Starbucks I have been to and I appreciate the climate of this one being so positive.

Although normally bustling, the staff never falls short of providing  exceptional service with warm affect. The store itself is well lit, with industrial styled high ceilings and plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. Despite being busy, there is usually a chair or table available for those individuals that like to work or study in a public atmosphere. The music selection is always great, and kept at a reasonable level. There is a broad variety of individuals who patronize this location so people watching here is stellar, if that's your thing. I enjoy sitting outside for some fresh air and sunshine and there are even outlets outside for your electronic devises. I also occasionally bring my pup, as they are dog friendly. The store itself is usually kept rather cool (great AC) so bring a sweater/sweatshirt/jacket if you get chilled easily and expect to spend some time here. The ample parking lot is in the back and at the side of the store and there are handicapped spots available near the front door. On the times I've used them I found the bathrooms are always clean and stocked.

On my particular visit today I was greeted with a smile and other pleasantries.  I decided to try the cold brew coffee and I was not disappointed. On the website it claims that the coffee is brewed over 20 hours, resulting in a smooth taste. I definitely recommend. The staff is efficient and makes their orders rather quickly so if you need to grab a drink in a hurry this should be your "go to" spot. 


Thank you, Soho Starbucks, for consistently exceeding my expectations. Kudos to you.

Ordered 4 coffees size grande. Received 2 size tall in grande cups and 2 grande that were actually grande. Very disappointed. Was taking to my fellow nurses working 12 hour shifts at a pediatric hospital. Will never go to Starbucks again. $17 for 4 coffees that weren't even full when I could have went to wawa and paid $4 for 4 full coffees.

This is "My Starbucks".  Consistently good cappuccinos.  I ask the barista to make them "dry", and they are excellent.  I also get my coffee here and have it ground for my espresso machine.  The staff manages to keep up with the customers. Easy and fast to get a drink and be on my way. The store is very small, has tables outside.  A well kept secret.  There's parking both in front and in the back.  Clean restrooms.

I go to this Starbucks fairly frequently, and the drinks are fine but I can't stand that if you just walk in and up to the counter sometimes it takes a couple minutes until you are greeted, let alone have your order taken even though there are a ton of people behind the counter.

One of my favorite coffee stops along the interstate, just north of the 865 split on I-65. It's attached to a gas station, of all things. I've never seen a Starbucks in a gas station, but there it is. The outdoor patio is right next to the drive-thru speaker, so you get to hear everyone's order and breathe exhaust fumes while sipping your latte. Not a smart place to put the patio. The inside is smallish, even for a Starbucks. so it really is designed for a quick drive-thru then back on the interstate.

I like that the baristas know their coffee culture and can answer any questions.  Whoever set up this drive-thru, however, is an idiot.  If you come from the cross street rather than entering off Brentwood, prepare for some tight finagling (and the blaring horns of irritated, coffee-deprived customers) to get to the lane.
And you're going to sneak in a sixty cent surcharge for adding soy milk (no upcharge for dairy) to my coffee?  St. Louis Bread Company is a block away with better coffee & no extra fees for those of us avoiding lactose.  I won't go out of my way for this one.

The Starbucks coffees and lattes are the same as coffees and lattes and coffees as same the are lattes and coffees Starbucks The.  This wonderful palindrome is not the reason I'm giving this Starbucks a 5-star rating.  This jawn is getting its 5 stars due to its friendly staff.  I don't really like talking to people, but the morning staff is so good at remembering orders (You want an Americano with a churclate durnut? Uhhh, yeah wow thanks) that I can't help saying Hi How are you? or Thanks!  All the workers seem genuinely enthused even when dealing with crowded rush hours and lousy soft misters.  This quality service makes me feel better about spending the ridiculous Starbucks price.  I feel good about the purchase until I get to work and log into my bank account.  But that's a whole different issue.
Very slow service here! The line to place your order is often very long. But the staff is often nice and very understaffed.

Customer service sucks !
Let me begin to say that if I want just regular coffee I would have gone to wawa. Nothing irritates me than someone who is so rude when people like me gives you business! I'm not the one to blame people and put them out of work. But damn if you're life depends on what you do maybe  it's a wake up call and this establishment better make it clear to people they hire what customer service is all about! I bought a latte macchiato from this woman who while she was asking me what I want has her back turned against me! You call that customer service? Order # 87682 inside target Springfield mall doesn't even deserve a star!

April 2017 update: Very poor service. I opted to go in the store...I usually use their app for mobile ordering. But when I went in, I was shocked that my below review needs no real update. It all still applies. I was asked no less than 3 times "what did you order again?" after placing my order, paying and waiting around. One person apologized because someone had spilled some beans. But a period of time after that, I was asked what I wanted. And finally got what I ordered. Wow! Awful!
=====
Nice people. But just had some bad experiences there. When I try and use the Starbucks app... it frequently says that they're out of items. It hasn't just been today. But pretty much every time I use the Starbucks app. Hopefully they will get more items in stock. Again, nice people. Nice location.
Easy access to good coffee right here in JW marriot!  Three cheers for Juan who was so nice and treated me like a queen!
Early afternoon and a long slow line, one cashier and barista. Got an iced drink that wasn't even full. Wish I had made the few block walk to the Starbucks in the Marriott.
One of the better Starbucks! My vanilla latte is always perfect and served with a smile.

I was going to preface this review with a defense of Starbucks, but changed my mind and decided to not get into the politics and simply stick to reviewing.  (Though I will say - politics does influence where I will spend my money.)

In some ways, a Starbucks is a Starbucks.  At least if you are at a Company Store and not a Licensed Location (of which there are thankfully few.) However, in the world of "the same" this location stands out as wonderful.  The Baristas are uniquely friendly.  They also do seem to try harder to be helpful than at other locations.  I have on a few occasions needed to speak to a manager, not for problems, but to get information, and the woman who seems to be the store manager is knowledgeable and responsive.  She also seems to have a good rapport with the staff, which may account for the quality of service.

The store, and specifically the restroom, is always clean, and when I have found it lacking in a paper product, they are quick to fix the problem.

Although the lines can be long, service doesn't dawdle.  On the other hand, when it isn't busy, staff is happy to chat about coffee, or movies, if you are interested and don't interfere with their work getting done.

There are plenty of tables, and four areas which have power outlets, which is more than most locations, so it is truly possible to be there and get work done.  It does get crowded at times, especially during exam weeks at Drexel and Penn, but I have only once, out of many visits had to leave because I couldn't find a seat.

This is not the ONLY Starbucks in Philly that I like, but it is my favorite! 

On a Company-wide note - they now use NO High Fructose Corn Syrup in ANYTHING.  Desserts are back on my menu!

What can I say - Starbucks is pretty consistent, and this is no different. It has a drive-thru, and I have never gone inside. I hate the coffee, but love the tea. Give me a black ice tea, sweetened, and I'm happy. Add a warm butter croissant and I'm even happier.

Not really a Starbucks fan, but stopped in here yesterday cause I accidentally missed the turn for Dunkin Donuts and my girls suggested we stop in here. The prices weren't as high as I remember, but I definitely prefer Dunkin Donuts iced tea over Starbucks.  Four stars though because the service was good and the place was hopping.  Just not my personal choice for coffee or iced tea.
We had a guy named Bobby help us out. Horrible attitude. Very rude and actually snatched the money from my hand. Very unprofessional as much as I love Starbucks I won't be returning to this one.
Nice small coffee shop. Kinda hidden. Some parking available free of charge. Drive up window available

Ordered two Ventis with pumps and one with almond milk and received two cups of black coffee after waiting for them. I understand forgetting but when you charge me extra for my order preference and that blatantly ignore my order as you make it is quite frustrating. Six dollars of coffee that wasn't even made correctly.

The staff here doesn't understand the concept using one's "indoor voice."  They could have their LOUD conversations a block apart from each other.  If this location wasn't so small, the noise would not be so painful.

I've been going to this Starbucks more often since the Second Cup across the street closed, and I've always found the staff here particularly friendly and helpful. I've even got a free latte when they were out of my first choice, and I went with what the barista recommended instead. Definitely makes you want to come back :)

My main complaint about this location is that there isn't a lot of seating, and the last few times I've gone by with the intention of getting a coffee and reading, there haven't been any free seats.
This by far my favorite Starbucks. The staff always greets everyone who walks in. My drink is always perfect.

First time ever asked to sing my order in the drive through... Crazy fun. Always a pleasant experience each time with the staff. 
Sure know how to keep the customers returning not just for the great beverages and food.

While my drink came out great, it took absolutely forever to get said drink. This was surprising given the number of baristas working, until I realized that most of them were cleaning instead of tending to the long line of drinks to be made.

Girl in the drive thru was super sweet! Everyone at this location is always friendly.

I was excited to try the coconut cold brew but was sadly disappointed! It looked like only 1/4 of it was coffee, and the rest water, syrup and coconut milk!

I like my cold brew the exact opposite, 3/4 brew and the rest the sweet goodness. I am going to see if they can custom make it for me next time!

Having spent my life in the PNW, and last 20 years in Seattle - moving to Philly area and trying to enjoy Starbucks does not work. This Starbucks has horrible service. So slow and staff not aware of customers (only each other and their conversation) and not able to do more then one thing at a time. Have been to enough Starbucks in my life to know how quickly and smoothly it should work. Just one person in front of me - six staff - why it takes 7 minutes is beyond me (I timed it, after spending what seemed an eternity in line to even place my order). And why they are stocking napkins and straws - and not checking the creamers (of course empty - there's another minute). Sad thing, this is par for the course here in Philly. Haven't found any that provide the level of service I've become accustomed to in Seattle. None. Bad training here? Or just bad people that don't care? And that's sadly why I end up at Dunkin Donuts or Panera most of the time even though I am a self professed Starbucks addict.

Every time I have been in this Starbucks there's no more than a few people in front of me and at least one table free.  I'm sure it's a busy location but I've been fortunate it hasn't been crazy busy.  There can be a few others by the milk area but it clears up quickly.  I usually get the Refresh tea for $2 and like the mint taste.  The staff are friendly and efficient.

The last time I came, most people were seating on the patio so there was available indoor seating.  The locations makes this one of my favourite Starbucks.  It's close to fun shops to check out and great to stop in for a mid shopping drink.  There are benches outside if it's too busy inside.  Parking lot can get busy but there's residential streets that you can likely find a spot and enjoy a little walk.
Drive thru usually pretty congested & slow but staff is ALWAYS friendly:). Buy one get one free salted caramel mochas today!

Apparently if you want your coffee hot and not just warm, you must ask for extra hot coffee! This is ridiculous! I was on the highway and seen the Starbucks sign and thought at least my $7.00 coffee will be good, because this is a chain. Wow was I disappointed!! Shift manager John Crawford told me to come back and he'll remake it, and I said I'm not from here and I'm on the highway going the other way, and his brilliant solution, now pay attention, he says next time you're driving by stop in!!!!! What part of I live over 100 miles away, and don't ever plan on coming back! I suggested he mail me a gift card for what I spent, and he says I can't do that, but I'll be happy to remake it! I'm like is he reading a script!!! Horrible horrible service and the management is just as bad! Stay far, far away from this Starbucks!!!!!!!!!!
Love Starbucks.. but I waited nearly 7 minutes for a tall blonde roast. Store seems understaffed.

This is by far the worst Starbucks that I have ever been to. I tried for the fifth time today to order at this location because I was being optimistic and thought maybe the first four times were duds. Every coffee that I have ordered either tastes like milk or water with a splash of coffee. My order came out with a hair in it, and the employees made a new coffee and sincerely apologized. I was very satisfied with the customer service, but once again the drink was not the drink I ordered.
They now have a secret code to use the restrooms which are locked. You must punch in on a keyboard. Extremely annoying. Take your coffee needs elsewhere.
Love their Coffee! Like their Service! Prices are High...and Need to stay out of Politics. Like the fact that they will fix a drink if not right.

Since I began stopping at this Starbucks in October, the service and drink quality and consistency have improved immensely. I wanted to make sure that I gave credit where it was due and upgrade my rating to 5 stars. The most important element of my 5 star rating is excellent drink quality (taste is consistent; not too weak; made to specifications) and that's the biggest improvement that I've seen here. I can't tell you the last time I received a drink here that I was unhappy with. I wish I could tip to show my gratitude. Keep up the good work!
Have been going here for a decade but staff keeps changing and not for the better. No longer a friendly place  have moved on to other coffee shops
Though it is a humble mall cart, this is also a proper corporate-owned Starbucks location, which means you can cash in your free drinks from star rewards and etc.
The interior is clean and cozy. Seemed inconsistent at getting orders out quickly. Had to check on my order.

Is it too much to ask that the cashier have some sort of personality and acknowledge the customer in front of her?  No acknowledgement, no hello, no attempted add ons and no thank you!  Everyone else working was very nice but first impression is everything and this one sucked.

Disorganized, the slowest service I've ever seen a Starbucks have, and they run out of supplies EVERY time I have ever been there (even ICE). I tried so many times but I won't be going back to this one.

I ordered a Caramel Brulee and they had it spot on. Delicous on a cool Friday night. Quick service as well. All the tables and chairs were occupied with people staying warm and enjoying Wi-Fi on a late Friday night. If I need a coffee (or Caramel Brulee) fix, I would come to this location again.
Very nice and modern, quick service. Great place to go to study, parking was a little tight though, other than that, great service and atmosphere.

The baristas are super nice and make all the drinks as they should be! It also has a full Starbucks menu, which is super nice because I feel that many smaller Starbucks in the area do not. Beware of the early afternoon though because it is super packed!

I ordered a caramel Frap with add shot and when I took my first sip, had no flavor at all! Taste like blended iced water! So I told the lady there was no flavor at all so she remade it, did not apologize and then when I received my remake she did not add the shot so when I brought that up to her she gave a face and got so irritated and the other lady ended up just remaking. I dealt with that third remake but was still not satisfied! They did no take their time to make the drinks or they need more training cause this one had a little bit of flavor. Worst Starbucks I've ever been too! You would think it would be better quality considering it's located in a hotel / casino. Staff was not happy or friendly, horrible customer service.

I do not know what kind of voodoo these people do. But every time no matter how tall and complicated the order, it's perfect and EXTREMELY FAST. They put coffees out, quicker than a hooker at a truck stop. AMAZING.

When in the area I visit this location, there is almost always a line fir the drive thru but the cashier is always super warm & inviting. 

The only issue I have noticed with this location is that they seem to sell out if pastries especially cake pops by the afternoon.

After house hunting for about 3 hours in the hills of Manayunk, I was so parched! We stopped in here to rehydrate. No line and there was only one other customer.  There were tons of seats, as the store extends pretty far back. When we move to the area I can foresee myself doing work here.  I ordered a venti iced green tea with 1 pump of syrup. Tasted devine considering my deprivation of fluids. The baristas were friendly, but it was not busy so it wasn't a good assessment of how they do under pressure.  Also, it was great people watching.  A few punky kids rolled in for their caffeine fix and a hippy chick wear a see through shirt and a black bra with a head band wrapped like rambo. Very interesting. They all seemed to be regulars, as they knew the baristas.
I love these guys! Ask the coffee master (who I think might also be a manager) about saving money with coupons. He's super resourceful!

We stopped in for a quick recharge on our way back to Sacramento. We were rudely helped by the cashier but Rachel, the one running around and making the orders, was flustered but still maintained a smile and friendly tone with us. It's customer service like Rachel's that will definitely have me stop back by this location when I'm in the area again.

My order: tall Pike in a grande cup.
Friendly, fast service!

Recommendations to Starbucks:
Inform guests extra creamers are available behind the counter when paying for order.
Sample clover brewed coffee (shots) during rush hour!

The parking lot at this Starbucks is a nightmare. I am always worried someone is going to hit my car -- or worse , hit me as I'm walking from my car to the building! I'm not kidding when I say the parking lot is scary. It's just as bad if you want to use the drive through option.
You have to maneuver your car to go through the lane by entering from one side of the lot and if you don't, you have to do like a ten point turn to get back to the right place so you can turn your car into the drive through lane. It's nuts!!
This Starbucks is like ONE minute from my apartment which is beyond awesome but because the parking and drive through are such a disaster, it's easier for me to drive a few more miles to the rock hill location on Manchester!!
What a shame!
Also, the baristas here are probably the slowest from any coffee shop I've ever been to! They really take like ten minutes to make a simple tall latte. Lmao. It's almost comical.
Finally, they never have samples or specials.

If you want to study or read somewhere or just get a quick beverage go to the nearby rock
Hill Starbucks instead!
The staff is amazing! Always so polite , on point and just all around super friendly ! Coffee always taste great and food is fresh! Store is clean and comfortable! Thanks

Literally the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to hands down. I travel to this area for business and stop here since it's close to my building, otherwise I would drive to a different Starbucks. However I'm considering switching to Dunkin Donuts. The drive through line is ALWAYS like a parking lot. It's never a quick stop here.

This is by far the best Starbucks in town, I come here to study and it's pretty quiet. There's plenty of seating and is pretty large for a Starbucks which is really nice. They have the happiest, nicest employees i've ever met at a Starbucks. It's always very clean as well. I always love coming here and it's becoming a regular spot for me.

This is easily my favorite Starbucks in UC and possibly in Philly overall. Used to sit here all day during undergrad to meet up with friends and get hours of reading/studying done. This was always my secret spot during finals, and I even make it a point to visit whenever I'm back in Philly :)

What makes it different - it's clean and a good size (not too crowded) and the staff is friendly. I also love the location; good midpoint between Penn and Drexel and close to Wawa, Sangkee, and other food places if you're looking to take a break while studying. There's another Starbucks a block away on Walnut but it's usually more crowded (although the Walnut Starbucks is more convenient for grabbing drinks in between classes). What I like most about this Starbucks is that it has plenty of natural sunlight and gives off more of a small coffeehouse vibe compared to other [more generic] locations.

A couple of considerations - It gets cold during the winter due to all the windows and the lights are pretty dim in the evening.

It's definitely nice that there is a Starbucks in the mall available for shopping. For a mall it's a pretty nice location but the line can be long and slow which is sometimes not worth it if you're in limited time. My drinks are always decent but for the price they should be among the standards of other Starbucks. If you're not at the mall during a busy time when they are overwhelmed I would recommend stopping by this location.
