I lived in Bensalem for a year and came here multiple times a week. Never had any issues whether I used the drive-through or walked in. They have a smaller inside area but they have a decent outside seating area. Even though I've since moved, I still come here occasionally and have no complaints.
Starbucks products are great! This store doesn't have the friendly service like most. I will come here again if I need coffee and am in the area, but it's nothing special!

This is by far the WORST starbucks I have ever been to! Their customer service is horrendous. People are NOT at all organized and don't even know how to make a drink correctly. Why hire someone when they can't do their one job correctly? Highly disappointed!

I've never had a problem with this Starbucks location. They, like their other nearby location off of Bruce B Downs, always have very friendly baristas, who always make sure you have a great experience, and a correct and tasty drink/order. I pass by this location on the way to work in the morning, which makes it convenient to pickup a mobile order. They always have everything ready and waiting when I get there, all freshly made and/or heated up as well (as far as food goes). I would say the only downside is that this location does not have a drive-thru, but even when ordering inside, they are usually pretty quick, from taking your order to preparing and serving your order.

Terrible drive thru! Have gone by 2 times in the last week and they have tried to overcharge me, give me drinks that were not my order, and did not have my drink near started by the time I was to the window (plus I had been waiting for 15 minutes already in line)..
quick starbucks that has a good staff to move the line... the inside is a little tight but there is plenty of room outside on the patio

Terrible customer service. You ask for blond they give you medium roast thinking you won't notice. After complaining, they just gave me attitude rather than fixing the problem. Only after I contacted the head office after the 3 or 4th time they've done it, only then i was satisfied. Usually don't go to that location bc of that but sometimes I have nowhere else to go.
The lady who doesn't brush her hair was being so rude and did not smile , was not polite. Made a nasty face because of my ethnic name. Rude. Definitely will not return.

Busy time at the airport. This location really needs an express line for beverages only. Sandwich orders take a lo-o-ooong time holding up the line. People have flights to catch.  Workers could use an incentive to speed things along.
Had to have my daily Starbucks! It's not for luxury it's a necessity!! Love this store since it's so close to my house. Clean store, yummy drinks & a nice crews! Until next time,...probably tomorrow!
Best Starbucks ever! Baristas were so friendly nice and chatty. Made conversation with us while we ordered. Made amazing drinks and very fast service. Highly recommend.

Always busy due to their location in suburban square but this was my first ever Starbucks location many moons ago and holds a special place in my heart.
Staff are always friendly and drinks are fast.
I got a triple cap and a cup with a heart over the "i" in Kim that made my morning.
Small selection, even smaller space but a job well done on the drinks

Wanted to redeem my birthday drink reward, so the cashier started my order on a Venti cup, to later find out I couldn't redeem b/c it was a casino-Starbucks. I'm (sort of) fine with that, but for some reason it was VERY hard for her to transfer my drink to a Tall cup: (first time ordering the new...) cinnamon almond milk macchiato, extra hot, with 2 pumps of syrup.  I confirmed that she "accidentally (?)" wrote 2 pumps of "CD" but she said Cinnamon Dolce is the name for the syrup. When I found her holding my cup by the lip I should have said something, that can't be proper "food" handling.

I got my drink in a decent amount of time, but it was a cinnamon dolce latte. I had the (friendly) barista fix my drink, but it didn't come back extra hot, the way I order all my drinks at Star'.

After waiting about 8 min. in line, going through the bday set back, having her remake the drink, and paying $4, needless to say, I can't give any more than one star. I pay for a custom cup of coffee and it's got to be right for the price.

A Typical Starbucks store which I love! Walking distance to wholefoods makes me love it even more.
Will come back again

Was there late this morning, parking lot nearly full. Cozy interior with huge mural photos of Colombian coffee growers I assume. Three big plush stand-alone seats, plus padded seats and tables for the laptop folks. Drive-up window busy, yet I was immediately attended to and got my cup in about two minutes. Sat on one of the big seats for a long time, listening to mellow music unknown to me while sipping and admiring the wall photos. All the outdoor seating was full, perhaps they need more. Quite a pleasant place.

I'm not the type to write a bad review. Much less about Starbucks, I mean how hard can you screw up something so standard nowadays. Truthfully the food and drink that I ordered weren't bad. Iced grande mocha and an egg & cheese (oh wait! That's not what I wanted, they were all out of the ham and swiss. Ok, that's fine, I came in late, shortly after noon, but come on at least know that your out of stock for the day). Now my major issue, I had to wait 15 minutes in line behind wait for it...TWO people. The employees work with no sense of urgency whatsoever. They joke around and have side conversations while I'm mid order!  What the hell! I understand team dynamic should be good, but finish taking my order before starting to talk about your children. Listen this is Starbucks. I want my order in 5 minutes, especially when the store is empty. The service is unacceptable, yea the employees were nice, but you have to do your damn job in addition to being sweet. It might be cause it's a new store, but these folks need to step their game up.
Located inside the Safeway, it's your standard Starbucks, as it should be. You can grab a coffee while you shop or grab one one the go. Convenient for Westsiders.

I am a Starbucks junkie-I get a quad-7 shot latte daily. In South Tampa, this is my fav location. Barista's are awesome, know you by name and drink. They are friendly and make it so easy to come back for more. They know ALL of my drinks-my substitutions for my seasonal drinks, my usual all year round drink, and my lunch drink. No questions asked-they have it already going as I am walking in!
It as a good Starbucks shop. The only thing I don't like about the place is that it gets busy most of the time. I would recommend you to come before 3 pm or after 6pm so you can find seats available.

So straight off I'm going to say I'm not a big fan of Starbucks. I really only end up coming here with my wife when she is in need of a coffee fix. This is a pretty standard Starbucks. The one thing to note is that the location is a bit tricky to get in and out of. There isn't much parking, and Brentwood Boulevard can get quite congested. I would recommend only coming here in off hours. If you come during peak times you make get a bit frustrated by the traffic. Since it is a small shop, it is also better to take the drinks and go. I would not recommend planning to do any work or reading here. It works best as a to-go spot.
It is nice to have Starbuck's signature coffee in the hotel, but they are definitely  missing Starbuck's brand of food.  The food is not that great.

thank you, thank you, thank you.

I can always rely on this Starbucks to serve me well. The staff is wonderful--always smiling and helpful, despite the length of the line. They understand the importance of a properly-made drink, serve it with a smile, and are patient with you when ordering and your brain freezes (duh--havent had my coffee yet).  It is much better than the Starbucks one block over on Walnut (and less crowded with Penn students). 

fun fact: when I was a student at Drexel some years ago, rumor had it that Reese Witherspoon and Jake Gyllenhaal hung out here while she was filming a movie a few blocks away.
Very busy location in the Glen Eagle shopping center.   Great barista who knows how to make a cappuccino.
Worst cup of coffee ever. Tastes like it sat in the pot for 6 hours. If you're going to have coffee on brew, please make sure it's fresh. This is gross.

This is the first time I have visited this location. 

When we entered at 12 noon, there were 3 'barristas'' talking loudly together. 

They took our order and delivered it OK but when we went to the condiments table, all of the carafes were empty. We brought them to the counter where they refiled them and handed them back to us for us to replenish the table with instead of making the effort to bring them out themselves.

It was extremely noisy in the shop even though there were never more than 2 or 3 other customers besides ourselves there at one time.  but the noise level rose even further when one of the barristas decided to rearrange the chairs and instead of picking them up and moving them, she dragged each one of the five chairs across the floor to it's proper place. We remarked that dragging was really noisy and asked her to please pick the chairs up  and offered to do it for her but she continued to drag them.

Whereupon, we took our coffee and moved to an outdoor table which was dirty with the remains of previous customers. When we took our trash back in before leaving, the three of them were still engrossed in lively conversation with each other.

One thing I love to do when I have a little spare time is break out the MacBook, pop in the AirPods, catch up on a few things and relax with my grande pike with sugar free mocha. This is a real treat for me. Almost like a zen time allowing me to realign a bit. If you hadn't guessed, I am even writing this out whilst enjoying my signature cup of joe. 

I have to give kudos where it is due and this location definitely earns great marks. Shout out to Anthony. Always friendly and had my drink ready before I had the app open to scan my phone. Didn't have to say a word. When baristas are invested enough in their customers to remember a drink or name that shows there is certainly a level of care above what these guys are paid for. Also, says something about character. Other than that, the place is clean and always packed. Good service, consistency and a quality product are the ingredients I look for when spending my hard earned money. Thanks Starbucks and thank you Anthony!

It's a Starbucks. Looks like a Starbucks. Lines like a Starbucks. Coffee tasted like Starbucks. Neither better or worse than any other! Conveniently located near to the worst DMV I've ever been to. Cannot be more glad that I got coffee here before my 5 HOUR WAIT at the DMV. Going to the DMV for you TN license? Go to this Starbucks first. Trust me.

This location can be a little hard to find (2nd floor of the Hyatt Regency -- and it's a little bit of a maze up there) but they have fast service, good wifi, and lots of seating.

It gets busy when there are conventions at the hotel, but they keep up the pace and the line moves quickly. 

Tables/chairs can occasionally be a little messy (a few crumbs) but not bad at all.

One of the best Starbucks I've been to!

It's an airport so they're a franchise location.  I ordered a drink, they made it, and their was a markup on the cost over a normal location.  Given the lack of options around Concourse B, it's just fine.

This location is such a delight to visit. The store manager here really cares about his customers, his employees, and the brand. You'd think that being in the middle of the mall would cause this location to be crazy loud and congested, but they do a great job keeping lines short, and sharing smiles with customers. I've been here many times and will keep coming back to enjoy my standard coffee and breakfast sandwich.

I come here often to do work on my laptop and every single time I'm greeted by the most welcoming smiles. My order is always made perfect! I sit for some time to finish up some work and I never feel rushed to leave. Bathrooms are consistently clean and that is much appreciated! Absolutely love coming here and definitely recommend it to anyone searching for a place to grab coffee and hang out for a little while!

I am assuming this is the Starbucks on the lower lever of the Target at Springfield Mall?  If so - I had a perfectly acceptable experience here - ordered my usual Venti light ice green tea lemonade.

No issues.

Fourbucks aka Charbucks is pretty standardized.

I went on a weekday morning and it was not crowded - but I have seen it on weekends and it can get busy.
Always gets the order correct in the drive-thru lane but can be slow.  Coffee is served hot. Very close the the pa turnpike and route 1.

One of the bigger stand alone Starbucks I've been in.  Very clean, very neat, and of course, it smelled DELICIOUS. YAY coffee!

Service was good, quick and full of smiles and kindness. Only one small problem, they were out of toilet paper in the women's restroom. I mentioned it and it was taken care of after my vanilla latte was made.

It seems that the drive throughs at Starbucks lately have been taking much longer than usual. This location particularly is always slow in the afternoon when they are the slowest you would think that their service would be better. But I even just went in the morning and the line didn't move for quite a few minutes and I ended up leaving the line.

Wifi down for three days with no clue when it will be back up.  Left a bitter taste as i just stopped to relax, catch up on emails/work and enjoy..    didnt happen-3 three days down????  And after i got my latte they told me well there Is another Starbucks just a block up the road that has Wi-Fi you can go there

I'm a regular here and everyone is great.  They always remember my name and know my exact drink.  Love it.  The coffee isn't bad either. ;)  But then again, that's what you can expect at most starbucks.
I love this drive through Starbucks! I come here all the time. Sometimes I order ahead of time and others I just use my Starbucks app to pay. They always have what I want and it tastes amazing!

Not sure why so many bad reviews.  I've been 3 times in the last 3 days and don't have a single complaint. Seen pretty consistent to me. The hot mocha is my favorite and I drink it daily now. I tried the slow roasted ham breakfast croissant and I was pleasantly surprised.  It was very good for a coffee shop. I've enjoyed the service and even with long lines I've gotten in and out of the drive thru quickly. I do remember telling the person to give me a minute and she said hey no worries I'm here til noon. Lol made me feel comfortable with looking for a second.

So traveling across the USA ordering the exact same thing from Starbucks along the way have been for two years now. Came to Philadelphia walked up to order and a I could be wrong but you shouldn't come to work stoned.  you should actually listen when your customers order. see if you're going to get the order wrong it shouldn't cost more than it has cost through the entire journey. So needless to say I'm definitely a Starbucks fan, my girlfriend and I have it every day. The coffee was good the muffins were good the service definitely not up to par.

The first time I went to this location, it was PACKED. Kind of a bad timing for the delivery truck to be delivering so the parking lot was super crowded. I waited in line about 10 minutes. The wait was long, but not unbearable. However, the reason I am giving 5 stars is the baristas were SUPER friendly AND to apologize for the wait they comped one of my drinks! This location is doing it right!!!

Management sucks! Poorly trained staff.  Inefficient service, lack of customer care and  not clean.  Workers are inexperienced and don't understand the basic concept of customer service. They'd rather gossip with visiting friends and ignore the  long line of customers. They also DO NOT wash  their hands or use gloves after touching their faces, rubbing their noses, scratching their heads, coughing or touching surfaces. You might be better served bringing your own coffee in a thermos to this mall or going to one of the many other vendors for better service.  This location ranks low in customer care and cleanliness.

Even though Starbucks is a chain it is still often a good environment to be in. The staff at this particular location is always super friendly, and always give personal recommendations that could make you're drink better. They always make my drinks good.

This is one of the worst Starbucks I've been to. I asked for a Carmel Macchiato and it took the girl forever to make it. After I recorded it and took a drink it tasted absolutely nothing like the drink. 

Be warned if you want a coffee that taste like your usual don't go there. They'll mess up your order with the quickness!

Had a very poor experience yesterday morning. 
In attempting to find gluten free options, I asked about the sous vide egg bites - a Starbucks product available in varying locations throughout the US - that utilizes a steam bath approach to cooking and is very light and healthy. 
As I was inquiring about these egg bites, another employee (seemingly a managerial type) cross-talked my transaction saying that these bites are only available in Maryland. 
Not true. 
I've had them in lots and lots of places. 
He then said, "Well....they're not available in Pennsylvania" - I have doubts about that too. I have written the corporation to get a true listing of who does and does not sell the eggs. 
From my experience, I've had them in Massachusettes, Austin, San Diego and other cities in California. 

I find it inexcusable for a manager or any employee to burst into a conversation and essentially provide information that keeps customers from buying product. If I didn't know better, I would take this young man at his word and never look again and never buy this new product.
Love me some coffee. The app is great. Love the fact that I can use my phone to order. I get rewarded for my patronage.

While our drinks were good and the lady takin the our order was very good and polite and pleasant, there was a lack of energy in the rest of staff. With this lack of energy came low efficiency and our drinks took forever.  One of the employees was called off the line by the manager but no one bothered to fill her spot and finish our drinks. Could definitely use some improvement.

A Starbucks is a Starbucks...and for some reason I still find myself coming to this one at certain points. It's always really busy, which isn't really the issue...but they do seem like they are understaffed at times. The wait is usually pretty crazy and my order has been forgotten on more than one occasion. As a regular boring coffee drinker, I feel like that'd be an order they would be excited for in between all the crazy stuff.
The baristas here are always very nice...this place is a bit further than the one on 32n market but they have apple fritters so it's worth the trip ;)

Went into Starbucks today for my usual Venti Caramel Frappuccino , I had the pleasure of interacting with Justin, I told him that I was 3 stars away from getting my next reward on the Starbucks app and wanted to know the fastest way to get 3 stars he told me a few different ways but it was so confusing for myself that he just hooked me up with a drink on the house.. I have never had anyone do this for me and I come to Starbucks all the time. Super grateful for what he did this guy definitely knows how to show good customer service!!! Thanks again Justin I owe you one!!!!

Oh Starbucks, how I love thee. Traders Point Starbucks, you're my #1. I hope we're BFF's forever.

When there are so many Starbucks around, the people who work there are really the ones who can make it or break it. This Starbucks has some pretty cool people working there, and they're great at keeping the drive thru moving at a decent pace, keeping the inside clean and organized, and getting to know their regulars. Hands down my favorite Starbucks, all because of the people who work there.

I was never a coffee shop goer until I moved into a condo with a Starbucks on the ground level.  It started with me requiring internet access before I had it installed in my condo, and needing to buy something from Starbucks in exchange for that free internet.  Now I'm addicted to lattes, and about $25 poorer/week!  

Generally, I find this Starbucks location to have poor service and sometimes poor product quality.  Oftentimes I will be waiting to place my order while the staff members are chit chatting with their backs turned to the counter.  I find this to be a customer service problem at many retail establishments these days, and I'm always taken back to my days in retail when we were taught that the customer comes first, and if there aren't any customers, you need to busy yourself with cleaning, stocking supplies, etc.- anything but chatting.

When it's finally time to place the order, the staff are sometimes unaware of their own products, or I have to repeat my order several times (I would think that Skinny Vanilla Latte is pretty standard!).  Also, upon ordering decaf coffee on behalf of someone else, I've been questioned several time as to whether I really want to wait for it (perhaps because they don't want to take the time to make it?).  Usually if someone orders decaf, it's not for fun and giggles... it's because they can't have caffeine.  Therefore, yes, I did want to wait for it.

I guess the real indicator of how I feel about this location is that despite the fact that it's on the main floor of my condo, I'll often pass by it in favour of going to another coffee shop to get my beloved latte.  I'd rather wait out the 10 minute bus ride to Second Cup or Le Prep to get my beloved latte than be set in a bad mood after dealing with this particular Starbucks location.
Worst customer service. Barista ignoring  customers refilling coffee machines. I left not paying for that.

Some people may hate chain retail coffee shops, but this is as good as it gets in Arnold! I particularly enjoy Starbucks because the service is almost always enjoyable and there is free Wi-Fi in the place. 
There are a lot of nice cozy chairs and I sometimes manage to plop here with a good book instead of the local library. (The library does tend to be a bit loud, but that is ok.)
I can order a variety of drinks that can be syled according to my preferences. I always order the skinny version of an iced caramel machiatto. I always get my drink pretty quickly.
I agree with other reviewers, they do need to add some more parking spots, but this is not a huge negative, because the store had to do with what was given to them.

This is your typical starbucks with a drive through.  Thenstagf has always been pleasant and the drinks have always been well caffinated.  This is conveniently located just ofnthe main road so it is easy to get in and out.

I usually go to the Starbucks in Montecito, but stopped here to avoid traffic on Coast Village Rd one afternoon.  I know they don't serve bold after noon, so I asked them to "pour it over".  Unfortunately, this took 20 minutes and was not really hot when they handed it to me.  Strike 1.

The barista informed me they don't sell the double choc. chip brownies at this location because they don't sell well.  I guess that means that I am not the typical Carpinteria customer... so I went to the donut shop across the street and bought my brownie.  

I would avoid this location...  the Montecito Starbucks is by far better and the help is much more helpful with hot coffee.

Review is ONLY on the location not the employees - who are fantastic. I've been coming here since the week the store opened last year.

1. The wifi is AWFUL - I've never been  able to get anything done with the internet in their store. Web pages load like dial-up 10 years ago. It's unbelievably slow - especially for a Starbucks. I think it's because kids in the Drexel building are illegally downloading with the Starbucks network rather than using their school wifi. 

2. The temperature in the store is always off - either too hot in the summer or too cold in the winter. 

3. There are far too few outlets for this to be a coffee shop. A total of 2(!) for 8-9 tables, which means you either luck out and find a table near a wall outlet or be prepared to find another coffee shop.

I usually don't review chain places but DAMN! 

Ordered an Iced coffee ended up with a cup of brownish water. My first sip was full of coffee grinds. Really? SB coffee never comes full of coffee grinds. This cup was watered down and just bad. 

By far the crappiest starbucks experience I have ever had.

Beautiful location, almost no line, nice cashier, fantastic Smoked Butterscotch latte. What's not to like? I think the new design aesthetic of Starbucks fits well in New Orleans - exposed brick and wood, clean lines, dark colors. And a good coffee!

I come here every now and then to get coffee (obviously) if I'm in the area. I've never had any problems with service. It's pretty roomy inside with the classic Starbucks cozy feel. They have a small area outdoors to enjoy your drinks. I like that they're open later. My drinks have always been consistent.

Friendly, fast service, drinks are as expected. Limited seating that isn't always neat or clean, but remember this Starbucks is in a Target so they have a zillion people with carts and little kids going in and out constantly.  They're very fast and I've never seen a huge or slow-moving line, which is nice because i usually want to get my chai and get the heck out of there. 
I'd recommend going before you do your shopping if you want to sit and nurse your drink or snack, as the sitting area really isn't large enough to allow lots of carts and bags unless it's basically empty. One or two small bags are fine, but if you've stocked up for the end of the world, put your stuff in the car and then come back in.
The staff is very friendly however the young man making the orders did give me the worst VBM i have ever had. I guess he was having a bad day, it is a simple drink to make so I'm not sure.

My usual order: Tall Pike in a grande cup

Money and time saving tips: Always use Starbucks app to pay and order.

Order:  Coffee is often fresh even with 10 mins remaining before close.
 
Service:  Quick and friendly.

Convenience:  Direct access to PA turnpike; multiple fast food cuisine options nearby (McDonald's, chick fila, Chipotle, panda), restaurants (red Robin, cracker barrel), businesses (Walmart, Lowe's, Neshaminy Mall).

Recommended breakfast sandwiches: Double smoked bacon with egg and cheese on a croissant; Spicy chorizo, egg and cheese on ciabatta bread.

Probably the best study spot in Manayunk given that there're only two free wifi spots but Volo has slow wifi so.. 
Standard starbucks menu, always stocked up on pastries and grab-and-go lunch boxes. 
The go-to recently has been cold brews or the pink drink. 
Staff are always nice. The line gets long in the mornings but moves quickly. 
The back area has a plenty of seating and lots of other people doing work. Pretty quiet most of the time. Not a lot of outlets though.
This Starbucks is in a great location--right by the Southwest Airlines gates.  The service is fast and usually friendly.  They are often well stocked on baked goods and snacks.

This place is always clean. They just added new tables and chairs and makes it easier to camp out than in the past. The new seating is great for small groups or for students who don't mind sharing a table. 

The employees here are always friendly and their do great work.

I think the "old" reviews are outdated as it seems that this staff has addressed the issues.

The best part...they open before the other stores in the area which is a big help to me.

Super crowded on a Saturday Morning around 11.
Waiting in a very long line - and then again to pick up each hand-pulled drink.

Just OK as S-Bux goes.  But I was jonesin' for a $5 latte.

It's a pretty typical Starbucks location. I noticed the baristas are pretty nice here, compared to a couple other locations. They make the drinks pretty speedy too. I also like that the baristas engage with you and really take care into making your drink.

This place needs help.  I ordered an almond croissant.  There were several on the display shelf.  They gave me a chocolate croissant and told me they were out of almond.  "But there are like 4 on display", I said.  The response: "Well, those are like 10 days old, so they are for display only and were actually out."  Then, they only filled my tall mocha 3/4 full.  I had to ask them to fill it up.  There's also no scanner at this location, so I had to read the 16 digit number out loud (for everyone around me to hear). And I had to do it twice, because the guy didn't get it right the first time!!  They got my friends order wrong too, giving him two of the same pastry, when he ordered two different items.  Very disappointed in this location.

The neighborhood Starbucks. What can I say? The service has always been nice whether I choose to go through the drive-thru or go inside. Everyone has always been friendly whenever I come in, there's enough parking outside, enough seating area and the place has always been clean and orderly every time I pay this location a visit.

I usually stop by here on Saturday mornings before going in to work (whenever I decide to go in slightly later than when I usually do) and there's usually not too many people which is nice. I've always been pleased with how fast the service is and how friendly the staff have constantly been. I am pretty easy and will most likely place the same order over and over but I have always been happy with my food and beverage quality.

Overall, it's a good place to stop by to grab a quick bite and for some caffeine fix.

Pregnant and really needed to use the restroom before ordering... unfortunately the girl cleaning the bathroom decided to ignore me standing there attempting to wait patiently and just continue cleaning. I appreciate them wanting to have a clean bathroom but if somebody looks like they really need to go and there is only one bathroom in the building to use, maybe stepping out for a second it would be helpful. Instead she sort of gave me a dirty side glare and just ignored me while starting on a whole new area of wall tile to clean. 
This forced me to have to leave to find a bathroom somewhere else and not even make an order there.
RUDE AND INCONSIDERATE STAFF 
I cannot wait for the day that girl has a baby kicking on her full bladder and no restroom to use.

My second home away from home. The best baristas: Jason and Benny to name a couple. If my drink isn't perfect,  then they'll make it again and are HAPPY to do so. It doesn't get too loud or too busy. Great location with ample parking. I pass four Starbucks to come to this one. That's saying something!  :)
Had to repeat my order three different times.  23 mins in drive thru line for ONE grande vanilla latte. Enough said.

It's so nice that Starbucks makes alternative employment opportunities for people incapable of even the most basic customer service functions. While I do kind of wish they weren't so close to the gates so I wouldn't think "I'll just grab a quick coffee before my flight," because they don't actually sell coffee here. They sell apathy and an ignorance of basic math skills. They give the coffee away for free.

This is my weekday Starbucks.  Every weekday!   Love the team.  Whether in-store or at drive through they are always great.  Energetic, smiles, good energy.  Store is clean, well taken care of.   Beverage is always perfect.   Note, it can get busy inside, and there isn't always a lot of tables available.  A few tables outside which is great in the summer!
If you hate your life at Starbucks you shouldn't work at Starbucks. 2 girls behind the counter were sharing a brain. Flies and garbage drinks.

Worst drive thru ever. If you have an extra 30 minutes to wait for a drip coffee go for it!
Why does it take forever????

Paoli Starbucks just as busy and drive thru moves just fine!

Maybe you need to hire better more competent people

Nice people. But just had some bad experiences there. When I try and use the Starbucks app... it frequently says that they're out of items. It hasn't just been today. But pretty much every time I use the Starbucks app. Hopefully they will get more items in stock. Again, nice people. Nice location.

Ordered coffee and a breakfast sandwich. Received my latte in a reasonable time frame. Waited and watched several sandwiches go out via the drive through. Kept waiting for mine - about 5 min. Finally I was given my sandwich with an apology on how long it took ... Started to eat as I drove off and the entire center was still frozen. Not edible. Had to toss it out. So I waited too long - for nothing. Wasted money too.
I mean who doesnt love coffee, any and all give it to me! Its so expensive though and sometimes the employees are too cheerful at 7 in the morning. haha

This location is usually pretty quick and accurate.  The staff is friendly and there is lots of seating indoor and out.  It's also close to my office, making it extremely convenient when I'm in need of caffeine :)
Looooove this Starbucks. I go to so many and this one never fails me and actually knows how to make coffee! Woohoo

I was kind of disappointed this morning when I stopped at this Starbucks. The drive thru was packed but it wasn't a super long wait so that was nice. I ordered a simple iced coffee with cream and sugar and a pumpkin cream cheese muffin. The guy at the window was friendly and awesome. Unfortunately nothing on my order was right. They gave me a pumpkin scone and an iced coffee with just cream. Not a huge deal but it bummed me out.

This a very busy starbucks, so if you want a quick cup of coffee, be prepared to be there early because the line is quite long, with all the conventions and events hosted by the casino, I do like that I could use my Starbucks giftcard, it was clean and organized,  and they were able to cater to the busy crowd,  and didn't mess up the orders.

I'll keep my Starbucks reviews limited to those locations that I think are better than your average Starbucks. This location on South Howard, I believe, is one of the nicer ones in Tampa. It is very spacious, high ceilings, plenty of comfortable seating options, inside and out...nice "scenery" too (wink, wink, nudge, nudge).  Thought it would be snobby based on the location but I didn't detect any snobbery from the staff or patrons. And the caramel frappuccino was made perfectly. So there you have it...5 stars
Vary nice staff, I was excited to get my large water served to me with a smile.  Very pleased, I will return soon.

First off, it's Starbucks and I already love the product but wow wow WOW to the service here. Each time I go, the staff are consistently friendly and so very happy about life in a coffee shop! They are always suggesting new coffee concoctions to add to my favorites. Add in the clean facility inside and the speedy drive thru and you've got a winning Starbucks in your hands! Keep up the good work!

I'm not going to review the coffee because we all know what Starbucks coffee tastes like. 
This review is more for the overall vibe of this location. There are a few other local coffee shops in the area, but if you want to use your rewards or just really need a frap, this location is friendly and always full of locals.
The patio is dog friendly and makes for good people watching.

I'm not sure if this is the one that is in the terminal, but if it is Samantha was so incredibly sweet and patient and took the time to make me a decaf right before closing, even though her Colleague was rude enough to ask right in front of me whether not they had an of time before closing... When they still have plenty of customers left in line that they needed to attend to. Just as a sidenote, I had already stopped by earlier to ask for one and said I would come back closer to when I boarded thank you for being so sweet and having such great customer service, the coffee was awesome!

This review is for this Starbucks location compared to other Starbucks. Everyone knows what to expect quality-wise from Starbucks. I'm not a huge fan of their coffee. I think there is much better out there. But, this Starbucks in particular, is a very cool Starbucks.

This is "my" Starbucks. (the one near where I live) It's a cool place. There is outdoor seating and plenty of couches, comfy chairs indoors. It's one of the few Starbucks that sells wine and beer. This is definitely one of the nicer, bells and whistles, larger, and complete Starbucks. 

My one complaint is that when I order a Venti coffee, the lid often leaks. That's more of a "Starbucks in general" complaint since the lids are not specific to specific stores.

Free WIFI, just as in all Starbucks.

I go to this Starbucks at least 4 times a week! They never are very happy! They are always out of drink trays and drink stoppers! Today they told me they don't get drink stoppers anymore! The coffee was running down both cups and they didn't offer to clean off! I will NOT being spending my money at this Starbucks anymore! Very rude and not fully stocks! At $4.80 a drink they need to have the supplies!

(In the voice of the most interesting man...)
I dont always go to Starbucks..but when I do, I go here!

Great staff, Drinks always done correctly, friendly.
They have hipped me to a few different drinks.
Big fan of the Red Eye (bold coffee/shot of espresso)

The staff are more into themselves than the customers. They are very impersonal. The service is not very good. (One girl is great though) But the ones that are no good rub me the wrong way. They are loud too. Everything is quiet except them talking to themselves.

Find an independent cafe

Very bad planning. Both the Canal Pl.ace Starbucks and the Canal Street @ St. Charles Avenue Starbucks are out of the eggnog latte! Boo. Hiss!
:-(

Okay - so this is Starbucks we are talking about.  Meaning - everyone has some level of experience with them.  My lower rating (as a Starbucks coffer "liker") is I got attitude once for asking my card balance and then asking them to throw the receipt with the balance away for me.  I just wanted to know the balance on a gift card, but not the paper to clutter my car.  Was that so hard to grasp?  Check the attitude.

This is an average Starbucks location in a shopping center.  The staff is friendly and the drinks are to be expected.

The strange thing is it's completely hidden unless you're looking for it.  I lived nearby for a long time before I even realized it was here.  I'm glad I found it!
Such a great location to get your favorite Starbucks breakfast sandwich, caffeine vice, sit and relax.

one of my favorite starbucks and the people are really nice there. i went last friday and some kids from penn came to carol and it was just so cheery. love it even more just cause its on the campus of the most amazing college.

The baristas and staff here are wonderful.  Always cheerful and efficient and such a nice way to start your morning. I just had a "pay if forward" moment when I forgot my wallet and a barista covered the cost of my coffee.  Sometimes it's just the little things!

I made the mistake of walking in to place my order, BIG MISTAKE! At the time  I was the  the only person is line and watched as multiple cars placed and received their orders before I received my one cup of tea.  The customer who came in after me received his order, had time to chat with the employees and even left as I was still waiting for mine.  I order the same item over and over and it's never the same. I don't understand why it's so inconsistent.  
I'd rather drive out of my way to another location than stop here again.

I asked for a sample cup of their Veranda. It was yet to be brewed so I didn't want to bother her to brew some just for a taste of it. So I asked for a Pike instead. She complied, not smiling. Maybe a half hour or so later I again asked for a sample of Veranda. Again, it had yet to be brewed. So I asked for another sample of Pike. She hesitated for maybe a half-second then complied with a sigh, again not smiling. The music was great!

Great Starbucks! The outdoor seating is an awesome place for some good people watching. After reading other reviews, I found out that this place is open 24 hours. Knowing this, I'm sure I will be visiting at 1-2am someday in the near future.
The Starbucks was filthy all the trash cans where over flooding with trash the restroom was pretty dirty as well. Disappointing  customer complaint about restrooms customers left upset

Can you give zero stars? The staff was very slow and we were waiting in line for almost 20 minutes. Then they handed us our drink that were both wrong. The first drink had no whip even though we asked for it like 3 times. And then the non dairy drink I ordered (because I have a dairy allergy) was made in a dairy blender, and we watched them put milk in it! I had specifically asked for almond milk so this was very frustrating. I tried to ask them to remake it because I couldn't drink it without getting sick, and they told me I was wrong and it was definitely almond milk. It was a very frustrating experience. The staff was very rude about it and didn't even offer to remake it after. I got a refund and left. Very disappointing

Great location, fast service (even at their peak hours), and friendly employees :) This is usually my go to SB & I'm never disappointed. They have gone above and beyond to fix our orders when messed up and have offered several free drinks to compensate for any mistakes they have made!
This Starbucks has always offered great service. They are in a great location. This place is right next to the Suncoast bike path and McDonald's. There is not much to say about it.
Usually a line, hard to find parking, not worth stopping in unless you are already at suburban square.
Walked out this morning, they are too busy filling pick up orders to handle customers waiting in line!!

You get a star and you get a star! Great location, love the baristas, and staff. Super nice, and take care of your Starbucks needs! Organized, clean, and extremely friendly service! 10/10 recommend! Also perfect place to get yourself a treat to shop around!
Pretty typical Starbucks. Nice group of people and the line is never too long.

What can I say! I love Starbucks, and I'm certainly not picky where I get it as long as the coffee is Starbucks, and the Service is anywhere near reasonable which it always is here! I don't have any problems here and never have, but I surely do love all of their coffee and will continue going here and any other Starbucks as convenient and nice as this Starbucks!!! This is another
Class Act Starbucks!
Great location, right off RT 1. Very clean and well managed, great staff and quick service!

My drinks are always good here but everytime I come here when a specific barista is working she always has a rude attitude with me. The first time I just figured she was having a bad day, but then again today she was rude with me. I asked for a drink and offered to tell her the recipe for it (it's not on the menu but it's literally just a mix of cool lime, lemonade, and passion tea.) and she told me "we can't do special orders because we're too busy with frappuccino happy hour." I asked her "so you can't make my drink? I have the recipe." And she goes "well we're really busy so we'd have to shake it in the shaker. It won't look how you want it to." Which like? I don't care? I just wanted my drink. So I asked again and she asked another barista who told her yes they can, she just had to write down on the cup how to make it. Cool lime refresher to the first line, lemonade to the 3rd line, ice, then passion tea on top of that. It's a super easy drink. It takes like a minute tops to make. I've never had an issue with any other barista but for some reason she's just extra rude. I went again though the other day and the new barista was super nice! She was fantastic and even though my drink was written wrong so I got the wrong drink, I think it was just the way I explained it. When I mentioned it at the end to the barista who made my drink she quickly and happily remade my drink for me!

love the personal treatment received by each barista. wasn't a huge fan of the male manager/register. not sure of his title. all window staff at drive thru are awesome! I look forward to seeing Nicholas.  he's a crack up. makes me laugh. couple of the girls are super bubbly and fun too. love this location as my favorite drive thru

Always seems chaotic here and sometimes under staffed. Sent a mobile order and went to get it. Waited much longer than the 4-9 minute expectation, yet it wasn't crowded. I think it took 20+ minutes. Then my drink is placed on the counter without a lid? This has never ever happened at any Starbucks. No lid,no sleeve and no explanation. Then a few drinks later my daughters drink finally is made. No thanks. No have a good day. Chaos.

Every Starbucks should have a drive thru! I go to this one specifically because it's to much of a pain to get both my kids out of the car to get coffee in the morning. Every time I go the person who takes my order is courteous and quick. Expect to have a bit of a wait here, if the line is backed up in the drive thru it can take at least 10 minutes to get your order. It's one of their busiest locations and for that reason it can take a bit longer.

This SBUX can get long lines during the busy shopping times of the year but they consistently deliver a good cup of coffee.

Seating is cramped due to the location, but overall this Starbucks is a shining star in what is a fading location.

(Note to Meadowood management - dump the Kiosks - they cheapen the whole experience)

Chronometer: Sunday morning, February 17, 2008: 9:00 am.

Course: Westbound on Interstate 76 West.

Velocity: 80 MPH

Temperature:  26 F

Caffeine Level: Non-Existent

Never, ever has Starbucks been such a welcome sight! I was almost cheering as I pulled into the Travel Plaza, secure in the warming thought that soon, that oh so blessed drug of choice - caffeine - would soon be coursing it's way through my veins and to my brain!

I stopped by here since I was really craving some iced coffee with the sweet vanilla cream and the Starbucks at the mall ran out! This Starbucks was pretty standard. I can't not love a place that always is air conditioned, has good drinks, and is ideal for getting work done or just chatting with friends. Service here was always great!

Not all Starbucks are created equal.

* Many have tiny, nasty, difficult parking lots.  This location is in a plaza so parking is a breeze.

* This is a busy location and after you place your order you need to wait for your drink to be made.  The area for waiting here is very small and I get mildly annoyed when it's crowded.

* The people here are great.

* Starbucks has partnered with a new bakery and they are rolling it out all across the country.  It's called La Boulange and they are from Fan Francisco.  It's easy to tell if a location has it because their signature color is pink.  This location was just rolled out so you'll see lots of different tasty treats.

I stop in here most weekday mornings and overall they're great!
I love the friendly baristas at this location! There isn't a lot of room for socializing here though-- it is a grab and go spot for sure.

I get coffee on my way to work each and every shift. I have been coming to this location for three years and this past year has been the best.  I found that the new store manager has did an outstanding job with not just the store but also the crew. He has taken the time to grow the crew and to inspire them to be the best they can be. 
The crew; what can I say; they know me by name and Jeep :-) I am greeted by name in d/t and when I walk through the door. It just does not get any better than that.  
Only down side of this location is all the school kids who come in and just want a "free" water and take up space for actual pay patrons. I had to ask a barista to help me find a place to sit for a few minutes before leaving for work.  I felt very uncomfortable and had repeated unappreciated stares from those asked to leave.

About a month ago we came in and ordered a iced coffee with milk and syrup around 10 pm. The iced coffee was more water than coffee with only about a teaspoon of milk added. I go to Starbucks very often and this Starbucks location just sucked! The girl working late that night wasn't any help when I told her I've never seen iced coffee like that before, she just looked at me and said rudely, " do you want me to make u another one?" Just rude. Never again here! Save your drive and go to another Starbucks

I understand everyone is busy for the holiday but get it together Starbucks! I'm sorry I don't have a fancy app with money stored on it to pay for my drink like all the other 9 people in line, but when I give you a $10 bill for my $5.35 charge, I don't expect over $2 in change in quarters and other coins. You should probably go check if you have some more ones

i love the bux. Forget about the politics you get your coffee the way you want it PERIOD. 
After drinks and nibbles i was in need to #GTL so yelped the closest starbucks and up popped this one two min away. I arrived to a pretty busy store but an even more amusing night crew taking orders and mixing up drinks. I was in an out in under 3 min with my #GTL ready to be up all night !

GTL =Green Tea Latte - yeah you guys can use it

I stopped here this morning through the drive-through. I was impressed with the quickness of service - four stars - since I was the fifth car in line and got to the window in five minutes.

I ordered a graham cracker latte and a ham and Swiss Egg sandwich for breakfast.  Unfortunately the latte was pretty tasteless as all the syrup was sitting at the bottom. The sandwich had been thrown into the bag and as a result half of the  cheese stuck to the side of the bag. Otherwise the sandwich was pretty good and pretty warm.   I had to ask for a napkin.

For almost $11 breakfast I expected something better so the net here is three stars.
Terrible service ! They are slow as molasses ! Every single time but I have gone there to order a chai latte they forget to make it !
The Baristas here, in particular Jordan, is one of the best ever. Splendid service. Just Ask for Jordan.

I'm not a Starbucks fan, but if you're in the Willow Grove Mall looking for coffee, this it. Baristas were very efficiently working their way through a fairly long line. Place is clean, and it's in the "food court" with convenient seating, pleasant lighting under skylights, clean seating area. Very strong dark roast, almost with a burnt flavor. I don't drink it, but shockingly they were out of the cold brew, which must be a bestseller at a place like this.

Nice staff, nice facilities, but sloooowwwweeesssttttt service I have ever received in a Starbucks! I ordered a grande iced coffee (read not at all complicated) with no one in front of me and just one guy behind me. There were 4 staff (yes four people matched to two customers) and somehow it took us both 6 minutes to get our drinks. Not the end of the world but not very considerate.

I just left this Starbucks and plan to never go there again! I waited in line almost 15 minutes with just 2 single people ahead of me. The girl at the register couldn't seem to figure out what she needed to do and no one helped her until the very end, and she had to ask! There were 3 others working and no one seemed to care that there was a line. Also, we got in line and there was a person down at the end of the counter that I didn't even see. My husband ask if she was in line and she said she was.(she really wasn't)  Come to find out SHE was an employee. Now I know you make the employees act like customers when they have their breaks, but really?!?! 15 minutes is way to long when the place is not busy.  Then the tall guy with dreads copped an attitude.  I mean,seriously...

I rate this Starbucks 3 stars instead of 5, because:
-as another reviewer stated, this Starbucks tends to be consistently busy and loud on the inside. I would not recommend having a meeting, interview or phone call here.
-the drive thru is very busy as well, and is one of the slower drive thrus I have used at a Starbucks
-the staff is below average, and there seems to be a fair amount of attrition. I have received more wrong orders here than at other Starbucks

It is clean on the inside, and has nice outdoor seating. The large windows to the South make the afternoon sunshine coming in nice.
I've ran into some pretty awful service here, I always go to the one on disc instead!!

Normally starbucks service and selections are always top notch however this morning at this  location my coffee was only a 3rd of the way full and my breakfast sandwich was cold in the middle..... I've never had bad food or coffee at Starbucks for the premium price for thier products the items should always be exemplary. Someone was in a big hurry and  cut corners. I'm very dissapointed.
Some of the employees are very rude. No customer service skills. There are a few girls there that are very nice and cheerful. I wish they were all like that!

It is an airport Starbucks. It's often lined up. But I do have some fond memories of sipping Starbucks beverages at this airport nonetheless, as I often end up spending a rather lot of time at this airport for various reasons whether it means delayed flights or otherwise.

(4.5) ~ Very Good Overall Coffee & Service.  This is one of the few locations in the area to have "Nitro Cold Brew" on Draft:). You can either get it Regular or with Sweet Cream.  Because I like strong coffee, I prefer the Regular;). Now the only reason I didn't give them a (5), is because they don't currently have a Clover Brewing System, which is the best way to brew hot coffee buy the cup and allow you to try their Reserve beans;)

I sent my order to a store that why 10 miles away. They tried to void it but couldn't and just offered to take care of it. Many complain this is a slow Starbucks, it's also busy as Shit all the time. 

Mobile order and waiting is not an issue ever. (Just send to the right store!)
It's fine if you want a run of the mill starbucks item. If you want an amazing coffee look down the street for Volo.

This is a starbucks; it's very similar to other Starbuckes and in fact I love Starbucks. They deliver top quality products and services, treat their employees well, give back to the community, and work toward a sustainable environment. This particular starbucks, however, recently underwent a renovation and I have to say, I'm not a fan. The stark white and dark browns are harsh on the eyes and that combined with the new angular furniture no longer feels warm and cozy. Worse still is the parking situation and by that I mean there are often no spots left because there aren't many in the first place. Major oversight in design here.

Girl at the counter had an annoyed at life,  expressionless look on her face as she spoke,  eyes barely open, almost as if she had nothing but mere contempt for the human race. 
Asked for the vanilla sweet cold brew (a featured drink this month). She had no clue what it was and said,  ummmm, we gots (yes, gots) vanilla frappucino.

I didn't even bother any further.  I'll hit up the one across from my house.

This is open for a while now and one thing they need to work on is maintaining the condiments counter.    I'm there often and almost always its out of supplies.   I'm also somewhat disappointed that they don't fill the coffee to the top...   Why should I get 3/4 cup of coffee?   Happened too many times to not say anything about ...

When I come here I can always count on fast and friendly service! Their baristas always get my order correct and it's brewed to perfection.  Today I enjoyed a grande non-fat iced latte and it was great! They have a large selection of bakery items at this location and I'm always tempted to get something. Their cake pops are delish! 

A bonus to this Starbucks is the outdoor seating. The atmosphere is not that special because it's in a parking lot but it's great to enjoy the nice springtime weather.
Picked up a simple iced coffee today. And dispite it being tasty I still prefer my Nespresso machine or local stir brewed coffee place.
Good customer service. Decent coffee, messed up order twice but fixed it both times. Espresso sometimes tastes burnt but I think that's just the bean they use. Overall good
The all glass walls have outlets all along the way. Perfect for laptop camping. The store is large, and not overly crowded.

This is one of the nicer, friendlier branches of Starbucks I've been to.

Staff is very friendly, the room isn't the biggest but enough light from both natural and overhead.  The noise level isn't booming where its distracting but the great level you expect from a coffeehouse.

Convenient location in Valley Park, a great spot all the time!

This place is hit or miss. The lines can get extremely long and people belly up to the bar like they are going to miss their grande half caf soy gingerbread latte. I just had to have them make my drink twice because it was flavorless lukewarm water. 

If the line is long I wouldn't even bother because you will wait forever for a drink they will probably make wrong.

A cool spot. Great location that never never ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever ever has cinnamon raisin bagels anywhere except the display bagel in the window that gives you false hope that they actually have them.

I love this Location.  I come here to study all the time.   Super friendly staff and the space is big.  No matter how busy it gets, I can always find a spot for me and my laptop.  The only thing, the wifi is weak in the back.  If you need to use their wifi, I recommend sitting by the front entrance.

This starbucks is SLOW and cramped. They also do not have a drive-through which is annoying. The barista's are so talkative, they cannot focus and they are super rude to each other. Every morning, I hear one of the saying " oh, is this your drink, you better put it up." I am thinking, "Are Y'all really playing this game with 15 people in line and they are more enthralled with the drama of which employee sits their coffee beside them. WHO F ING CARES? They also will make the regular brewed coffee before anything blended, so if you order a frap, you better take a seat, it's gonna be 10-15 minutes. I see people leaving line or complaining about being late for work every single morning. This starbucks will slow you down for sure!

Starbucks continues to be the bane of my existence. The thorn in my side. The ultimate example of everything that is wrong with chain restaurants, and the suburbs. 

While I do enjoy their coffee and willingly pay five dollars a cup for coffee, water, and milk. I would much prefer going to a mom and pop establishment. However, the problem with the suburbs is there is a severe lack in mom and pop coffee shops. But I guess the upside to chain restaurants is that you can always expect the same quality where ever you go. 

All my ranting aside, this is a good starbucks. They have a nice outdoor patio, my order is always correct, and they have a drive through which is always convenient. Be warned, however, this drive through with its proximity to Rt. 1 and the turnpike, can get very crowded in the mornings.

Great location, makes it easy to grab a coffee in between classes. People are super friendly. And actually get my name right which is awesome. It's always packed in the morning/afternoons during weekdays though, so if you're looking for a quick grab and go this may not be the best place at that time.

Went twice & it was the worst Starbucks experience I've ever witnessed. The first time the girl made my drink wrong, so she made it again & it wasn't right so I told her to forget about it because I had to go. The second time I thought I'd give them one more chance. Fail. She made it wrong then after some thought she realized she did two things wrong to my drink. Second drink was awful even though she claimed it was made right. Next time I'm driving to the one down the street bc the extra stop is worth it after target.
Must be one of the slowest Starbucks ever, every time I have been there. Ridiculous! Hire some more people for goodness sake!  Other than that, your typical starbucks.

This location is usually awesome. Except today I walk in, and the girl at the counter continued to gossip with what I'm assuming was a worker in break, while I waited to be served. I was pretty shocked at this. Then, as I'm waiting for my stuff, for other workers were working their butts off while the dark hair girl who took my order continued to gossip with her buddy. All while coughing her brains out. I'm sorry but I'm not paying to watch you gossip or cough on my coffee. I thought this entire stop was disgusting and makes me question my return to this location. Aside from this girl with bangs and dark hair, the customer service here is usually great

Well it is Starbucks.  How interesting can this review actually be?  This is your standard Starbucks.  They are friendly and fast.  They run out of stuff sometimes though and it pisses me off.  Other than that I guess you could say they are pretty comparable to all of the other 5 gazillion 'bucks out there.
The already over priced Mocha quickly turned $160 cup of Mocha, when the lid was closed on the paper seams of the cup. Realized it dripped all over my pants and shirt when it was too late.

I miss this Starbucks! For awhile it was the closest to my home, as well as my work, and the staff here had my regular drink DOWN, man. In fact, if I stop here whenever I'm back in town at least a few baristas remember me... which means they don't have a lot of staff turnover which means they must treat their people right which means there's a good vibe here which means, dammit, this is one good Starbucks!

I have the unfortunate pleasure of visiting this Starbucks at least 2x weekly as I work part time in the mall. The service here is constantly BAD.  The employees here do not provide good customer service. Most times the are too busy tasking to pay attention to their customers. The worst part is that it never seems too clean, meaning trash bin is full, I have observed gnats in the pastry case. The cold case isn't fully stocked...The order takers and baristas don't appear to be a team. I tend to stick with just purchasing tea as anything outside of that the wait is FOREVER or the don't have the item. For example their have been at least 10 times this summer that cold brew coffee was not available. No in e offer to instead make a iced coffee. The attitude was pretty much we ain't got it prefer something else and move along. I only provided one star because I'm kinda forced to go here.

I love the service I get at this Starbucks. They always get my order perfect. I love bacon Gouda sandwiches and it's always prepared just right. My daughter drinks a mocha frap with hazelnut and roast. It's yummy. Go get one for yourself.

Had to explain how to make a iced coffee with cream and sweetener along with a shot. Not sure if the IQ level of the cashier was to blame or just her inability to comprehend an easy order that one would get on a daily basis while working at a Starbucks.

Stopped in for a drink and a sandwich on my way to work. Service was ok, they didn't know my order but eventually I received it. The java chip frap was good enough, but the bacon egg croissant I ordered was so bad, it ruined my appetite for the rest of the day. I know food isn't the company's strong suit, but this was disgusting.  Go to Panera.

Starbucks at a turnpike service plaza where people want to get in and out. 
Two people working on a high travel holiday weekend. I counted 17 people in line. 

All i wanted to do was purchase one of their expensive ,high profit items- a coffee mug. 

As the line appeared to be over 30 mins long i asked since i wasn't needing a prepared item could i just jump ahead and be rung out.  I was told no.  I don't  get it!    

Lost sale. !!

Too crowded, loud (some students don't understand volume control yet) and double check your cup contents before you walk out because it can be filled only partially.  Had better service and experience in crowded busy airports or freeway rest areas.

As far as Starbucks chain coffee shops go, this one is well managed, maintained, very clean, has friendly and knowledgeable staff, and make your order for a drink fast.

Of course when I have gone to this coffee shop I do it after I make my purchases at Target, not before, and just drink the coffee while driving home.

Food: 4 Stars
Service: 3 Stars

Love having Starbucks in any mall as it's an easy way for me to get a little kick while I shop. What can kill an experience is the speed of service and getting your order correct. Not sure how "Chai Tea Latte" translates to "Green Tea Latte", but whatever. :|
Ladies were very friendly and line moved quick. Spacious location with fair amount of seating. was in and out in no time.
Coffee is always hot and perfectly blended! The line stays long because of it..but it is definitely worth the wait...
The staff here are, on most times, amazing. There's limited seating, compared to how many people line up during and after lunch time, but they have free wi-fi.

At this location you have to deal with a**holes who block traffic to go into the drive through the wrong way.   Circle the building people and get out of people's way.

The staff and service has always been outstanding. The coffee is just as good as any Starbucks location.  3 stars due to the jerks who block traffic.

Horrible service.  The manager needs to be fired.  She was abusive and berating with her staff both Saturday and Sunday mornings.  On Saturday, I stated that it was very hot.  Her answer should have been, "let me adjust the temperature."  Instead, she said, "I know it is crazy."  Her employees tried to help but she was not managing properly.  Almost passive-aggressive with her criticism.  I suggest coffee bean up the block instead.

second time here, before the mall was opened.  on a Sunday they were friendly, but served drinks out of order.  lady waiting as several behind her get served.   Today, Nov 16 the young ladies working  were not nice, border line rude.  I requested a drink and told her I wasnt sure how to pronounce it, she rang up something else.  when I asked for my holiday drink card,  she said oh, you want the Carmel Brulee.  I said yes I wondered why you charged me for carmel.  Acted put out, annoyed. both my husband and I were not impressed with their lack of politeness and annoyed to be working.

I like this place it's very quiet and beautiful,  I visit regularly because of the less-people.  Not a lot of people know this location it's under looked.  It's place to be if you are looking cool Starbucks.

My favorite local Starbucks! Very polite staff, fast service, and comfortable seating with accessible outlets. Most of all, the coffee here is consistently perfect and accurate to what I order. It's also open earlier than the location in East Norriton.

Its a Starbucks... but this one is walkable from home and has a great outdoor seating space on Howard Ave. I only drink the shaken tea (not a coffee achiever here) so thats all I can comment on. I love the black shaken tea - its strong, could be even a tad stronger IMO, but I'm not gonna quibble over that I suppose.

Here's an issue though: Walked the dog up there and picked his tiny butt up (Italian Greyhound) and went in to order - so I could sit outside with him, and one of the employees was NOT NICE about saying he needed to be outside. Well, DUH. Thats why I was gonna sit outside... Dolt. So I asked for my tea to be brought out - WHICH THEY NEGLECTED TO DO after saying 'sure'.

FAIL.

And thats why they get 2 stars instead of 4. One idiot employee can do that.
PACKED NEW YEARS DAY TAKES 20 minutes in line because employees are short. Ridiculous pjs all the way!!!

Very good Starbucks right in the heart of Carpinteria. They were super busy but I got my drinks FAST!!!!!! I was impressed that the barista used my name several times during the transaction and she took the time to clarify my order. 

My drink came out perfect and just how I ordered. Thanks for another lovely visit Starbucks!

Starbucks is a Starbucks. And this one is really not much different. I do have an interesting front patio though. Still the top is not enclosed, instead it's just rafters. So it provide some shade which doesn't help much in the Arizona summer. Also, this is the third time I've been here and they continue to get my order wrong. I had to go back inside to get it changed out. What's more, is they have seating inside suited more for students. Lots of tables; not soft easy chairs. Oh well, at least the people who work here are nice!
I study here often, but why are there so many flies all the time?! Staff is friendly enough, but have nothing on the Tesson Ferry store! And there's not a ton of flies there!

The staff here had gotten pretty consistent; there was a huge turnover rate but the workers have been constant factor so that's a big plus. The manager here seems really really invested in what she does and I love that passion. Even though Starbucks is a corporation, I can see that the manager here really likes what she does and she seems pretty well educated on coffee (I've seen her so seminars and stuff). The biggest thing I have against this place is they run out of things which is fine if it's towards the end but, it's been pretty frequent that they will run out of things in the menu by mid-noon. 

I understand that coffee is popular but that being said... Once or twice I understand but this many times this early? 

Overall though, Horsham location wasn't the best and I preferred to drive out to other place even though this place is the closest to me. I like it now; staff is good, coffee is ok (aside from what I mentioned).

Best Starbucks in St. Louis. Great crew and the drive thru is super fast! Arnold is an official city now because we have a Starbucks! I have never had an issue at this Starbucks. 

The place is always clean and stocked very well.

One of its own kind of starbucks. Much better than the others. Soo clean, soo  neat, and of course, it smelled DELICIOUS. Yummmm coffee!     Service was good, quick and full of smiles and kindness. I love their hazelnut cappuccino . Very near to my place.Will be back again & again!!!

I am not a coffee, latte,  etc. kind of person but once in a year I will get a Hot Chocolate before I go to Candycane Lane and Starbucks is where I go to get it. It is very tasty and I love that they can make it with skim milk.

The place is nice- in addition to the standard Starbucks look they have a mini sofa room and a patio. What i dislike is that the staff changes a lot and the drinks are not always the best. But it is great if you want to enjoy a cup of regular coffee while enjoying a nice weather, especially because bensalem doesn't have that many patio places.

Came here late on the drive home from NorCal. Employees were friendly and our drinks were made perfectly to order. 

Line went quickly and drinks were made quickly. Granted it was pretty late at night however some Starbucks are slow even with a short line but these baristas made our drinks quickly even though the line was short. 

Great job!

I've been a customer at this Starbucks since about 10-15 days after they opened some 15 years ago.  As an everyday (literally!) customer, I feel I have a duty to point out when there seems to be a problem.

There have been rumors that the newly appointed district manager (Rose, I've been told) has taken it upon herself to flex her managerial muscles and make BIG changes to "my" Starbucks.

This surge of managerial minutia / micro management was first apparent when the well-liked and seemingly very effective manager was shown the door. The next catastrophe was the mass exodus of FOUR employees that have been there since the store opened and one who had only been employed a few years.

I apologize for making the following rodent based analogy when discussing an establishment that serves food . . . BUT I believe the rats leave just before the ship sinks! (not that I'm referring to Missy, Kelly, Ed, Ng and especially Carrie as rats but the analogy fits!)

I can't be the only one who sees a problem here . . . ROSE!
Free ice water, it's got my vote.  Sure, I know that's a policy of all Starbucks but this is a valuable thing whilst traveling -- where bottles of water are often charged at Disneyland prices.

Most of the time there is someone friendly, efficient and aware of the customer at this location but not today.  I have been at Starbucks everyday of my life for probably 5 years and things have changed.  No longer do they wear the uniforms, allow you to choose at the customer station which cream/milk you want in your coffee (self serve) and no longer do they feel necessary to give impeccable and friendly service.  

Love the coffee, love being able to sit and work in a nice environment but starting to lose interest in asking for milk versus getting it for myself and waiting for pleasantries.  Today I waited 5 minutes (long for Starbucks to be acknowledged) and another 5 minutes (with no one waiting) to have a basic ice coffee made with equal and milk that I had to ask for....  Disheartening for a big fan.

I stop here frequently when shopping in the Target but the line is usually always long and they have been out of something I wanted to order quite often. Sad to say that the service is not great either.

Great drinks, but the service here is SO SLOW. I have gone inside and through the Drive-thru and there's never any sense of urgency from the baristas. I feel like they take their time and don't consider the customers they are serving. It's just a bit frustrating when you're trying to get to work.

This Starbucks (about a block and a half away from another Starbucks--one of the many charms of living in a metropolis) is offers consistently  great customer service and a friendly, attractive staff.  And who doesn't appreciate a hot barista (though most don't stick around long).  

An added bonus of this Starbucks?  It's the only one in the city located in a super-luxury condo building.  Personally, I like to sit in a comfy chair, sitting on my Egg Nog latte and pretending that I live upstairs.

As others have indicated, it's a standby, Starbucks. The real challenge with this location is the locavore guilt you get when you could EASILY cross the street and have a brew at the Irvington original, LAZY DAZE.

I came here excited for my breakfast bakery item but unfortunately they were out of my first two options so I decided not to get anything to eat and just enjoy my drink. The woman at the window was very apologetic about not having the items I wanted and let me know when they would be back in stock and even gave me my drink for free! Everytime i come to this location the service is wonderful!
Extremely dirty. Not impressed with this particular store. Walls. Floors bathroom fixtures etc all stick and dirty. Makes me not want to come back

Excited about the convenience of having a Starbucks in our hotel. However, it was not. We figured we can grab a quick breakfast bite there, during our stay, before our adventures. Not! My boyfriend ordered a bagel. The Batista said, "plain, not toasted, with cream cheese okay?" Uhhh. No. Apperently   they dont warm or toast their bagels or pastries. Their pastry bar was filled with lots of pastries, but they are all cold. You would think all Starbucks locations would have a food warmer. 
Unless your going for a plain cup of Pike, you might want to drove to a Starbucks.

Friendly staff and quick service. Clean and well stocked with coffee items and condiments for your coffee. We ordered coffee and two cinnamon twists. So disappointed in the twists. The pastries were hard and dry (except the glaze). Ugh...a coffee cafe should always have FRESH pastries!!

This is by far my favorite Starbucks! Mainly because of the baristas compared to other Starbucks. It is also at a good location where you can seat outside on a nice sunny day. I love the peach green tea lemonade! Defiantly will recommend to others
Great customer service. Nice way to start a morning. New pastries are not as good as the previous supplier.
Very good customer service, always friendly. They also give our dog treats sometimes if you bring your pet through the drive thru.

I've noticed a huge improvement in drink quality since my last review. My main complaint was that my lattes were too weak and the overall quality was inconsistent. I started ordering a different drink and I've been pleased ever since.

Not impressed with the drinks here. The peach green tea lemonade tastes like water, but for $4.05. But the air conditioning and wifi were fine so I'd recommend it as a study spot. Next time I'll stick to black coffee though.

I am not one for chain coffee places, but as far as Starbucks goes, this is one of the best. It has an intimate atmosphere and is located in a very artsy shopping block. Unfortunately, it is almost always too busy and even in the heart of a weekday afternoon it can be difficult to find a seat.

Located on the ground floor of the Matrix Hotel in kind of an off-the-beaten-path area of downtown Edmonton, this Starbucks location is a total Jekyll and Hyde, with two distinct faces. By day, the baristas are constantly trying to defeat an unending lineup that snakes through the entire store, providing what must be the occupants of every cubicle in a four-block radius, via skinny vanilla lattes and venti bolds, enough caffeine to power the Legislature, Alberta Blue Cross, and the rest of the nearby institutions through another 9-5. But by night and weekend, this shop is like a graveyard. Quiet and empty, it's an excellent place to sit and read, study, or pick up a coffee before a walk through the nearby Legislature grounds.
Staff is friendly and fast, and I heard a great deal about a Russian lady's soy allergy and the ramifications of soy consumption on her body!

Pretty fast and friendly service but they run out of bagels pretty quickly so get them early on if you want one (usually gone by lunch). There is also a drive thru and the seating inside looks relatively spacious and comfortable, with plenty of outlets and tables, although I usually grab my Americano and go.  Otherwise, this is your typical Starbucks, but it is the only one in the Bristol/Bensalem area besides the kiosk in the Barnes and Noble in Neshaminy so it serves its purpose well.  It's located right across Horizon blvd. from Chipotle so I can get my caffeine and burrito fix in one fell swoop right before I get on Rt. 1 to head to Princeton or the turnpike to head home.
