Nice little satrbucks in Carpinteria.  the staff is friendly and they make it a point to remember your name and what you ususally drink

These guys are like superheros with green aprons and a friendly hello! Excellent service excellent at fixing the drink and not making you feel bad about it when the they might have sweetened your iced passion tea instead not sweetener! You guys are good! 

This is my day off Starbucks where I like to budget and plan for the week! Fun businessy environment! 

Drive through is busy during lunch!

This was THE most painfully slowest line ever.  This location is in the largest Mall so you would think that the management for this location would plan accordingly.  No, they do not.  Management here plans for rural America locations.  

After waiting in line and placing an order for a London Fog I received a very piss poor version of a watered down undrinkable slurp.  Due to the long line I didn't even want to ask for my drink to be remade properly.  

All around this location is joke.

The coffee here is consistently awful and just not up to the standard of other Starbucks. I always get a brewed coffee and it tastes burnt and bitter every time. I can't imagine what the espresso drinks taste like that aren't loaded with milk and sugar. Also it has a tiny cramped parking lot that makes it difficult to get in and out of parking spots due to the drive thru line.

Wish they had a drive thru. I know space is limited over their but im sure theirs plenty vaccant  buildings on that road. Parking lots are usually crazy busy but the Service is always good and drinks are great. Will go here again.

This location is hell to get in and out of. The drive thru line often extends into the right lane of northbound Brentwood and because of the small parking lot don't even try to park and walk in to the store. You'll be stuck trying to get out of your parking spot. Also, the entrance from Brentwood is narrow enough to cause an issue if someone is trying to pull out at the same time someones exited the drive thru and is trying to get onto Brentwood at the same time. 

However, the staff here are genuinely friendly and quick to get you on your way. Just beware of getting in and out, it's an accident waiting to happen.
Love Starbucks! Nice out door seating. Today was fast and service was very friendly. Nice place to come relax with a cup of joe or meet up with friends for nice quiet conversations.

Stopped in for a quick coffee. Parking was easily located, almost right in front of the building. 

This location is well staffed. I counted at least four baristas &/or attendants. Our service was swift & greetings/interaction with the staff was pleasant. 

Customers were streaming in and out during our visit as others just enjoyed the environment while people watching, conversing with one another, and attending to the daily emails and/or reviews 

I will be back.

One star because the parking lot here is terrible. It's that bad. Traffic from the drive-thru line backs uo out onto Brentwood Blvd. When this happens, which is frequently, it's extremely difficult for cars exiting the drive-thru to leave. Nearly impossible to get one of the very few parking spaces that they have, and overall just a mess. This place was planned extremely poorly.

We headed here one morning from the hotel for breakfast because our hotel says they have free WiFi.  They do not (only Boingo) but not a reason to not like this Starbucks.  

Drinks were solid.  The breakfast food was normal.  They were pretty busy for post 8 am.  It provided a nice place to get some work done.

Amazing strawberry banana soy smoothie.  Since I actually watch what they put into the smoothie, I know that they put in real fruit and the ingredients are fresh.  It's really filling and is just delicious.

The wait staff is by far the most efficient I have ever seen at any Starbucks.  They are friendly, too.  I enjoy the visits I have here for that very reason.

There are way too many people in there sitting and taking up space, however.  Whether people are taking up sitting space with bags and laptops/ipads for hours on end without leaving.  If the Starbucks were bigger, I could understand more, but the cafe is a) fairly small and b) has a steady flow of traffic.  30 minutes to an hour?  Have at it.  After that, get off your butt and go to a library or somewhere appropriate for your attention getting tactics.  Sorry, but there.  I said it.  Ever heard of a library?  There is one a hop, skip, and jump away.  Usually people are at least talking audibly, the hot coffee drinks do get cold just as the cold drinks get lukewarm, and the place does close eventually.  

That is no fault of the Starbucks, so I will not lower the stars.  But ugh, people.  Ugh, I tell you.  Let everyone have a seat to enjoy their frothy beverage.

was thirsty and tired and decided to stop by the starbucks by my house. it's a pretty tiny starbucks and has seating for no more than 15 patrons. tried their new dark cherry mocha frappuccino. it was pretty good and expected. prob a tad sweet for a mocha for my taste buds. drinks were made pretty quickly but nothing too special about this location. it's a good place to wait If you're waiting to get seated at the bonefish grille next door. don't come here at night around dinner time because they get pretty packed. it's not busy around lunch till the afternoon though...

I noticed some small tables with umbrellas for outdoor seating which bumped the 3 stars to a 4!  good job umbrellas!!!!

For a Starbucks these guys are awesome!

I was in town with 20+ friends for BLFC the Furry Con and man was it insane! Like lines of 50 people each morning trying to get caffeine to make up for the fact they were dancing till 5am (myself included). The crew was fast, friendly, and didn't flinch when my friends started barking. They even drew a paw print on my coffee cup! Super cool.
This is prob the best Starbucks around...it has the friendliest people working there.  Patrick is one of the nicest baristas I've ever met.
I enjoy that it's right next to my house but they are a little slower than other Starbucks, still friendly but always so busy...which I guess isn't a bad thing!

After a disastrous cup of coffee at the restaurant in the hotel - I headed into town for some "real" coffee. I was looking for either a Sheetz, 7-11, Dunkin' Donuts, or a Starbucks - as I knew the coffee would be quality at any of those places.

First place I bopped into was a Starbucks! Even had a Dunkin' Donuts next door!

This Sbux has a peculiar look to it - it looks like it used to be some other sort of small local restaurant - the architecture does not look like a building that Starbucks would design (see the attached pix).

In any case, I got a Grande coffee with room for cream - I believe it was a "Pike's Place." Service was efficient! Great flavor and good coffee. All was then right with the world!

A staid sterile starbucks. Analogy: Holiday Inn. Starbucks and Holiday Inns are both known quantities: staid decent chains in which you know you won't get bad product and you know you will get predictable uninspiring ambiance.

Starbucks has been my favorite coffee place since its first invention. I love this store and it is probably my favorite one though I've never hit a bad Starbucks. Try it if you love Starbucks coffee, and I promise you that you will not be disappointed!

I used to love going to this starbucks on the way to work but unfortunately the new girl ruined it for me entirely. I order the same drink every single day, a grande iced caramel latte. The new girl made it hot and not to be rude but I cannot drink the steamed milk-it makes me stomach sick all day. So even in the coldest of winters I order an iced drink. I said I ordered it iced can you make an iced one please? She looked at me and another girl-who I had never seen there said sure no problem. She must have taken the hot caramel latte and put it on ice because I have been feeling sick all day. What kind of service is that? I would think when I pay $5 for a latte it should be what won't make me sick. NEVER going back. Watch how they make your drink carefully, absolutely awful!

I've had the coffee-est of coffees... I don't haha it's Starbucks. Plenty of chairs to find a spot. Only time I'm here is to do interviews. Always have friendly employees. Can't think of a bad experience there that's forsure. Anyways just go get a coffee here don't over think it huh! You probably have bigger things to worry about rather then if this is going to be the place to get your morning coffee

I like Starbucks, and I love this location. Unfortunately the concept here is dragging its feet.  This is my Starbucks go-to, due to its convenience for me.  I was elated when it opened, and it deserves a trophy for often waking me up in the morning with its dark roast selections. Situated in the beautiful Matrix hotel, with its clean lined design and wrap around windows this coffeehouse has so much potential, in fact it could easily be the best Starbucks in Edmonton, if not one of the best in the entire Starbucks chain.... but only if it manages to fix itself. In the 6 years it has been open, the quality of service as well as the consistency of the beverages and the food have been steadily nosediving.  It's a staffing problem.  Though every barista behind the counter is exceptionally kind, friendly, and greets each patron with a genuine smile, the dizzying turn over of (evidently unexperienced) staff creates painfully slow service, and beverage and food inconsistencies. I feel for the management faced with this problem, and hope they can find, train, and retain the level of experienced staff that is required for such a high volume location. Again, this spot has so much potential, they have just completed a new Reno that seems to have tripled their seating, and this is THE place in Edmonton for celebrity sightings... from international recording artists, to big name Hollywood actors, the Matrix is where they all stay while passing through town on projects.  And this is where they grab their Starbucks coffee.

such great service! such good looking and fun, funny employees! the service was excellent, they love to make conversation. i had an employee talk to me on his lunch break and it was so nice to hear his story. i'd recommend this starbucks as a passerby or as a local!

This is the Starbucks I go to when I'm in the Brentwood area due to convenience to my part time job. I kind of dread coming here due to only being able to pull in going north on Brentwood Blvd, the tiny entrance making it tight for one car to pull out when another pulls in, the small parking lot, and tight drive thru I've scratched my rims on. My husband dropped me off before getting gas since we had to go there from the south side by pulling onto the side street making it impossible for him to turn his large truck around to get into their small drive thru.

I ordered a very 'basic' pumpkin scone and iced nonfat pumpkin spice latte (blame the maternity leave and comfort eating) while getting an espresso macchiato for my husband. The scone was delicious as always but I have to be a little critical of the drinks due to me being a barista for five years. My iced latte had syrup all in the bottom which is a pet peeve of mine since syrup cannot be blended once the drink is iced down making it a sugary shock to your tastebuds. Espresso macchiatos seem simple but need a little TLC. There is nothing worse than being handed one that feels heavy before you even taste it. The barista was very busy and left the milk to steam by itself instead taking care to make a nice foam for my macchiato. However, there were two people working the drive thru window that were gossiping while she was busy making drinks. There definitely seems to be more efficient ways to use the staff to make sure the drinks are more timely and made correctly. It's no secret that Starbucks drinks are pricey so it's important that they have the quality to match the taste. I will continue to go to this Starbucks when convenient but my home store is on Grand and Magnolia.

Four stars for Starbucks!

Three stars for LOCATION...


Good news is... They always get my order right and are friendly enough!

Bad news... Their SUPER SLOW. Legit you'll be in the drive thru for 15 minutes.

I don't mind much as long as my order isn't messed up which it never is so I'm satisfied enough :)

Perfect "last chance"  yummy coffee stop before dragging through security and  boarding your flight. Or the perfect pick me up after arrival or while waiting to pick someone up.  The Baristas are speedy and very nice.

I like this Starbucks, mostly because it's the closest one to my apartment. Quiet, easy to get to, staff generally pretty quick when it comes to making drink orders. If you like Starbucks, this one is good. Nothing great, but nothing any worse than average.

Typical Starbucks, nice location and nice enough staff. 
Drinks are overpriced so I don't come here often but I love the passion fruit lemonade.
Quick, friendly and efficient, what's not to like?

I am a huge Starbucks fan and was thrilled to see that this one was built right between my gym and my home! I went to get coffee the first day they were open and have been back several times since. I was disappointed on my first visit to discover that the employees were not as friendly as all the other Starbucks that I have been to. I decided to give them the benefit of the doubt since they had just opened and were possibly unfamiliar with the store. Unfortunately, this unfriendliness has not changed on any of my return visits. Until now, the quality of the coffee was just as good as any Starbucks so I just overlooked the unfriendliness, but today something happened that forced me to write this review. 

Today I ordered a latte Macchiato with an extra shot. I told the cashier my name, she wrote it on the cup, and I went to wait for my drink. Christin the barista, called my name when it was ready and announced my drink but it was not what I ordered. I politely asked, "what did you say"? She did not reply, and my partner said he couldn't hear her either. I leaned in and asked again politely "excuse me Miss, what did you say?" She looked at me and impatiently and said the name of the drink again which I still did not understand. I smiled and said "well that's my name but that's not what I ordered". To which she replied petulantly "well then I guess it's not yours". She then condescendingly proceeded to explain to me the difference between what I had ordered and what she had made. So I replied again politely "well you can understand my confusion since that is my name and there's no one else here waiting". She snapped "yes of course". 

Nothing else was said, she went about her business, and then after about two minutes took the mistake drink and threw it away. In reality, she had made an error and was making me a new drink. Shortly after, she gave me the correct drink and said barked "here you go"

I'm not sure why, but for some reason the management of this Starbucks tolerates unfriendliness and bad service. This Starbucks is conveniently located for me so I will continue to go there, but I will recommend that you be ready to be treated poorly when you get your coffee.

I also do not understand the negative reviews for this starbucks. It really just is a typical starbucks. Starbucks may not be my favorite coffee shop, but in comparison to the chain's other locations there is nothing wrong with this particular one. This starbucks has plenty of seating and is definitely big enough, it just happens to be crowded a lot as it is in the middle of suburban square, which is a busy place. The line is typically long, but has always moved quickly and my drinks have been good. Employees are friendly. No complaints here.

Love this SB location. My favorite part is seeing my baristas and getting my happy greetings from them! Love Michelle, Nick, Brady, Hailey and several others. I hate that I can't recall all their names. My drinks are always made quickly and accurately!!

Nice, clean and nice size Starbucks! Plenty of seating inside and out! Always a decent crowd. Plenty of parking with a short walk to the doors. This is one of my preferred Starbucks and when in that area I like to stop for a drink and that's where they lose that last star!! I wanted to try the new nitro cold brew and for a grande with a mummy cake pop for my daughter...$7.10!!!!! Seriously???!!! So I believe that put the nitro in the $5 something range!!!!! It was good but definitely won't be buying another one anytime soon!!!!
Worst Starbucks experience. The baristas here need to find a job in something other than customer service.

I know there is an explanation to why on a Saturday at the busiest time .. you Have lines of people out the door and there are one person at the register and 2 on bar , please please please .. either hire more people or re build this store so it can take the volume .. 

Employees seem to be just moving at their own pace and customers are patiently waiting .. 

No riots over coffee here...

These guys are on it! Fast,friendly, helpful, even SMILING baristas. Their super busy but work with a much appreciated Zin calm. Tried new Skinny Hazelnut Macchiato...excellent. Carmel version also offered. Smaller store with few tables indoor and couldn't get table even in late afternoon. Outdoor setting should help once warm weather hits.

One of my favorite starbucks to go to when I get a chance. They always remember me and my drink. They make it perfect with a hint of love.  It's perfect location makes it easy to grab on your way into target and out to go shopping. There is no better way to spend your then drinking a Starbucks while shopping and looking around. The only issue I ran into is a new lady working there gave me a hard time about a birthday coupon and she got really sarcastic and rude and didn't even say happy birthday or try to make the situation better. The worst experience I had. Other then that everyone else is lovely. Also sometimes I feel they are short staffed, most the time I only see one person up front.

Of all the Starbucks in the surrounding area I think this one generally has the most attentive and friendly staff, despite the fact that they're overburdened with customers at times.  It's usually a pleasure stopping in here. I don't know why so many people use the drive thru. It's a far nicer experience when you get out of the darn car and actually talk to people face to face.
I often drove through and every single time the lid was loose, and coffee ended up all over. The quality of the coffee is bad and lack of consistency. I will never come back!

I come through the drive-thru every morning for my trenta iced coffee double expresso. Matt is generally at this window. He is so nice, smiling and helps start my morning out right. I am moving to Alaska and will miss the morning Starbucks crew which have always made me smile.

7/25/17
Came back a little over a year later. Same location, same time, much improved experience. Service was great.

6/9/16
The Gate A location... literally the slowest Starbucks I've ever seen... literally. It took longer to get coffee from that Starbucks at 5:30 AM than it did to get through TSA. Did you get that? It took longer for their "baristas" to make espresso than it did for the federal government to make sure I wasn't bringing a bomb on the plane.

Wow- I'm no Starbucks expert, but they're usually nice. This one is gross. For starters, upon entering, at least 7 employees were buzzing around, but no one was taking orders. The woman who finally assisted me was very nice & helpful. Drink was fine. 
I needed a space for some computer work. Had to put napkins down as a barrier between my computer and the table. The bench to sit on is completely broken, dented in, and uncomfortable. Only use the bathroom if you are wearing a hazmat suit. I would definitely not recommend this place unless you use the drive-through.
Went there and 1 oven was broke so it took awhile to get my sandwich. Then they forgot to give me the cake pops that I ordered. Was a little disappointed

We were visiting our home away from home, Tampa, FL and decided we wanted some baked goods to eat while in our hotel room. We don't normally consume goods from Starbucks, but it was all that was open around the hotel we were at. 

We got a cheese danish, a coffee brownie, a lemon bar, and a chocolate chip cookie. Everything was average- which isn't too bad considering this is a mass producing franchise that doesn't care for customer quality for the most part.

Overall, an average experience for an average establishment.

Worst Starbucks I've ever been to!  They can't seem to get an order right!  I am a regular (I know, stop going if it's so bad) since it is the closest Starbucks to my job.  At least 50% of the time my order is made wrong.  It's not a hard order - Peach Green Team Lemonade.  It's on the menu.  Maybe they should hire some people who can read what the order actually is!

This Starbucks by far is the best around. They always get my order correct. Sean and Alex are two of the best barista's I have ever seen!!  They always go above and beyond at this Starbucks! Just want to say thanks!!

Save your time and energy and drive to Sunset Hills, Crestwood, Rock Hill, or even inside Target. This is always the WORST Starbucks! Not to mention how small is it, with no drive through. Besides that, the service has always been the worst! 
I go there MAYBE 2x a year, because I go next door for my glasses. Otherwise I avoid it at all costs! 
For instance, spent $6.06 on my Venti Iced vanilla latte with almond milk today (which I get everyday)... he made it COMPLETELY wrong. It was dark, made with iced coffee instead of a latte, and I told him it was wrong and tasted bad. Him AND the manager looked at me crazy. She said we can add more almond milk... so he added more almond milk to it and wouldn't just remake the drink they made wrong in the first place! I just left, because I did t want to cause a scene. I walked there today, because we live close and I still try and avoid this location! Do. Not. Waste. Your. Money. There!

Yesterday I went in to this location and Morgan was an absolute angel! I accidentally ordered the wrong item on my mobile app and she happily remain my  Order! Thank you so much Morgan! Out standing customer service!!!!

Great staff and this place SAVED me with the wifi. I stayed at the Sheraton down the street which has awful internet service.  

Great Staff + Fantastic Coffee + Reliable Wifi = Phenomenal

I'm not a big "chain" person but I continue to adore my Starbucks!
It's a star bucks what can I say yummy. When we went to this one they were very friendly and there is some out side seating

Nothing too spectacular about this Starbucks. 

However, this Starbucks ALWAYS has a line, a long line and a long wait. By the time you get your coffee, you probably have lost your craving for it.
Relatively roomy Starbucks with a fairly decent parking. Nice to see in the neighborhood!

I come here almost daily and enjoy my very consistent iced chai tea latte!  With that ring said, most-to-all the staff is very friendly.  The only negative thing I can say about this specific location is the dining area is almost always dirty and the trash is always full to the point things are sticking out.  I can only blame this on small amount of staff on.

I come to this Starbucks every day and they're always very nice. I work down the street so I place a mobile order and it's usually correct and everything is ok.

Tip: every other Starbucks has a sign or a bin that says "mobile order pickup" and they don't. After 2 months I still stand there for a while waiting or they hand me one thing and forget to give me the other so I wait for that.

Typically everything is great but since I order through mobile and leave with it, I have gotten back to my office to find that they didn't warm something or they gave me cream instead of coconut milk. I don't have the opportunity to say anything after I've left so I would just ask that you pay closer attention to each order. A bad coffee can ruin someone's day when they don't have time to take lunch.

This Starbucks is by far my favorite in University City. It's not usually over crowded like the one on 34th & Walnut, and the baristas are sweet and haven't messed up an order yet. If there is a deal or promotion, they make sure to let you know about it to get the most on what you are spending for your coffee.

This is a nice Starbucks! I've never been to a location that I hated, but this one is consistently calming, warm, and cozy to work at - or to have a coffee and hang out with friends.

I always enjoy the friendliness of the baristas at this location. One time, one of them even offered to watch me to my car at night just to ensure my safety. (Don't worry - It was truly, simply a nice gesture.)

Coffee = good. Food = good. Cleanliness = good. Wi-fi = good. 

I'll be back!

The line can be REALLY long in the drive through.. going inside seems to be punishment for not waiting in the drive through! I tried that once and they filled 5 drive-through orders for every body inside it seemed! Drinks are always yummy though!
They make great mochas here! It's not all gross because it's inside a casino either, it's kept clean and the wait wasn't too long in line.

We came to this Starbucks on our way to Bed Bath and Beyond in the same plaza and noticed it had a drive through! At first we wanted to use the drive through, but the line was too long, so we ended up parking and going inside. The inside was nothing special, but it was clean and the baristas were friendly. We ended up ordering an iced tea lemonade (not in the mood for coffee that day) and the order came up fairly quick.

Next time I go, I'm going to try the drive through!
Horrible horrible horrible customer service. This location is more worried about pushing customers in and out that they don't care about customer service.

As Starbucks go this one is pretty small, and although the staff is very nice here, the lines are often too long and frankly, it's just a Starbucks and there are other choices not far away. the parking lot is very small and the drive thru makes the entire retail experience a bad one.

Bad service and lazy employees, if you go at night you always have to wait at least 5 minutes till someone notice you....employees always on the kitchen spacially at night chatting and carless....if the drive thru person sees you, won't service you and u have to wait till the front desk employee show up.
Starbucks should be the same anywhere you go, except this branch use all bad beans or wierd flavors one...

I don't nno if the manager knows about the night shift but, it's pritty bad.

1 star is even to much for this location

Starbucks-- Probably every location would get eaten alive on Yelp. Everyone wants to pretend they don't like it and everyone feels guilty for going there. 

As other people said, it brings comfort to the people who are afraid of things. They say ooooh Starbucks, this place must be okay. It's special like that. 

While I would prefer to go to a 'real' coffee house, I now have a child who strongly dislikes getting in and out of the car for no reason and the drive through where I can use an app that is connected to my debit card to pay is well, really freaking nice. 

My current issue with Starbucks (and specifically this location) follows:
1. Get highchairs. More than one preferred but one is just required. (this is not the only location that doesn't have highchairs and I'm sure A LOT of your business is from moms. Get with the program *yeah I said that*) 

2. Get a changing table in your bathroom. I'm sure it doesn't cost much and since everyone is paying $4 and up for their latte, I think you'll survive. You know who won't survive? Me. If I have to change another diaper on my fabric car seat which just happens to be kinda small because I drive a compact car. Have you ever wrestled a 19 pound fish?

This is my usual go to Starbucks that's located close to home.  The location is large and spacious and has a great outdoor area.  The drive through lane can get taxing at times, so pack your patience.  The staff is generally very jovial and upbeat, which makes a stop here that much more pleasant.
Lovely Starbucks. Staff was friendly and fast. My coffee was good. Lots of sitting :)

I just wanted to say THANK YOU for mobile ordering. An introverted otaku's dream. Still one of my favorite locations to grab a grande drip or my seasonal fave Chestnut Praline Chai Tea Latte (say that 5x in a row).

Just a convenient place to get "STARBUCKS" because its just there!  It's a good and bad thing to this, just like any other Starbucks, some just don't have the same consistency to drinks.  I ordered a drip coffee and it seem like its been sitting a while like some other people said in the reviews.  I asked if they changed the coffee and they told me yes we have and it just tasted off a bit.

The lines can get long sometimes especially in the morning, afternoons and night time.

Overall its Starbucks, it'll do its job, sometimes might taste slighty off and just ask them to remake it.

*parking*

outside of GSR hotel casino & resort

cash / credit
SIDNEY is absolutely RUDE!  she was the barista on the 16th of february!  im surprised sbux has a staff member who probably hates her job and shows it to customers!

Bought Starbucks deal on Verisomo Pods. Buy 3 and get 20% off. I bought 4 and they would not honor 20% off the 4th box. They claim I had to buy 6 to get 20% off the 4th box. What a stupid rule, this will be my last purchase of Starbucks Pods.
Great seating options for studying, including some outdoor seats. Fast service; I did not wait very long for my coffee. I like this Starbucks and would come back again.

SCAM ALERT!

I go to about 30 different Starbucks stores and every time I order here I never pay attention until I finally asked for my receipt. They advertise ice coffee Caramell or vanilla for $2.65 until you get the receipt and it says .50 cent for added shots.
Number one,I never asked to "add"anything I simply asked for the drink that's displayed on their menu.

When asked why are you charging me for added shots when I didn't ask for any change your menu says in black-and-white it's $2.65 Caramell or vanilla which I asked for Caramell.

She tells me the GM came in there and made sure that they did that from this point on.. 

When asked where is my added him she said you got 14. Seven shots of Caramell in seven shots of sugar. Really?!? 

And where in my order did I say "add"anything??



it's not about the $.50 not even if it was $.5 this is a scam they need to make people aware of before they go charging them. If you check my yelp reviews I actually leave nothing but good stuff on there it took a lot for me to even write this and I hope somebody takes heed to this review because it's unfair to charge someone something without telling them for one and then to false advertise on the menu.

Crooks!
Top Notch people here polite kind fast!!!! I have had great experiences here!!

The coffee is good but the service at this location is always horrible. The staff looks dazed and confused especially if you ask for something like more half and half since the container is empty. No reason to wait 5 minutes for a cup of decaf, gave up on getting cream. I could understand if this place were busy.

I've never had such poor service in my entire life. I dread coming to this location, and the only reason I ever do is because the location closer to me never has multigrain bagels. This location REPORTS that they do on the mobile app. Yet every time I place an order for this location, they "run out" of what ever I ordered.  On top of the lack of accurate reporting on the mobile app, I have yet to receive a drink order that I haven't had to reorder. The baristas here must never read the label on the cup because my order is incorrect 99% of the time. Every time I complain to the baristas about my incorrect order, I never even receive so much as an apology. They usually just shrug their shoulders and offer me something else that's not compatible. The only time I've ever received any kind of sympathy or compensation from a barista was today. After I've been coming to this location for over a year, today was the first time anybody ever did anything to reconcile the mishaps that occur here. Again I placed mobile order because their location reported to have what I wanted, but yet again once I arrived at the location, they were out of whatever I ordered. Shocking. After I made it aware that I was not happy, a barista, I believe his name is Chris, approached a manager on his own will and asked that my order be refunded. Chris, I will give you a 5 star customer service rating. But the other employees at this location, need to go back to barista training. Actually, they might even benefit from learning what customer service actually is. Thank you, Chris. You're the only salvation this location has.

This is has to be one of their best locations. Exceptional service. A few years ago I requested donations for my daughters PTA fundraiser and was able speak to a supervisor with out a problem. 
Employees recognize public service workers with discounts or beverages.

Love this place usually fast and spunky awesome employees who you can tell for the most they part enjoy their jobs and have passion for what they do. Always happy to give a puppicino to my puppy (other locations I've gotten attitude for asking ) and their happiness is contagious which is refreshing. My everyday drink is a Trenti 1/2 strawberry acai refresher, 1/2 green tea and light ice. They do it right every time !
It's a Starbucks in kop what do you expect ... I like the one on gateway shopping center but that's me. Love the mobile app,

So sad to be giving a Starbucks 2 stars but after visiting this place 4 days in a row it's a pretty accurate rating.

I came to this Starbucks daily during my vacation in Tennessee because it was literally across the street from my hotel and it was nice to walk to get my morning coffee. However, every single time I went I waited at least 25 minutes to get my drink. That's ridiculous.

It doesn't matter if you come in the morning because the line and waiting time will be ridiculous. It doesn't matter if you order it through the app, because you have to wait till they help everyone in line first. It doesn't matter if you come during the day because somehow they still take forever.

If it wasn't because I have a Starbucks problem or because it was so close to my hotel I wouldn't be coming here after 2 visits. Ever. And if you're a local, stay away. Find another one or go to Dunkin'!

This store is awesome. The manager, Bennie, is the man! 
The unfortunate part of this store is it gets SLAMMED in the morning and at lunch being in the business location that it is, so be patient. But they kill it.

I've been here multiple times and what I've noticed is that there's always limited seating. I was there for over an hour and there was a large table with four seats next to us that had one open laptop and a large stack of files- unattended! I never saw anyone sit there the whole time I was there. This is a very small Starbucks and if you wanted to sit inside to relax or get things done it can get quite loud and chaotic. As a warning there are always lots of middle schoolers after school hours because they can walk to this one. I've never had a problem with my drinks here but the seating arrangement and policy could be improved.
My go to Starbucks in Tampa! The staff is always friendly and accommodating even when it gets overwhelmingly busy.

Oh man, it was way too early in the morning when I rolled in here to take a picture while driving back from Las Vegas to Portland. It's a pretty standard Starbucks with a drive-through window that gives the standard Starbucks fare. It is exactly like any of the other million Starbucks across the United States although the staff was slightly friendlier than usual. Certainly more friendly than they had any reason to be at such a god-awful early time in the morning. Anyway the coffee is fine.

The only other piece of information to note of interest is that if you're coming off of the freeway to this Starbucks, you will not be able to directly get back on the road toward the freeway. You will need to exit from the shopping center it is in and make a U-turn regardless of which exit you take.
Great people here!  They always remember me and what I order.  Super nice and friendly, every time.

I always seriously enjoy Starbucks, but this Starbucks has been a complete let down all 6 times I've visited! The staff is incredibly rude and they consistently make drinks improperly, then make it seem like you're being a "problem" for having hem remake it. 
I have called corporate on this Starbucks after my 3rd disappointment, and just chose to try it again a few more times, and each time... disappointed. Get it together south Tampa!

I've been to this Starbucks many times, and I've never had a good experience. There are certain things that I know are out of the control of the baristas, such as:

1. Only one employee working at a time, therefore he/she works both the register and as a barista. With a long line, or even just a line of 2-3 people, this can take up to 20 minutes. 
2. Running out of ingredients/the blenders breaking - both of these happened on my most recent visit. 
3. They don't accept birthday rewards (the free drink you get on your birthday as a Gold Card member). 

What IS, however, in the control of the baristas is the quality of the beverages and their attitudes. It's just impossible for them to get a drink right. Even the most common and the most simple of drinks (i.e. Caramel Macchiato, vanilla latte, etc.) are always so way off, that I end up just throwing it away... and that's after having them re-make it. 


Yeah, if you can get to an actual Starbucks, don't waste your time here.
Cheers to this Starbucks in Yardley. Its easy to get in and out. They don't obstruct the lines with lots of nonsense on the floor like many Starbucks locations do.

Not the cleanest, newest but the staff makes up for it all 
After a  long work day, they were patient with my burned out brain. Simplified my life. 

Went beyond and gave me caramel for my Apple in their snack packs. 

Thank you!

Pretty much exactly what you would expect from a Starbucks. Quick service, super friendly. There's a ton of extra seating in the back, which is so nice. Very clean inside and out, bathrooms also super clean. Whether you just want a quick drink or snack, or you want to sit and stay awhile, this is your place.
worst starbucks ever. theyre always out of everything and the drive thru is always SO. SLOW. This starbucks is the closest to me if it wasnt I wouldn't come back.

Love this Starbucks, only visited twice, but I was only there a short weekend. Great location, just a short walk from the Epicurean hotel. Epic place to meet new people and pets. Very friendly patrons as well as employees at the location. The barista was very nice and understanding as I geeked out at finally finding the special Metallica Starbucks card. I told her that it figures I had to come to Tampa to find these cards. Side note I had searched for them in Phoenix and had NO success. She was also nice as I explained I had to load the card to my app before I ordered. Very patient barista! 
Ok once I gained composure back and was able to order my drink, which I don't think they get many orders for, skinny hot chocolate no foam, she passed the order on to another friendly and happy barista. My drink was made to my liking. We sat a while at this location while we planned the day. It was also a nice quiet spot to hail an uber and wait.

A Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks.  There's a reason these places are so popular, and it's not because they each exhibit a sense of individuality.  Walk into a Starbucks on the south side, like this one, and your experience will most likely be the same as walking into one on the west end or north side.

I rather like the feeling; when I'm going for coffee, I want to be able to relax in a comfortable, familiar setting.

I'm also currently addicted to these places, since they brought back the holiday special beverages.  Yum!

Unfortunately, this one isn't all that great for people watching, as it's right in the middle of a shopping mall parking lot.  Ah, well - can't win them all.

Every time I go to this location for a Starbucks the service is always horrible . There's always a long line and extremely slow service . I'd ordered iced coffee on two occasions and both times my coffee always tasted bad . Always ending up wasting money and throwing my coffee out . I know Starbucks offered a thing where they'll make your coffee again if you're not satisfied but why wait in line again and hoping for a better coffee when it already tasted bad . In my opinion , coffee doesn't always taste the same wherever you go , it all depends on who's making it .

I can always rely on them to get me my caffeine fix. The Baristas are always courteous,friendly, and go out of they're way for the customer on a regular basis. Even when it gets crowded, the baristas keep the line moving. The muffins are also made fresh everyday.

I often stop by here when I am at work as they are only a block away. The baristas know me by name but I never really order the same drinks 2 days in a row. Like to keep them guessing. LOL. They have pretty good with service and try to be efficient and get people through. I love their patios in the summer time and actually it's probably my favorite patio for a coffee shop in the city.

Worst Starbucks I've ever been to. About 30-50 middle school children running wild on a Friday afternoon. Was unable to get any work done and left after 20 mins. Couldn't even get a drink because the line keep getting longer with gaggles of children
Coffee was fine here this morning. We also got breakfast sandwiches, a scone, and an old fashioned donut.  A nice Starbucks breakfast before hitting the road to come home.

Came in for a coffee before my 6:15am departure... You would think this time of day would be their bread and butter, and that the employees would be on the their A-game... But alas. 

The service was only okay. Drink orders were taken very quickly and finished drinks were coming out in rapid succession, but there was not a single smile in the whole place. The young woman who took my order acted annoyed to talk to me. She gave me room when I asked for no room, so I had to send her back to the drip coffee for a top off. That made her more annoyed.

I'm glad I stopped by because the food and coffee were satisfying once made, but it was disappointing that getting them wasn't the usual friendly Starbucks visit.

Stopped in to get a coffee after a canceled meeting.  Figured I'd grab a gift card while I was there.   Ordered a dark roast coffee and paid for my gift card.   Stood and waited, and waited, and waited.   It's a dark roast coffee that's already brewed.  Nothing needed to be made.   Watched over 20 people get their orders.    Could not even get any staff's attention to let them know.   Left an unhappy customer and will not be going back.   Another negative Starbucks experience
Though plenty of staff, few waiting on customers so very slow and rather surly service. They do not actually stock items listed on their menu board.

Starbucks is a known entity. That said, this isn't one of the better ones. It's too small for the number of patrons and needs a more regular cleaning.

There must have been 25 coffee drinkers packed into this Starbucks this morning. The order line was pinched between the pastry counter and a rack of stuff to buy (mugs, packaged coffee, etc). There weren't enough seats, and the floor needed a sweeping. 

Corporate should move this to a larger location. This one is showing its age.
Apparently food is only delivered every other day and this location seems to never have chicken caprese or turkey basil pesto paninis.  Tried for a couple days now and I give up.
Got to the store 7:55pm - realize only 5 minutes to close, but the Barista told me they could only make me a cappuccino because they were "out of coffee".

This was a perfectly typical Starbucks, like 100's of others. They provided me the caffeine jolt I so desperately needed and sent me on my way, buzzing around like a fly on meth. Ok, it wasn't that exciting but it hit the spot!

Reminded me why I never go to this location.  Was ignored by staff so they could talk to co workers.  They actually told me I would have to wait until they could finish their conversation.  The girls behind the counter were talking so loud to each other the entire 2 hours I was there that multiple people commented about it and left.  They were literally screaming about gossip.  Totally unprofessional and distracting.  Serves me right for even coming here.

Quite possibly the worst parking lot design in the western world.  As a result, it's a great place to stop during non-peak times, but not worth the hassle on a busy morning.

On the morning where I have toughed it out, the staff is nice - almost too much so as I feel like it slows the service.  Given the physical constraints of the parking lot and building, that's not a luxury they can afford.

Am I invisible? Seems like every time I come to this Starbucks, I stand at the counter and no one acknowledges me. Each time I'm here, there are at least 5 employees. Most every other Starbucks I walk into, one or more employees say, "hello" to me as I walk in and tell me they'll be right with me. Not here. Arnold Starbucks needs to have an employee meeting about friendliness....

8am mobile ordered that was prepared promptly! That's incredible considering my order & how busy they were.

I ordered something in error & they happily corrected my mistake & no cost. 

Great staff & very pleasant!!!!

Items ordered:
2 cheese danishes
One banana nut bread
Grande white chocolate mocha 
Tall americano

This particular Starbucks location really gets the job done and pushes their customers through with ease. Ordered a cinnamon chai tea latte, it was on point and tasted delicious. Major knock on this place is if your ordering inside, parking can be tough because the lot is small and the drive thru traffic makes it difficult for you to pull out. Aside from that, solid location. 

Pros-
Drinks
Service 
Taste 
Cleanliness

Cons-
Parking 
Crowded 
Drive thru traffic
Awesome and quick service! Whoever Snow White was on Halloween was so friendly and had lots of jokes! Store was clean and food was great

Josh made my experience great such a friendly upbeat person in your business goes a long way I got the most amazing caramel macchiato with extra caramel and extra vanilla today and it was made with love will definitely be back thanks for a  wonderful experience ps thanks to whoever made the coffee the coffee was sooo great

This location has the best and most cheerful employee (I believe his name is Richard) I have ever encountered, and I go to Starbucks regularly wherever I go. If I could nominate a Starbucks Employee of the year, it would be him.

The location is spacious, and a quiet place to do work (thanks, free wifi). I don't feel rushed by employees to leave, even after monopolizing a table for almost 4 hours.

Clean, comfortable and welcoming! What else could you want from your local Starbucks?

I've only been to this location once (but will be coming here from now on), but I can already tell there are regulars that come to this Starbucks. Many of the customers greet one another; one guy even came to pick up his packed lunch that his wife had left for him behind the counter.

5 stars.
Quick, courteous, coffee was good.  Everything you can ask.  Most Starbucks are slow, not this one.  Great location, they keep u moving!

Brand new. Clean and airy facility. Nice employees, although slow and still learning. I've had my order messed up, my payment screwed up, and been charged for my "free" drink. I get it. Kinks need to be worked out, and since this store is in a plaza that caters more to drive thru customers than counter ones it is a good training ground. I'll check back since we have music lessons nearby.
This Starbucks is awesome! The baristas are fantastic and always are super friendly. I've gone through the drive thru several times on my way to work and they always brighten up my day.

While my drink was made well, and the baristas were friendly, Steven dropped some ice on the counter, picked it up with his hand, and put it back in my drink. That is a huge health violation and he should know better. Nice guy, but he shouldn't be putting dropped ice back into a cup, nor should be be touching anything with his bare hands and putting it in the cup.

This is a solid Starbucks, I just wish they were open past 8:30pm. 


Also, Yelp has a word limit, so I have to write some more to make sure this review is actually posted. It's a Starbucks people! They have coffee and tea, and magic microwaveable sandwiches that taste better than some fresh places.

On Oct 6 at about 3pm, sent my 12 year old daughter in to order a Frappuccino and a cake pop while I stood outside holding our small dog. Although the food was good, I'm giving it 2 stars because the staff had so much attitude when handling her order. I guess because she's young they can treat her like she is less than.  She asked if they had strawberry cake pops and they rudely told it it was only seasonal. Then she asked for a birthday cake pop and they told her they only had chocolate but with attitude like she was bothering them. Finally they filled other orders of people who came in after her and left her standing longer.

A great Starbucks in the town center and a welcome stop in the road trip between Santa Barbara and Los Angeles. There is sufficient parking available. Even for a busy location, the Starbucks is reasonably fast in delivering orders. The spelling is messed up as usual, so you get the authentic Starbucks feeling. The restroom was closed during our visit though.

I ordered a skinny mocha frap and a regular mocha frap and the barista made a big deal about it to where she actually said she couldnt deal with it because her lazy ass couldnt make two different fraps. First she made both fraps hot and then added whip cream too both even though i asked for no whip. That's when she got frustrated and had to pass to the other barista to make it.

They are very slow  even when they aren't busy and seem to mess up orders more often than othe SB I've been to. I keep thinking it's because the store is somewhat new but they've been there long enough to get the kinks worked out.

It's Starbucks.  There is no need to review my Caramel Apple Spice because you should have already tried it by now! This location seems like the only Starbucks on this side of town.  I pick my grandmother up from church in Irvington and I usually stop here on the way home. I have read in other reviews that the wait time can be pretty long, so Sunday afternoon is a blessing because I never have to wait.  I go to the drive through every time so as not to leave my granny alone.  We are in and out pretty quick and I am sipping my fave Starbucks drink in a couple minutes after it cools off a little :)
I enjoy that it's right next to my house but they are a little slower than other Starbucks, still friendly but always so busy...which I guess isn't a bad thing!

Drive-thru is perpetually slow, sometimes waiting 10 minutes plus. Not sure if they are understaffed or staff is just slow. Other Tampa Starbucks the staff is hustling during busy times. It's too bad because it's such a convenient location.

The last two weeks my drinks have been Luke warm every time at this location. Often they are very slow compared to other locations, and the baristas are not as friendly. But it's the most convenient location so that's why i continue to go there.
30 fing mins to get small iced coffee. The app said 5 mins! And they missed up my order. What a crazy world we live in!!

Decent for a quick place to grab a coffee. Staff are friendly. Over priced for quality of product, pastries come from the freezer. There are a few more local business in the area that offer a better coffee and snacks.
It's like a McDonald's, but coffee. Expect average American coffee and service and you'll be OK.
The new skinny mocha tastes like warm chocolate milk!! Don't waste your money!! Splurge on the regular.

Very cool, low-key easy in and out not crowded most mornings- plus all of the workers are great weekends are a lot busier but hey it' worth the wait not as many seats as I have seen at most, being that it's a community college across the street it could use a little more seating, very limited outside seating ( but great place to stop buy

I have never done this but I am finally over the arrogant, non helpful attitudes at this location.  A handful of good people work there but this is directed mostly at the "upity" little guy with brown shoulder length curly hair working this morning.  I asked him a question and as always, he responds with an attitude of why are you bothering me, I don't know anything.  I asked another employee and the attitude was better,  but nothing.  Three customers in line helped me.  The Starbucks employees need to remember customers who buy from them every single day.  Remember they make coffee and there job is CUSTOMER service.
Convenient, good coffee, a little bit expensive for the merchandise inside. But we will be returning to have more coffee.

Best Starbucks experience ever! Not sure if I'm spelling this right, but Diane was the nicest persons ever. We came through the drive through and she was so perky and friendly. I go to Starbucks everyday and this by far exceeded my expectation and made us smile

Its an average Starbucks location.  I think the best quality is the amount of outlets along the glass wall.  Maybe I'm spoiled but the staff at the location closer to my house is really friendly - the peeps here not so much.  Not that they are rude or anything, just not friendly.  The wifi kicks me out about every 15 minutes which is annoying.  They've recently rearranged the seating area to allow for more space but it feels pretty cramped now.  They do have a large outdoor patio area which I think is awesome weather permitting!!

I like that this Starbucks is conveniently located and that they have a drive through. We came here yesterday for the first time. Service was good and the person taking orders was friendly. I had to dock a couple of stars though, because of their tiny parking lot. It's very difficult to get into the drive through line, and then it can be difficult to leave the drive through line because the line is so long. We also seemed to have a pretty long wait in the drive through. Lastly, our drinks were super sweet compared to other locations, like they used extra pumps of syrup. I couldn't finish mine. Overall, fine but not great.

Old gum pressed into the floor in multiple locations, dirty mats, coffee isn't very hot.

Coffee has been spotty at many locations lately,but Starbucks is usually very clean.  What more will go downhill with these people?
Friendly staff but understaffed , dirty , small , bathroom dirty ....  look for a different location !

Got some drip coffee here and it was so incredibly burnt tasting, I ended up throwing it out.  The next day I went to get some breakfast... Even though they told me two days before that they had "just" run out of the two gluten free breakfast items (sous vide and gluten free breakfast sandwich), it turns out that they don't actually carry either.  I probably wouldn't have been so irritated had I not waited in the huge line, but there you go.  Do yourself a favor and walk ten minutes to stumptown.
Best Starbucks location in our area! Employees are always providing the best possible customer service, including custom recommendations and making customers feel special and appreciated. Thank you!

Yes, reduction in mindless chit chat! My server was hung over or had a rough night which meant no idle talk!  I ordered, was served and left.

That's how you do it!

The parking/drive thru at this location stinks.  Not sure who came up with it, but I hope they didn't design any other locations.

I don't love Starbucks coffee. But I do like this Starbucks. The staff are friendly and kind, the patio is great with some refreshing misters, and the interior is clean. When I need a quick espresso on ice, I will pop in here. This was one of the first places I stopped when we came house hunting in Tucson, and Emma (hey girl!) made me feel welcome and at ease. She always remembers me and says hello, which is awesome in such a busy place. They also have a drive thru, but I always go in for some extra steps.

In the early hours when there is absolutely no one in the mall, service is great. Now ordering anytime once the mall is open is a waste of your time....the wait is always 10 mins or longer guaranteed. During this visit though i wanted a Caramel Ribbon Crunch Frap (which is amazing) and was clearly available to order based on the signage. How, after waiting in line for 12 mins i was told that they did not have the ingredients needed to make this drink. ..confused i was but I opted for the basic Caramel Frap seeing as though i had no other choice after waiting for something i really wanted but clearly could not have.

 So get your fix in the early hours or try the court Starbucks its less foot traffic on that side of the mall so it may be a shorter wait. 

Otherwise you'll spend your lunch break in line waiting to be served. Which is no way to spend your break if I must say so myself.

 I gave 3 stars because they are nice and make good drinks....when they have what you want of course

This place is amazing. Whenever I go there I never have to wait in a long line, the employees are very well mannered and always put a smile on my face. The drinks both hot and cold are delicious.  And the food is always hot and ready. Keep it up

I've Starbucks hopped for many of my years in grad school. The baristas are particularly friendly and efficient compared to other locations. I like this location in particular for studying during the spring and fall because of their outdoor seating set up.

If you like subpar coffee experiences, Starbucks is the way to go. Personally, I don't like burnt coffee taste or food that's been frozen and reheated. But hey, I'm sure I'll learn to love it after all the locally owned coffee shops go out of business once their rent goes up like Beauty Plus.

I occasionally come here to get drive- thru oatmeal for breakfast. This location seems to mess it up a lot. They dont include things like the spoon, or blueberries when i order blueberry oatmeal. It doesn't bother me too much as I've come to lower my expectations.
The drinks are typically over sweetened. Maybe this is to cover up the over roasted, bitter, burnt beans? 
Lighthouse Coffee down the road is wayyyy better. The way espresso and coffee should be. If Lighthouse had oatmeal I'd never come back to this store.

An open letter to the Starbucks in KOP:

Dear Starbucks,
 
     Almost every single one of your employees is awesome. They are pleasant (even at 6am), always remember my name and drink order as well as being kind enough to deal with me before I've had my espresso. Kudos to the early AM staff, especially Deidre, Kimber, Greg and the other 2 nice women whose names I do not know.  

     However, there is one employee; a young elvish girl with brown hair who is an EPIC FAIL. She is slow on the bar and gets irritated very easily, yet for some reason, she keeps getting scheduled to make drinks on Saturday afternoons. Saturdays are insanely busy and could put a seasoned vet in the weeds! 

     Please, please, please Starbucks of KOP let this girl go for the greater good. I'm sure there is a company out there looking to hire a slightly incompetent, easily flustered young woman with a lacking sense of urgency.     

Thank you for your time,
Annie

I love Starbucks but I avoid this one. It has some of the slowest service I have ever experienced at a Starbucks. 

I was there 2 days ago...The guy who was doing the drinks loves to talk to the costumers and his co-workers, which is fine...I just noticed he does a lot of talking and no working too. He will stop working and just start talking and talking. There was only one person ahead of me and it still took almost 10 minutes to get my drink. 

I also got over-charged at one point. The price on the menu was lower then the price I was charged. I added nothing special to my drink...I was going to ask for an explanation or my money back but there was a big line at that point so I let it go.

Small coffee shop, not much sitting. Music can be too loud sometimes. On the plus side there is a Sweet Cece's and a Chipotle right next door, that's a bonus.

Ordered a venti iced coffee, and a cup of water. The barista refused to give me tap water because they were "too busy" and "didn't have enough ice". Even when I said I didn't even need ice, just the water, the barista looked very upset and then finally gave me a small cup of water. Paying customers shouldn't have to negotiate for a cup of water. 

Also they must've not been making the iced coffee on a regular basis because it tasted SUPER watery. I know this because I used to be a barista, you have to either make coffee and let it cool off, which is the slower method, or you make double strong coffee over ice so when it dilutes due to the ice you have a normal strength coffee. I'm pretty sure they were pouring their normal brew over ice and having dilute completely. Won't be returning here.

Go there often and every time I get bob he gets my order right every time  , is so polite , uses my name and always is smiling !  Thank you bob for always making my experience great ! And thank you for serving for our country
This may be the "Training Starbucks" because they are a little slow but they're nice and I like that it's close. They are out of my favorite milk a lot however.
I waited in the drive-thru line for over 20 minutes. It's not convenient at all! They even gave me the wrong size iced coffee, but I just wanted to leave at that point. Terrible!

I can't go down Manchester without the car mysteriously turning into Starbucks.  They are very friendly, and usually fast at this one.
Ask for Doug, he is an amazingly fast and friendly barista.

Stopped here over the weekend for a pick me up.  The drive thru line was ridiculously long with over 8 cars waiting but rather than wait I took my chances and went inside.  I'm glad I did because there was only 1 person in line and they were already being served.

I ordered a grande iced coffee with skim milk and Splenda.  It was prepared well and tasted exactly how I expected.

The cashier was friendly and made small talk.  When she heard my dog was in the car she offered  me a free Puppacino .  For those who are unfamiliar with this a Puppacino is a cup full of whipped cream for your furry friend.  My girl Bambi was a happy girl!

Rude Rude Rude Rude Rude baristas!!! No hello, no good afternoon, no thank you, no anything.. honestly just told me my total and walked away!! I said thank you too the other barista that made my drink and she said nothing either!!! 
Made my drink pretty fast, that's the only reason they got any stars. Welcome to Brentwood...where we're too good for anyone.
It's a Time wasted crew, and the attitude that you can never miss when the Starbucks employees deal with you in 1300 s Dale Mabry is Impressive
Why would you go to a chain with burnt-tasting coffee when a local business (Lazy Daze) is within walking distance?

Starbucks is Starbucks. This store has been pretty decent. MAJOR problem - this location is too small. They parking lot constantly backs up and the drive thru blocks cars in their spots because it routes right through the parking lot. The drinks has always been really good coming out of this location though and the staff has always been really friendly. I hope maybe they expand this store or move it to a bigger location with a better design for a drive thru.
always great service... drinks are always made perfectly. ..and the drive through I'm the morning is SUPER fast. keeps me on time for work!!
Out of everything. Messed up what I finally did order. Had to wait 30min for a refund.

Stopped here on a Tuesday morning around 6am and had some pretty poor service. Me and 2 coworkers made our order and the two of them ordered breakfast sandwiches with their coffee. As soon as the cashier took our order she just left and wasn't seen again. Only one person was left at the counter making our coffees and didn't see the order for our sandwiches. There were no other orders/customers so she was just hanging out while the other girl was nowhere to be found still. After several minutes she realized she missed something because we were still standing there waiting and she finally started heating their food. When they was finally delivered it wasn't even heated all the way through. Not fun. 

Coffee was good but the experience left us less impressed. We most likely won't be back here.

Not my usual Starbucks but the one on High Street was closed so here I was. They have a lot of seating  but no comfy couches which I think is a necessity. The staff there are friendly but did not know what kind of promos were happening for Rewards members which didn't impress me.

Very slow. They forgot my coffee. Had to ask for a new half and half. Every other Starbucks has a refilled one ready but they had to refill it. The body language of the employees is awful and they move slowly. Management needs to shake up this location.

I am getting my quad shot expresso macchiato there for last ten years, baristas change few times but they continue to remember my drink and have it ready some-times before I even have a chance to pay for it.
The slowest Starbucks I have ever been to by far! The baristas do not move with a purpose. If you are under time restrictions I would not recommend this Starbucks be the stop you make.

This Starbucks is one of the best ones I've been too! The baristas are always very very nice and I've never had any problems here they get the drinks and the food out fast and always ask if the drink is right and if it's not they'll make you another which is amazing.

Cant complain too much about this place, they have pretty good coffee and great customer service. I prefer to go through the drive thru when I can cause there's less pressure to order and you're not rushed as much. 

When I go inside, I always feel like a fool cause I'm unsure of what i want or what to ask for most of the time. Still learning the lingo on the coffee and how to order it! 

You cannot beat a military discount too which is pretty awesome, for both active, and retired military and veterans. I also enjoy their cake pops and when I go I either get their iced coffee or their iced tea. 

If you're anything like me and like to avoid the crowds or aren't a fan of being in crowds, go to the drive thru instead.

This Starbucks may not have a drive thru but I've always enjoyed getting my coffee here! The employees are always friendly. Wait time isn't too long, even during morning rush hour. I've had issues with other Starbucks watering down my iced coffee but not this one, it's perfect. 
The space inside is a little small, so it's not the perfect place to study or do work unless you come during a quieter hour.

Try the new-ish Summer Sunset. You won't regret it.
You're welcome!
Don't assume that this is worth a stop off to get a sandwich to take on your flight out of PIE.  Out of sandwiches (except breakfast sandwiches, really?) at 3:30 pm on a Monday.

Pretty normal Starbucks, maybe slightly below average as far as staff interactions and atmosphere. Small details like getting a receipt or filling a cup all the way are overlooked and are somewhat begrudgingly fixed. Actual drinks are standard Starbucks, no complaints.
The baristas are great! Service is prompt, accurate and consistent. Drive thru operates smoothly with little delay

My husband and I came to Starbucks with our laptops to get a little work done on a Sunday afternoon. Unfortunately, the store was so overrun with flies, we quickly left after getting our drinks. We were the only customers in the store and there were at least 25 flies flying around, by my best estimation. It was disgusting to say the least and I'm not sure how that is not a health code violation. In addition, both of our drinks were made incorrectly and neither of us received so much as a "sorry" when we brought it to their attention.

My go to Starbucks! I love this location because of the location itself and the always friendly service. I'm always greeted whenever I walk in the door whether it is busy or slow inside. When the weather is just right, the tables outdoors are the perfect spots to study or to hang out. 

I recommend anyone who frequents Starbucks to utilize the mobile app rewards. I love the mobile order feature: place your order ahead of time and just pick it up if you're on the go!
Love the coffee but they are painfully slow. Ten minutes to get a drink once I've ordered and paid? Unacceptable. This is the slowest location I've ever encountered.

This is the slowest Starbucks ever! My drinks are never consistent either. I keep trying it, but after today I am done! There were five cars in front of me in the drive-through and it took 16 minutes. That is absolutely ridiculous!
This is by far the best Starbucks location in all of University City. I am so pleased with the service. The baristas are friendly and prompt. They make their drinks to perfection!

Great Starbucks with great service. I've been here a few times after staying at GSR and I never had any problems. The drinks taste great and GSR sometimes has coupons where you can get 15 dollars in free food and it works at this starbucks. 

Also right before closing, sometimes they offer their left over pastries for 50% off which is nice to snack on if you're hungry.
Just ordered online, paid for it get to drive through wait to get to window and only then get informed they're out of it. Totally defeats the reason for ordering online. Big waste of time.

I just redeemed stars for a cookie on 5/21 and the barista used 150 of my stars!! Under the new system it's only supposed to be 50 for a bakery item. What a waste! Somebody needs to do some training if the customers know more about their new programs than the employees. I've had mistakes here before such as charging my card when I asked to use a reward. They are chronically understaffed as well- poor management.
*This review is for the Target location

Teeny tiny starbucks, but just fine if you're taking your coffee to go.  

They were fast, which was nice, and they had a special going on where if you bought one pack of their K-cups you got one free.  WHOA!  My husband was thrilled.

Outdoor seating looked nice, but like I said, my order was to-go!
Prob the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Their drive thru is always packed no matter what & their always out everything....

Typical Starbuck. Nothing extra and nothing less. It is clean and nice looking. Bathroom are kept clean. The area is really bright with natural lighting. 
Good place to study if you are a student or just want a place to chill. Lots of available plug to charge stuff. Friendly and attentive staff

Staying in the hotel. Decided to come down and grab a cup of coffee and they closed early. Today I came down for breakfast and they don't have oatmeal "today". I'm not surprised at the overall rating of this location.

Best Starbucks ever!  I will drive out of my way to get my coffee at this location on Los Altos.  Shout out to the best Barista out there, Chadley!  Thank you for always making me want to come back.  Best customer service and a sense of humor...who wouldn't go back.  Great job!!

I love Starbucks.  I like this location, but it can be hard to get in and out of sometimes.  Especially if the traffic is congested.  

The crew is always friendly. My order is always right and hits the spot.

I want to first start off day that this store and the employees there are very revolting. The bathrooms were dirty, the bar was super messy and I being the customer seeing that makes me not want to go there ever. I have went there only one time and will never go again due to the fact that there are very rude and unprofessional employees there. This one employee made a huge big deal behind my back and a friend behind our backs. This employee name is Xander. He has had made various accusations about me and my friend having a fetish with transgenders. First off that is very untrue and that we had no idea this employee was transgender. Aside from that the store was very comfortable to do some studying but besides that Xander should not ever be employed at any Starbucks. He has worked at the Tyrone Starbucks and had accused everyone at the Tyrone store that they were out to get him. I hope someone sees this and have a talk with this person. WARNING!!!!! IF YOU GO TO THIS STARBUCKS PLEASE BE CAREFUL HE MAY BRING SOMETHING UPON YOU.

I drive out of my way specifically to come to this Starbucks location! The baristas are always friendly and quick, and my order is always accurate, consistent, and tastes perfect!
The only downside is that there isn't a drive-thru, but the service is fast enough that it hardly makes a difference.
Love, love, love this Starbucks!!

This Starbucks kiosk is located inside Super Target just to the right as you enter.  My visit was brief but well worth it a I needed a caffeine spark.  The barista greeted me and we chatted about some of the new iced teas and how they are made before I finally decided to try a white tea with their cane syrup for a light sweetness.  My drink was prepared correctly and timely and served with a smile and a thank you.  I walked away enjoying my new found beverage with many thanks.

It's nearly always too busy, which I suppose is just a thing to deal with.  When not too busy, it's a lovely place to sit and enjoy a tasty beverage with a friend or with a book.  They have a deck so in the summer, they double their seating capacity so long as the mosquitoes aren't biting.

I've been there several times and have received adequate service.  

Yesterday, I wanted their egg-whites, feta, and spinach sandwich.  It was unavailable and so the person apologized and then removed the sample from their display -- this tells me they care about their customers.  The fellow making the drinks needed help, though -- there were 5 people waiting for drinks by the time I joined the line.

I usually dont write reviews for big chain restaurants bc its the same everywhere. But the Starbucks is the best ever. Quiet, spacious and clean. The staffs are nice and friendly. They also give you left over drinks with smiley face on them. Would love to come here more often.

They forgot our order 4 times after we reminded them. It was a breakfast sandwich. 45 minutes later I just reminded them the 5th time and they looked like they had no idea what I am talking about. Least organized place I've ever seen
Slow AF but the barista made my very berry hibiscus really well. I've had them made before where my drink was a shade of pink. The one made by the guy at this location had a nice strong flavor.

One of the few Starbucks in Carpinteria. It gets crowded in the morning. We did an online app order and walked in on a Sunday morning. Surprised to see a lot of locals satisfying their caffeine  addiction. The cinnamon roll we got was crap but thats true with any Starbucks. Parking is plenty in the strip mall where its located.

Went at 11a on a Saturday. There were 7 people working behind the counter and it took 10 minutes to get the three drinks I ordered. The two chai lattes were not good. Tasted like hot milk, no froth. Drive through wrapped around the bldg. Wouldn't recommend this place if you are in a hurry.
Baristas need to learn how to make drinks properly.

Leather chairs 
Bar seating 
Recessed & pendent lighting 
Industrial tables 
Patio seating 
Drive thru 
Pleasant & efficient service 
Drink perfection 
Instagram page 
Spotify ready 
Ceramic mugs & tumblers for sale 

BUT....

The parking is a conundrum (1 star penalty). 

~Christy

This Starbucks is literally around the corner from my office, so is the location my coworkers and I frequent! 

The cafe is generally clean, and there is ample seating; however, because most of the time I just pop in to pick something uo and head back to my office, I've never really stayed very long in the cafe. And now that Starbucks takes mobile orders, I often just send in my order before stepping out of my office and pick it up when I get there. It definitely reduces the time spent waiting, and is particularly helpful when it is a busy time of the month at work!

During the standard morning and afternoon coffee break times, the cafe can get pretty crowded and a bit noisy with chatter from people waiting for their drinks at the end of the bar. The staff at this location are pretty friendly. And the drinks in my opinion are about the same as you would expect at any other Starbucks.

The staff is friendly and but they are busy
And always avalibal  for suggestions  or questions  about  there products  or coffees

Arrived this morning around 7:45 am and was able to walk right up to the counter to order. The place was packed! Lots of people waiting for their specialty drinks. But ordering a plain coffee is super easy and quick! Parking was easy to find as they have a lot out front. Lots of baristas working behind the counter and they clearly have specific people working on food orders too! This Starbucks knows how to handle a crowd!

Still sitting here 15 minutes later waiting for my drink. Have watched countless cars drive through and get their orders. Very tired of the drive thru being given precedence over walk in traffic. Will not be returning.

Slow service, crappy staff, not what it use to be. 
Asking for a name just goes to show how much the staff doesn't remember their day to day heavy tipping customers, well, fixed that pretty fast, don't mind if I do keep the extra two dollars everyday.

Road trip Coffee. 

The Caramel Ribbon Frappuccino one of us got  looks like a dessert. It has Marshmallow whip cream added, wow.

I got my usual Grande Caramel Macchiato. I added a pump of White Chocolate Mocha, so good, just not hot enough. 

Cute little Starbucks and the people are very friendly. 5 stars for that.

Love popping into this Starbucks in the morning. Located in Irvington off of the strip it's very convenient. Parking in the back, sometimes the drive thru gets congested. Staff is always sweet & patient even when busy. Service is usually fast and served perfect. My daughter is obsessed with the cake pops and I usually get a Frappuccino. Last time I was in Carmel frap was a little strong and tasted like a buttery nipple (alcohol shot). My husband usually gets the hot sandwiches when he's in town. Served hot and fresh.

This is one of the better ones. Service was great and the drinks were well balanced. The iced chai tea was spot on.
