Good place to meet and chat with friends late night since their patio is well lite and you're welcomed to sit after close, but with that, this place is not open late. You have to come a bit early to snag a drink (I think they close at 10PM, not sure).

Put in a mobile order for 3 drinks. They lost one of them and when I asked for it they still took 10 minuets to make it. I was right in front of them and instead of handing me my drink they put it all the way at the other side of the counter.

Rude and unfriendly staffs.  I ordered my usaul mocca frap and there was something missing all I tasted was sugar but I didn't want to bother bacause I just saw the lady who made my cup yelling at another customer when he asked for sugar " NO! We don't have anymore sugar!"  
 Made me wonder how possible you run a coffee shop with no sugar. Next time I'll try PJ's
Fast service through drive-through even during rush hour each morning. Friendly staff. Convenient location.

Ooh Starbucks analogies! I've got one. Starbucks is the McDonald's of coffee shops. When you go into a McDonald's you do not expect to wait for a freshly prepared meal. You know that it will probably be microwaved or the equivalent. And when you go to Starbucks the "barista" will push a button on the machine and out will come your watery shot of espresso. Your latte will probably come out with a dollop of foam on top because their steam wand is incapable of making milk the appropriate consistency for a latte. When you go to a real burger joint you know that you will be laughed at if you attempt to order a "big mac". This is the same at your local coffee shop if you attempt to order a "caramel macchiatto" or a "frappuccino".

As for this Starbucks in particular. Well it is exactly the same as all the others (just like McDonald's!). Only here you will find herds of preppy high school teens toting coach purses  too preoccupied on their cell phones to actually even place an order.
I always see a line at this starbucks so I steer away from it but when I do end up going, the line moves quickly. The employees are friendly about everything too even if you go just to order a water.

UPDATE: decided to give this place another try and they failed . I ordered on the app & when I get to the window, they give me my drinks and tell me to have a good day.. I say, I ordered a lunch box and two cake pops.. they give me one cake pop and a lunch box. And they gave me the wrong cake pop. Back around, she apologized and gave me the right one. But idk why they can't get things right.


This place needs some work.. ordered a caramel frap and a cookie dough cake pop.. I was told the cake pop was out of stock. I asked which flavors they did have.. and she said cookie dough or chocolate. So I said okay I'll take the cookie dough. It was silent and she goes "so you want a cake pop?" I confirm, yes the cookie dough one like I asked three times now. Get to the window- I ask if I can pay cash but still use my rewards, she says yes. Takes my phone and then charges my card- WTF?? Come on Starbucks.

This location is horribly slow and has extremely poor customer service. I waited for 20 minutes for my food order. They had plenty of staff working but they sure were inefficient. They gave me half my order and then looked surprised when I asked where the rest of it was. No reason that this place can't be more more organized and customer centric. They were also out of basic items like napkins and Splenda. Not a great experience to say the least!

The staff that work at this Starbucks are amazing.  A review mentioning "LOUD and obnoxious employees" is totally off base.  I've never had a bad experience here and I am a daily regular.  You will be greeted with a smile and a great beverage every time you visit!

Worst Starbucks ever!!! Rude customer service. They didn't make the drinks correctly. Overpriced. Can't use your Star rewards here. They don't give cold brew refills. What a terrible, awful experience!

Starbucks Carpenteria near freeway excellent 
Baristas excellent thumbs up here. Great old music to download oldies love it. Keep it up guys!!

I love this starbucks as everyone is so friendly and very helpful; however, I was sitting at the bar doing homework and a little cock roach crawled right up next to me. Yuck! I know it's common but there is this thing called pest control. That's the only reason for 2 stars. Everything else is perfect about this starbucks

This has been consistent for me as an employee in the mall. The staff is helpful and really nice. I have mobile ordered and ordered in person and both experiences have been seamless. The product is always starbucks standard so no issue there. The only problem I have had, and it is small, is that they had a product listed on the app as available but they didn't have it when I arrived it pick it up.

I always come here for Starbucks before a shift before work. Every time I order mobile, it takes about 15 minutes to get a drink with the barista making everyone in-store drinks before mobile orders. They usually only have 1 barista and 1 cashier during the weekend when this is a very busy Starbucks. I can't depend on coming 10 minutes before my shift because it typically takes more than 10 minutes from waiting in line, to ordering, and then getting my drink made. They should definitely have some more people on staff.

Located inside the Safeway store so no drive-thru which is what I really like. Having to exit my ride for a cup of coffee is a waste of my time, but it is close so I do it. But I don't do it as often as I would if I could drive up. The people are friendly and the coffee is above average. The only regular coffee that I drink is French Roast and I keep a bag of beans in my freezer just in case I am needing a shot of the good stuff.
Slowest starbucks I've ever been to. Don't use the drive through. You'll be stuck for an hour.

I always get my coffee via mobile app and yes, my coffee is sitting there waiting HOWEVER, the workers ignore me so I still have to wait for my order.  This really makes me mad!!! I used to get coffee every day but I only use this particular starbucks because of location....it's on my way to work.  I've cut down on my coffee thanks to their stupidity.  Question:  Why can't they put the orders somewhere so we can pick them up ourselves like they do at the starbucks downtown Franklin?

I've been coming here off and on since they opened. A drive thru is a big bonus, but coming in here is just as nice. The staff is friendly and they always seem to have a good time. Many date nights were had here after dinner at Wegman's. Even after a dinner date at home, the ex & I would usually end our evening here. Today I came in here because i was an hour early for a job interview. Asked for a Venti iced decaf, but ended up with a Grande. Hit the bathroom while they were making my drink & when I came out I pointed out the error. With no questions asked, the barista made me a new one & had me keep the Grande. I'm very happy with that!
This is a typical Starbucks but getting in and out of the parking lot is totally SNAFU. Yikes.
Great location. As the only Starbucks between Ventura and Montecito, they have a big job. Drinks are good, service is usually friendly.
Bought two different drinks but got the same one. Also had the wrong toppings as well. When asked to correct they were not nice about it

This place is truly incredible. Background: this location is on my way to work so I frequent this place at least four times a week. The first time I went, I ordered my usual drink per my allergies and one sip told me they didn't pay attention to any of the customizations. But, I gave them the benefit of the doubt because mistakes happen.

Since then, I've started mobile ordering so it's ready when I get there and I don't have to deal with the morning rush. I have the timing down to a science. Normally things run smoothly enough, but they've never been fantastic. This morning I ordered a decaf black coffee and a sandwich. I got there ten minutes after placing the order, and the coffee wasn't on the stand. I waited a few minutes because there were six baristas running around, and I saw the drive thru line was a bit excessive. (Note there was never more than one person in line in the actual store.) After a few minutes I ask about my coffee and it doesn't register on anyone's faces. I show them the ticket on my sandwich bag that clearly says I ordered another item. They ask what the coffee was, I tell them, the woman in charge told another barista to make it. 

This girl...has she never been awake in the morning? Does she know people have jobs? I don't know. She pulled the coffee filter out of the bag slower than my 90 year old grandma getting off a toilet. Then she went to the back and pilfered through some shelves. The woman in charge asked her if she made the drink yet and she whined, complained to her coworker about the harsh treatment, literally spun around a few times in the back, then came out and started pouring my drink. She overfilled the cup and had to pour some out into the sink, drenching the side of the cup. Then served the dripping cup up to me with a "thanks for waiting" without making eye contact. 

Look, I understand the stereotypical White Woman thing so I try not to make a big deal about things like this, but I'm on my way to work when I go in there. I ordered my BLACK COFFEE at 7:37AM, and arrived at 7:48. I didn't get the drink in my hand until 8:01. And somehow, it's cold. 

This location makes weaning off of my Starbucks addiction so much easier.

I got in and got out...very fast. This was on a Saturday meaning that there was basically a petting zoo outside due to all the dogs on leashes at tables.

Hey it's a Starbucks and they're peddling a legal drug...lucky for you, they're open 24/7.
It took so long for them to make my TEA, a grande tea, that I signed up and made an account on Yelp just to give them a bad review before I even got my drink :))
Seriously the most friendly service at any Starbucks I've been too.  Everyone seems like that want to be there.. which is always so refreshing!

This location has just been rebuilt. They just rebuilt it a few hundred feet away and for those fast food lovers, it now has a drive thru option! The line is usually long and slow moving so you may still end up going inside to get your order quicker.

They still have all your standard treats and drinks available, so what are you waiting for? I've been a few times already and love the convenience of the drive thru!

This is the worst Starbucks that I have ever been to. They were out of many food items, the milk had weird globules of fat in it and my coffee had grounds in it. The customer service is also famous for being awful! 

AT LEAST THE LINE WASN'T TOO LONG DUE TO THE REPUTATION! Maybe they can make a documentary about it...
Just ordered online, paid for it get to drive through wait to get to window and only then get informed they're out of it. Totally defeats the reason for ordering online. Big waste of time.

How the F do you give a corporation business a 5 star? I dont know?  But go visit this Starbucks to find out. 

All starbucks suck. Yes true story.  But when you need a decent cup of coffee fast you dont have much of an option.  

Its like ass crack early.  Like super ass crack.  This cute chick greeted me with no problems!  Im thinkign wow, its way to early to be this nice.. but she pulled it off, but the best part was customizing my black coffee with zero problems or lip or attitude or faces, etc.

Excellent staff; they keep things moving. The clientele can be a little snobby, but whatever. I like how friendly the staff is. I am usually here killing time before doctors appointments, so the location is perfect for me.
Worst Starbucks ever.  My oatmeal was like soup. The staff is unfriendly. Never have I been to a Starbucks that have been so rude

Ordered my drink via the Starbucks app and waited for maybe 3 minutes inside at the mobile order pick up spot (maybe 7 minutes since ordering) before someone asked if I had ordered online and what I got. Turns out something glitches in the system and they didn't get my order until just a minute or so before they asked me what I was waiting on (so while I had been standing there waiting). They quickly started working on my order and got it out within a minute or so. Wasn't their fault their machine didn't spit out the order in a timely manner, but I ended up spending 10 minutes waiting for my drink when the store/drive through were practically empty. Staff were OK but seemed frazzled with 4-5 of them behind the counter and very little going on in the store.

Love the location because I literally live 3 minutes away so that's a plus. From what I experienced, this particular Starbucks is very generous. On the few times I get my orders wrong/drink out of stock, they'll graciously offer me a free drink - with a positive attitude as well. :)  I like to study early in the mornings but it does get crowded so if you want to have a quiet space, come in the afternoon. If you like positive vibes and an overall nice atmosphere, this place is on your list.

For the first time in my life a Starbucks barista actually asked me how to spell my name instead of writing something incorrect and acting indifferent (although it was always funny to see what they would put), and I appreciated the fact the gentleman took the time to ask me! I had a delicious frappacino - toasted white chocolate mocha - it was prepared quickly and was delicious! This location also has plenty of seating and lots of convenient parking.

This is a pretty bad Starbucks.  The drive thru is painfully slow.  I waited 10 minutes for a latte before just pulling off.

Next time in I opted to go in.  This wasn't slow, but the teenaged working behind the counter need to be mindful of cleanliness.  Picking up the mat that they stand on and flopping it around inches from where they are making my drink is just gross!!!

The service was great miss my buddy I usually have coffee with had my regular 4 venti soy 2 Splenda iced latte. Yummy to the max today, great service. Only thing to make it better would be if my friend was here with me.
This Starbucks was so slow. One girl was making all the drinks. Poor management having only one person making the drinks
Besides parking this place is really roomy and they're always very friendly. I live across the street so I'm here all times of the day and it's very clean.
The Starbucks itself was okay, coffee was as normal. I was unimpressed with the service. There was a lady, Nancy, who was pretty condescending, which was annoying.

Are there any Sbux locales out there that truly stink? This place is close to the office I'm temporarily working at and it is always packed! My only gripe (and why it received 4 stars instead of 5), is the parking. During peak hours, its very difficult to find a space and there is no drive-thru.

After going here for more than 2 years, I thing I like most about this Starbucks is familiarity. I've seen staff come and go but they're often replaced by eager and friendly replacements which are a welcome. The core staff are a mature bunch but they also have a sense of youth, exuberance, a jus de vie if you will. They're not my best friends, but their quick smiles, efficient work ethic and the duty of handing me my prized drink will always leave an impression with me if I ever leave to another Starbucks.
 
Their chalkboards with the flavor of the month/season is always a treat to gaze at while I'm waiting for my order. I wish there more coffee stoppers available but I guess we have to do our part to save the environment.
 
Orders are most often accurate and the taste is as expected from any other Starbucks. The service is what wins me over.

This location always has a long line during normal mall hours and the wait is excruciating. This morning there was no line since we were there really early but the cashier must have been new because it took forever to order. She also charged me to replace the regular milk with soy milk in my green tea frap. I've never been charged before at other sb locations. Oh well, what's an extra $0.60 when you're paying a ton of money already for crushed ice?! My friend ordered a plain coffee with a pump of sugar free caramel syrup via the sb app. The barista told her they only carry sugar free vanilla and hazelnut. They should really update their app.

Location is an A+
Drivethru traffic D
Staff barely a C

When you walk into the store you do not get that warm feeling! The staff literally doesn't know how to make drinks and if you want custom orders forget it!
Arron the DM needs to get control of this store!

Great NOLA-inspired interior with trumpet-lamps and whatnot (1 star). Coffee is good as expected (1 star). But don't try to talk or work here, they love to play ear-battering punkrock music at noon (They dimmed it a little bit after we asked twice).
Starbucks how I used to love you but now I've sampled really good local roasted brews, I realize you serve a really mediocre cup of joe!

If I could give this Starbucks location six stars I definitely would! That's how friendly they are! I was at the mall just relaxing and when I came back around the second time to order another round of a Mango Dragonfruit the Barista asked "so how'd you enjoy your drink?" To which I replied "I loved it!"

One of the worst starbucks experiences and not something I expect from my favorite coffee place! They were out of chai and they forgot the sausage on my cheddar egg sausage sandwich. So lame. Won't be back here!

Quite possibly the most disappointing Starbucks I've frequented. Time after time I walk in, place my order and have to wait in excess of 10 mins while there is no one else in the store, but drive thru orders are flying out faster than Usain Bolt. To add insult to injury, my drink order is often wrong -- light ice does not mean half a cup of ice. I go here grudgingly due to the convenience factor but I won't go out of my way to give this Starbucks my business.

First off l, thank you for giving us a Starbucks. Secondly my girl Alex is amazing. She always greets you with her amazing smile. Today was the first time she waited on me (took my order). So I got to see her bubbly personality and her kindness. I told Alex how I wanted my drink and she let me know that there was already a drink on the menu like it so I was able to save (woot woot). She helped me understand the starred points system. But the best part is when I saw an organic Reese's that was dark chocolate (eww). She tried to explain it to convince me it was great. Then I told her next time and then she purchased it so that I could try it!!!! Made my day (it was THE BOMB btw). This Starbucks is amazing!

I am not a Star$$$ fan. 

I love coffee that tastes good at its base and does not require extra processing (read, latte, capp, etc.) to make it palatable.  So, it is always somewhat surprising to see these little coffee caves sprout up in supermarkets and box stores and do moderately well.  I admit to having been a happy stockholder for a while, but that did not change my opinion of the underlying product.  

So, I was skeptical when I walked into Target a few years ago, and several times since, to see this outpost hanging its shingle within.  It is still there, but seems to be scraping along with only one person running the operation.  Some people like to sip java as they push their shopping carts around the store.  A few actually stop in only for the coffee and depart.  

It would be great if there were more coffee alternatives around here.  Until then, this place and the competing Dunkin Donuts and diners of the world will duke it out for my coffee dollar.

Horrible service! While five of us waited in line (one person holding a toddler), a friend of the staff thought it was humorous to keep all of us waiting while he and two cashiers chatted about a movie. I walked out and will never return.
It's consistent, clean, spacious, and friendly staff. What else do you want from a Starbucks. The only pain are the lazy asses who can't park.
The best moca frap I have ever had! Nice people! Will come back here for sure! Although like all the Starbucks stores it a bit expensive

Just waited 35 minutes for a breakfast sandwich. So disorganized. Had to tell the workers 4 times that I was still waiting on a sandwich and each time it was like it was the first time they've heard it. Horrible.

Let's just get this out of the way- it's open 24 hours. This means that, after 1am, you're going to run into drunks or people in recovery. The locals usually clear out by midnight.

The staff is pretty great. As you might imagine, cleaning up vomit in bathrooms on a regular basis tends to take the edge off of a person, regardless of how caffeinated s/he may be.

The outdoor seating is ample. and rarely unusable, as the weather tends to be agreeable.

Sure. there might be a lot of weirdos, but you can usually just pull up a chair and engage in whatever inappropriate debate is taking place.

Just don't try to talk with the guy intently watching the game outside on a portable television. If Ohio's losing, he's pretty cranky.

This Starbucks is a concession inside the Grand Sierra Resort, formerly the Hilton, and before that, formerly the MGM Grand Reno. It is located near the main casino floor near the other shops and not too far from one of the main bars, and also not far from Registration.   

Ready made Sandwich $5.50
Grande Soy Latte $4.15

So glad to find this Starbucks.  Cute little building.  Service was good.  I like the little outside area as it is away from the main road and parking area.  Only handicap space are adjacent.  Makes for a nice spot to drink coffee right on 202 while avoiding the crazy mall scene just down the road.

This is a great Starbucks.  The staff is wonderful.  Plus its less than a mile from our house!

This is just to give another shout out to the wonderful staff at this Starbucks.
You are so nice and helpful and appreciated!

Weekday mornings it can be hit or miss. If Pat is working your order is ready quickly, it's correct, and you get a friendly conversation to start off your day. If Pat is not working, be prepared to wait an additional 10 minutes for the mobile order you placed 10 minutes before arriving, and you're lucky if you are acknowledged with a glance in your general direction.

The couple times I've stopped here have been positive overall.  The store is spacious and relatively clean; ample parking.

The baristas deliver service with a smile, and make the drinks to standard.  Sometimes there is a bit of a wait when they get busy, but it's not unbearable.  (Tip: Try to order ahead on the mobile app if possible, to save some time waiting.)

I'm sure I will be back.

The employees here do the most and are underpaid for it. They always give exceptional service even when they are understaffed. Hannah especially is amazing. Keep doing what you are doing ya'll, and don't let terrible corporate practices and rude customers bring you down.
Worst location for a Starbucks! Drive thru line always poorly managed and cars always hang out into street which precwnta those who wish to park and go inside from being able to do so!!!

I went in today, ordered my coffee, took a seat and began studying. Everything was good except it was freezing in there. I look around and everyone has there winter coats on. I had to sit with my winter coat on so I wasn't freezing. For the price of those drinks I don't understand why there being cheap with there heat.

Even though I am not a coffee drinker, I frequent this location when I need to work or study. Its clean the staff is hospitable and the wifi always works. The staff seems to really pay attention to its patrons and gets to know them on a personal level. There is indoor and outdoor seating. Inside it usually gets very cold though so bring a jacket or plan to sit outside. 

Although Starbucks serves food, I love the proximity to restaurants when I need a break to grab a bite to eat.

I ordered a cloudy caramel macchiato with super light caramel drizzle, the lady gave me it with extra caramel drizzle, I let her know I asked for light and she got mad. I understand the frustration but if I'm paying $6 for a coffee I'd like it made correctly. She dumped it into another cup and the drink was ruined (no longer foamy like it's suppose to be) I will not be returning to this Starbucks.
Don't order a drink with no ice. Payed 5$ for half a cup, and got charged extra for ice on the side.
Quick and easy! So nice to have a Starbucks inside the JWMarriott. Employees are very friendly and Juan is awesome! Keep up the good work!

Went to this Starbucks for a BOGO free offer! The app didn't work so the young lady at the counter helped me out! She was so nice and patient, she had a loooong day with the app not working, but was still very sweet. 
I got the pumpkin spice cold brew which was delicious!! I went back the next day and had the dragonfruit drink with coconut milk and it was Amazing!!!! The workers are quick and efficient and it's very clean!

This is one the most spacious Starbucks in Tampa.  A long seating along the wall with personal tables, couple high tables, round table and seating - conversation area invites to work and relax.   The corner windows are great, provides a lot light to the store.  The parking lot looks small but actually work very well with the crowd.  Along the busy Dale Mabry  Hwy is a very convenient place!
Open early even on weekends. Friendly, big, clean. Has a drive through and ample parking. The music is good. Outdoor seating too. A prime example of what's good about the chain.

Love this Starbucks.

The drinks are usual Starbucks fare, but the employees here make the difference. All of the employees are extremely friendly, shout out to Lindsey, Ben, and Jordan. 

Fast drive thru, and mobile orders are ready on time.

No complaints!

Is there a "no star rating" available? 1st let's just say that kids working there are in dire need of supervision or at least some management. I asked for a strawberry Açai mixed with coconut milk and extra strawberries...easy enough to follow instructions especially when you're giving them the specific mixing ingredients, no? Well it took them 15 minutes to tell me they ran out of coconut milk which I agreed to be replaced with soy aaaamd another 10 minutes to tell me they had ran out of berries, all berries apparently. This place gives Starbucks a bad name.

Its a starbucks, so unless you have been living on Mars there should be no need to describe much.
However,  what makes this location stand out more than the average location... they have great consistency. My drink tastes the same almost everytime, and its good.

Even though it was 6:30AM, the girl who took my order was pretty chipper; the other girl (barista) making the drinks looked pretty miserable though.

I got my drink in a timely manner though, and that's all I ask!

This is by far one of the worst managed starbucks I have been to. This is the closest location to my house in Carp so I deal with it when I'm not going into Ventura or SB... The bathroom is always disgusting, the staff when you order is nice but the ones making the drinks are not as pleasant. I always order a matcha drink & they never shake it even if you ask. They serve it all clumped up on the bottom. Would be nice if they took a little more pride in their job & cheer up. Also a cleaning routine where is the manger at this place can't they see the messy store.

Review is based on drive-thru only. The baristas are always super friendly and they always get my order right. The line can be a little long in the morning but everyone's getting their coffee on their way to work so I get it. 
I don't get Starbucks unless I have a giftcard. I have much better coffee and lattes at other local places and I'd rather support a local business if I'm being honest.

3/5 hotel prices but otherwise all the same

i always forget that this spot will have a slight up-charge because it's formally inside the hotel, but sometimes i use it as a landing spot between meetings, since the other coffee options nearby will also charge just as much anyways...

it's always pretty busy, given the hotel hosts a bunch of meetings. sometimes the line can be out the door, but they seem to most pretty quickly. it seems they've expanded seating (at least compared to years past), and you have some seats next to outlets if you need to charge up your devices. 

all in all, it is what it is. oh, and i mean, it's starbucks so there's not really a need to comment on the drinks, since it's the same as other stores...

If I had to pick a favourite Starbucks in Edmonton, I think this one would be it. The only way to describe this setting is that it is wonderful. This is what a coffee place should be.

It has a great setting and the building is nice also. It's an older brick building with tall arched windows and a high ceiling. It's a nice change from the modern-style Starbucks I'm normally in. I get the feeling that this place has been here longer than most of the Starbucks in Edmonton.

It's a very relaxing location that is conducive to having a relaxing chat with a friend or avoiding the stress of the office.  It's not far from downtown either. I just wish it was closer to home for me.

I will now judge every other Starbucks I go to by this one.

Busyness - It's pretty steady. Obviously it's a popular coffee place in this older neighbourhood. I get the feeling I was lucky to get the biggest table in the place.

Noisiness - Aside from the occasional blender, it's generally pretty quiet. The music is at an acceptable level and I'm tucked away at the back, so I miss much of the traffic.

Ambience - I understand this is called High Street and it's a great area just a short distance from 124 St. 

Power - The booths don't seem to have power but the other tables look to have power available. You may have to stretch a cord in some areas. I don't know if the patios ever have power.

Free wifi - Yes, free wifi is available and works well.

Staff - They're friendly as always. I got my coffee quickly as I usually do. I almost always order coffee, unless I'm at a Starbucks in the evening when I order passion tea. If it's got an 'O' on the end of its name, I probably will never order it.

Seating - It's not a big place, but it's laid out well and it has a lot of seats. The prep area doesn't take up half the floor space, like it seems to in some places. There are 24 seats with two of them being comfortable armchairs. Those seats also include three great little two-seat booths. With one large table to work at, you'll easily fit four people. The outdoor patio is huge (nine tables) and on a hot day it would be really nice to enjoy sitting out in the shade of the huge trees (elms?) lining 125 St.

Security - Seems like a pretty good area, but I'd still lock up the laptop or bring it with me when heading to the washroom.

I have gone to this location twice in the past week and both times they have closed over an hour and a half early! It's not like I waited until the last five minutes... I will not return this is ridiculous.

Normally this small Starbucks is excellent. However, this morning we had to wait 15-20 minutes on two orders. A pumpkin spice latte and an Americano.   I finally asked the register person to credit our order.  He said "sorry". The basic root of the problem was a slow, untrained barista who seemed to go even more slowly after I complained about time.    So, I'm sorry to say I cannot rate this location higher than a 2

If I can give this starbucks negative stars I would. I was staying at gsr for a night and Sunday morning my family and I decided to get some breakfast sandwiches and some teas. My daughter and I both love their black tea lemonades so we ordered 2 of those and my brother ordered the peach green tea. Cashier was very nice and helpful. The girl making my drink I believe her name was Maria or Mariah but she had like blueish hair was extremely rude. I always try my drink before leaving and while I was waiting for my other drinks I tried mines and it I already knew it was wrong by looking at the color. It tasted disgusting. Not only that the way she made it was wrong. What I ordered is a shaken black tea lemonade and I had asked her to remake my drink because it was not sweetened at all but she made a remark and said well you need to specify it when ordering well fyi the cashier never even bothered to ask and usually at Starbucks they do. So she then takes back my drink and asks me to hold my lid. I myself work in a same field as hers and I tell her that I didn't want to cross contaminate and asked her to toss it out and give me new one. She takes my drink back and just pumps sweetener in one cup and poured the exact same one over! And not only that she didn't even use the shaker like she was supposed to. I had to ask the other employee there and she said yes she's doing it wrong. Out of my whole order I was missing my daughters tea as well and had to inform her. My brothers peach tea was made the same way. She didn't shake it. She just poured it all in a cup and put ice in so his drink was overly sweet. How was I supposed to shake my tea and make sure the sweetener tea and lemonade gets all mixed up? It's not possible! I don't know how the employees are trained here or if the girl was having a bad morning because it really looked like she was out of it. I don't blame her since it's Reno but for paying almost 40$ for Starbucks I expected it to be good. Worst Starbucks visit ever. My daughter is only 6 years old and she even noticed that her tea was not what it's supposed to taste like. If a 6 year old says something then you guys really have a problem and need to fix it asap since you guys are a well known name. I don't think I will be visiting this Starbucks location when I come back to gsr.

I've only been once but the service was fast and my drinks were made as ordered. The kids temp drink was perfect! The line wasn't long even right before Christmas. I'm so glad I don't have to go to the Starbucks one anymore. I hope the service remains this good.

This is a cute little stand alone starbucks (not tucked into a target store like so many)  nice decor staff is friendly....I do not drink starbucks coffee but I like that I can get a hot or iced black sweetened tea.  Found myself chinchillin here with my laptop for awhile one day and it was a nice place to be......

So.... I waited to visit this location a couple of times before writing this review. I visited Saturday 9.14.19, Sunday 9.15.19 and today 9.16.19. I read the reviews  about how slow the store runs, how long the lines were, etc. 

I love Starbucks and sometimes I feel that Yelpers give negative or bad reviews just because they have nothing better to do. (Most Yelpers who give bad reviews have lots of negative reviews on their page)

My first visit to this location was Saturday September 14, 2019. It was around 4pm and the store was crowded. There were at least SIX baristas behind the counter, but it just didn't seem like they were moving "fast enough" to accommodate the crowd of people wanting their Starbucks fix. 

This visit, I purchased: a Treinta Iced Passion Tango Tea Lemonade, a Tall Salted Caramel Mocha Frappuccino and two Protein Boxes (PB&J on Wheat|Smoked Turkey). The barista prepared my tea as a Tall as opposed to a Treinta. It was horrible and I waited for such a long time, I thought I was going to miss my bus to work.


My second visit was Sunday September 15, 2019. After Saturday's visit, I was in and out simply because I didn't purchase a drink. There was still a crowd of people to wade through.

My third visit today was in the morning before the mall even opened. I was one of two customers in the store. The barista looked as if he was tired and really didn't want to be there. I purchased two Cheese Danishes and a Tall Iced Passion Tango Tea Lemonade. It took FOREVER!!! I actually missed my bus to go home.

It seems like there is no set time of day that will get in|out quickly (even if your purchase isn't complicated). You may want to visit this location if you are strolling around the mall and have the time and patience. 


Also apparently this location is in the hiring process for a new store manager. Maybe they need someone to whip the employees into shape, elevate morale and create better customer service.

the line was about 15 people long i ordered my drinks ahead of time and when they gave me my drink i asked for a cup of water the barista told me i had to get back in line if i wanted water. this is literally the first starbucks ever to tell me i needed to get back in line for water. wow really

One thing I know about Starbucks in this location is that there a lot of mistakes with order. 
I ordered Iced green tea latte but instead they gave me a hot green tea latte.
Last time I ordered tall iced white chocolate mocha but instead they gave me a different size, which is grande. 
Great place to study, but I don't recommend ordering coffee at this place.

Relative to other Starbucks, this one is generally okay- nothing horrible, nothing great. 

The building doesn't look like a typical Starbucks, and the first time I went here, I actually drove by it. It's easy to find parking, and the place is on the small side- about maybe 7-8 tables plus a few chairs inside, and then an outside patio for when it's nicer out. I've always been able to find a table inside, though. The service is decent, the line fluctuates between quite long and empty, and the noise level fluctuates between quiet and very loud. Service is okay, speed of drinks is okay, food is okay. The bathrooms were clean, and they have free WiFi. 

Generally a decent, middle of the road Starbucks, but it's main advantage is its location right on 202, near the KOP mall.
I asked for a cup carrier to carry 3 cups of hot coffee and the response was " We don't have any!"  The second response was " Like is my fault we don't have any!" RUDE, RUDE, RUDE!!

This Starbucks used to be good, but they never have cold brew anymore. They don't know how to make the pumpkin cream cold brew either. So gross I asked for it to be remade and the cashier rolled his eyes at me and it still came out nasty. please learn how to make the drinks advertised.

Stopped by on our way out of town last night as Dear Hubby had a Starbucks craving.  He went in while I waited in the car.  We'd done a lot of walking and I was ready to rest.  I have been inside in the past.

It's a smaller location in a shopping plaza away from the beach and the downtown area.  It's not far off the freeway.  Established before drive-thru Starbucks became so popular, this location has indoor and outdoor seating. 

Our Frappuccino was frosty and delicious; a great summer's evening treat.
A little slow. But the coffee is always delightful and the people working here are friendly and helpful. I would come here everyday if I lived here!
It's located inside a hotel so it's always busy. Surprisingly the service is very quick and efficient despite the rush
This is a great Starbucks.  The staff is wonderful.  Plus its less than a mile from our house!

This Starbucks has failed me so many times today I asked for iced macchiato splash of heavy cream and they gave me a hot drink. I asked they remake it and they basically gave me a cup of cream that is not consumable. And before I ordered sugar free caramel macchiato to then find out they don't have that option so this past year I have been I unknowingly been drinking sugar! This is so dangerous what if I was diabetic!!!!

This is my favorite Starbucks in the area. I've got a lot of choices and this one isn't the closest, but I really love this one and will go out of my way to choose this Starbucks over the others. The people are very nice and make delicious beverages (everyone makes them a little different, but this is the most consistent and delicious!). It doesn't ever seem too crowded and the service is very quick!
Located in the Hyatt regency hotel. It's your average Starbucks. Cute mugs to purchase tho. Very nice people behind the register and good service.
A typical Starbucks with the slowest service ever. You're better off heading over a few blocks and spending your money at Who Dat.

Their service needs work and bathrooms are not clean. Their cashier puts in the wrong drink and when I asked them to fix it, they act like I inconvenienced them. The lady working the cashier acts like she doesn't want to be there. Customer service training and quality control are needed, as it's below the service level of other Starbuck's.
Waited in drive three for 15 minutes only to be handed the wrong drink, had to drive all the way back to have it remade.... come on @starbucks

Can count to get in and out super fast on my way to work! The people are very friendly and have fixed my drink the few times it hasn't been perfect. It has become my go to Starbucks! Top 3 that's for sure!

My DISABLED child came home and told me today that the lady at Starbucks at the Mall was very rude to her when she was there yesterday. She (not sure what her name was)  made her feel so rushed to give her her order. And was very nasty to her. This is the most disgusting behavior, and whoever you are you should feel really ashamed of yourself.  And maybe find a job where you aren't in SERVICE.

I am quickly becoming a fan of the blonde roast espresso. The staff is always friendly and there is rarely a long line. Much less people compared to the one closer to Penn campus. Although I never stay there, there seem to always be seats to sit at and it is not very loud. I do like the americano at Starbucks more than Joes and Saxbys. It's also nice to sit outside when the weather is warm.

There is always a long line here as others have mentioned.   Today it took me 30 minutes from the time I got in line until I had my beverage.   I had over and hour until my flight, but...still....

I think the issue is that there really aren't other good options for coffee in the airport.   I won't detail the problems with other places to get coffee in the airport here though.   There were three people working plenty fast this morning, but with running the register, making beverages and making sandwiches, they were overwhelmed.   

The beverages are always the same quality as other Starbucks locations, and they have all the seasonal specialty drinks.  The prices are higher of course, though because of being in the airport.
Worst service. They are totally confused. No manager in sight. If you are in a hurry dont even think about it.

Both service and quality are consistently good. I felt like a regular after only a few trips. Like any retail establishment, Starbucks especially, when they hire a new employee there's a good chance this employee will not know all the subtle nuances of the pricing or understand the strange ordering habits of the patrons.
I was half way done with my drink before I noticed a dead fly at the bottom. I don't know why I paid $5 for a drink with a dead bug in it.
This is my absolute favorite location! rarely do they get my order wrong and if it is wrong they fix it no problem. The staff is very friendly and the drive through time is always reasonable!

I love this Starbucks... Probably one of the busiest in the Spanish Springs East Sparks area. Always friendly and never got my order wrong... Sometimes the sand which might be a bit cool but heck I just press on.. The team does their best and probably can use some LEAN Management, heck they are always awesome.

This is the Starbucks in Target. I've been coming here since they've open. Everyone here is nice and patient. Mallory is the best!! She's always helping me customize my drink to my liking. I prefer going to this only versus the other one down the street.

This is an amazing Starbucks, I ordered a Violet Drink with 2 pumps of raspberry syrup, it's good and something I recommend trying,  The staff were so kind! A worker who made my drink, was off break, so when he went down the sidewalk he saw me and asked me if it was good, this is DEFINITELY, a good quality Starbucks, it wasn't to pricey, and it was definitely clean, and child friendly. Bathrooms are gender neutral, and they are very sanitary. They are #1 on my Starbucks list. If you are looking for somewhere to study on your computer, I recommend here, they are quiet and they know how to keep a place clean! This is one of the best places I've had Starbucks in awhile.

So glad we finally have a drive thru Starbucks here in Santa Barbara, I always hated going inside and talking to the barista and waiting in line. Service used to be quick when this place first opened for the first month or so but it's gotten a lot busier since word got out. Had to wait 15 min in the drive thru line once. Not sure if there was some barista in training who was slow or it was short staffed but I was almost late to work, plus the lady in the car  in front of me decided to make the barista show her all the Starbucks merchandise.

Deplorable service - was not greeted, waited to have my order taken, even though nobody else was in line.  There were 4 girls just standing around behind the counter.  They got the order wrong, but was afraid they might spit in it if I had them remake it.  I have never had a negative experience at Starbucks before this evening.  This location needs some customer service training!

Love my Large Sugar Free Cinnamon Dolce, Soy latte .... These are great. Every few though you will find one that is more bitter not sure why, but sometimes it's not perfect. I like the drive thru ability... So I come back.

This review isn't based off just a one time drive thru experience but many... it is probably the slowest service I've ever come across from any Starbucks. Everytime I went, it wasn't busy at all, there were no long lines so I don't know why it takes 10 mins to get 1 order of coffee.

It's rare for me to grant ANY starbucks a 5 star rating - but this is for SERVICE, SERVICE, SERVICE.  Isiah and David? was on point and greeted my like an old friend.  The other customers were all so friendly - it felt like a neighborhood coffee shop and not like a chain-Starbucks at all!

My drink (a basic latte) was perfectly fine, but the chit-chat made my day.
It made me realize how comparatively unfriendly my "regular" Starbucks (in Media) is.  And I am at that location several times per week!

Wish this was my defaut bux.

Shout out to Isiah and team for the beauty tips!  Ya'll rock some serious balayage!

Hours say open at 5:30am on Yelp. It's 6:36 and the door is locked with one person inside getting ready. Traveling on the interstate so just wasted about 20 minutes of travel time. Review is for hours only. Didn't get to sample wares.

This Starbucks is a few blocks from my work and I'm a frequent flier. I normally mobile order and pick up inside but on occasion, I do use the drive thru. The staff here is friendly and warm, which leaves an impression at 6:45 AM when I'm exhausted and heading into work. I've never gotten a wrong order here and even though they are pretty much always busy, quality does not suffer. If they are out of something, they readily make recommendations that are often better than what I was initially thinking. All in all, a great experience regardless of the day or time. One of the best Starbucks I've ever been to.

This is my very favorite very starbucks. I study here as often as possible. The only thing I would say that there are limited seats with access to outlets. The staff is amazing. I recommend times 100.
Good location, nice outdoor seating if kept cleaner, ambivalent staff, creamers usually empty, cramped indoor seating, nice window stools, long wait for drinks.

I love Starbucks but honestly, this is by far the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. When I went up to place my order, the cashier was too busy on her phone to notice me. When she finally looked up to take my order, she kept interrupting my order to talk to her friend. I ordered a medium green tea latte with soy milk and less ice. The barista that was making my drink did not add soy milk and filled it with regular ice because she was also busy chatting instead of paying attention to my order. This Starbucks is super unattentive and the staff cares more about being on their phones and talking to each other than paying attention to the customers.

This Starbucks is clean and staff is really friendly. I came here with my sister around 330pm on a weekday and it was a little busy but they did not rush us. Our drinks tasted awesome and cant wait to come back.

I wanted to visit this Starbucks several times before providing a review to make sure I was offering feedback for more than just one experience.  I have to say, this is a great location!! Each time I have visited inside, it has been very clean and the staff is upbeat and courteous!  I've been through the drive thru as well and experienced a little bit of a wait, but I find that to be normal since they make these delicious drinks to order.

Pro-tip:  If you're on a time crunch but need to get your coffee fix, order ahead using the Starbucks app and you can pop inside to grab your ready to go brew from the front counter!

Shakira makes my mornings so happy with smiles, laughs, an amazing attitude and warm personality. She gets me my coffee in usually under 10 seconds after ordering and its always a super tasty cup! I take the detour off my commute just for this starbucks! Thanks Shakira and the rest of the staff!
Great place, quite, clean, fast service. A+

This location is getting shut down at the beginning of December, so it seems they've stopped restocking a bunch of things like berries, sandwiches, and other things. Ordered on the app and none of my stuff was available or made correctly when I got there.
This place is nice since this my first time in Kirkwood, Missouri. Even though this is a small to medium size twon one can't leave without having to stop by a Starbuck's
This location is fantastic, short walking distance from my apartment so I can get the day started off with a venti americano pronto! The staff is great and have always been friendly and efficient.

Nice people but slow service. 10 minutes from order to first sip. 
Space is average size for a Starbucks, they do have a drive through....good if your in it, but slows down the inside.

I like this Starbucks even though I always forget it exists because of it's location. It's in the new shopping center where Wegmans is located but it faces 202 and it's not accessible from the road, you have to pull into the shopping center. 202 is also going up a hill in front of it so unless you are looking for it I feel like it's easy to miss.    It's a standard Starbucks in terms of layout and drive through. It has plenty of parking and a nice outdoor patio. Free WiFi.
God why does this place always seem to have like 2 people working the morning rush? It takes an eternity to get in and out of here even when there are only two people in line ahead of you.

The drive-thru line can block parking spaces if it gets super long, which it has a tendency to do. This can be very problematic if you're inside and come out wanting to leave your parking space.........

Other than that, it's your typical Starbucks. The inside is fairly small, but there are a decent number of tables and a couple comfy chairs where you can read, chat, or work.

Horrible customer service!! Literally stood there for a minute while 5 employees all talked to each other and the cashier lady just stared right through me! I wasn't sure wether to order or leave. Then she finally came back to earth and asked me if i wanted to order. Pretty sure that's why I'm standing there?! Got my drink and the barista made zero eye contact and didn't thank me. As a past Starbucks employee myself, they didn't do anything to standard and was the worst customer service I've encountered in a long time! Will not be back!

So i usually never write reviews. But i absolutely love this Starbucks. Every morning i am greeted by Bob, who is the sweetest man ever. He is always happy and makes my morning! Line moves quickly and my order is always right!

I've been waiting years for this location to open since it is super close to my job. Now, it's here! The good, it has a drive thru for all those convenience needs. The bad, the inside area is kind of odd to sit and relax in. The drinks are standard, staff seem to be learning all the drink querks, and the Peking is easy. This is a standard Starbucks and I only wish it had better seating options.

Joe the manager here has turned this place around!!! 
He understands customer service and has taught his people well!!
This store is now on fire and no complaints ever!
This Starbucks has it together! Staff is always super friendly, food/drinks always consistent! Drive thru is usually busy but it's worth the wait for a friendly barista and well prepared food/drink.

Not the easiest Starbucks to get to because of 202, but other than that, it's pretty much your typical Starbucks inside. During our visit, I think the cashier was in training as he seemed to be struggling with the orders, but other than that, no major issues. My order came out quickly and correctly. There is no drive-thru at this location.
Decent Starbucks but definitely would be better if they had a staff that actually knew what they were doing and you didn't have to explain to them what kind of drink that you wanted....

Starbucks is always a great backup plan when your local favorites are closed or not in the area. I usually go for a grande coffee with 2 add shots. Simple but great combo...My wife likes the scones and I will usually for an oatmeal with fruits and nuts. Overall nice and clean place with nice and friendly staff.
Not impressed. Small cramped place with inadequate seating. Barista wouldn't stop talking, which got irritating quickly. However, the coffee was of decent quality and the music was pleasant.

Ok, I am not one to write bad reviews. Especially for chains because I feel like you'll generally lose some quality somewhere along the way. But this Starbucks, I just will not ever be wasting my time here again. The past 3 times here, I've had my ordered messed up. 
First time, I got the wrong sandwich but correct drink.
Second, wrong drink and wrong bagel.
Today, wrong drink, right sandwich.
In all of this I know I've been "overcharged" in the sense where I should be getting some money back no matter the amount. But I just can't even bring myself to stay there any longer. The person at the window has always been sweet but I honestly would just like a correct order for once.

It's kind of rare for casinos to have a place like this where you can get an inexpensive coffee and sit in some comfy chairs and just take an extended break. Usually it's all about pushing you from machines/tables to an overpriced restaurant to the bar and they don't want you doing anything else there that doesn't involve money non-stop coming out of your pocket. So this Starbucks, which is like a typical one of their smaller locations with plenty of different types of seating, is a pleasant oddity.

Pricing is a bit higher than other locations in the area, but not much, about 20 cents more per drink. Open to midnight Friday and Saturday, I think 8 PM all other days.

Only issue is that there can be a monster line, but an hour or two after checkout time the place really mellows out. Well, that and they could be a bit more pro-active about cleaning the place up. Last visit they had 3 baristas chatting behind the counter with no line while there were old discarded coffee cups and casino drinks all over the tables.

i only went here once while i was visiting...but their bistro lunches are the BEST ive ever seen....maybe because its in the middle of a college & people are constantly on the go...ive been to a lot of starbucks & i really like this one...if i lived in philly this would be my starbucks of choice :)

Rudest workers I've ever encountered at a Starbucks location. I've given them multiple visits and each time something occurs. No greeting. No thank you. The order was wrong and when I asked a question about it, the barista at the drive up was snarky. I'll stick with the location near downtown Zionsville. It's worth the extra five minute drive.

Since there was a district convention event going on in the hotel, a lot of people were in line to buy drinks.

The service is really fast and the staff are still consistently friendly.

I got my drink within 5 min despite the long wait in line
Slowest. Starbucks. Ever. I don't understand why they take so long! The line is ridiculous because they can't seem to get orders in quick.

This is a very convenient Starbucks for me because it is right by my work. However, they often turn off their "order through the app" option. It's very inconsistent and it impacts my morning schedule.

It's a drive through!  It's early in the morning, you're on your way to work and you want to beat traffic. Here is the perfect place to get that cup of coffee. Staff will make you feel like they care about you. Service is quick, then you're on your way.  A must for teachers traveling from Odessa into Tampa. You know you need that 5:30 a.m. coffee fix to sweeten up your day!  Conveniently located right before the entrance to the Veteran's Expressway.

I've been to this Starbucks in Target three times. Twice they were out of regular coffee. TWICE. Two- thirds of the time. Sixty-six percent. The word COFFEE is in the name, right?

Yikes. 

The first time, I let it slide because everyone has an off day and the barista was by herself and seemed pretty busy- she made me an Americano (didn't tell me- just did it) and sent me packing. No biggie- but it didn't go unnoticed. 

Today, the same barista said she had to brew a new pot- I didn't have time to wait, told her so and she replied, "Ooooookkkkkaayyyy...." implying that it was my loss/fault.

Yuck.

Boo to you, Starbucks in Target. Boo.

I always place my orders through the mobile app when I'm in the area...while my order is always made correctly and the staff is extremely friendly, I always have to wait for my drink to be made. I hate to complain about that since my drink is made right, but I mean I order a head through the mobile app before I get there so I WONT have to wait once I arrive. Worst of all when this happens it's always slow, so there isn't even the excuse that they were fixing other peoples drinks 1st and hadn't gotten to mine yet.

Majority of the time I am going to Starbucks is on the way to work in the morning...it's early...not always the best mood...the people at Starbucks truly do brighten your day. From the moment you order in the drive through with the excitement in their voice and even the small talk they make at the window!

This is really one of the nicest Starbucks I've been in. The decor is very comfortable, the Google WiFi service is lightning fast, service is quick & friendly, and the drive-thru option outside is a great option for people on the go. I'm not crazy about the location right next to the KoP mall, but hey, you can't have everything. Now all they need is a Tiki bar and a dog play area, and I might move in.

Where is the management???

Employees are rude, disorganized, and obviously untrained. Is nobody running this store? I watched 3 customers get their orders before I did, even though I ordered before them. When I asked where my order was, the barista was very rude and rolled her eyes at me.

I have stayed at many hotels in my life. Of those hotels, several have had a Starbucks inside. But this is the first hotel I have stayed in that had a full service Starbucks and that is a nice perk.

When people visit New Orleans they often have a tendency to overdo the partying. That leads to dehydration, food cravings and the need for a massive influx of caffeine. I am not saying that happened to me, but this Starbucks was a very welcome addition to my stay at the Hyatt.

Since it is part of a massive chain, you already know what they have here. The sandwiches are a great snack or meal, and the coffee does contain caffeine. Service was friendly, but a bit slow. This could be because of the massive crowds so I cut them some slack, but it does bear mentioning.

If you stay at the Hyatt, come here. If not, it probably is out of your way and you don't care. Move along to my next review.

Great since it has a drive-thru. They took quite awhile to make my aunt's white chocolate mocha, but my drink came out quickly. The cashier was very nice though and we chatted while we waited so it wasn't too bad. I just love me some Starbucks.
They make the most delicious venti soy sugar free decaf latte ever.  The people at the register are so nice; the people actually MAKING the drink?   they can be salty.

5/5 Stars.

Why?

I walked in here today looking for some refuge from the scorching STL heat/humidity as well as a temporary respite from waiting around for Izakaya Ren to friggin' open! (Who takes a "Lunch Break" from 2:00pm - 4:30pm anyway? I guess they just don't get enough biz between those hours to warrant staying open. Understandable.)

Anyhoo. I walked into SBux, on my phone, looking like a rambly idiot as per usual. I hung up and skittered over to the counter where a very peppy woman wanted to take my order. Oh, and believe me when I say "wanted." It was like she was born to be friendly and serve coffee or something, haha, IDK. Not trying to be condescending here either. She was SO helpful. I remarked that I've been wanting to try a "Cake Pop" for a long(-ass) time now and that I wondered how many calories exactly is in the Birthday Cake flavor. (Mostly out of curiosity because they have an advert that boasts each one only being inbetween 170 and 190 each. So it was almost like a bizarre urge to play the Price is Right only with calories and cake pops!) She hurried around the counter to the customer side to grab me a brochure with all of the calorie contents in each food item at Sbux (forgive my crude acronyms) and pointed out each one to me. Wow. 

I settled on a Birthday Cake Pop (which she attested was their most popular flavor) and then I inquired about getting a Tea Latte. I haven't really been to an Sbux in a long time (as you could have probably guessed) so I had no idea what went into a "Tea Latte"....she immediately grabbed the cards on how to make each drink and rifled through them. I told her it was okay and she didn't have to but she said it would be good for her to touch up her drink making skillz anyway. (O_o;)  She even accommodated my bizarro request for wanting it made with sugar free syrup and low fat skim milk. (Haha I am such a jerk...or rather my diet is such a jerk.) When she asked for a first name for the cup, I told her "Kate" and she even made sure she was spelling it correctly, "With a 'K', right" Omg! So adorable. :]

It took the other girl a little while to make it but I wasn't in any big hurry anyhow. When she called my name I came over and she apologized profusely for taking a little longer than usual to make the drink and even offered to completely re-do it if I didn't like it. Holy cow. Yeah, I was pretty much floored by this point.

The drink was amazing, and the cake pop was sooo fresh. My mum had warned me about getting a stale one once so either I got lucky or....maybe this is just the Starbucks from some bizarre parallel universe where big corporate chains randomly decide to bend over backwards for their customers. Even the interior was sparkly clean, neat, smelled nice, and was relatively quiet for a Starbucks. Damn. Impressive. It looked kinda new too, maybe that's why. There's only one other review for this location so yeah...I am not familiar with this part of town.

All in all, good experience. I can't believe I just wrote this long of a review for friggin Starbucks, people!!!

(The girl who made the drink even smiled tenderly at me on the way out....she was cute too....maybe she fancied me? Ooooh.) :D *is  creepy*

Edit:
Is it weird that I'm finding myself wanting to go back to just this location? @__@; maybe if only to flirt with the cute blonde gal who made my tea latte, or maybe to enjoy atmosphere again! But I am secretly afraid that if I keep coming back, it will lose its magic, like a little kid at the city museum. *weird* xD
Slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. Consistently, every time, S. L. O. W.  Food and drinks are good when you eventually get them.

Quick service both drive- thru and counter.  Always have bakery items and sandwiches. I've gotten to know all employes since I frequent at least once a day. Baristas even know my drink before ordering- that's awesome customer service. There are plenty of seats, both inside and outside on the patio.

Worst Starbucks ever. 20 minutes in drive Thru  with 3 cars ahead of me. No apology at window, not even hey coffee is in the house for your wait. Then when finally get to the window she makes me wait another 3 min while she took an order and didn't hand me coffee.  I was late to get back to work on my lunch break because of how long they took! Ridiculous

Recognition and thank you to "Keena" at the Carpinteria location. New Barista I was told. I had to get a temporary Wells Fargo Debit Card. And for my second time this week, my temp card didn't work on Starbucks system. Nowhere else having issues. I didn't have cash but really wanted my usually coffee and sandwich. Mentioned I live around the corner and will be back with cash.   To my delight and surprise Keena said with a smile..."Don't worry about it. I'll put it on my account since I already have it ready. Have a wonderful day". 

Should she have done this? Probably not encouraged. I understand. However she took initiative and had empathy. Made a judgement call. I appreciate it. Treated me as a person and not a transaction. 

I got home and was wondering how much I've spent at Starbucks last two years since I've moved to Carpinteria.So.... I pulled up Wells Fargo transactions and answer is $2,394 dollars. Over $900 at the Carpinteria location alone. 

Wish Keena well at the company. Tough job but little acts of kindness go a long way. Good team at the this location. I usually keep to myself. Staff that makes the extra effort like this keep me coming back. 

Thank you, 
Scott

This review is for the Starbucks located near the food court between Terminal B & C. It is not a review of the new location within Terminal C. 
Please see my attached photo of the pure filth that is ALWAYS present at this location. I'm not sure who the manager is of this DUMP, but HE/SHE needs to be replaced. Someone with some backbone needs to FIX this location, otherwise I'm hoping that the airport authorities pull the plug on this location for health concerns as well as super nasty service. I'm come thru this area way way too often and I'm always expecting that change for the better, but tonight... it was the worst ever. The employees here don't know the first thing about customer service and keeping a clean food, coffee experience. They all need to go, and that starts at the top. Otherwise, please PHL Airport Authorities, it's time to shut this place DOWN! 

AVOID AT ALL COST. 

Better options are located as you walk towards Terminal C. 

If I could rate Zero to Negative stars, I would....

The layout of the shop seems better than many, allowing seating without feeling swarmed when a lineup forms. And the service any time I've been in has been prompt and friendly. 

Today I met the barista Lindsay, and she was friendly and efficient. Even though I was midway into a to-the-door lineup, she took a minute to engage in some friendly banter as she took my order and got my beverage started.

The shop is clean, well-maintained, and well organized. Oh, and they have a deck patio! Not ideal today with the melting snow but great once the snow is gone. 

I pass two other Starbucks to get here, including one that's less than a block from my apartment, and I never regret making the trip.

Yes its great to have a Starbucks inside a hotel in the morning near the lobby on your way out for those who thrive on their daily dose of Starbucks but jeez this location doesn't have anything convenient that the usual Starbucks has. Quiet tables, "free" wifi, decent drinks are all very lacking. Having one person working in the morning both the register and drinks is great for making long lines and grumpy people. It also doesn't help that the drinks were meh craptastic.

Visitors should note that there is no standard Starbucks WiFi, the usual one offered through AT&T, but instead you're stuck with the $8/day convention center WiFi service which is only accessibly on the first floor of the hotel/casino at Grand Sierra. If you happen to be staying overnight at Grand Sierra and need the interwebs, that's another $12/day for the connection there. Um.. no thanks.
Friendliest baristas !!! Love the clientele that go there ...I have never had a complaint ever there ..

This is a crazy-busy Starbucks but the baristas are especially friendly. I don't like the store layout - you have to squeeze past mobile order and pick up to get to the registers to order. Seating is also tight so it's not designed for guests to linger or have coffee shop meetings.

I like the Starbucks brand but this is certainly one of their worse locations. They seem to have a new person every day so turnover must be high. They also won't cut the bushes back from the drive thru line so your car will absolutely be scraped by them exiting the line. The staff isn't that friendly, definitely not uniformly knowledgeable. You'll get a different answer almost every time about the menu, the staff makes it up on the fly. Extremely long wait times even when you're the only car in the line with a one drink order. Unkempt location, trash flying around the parking lot. Today there was a lot of trash and branches in the drive thru line. One annoying thing is they take your card and will put it in the card reader and leave it in there while it just beeps forever and you can't easily reach it to grab it back. Remember it's always a long wait so you'll be listening to it for a while!

It's a sad day when a Starbucks has bad customer service. Her name is Jo and you'd think with a name like that she'd understand mix ups between Erin and Aaron but she wanted to blame me for handing me my sausage egg sandwich and nitro cold brew. The receipt was a mobile order and I am Aaron, then after her coworkers asked her she tried to blame me EVEN MAKING ME GO TO THE TRASH FOR THE RECEIPT. Yes, I had to go into the trash to get my receipt. Never again Jo, I pray management sees this and other poor reviews and decides to do something about it.

Okay I'm shocked!!!! It is the Busiest time of the year & Starbucks have 2 employees working!!! Tomorrow is Christmas Eve Day!! I really feel bad for the young man making all the drinks!!! The young lady is at the register and trying to help and keep customers happy. I figure STARBUCKS is either cheap or no one else would work. Just makes NO sense!!!

Not much to review ... it's a Starbucks; what can you say, except to be glad they have one in the mall! You get your drink, and hope it's up to par. If not, they'll make you another one. So relax, and hope they get your drink right. Also, prices are a little higher than other stores, the barista couldn't explain why. But that's ok- maybe they're a privately operated. 

There are few tables and chairs, so it is convenient to stop, have coffee, and strategize shopping plans. 

They use the app, and it's convenient.
Worst Starbucks in service and efficiency in America probably but it's the only one in the The Gulch so location keeps it open.

Just stopped by this morning, 8 am on a Sunday, and the barista Chris was so nice, and pleasant. I love starbucks coffee in general, but I wanted to point out specifically this barista because it is not often you find sweet, people who care about you and your morning! My morning was not going so well, and his positive energy was amazing and made the whole starbucks a better place. Thanks Chris.

This Starbucks is the absolute slowest coffee shop I have ever been to. I have used both the drive-thru and gone in multiple times. Expect to spend at least a half hour doing either. It is not that this Starbucks is anymore crowded than most others- they are just under-staffed, don't know how to quickly make the drinks, or simply slow moving. Considering this is a business-oriented location it's quite surprising.
Typical Starbucks. Everybody is very nice. The drinks are good. The reason I'm counting off two stars is because of the crazy prices and slow drive through.
Fast service if no line. If more than 3 in line plan a 15 min wait. Not staff fault just lots of spring break fraps. Nice staff once ordered too 3 mins w hot sandwich. Gold card worked fine on phone
Big, open efficient Starbucks. Weekday late morning there are plenty of comfy chairs. I like this location and wish I lived closer.
What's with not being able to get a venti strawberry smoothie. Can only get a grande. Tried to new molten chocolate. Tons of chocolate left on the bottom. It was cold and skimpy on the whipped cream.

This place needs some work.. ordered a caramel frap and a cookie dough cake pop.. I was told the cake pop was out of stock. I asked which flavors they did have.. and she said cookie dough or chocolate. So I said okay I'll take the cookie dough. It was silent and she goes "so you want a cake pop?" I confirm, yes the cookie dough one like I asked three times now. Get to the window- I ask if I can pay cash but still use my rewards, she says yes. Takes my phone and then charges my card- WTF?? Come on Starbucks. Get your crap together.

VERY RUDE worker!! If possible, avoid this location! Overall, the service was slow but most of the employees were friendly... except the lady. Unfortunately, my drink wasn't made correctly, so when I let the worker know my drink wasn't right, she was really rude about it and remade it incorrectly again! She literally threw the straw when she set the drink down, so I just gave up and left. I visit Starbucks several times a week, and I rarely have a drink made incorrectly... but when I do, the workers are always happy to fix it. This worker was the only lady there, so I feel sorry for the other employees in the store who have to work with her... Based on the other poor Yelp reviews, I would recommend VISITING A DIFFERENT LOCATION if you can.

i am not even going to try this location anymore.  not sure about other times of the day, but midday they are the slowest staff i have ever seen.  i am not sure if it's a lack of help or if they just have zero sense of urgency.  i have walked out several times.  i'll take my business to the starbucks in the neshaminy mall--parking + entering/exiting the mall and i will still crush my wait time here.

Oh boy. If you're in the Gulch and you're looking for god-awful service, this is the place for you. They'll take your order, but hardly will they ever actually make your order. So after sitting there for 10 minutes wondering where on earth your food is, you'll have to shout to one of the employees that they forgot your order. They'll ask you to re-tell them your order because it never occurred to any of them to write anything down. Manager is rude, and refuses to apologize or do anything about the horrible service. I would tell you not to come here, but it's a Starbucks in the gulch so everyone will inevitably come here no matter how horrible the service is.

This Starbucks often goes unnoticed because it is tucked away in a shopping center with a lot of businesses, but the store is really nice inside and the service is always top notch.  If you have an early morning game at Golden Eagle or an early tee time at Redhawk, this is your spot!
Worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Trash was all over the floor yesterday. Drink was made with waaaaaaay too much cream.
New location. Service was quick and friendly. Food and coffee were as expected from Starbucks

Product is always the same so no reason to comment on it....they can make my tea right,,,too bad half the time I come here I get attitude served with it too. I can do without that first thing in the morning!

I did an online order. I arrived there 10mins after I placed my order. They were busy so I waited when I looked at the time, I had waited already 10mins. I went in line and wait. Once I spoke with cashier, my order had not been completed. They said they would take care of it. In total, it took me 30mins to receive what I ordered. I waited because I did not know how to cancel my order from online and get refunded. When I left, I realized my order was incorrect as well. I did not return back since I did not want to wait anymore additional time. I do like Starbucks, but I will not be returning to this location.

I visit the Brentwood location about twice a week. Every time it is absolutely packed. The baristas always have a smile on their faces and never fail to welcome a single customer into their store. They always have a positive attitude no matter how busy they are. I have worked in customer service and in restaurant business, and I have never seen a more well oiled machine. So I thank you and the Brentwood & White staff for making my routine Starbucks a real treat
The lady Emmma was rude and unprofessional. Starbucks shouldn't have people like that working there. Ruined a whole business. It's sad.

The drive thru is usually pretty good and the people are nice. Great location for sure, super convenient. 

Word of advice: never ever go inside. Every time I've been inside they've messed up my order or forgotten to make my drink completely. I get my drink in my personal cup and every time they've set down the cup and forgot to make the drink. I waited 20+ minutes once. Horrible horrible experience inside and they weren't apologetic. Drive thru is convenient but never go inside

I agree with the other reviewers...not very friendly...no friendly greeting. My girl and I had coffees (although they filled hers halfway and then said they were out of the blonde roast (??). And we had no idea our hot breakfast sandwich was made. They let it sit on their counter without telling us. And no comfortable chairs...not the nice leather ones like the others, despite the space here.

My favorite Starbucks.  I like seeing the same crew and like that they remember my normal breakfast order when I come in.  It helps that I'm not in a rush when I stop in but the staff is generally very friendly.

Never would I think I'd make a review for Starbucks cuz come on, it's Starbucks. But here goes; So made a Starbucks run and came in here with my 2 friends for 7 drinks. 4 hot lattes and a hot chocolate. They didn't want to give me sleeves for my hot drinks cuz they were running low and wanted to reserve them for "really hot drinks". I told her we did have hot drinks but she said they really aren't and really hot drinks are like Americano's  I mean really? I've never experienced this and don't think we really need to be ordering $5 lattes and have a cheap Starbucks be stingy with sleeves. Kinda ridiculous for a company that makes millions.  On brother...

I've had several off experiences with this location which is disappointing since it's so nice to grab a coffee and shop.
