Twice I've gotten an incorrect order but had already left the mall before finding this out. I also got a salad, took it back to work and found that it was mostly black goo lettuce. Not sure what's going on with this location but hoping that they get it back on track.

First time here

Quiet

Lots of tables

Friendly service

Outdoor tables too

Big parking lot

Will return

This is my favorite Starbucks in Saint Petersburg. Usually I wouldn't write a review for something like a Starbucks, but I love this location! The staff is SOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO friendly. Every time I'm here, they make sure everything is perfect for me. And it ALWAYS is delicious and more than one I ask for. Cinnamon chai frap. Is consistently made to perfection. This is the only place I trust to hook me up. Thanks so much guys.

Perched inside the old Moorestown Trust Company, (name is still at the top of the structure) the building has since then been converted into a duplex, with the Starbucks to the right and a Subway to the left of the entrance. The architectural design certainly stands out with their giant Corinthian columns, contrasting the brick buildings nearby and embellishing the cozy design of the Starbucks inside, adding for a perfect look to the Main Street of Moorestown. The interior offers only space for maybe a handful of groups, with no tables looking like they'd fit more than 4 at a time, while outside, they offer a few more table options in the warmer weather, keeping you connected  to the mildly busy Main Street.
worst starbucks i have ever been to.  they made a drink and refused to remake it for it being incorrect.  i paid twice, the second time it took 30 minutes for a cold brew

Despite the Starbucks.com website and the sign posted on the door of this location saying it opened at 5 am, when I arrived at nearly 5:30 the employees were in the back parking lot and told me they weren't open.
Slow service. Be prepared to wait 30 minutes when line is 10+. Absolutely ridiculous. Employees need training with registers and a kick of urgency.
Great coffee but this stores hours are awful. Seriously.
Worst service ever, got my order completely wrong and it tasted like trash!!  Don't come to this Starbucks, you'll be wasting your money

If I was to leave a review before today I would have been 5 starts, but today is the day Starbucks lost my business for a very long time or for good. I frequent this Starbucks at least 3-4 times per week. With the virus scare they have shut down the store to drive up only. My medium duty wrecker can not fit in drive through. Today I was refused service bc I was standing in the drive through, which is funny bc last Thursday the staff told me I was always welcomed to walk up to the window. Not very good service to someone who is essential to people and i am not refusing road services to anyone

Of the elite superheros and gold medal winning award winning Starbucks teams I have encountered these guys would probably get a silver or bronze. Not always the most professional but they are friendly most of the time. 

Do love the comfy couches and chairs! Cleanliness worries me a little bit just at how often the floors are a bit dirty but this is a perfect starbucks for the Village of Zionsville!

I'm not a Starbucks fan, but if you're in the Willow Grove Mall looking for coffee, this it. Baristas were very efficiently working their way through a fairly long line. Place is clean, and it's in the "food court" with convenient seating, pleasant lighting under skylights, clean seating area. Very strong dark roast, almost with a burnt flavor. I don't drink it, but shockingly they were out of the cold brew, which must be a bestseller at a place like this.
Every time I come to this location my wait time is always over 10 minutes. If the customer volume is high add more people to your payroll.

These guys can't do math.  I have been here 8 times and every time paid cash but got the wrong amount of change back (always too little).  I am beginning to think that the whole crew must be doing it on purpose. The first time I gave $10.43 when the bill was $5.43 expecting $5 back but they gave me $1.00.  And every time after little screw ups with the change.  It's hard to screw up coffee, but apparently very easy to screw up giving the right amount of change back. If you go here and pay cash, count your change.

Centrally located in the meadows mall, Starbucks is an oasis in the crowded shopping mall.
With all there favorites, espresso, cappacino, latte, chat tea, frapachinno and more there seems to be a small line all day.
The coffee is OK, not great, but the padded seats and free Wi-Fi make for a good people watching area and to get work done.
Ugg.. the drive-thru is super slow. Don't come if you are in a hurry or are late to work. We came at 7pm and 2 people in line and it still took 15 mins to get our drinks.

This location has a drive thru! Yay! I used the Starbucks app and came in. This Starbucks is near the ALBERTONS and just across the way from the lunchbox waxing salon. Kill a few birds with one stone.

Same ole Starbucks. They are all pretty much one in the same. The baristas are friendly and they seem to mix up some wicked brews.

This is my first Starbucks experience in Idaho and it's not bad.
All of our drinks were made wrong. All of them. One the substituted for something else because they were out and they didn't even warn us before making the drink.

I tried ordering a Vanilla Cold Brew Sweet Cream without the vanilla syrup. The lady said they couldn't do that. I get it all the time. I told her it's just a normal drink without the syrup. It was frustrating but she told me they make it with heavy cream and half and half or something and I said I just want however it's made but without vanilla syrup... anyways at the pick up counter this little boy came up asking for his apple juice (I don't think he realized his dad had it) and the baristas all laughed at him and it was totally not nice. Luckily I don't think the boy noticed (he was like 5 years old). But it was just rude.

This review regards this location, not the amazing food and drinks.
This starbucks is a local hangout for high schools, like baldwin and shipley. I think that everyone agrees that their parking lot is atrocious. It is impossible to find parking, especially in the morning. It is always hard to sit down and some on the seating in the left side of the starbucks is really weird (there are two big tables that are simply awkward). Some of the baristas there is super friendly, but it isn't rare that I get a non-attentive barista.

I love this Starbucks!! I travel for work, so I go to a lot of Starbucks all over the US & I have to say that this location is one of my favorites! I usually order the same drink but occasionally I want something different. They are always helpful. When I redeem my rewards they are just as helpful & always polite with a smile!  My Latte is always perfect too! My drink is a grande triple shot Latte so I know how it should taste. Some locations don't get it right but this location always gets it right! However, there is one employee who is not as nice and helpful as the others. She wasn't helpful when my Starbucks app was not working. Not that it's her job but she acted as if it was an inconvenience when I asked her about it, even though I had my cash in hand because the app wasn't showing any money. I've had the same experience with her on several occasions.

This Starbucks WAS my favorite in Philly, the workers were friendly, fast, and the quality of the store was very good. This was a place I could get work done, and didn't feel like I was in the way, the store was also very clean, and comfortable. Lately the quality has dropped, the drink I usually get (Hot White Chocolate Mocha) doesn't even taste the same, the staff is very short with people and will often get rude with you. When you ask a question they act as if educating and informing customers is not apart of their job. I will not be visiting this location in the future because the new staff lacks substance.

I'll start by mentioning I am a regular at Starbucks, I am there everyday. As I ordered my drink today an employee decided work was the appropriate place to talk about a protest she participated in. She also mentioned how she spoke poorly to the police that were present at the protest. You are free to have your beliefs, but work is not the time to publicize those beliefs, especially when all you patrons aren't anti- police. I won't be visiting this location again and I'll be sure my pro- police friends and family don't either.

While I may not be the biggest fan of Starbucks - you know, it's the whole "giant chain" thing. I just prefer to support local! Also, I don't love their cappuccino, the espresso just tastes bitter. Of course you can't taste it in a big, fancy, 900 calorie frappuccino... Another reason why I don't like Starbucks, it's yet another American chain that is geared to getting people f-a-t! But enough of what I don't like about SatrB's and on to what I really like about this location: I just love the location! High Street is so quant, full of adorable shops and free parking. Then there is the patio situated under the gigantic sprawling trees of the east Glenora address - shaded and breezy in the summer, gorgeous in the fall with a plethora of falling leaves. In the winter you can sit in the big windows and watch the snow fall as you work. They also have 4 stools up at the counter which is a cool spot to park yourself and your laptop. So, if I'm going to be at a Starbucks, this is definitely the one!

An amazing Starbucks! This is easily one of the busiest locations in the city, especially during rush hour, but the baristas easily keep up with it and get drinks out in a reasonable time at a great quality. The staff is friendly and maintain a positive environment. I wish there was more seating, because if there was, I'd spend hours and hours there! Love the Comcast Starbucks and baristas!
The service was great met my friend there for coffee. It has be come my favorite meeting place. My coffee was very good. Smooth and full of flavor.

I was in this Starbucks for 10 minuets waiting on 2 drinks. 2 people in front of me. The employees are more interested in their social life than serving their guests. At one point the barista had my drink completed and was just holding it in her hand talking to another employee. I will never return back to this location.

I've been to this Starbucks multiple times, they have great service! The only thing that bothered me is that I don't think the barista knew what topping is... I ordered an iced chestnut praline latte with extra topping. I didn't taste the crunchy topping, so I went to ask if she put any and to put more of so. When she went to put the topping, she added 2 more pumps to my drink. I didn't complain because I can really taste the chestnut praline in my drink. However, the only thing missing from my drink is the Chestnut Praline crunchy topping that I love :'( Other than that, great service!

While the parking isn't ideal, the staff are incredible. 

They're talented and caring! They remember your name and have an interest in serving each customer well. Holly is the manager and she's active in the store and does a good job of picking the right employees. 

The people behind the counter are just incredible. Lucky to call this "my" Starbucks!

Closest Starbucks to my friend's house. Fast efficient. Baristas were friendly. I walked in and it was empty. The drive-through had a long line. 
The parking lot is a bit precarious. Be careful!
Very rude to me and my friends when asked for water. Told us we suck and then ignored our order when people who ordered after us were getting their coffees. Will not go back

This is a great Starbucks to come to. I love spending a couple of hours working on my school/personal work. The team members are always smiling and they get my order right. Definitely recommend this place.

I think Sybille is right, we could all go for a midnight frapp. That being said, I commuted here from Boyertown to get coffee. Boyertown only has Dunkin Donuts or Turkey Hill Gas Station. The woman who did monthly updates for her reviews was right, there was an older woman. When we first walked in, the line was about 10 people long with just the older woman. We decided to walk around until the line died down (10 minutes). When we came back, the last lady in line was only 3 away from the front, but a younger woman had come back from a break, I guess. All Starbucks drinks pretty much taste the same. The Madeline cookies we got were stale. Went back 24 hours later, same woman working. Quicker service because there wasn't a long line. Ordered 3 of the same drinks because Monica said she consistently had good drinks. They were all the same. Lol, great work xo
Great Starbucks! Could have been cleaner but the barista was super nice and made conversation with me which is a great example of how customer service should be!

Friendly customer service every time I come here. Rarely more than 1 car in front of me in the drive thru. Took off one store only because about 80% of the time they don't have their Veranda blend coffee brewed. I know they don't get many that ask for it but it's my favorite!

Great study place! I got to enjoy a caramel brûlée frapp. Best part of winter. One of the employees even walked around giving free samples of a dessert (Cranberry Bliss?) that was absolutely delicious!

I don't know much about other items it offers, but I do love the *Iced Green Tea Coffee Latte* there. I've tasted this one at bunch of Starbucks in Philla, and another one is near Broad street, Temple Univ., which is also neat. But I used to go to this one where is near my house to do my reading assignments every weekends, and I'll definitely buy a cup of green tea coffee latte.

The only drawback there, I would say, I feel a little noisy if I sit in the upstairs, cause there are always vibrating the coffee machines underneath.. and the seats having good lights are limited, but if you don't work with readings, you can choose the secondaries.

I love Starbucks. I am a regular customer, but I've always had problems with this location. But on this one instance my friend and I went in there and we were in a hurry. We were Almost the only ones in there on a Sunday night not even close to closing time. We ordered two drinks and sat there wondering why they're taking so long. Then when we are about as we saw they were sitting on the counter. The ice had melted and my friends drink and my drink was no longer warm. I was very frustrated because they could see that we were sitting there waiting for our drinks for a while. They never called our drinks or our names we would've heard because we were the only ones in there at that time. Very frustrating when they were all just standing there and you were waiting for drinks but didn't say anything which made my friend and I very late to our event.

In the age of franchise coffee, the atmosphere of this location make it worth a revisit. This crew is just amazing- super friendly service, hilarious banter behind the counter- and makes you feel like you're part of the community somehow. I don't care about any other Starbucks, but this one is super special.

Gorgeous new location! It's very trendy and looks unlike all other locations in Nashville. The store is still very new so they may have a few kinks to work out, so I can overlook a few mishaps (extra wait time and not adding almond milk to my coffee...definitely not the end of the world!). They have a cooler for a greater variety of cold to-go food options. It's an odd layout because the front of the store is the drive-thru ordering station so the windows are on the back of the building. Give it a try if you're in the area!
Drinks are fine, and the employees are nice, but the outside area is consistently dirty--trash surrounding the sitting areas. Kinda gross unfortunately.

I went to buy a gift card. No one said hello. The music was insanely load though, so maybe they said it lightly. Either way obviously they didn't care. I picked out my gift card. Brought it up front. The girl just stared at me. So I told her I needed to put $10 on this gift card. She then looked at me like I was an idiot and asked if I needed to preload more money. I told her no, I needed to get this gift card (the one I handed her) for $10. To which she replied in a very condescending tone you want to buy a gift card with a gift card. I said no again and said I needed to get this card with $10 on it. To which she came back with a where did you get this card. I told her at the rack in the front and pointed to it. She then just rang it up and said $10. Overall my experiences with this Starbucks are lackluster. The employees are unnecessarily rude and blasé. I 100% would not recommend visiting this location. It's a beautiful Starbucks in a pippin' location with the RUDEST staff ever.

This area needed a reliable starbucks! It's got the perfect atmosphere to sit down and do work without being too overwhelmed. The whole team always does an excellent job preparing our drinks. 

Maddie, Zac, and Emily are always there when I'm there and they are really friendly, provide great customer service, and know my drink by heart! 

Keep it up guys!
I purchased a Starbucks from this poorly ran store asked for a water cup she refused because this is not a corporate location poorly run don't use this Starbucks.

I normally wouldn't bother writing a review for someplace as generic as a Starbucks, but the staff  here is so amazingly friendly and quick that I had to give them a shout out. It's sadly becoming more uncommon to find people in food service who aren't giving you attitude or busy checking their cell phones or whatever these days, but the baristas here not only don't do this, they also completely respect the urgency of the long lines and I've NEVER encountered any of them in a bad mood!

For such a small location, they're always prompt and friendly.  I've never had a bad drink and the pastries are great too.  

Target & Coffee - all in one place - what more do you need?

I like this Starbucks a lot I mean there is actual parking here unlike a lot of other places. Plus Irvington rulesss not just because I work here but Irvington plus coffee equals greatness. The staff are really.good here to. The only problems I have are that it does get overly busy here in the inside so on a cold day there is no sitting. And my coffee does not always come out the best but everyone makes mistakes no big deal

My little sister and I frequent this location and we love it. We always go through the drive thru and we have never had a problem. The people who work the drive thru are extremely polite and nice. Great job to whoever does the hiring there. The coffee is delicious as it is most Starbucks. Quick and friendly service every time always equals a 5 star review from me! Great job!

I have never had such rude service at a Starbucks before. Quite shocking for the area of Nashville. I walked in used the restroom and went to the counter where I was the only person in line and waited while being ignore for at least 4 minutes while the lady carried on a conversation with her co worker all while Counting her tips. Once she finally finished and announced her grand total of tips she finally recognized that I was standing there patiently waiting to order. She was not very friendly nor apologetic for the wait. 

I order my drinks and my brothers (all the same drinks) and once received walked outside and took a sip of my drink and recognized that it didn't taste like it normally does. So I walked back into the store where the lady who made the drink basically told me that it's not normally a sweet drink and do I want her to add sweetener? My brother also at this time tried his drink and verified his wasn't sweet either and came in behind me as I'm speaking to the lady. The other lady jumps into the conversation and basically says that his normal Starbucks is not making his drink following the recipe. So they are not normally sweet. However they can add vanilla sweetener to our drinks if we would like. Instead of arguing with them we accepted the vanilla sweetener and went on our way. 

I felt this duo are just lazy and argumentative and did not want to remake the drinks properly.

This Starbucks seems more organized then most.
But more importantly, the coffee and other drinks are consistently Starbucks... so you know what hat your getting before you order...
In the outlet mall so no drive-thru
Lots of outdoor seating a little cramped inside

We waited in the drive thru for 20 minutes for two drinks.  Watching the four bumbling idiots work behind the counter, they were moseying from one drink to another like they didn't have a care in the world.  When the drive thru is backed up twenty minutes, you need to get the lead out of your ass!

This place used to be awesome, always was quick, kind, and correct. Recently things have started to change. I've come here probably 5 times the past month to get the drink I always get, the nitro cold brew, and they've been out of it every time. I'm no longer wasting my time at this location.

Such nice service. I didn't hear my name so my drink sat for a few and she offered to make me a new 1 even though it was my fault and still got (actually perfectly cooled). I said no but what a nice offer!

Over 25 minutes. Never got my coffee. I was stuck in the drive through with no way out. They didn't seem to make anything until you got to the window. We were then late for a show that we had plenty of time for. Horrible start to our evening!!!
Sick of such long lines. Hire more help and stop understaffing the place! I shouldn't have to wait 16 minutes for an iced coffee!
Super quick when you're in need of some caffeine and breakfast first thing in the am!

What they made is couldn't be further from what I ordered.  And I specifically asked to add a banana in my smoothie to get some extra potassium. The guy with wired hair said. We don't have it and we do not care.

We live right down the street, so this is usually our go to place, but it is not consistent, by any means. 

We order the same thing every time. I get iced coffee with just a touch of coconut milk. Sometimes I'm charged to extra, sometimes I'm not. No big deal, but it is annoying when I ask about it, and now I'm the jerk because they're not consistent on their register. 

What really upset me about this location was my fiancé always gets iced coffee with classic syrup and some half and half. Easy enough, right? 
The last time we went, they didn't add any creamer, and directed him to their condiment bar. Every other time they've added it, why not this time? 
The girl not adding the creamer prompted me to ask if the classic was in there. All of a sudden, I'm the jerk for questioning her barista abilities. "Uh, yeah! You ordered it that way!"
We also ordered it with creamer, sweetheart. 

I'm more than happy going out of the way to a different location when I see certain employees working. I wish there was some consistency, because there's some really sweet baristas here!
As far as Starbucks' go, you could not ask for a better team. This store is always running very smoothly - even when the line is to the door and there are 20 cars in the drive-thru!

The problem here is that there was a shift in management a few months ago and the baristas see no urgency in providing for the customer. I gave them a few months before saying anything, but they have just not improved. EXTREMELY SLOW! The associates seem miserable and disinterested. Some have even admitted to it. Being that I also work in the mall and sometimes only have 30 min break, I could be the 3rd person in line but still wait 20 minutes for an iced coffee!
My family and I enjoy Tampa Premium Outlet and our experience at this Starbucks has always been fast, friendly and efficient with excellent service!
There's a red head male worker there. He is fantastic. He asked me how to spell my name. Anyway, if you see this review hit me up let's be best friends @whitness_myfitness on IG.

I go to this location about once a week and I really enjoy the barista's. They are super friendly and accommodating to my off the menu orders. My daughter loves the Pink Drink and other fruit beverages. I gravitate to different iced coffee or cold brew concoctions. Also the egg white sou-vied bites are a great option for those counting calories. 

I love the ample seating, outlets, but hey can you turn up the heat in there. I always need to keep my coat on while I'm there, even if drinking a warm beverage. :)

One time I came and the espresso machine was broken and another time it was so loud I couldn't work. Most previous time I came I did a mobile order. I was pretty surprised it was already ready when we walked in. We sat down, logged into the free wifi on my laptop, and began working. Within minutes I jumped a little when one of the baristas slammed the metal sliding door to the ice every time she opened and closed it. So annoying! It was distracting us so much that we wanted to leave as soon as possible. Hopefully I don't ever return when that barista is there...
Other than a couple weird situations, this Starbucks has a good amount of seating, is spacious inside, has outdoor seating, has a new sleek look, and is easy to pull in and out of. They have nice, friendly staff and I have always received a correct order. Plus, they have nitro brew!

The Irvington Starbucks gets it right! The team today and the team that was there Thanksgiving morning were both so professional and on point. The drinks are consistent and they never sound annoyed with a complicated order. Thanks folks for always taking great care of us!

This starbucks location is far from impressive. I've been here multiple times and found the trash overflowing from the can, flies by the food, and specialty drinks having run out. The baristas play around and waste time while making your drink. All of these things could be fixed with just a little better management.
This Starbucks is by far the worst one I have ever been to. I have been waiting almost 45 mins for two Chai tea lattes. I could literally make it myself faster!! Poor system, poor service.

Standard Starbucks drive trough, with exception that in rush hour traffic waiting in line is blocking access for guests who like to park and walk-in. Poor design for accessibility. Like many other stores internet access is painful. Since the change was made year or more ago it was promised auto login for customer with app. That doesn't happen at all, including this location.

First time coming to the new location on Calle Real & Turnpike! The drive thru girl was super friendly and great attitude. I asked for light ice for my drink, they kinda went heavy on the ice. But I'd definitely come back.
I am so glad we have a drive thru nearby!!

This Starbucks is typically pretty slow on service and disorganized. I always know never to chance dropping in here if I'm in a hurry. It isn't rare to have a 15 minute trip in total just to simply pick up a latte because of the service.
Nice location, but service is way too slow. Sticking with the Dale Mabry & Walnut location.
Nice place, good coffee. Annoying location, but that's the plaza designers fault.

I came in after work today.  I work outside so I needed a cold drink.  I got a vanilla iced coffee and asked for a cup of ice water which they gladly gave to me no charge for the cup of ice water.  My iced coffee the barista made it, he looked at it and then goes this doesn't look right too much cream let me fix it and he re did my iced coffee for me!  I thought that was super nice!  It was a nice experience all around, friendly staff!
Seriously! 30 min sitting in the drive thru and I was only two cars behind where you order! I literally put my car in park and sat! If your in a hurry do not stop here!

Least favorite Starbucks in the area. Both the guy taking our order and the young girl barista seemed distracted & not very accommodating. The Americano with 6 pumps of flavor & 1-inch steamed cream ended up being good, but I had to ask twice to get it right & barista did it with a snarl. Also was charged more than any other Starbucks for the same drink.

This Starbucks is not for you if you're looking to sit down and be on your laptop. It's small and efficient. I am fan of the mobile order and have yet to have a problem with it. This place works for me. Luck for you there's others wishing a block or two if you're looking for a spot to relax or do some work.

Every time I visit this Starbucks, I'm disappointed.  Today, it was so loud I couldn't read the newspaper.  Staff was vacuuming the food case - so they turned up the music to hear it - then had to speak to one another so loud that it was impossible to think.  This store needs new management.  I generally avoid it, but it was  the location I needed today.

There's nothing bad I can say about Starbucks. It's amazing that a coffee shop can lure little old me, non-coffee drinker, into their world! I mostly drink their caramel apple spice in the colder months and their green teas all year round. Their pastries and treats are tasty too and I don't mind grabbing a muffin or scone to complement my tasty drink. I've been a Gold Level member for about four years now. I downloaded their app and I can pay with my smartphone. Rewards, freebies and locations can be found on the app. I have had pretty consistent service no matter what location I've gone to. Baristas are always upbeat and happy. Maybe they are all hyped up on espressos and cappuccinos. If you go early, you can expect a line. The location on 10th St and Girls School Rd wraps all the way out onto the street.

Love this Starbucks. The service is quick, the coffee is consistent. The outdoor patio is a great place to sit, and there's lots of room inside as well. Other than that it's a pretty standard Starbucks.

The store did not seem overly busy, but it did take longer to get my drink than expected. Next time I will mobile order ahead. I tried the Ultra Caramel Frappuccino (w/ almond milk) for the first time. It is really tasty, and I'd recommend it!
Always get it right. Stop here almost daily. A great crew at this location.

You know how when you go to Dunkin' Donuts and you ask for a little bit of cream or a little bit of sugar, they put WAY too much in there? Yeah, well that's this place. I got drinks there two days in a row, first day I ordered iced black coffee, they put about 5 pumps of vanilla and sugar into it - totally sucked. Then the next day I got cold brew coffee with LIGHT sweet cream. It looked like a cup or cream with a splash of coffee. It's a shame too, because their cold brew is good. Idk why they feel the need to dump a gallon of full fat cream into it. This place also runs out of almost every breakfast item daily. Do yourself a favor and skip this place! BOO!!

average. strip mall setting, decent seating, friendly but not terribly fast service. nothing gluten free in the pastry case except a rice krispy marshmallow bar and--sorry--that's not food.

the soy makes my teeth hurt it's so sweet. the pastries are mostly junk food though there are a few bkfst sammies for those who do gluten/dairy/meat, and a yogurt/granola cup too. mostly, starbucks just makes me sad. i look forward to the day they stop contributing to the over-sugaring of our nation. 

as for this location, it's nothing special and it's not bad. it looks like every starbucks. no surprises.
Always great service when I come here. And the baristas offer free samples to make sure I like the drink. My favorite Starbucks in Reno!

Place sucks... The workers here do not know how to make the drinks properly and if you go up for something the second time, they give you attitude. Some of the batista are nice but the majority... They're pretty bad. 

I do like the building but that's about it

They say you have home, work, and "third place".  The Deptford Mall Starbucks is my third place.  The store is fantastic.  Despite being in the center of a -very- busy mall, the service is excellent.  The employees are friendly to me and to other customers in line, and my grande white chocolate mocha latte is made just right every time.  Professional and well-run, if you're looking for a great Starbucks experience, you'll find it here.  As an added bonus, there's lots of comfortable seating right behind the kiosk.

I am a huge fan of Starbucks! It's definitely helpful to have a cup of coffee or tea to start the morning off but the staff at this location are really rude. 

I've been very patient with them but its not great to deal with impolite people (especially staff workers) when you are looking for a pleasurable day.

This location is always: Courteous, quick and accurate with great customer service. What more can you ask for when you are in a hurry to your next sales call, or need a quickie lunch before heading to a flight? 

Great job, guys and gals!

I had such a great experience at this Starbucks. The staff was extremely friendly and the place was very clean. I had the best tea of my life at this Starbucks. The girl that made my tea was so nice and accommodating.
Very convenient downtown Moorestown location, sometimes long line due to rich "Escalade" moms buying all their kids lattes and macchiatos.
Ewe!! Went for a night coffee. Paid $15 and did not get what I ordered. It was horrible. Won't be stopping at this one again!

I've only been in here once but the baristas are super friendly and chatty. I really appreciate it because a lot of people in the university area seem to hate the students. It closes late at midnight, and it's got two floors! I love Starbucks. You always know what you're going to get.
I love this Starbucks! It's the biggest one around. Wish it wasn't so far away. So much space and so many comfy seats.
No bacon on my bacon Gouda breakfast sandwich. The iced vanilla coffee is good. And the sandwich tastes good just wish it had everything on it.

The Starbucks here is terrific!  The people who work there make you feel welcome and remember you and your favorites!

Great people who deserve a thank you!

Mary Burns
Open from 5am to 8pm, conveniently located, with plenty of parking and a good staff. I have come to this location a number of times and have not been disappointed once.

I had started this review differently and was planning to go on a rant about slow service and how I've been to other starbucks and blah blah blah.

This Starbucks is big, it's clean and the employees are nice.  They have a drive through which seems silly to me but I know people that like to use it.  All I know is that when I stop in there, it seems like the employees move at glacial pace.  If you're stopping here, plan to slow down a little (or a lot, depending on how fast you normally go)

Other than that, it's pretty nice and well, it's close to my office.

I look forward to my Starbucks break everyday as a fellow mall employee and I'm never disappointed by the service or quality. Amber, Phil and the team are very nice and do a great job given the chaos of the location. Since they already have a captive audience, they don't need my endorsement,  but I encourage you to get a drink here.

Dear Starbucks in Suburban Square,

Come on.  Are you really so hard up on cash that you need to charge for wireless?  And why are your tables so small--and round, to boot--that they discourage camping out and working all afternoon?  I must admit, I'm irritated.  I love my frappuccino lights in all of your flavors--I'm a loyal customer, I swear--but I also love coupling said drinks with long afternoons of steady work, preferably in an environment devoid of teenage girls screaming about lip gloss.  Just saying.

Love,
Shawna

This is my favorite Starbucks out of all the Reno locations. Besides being the closest, it's also open the latest. It used to be open all night then got changed to 11pm, not bad considering most Starbucks locations around are only open until 7,8, or 9pm. The baristas are friendly too! As usual, like all Starbucks-they'll make it right if your food or drink doesn't taste right. If not, a quick call to their Customer Service will solve your issue(s)

What a horribly misplaced edition to the neighborhood.  I even hate looking at it when I'm driving by.  This is not a great new addition to the neighborhood.  It's commercial greed at it's finest and takes away from local businesses who are intricately involved in the immediate community.    Their coffee tastes like burnt toast, their food comes from a box and is microwaved.  What a disgrace.

Great morning crew! It makes the coffee even better. They should have a different brew daily instead of weekly. In addition, this Starbucks is slow, messed up my simple drink 3 out of 5 times but refuse to acknowledge that they mess it up. They aren't friendly and I've never felt such a cold atmosphere. This has gone downhill recently...new manager I'm told. This is Valentines Day at 7:00 am and certainly not feeling the love.

This is possibly the worst managed Starbucks that I have ever visited. Inexplicable and inconsistent pricing.  Good customer service is seriously lacking at this particular Starbucks.  When I brought this to the attention of the store manager, she insisted on blaming everyone else. Yet she was the one that charged me differently, on three separate occasions, for the exact same drink.  Honestly, they really need to find someone to run this Starbucks that knows what they're doing.

One of the best locations in the area, fast speedy and friendly service makes this my favorite on the way to work stop! Only downfall and I don't think it's lose a star worthy is frozen drinks don't come out frozen if they have espresso like some locations. I think it's just a temperature being a little hotter melting the ice than other stores. Love the staff and will continue to return often.

I've been on a tour of Starbucks lately in our region and this one along with another could be considered a favorite. The seating is a tad less spacious than some other of the locations, but as long as it isn't a jam-packed day a person should still be able to find a nice counter-top seat by a power-outlet or a comfy chair.

The employees have always been nice to me and eager to discuss what is new or popular (the Flat White is an interesting addition to the Starbuck's repertoire). The drive-thru is efficient at getting people in line and back out on the street at a good pace too--an important aspect for any Starbuck's.

Overall a great place!

Why is the music so loud at this location? The acoustics are already awful, so it's noisy from talking, phone conversations, blenders, timers, and chairs being dragged across the floor. The music is just added annoyance.

Usually I'd say a Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks, but this is my office away from the office. I'm here several times a week and my experience is always great. 

The wi-fi is reliable and the service is always great. Bring your headphones though, the music isn't anything to write home to mom about.

This is a great location to meet up with all my friends in Millwoods for a nice Starbucks drink. Staff here is always friendly and they always get your order right. They are really quick at the cashier and they are also knowledgeable about the drinks.

I always find a parking spot in front of the shop. 

It's kinda crowded near the front of the store, but as you move further to the back of the shop, there is a lot more room. I like going there with 4 friends because there is a spot with 4 really comfortable couches near the back corner. We have great conversations there.

I find it pretty noisy here so this wouldn't be a Starbucks that I would bring my book to sit and read.

Sometimes if you go when they are about to close, they give you free pastry from the display case.

It was great and the staff were nice. They had the Dragon drink when I asked for it which is fairly new. It wasn't worse than any other Starbucks I've been to. The other reviews made me think that the Starbucks would be really bad but it wasn't.

For the amount of times I repeated my order to the gentleman in the drive threw I don't no how It still got messed it up.I get up to the window he's to busy gossiping with coworker to even acknowledge me and then he hands me a tall cup with nothing but liquid Bc the ice melted already, and mind you I asked for a Venti with ice, So i asked for ice n he rolls his eyes at me and storms away to get it. For the money I spend weekly at Starbucks this service was awful. I'm deff going to go out of my way to find a different one in the area very unhappy with this location as of late.
The service was good, but my skinny caramel macchiato didn't taste as delicious as normal.  I would go back if I'm passing through again, but I would order something else.

I always come to this Starbucks after my lunch to get my coffee, thank you so much to Christian always making my drink's amazing and being so kind with a great attitude when they don't have something I want he always make's sure I get taken care of with something similar. Come visit him and the great team.

Manager at this store is clueless. She believes anything people tell her. You have a camera take a look. Employees are rude and it's filthy. Maybe you should learn how to manage this shitty Starbucks. I'm attacked weekly here bc of the parking lot situation.

The staff here is so rude!! How dare you laugh at my order?! They made fun of
Me bc i asked for a Guava drink with coconut milk?! Like the hell!? These people should be trained to not laugh at customers because of what they order it is very unprofessional! Never coming here again and will be contacting corporate!
Great pizza and sandwiches and the pasta is surprisingly good. Very quick delivery. A little pricier than some, but worth it.

This is a very nice, friendly Starbucks. It's a little hard to get in and out, due to the layout of the drive through and parking lot.  Every time I've gone there they make my drink perfectly and I'm a bit picky. Brentwood is a very busy road but I've found the service to be prompt even when they're busy, unlike some Starbucks.

It is a Starbucks. 

What is different about it is the fact that it usually full of patrons sitting on their lap tops. The lines are usually pretty short. They have a big parking lot in the back. Outdoor seating is available but usually full.

Served caffeine when I ordered a tall, decaf capp - in the early evening. Did not sleep!!! Starbucks - do one thing and do it well. Serve coffee. Plus, the milk and sugar stations were overflowing with disgusting trash during this visit and a previous visit earlier in the week. This Starbucks is not good.
This was just another over crowded understaffed Starbucks.  Super slow. 10 minutes to get my one order. And it was wrong! Oh well. Lesson learned.

Everyone was so rude here. I work at a Starbucks and if I acted the way they did I would have been fired a long time ago! It was only 9:30 am and no one was in there...it was like we were bothering them by being there.
This Starbucks is one of my favorite in the city absolutely love coming to this location definitely recommend this Starbucks to all coffee lovers

Ann is one of the nicest people I have ever met. Starbucks is a place where a lot of people go to have conversations and particular people go to be specific and complicated to feel better about themselves but Ann made everyone feel like they were special, including those annoying caramel frappacino/caramel machiatto with extra caramel people. I was so incredibly impressed with her service and care. She is an amazing person and I hope she gets promoted to the highest position because she is what every Starbucks employee should strive to be, up to the highest position. Hire more people like Ann and your company will be nothing less than the best.

The Gate A location... literally the slowest Starbucks I've ever seen... literally. It took longer to get coffee from that Starbucks at 5:30 AM than it did to get through TSA. Did you get that? It took longer for their "baristas" to make espresso than it did for the federal government to make sure I wasn't bringing a bomb on the plane.

This is one of my "go-to" spots!  In addition to stopping here on my way to work, I spend a lot of time, setting up camp, and doing work here. The staff is very cool and really know their regulars, and, most importantly, the place is always super clean.  Just really dig the vibe of this Starbucks. The only thing I wish this place had was a Clover machine, but from what I understand, that's a corporate decision.  But, yea, overall I give this place 2 thumbs up....oh wait...we're doing stars....overall, I give it 5 stars!

Brand. Spanking. New!

Welcome to the neighborhood Starbucks! This location is brand new, and so far so good. The gentlemen at the register was super helpful and friendly. My husband and I even got a lesson on Apple Pay via our Apple Watches.

My order was correct, tasted delicious and the people were friendly. What more could a girl ask for?

Worst parking lot layout in the history of the world. It's nearly impossible to find parking here in the morning and the drive thru line is crazy long. I expect a long line at a coffee shop in the morning, but when the drive thru line blocks the way out it's just a pain in the ass. 

Baristas are very friendly and move the line quickly once you order, though.
Starbucks is great.   This one is a little difficult to get to and service was slow the day I was there.   Maybe it was just hard day for them.

Showed up at 8:30 AM. Having barely been open a few hours the store looked like it had been through a holiday rush - disgusting bathrooms, overflowing trash cans, a sticky dirty floor. Truly embarrassing if I was the owner. It's as though the previous night's crew just closed up shop and the morning crew came in and also did absolutely nothing. Small things go a long way - clean your store.

I was here last weekend and have been coming to this Starbucks for years now. The quality of the drinks, the building upkeep, and staff has gone extremely sour. The building is covered in weeds and just looks kind of abandoned. My drink had to be made almost 3x because it was made wrong (all I asked for was a French vanilla latte). First I received an iced coffee, then a regular latte, and finally he opened the window told me the price of my latte (which was way less than usual) so I double checked and said "that is for the French vanilla latte, correct?" The response that I received was "OHH, you wanted a French vanilla latte??". At that point I said "never mind" and then received an "OH MY GOD, really?!?!" as funny as it sounds, it was not funny when I was waiting in line for so long for a coffee. Maybe if I was in a better mood that day I would have taken it lighter but I still feel as though this whole situation could have been handled better.

I am a big fan of Starbucks even though they are a gross polluter. But this Starbucks is the worst.  It is poorly organized and service times are slow slow slow. Even with mobile order.  They seldom get a drink right even with mobile order.  Average wait times for your drink is about 12 minutes I usually mobile order and that's still about a 8 min wait time after ordering 15 min in advance. This store is too small to accommodate the crowd.

We ordered a caramel coffee and they made it perfect.

Nothing special, just a run of the mill Starbucks.

This is a nice Starbucks in the heart of Irvington.  It stays fairly busy because it attracts everyone hanging out on or near the main drag, which is the stretch of Washington that runs from Arlington to Ritter.  In addition, it attracts people that live in the area who need a coffee fix and want to just get in and out without incident.  The staff does a good job of keeping up, and they are friendly.  They keep stocked on all the standard Starbucks products.  I have to be honest and say that sometimes the standards come out a little inconsistent on taste or how it's made.  It's as though someone is using a different measuring cup or something.  Nonetheless, it's still Starbucks.

I've been going to this Starbucks for over 10 years, there's some people that are amazing there and that's why continue to go like Nicholas, Eric, and Jen. They are amazing people and really good at their job and know what I want before I even order. But my last two drive through's were horrible because the girl at the drive-through window was very rude and made me feel stupid to the point I had to go to another store. She made my drink wrong and when I said something about it just handed me the drink back without correcting it,so overall I give this place a five stars but not because of Bailey Bailey gives it a one star she should not be working the window.

Wonderful experience!  Fast, friendly service - especially Kat and Liz...sunflowers in sea of sand, they were...bright spots in my days for sure!  They know their stuff - never had caramel in a vanilla frappe before, now I don't think I'll ever go back to the regular!  Definitely pay this place a visit if you're staying here...the best!
My favorite Starbucks in town. Valentina and Cornelius are so welcoming and always smiles. I only go to this one over others.

IDK WTF goes on here, but a couple of the baristas can't make a Salted Cream Cold Foam Cold Brew (SCCFCB) to save their LIVES. I had to go go back TWICE for them to get my drinks close to right. Maybe I'll just stick to basic drinks here.

Mobile ordering not available, but you can use your app to pay.

I happen to love this location of Starbucks - the people who run it make the difference.
There are usually several people sitting at the barstools chatting with the barristas.  It's alot of fun and makes dropping $4.72 on an iced tea or coffee that much easier.

I have been to so many Starbucks around the world, and it's difficult to review them as they are all so similar- easy in and out, quick service and good coffee. From time to time, I have a less than desirable experience, but for the most part, they're all great- and this one is no different. Service was quick, staff were friendly and coffee was good! Plus they open at 5 AM which was a Godsend for early flights!!
Always great to find a SB close by when I'm traveling. This location has a drive thur which I like.
Probably the friendliest Starbucks I have ever been to! I walked out there with a smile on my face. Such a pleasant way to start my day!

As a caffeine-addicted adult that desires a moderately quiet space to work, I would have to give high props to this Starbucks location! 

Both times I have visited the site, I have been greeted with smiles and an error-free order. The ambience is well suited for working in terms of noise and there is plenty of seating, including a bar-style row of chairs by a window.

The only downside is that parking in front of the shop is a bit limited but there is plenty of parking in the immediate area. 

If you are looking for a good study spot with A+ service and a quiet ambience, check this location out!

Not my favorite USF area Starbucks, but convenient on my way to work. Parking is often an issue and many times when I visit the baristas are cleaning or vacuuming or conducting other loud tasks - not an ideal location to sit and chat. Though the seating is plentiful and diverse - a couple big comfy chairs, a high top, a long bar that regulars sit at to chat with the baristas. My last 2 visits have been okay - one was for a frappuccino that took far too long to make between the 3 baristas working and NO ONE in front of me - the guys after me got their drinks before me and they were quite chummy with them meanwhile I'm standing there awkwardly waiting. The girl doing the register was new and took awhile to ring me up but it was fine. Last night I wanted a passion tea lemonade and was told they were out of lemonade. I was recommended to try a passion tea apple juice and reluctantly agreed. Then the computer froze up for a minute and I was given it on the house! Bonus! I'll take some free Starbucks, though I admit I did want the stars on my card lol. This one is much less crowded than Fowler and not much further from USF. I also wish this was drive through or there was SOME drive through on my way to USF but this one is pretty good. Fowler is my favorite for the friendliness and speed, but this one is good too.

This mornings crew was garbage except for the strawberry blonde girl. All gossiping and standing around. I ordered a tea, and two food items. They ended up being out of the sandwhich and tea that I ordered, so I just asked for a refund based on the lack of customer service. Then, I was told they could still make the tea that I wanted (strawberry açaí) even though they just told me they were out? Incredibly rude, inconsistent, and childish. It was like being in high school watching them stand around and talk while neglecting customers. For the messed up tea and the egg bites I ordered, it took us 25 minutes. There was no one behind me and they waited 10 minutes before starting anything. After 20 minutes, they asked if we were waiting for something (egg bites) and proceeded to JUST START THEM after that. My advice? Get people who take this job seriously unlike the girls that worked this mornings shift.

This was our first visit to this location and they were PICTURE PERFECT! It was swamped but they didn't make us feel rushed, bless the barista that asked me 'And what else?' vs the always obnoxious 'Is that all?'. Our order was relatively simple this time but all the drinks around us were pretty customized and I didn't hear one mistake. Also, by the time the rest of our order was done I needed an ice water refill and the bar barista was perfectly gracious and didn't come across inconvenienced in the slightest to handle it for me. 
I'm only afraid to go back because this visit was so smooth

Please stop the chit chat and take my order! I've noticed a trend at the Starbucks in this area where they talk way too much to the customers and hold up the line. It must be a St  Louis thing.

I grew up around here so I'm used to chit chat and the inevitable "Where did you go to high school? question, but when it's 8am on a Sunday I WANT MY COFFEE!

The inside of this place is ok, it looked like a little clean up was needed. The outside has a few tables and umbrellas. I can see a big clusterfuck with the parking and drive thru during the week because of the location.

I'm hoping one of my visits to St Louis I can find a location with faster service.

This is one of my fav local Starbucks.  Fast & efficient- & most importantly consistent service!  This location has indoor & outdoor seating, layout friendly to both solo as well as group work sessions- & tends to be the quietest Starbucks location in Treasure Valley.  (Busy, but generally quiet noise level.). If u need a respite from Eagle road- pull in here!

Have you even been to this Starbuck's? If that's a yes then you know at busy times this drive-thru really backs up. Also if you are south bound on Brentwood you have to pull into the parking lot and turn around just to get into the drive-thru. Lots of confusion. Other than that the service is generally friendly and speedy. Today I had an iced green tea with strawberry infusion (no syrup) and the bacon gouda egg bites. Have you tried these egg bites? They are good and decently healthy!

Nice people and doesn't get too busy around 8:30-9am.  Drinks come out on time and there is plenty of parking.

My only complaint and this goes to a few locations now: FILL THE CUP!  I pretty much get the same drink every am: Venti Latte (or venti mocchiatto).  The cup is always about 1.5-2 inches empty from the top.  That would make the drink a grande, so don't charge me for a venti and serve a grande.

Worst Starbucks. Ever. No less than an 20 minute wait every time. Employees just stand around and talk. And sometimes, they mix peoples orders up and hand you something completely different. So irritating.

This is the second time that I have visited this location and had the exact same experience. 

Good things first, the store is clean, with ample parking, looks cool, and is convenient when shopping at REI.

Not so good things, took a long time to make my wife's cup of coffee and totally forgot to make mine. Limited seating with limited desserts. 

I will only stop by here in the future out of convenience, not for great service or great ambience.
I've never had a bad experience here. I just wish they didn't close so early.  I mean, it's never too late to have a Vanilla Bean Frapp.
Definitely small inside, outdoor seating is available but limited. Not as friendly as other Starbucks in Williamson Co. Good coffee though, what do you expect there.

I don't see why this Starbucks has only a couple stars. Service was excellent, my order was perfect and the place is clean. I don't live here but it's a normal small store. Bonus is it's in an Albertsons large shopping center.

It's Starbucks - what else can I say? Super friendly staff. A little cramped space-wise, they could probaby afford to expand. The app makes life easier, but seriously, a little direction for us semi-regulars - where do I pick up my mobile order? I've stood there waiting and thinking, wait I ordered ahead so I didn't have to wait...only to find out that my drink was indeed ready - just hidden in the secret mobile order cubby. I have a few self-described Starbucks cult-member friends who told me I just need to ask for it when I get there. A sign - "Pick up your mobile order here" would be helpful - but now I know, so whatever. Keep making the Peppermint Mocha - that's my Starbucks jam.

Tried this Starbucks again. I ordered a venti and got a grande. The guy never repeated my order at the drive through which instantly annoyed me. Once I received my drink it was all ice to the very top and barely any of the drink. This is the worst Starbucks yet.

A disservice to all the good Starbucks stores out there.  This is a "licensed" Starbucks, so it's not managed by Starbucks.  They give points but you can't redeem rewards here.  I was here last night and they were out of decaf.  They were also out of napkins and wood stir sticks.  I returned today (it was close by) and they are still out of napkins, and refused to even give a paper towel to someone with pastry goo on their hands.  They are still out of wood stir sticks as well.  Go elsewhere.

i love this store! every employee is extremely kind and they never fail to say 'good morning' when i walk in. it's a huge plus that i come so often, they start my order before i reach the counter. two thumbs way up
Not as good as the other Starbucks I have visited. The prices were also higher here. Guess the higher prices fit based on where it is.

I stopped at this Starbucks on my way to work this morning at about 645 am to find the door locked and 2 staff members inside. I have been here on a Saturday before where they were open at 6 am (the same hours were also posted right by the door). The staff member (young lady) proceeded to ignore me and refusing eye contact while I knocked on the door. If the hours have changed, fine but at least come and tell your customer that at the door. 3 days prior to that, I was getting a coffee and could not find the green stoppers anywhere until I saw them behind the barista counter. Nobody was around to ask so I grabbed one. Only to be scolded by a barista who came out of the back and told me that I needed to ask for them. I informed him that there was no one around and wonder why they were kept back there? He told me for health sanitation reasons so people would not touch them. I was like "well your stir sticks are out and everyone is touching them so why are they not kept behind the counter". I asked if this was what the health inspector had requested? He told me it was Starbucks policy. I have been to other Starbucks cafes where stoppers were not hidden by staff member so that is a load of crap. I will be contacting the store manager.
Frequently get lukewarm coffee. They always remake the coffee when I have time to go in and ask, but this is Starbucks...they should have HOT coffee at all times.

Relatively spacious caffeine station, complete with drive-thru and outdoor seating which is perfect for the heat and humidity we have in the area ;-)  They are helpful about using the iPhone app to pay from your car which is a plus, since some places will not accept it if you can't physically reach their barcode reader.

I love the girl at the window she is always so sweet she had long dark hair she is the only reason they got an extra star. Jose the manager he needs a refresher course on customer service. I on average spend$100 a week here and when I ordered my iced coffee with extra cream and when I got to the window and there wasn't enough cream I asked for a small side and Jose told the lady at the window to tell me they will have to charge me additional almost $3 (mind you my coffee cost $3.18 with tax) and then handed me like a little cup with like no creamer. If I don't like my coffee I can give it back and they will make me a new one but if I ask for a side of cream to fix it my self I will be charged?? If it wasn't so close to my house and always slow I would have probably started to go to a different one a long time ago..

By far the best Starbucks in Florida!  I travel a lot and there are good and bad Starbucks......  and then there is Starbucks at Suncoast and 54. The employees are friendly and hold conversations.  The bar moves much faster than any other Starbucks I have ever been to.  Thank you Joey, Christine, Sherry, Demi, Just Jake, Phoebe, Kevin, Chelsea , Sania and anyone I missed!

I ordered an ice green tea latte but the clerk made a regular latte.  She had an attitude when I corrected her.  She was apathy about her mistake.  This is no the first time we experienced poor customer service at this store.  My friend was cut by the entrance door and bleed heavily from the cut.   Couple employees came out to clean the blood off the floor.  None of them care to ask my friend how she was doing.  This store completely lack professionalism, care, and respect toward their patrons.  Collectively we all spent over $1000 per month at this store, we all decided to spend our money elsewhere.  We all very disappointed; This store deserves 0 star.

Shoutout to Dylan for his amazing customer service. 

I did a mobile order and drove to this location. When I walked in and sat at the mobile order station. Within a minute Dylan asked me what the name for my order was. I told him and he said he didn't see it, but he could get it started if I told him what it was. 

So as I was waiting for my venti green tea latte with soy and a cake pop I double checked my order to make sure that I did pay for it. This is when I realized I ordered at a completely different location. I told him my mistake, and was about to trek on over when Dylan said he would take care of it by making my latte, giving me my cake pop, and that he would call them later to confirm the mishap. 

On top of everything he remade my drink because when it was done because he wasn't 100% sure if he made it with soy. The only way to be 100% sure what to start over. 

He is amazing!

My beverage was made perfectly, super delicious. However, the drive thru takes priority. If you need your drink in a hurry, go through the drive thru. 
I went inside today to order and literally waited 27 min just to get my drink.
Starbucks prices skyrocket. Out of principal I won't  buy their coffee. If you think I'm going to pay 3.00 for a simple cup of Joe, forget it.

Very sad this Starbucks was my favorite but it has gone down hill!! I can't believe no matter how many times we bring it to the Manager Heathers attention it stays the same.. Lynn you are still the nicest person Ever !!!! 
Wake up stop making us all feel like we work for you !!!

Slow, slow, slow.  Theres a line out the door all the time, yet these workers keep the same slow pace all day long.  No mobile ordering either.  That may actually make them work faster. Wouldn't want that.

Now it's taken me quite some time to actually write this review because I wasn't quite sure what I wanted to say..but here goes.........

Don't get me wrong, I do like Starbucks but I finally came to the realization that it's overpriced and overrated.  I was a Gold status for quite a few years as my favorite drink was the hot or iced chai tea and more recently, hot green tea.  I began boycotting them when they had the holiday red cup release in 2018 for the fact that I received by red cup but with no lid since the store was out --- the barista @ that time advised me to just visit another location or call and ask Starbucks and they should be able to give me one because they sometimes just ship to few to the individual stores.  I went around and asked other locations who were sold out of the cups and didn't have any extra lids so I proceeded to call Starbucks as well as post an inquiry online.  I was not given any help or support for this...just basically "oh well" and they couldn't do anything about it.  Now my concern is how can Starbucks send a store a certain number of red cups but not enough lids for the cups.  Is the expectation for guests to have their HOT drinks in lid-less cups!? I could spill my drink on myself and it's not cool to have my Starbucks HOT drink in a lid-less cup because most of the time you're on the go when enjoying your overpriced drink.  Based on the level of service I've had at other establishments when there are shortfalls or issues w/things when being a committed customer, I was surprised by the level of service and just lack of caring I received when I spoke to someone at corporate about the issue.  

When I look at Starbucks now,  not being intrigued or care to be a Gold star status anymore, I don't know why consumers are so crazy about this place!  It can't be that the drinks are THAT amazing that people are willing to pay so much for their iced coffee.  When I used to get the Chai tea --- it was never made fresh --- the chai comes out of a cardboard container, heated or iced.  Yes, I used to be one of these people but not anymore .... and now I would rather save that $5 that I used to spend on a drink and get a smoothie from a place that tastes much better and is not overly sweetened and unhealthy. I'm always amazed at how any Starbucks establishment always has a crowd --- you almost never see one that's empty or not busy in some capacity.  And as I look at other reviews on Yelp, I can see that mine is clearly one of the very few that isn't 4-5 stars.
Truly a wonderful Starbucks and very close to CHOP

Essentially another Starbucks cut from the same mold as all the others.  However, I think that either this location is smaller on the inside than most others, or it is constantly crowded with teens who like over-milked, over-sugared not-exactly-coffee, but want to say they drink coffee.  

Not a place I would stop to get coffee, or anything to eat.

Look I know that people love Starbucks, and I know its only for the name. look Mc Donald's, they have great coffee and you can spend 4.00 on a meal with coffee or just get coffee for 4.00 at starbucks with no sandwich. Just somthing to think about.

Starbucks has worked hard to make this store a mess. They don't accept mobile orders despite being fairly high volume. Consequently, the line often takes up most of the store's space. The place also only has one bathroom. Sometimes, the lines for the bathroom and the counter will become intertwined. It's also the first Starbucks that I've been to that requires a password for the internet.
I love Starbucks! This one is in a great location. Staff is friendly but the drive thru is always backed up.

Your typical Starbucks.  A good stop on a nice day while shopping in beautiful Suburban Square; there is plenty of outdoor seating available to enjoy the sun while you self-medicate your caffeine addiction.

Not only is their parking lot entrance horrible, but they are as slow as molasses!!
Blah
Blah
Blah
Blah
Good location with nice employees. Gets busy in the morning but is great at mid day. I like quick service and good coffee!

This is a cool place that a lot of locals hang out at at all hours of the day.  im in noway a starbucks coffee drinker (hot choc and chi tea fan) but i do like to go down there on a chilly night and get hot choc and read.  H/O they are doing away with being open 24 hours (me thinks for now).  I found out through a friend I see up there on week nights i go.  The other night i tried to find a sign by the front door alerting people of the change but no sign!  I hope mgt at least tells the homeless old men that sleep in the store on a nightly basis of the changes!
This is a great Starbucks. The staff are fast and friendly. My drink is right every time. I love having them so close to home!
They made my drink right! 4/5 times Starbucks locations make it wrong. Ordered on app, was ready within minutes of ordering. No complaints here!

This Starbucks is definitely my go-to and my favorite location in the area! The employees are always so friendly and helpful. Their customer service is truly wonderful. My wait time is never long, and they have always gotten my orders correct. I highly recommend this location if you're in the area!

I normally seek out locally owned small businesses to review versus a new Starbucks location, HOWEVER, this is a big deal...

Santa Barbara + Starbucks Drive-Thru = Happy, Caffeinated Locals!

I know, you're probably not nearly as excited as me and other folks in town, but I can only count on one hand the amount of drive-thru establishments within the boundaries of Santa Barbara. I know I know, us Californians are spoiled for having such beautiful weather most of the year that there's no excuse to not get out of your vehicle and walk inside. Yet, once in a while you want the convenience while en route to run errands, meet a friend or pick up the kids. The closest Starbucks drive-thru locations are 30 minutes away in Buellton and Ventura.

Now that I have stepped off my soapbox, I ended up parking my car in one of the 20 or so spots and walked in. From the minute I entered, the store manager Arumi introduced herself and welcomed me. 
I guess not all Starbucks are created equal... 
The interior decor is modern rustic with a fair amount of seating but also offers an outdoor patio too. The staff is excited to be open and made my basic Iced Vanilla Latte with light ice (they got my request correct, Genezaret C.--give them another try!) just as I remember and expected it. They offer the normal packaged food options, fresh pastries and some Starbucks merchandise.

Bottom line: Santa Barbara, there's a drive-thru! Hooray!

Horrible experience at this Starbucks. I came in during a time when they were carting inventory in from a truck, but the space to do that was in between where the line starts.

I was in line to make my order when the employee harshly demanded that I move out of the way. I would have been fine if he had politely told me the situation, but he literally hollered at me from behind the counter and was walking around multiple times (cleaning counters? Replacing cups?) before even taking my order. Really? It was a slow evening which is why I expected it to not take too long to receive my drink. Took a total of 2 minutes being hollered at and being told to move away while being stared at, 5 minutes just to place my order and 3 minutes for my drink to be ready. 

The lag time because this employee was slow and rude was just not worth it.
I've been coming to this location for a little while and they are always friendly and quick. I really like them and I'll be sad when I'm not out here anymore to use this Starbucks!
Basic Starbucks , clean , nice area , nice people fair enough , gets the job done. Had to spend a few hours in the area to kill time I relaxed here and worked a bit

The staff here is friendly, the drink quality is great, and the atmosphere is overall pretty welcoming. I felt it was necessary to post about that after reading the previous post regarding an overall disdain for Starbucks as a whole.
Great location. Friendly people. They remember me and my family. Even what drinks we like. That's awesome.

Great coffee, but really questionable service.

On a recent trip there with my fiance, I ordered a decaf mint tea. I've been getting decaf mint tea regularly from Starbucks for roughly a decade. But this time, the barista - one I'd never seen here before - insisted that "Starbucks doesn't have decaf tea." 

I blinked, wondering if I'd been hallucinating over the past 10 years, then reminded myself that my drug days pretty much ended in the 90s and now my only vice is overpriced coffee served by pretentious hipsters. I noted that I'd often gotten decaf mint tea, if not the other decaf option of passion fruit or something. She repeated her mantra like a corporate robot, adding that the teas I'd mentioned are HERBAL, NOT DECAF. 

It occurred to me that, maybe while taking her Starbucks 101 training, she'd learned some distinction between herbal and decaf teas, and the role caffeine plays, or doesn't, in both types. And that my lack of that esoteric knowledge was seriously irritating to her.

I finally had to point to the drink she served me and say, slowly, "Does. This. Have. Caffeine?" "No," she said. "Great," I said. "That's all I wanted to accomplish."

Isn't safe to assume that the average customer, who likely isn't a tea geek, asking for decaf simply wants a beverage without caffeine? Did she REALLY not know what I was talking about? 

If I'm going to buy overpriced beverages from people with hardware in their face and rainbow-coiffed heads, it'd better be service with a f****** smile and pleasant attitude.
Typical Starbucks experience. I'm a simple order Americano w/ room for milk. Can't really mess me up.

This is an small Starbucks in Odessa but the close one to the Lutz Area.  I am very excited about the service and attention today.  My coffee was prepared to perfection.  Joe, the manager was talking with the customers today about the remodeling of the store and what we will expecting at the end of May.  He graciously passed out some samples of sconces to all the guests.  I can see how hard he is working to make sure that are employees are nice and attentive to customers.  Keep the hard work!!!

The people really weren't that nice. I would recommend going here though because i have had better experiences. But today, the lady made my father and I's drink horrible. It taste like water and has no flavor what so ever. And for the price we pay i would expect way better, especially since it's happy hour today and it's a more popular day to go.

I love Starbucks!  This one is absolutely horrible though.  I thought they all went to "sensitivity training."  I think they forgot to invite the employees from this particular Starbucks.  The store manager that works the morning shift, is by far the rudest manager that I have ever encountered at ANY Starbucks.
Love love love coming in here on my most tired mornings to treat myself to the wonderful deliciousness of Starbucks. The staff always gets the order right each time I come in here.
GREAT service! Drive thru was so friendly and made our coffees exactly how we asked them too! Everything went quickly!

I always have pleasant experiences when I stop by this location embedded within the Tampa Premium Outlets. Small corner store centrally located by outdoor seating area, fountains, guest services and foodcourt. 

This Starbucks provides friendly and attentive service, and shorter lines than most. So far my drinks have all been made well. I can't think of any mishaps or misspelled names on my cups. 

For a small shop there are plenty of places to sit and eat or lounge. Not to mention the number of places to sit comfortably right outside. 

I tend to stop in for a chai latte or light snack while shopping since I'm not a fan of the foodcourt. Since I'm a huge fan of the neighboring Coach store, this Starbucks can't be missed. 

Since Tampa locals seem to need Starbucks to live, they nailed it by opening one in every mall here. The outlets are no exception.

Have you ever gotten so busy and distracted through the course of your day that you forgot to drink any coffee, and then started to completely run out of gas in the late afternoon?  That happened to me today while I was shopping, and I managed to trek the fifty yards or so from Eddie Bauer to here without calling an ambulance ;-)

I give Starbucks points for having locations pretty much everywhere on the Planet, and this one turned out to be convenient in a pinch, but the coffee here (and at all the other links in the chain) is just AOK at best, and considering the prices, the value proposition is questionable at best.

Bottom line: If you need a decent cup of Joe, you can do worse than Starbucks, but you can do a heck of a lot better as well.

Service was fine and the Starbucks quality was the same, but those airport prices are crazy as usual. When you order a bagel, they give you a knife and a small pouch of cream cheese that's barely enough for one side of the bagel. It's also a $1 up charge when you inevitably ask for another one...
Can you please start cleaning the cups. Espresso was all over lid and spilled in/out my car and on clothes. This has happened multiple times. Drinks are not consistent in taste.

This is a very small location you can easily pass. There is no sign on the side of the road, but it's in the same parking lot as Marshall's. The Earl grey tea is amazing and I'd recommend it for non-coffee drinkers.  Very nice atmosphere and the music isn't too loud. Fast service and friendly staff. I'd recommend this place.  Go in as that seemed faster then the drive thru.

A friend and I come here when the weather is nice and make use of the outdoor seating area. 2 weeks ago, the outdoor trash was overflowing when we arrived, and stayed that way for 2 hours. Finally, an employee emptied it. This past weekend, some overflowing trash, but no one emptied it while we were there. The trash/recycle can by the back door was also out of room. 
No one ever wipes down dirty tables, indoors or out. This used to be done regularly at Starbucks, but no more. It's a shame. They are becoming just another fast food joint that sells expensive coffee.
