Since i am writing this about a Santa Barbara venue i must mention the Handlebar downtown and of course the almost sublime Handlebar on De la Vina: both serving great coffee, beat the 'bucks food-wise (Roman-style pizzas one night as a special??) and thrill you with terrific service. (isn't it sad that we often expect bad service in coffee joints or other joints...for that matter?)
So since i was in SB for a few days i knew i had to check out this venue particularly since it is a Drive thru. I know. I know. Sounds a little  kid like. But i can still engender, pull up from my gut the thrill i used to feel as a kid checking out a new store.
And oddly enough it was my little niece and nephew who wanted to go here to experience the drive thru-ness of this place. And so of course we checked it out.
The kiddoes were mostly interested in the Cake Pops, i wanted to see if the 'bucksters here could make a Triple Grande Soy Capp, Dry in one try as it doesn't happen often.
I am happy to say that they got it right: perfect blend of primo espresso, soy froth and soy milk: all in the correct proportions.
The espresso here tastes of cherries, citrus and yes a bit of smoke. But the blend is a beautiful thing. I am not a big fan of the brewed coffees at the 'bucks but many many people are. What i am a fan of is the French Roast beans which i brew at home. At home, with my coffeemaker i can extract a big fat coffee, slightly vanilla, slightly flowery, slightly citrus cuppa Joe! Odd, i know. But the 'bucks should look into how they brew...if you ask me.
The Birthday Cake Pops disappeared inside the kids seemingly in 2 gulps. The Pops themselves are a secret vice for most of us. The cake is soft and buttery and the hard shell frostings are good, the flavors taste natural. As in the advent of the Muffins, i think that cake Pops were invented so that we can eat cake in the morning and not feel guilty.
But the Soy Capp is for slow drinking: letting it dwell in my mouth in order to pull out all the inherent flavors swirling around.

.

Mark.

I love Starbucks and this is two miles from my home, but the parking has become impossible. Last two times, I've been--no parking. Drove across the street to an independent, equally good coffee shop. Steve is great!

They have Nitro too!
Gave attitude and was short and snappy! Poor customer service. Better off going to other coffee shops in the airport!
one of the workers were very kind but the other girl was very rude. they barely have anything in stock to make the drinks

Not my favorite Starbucks. The service is ok and the food is the same. It's pretty quick service, but my sandwich wasn't very warm. It normally takes a while to make my drinks. This is a decent Starbucks for an airport.

Seems like every time I go to this Starbucks. They never have the ingredients to make the drinks I want. I'm so tired of it. I don't recommend this location at all. Horrible.

Drive thru quick and kind. One girl remembers I always want a water with my coffee and has had it ready before I asked!

I feel like I'm sitting here in my room drinking a coffee scented cup of soy milk. Understaffed for a hotel this size. Apparently my americano with 4 stevias, two pumps of vanilla, and cream is a "really complicated drink" and requires an apology to the person behind me. The Starbucks in concourse a is total crap! Horrible service, messed up my order, and got an attitude with me because they were out of grande cups at 6:10am

I've visited this Starbucks several, many, beaucoup times before and I'm not sure how I didn't write a review, but here goes nothing...

Just to save time, I ordered ahead, using the app, I love this order ahead feature... I love, love, love this feature. I was using it before Covid-19. I love it, I  really, really do; do you think I love it? You're right, I do. 

I ordered a Venti green tea Matcha Frappuccino with coconut milk please, because your girl is lactose intolerant, but I still wanna get my matcha on, so there you have it coconut milk it is. The barista's hold the drinks behind the counter because I believe there's been some issues with folks doing a 'snatch & grab' of drinks they didn't order or pay for. VERY limited street parking.

Staff is friendly and you get served pretty quick. Only reason I'm giving this location a 4 is because there are so  many people just standing in there with no coffee and no order, and by standing I mean standing.

I LOVE the morning baristas here. My order is always perfect and they're so sweet. My drink order is a little complicated and probably annoying but they never make it seem like a chore. Can't say enough great thing about you all!
So personable ,friendly and polite I am welcomed with a smile everytime. I really enjoy the cleanliness, but most of all the sweet staff

I love this Starbucks. I have gone here at least once a week for over a year and have never had a problem. My order is always correct, the staff is always friendly, and my drinks always taste amazing.

This has become my new commute Starbucks. The drive-thru is efficient and easy to navigate. Online orders are fast and accurate. My cappuccino is consistently good. 6 ounces of coffee in my 12 ounce cup. Since I was already home, I was not going all the way back for a new one. Not cool!
Every time I come and order here they are fast and in an amazing mood! The line might be long but it goes really quickly and everyone is always Super nice and happy to see you!

I'm not one to travel to a new city and head to Starbucks, but since this location was located literally next door to my hotel (The Matrix), I did visit this store twice during my quick visit to Edmonton.  And, I have to say, both of my visits were pleasant.  Friendly service, warm atmosphere, free wifi, and a clean bathroom to boot!  The only thing I didn't see were outlets to plug in my laptop, but maybe I didn't search well enough?

Regardless, if you're looking for a cup of coffee or tea or a snack of sorts, this Starbucks is just fine to swing by... even if it is a big box retailer!

The employees are great and the customer service is as well. 

I would give this location 5 stars if it wasn't for my favorite drinks having a "We're all out" label plastered over them on the menu. Last I heard they were making room for new drinks on the menu, but I haven't seen them pop up in 2 months. It can't be Starbucks corporation removing them permanently. Every other location still avidly sells them and they are not seasonal drinks. 

What's the deal with the long wait?

We were headed up the 101 in early November and needed a Starbucks fix.  This newer location features a drive-thru, high ceilings, and distinctive decor.  It's definitely not an old school design.  This is more high style than many other 'Bucks venues.

When we arrived on a Friday evening, a high school football game had just finished.  The entire cheerleading team was in the lobby, ordering and waiting for their beverages. That made for a longer than usual wait for all to get their orders.

It looked like several trainers from other stores were there, training newer hires, and helping expedite the orders.  I suspect that the regular crew will learn how to manage on their own, as I suspect this will be a popular location.

I want to preface this review by saying that we live in the building and want nothing more than this Starbucks location to be successful. However, service is constantly slow and the workers rude. Today marks the fifth time in a row that my order was wrong and the barista on duty's reaction was as if she could care less. The store recently fired the one bright spot that they had, Key, who was let go for closing up early when she was left alone to close (major safety issue and happened way too often). The store is not clean and hasn't gone through the standard updates that all Starbucks stores get on the regular. The manager is never in and it makes me wonder if this store isn't getting proper attention because it has been written off and plans to close. I really hope the manager can start doing their job and get this place on track. The Gulch is a prime location and this store certainly does not fit the bill.
I ordered yesterday and today, both times my order came out good. I ordered the passion lemonade and caramel cloud macchiato. Service is good. They are super busy.

Always fast, friendly, and delicious! Come here often, daily, when passing through. Today they spontaneously made my day and said "This is on me today!" Somehow the sweet girls at the drive-thru "magically" knew I needed a nice little gesture today, as it totally turned my mood upside down (in a great way!) Thank you so much!!! :) keep up the great work here.

Terribly slow service is consistent in the mornings here.  The line is always long in the morning and the staff have no urgency.
Great service, any time I come through. They get my order right, quick service. Baristas are super nice and professional!

Stood in line for 20 min to have my January tumbler filled.  Got to the register and was told they did not honor this Starbucks offer.  I traveled two weeks ago and they honored the deal then. If Starbucks is not going to honor their own promotion at least have the courtesy to post it so you do not have to waste your time  waiting in line.  Extremely disappointed in Starbucks for not honoring their commitment

Saw three people in there but yet they didn't want to answer the phone. All of them were aware of the call and just ignored it. They shut their drive thru down with no explanation so we were just calling to see if they were even open.

Worst Starbucks. 4 on staff with three meandering around. The cashier in loooooong small town gossip conversation with a couple while more people wait. The poor barista was a slow goer but at least he kept to his surmounting order tasks one drink at a time.

   "Here it is!" She said as she handed it to me before resuming her conversation.

Quality location, quality staff (yes, Nate, I'm referring to you!) A bit busy on weekends but that's Suburban Square for you. Only thing I'd change is making it open later, especially on weekends. A girl needs to study!

I must say that I disagree with the first review. This Starbucks is my go-to! I live maybe a 3 minute drive from this location and it has never disappointed. They are always quick, correct with my order and they have a very nice and friendly staff. 

I would also encourage you to check out the inside -- Pre-COVID this was my go-to study spot and a great place to just chill and get out of the house. A lot of seating and comfy seating at that. With plenty of plug-ins and tables to accommodate groups.

I would recommend -- if you are in a hurry and have no time to wait (even in a small line) to look into their Mobile Order so that you can just walk in and pick it up. I always mobile order and then I can choose whether to just go through the Drive-Thru to pick it up or if I need to walk in.
Worse customer service, never going back. If you don't like your job then leave , if you are having a bad day then leave.

Stopped here for coffee on a Saturday afternoon. They had a long drive thru line so we went inside. Friendly, fast service! We sat on the patio to drink our coffee and could hear orders. They seemed to be out of a lot of non-coffee choices but were apologetic and no one was cross. Shortages are due to COVID but what isn't being blamed on COVID? We'll go back.

WORST STARBUCKS I HAVE EVER BEEN TO!!! Please do not go here if you want your coffee order done right. My order was messed up about four times and the cake pop I got was old. These workers DO NOT care about their customers. Honestly I just should've gotten my money back instead of even getting my drink remade for all the trouble I went through. I usually don't write reviews unless a place is really bad, so trust me on this and do not go there.

This Starbucks in Horsham is staffed by friendly baristas who aim to please and you do not get too much of the upsell (dont you want something to eat today... ) schtick. The drive through window is convenient but it is a pain to get in and outof the parking lot due to the traffic. Nothing special but nothing wrong with this location.

I really keep trying this spot so I can eventually put the coffee boy in his place one of these days. I go through this Starbucks on occasion when I'm

Alyssa is seriously the best! She's always sweet and friendly. The baristas at this Starbucks always make my drinks exactly how I like them.
The weight of the cappuccino is always light, half is foam. If you don't drink it right away, after a few minutes, the cup is only 3/4 cup full.

This is the worst Starbucks, neigh, the worst coffee place I have ever been to. The worker at this starbucks (inside Grand Sierra Resort) told us that they couldn't switch out chocolate to white mocha LIKE EVERY OTHER STORE COULD. Though another worker last night has made that change to my drink (the drink was great by the way), the lady working today (December 26, 202112:00pm) has been really stubborn and given us an unsatisfactory service. Condescending and rude for no reason. My girlfriend asked if her order was ready, because some Starbucks keep orders behind the counter due to COVID. The employee said. I am currently at the Starbucks in Willow Grove mall - my idea is include more customer service courses for the team members or quality control of the team member. I was served by a team member who was an older woman with red hair she was wearing a purple Starbucks shirt and did not display a name tag. This employee did not greet me as the customer she held a conversation with another team member during my order and did not thank me for the business or say have great day. A TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE

Walking up to Starbucks at 3 AM some weeks ago, from a full table outside, I heard,

"VAGINA!"

...WTF?  A minute later, I realized that they were playing a game like Taboo or Catch Phrase.  Apparently, they're ALWAYS there.  Good times.  Though I still wonder what that word was...

Yes, I'm writing yet another 5-star review for a Starbucks.  I mean, it's hard to give a place that's open 24/7 any other rating.  Plus, they've got cute, attentive baristas ready to serve you a tasty drink any hour of the day!  You can't beat that.  Definitely my Starbucks of choice when I'm in Tampa!

Sidenote: If you're going to sit outside, use bug spray.  In the scant few minutes that I sat outside to people-watch, I got four mosquito bites on my leg!

This Starbucks is convenient if you're in Manayunk.

Staff have always been nice, and I've had my fair share of coffee drinks here.

For you drivers out there, street parking can be a royal pain.

Pretty standard for an airport coffee kiosk.  However the coffee and egg bites were on point even though there were 27 people in front of me, they averaged about a minute per customer.  With only two folks working, that is pretty impressive. They were also very nice to each and every customer, this says a lot for a stressful situation with so many impatient coffee deprived travelers.
OMG! The price is over priced! Plus the attitude is bad! How can they have such a bad service in the airport! They should train their employees!

No matter the time of day I come to this location there is always a super long wait!  It seems they have to brew the coffee fresh for each customer. Lol. After about a 20 minute wait, the host was apologetic for the wait and took my order. My Pumpkin Spice Latte was hot, flavorful and delicious. And my Berry Açaí drink was perfect for later.

Ordered a sandwich and they forgot to make it. Not a huge deal at first. Mistakes happen. But I stood there and the barista (Alexis maybe, pink hair) wouldn't make eye contact with me at all. I could have been standing there bleeding out and she wouldn't have looked at me. I waited it out trying to get her attention, as I had plenty of time while waiting for my flight. But finally another employee noticed me, apologized that they forgot, and took care of my order. Maybe a bad day for Alexis, but with the way she was interacting with her fellow employees, I believe it was just a bad attitude and bad customer service.

Nice location close to Walmart. We ordered expresso and American coffee. Inside was not crowded. The order was taken with details. Ambience was nice with a wall art on coffee lifecycle. Order was quick and service was due.

A full-fledged Starbucks INSIDE a JW Marriott resort?!  Couldn't ask for a better combo!  It was a nice treat to get a cold frap on a hot AZ summer day.  There is nothing else for miles and miles from this resort as it is in the hills above Tucson, but well worth the drive and the bonus was this Starbucks.  You don't have to be a guest here either to enjoy it and prices were the same as any other Starbucks.
Really bad, the coffee is cold, really bad personal, im upset  no sugar, im not come back!

This is a very small Starbucks.  It gets pretty crowded, and it's not uncommon to not find an open seat inside.  They have added more tables outside, so if the weather's agreeable, that's fine. 

Service is good here, but I've seen them get way behind a time or two when it's busy.  One one such occasion, my drink somehow got pushed aside, and folks who came in after I did got their stuff first.  I had to ask where my drink was, and then they got with it.

Went to Starbucks after eating lunch at new restaurant around the corner called Dim Sum factory.  I love going to Starbucks!.  Order was taken. Upon paying, the cashier asked my son and myself, what did we like about Christmas? I thought that was nice that she asked.  My drink was made to perfection.  I will continue to go to this Starbucks.

No Carmel or Brown Sugar syrup, so they can't make the drink they're currently advertising...HUH? 

Also, I can't scan my Starbucks rewards to earn points because this location inside Target is not setup for this capability...not really sure why not and def. disappointed!

The Macchiato also tasted bitter - the sugar helps to cut down on it, but I could def. taste it and it didn't go down smoothly like other ones that have been made for me.

The customer service was really good besides the shortage of syrups to not be able to make the original drink I wanted!

I won't be back - I expect better for a coffee that costs +$5.00!

No dining at this location because the chairs are still up on the table.

This Starbucks is a licensed shop by BPG (I assume) rather than being directly managed. They don't have a lot of the food options and don't typically participate in promos. If you're an avid app user - beware no mobile orders and no redeeming star rewards but at least you can spend the gift cards.

Pros: Best coffee shop hours downtown, would be great if it were open even later but anything after 5 is still a rarity around here. Open on the weekends (live music which may or may not be what you want out of your weekend coffee stop). Lots of outlets.

Unfortunately this Starbucks is kind of dirty. Especially the bathrooms which are locked and must be unlocked by a staff member. Given that the employees are unlocking the door so much you'd think they'd stay on top of the cleanliness... to be somewhat fair they are nice enough to let anyone use the restroom who asks and it seems that some homeless people are using the space to bathe/freshen up. That is a difficult situation but still the dirty paper towels and water all over the floor have to be dealt with.

Some of the employees are super sweet and make visiting a great experience. Some seem like they hate anyone who walks in the door. Hit or miss attitudes, but at least the drinks are made correctly and quickly.

Customer service is awesome and they are very kind and caring. They are very understanding if you don't have enough money they sometimes help you out a little because they know that these are hard times

Food: 4 Stars

Prompt, friendly, great for when you're on the run and need a pick me up! These guys are always reliable. :]
The girl working here was completely rude and there's always a long wait. But the drinks come out average so some times the convenience over the other Springfield Starbucks wins out.

This Starbucks is always slow, and my order is usually wrong(today they added smoked sea salt to my honey latte, I did not order salt on my latte). Disappointed customer, the location is ideal however the service is subpar. I would recommend going to the Lindbergh and Lemay location instead, they always get my order correct and are way more efficient!

I went away for the summer and now I have returned to school to find that this Starbucks has apparently put their night shift on during the rush hour. I will also post this review on your Facebook, once I find it.
Slow service. Ordered one iced coffee with cream and one Americano plain. Took over twenty minutes to make. And no apology for the wait., I don't care for Starbucks coffee, but was desperate.
Let me keep short and sweet. Hands down the worst Starbucks, they can't make coffee & the staff seems to have been hired from the unfriendly stupid valley employment agency.

Had a bit of a rough experience there with the ordering process, however your barista Raven made up for it with her absolutely joyous and super friendly attitude. Also she had excellent customer service that supersedes any Starbucks I've ever been to. Also note, Julianna who was working there was also very friendly and kind. The quality of the drink was so good I got a double shot yum yum yum. So albeit a rough start, it turned out to be a good experience.

It's 4:35am and their hours say 4:30 am opening time. The employees were very rude to people asking why they were not open at 4:35am when clearly it says 4:30. They said they were running behind and they would open in 15 minutes. Time is everything when traveling, and most certainly when taking a 5:30am flight. It is very inconvenient to have them not open on time. For being an airport location, this absolutely sucks. It is beyond disappointing that Starbucks cannot ensure quality at its locations. Anytime I fly through this airport I will avoid Starbucks like the plague.

Asked for egg & cheese sandwich. Not possible. 
Head to Dunkin Donuts in the food court.
A little small but I love the area of  town it is in. Right inn the shopping district.  Parkking is challenging (meters).

Not my favorite Starbucks. The service is ok and the food is the same. It's pretty quick service, but my sandwich wasn't very warm. It normally takes a while to make my drinks. This is a decent Starbucks for an airport. This is the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. 

The next time I'll probably just go to Chic-Fil-A. It was right across the food court

Omg terminal b Starbucks has got to be the slowest Starbucks ever I don't think I've ever seen people this disinterested. 3 people working and I kid you not 15 mins to get to the register. Literally made it past tsa pre faster. I think these guys may need some corporate training

Not only did we have to wait in line for an extended amount of time but we were only allowed to order grande size drinks and they were out of the drink we wanted and out of all 3 food choices we wanted. Very disappointed won't be going back to this Starbucks again!

In the past this Starbucks has been nothing but drama for me. Today was a completely different experience. The baristas were ridiculously friendly and the service was wicked fast. The order accuracy has always been a triumph here. 

I usually find the cafe orders to be quite slow. It's possible that there is a completely new team. It's possible there's a new manager. I don't know what it is but boy it's like a whole new store. The drive thru is usually more reliable for speed. 

As of September 30, 2020 they have recently reopened the cafe for some socially distant seating. The restrooms are still closed for guests.

I sat in the drivethru of this location longer than I've ever waited for Starbucks in my life and there were only 3 cars in the drive thru. The guy taking my order was excited to do his little voice and schtick but didn't listen to my order. He asked me the size after I'd ordered. When I got to the front of the line ten minutes later, he tried to give me a hot beverage. I reminded him of asked for it iced. 

After all of this, he did not offer it free, give me the mistake drink, or even apologize for the long wait made even longer by the mess up. Not the experience I'm accustomed to at Sbux.

Convenient drive-thru. Always seems like a popular drive thru, but workers are fast. Standard full-service menu to include nitro cold brew (if that's your thing, like me). Outdoor seating next to the parking lot seems dog friendly. A small grass area close by, too. Some assigned parking spots for curbside pickup up front with additional parking on the side. Easy access from I-55. 90 seconds from exit.
I'm sorry but the staff here is just rude. I'll just go to the one down the street next time because they are way nicer. Guess I should have known going to a Starbucks inside of a target

Gentrification at it's best.  So many white people.  Open early as heck and doubles as a warm spot to wait for the fantastic NOLA public trans.  But the best part...They have free WiFi and welcome all the homeless.  By the way, PJ coffee is right next door.

This is a common stopping place while traveling to LA (they call me the urinator like it's my super power lol) The Fireman can get a quick coffee and I can use a restroom. As far as service for Starbucks, the baristas were so so friendly. You could tell the holiday "weekend" was enough. It's just ok.
Went here today for my morning drinks for my husband and I. The baristas did a fantastic job. Ris is one of my personal favs. Thank you Burlington starbs!
The girls did amazing! So many people were rude and they were so busy and they worked great under pressure. Kind of disappointed in how adults act these days.

As a former employee (partner), I can say without a doubt that the drive thru window staff is a nightmare. In the morning, add 10-15 min to your drive thru order time. @Management, please train new employees during day shift so we're not all late to work for bar drink orders. The baristas deliver, it's the order being taken slowly/incorrectly and slow handoff that delay the process. Go to another location.

Just went through the drive thru and it was super fast. 

Inside, well it's not the nicest. Furniture is old and worn, not in the cool vintage way, but in the yucky please clean this way. 

There's not good space to have a private conversation with a friend.

But thankfully the staff here are nice, quick, and attentive. Thanks team!

I am a huge starbucks customer and I have to say that this is my all-time favorite Starbucks location. I've gone to this Starbucks location for probably four years now and have never been disappointed or had any issues with the service. All of the employees are extremely kind and welcoming, the space is always very clean and well-kept, there is plenty of space, & the service is superb. Joey, who I am assuming is a manager, does an amazing job of ensuring that the customers are taken care of and leave satisfied with their visit. When I do come to this specific Starbucks location I am usually there for multiple hours doing work and I find myself choosing to come to this specific location over any others, even if it is 15 minutes away while a Starbucks is right next-door to me, just because I enjoy this location that much more. I can definitely say that they are doing a wonderful job, and that I feel extremely welcomed and valued as a customer of this location. Keep up the great service guys!!

Just moved from Cali and super stoked this Starbucks is literally in my backyard. The staff / team here have the best friendliest customer service so far. My order is ready and fresh for pick up. Thank you for your excellent service at times like these (Covid19) Keep up the great work, stay safe and always keep smiling you make a difference.

Worst Starbucks experience. The woman taking orders fussed a young girl because she scanned her phone for the rewards when the barista wasn't ready. The girl profusely apologized and the barista kept commenting obviously making the girl feel terrible. The woman in front of me had a card not functioning right and the barista made a snide comment about it. And when I ordered I was critiqued for it. To wait in a 45 min long line just to receive a critique at the end... terrible.

I love this Starbucks. It's the most spacious one I've been to. I never have to worry about finding a place to sit if I chose to stay and drink my coffee. The service is friendly and fast, and my drink is always how I want it. I highly recommend the pumpkin spice latte, the iced cinnamon almond milk macchiato, or a Frappuccino. I hope they bring back the mocha cookie crumble and s'mores frapp back next summer!

Did drive through. I usually go inside to check out all the goodies. Always happy with service and coffee. I always order extra hot so I know it will be my idea of normal hot. Terrific brews. Super nice barista. Her apron was quite soiled so I know she's a hard worker.

I went here on Sunday (1/2/2022). We had already placed our order through the mobile app at 130. Went inside at 140. At 215 I texted my son to see what was going on only to be told there were several people in line waiting for drinks. Most had been waiting over 25 mins. I called the store and was told they were really behind and not able to catch up but that I could keep waiting (no time frame given) or come in and get my money back. I went in to get my son and get my money back. The manager was nice and came out from the back to refund me. I'm no expert but as a manager if you have a team that is failing miserably shouldn't you jump in and help?  They were clearly overwhelmed and undertrained. But no he gave me my money back and went back in the back while his team drowned in orders and customers kept getting more and more frustrated. Not a good manager and that gives you a team that will never succeed.  I will drive the extra ten minutes to Royersford to get stellar service or just go to Wawa or Dunkin next time. Horrible service. Nice workers just not trained or supported.

I often go to this Starbucks. Today I was disappointed and didn't notice till I got home.  I ordered a strawberry lemonade acai with 3 pulps of raspberry syrup.  But where are my floating strawberries?
The WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE EVER. Total attitude from the time we walked in.. 20 minutes to get a pour over!!!  Pathetic.
Tried a new drink today... chi tea latte.... Tasty, iced and will go for it again! Drive thru was easy with good prompt service! I like the cup to sip my drink and not have a separate straw! Thanks!

I have always passed this Starbucks, but never really had the opportunity to give it a try until the other day. My Mom and I were in the mood for a refreshing drink and a snack. 

My Mom got an iced black tea with lemonade and cane sugar, I got an iced passion tea unsweetened with stevia, we each got one cheese stick and the dark chocolate graham cookies to split. 

This particular location looks so fancy, I love the exterior. The employees were also super friendly and helpful when I accidentally gave my name for the order rather than my Mom's (we were using her app). 

I could smell the delicious coffee through the drive thru window, it smelled heavenly. Smelled like a legitimate coffee house. Beautiful!!! 

I definitely would recommend this location again!

This is one of the most rude coffee stores in Sparks NV . He only employee who was working at the time we drove by never acknowledged us as we drove to the drive thru she flat out ignored us for 3 minutes! Ugly baristas get ugly reviews!
Very nice and accommodating...out of dark roast and gave me a special pour over at no extra cost

They should consider closing this location. They literally never have anything in stock, run out of things constantly and they are slow AF. I understand there are supply issues but just take it off the menu already. Frankly it's not like SB coffee is actually good, it's just slightly better than mediocre and convenient, but when you have to hit up multiple places to meet your needs you might as well just skip it.
Its amazing that i can place a mobile order without being notified ahead of time that i have to sit in the huge drive thru line. Defeats the whole purpose of mobile ordering!
Service was absolutely terrible spent. Spent 10 minutes being ignored by a staff before someone offered to take my order.

I was very disappointed by the crew at this Starbucks.  It wasn't even busy and my order was wrong and got a "geesh" remark from the barista when the coffee was served lukewarm and I asked it be warmed up. Also, internet was lacking so I couldn't use my phone to pay. I did not get a receipt to claim the points and when I went back to ask for one I got another "geesh" from the cashier.  To top it all off, I wasn't done ordering and cashier started waiting on the next person. REALLY??  Not a pleasant experience.

Worst Starbucks ever!!!! I am always in this line for 30 minutes or more!!! They're so unorganized and customer service was horrid to top it off! This is the only Starbucks on my way to work get it together guys!!!!

Not sure what happened here, but some of the people that work here are just awful. The person that made my coffee didn't get the lid on right so that when I went to take a sip, the lid popped off and hot coffee poured down my shirt. Everyone saw it, including the person that made my coffee. They didn't even apologize when I asked for napkins. Just pointed to them. A simple 'oh my gosh, I'm so sorry' goes a long way people.

Came to this location as I was in the area and was early for my appointment next door at the hair salon so decided to stop in and get a drink.  It actually wasn't busy at the time I went so I was able to walk right up and place my order which was very nice.  They were nice and had my drink ready in no time!  Great taste and friendly service.

I wouldn't even give one star! All 3 Starbucks locations at IND are filthy and service is horrible. It's been this way for years and needs to be fixed by HMSHost. HMSHost operates and manages all 3 locations. The location in Civic Plaza is the worst. It took 30 minutes to get an espresso at 5pm on March 15. Neither the cashier or one barista were thrilled to be working and it was reflective in their demeanor and slow movement. HMSHost is failing to uphold the Starbucks brand!
The people who work here are seriously the best. Always so nice! Keep it up Starbucks crew, you guys are my favorite
This is currently my favorite Starbucks the staff is always friendly the coffee is always Starbucks but the atmosphere is always comfortable. Big thanks to Jake

Dear  Starbucks Co.

I drink your coffee when I'm in a pinch due to your baristas' lack of coffee knowledge and poor attitude. The lack of customer service has only increased with current Covid-19 regulations. 

You know... I'm so ticked off, I'm not even going to bother further.

IND airport Terminal B Starbucks had three people working behind counter with one of them making drinks. Took 15 minutes to take orders from 5 customers in line. Several orders inaccurately recorded by indifferent clerks. No customer name requested for our order. Drinks made quickly, but incorrectly because orders inaccurately recorded - and drinks ordered didn't have any special requests!

05:00 am, the Barristas seemed harassed and unwelcoming. I'll never ever go to this place ever!! I waited 17 minutes until the opening time, no smile, no thank you no nothing. Gimme your money, get your coffee and just go

Worst Starbucks ever. I've never in my life seen Four women work so slow. Literally 40 min to just order. People were leaving because their flights were boarding after standing in line for over half an hour. The manager should be fired and the Starbucks should be closed. Find a new coffee shop.

Staff was so nice, they filled up our water bottles. The place was clean and well stocked. We may of gotten lucky that it was a down time so there was no rush. The new holiday offerings look great too!

It's no surprise to me that the reviews for this location are so bad.

Unfortunately for me this is the closest location to my office so I happen to stop in quite a bit. I've had some not great experiences there but always chalked it up to nothing& didn't want to write a review- which isn't really like me. 

So we will start with today- ordered ahead because I needed a pick me up on a rainy day. Take the walk in the rain pick up my drink, walk back. Take the elevator ride, get back to my desk ahh can finally take my mask off& sip my sweet pumpkin hot chocolate. UGH but I'm met with a coffee. In my correctly labeled hot chocolate cup. 

So I have to walk back in the rain- don't get a sorry just "I'll remake it" handed my drink a couple minutes later. I take a sip of the half full feeling cup and it is pumpkin, but almost all foam. Which my original had been customized for "no foam" but I didn't have time to wait& didn't feel like getting the attitude about it. 


Another day I wanted to use some cash I had on me but still get the rewards for my 2 drinks. I asked the cashier to scan my app for my rewards& she stated that's too complicated& wouldn't do it. 

Dumbfounded I just walked away, waited a few weeks& then this today. I'm done.

Went here just before closing and were happy to find it still serving. Ordered a nitro and frap and two water because we'd just changed a flat. They forgot the waters and didn't mix the drinks. We asked for a straw to mix the drink but they said they were closed now and couldn't open the window to give us a straw. We went to Luciana's for straws. Love that place.

Have been several times as my office is nearby.  Service is generally friendly but slow.  I would love to get coffee before my early trains to New York but they are almost never open on time.  Great location, they just need execution help in a big way.

Always nice people 
Always consistent 
Coffee never bitter
Nice option to sit from time to time and get get the day moving forward.

I feel sad for the other employees. Shannon at Starbucks was rolling her eyes at them, yelling at one of the younger girl(Isabella I believe) for asking her "too many questions" and kept raising her voice saying "OH MY GOSHHHHH" towards her 

She was also ignoring the customers because she was so flustered with the other employees (who were not doing anything wrong)

It costs $0 to be a kind human.

Y'all. I come here very often as it is right around the corner from my work. I've gotta say I am consistently underwhelmed by the staff. They are beyonddddd rude allll the time. I didn't request a bad attitude with my $7 coffee and I certainly don't need to be spoken down to & yelled at. I will be taking my business elsewhere.

The airport Starbucks stand is awful. I don't fly that often, but when do I look for comfort foods (drinks included). This Starbucks in front of gates B16 and 17, has consistently feel short on making a satisfactory order. I ask for a simple tall carmel apple spice. WhatI get is just hot apple juice; no whip cream, no carmel, and no spice.  Aauugghhh! I've got to remember to go to Copper Moon next time.

Across the causeway from Tampa where St. Petersburg meshes with Clearwater is one fine Starbucks.  I could tell from driving by.  It is on that racetrack of a thoroughfare that is Ulmerton, your first Pinellas County exit off I-275 when driving over from Tampa.  (Many of the major roads around here are racetracks, with 3 lanes in each direction and frisky driving.)

First, the staff was incredibly friendly.  I told them I liked their store.  They explained that this is the "regional" store and that it had been a bank at one time.  That's why it also has a conference room.

Clearly, their stuff is typical Starbucks fare, which garners about a 3.5 stars from the get go and for which the pricing is boilerplate, but what sells here is the ambiance.  I'm not talking about a stellar ambiance but a really soothing one, with some comfortable seating and larger tables.  There is also a nice patio outside.

I came by here in the evenings so I didn't take photos.  I also just went to get a cup of tea and to do some reading, writing, and organizing.  

And, yes, let me expand on a dynamic that I see from sea to shining sea - when you go for coffee or tea in a way cool neighborhood and at a way cool coffeehouse, your baristas may be turds with a little bit of attitude and apparel and counterculture appendages that come with that way cool packaging.  Then, when you go to a coffeehouse in nice suburbs, the baristas mimic the change in atmosphere.  At this Starbucks, you are right at the entrance to the Feather Sound area, with nice housing north of Ulmerton and corporate type digs south of Ulmerton, so the baristas are better groomed and are more polite and pleasant, commensurate with the surroundings.  End of rant.

Look for the big Shell station on the north side of Ulmerton.  This recommended Starbucks will be across from it, on the same side of the street.

This Starbucks is absolutely disappointing. I live in Carpinteria and dread every time I have to go to this Starbucks when I leave to go down south in the morning. I go to this place hoping it will be better than the last time I went but it never ceases to disappoint me. I went recently this time I mobile ordered. I ordered a Venti Iced Coffee with 2 added shots, light ice, and half and half but what I got was extra ice and no half and half. Not only that but my second order I ordered a grande double shot with light ice, pumps of white mocha and half and half. What I got back was a double shot with the pumps but Extra ice and no half and half. Again once disappointed. Never going back

I come to the Starbucks often mostly through the drive-thru. Each time the Baristas there have been so nice and friendly and of course like any Starbucks I love the coffee in the food. Only downside is that it's a right on the corner of to majorly busy intersections hahaha. I love the look of the place it's very nice and inviting and it's a good place if you wanted to sit and talk or quietly work on something. A good Starbucks to pop by if you're in the area.

Why does it take so long to make a coffee or whatever else they are selling? I've been in the line for the drive Thur since 2:25-2:30 now it's 2:44 pm and I still haven't gotten to order yet! And I have to be in work by 3pm! Smh

I hope people understand that this Starbucks is populated by human beings who have been working with the public throughout the pandemic--I hate to see negative reviews when they can't help that their staff is out sick or that they had to close early due to lack of supplies... anyway this is my go to Starbucks and I love the people here, always kind and polite even when I forget my order as soon as I walk up lol. You all are doing a great job.

Wow, they cant properly fill a cup of coffee.. unless filled to the tiptop as high as possible. The temp of the coffee is also way too high, McDonalds burn your genitalia's hot. Not to mention slow like molasses. Terrible.

Not impressed.  Was there on a slow Friday morning and couldnt get good service.    The heavy set woman with her head covered was exyremely rude.  She took my wifes order and gave her a total with me standing there.  When I told her I had an order she seemed annoyed.  When she was writing our orders on the cups she had her hand on the inside of the cup half way down it.  We pointed it out to her and she got upset at us and put her hand up and said whatever and then walked away.   This was the worst service I have ever had.  I will not go to that Starbucks if she is there anymore.

I've frequented this Starbucks for many years due to it being close to a neighborhood where I used to live. The staff is extremely friendly and efficient. The drive-through line can get pretty long, but employees are usually able to work through it fairly quickly. The coffee is always delicious. I find that this location is out of some food items frequently, so that is a little frustrating. I'm not sure if that is due to busyness or the store not stocking properly. But overall, this is a great store.

Workers are always friendly, drinks are always exactly what I ordered! This location is close to my work so I stop by often and throughout the day. Today, they asked how to spell my name and for me that's a win! Highly recommend this Starbucks location!

Let me just say that there were friendly, efficient people working this Starbucks the evening of September 2nd when we were stuck in the Indy Airport for hours due to a delayed flight. I was disappointed that they closed at 7pm, which felt extremely early for an airport location, but the overall experience was a very good one. Our order was received exactly as requested and even came with a smile from each of the gentlemen working the stand. We made a little small talk since they weren't busy and off my girls and I went to enjoy our tasty beverages! We got what we expected and a dash more.

I usually  drive out of my way to visit this Satrbucks bc they always make my drink the best. And I just have to say how amazing the employees have been since they have re-opened during this pandemic. They have been extremely efficient and kind, and are doing a great job ao kudos to all of them. I will continue to go there even though I have to drive a little further out.

The Good: Their service was fast. 
The Bad: The staff was rude, ignored me for a few minutes as I stood there waiting to order. One of the very fews times that I didn't have a good/welcoming customer service experience at a Starbucks.

Tip: They do take your Starbucks card here.

Those of you who follow my reviews know that I am not a big fan of coffee. In fact the thought of knocking back a mug of percolated, roasted Columbian bean juice pretty much turns my stomach. No matter how much I might like that early morning blast of caffeine to clear the cobwebs after a night of sharing a bottle of Caymus Special Selection Cab during dinner, I just can't handle the taste of coffee. Nope, sorry, it ain't gonna happen!

Now that we have that out of the way I'll continue with my review....

So there I was, innocently minding my own business, as my friend and I strolled the sidewalks of SOHO one afternoon, when she suddenly perked up and gushed, "Oh look.....a Starbucks!". She used her feminine trickery to convince me to stop at the store so that she could order a mega-cup of Grande Mocha Triple-shot Soy Milk Salted Caramel Flan Latte blah blah blah while I ordered a simple hot green tea. (How in the hell does anyone remember the name of a drink that must take 5 minutes to write down all of the ingredients?) Oh, and she also wanted a low-fat blueberry whole-grain yogurt muffin with honey ("because it sounded yummy").

We found a quiet table in a corner of the store, and sat down to chat while waiting for the barista to call the name on our order. (I had momentarily pondered giving my name as 'Beelzebub', but I decided to behave.) Perhaps I was captivated by my date's lovely smile, or the friendliness of the folks behind the counter, but I began to calm down and enjoy my time inside of this coffee shop.

The place was jam-packed with people typing away on their laptops and conversing on their cellphones. There was a group in the corner playing some sort of word game, and every so often they would shout out a random off-the-wall, and generally inappropriate, word and the whole shop would bust out laughing. Another group was playing a board game, and so the mood was very festive.

As I sipped my tea I took in the décor of the shop which included vaulted high ceilings, huge plate-glass windows, tables and chairs which could easily be pushed together to accommodate any-sized group, a large outdoor patio where the locals sat with their four-footed furry friends, super-friendly folks behind the counter, and everyone laughing as they worked or played games or simply chatted away. The smells of the various drinks and food items was pleasing, and I am told that the muffin was divine, though I was threatened with a fork stab to the back of my hand if I even thought about reaching across the table to try a bite.

The folks from Starbucks love to say, "Wake up and smell the coffee -- Starbucks is everywhere," and rightly so as the world's #1 specialty coffee retailer has more than 16,000 coffee shops in more than 35 countries. They've built a massively-successful brand, and you have to admire all of that work and the quality of their products.

You'll find this particular Starbucks located along South Howard just south of Swann Avenue, and in easy walking distance of several popular restaurants and neighborhood watering holes. The shop is open at 5am each morning, and stays open till 11pm on weeknights, and then till 12 Midnight on Friday and Saturday nights for your late-night Java fix. There's a huge parking lot out back, so plenty of room to c'mon down and meet your friends.

I'll never be a coffee drinker, but I am a huge fan of this neighborhood gathering spot and the service that they provide to the local community. Oh, and they have hot tea and cocoa to keep me happy!
Erica at the front needs a huge attitude adjustment Just because you hate your job don't take it out on us we love Starbucks  and come to ours every single day!

Incredibly busy Starbucks location so I do understand that the employees may get short tempered or cranky.  It's unfortunate that customers suffer for their moods.  

I was ordering my drink and with the noise of the airport announcement behind me and steamer noise behind the counter, I didn't quite catch the cashier's question but thought she asked if I wanted anything else.  I said "no thank you," but that wasn't an appropriate answer to her question so she said "you gotta stay with me."  I apologized and asked her to repeat her question.  I answered and let her know that I didn't leave I was standing there the whole time but just didn't hear her question.  Ok.  Moved on.

Then the barista serves up my drink and I'm certain I heard "green tea latte, extra soy."  She was speaking pretty fast.  Anyway, after she returned to the counter I asked is she said "extra soy."  She seemed annoyed and told me that the size of the drink is what I ordered.  I explained I understood that but is the drink extra hot or extra soy?  (The flavor isn't the same if it's with extra soy and not what I ordered).  She said "I said extra hot, soy."  Ah.  Ok.  Great.  Got my drink just as I ordered but please keep your attitudes to yourself. 

It's unfortunate that the area by the airport gates is noisy.  I'm sure customers really do want to make the ordering process efficient and friendly.  A little understanding, please.

Hope your day gets better Starbucks IND Concourse B18!.

Every Friday for the last few months I place an order to pick up on my way to work. I think the last 5 or 6 visits, Nicolas has greeted me by name. I think that is awesome, mask and all he recognized me and my weekly visit!! It's a little thing like saying good morning Debbie that makes a great start to my day!! 
I don't know how often I'll make it in over the summer but hopefully it will be when Nicolas is working!!
Thanks!

I looked to see if there was a Starbucks on the way to my friend's house, and this one came up as being on-my-route. I pulled into the parking lot and struggled to find a spot (there's a bunch of other stores in the same strip mall - like a Giant). I thought to myself that the parking situation was probably an indicator of how busy they were inside the store, so I put in a mobile order instead (to avoid the line).

By the time I walked out of my car and into the restaurant my order was already completed and ready for pick-up. I was beyond impressed with their speed and will definitely be stopping here every time I go visit my friend!

I go here to get coffee for my often and every time I'm in here I wait 10 plus minutes for a house coffee with cream in it. I live in this community and still feel as though they (the employees, which most don't even live here) treat everybody as though we are bothering them.

I actually drive past two other Starbucks locations to go to this one now. My previous favorite location was the one on Park, but they closed back in May and I've not been happy with the service or drink consistency at the other local Starbucks.

But when I come to this location, the employees are always really friendly and just seem like they are genuinely happy to be there. My cold brew drink is consistently made well where at other locations it's either all coffee or all cream. There are usually a few cars in line but there's plenty of room in the drive thru line and it moves pretty fast. Keep up the good work!

I love this Starbucks it's always really fast and all the workers are super nice! Especially the barista Sydney she's recommended so many delicious drinks that I've never tried before, she always took her time to make sure the customer was happy with their order and always promoting a happy attitude. Please promote her she deserves it!

I wish I could give this place 0 stars. 


Terrible staff. Beyond rude. 
Long wait times.

These other reviews are so disappointing because this location is just wonderful. The folks who work here are always friendly and their drinks always taste great! I love popping in to this location before work. It makes my day brighter! Love y'all.

There was a long line but I could hear someone bantering with customers in a cheery upbeat manner. When I got closer I could see it was the person behind the register. She was smiling, greeting every new person, taking their order, asking how to spell their name correctly, and asking where they were from or where they're going as she's ringing them up. None of her chatting slowed her down one bit, as a matter of fact she was really quick and efficient. I was through the line in no time and was left with a "good travels lovebug!"  Seriously if I had a customer service position anywhere around here I would try to hire her away. None of her badges showed her name but I snapped a pic so If you own a business around here, you may want to pay a visit yourself.

Most of the time the coffee here is ok some times is better then others but overall it's pretty ok. The problem is the workers they r very rude at least Saturday night shift workers since that's when I came and they were very rude to me and my husband. When I used their restroom the toilet wouldn't flush so instead of leaving it broken for the next costumer I went to let one of the workers know but when I tried to tell a male worker I was ignored till about the third time I called him then when I told him that one of their toilets wasn't flushing he looked at me like he was mad I bothered him. Another girl worker came up at that point I'm guessing hearing what I told him and gave me such a look of anger and irritation like I had broke the toilet myself and kept staring at me with such anger till I walked out the store with my husband and our drinks. So heads up to anyone going their if you encounter anything broken in the restrooms maybe you should just leave the employees to find it out for themselves since you probably won't get a good response for letting them know.
Slooowwwww. Make sure you place your mobile order 35 mins in advance if you want it somewhat on time.

No words for the horrible drink i just received. It was so bad that I literally just took a sip handed it back to them and drove away...and yes I paid for it. What a waste of my time and money. It wasn't a hard drink to make just a black tea lemonade...simply horrible. No wonder this location has 2 star review.

This may be the largest Starbucks I have seen east of Ohio! 

At least 5,000 square feet, it feels like a small theater, more than a cafe. Plenty a seating with tables, chairs and more relaxed furniture in the corner. Easily 15 foot ceiling which does impact the acoustics, but almost feels like being outside. A 50 foot wall long black and white panel that pulls the room together. 

Yet, when I was there at 4:30 on a recent afternoon, the operation was being run by only 3 baristas, including drive through service. Impressive that they managed to sweep and clean up the place during their shifts. 

Menu was standard for the Green Mermaid, although the display case was somewhat depleted given the time of day. I snared the final slice of lemon pound cake - my endulgance for the week. It was as tart and sweet as always. 

While still not a true fan of Starbucks, this place isn't bad.

I love this Starbucks. Every time I go, the baristas are super nice and very open to talk. They also recommend good drinks and many that I don't know about! Prices are good for the sizes. Word on the street is that they are finally using better ingredients while decreasing the amount of artificial sweeteners in their beverages. The layout is comfortable and there are plenty of tables to occupy. Wifi is great, they now have Google wifi which is 100 times better than the old one. I am definitely coming back here for sweet caffeine trips or simple college studying.

Super slow! One would think as it is an airport Starbucks, efficiency would be the key word, but 
no way. They are slow, employees are chatting to each other, and it can take 15-20 minutes to get coffee. Of course there might not be any cream
by the time you get that far...use at your own risk of delay!!!
Very dirty outside and in. Very slow service also sold out of Tea. This location has been closed 2 times for employees with Covid. By far the worst starbuck I have ever been to.
Worth the wait in line. Staff are always friendly and polite. Love stopping by for a quick treat with my daughter.
Very slow Starbucks. Was not very organized and did not really know how to deal with the large crowd.
This location is awful. You have to double check everything in the drive through. These people could fuck up a wet dream. If you want sbux, find a different location.

Ridiculously slow! TSA was faster and friendlier! They forgot my drink (the cup disappeared) and saw me standing there and didn't think to ask me what I was waiting on. And when I brought it to their attention they seemed annoyed. Very happy that I don't regularly travel through this airport.

Overall - The coffee and chai tea latte were good once they got the order right.
Drinks - both drinks were consistent with what you would expect from a starbucks
Atmosphere - small stand in a travel plaza, not a full starbucks
Service - good service

What can I say? I've been waiting for a Starbucks drive thru forever! The staff were friendly and the inside of the store is laid back and relaxing. It's very spacious so doesn't feel too crowded when there are a lot of people. The one downside is a small parking lot that can get backed up with cars coming in to park and cars leaving the drive thru. They also have two 10 minute mobile order parking spots! So cool!
This was one if my favorite Starbucks.  The team was super friendly and you could tell they really enjoyed being there and serving the customers.

First of all let me say that I stay in the lower 9th ward in New Orleans Louisiana. I would go to the local coffee shop in the area just like anyone else. Will I continue to use the local shops yes I will but I will also go to Starbucks on Elysian Fields. And I started off with saying that because I see a lot of reviews complaining about a major company taking advantage of the small local businesses. There's room for all. 

But my experience at this new location was calming .  Walking in was very clean and the staff was extremely helpful. Free WiFi was definitely in place because the laptops were definitely in use. The only thing I would say is a dislike of mine is the no drive-thru. Other than that I was able to order online and pick up just like any other store.

Came in on a 10 min break lol but it's 2 mins from my job. Saw that the line was a tad bit busy just 5 cars so I went inside luckily no one was there ordering ;so I ordered quick seemed as though I'd receive my drink quick as well....a guy comes in a few minutes after I ordered & received his drink a min later & yet I was still waiting on mines so I INSTANTLY asked when was my COLD BREW that takes exactly a min to make you guys like seriously  ( I would know I worked at the one ) so as soon as I asked about the drink this SWEET gal assisted me UNDER A MIN. with the drink I ordered & the guy that placed my order was doing NOTHING !!!!!! Like why did I have to spend 7 mins standing there ? No one else was inside ordering! & it was SIX people there . Like geesh

Love my local Starbucks! Friendly service and pretty consistent in terms of quality. I recommend their refreshers and bagels! 

Thanks so much for making my mornings better!

Happy to add a star from my previous review. Ordering ahead on the Starbucks mobile app for pick-up in store is super convenient. I've enjoyed their almond milk honey flat white over the past couple months and always enjoy indulging in a holiday drink. This location's drive thru is usually pretty long but it goes pretty fast. Seating inside is currently closed due to covid but you can still go in and pick up your drink if you ordered ahead.

Fortunately, coffee drinkers are addicts so they put up with a lot to get the coffee.  Very rude workers.  Petty.  No customer service.  They don't even try to be decent.  Convenient location is best attribute.  Usually there's parking, but wow, putting up with the disrespect and rudeness of the "help" is very hard.  90% of customers are using Apps.
I like this location.  It's big, and they crank the drinks out fast.  There are plenty of places to sit, and there's plenty of parking.

The staff at this location are super friendly and I've never had a bad experience with my drinks or mobile order pickups inside! Although ever since this location opened up a few years ago they have probably one of the slowest drive thru lines I've ever seen despite what time of the day I go. I just wish they could have some more emphasis on this!

Made my drink poorly and use the wrong milk so I asked them to remake it the guy says yes I'll make it and then use the last of the milk I needed on a drink he had not started yet knowing full well that that was the last of his milk. Completely disrespectful and lackadaisical of my time. This is not my first bad experience at the Starbucks. There is serious attitude problems at this location

Generally terrible customer service. Unfortunately I think the location is what keeps them in business - close proximity to 295 for travelers. I'm guilty of stopping there during travels to PA because of the location and every time I kick myself - mediocre beverages and food that's either sold out or never heated all the way -- certainly not a good representation of the Starbucks brand and consistency.

The manager came to the door and unlocked it, turning us away and saying she wouldn't be opening until 5:30 because she was "running behind".  She wouldn't let us in.

That's pretty shoddy....and I've seen something like this before at another Starbucks.  The shift supervisor that time simply didn't get up in the morning and I sat outside with the employees until she showed up.

No caption needed this was in a iced caramel macchiato
Look like someone shaved in it. Had to wait almost a month to talk to a manager on the phone because no one was in at the time and only wanted to give me one free drink.

This is where my husband and I get our morning coffee when we are in the area visiting family. I always have a complicated order, and it is always met with a smile. The staff here are great, above average staff for a Starbucks in my experience. They are super friendly, have never messed up my order, and have been very accommodating. For example, I wanted an egg and cheese breakfast sandwich the last time I was here, and they were out of them. The cashier offered to take the sausage off of a sausage, egg, and cheese for me before it was heated. 

I've never been able to sit down and enjoy my coffee in-house, as the tables are always full when I stop by.

The reasons it is a four and not a five: 1. I always order my drink extra-hot, and sometimes I still get it regular temperature (not a huge deal as I just go home and microwave it), 2. During busy times they run out of different food items quickly, and 3. It is a small Starbucks and is always very crowded with a constant line (though I think they handle the volume of business generally well).

I'm only picky about a few things, and my coffee is one of them. I always know when I come here that I will get what I'm expecting and will get great customer service (much appreciated, especially before I get my morning coffee!).

Our local Starbucks is a MESS!! Drove through last week and bought a few things and asked for a water too. "Due to a national cup shortage, we cannot give out water" ... so I asked if they could fill my cup. Nope, "due to covid, we won't fill your cup, you must purchase a water bottle." Ugh.. wow. Okay...

Then, yesterday my family walked to Starbucks & the door was locked. They had a sign that they are not doing mobile orders and clearly their cafe was closed for an unknown reason. There was a lady with her family sitting outside and said that she just walked through the drive though  so do that. We attempted to walk though the drive though and we're denied service. Furthermore, they have been "out" of many things including oat milk despite being in the same parking lot as Raley's. 

They suck. I'm going to avoid going there. Super annoying.

I think this Starbucks might be a training ground for new hires..lots of new faces.. Everytime we go there, drinks taste different. LONG wait and  unfriendly workers. Today was another disappointnent. Ordered the midnight mocha today. Nothing minty about it. Taste like a milk chocolate. My 75% full grande vanilla bean frap and my watery venti chocolate.... Peppermint mocha frap

since the app said in store was available, i ordered our coffee/food via mobile order so i could just walk in and walk out. 

instead, the doors are all locked, no signs indicating why and the drive through line is wrapped around the building and almost spilling out on to dale mabry. 

if the store took responsibility to be honest with it's customers and remove the 'in store' from the app your drive thru line wouldn't be ridiculous and people wouldn't rate so poorly.

The first person to review this Starbucks could not be more off. Most of the staff came from the location that closed across the street and they're always so welcoming. The drive thru is always quick and efficient. Yes, sometimes the line is pretty long but I've never waited more than a few minutes. 

If I don't want to risk a wait in the drive thru I order ahead on the app which is super easy. The inside is a nice size compared to the old whitestown location and the outdoor space is awesome in warm weather!

Today we got two kids size chai teas, one vanilla latte, one cold brew.

One of the kids chais was milk and the other had chai, I told the cashier and asked for a cup to mix the two together so they could each have some of the chai mix, she gave me the cup without offering to fix their drinks. 

The cold brew ended up being a nitro which we did not want. 

Never had this kind of experience with Starbucks.

I was asked to leave for not having a mask. I was happy to wait for my coffee outside so I asked if they could notify me while I wait outside. They said no I can not let you know when your coffee is ready. They were extremely rude. On top of it they were wearing clothing affiliated with a political movement that was found to be offensive. I would not recommend this Starbucks.

This store is quite unique. It has a kind of business professional type atmosphere probably because of its location right next to St. Luke's hospital and the tall Portico Office Tower in front of the store. 

Baristas are very courteous, polite, and very efficient. While I was ordering my coffee with the cashier, the barista was getting started on my drink. By the time I wamy wallet back in my pocket, my drink was ready. I was pleasantly surprised by this. 

Also, their north side wall is simply amazing. It's like nothing I've ever seen before and it really gives the store that special coffee feel. 

My only note is that tables are quite small and I had a hard time having more than one item out while I was doing homework. Nevertheless, this is a great spot to meet up on a date or simply catch up with a close friend.

Really recommend you come check out this store and have a nice pumpkin spice latte.

This location is a big small & always busy! They've messed up my drink a few times and got upset to have to fix it. Some employees are nice & some are so rude. But Jessica is the best, super friendly & all around a great employee, you can tell!

This Starbucks gets super-busy during peak mall times. I didn't review it after previous visits because I couldn't decide whether the heavy traffic was a negative or whether the fact that they handle it is a positive. But, after stopping in on Black Friday during a 2-for-1 Frappuccino special, I decided that their crowd handling is good enough to warrant a positive review.

They do an awesome job keeping lines moving while being friendly and without making you feel rushed. Naturally, if there's a line out the door, there will be a bit of a wait for your drink, but I think today's wait was probably the longest I've had in more than a dozen visits to this location, and it was about seven minutes.

They also did a pretty good job positioning seating in their available space so that there's a fair amount of it while none of it is in the way of the line into the store, the path out, or the areas where people wait for their drinks or put cream in their coffee.

It would, of course, be nice if there were a Starbucks in the mall that didn't have a mall's space constraints or KOP's volume of traffic. But this location does an excellent job for its situation.

Go get your coffee on.
Hey the coffee was strong, so what else?
Easy FWY on/off access
Close the beach
Other food choice nearby
Smaller starbucks, with less seating both indoors and outdoors
Wifi was slow at the time

Great Starbucks. Nice people, and they prepare the drinks well. A lot of Starbucks have stuff that's kind of watered down, fortunately that isn't the case here. The building itself is pretty clean too. They're also the only place that spells my name right.

i never stop here because it's always so busy but i did today and my order was completely wrong i requested a venti ribbon crunch frapp with extra crunch and a warm banana nut bread. what i got was a burnt banana nut bread and a grande ribbon crunch with no crunch! i will never be back my order wasn't hard at all very simple and when i told the worker that i wanted a venti all she said was "oohhh i'm sorry!" come on now. 
don't waste your time going here for sure, all you'll get it wasted time and wrong order

I have been to this location several times and it was always good until today. Arriving around 1:30 I use the restroom and no soap. I wait for my daughter and this place is downright dirty. Tables all uncleaned and stuff all over the floor. So dirty I went outside. There were easily 5 staff members doing mainly drive thru with no in-house lines but no one was cleaning up. I stayed for a very long time visiting and drinking coffee. Not till 3:30 were floors swept by incoming next shift staff member. Bad impression.
Ollie/Olay (not sure if that's the spelling, sorry!) at the window was so kind and friendly to us and provided above & beyond service! Made for a great experience, many thanks to them!

This Starbucks is located on Los Altos pkwy next to walgreens.
The store is a good size with ample seating and comfortable seating selections.
The wifi is excellent both inside and out.
There are a couple of tables to sit at outside on warm days.
The coffee i ordered was delicious. I really was expecting the starbucks burnt taste, but my latte was really good.
The coffee shop was extremly clean and the the baristas were very friendly.

This is one of the nicer Starbucks in the area...right now they are just drive thru because of COVID which is understandable and I appreciate them taking precautions. They have great customer service skills and I have always been satisfied with my drinks which is not the case for some of the other Starbucks I visit. Before the virus I used to sit in the cafe and get some work done however there wasn't much work getting done because one of the baristas named josh (I think) is quit the distraction...but anyway all in all it's a great stop.

Ordered two skinny vanilla lattes. Took 20min to get the coffee on a Sunday evening. Got two lattes with whole milk and only 1 pump of sf vanilla syrup looking back at the receipt. Won't be going back to this Starbucks.
I recently had the pleasure of visiting this Starbucks and Amanda was an absolute gem. The team was cheerful, the wait was short, and the coffee was great!
Ok service , really nice layout. Only one creamer out and it was not labeled. At the end of the day it's a coffee shop and served it's purpose.
Slow. Understaffed. Impossible drive through. Slow inside. Horrible layout. Even on a Saturday morning this might be the slowest location.

Very disorganized. Got up charged, wanted a black coffee and some egg bites: should've been around or under $10 but got charged $16. Then they forgot about my coffee and I had to remind them 5 minutes after that I just had a black coffee that they literally keep on hand and just have to pour it. Worst Starbucks I have ever went to very unsatisfied with the service. They were out of everything I tried to order. The girls had terrible attitudes and were beyond rude.

A Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks. This one is reliable, with friendly employees, even when I stop by before 6 AM, a usually quick drive-through, and a clean store. The drawbacks are that you can only really get in going eastbound or southbound (not their fault) and that the outside drive-through ordering sign is almost always broken.

Not a coffee standout, but if you need your go-to espresso drink, this Starbucks always suffices.

They had some random person standing out side telling everyone they are closed at 1pm when I showed up a min after. You should really update your hours online or something. Or maybe just close this location.

As I sit watching while my drink is being made, I witnessed an employee restock supplies, warm up food, SMASH HER BARE HANDS DOWN THE GARBAGE and proceed to making drink orders. Major food violation for all to see. Starbucks needs to train employees to wash hands more regularly? This consumer will not be retuning to this one.

This Starbucks is one of the most frustrating I've encountered. They can never keep up with the volume that comes through there and the parking lot is too small to support the amount of cars waiting in line. You either get stuck in the road in Brentwood which is always busy or if you try and park to go in you will get stuck in your parking spot till the end of existence by the lane of cars waiting in line at the drive through. They also frequently disable their ordering app so you can't order ahead and just pick up. I don't understand why this happens so often they need more staff or something.
Counter service is fast and friendly. When it gets busy it can be a longer wait and barista drinks can be inconsistent

This is a new drive thru Starbucks on RT. 541 (Burlington-Mt. Holly Road), is one of their smaller designs, yet with ample comfortable seating for those who prefer to sip in or work, and a tight bar area with two cashiers and snack offerings. The staff is skilled and friendly, and keep the joint humming and clean. 

I stopped in after court in Mt. Holly, in need of a caffeine jolt to keep me sharp through the rest of a dreary Thursday. My grande low fat latte did the trick as I watched the laptops burying their noses in daily labor. 

Wish I liked nitro cold brew, because that was very popular with the peeps there. There must be something to it, but I just don't like the bitterness. 

Regardless, in the land of Dunkin it is nice to have an upgrade available.

Recommend placing order on phone app as expected long queues (although fast moving). The staff has always been nice and 1 of the times I had such a lovely server he explained me in detail difference between different types of shots, ingredients, everything. He was super nice and patient. P.S. there was no long queue that day so could buy that extra time knowing more about the coffees.
Some of my favs are - Chai Latte, White Chocolate Mocha, Creme Brulee (Seasonal) Frappuccino and Tomato Mozzarella Panini

Always can enjoy a cup of Starbucks. While out of town, we decided to stop by and grab a cup of coffee. At this moment, the store is not busy at all. Just a few of people chatting and sipping some coffee. Store is not very clean and the bathroom is very dirty! 

I had ordered us the drinks and they didn't except the rewards from the app of Starbucks. Just a little bit of FYI. 

Over all it was okay. Future I will only get coffee and head back out.
