This is a cute Starbucks tucked away within the Willow Grove Mall. There is plenty of seating, and it's right next to Auntie Anne's! The service was excellent, and everything was clean.

This is a great Starbucks and the one that I stop at almost threw mornings a week.  There's no drive through but it's so easy to get in and out that it doesn't matter.  

My favorite coffee to get is a simple task blonde. It tastes a tiny bit chocolaty and I like how is smoother than most of their other coffees.

My favorite breakfast food there is the bacon sandwich with egg and gouda.  I'd amazing.

If your into a good cup of coffee then STARBUCKS is the perfect place for that. And a good breakfast sandwich to go with it. Personally I go to 282 Los Altos Park way. The staff is amazing they will literally go out of their way to help or please you. I highly recommend the Chicken Dubbe smoked Bacon!!!

I know they are new and still trying to figure out their sh** but I've gone there a handful of times and I've tried the drive through and mobile order and no matter what it takes 20 minutes to get a drink. There are a couple girls in there that look like they are overwhelmed and don't know what to do. They have also been out of to-go items a lot. Happy to have a new Starbucks and a drive through though, but it is less than convenient

Has to be one of the worst Starbucks I've been to. Without fail, they are incredibly slow (evidenced by the constant line), mess up orders, and the past 2 times I've gotten a breakfast sandwich it's been cold in the middle. C'mon now, Sbux - get your ish together!!!

The drink was decent and employees were pleasant but I find the Starbucks "policy" bothersome and downright rude to not allow customers to sit indoors. Why open up the inside then? The sole reason I go to Starbucks (when I do go) is to work and grab a coffee, which is what coffee shops are known for. But instead you let people in and out but you tell a pregnant customer she has to sit outside in 95 degree heat "outdoor seating" when there is no one but employees inside. I've been hitting up the Drive through Starbucks off of Turnpike. They are really striving hard to get people through the lines quickly. 
I order my usual 3 drinks for the fam. 
The only complaint was the black coffee had what appeared to be grounds at the bottom of the cup,& tasted burnt. That was according to the family coffee connoisseur!

Horrible! Went at 5:00 to pickup my order after placing it on the app. When I got there I tried to go inside but they had a sign on the door that said they had close at 4pm today. I pull through the drive through to try and get someone's attention because I had already placed my order. When I got to the window I motioned to the girl behind the counter so I could inquire about receiving a refund. She would not talk to me or even come to the window to make an attempt to help me.  She yelled I would have to come back tomorrow. Well guess what, I don't live in this area and won't be here tomorrow. Bad display of customer service.
I wanted a drink that I saw on tik tok and the girl in the shift made fun of me and I ended getting something completely different from what I wanted. Not nice

Your love for coffee and having it meet your dietary needs is best thing I have happening at this moment.  A nice clean coffee shop, a darling space outside to do reading or work.  Nice place to chat with a friend and get a sweet drink. 
Restrooms are clean and the staff is very friendly.

Not all Starbucks are the same and there are plenty that are just plain corporate. I really like the Eagle and Franklin location for the following reasons 

1. It's very personable. It's like Cheers but for coffee. I know Scarlet and several of the other baristas by name 
2. There's outside patio seating as well as seating inside.  The seating inside is portioned out nicely. Sure, there's the community table but there are nooks and two tops designed for solo coffee drinkers 
3. The location. It's easy to get in and out. Some locations feel like you're driving in downtown Tijuana. I just want coffee not a wacky race 

Thanks Eagle and Franklin Starbucks, you're a fan favorite, I just wish more locations were like you.

I was never a Starbucks drinker. But after my first occasion at the king of Prussia stand alone, I have never gone anywhere else. ELENA IS AWESOME! Totally love her and her connection with customers! Matt is so nice! And always greets me with a "hi Vinn" and barb HOOKS IT UP. So nice and such a good atmosphere. I never mind waiting because everytime there it feels like time flies!

My parents were tired of walking so we stopped at this SB while in the hotel checking it out. We got 2 hot coffees at around 8 something PM. Really late for the caffiene though. I think they close at 9pm. They were not very busy but the tables and seating were all full. Some who bought drinks and others not so much. Just relaxing and people watching. Service was meh and the pricing was much higher as it was in a casino. I didn't care for this location. I just needed a fix...

This Starbucks was pretty good...a bit chilly in the front area, but it's nice that they have an extension cord so you can plug in even when there aren't outlets in the walls. A nice seating area in the back, which was super crowded when we went around 1pm. Nice employees, no line, and outdoor seating!

The 4 stars is for the nice gentleman that tried to help me log onto Starbuck's wifi.  Sadly, my chrome book did not want to comply, but a server there today spent the time helping me connect and I appreciate that.

This place is packed with nonstop people lining up all throughout the afternoon!  Who would have though this hidden gem tucked away near Applebee's would get so much foot traffic!

Clean, organized and consistent with the Starbuck's brand.

This location is excellent. I will forewarn you it can be busy at times (the lines for the drive through can get long) but the workers are quick and somehow even friendly while working so hard. I live off Page in Overland and all the fast food type places up there have TERRIBLE service so it's nice coming to a place like this that is the total opposite. There was even one time a while ago when I realized I forgot my wallet while in the drive through and they gave me my drink for free. Because of that action I have gone out of my way to come back to this location many times just to even it back out. 5/5.

I think if you ban her for good, your business will dramatically improve.
Absolutely the worst. Every time I do a mobile order it is never ready and it is always wrong. I will go out of my way to go to a different one from now on.

This Starbucks is not only poorly run, it is dangerous to be in. The sign in the store reads they support social distancing and want only 6 persons in the store at a time.

They also got 3 orders completely wrong just in the time in I was there. 

They need a total clean out of management here.

Love this Starbucks. I go thru the drive thru. Most of the time there is a long car line. The line does move quickly. I always order the Caramel Frappuccino. I am always happy with my order and with the service provided.  I will continue  to go to this Starbucks location.

Came here to get my free birthday drink (a hot Venti caramel macchiato). The staff were all friendly & they all wished me a 'happy birthday' which was nice of them to do. My drink came out good, nothing to complain about. The interior was very nice looking. There's couches there that were very comfy - I definitely could've stayed there for a while.

I pass this Starbucks everyday on my way to drop my daughter at school, and while it's super convenient for me, I generally do not stop there due to the time it takes. The staff has always been friendly, but it's such a busy place sometimes it would take 15-20 mins to get through the drive thru line. Well today, I desperately needed a coffee after the long weekend and thought I'd give it another try. And boy I am glad I did! They had a team member out at the front of the line taking orders, who was so pleasant and professional! She asked for my order and my name, told me the total and asked me to pull around. IT WAS THE QUICKEST VISIT EVER! I pulled to the window and my order was ready! It was such a nice way to start my morning, and I'm so happy that I can incorporate this store into my daily routine more often now that they have an expedited ordering system! Great job and thank you!

If I could give an negative I would. Super long wait time in drive thru. Only to have my simple drink order made wrong 3 times. And the barista called me rude. Tossed my drink and a straw. And slammed the window. Not the only coffee shop in town. Dutch Bros here I come. Never going back to this location.

This Starbucks (Wingfield location) has the nicest crew!!!!  I am a coffee snob, but I also appreciate nice people.  You want to start your day off right, go out of your way to come to this Starbucks.  They're dog-friendly (outside patio only).  

I am updating this review as all employees are new to me.  However, they're still so very nice. 

Good place to stop for any kind of break, breakfast, lunch, dinner, etc.
This is my favorite Starbucks in Reno! Great staff. Very friendly. Just an overall great business!

Closed 20+ min early. Really inconvenient. I guess people aren't struggling for work in this era given that the employees locked up early. What's the point of posting closing hours when you don't abide by them? I would like to report this to Starbucks. Probably not the best way to run a business.

Dark & dirty.

Disorganized, bored, and slow staff. They started by assuming I would pay with credit, then had to void the purchase and redo the transaction for cash. I'm gonna be PISSED if I get ill on vacation because of her.

This is a great Starbucks location!  The baristas are nice and seem to care about what they do.  The line moves fast and our orders have been correct the 5+ times we have been there.  If I'm at the Tampa Premium Outlets, I will definitely stop in.

Slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. Customers were getting frustrated waiting. They were not filling orders in order. My drink tasted fine which is why I've given them 2 Stars. The person who appeared to be a manager seemed more concern about mug inventory than the group of people who had been waiting forever. They were not even that busy. It should not take over ten minutes per a person with a staff of about 7.
I always have a good experience here, all the workers are very friendly and care about the customers. Sasha, who works afternoons was very nice also.
U cannot even enter the mall until 10 am! I guess they open for local in mall store staff to use between 9-10 am!

This is probably my least go-to Starbucks. I was trying to complete the Bingo boards of visiting five different participating locations. The location is pretty good, it is right off of Horizon Blvd with parking lot. You can either park and eat-in or you can choose their Drive Thru.

The moment me and hubby walked in, the vibe is just off. As if "we don't  belong":( Idk if is just bc I'm too sensitive that day or ........ The male barista is just not very nice. I won't be returning unless I MUST.

Came by this morning on May 14 around 5:30 AM, and the doors are all locked the gal looks at me and tells me drive-through only. I told her I only have a big box truck and can't make it through the drive-through. She took my order which I ordered a coffee and a Danish and she brought it to the front door for me since I could not go through the drive-through. Great customer service at a time where things are hard for everyone
The cashier was in no hurry and chided customers "don't come to Starbucks if you don't have patience". I would have left if I hadn't already waited over 10 minutes just for a regular coffee.

Had a slightly less than sterile experience when I was there, but I believe it was because the place had been bum rushed by hundreds before I got there so I'm not expecting it to always be in the level of uncleanliness.

Other than the furniture being in disarray and a few napkins laying about it was your Joe Generic Starbucks.  The entire time I was there the people behind the counter were hustling, so they never got out to see, so my guess is it's generally a nice and clean place... it was not dirty, just disheveled.

Nothing wrong with it... coffee was ok and food was ok and price was too high and it's Starbucks.

Quick moment to say thank you to the Starbucks partners at Bay Pines! This location is more reliable for friendly service than any other Starbucks I have ever been to...like seriously. 


This was my favorite Starbucks to "work from" back in dinosaur days, when that was a thing. It's spacious and has a high top which is perfect if you are a stand-up worker like me! 

I am grateful that they are up and running full time again through drive thru. If you have tried going here lately you'll notice they have been closed intermittently. I recommend checking the app to see if they are serving. They also have added a banner out front which has been greatly helpful!

One of the best Starbucks experiences that I have had! I had a free drink gifted to me that I needed to use and decided to stop in to claim it.

I wish I caught the guys name because he was so incredibly fantastic at his job!! I ended up getting an iced Caramel Macchiato (my go to) and it was delish as always!

Got a vanilla iced latte with oat milk, a chai tea late, and a caramel brûlée latte. They gave me an extremely small cup for the latte and it was still about $4. The cups were also sticky.

The standard assortment of snacks, cakes, sandwiches (I hear they're discontinuing those, if they haven't already), and, of course, LEGAL stimulants (coffee, tea, or espresso, as you like) are available for purchase. If you're addicted to Starbucks and too far from the mall, this one will satisfy.

I like indie coffee places, but sometimes I want a weird frappa-something-I-can't-pronounce. When I want something more than tea or black coffee, I head up here.

This place is clean, the staff are nice and friendly, the food is just like any other Starbucks, so you know what you are getting.

They sold me not one, but TWO moldy protein boxes and that's supposed to be a mango dragonfruit drink. "We're out of the dragon fruit but it's just the same stuff." Server said. But if I'm paying for a $5 drink, I want the fruit. And I want my overpriced apples to be edible.
Just waited in drive thru line for 35 minutes for two nitro cold brews. HOW?!?! This is easily the SLOWEST Starbucks I've ever been to. Absolutely insane.

This was the worst experience I've ever had at any business ever. There was only one staff person there. That itself was strange as there were a number of customers waiting around. Before Covid-19 - My partner goes there every morning as soon as he wakes up, he MOBILE orders & picks it up & is home in less than 10-15 mins. It is our Favorite Starbucks. We have lived in the area for 6 plus years so we do know almost everyone & how things are run. That is a Plus & they take the time to hand write a little note on our cupsIn the summer on very hot days I switch to Cold Mocha Frappes with 3 layers of whipped cream. It taste so much better than it being just on the top this way you are getting some with each sip. I don't have to Mobile order either they know my drink never changes except when summer comes. But it is faster if you do Mobile Order to beat the wait in the summer. I have read the reviews & can only say to the people who wrote bad reviews this is a location that is super busy because of the Turnpike, 95 and RT.1 traffic all get off at this exit & usually go there. The reason you wait is because they are trying to do a lot of orders at one time. If a bunch of sports kids & adults groups come in the summer before you get there expect to wait even if they have a full staff this is the time Mobile ordering is  great You have to consider they are making a lot of drinks at one time, this is the time that they would be out of half-and-half, cream, anything & they can't stop doing the customers before you even if you want just a small coffee or refill, this is the only time you will see a big mess. The person who rings you up, that is her job just to take orders, she will also help with food, coffee & brewing but she can't just leave to go & refill stuff or clean up. If they're out of anything you can just go to that section 1st before ordering to find out This way you're not stepping back in line to ask it slows things down a lot. The only down part is that they don't have the French Press Coffee that many smaller ones do  I have been hoping for a while that they would put one in there Because the taste of the coffee is so much better. At this point I have nothing more to say other than it's my favorite place.

Hands down one of the best Iced Carmel Macchiato I've gotten from Starbucks in a long time. 
I normally go to a different location, but since that ones always so busy I went to the location on 1st and Wetmore. Safe to say I'll leave for work a few minutes earlier so I can go to this location from now on

This used to be one of the best Starbucks locations around! However, in the past 6 months it has turned into the worst. It's an airport location! The staff seems to not really care about what they're doing. I went to use my Gold Card and they informed me their system was down and they could not accept my card. Clearly there is a reason why I wanted to pay with my starbucks card.

My drink did come out correctly and it came out fast. But seeing that no one was in front of me I would hope it would come out quickly. Their floor space is lacking and I had to maneuver around several employees restocking tables just to get to the counter.

It's worth mentioning that the employees at this Starbucks location are all fantastic. Management has really established a great team of individuals and they all function like a well oiled-machine, getting drinks out quickly while still making customers feel welcome. The drive-thru is often way too long (the only negative)... so I'd recommend going inside and ordering. You'll get your drink faster and the folks inside are great.
2 stars for coffee.. sometimes it's very weak and flaw. 5 stars for customer service. Polite & friendly  baristas.

This Starbucks is slow as Christmas. I've sat in the drive thru for 10+ minutes on numerous occasions and had to just pull out. Another frustrating thing about this place is the hours. Great service, full cup coffee. Justin and Fabl are working amazing! Good location and good coffee

In general, a Starbucks is a Starbucks.

This is the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. I waited in the drive up line for 40 minutes!

My brother and I went here and our coffee was just okay. I had better a different locations. It was almost empty inside but the guy making our coffees was taking a very long time. Then a lady he was friends with came in and he took even longer to make them. He forgot to put the vanilla syrup in one coffee but corrected this. He also almost spilt the second one. We probably won't be returning to this location.

5/5 stars for amazing service -- I used the drive thru twice while in town and both times the person who took my order was extremely friendly and helpful. It's the little things that make an experience memorable/positive, like just asking someone how their day was. This is one of those locations that you can see yourself sitting there for hours on end, studying or reading. I like the glass windows and the ambience. It's got just enough busy-ness from Jasper Ave, while also retaining the quaintness of the residential street behind.

Staff is friendly and food/coffee comes out quickly. It's a Starbucks so you know what to expect. The best part about this location is being able to people watch! They have a steady stream of people coming in and out throughout the day. 

I should come to this location more often... it is lovely.

Thank you GSR for having a Starbucks! Yeah!

Plenty of seating and located right off of the casino floor

Slowly but surely I'm going back into a normal routine. And part of that normal routine sometimes involves a drive thru for coffee instead of a scale, grinder, and French press.

This Starbucks could use some work. I think I must go every time they happen to be training new staff at the register, but the cashier staff is rough and leads to incorrect orders. 

For example, today's order:
- Plain bagel toasted with cream cheese: Got the plain bagel. It wasn't toasted, they forgot to include the cream cheese. I took the bagel home and toasted it. 
- Grande Iced Coffee: Well when I checked my receipt, she gave me a venti and charged me accordingly. My stomach isn't big enough to fit all that liquid.
- Mint Majesty Hot Tea: I think this was the real stumper for the cashier. She kept asking if I meant "iced tea" with a mint add on (?). After a while, the manager finally showed the cashier how to enter hot tea.

Mistakes happen, but these issues occurred several days in a row. 

Also, I know it's a tourist hot spot, but there were a few homeless people hanging out which is less than ideal. 

Overall, same Starbucks branded establishment but a little rough around the edges.

Slowest Starbucks in Tucson! Drive thru usually takes 20 minutes to get your drink and if you think it will be faster if you go inside you will sadly see how wrong you are!
Starbucks company please open another one right next to this one just to keep up with the customers or maybe just hire more competent workers. How is it possible to wait 20 minutes in the drive thru line and another 10 at the window just for one drink?

We ordered two pumkin cream  cold brews and they where really watered-down. After trying to explain to the baristas she said "maybe all the coffee is down in the cup and your just tasting the sweet cream" after I stir it up it still tasted like water and pumkin cream. We informed her about it and she never once offered to switch our drinks or even a refund. So after making us look stupid infront of others customers,We politely left the drinks on the counters and left. We will never go back to this Starbucks.
Always great service, have came to this Starbucks plenty of times. Overall just a great local Starbucks.

So slow!  They only had one person working the register and one making drinks. At any given time there were at least 20 people in line. Not only were they super slow, they gave terrible customer service. The staff at this location really need to be retrained.

Slow slow slow, never enough people working, brewed coffee never ready in the am.  They really need to get it fixed here.  
The location is great but corporate needs to get on the manager
15-20 people in line and I waited 25 minutes to order. Slowest coffee shop I've ever been to.

Their management of the drive-through line is incredibly poor. I've never seen anything like it at another Starbucks. Not only do they take a lot of time between making the orders and taking the orders but also have carried on conversations that last over a minute with people that they know that are driving up to the window as if they have no consideration for the amount of cars that are still in line. They really need to address this before it becomes a bigger problem for Their establishment.

Ok so I am a diehard Starbucks fan. I was way excited when they opened this one because it's super close to me and now i don't have to go inside target to get one of my fav morning pleasures. That said, I am really sad to say this Starbucks has consistently fallen a short of the excellence Starbucks is known for. There are usually extra long wait times (regardless what time you come in), the last 4 of 5 times I've come here they got my order wrong or just given me someone else's order accidentally. I've ordered via the app, walk in and drive thru but it doesn't matter - they are consistently inaccurate. Literally every time I've come inside, they were out of raw sugar at the bar, so I have to go to the counter and ask for it. I hope they turn it around because the way it's going now, I prob won't keep coming back much longer. I am not one to complain and I don't put in difficult orders - but there comes a point when even the most faithful customer will get tired and walk away. I'm almost to this point and it sucks.

PLEASE GET IT TOGETHER Starbucks. Please.

I will literally drive way out of my way for this Starbucks. Most Starbucks I go to are very inconsistent and the Frappuccinos are very thin/ melted/ etc. THIS place is ALWAYS on point. I have never had a bad drink come out of that building. I always order to go because this is on my route to work and it is ALWAYS ready for me. The staff is always super friendly and kind. I absolutely love love love this Starbucks. The staff and drinks are high quality. It's always clean. Love it. I go to every Starbucks in the area and honestly none of them hold a candle to this one. **Starbucks, please recognize these employees for the great employees and humans that they are!!!**

I just had the most terriblest time at this Starbucks. This store is in fact open and the young girl Morgan was awfully rude. She was mean from the start & talked about me while in front of me. I never had an experience like this at a Starbucks before. If I could rate this zero star I would.

I was greeted with a warm welcome. It has been at least 10 years since I last visited a Starbucks. Excellent customer service, friendly, and super helpful with helping me to signup for the rewards and selecting a beverage. I see why people come here for these delightful designer beverages hot and cold. The strawberry Açaí with lemonade venti is so delicious. It was sweet but not too sweet. There were slices of strawberry that were suspended between ice cubes. So cute! I will be back.

No where to park around 10am. If you park in the lot across from their drive through. You will be towed by A1 towing. I watched 4 cars get towed in less than 3 min after driver got out of vehicle. That's a bad partnership with the neighbor and their lot is not very well marked. 
So they must have a scout watching the lot. What a shame. Some lady was crying as the tow truck driver took her car away. The coffee and service was average at best. Luckily I waited for a parking spot to open in Starbucks lot. Watching this made me not want to come back to this location.

Standard Starbucks shop but perfect for studying when it's not crazy busy. It does get noisy at times so make sure you bring ear plugs if you need quiet or just listen to music to tune it out. The environment is nice and open so you won't feel cramped (like I've felt at other Starbucks shops) which is definitely a big plus. Outlet wise, there are a few if you position yourself at the bar or at the larger table.

Fast, friendly, courteous service. My drinks are always prepared exactly how I request it to be made. This location is always busy , but there is always room to sit since a lot of the traffic are to go orders.

What a pleasure as Emily was at the drive through and as she handed me my drink I drove away smiling because of her Great Personality!!! Look forward in seeing her again at Starbucks on Los Altos in Sparks!!!

This Starbucks has very nice customer service.  The Manager, Miguel, is a 5-Star manager. He's always in a great, mellow mood. They are very busy place. However, that tells me it's because their Good! They have plenty of tables inside and out. My husband and I go there almost everyday so I can start my day off right, with a smile!
Omg I love this location friendly staff, fast service, cleannnnn. Beautiful drinks are made here. Time and effort put into each one.

Ordered via Mobile ordering. Drinks were made correctly and ready when we arrived. That's the way it should work. This is one of the better Starbucks in the Philadelphia area. Friendly knowledgable staff that always goes above and beyond to make sure you have a good in store experience.

I've been to this location about a dozen times. My husband and I enjoy going in on a rainy day and reading for a bit. The inside it pretty big and they have outdoor seating but it's usually pretty crowded. Unfortunately the last 2/3 visits have been negative. We stopped on a Sunday morning before church and went in because the drive-thru line was super long. I ordered the same thing for both myself and my husband. It took 15 minutes for our drinks to come out. Not kidding. I requested the drinks have sugar-free syrup because of dietary restrictions. We rushed out once the drinks were made and didn't try them until we got to our car and were out of the parking lot. One of the drinks was SF and the other wasn't. We had to throw the one with regular syrup away and couldn't go back because our drinks took so long. The woman who made them was clearly flustered because they were super busy but she made them back-to-back. That mistake shouldn't have been made. 
Fast forward to this morning at 6:50 am. No one was in the drive-thru. I ordered my drink (the same one that was messed up previously) and gave the woman my money. A man made my drink and set it on the counter and then went to the back, I think. The woman also disappeared. Literally. FOUR MINUTES PASSED and my drink was sitting there. She came back to take someone else's order in the drive-thru and then proceeded to get a cup and start making their drink. I kindly said "excuse me, I have somewhere I need to be. Can you please give me my drink?" She didn't say anything and just handed it to be. I was in shock. I'm not kidding when I say it was four whole minutes. If I could've reached in the window and grabbed the drink myself I would have. 
I tell this long story because both of these poor visits involved the same woman. A little bit older with short blonde hair. She can be very nice but tends to be a little out of it at times. I hate to call someone specific out but in both accounts she was the one to blame. I still plan on visiting this location but hope that this particular employee gets the hang of her job.

Starbucks is ignoring the current plastic and waste issues that are all over the news. They have a double cup policy?  So when you order a coffee or tea you get two cups. I asked why and even the server agrees that this silly policy is ruining our environment but she has her orders. Normally I bring my own cup so I never noticed until today. This is very wrong

I stopped in here to get a Macchiato and to have a little time to myself to read. It was pretty busy inside and a new person was still in training. After waiting a few minutes and everyone behind me already gone another young woman noticed me  waiting so she checked on the person making my drink, since  he seemed to be having a little trouble  she happily took the macchiato he was trying to make and dumped it and started over again showing him how it was done. I'm so happy she did start over again to make sure my drink was just as I  had ordered and expected it to be. ( to keep it vegan you just hold the caramel drizzle and use soy milk)

This place forgets so much... I don't know if they are hungover students or just don't care... one day I can get my drink and have to wait for food and another the opposite. There isn't any consistency in this Starbucks. Jake is one of the rudest baristas I have ever encountered. I asked to see if my food was ready as I was waiting because I'm en route to work and don't have time for inefficiencies, which is why you pay a premium for world class service. Unfortunately, this store misses the mark and that the only consistent thing they do. If Jake could have he would have thrown my bagel at me as I was in the lobby waiting with my drink and he said here is your bagel and tossed it on the counter. Definitely not the level of service I'm used to. I will choose circle K coffee before returning to this store as Jake does not represent your brand well and this store is not operationally sound.

Back for the bogo special.  It is still only for take out only.  All tables and chairs are blocked or removed (including the outdoor seating).  The instructions are cleared for the CDC guidelines and also all workers wear mask.

Nice starbucks!

Pretty bright inside environment. Clean restroom. Lots of tables lots of seats, lots of power plug sockets.

Friendly staff. Even during closing time they let us stay. Staff was nice and explained different drink options.

Drinks tasted good. As expected. Same as most starbucks locations.

Overall a great coffee place!

Yes I drink was awesome today! Great staff and I am truly grateful for them.They can occasionally have some long lines just like any other Starbucks, But they are great at moving that line along and being friendly while doing so.

I stopped in here while I had an hour to burn.   The cappuccino was pretty good and service was noticeably faster than the service at other local Starbucks.   There were many people working here, snuggled up with their laptops or phones facilitating employees or scheduling meetings.   Not a particularly relaxing venue.   Table area is long and narrow so it's hard to escape the conversations.

In the last 7 days I have been there twice. They forgot my 2 for 1 that I had to go the next day for a refund of drink. I come in from Oxnard to work thank goodness I worked the next day.  I do Starbucks at least 4 days a seek. Today I go in and my  order had more milk then anything it was supposed to be a caramel macchiato I could see the caramel strip on the side that's one side and about a half inch of color on top.. I thought the first time a simple mistake, but a second time. No Thank you.

The drinks are inexperienced and taste awfully.  They should be improve more how to make coffee rights.  I drinks Starbucks a lot and this location I have tried 3 times and never got the right tastes as I expected from difference Starbucks places.
this is my favorite local starbucks! always get my drinks right, handle long lines efficiently, and great customer service! shoutout to alyssa, she's always been very nice and helpful. :)

This Starbucks always does a great job with my orders.  I send mobile orders in all the time and the staff are very prompt in making my drink.  The staff is always very friendly when I come in.  They all know my order by heart now I'm sure! 

Ps, can't recommend the mobile app highly enough, especially during COVID. I'm
For what ever reason the management here doesn't not give you the option to tip the hard working people here when using you're card. You can only tip in cash and most people don't carry cash anymore
Great place. They have very clean bathrooms and trust me I've seen quite a lot of bathrooms in my day!

We came through drive thru today! The customer service at this store is AMAZING! I forgot to ask their names before I left but the lady who took my order and the lady who rang me up were the most friendly and accommodating people! Thank you so much for this! Made my day

Ngl i have lots of problems with this location and still go here for the convenience. Three times in a row my drinks were watered down and not as joyful to drink. Once got caramel on a white mocha and couldn't even stomach it. That combo is gross. Maybe a handful of times my drinks made to order and i order the white chocolate mocha every single time

You never know if they'll be open or closed. Business hours change too of. Can't rely on the hours published on the web.
Ridiculous.

They make drinks adequately enough, and some of the employees are super friendly and know me on a first name basis, because I come sometimes 2 times in a day. I will not be returning to this location. I understand they may have needed to adjust their hours due to Covid-19, however, I found it incredibly frustrating that they refused service 1 minute before closing, with hours that are already earlier than their listed hours.

NOT OPEN until 7pm!

Quick mobile order pick up!  Staff was very friendly inside, especially friendly for a busy Saturday morning. Was bummed they were out of peppermint but still other holiday drink flavors. Good sized parking lot and management of crowds.  Clean inside and happy puppy! Great location!

Some people get coffee every day and I am not strong coffee drinker to be honest but Starbucks is the only place I buy coffee when I need some energy. 

I live close by to this Starbucks and the service is always above and beyond, many people probably would say I am exaggerating but the other day for example me and my fiancé ordered two caramel brûlée and did not specify we wanted it cold not hot, when we got to the window the lady gave our hot coffee and we said that we sorry but we thought that it was cold even thought we offered to take the hot coffee because it was our mistake the lady from Starbucks insisted in making us a new coffee the way we wanted it. 

I really really appreciated what they did I mean they did not had to do that because there was a lot of people  waiting in line and to take the time to make us new coffee when it was our mistake in order it's just demonstrate the amazing service they have.

I just wanted to say thank you so much Starbucks for making my experience amazing!

I was staying at the Marriott on the other side of the expressway so I swung in here a few times to grab breakfast on my way into work.
The place opens up at 5 am even though it looks dark and nobody is there, its open. Nobody was in line when I came through both mornings so I made my order and got it in mere minutes. 
My impossible breakfast sandwich was delicious and my iced chai tea latte was killer both times.
I will definitely return next time I'm in town for work.

5/5

after being rebuilt with the drive-thru option this place cannot handle its business. I've gone through the drive-thru at 7:30am, 8:30am, and 3:30pm and each time I've had to wait over 10 minutes. I've even had to wait when I physically walk into the store. there is absolutely NO sense of urgency, even during the busy morning rush-hours. after deliberately leaving my house 10 minutes early, I was still 10 minutes late for work this morning, and thus, that will be my last visit to this location.

Great Starbucks visit. Made my Frappuccino perfectly perfect and my barista was friendly and cheery. 
My order was ready when I arrived at he window. 
A five star visit today.

Okay the LADIES at this Starbucks are 100% doing the most at all times. Especially appreciate this as I wasn't having the best day when I came in for a coffee.
Props to the employees for being as positive as they are in this busy ass location.
Always so fast, friendly, and delicious! I love the shaken espresso with oat milk and brown sugar. The baristas are so sweet, and the space is nice to study or read in.

The reason for two stars for this location is the horrible parking and ingress/egress design; it is easily the worst Starbucks I have encountered from that standpoint.  The primary entrance is a single entry/exit on Central Ave but with a pointless and stupid triangle curb built in the middle as an effort to force people to only enter when heading westbound, and only exit via a right turn west bound.  Of course, this being Florida, no one listens to any traffic rule, so judging by the deep gashes in the curbing, many people turn in when heading eastbound anyway, don't see the curb and then run over it.  Additionally, I routinely see people leave with a left turn even though the curb is supposed to prevent that, along with the sign that says right turn only.

Anyway, that's not the worst part of this location, it's once you get in the lot where things get really bad.  Since the location is small and only has one primary entrance/exit, the drive-thru backup often snakes through the lot and out to Central.  This means anyone who tries to park in a space, has to wait in the same line to get to a space, and if you're in a space trying to leave, good luck, you could be there five minutes or longer while the morons in the drive-thru line keep inching and inching so as not to lose their space, rather than letting you out.  

Complicating matters further, there's an entrance from the alley behind the place where people in the know try to sneak in from.  This results in two queues of cars trying to get into the same drive-thru, and people fighting with one another via their cars if they didn't think the other car was waiting as long as them, and thus not entitled to enter the line in front of them.

Finally, if you are there during busy time, leaving the parking lot after successfully navigating the drive-thru can be just as difficult because the turn to get out without smashing into the curbing can be quite difficult if there's a line of cars blocking half the space you'd normally use to make the turn.

I stop in before work sometimes twice in one day or with my wife music is actually pretty good Spotify it varies on what drink I get I've had a couple different breakfast sandwiches one I didn't like to well other one I did and will get again the staff are friendly since my wife is in there all the time they know her order I've only used restroom once it was clean if you have kids the cake pops are good too.
Every week I go to this location and it's sad because they never and I mean never have any raspberry syrup just pitiful

Floors are filthy, and it looks like they haven't been cleaned in a week or so. The trash bins both inside and out are overflowing with trash. 

I've really been disappointed in this Starbucks lately. I went inside, and the floor and counters are filthy. The counter is dirty, and this is where they set your food and drinks. 

Don't even try to use the restroom because that too is gross. 

The staff has been okay lately. Maybe they are understaffed? Idk but the friendly, happy chipperness is gone. 
Every time I order. Lately, they are out of something. Sometimes 3 or 4 items. It's crazy.
A very handy place for a starbucks.   Good coffee, always friendly staff.  Often has a line.

BLACK MOLD WARNING! DO NOT DRINK OR EAT HERE! I work in the airport. It has been confirmed by multiple workers that have been employed and hospitalized at this location that it has black mold everywhere due to improper cleaning. Stay far away from this Starbucks. They close every couple of months for "cleaning" but it never gets cleaned.
This location is frequently out of ingredients and very slow. We order ahead via the app and this location almost never meets the have-ready time listed at order confirmation.

Early morning at the airport.  Ordered a breve white chocolate mocha.  The cashier didn't know what it was.  The cashier was complaining that she was tired and if someone could complete a void for her. I repeated my order three times.  Finally the person making the drinks gets my order. The cashier still hasn't rang me up.  She doesn't know how to ring up the order.  I repeat my order to her again and the person making the drinks says "I heard you the last time".  I pay for my drink and move over to the other side to wait.  Now the person making the drink is arguing with another employee.  He walks away and is telling the manager about this argument.  

The worst customer service ever at a Starbucks!!!  I asked for a refund!!  

They should put the customers first.  Keep employee conversation to a minimum.  The manager should have had them take care of customers and then settled their disagreement.

While I'd typically choose any independent coffee shop over a Starbucks, the international giant certainly has its place. Like when I'm on a major highway, in an airport or in Jersey. For whatever reason, the area I grew up in is seriously lacking in decent coffee shops. After dropping my mom off at work, I had to put my thinking cap on to come up with a suitable destination for coffee, and the Moorestown Starbucks was the only place within five miles that came to mind. 

This particular location is housed in a gorgeous building with a small patio out front. The inside is always very clean and feels more comfortable to me than most other Starbucks locations. Probably because I spent a lot of time there, catching up with friends during breaks from college. 

The milk and sugar bar is always well stocked, and unlike many of the other Starbucks locations, the flavored powders are always available. Even the vanilla one, my favorite of the four.

You can take the guy out of Seattle, but you can't take Seattle out of this guy, so forgive me for violating my "no chains" rule.  Yes, I prefer the local coffee shops, but just need a Starbucks fix from time to time.  This store has no drive-thru, which is the way they should all be, in my opinion.  

I visited this store a year or so ago, and recall being less than impressed with the customer service.  My next few attempts were met with "closed early due to Covid" signs on the door, so I ordered on the app today with minimal expectations.  I'm happy to report, that in-spite of the ongoing pandemic, my visit was much more pleasant than expected.  The store was very clean.  I was greeted by a friendly barista who assured me that my drink order was being prepared.  

A couple minutes later, my drinks were ready.  They were both hot and tasty.  Can't wait for things to return to normal, so I can go back and relax with a familiar coffee in one of their comfy chairs.

I'm only giving it two stars for the convenience that it's in Target. But other than that, just go to the other Starbucks further down Manhattan. The baristas here always have an attitude and never make my drinks right. My orders are usually simple and they still seems to mess it up.

I've grown increasingly frustrated with this Starbucks. I now go out of my way (driving ten minutes to another location instead of only 5 mins from my home to this location. They VERY rarely get my drink order right ( it will be very clear on the order sticker as to what it is) and I am more often than not requesting a remake. I am a daily Starbucks consumer and every time I have decided to give this location another chance, they have messed it up.
I have ordered thru my app a couple of times and driven to pick up my order and they start it after they see me waiting at work the pick up counter....

I am not a big fan of this location. The hours of operation are misleading. The ones posted on the door and online say that they close at 10:30pm, when it should be 9:30pm. The WiFi is here is also terrible. Couldn't do any work at all.

To top it all off, there was hardly anybody inside the store or at the drive through, and the men's bathroom looked like it hadn't been cleaned all day. There was TP strewn all about, and the floor was extremely dirty. 

On the bright side, the baristas were nice and provided great customer service. I probably won't be back, unless it is convenient to go.

It is ironic that this place has the nonprofit organization "stop bullying" outside their doors considering they only cater to customers with vehicles, and turn away customers who only have cash. Seems a lot like discrimination and bullying to me. I will never be spending my money at this place again, not because I don't enjoy their overpriced coffee, but because THEY WONT LET ME SPEND MONEY THERE. The dumbass on the phone told me to "order on uber eats".... as I'm standing outside their door.

The. Absolute. slowest. Starbucks. drive. thru. of. all. time. 


I waited 10 minutes at the window for a black coffee and a heated up croissant. The person in front of me was at the window for 10 minutes as well. All in all, it took 20 minutes to get coffee and a pastry. Now, I am not sure if the microwave was backed up with other people's pastries ahead of me, or what. But the cashier never even apologized for the wait. He just handed me the coffee, and the pastry. He was not even friendly when placing the order. Neither was the other girl. The staff just seem miserable here unlike any other Starbucks I have been to. I don't know what they are doing wrong here but miserable staff is always a red flag that something isn't going right on a store level here. 

I definitely won't be back to this one.

I know, it's Starbucks. This really is the best one. Everyone is super nice and thoughtful. Even when they are super slammed and people are crabby, they still smile. They love making reccomendations and are enthusiastic for the job. Parking can be challenging and it gets super crowded. It's a great spot to sip your tasty beverage and people watch
Drive thru was not as fast as other locations. Ordered 2 Turkey bacon breakfast sandwich and they only had 1. Not ha OP py with this experience.
This location has greatly improved over the past few months. They always make my order right and the line moves much faster. I appreciate management taking action and improving the service.

I'm truly disappointed that my order of something basic as a cappuccino with caramel sauce could become an error. I order venti hot chocolate, hazelnut coffee and mines. It was made with syrup when I specifically asked for sauce because I deplore the syrup. He said he thought I said syrup. Whatever I took the two drinks to the car. I can back and another man handed me my drink and he gave me the same cappuccino. I'd assume the person who made the mistake would fix it but he didn't he was ON to the next customer which isn't very customer friendly. 

When he remade my cappuccino I left. I was on the fwy and I tasted it a second time because all I tasted was foam at the store. It was horrible. When I arrived to work in Chester I had to go to WaWa to get a coffee. I spend nearly $15 and I bought those other drinks for my colleagues. I guess it's true no good deed goes unpunished. 

Thanks for a horribly expensive, latte tasting, no caramel flavored cappuccino.

Staff is quick to handle the long lines.  One guy was so quick in asking for tips that he screwed up my peach tea lemonade order by just giving me peach lemonade.  I asked the girl who gave me the drink if that was peach tea lemonade and she said yes despite the fact that I could see that the tea was missing and it was not labeled as peach tea lemonade.  Had to ask someone more knowledgeable if that was peach tea lemonade and he said you wanted peach green tea lemonade to which he ended up making the correct drink.

Be prepared to be underwhelmed and even slightly dissatisfied.  

I am without a doubt a very loyal Starbucks customer and have been for years. To the point that I definitely have my local to me locations but I stop by on a daily basis. This does not make me an expert, but it does make me a consistent consumer who is knowledgeable about Starbucks products and services. 

This location is located inside of the GSR hotel in Reno, and is frequented by predominantly hotel guests and staff. I can't imagine someone stopping by the hotel just to go to this specific Starbucks.  

The seating area is ridiculous. While it is open seating, it's located near the check in/out counters, as well as, gambling sections. It's just not a great spot/location overall.  

The service is close to horrendous, and the staff is just the same. 

I ordered two different drinks, both fairly easy to make, and I was the second person in line, with no one else behind me. My drinks took close to 25 minutes to be made. Yes, you read that correctly, 25 minutes for two drinks and no one else was waiting.

Once the drinks were ready, despite the fact that I was standing fairly close to the counter waiting, the barista put them on the counter and walked away. Did not call out my name, let me know that the drinks were mine versus maybe a mobile order, etc. then to top it off, both drinks were made incorrectly. Unfortunately, I did not discover this until I had already left the counter and was on my way outside of the hotel. No one wants to trek back into a hotel that is currently under construction, and frankly has become a hot mess to get in and out of. And let's face it, who wants to deal with unpleasant people when they are handling our food and or beverages?!  

Would  I stop by this location again? More than likely only under desperation.  My two stars are because if nothing else, the seating area and counters are clean.

There is no better Starbucks than this location.  My wife goes here almost every day and I go here more times than I will admit by checking in!  I said previously that it is my Starbucks of choice just because of the friendliness of the staff and the service provided by all who work here.  

Go in a few times and I guarantee the Barristas will know your name and what you drink (so if you're gonna change it up - tell them fast because they'll often start making your drink when they see you just to get your order out to you more quickly).  

The staff that works here genuinely like one another.  You see them talking to each other when they're off shift which makes for a great level of service and team work when they are on shift and working together.  I've seen some of the people who have worked at this store working in other locations and they still recognize me and know who I am which says a lot about the caliber of people who work here.

There is plenty of seating inside and out (and it's comfortable and well-located too).  It does get busy, but the customers aren't too territorial of their seating locations like they are at other locations that I've been too.  

Whatever your drink of choice, it'll get made correctly here.  If an error is made, it will be corrected with a smile and usually a courtesy drink as well (I've seen this happen even when the error occurred because of a mistake made by the customer ... yes I'm guilty).

Was diverted here after the location on Shadeland decided that even though they are posted to open at 6:00am on Sundays, that means they have the lights off & are still prepping at 6:15...while customers are driving away, including an Indy Metro Police cruiser...that's another review.

I pulled up to the drive they, placed my order & was on my way in less than 5 min. Awesome!

This is my favorite Starbucks. I know most of the Barista's by name.  Eric, Carmen and Amber to name a few. I hope they all get KUDOS as they always have a smile and a kind word on their lips. They are always cheerful and will uplift anyone coming thru the drive thru.

However today was way different. I went through the drive thru like I normally do. The person working the drive thru seemed put out that he had to take my order. I gave him the benefit of the doubt. When I drove up he helped me add my money to my Starbucks app. But when he handed me my Very Berry Refreshers they were wet and sticky. Normally the barista's wipe that off. He seemed annoyed when I asked him for some napkins saying that the cups were wet and sticky.

I don't know if it was because it was late in the day or if he was having a bad day. In either case I thought that he and management should be aware.

It's Starbucks - what do you expect?

The GF and I end up here a fair amount as they stay open late - 11 PM most nights, 12:30 on weekends - so she can study, while I write Yelp reviews, read a bit, catch up on email, knock out a bit of code, etc.  

As with most Starbucks, the tables are small, and more conducive to sitting and chatting with a friend, rather than working on laptops, though there are outlets every 18" or so along the south windows.  The table layout is such that there are two lines - one against the south windows, the other running parallel to it.  If you're sitting at one of the 5 inner tables, you'll need to stretch your cord across if you need an outlet, though it works fine.  Tables are usually about half occupied with people studying and using laptops.

There's a patio space as well, though as we're usually working on our laptops, we rarely sit out there.

Staff is friendly enough - I got my large dark roast free tonight since they had just started another batch of drip and they felt bad about my having to wait a few minutes.

I like my coffee like I like my baristas: tall, dark and one shot of sweetness.

This team of coffee always perky, helpful and beyond friendly! Never a long wait in the drive-thru or inside. When I ask questions about drinks, they give me a pleasant, helpful answers. What more could a coffee girl want?

My tall orders: passion tea with one pump of sweetener (100 cals), vanilla latte with coconut milk (150 cals), regular coffee with half & half and raw sugar (80 cals).
Wife loves this Starbucks because she can grab a coffee and shop till she drops at the outlet stores. Always busy but never had a long wait. Good stuff to be found here !

This Starbucks (Wingfield location) has the nicest crew!!!!  I am a coffee snob, but I also appreciate nice people.  You want to start your day off right, go out of your way to come to this Starbucks.

I've been going to Starbucks for years but this one has become the worst. For the past two and a half months they have messed up my order, various drinks off the menu, 12 times which is atleast a 70$ loss for me. You cannot reach this location by phone and you definitely cannot park in this location legally because of the one way and the drive thru cars that ignore traffic laws just to stay next in line. Poor way to start the day.
Aside from DD, I also go to Starbucks. Do you think I am a coffee junkie? No, I do not always go to the coffee shop daily but when I need to stop I go get a coffee at Starbucks as well.

Not the worst, but they definitely need to work on some things. 

This Starbucks is already located in a Target store, so I feel like it should lose points for that. I don't like having to wade through a sea of middle-aged, oblivious moms in yoga pants who would rather chit chat than let you get your coffee (this actually happened, I'm not stereotyping). 

There was one woman working when I was here and she was being run ragged. She was hustling getting coffee, food and everything else that the MAMs were demanding of her. I seriously think she was thrilled when I just ordered a large iced coffee.

At other stores such a simple order comes out right away, but because there was only one person working, it took a while. Seriously Target, get that girl some help. The coffee was mediocre, as expected, and I only stopped here in the first place because someone gave me a gift card for Christmas because they obviously hate me or something.

Anyway, if you need coffee during your Target trip, then this is the spot. Otherwise, you should probably avoid.
Quick service and the barrista has the right vanilla to blonde roast quotient correct for my taste buds. Thanks Starbucks!!

Drinks are always great....when I get them.

Twice I've done an online order only to arrive 15-20 minutes later and my drink not be ready. 

Buttttt as stated above, when I get my drinks, their top notch and exactly how I like them.

Probably the worst Starbucks experience yet. The barista was too busy talking to her friend to make the orders. They took so long to make a simple small caramel macchiato. There were also almost no stock in for the baked goods. Would not recommend going to this location even if it is closer to you. Very disappointed.

I went to this Starbucks and ordered a salted caramel cold brew. When I received my drink it wasn't what I had ordered and nicely told the barista (Christian) that this order isn't correct and he insisted that this was the right drink and kept arguing with me. I then said this isn't what I normally receive when I ordered this drink and with extreme attitude was told "that's gravity" and that's why it's looks like that. It had gotten to the point that I had to drive away because he was not going to make a new drink and was going to argue his point. 

I truly don't care or mind if the drink is made wrong or exactly what happened in this situation with the drink but the fact that right of the bat it was the most rude exchange and his responses were so vile to the point I felt uncomfortable. I will never be back at this restaurant due to the bullying I had received and if Starbucks cares about costumer services and hiring high quality staff they should definitely reconsider having Christian represent the company's name.

Yes I know it's Starbucks!! I need my coffee and I am not going to drive all over town to get it. 

The employee's here are really kind and thoughtful. Pretty sure there are specific ways to order latte's and the baristas never make me feel silly for not knowing the order of the words. So I like a breve hazelnut or caramel latte. 

Went through the drive in on this day and ordered three drinks. No they weren't all for me. Ordered a Venti caramel latte, a venti coconut milk caramel iced coffee, and a venti white chocolate latte plus three double bacon breakfast sandwiches. The barista double checked to see if there was three and there were so I got them. BAZINGA did that make my day. 

Went to pay and asked to use my charge card to add money to my Starbucks card. She was very kind and sweet and said it wasn't a problem. (People have the right to say no to our requests especially if the drive up is really busy). I told her I appreciated her kindness.

Everything came in a timely manner and our sandwiches were hot.

Unfortunately this is the closest Starbucks by my house. I should probably start making my own drinks at home and save myself the headache. They had a sign in the front that said to try their store favorite drink (it was a sign on the black board with chalk) -- anyways it was a matcha frapp with brown sugar and green whip....so I  decided to order it thinking "Oooo this might be delicious"...yeah, well they didn't even know what I was ordering & didn't know how to make it...I received some over sweetened drink with white whip... and some brown powdery sprinkles on the whip...so I  asked why the whip isn't green and they said they don't do that (so why advertise it?) and then I  asked what the brown stuff was on top of the whip...they said brown sugar garnish.....it was cinnamon  this drink was SO sweet that my teeth literally hurt (and I love sweets)... did I mention this Starbucks made me cry before because I ordered a venti iced tea and they gave me the wrong size/wrong item and when I made a comment about it I  was apparently inconveniencing the barista... this place is not cool.

I am a daily weekday customer of this Starbucks location, so if this review were anything OTHER than five stars you'd better believe I'd be a walking contradiction. 

The success of this particular Starbucks may seem to be due to its centralized South Tampa location, but that is only partially true.  The rest of its success can be attributed to its excellent management and staff. 

The manager Ian and all of his baristas make a solid effort to get to know  you - and not just how to spell your name (an effort that I have come to appreciate given the unique spelling of mine), but they also make a considerable effort to get to know who you are as a person. I would love to report that this is just my experience, but I have personally overheard more than one barista ask various customers, "Hey (insert any name you can think of), the usual?" Sometimes, they're already preparing the drink as the person walks in. This type of familiarity is hardly achievable at most modern-day bars, let alone a "chain" coffee shop! 

On a recent occasion, a newer barista forgot my breakfast sandwich order. Upon realizing her mistake, she offered me a $5 gift card for my wait and trouble (which I graciously accepted...my daily visits make for an expensive habit!) The aforementioned is only one of many examples that support my assertion of a five star experience. 

One last thing - re: the bathroom code; I am honestly shocked that it took Starbucks so long to implement a secured bathroom system. While I lived in NYC, Starbucks was referred to as "the public restroom of the city." This is no joke and it is no surprise - heck, there was one on nearly every corner!  If you are actually a CUSTOMER and not just popping by in a drunken stupor post-Gasparilla or after your generic walk/run on Bayshore, then asking for the code shouldn't be that hard now, should it?

Asked for a Light low calorie beverage and was told they didn't have it... they didn't even offer to make a beverage with half the flavor or attempt making a low calorie beverage for me, so the rest of my family got their coffee while I couldn't enjoy anything.

Beautiful location, sweet employees & quality service! 
We almost didn't go because of the negative reviews and our expectations were beyond exceeded!

I really like this location. It's located on the corner of Washington. The staff is very friendly and there's always plenty of seating. Definitely one of my favorites spots to stop in and drink a cup of coffee with a friend or to get some work done!

Okay well I found like a million of these ball like things in my drink....I'm absolutely disgusted. By the time I discovered it I was already at work and couldn't do anything to get my drink fixed. Just gross!!!

Starbucks is my go to place for coffee, but I was very disappointed when I stopped here this evening. I ordered on the app just a few minutes ahead. Of arriving. I asked about my order five minutes after the app said it would be ready, and the barista asked what my name was. My order was ready in another 5 or 6 minutes (not really sure because she didn't call out my name when it was ready). We ordered d a tall and a grande cappuccino. The barista said she put the grande in a venti cup because they were out of grande cups. That would have been fine except that they filled the rest of the cup with milk so, of course, it was no longer a cappuccino.

The service here is so nice! The male barista was so cheery and happy, it made the short experience much better. The coffee was made great and I would definitely come back this one if I was in the area. Much better than the Target Starbucks.

It's Starbucks. My default rating for fast food chains is 3 stars, and they didn't do anything special to rise above that. They didn't do anything bad enough to lose a star either, though I was seriously tempted to drop one for the lack of drive-thru. There is at least a parking lot though.

I ordered hot cocoa and the reindeer cake pop. Unfortunately, they forgot to add the whip cream. The cake pop was delicious and I even shared it to my sister. I recommend to order the reindeer cake pop so you can try it your self.

I would have given them a four but the gal that made our coffee wasn't the friendliest which was a bummer because we came a couple days later and the guy working the drive thru was very happy and polite. I guess some people just have there off days, I get it.
This Starbucks has a drive thru so it's super convenient! It has great customer service and they make the drinks pretty good. I got the iced peach green tea.
Friendly and fast staff. Location was clean and well maintained. Great service and I recommend this location at the mall

This is located inside a service plaza travelling on the turnpike I76W.     Have stopped here multiple times but always found it to be one of the worst ones. Service is very slow and they take their own time in attending to the customers. I had only two people in front of me and I had to wait 15 minutes for my order of two cups of coffee. The coffee was also not good and was not even hot on top of it. They are even slower when they're busy. Have a bunch of snacks also including nuts, snack bars, Madeline cakes etc. to choose from. Avoid it if you can.

Hours suck. Close early. I get COVID but seriously? Never open, closes at random and out of everything. All other Starbucks are not like this one. Should just go out of business completely. Clearly the employees don't want to work and when they do they obviously don't want to be there anyways. So over Starbucks and it's inconsistent hours

The best Starbucks around!!! Kind, engaging, fast, detailed, and they remember their regulars! 

I travel the Western stats and by far this is the best location ever! They never get an order wrong and the staff are always happy to help!

Usually, I never have any problems coming to this location. However, this morning my husband and I went in for a mobile order I placed through the app. We got there and told them at the intercom that it was a pickup order with my name. We pulled ahead and the lady told us we the total. I thought that when I reloaded my app with money that it didn't go through, so my husband went ahead and gave her his card. Then she hands us a sandwich and we realize it's not our order. We tell the lady and she says she'll have to get her manager to refund us. The manager comes to the window and says we should have told her it was a pickup order. We told the guy at the intercom. So there was no communication on their part. They also didn't repeat the order before taking our card. So I assumed my money just didn't go through to the app. The manager also says that the first lady at the window didn't have a headset on, again trying to excuse their bad communication. Drive through should always have headset, and if not, they should at least have some communication with whoever else is working drive through. They voided my payment. I appreciate getting it fixed but I did not appreciate the attitude and the blame for their bad communication. 

This was at about 6:30 in the morning on a Tuesday.

This Starbucks is just.... a disgrace to all Starbucks. And I LOVE Starbies!! 

Firstly, the layout is weird and it's always dirty in there. 

Secondly, the girl who took our order could not comprehend anything I was saying. I'm usually quite patient with people, but after the 4th time of repeating myself I was quickly losing my patience. Especially since I had somewhere to be. 

Thirdly, the girl who made my drinks made me a hot latte when I asked for an iced one. I noticed she messed up the girl's order, who was in front of me as well. 

Maybe if they weren't so busy talking amongst themselves then they'll be focused on taking correct orders, and not have to do extra work...

Surprisingly enough the drinks I got turned out to taste well. 

There's another Starbucks a few blocks away that's much better than this one. I wouldn't recommend this location at all.
Not my regular Starbucks, but convenient to where I was.  Tried the toasted coconut cold brew for my birthday reward to enjoy on a nice spring day in Reno.  Nice patio seating outside

Yes it's Starbucks, but I seriously need my coffee and FIKA (Swedish term) time!!. 

I always feel like everyone at this Starbucks sounds like a prince or princess from Disneyland. You know that joy that is so genuine and uplifting!! The Disneyland effect of meeting one of the characters there. Disneyland knows how to treat their customers. Well, this is what if feels like to go through the drive thru here.

So to all the fabulous Baristas at this Starbucks thanks you for always making me feel like I'm driving thru Disneyland.

Thanks Amanda for lifting me up today and giving me a great big smile too!! Nicholas is a supervisor at this store! I am hoping that this whole store gets KUDOS out of this!!!

I like this location as it's not on a busy corner like most Starbucks! The space is very small so if there is a lot of orders- there is very little space to stand and wait for your order but I like that I can walk underground from my building to get here.
The staff knows my order and are always very friendly! I would not recommend having a meeting or working from here- there is literally 3 chairs in the window seat! But I'm a nice day you can enjoy your coffee in the large plaza outside and soak up some sun!
I was simply not listened to. I repeated my order twice and the barista failed to fix it both times. This is not the first time. I'm in rage.
This is the third consecutive frapp I've had here that is watery. It's literally cold chai tea with whipped cream on top.

Was my first time at this Starbucks my wife's favorite coffee place since the others are closed she came to this one was nice fast friendly and order was correct then we went to another place that was open now just so you all know lol I prefer coffee bean

Yes there was good amount snow on floor.  But thank goodness this starbucks opens late. Wife had craving and I admit I did too. Other then this being like other starbucks. They have hours that works for me.  Others tend to close to early. This one had better schedule.

Would be negative one star if it were possible. Absolutely horrible service. Been to this location on several occasions and they are dreadfully slow and always behind. Unless you have 45 mins to waste, don't bother.
Friendliest Barista's around!! All employees at this location are phenomenal!! They always go over and above to make their customers happy!!

Welcomed me when I walked in. Parking is limited and right off of a busy street so don't park in convenient spots if you don't want your car to get scratched or bumped. 

Bathroom is clean. Not a lot of seating. It's in a plaza so there is no drive-thru. 

They have a lot of staff and seem to get the job done quick. 

Popular location for plugging up for productivity, so get there quick!

Pretty crazy that we are in a time sheets it's exciting to go out just to go through a Starbucks drive thru but that's reality at the moment.  I was very impressed that they handled the rush very well and were prompt and efficient.  We were able to put our card into the chip reader and did not have to touch any buttons at all or sign anything .  Very cool.

I live in Pinellas county but come to this area quite often for dinner.  I have had nothing but great  service  here!!!  The staff are really nice. 
I popped in literally before closing on a Sunday night not realizing how late it was and the two young ladies working were super sweet! They cheerfully made my drink and gave me a  piece lemon cake!  They made me feel important and I really appreciate them!!! Thanks for making my night ladies! I will be back!!!
I continue to enjoy this location!!  The young man working on Sunday night was spectacular!!  He made the perfect drink!!

This is one hopping location.  Right across from a busy business park, in the morning, you can forget about finding parking or a quick run through drive thru.  The employees inside are hustling and getting orders completed as quick as possible.  They are friendly, polite, and got me moving as fast they could.

I also ordered mobilely and it was ready within minutes.  

Great location.  Order was right.  Food was fresh.  People were amazing.  Best location I've been to in a while.  Employees stay smiling and organized even in the rush hour of morning time hustle.

When my husband and I moved to the area two years ago, we were ecstatic to have a Starbucks with a drive-thru minutes from our house, but in the last six months or so, it's gone completely down hill - and the experience is the same inside and out. 

First of all, there's a wait, 75-80% of the time.  They're just slow.  Unless you do a mobile order- so by all means, do a mobile order, but that does defeat the purpose of the drive-thru.

My lattes are always "light" -- meaning the cup isn't full (not even with foam) and there's a ton of foam in the portion that does have something in it.  And recently I've had 2 lattes that had an awful burnt aftertaste.  Once I even returned to have my drink re-made - I waited a good 20-30 minutes to be acknowledged and I feel like they were agitated about it.  

Another time I received the completely wrong drink through the drive-thru, so we had to turn around and I had to go back in to get it fixed.  

It's really frustrating - the location is nice (the patio is a perk) and the drive-thru is convenient, but if I can't get the correct drink and when I do I'm paying for 2/3 of a cup, what's the point? 

Make the extra effort and go into the location in the Target- same parking lot.  Or the Giant on Henderson Road - their team there is AMAZING.  All I can say is this Starbucks needs to get back on their game.
While I am not a coffee drinker, my wife loves the place. She also buys 2 bags of coffee and has them grind and blend them together.

I was cued to revise my review of sbux due to reading a past review I had written of it. I posted that their pastries etc were superior to the competition down the street. Well, the competition down the street must have changed their vendor because now they are on an equal playing field when referring to food selection. However, I still find the customer service second rate to the "competition." the only reason I utilize this sbux is because I don't feel like walking my venti American ass a little bit further to the competition. I'm a lazy bitch some days.

This is a large, clean, well-run starbuck on the corner of Marsh & Silverside roads in Wilmington.  We usually stop by in the morning - and even at the height of the AM rush, the lines move quickly.

Fourbucks, Charbucks, whatever yoiu call it - it's nice tohave one around when you need it.

Especially in the Culinary wasteland of North Wilmington.
(3) ok....surprisingly they were out of EVERY Breakfast sandwich at 9:30 AM???  I'll try them again later, just to make sure this wasn't a fluke;)lol

While I do try to buy local as much as possible, there's a lot to be said for Starbucks' consistency. CC's has better drip coffee that I buy in bulk, but the espresso drinks at Starbucks never disappoint. 

I love the staff at the Maple location! They're great about remembering regulars. My only issue with this location is all the undergrads here during the school year. But if you do want to be surrounded by stupid hats and girls in belly shirts having "like, totez deep convos," Maple is the place to go.
Love this starbucks. Everyone is usually always nice and polite... Thumbs up from a true coffee drinker :)
Just got a coffee made so poorly I had to throw it out. That's $5 completely wasted. Save your money and don't go to this one.

Ordered a Venti chai tea latte cold no ice. They made a reg chai latte up to the third line on the venti (leaving a third empty). Then the barista proceeds to pour MILK into the rest turning the drink white and explains that MILK is the substitute for no ice. What? Shouldn't CHAI, the drink I ordered be the substitute?  I didn't pay $5 for milk. If I wanted milk, I would have asked for Venti milk. Never coming back. Asked for my drink to be remade and she took a little off the top and added chai. Worse drink ever. Will now just patronize other coffee shops.

I don't know how the barrista's are supposed to be trained, but the one I had this morning clearly needs more training. I know this isn't Europe, where they actually know how to serve a pastry, but the service was ridiculous. I walked in, put my computer and book bag down, and went to order my food. I ordered a chocolate croissant and bought a bottle of water. The girl just threw it in a paper bag and stuck a label on it. Is that how Starbucks is training their people? Pastries of any kind are supposed to be served warm and on a plate. I know, very difficult. We Americans and our high standards. Such snobs we are, expecting a pastry to be warmed up and put on a plate as opposed to being thrown in a bag. Making coffee and pastries is so hard these days!
