If I wanted a hard piece of chocolate, frozen between the layers of a piece of bread, I could do that at home. Even at home I'd at least get a plate
Bad service. 15 min wait mid day for a Mocha. A hassled barrister. Sweating. With attidude. Maybe just a bad day.

Ok, not a whole lot to say about Starbucks other than it's Starbucks. I go here about three times a week for coffee and I do that because it's consistent.

No, I don't order the mocha skinny latte with a shot of anything. I order Pikes Peak because that's all I want. Coffee. And because I only order coffee I find that their price is consistent with other coffee shops.

If you do go to Starbucks on a regular basis I would highly recommend doing the star points system. After 12 stars (1 star for each purchase) you can choose a free anything. Sandwich, custom coffee, dessert. Anything. That's kinda neat and makes it a better value.

I struggled with the rating.  The place is clean.   The bathrooms are kept up.  As I typically stop in while traveling I appreciate a clean place to grab a warm drink and to use the restroom.  

The customer service is spotty.  A few of the young men are efficient, friendly and make this place seem youthful and vibrant.  However, today I was helped by a woman who initially seemed as though I was bothering her.  After a few "yes ma'am" answers to her questions, she softened and was a bit more friendly.

This is a good place to grab a drink, but don't expect to be wowed with phenomenal customer service.

Went in at lunch, not too busy, several baristas working.  Asked first if they had any January cups left, barista looks around and says, no, I don't think so.  I asked if they would be in the front register area and he said, probably.  I ordered a venti cool lime refresher, tomato mozzarella panini and had picked up a box of cranberry bliss bar with a mark down of $8.43.  Rings me up, I pay with my app and he walks over to warm up panini.  I look at the receipt and the bliss bar rang up at $13.95.  I brought it to his attention and he said let me ask my manager.  Standing right there, she said, "Oh that ended yesterday."  There were several people waiting behind me by this time so I walked away, with the whatever attitude.  So I am waiting for my drink, and waiting, and waiting.  Finally I went up to the bar to inquire.  They forgot :(  So disappointing for this location (Stanford and McCarran) because I stop in here several times a week.

This Starbucks is always busy. Expect to wait for a seat. The store is like any other Starbucks but with a few things that make it stand out a bit from the rest:

1. They hang artwork from local artist. The artwork is nice and it is for sale upon request. I like this.

2. The staff is a bit more friendly than other Starbucks I've been to. I think they might genuinely care about their jobs... Or, maybe they're just nice people. 

This is a good rating from me... for Starbucks.

This has become my new Starbucks now that I've moved. I'm into it. Everyone I've met has been really friendly and chipper even though I am never there later than 6:45am. They are also great at handling long lines and getting people in and out with the correct order. Very important!

Only complaint - whyyyyyyyy would you build a Starbucks with no drive-thru??!?

This Starbucks is a quiet place to get a coffee and relax. They've got these big, comfy chairs lining the wall that you could sleep in if you're not careful. The associates were very nice and I was able to get a very delicious frap with no issue. 

Although the drive to Blackwood NJ was an adventure of itself, getting into the parking lot was no problem. As you got onto Blackwood Clementon Road, it's was easily visible and you could find the entrance to the very pig parking lot right then and there. There's also a Pizza Hut and a T-Mobile right nearby, if you're into pizza or you're checking out a new wireless carrier.

The chairs are plenty and they are nice. Besides the usual coffee shop seating, they have these big airport lounge chairs. They have a greyish tint to them and are the type of chair you can catch 40 winks within 1 minute. Kudos for that. 

The associates were all very nice. I had my Frappuccino order within a few minutes with absolutely no hard time from the employees. For some reason, people have been saying on Twitter and other social media that the baristas at Starbucks and similar coffee shops judge you for your coffee order. Maybe if you add a whole bunch of shots or something, they might, but, I have never been "judged" by a barista for an order. I think their job is tough already with the various types of customers they deal with on a daily basis. A simple order every once and a while is probably a treat for them. 

The YUM was great, the seating was great, even the location wasn't that bad.

It's 7 AM I want my Starbucks I drive to this location a few miles from the hotel order my grande no foam latte. It's all good but something is wrong here no smiling faces everyone looks so unhappy I understand it's early Sunday morning but I really didn't mean to create extra work for anyone by having my foam scooped off the top apparently this is new to the west coast she spilled hot steaming milk all down the side of my cup shoved a sleeve on and handed the dripping mess to me. I was so distraught I wasn't able to speak I walked out open my truck door grabbed my travel mug and dumped it in and trashed the cup and sleeve it wasn't until I drove away that I realized what just happened this is unacceptable now I'm wondering where I go tomorrow :-(

5 stars alone for:

-having reasonably priced bottles of Pellegrino
-letting me come in and use the restroom after hours as your were closing/cleaning up
-giving me complimentary iced water as i exited
Very friendly and nothing out of the ordinary from a Starbucks. Shame about the poor quality coffee though. This post maybe more positive because I just walked away with a free cup

-2stars. Now that's generous. 

Please keep reading to find out why.

The staff at this Hyatt Hotel location Starbucks deserves to be informed about coffee. I have had opportunities to visit Italy and experience real coffee, espresso and cappuccinos.  Attitude of cashier at this location made me think that the Italians got it wrong. The attitude, the arrogance and refusal to correct their thinking puzzled me the most. And according to this cashier on duty, the Italians have it wrong since the 17th century. I was so puzzled that I chose to look up definition of cappuccino before writing this. It was an indeed a very disappointing and humiliating experience at this Hyatt location next to the Arch at STL.
One of the most homley Starbucks I've encountered.  There's a real fireplace here.   5 stars for the University of Arizona.

Watch this Starbucks when you order.  Three times in the past few months I have ordered a trenta drink and they have given me a venti.  I am sure that helps with their profit margin but not the best customer experience.  The first time I didn't notice.  The second time a friend picked it up for me so it was too late by the time I received it.  Today they handed it to me like I wouldn't notice.  When I pointed it out to the barista, she said they were out of trenta cups so she clearly knew the order wasn't what I had ordered.  I use the order ahead feature in the mobile app so even the label clearly states the the correct size.  

As others have pointed out - management and customer service training seem to be in order for this location.

My boyfriend and I stopped at this Starbucks on our way back home after a weekend trip to Reno. While the drinks were fine (it's not difficult to mess up two hot chocolates but its been done), the service was the worst I have ever experienced at a Starbucks. We waited at least 20 minutes to get our drinks, while the three customers that came in AFTER us got theirs. One of them had two orders and another had four. Why on earth did the employees find it appropriate to make six drinks before our two? Maybe that is how things are done in Nevada but the proper etiquette is to make the drinks in the order they were placed. I was seething by the time we finally received ours but we received no apologies or compensation. While we are planning to come back to Reno, you can bet that we will never return to that Starbucks.

Starbucks is good because it's a franchise and it's hard to screw up a business that's already been layed out for you. Since the methodology and the ambient are uniform throughout the stores, the one thing an individual store needs to make a priority to not get a bad review is customer service. The barista, Cory, took my order as if I were inconveniencing her. If she had even been uninvolved or emotionless while I ordered I wouldn't be writting a bad review. But she outdid herself with her attitude. She didn't make me feel welcome. Only reason I'm not giving one star is that I liked the coffee.

A Starbucks right on the Ave. Does it get any better?

When you are strolling down the Ave and fee like a cup of comfort, this Starbucks is always the best place to go. They changed the interior arrangement which always throws me for a loop as the line-up now starts at the other end of the store. In any case, there is quick service and there seems to always be a seat inside or outside. Outside is a lovely spot to sit with the poodles and watch the traffic of the Ave. Wonderful people watching spot.
Walk across the street and go to PJ's.  Nice building, though. What a waste.

The lesser of the two uptown starbucks locations, based purely on seating.  

There are lots of great local alternatives that serve better coffee with FREE wifi.

Local options close by include:
PJs (literally two storefronts away toward downtown)
CCs (magazine and jefferson)
Rue de la Course (oak and carrollton)

Very friendly staff that were efficient and hardworking. Solid consistent Starbucks drinks. Great assortment of pastries/snacks. I found a spot to sit and relax with my drink and book for a bit. The parking lot can be quite the nightmare during sporadic busier times of day though.

At first I thought this was an office building. But it's not. They give great service and the store is always clean. My favorite drink they make is a green tea frappucino. Have them make it with soy milkand sugar free syrup. It's amazing

Super great service. Happy employees with great A/C.  Really appreciate the upbeat attitude.  Accidentally ordered a Tall but needed Venti size of the Refresher. They mixed it into a Venti before I could blink. Awesome customer service!
Typical Starbucks. No complaints here. My drink was good (I always order the the chai tea latte) and the speed of the service through the drive through was about average. Overall a decent stop.

This place is okay, but what Starbuck's has no venti-sized straws. I literally have to go to Jamba Juice to get a fucking large straw. Just be warned, if you buy a Trenta or Venti or any large sized drink, they will leave you hanging. Better work on the customer service.

What a disappointment I had today in Starbucks at this location.  After placing my order, I waited for 15 minutes for my drinks.  In addition, my order was presented to me wrong 2 times.  The waste, the waiting customers, the frustrated Starbucks workers.....I'll think twice before I go to this Starbucks again.

Great Starbucks:
Fast and good service. My
Coffee always comes out right. It's super convent when you have shopping at target to legends to do. If they is a long line it moves fast and you get your coffee within minutes.

Didn't give 5 stars because a they always seem to be out of something.

I am a Starbucks fan, even though I usually purchase traditional coffee. There's many different locales better than this one. I went through the Drive-thru this AM, no picture on the screen which was odd. Requested a bagel, all out, fair enough, it happens, I took it as a sign to cut some bread out of my day. Apparently the barista or cashier was a mute! Not one word during the whole transaction, not even a "here you go", "ok" or anything. Just handed her my money, she handed me my drink, I was the only one in line. I said Thank You, to her and she looked like she wanted to tear me a new one. There's a much better one in Exton, super people, and the one in Edgemont makes me feel like part of the family. Not this place, is it the manager? The coffee was tasteless, and lousy, I made myself a K-cup later and reused the cup, had to be good for something. Definitely not the Starbucks norm. Devon, better, Edgemont, fantastic, Exton, supernice. Newtown Square and Broomall, very warm. Paoli...go somewhere else if you want a good start to your day.

This is a licensed and not company owned store.  They do not honor gold card refills.   It's ok but Starbucks should require them to hold their same standards. The WiFi is also pretty slow at only about 2mb/sec clocked using speedtest.

Aesthetically pleasing uptown location. Parking is a headache on the cramped Maple Street but there is a small lot available at an old gas station right across the street. 

I brought in my reusable mug that had a bit of gunk in the bottom from letting old coffee sit in it and the nice guy behind the counter scrubbed it for 10 minutes in scalding hot water to try and get it out--how nice! This location is busy and crowded because of its close proximity to the universities so I suggest getting your drink to-go. I'd stop by again if I were in the area.

Used to come here to work while having a coffee and then some tea for a few hours. Love the place because the staff is nice (some more than others) and they know how to make the promotional drink (Cocoa Cappuccino) that I used to get all the time (maybe 2-3 years ago now). They still make it for me when I go in which is great :). Had to cut back on coffee intake and only go in there from time to time and they still remember my drink when I go. Thank you all! 5 stars only because of the staff that remembers my drink :P

Other drinks I get is a tall 2 pump mocha (good balance of coffee + sweetness and hint of chocolate taste) and peppermint mocha. Also love their spinach croissant (though sometimes i feel it is a bit too oily, just depends on mood)
I frequent this Starbucks since it is close to my house but the drive thru today set the mood for my wife and I as the chillest experience we have ever had. It truly set us up for a relaxing day.

We were in here on 8/4/15 after checking in to Whitney Peak Hotel for our stay during Hot August Nights. Ordered a Ristretto Breve Cappuccino, got a Raspberry Breve Cappuccino. Not the first time this has happened, but at least I didn't have to find out on my first sip since the barista called it out (they didn't call names during the time we were here). I was a little apprehensive for the remake, and my husband's drink (same), but amazingly it was spot-on! Not made like a Latte, like many baristas do nowadays. Everyone was friendly here, too.

Early morning deciding which coffee shop to pick up from since I had a little extra time to spare before work. Decided on Starbucks since the online ordering is convenient and I wouldn't have to wait on the order and risk being late. 

I get there to pick up and there is an item missing. I try to catch the baristas attention and she blatantly ignores. I tell her I had the pick up order and I ordered two drinks (both iced americanos) and there's one missing. She says with an attitude, "What type of drink?!" After I tell her she walks away and continues working until she finally decides to make my drink. She practically shoves it at me and immediately turns away. What an awful experience. I don't like to be treated like I am inconvenience when I am a paying customer and the error was on her part. Won't be patronizing this location again.

My coworkers and I were hosting a meeting at the Westin by the baseball stadium but there was no coffee shop in our hotel so we walked on over to the Starbucks in the Hilton, located only a short walk away, to get our caffeine fix. 

It appears to share a space with a frozen yogurt shop, so where to enter Starbucks is a bit confusing. There was signage for both the Starbucks and the fro-yo joint, so it was not clear. We ended up walking into the front of the hotel and in that way rather than through the outside entrance which is where we ended up exiting after we had our coffee. 

The staff was super friendly, helpful, and quite efficient. Our drinks were made within minutes, and we were on our way! They tasted perfect and were just what we needed for an early morning pick-me-up. I highly recommend the location!

Tracy is the sweetest lady there. I go there most mornings before work, and we always chat and talk. My breakfast is always delicious and made quickly. Even if it wasnt good, I would still go here just for the people who work here. The customer service is beyond compare.

Always clean and friendly. On occasion their soy milk isn't great; it's almost like they forget to shake it. But, overall, it's a great place. Newly renovated and plenty of indoor seating; there are a couple of tables and chairs outside too.

This place is tiny ;( I entered with a small/compact stroller and it was difficult to maneuver around. But it appeared clean and there was another room for patrons to sit. 

The baristas were friendly and accommodating. I asked for a grande to be split between 2 kids cups and they had no problem doing so. Plus there was an extra bit in the grande cup that she gave to us as well. Thank you Sidney! 

Yup, totally ok with returning if I'm in the area :)

Every Starbucks is the same bland, boring, sterile yuppie infested, "I'm in a rush, get my latte quick" type place.

Awful Coffee, lousy rude service, terrible sandwiches, overpriced everything.

I avoid it always unless I get a free gift card.

This is THE Starbucks - smack dab in the middle of New Hope's tourist district.  Right over the bridge from Lambertville.

And while, I tuly believe that "friends don let friends drink Charbucks" (or "Fourbucks") this one is not bad.  Nice customer service and the line (if there is one) moves quickly.

As Fourbucks goes - this is one of the better locations.
My Chai tea is on point!! I added a pump of gingerbread to it this time. More than pleased. Doing the happy dance... Delicious!!

This place is AMAZING w Starbucks new mobile order option. They always have it ready in about five minutes. I give it 4 stars because As far as a study spot, I don't feel like this is a great place. There are not a lot of seating options and they are very close together. On occasion when trying to study here at had to leave because the music was a little too loud and I can hear it over my headphones.

Been to this Starbucks twice. waited in the drive thru for 17 minutes and never got my order. had to pull out to go to school with no food or drink. don't go to this one if you have to get anything quick this is the second time this has happened to me

To be honest, I love Starbucks, but this particular location I avoid. The employees are super nice, and know all of their customers, but it is always busy and even when it doesn't seem busy, the mobile orders make what should be a 5 minute wait a 15-20 minute wait. Most likely due to the proximity of the hospital and multiple businesses in the area, and the extremely convenient location for those staying in the neighborhood. If you have the time to spare, this is a cozy location, great for people watching and local flavor, I would not recommend stopping here if you are crunched for time.
When I am in town, this is my place for espresso. Curtis even knows what I want without asking, triple shot on ice. My go to coffee shop when I am here in Nola

Ok  it's 5:20am and i have never been greeted with such nice staff. They went out of their way to make my morning pleasant. Not to mention the drinks tasted better than ever! Thank you Todd for a great Latte and Thank you Joel for great service!!!

I have been to three different Starbucks in a week.  Why aren't there any pumpkin scones??  I was told that "they" misjudged the popularity of them and that they are gone for the season.  The season just started.  Very disappointed.  Not good.  I guess I give on you guys.  Bad decision.

Today we ordered coffee and hot chocolate for our son. The drinks tasted like dish soap. Called to speak with manager she sounded like she didn't know what to do. While pouring drinks put in sink, soap suds had formed. Please avoid this location!!!! We are now sick.
I love this Starbucks. It's comfortable, roomy, and the service is awesome. Definitely recommend stopping in there if you're in Turnersville
Brian was great. Amy had a Skinny-Peppermint-Mocha w/3 shots & choc croissant. I had a tall blonde w/ honeys buns. Great!!
Your standard Starbucks minus plastic utensils for spreading cream cheese on a bagel. Service was quick but the drink / food announcements were very quiet.

The better of the two uptown starbucks locations.

This long, narrow starbucks has more seating than the maple street location.  In all other aspects, it is a completely typical starbucks.  How can there be any difference?  All the drinks are made by machines anyway.

Service sucks at this location. Not only are they systemically rude (which is a leadership issue) but they are not proactive. Seeming high turn over..today once.again asked for something easy and simple and again it was not done, then the young man handed me the cup.to do it myself. Shame on me for going back.
I came to this Starbucks while visiting my mom. This Starbucks is very clean, has plenty of seating, and family friendly. They've got a changing station and high chairs. Staff is very friendly.
Great post-Macy's shopping respite.  Their employees are friendly to the bone.  The decor in this place is a bit more upscale than a regular SBUX, despite the constant traffic.  I love it.

Everyone in this Starbucks is very nice and friendly, but it has a horrible stench inside.  There are a lot of homeless people in the area and they tend to camp out in the store, which makes you want to grab your coffee and get out as soon as possible!
Great wifi and shared lobby with Hilton is a great idea. Lots of sittings and even for a small meeting.
I placed a mobile order for coffee and food. 15 minutes later, nothing was prepared. Ultimately, I flagged the issue to the cashier and got my stuff in 25 minutes - horrible customer experience!

Okay I never really write Yelp reviews. Let's start with the pros because that list is short : none Cons.... I have never seen so many people work at a place without actually doing any work. This is the most inefficiently run Starbucks. It doesn't matter if there's one person in line or 10. Also, there's a manager there who always acts SO stressed out (like she's running nasa) that it stresses me right out. Was here this past Sunday and I'm not kidding you waited 30 minutes for my drink. When I asked about it the woman said that "it was coming" despite FOUR people working there I mean come on if they were short staffed it's one thing. People behind me were getting their drinks and when I asked why I got a rude response that they're running two different bars my drink is at the cold bar (they kept sending the guy who was running the cold bar to do useless errands). I guess I don't understand how it's so hard to follow the queue and just turn and make the next drink at the other bar. Or how with this many employees you can operate so slow! Another time I watched the girl make my drink wrong and said it tasted funny I was told "well maybe you want something different then" like are you kidding. Then I pointed out syrup was wrongly added and got an "oh" not a sorry ... nothing. Terrible and rude

Probably the worst Starbucks that I have ever been to. The 4th of July AM cashier was about as surly as they come. The "flat whites" were awful. The store is cold and uninviting. Really just a hangout for the homeless. The manager needs to check out the several far superior coffee establishments close by like Green Star or Handlebar. Starbucks has fallen far from its original concept. It is really just a fast food chain now. And not a particularly good one at that. So long Starbucks at State and Victoria!

Top notch first class Starbucks! Customer service is excellent and always feel welcomed. You know the workers are good
when they remember your order and begin to make it at the sight of your face. Only negative is parking!
Well, it's on the base, so those that can access it can enjoy the tasty  that Starbucks offers. The lines are decent and the service is excellent! Use your app and get those rewards!

This Starbucks has a first rate crew of baristas. Great Starbucks products delivered with a smile. I go out of my way to visit here.  I particularly like the tub chairs for comfort.  This store also has a consistent clientele of pleasant people. The Drive Thru often has a long line but very efficiently served.

I am a daily Starbucks customer and live in goleta I normally go to the fair view location but occasionally go to the one on the mesa. I will no longer go to this location. I have had the worst service possibly the workers are rude to me every single time. Have an attitude don't greet me when I come in. Terrible I would love to take my tips other places but they are not deserved here
Love the location on the corner of Gay and High. Great space they're in with entrances on both streets. Quick friendly service. Awesome drinks and snacks.

Probably the worst Starbucks I have ever been too.  Maybe because it's at the college but doesn't mean you shouldn't have a working bathroom.  Told the person behind the counter and she wasn't surprised.   Took 20 mins for an ice tea!

This is my neighborhood Starbucks and I it visit frequently because it is close to my house, and being the coffee a Holick that I am whenever I don't have fresh brew at the house this is my go to stop. Your typical Starbucks decor,  friendly atmosphere, free Wi-Fi, great place to come and read the paper or a book or catch up on some work that you just can't get done at the house. During peak hours, mornings and afternoons the drive-through line can be kind of lengthy but if your Starbucks Conniseaur such as myself it is worth the wait.
I like Starbucks because it is a consistently good cup of coffee. Always know what you're going to get in you can always rely on the rich bold flavor

This is based strictly on using the mobile app.
The last few times I have picked up my beverage it has been about half full with mostly foam and a lot of empty space.  
The few times I have ordered at the counter I haven't experienced this so I can only assume they short the mobile customers assuming they'll be long gone before they notice.
It was obvious when I picked up the cup by how light it was, but I ordered mobile because I didn't have time to wait in the always very long line.  I gave them another shot assuming it was a fluke but it looks like it's become the standard.  
I'll be visiting the Virginia Street location from now on.

I have been to Starbucks all around the world. This is the only store (other than the one on Carrothers  in Franklin which can be equally bad) where I am not greeted soon after entering the store. I can stand at the counter for several minutes when there is no one else in line and still be ignored while the staff talks amongst themselves. This is not just an issue of being over crowded or under staffed. This is poor customer service and bad management. The milk is often over heated and the espresso over extracted. I have given them multiple tries, as this location is the closest one to me. But with no improvement over all the years since they opened, I now go out of my way to Old Hickory Blvd  to get a latte.
I love Starbucks and the staff is always nice, but this location is the slowest I have ever been to.  Every time I go through the drive thru I regret it because it takes so long.

Nice location in the heart of New Hope. The design is definitely favored to get you in and out of the store, as there is very little indoor seating. The outdoor patio is quite large. And this must be the only Starbucks I've ever encountered that doesn't have any available outlets? I'm sure they get a lot of day trippers trying to charge their phones, but seriously not even one outlet? My hometown Starbucks has probably 20 outlets and USB plugs. They got our order wrong and couldn't figure out how to use my Starbucks Rewards coupon. But I suppose at least they were pleasant about it. Overall, not the greatest, but not the worst. I think next time I'll go across the street to Dunkin Donuts.

Today me and my dog Suade pulled up to the drive thru and before I could say anything a voice says "would you like a tall coffee " , I always order a Tall coffee and it was nice to have someone remember me. The Barista's name is Jon, thank you Jon!!!

I love this Starbucks location.  The staff is super nice - not to mention quick and efficient.  I've never had a problem with my order not being right and I've never had to wait more than a few minutes to complete my order from beginning to end.  I highly recommend this Starbucks - one of the best in Tucson!

Don't even know where to start! They don't put names on orders, how do you know whose bagel is whose! So shit show at the counter needless to say people trying to guess who was whose! Then my drink was wrong and when asked to remake it they asked if I even knew if it was my drink or not.... well had my name been on it I would be positive but for now I'm assuming since no one else came to grab it! So when they made it right the employee mocked me while the other employee gave me my drink!!! WILL NEVER EVER RETURN!!!
Coffee's great and the food is the BEST! I love their rice crispy treats, scones, mini donuts, and breakfast sandwhich. It's the most perfect breakfast !
No real complaints about this location as far as the drinks or service. It's just always incredibly packed. You're lucky to find a seat when you go in. Best to get your order to go!

Omg this is the slowest Starbucks ever! Seriously, the drive-thru is always backed up and takes forever. I'm not sure if it's because it's a new location and they are still working out the kinks or what. Twice when I have gone here they have been out of Chai for a chai tea latte. Also be careful entering and exiting there are horrible pot holes at both entryways.

The staff here are always incredibly kind. This morning I ordered a venti iced coffee and it fell over as I was trying to balance my bags and umbrella. The staff members were quick to assist me clean my things, replace my drink order, and clean the coffee from the floor. I was incredibly embarrassed and kept apologizing to the staff for having to clean the mess to only have them say again and again that it was alright and not to worry. Upon leaving I said thank you again and was told to have a great day. For a chain location in Philadelphia, this store and staff are fantastic. I wish I had more than $3 to leave as a tip since I had paid with the app. I'll have to come back again.
The parking lot is a pain, but this locations caramel macchiato is SO worth it. I was here in the morning around 8am - not too busy at all! Great variety of mugs too :)

Definitely the best Starbucks around. The Starbucks rewards program has me coming in a lot more than I used to, but I'm sure glad I am. The people who work here are super cool and never mess up an order, even when I use the secret menu. My boyfriend from out of town even said this is the best Starbucks he's ever been to. I don't go to any other Starbucks.

Last time I go to this particular Starbucks.  Woman who helped me took my order and just left the cashier.  I stood there for a good few minutes and had to ask the neighboring cashier what happened.  

Cappuccino barely had any liquid - majority foam.

Go to a different Starbucks.

First off - I love Starbucks. This location? Not so much.

I've had issues redeeming coupons that Starbucks sent me here and every time I get a drink it is SO MESSY. I am talking about fraps, hot drinks, cold drinks, PLAIN COFFEE. The only reason why I still go here is because it is on the way to class in Hammond.

I visited this Starbucks during the Summer and sat outside; plenty of seating even on a Sunday. The outdoor music brings the typical Starbucks ambience outdoors making it the ultimate dog watching place in town. 

The barista remembered my name when I got a second drink & all was great.
Can't complain with Starbucks! Just watch leave extra early if u want to go to this location in the mornings during the week because it gets crowded.

I truly love this Starbucks everything about it the staff is always welcoming always nice and they seem to remember you even if you don't go to this Starbucks all the time. I generally get the Venti Caramel Macchiato or a Venti Caramel Frappuccino and today I chose a peach green tea and it was delicious. they always make the Frappuccinos consistent there's never one that doesn't have enough caramel and they always ask if you want whipped cream. I love Starbucks and go to many different locations however this is my favorite due to the staff being as friendly as they are.

Not too bad.... We ended up coming here on a holiday, which for me is always iffy. The staff was exceptionally happy, upbeat and helpful. I am a big fan of Starbuck's. I know there are plenty of wonderful coffe shops out there but for me to be in and out timely they are the way to go. 

I am a huge fan of Bone Dry Cappuccinos. They did an alright job. Not as dry as I like it but who can be picky. If this is the worse thing I have to deal with then I think I'm doing pretty darn good.
Wish I could give less than a one. These are the rudest people I have met at any Starbucks across the nation. They should be fired. Don't you know that the customer is who keeps you employed?

Maybe it's because I love SB, but this Starbucks rates higher for me than most others.  

It's in a great location, friendly service and clean.

Picking up an essential caffeine recharge during our tourist travels, this was one of the few Starbucks experiences where I wasn't told "out of this" or "can't substitute that" or anything else that would send me back onto the street in search of 7-11.  The man who took my order was very pleasant and didn't seem like he had too many imperfect lattes thrown at him so I was pretty stoked.  No external lock on the bathroom door or need of tokens so that was pretty nice.  Coffee was typical for Starbucks which was exactly what I was looking for.

Visited about a month ago. About the largest SBUX I've ever visited! Very clean and neat. The manager was very friendly and extremely knowledgeable about coffee and the business. Next time I head through Nashville, I'm taking the extra minutes to visit this SBUX!

This Starbucks is a perfect example of what happens without corporate or proper supervision... Either the staff or the manager has this figured out... the way to get out right at closing time is make it so unbearable to be in the store that everyone leaves... It's the evening of the Summer Solstice Parade... State Street is packed with people and yet this Starbucks is empty! Why?
It's freezing in there... 
One of the biggest complaints is that Music is so loud... there are tables galore and many electrical outlets... (One of which two months after reporting that someone broke off their plug in the outlet, is still not repaired).

But to be in there more than 5 minutes... you will need a bottle of Excedrin
I am sorry... but management this store is a fail... 
The people smile and talk with you... but if you ask to use the bathroom they will say (and I'm not kidding here)... even if you're the only one in there they will ask have you purchased anything? are you a customer!
There is a young mgr there he thought this was funny after I said that Yes I have been a customer here for some time... figuring as we have talked a few times he would remember me... but Nope!
I understand that transients use restrooms and leave them a mess... but I'm sorry... I'm 59 yrs old and I do not look like a street person.

I love the vast majority of Starbucks... but I would not recommend this spot at all.

I've been waiting for more than 30 minutes on line for a coffee. If I didn't have this gift card, I would totally go across the street to Brew Ha Ha. The staff of 2 seems overwhelmed & kind of unhappy--no service with a smile. You would think a multi billion dollar organization like this would anticipate the busy periods & staff appropriately! Also, no recycle bins or containers. Shame on you Marsh Road Starbucks...I expected better.
I love this Starbucks. Everyone is so friendly. They are fast. Easy to get in and out of too. Inside is super cozy.

This place just blows my mind.....the drive thru is always packed and i'm convinced they are pumping in some type of "happy" air for the staff because they are over the top pippy---to the point that I just couldn't wrap my head around it.  I felt like I was being filmed for some type of tv show....they are like the spunky perky cheerleaders from bring it on.  each and every one of them....worth going through the line just to get a load of this cheerfulness.  Rock on Starbucks employees.....way to try and turn peoples frown upside down...
Guy behind the counter made an off remark when we mentioned we usually don't like Starbucks whipped cream

I love Starbucks. I'm loyal to them, and have been going there for years. I have a gold card, and am quite addicted!

I'm pretty picky when it comes to location. I've determined that this one is my favorite! There are two newer people who always screw up my order, but it's rectified, and I leave with a great drink. I usually get the same drink, and this location makes it the best. Sometimes I go in the morning before class, and everyone is so friendly! I'll be honest, I'm not a tipper, but the baristas in the morning win me over every time!

This Starbucks really needs help no matter what time of the day I come here I end up waiting ten minutes or more for a drink the only time they were fast was when a couple people were standing with a clipboard watching the person in the window... hopefully they get the help they need one day
Friendly and fast service for me. Bad part they almost forgot my boyfriends beverage. Short line good indoor & outdoor seating.

I've pretty much given up on this place. No matter what time of day it is, the team doesn't seem to be working together cohesively, and the line inside seems to get neglected while most of the employees scramble to take care of the drive-thru. I hate going through the drive-thru anywhere, but I didn't realize I would start getting penalized for my preferences.
Katrina, Robert and the am Starbucks crew are were it's at. Like magic, I walk in, my favorite beverage is expertly prepared and the customer service is impeccable.
I ordered the a white chocolate mocha. I noticed it tasted a lot better then most starbucks.

There are some really great employees here, but the majority of them are terrible. I don't know if there are a bunch of new people...? They are extremely slow and unorganized. I come in almost every morning, and I'd say twice a week there is a good crew in there. The rest of the week is a really frustrating experience. I hate to drag the whole store down with a bad review, because like I said, there are some really great employees there sometimes. But for the 3rd time this week it has taken over 15 minutes to get coffee and a warm pastry. This isn't because it's busy, but because the employees seem to not give a shit and cruise around and socialize. Bummer.

Stop by for an afternoon ice coffee. Had to wait to order while they fixed online orders and drive thru. Barista was not real friendly, will be sure to go to drive they or order online. Our sweet cream cold brew was ok not great.

Good location with a friendly staff. The new store is great and the line moves fast. The coffee is always fresh and the condiments counter stays stocked. I would have given Starbucks 5 stars, but as long as they sell the La Boulange crap, i can't give them a perfect rating.

Worst experience at a Starbucks ever!!! I worked at Starbucks for 5 years and have never had this bad of an experience! No names on cups! Cluster f***. Baristas talking crap about customers who were less than 3 feet away! Absolutely unacceptable!!!

They were kind and attentive to my needs and wants as a customer! Great spot! 

They offered to press instead of brew my coffee. My breakfast sandwich was hot, and I didn't know they had Sriracha!!  

Feel bad for their location, but if you're in Millwoods, this is a great location!
Clean store friendly staff.  Cheerfully added cash to my Starbucks card, and had my food order ready before I finished putting cream in my grande.  What's not to like?

Not my favorite location, lines are always too long in the mornings and they take forever to take your order then to fill it. Barista's constant talking to each other about non-Starbucks related orders are annoying and could be partly responsible for their lack of attention to details. The drive thru Starbucks up the street is even worse so I guess this is the best city line has to offer.
Staff is horrible. I actually got into a back and forth with one of the staff. She was very disrespectful. She pointed both of her middle fingers at me. I was nothing but nice. Will never go back.

Everytime I come I wait in line for about 30-45 minutes and 9 out of 10 Times they tell me they are out of the food item I choose. It's frustrating to wake in line for so long and then be told the one thing I actually really want is out.

I hate going to this starbucks, the only reason I go sometimes is because it's conveniently located close to my house. The staff is often rude and impatient, they've also have been short on my change multiple times which is annoying coming in and losing 10-25 cents each time. They need better, more friendly staff.

I love coming here because it's really close to my house. The night crew here is very friendly and always stricken up a conversation with me! Morning crew is a bit different.  More business like lol.  Oh well ...as long as my drink is made correctly...I don't mind coming a bit later or maybe a bit sooner.  Please stop here and check it out!!

Place is clean.  Bathroom is stocked.  Plenty of places to sit inside and outside. I would love to see more merchandise.

This is the best Starbucks in St Louis!!! Baristas are wonderful, they make solid quality drinks EVERYTIME and I love going there!!! If your a regular they learn your name, and they get to know you and ask you about things In your life you discussed 2 weeks ago, great memory!!! This place is a great asset to our community!

Horrible service. Very unprofessional attitude and very slow service. I ordered a drink from the drive through and when I got to the window, I got a snarky remark because I wanted to use my Apple Pay. I'd rather drive an extra 5 minutes to the other location.

They were positively slammed busy because someone didn't show up for work, but the girls there still rocked it. I know they were overwhelmed but they remained friendly and efficient, despite constant questions and requests from customers. And my chai latte was good, as always.
Standard starbucks menu. The cashier usually remembers what I ordered in the past so it is a plus for me.

Great Starbucks! I do enjoy seeing the different variations of my name after I tell them (lol).

Such a friendly staff here in the morning!

They spelled my name 'Luy' lol smh
I think the staff is quite friendly and nice.  My issue hear is that they play the music at extraordinary loud levels.

Went in tonight during finals week. The store wasn't busy and the place was very clean. Every employee there was incredibly kind and my drink (even though it was a little complicated / custom) was made perfectly! 10/10 would recommend

I went on a sunday afternoon. Poor customer service for a neighbourhood coffee place that can attract regular customers. They didn't call out my order. It was left sitting on the not visible area of the pick-up counter for at least 10 minutes. The other coffee I ordered....they forgot to make it. The baristas didn't even apologize. 

The vibe of a establishment is dependent on the vibe of the employees. At this Starbucks: No customer greeting, no music playing, and unkept creamer counter. It's a sad Starbucks.
This particular location becomes a cluster very quickly. Not only is the drive thru /parking situation weird. But they consistently are running out of cold brew.

the barista at the register had an abominable attitude. basically shrugged off every customer question and concern because it wasn't her problem. this location was having "technical difficulties" with their register system, so they were unable to accept any Starbucks app payments and rewards. when I asked if I could still get a free refill due to my gold card status, the barista at the register said "no, this time you'll have to pay the refill fee because our system is down." this location doesn't care about customer loyalty - I shouldn't be charged extra because your register program was failing. iced coffee was watered down.

EW! Everything is gross about this place. It's disgusting. Cannot even tell the last time they cleaned it and the drinks are even worse! I normally like Starbucks, but this one is just all together BAD. Go to Dunkin Donuts up the street. I promise it will be better coffee than this Starbucks.

A great Starbucks. I've been to other SBs but this one's my favorite. They never get my order wrong (this has happened to me at other locations) and they typically seem genuinely friendly (some locations seem to speak to you in rote.) I'd give it 5 stars but the line is typically long and parking can occasionally be a bear. A caveat during winter: I nearly slipped on one of their sidewalks because it wasn't shoveled adequately.

Horrible service! 
Never have I personally gone out of my way to write an review, but this particular Starbucks is the absolute worst in Santa Barbara. I only had come here since it's close to my house, but every time, and I mean EVERYTIME they either mess up my drink or  have an sour attitude. The atmosphere is great with the patio seating, but that's really the only good thing about this place. They once gave my order that I paid for to someone else and rather than correcting it quickly, they made me get in line once again to order. The guy standing behind the cash register pretended like he did not recognize me (he was the one to first take my order) and I explained that I have waited over 15 minutes for my drink. This time I spelled out my order to him again and said that he should write my name on the cup. Again, I had to wait through them taking and giving everyone there orders before mine. I waited 25 minuets for a drink that they MESSED UP ON!! By the end of this experience I now go out of my way to any other Starbucks or coffee place.

If only no stars was an option...employees move slower than slow. You will grow cobwebs waiting for your drink. And when you do get it, God forbid the drink is made correctly. Having worked at a busy nyc starbucks location, this place would never make the cut, and it's in a slow paced philly location. Management is doing a bang up job with this one! Never coming here again.

Felt like I walked into a Dunkin doughnuts. The girl ringing me gave me the biggest attitude about getting a receipt. (And I needed to get reimbursed from my company) at first she asks me if I need a receipt, then she doesn't give me the recipe just puts it in a pile next to the register and takes the next order. Then I ask her for my receipt and I get a nasty look and she asks me for my card back without any explain actions. At this point I am thinking maybe my card didn't go thru the first time. But hey no communication there. A note to the manager of this store: u have an army of people behind the register, who smile chit chat, talk about life events etc, unfortunately only amongst them selves which again reminds me of Dunkin. however it would be nice if that good energy projected to ur customers; I thought Starbucks brand had a different work culture. To reference my transaction; chk 8516, 
7:30 am,  05/27/15

I can 't believe the people here actually say the service is good. The eye rolls and less than friendly atmosphere makes me drive a few extra minutes to the one on Jefferson Highway. 

Also can we keep mentioning how many times espresso shots are dead in your drinks? LOL I CAN'T EVEN COUNT ON TWO HANDS. Its been that MANY times. The wait in the drive thru on a week day? 20-30 minutes. 

This is BY FAR the worst location in the WHOLE WORLD I have been to. WORSE THAN AIRPORT STARBUCKS.

I've gone here to work for a while now and unfortunately the reasons to stop have been slowly building and today pushed it over the edge. 

Customer service is quite underwhelming about 90% of the time. Usually it's nothing crazy, just a general lack of attentiveness or feeling of caring at all from those taking your order. 

Bathrooms (can only speak for the male) are always gross. And increasingly not stocked with paper towels. 

Today I ordered an Americano and after what was at least a 20 min wait (the room was full of people waiting on drinks but order line wasn't long) I asked if my order was in the queue. 

It wasn't. 

They got another one going and had it to me in a couple minutes but didn't apologize or even acknowledge they had made a mistake. 

If this was a first time negative experience I wouldn't write anything my on here but this Starbucks has shown itself to be in need of some restructuring.

Stopped in after lunch to grab an iced vanilla latte. Didn't want Peets down the street so I settled for Starbucks. Not wanting the bitter burnt coffee Starbucks is known for I ordered an iced vanilla latte. They did a really good job and it hit the spot .

Not sure what's wrong with this location, maybe they don't have enough people working, maybe it's too small for as many customers as they have, but the woman and guy who were running the registers were having some sort of a tiff.  I couldn't tell if the guy was being a jerk, or if the woman was being dense, or a little bit of both.  In any case, it was really obvious that they were not getting along, and it was really awkward.  Also they had a display table of mugs and coffee set up right inside the door and there was another table set so close to it that someone could not sit at the table without customers who were leaving not hitting them or the display table, and it just made the whole area by the registers and door really cramped.  Very slow service.

I came here to grab breakfast sandwiches and coffee for 4 people. The cashier did not understand that I just wanted egg and cheese sandwich without any meat. It took good 5 minutes to get that straightened..

Anyway, latte and the coffees were great! Pretty good and quick service otherwise!
I like this Starbucks. It is close to my house, and close to the park. Has some outdoor seating. Always seems to be a good vibe here.

I don't usually leave Yelp reviews but after pulling an all-nighter and waking up from the coma that proceeded after arriving home from my 8am final, one of the few things I remember is the positive and kind attitude of the employee who served me the drink that kept me awake for those last few hours.

Starbucks needs to help this location big time. Wait times are ridiculous any time of the day! The drive thru has to share a freakin card reader and pin is required which slows down the line even more! 20 minutes is way too long to serve 6 cars.

Not impressed with this Starbucks today, usually we receive great customer service, however the lady that served us today ( no name tag however she did have a tattoo on her right upper arm, flowers of somesort) regardless we smiled when we approached and she was rude right off the bat that she was obviously upset about something. We ordered our 4 drinks two ice teas one strawberry frap, and one caramel frap. She was pissed that we ordered and that we ordered so many. She should work on her customer service skills, and smile.

Not every Starbucks is the same. You can easily separate the cream from the crop when you look at their level of service and consistency in making their drinks. This Starbucks unfortunately curdles and drops to the bottom of the pack.

The service is just plain bad compared to other Starbucks, it takes forever to get served and the drinks do not taste as good as other locations. It is obvious that the management here  has a long way to go in living up their corporate standards.

Pros: It's a Starbucks. Nice seating in the back and outside. They appear to have brought in some new baristas that are a little more on top of things. My dad buys me starbucks gift cards.

Cons: Close to the worst starbucks I've been too. They are consistently slow and have messed up or forgotten my drinks several times. 

Call me a coffee snob, but they always let my shots sit for a long time before adding the milk to my latte, resulting in a bitter drink. (Starbuck's "policy" is to never let a shot sit more than 10 seconds--the layers combine and it goes bitter).  I'm used to west coast starbucks, and the drinks definitely taste different here.

Starbucks is my favorite morning stop.  I drive thru here a few times a week to get my skinny caramel macchiato. The line is usually pretty long but it moves very quickly.  I couldn't imagine getting my morning coffee on my way to work anywhere else.

So I normally prefer to come to this Starbucks location. They tend to be friendly and quick. I am a sucker for good customer service. I came in to the store because the drive thur line was long. Like out in the street long. There was one group of three guys in front of me. They took their sweet time ordering and the cashier was falling all over herself in helping them. I dont mind it if you display that some level of helpful to everyone. Then she was so busy talking to another employee before she even greet me with a "we will be right with you".

I went with some co-workers to use the coupons on Retailmenot for free caramel or hazelnut macchiatos from 3/1/13-3/31-13. Retailmenot is a reputable site from which I have successfully gotten several other coupons or coupon codes before. The coupon has no limit aside from not using more than one in the same transaction. 

I used the coupon from Retailmenot at this location and other locations the week prior with no problems. Today, a few co-workers and I went in to use the coupons and there were two employees at the front register. When we told them that we had coupons, the male said, "Oh, we're not taking those but I don't know why, talk to my co-worker." We went to speak with the co-worker and she insisted that they were a scam. The first week the coupons were available they were accepted but then all of a sudden they were a scam? Especially considering the first employee "didn't know" why they were no longer accepting them, it seemed to us as if too many people used them so they didn't want to lose out on more money so began telling people they were not valid.

I doubt Starbucks is hurting for money, however, if they can't afford to have a month long special, they probably shouldn't offer free items with a coupon for a long period of time.
It is probably the worst Starbucks service in the city. Coffee is fine if they get it right. There are much better coffee places near by.
Very nice people, international atmosphere, and a nice place to go on the internet with your laptop or smartphone, for the have a nice hub.
I have had the most wonderful experiences here. I am greeted by name. The workers are friendly. Make exactly what I want. Tastes great. Best location ever! Really good tables to study at

I come here when I am out of town. Great, friendly staff, prompt service and fresh coffee. Overall a pretty good vibe. Wifi is off the charts fast and there is ample seating. Enjoy a nice cup of coffee here!

I love the fact that when you walk in the door, most of the employees greet you by name! They are quick and always get my drink order right everytime!  I have 2 or 3 different drink I usually order and they will immediately ask, which one are you getting today and they gladly make it!

Woot! Another nice clean Starbucks! Smells nice in here!  I love it! Friend baristas! My drink was made correctly. 

Plenty of space to park.  Good amount of seating plus out door seating available.  

The baristas were interested in my day and genuinely cared about it! 

Bath room was clean.

I hope they will get more New Orleans mugs! I know they sell out rather quickly! Other than that...awesome!

I mean, it's a Starbucks, not much to say. Service was good, real fast actually. I come here sometimes since it's up the street from work. But if you like Starbucks then I think you'll like this location. Only downfall is no drive-thru & you can tell this one has been around awhile.

We've been visiting this Starbucks for several years now and we've always found it to have friendly service and the high quality beverages and treats that you expect from Starbucks.   While it's still a "treat" to us and not an everyday thing, we do appreciate this location being so close to home.   The only comment I would make is that their outside "porch" facing the gas station is almost comical.   But there's really nothing they could do about that.

Pleasantly surprised with this off-Macys mid-city Starbucks. Given the location, I wasn't expecting much to be honest. There was also a Starbucks inside my nearby hotel, and I was disappointed with their drink quality. I figured this would be more of the same.

Instead, I was greeted by a friendly, smiling barista, my drink was made quickly (and correctly!), and I was able to find a seat easily. It was decently busy for a weekday, but it was still comfortable & not crowded. The line was moving & the vibe was relaxed. And that's all you really want from a Starbucks, isn't it? Besides a good drink of course ....

Horrible food inventory control: multiple times I have ordered a breakfast food item and 5 minutes later been told they have run out. 
Horrible atmosphere: too small, too many people with mental illness issues hanging out.

This is just your typical Starbucks.  the parking lot is slightly small and can be a pain in the rear-end as I've had to park at the bank a few times.  Sometimes if you want to nab a nice big table or couch to study it is difficult as this place always seems to be quite busy.  They make a decent coffee and it is relatively convenient.  I just wish it had a drive-through :(

I'm really kinda bummed to give this place 3 stars after seeing a few 5 star ratings.  I had two separate bad visits here.  The place is clean and looks great.  The staff was ok, nothing overly impressive.  I had VERY long wait times for my order of an iced coffee with cream and sugar...  Not good.  Meanwhile two of the other baristas didn't seem phased by the growing line.  Not impressed.

Eh, this Starbucks is hit or miss.  Unlike some of the other reviewers here, I've typically had pleasant interactions with the staff as it pertains to personality, but the wait times here are tremendous.  They're so slow that the traffic gets backed up well into the street, which, during a morning commute in Brentwood, is very frustrating.  In short, this is a fine place to go on a slow Saturday morning when you can go inside and have time to wait, but stay as far away as possible if you'r eon any sort of schedule.

Best Starbucks. Worst parking lot. There's nothing they can do about it, I know, but still. We literally come here every single weekday morning. The baristas are always smiling, knowledgeable and friendly. Oh and fast. They give my daughter stickers sometimes. The have big, comfy chairs we chill in and we love. The walls used to be covered in local children's artwork. I miss that but it does have more of a sleek vibe now. And a farmhouse table in the middle and a bar by the window. They always have plenty of everything and it's fresh. I will go out of my way to come to this Starbucks. They are a breath of fresh air in the mornings. Franchetti and Erica are so incredibly sweet and I think his name is Gannon or something with a G (I'm probably blushing too much to read) is smiling and happy and super cute. Definitely doesn't hurt to look at him first think in the morning. But really he does make the best iced green tea lattes. When I go other places the matcha powder doesn't dissolve. He makes that happen. I've left my debit card here and they kept it for me. I went on a mad search for an specialty mug and called and they held it for me. It's home in the mornings. We love this Starbucks (especially compared to others).

My family and I actually had to look this particular starbucks up bc we were not familiar with the area and this was the closest one to us according to our GPS navigator. We came in 15 minutes before they were about to close. While waiting for all of our drinks to be made, about three small groups of people came in altogether and I overheard the staffs say that they should've locked the door. Really? But It was still during open business hours! Walking in the door 5 minutes before closing is technically open business hours ----- ! Our drinks were also not as good as it should've been as compared to our regular go to starbucks .

The people here are always amazing, polite, and amazing. I have never had a problem with them unlike other Starbucks where it's an issue just to order a drink. The manager is super nice and ready to help. The baristas are on point with everything they do including friendly service and attentive actions. I trust them to do it right every time. This should be the most popular location in town, if it isn't all ready.

2/5 angry barista?

dude, this guy must not like his cleaning duty today, he's sweeping like a honey badger and stomping and dumping everywhere. a quiet rainy sunday has turned into a honey badger sunday. the air's thick with dust now as he's swept it all up into the air.

I stopped in for a pound of coffee. Justin overheard me tell someone I would like a cappuccino and he said, "Well you've come to the right place!". I was skeptical because I have walked away from the last three cappuccinos I have ordered at Starbucks. I didn't think he could pull it off but I liked his enthusiasm so I ordered it anyway.  It was the best cappuccino I have ever had at Starbucks.

I stopped here after discovering the Soho had sold out for the Chris Robinson Brotherhood, and I couldn't find the public restrooms. The barista(Katie) on duty was very kind and engaged me in conversation when I told her I had just driven 120 miles to see the show. I was quite pleased with her customer service and getting me on the list to the show)). 

If all baristas could be as customer service oriented, the service industry economy would thrive. Having grown up in Ventura county and frequently going to Santa Barbara on the weekends I have forgotten what it is like to receive great customer service from a corporate run business.

Wonderful uptown atmosphere. There are a lot of college students, business men and neighborhood locals meeting here. Some of the staff are friendly and others are defiantly not. 
I love the beautiful patio and the atmosphere this Starbucks offer.

Oh man, did these guys get a new staff? Things seem to be served so much slower than in the past. I live across the street so it's super convenient and I wouldn't stop coming back. But man, I have to give myself like 10-15 extra minutes additional now compared with the old staff.

This Starbucks is a perfect example of why I DONT frequent Starbucks, but I had a gift card to use. 

Only one person working - making both the drinks and taking orders. Obviously this is a set up for a shit show!! He was unable to get anyone's drink right and did not listen to the orders. I asked for regular milk, but instead get skim. It was BOGO from 2-5, and he had no idea. Person next to me ordered an iced latte, and he makes an iced coffee. 

Very annoying and frustrating. Will definitely avoid at all costs.

Went here last weekend and worth crossing the river. Order was correct, staff was polite, ample places to sit both inside and out and it was clean. Best of all the baristas don't argue with the customer over an order they make incorrectly. Unlike the manhattan blvd location. Which USED to be our go to spot for coffee on Saturday mornings. At least they got the hiring right at this location.

Nice staff... nice location. .. great fast service even it was packed... worst coffee ever!! I love starbucks but surely not this branch....!! 2nd time I go it doesn't taste nor the color of coffee is the same. I think they need QC :( oh and the choclate brownie, looks like a brownie... but taste like a delicious choclate cake!!

I was the only person in line in the store and ordered two grande salted caramel white mochas. Since they're not in season I had to remind the cashier that he still had everything behind the counter to make the drink.(previously worked at Starbucks) I waited 10 minutes for him to finish my drinks and ended up with two tall toffee nut mochas. Will not be coming back.

the staff are nice (although immature) and don't take away from the atmosphere--the atmosphere feeling warren but not in a rustic way. more like a premium cafe past its prime; not quite forgotten but not sought after either.
I think I've said this before....but.....crack open a vein and just inject it directly :-)
Anyone see Food Babe,  she points out ingredients that Star Bucs Coffee in other countries don't put Carman Color into the coffee like here. Too many GMOs for me

I LOVE starbucks. It's like home to me. I still enjoy local coffee shops and frequent them, but I always go to a Starbucks when I want to know exactly what I'm getting. 

This Starbucks is beautiful and large, with tons of seating. 

I'm really disappointed in the service I receive here though! I often come in at 530am on my way to work and everyone working is moving so slow. I understand it's early, but if customers are coming in at that time they're probably in a hurry to get to work or something so it shouldn't take 5 minutes to order and get rung up for a grande coffee. 

I've also gone in on the weekends where the staff has been having extremely loud, long conversations with each other and never looked or spoke to the customers. In between loudly talking to each other about how late they were for work etc the cashier said only "what can I get you" without even making eye contact. 

The line grew to 14 people while I was waiting for my drink, and the barista forgot to give the girl ahead of me her water 3 different times. 

I hope that the service gets better because it's a shame to have such a nice store in such a great location ruined by staff that just doesn't care about their clientele. 

Side note - this location doesn't have the yogurt parfaits or any fresh fruit like a lot of the other locations in the country do. Not sure if it's like this in all Nola locations or just this one.

I have been a loyal customer of this Starbucks for four years now while living in East Falls/Manayunk.  I study here often because of the quiet atmosphere, great seating, and abundance of outlets.  There is a parking lot behind the store which can get pretty packed due to the other business sharing the lot, however, there is street parking in front as well.  All of the baristas there that I have encountered have been very courteous and friendly and service is always top notch.  There are plenty of seating options from sitting at the high tables to 2 person tables to a large community table.  There is outdoor seating as well when the weather is nice, but there are no outlets outside.  I definitely recommend this location to any college/grad school students in the area because it's a great place to get studying done.
I go here nearly everyday and never a problem, always delicious.  Friendly staff and  the manager Candice is always very sweet too :)
Just like any other starbucks and the service is nice :)

Great Starbucks! Pretty cool place to just hang out and do work offsite. As with most Starbucks, the staff is very friendly. The coffee is overpriced... But that's kind of the norm for these places. The parking is not ideal...but it remains one of my favorite places to work on my computer, read a book, or have an off-site meeting while enjoying a caffeinated beverage.
Love me some Starbucks, but the line and parking is very busy. But nothing will stop me from getting a Grande Raspberry, White Mocha Cappuccino :-)

Great Starbucks, they make some pretty good secret menu drinks. Google it and they are more than likely to make it for you here. Service and drinks are well made here but there are some flaws to this Starbucks. The seating area has like no windows. I felt like I was sitting a box. The restroom lines are usually long and restrooms are sometimes out of order. Many of the tourist who come visit New Hope use Starbucks as a public restroom.

Verdict - Great location and if you wanna try some whacky secret menu flavors, the people here can try their best at making those drinks. I tried some cotton candy drink and it really tasted like cotton candy. There is also outdoor seating here and Lambertville is right across the bridge. It's a good corner spot to take a break and enjoy some refreshments.
I like going to Dunkin across the street because this StarBucks is way too loud to have any type of meeting.
I've noticed a few improvements at this location recently. The staff is obviously working hard and making improvements.

Great neighborhood spot! I love the outside covered porch, it is the perfect spot to study or catch up with friends. I know this isn't the local coffee spot, but, I like the coffee quality here much much more. It can get crowded from university students and in the mornings, but, I can usually manage to find a spot.

It was Starbucks. If you've been to one, you've been to them all. 

That said, the guy either wasn't listening or couldn't hear me when I ordered my drink because when I got it, it was missing the ingredient from the title, lol. It wasn't a big deal, but I'll make sure it's right next time. It's the only thing I like there. 

My husband's annoying and likes to pour his own milk in his coffee because his milk to coffee ratio is never what the barista's would expect. Not a big deal, but the carafes were all behind the counter, so he asked and they handed him a gallon of Great Value (Wal-Mart brand) milk. C'mon, it's $5 cups of coffee, use a name brand! ;)

We sat outside and enjoyed ourselves. So, three stars.

This is probably the worst location for a Starbucks ever. At nearly 9 am this Tuesday the drive up line was clear around the building (I think I counted 16) and you couldn't even get in the parking lot. I feel really sorry for Einstein Bagels that shares that lot. I think of all my attempts to visit this location I have only been able to get in once.

I love Starbucks bold coffee.  Today, like many other days, I stood a long slow line at the Cool Springs Mall Starbucks only to find they did not brew a bold coffee.  The other Starbucks in the Franklin area always have a bold coffee brewed and ready.  The Cool Springs Mall Starbucks is slow and maybe understaffed.  Other area Starbucks are great.
I love this Starbucks, I can get work done on the computer and have a great cup of coffee, the staff is very friendly.

This Starbucks is in the New Orleans Marriott at the Convention Center.  They have strange hours from 7am to 3pm.  So if you need an afternoon pick-me-up get there before 3pm otherwise you are out of luck.  I am glad this Starbucks was here because I don't think there were any other coffee shops within a few block radius.

The staff working there were super sweet - especially Beth, she's awesome!

I came here a lot during the week of Mardi Gras because I am a Meeting Planner and had a conference at the hotel that week.  The hotel gives you a mug that you can use while working that will give you unlimited whatever you  want refills at this Starbucks.  BRILLIANT!  Why don't more hotels do this? I love it!

The hotel staff was always asking me what I wanted and taking my mug to the Starbucks and filling it up with a soy latte or mocha.  They even washed it for me in the mornings! 

The only downside are the limited hours, and when I came there once and asked if there were bagels or oatmeal they said no (like no as in they don't carry it) so I didn't have any breakfast options because I'm vegan.  However when my friend came like 5 days later and asked if there was oatmeal they had it.  Perhaps they were just out of it the day I asked but the way it came across was not that they had run out, but that they just didn't carry it.  Once I found out they had oatmeal I too got it.  As a vegan I can't eat their other pastries/breakfast items.  Also because it's in the hotel you don't get the waivers for using your registered Starbucks card like you do at other Starbucks.  Meaning that in most Starbucks if I pay for my latte with my card they waive the soy tax but this one doesn't.  So that makes all my drinks around $0.60 more than I usually pay. BOO SOY TAX.

Anyway this place is a life savor. I can't run a conference without a Starbucks.  It's seriously one of the most important features to a hotel if I am looking at a site.

Besides the few things mentioned above, it's just like any other Starbucks:  quick, friendly, convenient.

An OK starbucks if you're retired and have plenty of time on your hands.  As you'll read in other reviews, the place is almost always too busy.  Exacerbating that problem is a pretty slow staff.  Hopping off the freeway and grabbing a cup of coffee generally takes 20 to 30 minutes.   After experiencing this problem often at this location, a casual mention to the server at the drive up window brought on a free beverage.  Next time, same thing.  And since they are chronically slow at the drive through, I guess I can expect free coffee for life.  Except I won't go back.  Sorry guys, there is no such thing as a cup of coffee that is worth $5 and 30 minutes of my time.
Didn't warm my banana bread or my mothers and gave me a half full venti coffee and a lukewarm chai latte.. Extremely disappointed. Wish I could get my money back.

This is my neighborhood Starbucks and I it visit frequently because it is close to my house, and being the coffee a Holick that I am whenever I don't have fresh brew at the house this is my go to stop. Your typical Starbucks decor,  friendly atmosphere, free Wi-Fi, great place to come and read the paper or a book or catch up on some work that you just can't get done at the house. During peak hours, mornings and afternoons the drive-through line can be kind of lengthy but if your Starbucks Conniseaur such as myself it is worth the wait.
I like Starbucks because it is a consistently good cup of coffee. Always know what you're going to get in you can always rely on the rich bold flavor. 
The baristas here are the bomb. Super nice, super friendly, and very accommodating. 
What can I say, I'm a creature of habit and if something is good I'll keep coming back.
Way to go Royal Oaks Starbucks.

I visited this Starbucks on 9-3-2013 and don't think I would recommend it to anyone else.  The tables were dirty. The windows hadn't been cleaned and there were dead flies on the window sill.  Not a good first impression.

Maybe it was just an off day, or maybe it was because of training new people, but this was kind of a confusing Starbucks experience. I guess I might be spoiled, because most Starbucks locations really get the concept of the "customer experience" right. 

A quick stop in for a nice chilly frappuccino on this hot afternoon started out a little bit strange when I was the next customer in line, and an employee standing at an empty till caught my eye and smiled brightly. I started to walk toward her and give her my order, and the employee at the other till, who had been helping the customer in front of me, broke off to reprimand me for trying to cut in front of that customer! I felt quite taken aback at the intensity of his response, to what was obviously a misunderstanding. I could barely even get out the words, "i'm so sorry, I thought she was asking me to come up and order." 

When it was my turn, for real and not for pretend, it became apparent that she was a brand-new employee, being trained, and thus it was no surprise that it was a slightly confusing process to get my card reloaded, my items run in, and finally paid for (no big deal in itself; we have all been learners at something, at some point in our lives). Perhaps this brand-new employee also learned that it sends a mixed message to customers waiting in line when you make eye contact and smile at them, but you are totally not ready for them to actually come up and order...

However, when I picked up my drink, it had not been marked correctly, so it wasn't quite right. However, it was close, so I just took it and left; I clearly needed to consume some of that caffeine, before trying to wrap my brain around any more confusion ;)

The staff wasn't rude but also wasn't friendly. They were out of cold brew by 10:45am and didn't immediately suggest something else in return. There were 4 employees working but only one making drinks so the wait was longer than most, especially for a hotel Starbucks.

Nice little place, but the parking is just a pain. 
Friendly people, great coffee

This location has a drive-thru.  Usually seems faster to drive thru than going inside, especially during peak times.  I have recently starting using the app to order from my phone when I am about 5 minutes away (the app will save your recent order to make it easy for you to order your usual drink in just 3 clicks).  If you use the app to place your order in advance, just walk up to the "pick up" spot and mention you had an online order.  Usually they have it sitting to the side ready to go (they don't want some random person walking off with your drink).  This location is always quick.  The only time I even end up waiting is when there is a person in front of me in line with no idea what to order.
Been here over the course of the summer. I've ordered 5 of the same drink, and they all have tasted different. staff are sitting around on their phones. Disappointing customer service.
Best customer service! And they were able to handle a large order and got everything right.

A smile would be nice from the 3 employees this morning.  It's my 3rd time here at this particular Starbucks, and I have yet to feel welcome here. Please help others start their day off with the right mood and vibe. Especially with you guys serving a load of college students here on Loyola campus, that little happiness and joy would make a big difference for their motivation to study.

Hands down the worst drive thru experience EVER!! Not only did it take me OVER TWENTY MINUTES to get TWO SIMPLE drinks but the guy was super short with me and I swear it would have killed him to smile. I would NEVER send ANYONE there nor will I ever return.
