I love it here! The staff is all super sweet- especially Martha! Great atmosphere and plenty of space to sit. My only gripe is that parking can be a pain. Still- this is my favorite Starbucks by far

Our own neighborhood store! (3 miles from home) What can I say about Starbucks that hasn't been said? 
I love my Venti Skinny Caramel Latte. I love my Spinach, Feta, & Cage Free Egg White on a Wheat Wrap! I love my Birthday Cake Pop! I love their Teavana teas and refreshers! (especially Mango and Hibiscus)
There ARE healthy options with assorted calorie marked Bistro Boxes and Wraps! I will return to places shaing calorie counts on their food products.
I must say the staff here is very friendly, and informative, and helpful.
This floorplan is fine for hangin' out and the outside patio is one of the better ones despite facing Main St! 
Finally, the restrooms are modern and clean! That's important as my Granddaughter, Gigi, is fancy!  :-D

This Starbucks is a hit or miss. Sometimes I get the most amazing beverage and sometimes it's way off mark. Today I asked for an Iced caramel Macchiato stirred and it tasted like milk with caramel flavor and came unstirred. *SMH* :-(
I would have asked for them to make me up a new one but I was worried that it would be extremely heavy on the espresso. So I just stuck with it plus I was to lazy to ask. So my bad I guess but if you pay $5 for designer coffee shouldn't it be perfect??
The staff is SO warm and friendly at this location. You can tell they like their jobs.
Love the remodel. Decent service. I love the holiday flavors, especially peppermint mocha which can be made vegan with soy, no whip.

Usually this Starbucks is pretty good, but today the workers were being obnoxious and not very friendly. I asked the barista if the sandwich on the counter was mine and instead of offering any sort of assistance she shrugged her shoulders and walked off.

Adequate, describes this location perfectly. 

The barista said they were unable to accept starbucks rewards because they are affiliated with the Hyatt hotel and not starbucks. I'm not sure why they can scan my starbucks card for payment but not scan for rewards?

Service was quick and lots of seating areas. But tables and chairs were filled with crumbs and a bit challenging to find a clean spot. 

Only came here because we needed a cool drink after wandering around the arch park.

I used the drive thru today and ordered an iced lemon pound cake to go with my coffee. Received a blueberry pastry instead and didn't realize it until I got home. From now on, I should check to make sure what they said is in the bag is actually correct.

Convenient Starbucks to walk into. It's average sized but might be harder to get seats on the weekend. The baristas were friendly and I received my order quick. You can walk from the Starbucks right into the Macy's without going back out to the street.

Incredibly rude and out of the few times I've been there my order is almost always made wrong. They gave me a smoked butterscotch frappe instead of a caramel which was fine. But upon asking for it to be remade they looked at me like I was speaking in a different language. Then the drink that they remade for me tasted even worse than before. And that was my last time EVER visiting this location.

Place won't give change to a paying customer. Ridiculous, and the coffee is garbage. 

I bought 6 drinks here with the family, after finishing I went back up to the counter and asked them to break a 20 and was told they wouldn't break a $20. I rarely complain about a place, but this place is terrible.

After speaking to a manager and reminding them I paid for 6 drinks they gave me change. I will increase my rating by 1 star.

Well this is the only Starbucks so far where I receive my Ice Coffee with cream unstirred or shaken....boo! I truly pay a lot for an ice coffee that i have to stir - might as well make at home:( The baristas not too friendly and not too helpful either. Still a Starbucks and the coffee is delish. Just not my favorite location.

This Starbucks has probably one of the rudest barista's ever. Slamming the oven, throwing our food down. I get that it's early but if you hate your job change it.  Three stars because the coffee is good.

My name is Tara and I am a Starbucks addict... its my one corporate crutch...
Also I am a NYer (Brooklynite actually) so I am used to a get in - order - get the h out kind of pace at Starbucks. This was a pleasant change of pace. The girls were so sweet and made my drink perfect (unlike some NY store that do not comprehend "very little ice"). They even held onto my umbrella for me when I left it behind.
I am a fan of their Chai Tea Latte. They have friendly staff and they are pretty good at handling huge lines. I love their croissant - warm!! The store is pretty big with enough seating area.
Music is horrendous today, but the new chairs and tables are nice. Cheese Danish hit the spot.

I love Starbucks in general, but I particularly like this one.  Mel is knowledgeable about products and externally helpful.  She is a pleasure! 

My only complaint is the small parking lot and narrow drive thru, but it doesn't stop us from going there.

This Starbucks is always terrible. Me and my girlfriend just moved to Franklin two months ago, ever since then, we have had nothing but bad experiences at this location. They are always out of an ingredient needed to make a drink, or they are just not carrying it completely. This location also makes drinks wrong constantly, and give us wrong orders as well. We now drive to the location off of cool springs blvd just to not have to deal with this Starbucks anymore.

With an entrance that shares the lobby of the Hilton Hotel, this is still a completely proper Starbucks with all the usual accoutrements including an independent wifi signal and Starbucks coffees and snacks.

Plenty of seating with tables, a sofa, comfy chairs arranged to face each other and lots of power outlets along the wall.

I just had a single espresso in order to justify the taking up of a table and sitting here for an hour while waiting for the library to open. But it's still a nice Starbucks!

To be fair, I did work at this location.
Kristina (who still manages it) is a GREAT manager, she was always fair and cared about her customers, her staff, and the community.  This Starbucks is also in a great locatios - we got regular nurses and doctors from St. Marys, lawyers with down town offices, transients from the near buy Greyhound Station, and college kids.  It's amazing people watching, and as mentioned in a previous review - the patio is great.
I find that baristas seem to stay for a long time here, so they know what they are doing.  Also, because this Starbucks doesn't have a drive through, they will make time to get a drink right if they mess it up.  
Busiest hours are 6am-9:30am.

The good:
It's right near campus so I was expecting a little bit of a wait. They handled 15 customers in less than 10 minutes which was terrific :)
The bad:
I ordered the breakfast sandwhiches with bacon and it unfortunately was cold in the middle :(
I would expect such a large chain to have things figured out with regards to heating times. What's more disappointing is that it's not the 1st time but rather the 3rd :/

Starbucks is one of my satellite offices when my basement home office is overrun by little people, dogs, or the occasional flood.  I always worried I will run into a horde of valley girls at Starbucks, and I'm sure there are times of the day when that is the case, but between 8am and 5pm during the week, there are rarely more than one or two of these offenders.  In fact, you are more likely to find an overzealous evangelical preacher making his case to a skeptical friend or a troubled housewife than a gaggle of mindless Belieber types.

Generally, this Starbucks is quiet, the internet is adequate, and the drinks and service are commensurate with what you've experienced in Hendersonville or Franklin.  That is, generally dispassionate servers and good, expensive coffee.
Good location and fast friendly service.  Line can get long as people leave for meetings from the Hyatt.

It was after lunch and my friend and I needed a "pick me up".  We decided on a coffee from the experts at Starbucks.  The store was actually fairly busy for 1:30pm but we were helped right away.  I had the Pikes Place regular coffee with room for cream.  My friend had the peppermint white mocha in decaf.  The store is very clean and so was the bathroom.  The customer service here is very good and the employees are very professional.  My favorite drink at Starbucks is their Egg Nog latte but I only felt like a cup of plain coffee this visit.  Too much caffeine will keep me awake later.

Rude staff.  Took forever to get our order, guy in front of us had to ask twice to get his order. Our caramel fraps didn't get the caramel drizzle. Waitstaff was obnoxiously flirting with a client with kids in the store. And it looked dirty!

Yay, a Starbucks at the Convention Center.  There were 2 conventions going on and the line was at least 10 mins. Fortunately, the staff was organized and had someone down the line to get orders ahead.  When it looked like they ran out o f croissant, she told me they had more and pulled them out, $3.  My latte was more reasonably priced than at other SBs, $2.75, the Pike Place coffee was $2.25.  The only delay was something wrong with their swipe mode at the register and it wouldn't deduct from my SB gold card so they had to type in the acct number.

I hate to write this but this particular Starbucks is poorly ran or managed. They seem to be very under staffed and when it becomes clearly overwhelming for the workers, the manager simply carries on stocking supplies or putting up advertisements without a care in the world. I do not blame the barista or cashier, you can only do so much without support. They either need to hire more staff or the mgr needs to step up and assist every once in a while.

Terrible customer service at the Drive thru! I'm gestational diabetic and have to order a drink that is "odd" I'm sure, however a barista being condescending and rude while I'm placing my order is not appropriate. I order this drink frequently at other locations and have never been questioned or "cut off" while placing my order. Luckily this is no longer the closest Starbucks to my home or work! I will definitely visit Starbucks again, but not this location!

A bigger, roomier inside and outside Starbucks. Typical Starbucks coffee and a nice presentation case of the food options. Varied seatings. The outside covered and uncovered areas were tempting but too cold for long in October but must be nice. They could use more mopping of the floors, and fly control. I saw the same man soundly asleep for hours two out of the three days I went?

this one i located inside DMAFB at the BX so it's convenient for our military and their family who needs their coffee fix. It can be crowded at times and service can be on a slow side. But so far they only messed up my order once. I ordered my son's fave (java chip frap) which is not that hard to make. But we waited for at least 15 mins for our order and it never came! The people behind us got their orders quick. I went in the counter and told them about my order. The girl behind the register talked to the barista and told us they would make our drink and did not apologize for their mistakes!. Anywho, the only time we go to this place anyway, is when we shop on base and my son or hubby craves for it. Other than that we go to a different location where they pay close attention to their customers orders.

This place used to be one of my favorite starbucks, but ever since the one owner/manager lady left and different one took over it has gone to crud. While it's not the fault of starbucks, it seems there are always the stupidest people in here who clog up the line and take forever to order and pay. The coffee tastes like crud lately and they often don't have coffee ready to serve...which is ridiculous for a coffee shop. They clean their ovens with lots of chemicals so I'm afraid to get anything baked, yet there are often liquid spills all over the counters and floors. The staff is way worse than others I've gone to. You're much better going down the road in either direction as  there are much better starbucks along broadway.
Worst Starbucks ever. There is always the longest line and 1 ringer and 1 barista. I've never waited less than 15 mins for my drink. If you know you're a busy store staff accordingly. Awful.

Beware.... I went to two Starbucks today and both times my cup collapsed spilling coffees all over and the second time burning my hand. I'm not sure if the went to cheaper cups but make sure you ask for double cups. Hard to believe this was a coincidence as I usually get at least 3 cup a day from Starbucks. It will be interesting to see if this happened to anyone else ?

This is one of the easier locations to get to except during morning hours. Go after 1030am. The drinks still do not come out consistent. I came here for 3 days straight and ordered the same green tea frap.. all tasted different.

I don't love this location.  I often get the wrong order, and the drive through can be slow, and one of the people working it lately is extremely chatty.   I think the coffee tastes better at other locations.  However, I've had two really good experiences ordering bulk brewed coffee (travelers) for events. Both times, the same woman filled my orders and the service there was top notch.

I stopped in the day after that snow storm because this was the only Starbucks open. Martha took great care of me. She was super friendly and had a great personality and we chatted about her friend whom I Kno at another Starbucks. I again returned the next night and I had Allison take care of me. She was also  super sweet and friendly. She was very tentative to my needs. Both made my drink perfect! Thanks  Ladies for all your hard work and keep it up!!!!

At 6:30 PM the happy juices aren't flowing as freely as earlier stated in another review. You need to pay attention to the order when they read it back. I had to fix their interpretation of my order thee times.

Brand new staff for a brand new store - I was extremely disappointed with the service.  It took about 5 minutes to reload my Gold Card and buy two drinks...then another few to make them.  There went my 10 minute afternoon break....their business would be better served with knowledgeable baristas and shift managers.
Nice location and comfy inside with plenty of seating. I had an a relaxing tine enjoying my coffee before my movie started nearby

Probably one of the worse experiences I've had with a Starbucks. Went there around opening for a quick breakfast. Had a long drive to Chicago. 

Ordered iced coffee and got a regular coffee. Ordered an egg cheese and sausage sandwich and got only bread and cheese. Didn't realize it until I was already on the road.

There were over 5 workers and they all seemed lost. Place was otherwise clean.

Spacious, clean Starbucks located next to St. Joe's. Baristas were friendly but a little inefficient. 2-3 people in line and 10 minutes to get my drink. Hate to see what would happen if the line really started to back up. Not sure how long this store has been around, but it seems pretty new. Strange hours as it closed at 5 on the day that I visited. Let's not stay open too late now; we might pull in too many college kids in need of a study break.

From out of town and stopped in for a coffee. The barista Sydney, I believe, at the cashier did not greet us even when my five year old nephew said hello. He just annoyingly smiled at my nephew. Then for some odd reason the jerk off kept staring at me like I killed his first born. Wtf? He was very close to me snapping on him. Not to mention I'm pretty sure he put regular milk in my coffee instead of soy even though I made sure to ask when I didn't see the soy container on the counter. My stomach is all types of tore up. What an a-hole.

I'll say it: I love Starbucks. I always order the same thing, and it always tastes the exact same, no matter what city or what Starbucks I'm in. I even get excited when they release their Christmas cups. Yes, I'm one of *those* people.

I visited this location because I had an appointment nearby earlier that day. The location within the shopping center is a bit difficult to get in and out of- but that mostly has to do with poor parking lot design and inattentive drivers. The staff working were very friendly and conversational, and offered everybody in line free samples of one of their newer drinks. My drink was finished quickly and correctly, and I got in and out in just a few minutes. They had a decent number of tables and the place was fairly quiet- I could see being able to have a meeting or get some work done at this location. They also offered the normal Starbucks food and gift fare- nothing different from any other locations. Overall, a decent location for people looking for a caffeine fix!

I typically am not inclined to write a review for a Starbucks I go into once, but I felt inclined to write one for this location for several reasons. Lots of younger people working and they were exceedingly polite, greeting each customer, not rushing, yet still kept things moving and hustling to get drinks and orders to the lots of waiting customers. I was very impressed with how they worked together to take care of everyone quickly and our drinks were made well. Nice job ladies!

Four stars for being a Starbucks with a drive-thru, but minus one star for being a pain to enter/exit. This location is right near a roundabout, and there isn't a clear way to enter, so I ended up driving a block past it and circling around. Once you go through the drive-thru and exit, then THAT'S when you finally see where the entrance is. FYI: The entrance is off of Keystone.

If you want to know where most of the 20 somethings in Town n' Country hang out - that aren't gang related, on a Monday night? I can tell you. They've brought their lap tops down to Star Bucks and are hanging out here near the movie theater. 

The coffee was coffee, it wasn't any different than any of the other Starbucks I've been to. The chai was good, the service was quick since our order wasn't complicated. The conversation with my friend was really what I went for.
This starbucks is close to work. They seem to be pretty fast and rarely mess up my order. They don't like to give napkins in the drive through.

This is my favorite SB in town. It's roomier and cozier than the others. And IMHO, much friendlier too! When I want quiet time to work or zone out, it's just what I need. But when I stop in for a pick me up and I'm open to chatting there's always an SB regular hanging out. 

The drive-thru is easy. Definitely not as crazy as the greentree/egg-harbor location. 

It's a cozy little spot. Stop in!

Hardly in the Starbucks tradition of great service, great coffee, great surrounding. As personal an experience as a cow at a Texas stockyard. No towels in the restroom, the floor hasn't been swept in sometime, no place to sit. :( no place to park. Out of sandwiches. Go elsewhere.. And I'm a huge starbucks fan..
The rumor is that this Starbucks is the busiest in all of Tennessee. I believe it. Every time I come here it's extremely crowded. It is a great location, but come with time to wait.
Drive-thru wait time a little longer than should be expected. Walk-in much quicker. Service is great, though! Nice people.

This was the first time I've ever seen a Starbucks connected to a gas station. I kept that in mind when we went in. The staff were friendly and the pastry case was full of a variety of treats. (Several Starbucks branches I go to regularly are not nearly as stocked as this one was.) The restrooms had paper towels everywhere and the front of the house was in a little bit of disarray.

Customer service... Great
Cleanliness... Great
Product... I paid for ice. My total came to 3.95 and my drink was 90% ice. First time at this Starbucks and completely disappointed in the quality of the drink.
It's a Starbucks. With ample seating. And a friendly staff. What is not to love? The coffee is ten times better than PJ's "coffee".

This is a nice Starbucks right in the middle of town. They should serve the reserves like some of the other Starbucks provide. The place is usually a mess. The employees are usually be personable. Public restroom for the "all day shopper" who needs to use one, but be prepared to wait in line.
A pretty standard Starbucks.  I've been here a few times and it's always been busy (which makes sense given it's location on Magazine).

During the holiday's I am a sucker for their pumpkin spice latte's. This location is good! It is close to my fav nail salon, so I frequent it often. I will be back! It's clean and the service is fast!

This Starbucks inside of Safeway is quick, friendly, and has quite a bit of seating even though it's inside a grocery store. The seating is one long half booth/half chair seating, but a huge group of women seemed to be having a great time when we were there. 

It was very convenient for the day we were having. We only had to make one stop on our way to a picnic. I got my frappuccino as well as a fruit tray and veggie tray all in one location.

My favorite drink was done just right and the baristas there were really pleasant.
Great location with comfortable outdoor seating right off the interstate. A recommended stop if traveling I-74. Stop here before you drive into the Indy metro area if you are heading east.

Great little Starbucks in St. Pete. The location has minimal seating and the parking lot is a bit small but it makes it a minimal sitting/loitering location which I prefer. Will definitely come back when I am in the area.

This was my regular weekday Starbucks for 6 years.  Weekends found me at various others, and I never figured out why but my chai lattes here were never as tasty as elsewhere.  Even ordered with no water, they tasted diluted and mildly bitter.

But that's being picky.  They were still good, and the staff are consistent and friendly.

Everyone is very friendly, but this is by far the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. They make the drinks well but there's always a line even when it's not very busy. The waiting space gets very awkward when you have 10 people waiting for their drinks. I will continue to come since this is my neighborhood location but now using the mobile ordering option only. The speed and efficiency of this location should definitely be addressed.
Always clean and comfortable. Friendly staff. Hot coffee. (Unless you like it iced, like me!)
Favorite Starbucks location.  Consistently have good drinks and food.  Staff is always friendly.  Modern atmosphere.  We come here every week, at least.

This Starbucks has a first rate crew of baristas. Great Starbucks products delivered with a smile. I go out of my way to visit here.  I particularly like the tub chairs for comfort.  This store also has a consistent clientele of pleasant people. The Drive Thru often has a long line but very efficiently served.

Got here today. And they didn't have napkins. I understand sometimes things run out before next shipment arrive but management you can still buy general napkins next door at supermarket just so your customer don't have to leave with oily fingers

The baristas are the friendliest I've ever met nationwide. They are always patient, welcoming, and helpful. I'm a writer and I feed off the energy of a particular room. The vibe is always good at this Starbucks. My daughter loves it too.

The service was horrible and one of the employees I think her name was Amy refused to take our order was extremely disrespectful to my children and was disrespectful to me the prices were high & I will definitely not come back here again it took 10 minutes to take our order and we were first in line

This is a problem I do like Starbucks and if I want to get something quick I can always go there. But this is like the fourth or fifth time already going to the Starbucks in Franklin and they never have what I want they always tell me when I'm ready to pay after waiting five minutes or more then that. I'm sorry we are out of this or that. I mean come on when you were taking my order you should say hey sorry we don't have this do you want to get something else. I mean it's easy to say yeah is this much and I know Starbuck it's not cheap. That's why I'm paying for what I want before you  finish get my order make sure that what I'm ordering is on there don't make me wait and then tell me you don't have any of it.

The worst. I ordered my salted caramel mocha without regular chocolate syrup ( which is awful tasting)  and subbed white chocolate....which was printed right on the label pasted to my cup. Of course they put regular chocolate and it was disgusting. I was already too far to return it so a total waste of 6 dollars. Won't be back.
This is a place where you get your coffee and leave. Sketchy people hang out there often and the chairs inside are very uncomfortable. Not a great place for a conversation in my opinion.

The Starbucks experience used to be a unique and memorable occasion compared to other beverage purveyors. The experience would suggest comfort, productivity, inclusion, & community. 

With the rise of the "buy local" campaign and the "social consumer" Starbucks had begun to lose its draw. Drive through experiences are rushed. Relationships with baristas are hard to establish due to the "efficiency" of the order and delivery process. Ideas and happening seem to have found a new home in our culture.

This store does little to help with the ordering experience. Cattle herding is more descriptive of the current experience. However, the fireplace inclusion & outdoor cove seating hold on to the ideals that this company used to stand for.

So I have never jumped in on the Starbucks hype. But I have given it a try several times. The coffee really is mediocre and the service is the worst. I takes way too long to get a cup of coffee. The employees are friendly but seem to have little patience. The quality of the coffee and service are not worth the price or the hassle.

This review is less about the place - Starbucks is Starbucks and they make great coffee - and more about the staff.  I'm a regular at this place and the people who work here keep me coming back.  They remember who you are, what you drink, even my crazy custom breakfast order, and are so friendly, even when it is busy.   This place is lucky to have Steve, Jay, and Debbie.
This is probably the best Starbucks if you're going to sit inside for awhile. Great employees who are very personable and knowledgeable.

This location is the most quaint of spots, absolutely everything you would want from a coffee shop hidden in a cozy area. My service here is almost always taken care f in a timely fashion and is much less busy than the Other Starbucks on campus! Baristas here as super friendly too! Not a terrible amount of room inside considering it's near a college but still adequate for studying!

It was 2 pm and I waited 20 minutes for a coffee and was late back from my break .  CLEARLY UNDERSTAFFED, which equals poor service and unclean areas. The parking lot is about impossible, with the drive-thru blocking the diner's spaces.  Since this is an obvious issue, one would think to prioritize a solution- which tells me the management doesn't care, is non-motivated, and assumes the establishment makes enough profits as is.

Awesome service, other than our drink longer than we expected (order mix up), and the barista was so apologetic and tried to make it up to us with a gift card for a beverage... It was nice and thoughtful.
Great place to study. Opens super early at 6 am! Their service is great and they have a big table perfect for studying with plenty of outlets underneath their big long table.

Stopped by this Starbucks because I was in the neighborhood shopping and needed some Starbucks. It's an average size Starbucks with indoor and outdoor seating. Outdoor seating was a plus since it was a nice day today. The staff were friendly and welcoming. 

I must say my drink wasn't the best Starbucks I've ever had though; it was below average. They were out of the mango black tea lemonade as well as peach green tea lemonade, which was a bummer because that's what I really wanted. The cashier did inform me that those flavors were a seasonal thing so I was cool with it. I ordered raspberry green tea lemonade instead. Not the taste I was looking for. Honestly  the barista tried her best to accommodate me, it just didn't work. I usually like raspberry but thus drink was not good at all. I don't think the barista put all the right ingredients, but I didn't complain, I just took my drink and left. 

Overall I like the store and I will go back if in the area. I would recommend if what you're looking for is not in the menu, just order something that is instead of getting the barista to make you a custom order.

Good location. I have only been here once but everything was in order. The place was clean and the staff was friendly and quick. They didn't get my order wrong even though I said it quite quickly. 

But my friend said that they forgot his shot of hazelnut =( 

Overall, I had a great experience at this location.

The worst service I've ever gotten at a Starbucks. Some of the employees are downright rude. Considering how hard it is to find parking, if you really want Starbucks go to another town. Or cross the bridge to Lambertville and get coffee at one of the three great local cafes there.

Tried this place today while helping a move, was shocked when I came in and I saw about 6 employees behind a somewhat small counter. I got a few espressos to go and it was fast and well done. I asked about the about the staff and they mentioned they needed right before I arrived. I always appreciate a well run store and this place looked super dialed, so BIG UPS!

Although it sounds like a cliche, it really is nice to go to a place where people know your name.  I only use the drive thru and I love the service almost all the time.  Most employees are fine, Jeannie and Vickie plus Will are super deluxe. These three faves need  a raise!
This Starbucks is always SO slow! It's completely absurd. I've waited 20+ minuets for a coffee that I ordered on the mobile app 10 minuets before I even walked into the store.

Coming from the Northeast, I can't believe there are so few Starbucks locations in Nola! I believe there's only two!

This one on Magazine has a great parking lot. Plus, there are so many plush comfy seats, tables for working, and they always make my drink just right.

We went here on a Wednesday afternoon to get some work done.  The wifi was about the best I've found anywhere, and I spend a lot of time working from coffee shops.  The music was great (the smiths, talking heads, lykke li, nina simone, ...), the building is unique and interesting, and power sockets were easy to locate.

It is a Starbucks, so you know what to expect with the coffee and food selection.  It is the same as other Starbucks.

I can always find a Starbucks, even when I am out of town.  That's thanks to the Starbucks app, but I like this location because of the drive thru and open space.  The baristas were great.  I went in with a really complicated order of four drink and a few breakfast items.  They had everything together in a few minutes.  It was Thanksgiving day so I was glad that they were in a good mood.  They probably didn't want to be there all day.  As usual, my espresso over ice was great!  Definitely be back to this location when I visit Reno.

I am in no way a coffee snob. I must have  a skim, double whipped, mocha grade with French vanilla, chocolate,  decaf smooth cappuccino.  LOL, KIDDING! 
Seriously I am only an occasional coffee drinker, in the cooler months and a tea lover, so I don't frequent coffee shops. 
On the occasion that I do want a nice cappuccino & it is too early for brandy or whiskey in it, I will stop & indulge my craving. 
At heart the very concept of Starbucks, makes me want to scream & run into hiding. For convenience sake I buck up and get my drink to go. I hate myself for paying what I consider to be exorbitant prices for a fancy named cup of Joe. I get it to go, because the interiors are sterile & full of people that act like they are busy & don't want to be seen ( even though that is probably their primary reason to be there).
Ok, you've gathered I am not a big fan of this enormous beanery. What I must cop to, is that every drink I order from them is very good and always hits the spot.( damn them). Yes, I must admit, I will return.
What's a girl to do?  A craving is a craving & sometimes you must give in to them.

I stop in here almost everyday for a coffee before I go to work. This is a place where the people are friendly, both employees and customers and where I can quietly work on my laptop. I'm a struggling writer and for reasons I don't really know, I can't write at home, but for some reason the hustle and bustle of people coming and going here gets my creative juices flowing.

I didn't drink coffee; didn't even care to know what it was. 

But it was during my years as an undergraduate years at the UA that I learned to love coffee. I had come accustomed to taking No Doze with water, helping me to pull extra study hours. But the No Doze began to fail. At the same time, I began studying at this very Starbucks. This was sometime around 1998 or 1999. At the time I was attracted to Frappucinos. Soon, that desire for Frappucinos evolve into a love for espresso. 

There are Starbucks cafes located the world around, but this one will always have a special place in my psyche. I began drinking coffee here, and I continue drinking coffee here. It is not the best espresso I have had in life -- not even close -- but it is consistent. 

I also love this location because the baristas are, for the most part, very committed to their customer service. And the fireplace is pretty sweet, along with the back room that was made for studying. 

And when you are in, be sure to try the bacon, Gouda and egg sandwich! YUMMM-AY!
The staff at this Hermitage location are so friendly!!  Yummy peppermint mochas are back.

Feel like I'm in a homeless shelter.  Was quite disruptive to hear someone mumbling and see him staring at me. There was another homeless man too although not disturbing anyone. Staff does not clean up after people leaving tables dirty.

Ok, admittedly I'm not a huge fan of Starbucks and initially I only came in to use their WiFi...but the staff is really what won me over. Everyone that works there is super nice and if you come in regularly they make an effort to learn your name get to know you a little bit, which i like. They play good music too. And their passion iced tea is delicious. Hi Mrs. Deb!!!

There was one time they didn't forget me or screw up my order, so that's why they aren't getting one star. The staff is nice, at least, so that's why they get three. But seriously, get coffee from somewhere else if you want what you ordered and in a timely manner.

This Starbucks doesn't have a drive through like some of the newer ones in the area but it does have an awesome sit in area to work on stuff with wifi and lots and lots of seating.  10+ tables, a window bar, couch, and a seating area with 6 or so comfy chairs. The staff is awesome too!

Awesome
Starbucks location, great staff and friendly place to get a coffee and hang out. Great new Starbucks location, check it out.

I'd leave it no stars if I could. This place is the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. And everytime I try to give them another shot it's just as disappointing as the last. This time I'm done. They are lazy, racist, and don't want to do their jobs and the manager has no managerial skills whatsoever. Someone needs to train her (Mari) on how to run a business. When you get a complaint about an employee who blatantly refuses to service someone waiting in the drive through- who's already paid and my drink was already made sitting there for over ten minutes while the employee chose NOT to acknowledge someone was at the window, she chose NOT to simply open the window smile and hand me my drink... i had to Knock on the door when i saw her walk away for the second time, and still nobody wanted to provide services or an answer... when my husband has to get out of the car in the drive-through to walk into the store to make them give me my drink, there's a problem that needs to be dealt with, apologies need to be made and the situation needed to be rectified. But the "manager" Mari could only roll her eyes and laugh as if she was tired of hearing complaints all day about how terrible they were. Probably because they get lots of complaints or something. She was more than happy to refund my money when I decided I no longer wanted to be a paying customer of theirs, I did not want the attitude that came with my cup of joe. She chose to lose a customer over making things right. Not only that, but she argued that she was not the one that was there, deflecting rather than facing issue about the other employee. That racists training Starbucks recently gave across the board, somehow dropped the ball on this location. I'll spend my $4000/year on something else.

It's a Starbucks, so if you've been to one before then you know pretty much what to expect. 

These guys get extra points from me for being extra attentive; I ordered an iced cappuccino latte with soy milk and when it was made with regular milk the barista at the drivethru window took one look at it and said "Oh no honey, this isn't right! Hold on a second while we fix this" and proceeded to have a whole new latte made for me with the correct milk. While I was waiting for my new/proper beverage she explained to me that the soy cappuccinos froth differently than those made with regular milk and mine didn't have that 'telltale whip'. 

So thumbs up for doing what it takes to get my order right. Even if it means wasting a perfectly good (if incorrectly blended) beverage.
The barista who took my order made snarky comments about another customer under his breath right in front of me. Not cool.

I have never been to a starbucks where we cant use the restroom .. went in there at 7.45 with my children to use the restroom. . Wouldnt let us use it because we did not make a purchase. .. really?..so if I give you a penny will you let me use it. .. we are obviously not asking for handouts..and have been dumping money into your overpriced coffees... for years!! And you wont let me use the restroom????
Venti White Chocolate Mocha. Doppio Espresso. I effing love this place....mainly because they get me through those bell to bell days when I'm dragging ass....That is all.

I do not live in this area but frequent Starbucks stores at least 4-5 times a week so I have interacted with many different employees over the years and they have always been very positive. I can honestly say that I have never walked out of a Starbucks without placing an order until this time. I'm not sure that I can think of another time when I have been treated with such an attitude by someone. I asked a simple question and was responded to so rudely and the other employee standing there heard her and didn't seem to be phased. If you don't like people, get a desk job in a cubicle someplace. I won't be returning here.
This Starbucks is always fast, friendly and never too packed. The only part that stinks is the parking lot, but this is a great location by USF!

I really like this Starbucks. I can usually find parking pretty close by and I can't complain about the drive through because THERE ISN'T ONE! I usually get a drink, change in the bathroom for kickball, and then get on my merry way.
This location gets rocked constantly. Its close to Tulane so you can imagine the sheer volume this staff is handling.  They are always nice and so obviously good at thier job.
We LOVE THIS STARBUCKS!*!  Everyone is friendly and very very fast at concocting delicious drinks! :)  Try the vanilla bean creme ! YUM!

Ugh, the place is slow.  I am sorry.

Okay, most Starbucks seem to manage the rush in the mornings pretty well, but it's the mid-mornings and afternoon walk-ins they seem to have problems with handling.

This Starbucks is great in the mornings, but at other times there aren't enough Batista's to handle the order follow or cashier function.  I'm sure it's just scheduling, but they need to give it some thought.
They must put crack in the coffee cuz I can never get enough... I'm always coming back for coffee.. It's awesome KCCO!!!!

5 stars!   Today picked up coffee and breakfast for 2.  Super cashier and awesome fast barista provided me with perfection.  Hugs!


Plenty of seating and table space.
My coffee is always perfectly prepared and the staff is always very friendly. The drive thru is ridiculously slow though.

I come here almost every day on my way in to work and the staff is always so upbeat and friendly. I think that Starbucks coffee in general is consistent so I like having the go-to standards and I don't stray from my order very often to explore the menu. I will say that on the days I can't leave work for lunch the protein boxes are life savers for me. 
Drive through or inside- the drinks are great every time, the place is clean and the service is friendly.

Perfect customer service! Drive thru window had fun facts printed for you to read while you waited. The wait was super short even though they were busy. Great attention to detail and the customer experience!

If I had $30 a week that I wanted to spend on coffee then I would most like likely spend it at Starbucks. I've tried other chains and a few other private businesses and honestly Starbucks is the only place that gets it PERFECT every time. I never have to add anything else to it. Customer service is always quick and friendly and the coffee is always a perfect drinkable temperature immediately upon receipt. Most places you have to wait a few minutes for it to cool down. This particular location has a large, cool outdoor area perfect for lounging around and enjoying your beverage. I'm a fan.
I prefer the neighborhood coffee spots, but this Starbucks location is in a great area and makes great drinks. The new salted caramel latte was deliciously made - even as a skinny version.

This was my 3rd day coming to this Starbucks and ordered 2 venti double shot in ice with light ice. Mind you these drinks are not cheap and still $5 a drink. I finally questioned the barista as to why my venti is not even remotely filled to top. She said well you asked for light ice! So then why the hell am I paying for venti when I got a grande. She was not apologetic and acted like I had no right to question why still on the 3rd day of getting this drink I would be cheated. I am done with Starbucks you have become so cheap with your customer and then teach your baristas as to not even take responsibility. I will be going to the better business bureau because this is unacceptable

I don't like drive-thru starbucks; they are noisy, have a lot of extra commotion behind the counter; making it much more distracting if you are trying to do read, write, homework, think, relax, meet, etc. 

With that said, the energy is great at this location.  Hail to the management for hiring really well.  Everyone seems to enjoy each other, and are very service-oriented.

Parking gets very tight...it's a BUSY location.

Who doesn't love StarBucks? Seriously, nice place, particularly here in downtown West Chester, PA. Love the town. Love that my kid goes to school here. The energy from a small (albeit affluent) college town is invigorating. No, StarBucks isn't my personal favorite. Most any coffee house in Europe is! They do coffee justice 4,000 miles east of PA. Absent that, and the Northwest Coast of the USA, thank God for StarBucks. Tonight, Doppio Espresso in a nicely steamed demitasse ... eventually when lemon rinds are served with it too, it will be perfect:-)

Located on the intersection at Magazine and Washington is this great Starbucks location. Being on the intersection, there are plenty of parking options available through out your visit there. 

The line is always 10+ people long, no matter what time I go but they usually manage to go through it pretty quickly, which is nice. On my last visit, I wanted to try the Gingerbread Latte and I had a free birthday drink, so when I placed my order I requested both of those, the woman who took my order "okayed" it and along I went. I paid with a different guy who ended up charging me for the drink which was supposed to free, I explained that I told the other woman it was meant to be the free birthday special but he just laughed and said "you have to tell me, not her". Well, she's the one that took my order so she should've been the one to put me through the register too. So that was annoying, they just had no communication between the staff members and how he shrugged it off was irritating. 

Anyways, I got my Gingerbread Latte and took a seat. Now this place is always busy so don't expect your ideal seating if you come too late in the day. I ended up moving three times as new, more preferred places to sit became available. The downside to the seating is that there aren't many powerpoint available and Starbucks has to know that people come to work here while they drink their coffee. Not a clever move. 

The Gingerbread Latte was just okay. It didn't taste like gingerbread at all so I was pretty disappointed but I managed to finish it off despite the lack of taste. 

There is a wide variety of seating inside with wall seating, tabled seating, and a few couch seating, which is nice. There is also outdoor seating but during this weather, it isn't recommended but would give you views of the street which is a nice distraction from the hustle and bustle from inside. 

Overall, a beautiful location but the lack of communication and consideration the staff have between themselves and the customers made the visit spoiled.

I ordered 3 different food items and they were all out including the egg whites and tomato mozzarella panini. This Starbucks used to be on top of it all but I don't think I'll come to this location anymore.

Mt family stopped in for drinks on a long drive home from Palm Springs. It was ten minutes before closing and one of the employees was cleaning the bathroom. When I asked if I could use it she said no. After we got our drinks, I told the cashier that they really should have the restroom open during business hours. The manager jumped in and said it was just being cleaned (in a defensive attitude). I responded that they could wait 5 minutes until they are closed. He made sarcastic comments as we were leaving. I have been to Starbucks hundreds of times and I know this is not the way employees are trained and expected to treat customers. Poor customer service at this location.

I like to check into Starbucks to see what is going on with my coffee.  All Starbucks for the most part are the same, this one was just a little shop.  I would say it was nice, clean and the service was usual.  Boy, there is one on every corner!

This Starbucks is spacious and filled with comfortable chairs, tables and a large area to work on your laptop, read, or have a cup of coffee.  There are also plenty of tables and chairs outside.  
The problem is not with the Starbucks store, but the employees. They are subpar for Starbucks employees.  I have never had such bad customer service at a Starbucks. The Baristawass unfriendly and had zero people skills. Hewas not familiar with the the drinks and did not seem to care.  The other Barista who assisted me, was rude and quick with my order and she gave me cold coffee  .In addition, the area where you put milk and sugar etc in your coffee was not stocked.  The music was very loud and I could not concentrate on what I was working on at the time. I ended up leaving early.  It is a shame, as the store itself is very nice.  I usually receive excellent and friendly, fast service from Starbucks employees, so I was surprised by this service.
Quick. Good coffee. Reliable. Just as any Starbucks should be.

Caffeine right next to Macy's and my apartment- couldn't be better! Plenty of tables and outlets for doing work, friendly staff, strong coffee as always. Their condiments do run low sometimes, but I've never had a problem with wait time so far.
Was good before they hired a bunch of duds. I guess it's because of their lack of pay.

There are a lot Starbucks around the area and this location has the worst customer service I've experienced. I'm not expecting to be blown away because it is just Starbucks but I also want to be treated with a little bit of respect and maybe get a smile but I guess that's too much to ask for at this location. They also seem stubborn about giving the discounts from the Starbucks app this is the second time I've had a run in with the rewards on my Starbucks application.

Ok...starbucks is usually pretty dependable but I went here for my morning coffee and they were out of splenda! The lady next to me said that people take it, but surely they must know this and order extra...

I love me some Starbucks and the service here is top quality. The staff is great and the drive through is usually fast. Their attitudes are much better than the people in some of the other Starbucks. I feel great about going to this one so often.

They apparently changed their store hours but did not update their hours on yelp (and I'm assuming other social media/online sites). There's been multiple occasions now where either other customers or I were unaware of the store hour changes and were asked to leave earlier than expected when we purposely planned on staying at this Starbucks till whatever hours said online. I've overheard customers on multiple occasions (and myself included) asking the workers to update their store hours or notify someone whose in charge of it to do so, but it has been about a month maybe and they wont do anything about it. To say the least, its frustrating as hell, and I would think other people whose experienced this share the same sentiment. SO I uploaded the store hours since they won't. Stop inconveniencing your customers' schedule please, Starbucks...

Take a step back when approaching this historic landmark, first floor roastery, this isn't your regular strip mall 'Bucks.  This be-seen locale offers the perfect porch viewpoint to look down upon the feeble tourists that keep this colonial town afloat.  Not for the non-elitist, there's a Dunkin across the street for the peasants.  Enjoy your $4 cup'o'Joe in peace and quiet countryside nobles!  

Even with all its bells and whistles, it's still a Starbucks.  Just as upidty at the next.  It's in a perfect location for walking traffic.  Service is quick and polite. Make sure you find street parking to save some dough instead of the lot out back. Someone is getting rich off that.  Street parking is free before 9 or 10 am for the morning goers.  The historic building adds a nice touch and separates it from the other run-of-the-mill chains in the area.

I have been here a handful of times and 3 out of 5 drinks that I have gotten were made wrong. I say in the drive thru line and watched the lady read the label that said soy milk ,shake the container of soy and realize it was empty , grab the whole milk and pour it in and hand it to me! When I told her that it was supposed to be soy she was upset and asked me to move up and wait ! I moved up and waited and she brought my drink out to me and pushed it into my hand with so much force that the top came off and splashed on my hand and immediately turned around and walked back in! This drink was also made with whole milk ..... The day shift is horrible but the two times I have went at night have been great!!

I went to this particular Starbucks almost every Monday through Friday of summer 2005.  About 90% of the time their beverages were right on par with the Starbucks quality i've learned to know.

Occasionally, as with any Starbucks location, the espresso for the Cafe Americano tastes horrible.  I just ask for another, and they are always more than happy to make me a replacement.

I mainly gave this review four stars because its Starbucks coffee and not something better.  The store itself deserves a five.

Worst experience ever at a Starbucks. The drive-through line blocks all the exits. One barista to work on orders inside the store. I only ordered an iced green tea and it took over 20 minutes to get it.

Love this location! Easy to get in and out and always the nicest baristas! Their service is exquisite and they get to know their customers.  It's fun to see people called by name. 

The only thing better would be a drive thru! Definitely stop in and enjoy their relaxed atmosphere and friendly staff!!!
Probably the fastest service I have ever received at a Starbucks. The baristas were extra nice.

Fantastic service, friendly and fast despite the busy area. Additionally i used the app to order a drink and got stuck in traffic and arrived about an hour late, staff offered to make me a fresh drink, very considerate, thank you

If you're not a Starbucks fan, guess what? This one won't change your mind. In fact, I doubt any Starbucks anywhere/everywhere is going to change your mind. Hint - All Starbucks are pretty much the same on purpose. 
But if you are a Starbucks fan, this one is pretty solid. It's usually a little too cold, the parking lot is a few spaces too small and the inside dinning area is on the smaller side (about 7 two seat tables inside). But there's always plenty of open seats outside (drinking hot coffee outside in Florida - yeah, about 3 months of the year). The staff gets it done. Not the friendliest crew but I'm typically not too friendly in the morning when I get my cup too. It can get pretty busy here at peak hours and there's no drive-thru, so you'll have to get up and get out ya car! But it's always clean, I've never had a major service issue (but I don't get a triple soy latte with 10 packs of splenda - I'm pretty simple) and the wifi is strong (because not too many people camp out here).

Service and quality at this Starbucks are extremely uneven and clearly depend on the staff at any given time. Some baristas are very good at making great lattes and frapucinos.  Others do a slap-dash job.  They seem to be saving money by not filling cups in the drive-through line, by the way -- you might want to check before you drive away.

Nice staff, spacious, and reliable free wifi. Not freezing cold. Tables are clean; people actually go around and clean their tables unlike other coffee chains.

There aren't enough outlets though. The outlets they do have are very loose, and my charger falls out constantly.

I think there's a missing opportunity because they have tables and counters that can fit over 30 people but only like 6 outlets. A lot of businesses can use the outlets.

Yes, I'm passionate about the lack of outlets.

It's a decent Starbucks. The location is poor so it's always incredibly crowded and the wifi is slow sometimes do to heavy usage. I've been there many times over school, so I obviously don't mind it too much.
Best Starbucks in town. Great staff and great service.
There is no reason it should take a staff of 5 more than 5 minutes to pour an iced coffee. This location is consistently the worst in Philly.

I go here every morning before work and class, and am totally addicted!  The employees all know me by name and know what I drink.  They are super friendly, which is nice to start my morning with a friendly face.  The line is sometimes super long but I still think it's worth it.  They have excellent coffee and always tastes great!!

The baristas here are quick and knowledgable. However, the parking lot is a nightmare and far too small for the popularity of the location. I've never stayed sitting in this's location, so I cannot comment on the ambiance.

My service was fine but there's a pet store next to it causing the lobby to smell like dog. No one seemed to have a problem with the smell but I don't have a dog which made me nauseous to the smell. Again service was fine.

This is now my go-to Strarbucks and is nearest on my way to my new job.  It's a 4 star place but I am knocking a star off gfor the horrendous parking situation.  It is located next to the Paoli train station which is jam-packed night and day and clearly there is just not enough parking for ommuters and locals alike.

I parked in a seafood restaurant next door and walked over.

Meanwhile, my Grande Nonfat Caramel macchiato (at $4.82) was pricey but delicious.

Nice gals running the show.
I wonder where they park???

Excellent Service, Crappy Parking

My favorite place to be. And everyone makes things to order correctly, and even offers you other options for flavors. I love it here! My usual...Hot Tall White Mocha Decaf...Stirred lol. Sometimes two pumps of white mocha, sometimes 3.
One of my favorite Starbucks in the city. Employees are always nice and fast with drinks. If the drinks aren't good they will remake and give gift card.

Never fails..disappointed Everytime but yet I come back to give them a chance... And YES got disappointed AGAIN 
Ordered the new Berry prickly pear frap.. Looks nothing like the the pic. Its a venti full of vanilla bean frap and a couple spoonful of berries...

Love this location for its convenience, outdoor patio (dog friendly and doesn't face busy Broadway traffic), and fun and friendly staff. A consistently good experience every time I go. I have never used the drive-thru...always go in.

Starbucks is great. I love starbucks. Never had a problem. HOWEVER, I have been ordering the same drink for months, and today was the first day I had a negative comment from one of the baristas. (I usually order a grande cafe americano with three pumps of sugar-free caramel syrup, three packs of Splenda and double-blended with ice. The drink foams up so much it needs to be out into a venti cup, it's all the satisfaction of a frappuccino but with only 15 calories rather than 500.) Then Sarah, the barista, rudely asked me if I had ever had a coffee frappe before, to which I said yes, and she was like "well they're awfully close to being the same thing" YES, I'm AWARE it's almost the SAME THING. ITS ALSO 500 CALORIES AND I KNOW WHAT I ORDERED, SARAH.
Slowest Starbucks in St Louis.  Have no idea how to process customers.    Don't come here unless you have time to kill.   This is the worse.

Food: 4 Stars
Service: 5 Stars

This new Starbucks at the corner of Olive and N. Woodsmill is not only conveniently located, but it's FAST! (Zippidy Doo-Dah!)

The number 1 thing I look for when there's a drive-thru is SPEED. How quickly can you place your order and have it made/ready for you at the next window? Most Starbucks take around 5 minutes, with the longest I've ever waited taking 17 minutes. YES. 17 Minutes in a DRIVE-THRU. :|   We received our drinks immediately after we paid. Super fast, and super friendly!

The Starbucks at this location does have a walk-up window as well and a small dining area outside, but does not allow for customers to come in. For people like me who are often on the go, this is perfect!

My favorite drinks: Chai Tea Latte & Vanilla Bean Frappuccinos!

Service with a smile!

Went through the drive thru because my dog was with me in the car. The line went quickly and they made my drink perfectly. I ordered a puppaccino for my dog (whipped cream in a cup) and they served it with two little dog treats on top. He was so happy!!

If you're looking for a great coffee alternative try an iced green tea latte with coconut milk. It's like a dessert in a cup without all the guilt.

Perhaps it was just a bad day. 

My drink order was wrong. I had to send it back. It happens. Never mind that I was seeing complicated frappucinos being served to people who came after me in line before I even got my wrong drink order. But that's one thing. 

I guess you would think I ordered something off the wall. 

My order... A large half decaf regular coffee. 

You see, they make you wait until they make the complicated drinks for everyone else, and then they took care of my simple coffee. And when I asked if it was half decaf since they didn't state it, the barista admitted it wasn't and offered to make another, but not before they had to complete one more complicated latte that came after me. 

Maybe it was just a bad day. But they reminded me why it's better to go to Dunkin Donuts or Wawa if you just want the brewed coffee.

Oven not working for the little lunch pizza squares, no apples or bananas, crowded but half the floor full of delivery boxes blocking the inside line, nearly empty pastry case, one harried barista at the inside register. Will try again another day!
Worst Starbucks ever! Why have an online app and promote if they don't have it in the store! Waited 30 minutes for nothing! Horrible customer service!
I love my morning crew here. It's a Starbucks, so for better or for worse you know what you're getting. It's the people that kick it to that fourth star.

Friendliest staff, especially Joanna and Jenny. They were so nice and patient when I had my two year old daughter in there earlier this week. We sat at the bar and watched them work while we enjoyed our drinks. Nice and clean store.

Quick service, must be the time of day usually they a little slower. Quiet atmosphere to work on my studies. The people here ( employees and customers ) are really friendly. This is becoming one of my favorite hang outs.

I get my morning coffee (more times than I would like to admit) every week from this location. The drinks are always well made (compared to the Campbell location-yuck).  I have no experience with the bathrooms because I am trying to get my coffee and go but the service is always friendly and extremely fast for the volume they have. Parking may be an issue but they do have a few 15 minute street spots out front for free that I never see people having an issue getting.

Coffee is good.... Place is comfortable, but loud and wifi is slow.

Service is excellent.

I've been coming to this Starbucks since they first opened. I have had both good and bad experiences, albeit mostly good. I've often heard this is one of the busiest stores by volume in the country due to the very busy drive-thru. That being said it typically takes at least 15 minutes to get your drink of choice unless you show up at an off time. 

About a year ago they started offering the coffee pressed from their new Clover machines. Around the same time they remodeled the location. They increased seating, albeit at a cost. The comfy chairs are in shorter supply. This is primarily the reason I've deducted a star. 

The location needs to expand. Realistically they should have double the space with more comfortable chairs and at least another cash register. 

All in all this location is a quality Starbucks with good service in a great location.

I'm not sure if I could imagine a Starbucks that is more sterile.  One would be better off going to Dunkin donuts or McDonalds.  Sure, I'm not a fan of the coffee at Dunkin or McDonalds, but they both have better food (imagin that!) for a much better price..  Starbucks is nothing more than a corporate coffee shop with a shelf full of chinese products and coffee that is disguised as good through the addition of large amounts of sugar in the clients drinks.  This Brownsburg location has two soft chairs with the remainder of the decor designed to get the locals in and out of this retail location as fast as possible.  I certainly regret ordering coffee in a paper cup from this place.   The  staff though was certainly pleasant.  Please someone open a good coffee shop in Brownsburg and hire the Starbucks staff.

That's right...locals beware I am up-ing a star for a corporate MONSTER!!!

But for good reason. First off. I have a friend that works here. So it's nice that I can go and work and catch up with her when she has some down time. That's really the only reason I hit up this Starbucks. Anyway, now that I feel justified...I went in today wanting some tea, but the register was down. The cashier tried to fiddle with a bunch of things, pressed buttons galore, but nothing seemed to work. Rather than have me wait for a manager to come over, she politely gave me my tea, sent me on my way, and said it was on the house. I would have waited. I was so impressed and appreciative of that small gesture. Now it's time to pay it forward. 

Know Before You Go:

It's in a strip with a bunch of other things so the parking situation can be dicey. I don't mind parking across the way near Ross and walking, which is probably a good idea if you're planting a seat at Starbucks for hours on end.

This Starbucks is hit or miss when it comes to making drinks right. I go here often as it is the closest Starbucks and I always order the same thing for my wife and I, but two out of three times they tend to get the order wrong and completely botch the drinks entirely. It's especially terrible if you order by drive thru, and it's only slightly better if you order inside. On the plus side, the employees are always friendly and welcoming.

I find it unsettling to be denied the use of the restroom without making a purchase. I understand all the arguable points on both sides. Natalie was the associate. I get her commitment to upholding policy. This reflects on management in my humble opinion. I generally stick to positive reviews. You guys are not playing for good reviews anyway

Update, 6 months later: Okay, so I'm more than happy to give credit where credit is due and changed my 1 star Review to a 5 Star review. I don't know how or when but this is my fav Starbucks again! Staff are always super nice and my coffee has been amazing for the past 20+ trips. That's a pretty impressive streak. I love that they always offer my dog a pup cup (even though I don't take it because ever since something changed with the whip cream around the start of 2018, he won't eat it; anyway, I digress). They're always happy and fast, and once again reliable! Thank you 96th and Masters Baristas!
This is the location that I come to to buy VIA Decaf, that the Longley store never seems to stock. It's the only thing that I buy here but the staff is always friendly and helpful.

I like this Starbucks; as others have said it's true some of the barista's can be slightly slow moving. I've been here about 3 x's only, though so I may not be completely right about that. I think I've ordered frappacinnos, only, which I always thought were well made. 

There's a parking lot. That's a nice thing as street parking is metered. 

^off topic: there's a UPS & Zesto pizza in this retail fixture. I've been to the pizzeria only once but really liked it! Got 3 slices. Nice portion sizes! So much took third one home.

Arrived 30 minutes from closing. The Barista was cleaning up and preparing to close. BUT you wouldn't know it. He was polite and made the best coffees!!   He made my regular coffee fresh. It was the best Starbucks ever.  I have no idea what the name of the coffee was, but it was smooth with no bitter after taste. Although the last customers of the day, we were treated as the most valued. Thank you for your kindness.  And great coffees!!
Best most favorite coffee including coffee beans to purchase for home brewing  (unground of course!) We like their Pikes, Veranda (blonde) and Guatamala/Antigua.

This is a pretty alright Starbucks. It's very clean, the staff is very friendly, and it has plenty of seating for chilling out and drinking your go-juice. I agree with Tricia M. that the lack of hot foods and the lack of drive-thru make it less convenient than some other Starbucks locations. I'm not trying to knock Starbucks as a brand but, if I want to park & go inside somewhere for coffee & a muffin, there are a lot of great coffee shops all throughout Saint Louis that I can visit. The thing that makes me choose Starbucks when I do is the variety of food options and convenience of a drive-thru...and this place is 0 for 2 where that's concerned. 

Still, if you're looking for some bakery items, some consistently Starbucks-y drinks, and a place to chill for a bit, this is a good location.

I stay in Paoli 3 days a week on business.  This is the worst SB I have encountered. 3 out of the last 5 times I been here my simple, grande red eye, order seems to be forgotten and I have to remind the baristas after 4 people behind me in line have received their orders. This does not happen at any of the other locations I use on a daily basis. Coffee is also warm about half the time. Hope they can get it together.

The person at the register was great! But the person making the drinks today was paying more attention to the guy (she knew) that came in for a free drink! Messed up our order and wasn't very genuine with her apology. And to top it all off this young man was parked in a handicap spot without tags/sticker!! I usually like this place.

Typical Starbucks, coffee, small bites, wifi. Seating on the street.

Lavatories are locked, for patrons only.

They often prepared our beverages as they saw us walk up to the building. They deserve an extra star for *not* having a drive-thru, though it might have made our morning walk safer without the groggy SUV drivers fighting for parking.

Had a Starbucks craving this morning that I had to make a run to this location. I've always tried to go to the one by the house but I was running slightly late, had a couple of cakes for birthday girl at work to carry inside, not to mention all the badge swiping I have to do so I decided I'll pick up some coffee a little later. I also needed to get to work and do a few things to feel somewhat productive before my coffee run.

It was nice and quiet this morning with only one car in the drive-thru. The woman on the speaker (the same one who took my payment at the window) was very pleasant.  The other lady who gave me my drink, however, was not. She handed me my drink order, I asked for a stopper nicely and she gave me a look and handed me a stopper. I'm sorry but no one is allowed to eat or drink in my car and I don't want to spill coffee either.  She looked at me again after a while and had this look like "why aren't you moving?". I had ordered a spinach feta wrap as well and they had it in the oven still but she told me to have a nice day (no smile, just plain words) hoping I would go away. I told her I'm still waiting for my spinach feta wrap. She then turned to the other lady and then turned back to me and told me it's still in the oven and that it should be out in a minute. Kind of why I am still waiting but I just sat there and didn't say anything. She walked away and when my wrap was ready, the other lady handed it to me and she was way nicer! 

Overall, a pleasant experience but I could have done without the attitude.
What you'd expect from a SB. Lots of cars in drive through but inside counter was fast. Clean. Not very many tables.

New location! The Starbucks next to the Marathon gas station has built a new location right across the street. **The old location is now closed.**
I liked the openess of this new location. Plenty of places to park too. And with a new building comes a new look complete with neat decor and new options like the nitro brew. They have a really long counter and many tables and gathering spots. They even have a cute outdoor section with trendy lights and seating. It would be a good place to work (I noticed plenty of outlets) but may get a little noisy because of the high ceilings and if it's busy.
I love this store. JAYCEE is the best man she's the best.shes fast but the manager white guy with glasses. Be very rude and disrespectful

The aroma of fresh ground coffee + Christmas tunes = a very jolly Kiki. I can't wait!

Located right along side busy old york road with a wawa across from it.  More family oriented, but I usually am able to find a table with an outlet for my studious demands.  =P

Cozy, toasty and welcoming.  Free wifi and friendly staff.  Not too shabby, folks.

Parking is the only reason why this place doesn't have 5 stars. If  you're a new starbucker of this location, you'll get frustrated of the limited parking spots if you don't know how to nagivate the lot.
I really try to stay away from big businesses but no where in Tucson can I get a good up of coffee and good service at the same time, not like I can at a SBUX. Starbucks, I'm glad I can count on you.

The best Starbucks around for me.
Great staff , and very good food.
It's in a great location right in the bridge, bit cold this time of year to sit outside but when it warms up a great place to be

Friendly and efficient staff. I've enjoyed all my crafted drinks here. I'm always able to find a seat for me and my family. 

My last visit I tried the blonde roast. It was extremely bitter. My spouse's thanksgiving blend was much tastier. Go with that brew!

Great place and location.   Very convenient to take a break from driving, sit back relax and have snack. Unlike most Starbucks this one is very easy to get in and out of it while driving.  The only possible drawbacks is there hours.  I would like to see them stay open later.

Deserves zero stars. Some if you cant make the correct product on the label then you should close the store.  I go to starbucks infrequently one reason is their quality is generally low. Well they didnt disappoint this morning get to work with a incorrectly made drink. A caramel macchiato should have caramel in it this one had none not just a little it had zero of the first ingredient in the name of the drink.  Last time I was here same problem that was probably 9 months to a year ago.  Complain to starbucks they wont do anything and make you go back to the store.  Inconvenience me even more. This is a change in policy from before they used to take care of you over the phone.  The organization does t care about customers.  DO NOT GO TO THIS STORE UNLESS YOU WANT A TERRIBLE DRINK.

I went to the Starbucks on Olive in Creve Coeur to redeem my free birthday drink and had an excellent experience. Whereas the staff in other places have been less than friendly when I redeem birthday giveaways, the staff here were friendly, helpful, and wished me a happy birthday. Would definitely return for more coffee!

Good location but a little cramped. Outdoor patio and a few restuarants next door. Staff friendly and they did spell my name right. Problems still with customer service during the rush in the mornings.  Only 1 person at the register.  There are 2 registers here,  just saying !
The absolutely worse Starbucks experience that one can have.  It is actually a Starbucks franchise.  Wouldn't recommend it to my worse enemy.. or even to Donald Trump .

Luckily there are two Starbucks in Hermitage. I usually just buy  coffee but every now and then I will get splurge on something else. We like sitting outside on the patio esp during the cooler weather.

Snooty baristas. They don't carry blonde roast. Out of cinnamon and didn't even have other shaker options out. Long lines. Packed seats. It's really a shame because what's a better way to spend unnecessarily in Macy's than with a caffeine buzz.

I stop here a lot when I drive to Indy from Lafayette on college business. It's right off the interstate and attached to a gas station so you can take care of that too. I love my Starbucks and this is a good one, although after you get your coffee at the drive through you have to drive all the way around the back of the entire building. The entrance off of the road has changed. You can turn right off the road to get to the station/Starbucks, but it's a one way entrance. You have to drive down an access road to get to the light to eventually get back on the interstate, A minor inconvenience but a whole lot safer.
The line was out the door... We didn't even go in. They are always do busy and the wait is always slow...I guess they need to hire more people.
This starbucks is pretty dirty compared to most, it's kinda hot sometimes, and the music is a little loud if you're working, but with the new management I heard about I'm hoping things will improve.

Drove up to my favorite Starbucks this morning in the hopes of using my new Starbucks app which I'd downloaded onto my iPhone.  Just needed someone to show me how to use the app. I'd linked it to my PayPal but couldn't figure out how to charge using my app. The drive thru guy couldn't help and neither could any of the other workers in the store. They said they were clueless. Can you believe that? Suspicious. Dumb. Worthless.

I've never been an A1 fan of this location but it is conveniently located right off of highway 55 and at the tip of Carondelet park, so whether I'm on foot (jogging) or in transit via car; this subpar Starbucks is the closest within a 10 mile radius.

But I do not like the service; most (not all) of the barista's have zero personality, no people skills and lack tact.  

The straw today was when I asked for a Willow on Clover and the drive-thru guy replied, "what?" to my order.  I repeated myself sloooooowwwwwwly and he said, "oh no we don't have a Clover machine here.  I damn near pulled off but I didn't want to be rude; besides I'd already been in the waiting line for a few minutes and really wanted a cool drink.  I settled for an iced black coffee and vowed to never come back; no matter how convieniently located it is.

This Starbucks is in the Hilton at the Ballpark. It's small, but the staff is super fast and friendly. They have a great outdoor patio perfect for people watching or you can sit in the hotel lobby area and have your coffee.

Last two visits before work at 6:15am, out of bold coffee, first time had a half cup asked if I wanted top it off with pike, that's a no. Second time a batch of bold was 'bad', then I had to listen to banter between the person in charge and the employee dumping the bad coffee if she could save it for ice coffee later, finally getting back to me letting me know there was no bold and would I like to substitute, no. Let's worry about having coffee made and concentrate on customer service.

Not an actual Starbucks store. More of a half done store located inside of a hotel. Not all Starbucks offerings available. Parking is horrendous. You can however leave your car out front if you leave your keys with the valet. Good for a quick cup of Joe. 

Major thing lacking for me is the stores inability to grind coffee for a French Press. Too bad as this is the closest Starbucks to home. I have to buy elsewhere.

Staff is friendly and the service is good. Coffee itself is a 4 out of 5 stars when compared to other Starbucks locations.
Love this starbucks, always efficient and fast compared to others in the city. Very friendly. I go at least twice a week for the past 3 years since i moved to Kenner.
I ordered cappuccino, extra shot ... Tasted like bland coffee with too much milk. No good morning, smile, or thank you from barista or cashier. Glad its not my local store ... Big disappointment.

I love Starbucks but this location has not mastered the recipes for chai tea, green tea or the ginger ale.
