The locations in Gonzales, Houma, and even the nearby Barnes & Noble are a lot better. The lines would move faster if your total was given to you prior to approaching the drive thru window. Customer service is fine but the drinks need to improve.
Worst service I've seen. No toilet paper, no coffee lids. Took forever to get us our coffee and it's always filthy, not coming back. Ever.
Busy location, generally friendly staff, inadequate seating, could be much cleaner, a convenient location, but too small.

Worst Starbucks Ever!!! Drive-thru is a joke, wait 15 min for your drink and then get to window and its either made wrong, or wrong drink altogether, and today the employee at the window when I pulled up asked "Did you miss the speaker box as we don't have your order?" Are you kidding me??? Ha ha! Save the time wasted and drive the extra 10 minutes you will wait in the drive-thru here for high quality service at the Starbucks at 8870 Ulmerton Rd!

Standing at the Paoli Train Station at 6am waiting for my Amtrak train, this Starbucks is always a welcome sight.  Having a Starbucks next to a train station is always great.  The staff here are friendly and bathrooms are clean.  (Which is definitely more than I can say for the train station)

There is a good amount of seating in this location as well.  If you miss your train, a good place to grab a drink and kill some time.

If you've ever been to any Starbucks on earth then you know what to expect here. The coffee is consistent and satisfying (except that one bad mocha I got at the Starbucks in LaGuardia, but I don't like to talk about that...) 

The great thing about this location is the customer service, especially in the drive-thru. They're always so friendly it leaves me wondering if the constant smell of coffee and car fumes combine to make some kind of mood enhancer. 

I don't branch out much beyond my tall mocha (Ok, fine. Venti.) and the seasonal salted caramel latte, but they're always good enough to make me want to come back for more.

Madison B is certainly a sight to see. She rang me up as happy as can be. The way she whipped up my frapp was the bee's knees.  No better barista than she. That's my official decree. Come here you won't be disappointed guaranteed. 

Madison if you're reading this, my number is 215-237-8433

My daughter and I stopped at this location on our way out of town, I'm so glad we did. It's a comfortable atmosphere, there's no overwhelming loud soud of hipster music and the employees aren't pushy. They got our order right and was extremely efficient. Now let's talk about the restroom .... Very clean and gorgeous skylights!
Bad service , needs help understanding that at lunch customers come first then restock candy later

This is my favorite Starbucks. I go out of my way to come here because the employees are so great. This location also has plenty of parking, which seems to be a major issue with some of the other shops in the Tampa area.

Ms. Deb is the best !! My wife and I always get the greatest treatment when Ms. Deb is working. She remembers our orders and always has a cheerful word to say. 

Peace

I managed a Starbucks in Ca, way back in the early 2000's.  Their goal was to have 2,000 stores nationwide.   They now have over 20k stores in their repertoire.  Everyone knows what to expect when they enter.  You know the scene.  Wifi surrounded by coffee and tea, sandwiches and pastries.  Most SB strive to have a community feel and this one is no exception.   Located in the AMC Veterans movie plaza on Anderson Rd, this SB has outdoor seating as well as a convenient drive thru.

The baristas here are friendly and proficient.  My only beef (pun intended) is that they don't carry almond milk.  But in their defense, I was happy to find coconut milk as well as soy.  

They are open well before other neighborhood coffee shops.  Daily at 5AM, w/e at 6AM for you early Java nuts.  And they stay open to 11PM most nights and to the witching hour on Fri and Sat.   

So kids, keep on trucking over to your local Starbucks as I have stock and it continues to grow.

I felt like I was annoying the staff whenever I asked for anything. They didn't have any cream out so I asked for some and the girl just turned around to get some. Then I also had to ask for sugar and the guy was almost arguing with me that there should be some at the carousel. I had just checked and it seemed like he didn't believe me.

Starbucks is good. It is always reliable and I can get my iced late just right no matter where i am.  Some indie coffee shops can't pull an expresso shot to save their lives and this is something i do not have to worry about with Starbucks.

One of the better Starbucks locations. I walk there several times a week so my review is based on multiple visits...not a single incident as many reviews are. The staff are great...they work as a team and seem to enjoy being there. After a few regular visits I was surprised and pleased when my order was already in progress even before I placed it. Good Job Guys...keep it up!

I love that this Starbucks is on my way to work.  Whenever I go the Batista's are always friendly with a smile on their faces.  The line inside and the drive through always go quickly even in the morning when everyone seems to need that cup of delicious coffee.  This location is also a great place to stay and read, study, or just sit and enjoy your coffee.  It is always quiet enough with a very pleasant atmosphere.  Thank you for keeping me awake and alert at work!

This used to be my home Starbucks that I stopped at several mornings a week for my standard Starbucks drink (Iced green tea with no syrup!) up until I moved to West County not quite a year ago. I was in the hood the other afternoon and since I had tried the chile mocha (special fall drink) a few days ago it has been on my mind. I hit the drive thru here at around 5pm on a Thursday. There was only one car ahead of me. I ordered a tall chile mocha latte and was on my way in minutes. My beverage was hot and delicious. I'm not sure why this Starbucks has a lot of negativity directed at it in the reviews. They retain employees and have a core group of regulars who hang out there in the mornings. I used to pop in when the drive thru was too crowded and I always got a "hello" and "the usual?" from the same girl! Don't hate on the South City Starbucks...

Caffeine right next to Macy's and my apartment- couldn't be better! Plenty of tables and outlets for doing work, friendly staff, strong coffee as always. Their condiments do run low sometimes, but I've never had a problem with wait time so far.
No line, clean and efficient Starbucks. I find it spacious compared to what we have in NY and they also have a large parking.

I hit this location up on my way to work 5 days a week.  I love the drive-through staff.  They are funny, upbeat and always get my order right.  Unfortuantly I cannot say the same for the weekend staff.  I sat at the order center for 3 minutes before someone took my order last Sunday and then waited 5 minutes for them to acknowledge me at the window.  I finally gave up and drove off.  I know that you can't have everyone work 7 days a week, but I would suggest some cross training between the week day morning crews and the weekend crews.

Used the mobile order for the first time. I ordered a caramel macchiato, drink for my bf and sandwiches for both of us. My bfs complicated drink was made correctly but somehow even though my cup says caramel macchiato which I've had so many times, it's just a latte with no flavor in sight. I've literally never had my order messed up at any Starbucks before so I felt I should leave a review.  This sucks especially since my bf picked them up so I'm not there to just ask for a new one. 

When you charge $4 for a tall drink, it would be nice if it was the right one.

Wazzzzup fam? ill cut to the chase. So starbucks gets alot of the hate cause the white girls are like "OMG CUPCAKE YAY" but in all realness its pretty swag. Was just in here the other day. One of the baristas spit in my double chocolate chip, then called me a nigger and threatened to call the police on me because I took to long to get from the entrance to the cashier. I'm not even black I'm just a dark Puerto Rican with curly hair. If it wasn't for her calling me a nigger and spitting in my drink it would have been a fine experience. 3 stars

Depending upon who is working is how great the customer service is. Either great or sucks. No in between. Parking is always a nightmare here. Having other customers park where ever they feel like doesn't help the situation.

On Sunday, August 19th, my husband and I, along with another couple, were returning to West Lafayette, IN from the Indiana State Fair in Indianapolis, IN. We were tired after a long day, and it's about an hour drive, so we decided to stop at the first Starbucks we could find that was just outside of Indy (to avoid local traffic), to get a little caffeine.

 According to Google Maps, the Starbucks located at 6378 Crane Drive in Whitestown, IN would be open until 10 p.m., and it was 9:12 p.m. when we got off on exit 130; so we weren't worried, even though from a distance we could see a line of cars. 

We considered getting gas at the gas station next door, but decided not to. When I pulled into the drive-thru, there weren't any more cars in line, so I was expecting a fast, efficient crew. 

Instead, when I spoke our order into the drive-thru's speaker, I got no response. I repeated it, but still, no response. I then said "hello" a few times, but again, no response. I thought that maybe their speaker was broken, that's been the case before at a Starbucks, so no big deal. I drove forward to speak with someone at the window. 

I saw a girl at the register and tried to get her attention by waving my arm around, this did nothing. I lightly honked my horn once, she turned her head and looked at me. I smiled and waved, so that she would understand that I just wanted to get her attention, not to be rude or anything like that. She looked at us, almost thru us, with a blank stare, and turned away. We sat there, puzzled. I was about to honk and wave again, when she walked away. I was hoping this was to go get someone else or something like that. After a short while, she came back to the register area, but did not face us, and did not look at us again. I was stunned at the way she was ignoring us, but I tried to remain calm and reserved, I didn't want to get upset over a simple misunderstanding. 

As my patience began to wear thin, another girl walked by, I took the opportunity, and honked. She stopped walking, and turned to look at us. I smiled and waved again, but she too just stared at us. Then, she seemed to huff as she also walked away from us, like we weren't there, like we didn't exist. Now I was upset.

We started to wonder if Google Maps was wrong, and if the store was actually closed. But the lighted sign was still on, and the lights inside were still on. 
We continued thru the drive-thru and neared the front of the store. We were going to get out and check to see if the hours of operation were posted on the door, but at that point, we didn't want to give them our money anyway. Not after that rude display of customer service.

Even if the store was closed, the only thing the employees needed to do, was tell us that; that would have made us slightly disappointed, but we would've been informed, and on our way. That would have been the decent thing to do. But no, they couldn't even be bothered to give us that, simple human courtesy.

As we drove away, we saw a few people getting out of their cars and walking up to the store. We were going to warn them away from the bad customer service, but frankly I was too annoyed to be advising anyone, and didn't want to waste even one more second on that store.

We have never received such rude service, actually, non-service, from a Starbucks before. It was truly unbelievable. Horrible customer service, we will never go here again!

The next Starbucks we came across had great customer service, thankfully.

This is a Starbucks. I am a huge Starbucks fan, don't get me wrong. I absolutely love a venti bold brew, black, and their coffee is deep and rich and just like my father forced me to drink (none of that "fru fru stuff"). The thing is, being a frequent bucks-er, there's a few things you come to expect and this location misses the beat on one key aspect. 
1) get me my coffee so I can get the f*ck out and on with my day.

I have NEVER not seen a snaking line at this place. It is, without a doubt, the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to and I grew up in the southwest. Good god people, you know your address is Philadelphia, right? We are city people who walk at a city's pace who want our coffee at a city's speed. If I wanted my cashier to nurture me and call me "baby" I would drive my way out to the 'burbs. If you're looking to grab a quick cup of coffee on your way to work, find somewhere else, because this place will undoubtedly ensure that you arrive late to work like a jackass, too embarrassed to bring your Starbucks cup in with you...

I will say, parking is great, location is nice and the interior bodes well to coffee enjoyment. But it frustrates the living hell out of me.

It's Starbucks. I've never understood high priced coffees but a large or "venti" blonde roast coffee is $2 same as any place else. This place has a great crew and a good comfortable environment to enjoy your coffee. I am a regular here and if I have one complaint it would be that it is on a busy street with a main bus route that leads to some oddballs coming through door but hey one persons oddball is another persons friend so what should I care?

The staff at starbucks is so well trained. I have had Starbucks for over twenty five years. I love your coffee but love your staff at speedway and country club in Tucson AZ more, they are a great and certainly make me feel like I am having coffee at a friends home instead of a corporate store. I really like this Starbucks location. It's definitely a neighborhood spot for East Franklin. If you love nearby it's quite likely you'll run into a friend. Typically it's easy to get in and out within 5 minutes. It does get very busy during the early morning hours. 

It's a great location to meet a friend or colleague unless they are full which happens more often than I'd like. This is a criticism I have have most Starbucks. There's never enough seating. 

The staff is always very friendly and courteous. If you like Starbucks coffee, I would recommend this location.
I was never partial to their traditional coffee flavor but the blonde roast they came out with is one of my personal favorites now.  I'm glad they opened this new location.

A far better experience than my last visit here a few years ago, the service was excellent and they delivered a great product thankfully...

I have visited literally hundreds of Starbucks' location since they've come into existence and although they all seem to be pretty consistence with the quality of the products they offer; the service, quality of the product, wait-time, cleanliness and accessibility of the location are the five points I will rate all of them on going forward - so to make the point I've recently incorporated a rating system based on this short list to calculate the rating of the locations I visit. Cleanliness - 4 Stars

Clean.  Coffee.  Friendly people.  Lots of places to sit inside and outside (big porch.)  It is not Dunkin Donuts.  All good things.  

It can be tough to find a place to park (err it has been any time i'm ever there, i'm sure its much less of a hassle during a tourist lull) but if you head right after the bridge, you should be able to find an out-of-the-way street spot as long as you don't mind a little walk back.

For coffee, I do not mind.

During today's visit I was a little bummed that they didn't have a fresh vat of Christmas Blend (my favorite cold-weather coffee) that I could stick directly into a vein of my choosing, but I did manage to bold my day up with a bit of Italian Roast.

If you can get a seat outside, relax a bit, eat some Internet, and watch cars run the red light just after the bridge into town over the Delaware.

Same old story .. Good Starbucks, pretty much the norm with the some outside seating but the parking lot can be a nightmare. They've recently made some adjustments to the parking lines in the lot itself but it is still very tight and limited. Be careful pulling in and out onto 611. Great Coffee Stop To Have In Reno If You Know Nothing About Coffee In This Town

SITREP

This is primary benefit of the Starbucks-"branding":  if you are not familiar with a particular city or location, seeing a Starbucks is always a great stop to settle in.

THE SETUP

I'm still learning about Reno, and do not have a finely-honed, nuanced view yet of this beautiful city.  So when it comes to visiting a new place for me, what Starbucks brings to the table is several things:

* FREE WIFI!  Ha.  You probably thought I was going to say coffee first, didn't ya?  The whole Starbucks chain serves as an "office-on-the-go" for me no matter where I am.  So I will flip up my laptop and check-in on the WiFi FIRST, because as I see it, what's the point of buying coffee at a place where there is no WiFi if I need to "post" and take a look at the digital-lay of the land?  "No WiFi" = Moving on to another coffee house location.  [But happy to report that there was no problem here because they had the WiFi.]

* COFFEE - okay, NOW we come to coffee.  And the good thing for about the Starbucks branding is that when I order a Venti Verona Blonde in the morning and/or a Venti Mocha Frap Lite in the afternoon, I know EXACTLY what I am going to get, whether I am back home in Sacramento, off hitting work sites in San Francisco, or on a fun trek to Reno.  CONSISTENCY.  If I don't have the luxury of being embedded in a location for more than 2-7 days, I don't have time to play a "guessing-game" of explore the coffee houses and get stuck with a rancid independent option.  In town for just a day means hitting Starbucks (unless I actually found a wonderful indie option on a prior visit, then I'll trigger for that).

* REGISTERED REWARDS - again, whether Sacramento, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Ft. Lauderdale, Nashville, or here in Reno, I get a credit on my registered Starbucks Card account that all accumulates for a free item after 12 purchases.  A very nice benefit no matter where/what city I bought my coffee that day.  *Cha-Ching*

LAYOUT

This is a nice store layout, with plenty of tables, LOTS of window views, and pretty cool clientele from the Downtown Reno area.  This Starbucks is truly "lounge-worthy" and makes for a very comfortable post-session of a couple of hours (or even more).

Pro-Tip:  you'll see a lot of local Casino & Business professionals, but fun quirky visitors as well.  GREAT place to people watch!

PARKING

Usually on the street here for me because my timing sucks, but that works for me okay.

THE LOWDOWN

Actually my favorite (and inexpensive) hang-out & chill location in Downtown Reno!

Once I was down the road realized my drink was quite light- so I opened the top to find a short poured coffee- it's coffee, it doesn't cost much to them but we pay such a premium. Most of the staff is friendly here, but the environment is just weird. It's not like a regular starbucks. People come in here all the time and just use the free wifi without even buying coffee. In the movie "Good Morning Vietnam", Adrian Cronauer said "we can't even say "lesbian" anymore, it's "women in comfortable shoes". This spot can be super busy, but they're also pretty efficient. For a Starbucks this location is pretty charming and cozy. They even have the fireplace going in the winter. When it's sunny outside sitting in the courtyard is seriously lovely.

This is by far the best Starbucks experience I've ever had. The new manager Emma is really turning things around. She is so nice and friendly and made my friends and I amazing drinks based on the request to 'be awake enough to go out tonight'. She is a genius!!! Definitely returning and I hope Emma is working. I would recommend this Starbucks over any other coffee shops (or Starbucks) in the area!! Ask for Emma.

While a Starbucks is usually an as-to-be-expected Starbucks - this one is ranking a little lower in my books. Yes, this location has all the coffee, tea, and snacks you'd expect, but the customer service here is a bit lacking - and the recycling options were nil.

The Starbucks is always quick but they are ALWAYS out of food and it's getting ridiculous. No matter what time of day. I'm getting ready to stop coming here.

Yeah, it's another Starbucks.  But man you can't beat this location.  It's right next to the train station and it's the perfect place to stop if you have time.    I was connecting between the Amtrak and SEPTA at Paoli and I had about 45 minutes to kill.  And what better way to do it than with a nice decaf latte?

I was so excited when Starbucks opened in my neighborhood. I literally go there every day. In addition to the drinks I purchase, the staff always offers a puppuccino to my dog. My day, and that of my puppy, would not be complete without our morning visit.

Starbucks coffee taste like burnt ass.  The atmosphere has all the charm of a hospital.  Why people go here when there are so many awesome local coffee shops in this city with fantastic coffee straight of the barges.

The time I went, this place was packed though (client wanted to meet there).  I'm really confused as to why...  You could go to Rue, PJs, CC's or any of the other fantastic coffee places.
This is a large Starbucks with plenty of good seating. Good neighborhood with good restaurants for a lunchtime break.
New Hope, Pa. Friendly and accommodating staff. Outside tables right on Bridge Street. The perfect place to relax, enjoy the great coffee and people and car watch.

Come on, act like you care. Somebody interrupt your chatting and run a register.
I really like this Starbucks. The staff are very friendly and helpful. It's definitely a nice Starbucks experience, but it's always packed, so don't expect to get a table to sit at.

I had looked, the Barista just said if it ain't in the case we don't have them.  Then I asked for what I always get and that is Frappuccino with some ground espresso beans in it  They refused to make it.  They said they could not make that drink at Starbucks.  So we got in the car, headed north on I65 stopped at the next Starbucks, the lady found us a cheese sandwich when we asked and she made my drink no problem.  Thanks Lebanon Starbucks for providing good service!

If there was a "zero star" option, we would choose it. This is probably the dirtiest Starbucks we've ever patronized. From the obnoxiously loud,coughing and sneezing barista(if we get sick, we blame him!), to the filthy tables we sat at, to the other patron( a "regular", we surmise)who acquired a container from the store and proceeded to open a can of dog food and feed his dog at the table next to us~ this entire experience was disgusting.
Agree wholeheartedly with Allison W. Worst Starbucks ever. I consistently wait for more than 10 minutes.
Starbucks is Starbucks. But A+ to this one for being the only Starbucks branch near Goleta that isn't teeming with college kids claiming all the seats while they study.

Staff is very disorganized. They ignore there customers and continue on with there own personal conversations. I know there a busy location but they take forever to get you your drink. Might need to reevaluate there staff because they don't seem very proficient.
I hate to leave bad reviews, but here goes.  Service was fine, but the place was dirty. Especially the bathroom.  Really dirty floor and more things that I cannot mention.

I had never really gave into the hype of Starbucks (SB). It was just one of those places that everyone seemed to enjoy. Coffee, smoffee...what's the fuss, right?!

 ...wrong? I think I may have become a new convert. 

One early morning, I needed to feed the post-workout beast within. Ya girl was HUNGRY. Without trying, I had time to spare before work and wanted to try something different. SB seeped into my thoughts, and I hopped on over to Loughborough Commons. Per one of my favorite YouTuber's vlogs, she constantly raved about the bacon gouda sandwich. So I went with that, along with the strawberry acai refresher with coconut milk. 

This particular store is small and sits at the corner to the entrance. The drive-thru was giving the ladies morning rush hell, but they still managed to greet me (somewhat dully) when I walked in. The store was clean and airy on the inside. After a few secs of menu gazing to make sure my choices were the one, I gave the cashier my order. Quick, simple.

The wait wasn't too long; the workers were going as fast (and accurate) as possible. The cashier didn't ask for my name and I'm not apart of their rewards program, so they had to yell out my order to me. Ain't no thing, as long as it was accurate, lol. The strawberry refresher was amazing. Mixed very well and so fresh. I'll definitely be ordering that again. The sandwich? Just ok. The Applewood bacon was very crispy. The egg was cooked to my liking, but I just wasn't wow'd.  Beautiful looking sandwich, tho. Honestly, the sausage/egg/cheese sandwich from Bread Co. is way better, IMO. In addition, my total was pricey. SB is pricey in general, but nothing over the top.

Being a new convert, I'm willing to try all of what's offered at Starbucks. Hopefully another trip and experience brings about more stars.
What do you say about Starbucks..this location friendly service and good Americano..like the most

Please fix your drive thru process.  My average wait time here is 15-20min and I am pretty sure that's me being nice.  Please please fix it.    This is one of the worst three Starbucks drive the in the nation.    I have ended up on several occasions leaving and just grabbing an ice tea from chick fil a or McDonald's or anywhere.   Very disappointing.
This starbucks has a great location , a had a really fresh croissant and a coffee latte . The service is good

Probably my favorite starbucks in the entire state. I'd give it 5 stars if they had a parking lot, but I cant really fault them for that because its Main st.

Beautiful old building, close to the bridge so you can grab a coffee and walk out to watch the boats, kayakers, etc. Or you can just sit outside on the porch and people watch.

I know this might sound a little odd... since every Starbucks is/should be exactly the same... but the New Hope location is my favorite Starbucks of all time! 

Each and every time I've visited this location they have made my iced venti non-fat 3 pump Cinnamon dolca latte correctly. I can't tell you how many times I have ordered this drink only to get a huge cup of something that tasted like dirty water. Not here at New Hope. Plus the staff is friendly, but not nosey. There is a convenient parking lot behind the store (though you do need to pay).

Hate this location and absolutely hate the service. They need a entirely new group of employees. Who warms a croissant for a second and expect the inside to be warm? Man and it's literally across the street from my house but I would rather walk or drive to another location. Do Better Starbucks.

The store manager, Ed, is a racist ass hole, he is also extremely sexist, and has made every experience I have had at this store, terrible. He does not know how to run a business, and he does not know how to treat his customers with respect. I have had nothing but negative experiences here.

I love Starbucks, but this location I'm not to fond of, and the reason is because I have come here a few times and my order has been ruined. The parking lot is horrible, the bathroom was disgusting, and how many times can you come to the same spot and they mess up the order. I try to avoid this spot, but I come back trying to give them another chance to not mess up. I still come back to the same problem.

I am a regular Starbucks customer for decades. I have probably been to hundreds of them over the years. This is the first time I have been charged for ice water on top of my order of a flat white and a food item. To make things worse, the baristas are totally clueless in this location - worst flat white ever!

I love to sit and do homework at Starbucks but for some reason whenever the place fills up with students they turn the air way down till we all freeze out, almost like they are sending us a non verbal message to GET OUT. I would prefer just about any other location because of this. When I go there because it is close to my house, I am sitting in the corner with the other students fully dressed for winter when it's 70 outside.

Just now (sitting in parking lot) was here. Walked in, no line  stand by the register and wait to place my order. Cashier (shorter brownish hair) is having a conversation and completely ignores me then turns to me half smiles and finishes her conversation before bothering to take my order. (Sorry to interrupt). I pay with card and she doesn't give me my receipt. I ask for it and she says "oh do you want your receipt?" Um yes ... so she hands it to me like I'm being a bother. What ever happened to customer service?

This is a great Starbucks location.  The staff is friendly - and the drinks and selections are everything you'd expect from the brand.  The location is convenient to downtown and walking distance to the hospital.
So confusing, awful drivethru/walk up window set up.  If it's busy good luck figuring it out.

We come to this starbucks whenever we are in the area. Great, fast, friendly service each time we've been in. I always get the caramel Machiato, or the white chocolate mocha and my other half always gets his norm the americano.

This used to be my favorite coffee shop.  However, in the past couple of years the service has gone down tremendously.  I still like the coffee, but whenever I walk in it looks like I'm bothering the cashier and the employees rather talk than make my coffee.

I was not happy about my visit to this Starbucks this morning.  I ordered an ice coffee, and was asked if I wanted it "sweetened."  Okay, I probably messed up at this point, but I'd never been asked this question before, and since I usually put some sweetener in it, I said yes.  So any way, it tasted gross -- not super sweet (yes, in my early morning haze I put some Equal in it after I got it), but just weird, like some strange disgusting flavoring was put in.  So I go back to the counter and tell the barista that it tasted weird.  She responded, "Well, that's why I asked you if you wanted it sweetened," unceremoniously dumped my cup, and gave me a new, apparently corrected cup.  BUT the allegedly unsweetened one tasted just the same as the first!

So at that point, I decided I had better cut my losses, dumped Cup No. 2 myself, and left.  Oh, and on my way out, they were rousting someone who was peaceably sitting there minding his own business, and told him he had to leave because he hadn't bought anything.  Uncool, no?

1.5.

This place has more problems then just the parking...the service went down hill as well.  It used to be my fab Starbucks to go to after school years ago and it was always quick and had a friendly staff.  I went in there the other day and the girl took my order and I waited for my drink and waited for my drink and waited for my drink.  The girl ahead of me got hers and the guy behind me got his and the family behind him got their stuff and the girl behind them got hers. I was pissed off for two reasons number 1 the girl who took me order saw everyone behind me was getting drinks and then saw me still standing there you think she would of said something to the kid who was getting the drinks made because the problem was my drink didn't show up on the screen for him to make. The second problem was the kid making the drinks was getting slammed with orders and all the two girls who were behind the counter did was wait around and do nothing to help him out...ignorant girls! But the kid who was working hard deserves recognition for his hard work and I feel bad he has to work with two ugly ass dumb bitches
Love going to this Starbucks. Always greeted by Bradley's great personality.  They always make my drink exactly how I like it. Drive thru however slow at times.

I have to agree that this Starbucks is slower than most, but the staff are friendly and they make your drink right, which I appreciate! The ambiance in here is a bit lacking due to the location- there are often shady folks lingering near the front during the day and often loud kids coming through once the bus lets out, making it not the ideal place to study or relax. It seems that the staff have to change the key code on the bathroom daily because of this to keep its use down to only paying customers, but it's still hard for them to keep up with stuff going on around a blind corner from the barista area. The station with milk, straws, etc is usually missing some things and the trash is often overflowing, but I can't say enough that I think the staff here works hard to keep it nice-- I just think they've been dealt some tricky cards.
They made they drinks pretty fast, and some of them were friendly. But they didn't have any table and chairs left when we went.

It's tough for me to give any Starbucks higher than a 3 star review (my hometown being the exception), so consider this a positive review overall.

The service is good, though I found it very slow to get my drink. Sometimes the place is packed beyond belief, which stinks, but others it's empty.

The space is good - lots of seating - and they're friendly and pass out samples often.

Worth a visit if you're nearby looking for some Starbucks. But if it were up to me, I'd go to a local shop instead.
This Starbucks is cool because of the outdoor patio. It's pretty big and has a lot of seating options. And they also have fans on the patio, too.

This place is good for lounging around and studying while sipping on coffee or whatever your favorite Starbucks concoction may be.  Drinks are what you expect from Starbucks: overpriced but made to order.  The downside to this place is they play music more loudly than I can remember any other Starbucks playing theirs.  Also, the staff is usually friendly, but the manager always seems to have a stick up her butt.  I always see her annoyed at someone or something and she does not hide it well.  

All in all, not a bad place to hang out and talk or study.

My love for Starbucks stems from growing up in WA - it's always my go-to place for a latte regardless of what city I am in.  This particular establishment is simply wonderful - the staff is courteous and quick to rectify any miss-order, space is clean, outdoor patio and indoor seating is conducive to students and professionals alike. Great location - close to lots of eateries, so grabbing a post-lunch coffee is easy breezy.  Parking can be challenging but not impossible.

This is unfortunately my local Starbucks. Never personable staff, typically rude, and overcharges my beverage at least twice a week. Coffee can get pricey, but the prices I'm paying are inconsistent every time. Wish the staff would be happier to be there.

Carolyn was very rude the whole time , from the beginning when she took my order she was cold and full of bad energy , and even more rude after I asked for a refill; she was talking to me as I was trying to take advantage or something of the refill process.. I spent 30$$ the same morning on a coffee and a Starbucks speciality cup ! I don't appreciate the dirty looks as if I was trying to take advantage of the system when I've never had any issue getting refills within the same day. between me and my fiancé we spend over 2000 $$ a year just on Starbucks and this time around the employees were extremely rude to me and a friend, I regret giving you business!! From now on my fiancé and I will be taking our money to Dunkin' Donuts next door.

Stopped by on my way to work about 8:40am- the drive thru line wrapped around the building, which blocks a couple of parking spots in front.  If you are parking and plan to go inside, just remember that you may have to wait for a drive thru car to move out of your way before backing up.

Service inside was speedy.  Cashier knew what he was doing and was very friendly.  My drink was finished by the another barista and handed to me before I even left the register.  My oatmeal was warmed and bagged about 2 minutes later.

Staff are very friendly, drive thru is quick, and they recently remodeled. The updated layout makes better use of the space & gives it a more open feel. Probably not good for large groups due to space but a very friendly place.
Best Starbucks in the Reno/Sparks area.  They are rarely out of stock and don't skimp on the flavorings!!  You actually come close to getting your money's worth here!!

This Starbucks location has simply become more and more infuriating. I like coming here after I do laundry to watch some netflix or surf the internet during loads....unfortunately the internet connection at this location is such an embarrasment, I am very surprised that no other reviews have mentioned it. There might well be no internet - I can't watch netflix, it takes 60 seconds to load a standard website, videos don't work, its absolutely pathetic. I am actually writing this review from the PJ's next door. Perhaps nobody else has complained? When I look around I see everyone on their computers in word documents but nobody trying to actually use the wi-fi so perhaps that could be why - but to the owners, simply pay for more/better bandwith, it's worth it despite your obvious conclusion that somehow its not. I will not be returning unless the internet actually works. Village coffee on Jefferson also never has this problem ,but again I'd love to come back since everything about this starbucks is great but for the nonworking internet.
Slowest drive through EVER. Be prepared to wait 10-15 minutes MINIMUM no matter the time of day. Pic on a slow day at 2:00 in the afternoon. Each stop at the window was like 3 mins. SO DAMN SLOW.

As far as Starbucks goes, this store is pretty packed. I've never been here when there wasn't a ginormous line...although the baristas are always cheery and friendly. They know an amazing number of regulars' orders by sight, which is cool. Unlike many SBUX I've been in, despite being pretty busy, this place is always pretty clean. Despite standing in line, it's always a treat to come here.

My first experience here at this newly opened store. I love Starbucks and stop in many different ones. This is a new and industrial look. It is wide open inside but only has a few cushioned chairs whereas other have a decent amount. But, the customer service is top notch and that goes a long way! Stop in here if you have a chance.

I want to once again voice displeasure at this location. I've currently been waiting 20min. There's trash on the floor (& only one trash receptacle in the entire place - with the creamers) & boxes strewn everywhere. There were at least 15 cups lined up when I ordered. I understand bad days & maybe someone called in sick & it IS Sunday, but this is consistent. I stop here when it's on my way. 
I've heard rumor that the Cool Springs store is one of the higher volume stores in the region & I believe it. I have no idea why this store can't get it right.

This Starbucks location is in the the Hyatt Downtown.  It's a major godsend on Sundays when the 6th and Olive location is closed, _but_ the prices here are a bit higher (about $0.50) more.

Not sure if that's due to hotel taxes or something, or if they just jacked them up due to a majority of their business being from hotel guests?  It's a mystery, because they do not provide an itemized receipt.  I'm guessing it's a little of both.

My drive experience was super fast which I like but fast isn't always good cause I was given the wrong drink plus was overcharged. Very disappointing experience for my first time here. By the time I got on the vet and took my first sip it was too late to turn back around after paying for toll. Oh well my lost right!

I've frequented a lot of Starbucks in my lifetime and I can say with full confidence this is one of the - if not THE - worst. 

I used to think I was biased because my Starbs of choice has always been the well-oiled machine at the corner of 12th & Walnut (Hey, Denise!). 

After switching jobs, this location seemed to be more convenient. Unfortunately, I have experienced nothing but inconvenience here. 

I can't exactly pinpoint why this Starbucks is so poorly-run. It seems like the employees at this particular location just work... slowly. During the morning rush, there's no urgency to make the drinks and move the line along. If you're looking for a "in and out the door" experience you will not find it here. 

The only reason I gave two stars instead of one is because the employees are all very friendly and seem to enjoy their jobs and co-workers.

This Starbucks looks/feels like you are at an airport. 
Some Starbucks are like this now: long and narrow with very sleek  sandwich/drink displays; perfect ones to just quickly pick up your coffee (etc..) and go. 
But,  they also happen to have the NICEST employees here, especially Natalie.  She is so genuinely personable and engaging, while also being efficient and quick with your order. Super special quality. 
There are also  two big tables here perfectly good for study, meetings, and sharing.  Little tables too. Easy outlets.  Outside seating.  Seems to have its regulars here too, so that sometimes makes it feel like a warm community cafe despite the cool atmosphere.

The service here was the best I've had at a Starbucks in a while. The guy behind the counter was quick and didn't give me the funny look I usually get when I don't order coffee or tea. (I can't have caffeine in my drinks and have gotten paranoid about ordering decaf after several disastrous experiences elsewhere). He was more than happy to ring through my bottle of water and banana loaf. This location is particularly bright and spacious. There are plenty of seating options, even though on this particular day two older ladies had five bags of clothing unpacked across all the couches. So, why the three stars? One of the things I used to love about Starbucks were the baked goods. Every time I get a piece of cake or banana bread it's starting to go stale, and for the prices they charge, that really shouldn't be the case. It still tastes good, but I like my cakes and breads to be moist and not hard and dry at the edges. They haven't lost a customer over it, but it is something that I hope they work on for the future.
Redid my drink for me when they accidentally messed up and gave me the other for free!
This is close to the hotel that I stay at in town a couple weeks of the month by far my favorite one to visit.

This place always seems packed probably because it's the only one near University street on campus. I ordered my drink ahead on the app and it was not ready at the predicted time. All the seats were full so I had to take my drink to go.
this is my first time ordering food the smoked bacon with gouda sandwich was okay the bacon wasnt crispy enough.  the peach tranquility tea was delicious.

A solid Starbucks. It is a bit on the small side, but I actually appreciate the openness of the store. Plus, it has an added benefit of keeping the loitering under control. 

If you're the type of person who thinks they're too busy to wait in line at a Starbucks (but still has time to write nasty Yelp reviews), just use the app and place a mobile order. It may come as a surprise but the internet can be used for good rather than a constant stream of negativity.  During my visits the lines are on par with or slightly shorter than what you'd expect at a Starbucks.  The staff has always been friendly and I've never had any mistake on an order yet. 

The only real downside is the location and the parking. During busy periods it can be a nightmare to park and it's located in this tiny corner that isn't extremely convenient to get in or out of. I'm surprised there aren't regular accidents or fist fights over parking spaces.
Great place to study. Lots of background noise but comfortable environment and friendly staff. Only thing is they don't have late hours, which isn't that bad. Has outside area too.

The staff here is very fast and friendly. I was greeted with a smile from multiple baristas and they started making my drink as I ordered and before I even had a chance to pay. My iced tea was ready to go as I finished the transaction and walked over to the bar area so I was in and out in a matter of minutes, can't beat it
3 solid stars. It was pretty clean to be so populated and they served regular Starbucks and did not try to rip me off! Unlike the Starbucks on South Broad street!

The manager (I believe; he's tall and bald... name Ed?) is so extremely rude and disrespectful. I rarely visit this Starbucks, and my last visit reminds me why. I truly feel sorry for the Batistas who work here. If you want to visit a Starbucks in the area, I would suggest driving around the corner to the Keystone Ave. Starbucks, where they know how to provide customer service and respect.
Being from Seattle/Tacoma comes with certain expectations of a Starbucks team. Very under-trained staff. Very Slow. Unusual for every other Starbucks.

The parking is horrible at this Starbucks. I'm surprised there aren't accidents. 

The staff does a good job and they hustle, but the drive through line STILL gets super backed up in the mornings. It takes forever. 

The inside is small, I often have to wait for a place to sit. 

But--drinks are good, staff is competent and friendly, and if you do a mobile order, it's ready quickly.

Have used them a couple times for coffee "travelers" to go.
Always ready when I come to pick it up.
Friendly staff.  didn't get 5 stars because i agree location is difficult to access.

Not sure why NAOMI is so sad, but this is a great location. The staff here is always friendly and consistent with their beverages. I love randomly stopping in here day or night and now that they will get it right without screwing up. The inside is always clean and the restrooms stay pretty clean too. This is my favorite Starbucks around.

Last night, a friend and I got together just to visit, sit around and talk, and really not to do very much. He said that we should go to this Starbucks. 

This is a typical Starbucks like almost all of the other Starbucks establishments in the metropolitan St. Louis area. Their coffee is not bad but it's not good either. They have their menu of drinks posted on the wall like the others. 

When we got there, it wasn't crowded, and the employees were helpful and friendly, and I always appreciate that. I just wished that the coffee at Starbucks was better in general, not just this Starbucks. It was quiet and not busy the entire time we were there, so I suppose that it's a good place to study or read your latest good book that you bought.

I come here quite often because it's the closest one to my work so it's always on the way.  Though I do go to a ton of different ones depending on the day.  This one is a smaller one in a weird looking building on the corner of Olive and Craig.  Its never been my favorite one, but, lately this location has really been getting on my nerves.  

The parking lot SUCKSSSS like major bad.  To get into it or out (so you can go L on Olive) from the main entrants there's a steep incline that you better watch out for or else you might scrape up your car.  Traffic blocks this entrance often too.  Once in the lot is ultra tiny.  If it's a busy time (which is 75% of the time since this one is so tiny) you have to fight for a spot or park at the bank and walk over... It's just annoying because the lot is stressful!! 

I typically get an iced coffee with sweetener and extra extra room for cream (as in I prefer a grande in a venti if they let me).  About 8/10 times the sweetener is forgotten.  I say I want it at least 3 times at the register and the cashier even reads back my order... Yet no sweetener.  If they're busy it can be 5 minutes before you get their attention and then they've been rude about fixing it.  Dude you screwed that up.  

One time they forgot and also put about 5 ice cubes in it.  When I finally got their attention to remake it I didn't see the girl put the sweetener in it so I asked to make sure.  She acted so pissed off that I asked, but, it's like do it right the first time.. Then I won't have to question you! 

Another time I asked before leaving the counter after the girl handed it to me.  Well, the girl handing it to me didn't even make my drink.  She looked confused, glanced at the cup and behind her and said yeah.  As I walked away I heard her ask the other girl did you put sweetener in it? Wtf man, you straight lied to me about knowing that you put it in there... At least say I'm not sure hold on and ask or something! Not cool. 

Even today the girl at the register was not very friendly about my request for a tall in a grande.  I get it, sometimes you're a stickler but if I ask politely tell me you can't do it. That's fine. Don't say ok, and in front of me as the other girl is grabbing the cup mutter no tall.  Ok, hello I'm right here... See me?? Yea, just tell me. I asked for it for a reason, I wanted extra extra room, not just extra and I even states such when I ordered.   

Lately the customer service hasn't been great.  I don't mind having to walk in cuz no drive thru, I don't mind fighting for a table, I don't always mind the parking lot.  But for crying out loud get my order right and if it's wrong don't be a bitch about it! Geeze. You're lucky it's my favorite iced coffee.

It's 7 p.m. in January. It's less than fifty degrees outside. The sun is down. Everyone in the shop is wearing a jacket or a sweater. Many people are hugging themselves and shivering visibly.

Have any of the employees noticed and turned down the air conditioner? Fuck, no.

Perhaps the SLOWEST Starbucks in the country. Regardless of the hour of the day or the amount of people in the store, I've never left without a wait. Regardless of the specific barista. It must be something about the management and the workflow. Avid unless you have time to kill
Too much staff none of whom understand the correct names for routine Starbucks items. Just say no.
Eric is my favorite barista of all time.  He knows my order without me having to tell him. Definitely tip the man on his hard work!
Solid coffee, like the skinny mocha... Usually make it with extra cocoa.  Wondering if it's a good idea to buy the $1 reusable cup?  Says it'll pay for itself but who knows.

Probable one of my favorite Bucks in the area. There is plenty of parking both in the back parking lot and street parking in the front. I would recommend ordering ahead if you are in a rush because this one gets fairly busy. There is a ton of tables and seating throughout the store so you have a pretty good chance of finding a spot to enjoy your beverage or get some work done. I personally love the fact that as a gold member you get free refills or hot coffee, hot tea, and iced tea or iced coffee.

Expanded seating in the rear. Sweet!!!  

I love this place!!!! 

Ambience.  Nice staff.  Ample parking.  Swift Barristas.  Spacious restrooms.  A plethora of sitting/studying area.  

Actually, I do believe this place is a meeting spot FIRST and a coffee shop SECOND, no really!!!!! I see sooooo many people and when I people watch, this is also the case.  And being in the Irish Channel - Magnificent Magazine Area... I mean what more can you ask for???  I love it.  You can study or meet or just chill.  This is my FAVVVVVV Starbucks in the GNO Area.  

Woooo Hooooo!!!!! See ya there!!!!

The usual Starbucks... the trend of the service is definitely downwards.

To be sure, the beverages are fine. The food is worth skipping.

The staff, though, continues to be lackluster and underwhelming. It is like they don't even try anymore... 

On occasion though, we do get surprised by competent and energetic service... occasionally.

I worked at this location for over 2 years as well as many others in the area for a total of 6 1/2 years. I can tell you for even being one of the older ones, this is by far the cleanest store in the greater STL area. The staff is still the most friendly group of people every time I go in-even the newbies I don't know! The environment is also a perk since there's no drive through. While living in Fenton, I would drive out of my way to go to this Starbucks instead.

The employees are short and a touch rude. Their customer service lacks a little in the "I am sorry it is early and I am douche working at a coffee shop kinda way". Have a latte and act like you are glad we are spending 10 dollars a drink.

Relatively speedy, efficient Starbucks location with a few dings for occasionally screwing up charges on a car full of people, but otherwise competent.  

Be forewarned: the entire local business community and government office complex swarm this place during morning rush and right after lunch, and the ingress/eggress paths were NOT designed to accommodate that volume of vehicles.  It turns unto a rat's nest real fast here.

I've been here a lot for coffee and I suppose all was fine, but my recent visit to get the steak breakfast burrito was awful. It was over $6 and the inside still had ICE on the eggs. It was super gross. I threw out the rest, blah.

This is by far my favorite Starbucks. I frequent here every morning, and the staff is just an absolute pleasure to chat with each day. They have it down to a science. From knowing the orders of regulars to ensuring there's always coffee brewing, this Starbucks is a well oiled machine! If every company had associates such as these, we wouldn't need customer complaint lines! Ms Deb is the best!!!
What could be bad at a Starbucks? New Hope is a noisy, busy town. If you are persistent, you can get a table outside to people watch and to breathe in the automobile fumes.

As far as a Starbucks goes it's the same as most. The food items are not as varied (no bentu boxes, which is a shame since they are great snacks and much more healthy than the sugar filled pastries). The service is very slow, as is common with a new store I am guessing, but I have noticed that the staff is constantly changing. I am hoping that once the store settles in this will change. As it stands now, this is the only Bux in downtown so if you're partial to this chain then you're stuck with it.

This is the greatest Starbucks of all time. The people that work there are super friendly and super attractive. The atmosphere is relaxed and awesome and the drinks they make are to perfection. If you chose to go to any other Starbucks then you are just wrong.

Am disappointed with how Starbucks has changed within the last 6 months or so. Not sure if it is management or simple personnel changes? The staff for many years was knowledgeable and friendly. Now you get clueless people at the drive thru window and updates are not being done to the board outside that sits on the grass which usually introduces a new product or drink, and the lines are long due to the lack of speed in making the orders; something that was NEVER an issue before. Also I find that my frappuccinos are getting more and more espresso that has a scorched taste to it. Long gone are the days of when Bryan (asst. manager) and Connie (manager) ran this place. Since they left Starbucks has never been the same. However the crew they had after them did a fine job up to a point and now the crew running the place leaves a lot to be desired. Starbucks is slowly becoming a place that I am avoiding and I find myself not minding the drive on West Esplanade from Starbucks to Puccinos. I honestly find Puccinos has a much better tasting product line than Starbucks - STARBUCKS IS QUICKLY BECOMING A HAS-BEEN!
The best Starbucks I have ever been in Philadelphia. An amazing staff, especially, Jawuan who made the amazing attached recipe, which is gonna be my favorite from now on :) Thanks Jawuan

Gotta love having a drive through.. it's a big PITA to get out of here though - save yourself the trouble and go out at the light.  Even turning right on Lindbergh is dangerous because of a poorly placed row of bushes blocking your view of oncoming traffic.

This place does get pretty busy in the morning but with the exception of one day when BOTH of their fancy machines were broken they're usually pretty quick.
My favorite Starbucks.  Great service.  If consistently order the same thing and stop in a few times, they'll remember you by name and your drink order.  Great people here!

Ridge Avenue, Roxborough, PA

I really like the front big table and window view at this Starbucks. Sets me (and starbucks DECAFF) into a dreamy mood...looking forward to come daydream again here. :-)

Few parking slots in the back.
I hope the blonde was fired immediately after refusing to let the officer use the restroom!!!!

Increased prices b/c location is inside the Hyatt building.
Staff are all very friendly, but seem like they're all new-hires - 2nd drink was made wrong (wasn't decaf) and the re-make was still the wrong size.

I'm not going to waste my time going to this Starbucks again. I got there around 7:05am. I ordered a tall pike from an apparently disgruntled employee who had a terrible attitude. I then proceeded to the window to pay and the girl hands me a Pike with no cream or sugar, which I wasn't asked for to begin with. I felt like I had to teach her to do her job. I then also had to remind her I had also ordered food, then she got an attitude with me as well. Where do they get these people? Never again.

So this new Starbucks opened recently at the corner of Olive and Woods Mill in front of the Four Seasons Dierberg's. I have only been able to get near it once in 3-4 tries because it's so busy. It's a free standing building with a drive-thru and a walk-up window but no inside for customers. It's a small building and a small lot and the drive-thru line has wrapped completely around the building on many of the occasions I have wanted to go. This means there's nowhere to pull into. Rather than hanging out in the right lane of Olive during the morning rush hour waiting to get in I have just opted to move on. Odd design. The one time I was able to get a cup of coffee it was an off peak time. It was fine.

On more than one occasion I have gone to this Starbucks (super close to my house).  Unfortunately, there is always an employee there who feels the need to berate the customers.  I have made orders there that I make at other store locations and I am told that they are not allowed to order that way and treated like I am inconveniencing them.  They usually have a friendly person taking orders, but perhaps bad management, they seem to have quite a bit of turn over.  I was also told by the person in charge that the other stores made my order as requested because "They are not doing their jobs right."  Seriously...?

Amazing Staff!
So very busy and packed BUT quick, efficient service with smiles!
Nice sitting areas and attached to the Hilton.
NOT just serving Starbucks, but a REAL Starbucks!
Probably the best Starbucks I've ever visited since they are so fast and correct with orders!
Go here for your morning Latte!
I go every morning when I'm at the Hilton, which is a lot.
I like it. They have good service and the bathrooms have been clean, at least the times that I have been here.
Possibly the best Starbucks of all time. Great customer service. Huuuggeee selection of drinks. 10/10 would recommend.

Who ever is responsible for ordering their supplies at this location needs to start ordering the ingredients for the Cascara Cold Brew.  They've been out for over a month and other nearby locations have the beverage. Pretty frustrating.

My favorite location to go to....very friendly....every time I come in here I have a great experience.  They do a great job making the drinks and alwaya interact well with the customers. I come to this location even if it is out of my way.

Good, friendly service. Quiet with ample seating, although I would have preferred some nicer and more comfortable leather seats. 

Not a bad Starbucks. My iced White Mocha-Cinnamon Dulce Hybrid Latte was superb.

The staff is horrifically slow. This starbucks is the worst one I've ever been to. Food and drinks all taste the same, as usual, but the staff clearly does not care. They're super slow and often get orders wrong. 

The one thing I like about starbucks is that they are all efficient and everything tastes pretty good. This one is not either of those things.

Think I'm going to stop going to this location. I have no problems with the staff, always attentive and friendly. My problem is the drink, I say drink because I only order the flat white. Normally a flat white has a great espresso type flavor, a little on the stronger side, which I like. Lately however it has tasted more like a plain latte with only one shot in it, tasting like heated milk for the most part. I know it can't just be my taste buds, somebody's cutting corners, or not doing their job.

This is the Starbucks attached to the Macy's. I went here around 1pm on a Tuesday. I ordered a java chip Frappucino with soy and half the amount of syrup because I don't like it too sweet. They messed it up and the barista had a bunch of attitude. 

To start, the guy taking my order wrote my nickname sloppily (I did my use my real name since it is hard to spell) so the barista read the name wrong. I was standing there not sure if it was my order or not since she wasn't calling my name. On top of that, the drink wasn't the right color, it was too dark like the color of hot chocolate. After calling the name a couple of times with no response, the barista rolled her eyes and grumbled "well, no whipped cream for you!" and capped it with a flat lid. 

I then looked at the drink and realize it was the java chip Frappucino I had ordered even though it wasn't the right color. I tasted it and there were NO chips in it. It was also too sweet and tasted like a full on mocha frap with no coffee taste despite my asking for HALF the syrup. I told them to remake it. They added some chips but it still tasted like pure mocha sauce, really nasty. I hate to think what full syrup would taste like! They told me they added 2 pumps of mocha for a grande with half syrup. That was what I had gotten the other day at another Starbucks with a venti with half syrup. No way they have the proportions right.

In the end I just asked for a free drink coupon for my next visit and left. The cashier was nice and didn't give me any attitude about it but the baristas didn't seem to know what they are doing. No way I'm going back here! 

I don't mean to write such a long review for a chain but I got charged a premium price for this drink at a chain. I expect it to taste consistent.

This is not my first time coming here and they can never seem to get my order correct. I went in a asked for a refund and they didn't even ask what was wrong with my drink. They are definitely lacking customer service! I'm done coming here
Love me some Starbucks it is very tasty and very Is so kind I love going there to get a drink it best place on earth. I love it so much.

I am so glad that Starbucks mothership has decreed the outdoors space around their venues nonsmoking.   Previously you could not get into this store without cutting the smoke with a knife.  Now it is breatheable air!  
The Baristas are very good, service is quick and friendly.
There isn't an employee here that doesn't remember you by name and favorite beverage, always greet with a kind smile, which is a welcoming start to my day. Fantastic service.

Drive thru here kinda sucks, that's just a location problem. I usually go in.  Service has always been great  but I find their drinks taste weak and watered down.
I usually get a triple shot latte.. that shouldn't taste weak!

This starbucks is always packed and working at its highest potential. Never had an order missed or wrong. Friendly staff that work hard to get things right. For the amount of pain that regular pain in the butt customers give, ya'll always shine through and make it happen. 

Know that I hate to see what pain regular customers give to ya'll, but damn if ya'll just put people in their place by ensuring the product you serve is on point! Keep up the good work!

Starbucks is Starbucks, so generally customer service is pretty good, but this location definitely takes the cake for the worst customer service I've ever experienced, anywhere, primarily because of one barista who  never seems to be ready to interact with humans. 

She is an older woman with short, dark hair. She is rude, seems easily overwhelmed, and is just down right condescending. She rarely takes orders correctly, and when a customer corrects her or asks for something additional, she gets annoyed and snippy. 

I'll gladly travel to another Starbucks before i need to deal with her attitude again.

This is a busy little Starbucks, but a fun one. Good music is always playing, strong WiFi, and nine out of ten times they spell my name correctly on the cups (haha).

The patio out on the side is a nice touch on the warm days, a good place to have a snack with your dog.

I like it here, and I will be back.

Baristas are top notch. Unfortunately, the cleanliness and tiny flies (throughout the seating area so I would imagine they are behind the bar) diminish my appetite which is hard to do - sooo well done?
Super slow service for only a grande pike hot coffee.  This location did not have any raw sugar and my coffee was cold.

Ordered an earl gray latte.   It was made correctly and tasted good.   The reason for the 3 stars was the service.  I stopped in mid-afternoon, not what I would consider a busy time.   Service was very slow.  In their defense the person in front of me was more interested in their phone rather than placing their order.  I kind of gave them a pass in this one but during order pickup the employees were more interesting in talking to their friends that had stopped in rather than fixing customers orders.   This was a weekday and during normal working hours, customers might have something to do rather than wait for employees to talk to their friends. 

This is not the level of service excellence I expect from a world class company like Starbuck's.
You just can't go wrong with a cup of hot coffee and a bowl of oatmeal in the morning.

I stop in this Starbucks a couple times a week. The staff is always friendly and efficient, and I'm definitely a sucker for free parking. I love big coffee shops that you can go and sit for hours and feel relaxed..this is one of those. I was pleasantly surprised the first time I went in and now I keep going back!

literally who the hell runs out of cream cheese and doesn offer to refund the plain ass bagel yall just sold me smh I sat there munchin on damn near white toast this is why my allegiance is with Dunkin
All I can say is, I love my coffee!!! I use my coupons from my iPhone also I have the Starbucks app that gives me great deals and points

I've been to this specific Starbucks twice and both times it was pretty good. They seem to have a lot more room at this location with a better waiting line situation. They have a nice seating area to do work as well. Very nice, I'll be coming here again!

This is my favorite Starbucks in the entire city. Everyone is friendly and they offer outside seating WITH outlets and it is covered. I usually sit outside. There's also the cutest neighborhood black cat that would walk past. Everytime I went , there was a good amount of people there but it was not loud or hectic unlike some other Starbucks I have went to.

Omg....I can't believe that I've never reviewed this Starbucks! This is my favorite one in Tucson, and one if my favorite in the State. 

First off, I remember when this place was a small independent coffee shop way back when. I saw the shop go out of business and then saw the Starbucks coming soon, I was supper excited! This would be the first Starbucks near campus. I think it was around 1995-96?  Once it opened I loved it and made this a regular study location for me. 

Fast forward many years and I still love this Starbucks. It still keeps the feel of a historic home, similar as to the older coffee shop that was there before. This location has a nice fireplace and lots of table and chairs in different rooms. 

Yes it's crowded as expected, but it's worth it. I always stop off here for my long drives back to Phx.
Strong wifi and nice deck. Good service and coffee to expected tasty standard.

So I go in on Sunday at around 9:30am. Not really busy as there was only one person in front of me at the register. Of course this person was an employee of Starbucks and the two behind the register seem to be having some issues ringing him up (with his discounts and all). Everyone else behind the counter seemed to be standing around talking with one another. Though this was the least of my issues....Now I have never made gourmet coffees myself, so I am no expert on how hard it is to make some of these crazy drinks....But I find it hard to screw up a simple iced latte. I mean espresso and milk with some ice. Did I miss anything?? If anyone thinks I wrong in this "assumption", then please let me know and explain to me what I am missing. My iced latte tasted watered down with no coffee flavor at all. And it didn't even taste like milk. You would think with only two ingredients that you would have some sort of taste from either of them, but not the case. So disappointed in this Starbucks location. My recommendation...would be to find another location or different coffee shop.

Unfortunately this place just simply cannot handle more than a few customers at a time. I just waited 10 minutes in line and 15 (FIFTEEN!) minutes for an iced coffee. 

Oh and I'm writing this while I'm still waiting. Let's see if we can make it 20.
They have a drive thru! Very convenient and the baristas are really friendly.  Only issue is there is still a bit of a wait.

OK, so this is not about Starbucks coffee or lattes. This is about service...quality or lack thereof.  I am a past Starbucks employee so I do have higher standards, but I do believe that if I spend $700/year in Starbucks and a significant portion of it at this store, I want more for my money. This store inevitably gets my drink wrong once a month (at least). They are slow through the drive through and they do not offer the "experience" or "third place" that Starbucks boasts. They generally aren't very friendly and are ALWAYS (no matter what time of day it is) behind in orders, where it seems they only make drinks off one machine.  I wish that they would take note of these issues and correct them. I know it's a smaller store, but that doesn't mean that there are less customers.

As far as parking, forget it.  It's near impossible to find and getting in and out is somewhat difficult since the redesign of the roundabout at Keystone Parkway.

I love me some Starbucks but I only stop here if I "HAVE" to.

Yes, I know - 1st world problems.
Great spot in the heart of whyte to enjoy a coffee. Great outside patio as well for people watching

They really screwed this one up. I used to love coming here, maybe my favorite Starbucks. Unfortunately the management decided to fix something that wasn't broke.

Gone are the soft surfaces and inviting colors. Replacing then are hard cheap firnishings and a color scheme reminiscent of American Horror Story.

The last two times I went it took over 10 minutes to get my coffee. In four visits I have not been able to successfully connect to the Why-Try (Wi-Fi).

What a shame. Gotta find a new spot.

Pretty slow Starbucks.

Ordered my venti iced green tea sweetened and waited about 10 minutes for my drink. Note that there were only three other people ahead of me and the place wasn't busy.

I have never gone to this Starbucks and had it be less than a 20-30 minute ordeal. The customer service is terrible, they act annoyed by you. I understand it's a busy location but there is no sense of urgency and when there's not a single person in front of you and you ask about your coffee after waiting 15 minutes and they roll your eyes at you? I've given this location several second chances, but I will not be returning. Too many other great local coffee shops in the area.

I know what you guys are going to say. Ugh why is Carlos reviewing Starbucks? STARBUCKS. INDEPENDENT COFFEE SHOP KILLERS OF THE UNITED STATES. *Shocked*. *Flabbergasted*. *Two thumbs down*. *Zero stars*.

Now I'm going to admit that I like Starbucks. Why do I like Starbucks? Simple. Free and fast internet. Lots of plugs and tables. Free water. Starbucks is essentially a free work-space  where you don't feel guilty if you buy a coffee or not because Starbucks is making bank internationally regardless.

Now why am I writing a review about this location? It's 24 hours. It is the ONLY 24 hour place in all of Brandon (and one of the few in all of Tampa Bay) and being the night-owl that I am it is a safe-haven for getting work done and also being able to grab a coffee late at night.

The coffee? It's Starbucks. If you want a delicious coffee go somewhere else, if you want a convenient coffee, there is Starbucks.

Slow, unfriendly, and inefficient. Not sure how the experience here could be worse... Perhaps if they screwed up the order...

Totally underwhelmed and not at all up to the standard of a usual Starbucks.

I would walk next door and get coffee from Bread Co. next time.
Been here many times before but haven't in awhile. Staff seemed hurried but there wasn't a big crowd. Didn't feel as intimate as some other Starbucks stores staff are. Drink was good as usual

If I could give one star. I totally would. I ordered a bagel. The woman grabbed the bagel with her bare hands. I didn't see her wash or hands or put any gloves on. I'm kind of disgusted. With all the food issues going on lately. I would've expected better service and cleanliness.

My go to place to study while in the city for college. Great WiFi. Nice employees. And a pretty good overall vibe. It's just a bit small which totally creates a problem more times than not, if you're trying to find a spot to sit with an outlet.
Spacious yet cozy Starbuck with mostly window seatings allows you to enjoy your coffee, contemplating on life, and people watch.

It was a hot day, and I had a reward so I came in. There were two baristas working, three would have been nicer. With three they would have time to take care of the full trash cans. The girls are working their tails off. 

My Java Chip Frap hit the spot, and the air conditioning felt good. The girls are very friendly and give fast service. It looks like there are plenty of outlets. One drawback is no outdoor seating. I hope management will staff this location better so the girls aren't killing themselves.
Horribly slow when it was almost empty and a bunch of degenerates hanging around

busy busy busy
I always use my app to get stuff here.   cause man there is a line.
but thats a good thing.
standard starbucks filled with customers and great employees.

This has been my go-to Starbucks for 3 years now and so far its been awesome. They are always so nice and don't mind getting creative for me when I want to try something off the secret menu. They're also really polite and sweet with my kid when I bring her in, and there is always available seating (even during the busy hours).
Great conversion and reuse keeping the feel of the old house while making it familiar. Friendly team here.
Great place employee that serves me allways make feel welcome.  I really like going here I hope they keep up the good experience for customers. Yes I recommend this Starbucks to my friends.

From my wife: "This Starbucks gets my order wrong 9/10." Given how awesome my wife is, I give her the benefit of the doubt. 

Granted, this location has a nice lounge area, which I'm sure inflates the higher-than-appropriate rating. But from my perspective, just because you have a chillax-conducive environment doesn't mean you're quality with respect to service. If any establishment wants a good rating, it's important it honors the customer by listening.
The employees are rude and have no personality. It's always difficult to order at this location.

By far, my favorite Starbucks, anywhere in the world.   I miss it every day.  Cozy fireplace on cold Tucson mornings.  Open early, by 5:30 am, like clockwork.  Dappled sunlight on the patio, lazy locals on Sunday morning.  Colorful bicyclists vying for the key to the bathroom (thanks, Bridget, for your kindness!).  Oh, yeah, and great coffee, too.
~Tracey, from Tokyo

probably the most unfriendliest starbucks staff ever. when I ordered a soy latte the first day I wondered about the extra charge (starbucks wont charge you extra for soy in europe where I come from). the answer was "because it is...". next day i steped into the store just at 5 PM asking for a coffee. the denied because they closed 10 seconds ago. horrible staff!!!
I think I just enjoy the convenience of a coffee drive though. I'm not sure I even like Starbucks but I don't mind your frappuccinos in the summer.

Decent coffee chain, though it lacks the charm and quality of a small town cafe. The Frappuccinos are icy drinks perfect for hot southern summers, however almost everything here is very sweet. Often, I get items 1/2 sweet with only 2 pumps of syrup, including their iced teas.The oatmeal and breakfast sandwiches are their best food options. The service is usually quick, and it's a clean place to use WiFi and have a cup of coffee.

Although this particular location does not have a drive thru but local patrons do make an effort to come in. Why? Because of the service! They will know your name and drink order right when you walk in. Always friendly and service is speedy.

This Starbucks has bad customer service. They didn't wipe off my drink and I told them I had rewards twice I wanted to use and they said sorry I already put it through when I asked a third time about making sure they used the reward.

Sure, "Starbuck's is Starbuck's", but it's ALL about the customer service.  One time I ordered a venti iced soy chai tea latte and got an "Are you effing kidding me?" look from the guy behind the counter.  What's wrong with a chai latte...iced...with soy. I don't think I'm being that high maintenance.  I did have to smile to myself, however, when he spilled it just as he was putting the lid on and had to re-make it.

Also, for some reason this location does not make iced coffee in winter.  When I ordered it I was told they don't make it in winter, but she could make it another way for me if I liked, so I said yes - and I don't know what she did, but it was about 100 times better than their regular iced coffee. (OK, so this is a plus, but I still hate the place).

Also, I've witnessed who I assume is the manager berating an employee on the phone for being late once again, right in front of the customers, which I thought was extremely unprofessional.
