Overall poor service... it's never speedy and I'm usually worried they are going to get some aspect of the drink wrong.  Saw a guy wait so long for his misto he had to leave before it was ready.  Lame.

Typical Starbucks coffees. 

I only write to request that someone feng shui this place. The flow is so strange in this Starbucks that I actually made a metal note to say something about it later. When you walk in the side door you walk smack into a huge display that completely hides the register. Then you're stuck going around this gargantuan display, but there's no clear path so you have lines going in both directions around the display and no one knows who's first. Then when you're waiting to pick up your drink, you're standing directly in the way of the other main door. And to top it off, the cream/sugar station is right in front of the front door, so you're getting bumped while you're trying to stir and the whole experience is just awkward from start to finish.
Don't pick up mobile orders from the drive-through at this location. The employees got really nasty with me! This location is super convenient but the service is awful.

The service painfully slow and the employees seem clueless. They were out of my first two beverage choices. I ordered an iced green tea latte. What I got was a cup of almond milk with clumps of matcha. I asked if this was how it's usually made and if there was anything that could be done about the clumps. An employee, who informed me he was on his lunch break, said there was nothing that could be done that the clumps are normal and perhaps I should just shake it up myself. He said he would re-make it for me but, again, he was on his lunch break. Great. Thanks for your help buddy. The best they could do is blend it into a frappacinno. Another employee begrudgingly tried to fix it but it didn't help. This store is just a mess overall.

What's the hell is the deal with parking? I mean, there's seriously like six spots and they were ALL full. Nevertheless, I was on the road and my GPS took me to two starbucks that were closed early, so I was not leaving without a coffee so I parked at wawa and hoped that their sign about parking was a bluff. When I got in, I waited for 20 minutes while one guy pumped out coffees and rang people up -- apparently his co-workers went on break and decided to stick the poor guy with the line. It looked like he was really swamped and I felt bad for the guy. He actually did a good job on my latte but all in all I don't think it was a good experience and would likely chose another nearby store.

Potentially the the worst Starbucks in the entire chain. If you plan on mobile ordering, do it approximately 30 to 45 minutes before you need to pick up the order. They are chronically slow, even when they're not that busy. You're better off going to nearby Mamas Kitchen or Cook's deli to satisfy your morning cravings.

Not surprised to see a little bit lower rating for this Starbucks; the service was fine.  I stopped in to get on some internet for a bit; there was no seating available.  The store is just a little too small and they've tried to make it work with a lot of outdoor seating.   I was happy to get my salted caramel mocha... yummy.

As all Starbucks this one was as busy as you'd expect and without a lot of seating. The unexpected pleasure here was the service provided by Sara who took my order. While taking my order Sara was welcoming and outgoing and very pleasant to speak to. Afterwards she was helpful and enthusiastic answering my questions. As I was leaving I said to my husband, WOW, every business needs a Sara. You leave with a pleasant experience and Sara makes you feel her best friend. She even double checked my order before picking up. Go for the coffee but hope Sara's taking your order.

Morning crew needs work (regular guy in the morning..never ask can I help you just stands there starring at you, fixes things while there's aline out the door, can I help the next person...Nope none of that!! Maybe he would be better making drinks instead of a greeter.)

Oh my goodness... all Starbucks in Nashville seem to be soooooo slow and this location is no different. Where is the sense of urgency? I have been to this Starbucks five times since moving here at the end of November and am consistently disappointed. Don't get me wrong, the drinks here are just as good as you'd expect. But I'm looking for quick service and this location just isn't meeting my expectations.

When I am in Metairie, this is the only location I go to! The staff is always fast and friendly, they make the drink just right! I think it is a certain crew, that works on a particular day that screws up my order, I rarely see them! This is a great location when I can catch Jen, the black guy, and the tall white guy working! I need to find out the other guys names to leave a huge tip one day for them! They always have the drink right, and are fast and professional!

I haven't figured out why this Starbucks isn't rated very well. Now that I've been a dozen times to this particular location I think I can safely say it's met my needs just fine! 

I have the mobile app and am always getting different offers to try new things and I generally go for them unless I'm just trying to take a quick shot of espresso and get on with my day. The various offers on the app are to try new things and you're rewarded bonus stars which can later be redeemed for food and drinks. Trying new things and earning free things is a win win for me. Thanks to the offers I've discovered some teavana tea flavors I really like (peach green tea and mango black tea) and the new almond milk and coconut milk macchiatos are fantastic. The pink drink with coconut milk and strawberry acai refresher is a little sweet but delicious and just the right amount of caffeine for me before exercising. I drank one about an hour before a long bike ride and it was the perfect extra boost. The sandwiches are also delicious in the morning when you're in the mood for a quick and hot most-important-meal-of-the-day. 

Biggest plus to me is I live within walking distance and I order it on the app and walk up straight to the mobile orders and grab my stuff and am on my way! Blows my mind more people don't do that. 

The place is usually pretty packed inside and relatively packed outside so I can see if you're looking for a place to plug-in and work for a while it's not ideal. Possibly hard at times to find work space I imagine in the busier hours. 

Once in a blue a milk or something will be out in the little drink prep area and you'll have to wave an employee down to refill but who really gets bent out of shape about that? It's a busy place. 

For me the ease of ordering and quality of what I get is all I care about and this location has done good by me!

Yesterday was my first time at the store. The staff was very friendly and courteous. The store is very clean, the wait time was very quick. The only problem I have with this store, is there parking could be better. I will be very happy to visit the store again in the future.

I ordered a nonfat Carmel macchiato with  light foam and extra caramel and the banging blonde named Carolyn (super hot) got my name and my order perfectly. I was extremely impressed when I received my order with no mistakes as requested and faster than anticipated. I would give this girl 6 out of 5 stars but unfortunately I'm restricted to five. Go in on Fridays to meet this angelic barista and get your super complicated order perfected quickly and efficiently.
I think they have new leadership at this location. It is still slow and alot of the staff is not friendly but it's better than it was.

Reading other reviewer's reviews on this place confirms my experience tonight, that the service has gone downhill at this particular location. I have been a Starbucks customer for over a decade and all over the country (and a few places overseas) and have NEVER been treated so rudely by an employee. I wasn't watching the clock (though clearly they were) and was yelled at that "Sir, its 10 o'clock and I'm locking the door!" Really? Was that a threat to lock me in or a euphemism for "get the F*&^ out." I'll go with both. I worked as a barista at Sbucks years ago and they trained us to professional and courteous and quick to please, not treat customers like mangy dogs. The staff there needs to 1. Do a better job at hiring employees who care about thier customer service and 2. Do a better job at training to be customer service orientated. The higher ups at Starbucks went through a lot of trouble to train and maintain high quality standards years ago because sales were dropping, and history is going to repeat itself if this crap keeps up.

Starbucks is Starbucks, so reviews can only be based so much on the quality of the product since hopefully it should be fairly consistent. My review is about the service at this particular location...I frequent this location since it's the one closest to me, but I'm going to have to scout out a different location now since this place just isn't cutting it anymore. The barista's here always seem to be grouchy, I've never encountered one here yet in my 10+ visits that has been remotely friendly. Fine, whatever, just give me my damned coffee. The last time I was there was what broke this coffee addict's back. A newbie took our order...didn't know now to process a transaction off a Starbucks card, didn't know how to refill my card, and allowed the line to reach the door while she fumbled with figuring it out instead of just asking a co-worker for help. It might not have been so bad if she could've at least tried to be a little friendly, but she was actually pretty rude...I know the learning process is stressful, but don't be a B about it. And why was the newbie the only one taking orders at the counter as the line continued to grow? Somebody get in there and help her out! She then gave my bf a cup of the wrong coffee and we made the mistake of stepping out of line and then getting back in line to correct the order, since by the time we got back up to the register, they were out of the coffee the bf wanted. By this time, another employee was fiiinally helping out, but...couldn't seem to understand the question "will you be brewing more coffee?" so that was also fun. Then after we waited for new coffee to be brewed, they tried to pass us off with a half empty cup of coffee. Sigh. SoooOOOOooo frustrating I just don't want to go back

Not the fastest baristas on the block but a friendly staff makes up for it. I believe every Septa stop needs a Starbucks like this one. I come on the earlier train out from the city just so I can enjoy the taste of a my venti vanilla black-eye. Train is long and I need to be refreshed!!!

Typical Starbucks! Hip music in the background, friendly baristas, neat store with cool designs on the wall.

First time trying the maple pecan latte and it was a whole lot better than PLS  (yes I said it). Love the smoothness of the coffee and the flavor is not overwhelming. Highly recommended !

Not related but one of the fuse went out while we were waiting in line and I guess that was the highlight of my day. No one got hurt and the staff were great in defusing the situation.
Slow and dirty best explain this location my iced coffee was horrible and I got snapped at by a bitch employee who wears a jeff cap. I will never visit this location again and won't miss it at all

Oh, Mill Woods Town Centre Starbucks - I have tried, really tried to like you. I tried to forgive you the first time, when the barista made my Orange Refresher with extra ice instead of light ice and tried to tell me that there wasn't supposed to be any orange pieces included in the drink. 
I forgave you when you forgot my cookie and made me wait in line to let the new staff member on till that I had paid for that delicious fruit and oat cookie that was calling to me from the pastry case. 
But three strikes and I am afraid that you are out. My americano misto was so watery that I had to toss it in the trash. I am quite sure the proper number of espresso shots were not put into that concoction of watery, milky, semi coffee flavoured beverage. 
I don't mean to nitpick, but at $5 a drink and with a Starbucks nearby no matter where you are in the city, my drink has to be right or else I'm driving to the next 'Bucks...even if it is not quite as convenient. Sorry our relationship was so short, it's not me - it's you.

This store is wonderful! I come here almost every day and the staff is great. It gets very busy during the morning rush so take that into account. But the new ordering from the Starbucks App is perfect to avoid waiting in line. The manager, Merry, has a great staff of baristas right now- probably the best in recent years. The drinks are always great.

This Starbucks is my favorite one in the Nashville area.  Most of the staff here are extremely friendly and even remember my name, despite being one of the busiest Starbucks I've ever been to.  It isn't unusual to have a long line inside and out and to have difficulty finding parking, but everything moves through fairly quickly, despite the volume of customers their serving.

Inside is noisy and the drive thru is perpetually packed. But the staff is super friendly and they do what they can to manage such a busy location. If you need a place to hang out and chill maybe read a book, you may want to choose another business. If you want some tasty coffee drinks and maybe don;t want to get out of the car, this place is for you. 
Just a quick tip: Don't park in front where the drive thru entrance is. Even if the drive thru is deserted, it fills up in 0.3 seconds and you'll be waiting 10 minutes for the car in line behind you to move so you can back out and leave. If the next guy in line lets you back out...

Super friendly staff. Drive through so awesome with small kids and don't have to go. Can't go in and sit down. Biggest downside is the fact that you can only get in certain ways into it but that's due to the location. I love this place.

Four stars just because the drive through people are awesome.  The guy was super nice and when I pulled up to the window --- best smile.  I love it when people just have that happy sparkle.  

My latte was hot and the service was fast.  I will have to check out the inside one day.

Honestly they were out of everything we tried to order except for a white chocolate mocha... this is a busy location, but it's right by my house.  The guys working here are super awesome and were as accommodating as possible... in the end I just feel bad that they weren't set up for a busy Sunday by upper management.

Nevermind... I wrote this post as I was eating my second spinach feta wrap.  The first one was cold in the center so I sent it back. The second one came back the same way.  The first couple of bites are scorching, then by the time I get to the middle, it's freezing.   The heating methods they are using here are horrible.

I mean....it's a Starbucks. 

It's pretty standard as far as the chain goes. When I came here a few days ago with a friend it was actually pretty quiet. My drink came out really quickly and everyone there was very friendly.

My biggest complaint is the parking situation. Starbucks has four total allocated spots in an otherwise permit-only lot, and one of those spots is a designated handicapped spot. Considering how empty Starbucks was, I was left to wonder whether patrons of other local businesses parked in the Starbucks spots.

I HATE Starbucks.

After trying to find a reason to overpay for coffee, still can't find a reason. This place is just like every other I've been to. Pretentious yuppies that try to be something they are not. They want to save the world but drink their coffee in this horrible joint. The employees will always treat you like a idiot because you know nothing about the menu.

If you love Starbucks and want to act trendy, you'll love this place. I'll stick to my truck stop coffee that someone made 3 days prior.
Not to happy with this starbucks, don't go in with a big order they don't like it. And they can't print you receipt s 90% of the time cause they say their computer is broken.

This Starbucks is fairly new, but it's close to home & everyone is so nice. My friends, fiancé and I come here a lot... we love to do the challenges from the app and earn our stars for free rewards, and sometimes we just need an awesome chill spot.
Staff is friendly and fast. They know my name and drink choice without asking me. Awesome service.

This Sbux is the best! The service was super friendly. Since it's in the Hyatt lobby it's not a store that honors gold card rewards but the barista wishes me a very happy birthday and gave me my PSL for free. Now that's customer service!

Great little neighborhood Starbucks. Our favorite. Not as busy. More likely to be soccer moms or dads after workouts than the corporate rush. Love it! Saturday mornings are best. Drinks well made and baristas know what they're doing!
this is one of my favorite drive through startbucks locations around Tucson.  Staff is always super friendly and efficient getting you through the drive through.  They also always get my drink right!
Internet speeds from the 90's. Great place to work and hang if you don't depend on Internet.

I only come here, because my mom gives me free gift cards that she gets. 

Good Lord, the music in here is so DAMN LOUD. For the most part, the line moves quickly.  So, they get a couple of stars for that. 

Want to escape outside? Get ready to get hassled by panhandlers.  Also--tourist central. Enter at your own risk.

Like every Starbucks, there's a wait but the staff is energetic and friendly and really seem to know a lot about their regulars. Unlike the one closer to my home in West Chester, this one doesn't have hatefully long lines so if I'm in the mood for a marked up white chocolate mocha, this is my go to Starbucks location. 

I get in and out fastest at this location.

I had a great experience at this Starbucks. I had to pull over during my two hour commute because I was sick. The workers let me stay in the shop until I felt better - over two hours! 

Of course Starbucks has great coffee and snacks, but the service I experienced at this particular one was great!
Going going gone! Sorry to see this Starbucks close. It did not have the largest layout but it was a great place to answer emails over a cup o' joe.

Actually, this store is at 1490, not 1468.  I found the crew in a nasty mood this morning....overweight women with bad attitudes and a chip on their shoulders, just going through the motions.  No music and the bathroom was a mess.  This store is a LONG way from Seattle, figuratively and literally!
Same as any other Starbucks. The service is very pleasant here. The atmosphere is comfy and clean

there are few things i ask for in a starbucks:

-pleasant but not overly gregarious baristas
-consistently well-made upside-down caramel macchiatos
-a drive -thru window if it's not in an "urban" environment because having the option of not getting my daughter out of her carseat and walking back to the car with a baby and a hot coffee is good.

this location has everything.

What great service! This is one of the best experiences I have had at a Starbucks (and I have been to many)! The staff is so extremely friendly and the shop itself is clean and has a great outdoor patio. Will definitely be going back.

Would be 4.5 stars... but I will happily round that up! 

We went on the day we visited Longwood Gardens. Since we left late morning, we had to find a place to eat for lunch before visiting the gardens. Considering I'm a Starbucks, we decided to eat here. This location is just a few blocks away from the entrance to the parking lot of the Gardens. 

Easily located right off of US-1, this Starbucks is part of a strip mall, known as the The Shoppes at Longwood Village. Hey, if the shoppers need their caffeine fix for buying clothes or groceries, they certainly have this place for that! If you see the sign for this strip mall, then you'll know that Starbucks is in there. This, however, is part of a smaller building, which is separate from the main building where other stores (including "anchors") are attached. Because this parking lot is huge, finding a spot was never a problem.

We walked into the store. It was small, but not the smallest that we've ever been to. They had some areas for you to sit at, but it's never enough to accommodate a huge crowd who wants to sit down and unwind with coffee and/or food while accessing the free WIFI (which was how I checked in here via Yelp! LOL). At least the wooden chairs were okay and the table was clean.

The people behind the registers were nice, and our paninis were toasted up without issue. We also got some iced white mochas too, and they were good, especially on a warm day. As we were eating, a lady from behind the register approached us and offered some samples of two of their seasonal items. One of them was a Michigan Cherry Oat Bar, and that tasted really good! Another item was a small berry drink. I don't remember the exact name of it, nor didn't I care for it as I thought it was just okay. It's not often I get free samples from Starbucks since I was being a patron, and because of this generous act, the full rating is warranted. 

Overall, the store was nice and customer service was flawless. I would say that this is as good as it gets. Woo! :D

I don't really drink coffee a lot. I love love love the shaken passion fruit ice tea lemonade sweetened! I also enjoy the pastries. Yummy! Staff is quick and friendly. The place is always clean. There is plenty of space for hanging out, studying, reading, relaxing or chatting with friends. I always grab and go and sometimes twice a day!

I had to quickly write a review for this location as it is night and day compared to the Marlton location. The employees are smiling(gasp) knew my name and even asked where I had been. There was no scowling or whispering!  I have heard from many people that the MARLTON Starbucks is only nice to a select few and that they always look miserable!  Anyway so refreshing this morning to see smiling happy faces!!

Wholly agree with Jenny!  This place is filthy. The condiment table needs to be cleaned. Have frequented this Starbucks for a long time. Recently it has fallen off particularly in cleanliness and seemingly service too lately. One barista a couple of weeks ago made me feel sorry for asking for a bold pour over. Tonight put the icing on the cake. The hot coffee is frigging COLD!

These are my fave Starbucks people! I normally hit to closest one when I need my Sbux fix but, if I'm in the area, I will make it a point to hit this one up, these guys are so much fun.  It's been a long time since I've come across a consistently enjoyable crew who care about their customers.

The service at this Starbucks is AMAAAZING. They always make my detailed drink to a T and their new manager Emma is one of the kindest most welcoming people I have ever met. You need to come to this Starbucks or you will surely miss out!

This is a nice location with plenty of seats and tables to sit at. Unlike most of the other starbucks in the area, this particular starbucks is very quiet, with most people on their laptops minding their own business and not having loud conversations that can be extremely distracting when you just want to work on your laptop. My favorite drink here is the iced green tea...nothing is better than a nice cool drink during a very hot summer day! And when I'm done with the first round, its only another 50 cents for a refill.

This location is so slow!  There is always a long line in the drive thru and no one inside, so I thought I could save time by running in.  Not the case.  When there is only one person making the drinks it will not make a difference.  As I waited for my drink I counted 7 total employees  and only one making drinks?!  That doesn't make any sense to me at all.  While I waited I wandered around the shop and the place was filthy, none of those 7 employees were cleaning either.  There were wrappers on the floor, spilled coffee, sugar & cream on the counter.  I wouldn't not have touched the tops of the tables they appeared to be sticky and need a good wipe down and you could see where someone must have dropped their coffee and when I hit the ground splashed all over the window, and no one ever wiped it down.  I like Starbucks but this location is disgusting...

It won't replace Peet's in my heart, but it's a better cup of coffee than the other chain places in town. The staff is quite friendly and seem to work well in keeping the line moving at a brisk clip.

I've also become attached the weekly iTunes app giveaways. 

Dammit.

I'm a lifelong starbucks drinker, love the place and the happy culture and the service. I went in this morning and the two baristas were major grumpsters. I know it was 6am but man I do NOT go to Starbucks for that sort of attitude. Total turn-off and not a great way to start my day, having to put up with extreme attitude to get my coffee.
I drive through this location just about every morning before work. The line moves fast and Gracie is awesome!

Their new manager Emma is wonderful! She is running this establishment like a true manager. The drinks are delicious, baristas are nice, and the line moves by extremely quickly. Makes us, the customers, super happy! Great work Emma!

OK..this Worldwide franchise sits on corner , between Bridge & Main st, sure gets good business. Love the fact its right on corner, pillar , from old building . The inside is quaint, very spacious. I usually get my latte, while walking around New Hope-when it gets colder. Across the st is Little mom & pop coffee place, find it never has anyone in there, hard to compete-with Starbucks.
I love coming here.  Parking is in the back.  Plenty of places to sit.  I like that it is a reserve store.  They have reserve coffee that are not available at regular starbucks.

Pretty long line on Saturday morning--probably filled with the hungover people, like my husband!  They were very efficient with their line, though, and got us through pretty quickly.

Great blueberry muffin, although the husband doesn't think it's as good as it used to be--apparently they changed their recipe.

But their lemon squares are just meh.  I don't drink coffee, but my husband seems to enjoy it at $3 a pop... *shrug*

Other than traffic on Overland making getting out of the parking lot being a bit dicey at times, I ADORE this Starbucks location.  It is my reward spot after surviving shopping at the HELL that is WalMart, which is across the street.  They are quick to take your order and on par with wait times at other Starbucks locations in Boise.  I've had some great short chats with the folks working the drive up window.

I think that this Starbucks location is my favorite Starbucks to visit in the Reno/Sparks area. Being surrounded by windows allows a lot of natural light to come in which helps if you are working or studying. I also like how the walls are lined with outlets which keeps it easy to stay plugged in.

Check out this location on a warm day and enjoy the patio seating!

Guess Starbucks is okay if I can't get to a CC's or if I am with someone who's regular spot is Starbucks. I'll go for a mocha frap, it's not too bad. Can't really say too much about it though since that is all I ever get and I am more of a local coffee kind of girl. Sorry Starbucks, know you have some loyal fans.

Brand new location! I was excited watching it built as I am a daily visitor, and this location is closer to my home plus a drive through. But...I have been twice and my family has went also. Each time, our coffees have been wrong. Also, they have a rough time understanding the orders. Maybe as they learn the business, things will improve? Until then, I will go back to my usual spots and skip this one!

Went in here with co worker, he wanted to stop in get chocolate chip frappicino , hint of raspberry. Wow, I ended getting lite caramel frappicino.Nice......not too sweet, Love to indulge, but I can feel the affects when I do during the week, on my work outs , so try not to eat bad . But all in all, service was good, nice Starbucks, located facing Rte.70 -by Wegman's.
Honestly best Starbucks around. Friendly staff. Very clean. And you will get a perfect drink every time. The outdoor seating is nice but is on a busy road. Fast and accurate drive thru.

This location is a artistry type Starbucks, down-to-earth vibe location. Very nice and friendly staff. Though, they gave my order to someone else. They apologized with a $4 card. How sweet is that? Will definitely make this my local Starbucks as the one in Westchase has NO PARKING! AT ALL!

Look they allow S M O K I N G ...!!!!!
They also allow  bleach spraying while ordering roasted coffee and the aroma of delicious sandwiches! Yum!

This is the perfect location for an SBCC student like myself to study, socialize, and grab a drink. The service is always great, very friendly staff. Also, try the Very Berty Hibiscus Refresher if you haven't already. I'm not sure why there's so many bad reviews, so don't give up on this location. It's really great.

Every single time I have come here, they are out of the salted caramel salt. I thought that maybe it was just a bad month, because it happened like 5 times in a row. But at this point it has kind of become comical. Don't ask for it, because they don't have it. Or maybe they don't like my face. The world will never know. That being said, I have rated this 5 stars and will continue to pay outrageous prices for sweet delicious coffee.

Better than Maple Street S'bucks because it has more seating and A LOT more parking. This location has many more regular customers who are not students. Plus it's on Magazine Street which is fun and convenient.

Personnel here are extremely consciencious. I forgot my computer power cable here once and they had it all wrapped up in a nice little package for when I sheepishly stopped back in to retrieve it.

Store workers informed me that a store remodel is in the plans.

This is very much a normal, well-run, nice-sized (places to study/meet groups/people watch), very clean Starbucks with an itty bitty parking lot that they share with a pizza place. Yes, "itty bitty" is the phrase I would use for this parking lot. but so far I've always found a place to park. 

I like this Starbucks because it is about a 2 minute drive (depending on the lights)  away from the entrance/exit of I-95. So if you are traveling North I highly recommend you take the extra time because once you pass it there are no other (nice) places to stop for coffee until you get WAY past Philly.

Went in on 1/19/17 and the tall dark haired worker whose name was Nick (I believe) said 3 really mean things to his coworker in the spend of 2 minutes. The girl in line next to me even made a comment of how rude he was. I felt very bad for the girl he said it to. it ruined the experience

As a former "partner" (Starbucks employee), I just can't kick that SBux habit. I know the standards, and I hate the stores that don't follow standards (looking at you, Canal Place location) because they are truly there for a reason. I will call you out on it gladly.
That said, these guys can make my iced venti 3 pump classic no water passion tea (summer) or my triple grande nonfat mocha (winter) correctly every time, and with a smile. I truly appreciate that.
Plus, if you can grab a table, it's a great place to study or get work done.

Prob the absolute worst Starbucks I've ever been to in my entire life. Mobile orders average 15-20 mins and if you order more than one item you wait 2-7 mins before receiving each item. I submitted my mobile order at 9:42 and didn't receive three items until 10:02. Forget asking the manager, the few times she's actually out there she's rude to the customers, as well as her staff.

This is by far the slowest Starbucks I have been too and after waiting at the drive thru for 11 minutes for the 4 cars in front of me, they inform me that they don't have the gluten free sandwich I ordered.  This is the 2nd time that has happened to me at that location (but didn't wait 11 minutes the first time)

Never had anything short of great customer service. My iced coffee is always good and tastes consistent every time. The only thing deterring me from giving it five stars is how long it takes to get a drink. Some days the drive thru is very quick, but most days it takes around ten minutes to get through the drive thru.
Other than that, it's a clean location with cheerful batistas and great coffee.
Very slow service here. Not a very well thought out drive thru or access plan. Drinks do not taste consistently as they should.
I Always get positive attitudes here!Great Place to get your drinks made like you order them.Yes,on a rare occasion mistakes are made when reading an order,just not EVERY DAY FOR OVER A WEEK.

Very green apron! 
Love the crew :)

THESE guys are the best Starbucks in the WORLD!!!

Of all the Starbucks I've been to in my life, this was surely the busiest.  It was INSANE.  The entire parking lot was full, then drive-thru line stretched around the lot blocking people in, and the line to order was never shorter than five people deep when I was there.

So I left, I couldn't handle it.  ;-)

Coffee with a smile, fast friendly service. It's really nice having a Starbucks on base that I can stack up rewards points. Speaking of rewards points you can't claim your rewards at this Starbucks, while that is a bummer I didn't see it as a reason to big enough for me to deduct a star since there are plenty of other Starbucks around town.

This Starbucks location was a meeting point for a walking tour of the Garden District we did while in NOLA.  But, I also learned a valuable lesson too!

ATMOSPHERE:
It's a long and narrow space with lots of windows letting in natural light.  No drive thru. 

BEVERAGE:
Iced Coffee 
Here's where my aha moment occurred.  While I've been to Starbucks numerous times, I always order a Frappuccino or smoothie, hardly ever an iced coffee as I don't want to make (mix) my own drink.  In the past, I'm usually given coffee over ice and forced to head to the condiment station, open the lid, discard some coffee so I can add cream, add sugar, and try best I can to stir them well with a straw or stirrer as opposed to using an unavailable spoon.  No thank you.  I might as well make it at home!  But, on this particular morning, I didn't want anything heavy or overly sweet, so I but on my big boy pants and was ready for a mixology session, or so I thought.  After placing my order, the barista asked "Would you like it with or without milk?'  Dumbfounded, I said "With milk."  "Sweetened?" she asked.  "Yes!"  Low and behold, I received an iced coffee, 100% made for me!  My labor?  Insert a straw and grab a napkin.  That's what I'm talking about!  It was perfectly sweetened and creamed.  

SERVICE:
Cashier service was fairly quick yet very thorough and their baristas rocked!

OVERALL:
Starbucks Corp:  Thanks to this shop on Magazine Street in New Orleans, you've gained an iced coffee fan!  If I don't receive the same ordering questions at my local shop, I know now that I can "have it my way."
Great Starbucks, friendly and helpful staff. They overfilled my drink and there was no milk out but when I went to the counter they quickly fixed my drink for me.
They just can't get it right in the drive threw!  Every time we go there they either forget the sugar completely or no cream!  Mind you we are asking for light and sweet coffee!

They never get my order right. I've been about 5 times since I moved to Nashville and they have never been able to serve me the drink that I ordered. I think they need to work on their abbreviations or actually look at the receipt.
Love the earl grey tea, most delightful!!!

This is one Starbucks that lives up to there advertising. Friendly employees, fast service and of course the same great coffee that brings me back again and again. The only problem with this location is the parking. Very limited and they share the parking lot with two other restaurants.
Don't think I would come at lunch time. Although they are expensive they are consistent which for me makes it worth it.

To be clear, this is a review of Starbucks on the corner of 13th and Chestnut! This is my second or third poor experience there and definitely the worst and most frustrating.

I went there for coffee on my way to work the other day. I waited patiently while the couple in front of me made up their minds, after 3-4 minutes it dawned on me that they were not making up their mind, rather they were simply looking at things while they waited for service. After 2-3 more minutes of no one addressing them, I asked if they perhaps had placed their order, to which they said no one had even greeted them! I finally called to the employees and asked if anyone was running the registrar since there was now a line of 3 people waiting.

Our orders were taken in the usual fashion, with a slight bump as the new person did not know how to ring a double shot of espresso, but I can be patient, though I was now cutting it close for work. After paying for my coffee, the barista, for lack of a more proper term, took her time making the tea and other simple drink ordered by the couple in front of me, after creating my beverage she said they didn't have any whipped cream (really? in the summer? when half your drinks are cold and offer it? we didn't prepare for the early afternoon?) however, I said I would try just a little of the marshmallow whipped cream, while confirming that it was my double shot frappachino. I was frustrated to learn that she had no idea it was supposed to have that, ether for lack of reading the cup, or as she said, "it must have wiped off." She then made 2 other drinks before going back to making mine, the whole while talking to some other employee who came and walked part way behind the counter in street clothes on his time off, apparently there to just hang out! 

I ended up late for work, with a poorly prepared drink that I paid nearly $9 for, and I will never go back to that location until I start hearing better things.

I am a big fan of Starbucks and this location is no different.  The service is usually friendly and efficient.  The coffee itself is consistently good.  Once and awhile I treat myself to a scone but the high number of calories in their food keeps me from doing that very often.  This Starbucks has a fair amount of seating and is good for meeting people or studying.
my peppermint  mocha taste like crap! bitter..no coffee taste..like plain ice blebded with milk ...suck

Very inconsistent depending on who makes the orders. Mobile orders are less likely to be right based on the printer settings. I've been to some that print exactly as the app shows but this one uses abbreviated versions which leads to quite a few errors. If I can spare the time I much prefer going to the one in Westport or Olive and Price.

I highly recommend this Starbucks.  I realize that I'm supporting a corporate giant, but believe me, there's a reason why I come back to this place. This is one of the busier Starbucks, and yet things always move fast.  More than that, the customer service, is great.  There are times when I go in to get coffee, deal with a barista that I barely remember ever talking to, and yet my name is on the cup, without anyone having to ask.

I've filled up punch card after punch card at local coffee shops, but I've never found warmer service than what I get at the 5th&Nevada Starbucks.

This Starbucks has the typical Starbucks fare, and it is good. If you've been to a Starbucks, the menu can be confusing, but I've always had the baristas suggest something based on what I liked.  The new go-to is a Venti Iced Green Tea Unsweetened for me.

This Starbucks has a drive-thru, which is a good and a bad thing.

The drive-thru gets backed up on the morning commute and all afternoon, average wait of around 7 minutes from the few times I've been at those times. During off-peak times, like late morning, it's very quick. Make sure you time the drive-thru correctly.

If you have the time, take your chances on the drive-thru.

This is a great Starbucks- quick lines, great outdoor seating.

The drive-through can get clown-packed during peak times, but that's life.

The staff is also amazing- friendly, quick.  I bought a mug for a friend as a Christmas gift and the cashier gave me extra tissue and a bag to wrap it.  They definitely go above and beyond!

Well this place looked great on the outside but it was below average on the inside. I walked in and it was pretty empty, only about 5-10 people sitting at the tables on laptops or phones relaxing. 

I was a bit confused when I walked up to the register and no one was there. I was confused and surprised when I realized one of the people relaxing at a table on a cell phone was the employee. She got up, took my order, then proceeded to make my drink while talking on the phone with a friend about ordering a cheesesteak. 

As I left I realized one of the other people on a phone at a table was another employee. Let's just say the customer service is horrible and it seems like the staff is really lazy. 

Do yourself a favor and get a coffee somewhere else.
Ordered a breve latte.  Got something else with half the cup filled with foam.  Staff was busy, but apparently too busy to fix my order.

Loved the convenience of being inside the hotel and not having to walk into the city. Always quick service but as previously stated, they do not accept rewards/coupons from the app. Also it closes at 5pm during the week which was disheartening after sitting all day in classes at the hotel and not being able to enjoy the cafe afterwards. Clean place and friendly staff.

Nice atmosphere. Great lunch choices. Fresh. I had the Thai peanut wrap. Four stars since the wrap was cut in three slices, with all sides open. The sauce was thick and tasty, with just a little heat. They have my fave chocolate milk - Horizon Organic. Pleasant staff.

I've stopped here a few times for coffee now, and have always enjoyed good service and tasty joe.  I've always been waited on quickly and the baristas have all been friendly.

There is a drive thru for those days when you just don't have time to park and go in (huge plus - huge, huge huge), and I've never had to wait very long in line.  

Either way, inside or in the drive thru, I'm a fan of this location.

I went there today to use a card/coupon we received in the mail to visit "the newest downtown Starbucks location." The card says they are open until 6 pm on Sunday; however, when I went shortly after 5 pm they were closed. We then went on the Starbucks and Hilton websites to verify their hours and both also said 6 pm. Very disappointed and it made my decision on which Starbucks to go to a lot easier.

When it comes to getting coffee, my goal is to get fresh, tasty coffee without spending a lot of time looking for it. That is my only goal.
If getting me that coffee is Starbucks' goal, then mission accomplished, Starbucks.
A three-star rating is the best I can do for any Starbucks. Each location is pretty much the same as any other.  The employees are reasonably polite, the service is generally quick, and the layout is generally inviting.
I like great coffee, but I occasionally go to Starbucks anyway.  Starbucks' coffee is good, but not great. I generally drink my coffee black, no sugar, but the standard brews at Starbucks are a bit too bitter, so I either have to add cream and sugar, or get an Americano.  I usually get the Americano.
The primary reason I end up at any Starbucks is the convenience of the locations combined with the very high probability of getting fresh, tasty coffee.

As much as one tries to avoid eating at a non-local chain when in New Orleans, sometimes PJs just doesn't cut it. For when that happens, this Starbucks is fine. The Northeasterners from Tulane flock here.

This is probably the worst Starbucks I've ever been to.  It's a shame that this is the one I now live closest to, because I frequent Starbucks.  But some of the employees here are so rude that it makes me never want to come back.

I have been coming to this Starbucks fairly regularly for over a year now.  Orders are frequently forgotten/botched, drinks have been poorly made on more than one occasion (I'm talking the same old crappy ice in an iced coffee refill or very little ice in a venti latte, to the point where you take a swig of warm latte), and some employees are downright rude.

If I had experienced this poor service one or two or three or four times over the course of a year then fine; that can happen anywhere.  But I'm talking cross your fingers...you don't know what you're going to get when you come here.  You get a bad experience about 30% of your visits here.

It's important to note that this rudeness does not apply to every employee at this location, however.  I have experience the entire staff there and a handful are nice, cheerful people who do not give the customer any attitude.  Many, though, are the exact opposite.  Unacceptable.
Slowest Starbucks Ever!! I've been to this location multiple times and it has never taken less than 20 minutes to get a drink.

I can always count on Starbucks when the little shops let me down!  
I changed my mind several times, even gave back a drink, and the staff worked with a smile the entire time!  Not only were they nice, but they were FAST!  The last thing I want is a SLOW coffee shop.

Summary: Run-of-the-mill Starbucks with great baristas!

I usually stop by here a couple times a week on my way to work or on my way home. It's right next to the station, the baristas are very good at their job, and the wait never goes longer than 2-3 minutes. I'm definitely willing to wait 2-3 minutes for my drinks.

The only reason that I would ever not go to this place is if I was in the mood for regular black coffee. If you're in this area, check out the little coffee shop on the inbound platform (going towards Philadelphia).

Tip: this place is open pretty late, but make sure to not miss the last train back to the city while chillin' and talking to the baristas (been there, done that). It ain't fun (or cheap).

No ice in the ICED mocha expresso.  I swear it's warm, not even remotely cold.  To add insult to injury, they never called out my drink order once it was prepared.  Probably waited an extra 10 minutes twiddling my thumbs.  

It's really shocking because no one else had ordered a drink after me and it was obvious that the drink order was mine.

This is by far my FAVORITE Starbucks location. The staff is amazing and is always ready to answer any questions I have about new items! They never fail to make me an excellent drink super quickly! Let's not forget how great Mike is! His energy and kind manor is the best part about this store, absolutely love it!

Yet another Starbucks and just as consistent as all the others.  This one has two things going for it that I like.

1. Starbucks is known for their incredibly tight parking lots.  This one is better than most.
2. They share this parking lot with a Phillie Pretzel Factory.  I prefer a pretzel instead of the overpriced, insane calories of the Starbucks bakery case.

This is the first time I've been in the Starbucks and I've been around for a long time. I just never make it to this little stretch of West Chester Pike. But since I discovered the bagel place down the road I figured I'd stop in for coffee to go with my my bagel.

The service here is not great. They're not rude but they're not really friendly and they are kind of slow.    However I have to say that I got one of the best Starbucks cappuccino that I've had in a long time.   For that reason I gave these folks at four-star rather than a three star rating.

Parking here is definitely a lot easier than it is at the other Havertown Starbucks.  I don't think this gets as much traffic plus they share a parking lot with the pretzel company so I think that has a lot to do with it.

Worst Starbucks ever! Don't expect to get to work on time with stopping at this Starbucks. I waiting 20 mins for a coffee it's ridiculous. It's understandable to be running behind sometimes but it's every time here. They should accommodate there costumers in some way.

All brand spanking new of course, this new location shares a space with a Mattress Direct and features two separate vehicle entrances and a drive-thru. Outside seating totals 4 tables while inside has a large table of 10, a 4-top, 4 couch seats and a couple of 2-seater stools. Free wifi of course and standard menu items, staff is friendly!

The place is right across from the Sunset Hills shops like Home Depot, Old Navy, Bed Bath etc. so it's convenient during shopping trips, it looks like they are also catering to the business park community in the vicinity.

I'm not even a Starbucks fan but I like trying new places. The Vanilla Sweet Cream cold brew isn't bad although I thought it would be sweeter. Everything here looks to be in order and clean, and I hope it would be seeing as they just opened their doors.

This was by far the best Starbucks location I have ever​ visited. The ladies that work at this location were terrific​. They made me feel welcomed and right at home with​ their humor and personalities. In particular​ Dominique and Anna we extremely​ knowledgeable​ about the various drinks and products​​s offered. The provided me with information about the local community and events while maintaining a high-degree of professionalism. I would visit this location the next time I visit from Washington, D.C.!​

The smell is just foul and its not just sometimes it is ALL the time! This location is the worst one I've been to by far. 
The staff on the other hand is great. But please do something about the stench! Not a good way to start the AM or any other time of day.

My guilty addictions include the spinach wrap and skinny cinnamon dolce latte.  I need a part time job to fund the daily purchases of these items!  These two items pair well and make my tummy very happy!!!
Great location! The workers are always nice and friendly. There's never a mistake with my order. This location always seems to be busy but there is never much of a wait.

It's unfortunate they don't support loyal Starbucks customers thru the Gold rewards program. They will gladly take your money though the app though. If you sell the coffee, honor the system. No coupons nor free coffee. boo!

Having a Starbucks right around the corner from my office is awesome! This location is very clean and the staff is really friendly. They have a drive-through at this location too. I will for sure be back!

I really love this Starbucks!

1. It has a drive through which I feel is essential for busy days on the run and to not have to drag my cranky or sleepy kids in. Thank you for working the drive thru into your design. It definitely gives me an excuse to stop by more! 

2. I feel like almost every Starbucks team is genuinely helpful and has excellent customer service...but I really like the team here. They crack jokes with customers and can carry on a good conversation. They are sweet and courteous. They make the atmosphere of this Starbucks more enjoyable.  

3. The manager, Mel, took the time to find out exactly how I wanted my coffee ground for my cold brew. She even ground two samples so I could check out the coarseness before grinding the whole bag. She offered suggestions on other Starbucks coffee she has tried cold brew with and had good results. I can't wait to try the Kenya roast she recommended. I feel like personalizing the customers experience goes beyond wanting to give good customer service; it shows you care about your job and are passionate sharing it with others. I LOVE that.

4. The place is always spotless. I always see the employees making sure everything is neat, organized and filled. Thank you for that!

I truly feel that employees at this location love life and love people and that just naturally radiates from them. I say ... give them all a raise!

This is not my favorite Starbucks location and today reminded me why. I needed to meet with a group of colleagues this morning about 10:40 because it was centrally located to where we were all coming from. Upon arrival, all the tables were taken and there were only 4 . There are more tables outside, but on a cold November day, that's not happening. There were several other groups descending on the location all to have the same disappointment I had, no where to sit. I stood in line to order a beverage and "wait and see" what would happen with the seating as I waited. I waited in line for 12 minutes and there were still 2 people in front of me yet to order, at which point people were standing between the tables waiting for one to open up. I made the decision to bail, left the line, and texted my colleagues that I was headed to a different meeting location. Perhaps this was a strangely busy time, but I'll put this Starbucks in the "drive thru only" category in the future.

Beautiful newer model with lots of comfy seating and a very friendly staff! 
Much larger that the Greentree location with a better parking and drive thru situation. Same great drinks.
So I went in there this morning and told the barista I wanted a large coffee that didn't taste like coffee with a lot of caffeine and im not sure what she gave me but it was dank.
I love the service I get from this Starbucks I like the management ,& workers are excellent especially the morning staff could not be happier

I used to love coming to this Starbucks but I think with new management, I don't think I'll be coming back to this location too often. The new manager is very hot or cold. He'll be nice one day and the next, he would be extremely rude. The baristas and the atmosphere is wonderful when the manager is not in.

Drive thru is fast and the outdoor lounge area is so cool. It's a good place to meet a friend or something.  If I lived closer to this location, I would be here daily. Also, parking is pretty good. Lots of spaces.

This Starbucks offers a stick-to-business-yet-friendly customer service. 

10 out of 10 drink consistency.

Very nice shop inside.

Use the nearby street light to your advantage to get in to the parking lot by going behind the bank next door.  :)

I love me the people here. I've been coming to this Sbux for the last five years of my academic career and it's always nice to see the smiling and faces of these Sbux baristas. They are always willing to go out of their way for you. The environment is communal most of the time and most importantly, it's not freezing!! Go pay a visit. If you're in the area, I'd suggest you don't go to the the Sbux on Linebaugh-terrible parking, dirty bathrooms, FREEZING, the parking smells of trash because there's a dumpster around it, and the staff isn't too happy :/

I really dont see the thrill of coming to Starbucks and their customers are the worst. Uppity , rude and impatient to say the least.  Some of the worst drivers and parkers.  Good news is they come here, so I choose to go somewhere else. I refuse to follow the cult.

Standard issue starbucks.  Coffee tasted about the same as most of the other starbucks I've been to.  The seating area inside and outside is relatively large.  No drive thru, prices were about the same, and the friendliness factor at starbucks is generally bordering weird as it is.

Not the greatest Sbux to be sure... there were 3 people "working," but there were about 4 people waiting for their drinks... not sure what all 3 of the people behind the counter were doing, but they clearly were not making drinks. Not a place I'll be going out of my way to come back to.

This Starbucks is located in the Garden District of NOLA. it's really beautiful compared to the ones in the Vegas area. I love how they decorated for their city's feel. The store was clean, including restrooms and they had a small selection of gift items (including Texas mugs?). 
The service was pretty quick but they messed up two out of three of the orders. One was the wrong size and the other was the wrong flavor. 
Weather was beautiful while we were there so we took advantage of the outside seating which there was a lot of. I would definitely stop here again if I'm back in that area.
great coffee in wonderful location,Grab a cup and stroll the streets of this wonderful town.

I happen to spend a lot of time and money at this Starbucks, every time I go I am amazed at how slow the drive thru line moves. The lady baristas are ok but Jay and Guy put them to shame with their impressive customer service skills. Drinks are inconsistent but beggars can't be choosers.

I love this location. I grab my caramel macchiato and head to my favorite spot, the long couch in the back, the only drawback is there isn't always a table available when needed. Hey it's kinda expected because of location though. The staff has always been friendly and the bathrooms pretty clean. Quick Fyi: When trying to sit and study at times there music is pretty loud so if you need/prefer quiet this may not be your spot.
One of my favorite locations and a quiet neighborhood. Good place for studying and drinking coffee.

Unlike most, I think Starbucks is quite overrated and too expensive. When my office was nearby I went there fairly often. Now almost never and I wonder why I ever went there. The coffee always tastes burnt and ALWAYS requires "additives" to make it palatable. The pastries they sell are grossly over-priced and mediocre at best. Bread Compny or Eiensteins are always better choices.

This is the Starbucks attached to Macy's.
We really needed a "fix" so we stopped here on Black Friday and the place was crazed.

Meanwhile we got through the line and were duly caffeinated.

Glad it was there.

8/10 times they are out of the food items I order on the mobile app--- so annoying! They offer a refund but when you're doing a quick pickup it makes the whole thing take 3 times as long and annoys people in line, so easy if they would just UPDATE the inventory regularly!

I don't stop in at a lot of Starbuck ' s anymore...mostly because what I enjoy there is high in calories and the prices are generally too high.  That said, this location is very convenient if you are a student at St. Joe's or here for a visit.  

We got in from the cold, miserable weather amd warmed up with a hot chocolate, a Chai tea, and my triple shot white chocolate mocha...all while my daughter was out in the cold playing field hockey (yes that was mean).

Pleasant staff, quick service, consistent drinks.  Only issue is there was no sign up telling us the password for the wi-fi.
I don't think this is Starbucks owned but rather a licensed concept as is often seen in hotels. As a result, if you're paying attention you'll notice a 20-30pct markup on all items. It's ridic.

By far the WORST UNDERSTAFFED STARBUCKS EVER! 5 minutes or more wait to take our order, attitude in drive thru window, literally threw our breakfast at us! Didn't wrap up breakfast it was falling out of Bag, no napkins. One star maybe, totally disappointed need friendly efficient trained staff who aren't hung over with pleasant attitude or shut this location down. Waste of space.... Awful!!

The bathroom is worst that I have ever seen.  The last time it was cleaned was 2013.   Starbucks should ashamed. It was just not one person. You would not want to use it.  Let alone have your children use it.

This is a Starbucks like many others, but I'm giving it a high rating because of the friendly service, which really stood out. It's not a bad study location in terms of being open later and having wifi and several tables, although plug access could be improved and I could see it filling up at busy times.

I have almost completed my training week as a new partner. This cafe store is amazing, friendly staff, amazing customers and it is extremely clean. This is my fourth Starbucks working in and it is the cleanest most organized store out of the four.

Wow, I haven't been to this Starbucks location for a long time and what a surprise!! EVERYONE was friendly and welcoming. This location is a bit out of my way but I'm okay with that if I get treated so well!! I wish the staff at Speedway and Wilmot got the same training in customer service!!
Went through the drive thru for an iced coffee. The line was long but the service was quick. My ice coffee was delicious and the barista was friendly.

The drive-through here is always full and slow. However, I cannot believe the difference a year has made in the barista turnover department. Last year was a very unimpressive bunch at this locale. This year I am happy to report a much more upbeat and friendly bunch.
The drink makers could use a boost in the speed department. However, the friendliness of the order/money takers somehow makes up for it.

Not my favorite Starbucks location.  The quality of coffee and pastries are, of course, the same as every other location; however, the service is painfully slow.  I always go inside (I'm not a fan of drive-throughs in general) and regardless of how busy or slow it is, I always have a long wait for my drink to be prepared.  Once, after a 10 minute wait, it seemed  my drink went missing all together.  At least that time the manager was nice enough to give me a coupon for my next drink free.  If I have a choice, I'll go to the Starbucks in the Garden State Park over this one.
quick service.. nasty bathroom though.. par for the course for a starbucks

My friend and I spend a lot of time here because the staff is so friendly. They are always smiling and making conversation and they all seem to enjoy what they do. This is definitely one of our favorite places to visit in Brownsburg.
Place is dirty and loud. The voices echo. I expect a big chain like starbucks should be held to high standards. Staff was decent. My drink was ok

Ok here we go.... 
1. I am from NYC. Starbucks is on every corner there. I have basically spent so much money on Starbucks I might as well hold a stock in it.
2. I live and breathe Starbucks.
3. I cant live anywhere where there is NO starbucks.
4. Metairie had one  and so wala! I was happy......
'

HOWEVER, I must say this one in particular kinda sucks. I do not  know whether or not they just are not good at customer service, or dont know what customer service is but I have not had many pleasant experiences here. I unfortunately still frequent it because its the only one around here. 

example noted: I get my free drink monthly from my gold starbucks card and I happily order my Toffee Nut latte... me standing there for a good 10 minutes waiting for my drink as the "barista" chuckles and laughs with fellow co workers as she makes drinks..one, two , three, four people get their drinks and me.. still standing... waiting.. no one noticing. not the chuckling barista. THEN... when no one else is there finally!!!
finally!! she asks what am I waiting for??? 

reality check starbucks barista girl. in NYC this would not have happened. second the drink was sub par and third I should have gotten a voucher for another free drink considering the amount of time and lack of acknowledgment you gave me.

Like I said, if there was another one across the street, I would ignore this one. but unfortunately this is probably the only starbucks around that I know of. Unless there is one magically hiding around close to metairie. ......

Very disappointed in my experience there. I bought two caramel frappuccinos and they were nothing but ice and foam when I got home I had to brew my own coffee  to add to it. I will not go back to that location

I was on the road from San Francisco to Los Angeles and stopped by this establishment. The reception was non existent for me, but the white guy behind me got the "welcome sir". I waited in line like any good citizen. Then came another person,a white girl this time and she also got the "Hi and welcome" and the server asked her almost instantaneous if she had made up her mind. Of course she did and she got to order while she stood behind me!!! I was totally ignored. I mean..whats up with that? 
If you have an explanation i would really like to hear it. I was well mannered, well dressed...khakis and shirt. I hope to god that me being asian had absolutely nothing to do with it!! I finally got my order and i didnt even get thanked for leaving a 2 dollar tip while my purchase was only 8 bucks! I mean really?

So this store has gone down hill since LJ has left, everyone's a lot less efficient, the stores messier then I've ever seen, and no one can really make my drink right, it use to be a decent store when LJ was working there but now its just bad, go to Delran or Mount laurel instead, unless LJ comes back.

I love walking into this place! Everyone is so friendly here. They always make me feel right at home. There is a really tall guy named Jameson who knows me by name and always has great coffee recommendations and something funny to say. Ask for him. (Everyone else is pretty great too)  The speed of service in general here has picked up on the last few months, which is a plus.
First time back here since my last review.  The crew is staying busy as expected, the drinks were good, as was the service.  The floor was a little dirty, but much better than the last time.
Great Location. Customer service is Superb! Clean and well kept.
It's a great pitstop for me in route to work; it's just another Starbucks to me...

Not too long of a wait and the baristas were friendly for the most part. My hazelnut frappucino was perfect, added a shot of espresso which they didn't let die and put the right amount of torani pumps in it. They serve great drinks here.

I love starbucks. and I don't drink coffee. at least not straight. that's where starbucks won me over, they create these delicious fraps and teas that are loaded with enough calories for a meal!!!! but I validate it with its coffee...this location has super friendly employees and is rather quick. they lose two stars simply bc whoever thought of this location was going for drive thru only, its not a location one can really sit at and enjoy, weird set up

Good location off I-80 for those of us traveling though. Friendly staff. Typical Starbucks coffee. Location a little small if you are looking for a place to hang and spread out. Perfect for a grab and go and service was fast.  Also has a drive-through.

This location has to be one of the sloppiest of them all.   This morning, the bathroom was not only filthy, the toilet was backed up and almost overflowing!  The floors were dirty, and the half & half dispenser was totally out, and no one seemed to care or designated to look after these "housekeeping" issues - I guess it's because they were too busy making coffee drinks, but appearances and cleanliness is important, no matter how busy you are!  There is always a wait, and it was prime time (between 9 and 10 a.m.).  PJ's is looking better and better - I won't buy anything here, as a matter of principal - I walk over with a friend, but don't patronize the place.
I was buying about $20 of things, I paid with $100 and the cashier Sav said she couldn't break it because she had no change. What, Starbucks doesn't have change. Then why are you in Business.

I understand that this location is the busiest location in the Nashville area, however they just don't act as if they give-a..... the tables are not wiped off, trash is overflowing, toss your straw at you if you ask for one, don't stir your iced mochas, don't say thank you for spending $6.00 on a coffee and can ignore you indefinitely if you come back to the counter after getting your drink to ask for anything else! While I sat on hold to Starbucks Customer Service for 38 minutes to get help with their nifty 'pay-with-your-iPhone' APP that won't work because I can't delete my old email from my account with them on their website and put my new ( 4 years ) email, I watched a drive -thru customer stop, get out, return the wrong drink and wait about 10 minutes while an employee brought her out yet another incorrect incorrect drink, and she repeated the instructions about her drink again ( it was pretty complicated and demanding...something like..."No sugar just 1 Splenda stirred in".)  On the third drink delivery she got something and left. Hopefully she didn't choose the drive thru because she was in a hurry or didn't want to have to walk in! Meanwhile back at customer service...the rep assured me when I got home I would have an email and a link and just reset my password and all would be right in the world! So I'm writing this because of course, the link says the Reset Password Link has EXPIRED! Oh yeah...and Customer Service is closed!

They usually are pretty good but on some nights I guess when the staff is tired they decide to close early and start turning people away from the door at 9:46 pm even though the Starbucks App says they are open and the sign outside of the store says they close at 10:00 pm but the employees have locked the door are sweeping the floors and when you knock they roll their eyes and just sign the store is closed but there is no advance  warning or sign that says this particular store will close early tonight. Just go there an hour after they open or an hour before they close to make sure you don't get turned away from the door.

The folks here are just as friendly as every other Starbucks and the setting is great.  You can enjoy your coffee overlooking the Geronimo Plaza fountain.  

One big downside.. parking is terrible.  So if you can, walk.  Otherwise its best to park in the nearby garage.  I tend to luck out and get parking when I'm there at 7 am, but even then the 15 min parking is dicey.
I love this place, my daughter and I go twice a week at least. Nice people who work there, I bring my daughter to work in the morning, so we stop on the way.

We stop here after every Broadway in Tucson production. I've been meaning to write a review for some time. This Starbucks understands the client experience. Once again I received a quality drink AND amazing service. Keep up the great work!!

This is the best starbucks I've ever gone to. They go out of their way to be warm and friendly to everyone that comes in. Every order is handled quickly, efficiently, and with care. The store is always very clean, including the station for customers to get cream, sugar, and other supplies. Speaking of which, cream and milk is stored prepared in a fridge in the back ready to go for when one runs out. It is replaced with lightening speed. This is a busy starbucks, as it is off of a main route, but I believe people seek this store out over others because of the wonderful atmosphere. I pass 3 starbucks locations, but I only ever stop at this one.

The service was horrible. I ordered a teavana passion iced tea and they forgot to ask me what I wanted in ti. They asked me 15 minutes later if I wanted it sweetened and I said head. 10 minutes later my drink was read *finally*. I tasted it and it was horrible. They put lemonade in it without asking me too.
Every order is correct and quick, even the drive through doesn't get clogged up. Always have a good experience when we go.
Trapped in drive thru for almost 25 minutes!!!!! Only a few cars ahead of me. Would have felt better if they felt a little bad about it, maybe a free drink next visit or "sorry for the wait"????

It's the holiday weekend and everyone is ready to get out of here so they started breaking down about 45 min in advance  lol I get it... but because we were already sitting here I feel a little awkward. They were nice though and didn't complain at me. They warmed up my chocolate croissant just how I like and the cc cookies were really big. The kids loved them. The Starbucks is fairly good size. The music was nice, too. No problem taking my order or anything so it was a nice stop.

Service was great as always . My fav ginger (Josh) wasn't there though.  
Nothing like a True North first thing in the morning

Love this Starbucks. It has a great view of the river and bridge from the porch and serves the same great coffee you'd expect in any Starbucks. Just make sure you know that around 7:30 am it's typically very crowded from people going to work or students getting their morning coffee. Also, going to this Starbucks around 3-3:30 on a weekday is dangerous as it is just about a 5 minute walk from a middle school and a high school, so often times you get crowds of kids coming in that take quite a bit of time to order and are very loud. If you avoid these times, though, this place is great.
What I expect from a Starbucks. Fast, friendly, clean, and a great coffee! And drive thru for those on the go, was quick. Close by several hotels, ours included. Yup, going back there tomorrow to.
I like Starbucks, but this one is kind of Ok to me. It's not as big as the one in Westport and the parking is really limited.
Free wifi, seating inside and out, friendly staff, fast service, and overpriced drinks.

Thanks Starbucks for the most delicious soy pumpkin spice latte I've had to date. The woman working the drive thru was super pleasant and friendly as well.. It's nice to start out a Friday on a positive note. I mostly use the drive thru which is hit or miss on speed. I have gone inside once, but I feel drive thru is faster. 

I would give four stars, but one slip up and you give me milk, I will always question what's in the drink. Being lactose intolerant sucks.

The friendliest and fastest coffee barrister on earth works at this locations (Barry).

I consider Starbucks coffee mediocre at best. But, this location is pleasant and It has a large sunny deck that is great for people watching while you sip your over-priced coffee.

Their back-room seating area is like a Soviet-era interrogation chamber (stradat')

Me like Starbucks, yes I said Me... just because!!!!

This is my Starbucks location that I frequent when I can't go to the location near Lake Avenue.  I do like it here as I pass this way weekly, sometimes 2 or even 3 times a week.  The drive thru, while small & kinda off the beaten path, it is very useful. 

Friendly baristas, outside seating & a WalMart nearby, make this a great location.  I especially like the outdoor seating as there are beach sized umbrellas that are affixed to the table that provide shade of a uber hot & sunny day.  It would be super, duper nice to have power strips in this area; I hope the Starbucks-wish-granting-fairies are listening to (or reading) this review.

Spacing inside is fairly nice as well.  A nice sitting area to the left & right, then straight ahead is the main, cafeteria style table & chair setups.  

I love that there's always something on sale, albeit coffee mugs, drinking straws, coffee etc; makes me feel like buying another mug/cup that I really don't need... Great marketing you guys. ( I know this is probably the norm at all Starbucks, but this location always seems to have the cutest little finds)

Anywho, I love the soy, skinny etc options; but  must admit I often forget the tall, grande, venti, trenta designations & I normally result to saying small, medium... My bad, I know, oh well, I'll try harder.

Anyway, I love it here, so do be surprised if you're passing thru & you see me posted up...

While I typically prefer local coffee shops, I enjoy coming to this Starbucks from time to time. It's always reliable, great location, the hours are better than many local joints, accepts credit cards, and the service is very friendly. Plenty of study space.. I like the area that's tucked away from the main coffee counter. Clean bathrooms (important when you are guzzling coffee all day)... The only complaint I have is that the music gets really loud sometimes. Bring your own headphones, and you can block it out.

I don't know how Starbucks could get less than par reviews. But after coming to this one... I know why. So, for starters the parking is pretty tight. In the front they have a couple spaces that says customers only. But it is most likely employees parking there because there wasn't many people inside. We parked on the side street. We went in and waited in line while the barista chatted with someone... waiting.... save the personal conversations for your own time.... 
Anyways, so we were there for the happy hour frappachinos. I ordered a small vanilla bean frap w/ javachips, no whip.(Told her this 3 times) Also I ordered a Espresso Frap with Java chips, 1% milk and whip cream. I am showing  a picture showing that even on the cup it says Java chips, but yet as you can see... none in there. I also had to remove the whip from my daughters drink and put it on mine. Also had to wait awhile for the girl to come back to the counter to ask for a dome top. I was purposely transferring the whip cream with a straw right there in front of her saying aloud that they didn't listen, when I was asked by a friend why I was standing there.  
Another thing I thought was odd was the chocolate straw things, they were charging 95cents for. I had went to Strabuck's the past two days and they were giving them out for free because they say right on it "Starbucks Happy Hour" and they aren't supposed to charge for them.

The change they made with staffs are the best that happened since my last review. They are more knowledgeable and more in tune with the upkeep of this place. Baristas are a lot quicker especially during busy hours. So far they haven't messed up my order (not like before) since I am attending classes on base I am more frequent here so I can really tell the changes they've made and i hope this will continue.

So this is a franchised Starbucks and not a corporate store. Expect to pay $6 for a latte here and they don't take goldcard rewards or deals/coupon codes that your Starbucks app gives you. The next closest corporate starbucks is half a mile away. Since I work in downtown and don't have time to walk half a mile, I've broken down and just stayed with Kahwa Coffee. Half the price of this place.
My order is always been correct employees are always courteous it simply makes my day or morning even if I go through the drive-through
Great ambiance, great service, Sbucks coffee. 'Nough said.

This place is always busy and full of the wide range of Santa Barbarians! Parking is a pain though! The lot off of Chapala is the best easy parking. This is a very convenient location for the Arlington and Granada theaters.

I made great use of this Starbucks in between doctor's appointments. It was nice and cozy on a cold, blustery day. It was refreshing to see friendly, cheerful staff of all ages, probably even number of men and women working. They seemed to get along really well. 
Also nice about this location was that there seemed to be enough space for tables, benches and more loungey furniture.

they got my order wrong twice but i had somewhere to be so i didn't have time to correct it again. the next day i went back  and told her my situation and how upset i was about this. i told them in a peaceful tone about what happened and the drive thru lady was so rude and sassy she kept interrupting me and saying ridiculous things. so i went inside and felt with a inside lady named hannah and she was so kind and understanding.

This place is mostly packed in the morning. And they can be slow.
