I gave them a better rating only because one time I went in right before they close the girl at the register was still nice enough to take my order and even gave it to me for free. Every time we went through the drive through they never got our orders wrong. So the extra star is for good service.

I'm not sure if it's poor leadership or what but I go to two Starbucks on a regular basis and this one is consistently subpar. I'm a former Starbucks employee so I know how stressful this job can be at times... so I want to have some grace... But the staff at this particular store has failed me numerous times and I'm often greeted with bad attitudes. Granted, there are some employees that have treated me very kindly and with respect, so maybe there are just a few bad apples spoiling the bunch? But they also seem to halfass their drinks on a regular basis and have given me a burned bagel numerous times. I'm glad I have a Starbucks near my house because i love their drinks and breakfast... but I wish this one was a bit better and treated the drinks, customers and their jobs with more respect. I'll continue to return here for the convenience, but I hope they undergo some improvements soon.

At first glance, it's easy to miss this Starbucks driving down olive boulevard in Creve coeur. It is in an unassuming building, but directed right off the main road. There is plenty of parking as you pull in and the shop has two entrances. The staff was super efficient, friendly and helpful. This seems to be a necessity as the location was in the middle of their morning rush. They got my order as I was waiting in line, didn't mess anything up and had my coffee and pastry ready in lightning speed. Plenty of seating choices, with couches and tables, so I decided to do a little work. All in all, didn't expect such a big Starbucks in this building, but ended up enjoying my experience. I would definitely visit this location again, as I was able to get a lot of work done. All while enjoying a hot coffee with free refills!
to the guy in front of me at the drive thru @ 1633. thank u for purchasing my drink. Happy Thanksgiving!!

This location is the smallest Starbucks I've ever been to. About five 2 seater tables and very cramped order/pickup area. The parking area is small and shared with other businesses with several spots marked "employees only". My latte is excellent!
It really is sad when the barista remembers your order down to a T each and every morning... a venti americano with skim milk and 2 splendas!

Everyone is always wonderful at this Starbucks. In fact, it's the only one I will visit anymore. The other area ones always take so long to get me my coffee and have my order wrong. And it's nothing too complicated either. I thoroughly enjoy my experience here and am sure to grab my coffee before I head out of town.

Worst I have ever been too. I purchased at least one Starbucks a day at various locations. This is by far the weakest. Employees tend to lean on the rude side, service is very slow and forget doing a mobile order. They apparently loose them half the time. If the manager is reading this, which I doubt, maybe it's time to close the store again but this time loose the diversity training and focus on doing what you are in business to do. Provide service that matches a $4 cup of coffee. Last I checked McDonalds was across the street for $1.

The workers have always been friendly to me. No problems with any orders. Pretty quiet outside usually, away from traffic. A few times people have been really loud outside and start yelling and that can get annoying. Some people need to realize that they are in a public place even if it is outside on the patio, it is not a park. There are not many parking spots but I have always found a spot. Some people do not like that there is no drive through but I don't mind that.

I have never had a bad experience at this Starbucks! I come here intermittently when my local coffee shop is unavailable. In all my years living in the area, the staff have always been extremely friendly and efficient. The location itself is clean and cozy, I love the sitting area for studying when I was in school. Only complaint is the location is hard to access due to no street parking surrounding the building, as well as being situated right along the bridge. I will continue to patriotism this shop!
Love this location!! They always get my coffee just the way I like it. On occasions they have messed up my order but are always accommodating both in service & courtesy.

This Starbucks was decent.

Our barista was ridiculously friendly.  I mean, she almost made me uncomfortable with her enthusiasm.  But it was better than someone who you can tell hates their job and doesn't want to serve you.

The place was empty but our drinks still took longer than they should have, which was upsetting because it was really cold out and we wanted to relax with a hot drink.

We grabbed a couple of the big comfy chairs but the table was covered with coffee and tea stains and there were 6 (count them, 6) empty coffee cups there.  The pace was not clean, let's put it that way.

The only reason they are getting 2 stars over 1 star is because their caramel apple cider is to die for!  It is the most delicious drink on the planet, of that I'm sure.  it's like dessert in a cup.  A little piece of Heaven.

But other than the drink itself, not a good experience.
Love their Selections of teas and coffee. Very friendly.  Wish it had more seating, great location.
The baristas were racist towards us and didn't even get our order right, even though we repeated it multiple times.

Okay, I downgraded my stars to two. One for location/building and one for a consistent product. Zero stars for service! The guy that was friendly and singing must have been beaten down by the sour puss employees that now work here. I get it! I'm not a morning person either; however, if you're in the service industry and plan on staying there, you might want to kick it up a notch.

Now, even though the service is subpar at best, it's the product I go for. It's consistent and fresh and I have found few local establishments that can compare. I've had latte/coffee products and CC's and PJ's and it was the worst cup I've ever had. Except CC's in Old Metairie... They have an awesome iced pumpkin pie latte! 

Previous Review:

They are always so friendly here. This morning the barista was singing and very enthusiastic. I'm not a morning person and was struggling to get going today. He helped me start my day off right with a perfectly made pumpkin spice latte and a kind word.

I love this Starbucks location.  It has charm and the building has that "old" feel.
Bad service.  The regulars are taken care of before you regardless of who is next in line.  AND I was on my way to work and the "regular" was just hanging out.  Not cool.
My new favorite Starbucks stop every morning on my way to the office. Love the look and staff does a great job!

Why such a low rating?  Location, location, location.  Each knocks off one star.

It's a real shame that there are no cafes or coffee shops in Kennett square that are open past 2 on sunday afternoon: that's the only reason I headed out to this corporate chain situated in an ugly, suburban strip mall.  I feel dirty spending my money in a place like this, like I'm playing a role in wrecking the structure of American society.

That said, it really wasn't that bad.  Starbucks is starbucks.  I had a decent cup of tea and a tasty, but overpriced baked good.  That's par for the course.

Staff were friendly, and the atmosphere was tolerable.  I found the Christmas themed decorations a little bit lame, and this atmosphere is a bit colder and less cozy than some other Starbucks I've been in, but they're all more or less similar.

Get it together Kennett Square Merchants...you gotta have something open in the downtown every day of the week.  When I'm in town, I'll go there, guaranteed.  Maybe the Mexican bakery (which was open) could put some tables out; they sure have room for it in their large storefront:

http://www.yelp.com/biz/las-alondras-bakery-kennett-square

I'd rather give them my money than a Starbucks in some butt-ugly suburban shopping plaza that's just enriching some sleazy developer.

Bad experience with the cashiers and all here.  Very rude, careless, loud, just lack of service and no knowledge of service, and overheard making racist jokes and impressions.  The drinks they have no knowledge of and carelessly makes it.  Hire new staff.
Consistent.  If you like it or dislike it you can be confident that tomorrow you are going to have the same experience.

Nice & friendly staff but dangerously small and unorthodox parking lot. (Totally not their fault!)

Great location 1.5 miles away from my daily Rte 95 commute to and from Philadelphia. They uphold the Starbucks standards and I recommend this location if you're in the area.

5 stars for the service! The people who were working there are some of the nicest baristas I've ever met. There was this one man (whose name I wish I had asked for) who received my order. We shared some small talk and he smiled and everything. When I ordered my mocha cookie crumble frap (which was absolutely delightful), he found that I was using this coupon for a free drink. He gave me suggestions of how to get the best bang for my (free) buck. I ended up just adding a shot of espresso and still enjoyed my drink.
This Starbucks is the SLOWEST Starbucks known to man! Jesus! I come here often in the mornings because the drive through is so convenient in this area but IT TAKES FOREVER.

I went through the drive thru just after 2 pm on Wednesday (12/14) afternoon. I ordered a tall chile mocha. While I was sitting at the window for about 3-4 minutes I heard the lady at the window comment to the barista that there might be an issue with the chile powder. After an eternity she opens the window tells me it's $4.65. I hand her $5.65 and she hands me my drink. After 30 seconds she opens the window again and tells me I didn't give her proper change. I mentioned that I handed her $5.65 and that one or more of the coins are now sitting on the ground between the car and the drive thru because she dropped them on the way in. Another 60 seconds later she hands me $1 and makes a sarcastic comment about how annoying the customers have been today. I drive off. Guess what? No chile powder. Chile Mocha indeed!

Pastries are yummy staff is nice.  

I have issues with my laptop battery and it was a bit of a chore to find a table for two and an electrical plug, but once we got settled in, everything was great!

Ah yes, Starbucks on university Blvd: the land of baristas who always let your shots die, make one drink at a time (whereas their training teaches them how to make two,) and this one blonde asshole.

As a former employee of the company, I try not to complain too much because I know things can be rough, but every single time I've gone to this location, I've watched them let everyone's shots die, make my drinks incorrectly, and received dry and rude answers from the aforementioned blonde barista.

Do yourself a favor: save your money and go to a different location. These people just are not trained properly at all, and you're left with incorrect drinks that you feel guilty for returning because one person with the meanest look on your face when you speak to her makes you feel like you're some sort of idiot.

Come on, you're better than this.

I love any Starbucks, this one has a lot of seats and feels a little cramped in cold weather.  In warm weather, sitting outside is a pleasure.  Comfortable and pretty seating makes it a summer favorite.
Great atmosphere. Much more spacious compared to the previous location. They just need a Clover brewer and five stars. Staff, very friendly.

Worst Starbucks experience ever. Everytime I come to this location the baristas are rude and act like they cannot be bothered by the customers. 
This time the person that helped me tried. However... once I placed my order, I was informed they didn't have the sandwich I ordered. No big deal. I chose different sandwiches. The person that I placed the order with started to make the order then was pulled in another direction. When I tried to bring this to the person's attention that I had not received two of the items that I ordered, I received one and saw that the other had not been made while the barista slammed the cooler door shut retrieving a fresh one. I was over it at that point. I would rather be hungry than spend another moment there. Thanks again, starbucks.

This location is the worst! Even though I live right around the corner I will not be going back. Placed an order for iced caramel macchiato and got a hot one and ordered plain bantam balls and got God only knows what! Took a bit and about died! Employees here are totally incompetent...

If I'm paying $6 for a specialty drink, I expect them to fill it to the top. I go to this Starbucks all the time and sometimes they are great and other times they struggle. I normally complain but I didn't have time today. It's ridiculous. Give the customer what they are paying for.
Coffee is ok, staff is great, but it is consistently cold in here. Turn the heat on, please! :(

I've been to many Starbucks and have been generally satisfied with most of them. Not this one. The "certified barista," Lucy, seemed stressed out and was stressing out everyone else. She argued with me about what breakfast sandwich I wanted (even though I was pointing at it in the display cabinet), snapped at me a couple of times and gave me a cheap plastic bag to hold a mug we'd bought as a gift instead of the official Starbucks bags that were given to everyone else. Also, our hot chocolates were not mixed well and there was so much syrup at the bottom of the cup. Maybe this was an off day, but I don't plan to return to this Starbucks again.

I visited this Starbucks for the first time this evening.  I walked into the store and waited while two baristas made drinks and another barista took drive-through orders.  Each one of the baristas saw me, but none of them acknowledged me.  After waiting a few minutes, I turned around and walked out.  I understand being busy, but these guys could at least acknowledge that they have a customer in the store.  A simple "Good evening.  We'll be with you in a minute or two" would've gone a long way with me.
Ordered two non fat lattes and waited for awhile and both came back wrong. By the time I figured it out we were already in the car on the highway. Too expensive to get both drinks wrong

Very poor service. Had to cancel my order and get a refund as first barista did not alert second barista of my order. Waited 15 minutes! Second barista was very rude and had a disrespectful attitude. First barista Alec could not give me management info. I will find on my own and follow up. Avoid this Starbucks at all costs.

Never thought I'd find a Starbucks that I didn't like, but here it is.

Kind of a shame, really.  Great location (Whyte), but the service was horrible.  They were friendly enough, but no one really seemed to know what they were doing.  My peppermint mocha turned out to be a regular mocha, which really irritated me since the clock is ticking down on the availability of that drink.

Also, the fact that someone left the door to the broom closet open was kind of disgusting.  Really did not need to see the filthy mop and bucket.
This is my favorite Starbucks in Pinellas County!  Very spacious and comfortable.  The baristas are great!

This Starbucks is such a great location (and build) that it hurts me to give this a two star rating, but here it is.  This Starbucks was my favorite a year ago and something has changed dramatically.  Keep in mind that my rating is based over several visits and not just one negative instance.  That's not how I roll...  :)

The Staff: Individually, there are some really great people working here (and working incredibly hard.)  However, they don't appear to be having any sort of fun.  Which, I get it, not every day is a joy.  However, this doesn't look like a TEAM.  I watched for 15 minutes as teammates passed by each other without saying a word to one another.  There was no joking, or laughing, or even a smirk.   If they're not having fun with each other, they're not having fun with customers.  This team needs a team-build coach!!!

The Service: I had a one-off situation in which I ordered a venti iced coffee and paid for it.  Moments later the barista advised me that they were out of venti cups and then handed me a grande iced coffee.  He then told me that the cashier would adjust the cost.  I was immediately confused as a customer.  The cashier apologized and explained "hey, if you're hanging out I'll give you a refill for free" and then adjusted the cost.  Kudos for effort, but this is a service fail.  Some better approaches: 1) Connect with me, educate me, and then present me with options. (Ex. "I'm so sorry, we're out of the venti cups.  Would you like to go with a grande and i'll refund the difference, or would you like to go with a trenta for a few cents more?"  2)  Get creative!  "Hey, I'm so sorry we're out of Venti, would you be ok with me giving you a venti serving in a trenta cup?"  3)  If it's rung up, it's your error, and needs fixing... Well, fix it.  (Ex. "Hey, you're getting an upgrade today at no additional cost, please enjoy this one on us!"    

I get that stock levels of other cups are a concern and giving stuff away in a sales environment is scary, but gaining customers for life is a far better investment in your time and energy.  My goal is not to tear this location down, but to give a customer perspective.  This place was friendly and a great place to visit and I'd like to see this location return to it's former glory.  Best wishes!

Located on a corner so it is easy in and out on a busy street. I opted for the drive thru as I drive a huge truck and the parking lot spaces are on the smaller side. The drive thru was a squeeze too but I made it without any mishaps. Ordered my cold brew and they had it ready by the time I made it to the window. Staff was decent and prices were normal for The Bucks.

I used the drive thru to get a cup of coffee and a breakfast sandwich.  It took quite a while to get through the line of 4-5 cars.  When I got my order i found out that the sandwich was the wrong one.  Good thing is, it was still a tasty sandwich.
Just moved to Roxborough, and I walked there after going to the bank. Very friendly staff, they complimented my accent and gave me great service. I shall return. :)

This should be renamed a Starbucks Express.  This is a smaller location with seating for about 10 people.  Also, they don't have an oven, which means they can't toast a bagel and their food options are limited to prepackaged goods.

I really do dislike this Starbucks. There's no urgency & more than half the times they miss something on my very easy order. The drive-through is usually more accurate & loads faster. I would almost rather drive further for better service.
We always forget about this Starbucks when we are working in town, but happened to be able to stop here to use the wifi for work and enjoy a cup of brew.  Wasn't busy at all which we liked.

We ordered the Pike Place Medium Roast Coffee and the Cranberry Raisin Oatmeal Cookie!

David's Take: The Cookie was so good, I wanted more, sweet but not too sweet! The Coffee was a great medium roast, I had mine with 5 raw sugars plus half and half.

Mom's Take: The Cookie was enjoyable, soft and very tasty! The Coffee was a nice blend, I had mine with 2 packs honey plus half & half.

The Location was clean and the staff was very nice. We noticed the staff working together good, everyone was having a good time while working and getting everything done.
I love the fact that I can get a Starbucks and shop at this Giant.   My experiences have been generally positive.
Great location and service! Barista was friendly, helpful, and made me a great cup of latte.

I wanted to leave an excellent review of the wonderful service I received from the employee Jody. (Sorry if I spell your name wrong!) I've been to many Starbucks but he put in more effort than any sales associate I've made contact with at other Starbucks. He made the experience fun and enjoyable. He asked if it was okay to surprise me with a drink, and I ended up loving it! It was an iced soy milk Chestnut Praline. I loved the surprise. This is something that makes people regulars. Thanks again, I'll be back!

I've been to a lot of Starbucks and this one doesnt stand out except for the drive-thru service. They are fast and very efficient when you are ordering. So if you like your coffee on the go I would suggest this location. Especially if you're heading out of Brownsburg, the location is right off 267 just before you get on to I-74 so its great for commuters in the morning looking for the caffeine fix.

I'm one of those coffee drinkers who thinks that Starbucks is part of the problem with coffee.  I think they do coffee all wrong, charge too much, and turn far too many people away from the joy that is a good cuppa joe.

That being said, I am going to award the Starbucks on Old Hickory Blvd in Hermitage my Matt L.  "Not That Bad" Award for having some positive aspects.  Previous Starbucks that don't suck include 2525 West End Starbucks and Cool Springs Blvd Starbucks.  All the others are "That Bad."

What makes the Southern Hermitage Starbucks worthy of being called Mediocre?  Well, I liked the staff, which is pretty rare.  Everyone seemed like functional human beings, which is definitely not the case at all Starbucks (I'm talking to you, corner of Church St. and 5th Ave. N).  Beyond that, the place was reasonably quiet, there were enough tables, and most of the customers seem convivial and pleasant, which certainly is not the case at the Starbucks at Vanderbilt.

Don't get me wrong, I would prefer a locally owned any day of the week, but every now and then, that is denied to me, so I have to go to the McDonald's of coffee places (and sometimes I even like McDonald's coffee better than FiveBucks).  And like I said, this one is "Not that Bad."

Congratulations, you should be "so proud" of yourselves.
very snobby barista, God forbid you ask for your drink to be made properly and/or ask for a condiment that is empty...maybe her nose piercing is too tight

I love this place.  I've never had any problems,  and I go at least twice a week with my daughter. I've been going since last year.  My daughter has gone longer than me,  but I decided to start going,  and I'm glad I did.  I love Starbucks,  and the employees are very nice.

I am a huge coffee fan! Its an everyday thing for me : ). I have been going to starbucks for years!!!!! I have been to so many all over the world its unreal... This starbucks location is great! It is always poppin with people! If you are a fan of the sport people watching, such as I am... This is the place for you : ). There is a great outdoor area to sit and chill. Its large as well! Large interior, with lots of places to hang! A+++

Drive thru at 545pm.... My order a hot coffee with whole milk and 1 sugar, I asked for half decaf coffee. So the girl said we don't have decaf coffee, we can do a pour over which takes 5 min or espresso for the decaf part. We asked if we would be charged for the espresso because I'm usually not and she says no. Then says ok it's $4.65 so them questioned her why it's $2 more, she said for your latte. I didn't order a latte, she said don't worry I'm not charging you for the latte pull forward. I explained what I wanted and she didn't seem to understand. A hot coffee made with half decaf and half regular with whole milk and 1 sugar. She had a huge black eye, which made me feel bad, maybe she has a concussion or got hit, who knows but if she has a medical condition, maybe they could've had someone else working the drive thru. She then asked for help and I was starting to cave and just get a regular coffee and decided to just go elsewhere. I can't understand how when we ordered, she prompted correctly like she knew what to do until we questioned the price. Isn't starbucks known for complicated made to order drinks? Not sure why this one was. The dunkin donuts 2 minutes away offered to brew decaf for me, so Dunkin got my business this time

I always receive fast and friendly service at this location. Today Hannah took my order and served me my coffee. she was very pleasant. I noticed she was helping the person in line ahead of me to receive the best value for her request. Not only is the staff friendly, the store and restrooms are clean. These aspects make this my favorite Starbucks location.

S L O W   S L O W   S L O W service & not friendly at all. No one cracked a smile, no one said "thank you" & Starbuck's won't be getting my business from this day forward. Too bad coz it's so close to home- good thing P.J.'s is right down the street .

I really love this particular Starbucks. 95% due to the fact there's always plenty of seating and it seems really open and bright. Most Starbucks are really crowded and, for me at least, it ruins my coffee consuming experience when I have to fight my way through the shop and am left without a seat.

The staff are pleasant, always a large variety of baked goods, it's clean and there's lots of parking! A++

i really like the cotton candy frappachino. it is amazing! must have. its a non-menu item, but just ask for it and they should know what you mean. the food is okay, but the drinks are awesome. just play it safe and just get the drinks. what i love about starbucks is that the baristas are so friendly and they sometimes make small talk while you wait for your drink. the reason while the last star is not there because it is sometimes a little bit dusty and when it is really crowded the drinks take long. i recommend this coffee shop to everyone who likes coffee (i dont drink coffee).

This is Starbucks what can I say! I live here.  If Tequila runs like poison in my blood (thank you Kenny Chesney), then coffee is the antidote. 

Coffee, my favorite cushy chair and meeting interesting characters... What more is there to say. 

Violet is not as talky before java. ;-))

This location is TERRIBLE on the weekends.... it is the only Starbucks I have EVER been in where it takes 15 minutes for a latte, (with only 3 people in the entire place) and they don't even manage to fill your cup up completely or even get a hot enough temperature on the milk. 
The drive thru crew is great during the week, but avoid this one after work hours and on weekends as they definitely have the B-Team on then.
The staff is uniformly great.  Warm, helpful, welcoming.  Parking lot is better than the one in Havertown and it feels a bit less crowded.  Too bad it's not open a bit later at night.

The absolute worst Starbucks in the world!! They may as well have poured mud into my cup and it would have tasted significantly better! They couldn't make a decent caramel frap if their lives depended on it.  I have a two visit rule and they failed miserably both times!
This was my first time at this Starbucks location. There is tons of parking, generous seating arrangements, and fast/friendly service. One of the best locations I've visited.

The address on Yelp for this Starbucks actually isn't correct - it's really 6024 Ridge Avenue in the Roxborough Ridge Commons.  But that's beside the point.

There aren't many places in Philadelphia that you can expect great service from, but this Starbucks has never, ever failed to impress me.  The atmosphere is pretty much the same as any of their other locations, but the staff are some of the friendliest, personable people you'll ever meet.  They eventually get to know you by name, and even remember what you drink.  I've never once, in my many visits to this location, ever had anyone who was anything less than extremely pleasant to take my order.  I once made a pickup of five drinks for a group of people, and my particular drink (an iced mocha latte) was prepared with vanilla instead of mocha.  Since I'm just right around the corner and it happened to be a nice day for a February, I walked back to the store, just to see what they'd do if I asked for them to replace it.  Not only did the woman gladly replace it, repeating multiple times that she was sorry, but she gave me the new drink in a Venti size when I originally ordered a Grande, but also gave me a free drink coupon for the next time I was in.

I've made it a point to contact corporate about this location because I feel every member of their staff deserves recognition.  It's getting more and more difficult to find pleasant service, but this place definitely tops the charts.
Really great Bucks! We are there usually every Saturday morning and they are always cheerful and fast! This location has become our favorite in Nashville.

After waiting for nearly 10minutes for somebody to take my order. I then watched 4 people who ordered after me get their drinks. I ordered a simple latte. I spent a total of 32 minutes between waiting to order and receiving my drink. I'm beyond disappointed. However they did me a voucher for my next drink free.

I felt compelled to write an update on my last review. I came in last Friday and ordered an iced caramel macchiato stirred. Again this time it do not come stirred but the female barista was happy to stir it for me. It tasted much better than the last time almost darn right perfect. Like I said it's a hit or miss here.

Can't live without my coffee fix, usually day and night! White mocha is my drink and they do it up right!!! I really don't like the drive thru set up at this one, but they are friendly and get my drink right.

Services are prompt. Like any other Starbucks. Their selections are limited tho since is not a store by itself. 

They have the cups and coffee stands for sale. A little sitting area as well.

I absolutely hate going to this Starbucks, but I go occasionally because it's on my university campus. It is literally awful. The line is always very long. Then, when you get to the register they are ALWAYS out of everything. The staff is so rude!!! Today when I went, they were out of all alternative options of milk, which I am allergic to. They did not have almond, coconut or soy milk. This is a terrible place!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Up early without all the coffee fixings at the casa, sooooooo decided to walk the pooches to the only place open. It's kinda hilarious with the media attention it seemed natural. Cranberry scone on the gummy side but the coffee was absolutely necessary. I like the coffee here, not more than my soul but close. I'd have preferred a local joint but 6:30 am -this is where it's at. Plus they're also pissing off "christians" these days so there's that bonus.

The service was good and quick.  However there were food crumbs all over several seats and tables as well as garbage on the floor.  I could understand if the store was busy and the two baristas were too busy to clean, but in the 45 minutes that I was there they stood behind the counter talking to each other.

So I am going to have to knock a star off because I tried to venture inside one afternoon.  It was crazy busy.  The way the store is set up disorganized the entire line so it was confusing to know where the line began or ended.  Maybe I will come back when it is a bit warmer outside because of the additional outside seating, but until then, I am sticking to the drive thru.  This is not the place to sit and do some work or have a little meeting.

Wow!!! This might be one of the best Starbucks locations I've ever been to. The inside is so spacious and there's a large patio. 

This branch has nitro cold brew and all of the regular drinks you would expect. There's tons of parking too, and if you live nearby it's a short walk. 

The inside is very clean and the service was great. I'm definitely coming back here next time I'm in Boise.
Out of all the Starbucks in Tampa I've been to this is by far my favorite. Everyone who works here seems to really enjoy the it job.

This is by far my favorite Starbucks ever!! I love this place. The drive-thru is always quick and the baristas are always friendly. And welcoming. My order is always prepared just the way I order it and always comes out in a timely manner. The inside and outside is always spotless and clean--great place to hang out and do my work in my laptop. Free wi-fi connection is just another one if it's best qualities (like every Starbucks). I honestly avoid going to any other location.

Like any other Starbucks - good service, friendly baristas, and aromatic coffee. 

What makes this Starbucks stand head and shoulders above others is the "European Bakery" next door - omg the sausage biscuit sandwich, ham and cheese croissant, and cinnamon roll were to die for. 

We'll be back tomorrow for both the European Bakery and for the Starbucks coffee.
Used to be a customer here 4 days a week, but I walk in dripping sweat when it's boiling out without a wallet and ask for a cup of tap water and am told that I can't have any. Thanks a lot.

The building is nice. The baristas are kind. Furthermore, there is n't a plethora of people so if you want to get work done then definetly come to this Starbucks. It isn't as popular since the storm because it took a while for it to get back into its regular hours.

Friendly, efficient staff but what an ugly building!  It looks like a bank from the 60's on the outside.  Inside I found it cramped and cluttered, with people bumping into each other constantly due to a poor layout.  The line to order stands in between the door and the line to pick up your coffee.. so you go in, order.. wait for your coffee and then have to fight your way back out through the ordering line to exit.  Oddly shaped room too, like a long hallway.
This is a very busy and understaffed location. It's not the employees fault. They are overworked and drastically underpaid. It gets busy, expect to wait your turn and don't be a dick.

I like to refer to this location as a "Manhattan Style Starbucks" because it's size and general atmosphere remind me of multiple locations found on the Upper West Side. 

Today, there wasn't much seating available as this location is on a university campus and there were a number of students and faculty lingering with their drinks while focusing diligently on various papers,  books, and laptop screens.

Even so, I was able to walk right up to the register and order a hot chocolate.  Surprisingly (in a good way), my drink was not blisteringly hot. Rather, it was at a temperature that allowed me to enjoy a hot drink on a cold day as soon as I had it in my hand.

I went to Starbucks for a client meeting this morning (yes on Good Friday). I had one if the best coffee experiences I've ever had, which is surprising because I usually prefer local places to Starbucks....
There was a guy behind the counter drinking his coffee out of a really tiny mug and instructing the workers on what to do, so I have to assume he was the proprietor.... Because who else would drink coffee out of a really tiny travel mug?
Anyways I ordered a pour over of their new tribute blend and they offered me a French press for the same price, so I jumped at it because I had never had a French press at Starbucks before. It was delicious!
The best part was that while I was drinking my coffee the barista came over with a different French press of some beans they are releasing for the summer... When she offered me some she started with "you obviously know and appreciate good coffee, so I wanted to offer you some of this".... Flattery will get you everywhere. It was quite good.
Overall I couldn't have asked for more out of this place so they get the coveted 5th star, way to go guy with the small coffee cup, I hope you are always there.

My experience at this Starbucks guarantees that I will never go into this store again!  I placed an online order, my normal a quad shot expresso over ice with 2% milk.  It was made as ordered, but when I arrived it was still strong for my liking so I went to add a splash of cream.  When I got to the service area, the cream was empty so I walked up to the counter and asked if I could get more cream.  The employee looked at me with a very annoyed face, and I stood at the counter for seven minutes while he finished processing four other drinks in their entirety.  (Yes, I ordered online because I had a meeting to be at by 7:30 AM)  I remained patient,  even though frustrated, as I knew he was working on another customers drinks.  However, when the man finished and finally addressed me he refused to refill the container for me but instead stated, "I will only give you a small amount (in which he placed a splash of cream in my cup not even topping it off), as you already have milk in your drink and should be charged for the cream.  You now have made yourself a latte and you did not pay for a latte." I stated that I was unaware of the "cream limit", as it is usually out for free customer use.  He continued to berate me about adding cream.  I was so embarrassed, as I am a professional and he was lecturing me loud enough for all people in the store to hear.   As I walked out humiliated, the other employee looked at me and mouthed, "I am sorry have a great day." 

I order hundreds of drinks from Starbucks each year and  If adding a splash of milk to my quad shot expresso increases the cost then it should be reflected in the cost of my drink, but refusal to let me use the cream once in the store is ludicrous and to publicly humiliate me in front of others is inapprehensible.

Drive-thru only for this review. My needs are simple: two grande mochas, two birthday cake pops. Same thing every time. One for now, one for later. This location did not disappoint. Coffee was the perfect temp, service was fast and friendly at the window. And I was happily caffeinated each time I had to come through Kenner.

I'm lazy, so I love a Starbucks drive thru. I have a Starbucks in Westchase on Linebaugh maybe only 3 min away, and another on Racetrack road. However I have to walk into the one on Linebaugh  and the one on racetrack isn't convenient during school traffic and there's always a long drive thru line. So, I go out of my way to this location on Anderson. It's never busy. They make my geen tea lemonade sand toffee nut mochas correctly. The drive thru at this location isn't extra tight or hard to get to from the street. This is the easiest starbucks I go to.

So I disagree with the prior review, i never had a problem getting a table here, with a plug for my laptop, and i came here between classes every single day...
i actually lived near the magazine one, and it is SO loud there i could never think. nor get a table with a plug.
the wireless issue with starbucks is a drawback, although they do have free internet now with your starbucks card..and there used to be free internet from uptown cajun nextdoor before it closed...sbux coffee is the best though (hate hate hate pjs, ccs and rue, for different reasons), therefore, if i still lived in nola, i'd still be here daily.
random note: i did dent up my car my very first day in nola (post cross country drive from CA), trying to find this location (that wasnt reopened post K yet). damn nola narrow jacked up streets.

How hard is it to take an egg off of a pre made sandwich? Must be extremely mind blowing hard. Out of the 15 to 20 times I've ordered this sandwich they have managed to screw it up multiple times. Now I will admit it falls on me to check my order before I drive away. But if I ask the person accepting my cash if there is an egg on it and you tell me no. I do not want to be surprised by an egg that I did not ask for. This is not Easter and I am not a child. Panera will now get my business at least I can get what I asked for and it is correct!!!

Sorry Chad, but I'm gonna have to disagree with you on this one.  I've been to both Starbucks (Maple & Magazine) and the Maple Street store is far superior.  Yes, seating can be a pain sometimes, but other than that, this store is better.  Staff is friendlier.  The best part is the patio, at least when it's not too hot outside.

I keep trying to give them a chance but the very young man behind bar needed more training didn't know how to pour a flat white and didn't care. Friday 645 4/29. He shouldn't be on the bar. Does the manager ever look at their 2.5 star rating and think hmmmmm maybe we should work on customer service????

Worst Starbucks ever!! Do yourself a favor by not going there. They took an hour to make one frappe and served so many who came after us. We were driving back from philly and wanted a cup of coffee only. I would not recommend this place to people who are in hurry. I would not even give one star to this place.

Thank the Lord that there is finally a Starbucks with a drive-thru on this side of Olive! Hallelujah! if you couldn't tell, I'm pretty excited that this location has finally opened. This location is on the parking lot of dierbergs, close to 141 and Olive. I don't believe that this location had any indoor seating,  if it does,  it's very limited, but it does have a drive-thru (again, thank ya sweet baby Jesus!).

An expensive habit, but I can't go without it! This location has great service. I never wait long for my order and it's always correct. The employees are very friendly and professional. The building itself could stand a renovation...some new couches, chairs, and table would be nice.
ordered a strawberry greent tea infusion this morning，i would said it is the worst drink i have tried in my life so far. it is simply just water with little green tea flavor

Rude slow service. Had sat at the window at 530 am for what seemed like forever while the staff with the window open didn't even pass my drink cup to the person making the coffee until I drove up. Just slow. Really slow.
Little nosey to do work, not alot of places to sit.

I have been here twice now.  The first time was great.  I got my drink and there were plenty of places to sit and the barristas were awesome.  The second time was awful.  I asked for a skinny mocha frappachino light. It came with whipped creme, which I expressly asked not to be included.  It's not really a big deal; when I brought it up to the barrista,  he made me feel self conscious in front of the other customers and only offered to scrape the creme off!  I really didnt have a choice to ask for a new one without looking like a jerk.  It was busy at the time I was there  but next time I'll just stick w a black coffee.

Great coffee and the service is always good. my only complaint is that all Starbucks brew the crappie  "Pikes Peak" after noon. That is the only brew that tastes like crap. It has a aftertaste that is nasty.

Starbucks is always going to be a Starbucks.  I like it enough; I'm a fan of their seasonal espresso drinks and an occasional iced latte.  Still, I am normally more local-business oriented, but Starbucks is the only coffee shop in New Orleans that is open when I leave for work at 5:40....so I am there every time I forget to set my coffee pot the night before.

However, this location has gotten my drink order wrong far too many times for it to be alright.  Every other time I am there in the morning, I get in the car and realize that this is not what I wanted.  Even when my drink order is exactly what I would like, I discover that it is luke-warm at best.  If I order extra-hot, I get burnt milk.  I understand that it's early in the morning, but there are always other customers and I never order anything needlessly complicated (today it was a skim carmel latte and I discovered a full-fat mocha in my cup once I'd gotten on I-10).

That being said, it is a nice coffee shop to go sit at; there's a patio and enough seating if you are going during prime-Tulane time.  I've never had problem with the pastries.  The service is always friendly and awake when I get there.  The holiday red cups make me feel warm and fuzzy.
Good coffee. Generally crowded and a bit noisy.
Love this location, love the staff.  Everyone is friendly and they know how to make the drinks correctly. Store is kept clean and lines are at a minimum.
Can't go wrong with Starbucks just get to this location early because they get crowded in the mornings.

I have been too many Starbucks, I always get the same thing, a chilled Skinny carmel macchiato with soy, no whip. This is the ONLY Starbucks that screwed it up and it tasted horrible. For how much they charge for this they need to get it right. I will only get regular coffees here where they don't screw those up. 
Very disappointed.

Disgusting service, disgusting people. Dave was the Barista yelled at a man minding his own business, to leave the store because he extended say. It was gross and that behavior is never accepted. Who is he to kick someone out of Starbucks. Saying "get out of my store" such a shame.
Great customer service! Sometimes I have to wait a lengthy time but they serve with a smile!

I've been here several times, my experience has always been pleasant. Staff are friendly, welcoming and they make sure you like your drink. Cute store, nice size so there are lots of seats which is a plus (You won't be standing shoulder to shoulder waiting in line, or looking clueless trying to find a seat). I needed somewhere to work this morning. This is the perfect place! My drink was good, very refreshing. The barista definitely gets two thumbs up this morning.

If you're in the area and in need of Starbucks you won't he disappointed!

Probably the worst Starbucks in Santa Barbara. The Staff is beyond clueless and rude . 4 out of 5 times my order ends up wrong even though I usually have to repeat myself several times to the staff member taking my order. Is there no manager at this location?? I am honestly curious at how such ridiculous customer service is allowed at such a big named shop.

Same Starbucks coffee as other franchises, however, one staff member in particular that works every morning is exceptionally rude. I live closest to this one, but am now driving out of my way so I don't start my morning with a rude employee.
Love this. Love starbucks. This location is always clean, service is friendly and fast. I study here all the time. Great stop.
They NEVER have sufficient half and half available.  Also, they need to get the recycling organized.

It's Starbucks so the coffee, etc is fine. BUT it has the worst service I've ever experienced at a Starbucks. You need new management. Average wait time is 15 mins, no matter what time of day. Best example I wrote this waiting for a coffee at the drive through on one hand.

I come here all the time. And the employees always seem miserable. I'm assuming it's poor management. I very rarely get any kind of conversation from the register worker, can't remember ever getting a smile and my drinks are inconsistent. I'm overly nice and I find myself apologizing for their mistakes because the interactions are so awkward!

I get it, they're always slammed. That has to be a tough job during the morning rush. But it makes for a positively miserable customer experience to be totally honest.

I always try to give the benefit of the doubt. But when you go somewhere 4+ times a week and it's a bad experience every single time.. that's too much. I love Starbucks coffee but I dread my morning trip to this location. sadly it's the closest one to me. 

I think the employees are overwhelmed and overworked. And as a frequent customer I can feel it.

Bout to bring this rating down!!!

I'm sorry but I have to... I refuse to rate every single starbucks or chain restaurant i've been to but this one deserves it...

im surprised to see all the great comments for the staff because that is my beef exactly! 

maybe this is why, i tend to go always around rush hour so i probably don't get the happy staff that works in the morning. i have been to other 'bucks before in the morning maybe 8am or earlier and they are ALWAYS SOOOOOO cheerful and they say please and thank you, have a nice day, they even write ur name on the cup and say sylvia here is ur americano have a great day. and yes, that makes me feel like a million bucks...

however, starbucks... why do you choose to put ur crabby staff around 4pm. they should take espresson shots to keep em on their toes. i remember one time the girl behind the counter practically rolled her eyes when i gave her my order.. i wasnt even rude or in a hurry or on my phone or listening to my music.. jeez, lady lighten up! maybe she needs a hug.

Hands down, Starbucks is my go-to coffee spot, and I've given many of the competitors a fair chance -- Coffee x-change, Peet's Coffee, Ike's Coffee, Cafe Luce.  Yet each time, I conclude that Starbucks offers a better cup of coffee and selection of food.

However this is the only location in Tucson where I've consistently seen the level of service fall, paired with poorly maintained restrooms (that is, when there isn't a line for the key or when they don't have the women's restroom blocked off for "storage"). 

I can no longer count the number of times where I've had my straw simply thrown on the drink hand-off counter rather than professionally placed on the counter or on top of the cup.  

They may as well start tossing my change at me through a hoop on the counter too.

It's also disappointing that after being a customer for over 6 years, they have yet to memorize my name or drink, unlike most of the other stores I'll visit.

It's pretty crazy that I have to settle for a coffee at Paradise in order to be appreciated after ordering a drink.

Nice location. Clean establishment. 
Drinks were made well.  They had a good assortment of breakfast items.
Wait times were longer than usual but this place gets packed.  It must be the only Starbucks for some distance but close to Drury Hotel.

As with most of the Starbucks in the area, entering and exiting the establishment can be a challenge. During rush hours, at this location you can pretty much hang up any hope you have of swinging in and grabbing a quick pick-me-up. Fortunately, you won't be hard pressed to find another great coffee shop within a two mile radius. As far as service goes, the staff is friendly and do a good job of getting drinks out quickly and accurately. If you see a line, you would do better to park across the street and walk in as I have found this to be a fairly successful strategy; That is, unless you don't feel like getting down.
Poor service, took twenty minutes to get two black, iced coffees out, and when they came out they were pumped full of simple syrup, took forever and they didn't even get the order right.
SLOWEST DRIVE THRU EVERRRRRR!! So frustrating to wait 15 mins. The employees show no compassion and are immature. Praying for a better 24 hour location in Brandon.

Always friendly. Always delicious. Great staff and great ambiance. The repeat customers specifically come to this location because of how awesome the employees are. I am one of those repeat customers.

I have had wayyyy better service at other Starbucks. They were "out" of most of the frozen coffee drinks, so when I asked about a Frappuccino, I was told rudely that they were out of that too. Plus, the drive thru line was very slow. Not bad service, but I have had must must better service at other franchises.

It is 8:15am and the store isn't that packed. The parking spaces are very few and people have to park illegally just for a fix of their Starbucks. The staff is also few, and SLLLLOOOWWW. 

Why Starbucks? Why?! Even when I come at other times of the day, parking is awful. Wifi is slow.
This SBS is so cool. I love that it is in a historic home with a wonderful courtyard and fountain. Opens before the sunrise which is perfect for my early morning walks.

The baristas are friendly here but they get my order wrong every other time. They always seem to go up a size and when I asked about it the manager said its only a small price difference. Nice scheme they have going on. Make sure you ask for a receipt. That's the only time they get it right.

It's Starbucks. They're the same everywhere. I had a strawberry açaí with caffeine at one location and an iced white chocolate mocha at another. My boyfriend had an iced green tea at one location and a hot blonde at another. All were good pick me ups. No surprises. I will say they were both nice, large locations that were clean and well decorated.
Consistently good drinks and all the people working there are super nice and awesome. It can get busy at times but that's just because SB is great :)

One of the better starbucks in the indy area. They are quick, helpful and overall it has always been a good experience for me.
They are colocated with a gas station which makes it loose the high end feel but inside the store it is very nice like a typical starbucks. Dont let this factor scare you away as it is still a corporate location.

If you are a Tulane student looking for a place to study before you "rage it" on Maple Street, then this place is for you. Personally, with local establishments like CC's, PJ's, Mojo, Hey! Cafe, Zotz, etc., why would you go to a big corporate chain like this? I got a gift card and I had to use it. The lines can be very long in the mornings but it goes faster than expected. Parking can be extremely tricky.

Busy store, but they move quickly. Lots of seating and a small parking lot in the back.

I'm always amazed at how many staff members they have on duty at one time, but I will say that the morning rush here can easily have a line of folks from the counter toward the back door (easily 15-20 deep), and I'll still have my latte in my hand in less than 10 minutes.  I appreciate that about this store.

I think that the weekday morning crew is uber efficient, but I will say that I'm not as big a fan of some of the weekend crew.  More often than not, my drink is made wrong on the weekends... when it's slower.  Go figure.

Either way, the morning crew keeps me coming back.  We joke around, they have a TON of regulars, plenty of seating, and the parking lot in the back makes all the difference.
Super busy location but if you get out if your car...(hint.hint.) you will be out the door in no time at all. The staff is excellent and extraordinarily friendly.

Stop here about every day for coffee either before school or work and it never fails! Workers know how to make your day when you're having a bad morning and always answer my coffee questions promptly. They're all so educated! Even though this place is always packed, you are bound to get your order within 5-10 minutes! Not going to lie, seeing so many cars in the drive thru has made me drive off to another Starbucks though.

Decently sized location
Above average Service (line moved quick)
Drinks made properly
Condiment section a little messy

I've never had an issue with them messing up on my drinks, but honestly this is the worst Starbucks in SB by miles. All of the girls have a huge attitude and seem like they hate their job. They're also the SLOWEST at making drinks. I've waited 15-20 minutes before and wind up late to where I'm going. I've tried to keep giving it many chances because it's the closest one to my house, but I'd rather drive a little out of the way to have friendly faces to see before I go to work and quicker service.

I'm a traveling Starbucks Supervisor whose based in Salt Lake City, Utah but visiting for Thanksgiving and I was impressed with this location. They were quick, clean, and prompt on adding more sweet cream to my iced coffee. Kay was the one who welcomed us in, took our order, and wished us a good day as we left. Thank you for embodying what a Starbucks should be!

I'm not big on the corporate chain thang, but I gotta give a shout out to this Starbucks. They are quick, kind, and the one mistake they made on a drink since I've been going there was in my favor. I ordered a tall and got a venti, and there's nothing wrong with that. I do think there are some great local java joints in Tucson, but when I need something consistent and a pleasant place to pop open the laptop, this location does the trick.

I came for the Wi-Fi as PJs Coffee has lacking wifi power just a few shops down the road. There was ample seating and my regular coffee was promptly handed to me. Creamer bar was well stocked; clean floor and loud music like all the other homogonize Starbucks you have ever been too.

This is probably one of the biggest Starbucks in the area. It has great seating inside (couches, chairs, benches) and outside. You can park on Magazine street (pay to park) or you might find some free spots around the corner on the street or in the back lot.

This Starbucks definitely feels more like a local coffee shop than a chain. The baristas are incredibly friendly, even at 6 am! They always make my drinks perfectly to order. This morning I was in uniform on my way to work and they showed some serious appreciation, I didn't expect it at all. Great people here!

Stopping at this location is apart of my daily routine. I continue to come to this location because of the staff. This is an awesome team! My only problem with this location is the parking lot. There are MASSIVE pot holes at the entrance of the parking lot and throughout. We live in Indiana, we all know we have bipolar weather- but the parking lot is never clear. I see elderly people in there every morning (the same 3 couples). One of them could fall on the ice and get really hurt. I slid today as I was walking back to my car. It takes less than 5 minutes to sprinkle salt down. Pay me, I'll come do it!

Closest store to my house, so I make a trip at least twice a month. It has a homey feel in that regulars are greeted by the staff fondly, students like to study here, always people reading with soft music in the background and customers understand early closings (4pm today due to TS/H Nate). If the line gets close to the door during a rush, there are 2 people at the register. Drive through is usually busy but fast. Fave store on the East bank.

Come summertime, there are always dead flies all along the counter. Plus a few smashed ones on the windows. It's NEVER clean here. No place comfortable to sit.  They do make a good vanilla bean frappe, but once you sit down to drink it...you just sort of question whether or not you should eat ANYTHING that they make here. Obviously SB does major drive-thru business, so that's what they focus on: shoving coffee out of the window to people who probably rarely to never step foot inside. So trust me when I say that they could stand to clean the place us a bit, please.
This was the closest Starbucks to where I am staying. Service was fast and efficient. There was plenty of seating. This location is at the Oxford Park Centre.

I like this starbucks because it's not usually filled with the chaos of any other starbucks usually found in other busy cities. 

I like to support local cafes in NOLA but once in a while it's nice to come here and just study for a bit. Plenty of light, I like to come in at the slow times during weekdays

Pretty reliable Starbucks, friendly employees, accurate orders. The only downside is that it's the only one in this general area so if it's a cold day the line gets crazy long. Coffee is always hot and delicious, will definitely be visiting here extremely frequently.

Just received incredible service at this store! Ordered my usual drink and asked about the new cascara latte. The barista's response was genuine and insightful, "you don't seem to like super sweet drinks because you only do 3 pumps vanilla in your latte, so I'm sure you'd like it." As I was waiting for my order, she had the barista making the orders make me a sample of the cascara latte. Wow! She asked what I thought and really provided an incredible coffee shop experience.

I'm did not appreciate this Starbucks. I go to a Starbucks pretty much everyday and order the same exact drink. The girl working the counter was rude and charged me for a refresher drink not a plain tea. I asked her if she had charged me correctly because my drink was over $2 dollars more than usual. I have been at basically a Starbucks in every city. Even in downtown LA, San Francisco, and NYC a plain tea does not cost that much. She told me "You got a trenta it costs more!" Meanwhile, I order a trenta every single day. Then I heard her tell another costumer that it was only her third day. Super rude and full of herself for only working there a couple days. Definitely will just skip this Starbucks in the future.
Hit or miss. The drive through employees are typically friendlier, but the line is usually crazy long. Popular location that I think needs more employees.
Slowest Starbucks ever. I only come to this location because it's close 2 the highway,  I have to get my coffee black because they rarely get it right!

Awesome location inside of Lakeside Mall in the Dillard's Wing. It's a small kiosk, nothing fancy like a physical shop location, but the coffee's always hot and fresh, and the baristas and staff are really nice. Because it's a mall location it's generally a busy location. There is seating nearby- but mostly anybody uses them whether they've made a kiosk purchase or not. There is WiFi nearby but the connections seem sloppy and unreliable. There are only a few plugs to recharge your devices. Only on the high seats in the island. But mostly if you're in the  mall you're shopping so it shouldn't be a problem. Just be advised to stay on your cellular data, or wait to get to better WiFi. Still awesome and sweet when ya need a Starbucks fix!!!!!!!

Stopped here on a cross country trip needing some Joe for the road.  First negative - no drive through.  Second negative - small parking lot that was very congested.  I think this must be an old Dr. office or something.  The building itself was unique for a Starbucks and was plenty busy but getting in and out kind of a pain.

Nice that the Sbux was in the hotel, not so nice that it smelled like piss every time I walked into the place. I even saw, what appeared to be some hotel staff, walk into the area and ask each other what the smell was, but the next morning when I ventured down, the smell was still there.

What didn't help the issue is that the line is not quick nor speedy in any way. Funny, since the main population this place serves are business professionals who are in a hurry. The staff did not seem to be with it, and the manager on duty (read her tag), was not friendly at all to the staff, nor guests. 

Disappointing.
Fast friendly service. This place gets super busy in the morning.  Tons of ucsb peeps. but they are quick. Clean spot and lots of seating

When it comes to coffee shops and stands, I'm usually not much of a Starbucks type of person. It's nothing personal. The coffee is decent, but I just prefer to support local coffee shops.

On a recent mall outing, I was in the mood for some iced coffee and my choices were a long line at Cafe du Monde or no line at Starbucks. I guess I'm an easy mark: no line wins over line every time, no matter what. This isn't a full on Starbucks shop, although they offer everything you would find at a regular Starbucks. It's pretty much a coffee stand in the middle of the mall. The man working was really friendly and the iced coffee I got was good and decently priced. I'm sure an iced coffee with 2% milk was the most "normal" order he had heard all day.

The cool thing about this stand is there are plenty of sofas and chairs, in case you want to lounge around and enjoy your coffee and take a break from the rest of the mall madness.
This Starbucks always seems to be out of something each time I go. My drinks never taste quite right either. I've decided a Target Starbucks is not worth the price of a real Starbucks.

This Starbucks has got to be the slowest one I've ever been to. I was so excited to see that this place is right down the road from my new house, but I might as well drive down to Curlew because this place takes FOREVER. Been here a few times now, and it's the same way. It takes me at least 15 minutes to get through the drive-through. The last time I left the line without my order. It was that bad!

I have mixed reviews on this location:
1) The service is SOOOO slow! They clearly take care of the drive-thru before bothering with the lobby. I was the only one in the lobby who ordered a drink, and I had to wait over 8 mins for my coffee. Really!? While 4-5 cars got their drinks ahead of mine.
2) The positives is that my drinks are usually made consistently well.

They either need to hire more baristas because this location is always packed and is only Drive-Thru Starbucks in Cherry Hill for commuters to Philly and in the surrounding areas.

Excellent location, great drinks and cafe snacks, but a little price-y,as all Starbucks are. I do favor this Starbucks over others I've seen in Tucson because it is so close to campus and has a wonderful outdoor seating and nearby fountain.
The Brownsburg Starbucks is my favorite! Not only is the coffee and the food great, but the service is AMAZING! I always feel like I am being greeted by friends! Such a friendly crew!

Parking lot is not the best, but staff is nice. As the manager position changes the place gets nice and not, in the past the manager was kind and would let high school kids relax outside after the store closed as long as the behaved. A new manager came in and got rid of that, also told the staff to be less friendly to the customers.

This is a really busy Starbucks in the mornings! Even when I order my drink ahead of time they always have it done within the estimated time the app gives you! I have never once had to have them remake my drink they always do an amazing job and customer service is phenomenal here!! 
Period, it is always great... be patient because this location is super busy in the mornings Monday through Friday. 
They are quick and efficient with a smile!

Disappointed in this SB. Took a long time to get drinks, even with what appears to be sufficient baristas behind the counter. And dirty with trash cans overflowing and tables dirty. It's mid afternoon on a weekend that is slow period. Disappointed in this SB.

I ordered ahead through my mobile app. My estimated time was 5-7 minutes. I got there about 10 minutes after I placed my order and didn't see my order at the counter. I walked up to the barista and politely asked if he had an order under my name, just to confirm that they received my order and he was snooty and said "there are other orders ahead of you. we have to serve the people here and through the drive-thru."....um, rude. Starbucks has a reputation for customer service and efficiency. This store doesn't represent the brand.
It is a fine Starbucks. Easy in, consistent coffee, outdoor seating. I tend to prefer places with a bit more atmosphere if i am having a meeting. I have gotten good coffee here many times.

Always wonderful. I recommend the skinny or regular mocha. Kids love the frappaccino. Using the app makes service and payment so much faster.   I am not sure how I ever lived without it. Service is consistent with the exception of one location at Tesson Ferry and Gravois in south St. Louis. The coffee was not hot and took forever to get a plain coffee.

Boyfriend and I went to grab some iced coffee drink for him and water for both of us. Spent about 10-12 minutes in drive-thru with only 3 cars in front of us. We come from a congested area in the suburbs of DC where drive-thrus are usually 10-15 cars long and the wait won't be much longer than experienced today. 

When we pulled up to the window, we saw 5 employees standing around chatting and were told that someone will be right with us. Boyfriend gets his drink and a minute later, we get one water after ordering two. No receipt, no straw for coffee drink, and no second water. If we weren't in a rush, we would've come in the store and demanded to speak with the shift manager. But for some reason, I feel that wouldn't have resolved or changed anything.

Stay away. Go to Dunkin for quick coffee fix, or small local coffee shops for small business support and better service.

Went there around 2:30pm. Local Starbucks where people will hang around. The parking lot is small, so parking was limited. 

Ordered: tried the new iced Oprah Chai Tea latte. It has a good spice to it. $0.25 of every order goes towards her charity, that's even better.

It's your typical Starbucks, nothing negative to add or anything exciting either. I was in and out fairly quickly. That's always a plus!

So, I'm paying $2.43 for a large (venti...or whatever they call it) cup of coffee; too bad I don't soak up some of that free wi-fi like others who seem to linger there for hours.  

The coffee is some of the best, most consistent and I'm a huge fan of paying via iphone and their rewards program.  Cashiers/Baristas always seem friendly at this location and always get my order right, but then again how hard is it to pour a cup of tall black?

Over the past year I've become a Starbucks loyalist and gold card member.  Love the coffee and service here.

This is a clean and comfortable Starbucks location with adequate indoor seating and a decent amount of tree-shaded outdoor space. The staff, while friendly was mildly inattentive. The barista seemed a little more interested in conversing with her male co-worker that going ahead and finishing my half-done beverage. It's not like the delay hurt the flavor of my drink in any way, but it seemed mildly disrespectful of my time.  

I came back the next day, 06/08/18 and the service was much better. A different barista was much more attentive. In fact the staff was much better overall, including one person who was helping a guest retrieve a mistakenly discarded gift card from the trash. (Eww, but way to go!)

This is a really nice location. It's roomy inside and they have several tables outside. Not a lot of parking though but it's fine. There's street parking. The staff are really accommodating. I wanted an over pour of Casi Cielo Cafe Misto and they looked in drawers and wholla!! They found a bag and said sure!! They even told me it will take a few minutes and to have a seat, someone will bring it right over. While waiting, all the staff treated their customers the same way. Also, when I scanned my app to pay for it, she said, remember to get a refill before I go. After a few minutes of sitting there, she came over and asked if I wanted a refill and I said yes. She took my cup. At most places, I don't get a Cafe Misto refill, it's usually just brewed coffee but she brought back a Misto. I was stoked!!

Love this place. I would come here next time I'm in the area since it's a few blocks from where we would stay.

This starbucks is ok, it's a bit small and crowded. Especially when there is a lot of customers. I used to come here to do homework but it just got too packed for me. It was conveniently close to me, but I've come to chosen a better place to go do my homework.

I went into the Starbucks in the Target after shopping.  It was 7:45 on a Sunday night and the cashier had told us that Starbucks closes at 8:00.  There was only one barista and when I asked if they were open, because she was sitting at a table, she responded that she would be on break for 10 more minutes. We decided to leave since it appeared that she would be on break until closing time.  They either need to have two people working at least or someone working by themselves needs to realize that the customer needs to be waited on and not expected to stand there until you are off of break.

I was working in the area and stopped here to caffeinate myself for my 90 minute drive home. If you're not college student age (the place was packed full of kids doing their homework, which I respect), you will pretty much be ignored at this Starbuck's. My 20 year old colleague was proof of that! I saw him get treated better than my 40 year old self and my 50 something colleague. I was holding an empty canister of half and half to alert the staff that it was empty and needed a little for my Americano and the cutesy young blonde working looked right at me, and continued her conversation with her coworker until ANOTHER COWORKER from the back noticed me and took care of the situation (maybe I should've asked my 20 year old coworker to get me the creamer, I would've gotten it quicker) The fact that there's a Vons in the same shopping center WITH A STARBUCKS in it should make these people give better service so the clientele doesn't go walking to Vons for their coffee fixes!! I have a feeling that's what anyone over the age of 30 does in this neighborhood!!!

Well, if you are a fan of classic Starbucks put-hair-on-your-chest strong coffee, stay clear of this place.  The coffee is so weak it is indistinguishable from any other coffee shop.  I couldn't finish my coffee this morning and this is the third day in a row that this has happened.  I asked about whether they had changed their formala and I was told that the "weaker" coffee taste was probably due to the ligher roast they used the previous day.  I am not a new coffee drinker.  I know the difference between a lighter roast and weak coffee.  You can have a lighter roast that is strong and a dark roast that is weak.  The weakness in the coffee I was tasting was due to one of two things:  (1) less coffee in the brew, or (2) very old stale coffee.  Either way, it made for a terrible cup of coffee.  If you like weak coffee, this is the place for you.  The service is actually excellent and the atmosphere is wonderful.  I love the music they play and the patio is a pleasure to sit on.  If you want strong coffee, though, I would suggest ordering an extra shot of espresso in your coffee, or go somewhere else where the coffee will be the same strength, but cheaper.

Typical Starbucks - good drunks, great service.  Only fails in attention to facility privacy.... Ladies restroom lock hasn't been fixed.   Instead the have a note!!!  Whoopee!   They need to fix the lock!  Like YESTERDAY !
When I am in town, this is my place for espresso. Curtis even knows what I want without asking, triple shot on ice.

One year later... 

So it's been almost a year... But I got sucked back into this location today out of exhaustion (and desperation)... The only good point to this Starbucks is the location... Otherwise, this store remains the crappiest in the area. Service and quality flat out sucks.

8/21/2018 7:30AM

Good thing I had time to kill.

This is a very clean shop and the Friendly Scale of 1-10, I would give them a 6.  Even the manager has issues with smiling.  I have found the aforementioned normal with Starbucks in Philly.

It's very busy, because of location.  The internet speed is spotty.  On my iPhone applications are very responsive, but on my Surface 2 pages do not load well in Internet Explorer 11, but better...whoops IE 11 just dropped connection.  Maybe because I tried to load Madonna's botched tribute to Aretha.  Well the Ping is 22MS, Download 6.68Mbps, Upload 3.38Mbps on Surface 2.  This is not the issue at the Starbucks 2201 S. Broad.  Why?

A pretty average Starbucks if you ask me. There're plenty of seats but because it's connected to a Macy's, I can see this place getting a lot of foot traffic during rush hour and wkends. 

The service when I went was just ok. One person, who was obviously still working ignored me for about 3 minutes then told me someone else would help me. That other person was very helpful.

The wait times here are completely ridiculous. The drive-thru line is usually at least 8 cars long, and they never seem in a hurry to get people through the line inside, either. With 6-8 people behind the counter, one shouldn't be waiting 10 minutes for three iced drinks. It's also dirty in the dining area. See picture...note the EMPTY drink area with four people waiting on beverages.

I havent done it in a WHILE Due to this awful recession id rather buy bags , booze and more booze, However working until 1 and not falling asleep until 1:45 and having to be up again at 6 is not something I can do @ my feeble old age. I needed a boost and red bull is more of an after 9am pick me-up . 
Im thinking and thinking and thinking THE BUXX  pops into my head like a lighting bolt from GOD on this magical ASHE WED ( oh its a sign) 

Tall NONFAT extra shot latte w/ 2 splendas has given me the power to crunch these #'s until 4 today 

GOD bless those baristas @ the starbucks on marsh and silverside!!!!

I feel bad using a specific name however I've been to this location 3 times this week and everytime Matt was extremely rude!. I even mentioned to him about being so happy to be there which he had a very crappy tude saying he was sick and its been a busy holiday week and he's worked a ton of hours.. While I was ordering everytime another customer walked in he would roll his eyes!! Ok I understand all of that to a certain point but come on.... On top of this two of my drinks were wrong! no apologies for the rudeness after I pointed it out or making my orders wrong! Everytime it was filthy as well!

I love that most Marriotts have a Starbucks attached to them or they serve Starbucks coffee. I am not an everyday coffee drinker, but Starbucks serve the best white chocolate mochas!!! This morning the service was prompt and courteous.

Went here after dinner tonight with my sister and a friend. We all got some very yummy treats. I had the chocolate chip cookie which was quite delicious. My sister had the lemon cake. She loved it. And my friend had the banana bread. he said it was really good and he gave me a bite, it was pretty awesome.  I had a vanilla latte one of my favorite drinks there. My sister and friend had the Salted Carmel hot chocolates. They loved them.

This place is pretty nicely decorated and quite packed. It's obviously very happening little spot. The wait staff was very friendly and when I wasn't very thrilled with my first drink they made me a new one. The customer service is always quite good at Starbucks. I have been to this place a few times in the past and would definitely go there again.
Excellent service. Come here very often. The people working behind the counter have already memorized my favorite drink and have been very attentive.

The coffee here always hits the spot for me! Great service, love the vibe from the staff here. They try to get to know their customers which is a huge plus.

They have great expansive seating areas which is a huge advantage for the business folks and common get-togethers in this busy city. I love the decor here. See a couple of photos I've taken. They've put efforts to match the environment in here to that of the surrounding structures. Paoli has so many historical values and it's such a delight to see business portray some of the fabled history attached to the city.

The only downside I would say would be the Amtrak station next to the shop. It brings in a lot of traffic and significantly affects parking. That however shouldn't deter the genuine coffee lover and happy Starbucks fan from this gem of a place.

The only bad thing about this place is the lot. I curse aloud every time I turn into it! I come here for my caramel macchiato and very berry fix. The barista Aliyah makes a mean and delicious caramel macchiato! Had one tonight and it changed my evening! Best I've had at any Starbucks so far!
They made my London Fog perfectly. The staff was friendly and I waited less than 3 minutes.
