A coffee shop is only as good as your last visit. It's Saturday morning, I have been sitting in the drive thru for 15 minutes and haven't moved. I think they are waiting on Juan Valdez to roll up with his donkey with the next shipment of beans.

Oh man, this place is great! For a while, I was in here every Monday and Friday morning with a friend. Not only did they remember our drinks, but always greeted us with a smile. What kind of corporate chain does that? Their drinks are flawless. I finally figured out why their iced coffee is superior to all others... I'm pretty sure they cold brew it which makes it a ton smoother. Anyone that says that the Bux isn't worth the extra price is absolutely nuts ... love Starbucks, love this location more.

I am so lucky this happens to be the nearest Starbucks to my office!  The weekday morning staff is so warm, caring, and friendly, and they make genuine efforts to engage in conversation and get to know me.  Their drinks are always consistent and well made, and they are always quick to point out that they'll happily replace a drink if it's new to me and I'm uncertain about whether or not I should try it (when I'm feeling gutsy enough to break free from my norm).  Case is always well stocked-very rare that they're out of anything (especially in the morning).  Hugely varied crowd makes for awesome people watching, too :)  Don't despair if there isn't room in the small parking lot, as there is typically plenty of street parking if you're willing to walk just a half a block!
The service here is aweful! The blond haired barista with the crazy dark eyebrows is a total witch... I think she forgot the customers, like me, pay her rent....

I have been to different Starbucks during my summer vacation here in Nashville, but my soy green tea latte hasn't tasted soooo good until I visited this location. It even tasted better than what I'm used to. I can finally say, I found the Starbucks where they can make my drink even better than how I like it!!!!
Friendly employees, and well stocked location with inside and outside seating.

I like the feel of this Starbucks. I'd say this is one of the better ones and I like that it's not really that busy. This means a good selection of places to sit. I know they call it a laptop, but I don't want it on my lap. Besides, all that radiation could, uh, damage my ability to have kids, should I choose to have more, right?

It's pleasant and bright and there's plenty of parking. Didn't see any signs indicating the presence of parking Nazis, but I'm always on the alert.

Busyness - Not a really busy place, but the morning is steady. Lots of available seats.

Noisiness - Overall pretty good. The music is at a decent level, depending on where you're sitting.

Ambience - I like this Starbucks. It's brightly lit, with the same light fixtures as the Starbucks at North Town Mall. It also has a lot of windows to let natural light in. The paint scheme is typical Starbucks, echoing coffee in the colour choice. It's pleasant overall.

Power - There is a good selection of outlets for most of the seats.

Free wifi - Available and works well.

Staff - Seem to be pretty good. The girl wasn't aware of my refill being free, but she may not have been the one who served me initially. I admit to being a little hazy earlier due to my lack of coffee. The men's washroom suffered from another patron's "bad aim" but I don't expect employees to check after every patron leaves. That'd be a full-time job in a coffee place. I did notice that there was no container of half and half at the counter and I had to refill the raw sugar (I've gone to Starbucks enough, I've figured that out.)

Seating - There are a lot of seats in this location at 31. You can choose from four armchairs, a couch and a nice long bench, as well as the traditional flat wooden chairs. I've never been a big fan of the tall tables, but if you like them, there are two, as well as four chairs at a bar. There's only one large table for serious work and the rest of the tables are smaller round ones. There are also four or five tables outside for those who'd like to brave the weather.

Security - Seems to be a nice neighbourhood, but I'm paranoid anyway.
Tall, 2-pump, no-whip mocha.

I'm pretty new to this whole leaving reviews thing so bare with me here! Whenever I go to a Starbucks, and I don't know if it's just my bad luck, the barista that rings me up rarely shows much interest or enthusiasm with their job or with welcoming me and it's a bit disappointing sometimes. But at this Starbucks there is a kind gentleman named Martin. I've gone the past two evenings and he rung me up and made my drink both times. He greeted me with a genuine smile each time and was very patient with me, being that I am very indecisive. We had small talk while he made my drinks and he showed interest which I really appreciated. I live downtown and I can say I do not mind driving to this Starbucks if I will be receiving this type of service every time. Plus, the atmosphere has been pretty calm both evenings I've gone, it's not too noisy or overcrowded :D

Just like any other Starbucks. Service was standoffish, it was too full and lacked atmosphere (and on Whyte Ave I expect atmosphere). I only went here because a friend suggested meeting here. With all the other cool places on Whyte Ave to meet, don't waste your time or money on this chain. My coffee was fine but nothing fantastic. Won't be going here again.
Great service as usual, but the coffee tasted like soap, I asked for a reusable starbucks cup to reuse my cup, but the coffee had a soapy taste..bit surprised

Yeah, it's a Starbucks.  If you don't know what their product base is about, then you should probably stick with the gem of a local roaster that you have been going to!
That said, I've never had a service issue early in the morning--my typical time when I'm searching for caffeine.  
As far as location goes, I really like this place.  There's no drive through, so the SUV crowd doesn't have their "in-car" fix.  Plus, there's great outdoor seating in the tree-shaded courtyard right outside.  Also, you'd be hard-pressed to find a branch with better people-watching possibilities than this one as it's located on University.
Great service and perfect coffee, and always very friendly. The only down is that they never ask for a name when the take order, so most of the time other people take my drink when mines ready.
Pretty good for a Starbucks. Lines aren't too long and they consistently get my order just right.

This location has shorted me twice now when I ordered multiple espresso shots. On 2 separate occasions within the same month I ordered 4 espresso shots as a solo order. When I got home and measured it out, I was only given 2 shots.
This location is always extremely slow. Nice staff but need a better system to get customers in and out. Each time I visit I wait for almost 15 minutes.
For those who work on the run, which often means local coffee shops-this is not your typical Sbux. Much more room and comfortable seating than the norm. My new fabrite.

This is the worst Starbucks.  The last two wines I have been here they have screwed up my order.  Last time they didn't put syrup in my frap and this time they gave me a mocha frap instead of a salted caramel.  Not again!  Wasted 11 dollars on something I didn't like or want!!!!

Great Starbucks with awesome staff. The coffee is always fresh, and it is served with a smile (seriously). The only thing that keeps this one from being a five star in my book is how small the store is inside. It's a good spot to grab a quick cup of coffee, but not so great to chill for a while.

Once a year, I go to Starbuck's specifically for heart attack in a grande cup, aka their seasonal egg nog latte. It's the kind of treat that begs you NOT to look up the nutritional information... no no, I'd rather turn a blind eye. But is it good? So good I woke up thinking about it.

This particular Starbuck's is very spacious, with lots of room for lounging, hanging out with friends and working. The baristas are fast - with so much traffic, they really run this place like a well-oiled machine. Always a stop for me when I'm near my aunt and uncle's house in the Lou!

Legit north county spot.  It's in a crappy lot by a strip mall but has a lot of parking.  Really close to the hwy too!  The inside is very, very small.  The drinks are of normal Starbucks quality.  The location over by Dunn and 270 is larger and nicer.

This is such a fun and easy to access store with helpful and friendly staff! I love the consistency of the product and the rotating seasonal offerings. The phone app makes it to easy to pay, order and track my coffee addiction and it keeps me coming back!

Best Starbucks I have been to in the Country. My wife and I frequented this Starbucks quite often while we were waiting to move into our new home and have internet activated. We sat in the lobby for hours at a time. The lobby is very comfortable, the staff is very friendly, our orders are always correct and done quickly. Can't say enough about this Starbucks. I have frequented several and this is the best one hands down.

We are from Germany, and we likes Starbucks. We stay here for Vacation in Chadds Ford. Day for Day we drink our Coffee and eat a Panini. Its beautiful. 
Next Year we comes Back.
My English is Not so Good.
Best Regards from Germany.
Mike

Very bad service. Please don't go. There were very rude and don't care about the customers. People behind me getting the order and some reason they didn't get my order for 10 mints . When I ask they were so rude. Starbucks management should do something. I never had a problem before with Starbucks. 
.

Oh man, did these guys get a new staff? Things seem to be served so much slower than in the past. I live across the street so it's super convenient and I wouldn't stop coming back. But man, I have to give myself like 10-15 extra minutes additional now compared with the old staff.

I never complaint on starbucks..but this time i have to! Mobile ordered: exactly 18 mins till i get my drink when i order 5 mins down the road! I understand theres situation where everyone ordered at the same time...but c'mon, 18 mins for a coffee drink,, i really dont have time for it! Whats the point of mobile order anyway...Really have to rethink about going to starbucks every single time now.

And on top of that..my drink was wrong...didnt follow my order!! ask for no ice, when i get ice..before that I ask gently how long or how many drink are ahead of me when i said i have been waiting 15 mins or more? maybe i could come back bc i have an urgent place i need to be..the barista guy smile and said with a tone "you are not the only one waiting, but the whole franklin town is waiting this morning!" wth...i am still shaking my head with the whole starbucks experience this morning!

I am done, this Starbucks is consistently rude and messes up my drinks. I will no longer being visiting this store. 
If I ask for NO WHIP then don't put whip in the bottom 2 inches of my drink. 
When I call don't argue with me, you are wrong you messed up my order.
Convenient location near the highway, good for caffinating your drive.
Awkward drive thru, the staff does a great job of directing drivers that aren't the brightest when needed. Sammy is awesome! Love when hes working. Always starts my day with a smile!!!
This place is awesome...the service is always fast and they have a bar to sit and wait at..........During the day its quiet, but during the morning its a busy crowd...nice place..
It's fine. Clean, neat, and you know what you're going to get. Good luck finding parking, though, but in downtown New Hope that's just how it is.

They get 2 stars just for being a Starbucks and making drinks correctly, but honestly, if there were another nearby, I'd go there.

I'm working mornings nearby for the summer, so I frequently stop here around 1.  The drive thru line is generally INSANE - this is not a business model that drive thru really work with.  The product takes too long.  It's usually much faster to park my car and go inside.  But the parking situation isn't great.

Final gripe - they don't have sandwiches or any of hte other non-pastry display items that most other Sbux' have, which makes it a little harder to stop here at lunchtime.

One of the most efficient Starbucks I've ever experienced. Friendly staff and clean environment. I can see why it's so popular.
Downside, it is NOT conducive for learning. It is very busy and loud.

I go to this location at least 3 times a week. Every time I go I have a pleasant and quick experience. My drinks are always spot on. This morning I forgot my wallet and didn't realize until I had already ordered. I informed the cashier and she let me have it for free! I can't remember her name but I see her almost every time I visit. Thank you for the coffee Starbucks! And to this cashier, next time I see you, you will be getting a large tip. Thanks again for being my favorite coffee joint!

First let me say everyone is very nice,but....
No one seems to have any idea how to make a latte how it's ordered. 
Here for a week and my buddy and I both order iced lattes. They're different every time. Its actually pretty amusing how off they are.

I'm only giving this store a 3 because their drive thru employees are super sweet every time i've been here. Today i came into the store to sit down and drink my coffee and get my breakfast. I waited in line to order and when it got to me, she seemed very rushed. i ordered my drink, AND FOOD. she didn't ring in my food, which is fine, i just waited in line AGAIN, i ordered my food and paid for it. then she tells me after i paid she doesn't have anymore of what i wanted. she then said "what else do you want?" in an aggravated voice. i told her nothing, i simply wanted what i ordered, she was very rude about it and told me she could just refund my money then. which is fine, but DONT BE RUDE. i work in the customer service industry and i would NEVER treat my customers like this. customers MATTER. i should have been told "sorry i apologize, we don't have anymore" rather than "what else do you want?"

This Starbucks is great. The customer service is awesome. All the guys working were hilarious and playful. They also made my drinking very quickly. It's a decent size with plenty of seating inside and outside. There is only one back wall with cushioned seats but plenty of normal chairs. All in all it's a great place to go on a coffee date or just go to cram for an upcoming exam (which is what I'm doing now.)

I love this place! Staff is amazing and they are pretty quick in the mornings. My "Peppermint Mocha" is always tasty and hot! :) I've even had one staff member announce my order at the drive through before I even said anything!

This is a great Starbucks. The staff is always friendly and like many other Starbucks they are rather efficient at what they do. I do find some inconsistency between baristas and this location is so busy in the mornings that I've gotten to the parking lot and there were no spaces available. I've had to park in the strip mall next door and walk several times. The drive thru line is also often backed up into the strip mall driveway in the mornings. I visit this location 1-2 times a week and will continue to do so.
The worst double shot on ice I've ever had. They clearly need to be trained on how to make this drink. Nothing but ice, I had to fix it when I got home.
Staff wasn't so kind but everything was ready fast and their selection of merchandise was excellent!

The music is always literally blaring. The girl was so rude at the counter. I simply asked her how much something was and she just says "I don't know"... then ignored me. This Starbucks has the worst customer service I've ever experienced. Again WHY IS YOUR MUSIC ALWAYS BLARING...

Clean and very friendly service.  Plus, they have a cute room with numerous tables, chairs, and sofas.  A great place to grab a cup of coffee (or the like) and catch up.  Parking can be a hassle but there is the metered lot in Union Square.

This particular location has the absolute WORST customer service in the industry! From the consistently slow drive thru, incorrectly made beverages and unbelievably rude service this location has it all.

This is my go-to Starbucks location. The drive-thru is super conviennent and the service is prompt and kind. The quality of the drinks is always perfect even though I never wait more than a few minutes for it (at most). I think drive-thrus often lack that high quality service customers want but this particular Starbucks has it perfected.
Great service! The white chocolate mocha with Carmel and whip cream gets me everytime. It has a wonderful atmosphere, comfortable for studying, and great service.

This Starbucks has a great crew of Barristas.  I've been on vacation in the area and have had my coffee here every morning for a week.  One day, the dark roast was out and one of the Barristas offered to make me a cup on the Clover so I wouldn't have to wait for the full pot of dark roast to brew.  Not sure who is having so much difficulty completing a simple transaction for coffee, but I'm inclined to think it's not the fault of the kids behind the counter busting their behinds, but rather some overly sensitive local who needs to be constantly validated to make up for the fact that they never broke into show business, as they all seem to be trying to do around here.  Get a job, locals!  And keep up the good work, Barristas!
Very nice Sbux. Love how spacious and plenty of plug in outlets there are. Next to the Arch, so perfect excuse to make a stop and rest a bit.

As a Starbucks regular, I especially love this one because of the staff. Sweetest people, best customer service I've ever seen at any Starbucks. I am a minute away from the main street Starbucks but insist on taking the trip up to this location because of the staff. Love this place!

This is one of the slowest Starbucks stores I've ever encountered. I consistently have to wait longer in the mornings than I ever have at any other location. I have ordered 15mins ahead of time on the app when the prep time is "4mins" and still waited over 5mins in the store. It also doesn't help that most of the employees are more interested in talking to customers than actually making their drinks.

A coffee shop is only as good as your last visit. It's Saturday morning, I have been sitting in the drive thru for 15 minutes and haven't moved. I think they are waiting on Juan Valdez to roll up with his donkey with the next shipment of beans

Not one of the better Starbucks avoid if you can.  Lousy food selection minimal pickings and I agree with the other person the guy who made me my drink was short and snippy.  Take your money elsewhere if you can

If you're going to need a high calorie totally unhealthy frappe you're better off getting much better shake at sonic for a lot better price with a smile too

Store revamped and clean and smart.
Excellent staff. Drinks served fast and efficient. My local and I love it.

I've been here twice and used mobile order both times. Both of those times I waited 20 minutes and eventually had to go the counter and ask about my drink. They weren't particularly busy either time and for my second visit all I ordered was a dark roast with soy milk, and they forgot the soy milk.

Like any chain establishment, for the most part a Starbucks is a Starbucks. I like this location because there is ample parking, both in the small lot behind the store (enter on Washington) and available on the street. There is also ample seating both indoors and outdoors. The indoor seating area has a variety of chairs, couches, and tables and the outdoor seating area has chairs and tables with umbrellas. The service is usually quick and of course there is free wi-fi. Unlike some of the other local coffee shops, it doesn't seem that people linger too long. Of course there are people studying, reading, working on laptops, etc., but I feel like they only stay for an hour or so instead of for the entire day.

This Starbucks is horrible! 9/10 my order is always wrong ! And i go right before work so i rarely get it changed! I wish there was another Starbucks close by other than this one I'm always disappointed

Starbucks is not easy to find here in NOLA!

This is the first and the only Starbucks I visited during my Weekend in New Orleans. I know there are more interesting places to chill out like going to the bar up the street to have a beer and using the WIFI...

But Starbucks here is definitely a lot more spacious and have a great outdoor patio area on the side.

Great location to just hang out and take a quick coffee break or stay for awhile to do some Internet surfing!

The customer service provided by the brothers and sisters of this location is unmatched. It's always a memorable experience when Lenny, Kyle and Batman are working. Nothing but laughs, good energy and good drinks. Thank you for going above and beyond for your customers and adding value to their lives. I'm sure I speak for everyone else in saying, we appreciate you!

Worst drive thru Starbucks in NJ. For kicks I timed the wait on the drive thru, as past experience was not good. It took 13 mins before we even got to order. There were three cars on line ahead of us. Once at the order station, it took 2:48 before the operator acknowledged I was there, and then only because I called out.  We watched two of the baristas come out and take out the trash as we waited on line. I do wonder who was making the drinks? Here we sat for exactly 20:18 before we got two sorry cups of coffee. SHAMEFUL. I will drive the extra miles to go to ANY other Starbucks and even consider Dunkin donuts before coming back!
Terrible service. Every drink in the order was wrong. Starbucks should be easy not this slow and inefficient. She also couldn't figure out how to take payment with the app - how is that possible.

Yup, I'm writing a review of a Starbucks. I have to. We go there almost every weekend, sometimes more than once per day (yikes!) and I'm giving them four stars. 

Not because I think Starbucks is all that great on its own. I'm not a hater. Starbucks makes fine coffee and serves it to the masses. Coffee snobs will hate on Starbucks because they think they have the rights to wearing nose rings and drinking coffee. Going to Fido does not make you a coffee snob, but it doesn't seem to help.

 No, I have to write this because it's like a bomb went off in Donelson and Hermitage and it killed off every coffee spot but two Starbucks locations. If there were local coffee offerings in this area (let alone worth going to) I would likely do so. I love local, and local coffee can be as fun as it is frustrating. But we have on more than one occasion had to move along from this Starbucks as the line to the drive through stretches into the Home Depot parking lot and the inside is swamped. 

Know what's amazing? The people who work here have always been almost creepy nice no matter what. We have been given free drinks after waiting in line because they were too busy. Wait, what? Yup, free coffee because we waited. With a smile.

Props to Ryann for being super nice and making me a new green tea soy latte when I just asked for more soy milk (since the green tea powder was chunky and undissolved at the bottom) Awesome customer service!!!
Coffee was ok. Selection of other food items was very limited. But that would not make it a 2 star yet. However this was by far the dirtiest bathroom I have seen in any Starbucks I have ever been.

What a pleasant way to start the day! The staff this morning was beyond pleasant. It is honestly the best way to start your morning when someone sings your name as they place your order, smile and say have a great day, AND they spell your name right on the cup! Thanks ladies!

I order a grande bold with a splash soy at each and every Starbucks I go to and this is the FIRST location where the barista/cashier showed me the cup at the counter and asked how the color was!  

Now, this was excellent for me because when I say "a splash" I literally mean "a splash" and they usually put way too much.  She put the perfect amount, but the fact that she asked how it was definitely made me happy!

I still go to this Starbucks location very often. The one in Cool Springs Franklin TN. The employees are super friendly. The Drive-thru is pretty quick. Customer Service is outstanding. I've had a few mistakes made on what I order. The employees react quickly. To fix the mistakes. In my honest opinion. The employees are amazingly awesome. They work hard to make your coffee, latte, Frappuccino. I always give them good credit no matter what. Just recently I tried their Smores Frappuccino. & it was the best cold beverage I've ever had. I am hoping for newer flavors of the Frappuccino beverages come to all Starbucks locations.

Just witnessed an employee roll a trash container full of trash through the store 3 or 4 times while he asked customers who were eating and waiting for their food to move out of the way while he dragged trash in a giant rolling trash bin through the store! Do not order from this place, it is unsanitary, and the employees are so lazy they can't be bothered to pick up a trash bag, and take it out through the back LIKE EVERY OTHER RESTAURANT IN THE WORLD. Someone should call the health department and report them immediately. 

The people who helped us at the counter were very nice, and they don't deserve to be represented this way by lazy employees.

This probably one of the worst Starbucks I visit. They are so slow with getting the orders including the mobile orders which they claim never prints. I'm sorry but what good is the mobile order service if it never works?

THEY ARE NOT A REAL STARBUCKS.  Worst Starbucks experiences of my life have been here.  First off, they are an independent something or other so you can't use any of your rewards or mobile order or pay with your app.  Second off, the employees clearly were not trained very well and seem to not have much experience with how Starbucks is supposed to work.  They are very awful at customizing drinks, so you should only stick with what is listed on the menu.  My usual order at any Starbucks is a "grande iced coffee, in a venti cup, with lite ice, filled to the top with almond milk" it comes out to $2.97 or $3.03 depending on the order in which they press the buttons (which calculates how much labor goes into the drink) and comes out a very light latte-looking color.  My friends tried to pick this up for me and read my script exactly and the employees seemed to have a very difficult time understanding the instructions (something I have seen no other Starbucks employee struggle with before).  They charged my friends $4.67 and made a drink nothing like what I asked for at all. 

If you want Starbucks take the walk to the real one on Freret street.

Wow, this SB location definitely has an efficiency problem. Average wait for grande cappuccino = 15 mins minimum. 5 of those minutes may just be waiting to order once you've reached the front of the line.
I cringe at watching all the slow moving wasted low energy.
If you are in a hurry, go somes place else!
Nice stopover to and/or from The Arch.  Friendly service 11/29/15 12:41pm from Lucy and nice sitting areas within Starbucks or adjoining next door in the Hyatt.
I love Starbucks. I go anytime I need a pick me up, they always provide great customer service even with my crazy special drink request add ons

I have such a love/hate relationship with this location. On one hand, the staff members are always friendly and more than willing to make sure the customer is happy. On a few small occasions, which I am not proud of, I have fumbled in my usual Starbucks fluency and forgot to say "iced" or whatnot in the midst of my ritualistic request for a "grande iced light caramel macchiato" and they were more than happy to make it iced instead of a latte when I realized my own unhappy mistake. Hey, when you have to remember FIVE fluent words to properly communicate your order, it happens, and they understand that. I appreciate that.

On the other hand, the line could NOT MOVE MORE SLOWLY in the mornings. So many times I've given up and drove right past this location at the sight of a line of cars dangerously backing up onto Veterans Blvd. and blocking traffic. The most baffling thing about this to me is I have (stupidly) waited in this long long tedious line many times out of pure desperation for my 11-syllable-long coffee order, and the line always moves painfully slow. Not sometimes, ALWAYS. In fact, I've timed it eagerly while on my way to work. On average, between 7:30am-10am this line may take you anywhere from 10-20 minutes on average to get through. Usually this averages out to about 15 minutes on any given weekday but there have been times I've waited for nearly 25 minutes in my car questioning the purpose of my entire life that I don't seem to have the decency and pride to say "forget it" and drive away like a normal functional human being with due priorities. It's a pretty consistent statistic. Unfortunately, I usually I don't have that kind of time before work to wait that long for my amazingly addictive grande iced light caramel macchiato. But I admit, there have been times in the past where I was a part of the problem (*shame*).

Anyways, by the time I get up to the window it's routinely about a 5 second exchange of, "That'll be $5.38, here's your drink, and here's your straw, have a great day!"....and I'm off! Sooooo my question is, WHY is it when I get up to the window it's all easy breezy but yet I'm sitting in a gridlocked parking lot for 15 minutes waiting on the people ahead of me?!?! I really WANT to understand!!! I really do!!! Are there an exceedingly large number of people in the drive through line with excessively complicated Starbucks orders? Are they fumbling through their wallets at the check out window because they failed to make their payment ready while they were sitting in line for 15 minutes? Are they all approaching the window and then suddenly deciding they changed their minds and now they DO want that whipped cream on their skinny double frappuccinos? WHAT IS IT?!?!?! WHY?!?!?! I NEED TO KNOW STARBUCKS!!!! Ok...sorry rant over.

My point is I really love the service and the Starbucks product in general but this location is a clusterf*** to get in and out of during peak coffee hours. I am forever highly faithful to my Starbucks coffee splurge but BEWARE if you are trying to hit up this location on a weekday morning with a time constraint. It might not be practical for most people to endure en route during busy mornings.

Absolutely terrible. I've come here 3 times and they just completely forgot my order 2 times. I would stand by the counter for 15mins and no one would bother to ask. they charged your card and just completely forgot to make the drink. 1 or 2 of the staffs are friendly but the rest is pretty cold. They would talk and laugh with each other instead of making your drinks.

It's a Starbucks. It's exactly like the others, which is one of the reasons why chains are sometimes comforting. You know what you're going to get. My tall Zen tea is going to be the same wherever I go. So I'll break down this location's idiosyncrasies. 

Pros
-Comfy chairs, and tons of seating.
-Clean bathroom
-Relatively friendly/professional staff
-Next to the train station

Cons
-The parking lot blows. They have three spots for Starbucks' customers within the train station lot and two or three parallel spots along Rt 30. 
-No drive thru
-No personal touches. It's Starbucks, they won't be dolling out hugs.
The employees here at rude and very slow.  The cashiers at this Starbucks are the rudest I have ever seen at any Starbucks
CAPRICIA is the BEST she knows just what I'm going to order and sees me coming lol love her
This place desperately misses Clint. Not the same since he left.  He used to keep the line moving.

So there's slow and there's Starbucks slow.  Really.  Been here 17 minutes with 6 drinks coming over walk in counter and 11 going over drive they window.  

This Starbucks is so slow it is ridiculous.  Safe bet here - go they drive thru.  They have a timer and they are in task.  Walk in. - slow.

Incredibly busy constantly. I came here a few times during a trip to Tulane and visited during the week and on a weekend and it seemed like there was always a line out the door. I think because of this the service wasn't the friendliest but I can understand given the sheer volume of orders.

The outside patio is really nice and would be a great place to work or study! I just wish there would have been space the few times I was there.

Find another location for your morning coffee fix. They are consistently out of menu items.  Couldn't make either of my two favorites last time I was there.  Had to sit in the drive thru as I'm not purchasing something else that I don6want just because. 
The drive thru is also incredibly slow. I've waited for nearly 25 minutes with only three cars ahead of me.

I have been to many Starbucks locations in many states and this by far is the most unorganized location I have ever seen. It took way too long to get our order when you consider that there were soooo many people working behind the counter- they are definitely not short staffed. It was crazy the amount of time people were waiting for their orders. I was trying to figure out what all the staff was doing, they just seemed to be moving around back and forth but not really doing anything. Side note: When we walked outside to leave we noticed the drive thru line was ridiculously long. Also, the guy that took our order- Daniel- was very unfriendly and seemed disinterested in our business and the napkin area needed to be cleaned. The two stars are because the breakfast sandwich was actually very good and I also appreciated Taylor's attempt to make sure everything was good with our order.

Great atmosphere, very clean. And baristas are very friendly & professional.  I am there often enough that they know my favorite drink and always perfect it.  Nice place to relax and meet friends there for a chat.

Dan is awesome. Cleans up fast & efficient. Makes darn good drinks, super nice. The customer service is out of the world. The parking lot sucks so be prepared. The inside seating is larger than I expected which is nice, but I guess that's why the parking lot is filled

I come here often. Heidi was unable to place my cup in the correct area-difficult task, I know. I waited 15 minutes before finally saying something. She overhears and the saunters down with my cup.  No explanation or apology!
This Starbucks has clean bathrooms, great service, lots of seating inside and outside and wifi.

I'm grateful that this place has a drive-thru and for that reason I will be an occasional  customer.  

However the drive-thru coffee is usually only lukewarm. I asked about that once and the barista told me it was because I added cream to the coffee.  Hahaha.  I get coffee from the Marlton Starbucks all the time and the coffee is always streaming hot,  with cream.  Oh well.....

Every single time I visit the drive thru at this Starbucks, it takes at least 20 minutes. Every time. Other Starbucks stores in the area - Hendersonville, Goodlettsville - are efficient and well run. The young man at the drive thru yesterday around noon didn't care at all that we had waited 20+ minutes for a single iced coffee, and worse, he even seemed to be *laughing at us* as we paid! Starbucks really needs to make some changes at this particular store.

So loud inside, it's uncomfortable. Crowd noise is one thing, but noise is 83db two feet from the cash register. I've been in over 500 Starbucks all over the world, but I won't come back to this one.  No manager on duty.

Another Starbucks. Typical drinks, typical snacks, typical decoration. So what makes this one different from the rest? I can point out 2 pros and 1 con:

Pro #1: Location. This is located on a busy corner of one of the busiest foot traffic streets in Edmonton (Whyte Ave; also known as 82nd Ave). So the location makes this Starbucks a great place to meet up with friends while enjoying an afternoon out and about. Another great aspect about the location is the ability to people watch. Whether you sit inside, or at a table on the sidewalk, this is a great location to soak in your surroundings.

Pro #2: I like the bar space set up inside. This is something I haven't seen at any other Starbucks. Just to the left of the barista brewing centre there is a bar with about 4 stools set up. It is fun to watch the barista's work behind the counter and I love the space available. The round tables at typical Starbucks' are quite small if you are going there to do work but this particular bar is very wide which is ideal to spread out books and papers.

Con #1: I guess this is related to the first pro. The fact that it is located on a busy street means lots of street noise from vehicles driving by and also can make it difficult to find parking. Hopefully this encourages people to take public transit but I know that option is not always feasible.

Overall I do really like this Starbucks, especially in the summer while the city is abuzz with all of the festivals taking place.

Conveniently located just off 70 in case you need a fix in the middle of suburban hell.

I grew up just a few blocks away in Barclay Farm and it's interesting to watch as suburbia has eaten away at all the mom and pop shops and chain stores have popped up.

The parking is very tight here due to the amount of businesses in the area. Back up S  L  O  W  L  Y.

Don't forget to ask for a puppucino in case your beastie is with you.

Service was robotic and fine.

Ain't gonna lie, the service is 4 stars but the crowd control and wait is 1. They closed off the exterior door, so you have to walk through the book-store. At 10:30, the line was all the way to non-fiction... and that ain't no lie.
After 17 years this Starbucks is closing. Everyone I speak to is so upset.  Why close?  Don't, please stay open!!

Smaller sized Starbucks but most of the tables are still going to be owned by the laptop crowd. I guess that's just how *$ are these days.

I had a quick single espresso and my barista pushed the right buttons. I was able to drink it before it really started to cool.

Oops, and then I WAS one of those laptop people for a half hour.

Small parking lot in front but there is more parking around to the back.
Great coffee for a Great price.  I don't know when they will find some coffee that is better.  Specialty drink wise that is.
Even though they weren't that busy, they screwed up my coffee and forgot to make my sandwhich.

This Starbucks is never open on time and ready to serve it's customers. 

I use to be able to depend on them to be open in the morning before I go to work to get my $8.00 coffee and scone. 

They are never never open on time any more. They use to be open at 6 am, lights,
on and ready to go. In the last two months they are never open on time, or not open at 
all at 6 am. There is always a line outside at 6 am waiitng for them to open, and 
many times it is 6:15 or 6:20 before they open if at all. 

I have counted as many as 9 people waiting to have coffee outside their door, at 6 am .
It must be costly to the owner to loose sales, like this. The customers are walking
next door, to a little pastry shop for their morning cup of coffee and pastry. Honestly
the pastries next door are much better. PJ's is there but does not open till 6:30 am.

It is awful to drive to a place for coffee, be in a rush because you have to be at 
work, and not have the doors, open. So irritating to say the least. No one smile or
greets you and in fact you get ignored for the most part while they stock the pastry
in the display. 

I would like to know who is responsible to open, and if the owner knows, they 
are loosing sales and customers. I myself am there every Friday, Saturday,
and Sunday before work at 6am and spend an average of 8-10 dollars a day.

That is 30 dollars a week some 1500 - 1600 a year. I cannot tolerate this 
inconsistency and will take my money eslewhere. 

I am just infuriated by the whole thing.
I love this Starbucks. Maria is the best ever. Her coffee is on point. Makes my morning.
Another reliable cup of Joe from St. Arbucks.

Surprisingly enough I've only been here once (I think). The space was small but very clean and really light and airy, despite its dark brick exterior. There is a small area for seating, just a few tables. My drink was really good but the staff didn't seem to care much about the customers. They were definitely more into their own conversations because they did not engage with any of the three parties that came in, which was really disappointing to experience. It almost felt like you were burdening them by being there. There is also seats available outside which is really nice since the entrance is right in the middle of New Hope and seated right alongside the bridge to Lambertville!
Filthy bathrooms and a Morning barista that kept screwing up drink orders,Not impressed!!!
Just waited 17 minutes in a line of 5 people, they where out of everything, and then yelled at me about it.
Much better experiences here lately! I think they finally got some new staff so they aren't so overwhelmed at this busy location. Lately everyone has been friendly and drinks come out faster

I've never been much of a coffee drinker. I'm more of a hot tea kind of girl. However, when I stumbled into this Starbucks looking for Christmas gifts, I have to admit I was really pleasantly impressed. 

Not only did they have a great display of gifts for sale, but to my surprise I found a nice little "nook" that I see myself going back to to hang out. They have a few comfy chairs, and several decent sized, sturdy tables set up where you can meet, study, and plan your day.  My favorite surprise was the book nook - they have a little alcove of books that you can read...YAY.

While I was there, I thought what the heck. I got a Salted Carmel Mocha Grande - YAY again. I have decided that this is now my go to beverage when I stop in. This drink alone may have converted me into a coffee drinker! No one is more surprised than I about that, let me tell you. 

I always envisioned Starbucks as having long lines, cramped space, and crabby people needing their next caffeine fix. I've been there 5 or 6 times now, and I always get waited on right away, and the barista is über friendly and helpful. 

I like this spot. A lot. The only drawback I've found so far, is that it's in a strip mall, and the parking lot can be full right in front of their store. But for books, a comfy chair, and and a Salted Carmel Mocha, I can fight for a parking spot.
Expect to wait a painfully long amount of time unless you have a mobile order. Annoying.

Very friendly staff!! Comfortable atmosphere for a Starbucks. I don't care for Starbucks, but I like that Starbucks. I had a caramel frappuccino and the foam was so sweet. Terra the cashier took her time with me. I had a gift card that needed to be scanned. She took her time and made sure everything went through correctly, my final bill was .23. Stop by for a refreshing coffee drink after riding the street car.

This used to be my go-to Starbucks, but since this day I think I'll just have to drive an extra block or two to get my daily cup, or try the new local place around the corner. I was annoyed about the milk ring (so gross), but even more annoyed that my Americano was so poorly made. I would have forgotten all about it but I complained to the supervisor, gave my information, and was told the manager would contact me the following day. Well, that was weeks ago so apparently they didn't care to make things right with one of their regulars. Which sucks because my original barista there, Bailey, is legit one of the best in town. Miss her already 

Check your coffee before you pull off people! I know that's easier said than done.
It's convenient because I work on base. Really good customer service. A good place to escape during lunch when the food court is busy.

This store is no where near the level of expectation of any other starbucks.  The mere fact that it's tied to a higher dollar hotel should be an indication to me of a higher level of service and expectation and this one just couldn't get out of their own way.  The staff was rude, the service was slow and it was obvious that the normal training of customer service that is provided by Starbucks simply wasn't completed.  Also, the store hours are less than ideal for what should be a "high traffic" store.  It's right across from a convention center which should mean that hours would be extended, not cut.  Standing in line for 20 mins (a line of 5) while 2 people meander their way through the day was just frustrating.  I get it, the hospitality down there is much more laid back, but the standard I would expect from a Starbucks store was seriously low!
Excellent and fast service. The line was insane long but i didn't wait almost at all. The staff was pleasant despite the crowd and they worked fast.

I love that they have a drive thru and The Loughborough Commons Starbucks and I like the bistro sandwiches.  But, they are always out of stock on menu supplies.  Very inconsistent in regards to inventory at this location.

If you are looking for the perfect combination of coffee drinks and people watching then this is the place for you.

 With the perfect location in New Hope there is never a dull moment with the hustle and bustle of this wonderfully populated town.

The location is perfect for people watching but the parking can be tricky. On busy days such as the weekends all meters are taken and it may take a few trips around to find a spot.

The Starbuck's is a hidden gem among all the other glammed and obvious shops throughout New Hope.  The simplicity of the brick is important.  With the pleasant porch that has chairs and tables, sets the mood even before a customer sets foot in the shop.

The interior of this Starbucks is very neat and tidy with a relaxing feel.  If staying a long time do not fear, the bathrooms are very clean but only have one bathroom for each sex which can become inconvenient if a line forms. 

As it is such a prime location, many customers are only to be expected. At certain times such as weekends there are lines that are not the most convenient when waiting for your delicious beverage. 

The beverages and snacks to go with are very good. Do not be afraid if you have a special request, the workers are very friendly and appreciate good clientele as much as you appreciate good workers.

Walking in the large doors you will be engulfed in the delicious smell of different coffees. After getting your drink and scone you can choose to go to the inside seating where there are both seats with tables as well as comfy arm chairs to sit back and relax while sipping your drink. On a nice day I recommend sitting outside and enjoying the town from one of the tables on the outside porch. This starbucks is best for the atmosphere the town itself brings.

I assume everyone knows the basics of Starbucks from the different options of drinks to tall, grande and venti size. Since Starbucks is a chain coffee store I would say the one in new hope is best for its surroundings and the feel of the place.

I come to this location very often!! It's right on my way to work on 96th st. I usually come in the morning and go through the drive thru. Usually this lady Laurie is working! She is the absolute sweetest!!!! She always seems to be happy even like today when there is a drive thru line soooo long!  I have never had any problems at this location! Very spacious! Also has lots of outdoor seating!!!!

The service is horrible! I ordered an ice pumpkin spice latte and they ended up not having the drink and not informing me! I sat here for 20 minutes waiting for my drink. I finally said something and they just said sorry we don't have that drink... so annoying.

Great group of employees here .
My family & I grab Coffee along w/ food items etc... almost 2-3 days a week. 
Love this location as a local .

I stopped at this Starbucks in a state of latte-emergency.
I desperately needed a caffeine pick me up and this location at 5:30 PM on a Friday was nearly empty so I got in and out quickly.

Staff was friendly and restrooms were clean (enough).

No issues.
Thankful they are here.

One of my favorite Starbucks places! The workers here are wonderful and the service is even more amazing! Came in for coffee and for some reason my Starbucks app would not pull up so I can redeem my free drink. The girl who was at the window told me not to worry and have a wonderful day. Just amazing customer service!

Shanelle the Barista here is amazing!!!!! My daughter bought a drink that she didn't love. She tried to doctor it up, to no avail so I called and told them it just wasn't right. Shanelle said "bring it back... I'll make it to your liking for sure!" Well, she did just that and made sure we were taken care of!!! This is what real #customerservice looks like!

First time at this location, on Independence Day ; it was a bit busy, but we were still able to order immediately and served promptly. Our cashier, (sorry, I didn't catch her name! My cup says register 2 @ 10:44 am) she was super nice and helpful. We had 3 gift cards and paid with cash, but she wasn't bothered at all and assured us of such. Again, I wish I got her name to commend her! Service was great, coffees were real good. I got Triple Venti Macchiato & my mom got a newer drink, cocoa cloud macchiato. Both delicious, as well as the breakfast sandwiches. I will def be back, thanks again!

At least this location got my latte correct.....
I always my coffee at Starbucks if they make what I order.....

They plated my cheese danish - the first of 8 Starbucks in the area to do that. 

Great service and very friendly people.

Starbucks usually have their acts together. Morning prime time and things are humming. This Starbucks, people standing around looking lost. Long line with nobody being helped.  Coffee that is mundane. With so many great coffee shops in town (shout out to Handlebar), why did I come here?

I really feel like Starbucks is trying to improve -- the last few I've visited have been very pleasant... the employees all very helpful and polite, the espresso pretty good. This one in Hermitage is no exception.

Placed a mobile order for five of us after a big storm knocked out our power. It was ready on time, but the pineapple black tea, which was on the menu, was not available. The barista substituted the Mango Dragonfruit limited drink for no extra charge. It was ready in record time. Friendly, accommodating staff in a clean, appealing Starbucks makes this a great place to patronize.

Today I went for breakfast before work. I work for a family. I have to be at their home so the family can go to work on time. I was 8 minutes late because they were so slow. They USED to be fast but not anymore. I may call & complain. I believe feedback helps make life better. My sandwiches weren't ready at the door. They got my order right but they waste peoples time.

I used to come here in the morning and it was fine.  The last few times I came at night and the staff was joking around and not making the orders in the right order.  They need more training or different employees.  How can my mobile order of two items get split by 2 other orders

A Starbucks is a Starbucks, but this location looked super-nice and modern. Lots of tables, expansive big windows, a nice view. 

Not a big parking lot but I found a place right away. No drive-through a bit of a minus but as there was no line and the service was quick I didn't sweat it.

I branched out and tried something different today, a Peppermint Mocha Frappuccino. Feeling seasonal. My frap was quite good. Tasty chocolate chunks on top, rich creamy whipped cream and minty fresh frappuccino goodness. The drink was all good.

The barista was nice. Got my name right which I understand is the perennial Starbucks battle.

As I am a Starbucks fan I imagine I'll be back.

By far the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. Eve going inside the wait is longer. Not sure their staffing but they have staff that are doing nothing at times. Your drink will sit there and just melt. Go to the one on grand for better service.

Starbucks needs to check the freshness dates on their Meal-Sized Plastic Box Treats. Seems at times freshness dates are overlooked. Snack and coffee freaks be aware.

Coffee is hot, or coffee drinks are ice cold. As we all know Starbucks has a coffee version for everyone.

The hot breakfast sandwich choices do not disappoint. This applies to any Starbucks anywhere it seems.

At the corner of State and Victoria in SB the Starbucks Crew is always friendly and nice. They do fix my orders just right every time. No worries at this location on my coffee requirements. A most convenient location at times! 

Use the App, it makes it so easy to get in and out of this busy Starbucks. If you need a coffee upgrade or a new flavor version, Handlebar is not too far away.

Give yourself extra time for your order. 

Right across the street from the convention center and a decent option for shorter lines for coffee than at the Starbucks in the center. The staff is super friendly. Like ... I fell like I want to be friends with them friendly. That makes up for the slow service. I chalk it up to the southern style of not being in a hurry. Granted all of us at a conference want our coffee now! Probably not a bad thing to make us slow down for a minute.

Thank you for giving me old, stale, nearly cold coffee today. I asked for the Thanksgiving Blend and the Safeway employee said something unintelligible and then pumped a cup of coffee from a thermos??? I asked for a stopper to keep it hot, what a joke. That $2.25 went in to the trash, no time to go back on my lunch break. Very disappointed.
Excellent customer service, if not the best in the downtown Reno area. Fast service, very clean, nice patio area to enjoy your treats outside.

I come a lot for work and meet ups, not one of the best Starbucks but close to me. It's kinda weird getting into the this place if your going south bound 116th street you have to make uturn to get in, it's only one way in craziness. Other than that they have friendly and good service.

I'm a fan of Starbucks. I am a huge fan of the new feature in the Starbucks app for ordering ahead. You just order, go to the location, and get yours off the counter. Efficient.

Here in #Nashville, a couple of local #Starbucks spots have AWFUL lot designs. Starbucks (West End) and Starbucks (Dominican). West End has a massive and dangerous drive-thru line sitting in the road all morning. Dominican has not nearly enough parking, creating a free-for-all need to invent solutions on the fly. Sometimes, this results in a cranky customer yelling at another, like I was yelled at this morning. Surely causing your customers to bicker was not part of the brand promise, Starcrack. This lot also has a dead-end into the oncoming drive-thru traffic, complicating the discovery of the lack of adequate space even more. (Starbucks Smyrna is also guilty of this one.)

I realize the previous Councilwoman from my area of town is credited with securing the Starbucks (and neighboring Lexus) deal, but clearly the planning was poor. Kinda what you'd expect, given her reputation. I was actually going to take this issue on if I had run for Council, especially the West End part.

So the question is, what are you guys gonna do about it??

Not only got my order wrong once and had to pay for their mistake, but got home and realized they got my order wrong again. Bad management and bad service. Better off going to the drive through Starbucks on Kennedy.
You know,  I was going to write a bad review about a worker there. ...but decided to take the high road...:)

I've waited far too long to write this review. This location has consistent bad service. Each time I come here I regret not taking the time to go to the Avon location. Starbucks has me where they want me, though, I'm so addicted to their product that I'm a captive audience. First of all, my biggest complaint is their lack of quality control with their drink production. They frequently burn their espresso shots or "skunk" them by being too slow with pouring them into drink, the ratio of syrup to milk is never right, often you are handed a very light grande (in other words they are too lazy to make sure each person consistently gets adequate steamed milk because they are stretching out the one carafe as long as possible), and if you order a drink that calls for stirring (i.e. Mocha) just forget it - that mocha sauce is just sitting at the bottom so be prepared to self stir. Second of all, they are not efficient. I'm willing to wait for an excellent drink when they are busy, but instead I'm made to wait while they stand around complaining and socializing & then handed a sub-par drink. There are a few people that work the drive through that are just rude. One is a young female who is so emo that she depresses us instead of greeting us. The other is a very tall middle aged man who is not funny despite trying very hard to be, not motivated AT ALL - very lazy in his presentation AND the dude ALWAYS hands us the wrong drinks first. Also I need to note that when I'm handed a completely wrong drink and I ask you to make me what I ordered - telling me what you handed me is better anyways is NOT customer service. Bottom line is every single time we visit this location we are reminded that we keep saying we should never come back there. Well, this time I think it'll stick. We will not be back. Sucks cause we are both currently grimacing over our mediocre coffee drinks that we just paid $12 for. Not happening again - Brownsburg Starbucks lost our business for good this time!
Average location, wait time was okay. No complaints, the hotel lobby was a nice thing to walk into!

This is my very favorite Starbucks. They consistently make the best Chai lattes. It's amazing how much the taste can change from store to store. They are super friendly and even when it's hopping they are pretty speedy. Highly recommend!!!
Coffee is great here...the only thing that I find weird is that they never have those Madeline cookies!!!!!! Why can't they order them??? I never had this problem at the Starbucks in Florida!

Hooray for a Starbucks with a drive-thru! This one is located right next to a gas station, right off the interstate, so it's convenient. The drive-thru line moved very quickly, and my order was correct. What more can you ask for?!

Another bad experience at this location. Not sure why I keep going in. Stood at register for 5 minutes. No acknowledgement.  No "we'll be right with you."  

Went out of my way to stop today. Now I'm running late w/o coffee b/c I finally just had to leave.
Worst Starbucks in Nashville. Slow service, overly busy, and the lattes and mochas are very bland tasting. Very clean store though.

Stopped into this Starbucks because it's on the way to West Chester and has a parking lot (rather than street parking like the one in downtown West Chester).  They served my tea quickly and efficiently and the salted caramel cake pop I ordered along with it was divine (except for when it fell off the stick).  The store was busy but still clean and well maintained.  I'll be stopping here regularly moving forward.

This location is fast, the people are very friendly, and the store is clean. I really can't see any reason to say anything other than it's great. People who write one star reviews because they have a I want to speak to the manager haircut need to get a life.

Went through the drive thru and employee Drea was the absolute most rude employee I have ever met from Starbucks. I go to that Starbucks almost everyday and have never been disappointed till now. Never have I ever had a person rip my debit card from my hand and she slammed the drive thru window open and close and said nothing but "HERE YOU GO". Makes me never want to go back to Starbucks off sunset hills THANKS DREA.
When I informed a partner that there was no soap in one of the bathrooms her immediate response was, "well just use the other bathroom".

Two stars because a friend works there. I find the customer service here is lacking. It's snarky. I often find that I am waiting at the counter for service while they finish sweeping or putting this and that away. Maybe I'm expecting too much. The product itself, though, is usual sbux fare and I do find their food selection beats the competition down the street.

It's been a long time since I had Starbucks. This location has lots of outdoor seating and so many people on their devices inside that it feels like a library (4:10pm Monday). More libraries would stay open if it weren't for fast wifi in Starbucks.I had to get off for this yelp review though (rarely can I acces this wonderworld on public wifi). Anywho, service was quick, my pumpkin spice frap was sweeter than I remember BUT the last time I had Starbucks was probably harvest/Halloween time last year. It tasted more like caramel than pumpkin spice. New state, new tatse buds I suppose. Worth the $, well air-conditioned inside, music I like played among the tapping and drink machines wirr-ing. Will return if in the area

I usually come here when I have to study, and this is one of my favorite Starbucks to come to. Most of the other ones in the area are always crowded but I can always find a table when I come here and can spend as much time as I need here either studying or hanging out with friends and drinking good coffee. The prices are a bit steep for what it is, but then again it is Starbucks. The inside of this specific Starbucks is large and spacious unlike some other ones, and the baristas are always friendly.

I prefer Starbucks over other options for coffee but this location has its issues.   They're often very busy and not super fast so there's often a long line.  Parking in the lot behind the store is tricky and often not an option.   On a recent visit I had a problem redeeming a reward.   Karen (the manager?) was very rude and condescending.  Her customer service skills need a great deal of improvement.

Was here for Scentsy convention . A plus service. Bought a pastry and it was moldy! Yuck! But
The were mortified and
Made it better.. Always
Called me by name

Tristen was a great pleasure this morning March 24,2019. We are on or way back to Atlanta GA our home and he took our order right away with a pleasant voice and also got the order right on point. Customer service is really big to me since I for one work in that bracket as well. He handed out our drinks in a timely manner and did not have us waiting no more than three seconds. Now that's what you call great customer service. Love it! Keep up the great job Tristen hopefully I spelled your name right. If I ever come back to this area I'll make sure to get my lovely drinks from Starbucks ! Omg my drink is perfect.

yes I am a fan, I think you have to be to go .... dont you?!
This is a very nice location with some nice people working the counter.
Great location on 4th, just a bit cramped in the parking area.

Went to this Starbucks location twice in one morning and had terrible service both times. The cashier was rude, they set drinks/food down without announcing it was ready. I stood for about 10 minutes waiting for a breakfast sandwich and when someone finally asked me what I was waiting for the girl finally noticed that my sandwich had not even been put in the oven. Everyone was busy fumbling around with stocking the kitchen and not with customers. Disappointing as service is usually great at Starbucks.

This Starbucks is pretty good. I appreciate the longer hours, and decent size/location. The place can at times get a little grimy... my guess is because they're extremely busy, but overall it is pretty comfortable to get some work done. It's right next to a movie theater so it's cool in that aspect too.

The staff here are always super friendly. It can be quite busy at times, but you never have to wait too long to get your order. It's quite a big store with adequate seating. It's one of my favorite Starbuck's locations.
The Starbucks itself is great...the parking lot, i want to punch in the face..
Nice staff but that's about it. It's freezing cold and the WiFi is absolutely terrible. Had trouble just steaming Apple Music.
This is not a Starbucks.  If this were a Starbucks, then I could pay for my coffee with my Starbucks stars.  As I can't, it's rather a waste of time and effort, and false advertising.

I don't go here because of their no carry policy.  I believe that people who carry make us safer and not more dangerous.  The people who work at this location are wonderful.   I just can not support parent company.

These guys are exceedingly slow and brusque and rude! Do not recommend this location! The line isnt long but the wait times are horrendous.  It should not take 20 minutes to get a simple latte.  I ordered amd finished my shopping in Frys and when I came back, I *still* had to wait 5 minutes.

I am beginning to think that having terrible customer service skills and being rude to your customers is a requirement for employment at this location. Yes, I know it is in the University area and that the demographic and employees for this store are mostly millennials , but could you at least thank someone for visiting your store? Or how about having an accurate inventory system set up so that your mobile app reflects what you actually have available for sale, or maybe , just maybe , wait until your guest is more than ten feet away to start talking smack about them with your o worker. If you are looking for mediocre coffee , rude and disrespectful employees and a little bit of frustration In your day then this is the place for you. Don't bother trying the PJ's up the street either, the same with even worse coffee.

This is the slowest Starbucks ever. Everytime it never fails. Do they train someone here everyday?? They are never short staffed so I can't put my finger on it. The people are always nice but geez it's always low. Guarantee when you pull up the first thing is , " welcome to Starbucks please wait for a moment and I'll be right with you.  So annoyinnngggg
Best Starbucks I have been to yet. Excellent layout with lots of natural lighting/windows and the coffee is great. Will definitely be going to this location from now on!
On a recent visit smelled strongly of chemicals. Frappucinos were watery. Pastries were ok.
They actually are not open until 5am if you go to their store early morning be mindful of that. Good service, odd set up for dealing with traffic inside when it is busy.
Awful product and service.    12 bucks for this crap.   Will never come back to this place again.  No one even acknowledges us during the long arduous wait.  And the fraps were watery and lame.

The service is very nice, the coffee is fine, the layout is kinda crappy, and there are some weeeeeeeeird-ass critters who stop by here. Not the kind of Starbucks I like to hang out in, but it's good.

My cinammon dolce latte was amazing!

How can it be that in some Starbucks they make better tasting coffee than others?

When in Reno, I will def be back!!

Since all starbucks are pretty similar, I'm going to review this based on atmosphere and location.

This starbucks has a great outdoor seating area.  It is pretty massive (being more than 5 tables) and is great for sitting outside in the few months that it is nice to do so.  Inside there are a few comfy chairs closest to the parking lot and some tables.  There are actually two handicap tables that are rather large.  That means, unlike other tables, two people can actually comfortably work at it.  It is a pretty small starbucks, but small tables that fit two (or really one comfortably when working) seem readily available.  

The parking can be a little tricky.  Normally there is enough, but the empanada place next door has some reserved parking, which limits the parking spaces.  I got the last one when I got there at about 1 p.m. on a Monday.  However, by the time I left around 3:30 p.m. there were plenty of spots.  

There is no take out at this Starbucks.  However, it is on a main road (4th street N) so it is pretty easy to swing by and get in get out.

This Starbucks- inside Frys- is the best Starbucks on the planet! The ladies are beyond awesome! Even when dealing with the jerks they maintain their professional demeanor and do their job! Jada and Bre are the best!

Thursday 1/4/18: My wife, two children and two friends and myself arrived at this location at 7:55pm and purchased $40 in 6 lattes, taxes and tips. There were absolutely zero smiles at any juncture of our experience. We tried to be polite and make small talk with the two employees who served us. They were not having it. After ordering our drinks, we were about to sit down and wait for our drinks when we were practically yelled at that they were closing in 5 minutes so we wouldn't mess their tables up. Besides not being friendly or even cordial in the slightest, we were very rudely told to leave at 8:03pm because they closed at 8:00. The manager went to the door, told us they were closed and held it open until we left. 

I will not visit this location again.

Absolutely the worst Starbucks in New Orleans . Store is dirty, unkempt and not stocked with basic supplies I.e. straws and napkins. Baristas are rude and can't even get a mobile order correct or complete . Save your money and aggravation and go somewhere else , anywhere else. Not interested in guest satisfaction at all. Avoid avoid avoid .ps French truck coffee just opened down magazine , go there , I know I will.

The only reason I suffered this stupid Starbucks is that apparently Sparks doesn't do indie coffee shops.  Cosmic just closed (my favorite) so maybe I'm just pissed off about that.  Maybe we should follow Russia's lead and annex Sparks and force them to drink indie coffee.  Understandably the idiot barista put diary milk in my drink despite clearly telling her I wanted soy (although I would have prefered almond which Starsucks doesn't carry).  How f cking hard is it writing on a cup?  She didn't even make the drink, she just had to write on that stupid cup "SOY."  Do they teach that at Sparks HS?  Writing?  Listening?  Starsucks may not be the worst corporation, but the only money that goes back into our local economy is the wages they pay, and the workers are probably just eating corporate junk food and buying clothes at some corporate chain.  With an indie store, the owners are spending their profits here and they're buying local coffee and supplies.  Do you not realize we have the worst economy in the country and need to shop local?  Thanks for the sh tty drink you green apron-wearing, mermaid logo franchise, cr p food-selling, over-rated bullsh t coffee chain

I'll still come here, but the Now Hiring sign is telling of the service. Good people, just slow. 1 guy had to unfortunately make drinks for inside and drive-thru. My drink was made well though. Hope they can find more staff! :)

Be warned. 
Starbucks on saint josephs university is money hungry. 
They will over charge you for anything if they want. 
Employees Always on the phone. 
Not a real starbucks. 
No customer service skills 

Go to the other Starbucks on 46th and city Line Avenue or on City Avenue and monument rd.
Clean, spacious and plenty of places to sit, either inside or outside.  A little further off the main road than most, so it's not at all noisy from traffic.

Only been in twice to grab coffee and treats, but it's really pretty inside and there seems to be a lot of seating. They even have an outdoor seating space. The staff is quick and friendly as well. I'm glad this is right near my new house!
Awesome.   Favorite Starbucks!  Barkley gets pup cup nearly everyday here.  Team members are friendly and do a great job.

This is the worst Starbucks ever! The attitudes are always "stank"!!! No one wants to pay nearly $6 for coffee and deal with unpleasant attitudes early in the morning! My Venti was so light this morning you could fill the cup's emptiness. When I complained they huddled while still at the window as if I were not spending my money. To "fix" it the steamed more milk and poured it in like I wouldn't notice the flavor of the drink totally gone. It was still not full and they blamed it on the foam. I order this drink almost every morning and evening from various locations but it's only until I have to stop at this one that I have a problem! I also ordered a sandwich! It was awful! Usually the bacon is crispy brown but today it was undercooked and white! They best pray I don't get sick!

It's Starbucks so by now unless you live under a rock you should know what you're going to get. So with that said, the x factor is the employees, the restaurant space itself and the cleanliness of the restaurant. 

The employees at this location have always been kind in my multiple visits here. Today I received a coffee and the barista asked if I could wait for her to pour a new batch because the coffee I received was on the stale side. That goes a long way because just the other week down the street at another location, I did receive a stale Starbucks coffee and it's pretty disappointing. That's your pick me up at work that you've been craving for the last two hours and then you finally get it and realize you should have just had the regular stuff in your work's cafeteria. So I'm appreciative that this staff goes the extra mile and acknowledges your presence when you enter. 

As far as the space goes, it's not a large space but this location is never crazy busy so I've never seen a seating issue here so it appears to be just right. And cleanliness has also never been an issue here, there's never packets of sugar thrown around the condiments counter or trashed tables.

Overall, it's a Starbucks location that has good employees, always seems to have seats available and is clean. Definitely recommend if you like Starbucks.

So after finishing lunch at White Castle - before I leave - I go up to the counter and ask one of the ladies - "Is there a place around here when I get some espresso?" The lady thinks about it for a few seconds - then tells me "there is one of them fancy coffee shops right before the interstate."

Wondering what I would find - I head back the way I came - lo and behold - it's a friggin' Starbucks! I laughed to myself - wondering what response I would have gotten back at White Castle had I asked for Starbucks by name.

This one is a little hard to get into - there is only one entrance to the parking lot as far as I could see - and there is a lot of traffic going to the Interstate.

This Sbux also has a Drive Thru - which I refuse to use. So I parked and went in. There were three young ladies working behind the counter. I ordered a Dopio Espresso Machiatto - the girl working the register - bless her heart - it was her first day and she had no idea what I had ordered. But the other two girls did not know what my drink was either - the girl who made my drink essentially made me a mini Latte. The cup was filled to the top with milk.

Then the other girl came over - we had a discussion about what the drink is supposed to be - and the manager came out to assist. Meanwhile - the register locked up and they had to reboot in order to give me a receipt.

The pace of life out here in Brownsburg, IN is much slower than the rat race of Washington, DC - and I was in no hurry. The folks behind the counter were so very friendly and wanted to make the drink right - which they did. They asked me where I was from and where I was going - and offered directions and advice. They laughed at me when I asked if I was going to encounter rush hour traffic heading to Champaign - because there is no rush hour! :-)

Lots of interior seating at this Starbucks. If you are ever headed out across the Midwest on I-74 westbound - stop at this Starbucks!

One barista and one person taking orders and long lines. I only stopped in because i had a gift certificate. I prefer coffee bean and tea leaf.  I ended up leaving because i had to be somewhere and did not have 30 min to wait
Took 20 minutes to get fucking oatmeal. No one asked if I had everything. Zero communication. And now I am late.

Ran through the drive through and ordered a cappuccino with an extra shot. The guy taking the order was efficient, but friendly enough. The cappuccino was piping hot and the milk was flawlessly steamed without being scorched. The cup was filled the rest of the way with a nice, frothy top that was perfect. Nice, quick customer service, well made drinks, and a covered, but open patio for warmer weather would bring me back to this location.

I'm a fan of Starbucks (for the most part) and this is one of my favorite locations. I'm always greeted with a smile, my orders are served correctly, and they seem to move people through the line in a pretty efficient manner. I've sat inside and done the drive thru, and have had positive experiences with both. 
Side note, I love the egg bites and this location seems to always have them while other spots run out. Another bonus!

Worst attitude that I've received in a Starbucks so far. I asked for a frapuccino without whip cream n she initially refused to make it, then she made it n didn't put chocolate syrup in it. At this point I was fed up n left. I don't need to start a war in a Starbucks over a drink but she could have done without the attitude...

No skinny mocha and out of blonde roast. Plus the guy at the register had an attitude. He tried to tell me that non fat milk is the skinny mocha when there's actually more sugar in non fat milk than regular.  Whoever is in charge of inventory and hiring needs to be reevaluated. Also maybe dig up on nutrition facts.
Asked for raw sugar and they told me that they were out. Hmmm to charge over $5 for a drink and the amount of traffic in here you think they can manage to order extra sugar.

The barista's at the store are my heroes of the day. I took my defective zippered tote in today and they gave me credit. It might've taken them a few minutes to figure out how to do it but they happily gave me credit for their defective product. Unlike the Starbucks I've visited in Woodinville, WA these barista's know what customer service and customer satisfaction are all about. Five stars to these ladies and kudos for my green tea peach lemonade. it was delightfully refreshing.

This place is down the street from my house, so I got there often since my bus stop is also around the corner.  Usually very busy, so there is a bit of a wait.  I've never had an issue with staff. I actually like a few of them.  I think the location is a bit inconvenient, because it's hard to get in and out of the parking lot, if you drive.  There's also two parking spots on the side that are a bit dangerous since you have to back out into a busy street corner where traffic can turn, so I would never drive there.
I arrived 35 minutes prior to their closing time and they were...closed. Bummer. I made a special trip for beans in the morning.
