I came on a Saturday evening, and I ordered a coconut milk mocha macchiato. Not sure why or how, but it was made incorrectly. For some reason, they used the vanilla bean powder and caramel. Well, I waited a long time to get the remake. The young lady at the window was extremely pleasant, and the barista was really apologetical. The remake was absolutely perfect.
waited an hour for a medium 8 dollar hot chocolate and they didn't even put whipped cream on it. heartless.

04/23/16  Expresso Machine Not Work... Has drown off my day... All I was looking forward to was Caramel Macchiato  with 3 extra Expresso shots.. To make My Sunshine bright... and to make things better after purchasing the last 3 mini vanilla scones they given then way to another customer  great... Not Happy!

The egg white bites are an absolute must have. My friend Lauren, who has a 10/10 body, was the one who suggested them. Anytime I have a suggested food item from someone who is in good shape I have to try it. The combination of egg whites, peppers, and seasoning cooked to perfection created a party in my mouth. I washed it down with a caramel macchiato and break danced home.

[Out-of-towner Review]

Thank you and you suck...are how I feel!

Given that you are in a convention center, you'd think although it was the weekend, you'd have better hours of operation. Conventions run 7 days a week. My convention happened to run Sunday - Tuesday. So opening day (Sunday), everyone was jonsing for coffee all day, but after 2PM you were screwed! It was closed...you could endure the gross humidity and/or pouring rain and walk a few blocks to the Marriott Starbucks, but theirs closes early too! Annoyed...to say the least...

BUT, for the two remaining days was their saving grace. Although the line was continuously 40+ people deep, these automons kept it movin'! No lie, they were quick and efficient for a very small set-up. They weren't the friendliest, but they were damn good and efficient with their time...you can't complain about that...

If I walk the length of this convention center, you better reward me with a caffeinated beverage. Your wimpy hours just won't cut it for all the various people who saunter through here...step up your game, but keep up the good work! It's a Catch 22, sorry guys!

Keepin' convention'er's caffeinated on their timetable...

This is my favorite Starbucks. They staff is always super nice and it's busy in the morning of course... What coffee place isn't?

The seating is nice and there is a lot available inside and out. It's ways very clean and even the bathrooms are always clean. 

My order is right all the time and usually pretty fast but I order the iced chai latte so that's pretty easy. Sometimes I order a snack too and they usually get that right as well despite being so busy. 

Overall this Starbucks is my favorite and I go there often. One thing Santa Barbara/Goleta is missing is drive throughs!  So annoying but oh well. 

The location is also pretty perfect for me as well and always a lot of parking available. 

There is also a Starbucks right inside the Vons but less selection for food and no seating.

Honestly every employee should be like Connie. She is the sweetest, friendliest, overall greatest employee I've ever encountered at a Starbucks. Her service is unmatched and the store overall is awesome!!
Since bookstores and their cafes are dissapering, Starbucks is the only bastion left to enjoy a cup of coffee and sit relax, read, chat or peruse your PC.

Pretty good Charborks, good service. Never seems to be too cramped unless it's the going to work, lunch or coming home from work hours at the nearby hospital.

Good amount of seating but I didn't see the power outlets other people were talking about.
I love my Starbucks. 99% of the time I used the mobile AP which I absolutely love.  The barista know me and have it ready when I arrive.  I've tried a variety of drinks and will purchase them again.

This Starbucks is amazing! Donna (the manager), Nate, Gabe, and another girl there that names begins with a C or K (sorry :/) are awesome people! They are always happy, know my name, remember my order, ask me how I am doing, always greet me, and are on top of their game! I spend A LOT of hours here studying and they do not miss a beat with other customers! I always look forward to coming to this Starbucks! They make my studying experience even better! Seeing they are a newer store the internet is a little slower than expected, but I know this will be fixed as the store works out their kinks.

Good location.  I was stoked to see they had a parking lot with lots of open spaces.  I walked in and it was very busy but they were getting everyone through really quickly, which was great.  I ordered my usual green tea no sugar.  I then asked for the spinach, feta wrap but the employee informed me their oven wasn't working.  This was such a bummer to me.  I was really looking forward to eating that.  My drink came up very quickly and there was a lot of open seating available, thank goodness.  My second choice for food would have been the multi-grain bagel with cream cheese, they don't even offer the mulit-grain bagel, another bummer.  Therefore I am still deciding what to eat for breakfast but I will figure something out.  Kind of a disappointment but there are worse things that happen in life so it's all good.  I will be alright.

It was my first time here and as you may know first times are always the worst depending on the situation. My first time here was amazing the guy fixing my drink was friendly even though I didn't know what I wanted. I ended up getting a white chocolate mocha omg it's was and still is amazing. The only grip I had about this location is the restaurant cleanliness. I had to come in and clean my own table. Really everyone who dined in had to clean there tables but other than that as a first timer I can see myself coming again.

Great Starbuck's. I usually get a Shaken Unsweetened Black Iced Tea and most of the time it is right on target... occasionally you can tell it's and old batch but not often. My wife ways gets a Refresher of some sort and she always comments on how this Starbuck's makes the best ones around.
Very awesome staff that goes above and beyond to make sure your satisfied. I appreciate the staffs attention to detail and their exemplary customer service.

This Starbucks doesn't have a drive though which already makes it an inconvenient stop but on top of that there are no parking spots for Starbucks customers. You have to pay for parking just to run in and pick up your coffee.

Shoutout to Sam for being an all-around 5-star bartender. Really made my evening with her cheery and helpful attitude. Gave a great recommendation for the flat white (though I'm used to café lattes and wanted to try something different). I normally wouldn't write a review for a big chain like Starbucks but just gotta say I had a fantastic experience at this one.

This Starbucks is quite convenient for me to stop at on my way to work since it's close to the 44/270 entrance.  I usually send my order through my mobile and pick it up with zero wait.  However, I have ran into a couple of issues almost every time I order from here.  The first time, they've completely forgotten my pastry and I had to tell them and show them the receipt on my phone.  Then I waited for them to heat it up.  The second mishap, my caramel macchiato was made cold when on the app, it doesn't say "Iced caramel macchiato."  They did remake it and were very apologetic.  

The staff are usually very friendly here and the storefront is always kept in great condition!  The staff is what makes me stop by this place before work over the one that is 10 seconds from my house.  They are, overall, more pleasant to all their customers which is the reason why I'm still giving this place a 4-star rating.  Nothing really major has ever happened with my orders and they've always done the best they could to alleviate the issues I've had with my orders.
They took so long to make my grande . I love Starbucks but this one is definitely not my favorite

By far one of the more people friendly and welcoming Starbucks I've been to. I'm not a consecutive customer but when I have some extra change or I can't stand another day of trying to choke down office kitchen coffee I'll make a stop in. What really stands out about this place other than the delicious coffee is the gentleman who manages the establishment unfortunately I haven't caught his name but I appreciate the fact he remembers how to spell my name (it's a bit off from how it's pronounced) especially since I'm not an every day customer. It's those little insignificant personal touches that go a long way and are truly appreciated.

You can't ask for better service- the staff is dedicated to making sure your drink is perfectly made and given with a kind smile to boot! I love anytime I go into a business and the staff is happy and playful- and this Starbucks obviously has a great team and good leadership because they were enjoying their work- something rare today! Then there was the order- Very Berry Hibiscus Tea for me, my daughter opted for a coffee creation only she could come up with and they obliged her writing her own order on her cup- yes she is that type and Connor got his 4 pump only latte that every other Starbucks makes with 6 even when he specifies 4. Happy customers for sure!

Waited in an abnormally long line (mostly college kids due to location). The line isn't what irked me though, it's that I waited in said line, ordered, only to find out that they do not take Amex!! What type of Starbucks does not take Amex? I could not get my order due to the fact that I needed to use my Amx because I was expensing my order through work. Complete waste of time.

I have to give these guys a 5 star every morning while I was working here at Reno they were there and got the coffee ready and I just feel bad bcus homeless people come and do their business in front of the store

It's open, and something happened to it. This has always been my favorite Starbucks, and I frequent many, this one was a little crowded, but everyone was always nice. They closed it and remodeled it, and now it is lovely inside, but the employees all got grumpy. 

I've been several times and there is no joy. No one smiles, all the nice people seem to be gone and they took all of the cranky people that don't really want to work and put them all in one Starbucks. 

Use your mobile app so that the coffee is ready when you get there and you don't have to talk to the employees. It will work out better that way. The facility is terrific.
Friendly staff and accurate orders. Can't ask for much more from Starbucks :)

I am a regular at this starbucks and found all the staff to be very nice and friendly except I had an awful experience with an employee today. She was rude and kept interrupting me when I was trying to order, and lied to me about not having any blueberry muffins despite there being 3 on display, and didn't even bother to check. I even called in to check if they had muffins two minutes after I ordered and they DID have blueberry muffins! I will not be returning to this starbucks again, thanks Isabel, you just lost a customer. :(

We traveled to Philly recently and stopped in on our drive home. Upon entering, it was if there had been a crack in the space time continuum. We were greeted by some pretty amazing staff and thought surely they must be from another galaxy, as the level of service and the genuine caring nature of the unfamiliar acting Maureen, Shaw and Caroline was something we are sure went extinct on planet Earth long ago. Seriously, I have never met anyone in the industry that took the time to make us feel so utterly welcome that as we pulled out of the parking lot, I looked at my husband and told him we're leaving DC behind for Wilmington Delaware. Top notch. I hope the Corporate functions at Starbucks use the behavior we exhibited as part of their training program.

Ordered my usual Trenta cup of ice with a grande peach infused tea n two pumps of syrup poured over it and today they decided to charge me $4.60 instead of my usual $3.52. When I try to explain to her that it was only $3.52 she argued that no it was $4.60 for a Trenta. I tried to explain that it was only a grande or in a Trenta cup of ice. This is what happens when you employ the ignorant with no customer service skills or knowledge of service recovery. As I've said before,Starbucks is not the same great place anymore.
Employees Always nice and polite and happy to be at work, drivethru is always quick and efficient customer service is always great enjoy buying my coffee here :) never had a bad experience!!

I love this location and always come here before my work, but lately i got nothing but disappointment. Turnover rate here is crazy. Where are my polite, friendly, and talent baristas. Sorry for complaining, but come on... I go here everyday and it's like a hit or miss. Ordered my drink through mobile order, because i was late and in a hurry (duh that's why Starbucks created that). When i got there witnessed the barista was making drinks for other off shift coworkers and my drinks and other guests drinks werent made. Mhmm he forgot there were lines of stickers on the label printer. Okay 10 minutes past, i was like where is my drink, he finally noticed the mobile order printer. Okay now i had to rush out because i was almost late for work. My drink was not right. Coffee was burned and almost no syrup in my caramel macchiato...bitter...disappointed...i got to work and had to dump the darn drink away. This location used to be very good, lately service is slower and drink isn't as good. I wish there is a manager so he tastes it

It's a Starbucks so I won't comment on the drinks as everything is pretty standard across the board. However when I went Sunday this location was a little busy and it took a bit of time to get my drink. Other than that it was clean location. I sat at a table for about two hours with two ladies discussing things and it was clean. With the amount of tea I drank too, I had to go to the bathroom and that was clean as well. I judge places by the cleanliness of their bathrooms, and this Starbucks passed.

A coworker went to Starbucks to order a "coffee traveler" carton for a boardroom meeting. In typical snooty fashion, they scoffed at the request and told her she needed to pre-order this carton a day in advance. After seeing her desperation, they offered to do her a favor and only make her wait an hour before filling her order. She left. 

I went to Dunkin' Donuts, who filled my equivalent order for their Box O' Joe in five minutes. Couple that with the ability to buy bagels and donuts in bulk at the same time, and Dunkin' trumps Starbucks heartily.

If I want to discuss race relations, I'll go to Starbucks. For coffee and breakfast, Dunkin' gets my business.
Always friendly and yummy coffee or non coffee drinks. It's our #1 downtown. Parking on street or limited spots in front of shop (next to sushi).

I stopped by this location today for a quick cold brew.  While they were out of a couple of things, their customer service was great.  The customer in front of me was rather rude to the staff.  Becca handled herself with grace and came up with a good solution for the customer in front of me.  Great job!

This happened a few weeks ago, and I am finally responding. It is consistent with the many one star recent postings about service, and in this case respect for customers. I am an 82 year old Jew and a widower, and among other matters going through a difficult transition since my wife's accidental death. I had come into this Starbucks in the morning, and really was treated so disrespectfully by one of the blonde baristas. I had not brought my cane with me into the store, but if I had, I am almost sure I would have smacked her over the head with it, and it would have given me great satisfaction. I could paraphrase Gore Vidal that "once the dog pees on the flowers, it ruins them for everyone." So just one bad barista makes this store verboten to me. I have been a Starbucks card holder for many years. Also now as an old Jew, I can rightfully be very sensitive to even a hint of antisemitism much less pure disrespect. I am being very mild in this review!

Love the snowman cookies!  They are delicious with real white and milk chocolate. Definitely big enough to share. Also had a Bantu iced green tea with a "splash" of lemonade to give a hint of lemon and a light sweetness. Very good.

Zach is the best!  He leads the tribe of hardworking co-workers who aim to please the customer with superior service and a smile!
Celebrating your future visit with a smile and a double espresso purchase!
every friday is decaf mocha latte day. 2 extra pumps of mocha and make it grande please.

Worst Starbucks I've ever been to. They are beyond slow, regularly understaffed, mistakes on drink orders are common and they run out of products often (so whoever does their ordering doesn't have a good grasp on how much they'll need). This location is convenient for me, which is why I've gone several times, but I've honestly never had a fantastic experience so I now avoid it if at all possible.

I've been going to this location for years but feel that recently it's gotten slower. They're definitely understaffed. Wait times are so so so long! 

Word of advice: DEFINITELY don't place a mobile order past 3pm ish. Every time I get there, it's not made. Even if 20 some minutes have passed. They don't check for mobile orders outside of busy times. 

Overall, some of the people try to be nice, but it's just awful in here
Nothing wrong with the operations, just absolutely minimal seating. You should probably pick another location if you're looking to get work done or if you are trying to set up a coffee meeting.

I was the only person in line. I watched the bug on the crumby counter while I waited to be served. "Someone will be with you" who "can't wait to have tomorrow off" and "can't wait to go home" finally took my order. I had a 5 minute expectation to be served. I had 15 min more to wait and look around at how filthy the place was and wait for my cup of coffee. I kept reminding myself that this is Metairie. Not bourbon street.
Took over 30 minutes for a mobile order. Just unacceptable when on our way to work. They need to address this with manpower in the mornings.

This is not the first time this has happened, online it states this stores closes at 8pm. I walked in tonight with my boyfriend at 5:59 to get tea and the employees say "we are actually closing" I understand business may be slow but this is the second time this has happened. What's the point of having a convenient Starbucks downstairs from my apartment if they are closing by the time I'm getting off work. It didn't help that I was getting tea because I wasn't feeling well and didn't want to have to go to the store. This store has a lot of work to do because not only are they closing early, I wanted to try these bantam bagels everyone is raving about. Not knowing how many come in an order I asked for two orders and a coffee, I get charged about $12 and I only get two single bagels. My friend later tells me that I got ripped off because I should have gotten 4 total. Not impressed Starbucks, not impressed at all.

Come here often, but today we ordered a fizzed tea. Person at the counter took our order. When we got to our car, I notice the tea wasn't fizzed. Went back in  and they told me the machine was broke. 
Why would you not tell us when the order was placed. When ask to exchange it for a Refesher. There was none on display and the claim there were none in back. Terrible service.  They always act like they're too busy. Won't be going back to this location.

*AVOID* this place at all costs!!!  They gave me green tea instead of black tea...i mean...how can you make such a mistake? You make coffee/tea all day...that is your job! After I put milk in my tea, it turned GREEN so I asked the barista if she had given me the right kind of tea.  She LIED and INSISTED that she had given me black tea.

This is intolerable! Such employees should not be hired if they are not interested in their work!
Sad! The drink was DISGUSTING!

If I could give zero or a half star, I definitely would.  I have always drank great Starbucks drinks but this was a horrible DISASTER.  I would have been better off drinking plain WATER. Please double, triple or quadruple check your drink before you drink it b/c you may not know what you are consuming!

One of my "regular" Starbucks locations.  I've used both the drive-thru and counter service and each time my order has been correct and prepared quickly, the service is friendly and helpful, and the location is clean and welcoming.  Also - mad props to my brother in Unusually Colored Car Love who was making eyes at my gorgeous Celestial Blue Mazda (my car knows he' hot and enjoys the attention).  Rock on, Sir!  Why be beige/silver/white/back/gold when you can be electric blue or metallic purple or coppery orange?

This is where I go to study on a regular basis, and coming here allows me to get what work I got to get done, get done. The atmosphere is positive and refreshing for me to think clearly and get to work, along with a little bit of coffee to help in the creative process. I usually get a basic mocha, along with either lemon bread or blueberry muffin. When I want to get something to fill me up more, I like getting the Gouda, eggs and bacon sandwich. The WiFi is a bit iffy, but overall a good place to work and get good coffee or a bite if in a rush.

This Starbucks is fine. I would agree with other reviewers that there isn't a real sense of urgency with the baristas. However, I've only been a few times in the late afternoon when I'm not in a rush and there isn't a real line. 

Not a good place to work- lots of teens hang out around Gay Street and they want their Starbucks fix too. Might be different during working hours? I think the non paying customer issue some reviewers were talking about a few years ago doesn't happen as often anymore. 

Kind of a shame that a Starbucks is in a nice location on Gay street vs. a local business. Fenn's Coffee is a short walk away and has a homier, local vibe (without kids) and I've seen people working there.

I've been eagerly watching the construction and anticipating the opening of this new Starbucks Coffee Shop and the Hampton Inn High Rise Hotel which houses this Starbucks in the north side of Channelside in Downtown Tampa off Kennedy and Meridian next to Kennedy Grand Central, Slade, the Fitzgerald, Crunch, Maloneys, and the Hideaway Sushi  bar. While Starbucks Coffee shop is a chain and there is a hipster coffee shop by the name of Ginger Beard Coffee next door inside the Pour House bar, it's always nice to have more options in the immediate area. Nothing says North Channelside has made it like the addition of a Starbucks and a Publix Supermarket that has been talked about for years. After all, who doesn't want to splurge with the new iced cocoa cloud machiato and a double smoked sausage, gouda, and egg sandwich topped with sriracha while listening to classy jazz music with a great view of Downtown? I enjoyed both here! There is ample comfy plush seating indoors to lounge out and study or surf the web or relax with free wifi. On my visit there were 6 patrons in the shop and no line. I was able to order without a wait and got my drink and sandwich in under 5 minutes which was quite ideal! My server was friendly and quick! I wanted to be the first to welcome this Starbucks to the North Channelside neighborhood! I look forward to many more splurges in the days to come!

So, I wanted to change my review from last time. I came back here to study but I realized that some of the tables were very wobbly and not in great conditions. Furthermore, the bathrooms (both of them) were very disgusting. As well, when I got my Pumpkin Spice Latte, there was already a lot of splatter on my cup, and the rim looked like someone drank out of it (though it is more reasonable to believe that the latte had overflowed and left its mark). However, I highly recommend the Pumpkin Spice Latte - very sweet and warm. Service was okay.

I know, this is just another old Starbucks however, the staff here is amazing! Super nice folks and very friendly. Not sure if the holiday season was affecting them but they were great! Olivia was making samples and asked which drink sounded best to try. I opted for the peppermint mocha. Long story short, the staff here is awesome. You will enjoy talking with them.
Love the place. Only down side is the baby boomers who complain all the time. Don't dare try to act like a human being, you are only seen as sub-human trash.

This is hands down the best Starbucks in the area. It's huge, plenty of seating, and friendly staff. Per my conversation with the manager this is the new layout coming to the entire Starbucks platform. Very spacious and a great vibe. Starbucks greatly redeemed themselves with this store I guess as a make up for the train wreck that is the Race Track store that Westchase residents have had to suffer through.

This is absolutely the SLOWEST Starbucks in history. Let me clarify, I this is not the first time that I have been through this drive-through. I have gone through this drive-through several times and it is taken over 20 minutes each time. I live super close to this drive-through and do not go to this drive-through every morning for my coffee because I know it takes so freaking long. I actually go to a Starbucks that is out of my way because they are consistently faster than this Starbucks. This Starbucks is so slow I watch two cars pull off before getting their coffee. I also did a time lapse of my drive-through experience. Take into consideration that I had started recording well after getting in line. It's ridiculous. Should it take over 20 minutes to get a coffee...

This Starbucks is okay. It is not my favorite coffee but at least they are open in the early hours when I need it. I even downloaded the Ap so I could have it prepared ahead and just fly through for an espresso shot. That is hit and miss. They usually know they forgot or are behind and get right on it. The space is a bit dark and dank but the regulars do not seem to mind returning to their spots every day.

Fantastic customer service! I'm a regular at Starbucks and their kindness and great energy never disappoints. I wasn't sure on what drink to get today. So a barista helped me while being patient with me. While letting me try 2 drinks for the price of one. Awesome awesome awesome!!! 

Thanks!

Ordered two drinks waited about 20 mins and when 2 ladies about 15 min. behind me got two drinks handed to them I asked where my drinks where. Come to find out they never actually purchased drinks and where given mine.  I ended up finally getting mine after the employees realized what happened.

I was really impressed by how friendly the people working were. I didn't feel rushed to order and just found everyone really likable in my three visits here! 

My coffee was made just as I wanted it and for some reason tasted better than usual.

There are some things they aren't able to do at this location, like accept coupons from your Starbucks account or rewards, or add money to your Starbucks card. I didn't totally understand why but I think they have a different kind of license or plan for this location- maybe because they are in a hotel? But when I showed disappointment at not getting to use my coupon for a free new coffee, the person working went above and beyond to make me happy and that was really cool- I didn't expect that and really appreciated it.

This is a really good Starbucks location!

never disappointed at Starbucks. I have frequented locations across the US, this one is always busy but the staff are very courteous and cheerful. I do like the Magazine location, great for tourist visiting NOLA. I may be the only person who ordered the standard drip coffee at Starbucks, just a simple guy i suspect. 
I love Starbucks because i found out a few years ago when working on a consulting gig (for 2 years) at there corporate office in Seattle that this company treats it's employees very well...Never met an employee who disliked working for Starbucks...This is a special company, too bad more corporations aren't following these guys....Take care of your employees and they will take care of you.......
Great company!

My go to every morning every here knows what I get ..... Excellent service here ...... But Dixie needs to stop talking so much sometimes holding a 5-10 conversation.. people people like me gots places to be and things to do

I ordered a Carmel macchiato with an extra shot of expreso and and extra pump of syrup, when I went up to the window and drove away it was a nasty peppermint drink. I hate peppermint and ended up paying for a crappy drink. I know their busy but come on pay attention to your job.

Pretty typical Starbucks. The workers were nice, the food and drinks were good. It wasn't the cleanest location I've ever been to, but it wasn't atrocious. The parking lot is pretty busy. I recommend parking near one of the others stores or you may get blocked in by the vehicles in the drive through.

What's not good about Starbucks? I mean, I had to put myself on a Starbucks budget. The preloaded app really helps with that . What I don't care for at my favorite location is the code on the bathroom door. I really don't want to announce I'm going to the restroom because I have to ask for a code.  
Joy kill...

BJ and Michaela make this Starbucks worth going to. They served us with excellence. I believe in making food with love, and they definitely made our drinks with love. They were extremely friendly and just made it an overall great experience. Way to go ladies! Great hire Starbucks!!!

Why 5 star? Well Gerardo listens to my order and he even got my name correct! Who wouldn't like their name spelled right or even called out by your given name! Simple stuff like that make the experience different. It's more personal. 

KUDOS to you my barista! They need to put agents like him or even better make him Trainor to train barista  to be more personal to clients/customer!

This is my favorite Starbucks in Reno. Every Starbucks I've been to has discontinued their avocado spread.... but not this one!! I will go out of my way to go to this location just so I can get that avo spread for my bagel!

I usually get a vanilla latte which tastes pretty good at this location as well!
This place is so filthy. I get it, it's a chain coffee shop. BUT, The bathrooms are always out of order or just nasty and gross, and the service is just the slowest.

Been going to this Starbucks since it opened and the coffee was always great but lately it's been going down. The last 4months I have been going here the coffee is just not the same. I feel like they don't add enough espresso to my macchiatos and they add to much Carmel and it's way to syrupy. I will not go here anymore I'd rather drive out of my way to cherry hill or Sewell. Thanks for now ruining my hometown Starbucks experience.

This Starbucks is a Starbucks.  Helpful right?  Why write a review about a Starbucks....  Well, I like this Starbucks well enough.  The staff turns out their coffee quickly enough.  I really like all the covered outdoor seating outside.    

This place is good for its outdoor seating.

Normally I don't have a problem with this location but today the young lady on the window delayed the line by talking and petting a dog! If you talk that's ok but when you handle food, especially my food, don't touch. To add to the problem she called another worker over and she petted the dog too! I don't know what happened after that because I got out of the line. I hope they washed their hands but I doubt it.

This Starbucks seems to stay pretty busy. Lots of traffic but they seem on top of things. I have a certain way that I like my coffee doing Keto. I've only had one barista to make it where it tastes different and not in a good way. Everyone else that's ever made it tastes the same. If that barista is making coffees and I happen to go in there I will just wait to get my coffee.

I could never give any more stars to a Starbucks. Their coffee is good and all but I hate the rude hipsters and snobs who flock and take over. This particular one has a back entrance away from the beards finger banging their Crapple laptops so you can order and then bolt.

*edit* Karen is hands down the best employee there and deserves a raise, everyone else gives sub par service and drinks.

This location is the closest to my house and the the way to work. Inside it's small and clean the waiting area is a bit tight and so is the parking lot outside. It's on he weird corner so if there are no spots your forced back on one main road or another. This is also not a drive thru location. I would suggest parking on the side where there is a little shopping center and walking over. Service here is ALWAYS great staff is super friendly. This location is always busy and sometimes it can take up to 15 minutes for my drink to be done. I haven't used the app to order and pick up but I might start. I am a faithful patron of Starbucks and will continue to frequent this location.

Staff was really friendly and conversational today! There's plenty of covered and uncovered outdoor seating, which is perfect for the warmer weather. The inside can get a bit littered (napkins, straw wrappers, etc). Ample parking.

Roomy, cozy, full seating, retail merchandise, artwork doned location. I know what you're thinking, "That was a lot." 

Well, being located inside the Hyatt Hotel I wouldn't expect a Starbucks of this magnitude. It certainly delivers service & amenities equivalent to any stand-alone Starbucks location. If you've checked-in, you'll find the cafe in the first floor, sandwiched between the gift shop and front desk. 

Please Note: There is no No Drive Thru, parking may require a bit of a work if all you're looking to do is grab Joe on the Go. I'd suggest throwing your hazards on & running in otherwise you'll have to valet, find a meter, park & walk or risk a parking ticket. 

Choose wisely, 

~Christy
This place has the worst parking, entrance & exit ~ they really need to move from this location
The drivethru is soooo sloooooowww....I've actually left this line and driven to the Starbucks on 301 just to save time.

This is the only Starbucks location that I've been to that I was told that they stop serving dark/blonde roasts after noon. I almost always order a dark roast at Starbucks and am not a fan of their Pike Place roast. At every location apart from this one, my order doesn't cause any conflict. If an establishment creates strife to make you one of its simplest menu options, that's a problem.

We are everyday regulars at different Starbucks throughout the Tampa Bay Area. Today we arrived at this starbucks and was one of 3 guests in the entire store, and the only guest in line. There were 6 employees behind the counter, doing various tasks. The ONE task the customer pays them to do however, they did not. And that is acknowledge us and take our order. We stood there like idiots for upwards of 3-4 minutes before anyone even looked at us or took our order. Then, and elderly gentleman behind us attempted at a refill, and stood there for close to a minute before anyone assisted him. Unreal

I think I'm being generous with the stars. Yesterday I went to this Starbucks and got a caramel frap and I tasted the first two sips and after that it was like straight up ice. Wayyyyyy too much ice that I had to throw away my 'ICED drink'. I was not a fan and I am a fan of Starbucks. This sucks because the service was really good so I didn't taste my drink before I drove off or I would have asked them to definitely make it over. Honestly the worst drink I have had from Starbucks.

Great, pleasant, & efficient service! 

Short line!

Great customers!

Music is at a nice volume!

First time coming to this location . Cashier was unfriendly and had an attitude. I ordered a berry hibiscus with light ice and my drink came out quickly but it was definitely not light ice , it was heavy ice . 90% of the cup was ice even though it even said light ice on the cup.
Yelp standing up for the cop hating management and employees at this store by hiding negative reviews.  I'm sure this comment will be hidden too.
Alexis is the best he knows our order when he sees me and my daughter walk in or through the drive through always has a smile on his face every friendly amazing experience with  him every visit!

This Starbucks use to be the fastest!  NOW is takes atleast 25 min in the drive thru and I couldn't get out of the line.   Its ridiculous. I'm not sure what happened but it's a total bummer. The girl at the window said they are really under staffed. But damn. Where is management?????

Honestly, I came to Starbucks to study. I ordered a regular s'mores frappuccino that took some time because I think the barista forgot my order for awhile so they made it a bit late, but they thanked me for my patience. Starbucks has outdoor and indoor seating available. There are sofas, a long table near the window and at the center, and bunch of small tables. There are outlets available near sofas and some small tables but definitely outlets available right under the table near the window. It is a good place to study if you don't mind some background talk. And yes, the frappuccino was good :)

One star for being clean 
One for being organized 
Deduct one for slow pace 
Deduct another for the apathy 
Deduct another for awkward parking lot - hard to park or get in / get out when busy

I watched in horror as the girl preparing my food was eating as she's putting it into the oven.  While its in there she takes the last bite of her food, licks her fingers, and then goes back to touching food coming out of the oven without washing her hands.  Then some guy is sauntering back and forth behind the counter, no apron, not working, wearing flipflops drinking his Refresher and eating while talking to the employees. The place was a mess despite there seeming to be an overabundance of staff.  Very unprofessional and not what I've come to expect of the Starbucks brand.  The sad thing is this is normally the case at this particular store based on my personal experience and all the other reviews.  I'm going to head to Coffe Bean which is only 1/2 mi away in the future.

Starbucks never disappoints!  Love their hot or cold green tea or Iced Chai Tea. Their breakfast sandwiches are always good too. Not greasy and flavorful. My daughter enjoys their smoothies and rice crispy treats. I also love their chocolate chip cookies--they are huge and they'll even warm them up if you like. 

Baristas are always friendly and quick service. The cafe is clean with seating available.  This one is convenient to stop in after a movie, especially on a day like today where it's rainy. They have Drive thru also available. 

If you love Starbucks like I do, I highly recommend joining their rewards program and linking a Starbucks card to pay via your phone. Didn't take me long to make Gold status and maintaining that status with all the promotions they have. You also get free rewards after you gain stars as well as a birthday freebie.

This is a pretty standard Starbucks located in the lobby of the Hyatt Regency downtown.  Catering primarily to hotel guests as there is no nearby quick parking to take advantage of.   Coffee was good as usual like most Starbucks, but by 9:00 am they were out of a lot of the breakfast sandwiches.    The majority of the baristas appeared new, as it took a few of them to take my order and I had to go point to the sandwiches, as they weren't familiar with the menu yet.  Overall it was okay, and supplied me with my caffeine fix.

Oh how I usually love everything about Starbucks but last night this stop was a little off! I ordered 3 drinks both all of which they either got the drink wrong or the size.. They even asked what I ordered again and I told them and they didn't fix it! I gave up at that point! The coffee was delicious as always and I have stopped at this buck before and it was great. But last night something was a little off!
Also the bathroom could have used some attention, but I'm happy they had a co-ed bathroom with baby changing station.. 
I will give them another chance but kinda a bummer.
The service was great and I received my drink quickly. The iced coffee I ordered tasted like how I hoped it would :)

The barista Carrie is just chatting up the other employees about Aldi and how it's a German based company and blah blah blah, taking her time, all while there are 10+ cars deep in drive up and customers inside. I am recently dairy free bc of an allergy so I ordered peppermint mocha with almond milk, no whip and no chocolate shavings. I see her put what looked like sprinkles in there so I asked her and reiterated that I'm dairy free and cannot have chocolate. She looked at me like I was the biggest idiot and said well mocha is chocolate. Obviously I did research before I went and the mocha sauce is vegan so I'm in the clear there. So instead of treating customers like idiots, maybe learn ingredients and be informative instead of an ignorant and unprofessional person who works at a coffee shop.

Top-shelf disappointment. I hear that this location is under new management, but why is the customer service so awful? Today I walked in to order to avoid waiting (wait times for mobile orders at this location are far worse). In short, I waited an entire 15 minutes for a MATCHA LEMONADE. Granted, there were only 2 workers; one at the register and another making drinks. The employee at the register clearly had zero clue what was going on, but I get it. Being the new person at work is a little hectic. But when minute 10 rolled around I crossed the point of understanding into the point of utter frustration as my empty cup continued to sit on the table while every customer after me received their orders (slowly). It wasn't until I watched the employee discover my empty cup, publicly blame the other employee, and make my drink that I was beyond frustrated.... Said employee poured the lemonade and a couple of scoops of matcha in a shaker, shook it, and handed over the drink. This took all of 10 seconds to make, yet I waited 15 minutes for it. Tips for management: understaffing is unacceptable, but so is overstaffing lazy employees. Get it together! People come to Starbucks for the quickness and supposed convenience. This is not the only instance. I hear people in my office complain about this location constantly. Please make this better!

Waiting to order. There's 4 employees. Not one acknowledged me. Finally one employee looked up and smiled then the one with curly hair and glasses (who looked like a manager or lead because she was delegating tasks) asks "are you ready?" I answered "yes" and she goes "well come on then".  As if I knew she was ready to take my order but her attitude given made it seem like I was troubling her at her own JOB. Wow, I've never been spoken too like that at a Starbucks. I'm from the West coast but I thought Customer Service was a universal thing. I doubt this review would ever be a candidate for a Review of the Day, but who knows, there's always a first time for anything, right?

In any case, while visiting my former college roommate in the Irish Channel last month, I was comforted to see this Starbucks a couple of blocks away on Washington and Magazine Street.

Surprisingly, I found locating Starbuckses, in general, to be difficult in New Orleans, especially considering that there are tons of really nice cafes and independently owned joints in the French Quarter and along Magazine Street. This particular Starbucks, however, served as a convenient road marker to know that I was on track to finding the St. Charles trolley a couple more blocks down on Washington Street.

I ended up taking a small detour here while walking to the trolley in the late morning on a weekday, only to find that the place was full of people. Lots of people who work immediately around the area, as well as students (your typical workday crowd) patronized the place.

Coming from Los Angeles for vacation, I did notice that I was the only one without a stack of papers, laptops or a backpack that morning. In a way, I was happy I was the only one without worry about work or studying and sat around observing the New Orleans/Southern style architecture here at this Starbucks. And, as is the beauty of franchises: you get a consistent product no matter where you are, and the hazelnut macchiato here was no exception and tasted as fine as anywhere else.

The baristas here provided a high level of customer service, as I noticed that they were keeping busy sweeping the floors in the main dining room area when there was finally a lull in the queue. In a separate incident, one of them didn't flinch or give a weird look at a patron who returned a partially drunk coffee. In fact, they were really happy about replacing the drink. The patron may or may not have realized that it was not to her liking until about halfway through, and most people, if they were in the barista's shoes would probably have made a look, gossip later or show a hint of attitude. None here...and I was impressed at the restraint and professionalism.

The setup of this particular Starbucks is elongated. The front desk is parallel to Washington Street (the long side of the rectangle shape of the coffee house's layout). There's a bit of an issue with seating arrangements inside because it gets pretty narrow as you walk towards the rear of the store (as if you're walking down the store with Washington Street to your right). If it gets a bit too claustrophobic for you, you can always do what many others did that day and take a seat outside. Thankfully, I like to think I brought the California weather with me that week, so it was totally enjoyable to actually sit outside in a typically hot and humid time of year.

Katerina! I don't think people like her should work in public. Especially when u have no skills of communication and willing to make your customers happy! So what happened to me: I stopped at this location to get coffee and from the beginning Katerina gave me an awful attitude! After she messed up my order and on purpose didn't fix it. Never again I go back to this place and don't recommend anyone if u don't want to ruin your mood!

I still go to this Starbucks location quite often. The one located in Royal Oaks, Franklin TN. I prefer going later in the evenings. Except for the mornings and afternoons around lunch time. Which tends to be super busy and very packed. The parking lot is way too small. Access isn't always easy to get in and out of. Besides all of that. The employees do a fantastic job. They're amazingly awesome. Customer Service is outstanding. Honestly I have no complaints whatsoever.

The people behind the counter here are always pleasant and nice to talk to.  The layout might be a little cramped and it's not really a "cozy" starbucks...but Starbucks is starbucks...oh and parking can really be tight as well.

I love this Starbucks.  My favorite place to study.  The baristas are so friendly/happy and frequently give discounts and freebies to regulars (and free samples of food to everyone).  Also, I've never not been able to find a place to sit.  Outlets are usually available, only a handful of times have I had to wait about half an hour for one to open up.  Also, when the weather's nice, there's a great covered porch outside with lights and ceiling fans (AND outlets).  It's true that their internet is restricted to T-Mobile/AT&T/SBC customers, but I think that actually keeps the place from getting overcrowded with students during peak study times (I suppose they go to PJs or Rue instead).  However, if you know someone with a password for one of those providers, you can use it unlimitedly (I've shared my password with a friend there and we were both able to log-on using it at the same time).

I would love to support "local" coffee shops, and I've tried, but all the places close to me have fatal flaws:
--too crowded and no tables during peak hours/times (Rue on Carrollton)
--too few outlets and trash all over the place (PJs on Maple)
--apathetic (bordering on rude sometimes) baristas, terribly low lighting, too few outlets (Rue on Magazine)
--Zots (WAY too dark)

These baristas work hard to provide you a great starbucks experience.

The product is starbucks brand, and these guys are polite, professional and fast. They bring you exactly what you want, and I have personally see them take an unhappy customer and turn them into a happy costumer, with excellent service and patience. 

The area is always clean and my order is always perfect. Great job.
The worst latte I've had in a ling time. Looks like just coffee with milk. Tastes ok, but no foam. Ive been here previously and it was better

Lilah, and the entire crew are the best. Always great service and great attitude 
Jay , Elora, Emily, Allison, Amber

This Starbucks looks/feels like you are at an airport. 
But, they have the nicest people working here.

Do not order from this rude and unprofessional store. Most Starbucks or fun this store is the worst I just had my order refused. They refused to give my order to the Uber driver I ordered are off of. I complain to Uber and to Starbucks on Royal Oaks and they continue to hang up the phone on both Uber and myself very rude and very unprofessional do not order from movies people they do not care this is the worst Starbucks in town I hope they close down from the way they treat their customers. If I could give them a 0 * I would. But they don't seem to care about reviews so I guess this doesn't matter.

The staff gets 5 stars from me, but the consistently slow drive thru takes away the perfect rating. The inside is rather small, the parking lot is kind of confusing, and the drive thru lines are so long. It's not the employees fault that the drive thru takes so long, it's mainly due to the amount of people coming off of I-65 mixed with a terribly designed parking lot shared with Einstein Bagel.

I've always had pleasant experiences with the staff and their outdoor seating has lots of options. If you're looking to hang out or get some work done, I'd probably suggest somewhere else because it's usually slammed in there.

To me, this is one of the best Starbucks I've ever been to. This isn't the closest Starbucks to my house, but it is the one I frequent the most because of the great service, personable staff, and overall environment. 

Each time I've been there I was always kindly greeted, offered many different suggestions, and just treated like a human being instead of somebody they are just taking an order from. The staff will actually hold a nice conversation with you, which is something I cherish. 

As for the products that they offer, I've never been disappointed. Anything I've ordered has been top notch, even the suggestions from the staff when I was just getting into drinking coffee. 

This location is excellent because they have a decent sized indoor area which is perfect for having coffee with a friend, studying, or even just reading the morning paper. If you wanted some fresh air you could even step outside and have a seat at one of their outdoor tables and enjoy your coffee.

If you love coffee you should check out this Starbucks location!

So disappointed!!! I RARELY go to Starbucks.  Went yesterday to a different location and tried an iced caramel macchiato and it was delicious! Came to this location and it is a totally different experience.  Drink is bitter with very little caramel flavor and an expensive letdown.  Last purchase at Starbucks for a long while.  Way too inconsistent taste, quality and value.

This is our all times favorite location in the Boise area. Their staff is super cool, they really have a passion for what they do. Their coffee is simply perfect and the location is on the way to go to work, so this is a must stop for us.

Worst Starbucks in history.  Always understaffed, rude employees, order is often wrong.  Only location in area with a clover which is its only saving grace.  But when employees complain about having to make a drink on it, you want to just walk away.  I now make the drive to bakers bridge because they are for the most part a million times better than cool springs Blvd.
Parking can be difficult during morning hours...drive-thru is your best bet!

I'll give at least 2 stars to any place that caters to vegans.  I'm not crazy on the service at this location, but it happens to be closest to me.  As for Starbucks as a whole, I am thankful for the "use your gift card for purchases and we won't charge you $1.20 to get your latte with soy and a flavor shot for the rest of the year after your 5th beverage" deal.

Comments on parking/drive thru - it get's INSANE here at times, it is an incredibly small lot and if the drive thru is backed up you just have to wait it out, there is no passing the line of cars to leave the establishment.

I love this location. It's just where you need it. Right across the street from a doctor's office. My fav drink is the green tea frap. The rice crispy treat is really good too. Free wifi and excellent customer service at this location.

Though I am not a huge Starbucks fan, I do enjoy several Starbucks drinks (anything non coffee). Oddly enough, I actually like target Starbucks compared to the regular Starbucks. Why, you ask? Because their pricing are a bit different. Drinks are the same, but you might catch a break and the drink might be a wee bit cheaper, plus they still take your Starbucks card, so It's a win-win in my opinion.

So far, with this location, I haven't had any issues and the several times that I've been here, all of the baristas have been very nice. Haven't messed up on my order or completely failed on my drink yet, so I'm a happy camper!

NOTE: I'm a complete coffee nazi/snob, If I wanted superb coffee I'd go home and make it myself or actually go to a specialty coffee shop for it. Starbucks is one of the last place I'd complain or be picky about coffee (just saying).

This place has a classic Starbucks feel. The interior is just bright enough with the typical beiges and greens, plenty of merch, an awesome staff, and plenty of seating. Personally, considering the location I was kind of shocked. It looks smaller than it is from the outside but there is quite a bit of space in there. They have a number of comfortable lounging chairs and more than enough tables including about 3 bar style tables and chairs too. I enjoy this location because it is a good one to take the laptop out and work. It does get busy but the design of the location, it's a rectangular store, helps to cut down on the noice even on the busiest of mornings.

Unfortunately, the previous reviews are true.  This has to be the slowest Starbucks between here and Las Vegas.  I waited more than 10 minutes for a plain black, nitro cold brew and the new chipotle chicken wrap from the chilled/cold foods.  So, I really only needed one simple item poured since I grabbed the wrap myself and it ended up being the worst food concoction from Starbucks that I have ever had, I do not recommend the new wrap or this location at all.

This is by far one of the slowest Starbucks ever. This is the second time I've been the only one in line and the crew was far too busy socializing to 1) take my order 2) actually make my very simple nonfat latte.

My recommendation is to head into downtown Dunedin and grab a great coffee from a small locally owned coffee shop. That's where I'm going from now on.

I come here most mornings to get my bacon and Gouda sandwich and an iced coffee. This morning I stopped intending to get the same order and the barista told me that the "ovens were down". Okay, fine. So I just got my coffee. On my 40 minute drive to work, I pick my iced coffee up from my cup holder and it spills ALL over my car because she put the wrong size lid on my venti coffee. Not having a good morning and now I can't even drink my damn coffee.

Christmas Eve and a very good atmosphere. Staff were very busy but maintaining a very pleasant demeanor. Taking orders as they came and delivering with a smile. Made the stop for Spiced Chai Latte all the more pleasant. And of course the drink was spot on!

I love this starbucks. The staff is friendly and always has a smile on their face. The usual for me is the white chocolate mocha hot with an extra pump of syrup so that I don't have to add sugar and a slice of banana bread but today I tried the mango dragon fruit tea and omg was it amazing and refreshing I will definitely be trying it again
Disgusting! Bugs in where the pastries are kept and the floors had mud and dirt all over them. Don't recommend coming here does not live up to the Starbucks name.

You can't be serious Starbucks. You're open but the coffee isn't brewed? You have two people working but one is such a control freak that she won't let the other take orders or make coffees. This is seriously the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. Oh yeah, and almost short me $3 change? Get it together guys

I'm quite sure this is not the correct way to steam milk. 

The girl that took my order just stared at me. Not that I'm handsome in any way. She just didn't care. Oh she did say "what's your name.... do you want your receipt". 

The coffee machines they are selling right next to the barista stations are covered in old syrup and syrup covered dust. Crumbs all over the floor. 

I was a partner for six years and this is the reason I don't go to Starbucks anymore. Just feel like the world should know I'm disappointed in this store. I'm sure the people that work here, including the barista in the video below, are TALENTED people and truly love what they do. However, the first impressions of my visit, warrants me posting this information so that hopefully they will know and should know better.

Our first time to the new Starbucks on Chinden near Target. This is a very nice store. We went there looking for the Sous vide egg bites. My wife had them and was raving about how great they were. We got them here and they are awesome!

The store has a great feel to it. Very open, clean, and comfortable.  We love it!  Awesome place to hang out.

It's pretty much a traditional Starbucks, never had any issues here. I usually just go through the drive-through for convenience. Overall always a great experience. Grabbed my coffee and a cup of water & I'm good for the day.
Don't wait in the rediculous line at this store,  order on the mobile app and you'll be in and out, just about as fast as drive thru. SB coffee is good every time though.

Typical Starbucks experience. I enjoyed it. Plus the other day they sampled the new mocha coconut frappucino and it was quite tasty.

I had a coupon for a free tall drink and the barista asked if I was sure I wanted to use it since it was frappucino happy hour and I'd get more bang for my buck by using my free drink another time, but I didn't have my wallet on me. I appreciated the advice, though, and probably would've taken it had I had my gold card with me.

This Starbucks has great, friendly employees.  The coffee and food are the Starbucks standard.  It gets a little crowded in the afternoons and can sometimes be a little loud, but I'm definitely glad to have it there.

Excellent concept for the grab & go Joe lovers. It's a drive-thru / walk-up only location. So avoid congestion and standing in long lines at the expense of indoor seating, chill tunes, work space & merchandise. 

Staff is decent...it'd be pretty difficult to do a poor job with so limited contact. Pull up, use your reward card & dash out. 

Easy does it.
~Christy
They always make my drink perfect! My moms on the other hand, it takes the right person to beagle to make an extra dry cappuccino, but this store usually knows exactly the way she likes it!!!

I order a Cameral foam cold brew with Almond milk and received a reg Cold brew with Almond milk. (not that big of a deal). However the Almond milk they gave me was bad!! You can see little chunks floating around  and my "cold brew" was warm! This place is trash

Most people don't like change and there is a feeling of security by knowing what to expect before you even buy something. This is why this Starbucks is so popular. You have all these great little coffee shops all over this city and yet Starbucks still gets people in here. My only guess is that most of their costumers just moved into town and that they are afraid of trying someplace new or local. They are comfortable paying $8 for a coffee that they have had back home in NYC or LA for $11. 

No one, costumers nor staff, seem happy to be there. No one looks each other in the eye nor attempt to make small talk. Maybe they are pissed about having to pay $8 for a coffee. You won't get this type of experience at local coffee shops.

No outlets at all so find another place to do schoolwork.
Bathrooms could've been cleaner. 
Coffee is alright.

"I wish it wasn't so cold!" Is what I say every time I go to a Starbucks without a sweater! This location is located at the El Con Mall and the drive thru is somewhat always busy. I met a friend today and we grabbed a coffee! Their selection of cups is amazing. They seemed to be fully stocked! (Impressive)

I ordered a white chocolate mocha to go for the honey. I tasted it and oh em gee it was so good! I had never had one taste that good! I'm definitely going to order that next time I stop in! 

This location has a lot of seating inside! It is very neat and clean inside. They also have seating outside where dogs are welcome!

Corporate giant Starbucks is not my usual coffee/WiFi spot but I am a huge fan of the Starbucks partner culture and a fan of this location in Downtown Tampa. The Starbucks is the same as any with friendly customer service.

What I like best about this location is the amount of seating available both inside the Starbucks and the Hilton hotel lobby. If you need an outlet, space to work or a table large enough to hold a small meeting you have plenty of options here. There is also a TV wall as part of the lobby area that you can watch the days news channels (if that's your thing).

An added bonus with the hotel combination is that the hotel has a full bar nearby so you can mix up your groups' drinks if you're having a late afternoon meeting. :-)

Other then closing at 6 p.m. which is a problem with all the downtown coffee shops, this Starbucks is a great addition to Downtown Tampa.

The streets of Santa Barbara are almost empty, but this Starbucks is open for take away service.  So glad that they can work during these scary times. Super Friendly and nice!!! Just make me feel good. Thank you for that amazing service, great staff
The staff is always friendly, it's easy to get in and out of, and there's never too long of a line.  It's not the fanciest Starbucks you've ever been to, but they do a great job.
I'm surprised that there are only two stars. Yeah, the parking situation isn't the most convenient, but it's a good place to study and the staff is kind and helpful.
We waited in the drive through line for 23 minutes for an iced tea!  There were only five cars in front of me I think it's ridiculous!

The morning of 7.24.14 @ 8:50am ... Just got charged close to double for my standard drink, the reason according to the gal "I don't wanna lose my job" ... Evidently you don't want customers either. I'm taking my biz elsewhere and u should too.

PS - Evidently one of the other employees by the name of Alex V. felt it was appropriate to engage me regarding this review... his comment "We would all appreciate it if you never came back." ... "We all" ... apparently this means the manager and the rest of the staff???   So, just to clarify, they rip me off, I call them out on it, they tell me never to come back.   Yes folks, these are the people you will be dealing with at this Starbucks,. If you think this wont happen to you... Well, just FYI there is another one down the street, AND it has a drive through... at the corner of 7th and Keystone... and much cooler employees :)

My first visit to the Goleta Starbucks on Fairview. Warm, nonindustrial ambience and very friendly staff.  Isabell made me absolutely awesome mocha as you can see in the photo. Nice view of the surrounding hills from the outdoor patio seating as well. Will definitely be back!

Very disappointed! Showed up tonight at 8:15pm and there is nothing in the case! Barista said they had put everything away because they were getting ready to close. They don't close for another hour and 45 minutes. While I sat there, 2 others came in and were surprised that the case was empty. Ridiculous! Lazy workers just trying to cut out early.

Outstanding customer service from V.W., came in with my elderly mother, she came out from behind the counter to make sure my mom had a clear enough path to walk to the restroom.  Very mindful, after that excellent customer service at the counter. Eden made terrific drinks for me and my mom, thank you Starbucks

I've never felt so compelled to write a review about a Starbucks.

I come to this location often because it's in between where I live and where I work. I'm probably here 2-3 times a week, at least.

With that said, every time I'm here my experience gets better and better. First off, the inside is spacious, clean and there's also an outdoor area with chairs and tables. 

Second, the baristas are the friendliest I've ever encountered. Whether it's cracking a joke with a customer to make them laugh, telling a customer about a latest deal, or just going the extra mile in general, the service has always been phenomenal. To be honest, it's probably the friendliest Starbucks I've ever been to.

Lastly, they're super efficient. Even when there's a long line, I never feel like I'm waiting too long, and my order has never been messed up. And to be honest, even if they did ever mess it up, I wouldn't even be mad because I know they'd handle it professionally. Best Starbucks ever!

Probably the worst Starbucks I've been to!  The service was horrible.  We came in and placed our order with no one in line in front of us.  We ordered 3 iced beverages, 1 latte, a donut and 1 hot food item.  The iced drinks we're ready right away (to be expected). We waited another seriously 5 minutes for the latte.  Both lattes were terrible.  They were weak.  The hot one totally watered down.  The 1/2 vanilla almond milk latte was also weak with zero flavor.  After waiting 15 more minutes and witnessing everyone in line behind us getting their hot food, I approached the woman working at the oven and politely asked her if there she had my egg bites because I thought they might have forgotten the order.  The manager immediately butt in and said in a snappy voice that it was coming and they had a a lot of food orders.  I told him I'd just seen everyone who ordered behind us had their hot food already so I wanted to make sure I wasn't forgotten. He then told me it was coming.  I said ok and as I turned to walk away he started shaking his head at me in a snarky way.  My husband witnessed the head shake as well.   If you don't want to be in the food industry, don't work there.  Totally unprofessional.  I'm going to Peet's coffee!

It's a Starbucks with a drive thru. Not much else to say. A Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks. This one is no better or worse than any other, I expect. But it does have that drive thru! It's one of the closer Starbucks from my work, so I've been a few times and never had any issues. It's a good, average Starbucks.
Super quick store!  Definitely worth a mobile order to get in and out. Not super busy.

I've been to this specific Starbucks what seems like over 150 times. I've came here after school, after work, or after practice, almost everyday starting in November of 2018. My drink is always correct and good, and there would be rare times when it wasn't good. If your drink isn't good, just go to the Starbucks website customer service, explain, and they give you a very good refund!! For me, the Starbucks app that allows me to order ahead saves me a ton of time rather than waiting in the drive thru line. And the rewards system is awesome, I currently have over 1,000 stars! The workers here are always friendly as well, and they care about their customers. Best Starbucks location ever!

Always busy and under staffed. 15 minutes in line everyday is ridiculous. If you have a line out the door and a bunch of employees in the back bring them up front to ring. At best a manager should stop and ring.

Line was almost out the door and they only had 2 people working behind the counter. Took over 45 minutes to order and get my coffee.

Hire more people if your store is this busy because that wait was ridiculous.

I came here ordered a drink, ran to the bathroom real quick since it was a bit busy and I had just ordered... I came back waited but then realized someone took my drink I ordered . So I let the barista know so I could get a new one , he then said "okay I'll make you another". Right after the barista I told then went to the back for like 15 minutes I have no idea why. Long story short I had to remind the other baristas like twice to remake my drink since I paid already, took at least 30 min for me to get just one drink.

This Starbucks is spacious in size, I often come here and study at one if their many tables while taking advantage of their refills program. This location is a lot bigger than others. It does get busy at times however they are very quick with the orders. All Starbucks are busy at most times however.

The staff are nice and work very efficiently. It is clean and thy have plenty of outdoor seating available as well. Located in a plaza with other things this Starbucks is a great place to come and study while drinking the best coffee.

All of the teas taste great as the Caramel Machiatto. My go to drink.

I would suggest this location for studying and getting your daily caffeine fix!

Finally, they build a Starbucks on campus and I am in looooooooove. 

Located in the Dana Center of Loyola University, New Orleans is this brand new Starbucks establishment. It's dead center of the university so it's easily accessible from all of the surrounding buildings. 

With a wide range of drinks available plus a variety of pastries, you'll be sure to find what you're after. I believe it has the same menu as all other Starbucks so once you know one menu, you know them all.

I've gotten their Iced Chai Lattes multiple times and each time, they've been great. A bit too much ice sometimes though which results in less latte, which saddens me.

I've also had their Pumpkin Spice Latte. This wasn't good. It didn't taste like pumpkin at all and overall, was just really unpleasant. 

5 stars though as it's super convenient, the long lines move relatively quick and they serve my delicious Iced Chai Lattes. Yum!
Update: the last few times we have ordered we've had great experiences. Seems they have resolved the mobile order issues

This place is usually mobbed on the weekend, but on the other hand, there's nothing better than strolling down Main Street with a hot cup of coffee on a cool fall day.

Drinks are made with care, and some of the servers are really friendly (Jess was so nice and called us by name, which I wasn't expecting).

They've got a public bathroom you can use too. It does usually have a line though (of course).

I get being friendly with regulars but don't spend 15 at the register chatting with them when only one other person is working the line. Very slow service with barely a line waited over 20 min for a coffee frap. Unneeded wait watching at least 7 hot drinks pass my order.

Filthy dirty place. They plopped an unopened jug of rotten chunky half & half on the counter when I asked for cream. They rolled their eyes when I told them it was rotten and they didn't offer to replace my coffee.

I've always experienced fast and friendly service at this Starbucks location! I often order from here from the mobile app and have my assistant pick it up for us. It's always ready when she arrives. 

I will sometimes go through the drive-thru as well and again, they are very quick! The parking situation is a little cramped, and I can't exactly review the inside of the store, since I've never been in it myself. The five stars are for the staff and the quality drinks they create. I have another Starbucks closer to my home and I will drive the extra couple of miles to get to this one. Not once have they messed up an order, when the one on Prater-Sparks Blvd have, repeatedly. 

Also they are always well stocked when it comes to bakery items. Not once have they been out of whatever I've wanted.

This Starbucks has lots of tables and space.  I'd probably give it a 3.5 stars because of the lack of electric outlets near the tables... Starbucks in the Marketplace is much better in that respect.

The staff here is super friendly and they always make my drink right.  It's in a convenient location, in a pretty busy shopping center, but parking is never really a problem.  Mmmm coffee.

At Starbucks, you know what you're getting...Ironically, I'm not a coffee drinker, but frequent Bucks because if their internet and short business meetings. This Starbucks specifically gets three stars for two reasons: 1 the parking sucks; 2. It was disheveled and kinda dirty inside.  Eeeek.

This Starbucks is kind of special because it's located in this old converted house on University Avenue. During the winter-time when it gets cold, they light the fireplace inside and it is quite nice to sit there with a hot cup of coffee.
For some reason this sorted has the rudest and most inattentive employees of any Starbucks. To date I have never had the urge to tip. Rude, rude, rude...

I'm a huge fan of this location.  I come here several times a week and I've never had a bad experience.  The store recently went through a renovation and became a more comfortable place to relax with your drink of choice.  Also, I love that the building that they rent from went green this summer by installing solar energy panels and that Starbucks took advantage of that.  Staff here are really friendly and I never feel stupid ordering a drink, which at some locations or other coffee cafes I do.  

The only reason why I am not giving this location 5 stars is they have the worse parking lot around.  Its because of how Marsh Road goes on an angle right at that intersection but it makes it very small and difficult to get in and out of.
Love Starbucks!!! Wished their prices were lower, but other than that...I love it. The one on Magazine St/New Orleans is excellent!

I've been to Starbucks all over the world and this could be by far the worst one I've been too. To get an iced tea it takes 10-15 minutes. Only one person makes the drinks, there could be no one in line at the register and no one ever jumps in to help. Two days in a row now they have forgotten my food as well.

Do not go to this location. They up charge everything and the prices are not consistent with regular Starbucks stores. Also the staff there does not cater to the customers needs, and one person in particular is extremely rude to customers and will give you attitude if you disagree with the price inconsistency. As a loyal, daily Starbucks customer I am extremely disappointed. It goes against the Sbux motto of good customer service. I've now changed my schedule to go to Kahwa every morning instead.

Starbucks New Hope never fails to take great care of their customers. Brandon, Christoper and the rest of staff remember their regulars, their orders and always custom tailor of drinks to our preferences. They are a part of my day, our friends and an essential part of this neighborhood.
LITERALLY THE WORST STARBUCKS IN AMERICA. They messed up my black coffee by putting sugar in it and gave me lattes with NO espresso. Terrible all around. Nothing good to say.

Regretfully, this is the closest Starbucks to where I live. I'm giving a low rating due to two things that are major turnoffs. First, the bathrooms. SO GROSS! I went it there today and neither stall had any toilet paper, there was toilet paper and other garbage all over the floors, the soap was gone...I could go on and on, but you get the picture. Completely and totally unacceptable!! It looked like no staff member had gone into it for at least 8 hours...maybe they did and just didn't care?!?

Now, the biggest problem with this location is one very, very rude barista. Whenever I go in and see her behind the register I just cringe. I don't know what her name is (I will check next time and report back), but she is very tall and has long, blondish hair I think. She's always there at around 6 pm on the weekdays, too. 

Anyway, she always has the most miserable scowl on her face and never, ever cracks a smile. Then today, I witnessed her scolding a very young child who was bouncing up and down (on her knees, not feet) on one of the brown chairs. She yelled out from behind the bar area, looking down on the child like the grandmother in Flowers in the Attic - super creepy. The poor girl looked very distressed and that miserable barista really overstepped her boundaries with that one. 

It's just very upsetting that we pay SO MUCH for sub-par coffee and have to deal with workers like her. I have to say that all of the other baristas have been nice in my experience. I'm not sure why that crabby one is still there, I can't be the only customer she offends on the regular! If she's so unhappy and miserable, she needs to get a new job...

ETA: I just read other reviews and YES, YES, YES this is the rude barista with stains on her teeth! I see that she made another customer cry not too long ago...maybe it's time to call the manager and report her or something. She is so soulless that it really makes me not even want to go to Starbucks again. Ugh!
Like most of the Starbucks I've been to they are always consistent in the orders I place. This is spacious one and it gets a lot of foot traffic from State Street.

This Starbucks is located inside of Publix, which is in the same plaza as another Starbucks. Competition between the two Starbucks has been created since the opening of the one inside of Publix. 

They offer everything as any other Starbucks, but with a shorter line and a shorter wait.

I avoid writing about chains because they often seem the same, but they really are not. 
 
For one reason or another some different locations make the drinks wrong like burning espresso or wrong pump ratios.   This starbucks on Anderson has always met my expectations.

I forgot how much history I have with this location until they finally messed up my oatmeal with soy this morning.  The cashier was new, but the girl on the hot bar remade it perfectly.  I came here to relax before my first interview for my current job and here to relax before my first day on the job.  We shouldn't underappreciate the hard workers who make starbucks an epic experience.

Shoutout to Suzy who remade my order!

If you like Starbucks this is a good one. Not a whole lot of space inside, but if you are looking for a quick coffee and friendly staff who even remember your order this will so the trick. 
There are not many coffee places in the area so this is the best option.
