This stores is very inconsistent.  I purchased the clear double-insulated cup that last year ice tea refills were always 50 cents each.  This year, this specific store will charge 50 cents for ice tea refills one day and then the next they try to charge full price less 10 cents.  They need to come up with a store policy and stick to it.  Ironically, they actually sell the clear double-insulated cups at this location, so it's not like they are unaware of the cup and the concept behind it.  

In the future, I'll visit the many other locations around Tucson, which are much more customer service friendly and consistent.

Like every other Starbucks near campus, this place gets BUSY!
The surrounding are quaint, like your artsy friend's living room, but they get crowded like a house party in no time. There's a back room with a long trestle table and several smaller ones well-lit by generous windows...prime study/work spot. The front patio is small, but gives a great view of University ave and the baristas here are not as ditzy as the on-campus Starbs.
This is the second Saturday around 11am my skinny vanilla latte...what I ordered and paid for in the drive thru....was without the vanilla. No more Saturday visits to this location.

I love the staff here! They know me and my mother by name. And usually our drinks but sometimes we switch it up lol. I will say the lines here are crazy in the morning but they can usually be pretty quick about it most times. But, unfortunately, the parking lot and drive through collide which makes it hard to get through with how busy it is. Not enough parking spaces.

Ya, I know, Starbucks has pretty bad coffee.  I get that, but I love this location because the staff here is super friendly, and they close at 11PM during the week.

This place does get it's share of homeless people but still all in all the location has nice people watching, great food options on state street and it's open late night!

Every time I order something cold I ask for light ice. Due to the weather being extremely hot I do not want to drink something watered down. But it seems that every time I order light ice I am asking for extra ice so very frustrating!!

I drop by here from time to time to see if perhaps the drive-through lane has gotten faster.  After all, I heard about the Red Sea and Pharoah and all.  But no such miracle today.  I was the third car in line.  Time from order at the clown's mouth to touching my cup of joe was 11 minutes.  The only thing I can say to those who previously reviewed this as a "fast" drive through lane" is, "should employees REALLY be reviewing their own restaurants?"  

Meh.  This place is a turtle's best friend.

I ordered a Bold Coffee, then I noticed they used whatever coffee is available. Didn't offer to brew fresh coffee or even make me aware that they were currently out of the bold, just take it upon yourself Starbucks to serve me whatever you like. 
Starbucks, you've lost your way as a service based company and seem to have an air of entitlement as your new company culture.  Not exactly what I'm looking for when I need a cup of coffee and a few minutes to collect my thoughts.  
If you can't deliver, I'm sure the free market will take up your slack. 
Very Disappointing!

The worst. Can I do zero stars?
Orders take forever to fulfill. 
They are almost always out of certain pastries and cake pops.

This Starbucks location is my favorite Starbucks in Santa Barbara! They always have great customer service, friendly people, and make my order very quickly. I have come custom to doing the mobile orders when I'm in a hurry and this place always has my order ready on time!

Their wifi is great and there always is space to sit in here. They also have tons of plugs which makes it easy if you decide to stay to get some work down for a few hours. They even have a small outdoor patio with tons of chairs if you feel like sitting outside. The have a large selection of coffee, tea, and food here. They fridge is also always fully stocked so if you need to grab a bite they always have so many things here to choose from! Their bakery pastries and bagel selection is big as well.

My favorite things to get here are the breakfast sandwiches, matcha latte, green tea, iced coffee, and their pesto panini! If you are ever on the go the mobile ordering service is great! They even have a parking space saved out front for mobile orders only.

Overall if you ever need an afternoon pick me up, or a place to study and or get work done come to this Starbucks!
Good luck getting what you order.  The management tends to yell at the staff while you wait for your drink.

This is my favorite Starbucks in Tucson. The staff are always friendly, my orders have always been correct, and they accept Starbucks gift cards (Not all locations accept gift cards).

I like the outside patio, since I always find the drive-thru is packed. It's a great place to meet up with friends and they have couches and many tables for groups. I would recommend this location.

Headed out on my morning walk with my mother as always we were in search for a Starbucks.  Opening our search on our Starbucks app we saw the magazine st. location! Excitement! We decided a good 3 miles was just what we needed to receive the deserving coffee taste that only Starbucks could provide. 
When we arrived and prepared our Starbucks card app we noticed how huge it was! Beautiful outdoor seating and comfy chairs and tables for the masses.  Everyone is so friendly here!! And my mother not a fan of public restrooms came back with a great report, not only were they clean but they were big!  Two thumbs up for that!
We grabbed our breakfast muffins and warm tall coffees and headed outside to enjoy the crisp morning air.  Where everyone greeted us with a morning salutation! We will definitely be incorporating this Starbucks in our daily walks when in Louisiana! Thank you!

I come here some mornings to treat myself to a nice cup of caffeine and calories. The drive through line can get a little crazy (5+ cars) and inside can get a little busy (also 5+ people) but if you watch the baristas, they are working their butts off! These guys are pretty fast which makes sitting at the bar waiting for my drink that much more entertaining!

Not really a review of the coffee since it's the same everywhere, but I really like the baristas there. Super nice, humorous, and not hopped up on espresso. :)

Compared to others this one misses the mark. The brand is supposed to be consistent and nothing could be further from the truth. Do yourself a favor and go 1 mile east on Watson Rd to the one in Crestwood. This matches what can be found through the country. No comparison!
Traveled 150k air miles last year and have been to hundreds of locations. Sunset Hills is the bottom of the barrel.

Most annoying drive thru ever. Is this a circus/clown show or a coffee shop?
A pleasant greeting and a cup of coffee is great. But Comedy Central is at Zany's.

This is my absolute favorite Starbucks. I feel like the staff always is accommodating and my drinks are always consistent. You can see their prep area which is always clean. Bathrooms are clean and the "partners" always greet me with a smile.

This Starbucks drive-through rocks!  Sometimes all you need is a smile and a pleasant conversation with your morning coffee to set the tone for your day. 

Well done Zionsville.

I've been in Starbucks all around the country and this one was by far the dirtiest of all. The staff simply does not clean anything? The floor is disgusting and the table tops are filthy.

No one is coming out from behind counter and wiping anything off when people leave.

Someone is dropping the ball big time at this location. Get a new manager, the current one must be lazy?

This is considered my "local" starbucks. I've frequented this one numerous times over the years and I haven't had a bad experience. The place is filled with more tables and seats than most starbucks. They have 4 lazy boys which is nice to relax in. Since its located near CCC and Highland, i feel that there are a lot of students in here. 

I don't like that they don't brew blonde after a certain hour. The staff have always been nice to me. One time, i took my nephew here and he doesn't speak english but was learning. The staff was patient while he was practicing his english ordering a drink. 

The bathrooms are usually clean as well as the rest of the store. I've used the drive thru on numerous occasions and its good they offer it since the parking lot is a bit tight in that shopping center.

Unfortunately this location has pissed my family of Starbucks regulars off. 

Brownsburg is the busiest Starbucks in the state--not a surprising fact if you know it well. 

They have taken advantage of this fact by increasing prices at this location, so all the drinks now cost more than elsewhere.

I appreciate the fact that you can come here on a Sunday and not have your order murdered by the third-string crew as seems to happen everywhere else on the weekends, but come on. Gouging us because we come here all the time!

I've been to several Starbucks across the U.S. but I must say this one was not very clean, had no real pastry selections and thank goodness the drinks were pretty simple avoiding a bad experience with the major aspect of why I go to Starbucks.

Maybe I just went at the wrong time.  Maybe next time it will be a better experience.
Just had an employee rather rudely get in my face about "being there without having purchased anything" when one of her coworkers had made my order about 30 minutes prior.

needed a place to sit down and study and found myself on this side of town (away from my usual starbucks).

i sat in this starbucks for about three hours and the team here really handles a busy crowd! all the staff was super friendly and the barista made sure my drink(s) were tasty, just the way i like it.

i also like that there were quite a few places to sit down at. some starbucks just don't have enough sit-down room.
This Starbucks is big and plenty of room to sit.Very Clean inside.The workers in here are very polite and accommodating.
I literally use to come to this place every morning and I'm stopping. Rude workers and rude people go here. They open late constantly.

I do not prefer to go to this starbucks, they are always out of something, such as Carmel for the fraps, or whip cream, the girl at the counter is always preoccupied with something. its always crowded and the quality of the drinks are off. Id much rather drive out of my way to the startbucks on State than visit the mesa location

unorganized. 
girl with short blonde hair and glasses was extremely rude when i asked about about the rest of my order after about 5 minutes of waiting. instead of being courteous, she responds with "i'm just making drinks"

hopefully someone sees this and teaches her about customer service

Starbucks is Starbucks (supposedly) wherever you go,  BUT if you like standing in line for a cup of coffee in a place that is never well staffed,  this is your place. 
Too many times I have had to walk out without coffee because I just can't wait 7 min. 
Then, the one thing that really gets me when I order a dark roast I get "we ran out and were brewing. It will be about 5 minutes."
So overall,  and a bit contrary to the other review, I'd have to give this a very low score because for a place that serves coffee, sometimes they don't have it and they make you wait for it much of the time. 
They need more staff. 2 people.  One making drinks and one running the register in a place that is this busy is bad managerial planning.

This location has gotten a bad rap in the past but the day I was here, it was wonderful. Megan greeted me when I came in, was very friendly and eager to help. I forgot to load my card... I know, pet peeve... but nobody was behind me waiting. Megan was patient and sweet about it. When a group came in behind me and didn't know what they wanted, she said she would stand ready to help when they were ready and not to worry about how long it took to decide. The baristas were very fast and stayed busy making drinks quickly. Everyone who walked in received a warm greeting. I'm glad I gave this place a chance.

This location parking is "my" Starbucks.  Every employee is fabulous and I go here even when I don't necessarily need the coffee because I like the environment.  The parking is pretty good - if you come between 8am-8:30am the parking can be tight however there is street parking.  I kinda wish they had a drive through but with the location it just isn't possible and it forces me to go interact with people which sometimes is really nice :) 

All Starbucks are great, but "my" Starbucks is the best!

This Starbucks is very efficient -- almost mechanical.  But truthfully, do I need a song and dance as you make my drink?  No.

It's a little brighter than other Starbucks.  Or maybe I've always there when the sun shines in particular manner.  But that some how adds to the clinicaliness of the place.  If that's a real word.  And if not, I don't care.

The drive thru is a plus, though I've never used it.  Just never been in that much of a hurry.

Continues to worsen.  Extremely slow anytime of day.  I've stopped coming to Starbucks because the standards have dropped on quality and service.  If they had any competition in this part of town, this place would close down.

Starbucks GETS IT!!! So fresh & innovative in their business endeavors.  

(this review is 60% about the app & 40% about the service, drink, store etc) 

Hello, this mobile ordering is making my life all the easier!!!! Ya'll saw the line, I totally skipped... Bullying huh. Lol. I know, I'm not proud... But I was totally able to pull off a #stickandmove caper!!! 

Picture it: early morning, I need a cup of Joe, but I ain't (yeah i said AIN'T) up for waiting. So I pull up the trusty Starbucks app, located the closest store, placed my order & pay, then... Boom, Bang, Bing, I pull up walk in & get my order!!! Helllllo am I happy camper? Heck yeah (in my Napoleon Dynamite voice) Annnnnnnnnnd on the way out, because this Starbucks app is so cool, I can tip the barista, even after my transaction is complete!!!! Way cool.

I found my skinny cinnamon latte to be great tasting & temperature appropriate; quite PERFECT. 

Although the Barista & I didn't have much bonding time, the time I did spend with her, mainly her calling my name & me scooping my beverage.  She was pleasant, cheerful & engaging (she called my name correctly & with authority!!!!) 

Clean store. Ample parking in this shared parking lot. 

This Starbucks was VERY busy, long drive thru line, lots of folks hanging out indoors... The ordering capabilities of mobile app is sheer genius!!!

Being a long time Starbucks customer, this Starbucks is my ALL TIME favorite. All the ladies and gentlemen here are always are welcoming and accommodating. Not once have I been here and had a hard time. Even when I'm the one being difficult. I appreciate all of you there!!
My lattes always taste perfectly delicious here. I've been visiting this Starbucks since 2010. The girls are nice the drinks are always prepared just right.

This is a Starbucks much like any other. It is in a really busy location and is a great place to meet folks on Whyte Avenue. If you're fond of Starbucks it has everything you might want. The outside tables are quite nice on a hot summer day for example.

This is a smallish Starbuck's compared to some in town but it is my local one and is perfect for the slightly out-of-the way, family oriented, slightly rural feeling Mesa neighborhood of Santa Barbara. There are a few chairs and small tables on the "pet friendly" front patio that is in an alcove sheltered from the weather. The atmosphere inside is cozy on a cold day and, being near SB city college, is often quiet and studious but is friendly and comfortable. There are two (quite well maintained) bathrooms which is unusual for a small coffeehouse, and the staff is quite efficient and friendly though the place does occaisionally get very busy in the morning rush.
 This is a "big chain" coffee with a distinctly friendly, local ambience!

This location is not one of my favorites.  Obviously, it is more frequented by tourists and shoppers versus families and people wanting to study.  It's always slightly a mess, with things understocked and tables not clean.  The service is okay.  Not the happy baristas that I'm used to at the Goleta stores.  As a former barista myself, I'm slightly disappointed in this location.  At least they make the drinks right.
Perfect setup for road trips. A full Starbucks right next to a gas station just off the highway.  Could not ask for anything better.

Maple is better than Magazine.  Metarie is better than Maple.  That being said, Maple is the location I visit most often as it is closest to my home.

I have been visiting this Starbucks more so  in the past few months.  I am tired of paying for just OK coffee at the local chains- PJ's, CC's, and on occasion Rue and Zots.  I don't include Village Coffee, because I only go there for 1 thing.   But bad cup after bad cup being thrown in the streets of New Orleans by this coffee loving woman, I could be polluting the Lake by now with crappy cups of coffee.  Not so with Starbucks.   THIS location is a 4.  They, for a long time, would "fix" coffee made by lesser Starbucks, (I'm looking at YOU Magazine Street).  They really have their act together.  I actually "crave" their coffees.  I also like the treat receipt program which gets you a two dollar medium(there, I said it), after 2 PM that same day.  I also use  their card, belong in their club, and buy gift certificates on line cheap when I can.  There are ways to make this  Starbucks habit affordable.   

 The one evening they were closed at 9 PM, and needed a fix, I thought about my options in the area, drove down to BK and got a Seattle's Best. (Which was better than some other local places).

There are those who will disagree with me. I am ready for that.  I was also ready to stop wasting my money at places just because they were local, and not enjoying their products.  It all makes perfect sense, it just took a long time.

Incredibly crowded every time I've been there, very clean for how crowded it is, parking is a mess and compounded by the long-ass lines that stretch to behind where your car is parked, blocking you in.

I went in, knowing what I wanted, decided against that because of the sheer number of people waiting on specialty, ordered what I thought was a safety standard coffee, which they were out of, and got my last place choice of coffee which was ok.

This Starbucks has the youngest coffee drinkers of any of the locations I have ever gone, with tables of 10-16 year olds sucking down some overpriced coffee.  Nothing wrong with it, just kind of odd.

It's a starbucks, it's way too popular, it's not bad for a starbucks and any complaint I have is just because there are too damn many caffeine addicts that descend on that location.

The last time i was there I believe there were 6 people working as fast as they could to keep up with the customers/addicts.  it was, at that time, an unwinable situation.

This is a clean and comfortable Starbucks location with adequate indoor seating and a decent amount of tree-shaded outdoor space. The staff, while friendly was mildly inattentive. The barista seemed a little more interested in conversing with her male co-worker that going ahead and finishing my half-done beverage. It's not like the delay hurt the flavor of my drink in any way, but it seemed mildly disrespectful of my time.

It's a Starbucks.

It meets expectations.

The layout is nice and the seating does not feel cramped.

Staff are friendly and the food case always is well stocked. 

Please stop wining about the parking. There actually is plenty of room to park on the street if you are willing to walk a few feet. Get over it!!!

Yep, it is A-OK.

I give this location four stars and not five because the parking situation can be a bit difficult at times. This location does have a small lot but it can often fill up quickly during busier times of the day. Despite the parking, this is a great location ..the baristas are friendly, the drinks are delicious and the wait is never too long. I'd highly recommend of you're in the area!

Today is a nice fall weather kind of day, but I ate lunch outside and got a little cold. Decided to stop into the Starbucks across the street from Zavino and was pleasantly surprised by how friendly and warm the gentleman working the Starbucks cashier was. I wish the customer service were this good at every Starbucks because I left feeling happier than I was when I first walked in!

The approach to this location is a little inconvenient. Additionally servers like Zack today made the experience even worse. He was preparing the coffee orders, whispering names and expecting customers To wade through a sea of drinks picking up each to determine if you properly identified the right. Ultimately, I took someone else's by accidental luckily it was the same coffee.

Ugh.

They've managed to make three mistakes on a single drink order. However! They are extremely kind, to me, and from my observation, to some difficult customers they must handle.

A great spot to enjoy a beverage and focus on computer work.

Super convenient location and great staff. Everyone was extremely friendly, efficient and helpful. There was a short line when we arrived but everyone's help very quickly and our coffee and food was ready in no time. Lots of parking and easy to get to from the freeway.
Omg I love the coffee here.  Now I can see why Starbucks is so popular.  Only one coffee in my lifetime has been better than Starbucks, and that was Scot Coffee out of Allentown....

I've always been a fan of Starbucks, but this particular location is among my favorites. The staff is always friendly, and the drinks are consistently good.  I'd recommend it over any other coffee location in the Hermitage area.

Friendly staff, quick service, great seating/working space, and an awesome outdoor patio when the weather is nice with ample seating. 

My only negative is that the music is too loud compared to other Starbucks I've been in. The music itself is good music, it's just a little too loud for a cafe in my opinion.

I've never had to wait so long for my drink. Only 1 person taking orders and 1 barista at 2:30 on a Saturday. Looked like a manager came out (wasn't in a standard uniform) after my drink was made, but there were 5 people still waiting to order and 7 people waiting for their drinks.

Holy crap these are the most incompetent workers. How do you mess up a plain bagel w/ cream cheese?! Or, no creamer at 8AM?! These stoners workers are slow & thats the last time I'm going there. Corporate needs to step in on these fools.

Extremely poor parking, must be a park and ride location. Went in from a full parking lot and there were three customers.  There were three baristas on duty, one manager? And a line. The baristas ignored the customers, acted like they were doing them a favor by waiting on them.When one elderly lady stated her coffee was wrong,  they said " too bad " and walked away! I was ignored until the poor inexperienced barista had to ask someone else how to do a simple order ( they got it wrong) I just paid and left. My first and last experience with the famous "Starbucks", never, ever again!
These employees are AMAZING!! I live coming here. No matter how busy they are, each employee is keeping their cool. Always amazing service and coffees, no matter how ridiculous my order is

I frequent this Starbucks. Compared to many other Starbucks, the staff is outstanding. They are friendly, adults, and fast.

The scene here is a little weird - a mix of Mesa regulars and City College students. Good Cup is a little bit more eclectic.

Seriously, if Good Cup had free wifi, they'd win me (and others?) over in a second. But Starbucks is just more comfortable.

The most charming (i.e., least corporate) of the area Starbucks thanks to a repurposed interesting building and a trendy neighborhood location. It needs more seating and easier parking, but it's still the most pleasant Starbucks in New Orleans.

I love Starbucks!!!! This place is the same as most Starbucks coffee shops, addictive & a time thief!!!! LOL!!!!  

Very nicely tucked away in the strip mall across from Best Buy on Clearview.  This location experiences the same influx & lull of patronage as most others.  

Great place to hang out and wait for a movie to start or a general meeting spot (among the million of others) in the Clearview/Elmwood Area.  

OOOOOOOHHHHHHH AND THERE'S A DRIVE THRU!!!!

I have equally come to this location and the location further up 4th Street closer to Gandy. This location seems less attentive. Johnnie seems like a good worker today, but he started my drink and turned around and started taking orders without finishing it and I stood there and waited for my online order. I don't care what the sign says and whether or not there's a bell there for online ordering, the employees should be more attentive to the customers. I think I will continue more of my business at the other location. Especially since the girl today sounded like she was trying not to have an attitude.

Baristas were incredibly rude. I was actually shocked by their demeanor and lack of customer service. This was my first time at this location since I happen to be in the area. I had heard from a friend about the rude service at this location but saw it first hand last night. Aside from the service, drinks did taste well and the location was clean.

This is the Starbucks location that made me want to be a Starbucks barista. Then I became one, and I had to laugh at my own stupidity. It turns out I didn't want to be one at all, I just loved coffee and pastries. But, that's another story. 

I love this location because my drinks have always been accurate and the store itself is close to my house. That being said, it's annoyingly challenging to ever get OUT of their parking lot because of traffic on Loughborough. They do not have the fastest drive-thru, but they do have friendly partners and try to move quick. Tip: the drive-thru moves faster than if you'd go inside to order your beverage.
Visiting from way out of town, wonderfully amazing customer service both times I was at the location.

Okay,  so currently this Starbucks has low ratings... forget the bad reviews because they have definitely made enough change for me to be granting them 5 stars! First off all I'm here and it's about to close and there is not one open seat!... college students dig hanging here, which if you don't know common sense means it's a rad spot! 
I was greated with the cutest and most fun baristas who totally infected me with the laughter and happy vibe they both exuded so well! My night is so happy now and I feel like I will be coming back specifically to this Starbucks because of the exceptional customer service skills that Lexi (super blonde babe!) and Angela (sexy dark hair babe!)
They go above and beyond and have the best time ever when they are at work which is so contagious and BAM! This is the Starbucks to go to! Located next to other cool shops too! And I only mentioned two employees because they specifically stood out for me... all the employees are great from my perspective. Happy Starbucks!!!

BEST STARBUCKS EVER! The Baristas that work here are amazing!! They get my order right every time and even know me as soon as I start to speak through the drive through! Kathy is amazing always so friendly! I hate being away from home and having to visit other locations! Thanks 4 being awesome! Triple Shot Expresso Mocoito With 4 Sweet and Lows!
As soon as I woke up...I walked towards the window...pulled the curtains apart...rubbed my eyes....AND BAMMM..Starbucks.  I knew what I was having for breakfast.  Woo hoo!
I had the pleasure of stopping here coming back from Philly. My drink was perfect, and the ladies working were so sweet.

I'm a die hard Starbucks fan. The employees and the managers here are super friendly and pretty fast for how busy they are almost all the time. They do have a great location for before and after work for a lot of people.

A good chunk of the staff here is inattentive. Out of the 6 or 7 times I've been in here, ordered and sat inside, I've gotten the wrong drink 3 times, waited 15 minutes for a cup of water, and had an order completely forgotten about -- all while the staff is either goofing around or not paying attention to anyone at all. I've watched so many people walk up to the counter and say "I don't think this is what I ordered" or "Did you guys forget about my drink?" I'd give them a break if they were busy when I come, but they're not. I really don't get it.
Sllllooooowwww service in the early morning. Plan to waste 20 minutes minimally. Should have the most staff in the morning but they  have 3 for like 20 something people  smh :/

Why are so many people so critical?  It's coffee and pastries.  

Came here on Thanksgiving, and it was super packed.  Staff was super friendly, especially working on a holiday. Came to get coffee for my fiance who also got stuck working on a holiday.  Unfortunately only big box retailers get on the news about their employees working on holidays.  Other big companies are forced to cater to consumer demand and those employees should get some recognition too.

Short and sweet review. If you read this today, Thanksgiving, be nice.  You could've stayed home and made your own coffee and breakfast. These guys are here making your mid-week holiday easy.

I come into Starbucks every year for my birthday to get a free drink. Came in this year and lo and behold there was a blond lady with stains on her teeth behind the register looking utterly pissed off and over everyone, I told her it was my birthday and asked for my drink and she said "only if you have a registered starbucks card" in the flattest voice imaginable. no "happy birthday," no kindness, no sincerity, just utter awful blunt rudeness. and i have this card and asked if she could look it up by phone number, she said no, I went through my wallet and couldn't find it. I stood there awkwardly and she did nothing so I said 'well.... bye." and immediately went out to my car and cried. Really? I could show my ID, you could look up my number in the system, how rude, unthoughtful, bitchy and utterly degrading does one have to be to just look at you with soulless, dead eyes and not even just say happy birthday anyway or something? never going to starbucks again and lowkey hope that blond girl with stains on her teeth gets humiliated and fired for making customers cry from her bitchiness.

I am a big fan staff are fantastic and my drinks are always perfect! I love the mobile order option because the only reason I didn't rate them with 5 stars is the drive through has always been painfully slow!

This is definitely my top favorite Starbucks! Love the location which is very convenient for me. Can be busy at certain times of the day. I am very content with the environment & atmosphere. Especially when ordering at the drive-thru or going inside to make a purchase. The employees are totally awesome! Had to re-correct my latte only once. Mistakes happen from time to time. Either way not a big deal lol. All is forgiven. I will definitely continue going to this Starbucks as my main location.
Full service location in Gallatin. Drive up orders are available as well as walk in. The parking lot does not have the best flow so watch out around corners.

Wonderful location. The baristas are super friendly and go out of their way to help you. The space is really open and bright and the whole place is always spotless. The bathrooms have always been in good shape when I've visited, which they get bonus points for.
They're efficient at taking orders and making drinks and there's never a long wait, even if the drive thru is busy too.
Definitely love the patio, which is big and has seating and even offers an outdoor electrical outlet, if you want to get work done outside. That's pretty unheard of.
I seriously haven't met an unfriendly barista here, they're always stocked up on food and have plenty of merch in case you need a last minute hostess gift. I would go out of my way to choose this location over others. Starbucks same quality drinks with the added benefit of a super friendly vibe.

It is a Starbucks, what more can I say. It has the same menu items and quality service as all others Starbucks. What makes this one good is the size - it is about twice as large as a regular Starbucks. It has seating at community table, sofa and other 4 top tables.  If you work downtown or are meeting someone downtown, this is a great place for a CoLab meeting.  Plenty if space to hang out, including extra seating inside the adjacent Hilton Hotel.

Dirty dirty and more dirty. I came in at 4:37. PLENTY of time for the 4 people working in this tiny shop to get the tables wiped off at least. First time here and I don't know if I will come back.  I will say that the coffee bar was clean and the half and half and sugars were full.... So ... Maybe I just caught them on a bad day. Regardless the floors and tables should be clean at least. Yuck!

Love that this Starbucks is close to my house. They are always friendly. My only issue is they have 4 wall outlets in the entire store. 1 of those is hidden behind the condiments bar, leaving virtually no outlets for the entire seating area other than the 2 comfy chairs. Not cool. 

It's as if they don't want people hanging out or working from there. I probably won't come back here to chill or work. Sad, cause it's an easy fix to run a strip of outlets down the wall. PLEASE FIX.

Tracie was very accommodating, friendly and attentive.  My drink was made perfectly and the environment great.  I visit lots of Starbucks across the country and have to say this one tops my list in the best way.  A pleasant experience coming out of the hot humid heat of New Orleans.
Very friendly staff, good coffee, newspapers, good seating (patio as well). This Starbucks is top notch. Free refills for Gold Card members as well make it a notch above the competition.

This location of Starbucks is the best! 
I've been hopelessly addicted to Starbucks Coffee for well over 10 years. I love how fast I can get a coffee in the morning on my way to work. Either by walking in or drive-through, they haven't ever messed up my order yet. I used to live on the other side of the city and I seemed to wait forever in the morning, but not at this location. They have extra staff and they almost know how many people to expect. 
Also I love the FREE WiFi that they offer. It's nice if I'm having a stressful day and just want to sit for abit on my computer and read/send off emails. The atmosphere inside is very calm and relaxed.

I read the reviews about how slow the service was before I went to this Starbucks, and I did not expect it to be so slow for my visit. It wasn't very crowded at all when I entered, and all I ordered was a nitro cold brew coffee. That's something that takes literally 5 seconds to make. There were only two other people in front of me, and it took me 10 minutes to get my coffee. To top it off, the baristas were taking their precious time. If you're in a rush, don't pass through this Starbucks.

This is my "go to" Starbucks.

Fast drive thru, comfy inside.  One time years ago a drive thru attendant handed my hubby a cup whose lid wasn't properly snapped on - yikes!  But they've been consistently more accurate since.

Nice associates, especially if you are going inside to meet a friend, etc.

There's nothing especially unique about one Starbucks to the next, true, but if you are in Franklin - your two closest other Starbucks choices either have difficult parking (Downtown 5 Points) or are always crazy crowded (Cool Springs, not Carothers, beside Carrabba's) - so I end up here a lot.

A fellow yelper just recently posted her love for a Starbucks raspberry mocha, OMG.  My 2013 diet is in trouble...

They always have a nice selection of mugs and bagged beans if you owe someone an easy gift.  And who wouldn't love a new stylist travel mug?

Just left Starbucks drive thru without my order.  Stopped off while on lunch break had two cars in front of me.  I ordered a latte and moved up behind the next vehicle in line.  The first car immediately pulled out and the car in front of me pulled up to the window.  The window person bumped fist with the driver of that car as he leaned out of the store window.  I waited thinking this was going to go fast just like the first car.  After a few minutes the server left the window then came back to the window and gave the customer his drink then bumped fist again.  They continued talking for over 8 minutes when the car finally moved on.  I told the server that it took over 8 minutes worth of conversation until the vehicle it left.  There were three cars waiting behind me.  He said," I wasn't going to charge you for the drink, he was a friend".  I told him to keep the drink as it wasn't fresh and I would not be back. I called the manager who apologized saying they were old friends and it wouldn't happen again.    This location is a hit and miss go to Frothy Monkey in downtown Franklin.

Small, quiet, attached to Hampton Inns.  All the handicapped sports were taken by enormous pickup truck with no stickers or disabled plates, super frustrating. Coffee was hot and strong  just like my husband likes. I like the free water to drink in the car. Good coffee.  Impossible parking.

All Starbucks in Santa Barbara are shabby!
They do not reflect the excellent  Starbucks I know from the Seattle area and worldwide.
This one is the worst in Santa Barbara. It is just so tired.
I've had some of the nicest service here and some of the most  shockingly rude. 
There is hardly anywhere to sit. Small tables fill up fast. 
But I thought it was really sweet that they had a Christmas tree in the window.
And  they have a Clover. Good to get your coffee and get out!
Love coming to this Starbucks! People are so friendly  and welcoming and they always make my perfect cup of white chocolate mocha!

The location and atmosphere are fine. It's a mall location. I just feel bad for the girl Rosie. She is miserable at her job and tries to make the feeling mutual. U pick ur job love. U don't have to hate life n people don't want that vibe. #notrosie

It was my birthday and I drove past eleven indie shops just to get to you and your familiar green mer...thing. I looked across the cafe, comfortable to be back home on the Mac farm. I ordered the venti chai latte because IT IS AWESOME. And I sat alone between two undergrads writing English papers and thanked the great Spaghetti Monster in the sky that it wasn't me dealing with that bull sh!t. Happy birthday to me... Happy birthday to me...

The customer service here is amazing! They actually messed up our order yesterday, but there was a bit of a language barrier with the cashier. She was super super sweet and the mess up wasn't a big one we ordered 2 vente caramel fraps with 4 extra pumps and two extra shots each... we got it except in a grande size. Whoa was it strong!!! But we still took it and went on with our day. Today we went in and the cashier (I'm thinking she may be a manager) remembered us from yesterday. And told us that today we would get the right order at no charge! I mean, who does that now days? We will keep coming back (we're addicted)
Under staffed, under supplied, slow and badly managed. Worst Starbucks I've ever been in. Shouldn't take 20 mins to get a plain cup of black cof

This place is so much more functional than the nearby 7th Street location. I've started coming here instead. There's no drive thru which is a major downside and often there's a long line, sometimes out the door. The staff is usually fast and friendly and have yet to mess up a drink so strides above 7th Street. Last time I went, I got the Frappula Frapaccino for Halloween and the girls working were particularly friendly and helpful. Several location I had tried to order the drink I was told "Oh, we don't know how to make that..." These girls "Oh we've never made one of those before, but they sent instructions. Let us know how it is!"  Awesome job guys! Thanks for making my specialty, holiday drink and my day!

This Starbucks is very close to my house and we go often, exclusively through the Drive-Thru. Service varies depending on the time of day/day of the week. We typically go before six am most weekdays (we have to be out and about early). Our order is correctly and quickly filled about 85% of time at that time of day. When I go later in the day, or on weekends, my order is right and quickly filled more than 95% of the time. Despite accuracy or speed issues, service is friendly **all of the time.

Finally they opened a Starbucks within a mile and a really nice one at that. The location used to be a Chase bank. 


I'm going to just come out and say it, this is the nicest and biggest Starbucks I've been to in Tampa. Should I go ahead and reserve my favorite sitting spot now? 

Great spot for enjoying your favorite drink whether it's for a meeting, date, as a workplace or just to relax. There's a long communal table in the center and booths and chairs scattered throughout. Even the workstation for staff looks roomy. Starbucks really maximized the space with their consumers in mind. 

I'll see you here!

Slowest  Starbucks I believe in Philly.
They are in dire need of understanding time/order management and to understand if they have product in stock. 
Service is slow and all over the place. 
I would recommend doing a mobile order to save time.
Another Starbucks with an efficient and cheery staff.  Thank guys for getting me my joe fast and with a smile!

This is the one location that I have consistently been to over the past at least six months, where their bathroom is atrocious. This last time I was in there, Sunday, it was especially heinous. One of the women stalls was out of order which I had been at least since the last time I was in there the week before. Which understandably it's not their fault, but everything around it could be clean. With that, the bathroom smelled like feces. There were toilet paper rolls thrown all of the floor but not single clean toilet paper roll available to use. And this is all in the available, working stall. I notified the people at the counter, then let them know I would be using the male bathroom since their female bathroom seem to not to be available for use. I went in there, to have a urine smell and the exact same thing. Five toilet paper rolls thrown all over the bathroom. Dirty, stinky and unavailable for use. As if this was a bathroom in the middle of the French quarter. Next time I go in there I'll be taking pictures for you.

Every time I go to this location, everyone is so friendly. I've been there when the computers went down and they kept working and trying to get everyone out as quickly as they could. Also just went by and they don't have water, but they are outside greeting people and helping to find another location. It's the customer service that makes this place great.

I stayed at the hotel across from this Starbucks and walked to this Starbucks. I am from the west coast and was looking forward to going to Starbucks and talking to the barista about things to do around town. Well that didn't happen! One, this is a very busy Starbucks even at 830am. Two, not one employee smiled or looks at you. And three, when you finally get to the register, you don't get a greeting, just a ' what can I get for you'. Now let me say, no one is rude but for a southern town I was very disappointed how unfriendly this Starbucks was. I will stick to the hotel coffee for the rest of my trip.

This Starbucks is very good! I love Starbucks in general, but this one is one of the good ones! I purchased a dragon drink and it looked just like the picture online! The baristas were very friendly! The interior was clean and organized. The baristas looked like they knew what they were doing and they prepared the drinks very well. In conclusion, this Starbucks is a great place to get a drink to boost your day!
I love my Starbucks!! Baristas were friendly.. The atmosphere was good.. I spilled my drink and they were happy to remake it

This starbucks can back up quickly at drive-thru. I use my mobile app to order. Was excited to have order ready and correct at counter for pick-up. I've had a few places forget to pull the ticket and not have order ready. Nice clean location that is also popular spot for meeting/interviews. Usually see a few groups quietly in discussion and it is a good spot if you need this.

This is not a bad coffee place for a national chain. Good location in a very active business part of East Carrollton. Parking is tight but it is no problem if you live in East Carrollton and take a pleasant walk for your coffee. 

Staff was friendly on my first visit and very helpful to me. There is free Wi-Fi and that is always nice. Electrical outlets are plentiful for your electronics. No TV and that is good and the background music was enjoyable and easy to listen to. Another plus for me is segregated rest rooms according to gender. Not one for unisex restrooms anywhere.  Nutrition information on all their products is a welcome addition for all who are counting calories.  There are additional tables outside and with covering. 

So I feel this is a good location for any Starbucks fan. And not a bad place to take a break with coffee, tea, or bakery items.
Great drive thru service. Smiles and polite. The coffee was made to order perfectly. This place is wonderful.

The staff here is amazing and the service is awesome! However, the physical space needs a major facelift. It feels dark and empty and nothing like a normal, cozy starbucks. It's clean and well kept up but doesn't have any charm.

So impressed with my experience this morning...especially beacaue of the wonderful gal taking orders named Peach!  She is a peach!!!  So extraordinarily pleasant!!  I had a few specifications on my order.  She was beyond gracious, so pleasant, warm and accommodating.  I am grateful...she makes ones day.!  Left feeling good with a smile on my face.  Breakfast and drink order were perfect!

My star rating is low because this is the smallest and busiest Starbucks I've ever been to. At any time you would expect to find a working person get coffee you can expect the line is out the parking lot,  across the street, and backed up to the light. I can't imagine how much business they are losing simply because of that. If they opened up another location in the area that would greatly help. I'm also not sure if they changed their to go cups but mine are always leaking! I have coffee stains all over my car :( Fix the location problem, fix your cups and I'll be a happy camper

They can replace the furniture to remove a bunch of the comfortable chairs to replace them with tables, but can't bother to get an electrician to fix their lights that blink every 10 minutes or so and have for the months I've come here,
This is my local starbucks and it's always quick and I get my drinks made perfectly! Sometimes there can be a big rush, but try to go there throughout the day and you'll avoid it.

Like wow!! Who does the training in this staff!!?? This is like the 5th time my drink it been messed up and the 1st time I come back... the remake the drink and still wrong!!!! Wtf!? And I spend $8 on a drink and for my inconvenience they give me $4!? Dude this is a joke of Starbucks.... I hate that this is he only Starbucks that is close to my job... Do I have to quit coffee in the mornings!!?? I guess if the staff are the same...

I love Starbucks and will probably never stop, but this location is making it really hard. Mornings are busy, but the staff barely acknowledges customers, and about a quarter of the time they get the app order wrong - usually because they put too little ice or too much milk when we specify extra ice and only a splash of milk, for example. They also seem annoyed during the rush when I bother to ask the baristas to please hand me my app order, which I can't grab myself. They don't know who I am, even though I'm in there at least 4 days a week. One good thing though is that the app order is always ready in a timely fashion, even if it is not always exactly the way we ordered it.
Maybe if y'all get a better staff y'all could open on time or change y'all operation hours.

I go to this location quite often because it's convenient and they always get my order right. I always get a venti white chocolate mocha with coconut milk no whip cream no foam long shot. I have gone to a couple of the other locations in both directions and it's always been hit and miss. Here it's is has been consistent so even if I am going the opposite direction I will go here if I need a quick caffeine. The staff is always friendly. On one day in particular I went in to get a gift card to do a giveaway. The barista helped me purchase the card and put it on my app so that way people weren't using my main card. It was very sweet.
They messed up my order and added sugar when I clearly said unsweetened.  They are pretty slow as well.
2nd time in a month they've gotten my food order wrong. I ordered eggs bites both times and got a sandwich instead with the egg bites sticker on it... not that hard to read
They have the nicest workers, I didn't know how to order my coffee an what lingo to use ,And all workers helped & found me my perfect cup
Nice location. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. I ordered a Venti Mocha Frapp with two shots!
I like Starbucks but the bathroom here is filthy!  There are many other options so I won't be back here.

When thinking about reviewing a place, I find it's important to consider the time and location. I've visited this Starbucks twice on weekday mornings around 8am. The drive thru is BUSY. I wait about 12-15 min in total. With that being said, service is friendly and correct. No issues for me me report, would visit again but will be ready to wait.

They need to improve their customer service. The store was not busy and yet I stood in the cash register for 3 mins with the Starbucks employee in front of me until she even took my order. I get it, she was doing some cash inventory-but a paying customer is standing right in front of you and you're making her/him wait for 3 mins so you can finish what you're doing. A good customer service would drop whatever you were doing to serve the customer first. 

To make things even better, I had to wait for another 10 mins to get my drink because the barista accidentally put my drink in the drive through section. Again, the store was dead- and it took me almost a total of 15 mins to order my drink and get served. I definitely would have gotten my drink faster in a busy NYC Starbucks!


Very poor customer service - doesn't deserve a star.

I've stopped in here a few times recently. It is such a busy location. The first time I came in and ordered--big mistake. I was there for nearly 25 minutes waiting in line and then waiting for my drink to be made. The next time, I ordered ahead on the Starbucks app.  This saved a lot of time, as it only took 10 minutes and I ran other errands as they made my drink. I'll definitely do that from now on.

Cappucino made with heavy whipping cream = keto greatness

Friendly service, clean location.
Only two employees on a Saturday morning ??  Lines out the door.  Gotta find a better place to grab my joe.

I have been coming to this Starbucks for almost 5 years. The guest service is top notch, management is top notch. I have NEVER been treated badly or had a long wait or anything. Sometimes though, I can't find the right mix or balance to my coffee.  Last week a young man that works there, named Jeremiah, turned me on to a drip type coffee, that changed my world. The coffee is delicious!  And I just wanted to give a shout out to this employee, as I am sooo grateful for his suggestion. It takes alittle longer to make, sort of an extra labor to the coffee attendant, but he never made me feel like I was an inconvenience or "owed" him anything. I think he deserves to be recognized for his incredible guest service.  This location, in general, gets 5 stars from me. THANK YOU!

They have flies in the food display case. Come to find out they are supposed to give you the food that's packaged behind it or in the back. After telling them about the bugs, the reaction the staff had was awful. They acted like they didn't care. One associate said it was because of the vents in the case, as if that was normal and that I should expect the bugs. They tried to then serve me food from that case. No thanks! I'll pass.
Highly disappointed it's 38 outside and this guy is telling me they don't make medicine balls and people have colds and it's one of the coldest days in history.Wow I'm not coming back here .
Ok they have a barista here who makes drinks perfectly  She obviously cares about doing things right
Avoid during the mornings.  Wait time in drive-thru typically is about 25-30mins.  Either it's the only Starbucks in a 15 mile radius, which isn't, and super busy or it's super slow.

Just spent 20 minutes waiting in the drive-through and realized after I left that they gave me the wrong order. I called to get a credit, but was advised that this cannot be done without the credit card. I do not work in the area and I can't afford yet another 10 minutes to go back, find a parking spot, go inside, and settle up what is their mistake. Very disappointing and I will not come back to this location if ever I am in this area again.

I just saw a roach crawling on the counter where they prepare drinks. I alerted two employees, and both seemed unbothered. One employee finally came over to try to kill it, but he missed it and it went into the cracks of the counter. No one bothered to look for it after. Secondly, the floors in here look like they haven't been swept all day. There are trash and food crumbs all over. The bathroom is always dirty with toilet paper all over the floor. The second bathroom stall doesn't even have a toilet paper holder. They just put the toilet paper on the back of the toilet seat. The cleanliness in this place seems to be non-existent. Lastly, there is an employee handling money and making drinks. That is very unsanitary.

This is a hipsters paradise. And I am not referring to the clientele. Every time I have come, the male baristas have either well maintained beards (even well conditioned) or moustaches that they have spent a lot of time grooming and shaping into styles. They must spend a lot of their spare time grooming their faces. And their clothes? Perfectly ironed pants (even the jeans have the line from ironing) and their shirts are perfectly starched. Seriously. Its a good thing they spend so much time on their appearance, because they definitely don't spend any time at all focusing on the customer, or even what the customer JUST ordered and paid for. Or that they took any order from any customer at all. On the few times I have been, I have never seen an employee of color or female. All white males. I wonder what this says about the area, or the management of this location. Which I am shocked because this is in a diverse area.

The inside is clean, neat and well organized, though on the small side. If you are lucky, you might get something similar to what you ordered, if you ordered something like almond milk in your coffee, you will probably get regular milk in that drink. Be warned, strongly warned. But, you will quickly be given a beverage and your food order, even though it will most likely not be what you ordered at all. For example, on my most recent order, I ordered a croissant and an iced pumpkin spice latte, and they tried to give me a cake pop and a hot skinny mocha. I'm just sayin'.
Out of green tea in the middle of the day when it's 58 and sunny, you're better than that Starbucks! On the plus side, after waiting 5 minutes, the barista who brought it out was super friendly!
Very friendly and nice people working there. The place is clean and busy most of the time, yet not loud.

I think I may have arrived after a mongol attack.  Upon walking in, there were wet footprints about (it was not raining), one of the employee's check stubs was laying in the entrance (and man, I hope that person was a part-timer).  I found the source of the wet footprints being an overflowing and caution-taped off wide-open men's bathroom.

Coffee was fine, place was dirty, people were nice what I saw.  I'll try again some day as it's near where I work.  It was typical Starbucks employee formation of 3 non-stop coffee-slingers never catching up with the unending line of customers, so I can see why the place was a bit dirty.  The choice was a line out the door or stopping to clean.

The actual Starbucks is fine, they are a little slow and my mobile orders are never ready when I get there though. That parking lot is a NIGHTMARE! I would never park in there because the drive thru line is so long that you would never be able to back out of the parking spots. Sometimes the line will be so long coming from two different entries into the parking lot that street traffic will be backed up. I usually park across the street and walk there so I don't get trapped

So I am a pretty easy person to please, having worked in the retail industry in the past and even in a restaurant for a brief moment in my life, I understand that most employees want to do their jobs and some customers are just plain jerks, so I am a pretty easy person to please I dont expect much, just that my drink is made correctly and that I get a Hi or some kind of greeting from the person taking the order. 

Well i pulled up today and ordered a drink and the other guy on the intercom said Ok anything else? to which i replied I would also like a chocolate croissant, well the intercom went blank for 2-3 minutes and i was just sitting there and he comes over the intercom again and asks anything else, to which i then replied a chocolate croissant i thought he didn't hear me the first time which is understandable, he said no I got you i'm on my way to check, he did in fact hear me the first time he could of atleast said let me check or something, so he comes back on and says we are completely out of chocolate croissants. 

I pull up to pay and the girl who rang me up was very friendly and said you had the drink and croissant right and I said well i wanted a chocolate croissant but if you don't have any then its fine, she said no we do have chocolate croissants and handed me my order, I give this place three stars just because of the attitude of the first employee, he needs to learn how to communicate with his customers better.

I'd like to express my discontent I felt harassed in this starbucks unwelcome and treated like a second class citizen. First I walked in and asked for a tall  coffee the person behind the counter then said do course you would in a very condescending tone. Next I asked for a sleeve because the coffee was hot the told me to bad we don't have any.Then I went to pay and I didn't tip them they told me thanks fat ass. Will never be back.

I've been here on a few occasions and I do not have any complaints. Inside is clean, the baristas are nice and get my drink right. Be forewarned if you order multiple drinks in the drive thru it will get muddy, but the order takers have always been patient and will repeat, repeat until they get it down right.

It took TWENTY minutes for them to make me my egg bites. They kept saying "sorry she's in training." I don't understand how that makes it take twenty minutes when there is NO LINE. When I got the egg bites they threw it in a bag and smushed it, no small flat tray like they usually come in. I will NEVER come back to this location, holy shit I am so annoyed.
the brunette lady was a bitch and they didn't put chocolate in my chai???? when i asked for it
Coffee is fine and the workers are nice, but they are just very slow. Only come if you have time.

As I walked into my favorite, classic cafe, i expected nothing less than to be greeted with smiles and friendliness, however, this was not the case. I walked in to the register and wanted to order two large waters along with a protein box and mango dragon fruit refresher. Before I even had time to carry on with my order, the cashier at the time interrupts me and simply says we're going to make that grande size for today. Not only did she not ask if it was ok if the size was smaller but she said it on a very snarky tone. I was drawn back by the rudeness that she conveyed toward her customers. Me and my family spend so much money at this business every week. I am so disappointed by the way I was treated and will surely never return to this specific location again.
Basic, run-of-the-mill Starbucks. Have had issues with mobile ordering. Either the order was not received or it's been sitting behind the bar and I get a cold drink.

The two star is solely for my drink not Starbucks as a whole: I ordered the iced guava white tea lemonade and I got a strawberry tasting drink that reflected more of a pink lemonade taste and zero guava taste. Such a shame that nothing out of this drink screamed guava to me. Good customer service by staff. Starbucks need to omit this drink out of their menu unless they find a real guava tasting syrup or juice to make this drink a reality.

My favorite starbucks location. They always make my green tea latte on ice just right, other places make it too milky. They were out of the tomato mozzarella panini but they offered to remove the meat out of any other panini to make it a vegetarian option for me. The customer service is excellent !! They were very nice and made a good conversation while I waited for my drinks :)

This by far the best Starbucks on 4th Street! I drive out of my way to come to this coffee shop. It's your standard starbucks inside and menu, but what sets it apart is the staff. They have ALWAYS gone above and beyond to help and be friendly. For example, out of a bakery item you ordered and they already rung you up? They'll take it off your order and comp you a similar snack. They're always friendly, upbeat, and quick with a smile and conversation. You can really tell that the employees here enjoy their job, their coworkers, and interacting with customers. Definitely makes it special and different from your average Starbucks.

Just moved down here for school & I was worried I wouldn't find a good Starbucks near me. Thankfully I found this one! The service is great and you can tell they take pride in their drinks. Plus it has a drive thru

The drug addicts need to be kicked out! They are disgusting. I'm glad they have high top tables in front which seems to help eliminate the people who only come to sleep. Starbucks and drug addicts are a huge problem!

Wow. Hire up people. 
If you have plenty of time and patience, and looking for a blatant disingenuous interaction, then you'll just love wasting valuable time here. 1st time ever I didn't tip at a Starbucks.
Good service, friendly staff and I got my drink order quickly. I recommend trying out the cinnamon raisin bagel. It's vegan!

This is a great Starbucks location. I don't do reviews too often because I try to do thorough ones, and the experience needs to be worth it for me to get the ambition to do so. But today for example I placed a mobile order ahead of time for a coffee and sandwich. It took me a bit to get there and because of my own doing they were cold. I asked if I could just quickly have them microwaved and he immediately took both them back, dumped the coffee and gave me a full fresh cup and even a whole new breakfast sandwich which took a moment while they cooked it up in their oven.(Sad to see them discarded, but it's this service that matters here). A local disabled woman that often wanders this area came in while I was there too and all the staff were so nice to her, complimenting her on a new dress and asking what she wanted when other people avoid and ignore this woman in public. You could tell they cared for her as a regular and treated her well.  This time, and all other times here staff greets you with smiles and very friendly accommodating service.

Let me first say that I probably go to Starbucks 3-4 times a week. 
I usually order one if the refreshers and when they shake it and let it sit there is room at the top...I ask for them to top it off...I have gotten more ice and more water in the past, so now I say top it off with concentrate please. Some barristas are good with that while others it appears to be an inconvenience. Today at this Starbucks the gal put it a load of ice when my order stayed lite ice...I asked her for the lite ice and she reluctant took out the ice then added water. These drinks are over $4....
She started to walk away and I said oh and can I get a pupicinno...I caught her rolling her eyes!!!! Really! 

She started with the pup and her canister ran out ... she looked around and said we are out of whipped cream right now. I walked away. 

Not how I expect to be treated at Starbucks. Gotta rethink my coffee stop.

This SBX has varied wildly in quality of service. Evening staff (6PM to close) is less friendly than I generally expect in Starbucks. Morning staff is more upbeat and less wrapped up in discussing their personal life and plans for after work. 

The layout does not encourage one to stay and order multiple items over time. All of the tables except for the handicapped table are small (two-chair) and are crammed around the front door. The cushion-chair area in the back is nice, but the store is clearly focused on its very heavy drive-through business because the area behind the bar is VERY spacious at the expense of the customer-seating area.

The parking lot is always jammed during the day, but SBX is the only business in the building open at night, so parking eases after 6PM.

No real issues with the joint and the quality of the items is the same as any other decent SBX, but it doesn't stand out as iniviting, a shame given how often I am in Franklin.

The location is great, the building beautiful, and the service is a disgrace to the Starbucks name. I WANT to like it and have visited three times in the last week.

Visit 1: visited specifically for frappacino hour. Announced at the counter that I was there for the frappacinos on sale and ordered. Looked at my receipt later and saw that the discount had not been applied. When I questioned the barista, she said that size was not included in the special. She really should have mentioned when I ordered.

Visit 2: went through the drive-through and ordered a refresher drink without ice (sensitive teeth). After I pulled up to the window and she gave me a drink FULL of iceN the barista told me it was starbucks policy that they required ice be in the drinks because it had caffeine.  I requested less ice if that was the policy (pretty sure she was lying) and she took the drink back, then handed it back to me 2 minutes later. I drove away.

Visit 3: once again visited for frappacino happy hour. Was charged full price for 2 drinks. When I questioned, the barista apologized and took my card to make the correction. Fast forward 2 days, she charged me twice for the same drinks, first time at full price and 2nd time at discounted price, but no refund for the mistake.

Summary: lack of professionalism and inadequate training, unfriendly staff, argumentative, openly lied, and dishonest.

The employees here are not great... Management should really think about hiring associates who clearly aren't morning people when your store opens so early!
I thought the store opened at 5am, when it actually opened at 5:30.  I tried to apologize to the associates for getting angry about them not being open and no one would even make eye contact with me.  One woman in general was extremely rude, should not be working in customer service at all!  The other woman working charged me to add cream to my iced coffee? Since when is that an additional cost?  So glad this isn't my local Starbucks...
I love this Starbucks.  They always get my order right, and they remember me when I come in.  Great place to hang out too if you need to catch up on some business or socialize.
This newly remodeled Starbucks is great. The barista's are always very pleasant and the coffee taste great. It's kind of expensive but it's Starbucks right.

No one in line, I'll grab a quick tea, right!?!? Nope, no greeting, acknowledgement, no nothing. I'll make tea when I get home. 

Oh, did I mention there were 4 people behind the counter? SMH

Very disrespectful Store Manager that goes by the name of Greg. Can't multi task at all to be a manager, poor manager levels.  Asked nicely to please hold a coffee mug purchase I was going to make for my Valentine's while I was going to get my wallet and he totally ignored me, hey man you look so miserable seems your working for free! Makes me  Feel sorry for the owners of the store you are making them loosing business due to your nasty values.

I'm giving this place four stars due to them never getting my order wrong. I've never had an issues with that aspect. But this place gets packed and I mean packed at times. It's in the middle of university traffic and Tucson HS, so expect to wait. Use the mobile app here if at all possible. The location is nice though. I like the outside areas to sit and at times the inside is pretty nice accept when it's really busy. The staff have been pretty friendly every time I've come here and move quick (because they have to due to the volume of customers). It's not all sheik like some other Starbucks around town but has that homey feel to it. Make a stop and try it. I've also seen dogs here outside too.

The worst Starbucks experience we ever had. Three people working; no customers before or after us. Had to ask them to wait  on us. 

When the person handing the drink to me at the bar announced my drink, it was not announced as what I ordered. When I restated what I ordered and asked if this was what was in my drink, he said, "that's what you ordered isn't it?" 

I said, "that is not what you said it was."

He just smirked.

Never to return to this location. I will stAy with the Baywalk location. They know how to treat people

You must have about three drinks in mind if you are going to order from this Starbucks because they never seem to have any ingredients. I am still confused on why they never seem to have ice - an explanation that I have heard on more than one occasion. You can wait about 20 minutes for one drink even though there may only be three people in line because some employees like to socialize with each other. I think some of the employees need some training on how to make the drinks because my friend ordered an iced coffee with cream and received a black coffee with whipped cream. The Starbucks was clean, but I would drive down the street to the other Starbucks to have a bigger chance of having all the necessary ingredients for my drink and in a faster time.

I mean pretty much 80% of the population loves Starbucks, so this wont be super long or detailed i just wanted to say that each time I've been to this location even if they are packed I'm never in there more than 5 mins. Also I discovered a new off the menu flavor and its amazing for my people that love sweet coffee. The ones that enjoy a little coffee with their creamer! :) its called Toffee Nut! Enjoy!!

I've had bad experiences before at this Starbucks but nothing like this. Zoe, is unfriendly and obviously hates her job. She snapped at me after I asked her the simplest question. She is unprofessional and rude. The vibe in that store was very unpleasant. I will not be going back. I advise upper management to step in.

Not a big fan of 'bucks but one thing they do well is consistency and efficiency - except at this place. But  OMG the wait here is ungodly...........
You WILL WAIT at least 15-30 min for coffee. 

Just go into Kroger and buy the coffee - take it home and brew it yourself because you will get it quicker than this location.

This Starbucks is one of the worst Starbucks I've ever been to in my life. The cashier was super rude and couldn't hear me. He had to ask me several times for my order and I said it loud and clear. Didn't even bother giving me a receipt either. Do not go to this Starbucks, there is a better one literally 5 minutes away.

Great atmosphere, the team working this location is incredible. Very friendly and attentive team. One of the only Starbucks location that I've seen the manager be so invested, involved, and cheerful with the team and customers. Spacious location, and great coffee!

I have been to this Starbucks a few times but I cannot recommend it because they refuse to take star rewards.  They will gladly charge you the standard Starbucks price and more on some items and take payment from my Starbucks card but sorry "We are a franchise and don't accept stars".  Last visit for me.
This is my favorite coffee shop ever. Never got the wrong coffee and it's always perfect drinking temperature. The WiFi here is blazing speed and always free.
Great location! I mobile order when going here and my order is always ready and perfect.

Ran in the other day to grab a coffee. Outstanding staff... coffee was perfectly made. The atmosphere was welcoming and cozy. Right off the highway. A definite if your looking for a great coffee with a smile.

The drinks and the food are the exact same as any other Starbucks that you will find, but the reason why I am even bothering to write this review for a international chain that we all know is because of the service.  The drive thru was extremely quick, the order was right, and the friendliness from the staff (especially Anna) was second to none. 

Keep it up crew!!! I am excited to make you all part of my morning routine now and it's solely because of you all and the customer service you put in day by day.

Probably the single greatest Starbucks I have ever been to. Everything is typical cookie cutter Starbucks retail...EXCEPT the staff is top notch and there is a Clover.  

The drive-thru line moves incredibly faster than any other Starbucks in the nation, it's like they have hired top quality normal people who become superheroes when they don their green aprons! Go Team Green Apron!
These ladies are friendly, accommodating, loud declaring ready orders and fast! Happy to have time to get a tea and do a little work here this morning.

Bumbling and questioning the customer was my experience with this location. I'm a regular customer but I usually avoid this store. Today, my order and payment, process were messed up, and the fix of both were cumbersome. I had already left the store when I realized my food order was wrong. I came back and was questioned if I had really ordered what I wanted. I think the person taking my was very distracted, and I believe that was the reason for the issues. But she didn't really accept full responsibility.

Great New FAST Starbucks in Four Season's Shopping Center.  This location makes Drive Thru a breeze.  Enter the Starbucks lot from N Woods Mill @ Olive Blvd.  Traffic from this store exits onto Olive Blvd.  This Starbucks is in a brand new building on a corner lot that has been empty for years (in front of Dierbergs).

Standard Starbucks Products available.  I ordered a Flat White and it was a delicious as always.  Extra friendly service.  Check out this new store!  I will be back soon.
Just went through the drive-through great experience drinks made perfect definitely recommend this location friendly staff
PANINI - Won't do THAT again. See advertisement photo compared to what I actually received.  Could they put any less attention to detail in that Panini? Service was fast and coffee was good.

This is a very packed Starbucks right off the freeway in my hometown.

On weekdays you can count on everything being good--the baristas take a lot of care with the drinks. My wife is very picky, always asking for Extra Hot, and this location gets it right. On weekends the backup teen crew is less strong, slows down the drive-thru at times and makes the occasional mistake. 

Overall the coffee is done well here.

Not enough seating. People like to hang out at this location, and it's hard to get a seat except when it's nice outside. 

Parking--just not enough spots and very poorly designed.

First, the staff was welcoming and efficient.  My Americano (no extras) was perfectly made. They do charge over $4 for a Venti.

My issue is that they use the Hilton Wi-Fi which is less than stellar.  The signon page would not open on our Android phones.  It works on WIndows but even at that, the signal was only two bars and slow.

OH MY GOSH!!! I just left this location and got in the car with my husband and said, "if I wasn't married I would marry that Starbucks employee!" I have literally NEVER had such a great experience at Starbucks in my entire life and I've even worked at Starbucks. Whoever the guy running bar on a Tuesday 10/29 was deserves a huge pay bump! Wow. Ok so I'm a super snob about filling up a Grande amount into a Venti cup. Literally every single time I order it that way they always ask what I want with all the extra room. Honestly there's NOT A WHOLE LOTTA EXTRA ROOM. 10 ounces to be exact - so he filled up the grande cup and poured it into the Venti cup and it goes well over the highest top black line. Like a lot. And it's the perfect amount for the pumpkin cream on top and this is the best day of my life. THANK YOU  THANK YOU  THANK YOU!!!!
The coffee is more like heated milk with water . Already second time ... even though husband had a good one once . Always check it right there. Somebody doesn't do the job

I ordered a cold brew w/ salted cold cream and instead received my cold brew with sweet cream. This has happened once before and chalked it up as just a mistake, but this is the second time! I suggest you always check your drink for accuracy before you leave the drive thru.

Holy crap they are slow. Stopped to get a drink through drive thru but won't again. Been waiting for over 5 mins and still have two cars ahead of me. Finally got my drinks after waiting 18 minutes, and it tastes like water. Okay Starbucks. What a waste of 15 bucks !

I love this Starbucks for 3 reasons:

1. I know exactly what to expect cos it's freakin Starbucks. 
2. It's close to my job.
3. It's open at 6am so I can go there before work. 

The slightly strange aspect about going to this Starbucks that early is that for some mysterious reason there are always people there just hanging out. Are they tourists? Are they jet lagged? Are they ghosts? No one knows.
Great folks that work here in the morning. Always on point and remember my order and name. Terrific start to the day

I've visited this Starbucks many times, the service has always been friendly and timely (unless it's prime-time morning traffic and everyone is pulling into the drivethru to get their coffee fix), but this morning's experience made an impression. If I remember correctly, Shannon took my order in the drivethru. She made sure to ask me, "how can I make your morning great?", which was such a nice touch! She complimented my drink order and said that's actually what she drank this morning too. So personable!! Once I pulled up to the window the service continued to impress me.
