Both ladies were so sweet and friendly. My drink was delicious, not to mention I was in and out of the line within a couple of minutes. I was impressed with the fact that even though it was a fairly busy morning, they made sure to make me feel special and delivered a personable experience. Great job Starbucks!!
Love the service at this Starbucks!  Really friendly and upbeat. Good location for walking. Parking available on the street (but no lot). Free WiFi. Drinks are always good.

Normally, I have no complaints about Starbs, even when they mess up a drink occasionally. However, today drew the line. We went through drive through and everything seemed fine. Had to repeat the order, but that's fine. The issues is when we were paying and getting our drink. They gave me my coworkers first and the label said it didn't have SG syrup she requested. When the girl came to the window again with my drink. I asked for the drink to be remade since it didn't have the correct syrup. My arm was extended for longer than needed before the girl took the cup with a huff to be remade. She handed my drink to me and it didn't say almond milk on the label. I asked if it had it in the drink. She rudely, 'No, because you didn't ask for it!'. I looked back at her and told her I DID ask for it. I have a dairy allergy. I extended my arm again with the cup and asked for it to be remade with almond milk. She took a long time to take it the cup. When she came back, she had both orders correctly. This seems to be an on going issue for this Starbucks, making their drinks incorrectly. Every time my friend and I come here, we always have to have them remade. I don't plan to return to this location for a while just due to how rude the cashier was. Customer service is everything and this girl is clearly lacking in that department.

If I could rate this location with zero stars, I would. The lack of customer service is very transparent. The baristas are too busy yelling over each other to properly take your order and when they do, they mess it up. I've had numerous drinks done incorrectly here but the rude employees were the icing on the cake today. Hire new people!

Nestled in the heart of academia (i.e. the University of Arizona campus), this Sbux is humming with the quickened pulse of anxious undergrads second-guessing their preparedness for the exam that will soon determine their fate, while professors sadistically toy with the idea of adding challenge questions to said exams. Baristas draw the focus of students and professors alike back to the matter at hand by collecting their orders: students going with an extra shot of caffeine in hopes of sharpening their focus; professors saying 'yes' to the whipping cream in a celebratory fashion. Ah yes, the bittersweet blend of the aroma of fear and coffee beans perfumes the air. *cheers*
Purchased bantam bagels and it was still frozen, but was able to come back the next day and get a new order for free. Customer service was great.

I know it's a Starbucks so they're all pretty much the same, right? But this one rates 5 stars for me due to its spaciousness and lack of a drive-thru. (So sick of waiting for my drink whilst drive-thru orders take priority at other locations.) 
Set in a strip mall, there is plenty of parking in the shared lot with Dierbergs. Easy in and out using either entrance at traffic light, just south of 270. Staff are friendly and fill orders quickly & accurately weather in person or mobile. My favourite thing about this location is how spacious it is inside. You can actually find a seat and not feel like you're sitting in anyone's way, making it great spot to relax over a cold brew.
Great for a quick refresher right off the highway. Not my favorite Starbucks to sit and chat but the drive-thru service is what keeps me coming back!
They are super nice and fast! Just stopped in and the baristas are sweet, clean store and fast service! Drinks made perfect. Ali was a sweetheart.

Just what every other 2 and 3 star said. I'm not a Starbucks fan but decent coffee is still lacking in Gallatin, I've been coming here for business for over 30 years and have seen the town grow up. Was somewhat happy when this location showed up about 6 years ago knowing I could get a halfway decent cup of coffee in comparison to what you'll find elsewhere here. 
No offense to Tennessee but life definitely is slooooower here. Any location in California would double the output of this store based on the speed of the employees. Corporate needs to get with it here and light a fire under these employees butts. The drive through line always has 15-20 cars and your wait is guaranteed to be at least 15 minutes.

I am a lover of Starbucks and going on here is always comfortable. It is big enough to sit down and have a nice chat over coffee and efficient enough to quickly run in and grab the drink of your choice.  Staff is very friendly and when you are a regular they often remember your name and order.  Every now and again you will find a bad apple but also will find those that go above and beyond to make sure you are a happy customer. If you love Starbucks, this is a great location.

A+ to the lady at 840 am at Starbucks inside of target for helping us out and telling about the coupon on the Target app. Took the time to teach me how to download it and find it - was very nice. Kind and efficient!! Best Starbucks experience not actually at a true store. Thanks!

This is probably the worst Starbucks employee I've ever encountered. Twiddling his thumbs while bring the empty creamer to the counter.  They don't get replaced I have to state the obvious. Please give me some half and half.  Wanted me to bring coffee to him from the island at first.  I had to take the H&H from him. Horrible service with an attitude.

Food and drinks are the same as any other target yet I remain a little disturbed by the consist lack of friendliness among some of the people who work at this location. You can't first make my drink wrong, then slide an open drink with no lid to a customer and then get an attitude when the customer asks for a lid. I'll stick with the nearby target location from now on. Just disappointing. Not the first time the atmosphere here has been unfriendly. They've also got to turn the music DOWN. It is already difficult to hear when people are speaking through masks and across a barrier. Imagine what this is like for people with partial hearing impairments ....

Great Starbucks.
Thank you to the staff for always being nice and hardworking.  
Parking is plentiful.
Pro-tip - Get your bagel breakfast sandwich next door. 
Another Pro-tip - Chinese "I'm ready for a nap" lunch next door.
Slowest Starbucks on EARTH. 20+ minutes wait for an online order iced coffee with almond milk. Had to go to work so I never got my coffee :(

Don't stop here if you are in a hurry! Consistently the slowest moving Starbucks I have ever visited, and I'm not sure why because they seem well-staffer. Expect a 20 minute wait in the drive through (even if there are only 2 or 3 cars in front of you).

Good save from one of the baristas who opened up a register to take my order, after waiting on another customer who I think was detailed in her order and another barista who maybe didn't have coffee yet.... But everyone friendly and smiley. Drink was made well, fast, came out looking nice, and tasted just right the way it should. 

Plus for a really clean, nice looking bathroom. Smaller location, so if you're here to study...might have to sit outside.

Worst Starbucks ever that consistenly screws up even the simplest of orders and does not understand their rewards program or prepaid coffee mug product. In one instance they completely forgot to put in our sandwhich order, then asked us if wanted them (hoping we'd say no). They later apologized and gave us a free drink voucher. However when I returned and used it-they messed up that order too. How ironic.

The only issue with this location is that it is constantly mobbed in the drive through.  The line can get so long it goes into the street, but it's not the employees issue as they move as fast as they can and move the line quickly.  Every time I have been here all of the workers are very nice and treat you with respect.  I usually have my dog with me and they sometimes give her a pup cup or try to pet her when her head is out the window.  They have never been out of anything and products always taste good.

I love this Starbucks. It's smack dab in the middle of the city and it's never crowded. The staff are always nice. There's a great view of Veterans Blvd. I decompress, sip my Pumpkin Spice White Chocolate Mocha and recharge for the next adventure. 

This is a bustling business but the vibe is mellow. I dig it.

Making my usual morning pit stop! Grabbed a delicious pumpkin spice latte and a breakfast sandwich. I ordered the double smoked bacon, egg, and cheese sandwich. It was really good. Bacon cooked perfectly and the bread was unbelievable soft. Wes the barista was super friendly and helpful! Thanks Wes!!

Yes, the parking is a nightmare. Although, I discovered that there is parking across the street at the Noble train station. That is, if you don't mind running across the highway to get to the Starbucks. The baristas at Jenkintown are okay. But, the staff at the Starbucks in Chestnut Hill and Flourtown are much friendlier and accommodating. They also go out of their way to remember your name and face. Also,  the clientele who frequent CH and Flourtown are way more affable and considerate of others.

Friendly and fairly fast here for a Santa Barbara Star Bucks. Took 10 minutes for drink instead of 15 or usual 20 minutes. Always consistent made drinks, so extra star for that. Although Barista mumbled names to the floor instead of calling out. Several orders sitting on counter until she finally called out to customers.
Excellent chai tea latte but quite a stale pumpkin scone. Disappointing drive thru experience.  Barista was competent and my order was correct.

Came in right around lunch time, and it wasn't too crowded. Available seats for a good conversation with a friend. Barista/cashier was very kind and friendly. My vanilla chai latte was yummy, though it took a little long for them to make it.
What a shit show. I waited 30 minutes for a drink that takes 1 minute to make, and it wasn't made very well. All I can say is get some help bc y'all need it

They take mobile orders but the store is only open for drive thru. It eliminates the whole Timeidea of a mobile order. I just had to abandon my order and leave. There was no way to cancel the order either. They really should update their app to show that store as not accepting mobile orders. Instead they just take money from people.

The problem with this Starbucks is that they know people will still come in no matter what they do. This is the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to, and their drinks are far from the best. If you go through the drive through, you'd better plan to be stuck in place for at least 15 minutes, regardless of how many cars are in line. The DT line goes straight down the middle of the parking lot. The parking lot is tiny, too, so it gets super congested and it's difficult to get out of your parking spot when there are more than 2 cars in line. Also, their coffee and espresso often tastes bitter and slightly burnt. Maybe they don't properly clean their machines? Unfortunately, this location is right next to where I work and I am as caffeine-addicted as the next person, so they still get a decent amount of my paycheck. Yes, I'm aware that I'm part of the problem! Haha
Very lovely staff. Very kind and hardworking. The girl with brown curly hair and the guy in the hat and long beard answered my questions about becoming a barista! Love y'all!
The slowest service ever. I've lived close to this starbucks for a few years and always regret going. Never changed, always slow.
My compliments to Starbucks at 96 th street they know how to make it. Cafe vanilla frap with a shot of expresso.

Every Starbucks location seems to deliver quality food and beverages, so they really only vary on their customer service. I've been to this location many times over the years, but unfortunately, this time was a real disappointment. 

I went through the drive-through mid-afternoon, which was surprisingly busy for that time of day. When I pulled up to pay for my order, I was shocked to see the staff member taking my payment was only wearing her mask half-on. Her nose was completely exposed, and it was barely covering her mouth. Given the extremely high Covid-19 numbers in the state right now, this is extremely concerning - especially by the staff member who deals directly with customers all day long. 

The second issue I had was how long it took to get my order and general customer service. From when the order was placed until I pulled up to the window took much longer than normal, even though it appeared the people in the cars in front of me had small orders (I didn't see them receiving tons of cups, just 1-2). There were at least two staff members preparing orders behind the counter (in addition to the one at the drive-through window), and they both seemed to be hustling. I'm not sure how many customers were inside, so they may have needed more help. It was the half-masked woman handling the drive-through who was moving slowly. I saw my drink prepared and set it down for her to pick up - she only needed to grab it and hand it to me. However, it sat there...and sat there... she took more orders from the drive-through... moved around a bit... then finally picked it up and handed it to me - almost like she forgot I was sitting there. 

The drink was perfectly prepared and tasted great (as always), but was dripping all over when it was handed to me. I had to ask for napkins, and the woman seemed irritated that I asked (even though it was obvious I needed at least one to clean up the cup). I had also ordered a cheese & fruit box, and would normally receive napkins with any food order from Starbucks. It may seem like something really little to complain about, but when your drink is dripping on you and in your car, napkins are pretty important. 

The food and drink I ordered would get 5 stars, but the service was more like 2, so I can only give them 3 stars overall for this visit.
they are RUDE 3/4 of the time if they even stirred your drink but hey $7 for a latte what else should i expect?

The slowest Starbucks I have ever been too. Always "out of stock" on non seasonal items. I have given this store 5 chances. I go one time a week and all 5 times awful experience. Drinks are made incorrectly. Ice to drink ratio totally off. Drive through is a total of 25 min wait when I'm the 6th car inline? 25 min!? I will not be returning.
It's realllllly unfortunate to have to wait 20 mins just to get our coffee then come home  and give my husband his coffee and they forgot to add sweet cream   To his cold nitro come on now Starbucks

I come to this Starbucks every so often, and that is for good reason. Not once have I come here and actually been greater by a single person. I get to the ordering menu, the same monotone (I cant be bothered with you) voice answers. I feel like I'm burdening them by being there. I order two things every time, I get to the window, one is ready and the other is forgotten. No a smile or a "hi". The only thing that is said to me is "$5.41". I show them my rewards app, she scans it, hands me my one item, starts taking someone else's order, then closes the window. I don't even go back for that second item out of fear that she'll punch me in the face for wanting anything else. I don't write reviews, but I've been coming here for two years and SOMETHING has to change. It's ridiculous that I go five miles out of my way to avoid this location.
The staff was really nice but I waited 25 minutes for my drink that was made wrong so I didn't even have time to get them to fix it bc I spent my whole break here.

Woke up early Thanksgiving morning and headed out to a local coffee shop near our vacation spot only to find it closed. I ended up at this Starbucks location and let me tell you, the crew working in there that morning was simply incredible. They went above and beyond. Everyone seemed truly happy to be at work and interacted attentively with each customer. My visit made me wish this was my local Starbucks!

We've frequented this Starbucks for over two years and never has the parking been worse. Construction all around and some popular Asian delicacies have the little mall a-buzzing. Not Starbucks' fault. Just fair warning.

They still mix wonderful concoctions. They still have Smitty (who knows all things Starbucks). Don't order off the simple-limited menu. Tell Smitty what turns you on and watch the master go to work. 

For the first time we had dinner here. Well, it was a Spinach and Feta Wrap that they heated in a small oven. I really enjoyed this wrap and will try it again. The price was right. Free. We are here so often we signed up for the rewards program. I figure every dozen or so Tall drinks equals one free loaded Venti in this case, dinner.

I have always walked into this location around 5:15-530am just like everyone else this morning shouldn't have been any different but it was. The two female employees were complaining about how I was able to come in early it looked like they had a ways to go before they could open. They were really rude and if they are working I will refuse to get coffee from them. Why is everyone else able to open the store early and have a few customers but they are not ?

This Starbucks will make you late for work!  I've spent as long as 20 min waiting in the drivethru.  I even tried going inside since there weren't too many people.  I walked right up and ordered and it still took 15 min.
Leave yourself plenty of time or find another Starbucks.
They were friendly. Went through the drive through to do our pickup. Love my morning Starbucks.

The drive through here is horrible! It never fails to frustrate and make me wait forever! I would rather get out of my car and go inside because I know my drink will be made right and not take 10 minutes.

Used to be a great location to come anytime to study - service was great and atmosphere was enjoyable. Not sure what happened because on what you think would be an easy Friday morning at the coffee shop, there is no music in the store, the employees' conversation from behind the counter fills the whole place instead, and they're mopping at lunchtime! Time for a change. #makestarbucksgreatagain

Not sure if it's because this Starbucks is located in a hotel, but it's not the best. The line is very long around check-out time and there is no mobile ordering available. The had 2 registers to order at, however there was only 1 cashier working making the line snake around the store. Their system was also down, so I wasn't able to pay with my Starbucks card. I would probably go a block down if you can for quicker service.

There's almost always a long line at this starbucks and it is usually packed. Because it is so packed, it is not the cleanest or neatest.
In terms of drinks, they are usually good and consistent. Service is typically friendly. Sometimes there is a bit of a long wait for your drink.

This is my morning go to coffee spot before the gym! Absolutely love James, he always has great customer service! However, the past few times I've been my coffee is half full! I always order a grande and it feels so light. I didn't take a single sip from this coffee and finally checked it this time. I don't want to sound rude at the drive thru asking for it to be a full cup  like I know there's space for whip, but my goodness!
I don't know why I keep doing this to myself. This has got to be the worst and slowest Starbucks in the city. These so called baristas need more training.

The cashier was very rude, he told me they didn't have something that they just served another customer. He would not suggest something different.  I ordered a Venti he gave me a grande he put his grimy hands all around the rim of my cup. All of the associates there were more concerned about their text messages on their phone then the work they should be doing for the customer. I have been a Starbucks member for numerous years, The service I received was totally unacceptable and once again RUDE. Don't spend your money at this mall Starbucks.

Starbucks drinks are always my favorite.  Normally the workers are a little stuck up but I go the extra mile out of my daily commute to come to this one! Rob is my favorite,  he slides that window open with a smile and is the sweetest  best starbucks in town

If I could give it 0 stars I would. The employee at the drive through window was extremely unfriendly. Not at all a good experience. I won't be returning to this location. I'll buy my $5+ coffees somewhere else where customers are treated kindly.

Dear Starbucks on Pater and McCarran..... we ordered two cold drinks. Paid for them.... and then waited 45 minutes to receive them.  Wtf?!?! No apology, no refund, no up sizing the drinks and no "thank you."  Never coming back again.

Surprisingly the store is actually pretty big. I love that they keep the restrooms locked but also very nice tidy neat and clean. Their staff are very friendly and patient. I love that the customers are also patient in return considering we all still have to mind the covid 19 health measures. My order was taken very easily and payment method was my Starbucks app on my phone. I had no problems. My order was made quickly and correctly. The only thing that was a little confusing for the staff was that I had ordered a drink that typically came with black tea but instead I requested their passion tea or passion tango tea. No matter, they were able to figure it out and make my drink very quickly. Delicious.

Last Tuesday morning, I went through the drive-thru to grab something before work. I ordered a vanilla bean cold brew and pumpkin scone. Drink was made perfectly and the woman at the window was friendly. The car line was long, but moved quickly despite that; it was about a 15-20 minute wait. I would come back again.

I would give this location 5 stars if it weren't for the awful parking lot.  Seriously don't know why this site was chosen to open up a store, I'm sure Starbucks has missed out on a ton of business just from people not being able to park and come in.  (I've done it myself many times.)

If you *can* get a parking spot, this place is wonderful.  My favorite baristas of all the Starbucks I've ever gone to -- friendly and fun, they make the atmosphere almost into a party.  They always make my day when I come here.  Extra bonus for all the power outlets available -- I didn't realize it until today, but the countertop along the windows has power outlets underneath it, one for every single seat.  AWESOME.

I work right around the corner, so i am always going to this Starbucks. Today was the day that made me want to write a bad yelp review. Around 1:30pm went in the drive thru, backed up. took almost 30 mins. I was locked in otherwise i would have backed out and went to pjs. I had to repeat my order 3 times. Grande coffee w/ soy. it shouldn't be that difficult? got my coffee and it was wrong. this happens more than it should. the baristas at the drive thru are never smiling. I will continue going to this Starbucks in hopes they get my coffee with soy right one day... and for the convenience!
slowest starbucks i've ever been too. i've been waiting in the drive thru for over 45 minutes and they mess up everyone's orders constantly

Drive through or walk up only.  Staff is very friendly.  The lines can get long and it gets crowded as there is not a lot of real estate for cars to line up.  However, service seems to move quickly and one can always park and walk up. 

Never an issue with the order. Enjoy the convenience and the drive through.

Ordered from the app, for pick-up. Waited a long time but no order showed up...the clerk admitted they could not find the order. Meanwhile, during my long wait, it was hectic, chaotic. The pick up orders were laid out with little notice, people had to constantly look for their order, the cups were poorly labeled, each person had to pick up each cup and pull down the cardboard sleeves that covered the drink name. Really!!!! You can't put the label in a more obvious place so 10 people don't handle my drink before I do??? But you want us to wear masks?!? The restaurant was sloppy, loud, tables had debris or liquid on them. The floors were cluttered with debris. Maybe they were understaffed? 
It was just a bad experience, no employee/customer interaction. It seemed that no one cared and they were all rushing around. Overall, it was a bad experience but I hope the employees can find a reason to feel joy in their crazy, chaotic work pace.

This is not how you mix ICE GREEN TEA LATTE. 
Also your ATTITUDE is definitely not matching with the Starbuck's culture.

I've been searching for a Starbucks on Chinden Boulevard for quite a few years, always assuming I had to drive down Eagle Rd to find one. This time I decided to look on the map and to my surprise I found it hanging out on the intersection of Chinden and Eagle Rd. 

This Starbucks has a drive thru that is easy in & out, particularly if you are driving east on Chinden. Super, super efficient, the longest I've had to wait is about 4 minutes on a Monday morning.

Inside, the store still has the brand new feel, with great looking furniture. We are always able to order quickly and get our drinks after a very short wait. Because I order long shots, I always expect a longer wait because a well poured long shot takes time to be perfect. Every time, my order is just right.

You shouldn't have trouble finding a seat here except on a busy morning.

This is the Starbucks located in the lobby of the hotel we were staying at for our annual convention.  It has a large seating area in the back with many tables for meetings or just comfy chairs to sit in.  During my convention, I would duck down here to use their wifi and get some work done while I was on lunch break.  This place has the same great drinks that you have grown to love and expect from a Starbucks.  
Everytime I came in here the place was spotless and the staff was extremely helpful and friendly.  They even remembered me from the days prior.  It was very welcoming.

Staff is always very nice here. Got out and got me a strawberry Açaí refresher which was suppppppper delicious and it was based off a recommendation from the staff! Sooo tasty! I needed a little pick me up but didn't want coffee so that was a nice change. This place is always super busy and they have a drive thru which is great! Especially if ya have kids and you need that treat!

Jilliana was not very friendly- first I waited at the drive-theu window for 5 minutes and she never opened the slider to acknowledge me.  When she did, it was 8 minutes past when my mobile order should be ready and she said "what's your name?".  I had told her my name in the drive-thru 6-7 min prior and I was the only car there.  They hadn't even started my order.  They didn't have the syrup, despite the app showing it as available.  After selecting an alternative, she made my drink.  When delivering it to me, she never apologized for the delay or so much as smiled.

This has the be the worst Starbucks. I live right here and always mobile order, but lately the app ALWAYS says literally everything is out but when you go they don't know why because it's not out. I had to start mobile ordering the second I woke in the morning for it to be ready in time because even mobile ordering it's never ready at the time it's supposed to be ready. I used to mobile order about 5 minutes before I'd walk out and it's 10 minutes from my house, say I order at 6:45 it'll say ready for pick up at 6:55 I get there for 7 and it's still not ready and I end up waiting another 15+ minutes sometimes my order gets lost, I've had to cancel my order so many times because of almost being late for work EVEN THOUGH i ordered SO early and made sure I had enough time.
The first few times it's ok but it started happening EVERY TIME and I wake up so early for work that it's not usually busy when I go.

My drinks never consistent- I order the same thing ever time and a few times it was either not full to the top like it usually is or ALLLLLLLLL half and half no coffee what so ever. The lady even noticed it before I did once & offered to make me a new one bc she knows my order, I never see her anymore   I now go to the one on vets and it's been SUCH a change- the same drink that I've ordered for a year consistently tastes and looks SOOOOOOO much different at the vets store, it's perfect every time. It's ALWAYS there when I get there I walk in and walk straight out even if I ordered as I'm leaving my house. I've never had any issues with the app saying items were out when they weren't. Even when they were extremely busy once my drink was still ready when I got there- I don't know who manages the chateau Starbucks but it needs new management bad.

By far the WORST STARBUCKS maybe in the entire state of PA. Not sure how this places stays open the way it's running. Every single time I go here you wait no less than a full 10-15 minutes for your drink and today she hands me the wrong drink after waiting 15 minutes and she just laughs about it. This place is a twilight zone.

I'm a SB fan through and through so I don't have any criticism about their coffee/prices/etc--it is what it is! However, I have noted subtle differences amongst the Nola locations. This particular location is quite convenient for me in terms of distance from my home but the parking sucks. I've been able to snag the one non-handicap position outside the building a few times and attribute that to God smiling down on me. 

It's not my favorite study spot because it is quite small and therefore gets quite loud; it is also a Tulane off campus coffee headquarters so you're bound to see someone you know (which can be a good/bad thing). Personally, I frequent this location more as a hangout spot with friends but there have been a few times where I run in to grab a cup before the start of a jam packed day--sometimes the wait is a tad long but that's kinda typical of SB.  When the weather is nice, I like sitting outside in their covered porch.

I don't mind a trip to this SBux at all. The staff is always super friendly and totally fast at making my drinks. They call me by my name which might seem cheesy but it's a nice touch, and makes my overall experience feel more personalized. I love the little sketch of the new Sbux "coming soon" to Forest Park & Grand that they have on the wall (the old Del Taco) which I thought was cute. The cake pops are always fresh, and the coffee is never stale or burnt tasting. It's conveniently located near a bunch of different places I frequent off of Olive Blvd. (mostly doctor offices) so yay for good location and stress-free parking, although the lot is somewhat small, I have never had issues parking there.

Today I was reminded yet again, why I stopped going to this Starbucks. Call me optimistic, but I thought I'd give it a second chance. The parking lot is extremely small and crowded even though they "added" some extra spots. The only parking that was available today was in the 15 minute parking spots. Some other patrons and I were asked to move our cars from these spots so that others could park there. I don't mind moving my car but there were no other places to go. And the Starbucks employee was somewhat rude about it. PLEASE do yourself a favor. If you're in Jenkintown and you really want a cup of Starbucks coffee, just visit the Barnes & Noble across the street. Save yourself the time and stress.

Some of the most disorganized service I've ever seen. The hot chocolate I ordered was disgusting. It was watery and had an after taste. The breakfast sandwich was Luke warm. Not the Starbucks experience I'm used to.

Nice little Starbucks with local architectural flavor. not the best location if you're driving, and there's no parking on the street. A few blocks away is a brand-new Starbucks with a parking lot. Service was fast and friendly. Bathroom was clean.

This location took forever to serve a cold nitro brew, which I don't understand since all they have to do is to pour it.  This should not have to wait for the barista.  The guy who took the order should be able to get this rather then stock shelves as he did.  Then when we got on the road I found that it wasn't even cold but warm, which is pretty disgusting.  $5 for a small warm coffee that is supposed to be cold.

The barista was so nice and helped to suggest a different drink after the pumpkin coldbrew was out of season. She wasn't at all bothered when I had a specific question about the rewards. Definitely come inside for a calm environment and a good place to work or chat.

I had one previous bad experience here and chose to ignore it, as I understand times are difficult during Covid. 
Now, I gave them a second chance and went in with a friend and ordered two drinks, one of which was a pike place coffee with sweet cream. 
Ms Shay, the barista, calls out "Monse, mone, whatever your name is" and I figured it was me, since my name is Monse. Thought that was rude, but whatever, I'm used to my name not being called out correctly. We wait a few more minutes and I go up and say "excuse me" and she ignores me. I want til she comes back again to call out another drink and I then ask her if I'm suppose to wait here for the pike place or if I should have gotten it at the register when ordered. She looks at me like I just inconvenienced her and asks me what I ordered. I told her again what I ordered and she walks away. I wasn't sure if she was grabbing my second drink but she goes and makes sure I wasn't lying by checking the computer and then proceeds to drop off a drink on the counter and call the precious persons drink still on the counter. I wait a minute and my friend and I go up and ask her if that's our drink and she says "yes" and we grab and walk away. I turn back and she rolls her eyes and nods her head. 
If this girl doesn't want to work customer service, she probably shouldn't be working at a high pace company where people have the pickiest orders (even tho ours were pretty simple). Again, I understand they were busy, but that attitude and poor customer service is just not okay.

This place is HUUUUUUUUGE!!!! There is so much seating, they should just set up a projector and screen some blockbusters! Not only is there a ton of seating, it comes in all different types: round, four person tables; longer tables with power outlets; solo chairs with footrests; booths along the walls; and backless, puffier, ottoman-like chairs. 

The area with the solo chairs is slightly removed from the rest of the store, so you can get your introvert on! Grab that prime seating behind the merch shelf and get some work done!

The staff was super friendly. The barista did make my flat white a grande instead of venti, but he fixed it in no time and gave me the messed up drink as well. I LOVE when they do that instead of throwing it away!

This place is going to be a local haunt for me for sure. I hope it stays this great as it gets older!

I come here a lot. A LOT! Usually multiple time per week, I have amassed a collection of 10 personal cups and counting, and have earned more "stars" than I really need. Which means I spend quite a bit of money here. I also work across the street and have for over five years, which means I have been coming here for five years. I also live the area so I frequently choose this location to do personal work as well.

Honestly, it's a 50/50.

Today's incident aside, you may or may not get friendly service. There is one guy who will hardly acknowledge my existence. However, the lady at the register knows me and my order very well, as do a couple others, and always greet me warmly. Some of the baristas make my order correctly every time, some do not. One girl in particular, who usually  works drive through can N.E.V.E.R. get it correct. If she is at the helm, my friend won't even bother, he just gets tea! I will absolutely sing the praises of some of the staff.

Communication isn't the best between the employees or with customers at times. The seating has been bunk since the remodel. Gone are the comfy chairs, replaced with small tables and a bench, obviously for the study crowd. Plugs are a hit and miss on whether they work and some are protruding from the wall or sitting on the floor. Wi-Fi works well.

The ladies bathroom is a frequent mess with TP on the floor and almost always dangerously low. There is a bit of a stuffy "I'm always being used for a #2" odor and no paper towels to dry hands, just blowers. Seriously, look up the health info of hand dryers. The air they are blowing onto your hands is the very particle laden, odoriferous air you are breathing and flushing into. :\

If you like it cold this is the place to be! I frequently find my hands and feet going numb, winter or summer and have even resorted to purchasing a HEATED MOUSE to try and stave off the cold of my mousing hand. Great investment, btw. I also frequently wear warm hats, sweaters, hoodies, etc to keep my body temperature up. Winter or summer. All. The. Time.

tl;dr: long time customer, big spender, overall experience is a resounding MEH.

25 min wait for 1 latte with no special instructions. Just right off the menu. Way too long and no apology for the wait. I love me some Starbucks but man it's not worth that wait... it's supposed to be fast food.

I think hard before giving any business less than 4 stars during Covid-19 even chains. I certainly do not like to complain during these tough times. Again, I don't want to give any less than 4 stars unless the food/drink isn't good and it's pricey. 

I was so happy I can still get my veins pumped with coffee. I fell in love with a Caramel Macchiato that included .5 pump Caramel & light ice. The Caramel syrup is a nice touch in my opinion. The drink also includes vanilla syrup, too. 

When I went through the driveway, the person taking my order was patient as I deliberated between a coffee or a venti tea. I went with coffee because I needed the caffeine boost. When I went to pay, it was a seamless process. I use the app. To rack up points to redeem for the future. They also give away a FREE drink during your Bday, so I redeemed mine today. A couple days ago, a patron paid for my drink at a different Starbs location, so THANK YOU! 

The Barista was wearing a mask to protect herself and others at this time - very commendable! If you dine inside, stay 6 ft. apart.

Thank you so much, Starbs, for always being there for me during these really, really hard times. I looove you! 

XOXO,

Joy X.

This Starbucks is located along busy Main Street. Parking is a little sparse but it shouldn't be a problem. I am in and out of a lot of Starbucks locations throughout the area to get work done and this one isn't a bad one at all. It is very spacious and comfortable. It is also very clean.

The baristas here are also very warm and personable! In spite of the afternoon rush they still managed to make me feel like a valued patron.
Sat down to a nice pumpkin scone with mold on it and hair. And bit into it before I saw. What a day

When I'm driving on the 101, this is our stop to make to stretch the legs, use el baño, and get a drink.  It's more about the strategic location than the actual location.

It's usually dirty on the floor, the service is at a minimum, and it is average on speed.

Too bad it's not known for the better! I hope they raise the bar soon.  This does not mean that the employees don't care (who knows? only they do) but it does mean that it is sorely lacking when it comes to other more cheerful and clean Starbucks.

Why can't they have the inside open to pick up mobile orders at least.  I get the employee shortage reason for closing but this is INSANE to wait in a jammed packed drive thru to simply grab a mobile order.  Many times it's cold by the time the line moves too.  What the heck is going on!!

This by far is the worst Starbucks. I just waited 15 min inside for my coffee to be told I still had 10 people in front of me. Always slow but this was crazy!! Drive thru is even worse. They need to either hire more people or learn to work better.

Out of the 3 locations I frequently visit, this is the only one I ever have an issue with. This time I waited 20+ minutes for one drink and it wasn't even busy. after the 15 minute mark I asked one worker if my drink was coming up and she told me it was next. Another minute or two goes by and the man who rang me up asked if I was still waiting and I told him yes. He looks and says someone must have given it to the wrong person. It took him all of 30sec to make it and I was out the door. The two female workers were complaining about being short staffed and such. Not only did they give away my drink but then the one lied about it being next. I work in the restaurant industry and this was not the way to handle the situation.
One of the more poorly managed locations in the area - staff wasn't particularly helpful and borderline unfriendly.  It also took a very long time for a simple cold brew.

Went to this location today, they made my coffee wrong. Easy mistake, but when I asked for it to be made correctly, I received lots of attitude. I was asked to try the incorrect drink, which burnt my tongue. 

If I'm going to pay six dollars for a cup of coffee, I think it's understandable that I get what I ordered! 

This location is very convenient, but I'm going to go out of my way to not be a customer.

I was shocked that outdoor tables were so dirty. First of all this is Starbucks and I thought they had a better reputation and secondly this is Covid season and these tables should be cleaned for health reasons especially! The Staff seemed busy and competent, but what is the point if I catch a disease. So disappointed!

If Starbucks has got to be the absolute worst Starbucks in our city. I ordered the same basic drink every day from which ever area in Reno I am working in and this particular Starbucks charges me anywhere between $4.04 to $5.38 for the exact same drink that every other Starbucks charges $3.03 for.  She brings it up as a completely different drink but when I try to tell her about this she insists that she is the only person in Reno that does it the right way.  There is only one lady at this particular store said she is a manager that does this. Today she added a shot of Hazelnut which was not even in my drink order and I am allergic to.  If I wasn't running late to work because I sat and wasted so much time listening to her nonsense the explanation I would've had them make me a new drink but instead I'm just out $5.38. Awful service. Awful manager. Don't go here.

The baristas here are OUTSTANDING! They're friendly and make grabbing coffee here very pleasant. And yet the parking is so atrociously awful I often drive to this location, see that there is no parking, and then head somewhere else for coffee. There is no place to wait for a spot, and I've even been double parked into a spot before. It's just a disaster

I don't understand why the reviews are not high at this Starbucks location.

I am always treated like a guest, they make my drinks to perfection. No complains 

Location is always clean and yes this is a busy one being right inside Macy's. 

You will not have a person smile everyday but I will say I'm usually greeted with a smile here. 

And the manager is always on top of things, for what ever reason my Starbucks card would not swipe and accept my point, he took care of the situation fast.

Service sucks, came here multiple times and was constantly disappointed. This time the lady seemed to get frustrated with me because of how I was  pronouncing the word "acai". She bluntly corrected me which was annoying. At least be nice about it. Another time, i got an iced caramel macchiato. It was absolutely horrible. The barista probably was drizzling the caramel in my drink for a good 15 seconds. I would sip clumps of caramel....it was so bad

I went there and ordered a grande iced cloud caramel macchiato. Then, the lid wasn't closed completely, so all the coffee poured into my WHITE hoodie. However, I couldn't use the bathroom at that time because of some problems. I told an employee who works there and her attitude was unacceptable. She didn't say sorry, all she said was " If u want, I can make u a new one" with a disrespectful tone of voice. In addition, she gave me a ton of napkins. Could I clean these stains only with napkins? I don't wanna think this way but were they racist me cause I'm Asian? That was my first and also last time there. What a bad experience!

Food/Service: 4 stars

Location/Building: 3 stars

Not your typical Starbucks.  Perfect for those wanting to grab something and be on their way, but not ideal for those planning to work, study, or hang out with friends.

This location is drive through or walk up service only.  There is a very small outdoor seating section.

The drive through wasn't super busy when I arrived, but it was still extremely tight and congested.  I cannot imagine what it might be like during rush hour.  

The service was fast, friendly, and accurate.  I had a little issue with my Starbucks card, along with a bit of confusion from the cashier with how to process the order, but it was quickly resolved.
Waited over 30 mins in drive thru. Slowest service EVERRRRRR! If you're in a rush stay away from here.

The partner that just got off work ordered five drinks thus causing a already slow team to slow down even further. They first made my hot latte that I ordered cold. I placed my mobile order at 4:28 and I have been waiting til now for my mobile order (the time is 5:08.) They need to get a grip.

I am a regular at Starbucks.  5 days a week I was going for my morning breve latte, that's about $5.25 a day, times 4 weeks, that's  $105. a month.  And However, if my husband and grandkids are with me it is much more as they usually want something to eat and often times a thermos and reuseable to go cup! Recently, I went in and upon ordering my coffee I discovered it was twice the usual price.  When I questioned the person behind the counter about this I was told "yes prices had increased", "by double?" I inquired (almost just paying it).  When another employee looked at the register and asked if I ordered one or two?  I said one.  He realized I'd been charged twice.  He apologized explaining the girl on register was brand new.  No worries.  We are all new employees at one time or another in our lives and mistakes are made, and then easily rectified.   I was told by this young gentleman that they made the correction (although I was never given a receipt; my mistake but I have literally been coming here for 6 years and didn't think it necessary).  When I arrived home later that day I was on line with my bank checking my deductions when I noticed that yes, Starbucks had charged me double, and then took it off.  However, I noticed that they than charged me twice for the same drink showing two separate transactions.   Again, knowing the girl at the register to be new I realized she simply made another error.  I decided I would call Starbucks to see what they could do about it.  I spoke to "Danni", whom I assumed to be a young manager.  I explained to her what happened.  She remembered me, as I said, I'm in there a lot.  She told me to simply come back when she was on duty and she would give me my next coffee making up the difference.  I told her that would be fine.  However, when I went back she wasn't there.  I explained to the cashier what happened and she told me to wait for Danni to come back in.  So I did.  Today Danni was in.  I went up to the counter and brought to her memory what had happened.  However, on this occasion she told me I needed to prove it with my bank statement.  Now I'm standing there feeling embarrassed asking for a refund for one cup of joe, while at the same time being looked at and spoken to as if I was just trying to get a free coffee.  Someone needs to speak to these young people about customer service, especially the regulars.  Not only did I spend what I believe was a nice amount of money on coffee and other items per month but I was also a generous tipper.  The only person whom I ever met at this location who knew anything about customer service was the night "Brandon" who has worked there for quite some time.  He is simply heavenly to deal with and knows the value of a repeat customer who has been nothing but kind and understanding towards your staff.   I am not saying I'll never be back but it might take a while for the sting to subside.  I'll also insist upon a receipt each and every time.  If you can't trust me why should I trust you?  Receipts should be mandatory, not asked "do you want a receipt" , if you are going to treat your customers this way. Today my star rating is going to be very low.

The interior was recently redone and all was clean. I have no issues with the service.  I ordered hot decaf and they had a pump carafe with enough for my venti.

My issue is with the WiFi.  When they first opened it was "Starbucks" WiFi.  Granted, it may have been routed through the Hilton router, but it was fast. I have no less than five Starbucks within walking distance so I rotate.  Last week I went to do some work at this location and the speed was unusable. No signon so it might now just be on the hotel lobby router.  I asked the manager if something can be done and was told that the WiFi is provided by the hotel.  I went to the front desk and was told the WiFi was provided by Starbucks, but he would let engineering know.  It did not improve.  YMMV.

I came here on a Friday afternoon when no one else was in the drive thru. I ordered a matcha latte which was good but it's pretty hard to mess those up. The girl had to ask me to repeat my order since she was laughing with another girl over the drive thru while I was trying to order. I was a little annoyed but they got my drink out fast and got me on my way.
Literally one of the worst Starbucks ever. 2 stars only because it's busy but that's no excuse for consistently getting people's orders wrong.

This store is Absolutely FILTHY!!! 
Floors, tables every surface looks like it has not been cleaned in a very long time. The tables are sticky, crumbs every where, small coffee spills.  I am shocked as I have NEVER been in a dirty Starbucks.

Skip this store if you can - and have another store on your drive - otherwise double check your order before driving off as I've found order error high.

This has been a great store in the past - with friendly service and a strong desire to get it right. Staff (in the past) would great you by name and even offer suggestions on something to try when I would sit in. I trust they get it right side up - as it has a great location.

Today I get 3 shots of espresso in my Americano Verses 4, poured milk into the half-and-half creamer, and warm Verses hot water. Luke warm - week coffee is the worst! And I did not realize just how far a friendly hello from a familiar face goes in feeling welcome. But the turnover is such that I rarely see the same person week over week in the past year. It has never been this bad

But I will check into Yelp and will be glad to give them another chance once they start delivering the cup of coffee that was ordered - and turnover slows down.
Great location.  The outdoor seating area is right next to Sprouts.  Perfect for coffee and a snack.  Drive thru is consistently quick even with 10+ cars in line.

The product is great - but the store is very dirty and the parking situation is always frustrating.  Many times I have gone out of my way to stop in only to find no parking!  Please move to a different location!  Your sales will soar!  (especially if you clean up the place!)

Wow! Some of the most unengaged and self absorbed staff I've ever seen at a Starbucks in my life! And, that's been awhile. 

They'd rather play "where am I going tonight" than help someone looking for serious caffeine.

Oh, and that lack of attention shows in the bathroom facilities.  I mean, beyond... 

I'll tell you that my mochas were perfect though.  But, I attribute that more to my suggestion of adding two mocha shots. It almost made me wish they were automatons, programmed to give a shit about the only customer in line waiting for someone to acknowledge them.

Signed, 
Not All Starbucks Are The Same

Update: does anyone at Starbucks even read these reviews or care? I now have an infant and this is the only Starbucks with a drive thru that's remotely close to me, so unfortunately I've been back. I still don't go often, but unless you have at least 30 mins to spare don't even bother. I've gone with literally an extra 20 mins and had to bail before ordering. When I worked at Starbucks years ago we had company wide standards about drive thru wait times and would start comping drinks at something like 4 mins. As in 4 mins was TOO LONG. Lol. That sounds like a pipe dream now. 

Worst Starbucks I've ever been to. They are beyond slow, regularly understaffed, mistakes on drink orders are common and they run out of products often (so whoever does their ordering doesn't have a good grasp on how much they'll need). This location is convenient for me, which is why I've gone several times, but I've honestly never had a fantastic experience so I now avoid tif at all possible.

This is not a review of the employees at this location, but of Starbucks' refill policy. The employees are always friendly and I like seeing them in the mornings. I'm sorry that this reflects on them, but the refill policy sucks that badly that I have to review my experience of Starbucks -which is what this review is about. They only give you the refill price if you stay there the whole time. 

I work night shift and I can't stay there, I just need the caffeine and if I come back 4 hours later (while working a double shift), I should be able to get the refill price. I'm happy to show them that I already bought a coffee earlier that day by opening the app to show the history, but I hope when the marketing team looks at this they see that they need to revise their policy for people who can't stay in the store. I don't plan on coming back after I go through my remaining balance.

My favorite Starbucks I come here every Sunday to read Sunday nytimes . I love the coffee and frappucinos . The service is first class all the way. They also have outdoor seating , I love their sofa chairs . The best thing about this Starbucks is they have 2bathrooms .

Two baristas didn't know how many pumps of sweetener went into a Trenta iced coffee.  I was charged extra for the standard pumps of sweetener.  Keep an eye on your drink as it's being made.  I get the feeling they are trying to short the customer.

While there are better Starbucks in the world this one downtown has everything you could want and more. The staff is friendly and quick at making your drink. Beware, it can get pretty busy at certain times of day but that's also part of the fun of going sometimes.

Parking will probably never get much better even though another structure is being erected across the road. Get here at 6:00 pm and  witness Eddie walking his chihuahua, Princess. We ice skate a couple blocks away and walk over for something warm and often have a rap with these legends. 

Evening is a great time to visit; Especially if Sav, Molly, Reagan or Erica is here. They're all very friendly, quick and helpful. 12/19

Inside the Hilton @ the Ballpark:

  Yesterday when I wrote my St. Louis Art Museum review, it was a struggle with the Yelp character limit. This will not be the case with this one.

 The Hilton @ the Ballpark is one of four Starbuck's currently in downtown St. Louis. Being that we spent hours in downtown we took a breather here on two locations.

  This Hilton-owned Starbucks is a hop and a skip from Busch Stadium, Ballpark Village, the Old Courthouse, and Gateway Arch. As a matter of fact, if you were staying in a hotel room several levels above Starbuck's, you could take in the action of the Cardinals game.

 Inside a hotel that includes Ballpark in its name, it celebrates the St. Louis Cardinals and the Arch. Approaching it walking north from the northwest corner of 4th and Chestnut Streets, there is an Arch decorated with the St. Louis Cardinals with the illusion that the nearby Starbuck's mermaid is hanging from it. Only a few feet at the southeast corner of the Hilton is the Starbuck's.

  This is a decent size Starbuck's with the customary Starbuck's furniture and a Hilton gift shop. The seating arrangement transitions from comfortable Starbuck's style seating to grand Hilton style couches near a fireplace in the adjacent hotel lobby. The majority of our time perking up with Starbuck's coffee was in the comfortable Hilton lobby. As a bonus, they provide complimentary water with lemon. The few minutes that I spent in the Starbuck's proper was at the wide table while charging up my phone.

   Being that it is a Hilton-owned location, I would expect higher prices. Contrary to my expectations their prices are competitive to company-owned locations. Along with the fair prices was good customer service. Apparently there was an error with our order, and the friendly Barista passed over charging us for the Coffee she had originally left out.

  As promised in the beginning of the review, it was not going to face the Yelp character limit. With that said, this is all I have to write about our experiences at the Hilton @ the Ballpark Starbuck's.

not so good experience. i waited a long time in the drive through. the lady that took my order sounded annoyed that i didn't know starbucks terminology. i asked for my drink to have extra cream and sugar, and an extra shot of espresso in it. at the window i overheard her say to her coworker "wait that was supposed to to have an extra shot of espresso. oh well". and she gave me my drink. i know what i heard, so i asked her if it has extra espresso in it. she hesitantly said yes. also, i asked for extra sugar, and in return got no sugar. there was no way i was waiting in that line again so i had to take the bad coffee and go.
I really enjoy this Starbucks because the staff is so nice and I don't have to worry about my drink being wrong! I've noticed with this one that when the line is long they still are pretty quick!

The drinks are hit and miss, I know the machines are automatic but it really does depend who assembles it. The staff is all super friendly, they know what I want before I open my mouth and somehow keep up with my life, I don't know how they do it! The store has recently been updated and looks great! Its defiantly a worth while stop in the morning!

I very rarely ever walk into a Starbucks, but I received gift card for my bday and thought I'd take my wife here so she could be something instead.  She had her coffee drink and I had a chocolate croissant (which was yummy I must add).

I do like the fact that they have free wifi, that's a plus, especially when you're sitting around waiting for someone else to drink their coffee and you just order water.

*** I just wanted to disclose up front that this review does not reflect on the service experience that I had at this location but specifically with the new corporate philosophy.  The people that were working were friendly, professional and fast. ***

Bottom Line:  Starbucks used to be an inviting and comfortable place to spent too much money on coffee.  Now it just looks like someone running a Subway is confused and forgot what they were doing.

My wife is obsessed with coffee.  She has the Starbucks account and is constantly using the app to get coffee.  She also buys the Starbucks bulk coffee from the supermarket.

Since we have two kids, we pretty rarely get out for a date night but when we do we always seem to end up at a Starbucks after dinner to sip coffee and attempt to have a calm conversation with just the two of us.

I like supporting local business, I dont like coffee, I and really don't like coffee culture so generally I'm uncomfortable at Starbucks locations but there's always been a vibe and ambiance that was attractive enough that I ended up not really minding being in one of these places.

Well, the last time we went I was really surprised to see that there were no couches, no easy chairs - just wooded chairs in a room like a classroom or a cafeteria in a Hospital. 

If I wanted to sit in uncomfortable chairs and get overcharged for stuff that I dont want, I can just as easily go back to Dodger stadium but then I would have to listen to Dodger fans talk about baseball - so that's right out.

We ordered coffee and tea and few sweets and went to sit down.  Wife liked the coffee and the tea was fine... its tea.... pretty hard to mess up hot water and a bag.

What I was most surprised about after there not being any place comfortable to sit (and little to no ambiance) was the waste.  Just for those two drinks we had three cups, two sleeves, two stoppers, napkins..... for two drinks!  Why cant they have mugs for people who are having coffee in the shop?  Isn't it frowned upon to single use pretty much anything?  I cannot imagine what their trash looks like for one day.

It really felt to me like we were being driven toward the app - get your coffee and leave.  We removed any comfortable place for you to sit, so if you insist on having your coffee here, drink it and leave.

This is pretty disappointing.  The only reason we go here is because there is no local alternative at this hour - which is a shame as I really dont feel welcome here
This is the slowest at Starbucks i have been to. 20 mins for a mobile order is unacceptable. It's a regular occurrence for slow orders at this location. They need a major operational overhaul.

Awful service. The manager is really nice but the crew acts like they hate their life. Drive thru is a miserable experience, sometimes going in helps. B/c it is Starbucks is the only reason they experience sales volume.

This morning was the worst experience that I have ever had at any Starbuck!

Maggie of Harahan
Worst starbucks of them all. Hours are not consistent,  slow on taking orders and preparing everything. Staff us not friendly at all.

This is my second visit to this location and let me say first and foremost new management please. Second, when I see staff twirling around when orders are behind that's a problem. I highly recommend that a system be established so that the bathrooms can only be used by paying customers. Zero star if I could. Short hair girl barista with attitude made my drink wrong. Simple request: no ice! She left her eyes at home without reading drink notes or doesn't like her job. Look how much dragons fruits bits she put for my $5 drink. What a joke!

I had a bad night last night but going to get coffee this morning at this location, they made my morning. Everyone there was so sweet and helpful. I did drive thru and from ordering to receiving my coffee, they make me smile. Plus, they got my mobile order just the right way. Thank you everyone there!
Staff was unfriendly, the drinks were terrible. I spent 5$ on something I couldn't even drink because it was so bad.

My daughter drops me off Monday morning after taking my granddaughter to school and I also come here on Tuesday nights before Bible study at 7:30 at New Testament Christian Church down on Holly Hills and Grand
  Kudos to the Starbucks Partner for the shot of caramel on top of my hot chocolate  For hot beverages I found out the best size of short because it stays hot longer! I slowly sip my hot beverages!!! Any size taller than a short, my beverage gets lukewarm and I do not like lukewarm beverages.  
Just in case you're interested in a Free Family Portrait!

 Come on down after your visit to Starbucks!
Great staff, friendly,  gave me an idea for a fun drinks with every little sugar. Clean seating area and overall relaxing atmosphere.

Parking here can be a little tight if you're coming at prime-coffee-time...but that'll probably be the only issue you encounter. The store is pretty big inside and the employees seem to be adhering to COVID precautions pretty darn well. My drink came just as I expected it to, so overall I left happy and would definitely return.

It's a very old Starbucks, so I wouldn't come in to do work or hang out. But, if you need a pick me up they are fast - too fast they they don't know how to make a double espresso right and are extremely rude or just irritated with rush hour. I will not be back.

I looked at the reviews and I was like hold on let me check this place out with all the bad reviews. Honestly ordered at the DT speaker at 18:46 went to the window at 18:47 and got my drinks at 18:47. Place is fast and friendly.

Truly the slowest Starbucks I have ever gone to. Granted, today was the launch of the holiday menu. However - why is there two team members standing around? I waited over 30 minutes for my mobile order, and when I asked about my drink, I was met with "oh, I'm not sure". It is quite frustrating to be waiting for a drink, and watching two people just stand there, while the two team members making drinks look like they're suffering.

The absolute worst SB in the USA!! Slow slow slow....... and half the time the drinks taste terrible.

Just make sure you have time to wait. And try your drink before pulling away from the window.

Let me just say the staff are all great! Very nice and welcoming! Only negative here is they will take care of drive thru customers and have walk ins Wait a lot longer!!  I had to ask them for my order almost every time I'm there because everyone is attentive to drive thru. Also a customer shouldn't have to wait simply because you are finishing a conversation with another employee

Wonderful location of Starbucks. Friendly staff , consistent drinks, clean lobby and service may be slow at times but staff work with great sense of urgency and awareness. All in all Seattle would be proud.
Nice job! Really appreciated the service and special pour over. My chai tea was perfect as well. Nice to have good service when on a long trip. Thanks so much!

I went here on a whim in between classes today. I had a three hour break and went here just because.

The parking lot was the worst part of the whole experience. This was something I wasn't expecting at all. It was such a let down and I'm thankful I had a few hours to spare. 

The store itself was cozy and the barista seemed friendly enough. The seating inside seemed cramped yet a little roomier than the parking lot. 
I'd go back again if I needed a mid-day pick me up but I'll know what to expect.

They call me Ms. Starbucks!  Okay, just kidding but I do adore my Starbucks!

This location is a medium size - they could definitely use additional space for seating and the parking lot is awkward.

Staff are always friends and turn around is quick.

I came at the beginning of the holiday season after receiving my email advising that the holiday drinks had arrived but they were already out of my desired beverage - Two big thumbs down!  I seriously spent my lunch break driving here from 20 minutes away with a coworker and they were out of Pumpkin Spice :-(

I don't live in this area but I stay in West Chester frequenty for work. This Starbucks location SUCKS! No sense of urgency from the workers here. I've been here numerous times and it takes at least 10 minutes for your coffee to be made. 

Today there was no line, maybe 5 people sitting, 2 workers, and it still took over 10 minutes for a f'n Americano. Let's put a little pep in our step here people.

This is by far the worst Starbucks ever. I normally bypass this location (despite it being the closest) due to their terrible service. Today was no different. I ordered a grande Mocha Latte. It was ready when I got there. Fabulous. I (stupidly) got in my car and drove off. About a mile up the road I pick up my cup and feel like it's a little light. Open the lid...its 3/4 FULL. Look at the photo. I didn't take a SINGLE SIP. Like this is what I'm talking about with this location. Either one of three things is going to happen. 1. You'll wait forever. 2. Your drink will be made wrong (in taste or just a completely different order than what you asked for) 3. You'll pay for a grande and get a tall.

It's a poorly designed (drive thru) and run Starbucks. Because of this they are constantly behind on orders and routinely taken 15-20 minutes per order. They need a new location to cut down on the drive thru bottleneck.

I live about 2 mins from here and every time I come, they have to remake my order. The drinks I order are always very simple and do not stray from the original recipe. They will knowingly hand you a latte with 75% foam or a matcha drink that is basically white because they obviously failed to measure out the correct amount of matcha powder. I've only had a nice employee a handful of times. Majority of their employees are extremely rude and seem very unhappy. Do not waste your money at this starbucks because there is a good chance it will be wasted.

Out of all the Starbucks I go to this one always has cold coffee in the afternoon so if you're looking for coffee I wouldn't go to Starbucks that's kind of silly because I thought that's what they were known for coffee

These people can't get an order right to save their lives!  
I am lactose intolerant, so I get my morning chi tea with soy milk.  I also like it without water, because a watered-down chi is just gross!  So, what have I gotten the past 3 times I've ordered??. A chi latte made with regular milk, and watered down!
I can't understand how the person taking my order can read it back to me and it's correct, but when I get the drink I have to throw it out because it will make me sick (the milk), and it tastes like water.
I stopped going to Starbucks all together now.  I'll give my business to a locally-owned coffee shop instead.

I like to come here once in a while when I'm getting a massage at the salon next door. Nothing hits you like a double espresso after a massage!

But, today, I arrived and found out they removed all the counter stools because it's healthier to stand. I exercise every day and if I want to sit down, I'm going somewhere where they have a chair for me! 

Am I unreasonable!

This is a great Starbucks to go to if you are looking for a spacious area to set up work shop.  The WIFI is pretty good here, I had no issues signing in while I was there.  I really like the big patio too!  

The service here is friendly and fast, plus the drinks are consistent with all other Starbucks.

The staff has always been nice. 

The drinks are made correctly at least 75% of the time.

The drive through has always been crazy busy which is no reflection on the Starbucks itself. It's to be expected often but this location especially is normally quite busy.

We order mobile order ahead and have started going in to pick up our order. It's always ready within about ten minutes from when it's ordered through the app. 

Quick, easy.

The fact that there's people serving food and still don't have their masks covering their face is absolutely absurd. I will never go here again, how dangerous and  disgusting. Total lack of leadership

With Covid-19 I would completely stay away from this location.  They are not easy to do business with.  The inside is closed and the couple ways of ordering a cup of coffee are terrible experiences.

The single drive through wraps around the building, often twice if people can figure out where the line starts.  

When I tried to go inside it is all boxed off and there isn't any easy to read instructions on how to get coffee without getting in the 30 minute drive thru lane.

Mobile ordering isn't easy without better instructions for those who don't frequent Starbucks.  Very confusing.

It's hard to leave bad reviews based off one experience but as I read the other reviews, there seems to be a pattern.  This Starbucks is BEYOND SLOW.  With only 6 cars in the drive thru, we waited over 20 minutes, we waited 7 minutes before we even moved to begin with.  

In terms of the drinks, they're basically out of everything so I'm unable to comment on that. 

If I come back through here, on a day I have time to wait, I'll update the review to see if it's consistently slow.

Probably the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Although they were quick, they made my first order wrong and when I mentioned it to a barista she told me she made my order that was no where to be found and then when she remade my order in a tall when I paid for a venti with a very rude demeanor. :( sad

Worst customer service ever experience at a Starbucks, with the exception of one barista who is very sweet. I comment on the rudeness of the barista who had an attitude and instead of apologizing, she says "sorry you feel that way". Very unprofessional to say the least. There are far better Starbucks in the area you can go to than wasting your time at this one.
Always a good day when I can get my vanilla latte. Even if it's a pickup or drive through. Friendly people too. Thank you for your service.

Bad.. just bad.. everyone there is very slow, shortage on everything which i understand but they dont even help with an alternative to what they dont have. Drinks are always very inconsistent... worse and worse over time

I have been visiting this Starbucks location for the past few years, and my wife and I always feel welcomed. We have had many wonderful interactions and experiences with the employees here. If you need a Starbucks store to temporarily find relief or get some work done, you will feel right at home with the generous demeanor exemplified here. Look no further then! For a brief moment, you might just feel like you are sitting at home in your own den.

So far so good at this bucks. I was so excited to see another one with a drive thru...right next door to my dentist...it'll be hard to say yes to fluoride knowing that I'll want a latte or a peach green tea lemonade right after my cleaning. Now I have a starbucks in every direction that I leave my home. This can't be good for me!

So, you know how they say sometimes you can go to a starbucks and someone in front of you anonymously pays for your order? It happened to me for the first time at this one!  It really made my day, so I ended up paying for the dude behind me to keep it going. I've only been in the drive thru, but already my service has been fantastic.  I can't wait to go spend a little time inside when I'm not running around as it looks like a big one.

By the far the worst customer service I have ever received at Starbucks. Not a single worker said hello. The girl that took my order stood there staring me and didn't say a word. I'll drive further up to road to support local from now on.

Not recommended, unless you like long waits and big crowds. It was 35 minutes before my mobile order was ready, with the last 20 standing at the counter watching and observing.

On my side of the counter were at least 10 other customers, waiting silently for much of the time that I waited. Each time a new customer entered, they all went straight for the pile of now cold food and drink at the mobile pick-up counter, hoping and praying that their order was waiting for them. Sad beyond sad service

In order to get your order right, expect 3 remakes and losing 30 mins of your life

Super friendly baristas. Our local coffee spot was closed early today so we decided to swing thru Starbucks. Got our yummy October Pumpkin Spice drinks. Sippin with happiness now! Have a great weekend.

Well, I don't frequent Starbuck's often and now I know why.  I ordered a caramel coffee regular.  Total $5.61. Came into an empty store, employees were EXTREMELY rude, impolite, and cut us off before we finished our order. Can never go wrong with Starbucks whether you want coffee, tea, or something sweet. It's my go to spot.
This particular Starbucks sucks. Ordered a 16oz latte and for some reason they gave me 12oz in a 16oz cup. And for a Starbucks, they would fix it. Ain't that a bitch?

The issue is not just that there's only a tiny lot, but that the surrounding streets all have parking bans or permit parking only, so there's nowhere to go for overflow parking.  The parking lot is too tiny to reasonably fill this coffee shop, assuming about 2 people to a car.  There's ample seating but barely any parking.  There isn't even any METERED parking nearby.

But to add insult to injury, this place isn't exactly easily accessible by ANY form of transportation.  I'm a walker, and a SEPTA user.  This location is along a big street with fast traffic, and the lot is between the sidewalk and the door...not friendly to walkers.  It's very near the SEPTA station but the walk from the station to the Starbucks isn't a friendly one.

Other than that, this place is decent.  Nice employees, decent decor.  But seriously...I'd like to see them do something about making this location more friendly to people trying to actually GET to it, whether by car or by foot.
Repulsed that you allow your employees to work while they are sick. I will be staying away
HORRIBLE SERVICE. THATS ALL I HAVE TO SAY. But anyways the way they take order and do those orders before your mobile order while they say you are next. Stupid.

Once I got to where I needed to be, I took a drink of the latte & realized there wasn't any coffee in the drink!  There was only syrup & milk.  After throwing that away, I took a drink of the frap... again, no coffee!!! I was really disappointed!  Also, they wouldn't let me use my Starbucks rewards card!  Needless to say, I will not be going back there again!

This Starbucks definitely used to be a bank or insurance office. It doesn't have your typical Starbucks decor or vibes. With that said, it is a big location with plenty of seating, inside and out. I had a great experience here and would recommend it to anyone in the area looking for some coffee consistency.

I got my usual and it came out promptly and I was on my way. I did not see a drivethrough but there was ample parking, There is no reason to give this Starbucks less than 5 stars.

Second, it's literally across the street from my job at Trader Joe's, so my awesome boss tends to bring us lattes and marshmallow treats more often than not.

There's lots of room out on the patio when the weather allows it. The parking tends to be a nightmare on occasion, but, like I said, I work at Trader Joe's. I'm used to it.

I won't review the drinks or food unless I feel I need too, because they usually are the same each location. I want to focus on the atmosphere, in these reviews.
This location is small, but good to work in when not many are there. Its quiet and the staff is friendly. Seemed clean.

While the customer service is up to Starbucks standards the drinks are not! In the handful of times I have gone to this location I have never once received the correct beverage. Service was dismal.  The cashier blamed the register but he rang my order up wrong. I left with my food and it has burned pieces of other food items scattered over the top of it.  They need to clean their oven.  They also do not have stevia.
