Wow!  Almost 20 minutes for a basic latte and iced mocha?!  Not even a "sorry about your wait".  Only 1 barista and 1 check out person.   Gotta blame management for this one.   Won't be back to this Starbucks if I can keep from it.

I'm not sure who the gentleman was at the window- but he paid for my drink due to my card not working. I showed him I was trying to unlock my card but the internet was not working. Hands down the slowest Starbucks in the Nashville area. They have no sense of urgency.
Horrible set up with drive thru. You wait absolutely forever. Not designed well at all
Good coffee but so darn slow. Small lot. The line often backs up onto Olive, which isn't safe. Sometimes people waiting in line make it impossible to leave once you get your order.

In my experience the last several months since moving to Metairie, this location is very hit or miss. They're either awesome or awful depending on the day but their drive thru has become extremely slow these last few weeks no matter what time of day. I understand rushes which is why I don't mind waiting in line 20 minutes because I know they're doing their best. But when you wait 20+ minutes and your drink comes out wrong twice with a line backed up to the street behind you (which has happened several times), well I'd rather just go to any of the other locations on Veterans. Shame because this one is 2 minutes from my house.

Slowest Starbucks ever! Twice I just left after placing an online order about 15 minutes before arriving to pick it up. Another 20 minute wait I decided to leave. The last 2 times I've gotten coffee from this location it's been super bitter even with sweetener. Also watching them make my coffee they have not done it the way it is written on the ticket. Even though it is super convenient I will not patronize this location again.

I don't know who is in charge of this place. They want to charge you a premium price and yet always have ti substitute items on your order. It's a simple fix, you know how much you sell a week, so order what you need. Really is no excuse to be out of things. Not that complicated.

Honestly there's nothing bad to say about this place. It was clean and it did the job if you're thirsty. The only thing I would say is that it's extremely overpriced for a small coffee. Overall I would recommend this place if you ever need a quick drink.

I had to give one star because they don't allow you to give zero stars...Every time I go to this Starbucks I get an attitude from the staff members..If you don't like your job find another one. I went there this morning and I waited 10 minutes for anyone to even acknowledge me then they turned back around and continued their conversation for another 5 minutes...when there was 2 people working and one person left to go outside to smoke in their car while I was waiting for my drink order to be taken and made...This is not the service that I have come to expect from Starbucks. Not your best place Starbucks!

i come here a lot because I live so close, the people are really nice. 
in fact the employees are pretty much the only thing that make each starbucks different, and why I'll continue to keep coming to this specific location. 
special thanks to alyssa, she's always really kind. and today a girl with half pink hair greeted me, and her attitude made my whole day, I had to write this review. thanks guys!

Safely covid  friendly ... in store - app or drive thru friendly! I do come here daily & drinks have always been made accurately. Overall highly satisfied & would recommend. I love love the brownie here btw.

Sometimes even while really busy everything comes out perfectly but today was bad the flat white was made different the oatmeal which I would think is pretty simple I was given one agave while two is just perfect for me. I'm going to take a break for a bit it's too expensive to be disappointed when you get it.

Don't go to this Starbucks, one of the workers stole my info off my CC & Starbucks card & took 200.00 out of my account. According to Starbucks headquarters this isn't the first time it happened here.

Can't stress enough how much this location impresses me. They train new staff to err on the side of caution in that they would rather send out a sugar free drink than one with sugar which would harm a diabetic, and better yet, they will ask you questions when preparing drinks to make sure they get your order right the first time. They have always been friendly and caring when I have gone too, which is much unlike the dutch bros a block away. Even if Starbucks in general took over some of my favorite small coffee shops, the stellar training and variety in menu make it hard to stay away. I really like this location, even over the one on W Franklin! Sometimes they have been out of things I order but they try to make up for it and have always been kind to me. I can forgive the supply chain issues much more easily than the many time horrible experience the dutch bros down the street sends you away with. This starbucks ROCKS!!!

Bought 2 protein boxes with the hard boiled eggs. Eggs were rotten which was really gross. Had to drive back and wait on line to be offered a refund. I feel like if you bite into rotten food and then have to drive back to the location and wait on line...you should probably be offered a little more than a refund. Oh well, that's Starbucks for ya.
Every time I have gone to this Starbucks they never fix my drink right and calling them is a joke never answer.

Really do not like leaving bad reviews but this store earned it. Staff was very friendly but I don't think they have enough experience running the store without a manager on site for a while. Drink order was cold and not hot. Drive through wrapped around the building and inside was totally neglected. Good intentions by workers but they needed better management.

As barb J from portland said - "Good location off I-80 for those of us traveling though."
Since i was doing the drive from Denver to Portland - this was indeed right at the right spot for us to stop.  Right when we needed it!

Great location to walk the dogs around some water and bronze statues that the dogs thought was real! hahahah!

Good coffee and good location!

Great location! However, there are certainly some kinks to be worked out. The drive through line for me has always been prolonged and inefficient. Love love love this Starbucks! Hannah helped me today and she was great! She was super helpful and patient with our party. This is definitely one of the best starbucks I've been to. Very clean, efficient & professional. All Starbucks should be run like this one honestly, they really have their stuff together! 10/10 recommend!

This Starbucks will make you late for work!  I've spent as long as 20 min waiting in the drivethru.  I even tried going inside since there weren't too many people.  I walked right up and ordered and it still took 15 min.

Horrible customer service. The worst Starbucks I have ever been to. Also web site says open till 10:00pm and they closed at 9:30.

Worse service ever!! It was complete and utter chaos in that place!!! Employees are very rude. I will not be going to. Starbucks ever again in my life

Worst Starbucks from Tampa to Orlando. 30 min wait in the drive through every time. No apologies. It's just how they function and don't ever strive to fix it.

I am all about spreading the love on local business, I rarely use this tool to leave a less than positive review, but on the other hand, this could help to get the attention of the manager or franchise owner of this Starbucks. I got out of the movies around 10 pm on a Thursday, knowing this Starbucks closes at eleven, I went to the drive-up to order a Latte. I am sorry to say that I was greeted really poorly if I compare my experience at another Starbucks. I felt a discontent from the other side of the intercom. Without exaggeration, I waited 15 minutes in line before I was able to pay and get my coffee. Now, this is the second time that I experience the same at this location, the first time I thought maybe they were short of staff and decided to give them another try. - Coffee was good, and my order was exactly how I ordered. 
If you are not in a rush, this Starbucks is really convenient as is next door to the AMC theater.

My first review was based on going inside to order a beverage. While waiting 10-15 minutes is a common occurrence when ordering in store here, even for a nitro, I applaud their new morning order routine. 

In a rush? Save the time and pre-order on your app before coming in. Let me explain the genius of morning coffee pick up at this location! Place your order online: the app says 15 minutes. Dont believe those green straw lies! When you walk in the store, rather than fighting the line of people ordering or digging through countless cups hoping to find your marked cup, no no, my caffeinated friends! There is a dedicated employee standing at the bar area that takes your name, hands you your drink and you're out the door in no time! This may seem minor to you but, for those of you that have never had someone steal your drink when you're already late for work or you have seen the kind of sneezy, mouth breathers that come in and sift through the drinks while clearing their throat-then this genius move is lost on you! 

Bravo, Starbucks on Cool Springs! Now, if only you could figure out the finesse of moving that drive thru line. Now, there's your 15 minute back up...

Defeats the purpose of ordering via mobile app only to have to wait an additional 20 minutes since only drive-thru was open. My coffee was lukewarm at best. However, the gentleman at the window was VERY pleasant. You could clearly see all the baristas were very busy. He made my coffee and that was that:)

I come here all the time. Most of the time, the staff is on point!

Other than that above this coffee shop is great for coffee of your choice they do have WIFI, indoor and outdoor seating for the customer while sipping on your coffee either hot or cold or eating some delicious there.

Staff were friendly , this location is One of 2 remaining Starbucks with a drive through in the area.

The only reason we stopped here was that we were at a neighborhood business. Cafe mojo was opening next week down the street.

Y'all are litttttterally the slowest drive thru in Pinellas county. Do not go to this location if you need to get to work, just go to Ulmerton location.

As stated in my other SB review, I'm a fan of SB so you won't find any criticism about their coffee/prices here..but anyways, this is my favorite SB location in all of Nola. I just discovered there is a parking lot in the back (who knew you could turn there?!--however, it is kinda cramped with all the slanted spaces). I haven't had much interaction with the baristas aside from giving my order. They seem to work through the line quickly. Music is always good although once in a blue moon, it seems a tad too loud. Looking forward to sitting outside with a refreshing drink when the weather gets better!

Definitely a fan of this Starbucks. This is probably the largest Starbucks I've been to in New Orleans or New York or anywhere else for that matter. 

This Starbucks has a decent sized outdoor seating area perfect for enjoying your coffee while watching life go by on Magazine. The inside has a multitude of seating options. I like it in the back of the store where it is a bit quieter for getting work done. 

Service is pretty quick and efficient although not very friendly, And I regularly frequent here. Decent selection of sandwiches and pastries, but then again why eat this over priced crap when you have a plethora of high quality eateries up and down Magazine Street. 

Stick to the coffee and the great location this Starbucks has to offer...

Overall great service at the end of the day when opened.

Friendly, professional and went above and beyond for my order today!! When I ordered online and accidentally placed my order at the wrong store the staff helped me navigate a solution in a timely manner.
Love stopping here. Gary and the rest of the staff are so kind and my coffee is always perfect. Awesome for such a busy spot.

The red head barista knows nothing of customer service.  I walk in and she immediately says we can take no form of payments so you won't be able to get anything. There was no Good Morning, how are you or can I help you. Nothing

The red head barista made my drink left it in the counter snd didn't announce it snd there was no name written on it.  I had to get her attention to ask. She said oh that's a caramel brûlée latte.

The drink was good, customer service horrible.

Starbucks, due to its success, sets the bar against all other coffee shops are measured by. But how does Starbucks compare to Starbucks? Well, THIS Starbucks compares very well.

As far as food and beverage quality goes, Starbucks is remarkably consistent store to store. So, if you like the Starbucks taste you will like it here. If you don't then you won't like it here either.

As far as location and interior décor this Starbucks is as good as any other. The parking lot is a little awkward, but for the most part this Starbucks delivers pretty much exactly what you expect.

The service here, however, is exceptional - even when compared to other Starbucks. My server (Shae, I believe) wasn't merely pleasant, but genuinely seemed happy to see me. She took obvious pride in her mission to serve others and add just a little bit of extra comfort and happiness in the world. In today's self-entitled world, precious few understand the true dignity that serving others affords.

I walked into this Starbucks with high expectations of their quality of product.  Those expectations were exceeded by their quality of heart.

Don't bother ordering a mobile order. They will make you wait an unreasonable amount of time and then won't bother to serve you at the door. Waited 5 minutes for them to get a straw for my drink and then wouldn't even look in my direction. I would drive an additional 5 minutes to either of the other Starbucks than stop at this one.

I really like this Starbucks. I've only ever used the drive thru but they are pretty quick. The baristas are so nice every single time I come through! They really go above and beyond for their customers.
I have not been inside and I probably won't ever because the only bad thing about this Starbucks is the parking situation. It's pretty bad. If the drive thru line is too long, you'll get blocked in. That's no fun especially if you're in a hurry. 
Still come here, though! Just opt for the drive thru instead of going inside.

This Starbucks often has a line wrapped around the building but they do a good job trying to move folks through as quickly as they can. The logistics are a bit messy, though (not their fault), though when it's busy. Don't forget your mask, and don't forget to tip your barista!

Try their secret menu fraps?!  why not. I go here only for hot & cold drinks all the time. Andrew is my favorite guy to make drinks. Drive thru sometimes is packed otherwise perfect 5 star. I never have any problem here. Service is fast for me.

Mentioned that.   The gal with out even giving a darn that I didn't get ANYTHING from them except a wait, announces "can't give the tips back".  So note to self do not tip them assuming you'll get something before it actually comes unless you like tipping to wait

This is a pretty solid Starbucks w a great staff.  They have never gotten my drink order wrong.  The restaurant for the most part is always clean.

My one huge complaint about this Starbucks is the entrance to the drive up.  It tends to become a cluster Bc it has 2 ways in which clogs the exit and people will not let you pass to exit nor will they let you alternate to get into the line.  Starbucks people are very possessive about their place in the line.

As I sit here now, there is a group of boisterous pre-teens loudly talking with each other, using the WiFi to show each other videos with the volume way up and generally being obnoxious.  They have ordered nothing, yet their presence is tolerated. 

Don't come here to quietly read or study.  It is way too loud.  Seriously. I wish I had earplugs.  The staff does nothing to police this.  

The beverages themselves are typical Starbucks.  Get your coffee to go.

I wandered into this Starbucks because my car was in an auto shop nearby. The service was excellent, particularly the barista Patrick, who was friendly, helpful and made me feel great even when I couldn't quite decide what I wanted and then realized I had left my wallet in the car. Barista's like him make me feel really comfortable in a cafe. I plan to take advantage of the lovely service and relaxed atmosphere again later in the week.

One of the top rated staff locations I felt like my presence mattered at this location. I tried their new PB&J lunch box for a healthy alternative to fast food menus. It was excellent, with a nice fresh half sandwich, apple slices fresh and crispy, carrots & cucumber, with cheese and chocolate covered raisins. It was satisfying.

I can't use mobile ordering here (hence the crazy long line) and I also cannot redeem rewards here.

The employees here are so incredibly nice! The parking lot isn't massive at this location & other businesses use the same spots, but I've never had an issue finding a spot either when going in for an order. The employees there act like they pay for supplies out of their own pocket. I really, really hate how this Starbucks' parking lot is designed. Save that nasty energy for the people who actually deserve it, not someone who's literally just asking for the coffee that they paid for.
I don't like this starbucks anymore they have enough indoor seating just 3 tables and the nail in the coffin they got rid of the sofa chairs I have a feeling they not bringing it back

What a wonderful Starbucks and crew working there.  I completely understand the challenges of hearing in the drive through with the flights, etc and my order was heard wrong and was just too sweet for me. The minute I called Mitch was so grateful that I let them know and really wanted me to enjoy the drink and make me a new one so I turned around and  Mitch was a great barista and was so helpful.  They apologized although it was no ones fault and the wonderful customer service will definitely keep me coming to that Starbucks which is wonderful since I just moved about 4 minutes away. 
Thanks for all you do Mitch and the Starbucks crew!

Yet again, the lack of any form of customer service strikes again. The barista here is beyond rude and condescending. Observed someone picking up two drinks and asked which was which...her response "read the sticker". I've sent in emails to Starbucks on 3 occasions about this location with no response. Appears this is what's tolerated. Over it and will not return given I work right across the street

Gone to this Starbucks two times and have ordered the same drink, a quad espresso. Both times it was made wrong and the expresso was bitter. Not one of the best Starbucks. The employees are nice the coffee just sucks.

I mean come on it's Starbucks and Starbucks is amazing !!! This is got to be the best place to grab a bite to eat or the main purpose COFFEEE !!
Forever a customer

If I could give zero stars, this location deserves zero. You really can't screw up starbucks coffee, but when you have 7 employees working and EVERY SINGLE ONE of them moving as slow as humanly possible - 20 mins to stand in line and make a latte is ridiculous.

I have always had a good experience at this Starbucks and especially enjoy sitting at a table outside and relaxing with a drink. I usually order through the app so it's nice to have my drink right there waiting for us. Everyone is super sweet to my kids and take time to have a little conversation with them.

Usually this Starbucks is wonderful. Sometimes a little slow, but not too bad. This morning I mobile-ordered. Due to Covid they reduced their lobby hours, which I totally understand. BUT there were no instructions stating how to pick up mobile orders when the lobby is closed. So, I went through the drive through but didn't stop to order (because I already had and there was no one else in the line) and the cashier was super rude when she told me "you can't just come to the window. Next time, stop at the box". 

I realize this a minor incident, but it could've been handled in a more professional and friendly way.

Nice friendlier staff. They seemed better than most getting your drink right! Smaller Starbucks with limited seating nearest the southern side of a Wal-Mart. If you're a group of 3 or more, you're in luck! 6 tables total (don't like these uncomfortable chairs though!). 4 leather chairs usually taken earlier weekday a.m. That said, there are several covered outdoor tables adjacent to the parking lot.
Pumpkin spice coffee around Thanksgiving was really delicious. Would not want it everyday. A little expensive, but a very nice treat, and I usually don't not like pumpkin!

Okay let's talk about it! Any and everyone that knows me knows how much I love, love, love Starbucks! I had to do a review on this location bcuz the WOW factor upon entering was off the charts! I walked in and was greeted by several employees immediately. I was looking around and perusing all of the display shelves and tables just taking it all in and also taking my sweet time. When I got to the counter the young lady was very nice. I ordered my normal morning drink and received it quite expeditiously. Everything here was absolutely perfect. Such a welcoming environment. I'll be back!

This review brought to you by a double-shot of espresso - and a double-shot of sass.

Even on a weekday at 9 PM they were still open and occupied: A mix of students and bored locals were sitting around and escaping the heat, mostly abusing the cafe's now-free Wi-Fi. Relaxing at their bar, we spied a pair of older ladies trolling YouTube, too. (I wonder what they were watching.)

Chipper staff got me what I needed, and fast. After swilling my espresso, we were on our merry way.

Not into Starbucks? Hit up the Chapterhouse Cafe nearby.

Service was friendly enough; the condition of the store was not to Starbucks standards. I left the store hoping that I would get a email generated survey for this location. The bathroom was a mess, toilet paper all over the floor, the back of the toilet behind the seat didn't look like it had been cleaned in a very long time. There appears to only be one trash for the the entire (large) store and it was at the connivence bar which was jam packed and overflowing.

Since this Starbucks reopened, I've stood in line twice and had a few people in line not wearing a mask or wearing a mask that only covers mouth, but not nose.  As a physician, I shake my head because those without masks are exposing others to their germs.   

Would this Starbucks consider posting signs about masks?  I realize they likely must follow corporate policies, but if there is an opportunity for them to independently encourage customers to wear masks, I would appreciate it.  

Having seen a wide range of ages of patients who have been both seriously ill with COVID-19 and those with mild symptoms, I cannot wrap my head around why community members would not wear a mask to protect other community members.  How can people be so selfish?  Do they want to visit our intensive care units and see sick patients and would that help them understand why masks benefit themselves and those around them?

I see masks as preventive efforts to reduce the spread of COVID-19.  I also see mask wearing as an act of kindness to others.

The business this Starbucks must lose due to insufficient parking availability and poor lot layout outweighs the convenient location. No drive thru, either.  Same standard service and products we have come to depend on with a smile. Parking issue keeps it from being 3 stars

I go into this Starbucks when stopping into Macy's.  I agree with other reviewers that the baristas are friendly, the lines are typically short and move quickly, however my main complaint with this Starbucks is that the music is usually so loud, much louder than other coffee shops, it makes it hard to relax.  They usually play something so upbeat, it would be nicer if it was something more laidback.  

There is plenty of seating available, however it gets crowded quickly, I think from the people coming from Macy's and the shoppers coming from other Chestnut St stores.

For me, this Starbucks is good in a pinch, but it's not my usual hangout...

Great coffee. Great service. But I just overheard two of the baristas talking about getting the booster shot and the one making my coffee said he hadn't gotten any of the shots. Starbucks isnt requiring vaccines or covid tests of its employees until February 9. I guess I'll have to wait until then for my next latte. I can't believe how many coffees could be responsible for passing on the virus.

This is the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. The service is ALWAYS painfully slow and the drinks never taste quiet right. It took about 20 minutes just to get a bagel one day and they weren't even busy. The iced coffee never tastes fresh and they never get the syrup to coffee ratio correct. Don't even try the drive through. You will be waiting for an incredibly long time.

Mobile ordered at 3:54 and received my tall iced coffee at 4:30. Then the barista with pinkish hair acted as if she could care less. When I told her I had chips with my order as well.  A simple sorry for your wait or would have been nice, it was only black coffee.  SOOOOOO SLOW!

First and last time I'll go to this location. I opted to go in instead of going through the drive thru. It took 16 min to get my coffee and there was only one person in front of me. They clearly prioritize drive thru and mobile orders!

So years ago I used to live on Starbucks Daily, even visiting their locations multiple times in a single day!  

I was literally addicted beginning with my first Hot Caramel Macchiato sweetened with Splenda. 

I became such a nut that I would literally specify exactly how I wanted it:  A Hot Venti Sugar Free Caramel Macchiato with 2% Milk, 6 Splenda, extra Foam, Extra Caramel Drizzle served with a Large Straw. 

Yuppers, I'm that kind of crazy, lol. And if tasted wrong, I'd have my hubby go back in and have them remake it. You didn't want to be behind me in line, lol. 

But I had to change my caffeine intake for my health, so we stopped going. I'm sure a lot of employees around the locations in this area were happy, lol. 

Anyway, For the last year or so I discovered Organic Green Tea and drink that daily at home, 1st with Splenda until July when I found out I was diabetic & have hypothyroidism. So I researched and found that Stevia artificial sweeteners are better for my health. 

So, yesterday for the 1st time since 2016, I asked hubby to go thru the closest Starbucks Drive Thru before we went food shopping.  

I didn't know what to order until I leaned over my hubby & asked the friendly female voice coming thru where you order if they had a Hot Green Tea & she said "Yes"!  Then I asked what artificial sweeteners they had & she listed a few until I asked if they had Stevia & I was delighted to hear "Sure Do!"

Pulling up to the window, the friendly girl handed had my tea all ready, let me know she mixed in the 2 "Whole Earth" (Stevia w/monk fruit sweetener) and also gave me extra on the side in case I wanted more & my large straw!  

5 Star Amazing Starbucks Experience & a Super Yummy Healthy Tea for me made perfectly!!!

I highly recommend this Starbucks & My order!!!

This Starbucks has the most RUDE employees.  They need a class in how to talk to people! My friends and I walked in and forgot our mask in the car not realizing it..."do you have your mask"? We said "oh were sorry,  we can go get them", response,  "do you know where you are"? How darn rude!! She said it with a terrible attitude.  Followed with "you can leave now"! Wow!! Do they want service or not. We were going to get them and those words were unnecessary. We got our mask as we wanted coffee and had been traveling.  Attitudes continued and its the last time we will EVER stop at this location again as we go past here on our road trips frequently.

I have gone to this location 5 times and out of the five times my coffee has only been right once. So four times I have had to throw out the coffee because it taste so bad I can't even drink it. Also every time I try to get a pink drink or anything with strawberry's they are "always out" kind of ridiculous at this point and it kind of sucks because it's right by my work and house but I guess I'll drive to the one near largo mall Instead because they always get my coffee right.

The Starbucks has heart and the best location! 
They have just started using a Partner on an iPad taking orders in the line. I came around 8 am (the beginning of rush hour) & maybe was in line for 6 min! Great AND fast

I totally understand that we are in a pandemic and all restaurants are trying their best but this particular location is never consistent on when they are going to be open.  If they are having issues opening the store or having enough employees for the store then they should keep to a certain time or certain set of hours instead of being open all day one day the. The next close at 3pm and pretty much every Sunday they close at noon.

This Starbucks location has amazing energy. And it's been that way for as long as I can remember. Which is surprising because it feels like there are frequently new faces working behind the bar. 

The cafe has more lounge furniture left in it than most of the newer remodeled Starbucks, so it's actually a nice one to hang out in with people, rather than simply plug away at the computer alone. And the the bar seating is still closed (social distancing). 


The drive thru line moves quickly, which is good because the parking lot is an obstacle course and so parking here is not ideal. Not ideal is a nice way of mme saying it's a disaster and whoever designed this plaza should have their engineering license revoked stat.

Always great service and always busy! If you can, order ahead on the app so you won't have to wait 15-20min+! My only complaint with this location is that they close early on some days compared to others around.

Every time I go into this Starbucks the people are so kind. My coffee is made the way I like and if not they absolutely don't mind making it over. Love the egg bites tasty. The desserts are not made in house but are still delicious. I go back because the people are awesome the music is good and the coffee is hot.

This is a pretty crappy Starbucks... as far as Starbuck shops go.  The outside is a orange red color that is atrocious to look at.  I was trying to find the place after driving off the 95.  I expected a shop with "the starbuck colors of green and pale yellow.

The location of the store is crowded with little stores and has lots of traffic.   It is not a restful place.  There's the subliminal fear that at any moment an early model sedan will come crashing through the windows into the area where people drink coffee.  Well, that's how I felt.  Whoever decorated the store didn't go out of their way to overcome that ugly look of asphalt and parked cars.  Maybe it doesn't matter.  They have a good business and the coffee is good; but if  you read those Starbuck books by Schultz you'd get the idea that just because all the other stores are scary, drab and dreary doesn't mean Starbucks has to be.

Oh well, grabbed the coffee and the 800 calorie "fruit bar" and took off.

A continental hotel breakfast in disguise as a Starbucks. No coffee options other than Pike? Really? Really? I'm sorry. I thought this was a coffee shop. I was told that those options were only for breakfast times. Sorry I missed the last call. Then no wifi available for customers unless you're a Hyatt guest. What am I taking crazy pills! They claim to be separate from all other Starbucks since they're inside the Hyatt. Guess that means you should expect less. Right. I was passing by looking for breakfast and coffee before visiting the Archway. Figured Starbucks was a good idea but instead a real disappointment. Guess it's only here as an amenity to the hotel and it's proximity to the Archway. Please get with it.

Always been pretty happy with this Starbucks - parking choices can be less than optimal during peak hours and drive thru often wraps around the building but that is pretty typical for most Starbucks in the Tampa Bay Area. LOTS of seating options (when dining area isn't closed due to Covid) - this location probably has one of the largest dining areas I've ever seen at a Starbucks!

Only drawback is when they keep mobile order beverages out of reach/unattainable, as that largely defeats the purpose of ordering ahead/efficiently.

Also, recommend ordering via mobile app and running inside to grab it versus waiting in the drive thru. :)

I primarily use the drive thru at this Starbucks and have always had quick and efficient service.  The parking lot is really small, so parking can be tough at peak times.  That's when it's  just easier to use the drive thru.

When I've been lucky enough to snag a parking spot, the service and coffee inside have been great.

So we all know about the Starbucks brand of coffee and drinks they sale to the customer such as cold/hot coffee, tea, sandwiches, coffee to make at home. Now let's get down to business this Starbucks could use some work in the drive thru department such as be a little bit faster and not take forever. At times the drive thru can be fast depends on the morning, afternoon and evening time rush. 

Keep in mind no matter what Starbucks you visit around town you will be waiting no matter if its inside or waiting in the drive thru. Trust me, I've waited in the drive thru for like five minutes sometimes longer in some other Starbucks locations all you can do is wait or leave if you don't have time to wait for your coffee.

One of my favorite Starbucks locations that I've been to! Very clean on the inside, and there was a nice sitting area with large plush seats. All of the workers really really nice and accommodating for my teams large order of a couple of drinks. I ended up getting a venti iced coffee with caramel and whole milk which is my go to drink and it came out perfectly! I love adding caramel because it gives the coffee so much flavor! Our barista was super nice and made the extra effort to get to know us and ask us how we were doing and how our day was going. I will definitely be coming back to this location specifically when I am in the area because of the excellent service!

Quite possibly the most poorly run Starbucks in the NOLA metro area.  Not only is it nearly impossible to get into their parking lot and/or find a spot, but once you do, the staff will make make you feel like they are doing you a favor by taking your order.

This is a fully licensed Starbucks that is inside the Giant grocery store.  If you've ever been into one of these mini-Starbucks before, you know the deal-

* They generally have the usual selection of drinks.
* Pastries/Sandwiches are limited.
* Merchandise is severely limited.

Compared to other stores in the area, this locations claim to fame is a beautiful outside cafe.
Still a VERY slow Starbucks.  I have found that this location takes forever whether you go inside or through the drive through.

My FAV and the BEST Starbucks in town and for the Westchase area. It's HUGE, tons of seating and the staff is excellent and super friendly. I love the fact that this location was the first one to offer the Nitro brew which is a must have/try. I absolutely love coming here to do some work or just to relax. Such an awesome atmosphere.

I stopped by as I was leaving target I was thirsty so decided I would order a drink. The reason for the one star review is the Starbucks is very busy and only had one person working I waited in line and then had to wait an additional 10 minutes before the lady could take my order then when she did take my order she was rude. They also need to check their Expiration dates on their evolution fresh drinks as many of them were expired and usually I wouldn't mind but they are very perishable items. Then I got my drink and there was barely and fruit pieces in it. Probably one of the worst Starbucks experiences ever.

I don't usually post bad reviews but this is the worst Starbucks experience I've ever had. I ordered my drink ahead of time and STILL waited 30 minutes for it to be made. If that wasn't enough, I didn't even get the drink I ordered and didn't realize until I pulled away. Very frustrating.

Do not go here unless you want to wait 45 minutes for a drink that's made wrong. Sorry but this store needs to get rid of the old lady in drive thru if she can't take orders the right way and in a timely manner.

Yes, this store gets slammed during peak hours, but they still manage to keep it reasonably clean while offering friendly efficient service.  If you're in a hurry you may be frustrated as a couple earlier reviewers pointed out, while blasting them for being busy.  

One of my favorite things about this location, besides the consistently good drinks and friendly staff?  No drive-thru!  I'm thankful that NOLA still has a few Sbux stores where the baristas can interact with their customers without the distraction of an annoying headset.  This location and St. Charles/Canal are my favorites.

On my way to work, I drive directly by 4 Starbucks and if I want to go a couple blocks out of my way, I can access an additional two. So, needless to say, I have options every single morning when I'm driving. Considering this, I have settled on this particular Starbucks as my absolute favorite because I know I'll always get consistent, fast service and be quickly back on the road - which is huge especially when I'm in a rush.

I admit, my coffee order is rarely complicated. I'm usually just getting a regular coffee with the occasional food item to go with so I can't really speak to how they handle complicated orders. Still, I can say there's almost never a line- and when there is, they move through it quickly! The person at the counter is always smiling and friendly and FAST! I'm usually in and out of there in 3 minutes or fewer.

The Starbucks closest to my house would definitely be more convenient and I'd have those precious extra 10 minutes or so to enjoy my coffee, but I still always choose this one as the other can't hold a candle to this location!

Long-winded, I know but when service is so impeccable, it should be recognized!

I recently went to this Starbucks during my lunch for a few items and quickly remembered why I don't come here. The first thing that remains a constant are the people's drab, unhappy demeanor. Their greetings always seem so forced and monotone. Then they're ALWAYS out of something. This time they were out of Strawberries for the refreshers, peach juice, caramel sauce and something else I overheard but cannot recall. Inside the facility there were at least a dozen unopened boxes in the front lobby area right by the door, it seemed dark like some of the lights went out. There were no lines inside and only 1 car ordering in the drive thru and another that was receiving their order at the window. It's really irritating to see a Starbucks operate this way in a predominantly black community, be the example!

Liberal party rejects!
Well below standards in customer service all served up w/ a side of attitude that puts patrons off.  The conversations the employees share about other customers is such a sad thing to hear.

Orders are consistently wrong, extremely slow service. Stay away 
How this place is still in business is beyond me.

I love Starbucks, but after years of going to this Starbucks and it never getting better, I am finally writing a review. This is the slowest Starbucks in the U.S. It takes 30 mins sometimes to get through the drive through with only 4-6 cars and every time I go I hope this time will finally be better and it never is. They need new management or corporate to come in and overhaul.

By far my favorite drive through Starbucks in Nashville.

They are always friendly and as quick as you'll find in the south.
The baristas that take your order through the drive through always are friendly & in a fantastic mood.
They've never gotten an order wrong and are always happy to provide my fudge with his puppachino.

I've ordered from this Starbucks a couple times during COVID through UberEATS. They make the order super fast and always get it right. Great customer service (I had to call once to inquire about something). 

I also love Starbuck's company policy of allowing anyone to use the store and the bathroom. That's an amazing contribution to the public and I am thankful they made that policy a few years back.
I approached the counter on March 27,2019 at 6.46pm to be exact. And the barista would not take my order and was very persistent. Even though they close at 7. Very rude.

Super pleasant employees, and surprisingly quick service through the drive-thru.... But for the high price on these coffees, I'm really really disappointed that my cup was not full. Pretty significant amount missing...

It's convenient when you have a Starbucks on base and you don't have to drive far, but the management aspect is struggle busing. The manager is slow as molasses, I literally just walk out if I see her at the register or making drinks. I will be late for work guaranteed despite getting there 15-20 minutes early. They consistently end up being too watery and...just not good. 

I will say the most of the baristas are very sweet and accommodating. Some are better than others with modifications with drinks, I absolutely adore Desirae (I think that's how her name is spelled). She's so bubbly and sweet and is the ONLY ONE  that consistently makes my drinks spot on. So, I'm on cloud 9 with my elixir of life. 

Two stars for me on the quality of the drinks is inconsistent and slow service. Not always the case, but it occurs enough to be noticed. However, if you don't do modifications to your drinks, you should be safe to order! It wasn't always this way, just went a little downhill progressively over a 20 month time span.
My daughters walked here and it was drive thru only, very frustrating. They were not able to get coffee
Ridiculous how they took 30 minutes for 2 coffee and it was a mobile order ... don't come here

By far my favorite Starbucks! I've been going there since I started school in May and all the employees are so sweet! But Max is definitely my favorite and always puts a huge smile on my face when he hands over my drink. Thank you starbies for being my favorite way to start the day.

My First time NOT having a Great Cup of Coffee at Starbucks !

I ordered the Chai Latte and it was Wonderful...

(((( Try The Chai ))))

Okay this is by far my favorite location. The management is wonderful, the staff amazing, and they even make great drinks!!! I love everything about them and they are always there with a smile. Drive-thru takes a little long but I don't mind since I'm just too lazy to walk my butt in there sometimes 
I have messed up ordering on the app I don't know how many times and they just wave at me and say no worries we got you. 
If I had any new complaint it would be the price and they can't help that 
Love this place.

I know it's a chain so you should have the same experience at every one. That is not the case with Starbucks. This Starbucks is close to home and in my opinion has the best staff. Everyone is friendly and works quickly, even at 6am. They are always polite and don't overchat with you which I appreciate.  The drinks are consistent and that is rare these days.

It's a Starbucks. It's the normal thing you'd expect from it  
I'm cutting it a few stars because it's an awkward location. 

I don't recommend the drive through if you don't have to do it. seriously, if you have 2 legs that work enough to walk into the building, I think you'll do yourself a better service. The parking lot is small, and I think they do lots of their business through s drive through window, but I find that I'm in and. Out fairly quickly if I huff it in on foot

I have no idea why but this Starbucks location lies about what food items have in the store. On 3 separate Saturday's we called the store from the Kroger gas station which is right next to the Starbucks to see if they had pumpkin scones. On all 3 calls they said yes. When we drove up to the order the pumpkin scones they said they were out of them! This  store consistently states when you order at the drive thru that they are out of food items when they are indeed not out of them! Why?!? We actually caught them this time and reported them to corporate. I don't know whats going on at that store but now they'll have to deal with their corporate office.

This Starbucks on the south side of Veterans BLVD, just east of Clearview Mall is TINY! The parking lot is small and tight, not even having 10 spots and a drive thru that will block the parking spots when it is full. I would suggest using mobile order to place your order unless you are planning on waiting awhile. The drive thru moves at a snails pace. Inside isn't much better speed wise. The interior is on the small side, but is neat, clean and well organized. Wi-Fi is obviously free here and is pretty good. Don't expect to get much work done as it is kind of noisy inside.
This is the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. One car was waiting for more than 5 minutes for their order! That's horrible.

Rating a Starbucks is not easy breezy. There is a Starbucks scale, and there is a NOLA java scale. I will combine the two into one.

 I would prefer other local coffee places to Starbucks (three stars on NOLA java scale), but out of all the Starbucks(es?) in the area, this is my number one favorite (5 stars on Starbucks scale)! I do love their hot sandwiches, especially on the go for Bfast, as well as their coffee frapps. The service is always quick and pleasant. There is some parking behind the building (wohoo!).

I average the two to make it four stars. And they all lived caffeinatedly ever after!

I utilize this Starbucks too much throughout the work week. It's so incredibly close to where I work that the drive through is pretty much begging for my business. And I cave. Every time. The staff are usually very friendly and quick with my order. The decor inside this particular Starbucks? Eh. But, for being attached to a gas station, it still manages to keep me coming back for more. Love me some Starbucks!

Just stopped in at 2:30 p.m. for a dark roast.  "Not available."  I asked if a pour over was an option.  "Not right now."  And not sorry about it either.  Starbucks is great for the over-prices sickeningly sweet drinks, but most usually awful for a decent cup of strong coffee.  Oh, Starbucks, how I used to love you!

I love Starbucks more than anything, but this location is close to the worse one. The wait is just way too long. I've been here fifteen minutes so far and ordered a latte and still no drink. There's four girls working and one making drinks while the other are in the back, they should all be up front catching up. A Starbucks drink should not take this long. Then one a separate occasion we were here and purchased a mug and gift card. They had no boxes, no bags, and no sleeves for the gift cards and told us we could carry them all out. I get running out of boxes at Christmas time but no bags... no sleeves for gift cards... on a third occasion I ordered an iced drink, she repeated it back, then made me a hot drink. I politely mentioned it was supposed to be iced and instead of the normal Starbucks "No problem let me remake that for you" I got a loud sigh and her walking off. Unacceptable for a $6 coffee. This location is in need of management.

I love Starbucks. A lot. But this drive through on the weekends is so incredibly slow. I don't know if they're understaffed but sometimes a car won't come out of the drive through for over 5 minutes. Sometimes it seems almost 10.

Very awesome store, beautiful layout and location.  Staff very friendly and fast, went in here 3 days in a row and no long lines and waiting forever to get your drink as is the case at many of the SBUX locations.

Really liked the layout of the store, great atmosphere and super friendly staff.
First full service Starbucks that I have experienced that does not honor rewards earned in Starbucks program such as a free coffee when it is shown on your account.

I am guilty of coming here a lot.. only because its literally 1.5 blocks away from my house. This is my favorite starbucks location because you can do a lot of people watching, and or enjoy the Geronimo Plaza with your dog. Also I just love old historic buildings/houses, especially ones in the West University neighborhood, so this starbucks is just a no brainer for me.
Loving all the stars I earn since I work across the street! Just wish they were open later now! But it's Starbucks so I'll make it one way or another!

The worst Starbucks that I've ever been to. Who ever was working Sunday morning (1/2/22) at about 9AM is the most unprofessional person ever! I start giving her my order, a total of 4 drinks, and every time I would add a drink she would make a face. I repeated myself a few times because she had her AirPods in and I could hear her music, that's how loud it was. For a Starbucks, having an employee that doesn't care about their job like that is very disappointing.

I've always wondered what it is that Starbucks has that people patiently line up in cars bumper to bumper around the outside of their buildings for coffee...

Remembering a gift card I have, I decide to treat myself to an eggnog latté.  Leaving the grocery store, I stop in on my way home for my much anticipated treat.

The friendly barista checked the card as I was unsure what the balance was.  I was good to go...except...they had no eggnog. WHAAAT?! 

Very disappointed, I got a Pumpkin Spice Latté instead, requesting decaf, light whipped cream and no sugar. The pumpkin syrup was very sweet; no additional sugar required. 

The beverage was flavorful and too sweet for me, but I can see why Starbucks has the following it does. What I CAN'T understand is WHY does a 8 oz cup of flavored coffee with a small amount of whipped cream COST $5.11?! 

Discuss amongst yahselves: how do coffee drinkers afford this (without gift cards)?

Discuss.

I know it might be more pc for me to like the PJ's down the street even though it  too is a chain (but a local chain)  and all, but I don't.  In fact I can't believe I would ever even bother to rate a Starbucks let alone give it four stars, but this place really earns it.  First of all, I love the building.  It is beautiful.  It has tons of natural light inside. The outdoor seating area is smaller than PJ's but it is so much more aesthetically pleasing and open.  You can watch people on the street and going into the building as well as the people sitting outside with you.  And, there is even a lovely fountain that birds play in that makes a soothing sound as you sip your coffee and breath in the fresh air.  

The staff here are extremely friendly and efficient.  I found them very personable.  I enjoyed talking with them on my several visits recently when I was in town.

The patrons are interesting.  They seem to be mostly law students.  They are pretty quiet.  When my friend I were here we were probably the loudest people here every time... LOL  They seem to be pretty friendly too except the guy that smokes the pipe on the patio sometimes in the late evening.

I believe now that the ATT wifi is free.  I accessed it with my IPhone every time I came in and I never paid anything or had a Starbucks card.  

I came here mostly for iced coffee before my strolls through Audubon Park.  The place where I was staying didn't have a coffee maker.  I had forgotten how good, rich and strong the iced coffee can be here. (OK, I still can't believe I am saying this.  I really did like the coffee.. iced and at this one at least!)  Also, I was pleased that they had naked juice protein drinks available for a decent price.  I would come by here regularly after my workouts down the street at Maple Street Fitness and have one almost every day.

Starbucks seems to be re-perfecting themselves (at least at this location).   I have noticed that their stock price has recovered a lot in the last year  too..  hmmm

Friday Oct 1, 2021, I drove here specifically for Starbucks (it's at a Giant grocery store). 
I parked, walked in at 5:50pm, and the girl behind the counter who was busy chatting with a non customer told me that she's closed.
The YELP map says open till 7:00pm, so I called into Giant and was told they close at 7:00. The customer service person was very nice and asked me to hold while she finds out - at this point, I'm not walking back in even if they are open, and probably won't be back for coffee either.

Starbucks at Starbucks yes they have comfy lounge chairs or barstools with high top tables that you can sit enjoy your coffee and enjoy the free Wi-Fi. This particular location is usually pretty packed. Most of the students from Kaiser University and HCC end up studying here so we can ours are not recommended for this particular location because it will be fun. There's an outdoor seating area where you can come and sit with your dogs and it is right in front of the movie theater.

I appreciate that they're open early even on Saturday plus they have nitro cold brew, which my usual store near work doesn't have. This location is modern and clean. It's easy to get to off 96th. The way in/out of the store is a bit annoying if it's busy cause there's a stop sign right outside the entrance/exit. Service is good and drinks are pretty consistently good.

We were exploring Magazine street and needed something to drink. Thank goodness there is always a Starbucks somewhere! This Starbucks was huge.  Super spacious!  Lots of seating and even included comfy couch chairs!  The big plus was the free wifi because I was having trouble accessing the wifi at my hotel.  Service was fast too!

Like other reviews state there is usually a decent wait for this location. I have come here once and gotten an order that tasted completely off and the last time I ordered prior to arriving. The app said it was in stock, they verified that it was ready for pickup, and then at the window they said they were out. No reason I should have waited the whole time

I've been coming to this drive through for a few years and everything's always been great up until a few weeks ago. I always order the same drink right off the menu - salted Carmel cold foam cold brew. The last 4 times I've ordered - I basically receive a cup of cream. To spend 5.50 on a drink and then have it taste like cream and no coffee (as you can see) is frustrating. 

I will say there is an older women who works and anytime she is there my drink is PERFECT! So props to her.

This is my go-to Starbucks for the time being. I've never had a bad experience, nor have I had to ask them to remake my drink.

One time I had to ask for some different freeze-dried limes, because mine were brown (???), but that was resolved quickly. Coincidentally, that was the day I realized the limes were even dried!

When the last holiday event was going on, one of the goals was to say something nice about your favorite SB employee. I chose someone from this store, because she was super helpful and cheerful despite a purchase and return going a little haywire. It involved several gift cards and receipts, a voided transaction... complete hysteria. Okay, maybe not. But she kept her cool despite a growing line and resolved everything with a smile. Great customer service!

There's also a really large round table you can pretend to be King Arthur at. Just saying.
Slowest service ever! Waited over 30 minutes to get drinks. Ordered fast then they only had one person making drinks. Unbelievable since this is a very busy location in downtown!

Very disappointing afternoon at this Starbucks!
I ordered 2 drinks via the app . A dragonfruit drink and a tie dye Frappe. I was told via the app that my order would be ready soon. I went inside to pick up the drinks only to find an empty cup! The tie dye was unavailable but they don't tell you that neither do they offer to make anything else. I asked why I had an empty cup with my nail on it and the barista said we don't have that anymore . I also asked if I get a credit to my card on the app because there was no drink. She offered a refund or make another drink at that point but why aren't you accommodated initially. My dragon fruit drink was much different from others I had at other Starbucks. This was was a very light pink and really looked like it was mixed with water and not coconut milk. Really tasted like the dried dragon fruit mixed in water.

This location is always absurdly busy in the mornings. This is the main reason I avoid it - even though it's on my way to work. Typically I'll stop off at a local coffee shop on the Westbank, or the Marrero Starbucks, if I need a caffeine fix before work. 

It would actually better for me if I purchased my coffee on the Eastbank, so that I would still have some left upon arriving at work... but here's why it's not going to happen:

If you wait in the drive thru, you're probably looking at a 10-15 minute wait on any given weekday morning during rush hour. Go inside? Add on at least another 5 minutes. I waited 20 mins from the time I walked in the door to the time I got my latte on Friday (needed some extra caffeine after Muses the night before).

It's not that the baristas are slow. They actually crank out a lot of espresso at a fair pace. They're friendly, too, which is why this gets 2 stars instead of 1. 

If it weren't for the service, this would defintiely be a 1 star experience. I can't see recommending a 10-20 minute wait for the same beverage you can get at any of their other approximately 28196291 locations worldwide. Granted, I'm sure the wait time is significantly reduced at any other time during the day... but the only time I ever *want* a $5 coffee is first thing in the morning.

I stopped in while passing through town on my birthday. I had to wait for a friend to go to lunch. I used my birthday drink reward and the barista who took my order was great and asked me if I wanted a larger size, extra shot or anything since it was my birthday reward.  I also ordered an older drink no longer on the menu so she helped the barista making it remember the recipe. Really outstanding service, which is what I usually get from Starbucks anyway. This location is very cozy inside and out. There's plenty of comfy chairs inside for reading or chatting with friends, plus great work spaces. Outside there's a spacious patio with covered and open areas. Even in January it was warm enough to sit and enjoy the sun. Plenty of comfy chairs and tables outside as well. Really just a great location for working or kicking back with a book or a friend.

Disappointed in this Starbucks. Ordered a sweet vanilla cold brew. After waiting a few minutes an employee came over and told me the vanilla cream wouldn't be ready and they could give me regular. I said ok, but I paid more for that specialty drink and only got a basic cold brew. No offer of reimbursement or to make a different drink.
The workers are very nice but sooooo slow.  It is consistently the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to.

This was my first time visiting this location and I already wish I lived close by to it. We came at 6:30am and they have been non stop busy since we got here (its now 7:30). They keep the line going fast and have a great routine going on behind the counter and get the drinks out fast. I'm impressed and again, really wish this was the Starbucks in my neighbrhood or even my town. Deborah is very kind and makes a point to make conversation with customers while working very obviously hard behind the counter. Andrew is also nice as we sit at the counter he makes sure to make conversation with us and others while working. James took our orders and was conversational, kind, and made a point to get our names and call us by our names. This is a great starbucks location with great workers!
Terrible drive thru 20 minutes waiting. Locked in the line no option to get out.  No apologies for the wait.

Would be better if the staff didn't talk bad about their customers when other customers can hear. Overall not a bad experience; staff seemed to enjoy each other's company. But it leaves a bad taste hearing then talk about other clients in a bad way while people waiting for their drinks. It just leaves a bad taste and makes me wonder what they say about me when I leave.
Why does it take forever to get out of this Starbucks? Why is it not possible to run, get a cuppa and be on my way?

I've been to many Starbucks but this place is awesome! The staff is so nice and treats everyone like they have known them for years . I love going here and would recommend this Starbucks over any in Reno Neveda

This is my favorite Starbucks because it's the closest one to my house.  It's located near the West Park Village Town Center.  For locals it's very convenient, but the times I've driven like on my way home from work, finding parking is a bit of a bear.  There are two parking areas, one at each side of Montague behing the buildings. 

It may seem odd but my favorites are the hot chocolate and the pumpkin bread (when they have it).   I'm a fan of this Starbucks because of its very convenient location.  If you live in Westchase, this is where you'd get your coffee fix.

This review is for the drive thru only...

This Starbucks is very fast and the staff is so friendly! I have been several now and the staff remembers me. I just think thats awesome! The Coffee is always right and perfect every time. There are other Starbucks close by, but this one is the best by far.
I would suggest this one over the others!

I've visited a few times and the workers are always friendly. The barista spent a little extra time making my zebra mocha mixed and presentable. The tables are always clean and the location is convenient and a perfect place for a pick-me-up for a day of shopping.

Starbucks opened today.   I do not like the location but I do like the inside and the patio.   I just hate that it is so close to local coffee shops and also it is right on the main road.  However, it is only a block from my house so... 

Looks like yet another coffee shop where I will be the Duke!   

*nothing special about this Starbucks other than it is new.  Otherwise it is the same as others.

This place is a zoo at peak hours (Anytime from 6:30am-8:00am) and parking is VERY limited. However, they are efficient for being the 2nd busiest Starbucks in the ENTIRE state of Tennessee. Crazytown. 

If my car can fit in the drive-thru, I will get coffee here because they really do move along the line quickly, but I've also seen the line with people sitting on busy West End waiting to even get in line at Starbucks. No thanks. 

Overall, this place is fine if you don't want coffee during peak times.

I go to Starbucks where ever I am while I travel...I cover 10 states for work.  This is the location closest to my home.  I give 3 stars because the friendliness of the staff is good but the service and wait time is atrocious!!!! They are ALWAYS busy - doesn't matter what time of day yet they usually only have 2 people behind the counter?!  Do they want their customers to pass up a beverage because they can't wait in line for 10+ minutes?  It's also not the cleanest location I've ever been to. For a Starbucks that is in Marlton, NJ in a clean shopping center, I expect more.

What an excellent Starbucks. Yes, we have quite a few already within a 3-5 mike radius, but this one has the best layout and furniture. According to the barista, they just opened around April 5. 

High ceilings give it a light and happy feel, especially coupled with the light wood furniture. There's black and gold wallpaper on the side that match the furniture perfectly. With the warm lighting overhead, all of this makes for an overall soft look. 

There are plenty of seating options! This is ideal for the laptop people and social people. There are around 4 wheelchair accessible tables that seat four people, two very long high tables that seat 10 people each, one high table that seats four, one long couch with tables, around 4 comfy lounge chairs, and stools at the bar where drinks are handed out. 

Outlets are everywhere. What's nice is there's the standard 3-prong outlet but also two spots to put phone charger cords in - great for my iPhone and laptop both!

Customer service seems solid so far. 

CONCERN:
Currently the potholes in the driveway from 31 into this shopping plaza is littered with tiny jagged potholes. It's really bad, so drive slow! This is the only reason why this place does not get all the stars - you'd think Starbucks would pressure who controls the shopping plaza to make things right for their grand opening month. 

I've kept it at 4-stars since this is just my first visit, and the pothole issue, and I'll update later if I think it's stellar enough to get 5.

I go to this starbucks almost every day now since it's on my way to UA. It's right off the 10 but you have to drive into the Costco parking lot to access it. My order is always perfect when I order here. I always order a trenta iced vanilla coffee which is simple enough LOL. Sometimes I order breakfast sandwiches. They have yummy ones! And they don't make my stomach hurt (I have a sensitivity to a lot of food if it's processed and frozen) so that's a plus! The bacon and gouda is a good option. I love paying with my app and getting points too since I'm literally always here. Always receive great service as well. Love my starbucks.

Fun music....a nice change!  

Some good staff.  Some great staff. Grateful it was not busy. 

The rest you know if you go to Starbucks.
This location is very nice. The staff is friendly and the service is quick!!! Makes for a good study location or lunch break.
Every time I walk into this Starbucks it's so busy! But I noticed they still manage to get so many drinks out! Great job Jackson!!

Love this Starbucks!
Definitely one of my favorite locations.
The Customer Service is great.
Employees are very friendly, super fast & efficient, even the manager too. 
Sometimes I'd have to wait in long lines.
Depending on what time of day I go.
But it was definitely worth the wait.
They take time & care when taking my order.
It's been almost a year since I've been by there.
I'll definitely be going back there for sure.

So... I don't really use Yelp anymore, as I find it too accommodating to the chronic complainers out there that want to hear themselves rant about the minuscule details in nearly every review. 
Today though, I had an experience that I feel needs to be shared in as many avenues as possible, so I am writing. 
I drove into Tucson today for a quick 2 day business trip, and decided I needed a coffee on a cold day. I popped into the local Starbucks expecting the consistent product I can get from them in any city. And I got it. What I wasn't expecting was the wonderful hospitality and friendly approach of Tom (apparently the manager). I sat for 10 minutes and Tom warmly welcomed every guest that entered his little coffee shop. He knew no less than 50% of the clientele walking in the door by name and held meaningful conversations with them. 
I know it's not the craziest thing in the world. But, its so nice to see someone actually care about their customers and offer a genuine caring experience to them. 
Thanks Tom. Keep up the great work!

I come here a lot and decided today to add to my review and reduce my rating and it is all because of how poorly Karina treated me. No eye contact, wrote down my order and would not repeat to confirm she got it right so I asked if she got all that. She replied quickly yes. I had to ask for a receipt. As she handed it to me she said here. No thank you. No appreciation. Nothing.  I will come back to this location because it is convenient and I hope I get someone who cares. If I do, I will revise my rating. It takes the same amount of time to be nice. 

Very convenient location. The staff is generally friendly. I like this location mostly because it is convenient and not because of the customer service. I will come back.

Great customer service and delicious drinks!  

This is my favorite Starbucks in the city.  It is in a great location, and the staff has an unbelievable memory.  Everyone is super nice, and I've never had a mistake on my order at this location.  This place can get a little busy, but the staff here knows how to pumps out consistently delicious drinks with ease.  I've never had to wait more than five minutes, even with a dozen people in front of me.  This Starbucks is what the rest of the locations should aspire to be!
Great place to hang out. The baristas working there are always awesome. They keep the store in great shape and make really good drinks.
So, I was pushed to pay for my coffee by the Cashier before I was able to order food and then the line was 20 people long. While I loved my coffee it seems like she could have switched registers?
My breakfast sandwich fell on the floor and the lovely cashier replaced it at no cost. Not all heroes wear capes

Meh, this location is just ok. The staff is mediocre and move at their own pace. It seems that they're not really there to get people in and out. One person can be responsible for taking orders and making drinks while another employee stands there or looks through a binder behind the counter. Since I work in the mall this is the most convenient location that accepts the Starbucks gold card so I can earn my stars.

This Starbucks is conveniently located in a mall near my house; I went there this morning to get some 'steps' in on my Fitbit.

The guys working there are really friendly and my Venti, Non-Fat Cappuccino came up as ordered and right away. They didn't even laugh when we realized the gift card I had only had seventeen cents left on it.

I had their Reduced Fat Turkey Bacon Cage-Free Egg White Breakfast Sandwich with low-fat Vermont cheddar on an organic whole wheat English muffin. I'm really not that yuppy, I got it because it was about 210 calories.

The sandwich came up pretty quickly and in general, it was pretty good, tasty and hot... it's just that they ( like lots of other places) don't cook the bacon! 

Honest, I cook turkey bacon at home all the time. You can get it crispy!​

Good friendly service, healthier sandwich option and pretty good value...
Asked many times for unsweetened iced green tea due to health issues but got sweetened one. Very upsetting and disappointing.
Jerk behind the counter gave me a cup with a mangled lip that he knew would leak. Which it did. Free coffee replacement won't pay for a $50 shirt with coffee stains.

This is the best Starbucks I ever been to. Everyone here is friendly and on top of there game. The best teamwork family here. I love using the mobile app bc it's quick. Ann and Ethan is my favorites bc they go above and beyond. I love coming here!!! The drinks are always made right to my tasting. Come to this location and you will enjoy it!!!

Not nearly as good as the service and atmosphere of the one in the middle of Doylestown - manager at Warrington never seems to be happy to see customers and frankly seems like she's in a bad mood all of the time.

This is one of about 6 Starbucks locations that fall in my work territory, so I often stop here if I'm in the area and need coffee.I don't usually write reviews on corporate chains because I think they have a fairly good system in place for promoting themselves and that they have SOPs and protocols in place that pretty much guarantee that a latte in Des Moines is the same as in Boston or Mililani or [enter city here] without fail.

The only thing I can think to comment on here is:

-their bathrooms are always clean
-the staff are nice 
-seating can be tricky
-the heating system is on the cool side 
-the music sucks (I'm not a fan of Starbucks playlists, with the exception of their holiday stuff)
- drive thru is convenient but can get backed up at times

So I go to the counter and order a coffee
 Along with what I think will be a huge slice of lemon poundcake  :-)
 But instead of the counter girl grabbing it from the counter display like she had with other products for other customer she pulled a  different piece out of a draw and it was a sliver in comparison to the display piece. So I said 
"oh man I was hoping for that one"  She just kept quiet and finished the transaction,I let it go  thinking  well I don't need the extra calories anyway.
  So I sit and start drinking the java and bite into the  sliver I was given and think to myself " I took the bait"  it Wasn't about cheating people on the size it was  stale product they where moving...
NEVER AGAIN will I think I'm getting more then status quo from a corporate ran place!
My favorite Starbucks in Tucson! Always fast and friendly no matter how busy they are. Not the best indoor seating, but perfect if you are on the go.

The place was clean and the staff was super friendly.

Other than that, hey it's a Starbucks.

I'm definitely not a regular at this location but everyone in line behind me was! The staff was very friendly and I received my drink right away. The cashier started ringing up all the "usuals" for those behind me and knew all their orders. Inside was tidy and clean. There's also a little outdoor seating area.
Main issue with this location is parking/maneuvering around the lot. Very small and tight location- I took the last front parking spot! There is a drive thru but it's a little tight behind the building. Make sure to note the very uneven pavement in the back and if you are leaving from a parking spot, you may get stuck in part of the drive thru lane :/ This Starbucks location is a little difficult to get to if coming from the interstate because of the left turn without a light but if you're headed to 465, it's a super easy right turn to get to it.

This starbucks is always super busy, day and night it seems.

The beverages here are hit or miss, depending on your barista.  The atmosphere is nice, they also have an outdoor fire place.  Parking is a nightmare though. 

Today, I got a classic latte, half of the latte was foam, um I didn't ask for a cappuccino?  Lets hope for better next time...

I always enjoy my drinks from Starbucks (bring back Valencia Orange Refresher).  A pet peeve of mine is when someone does not say thank you or you're welcome. When placing orders at the drive up, it would be pleasing to hear them say thank you.   They say thank you at the window,but it should also be said when you place your order. Why not?  It is what starts your day.  Gratitude is so important!

I wrote a complaint to Corporate and decided to write a Yelp review before I ever saw the other negative comments regarding this location.

First off, this is a gorgeous location with a nice semi-private room in the back. It looked like the perfect place for me to settle in and work remotely. I usually make 2-3 purchases averaging $15-$20 for the day, and leave tips for the staff to offset my "camping".

The problem started when I went back for my usual refill, which I usually complement with an extra order so that they have the added sale. I was told by the barista that because I had a Venti Hot Chocolate, they couldn't accommodate my request for a Tall coffee refill and had to charge me. I had not left the store, and I know the rules (see http://customerservice.starbucks.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/1882) but when I asked them to check with a senior staffer, I got the same answer. Their attitude became slightly brusque and I decided to just pay up before I was humiliated any further.

The lady behind me loudly asked if someone could please help her, because despite the fact that there were only two people in line and 4 staffers, only one person was working the register while the other 3 socialized amongst themselves. The barista helping me then argued for a little bit with the others about who was managing the store because it was afternoon and they were completely out of Pike Place and nobody had checked or set a fresh pot to brew. I was even being accommodating by not insisting on a pour-over (I much prefer their Dark coffees to Pike Place, but didn't want to be a bother) but I ended up waiting 5+ minutes anyway.

It's a shame, because with properly trained staff this could be a great location. As it stands, I will not be returning here.

Also to Phil B.'s point, sadly it is not illegal to sell products after their "Best Before" date. FDA only provides strict guidelines on baby formula. However, it's certainly skeevy, and there are better businesses out there that deserve my patronage.

I'm extremely happy that this has opened in my neighborhood. The place is well laid out with a decent amount of sitting room. It has a community table that's perfect for bigger groups. There is an outdoor area to catch some rays as well

The staff here are great and are quick in getting drinks finished. Even thought the wifi can be a bit of a challenge sometimes, this is one of my regular hangouts.

I would love to try the coconut cold brew but every time they are always out!!! Not just at this Starbucks, several Starbucks I've been to. What's the deal? Why can't they order more when they know they are going to be selling it?

I love this Starbucks. It has a healthy split of clientele with middle age people like to college students studying on their laptop for classes at UNR. It's in a good neighborhood northeast of downtown Reno off I-80. The employees at this Starbucks are very knowledgeable about the drinks and are helpful. They also are very nice to the customers here. The place is very clean. It's usually busy day and nite. There always a few people in here. My favorite Starbucks in Reno!!

Drive thru is slower than I-76 at 5pm on a Monday night. Takes 15 mins to make 1 frappacino. God forbid if there is more than one car in line. I look in the window and the associates are talking to one another instead of making my drink. Bring the old Starbucks back!!!
This location is the best.  The baristas are great & so pleasant.  They never get my simple food order wrong (bagel toasted with butter).

New location, same drive thru problems. 

I always have to double check my order even after it's read back. 

It's also slow.
Love this Starbucks!They're nice and know their menu!my drink is a bit complicated but they always know what I mean and make it perfectly!
Well worth a visit. You can sit out back by a stream and enjoy your coffee. Coffee was good and the clerk offered to warm up my cookie! Had never considered doing that. It was yummy.

I don't know why this Starbucks has such low reviews. The only downside to this place is the fact that they don't have a drive thru. Other than that, I used to go here every day because it was close to where I lived. They were always speedy and the staff is some of the friendliest of any Starbucks. It got to the point where I would go there and they would have my drink ready for me by the time I paid. They also have a nice outdoor area to sit at.
