This review is for staff service not for product quality. Im leaving 1 star because - 5 is not available on the options. This Starbucks is no longer at 738 Bethlehem Pike, the store new home is 776 Bethlehem Pike Montgomeryville PA 18936. I was excited to visit the new location science my previews experience were all positive at the old location.
However the evening of Tuesday 11/22/2016 at 9 Pm at the new location was not the case. I arrived at the store at 9 Pm, 1 hour before closing time, after waiting a few minutes to be waited on and getting my cup of joe I turn to the self help station to realized that there was no creamer on the station. I turn around to ask the barista for some cream but he had already gone on the back. I walk up the the door to get his attention, this upset the female on the rear and the person cleaning the tables. At the time I didn't even realized what had happen, so the barista who had initially help me got me the cream, I told him im sorry to trouble him  and he replay no problem. So I turn back to the Station to finish fixing my coffee and know there was no withe sugar. So I open the door next to the trash and reash for the sugar, the person who was cleaning the store once again approach me not in a friendly way and ask me what I was looking for, I said some sugar, he said he could have got it for me. I said no need I already have it and I don't understand what the big deal was. At this point the female came out the rear and ask me if I was done with the creamer I reply yes, She than snatched from the table and said next time you don't come on the rear, is for employees only and I was counting money. I reply there won't be a next time, this place is unbelievable, she than reply no your are unbelieveble. So I guess I was to apologized for the store short comings, I don't think so.

First of all I did not go on the rear, and second money should be counted behind lock doors not in the open. I feel like every time I go to a Starbucks Im always asking for creamer And refilling the sugar. While I love Starbucks coffee or coffee all together this location no longer on my venue. 

If me asking for cream and getting my own sugar is a problem, why not try keeping this Items properly stock. This store lost a loyal customer over something so simple and lack of proper custumer service training. Real shame !!!

This Starbucks is right across the street from my work so I love how convenient it is. The staff is always very friendly and orders are made quickly. I like to use mobile order through the Starbucks app and have never had an issue!

Our stay at this hotel might not have been great, but the employees at this Starbucks are awesome and actually make your drinks up to Starbucks standards! They really do deserve a pat on the back. 

Any other Starbucks recently has not made my green tea latte how they were supposed to but this place did! Thank you for not just dumping my matcha powder directly into the cup and adding milk to it only for it to float to the top and not be blended. IT WAS DELICIOUS!

I've given this location several opportunities to change my mind. But every time i come they disappoint me. I'm a pretty basic coffee drinker, just a basic java chip trap is what I get each time and every time they have made it has been terrible. From a compete mess covering my hands in chocolate to completely watery, or flat no chocolate. The only reason I even placed two stars is because of a funny gentleman running the drive threw admitting his faults and making it laughable. The rest of the staff I've dealt with im lucky if they even make eye contact with me and I'm a pretty friendly person so I'm surprised.

Came in for a quick cup of caffeinated energy post food coma and was actually impressed. In and out with the correct order and a smile from the friendly barista.

This place doesn't have a drive thru, but visiting from Austin and recently having issues with several locations not getting my super simple order of a tall dark roast with a shot and 4 splenda right, I might be willing to forego the vehicular convenience for getting exactly what i ordered.

So 4-stars for giving me what I asked for in a timely manner and with a smile...would you be interested in relocating to North Austin?

Starbucks are a dime a dozen in this city and they're all basically the same.  Yeah, the coffee isn't the most AMAZING coffee in the world.  Yeah, the food is all pre-packaged.   
What sets this one apart from all the others is the baristas.
Since I work in the Empire building, I visit this location once a day (sometimes twice, sometimes three times...please stop judging me...)   All the people behind the counter know my name and know what I drink at what time of day.  
I appreciate the fact that even though I'm one of hundreds in any given day, they still remember who I am.

Would come here 3 or 4 times per week for at least 5 years now and it was by far my favorite place to get out of the office and relax. Unfortunately with the new seating layout and upcoming changes to the rewards program, I'll be finding somewhere else to spend my time.
EDIT (1/25/17): 
Layout has been changed again, much more enjoyable. Also, the barista Rebekah is the best.

Every Starbucks is the same bland, boring, sterile yuppie infested, "I'm in a rush, get my latte quick" type place.

Awful Coffee, lousy rude service, terrible sandwiches, overpriced everything.

I avoid it always unless I get a free gift card.
Its crowded, but service is great, coffee is made just right and friendly environment.  Theres two levels with plenty of seats to hangout and chill as long as u want with free wifii.

I love the location and this is a great starbucks, but the access drive to get to their lot is in bad shape.  I worry for my tires.  I wish they would put pressure on the company who owns the mall property to resurface the access drives.  Really, all of those businesses in there should be complaining about it, and especially new tenants should be complaining.
Beautiful, new store. Lots of space for meetings, studying, or sharing a coffee with a friend. Nitro cold brew on tap!

I usually go to the Starbucks off keystone and 7th and I'm going to continue to go there. The staff at this location are unfriendly, don't even look at you when you order, hey just talk to the other staff while you're ordering. I wasn't greeted with a smile, no one asked how I was doing today like Starbucks employees normally do. The store was clean, but they were basically empty in the food section and it looked as if a mob attacked the food stand. I haven't tasted my drink yet, it's too hot, so hopefully it taste better then the staff acts.

I always drink coffee in the mornings to keep me awake in school. The coffee there is AMAZING. I go there almost everyday. The service is fantastic and the pastries are very delicious. The workers there are very nice.They are also very well organized.

I like this location a lot because they're open until 11pm. The staff is pretty nice but the girls who work here are sometimes loud and annoying. They're food is really good too. The only problem is that the parking lot is really tiny.

Quality of my mobile order coffee was fine. Also ordered breakfast but was not correct. Looked at me like I was insane when I politely asked for my toppings and a spoon for my oatmeal (the only place to get them was behind the employee counter). Really loud and giggly baristas that were blasting lady gaga and other top 40 club music (which I don't think is normal for starbucks?) not what you want at 7am when you haven't had your coffee yet. I mean, do you and be happy but please...shhhhhh

Went inside to place my order as the drive-through was quite busy. Barista who took my order was friendly and personable but I guess because they were so busy at the drive-through the barista who fulfilled my order was a little harried. In fact, she didn't even provide a straw for my drink! The store was clean and parking was easy. My drink was perfect and I even ordered my favorite pumpkin scone, now that it is fall and pumpkin scone season again. My pumpkin scone had ample frosting and was moist inside with a delightful pumpkin flavor. Next time I'll try off-peak hours.
There are always 4 employees stuffed in the closet space that is the single order counter of this tiny Starbucks.  No wonder they are so impatient and rude.
Okay....somedays I rully rully need a reliable and good cappucino. GUILTY.

My favorite Starbucks in town! The employees are ridiculously good at remembering names and orders. I took a month's break from coffee and when I returned they still remembered me, which is crazy considering how many people walk in and out of there. Coffee always tastes good, and I have never had a bad experience here!

This store can get busy at times because it is just off I-80 and it has a drive-thru window. It is also close enough to UofNV that students will come to study here, especially during finals. The staff usually handles the rushes well, but impatient people are what they are, so if you expect to pull in and be the first in line everytime, you should take a reality check and make your coffee at home. Some of the staff to note are Katy, Angela, Chris, Sarah, Charlie, Micah, Carrie, and several others I am forgetting. The cafe has south-facing windows which are great in the winter. There is also a narrow patio area on the south that wraps around to the east. Overall, it is a good place to come and chill for an hour or so. The Manager name is Henry. I spend a lot of time at this store! Like all Starbucks the WiFi is free! Location is north of I-80 (just north of a cell phone tower array) at the corner of 7th and Keystone. Two entrances, one off of northbound Keystone between the store and the cell phone tower, and the second is off 7th street about 50 feet from the intersection.

Came here on a rainy day. The staff was overworked, yet managed to prepare my Mocha Latte very quickly while still maintaining conversations with customers. With  all of the computer space I plan on staying longer next time. The rain was so deep my service dog had to stay at home limiting my time out.

The walls are decorated with nice artwork. It actually enriches the experience here, unlike some places,where it distracts from the ability to drink and eat in visual peace.

Girl behind the counter was awesome. Supposed to close at 9:30 pm and while sitting on the patio, we were rudely told by another employee that she was locking up the outside at 9:05 pm. Will we return?  Doubtful. What's up Starbucks?
This place is so good. I will come back here more and more. Coffee is very good. Try out latte with. That's fantastic. Thank you for your service!
Great spot to chill with a cup of coffee if you're downtown Santa Barbara.  They have a new loft area for laptop peeps who want a little quiet space.

This Starbucks is probably my favorite.  Even though they don't have a drive thru like the West End one, there is always parking available and the line is never too long.  Plus, they have some cool seating with bar tables, short tables, armchairs, and booths.  Its a nice place to sit and talk or work.

Great service. Always a welcome warming smile from the team, and they really know me now. Just what I want. The atmosphere is cozy (although it gets cold with the door opening and closing with nothing in between).
Has the gingerbread latte. Not a fan of it. Smells like an old wood shed, but tastes like a cinnamon dolce latte.
I really like this location . The staff is very friendly . There are two floors which is pretty cool so there is always room to sit down .
Awsome coffee and frappuccino, my best drink java chip.

Cute corner location and friendly service. This was a nice location but nothing to write home about. The location is cute but can be a pain to get to and parking, depending on the time of day is not the greatest. That being said, they have plenty of merchandise and the couple of times that I have been here, they have always gotten my order right.

Quick service and extremely friendly. The manager has a great memory too. I was in town for a week and everyday she remembered that I didn't like bananas. This made ordering my preferred smoothie a cinch. I wish every Starbucks was this attentive.

This is one of my favorite Starbucks. Their service is great as usual, but the surrounding small shops and boutiques give it a quaint vibe, something not so common in Tampa. Granted it is on Linebaugh, but the traffic noise is acceptable.

I'm a fan of Starbucks. I am a huge fan of the new feature in the Starbucks app for ordering ahead. You just order, go to the location, and get yours off the counter. Efficient.

Here in #Nashville, a couple of local #Starbucks spots have AWFUL lot designs. Starbucks (West End) and Starbucks (Dominican). West End has a massive and dangerous drive-thru line sitting in the road all morning. Dominican has not nearly enough parking, creating a free-for-all need to invent solutions on the fly. Sometimes, this results in a cranky customer yelling at another, like I was yelled at this morning. Surely causing your customers to bicker was not part of the brand promise, Starcrack. This lot also has a dead-end into the oncoming drive-thru traffic, complicating the discovery of the lack of adequate space even more. (Starbucks Smyrna is also guilty of this one.)

I realize the previous Councilwoman from my area of town is credited with securing the Starbucks (and neighboring Lexus) deal, but clearly the planning was poor. Kinda what you'd expect, given her reputation. I was actually going to take this issue on if I had run for Council, especially the West End part.

So the question is, what are you guys gonna do about it??

Yay!  The Starbucks at 30th and West End is open again!  

The staff is still in training, but my patience was rewarded with a hot, delicious mocha given to me by a smiling barista to warm me on a cold and dreary evening.   

The interior is contemporary and utilitarian with clean, uncluttered lines and an open, upscale feel.  I am not sure how I like the wide backless bench running along the western wall instead of chairs.  

Outside on the patio, is a conference table which will be great for groups.  The fireplace is no more.

Very disappointed in the taste and flavor of my pumpkin spice latte yesterday. Didnt taste anything like a pumpkin spice .  Not only that but we sat for 10 minutes while the guy at the window chatted with the person in front of us and we still waited another 10 minutes for our coffees that were not hot or good. Won't be back to this location
This is right by my house. I go there usually during the hottest part of the day for their Very Berry Hibiscus drink.. The staff is always really nice.

This starbucks has a great lobby space and plenty of meeting room.  The drivethrough is awkward and often slow moving.  The parking lot is a little odd to negotiate at busy times.  Good coffee, as always.

I love Starbucks! Iced cinnamon almond milk macchiato! Yummmm
Pumpkin spice lattes Yumm!
I like the way your local Starbucks gets to know you!

The remodel is awful.  Sterile and not friendly or inviting for hanging out.  Most likely this is by design by someone to drive more traffic through and discourage long stays.   Coffee is still good but the food is pre packaged and meh at best.  So for over all id rate SB my fav for coffee but they ruined a good thing with the remodel.

This is easily my favorite Starbucks for many reasons, the main reason being that it's the most convenient--I love that it's right down the street from the University (where I work and study) and that it has a drive through. Despite the lines, the workers at this specific Starbucks are always quick and greet me with positive attitudes. I've never had an issue with any of my drinks at this Starbucks, and I've been going here since I started college in 2014. I go here at least 4 times a week and don't plan on changing that this next semester. 

As for my drink today, I decided to try the new blonde vanilla latte (iced) with almond milk. It was absolutely delicious and the perfect amount of caffeine to get me through the afternoon. Come to this Starbucks and you'll never be disappointed!

After spending way too much money at Starbucks in my life, this is the one that has made me decide to drastically cut back.  After they made my $5 order wrong (pretty basic - mocha w skim milk), I got a condescending lecture about the Starbucks vocabulary and how to order properly so they dont get confused.   Or, I could just go just about anywhere else.

My Starbucks! or at least I like to think so. This place is why I spend a ridiculous amount of money for a cup of coffee. Friendly staff, nice place. Outdoor seating is a challenge due to Binford traffic. Inside fills up quickly if your looking for a place to work.

Okay, my previous review stands but things are getting better. 

I started going to this location late night (because they have the latest hours) and their late night staff has converted me. There is mostly college-aged ladies working when I go in and they're AWESOME. They are friendly, quick, and they remember me AND my drink. I rarely have mess ups, no more rude staff, and no more waiting for them to find time to acknowledge me at the register. 

My one singular dislike about my new experiences is that they put away the milk starting late afternoon so I have to ask them for it. It's not a big deal, but semi-annoying.

****** updated AGAIN*****
Drink mess-ups are getting on my nerves. Not including the messed up drinks from my original review, 3 more times I've had to return my drink because they never put the espresso in my drink. Once again, they got it wrong and once again it was made my problem. Starbucks employees used to apologize, re-make your drink and give you a free drink coupon when they made mistakes. Obviously, I expect the drink to be fixed but it would be nice if someone would apologize when they eff up. 

I really don't know if I'll ever go to this store again. I'm fed up.

This convenient Starbucks has a plethora of outside seating. While the area is right on Linebaugh, it can still be nice to sit outside and enjoy a nice coffee beverage. 

For those dog inclined, they are dog friendly. I haven't seen a dog outside lapping up a double espresso yet but I encourage someone to see what happens! Please report back. Yelpers want to know.

This is my favorite Starbucks. It is located walking distance from my house in Westpark Village inside of Westchase. They make all of the Starbucks classics and they are always very diligent. I have never waited more than a couple of minutes. There is an outdoor seating are as well. Give it a shot.

This is a Starbucks, so we know what to expect when it comes to coffee and tea drinks and that's a good thing if you like Starbucks.
The people are friendly and helpful, almost offering a smile all the time...the seating area is big, clean and bright.... and they have a drive thru for people in a hurry. They also have outside eating area.

I was so surprised at how close this location is to me! Like most Starbucks, the menu and setup is the same. I like how the tables are spread out and that there is a long, spacious table in the back, perfect for studying and underneath there are plenty of outlets to plug in your electronics. 

The staff when I was there was very friendly and attentive. The area for milk and sugar was clean and the garbages weren't overflowing. There isn't much more that I can mention about this place. It's a great location, good atmosphere, lots of parking in the shopping complex and great service.

This is now my go-to (near work) Starbucks - as it is closest.

Can get crazy-crowded during peak times.
Some of the baristas are terrific and others not so much.  There is a young guy with dark hair who is super funny and bright - and been there a long while.  He is great.  (Can't remember his name.)

If you can snag seating in the back it can be a decent place to get work done.

Parking in this shopping center has always been and still is a nightmare. (Lunch rush, Holiday time etc.)

Try to come at odd hours and you'll have a better experience.
Unbelievable! Another establishment that serves food allowing an animal to hang out. The employees saw the dog and didn't do anything about it.
Never knew you could over steep tea till I tried Charbucks. Go to the Purple Bean instead.
Quick service, clean interior, and plenty of outdoor seating with many tables and outlets for chargers! Great place to do work on a nice day!

The most expensive Starbucks I've been at. Even more than the San Francisco downtown ones. Customer service sucks, the scanner was broken. And the girl charged me 54c for a refill even though I am a gold member and gave me a snarky " just so you know you are only allowed one refill". I spent $6 for a mediocre TALL drink and a refill of 3/4 cup of coffee.

The people working here have a very difficult location.  Super busy and a lot of type A, not very polite customers.  I've never seen any of them loose their cool!  I wouldn't last one day! :)  They're fast making the drinks.  The line is slow to order, but, it's the customers asking a million questions, not considerate of the line behind them.  So be nice.  It's a great Starbucks location.

Update: Pleeease lower the volume of the music!!!

This is not my favorite Starbucks, but I have gone here several times.  I do not really think the drink quality for most drinks is as impressive as other location in Tucson and may it is because they are busy so often I feel like there is never a clean table inside or out.  Overall, it is an average Starbucks and it will be a place I go just due to the location.
Worst service ever. I advise you not to use the drive thru, better off going inside it's a little faster. They also forget your orders, so keep an eye on them.

RE: THEIR NEW BREAKFAST SANDWICHES.
I always enjoy visiting here. Very nice barristers and customers alike. Right across from where I work. I wanted to mention the new breakfast sandwiches just rolled out. There are 5-6 choices, on artisan bread or muffins. They sell for around $3.25 or so each. 

I tasted a sausage/Cheddar cheese one. Very fresh muffin, moist folded egg and melted cheese. Served very hot and fast, too. It does not have any condiments on it so if you like it moist, add butter or whatever goody. Gary got a bacon/Gouda one on artisan bread, very fresh bread, also with melted cheese and folded egg. They were filling and tasty but for me, don't take the place of a fresh-cooked egg. Might be a little rich at the price because there are cheaper options for this type of breakfast sandwich out there, but it's well prepared, nice quality, and a good option when on the run and needing protein.

I travel through out the country and visit a Starbucks daily. I truly believe in the product and experience.
This location needs assistance. Customer service is lacking and productivity is almost non existent.

This location is very slow. While waiting 15 minutes for a Bacon Gouda sandwich, I noticed the staff is disorganized, little to no structure. What surprised me the most was the amount of staff behind the counter should not allow for slug moving service.

this has been one of my favorite cafés since it was a 24 hour store. it's not open all night anymore but still a good cafe. clean restrooms and strong wifi signal. recently renovated in a retro design, and the baristas wear vintage style hats and ties. i always stop here when i'm in the area.

Quite a large location and this Starbucks is always so crowded. Between 9&11am it's very difficult to get a seat. 

Come in the afternoon, and while it is a lot less crowded, it can take forever to get through the line. I don't understand. 

They have EXCELLENT internet

Located inside Nugget casino, this place is really doing good service. Queues can get long and no points for guessing why. Stopped here a couple of times during my short stay at the casino and it was good.

I'm sure you're asking yourself--do we really need another review telling us how good and consistent Starbucks is? Well, yes. This is the local Starbucks in my neighborhood, so I think it deserves some love for being so great every time I go there. They are fast, friendly, and consistent, which is everything you want in a coffee supplier. The atmosphere is great, plenty of space, tables, and some comfortable chairs, alongside a plethora of Starbucks objects to purchase. They sell their coffee, mugs, thermoses, and everything you could possibly imagine. They also sell baked goods, such as scones, muffins, sorts of sweet breads, even hot breakfast sandwiches, and more. I know we don't need to know how great Starbucks is, they are, in fact, taking over the world, but hey, I appreciate the great service!

First, it only applies to drive through.  It took good five minute to prepare my "Iced Grande Americano."  When I picked up it, it was room temperature without a single piece of ice.  My worst ever experience.  I gave two stars only because the place was unusually busy and I felt for the staffs. But still it cannot be an excuse for an iced americano without ice.

What can I say, it's a Starbucks. Hit this place twice on our visit. Once today, once yesterday. Yesterday we went through drive through. The line was full and it was very slow.  Food and drinks were great. 

Today the drive through was long, so we went in. It was very fast, even with a lot of people there. Staff was pleasant and friendly.  A cool variety of seating from a board table, to bars, to chairs, and comfy chairs, to outdoor patio. 

Nice atmosphere.  Felt good here. Id come back for sure.
A truly social place. A busy location

One of the worst locations for Starbucks. Drive thru is almost always guaranteed a 20 minute wait. My order has been messed up many times. Even inside the location is slow,I've waited 10 minutes for my pike place grande before then finally had to ask for it again. I know these are first world problems but it can be very frustrating.

This Starbucks has a great location and friendly staff however they never have enough people working to keep the line moving. The store has two registers as well as two espresso machines but only one of each is used at any given time. This causes really long lines. That's all - it's a Starbucks with a long line.

I love this Starbucks..I love their flat white!! Rich and sweet! I have been to all of the other ones this is the only place that gets it right!.. However... I would give five stars but I feel like I'm at the bank on Friday at noon.. 20 people in line and one teller The wait is ridiculous!!

Incredibly slow. No matter what time of day I am here I am sitting in the drive through for 10-15 minutes. And once you are in the drive through lane you can't leave. So you have no choice but to sit and wait.

This location is cool because its the 1st starbucks with a 2nd floor loft, which looks comfy for studying or working on your computer. On a saturday afternoon, it was busy but there were lots of seats to be had.  Parking is not good though and you'll have to pay if you go over 75 minutes parking at the shopping plaza parking lot. I guess that's typical for downtown Santa Barbara.

What can you say, the ubiquitous Starbuck's.  They cut their own throat by going for quantity (of stores) over quality.  Definitely  have had better espresso at independents and other Starbuck's, but the view is quite lovely if seated just right on the patio, otherwise it's just another parking lot.  Access to go back South on Campbell is kinda tough, but doable.

She did well to flip lid and put Ice cubes on lid. Almost looked like she had forgot but it was done right. If I had not already had exact chg ready I would have given gratuity in excess , maybe not .
Pretty much your standard Starbucks. Came in at 8:00 to work for a few hours. Still several table seats that were open.

If there were a minus star I would give that!! The person behind the counter couldn't even look up to greet me. I could hardly hear a word she said and never once said thank you!!!

Than the girl who put my iced tea and sandwich on the counter mumbled to let me know my order was done and again grunted a thank you. Wow this Starbucks sucks. I've been to many and never had such an experience....blah
Staff is extra friendly and helpful. Two grades of decaf is also extra nice. Newer, clean location in the shopping center. Don't drive fast you go right past it.

Came into the store and got 3 drinks, 2 Apple juices, 4 pastries and reload my app. The cashier was very friendly and patient with us. Great experience for a Friday evening at 7pm. 
Drinks: tall flat white, tall decaf mocha, and venti caramel mocha
Pastries: regular croissant, everything croissant (so good), chocolate croissant (all time fav) and chocolate chunk cookie.
A pleasant environment and layout...I've always enjoyed coming here. Serves as a great meeting spot, coffee to go, or a peaceful place to get some work done.
Horrible service for mobile orders. They have no concept of what to do. Yeah I actually want my drink in under 15 min.

This is my favorite location to go to from home. They don't always get your order right, but they are quick to fix it and make it up to you with a free beverage in the future. There have been times I've gone and the wait was really long in the drive thru and they're pretty courteous about making it up to you with a free drink on occasion.

Unfortunately this is another review saying the girls messed up my order. The male barrista is awesome but the blond girl gave us an everything bagel vs the plain requested and it had curly blond hair all over it. Awesome. Get your shit together!
Can't even get a simple order right. Visited the place twice and both times they messed up my order.

This location has the same menu as most. 

This is a very small store. 

They had plenty of employees and they were fine as far as doing their jobs however I never saw a smile. 

The reason I am giving them 2 stars is the floor was dirty, the "line" floor where they were working was filthy and the cream/sugar area was dirty with overflowing trash. 

Must be in need of a new manager. If it were my store some heads would roll. 

It's Christmas time, would a smile be too much to ask for?

I was staying at the Renaissance nearby for the weekend. Since I was up early, I ended up having a big lunch, taking a nap around 6, and totally missing dinner! Not feeling up for a big meal, I decided to take advantage of the billions of Starbucks gift cards that I have and get a little snack. 

It was a mile away AND they have a drive-thru, so it was perfect! I pulled in and there was no-one there. Not sure if it was because of the time or if it's because it's still a new Starbucks (so no-one knows about it), but I was happy! I pulled up to the menu at the drive-thru and was immediately greeted by a VERY friendly employee. I asked her to give me a few minutes to decide what I want. After a few "hmm's" and "uhm's", she decided to help me out. She asked me if I was looking to get something particular, something big, something small, etc.. It was really helpful, and I appreciated her personality. I ultimately decided on the iced green tea and their oatmeal. 

I pulled up to the window and she was still SUPER friendly! Seriously, the friendliest employee/barista I've EVER encountered at any coffee shop. My order was ready within a couple of minutes, and I was on my merry way. 

The oatmeal was nom! It would've been even better if I was at my own home with my own microwave to heat it up a bit more but that's no fault of Starbucks. I asked her to "hook it up", so I got all of their toppings - dried fruit, mixed nuts, FRESH blueberries, agave, and brown sugar. I opted to not use the brown sugar (since it wouldn't have dissolved), but the agave was perfect. It was really delicious, and I'm definitely looking forward to getting it again. The iced green tea was as good as usual.

A great little Starbucks! Also, it's next to a Chipotle, so it would be perfect if you're looking to have dessert after a meal. 

PS. I managed to sneak a few peaks at the interior. It is definitely bigger than it looks from the outside. Also, the parking lot is small but decent.

I stopped in here for the first time on the way to a hair cut. Tuesday evening - packed. Friday morning - packed. Expect a little wait no matter when you go. As always with Starbucks, my order met my expectations. Larger than most I've been too.

What a joke.. $4.65 for a tall, (their smallest size,) green tea latte with almond milk. Purple Bean does it for $0.20 less and it's a large! The powder they use for their green tea lattes here isn't even good..

I am a semi-regular at this location.

I often end up here when I have some time to kill before or after shopping at Merenda's Italian Specialties, which is one of the most awesome Italian groceries I've ever been to, and which I highly recommend.

I like this place, and I obviously keep coming back.  I like the ambiance, minus the view of the parking lot, and I like the location, again, minus the suburban sprawl that it lives in.

My main complaint about this location is that the staff seem really overworked, and I don't understand why.  I suspect it's the drive through that's the culprit.  I've been in here time and time again, when there is no line (inside, there's usually at least a car or two waiting at the drive through), and it takes quite some time, often over a minute, for someone behind the counter to even come over to me.  For example, today there were FIVE employees behind the counter, no line, very few customers in the shop, and they were all doing things behind the counter in a frenzied / hurried looking fashion.  All five of them!!!

What the heck are they doing?  Cleaning things?  Making drinks for the drive through?  I don't know, but I don't get it.  Maybe I have trouble understanding it because I always order stuff that requires limited effort, like tea, coffee, or a baked good, and maybe other people are ordering ultra-special-involved drinks that require 4 people to expend 5 minutes each just to make the freaking drink.  But I don't know, that just doesn't seem plausible.  I've been to so many other coffee shops where there are fewer employees, yet the employees like, walk right up when a customer comes up to the counter.  Some of my favorite coffee shops in West Philly have only 1 or 2 employees at a given time, and they handled more volume than this shop (no drive through though).

I don't like it.  It creates a stressy vibe.  When I stand at the counter, I feel like I'm absorbing the stress of the employees.  I don't feel like they're really 100% there, when they ask me what I want.

Like, I'm sitting here in the coffee shop as I write this review, and the employees are constantly running back and forth behind the counter in a frenzied fashion, yet there has been a total of one customer at the counter the whole time.  Ahh, here two more customers come in, finally.  I'm watching the interaction.  The employee isn't making much eye contact.  The two customers look so nice.  The guy behind the counter looks so stressed.  Oh, here someone comes out of the kitchen...she looks so stressed out too.

Seriously, Starbucks corporate management, DO something about this location.  The poor stressed, overworked employees...they don't look like they are having a good time, and they're making it a less pleasant place to be for the customers inside the shop.  I really want this place to have a genuinely chill vibe.  That would be like, really chill.  And I'd like that.  Heck yeah.
Good service but ... What is with management of these places??? Filthy, I mean filthy tables. I had to put down a layer of napkins on the table because it was disgustingly sticky!

Typical Starbucks, but this one have outdoor seating under a roof. Also very convenient parking right in front of the store. You must get a coffee from the Clover. A ver unique way to enjoy your coffee.

Another great location is it is next to Belle Meade Premium Cigar. Get a coffee and a smoke and enjoy life, its short.

Had to update my review because the service was so good today. Not sure the barista's name, but he is always so kind to me when I come in! Always greets me! I wanted a chocolate croissant, but noticed all the pastries were out of the display and sitting out on the counter so I asked if there were others and he took a new one out of package for me. I ordered my drink wrong and didn't realize until I got it and he was so nice about having it remade. I ordered an iced green with no water and meant to do classic syrup instead of cane sugar (since they changed it). My tea tastes perfect.

This Starbucks is kind of a mixed bag.  The drive thru is slow but I think it is do to the location.   It is on a major street and is very busy in the morning.   Getting in and out of the parking lot can be a little tricky.   I recommend going right and around the block down to 31st where you have a light instead of trying to turn left out of their parking lot.   I decided  to park and go inside. The service inside was fast and my tea was made correctly, which is what I expect from Starbucks.

Pulled in quick for some coffee, after driving 15 hours and 12 more hours to go from Texas to Cali, the employees were very pleasant and fast. That's why I chose Starbucks over any other place. They teach employees the quality of customers service and hire nothing but the best.

Really heavy traffic in the drive-thru! Otherwise, this place is pretty good. I like to go here the most when it isn't breakfast, lunch or dinner (which are the busiest times. 

There's a great atmosphere here. It's probably in my top 5 favorite Starbucks in Nashville.

It's a Starbucks, pretty standard. Nice people work here, and they do have a snazzy fireplace that gets turned on during colder months.

This particular location gets wicked slammed on weekday mornings, so you're much better off going inside that sitting in the never-ending drive through line. Mind said line when you're backing out though!

The clover machine is awesome and the reserve blends are very good.  I am not a coffee drinker but after some of the tastings of the Cameroon I now like some coffee.  Baristas are very nice and patient to help me find the type of coffee I might like.
Today I had the best experience I've ever had in Starbucks, Luis the barista was the nicest barista I have ever met 10/10

Nice new location. I visited this location several times over the last couple weeks while a family member was in the hospital. They are a little slow but my drink was always made the way I wanted and the baristas always had a smile which is nice since not all places have friendly employees.

If your moving like I am right now then there's no place on earth to chill with the free WiFi then this Starbucks. 

It's big, clean, nice, and awesome. Did I mention the free WiFi.

I get it Starbucks is a hectic place, especially during the morning rush as folks are in and out trying to get to work. What that does mean is a bit longer of a wait and a little more chaos. However, what that shouldn't mean is rude baristas who seem irritated by your morning order. Bravo on the coffee, but so much work to be done here on friendliness.

I was relieved Starbucks was open on Easter! I made a trip in here that Sunday afternoon to catch up on work and house hunt online. The barista made my drink very efficiently and there was lots of space to sit down. This is one of the bigger Starbucks locations in Nashville.
Service was fine enough.  Normal from what you would expect with a long line at a drive-through, but my iced chai latte was definitely just straight milk. Sad.

"You've checked in here 5 times! What keeps you coming back?"  Why Yelp, my coffee addiction keeps me coming back, what else?  

Typical Starbucks, although no drive-through so you actually have to park and enter.  Plenty of tables both inside and out.  Free wi-fi. I am usually here before the butt crack of dawn, so it's not crowded then and service is quick.  If you come on weekends or after school, then the billions of children that live in the Westchase area will be inside, and the line will be out the door.  You decide, just how badly do you want that cup of joe?

I really like this Starbucks because it is located in the hotel for easy access, and the player card money can be used here to purchase drinks. The workers are always really happy and outgoing when talking to customers.

Close to home and close to the interstate! During rush hour in the morning, expect to wait a while whether inside or out at the drive through. Staff is friendly, products are made well. This location is a little on the small side.

I like this Starbucks.  It's practically across the street from my house and it's never really that busy.  The service is great and fast.  Also, it's next door to a Brueggers if you're not feelin' the Starbucks breakfast choices.
So went there this am and they didn't have much baked good for breakfast.   Disappointing....   But coffee still good!

OMG..I've returned to the dark side! I've found myself stopping to visit ths "Siren" too often. I'm now feeding my addiction to a Skinny Venti Caramel Latte & Birthday Cake Pops! 
Strangely, I've found healthy go-to choices thanks to time calorie listings! My go-to is a a Spinach Feta Wrap. My cake pop falls into my portion control facel of my Healthy Lifestyle strategy! Obvi, I will hit their great tea options as well.
Another tell tale addiction sign is the fact I have the APP! You will find I'm always $25 loaded in my account. Starbucks marketing has won me over!
Have I mentioned Gigi loves to come here?

Awful service. Ordered ahead on my phone and still had to wait 10 minutes for my drink - that turned out wrong. When I told the barista it wasn't supposed to be iced he said "Oh, next time it will be in the house." Right...

They seem to keep this one a little colder than other locations for some reason. Also on a couple visits, they have been out of items I've wanted. It gets full really fast, but at least the staff is really friendly, and they have the all important drive-thru! Very convenient if you are heading up 69!

Starbucks is a fantastic brand. This location lives up to it most the time.  Smaller place than most the bigger locations.  Always busy a bit dirty today. Wish the case was filled with more goodies.  I like the overcast day at this location makes me feel like reading a book and sipping hot chocolate.  Floors were a bit dirty ... And countertops by creamer station.
Great staff. Always friendly. Wish I could smoke a cigar outside to enjoy my coffee though.

I have visited this location several times.  I am not a coffee fan, I only get Frappuccino.   The service here is prompt and adequate.  I do not use the drive thru. I have always found it easier to go inside and get my order.  I.double check everything before I leave the premises.  

Out of principle I don't give 5 stars to chains. This location seems up to par for me.  I have not had any of the issues that others report here.

I've never seen a Starbucks that is more CLUELESS than this location. While I try to give your store additional chances, you always disappoint. Please take your GM to nearly any other Starbucks store so he or she can be properly trained. Wow what a train wreck. Like the island of misfit toys in this joint.
I ordered one of of those Big Twelve Cup carry outs. there was no way to get to my car without help but Lauren was nice enough to give me a hand. Very clean and well-run Starbucks. Thank you Lauren!

The staff will do literally anything to make your day and be personal. If they ask if you want something made off of their clover press DO NOT SAY NO! So worth it. Every penny. I love these people. Shantel is the store manager and I wish she was my mom. Tony is hilarious and personal, phil is knowledgable and up for conversation, Christine is like your best friend, Sakinah is sweet and adorable, Evan is a polite model, Mary knows her stuff and you can ask her anything, Darcy makes the place feel like home, she loves the popcorn and you will too. Eli knows the best way to add the right flavor or spice to any coffee, LET HIM HELP YOU! He helped me find my soul coffee -- Verona with cinnamon. Come here and be merry!
This is my favorite Starbucks!! Everybody that works there is so nice and friendly!! And they are very fast making everything!!

I come here usually on Saturday morning around 10 AM. It always has slow service. They don't seem to staff appropriately. Always a 15 min wait. I have tried drive thru and going inside the store. Today I did a mobile order - and so far it has been 12 min and no order yet. I will stop coming here.

Its hard to believe that a company this big allows it's employees to dawdle and move as slowly as they do. I work in the service industry, I know first hand that what they do is not hard, and should not take long at all. I waited 8 minutes for my frap with nobody in front of me. Insane. I love Starbucks but this locations lack of speed and general nonchalant attitude makes me fear being late for work every time I go in.

I guess I like this place, especially since I keep coming back. I appreciate the friendly service and the open environment. They're always busy because of their drive-through but they make time for you. Unlike most Starbucks they make an effort to please their customers, which I truly appreciate. Great place to get work done!

This Starbucks is just ok for me. It's nice that it is close to work so I can stop by before I head on in but they take too long. I have waited over 5 minutes for them to make my drink and hand it to me. For a drive thru that is a pretty long wait time especially when I only have one drink. 
The baristas are pretty friendly though. I just know that if I am in a rush that I will have to bypass them.

It gets the job done and its on the way to work. People who work there are a little too over excited to talk to you at 8 am and the store doesn't honor Starbucks Rewards cards -- its like a knock off Starbucks, but I mean they still have coffee if you're willing to put with the minor annoyances.

This went from being a favorite Starbucks of mine to least favorite with a recent remodel. Not sure where the direction came from but it was totally misdirected. Instead of being that  unique community feel, the lack of comfortable seating, outlets and stark design makes you want to get out asap. Too bad for the loyal regulars.

The baristas here are always friendly, they know my drink order and usually have it ready. Occasionally, the pastries aren't the freshest, but they do a good job. Be careful in the morning; it can get super crowded. Super. Crowded. But they do a good job of getting through the busy times.

I've had good service at every other Starbucks I've ever been to! At this location the lady who took my order was so snobby and acted like it was a chore to take my order when thats her job and she didn't even get my order correct. The cold brew was so bitter it was hard to drink. They should try to work on their friendliness and hospitality skills.

Really bad customer service. Ordered in the drive thru two iced lattes. Get up to the window and they are making them hot so I tell them the drinks are suppose to be iced. The drive thru guy later tells me I need to tell them before I get up to the window if I want them iced. I tell him I said iced at the speaker. He kept replying "no you didn't" like a five year old. I responded "yes I did" and he shuts the window in my face. He was totally embarrassed and frustrated that he got my order wrong. This location always gets the order wrong and blames the customer.

The review I'm writing about is for the Starbucks on 986 Ambassador Dr. Reno, NV 89523

I normally go to the Starbucks closer to where I work, which is the one on 1610 Robb Dr. Reno, NV 89523, but since the new one on Ambassador has a drive thru, I figured I'd give it a try. It's convenient because it's right off the freeway on my way to work and next to a gas station. But i wouldn't consider it convenient after the amount of times I've gotten very poor service. The bartistas there act like its a burden to order more then one thing or to take your order in general. This has happened to several times, and I'm fairly certain it's not a coincidence. After speaking to other locals they have gotten the same service. This morning, I paid attention to the name tag, and it was Julia. After I ordered just one thing, she said, "Is that it?" in the rudest tone. I always feel so rushed and like I can only order one thing. I am extremely upset because I love Starbucks. I am a Gold member and i get Starbucks 6 out of the 7 days of the week on my way to work. I always have a good mood and I want to keep that good mood after getting my Starbucks, but everytime I go to this location, I leave upset because of their negative attitude. I do want to praise the Starbucks on 1610 Robb Dr though. The ladies are always so so nice and helpful. They're always in a good mood and ready to go. I love love love it there! I will be going there every morning from now on, even if it's a 2-3 min drive away from the one on Ambassador. Doesn't even deserve one star.

West Park village is a quaint little area in the middle of westchase that draws this community out for a family breakfast or brunch on the weekends. Along the ties of family and community this location is a very pet friendly destination. Besides, our fur babies are family as well and most like a good outing.

Though it does make for a quick stop during the work week. It is not a location equipped with drive thru service. The staff is friendly and accommodating. Though the line appears to be long at times, they readily moves through each and everyone's order with precision.

This Starbucks is designed to come and lounge, work, surf the internet on the free wi-fi or sit outside and enjoy a beverage, pastry, sandwich, etc.. On the street side seating with umbrella shade at each table or benches for lounging. Come one, come all, this location despite busyness is a calm, peaceful place to sit, relax, converse and enjoy great beverages.
Love this starbucks, always fast and always has a little whipped cream treat for the pups! They do some times taste like they have burnt their shots but consistently good.
I love Safety Harbor and this Starbuck's is right in the center of everything. The baristas were super friendly and my skinny mocha late was just right.

I come here every morning to Order my breakfast. Depending on who Is staffed the drinks can be hit or miss. I think the caffeinated drinks are way too strong and needs to be mixed with decade coffee. I had to order skinny drinks because the the Originals had too much sugar, caffeine. And some of the food has too much sodium.
Worst Starbucks I've ever been to, how do you mess up oatmeal? The stupid app, sent my order to this location, otherwise, I would have not come here.

Well for starters this is my regular morning stop but today they deserve a call out! I got into a line today around 5 till 9 that was winding way back to the seating area and had been through the line and had my coffee in 7 minutes along with the many other people in front of me! As they do me I am continually surprised with how many names they remember and their coffees! Well worth walking out of my to get my coffee! Way to rock it guys!

I typically wouldn't spend the time writing a review of a Starbucks, to me they're all pretty much the same, however I want to give a big shoutout to the 1500 Market team for always getting my day off to a good start. 

This location is a zoo, I mean suits and ties, pumps and pencil skirts packed to the gills all day every day. The line can be 15 deep and yet I have never waited from the end of the line to drink-in-hand more than 5 minutes. Now mind you I'm not exactly the "Venti 1 pump caramel, 1 pump white mocha, 2 scoops vanilla bean powder, extra ice frappuchino with 2 shots poured over the top (apagotto style) with caramel drizzle under and on top of the whipped cream, double cupped" kind, a simple iced coffee will do, however this place runs like a well oiled machine.

Line getting a little long? Don't sweat it, there's always a friendly faced employee taking advanced orders for drinks to expedite your wait time. By the time you get to the register to pay for your concoction, you're never waiting more than another minute or two for the barista to shout out your name. 

Thanks 15th and Market S-Bucks for making my mornings a little brighter and still managing to get me to work in time.

Of the local Bux, this one is great for two reasons:  Drive-through service and very speedy service (a necessity with a drive through window).  The beverages are consistently good, and I have never encountered a surly Barista here.   

I do not find this location terribly hospitable for lingering because the seating is very limited.
I love this location. It's just where you need it. My fav drink is the green tea frap. The rice crispy treat is really good too. Free wifi and excellent customer service at this location.

This is a clean starbucks with a drive thru.  A very small parking lot and even smaller drive thru.  Be aware of where you enter as traffic from all directions prevail at each entrance.  No room to wait in line at the drive as it is directly next to the entrance drive.
Awesome service and great coffee! Matt hooked up my birthday coffee by adding vanilla bean powder to my latte. Yum! Great idea! Thanks everyone there! I'll be back!
Very nice staff, but holy moly is it slow in there.  I waited 20 minutes for a simple order.
Attitude in this store was horrible greeted by barista cashier had attitude.  Seemed like we were bothering here

Came in mind my own business watching videos on my tablet waiting to be picked up till this manager came up to me and said I can use the restroom and all but to can't stay here.  Told him I'm waiting for my ride but I'm still getting kick out

I've never wriiten a negative review on a business based on their political stance. But in the case of Starbucks, I feel most compelled to do so. My family and I have enjoyed your drinks and your assosiates are curteous and respectful.
I can not agree with the foolish statements Made by CEO Howard Shultz regarding illegal immigration. Our nation has laws that are to be followed and respected. When an indivdual such as CEO Shultz advocates giving employment to individuals who disrespect our laws, I can no longer respect him
Yes, Legal Immigrants are always, always welcome.It's who we are as a nation.Illegal immigrants are not.Instead of advocating to hire 10,000 illegal immigrants, maybe Starbucks should consider hiring 10,000 homeless veterans. Aren't our men and women in uniform worth at least that much?

A former happy customer, gone for life.

#RESISTthe Media
Very VERY friendly people, prompt service, fast orders, overall one of my best Starbucks experiences.

This Starbucks is very friendly and nice. It is about medium to normal size for Starbucks. It has a very cool ambience as the building is old looking outside but not in a bad way just like an old town feel. It was very clean and comfortable. The lighting was great (and pretty) as was the music, and not to quiet or too loud. The cookies, apple juice, and Frappuccino was delicious too. They have free WiFi available as well as gender neutral bathrooms, if you care about that. It is busy here though. Every seat and table is occupied. There is outdoor seating available and the temperature is nice out right now so that could be an option as well.

This location is very busy, but typically puts out good drinks.  The drive-thru can  be a bit slow so I often go inside to order. It's pretty small inside but normally isn't too packed.  I love the lattes and valencia orange refreshers but my favorite will always be the coffee, especially Verona!  Yummy!
Super quick service, wish there was more places to study on my laptop (ie more outlets), but it's pretty much my go-to Starbucks :)

Having just left Portland OR & going through major amazing Stumptown coffee with drawls, I was appeased by a friendly adroit barista who made me a fabulous vanilla "wet" breve Cappucino which brought my craving down & put a smile on my face.

Great location, friendly baristas, always receive correct order. Parking can be a challenge because the lot is small and usually full. Drive thru is my favorite way to go. Convenient, efficient, and if you order ahead you can zip through the drive thru as well. A win-win!

I love the location of this shop.  I think the management is super cool and always engaging. Because it is off the interstate, this Starbucks tends to find more traffic than most around but they handle it with great ease and efficiency. It's a great place to conduct an interview if you can find a table tucked in a corner but it's better suited for more social activities like sitting with some friends and enjoying a delicious coffee. 

Again, love the management and how well this Starbucks is run!

Have been coming here consistently on Sundays with my sister as part of our weekly bonding issue. I've always really appreciated that they take care to get our orders right. Both of us order some strange things, mixed with weird dietary things, and they've always been great! 

Drinks are on point!

They have a secret spot upstairs to read away from the hustle and bustle of State Street. I know it's not baked here but the pumpkin bread tastes like it just came out of the oven. 

The people here are wonderful. They just seem to go out of their way to make sure you are happy. Can it be they slip something in the coffee?

This Starbucks is a public nuisance. It blocks traffic, today it almost caused an accident as it was blocking TWO lanes of traffic on west end in the rain. Cars were driving by and honking at the car in the middle lane and the employees did nothing about this. They should be more responsible, someone could get hurt.

Asked for the easiest drink that you could possibly make: A Dopio Espresso (literally just two shots of espresso with nothing else in it). As I was emptying a packet of sugar I couldn't help but notice that I could see the bottom of my cup, that's how watery it was! Look I work at a Starbucks myself, so of course I know that mistakes can be made. But as soon as I pointed out the mistake the Barista told me it's probably like that because the shots go bad after 3 seconds...Uhhmm what? First off, Shots usually expire after 10 seconds, second: I'm sure even expired shots arn't see through, third: don't try to justify it because you're basically insinuating that the customer is in the wrong. I literally had to show it to her for her to realize I wasn't lying. Our policy literally says "Your drink should be perfect, every time. If not, let us know and we'll make it right." When she started to remake my drink I noticed that the espresso machine was extremely low on beans, which she promptly refilled. Mystery of the Watery Shots solved! I just didn't appreciate the fact that she tried to brush off my complaint, the little whispers that were exchanged as they re-made my drink, and the absence of a simple apology. I ALWAYS apologize to my customers whether I made the mistake or not, but that's just me I guess...

Was very dissatisfied I stood at the register for at least five minutes without even getting said anything to nobody asked me how I was nobody told me that they would be with me soon I pretty much just stood there while everybody just kept walking past me. And then when I finally was able to place my order my friend I just went in and placed her order she was outside watching my dog so I try to ask about her order while I was waiting on mine to be made and they wanted to act like everything was an inconvenience the girl that was making the drinks at the bar I do not know her name but she was a little heavyset and she did not have any eye contact with me her customer service skills or should I say the lack there of that was absolutely none. I'm completely shocked because I do you coming to the Starbucks a lot but this Starbucks has me thinking that I will start going down to the Southport location and set of coming back to this location because they don't know what the word customer services! If I'm paying 5 to 6 bucks for a drink I better be gettinggood customer service when I'm inside paying for the stuff that I am choosing to buy from the Starbucks store! If you don't appreciate your customers and how can you appreciate your job.

My favorite Starbucks in the whole world!

The staff is always friendly and the location is the best. It's a Starbucks so no point in reviewing the food or drinks - everyone should know what to expect from a starbucks by now...
(3) ~ A-OK overall Food & Service.  There's plenty of seating in the back.  And the Chocolate Chunk Cookies are good.  My only wish would be a Clover Brewing System;)
This is my favorite Starbucks!  I love the baristas!  They are so nice and helpful and patient with my kids when I bring them for smoothie dates.  :).

Great location. Staff is friendly, place is clean, drinks are ready quickly. Easy off the highway location (we stopped en route to Iowa, and were happy we didn't have to drive miles off the exit). The shop was busy, but there are plenty of places to sit and the temperature is nice (hate when a Starbucks is 100 degrees).
We love this location and the friendly staff.  We are regulars and go about 3-4 times a week.  My daughter loves it too (decaf of course!)

Everytime I come to this Starbucks, the drive thru wait time is insanely long. Even when there are only a couple of cars in line. I know this is a new location, but get it together. Let's get this drive thru moving faster!

Newer Starbucks location, friendly staff, enough parking, and neat setup inside. There's lots of space inside and I liked how there were different types of seating instead of identical chairs and tables all lined up. The decor is also new and interesting compared to other locations I've been to. This Starbucks has nitro brews which can't be found at all locations. Only complaint was that all the tables seemed to be dirty when we arrived, and it wasn't busy.

Lately I've been making it a habit to visit every Starbucks within the vicinity of places I visit. We were in Safety Harbor so I thought a quick Caramel Macchiato might be a great addition to my afternoon stroll. 

We walked in to a busy store that seemed seriously cramped. Although it has plenty of seating at either end, the line right in front of the counter is almost right against the parallel wall. Confused? Well let me explain what I mean by that.

If you come in from the front entrance, you have to walk past multiple tables and do a u-turn into the waiting line. That seems fine and dandy... unless there are people actually sitting at those tables. There is not enough walking room, and we were also toting our son in his car seat which lead to an embarrassing string of "Pardon me", "Excuse me", and "I'm sorry" as we tried to make our way through.

When I finally got to the counter I asked the barista about an offer I'd received via email. Before she even let me explain she cut me off and assumed that I'd meant the holiday drink bogo deal. I had to get out my phone and actually show the email to her before she knew what I was talking or even believed me. After that she seemed very huffy. When I asked her "So that means I can get any drink that has espresso in it, right?", she responded with, "Yeah, it's any of those as long as you give me the code". It wasn't her words that upset me; it was the way that she said them, as if I was annoying her. I was in no way rude or entitled in the way that I inquired about the email, so the attitude was not appreciated.

After I handed her the card and she slid it through the reader, she proceeded to tell me the price(after the discount) and went completely silent like she was waiting for me to pay. "Ma'am, I just let you swipe my Starbucks card. It has money on it", I said. Being as frustrated as I was, I really just wanted to get the heck out of there.

(Just a note: I came to find out later on in my Starbucks travels that the barista has to slide your card once for the discount and a second time for the payment. I was new to the Starbucks scene and another MUCH friendlier barista at another location explained the process to me at a later date.)

At least the drink turned out right. That's the only reason I gave it 2 stars instead of one. I'll come give this place another try sometime and hopefully I'll have a better experience. Can't let one bad apple spoil the bunch.
Convenient location but staff are rude and the place is very dirty. Needs new management and a staff overhaul. It's a bad representation of the business.
Love this place. Our Barista's are so friendly and remember us every time we go in? They even remember my usual drink!

This is a lovely, clean, spacious SB, located in a great neighborhood (near Trader Joe's!). However, the staff there is so young and uninformed. Perhaps there is too much turn-around and they cannot train employees fast or well enough, because I have had such poor experiences there. They do not know how to answer my questions about drinks. They do not know how to make a return or exchange. They have had to pause the transaction, and call their manager for help. I have also been overcharged twice, and getting it corrected is not worth the time and effort! I learned this the hard way when I waited over 15 mins for an error I discovered on my receipt, all while holding up the line and making all of the customer's behind me very cranky.

I can honestly say that this is my favorite Starbucks in Nashville, if not, my favorite late-night coffee shop in town. While most shops close at 10 or 11pm, are dimly lit, have poor Wi-Fi capability, and blare loud music, this one is definitely a work-conducive environment. I come here quite a bit just to get work done late at night, and am always happy with my productivity level.

On a downside, due to the location, it may be difficult to find parking at times (note: the neighboring back parking lot seems to be fine passed 9pm, when the other businesses close). As far as seating goes, I've rarely had issues finding a place to sit. The one time I did, I plopped myself right in front of the fireplace outside, and basked in the fiery heat. It was pure awesomeness.

The bathroom, however, could use a little more upkeep. Tonight, I went in twice in the span of a few hours, and both times, the toilet paper roll was merely sitting atop the dispenser, not inside of it. I tried not to think of all the hands that grazed the toilet paper roll... (sigh). But at least the soap and paper towels were well stocked in order to have some level of sanitation. 

Other than that, the staff were friendly, helpful, and extremely service-oriented in getting your order to you as quick as possible. So far in the six months I've been in town, in my opinion, this is Nashville's best late-night work spot.

So, the space is great.  I'll start with that.  They have updated their seating and it is very conducive to studying and/or hanging out with friends.  After giving this place more than 4 chances, I've always experienced the same negative thing: the baristas are extremely loud, they yell, sing, and you can over hear every bit of their conversations.  Their voices drown out the music and everything else in the coffeeshop. It sounds like you are at a loud bar instead of a coffeeshop. It really takes away from the atmosphere.  I'm not saying there is anything wrong with being sociable with your coworkers, it is just extremely loud and innapropriate.  I am almost embarrased for the staff.  While customers read and or chat quietly, the baristas are causing a scene behind the counter. I will not be back.

I love this Starbucks. It delivers on everything that a good Starbucks is supposed to be - quick, clean and inviting, funny and friendly servers, and they always get your order right or make it up to you if they (or other locations) mess it up.

This is my favorite Starbucks in Reno! I go to Starbucks up to 3 times a day-everyday and I will always go to this one! I live out in Verdi and there are 4 closer Starbucks to me but they never seem to do as good of a job as this one. This Starbucks is never out of drinks, and always makes the drinks exactly how I say! This Starbucks is also the fastest I have experienced and has a convenient drive through with the nicest staff who always give my dogs puppacinos and water!

First, it only applies to drive thru.  It took good five minute to prepare my "Iced Grande Americano."  When I picked up it, it was room temperature without a single piece of ice.  My worst ever experience.  I gave two stars only because the place was unusually busy and I felt for the staffs. But still it cannot be an excuse for an iced americano without ice.
Friendly staff.  But extremely slow. There wasn't a line and if there was it was 4 people. Took forever to get my coffee. Guess drive thru is better at this location.
I love Starbucks...always will....it's my addiction of choice. :-)  Tonight they were giving everyone in the line free drinks because the line and wait was so long.  Thank you so much Starbucks :-)

The employees are friendly but they need to move faster.
They work to slow which makes long lines.
You also need a code to get in the bathroom which makes another line for the bathroom.
We love to check out independent coffee houses but sometimes you end up with a bad cup. Starbucks is always consistent, it usually comes out just right.

I was a barista at one of the Tucson coffee shops with a cult following, so usually Starbucks is just average for me. But this Starbucks truly breaks the mold. They're incredible! One of the baristas is such a ham and really made my day. I don't know his name... Tall with curly hair. Even now as I write this review he is checking in with his regulars about their kids and weekend golf games. The other baristas are also very kind. And my drink is delicious and at a perfect 140 degrees (not my request, I'm not one of those customers). I just moved to a condo near this Starbucks and I'll will definitely be adding this one to my weekly routine.

This star is based solely on the customer supervise. The drinks are typical: coffee was good, shakes were normal, a little longer wait time due to the amount of people but that was fine. However what I didn't like was the girl taking my order being rude to customers. I made a small comment about the long being long and she returned with a snarky remark like she was bothered to be working. It made me uncomfortable and the people around me. There are a few different coffee places around and I'm going there next time. I don't need to feel uncomfortable when getting my coffee.

Was there yesterday around noon, several people inside and outside seated, mostly on their laptops. Was immediately catered to by a kind attendant. Four plush padded seats facing each other, separated by a table. Several outside seats arranged in twins around small tables, some with umbrellas. Pleasant music playing as always, in a pleasant place to relax and unwind from stress.

Fantastic Starbucks!  The crew really makes this popular coffee shop stand out from its other locations.  Not only is it located in beautiful Westchase but you'll be greeted with friendly smiles and great conversation.  This is my favorite Starbucks.

This is the best Starbucks in Nashville. The location is really large with plenty of seating. The best thing about it is the staffing. They really seem to enjoy their job and its consistently an enjoyable experience. The baristas always know me by name and know my drink order. Casey the store manager does a great job of keeping her employees happy and making it feel like one big family. Also they are impeccably clean. Keep it up Bell Meade!

On my way from New York Back home to my new house in Pittsburgh I stopped at Starbucks.
It was one of the few I have been to that is in a strip mall.
Generally most Starbucks are stand alone stores.
I had a venti coffee frap with an extra shot and whipped cream.
The drink was made perfectly and tasted great.
The baristas were fast and friendly and If in the area I would go again to this location.
The store had charming decor and plenty of seating.
Definitely recommend this Starbucks if you are in the area.

Its starbucks, you know what your going to get. Its going to be good and the service will be good. I had the Green Iced tea and it was perfect. This is a very nice Starbucks. Big. A lot bigger than most. The Wifi works. its like an office for you

This is my favorite Starbucks. That being said, I favor this one because the evening staff is great! All very friendly & awesome. They make my drinks perfectly, & I'm always pleased. The only reason this is not a five star review is because of the day staff. I have been there a few times & the same girl took my order via the drivetru & when she handed me my wrong drink, I would tell her that I didn't order this. She would roll her eyes & then take the wrong drink back. Look, if I'm paying the money for a fancy expensive drink & you hand me an iced coffee, I'm getting ripped off. Overall, love the night staff!
Probably the dirtiest Starbucks I've ever been too. This includes rest stops.   Clean it up. Windex the doors. Clean the bathrooms. Gross

Not the most efficient Starbucks that I have ever been to.

We visited on a typical weekday evening to find that the place was pretty busy. There were several people in line as well as several people seated around the lounge area. One thing that I noticed is that they do not take your name when they take your order. I feel that when a place is super busy that is the easiest way to make sure that everyone gets their drink. I mean its Starbucks so its not like every single person is going to order something different.

The girl that took my order seemed to be a little frazzled by how busy they were. IDK how else to word it other than that. Just felt that something was a little off. Then you had several people actually making drinks. I counted 3...which you would think that would mean you'd get your drink faster. But that was not correct either. Two people seemed to be not only making drinks but also trying to manage the drive thru. They carried a personal conversation the whole time but talked loud enough that everyone could hear.

Despite the lack of organization the drinks did come out in the order in which they were ordered. That was impressive. Also with everyone kind of doing their own thing only 1 persons drink was wrong. Apparently a guy wanted his drink cold and they made it hot.

When my drink finally came out I felt that it wasn't made like the other places. Its not that hard to make a passion tea lemonade sweetened either...but apparently they did something wrong. Due to the slow pace and overall appearance that no one really knew what was going on...I did not ask them to re-make it. It wasn't horrible by any means...just not what I was expecting. Maybe they left the sweetener out?

Regardless I feel that I will pass up on this location and choose to give my business to another location...one that is more efficient and quicker.

Seems like they figured out their logistical issues. Not sure if they got more baristas or new ones but things have been super smooth here lately. Lines moving much quicker. Very pleased, as I was getting sick of Wawa coffee.

Eli is the man! The best barista around! He goes above and beyond what is expected of him. If available, try the sun dried Ethiopia reserve coffee with mocha. It's delicious. If not, ask Eli or one of the other baristas for a recommendation. Great atmosphere and usually always very well kept.

There are two Starbucks on my way in to the office. This is my Starbucks of choice despite not having a drive thru. It's still much faster to do mobile order, park and walk in than wait in the drive thru lane at the other location. Occasionally, I'll still have to wait a few minutes and for a brief stretch over the last couple months that wait became pretty consistent and a time or too way longer than I think it should have been. Today, I mobile ordered a little later than I like to, drove by, saw it was packed, and thought "oh dang I'm fixing to be late to work for sure..." but I walked in and they were throwing out mobile orders like the T-shirt cannons at the titans games! Super quick and my sandwich (reduced fat turkey bacon egg white sandwich) was great and thoughtfully assembled. I usually get mochas but today I had a star reward so I got something a little special - white chocolate mocha, light whip, nonfat. Yum! There's also a lady that works here who is just the absolute nicest - always so helpful and so friendly and cheerful even when I know she's been there since the crack of dawn. I really appreciate her. 
Tips: no drive thru! There's street parking for free or a parking lot behind the building that's paid (ridiculous - in my 22 years of living here that lot hasn't been a paid lot til a few months ago...) but if you're mobile ordering and running out I honestly never pay bc I'm there less than 5 min most occasions.

Well, ... I think we all know what to expect at a Starbucks. The questions are is it clean and how's the staff. Yes it is and top notch!  This is a new location about a week old. It looks small from the outside,  but it's a good use of space. We'll thought out design and feels much bigger on the inside. The staff is friendly and gets you served pretty quick.

I guess everybody's entitled to an off day. Ordered two caramel frappachinos and wanted to buy two of the new reusable cold drink cups that Starbucks is now selling. The sign says three dollars each including a straw. When she rang me up for eight dollars and some odd cents I questioned it and she advised me the straws were a dollar apiece additional. I pointed her in the direction of the display where it said three dollars for cup and straw, and additional straws for a dollar. She apologized, but didn't leave it at that, she went on to explain it was the first one that she had rung up and she didn't quite know what the price was. As an employee it seems it's her job to know what the latest and greatest promotions and pricing are. Simple apology would've gone a lot further than trying to explain away her ignorance of her product line. Frappechinos were fabulous!



Great location, friendly baristas, always receive correct order. Parking can be a challenge because the lot is small and usually full. Drive thru is my favorite way to go. Convenient, efficient, and if you order ahead you can zip through the drive thru as well. A win-win!

This Starbucks has some of the best baristas around. Not only do they make drinks correctly and promptly, they are some of the most friendly people. 
I could have free coffee at work. But, I like the walk here as a way to get away from the office for a few minutes. My daily visit to this Starbucks is more about getting away for a little bit. And this staff makes that time great.
