A note: This is actually the Omni Severin running a Starbucks, so you cannot redeem free drinks earned on your Starbucks card. You're still, however, able to earn stars with purchases.

Nice service, nice coffee, and very quiet and comfortable environment. Free Wifi, and sufficient chargers for laptops if you wanna stay here for a while. I love the sunshine coming through the windows.
24 hour Starbucks. Near the interstate. One time I had to wait a couple of minutes for my coffee, so they gave it to me free. Pretty sweet.

Sadly not terrific service on Friday morning. Flavours of Megpies were limited with no additional stock, and our breakfast sandwiches took a little too long to come out. Further, we asked for no cheese on one, clearly indicated on the bag, and it had cheese on it. Quickly remade, but would have been better done right the first time.

I'm only a fan because they have the drive thru, but the drive thru was sooo slow!  And parking was limited so believe it or not, the drive thru was the better option.  Anyway, I still like it for its proximity to me and the fact that I don't have to walk in to get what I want.

It's the worst Starbucks I've ever been to.  There was no any milk or cream or half-and-half at the condiment counter so I requested for half-and-half.  The young server poured me just a sip of it and he refused to provide a bit more when I requested.  Instead, he told me I need to pay to get a bit more of it.  I've never heard of a customer of Starbucks who needs to beg in order get a bit of half and half.
The nicest Starbucks that I have seen. Great place to meet with your friends or sit in the comfortable chairs and use your computer. Much nicer than many of the other Starbucks that I have seen

Good indoor/ outdoor seating.  As usual thought the bathrooms are not very clean and no soap.  Starbucks really needs to improve their bathroom situation, all locations- not exclusively this one. When you pay $12 for a cup of tea and a muffin the bathroom should be clean and have soap, paper towels, TP, etc.

Officially done with this Starbucks. I sat in their drive-thru for over 20 minutes today only to get my order wrong. This is about the 10th time this has happened. It's one of the only Starbucks in the area therefore I always keep coming back, but never again. Fully okay with grabbing coffee by my house and waiting for the Dunkin Donuts across the street from this Starbucks to open and to never give them my business again. There is a complete disconnect between the employees and customers and they never apologize for the ridiculously long waits. Rude, and incompetent employees.

I travel through out the country and visit a Starbucks daily. I truly believe in the product and experience.
This location needs assistance. Customer service is lacking and productivity is almost non existent. 

3/10/16 if zero stars was an option that's what today's visit would get.
This store needs some supervision and to be attentive. 

Starbucks fan for life just need to find a new store off the expressway.

The Asian barista made a great iced double shot so we ordered another. But the young (teen?) barista lady ruined the next one. Strongly suggest baristas taste the drinks they make, it will give an idea how good or bad you make them.
Great place to read and has extended room for customers!

Every time I go there, there's an issue. I just bought a frap with extra espresso, paid almost 7 dollars and be extra shot is missing. Very annoying, I have to go in to work and don't have time to turn around.

Amazing in a bad way how defensive the current supervisor was when she was unable to explain where all of my Starbucks rewards had gone to. The attitude was the limit and think I'll skip this store from now on. To add insult to injury they served me a caffeinated coffee at 830pm instead of my CLEARLY ordered decaf and then said that they did not brew decaf after a certain hour. I pointed to their fancy Clover machine which makes all types all day and night and the clerk replied, "Oh yea." It is like a circus here!
This Starbucks is conveniently located inside of the Nugget.  The staff is very friendly and makes your drink perfectly as ordered!

Every single visit I've made here since it opened (which have been several), has been fantastic.  The drive-through is speedy, orders have been accurate, and the best part is the friendliness of the staff.  They actually SMILE when they talk to you and seem pleased to be there, a very welcome change from the Robb Dr. location just down the road.  Hands-down, this is my new go-to morning coffee stop on my way to work in NW Reno.

This is my local Starbucks and I must give them props because I've been going to this one for years as it was moved recently to a closer place by my work! It is very convenient I will say the parking lot is a war zone and I get scared for my life by all the drivers who ignore stop signs here! Other than that there is no better Starbucks location in the Montgomeryville area! I literally will go out of my way to go to this one as opposed to many others in the are because I know my coffee will be perfect here as I've had bad experiences at other Starbucks in this area! Please look no further for the best Starbucks cup of coffee in the area!

Ah, Starbucks. Where one goes to get a delicious, but over priced drink.

This particular location is my favorite, but the service is very slow compared to many other locations. 

Baristas are nice, drinks are usually made correctly, and I'm happy when I leave.

Not open during listed hours!!!

I love Starbucks even though they refuse to build stores within a 20 minute drive for me. So Saturday night I was out , looked up this store's hours on Starbucks website which stated 10pm and drove 10 minutes out of my way to arrive at 9:30. Store closed!!!

I was immediately greeted with a Good Morning and big smiles from all the baristas.  Everyone working was very pleasant.  I ordered my usual drink of choice and it was just as I like.  The store itself was very clean and a great location.
Love my local Baristas! Take such good care of their guests and make everyone feel like a regular!

You expect a certain level Of customer service when you go to a Starbucks. However, this location exceeds all others that I have been to.  Always lots of people but somehow the baristas always have a smile on their faces.  Truly when you have to be up at 7am, it is nice to consistantly see a smiling face.

Starbucks is Starbucks. For a caffeine fix w/ regular coffee only TruBru @ Portland brew wires me better. Today they didn't have Bold so they hooked me up w/ an Xtra Shot Americano, which may replace my need for Bold coffee.
This location has great outdoor seating. The Drive-Thru is always cramped and hard to navigate.
This Starbucks has great customer service and quality drinks.  This was one of the best soy lattes I've ever had.  I am very impressed with the speedy service and staff!

You have a very rude (continuously) female barista who must hate her job, or hate life in general in the morning hours before 9am on the weekdays. I've experienced this and have seen her be rude to others as well. She either needs a cup of coffee or a reality check that she's making other people's mornings not so pleasant. Makes me want to go to another coffee shop.

Long wait, but very good hot coffee. I like how the art is tailored to the area, with the chalk drawing of Madison, Tennessee and the O in Madison being used for the Tennessee Tri-Stars. Keep it up Starbucks.

Went through the drive-thru and ordered iced tea and an iced mocha. Sat in the drive-thru for 15 minutes, 10 of them waiting for my iced mocha to be made. 7 staff behind the counter, 2 actually making drinks, several playing on their phones, and then after waiting for 7 minutes they asked if it was ok if my iced mocha did not have whipped cream as they were still making it. At that point I needed to leave so I said fine, but it still took another 3 minutes for my drink to come out. As my drink was handed to me I watched a barista put whipped cream on another drink. Many young kids playing around and chit chatting, not working. Definitely not going back to this location, poor service!
Such a beautiful place, I am totally in love with it. So nice interior, nice staff, extremely clean place including restrooms, outside seating, amazing crowd.

Wow, what a change. I think they have a new manager or managers because every time I have been in there for the past 6 months the person in charge comes off miserable and unfriendly. They are short to the rest of the staff and look borderline aggressive the way they make drinks. The quality of the drinks has also gone down to the point where I skip this location when I'm near it. It's a shame because the rest of the staff is very very friendly, but it's not worth getting inconsistent drinks and foul vibes. I understand that work can be stressful, but when you run a store you shouldn't let it effect the way you treat the staff and come off to the customers. It's a shame because this is one of the only locations in the area with a Clover machine.

I live nearby to this store and I come often, I can't recommend the service because it took 15 min. To make my Cappuccino and the guy didn't call out so I kept waiting, too much of college casualness not enough professionalism! Don't go during afternoon rush hours they are too slow. Highly not recommend it.

In general the move away from the train station was a very positive one. Allowing for a great space to sit and relax or work. Ample parking. They now have a drive through and still seem a little "challenged" with that new addition but all in all a great place.

Wow...this is my first experience with an unfriendly Starbucks. I was given the wrong order going through drive thru. I went in to get it corrected. I explained the problem and was told that it was rung up incorrectly and was given no apology. They gave me my corrected drink and I was told to go stand in line to get my refund if I wanted to. She took my receipt, and as the last person went through, I was told by "D" that she would get to my refund in a moment. After 3 times of saying that to me, I said that I had waited moments, and she asked what my problem was. I was finally given the difference owed to me.  Starbucks is usually the top in customer service. This location fails with me.
Over priced and not friendly at all. Go here for free wifi and comfy places to seat? I think not!
This is my favorite  Starbucks the staff is very friendly and helpful.  That atmosphere is really comfy.
my go to place before work. don't get scared by the crazy long lines!!! they are all efficient and fast here.

I am giving this a 5 star review because the 1 and 2 star reviewers are hopefully long gone! It's really more like a 4 just because it's Starbucks, but I would like to defend the employees. I have found most of them very friendly. They don't know my name but they seem to know many people that come in around 9ish, which is when I pop in a couple times a week. The music is at just the right level and the ONE time they flubbed up my order, it was super busy and they more than made up for it. One of the managers knows who I am and even though O don't called by my name, they make me feel welcomed here and that's what I like.

My go to Starbucks
Staff is always attentive 
Friendly and the quad grande Amercano is always right!
Not my favorite Starbucks. It's cool inside and a good place to study but its always too packed, takes too long and the staff kinda sucks.
Always, always out of cold brew. Even at 6 in the morning... please, for the love of God. Have the Cold Brew ready.

If I had to rate all the SB Starbucks stores, this would be the worst.  this location has all the trainees here and I'm sure they think they can get away with it because they know the foot traffic  store is on state st.  If I'm wrong about them being trainees then they've got real problems because it seems like everytime i come back to give this place a chance, they do something that annoys me.

For instance, if I order an iced coffee with an add shot and you call out "iced coffee" is that's the same thing? so why in god's green earth would you have me ask "does it have an add shot?" only for you to confirm there is one. also, the person taking my order asks for my name and asks for my order and then asks for my name again.

they obviously don't care about their standards here because they have no shortage of traffic from all the tourists

I love this starbucks but today have to give it a one star the lady at the pos aka register i couldn't catch her name short chubby wears a ball cap.  She is so rude and always looks like she is on something. She never smiles and is always straight to the point she is new i believe and shows no interest that she even likes her job or wants to get to know customers. So very very bad customer service!

Whether it's 5:30am or 5:30pm, customer service should be top notch. I called in advance for travelers and was told "it might be ready when you need it if we don't get a lot of customers this morning." I did pay for the travelers when I arrived so I would expect to be treated as a customer as well.
This is a nice starbucks store.  Clean, bright and spacious.  A bit light on inside seating, but a big outdoor patio with lots of tables.  Staff was attentive, and food was as expected at Starbucks.

At one point in time, I truly believed the staff was once courteous and professional at this specific location but it is no longer true. Yesterday 2/13/16 around 10:30 am, a young brunette woman, a Starbucks employee was off duty gossiping with her co-workers (they were on shift) about the customers within the shop. It was astonishing and incredibly disappointing  to know that as a customer I can not enjoy a cup of hot chocolate or the overall service of this establishment without Starbucks employees laughing & gossiping at the expense of customers that pay for proper customer service at this location. I will not be returning to this location again.

No lines unless you go during peak hours like 7am-9am. They accept Starbucks gift cards which is a plus. When they take your gift card (you can use your phone), they need to enter a bunch of numbers in first and you need to sign a receipt. Weird but not a problem.

I have been coming to this Starbucks at least three days a week for the past three years. What I have walked away with, besides an exorbitantly large coffee bill and a caffeine addiction, is the gratification of consistency. The staff here is great & super friendly -- it's awfully nice to walk in, be greeted by your name, and to not have to order your drink half of the time since they've got it memorized (I work nearby and most everyone in my office frequents this location and I am not the only one who has this experience. It's always amazing to me how well they keep track of their customers' wants). The other great thing about this location is how quickly they move. The line can be backed up to the door (as it often is...) and they can plow through it in a matter of minutes. 

A Starbucks is a Starbucks is a Starbucks.... but the staff at this location just makes this particular one stand out for me (and the update to the decor that they did a few months ago doesn't hurt either).

Love the drive through. its great right before going to centennial park. I usually get what I ordered after I drive away. Some other ones are unreliable but this one seems to consistently get our order right.

I admit I occasionally  stop at a Starbucks,  but this is not my norm. And I will even admit I enjoy some of their coffee & tea beverages. The food, I am not very impressed with, as it all appears cookie cutter style to me & that just isn't my thing. 
On my last visit I did enjoy my cappuccino, it was hot, frothy and had a robust flavor. I can't fault the beverages.
My problem comes with the overabundance of locations. Ok, offer free wifi & a particular  type of crowd will come. All of the restaurants  are basically  the same & just vary in size. Are they really out to take over the entire coffee industry, of enjoying your favorite  brew at a public location? 
Personally mass comercialism, is not my style. Yes, I plead guilty to stopping occasionally & am usually furious with myself for giving into convince & paying way too much for a beverage.
Give me a family dinner, a good cup of Joe & I am a happy patron. Friends, enough with the gifts of gift cards. If I didn't  have the gift cards, it would be easier to keep on driving. To those who love Starbucks, definitely  your choice, as is mine to keep driving the next time.
What's a girl to do?  Too many of the same anything, just screams monopoly, this is still the USA & we have choices.

So we just got back from this Starbucks and they did not do very well. We wanted to try the new Smores Frap. As we were waiting we saw them catch a breakfast sandwich on fire. 
People in line were complaining on how the store has gone downhill since new management has happened. We were in line for about 15 mins and they were only serving 2 groups in front of us.
When we finally got our Fraps, they were not expertly crafted at all. The graham cracker topping was not there and it seemed to be blended into the drink which made it feel sandy. Also no marshmallow cream. The only thing they got right was the heating of the Smore Tart which was really good. Surprised it didn't catch on fire.
Absolutely the best place around!!  The customer service is amazing. Only had one bad server, but for the majority of the time EXCELLENT SERVICE.

WORSE STARBUCKS EVER!!!  I was in the area and decided to get some good coffee but I ended up leaving.  The employees lack customer service skills.  They don't know how to smile or greet people and they were extremely slow.  Not going back!!!

Definitely by far the best Starbucks in the Bucks area - that I have been to. It is new and clean , and has maintained its cleanliness. I have seen it very busy to the point you cannot get a seat and it is still clean, unlike other locations who drop the ball. I also have noticed that there is never a significant wait time for drinks, which is always a plus. This location always is well staffed, maybe because of the drive thru? The staff is always super nice here and friendly and will converse with whomever, not just their favorite customers. I definitely feel like they do a great job with customer service. Between that, their expertly crafted drinks, and an overall great environment, this is always my Starbucks of choice. On the weekends it does close earlier than other Starbucks so sometimes it is not always an option, but when it is, I will always pick this location! A+
Super nice employees and customer service but this is the slowest Starbucks I've ever been too! I've been to busy Starbucks in the am and I get it but they've never been as slow as this one by far

Good Venue.  One of few with a Cover Brewer and Reserve roasts by the mug.
A tad cramped and on the chilly side indoors.  Quaint patio if you tolerate highway noise.
Great service and as always a great product.  Its a busy location so don't be in a rush.

I love coming to this Starbucks location.. Westpark Village is a very pet friendly neighborhood, which is a plus because not many businesses are pet friendly anymore. The staff is very friendly, accommodating and they work as a team to get all customers in and out as quickly as possible.

It was around 15 years ago that this location opened it's doors. This store holds a special place in my heart. The partners working here over the years have changed and with each I have many great memories as a continual customer. The current team is outstanding and while one day I know they will each move on to greater endeavors I am proud of the quality of service they give. Many ask why I am so stuck on Starbucks. It's not just about the coffee. It's about the people they have that make it special.
Pretty fast considering where this is located..staff is always friendly :)

I just sat at the front counter for over three minutes without being greeted or spoken to.  In the meantime, five employees ran around taking care of drive through customers.  I was the only customer at the front counter.  I can get that at mcdonalds.

It's high time I reviewed my work neighborhood Starbucks. Over the last 6 yeas there have been periods of time where I've been here at least once a day. Sometimes I just need to get the heck out of Dodge so my friend and I walk over from the office. Then there are the "I'm starving because I didn't have breakfast" days, and the "I am in serious need of caffeine days" and the "I'm totally craving something sweet" days or maybe even the "I didn't bring lunch and don't feel like driving anywhere days". 

I will admit that sometimes the staff isn't always overly friendly right up front; however, I've definitely seen improvement in this area over the last 6 months. Lately I don't think I've walked in the door that I haven't been greeted. They are always friendly at the counter and sometimes even remember our usual orders. My friend and I do our best to provide comedic relief for them. Most of the time we get a laugh. There was the whole "hot morning buns" conversation with the guy at the register once but maybe that story is better left for another time. I don't think they've ever messed up my drink order. They are patient and accommodating when my friend wants a chai tea latte made with a tea bag rather than the mix, and I want a caramel machiatto made with coffee rather than espresso. 

As for the consumables, the coffee is still Starbucks coffee - enough said. I do like the tea offerings. I also like the breakfast sandwiches. The pastry case, as in any Starbucks, can be hit or miss. 

I border on the Yay! I'm a fan, but then I ask myself "if there was another option within walking distance would I still choose  this Starbucks?" Probably not, but this place is A-OK.

Out of all the Starbucks I have been to in the Nashville area this one is my favorite. The people are always friendly. I usually take my dog with me through the drive thru and they always say something either to her or about her. I stopped by a few nights ago, with Sophie on my lap. The girl at the drive thru window was so friendly. She said how cute Sophie was and asked if she could have a puppuccino which is a cup of whipped cream. I said that she could so she went and got a small kids cup and filled it with whipped cream. I knew about the puppuccinos because my sister works for a Starbucks but I have never actually had anyone offer it to me before. I was very impressed that she asked. 

The only bad thing about this location is that it gets so busy sometimes! I have tried going to it because it is close to my apartment some mornings before work but when I saw the line out to West End Ave I kept on driving by.
FYI: Last time I was here, it was only open until11pm...although that still puts it as one of the few Starbucks that stays open past 9pm or 10pm.

Yes it's a Starbucks and they are always amazing, but holy cow the prices!  There are several other Starbucks in downtown Indianapolis, unfortunately I thought I'd stop in at the one closest to my meetings. Big mistake. 

SIGNIFICANTLY more expensive than all the other downtown locations, and trust me I've been to them all! 

Not bad service though.

There are packs of rats darting back and forth between your feet as you sit in the front courtyard enjoying your coffee.  They are a family of rats, in fact, they appear to several families, including several large males, several large females, some teenagers. There didn't appear to be any little ones.  My friend was initially scare when the rats boldly fought or danced in the middle of the courtyard in broad daylight about 12 ft. away from us.  I convinced her that this is simply a harmless family of rats, hanging out, doing what family does.
Its a starbucks. You know you will get good service and drinks. I had the Green Iced tea. Yes it was good stuff.
I drive out of my way to go to this Starbucks. Annie is great and there is a fella inside with blonde hair who makes my drink perfectly every time!

Starbucks is Starbucks, but this one ALWAYS seems to have a line, and the retail area is hard to get to when there are ten people standing in line...it makes you feel bad that you want to browse the mugs and gifts.

Still, they are a friendly bunch behind the counter, and it's always nice and clean in here, unlike some other Starbucks locations where there never seems to be a clean table.

Lovin' my peppermint mochas this holiday season as always...I'm limiting myself to one per week!

~There's something magical that keeps me always coming back to this Starbucks, whether it be the relaxing atmosphere or excellent customer service(for the most part). It seems one can always grab a coffee, take a seat, & stare off into the streets of Philly or buckle down into some work on a laptop.  

I usually order the Nariño 70 Cold Brew, which is handcrafted in small batches daily, slow-steeped in cool water for 20 hours, without touching heat. If you're a "coffeesseur" you will definitely be able to taste the difference comparable to a regular iced coffee.

One day i was feeling a little under the weather & decided to try out the Green Tea Crème Frappuccino which is blended with sweetened premium matcha green tea, milk & ice powder in order to give a boost to my immune system. Unfortunately the "barista" goofed up on the first drink, but went above & beyond to redeem herself by giving a 4$ gift card & the extra drink. I was on cloud 9!

Unfortunately, once again, I went back to use the 4$ gift card for a cold brew, & a different "barista" made the drink absolutely horrid..hopefully this does not become a habit, as I will have to find another coffee spot. 

The Don approves of this establishment & will be back~

LOVE this Starbucks because there is an outlet wherever you sit. If you sit at the community table or at the bar, the outlets are right under the table/bar, facing down. Outlets are on the wall for the rest of the seats. Of course, it wouldn't be Starbucks if the temperature isn't at freezing, so bring a jacket. There are also lots of seating outside. The baristas here are nice and very accommodating.
Best baristas in town. Remember my name and my order every time. Well run and very efficient all around. Pretty convenient location as well right on the corner.

I am so torn. I love having this Starbucks close by Bit  I feel like this location for a drive thru wasn't the  best choice. Avoid the place during peak times if you can because navigating through the parking lot is horrid especially if you have an SUV. 

The staff is friendly and attentive. They get my order right and the mobile ordering is awesome! The bathroom and inside is clean and brand new. Plenty of seating. Great retail selection as well. 

Love the nonfat chai lattes and the pastries are always fresh. My son tried the chorizo breakfast sandwich and thought it was okay. The younger kids love the hot cocoas and they definitely keep them at kids temp. Love this Starbucks and it's my go to but I do suggest if you're doing the drive thru be patient and mindful of fellow patrons trying to make their way in the lot. Also- right turn ONLY when exiting!!!
Im not sure why there are low ratings. I went in today and there were a fair amount of people yet I received my large order quickly. The customer service was great and the food was good too.
Really great location - one of the faster Drive Thrus I've been through. People who work there are friendly and I normally have a great drink.
visiting from LA for the Hot Air Balloons, I stopped at this location about 5 am and the service was amazing, I will comeback next year to this location.
Great location and friendly staff. Lots of open tables and seating at all times of the day. Whenever I'm downtown this is my go to spot!

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. It was absolutely dirty; there were crumbs everywhere, and the tables and floors were very greasy. Also, there isnt much seating, the layout wasn't done very well and makes the space seem a lot smaller than it really is.

Not bad- the drinks were typical and fine. The wait was a bit long for as many people working as they had and indeed one of the two drinks seems to have been missed. The service was slightly less friendly than most Starbucks in this area. 

The inside is small but cozy with lots of tables for working at, and one small soft seating area. It looks
Like it would be a good place to get some work done. They also have a drive thru.

This Starbucks is awesome! The baristas are super-friendly and quick to make your order. They have a great rapport with the locals and seem to really enjoy being baristas. 

The outdoor seating is phenomenal, and is stocked with plenty of tables and outlets for laptops. I'd definitely come back here to enjoy an afternoon of productivity and friendly service! 

Great job partners!!

Stopped by this Starbucks before a trip to the DMV. My order was made perfectly and the girls that worked there were nice. The only problem was the cleanliness. I went later in the day so I understand it being a bit messy but it wouldn't hurt to wipe down your tables and check your bathroom every hour or so. 
I did like that this location had ample outside seating, as well as a counter top seating section. Overall the look was very modern. Definitely better than other Starbucks I frequent.
Starbucks is trash. Sizes shrunk. Prices inflated. Coffee is gross. Overpriced. I'd rather drink Dunkin' and they suck too.
Best Starbucks in town!!!  I had a great experience tonight.  Awesome baristas and pleasant environment.  My pumpkin spice latte was perfect.  I highly recommend this location.  Can't be beat!!!

So i was planning on going to Barnes & Noble on Dale Mabry, until i spotted this new Starbucks right next to the new Chipotle !! Whaaaat !? How awesome is that... if i get hungry after hours of studying i could just head next door !! So the parking area made me slightly claustrophobic... thank god i am a skilled driver (yeah right !!).  All kidding aside, If you came in from N Dale Mabry you get easy access to the angled parking spaces but if you come from Walnut St. you might encounter some difficulty. I don't know how they would have enough spaces for customers of both Chipotle and Starbucks on a busy day. I love the wall decorations and the different seating options they offer (from lounging spots, long counter height table, to 2 or 4 person seating). The inside looks bigger and more comfy than it appears to be from the outside. Initially, i was bummed about not having the long (non-counter height) table available to study, but the normal height 4 person seating was perfect as well. I sat with a gentleman who was also busy working on his laptop. The noise level was good for studying or working. What really made the difference were the employees that attended me. They did not seem like they were brown nosing, but like they were genuinely trying to help me out, especially when it had to do with the Starbucks Rewards program and Stars. Overall, i would definitely return (if i am ever in the area).

Not a drive-thru location, which is always disappointing. And this location is especially small inside w/only 8 small tables and limited seating. 

The staff was fairly nice, but the reason for the two-star rating was an epic fail on this location's part...how the hell do you not have any dark roast brewed? And then not even offer to brew some!? WTF? 

I desperately needed caffeine and had already walked in, so I settled for the Pike w/a shot and 4 splenda. Let me just say, that was the worst $2.71 I have spent at an SBucks to date and shame on this location for not having dark roast and denying me a well-intentioned caffeine fix!
Trash is overflowing. Cables need to be wiped. Bathrooms need to be cleaned. I think the morale is down across the board at Starbucks. Not looking good.
Drinks are good. Device is fast and friendly. Place is always clean.

Spacious with friendly service. There is more sitting room than any Starbucks I've ever been in before. Because it's in a large shopping center there's ample parking. The decor is all wood and metal which is very interesting. It's warm and inviting.

Ok, I have to admit...  For years I was NOT a fan of Starbucks.  Yeah, I had been drinking Starbucks for years, and thought they weren't bad but not that great. I am definitely a coffee lover, and in the past, I had my favorite local coffee houses and roasters that I loved.  Well, time passes, and things change, and now the places I once loved (along with their delicious coffee) are gone, and nothing more than a memory.  :-(  At some point in time, my wife told me that there was something about this particular Starbucks in Meridian.  The coffee was simply really, really good.  Well, I tried it, and she was right.  We have drank Starbucks coffee all over North America, from Seattle, to New York City, to Orlando, to Anaheim, and this Starbucks here in little ol' Meridian Idaho has them all beat.  I don't know what it is.  Is it the water?  Do they throw a little extra coffee in there?  Is it just the love they put into it?  I don't know, but this place consistently brews a really really good cup of coffee.  I also love their Chai Tea drinks.


[ My Dad is in hospital, texted me this: "My Dr only gave me 6 months to live - so I chose October to April 2056." ]

They are great! 

I have been here a handful of times throughout the past year and have thought it was a nice, clean, polite little Starbucks. None the less, my I was quite impressed with my last visit here this past Saturday. I came in here to get a quick smoothie and take a few minutes to relax. I ordered a Strawberry banana smoothie SOY. Thereafter, I proceeded to take a seat and wait for my order, received it, took a few sips and was enjoying my time. A few minutes later the cashier came around realizing it wasn't made soy, offered to remake it and as well was nice enough to offer me a coupon for another drink on the house at a later visit. 

I thought this was great service given that they realized it was made incorrectly and had the audacity to acknowledge me and make me aware of their mistake. I feel most places would realize they made a mistake and write it off as if it never occurred. 

Fantastic service, great drinks! Thank you very much.

If you go through the drive-in at this Starbucks you should be fine. But if you go inside it's a totally different story. Like this morning there were four people working the drive-through only to actually doing something and the person working the counter was helping someone who would come in before me. The person working the counter was actually standing talking with the manager and after three or four minutes of standing there watching two people in the drive-in doing nothing I decided I would go down the street to a local coffee shop this is a very frequent occurrence. If you're in any kind of a hurry or if you don't mind waiting and watching people working in actually doing nothing this might be the place for you

I'm fairly new to Starbucks, having been given a Starbucks card as a retirement gift. A friend showed me how to download the Starbucks app, which I always use to order ahead and skip the line. The Starbucks at 986 Ambassador Dr, Reno, NV 89523 off Sharlands Ave, is very convenient off the I-80 Robb Drive exit. All the Baristas are friendly and helpful, but my favorite is Chaz Cooley - Rieders. He is always so upbeat and cheerful. He really goes the extra mile! 

The only reason I gave them 4 stars instead of 5, is not the location's fault. If you order a drink AND food ahead, using the app, your drink order prints out at one place in the store, and your food prints out at ANOTHER place. They are not linked! So sometimes my beverage is ready, but my food isn't, and once I was rushed and actually forgot to ask for my food! I'd driven away and had to go BACK to pick up my food. Hopefully Starbucks will get this figured out, so it doesn't happen in the future.

Great location, right next to Rumba.  We came here to have a drink while waiting for Rumba to open.

As I stood in line, noticed a fly inside the cake cabinet next to the counter.  It was going to town, taking turns landing on all the cakes.  I  mentioned this to the cashier, who opened and closed the door to the cabinet several times.  He did not reach in to try to get the fly out, and the fly ended up untouched and unbothered.

The cashier walked away and started mopping the floor.  I picked up my receipt from the printer as the buffoon cashier forgot to give it to me.

However, my drink was good and satisfyingly cold.

This is a Starbucks, so we know what to expect when it comes to coffee and tea drinks and that's a good thing if you like Starbucks.
The people are friendly and helpful, almost offering a smile all the time...the seating area is big, clean and bright.... and they have a drive thru for people in a hurry. They also have outdoor seating.
Make sure to check the order before you leave. This place likes to fill drinks up halfway and give them to you for the full price.

Drive thru is the worst ever. I waited in line via drive thru because I had my infant twins with me and just wanted a little coffee. I waited for over 20 minutes for 4 guys to order, I never made it to even place my order cause my babies started crying. How slow can those employees be to cause that kind of backup. Absolutely ridiculous. Never visited this Starbucks again.

The only reason I am giving this 4 and not 5 stars is because of how busy this location gets. Sometimes when you plan to "dine in" it is hard to find a seat. The wifi is also slower when there are more people inside. The staff is great! They really enhance the experience and you can tell they love their jobs (or they are great actors.) They really make it a personal experience from the cashiers, to the people who make your favorite beverage. Sometimes, however, I do find it frustrating when they only have one cash register going and there are tons of people waiting in line. Overall, a great location with great employees who continue to enhance the Starbucks experience.

Definitely not the best location. I was thinking with it being so new, maybe that's what kept everyone continuously slow and rude. I decided to just start going inside due to that being much quicker than the drive thru. There are two blonde guys who work there that are amazing and have a great personality, but every woman that I've come across there is just mean. Hopefully it picks up and their attitudes improve..but for now, I'm sticking to my coffee and tea at home.

It's a Starbucks. They have a few drinks that I like.

It is a handy location with easy parking. Good staff.

It is a little tricky getting in and out at certain times due to traffic.

I've been coming to this Starbucks since the day it opened. It's my favorite ('cuz it's in my neighborhood). Quality of product is standard. Service has always been good in my experience. Staff is pleasant and attentive.

Much better capacity since they ditched most of their kitsch. Recently they overhauled the furniture, I give that change a C+. However, if you have a group of 8-12, there are 3 big tables that will seat you comfortably.
When I ordered a coffee they only filled the cup 2/3 of the way. I am disappointed. This is not what I payed for.

Typical Starbucks as far as coffee drinks go.  I prefer this location in St. Pete however. The staff here is always friendly. I've yet to get any attitude from anyone. Always very clean when I'm there. I love that they have a bar that you can sit at or tables and chairs. Plenty of places to hook your computer/smart phone up to. 

Any time I go through the drive through, they seem to move the line along fairly quickly. 

This location is very close to Tyrone Square Mall and many stores/restaurants. 

Not a fan of their "plain" coffee however (and that's at ANY Starbucks). Every one I have tried is super bitter. LOVE the white-chocolate mocha and other drinks though!

First time at this new location and went through the drive thru. No one in front of me but it took almost 5 minutes before someone came to the window to take my money. Once she came she was super friendly but the wait was a little surprisingly. I got a java chip with an extra shot and it was amazing as always.

3.5 stars.  It's a no frills Starbucks.  Nothing great, nothing bad.  Busy little location, 2 registers chugalugging, long line, and the highlight, a loft with seating.

When in the area, and you must get a fix, this works.

I dont love Starbucks. I think their coffee tastes too strong, has too much caffeine and is overpriced. 
The two things I truly like about this particular Starbucks is their location and their size.
Their location is right in the heart of Belle Meade and so is a great place to meet. It is also one of the larger Starbucks, with plenty of seating, so it is a great place to meet.
If you like Starbucks, you'll love this one. If you are not a fan, this one is better than most
The address is actually 125 E Swedesford Rd...it is in the Gateway Shopping Center. It's great! The service is super friendly and there is a ton of seating. Everyone should go here.

Great place that will happily make the special beverages not on the menu.  The North McCarran location should take a queue on how to run their location from this one!! I will go out of my way to get their awesome Vanilla Bean Latte!  Baristas are all super friendly and welcome you with a smile!!

Awful customer service!! They cannot get a drink right even when you explicitly give your order.  The drive thru is SO slow.  If Im in a hurry, Ill go out of my way to go to the location north on Little in NPR--its faster to drive that much further than wait.  Im at the point where they pay me now because I get a refund when they mess up plus I get a free drink card.  Reported to manager several times--gave up that route.  He couldn't care less--its obvious why his tram is so inadequate.  Unfortunately, the owners are losing money due to manager's inability to train the staff.

My friend ordered a flat white and it was ok, not as well prepared as she's had at other Starbucks.  I had a breakfast sandwich and friend tried it as well and lets say it mostly went in the trash.  To sum things up, the experience at this Starbucks could have been better if we were greeted with a smile and some enthusiasm, however young lady at counter couldn't do either as much as we were trying to be infectious with ours. Great customer service can a lot of times compensate for mistakes.  Hope this helps improve things at this location.

Under construction to become an even better location. It's small, so I probably would not spend much time here working or anything like that. But it's a nice spot to eat lunch at or chat with a friend. For me it's three blocks from work so it's a no-brainier. Friendly but quiet staff. I like my Starbucks baristas loud and obnoxious. But I won't knock them for that. :)

I stopped at the Starbucks off Grand near Tower Grove Park on the way to The Botanical Garden this afternoon at 2:22pm. From the moment I walked in the cafe', I wished I had gone to Panera down the street! The lady at cash register and the lady who gave me my drink both had an attitude and never once smiled. They acted as if I had inconvenienced them. I ordered a Venti Iced Caramel Macchiato with Almond Milk, which by the way tasted terrible! The only reason I didn't say anything is because I just wanted to be out of that cafe'! Honestly, I will never step foot in that Starbucks again! If you hate your job that badly, find somewhere else to work!

I am a Starbucks fanatic. I expect perfection when I order a drink and this location delivers perfection. They get to know you and remember who you are, remember what you drink and are the nicest! 

I use the rewards app and order my drink ahead. It is always waiting for me when i walk in, hot and ready!
Love this location! The baristas are always up beat and friendly, knowledgeable and faat. They updated the seating and added. Ore tables but took away the comfy arm chairs to relax in.
I've only been to this location a couple times, but it seems nice enough. Spacious and a beautiful layout. If I can get my frappucino fix, I'm happy!

gross. early in the afternoon today, I went in here for a drink. watching the barista make my drink... he stuck his fingers in his mouth then went to finish making my drink. I stopped him and told him I wanted him to wash his hands and for someone else to make my drink over again. I regret that I didn't obtain his name or demand my money back. I'm feeling disgusted now thinking about how many other times he's dug around in his mouth with his fingers and touched equipment, food, and anything else for that matter. truly horrified by this and will not be returning to this location

Starbucks is still my go to in the morning on the way to work. The new staffers here can be very slow, but they do a good job with the drinks. I only wish Starbucks would keep the salted caramel mocha around all year.
I have never had a bad SKINNY CARAMEL MACCHIATO (the only thing I order haha) here. The service is always super friendly and quick! Love this place.

Never fails. Every time I'm there the drive thru window line is insanity. 

But most times I wait and order the same thing a large unsweet green tea lemonade. 

The last 7 times I've been there.  5 times the order has been wrong.  They charge for a GTL and I always receive a watered down green tea

Today I decided to go inside.  8 people were working.  No one was in line.  

It took 13 minutes to get my beverage.  


Ummmmmm....

Staff is friendly and great, but this is the second time I have gone though the drive thru, ordered a reduced fat turkey breakfast sandwich and it was cold. 

The first time I thought, maybe they messed up or their oven was not working or their freezer works too well. 

Now, this is the second time. Disappointing. I guess I will have to check my food before driving off in the future. 

Not a good way to start the day.
Let us congregate at St. Arbucks.

4 stars for great consistent coffee, but 3 stars for service:

Out of the Starbucks locations in the area, this location is very consistent with how their coffee and specialty coffee drinks are made. Yes, there may be a line all the time but 1) it is the only one within 4 mile radius and 2) it is the one that makes it consistently good each time. I never really have a complaint about this location.

Sometimes their customer service needs work. If no one is at the cash register but other employees are stocking things or making coffee, I'd appreciate it you would at least acknowledge me and let me know that someone will be with me so I'm not left thinking you are ignoring me. This happens once in a while, but not all the time.

Parking can be a pain, but you are in a very busy shopping center, especially on weekends, holidays or sales.

This location is not for one who is in a hurry.

I had a friend order a light frappuccino blended. Barista thought that meant to blend it for half the time. I don't know why they would think anyone would order a drink like that, and cant use a little common sense.

This morning I placed my order on the mobile app which is normally very convenient but today I somehow accidentally sent my order to the keystone store which is way out of my way. When I got to the Robb store and realized the mistake, I was already late for work and stressed but the staff there was very nice and helpful, my made my order quickly and even honored the fact that I already paid to the keystone store. Thanks Robb Starbucks!

I am a regular Starbucks customer and occasionally hit this location on the way to work. Service is ok most days but not today for sure! I ordered a Venti Pike and a couple things to eat at the drive through. Let me clue your drive through workers about something. IT IS IMPORTANT TO MAKE SURE THE LIDS ARE PROPERLY ON THE COFFEE CUP! The window attendant hands me the cup and the lid pops completely off and coffee spills out of the cup all over me, my center console with my phone, wallet, ear phones ect. Soaking everything. Scalding hot coffee on my shirt and pants. The attendant looks at me and says, "Oh sorry can I get you another coffee?" Are you freaking kidding me! How about a roll of paper towels and some burn cream for my leg! News flash....Hot coffee is dangerous and hurts when it is all over you body. And needless to say my leg is bright red at the moment, My white shirt is probably ruined and I know for sure my iphone and headphones were not made to be soaked by the better part of a Venti cup of coffee. Seriously get a clue!!
This location is constantly understaffed .. wait time is absolutely awful ..morning , day of night ..

This is one of my favorite Starbucks in Tucson. Building is relatively new, so it is clean and stylish. 

Service is always fast and friendly. My strange requests welcomed with a smile :)

The baristas are bunch beauties. Drinks are always made correctly and make me feel as good as some cocaine on a Monday morning. Sounds depressing? Actually it's the opposite. Me and a couple boys last week did a full send and nailed some broads. Woke up Monday morning did the white and it made me feel like I was born in a new light.

I understand this is a busy location, like many others in the area. But the wait time is uncalled for. The staff is always nice, which is why I gave it 3 stars. If this was based on time it'd be a 1. I go out of my way to the Park st. location so I won't be late to work! Put it this way, if you're looking for a cool place to chat/lounge/study with great customer service, perfect. But if you are in a hurry,  try to find another location.

Friends don't let friends drink fourbucks.  This particular location is crowded fduring the AM rush especially.

I also call it CHARbucks as the coffee drinks usually are roastde too dark for me.  The espresso drinks are passable - but be careful as they are loaded with sugar and often with fat if you get them made with whole milk.

Not a big fan of Starbucks in general.  We grind and brew our own at home using peregrine coffee beans for a fraction of the price.

The rating is for the establishment, not for the coffee.

The best part about this Starbucks is that it's huge and has tons of seating. There is a location besides this one closer to where I live, but I drive the extra mile to be able to get a place to sit. 

This location was redone in the past year and they installed a bunch of outlets which was much needed (there were only 2 prior to the redo). Very convenient for you to set up shop with your laptop and stay a while.

The staff is hit or miss - some of the baristas are extreme friendly and go out of their way to be of service, but others are always grumpy and make you feel like you're an inconvenience. Depending on who is working the staff can get EXTREMELY loud and - as Fiona pointed out - it's almost unruly at times.

Free wifi is nice. I wish they had outdoor seating.

Oh, bring a jacket! Even in the summer. This place is ALWAYS. FREEZING.
Typical Starbucks, coffee is always good and I enjoy the vanilla scones. A nice treat for a morning sweet fix.

If you ever are driving by this Starbucks, stop by. I recommend it!

What I had was the pumpkin spice latte, hold the whip cream. It was great. It came out fast, under two minutes, and service was friendly. This was surprising because there were a lot of customers. 
I came at about seven pm. 

If you go around this season, I'd definitely recommend.

Coffee is quick and tastes wonderful.

Clean and with good service. Everything is as you would expect. They are not open very late. There are only limited places to plug in your laptop.

You could close your eyes, open them again, and be in any Starbucks in the area. 100% generic.
When this morning and they messed up my drink twice. This isn't the first time this has happened, it's almost every time I go. I only continue to go back because it is the closest one.

I have recently been going to this Starbuck's more due to the fact all my meetings are very close to this location.  I was having a bad day and they asked how I was doing and I said terrible and they gave me a free drink.  It was really great and kind.  I went there the following day and the barista asked if I was having a better day.  It was great to know they remembered me and cared enough to ask.  I am really impressed by this location!

In my mind, there isn't much bad to say about a place that guarantees getting your drink right, is open a lot of convenient hours, and has a drive through.  I'll pay a little extra for quality and correctness.  The service at this Starbucks is great, the store is clean, and parking is plentiful.  The only downside is that you can only enter approaching the store heading south on Route 309 -- if you're coming from the south you'll probably have to wait through a light at 5 points to find somewhere to make a uey.  The drive-in gets a little backed up in the mornings, but you have your choice: take a few minutes to enjoy the what's on NPR while you're waiting for your coffee -- or unsweetened iced tea as my case may be -- or park the car and go in.  If you're short on time but not on foot power, head inside and mingle while you order your drink.  You won't regret it.  They're a friendly bunch!

This store has been amazing. Everyone there is so friendly and very knowledgable. The coffee master Chris helped me out, he told me what kind of grind I needed for my k cup filter. He even got me into Verona my new favorite coffee!  I never have a bad visit or a bad cup of coffee. I prefer going to this store in particular because of the staff, keep it up Starbucks!

BAD!!!! Most of my order was right, except for the drink I wanted. I had ordered a Salted Caramel Mocha. I was given a Pumpkin Spice Latte. Not what I wanted. I cannot say that I was pleased with my drink. #StarbucksFail
Quiet place for two or even a short business meeting. Outside patio allows private conversations in the evening and their inside atmosphere is very inviting

I was always a frequent patron of Starbucks, especially this location because it's so conveniently located to my house. I just can't fathom paying Starbucks prices anymore when there's so many other delicious local coffee spots in this area. The inconsistency of their beverages and breakfast sandwiches is unbelievable. No matter what kind of hot coffee you get it almost always taste burn, all iced drinks come with entirely too much ice even if you ask for light ice, and I've bit into way too many cold centered breakfast sandwiches. Maybe they have gotten so mainstream and overly popular that they just don't put any care into what they are giving their customers anymore. I'd much rather go a few minutes out of my way to coffee places like Bandit or Black Crow for a quality cup of coffee.

I love Starbucks. I love being able to order/pay from my phone. My only issue is that if I was a customer in the store and I ordered my drink with no whip it would come to me without whip cream. Now, I understand that Starbucks is typically always busy but if a person orders from their phone and the order says no whip it then it should be no whip.
Great service, quick and ready when we got to the window utilizing the Mobil ordering app.  Zendaya got her pup cup and was beyond happy!

The redesign has helped this store manage the high volume a lot, and it doesn't feel as crowded anymore. It's not as cozy, as it once was, but given that it's mostly a haven for students slaving over homework, that makes sense. There's a long table with electrical outlets underneath, so if you need a place to hang out and get work done, you'll find a seat here.
The baristas are worth a mention--they are amazing. They're friendly, personable, and quick. Even when there's a line they people moving pretty fast, and drinks come out at a good rate. They also manage to pick up the straw wrappers and sugar spills that inevitably follow a rush. If you're looking for a Starbucks to make your home base, so to speak, the friendly and genuine people behind the counter here make it a good option. Not all Starbucks are alike. The staff here makes a big difference, so I'd check it out.

Stopped in last night (walked in did not use drive thru) and the place was empty at 8 PM.
I actually thought they were closing, but they were just cleaning.

Very nice shift manager and 2 female baristas.

Got my kid a Peach Iced Green tea Lemonade and I got a Grande Caramel Macchiatto.
Both were just perfect.

No issues.

The staff here are quick and courteous.  Also, once they get to know you, you're like part of the family. 
The dining area is big enough to work or just sit and talk with someone. 
Stop in and enjoy a hot beverage, a frozen concoction, or even a delicious cold-brew special. 
Tell them Pastor Randy sent you ~ PastorJavaMan

I usually use the mobile app for this location because of the parking lot (not their fault) and the traffic. I walked in and it was busy with very few employees. 3 for a morning does not seem like enough. Anyways, I am standing at the pick-up counter and the girl yells out my name, sounding confused which is acceptable you don't know many customers. She tells me they do not have coconut milk and if soy is ok. I am not allowed to really drink soy, but I already paid over $5 for my drink that was supposed to be coconut milk. So i said yes, and the guy who received my cup looked at the order, very confused. I am thinking that he must be new. I watch him make my drink because on my order it is a grande green tea latte with coconut milk light ice. No where on the order did i put sweetener. What does he do at the very end, he adds sweetener. I was mad and irritated since my drink was not ready, it was completely wrong, and making a scene early in the morning will just ruin everyone's day. So i took the drink and left. I despise this location because I have to tell them my order when i walk, two times so they do not mess it up. I hate that it is the closest one to my work.
Grabbed a quick lunch before my mani-pedi. The Thai-style peanut chicken wrap was just divine!

I've never seen a balcony within a Starbucks before! Mind blown!! I wish they had that in my neck of the woods. I would enjoy it so much more.. all the starbucks look the same, but this one is set apart from the rest. The young man who took my order was really friendly and seemed to have a nice personality. I used to work for Starbucks and I can honestly say that excellent customer service skills are acquired while working for this particular company, and this young kid seemed to know whats up. As a patron of Starbucks' everywhere, its nice to know that they do their best to put a smile on your face.
Drinks are always quick and on point. Not to mention Aaron made our morning last week with his singing through the drive up speaker. Glad to have a solid Starbucks close by!
Great crew that is consistently friendly, fast, and accurate with my orders. I love to lounge here - wish they had more comfortable areas for that though.

Yes, I am indeed addicted to Starbucks. I haven't had the pleasure to drink much coffee lately cause of my stress levels, but I do stop in sometimes for just their scones!!! The blueberry one is always the best!!! Highly recommend that one!

I really like the staff here, they do their job instead of messing around or chatting to other employees like you aren't even their. Great place all around.

Great service, always a great coffee and nice place to hang out. I went here with a good friend of mine and as we sat down, there was a guy coming over us and gave her a necklace and gave me a ring and said that he doesn't need it anymore so he gave us the jewelry. We both ended up giving him back those jewelry. It was a weird weird day..

Three years ago this place operated like clock work. Not sure what happened, but it seems that they are always out of drink ingredients and staff take forever to assist you, even if there is no one in line ahead of you.
Starbucks is Starbucks.  Nice atmosphere and typical $bucks

This is a Starbucks, so we know what to expect when it comes to coffee and tea drinks and that's a good thing if you like Starbucks.
The people are friendly and helpful, almost offering a smile all the time...the seating area is big, clean and bright.... and they have a drive thru for people in a hurry

Awesome job guys! You feed my caffeine addiction! For that I thank you! 

Keep showing your new hires the fine tunings of taking care of people and their need for caffeine! 

The new frappacino the cookie chocolate one is awesome!

Not a fan of this location in particular, the location promotes unsafe foot traffic routes through the parking lot, most of the baristas here either don't seem to be trained properly and/or have absolutely no sense of urgency. Its not a leisure thing grabbing coffee before work or a meeting and having to feel pressed for time by a barista that feels like they can take their sweet time with every single drink. Take an espresso shot and get to work.
I go to this Starbucks almost twice a week and they are so awesome. The customer service is wonderful and they are always always super friendly.

On the third morning of our cross country trip we had a delightful experience at this drivethru.    The staff was refreshingly cheerful and even offered recommendations for a place to visit in the Bay Area (our final destination ).  We left the window with delicious lattes and smiles.    Thanks Kelci and male voice taking orders.

This is my LAST VISIT to this Starbucks. I met a friend this past Friday afternoon. I walked in and no one was in line so I was excited to be able to order my right away. WRONG!!  The two people behind the counter were busy arranging the food and counting money. The talk slim girl at the cash register didn't even look up. I stood there for several minutes without acknowledgement. I walked out and told my friend what happened and so she chose not to order anything. We sat outside at the tables and drank our own water. We used to meet here 1-2 times per week. We changed our location and will now go to the Starbucks on Speedway and Wilmot. This is a double bonus location as Trader Joe's is in the same complex.

I've tried to visit this location 5 times and have only actually ordered twice...once being a mobile order that I waited 15-minutes for after arrival because the line was almost out the door. Not sure why this location is always so packed, or if the service is just that slow, but either way I tend to avoid this Starbuck's by all costs.
Typical Starbucks. The line was wrapped all the way through the room but they got us through pretty quickly. Staff were very friendly.

I was in this Starbucks location yesterday at approx 10:15 AM to get iced coffee. No espresso shots, no steamed milk, nothing froufrou. There was six employees behind the counter. Took 35 minutes to get plain, simple iced coffee. This location should get its game on or people will be going elsewhere.

I went to this Starbucks today and I waited in line for 14 minutes. When I expressed to the barista my frustration she argued with me and said it had been 5 minutes. Great customer service! Keep it up! I seriously spend way too much money here to get this type of treatment.

Coffee Coffee Coffee... We need Coffee.  So I might be a little hyper for this review as I just had a coffee with three shots of espresso in it but I am I high energy person with a high energy job and a type A+ personality so coffee is like mothers milk and this place has that milk for me. (insert breath) So I came here and while I am usually on the go and running to work my 12+ hour days with a coffee float on my energy drinks, this place helped me s-l-o-w down.  OK.  This is cool like most Starbucks but this one is a bit more comfortable than most.  It has a big outdoor seating area.  It is in a quiet and upscale community.  There are also a bunch of nice shops around it which adds some nice ambiance.  It is just a nice place to chill and relax unless you like espresso like me and then it is a great place to recharge.

Tried the new Strawberry tea infusion with 2 pumps of syrup not 7, as per the recipe. Wonderfully refreshing and ice cold. Here's hoping they keep it on the venue beyond summer. Friendly barista today and clean interior of the store. A five star day for them. 



Got my order correct today. Inside clean and a personable barista. 


I have no idea how the Starbucks could possibly be rated as high as it is. Today I was here and asked for a mocha frappe P with caramel. The barista asked me if I wanted the caramel in it or on top. I replied I wanted the caramel sauce on top. I received my frappucinno
Very crowded Starbucks with long lines and long wait times for orders. Best thing about this location? LOTS of seating both indoors and outdoors. This one's not bad if you're not in a hurry.

Been to this spot twice in the last month. Both times the services was horribly slow. I actually had just came from the king of Prussia store which was twice as busy with the same amount of employees and got in and out in less than a fraction of the time it took this store to make one simple latte.
Best service with a smile thanks for making the magic happen and having great connections!!

This is my office away from home. As others have stated, parking is a mess. But I usually find something. The baristas seem nice enough. I've never had problems. Upstairs is great to kill time or get work done. On occasion, the music is really loud so people have asked to lower it. But overall, a good space.

This is probably my fav Starbucks on the south side. It's always warm inside, which is nice during the winter. Of course, do note that occasionally it get too warm (usually late evenings when the heat is still up but fewer people opening the door so less heat escapes). 

I never order complicated drinks, so I can only attest that they pour coffee and hot water well - lol. 

Great environment with tons of outlets, so it is ideal for laptops. Seating area is small (an issue with all the south side Starbucks locations) so you have a long counter with 14 chairs, one tall long table for working (multiple outlets in table) that seats 8, two lower tables that seat 4 each, and two high small tables that seat 3-5 (but the table is so small only enough space for drinks). Great soft lighting.
Two thumbs down on this awkwardly placed drive-thru Starbucks. Staff is a hot or miss with customer service.

I come to this Starbucks often. I've been a gold card member for years and was so excited about this location opening (it's on my way to work). This is the second time I've had an issue with Gwen. Simply put she is rude. Speaks to you like you're 3 years old. Coming here is the highlight and start to my day but I'll be driving right on through if she's working...felt like somebody should at least read my frustration.

I am giving this a four star rating as far assuming that an "average" Starbucks is three stars.  This Starbucks compared to others has a really relaxed, inviting, vibe and ample seating but what it gains in atmosphere it lacks in customer service.  There are long waits for drinks and most of the staff seems pretty inexperienced.  With that said it is a cozy spot that is a great option to meet a friend at either after or before taking a walk at Tyler State Park.

I know a lot of people like to rag on Starbucks for one reason or another but I'm a relatively picky coffee drinker and I still find them to make a decent cup. I've been to a lot of Starbucks, I think we all have, they are on almost every street corner and they always serve the exact same thing. But there is one difference and that's the employees. I know that locally I avoid a couple different Starbucks because the baristas there are terrible. They are rude to customers and they don't like to help you. But that isn't the case at this one. Everyone is always friendly and nice, they try and help you out if you're not sure what you want to order, and they always seem really excited to see me. I do love this location.

So sad I can't give a good rating but this is the fifth time in a row my order has been messed up.  It's unfortunate because they are also so slow, so when your order comes out wrong you can't even complain because it's likely you are already late to work.  I refuse to go back, especially when there is another Starbucks up the street.

Busy location! But their drinks are consistent and the baristas are friendly and fast. Although the lines are long, they actually get orders out in good time. Not a very big Starbucks, but it seems like a lot of people take it to go anyways since this location is right in front of a shopping plaza.

Haven't received a bad drink yet the times I've been here. I always order an extra shot of espresso in my coffee and they make it just right. I sometimes swing by after dropping my son off at his class or before taking the dog to the park in this area.

Other than the very limited parking (as every other reviewer has noted) this is a great Starbucks.  I've never had a problem with the staff and surprisingly never had my order messed up.  The staff seems to be knowledgeable of all the new Starbucks products coming out and are very attentive to every customer.  I'd say this is the product of a great manager, but I never actually see the manager around working with the staff, so it must just be great personalities on their part.

I've never stuck around to lounge around in the upstairs but it does make a cozy workspace if one is needed.  Stop by this Starbucks and you won't be disappointed.

I gave this place two stars because I still drank most of it, but this is a green tea latte... or at least that was what it was supposed to be. The green tea powder was not dissolved into the drink, so it just tasted like milk with chunks of powder. I always go for the green tea latte at Starbucks, but this franchise seems like they don't know how to make it.

Also, they don't accept Starbucks gift cards, but that doesn't bother me. Service was whatever. They weren't mean or anything.

Today I went to Starbucks with my sister, my niece, and my son and we experienced The worst customer service. The cashier was a younger looking guy with long hair. He was rude and impatient. He immediately assumed that I was drinking a white mocha when I was trying to say ice blended macchiato. As me and my sister were paying I wanted to treat her and she wanted to treat me and so we both pulled out our forms of payment and he said "I'm not going to play this stupid game" and turned around. Me and my sister just couldn't wait to get out of there at that point. He got the order wrong and was rude. The female barista that helped us out was also rude. Didn't smile, didn't acknowledge us, and when my niece asked her for whip cream on her drink she said "no" so offensively. Upon reviving our drinks we noticed my sisters drink was a small and we all ordered medium drinks. Overall a disappointing experience..
Love the drive-thru here. I've been going several times per week and they now know my order before I order. I've had only one bad drink made here and they re-made it without question. Superb!

It's Starbucks, ya' know? And there's nothing wrong with that. 

I like this location; in the morning, the west-facing patio is out of the sun's death rays. The staff are usually caffeinated enough to be friendly. And there always seems to be nice people in this store. 

It's no Exo, but it's a nice Starbucks at a nice location.
Friendly workers, of course expensive. I can't understand why they don't put up a fence by the drive through. The view is all of their garbage, very unsightly!

The staff always greet with a smile, are always friendly, courteous and make make a seriously mean Peppermint Mocha!! I visit every morning and even with the long line of cars, they move extraordinarily fast. Best Starbucks around! Easy 5 stars! Keep up the great work!! :-)

A very busy intersection and so the parking lot is one way. Supposedly.

This Starbucks has a different layout from ones I've seen before. I think it was a converted home. A very small downstairs sitting area with only two tables in addition to the usual counters and coolers with sandwiches and pastries.

Upstairs seating area is a lot bigger, if you're okay with stairs.

Staff seemed friendly enough and while I sat there with my coffee and breakfast sandwich, they took care of customers quickly while they kibbitzed.

There is no drive through.

Very friendly staff and place is really clean with lots of seating. Have been there twice and both times were great. My second time being there, tried a new drink and I wanted to add some more cream into my drink and they were more than accommodating my request with a smile. Would definitely recommend going to this Starbucks.

This Starbucks has been great to me over the years. I came here the other day ordered some drinks and sat up in their loft seating area, very cool place to sit.

If you have to go pee, don't hold it, the bathrooms are key code entry... so a barista needs to shout the code to you, this could lead to problems. This is probably because of the insane amount of peddlers and homeless that crowd the streets of Santa Barbara.

The service here was great. The parking in downtown can be tough if you think you are going to park right out in front of wherever you are going.

Great spot!
The staff is super nice and friendly and knowledgeable. Store is clean, customers friendly. I would recommend this Starbucks location to anyone.

Went to this Starbucks today through the drive thru since there was no where to park. It wasn't a busy time either. 

I order my drink and there was only one car ahead. When I get to the window, I pay and I am given my drink. It's a typical paper cup with lid but coffee has been dripping out on the sides. It's messy and sticky. And I notice it was not the size I ordered (Venti). I hand in back and tell them, and he takes my drink back- within a minute I have a new drink. 

I have to rush off back to college at that point and I am not really expecting much from my drink. But when I get to school and I open the lid, I notice the drink wasn't at the top. Instead it started over 2 inches down. 

Did they really do that? Make me the wrong size and when I complained just put my drink in a bigger cup so I would shut up? Looks like they did that too me.

This Starbucks has so much potential with it's large outdoor covered seating area. A huge bonus for those who don't care for air conditioning. Unfortunately, the patrons of the cigar shop next door also sit outside...and smoke cigars. Yuck. Totally ruins it.

I can easily see this as being one of my favorite Starbucks.

When I first got here, I was surprised that there is a drive-through -- I 've never seen that in a Starbucks before. In other coffee shops, yes, but not at a Starbucks. But then, the Starbucks I used to frequent were all in a very walkable, not very car-friendly city. There is a guy who stands outside of the place, within easy reach of the drive-through customers -- I don't know what he's selling or asking money for, but I've seen customers give him money.

I liked their outdoor seating. There are enough places for a few dozen people. It's shaded, but perhaps the sun will hit people at certain times of the day. In the center of the seating is a fireplace. I have yet to experience how cold the winters will get here, but I can see the draw of this (if they use it).

Inside is a typical Starbucks. On the left, it looks like an office lobby: Comfortable chairs for reading. On the right are the expected rows of tables and people all absorbed in their laptops. I'm assuming the place has air conditioning, if only because it didn't feel hot or stuffy inside.

The pastry offering is not extensive as some Starbucks. But it has the basic donuts and cheese danishes and cakes and muffins that I've seen elsewhere. I was only on a breakfast mission, so I did not see if there were any sandwiches on display.

The staff who took my order were very friendly. No problems with my order whatsoever.

If anything, I happily felt like a Luddite, as I whipped out my old-fashioned book and read it outside in gorgeous weather while the people inside were hunched over their laptops.
Fast and easy. Always gets the order correct and staff is friendly and knowledgable.

Really nice cashier, service was fast and location was in a nice spot. I would come back to this spot. 

I would recommend this spot

This Starbucks is never super crowded (and I typically go in the morning-prime coffee hour).  The service is always fast and the staff is always friendly.  This morning I went to pick up breakfast for my bf & me... got him a sausage cheddar & egg sandwich (he LOVES them) and myself an egg white feta & spinach wrap. (Related: they seem to run out of these wraps if you don't get there early enough).  

Our drink orders included a caramel frap for him and a soy chai for me.  I didn't specify if I wanted my drink hot or iced (I wanted it hot) and the barista didn't ask me and when it came out, it was iced.  I didn't wanna send it back because I felt like it was partially my fault for not clarifying, but I was actually quite pleased with the mistake because on this warm day, an iced soy chai hit the spot!

Excited for a new Starbucks to open near me, in the beginning it was great and they were fully staffed. Now when I go to get coffee before work in the morning, they seem to keep me in a line for 20 min. ( even when there's only 2 cars). Can someone say understaffed ?

Spanking new Starbucks, open less the a week.
It has everything you expect from a Starbucks, and that's good... people are friendly and helpful 
Coffee is good, cold brew is on tap.....
Big store with plenty of seating both inside and outdoors
They have a drive thru as well...

I've never had anything but great service here! In and out fast, just like you want at a Starbucks. The employees are extremely friendly too. My drinks have always been well made. The only thing that I don't like is the location. It's a tight fit in the parking lot and when the drive through line is long, it sometimes goes out on the street. However, even when they are busy, I have never had to wait long! This Starbucks is on it!

Stopped in approximately 7:15am to order a green tea. The cashier stated they were out of both varieties of green tea.

...What? How does that happen? Tea packets are the cheapest thing to stock and store. I drove down the street to the other Starbucks and ordered without any issue.

For those looking to study, this Starbucks is a gem. The top floor precludes crying babies. It also has approx 9 round tables and 5 sofas which makes it choice to hit the books.

I don't like Starbucks, but I like this particular one.
Would be 4 stars except we dock 1 for a small, cramped bathroom.

I am here probably more than I should be. It's just so close to my house and the coffee is always delicious.
