They kinda have a bad set up and the drive thru line sometimes goes into the street, but if you just park and run inside it's pretty quick. The staff is friendly and the store is clean. They have very clean bathrooms.

Initially couldn't serve me because all I had was a $100 bill (us dollars). After i stood baffled and again requested to pay for my mocha and get some normal change the barista offered me the option of the $94 change in $1 bills and quarters or a starbucks gift card. Dutch Bros and Peets take $100 bills no problem during regular business hours, I'm surprised that a business as busy as Starbucks selling coffee drinks at $6 each doesn't have appropriate change at 2:00 in the afternoon.
This is the best Starbucks in Tampa! Everyone is friendly and gives great service. The outside seating area is great and provides a quiche atmosphere.

A comfortable, clean, intimate space. Always have experienced friendly staff and positive service. I've come here many times to study or meet up with friends to chat. (Or when giftcards were wanted to be used, since the Starbucks in Barnes and Noble at the mall does not take them). Chipotle, Subway, and Baskin Robbins are in the same strip, so catering different tastes is quite easy. Outdoor seating is set off to the side of the building and is more spacious then most Starbucks outdoor seating areas.

Okay, I've been coming here for a few years now and I guess its only fair to say that from a staffing perspective everyone is very nice.  The LOCATION suffers a bit because of how crammed it is onto West End and in the morning the drive thru line easily backs up onto the street.   However, the staff generally keeps the line moving along pretty well.

It would be nice if it had more parking, but overall they will treat you right.

Visiting trinity this past 10 days. Love Starbucks coffee and was there twice a day. Problem was sugar and cream at counter was never attended to. Very frustrating.  This seems like the simplest thing that manager should stress to it's workers

This is the newest SB in NWReno, and it has all the things you might expect...
and that fancy CLOVER machine.
https://www.starbucks.com/coffee/learn/clover

I may not often get a cup from the Clover, but DAMN it makes the place smell better than most Starbucks.

---
Also, very kid friendly, and the crew is nice, even when I show up to meet with my boss, and not my cute kids.

Aside from one or two employees the workers there have such a stick up their ass! They never smile, give you looks and always look they are miserable! It is actually amusing. Everyone that goes there says the same thing.  It's not the best coffee but if you want some pure entertainment go order from there:) they bring new meaning to the word Debbie downer:) I love Starbucks and people at corporate though:)
This is legitimately the slowest Starbucks in America. Maybe don't have 1 barista working during the 8am rush hour on a Friday.... I waited 25 minutes for a latte.

Ok... lets start off positive. Still the best coffee. Still over priced. But good. Now, onto the problem. If you are selling food then stock food. 9 our of 10 times going to this facility they do not have what is on the menu. They are out. And, most of the time it is 10am in the morning. There is NO way they can run out so please don't give that as an excuse. I will probably still come here.... I just wish they would fix their shiznit!!!

Starbucks is a Starbucks, and anywhere in the us u go is the same, but what matter, is who is working...i notice a lots of Starbucks ran by unprofessional employees....maybe the manager is coold and okay for the company, but being super friendly is not good, because after a while all the boundaries between the customer and the employee will be gone and they won't care more....
I also notice some dome employees, and they careless if u like the drink or the service.
This location can't manage 5 or 6 customers goes on line at once, and it will be a mess.

I give 2 start for the starbucks not for the location, because ill never go back there

Drinks were good as almost always are at any location. However, service was seriously lacking in several ways. Among the worst was when a lady next to us crashed chair into my arm causing my just received hit Chai Latte to fall and splatter all over the floor. It took at least 7 minutes for someone to offer a towel or show up with a mop. No inquiry about whether or not I was burned and no concern for the dozens of other customers slipping in the mess. I had to put a chair over it myself to protect people from stepping in it and falling. 

Once someone showed up with s mop there was no offer to get me another one, free or otherwise. The lady who spilled it walked away as if nobody else in the place existed and I got bupkis. I'll be back because they get it right more often then not and I love their products, but just maybe not to this one.  I gave 2 stars instead of 1 because the two tiny sips I got tasted pretty good.

Unfortunately, every time I've come in to this Starbucks, the customer service was pretty horrible. Not only does it take forever to get a drink, the coffee was not very good (compared to other Starbucks) and the baristas were not friendly. Definitely not my fav, and meh, i've definitely experienced better.

Pretty average Starbucks. I asked for an unsweetened, no ice, lemonade-iced tea. I received a full of sugar, iced tea. Not the end of the world but as the only person in line, I was hoping for a bit more attention to detail. 

The pastries were stale on a Sunday evening... If they're not fresh don't put them out!

Starbucks, A place that is, quite literally on every corner.  Now o'days seeing it can be an eyesore, and the coffee quite lackluster.  But man there is no way I can give two stars to starbucks, not after all the times it has saved my life from a near coma during work.  The staff is alert and friendly, always on the ball, even better they are fast (fast food... coffee style).  I can get a regular cup of coffee, exactly how I like it, at a pace that will make your head spin.  So what if the coffee comes from some mans diarrhea that gets sprayed out of a machine, it wakes you up... all i can ask for when in a hurry.

Overall:  the coffee aint the best... but its good enough. lol.

Everyone at this establishment is so incredibly happy and energetic and friendly whenever I come in! I'm from Michigan but I visit franklin for a week almost every month and even though I'm gone for a month at a time the ladies and gentlemen baristas still remember my name and my drink order! As a barista myself I know how hard it can be to always maintain a smile while working behind the counter but these baristas never seem to have a problem keeping their smiles and attitudes happy and friendly! Definitely my favorite Starbucks I've ever been to!
Was not happy with my drink today. I paid 4.55 for green tea with extra tea, my drink came out all milky and no tea taste.. very disappointed!

If I'm going to go to a Starbucks (primarily for the lemon pound cake), this is one of my favorite locations in Tucson. Convenient parking, generous seating areas inside and out,  and friendly staff. The lines can get kind of long, but generally my drink (and lemon pound cake) are delivered quickly enough.

Since it's getting cold out I've had to find a more convenient, coffee-inclusive way to get home from my boyfriend's house than my former walk-ten-blocks-to-Tra Amici, walk-10-blocks-to-LRT.
My solution incorporates the Starbucks on the corner of 101 St and Jasper Ave, formerly a coffee shop called Baraka, although infinitely smaller. A quick grande bold and I'm out the door. There doesn't seem to be a lot of sitting spots available most of the time, anyway, as downtown Edmonton doesn't get more central than this.  So central, it's pretty much right above Central LRT Station. 
Of course, it stinks that an independent coffee shop was replaced by a Starbucks (both physically and in my routine), but sometimes you can't argue with convenience.

The inside is just WAY too small.  You walk to nearly the back to place your order, then step a few feet to the very end to wait for your drink.  Then you have to walk all the way back through the store to get out.  So you have to excuse your way through the people placing their orders, and the people waiting in line.  And with it being so narrow it's a pain.  They desperately need a larger space.  I won't be back.  Maybe I'll use the drive-thru but I won't go in.  I'll visit other locations instead.

My husband and I were excited for this new Starbucks so one day we decided to go. The staff are very nice and polite. The place is very clean and neat. It has this relaxing vibe. The parking lot is very spacious. The tables and chairs inside are not placed very close to each other. Thumbs up for every power outlet for each table. Physical setup 100%! :))
This is a low stress starbucks not alot of lines,  quick service

Their customer service is horrible! I use to work at Starbucks's and I'm shocked at this location. Very sad when you pay what you have to pay for a drink and get bad customer service on top of drinks always being up in the air if they are even made right. And if you go back to have your order corrected expect an attitude from staff. I mean really this location disappoints me.

First time in this WC location! So happy it finally opened, my boyfriend lives 5 minutes down the road so it's convenient for all the times I bug him for a coffee run! This Starbucks is huge, clean, spacious and has lots of outlets unlike other Starbucks! The workers were working very hard and still remained friendly :) I enjoyed my visit here and will be back soon

Everything about this is standard in regards to quality of the product. The staff could be more pleasant but it really variates depending on the shift. All of that aside, the remodel stole the old comfort this Starbucks always had in its atmosphere. It has an uncomfortable feeling now and they removed a lot of seating so it's prone to getting more crowded and it won't be a great place to study or relax like before. But if you're just stopping by, it'll suffice.

It's a Starbucks whats not to love. Even my auto spell has it memorized and will correct me if i don't capitalize the "S". this location has fast service and plenty of seating. It even has a drive through window for those on the go. 4 stars because i was terrified of the wasp flying around near my table that day.

I love Starbucks which is odd because I rarely don't drink coffee. When it comes to Starbucks in Center City there's an abundant selection. This is my favorite Starbucks to visit! The baristas are always so pleasant and friendly and no matter how long the lines are the service is always quick and efficient. That might not seem like a big deal but when you're going into work at 7:30AM every smile makes a difference. I've gone to a few Starbucks in the area and no one makes my skinny peppermint mocha like these guys do. I'd definitely recommend this Starbucks above the rest to anyone working in the Market St/ JFK Blvd area.

Even though they never manage to spell my name right, and there is always a long line, I really like this Starbucks.  They are not all the same.  Here, I have never had bad service.  Everyone is so nice and they always have a filled case of yummy treats.  I'll keep going no matter what they right on the cup :)

I'm still giving the Starbucks a two stars because I pre-ordered my drink through the app on my phone when I got to the store my drink wasn't ready and they acted like they didn't even know that I had even ordered a drink. So I basically could've just ordered my drink here and wait just as long as I did for my drink anyways I thought I was saving myself some time by using the app but clearly they didn't get my order so something either needs to get right with the stores or something needs to get right with The app. People pay so much money for the drinks inside this coffee shop and I'm one of them that choose the pay your prices and I deserve good customer service which I will say I got somewhat of good customer service hear nothing great nothing out of its way and the trashcan right where you go to pick up your drinks is completely full actually overfilled with other peoples trash. So it's kind of disgusting when you go to pick up your drink that you want to enjoy and you have to look at this disgusting overfilling trash can right by the handoff station. So still I did have somewhat good customer service but I can't give them any more than the two stars which is sad because I frequent the Starbucks a lot and I have not yet been able to give it anything over to stars.

late night coffee run is my thing : ) after a double date, we all hung out at this location for about an hour. one iced coffee, one iced tea ( yes it was snowing outside) and we tried the new cookie dough cake pop and were smitten. the staff was talkative and attentive. this is my normal location- so I am for sure coming back :)

This Starbucks location is the gold standard.  I have been to many others in Nashville and in small towns and far bigger cities, and this West End location provides the friendliest and speediest service and most consistent quality. Have I gotten a wrong order once or twice in my history of going there at least 2x/week for years and years... yes, maybe so, but really... what do we expect, fellow Nashvillians, if our vehicles are lined up for a block and half on West End and we get thru the line in ten minutes.

They are my best friend in the morning. The morning crew including Truman and Jeremy are very helpful. 

The ambience is nice. I LOVE the fireplace. I set up my laptop in the early mornings and get to work. It's a great place for me to make my mornings productive and that's a reflection of the staff and how hard they work to maintain and provide excellent service.

Messed up my order and woman was unbelievably rude to me about them closing early. I'm a Starbucks lover and have been to S'bucks all over the world and never been treated so rudely!! Such a disappointment as I come to Safety Harbor often to visit family but will not be returning here.
This is a nice Starbucks coffee store in the middle of down town Santa Barbara...I'm really impressed with It's decor,space and location..I will be coming here again when I visit Santa Barbara

I don't usually review chain restaurants, but this Starbucks is absolutely adorable! 

Conveniently located at the Omni Severin hotel (where I was staying), the staff is friendly, it is always clean, and it is one of the cutest Starbucks/coffee shops I've ever been in!
One of the best Starbucks I have been to.  They are very friendly and have a nice upstairs to work at.  Only downside is parking is limited.

Blair is an asset to this location. All I have to do is pull up and I hear the following: 'Hey Lady, your usual, right? Venti dark roast with cream, 3 equal and pumpkin spice, right?' Yes, Ma'am. And she's always smiling and making sure you're smiling as well.

This store has hit a new stride in service. The staff is focused and friendly. The things I would change are issues that can't be easily resolved (limited parking for example.) Everything else is running on all cylinders.

They may be a chain, but every Starbucks is unique to the others. This one has a wonderful staff and an attention to detail that makes it stand out among the others in Boise.
I come here in the evenings, when it's usually crammed with students studying and a few friends catching up. I can imagine the staff getting frustrated with all the campers lingering for hours over the cheapest cup of coffee, but instead they're always friendly to everyone. Since they're quite busy and usually have a person in the drive thru and in the lobby, I'm impressed that they can continuously act genuinely warm and welcoming.
I come in frequently, and most of the staff remember me and my name and beverage. I appreciate that they're willing to engage in idle chat even when they're busy. They feel like they enjoy connecting.
Sometimes the floor gets dirty, but they make a good effort to sweep and keep the condiment bar free of the piles of sugar and spilled milk that often get left behind. The bathrooms are pretty clean too, and they've always good a good selection of whole-bean coffee and tumblers around.
The drinks taste like they do everywhere else which is actually high praise--even with the constant traffic they don't seem to get lazy and take shortcuts or put out substandard beverages. They're also quick to make pour-overs and don't act put out when people order a coffee that isn't currently being brewed (ie, anything but Pike Place after noon). Sometimes baristas at other locations try to talk you out of it, or into an Americano since it's less work for them, but here they don't bat an eye.
It can feel jammed in here sometimes, and occasionally the mess gets a little much, but other than that this location does a great job. Plus, it's the only Starbucks open past 9:00 in the valley, and one of few places to hang out later at night. I'd definitely stop by if you need a late-night fix.

Let me preface this by stating that I rarely reivew things.  I have only good things to say about this stabucks, I frequent many starbucks and this location is by far my favorite.  I am a very consitent person and like to go in when i know my favorite barista will be there.  The service is wonderful and they really do make an effort to get to know you and to be friendly.  A special shout out to Kevin the barista for being such a positive person and always brightening my day!  I am always happier when I leave this location than when I come in.  They have nice tables that have excellent light for studying and it is always very clean and welcoming.  Additionally there are rarely lines inside of the store, but the drive through is usually busy because of the proximate location to the highway.
Best,
Reagan

The drinks here are good, once you actually receive them. Every single time I come to this Starbucks, it is at least at 30 minute experience. Lines, inside and out, are at least 3 people/cars deep and the workers are unusually slow!!! Never been to another Starbucks where they are SO SLOW. It is so frustrating and my order is messed up half the time. Go to a different Starbucks if you don't want to be late to work or if you want your correct order in a decent amount of time !

I love this Starbucks.   I enjoy that they remember me and my order.   It's so nice and refreshing to walk into a place and they call you by name.   Great Hospitality!   The store always looks clean bathroom are maintained.   Great job!!

A nice Starbucks. Parking is easy, although I do prefer the drive-through Starbucks. This one is clean and appears well-managed. The staff are friendly and my chai tea latte was made so quickly I thought maybe they had read my mind as I was standing in line!

Friendly staff and a tremendous caramel flavored frozen drink! Located right in the middle of downtown Franklin, and they do a great job of managing orders, keeping up with the population, and blending in with Franklin's atmosphere.
I went here it was quick and pleasant. Thanks you Devin for wonderful customer service.

I must agree with the gentleman who stated the staff here is very nice. I frequent this Starbucks often, and never had bad service! They did get my order wrong and served me a sugary drink instead of sugar free. I did call to advise to watch serving sugar if someone specifies sugar free and the staff was very apologetic and offered to make it right.  Again, the service is very good, in spite of one mishap in several years worthnof visits!

The last time I was there, I went through the drive thru. I waited almost 20 minutes for an iced green tea. They aren't very friendly. One time I ordered, they told me one price at the speaker box and a completely different price at the window. I don't think they're very competent.

best outdoor seating at a Starbucks ever--outdoors, but with a roof and outlets (and a fireplace! That wasn't on, but was still cool). I was on vacation and would pay to have a Starbucks like this closer to home.

Great friendly starbucks. I never have any problems at this location. Drinks and service is consistent. Fun fact, this location does coffee tastings similar to a wine tasting in select nights. You get to try 3 coffees and three pastries that would pair with it well. And it's free!!!
One of my favorite locations. Staff is always wonderful, quick service and everything always served perfectly. I have 2 small kids so I frequent the drive thru. Easy in, easy out.

This Starbucks is really convenient for hospital employees and health sciences students. However, it's not open on the weekends and the employees have no sense of urgency. If you are in a rush, do not go to this Starbucks. It takes entirely too long to get your coffee.

I'm not a fan of Starbucks. However... From what I had it was pretty good! I ate a cake pop and it was one of the best I've ever had! The reason for a 4 star is that the coffee smell was so strong I wanted to get out of there immediately!

Coffee was fine as usual at Starbucks but the service was lacking.  Cashier just doesn't know basic math .  My order came to $5.78, I gave her $6.03.  She had already entered $6.00 and couldn't figure out the change and insisted that my change should be $0.22 not $0.25 that I was saying "cause the computer said so". SMH.  This world is in trouble, our youth can't do simple math.l

Slower than slow today! Four people in the front. One mopping. One guy looking lost. Two other girls going back and forth getting stuff. Looked disorganized. 10 min to get a tall cafe Americano w steamed cream. I also didn't have anyone in front of me. Rational?? Couldn't tell ya.
This place is mismanaged.  Always understaffed in busy times.  A zoo.  Too bad cause great location.

I love this Starbucks in the heart of Westchase. The staff is always very friendly and the ambiance really gives you a feel of the neighborhood. 

The outdoor seating area is pet-friendly so I often see owners with the cute dogs outside mingling on the weekends. 

There is parking within the complex and it's also friendly for those jogging or exercising in the area.

Not all Starbucks are the same, at least they aren't in the Nashville area. I've been to almost ten. Some serve food on plates, some have more sitting room (including outdoor tables) this one makes my drinks right. Not allow of them do. Oh, and they're friendly.

I'm not really a Starbucks person, but this is a great location.  There is lots of seating, the staff is so nice and knows you, and they make it seem like it's not a mega chain.  As with all Starbucks, the drinks are great, and it is a little $.  It was /the/ after-school hangout in junior high - how lame - but brings back good memories.

There is no consistency to the service here. I was going here for the last 2 weeks b/c I didn't know there was a Second Cup across the street from my new office in the basement of ATB/TELUS towers. Anyway I would get my morning mocha and at lunch grab a hot tea. I like my tea a lil sweet and ask for 2 pumps of classic syrup sometimes I'm charged sometimes I'm not. I get the charge for syrup in an iced tea as they use like 6 pumps but come on 2 pumps should not be $0.50. like I said sometime I'm charged sometimes I'm not. Ugh.
This Starbucks has a lot of indoor and outdoor seating which is nice.  The staff was friendly and since it is in the lobby of the lovely Omni hotel, the environment is lovely.
Quick friendly service inside, and never a long wait in the drive-thru.  Only 4 stars because of the lack of inside seating proportionate to the amount of space inside the store.

I love the drive thru. The old Starbucks up the street was not drive thru and difficult to park. 
The staff is sweet. Their faces pop up at the ordering center. And they remember you!

It's your typical Starbucks, so no complaints here. It's pretty spacious inside with plenty of seating. They also have a small patio outside with seating, and of course a drive through. The staff has been efficient and friendly every time I've visited.
The Starbucks new location is so much better than in the Paoli train station.  I can get off the bus and I'm right there!!  I love their Strawberry  Frappuccino, so good.

Ted and Patrick are the best baristas! I am so pleased with my experience with them! Went in to get an extreme caffeine fix to study for a nursing exam. I asked for their expertise on the most caffeinated beverage and not only did they have a great suggestion but it was incredibly good! They were excellent and very personable! Thank you soooo much for helping me get through my exam! 

Also thanks for making my new Starbucks go to drink (: soooo yummy!

Stopped in after dance class yesterday, to catch up with a lovely fellow dancer. Haven't seen her in a year and she looks FABULOUS!  I ordered my chai latte and she got a peach green iced tea. 

Both drinks were made with efficiency and a smile on the barista's face. It wasn't a busy day, so there were plenty of seats for us to grab and gab. We spent an hour sitting in the corner and chatting.  Have to say, one of the more comfortable S*bucks I've been in recently.

Best Starbucks experience I have ever had! The customer service here is phenomenal! Every employee I have met has gone above and beyond to  meet our expectations and makes sure every customer is happy! Wifi is another story, bad service connection, and some days I cannot get any Wifi access at this location on River.

Pretty average as far as Starbucks go. I find this location to be a decent spot to get some work done. Ample tables to spread out at, and never exceedingly loud. However, as an avid (2-3 per day) cold brew drinker, this location tends to disappoint on a regular basis...They are hit or miss...with a strong skew toward miss...when it come to having cold brew in the am, which always baffles me.

This place is good when I can get in. Unfortunately the parking is awful so it's rare I can actually get in to this one. Once you're in don't leave because you don't know when another spot will be open.

Worst customer service by far by both female workers today which is why I'm writing this review the female with tattoos down her arms gave me so much attitude when I asked for her to remake my drink she said what's wrong with it I said there's no flavor she then grabbed the cup out of my hand remade then just put on counter when I asked if it was mine she stated whose else would it be. They need an attitude check here !!!! Especially since there an overpriced Starbucks.

I'm a reglar here but they've messed up my drink twice by putting milk into my latte instead of soy! My stomach was destroyed today. This is dangerous! People order soy for a reason! I realized this too late. I always get ventis, too.
Awesome customer service! Gretchen is a role model example of a Starbucks employee! 5 stars!
You can tell it used to be a Burger King. Standard Starbucks fare.

This Starbucks is so slow. I used the mobile
App to save time and my drink was not ready. When I requested my drink from the Barista I was told she she was catching up on orders for people who were already in store getting refills. The only reason I gave 2 stars is for the large sitting area in the back.

Came in last night and ordered a Rewards drink for my son. It was a customized butter beer recipe (Harry Potter). I found the batista to be at bit short and not very friendly. He seemed to be in a rush when I was trying to pull up the recipe on my phone even though there was no one behind us. When the drink was done, he slid it across the counter to my son, who is 11. Son whispered to me that it felt word to be given a drink like that. 
I do frequent the St. Pete stores almost on a daily basis. Never got such a cold feeling in an otherwise warm place. I didn't bother ordering anything else. Is rather just go to my local Starbucks, where I am treated with a better attitude.  
The drink was made correctly, so I did give 3 stars.

This Starbucks is really nice, probably the nicest Starbucks I've ever visited. Since it's the suburbs they are at a slow pace and I'm used to fast paced city life so that's my only other con. Other than that great job

This Starbucks just moved "down the street" from the Paoli train Station (where there was NO PARKING) to here - where the old Burger King used to be.  

I have not yet gone into the store, but I used the convenient drive-thru today and got in & out quickly.

Glad there is parking!

I'm not sure why i haven't written a review before. This is my go to spit to pick up my morning. Staff know me by name and my order. It's nice to have a real conversation versus knowing people are being completely fake because their boss may be there. They always ask how you are and it always feel genuine. 

As for the drinks, I'm never disappointed. They care if they get your order right. I order a Carmel drink every time and they're pretty good with making sure the Carmel isn't everywhere. My drink is always right.

Terrible service asked for a iced London fog tea. Tried explaining what is was because she didn't know, at mid sentence she stopped me and said she'd figure it out. Got my drink and it was just 2 bags of tea in a overfilled cup. Didn't even attempt to try to get my order right

FABULOUS starbucks location! i always leave with a smile on my face, the staff is always warm informative and fun to chat with! For example Peppermint Mocha is my absolute favorite flavor of all time, and WHO KNEW.. THAT ITS AVAILABLE 365 DAYS OF THE YEAR!  the staff told me that as soon and i let out how much i love peppermint, now i can enjoy it all the time! SO HELPFUL! love it!

So glad they moved down the street away from the train station where it was a nightmare to park let alone get back onto Lancaster Avenue. I fequent this drive through at least 3 days a week and 99% of the time they are quick, kind and drinks are correct. I try to stay away from any business during peak hours but this is my exception to the rule. 2 thumbs up for easy access and convenience.
This Starbucks empties trash and cleans the shop.   Staff were super nice and efficient.   Too rare at Starbucks.   Made my morning.  Thanks.

A great little Starbucks located in Scotia Place. It's a smaller store than most Starbucks location but if you are a Starbucks addict this will hit the spot. 

The baristas are friendly and quick with drink order and the drinks are always hot. The seating is limited and so is the merchandise however they have the basics. Coffee, K-cups, Travel Mugs, etc. This Starbucks also has the standard baked goods for sale. This location also provides "drink" samples for customers to try something new. 

If I'm downtown again and need a Starbucks fix I would definitely stop by again.

This Starbucks is fantastic. I've been to a lot of coffee shops in Nashville, but this one feels like home to me. Whether I'm in the drive thru or in the cafe I always receive prompt and friendly customer service from the employees. One of the baristas told me they are the busiest store and Nashville and I have no doubt that's true. It's packed every time I come in, but the employees don't even break a sweat. Whatever ya'll are doing keep doin it!

The store is nice, but I am confused about the different levels of service.

In most Starbucks they ask your name and call out your name for the order.

This one does not and customers stand around confused as to whether that "coffee" is for them.

A simple change that should be apparent.

I've finally figured it out: Starbucks coffee is so bitter because its most popular/sold beverages are the sweet syrup-laden or condimented, and the super strong coffee flavor needs to "shine through" all of the other stuff. 

So, for straight-up black coffee, espresso, cappuccino or a mocha, this really isn't the place for that.  

I find the best time to come in here is during the early afternoon, when it is least crowded. 

The recent turnover of staff leaves for happier & fresh employees, thus better service.

Their Wi-Fi is very reliable, as well.

I enjoy the communal table, too, but maybe that's just me.

Also, for now, if you buy a beverage before 2pm, you can show the receipt after 2pm on the same day only and get a grande anything for $2 minus tax. I cannot say when the promotion will end, though, but it is a tempting excuse to come back on the same day.

The older lady tonight behind the register was so angry and bitter. We had six people with us total and it seemed that it was way too much for her. All we ordered was venti black iced teas and a tall iced tea. Nothing hard or complicated. Made us feel totally not welcomed. If she is working again, we will not go in.
It's Starbucks: good quality, overpriced coffee with code names for the "In Crowd", but the bathroom was filthy. Unless it is inconvenient, go to Wawa and save your money.

New Starbucks and chipotle right around the corner from our apartment complex! I went mid afternoon so it thankfully wasn't too much of a mad house. This Starbucks has a drive-thru which is awesome, but unfortunately it is poorly constructed. You can tell they built this establishment as quick as possible.

Tatianna was so nice and friendly. It was a little bit of a wait for my drinks, understandably since they are brand new. My coffee had too much syrup in It and was a little too sweet for me.

Convenient location for me so I'm sure I'll be there a few times a week.

I frequent this Starbucks on a weekly basis. At first, the customer service was okay. There used to be several men in the morning who were friendly and helpful. Now its over ran with a bunch of bitches. Sorry for the language but literally that is all that works there. They are not friendly, not attentive to the orders, don't smile, don't say thank you or have a nice day. Just a bunch of bitches. If you hate your job so much, find a new one. But with the amount of money I spend at Starbucks, the least you can do is give me my drink with a damn smile. I continue to go here ONLY because of its location to my work and that it has a drive thru. But seriously, whoever is managing this store needs to get its employees in line. This is NOT how Starbucks  patrons are supposed to be treated.

Finally, Starbucks has another Southside location. This little gem is situated in the Tucson marketplace center which is nestled between Kino Pwy and Park Ave. I work in South Tucson and always wished there was a Starbucks or dunkin donuts near by. 
I tried out the Drive thru, ordering and paying for my order took less than three minutes ! so far I am loving this new location.

Used to be one of my favorites, but a fair number of the staff aren't as friendly as the previous employees. I like their product, but half of the Starbucks attraction is atmosphere and if employees are grumpy it ruins the vibe.

This Starbucks is a conveniently located on the bottom floor of The Nugget in Sparks. 

It is certainly not one of their flagship stores but it serves the purpose. It is not open 24/7 but they will extend the hours on the busy nights. We stopped by here at 10:45 PM and they were still open. 

Due to the location,  the prices are slightly higher than at the outside stores but that is the case at every Starbucks inside the hotel I've been to. Also worth the mention is they don't have a toaster at this location so if you like your bagels toasted you will need to go elsewhere. Otherwise there is nothing wrong with this Starbucks. 

To put it simply: if you are staying at the hotel you will like it. For others no need coming here.

At the time when I lived near by here, this was the perfect coffee place for me to go, since it was like literally 3 mins away. I loved it here due to the short distance. My coffee here was greatly made and the people here were friendly. Since I moved I will miss this spot!

Hubby and I visited this Starbucks for the first time the other day while on our way out of town. They were really on top of things there and showed wonderful customer service. Everything was made as we ordered and ready to go quickly.

Since I started grad school a few weeks ago I have been camping out at this location. I have been here on Saturday afternoons, Sunday mornings, and now a Friday night. It doesn't matter what crew is working, without a doubt the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. Typical wait for a drink from the bar is 10-12 minutes.  All this with no crowd, just drive thru traffic. Tonight I  met another customer and he said he has waited over 30 minutes for a frappe..

First of all manager Michelle runs a great store. Everyone here likes and is liked by customers. The best news of all is that Starbucks is banning smoking outsider it's stores. In Florida where alfresco dining and drinking is what makes living here so worthwhile, smokers can ruin that fast. Kudos to Starbucks for their courageous and correct stance on this issue.
Best Starbucks on State St. They are always busy but are fast and the quality is always good. Staff is very friendly as well.

Hands down, this is the WORST sb ever!  My husband and I always get the same drinks... this place NEVER...EVER gets it right!  It's either too bitter, too diluted, or too much breve. I've even received my ICED coffee WITHOUT ICE!! After many... MANY complaints to the customer service department ... even an in-person meeting with the AREA MANAGER, we have officially given up on this place. We have been very patient and they just can't get it right. There have been numerous times that we've even brought our drinks up the street to the SB on Robb & Mae Ann for (what I have defined as) "coffee repairs".  Simply awful :(
Bathroom was worse than a truckstop glory hole. Not open late enough and has terrible internet.

It's a Starbucks, so as far as Starbucks go, they are top-notch. Witty banter between coworkers entertain us customers as we wait for our beverage. Even so, the wait was short n' sweet. 

I enjoyed sipping my drink at the window high-top and people watch. Lucas Oil Stadium is a stones throw away... if there was a wind, a strong wind. But seriously, I can see it from my high-top table. 

Last note: I like my chai like I like my men - stong, smooth, and keeps me up. And my friends, they make a strong chai here. :o)

I have been coming to this Starbucks often because it is the easiest location to stop at on my way to work, however, I will now be taking my business elsewhere in the mornings. The morning staff is quite rude. Every time I've asked a question I am given attitude along with the answer. They had once not given me the croissant I had order through the mobile app. I thought they were maybe working on it so I waited a bit longer, as I saw they were busy. After waiting some time, I asked the barrista if they had received my order for the baked good (as I had already been given my drink) and I was given attitude when they said they never got it. I kindly showed them my order receipt and was given more attitude in their response that they'd grab it for me. After which, it was placed on the counter without a word to me. 
I know not all of us are Morning people, but don't take your frustration out on your customers. HORRIBLE customer service.

I've been to many Starbucks. The tea here was the worst. I have gotten the tea infusion and it has been very tasty. At this Starbucks it seemed as though there was no infusion. I even returned thinking they had just made a mistake. No apologies just excuses and another tea that was very bland. It would have been a one star but the woman taking the original order was friendly and courteous.
Molly and Madison are amazing!! They go above and beyond for their customers and make this location a destination coffee stop for me :)

Very friendly, and they keep the place clean. The staff was knowledgable and was able to make my drink quickly.

Other than that, hey it's a Starbucks, so you know what's there.

Starbucks should never take so long to get. It takes 30 minutes in the drive thru to get coffee. I then tried going inside to see the difference, the workers have no since of urgency. Going to a Kroger Starbucks would be faster.

Called at 10:15 p.m. last night to make sure they would be open until 11p.m. as posted.  The gentleman confirmed the closing time was 11p.m. So I get there at 10:30 and every do you know? They are closed.

This Starbucks store is perfectly situated in the middle of town.  It's quaint interior decor fits the area as they seem to have used the existing structure highly in the build.  Their coffee good as expected and I believe they have a Clover machine and usually have a bunch of single origin coffees  if you are a coffee enthusiast.  Both a front and a rear entrance make getting in an out easy and they usually have enough Baristas to keep the line moving.

Sometimes.....ya just need to run into an S-Bucks to calm the caffeine headache. I rarely frequent Starbucks simply because I don't enjoy their product enough to make it my regular spot. But I'll take a meeting here from time to time and enjoy a latte. When I'm in this neck of the woods, this Starbucks seems to be the most convenient and quite pleasant. It's small and cozy, the customer service is excellent and usually, they move pretty quick. Starbucks as a whole, knows how to run a solid operation and I definitely appreciate that about them. Knowing that I can expect a consistent experience is worth four stars to me!
Ordered my Mocha Frap and it tasted spoil. Milk prob bad and no chocolate syrup, asked the cafe tender and she looked at me like I was talking a different language!!!

Starbucks needs to rein in the jackass employees at this franchise. We've been in Nashville for months and we keep giving these bitchy baristas another chance. 

They suck! The service, the attitudes and the orders always suck. They actually gave me crap for ordering too much in the drive through when their was no parking and no other options. I'm sorry to inconvenience you with my $50.00 order at your establishment. 

These guys are aweful, rude and snippy.

Well this is the see and be seen Starbucks of Westchase. I was here at about 10am on a Saturday and the place was packed. I think all of Westchase was there. The staff was friendly and they have plenty of outside tables for the crowd. Grab a friend and your dog and hang out a while.

I had an issue with my order the day prior so I came back in (after giving them a call yesterday) to get my order fixed. That being said....

It's before 7:00am and JEREMY was amazing in the drive-thru! Thank you for the awesome attitude, barristas like you keep me coming back!
They always know my order, Americana with steamed Breve. They are always full of smiles and can actually turn my day around.

This Starbucks rocks! They get some of the heaviest volume of customers I've ever seen a Starbucks have and they still complete their jobs at a fast pace. The only problem I have with this Starbucks is the parking situation. Parking can be found only on east and west side of the stores. They are friendly and deliver great service to their customers. I would highly recommend this Starbucks located near the corner of 31st Ave/west end ave

I purchased two Veggie Artisan Breakfast Sandwiches. They were served to me frozen and uncooked. I've become ill after consuming them.

I've reported this to the Tennessee Department of Health.
Love this Starbucks location!  Drive-thru is very convenient, drinks are made perfectly and the employees are great!!

Ok a Starbucks is a Starbucks in terms of drinks. The drinks here are good and the staff is friendly. The location is terrible though. The layout and location of the building often leaves a huge backup of cars in the drive thru. And cars block other lanes to get their spot in line and you end up getting stuck and can't even get through to park.

I was in Tucson for the weekend and stopped by this Starbucks. The staff was really nice and attentive and made my grande, nonfat chai perfectly! :) I'll definitely stop by again next time I'm in town.

Probably one of the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. The wait for 1 tea and 1 frappuccino with average customer traffic was 30 minutes. This is ridiculous as I KNOW the drive thru customers do not wait longer than a few minutes because Starbucks corp implements a timer for drive thru efficiency. Basically, go here if you want to wait REALLY long for a simple drink.

One of the best things that this Starbucks has going for it is its drive through and friendly service. It's fast and efficient. Depending on how crowded it gets, the line can get ridiculous because of how the traffic can flow into the strip mall that this Starbucks is located in, which can be a pain to get into if you happen to be on the opposite side of the street and trying to cross traffic.

If you chose to go inside, parking can be tight, especially during the the morning. If there is no parking in front, you can park behind the store itself and walk a little. The inside has a few tables to sit, but space is at a premium, especially when crowded. The line for orders can sometime merge together. 

When the weather is nice, there is a small patio with a few tables and chairs that allow you to watch Pendleton Pike traffic while enjoying your caffeine.
They are on the slow side here. Not the worst but not the best sigh. I am frustrated by my most recent wait so I just can't say more.
The folks are friendly and they don't mind that I call the Venti "Large". Very good!

Terrible. The last few times my husband has stopped by over a few weeks he's complained to me either about slowness or the order being a little funky. Last week he asked if my quad venti tasted like a quad. I said as a matter of fact, no. Neither did his - he said the girl at the headset couldn't seen to get the order right no matter how many times he repeated (mind you, he ordered *two* drinks).

Today, he texted to say both lattes came with soy. Only mine was supposed to. He brought that to their attention and they replaced it. Sadly, he only took a sip when he got home. "Taste this." I gagged when I did. He thought it was just him. Nope - i don't know if that was out of irritation with him or what, but it tasted just awful. I shudder to think why. 

This place is a joke.

Yo this place gave me wayyyy to much coffee and too little sweg. I hate that. Sweg is the starting point of all organic life. Whenever I run out of sweg this place never tends to my needs of my ridiculous amounts of sweg that I procure. 2 swegs out of 5
Just went to this location for the first time today. They were quick and friendly. Lots of places to sit too which is awesome. Keep up the great work, Starbucks!

Whatever guy is working right now.. it's 6pm on Wednesday night, 12/6, is the MOST RUDE Starbucks employee I've ever encountered. I can't believe I'm even writing a review but I've never had this happen at Starbucks. I know these jobs are hard to come by as Starbucks is a phenomenal employer, so whoever the dude is working the Starbucks drive thru on Robb needs to at least treat people with some form of kindness. I'm in disbelief..

This location is no different than any other Starbucks as far as service. Not a lot to say that anyone doesn't already know. The staff is always friendly. 

A word of warning though:The parking lot is a damned nightmare!! Seriously, it's a train wreck. Otherwise always had a good experience.
I love this location. The people are nice and I get my drinks in a very timely manner.

Great location. Roomy and aesthetically pleasing. Awesome friendly staff. Very accommodating, even with strange drink requests. All in all, I'd say it was a great experience. And pumpkin spice started early, score!!! The girl with cool glasses was great! :)

Gotta say that I've never had a worse experience than at this starbucks. Went in and it wasn't very busy but it took ten minutes to get my drink because of mobile orders.  As I patiently waited with the other walk in customers  all of the mobile orders were handled without the customers even in there.  Then my drink was made wrong. When I pointed it out the barista said she would "fix it real quick". By that she meant she would finish the other two mobile orders. When I said to them it was the worst experience I had recieved at a Starbucks I was ignored.  Not normally one to write a negative review but...  Anyway, novel idea, maybe someone should handle the drinks for the customers that are actually there and one for the mobile orders.

Good service. I've had my order messed up a couple times but was remedied. Can get busy and wait 10 mins or so. 
No drive thru but there is a nice lounge area upstairs that makes the trip worthwhile.

Super busy location, but the baristas here know how to handle busyness.  They don't flinch when you give them a large order or a special drink with 4 specifications.  You may have to wait a couple minutes for your drink, but it will be amazing - the espresso is strong!

My favorite location :) The decor is earthy and inviting. I have spent a lot of time studying at the back or reading on the sofas often getting into interesting conversations with people. The atmosphere is great, very friendly staff who take their service seriously. They remember your name and make sure you walk out with a well made drink and a smile!

Although the drive-thru line routinely spills into main thoroughfare during peak hours (6-10 am), going inside saved me tons of time. Took less than 5 minutes to order and receive my drink.

Fully staffed with friendly folks! Very clean and cozy atmosphere inside.

If I'm going to pay almost six bucks for a coffee (a Grande Flat White) I expect it to be fresh.  Three stars because at least at 2pm, the drive thru wasn't packed as it normally is.  Tip:  Check your coffee for freshness before you leave.

I give this Starbucks based off their service. I ordered my drink through the app, and it said it would take 2-6 minutes. I get there and three girls walk in, get in line, and order their drinks. While I'm waiting, two people plus those girls who walked in the same time I did, all get their drinks and leave. By the time I get my drink, which ended up taking about twelve minutes, the guy didn't even make the drink the way I ordered it. They weren't even super busy, so there is no reason he should have overlooked it nor should it have taken that long.

Went in here with some friends around 10 a.m. on a Thursday while on a girls' trip to S.B. and ordered the same drink I always do - a venti iced coffee with half and half.  The drink was $0.60 more than usual.  I asked why the price was different and the unfriendly lady ringing my drink said it was because I asked for half and half.  WHAT??????? I told her that if it was a charge for that, I would've put it in myself (which I used to do before a Starbucks at another location once told me that they would be happy to do it for me) and she annoyingly asked if I wanted a refund.  Obviously, I wasn't going to hold up the line, but now I feel like I should have.  Unbelievable!

Seriously??! Apparently the baristas were more concerned with quantity not quality. Not only was my iced americano lousy due to lack of cream they left the Splenda wrapper in the cup. Poor poor service. Safe yourself the headache, head to another one- any one- nearby.

You know you've made a mistake when the barista apologizes to every customer.  I mobile ordered.  I got my food in about 5 minutes, but my bagel was extremely hard, but didn't appear to be overcooked.  After 12 minutes, I watched them make my drink.  One person put classic syrup in it and set it down.  The next person picked it up and put classic syrup in it, then coffee and passed on to me.  Way too sweet, obviously.  Asked him to remake it and he did.  But, he added classic and he filled the cup halfway with iced coffee and crammed as much ice in there as possible.  I fought to get the straw in and tasted it.  Too sweet.  Less coffee and less classic still add up to too sweet.  I've ordered my coffee this way for the last 5 years, roughly, and it's perfect when it's done right.  This Starbucks can't get it right.

I go to Starbucks at least ten times a day. Many times I want to take my home office to this location. The music is so loud one would think they are in a bar. I politely asked if they could lower it and the manager was so flipping rude as he always is. His response was no as it pre set. Funny as two weeks ago even one of the employees lowered it as she said it was so loud! I don't even know if he is the manager. He just acts like it which is quite entertaining, This is the only Starbucks where a few employees always look so angry! Thankfully corporate called me back and even they heard how loud the music was.  This is the only starbucks I have ever been to( I go to a Starbucks in every state and country when I travel) where some of the employees are about as cheerful as grumpy the cat. I will say some employees are so sweet but there are a few in the morning  who need to realize they are only serving coffee...not saving the world;)

I like this Starbucks, except that it is a little less accessible from the north bound lane of 309.  That's not there fault, but it's a definite inconvenience and deterrent some of the time when I contemplate stopping for a cup of joe.  Nice staff.  Good seating.  Nice atmosphere.

While relaxing in Starbucks at Sunnyside and Pendleton Pike, it was delightful to observe  employees greeting customers with a smile, recognition by name and speaking to co-workers in a respectful manner.  When you think others are engaged in conversation and preoccupied. ...take notice...it is a pleasure to be surrounded by good food, drink and company!  Keep up the great service!

I really like this starbucks, the building is super cute, and the staff is very friendly. I've read some of the reviews and I cannot agree with them. I've never had a problem here and I frequent this starbucks because it is close to where I work. The coffee counter is downstairs but upstairs they have a separate floor with tables and sofas so it's great to sit, have a cup of coffee and read. 

My negative about this starbucks is that the parking lot tends to be full and its difficult to get out of it depending on what direction your heading since its a highly traveled road.

I used to be a little bit against starbucks, but the coffee is decent and there aren't many places that serve coffee that is better in my area. If I lived in the city I wouldn't visit starbucks, but being from the burbs, its good enough!
Very nice baristas! Great coffee! No line... had a great time.  Paid for it with my iphone which made checkout a snap! Will go back often! Outdoor seating available.
Needed a quick start to my day and low and behold Starbucks Coffee Shop..great service..

It's a Starbucks.  There isn't a whole lot of difference between them.  

The coffees, especially the bold ones, are always good, hot, and somewhat overpriced.  The baristas are always very friendly but unhurried, and they no longer try to correct me when I ask for a large coffee.

I do not need to tell you the coffee is horrible,  you already know that.  I'm here to stop you from wasting your money on there breakfast or lunch sandwiches.  Overpriced garbage!  The chicken sandwich had a teespoon of chicken. Nothing like the one on display. The tomato sandwich had 2 pieces of tomato.  The sandwiches are pre-made at who the f**k knows. They taste like sh*t! No more!

The best place to study or have a meeting/get online. There is a nice quite secluded upstairs seating area and the staff remember who you are even if you don't visit often. The ONLY bad thing about this place is the no parking due to it being so popular.

Ive beenbhere several times, but this is the second time in a row here in the drive thru and can't get a drink order right.  Gave me a grande but I know I paid for a venti. Not a fan of the drive thru here. Will drive a couple of extra miles to go to the other location at 135 and main instead from now on.

The drive thru here can be SSSSSOOOOOO slow. But 24/7 is awesome and as Andrew S. said if you wait to long you might get a free java outta the deal.. but that has only happened once to my dozens of times of waiting 5+ minutes for a cup of joe.

I attempted to place an order for a traveler this morning and was treated by the employee who answered the phone like I was a moron for asking to order in advance; someone inconveniencing her with my stupidity. The employee indicated the only thing they could prepare in advance was travelers, and when I confirmed that was my order, she heaved a sigh and demanded to know how many, of what roast, and when I needed to pick it up. When I gave her the information, she scoffed at me for asking for a traveler in 10 minutes rather than 15. I'd have been happy to wait the extra five minutes if at some point in this interaction I'd been treated like a human worthy of breathing the same air as the employee who took the call. The same employee complained to me she was tasked with taking orders and making drinks simultaneously, which is apparently an excuse to chase away potential customers. I ended the transaction at this point, then redialed and asked to speak with a manager, hoping there might be an adult willing to offer some modicum of customer service. Instead, Jaime insisted I must be calling the incorrect location, then curtly asked for the details of my previous interaction, before simply telling me to have a better day and hanging up. 9/10 times I order coffee from local roasters and brewers. Shame on me for opting for the possible convenience of a chain this morning. My lesson is learned: I will continue to seek out businesses desirous of my patronage.

Was here this AM and Ashley helped me out so much.  I'm vegan, so I hate being "that customer."  She was super knowledgable about the drinks and suggested something different when I said I couldn't have whipped cream, since it "made" that particular drink. She didn't act like I was a hassle or anything, and made me quick experience great.  Just wanted to share excellent customer service when I see it!

These guys are pretty consistent in service. I've never had a drink I didn't like. My only complaint is that the bathrooms are rarely clean. I know the store is in the center of town, so I usually take myself to Liberty Place if necessary.

I get the same drink from Starbucks everyday.  I do not always go to the Newtown store, but I do stop here at least twice a week. It is literally hit or miss that my drink is made properly. I get a green tea lemonade. The proper name is shaken green tea lemonade. There are a lot of times they forget to put the lemonade in. But mostly the barista tries to take a short cut and not put it in the shaker cup and shake it. I know it sounds petty but it is how the drink is supposed to be made and it makes a difference to me. Today when I saw the girl did not shake it I asked her to shake it. She proceeded to swirl it around in the cup, getting it all over the outside and then hands it to me. I honestly couldn't believe it. Usually, when I ask the barista to please shake it they get the shaker cup and shake it. But this girl got an attitude as she could see my reaction and put it down and walked away. I will not be going back to the Newtown store. They really need to train their baristas on the proper way to make each drink.

Got my order correct today. Inside clean and a personable barista. 


I have no idea how the Starbucks could possibly be rated as high as it is. Today I was here and asked for a mocha frappe P with caramel. The barista asked me if I wanted the caramel in it or on top. I replied I wanted the caramel sauce on top. I received my frappucinno

I have been to this location many times on my way to work. Unfortunately it is the closest location for me. I'm always amazed at the complete lack of even mediocre customer service. The last time I was there (about 2 weeks ago) I ordered from the mobile app, when I got there my order wasn't ready yet, a very simple trenta green tea. They all look like they're having a bad day, bad life, just overall bad attitudes. I have started going out of my way to a different location on my way to work, which of course means I have to leave extra early. This location, no matter how convenient, is NOT worth the frustration. The only reason for one star is because I can't give them anything less.

I've been to this Starbucks a few times and the service is extremely slow. Efficient, speedy service is such a huge part of Starbucks' reputation and this one is failing in both of those areas. On my last visit, I pulled into the line and immediately heard the driver of the car in front of me yelling into the speaker. I didn't think too much of it until it was my turn to place my order and I was asked to repeat my self SEVERAL times. When I started customizing my order the person taking it seemed utterly confused by my requests (coconut milk and extra sweetener) and his tone quickly became curt and rude. I stopped customizing and finished ordering, when I got to the window I was met by another rude employee. Shockingly my order was correct but the service was terrible.
Love this location and so does everybody else. So when you stop here for your coffee fix expect a wait. But it is worth it!

Love this location--- drive thru is pretty quick, everyone is super friendly. 

My order is always correct which I appreciate!!! 

Try their pumpkin spice latte and pumpkin muffin for a seasonal favorite!

The bathrooms were absolutely disgusting. One had no toilet paper whatsoever and the other one had an explosion of trash on the floor. When I informed the worker at the counter, all I received was a heavy eye roll and an "okay."

Tuesday Afternoon Farmer's Market, perfect SB weather for all the cuckoo crays to come up out of the woodwork and invade State Street, and it seemed they were all in line at this particular Starbucks to use the two unisex restrooms who's numerical locking passcodes were taking the day off. 
I knew this experience had an unforeseen idiotic outcome as soon as I walked into the door behind Mr. and Mrs. Bewildered Halfwits discombobulated by either Starbucks in general or just being around people cuz they lacked any clue as to what the next step was once they got in the door. Barista finally succeeds in focusing their attention on his task at hand ( which is finding out why they're in his breathing space, taking their money, and moving right along to Moi, who knows what she's ordering) FINALLY! My turn at the counter, yay me! Until I hear the words I didn't want to hear "Sorry ma'm we are out of Very Berry Hibiscus Refresher" Boo!!! 
Meanwhile, the place is swamped full of disrespectful marionettes of all walks of life and age groups, and they're all waiting to use above mentioned restrooms. An eternity passes, and it's my turn. I'm in there about 90 seconds give or take, and someone's banging on the door. Uh hello Miss Impetuous, if you took five seconds to LOOK before you start your spazz on the door, you may see the conspicuously bold "IN USE" I walked out, slammed the door so it would lock, (oops, my bad! Now you've gotta go to the counter and pray you'll get the attention of busy baristas for an unlock, I would've made sure to pass the door to you. But why should I? Your ignorance landed you here sweetie) and walked out of there before the scenery would start affecting my brainwaves. With all the sbucks all over State Street, I will choose wisely next time and keep this one in my rearview.

This Starbucks is one of the best I've been in because the staff is always super friendly, makes their drinks correctly, and the place itself is a smaller shop, so it's a more intimate environment, which is great if that's your preference.

Anytime I come here, I prefer walking in over going through the drive-thru because the people who work here brighten my day and it's a great way to start before I head into work.

I look forward to stopping in on my way to work today.
The customer service is terrible and their drinks are even worse. Worst Starbucks in Reno.

I have been coming to this Starbucks location at least twice a week for over 6 years.  Staff always gets my drink right, the location is always clean and love the outside patio in good weather.  A few of the long time employees could use a little training in being welcoming.  One of the guys never smiles.  Ever.  Or recognizes me as a regular, though he does recognize my husband.  Many times I have felt like I am bothering him when I order.  But he is fast and efficient.  I sometimes go to the Keystone location when I am not in the mood to deal with what I perceive as a bad attitude.  So minus one star.

So.. I live smack dab in the middle of this Starbucks, and the one on the Black Horse Pike. When this one opened, I was pumped to have a drive-thru Starbucks, where I could roll out of bed, hop in my car, and buzz on through without having to look even the slightest bit presentable. But I've ran into some snags here..

Firstly, some of the employees are AWESOME, and I absolutely LOVE them! Personable, amazing baristas, who nail my drink order every time! They are what keeps me coming back!

Now, for the rest of the employees: unenthused, nervous, and unsure of their barista-required-knowledge. Multiple times my usual ICED Americano, with hazelnut, soy milk, and extra, extra, extra, extra caramel drizzle has popped out of the drive-thru window either hot, soy-milk-free, or lacking the extra (...extra, extra, extra) caramel drizzle. I'm usually flexible on the extra x4 caramel drizzle, and I understand that not every barista wants to dump the whole bottle in my drink, but throw me a bone here guys! Or some caramel drizzle... Throw me some caramel drizzle, please. I've also had sandwiches burnt or undercooked by the same employees. 

On the days I'm not rolling through the drive-thru fresh out of bed, I like to actually go inside this Starbucks. It's pretty big, with ample seating, super clean bathrooms, and a nifty private "conference" room in the back - how cool? Definitely way better for sitting down in and enjoying your coffee, or meeting up with friends. They also have a few outdoor tables, and a picnic bench across from the drive-thru window on the side. 

Lastly, the drive-thru placement here it's a little strange. Make sure you drive passed the front of the store,and make your SECOND right into the drive-thru. Despite the sign pointing towards the drive-thru entrance, I've still witnessed multiple people try to turn into the exit *face palm* c'mon guys.. 

Either way, I will continue to return to this Starbucks for (sometimes) excellent service, (usually) correctly made drinks, it's convenient drive-thru, and ample indoor and outdoor seating.

Some of the employees are nice. Some are in too much of a hurry to get back to whatever else they're doing.
Drinks have been messed up.. have had drinks shoved out the drive-thru window with a quick "have a good day," and the door closed on my face before I could even ASK for a straw. 
All-in-all, not impressed.


I've come back to lower my rating.
This location is awful. All of my drinks taste terrible, like they let the espresso go bad before it makes it into my drink (burnt flavor). The staff is REALLY lackluster. I've spoken with Mike Rose (district? manager) twice and no results have come from the discussions he and I have had. "Oh, yeah! I'll talk to my crew and make sure they make sure to give you a straw. I'll talk to them about not speaking to the customers in a rude tone of voice." Well, the lady with the blonde hair and glasses still snips as customers. 

I've decided to go out of my way and walk into the Warminster Starbucks. Fabulous workers and the drinks are always on point.

Too worried about the drive-thru to wait on three customers made the comment three different times that the drive-thru must be important then waiting on your inside customers they were not busy at all in side but they seem to think that the drive-thru was more important than the inside .... should not have to wait 5 min to get my order taken
Amazing store! Great people! Wonderful Clover coffee!

Shout out to Eleanor, our barista this morning. I had my first clover drink as I can't do the caffeine cold brew. She made s similar version via the clover machine. 

Greeted with a smile, even with a full store. The team was fast and friendly as well as efficient. The place was super clean.

Well done team Newtown Starbucks.
Always freezing here!!!  Come on guys make your customers comfortable and turn up the heat!!  Everyone sitting here is wearing their winter coats!!
(4) ~ very good overall.  Located where the Burger King used to be.  And they have a Clover Brewing System too;-)

This location never ceases to amaze me with customer service. Please give Leo, who worked tonight at 9:24pm, as many kudos possible.

I had gone to the Central Ave location, and they had put whole milk in my Iced Chai. My boyfriend and I had gone to this location to get a Caramel Frap, because the Central location had a broken blender.

When we got to the Tyrone location, we had asked if we could get a new chai because I cannot have regular milk due to health issues. Leo said he could accommodate us and replace it, no charge. He was a great employee and definitely had great customer service! Thank you Leo!

Coming from someone whos worked at starbucks before i was disappointed with the person who took my order. The Barista was great it was the person who rung me up for the wrong drink and wrote it down incorrectly. (He also made a mistake on the persons drink before me). I asked for a Tripe grande soy carmel mach. not an espresso mach. Obviously the guy wasnt listening to me so now im stuck with a drink i didnt order.

I've been here three times in the last 24 hours.  Two of the three times they got my drink wrong.  One drink they had to make three times. Each visit I had to wait a crazy amount of time.  I'm going to look for another location.
Typical starbux with good baristas the place is a bit tiny for inside hangout.  But always service with a smile.

New New location, I likey.  Then again I like all things "new".

Located at the corner of S. Grand and Sidney; across the street from Tower Grove Park. The decor is an industrial, rustic feel.  There are 2 leather chairs but no sofa which was a bummer but the long tables and steel stools made up for it.  

Full stock of your Starbucks favs; tins of tea, coffee, tumblers, sippers, pastries, sandwiches, parfaits and more!  There's a "What's Happening" board at the front entrance if your interested.  Patio seating is available with plenty of shade for you to work.

The drive-thru looked forced. Tight. Sharp turn-ish but hey whatever works.  

Lastly, the coolest thing I've ever seen at a Starbucks was the "Customer of the Week" incentive which shout-outs a random favorite customer who receives their next drink on the house.  I asked how this was made possible and Jeffrey explained "It pays to get in good with someone; it's totally random."  Made no sense but at least we know its a possibility.

This Starbucks is one of the cleanest and friendliest in Reno. I like the drive up window, it makes it easy and convenient to get a coffee or tea on the way to UNR. The staff is always really friendly and after ordering at least 30 drinks, I have not had a bad experience.

The major downside is its not a Peets.

Usually everyone is very friendly and I never have to wait very long. However, 1/2 the time my drink is made wrong. Being a somewhat complicated drink, I can understand little mess ups here and there and normally don't say anything and just take it. But when I've been ordering the same drink for 3 years the exact same way, I know how to order it. The few times I have asked for simple fixes, (like actually putting ice in my drink...) I get the "you didn't say that...." Or the "oh you said no ice not light ice". No I didn't.... That's why the cup says LIGHT. I am always nice and tip them because I understand the drinks can blur together but I don't like walking out of there feeling like the bad guy for wanting my drink made right so I don't go often :(

Love this place... I hate the limited seating though. Line moves quickly but you always have to take it to go because many seniors come and take over the place and stay forever. I can't complain about my drinks though, always on point

This is basically the worst Starbucks I have ever been to. I'm not a daily Starbucks type of person, more of a "when I really need it and my much preferred local coffee joints are closed/out of my way" type of Starbucks person... All that to say it's maybe once every three months that I come here because it's my local location. 

Every single time I'm here it takes forever to order/get my drink.. it's like the employees are always rushed and/or distracted. They always seem to want to argue with each other about who is going to make the drink. Recently, somebody took my order, went to the back and didn't come back out for over three minutes, I then stood there for another two minutes before I finally said something and all he said was that he thought the other girl was going to do it... However in the entire five or six minutes I had been there I never saw a single other girl and it was obvious no one was making my drink and I was just standing there waiting. It took over ten minutes to get a quad espresso and there was no one else in line before or after me. 

Most experiences I've had here are similar to this one. I brought my own cup last time, informed her it was 16oz (their grande size) and the girl working actually said "can I just put it in one of our cups because I can't ever get it right if I don't." Um what? It's literally the same size.. 

I'll digress. Starbucks has the worst tasting coffee/espresso anyway so I should probably just stop going there.

It's Starbucks, you know what you are going to get when you walk in.  Apparently this is THE place to hang in Franklin.  If you are there long enough you are likely to a celebrity here or there.  And if you are in Christan Music, it appears to be a must that you sit here and converse and write songs.  (not that I am complaining, I actually like secretly listing to your conversations)  

The staff is really nice, and quick at their work.  I sort of feel like you have to be promoted to work in this location, you never seem to see people here brand new off the street.  They have never yelled at me because my daughter was running around so my hat's off to them.

I really like the interior, but I don't like how online it says open till 11 but then I get there to work on a paper and they tell me at 8:56pm they close in 4 minutes. They didn't have their hours posted anywhere in the store. I also don't like how they start putting their food away at 7:30pm.

I come from New York City, which is chock full of great coffeeshops with great coffee, service, ambience. So I was kind of against Starbucks until I went to this location in the Foothills Mall shopping centre. It's just that I want to encourage the people who work here to keep up the superlative job they do. You greet people the second they walk in the door, even if you're with another customer at the register. As other reviews attest, you're much nicer and overall better than other locations.

The peppy young dark-haired woman with the high voice and the tall big guy with reddish hair are always so authentically (or seeming so) happy to be there. They don't ever seem stressed, yet they move fast and help everyone through, without stressing us the customers out. They never make anyone feel bad for asking for anything. It's a small location, but I don't mind sitting and hanging out when I'm not rushed.

There's another Starbucks closer to me, but they routinely ignore people waiting at the register and don't at all acknowledge anyone until they're right at the register ordering. It's like "Okay. It's your turn. I see you now. You may speak. Order. Good. Now go over there. Next."  But this small crew is very cool.

It's a Starbucks, so the coffee is solid and predictable. I wish more of their stock was Rainforest Alliance approved.  Still, this crew makes me feel okay about Starbucks and the staff's goodness has had a halo effect, such that now I go to the other ones in town.  Near the UofA, I still prefer to go to the local spots, but in the burbs and even at airports, I no longer feel so bad about doing Starbucks.

First visit while in this area. Slow filling mobile orders - over 10 minutes. Otherwise, same expected high quality with pleasant barista-ship. I'd say this location is difficult to access from Pendleton Pike with crowded parking lot. I'd bet drive their is its primary business - and that may work better.

I love Starbucks because of their consistency, yet this location needs more training on how to make their drinks to Starbucks normal standards. For some reason their espresso is incredibly weak and the color of iced tea... when I asked about why it was so weak they offered extra shots of espresso but again, it barely tasted like coffee. They need help.

The benefit of this location is solely parking availability. I don't like it as much as the old one/some other Starbucks because it doesn't have that variety of sections to sit. I prefer locations where there is an open section, a more quiet section for studying, etc. This one is all open--it's an old fast food restaurant and is laid out as such. 

The set up for ordering can be a bit confusing as it goes right to left. When I was in there, after being stumped myself, about half of the people who walked in after me asked me where the line started (I guess I was looking particularly friendly and knowledgable ) Staff was friendly, busy as usual, typical Starbucks with indoor as well as outdoor seating options and a drive through.
Slowest place in town. We're only here once a week & still have issues. Figure it out or close your drive through. A 5 minute wait here is short - expect 5 to 12 minutes in the drive-thru. Dumb.

Super friendly and nice baristas!  Decent drink.  This Starbucks is great for browsing the Internet, reading, or having a good conversation with a friend.  It's not so great for larger study groups.  The lighting is good - slightly dim but you can see well - and the place is very clean.

Ok... Hoped I would have more of a positive result this visit, but... no. I guess I should bring a beagle from DD if I want to eat one at Starbucks! 11th time and the 'RAN OUT'. 10am in the morning and they ran out. Right! I think I will just bring my own next time and stop thinking they are actually going to have something I want. Wish my meeting was in another location. Trapped like a rat.

If you ever are driving by this Starbucks, stop by. I recommend it!

What I had was the pumpkin spice latte, hold the whip cream. It was great. It came out fast, under two minutes, and service was friendly. This was surprising because there were a lot of customers. 
I came at about seven pm. 

If you go around this season, I'd definitely recommend. 

Update: also try the green tea latte.
