Even though a new store.. their supplier seems not to be able to keep them supplied with Herbal Chi tea or coconut milk. 
Don't blame the weather... just an excuse and not an acceptable reason.

Staff very friendly and service was quick and made to order.  EXCEPT out of tea and coconut milk for 3 days... Unsatisfactory, 

Wonder if their buyer has ever heard of counter to counter delivery? :-)

This is a convenient location for people in the King's Row neighborhood to swing through and get their fix. 

If you don't already use the app, download it and take advantage of rewards and promotions. Order ahead and set your favorite drink. 

The atmosphere here is good. It's a little hub and a little hub. Always the usual conversations, meetings, and faux-office set up. They rock the music at a nice volume. 

Of course if you're just on the run, theirs a better local place just up the street. ;)

Very friendly staff and plenty of study tables makes this a great place to enjoy a warm or iced cup of coffee. Makes sure to use that Starbucks card/app to earn a free drink and get free refills. It's the refills that help me stay awake enough to study for hours. If you happen to see me sleeping please have them refill my drink and get me back to my studies.

You know, I've had some irritating experiences (i.e. not seeing my cup by the Clover and therefore making 20 minutes' worth of drink orders before I showed them my cup sitting there), but overall, this is a great Starbucks location. I've been to countless Starbucks all over the country, and I find it very fortunate that my favorite is right down the road. 

The baristas are friendly, the drinks are made with accuracy, and they work quickly (which is important for such a busy location).

What a rude barista. My order was messed up & after explaining to the barista, she (mid aged Caucasian female)  was very upset that cashier hadn't ring up my order appropriately. It was a very simple order. She looked at me such a stranger way like I had done something really screwed up. I just flew 8 hours & this was my first stop in Indianapolis downtown, was hoping for a little bit warmer & welcoming response in the cold afternoon:(
Quick drive thru service
This place is always good.  The staff is efficient and accurate.  The store is always clean.  I love to place mobile orders for faster pickup.
The drive thru can be a mess at times.  I drove through here a few times and it took be well over 20 minutes to get my drink.

Exiting Crate & Barrell, I needed a pick me up to continue on my day in Tampa and decided to stroll in. Everyone is always so friendly here & my order was taken with a smile and was prepared quickly. They have a drive through for those who are on the run and still deserve their caffeine oomph. The entrance is a bit weird because it's a double lane that cuts off into a weird yielding turn so if there's traffic, you can be stuck on either side for a while. The WiFi is always strong and since the coffee shop is very clean- it allows for a laptop session alongside your iced coffee. There's a hunch if outlets everywhere which is probably due to them being a newer and more renovated location. Starbucks is always a good idea so when you're in the area, stop by for a quick caffeine boost. You'll be glad you did!

This location is so hit and miss, and it's one of the most inconsistent stores I have been in. I live right around the corner so this is my local "didn't have time to make coffee before I had to leave for work" drive thru shop. Each time I come, the drinks I get taste different, a phenomenon that is so confusing because of the nature of what this nationwide chain is built on. I suggest management have some training refresher courses to up the standards for all of the employees. 
I've also had a few awkward experiences with some of the baristas' customer service skills. The baristas seem to be more friendly and talkative to each other, and usually ignore any kind of conversation with customers, even when I'm standing right there staring at them. 
I'll still frequent this place, only really out of occasional necessity, but I hope management reads this and takes some action to change the culter and vibe of the store and the employees.
Nice environment, but atrocious terrible WiFi. You cannot even get 1Mbps upload or download. Standard is 20Mbps. Don't come here to use Wi-Fi and drink coffee... just come here to drink coffee.
I came here last week and all but one of my six very basic drink orders were made wrong. So today I just got a straight drip and water. What did they even hand me?

Such a convenient location with friendly staff. I do think there needs to be more attention to detail when it comes to orders. I ordered via mobile, requesting for no cheese, because of allergies, and two times, I found cheese. It even printed it clearly on sticker. I know it gets busy, I get it, but I also don't like wasting money on a good breakfast sandwich.
I love this Starbucks. The people there are nice. And most of the time they get the drink order correct. If they don't get it correct they make it right.

The place is too loud to get any work done. The environment feels a bit tense because there are too many employees talking and laughing just as loud as the customers. It doesn't have the sophisticated feeling as the other Starbucks I have gone to in Tucson.

The workers here at the Newtown branch are very upbeat and friendly and there is zero attitude, which is nice. The long lines move along very quickly too, even when they're busy. The noise factor is often really high, but I take my coffee to go so it isn't a problem. However, if you're trying to get some work done, it may not be the best spot.

Abosuletly will not be coming back after a rude barista that was not helpful and derogatory. It was not busy and I had to clarify an order because the item was not on the menu. The barista said she was going to help the drive through and be back after my quick call to my girlfriend to double check her order. During this process the barista had told me to speak up because my voice was cracking from being sick. When she left to go do the drive thru another barista finished my order before she returned to start making the order. I asked for no whip cream to both baristas including the second one who actually took the order. She made the drink with whip cream she retorted by saying I should've spoken up because she can barely hear me when she was not even the one who took the order in the end. She made it seem like it was completely my fault and did not make me feel welcomed at all in the store. Her blue hair and bad attitude have definitely encouraged me to avoid Starbucks' overpriced drinks to go to the Purple Bean just up the street from the Keystone location. Thanks but no thanks.

This place is supposedly open until 1 am but this was the first time i actually saw workers. I came around 10pm saturday night and they did not have ice coffee. They did not offer for me to wait while they brewed a fresh batch, or offer me something else. I ended up getting two shots over ice. $3.10 

I do like the connivence of this inside of the casino.

Asked for a $15 reload on my card. $50 was put on. went back to have it corrected. Alexis was very kind however, her manager Lori was not. Not only was her attire not of the Starbucks representative but her attitude was far from matching as well. Before she would even refund the $50 I had to pay the $9 and change for the coffee ( you think she would have comped that)... The incompetent manager did not refund the $50 in fact she charged me $50 more. After all said and done I'm sure corporate will be having a firm chat with her.
The music on point at this location! They play Motown and the seating bar in front of the window is great for people watching while talking to a friend! Great location

Beware the drive thru

If you want to use the drive thru make sure you have a lot of time on your hands. Several times I have been here and waited more than 20 minutes with only a few cars ahead. You get trapped if someone comes behind you and can't leave. Need better management or training.

They were crazy busy when I stopped by, but did the best they could with the staffing.  One barista, (Daniel, I think?) was exceptionally good - making chit-chat with a number of customers and remembering a lot of them by name while whipping up drinks.  I'm sure I'll be back.

This is one of my top Starbucks in Boise. Sure, the parking situation is a nightmare, but the location of this place is convenient and the inside is spacious. It seems almost like it is an old converted Burger King with the indoor patio seating that the old locations used to have. It has more than enough tables and chairs and there is separation so that it doesn't get too loud. The outside area is non-smoking... but then again, all of Boise pretty much is. It is shaded though and away from the main street traffic, which is bueno. I love the location, the service, and the layout. Can't beat that :)

This Starbucks is spacious and well laid out. The drive thru is an added convenience. I visit several times per week and the staff is always courteous. I prefer espresso and related drinks and am always pleased.

I highly do not recommend this Starbucks. Which sucks because there aren't any other ones close in this area. I literally spent 38 minutes in there drive thru yesterday THIRTY EIGHT MINUTES!! A few times before that it was bad too, but I left. This time I stuck it out to see how long it would be. Crazy. I ended up getting my drink free so did everyone else it seemed. You guys are losing money. Or somebody doesn't know how to run the drive thru. Good luck.
A little disappointing when at 8:30am a Starbucks still won't have their cold brew ready for another hour.

Although I do not drink starbucks often (way too pricey for me), I do like it here. The customer service is top notch! I noticed that they really try to get to know each and every customer there. They are huge on teamwork back there. When one person gets extremely busy, I noticed that they don't even need to ask for help. Other team members just step up and do their part.

They tend to always butcher my name, but I know they are trying. :-) Maybe if I came more often than once ever 2-3 weeks, they would get it right. Plus, I give them a thumbs up for knowing so many people's names since the place is always packed to its max.

This place have kicked up there game recently. The lines are moving much faster now! I'm basically in here everyday now. The workers are amazing. They all finally got my name right! Yay!!! 

So many drinks that I love but can't get all the time bc of the crazy calories:
Salted Caramel Frap & Mocha- Delicious. I love the salitness and sweetness
Double Chocolate frap with the choc whipped cream-YUM
White Choc Mocha-Mmm

hahaha...I could prob list the whole menu, but I won't.

Oh, the breakfast sandwiches and pastries are wonderful as well. Give those a try!

I have seen an employee, I believe she is actually the manager, coming back from a smoking break and start working without washing her hands. I have been going to this Starbucks often since I've been staying at this hotel and I have seen this happen more than once. How do I know she was coming from smoking break? Because her breath smells like ashtray! Disgusting!

Worst Starbucks Ever! The average wait in the drive through is 10 minutes, and then your lucky if they get your drink right! Going into the store is just as bad, you wait forever while the staff just stand around and chit chat. The only reason I keep coming is because it's the only Starbucks that is close to my house :-(
Frequent this Starbucks often. Turned OFF today when a staff member placed two toilet brushes in their holders on top of the counter where the bananas were, not smart.

This is my go-to Starbucks since I moved to Tucson. I used to get my drinks made wrong often, but that has started to fade. Today my green tea was made perfectly. Overall, all staff I have encountered are polite and friendly. Gets packed occasionally, but I love coming here to study.

Today I stood in a store new to me. Five people behind the counter, three looked me in the eye and let me stand there waiting to order.  I stood quietly as they finished what they were doing. They began other tasks and chatted with each other. After this continued on and on I finall asked the barista near to me if she could help me. She slowly moved to the register, rolled her eyes and waited for me to order. Unsure I asked if it was ok that she take my order. Annoyed she said order when ready. I stated I had been waiting for some time. Another eye roll. After I ordered she turned to her manager and called and called me a name I shall not repeat here. Then they were out of the cups and lids of the  size I ordered. I've never been here, but startled by the appallingly bad service and the ridiculous behavior of Starbucks employees.

The team that works at this location is nothing short of amazing. You made my day with your great service when I had a problem, no question asked. I couldn't ask for more. Try the pineapple infused back tea, zero calories and it tastes like you're on a tropical island. See you tomorrow guys.

We know what Starbucks is...so this is going to be quick. 24 hours. 

That's right 24! And...the only 24 hour coffee shop in Indiana! Well beyond truck stops and such. 

Fun, chatty, caffeinated staff. Ample leg room. 

I'd drive from my Northside location for this place. I bet they bend the rules and give free refills when it's the right thing to do at this Starbucks.

24 hours. Good form!


PS It's Starbucks, not Starbuck's. There's no possessive apostrophe necessary here. This reminds me of how sometimes folks will give a venue the possessive, which irks the syntactical beetlegeuse out of me. (For example...Bravo cafe is often said as "Bravo's.") I'm still trying to figure out how this pet peeve could possibly be linked to something deeper for me. Inner-Rabbi Therapist...your thoughts?

I usually like going to this drive thru but lately they've been careless with the drinks- twice in a row now i've been given my drink with the lid not on correctly and unfortunately my latest visit resulted in an entire venti iced coffee on the floor of my new car. My $2.95 coffee ended up being a $35 car detail experience.
They really know how to make a dry cap, dry. Clean, fast-ish, and friendly. Super clean thrones also.

My sister frequented this Starbucks location more than I did while we were living in Tucson, but here's what *I* have to say:

It's clean, the employees were friendly (except one who laughed at my Visa Card picture, but maybe I deserved it--I had my picture on my credit card), the deserts they had the last time I went in were delicious (okay, I didn't try everything, but the chocolate cupcake was good), and they made my Caramel Light Frappacino perfectly (because I like my drinks light and my sweets packed full of awfulness and sugar--I'm full of contradictions like that). When my sister went, she said they had her and her ex-boyfriend's order down to a "T," which I thought was kind of cool. 

Otherwise, it's a decent, typical Starbucks. Nothing awful, nothing exceptionally noteworthy...yet, here I am...making a note. 

Ha.

Not my usual Starbucks but the service was fast and friendly.  This location has lots of outside seating but is also surprisingly large inside as well.  It was a busy Saturday afternoon when we visited, but our drinks were up quickly and we were off to our spa treatments!

Employees are not the nicest.  I sometimes get coffee in the morning.  One particular female barista has a personality like wet mop.  I won't use the b***h word,  but you get it. . Can't even picture waking up to that drab unfriendly person in the morning.

Tried a new tea today but only 2 pumps of classic. Don't like sickeningly sweet; I prefer a bit tart. Score bonus points as the barista had me sample it before leaving, to be sure it was perfect. It was. Thanks Starbucks! Another satisfying beverage.

Will not come here again. This place is so slow and unfriendly. They have a new barista and the staff is not being supportive. I was not greeted at the register and not given my pastry after ordering. Then the barista is new and I totally understand but she doesn't know how to make all drinks yet but the staff is not explaining anything to her and you can see she is struggling. She made my drink wrong and now have been in Starbucks for 15 waiting for my drink....and I was first in line. I'll drive further and take my business elsewhere.
Worker named Jeremy was very rude. Worst Starbucks experience I've ever had. Confused as to how someone can act that way at their place of work at get away with it?! Come on Starbucks.

Coffee is okay. Drive thru service however is sub par. I ordered 2 iced coffees but was charged for 3. The second iced coffee I was handed was covered with coffee on the outside which ended up on my tan seats. Very sloppy.

Ok, here it goes. 
This Starbucks is perched on a portion of 309, just beyond the incredibly fun 5 points intersection making it (due to medians and traffic flow dividers) accessible only when you are traveling southbound on 309 while making it enviably inaccessible when driving north bound (though,  you could detour and go to the crowded overstuffed Montgomery Mall location two seconds away or to the 202/welsh road location if you're in need of  pick me up but unable to acces this location). The staff does NOT have a high turn over rate, leading to a heightened familiarity and relationship with Baristas. I very rarely have an issue with an order that is placed, even when I do mix it up or if I have a larger order than is usual. The selection of pastries, snacks, Juices and other refreshments is always up to my expectations. VERY rarely are the cases or shelves barren or devoid of goodies. The Baristas are quite helpful, and provide great recommendations based upon your tastes and preferences.  They always seem to genuinely enjoy their jobs, their coworkers and their interactions with the patrons! I go out of my way to go to ghis location, daily.

It got two stars because its the closest Starbucks to my house. Every time I've come here my drink has been crappy. The last time I went through the drive thru they made my drink wrong and I had to go inside and have them fix it. The girl was nice and I was nice about it but jeez

Awesomeness! Another Southside Starbucks near Costco. Unfortunately you have to drive into the Tucson Marketplace to a little strip mall on the Left side near the Costco, but it has a long drive thru, large interior and exterior seating area. It is Brand new.  

Here's a tip: When you drive into the Marketplace you can see the back of the strip mall and see how long the line is so you can decide to park or do the drive through.  When you pull in the Starbucks is on the Left side of the strip, but the drive thru is on the far Right side.

I do like the large interior and exterior, some Starbucks can be so cramped, the parking is sufficient as well.  Since it is NEW, the lines are getting long in the morning.  So Read my TIP above to get in quick.

I enjoy Starbucks and this location. It's right in the middle of town and you can sit outside and enjoy your coffee and the weather. My only complaint is the long wait and it's a bit dirty. The tables and chairs always have some kind of spill marks and crumbs and the bathrooms are just filthy. I'm sure if they fixed those things up it would be much more appealing. Getting my grande white chocolate mocha now!
Speedy service through the drive thru.  Courteous people on the intercom as well as the window.  Excellent location on the way to the freeway on-ramp.

Very nice Starbucks location.  I love the warm fireplace, and the views of the sierra from the window.  The location is large enough and loaded with seating so that you can find a seat even if it's busy (for the most part) and the service was quicker than most Starbucks I've been to and it was very friendly.

I often work out of coffee shops all around town, being a field sales rep and I got a gift card to Starbucks from my boss this year for Christmas.  This was a nice location to use it in.

I come this Starbucks very often to do my computer work while I'm drinking afternoon pick me up.  I like dark roast coffee and I do not care for any other kinds.  Starbucks is well known for its strong taste coffee, but not this one.  They only have Pike Place and Blonde Roast.  There is a sign of Pour Over French Roast, but they tell me they don't have dark roast at all.   Because I need a coffee, I take Pike Place, but it's not my favorite.  Can someone bring Dark Roast Back???
I like this Starbucks. It's big (took over a Chicken Restaurant), has a drive-thru, plenty off seating. They have a clover machine which gives you more options than the normal 3 drip brews.

Best Starbucks by far!!! 
My wife and I moved here back in January and this Starbucks is literally 2mins from our house. The location is convenient and perfectly placed downtown safety harbor. From the moment we first walked in the staff was so personable and friendly. We were big regulars back in Chicago and we thought we would never find another awesome Starbucks. This store is now our all time fav! So happy to be regulars. The coffee is never burnt, and every drink is made perfect. EVERY TIME! That sums up the reason for 5 stars. Awesome consistent service.

It is 7:30pm on Thanksgiving Day, and these folks will be here till midnight. You have no idea how grateful we were to call and be told your store would be the sole source of quality caffiene in the area still open at this holiday hour. After a day filled with food, family, and frustration, Chris and his bling-y pimp headset, and the rest of his team, were a lifesaver. Thank you Starbucks crew at this location, you rock our coffee colored socks.

This has got to be the biggest Starbucks in Tucson that I have found. Plenty of seating (indoors and out). It could be their big open glass windows that emits so much light that it makes the space look bigger, unlike the other dark, low lit ones. And like all the Starbucks everywhere the barista is super nice and cheer-y :)
Love this place! I come here to study all the time and the batista makes the drinks great. Im closer to the horsham branch but they're awful at what they do.... I drive a little more to come here
Stopped by this morning. My drink was alright but the place smelled like burnt coffee like usual. There were actually seats open today.  Most of the time there is barely enough room to wait.

Literally the best workers here, you can tell they care about their work and their customers. I come here almost every day, sometimes twice a day (lol) and I'm always served promptly and feel like a valued customer!

Service is good, but if you have to use the restroom, I would definitely go somewhere else.  I've seen gas station bathrooms that are 10x's cleaner than this one.  You even need a code to get in, you'd think it'd be cleaner
The bathroom was really dirty. The customer service was poor and the forgot to add some parts of my order.

Manager gave me grief when I asked him to refill the mug I bought at a different Starbucks. I have had this $20 Starbucks mug  filled at several different Starbucks in Tennessee with no problem but this guy told me it was against policy if I didn't buy it at that store. I didn't want him to go against policy so I drove away even though he said he would do it this one time.

Probably the worst Starbucks I've been to. Although it has been refurnished to look more modern, it has the most insane crowds -- I've come during all times of the day, and the lines are usually hitting the door and the huddle of people waiting for their drinks also hits up against the door as well. Not sure if this place is just inefficient or understaffed. Either way, I practically have to always allow 20-30 minutes to get in and out with my drink. Not worth it.

Go a couple blocks down State Street to the other Starbucks (539 State St) for better/quicker service and much much shorter line!

Today I went through the drive through before work and I ordered a trenta iced green tea non sweetend. They gave me a venti and I decided to let it slide. I noticed the color of the tea looked weird so I asked the lady "this is unsweetened, right?" She shook her head and said yes. I should have known better and tasted it while at the window, but since there was a line of cars behind me I drove off. Once I got to work I tasted my drink and it was fully sweetened and disgusting. I'm really bummed as normally they get my order correct as it's not a hard order.

This is an *update*
I went back in for another drink and after explaining that they keep messing up my green teas, they gave me a free green tea. They said they are training new people and mistakes have been happening quite often lately. They really do want to make their customers happy and I appreciate them giving me a free drink. Thank you!

One of my favorite Starbucks locations! Kind of a regular here to them too hahah ;)

They are always very efficient with the order sometimes it can take a minute for the drinks to be made tho. 

The staff is always very friendly and energetic! Nice to chat and say hey to some of the staff we know when we stop in or are in drive thru. 

Great double shots on ice, frapps, and wht choc mochas!

This place is great to get you the extra boost at work or to get your day going! Love the taste and caffeine pick me up! Haha

This location is great, check them out when you need your next cup!

This Starbucks gets busy as hell during the morning commute. However, they do their best and have a system set up that's as good as can be.

The staff were all nice, and the breakfast sandwich I got were good. Solid 'bucks.

I'm not the biggest fan of Starbucks drinks, but I find myself frequently at this location because it's so close to my house. It opened this year and is as new as it gets.

This location has a drive through and a spacious parking lot with two exits and plenty of room for the drive through to stack up without blocking cars in the parking lot (all of this is the beef I have with the Keystone Ave Starbucks). 

The seating area is well lit and has spacious windows that let in a lot of light. There's indoor and outdoor seating. I go here when I have to quarantine myself from my home or office to get uninterrupted work time. For this reason, I appreciate this Starbucks more than others because I feel like the baristas are not loudly having distracting conversations that the whole establishment is forced to listen to. I realize this may change, but it's been consistent (for me) so long as this location has been open. 

When it comes to eats & drinks....its Starbucks and there's nothing about this particular one that puts it above the rest. The staff here has always been friendly and if there's something I HAVE to get done...you'll probably find me here.

Here's a joke:
How long does it take a barista at this starbucks to make a cup of water?
10 minutes.
That's how long.

They now offer almond milk for .60 more per drink. I had it with my Pumpkin  Latte today.
They also offer a Chile Latte. Can't wait to try it!
Yelp Out!

I don't normally review large company chain type places such as Starbucks. But, I've been stopped by here several times in the morning during the busiest hours and the drive thru has always taken five minutes or less. They're always speedy and all of the employees are always polite and nice. I've also never had my order screwed up which is amazing. 

Also I do gotta give the company a shout out for addressing the volume of their plastic straw use and encouraging more use of reusable cups. I appreciate that they listen to what customers have to say on that matter. Now if they could just switch to paper cups without a plastic coating that can be recycled - then we'd really be talking! 

Also considering the location of the store, there's decent parking. Also if you are really in a pinch and are looking for parking so you can go into the store and study or something like that, you can always park at Costco and walk over - just be careful crossing the road between the Starbucks and Costco!

Close to the freeway, good for travelers, good promt service, nice drinks. Like any Starbucks.

Mostly close to the freeway.

Customer service- Not available at this location-
I went through the drive thru and waited 15 minutes meanwhile I was the only car then once ny drink is finished the girl puts it by the window- where the cashier and another employee continued to have a conversation while I sat there- with the drive thru window closed- so finally I yelled is there a problem - to high the rudely said what u talking bout - I said I been waiting for 15 minutes I want my drink sitting there- she says I'm talking to my manager closes the window and turns her back on me- so I drove off- calling district tomorrow-

Finally! A Starbucks with some COMFY chairs. There is a nice patio outside with misters and some mountain views. The drinks are the usual fare. But it's still a chain in my book. I just wish we had more local biz' to support. But I will take this location over the others.

This is probably the best Starbucks in Reno! It's right near where I live and I come here to read or draw because it's so comfy, I've never got anything but positive baristas and my order has never been wrong!

I was staying near this location for a month and my experiences were 50/50 right down the middle.. Everytime my order was just one drink.. the service and and drink were perfect. I had received suggestions on how to make my drink better next time I ordered it and recommendations on what might add flavor.. it was great.. 

But the other half of the time I ordered I always ordered 3 drinks and they were never correct. Ever.. if I said white mocha I got a white hot chocolate.. when I ordered my DoubleShot I received a Mocha.. whats weird is that each time it was a different persons fault.. one time it would be the cash register person writing the wrong order.. and the other time it was the barrista making the drinks.. it was really weird.. I have concluded that it is my fault for these mixups. Presumably my stunning features or my impeccable jaw-line distracting said persons to make mistakes. 

I have resigned to never attend this location again. I apologize for flaunting my essence and impeding your abilities. Good day.
Filthy. Not crowded but service is lackadaisical and it took me five minutes to get a tall coffee. Out of cream at station, garbage, crumbs, unclean tables everywhere. Signs of a poor manager.
The staff here is always friendly, I use the mobile app and they always have my drink ready and already know who I am and have it up on the bar for me.
Same as any other starbucks and it is nice inside and a drive through.  In a parking lot with other stores and not great at controlled direction so watch for cars it is Tyrone Blvd.
One of the best Starbucks in the area! Quick and friendly service with an efficient drive thru. Can't ask for much more when I'm on the go!
I like this Starbucks! They always make great coffee with good flavor. It gets SUPER busy in the mornings so get there early if yore going to work! Great with friendly baristas.
As far as Starbucks chain coffee shops go, this one is well managed, maintained, very clean, has friendly and knowledgeable staff, and make your order for a drink fast.
I don't drink coffee, but sometimes crave a green tea or egg sandwich.  It's good for a random pit stop but I think Starbucks prices are too high.

My favorite Starbucks because of the location first of all and secondly because of the really friendly baristas.  Unlike some Starbucks, this location has a very comfortable environment. anytime of day.
Typical Starbucks but they're kind of slow here. Not good if you're out over lunch break
BEST COFFEE EVERRR quick service too di love the coffee from this location more than the rest
I like the atmosphere of this starbucks. Plenty of different options for seating- comfy chairs, high top, long tables, small tables!
Been here often for coffee to go and in house. Service has always been great and order has always been correct. Yes it gets extremely busy but I've always seen the staff do their best
It's another one with a fitting exterior. It is the place we all know and appreciate for it's uniformity and selections. It's not perfect, but it wants to be.

I usually love starbucks, put in an online order, 1 cappuccino, 1 sausage and egg breakfast roll, coffee was great but I got a bacon and egg roll and it was cold? 
Swing and a miss here.

This is the first Starbucks I've seen with the new La Boulangerie pastries.  I didn't try any other them, but compared to the Starbucks offereings they replaced, I was very underwhelmed.  All the pastries look 1/2 the size as before.  Notably different and not as appetizing was the Iced Lemon Pound Cake.  That was my favorite.  But judging just by the size of the pastries, I'm not impressed.

This Starbucks is absolutely horrible. I work at another but this is the only one on my way into Doylestown. I have never received a drink here that is made right and it's extremely frustrating. My cold brew is watery, my frappuccinos are completely ice and no flavor and my lattes have dead bitter shots. They take forever when there's absolutely no reason. Never go here. Ever.
Quiet, pleasant, and predictable for a pair of tourists on a Sunday morning walk around the city.
I'm still upset about the stupid trash can issue of my previous post, but otherwise it's a decent Starbucks locations.
This is a pretty standard Starbucks. It's close to work for me, and the staff is very nice. It's really, REALLY small.

When I moved to Boise from Portland I was an avid Starbucks Hater.  However after experiencing local coffee I was happy to find one,and have since become a gold card member.  I decided to treat my parents to a cup of coffee on our way out of town on a Tuesday.   We entered the drive thru and place our order.  I had been trying (with no success) to access Starbucks on my smartphone to reload my card.  When I got to the payment window I asked if they could take my debit card and load my gold card, which they did.  My problem was that it seemed to take a long time to get our beverages. We had ordered a Venti mocha (hot) Venti Caramel Macchiato (iced) and a Venti Mocha Frappucino.  I don't know if they were short handed or what, no excuse or apology for the wait was offered.  Our drinks were well prepared, but over all we were not impressed with the service at this visit.
Very busy store you can get and right out! Lots of parking in the rear of the building!

This Starbucks has everything you could ask for. The vibe that you get from the small Westchase village give it the perfect atmosphere to meet a friend for a coffee and take a stroll through the park.

For some reason this specific Starbucks has gotten a bad wrap because the Westchase folks are supposedly snobby and stuck up, but I haven't found that to be true. I do think the baristas can be a bit frustrated sometimes but let's be real, most baristas working a busy cafe wouldn't be any different.

Overall it's a night fine Starbucks

Come here if you want to be treated like you're a bother to a group of very basic bitches with markered-in eyebrows. Very rude staff that were slow and uncaring. Gave me and my wife attitude about the code to the bathroom even though we were paying customers. 
The music is obnoxiously loud and when asked twice to lower it a little, they just blew me off. 
I was hoping to get some work done while here but I had to leave and find a location that wasn't bottom-of-the-barrel. 
Fortunately,  there's no shortage of better places nearby.

Worst customer service I have ever received at a Starbucks!! Girls were very unmotivated, and rude. I will never be back. 
Very, very disappointed!!

Groundside next to the security exit on the A side, this Starbucks is perfect if you're waiting to pick up an arriving guest. And like so many spots here in Music City, there is a stage set up for musicians. How awesome is that?

Standard Starbucks layout with pastries and coffees. Remember that you can't bring your coffee with you through security. There is another one on the other side.

No free wifi here.

This is my go to coffee place! The staff are all friendly and make you feel welcome! Eli, Ronnell and I believe his name is Tracey are FANTASTIC!!! Every time they see me they know who I am and they are always right on with my order! As long as they are there I will always be going back :D

Uugh, how disappointing for the Starbucks chain. This is getting very irritating. I mean, I know its Albertson's but come on, you don't have pain bagel's & cream cheese? They have almost every other heart attack breakfast thing there menu but no plain bagel's. KILLIN' ME SMALLS! Also, why is the light roast coffee taste like 20/50 motor oil? Strike 2 for Starbucks in Goleta. Very disappointing.
Jeremy is the best! He loves his customers, is attentive, quick, and always happy! New patio area is done! Go get your coffee at Starbucks in Bashas.

Great location, friendly baristas, always receive correct order. Parking can be a challenge because the lot is small and usually full. Drive thru is my favorite way to go. Convenient, efficient, and if you order ahead you can zip through the drive thru as well. A win-win!
Yes the coffee is good but an additional bonus is that the employees here are for the most part very attractive. A+
Staff is friendly, but the lines are long!! What do I expect I guess...its right on the busy State Street.  Good for your sbux fix, but not good if you're limited on time.

The checker was a young girl the only one that was not friendly. Because of her they get the one star. The food is always good at Starbucks or for the most part
But her attitude and lack of customer service was not good. The rest of the people working there nice.
Coffee is man's best friend....great place to hang however if you go here when middle school lets out you'll be invaded by little munchkins!
Friendly service and nice seating area. Staff was nice even after I accidentally broke a mug! Sometimes lines were long in the morning.

I am a small town barista, well was.  I don't care for yhe brunt flavor espresso that Starbucks serves up.  However I do like the I pike roast coffee and will get a travel size take along to share at work now and again.

I have gotten a travel box once before at this location, but today wow!  So nice, had it ready upon arrival as well as walked it out to my car! Above and beyond that morning.
If the restroom was clean would give 5 stars. Service is great, Batista's are friendly, pleasant atmosphere!
The staff is always friendly and helpful.  Even though my order is pretty simple people don't always get it how I like it all the time ...today it was perfect which so made my day!

This Starbucks consistently messes up my order. The service is also regularly slow. I gave it one last chance, but after several things I tried to order confused the barista, I gave up. We left without buying anything and are going to Chickfila. That will be the last time I ever go to this location.

You have probably heard people start their comment on things in such a format, " I don't want to be rude or complain but ......" After saying BUT they contradict themselves and throw out bunch of exaggerated complains.
 
I just want to be straightforward, I honestly like the location and most people who work there. I think this starbucks is one of the most successful location in Santa Barbara, however there are few things  that I like to be changed so me and other people who stopped going there change our mind and go back again.

First, the internet connection is poor. Every single time I go there either the internet is so slow that you cannot pull up anything or it starts fast and then after a while it drops repeatedly. I don't know if this is the corporation policy so people won't stay there too long or what? cause I haven't seen any other place with this type of WIFI problem.

Second, most of the time inside the store is so cold that you freeze, I've heard this from many people. if it is summer you have to go in with jacket and pants and then you come out from the store take off your jacket. It is like the ski resort they made in a mall in Dubai, people on one side (which is out) are wearing shorts and inside the resort people are actually playing snowball and skiing.

Third, this does NOT applies to all the staff that works in this particular location, but few of the people who work here they are so noisy and disturbing. I was very patient for the few times that I was there and they were making noise, speaking loud and yelling. I didn't feel like talking to a manager or anyone cause I didn't want to embarrass the guy and ruin their day. I don't like the businesses that look like kindergarten.   

However, the rest of the staff that are very professional are making the business look good.

Lost my debit card in the parking lot.  An employee went out of their way and found me on Facebook to let me know it had been found.  Drinks are always on point. The baristas always have a smile and go above and beyond the call of duty.  My new favorite Starbucks

I'm outside and their WiFi is working great.My.friend used their bathroom. No complaints. As a non-coffee drinker and independent bakery lover, it's everything I could ask for in an expensive coffee chain.
Love this place. Our Barista's are so friendly and remember us every time we go in? They even remember my usual drink! Great new sandwiches. 5more days till La Boulange.
It is ok. I can't complain. Only issue is how everything comes out of a bag and is reheated now. The food items at least.

This was such a cute Starbucks! The decor and ambience is really nice compared to the Starbucks down in So Cal. The location is perfectly on State St so expect there to be A LOT of people sitting and waiting in line to order. The baristas were all super friendly and helpful. Drinks came out really good and hit the spot!

Pretty solid Starbucks. I recently started going to this Starbucks on my way to work. They do a good job of really trying to get you out of he door quickly in the morning. Even though sometimes the line can look really long, it goes much quicker than it looks it will.

Ok regular customer comes in talks to the lady working up front says where's everyone at today the worker tells him you mean the homeless people? He's says yes she says I don't know where they are today they're always here during business hours seems !!!   They keep going on about this issue whole time I'm listening and learning what they're speaking of and particularly who?  So I guess Starbucks didn't learn anything about talking down to customers or profiling a set of customers that ain't even in the store?   I'm gonna report this to the higher ups that be cause I pulled out my phone and video the whole conversation tired of people thinking they can talk about whoever they want to if you don't have anything nice to say just don't say it

Love the location and staff, particularly James. He's one of the best mixologists (my preferred term) for making wonderfully delightful coffee and tea drinks. Hope this location does really well because it deserves it from my experiences there. - Steve Newcomb, Tucson, AZ
The staff are super nice. They ask how your day was at the drive through window!! And they haven't messed up a single order of mine.

The service at this location is so slow. I've come threw both drive threw and cafe different times of the day and I'll still be waiting in what seems to be no line and wait 5 mins for a tall dark roast and a bacon sandwich. One time I was in the cafe and for some reason my bacon sandwich wasn't cooked all the way I asked the barista with blonde hair and glasses if she could reheat it I got an eye roll. Which at that point I felt uncomfortable. When I left I said have a good day and have her my plate she take it from my hand and doesn't say a word and heads to the back room. Another barista comes to me and said she's been working a long shift. I don't think that's a good excuse nor professional. I will not be returning to this location.

This SB is close to my job, so I visit often. I appreciate the staff knowledge of the product and overall friendliness. Generally always clean a well stoked. They introduced me to youthberry which is my new obsession. Only concern is that they are soooo slow at times and not just during peak hours.
the best Starbucks location. The employees here are so friendly and engaging. They never mess up my drinks. Because of the location, it does get really crowded but it's worth the wait.
The spinach egg feta wrap at Starbucks is the best sandwich I've had in forever 5 outta 5 Starbucks good job!!

I'm simple. Grande mocha and a cake pop. It was chilly when I was in Boise, so I sucked down a whole lotta coffee. I only used the drive-thru at this location. Service was friendly and fast. My mocha was a little on the too-hot side, but I got over it.

This location is close to my apartment so I regularly visit this location. Its convenient to I-65 as well as most of the Greenwood area. The people here are very friendly. There have been a couple times where my order wasn't correct, but they've always fixed it. I've noticed that the errors have been in the drive thru, so I do recommend with complex orders you go inside verses the drive thru. Its not a 24 hr location anymore, but opens early in the morning and stays open late into the night. The inside has always been clean and a relaxing environment to just hang out with friends or get some work done. For the most part the service is fast, but there are times it seems to take forever. I don't know if it is because they are just really busy, understaffed, or just move at the speed of a turtle.
The staff at this Starbucks is always very friendly! Drinks are consistently good & made quickly. I highly recommend their new blonde espresso.
I like this location because it has a drive thru. It used to be a bagel shop, but I guess a Starbucks will do. It does have a bunch of comfy chairs inside.
Even worse the second time around. Thought I'd try again since it's on my commute. Watery drinks. Horribly long wait.
This Starbucks is definitely catered to large groups (I.e. Study groups, conference groups), which is awesome! Ideal ambience for reading and getting your coffee fix!

There's good and bad stuff about this Starbucks. When I went, it was incredibly busy and difficult to maneuver around but the employees managed to get drinks for the customers quickly. I also had to use the restroom and thought they were bothersome as they had locks and codes. Overall, it's probably quite nice when not busy and the employees handled the crowd well but there was minor problems that prevent the place from being good.

I use to work at this Starbucks location.  I have since left the company to stay at home with my family, and I still make the drive to see my folks at Starbucks!!  I love this location, it is by far my absolute favorite and I have been to Starbucks locations all over!

What can be said about Starbucks? Everyone has gone to Starbucks before.  The coffee is good and hot.  They are trying new things new food. The protein boxes.  The tea is good here.  The barista know the drinks well.  I asked for a breve. They knew what it was and made a good one!

Positive note: 
*New Starbucks! Open til 10pm everyday, including weekends! 
*Conveniently located off of Page Ave/364, next to QDOBA. Spacious and clean! 
*Like that they have separate restrooms for men and woman, unlike other Starbucks.

Negative note:  
*Took awhile to get my drinks. Felt like the drive-thru customers were their first priority and walk-ins were invisible. 
*Music is usually loud in other Starbucks too, but felt it was a lot more louder here...
*Some of the female staff members are rude.

Friendly, helpful employees (Thank you, Denny!)
Drive thru and counter service 
Expeditious service
5 / 5!

Honestly I used to come here every day...  Yes they used to pay attention to what you ordered and even know you by name... I've been going to this Starbucks 4+ yrs and this the third time in different occasions that I've been rushed to take my drink order..  The cashier didn't even listen when I said I wanted to load my gold card first so I can get my star,  not to mention he took more time with the guy with 7 drinks in one order, ahead of me.  Then paying attention to what I had ordered.  And then it still came out wrong in the end. I understand they are trying to work faster however you are losing guest service experiences all around..  And by reviewing this I can tell I'm not the only that feels this way...  Miss all the old crew here..  The newbies need to step up there game. Or another coffee shop will be getting my money.
Great location and friendly staff. Whenever I'm visiting Downtown Reno this is the only Starbucks I go to.

I ordered a Tall Maple Pecan Latte', with no ice. The barista called me up to the counter to clarify that I didn't want ice. I've ordered "no ice" many times. So I didn't quite understand her confusion. I figured she must be new but she acted as if I was the confused one. I simply restated what I ordered. And she said "ok" with a glib smirk. 

What she gave me was half of a tall latte. She Evidently she figured out that I was trying to defraud Starbucks and she was going to protect the company's bottom line. 

Again, I've ordered Tall lattes with no ice many times. Never before has a barista stiffed me half a cup of a latte. I paid $4.86 for a half of a tall Latte. Nice.

This is probably my favorite Starbucks in the Tucson area. The staff is awesome, the service is fast and the seating is the best. Lots of space for studying and relaxing (I never feel cramped unlike other Starbucks in the area). I would totally recommend this Starbucks!
Love Starbucks but this place could be better in employees. They are dull and boring and could be more cheerful . Wish they had a drive thru tho. Other than that this is a decent Starbucks.
Most disorganized service of a Starbucks. Mobile orders take twice as long as walkup orders

Great staff, bigger than appears from outside

The amount of personal interviews, small office meetings, and real estate closings held in here, just RUIN it.

From across the small place, with little soundproofing, you hear self promoting projectors and their agendas, more than you want to.

Fun to meet up with friends, even a cup by yourself, but there is real taking advantage of, particularly this location.

Went to this Starbucks Friday night to relax and the staff was very unprofessional. All were talking about things that were inappropriate. I saw each of the three staff members that were working, eating while they were preparing drinks!  Some were even talking to each other with a mouthful of food. I didn't see any of them wash their hands after they snacked on rice crispy treats, prior to preparing the next drink. Rather gross. There was no background music to drown out their conversations and you could hear them making fun of how the drive through customers were placing their orders. Customers like me pay top dollar at Starbucks, not only for the drinks, but for the ambiance and I have to say that I was sorely disappointed tonight.

I have never gotten Starbucks before so this was my first visit for a casual business meeting. Ample parking and plenty of seating. I went to the register and gave Ryan a very vague "I want something hot and super sweet". He narrowed down my drink by asking a few more questions and within 5 minutes I had my new favorite drink. He even offered to make me something else for free if I wasn't happy. I just wish it had a drive thru!

Horrible service. I used to come here everyday. Stopped for about 6 months. Figured I'd try it again today. Bad idea. No line inside and quick ordering but it took forever to get my drink after I had to get back in line to complain. There excuse? We make the drive thru drinks first.

My least favorite Starbucks not only in Reno but in the planet! I've been to Starbucks all over the world and the Keystone Starbucks is by far the worst one of them all. They forget something every time. Whether it be creamer, ice water, or even my sandwich. Go out of your way to another Starbucks and stay away from this one.

I travel through out the country and visit a Starbucks daily. I truly believe in the product and experience.
This location needs assistance. Customer service is lacking and productivity is almost non existent. 

3/10/16 if zero stars was an option that's what today's visit would get.
This store needs some supervision and to be attentive. 

Starbucks fan for life just need to find a new store off the expressway.

Clean, straight forward Starbucks.
For some reason the green tea does not taste like the ones I get in CA. I know, I know this is blasphemy for a corporate chain ....... I'm so sorry.
I guess the problem is me, I am monotone - I just get one drink over and over.
This location is a former Captain D's Seafood restaurant, and they've created a great covered patio to relax an hang out.

This is one of the Starbucks locations that is closest to me. While I don't go all the time, I can't help but notice that every time I'm here, whatever time of day it is, the staff is positively slammed and buzzing around making orders. Even so, my order has never been wrong, nor has anyone on staff every been rude. They know what they're doing.
The drinks were good. But when you order and are charged for a venti I also expect the cup to be filled more then half way.

We stopped in here to grab a sweet treat after a tough day. Our barista Bryan welcomed us with a smile. He was very sweet and caring. He asked how our day was and we briefly explained what we had just experienced.  He said he was sorry for our loss and really made us feel better. He went above and beyond and that was outstanding customer service for me. He didn't have to care but he did. I hope @Starbucks knows how lucky they are to have such an awesome employee working for them.

5 STARS for STARbucks! I find the Starbucks company to be a wonderful business. They have done everything possible to make sure their valued customers can have WHAT they want AS SOON as they want it! Example: there are 3 on State Street easily within walking distance. And they have state of the art expresso machines that almost just make the drinks by themselves, so the 'barista' 's job is mostly to make your day instead of make your drink! Lol. And they always make it just the way you like it! I hate the stupid 'milk foam' other places put on their drinks, and Starbucks barely gives you any! And if they do, it's mostly just big bubbles so it's not gross like 'foam' is! At Starbucks if they don't make your drink right you can kindly tell them and they will offer you a drink 'on the house'! Who doesn't love something for free! 
I like to go to Starbucks and find their comfiest chair, plug in my laptop and just 'chillax' and unwind. It's basically "my chair" at this point! Also the nicknames abound and are so fun to use. "Charbucks", *$, 'the bucks'; no matter what ya call it, everyone knows!
I also loooove their little names for things. Like 'whip' for whipped cream, and 'frap' for their 'frappuchino' drinks, and 'grande' to mean medium instead of large. It gives me the unique opportunity to use a foreign language as part of my daily routine.
Great location and potentially great ambiance EXCEPT FOR THE YOUNG WOMAN SCRAPING 20 CHAIRS ON THE TILE FLOORS as she cleans tables and scoots chairs. Really prefer fingernails on chalkboard.

Their drinks are always on target! Nothing ever taste wrong or not enough. For the most part, the staff are all nice! I highly recommend this Starbucks! It just doesn't have a drive thru & that's why I don't go here a lot.

Not friendly at all! Didn't ask the normal things you ask when you are in service like, " can I help you"... Just looks at you until you figure out she is ready for you. I would have at least appreciated a thank you for spending over $10 for two coffees. This used to be a good place to come, now just a bunch of unhappy, entitled people that are obviously unhappy with life.

The girl Blair did not use gloves when she touched the food as she made the smoothie. Who knows when the last time she washed her hands. Also, there was no toilet paper in the bathroom. 1 stars because of this!
Drive-thru line was out to the street, but they were so fast! We were amazed. In line for less than 5 minute. Friendly and good drinks.
Easily the worst Starbucks you'll ever visit. Staff is incompetent and detached.

I don't like giving bad reviews but this location begs for one. 

I can't say they've NEVER made my drink correctly, but 5 of 6 visits is pretty bad. I'm always patient and politely ask for my drink to be re-made; sometimes they've been okay about it and some times they've been rude. 

In general, I can't say they're "rude" at this store but they're certainly not welcoming or pleasant... and when they mess up they have a way of making it seem like your fault. When I order the exact same drink every single day of the year, I'm 100% certain I'm not the one who messed up there. 

This is the closet Starbucks to me and I now drive to the Starbucks on State Street. will drive across town to avoid this one.  I really tried to like this one (due to the vicinity) but no matter how many times I returned it was the same thing. If I'm spending 5.00+ on a coffee, I expect for it to be at least close to what I ordered and I don't except you to get angry at me because you messed it up.
First time here yesterday. Wasn't busy at all, friendly staff, & quick service. One of the best Starbucks I've ever been to. Service with a smile, that's the way it should be and the way it is here!

I love this Starbucks I been coming here for couple weeks now I always set on my laptop for long hours 
They are super nice and the girl that work there I couldn't get her name she the one with tattoo she is amazing like amazinggggggggg

I go to this Starbucks regularly since it opened to study. Wait times for drinks have gotten progressively longer. The interior of the store is freezing, I mean freezing!!! I wear long pants, long sleeve shirts and bring a sweatshirt and I'm still cold. I've asked them to turn the air conditioning temp up a little and said they couldn't because it is controlled by corporate. Don't know how true that is. I have had to leave many times because the Internet was ridiculously slow and could not support the live lectures I needed to view for my classes. Looking for a new place to study.

This is by fat my favorite Starbucks in Tucson. The staff is always friendly and speedy and the atmosphere is always a positive one. This location is right between my house and my work and I love coming here regularly!

My family and I were/are so excited that a Starbucks with a drive thru has opened up close to us. We have been here several times now. Both in store and through the drive thru. In store they are VERY slow on getting drinks out. My problem with drive thru - I had a free coffee on my Starbucks gold card and I told that to them. The barista gave me the total for my drinks ( $18 and change) I reminded her that I had a free drink. I then paid and was not given a receipt. While I was waiting for my drinks I asked how much was my total with my free coffee? She replied "$12 something". I asked for a receipt. I then saw that I was charged the $18! I told her this and she apologized and asked if I wanted to go inside and get a credit or use it next time. I did not want to go inside and will get my free coffee another time. What I don't like is I wasn't given a receipt and I feel like she just flat out lied to me. I will now always ask for a receipt since I visit Starbucks regularly.

I used to love to go here but whenever I go to this location, I regret it. Last time I got a smoothie here it was just ice and orange juice and mostly ice. Today, my sandwich was still frozen. We also got a Danish and it was stale and my caramel machiatto had so much caramel syrup that the straw was clogged from top to bottom. It was too sweet for me to drink (and I've been known to eat sugar). I agree with other posters that say the staff here look miserable and behave discourteously.  

If you're in the area of this Starbucks, I recommend driving further down the street to the 5th Street location or heading over to the Purple Bean.

Excellent customer service! Super friendly and knowlegable staff. I was curious about a new drink on the menu and they said go ahead and try it and if it's not to your liking we'll make you whatever else you'd typically get, how freaking awesome is that? :) So didn't like the new item lol and they quickly made the usual for me and were absolutely delightful.

I can't believe we are reviewing Starbucks. But then again, we also reviewed Wal-Mart and Super Fresh (ah, local Philly flavor!).

I personally don't like their coffee (too bold), but I suppose Starbucks is good for those who drink Coca-Cola Blak (that's caffeinated caffeine for those not in the know) or for those who need to be hit in the head with an anvil to wake up in the morning. 

BUT, Starbucks' Iced Black Tea in the summer is incredible. For colder months, go for Pumpkin Spice!

Horrible customer service. There's a girl who works there, she must be a manager, she is so rude. She always has her hair tied back tight and has painted on thick eyebrows. Please fire her. My friend kindly asked for her to correct her drink since they put sweetener in it on accident & she made it seem like it was her fault. Took it back and just handed it to her without saying a word. No smile from her. No personal interaction. And this is my weeklong observation of going there twice a day for 7 days straight.

I've been a loyal customer to Starbucks for years and never been so dissapointed. For the last 2 days I've had bad experiences with 2 employees. The guys are always extremely friendly but most of the girls are rude, helpless, and don't have customer service skills. I ask for a bag and I'm expected to bag my own purchase. My drinks are made and just set on the counter by the barrista without her calling them out when there's not that many customers. The only reason why I gave 2 stars and not 1 is because there are some employees who know what they are doing. Overall unnecessary experiences.

A standard Starbucks location, this has been a fixture on Jasper Avenue for many years. That said it does have limited seating available and unlike many of the other Starbucks locations I've visited it had items in the display case that were out of stock (rather than removing them from the display case when they ran out they left them there) when I visited which was pretty disappointing. 

Still, the staff was friendly upon my visit, and I was able to relax by a window for a while to enjoy my treat. It's nice to have this reliable chain with its excellent rewards program in so many accessible places when one wants them.
The wifi doesn't work. Having come in to take a web meeting, this was pretty frustrating and no one was able to resolve the issue.

Stopped in today around 530/6 and there was a deaf family ordering lots of frapps and goodies. One guy was writing down all his questions and drink orders and she was writing back the answers to his questions. The barista was SO patient and undeterred and totally not flustered by the growing line, it was great.  With Sbux new push to make their stores accessible by all, this was a great example. I was really, really, REALLY impressed. You go girl.
AND, this store is always great with my stupid drink. :) Love it!

New Starbucks location right in lobby of my hotel which is super convenient while I am staying here for a convention and need my morning caffeine.

This spot is kind of fancy looking with a nice counter area and crystal chandeliers hanging in front of it. Full menu as with most locations.

Lots of seating - high-top tables, window counter, outside patio seating street side, and even a little nook with comfy leather chairs. 

Free wifi.

Very friendly staff that welcomes everyone who enters with a hearty hello and will engage in cordial conversation. Quick and attentive with the drinks.

Adjacent to the Omni Hotel lobby so you can take your drink to one of the nice couches there and relax while watching some tv on the flat screen.

Plus, my hot coffee does not have that burnt bitter taste here as other locations seem to have. That's a win in my book.

No respect for handicapped people. The handicapped table has been used the entire time I've been in the cafe, over 1 hour, and no one cares. The first 40 min it was occupied by a Starbucks manager interviewing a candidate. Shame, shameful.

They did a really good job they got my drink on the first try no questions asked and didn't even charge me for the drizzle being that I didn't want it inside the cup which a lot of the Starbucks are doing now and seems very silly to me since I don't have it in the cup and it's not using all of that product I shouldn't have to pay $.60 for something that is such a tiny amount.

Good Starbucks. 
It is usually busy when I go there but the line moves quick. 
Good location for me.
The staff is friendly.
clean.
Although busy FABULOUS! Staff is attentive and organized although a big line in and out with coffee stirred in about 10 minutes faster then pumping my gas

Soooooooo slow. Since last week it seems that every single staff member has been swapped out with newbies. Took 5 min to order a Venti Cool Lime Refresher with Black Tea instead of H2O. Yikes. Don't come here if you are in a hurry.

I know it is a Starbucks right?  No!! All Starbucks are NOT created equally!  

Are you a real extreme coffee lover?

Well then you probably know all about Clover.   Still with thousands of stores, you only find the Clover machines in wealthier areas because the cup of coffee will cost you twice the regular price.... But oh so worth it!!!  True coffee bliss!!!!!!  I had the new Oahu and, well, it made me write this review as it was just that good!!!!  

Love coffee???  You owe it to yourself to try a Clover.  Good Barrista, too.... Knew what he was doing.

Well.. this SB is on a busy NE road near Lawrence Township Indiana and this is my first time here. For starters it is not up to the standards of the East Coast ones. First I will say I waited quite long at the counter for someone to help me. After some time I purchased a sandwich from under the counter, a coffee and a cake pop. Once I got to my table I noticed the freshness on my sandwich was 2 days past. At the coffee station there were no sweet n low packs and all around the floor was quite dirty. Plus when I went to go there was only one trash can I could find and it was totally full. I had to go outside to throw my trash away. When I mentioned this to one gal behind the counter she looked at me like I was from outer space and never said a word. Yikes. Not sure will be back.

So pissed about our experience today (and this isn't the first time this has happened. My husband and I just had a baby and decided to treat ourselves to a coffee today; it's not easy to get out of the house and get coffee so we don't do it often. Anyways, we ordered a grande white chocolate mocha and when we got home to drink it, we opened the cup and it was literally only half full! What a waste of $5 - they had to have known the coffee went full when they served it to us

I had an early meeting in this neighborhood so I stopped at this new Maryland Heights Starbucks because I was early for the meeting. I got a Venti Jade Citrus Mint Hot Tea. The place was mobbed. The drive thru was mobbed. The mobile order pickups were mobbed. I got my tea and it was HOT!
This new location is notoriously slow in preparing mobile orders. They also served my wife burnt coffee beans recently in her eggnog latte. Friendly, but certainly lacking in the production side.
I came here to enjoy a coffee with my family and the staff ignored us. The customer service was especially horrid. I will not return to this location. I would not recommend this Starbucks.

Very poorly run Starbucks. Lazy, disinterested employees. Wont make a bulletproof coffee, making up some nonsense about how they are not allowed to, even though all other Starbucks do. This place needs to get up to speed...

Starbucks are usually Starbucks, except for the staff. They usually make the difference ANY place you might go. 

Well, the staff here was VERY nice. They watched my laptop while I left for a moment. They made excellent suggestions while ordering. 

The only complaint this day was that someone left something in or on something for too long. There was a burning smell for a while.

It was nice and cold inside while it was hot outside, and this makes ALL the difference when drinking coffee in the summer.
Large, center of town, clover brewing system, windows/counter for view. Can get crowded and not the cleanest store.

I've stopped at this location often because it is near my place of employment. Everyone is always extremely friendly & polite. The navigation of the parking lot is rather tight but the kindness makes up for it. I've been particularly impressed recently because even tho the interior is going thru renovations they are still in service with a temporary truck. Service is still as swift & polite as usual.

Very crowded and hopping Starbucks in hipster Newtown area of Bucks. If you are into people watching, especially attractive young yuppies, this is the Best of the Bucks Starbucks to go to. Seems popular with the college age crowd on the weekends and the working crowd during the week. But If you like a quieter environment to drink your latte, this probably would not be the best of the Bucks County Starbucks to go to. Food case could be bigger and the seating area is small and cramped. (Although they do have a smaller outcave to the side for seating with few extra seats. Parking can be difficult especially on the weekends as it's all off street and always crowded. Bathrooms could also be cleaned more often i found. This location does the job I guess if you just want a Starbucks drink and go but other than that, there are better Starbucks in Bucks in my opinion!

A genuine little piece of Seattle right in downtown Franklin -- What a beautiful addition to historic West Main St.! Now we're talking civilization. The only espresso shot in middle Tennessee poured in less than ten minutes! A WARNING however: This starbucks *is* a bit of a surprise. I mean, yes they do have the wonderful digital wall prints and tacky art-glass lampshades and cartoonish overstuffed furniture-- don't worry about that. But, there is a long hallway to get to the bathrooms in the back. TIP: If you just want to go to the bathroom and don't care for the "icky bitter coffee junk", go through the back door (adjacent to rear parking lot) and duck in unnoticed! I think this is a great place to stumble over from Mccreary's to and cover up your drunken stupor by doming a venti quad bullseye in one gulp, getting in your car and careening through the baby strollers as you make your getaway!

Loft is very European at this one,  nice. 
Very busy with tourists. 
I've had fine service here  and also horribly rude very Un-Starbucks quality service.

The service here is one of the worst I've seen at Starbucks.  They try to be so quick (even when it's not that busy - I guess they are rushing to take a break) that they miss the customer service part.  I'm serious about customer service - some may say, it's just a cup a coffee - I would say, so is Folger's instant crystals, and when they have store and baristas, I will expect the same from them.

Learn to make the drinks right i thought starbucks was supposed to be good an not a mismatched compilation of random amounts of different drink mixes if you guys don't like your job don't take it out on paying customers like seriously grow up

This place has gone downhill since Micah went to work for Platinum during the day. Now it is a bunch of lame ass chicks, that will tell you that you can't have a drink that you just had the day before.

Sorry but I will no longer come here during the day, My last experience was a huge turnoff and the hag staffing the drivethru needs to improve her snotty attitude. I didn't even get my MAKE IT RIGHT coupon. 

Bye Bye Bitches!

While driving from Louisville to Chicago, I made a stop over here. 
It's conveniently located next to the interstate near the exit. 
Quick service, friendly staff and clean store.
The coffee tastes as same as every Starbucks coffee tastes.
I love Starbucks!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

The designer coffee drinks and teas are rich here, as is the Belle Meade west Nashville clientele.  Customers are a proper mix of fashionable society ladies, men with their Wall Street Journals (thank you Mr. Murdoch), and and some student types from nearby Nashville Tech college. PS: some regular folk like I hang here too.
Plenty of space to chat. This is a larger location than most, I think. It's not too far off the highway, and there are lots of other businesses around. Also, there's a drive thru!

This starbucks is located in a big "Gateway" shopping center and is my go to after I hit up Saladworks or the deli or the Taco joint at lunch time.

In the morning it's swamped but at lunch I can usually get my four-bucks (try almost $5 for a Grande Iced Macchiato) caffeine fix.

Le sigh...

Typical Starbucks inside nugget hotel. My first hot coffee was untypical of Starbucks and awful. My iced coffee was atypical and awesome. My iced tea was also awesome. No I didn't drink these all in one day. We stayed here for a few days so these drinks I experienced over several days. Yes I do have a Starbucks problem

I have been to many Starbucks and this one is the BEST. 

First, just spacing, most Starbucks are not set up well, and this one has plenty of space and seating, plus a fireplace! 

Second, they ARE FAST. I have never been to a faster Starbucks. Most Starbucks I go to it seems like everyone is trying to figure out their job rather than just execute. Here everyone is on the ball, even if they are busy, they still fly the drinks out. 

Third, FRIENDLY, all the people who there are quality, fast, and friendly. It feels like a local place. 

Every time I go to another Starbucks, I always miss this one, so that tells you that is the BEST!

I love the location and drive thru option of this Starbucks but the coffee has recently been less than satisfying. 

The atmosphere is pleasant and clean. The staff are friendly and polite. The drive thru is clutch. Food is meh-right. The coffee is unpleasantly watery like there isn't enough coffee beans for the brew. Add more beans and this place will shine again like it did in it's hey day.

I use the drive thru at least once every two weeks and the service here is amazing! 

One time the barista, I think his name is Michael, gave me a compliment on my outfit. I'm a stay at home mom and I know I didn't really look quite that good with my yoga pants outfit but I put a little bit more effort on my top and I put some blush on. But anyway, he said he liked my outfit so it made my day. He also made sure he gave me enough straws (you can never have too many especially if you have a toddler).

Another time, I ordered a grande drink and I told the barista that I had a birthday reward to use. She asked if I wanted to upgrade to a venti! Umm hello?!! Yes please! I kicked myself for not ordering a venti to begin with but I didn't wanna be greedy so I'm so glad she offered!

They're the best at this location! Keep it up guys! 

Thank you!

I think that what malls were in the '80s, (and continue to be in New Jersey today), is how the '00s will look back on 'Bucks. A fad to be laughed at.

In 1995, when a Starbucks opened up a block from my house, I was happy. Twelve years later, I'm sick of seeing them everywhere, and I'm sick of the effect they've had on the English language, and the consciousness that it's okay to pay 10 dollars for two coffees in a paper cup. You're not ordering a Scion... you're getting coffee; kill it with the options!

The only time I use the 'Bucks is when I'm driving on the various turnpikes of the tri-state... and in need of that Costa Rican crack that strips the enamel off of my teeth. I'm at Dunkin Donuts... which might the John Candy of coffee houses, but I never had a problem with Trains, Planes, and Automobiles.

I have had nothing but great service at this new Starbucks in Lutz. Not only is it super convenient before heading onto 75 for my morning commute but it's quick to get in and back out to 54. Most every person working the drive thru makes an effort to have conversation with you as you wait for them to hand you your order. The food comes out hot and my custom drink orders are always done right the first time. 

This morning it was SUPER busy not only through the drive thru but inside as well. I could see and hear all the people in the store through the drive thru window and the parking lot was packed. I made it through the drive through quickly as usual but was asked to pull around to the front doors where they would bring out my food because it wasn't quite done yet. That was fine. I wasn't waiting long and I appreciate their courteousness for the customers waiting behind me. If it were me waiting behind someone in the drive thru line I would've appreciated this as well. There have been so many times at another nearby Starbucks location west of here that I've waited unreasonable lengths of time behind people whose orders weren't ready. They have their operations nearly perfected here. 

Awesome staff, awesome location and awesome service! Will definitely frequent this location not just for convenience but for it's 5 start service!

Up until the last few months, I have LOVED this Starbucks.  I am downgrading to 2 stars based on on consistently poor experiences that are driven by the staff.  Let me say, if you get some of the more 'tenured' Baristas you will get top notch service and drinks, but there are a couple of newer (newer to me) Baristas that seemingly don't know what they are doing.  If I am paying a chunk of change for a specialty drink with extra shots -- have the courtesy to pay attention and make it correctly.  The last four visits, one Barista in particular doesn't pay attention, leaves out shots, pumps the wrong syrup, gives me whole milk instead of NF... the list goes on.  I started actually watching him from the side after the first 2 issues I had with my drinks... he gets it wrong every.single.time.

When I see him working, I feel as though someone in this cosmic world hates me.  I have written two letters thus far to customer service... hopefully they will get this guy some training.

This is a great Starbucks right in the heart of town. One of the few you see anymore that isn't a drivethru. It really keeps hold of the old ways of the neighborhood store. I moved away from Florida 3.5 years ago and just came back for a vacation for the first time since I left.
