And while there has been some turnover there were still a few baristas (and the manager) who remember me by name. It's nice to still feel like a regular in a town that has changed so much in the last few years. 

Outside of that this store while busy can usually get you through the line quickly and is kept clean and comfortable. There is ample seating inside and out and the music is kept low enough that you can easily read, study, or work if you want to camp out for a while.
Great Starbucks. Helpful and friendly staff most of the time. Consistently great coffee.

The girl Kaylen that works there has the worst service ever. She didn't give me my receipt but I wanted  to complain about her service so I grabbed it from the register so I could get her name.Nice try lady, but I'm shameless. She was rude and messed up my order and then refused to fix it. I realize working early on Sunday morning sucks but don't take it out on the customers. It's not the kind of service I am used to at Starbucks. I really should have gone to mcdonalds, cheaper for the same bad customer service. I used to love this Starbucks and am really sad to see it go downhill. I hope Kaylen gets a better attitude because I know people that work for Starbucks and they really do treat their employees well.

Usually I have a great experience at this Starbucks but the past couple times have been horrible. Maybe it's the change of staff but I can't even get a simple "hello" or an ounce of kindness. Baristas look at me and other customers rude and every time I've asked a question, I would get a condescending answer. I won't be coming back.

Very slow service. I write this review as I've already been sitting in the drive-thru for 15 minutes. Also, they seem to always be out of Trenta cups. What's up with that? This seems to be the slowest, most disorganized Starbucks I've ever visited. I happen by here about once a week, and it is consistently poor.

Service has taken a backseat, and standards have fallen. This once shining example of Starbucks franchise consistency has been pulled down by new hires who are difficult to understand (in person as well as on the intercom), and who appear to give no effort to customer service.

I can tolerate a decent amount of shenanigans but my experience this morning was so abysmal that I have to cry foul. Not only was the window attendant impossible to understand because of a lack of enunciation but he "no look" passed me my coffee and spilled it on my hand. Then he didn't  notice what he had done because he instantly turned his back on me. I would expect this from a Duncan Donuts or McDonald's, but not a Starbucks.
Typical Starbucks - consistent product, friendly service and clean establishment.

Went there today to get my usual drink. I usually go to the baseline one but decided to switch it up.  For some reason it all of a sudden cost more so I asked the barista why via speaker to which she responded "see you at the window" ummm okay doesn't answer my question. Then I drive up to the window and ask her the same thing because it's always the same price and now it's more to which she literally responded "I don't know I just press the button and it gives me the price". When my coffee was finally made (a good 7 minutes later!) she hands me the cup that has melted ice and iced coffee dripping from it. When asked for a napkin she gave it to me with an attitude. She also looked like it's such an inconvenience for her to even be there and like we should be honoured by her presence. Here is a little tip honey. You're not meant for customer service go do something else and take a nap maybe.

Super disappointed with the change of this location. I have worked across from this Starbucks since it was placed there and I have never been more disappointed and frustrated as I am now. The service has gone way down hill. The crew are still polite (which is great), but the place is dirty, there are never enough staff members working, and the time it takes to get anything besides a drip coffee is way too long! It seems that there have been too many new hires that are not trained long enough and just put on the register, machine, and than you wait and wait and wait. My co workers and I are pretty patient, but some of us including myself has walked out and gone to Coffee Bean across the way just to have faster service. I so miss the days that the store was staffed well, it was clean, and your wait time was quick. I really hope that they have a better manager to show some leadership and care for this place. It's in the middle of State Street with a lot of traffic too (bonus)! At this point, I don't even want to step foot in there again. So bummed and sad. If you go, make sure that you have plenty of time, and that you don't mind repeating your order over and over so that the poor clerk can punch it in correctly. Hope to see a good positive change sooner than later!

In my opinion the only thing you can review at Starbucks is the people that are serving you, the cleanliness of the facility and the location.  The coffee and the "snack" assortment is what it is...

At this location the staff is average.  They do their job and do it fairly well.  I think it would be better if the staff paid more attention to their customers.

The facility is clean and neat.  The location is convenient and has a drive through.  My only caution is on the drive through, watch the turn as it is very tight.

I'm stuck between giving this place 4 and 5 stars. 4 stars because Starbucks in general doesn't have the greatest coffee but 5 because this is definitively my favorite Starbucks in the area. I think if this Starbucks got a Clover machine and started brewing more than the basic Starbucks menu, it would be easily pushed into the 5 star rating category. 

Anyway. Internal dilemmas aside, why do I like this Starbucks so much? It's fairly large in comparison to others in the area and there is PLENTY of seating- with lots of room. There's nothing that I hate more than having to basically sit on top of someone else while I study. The staff is really nice, attentive and efficient. Even at high volume times, they get the drinks out at a decent speed. It's nothing like the speed of NYC Starbucks locations but for suburbia, it's pretty fantastic. I also love how many windows there are and how open it feels. There's a decent amount of outdoor seating, which I fully intend on taking advantage of now that it has warmed up outside. 

Overall, it's a great environment and it's never too loud if you're looking to study here. Like I do. Almost every day
Ordered a drink via Mobile Ordering last night and the drink was ready when I got there and made perfectly. Service was fantastic!! One of the better Starbucks in the area.

Soooo, this place have gotten even more busy lately than usual. I understand they're in a prime location, but dude, it's a tad ridiculous in here. I rarely go stand in line anymore as the lines are crazy, but it's pretty bad when I now have to put my mobile order in on the train about 2 stops before I get to Suburban then have to walk there and my order still isn't ready.

Staff... still friendly as always and this is why they get the 3 stars and not 1. I'm just not sure how they can get their efficiency up... they tried moving mobile orders to up front, but recently put it back to having to ask for it. It was awesome when I was able to come in and grab my drink and leave without having to wait to grab their attention. 

Anyway, I still come here since it's directly in my building and it's convenient, but I do think they need to figure out a way to handle the extra customers.
I love my coffee but they were really sloooooooow! I miss the old staff they had.......

[558]

Nice Starbucks with cool counter seating in the heart of busy Philly.

We stop in here when we are in the area. 

The staff is nice and the order is done correctly

Terrible service, slow incompetent barista, parking and driving to this location is nearly impossible.  The line for the drive thru backs up so bad, people end up blocking the parking lot and driving on the wrong side of the road.  There isn't nearly enough parking here, most are reserved for other stores.

Unfortunately this location is closest to my home, I try to avoid it if I can.  Terrible.

this Starbuck's is OPEN 24/7 (& on XMAS) lovely spot for late nighters Craving their Starbuck's favorite drink
new decor inside & out
but the night shift staff Nicole & John are FABULOUS HELPFUL & FRIENDLY
A great spot to head when Indy rolls up the sidewalks!

I visited this store on 08/28/18 6:30 am , restroom was dirty , toilet papers was all over the floor, there was no soup to wash hand. The girl gave me dark roast coffee tested like water, I asked her is it dark roast, she moved her head up and down, because she was on the phone texting or searching, she was on the phone texting, when I entered the store also.  This place needs to be shut down or fixed unless Starbucks likes to runes it's name by this few.

How is it possible that a coffee place is bad?
I actually like Starbucks but this one does not stand up to others.  My favorite Starbucks happens to be in a grocery store which is hilarious since they are actually employed by the store.
This location I have hit up at least 10 times and each time the service has been less than adequate.

Too bad because I would gladly keep spending money there.

I drink a lot of coffee! Usually iced coffee even through the winter. The Baristas at this location are extremely pleasant always with smiles and extremely eager to make their customers happy. Starbucks corporate if you ever monitor yelp for constructive criticism, take heed. You should use this store as a corporate model!

Absolutely the worst coffee/cappuccino I've ever had.  Should have taken heed when didn't see cappuccino on the menu. I didn't want the amount of milk of a latte and not a fan of the oily burnt taste of  their regular coffee, so I asked for a cappuccino w/almond milk; (forgot they use sweetend almond milk).  After removing 3"of the sugared flavoured almond milk froth, there remained 1/8 cup of luke warm very sweet, over milked, very weak espresso coffee (if they even used espresso).   Definitely not worth the $4.  Never a fan of Starbucks, but was meeting someone who suggested it.  I'll pay good money for a small roasters specialty coffee, or pay alot less when settling for not so good coffee at WaWa or Duncan Doughnuts.

This Starbucks is the best Starbucks in Reno! I have never seemed to have a problem with parking or customer service here. There is always somewhere to sit here. The wifi ALWAYS works. I go to different Starbucks all the time, depending where I am at in Reno. This is the BEST in Reno.

Not a fan of the recent renovation . It's dimly lit and very sterile IMO. Coffee and service is the usual Starbucks. Wouldn't it be great if they used local vendors for fresh food and appetizing pastries?

Starbucks locations tend to blend together, unless they are blessed with newer renovations, charismatic staff, or Clover (or other fancy coffee programs).  This location is my "grab-a-latte before braving I-69" Starbucks; I think a lot of people have the same perception, as it is always super busy with commuters. Beyond that, there isn't much that differentiates it from other typical locations. The drive-thru can easily back up during prime times, but I've never had my decaf nonfat latte messed up.  The major con for this location is trying to access it when driving to it from any direction but north. I usually have to criss-cross across parking lots to get close.

This little Starbucks is at the baggage claim for red Airside and mainly southwest air. It is fairly new after the airport did renovations and looks super clean and neat. The staff running the counter were super nice and very efficient. My coffee was delivered quickly and just as ordered. What impressed me most was the man at the register... The lady in front of me was just a little short of having enough cash to pay her bill. With a smile, he offered to cover the rest for her and she was so grateful. The experience gave me a smile after a long day of post holiday traveling.

First time going to the new Starbucks! I only went through the drive thru but the girls seem to be super friendly and my drink tastes perfect! It's really nice they opened one at this location. The other one down the street can be a little congested and hard to get in and out of during rush hour. 

Also, read a review about a guy complaining about keycode on restroom door! Need to go check that out! I've never seen that before and it seems like cool idea!

Wow really bad service here. Probably my least favorite Starbucks. Sucks too because it is so close to my home. Idk if the workers just don't enjoy their jobs but you can tell they don't want to be there. Typically I think of Starbucks as a casual place to grab tea and do some work but they make it so uncomfortable I can't even do that here.

I have over the last six months donated now $27 worth of my drinks to Starbucks because I didn't have time for their unadvertised slow food movement which pertains to waiting 30 minutes or longer for a drink. They could blame it on the time of year. They can blame it on a busy drive-through they could blame it on lack of employees. Because they've done each of these things every time I've asked them about it the last time I left a review on their Facebook page January 1 they had nobody in the drive-through and one person in the store 37 minutes later I got my drink two minutes later I realized I waited that long for them to make my drink wrong. Here's the thing I understand and I'm patient and flexible with crappy fast food. But if I'm spending six dollars or more and sometimes triple dad to buy my husband a drink and bring home something for my daughter then it would be nice not to have to dedicate an hour of my time to get it easy drink from Starbucks which is 1.2 miles from my house. You might ask well why do I still go? And I'm asking myself the same thing but I just keep thinking that one day it's not going to be such a miserable waiting experience and they'll eventually figure out how to be quicker and more efficient on the bar .
This small Starbucks has a super friendly and efficient crew. There is a nice coffee bar inside and six tables outside to enjoy the sunshine and chat with the cool local residents. www.starbucks.com

Love Starbucks. If you ask me if I would like an extra shot, yes, I would. If they don't ask, I don't order one. Weird how that works. They need to ask more! Some of us will say yes without hesitation!

Stopped in to Starbucks before we head out to this building for work. No coffee for me today, went with my favorite Green Tea Lemonade for the Win!

When we arrived in the parking lot, apparently we were at the rear entrance, so it's a little confusing set up from the outside. However when you get inside, you witness this amazing setup. Like probably one of the best designed setups that I've been to.

They have this area that looks to have been setup for meetings and getting work done, it's like it's own room. The work benches have electrical outlets and USB ports on them! That is a great setup. My colleagues and I were amazed by this as we hadn't seen any like that one. 
It had a great feel to the place, the barista was nice and my beverage is delicious as usual! Man I love Starbucks!

This Starbucks is closest to me and I go here often-it can be inconsistent with service and quality of drinks. I get something different all the time-but friday I wanted a salted caramel mocha-what I got was a lackluster hot chocolate after 15 minutes. Then I called and they said they would give me a Nother drink for free. So I came back on Sunday for my drink redo, and I ordered the same salted caramel mocha the woman made my salted caramel mocha, however after she finished the drink she told me they were out of salt. Well the drink is supposed to have a balance of saltyand sweet flavors so without the salt it doesn't really taste like a salty caramel mocha I wish they would've told me this before the drink I would have gotten something else but at this point she already made my drink and was kind of rude about it like it was my fault that I used up all their salt. I left feeling guilty for first gettin  a free drink on them but again it wasn't done right. What is a girl supposed to do??? Most of the time I get great service and I always tip when it is good. Just work on training your baristas better on consistency. Take your time with the drinks-it makes a huge difference when you neglect an ingredient or don't steam the milk correctly.

There are a few staff members at this location that are FANTASTIC! They're fast, efficient and friendly. Of course, the drinks and food are great quality as there are at any Starbucks. My main complaint with this location is they are CONSTANTLY out of stock on items that I order. It's happened to me on numerous occasions I'll order 3 different (mostly food items) and they're out of all 3. It would make sense if it were the end of the day, but this has happened to me as early as 7am on numerous occasions. My recommendation would be for whoever is in charge of ordering and inventory at this location pay a little more attention to your top sellers and stock up on them!

A solid example of a Starbucks. You get what you usually do at a Bucks. No surprises.

They keep it clean and kind, and the fireplace in the corner is cozy warm.
Parking is plentiful.

At first glance,  this store doesn't seem as clean as it should be for this time of day.   There were several workers, but only one taking orders at the counter.   I would be willing to give this store another chance.

Ok I know... It's Starbucks. But all chain stores are not built equally. I am not a big Starbucks fan but they have become my regular coffee place the last month since I changed job locations. There are two Starbucks by my job (the Wawa is closed for construction, ugh). I have named them good bucks and bad bucks. This one is the good bucks location. Excellent customer service, and in comparison to other Starbucks a much better turn around time on service. The most I've waited here when very busy is 5 minutes. At the bad bucks ( on 18th and market)  the norm is a 10 minute wait and if it's busy kiss your lunch goodbye lol

I really do like the staff here, and prices while steep for a coffee aren't to bad if you just get a regular coffee, not the fru fru crap that is more like a milkshake. I will still be going back to Wawa when they open. The coffee is simply better and cheaper.

4 stars is because the staff is great... Starbucks as a franchise is more around 3.
This has become my fave Starbucks... the service and quality in the AM is spot on.  No more issues... just rockin' coffee and espresso!
Terrible service. Totally chaotic every time I've been I here. Otherwise, it's a totally normal Starbucks.
The baristas here know what they're doing! Amazing drinks with a cool staff and a wide selection of packaged coffee

It takes a lot for me to get mad about customer service, because I work in it and I understand how hard it is sometimes. But If you're working the cash register, get off your phone and pay attention to the customer trying to place an order. When I walked up he didn't even look up to acknowledge me and instead of placing my order I had to stand there and wait a solid minute while he was texting away. Also complaining about other employees in front of customers- not professional at all. Coffee was good though. But this location needs to work on customer service.

The absolute slowest drive-thru service one can find at any Starbucks. I've spent over ten minutes waiting at the window at least three times now. I would be understanding if they said something like our computer is operating slowly, but instead I'm left sitting and waiting without any heads up as to what would be slowing down the process. 

The store is clean, well kept and a great place to work from if you can work remote. So two stars for that, but three down because of the drive-thru service is so bad that I don't believe Starbucks as a company would be proud of it.

(Note that I'm not saying time in line waiting, but time spent literally just sitting at the window)

This is the filthiest Starbucks I have ever been in. Gross. Gross gross. 

Toilet was a filthy mess with toilet paper everywhere on the floor. The store itself needs a good scrubbing. Trash cans overflowing. Straws, paper and other questionable detritus on the floor. Sticky seats. 

I get that Santa Barbara seems to have a burgeoning homeless challenge. Perhaps that's a contributing factor. I don't know. 

I just know that this is a seriously gross Starbucks. There's a coffee bean and tea leaf across the street and an independent coffee house up the street. Go there instead.
This Starbucks is nice and big! Plenty of table space for working. Their space opens into the bank next door. Menu is what you would expect at any Starbucks.

Great Starbucks. Decent size with some seating. Right in the heart of downtown by Macy's and City Hall. They made a great cinnamon dolce latte, but my favorite thing is that they said my name right when they said my coffee was ready! For someone with a unique name I never wait for my name to be said correctly! I was so excited! Employees were super nice.
Love this new location!  It was a bit slow at first, but after a few weeks it seems that all the kinks are worked out.  Staff is very friendly and keep the drive-thru line at a decent pace.

The staff here are really friendly and the service is pretty quick!

My only complaint is how long the drive though line is in the morning and how hard it is to get in line coming from downtown. You have to wait for a break in traffic AND someone coming east bound to let you into the line.  Not sure how to fix this though.
Very basic 'starbucks'. They have a couple tables but they only sit 2/3 people. They do have a couple big chairs that you can hang in (where im at lol) all the baristas were real nice!

I love almost everything about this Starbucks. The layout and space available is conducive to studying and/or meeting with others. Service and employees are always delightful. There is ample parking. There is really one sole reason for this 2-star review, their wifi connection is always HORRIBLE!!!!! My music stream is constantly cutoff and My I internet connection is lost. Every other time  I conduct an internet search I get an error message that my connection is lost. It is incredibly frustrating and every time I return to this location I hope it's fixed, but I'm batting 100% here - 5/5 times I've come, this has been the experience.

No drive-through at this location, which is the sort of lazy convenience factor that does matter to me when I can't be bothered to make my own coffee in the morning.

The shop looks like a Starbucks, smells like a Starbucks, laid out like a Starbucks. There's outdoor patio seating as well as the wooden tables on the inside. 

There's a PokeStop here, which is why I came in in the first place. Settled in to get some caffeine and check in for goodies at the spinning blue disc. Promptly found some other people doing the same.

Took longer than I expected for a coconut milk latte considering the place wasn't hopping, but the taste was exactly as every one I get at a Starbucks anywhere. The other thing that bugged me was paying with the Starbucks card. I needed to refill the money on the card in order to cover all of the transaction, which is fine, so I told her to reload with my debit card and then pay with the Starbucks card so I get the points. She claimed it couldn't work out that way, which is a total falsehood because I've done the same thing at least three times at other locations. It wasn't enough money to make a big deal so I let her do it the way she knew how, but one of the reasons I have any frequency at Starbucks is earning free drinks.
Staff not friendly in the drive thru, skip this one if you can and go to another one. When you pay $7.75 for a coffee, it's enough to swallow without getting two spoonfuls of attitude.
Never been here before today but they were very nice. Just a little slow and there was no drive thru otherwise they'd have gotten a 5-star for the java chip I redeemed with my points!

I popped into this Starbucks today for a cup of tea on the way to a hair appointment. I was happy with the speed of service, the cashier (who prepared my tea) and the tea itself. The milk and sugar station was clean and well supplied -- I don't know what else you could ask for in a Starbucks. Parking spot? Found one reasonably close to the door. Overall, this Starbucks is in a great location and the service I've received there over several visits has been on point. As with any Starbucks drive thru (available at this location), if you're in a rush, it's better to go in. Once you're in line for drive thru at this store, you're kind of trapped and I've experienced some significant waits at this location. Otherwise, a good Starbucks to hit up for your caffeine fix.
Excellent Starbucks. Large with lots of seating. Convenient and easy parking (unlike Paoli).

Usually all is well here at this store, and I usually frequent it everyday on my way home. Today was different. I stopped in around 6pm and I guess there was training going on where the store cleanliness was neglected, even though there was very little traffic (since the drive thru was closed too). I got my coffee then went for a refill, where i was told that coffee doesn't get refills. This is the first time I've heard this "company policy" since it could "give me a heart attack." The barista really didn't care that everyone else but her has done refills and have me a similar drink without asking if that's what I wanted. It not like I'll never come back, but I'll avoid that barista for sure. So much for the Third Place.

This location is not consistent at all. A few of the baristas are very nice and friendly but I've had more bad experiences here than any other Starbucks. One barista was super rude to my fiancé when he asked to replace one kind of topping for another. She basically looked down her nose at him and said they couldn't replace it unless they charged extra. We're talking about replacing the cranberry sprinkles with the chocolate curls, nothing crazy. And today I went in and asked for extra whipped cream and they didn't even put a normal amount, literally just a tiny dollop. So I asked the barista to add a little more and she glared at me like I had just asked her to remake the whole thing. I don't know what's going on at this one but I would suggest you go to any other one instead.

I stopped at this Starbuck's this morning because I had to have the bacon gruyere egg bites. I just had to. It's very close to Highway 40 so I didn't veer too far out of my way to work. It's shiny and new and the barista was friendly. What more can you ask for? I'll be back.

This Starbucks is my normal spot, and I love it. Warning- the drive thru line can get crazy long, so utilize the mobile order option on the app. The parking also is a mess, but the drinks are always right and the baristas are really friendly and efficient.

Starbucks is as Starbucks does! This store consistently has good drinks and hot food, but consistently SLOW service. Be prepared to wait. If there are more than 3 cars in the drive thru - skip it and pick a different location.

This Starbucks has personality. I went in yesterday and one of the employees was singing and everyone else working was super happy and very engaging with each customer. Last week, I went through the drive thru and after they said they were out of the Oprah Chai, I ordered a regular one. When I got to the window, they told me it was their treat that day. I like free coffee obviously, but more than that I like employees who are happy and take the time to notice ways they can take care of their customers. I've always had great, speedy service and my order has always been correct at this location. Only downside is they keep it FREEZING inside. Bring a jacket. Thanks!

Baristas were friendly and the coffee was well made.  Wi-Fi worked well all day without a hiccup.  The atmosphere is pleasant and a rear entrance makes exit to the parking lot behind the stores easy.  Everyone in town comes here, and it's exterior and interior blend in with the community.
Change the store hours on the map or stay open until 8pm on Saturday night. Or at least don't close at 6:59pm with customers still walking in the door!
I absolutely cannot stand Frys,particularly this location, but the gentlemen that is always there is the ONLY reason I come to this Starbucks. He is always super nice and gets my order right.

The staff here are super friendly. The barista's almost always ask me how I like my milk steamed (wet, dry, etc.) for my cappuccinos and often let me check it before they walk away to see if it needs more or less milk. I love going here for lunch and just relaxing. I usually get either a short or tall cappuccino. They have free wifi, plenty of indoor and outdoor seating, always very clean and friendly.
This one has the best staff that I've seen at a Starbucks. I've been to them all over the country and they are always staffed well. This team is exceptional.

With so many starbucks in this area it is easy to avoid this one. Staff is not necessarily rude, but they definitely aren't nice. I felt like them making me a drink was an inconvenience to them. I'll go down the road to the smaller Starbucks where even when it's super busy, my drink is a priority and my presence is acknowledged in a positive way.

I like Starbucks in general, but this particular location is fantastic.  It is definitely NOT your typical Starbucks.  It was remodeled a few months back and now features a very cool open terrace mezzanine seating level above the bar.  They also have some outdoor seating on State Street.  This location also has one of those Clover brewers and several varieties of high-end coffee available that they custom-brew for you.

This location is across the street from my office and I go there several times each week.  Most of the staff knows my name and they also know my drink depending upon what time of day it is that I come in.  This seems to be the case for alot of other customers besides too.  That's impressive when you consider the volume of business they do here.

The interior is kept clean at all times and due to the unique floor plan, ther eis almost always somewhere to sit as soon as my drink is ready.

There are a few Starbucks location on State Street in downtown Santa Barbara, but I think this location is the best.

Nothing like your local Starbucks , well my Starbucks is definitely better than yours lol, this place is in a good location for those of you that live in Zionsville like I do, this Starbucks is right next to the interstate and have some of the friendliest barista in the business

Left here laughing and irritated. Laughing because I couldn't believe how ridiculous the barista that waited on me was. She was so dramatic and inappropriate. Making comments like "I can't take this anymore" loud enough for us to hear. It wasn't even that busy. 3 of us in line inside and a couple cars at drive thru. I needed to order 3 drinks. Got through the first and started the second and she just walked away while I was talking. Didn't say excuse me or anything. Just walked away. I had to repeat my first drink order 3 times and it wasn't complicated. Basic off the menu item. She was just rude and didn't know how to act properly in front of customers. I was a little embarrassed for her.

Fast and friendly service. Normal Starbucks coffee. Their location is good and they have a huge parking lot right behind them. So they are normally pretty busy. They also have enough table for different groups of people.

Well, I love coffee and I love to have a cup of coffee while I sit back and relax with a book.  I also love to study at my local Starbucks location.  The staff at the Jasper Ave location knows my drink better then I do!  I'm not kidding!  I've recently tried to switch to decaf but sometimes I forget to tell them that but the guy who usually makes my drink asks me if I want it decaf and I thank him for reminding me!  If you like to people watch I think this is the best location to do it.  It's in downtown so the streets are busy and so is the store.  I'm not the only regular that comes in all the time; it's nice to see the friendly faces of these strangers who feel like they know you because they see you all the time.  The staff is also really friendly.  I end up joking with one of the guys while I place my order.  He usually crakes a joke at me as I walk off without receiving my muffin; I forget that I ordered one.  

If you are going to grab some goodies may I suggest the Lemmon Poppy Seed Loaf, the Raspberry Lemmon Loaf, the Buttermilk Blueberry muffin, and because it only comes out at Christmas try a piece of the Bliss Bar.  

The Jasper Ave location can get pretty busy so if you want to sit and study you need to come early in the morning or after the lunch rush.  The place is pretty busy but it's clean, the staff does a great job keeping up with the cleaning and reloading of sleeves, lids and flavored powders.  If you are the type of person whom can't study with too much noise then bring earphones and study to your own music to drown out the sounds of people talking.

They do have Internet and if your Starbucks card is registered then you can use the Internet for free for two hours at a time.  It doesn't cost you anything to register your card (like a gift card) and you get other benefits

This is the first Starbucks ive ever been to, and by far the best!
I love the friendly atmosphere and how quick they have your order ready.
Plus, plenty of places to hangout inside and out.
Love this place. Our Barista's are so friendly and remember us every time we go in? They even remember my usual drink!

Most joyful morning staff I've seen in awhile! Also, while it may be difficult to pull into according to some of the other reviews, it's also located within walking distance to car repair places such as church brothers and greens auto repair, which is why I came here in the first place. Not a bad spot and I would totally come back to say hello to the fantastic baristas.
This is the worst Starbucks in town. The parking lot is horrible, the baristas have attitude, and there's always a long line. Obnoxious all around.

I love Starbucks. It is a wonderful treat every once in a while in the afternoon. But out of all the Starbucks I visit this is the slowest by far. I appreciate it when they make drinks correctly and understand this takes time. But this Starbucks is beyond just making the perfect drink. It seems to be a popular stop so you would think there would be more than one person making drinks and one person running the drive thru. If there were more hands on deck they wouldn't have people pulling out of the drive thru line after placing their orders. Unfortunately it takes just as long if you go in.

Starbucks almost seems like the lamest thing to review. If you want it and you see it you'll probably have it. It's no mom and pop kinda place and you pretty much know what to expect. It was a regular visit for a caffeine fix. Nothing to write home about just good old fashioned corporatism.

Spent all morning here. Was busy when I arrived and somebody was willing to let me sit next to them on the table they weren't using - moving some documents so I could work on some stuff as well. Free WiFi and and I was able to plug my laptop into the outlet on the wall. I have a giftcard on the Starbucks app and was able to get two free refills! Will definitely return. Hopefully there are some places to sit outside in the summer!

While this Starbucks is located in a tight spot, it's location is primo for those headed southbound on Michigan. Makes it very crowded sometimes but the staff is consistently friendly and efficient.  Plenty of regulars spending too much time in the good seats, and there's not much room inside, but still one of my favorites. Brebeuf location on 86th is much larger inside, but this is your only choice if your regular route is down Michigan Rd.  I avoid the drive thru at all costs...

Good: The drinks and food are regular Starbucks quality. Their service in the mornings are usually pleasant and fast.

Bad: This Starbucks is WAY to small and slow for the amount of foot traffic in downtown Franklin especially on weekends. Also, this particular shop routinely blocks the doors and puts chairs on tables during posted open hours.

These guys are like family for me. I've been coming here for a long time. The staff is very friendly.  My favorites Annie, Ronnie, Brett, Abbie, Chrissy and Noah and the boss lady.  I actually think that might be everyone. Lol Oh, there's that little blonde. Anywho I come here often and Annie is my little Sagittarius buddy. We have some things in common and I just love going here because when I'm having a bad day they always seem to cheer me up! Great job everyone! Oh, and thanks for all your hard work!!

Not sure it could be any slower and beyond annoying when a barista friend comes in 10 minutes after we are all there WAITING cuts the wait line and gets drink first from guy working. Peet's YES please!

Update: I officially dislike this store. I went in the drive thru this morning and ordered an exorbitant drink, which I meant to use a free drink reward that I have been saving. Went to the window to pay and notified the cashier before I handed her my card that I have a free earned reward on my Starbucks card, but went to check my balance tonight and found out that she didn't redeem my free drink on the card and charged me the full amount! 
The customer service at this location has been going downhill, the cashiers are downright depressing. Won't be back.

I never thought I would ever give a starbucks one star...but this specific starbucks definitely earned their rating.  I love starbucks, as a student I practically live in starbucks and probably spend most of my life savings at starbucks. So, when I came to this starbucks I assumed it would be the same experience as any other starbucks. However, I was very wrong. This was the worst starbucks that I have ever been too. I was there with a friend doing some homework when we decided it was time for a caffeine break so we made our way to the counter to order.  We both ordered our usual but they overcharged my friend for his drink. He pointed it out to the cashier saying the other starbucks downtown charged him a cheaper price.  And what was their response....? Well, we took a break from our studies to find out we were going to be lectured instead by the starbucks cashier guy, and unlike my professor I really don't believe he is qualified to be lecturing anything to anyone...so he stood their and told us we were being incorrectly charged at the other place, that this whole time we were being undercharged...and while this was happening another employee steps in to yell at us, pointing out that the other starbucks has been wrong this whole time.
We were simply pointing out the discrepancy in the price difference...but what we also pointed out was how differently this particular starbucks treated their customers versus every other starbucks that I have ever been to.  You would think that they would just apologize and say that each starbucks does things a little differently, but instead they decided to yell at the customers that were just the messengers.  If they had a problem with the different pricing, maybe they should discuss that with the downtown starbucks and not the customers that are just trying to purchase their product, because we have no power on the pricing of anything. 
So after withstanding the yelling and chastising we finally get our drinks and you would think with all the work it took to order those drinks they would be magically delicious BUT they made them wrong of course. I don't know if they did it on purpose because we made a deal about the pricing, but whatever the reason it was disappointing to know that a starbucks like this exists...I can stand the bad customer service ( maybe they just had a bad day or hate their lives), but to not make the drinks correctly is just embarrassing. They do not deserve to be called baristas, they are just bullies with very bad coffee making skills.

There isn't a lot new to say about Starbucks. I happen to really like Starbucks and this particular store does a great job. I haven't run into any problems with drink or service quality and the store itself, given that it's on the newer side, is really beautifully decorated. There consistently seems to be a lot of people hanging out there working and passing the time and it has lot of little nooks to accommodate everyone. Also, since they're in a shopping center, tons of parking! Hooray!!

Wow.. nice new starbucks.. HELLA SLOW SERVICE.  

Friendly but took almost 15mins for my praline chai latte.  

Forgot my drip coffee

Waited again because half n half 5mins

1 star for slowness

+1 star cause they noted i was pretty ticked.. explained had a lot of new ppl , but thats a management issue not a customer .. gave a $4 gc but not sure that equates to a long wait and slow service

Update: chai praline tea latte was hella water down

If you dont mind the wait its a nice new starbucks!

Nothing wrong at all with this place when I visited it!  My daughters and I stopped in for a little treat after spending the day at museums. 

Service was very quick. Staff was friendly. 

I was worried that we would have to go INTO the Constitution Center to get to the Starbucks (like... I thought it was just part of their gift store or something) but it's completely separate from the rest of the building.

Went through the drive-thru at 6:00am on a Saturday. Ordered decaf Americano grande with half & half and a stevia.  Got back to the laundromat and took a sip...no half & half. What? I called and of course if I drove all the way back there they'd make a new one. I wanted the right order the first time. A piece of advice to the youngsters working there...talked to each other less and don't worry about what music you have playing. People pay for your ability to get their order right.

I love Starbuck ,we usually got coffee plates it so good..
We are relaxing to stay in the Morning .
Love the drinks & pantries..worth every penny!

This is, without a doubt, my favorite Starbucks. It's brand new and is so nice. The interior is beautiful. They have high top tables with outlets attached. You can sit or stand while working! They also have tables against the wall that you can sit at. They also have bigger comfy chairs in the corners by the windows! This Starbucks is pretty big and has so many places to sit. 

The staff here is also really nice. They area always so friendly and make our drinks really quickly.

I think that this Starbucks is great for all kinds of people. A great place for people who want to do work or study and great for people who are meeting up with friends!

This has quickly become my favorite place to study and do homework. I highly suggest checking it out!
This is a solid Starbucks, they are slow compared to other Starbucks, especially any of the busy ones in NYC or Philly, but always friendly.

Not only are the beverages and food exceptional, but the baristas make this place. Always patient, friendly, remembering your drink orders. They make a bright spot in every day I visit.

It is a bit crowded at this store in Newtown Borough. Would love to see them expand -- maybe upstairs with some outside seating!

My wife and I have been away out of the country for work and have missed our usual quiet place to enjoy our favorite drinks. 

Whether you are stopping by or been sitting in the comfy leather chairs for years, this is a great place with an amazing staff.

This location is inside the Kroger located by the floral department. I love drinking my Chai Tea while grocery shopping. The staff is always friendly and quick. The seating is on the minimal side but more than enough space for grabbing a coffee and sandwich. If you're looking for working space I'd go to the new location on Crawfordsville Rd by I-465. So happy we now have a Starbucks inside Kroger.

My go to Starbucks place near me. Drive thur does take a little longer but that is because they make ever drink custom. If I wait too long they sometimes give me a free drink! I also order online to avoid the wait!

I walked in and purchased a drink after a pretty rough morning... I wanted some time to cool down and gather my thoughts. There were about 8 people behind me who also ordered their drinks. I stood there... all 8 people received their drink, except for me. I looked at the back counter and there was my half made drink just sitting there. I proceeded to let the barista know. She grabbed the drink without a word and put it in 'line' to be finished alongside other remaining drinks that were being made. I waited another few minutes for ice to be added to the cup, along with a lid. No apology... Nice.
Really enjoy this location. It's drive thru line seems to be wrapped around in the mornings when I go by but it is pretty quick. In and out usually in less than 5 minutes. Worth the time...

This one was mo' nicer than the one (at 1235 State) that I reviewed earlier, the one that twice dispensed ice coffee that tasted like crap.  Really friendly barista at the counter at this one.  And service was fast, the bottled water cold, the breakfast muffins piping hot -- and the ice coffee just as I wanted it.  Go here instead.  Three stars -- and for me, with my general bias against Starbuckses, that's pretty dang good.

I like this location because it is really convenient location to meet for business with Carmel, Zionsville, and Westfield people.  The parking situation can be a bit tough with the other businesses that share the parking lot.  There is plenty of seating as this is one of the larger Starbucks that I have been too.  Since I spend so much time in coffee shops, I will admit that I am hyper critical of Starbucks and unless they wow me, they get average marks.  This would be another one that met expectations and with that I am pleased.

Having an office above this Starbucks has been good and bad. Good in the sense that I get to enjoy it every day if I like. All of the employees know me by name and the service is great. Since it is in downtown Franklin, it CAN get a bit busy, but that's normal. On the bad side... I've spent a lot of money here... And while I DO love coffee and their bakery items... It gets expensive very quickly. So... Unfortunately, for the sake of my wallet, I've had to cut back. But if money wasn't an issue, I'd be going there all the time.

Great location, closest to where I live. I go there around 5 times a week, and it's really upset that they always make drinks very watery. I usually order cold brew and they would water it down way too much. And today I decided to order something different, which is caramel macchiato. 
But I'd rather call this a "dirty milk" instead.

Quick friendly service ! 

The staff always has a friendly smile on and delivers quick service! 

This location is always neat and clean and never too busy :) 

Location is right next to Jimmy John's and near Costco, Century Cinema, etc.

Love this place, it's close to my house, and the staff here are energetic and amazing! I've been coming here as a regular now after my morning class to knock out 3-4 hours of homework! Can't complain since you get free wi-fi too! The customers are pretty friendly as well, I'll greet them and they greet back without a weird look! I can even leave my table to use the restroom or go out side to talk on the phone with my stuff all on the table and feel safe about everytime. So far no one has tried stealing or messing with my stuff so I'm happy for that! The coffee here taste great and haven't had a bad order yet. You can catch me here every Tuesdays and Thursdays for this Spring Semester!
Same great service. The re-model is excellent! Still one of my favorite Starbucks in the country.

Love, absolutely love meeting at this starbucks! I will say however, that the service is very mediocre. They just make your drink and keep it moving. I am the type who likes to be sold or engage with others.

Went there for a quick seasonal drink. The store was filthy including the working area where Andre was making the drinks. He was even placing drinks in milk that was spilled all over the work station. Andre was giving incorrect orders to customers. We saw orders sitting on the counter for the 15 minutes we were standing waiting for our order. Andre seemed liked he was being bothered by the rush of customers and was not even announcing names for people to know when their order was ready.
Ordered the White Chocolately Bliss and it tasted like it was just warm milk, absolutely no flavor.
Very disappointed.

Just like any other Starbucks. It's a light or two away from the Interstate, not yet into downtown Greenwood.  Plenty of parking but not enough seating.  Place was packed when we went.  Bathroom was kept clean.  Drink was made perfect.
So much better inside than the old location.  Staff is always friendly, and drive thru is the fastest I've ever been to

I'd like to Thank my Starbucks family for making me feel appreciated! @Ronnell, Humpty Maci, Miss Abby, Megan, and Cat and the rest of them you all have been great! My coffee is always on point. Thank you for your dedication and Hard work you guys are Awesome!!!!!
Nice group of workers, however may need to hire a few more lines always out the door!!! Always a wait..
Very convenient location. The staff is generally friendly. I like this location mostly because it is convenient and not because of the customer service. I will come back.

I really enjoy this Starbucks location. Good amount of seating inside with typical coffeehouse music and a few tables outside for good weather. Service is always friendly and coffee is consistent. Can get a little crowded during expected peak morning / evening hours.

I frequent many Starbucks locations in Indianapolis/Fishers/Carmel area and I'd have to say that I get the best customer service from this location pretty consistently. I always order my drinks via the Starbucks app because I'm on the go at all times, which leaves little opportunity for interaction with the baristas. However, I came into the store last week while waiting for my order to be prepared and the barista promptly greeted me as I walked through the door and asked what I was waiting for when I stopped at the mobile pick up area. I told him my name and after reading my drink specifications on the sticker he asked if my preference of soy milk was an allergy or preference. I've never been asked that before, and I rotate through the same few drinks at Starbucks, so it took me a second to think through why he might be asking. I told him it was more of a sensitivity to milk than an allergy and he must have sensed I was confused by where he was going with the question so he explained the sprinkles that usually go on top of my drink contain milk and so he wanted to know if they should be left off. Again, this is the first time I'd heard of this being a consideration for my favorite drink choice and I was really thankful for the tip and opted to leave them off. This is customer service at its finest and all done with a smile. Highly recommend this location!

This location is extremely hard working and accommodating. They had great customer service and wanted to make sure I was happy. I went on Veterans Day and was served a free drink and also bought a bunch of other treats. It was a really kind and friendly environment which is not my usual "normal" experience with Starbucks, so I can't help but rate them a 5. Yay for good people :)

This has always been our favorite Nashville Starbucks, but this is the second time I have been in recently and had an extended wait. They don't have enough people working. Staff working are doing their best but there is too much customer volume in this location for only 2 people.   My order was placed for a Mocha and a hot chocolate at 4:35. Drinks ready at 4:53. One questions if the desire for profit has exceeded the desire for a positive customer experience.
Slowest service on the planet. Only 3 people on the line and had to wait over 10 minutes. I left the place without any coffee and nobody even cared. Incompetent employees. Worst experience ever.

I walked into this Starbucks location with only 1 person ahead of me.  I ordered an Iced Coffee and sandwich.  With only very few people waiting, I received my coffee in 5 min but after 15 min, never received my sandwich.  After asking about how much longer for my sandwich, she said "soon".  I was about to be late for work so I asked for a refund.  I was told they are "trying something new" and I have to say, It isn't working!!!! I think they are catering to Mobile orders!!  Service is extremely slow and for this reason, I won't be back.

This a great little Starbucks. The baristas are friendly and, even though it was my first time at this location, they greeted me like I was a regular. I dig that. I had my order in hand very quickly and my drink was made to perfection. 

The only reason I docked a star was for the noise level. It seems like this is a more family-oriented location, which is awesome, but the compromise is a lack of that Starbucks chill ambiance that I've come to know and love. 

Other than that, this is still a nice place to take a break. As we speak, I'm sitting here in one of their leather chairs sipping on my nonfat Caramel Macchiato. Seating here is abundant and comfortable, with couches and chairs inside and plenty of tables outside. 

I'm not in this area often, but whenever I am again I'll be stopping in for a drink.

Great staff! They are always very friendly and welcoming when I go. There is a nice lounge area on the 2nd floor. The parking lot can get pretty crazy at times, but that's nothing against Starbucks. Service is usually pretty quick and I've never had any issues.

Rude workers who doesn't care about your drinks. I asked for a Frappuccino and wanted to ask about how many pumps of caramel syrup and I asked for 4 and when he was talking to the barista he just told her to do whatever. And when I got my drink, they forgot the whipped cream and when I told her she just messily put some on spilling the whole drink on my cup which is now sticky. Also they didn't give me friend the right change. My other friend also received the wrong order and she asked them to remake it and they gave her a grande when she ordered a venti.

This Starbucks is my regular haunt almost daily. It is a great place to start the day. The staff of baristas is great! They all greet me by name...they all all know exactly what i get and have made before I can get through the checkout line. This location always busy....always clean and always a joy to visit.
Ordered a peppermint mocha and it was awful, it tasted like straight up chocolate water with too much mint....

I've been coming to this location almost everyday for the past two years.  I really miss the old crew, It's just not the same.  It used to be one nice cooperative happy team.  No more smiles, no more heys, it's just simply order, grab, and go, which is fine too but only if my drinks are prepped the right way. I want my coffees fresh not burnt.  My iced teas should be shaken all the time not only upon request, right? my drinks should be served in clean cups, not all sticky and overflowing right? No syrup means No I do not want my drink sweetened! No whip means please save your time and whip. No cheese means, please do not add in the damn cheese! What the heck! No customer service is fine but please read the orders and prep them the right way! If you can't follow simple instructions, why bother work here?

That Blair girl was the bestest Barista ever, like in the HISTORY of Baristas. Pretty sure she's a super hero. Just sayin; I've never seen her and Wonder Woman in the same place at the same time, just sayin... 

Don't listen to "one star" Sherry. She probably punches kittens in the face.

Cool building that this is in - refurbished farm-house style.  But that's where the good news ends, I'm afraid.  

Staff looked at me like I was a unicorn - I'm not that odd of a guy, I promise.  They just weren't all that friendly.

Parking lot is a bear to get out of during morning rush - good luck turning left out of it.

Hands down the best Starbucks in town!

I have been coming to this Starbucks for over four years now and will purposely drive across town just to get my drinks from this store. Not every Starbucks was made equally but this one sure does break the mold! From the actual people working here, to their skills and ability of the drinks they craft - you will not be let down! 

Tell them Schieler sent you (skyler) just because! :)

I don't know what the hell happened since the move to this location 2 months ago, but the staff that was reasonably friendly and efficient at the old location has apparently been replaced by a staff that's inattentive, surly & completely incompetent (Yes, they're mostly the same people, it seems, just very different attitude). Yapping/yelling/carrying on with one another about personal life stuff while ignoring people in line waiting to place their orders. Snapping at customers (including myself) for no discernable reason, sometimes just for asking for things like creamer. And I've personally seen them mocking someone waiting for their drive-thru order. Totally unprofessional. Plus, the place is brand-new and already looks like a dump -- the 4-5 times I've been in here, at varying times of they day, there has always been trash all over the floors/tables and overflowing trash cans, and none of the employees seem to care. I'll never go back to this location again, and I hope a Starbucks regional management person reads this and looks into this for themselves to rectify it. Don't just take my word for it. This is a REALLY bad look for a new location.

This is by far the best Starbucks around town, I love it! I pass so many other Starbucks just to get to this one. It's like they're all trained well. To treat customers right! I will continue to make this my Starbucks! Keep up the great work management!
Really slow. Workers standing around. More efficiency especially for airport . Was hoping to get quick coffee before flight. 20 min later

Every time that I have been to this Starbucks in Albertsons, I have experienced an unusually long wait time. The service is slow- especially for an overpriced cup of coffee. It only gets two stars for the connivence of being inside the store. If you're looking to get a cup of coffee don't go out of your way to make a pitstop in the store. Go to another Starbucks or coffee shop all together

This is one of the better and more consistent Starbucks around town. The main issue here is the lack of parking. If you cannot find a spot, I suggest being brave and parking in the lot to the North on the South edge near Starbucks. The inside tends to run on the chilly side, so you might bring a jacket or coat with you. I like to work here because there is a long bench of bar stool type high seats along the windows that have power outlets under them. Facing the windows while working can help avoid distractions and conversations going on. There are also a few tables great for groups. Be wary that the drive thru is often wrapped around the building in the mornings.

Every single time I've been to this Starbucks, I've had an amazing experience. The staff aren't just nice, they seek to make my day. And they do it every single time. They have to have amazing leadership to pull this off every time. It's the way customer service used to be.

This is my favorite location! The manager, Emily, is clearly running the store as though she owns it. Her employees represent how she hires. They are all fabulous. They all treat me with kindness every time they see me. Some of them have my drink started as they see me walk in.  To name a few, Terri, kyana, Ashely, mike, Joan, and a few others that I know well by face, but not sure of their names. They are all wonderful. I'm super impressed with how well the store is run, but also how they all clearly work so well together that it reflects in the overall happy, warm feeling you get when you go in.
Starbucks is Starbucks. Decent coffee. This one is no exception. They tend to have a really long drive through line in the mornings so I go inside. No line there!

Hands down best crew here!!!!  Miss Abbey you were the first one to remember me. thank you and congratulations on your new location and I'll miss your face!  Ronnel, Megan, Sara and Issac.Thank you for your hard work, your smiles even when you've had a bad day. You guys have been like my little family! Without you guys I'd be lost. My coffee has always been on point except one time but, she was a newbie cough..cough Sarah! Lol then the next time I seen her she mastered my drink. So, with all that the entire crew is pleasant, fun and great atmosphere!

Such a great start to my day! I opt for the mobile order ahead at this location on my way to work. Between my drink and the lovely people, I am NEVER disappointed. I can get the drink at any location, but I haven't received the same smiles or "have a great day!" elsewhere.

Enjoying a flat white with friends on this cold January evening.  Love this location. A nice mixture of high school and college kids plus plenty of us more mature crowd.  The baristas are always friendly and always happy to recommend a new item. Parking is very convenient with street  parking and lot parking.
This location is clean and staffed with friendly people. I had the egg white and red pepper breakfast offering. It was perfectly cooked and a healthy snack to get my day started.

Consistently slow mediocre service. Drive thru is even worse. Just avoid this one! Drinks are usually wrong or weak. Not sure what's going on here as it's been bad from opening till now. Starbucks get it together cause this is a stellar location!!
Recently opened! This place is new and has plenty of windows for sipping your coffee and wandering off. Staff looked a little busy when I arrived but thats just the new normal with mobile orders

Yes, I'm actually reviewing a Starbucks. If you drink coffee, you likely know already whether you like the taste of their coffee or not, and the coffee here is no different than any other Starbucks. The staff, however, is OUTSTANDING! I'm here way too much, so much so that I know there are a lot of other "regulars" who are here way too much as well! The staff know me and my usual coffee buddies and if any of us come in solo, they'll ask about the others. They'll also ask me about my kids, even down to knowing what my kids wore for Halloween! Needless to say, they remember everyone's regular coffee order as well. When staff members have moved on, I have seriously missed seeing them in the morning.
The missing star is only by fault of the Starbucks Corporation - lousy planning with the parking. If you come in the morning during a rush, you may be stymied trying to find a spot and the bank next door is very clear about not wanting you to park in their spaces.

Despite posted hours of being open until midnight, this location is now closing at 10pm. The only reason I come here is to have a place with minimal distraction that will allow me to work. Being unexpectedly told to pack up and move out is unacceptable. I won't be back to this location unless the hours return to midnight close time.

It was so hard to park here.  This Starbucks is fairly busy (especially on Sunday).  Since the parking lot is on the corner of an intersection maneuvering around is a real pain.

Besides that though this is a good Starbucks.  Service is pretty quick and the building looks great.  As long as you have the patience to find parking feel free to utilize this Starbucks.
Had to give it the lowest rating possible. It says it's open but no one's home :/ literally the only coffee shop that opens early but maybe the posted hours are inaccurate ‍

This is my home-base Starbucks and it's because it's friggin awesome. They have a large sitting area with its own 'private' community room near the back so if you use Starbucks as a glorified study lounge (like me), you'll always find a place to sit. Also, there are a ton of power plugs so it's great to plug a computer in and work.

They also have the Starbucks Clover machine there which lets you get really great coffee instead of typical drip coffee. I personally am a bigger tea person so I don't try the Clover machine a lot, but I know a lot of people who rave about it.

Most of all, I find the employees at this Starbucks to be super nice. They're all really friendly and they do really care about making sure your drink is just right. And when you're paying a premium price for a drink, service is a big deal.

Between the location, baristas, and just Starbucks in general -- the Sicklerville location gets five stars from me.

This location on this particular occasion was not a pleasant experience; it was noisy and chaotic, mostly due to the staff. They were throwing things back and forth over the counter to each other, and being very noisy yelling to each other and making weird noises (maybe singing?). I know they are teenagers, but I couldn't relax there with my coffee.
Going down hill. HUGE Line again in drive through bc the new kid is in the window. Why aren't the employees and managers realizing this!!! U guys ROCKED but NOW... sad

I used to come to this location almost daily, but Mobile Orders are killing this place. I walked in this morning at 10:10 am. 5 people in front of me in line. As I was paying for my coffee and bagel, they got in 10-15 mobile orders all at once.  Got my toasted bagel and had to wait until 10:38am for my drink. Meanwhile, at least dozen  or more mobile orders went ahead of me.  I did retail years ago and was always told the most valuable customer is the one in front of you, so as I sat there with a now cold bagel, I asked myself- do I feel like a valued customer? Does the line of now approximately 40 people waiting to place an order represent good customer service? The answer was no.  I will just go to my local Mom and Pop coffee shop from now on.

Wow I did not realize there would be a difference in the different Starbucks locations across the city! I would say the Starbucks here have the friendliest baristas and they know how to properly make the drinks. I did ask for soy once and they accidentally made my venti latte with milk. I had already went back to work and finished 1/4 of my drink by the time I realized this. I went back 30 minutes later to get a replacement since I would die if I had drank all that milk.  They were happy to replace it no questions asked.

I've also ordered multiple frappucinos from here and my favorite is the java chip. They load it with a lot of chips and it tastes great. I did not realize how much I liked it until I tried to get it at two over Starbucks locations around center city and they weren't as good.

I took off one star for this location though because by the time you show up mid afternoon around 3pm, they run out of ingredients to make the speciality drinks ( caramel or vanilla syrup or fruit purée for smoothies). Stock up some more!

Best Starbucks I have ever been to! (& I've been to many of them in all different states). I frequent this location at least 4-5 times a week, as soon as I pull up to the drive-thru I'm usually greeted by my first name followed by "are you having your usual today?" They truly go above and beyond! Robin is the sweetest person and always so friendly! I truly feel like family every morning when I stop for coffee. What a way to get my day started!!

The couple times I've visited this Starbucks location, I have received phenomenal service. All the baristas I have encountered here are very friendly. Drinks are made quickly and to standard.  Store is clean, welcoming, and nicely decorated. Lots of seating. 

As a former barista myself, I know what is expected, and appreciate when they deliver that.

No complaints!

I just recently went to the new starbucks that opened near McCaffreys and I went through the drive thru. I ordered a drink and a panini and as soon as I got to the window, my drink was ready and my panini was out only a few seconds after that. The panini was cooked perfectly and wasn't cold. I hope they can keep up the fast pace unlike the other starbucks in town where you wait 10 minutes to get a grande drink. 

update: at the drive thru i asked if they had any bacon and goudas. they said that they ran out to witch i said oh no what am i going to do because i was sad they didnt have any left and told the man its ok have a nice day. I continued driving and a man popped his head out the window and said "i heard screaming" and i said no i was just sad there were no bacon and goudas left and the guy said "yea thats not out fault" like hello i know its not your fault sir. he didnt smile or laugh and just gave off a bad vibe.
Everytime I try to come here there is no parking so I just keep driving to get my coffee somewhere else.  I wish they would relocate to somewhere else nearby with more parking.

The bad reviews are correct.
Worst Starbucks Ive ever been to. If you can avoid this one and go to the one inside Target next door, you should. The drinks are wrong or gross 4 out if 5 times here. So, make sure you taste it before leaving. It's a reoccurring issue at this location. Also, drink orders take forever sometimes.
Staff is detached and sometimes unfriendly

I've always been a lover of Starbucks, however this visit has changed my  mind. My first few second of talking to the drive thru worker named Dan were awful. I kindly asked him if we could pay separately for the two drinks and he refused. After I asked why, he said I should've asked earlier before coming to the window with a rude/sassy tone. He then proceeded to charge me wrong for the drink even though I said I wanted to use my free reward. (I still haven't got my Starbucks money back by the way even though he used my free reward). While he was grabbing my drinks, he was acting annoyed while talking to his fellow co workers. On top of that, my order was made wrong and the coffee was cold by the time we received it. I will never be returning to this Starbucks location again thanks to the horrible customer service I received.

Worst burnt tasting coffee I ever had in my life. Expensive is an understatement. I'm told you have to get one of the flavored coffees or some fancy drink and you'll like it. If you can't just get the base coffee right they shouldn't be selling it. Anyone can dump a bucket of sugar in something to make it taste like desert.

This Starbucks is located between Terminal A and Terminal B.

Stopped by on my way to Terminal A for a 6am flight. This location opens super early (around 4:15am). Quick service and polite staff. They had 2 cashiers and 2 baristas. You gotta appreciate that! This was a great stop before heading to the A gates because there were no great food options in that terminal.
Tonight a sweet barista made me a drink even though they were closing and she had already counted her drawer. It made my day. Thank you for your kindness- I needed caffeine!

This is my spot! I find myself at this Starbucks location many times a day! Coffee is one of my biggest passions and I love the environment this location offers. 

This coffee shop is located in the heart of downtown Franklin. Right of the corner were you can sit and people watch all day long... Its very relaxing I must say. I am all about hanging out with my iced coffee, and friends on the corner watching life happen all around us. 

Wonderful Starbucks! Wonderful people! Its all good!
I love Starbucks!!! Grande soy mocha frapachino!!!

Starbucks is Starbucks, I know...but...this one is a great place to sit and study (without electronics). The baristas are friendly, they don't rush when making the drinks, or multitask/get interrupted and burn the espresso shots, and it seems to be quieter than other Starbucks I've visited. 

The only downside: a lack of power outlets, and the orientation of some of the tables makes the sun shine directly in your face during the hours of 2-4pm. There is a power strip along the long table, but the other 4-top/2-top tables in the middle of the space require you have a cord that transects major walkways of the store, and I'm always reluctant to do it because I don't want anyone to trip. 

On a more positive note - They also have GENDER NEUTRAL bathrooms! (Thumbs up, Starbucks!) Also, plenty of outdoor seating that is recessed back enough from the curb that you don't have cars in your face while you enjoy your latte/catch up with an old friend. :)

Their drinks are always great! The line for the drive-thru is just usually pretty long. I've never had a bad experience. The staff is always kind and goes above and beyond for their friendliness. This tends to be my go-to Starbucks in town based on their staff and quality of drinks.

This location is consistently the dirtiest Starbucks I visit. I've also never waited less than 15 minutes for my coffee. I know they are busy but they need to make customers inside the store as much of a priority as the drive-through. If you visit this location don't bother mobile ordering or going inside, stick to the drive-through.
Sweet girl great service in the drive through this afternoon, thanks for making my day!

This location will periodically get new people and they quickly jump into the culture of the store. I attribute this to the store manager as she is very consistent and the team she has had for awhile seem to be happy. When a store feels positive, it creates an experience that makes their loyal patrons drive a little further if they have to. This is a fantastic store and the team is second to none

The line was a little long but other than that this Starbucks was friendly and made my caramel macchiato perfectly! They have everything a flagship Starbucks dies including hit breakfast sandwiches and yummy pastries.

I would love to review the actual service and product at this Starbucks. Unfortunately, they have the worst hours for a coffee shop I've ever experienced. I was staying in Indy for 4 days (Sat-Tues) and everyday I wanted to stop by after dinner or something and it was closed. I'm unfamiliar with the idea of a coffee shop closing at 8:00, it makes no sense to me. It's absolutely ridiculous. Especially one inside a hotel, where guests and businessmen alike are akin to a coffee at night. 

The funny thing is, even on Tuesday, when I was getting ready to leave Indy I thought "well, finally, it's only 11am, they've gotta be open". Only to find a sign on the door telling me they were closed because they were testing generators or something. Starbucks in a hotel isn't there for their great coffee or some hidden secret. They're there for convenience, and this is about the most inconvenient Starbucks on earth.

This Starbucks is nice, new (2017). Spacious, lots of chairs and fast friendly service. Cold!!!!  Which is nice. 

However, the wifi is spotty, slow. I kept getting booted out. Also the hi tops and two chair table tops are small. If you are with a friend you will need a four chair table if you both have laptops. 

Also the community long table is right in the front by the entrance. This is a weird spot right between people coming and paying. It kinda forms the line separator for paying. No one uses it. They should move it to the back. 

Over all nice place by if you need to do some work probably not the best one to come to.

Your usual friendly Starbucks.

There is a ton of free parking around.  I love how it is across the street from the library.  i can grab books and walk across. 

Service here is really fast and friendly.  They have coffee tasting on Tuesdays.  I like how they make this feel like a neighborhood coffee shop.

There are two tables in the corner that is relatively hidden.  I like sitting there and looking out the window.  There are also comfortable chairs by the restrooms.  It's a great place to sit and read.

Good service, but for some reason the past two times I've been there my drinks have been kind of "meh."  My husband's coffee was also filled to dangerous levels, which facilitated the making of a huge mess as coffee leaked from the cup.  With that said, the store is modern, clean and new and it's in a great location.

This Starbucks has lots of bad reviews on Yelp, but they're either outdated or simply not true. It's great...everything you should expect from a Starbucks. 

I went on a Monday morning at 8:30 am to work here for a while. The service was quick, the staff was friendly, and there were plenty of places to sit. My only complaint is that the music was blasting, but isn't that a problem when you're looking for a study spot at any coffee shop?

Don't believe the un-hype. This Starbucks is just fine.
i'm not a big fan but here and there i will go. sunday mornigns with a few gym bros. and the few times i do go i do enjoy it. coffee is coffee but seasons blends are the shit.
Drinks are fine, but the service is inefficient, and quite slow. If you are a commuter, consider passing this location on the way to work. It is a ten min it stop for anything that isn't drip coffee.

They still have no lids for their cold commuter cups. The barista rang up two of them last week before she told me they had no lids.


I guess everybody's entitled to an off day. Ordered two caramel frappachinos and wanted to buy two of the new reusable cold drink cups that Starbucks is now selling. The sign says three dollars each including a straw. When she rang me up for eight dollars and some odd cents I questioned it and she advised me the straws were a dollar apiece additional. I pointed her in the direction of the display where it said three dollars for cup and straw, and additional straws for a dollar. She apologized, but didn't leave it at that, she went on to explain it was the first one that she had rung up and she didn't quite know what the price was. As an employee it seems it's her job to know what the latest and greatest promotions and pricing are. Simple apology would've gone a lot further than trying to explain away her ignorance of her product line. Frappechinwere fabulous



Great location, friendly baristas, always receive correct order. Parking can be a challenge because the lot is small and usually full. Drive thru is my favorite way to go. Convenient, efficient, and if you order ahead you can zip through the drive thru as well. A win-win!

This location is OK. It has a drive thru which is nice but parking is extremely limited and it is no longer 24 hours.

This would have been a 5 star location in its 24 hour heyday but I myself have almost forgotten that it is there since it seems like it is closed all the time now.

I love going to this Starbucks to study! It has such a comfy vibe here that makes me feel like I am at home.

On top of that, my Barista Mickey was awesome! He answered all the questions I had and seems to always be in a positive attitude! This guy makes the location amazing!
