Aside from the atmosphere the coffees great and it's nice always seeing local law enforcement in there to get some coffee. Maybe the only downside is the limited parking, but that makes it more exclusive!!

By the amount of positive reviews, I mush have stopped by on an off day. It's in a great space, very comfortable, but it's a mess. There are only three customers sitting, but the tables and counters are dirty, trash is overflowing, the first bathroom I walked into was out of tp, and both floors looked like people couldn't aim.

C'mon Starbucks, I've been to shops that were SRO and were immaculate.

I'm back to update my review because service has, surprisingly, improved. I don't know if it's because of the new faces on board or the supposed change in general manager, but it has gotten better. My drinks have been better prepared-- tasting fresh and flavored as they should be. I haven't received a drink without a straw recently, which the "old" general manager said was "unacceptable" when it happened, but didn't do much to change it. There was an older woman who worked at this location who was always so bitter and she seems to no longer be there, which is nice. 
I can now, in good conscious, recommend this location to people who want a Starbucks drink worth the price tag. ;)

How nice to see our favorite barista at this location now. Treighton is awesome!

Older post - Clean and modern. Staff is very friendly. Thought we'd try this new location. Parking is not great!

I had never visited this Starbucks before because it looked difficult to pull in and out of, as it is tucked away in a little mall with only one very narrow visible entrance/exit.  I was cold, wet and dying for a pumpkin spice latte for myself and my wife, so thought I'd try it.  First and last time I make that mistake.  I was the third car in line at the drive thru.  I don't really understand how they have it set up, and there were no visible cues to explain.  It looks like there is a speaker to order, but not sure where you pick up your stuff.  The car at the order speaker sat without moving for 10 minutes, and no one came out to take other orders or otherwise manage the ever-increasing line, so I decided to pull around and go inside.  Next problem...no parking.  There are very few spots that are not handicapped or reserved for other stores, and they were all full.  So I gave up and drove to the only exit, but the drive thru cars were pulled all the way out now across the exit.  I eventually got out, but vowed never to try this turkey of a Starbucks again.  My first ever negative experience with a Starbucks, so it really stands out.

Pros: new starbucks location, new chairs and tables, and now with drive thru!
Ughs: Longgg wait times, single worker making drinks, slowest Wifi ever (tested), flys flying around.

So this is the new starbucks that moved across the parking lot. It went from a corner unit with one restroom and moved into a duplex with two restrooms. you would think the upgrade would help, but I feel like its still the same old environment in the store, in terms of speed.

I order simple drinks like a shaken sweet tea or a coffee. Usually at other SB stores since its so fast it can be done immediately. But here, nooo, they put you in a queue with the rest of the cups and that queue apparently takes second priority to drive thru customers. So even when there is less than a handful of customers that ordered, my drink will take 10 minutes. To dispense coffee. or shake some pre-mixed tea. what. the. hell. 

Also, did they move the flies over from the old location? There are fruit flies that used to buzz around the tables, indicative of not keeping the environment sanitary. I figured with the new store it would not be a further issue. But now the flies are back. I killed two. I'm sure more will be back.

Finally, what is the deal with the Wifi. I thought this was google starbucks wifi. Or whatever that means. Before the speed was decent that I could watch at least a youtube video. But lately that has stutterred and buffered to a crawl. So I did a speedtest.net at the location, and lo behold, the downspeed bandwidth turned out to be 0.76Mbps. WTH? I'm yelping right now from the starbucks down the street and the download speed here is 8.06Mbps here. 

So, yeah, I think I'd rather go to this starbucks that I'm at right now, or drive real far to palm harbor. because this trinity one is blech.

I go to the Starbucks on Easton Road in Warrington at least three to four times a week. Every time I ask what is on tap it is always "Pike" .If you want anything else it is a " Pour Over". The pour over is how the Hobo's make there coffee on the Train Tracks. You pour water over the Ground into a cup and that is your cup of Coffee. It is a constant thing there . Why do they try to sell all different flavored bag coffee but don't have it on tap to try. It doesn't make any sense to me. Then they change the Seating arrangement there by putting Rock hard Chairs to Sit on and Low tables so that after your finish the coffee , and get up ,your back hurts from bending over. It starting to look Dirty in there too. This place needs a Make Over.

Every time that I come here I have a very good experience. I'm greeted, and the coffee tastes good. They have also never ran out of anything when I have asked for it, which has happened to me a lot in other states recently.

Had my first iced cinnamon dolce latte at this Starbucks yesterday evening. I didn't stay here, but it looked clean and had plenty of seating space, so it's a good spot if you're in this section of the city. 

The service was really great, probably helped that I was the only one in line. The guy who took my order was very friendly and accommodating of my preferences - one less pump of cinnamon syrup so it wouldn't be too sweet, half whipped cream so it wouldn't be TOO rich. He was very apologetic about the fact that they only had the sugar free syrup, and I was kind of apprehensive about that but it actually still worked. Definitely one of the better Starbucks stores I've been to, although it's only the second one in Philly. Maybe they're all better here!

Went to this place yesterday, and when I arrived the energy was bad one of the employees was complaining about the working conditions to another worker and saying how bad it is, I just wanted to get my Starbucks which i thought was gonna be good as usual, in fact it was NOT I asked for a caramel macchiato upside down I made it very clear, and when I got it it was NOT upside down. Would recommend if you want your order messed up.

They provide really fast and really awesome service, every time I walk out I'm pleased. If there's every any issues like out of stock on a certain item, they handle it with respect and provide alternatives that I've been pleased with.

NEVER have been to a Starbucks with such a rude employee... Kelsey shouldn't be at a job where interaction with the public is part of the job description... someone should remind her that the customers are the reason salaries get paid (and the tip cup gets stuffed by customers too).

This is my favorite Starbucks in the area. 99% of the time, my drinks are made to perfection! And if it misses the mark, the friendly staff is more than eager to re-make it without any fuss. There is normally a long line, but that should be expected when you're going to any Starbucks in a shopping center. The staff works quickly and efficiently and get the line down relatively-quickly.

This coffee shop is by far is the best around! The staff is awesome and super friendly. Thank you Ronni, Abby, Krissy, Brett, Annie and sara and issac. I know dealing with people can be different but you guys to a superb job at keeping your customer's happy! Thanks for your hard work. I appreciate you!!!

This is a pretty good Starbucks. It is in a great location (state street), so if you feel like taking a stroll with your coffee and popping into some cute local shops, you are in the right place! It is also a nice atmosphere to sit down and do your work. My only complaint is that it is always so busy that when I place an order ahead through the app, there is typically a longer wait than other locations. But overall a great experience!

I'm sorry, but I wasn't impressed with this Starbucks.  

I stopped in before I got my pedicure on Friday and the line was not only stupid long, but they only had two people working behind the counter (at 4pm).   A cashier and a barista.  That's it.  Nobody washing dishes, nobody taking drink orders ahead of time, etc.  

I paid for my drink and went over to the bar area to get it.  Oh wait a minute, there wasn't a place to wait- they had tables crammed all the way up to the bar area and there were at least 6 people standing there before me (all waiting for their drinks).

The barista looked swamped and I felt bad for him, but I've never experienced that big of a backup at any Starbucks (and I've been there at some baaaad times).

I tried the skinny mocha.  It was okay, but nothing to write home about,

It's Starbucks, always consistent. The drinks are always on point. The baristas are friendly and personable.

You have to take the good with the bad. And as thrilled as I was for the drive-thru, I'm a tad saddened. The drive-thru has slowed the service for those in-house. I've never noticed this before at other Starbucks with drive-thrus but here I have. They have also been out of caramel syrup for what feels like 2 weeks. You would think with so many Starbucks nearby they'd help their new location and loan some.

I'm not in love with the new location's bathroom. There fan in there makes you think there's a jet overhead. And for a paperless hand-dryer bathroom you expect less paper mess. But the toilet seat covers are hanging outside of their holder, and toilet paper bits were all over the floor.
Good location, friendly barrista's, good coffee and treats! Parking is rough and it's always busy and sometimes quite a wait! Good for the neighborhood though!

Why does Star$$$ coffee always taste burnt?
This is always my problem with Green Mermaid coffee.  The house coffee, without the benefit of heavy doctoring into lattes, capps, etc., is close to awful - harsh, bitter, skin peeling.  After being reformulated into the expensive brew, they are good drinks.  But, should you have to forgo the basics and rely on alchemy to be able to drink their stuff? Just asking. 
The bakery goods are very nice, and the oatmeal breakfast is way above average.  
The former Rexall never looked this good.  This is a great place to meet someone, and sit for a while. The bench sitters out front may take that idea to an extreme. 
So, how to rate when there is so much going on and such extreme divergence of quality and experience?  "Meh," doesn't really reflect the gestalt. "Yay!" is really going too far. "OK," is just about right.

came in on vacation and they were so speedy with my order, there was a mistake with whether my drink was iced or hot and they fixed it immediately and were extremely accommodating and sweet about it. good music, nice place to sit down and relax! one of my best experiences at a Starbucks!

This is a great Starbucks. It is clean and bright and the baristas are helpful. I wanted an iced tea in one of those cool reusable cups today. They helped me choose a cup and customize my iced tea: peach infused green tea. It was tasty. Thanks Starbucks!

Don't come here unless you are using the drive-thru!  I have been here twice in the last 3 days and both times I had to wait over 20 minutes for a toasted bagel!  Terrible in-store service.  Coffee also inconsistent in quality and flavor.  I observed the staff frantically getting orders out to drive-thru customers while ignoring in-store clients.  Bad form , Bux!

Skinny Vanilla Latte, it's so good I wanna eat it !
If u carry ur own nug u'll save money

Worst experience at Starbucks in awhile. I get it's a licensed store (in a hotel) but don't punish your customers for it. As a former Starbucks employee maybe I'm over critical but here are my issues with today's experience.
1. No signage on one of the breakfast sandwiches. I had to ask the curt barista what it was. 
2. I ordered an iced chai with soy and a shot. I saw the cup was marked incorrectly and reminded the barista about the soy. She said she got it. She did not so I asked her again to put it on the cup. She finally realized her mistake and told the barista - soy.
3. She rang me up and the total was around $13. A breakfast sandwich and a drink. Ridiculous. I knew it would be high and I was planning on using a free drink reward from my gold card. The barista on the till the said "we don't accept rewards". Crazy because I could pay with my gold card. Insanity. I know most licensed stores are able to accept rewards so not sure why this one is lagging.
4. I get to the handoff plane and my drink is called without the shot espresso. I corrected the barista and she had to take the drink back to add the shot.

Charging customers $13 for a to go breakfast means I shouldn't have to hold your baristas hand throughout the entire process let alone no one working smiled or said thank you.

For me this is my usual location. Its directly in between my two jobs, the university and my house.  Smart location. 

The staff always recognizes me and helps me out - shout out to the barista who we talked about Lady Gaga heels and my dreams of wearing them after I'm off crutches, and helping me get everything all situated on crutches, you're the real MVP.  

Downside is that at certain times of the day, its PACKED. and people can be real jerks about sharing the one big table.  And not all tables have outlets next to them. If you're going to a starbucks to work, its not my favorite one to do that at.  But for a quick cup of coffee (or unicorn frap) you're golden.

Ok, as a long time Starbucks fan, I am a bit bias. Boise is where I began my addiction to coffee, and this "open late" Starbucks definitely had a hand. The baristas here are nice, and this location has a drive thru. Lately they re-decorated for BSU studiers, with more plugs and lone seats. I personally miss the comfy chairs, but am happy it is open late.
Depends on who is working, but this location is pretty slow. I do really like the people that work here, super friendly!

It kills me that I like Starbucks coffee so I end up coming back. But, the owner of this store really needs to be more proactive in keeping their tables, floors and bathrooms cleaned. I  have been sitting inside working watching the tables just sit with cups, crumbs on the tables and floors. It's like no one dares leaves from behind the counter. And, the bathrooms are dirty. I would think it would be mandatory that one staff member would be responsible for coming out every 15-20 minutes to tend to tables. And maybe every hour to do a bathroom check. I needed to get on my computer for a bit for work, so I am grateful that I could stop in for that. But, ended up using my hotspot since their service is spotty:(. I am an everyday customer too, because I like my coffee or tea for the day. But, I can't wait until a new type of coffee house comes our way one day with top notch cleanliness as a priority. And, is it just me or is this music loud enough for a nightclub sometimes?

This location is across the street from my office so it's my go-to Starbucks. I usually order online and just run in to pick up but the weekday morning staff are always friendly. They'll shout out a "thank you," "have a nice day," or even a compliment as you grab your beverage. I've stopped here many times and they almost always get the drink right and if they don't they won't hesitate to remake it or add what was missed. I wish the coffee wasn't so expensive but that's an issue with Starbucks in general, not this location specifically.

Hold it. I know I have reviewed here!  

I did a mobile order. Got there and waited and waited. I asked if they got it and they did. Just two people there. Maybe understaffed and well was not too busy. 

Other than that. A Starbucks. Clean. And the same otherwise. Lots of parking here.

The place was clean, good coffee, but...
Service awful, cashier made fun about my nationality he though I don't speak English or I don't understand, bad experience, just not comments, I hope all the franchise are like that

The coffee is jank. Its hit or miss, sometimes the iced coffee is good and sometimes its watered down. It is not consistent, and not to mention the food is way overpriced. The employees there are pretty good, although the manager or front end lead sucks and seems like she spends most of the time in the back room instead of being a team player and helping out.
This store has remedied the blocking of doors and early closing of tables since my last review.

This Starbucks is on point when the manager is there, when he's not there it's crap. My drink is consistently made wrong every single time! I've even began asking them to make it right while I'm placing my order so I don't have the line backed up. But the moment I don't mention it, it's back to being made wrong! But this time today I was beyond mad. I made my order for the white chocolate mocha frapp. It was once again made wrong and I told the women in the drive through that it was made wrong and I've had this convo multiple times with her about my drink being wrong. So she had the guy make a new one. Mean while she opened the window back up and asked me if I wanted the messed up one as well as the new one. So I said sure I'll take it home. I took it and waited for my drink. Then the nasty attitude girl ( not sure her name) came to the window and asked for the drink back so she could dump it even though I was just given it by another employee. She is always nasty no matter if I go inside or out. Personally don't think she's a good fit for Starbucks! I only come to this Starbucks cause it's on my way home or to work. I'm gonna have to find another place to go, I'm am disappointed in Starbucks employees! The morning staff are better than the night crew!

An "acceptable" level of service, neither good nor bad, and some points for the interior design. However, the WiFi is painfully slow and drops continually, forcing many of us to head over to the nearby location on the interior of the outlet mall.

This is my local starbucks but I tend to go to Lakeland when I'm in a hurry or need consistency. This store was bad in the early morning for not following posted start times but lately they have been consistent.
I haven't waited the longest I have every waited in a drive-through in this stores drive-through (over 20min) If it's busy I don't bother stopping which is an inconvenient first world problem but if i have the time I still stop by.

So, I wouldn't normally review this type of place, seeing as its just such a massive chain and you generally know what you're going to get...but the baristas here have completely exceeded my expectations and they alone get 5 stars. 

Each time I've stopped in here, I've rarely seen the same employees for some reason. Regardless, they have all been very friendly and accommodating. I haven't had to wait in line for more than 2 minutes and the store has nice seating options, inside and out. 

Now, what has inspired me to write a review, you ask? As aforementioned, their accommodation. I came in on a Monday, got my usual drink, and then also got my usual sandwich-- the spinach & feta wrap. As I'm driving to work, I get towards the middle and it was frozen. The egg was like an iceberg. Irritated, I had no choice but to throw it out as I didn't have access to a microwave at the time. 

I didn't want to go back for a while, but I returned that Thursday as I saw that their Refresher beverages had returned. I placed my order for the Berry Hibiscus, and I was asked if I wanted a sandwich. I hesitated (I don't like to complain a lot), but I told her about my experience on Monday. She was very apologetic and said that my sandwich that day would be on the house. They made right my prior, lacking experience. Kudos to you, fantastic baristas!
Great place for coffee..at silver legacy casino..lots of choices..real neat staff..people real nice..m

I love how Starbucks gives back to the community and invests in their employees. Their coffee is great and frapps are awesome. But I'm kinda hooked on Verve from my hometown of Santa Cruz which can not be beat on taste.

The hot Americano's (extra shot) here do NOT taste the same as a corporate Starbucks. As an example, compared to the Circle Center Monument corporate Starbucks store. I'm unsure if it's the machine type that does not properly brew the espresso beans, OR the bean they're using? I can tell you this though, the machines they're using is not the same as a corporate store! Suggest a little extra 10 min. walk to this store. On 55 Monument Cir., Indianapolis, IN  46204.

If you say you'll be open until a certain time, you don't turn customers away 10 min prior to your advertised closing time. It's bad business. I completely understand not wanting to work on a holiday. As someone who worked in the service industry for over 20 years I respect it more than most and worked more holidays than not. That said, either don't open, or be prepared to serve guests until closing, even if its the slowest day of the year.

I've been to several Starbucks around the area. I used to live in Bell Meade until I moved to Franklin and I would always go to the one off Woodmont in the shopping center. Earlier this month, I ordered a extra dry soy Cappuccino. When I finally got my drink (there were a lot of people waiting), it was much too heavy. Over 1/2 full with milk instead of mostly foam. I took it back and said I had ordered it extra dry. The snarky barista said "it IS extra dry" and brushed me off. 

I was in a rush to go to a meeting because of the wait so I didn't push the issue, took my drink and threw it away. I've never been so offended as a paying customer in an establishment. I'm just going to have to go back to my usual Starbucks or another coffee place when I want a good Cappuccino.

Frequent here.
There is usually a line in the drive thru and subsequent wait. Today was a it long though I was the only car in line. Customer service was poor today as well. When I did get my non specialized cold beverage the cashier did not look at me and leaned it our the window half tilted. This rubbed me the wrong way. Service is normally better. Perhaps he was having a bad day. 
Inside the store it is clean and cozy. The bathrooms are also very clean.

This coffee shop and the staff is by far the best around! The staff is awesome and super friendly. Thank you Annie, Ronnie, Brett, Abbie and Krissy, Aron and Noah.  I know dealing with rude people can be challenging but, you guys do a superb job!!! Thank you for your hard work and thanks for keeping me happy and keeping it real! Thanks... I appreciate you!!!

Good cappuccino. Terrible environment. I was enjoying my cappuccino and working on a research paper when a loud customer began a dialog with the Starbucks employee (Joshua). The conversation turned to Joshua's co-workers and supervisor. Joshua began bad mouthing fellow staffers and his boss. It began with Joshua talking about a co-worker who continually clocks out ten minutes early. It went downhill from there. I had to listen to all the nonsense for approximately 20 minutes. It was terrible. Joshua was loud and the customer was even louder. Ugh!

UPDATE:
Nobody reached out to me, after my review was submitted several weeks ago, with either an apology. I can only surmise staff matters aren't important to this business.
Always packed, always slow. Snobby suburban moms being rude. Sucks it's the only Starbucks near by.
Reliable, quality drinks. Comfortable atmosphere. Parking can be tough to find at times.

We ordered 2 coffee drinks one of which was a decaf pour over. We also ordered 2 toasted bagels. The barista who took our order and money totally forgot our bagel order-never got it himself and never asked anyone to make it . One of our drinks was also super slow in coming out- and the store wasnt even very busy.When i asked another barista where our bagels were he did go 
 make them up-by now the coffee was getting cold. No apology. No explanation.
Oh- and he forgot the cream cheese also.

Either they were having a bad day or ( as i suspect) poorly trained employees.  Certainly not up to Starbucks standards.

Will find another one to try.
Great place to get that first cup in the am or mid afternoon! Great energy Baristas who always greet with a smile!

I had absolutely no idea that this location was even here until I stopped by Cheeseburger Charley's. It was a lot larger than I thought it would be. But it didn't seem to have a lot of lounging room. I rate all coffee shops on how good they'd be for studying or reading. They had a lot of seating but it wasn't really a studying environment. I don't think I'll be going back.
Fast and friendly service. My order was correct and very good. I received a free drink for my birthday, which I appreciate.

A bit small inside and often too busy to sit and work, especially with limited outlets. Staff has been inconsistent but the drinks have been fairly consistent. They have a tendency to short cut (mopping with two hours left and right where you are working, creamers away, no dark roast by lunch time) but are pretty nice. Standard Starbucks so a safe bet :)
Really not my favorite location. Parking is terrible and the staff is slow. The shop itself is one if the nicer shops but as its on the main strip in Newtown it really has to be.

This is the most comfortable, and well-managed Starbucks I've been to in Philadelphia, hands down.  One might be hesitant to go in due to the current construction in the building (rendering the entrance a bit hidden) and the seemingly long lines, but rest assured, they know how to move a line along and you won't be waiting more than a minute or two.

This location is convenient. As for the efficiency and general atmosphere ... well that is an entirely different story. When you walk into a Starbucks you know what you are going to get. The coffee is not great and it is not awful. So with that as the baseline one has to rely on service and the general feel of each individual location. 

Here's the skinny: most of the time the crew seems to possess no sense of urgency. Not to worry though, in the background you get to jam out to overly loud dance party USA. (Must be for all the non-paying customers who are allowed to just hang out) This tends to be a busy location and service along with attitude need to change accordingly. The square footage of the current space seems to be less than the older space it occupied before the move further into the 'Ville. 

Bottom line is I want to like this particular location however with two other, relatively, close Starbucks (right off the 292 parkway and right next to the next Whole Foods) I cannot believe someone has not called this location out to "step up it's game". The few times I spend in there each week may be better spent in another "local" coffee spot. 

Mediocrity is the new norm.
Terrible, latte was not made correctly went back asked for another and hooray it was made correctly. No I am sorry just a dirty look. And they weren't even busy. Never again at this Starbucks !
Baristas are always friendly and greet you as soon as you walk in. They're helpful with options and accommodate when I'm being picky with what I want in my drinks :)

The service/staff were great; friendly and quick at getting my order.

I love Starbucks. The pastries make me smile, the oatmeal is comforting, and the breakfast sandwiches are cheesy goodness. My daughter is a big fan of the Turkey Pesto Panini.

If I love the star so much why only 4 stars?..the disappointment of the Holiday Panini. It was underwhelming. The sandwich was a barely a resemblance of what is pictured on the Starbucks site. 

***** Site description: A generous portion of sliced turkey breast is at the heart of this holiday-inspired panini. It's topped with cranberry-herb stuffing and turkey gravy then served warm on toasted ciabatta bread. It's a handheld turkey dinner.*****

Generous is a subjective term. The panini was slim..it actually looked as though there wasn't anything inside. The stuffing must've soaked up all the gravy creating a thick paste that birthed a mushy texture. Thankfully the bread was toasted; it provided some crunch. 

This experience has me doubtful on trying something new at Starbucks. No worries though, I have plenty of favorites to keep me going back. 
*The oatmeal options are so good I often order one for lunch or dinner :D

This Starbucks is right in the lobby of our hotel, which was so convenient. I love Starbucks and this one did not disappoint. I got a yogurt and bagel one day, and a yogurt parfait another day. The espresso drinks were on point.
Kept getting my order wrong. Charged me a second time for one of my drinks. I wouldn't recommend anyone I know to this location.

This new location is notoriously slow in preparing mobile orders. They also served my wife burnt coffee beans recently in her eggnog latte. Friendly, but certainly lacking in the

I just tried this store again. As usual, mobile order took forever. The nearby Oracle and Rudasil store is also busy, but doesn't delay in processing mobile orders. ugh

Ok. The positive: my drink was hot (black coffee) and my cookie was good. That's what the 1 star is for. 

Cons: I walked in and the floors looked like they hadn't been swept all day (it's 1:30). The walkway to the bathroom was really dirty. Footprints, trash, messy rubber floor covers. The bathroom... the toilet had rust stains (that doesn't happen when you clean the toilet daily), and there was no soap coming out of the dispenser. Gross.

So, the place was dirty. 

Also the guy took my order (hot black coffee and a cookie), then immediately took two more orders without getting my stuff. One of them was outing $59 on 10 gift cards! He only remembered after I wandered back up to the register.There were two girls talking by the cookie case not helping at all.

I will not go back.

I went in this morning and ordered an iced mocha. Tatiana greeted my friend and I with a smile and a warm welcome even though it was 6:50 in the morning. Brandon greeted everyone  with a good morning welcome to Starbucks even thought he was prepping drinks. This locations stafff has never failed  to impress me. Whenever I need Starbucks I will go to this location because of the great customer service that I receive from here.
Nice to have inside frys...they are always busy whenever I am there...only go to Starbucks when I have a gift card but I like to go on their sale price days. Service is pretty quick.

I've started coming to this location in the mornings vs my usual location by Trader Joe's because it's winter and they have a drive thru so I don't need to leave my preciously warm and cozy car.

I have a regular order I get and it's always been given to me correct and piping hot, as well as in a timely fashion. 

I might make this my regular location as the morning baristas are definitely more friendly here, it's certainly not expected that ANYONE be super cheery before 7 AM and I would never retract points based off that, but it is an added bonus I appreciate, for sure.

As far as chain Starbucks locations go, this one is a few notches above others.
This is the saddest, most watery espresso I've had in years. I feel sad and under-caffeinated. Sad emoji. Sleepy emoji.

I usually get excited when I find a Starbucks. However, today I was disappointed. We walked in to a very long line so I went to my app to order on line and I could not find the store listed. The lady in front of me said, oh their app is not working. Then I looked behind the counter and they only had two people working. The guy taking the orders was as slow as molasses. The Barista making the drinks was just as slow. Made for a long wait. Several people got tired of waiting and left. Too bad.

Like the Starbucks over in the GSR, this is like one of their smaller locations with plenty of different seating types and etc. Kind of a rarity in casinos. You can hook into the decent free Nugget wifi here too. They do charge about 20 cents more per beverage than other Reno/Sparks locations, tho.

Open 'till at least 10:30 every night, possibly later on Fri-Sat

No problems with the bevs but I only get black coffee at Starbucks, I never get the complicated mocha frappa rappa ya yas unless they're giving me one for free

Staff is great and drinks are made well. But the WiFi constantly disconnects and there is not enough plug ins around the cafe. I spoke with the manager about a month ago about these issues. She said the would be fixed, but no improvements so far
No stars. This place is the worst. Service sucks , people suck, all around just sucks.

No no no no
I was thrilled to see this place open near my home.  My first trip 7am Sunday morning and the bathrooms have lock codes on them. I asked the guy behind the counter why and was told so they can monitor who is using the bathroom. I hate this kind of snobbery so I won't be back. 

I'm guessing this is an anti-homeless measure but there are no lock codes at the Grand and Lindell location or the S Kingshighway location and homeless people frequent those areas without over running the coffee shops. Locking the doors helps no one but it reveals something sad about the owners heart.

This is a brand new store so the owner isn't reacting to a historical situation. Perhaps they are acting on faulty assumptions about this part of town.  Maybe they are worried about losing business Whatever, doesnt matter. As said earlier, I won't go back. There are plenty of other Bucks in STL and there's a perfectly wonderful privately owned coffee place closer to my house anyway -Restituto (without locked bathrooms). There are two other local coffee shops in a 3 block radius and they don't have locked bathrooms or hordes of "undesirables" hanging around.

I love you Starbucks but this anti-human snobbery breaks my heart. What if a random homeless person happens by and really needs a bathroom break? I know what that is like because I'm one of the millions of Americans who has been in that situation.  I'm not going to spend my money in a place that makes me feel like I'm contributing to more human misery. If I patronize you when your employees are kind to me it will only remind me of your unkindness to others and it will ruin my coffee.

This is the second best Starbucks in Reno, behind the one in the Mae Anne Safeway. Drinks are always good and prepared as ordered. I stop here a lot and I'm always happy. The only reason it doesn't get five stars is because its a Starbucks. No matter how good it is, its still inferior to Peet's.

From an avid Starbucks customer, this location is one of the worst. Make sure to have plenty of time to wait for your order to come out. It took just a few minutes for my breakfast to come out, but another 25 minutes for my coffee to be made.

This Starbucks is a mess. From web orders to the check out, nothing is set up to be customer friendly. The web orders are housed behind the counter. That is totally fine, but the employees actively ignore people. What's the point of mobile orders if you need to wait to get drinks in line? Next, the barista there this evening was in no rush or concerned about doing anything quickly. He filled up the lids, stared at the blender for one drink, remade the drink, and did nothing else. The cups were piling up. Each time I go here, the experience is the same. It's very disappointing.

friends of mine call it 'fourbucks'

i tried to order like a regular cup of coffee, and was confused.
i can't believe i can buy a cd of the music they are playing if i wanted to.

Wasn't there long enough to really give it more attention for an in depth review.  We stopped in after walking on State Street, enjoying the lights and holiday atmosphere.  Headed back to our car, this location was convenient.

It does have the charm factor of being two stories inside the space, with the upper floor being mezzanine style above the barista's serving bar.  One could imagine this being in San Francisco or Seattle, with the vintage vibe of a Victorian era space.

We received our drink in a reasonable amount of time, made correctly.  The shop was pretty busy on New Year's Eve.  The staff was working regular hours, until 10 PM that night.

They have a good location, centrally located on State Street, across from Paseo Nuevo, and not far from City Hall.

If i could give this location 0 stars i would. I keep giving them a chance but this is definitely my last they are ridiculous with drive thru time we are waiting sometimes at least 5 min! I used to work in fastfood and we would always try to get our food out in under 2min but not this location like today i waited 5 min for a tall green tea frapp i usually wouldnt even bother to review but today was ridiculous and I'm livid. Anyhow there are better Starbucks and DDs to go to other than this one.

I'm a coffee snob and I make sure to go out of my way for this Starbucks. Not all have the Reserve roasts and the Clover Brewed coffee, so take advantage when you are near here. It takes a bit longer for the clover brewed coffee so be patient. I get the reserve roast clover brewed so to enjoy the best of the best. The customer service here was also outstanding.

This is actually one of the better Starbucks in Indianapolis to be honest (which is unfortunate). Immediately, I was greeted by very pleasant barista's that gave good Customer Service. Not only was my drink recommended good but it was actually made well, this is what stands out to me when ordering at Starbucks. Went with a friend she too enjoyed the experience at this Starbucks. Normally, when going to Starbucks I'll go with what is closest, however I'll try to get to this one more frequently after this most recent visit.

My home away from home.
I love you Starbucks, let me count the ways!

This place is always hopping, especially in the mornings.
It's busy, and usually understaffed. Just come prepared to wait. and then wait some more.
The staff is super friendly and the store is clean.
Above all else, the COFFEE AND ESPRESSO is YUMMY.

Other than the mall, this is my fave Starbucks around this side of town.
Shots are milky-ish and perfect, especially when ordered ON TOP of my iced coffee. YUMM.

I would marry this spot if I could.

This Starbucks is always slow in the drive through. Today, I waited 10 minutes (normal for the drive through). I ordered a latte, which is obviously a hot drink. For some reason the woman added ice to it. I saw that on the sticker and so I asked her if there was ice and she said no. I left the drive through and took a sip and the drink was cold. So I had to drive all the way back around the block to get back in line. The drink also had whipped cream when I asked for no whipped cream. I went inside and politely asked her to make me a new one without ice. She did, but with a very unfriendly attitude. No apology or anything. She must be new.

Busy busy busy busy!!!

This place is always busy. At first, it didn't impact me. Sure, I had to wait in line to order. But once I placed my brewed coffee order, the barista just turns around, pours me a cup, I pay via the app, and I'm on my way. If you order anything beyond a brewed coffee, be prepared to wait!

Every (not occasionally, every!) morning that I come here, there are countless people waiting for their specialty drink.  And these people look tired, frustrated, impatient - the exact look of people who, well,  "haven't had their coffee yet." Poster child for that novelty catchphrase coffee mug.

Well, I've switched from brewed to Americano and have joined the pool of the disgruntled. I mean, wow - I've waited almost 10 minutes once, AFTER a did a mobile order 5 minutes prior.  And an Americano is just espresso with hot water! If you're going extra special (fraps with 2%, light foam, coconut milk, shaken not stirred, dash of mocha, etc), good luck to you.

Don't get me wrong, the staff is friendly, but this place just seems to suffer from efficiency. I've actually come to the point where I only order an Americano if I'm with a friend and have to wait anyways, or there isn't a swarm of waiting patrons crowding the place. Needless to say, I'm drinking a lot of brewed coffee again.

Will I return? Yes, because I'm a sucker to maintain my Starbucks Gold status and I frequent the area a lot.  Beverage quality is consistent with other Starbucks. But when I'm exhausted, it's early morning, and I absolutely need an espresso drink, I go around the corner to La Colombe or Gran Cafe Aquila.

Waiting 10 minutes for a crafted drink? Ain't nobody got time for that.

I like this Starbucks a lot! It's super cute. It has a drive thru. Inside, there are comfy chairs and tons of tables and seats and it's warm. It's a really large Starbucks with enough parking. Seriously can't think of a single thing wrong with this place.
Unfriendly.  Forgot part of order. Half full drinks. Asked for extra hot - didn't get that either.

The employees of this Starbucks are disgustingly rude and inconsiderate. They always have an attitude as if they hate their job and everyone who comes there. It was the absolute worst way to start my morning. They never have anything - refreshers, bagels, cream cheese, proper sized lids. This morning I asked for a lid with out a straw because I seen them across the counter and the barista almost yelled at me telling me I got what I got. I couldn't believe the customer service here. I hope that lady gets fired because it is not the first time I've seen her be rude to customers and to her coworkers. I'm beyond disappointed and never coming here again.

The barista was making a drink for a target employee and was talking me and a girl got in line 
The target employer left and she took my order then proceeded to take other orders before starting any. 
My point is you were sitting there chatting with a target employee you could have done that while taking my order and starting it. It wasnt even that hard an order. Waited 15min for an iced tea.

You can hate on Starbucks all you want. You can bring up all the other locally owned or franchised coffee shops all over the world about how much better their coffee taste over Starbucks. You can say that there's too many locations but if your gonna make those complaints about Starbucks than you should write one about McDonalds too! I thank the man who decided to put one in every corner so that I can convienently grab one. I would tell him that he should put a few more on the south side of tucson because when I'm around the airport area I cant seem to find one. 

Starbucks is genius and I am a sucker. I would never refuse a starbucks run. I just love the obnoxiously sweet syrups they pump into your cup before they fill it with espresso and milk. I love how they offer organic soy milk! and I am willing to pay the extra .60 cents (actually I dont because I'm on the rewards program. haha!) I love the overpriced pastries and deli items. I love how the flavor of every item is overpowering, rich and intense. 

Its my crack and I'm addicted. Convienently I work by this one and being up at 6 am to work in customer service, its the best thing to help get through my long, exhausting, had no sleep, people expecting the world catered to them on gold platter day :D I LOVE YOU STARBUCKS

Had to head out one evening to get a fair amount of work done and found this spot packed wall-to-wall with students working on projects and studying.  Find your spot, get you coffee, and get working :-)

Just waited 20 minutes for a coffee..... the employee Nathan was extremely rude didn't greet me or anything never once smiled and when I went to pay he got annoyed that I as a customer didn't know where the scanner is to pay when that's his job, not mine. If you hate your job that much then quit. 
It's not always like this here sometime they're so nice and positive but it's been less frequent that it's like this lately.
I came in a few times on my break and each time everyone has been super friendly! My barista Shelby was extremely helpful and i'll definitely be coming back!!

It's Starbucks.  Pretty standard when it comes to the food/drink.  This location is always packed full since it's part of downtown Franklin.  Parking can be tricky.  Not a lot of area to stand and wait for your drink, and rarely there is a place to sit and wait for your drink.  However, it's the closest to my house so I'll continue to frequent it.  I do prefer the one across town with the drive-thru.

I'm going to "lovably" dub this location as the Snafu Starbucks. This location runs out of menu items more frequently than any other Starbucks in town. Come after 8 on a weekday and they're pretty picked over on breakfast items. You'd think they'd eventually figure out to stock adequately to meet demand. Still more frustrating are inexplicably long waits--even when there are just one or two other customers in the place--and the frequency with which they mix up orders. Today I waited a ridiculously long time for a breakfast sandwich, was handed a bag by the barista, and got home to find myself stuck with a multigrain bagel. Um, thanks?

I don't normally review Starbucks for the most part they're okay but this location has a few people with attitude problems. The location is good and they're fairly quick but not anything that stands out as far as the Starbucks chain goes.
This is the closest one to my work. The staff is ALWAYS friendly & have smiles on their faces even in the morning. Most know me by name, but overall I've never had a bad experience at all!

Lowering my review to 1 star. After being to countless Starbucks all over the country the Newton location is now consistently the slowest, by far. I think they must have management problems because after years of seeing familiar, hustling staff it's now new faces every time. No sense of urgency and the floor and tables were filthy. Yuck. I'm done.

I'd give ZERO stars if I could. The customer service is absolutely HORRIBLE, the "barista" has the worst disrespectful attitude, I'm disgusted Starbucks would even employee someone with such poor etiquette and is far from articulate. The sanitation is absolutely horrible here, the first time I came here I asked if they had sandwiches and one employed rudely said to me "If you want a sandwich you need to go somewhere else we don't have them here." Later to find out they do in fact have breakfast sandwiches which is what I intended on purchasing. My second time coming here the employed were speaking very LOUDLY about how all the food in the casino INCLUDING Starbucks looked disgusting and looked roach infested, I was so grossed out I couldn't believe they were slandering the casinos name along with their employers name. The THIRD time my husband ordered us strawberry refreshers and the "barista" filled the venti cup to the very top with ice, my husband took 3 sips and the drink was gone because there was so much ice, when he politely asked the barista what the issue was, she again rudely stated "That's standard to fill the cup to the top with ice if you didn't want it you should have said light ice." WOW I cannot believe Starbucks allows their employees to speak to customers like this. Especially a gold card holder since 2012 who regularly purchases bulk orders of drinks for her office on top of being cooperate account members at the Nugget Casino I am absolutely appalled at the service, I will be no longer be spending such large amounts of money at Starbucks and will be taking my business elsewhere!

This used to be my favorite location , but it seems like management may have changed. The employees don't seem to have that same personable feel like those in the past. I miss seeing the same people I did for years that actually knew me would actually ask how I am and we would laugh and chat while waiting for my drink. Now it's pretty much in and out. I know no one nor do I think the people there really will take time to get to know me. Otherwise , it's clean and in a good location.

The worst green tea Frappucino ever made!!  It looked like I was scraping algae off the sides and bottom. It was chunky and just gross. Already down the interstate before I took my first sip of it, something tells me this is what they count on. Will never go to this location again!

Excellent service!!!  Thank you for being so good!!  Had a small issue with the way my coffee was made but they fixed it to my liking right away!!  The cashier was so so so sweet. I'm sorry I did not get her name!!

I didn't realize that the stores at the mall don't open until noon on Sundays, so I got there before the stores opened. Luckily, Starbucks opens earlier, and I stopped by to get a coffee while I waited for the stores to open. Just a Starbucks, but it was big enough and had seating. What else do you need in a Starbucks?

A nice starbucks with consistent quality of the coffee they put out. A great place to meet up with friends has a nice vibe. A little loud for a place to get work done, but a good place nonetheless. The baristas here are very upbeat and kind. They get the coffee out fast and diligently.
I had to disconnect their Wi-Fi connection to even make this review. Waste of time if you need the Internet. Maybe at other times it works but it was .3 MB a second.

I absolutely love the new staff @ this location! I go here frequently to get my venti java chip frapp. I love the coffee, the healthy treats and the sweets. I stepped in tonight. It's the 4th of July. The young male with a nice smile. I can't remember his name but, as I walk in the door he yells out my order. He knows it automatically. A new guy was behind the counter he asked what I wanted and the other guy was on it. 
  Everyone here if very friendly great staff!

Almost every time I come to this Starbucks they get my drink order wrong. I usually order an iced quad espresso with 2 % and a few pumps of a flavored syrup (from other Starbucks) and I've never had a problem. When I order it here it looks extremely light or super watery. The third time they remade it I just didn't say anything and went to the Starbucks across from Wiregrass because it still didn't look right and  I didn't trust it(drink was right at Wiregrass location wish I took a picture to compare)This Starbucks is closer to my house so I try to give it a chance but for now I'm going to just stick to my usual one by Wiregrass. Staff is friendly but baristas need more training making iced espresso drinks. (Noting I use to work for Starbucks so I know how the drinks are made)

Your typical well run Starbucks! We needed a coffee to keep us going this morning and we were nearby so in we went. Clean, efficient and delicious - like most all Starbucks!

I'd come back here anytime!

I really like that this Starbucks opened in Richmond Heights to give me an option not to have to fight the parking lot situation at the Brentwood location. However it's been open for quite a while now and there seem to still be quite a few kinks. One time they forgot to make my food and I had to interrupt them talking behind the counter to ask for it since I had been waiting awhile. Another time one employee was working the window and also training someone at the bar who was taking a long time to make my drink by stopping after each step to wait for more instruction. I waited 10 minutes for an iced drink and it wasn't correct. This past time I was in the drive thru with a lady in front of me that they couldn't answer her questions so someone else had to get on and answer them. Then she sent her drink back at the window that they had to remake. After all that wait they told me the food I ordered was out and I had to wait again for something else. This location is gorgeous inside and convenient so I will keep giving them a chance but I hope their training picks up soon and they get more efficient.

The guy who was at the front was having a bad day. I just got two waters around 7pm, so it wasn't busy at all. He just acted like he was having a crappy day and didn't want to deal with customers. The red headed gentleman was great & pleasant to work with.. however the female on staff was not very nice at all. I'm almost positive this girl was management & that makes me question the type of personality Starbucks hires. Promote the young redhead guy! He's adorable & personable :) xo
Charged me for an order they messed up. I went back to get a replacement without sugar and instead the woman in the drive-thru said, "Welcome back that'll be $3.31."

I hate to say it but while at a comic convention at the Nugget I stopped by the Starbucks to get an iced latte and what I got was a five dollar cup of ice.  It was literally so packed full of ice I could not insert the straw.
I don't know if the Barista was new, if this was just a mistake, or if Starbucks tells its employees to do this but I'm kind of angry that I paid five dollars for essentially 3 ounces of latte.
I guess the moral is when at Starbucks make sure to ask for LESS ICE or NO ICE so you get your money's worth.

Drive through took over 20 minutes with only 3 cars ahead. The employee was very hard to understand over the speaker, just thought it was there was technical issues. Reached the window and the employee was very rude, needs better people skills.

I know this location won't be open much longer and I am so sad by this news. So I decided to come on here and give this location and it's wonderful staff a 5 star review before they go.
I've been coming to this specific Starbucks location for the past two years now. And of course I've just fallen in love with the staff. Everyone is so friendly and beyond kind when I walk in the door. And on the mornings when I walk my dog, I sit outside on the patio chairs and place my coffee order through the app on my phone for pick up. April, one of the staff members, recognizes my name and my order  and actually BRINGS ME my coffee outside on the patio. She's so sweet!
Wonderful customer service! I'll miss this location dearly.

The staff at this Starbucks is exceptional; engaging, friendly, knowledgeable & helpful and, very customer centered.  Frankly, today, it was like being at the coffee version of Cheers while I was at the counter .... the whole staff.  It's also more spacious than most Starbucks. So, if you're sticking around, it's a comfortable place to be.

It's the bogo day, and the wait time was about 45 minutes. Everyone works hard and still very friendly.  However, my drinks were very disappointed.  I ordered extra hot and got them warm.  Also, the drinks were less than 3/4 full.  So I brought one drink and break it into two cups???

I gave them a one because the barista was pleasant. This Starbucks is in the airport. I just waited 36 minutes to get my drink because they have one personWorking the cashier and making bricks. They had a second girl there that said she could only do stocking. When I ask why it took 31 minutes to wait in an airport Starbucks she said we're understaffed. Totally unacceptable.

Same drink I order at every other Starbucks but taste and looks disgusting recommend trying a different Starbucks. I'm vegan and it looks full of something white floating in my drink almond milk dose not do that. Looks maybe they added whipped cream and instead of starting a new drink they just mixed it in

When this Starbucks store opened I was singing Oh Happy Days because the store has a drive-through and they open at 5 AM!  Being the early riser that I am, I like to go to Starbucks while still in my pajamas so the necessity of a drive through is a must.  I used to drive several miles just to get to the one on 7th Street so I wouldn't have to get out of my car.  This new location is just a mile and a half from my house.  One time when I got there at 5am the store wasn't open so I decided to wait in the parking lot to see when the baristas would show up to work. They ended up opening the store at 5:30 yet didn't apologize for their tardiness.  Tardy = 1 less star!  My favorite drink is the triple grande Latte.  That's all I ever order.  Why mess with perfection?  Now you know why my chocolate Lab is named Latte!

The lines may be long but it's worth it. When I ordered she was so nice. Greeted me with a smile and said "Good morning and how can I help you? " I placed my order but forgot I was hugging a water bottle to purchase. I received my coffee and cinnamon blueberry bagel, toasted of course and this lady too greeted me with a smile. Then I realized I still had the water and had not paid. So I quickly put it back and told the lady and we laughed. She offered me a cup of water and assured me it was filtered and triple filtered. Haha They're busy but not too busy for to give a smile.
Good place to hang out and get a quick cup of joe. According to my husband but I like the frapacinos
Horrible service, waited 20 minutes, did not call coffee half glass and cold, had to remake the mocha because the ice was melt, expensive and not quality, shoud be review the prices and services.

They messed up my order short pike coffee with soy and carmel both of the baristas were complete bitches with major attitude but, yet they could not get my drink right . I had a gift card otherwise, I certainly would have gone to Cafe Luce . You Starbucks have lost me as s customer . Oh and my coffee tastes like crap too watered down .

The barista at the window was very friendly and seemed happy. They also put like alooot of caramel in our drinks since we asked for extra caramel. But they were generous with it and I appreciate that. Great location and you can tell they care.

This Starbucks location is right in my neighborhood, and I've had my fair share of visits. Never anything to critique this store about, until today. I got an email from Starbucks rewards promoting the limited-time Tie-Dye Frappuccino, and I wanted to give it a try. I had my sister (teenage years) grab it for me and we'd share while I stayed in the car. It took a while for her to get back, which didn't phase me as this is a popular location. Drink was presentable and wasn't bad at all, but this review is for the customer service. On the drive back, she started telling me "if employees don't want to make these kinds of drinks, they shouldn't sell them at their stores?" I told her it was the corporation that decides what drinks are promoted and it's mostly out of stores' hands, but that prompted me to wonder why she asked that. She told me that once she'd told the barista the order, the staff all began to seem annoyed. Like I get it, these showy, over-the-top promotional drinks are probably annoying to deal with, but I don't think my sister shouldn't have received the air of annoyance because of that. Nor should any customer in general, I believe. It would've been much more professional to keep their discontent to themselves, or at least display it at a time where customers can't take note.

I love starbucks but I will pass this location and do without my favorite latte!  Everytime I gave this place a chance I was disappointed.  The staff is miserable and always with a bad attitude.  Ive gotten the wrong drink multiple times and the wait, is well, beyond awful!!!  The service was awful and I rarely had a decent experience here. I will continue to do the drive by!!

Double tall extra hot latte, tasted like hot water from strained through the previous customers grind. This coffee was bad.  Now if u like fancy sugar water, maybe u love this place. I like coffee, had better coffee at Starbucks in flipping China. What is going on people? One star for friendliness.  The store was trashed. Wipe off the sugar stand much? Jeez, we aren't animals.
I woke up at 7 in the morning just got a soapy Frappuccino!! I would give it 0 stars if I could !! But the whip cream was good.

Stopped by to rock a iced venti white tea w 1 pump of liquid cane cuz it's just crazy hot out already!

My barista, Shelby was moving at the speed of light as her hands blurred w speed. I've been to, some would say, too MANY coffee shops but this particular Starbucks location rocks. Fast, clean, and really friendly staff. Nice change!

This place is extremely slow and employees are not always nice, very rude sometimes. The drive through is horrible the line backs up all the way into the street because they are slow and it's too small of an area. I was cursed at by an employee a few months ago and called corporate and emailed them and never heard back. Really wish they would get their shit together!!!

Awesome spot in the middle of historical downtown Franklin Tennessee. The crew always remembers my drink and the team always greets me immediately. Clarice and Liz Anna are fantastic barista's. They always make my drink exactly the way I want it and are very friendly and egg knowledge the frequency of my patronage. The store is very well-managed and always friendly and provide a great atmosphere. Thank you for always being there for my early morning coffee needs!
Great service, so friendly, accommodating for my weird orders!!! The order taker and Anna, the cashier were awesome!

Order at your own risk this Starbucks is convenient for shopping the mall but they half listen while your ordering therefore getting your order wrong most of the time and you don't want to wait in the long lines for them to fix it so my advice go to a different Starbucks before or after shopping.

I like to get coffee from this starbucks. The baristas  are very friendly and polite. Typically I go there when I want to take some break from my school work. They have nice outside area that you can sit and wait for your drink. It is a crowded place to work inside

Maybe the worst Starbucks there is around. They are slow, don't do the drinks in the order they receive them, and sometimes the order doesn't even come out and you have to go back to the desk to remind them or ask them what happened. All they have as an answer is "oh I'm sorry, what was it again?". I just don't get it.
This location struggles occasionally with providing consistently good food and occasionally struggles on a drink here and there. Staff is fairly friendly - could use some additional training.

You'd think with six employees it wouldn't take 10 minutes to get an iced coffee!Starbucks has been added to my regular morning routine which usually means a long line in the drive thru. My logic says park and you'll beat a lot of the cars in line. Well my reasoning is incorrect. This location obviously caters to the guests in their drive thru. I'll admit the product is always good but you'd think patrons that go inside would receive the same service as those in their car.
I really like this Starbucks.  The staff is friendly( especially Rebecca) and the service is great.  I go there everyday.

Love this place!! Makes my coffee just right every time!! Great place to see business professionals refill their energy. Parking can be limited so be patient. And there is no drive thru, but that's ok. Just makes you stop and enjoy your coffee more.

It's hit or miss here. I've noticed the morning staff seems to be more attentive than the afternoon staff. Also if you're in the drive-thru they have a tendency to give you small straws for venti drinks, so always double check or it's awkward to drink out of.

I typically pick up large orders from Starbucks. 10-40 drinks at a time. Today was the first day in 12 years that I dumped an ENTIRE order. One quick call to this location and they quickly remade the order. Thanks for the excellent customer service!!!!

So excited to try the newly renovated Starbucks in Safety Harbor! This is where my excitement ended.

Newly renovated, but for some reason it doesn't seem like the whole "Design and Research" department at Starbucks tested the seating and comfort designs on humans.  

Let's get started with the HUGE bench in the new part of this Starbucks, why is it so high up?  Why is it so uncomfortable? Did the designer actually SIT on this?  Nice plugs right by your feet, but why?  No Human could ever sit here and plug away at studying or work while enjoying Coffee because the tiny tables in front of the bench is LOWER than the bench itself.  What? Yah.  This would be torture to try to use these little tiny tables even for setting a coffee on.  

OK, so what about the chairs?  Very odd wooden bottomed chairs with either a strange padded back or NO BACK AT ALL.  What the heck?  I wonder how many back injuries are going to happen after sitting in here over a cup of coffee and a scone.

Bench along the window.  Good idea I guess, but I can't get over the horrible chairs. 

To the designer, are you a reincarnated Medieval torture device engineer?  What on earth are you thinking!? 

As to the coffee, yah it's good and the service is still on point.  But the Baristas were even complaining about back pain because they lowered the counter they have to work on by 4 inches and over the course of the day they are hurting.

Starbucks, you might want to go back to the drawing board on this design.

Just like any Starbucks, you can find the kind of Starbucks coffee here. The service is great, but sometime when they get too busy, nobody clean up both the table and the restroom. Whenever I see  a lot of college kids inside, I will go someplace else. Otherwise, this is the Starbucks where I can enjoy my coffee, read the paper in peace in a clean table and room.

Walked into the store and was immediately attacked by white girl radical feminists for being a male. There coffee is ok considering they burn their coffee beans. Upon walking out I was called bad names by people who have to write novels in public. Then mugged for my grandfathers pocket watch by a group of hipsters.

I decided to review my neighborhood Starbucks, mainly because of the nice people that work there.  The barista named Kimmy is always smiling and calling me "dear".  It is appreciated.  Starbucks is Starbucks for the most part and although I am not a huge fan of their coffee... I can easily review it for their tea.  Favorites at Starbucks for me are- iced green tea, iced passion tea and iced chai tea.  The new addition to  Starbucks are these cute and yummy petite sized treats.  The red velvet whoopie pie is a favorite of mine.  I find it quite challenging to resist getting one of those petite treats. Bottom line of my review is, I am a fan of my local Starbucks.

Caffeine not Caribe. Stupid spell check.

Well, fast service, friendly and I get Fry's points. What more can you want.

If you are near, stop on by, they have s few tables and chairs where you can sit.

As far as Starbucks go, this one is just fine.  No drive-thru, which you might expect from being on the end of the building, but I don't think the structure allows for it.  Still, that's a minor complaint if mentionable at all.

My only legitimate complaint was the amount of time I had to wait on a weekday afternoon for a coffee (latte), as there was only one barista working the entire show (register, making orders, etc.).  Others slowly came out of the woodwork and started to help out, but if you are a crew of three or more, why would you leave only one person alone for an extended period of time?  Bad culture I'm guessing, or just a lack of focus on the customer experience.

Still, the drinks were fine and the service was friendly.  I have no real complaints beyond the first one.  I'd come back (of course I would, it's Starbucks...)

One of their espresso machines was down this morning during the rush and I think drinks were running 15-20 minutes.  The employees worked their butts off and gave out recovery cards to everyone who had to wait a while.  You could tell the staff was stressed to the nines, but they were awesome and did an amazing job given the circumstances and still smiled through it all.  Just wanted to say thank you, I appreciate all of the hard work and positive attitudes!
Slowest starbucks in the United States! Least proactive staff, unfortunately only coffee at terminal

This location has always been very convenient for me to get coffee before school. I've seen both the morning and afternoon staff and I've never had an issue.
