I really feel that the individuals that I've interacted with at this location tend to be very helpful compared to other experiences that I've had at other grocery store locations.
They're always friendly and they never get my order wrong! They're always consistent. There's one closer to my house and I drive over to this one instead.

3.7 Stars! 

Drive through was quick. They made my friend's green matcha tea latte so hot - 130 degrees. Her tongue was burned! She had asked for it to be warm and children's temperature. I brought her latte back and the manager made her another latte at 100 degrees. She said if it was too hot that she would make another at a lower temperature. Great customer service! Despite my friend's tongue burn, I was very impressed at how they fixed the issue!

I love this Starbucks! I work right on state and will only go to this one. Today I went in and I believe I read her name as Gianna, and I was so impressed. Her customer service and attitude was so inspiring and made my whole day turn around! I love how personal this entire staff is. Great job, Starbucks! You are making a good name for yourselves. I will miss this service when I move out of town.

I drink Starbucks a few times a week and usually have a great experience. My husband and I came to this Starbucks today for a little holiday pick me up. The customer service could be a little better and the wait was longer than normal even though there wasn't much business right now.
Amazing staff, great view in the outside seating area. I love the people and pet watching here, it's like my second home when visiting my parents in the area :)

In the past I've been dissatisfied by the service and quality of product but on this trip I was shocked to see that, regardless of the cavalier attitude of many patrons, the barrisa was not wearing her face mask. I let her know that since she's preparing food she should be the most cautious of anybody and I walked out without placing an order because I didn't feel it was worth the risk.

If I could give this Starbucks location negative stars I would. Went today and experienced the rudest customer service. Ordered a venti and received a grande, when I told the lady she rudely dismissed me and said " well I charged you for a grande" LIKE DO YOUR DAMN JOB PEOPLE. And if you're going to have an attitude then maybe that job ain't for you. LEAVE. Moral of the story: don't come here unless you're up for extreme attitude and rude behavior.

If the drive through didn't take 10 minutes per customer, I wouldn't have the time to get super annoyed enough to write this review. Not sure why there's plenty employees in the building to have the drive through move this slow?? Other then that, friendly staff for the most part. As of now, I've been in the drive through with only 3 cars in front of me for almost 20 minutes. This is ridicules.
I love the way this works. The design os more like the Christmas one it's better than the Tampa version of Starbucks and it's not that bar in the inside. What i like the most is the parking spot.
You could fly to Colombia and pick the beans for your coffee before anyone gets you something here.
They do not have the menu items they post. I asked for Green Tea on two separate visits and they claimed to be out so I guess they don't stock what they post. Avoid.

New Starbucks on Dale Mabry attached to Chipotle. The parking lot is ill-equipped to accommodate both places. The lot is poorly designed and if you're coming from Walnut St, it is a challenge to park since some of the spaces are angled for traffic coming in from Dale Mabry.

The interior is very capacious with high ceiling, plenty of seating (including 8 very comfortable leather chairs), as well as an outdoor patio.  Nicely decorated with a large mural on the main wall and other prints. 

Since it's not really in a popular area and it's newly opened, it is quiet enough at this time to study or work. 

The pumpkin spice latte was all right, not a game changer even though it's now made with real pumpkin. Doubt I would order it again, especially given the price.

One star deducted for the cramped parking lot and not having any toilet paper in men's bathroom. haha

This is generally a great location.  I stop in whenever I'm in the area and its right down the street from my salon.  

My drink is always perfect and the customer service here is great.  The employees are really friendly and relatively speedy for a Starbucks. 

The only downside to this place is that there is only street parking (or a short walk from the city lot) and you'll have to resist rolling your eyes at some of the snooty customers (but that's just Newtown).
I still and will always say Starbucks is overpriced and over rated, but the coffee is still good.  The people that work here care about their jobs and are super nice.
Clean and modern. Staff is very friendly. Thought we'd try this new location and we were not disappointed.
Jordan in the drive thru was amazing and the drinks were awesome! Coming back again for sure! Great customer service!

Located in the Greenwood Park Mall, this Starbucks doesn't have much room to sit and relax, and it's typically pretty busy. It's also one of the messiest Sbux locations behind the counter that I've ever seen. Not dirty.. just messy. 

That being said, everything I've gotten here has been comparable to other locations. Just plan on the place being messy, waiting in line for a couple of minutes, and not sitting around on your iPad relaxing.

I was so excited that they were moving because that would mean adequate parking and an easier in and out. I didn't realize that meant that the fabulous staff at the train station location would be gone. I've gone in several times and each time the staff has either been rude or messed up an order. Unsweetened black tea is not a difficult drink, but they manage to. I'll be going to Exton, which is saying a lot because they're slower than molasses in February.

4 stars for excellence! Minus one only because there isn't a drive thru, however their customer service is great, they only had two people working and yet they made the drinks and prepared/collected our edible items quite rapidly, I was impressed. The area was clean, and they had nice options of cups and coffee for sale. I liked this little Starbucks in the grocery.

Don't let the long lines scare you they move pretty quick here! It's always busy during rush hour so maybe they can use another register? But If you go after 10am and usually noone is there! They re nice n friendly and the place is clean! Plus the free wifi is always a nice perk.

This used to be my favorite Starbucks.  I love the location and it's a very social, lovely place.  However, the past 2 times I have been here, the service has been horrible.  I had to wait forever for a cold drink to be made as most of the Baristas were standing around.  The staff seems to be all new or just completely confused as to how to make the drinks and move the line along.  There was only one person ahead of me and it took nearly 20 minutes to get a cold Passion tea.

Awful customer service. I always get a large strawberry açaí refresher, no ice, no water no strawberries. Just the base. And a large cup of ice. I get this at every other Starbucks and never have a problem. But these ladies were mad at my order, very rude about it and gave me a hard time. They made me pay extra and then complained that I didn't have to pay even MORE than what it adds on the system. There's so many Starbucks that are better than this one. Disappointed I decided to stop at this one though on my way to work.

They can't follow even basic instructions regarding what you'd like. It's like talking to a cat, but when you talk to a cat, you know they don't understand you. These are humans who can't understand words or what they mean.

Quality is consistent with this Starbucks. Their parking situation is rather ruff and I believe that is why only Starbucks has been successful in this plaza. The staff inside was very pleasant and immediately greeted me with a smile. I'd recommend doing a mobile order in most cases but if you can order inside as the layout is nice. 

Ps make sure you have Starbucks rewards it's so worth it!

The employe this afternoon  was very rude and does not deserve to work at Starbucks. I will never come to this location again. That's is so sad as thIs was my new stopping spot but I will go out of my way to have nicer employees help me. I also don't understand how you could be in the middle of the holiday season and not serve pumpkin spice lattes anymore.

Oh my goodness!! I love, love, love this StArbucks!! Always great service and I love all the workers there! Brittany helped me today and was so kind and attentive!! Thanks everyone!! Always a joy to see happy faces!!

Dropped in for a short time to chill and catch up on stuff. The staff, especially Keith, are friendly and bus. This place is in a strip mall, but nice inside. A ton of seating and is this place ever popular with younger and older. It before noon on a Tuesday and there are people doing business, computer time, chatting, reading, and even some knitting time. Awesome that we have places to be where we are welcome to hang out and be with people. The store is clean and love the center area with two leather couches and four leather chairs.

Went to get a iced tea and coffee been here multiple occasions all were we'll very fast at service very friendly if there is a slight or even chance of dissatisfaction they are happy to remake what you need with out making faces or acting as if it is an inconvenient thing for them to do. Never had any issues here yet great place

Meh, parking nightmare. There are better locations but honestly, I'm getting a little tired of Starbucks in general. Anybody tried Dutch Bros? They're awesome. Better customer service (and not because Starbucks customer service is bad, but just because Dutch Bros. is THAT good) and the best rewards program. Starbucks should, at $4 a cup, have a better rewards program for frequent drinkers.

I will say I like the ability to sit in the seating area with a laptop so I can hopefully someday be the target for a piece in The Onion.

I'm sorry, this review sounds so negative. Starbucks isn't bad and this location is not to blame for all of Starbucks' issues. There are just better, less chain-y options out there.

I enjoy dropping in from time to time, after dropping my little one off at school. It is always a hit or miss. Sometimes they're on point and your drink is made perfectly and other times they're just so busy they aren't consistent.

There isn't a lot to say about Starbucks so far as their offerings go, because they're pretty consistent across the chain.  The only thing to comment on then is the service and the actual store.

As for the Dresher store, something changed a couple of months ago and all of the faces I had become accustomed to seeing turned over in a time period of what seemed like overnight.  The new people are efficient and nice, but they're a little less personable than the former employees.  I have not had any issues with the service otherwise -- they've been prompt and accurate with my drink orders.

As for the store itself, it's generally clean and there is ample seating upstairs.  They have a variety of table sizes as well as the over sized armchairs, so sitting there during a lunch break reading or knitting is very inviting.  People seem to "fight" over the outlets as there aren't many available.  

The parking is horrendous.  People make their own spots and park in the handicapped spaces.  I've even seen people drive up on the grass next to the dumpsters.  Some people tend to camp out in their cars there and have phone conversations or check email -- this is not the place for that.  People also don't abide by the "one way" directive, so that makes things worse.  I would say one out of seven times I go there I give up on finding a spot and drive down the road to the Maple Glen location.  The parking situation is what it is -- it's not a deterrent, but it's definitely an inconvenience.

As packed as this location always is, being in the middle of a business district area, they move remarkably well. The service is as fast as it can be but if you have questions they take the time to answer them. They are kept immaculately clean and as busy as they always are there's always a seat to be found If you want to just take a moment and relax

Friendly and down to earth staff provides an excellent in and out or dining OR drive thru experience. They are kind, non-condescending and very nice! Also my barista made my VERY SPECIFIC DRINK, perfectly. I order a venti vanilla sweet cream cold brew iced coffee with no water, 2 pumps of white mocha and a bit extra sweet cream. This is a complicated drink I'm aware. My barista made it perfectly BOTH times as I dined in and went up for a refill. Thank you to the staff here. My experience at this location is always exceptional but today's drink and service blew me away!

found a hair in my muffin, when asked to speak to a manager they made me wait twenty mins and when i went up and asked again a man who was standing right beside the girl I asked in the first place who watched me sit and wait said he was the manager and then proceeded to tell me that basically it ws a mistake and what did i really expect him to do. Awesome place NOT.

Well usually I have a great experience at Starbucks. Not this time. I ordered my Frappuccino on the mobile order. I showed up to pick it up, and 15 minutes later asked where was my drink. They said I'm so sorry I did not print out and she was happy to make it for me. She then finds the cup on the counter and says are you Mike, and I say yes. Apparently the other  gal started making it and got pulled off and had to go do something else and just left it there. Nobody finished it and my cup was just sitting there.

I used the Mobile app to save time, not to stand there for 15 minutes and wait for my drink.
Perfect spot on a cold morning for these travelers! Very friendly crew, and we were there for quite awhile. The Irish cream cold brew they made me couldn't have been better! Nice job, crew.

I ordered an iced decaf americano with vanilla syrup yesterday and was handed a hot regular coffee with heavy cream. We explained that this was not our drink and told the worker what we ordered. She acted frustrated, but went to make our order. She handed us an iced coffee and we drove off... our drink was still not what we ordered.. we received a regular iced coffee with heavy cream. Super disappointing for this 9 month pregnant lady who is limiting caffeine and just wanted one last Starbucks drink before baby comes  Instead I was charged for a drink I didn't receive and left with two drinks I couldn't even enjoy.

I am -not- a Fourbucks fan. This is right down the way from where I work, so they're close and they're usually very good at what they do. I've never had bad service here, and they can run through a line very quickly, so I'm happy with that too.

We are on a Cross-Country road trip (again), and my family loves to make that occasional stop at Starbucks once in a while when it gets late and the driver needs a boost.

Excited to have found a Starbucks that was still open at these late hours as we were entering the unsuspecting town of Reno, we rapidly pulled our van into the lot and rushed to the front door like maniacs.

Not to worry though, we were rapidly tended to by sir Chaz. He seemed a bit busy listening to the drive-through customers on his earpiece, but that did not stop him from welcoming us with a bright smile.

I ordered my usual custom drink. Julia my niece came in behind me wanting something to eat and after much debate, decided upon a simple bagel and cream cheese, and a chai latte. Next came Dante. They asked for two cups of water which Chaz was happy to give us.

This is where the other barista Jessie comes in.  She skilfully made our drinks possibly the most perfect they have ever been on this trip so far.  We needed to use the restroom and were so delighted to see that it was sparkling clean from top to bottom. The entire interior of the whole store was spotless.  Chaz and Jessie were so busy energetically running back and forth maintaining the entire store to the highest standards, that I started to wonder how it was possible that these two could do it all themselves.

I tipped them a dollar for their good service but I should have given them more. My drink did its job and kept me up the rest of the night until I reached my destination. This was a fantastic Starbucks experience to say the least.

More than once I have walked to this Starbucks on an impulse because it is in the same shopping center as Kroger. Who doesn't need a delicious coffee treat after a long grocery trip?? 

This is a big open Starbucks inside with good outdoor seating (though it overlooks a giant parking lot) and no drive thru. They always get out my coffee quickly, and have plenty of parking which is nice compared to some of their other West Nashville locations. I don't typically hang out at this Starbucks; this is more a stop in when I'm on my way home with groceries, but might be tempted by their cozy leather seats next time! :)

I've always enjoyed stopping by this Starbucks. The ladies are always so nice and their customer service is excellent - definitely an extra perk in the morning when I'm still groggy before having my coffee!

The crew at this Starbucks knows how to hustle! I work nearby and visit often. During conventions this location gets slammed and the crew keeps calm as a cucumber and works through the backlog with ease. 

There are lots of regulars that this location and the crew knows them by name and their drink orders. It's so nice to see a friendly face behind the counter.

Also I think they make the best pink drinks and cloud macchiatos of any location I've ever been to. Don't know what they do that is different but they need to teach the other locations a thing or two.

Spacious, well lit, plenty of seating. Good place to get some work/studying done or just pass some time. Doesn't have its own WiFi like most SBs, but you can use the Constitution Center WiFi which worked fine for me.

This is the worst starbucks. Drinks weren't properly made and the baristas were very rude. Mae Laen definitely didn't make the moment right by having drinks properly remade. Didn't follow starbucks policy. Horrible experience don't recommend.

the starbucks employees in the beginning of the summer where really good and fast and where really well at multitasking but now the new people there just made it more they hold up the whole stinkin line. Also not to be mean but the older lady that works at the drive through should be working there because every time she's either holds up the line or gets the order wrong.

My chai frapp tasted like coffee. Once remade they did not make it to order. I ordered 2 extra shots of chai but they were not in there :( I will stick to the awesome Starbucks on Rob. People are way nicer that work there.

I mean it's a Starbucks there are always good, did a noble order and was ready when I got there, not too noisy for a Sunday morning. Nice and friendly employees, maybe a little bus since I love Starbucks.

Wow if I could give ZERO stars I would. ADAM was too busy flirting with his coworkers, he didn't even greet us, he literally took my payment and shoved my drinks in my
Hand so he could continue to flirt with the girls. 

Oh and my drink was wrong.... ‍ SHOCKER

It was decent. That's about all. They seemed to not know how to make an oatmeal or open a new carton of coconut milk. My dying son found nothing on the menu appetizing and soon after leaving had to throw up. Was it the service that made him nauseous? The food? The terminal disease that's eating away at his organs? No one can be sure. One thing I can be sure of though is that I'll be visiting this Starbucks again because the other option is McDonald's coffee and that's doodoo. Pure. Doo. Doo.

I'm a huge SB fan and this is one of my go to locations because it's within walking distance of work BUT it's oh so small with very limited seating and has an even smaller merch selection.

So if you're downtown and looking for a coffee while on foot, this may be the just right SB for you.  But if you're looking for a location to linger at, enjoy on a date, or work from your laptop, this one isn't ideal for longer stays. 

As an aside, this one is connected to the LRT system and you can access it from underground if that floats your boat and you want to avoid mountains of snow or ice :-)

All my drinks have been made correctly here over the years but I do long for a larger location close to my work that's got a more inviting feel to linger longer than just picking up my drink and heading out the door.

Went through the drive thru and the costumer service was awful. Jesus was very rude, he was condescending  towards us just because when we ordered a white mocha with "whipped cream." it wasn't a normal order. Also when we got through the window it took him awhile to get our payment and there was no one in the store, or behind us so there shouldn't have been any reason he should have taken such a long time to give us our drinks we hope for better service and let him know his bad attitude isn't acceptable

Place is dirty. Tables and chairs and floors dirty,  makes you wonder about food and drinks. Bathroom was filthy also. Pretty gross.Will definitely visit a different location (of the hundreds around).

I stopped here for a drink without co-workers on my way to the airport. I was surprised how crowded it was at 10:30 on a Wednesday. 

It was a pretty standard Starbucks. I got an iced chai tea latte and a chorizo breakfast sandwich. This one actually had the low sugar chai mix here which is hard to find now. The breakfast sandwich was pretty good. 

It was so crowded that I think we got the last table there. Even though it was crowded, there wasn't a line to order and we got our drinks fast. 

I would come back again.

It's interesting to read some of the reviews of most any Starbucks.  My experience at any and all of their locations in six states I've received service from is they provide the best of the best in coffee options.  Check out the lines for service and your answer should be they offer a great product.  You have to wait your turn clowns!  Anyone ragging on a Starbucks comes across as a pretentious putz and a classic whiner and someone I would go out of my way to avoid.  Okay, that's it, I'm heading out now for a Extra Hot No Whip Mocha!
Hipster kids in their late teens/early twenties that would rather talk to each other than serve customers and clean up. Shame, it's in a great location.

This Starbucks is located within Temple University's Health Sciences Campus. I have frequented this Starbucks many times in the past and have had a variety of experiences, mostly pleasant. The staff is usually courteous, and the store itself is clean. There aren't many seating options, but most people tend to grab and go, so typically there are seats available if you'd rather sit and stay awhile. During my most recent visit, I just ordered a tall coffee. I tried paying through the app, but their phone scanner wasn't working. They were extremely apologetic and since it was just a coffee, they didn't make me pay. It was very kind of them, and they have excellent customer service. One thing you should know about this location, though, is that you can't take advantage of special offers through your app and they don't accept free drink rewards. You can still collect stars, though! 

I usually have a good experience here, but after a recent visit, I need to update my review. A few friends and I came here for frappuccinos and were all super disappointed with our orders. I got the caramel frappuccino and there was no flavor. It was basically just a cup of blended ice topped with whipped cream with a drizzle of caramel. My other friends also noticed the lack of flavor and terrible quality of their drink orders too. I don't order specialty drinks from Starbucks often (since they're so expensive), so I was extremely disappointed to not get my money's worth. There did seem to be a new employee there I did not recognize, so hopefully that was the only reason. Still, the quality of products shouldn't suffer just because someone is training or new.

I love Starbucks and go pretty often. However, at this specific one I have had a few issues with customer service. Having had a similar job to this before, I realize these things are unacceptable.

My first issue was a while back, but still memorable. I had ordered a medium drink. When my drink was made it wasn't only a small but it was only half full. Not only did I not get what I ordered but it was half empty. There is no way while serving that they didn't realize it was a problem. 

My second issue happened Friday. I had ordered a new drink for me and was excited to try it. However the whole time the woman was making my drink she went on and on about how gross she thought the drink was. I was a little disappointed by hearing that. I loved the drink but didn't love that experience.

I love Starbucks and that won't change even after this happening. However, I do know that is not acceptable service. 
I have had great experience here because it is my closest Starbucks, so this doesn't represent the staff as a whole.

Love this Starbucks! I have an unusual name and they bent over backwards, offering to spell my name correctly and phonetically on my drink. They do a good job with their drinks, and there is so much space inside to study, play games, or have a great convo with a friend (even though it looks small from the outside!)

Went to Starbucks again on Easton Road in Warrington pa. today to see what they have on tap.  I've Been going there for years but to no surprise Pike Place only one on tap any thing else  Pour Over Style. I would Bet they have a Ton of Pike place Beans to the Roof in a Warehouse that they have to use. I think for the price of cup of there coffee there should be a Selection of Coffee on Tap to Try .

It's a Starbucks - you know what you're getting. 

Notable of this location:
- clean
- has good parking
- relatively quiet and good for work. 
- locks on the bathroom doors (not a huge fan...)

Overall, I'll probably be back just because of the convenience.

Best service during a packed Black Friday in the galleria!  The line was outside filled with impatient shoppers needing their fix.  Once you made it inside to order, the employee at the register named "Drew" was oozing with happiness and excitement to take your order and the employee "Cara" passing out the drinks and food was just as happy, cracking jokes, smiling and giggling!  Now that's how you run a business!  I give this location a 5 star!

LSo understaffed, I waited for 15 minutes 1st in line at the counter before I left, my wife who ordered ahead of me was still waiting for her drink. It took another 10 minutes and they got it WRONG. This has been a very big problem since they have opened. Springfield is starting to get just as bad, but Brookhaven is still the worst I have been to. I guess I will need to go to Haverford or Ardmore for good service.

You have NO IDEA just how excited I was when they opened a store right here. PERFECT LOCATION. The drive thru is a bit of a tight squeeze but the service is faster than any other Starbucks I've been to and the service is always fantastic. Easy 5 stars! :-)
if you like adventure, you should go here. The drive thru SUCKS. Just left this dump late for work and without my coffee. Thanks for nothing

So tired of walking into places and people bring their dogs which are obviously not service animals. Why can't people do the right thing? And why can't Starbucks have the nuts to tell people to take their dogs outside?

Very very unprofessional the only Starbucks that I know that want to argue with customers and then ask me after I stood there for twenty minutes are you waiting for something, yes my drink that was made messy with coffee dripping down the side. Then I asked for a kids hot chocolate but because you are incompetent and can't read you made a grande hot chocolate for a little kid. When it request a refund you tell me I need to get at the back of the line of 4 people well not today I won't. I'm going to need to be professional and if you can't stand the heat get out the kitchen.  Starbucks need some competition then maybe they might treat their customers better

Love this location! Easy to stop here for a hot cup in the morning or come in for a quick lunch. The grab-n-go meals are always easily accessible and the hot sandwiches are always heated to perfection. As someone who usually goes to a local coffee spot, I appreciate a good Starbucks visit every once in awhile.
I have no idea what the guys name is but he makes everything brighter when you go thru the drive thru. Shine on Starbucks crew

Very portly managed. Was waiting in line since 3:45 via drive thru and the sign says they closed at 4:00. I was about to place the order by the time it was my turn and it was 4:06 and the barista said "sorry we close at 4:00". There were about 8-10 cars after me on line before 4 and no one from Starbucks with a sign to cut off the line at 4. When I asked the barista that we have been waiting before 4 she said they didn't care. Very rude and poorly managed. She sure angered a lot of people me included who waited 25 minutes.

Today was half-price espresso... I knew that it would be busy so I ordered my caramel Macchiato online. It took me longer to find a parking spot than it did to get my drink. The drive-thru line was wrapped around the store and I had to drive around the store twice to find parking 
so they have excellent service 
I highly recommend ordering off the app.

What an unpleasant visit to this Starbucks! Out of bagels. The outside tables were dirty and clearly had not been  cleaned for a long time. There was a used band aid near one of them also. The restroom was absolutely filthy. NO paper towels to wipe your hands and toilet seat covers strewn all over the floor. The store had 5 employees working but clearly keeping the place clean is not a priority here.
Starbucks  stores vary in quality i know but this is about the worst  i have seen in Tucson.

Ordered a strawberry açaí refresher and received a cup of ice with a splash of refresher. Three swigs and it was gone. Normally I go out of my way to go to this location But I don't know that I will anymore.

This is my favorite spot to post up and do work. Wifi is super reliable and the Crawfordsville store has a ton of space wth a lot of outlets to plug in your computer. Some of the smaller stores have tables but the outlets are hard to come by. As it just opened it is very clean with great natural light! Might be my new landing spot!

I have had nothing but issues with this location lately. When they first opened they had a good group of people working and they've all seemed to disappear. My first issues came in the form of them never having my food order ready when I ordered through the mobile app. And this was consistent every time. They were an hour late to open one day and made me late to work waiting for my mobile order to be prepared and then when they didn't receive an order through the app that I had placed they begrudgingly and slowly made my drink and then when I told the manager this was the second time in two weeks that they had made me late to work he shrugged and said sorry. I reported all these instances to corporate and the last one they acted like I was just complaining and that these things happen, which I agree that they do happen sometimes...but it has turned to every single time I order from this store. I will be going to another location or no Starbucks at all from now on.

Great customer service even though I went at the time they were closing they still did my order. Which I'm very grateful they did it. 

I know I'm sorry I really want it a Pumpkin spice latte. 

Moreover the employees were amazing for taking my order at last minute.

I just recently went to the new starbucks that opened near McCaffreys and I went through the drive thru. I ordered a drink and a panini and as soon as I got to the window, my drink was ready and my panini was out only a few seconds after that. The panini was cooked perfectly and wasn't cold. I hope they can keep up the fast pace unlike the other starbucks in town where you wait 15 minutes to get a grande drink.
The team that works this Starbucks is very energetic and meshes well which results in an upbeat environment with better tasting coffee!

Despite a long line, it moved FAST.  The staff was nicer than average, and they clearly knew their regulars.

No drive thru
Slow employees long line, all the girls seem to work at their own paste  bad customer service, no rush what's so ever

I don't mind the long lines, but Starbucks is known for friendly service and this Starbucks was anything but!  The Starbucks where I live (New York City) are always friendly and helpful.  I would expect more out of a Starbucks in a city that is supposed to be the friendliest.  My order was wrong and the woman (Ecasia) was really rude.  I was shocked. Try a different Starbucks.
Staff is very friendly in the morning but when I come in in the afternoon they are always playing abrasive rap music. Don't really want to hear nwords and fbombs when I get my coffee.
Great staff in a very busy part of town.  Good job SBUX.

I use to love this location, it was convenient for me,  until today!! OFFICIALLY NEVER COMING BACK. I went through drive thru and had a worker named Ana. I had to turn around to go in (which was my problem), and when I came I explained what happened. The two, Ana and a coworker came off very rude. The girl made my drink, and wrong, which I didn't drink after even buying it because I did not trust it. The other girl rung me up etc. and I payed. I still didn't get my change. Ana bring me my bread and drinks and leave it all the way on the other side of the counter and she says here you go(expecting her to hand it over because that's what a normal worker would do) so I wait. She says here you go again and I just grabbed it because I am done at this point. I then grab a straw for my drinks, and I'm getting looks from them. And I walk out the door and hear a very rude voice saying Have a Nice Night... of course from Ana. And then I hear my change being put into the tip jar, which THEY DID NOT DESERVE, even the little amount. I was shocked that she didn't remind me of my change... I would honestly like to see surveillance to be notified that my drink was safe... i am very disappointed and have no plans in making a trip back here, I would rather drive further.
Taylor is a very nice and polite barista. He is always in a good mood and looks you in the eye. Besides that, it is a normal Starbucks with everything you would expect.

Not going to go harsh on this particular Starbucks & I'll give them the benefit of the doubt. I came in around 1:00 p.m. and it seemed like there was only one poor employee doing it all. She managed to move the line along fairly well but I felt bad for her, since she looked so harried. 

Starbucks is clearly able to keep enough people around slamming out over-priced coffee drinks, where this poor soul should not be doing it all. I visited the bathroom, where you need a code and they had run out of t.p. which I brought to the attention of the lonely barista.  To Starbuck's. credit, there was paper in the bathroom later after I came back after my visit to the Salt Cave.

At this 800 State Street Starbucks, there was a big Christmas tree put up, which I stood by admiring. It was a nice holiday touch. Also, I had never seen a two-story caffeine-peddler store, whereby you can go upstairs to rest in peace and look down upon (literally) the other patrons.

I would just advise that the store is staffed properly so that one person behind the counter doesn't have to do it all. Later, I did see two other employees and felt better about things. 
4 YELP STARS.

I was staying at a BNB DIRECTLY behind this Starbucks so Heyyyyyy easy walk to breakfast. The shop was clean, the service was nice and everyone was smiley for a Saturday late morning. 

I ordered my usual: Bacon Gouda (YAY they weren't out!) & a venti very berry refresher. Sandwich was toasty, and the drink was delicious. 

I have no complaints!
Driver thru employees were very pleasant and patient yet fast and efficient even with a full line of cars .

Today I had to sit in an incredibly long drive through line to order my usual drink. No big deal, it's Starbucks, and it's busy... I get it.  When the drink was handed to me I could tell it was wrong but the employee was already speaking on the headset to the next customer so I decided to pull around and go in with my toddler in tow. I had to stand in another line of 7 people. Finally I get to the counter and let them know this is not what I ordered. He said ok. They dumped the original drink and made the new drink in the same cup. No apology was given, no offer of a free bakery item, they didn't even let me keep the screwed up drink. I am baffled by this. The worst part is that the second drink I got was still not right. This is supposed to be a cloud macchiato. I get this drink all the time. I wasted 25 minutes of my time at Starbucks today that should've been 5 minutes, for subpar coffee. Won't be going here any more.

Oh man. I don't normally write reviews for EVERY SINGLE STARBUCKS I go to, but this one was so bad, it warrants a review. While it's super convenient in location, the really young staff could care less about their job. There was one younger gentleman who was basically doing every single thing (running the register, making drinks, etc.) while 2 young teenagers just sat around. The manager needs to seriously review applications for hiring here... :(
Great place to get your day started. Wonderful people to see first thing in the morning

The online hours state 10pm closing.  However, we literally honked at the 2 baristas in the store.  We were completely ignored even when we got off the car and stood at the door.  Not even a gesture to say they were close.  So much for genuine friendly service.

I am very picky on my macchiato. For some reason this location is the only one where it always tastes amazing!  The staff is always so friendly. My office is a couple doors down from here so I stop in regularly to get out of the office and work from there.  I'm sad to hear that they will be closing down and moving to a different location.
Slow service and sloppy staff. No sense of urgency and numerous people standing around doing nothing while many people wait.

There's a 50/50 chance that you will end up with the wrong order going through the drive thru. Take it from someone who goes to Starbucks almost daily, this location is horrible. The drive thru takes FOREVER and then they rush you through just handing you a random drink that's not yours. I've kept track, and they are currently sitting at a 50% accuracy. They under fill every drink and someone's they taste horrible. I avoid this location and only go if I'm shopping near by. Save yourself some trouble and just go to McDonald's down the parking lot and get cheaper coffee that's made correctly. Corporate needs to be on this location NOW. They are starting to lose valuable customers because of the customer service and wait times.

Why does anyone go to Starbucks?  Slow, dirty. The incompetence of the staff oozes throughout the entire store. So many better places close by. If you want long waits, poor service, dirty store, by all means this is your place. Try the Mustache Cafe for the best in SB.

Two and half stars?  I don't thinks so! The quickest the cheeriest place, it's weird to write Starbucks a review but the kids up there work so hard that I couldn't help it.  Most of the time I go drive thru, the line is always so quick if you order something and they don't have it they give you a suggestion of what they have it's a nice touch it's a nice thought. 
When I go inside the same fast and very nice crew...

The place is medium sized in  a middle of the Weiss shopping center,. I never sit inside so I can't share the cleanliness and atmosphere of the place.

This review is expressly for Adam, the night shift supervisor. Without his incredible attentiveness and incomparable customer service, my friend and I would have been stranded in the cold while waiting for a tow truck. Not only was he very accommodating while we waited, he made a mean caramel apple spice drink! 10/10 Goldblums!

This Starbucks seems nestled in the mall as opposed to being near an entrance. Not very crowded when I went (early weeknight).  I had prompt and friendly service. Love the interior design of this location. If you're in the mall I'd recommend.

Not a great experience. Sunday at 930am with an empty store.
Ordered all done egg bites and two drinks. Yes we had special instructions but the person at the register got my daughters right away but had to ask the size of my drink multiple times and low and behold my well done egg bites arrived before either drink. Y drink came out in the wrong size and was rung in wrong so i asked for it to be remade. In the mean time the barista was train g someone new and the drive through window person started making my daughters drink, stopped half way through to take an order then came back and finished her drink. She then went back to the window and took an order. I finally spoke up and asked her about my drink and was told she hadn't had time to remake it yet. Perplexed that the trainer isn't making hot drinks but the window person is in asked for a refund and she began to make my drink then. I asked her to stop making the drink as i had to be some where and I'd like a refund. I told her how i paid and during the refund process i asked why she is the only one dining anything with three other people behind the counter and no customers.
She would not respond or make eye co tact
Staff is so nice all the time even when line is out of the door! I love the refreshers

Rude employees and they always run out of items. If it wasn't for the convenience and time factor, I wouldn't go there at all. If you have time, definitely head over to the Saxby's near polett walk instead.

Very fast and efficient  location! Always get my drink made right here and the staff is friendly and well trained. 

This location  is conveniently located amongst many stores so it's easy to stop in for a great drink. 

The only tiny down side is that this one doesn't have a DT, although  you can  order ahead on the app and skip the line inside so that's always great too :)

Glad to have a well staffed and trained location near me, bc it's important  to have a store that makes your drink right when their are so many customizable options. 


Great Location!!!!

Wanted to try out the new Starbucks within the Safeway in Vail. Have to say that the young man that was behind the counter was very nice. I believe his name was Zeke. There was a little line and when it was my turn he apologized for the wait. I asked him how long he worked here and he said about a month, I was impressed because he was working all by himself and still kept a smile on his face.
After the new renovation the drinks are definitely much better than before. And the new employees are friendly. Keep up the good work.

Probably the poorest run Starbucks ive ever been to here or in Seattle.

There was a line of about 8 customers waiting for their drinks to be prepared. One barista was making the drinks. The other 2 baristasj were "busy' one fiddling with the garbage and the other taking orders and then just standing there watching the world go bye. When  I saw customers who ordered after me receive their drinks  before me i asked what happened to my decaf americano? The harried barista asked the other one and was told "oh i forgot to put the order in"  . No apology from either barista. 

This is poor customer service for sure and absolutely pitiful in a Starbucks where you pay top dollar. Though it was hard to do i did go back in after i finished my drink to tell them how poor their service was. 

Clearly this store needs a competent manager-no one really seemed to know or care what they were doing.
I love my Newtown Starbucks but they have gotten so slow with the overwhelming customers. OPEN ANOTHER STARBUCKS in Newtown....please.

This is pretty much as "good as it gets" for a Fourbucks.
There is a drive through - but the walk-in service is even better with a spacious dining area - and super clean (brand new) facilities.

Excellent service and a full staff during the AM rush.

Plenty of parking.  Yay!!!
This Starbucks is great, fast service and very convenient. I'm a guest here and I appreciate the staff and the manager.
Nice Starbucks and the employees were all very friendly and polite. They remembered my drink after one visit. Definitely gets busy there.

Whoa buddy, as a service professional myself it takes a lot to get me to write a terrible review, but I feel it would be in the best interest of this location to lend some constructive criticism . I have been to this location three times in the last couple weeks between, 1:30 and 4 on varying weekdays and each time I have tried to be patient and left frustrated, this last time without drink in hand. First off, let me start off with saying the DMV has more awareness, sensitivity, and consideration for its patrons time. There is always one person taking orders, one person making a bunch of drinks and two people just kinda standing around bouncing between doing sidework and playing with their phones/ making idle banter with one another. I understand people are trying to go home, but there are paying customers that could be receiving their orders and be on their way much quicker with very little time diverted from their responsibilities. This last time, I went knowing I was rolling the dice, I even budgeted extra time and planned to walk over to Office Depot while my drink was being prepared, because frankly, spending 8 minutes watching a single employee bust ass knocking out a queue of Frappacinos while two other dormant employees just stand there unbothered to pour my Iced Green Tea into a cup gives me anxiety. When I arrived, there was only one person ahead of me, unfortunately this person had seemed to never have been to a Starbucks before, while I admire the employee doing the hospitable thing and  taking his time to answer questions and engage with the guest, this whole interaction lasted atleast 6 minutes as it began before I walked in and still was going on after I decided to walk out, certainly there could have been some sort of attempt by the employee just standing behind the counter rubbing his belly, who noticed my frustration and chose not to care and instead engaged with the conversation that had then became non Starbucks related. I am going to go ahead and assume and hope in all that is good in this world the second register was closed, but a nod of concern would have done wonders. I can see how 6 minutes doesn't seem like a lot of time, but is a really long time to not be acknowledged when you are working in a time constraint and there is more than enough staff to afford the attention. I understand it's a corporate job, and it is not in the job description to be passionate about hospitality, but it is not a nice feeling to stand there knowing the people in charge of my experience do not give a shit, and do not value me, my money, or my time. This happens every time i go in there.They do not deserve your business and most of the people that work there are rude. Go to the one in Glen Mills or maybe not at all!

I guess when this new location opened being helpful or friendly wasn't part of the hiring process. I get it's a customer service job and those aren't the best, but at least try and fake being friendly. Dang. Never going to this location again

I'm going to review this specific one first, because a majority of people know of Starbucks.  So, this one is quit busy before and after work, also for lunch.  There are NO couches, so don't come here to lounge.  It's also a bit of a weirdo magnet.  I was in their one day and this guy came in was waving his hands around in the air pretending he was deaf, but NOT signing anything coherent.  They tried to help him and he just stood at the counter, they finally asked him to leave and he wouldn't.  Then another guy was standing outside spraying himself and the air with windex, while an overweight white guy enters in African garb and a 1980's portable tape deck.  So, come here for the entertainment, come here for a coffee, but don't expect to lounge around like at other Sbux.

What makes Starbucks worthwhile? 1. Consistency and 2. Service.  I'm not picky about my coffee, so I could really go anywhere as long as it's close.  I spent most of my college years (avoiding study time) in a coffee shop before I even heard of Starbucks.  But, what i love is that I know with virtual certainty that if I walk into a Starbucks anywhere in the world, i can get the same drink and they will remake it if I don't like it without hesitation.  Now, we've had our run-ins with Sbux employees, (Willow Grove, New Hope...I'm looking at you.)  But, entering an unknown local place, is hit or miss by a large margin.  Did the guy order enough milk for the day?  Are they using a crappy mix?  Do they even want you there?  You never know, but when you find the place you like it's yours forever (or until Starbucks moves in down the street.)  Starbucks, is definitely expensive.  So, don't feel bad about sending your drink back...but don't be a jerk about it.  We're all staring at you.

TIP: GET A STARBUCKS CARD!  FREE:  2 hours of wifi a day, free beverage with bean purchase and free 'select' syrups and milk.

Huzzah! 

We got another Starbucks on the South Side! 

Thank goodness, because the Irvington location, despite the recent upgrade (which is beautiful and was hugely needed -- yes, yes) is frighteningly overstuffed. 

This location is beautiful and bright. New feel for sure. 

...but it does seem to have what looks to be some sort of fruit fly infestation. 

Anyway...thanks be to the builders -- they had the good sense to point the windows in the direction of the mountains. 

So, on a clear day, you can see a bit of the Rincon Mountains from your seat near the front of the house, which is a wonderful motivation for us students, writers and general creative types who would rather be outside hiking, walking, camping, playing in some water...

...oh, but no! Decided to go for advanced studies, eh? Wanted a Ph.D., eh? Well, no mountains, hills, water and butterflies for you! 

*heavy panting* 

So, yes -- lovely location. 

And ample seating. Literally dozens of seats here. I love the mix, too. In addition to patio seating, you have the community-style table, and also individual tables throughout. There is also bar-style seating. 

This may be my new go-to place to study!
I love Starbucks. Especially the green tea frap and pumpkin spice frap. Just wish it was one closer to me
Never coming here again. This location has only been open a short amount of time and the fact that this was in my drink is not okay. If you want coffee go elsewhere.

Excellent Starbucks, I really enjoy the atmosphere and my drink was made with care and is fantastic. Great place to get work done and have a cup of coffee! The staff was particularly attentive and welcomed me with a smile.

Today I ordered a venti Java chip frap with no chocolate sauce, add a shot, and caramel brûlée pieces. I also ordered an ultimate caramel frap. This is my go to Starbucks. #myfavoritestaff Brett, Julia, Krissy, Mick, Abby and Ronnie. I Never have a issue at this location. Everyone is really super friendly. Over priced and too foo foo.  Haven't been able to find a regular coffee with cream that I care for.   Just don't appreciate the blends there.   Way prefer "brand x" for a cup. Or the local convenience brand


Their black iced tea is good.  Wish there was a fresh lemon slice to squeeze in but Starbucks doesn't offer it.

The staff here is terrific and remember me from the days "across the street" at the old location.  This location is much larger and has a drive though and takes up a large portion of the parking lot - so there is less parking for the stores in the strip mall and Acme.

Media needed this!!!

Least efficient SBux I've ever been to. Drip coffee was old. One of the espresso machines was "down" and it took nearly 15 minutes for 2 lattes. Lots of kids running around, in fact, two children were wrestling.
Cleanest Starbucks I have ever been to. Staff is always friendly and are hard workers. I come here at least 3 times a week to work and have never been dissatisfied.

This store by far is best, not all Starbucks are the same, you can tell people like there job, some store don't take time to make a good drink and sometimes don't put extra shot but this store is a good Starbucks.
Nicest Starbucks in SB. Lots of space, beautiful decor and sight seeing. Beautiful people wall-to-wall
Super unfriendly baristas, two bathrooms but they had one closed and said the other one was employee only.

Hi! I don't normally write reviews but I just had to give a shoutout/credit to these two wonderful and sweet Baristas, Aron and Carmen! Mixed feelings. This opened up as a replacement for the Starbucks that closed across the street. Huge, new and clean as a whistle.   The sad part is the drive-through addition. This Starbucks is located in a brand new Safeway, might just be the largest in grocery story Starbucks I have seen.  Tons of indoor and outdoor seating with free Wifi, so truly worth thinking about this location just like any other Starbucks.

I gotta tell you though why the 4 stars on and not 3.  I went there the other day to get my Grande Quad shot Maple Pecan Latte. Sometimes a little crowded, but very good environment. Staff very friendly and helpful.

This is my favorite Starbucks in the Reno area. My drinks are always great and the wait is usually pretty quick. One long communal table plus two small tables

Great little place!

ETHAN IS THE BEST!!! Every time I order he always puts a smile on my face and is literally the cutest, nicest, most polite employee there!!   HE IS THE BEST!!! #ethanforpresident

Always a nice pleasure to visit this particular Starbucks.

I came to this side of the mall on my way out & ordered my drink, kind of taking a chance bc I have a particular Starbucks that I go to. Skyler made my drink & it was amazing! Super friendly staff! They always help remind me to use my starbucks card so I can get points to earn free drinks to further feed my starbucks addiction haha. I must agree with most reviews posted here! This location doesn't up hold customer service. I hope Starbucks does a better job at hiring their employees. If your an employee here and do not like your job, go do something about it, but do not take it out on customers who pay your wages.

Now, caffeinated beverages at odd hours of the morning might appeal to a limited crowd, but it's a wonderful place to hang out, or even grab a scone.  The staff here is friendly, as it's kind of slow at 3am, and the chief crowd is from the local university stopping by for the myriad of reasons a college student has to want coffee.

The ambiance is like all Starbuckses's, you've seen it before.  This one is a little nicer than most in that the walls are plain colors and no bizarre artwork is looming down at you.  Service is prompt unless it's really busy, and they're always willing to remake a drink for you if the first one was done incorrectly, or even if you merely suspect the first one was done incorrectly.  

Something to say against it.  The bathroom lights are those stupid, automatic ones that turn on when you enter.  More than once, these lights have not come on.

I get starbucks everyday.... friendly staff most of the time quick service

Really disappointed in Starbucks for having people who lie about making the drinks right,

One of the cleanest, organized, friendly and prompt Starbucks I have ever stepped foot in. I was nervous to order in store due to time, but they were really fast. The quality of the food was superb. I ordered the egg sous vide and a toasted white chocolate mocha. It was all very delicious.
This is a great Starbucks! All of the negative reviews don't seem to be recent or even represent the standard experience
Efficient and what you'd expect at a Starbucks. Since this store is in my neighborhood, it'd convenient to order via the app and pick up within a few minutes. Always ready and always on time.

I was never a Starbucks person, but I always was asked to use this location to pick up drinks for coworkers about five years ago and would begrudgingly arrive at the drive thru line to wait for something I was not going to enjoy. And even though my times at this location were not my favorite use of time, I cannot recall a single bad experience. In fact, I can only think of times that they exceeded my expectations. 
  So flash forward to now, I have found myself with a rapidly developing coffee addiction and have been using iced green as a catalyst for a positive attitude. This all began in Boston, where there were several local coffee shops conveniently located near my places of employment and apartment. Since I've been back I have found a huge disparity in places that have prepared green tea, so I find myself, again returning to this same location on the way to work. 
  I've always been happy with my experiences, but it wasn't until I realized not all Starbucks are created equal, that I realized how impressive this location is. I don't know if they scout out the best employees from other Starbucks, the management is just top tier, or what, but this location is a well oiled machine. If I pull up and the drive through line is wrapped around the building, I know I'm still going to get exactly what I ordered, in a timely fashion, handed to me by an employee who values my business. I am impressed by and admire the staff here and want them to know that I appreciate their dedication.

The best Starbucks in the Lou hands down! Makayla and Liz are awesome, with great customer service skills! 

P.s if either of you see this, it's the everything bagel girl

This store is just about the same as any other Starbucks however they have an outdoor fireplace in the outdoor seating area. This is a plus!

The girl who took my order was pleasant and quick filling my order. 

I give this location 3 stars because of what I mentioned above but I would have given it only 2 stars because the bathroom was just nasty. Besides being filthy there were no more paper towels to dry your hands with. I guess the male employees didn't notice. I guess I will be back again sometime I just tend to judge "food" places by their bathroom's cleanliness and the staffs attitudes and the quality and taste of the food. 

So in conclusion, the staff was nice and competent, my coffee was what I expected and the cleanliness was well below par. I suppose 2 out of 3 is not bad but still not good enough. 

The thing is Starbucks is not my favorite coffee as they always over roast the beans making the coffee bitter. Only went as someone had given me a gift card so it was free. If I were paying for my coffee I would probably just go to McDonalds.

Good friendly service from friendly and efficient baristas. Don't want to sound non pc but all outdoor tables were taken by homeless many without a drink. Seems management could help a bit. Love the upstairs area.

I'm not entirely sure why this Starbucks has such a low rating? I have go through the drive thru several times and they have done a fine job and the coffee is on par with other Starbucks. They are seemingly following COVID guidelines well too.

Waited 20 minutes AFTER I placed my order for my coffee.  The computer never sent my order to the barista. Had to leave without getting my coffee at all. Was not reimbursed for my coffee. I'd really like Starbucks customer service to contact me about this.

The employees are nice enough but this is by far the slooooowest Starbucks I have ever visited. I actually left before my mobile order was ready the other day because the 3-6 minute prep time wasn't ready 17 minutes later and had to be to work. (I was 20 minutes late to work waiting for the drink I never got.) I get they're busy but there is zero sense of urgency from any of the staff. If you choose to ask why you haven't received a drink after 20 minutes(I wish I was exaggerating), they mean mug and treat you like you're inconveniencing them. I can't say they are all like this but it's a pretty consistent feeling. I come inside sometimes because it's a "shorter" line and even the people inside waiting are complaining about the time. It's a real buzz kill . Coffee is always good but it's also good at other locations that take 10 minutes.. Hoping they step it up just a few minutes.

As far as Starbucks go, this one is pretty great and pretty typical. They always get my drink quickly for me and the staff is really nice. Even when there is a long drive through line, it moves really quickly.

It is likely you will not be able to sit anywhere in a group. They do have window seating. This is usually where I sit when I come here to study and do homework. I like this spot because it is the perfect height to stand up and work! I would also suggest wearing a sweater or some layers because I am always chilly here. 

As always, I suggest getting a "for here mug" to make your Starbucks experience more cozy!

Customer service is slacking - especially if you order inside the store (They are all busy dealing with the drive thru).  You need better counter people - some of the old crew has left and you can tell.

Step it up, Media, Starbucks.  We need you!

Whenever I order no foam it gets handed to me with about an inch of foam on top which I end up scooping off with a napkin so I pay $4-5 for a half full drink. They also have about a million people working but the wait time is 15-25 mins. I was a Starbucks barista for 10 years and they need a full reset over there

Great coffee Jose, Carlos, and Ruben are the best.
Though it is located in a BAD area I recommend.
It is located inside of a Fry's store at 555 east grant next door to dollar tree. Beware upon arrival you will be greeted by pan-handlers and hobos. Luckily they have security on certain days of the week to keep the rift raft out.
Good Danish. Fresh, buttery and soft. But $4.00 for a medium iced chai tea latte? Really! And it wasn't even that good. Ummm half bucks wasted here.

This Starbucks is the best of the three locations that are within a few minutes apart.

Interior is roomier, there are more seating options, and the staff always seems to be in a good mood. 

They even have a "bar" area where you can watch all the action behind the counter. Also there is a outdoor area,,,

I frequent this Bux location at least three times a week, usually by means of the drive thru. I've gotta say: FANTASTIC service and friendliest cashiers. I highly recommend it if in the Carmel or Zionsville area! :)

Was very disappointed in my drinks. I ordered a hot choc and a latte and after walking back to our tent at third Friday realized that both drinks were not filled to the top and both weren't even hot. Live in Speedway, and been looking for a closer location to use laptop publicly, so Im happy for this location. Employees are nice and friendly!!!

i love this starbucks! i come here like 4/5 times a week and have yet to be disappointed! the people are super nice. i left my purse there on accident once and when i came to get it, they had it locked up for me and said it might take a couple minutes. then he asked me if i wanted a water for while i was waiting! super nice! definitely recommend the cascara cold brew if you're wanting something thats REAL coffee!

I almost always have a problem at this location, the employees never get my order right, and when I tell them about it they make you feel like YOU'RE the wrong one :/ I will say, the lines are always short, and it's in such a convenient location for me, I just wish the employees were a little friendlier and had better customer service. Yeah Jeremy, Chris, Vanessa, and the rest of the crew are the best in All of Tucson and I'm not just making it up. It's the best place to go to get your Starbucks. I hope their boss see's this because they deserve a raise. They are very special people. If I had a business I'd hire them on the spot!
Love this place.  Great service.  Quality made to order drinks and nice selection of food options!

The employees at this location are a disgrace to the Starbucks brand. I've been to countless Starbucks locations and the employees are ANGELS. Nope not at this one. In addition to all of this wonderful stuff, the prices are significantly higher than other locations? Not sure if the cashier charged me wrong but this was an awful experience. Won't be coming back to this specific location.

I got on today, JUST so I could write a review. Today was my first visit to this location & I will definitely return. The ladies working this morning were incredibly pleasant and treated me just as well as the regulars around me, whose names and orders they knew already. I was absolutely impressed and want to praise them for their outstanding service.
I just want to say thank you to the gentleman working the drive through today at 1:51 on 1/21/2019. Small gestures go a long way. YOU ARE A BADASS SIR!

I still love this Starbucks but wish they would wipe off the counter more frequently where they place the finished drinks. Lately, it has been a mess and I always have to wipe off the bottom of my cup.
Terrible service. 15 minute wait after placing an order. Plenty of people to help, but they were sweeping the floor at 9am.
Always seems understaffed. I was overcharged because the cashier was too frustrated to change the mistakes she made.

This morning it was the Worst service I have ever received at a Starbucks.  

1. Cashier walked away while I was in line when my turn came up.

2. After I waited and the person behind me started to receive help the cashier came back and without apologizing told me to wait for the cashier that was helping the guy behind me.

3. I picked up my "for here" order (in a bag)

4. Told guy handing out order my butter was missing.  Instead of getting me my butter he told me to go back to wait for the cashier to get it for me.

Very disappointed, won't be back.

Just went there, long line and only 3 servers, the 4th was doing stock
Customers were leaving because of the poor service
So unusual for Starbucks
Wouldn't recommend this store
Great location and staff. Very friendly and great memories too. They work quickly and pleasant. Cheers

This was the first time I had been to this location an since we were kinda in a hurry we went through the drive thru, after pulling up to the menu right away I noticed they do not have any type of markings about their specialty drinks like they do inside, so it's a ill hard to order when about 25% of the menu that's inside isn't in the menu outside. But over all when ordering I wasn't sure what I wanted since I like trying things outside of my comfort zone. But we heard "is that all" for the 3rd time when I was like never mind an got a regular coffee. Then drove off.

Not all Starbucks are equal!  This one by far, in my opinion, is the best in the valley and all Starbucks that I have gone to in my travels with my husband.  The Pike Place market coffee is rich with flavor and just the right strength.  The people that work here are nice and what can I say... I love this place.

Veterans Day coffee! I love Starbucks! The only downside of any Starbucks is that they don't give you enough room to put your creamer or sugar is on top. I guess that really isn't a bad thing.  Seasonal flavors are now out. I opted to try the new vanilla blonde coffee. It has a phenomenal taste.  It really isn't that strong and it's perfect with just a little bit of creamer in it. I'm so happy I stopped.

Much like it's counterparts in the Silver Legacy and El Dorado, this Starbucks sells the exact same drinks you would get at any stand-alone location but inflates the price due to its, "convenience", of being in your hotel. I get it, but at the same time, Starbucks is already overly inflated so the addition of this kinda adds to the sting.

Unlike its counterparts, however, I've always found the customer service at this one to be particularly good and in line with most of the stand-alone locations. The other two casino locations I mentioned above are hit and miss. This one always gets the service and quality just right.

A year ago I walked into this Starbucks with my 1 year old.  The barista and I chatted a bit about my daughter while I was ordering and when I was about to pay she told me that she was going to cover my drink that day.  It was such a sweet act of kindness and made my day, which had been a bit stressful a whole lot better.  It made a big impression on me because I still remember it a year later!  I'm sure working in costumer service is very hard, and I really appreciate the kindness!

I really love this Starbucks location!! I don't live near it but it's on my way to school and I always choose to stop at this one. Everyone is always so friendly and are willing to work with complicated drink orders which I know can be frustrating! All in all great location and friendly staff!
I'm not sure who Starbucks thinks they are because their coffee is not any better than the next guy and they are pricing themselves way out of the market

This is my daily go to coffee spot, the staff are friendly and fast. Every Starbucks is basically the same, this one is no worse than any other. Except the location is ideal for me and the many downtown office workers. 

The bathroom can only be opened by asking at the cash register, this is due to the central downtown location.

Don't usually drink this stuff but they have wine and beer too.  We got a glass of red wine. 

I am only giving 4 stars service was great.  Staff was super friendly but the wine was bad.  I guess I shouldn't get wine from a coffee sho

Always way too busy!  Always friendly!  Clean!  However today I found a table easily (one table was available) so I had peace and joy!  

All the rest it good. 

They do not like adding half and half when ordering, they prefer you add your own. Not pleased with that. Otherwise, there you have it. Another Starbucks!.

Bad experience, iced tea latte was so watery from very first sip. Mobile order took 15 minutes, felt bad getting my order in front of people who were clearly waiting longer. Yes it was busy for an afternoon I guess, but the drinks were coming out of order, mobile orders arriving for people not even in the store yet. They need a better system. Can't believe I wasted my free drink here. Yes nice store and good location but if drinks are bad why come back?
I visit this location often as my go-to for homework. Consistently Top Tier, from all drinks & food served, the great team & welcoming atmosphere. Thank you

Not sure what's going on at this Starbucks. Maybe they're numb from dealing with tourists. I knew they were busy so I mobile-ordered my cold brew coffee. The app said 1-4 minutes. I got there and there was a line that grew as I sat and waited. Everyone got there drinks and more people arrived. They got their drinks. I checked for my drink. No. More people arrived and they got their drinks. Finally after 15 minutes (i looked on my app for the order time) I asked the "barista" if the was a mobile order for "Richard". She looked at the cup sitting atop the espresso machine, curtly replied "yes." and turned away. I waited a couple more minutes and left. Someone else could have my coffee. A simple "oops, sorry" could have turned the situation. Apparently to much effort. After seeing the other reviews, I realized it was less an employee problem and more a manager one...
I had the best customer service experience thanks to Genna! She was very kind and just super helpful. This girl definitely deserves a promotion.

I still miss the tiny Starbucks right next to the Paoli Train station, but this venue is far roomier. I've only been here a handful of times, but I've never had any issues with my order. They're just a little slow making the order, but everyone I've interacted with have been friendly and warm. 

I like the atmosphere in this Starbucks as it's far more laid back than some of the others I've visited. The decor reminds me of a ski lodge with industrial accents. At first glance it looks clean, but each time I've been here, the floors definitely needed to be cleaned better. Bathrooms are nice as they are single stalls with secure locks, but they are separated by gender. The women's bathroom tends to be occupied more often than not, so I am guilty of using the men's room in times of dire need. Would be nice if they were just straight up gender neutral. All in all, it's comfortable place to take a caffeine break.

This is the most terrible Starbucks location I've ever been to, and I've been to about 150 of them. I had to wait five minutes before an employee asked for my order. By that time, I decided to leave the Starbucks and not place an order because they made me wait five minutes before even acknowledging me behind the counter. I am mind blown and shocked. When I asked to speak with a manager, the employee simply replied that the manager Melanie is currently not here right now, and there are no other managers to speak with. This place is extremely disorganized. I am highly disappointed and will never be coming back.

I love the fact that this Starbucks is close by my school and they have a drive thru but this is the second time I've received the wrong order! If you are in a hurry I would not advise you to go here early in the morning looking for great service. Overall the drink was tasty but the sandwich I was given was completely horrible!!!!

Went in the day after Christmas, and I know this is a heavy business day for retail. I was hoping it wouldn't be too busy at 10:30 am, but hoo boy it was packed. Waited about 5 min to order, got my order in and took a seat. As I'm people watching, I see everyone waiting getting visibly irritated and impatient. To be quite fair, the lady making the coffee was goin as fast as she could, and it made me feel for her. Another barista asked if she wanted some help, and she shooed her away. My whole wait was about 20 min, but i can't complain because it was a heavy traffic day. The staff was friendly, and as fast and efficient as they could be.

Did a phone order for a cafe latte and a hot tea- said 6-10 minutes. It took 5 minutes and order was correct.
Not sure why others complain.
It's way easier to do online order and pick it up than wait in a car line.

The customer service is always superb. However, they are always out of something when I go there. It's beyond frustrating. It's not the employees fault, but it drives me insane because I drive out of my way to go to this Starbucks and then to hear they are out of the drink I want... it's disappointing. Theres also always a huge line at the drive thru. And it's annoying to navigate because you must drive around in a circle to get to the drive thru.  Then it always moves very slowly. Sorry but i prefer the Brookhaven Starbucks!

This is the worst Starbucks I have ever went to in my life, and I would know because I go at least 6 times a week to multiple ones around where I live. I went through the drive through and ordered a pink drink with light ice... they gave me my drink with ice all the way from top to bottom. Also in my drink they put too much coconut milk and not enough strawberry flavoring. The employee was also very forgetful and gave me a Frappuccino lid on my iced drink that doesn't have whipped cream also forgot my straw. Worst of all...THEY FORGOT TO EVEN GIVE ME MY DRINK!

I honestly don't know how long these baristas have been working here let alone being an actual certified barista but it's just amazing how much they don't know about the drinks. I came in this weekend and got an iced matcha green tea latte with light ice and no foam and when I was handed my drink I was given a white drink with the matcha powder stuck at the  bottom and I asked to have my drink shaken and he told me that I had to ask for it to be shaken because it doesn't come that way. I told him that I was a Starbucks barista and that they come shaken so that the powder is mixed into the drink. Long story short he again handed me a drink that was 95% milk because he just dumped the previous drink into the shaker and so then it was just over shaken milk with extra foam and extra ice. Overall extremely disappointed with the service and the quality of my drinks I bought. And this isn't the first time I've had terrible service here. No more second chances for this store.

I tried this location for 4 times by placing mobile orders. They are SO SLOW in preparing my drinks EVERY SINGLE TIME!!! I had to wait in additional 10 mins after arriving. If you are in a hurry, I strongly recommend to AVOID this location.
Best customer service I have ever received. Your energy in the mornings can really change someone's day around.  Thank you all for making my morning!

Decided to go to this location this morning not a good way to start my day. Nate wasn't very friendly but rather sassy. Instead of asking someone else he says ,well this is what is coming up and completely disregarding my comment and charged my card. Not quite the way to start off my weekend . I will try and avoid this location with that.
Extremely slow in the mornings especially on a Sunday morning. If your looking for quick service and friendly customer service, this is not the Starbucks you should go to!

Caetlin was so kind!!! Stopped in before work they were out of some milk substitutes but she was so sweet about
It and honestly made my night with her kindness!!!

Meh...it's a Starbucks. What can I say. It's close to home but I've only been once and honestly I would rather drive 5 miles down Campbell and get some seriously bomb coffee.

I swore off corporate coffee a couple of years ago and every now and then I end up having to come for one reason or another. I ordered a Dirty Chai and it was horrible. Tasteless honestly. I could barely taste the Chai and there was no spice at all. It was probably the blandest tasting Dirty Chai I've ever had.

That's really all I have. No love loss here Starbuck's

Last week I stopped by this location Starbucks (I have the member card/apps) and saw there was a line up of people waiting in front of me for the one cashier.
