While I was waiting in line I thought to go to the washroom first but found the door locked and asked the cashier, a large heavyset guy who didn't seemed too happy with his job; he ignored my repeated requests to open the door but then told me (customer) NO and that I had to buy first before he'd unlock the door of the washroom! ???!!! and that I had to get back in line!!! But there were several people in the line ahead of me. That mean I had to wait longer at least several more minutes!!! The line was moving too slow! After a while I told him I'd report and left.  Unbelievable!
This particular location staff is very unfriendly and rude.  No greeting and smile at all compared to other Starbucks location. 
I never had problem with other locations at Whyte Ave, City Centre and Northgate their staff were polite, smiling and friendly; they'd happily unlock door first for their customers' need when asked but not this particular Starbucks at 100 St/Jasper Ave location.  Terrible customer service.  
Avoid at all costs!!!
This Starbucks is over priced and gets very crowded. They also don't let you use your Starbucks reward stars .

I would visit the old location at least twice a week. The staff there was great! They were friendly and always helpful. Most of the drinks I ordered were made perfect. However, I have had quite a different experience at their new location. I often feel like I am bothering the staff when I place an order (even if it is a simple as straight coffee). Most seldom smile and as mentioned in previous post, they mock customers or other employees. I have had positive visits with a couple employees that still work there from their old location. 

   Not a go to place anymore. It's worth the drive to Main Street Lansdale location where the staff there has always been great!

Being in nashville over the years starbucks locations are everywhere and the emolyees are always so amazing. But the hospitality that i experience when im at this particular starbucks makes me drive that extra couple minutes just to say good morning and catch up!  From Caetlin, Spencer, Kylie, Blair, or anyone else they are a phenomenal team!  Seeing themlaughing and interacting not only with themselves but with other guests!  

Its a game changer when your not in the spirit to do homework  but their attitudes make the time spent here so enjoyable!  Thank you all for being so sweet and kind always!  

From your  tired Hi-Fi Clydes bartender! 

Go visit them!

The employees here rock!  They are always sweet, kind, and offer a big greeting when you enter. But the store itself is just getting filthy. Surfaces, windows, floors, furniture...this place needs serious attention.

Really charming location.
Love the outdoor seating area and people watching in West Park Village.

My drinks have been as expected.
Mainly the outdoor seating and area is the draw for me.

This is the second time I have been to this Starbucks and ordered a Vanilla Cream Cold Brew which tastes like it has no vanilla at all. This is always my go to drink in the morning and have never had issues when ordering it anywhere else.

Convenient location and friendly service. I stop often and my pick up / drive thru orders are always correct.  Today I purchased a gift card in the drive thru and was helped by Juan. He brought several gift card options to the window and completed the order efficiently.  Thank you Juan for another great experience.

They are all very rude and not nice i've never had a good experience ever going into here.
They also look like they are hating life.

Very disappointing service at this location, the barista beyond uninterested in doing her job. She came off very insulted when I asked for something to wipe off my cup because she had spilled a large amount down the side, directing me to go get some napkins.
I still had a nitro cold brew coming, and she trashed this drink. I didn't realize how bad it was until I began driving away to go to work. I tossed it in the garbage.
Slowwwwwww.... This Starbucks used to be a quick trip. Now, it's a training ground for new employees.

I am always hesitant to write reviews for chain stores like Starbucks.  There isn't anyone coming to a Starbucks who is checking a Yelp review first.  Almost always, folks are headed to Starbucks because they need their legal fix of caffeine and know that Starbucks is a international consistent supplier.   

This Starbucks is no exception.  The staff is fantastic, I have always had great service here, and well made drinks.  I am a big fan of how Starbucks treats its staff (and have been for a very long time, they have treated several of my friends very well and earned my loyalty a long time ago).  It is nice to arrive in a shop and feel welcomed and like the staff are happy to see you. 

But, the layout of this Starbucks leaves something to be desired.  I like Starbucks as a workspace.  It is usually a great place to zone out and focus on my task at hand and still be around people.  All of the Starbucks around here seem to be moving towards a shared workspace model, with one large table with several chairs.  This encourages co-working at the table, and leaves more room for lounge chairs so people can be social.  There is a lack of open space, so they can't easily add more tables if they wanted to - so I guess they have done the best they can with with what they have to work.  It is a free standing store and can't really expand any further- it also has a drive through. 

I visited this Starbucks today because the Starbucks by campus on Central has remodeled and significantly reduced the aviable space.  They have added a co-working table there too.  At least this one still has more space for people to lounge and be social.  Central seems to have forced everything to take place at the co-working table. 

It is probably a choice from corporate Starbucks to reduce people loitering in their shops (which started before the recent troubles over race and kicking people out up north). 

Helpful tip- get a Starbucks card or app.  It is a pre-paid card and lets you discounts and free drinks.  If you are planning to loiter it is a great deal - because it makes the normally $.50 refills on ice coffee or tea free.
New location is nicer, staff is friendly but it literally took more than 10 minutes to get my iced coffee and there were very few people here.

Drinks amazing. Most of the employees super amazing and sweet. But don't forget to order anything at the screen, or you'll get attitude from someone who wasn't even running the drive thru, about how to order. Like yeah, I'm the only person in America who doesn't know how to order at Starbucks. I forgot to add on a SCONE.
Friendly baristas, quick service and plenty of seating. Nice spot to recharge with your favorite caffeinated beverage and a quick bite.
Plenty of space and friendly staff. Designed for the road warrior. Thank you Starbucks.
I have given the staff multiple chances thinking that it is just an off day. I was wrong. These people are truly that unfriendly. I will never go back. They totally ruin your day.

You would think that this Starbucks would be awesome because they are usually busy, have great local and tourist customers, and there are several other locations in a 3 block radius. WRONG. This Starbucks is THE worst Starbucks I have EVER been to. I have worked on State Street for years and every time I give them a chance, they always let me down. I used to only drink Starbucks coffee, but this location has made me learn to love Coffee Bean, which is right across the street. 
Here are the worst parts of the service they provide (all of these things happen 90% of the time, no joke):
1. They act like taking your order is a nuisance. They roll their eyes and sigh if you take longer than 2 seconds to order.
2. They take FOREVER to make your order. I'm not talking 3, 5, or 7 minutes. They literally take 20 mins to make you a drink. It is because they don't care. I really think they hate making coffee here. i have seen them, with a super long line, have 2 people taking orders, 1 person doing nothing, and 1 person making all drinks. They do not care if you have somewhere to be, if you are on a break, if they are busy, or anything else about your life. They move only at 1 speed: DGAF.
3. The reason I write my review: Today, I went to get a coffee on my break. I was too lazy to walk the few extra feet to a different Starbucks or CBTL. I always regret when I do this. I gave my order and endured the normal attitude and eye rolling that is expected. I waited for the baristas to continue their personal conversations with their friends seated at the bar. When my 10 minute iced coffee was finally ready, the girl did not even break eye contact, let alone talking, set my coffee out and THREW my straw at me. THREW it. like tossed it so that it fell to the edge of the table. She didn't say my name. She didn't say my order. The signal to grab my drink wasn't a smile or eye contact. It was a thrown straw.
I left disgusted that I just paid $3.95 to be insulted!! I know that it's just coffee, but this day in age, when times are "tough", the one luxury we all have is to spend our money where we choose. When something is so prevalent and there are so many options, stores should not rest on the fact that people "need" what they have. Because the truth is, we don't. I gave this Starbucks 3 years and probably close to 100 visits to earn my business and today it was literally a straw that broke the camel's back. 
DON"T GO HERE.

4 stars for the location, cleanliness, and service-

One of my favorite Starbucks for sure. Yeh, not a lot of parking right next to the store but it is a standalone building in a shopping mall parking lot so there is parking available. The store is usually busy especially the drive through but the lines move fairly quickly. I've always had good service at this location and the restrooms are maintained well. Also, a rarity is the cleanliness of the self-service bar. It's not only clean but it's usually orderly as well. That's a difficult accomplishment with how busy this place can be so they obviously pay attention to the details. Typical Starbucks trinkets and sweets for purchase.
Friendly service at Starbucks. Service was a little bit slow but it was morning and you expect a wait. I like the blonde coffee because I like lighter coffee. I appreciate that they give an option.

I go to this Starbucks on my way to work because its the most convenient...but they upset me a times i think I wasted a total of $100.00  just going there and giving them repeated chances theres only one guy there that knows how to make the drinks hes the best but when he isn't there everyone else knows nothing. I just sick and tired of the crappy service from the baristas at this location.  I'll  just have to start going to the york road location more evern tho its out of my way.

This Starbucks is a hit or miss! I have gone  there every day for the past 8 years! Sometimes the coffee is good. Sometimes awful! The lines are ridiculous! Weekends I go to Hendersonville as you may as well park at this one! The people there are very friendly but they get my coffee wrong at least 4 days out of 7! If this continues I will start making y on coffee at home!
Clean. Quiet. Haven't failed to find a seat. And quick to fix any mistakes! I go here once a week or so for an hour or 2 of relaxing!

Starbucks has been great through COVID. They've remained open with their drive thru and employees have been wearing gloves and masks. We love coming here for our tea and fraps. They were out of the mango flavoring for my mango green tea drink so the barista recommended making the Guava tea which typically comes with white tea with green tea and OMG I found myself a wonderful refreshing new drink!! Even my daughter who is not a green tea fan loves this drink. I highly recommend trying the Guava Green Tea with 2 pumps!! You won't be disappointed.
It's a great little Starbucks in the store so you can get coffee while you're shopping. I would not try sit here and write a research paper though because once again it's in the middle of a Fry's.

Absolutely awful. Messes up my order every time I go there (especially mobile orders). I try to stay away from this particular starbucks because of their poor customer service, however they're in a convenient place which is sometimes easier than driving all the way to SR 56 and Bruce B Downs. I have a dairy intolerance and every time I have ordered coffee they have had to remake it because they ignore my requests for milk substitutes. They always seem to have new staff who are grossly untrained and somehow get upset with me when I try to correct my order.

The barista named Alondra was making whipped cream. The whipped cream in my drink was truly a piece of artwork. Great consistency, great appearance, great quality. 17/10 would recommend! Never knew whipped cream would create such a great experience for me!

I really like this Starbucks, which is great because I'm a freelancer who lives in the neighborhood. There are plenty of comfortable places to telecommute in Tower Grove, but I usually wind up here. Thanks Grand & Sidney Starbucks staff; may the blessings of Starbucks MegaCorppucino™ rain upon your good heads. s/o to the barista who comped my frap for having to wait a few minutes; you made my day today

Yeah, so I bet Seattle is thrilled to hear we all equate a Starbucks with their fine, rainy city.  With Xoconocho two doors down, and the Listening Room across the street, I'm not sure how this Starbucks gets any business.  Even Merridee's down the street offers free wi-fi.  

Enough ranting.  The coffee here is identical to all the other Starbuck's coffee I have ever tried. If it were not for the urge of people to give me Starbucks gift cards and holidays and birthdays, I would not be here.

This Starbucks always gets my order right. 
Whenever I go in to any Starbucks, I order 'sugar free iced caramel macchiato with almond milk, no drizzle'. 
Every other Starbucks serves it to me hot first and has to remake it iced, or they forget almond milk, or they add drizzle. Clearly I've made it into a skinny drink. 
Today the barista was working alone on cash and making drinks and he got it right and he was friendly, a teenager. 
Always clean. 
Always polite. 
Thanks Jasper Ave Starbucks

Can't even believe the horrible service we just had.  My daughter ordered a drink. No other customers in line ahead of us. As we stood for 6 minutes waiting all 4 girls stood there talking about stuff and not one of them made our drink. The one girl was alone making drinks for the drive thru alone while these girls talked and did nothing! .   One sat down then got up and finally made my daughters drink and it wasn't even made right we had to tell them it was wrong and have them fix it.  She even while talking and making her drink threw the empty container across the room to the trash can which it missed and fell to the ground.  Then she proceeded to throw the top from it across to the trash which missed too! Unreal.  Glad I wasn't a manager there seeing that.  Very unprofessional.

Wow! Totally totally totally unexpected. So here's the deal. I really hate having to go into a casino, a bank, a grocery store... Or whatever to have to get my Starbucks. I find the coffee is always different The people are always weird and rude... They are definitely not drinking the Starbucks Kool-Aid, if you know what I mean. 

Because it's a casino... You don't have the luxury of parking in the general parking lot and just popping in. You have to either Vallet Park, which I totally suggest, because the location of the kiosk is right on the other side of the vallet doors, we're parked in the general parking lot or parking garage... And make your track all the way across the casino.

I popped in about 1115 on a Tuesday afternoon to grab my midmorning caffeine fix. The very first thing I saw was an extremely clean location! The food cases, the counters, the merchandise shelving, the merchandise itself, even the space that you get to put all of your goodies in your coffee with! That was even clean!!! I mean how many times can you say you've been to a Starbucks ever! Had all of these things be clean and organized? It's very rare.

Anyway I ordered a Venti Americano and a feta spinach wrap. I like to have my spinach wrap cook twice because it's nice and crunchy. Sometimes the cashier doesn't like that. However the gal that took my order was super happy to do it twice, she even had a nice smile on her face and said no problem! I love that. 

Because this location is inside of a casino, they don't have the same system when you're using your Starbucks gold card. So the cashier had to type in some numbers through the credit card machine to process my order. It took a little longer than a normal Starbucks location, for this process,  and you have to signed a credit receipt... So that's a little different than a normal Starbucks standalone location. However she did a great job to take my order processed my payment and get me and out of there in no time.

Cayden ... my barista, had my Americano done in literally 2.5 seconds. He's my new favorite Starbucks ninja barista!!! He even noticed at the top of my coffee lid had a crack in it, so without me having to say anything he replaced it. I can say from experience, as probably some of you guys could to you... That doesn't always happen, and then you get 10 miles away and coffee gets all over you! Not a pleasant experience.   Cayden had a great smile on his face and had a nice disposition about him.

The only reason I gave four stars is because this is literally a crossed from an open bar where people can smoke. This location is like enough to also be right next to the valet doors, so it didn't smell too much like smoke in there. Which was a seriously big relief! The last thing I want to do is smell like smoke, you know?

I have to tell you guys! I literally was going to drive 8 minutes out of my way, to go to the next closest location, but I'm so glad I didn't. The coffee and the food we're just perfect! I will definitely remember this and be back.

Vandy RN went to Starbucks at 9:30pm 2/10/18 and ordered a Frappuccino and a chicken bacon panini. It took not only 15 minutes in the drive thru and I was the only customer but when I got to work and opened the bag this is what I received for a $7.00 sandwich! This was my only food for my night shift and couldn't go back due to timing which caused me to not eat dinner. Truly sad! Thanks Starbucks!

The service is poor.  They were messing up drinks left and right, including mine.  I realized it wasn't right, I realized there was a small line at the pick-up end of the counter.  There were two others in front of me waiting to get their drinks fixed.  It feels like the drive-thru gets the priority here.

It seems like everybody working there had on a head-set, so when I tried to address the drink-mess-up with the barista, I got the blank stare that says "I'm not listening," because I assume the head-set was talking.

This place has a great location, so I guess it survives in spite of itself...

What's up with the AM lines here lately? Over the last 2 or 3 weeks there have often been no less than 12-15 people waiting to order each time I've stopped in. I've actually had to walk out a number of times. 

As much as I love a good cup of coffee, I can't be wasting 20 minutes of my morning on line at Starbucks. Hire more staff!
They never get my order correct.  The one guy working in the morning is a jerk.  After today, I'm never going back.

This is the best Starbucks closest to me, unfortunately. My drinks are always consistent but when I pull up to the drive thru, which is quite often to pick up my mobile order, i cringe when the older gentlemen answers the drive thru order. Today I receive my third lecture from him on how to properly order my drinks on the mobile. Today's lecture was longer than normal because apparently there was a situation with order prior. So I had to YET AGAIN wait for my coffee and be lectured by this man! I thought I left my father in Ohio, clearly not!! 

NOTE TO ALL: If you don't properly order your mobile order, be prepared to be lectured! Dad works here!!

This is by far my favorite Starbucks in the area. The staff is so friendly and I've always gotten exactly what I ordered. I try to always be polite and say please and thank you and one time I think the employee who took my order was having a rough day so when I said thank you for taking my order and went to pay, he said not to worry about it and that it was on him. He said he hadn't heard someone say thank you all day. 
Just a small reminder to always be kind and polite, you never know what people are going through.

We have a "Starbucks" in my office building. In reality, it's an Aramark stand that tries to brew Starbucks coffee. I'm a coffee snob and refuse to drink it. So, I walk to this Starbucks when I'm in need. It's a 10 minute round trip if there isn't a wait (usually) and they give select local companies discounts (so make sure you show your ID and ask). 

I've never had a bad experience here. 5 stars in the world of Starbucks ratings.
Friendly baristas. Great location just off the freeway. Absolutely beautiful building. I will be coming here FREQUENTLY!

They just remodeled this Starbucks and its much nicer now. Very open and lots of big tables to share with fellow coffee shop junkies. I'm not a huge fan of Starbucks coffee, but since its basically across the street from where I live, it makes it very convenient when I need my caffeine fix. The staff is very friendly and accommodating.

i pulled up to starbucks this morning at 5:50 , thinking  it opens at 5 am because that's what the website says. i get there and try to order and nobody was answering. i pulled up to the window and the lady rolled her eyes and walked away then came back and held up 6 fingers on her hand then walked away again . also there was 2 cars behind us which shows that this wasn't just an error on my behalf.

Usually will always get the same thing at Starbucks - coffee with a splash of soy milk. Starbucks policy states that soy is extra for 4oz or more (ie. A latte which is mostly milk, and makes sense) but I am consistently charged extra for the small amount they put in a black coffee at this location... I asked and they said it's company policy (which is wrong). A shame because this is the closest location to me, but I'll go to some of the others on my way in to work from now on.
The workers are very rude when speaking to the customer. It's like they are unhappy to go to work here.

Short and sweet review - This location offers your typically Starbucks faire. I marked this one down because the customer service is hit or miss with mostly misses. There are 4 Starbucks locations in my area and this is one I visit the least. Not the friendliest baristas I've encountered. Don't feel the same welcoming environment I feel when I walk into other locations.

Lovely location; right off the main road, but not too much traffic. This is a great Starbucks to run into if you want a quick beverage. I stumbled upon this establishment while wanting to kill some time waiting on a friend. I tried the mango dragonfruit refresher for the first time and fell in love, would recommend. Even though this location was slightly busy at the time I was there, I still got my drink in a timely manner. Overall great atmosphere and excellent service.

Great location, friendly staff and great service.  I learned who most of the baristas are and they know me by first name, so it feels like im going into Cheers when I walk into the coffee shop.  Highly recimmend this location.

The cashier and baristas are rude, immature and wait on you at their leisure because they are too busy socializing with each other. I have tried to give this store several tries but am disappointed every time. Unprofessional sums it up.
The Barista Gisselle was super nice and friendly! Helped me decide on which Frappuccino I should try and it was amazing. Great customer service and would recommend giving this Starbucks a try :)

Until today, I occasionally frequented this location. Not again, however. 
The staff is not friendly and they often forget your order. today, 2/4  staff are on their phones while I am waiting for them to remember to make my drink. I reminded them and they made it wrong. I brought back and they fixed and handed me a cup wet with coffee on the outside. 

It's just a bad experience every time.  They need a new manager and a wake up call reminding them they are in the hospitality industry.
So fast in and out! Chelsea was great taking orders in line to help move the morning rush along!!! All the while with a big smile on her face.

Coming through the drive thru I began to have a very nice conversation with the barista that was working the drive thru we were making jokes and just enjoying the conversation, I jokingly said don't burn my coffee and she immediately became defensive and an awkward silence began. And when my coffee finally arrived....it was burnt

This Starbucks location is nice but I have to say that the people that work there are incredibly rude. The girl that took my order had such a bad attitude. I don't feel like I want to go back to this location. They really need to get people that actually want to work there or at least have some manners and good customer service.

I love the Starbucks on meridian road. They always provide great service and make yummy coffee. I really like the new remodel and the feeling of the environment. I have never had a problem with this location! Thanks for everything!

Just echoing what has been said by other patrons. The baristas here need more training. They did not know how to make my cold brew when ordered. They were nice enough to make me a new one when asked though. Drank about a 3rd of my drink before throwing it away because it did not taste good.

If I were rating this solely based on the amazing individuals that work at this location then believe me, you'd see the biggest 5 stars possible. These employees get hounded daily by huge lines of obnoxious students. I've seen them be berated, I've seen them when they're flustered, and I've seen the way a lot of jerks treat them. I absolutely love every employee here and hope that everyone else appreciates them. 

Since this location is at the UA, and on campus right by the library, it gets slammed throughout the day. There are times where there are lines that go 20 people out the door and the employees here continue to bust butt to get drink orders out. Unfortunately, the UA has set them up for failure by also having an advanced ordering app (not the regular Starbucks app--they don't do that at this location) where while there are 30 people in line, there are then 30 college students in classes also ordering drinks. So at certain times of the day the "in person" customers are getting angry because "tap and go" customers are getting drinks before the "in person" orders. But imagine how hard it is for these few employees to keep up with the 30 people in line and the 30+ mobile orders happening at the same time. Really, UA has set them up for failure because people get cranky and take it out on these poor baristas who are doing amazing work. Unfortunately, I have to deduct a star for the long, long wait times and for the fact that I think its a horrible business practice to have all of these different ordering systems slamming people. But again, still 5 stars for the employees! 

They don't let you redeem your stars for a free beverage here. That's frustrating. You can, however, still get happy hour deals and other perks here. I mainly earn my stars here and then cash them out at "regular" locations. 

What I --really-- hate about this location is how they nickle and dime you. I switch out the milk for soy or coconut in all of my beverages. The upcharge for this is fine, as I appreciate them offering soy, and I realize that costs them a bit more to make. I have zero issues with this. But what irks me is I used to order drinks with "no ice" and I'd have no issues. The ice makes things too cold for me to drink, but sometimes I want something that isn't hot either. "No ice" is a great way to get something closer to room temp. Again, I've ordered like this several times with no issues (and I've NEVER had an issue at any other location ever). But suddenly I'm told there is a 50 cent upcharge here for "no ice". They're actually trying to charge you to take ice out of your drink. I've just saved you some water, some ice, the power it took to make the ice, etc., and the coffee I'm purchasing is around $6-7 and I usually purchase here 3x a week, 2x a day (that's 6 drinks a week, a loyal customer). And you really, really want to charge someone to take ice out of a drink?!

This "new rule" comes and goes. Sometimes they have it. Other times they don't. But basically, they need to get over all of their extra charges that don't exist anywhere else. Seriously, this doesn't exist at any other "regular" or "franchise" location I've ever been to. At some point, you need to realize you're making plenty of money and you don't need to charge to remove ice. After all, I don't get a discount if I take whipped cream off of my drink...

Employees: 5 stars
Long waits and weird mysterious extra charges: 3 stars
Greed of this location: no stars

First and only Starbucks where I ordered online and my order was not ready when I came in. Generally not that big a deal but there's only a few people in here and probably 5 to 6 people behind the counter. The whole point of ordering ahead is to grab and go, but I'm still waiting here 15 minutes later watching people who came in after me get their drinks ‍

I go to Starbucks a lot and have been to most of the ones in the Reno area. This one is by far my favorite choice. Every time I have gone I have received friendly, fast , service. If they accidently make your drink wrong they do not get an attitude about making you a whole new drink. It's always very clean and inviting inside. This location also has a big selection of cups, mugs, and water bottles to choose from and several other coffee related items. I will go out of my way sometimes just to go to this location. The only bummer is they do not have a drive through.

I come here multiple times a month. I always get excited when Rhett is working or helping me. Always makes great suggestions; like changing my milk on my dirty chi tea, or how many pumps to put in it. Or adding nutmeg or hazelnut to my iced americano.  

I work from home or at different Starbuck, I would say I got to at least 5 different locations throughout the month or not more. From St. Charles to downtown STL and everything in between plus some in IL. This is my favorite location. They just seem to be more on top of it and caring about their guests, mainly Rhett!

Starbucks is Starbucks, my coffee was good- but for an order of two croissants, a blonde roast and a chai tea latte- it should NEVER take 15min. 
Funny enough, it was an honest mistake, but after you make a mistake, you apologize. 
I think the sticker got stuck to the apron of the barista so she didn't know what I was waiting on. After I politely reminded her that I had another drink, she looks down and sees the sticker and makes the drink. 
A nice acknowledgement- sorry for the wait, or "I'm sorry", or "Oh, excuse me."

This is one of the busiest if not the busiest stores in Reno due to their location. They are constantly hustling and making sure they serve orders quickly and with a smile. The staff is friendly and accommodating.  There is always parking available and one can get through the drive through in a matter of minutes. 

Joe the manager does a great job running this shop and his staff makes customers feel welcomed. Nice work!

I used the phone apps to place order. Instead of drive thru.  I always like to walk in to meet the barista because I want to see a good smile with a good cup of coffee before the day started.  So far, it was a good experience and the mask did causing some miscommunication.  Otherwise, the service is OK and I am sure I will miss the beautiful smile. (you know who you are : ).

Every time I have ordered a drink at this location it has been under-filled.  And every time I have asked for it to be filled to the top (that's what I am paying for) the server says "give me a minute and I'll heat some for you."  Well that's just corporate BS and you are deliberately scamming your customer by under-filling their drinks.

You should avoid this scam artist company.

Best Starbucks ever!  It is not due to the coffee products- they stay consistent. I love this Starbucks because of the layout and location. It has a lot of great space, seating and a private area for meetings if you choose. In addition, it is surrounded by other chain restaurants i.e. Bertucci's, Texas Roadhouse and Buffalo Wild Wings all in the same plaza. So when you've finished your Starbucks, you do not have far to travel for food...or vise versa.

In all honesty this is the worst Starbucks in the city every time I've been here the employees are incredibly terrible as if they have no customer service skills whatsoever one time I walk to the register and they were joking and laughing and I stood there for 2 minutes until one of them decided to get their life together. I'm just warning you do not. I mean do not go to this Starbucks they don't even do Rewards or points.

Love Starbucks!! I always get the free tea crap with extra matcha. All the Baristas are super friendly and my poodles
Love going with me they always get a pupachino
Would go the extra mile to the one down the road .... place is very chaotic when busy

This place is the much needed update to the previous version of the old one across the street. It's obvious this place is a hit. Every chair inside was occupied. The drive thru also had a line of cars funneling through. 

Although it took a minute for someone to come over to take my order (drive thru appears to be the bulk of their business), my order was made in a timely manner.

After my fourth visit at this Starbucks, I'm done. The baristas are always grumpy and act like your inconveniencing them. I chalked it up to maybe just being a rough or busy day, as they are human too and shouldn't have to always be peppy. However, this isn't the case and my experiences have always been unpleasant.

I love love love this Starbucks. The baristas are very friendly! They make my drink very quickly too and it is perfect every time. They were having trouble with their cash register today but they were still very nice and calm. They took my order and I was able to pay with my Starbucks app that they can scan. We found a solution and I was able to get my coffee.

This starbucks has been open throughout the pandemic with altered hours 6am-6pm. When they are open they have a really great dining room and a private room for studying in the back! I've been through the drive thru quite a lot lately and my drinks are always made correctly here. Also everyone here is very friendly despite the times. If this starbucks was closer to me then this would definitely be my go-to!

I love this starbucks. I work in the mall and I go every Monday. The people are fantastic. I always order the same thing and they have it made before I ever get to the register. I think they stay busy because of the mall traffic but I have never seen people make coffee so fast and always consistent.

Geez. Slowest. Starbucks. Ever.
Sunday morning st 9 am and they have only 1 barista.  Needless to say, after finally ordering, the wait was 20"+ for the coffee

533pm Sunday 6/9 - There is a male working that is always super friendly and a female working that is has not been friendly the last several times I've been there. This is the second time I've ordered a grande nitro in a venti cup and that I have questioned the portion amount. Last time I let her speak to me that the small amount was accurate and I went home to do a test to confirm. She was way off. She is not doing the full grande pour into the venti cup and it's extremely frustrating. This time I asked for a grande cup of water no ice and an empty venti cup to show her how small the pour is, she just said, "so do you want some more nitro in there?" - YES I DO WANT THE FULL GRANDE AMOUNT OF NITRO IN MY VENTI CUP PLEASE. I spend a lot of money here and it's infuriating to feel like more than once you're being cheated. And the way the employee responds when you question being cheated twice. The customer is ALWAYS right. 
I hope they will be able to have a training refresher about accurate portions in the near future to stop the madness.

Super convenient location being right outside of TSA security check-in.

Line backs up sometimes especially if you're waiting for an espresso coffee drink and they're also making frappuccinos.

The fastest way in and out is to get a regular drip coffee since the cashier can get that for you quickly.

Came in late night, around 11:00 p.m. landing from a New York flight. Everything to eat was closed except for a grab and go store and Starbucks. Was greeted by 2 wonderful ladies who gave outstanding service and had the whole transaction done and my sandwich warm and ready for me to eat in under 5 minutes. Some of the best service I've received that any Starbucks, surprisingly! 

What I liked most about it though? Prices are kept reasonable despite being inside the airport -- not like many other outlets that jack up the prices once your inside a terminal.  I think Starbucks will now be my place of choice to grab a reasonable, delicious quick meal before or after my flights! Very happy camper.

This is just your average Starbucks. Nothing sticks out at this location to set it apart or above your normal Starbucks, which is why I give it three stars. It is a pretty tight squeeze when there is a line of people waiting. The location was ideal; right next to the lobby of our hotel. Everything was clean. The service was average. The drinks took longer than normal to make. The quality of the coffee is what you would expect. 

Please note that if you are trying to redeem your stars for a free drink, they do not accept them at this location. 

When I am in Indy again, I will probably swing by this location to get my early morning caffeine fix.

If I COULD GIVE ZERO STARS I WOULD  Once again, another terrible experience at this location.  The staff is so unprofessional it's a shame. I started to say my order and before I could even get out what I wanted the lady was walking away starting the order.  I said "can I have a small hot coffee?  Caramel drizzle, extra..." she walks away and begins making it before I could complete my sentence.  Then she returns to the register with a black coffee.   I said "I wasn't finish".  I continue to say my order and the lady said "we don't put half and half in, we let the customer do it"   I continued to tell her I wanted whipped cream.   Then she magically was able to add half and half.   Pure laziness.  I asked for a banana nut bread and she said "we ain't got none ". The level of ignorance and irritation that they display is disgusting !!!  I will never return

Really Starbucks!!?? No holiday cups by 9:00 AM today. That is so disappointing since both the radio and TV mentioned the holiday deal today only when you buy a holiday drink. See if I give my future patronage. Hmm

Probably my favorite Starbucks ever. After being tired of the store on Edgewood never getting my order right, I drove out of my way to come here. I have been coming to this location ever since. Baristas are all super friendly, even when they're busy. Drinks are always made pretty quickly. It's nice to go to a location that actually makes you feel welcome. I got a drink to try and I thought it was gross one day. They made me something I would like instead without any fuss or extra charge. Manager (tyree) is super friendly and I always see her working just as hard as everybody else. I can absolutely respect that!! Try this place!!

my favorite location. they ran out of the breakfast sandwich i wanted and it wasn't updated on the app. the barista was super apologetic and overall very nice! it was fast and painless to order. my drink was delicious.
I'm just wondering why I got stuck in the drive thru for 30+ minutes with a total of 5 cars in front of me. I so wish I was exaggerating.
Waited over 20 min to get an iced coffee and over 40 min to get a breakfast sandwich. They definitely prioritize the drive-through, would not come back to this location.

Spacious respite to get away from Eldorado's gambling or the downtown heat. Lots of seating and actually temperature cool for being close to a large open entrance of the casino.

Popped in a couple of times. Got a nitro coffee, wonderful. Doesn't need sugar or cream, I know right? Also the dragonfruit tea is quite visually stunning.

Service was a hit for the tea but a sorrowful miss for the coffee. It looks like the most quiet and relaxful Starbucks to be employed at.
Ordered thru app. Reserve coffee I had ordered thru the app was out of stock. Informed only when I showed up. No phone call, message or email. Ended up wasting 20 minutes.

This Starbucks is, unfortunately, on my way to work ... sigh. There usually is a line for the drive-thru; I almost always park and go inside. It's much quicker than waiting in line. Good solid service; I rarely have issues other than sometimes they put the sprinkles on my skinny cinnamon dolce latte and sometimes they don't. Another reason to go inside ...

I used to study here when I was in grad school. It's small but you can usually find a table.

This is definitely the worst Starbucks in the area. They constantly get orders wrong (my favorite was getting a hot latte that was made by pouring espresso into cold milk). They also have a huge problem with time management. I've waited in long lines at plenty of Starbucks, but they've always moved fairly quickly. Here, you could be waiting for 30 mins or more (which has happened on numerous occasions). Better to take the extra time to drive to Woodbury. You'll still get your drink faster and it will be correct.

Friendly staff and quick service. I have to hand it to the employees here because they are constantly slammed. Y'all, the closest Starbucks is like Devon, Wayne or West Chester. Yes it's annoying when the drive through line goes all the way to the street, but the staff keeps their cool with a smile. 

Love the open space to do work! People are always having meetings or doing work in this space so it's really productive. I haven't had a long wait time for a drink before. So kudos to my local Starbucks for doing the damn thing day after day.

It's a Starbucks...with completely clueless employees who, no matter what, will struggle (and ultimately fail) getting your order correct. Skip this one and just go to the one in Target. Trust me, It'll be worth the extra few mins.

The crew working Memorial Day was fantastic! Very cordial and efficient. In particular, Jack, who took our order, suggested to my fiancé to get a pump of classic syrup, as opposed to granular sugar in his iced Americano. This has solved an issue in our relationship, for this had been making him grumpy and sad. Thanks, Jack!!

I don't usually write reviews for Starbucks locations but the Willow Lake Starbucks location is by far my favorite in Indy! 

Unlike most Starbucks locations, this location is big; with large tables for study groups, couches for relaxing with friends, and comfy chairs for reading a good book. There are high ceilings which really make the space feel open and airy along with large windows allowing natural light. It's such a great space to work in! In combination with the great store atmosphere, the staff here are always kind and friendly. It doesn't matter what time you come, the staff is great. 

I will continue to come here for my Strawberry Açaí Refreshers and lemon pound cake when I need a place to meet a friend or get some work done.
only reason i didn't give 1 star is because the young man at the front was so kind to us! and our chocolate croissants were great. I simply ordered a matcha latte and it tasted awful :( sad
No complaints for my drive thru. Eveyone was wearing mask and gloves. I got my Java chip frappe perfectly made.

Have had issues at this location before accusing me of stealing so I'm always weary about coming back. Thank you Vaughn for helping me today. You were awesome! I hope you're working  next time I'm in so I can have another great experience.

Friendly baristas and they work hard.  In the morning between 8 and 10 am, the line, and the wait, can be pretty long.  They get a lot of app orders. This is a very busy location and not too large a store.   Drinks and food are standard Starbucks.  My wife loves the Carmel Macchiato and their donuts.  She drinks and eats like there is no tomorrow, even though it isn't cheap.  Grandkids really like it here too.  Always seem to have a Starbucks coffee cup on my desk. 

Generally recommend but be prepared to wait in the mornings.
The worst Starbucks I have ever found in my life. Small, cramped, and slow! Do not go through the drive-thru line, you'll be there for half an hour at least.

I just had the best experience at any Starbucks!! TT was awesome, they helped with my questions about the new tea flavors and was just so kind!! I got the iced peach green tea and it was yummy - just quite sweeter than I like. I wasn't sure if it was a sweetened drink and she made it without any sweetener and it's just naturally sweet. She was able to recommend a way to order it next time I am around Starbucks that I didn't even think of. My fiancé and I both were so glad we stopped just because it was a great experience where we were treated so nicely. Guess we just aren't used to the great customer service TT provided. I hope they get recognized for it because they deserve it!! 13/10
Out of cold brew  recommend a good alternative. Made best of a unfortunate situation.  Thanks!
Friendly staff and inside seating is comfortable.  The coffee is on par as the others.  Saw a few students there hang out or work on their homework.  Decent size, not too big, not too small.

The customer service from the girls here is great!  Taylor, Grayson, Michelle,  and Gabby all work so hard to make sure they get it right.  I had a real "karen" in front of me complaining the other day and Taylor dealt with it with grace and class,  which really,  they don't get paid enough to put up with a bunch of crap but she was nice about it anyways.   Great work girls!

Both times that I have been here, today being the most recent, they ignore my request for almond milk and use regular and STILL charge me for it.  I have a dairy allergy, and I always make sure to repeat myself to avoid these instances.  Neither time was it busy, the baristas were all talking amongst themselves and distracted and clearly not paying attention to the customers.  Normally I don't write poor reviews of this nature but I'm trying to save anyone else that has similar dietary needs.  Pretty disappointing, especially considering I pay the price for their ignorance.

Thank you. Doth such a place share such an idea with a complement reader? https://twitter.com/DwKleckner seeks a very refined, polite, female acquaintance who may further an incomplete Introduction to Society, though discreetly. BACKGROUND... https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103051966613676983821/reviews/@33.8243044,-114.1629745,4z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m3!8m2!3m1!1e1
Worst experience ever!  Randomly added Splenda to my drink and we had to repeat our order several times.

This  is small location but both times I have been the staff has been awesome! Always super friendly, sincere, and most importantly quick! They could have stocked the front cooler a little but I did take into account I came in towards the end of the day. The best part is it's located inside Kroger so I can have my coffee and shop too! Now we just have to get Kroger some carts with cup holders . Worth the stop.

I should have known to just walk away when after ordering a Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew, I was asked, "Hot or cold?"

Thankfully they didn't have anymore as my confidence level in the drink would not have been very high. And I saved myself $5 in the process!

Fingers crossed that there is a better staffed/stocked location somewhere else in this airport.

Absolutely LOVE this new location!  It has just recently opened and is easily my favorite one to study at!  It is actually a little further of a drive from my house than other Starbucks locations, but I choose to make the drive every time!

First of all, I have to complement the staff!  The employees are so kind and are eager to please their customers.  During one of my visits, I ordered a drink that they were out of and was completely refunded and given my "second choice" at a discounted rate.  I thought this was so kind.

Next, the atmosphere is great!  There are many tables of all shapes and sizes, so I am convinced there is a place for everyone to get "comfy" here!  They also offer nice furniture in the front of the store by the windows, which is not something all locations have.  The restrooms are impressively clean and are very well-maintained; really, the whole place is!

If you are looking for a place to be productive or just meet with some friends over a cup of coffee/tea, I highly suggest this Starbucks location!

Shoutout to the staff for always working with an expected long line as it is located inside Nugget resort where people will come to the convenience of Starbucks and basic catchy favorite drinks to order. 

Every time I ordered from here every time we stay at The Nugget, they always get the order right and are very nice and polite! Do not expect the full blown menu and snack menu at this location as it is more as a Starbucks express!

*CAUTION* The cars speeding through this cramped tiny parking lot to get to the drive thru are going to hurt or worse the customers coming from or trying to get back to their cars. There must be a resolve. TRAFFIC BUMPS ???

The employees there are great and very respectful. Very down to earth and serves the customers well. Newtown is a very high maintenance area, and I give them props for how they deal with complaints!!!

This is, by far, the Best Starbucks location out of 5 in my area. It is spacious inside! It is a pleasant environment to meet with clients & friends. The parking lot is ample. The coffee is perfect every time I go here. 
I wish all of their locations could boast of the same things. When I die I hope to go to a Starbucks Heaven- exactly like this Montgomeryville location!
And most importantly- Customer service is top notch here!

The cream was spoiled and sour, which caused me diarrhea for a whole night. Not to mention that they gave me a grande size for my venti order. BTW the lady in the window was rude and impatient. The starbucks on river and stone is way better.

I like all Starbucks in general, so even though this one is inside the mall = no seats, always long lines, I still like it. I'm taking 1 star away because sometimes I do have to wait a long time for my drink. As long as the drinks are made right, I'm not complaining.

I absolutely LOVE this location!! I stop here everyday before work. The morning staff during the week are always upbeat and super friendly. They write little smilies on my cup which makes me smile! They are always so quick, even when there's a mad rush. The weekend crew is a little bit slower and less friendly, but they still get the job done. I switched my Starbucks location to these guys about three months ago and I don't miss my old location one bit!

Depends on the person who is making coffee, it can be super nice or it can be to sweet. I usually order my caramel Frappuccino from people whom I know there. But it's very chill place for chatting and enjoy your coffee

Starbucks is no longer a fast service set up you have to actually allocate at least 10 to 15 minutes to get your coffee when you show up....At least 10 to 15 minutes and generally I give it 15 to 20 based on the time a day

The Nugget gave me $10 credit for the starbucks in the lobby. Now I know why. It's freezing out and a nice hot cup of coffee sounds good. I order a salted caramel mocha. After the drink is made, I'm told that I'm getting the last drink of the day. I'm happy they took my order, but then I see the drink. 
Salted caramel mocha is what I ordered, but I'm given a salted caramel frappuccino. The last thing I want is something cold. However since it was a $10 credit from nugget and they just said they closed, I told them I'll just take it. They offered to make a new one, but I need to be somewhere. 
I take one sip and it does taste like it's the last drink of the day! It was disgusting. I just dumped it. 

I'll just drive to get some real coffee. It may be convenient to have a Starbucks in a hotel lobby, but when the drink is wrong and disgusting, I'd rather go elsewhere

We order two cups of coffee every day.  Nothing fancy just coffee, milk and sugar.
Every single time- our order is wrong.

Woman working was very rude. I ordered my drink with a sandwich and as I held out my money to pay, she snatched it out of my hand and didn't even look me in the eye once. I waited to get my change and held out my hand to receive it and she put it on the counter instead. When my order was complete, I noticed she threw the sandwich onto the counter and also did not give me the sandwich I ordered. Do not recommend.

Used the drive through to get the beau and myself a pick me up. There was no line and we were able to order right away. I got a Pink Drink, and the beau got a Cafe mocha with 1/2 the amount of mocha. 

The drinks were ready when we got at the window, they were efficient and friendly.

New, large Starbucks that now has a drive through and a much better parking arrangement than the former location that was across the street.  Service through the drive through has been fast and pleasant!

We tried Mobile order for this location as the drive thru was super busy and it was quick, easy and super friendly! Due to social distancing, they are not allowing people inside so you wait outside six feet apart, tell the barista your name when you get to the door and the grab your order! Super simple and no contact as they put it on a table for you and then you take it from there. I recommend this option if you know you are going in advance. The food and drink is wonderful as always. The app lets you customize your order as you would through the drive thru or in person so don't be scared to try that out as I was originally. Thanks for my morning pick me up!
This is the worst Starbucks. Two baristas stand and chit chat with huge lines in store and at drive through.

Super convenient Starbucks located inside the lobby of Nugget Casino Hotel. It's located near the east tower elevators, with a big open space in front containing seating with a handful of tables/chairs. Pricing seems to be normal for Starbucks (not overpriced like those in "special" locations like airports, etc). Staff was very friendly and very enthusiastic at 7am in the morning and they got my order out to me very quickly and even asked if I need a bag for my items.

I passed by about an hour later and it looked like a long line was already forming. They do have several staff members on hand so hopefully the wait isn't too long. All in all, great location and super convenient if you're staying at or visiting Nugget. They're also open early and close late, so you can get in a Starbucks fix anytime!

Vanilla Rooibus Tea Latte** I recently tried this for an afternoon delight, and was delight-ed.

Such a friendly staff. quick and accurate. 

Quite the hang out spot for tweens and can be a prime spot for hilarious eavesdropping.
really? lol who actually fills up a coffee cup this much and thinks it's appropriate to give it to a customer?

I do not like to burn my tongue. I specifically asked for matcha tea that is "kids temperature". They gave me my drink and I burned my tongue. I made sure they heard me to make it not as hot. Burning your tongue is the worst thing ever.

You might want to bus your outside a little more. Our time sitting here has been shared with a couple of kids who not only bought no drinks but also smoked cigarettes non-stop and openly drank booze from a half pint. Classy.

I've been here a total of four times and every single time it gets messed up. I never order anything fancy I just get a venti vanilla iced coffee with milk in it and twice they have put cream in it and the other times they don't put anything in it besides just coffee. I won't be going to this location ever again.
I'm not a coffee person but today I tried a Tall Carmel crunch frappe & I have to save I'm happy with this decision!! Delicious, Literally the first every Starbucks drink I ever enjoyed

Spacious relaxation area to have coffee. The baristas immediately greeted me and helped me figure out exactly what I wanted. I found it very cute that they had turkeys available to write what you are thankful for :) the coffee was brewed and ready fast!

This little mix I requested was delicious ok first sip, then after there was no more strawberry lol Idk how that happened there appears to be more than it actually is. Other than that I think I was on to something

While the workers at this Starbucks provide exceptional customer service, I was extremely disheartened to learn that this Starbucks severely lacks in its ethics! They have "recycling bins" and trash bins inside, with a recycling symbol indicating the recycling section. While an employee was changing the recycling bag, I asked them if I should wait until they were done so that I could recycle my cup. Their response: "we don't actually recycle. I'm thankful for this honest employee, as part of the reason I choose Starbucks is for their "support of the environment" and developing counties. This Starbucks purposely misleads it's customers and exploits patrons like myself. I will not be back.

The amount of respect I receive when wearing my scrubs vs not wearing my scrubs is so very sad. I literally never have been more upset with Starbucks  in my life. Being a gold member at this location really doesn't even matter.
Love love love this Starbucks.  I always go through drive through. The staff is friendly.  The drinks are amazing.  I will be back tomorrow!

This location is in a great spot within the airport that is convenient to the Delta Gates but the service is terribly slow and the staff are very unfriendly. During a busy morning today they had only two staff working and a line that took me 36 minutes in order to even get to the cash register. They also rang up my order wrong three times and I had to correct them. This place is a total mess with so much potential.

This place is always a disaster. Too many orders, not enough workers. Everyone seems to work at their own pace not worrying about the back order of drinks in a swarming cafe. Not many smiles. John seems to be the only worker that holds this place together, always in good spirits. The way the manager Tressie treats her employees is disgusting. Her attitude seems very contagious. I'd consider myself a regular due to working nearby & nothing ever changes my opinion of this Starbucks. GO TO ANOTHER ONE!

Horrible service! Overworked and not happy people working here...Our 2 drink order took 20 minutes.  It was made twice, they attempted to scrape off whip cream on a vanilla bean,  add java chip,  no whip... really.  Please retrain!!

A little better than your basic run of the mill Starbucks as there is good parking out front and a large and comfortable second floor lounge with natural light.  Perfect for lounge lizarding, so be ye frog or toad you can raise your body temp with a nice latte and some sunlight on a chilly morning.

I used their drive-thru and wasn't pleased at all that the barista wouldn't accept throwing away my soda can for me to place my frappé in my cup holder. 

I highly suggest if you're going to deny the customer you should put a trash can outside your drive-thru.

I love my iced caramel maciato it's a wonderful way to treat myself especially after going to the gym with matches after the gym I like to stop by the mornings and sometimes after work I don't drink coffee too much but when I do Starbucks is the place for me.
It's nice I love the fact that they not only so different types of coffee is whether it's iced hot or the wonderful balloons they also have cakes breakfast sandwiches and different types of snacks this location is always busy but they're pretty quick to get you in and out without many mistakes got a love Starbucks

I truly love this location! Everyone is happy to help and just an overall positive atmosphere amongst the employees! They're all very sweet and I'm glad they helped me fix my drink without any hassle. I always leave with a smile and the energy to power through my mornings! Thank you guys!!! Such an awesome team!!

The last couple of times I've been here I went through the drive thru , hours said they were open and no one answered. Not sure if they've changed their hours or if someone is being lazy. This was on a Thursday at 9:20 pm. It's the second time it's happened.

I like stopping here. 

It's just off the freeway and back on.  
I don't have to be here in town long and I can hit the road. 

The store is clean
The employees are nice

My coffee is hot and yum! 

I'll be back,  I feel like I can recommend.  
This store has plenty of parking and seating both.

Really a horrible experience. I came here 20 mins before my shift because i know it's busy. I waited 25 mins for my one drink before asking if they had my order. The lady said no, and then went back to making drinks. A different employee then approached me and asked if i needed anything, and i asked her also if my order was coming up soon. I will not be returning to this location.

What a terrible place. They're rude and dismissive. I had an issue with my order and after 25 minutes of waiting I finally asked and they basically blamed it on another customer taking my order. I wouldn't of been so upset if they were apologetic. Do yourself a favor and go to Dunkin'. The food may be trashy but at least you don't have rude employees. Do better Starbucks.

Service is very good, but the store needs to improve.  Bathrooms are locked and the company does not repair them.  Not good business.
This place gets a lot of business from Temple med students, so there's no excuse for running out of supplies (no Truvia).  

Starbucks needs to pay attention to their North Philly store and its customers!
Just wanted to thank who ever made our drinks!! They were the best! Haven't gotten well made Irish Cream Cold brew in a while. This time it was perfection!

I am running on nothing this morning and needed some caffeine and hot food to get me to and through work. There was no line in the drive through so I pulled through and ordered my absolute favorite sandwich - the bacon gouda. Doesn't get better than that. I also got a grande black iced tea - I don't love their tea but it has caffeine and I really needed some. I was through the drive through in less than 5 minutes and my sandwich was hot and tasty as usual. They are doing a nice job with covid measures - the employee giving me my order was wearing a mask appropriately, they have measures in place so you can get your food and drinks without touching, and the credit card reader is set up so the employee doesn't touch your card and you don't have to touch the machine. 
Thanks Starbucks for making my day better.

42 people in line and 3 employees. I'm not complaining if it's a $2 coffee.  But if I'm paying $7 for my venti iced nonfat upside down caramel macchiato, I expect to have a half decent customer experience.  Little help here?

I live very close to this new location and was so excited when they opened last year. Unfortunately, every time I come here something goes wrong. I'm not a picky coffee person. I order standard things usually unmodified. I waited for 30 minutes due to the nitro coffee machine being down once and I had to ask if everything was okay, I've had numerous wrong orders both drive thru and  inside and today I woke up a little earlier to swing by at 5:30 to get an iced coffee and they weren't even open and employees were waiting outside (I'm assuming to be let in my a manager running late). It's a Friday and I wasn't the only car in line waiting in confusion. They are supposed to open at 5.  I never go that early but still, I hope that doesn't happen often. I'll go again due to convenience but it's not really because I think it's a great location with outstanding customer service.

If you don't know how to make clover drinks, then don't offer it. If in a grande size you have to dump a third of it before you had to add ice, you've made it wrong. Get retrained if you need to but your customers are not just paying a premium for your clover drinks but go out of their way to get to a location that still offers it.
This place is so small, they don't have indoor seating. Staff is very nice and my order was accurate.

This new Starbucks used to be station across the street with little to no parking.  Now, the new building is fantastic, with amble parking.  Also, met Deanna who greeted me with I arrive. She is extremely warm, friendly, and easy to speak to.  A valuable member to the Starbucks staff I feel.  I'll be sure to visit here again.
This new crew although very friendly and trying hard, are a little disorganized and frequently out of products which doesn't make sense since there is a distribution center 45 minutes away

Got my order as expected. Ordered a tall cappuccino and no problems. The cashier was friendly and answered my questions. Also, this location is great with the temperature inside, usually all other Starbucks locations have it cold like an ice box!

I'm local and used to visit this location a lot prior to the renovation- so I was excited to stop in today to get a coffee and do some work. The excitement ended there. The place is sparse and not an ounce comfortable. Who ever designed the store, really lost sight of why patrons sit and stay in a coffee shop rather than take their beverage on-the-go. First, there is not a single cozy chair. There is a long bench which would be comfy if there were actual usable tables in front of it. Instead there are knee height tiny round coffee tables, that fit perhaps 2 coffees. Second, the chairs are solid - painfully uncomfortable wood.  And, there are no square tables, only tiny 18" or so round ones. Barely enough room for a laptop and coffee. At the bar, there are more wood chairs with mini backs. 

Perhaps they don't want patrons to stay awhile and that's why it's so uncomfortable- who knows. But I for one am 
deeply bummed as Starbucks will no longer be my go-to for coffee or an alternative location to work.  

I guess it's a win for the other mom n pop coffee shops in the area as they will have less to compete with.

I thought I would try it this a Starbucks despite the bad reviews,since it's close to my house, and I get a free birthday drink. I started telling the lady my order and she started talking over me  to someone else, rude, but she rang up my orders.
