Are you kidding me? I ordered large, look this cup, cup is large, but they offer medium size. 

This is half cup of the coffee! Seriously Starbucks?

I've been missing the friendly crew at this Starbucks since the store closed its inside due to COVID-19 but that hasn't stopped them for being as friendly and with it one bit. Today I went thru the drive thru and "The Chaz" took my order and cheerfully served my order - just right I'll add!
Actually the crew there works real hard to make everyone feel welcomed and are one of the primary reasons why I enjoy spending time there for simply grabbing a snack or parking myself with my laptop and catching up on work.
Great job and keep up the great work - I speak for many that we miss seeing you all!

This Starbucks was conveniently located off the interstate. Everywhere is out of almost every syrup made because of shortages in production. I went with the only thing available. Vanilla latte. Bathrooms were clean. It was a little slow getting the coffee and they weren't that busy.
Looooove this spot and especially Kelsie's warmth and awesome personality along with her way of rockin' my order to perfection!! Grazie mille!

Location has a bad fly problem and service definitely needs to be better.  My mother-in-law mentioned the flys were horrible inside and seating wasn't the best. So benefit of doubt we went anyways and at first was in drive thru which was going very slow, so we went inside and ordered the coffees and asked for banana loaf (they didn't have any). Had to wait over 10 minutes to get our drinks.  That is when we saw dead flies everywhere and in the window seals.  Very disappointed since the location is newer expected a lot more and the team seemed overwhelmed.
Love this location! Always fast and gets my order right everytime! I think I've been there over 20 times and they've only messed it up like once! When they did mess up they quickly fixed it.

I've never had a bad drink from here.

HOWEVER, customer service needs work. The slowest line ever. Not to be rude but if I'm paying four bucks for a coffee it shouldn't take me half an hour to get.

I had a birthday reward on the app but didn't know how to get it. Not only was the girl rude about it.. She didn't even ask if I was getting anything else. So I stood their awkwardly for abt a minute and then said "yeah I wasn't done ordering..."

The other girls though had always been nice so maybe the day was just an off day. Still a 3 for crowd control though. Other starbucks do not have that long of line. And I've been here in the AM and PM... Always out the door!
The Service was great the coffee doesn't taste the same like in cali, sorry but my opinion only, my friend loved it... not me. and plus it was inside a gas station plus casino.

This Starbucks has terrific baristas.  I liked that they greeted me with friendly faces, served up my custom coffee with wonderful smiles, and had no problem fixing my coffee when I realized that I forgot to reduce the amount of syrup, making it too sweet for my tastes.  The atmosphere is pretty cozy with some oversized chairs for lounging and several tables and chairs.  The music wasn't too loud.  Everything was neatly arranged without creating a maze for customers to get to the counter for ordering or pickup.  I would recommend this location as one of the best in Northwest Reno, and I look forward to dropping by the next time I'm in the neighborhood.

This Starbucks is a gem. I've always had very good service overall and appreciate the friendliness. I especially enjoy the desire to remember what my name is and what my order is. I'm generally here for meetings and coffee with friends and would say 9/10 I get great service and my expected order. 

And that's what I expect out of Starbucks - consistency and speedy service. I give it an extra star for the overall staff friendliness.

Additional bonus - they have a small assortment of board games
Always spot on. We will skip other Starbucks just to go here instead. I appreciate the coffee and you guys never disappoint.

Had the worst customer service experience here. I asked the barista if my drink had the right shots of espresso in it because it was rather pale. Without answering they took my drink back and gave me attitude for having to remake it. The manager demanded I tasted the remake and when I said no she demanded again. I'm extremely appalled by this behavior and hope the managers behavior does not reflect the corporation.

This is an awful Starbucks. It's consistently terrible service with rude employees and the drinks are never correct. I was in there today and they didn't have any blonde Espresso. Really? I also asked for whipped cream and when I got my drink there was no whipped cream. So, I sent the drink back asking for whipped cream. The barista said "well, it does not say that on the cup".  And I was like I know, that's why am telling you now. Because they weren't listening to me up there. And you can lose the attitude.
Why?!! Why are all of the employees here so rude? Why can't they also just get a drink correct? 
The line is also always way too long for the drive-through. 
It's pretty bad when there is a Starbucks inside the Target next-door and the employees there tell me they have people bringing drinks to them to be fixed that they got from this Starbucks.

This Starbucks is always out of everything and they always mess up my order somehow. They either forget something or it's made wrong etc. sucks because this one is close to my work but when they have forgotten part of my order over 5 times I won't be back.
My "go-to" morning coffee stop on way to work. Love the mobile online ordering. Parking is never a problem at 6am, I run in the back door, grab my coffee and I'm out the door.

By far the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. There was a worker by the name of Brooklynn who snapped on her employees and was not very jovial at all. In the service industry service with a smile is important. I enjoy having coffee to uplift my mood, but my Espresso energy was drained from my body from the sheer toxicity of this place. The employees have to work with this person? How they manage to make it out alive during a shift is beyond me.Cake pops still rule though.

One of the newer Starbucks in the area....busy but only waited a couple minutes up front before waited on. Daughter wanted to try an item off the "secret menu" and the gentleman (didn't get his name) was happy to make it with the recipe. It was a bit more expensive, as Starbucks already is, but daughter really like it. It was a Strawberry Shortcake Frappuccino....basically a.dessert!

I don't understand the problem they can't seem to get my order right and it's a very simple order of sous vide eggs with Sriracha. They always forget the Sriracha and I put it on my order. And they hardly ever remember to give you a napkin. I don't know why I want food from a place that doesn't give you a napkin! How hard is that!

Awful coffee! Ordered a hot coffee with a cold foam topping. I have ordered this multiple times at various locations and never had an issue. I ordered through the app and picked up at the drive thru. Was never told they made it an iced coffee up til I was at the pick up window. When the young girl handed me my drink and I noticed it was an ice coffee I asked her why my coffee was made are used instead of hot like I ordered. She proceeded to tell me that they cannot add the cold foam to a hot coffee. I told her I have had this ordered at various locations and had no issue. She never offered to remake the coffee nor apologize.

If you are looking for a solid spot to get work done, then check out this Starbucks location! While it does not have a drive-through, the inside is very expansive and clean. There is tons of seating and lots of plug-ins. I haven't had any issue with the WiFi and the staff is super friendly. The ambience is pretty chill with the exception of the 15:30 school rush during the week. During that time, seating and quiet can be a little sparse. Fortunately it clears out within about half an hour. Overall, a great study spot that is opened late!
Love the drive through. Friendly employees and eager to give my dog a pupa chino the breakfast sandwiches are delicious.

Don't get me wrong super friendly service, but almost every single time I come here they manage to mess up my order whether that be making a hot drink iced or an iced drink hot, or not heating up bakery items. You're better off driving to Brookhaven. I wish I could give a better review because the staff is so nice and the location is cute and convenient, but for the $$ your order should be right the first time
This is a great location. I just wish they would make my drink right.
Predictable, solid service. Nice that your drive-thru drink orders are served to you on a tray to minimize touches.

Went through the drive-through and ordered iced coffee's super simple drinks they messed it up went inside got attitude from one of the barista's then another barista offered to remake our drinks there OK not the greatest iced coffee I've ever had.

This is a newer location with plenty of seating and friendly employees. Since it is a new location, it has the ability to make a COLD FOAM NITRO, which is an amazingly smooth, lightly sweet cold coffee drink served out of a tap.  My husband tried the COLD FOAM DARK COCOA NITRO, which is similarly excellent. I go miles out of my way to get the cold foam Nitro drinks...they're that good.

This place is definitely worth the stop.

It's a Starbucks located inside the Albertsons in goleta. Standard faire Starbuck items so nothing really new to add. Since it's so new they obviously have some growing pains (starbuck app not working properly on on visit, longer then normal time to get drinks made). 

The one thing I like about this location is the convenience factor as I can get a drink before or after I shop and not have to drive a block over to the other location for my caffeine fix.

The Nashville airport has two Starbucks locations. The other one can be a disaster (line of 50 people). I'm almost always flying Southwest (the other terminal), but sometimes I'll come to this Starbucks because I think it often has shorter lines. That's all. It's a Starbucks and maybe the lines are shorter than that other one.

So as someone who travels the country for work, I've been to at least 100 Starbuckseseseses but this one is my new favorite. Had a totally minor mishap about which I wasn't pressed at all, but the staff practically jumped through flaming hoops to help me out. And I should know from flaming.

Side bar one of the fellas working here is THE cutest cub in the entire world. Like, I would never hit on a service worker because that's a fucked up position to put someone in, and I don't come out to this area ever so I'll probably never see him again... but dude, if you see this, you are as gorgeous as you are kind. :P

This place is the embodiment of what I like to find in a good Starbucks. Good drinks, good food, fast service time is all the most appreciated. I decided to get a double smoked bacon and Gouda sandwich with an iced black tea, and within 5 minutes, they got my order out. Good food at good price, and the iced black tea met my expectation. I decided to get this drink sweetened, and my decision paid off. I drank the tea without hesitation after tasting the first sip, and sure enough will be back to get another.
Great location! TPA land side terminal is newly remodeled and the Starbucks is located in a great place. If you are dropping someone off it's a great place to grab a quick coffee!

A decent spot to grab a cup of coffee or some food before going through the day. This Starbucks is part of the University of the Sciences and will host a plethora of students. It will get crowded and loud during the rush, but slow down as people go to class. Staff are usually friendly depending on the day and service is quick   

For students:  
This starbucks is similar to regular ones, with the perks of being full of your classmates. You can use your declining balance or Devils dollars here. A great spot to get quick tasty breakfast. Literally the best option for food in general on this campus that doesn't cost you real money. 

For non students:
This location is nothing compared to a non university affiliated starbucks, but  you can always get the same options you can at other locations. They will take cash and card and treat you no different. There are usually many students here who will either be studying or eating, so seating can be tricky. Definitely a go to when you visit the school. 

Phone wi-fi does not work here for some reason. There just doesn't seem to be service and nothing ever connects. Laptops do work here however. 

This is a pretty nice locstion and typical location for a University. Better food here than most places and a nice atmosphere.

Holiday coffee beans are currently on sale, so my boyfriend and I decided to pop in and see what this location had in stock. Both of the baristas that were there were very helpful. One offered to check in the back because he had a feeling that what was on display was not everything that they had, and he was right! We ended up getting 2 bags of whole bean coffee and are looking forward to enjoying the Christmas and Holiday blends well into the new year. I would definitely return to this location when in the area!

Had a bad experience at this Starbucks. Made a mobile order from the app and chose the location. It took my money. We get to the front only to find out that this location does not except mobile orders. It sent it to the next Starbucks.  The barista said to call the other location and cancel my order and get a refund.   After ringing a very long time with no answer I hung up and called back.  More waiting but  when the gentleman answered he said he couldn't cancel my order.   They have no control over mobile orders.  Now I have to take my time to call the corporate office and try to get my money credited back.   They should not have locations listed on the app that don't accept mobile orders!!! What a mixed up way of doing business!!  Actually not this locations fault I guess , but they knew it was an issue and has been and haven't corrected it !!

Best mango-hibiscus drink! I'm not a regular at Starbucks but I've been in several & this one was by far the best one I've seen! Very open with tables or comfortable chairs and tables by window. Bathroom was clean and had baby changing table. There's also a small semi private room/area for work or studying or possibly nursing. All staff friendly! Also had many more choices for a non-coffee drinker like me where others I've been in typically offer much less. I recommend this location! Did forget to get my free birthday item though-oh well maybe later:)

Avoid coming here. It's close to my house so I keep trying it but my order is consistently incorrect. Also good luck getting anyone to acknowledge you. When I order through the app I have to go in the line to get anyone to talk to me. I will no longer come to this location. There are so many other better options nearby where the employees are actually friendly.

Spanking new Starbucks, open less the a week.
It has everything you expect from a Starbucks, and that's good... people are friendly and helpful 
Coffee is good, cold brew is on tap.....
Big store with plenty of seating both inside and outdoors
They have a drive thru as well...

For people eating at store, they now serve in glass or ceramic cups and plates. Nice touch and good for environment

My favorite Starbucks!  The staff is really fast and efficient!  They always get my order correct. 

MOBILE ORDERING!  I can't stress this enough! Register any Starbucks gift card, download the app, place your order and pay from the app 5-10 minutes before you plan to arrive, then just go inside and pick it up!  Super fast!  In the mornings, I will park in one of the lots of businesses that aren't open yet and just run inside.  Of course, you shouldn't park in any unauthorized lot while the business is open;  I only do this super early in the morning.  Avoiding the actual starbucks parking lot or drive-thru is key.

Also, you get a free drink on your birthday and earn free drinks the rest of the year when you pay with your Starbucks card.
Order the same thing every time from different locations and never have had a problem until today. Java chip crap tasted like regular coffee that had sat out for 2 days.

This location can be slow and has messed up my orders on occasion (asked for a half Splenda and they put in 5!). 

The staff is nice, but I've been sitting in line for 8 minutes with only one car checked out. But it's convenient so I keep coming back

Pros: Super friendly folks, and did not have to wait long. 

Cons: They were pretty busy and the lobby needed some TLC. 

Pro Tip: On your birthday, you get a free coffee, go for the Venti!

This is the absolute best Starbucks ever! The customer service is amazing. The people who work there put a smile on my face and make me laugh  every morning.

Glad that Nugget has a Starbucks! Makes it really convenient for guest. Just wish it was open 24 hour.

3 stars for the quality and the service-

5 stars for this location! They are always friendly and prompt. Today I put in an online order and came and waited and waited for it. This is a Starbucks, so we know what to expect when it comes to coffee and tea drinks and that's a good thing if you like Starbucks.
The people are friendly and helpful, almost offering a smile all the time...the seating area is big, clean and bright.... and they have a drive thru for people in a hurry. They also have outside eating area

Seriously the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. Super slow and always messes something up. I don't know if everyone is just new but the only reason I go there is because it's convenient but the only good thing is everyone is friendly.

The interior has a lot of bar type seating, which made good use of the space. The outdoor has a nice sized patio, too, if it's not super rainy like it was today!

Staff at this location are really friendly. I love going early mornings because they have tons of open seating as most of their business comes from the drive thru at this time. Even though I typically prefer local coffee shops this is a perfect place to work a few blocks from where I live. Make sure to sign up for rewards so you can get to free refill status on black coffee then get a coffee for a few bucks and refill it a handful of times.
could not order because the line was a joke. just a single employee working at 1pm on a friday. laughable.

The caramel creme brûlée is one of my favorite lattes this time of year. The candy whipped cream topping and the sweetness of the carmel latte compliment each other   They did not disappoint with the flavor and temp. I enjoyed my drink which made it worth the wait.

Amazing service.

I went inside during the morning and was helped immediately. All 4 items which I ordered were in stock and prepared expertly.

Everyone was working hard and making sure that they were getting the customers orders right. The greetings were very friendly and they made extra sure to make sure that everybody got the items that belong to them as soon as they were ready.

Congratulations to this relatively new Starbucks for getting the important things right which are the customer service and the accuracy and called the orders, besides having a nice pleasant environment in which to get your SB.

Kudos to Nickie who made sure all the customers were taken care of n

Amazing service and great atmosphere. The manager Joe greeted me nicely and I love how they seem to know all the local customers. Cheers y'all.

As expected, this location lived up to the hype. Nice to finally see a Starbucks on this side of town. The service was quick and accurate. They have the absolutely delicious cold brew on tap. I will be a regular at this location.

They work really hard for being in such a busy mall. Everyone is really nice to me every time I come in!

6. There is this little nook off to the side of the bar. Only two tables there, but it is a bit more intimate if you prefer not to sit in the main area. They have a similar location on the other side, with sofas.

By far the worst Starbucks in town. They are always short staffed or there is one employee opening the store with 20 customers because the other employees are always waking up late. Right now there are 3 people in line waiting with one employee but she cannot open not start taking customers since apparently she forgot the key to the register.
The qualities varies depending on who opens. So since I take the shuttle from the nugget parking lot to work I rely on this location only to not even be served on time without getting my morning coffee since one poor girl can not assist 10 customers at a time when there is an even in town.

I am done with this store!!! I have called and called, over and over! Corporate knows the problems this store has with the training issues but Jessica the manager is either oblivious or has an extreme turnover rate that makes teaching impossible. 
Waiting 15 minutes for coffee is bs especially when you place a mobile order and they don't start working on it until you get there. 
And there are 4 people working with NO ONE THERE. Seriously no one in the drive through and no one in the store. 
They have to be the single Starbucks issue in the whole region. 
For the love of god get it together

Waited 35 minutes in the drive-thru on more than one occasion when there was about 6-7 cars in it each time. Drinks were okay but they have got to get a better system for the drive-thru. Inside might be faster but the drive-thru is not quick by any means.

Extremely friendly! Me and my wife and her dog are moving from Seattle to Nashville and spent the night near the Starbucks last night. Before hitting the road we stopped here for coffee and breakfast. The two ladies that took our order and gave us our food we're both exceptionally friendly.

The food and drinks we're both fresh and the appropriate temperatures. They also offered us a "pup cup"

Me and my wife both had the double smoked bacon cheddar sandwich. I got some large guava juice thing and my wife got a Frappuccino.
Great spot for morning breakfast and coffee.  Usually very busy but quick moving. Overall good service and drive through usually moves well.

This location is smaller than most locations I've visited. The layout is galley style, quite narrow, with a couple of leather seats by the entrance. During warmer months the outdoor seating is great if you want to avoid feeling crowded inside. 

The staff is friendly. I can't remember a time when I wasn't greeted even during peak times. 

The only downside with this location is getting in/out during rush hour. The traffic on Pendleton Pike can be challenging to navigate. If you're familiar with the area the "back way" will save some time and sanity if you opt not to cross multiple lanes to go east.

This location is in a prime location (shopping center with a rivaling Starbucks a few stores down). It also has a drive-thru which you would think would be fast. Unfortunately, we were waiting five-seven minutes and the line was not moving whatsoever. We decided to park and go in. The app said our food we ordered would be ready soon, yet we had to wait another five-seven minutes inside to get our drinks and food. Everyone inside was waiting for their orders. They did not seem to have enough employees working. I ordered a Tall Mocha Frappuccino with skinny mocha syrup, frappuccino chips, heavy cream, and whipped cream, a Short hot White Chocolate Mocha, a bacon, Gouda, and egg sandwich, and pumpkin bread. My Frappuccino seemed to have a lot of ice, I barely tasted any flavor. My pumpkin bread seemed fine - I didn't realize there were pumpkin seeds on the top, but it was fine. We left the parking lot after eating in the car and the car that was originally in front of us just finished ordering (so that goes to show you how slow the drive thru line was). They also did not have any straws at the station where you fill in your own milk and sugar - I had to ask a barista to get me a straw from behind the counter, and two other customers had to also ask for them. They should have someone fill up straws at the coffee bar.

This place is always packed. While most lines are long and annoying this location does everything they can to get you your coffee as fast as possible. I always enjoy my visit here whether it's the drive through or when I come inside, the people who work here are some of the most interesting people I have ever met!  Today, the line was wrapped around the building and there must have been 20 people inside waiting, but Christian still took the time to help me with my order as well as using the Starbucks app for the first time!  He didn't get annoyed at me for asking questions when they were slammed!  He went out of his way to make my visit the best and he saved me 6$ !!!!  As I sit here typing this review I can hear him helping customers with such a positive attitude even though the door keeps opening and people are pouring in to get their drinks!!!  All I hear from the staff who are working their @$$3$ off right now is "have a great day" and "welcome to Starbucks ". They are all working together as a team and drinks are flying off the counter!!!!  I love this location!!!
Typical Starbucks! Has a drive thru, some outdoor seating outside (not a lot), and minimal inside seating. We were walking by and needing a cooling drink, so it worked. But just another Starbucks!

This Starbucks is probably one of the worst mannered. Employees seem irritated quickly & are NOT Friendly. I always get my Frappuccino double blended as I hate crunching on ice. The barista taking my order asked me in a very rude way WHY I get my drink this way & when I answered he Scoffed at me. I will NOT be returning or giving my business to this location. Anymore.

The baristas at this Starbucks are SO FREAKING NICE that I seriously don't know how to deal.

This morning the barista working the drive-thru recognized my baby boy (from our visit yesterday) and offered him a "puppachino".

Wait, what? YOU'VE NEVER HEARD OF A PUPPACHINO? 

Well, I hadn't either. 

It's a cup with a bit of whipped cream.

So now you're wondering if my baby liked it...

I hold these photos to be self-evident.

Carry on.

Nothing like going to starbucks and waiting 40 plus minutes for 2 cold brews to only see a 4th employee (army print crew neck) come out of the back and distract the other 3 workers (who were working hard).
Waited 20 minutes for my mobile order to be completed of cold brew coffee. Still not done and was told I could not have a refund.

This Starbucks is my go to location since it's right by the house. Consistency is key and this location always comes through. Warm and friendly greeting upon arrival, quick to get your order and have you on your way promptly. It can get a bit busy but the staff works hard to keep customers moving.

Parking is horrible. The service is way below standards unless the store's manager Cara is there. There is a brand new drive thru Starbucks just 1/3 of a mile south at Robb & Sharlands right next to the I-80 freeway.

The employees freely share the only reason Starbucks didn't close this outdated store when the new one right down the street opened is the company can't get out of their lease. 

You can avoid a store full of loud McQueen High School students by passing this location up.
Hands down one of the BEST starbucks I've ever been too. Wow is this staff amazing - good job starbucks!
Two words , pumpkin latte! So delicious and they are pretty friendly over at this location

This is my go to location for my Friday Morning O made it through the week treat. The staff is always friendly. The service is on point with speed and accuracy. I try to avoid other locations as this one is like home. My kids also love coming here as the staff treats them as if they are just as important. Their favorite is the hot cocoa and mine is the Hot Cafe Latte Venti. The staff seem like they really enjoy what they do. 

If I happen to use the drive thru (usually a walk in for coffee kind of girl), the service is no different. The line moves quickly and no issues with the order where you have to go back inside to get it corrected. I also love their seasonal drink specials.

The worst Starbucks I've ever been to.  I live directly by this location but I drive the 15 min drive over to the 135 location.  I've have been through the drive thru maybe 6 times.... Drove off twice after 15 min waits with only 3 or 4 cars in line.  Was served tall coffee when ordered grande.  And the last time I gave it a shot the lid I was served had red lipstick already on it. I am a male that does not wear lipstick so this was a final straw for me.  Stay away.
Great location, and my order was made perfectly and quickly. So glad to have another Starbucks location in the City!
Every single time I've been to this Starbucks they've gotten my drink wrong. This is the closest one to my house and I'm going to have to start going out of the way to find another one.
Best Starbucks in Reno! The staff here are the nicest. And the drinks here are the best!
Needs more workers! Lines a lot of times are super long! They also move slow.Drinks are usually alright.
Longest time being in the line while even placing a mobile order then told to move to the patio area so they can bring my drink out!!! Why the heck do you have mobile ordering?????

Starbucks as far as drinks go is... Well.... Starbucks. They're always exactly the same. I know what to expect and that's what I get. So that's the reason for the solid three stars. What baffles me about this location is that I have been going there consistently since I moved to this side of town about three years ago. And by consistently, I mean at least three times a week, every single week. They still do not know my name. Every time I go in, they act like its the first time they have ever seen me. They're never rude, but they're not really that nice and even when they're nice- they definitely don't recognize me. The QT employees next door recognize me more and they have only been seeing me for about 4 months... Step it up Starbucks. Please.
Quick service in the drive thru, Annabelle was the nicest barista we've ever encountered. Very friendly, had the best attitude of anyone I've come across at a Starbucks.

I have been going to Starbucks for so many years that it's almost a daily event for me and my hubby!  I'm so glad they are open thru this awful pandemic!

You know what's funny:  I don't like coffee at all. The only way I drink it is if doesn't taste or smell like coffee!

I actually feel bad for the employees who take & prepare my beverage, lol. 

I am so picky. My order is always the same and EXTREMELY specific. I literally specify exactly how I want it and considering how expensive they are, I believe I should "get what I pay for" (I'm not trying to be difficult, I just w as want what I want, ya know?)

So, I politely say, "Hiiiii, Can I please have a HOT Venti Sugar-Free Carmel Macchiato with 9 pumps of your Sugar-Free Vanilla Syrup, just 1 Shot of Espresso, 2% Milk & 4 Splenda with a large Straw".  

Now if you've read my reviews, you know that's just my personality. I'm not rude at all, I am always super polite (unless you're rude, lol. 

Now, I always tell my hubby to wait a sec before pulling away/leaving until I sip it to make sure it's right bc if not, I'm going to send it back & ask them to make a new one. 

I mean, for what we are paying, we deserve to have it right,  Right?  Yup. 

So, I highly recommend that you go to Starbucks and get a Yummy beverage made just for you to your specifications!!

I Love, Love, Love Starbucks Hot Carmel Macchiato

I really like to go to this Starbucks. This location can get pretty busy. Lots of people seem to meet up here or do their homework or study. I also like to come here and get some of my schoolwork done in the evenings. I pretty much always order the caramel macchiato and it is always good. They also have a drive thru here and it usually goes pretty fast they never have to wait long even when there are a lot of cars.

I come to this at Starbucks drive thru pretty religiously since it's close to work and they have the friendliest baristas. I usually see the same guy and thought man he's really friendly, but then I've had a few other people mixed in where I drove away delighted at how friendly and outgoing they are.

This is a great Starbucks location just for the loft upstairs. Great people watching opportunities, and in a charming older building.

Minus 1 star because my latte tasted a little burnt.

This Starbucks saved my family and I from a bad time. After having dealt with horrible service at a local restaurant for my mother in laws birthday, we came here to grab coffee and cut a small cake for her. The staff went above and beyond, especially one of the gentlemen working. He gave us plates and forks and made sure we were ok. They were out of decaf and we came closer to closing and he did not hesitate to brew some for us (it was night time so caffeine didn't seem like a good idea.) Our drinks were all great and we were able to share a special moment for a special day in an unexpected place. My respect for the staff at this Starbucks for exceptional customer service!

I'm a regular there, in fact I'm there every morning and gotta say that most of the time when I pull up to the front my drink is all ready made and waiting for me as soon as I walk in. The employees there are great, never had a problem.
Luckily I was one of the first in line but it was very slow,I have to say it was not the best Starbucks Ive been to.

Have been coming here a few times a week for the past two years. It's Starbucks, it's the only one close to the hospitals and such here on S Grand so it's a popular spot. They do get busy but it's always service with a smile, they have been hiring some new great baristas recently as well! 
Always enjoy time spent here! 

*update* still coming here, still great staff - Kori, Erika, Ella, Miranda, the whole team is just fantastic!  
Also for anyone complaining about wait times, this place gets slammed - it's on S Grand one of the busiest streets! Perhaps try taking a seat and people watching while you wait, or do a mobile order as you leave the house (make your drink extra hot.)

I would not recommend having babies here. The owners were very displeased, everyone kept giving me judgmental looks. and they weren't supportive at all, in this time of great stress. If i could rate 0 stars, i most definitely would. when i asked for assistance they told me i was too young and banned me from all starbucks franchises. don't have babies here!

I honestly avoid going to any starbucks on campus because I had a bad experience with the staff. They're extremely rude and honestly unprofessional. I walked up to the barista assuming she was gonna take my order bc she was standing at the register. As i told her my order, she told me she's not taking it and continued to mock me with her co workers. Honestly a bunch of weirdos. I recently revisited the starbucks again and didnt recognize any of the workers so i think they have new staff. The new people are nicer and actually do their job professionally.
Great Starbucks location. Wildly efficient drive-thru. Nice staff - very friendly and helpful.

They suck here and they don't even care they suck. I had to stop.... well I tried to stop because my son wanted a treat after he just played a very tough football game. the drive thru was ridiculously long and slow as usual so I went inside. there with three people in line (that should have been my clue) I was in line for almost 6 minutes before I spoke to the lady in front of me(I assumed she had placed her order). I eventually asked her if she as done with things she said no! The woman in front of her left and I am assumung she had not placed her order either. They're inefficient and unprofessional here. (so that was from a visit in Oct 2016)

I have since been back. This branch is still ridiculously and I mean ridiculously slow. Poor management in my opinion because I have been to other locations who have had lines 3x as long and they work magain (shot out to the Capitol Ave location). I have now started going to Dunkin Donuts off of 79th and Fall Creek or I go to the Starbucks inside the Geist Crossing Kroger.

Go thru the drive thru today to order a strawberry açaí. Place my order and get to the window To get told we can't make it with light ice and light water, the Açaí cost too much is what the employee said to us. Well I'm not paying you for water!! Every other location has made it the way I've ask for it. Will never return to this location. Plus the Employee got all pissy when I canceled the order after they told me that. Absolutely horrible customer service
Crazy! So I wanted to order a coffee and buy one of their reusable cups. I asked if the reusable cup could be rinsed out before putting my coffee in it.  I got a BIG no! What? Crazy!
Shirley has stupendous customer service. It's very hard to come across someone who is so nice and so welcoming in the mornings. She is such a dear and would like to thank her for being so kind!

So I have been going every weekend. I used to go starbucks with my 2 dogs in the drive thru for over a year. I have a 2 mixed breeds. My one is a Chesaspeak bay retriever named Cinnamon and a mixed breed named Gigi. Gigi looks like an american bully but she is mixed with a little bit of everything. So I was told because my dogs scare people from any employee, not the store manager, because of how my dogs look and sound I have to order inside and come in to get their puppinchinos. I understand people are scared of my dogs. Which I am a understanding person. I was not asked roll up my windows which I lock them when I go through but I was never given that option. I did contact cooperate but they said they will contact the store manager. I have more of an issue that the employee told me and not the store manager.

I live downtown and pass the Casinos everyday. I've made it a ritual to grab cold coffee even though the weather says grab a hot one!. I'm weird like that. 
  So I've know for years there's been a StarBucks inside Silver Legacy and another  SB  in the Eldorado. Silver legacy has remained closed so If you need some fresh beans grounded up go towards the Eldorado far southeast corner and you'll find it there.
    Today to get the party started I'm going with a Venti Vanilla Sweet Cream Nitro Cold Brew shaken not stirred. On this weekday there's no line at alll. On a weekend or Holiday be prepared for a little wait around 10 minutes.
  Other then that it's your above average Starbucks with super friendly service from happy faces located conveniently inside the Casino for all you visitors and locals.  enjoy!

I got in an out of this Starbucks so quick!  This location is at the Omni, so I think a lot of people forget about this Starbucks.  Parking can be such a pain to run in and out of any coffee shop downtown.  I shouldn't admit this, but I did park in the no parking/valet section, which helped make this and easy in and out trip.  

There were a couple guys ordering together in front of me and one lady working behind the counter.  Once the guys moved out of the way, the lady behind the counter looked at me, but didn't acknowledge by saying hi or I'll be with you minute (why it got 4 stars).  She finally acknowledged me and became super talkative when another lady came out from the back. 

The lady who came out from the back is the one who made my drink (Chai).  She was so nice and friendly!  My drink also tasted great.  I can't tell you how many times I go to Starbucks and the Chai has no flavor and/or is watered down (even though I order it without water).  But props to this lady for doing it right!

I'm typing this from this Starbucks on their wifi. Our barista was so nice, she let my friend have the extra from my Vivanno blend. I've been here twice. It's nice and quiet, lots of space and friendly workers. Normally I don't review chains, but I had to make an exception.

This is the closest one to my house and it has the added benefit of having a drive through window. The staff has always been top notch and the drinks have always been tasty. The parking lot sucks and the drive thru is usually hanging out into the street.

This Starbucks is convenient because it is in the mall, however the people were so rude. They were so rude when i asked questions and didn't have patience. They also made my drink horrible because i asked for something extra in it.

Staff is really friendly but the service is so incredibly slow. The drive through line is painful. The starbucks in Wayne never has this issue. You buzz right through. Its so frustrating. It doesn't matter if there are 3 cars or 5 cars in front of you. It always takes forever.

I go to starbucks quite often and I love the customer service that I have experienced at each location.. except for this one! I will never return to this location. I decided against my usually location on Friday the 25th because I was taking my kids to see Santa at the Christmas craft show. I got my daughter a vanilla bean frap and myself a salted carmel mocha frap. My mother also got a iced mocha. My daughters drink tasted just fine. However my drink and my mothers was horrible, it had some burnt taste or something nasty to it. I couldn't even drink it, my mother said she could because her wasn't as bad as mine , now mine didn't have a sweet taste, it tasted nothing like it should have been. I took my drink back up to the barista who was finishing the drinks and handing them to the customers. I told her my drink did not taste right, she just looked at me blankly, so I continued and said it tasted burnt or something and she was welcome to taste it herself. She said soooo? Well, so .. make me a new one. That is part of the starbucks motto, better yet I believe they have signs stating this very thing. she seemed annoyed, took my drink threw it in the trash and made me a new one. after a couple minutes she called me back up and handed me the new one, I thanked her and walked over to the table. My drink tasted the way it was supposed to, so I walked back over to her and said again I appreciate it and thank you, this ladys response was mmhmm.. This pissed me off, mmhmm thanks for doing your damn job! This customer service is horrible, and im paying for a product you should make it right if you don't want to do it again, mind you again my mothers drink was bad too but she didn't want to deal with her after I did. I will never return to this location. HORRIBLE!

Really disappointed at the non friendliness of the employees. No customers but 2 others and it still took three employees eight minutes to make my iced coffee. I think it sat at the drive up for a while. Yet no apologies or smiles. I will go to Panera next time.

Consistently the slowest service of any Starbucks I have ever encountered across the country. I waited until I visited at least a handful of times before reviewing. Less chatting with friends and other employees and more brewing, please.

I had a few minutes before my flight was called to board. It was super cold and super early, which means I needed a good, strong, and hot beverage in my tummy. I walked the long, boring hallway to score a soy latte, which was practically my salvation for this morning.

The employee was super nice and took my order promptly. This location wasn't crowded at all, which was perfect for me since I'm a grouch prior to 11am. My hot coffee was ready in about 1 minute. I walked the long and boring hallway back to my terminal with the holy grail in my hand. 

The soy latte was perfect. Hot but not scalding hot, thankfully. I was able to get my caffeine infusion before the flight was called to board. I'm pretty sure the other passengers were quite jealous of my tonic. It may have something to do with my yummy noises I made as I made quick work of my tasty treat.

Great drive thru service. Better than Chick Fil A. Kara and Connor are the best! They always remember my order, along with another girl that works the window who I don't know her name. Always friendly and fast! I get the hazelnut iced coffee with light cream and it is always correct and consistent. Love this location!

This one is a staple. Close to school, good hours, and plenty of seating. It's always filled with fellow students, and there's always a few cars in the drive through, a testament to it's popularity. All the employees (that I've interacted with) are very pleasant and the restrooms (for those that care) are well kept!

I can see where parking could get a little hairy or be a smidgen of a hike around the corner but this plaza, for a strip mall, is actually pretty elegant and the views of the mountains all around make it one of the more scenic parking lots I've ever been in. 

The interior of this Starbucks is on the small side but they have multiple umbrella'd tables on the outside that are also in the shade. 

Service was friendly and even more efficient than your average SBux, imo.

Liquid hot rich hugs in cups lovingly prepared by coffee barista artisans!

I like to sip the wonderful blend and let it tantalize my soul with its powerful beauty.

Coffee enriches life! Lights the soul! And engages the mind!

Starbucks you are a joy in a world that needs more of it!

They just opened last year and every time we pass by they are alway super super busy. The line is always at least 5 people. But they actually move pretty fast because they have enough people working so that's good. If you like Starbucks then make sure stopping by when you are shopping.

I stop here multiple times a week and have for 18 months or so. MJ has been an amazing barista and host nearly every stop. First name basis, always welcoming and really brings the joy to our interactions. Staff is always kind, coffee is always hot (or cold, seasonality you know) and I really appreciate the break in the day this stop provides. Keep up the good vibes MJ and crew

I was here for the free coffee special, it is a decent size store with plenty of parking.  It was packed.  The ordering line is long, but the staff is very helpful and efficient.  The waiting time is 15 minutes but is understandable.  I do see the  barista got frustrated with the workload, however, the drinks that I got didn't drop the quality.

11/01 - Update: The service is great every time I am at this location.  I got the free drink and I loaded up my drink to the limit.  No complaint, no fuss.
They're closed until further notice ): there's a sign blocking the drive thru saying not much more than that, hopefully they will reopen soon and I'll change my stars! I hope y'all are all good :)

Love Starbucks, this location on is the worst at well as the dirtiest I have ever been.  The coffee is always warm never hot and the drive through is absolutely filthy. I complain to the manager after waiting 36 minutes at the drive through, not because of the unexplained wait but about the dirt and food  at the pickup window.   I will not be going to this one again.  The odd thing is the manager seems to not care about anything other than profit which as we all know is the  fastest way to lose customers.

I go to this location all the time and normally receive good service and products, you have to wait because the parking lot is a disaster but they make it work! Today, I had to have a brand new barista. I swear they gave me brown sugar milk. Any time I've ever ordered the venti shaken espresso it's a medium shade of brown. Even fully stirred this drink was white! Tasted awful, way too sweet, and again, probably half the amount of espresso. Very disappointed.

To say this is a Starbucks is giving Starbucks a bad name! I frequent Starbucks an average of 4 days a week. I ordered an iced almond milk latte and it tasted like burnt wax! I haven't ever had coffee taste like this. Five dollars for something this unpalatable is sad.

My wife and I were at this location today, I'm Hispanic and she's Caucasian, I figured that's why the bad service we got. 

They never called my name, my drink had a extreme mint taste it was undrinkable and my wife's chocolate tasted more like water with some chocolate tint to it. Again, they never called my name, our drinks were just sitting there at the bar and my wife had to pick one up and verify if it was ours... horrible drinks, for almost $10 dollars, I ended up putting this drink where they belong (in the trash) and stopped at a gas station and bought us some $2.00 hot drinks. I'm placing this review on Google as well and every other place available, I would hate to see other Hispanics go trough what I went. I'm attaching a picture of the watery looking nasty drinks we got.
Staff is nice but the wait was ridiculously long. If you're in a hurry stop somewhere else.
Over 23 min for two drinks. Scorching hot coffee and iced cold hot chocolate. Crew inside is oblivious to what they are doing.

The best and friendly Starbucks location jn St. Louis! Never have to wait long here. This location was like my secret spot but others have found it too. They are fast and no waiting for hours like other locations. My personal fave!

We have experienced this Starbucks go down hill. All the ladies that work here are angry at their customers, Kim used to be fantastic greeter in the morning, now she won't even make eye contact...the service attitude destroys good mornings..so we don't go in this location any more.

Also, the average amount of time is ridiculous..
Overall it's a horrible customer experience.

Come on get with it..

Let me start off by saying this place is very very busy. You will need to bring your patience with you. They are understaffed, not the fault of the workers. Hopefully someone will see this and do something about it. Waited 30 minutes in line for coffee. Yes that's a long time. They need more staff. The staff they have for the volume of people they get doesn't match. Staff is amazing and friendly(with the exception of the two ladies that just left when their teammates needed them the most...sMH.  We watched them just walk away and never communicate to their teammates where they were going). We have been at the hotel for three days now and they work non stop alllllll day! Probably the hardest working folks I've seen at a Starbucks! These lines are crazy. Their little shop is clean and organized. People walk away happy with their coffee and no one in line has complained about the long wait. I hope these folks are getting some amazing stock options. Someone needs to acknowledge this store and staff. I can't say that enough. Special shout out to Gracie that was making all these drinks alone and Rachel for holding down the front and orders. The other two chicks...well they would be better off counting stars for NASA. I feel sooo bad for these two girls. Starbucks, time for a secret shopper at this place!

Loving this Starbucks!  Elegantly situated in the Omni Downtown, the chandeliers and cozy tables set the mood.  Our order was cheerfully taken and completed in record time.  I especially appreciated the patience and knowledge of the barista, as I asked many questions looking to try something new.  

Outdoor seating available and shaded.  Great place to sit and watch the activities on Georgia Street. Great work space for your internet needs.  Quiet and charming this also makes a great meeting place for friends.

Staff and vibe are immaculate. Would like to thank Denise for making my mornings. 

Appreciate that they check on masking and ID people eating in the store for the vax cards.

Love you guys

This will always be my favorite Starbucks because of all the memories I have here. It's very cozy and has a fireplace with sofas around. I usually get good service here, although there have been a couple attitude-y baristas. It's located next to Subway/Papa John's and the Raley's shopping center, so it's fairly convenient. It's also where all the McQueen kids frequent (I know because I was here all the time when I went to McQ) so if you're anti-teenagers, don't come here. Otherwise, it's pretty great for a Starbucks! Come in and get your frapp on :)

I was having a panic attack so I had my headphones in and I had only been seeing 1 person working the register. I guess another person hopped on and started yelling for me but I didn't realize it because, again, middle of a panic attack and trying to reduce anxiety. But then she yelled at me and was hateful during our interaction and then the lady who gave my my drink was also super rude and hateful. I can't imagine someone hard of hearing going on and getting that type of disrespect. I cried for a bit and am still trying to avoid people but it ruined my day.

Horrible customer service. The people working the driveway are always so upset and rude. Every single time I order a HOT breakfast sandwich they come out freezing cold and they will not give me another or reheat. Worst starbucks location ever.

Prime location on the way to/from work or accessing highway 40 at Jefferson.  I appreciate the alternative to the busy DelTaco location at Grand and 40. 

Interior is a bright, welcoming, open floor plan with plenty of seating once we get back to dining, working, meeting, chillaxing at cafes again. The restrooms are upscale chic as a public restroom can be with the soap/water flow/dryer in a single sink location.  This really cuts down on paper towel waste  it I like to have a little tissue to open the door after washing my hands personally. 

Service was prompt and pleasant (I was the only one brave enough to walk inside I guess) the drive thru was popping.  My coffee was made just as I'd requested and I was on my merry way. 

Oh, plenty of outdoor patio seating and parking available. 

~Christy

WARNING: This Starbucks does not keep consistent hours. The sign on their drive thru window says they are open every day 6:00am-8:30pm. But this is only true 60% of the time. Today they randomly closed at 5:00pm. Tomorrow it might be 6:00pm. And I'm not even sure if they consistently open at the same time every day. Don't waste your time - there is a Starbucks at the exit before and 2 exits after that are far superior in terms of service and consistency.
