1 star because I can't give 0. I never rate places negatively. This Starbucks is terrible. Since this is about the 8th time in the last 2mos I got my very simple, literal 2 ingredient drink (iced coffee, milk, no sugar) made wrong, I made sure said no sweetener like 6 times to the cashier. When she repeated it to me, I said it again. After 30 mins of standing in there, I made the mistake of rushing out and not trying it before I left. Do you think there was sugar in it when I finally got it home?

The wait times are outrageous and the drinks are consistently wrong.

I understand people being overwhelmed and making mistakes. Once again I never give bad ratings. But a place selling $4 coffees simply cannot be this bad at coffee.
One of the best Starbucks I've been to. The employees are always nice and fun. Plus the drinks and food are always amazing. It's always my go to for a coffee shop.
Slowest Starbucks. Waited 30 minutes for two drinks. Gave us our food right away and was cold by the time we got our drinks.

I go here because it's the closest Starbucks to my home, so +1 star for convenience.  Another star for a large parking lot.

Although I have never been to this location when it is "busy," the staff is not very warm or welcoming.  I've gotten this vibe at other Starbucks locations when they were so crowded with 10+ people in line.  On one occasion, one of the employees handed me my drink with the lid not tightly on; therefore some of it spilled onto the counter and also a decent amount on my hand.  I didn't have any burns but it was not exactly pleasant.  Did he apologize?  No, he told me that I don't need to clean up the spill and he will get to it later.  Not cool, man.

Go here to get your coffee.  I've never gotten my drink done incorrectly (granted I only drink iced coffee without anything added or a simple blonde roast).  Don't come here expecting warm, smiley service.

Stopped in to grab some coffee and banana bread while I waited for an appointment. Seems to be a pretty busy location, so I was really shocked they don't have a drive thru. 

There was quite a wait for my Peppermint Mocha, but they seemed pretty busy. Service was friendly. It's a nice, spacious location that looks good for working or casual business meet ups. Having no drive thru is the only downside I see to this location.

Oof, this was a hot mess experience. I would typically describe my frequent visits to this Terminal A Starbucks location as "meh" but this particular visit especially unfortunate. They were busy as usual and it seemed that two of the three employees were bringing their A game while the third, Amber, was a weak link. Oh man, where to begin?  Despite the crazy busy line of travelers, she was texting on her phone (germs galore) then proceeded to plug her phone in to charge with the cord wrapped around the nozzle of the whipped cream bottle and phone on top of everything... Note that she was the individual creating everyone's drinks. 

She then wiped her nose on hand while making preparing a drink. Seriously, this was a health department nightmare. 

She then talked to another airport employee about how much each of them were paid and stopped working (while the store was super busy...) to ask these tacky questions openly. 

I don't want to read too far into it but I could feel a sense of frustration from her teammates. Here's to improvements and additional training...

I was in a really desperate place mentally this morning as I pulled into the drive thru of this Starbucks. The encouraging signs that read "You are enough," "you are worthy," and "be kind" paired with the friendly voice through the speaker made all the difference in my day. Thank you for putting so much kindness into the world. Even though you don't always see it, it helps people. 8/19/2021

Placed my order at 1:00 on the app. I got iced coffee with some vanilla syrup and cream. Arrived at 1:13. My order said it was ready at 1:13. It was a Sunday afternoon. Not super busy. Not a lot of people. They did not get my order out until 1:30.....

For the past few weeks I've been ordering a (triple shot) venti chestnut praline latte, nearly every day at this (my favorite and closest) Starbucks.

The past few days, the latte has been less than 2/3 full. I know that whipped cream melts almost immediately in hot coffee, and I expect a little space, but this is STUPID. 

I'm spending nearly $6.50 on one of these and I'm getting ripped off.

I'm fa la la la la la la la sick of this.

This morning the problem is the ability to accept payments other than cash. These coffee geniuses don't tell their customers about the purchasing limitations until after one is trapped in a 10 minute drive through. This is simply pathetic customer abuse. Is it so hard to show a little common sense and respect towards customers?

I have reviewed this Starbucks before, and for this exact same reason. Why is this location just completely unable to remain open for a fixed schedule? For the past 2 weeks they have either been closed or running on a reduced schedule. There is NO EXCUSE for this. Someone on your team got COVID? Not an excuse, you are a fucking business. Your team is doing training? Not an excuse, do it outside of business hours. There is nothing more important to a BUSINESS than making MONEY and this reduced schedule/not being open is bullshit. This location just needs to be closed down. There is a Starbucks the next exit down with better service anyways. Please Starbucks, get a hold on this location. Get it under control. Poor leadership and business decisions being made here.

I just picked up my order at Starbucks when I realized I ordered from the WRONG place! Such a stupid mistake on my part. I felt so bad and  thought they'd be mad or salty, but they were SO incredibly nice!! They really made my day. They made my drink for me anyways and LOOK they even put a little heart on my cup! I'm really trying not to cry in the office rn.
I LOVE THIS STARBUCKS! I noticed that they are so nice to me every time I go (i go probably too much for my own good ) this time was just so extraordinary I wanted to share. I think kindness goes a long way no matter how big or small, and the people working here really do their best to extend that. Tipping them every time I go, and I encourage everyone to absolutely tip them! They deserve all and only good things

Hi! Love this Starbucks store! But could you please update your hours to reflect when you are actually open during COVID? Over the past 10 months, the store (drive-through) is closed 90% of the time I've stopped by, but the website and all of the map apps say it's open. Thank you!
Service has gotten much better at this Starbucks so I'm taking my 2 star review to 4 star

Thought I'd stop by here to pick up something cool and refreshing for my darling wife - A "pink drink" - I recalled that it was something that she wanted to try. I pick it, before picking my wife up, then head out towards Oro Valley and stopped in the parking lot of a new restaurant we wanted to try. Before I could get outside and place an order, my wife tells me "Honey, look at this..." I then take a look - her "pink drink" Should have been called "green fungus cooler", as the strawberries provided were overripe, decomposing, and Riddled with green, gray and blue penicillin... 'If angry face emoji's were allowed in this review, the next 10 lines would be loaded with them one after another.

Needless to say, and I'm speaking as a disappointed husband - I will not be returning to this location...!

I'm a visual person, so I've provided pictures...

Great service, and I come here every two days. Whenever I end up coming in and ordering there are several super friendly, cheerful baristas ready to craft me that perfect beverage. I have never had an issue here. I've order specialty creations I found on the internet, regular items, and have sometimes just said "Surprise ME!" to see what happens. Yum! 

Tip: The parking lot fills up at certain times, so you might want to do a mobile order to quickly run in and run out. I've used this service several times, have never been disappointed! It is also very convenient if you are on the way to work!

These very simple people have a very hard time both listening and making coffee.  I find it amazing that so many people have such a hard time making large coffee with cream and Splenda.   Also generally speaking the cream and sugar are supposed to be in the cup not all over the outside of the cup.
Closed at 5 on New Year's Eve! I get closing early but not at 5. Lost my business for all of 2022

Typically I avoid drive thru lines when they are really long but this place was so fast & on point with my order it was crazy. There was at least 10 cars ahead of me & I kid you not I waited only two minutes for my order. My Carmel macchiato was so good I finished it within minutes. I'll definitely be back!

DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY!! 
I went shopping with my family at the outlets and decided to stop and get my usual caramel frappuccino. After placing my order, I then waited about 20 minutes to get my drink. They proceeded to tell me they are out of whipped cream. The drink came and it was watered down and tasteless. I requested a remake and they did so somewhat willingly and the drink still tasted terrible.
This is an excellent Starbucks location. The employees are kind, quick, and always on point. In particular, I was helped by a barista named Baylee who brightened my whole afternoon. Thanks Baylee!

I like this Starbucks. I have quite a few to select from near where I work. I'm not going to lie, I actually loove Starbs & convenience of having 3-4 close ones near me makes me feel spoiled rotten. The only downside is that my pocketbook isn't the biggest fan of my frequent coffee visits.

I don't like the crammed parking lot, so I rarely go inside. Drive through is the way to go @this location. Download their app. for BOGO drink specials, usually on a Thu. and alerts on innovative, new drinks...That's one consistent thing I love about Starbs, always expanding & creating new drinks - another reason I'm addicted!

I've tried nearly all the drinks on their menu, but I've really been obsessed with their Caramel Macchiato 'cause it's similar to an Iced Latte. I get a Venti with one pump of Caramel, light ice & it comes with 3 shots of espresso. Will I regret trying to sleep later on tonight after getting a coffee at 6:21pm? Maybe...Will my body thank me for the caffeine rush? YES, PLEASE! :-)

Love Starbucks on Rob Drive in Sharlands Terr. it's always clean inside drive-through is always clean coffees are of course is always good and their sandwiches are very good they have a nice mozzarella tomato and basil sandwich for those of us who don't eat meat
Bad Starbucks service!!!!    So slow and machine broke.   No smile either.    Drink a coffee,  move faster and get with the program.
I have been to this Starbucks multiple times. They are very busy and they move fast. I haven't had a complaint on my drink. They are just another mall Starbucks.

This location seems to continually go down hill. The most annoying new habit for them is randomly closing the drive thru at various times throughout the day for no apparent reason. I have a broken foot so I called to make sure it was open so I didn't waste my time. She said it was and in the 5 minutes it had taken me to get from my house to this location, they closed it with cars still in line. It's not even 10am yet. It seems like whoever is running things doesn't put in orders when needed either,  so simple things like tea, protective cup sleeves, and stoppers will be unavailable at random times. It's frustrating because this is the closest location for me, but I think I'll just be going to a different place from now on so I'm not wasting my time with this nonsense. If you don't want to keep losing long time customers, I'd suggest getting your shop in order.

I visited this location today.
It was not really busy. For the 1st time in all my experiences I received my order and I did not have the labels on the cups, very small issues. But bigger issue is both my drinks were made wrong. My pink drink was just coconut milk and floating strawberries. My Carmel ribbon was on about 2 inches of drink. The rest was Whip cream. I tried to call 7 times . Of course the 1 time I didn't get a recipient is the time my order was wrong. Next time I will taste before I leave. I am sure this is not the normal.

This is a fantastic Starbucks in the heart of Downtown Franklin. Good line management, friendly baristas and clean store. Excited to see what the remodel brings. It is a great Starbucks but if you are visiting and want something local walk down the same street to Frothy Monkey for an amazing local business that has a coffee stand inside their cafe/restaurant.

The wifi here is TERRIBLE... it was so bad that I actually had to go somewhere else to study. Also this location was a little dingy looking, as if the floors were not clean and tables were not wiped. People seemed friendly enough, but I don't know if I will be back just because the wifi was terrible, and I was unsure about this location's cleanliness. There was just too much debris everywhere for my liking. On top of that, I didn't like how it was freezing cold in there. Everywhere I moved.. the AC seemed to be blasting on me.
This by far is the SLOWEST Starbucks I have EVER been to. OMG 30 minutes in drive thru for one drink. Never coming back. Trust me go somewhere else.

Drive-thru was very quick and they handed us our drinks out of mugs for contactless pickup which was a cool idea I've never seen before at a Starbucks drive-thru. Very safe during this whole corona pandemic.

Short version: This Starbucks is terrible. You're better off finding a different location. 

Long version: I never thought I'd have to write a negative review on a simple iced tea order, but here it is. 

I sat thru the drive-thru and ordered a black iced tea with no water or sweetener. Got the drink, drove off and realized I got an Arnold Palmer. Yeah it's annoying, but mistakes happen. 

I drove back, got in line and told the person up front I received the wrong drink in the drive thru. Instead of just making me a new one, they decided to get the gal who originally made my drink to come help me. I realize now that it was at this time that I entered THE TWILIGHT ZONE. 

She remembered me from the drive they and asked why I came back. I let her know I that I just wanted a black iced tea and not a tea mixed with lemonade. She seemed annoyed with my request and then started grabbing a bunch of different items and asked I wanted lemon in the tea again??? No, black tea only please.

I was patient with her through this whole process, but this barista seemed pretty frustrated with me for not being an Arnold Palmer fan. She was slamming stuff around. When she finally served up my drink (which really as simple as pouring pre-made tea on ice) she mumbled: "Have a nice day yesterday" and quickly started to walk off. I quickly launched back with "Excuse me? Did you really wish me a good day YESTERDAY? 

Really, I was more curious as to how what she said could be construed as an insult, but alas she pretended like she never said it. Whatever, I had my tea finally. I took a big victory sip and tasted the leftover chai spice from the dirty container they obviously reused for the black tea. 

I knew there was no hope in getting it right at that point, and just fled the battlefield uncaffeinated, but fully inspired to write this long post. 

Basis for my rating: I think taking 4 stars off for screwing up my order, having a garbage attitude and not using clean containers is fair.

If I could give them no stars I totally would the service is horrible they don't even make the drinks the way they should not to mention the parking lot is actually hell on earth you would be just much better off going to the woodbury location it's just a shame considering this location is closer to my house and more convenient but after waiting 15 minutes for a mobile order latte I will not be coming back to this location anytime soon

Love that there's a Starbucks in the Constitution Center! I stopped on my way home because it was hot out. The AC was cranked up thank goodness. It's a fairly large location with plenty of seating options. It was clean. It had a large selection of food. The people were both nice and friendly. I needed some caffeine in the form of tea. It was pleasant to sit here in the air conditioned coolness to rest my feet, cool off and enjoy my drink!

Love Love Love Starbucks!

The employees here are super nice and friendly!

They know your order, they customize your coffee at your request and make super yummy drinks!

5 Stars All the Way from me!!
The workers there seem to treat every customer with disdain. Every order was incorrect and they were soooooo slow. Terrible service.

I've had very friendly customer service at this drive-thru location. It is relatively quick even though there can be a handful of cars in line. The process is speedy when paying with a card or cash, no receipt signing or having to fill out a tip form (just cash tips). I like this as it keeps the lines moving and probably means the employees get paid well enough to keep coming back- delivering good product with smiling faces. The drinks are consistent from location to location and pretty much everyone can find something they enjoy from the bucks. They keep adding new items to the menu and despite their being super mainstream they are quality and not insanely priced. My only complaint is that there isn't one more conveniently located near me which is a surprise for Nashville.

I work very close to this Starbucks so it's very convenient for me on an ever day basis. I would say that they are the most friendly Starbucks in this area but it often takes twice as long to get a drink from here because of the small location and it's proximity to other offices, a school, and homes.

That said I've never received a drink that was made incorrectly here. In addition, most of the staff make an effort to get to know your name and greet you personably when you enter. You won't find that at the other Starbucks in Tucson.

Out of Venti Cups and refused to sell us a trenta because they only had 20 of those cups left for the day. I'm sure the girl working was just tired of explaining that, but her tone and sarcasm was unneeded. Her exact words were "I can only sell you a grande, because as you can read on the sign we placed above the screen we are out of venti cups" First world problems for sure- but just unnecessary to be rude.

Went out of my way to go here, I could've gotten one of the delicious breakfast sandwiches from the sidewalk vendors but I chose here because it's a place to sit down to eat. Unfortunately upon arrival I saw the place jammed with people, so I had to go back around the block to the Wendy's ...

I'm not a starbucks fan overall but was forced to stop at this one. The breakfast sandwich was greasy and disgusting but the dragonfruit drink was really good. The staff wasn't friendly at all either. I'm going to continue to avoid them as much as I can.

We were so looking forward to having a Starbucks closer to home and really had great expectations for this store since it's in a hotspot...HOWEVER...we have been sadly disappointed every time (except for one) of the ten or so times that we've been since they opened! They are SO SLOW!! Even when there is only ONE or TWO customers in front of us and we have ordered ahead!  This location is so much slower than the other one in town that is always super busy...that this new store was meant to help alleviate the load.  It's sadly lacking in the usual speed and efficiency we have come to expect from the Starbucks brand.

They just shove that pike down your 
Throat.  Pour over request greeted with
A smirk and wait 15 minutes

I am bias because this is my "closest to home" shop where they know my name often times & my mobile order is always ready when I go pick it up.  I know they are a bit slower when it comes to the drive-thru (which is why I mobile order) but my order is right 99% of the time and that 1% they'll fix it.  Pam talks to me about my dogs (who LOVE getting pup cups here) and every single worker "good morning"'s me.  Kind and great service!

Highly recommend the nitro cold brew with sweet cream as well - it is the perfect boost in the morning!

I am REALLY disappointed in this Starbucks! I have been getting Starbucks for YEARS and on a regular basis! I have never had such bad service, rude customer service, or a high priced drink before. They nickeled and dimed me for my drink. Charging me .80 cents for extra caramel, when I mentioned I've never been charged in the years I've been having Starbucks, she told me this is a licensed Starbucks and that's why. HORSE PUCKEY! I have NEVER been charged out of all the different locations I have been to. It was an EXTRA $1.30 (than I usually pay for my whole drink!) 

When I told them I need 2% milk because whole Milk will make me sick, the cashier looked at me like I'm joking and said ok. When she told barista, he scoffed and huffed when she made the comment it needed the 2% milk. 

I'm sorry I need a certain type of milk because of my dietary limits. If you hate your job that much that you can't be up beat and personable, maybe it's time for you two to maybe find ANOTHER JOB! I will never stay at the nugget or spend my money their in the slot machines with this HORRIBLE customer service!

What am I invisible???  This Starbucks is so UN-organized!  I placed a mobile order - allowing 20 minutes so it would be ready when I arrived.  No such luck - stood there for 15 minutes while the Barista called up everyone but me to make sure they got their order.  Totally ignored me - even though I was standing 10 feet from the counter.  I finally went forward and asked if my order was ready - since no mobile orders were visible and she was now chit chatting with co-workers.  Her comment was oh I'm sorry I guess I didn't announce it when it was ready.  Really!  Thanks a lot!  Great customer service here.  I frequent Starbucks pretty much every day - this is the worse service I've ever received - maybe they were just having an off day, I hope so.

It actually pains me to write this, because I LOVE the employees at this location and it's very close to my apartment, but it's really not worth spending the $5-6 I do everyday here. I've been going to dunkin' more cause it's so much faster and consistent. 

While the employees here are so sweet and funny, they are incredibly slow. Like the pace of an anemic sloth. Today I waited 30 mins in the drive thru. I'm actually writing this WHILE still waiting! And half the time my order is either not right or hot.

Not a coffee snob or anything so this isn't much of a coffee review but just thought I'd give an honorable mention to the staff helping me when I came in the other day. I asked if they can put a quick "Happy Birthday" on a drink for me and they made it extra cute, thanks guys!

Okay so I know it's not the end of the world, and mistakes happen, but I wanted to make the store aware- if it doesn't say iced on the Uber eats item order (like this sticker does not say iced anywhere) it's because someone ordered a hot coffee. I know it was probably a genuine mistake, but would appreciate awareness for future orders. Thanks!

Horrible place, unprofessional staff who don't care about cleanliness. I drove up and an employee was chilling outside with her dirty bare feet planted up on a table.  This is a food industry!  I pointed it out to three different employees who denied their co-worker was doing anything unprofessional.  They were all dead-eyed and apathetic.  One tall, skinny girl got angry that I dared to point out that Starbucks is a food industry and they should adhere to industry standards.

I am reporting the incident to corporate. Will never go to another Starbucks because I can't unsee this flagrant disregard for customer consideration.

This is by far the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. When my husband and I started coming here 6 months ago it was great! It's been slowly going downhill. The last few times we've gone, his iced coffee was way too dark despite asking for sweet cream in it. So we asked for some in a cup (since Covid you can't send it back in to be fixed) and this seemed like a problem. The drinks are never made like we order. The forgot sweet cream cold foam multiple times - and even charge $1.00 extra for it!!! Today was the last straw. Ordered our drinks - iced coffee too dark again, and the other drink had sweet cream cold foam on top and he handed it to me overflowing out of the top, all over the cup, and had the audacity to say "oh looks like we put a little too much in there." So I asked for a bunch of napkins and he hands me 2. TWO NAPKINS. So I asked for more and the drink is spilling the sweet cream cold foam all over me and on the inside of my car. HOW IN THE WORLD DO YOU HAND A CUSTOMER A CUP LIKE THIS AND ACKNOWLEDGE IT'S A MESS??? So I had to ask for even more napkins and he seemed annoyed at my asking. Well. If you wouldn't have handed me a messy cup overflowing, I wouldn't have to ask for so many napkins. I would give this place zero stars if I could. The service is terrible now and drinks are never made right. Get the old crew back you had 6 months ago! And teach your employees CUSTOMER SERVICE because they are clueless. We will gladly start going to the one on Lindbergh and Clayton - despite no drive through and out of the way - because the service is super fast and drinks are perfect EVERY TIME. I suggest you all start going to that one too!

This Starbucks always seems like an after thought in Terminal B and I really hope an upgrade is coming soon.
It's tiny for the space it covers & there never seems to be more than 1-2 employees and only ever 1 at the register - although there are 2 registers.
Their Starbucks app seems to never ever be working - so you choose to wait over 15 minutes for $3 coffee and don't get to reap in any of the rewards.
Well here's the good stuff (because I know all that sounded like whining and of course first world problems but hey I'm serious about my coffee and am an extreme grouch when I haven't had it - see above and it's 6am) ok the good stuff
The staff is always nice and friendly no matter what - even when dealing with grouches like me (this morning the woman at the register had the most impeccable eye make up).
If you want Starbucks and are flying out of terminal B arrive 2 hours before boarding - you've been warned.

This is run by University of the Sciences dining services, not the Starbucks corporation. As such, they have Summer Hours and close along with university schedules. They do have some of the hot food items now & the workers are great. Be sure to check http://www.usciencesdining.com/locations.html rather than the Starbucks home page for accurate hours of operation.
This Starbucks is filthy! Someone should take away their license. Their floors, kitchen  and bathroom are very dirty. The toilet and bathroom floor are covered in urine, etc.

Omg. This place keeps getting worse. Truth. I have been waiting in line for 10 minutes. I am serious. If my eyes weren't burning with fire bc i only had 4 hrs of sleep i would have pulled off. This is ridiculous. Officially done with this location

Maybe it is the volume of traffic, but this SBUX seems habitually backed up and just hanging on by fingernails.  The staff is friendly which is great, and they make up wrong drink orders but a stop here isn't a 5 min quick in and out.  It's an ordeal. Even if you mobile order and show up at the approximate availability time, you are still waiting upwards of 10 minutes.  It's like the bar needs to be bigger, with less seating because nobody wants to hang around and add a few team members. Maybe a visit from the process folks would help.

My grande almond milk cappuccino tasted great this morning! I ordered ahead via the mobile app while I was finishing a song in my car In the parking lot. My drink was ready when promised, between 2-5 minutes.

The staff is always friendly here and ready to help and the store is nice and clean. There is always plenty of parking when I go at 7:45am and little to no line at that time.

Okay, I am not one to flame a restaurant, first of all. But.. this is ridiculous. This is an establishment that serves food and drinks, and I have NEVER seen SO MANY FLIES and other bugs in a building since I once went horseback riding in 6th grade. Am I exaggerating? No. I am sitting here, right now, in fact, twitching every minutes when a fly lands on me. And it's not the same fly. After swatting four on my own, I gave up. FOUR. There is also a giant wasp-like insect about 5 feet from me.

Also, there was no toilet paper in the bathroom and I had to ask twice before they brought some. Again, if this was a stable, a meadow, or even a bookstore or a seedy bar, the bugs and lack of TP wouldn't bother me. But people are eating food and drinking drinks that have been exposed to some serious insects. And if these are just the bugs I see, I don't want to think about the bugs everywhere else. Seriously this is foul. Two flies attached to each other (mating? fighting?) just landed on my table. Whoa.

Also, I have had to pretty much assault my friend Brittany while trying to get some of the bugs off of her. Now I look like an asshole.

You might be asking, "But Anna, why don't you just leave?" Because traffic is about to get really bad, that's why.

Get it together Starbucks
I'm a huge fan of Starbucks and this was a great one to stop in. For it being in such a crowded tourist spot the staff was friendly. Really enjoyed my latte.
Nothing like driving to get a $5 cup of coffee to get it only half filled. I wish I noticed before I got home. What a waste.
Great customer service here.  Also love the fact that they foster relationships with their customers.  This sets them apart from other locations.

I love the service. 
I recalled coming here twice already. So I ventured out the house and returned to this location again. 
I ordered a hot chocolate and a chocolate chip cookie. The husband got some lemon cake. I got to say this has been my favorite location in Saint Louis thus far. The hot chocolate is perfect. The employees are super professional and kind. Of course I swung through the Drive thru. But next time I'll grab my laptop & go in and chill a bit. If that's allowed. My drive thru attendant was wearing a mask & gloves. I give it five stars.

This Starbucks is one of the busiest you'll see in Bucks County. It's THE hang-out spot in Newtown. Starbucks is Starbucks, but at this one, the staff couldn't be nicer and, more importantly, they get the drinks right. There's a good amount of seating for the space for individuals as well as groups who'd prefer to sit at larger tables. The only gripe is that it attracts the teens late at night, so around that time it can get a little loud/annoying. But as long as you hit it before 8, you're in the clear.

Every single time that I have visited this location my order has been wrong.  And every time I pull up I think "I should probably go to a different one but certainly they will get my order correct."  But once again my order was wrong.  Yesterday I ordered a triple Carmel macchiato. I was a few miles down the road when I took my first sip.  And it tasted different -odd.  I took the sleeve off and it was made with oat milk.   Ive never had oat milk and I didn't realize it was a thing. . Anyway, I will say the staff are always friendly.  That is a huge positive.  So the question is do I try this location again after 10 visits with the wrong order???

Why do I even bother to go to Starbucks anymore? 

On Thanksgiving, I ordered 3 coffee via mobile order. When I got there, I realized my order was still not ready yet. No biggie. After getting my 2 drinks, my 3rd drink finally came out....but it wasn't edible. The worker put "not available" and put 5 dollars and 25 cents in my cup. As I was asking them what this money was for and if I can order another drink, the barista cuts me off and says "we don't have that drink here and that's your refund" HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. I feel like they should have asked me if I wanted to order something else OR block that drink off your mobile order section so people don't order it. I will not return to this location.

I love Starbucks. The lines can be long but service always nice and consistent. The lattes are always good. Everything is prepared down to a science- I used to work for Starbucks. It is actually impressive what this company does. I'm a fan! Love the banana nut bread when I need a quick bite.

Early flight means Starbucks coffee. Myself and my co-worker got drinks and breakfast sandwiches. Everything was really good and the staff was friendly and efficient. 

No complaints. I'll be back next time I fly.
We only have one kind of coffee right now and we're not gonna brew anything different, but there's another Starbucks 2 miles away.

Just about every time i come here my order is wrong. Ordered a venti iced coffee with classic and white mocha. They gave me a cold brew with caramel. I didn't have time to wait around for them to correct it. So i was out money and coffee.

male employee working the window.  The drink was made incorrectly and they wanted to add the missing whipped creme in a separate cup and told us to add it to the drink.  We asked that the drink be remade and he slammed down a cup,  walked away rudly and went and threw something in the trash angrily.  We asked for a refund and a female emplyee comes to the window and my husband told them that the man was being rude and she told him you are being rude. She then says you have your refund. Ordered using the ap a free birthday beverage and the Venti pumpkin spice frappe was ready for pick up on arrival and did not disappoint!

It was very busy in Starbucks and I was waiting on my scone for only about 5 minutes when an Employee asked me if I was waiting on anything. Hard to find. Filled with kids climbing on the tables. Not a seat to be found. Loudest Starbucks I have ever been in. And this after the circuitous route to get here. Walked in, walked out

It makes me so happy that there's a Starbucks in this location.  Super convenient to a neighborhood that's largely interested in organic food and granola-type coffee shops.

Thank you, U Sciences, for bringing my beloved big-business espresso to the 'hood.
Really great experience at this brand new Starbucks! Jamie the manager was super helpful and all the staff perfect in the preparation of drinks and friendly in every way! Love this new location!
This staff is the best! They know your name, remember what you drink and always have a smile on their faces!

I deliberately go out of my way to go to a different Starbucks. The employees in this store seem like they've never been trained. Drinks are constantly wrong, wait times can be as long as FIFTEEN minutes with less than 3 customers in the drive thru and minimal customers in store. Being a former Starbucks employee, as well as having family members work for the company for decades, it truly embarrasses me that this store is even open. Most of the stores in the area are well ran and operate efficiently, but this store is a complete disgrace and embarrassment to the wonderful company that Starbucks is. I have wasted countless dollars at this store because I did not have the time to turn around after I drove away with a completely screwed up drink. I would rather go to a Target Starbucks than this store.

So I have a secret addiction to these Carmel Ribbon Crunch Frappuccino's.  While I was headed to pick up some pizza we ordered for dinner, I saw a Starbucks and decided to hit up the drive thru. Not only was this Frappuccino perfect in every way, the service was fast and I was on my way in no time at all! Thank you for my secret treat I was able to finish before I got home. Yes, I hid the empty cup in the garbage so my husband wouldn't find it!

Today, I went to Starbucks. Starbucks is literally my favorite place to go, I ordered my usual today then got up to the window and saw that my drink; Had to cups on it, I wondered why. Step up your game starbucks!
Last time, a month ago, was terrible. Today I am here for lunch and I'm impressed by freshly brewed coffee&cream, bagels and cookies by the cashier, all fresh and service was fast!

This location is amazing 
The employees are the BEST OF THE BEST

The drinks are great along with the service however the past few times I've tried to come here they've been closed. They change they're hours every other day which is a inconvenience.

I like this location as it's open late so I can study but it's sooooo loud! Between the blaring music and obnoxiously loud employees gossiping and acting like they are at night club, it's too distracting to study. The ladies that work at this location are so rude!! This is the third time I went through the drive through and the baristas were not nice at all. I ordered a venti iced tea lemonade, nothing fancy and the young lady that took my order didn't even greet me when I pulled up to the window. It felt like I was inconveniencing her by just being there. Maybe she was having a bad day but since this is the third time I've had a bad experience there, I'm convinced the workers are just rude.

Slower than malassis. Can't even get your name right. " Can I get a name"?  "Greg". 

There's a better Starbucks over at Glenbrook.

We rarely visit Starbucks and this encounter reminds me why. 
The only reason we did was because it was HOT, we just finished our Costco run and we wanted a refreshing drink. 
So we go through the drive thru, not familiar with the menu and in less than 1 minute the employee asked us 3 times for our order. There was one car behind us that showed up midway through. They were not busy, inside or outside. She was just rude and inpatient. 
2 stars because the drinks were good. 
Work on improving your demanding, overzealous employee and it may go up. After all, I'm paying for your overpriced frapps at $10 plus for two talls! Some pleasant customer service would help the feeling of not being ripped off.

Anna & Ricky always take good care of my daughter- and Lisa is the fav barista on bar. My daughter has been treating me all week to her obsession! From breakfast sandwiches to coffee and tea! This has become a morning routine. I love the Very Berry Hibiscus Tea (Refresher). Berries and a light refreshing tea is the perfect blend for me! Connor always gets the vanilla sweet cream cold brew and my daughter loves her double tall latte, one pump white mocha and one pump mocha, heavy cream, extra hot, with extra whip in a grande cup (and yes she is that portentous). She's fan-cy. And the breakfast sandwiches! She has me hooked on the bacon gouda- but her fav is the sausage cheddar and the ham and cheese croissant. Drive thru is fast- and given that it's all drive thru at the moment, I am happy they are quick! I have been shotgun on many visits this week!

Small Starbucks with a connecting convenience store. Every time that I've gone, they have plenty of space to study and sit and the line is non-existent later in the evening compared to the other cafes around Penn and Drexel around the same time. Friendly workers and quick service.

I've been going to this location when I'm in the area since it opened and it's great! Other Starbucks can be hit or miss when it comes to staff. The staff can be aloof or more interested in what their coworkers are saying instead paying attention to your order. 


This Starbucks is not like that at all. It has the best staff and super quick service!  I would drive to this location before others in the area without hesitation. They also have a clover machine!

As others has said this is by far one of the slowest locations I've ever been at.  One person working taking orders and working as a cashier.  The majority of my time in the drive thru was listening to her taking orders. A definite need for more help or training.  My frappe was very good but melted a little while I waited to be served.

I go to this Starbucks primary because it's closest to me, but if the Customer Service was ever awful then trust me. I would go 10-20 miles away to a different to get coffee and great customer service. But today I went here and was greeted, given a mask, and before I left Kaitlyn asked me if I wanted a water. It's been a really rough week, or rather a really rough year. Being out of work, COVID, Bills, and other personal issues. Kaitlyn asking me if I wanted a water was the best thing of today. "Go the extra mile and act like you care about other people." -That's what that meant to me.- Thank you. I will definitely be coming back here more often than not.

the starbucks in the Nuggett was very slow, the employees seemed to struggle to know what they were doing or even the name of the drink. i overall would not recommend coming to this starbucks unless you are okay with a 20 minute wait.

Can you say lightning-fast service? Well, lightning-fast for Starbucks at least. I just started coming to this location, as it is in on a common route I've been taking twice a week, for the past three months. Every time, I'm very impressed with how quickly they get beverages out the door considering how crowded it can get. I always assumed that due to its close proximity to Northwest Hospital, that it would regularly get swamped with employees and visitors from there; I was mistaken.

My lattes always come out nice and strong. I always get triple shots, and here, you can tell they're there. The other locations? I'm convinced they say they put it in, but they just use less milk.

Will continue to return.

Let me provide you with a disclaimer that I'm not a huge fan of Starbucks, so you might see some bias in this review. However I happened to find myself here while visiting with friends in the area, and we came here for an afternoon coffee, or in my case, iced tea.

The parking here is atrocious, but what do you want for a business that emphasizes more on the drive through experience? We were however able to obtain a space, despite the fact that it was super busy for some reason. 

The inside of this place was a madhouse. It was dirty, and smelled horrible. 

People huddled about everywhere, standing shoulder to shoulder, and not wearing masks despite the fact that the city of Tucson had passed an ordinance requiring people indoors to be masked. Unfortunately, Starbucks must be desperate for business since they didn't enforce the masks. 

There were people talking loudly on their phones, a group in the corner playing Pokemon Go, people hunched over their computers, and patrons in booths shouting over the din of those on their phones to the point where me, a Deaf man, was able to understand what they were saying. 

What an awful experience to behold. 

We ended up going through the drive through instead (against my wishes, as I prefered to go elsewhere). However, to Starbucks' credit, they completed my order accurately, and we went through the drive through much quicker than expected.

Walked in with my mask on and this young man asked me to pull mask mask up higher and was very rude. Now I follow the mask wearing when I have to but you do not need to be rude to customers and talk back.  I don't like your coffee and your employees are rude!

Rude baristas. A lot of teenagers work here and don't really care about their jobs. I go here often and almost always have the same experience with the same workers. They're rude and busy talking among themselves.

Don't waste your time. I was stuck in the drive through for a half hour, and once you're in line, you're stuck. I never imagined it would take that long for a plain cup of coffee. When I did get to the window, I was handed a iced coffee and the employee looked at me like I was the one who made the mistake. She told me to "hold on-the coffee is brewing". No apology, just a shut window

I ordered my usual drink and my friend got hers, and the workers messed both of them up. When they handed me the first one I told them they forgot to add foam on top, so they took it back and added it themselves. I know that taking drinks back at all is against store policy for workers(they are supposed to make a totally new one), so I thought it was a little odd. After I got my drink, I took a drink and they had only added coconut milk to it (it was supposed to be a coconut milk refresher with juice). I asked them if they could add the juice to it, and they just told me they were out of it. If they were out of it, they should have told me so they didn't give me a messed up drink. They could have told me they didn't have it at the register as well. And if not that, I would've been fine with an "I'm sorry about that". But in their defense, they had been working pretty fast. I don't recommend stopping by.

As always, it's a Starbucks, and it's there to please. I go for the Pike's Place and dress it up with my own cream, sugar, and spices - which makes it much cheaper than the fancy $5 a cup brews! 

This location is usually pretty crowded with USP students studying on their Macs or discussing group projects. It's a really good location in West Philly, but there are also plenty of good local coffee shops in the area, too!

super weird starbucks. out of almost everything at 8:50am but didn't seem to have been too busy earlier?? they let me order a drink and didn't tell me until they handed it to me but they didn't have all the ingredients for it

If ever a Starbucks needed a location makeover, the Paoli Starbucks was it. To actually have adequate parking at the Paoli Starbucks fulfilled a desperate need for them. 

But sitting here, I feel like they didn't quite get the seating area right. I've been in more comfortable Starbucks before. I feel like they missed an opportunity to add more comfort seating, instead they went with harder tables. They could have added more outlets for laptop use, but I don't see as many. 

There are a lot of improvements. But they could have done better.
Quick swing through the drive through on the way to the St. Louis Turkey Trot in Tower Grove Park.  Super convenient location.  Friendly drive through employees.

Not sure why all these negative reviews on this page. They are always friendly and nice despite being super busy almost all the time. (I'd be miserable) LOL. Always great with mobile orders and have them ready when I get to the store. Today specifically I was having a bad Monday and just wanted my coffee,  I called the store cause of course I forgot my mask and spoke with a gentleman (not sure of his name) I was asking if he could meet me at the door with the mobile order , then he met me at the door with a mask instead. I was happy about this because I needed one the rest of the day and I was thinking of where was I going to get one for the day?! Made my Monday much better with the kindness of this employee, also made me feel like it was no big deal I called the store telling them I didn't have one. He was happy I called and let them know. Recommend this Starbucks not only for the service but people working there who are always friendly and willing to go the extra mile. :)
The company became so bad on so many rude ladies working there feminist disgusting unprofessional company became unbelievable

Let me just say how grateful I am for this Starbucks. I went in and told the woman (I wish I got her name) that I teach preschoolers with autism and that we were wanting to do a green straw sensory bin for fall and I asked if I could buy some green straws from them. She said she would be happy to donate them to my classroom and gave me a huge pack. My students will thoroughly enjoy their sensory breaks in this bin and I am so thankful they would donate and support my classroom and myself as a teacher (who as we know doesn't make nearly enough and already spends too much of my own money on stuff for my students).

I stopped by at this Starbucks location while on the go to work. They are stationed right next to the Kroger in Belle Meade making it hard to miss, great parking right out front.

I like to be adventurous in my Starbucks order and went with the nitro cold brew with sweet cream...it wasn't necessarily my favorite. It wasn't hot or cold, just a weird in between, and didn't have much flavor either. The egg bites were also just okay, but didn't taste very fresh.

It was fairly clean, and there were plenty of members on staff to get speedy service. There were plenty of tables and seats available making it great to get work done or just hang out at.
Great, fast service in the drive through. Kind, happy employees. Inside is much much much slower which is a bummer but they focus on their drive through.

They're still getting their stuff together and getting settled in, but it's a great place for hanging out and people watching.  Not the cheapest place to grab coffee around here, but I still find it hard to resist.

So Starbucks gets a 5 star no matter what cuz I'm super bias towards them. They provide me with cups of happiness and joy that make my day much better. The best Chai Tea Latte I've come across to date. Their Vanilla Petite Scones are little bites of smiles and rainbows. Never had a bad experience. *Tip* the parking lot is sometimes hard to get into and out of. If you park in the Family Dollar lot across the street you can save a lot of time.

I was super excited for this Starbucks to arrive. It's directly between my home and work. Unfortunately, I'm still waiting for this location to get it together. They are frequently out of products, the drive through ordering screen has been broken for more than a week, they will not take cash payment, and the wait times are LONG, even for a Starbucks. I understand that COVID has interrupted some supply chains and most restaurants are operating short staffed. But, the ownership/management needs to do some damage control on this particular location or it will not survive.

I always order mobile order from here. The staff is always super amazing. When I walk in they know my name. They are super quick for all the shortages and stuff they are dealing with. I really love this store personally since it also is very close to work. I love it's convenience. The food and drinks always come out right. It's super easy to mobile order. Even when it's super crazy they are always so friendly and greeting everyone that walks into the store. I definitely will always be coming here when I need my Starbucks fix.

The staff gets a 5-star rating.  The abuse of the handicap spots in front by mobile-app patrons gets a -4.  To those that think a quick in&out to get your trenti sized quad shot soy milk pumpkin spiced latte warrants parking your Range Rover in the handicap spot because you're too lazy or entitled to walk the extra 30' from the nearest available parking spot.

Do you want to be late for work? Do you want to wait 30 damn minutes for a single cup of coffee? Look no further than the absolute worst Starbucks in Reno! Shoutout to you guys for mixing my walk-in order with the drive-thru orders! Making me wait 30 minutes for a single cup of coffee! I'm now late to work thanks to you guys! I came thirty minutes early specifically to give myself time for coffee and still be on time and if not, early. I'm now late thanks to you! I will be telling everyone I know to NEVER go to this store again. There wasn't even a line. Just lazy workers!

Last time I went there, I picked up an online order.  I ordered a hot latte, and they made a cold latte.  Thy remade a cold latte, and finally got it right the third time.  Staff was very nice, I let it go.  Tonight I picked up an online order, and it was caffeinated, despite the fact that the label on the cup said "decaf."  I haven't drunk caffeine in years.  I'm now shaking at 8:00 at night because they screwed up my order.  WHAT is the problem?!!
Very, very slow. 5 Starbucks employees but only one is preparing drinks. My late took over 15 min and it was not busy - just one big order for a Frappuccino.

Never thought I'd feel compelled to review a chain store, let alone the ubiquitous wonder bread of coffee purveyors. But watching this team -- they literally look like a varsity hockey or basketball team zooming up and down a rink or court, with perfect timing, constant communication, and a vibrant and sincerely positive energy -- makes me really want whatever they're having... Hopefully it spills over to the coffee because I have a long drive ahead of me. Thank you for the display of your flow, guys. Keep up the great work.

This is the Starbucks of my school, USP. I come here a few times a week to satisfy my chai addiction. The staff is usually student based during the semesters. They're pretty friendly day-to-day.
The setup is a little unique. There is a long bar style seating spot by the window, then a large table in the center, and a few small very low tables with uncomfortable chairs. It's always too boisterous to get any work done here. The downfall is to us starbucks connoisseurs - this location doesn't offer the rewards benefits. You can still have them enter your numbers and get stars, just not the benefits that come with it.

I hate to say it because I've been to this location quite a bit over the last two years... It really declined about a year ago to maybe six months. They've improved a little since then, but not enough to make the rating average.

You have about a 50/50 shot of your drink being made correctly. Today I got whole milk instead of soy and unfortunately I have lactose issues. That's not the first time that's happened. Sometimes you order something cold and it comes back hot. This is definitely a location where you need to stress the details and make sure you mentioned everything you want. They've been out of stock a lot in the last year. I think it's due to COVID and the fact that they're a popular location.

The worst it's ever gotten is when I have to take the drinks from this location to Harding because they're just bad. There was one chai latte I swear was straight up just water and soy milk. 

Not my favorite location, but I think with the right team they have a lot of potential. Just wish I went in with certainty that I'd get the right thing every time (or almost, mistakes happen).

I actually really like this coffee shop, and I tend not to be a huge fan of Starbucks.  But this particular location offers something unique to the neighborhood, and in my opinion, is a huge asset to the neighborhood.  The main reason is location: it is the farthest Southwest coffee shop in West Philly.  But it also is unique in terms of its atmosphere.

I would say this is a "pseudo-Starbucks": it is in many respects like a normal Starbucks, but it's a little different, as it is also part of the bookstore for the University of the Sciences.  Situated on the edge of the USP campus, this place definitely is evident as a campus coffee shop.

The interior is a bit cold and sterile.  It has a lot of large tables, both long and wide, which are quite useful for group work.  Very high ceilings, very big and open, lots of glass and hard surfaces.  The atmosphere is loud and lively.  Lots of seating, including stools and a bar facing the window, with a great view of Woodland and 42nd street.  Trolleys go by on woodland, which is fun, and like the other reviewer said, this is great for people-watching.

I have found the wireless (which is different from the typical Starbucks wireless) to be very reliable.

My one complaint?  Short hours.  This place closes very early and I wish it stayed open later.  You can, however, stay camped out in the shop after buying your drink, as they have a nice separation between the storefront and seating area, which makes the hours effectively a little longer.

Bottom line?  5 stars.  This place may be a Starbucks, but it is still a big asset to the neighborhood, and is also a unique offering in the neighborhood's selections of coffee shops in many respects.
My favorite location on the south side . Always quick always accurate and always good. Outdoor seating right on grand which is perfect for people watching .

As someone who used to work at Starbucks, I feel I have enough authority to say that this is one of the best Starbucks I have been to. 

My drink is always made exactly right, and all the employees are very friendly. I am known on a first name basis by several of them, and I visit this location 3-4 times a week. 

The store is very clean and spacious. Even when they are busy, there are enough seats to be had and the service maintains a steady 5 out of 5.

I am just about done with Starbucks. I don't drink coffee& I love all the drink options that they offer but the price per quality served are not adding up. I did order ahead& while they were busy you would think that 20 minutes would be enough time so just be able to walk in& get my drinks. That was not the case. Then when I did get my drinks there was a lap in my first and second drink being made. 3 other customers were helped in this time. The drink I got was a cinnamon dolce crème, just steamed milk with cinnamon dolce syrup, whipped cream& a little cinnamon on top. The last 3 times I got it my cup has been half full when paying 450 for a 16 oz drink you want all of those 16 ozs. Also & this is nothing of the staff but the parking situation& getting in& out of the lot is a total nightmare.

Best bucks around 

Super service and nice employees

Highly recommended to new visitors
I am so sorry you have to deal with such crappy people and I hope the next couple of customers that come in treat you right. I appreciate your prompt service and the amazing flavor each time I go in

This Starbucks is exactly what I expected a Starbucks to be. Great job on consistency Starbucks! Will be back because the location is really convenient and a good place to study.

That said, I also really dislike the locks on the bathroom doors. The locks are not a necessity and I have to agree with Monte A's opinion regarding the locks that he wrote in his review. Plus, I can never remember the code no matter how many times I'm told it.

Friendliest Starbucks staff ever here. The baristas were so sweet to my grandson today.   His "baby coffee" (aka hot cocoa) was done in a snap and served 
with a smile.  He was delighted. 
The drive through can be difficult which is why I took it down a star, but I do think that is in large part because it is located on the corner of a very busy street.  
Inside...super quick.  Drive through...not so much. 
If you're in a hurry, step inside 
The drinks are consistent here as well which I have noticed isn't always the case with some other locations.  When I order my sugar-free vanilla latte...I know exactly what it's going to taste like.

This Starbucks gets really busy ever since they close the one on Robb dr but even though they get slammed, the baristas are always polite and they always give great service. I'm happy for this Starbucks. It's conveniently located too.

Love this location! The employees are consistently friendly and helpful! Puts a smile on my face. 

The location is newer and very clean. They have some board games, which is nice. I love coming to this location!
Awesome service by Scott and Chara- not only were they kind and friendly but provided top notch service! Kudos

FATIMA JACKSON, FATIMA JACKSON... the supervisor at this Starbucks is the most inconsiderate supervisor there is .. I ordered a Strawberry Açaí drink for my daughter and asked for it to be blended and as if I asked her for her soul, she just got defensive , saying we don't do blended here.. I dont know what tipped her , is it my skin color, my accent or my Arizona shirt !!... the lady before me in the line ordered a drink and substituted everything for everything and that was ok but she had the correct skin color and accent.. unfortunately for me I did not... FATIMA JACKSON YOU SHOUKD NOT BE A SUPERVISOR
Please delegate tasks better during a rush! 30 mins wait for a mobile order is too long. :(

Closed inside seating but there is seating outside. They have quick and friendly service, and a drive through as well. Hopefully they will open the indoor seating soon because it's a very nice, clean and relatively new Starbucks. My pumpkin spiced latte that I was craving was perfect.

Love getting my coffee at this location! Always friendly, and a few of the staff members know my order lol I think it might be time to change it up! They did forget to put sugar one time and has they handed me the non-sugared coffee, they handed me a second one with and said have both! Always great! 
One take away from the location: they are fast! This crew has definitely stepped up and it's rare that a line builds up at drive-thru!

What a bunch of whining babies some customers are!  You are not going to your therapist here. It's a coffee shop. The employees here have always been friendly and helpful. A very pleasant environment.  I'm sure if I worked here I would have given some of you much more to cry about. If you encounter problems, perhaps look in the mirror for the culprit.
Great service for a busy crowd. Drink was as expected and served with a smile. Great job to the management of this location.

Extremely friendly and fast drive through service! Trevor was extremely kind and even gave suggestions on what might taste good with my drink. Thank you! Strawberry açaí lemonade with peach juice tastes amazing! 10/10 service will definitely be going to this Starbucks from now on

I try to like this location, I really do. But I don't believe I have ever gone here and not waited more than 10-15 minutes for a drink. While I understand there are busy times in the coffee business, I feel this location just can't quite figure out efficiency. Sadly, I waited 10 minutes in line to get to the register and another 20 for my drink. 

All came out fine. Thankful for that. If you're in a hurry and need a drink quickly, don't go here. 

*the app doesn't show this location as a mobile order location---at least it hasn't for me. Not sure why. *

Was this place always this bad...and I never noticed it? 

I have no choice but to come to this Starbucks since it is 5 minutes from work...which SUCKS. Basically, all the old workers are no longer there anymore and I consistently see new faces every other week...which is not good. I understand that it can be overwhelming when it gets busy but it does not give the workers an excuse to be throwing everything around...I just wanted an ice coffee...that's all and it took forever for me to get it even placing the order 10 minutes ahead. It is super disappointing because I love Starbucks and more and more this place is getting worst. I guess there is a reason why i always see new faces here and I feel like the management needs to retrain the workers here because they always seemed angry or overwhelmed.  I cannot wait for the DD's construction is over so I can start going there instead.

My PSL was on fleek, such an experience is akin to an injection of holiday life into my body. My PSL was on fleek.

Stood in front of the register for a good 45-60 seconds before a word was said to me. Keep in mind there were two employees directly across from me, one was like clocking or out or something. The other was helping him I guess. It's cool, I don't mind I understand people have lives outside of the grind.

A friendly face or a hello wouldn't hurt. Basic customer service skills.

Again, my PSL was on fleek so in the end I was a happy camper.

You already know Starbucks, consistent flavor/quality and good service. It's not a local coffee shop, but it doesn't try to be. Compared to other Starbucks locations, this one does seem to have a bigger variety of pre-packaged snacks, which is good. There are also a ton of board games available if you're in a playful mood.

The real reason for my review is the baristas -- I really appreciate the baristas at this location working extra hard to keep up with the influx of Pokemon Go players in the area while maintaining a friendly and welcoming attitude. A lot of businesses in "hot spots" seem to be struggling to keep up and I even heard an employee at a nearby business complaining, but the baristas here always have a smile on their face and always get your order right. Will continue to give them my business over other places in the area when I need to grab a snack in between pokestops :)

This location opened in 2018 and is a big step up from the other Ofallon location.  The seating area is much more spacious and easier to maneuver.  The counter is also very large and aesthetically pleasing.  The drive thru is standard and usually pretty good.  Only had one bad experience here when they were 100% out of food because of a labor strike at their supplier. Parking lot can be treacherous due to the way traffic moves on and off Highway 50.  4 stars because of the starbucks price tag.

A decent spot to grab a cup of coffee or some food before going through the day. This Starbucks is part of the University of the Sciences and will host a plethora of students. It will get crowded and loud during the rush, but slow down as people go to class. Staff are usually friendly depending on the day and service is quick   

For students:  
This starbucks is similar to regular ones, with the perks of being full of your classmates. You can use your declining balance or Devils dollars here. A great spot to get quick tasty breakfast. Literally the best option for food in general on this campus that doesn't cost you real money. 

For non students:
This location is nothing compared to a non university affiliated starbucks, but  you can always get the same options you can at other locations. They will take cash and card and treat you no different. There are usually many students here who will either be studying or eating, so seating can be tricky. Deffinitely a go to when you visit the school. 

Phone wi-fi does not work here for some reason. There just doesn't seem to be service and nothing ever connects. Laptops do work here however. 

This is a pretty nice locstion and typical location for a University. Better food here than most places and a nice atmosphere.
Been here twice in the past month. Both times good experiences. The only con is probably a pro - they are always busy!

This may be the slowest & inconsistent Starbucks that I have ever been to.... Why?!

Line is not terribly long, but takes forever to make my order, whether I'm in drive thru, in person or mobile.

Very convient to The Kolache Factory next door. Friendly fast service even though they had a sign up stating they were short staffed today so please be patient. Got two Trinta Iced Teas no Water 5 pumps liquid sugar cane in minutes. Caffeine fix for the day done. This little strip mall needs to have the landscaping cut back. You'd really miss it if you weren't looking.

I go to the Starbucks all the time and I've never had any complaints but today I went in there and the floors were dirty the tables were dirty nobody was wiping anything down the way they were making drinks using the same towel over and over again some of them had gloves some of them had masks but most of them did not I'm sorry that's a health code violation should I call the health department for on you are used to have to deal with them all the time maybe you should deal with him to
Prices are ridiculously inflated. Over $18 for a tall pink drink , grande matcha latte , chocolate chip cookie and blueberry scone. That is almost double other Starbucks locations!

This Starbucks was filled with chandeliers... It was so fun and funky!!! Great decor!

This is right off the lobby in my hotel which was very convenient!!! 

Love downtown Indy!!! For sure!
Poor service and unfriendly staff. Maybe they were just having a bad day. Not sure I would come back.

I go to this Starbucks every single day and I usually order the same drink too. Marley is the best barista because she can memorize your drink! Anytime I've ever had a drink taste funky, she's always remade it PERFECTLY for me! She is so nice and friendly and deserves a raise for doing gods work. I don't usually write reviews but she deserves the hype!
The pumpkin sauce makes all the difference in ordering the Grand pumpkin spice latte!
I have always had a good experience here. It's a cozy place to sit and work and the deck by the creek is a plus. Always had good service over the years.

Amazing staff and store! I love visiting this Starbucks location! My drink is always made perfectly and several times the staff has gone above and beyond to make my Starbucks trip great!:) The Pumpkin Cream Cold Brew is my go to seasonal fall drink! The perfect blend of creaminess and pumpkin spice!

I rarely used Yelp but today was a must. The drive thru girl with the fake lashes was the rudest employee. I could sympathize with working the day after thanksgiving, but there's no need for an attitude with every question. After all that unnecessary hostility... she gets our order wrong. What an embarrassment, I hope the manager recognizes who they employ.
Rude staff and drinks are not made properly. I have thrown out my drink on multiple occasions.

My turn to chime in. This is my local go-to for my caffeine needs, a vice I'm not giving up anytime soon, especially with the service-with-a-smile and go-the-extra-mile staff that greet me here. Yes, the place is small, and the only two comfy chairs are in the front corner and usually taken it, honestly, the lack of seating prompted my friend and I to sit at the little bar. And, we actually enjoyed it, felt kinda like we should do a newspaper puzzle...lol; so, we did. And now it's where we like to sit.  Plus, you get to watch the scene behind the counter, the magic at work.

I have a particular appreciation for this, as I once worked as a barista in a very busy Fishers location. My past experience, too, makes me feel like they deserve a shout out for being as friendly as they are while also being fast.

Now, I haven't been there when they were slammed, but I've been there when they were moderately busy, with a nearly full-house in the dining area ( as stated by other Yelpers, gallery style with patio outside). However, even then the barista was helpful. 
For example, the new thing is the Keto diet (yeah, yeah, don't judge me, my son's wedding is coming up...desperate times people) and after a couple of visits trying out the drinks I find online (uhm not so much happy-ness) I asked the pros if anyone else has ordered trying to be "Ketonian" (ha I just made that up),and the girl asked a co-worker and discussed the "Pink Drink" that was all over Google. I left them to drink my drink and after a few minutes she arrived to my table with a drink in her hand! And she put a sticker on it so I could reorder it! So glad she showed up (a Starbucks angel truly!) because what I had concocted wasn't even drinkable. See, extra mile for return patronage creates loyal customers!  They can't get rid of me now!

And the drive-thru was no different, in fact, it was unexpectedly speedy service. And, I know how busy it can get because I was put in drive-thru a lot. She served me with a smile, which I've found is less and less a norm with fast-food anymore. And it's amazing how much that can impact your day and experience. Also, when I happened to ask questions about the loyalty card (my memory doesn't serve me well) she didn't brush me off with a quick, "you can go online and see details" (or something like that, which wouldn't have been wrong either), but instead briefly and happily gave me an answer.

It's a 5 star review from me for sure because I find that these experiences I've had are reliable, consistent, no matter who is working. So, this is the place I will continue to feed my addiction...and I am not ashamed.

I give this place a 3. It's a solid 3 though. Every time I go in the people working there are fantastic to interact with. The place is clean and the products are consistent. It's everything you want your franchises coffee shop to be. 
A well oiled mass produced machine.

I get almost the same thing every time I go and they do a great job at this Starbucks and the employees are nice. The drive thru is a little wacky because of the bank that used to be next to it, and if you go during busy hours, you'll hold up traffic waiting to get in line since it connects to Edgewood.

Out-of-towner here visiting for the first time.

Fast service. We ordered via mobile to get BOGO drinks! This is a new and modern Starbucks that has a super-cool covered patio, plenty of seats inside, and a fun vibe. 

I wish the Maryland/DC area had patios like this one does. I'd be here all the time. 

Our drinks were made quickly and tasted excellent. Caramel frap always wins my heart.

We go out of our way to come to this specific Starbucks location!! They are always friendly and Evan is absolutely awesome!! Thank you to this location for always being kind & friendly! I will continue to be a repeat customer!!
Henry was at the window and did a great job customer connecting ! A+ for him and the fast service !
Drive thru- closes early ... would like to get coffee before my night shift... oh well... guess they don't need late night customers anymore...

They screw up my drink every time I go to this one. And unfortunately it's not just me.  when I go pick up coffees for friends they ask me to NOT go to this one because they don't know how to make it correctly.  They y all need to be retrained.

Atmosphere - for being in the student center, it still has a cafe feel. There is some seating, and everything is still nice and new. 

Service- its the same university staff that work at other temple-run establishments. Those I interacted with were pleasant and professional. They got my drink order wrong, but remade it without hassle. 

Prices and drinks and such are on par with other starbucks. They did run out of a bunch of things though, by about 3 pm on a Friday.

I can count on one hand the amount of times I have been to Starbucks in my life. It's not that I don't like Starbucks, I'm just not into iced coffee, regular coffee or $4 drinks that don't have alcohol in them. 

My chiropractor's office was handing out free drink coupons to all of their customers and it was my lucky day as I was included in this nice gesture. 

I ordered a blackberry tea and it was out right away. I took it to go because there are only a few tables in here and not much space. The two guys behind the counter were very nice and got me in and out in a quickly manner. 

My drink was refreshing on a hot day and gave me a little energy boost to get me through the afternoon.

Worst Starbucks I've very been too. I worked as a  barista for Starbucks for 3 years and I've never seen someone with such poor costumer service. The manager named Ally, gave me my latte with no foam and then when I asked for extra foam she threw out my entire drink and insisted on giving me a Cappuccino. While I was arguing that I did not want a Cappuccino but just a regular latte with foam, she proceeded to finish making me the Cappuccino. Only to throw that out and then make the latte (again).  Waited so long to get the drink, had to make a scene, just because I wanted a latte with foam. If I could leave 0 stars then I would.

Ordered a strawberry funnel cake Frappuccino. The barista wiped some errant whipped cream off the bubble top with a dirty rag and handed me the drink. She then proceeded to wipe the counter in front of me with the same dirty, wet rag.

Gross.

Emailed Starbucks and was credited $10. Greeeeat.

There's a Starbucks a couple of block down,  across the street that doesn't contaminate your drinks and let me use points.
One of my favorite Starbucks in the City! I absolutely love the staff! Always so friendly and always smiling :-)

Service is fine here; my irritation with this location is the fact that drive through traffic can enter either off Pendleton Pike or German Church Rd; one would think common courtesy would  prevail and customers would  take turns merging; they do not. My suggestion is a sign at corner of drive through with a reminder.

Free birthday coffee - any size, any variety - thank you!

Friendly staff, not at all busy on a weekday morning around 8 a.m., quick service.

I gave it one Star because I had to pick at least one. I would have given it 0. Made a mobile order and "pick up in store" was the only option. Not a problem until we arrived and the store was locked and drivethru was 13 cars deep. I tried calling and they wouldn't answer the phone. Since I already paid I had to sit in the line. My order was supposed to be ready at 8:58 and I didn't get to the window for 20 minutes. While in line I watched 4 other people go to the door and get their orders. Apparently they know someone there? At the window they said they were understaffed and can't change anything on the app to show drive thru only. Very inconvenient,  and they were unapologetic. Frappuccinos were melted and coffee was luke warm when they finally gave it to me. 
Go to one of the other hundred Starbucks in town. This one is poorly managed.

I hate this location. The people are so slow. I always order a frap and the bearded guys "always" forgets it in the blender. They kick out 6 or 7 drinks before they remember I am still waiting.

The location on Broadway near Kolb is so much faster and has a drive through. Well worth the drive across town.

There was even one time I was waiting for my frap... again, then one f their former employees walked in. Everyone stopped what they were doing to say hi. They took her order right away, she got her order right away. And I was still standing there staring at my frap sitting on the blender. That was the last time I ever went to that location, so aggravating. Fire that whole staff and start over... except for the older dude, he works his tail off compared to the younger staff. Promote him! They are the reason I am ashamed of my generation.

One of the worst Starbucks I've ever been to. I was able to order right away and then the wait began. I waited 15-20 minutes for one iced coffee. There were at least 5 people working but only 1 making coffees. It wasn't even slammed. On top of that the inside of the store was quite dirty. The floors were awful and nothing was restocked. It was evident that customer service was not a priority here.

I was staying nearby for the weekend and stopped here early on Saturday. I only did the drive through, but it was quick and yummy! It is off the freeway a bit, but in a really convenient location. Easy to find and go through the drive thru. Good menu and good service.

This has got to be the slowest, most incompetent Starbucks I've ever been to. That says a lot, since I've visited hundreds. I waited in the drive thru line for 35 minutes for one item, and no it wasn't during rush hour or anything. 
Actually still in line! This is the reason I typically visit the Goodlettsville location. Should've known better.

Eew. l just paid $17 for: a triple Macchiato that tastes like nothing but milk (no espresso in sight despite paying for extra espresso), a mocha Frappuccino that is basically ice and chocolate syrup (you can even see the ice visibly separated from the syrup) not in the least appetizing, and a mocha that tastes like chocolate water. First and last visit.
