Just redeemed a birthday drink. 

Tanya was AMAZINGLY friendly, wished me happy birthday, and gave me this big smile that just lit up the entire room! She totally made my day!

This is a high volume store and the crew does a great job but I don't understand why the markup is so high. And going higher, apparently. Guess I will just have to start bringing my own coffee to work until the University gives out another raise. :/
Perhaps Jimmy who works the first shift should consider finding another line of work. He was super rude this morning. He didn't want to call my name for my coffee. He was just so cringe. Ugh.

The customer service at this location is subpar. They don't reinforce the mask policy and they run out of a lot of ingredients and don't offer any substitutions for a drink you might order because of their own inventory issues. I have finally had it with this location. Save yourself the time and go to the other location about 2 miles up the road for a better experience.
Super long line, took forever to get to the front. When I did get there, they told me they were out of food. I'll go to a different Starbucks from now on

I decided to not make my usual fast rush home after running the rat race all day and take a moment to remember why I work like a demon.  

$6.00 craft IPA with an espresso shot on top along with $6.00 truffle mac and cheese is where I decided to throw my hard earned dollars at.  Keep in mind the evening menu is called small plates so do not expect a big heaping portion of food nor a trough of spirits but for the evening kick back it's just the right amount of everything.  

The baristas usually serve the truffle mac n cheese on a real plate with real silverware (not the cheap plasticity things) so do not let my photo fool you.  I actually wanted to take mine to go and not eat it all in a sitting.    This was a hard feat because the mac is seriously good coming from a coffeehouse!!   I mean wow!  And I was thinking I would not get my mac b cheese fix because the place I wanted to go is closed on Tuesdays.   The mac n cheese has a nice lasting taste that keeps you craving another forkful that you have to wonder how did Starbucks pull this off and where can you get the recipe from.    It is cheesy and moist, not dried out and not lacking flavor with its complex flavor profile.  I admit for $6.00 its expensive but the taste had me hooked and throwing my dollars at it like a well deserving....um yeah probably should not say who or what lol!!

Somehow the Espresso Cloud IPA paired perfectly although they suggest a wine with it.   I normally would never think beer and mac n cheese could pair so well.    The Espresso Cloud IPA has a nice smooth taste that keeps it from tasting like a regular boring IPA like some I have came across as of late.  The smoothness also mellows on the finish to where you may be tempted to have one more before leaving.

For an evening kick back and maybe even a get to know you date, Starbucks Evening menu definitely will have you seeing stars of delight.

Leaving Nashville and heading north, we wanted to grab a coffee before we went too far and had to wait until we hit Bowling Green, KY. While a turn or two away from the highway, this Starbucks was easy to get to and get back on the highway from. 

It's got a nice private parking lot but it shares a structure with a minute clinic which was a first for me. 

The staff were nice and answered my questions about some new items easily. The menu and set up was pretty standard for Starbucks - minus the fact that the pick-up counter is all the way at the back by the bathrooms. You wait way at the back of the shop and then have to wade  through all the shop and the checkout queue which is kind of odd and could be really challenging for a wheelchair user, customers with kids, or someone trying to grab a seat, work, and grab their coffee when it's ready. 

.

If you go through my Yelp reviews, you will come to the conclusion that I spend lots of time in coffeeshops, especially Starbucks locations. You would be correct.

As a medical student/physician I am, quite literally, a lifelong learner. Starbucks fits the bill for a place that offers both a conducive place to study as well as consistently strong enough coffee throughout its locations.

In terms of places to get work done, this is one of my favorites in the area. It's located in the heart of the Tyrone area so if you need to run nearly any errand before or after spending some time at a coffeeshop, it is extremely convenient. Parking is not an issue either.

Secondly, the openness of the cafe really helps let in lots of natural light which helps me focus. There are also lots of other people here getting work done so it feels like a productive atmosphere. There's a big table too with tons of outlets.

Thirdly, the baristas here are all extremely kind and quick! This is a very busy location and I've never seen them lose their cool. They make working under pressure look like a breeze.

Overall, this is probably my favorite Starbucks in Pinellas County.
Love this location!! They always are so welcoming with their greetings. The only bad thing is that is only 1 mile from my house and is too convenient when I get a strawberry açaí refresher desire.
Just use driveway. Parking lot is very small. Staff was busy as usual. store was clean. always seems high priced but that's just how it is.

I'm always confused why Starbucks is so busy.  Stopped by this morning as this was the closet coffee, and waited 10 minutes.  Coffee is mediocre compared to other local coffee shops.  Rather get better coffee and support local business vs. this Corp giant.

The drive thru line was long so I decided to go inside. I often debate about going in Starbuck versus waiting in a drive thru line, because the lines usually move pretty quick. I'm glad that I went in. The service was professional and fast. They seem to be doing what they need to take precautions for COVID safety.

This Starbucks is by far the SLOWEST Starbucks I've ever been to. Every time I go through the drive thru, it takes over 20 minutes to get my coffee. Today, I decided to go inside... my mistake, it took 35 minutes to get my coffee. They need to hire more people or come up with a better system.

Drive Thru Disappointment

I frequent this Starbucks because its close to my house. It used to have a trash can accessible to drive thru customers, but apparently according to a staff member I spoke with it was "getting used too much" so now the trash can is still there, but its too far away for use from drive thru customers. Why you would remove a feature that was getting used is completely beyond me.

Rude, slow, and inaccurate. They had an attitude when I walked up, ordered, and when they handed out my drink. They also gave me a completely different drink from what I ordered and were entirely unprofessional throughout the experience, they were yelling at each other behind the bar and ignoring the long line of customers. And this is coming from another Starbucks partner.
We came here while waiting on a table from a popular restaurant. This is a large Starbucks and the staff was friendly.
Out of mango dragonfruit 2 different times. My daughter is never coming back to this store
The wait was horrendous, the service lackluster, and the cleanliness/upkeep deplorable.

I hate that this is the closest Starbucks to my house.  Either they can't read or you refuse to listen,for some  reason extra almond milk means I want a black iced coffee. If I'm asking you for extra when I order I don't want my coffee to be almost black. I don't understand why this is such a hard concept I'm not trying to be an asshole.

I asked for a caramel Frappuccino with EXtra caramel and got a regular one. The pictures show they barely put any in the first place. Everything else I got was fine because I got a puppucino and a birthday cake pop but the actual drink they didn't! they were slow, the line had space for one car and shortly after I pulled in multiple other cars pulled in behind me but they still were taking long. The lady at the window was nice taking my order and giving it to me but other than that it wasn't worth it.

Awful customer service. Came in last night at Tuesday 8/13. Tried to order a mango dragon fruit. Upon receiving it there was no dragon fruit so I asked why. They said they were out. I think that would've been great to know prior to ordering. The two guys working especially the one on the bar was extremely rude when asking if I wanted a refund. Was willing to order something else but I won't be coming back to this location are they're clearly under trained in handling customers. Glad I didn't spend my money here.
I was very excited for this location to open. They have already exceeded my expectations. They are the friendliest Starbucks staff by far and all of my drinks have been spot on. Thank you!!

So, We go all the way to this Deptford location bc they have made our drinks perfectly to our specific likings/specifications.  So I have been giving them 5 stars. 
Well, today I have a problem. Not with their staff or the taste of our drinks, as always. But the big thing for me, they gave me this horrible straw. When I started to drink, it wouldn't come thru the straw. I pulled it out and it actually disintegrated!!!  Seriously. I'm not kidding  
Where are the normal large green straws that I use everyday?  
Yes, we get Starbucks everyday. 
I have to have it, not only bc it's yummy, but bc of my medical situation (chemical imbalances) which requires me to have a specific amount of caffeine. 
Anyway, what the heck is this cardboard straw?
Starbucks Corporation, stock the stores with the green plastic straws please!
fucking idiots only filled my drink up halfway. i ordered a chai tea latte with light ice ??? NOT LIGHT DRINK DUMBASS. AND IT STILL HAS A SHIT LOAD OF ICE

Worst and slowest Starbucks ever. 20 minutes to get a hot tea. The staff was serving the drive thru and the inside counter was back up 10 orders deep. There were 3 employees working the drive thru and 1 working the counter.
I will be looking for another coffee tea place and will  not be returning to this location.

I've been going to this starbucks for nearly three years and 99% of my experiences are great. Being attached to a hotel means there will always be lines and the staff handle them with speed and accuracy.

I'm not sure why, but Starbucks coffee tends to always taste burnt, so I still with the various tea and non coffee drinks they have. Matcha latte, passion tea lemonade, you name it and they can whip it up. Freaky limited edition drink? Make it a venti.  Are you craving 12 cake pops and an order of egg whites? They will hook you up.

The only downside about this site is they don't accept Starbucks's rewards or special promotional deals, like happy hour, so plan accordingly.

The location is prime in the 5 points area. The flow of the store is simple & efficient with this social distancing season. The drinks were good but the service - not so good. After they got one of our drinks wrong we let them know & put it back on the counter. The girl was snippy & told us to throw it away bc there was nothing they could do with it instead of apologizing for their mistake & taking it from us.
Faster to stay in the drive thru back out to the street than mobile order pick up same arrival time today

The drive thru is a thing of convenience. Or so I thought.
I am assuming the new people are on the drive thru. I ordered a hot chocolate & a chocolate chip cookie. 
The young man at the window appears with hot 2% milk. And no cookie. So I told him. Sir, that's not my order. He reappeared with a cookie. Hmmm, I just took the cookie paid and left. Maybe things will improve once they get trained properly. On the bright side noone was rude to me. Oh it's gonna be a lovely day.

Save your money and go to a local cafe. Don't support this toxic work environment. I worked here for over 6 months and it was the absolute worst experience I've ever had working anywhere. Each employee here is overworked, overwhelmed, & underpaid. 

Starbucks is a mega corporation thats more than capable of paying their employees more. Not only that, but dear lord, please check up on your management. Creepy bosses, district people coming in a watching you while you work, at least one employee leaves crying everyday. It's ridiculous. If you ever consider working here; don't.

This Starbucks is literally never open. They are randomly closed for days at a time, and the inconsistency is extremely frustrating. If you as a store manager can't orchestrate a team that can operate within the business hours that you have listed on your website, then you are not fit for the role. I've been a store manager for 8 years and have battled through COVID myself. There is absolutely no excuse for the inconsistency in operating hours. I will not ever be returning to this Starbucks under its current management.

I ordered 3 beverages on the app about 30 minutes beforehand. When I got there the employees said that I have to stand inline at the drive through. The line was very long going around the building. I couldn't cancel my order on the app, and when I asked the employees to cancel they said that I have to stay in line to cancel. So I left feeling very angry that I waisted my time, money and still don't have my beverages. Poor experience that reflects: corporate greed & lack of customer service. There should be a cancel button on the app or a warning for  stores that don't have a mobile pick up.

Yo the barista's in Philly are built different, nyc native here visiting Philly and they are really risking it all for the brand. Starbucks, give this Man a RAISE! We were sitting in the cafe when the SB employee came over to a couple (seemingly homeless) and gave them a fair warning to leave, since they had been sleeping on the benches and were repeatedly asked not to. The exchange became hostile after the couple refused to leave along with their suitcases and bags of stuff. (Meanwhile bops were playing from Donna Summer and Lana Del Rey) the man of the couple had started to threaten the employee saying "You got the wrong one!" And "I'll show you what time it is big boy!" The employee did not back down for a second and insisted on maintaining a safe space for us. I appreciate a barista who can make a mean mocha and bring the hands when necessary.

Just went there and staff was extremely sweet. My family and I had Joy at the drive thru window. They actually covered our drinks, thanking us for being patient. Funny thing is, their service was EXTREMELY fast and no patience was needed. Thank you to Joy and the rest of their amazing staff for such a sweet gesture and clearly being so caring to their customers. We love you!

This location can never seem to get an order right no matter how many times you repeat it to them. Today I ordered a certain kind of hot tea, I repeated myself twice, they still tried to give me the wrong kind even though the two sound nothing alike and I had to wait for them to remake it. I got home and opened my tea to let it cool and there's a long black hair floating in it. So there's my money down the drain, literally... again. Because this isn't the first time this has happened. I've ordered green tea and been served straight unsweet lemonade mix (which looks nothing like the iced green tea) and had to go back and waste my time waiting for them to remake it. I've had metal in my green tea latte because they are sloppy with opening packaging...and it's always an "oops sorry about that, if you come down we'll remake it." Like it's not a big deal, like I didn't almost SWALLOW a shard of some kind of metal foil, like I have the time to go back down there because of their mistake. They really need better training at this location, until then I'll gladly drive the extra 5 minutes to ina and oracle and stop wasting my money here.
I don't know why this place it's so so so dirty. Trash on the floor everywhere and table are yucky. Worker here doesn't know about their product and drinks...

Worst and laziest person working there ever. Everytime I've been there, same person. She's slow to take your order ( last time she stood with her back to me, washing dishes, and ignoring me completely). Today she claimed she was unable to steam milk because the steamer "is broken". No drinks then. Apparently just for me. I'll never go back . She's a horror show.

Since they closed Clayton @ Wydown location  this location has suffered because of to much demand and lack of capacity.  They suffer from unreasonable waits and constantly miss estimated windows quoted for mobile orders.  Some times they are early, which is good but most cases 7-10 minutes late.  15 minutes or later has occurred on more than 1 occasion.  Likely will be charging our Starbucks habit to a competitor soon

This is a Starbucks that is located at 42nd and woodland and is part of the university of the sciences. It serves students, faculty, and anybody in the area and takes all forms of payment including the student bucks. 

This Starbucks is run by the Sodexo company but has the drinks and foods associated with Starbucks. The drinks are made very well usually, but be aware that on certain days the store may be out of many things such as bagel,s, danishes, crescents. They can also be out of syrups due to high demand. 

Due to covid there are no seating options for guests in the Starbucks area. Social distancing is encouraged and masks are mandatory. They are quick so you wont be waiting too long.

This use to be my stop for Starbucks because I'm close to my work place I can walk for a minute to get my drink. I did a mobile order around 9:50 and it say will be ready around 10:05. I came in around 9:58 and still waiting on my drink. The girl that was standing there was handing people drink. The people already ordered drink way before me and the other probably after me got their drink. I was like they getting busy so I don't mind waiting for a little bit longer. I already saw my drink out. I was waiting for her to call for my name that my drink is ready. She look at it and didn't say anything and put it down. I'm like what the heck 20 minutes go by I'm like. What the heck? I go up there and told her my name. And say It just got here 2 second ago. She got the audacity to lie in my face. And told me have a great day. I'm like I didn't get my cookie and she like oh we ran out of that you want something else. I say cheese danish. She was being to nice to other people but apparently not me I didn't even do nothing to her. She didn't even give me a free red cup either. She shouldn't be working at that counter if she treat people like this.

Late in the day business meeting. Plenty of space in this small venue for our group of 7. Slow service....I mean....s-l-o-w service with a barrista who was very congenial but kept forgetting what the orders were and/or for whom. Wrote the order on the cup, but not the name...and at times mixed the cups with another patron's order.

The Chili Mocha Frappucino (warm) was excellent. Pastries and other finger foods that might have helped our group a bit were sparse and stale.

Will return if I'm ever back in the area...but hope for better.

Lovely new Brentwood location. Easy access off Hwy 64. in the lower plaza next to CycleBar. Drive thru available, outdoor patio and plenty of seating inside. Staff is decent but could certainly use a little spunk & a few smiles to go with a morning cup of Joe. Merchandise, snacks, nice background music and most importantly caffeinated beverages vailable. Therefore I'll likely return at some point.  

~Christy

This is the best Starbucks in Reno, NV and maybe the good ol USA. The employees here go above and beyond and seem to be just better than other Starbucks around the states. I've been coming here for over 12 years on a weekly basis and am amazed at how polished their skills are to other Bucks stores.  This store staff go above and beyond for their customers.  My drinks are always made correctly.  When In Reno, NV check out this place at 7th and Keystone.

Once a month my church group... Just Us Couples get together for some fellowship. Food. And laughs. This evening our group of about 20 decided to meet up at this Starbucks location after we had dinner at a few restaurants near by. 
Everyone ordered something from a Starbucks. So they made several great sales from us. We hung out enjoying each other's company. Talking. Laughing. And drinking coffee/tea/pastries. We were having a great time. 
This is a group of Empty Nesters. We all look forward to our fellowship. After about 45 min, one of the employees came to our table and told us to "keep it down and not be so loud" because they can not hear the orders from the customers in the drive thru. Like really??? We...... paying customers were impacting your job. Man get out of here. It was such a disappointing experience and embarrassing for our group organizer. 
What this employee did was unacceptable. No group should ever be singled out. Especially not the way she did it and how she said it. We are adults. And we were being very mindful of what we were doing. 
Anyhow.... it was such a great evening that ended up being disappointing as we left Starbucks.

fast service. friendly faces. 

this location is ON POINT with the new 'order to go' app feature. they have always had my drink/food prepared before i get there. thank you for being organized!!!!!!!

I used to love going to this location...when there was a very nice barista (never caught her name) but I haven't seen her in awhile. Since her departure, Kim is always there and she is horrible. She's always chatting away with the other baristas, not helping customers in line or making drinks for the waiting customers. She is rude and her drinks are inconsistent. This last trip, I overheard her telling the other barista that she won't be getting the vaccine and will get a fake vaccination card. I stopped going to that location even when I'm shopping at Albertsons, I will go out of my way to the other locations.

Great place to pick up coffee. I used to come here a lot when I'm studying in the library. Haven't had any problems. The only minor problem is the high prices, but that is to be expected of Starbucks.

I go to this Starbucks often because it is the nearest one to my house. The location is great and the place is always clean. Even during the rush times they try to get your drink out in a timely manner. The reason for the 3 stars is the accuracy of the drinks and how often they mess up orders. The quality of your drink depends on who is working and how they feel that day. There are plenty of times I have gotten the wrong drink or it was made incorrectly or they would forget to give me my food. Another issue is asking for extra caramel, paying for it, and getting the average amount. All my caramel lovers know how frustrating that is! When I say extra extra extra caramel I mean extra extra extra caramel! I want to see it all at the bottom of my cup not just a few lines around the edges.

Starbucks never ceases to amaze me with their policy on allowing the crumb bums and vagrants to take naps, store their belongings and stink the place up.  Beautiful new location. Lots of space to stretch out and nap. Friendly staff. Get rid of the crumb bums and smelly vagrants.

The only reason I even go to this starbucks is because it's the only one on my way to work, but other than that the manager is horrible!!!!!!!! She was unpacking boxes when i went to get my drink the other day & literally threw the box over my head & if i didn't move it would of hit me. another time she told me i didn't know then importance of masks & was rude to me all while i was wear scrubs to go work my hospital job during a pandemic.  there's one employee here that is always pleasant & nice, he always tells me have a good day & says good morning, but the rest are rude, & honestly the customers are rude af too. i wish they would make a starbucks closer to my house so i could stop going to this trash can of a strarbucks

I have been to many Starbucks over the years but never seen a place like this. This is the Starbucks in the Nugget Casino in Spark, NV. A barista uses a whip cream container, she hangs the container on edge of a trash container(see attached picture. I circled). After seen that, I walked out of the place. That makes think twice to go visit any Starbuck again. Is this how Starbucks trains their employees? After many many years of their customer I am so disappointed. I hope they change their training procedure so this type of incident do not occur again.

This is a common place of study for me. While studying for home inspection state Licensing exam, I sent here every single day. The staff is nice, helpful, and friendly. Every time, no matter how crowded. My drinks comes quick and just how I ordered it. I've never had a problem at this Starbucks.

What is all this about dinner here?  Just looks like a regular Starbucks to me.  To be fair, I've only been through the drive through... this place is on the way out of town heading Northeast.  

But the service is fast and it's standard 'bucks.    

Take that for what it's worth.

I like this Starbucks because:

- It's brand new and clean.
- It's spacious with plenty of tables and seats to meet up with friends, work related meetings or study.
- The high long table has many electrical outlets. You can basically sit anywhere and there'd be an outlet to use.
- The Baristas are nice.
- There is a drive thru.

I don't like this Starbucks because:

- It shares a parking lot with Chipotle so it's impossible to find parking during the lunch hour.

I was reading some of the other yelp posts about the ineptitude at this location but I needed a Starbucks and I was right there.  Going through the drive-thru, I hoped for the best.  Grande + 3 shots, extra cream, 6 sugars.  
When I took the lid off the coffee cup in my car I found it was filled to the brim.  Had I been wearing a business suit, I would have been livid but it's just laundry day.

I'm OCD so I would have put the shots in first to make sure I had enough room for them, then the coffee w/room for extra cream.  Personally, I think OCD is a gift and that the rest of you should try a little harder to rise up to our standards.  No offense!  Just, please?

I have been driving all around greenwood and every location is closed early. This one, STILL OPEN AT 5:40pm and packed but successfully getting people in and out at a fast pace still with a friendly environment. I am 5 1/2 months pregnant and the second i got greeted, I instantly felt calmer and just excited to get a drink. This pandemic has affected a lot of places I understand that, just helps when the staff is still welcoming and not pressured by the overwhelming amount of customers due to staff shortage at other locations.
This location is the worst. They are so slow that traffic gets backed up into the street. They never listen to what your order is to get it correct. Most days they are out of items too.

Another good Starbucks! What I love about this Starbucks is all the windows and natural light that shines through. It has lots of seating, with tables and comfy chairs for those that want to relax and read a book. It is pretty busy because of the location, but I always find a seat. This Starbucks also has a drive-through, and has good service too!

Either keep the inside open or close it--but quit changing it back and forth with no explanation.  For the last several times I've attempted to go to this location the inside had no signs but was closed, then open, then it said closed but really was open, then closed again.   Make up your mind so customers know what to expect.

This Starbucks is awesome !  
Personally, it's becoming a favorite!

I believe this is a newer location with a newish design, they even have cool plants, curtains, shades and a modern interior which is cozy and inviting.  The bathroom facilities are newish too.

What I personally like of this Starbucks vs other Starbucks in the area is they play music that's at a good volume, not too high and it's a smaller cafe so it doesn't get overly noisy like some busier cafes which can become a bit overwhelming.  

I find that the baristas are friendly and welcoming, positive and in a good mood!  

This is a nice cafe to relax and grab a quick bite.  
Warm, friendly atmosphere.  I enjoy it!  
Wish it was closer to me!

Today is double star day!! That means much needed coffee. Luckily this Starbucks location was on near by, its my favorite location for respectful employees who get my order correct on the first try and speedy service!

I am regular at Starbucks whether I'm at this location or a location across the map. This location is the closes to my house and the baristas here are generally nice. 

The location does not have a drive through and are typically busy during the mornings because everyone wants to get coffee before work so I typically place a mobile order before heading to work. 

The only issue I have with the location is that I generally order my drink through mobile order. I typically place this order 10 minutes before leaving my house. The app will generally give me a time frame of anywhere between 2-6 mins that my order will be ready. It takes me a about 5 minutes to get to the location which gives an entire 15 minutes to prepare my order. For the past few days my coffee isn't being made until I actually arrive which defeats the purpose of me ordering ahead of time and allowing more time after the given time frame. I am unsure if this is due to new baristas or some other factors but I surely hope a better strategy is implemented. 

Sometimes I like to sit in and take care of some personal things while having a drink. Most of the tables are usually taken up all day so I have to visit a different location which isn't a big deal just a heads up if you like to sit in for some alone time. 

Other than my issue with mobile ordering the location isn't too bad.

Unless you order your drink ahead of time via the app, don't expect to get your drink in a timely manner...even if the place is dead and you are the only person waiting for an in-store ordered drink. There is no sense of urgency to any of the aforementioned drink-making and they seem to be consistently understaffed, or the staff isn't managed properly. You've got three people taking orders/warming food, but only one making drinks. The renovation of last year is unwelcoming (probably done on purpose) and it no longer has the small-town feel it once had. Oh, and the flooring they chose to put down shows everything and it is beyond dirty every time I go in. This store is going to take a hit once the new one opens over near McCaffrey's, especially if they can't get their crap together.

If you want to grab a quick bite for breakfast, nothing beats Starbucks! Glad there's a Starbucks at the casino so I don't have to sit down and eat a full breakfast. I got a ham and Swiss croissant heated up perfectly and a grande apple crisp macchiato. Not a fan of the apple crisp macchiato, it has a nice apple smell to it but the taste fell flat from that. Glad I tried it though!

The four servers there were totally not interested in timely service (served me after several orders after me)), pretty sure on purpose) & when I asked for a longer straw for my venti frap, she said those are for venti (really?!)

This place is absolutely ridiculous, I placed a mobile order yesterday for a Venti quad white chocolate mocha. I went to pick it up and it tasted like water down hot chocolate at the very least. I called the store spoke to the manager her name was Liz, she offered to remake that drink but I was in a hurry so she told me the next time I come in to tell them the order was on herperiod So I just went through today about 1:05 PM and ordered the exact same thing I ordered yesterday. When I got to the window and let the young lady know but I spoke to Liz and the drink was supposed to be three I got 150 questions I told her at the beginning I spoke to Liz when I get did you even talk to anyone yesterday, yes I spoke to Liz. As if I were trying to steal something I spend too much money on as it is, all of this came right afterThey made the wrong size and didn't put the requested amount of shots so it had to be made over. The young lady at the window has a very bad attitude, I visit the store daily, this girl is new, and she sounds like she hates her job. I will just drive to the one on Southport Road from now on.
What to say - Its a Starbucks with great service.  Usually hang outside after cycling on the weekend - can't beat it.  Baristas are very friendly.

On my way to Vanderbilt I stopped by this Starbucks location directly up the street from the school. It's the perfect spot to study, meet with friends or colleagues, or just relax and enjoy the scenery.

I beat the early morning work crowd and was able to be in and out in minutes with an iced coffee in hand. The staff was very friendly and quick in taking and making orders.

My favorite aspect of this Starbucks location is the outdoor seating, it's very upscale with a covered top and lots of table options. This would be a great place to work on projects on a nice day. I will definitely be back!

This starbucks always has a very long wait in the drive thru. No matter what time you go. My order is also always wrong or taste off. I continue to go because I like starbucks over dunkin donuts and it is the closest starbucks to me. This store needs to speed up there process and make better coffee.

I always come in super early so there's never anybody there so maybe that's why I never had to contend with long lines from students excetera. when I come in,  the ladies who are behind the counter are always very nice & friendly

The service has gotten better. One of the better starbucks in the area. I'd go to this one over the Target one down the road. But avoid the drive thru at all cost if there are any cars in line. One time I saw 2 cars in line at the drive thru and I thought ok this will be quick but nope took me about 10 mins to be out.

Oh you know, your run of the mill Starbucks.

The bathrooms were clean. This Starbucks seems much larger than other locations. There is plenty of seating as well as outdoor seating. The staff was friendly but the drinks do take quite a while. Not sure if I will be back to this Starbucks. It's in the most convenient location to get in and out.

My friends like Starbucks food. I am neutral. They got me cheese bacon egg croissant: it was hot and every single item was good quality.
I am giving five stars based on my food, not the physical location.
NB: previous reviews would have made me turn away.

Still can't take an order straight.   Finally stopped going.  It would be so easy to just listen to the customers orders.  I did buy twenty pounds of coffee from them because I love the coffee, just won't subject myself to the usual wait and then to have the order  screwed up every other time.  Last time I purchased a coffee " large ice with two artificial sweetener and cream ".  They gave me two coffees and both of them were loaded with sugar as well at the sweetener.  Maybe it's more complicated than I think.
Thank you thank you thank you! To manager of the Starbucks for donating to my classroom for preschoolers with autism! They donated so many straws for a sensory activity and we are so appreciative!

I had the best drive-through attendant I have ever been helped by today. I ordered a cold brew with almond milk-- they were out but the attendant happily offered me some other non-dairy creamers and gave us two cups of water to go since it was a hot day. Delightful service at a typical Starbucks.
Another slow day at the drive through with the new blonde kid. Please someone check out what's going on. This time I had to ask him to hand me my drink!

This Starbucks was clean, and service was friendly and quick!

The very big downside to this location is the parking lot. There is a double-sided, one-way lane that hooks to the left into the oncoming lane of a two-way road. The space is very tight, and if the two cars parked at the end by the store aren't parked far enough into their spots, you may have to do a bit of neck-craning to make sure you're going to make it out without a scratch.

Otherwise, I like this SB and would go again.

This Starbucks is the  average Starbucks. Lots of area for seating, indoor and outdoor. Staff is friendly and somewhat attentive. I ordered a tea, and had the cash in my hand. The barista decided to leave me hanging and made my tea first. I wish he would have taken my cash. The board that shows what Starbucks offers is a bit disorganized. I felt confused as to know what to order.also, staff does not know their product. My friend asked for a Vanilla Steamer, but the barista at the counter had no idea what that was. If it wasn't for the manager my friend would not have gotten what she wanted because the staff does not know their product!!!!!!!

I always order via mobile and have yet to have a good experience at this location.  It seems they don't have a process in place to let folks know if the unclaimed items at the counter out of reach from patrons are for mobile orders.  There's usually a group of folks waiting for drinks having placed orders through the app only for walkins to be given drinks first whilst the mobile orders sit there.  Why not just acknowledge folks if they're standing there for some unknown reason...like a mobile order?  Seriously...eye contact...acknowledgement...simple courteous customer service stuff.
We waited for half an hour and every single part of our order was messed up. Literally every drink.

This Starbucks has both quality and quick service. Both my drink and all of my friends' drinks were made deliciously, and came out really quick even during rush hour. One of the main girls working, possibly the manager, was also excellent. She was exceptionally friendly and would make light conversation with customers which I enjoyed. I also noticed one of the other workers who appeared to be new was having trouble doing a particular task on the register. She quickly went to him and showed him how to do it and explained exactly in what situation or condition you would actually need to do that task, including telling him that it had to be done before the next customer could get to the register. I appreciated hearing that as it shows the commitment to fast and quality service and how they value their customers. One of the best Starbucks stores that I've been to.
Excellent staff and excellent service. They always get my drink right. Iced green tea latte with soy milk is my go to!
Used to be a favorite, but something's changed... Today, at 3pm, I tried to order a decaf Americano and was told no, not available. No decaf in the middle of the afternoon?!! At a Starbucks!

Not really happy with this location. My friend and i got to starbucks at least twice a week and everytime we have come to this store they never get our drinks right and the lady/ladies who are running the drive thru are rude most of the time. I dont recommend this location.

I came here almost every day for 6 years, and my experience has been hit or miss. There's constantly staff changes. There was a very nice barista who used to work there at least a few years ago but left to the King of Prussia Starbucks; he even remembered me and my order when I went there. Mel, a current barista, is the best! Ever since I first met her, she's always been smiling and making my drinks perfectly. If you want light ice, less drizzle, more drizzle, no whip, whatever, she's the girl to ask. Whenever I ask another barista (don't know her name) for light ice, she fills the cup with so much ice that I had to shimmy my straw through a couple times. Sometimes if Mel isn't working, I don't even bother to ask.
Because this is the University Starbucks: The inside is pretty spacious but always full. The line can get really long, especially between xx:50 and xx:10. There's never available parking spaces after 7:30 AM. Rewards don't work, but you can still get stars. 
One nice addition is that they do have a barcode scanner now so the baristas no longer have to punch in the card number.

I am beyond happy that they got rid of the Starbucks across the street and moved to this new location. The old Starbucks had barely any parking and was difficult to enter and exit. This new Starbucks has a bougie drive-thru and tons of lot parking.

The girl working the drive-thru today was incredibly sweet. She made sure to call me by my name and thanked me for waiting patiently - even though there were a ton of cars in front of me and they were going through at a reasonable pace.

Love, love, love this new location!
Consistently, comically slow. It is funny because they show no signs of improvement, ever. Worth a laugh, staff is always very nice.
It was ok.  Big stuff f God did so discuss icy rigidity d do d TV etc day has u do odd Suzy trust

The internet is SOOOO slow I can't even work on my laptop here. Don't even TRY if there's more than 4 people here. PLEASE switch from AT&T to Google like so many other Starbucks have. There is NO REASON this store should still be on the slower speed with this many Carmel Professionals coming in and out of here... 

Plus, the parking availability is awful as well...

I'll treck to the Meridian and 131st to get Google Wi-Fi and parking.

I no longer live in Indianapolis but my wife and I travel back often for friends and business. This time around we have been to 3 Starbucks locations so far on our trip in the Greenwood/Indy area. I say all of that to just say WOW....to this location in particular. They do not have their lobby closed (huge points there for me) they are training new hires (shows they have a great work environment to be hiring when nobody else can find employees) and they had smiles you could feel through the masks the entire time. I brought my daughter in on a coffee run, she's 1 and a half, and everyone complimented her on how cute she was but she was restless nonetheless. One of your employees offered to help me carry my four drinks to my car for me, to most this may seem like a small gesture but in today's society that speaks volumes. I just wanted to say thank you and that If anyone is looking for great coffee and a great environment to match please don't waste your time going ANYWHERE else. This spot is the place to be and I left with a smile on my face. I own a retail business myself and know that an environment like that is built from the top to the bottom. So thank you to all employees and to those training and growing this location.
They said my order would take 10 minutes and it literally took 20 min. To make 2 coffees. Insanity
Asked for very light ice and this is what I gotvery disappointing! Next time it will be with NO ice.

I happen to be right next to this place every day, sometimes twice a day! It took me a couple years but now I find myself hitting the drive thru once or twice a week. I usually get a nitro cold brew and a smoked Gouda sandwich. Sometimes the nitro machine (tap?) Is down but it's not that often. Their nitro brew beats the other large chain nitro cold brew by a mile.

Best part about this location is the friendly drive thru staff, they're always so happy. I don't know how they do it!

To be honest the only downside are the terrible drivers that frequent this place. As I mentioned I goto a business nearby and these other "drivers" do things you would only see in a demolition derby. So if you do stop here be prepared for the hot mess that is their drive thru.

The Starbucks location is located within the Reno nugget hotel 

One would think just based on the fact that this location is inside of a hotel, that service, and offerings would be top notch. They really aren't

This location has some segregated seating for Starbucks, but the seats and tables are not wiped down, making it impossible to grab a drink and sit there and enjoy it.

Barista's are supposed to be knowledgeable and friendly. I found the customer service to be mediocre at best. When I asked if they had specific flavorings for my drink, the barista had an attitude and said that it was a flavor that they did not carry. I'm 100% sure that caramel is a frequently used flavor at all Starbucks.  

If you don't mind a drive about a mile away from the hotel, there is a lovely drive through down the road. The barista's there are super nice, and provide great customer service.

Okay first of all... I wanted Starbucks, during the corona virus they only had there drive through open and that's fine but the service was absolutely great! Shoutout to John!! He made my experience great!!!! Awesome attitude!!!! Keep up the great work!!!

First time I ever remember asking for a refund, but after waiting almost 30 minutes for my order of one coffee I'd reached the end of my limit. It should NEVER take 30 minutes to get an order from a well managed Starbucks, and that to me is the issue at this one - very poorly managed. 

I ordered on the mobile app from my home at 9:10 am. The app told me my order would be ready at 9:25. At around 9:37, with my coffee order still back in the line, I asked for a refund. Being busy is not an excuse - if you know you are going to be busy you plan for it with proper staffing. 

The music in the lobby was VERY loud. From where I was standing if my name had been called, there was not way I would be able to hear it from employees calling names at normal volume level. Again, just a total lack of awareness of the manager on duty today. 

It will be a LONG time before I return to this location. I learned today they don't really appreciate me as a customer, so I'll take my business elsewhere.

Whent in at 4:39 and noone answered the drive thru. Was exited to try this since i work early. But lost me before having me.
Thanks again Goodluck

I went in to the Broadway location to get a Salted Carmel Coldbrew with no ice. The Barist handed it to me full of ice, and I nicely told her I ordered it with no ice. She took it back, scooped out the ice with a spoon and handed it back to me.  The drink was inch below the top of the cup and completely mixed. I asked her if she could add more coffee to fill it to the top. She plopped a scoop of foam on the top and walked away. The drink tasted only like foam. I will never go back there again. ($5.95 for foam, yuck)

We ordered several items, they all came, except one drink. A family of about 8 ordered after us, they alllll got their orders before my missing drink. Waited probably 15 mins total, as orders passed. I finally asked the girl, who SAW me standing there (I even said "just waiting on my drink" when a guy asked if I was in line and she looked right at me, didn't bother to look into it), and she said "ummmm what size was it?" (Does it matter?) Then she looks all over the counter top, whispers to another barista, then comes to me and goes "it'll be ready in like a minute"... I said "has it even been started? We're going to be late for our appointment if I wait." And she goes "she's starting it next" so I was like ok well, I gotta go. Not worth the $4 coffee, and she said "ok bye."

It's one thing to miss an order, people are human. Don't BS me about it though when I'm WATCHING you guys not even making the drink.

Very disappointed with Starbucks lately. I was at 2 different locations neither had The English Breakfast tea. I was told there was a tea shortage. Funny that Wawa and the supermarkets do not have a shortage.  It feels like Starbucks would prefer to just serve coffee drinkers. The server was annoyed that I asked what other kinds of tea there were. 
I had to settle for Earl Grey because I had points to use. To top it off the cup was 1/2 full!  The server was annoyed that I wanted sugar and milk in the side. At over $3 for a cup of tea i should be able to have it the way I like it. 
This is why I go to Wawa.

Without question, this is the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to. I have now been standing for 20 minutes, awaiting two drinks that I have already paid for. Given the expected holiday demand, this location is extremely inefficient. FIND ANOTHER LOCATION!

I was in the downtown area taking night photos and when I was done, I still had an hour drive home ahead of me so I wanted a little pick me up. I remembered that El Dorado had a Starbucks inside so I stopped by before walking to my car. 

Service was slow despite there being 3 employees working and only 4-5 people in line. I ordered the Toasted White Mocha (hot) and it tasted like a normal white mocha. Also had a burnt taste to it. Price was over $2.00 more (same drink/size) than what I get at every other location. Ridiculously inflated.

Next time, I'll skip this one and walk a little further to the Silver Legacy location. The price may also be inflated but I've had good luck with service and quality here in the past.

I tried this location again after having several bad experiences and it's great! My drink is always perfect, even during the rush, they take their time to talk to you and make sure everything's perfect before you leave. My go to location now. Keep doing what you're doing guys!
Delicious food and amazing taste & consistency of smoothies. Blows smoothie kings smoothies right out of the park. I think their prices are reasonable and their flavors are amazing.

While house sitting in Kuna I needed a grocery run.  So on my way home from work in Boise, I hit the Winco at the Meridian offramp and decided coffee was in order!  Starbucks rarely disappoints, and this location DID NOT either :)  Quick zip through the drive though and a venti iced caramel macchiato was making my evening MUCH BETTER.  Viva las Starbucks!

Such a great location. I was really craving a Starbucks drink. Let me be honest, I had not been to Starbucks since March 2020...it is November 2020; I needed a treat! 

While I was out running errands, this was the closest location and I decided to give them a try. When I drove around to get in line at the drive-thru, I noticed 7 cars ahead of me-no thanks! I decided I was going to park and order online instead. I placed my order online, waited 2 minutes and then went inside where my drink was ready for me! The barista saw me grab the drink and thanked me and told me to have a great day-so friendly! Such a fast process. Those poor drive-thru people were still waiting while I was on my way. 

This location is clearly a newer location so it looks updated and fancy. There were some people inside working, but it was not crowded at all. They have social distancing signs up and require masks be worn inside. I can definitely see myself visiting this location again!

Went to buy a Starbucks bottle, asked the staff if she had the box for it because i'm buying as a gift for someone. She said she would put in the bag for me. So I assumed she had an extra box so I can put it on my own. Also asked her if I could use the stars reward for my drink, she said okay but still charged me money? After I got my drink, asked for the box again. She said there is no box for the bottle. Then I said don't want the bottle no more. She said no return and already told me that it had no box? Why didn't you bother to confirm if I still want the bottle if there was no box as I told you I bought it as a gift? Very rude customer service! I've been buying cups for all my friends at Starbucks for many years. This is the first time I experienced this!

This Starbucks is so quick and delightful. I was greeted with conversation at the window by a fine young man. He asked how my day was going with a smile and continued to say how he hoped I had a better day. Definitely will be coming back to this Starbucks!!

I get a Trenta Vanilla sweet cream cold brew every day with extra shots and I asked for extra vanilla sweet cream on the side and they want to charge me extra for it.  Triston came to the window drive through and said he is the shift Mgr and told me I have to pay extra for it.  I think this is very petty that I pay 12.04 every day at this place and get different people make it different ways and never taste the same.  Some in their have no idea what they are doing and have no clue of making drinks, so before you start wanting to charge me extra I think it's best you have better training how to make them, I think asking just to remake the drink and waste product is as petty as you asking me to pay for extra.  Really do I need to just say remake it!  How's that works!  I pay you over $300.00 a month and you really want to be this way!!
Light ice means less than half. Since it was a mobile order, I couldn't have it remade.

I just ordered a grande iced caramel macchiato and they gave me a drink that was mostly milk. I went inside and asked politely for them to remake it. They gave me a dirty look and then said yeah... the girl that made it spilled it out some because someone bumped into her and she preceded to give me the drink that was not full anymore. I just said thank you with a smile. I then tasted the drink and it was just a really bitter iced coffee. I was really disappointed but I didn't want to ask for them to remake it. I'm never going to this location again.

I had a great experience with Amy this morning. I messed up with payment and she went out of her way to make sure I got some coffee in me. Excellent customer service, wonderful experience. Thank you again, Amy! You made my morning!

I work remotely and I work at this Starbucks at least twice a week when I'm in town, and I love it. There are plenty of plug in options to charge my laptop and phone, large tables, and comfy chairs. The workers at this Starbucks are personable, energetic and are always welcoming.

This is one of my favorite Starbucks locations in town. It's a newer location with clean interior and an upgraded drive thru with video screen ordering which makes it easier to see that your order is correct. The parking lot is fairly small but there is street parking on Sidney right next to the store. I generally do mobile ordering in the evening before work. The evening crew generally greets me by name and knows how I like my drinks. If they are out of a food item I ordered by the evening they have other suggestions ready for when I arrive. This visit I went in the drivethru at noon during the week and got a Frappuccino as a pick me up. The service was prompt and the guy working the window engaged me in conversation while I waited. I will definitely keep using this Starbucks as my preferred location.
very nice especially on the inside. they also have the latest clover machine and select coffees that you don't always get at starbucks. This is one of my favorite starbucks.

Great location for picking up my morning pick-me-up on my way to work!  The baristas are always friendly, welcoming me with a smile (I can see it in their eyes since they have their masks on!), and a warm "good morning!"  My order is always correct, and they make my drink the best!  Thank you for consistent great service!
I just want to send a quick shout out to  the crew of this Starbucks. They are so busy and so quick and so friendly! Great job!!

It is very unfortunately if you have a bad bladder and have to use the restroom there is no where to use the restroom here in the city because most of the restaurants like this are not allowing the general public to use the restrooms

Worst Starbucks in town. The lobby is closed. They are always out of stuff, specifically non-coffee drinks, so when you order something that they're out of your forced to wait in their drive-thru to just leave empty handed.

If i can give zero, i definitely would like to give zero this location. Not friendly ever. I was waiting to order, the three staffs were keep chattering even they saw me that I'm waiting. If they were making other orders that would be fine. BUT they were not!!
When I scanned the card through mobile app, the lady did not look at me and never said all set. I was like did it scan correctly or not.

This is a busy fast moving Starbucks. There will be a line, it will move fast. The servers are adequately knowledgeable. Not the most, not the least. The food is fresh, sometimes they run out. 
There is parking, yet it is midtown, it is crowded. However in the am, you may consider mobile ordering or go thru drive thru. There are people asking for donations at the front and the back. 
Ironically on the weekend nights it is not to hard to find a place to sit or park. 
There is a fire pit in front when it gets chilly. 
Have ONLY had wonderful coffees and teas here. 
Lots of good seating and wifi.

This has always been my absolute favorite Starbucks, but the last few times I've been here they've been EXTREMELY SLOW!!!!  I even tried using the mobile app and Still have to wait!!!  Today, they told me they never received my mobile order!!!  Funny, that's never ever happened before.  Last time they said staffing was bad...whatever!!!!  I thought Starbucks strove to be the best of everything in customer service and drinks!  Also, last time they prepared my drink on top of everything else and she gave me a $3.00 coupon off for next time, of course my drink was over $7.00 but who cares! Would someone let me know if there is a better option on the south side of Indy???
I didn't know a Starbucks could be so fast and efficient! Wow! I wish that they were all like this. Three drinks and three sandwiches in probably less than 5 minutes in the drive through!
The front staff lady was super friendly. I ordered a Chai lattee with coconut milk and they were able to accommodate which is fantastic. The store was clean and organized.
Consistently good service and short wait times. One of the few good ones left in central Indy - other Starbucks around don't even compare!

Yesterday was my first time at this Starbucks, just a day before Thanksgiving. 

My companion ordered two venti blond coffees, being advised by two baristas that that particular coffee choice offered the maximum caffeine, as she indicated she needed exactly that. I ordered a venti hot chocolate and dark chocolate Graham crackers - a non coffee drinker although an ally to coffee drinkers. 

The baristas, from ordering to receipt of my hot chocolate were friendly, full of the holiday cheer, and made me want to brave the cold morning to revisit them again today. 

Starbucks hot chocolate goes well with banana bread, strawberries and early morning breakfast conversation back at home with dear relatives on our holiday visit.

Well done Starbucks baristas at this shop!
Grazie JC and Kelsie for being epic baristas! You almost make me wanna live in PA rather than in North Carolina....

This store has a real problem with flies! Also, there was a women inside with her dog! She was dropping food on the floor for him, even had a little bowl of water on the floor for him. Not one employee said a word it's one thing to deal with the flies but the dog while I'm eating omg! I had to get out of there! What's up with this Starbucks???

One of the largest Starbucks in town. Therefore has more space for added extras in food and coffee extras and seating. Service has always been friendly. Seating at tables, round tables, lounge like chairs, at a bar looking out to West End/Harding and outdoor seating. Many meetings have been held in this Starbucks.  Parking is shared with the strip mall but always a place to be found. Early am coffee drinkers are moved along nicely, so one doesn't feel like, 
"Oh Snap, I should have skipped coffee this am". The milk and sugar station remains filled and tidy and the tables and bar are clean. One of the top Starbucks in town due to size and hospitality combined. Others also have great quality service, but not the space. Close to many other places, Grocery, Liguor store, Mexican, Sushi, Sandwich place, Office store and Drug store AND close to 40 and 440. Looking for a meeting coffee place close to everything with great service and clean, BAZINGA, here it is!

According to yelp his particular location is supposed to open at 730 this morning. It is 823 am and the doors are locked. I had to call the store to find out that they will not open until 9 am today. Not familiar with this area and just need some place to sit to pass the time. Now completely bummed sitting in my car for 40 minutes waiting for the store to open.
Made me wait longer for ice coffee and any question is answer with smirk or attitude.I don't think the employees want to work there sad.

I understand we are in Newtown and you're supposed to expect being a snot but if I'm standing in front of someone don't ask the person behind me if they need help and then walk away to do something else

Very rude barista. Came up to window to pay and she repeated the order to me and repeatedly rolled her eyes at me . Asked to to fix my order and then she went over to the sink took my lid off my cup and started to scoop the ice out with my lid and added cream and it coffee and then put the lid back on and gave it to me all rudely. Will not be returning to this location that I go to almost every day... sorry not sorry

One photo is from the Starbucks on Jefferson and Walnut. The photo with the Holiday cup is at Loughborough Commons! Starbucks baristas are the best in customer service! They deserve more tips as they provide a needed service for a lot of us.
Tip: Order Hot Drinks including Lattes, short, or tall for the best flavor and longer-lasting heat!
Tip: Frappuccinos have the best flavor as a Grande!
Tip: Order Short brewed coffee or tea in the app. (Get 2 Stars per dollar) to build up your stars daily

This Starbucks is located within Temple University's Health Sciences Campus. I have frequented this Starbucks many times in the past and have had a variety of experiences, mostly pleasant. The staff is usually courteous, and the store itself is clean. There aren't many seating options, but most people tend to grab and go, so typically there are seats available if you'd rather sit and stay awhile. During my most recent visit, I just ordered a tall coffee. I tried paying through the app, but their phone scanner wasn't working. They were extremely apologetic and since it was just a coffee, they didn't make me pay. It was very kind of them, and they have excellent customer service. One thing you should know about this location, though, is that you can't take advantage of special offers through your app and they don't accept free drink rewards. You can still collect stars, though!

Sad to say this place is "my starbucks", the closest to my work. This is a collective review of the 3 or more times a week I usually visit. The staff here either hates their life or their job or both! Even though you're paying at least 6 bucks for your drink, don't expect it to taste gourmet at all. It's really disappointing that starbucks has gone so down hill. There is only one girl who is nice and friendly there, the rest act like you're bothering them. I ran into one other friendly chick who even had to remake my drink for whatever reason and she restored a little hope in me..however, I'm sure she's a borrowed partner bc she wouldn't last long in that store before they drained the positivity out of her! Guess I'll be traveling to the Ina store to get my fix. Sorry that those rude customers have ruined it for the rest of us who just want the delicious drink that we paid for.

Went in to the starbucks a week or two ago at the nugget to get a quick bite to eat. I was looking at the food in the display case and noticed there were fruit flies in the case so I let the manager Gabby know, to my surprise i was met with rude attitude from the manager as she coldly told me those are only for display so it didn't matter. I can't believe the attitude i received from the manager Gabby especially since i have known her father and mother for years. Gabby was far more interested in chatting with the supervisor on shift Taylor which is probably a given since they are family, which leads me to my next question why is there a supervisor working under her sister who's manager? Things like this is how you end up with poor customer service employing siblings in high up positions like this in the same department. They are far more interested in chatting with each other than listening to customer feedback.
Starbucks needs to get with the program at each location. I've never been charged for almond milk in my iced coffee before.
Always so fast! The staff is knowledgeable and friendly. Haven't messed up my order once.

Terrible staff and coffee at this location. 30 min to get a nitro cold brew. Ordered online... went to the bar 10 min after order to ask, and was told it was being made. 20 min later still no Nitro. Asked again and was told none of the mobiles were printed... so they blatantly lied to me. On top of it, probably one of the dirtiest drink making stations I have ever seen at a Starbucks. Seriously go anywhere else to get coffee!

As far as Starbucks go, this one is really nice! Stopped in after CycleBar next door because it was too convenient to pass up. 

The staff are especially kind and soft folks. 

Today, I wanted to try something I have never had before and went with their Jasmine Latte. It was a featured holiday latte that comes and goes with the holiday season. It was a little sweeter than I was hoping, but I am at Starbucks... so maybe I should get rid of those expectations for their flavored lattes. 

This location is really clean, and you can tell it's not just because it's new. The aesthetics are on point, I love the high top chairs that have the low back and the marble table tops. It's a nice touch. 

I also didn't know that Starbucks gives away complimentary grounds that you can use for composting or your garden. That's a nice idea if I stop in during the not-winter. 

Good stuff!

Fast efficient service, and they serve me what I like when I like it and how I like it. There's something about going into a good starbucks and getting exactly what you expect to get every single time.

I had above average service in this Starbucks. A pour over and a latte. They were busy too.

The latte was wrong but they fixed it all before the pour over was done. Drinks were all nice and hot. Yum!

We will be back

Starbucks in Newtown Pa. seems to be slacking in its cleanliness -  the trash is always overflowing and the counters are always a mess.  It doesn't take long to clean up every once in a while - not once a day.  Also I have been to other Starbucks in Hamilton NJ - Doylestown & Yardley and why is the Newtown Starbucks the only one that takes away the milk containers from the section where you fix up your coffee.  If these issues have been taken care of that's great if not, there is always Dunkin Donuts, or maybe it's time for a Saxby's to come to town.
1 barista, 3 people on register and 10 people around me waiting for their drinks. All I ordered was a tall cappuccino and its 4:30 pm on a Thursday. Need I say more?

I came to Starbucks more or less everyday for 3-4 years. Just came today after a long time. Look like nothing have changed. Terrible service! It's an busy location. Right on USciences campus. There is always a long line. I don't mind the line however, staff could be a bit more friendly.

This location has poor management. Myself and family frequent this Starbucks regularly but yesterday they were more busy than usually and forgot to give us an item.  My daughter went in to get it and their shift supervisor Jackie was completely rude to her.  I called and left a message for the Store manager Heather and she never returned my call.  Today I call back to reach her and she tells the guy that was on the phone with me "if she can't call back call corporate". You have lost our business and we will not come to your location anymore..... how rude and irresponsible as a store manager not to return a call and try to reconcile how your staff treated a customer!   I wonder you have such recent bad reviews ... it's a reflection of your leadership.  You need to do better!

I used to love this Starbucks but lately they have been messing up nearly every order. Yesterday I ordered an iced coffee unsweetened with an add shot and coconut milk and I got heavy cream, so I had to throw away a 5 dollar drink because of my lactose allergy. I asked the short brown haired girl to load my Starbucks card with my credit card and pay with my Starbucks card. Instead she loaded my card and paid with my debit so I didn't even get the stars for my drink I had to toss out. The time before that they sweetened by ice coffee, there have been other issues too. I'm gonna save myself the headache and go to another store for now on

This location seems the same as all the rest, only it is a bit more of a pain to get in and out of the parking lot.

I only come here for gift cards and the occasional beverage for my hubby/daughter. Each time, it seems to take a while even when there are few people in the place.

the friendliness of the staff is hit or miss. guess that is just part of the turnover effect.

Horrible. Horrible. Horrible. 

PREPARE to wait for at least 20 minutes for your drinks. If you go through drive through, expect to wait longer. We ordered 3 drinks 10 minutes before the getting there. Went through drive through to pick up the drinks and waited for 20 minutes to speak to someone and then as we pulled up, they were making our final drinks. So it took them 30 minutes to make 3 venti drinks. There was a lady behind me who was yelling saying HURRY UP. I mean this is ridiculous. Maybe this place needs to hire more people or they just need to be retrained but whatever the case is, the quality of service is getting worst and worst. Of course they apologize for the long wait here and there but how far can that actually get you? Why have a drive through when you have to wait 30 minutes for a drink? I think I am going to start going to DD once they're done the renovation. Only ONE guy works there and I never have to wait more than 10 minutes.

I always love to get a Grande, Vanilla Bean and a Venti, Black Ice Tea. 
It's a great place to study and do homework after school.

Super slow!!! But super friendly. There were only two cars in front of me and they didn't have a massive order or anything but it still took 15 mins to get my drink. That's a bit excessive for a drive thru. Sure, I could have mobile order (which I usually do) but this location said they were out of what I wanted on mobile app but really they were not out. My frap was melted and my tea looked like it was sitting around for awhile. I'm sure they made the drinks right away when I ordered. They just took a long time through the drive thru. Anyways, I'm sure I'll be back to this location if I'm in the area.

This Starbucks location is located in/next to the National Constitution Center which is a plus. 

No free/easy parking in the area so this spot is great for walking traffic.

The staff was nice.  They did not have cookies available so my son was disappointed.

I'll definitely be back.
Very unpredictable drive thru wait time. Sometimes it is normal but other times it is a parking lot. Right now it is a parking lot and it looks like about 20 cars. No movement for about 5 minutes

What a shining example of how a Starbucks should be ran. 2 days in a row, the drive through was quick and the people friendly. One girl started up a quick friendly conversation while we waited for our coffee at the window. Super sweet girl (I didn't catch her name, but she has a couple tattoos on her lower arms). I truly wish ALL Starbucks operates this efficiently and this friendly. Thanks!

Since moving to the new location we have had nothing but troubles with this location. Drinks needing to be remade sometimes two times before they get it right. Had an order placed the day before and when I showed up to pick up my order was not even communicated so I had to wait for them to make it. I kind of expected them to give me a free drink for having to wait but they didn't. I've asked for decaf and was up all night so that wasn't right. I just don't feel these newer baristas are being trained properly.
Literally the slowest Starbucks I've ever been too. Both times I've been here. Don't go through this drive thru unless you have 30 minutes to spare.

I've been getting coffee at the Starbucks Bellemeade location for several years without issue. Over the last 4 months they continue to have issues with orders placed on the mobile app. On three occassions I went into the store to pick up my order only to be told after waiting 10 minutes that the mobile order machine was down.  Another time my order was re-routed to the green hills store and on another order I was charged 3 times. Not sure what is going on here.  I was given the name of their regional manager, Brandon.   Just left him a message. I really hope things improve.

We always get friendly and professional service here plus properly made drinks. We buy a hot chocolate for my wife's manicurist each month and sometimes an espresso for myself. Thanks for being on point!

Life is good with espresso!

Women's bathroom was out of order, so there was a sign to request the key for the men's bathroom. I bought my $5.50 drink, requested the key, was told it was in use and to wait in line.
So I waited.
Did I mention that I'm 9.5 mos pregnant?
And I waited.

Then this guy comes around the corner, key in hand, steps in front of me and goes into the bathroom.  Grrrrrrrrrrrrrrr....

I finally get into the restroom and the TOILET SEAT IS BROKEN. Like hanging part of the way off the bowl.  Awesome. Thanks, Starbucks.  A new seat would be a $10 bill and about 10 minutes of work.  You have one bathroom at 15th / Market and you can't even have the decency to have one functional toilet seat?  I could see the headline as I hovered over the toilet seat "Pregnant Woman Falls Off Broken Starbucks Toilet, Gives Birth in Bathroom, Spills $5 Drink".
This is the newest Starbucks on the Main Line! It's the cleanest, has the friendliest, most informative staff, and the layout is perfect for working, studying or doing art!!!

They've remodeled and taken away 50%
Of the indoor seating.  People that go inside should be taken care of first .  If someone wants to sit in their car, let em wait.  But that drive thru is their cash cow. 
.,,, It's all set up for that.  The employees have good attitudes tho.

Exceptional service provided by Becca. She greeted us with a wonderful attitude and managed to knockout four drinks that were all different in a speedy amount of time. Kudos! She should be considered a trainer for her incredible knowledge and expertise! Thank you Becca!

I'm not really a coffee or latte fan, but Starbucks may have changed my mind. I had a sweet tooth today and remember that I had a $10.00 gift card from last week.

This location was very clean, but there was an odd smell in the store. Not sure if someone passed gas or someone didnt shower. I hope it wasnt the actual store.  I dont know... anyhow

The young lady at the counter was very helpful and friendly. She really made my experiece easy and fun. I didn't know what I wanted but she helped me choose the perfect drink! Simple French Vanilla with whipped cream on top. Yes, the good ole French Vanilla! I also ordered a Blueberry Muffin topped with Yogurt. My sweet tooth was satisfied today and I be back to this location very soon.

They are very slow. They show no urgency when they are busy. Walked in to get our drinks on a Sunday evening, it's not outrageously busy but they are at least 5 groups here with us...should be taking 5 mins. This Starbucks takes at least 20 mins for drinks every time. It's just inconvenient & not a good experience.

I just can't say enough wonderful things about this Starbucks location and the incredible staff!!! So many times I pull up to the Drive Thru and all I have to say is Good Morning and I am almost immediately recognized ..greeted by name and my usual order appears on the screen!  When I walk into the establishment I feel like Norm on Cheers... because 3-5 people shout out my name when I walk in! I feel special there to say the least!!!!! Even when they are swamped they move quickly and are so Friendly and professional!!!! LOVE MY PEEPS AT SPEEDWAY STARBUCKS!!!!!!!
Always a good stop on a hot afternoon after the movies .. Friendly staff and good service .. Cheers

Eh, store manager didn't want to scan my Rewards so I could get points for two drinks or approximately a $12 transaction...the process felt rushed and disappointed with the customer service. 

I got a Nitro Cold Brew w/a pump of Vanilla syrup. It was good - still sweeter than how I liked my coffee, but still enjoyable.

Honestly, wouldn't return and would hunt down the local coffee shop in downtown Safety Harbor vs. Coming here.

Customer service wasn't inviting so I'm def. Skipping as a result of my interaction...so disappointed the scanner wouldn't work to receive points or the fact the manager did the bare minimum to attempt to help me with the situation...No thanks!

My favorite starbs! Probably because it's super close to my house and the only one in the area with a drive thru :D The service here is always friendly and efficient, and they always get my order right! I'm lactose intolerant so it's super important I actually get my milk substitute!They do get pretty busy in the morning though, but that is normal. Definitely prepare ahead if you're pressed for time, but they also have online ordering so you can just order ahead and pick up!

Stopped here on our way back to California. The way that the Starbucks is placed makes it impossible to attempt the drive thru when it's busy...like most Starbucks. The 5 stars is for the exceptional and fast service this location provided. My drinks came out fast and my food a little after that. I recommend the pumpkin cream cold foam cold crew and bacon egg bites! Thank you Starbucks!

Last Saturday on 12/26/20 I visited this Starbucks through the drive thru. My sister got her beverage and I got my standard hot chocolate. There was a bit of a wait but that is standard for any Starbucks drive thru these days. The beverages were decent and the location on Easton Road (Route 611) is very convenient if not very crowded. Overall, it was a decent experience.

All downtown coffeeshops were closed, so went here. Got the nitro cold brew. No ice, slightly below room temperature, and zero "nitro". Tasted like very average coffee forgotten on the counter. Wife got an iced peppermint mocha that was 90% ice and tasted terrible.
Both were smalls, and bill was over $10. What a joke.

I dont get to go to Starbucks often, largely because it's not within my route to work. 

I had a mocha latte and it was delicious. I wanted something warm and soothing. 

The barista was pleasant and made my drink carefully. The atmosphere of this Starbucks was quiet. There were a few groups of people and they were not too loud.

I will return to this location.

This Starbucks is very often super busy. I have rarely come when the line is not a mile long. So I am so glad Starbucks came out with an order ahead option on their app. The seating can get a little tight, but usually you can get a seat. On the weekends, all manner of Newtownian folk come out, and it is hilarious to eavesdrop on their conversations. The nice thing is there is a large parking lot in the back, so access is easy.
